Yela tɔn loɡle Nɛra baa wola nɛnchɔɡa we-ɛɛla ta teŋɛ, baa wola waa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ ɛ ɛ, kɛɛ baa wola banɔ la baa dɛ mamɛ Korowii nɛɛ jae la, ba na som.
Ba sie dɛ lɛ Korowii waa ta, dɛɛ hweli o Mmara la chɔɔ ne jwaana.
Ba do kɛŋɔ daa baa duu bela waa sɔna, saŋ bɛlbwa o dɛ nɔnɛ o saŋ ta, o papooni ɡe aa chure bwa.
A ɡɛ nɛra la wobɛlbwa baa ɛ dɛ́ do wer.
Gɛ laa nɛnchɔɡa la te do, ba waa do kɛŋɔ haahra, peu yon ta dɛ́ kaa ane la ken.
Awola tɔpere Korowii aa bol nɛra waa la, nɛnchɔɡa aa won che o sie, baa nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛɛ ja.
Korowii dɛ nyiŋi nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛ, kɛ nɛnchɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre te, a dɛ kaa ba ne seo ta.
Kooro Korowii aa leo cheɡ tɛ o te Ɛrɛɛ harɛre nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ, lɛ ɡaeh, dɛɛ le jina dɛɛ koh ba te pɛɛ nɔɔ?
Ba koranar kpɔ ba te, dɛ ir che dɛɛ vɔrɔwe Korowii ne o kooro waa leo la vɔrɔwa.
Ba ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya lɛ ya te le ba lɔɡa, ásɛ ba bɛ won di kpeɡri ya nɛ.” Korowii soɡe o kookara ta nyundua dɛɛ mam ba, ba waa ɛ wesale o be.
O bol waa baɡ ba bandia kohona ne, dɛ aah ba ŋɔ, “N cheɡ n kooro n deŋɡare waa do ɡoroŋ Saayɔn ta.” Kooro la ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ bol waa Korowii aa bola la waa.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘N Biee hen, fini n berɛ he Mɛɛ.
Soŋ mɛ, mɛɛ kpɔ harɛre bwaa tɛɛ.
Hɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ kpeɡri ne, hɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ, ba yon paɡre vii burbur la ken.’ ” Anomanta, koranar, hé hweli wa, harɛre nomonome, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ, hé charɛ he liire, dɛ́ ba he te ne harɛ.
Hé kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii bie la, ásɛ o baah bɛ di dɛ́ chɔɡ heya.
O baah won dii saŋ bɛlbwa.
Nɛra baa chwaa kaa marɔ la bwa, ba na som.
Saŋ Kooro Devid aa chwaa le o bibaa Absalɔm be Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, n dɔma warɔ, ba warɔ dɛ che n nɛ.
Dɔma la ɡalɡa dɛ bol n waa ŋɔ, “Korowii aa on lɛɛ ba.” N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe.
N Naa Korowii, henee tɛ mɛ jirima, dɛ ɡel n dɔ hwɛɡa.
N wio no Korowii takpeɡ ne, asɛ o no n be o deŋɡare waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.
N dɛ chɔ dɛ́ chɔ dom kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ir ja, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛ.
N dɔma warɔ ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, maa ɔmɛ.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, ir nyu ne dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ!
N Naa Korowii, sɔɔh n dɔma nyoa.
N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ lɛ nɛra, swee andɛɛɡa tɛ he nɛra.
Jɔmɔra chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, he waa toɡrɔ, no n wesoŋa saŋ bɛlbwa.
Lɛɛ mɛ le n wahala ta, na n sum, dɛ́ no n wesoŋa.
Saŋ besoo he nɛra haa dɛ chɔɡ mɛ la ɛɛ ba ɡela ɔ?
Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba waa aa ɛ wepuu, ne nyosone waa ta teŋa ɡela ɔ?
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii le nɛn, o wa aa toɡra tɛ o te biɡri.
Saŋ bɛlbwa maa wi noo la, o dɛ no.
He bɛ ɡel he baah di bandichɔɡa he ɛ wechɔɡa, he ka chɔ dɛ lii a wa, saŋ haa chɔ he kalaŋre ta la.
He ɛ sarahare Korowii aa ŋɔa la ásɛ dɛɛ yaradao.
Nɛra warɔ dɛɛ soŋe ŋɔ, “Umee dɛ́ won ɡel yá dɔ wedɛɛɡa ɔ?” N Naa Korowii, na ya sum.
He ɡelɔ n dɔ silɛɛ kohona, ɡwaa silɛɛ nɛra yon dɔ, ɡɛ saŋ mea ne sen yon bu ba nɛɛ la.
Mɛɛ chɔ domii deŋnesɔɔhna ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ hen Korowiirii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ n nɛ.
Korowii nɔn kpɔe dɛ́ tɔ nɛn nɛɛ wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n wesoŋa, dɛ́ no n hima maa dɛ hime nɔ.
No n wii maa wia dɛɛ noe nɔ dɛ́ cha mɛ, henee n kooro ne Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, henee mɛɛ soŋe.
N Naa Korowii, chɔɔ bɛlbwa he dɛ no n taa.
Chɔɔbɔr n kpɔ n wesoŋa dɛɛ bil he sie, dɛɛ kpa ɡɛ haa chaŋ mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, he sie aa wechɔɡa ta lɛ, nyubinikpeɡ tena aa won ba he be.
Mbarafo tena aa won che he sie, he hah nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
He dɛ chɔɡ nɛra baa dɛ teŋe nyosone, he hah nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra, ne nɛra baa dɛ neɡre nɛra.
Kɛ n te, he nyina haa dɛ nyin mɛ kohona nomanta, mɛɛ won ba he Dea dɛ́ ba ɡuŋi, dɛɛ tomɛ he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ ta ɔmee ne.
N Naa Korowii, n dɔma warɔ kɛrɛdɛ!
Tɔ n sie ń ɛ anɔ la aa too he tea, ɡel n na he wa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Wobol aa le ba nyoo dɛɛ ba bwa ɛ nyosone, ba pɛla waa bwaa nɛra chɔɡa.
Nɛra neɡra dɛ́ kpoo ba ɡboo lɔ ba nyu bini, nɛra ɡboo baa neɡre.
N Naa Korowii, pa ba bole dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne, ɡel ba ɡbaɡba waa baa vɔrɔwa ɡure ba nyu ta.
Doŋ ba le he sie, ba wechɔɡa kohona ne ba deŋnekpeɡ baa dɛ ɛɛ la wa.
Gel nɛra baa chwaa baa marɛ sie lɛ, baa wonoo ɡo yela saŋ bɛlbwa ba sie lɛ.
Kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ nɛra he wa aa lɔ ba bambile ta la sie lɛ.
Kpela, Korowii he ɡelɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra na som.
He nyina haa dɛ nyin ba la tɔ ba ɡbemɡbe, dɛ bar ba cheme.
Nɛn waa lɔ wekpeɡa ta chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel he baah di hé pwaah mɛ, bɛ ɡel he baah di kohona hé tɛr n deŋne.
N Naa Korowii, n ɡwɛɡrɔ, n poori, na n sum.
N hoɡa bini bwa dɛ wee mɛ, chaah mɛ.
N bwadabii bwa dɛ wee mɛ taeh.
N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo he ba cha mɛ nɔ?
N Naa Korowii, ba lɛɛ mɛ.
Che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le seo ta.
Nɛn sewaa, waa he waa lii kpa.
Umee dɛɛ kpɛɛre lalabwɛ ɔ?
N pɛmɔ dɛ ba koh, jwaana bɛlbwaa n sinii ɛɛ yɔɔ mɛ kalaŋ ta, dɛɛ pweh n kapuri bwa!
Maa na kɛrɛdɛ kpa, wii dɔma aa ɡela mɛɛ wi nomanta.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, hé le n sie!
N Naa Korowii, no n wii.
O no n suna wii, wɛɛ sɛh n bee.
Sihiih ɛɛ kpo n dɔma bwaa ba bwara yɔr, ásɛ Korowii ɡel ba berɛ, dɛ́ den kpɔ baŋaɡola kaa.
Waa soŋa aŋwɛnɛ ta Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, n chwao baa marɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛ dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, dɛ́ le nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ nɔn ta, ásɛ ba bɛ n bini peeɡe kɛŋɔ nyujente, dɛ́ toɡri n bini nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛɛ mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, dɛ n ɛ nomɛlbwa wechɔɡa, dɛ di a bolchɔɡe, dɛ n ɛ nɛn n ne waa soma wechɔɡa, kɛɛ dɛ ɛ nɛn waa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ wechɔɡa pɛɛpɛɛ aa, ate, tɛ n dɔm ŋwɛnɛ ó dɔɔ mɛ lawɛ, dɛ́ kpo mɛ bil, ásɛ n sewɛ chɔ.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel he baah di.
Kpɔ ba che n dɔma ba baah aa di n nɛɛ kohona la nɛ.
Ir nyu ne tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ pa bole.
Gel harɛre nɛra bare cheme he do nyundua dɛ́ di kora ba nɛ.
Henee bol nɛwɛnyina bwa waa dɛɛ pa bole.
Nemenɛ Korowii, cha mɛ, dɛ́ bol n waa tɛ mɛ.
He jemɔ kɛŋɔ n tea too.
N Naa Korowii, he waa toɡrɔ, he jemɛ nɛwɛnyini bambile bini, ne o liire bwa wa.
Gel nyubinikpeɡ tena naɡrenyin waa bwa ba a jaɡa, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra ba wa aa toɡra do le.
Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, on dɛɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta.
Korowii dɛ bol waa aŋwɛnɛ ta kasinteŋ ne, dɛɛ pa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bolchɔɡe saŋ bɛlbwa.
Dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la ta ba liire charaa, Korowii ɛɛ sar o tokobii, dɛ́ harɛ o to kpa.
Korowii ɛ o dɔmkwaa anchɔɡa cheɡ, o hɛma ɡe nyoo ɛɛ lawɛ nii, dɛɛ kpa ɡɛ nɛra.
Na ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa!
Ba dɛ le jina dɛɛ neɡre nɛra.
Ba nafuɡere baa kwia la, ba ɡbaɡbaa dɛ́ le a ta, á laɡ ba.
Naɡrenyin waa baa liira la ɡure ba nɛ, waa baa ba a ne la, ba ɡbaɡbaa dɛ́ na a wa.
N dɛ jam N Naa Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o waa toɡrɔ.
Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii.
Korowii Jirima ne nɛwɛnyini jirima Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he sɔn kan harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa!
Nɛra dɛ kpɛɛre kohona, aa tel nyundua bwa.
Bechale ne bifola bwa ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛre he dɔma wa, dɛ ɡel dɔma ne nɛra baa kpɔ waa dɛɛ bɔ waa kem la nyoa sɔɔh.
Dɛ n ta sie dɛ nyiŋi nyundua, dɛ lii kwaa haa taa, ne ɡɛ haa kpɔ korobie ne weweela cheɡ a chebɔra aa, nɛwɛnyini ɡee bɔkwa, asɛ hɛɛ lii o waɔ?
Nɛwɛnyini ɡee bɔkwa, hɛɛ dawɛ o waɔ?
Tamaa kenii he ɡel nyundua toroma ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini, he ɡelɔ nɛn dɔ jirima asɛ komɛlbwa ɛɛ tɛo duure.
He ɡelɔ o dɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri a do o lɔɡa, peera ne nae, dɛ kpɔɡ bini ola bwa, ne jumbii aa lɔ nyundua, dɛ pɛŋa aa lɔ mpo bini, ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o bini bwa.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he sɔn kan harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa!
Jaama kpɔe dɛ́ tɛ Korowii o waa bola aŋwɛnɛ ta Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ kpɛɛre n bambile bwa nee, mɛɛ bol nyokpowaa haa ɛa bwaa.
He nomanta, mɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yelaa, dɛ́ hɛɡre.
Nemenɛ Korowii, mɛɛ kpɛɛ he sɔnee yela ne.
N dɔma nae naa, dɛ ba laa berɛ, dɛ́ choɡli dɛɛ serewe.
He waa dɔ kasinteŋ, dɛ bol n waa tɛ mɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta, he soɡe he kookara ta, dɛ bol n waa tɛ mɛ n di bole.
He pa voɡtoroma bolchɔɡe, dɛ chɔɡ nyubinikpeɡ tena, dɛ ɡel ba sɔna he harɛ nɔ ta kwaraa.
Ya dɔma heo, yaa ba waa lii kpa.
He chɔɡ ba bwɛjena, ya soh ba waa kwaraa.
Kɛ hen Korowii, he dɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa.
He kpɔ he kookara cheɡ, dɛɛ ba ba waa bola.
Hɛɛ bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa a toɡre, dɛ di kora aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Hen Korowiirii nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la chwa baa marɛ.
He do kɛ dekpeɡ waa balaa, nɛra chwa baa jo he be.
N Naa Korowii, nɛra baa jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ bwa ɛɛ yaradae, haa banɔ la baa dɛ nyin he bɔr la vɛh.
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii waa dɛ di kora Saayɔn.
Hé bol waa waa ɛa harɛre nɛra bwa be.
Hen Korowii dɛ lii nɛra ba bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ ba wa, haa wii baa dɛ wi waa soh.
He dɛ tɛr nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ nɛra wechɔɡa la deŋne.
N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ n dɔma aa cheɡɛ n nɛ, dɛ ɡel n bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ!
Sune n nɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le seo ta, ásɛ n che Jerusalam tena bwa sie, dɛ́ bol ba be waa bwa haa ɛa.
Mɛɛ hɛɡroo, lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.
Voɡtoroma kwi nafuɡe, dɛ ɡbaɡba le o ta, ba ɡbaɡba bel laɡ ba.
Hen Korowii cheɡɛ bole haa dɛ pa a toɡre la ta, dɛ ɡel nɛra jemɛ, nyubinikpeɡ tena ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla laɡ ba.
Seo chɔ le dɛɛ kpa nyubinikpeɡ tena, banee harɛre nɛra baa vɛh hen Korowii toma la.
Hen Korowii aa nɛra baa wola komɛlbwa dɔe waa soh.
He ta ɡelɛ nyaara hwɛɡa ɛɛ ta pɛɛ bwa.
N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne.
Bɛ ɡel nɛwɛnyini nyiŋi he nyubaah.
Ba voɡtoroma ne he sie, dɛ́ pa ba bolchɔɡe.
N Naa Korowii, aah ba, ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyinaa ban.
Korowii soŋa ó bol waa aŋwɛnɛ ta N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ n ne he baah do jaŋne ken nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ waa puu mɛ, he sɔɔh mɛ nɔɔ?
Nyubinikpeɡ tena mbarafo, ba cheɡɛ nyaara nɛ, ɡel ba liichɔɡa ɡure ba nyu ta.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena dɛ maŋkura ba te ba pɛlchɔɡa ta, nɛra baa dɛ nyin kafo dɛ bol Korowii bwara wechɔɡa dɛɛ vɛoh.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena waane laa Korowii wa, ba mbarafo, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ, Korowii waa ta hiaih.
Ba we-ɛɛla bwa dɛ do wer dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, baa ŋwɛnɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o ta, dɛɛ pa bole mun no, dɛɛ mamɛ ba dɔma.
Ba dɛ lii ba nyu bini ŋɔ, ba wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, wobɛlbwa aa ban pu bwa ɡe.
Nɛra taahna ne nɛra neɡra, dɛ nɛra aahra ɡboo ba bwa, wobochɔɡa ne musuwaa ɡboo baa bol.
Ba yon sɔh bwɛjeɡre dahare, dɛ́ pɛɡle dɛɛ kpaah nɛra baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó lɛɛ ba, dɛ́ kpoo.
Ba dɛ sɔh dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ nyujente ken, dɛ́ pɛɡle lawɛ nɛra baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó lɛɛ ba, dɛ́ laɡ ba, dɛ́ tɛɡ ba kaa.
Nɛra baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó lɛɛ ba la ɡwɛɡrɔ, nyubinikpeɡ tena la kpɔ ba bokpeɡa la pɔ ba nɛ.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena la yon lii ba nyu bini ŋɔ, “Korowii waane laa.
O laa sie kpɔ, waa yaa na bwa!” N Naa Korowii, tɛr nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔ deŋne, dɛ bɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra waa soh.
Ɛrɛɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ ba wona ɛ hen Korowii sisawa ɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ baa lii ba nyu bini kɛŋɔ, hen Korowii aa ba deŋnee tɛr ɔ?
N Naa Korowii, he dɛ na nɛra siswɛm ne lokua wa, dɛ yon dɛɛ cha ba.
He nɔn taa nɛŋɡwɛɡra kpɔ ba nyu dɛɛ do, hɛɛ cha ba saŋ bɛlbwa.
Sɔɔh kpeɡri nyubinikpeɡ tena ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɔa la nyoa, ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa, tɛr ba deŋne ka tel kɛŋɔ, baa ɡela kwaraa.
N Naa Korowii, henee kooro saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa ɛɛ heo le he harɛ ta.
N Naa Korowii, he dɛ no nɛŋɡwɛɡra wesoŋa, dɛɛ do ba ɡbemba, dɛɛ lɛ bilalbii ne nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba, dɛ́ bol ba waa tɛɛ ba ɡɛ aa ɛ nɛwɛnyini waa won sewa nɔ bɛ on aah kpa.
Yarada dɔe Korowii be Kooro Devid yel Korowiirii n chwa kaa marɛ, bɔkwa waa hɛɛ ba wona ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ir kɛŋɔ jumbie, dɛ́ kaa bwejen la ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nyubinikpeɡ tena harɛ ba tori kpa, hɛm la jaɡɛ to la ŋwɛn ta, ba sɔh biro ta, dɛ́ ta nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta.
Dɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena chɔɡ wedɛɛɡa ŋwɛnaa, ɛrɛɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta ɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?” N Naa Korowii lɔ o Dea waa lea cheɡ tɛ o te bini nyundua, dɛɛ di kora, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛwɛnyini bobɛlbwa, dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛ. O dɛ pese nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena, ne naɡrenyin tena te, o hah ba o bambile bwa.
Wɛɛ fuɡe ninhɔla, ne jebɔrɔwe niinii ta ɡɛ nɛra la nɛ, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne peuwɔb ne.
Korowii waa toɡrɔ, o dɛ nyin kasinteŋ.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ ba o nae.
Chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, lɛ yaa!
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra toole kpa, kasinteŋ diile tonɛ nɛra bini.
Nyosonee bɛlbwa teŋe dɛɛ tɛ o dɔŋ, nyokpɛlee ba kpɔ dɛɛ neɡre dɔŋa.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel nyokpɛl ne nyoo baa kpɔa dɛɛ bol wejena ba a jaɡa.
A ɡɛ nɛra la dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya nyoa ɛɛ yoo tɛ yaa.
Yaa bol anɔ la yaa dɛ nyinii.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ.” N Naa Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ bao, fiiɡa baa dɛ fiiɡi nɛŋɡwɛɡra, ne pɛma nyaara aa dɛ pɛmɛ la wa.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.” Korowii waa do chasee, dɛ do yaradae, kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ baa laa doŋa kpɔ o ta kera anuanɛ, o do wer kohona la.
N Naa Korowii, kpɔ nɔn tɔ ya nɛ, dɛ́ lɛ yaa le ɡɛ nɛra nɔ nɔn ta kwaraa.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena perɔ, dɛ valɛ dɛɛ ɡu, ba na waa aa wola were nɛra ɛɛ ɛaa, dɛ ba dɛ kpɛɛra.
Korowii chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba n waa soeh ka tel ɔ?
Hɛɛ soh n waa kwaraa kɛɛ?
Hɛɛ laa sie kpɔ n nɛɛ biɡri kɛɛ?
Saŋ besoo waa aa dawɛ n nɛɛ nɔ ɛɛ ba a jaɡa bala ɔ?
Bɛweeree tebinichɔɡ aa lɔ n nɛɛ chɔɔ ne jwaana nɔ, ɛɛ ba tona ɔ?
Saŋ besoo n dɔma pɔ n nɛɛ ka tel ɔ?
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, no n be dɛ́ cha mɛ, ɡel n do kpeɡri ja, bɛ ɡel ń sewɛ, a ba ɡɛ naa, n dɔma ɛɛ ŋɔɔ ba pɔ n nɛ, n horaa, baa hɛɡroo.
N kpɔ n te dawɛ he nyina waa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta, n sie dɛ lɛ, lɛɛ haa dɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ la ta.
N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre, kɛ haa ɛɛ mɛ wedɛɛɡa ɡa la.
Nɛwɛnyini nyubinikpeɡ wa Kooro Devid yel Gɛnaa yon dɛɛ lii ba nyu bini kɛŋɔ Korowii toole, ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, ba ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Korowii lɔ nyundua, dɛ ba sie ne harɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛwɛnyina kɛŋɔ bɛl dɔ wejema dɛɛ nyin o Korowii bɔr dɛ́ tomɔ.
Nomɛlbwa berɛ habɔɔ kpoo, nɛndɛɛɡe bɛlbwa toole ba bini, bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Amɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ hweli waa yaa?
Banee lawɛ n nɛra baa teŋɛ n nɛɛ dɛɛ liɡli kɛŋɔ kondikwa, baa wola men Korowii soŋe ŋɔ ń cha ba la.” Baa ɔmɔɔ ba bwara ɛɛ sa, jae Korowii aa ja nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la nɛɛ wa.
He wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, he dɛ tɔ nyaara we-ɛɛla ŋwɛnɛ, kɛ Korowiirii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ.
N dɛ soŋe Korowii waa lɔ Saayɔn kohona, kɛ o ba lɛ Israel tena!
Dɛ Korowii ɡelɔ Israel tena dɔ ba te ja aa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛo kohona ba hɛɡre!
Waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, nɛn besooree dɛ́ won jo he Dea ɔ?
Bamewaa dɛ́ won so Saayɔn waa ɛ he deŋɡare waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, dɛ́ tomɛ nɔ?
Naate waa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra, dɛɛ bol kasinteŋ o bambile bwa ne la, nɛn waa wola o dɔŋ wechɔɡe bol, nɛn waa wola o dɔŋ wechɔɡa ɛ, dɛ nɛn waa wola o dɔŋ waa kpɔe dɛɛ perɛ, nɛn waa hah wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, kɛ dɛɛ duu nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛ teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta, hale dɛ a kpeɡri tɛo kwaaraa noo, ne nɛn waa dɛ kemɛ suuɡa, waa wola a nee lɛ, ne nɛn waa wola sɛɛh baa yawɔ sen, dɛ di dansewea dawɛ nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ nɛ.
Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa la, o wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛo.
Hwɛɡa dɔe wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, he nɛɛ n sie dawɛ kɛ mɛɛ dɔ n nyuu.
N ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ.
He habɔɔ, n ta kondɛɛɡe bɛlbwa dɔe.” Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra harɛ nɔ ta la, ba waa wer n be kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ n bwara ɛɛ sɔɔh mɛ ba waa taeh.
Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la nyin waa dɛɛ dawɛ ba nɛ.
Maa ba nɛɛ ja kpoo kwaa tɛ ba voɡare bwa, maa ba voɡaree tomɛ bwa!
N Naa Korowii, henee n komɛlbwa, hen tɛ mɛ anɔ la maa dɛ nyin bwa, n kerekere waa bwa lɔ he nɔn ta.
He koŋkɛɛla haa tɛ mɛ wer kɛrɛdɛ!
A wer ɡa.
Mɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, on dɛɛ ja mɛ.
Jwaana kwara, n liire dɛ baɡ mɛ wa.
N dɛ na kɛŋɔ, n ne Korowii lole saŋ bɛlbwa.
Maa ɔmɛ bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o cheɡɛ n habɔɔ.
Anomanta, n sie lɛo mɛɛ jam hen Korowii, maa wobɛlbwa ɔmɛ kpa, tɔe haa dɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, dɛɛ le seo ta la wa.
Haa he Bidɛɛɡe waa soeh ba lalabwɛ, haa ɡel ó chɔ bɔɔ bini pɔh.
Hɛɛ baɡ mɛ mkpa ŋwɛnɛɛ.
N lɔ he sie naa, n sie dɛ lɛ, n bwara ɡe ɛɛ sɔɔh mɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra Wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, no nɛn n wa aa toɡra nɔ wesoŋa, no n wii maa dɛ wi nɔ.
Ken deŋne dɛ́ no n wesoŋa, nyosone laa mɛɛ teŋe.
Hɛɛ bol n waa tɛ mɛ, henee jemɛ waa aa wera.
He jemɛ n bambile bini wa, he ba n be jwaana, dɛ nyiŋi n waa bini, dɛ pese mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, he ta wechɔɡa nae n nɛ, n ɛ n liire kɛ, wechɔɡa aa n nyoa le.
Wobochɔɡaa n nyoa le, ɡɛ bane aa dɛ bol la, n no he Korowii waa la.
N ta naɡra we-ɛɛla bane aa dɛ ɛ la ta teŋɛ.
He ŋwɛnɛ taa mɛɛ valɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, n ta kee le o ta bwa.
N Naa Korowii, n wio dɛɛ noe, n jemɔ kɛ hɛɛ chaŋ mɛɛ, cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no n wesoŋa.
Baɡle he nyokpoa nyina waa do kan la, ásɛ n chwa le n dɔma be ba marɛ.
Tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe kɛŋɔ, haa dɛ tɔ n siwinyiŋi ta la, kpɔ mɛ sɔh he kena lɔɡre kɛŋɔ, jal yon lawɛ o bii do lɔɡa la ken.
Lɛɛ mɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena baa dɛ nyin ba yoo mɛ nɔn ta, n dɔma baa bar mɛ, dɛɛ nyin n kpoe la be.
Baa nɛn sum na, mbarafo wobolee baa bol.
Ba bar mɛ cheme, bobɛlbwa maa kpɔ la, dɛ ba lole, dɛɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ, dɛ́ taɡ mɛ ɡo.
Ba do kɛŋɔ nyujente lɔr aa dɛ kpoo, wɛɛ nyin ol dɛ́ lawɛ, dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ toɡri n ola.
N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne, puu ba, dɛ́ ba ba ne harɛ, kpɔ he tokobi, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.
N Naa Korowii, che he kpeɡri ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire, dɛɛ nyin ba soɡa bini kwaa la nɔn ta.
Banɔ la haa dɛ nyin ba waa la dɔ kondikwaa kohona, ba bii dɔ ane di dɛ́ vaɡɛ, ásɛ ane ka ba naanar ɡe ba dɔ.
N waa aa toɡra nomanta, mɛɛ nae, n chɔɔ ir aa, n sie ɛɛ lɛo kohona, ń na ɡɛ haa doa.
Dɔma nɛɛ pɔe yel Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ta tea tɛɛ dɛ́ nyin he wa, henee n Kpeɡnɛn.
N Naa Korowii, he do kɛŋɔ Bwetal, maa chwaa kaa marɛ, ne danjwɛkpeɡ hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he do kɛŋɔ Bwetal, maa chwaa kaa marɛ.
Henee dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, dɛ ɛ n kpeɡnɛn.
N wio no hen Korowii waa chɛ kpɛɛra la, asɛ he lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ta.
Seo vɔɡ mɛ bil, asɛ nehɛma aa kpeɡa lɔ dɛɛ kpɔ n nɛ.
Seo bela bar mɛ cheme, lalbɔɔ hah nyoa dɛɛ kpaa mɛ.
N wahala bini n wio no hen Korowii ŋɔ hé lɛɛ mɛ, n wio no hen Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ ŋɔ, hé cha mɛ, he no n taa he Dea la bini, n wii la tel he be, asɛ he no.
Harɛ jiɡro dɛ yiiɡi, asɛ bwejena mune jiɡri.
Korowii bandia waa a bwa ɛ ɡɛ.
Ninchuu le o mebɔɔne bini, ninlao aa dɛ chɔɡ kwaa le o nyoa, ninhɔla aa dɛ fuh kwaa ɡe ɛɛ le o nyoa.
O forɔ le nyundua ba harɛ, baama aa bira kpirkpir do o nakpale lɔɡa.
Kerobim taa o so dɛɛ ɡah, peu kena taa o kpɔ ba.
O kpɔ biro bɔle o bwa, baama aa bira kpirkpir, tenɛ bwaala, dɛ baro cheme.
Bɔr nyɛɡlɔ le baama la bini tɔ o sie, asɛ dombwea ne ninlao, ɛɛ le bela aa dɛ nyɛɡle la ta.
Nemenɛ Korowii bol waa nyundua, a do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra ken, asɛ ba no o taa bobɛlbwa.
O ta o hɛma, o dɔma peɡre, o ɡelɔ bwaala nyɛɡle kohona, ba chwa kaa.
N Naa Korowii, nyɛɡa haa nyɛɡ he dɔma nɛ, ne he bandia kohona nomanta, a ɡelɔ mpo vile bwa hweeh dɛ chɔ pɛɛ, harɛ mumpar ɡe chɔ pɛɛ.
He ha nɔn le nyundua dɛ laɡ mɛ, dɛ tɛr mɛ le vile bini.
He laɡ mɛ le n dɔma baa kpeɡa nɔn ta, nɛra baa hah mɛ, dɛ do kpeɡri ɡwaa mɛ.
Ba cheɡɛ n nɛɛ kɛ bá chɔɡ mɛ, ɡɛ saŋ maa lɔ wahala ta, kɛ hen Korowii, he cheɡɛ n habɔɔ.
He cha mɛ dɛ le n ne wekpeɡa ta, he lɛɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ he sie lɛ n nɛ.
Korowii bɔ mɛ kem ɡɛ n wa aa toɡra, o swee andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole n nɛ.
N teŋɛ Korowii waa ta, n ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛ vɛoh.
N teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa ta, n ta waa waa do mɛ a ta la ta leɛ.
O ta n bwara waa dɔe dɛ bol bwa, n laa n te kpɔ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta.
Korowii bɔ mɛ kem ɡɛ n wa aa toɡra, dɛkalkɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole n nɛɛ o be.
N Naa Korowii, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ nɛn o tea aa toa, he waa wer kɛrɛdɛ dɛ tɛ nɛn, wechɔɡa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ.
Nɛn o tea aa toa la, onee he dɔ tepoŋ tɛ, kɛ he dɔ wejema ɡwaa nɛn waa dɔ baradeɛre.
He dɛ lɛ nɛra baa pwɛra, kɛ mbarafo tena te, he dɛ ba ba ne harɛ.
N Naa Korowii, henee ɡela bɔr chaah n sie mɛɛ na, he ɡelɔ n le biro ta ba bochaah ta.
He tɛ mɛ kpeɡri n won yo n dɔma, dɛ cha mɛ n jah ɡale ba danjwɛjen baa maa bar ba bwɛ.
Korowii te, o ŋwɛnɛre bwa wer, o waa bwa toɡrɔ.
O do kɛŋɔ ɡbemɡbe, dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa chwaa baa marɔ.
Ya Naa Korowii habɔɔ, bɛlbwa toole.
O ɡboo ɛ Bwetal dɛ́ won tɔ ya nɛ.
Korowii tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa, dɛ ɡel n ŋwɛnɛ do wer mɛɛ kpɔ o ta.
O ɡelɔ n nakpala do kɛŋɔ welo kwaa ken, dɛ ɡel n won bwejena dor cheɡa.
O baɡ mɛ n won laa yoi, asɛ n won to waa do kpeɡri tae.
N Naa Korowii, he tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe dɛ lɛɛ mɛ, nyiŋa haa dɛ nyiŋi n nɛɛ la ɡelɔ n do kpeɡri, asɛ he kpeɡri ɡel n dɔ n te.
He kwaa ŋwɛnɛ o do paɡri tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n bɛ naa lɔ.
N ti n dɔma dɛ ka puu ba, n kpoo ba mɔɔ dɛ laa berɛ.
N lɔ ba bil, baa wola won ir kpa ba serewe chɔ n sie.
He tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa n won laa yoi, dɛ sɔɔh n dɔma nyoa n pɔ ba nɛ.
He ɡelɔ n dɔma berɛ habɔɔ, dɛ chwa le n sie, asɛ nɛra baa hah mɛ la, n kpoo ba.
Ba wio dɛɛ nyin lɛɛ, kɛ nomɛlbwa toole, ba wio no hen Korowii, he ta ban chaŋɛ.
N nam ba, ba ɛ kɛŋɔ tutuɡ peu aa taa dɛɛ kaa ane ken, dɛ sa ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, fɔɡbaah kpechɛɡre.
He lɛɛ mɛ le nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ bini, dɛ ɡel mɛɛ di kora harɛre nɛra nɛ, nɛra maa wola ban jemɛ laanee dɛɛ tom mɛ.
Baa dena no n waa ba no n be, nɛŋhɔɔhra pwɛr ba te dɛ baa ɡuŋi n sie.
Ba hwɛɡa bwa tonɔ, ba kpɔ bochela le ba dekpeɡa bini dɛɛ ba.
Korowii lole kɛrɛdɛ!
Korowii waa do kɛ Bwetal la, hé kpɛɛro!
Onee n chwa kaa marɛ.
Hé ɡel Korowii waa dɛ lɛɛ mɛ la sɔn le.
Korowiirii tɔ n wel tɛ mɛ, o kpɔ harɛre nɛra do n nɔn ta.
N Naa Korowii, he lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma bini.
He laɡ mɛ le nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ bini, he lɛɛ mɛ le nɛnchɔɡa nɔn ta.
Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɛɛre harɛre nɛra bwa bee, mɛɛ yerɛ he sɔnee, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛre.
Kɛŋɔ haa tɛ he kooro kpeɡri kohona, o pɔ o dɔma nɛ, dɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin nɛn haa leo, ó ɛ Devid ne o naanar kon, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la la.
Korowii jirima waa dɔa Kooro Devid yel Nyundua dɛ baɡle kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɔ jirima, kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ɡe bwa ɛɛ chaɡle ɡɛ tenten, toma Korowii aa ɛa.
Tɔpere bɛlbwaa aa na Korowii jirima, jwaana bɛlbwa ɡee aa na o wejema.
Aa waa bol, nɛraa a waa no.
Kɛ a webaɡla do kɛŋɔ wobol, dɛɛ tel harɛre bwa ta, asɛ a waa ɛɛ tel harɛ jaɡa bwa.
Korowii kwaa bɔr nyundua bela tɛ wee, o le bela dɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ, hanfale jaa sie aa lɛa, kɛɛ nɛn o sie aa beɡra wɛɛ ba chwae dɛ́ lɛ komɛl la ken.
Wee dɛ le nyundua baŋ bɛl, dɛ ɡale ba kaa baŋ bɛl.
Komɛlbwa aa won laa on kpɔ le o nyɛɡre la ta.
Korowii Mmara wer, dɛɛ tɛ bokpeɡfale, Korowii waa waa dɛ do yaa a ta chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ ya te dɛɛ dawɛ a ta, a ɡelɔ banɔ la baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ la ɛɛ jemɛ wa.
Korowii Mmarare toɡrɔ, dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa dɛ teŋɛ a ta silɛɛ.
O waa waa dɛ do yaa a ta wer, dɛɛ pili nɛn sie.
Korowii ɔma wer ɡa, aa do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii waa bola dɛ́ pa bole ɛ kasinteŋ dɛ toɡre.
O waa bola dɛ́ pa bole dɔ tɔnɔ, dɛ ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm tenten, a torodi dɛ ɡwaa tohno baa wola komɛlbwa a ta koore.
A cheɡɛ a ta men maa ɛ he torome ɛɛ dɔ wejema, dɛɛ dɔ kembɔr a ta teŋa ta.
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ o ɡbaɡba wechɔɡa waa ɛaɔ?
N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡa maa wola jemɛ dɛ ɛ la ta.
Lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡa maa saahna ɛ ta, bɛ ɡel a lɛ n liire.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel n waa do wer, ásɛ n dɔ n te le wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel n nyoa wobol, ne n liire ɛɛ lɛ he sie, henee n Lɛɛ, dɛ do kɛ Bwetal maa chwaa kaa marɛ.
Dɔma nɛɛ pɔe wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, no he wii he wahala ta, Kórowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ la, kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛ!
Ó che o Dea bela dɛ́ chae, ó tɛɛ kpeɡri le Saayɔn Bwejen ta.
Ó lii sarahare haa tɛo bwa, ásɛ dɛ lɛ sarahare haa fuah tɛo la.
Ó tɛɛ komɛlbwa he bambile aa lawa, dɛ́ ɡel waa haa dɛ maɡle bwa do wer tɛɛ.
Ásɛ ya kpɔ silɛɛ moo, pɔe haa pɔ ya dɔma nɛɛ la wa, dɛ́ ir ya fraŋkaare, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ sɔn ta.
Kórowii no he wesoŋa bwa.
Name, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ tɛ nɛn waa leo kɛ kooro kpeɡri, wɛɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛ.
O dɛ sɛh o be nyundua bela waa do ɡoroŋ la, dɛ che o kpeɡri ta, dɛ ɡel o yo dɛɛ le.
Nɛra bane dɛ hwɛɡɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ta, bane ɡee hwɛɡɛ ba jaɡre nɛ, kɛ ya te, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la nɛɛ yaa hwɛɡɛ.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛɛ lɔ naa, dɛ́ choɡli, kɛ ya te ɛɛ iruu, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ.
N Naa Korowii, cha kooro ó pɔ o dɔma nɛ!
Dɛ ya wio noe naa, no ya be!
Dɔma nɛɛ pɔe kpɛɛra Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, kooro dɛ hɛɡre bokpeɡa haa tɛo wa.
O sie lɛo kohona pɔe haa ɡela o pɔ o dɔma nɛɛ la wa.
He tɛo kwaa o bambile aa lawa, he sɛh waa waa soŋa ta tɛo.
He swee andɛɛɡa tɛo kohona, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kooɡbɛrɛ tenten piu.
O soŋe mkpa, asɛ he tɛo mkpajaŋ waa wola jaɡa dɔe.
He chao o pɔ o dɔma nɛ, dɛ ɡel o ɛ nɛnjen, dɛ tɛo sɔn o dɔ jirima kohona.
Kasinteŋ, he swee andɛɛɡa aa wola jaɡa dɔe tɛo, dɛ ɡel o do he sie o sie ɛɛ lɛ.
Kooro la dɛ hwɛɡɛ hen Nemenɛ Korowii nɛ, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ɡelɔ o dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna saŋ bɛlbwa.
Kooro ɛɛ kpɔ o nɔnee dawɛ o dɔma bwa nɛ, wɛɛ lawɛ nomɛlbwa waa haoh laanee.
Korowii baa forɛ le aa, wɛɛ chɔɡ baa kɛŋɔ, nii yon fuh kwaa a chɔɡ la.
Korowii baah ɛɛ diu kohona, ó chɔɡ ba bwa, dɛ́ ɡel nii fuuh ba kwaraa.
Ba naanar bɛlbwa aa kae ba, kooro la ɛɛ kpo ba bwaa.
A lole kɛ ba chemo dɛ yon dɛɛ vɔrɔwe kooro vɔrɔwa, baa won ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ́ pɔ o nɛ.
Wɛɛ harɛ o too ba nɛ, ásɛ ba berɛ habɔɔ dɛ́ chwa kaa.
N Naa Korowii, ya dɛ kpɛɛre he kpeɡri kohona wa, yaa ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre a wa.
Weweele wii ne Korowii kpɛɛra Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii!
N Naa Korowii!
Ɛrɛɛ he chwa mɛ nɔɔ?
N do lɔŋɔ sum ne ŋɔ hé cha mɛ, kɛ maa wobɛlbwa na.
N Naa Korowii, n wio dɛɛ noe chɔɔ haa men chaŋe, dɛ wi dɛɛ noe jwaana, kɛ n bwara aa men sɔɔh.
N jemɔ kɛ he ɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ dɛɛ di kora, henee Israel tena ɛɛ kpɛɛ.
He nɛɛ ya naawa hwɛɡɛ, ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ he nɛ, asɛ he lɛɛ ba.
Ba wio noe, asɛ he lɛɛ ba le siswɛm ta, ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ he nɛ, he ta ɡelɛ a ɛ pɛɛ.
N ta nɛn ɛɛ kpa, n do kɛ sɔɡlɔ, nɛra baa hah mɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi n nyubaah.
Nɛra na mɛ naa, ba dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, dɛ di n loro dɛɛ viiɡi ba nyuune.
Ba ŋɔ, “He kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛ, ɛrɛɛ waa wola hen lɛɛ yɔ?
Dɛ Korowii dɛ nyini naa, ɛrɛɛ waa wola hen chae yɔ?” Hen Korowiirii ɡela ba lol mɛ, n taa ɛ bechasɔɔhna dɛɛ ɔr la, he nyiŋi n nɛ, dɛ tɛ mɛ bosɔɔhna.
Awola baa lol mɛ bwaa n le kpɔ n te dawɛ he nɛ, he ɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Bɛ ɡel n ne he baah do jaŋne!
Waa puu mɛ tonɛ, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ cha mɛ.
Dɔma warɔ dɛ bar mɛ cheme, kɛŋɔ Basan harɛ nabala a bwara aa kpeɡa ken.
Ba hah nyoo kɛŋɔ nyujentena, dɛɛ kɔɡre, dɛ́ toɡri n ola.
N bokpeɡa tonɔ kɛŋɔ, baa fuɡe nee ta harɛ ken, asɛ n hoɡa bwa soɡre, n bambile chɔɡ, n ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe kpa.
N ta bokpeɡa dɔe kɛŋɔ kaŋli ken, n nyondoŋe marɛ n nyoa, hé ɡel mɛ ń sewɛ ka chɔ lalabwɛ.
N dɔma bar mɛ cheme, kɛŋɔ nyootena aa wara dɛ tɔ mɛ do baah ta, dɛɛ toɡri n nɔɔra ne nakpale.
N ka hoɡa ɡbo, n dɔma nyiŋ mɛ dɛɛ mamɛ.
Ba ta chacha n laala wa, dɛ bɔna kpɔ.
N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel n ne he baah do jaŋne!
Henee n kpeɡri, ba warane dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛ le tokobi seo nyoa.
Lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma baa do kɛŋɔ nyootena nɔ nɔn ta.
Lɛɛ mɛ n dɔma baa do kɛ nyujentena nɔ nɔn ta, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma baa do kɛ, nabala nyeɡlare nɔ nyoa.
Mɛɛ bol he waa haa ɛa n nɛra bee, mɛɛ kpɛɛree ba chema binii.
“He banɔ haa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la, hé kpɛɛro!
Jekɔb naanar, hé kpɔ duure tɛo!
Israel tena, hé tomɔ!
Korowii aa nyaara vɛh ba wenaale ta, waa habɔɔ berɛ dɛɛ kpo ba, ba wio noo waa, o dɛ cha ba.” Mɛɛ kpɛɛre nɛnlaa tenten baahnee, nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ siee mɛɛ ba kwaa kpoora ɛ saraha tɛɛ, ɡɛ maa baɡɛ nyoa la.
Nyaara ɛɛ di kwaa vaɡɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin, nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii ɛɛ kpɛɛroo.
Kórowii ɡel bá dɔ silɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la!
Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ lii Korowii waa dɛ́ kpɛɛro, baa le harɛ jaɡa bwaa, dɛ́ ba o be, harɛre nɛra bwa ba ɡuŋi o sie.
N Naa Korowii ɛ kooro, dɛɛ di kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo bwa ɛɛ ba tomɔɔ, nɛwɛnyina bwa ɛɛ ba ɡuŋuu.
Naanar baa ka ba bwa ɛɛ tomɛ Korowii, dɛ́ bol o waa baɡle ba biirere ne ba naanar.
Bii baa wola ban lolɛ mɔɔ kwaraa ɛɛ ba noo kɛŋɔ, “Korowii lɛ o nɛra.”
Korowii waa dɛ nyiŋi ya nɛ Kooro Devid yel Korowii do kɛ peteɡre dɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛ, komɛlbwa aa men nya.
O ɡelɔ mɛɛ chɔ bela kpɔɡlwɛɛ aa lole, dɛ tɔ n sie dɛɛ kaa nee aa wera ta.
O dɛ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡfala, dɛ tɔ n sie dɛɛ baɡ mɛ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡa, o sɔnjen la wa.
Hale n dɛ valɛ biro tenten bini kwaraa naa, maa ɔmɛ, dɛkalkɛ he ja n nɛ, he daŋɡbala haa kpɔa dɛɛ teɡɛ peera laanee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ bosɔɔhna.
He ɛ kondikonjena cheɡ n sie, n dɔma bwa siwi ta.
He fuɡe noo do n nyu ta, dɛ ɡel n numol su dɛɛ ta.
N jemɔ kɛ he waa wer hɛɛ nyin mɛ nomanta, hɛɛ ja n nɛɛ n soɡa bini tɔpere bɛlbwa, ásɛ n so hen Korowii Dea, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Koojen la wa Kooro Devid yel Korowiirii dɔ harɛ nɔ ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta, hale nɛwɛnyina bwa sekwara.
Onee pa harɛ mun o chɔŋɛ nee sie, dɛ ɡel kwaa aa lawɔ kpoŋe che viljena ta.
Umee dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ teeh kaa Korowii Dea, bela waa do ɡoroŋ ba le cheɡ dɛɛ tomɔ la ta nɔ?
Nɛn o we-ɛɛla aa wera, o tea to waa wola voɡa tomɛ, kɛɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ saɡasaɡa.
Gɛ te laanee Korowii ɛɛ ba andɛɛɡa sweera tɛ dɛ́ lɛo, dɛ́ pao bole.
Gɛ nɛraa dɛɛ nyin Korowii be bala, Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ la be.
Hé ya doonyojena la kohona, hé ya saŋ la doonyoo la, ásɛ Koojen waa dɔ jirima la ba jo.
Umee Koojen waa dɔ jirima kohona nɔɔ?
Onee Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ do kan, dɛ ɛ banyoo laa yoi ta la.
Hé ya doonyojena la kohona, hé ya saŋ la doonyoo la, ásɛ Koojen waa dɔ jirima la ba jo.
Umee Koojen waa dɔ jirima kohona nɔɔ?
Nemenɛ Korowiirii, onee Kooro waa dɔ jirima kohona la!
Korowii nɔn kpɔe dɛ́ tɔ nɛn nɛɛ wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, he nɔn taa n kpɔ n nyu dɛɛ do, Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ.
Bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ, kɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel n dɔma pɔ n nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ kpɔ o te dawɛ he nɛ, he ɡel sihiih kpoo bwa, kɛ banɔ la baa vɛh he waa pɛɛpɛɛ la te, sihiih ɛɛ kpo baa.
N Naa Korowii, baɡ mɛ he ŋwɛnɛre, ásɛ n jemɛ dɛɛ kpɔ a ta.
Baɡ mɛ he kasinteŋ waa la mɛɛ teŋɛ a ta, dɛkalkɛ henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he ɛ n Lɛɛ, he nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa.
N Naa Korowii, lii he suna kohona, ne nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la wa, saŋ la bwaa a le, dɛ ba le fini.
N Naa Korowii, bɛ n bonɔɔne saŋ wechɔɡa, ne deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla lii.
Che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ta, dɛɛ lii n wa, dɛkalkɛ he waa wer.
Korowii wer, o waa toɡre, o dɛ baɡle wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe baa kpɔ o ta.
O cha nɛŋɡwɛɡra baa ɛ wa aa toɡra, dɛɛ baɡ ba o ŋwɛnɛre.
Korowii dɔ nyina, o waa dɔ kasinteŋ, wɛɛ tɔ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la ta siee.
N Naa Korowii, a lole kɛŋɔ n wechɔɡa kan te, koh he sɔnjen la wa dɛ́ kpɔ kɛ mɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ duu Korowii la, wɛɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛɛ baa kpɔ o ta.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba saŋ bɛlbwa, ba naanar kpɔ harɛ la ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.
Nɛra baa dɛ duu Korowii la, o kpɔ ba ɛ o daamanar, o ɡelɔ o ne ba fɔo baa fɔwa la che kiŋkiŋ.
N sie dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa kɛ ó cha mɛ, onee dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le wekpeɡa ta.
N Naa Korowii, berɛ sie n be, dɛ́ sune n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n ɡwɛɡrɔ, n ta nomɛlbwa dɔe ó cha mɛ.
Laa waa aa dawɛ n nɛɛ kpɔ n nɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale bwa ta.
Nyiŋi n suna dii ne n bonyɛɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ n wechɔɡa bwa kɛ mɛ.
Na n dɔma wara baa wara, dɛ hah mɛ kohona.
Kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ, bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ, henee n chwa baa marɛ.
N dɛ soŋe, ɡel kasinteŋ ne wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ tɔ n nɛ, he nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ.
N Naa Korowii, lɛ he nɛra Israel tena le ba wenaale bwa ta.
Nɛndɛɛɡe wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, nyiŋi n waa bini dɛ́ pa mɛ bole, dɛkalkɛ n waa toɡrɔ, he nɛɛ n den kpɔ n te dawɛ.
N Naa Korowii, nyiŋi n bini, dɛ́ daah mɛ na dɛ́ pese n we-ɛɛla ne n liire.
He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa laanee dɛɛ baɡle mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, he kasinteŋ ɡe ɛɛ tɔ n sie.
N ne nyosonteŋna aa darame kpɔ, n ne nɛnchɔɡa toole wobɛlbwa bini.
N hah wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bini joe, n ne nyubinikpeɡ tena aa so.
N Naa Korowii, n sarame nɔɔra, a baɡle kɛ n ta bolchɔɡe bɛlbwa dii, dɛ ka valɛ bar he saraha kon la dɛɛ tomɛ.
N ɡo yela kohona dɛɛ kpɛɛre, dɛɛ bol he nyokpowe-ɛɛla bwa wa.
N Naa Korowii, bela haa soɡa dɛ do n wer, bela he jirima aa lole la.
Bɛ pɛ chɔɡ n ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, bɛ men kpo ja nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra nɛ, ba bee wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa bwa le, dɛ ɡel baa yaɡ ba sen tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Kɛ n te, n waa toɡrɔ, sune n nɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ!
N cheɡɛ bodɛɛɡe, nɛra ɡalɡa binii mɛɛ ba hen Korowii kpɛɛra.
Kpɛɛra wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel Korowii do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah mɛ, dɛ ɛ n Lɛɛ, maa nomɛlbwa ɔmɛ.
Korowiirii ɛ n Kpeɡnɛn n chwa kaa marɔ, maa ɔmɛ bwa.
Dɛ nɛnchɔɡa balɔ ba lɔ tɔ n nɛ dɛɛ nyin bá kpo mɛ naa, baa lɔ naa dɛ́ choɡli.
Dɛ laa tena bar mɛ cheme aa, n bambile aa teŋe.
Hale n dɔma ba dɛ yoo mɛ kwaraa naa, hen Korowii nɛɛ n hwɛɡa ta do.
N Naa Korowii, kombeŋkpoŋii n soŋe dɛɛ le he be, ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin laanee kɛŋɔ, ń so he Dea n soɡa bini bwa, dɛ́ nyiŋi ɡɛ he wa aa wera dɛ́ kooɡa, dɛ́ soŋe, he nyiŋi n nɛ.
Hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ n wenaale tɔpere, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ he Dea dɛ́ laɡ mɛ sɔh bela, dɛ́ kpɔ n naa cheɡ bodɛɛɡe.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel n baŋa pa, n dɔma baa bar mɛ cheme la nɛ.
Mɛɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛɛ he Dea bela silɛɛ lɔŋɔre ne, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛre.
N Naa Korowii, n dɛ yerɛ naa, no n wii, na n sum, dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ!
He fa ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ba dɛ ba tom mɛ,” asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ bao, bɛ he te kpɔ sɔɔh mɛ.” Bɛ ɡel he baah di men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛ.
Henee dɛɛ cha mɛ, bɛ men vɛh, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, henee n Lɛɛ.
Hale dɛ n mɛɛ ne n nya ɛɛ vɛɛh mɛ kwaraa naa, hen Korowii te ɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛɛ.
N Naa Korowii, baɡ mɛ he ŋwɛnɛre, tɔ n sie, dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta, dɛkalkɛ n dɔma warɔ.
Bɛ men ɡel tɛ n dɔma, ba teŋe nyosone dawɛ n nɛ, dɛ nyin mɛ naɡra, dɛɛ aah mɛ.
N dɔ hwɛɡa hen Korowii nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, mɛɛ soo, dɛ́ jemɛ he wedɛɛɡa haa dɛ ɛ.
A chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ ya te dawɛ hen Korowii nɛ, dɛ́ lawɛ bambile, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he siwi ta.
Chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii haa do kɛ Bwetal dɛ che n habɔɔ, henee n wi dɛɛ yerɛ.
No n wii maa dɛ wi nɔ!
He laa deŋna kpɔ n be naa, mɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa ka chɔ lalabwɛɛ ken.
No n wii maa wia dɛɛ noe nɔ, dɛ́ cha mɛ, sune n nɛ, dɛ́ no n wii, maa ɡɔɔ nɔɔra nyundua chaɡɛ he Dea dɛ́ soŋe, bela waa do ɡoroŋ la.
Bɛ pɛ pa n ne nyubinikpeɡ tena bolchɔɡe, nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, ba nyoa wobol som ba bala be, kɛ dɛ dɔ liichɔɡa ba nyu bini la.
Tɛr ba deŋne ba we-ɛɛla, ne ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa wa.
Bɔ ba kem ba we-ɛɛla baa ɛa bwa wa, ɡɛ aa chɛa.
Ba siwi aa waa Korowii aa ɛa tɔɡɛ, kɛɛ kwaa waa taa bwa.
Anomanta, wɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba kwaraa!
Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o sune n nɛɛ dɛ no n wii.
Korowiirii dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe dɛ ɛ n Kpeɡnɛn, o nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ, wɛɛ cha mɛ.
N dɛ hɛɡre n bambile bini, mɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yelaa kpɛɛro.
Korowii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra nɛ, dɛɛ tɛɛ ba bokpeɡa, o do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ, dɛɛ lɛ kooro waa leo cheɡ.
N Naa Korowii, ba lɛ he nɛra, dɛ́ swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba.
Nyiŋi ba nɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre kaa saŋ waa wola jaɡa dɔe.
Korowii taa waa kpeɡa wa Kooro Devid yel Nyundua toroma, hé kpɛɛ Korowii, hé kpɛɛ o jirima ne kpeɡri waa dɔa wa.
Hé baɡle kɛŋɔ o sɔn la dɔ jirima kohona, hé tomɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ, dɛ dɔ jirima kohona la.
Korowii taa bɔle mpo ta, Korowii waa dɔ jirima kɔrɔ kɛŋɔ bwaala ken, a ka le mpo ta bobɛlbwa.
Korowii taa kpeɡri, dɛ do kan, dɛ dɔ jirima kohona.
Korowii taa kpeɡri dɛ won peleme daa kuuɡa, hale dakpeɡa aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn.
O taa ɡelɔ Lɛbanɔn bwejena ɛɛ yiiɡi kɛ nabiiri aa dɛ jah, Hɛmɔn Bwejen ɡe do kɛ nabale waa dɛ jah.
Korowii bol wa, a do kɛ bwaala aa nyɛɡla.
O taa ɡbo ɡelɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ jiɡri, o ɡelɔ Kades pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ jiɡri.
Korowii taa yiiɡi dakpeɡa, dɛ chure kɔr bini daa papooni ta.
Asɛ nɛra baa lɔ o Dea ɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ jirima tɛ Korowii!” Korowii dɛ di kora mpo vile ta, o dɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ o nɛra bokpeɡa, dɛɛ swee ba andɛɛɡa, dɛɛ tɛɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna.
Korowii jaama wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ kpɛɛree, dɛkalkɛ he lɛɛ mɛ, he ta ɡelɛ n dɔma mam mɛ.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, n wio noe kɛ he cha mɛ, asɛ he chaah mɛ, dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le seo ta, he ta ɡelɛ n kaa lalabwɛ.
Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro, hé kpɛɛ o sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la.
O baah diu waa, aa biɡri dɛ o sɔɔhnɔ, kɛ o nyina waa dɛ nyin nɛn lole saŋ bɛlbwa.
Yaa won dɛɛ wi jwaana, kɛ tɔɔ ne pera dɛ silɛɛ ɡboo.
N fa aa dɔ bosɔɔhna la, n ŋɔ, “Wobɛlbwa aa won ɛɛ mɛ.” N Naa Korowii, haa sune n nɛɛ la, he ɡelɔ n che kiŋkiŋ kɛŋɔ bwejen ken.
Kɛ haa laa sie kpɔ n nɛɛ la, n ɔmɔ kohona.
N Naa Korowii, henee n wi dɛɛ yerɛ, n soŋe kɛ he na n sum ŋɔ, “Dɛ n sewɔ ba huɡ mɛ naa, tɔnɔ besoo aa ba lee dɛ́ tɛɛ nɔ?
Nɛn sewaa, wɛɛ won kpɛɛre ja aa?
Wɛɛ won bol he wedɛɛɡa, aa wola jaɡa dɔe la waa ja aa?
N Naa Korowii, na n sum dɛ́ no n be.
N Naa Korowii, cha mɛ!” He ɡelɔ n suna dii berɛ silɛɛ, mɛɛ sa, dɛ ɡel n soh n wii, dɛ kpɔ silɛɛ tɔ mɛ kɛŋɔ yal.
Anomanta, maa nyoa tɔ, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa dɛ́ kpɛɛre.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, mɛɛ kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii yaradae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, henee n chwa baa marɛ, bɛ ɡel n di sihiih, che toɡra he wa aa toɡra ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.
Cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no n be, dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ warane.
Do kɛŋɔ Bwetal, ń chwa ba marɛ, ɛ danjwɛkpeɡ dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.
Haa do kɛŋɔ n Bwetal n chwa baa marɛ ne danjwɛkpeɡ nɔ, ba tɔ n sie, dɛ́ baɡ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, he sɔn la wa.
N dɔma har mɛ bela, lɛɛ mɛ le a ta, dɛkalkɛ henee n chwa baa marɛ.
He nɔn taa n kpɔ n lileo do, N Naa Korowii, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ, lɛɛ mɛ.
N hah nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe nɛ, kɛ hen Korowiirii mɛɛ yarada.
N sie ɛɛ lɛo dɛ́ hɛɡre, nyina haa dɛ nyin mɛ la wa, dɛkalkɛ he na n wahala, dɛ jemɛ n weweele.
He ta ɡelɛ n dɔma dɔɔ mɛ, he kpɔ n naa cheɡ bodɛɛɡe.
N Naa Korowii, na n sum, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ na wahala kohona, wii kohona ɡelɔ maa na kɛrɛdɛ, n bwadabii bwa ɡwɛɡre.
Suna dii ɡelɔ n ɡwɛɡre, wii kohona ɡelɔ maa won biɡri kohona.
Wahala nae ɡelɔ n ɡwɛɡre, hale n hoɡa bini sɔɔhnɔ.
N dɔma we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ n bala aa men komɛl yerɛ.
N daamanar bwa dɛ ɔm mɛ, ba na mɛ fɔɡbaahna aa, dɛ ba dɛ chwa.
Ba soh n waa kɛŋɔ, maa sewa ken, n do kɛŋɔ vii waa paɡra.
N noɔ nɛra ɡalɡa ɛɛ ŋwalɛ ŋɔ, ɔmee kohona chole n nɛ.
Ba dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa, dɛ́ kpo mɛ.
Kɛ n Naa Korowii, henee mɛɛ yarada, henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ.
Saŋ bɛlbwa, n lɔ he nɔn ta, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma, ne nɛra baa dɛ nyin bá chɔɡ mɛ nɔn ta.
Sune men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛ, che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ, henee n wi dɛɛ no.
Gel sihiih kpo nyubinikpeɡ tena, ba serewe ka chɔ lalabwɛ jeiih ken.
Gel nyosonteŋna la nyoa sɔɔh, mbarafo tena baa wola waa bu, dɛ bol wobochɔɡa dɛɛ yaɡɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ la, he kwaa kondɛɛɡa aa wera cheɡ ba.
Nɛra baa chwaa baa marɛ la, he kpɔ waa aa wera dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
He kwaa ba dɛɛ sɔh he lɔɡa, dɛɛ le vɔrɔwa nɛnchɔɡa aa dɛ vɔrɔwe ba waa la wa.
He laɡ ba dɛɛ sɔh he lɔɡa bela haa soɡa, dɛɛ lee ba ba dɔma chɛɡa nyoa.
N Naa Korowii, henee dɔ jam, dɛkalkɛ he baɡle he nyina kohona n nɛ, ɡɛ saŋ n dɔma aa bar mɛ cheme la.
N ɔmɔ dɛ lii kɛŋɔ, he doŋ mɛ le he sie.
Kɛ maa wia noe ŋɔ he cha mɛ la, he sune n nɛ, dɛ cha mɛ.
Korowii nɛra he wa aa toɡra, hé baɡle he nyina o nɛ.
O kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ nɛ, kɛ mbarafo tena te, o dɛ tɛr ba deŋne ɡɛ aa chɛa.
Nɛra haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ bwa, hé lawɛ bambile, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ.
Wechɔɡa bola ne a kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ Kooro Devid yel Nɛra Korowii aa kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, waa wola a waa lii kpa la, ba na som.
Nɛn Korowii aa wola o wechɔɡa waa lii kpa, nyosone bɛlbwa aa wola toole o bini la, o na som.
N fa aa wola n wechɔɡa maa ɛa bolɛ la, n wio tɔpebir bwa, dɛ ba koh.
N Naa Korowii, chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa he tɛr n deŋne, asɛ n bokpeɡa bwa tonɛ, kɛŋɔ wee yon lɔ bobɛlbwa hol hwel saŋ la.
Asɛ n bol n wechɔɡa baɡle, n ta kpɔe sɔeh.
N liiro kɛ mɛɛ boloo baɡle, ásɛ he kpɔ a bwa kɛ mɛ.
Anomanta, ɡel nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ ɛɛ soŋe ba wahala nae saŋ, ásɛ dɛ wenaale do kɛŋɔ nee waa sua dɛɛ ba naa, o bɛ won tel ba be.
He bee n chwa baa sɔh, hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ le sibeɡra ta.
Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre, lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛ aa chɛ kɛ he kpɔ o ta, mɛɛ bol waa baɡle, dɛ́ kpɔ n nɔn tɔ he nɛ.
Bɛ ɡɛn kɛŋɔ jaaɡɔ kɛɛ keeɡo, ba yon kpɔ kabaɡrare do o nyoa, mɔɔ o jemɛ waa o dɔɔ aa dɛ nyin kɛ o ɛ la.” Nyubinikpeɡ tena wenaale warɔ taeh, kɛ Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la, dɛ tɔ nɛn waa dɛ yaradao la nɛ.
He nɛra he wa aa toɡra, hé ɡel he sie lɛ hɛɛ hɛɡre, waa Korowii aa ɛa la wa.
Nɛra haa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta la, hé do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ ne.
Korowii kpɛɛra yel Nɛra he wa aa toɡra bwa, hé ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ Korowii waa waa ɛa wa, nɛra haa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta bwa, hé kpɛɛro.
Hé lɔ janjela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé kpɔ koŋkwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ bwa soo siwi, lɔ yela kpɛɛro.
Hé ɡo yelfale tɛo, hé lɔ janjela kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ moo silɛɛ ne.
Kasinteŋ lɔ Korowii waa ta, o waa waa dɛ ɛ bwa wer.
Korowii dɛ nyin wa aa toɡra dɛ do wer, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe lɔ harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ.
Nyoa wobol nee Korowii ta nyundua, ne kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa.
Onee ɡela mpo boa nyoa chɔ bobeŋkpoŋ, dɛ kwaa a vile cheɡ kɛŋɔ, paa yon kwaa kondikwaa cheɡ dɔndɔŋ bini la.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra, hé tomɛ Korowii, hé kpɔ duure tɛo.
Nyoa wobol nee Korowii ta harɛ, asɛ komɛlbwa do le, dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa ŋɔa.
Korowii chɔɡ harɛre nɛra vɔrɔwa baa vɔrɔwa, o lɔ waa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe bwa ta.
O wobɛlbwa waa vɔrɔwa dɛ che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, o liire aa charɛ bwa, a lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra baa kpɔ Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ, o lee ba tɛ o te la, ba na som.
Korowii soɡe nyundua, dɛɛ na nɛwɛnyina bwa harɛ ta.
O soɡe bela waa dɛ di kora, dɛɛ na nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
Onee tɛ nɛwɛnyina liire, dɛ jemɛ waa baa dɛ ɛ bwa.
Kooro laa tena wara laa ɡela o yo laa dɛɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛ, banyoo kpeɡri laa ɡela o yo dɛɛ le.
Jaɡre baa soɡe a ta dɛɛ yo, aa won ɡel nɛn pɔ o dɔm nɛɛ laa ta, a bokpeɡa kohona laa dɛ́ won lɛ naate.
Korowii sie lɔ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta, nɛra baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ta la.
O lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le seo nyoa, dɛ́ ɡel ba so le, hale lɔr saŋ.
Ya hwɛɡa bwa lɔ Korowii nɛ, onee dɛɛ cha yaa, dɛɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe.
Ya dɛ hwɛɡɛ o sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, anomanta, ya dɛ hɛɡre.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ba ya nɛ, he nɛɛ ya kpɔ ya hwɛɡa bwa do.
Korowii duura Kooro Devid yel Mɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii saŋ bɛlbwaa.
Maa o jaamaa ɡel bwa.
Mɛɛ kpɛɛro n bambile bwa nee, ɡel nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba no, ba sie lɛ.
Hé ɡel n ne he bwa kpɔ jirima tɛ Korowii, yá ɡɔɔ o sɔn.
N soŋe Korowii, asɛ o chaŋ mɛ, dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le ɔmewa bɛlbwa ta.
Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛɛ sie dɛ lɛ, sihiih aa ban kpo bwa.
Nɛŋɡwɛɡra wio no Korowii, o no ba be, dɛ lɛɛ ba le ba wenaale bwa ta.
Korowii nyundua torome dɛ daah nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, dɛɛ lɛɛ ba.
Hé daɡɛ Korowii waa la, dɛ́ na kɛ o wer, nɛra baa chwaa kaa marɔ la, ba na som.
Korowii nɛra he wa aa toɡra, hɛ́ɛ duuru, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta la, ba dɛ dɔ komɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.
Lɔr ɛɛ won kpo nyujentena a ɡwɛɡre, kɛ banɔ la baa dɛ no Korowii be la, kondɛɛɡa aa ban paŋɛ.
N bii, hé ba dɛ́ ba cheɡ deŋne no n be, mɛɛ baɡle heyaa ɡɛ haa kpɔ duure tɛ Korowii.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin mkpajaŋ, dɛɛ nyin kɛ o bwara sɔɔhno la, wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi o nyoa kɛrɛdɛ.
O bɛ wobochɔɡa dɛɛ bol, o bɛ nyosone dɛɛ teŋe.
Wɛ́ɛ ke o te wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Ó swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ ba nyopɛo ne.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛɛ su Korowii siwi la, Korowii dɛ nyiŋ ba, dɛɛ no ba wesoŋa.
Kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra te, o kii ba, ba sewaa, baa ba waa lii kpa.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra wio no Korowii aa, o dɛ no, dɛ lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le ba wahala bwa ta.
Korowii dɛ bɛne banɔ la ba bambile aa chɔɡa, dɛɛ lɛ banɔ la baa wola hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ won na wahala kohona, kɛ Korowii lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le a bwa ta, Korowii dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, ba hoɡ beŋkpoŋ kwara aa ku.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ laanee dɛɛ kpoo ba, nɛra baa hah nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɡe ɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra.
Korowii ɛɛ lɛ o nɛraa, wɛɛ lɛ banɔ la baa chwaa kaa marɔ laanee.
Chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, kpɔ nɛra baa ɛ n dɔma la ɛ he dɔma, ka yo nɛra baa dɛ yoo mɛ la.
Kpɔ he dɔmkwa tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, ásɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.
Kpɔ he lampea ne kpanfɛ, dɛ́ yo nɛra baa dɛ ti mɛ la.
Baɡɛ nyoa kɛŋɔ, hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ.
Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo.
Nɛra baa dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa la, ɡel ba wili, dɛ́ berɛ kaa.
Gel ba do kɛŋɔ haahra peu aa taa dɛɛ kaa a ne la ken, Korowii nyundua torome teŋɛ ba nɛ dɛ́ɛ kaa.
Gel biro ba tɔ ba ŋwɛnɛ ta o do vɔle, Korowii nyundua torome la teŋɛ ba nɛ.
N ta ban wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba har mɛ bel, dɛ forɛ bɔluŋ, dɛ́ laɡ mɛ.
Gel ba ne jara, dɛ wenaale ba ba nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba ɡbaɡba bel la laɡ ba, ba lee bɔluŋ la bini dɛ́ serewe.
Ásɛ Korowii nomanta, n sie lɛ, dɛɛ hɛɡre, o lɛɛ waa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.
Mɛɛ le n bambile bini bwaa dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, umee do kɛ hen ɔ?
He lɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra dɛɛ le nɛŋkpeɡa nɔn ta, dɛ lɛ nyaara dɛɛ le nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba nɔn ta.” Nɛnchɔɡa teŋe nyosone dɛɛ dawɛ n nɛ, waa maa wola a waa jemɛ laanee baa bɔɔ mɛ.
Wechɔɡaa ba kpɔ dɛɛ bɔ mɛ wedɛɛɡa kem, a ɡel n sie aa lɛ, n bambile chɔɡ.
Ba bwara fa aa dɛ wee ba la, lweyalee n kpɔ tɔ, n vɔwɛ nyoa, n ta kwaa dii.
N ba harɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba kɛrɛdɛ, ɡɛ n fe aa soŋe tɛ n dam kɛɛ n nime.
N bambile chɔɡɔ mɛɛ wi, kɛŋɔ maa dɛ wi n nya seo waa ken.
Kɛ wenaale aa puu mɛ la, ba sie lɛo, dɛ ba bar mɛ cheme, dɛɛ di n loro.
Ba teŋɔ do mɛ hɔhɔrɔwa kohona, baa wola n nɛɛ sune.
Ba do kɛ nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ, dɛ cheme dɛɛ mam mɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋ mɛ sichɔɡa ne.
N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ nyiŋa ka tel ɔ?
Lɛɛ mɛ le yoi baa dɛ yoo mɛ nɔ ta, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma baa do kɛ nyujentena nɔ nɔn ta.
Ásɛ n kpɔ jam tɛɛ he nɛndamanta baa chema bini, nɛnlaa baahnee mɛɛ ba he kpɛɛra.
Bɛ ɡel nɛra baa hah mɛ pɛɛpɛɛ la di n loro, bɛ ɡel ba sie lɛ, n suna maa dɛ di nɔ ta.
Baa waa aa ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne bol, nyosonee ba teŋe dɛɛ dawɛ, nɛra baa wola ba bwara ne waa nyin nɛ.
Ba dɛ pwaah mɛ ŋɔ, “Ya na waa bwa haa ɛa.” N Naa Korowii, he na ɡɛ waa nɔ, bɛ nyoa tɔ.
Bɛ bojaŋ kaa ɡel mɛ.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ yo tɛ mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, che toɡra he wa aa toɡra ta, dɛ́ pa mɛ boldɛɛɡe, bɛ ɡel n dɔma mam mɛ.
Bɛ ɡel ba lii ŋɔ, “Ya dɔɔ ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyin name!” Kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya dɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ.” N Naa Korowii, ɡel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ mam mɛ kohona, ásɛ dɛ wili, n wahala maa dɛ na wa.
Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛ ba ɡwaa mɛ kohona.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel banɔ la baa dɛ nyin n di boldɛɛɡe, ɛɛ do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ ne.
Ásɛ baa bol ŋɔ, “Korowii kan ɡa, o sie lɛ o bonɔɔ wer waa doa ta.” Belaa mɛɛ ba toɡra he wa aa toɡra la waa bola, dɛ́ kpɛɛre tɔpebir bwa.
Nɛwɛnyina nyubinikpeɡ wa Kooro Devid yel Korowii waa lɔ n bambile bini, dɛɛ baɡle nyubinikpeɡ tena wechɔɡa wa.
Baa Korowii ɔmɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa duuruu.
Ba dɛ lii ba nyu bini kɛŋɔ ba ɛ nɛnjena nomanta, Korowii aa ba wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ la nae ba, dɛ́ pa ba bolchɔɡe.
Nyubinikpeɡ ne nyosone waa baa bol, ba ta wedɛɛɡa liire dɔe kpa.
Ba chɔ ba chɔɔbɔra kwaraa naa, baa wobɛlbwa aa wera ɛ, baa wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɡe vɛh.
N Naa Korowii, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ɡwaa komɛlbwa, he kasinteŋ waa ɡe ta jaɡa dɔe.
He wa aa toɡra la jaŋne kaa nyundua kɛ bwejena tenten ken, he bole pae bini do luŋri kɛŋɔ mpo vil, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛwɛnyina ne ola bwa nɛ.
Na ɡɛ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe aa wera!
He kena lɔɡree ya chwa baa sɔh, kɛŋɔ jal yon lawɛ o bii, do o kena lɔɡre la.
He tɛ yaa kondikwa a warɛ yaa di he dem, dɛ tɛ yaa he wedɛɛɡa, a do kɛ nee waa dɛ palɛ yaa nyɔ.
He nɛɛ ya che dɛɛ dɔ mkpa, he nii laanee ɡela bɔr chaah yaa na.
Teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ he waa ta, dɛ́ɛ ɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra andɛɛɡa.
Bɛ ɡel mbarafo tena ba yoo mɛ, kɛɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena la doŋ mɛ.
Na ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa chola, ba taɡ ba ta, baa wola won ir kpa.
Korowii nɛɛ hwɛɡa Kooro Devid yel He bɛ ɡel nyubinikpeɡ tena we-ɛɛla we he nɛ, he bɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwara we.
Baa biɡri hol kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken, dɛ́ piɡri serewe kɛŋɔ, kpɔɡlwɛɛ yon hol la.
Hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛ, dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, ásɛ dɛ so harɛ la ta deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
Hé ɡel he sie ɛɛ lɛ Korowii nɛ, ásɛ o tɛ heya he bambile konnyina.
Hé kpɔ he waa bwa do Korowii nɔn ta, hé kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛ, ásɛ o cha heya.
Wɛɛ che toɡra he wa aa toɡra taa, ásɛ he kasinteŋ dii do kɛ nii, dɛɛ chaah kɛŋɔ webaŋa ken.
Hé lawɛ bambile, dɛɛ kpa Korowii, dɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena waa wer dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aa, he bɛ ɡel a we he nɛ kɛŋɔ aa chiɡ ba kɛrɛdɛɛ.
Hé laa he te kpɔ tebinichɔɡ ne bandia ta, wechɔɡa ɡbo taa aa kaa nɛn ne.
Nɛra baa dɔ hwɛɡa Korowii nɛɛ la ɛɛ dɔ harɛɛ dɛ́ so o ta, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena te, baa doŋ ba le o ta.
Aa biɡri dɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena toole kpa, hɛ́ɛ baa nyin ba bɔree, kɛ háa ban na.
Nɛra baa pwɛr ba te la, ɛɛ so harɛ la taa, dɛ́ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna kohona.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena dɛ vɔrɔwe nɛra ba wa aa toɡra vɔrɔwa, dɛɛ nyiŋ ba sichɔɡa ne.
Korowii dɛ mamɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena, o jemɔ kɛŋɔ ba chɔɡa tɔpere telo tonɛ.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena kpɔ ba tokobie, dɛ harɛ ba tori kpa.
Ba dɛ nyin bá kpoo nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, kɛ ba ɡbabir tokobie dɛ́ kpoo ba, ba tori kuuɡi.
Ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta cheɡa dɛ́ dɔ konjeɡa wer dɛ ɡwaa, kɛ haa cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta dɔa kohona, dɛkalkɛ, Korowii ɛɛ sɔɔh nyubinikpeɡ tena nyoa, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛ.
Korowii jemɛ nɛra wechɔɡa aa wola toole ba nɛɛ wa, baa dɔ harɛ laanee ó ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Baa wahalaa na sibeɡra saŋ, lɔr saŋ kwaraa yaa, dɛ ba te dɔ kondikwa.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ serewoo, nɛra baa ɛ Korowii dɔm la do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa wola biɡri la ken, baa nyoɡroo kɛŋɔ ninchuu ken.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena kemɛ kon aa, ba dɛ vɛh bɔe, kɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra te aa nɛra kwaa tɛɛ ɡel bwa.
Nɛra Korowii aa swee ba andɛɛɡa la, ɛɛ dɔ harɛ laanee, kɛ banɔ la waa taah ba la te, wɛɛ doŋ baa le o ta.
Korowii sie lɛ nɛra we-ɛɛla ta naa, o dɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ o ta, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ.
Ba lɔ naa kwaraa naa, baa chole, dɛkalkɛ o laɡ ba kpoŋe.
N fa ɛ bechala, dɛ ba ɛ banjena, kɛ n ta nae kɛŋɔ Korowii laa nɔn kpɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛ, kɛɛ ba bii valɛ dɛɛ soŋe kondikwa.
Ba won kwaa kɛɛ, dɛɛ kemɛ ba bala ja, ba bii ɛɛ dɔ andɛɛɡa.
Hé ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛ́ɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, ásɛ he so harɛ la ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ́ɛ la.
Waa aa wera dɛ toɡre laanee Korowii ɛɛ nyin, waa nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ laanee ɡel.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ ba nɛ, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena naanar te, wɛɛ doŋ baa le harɛ la ta.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la, banee dɛ́ dɔ harɛ la ta so, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nyoa wejemwaa do, ba nyoa waa aa wera ne kasinteŋ do.
Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ Mmara lɔ ba bambile bini, baa an kpɔe dɛɛ ta bwa.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena dɛ kpaah nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, dɛɛ nyin ba dɛ́ kpoo, kɛ Korowii aa ɡel ba di kpeɡri ba nɛ, kɛɛ ba di bolchɔɡe, ɡɛ saŋ wa aa puu ba la.
Hɛ́ɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛ, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo hé dɔ harɛ la ta so, dɛ́ doŋi nyubinikpeɡ tena la he siwi ta.
N na nyubinikpeɡ te waa wola nɛn nɛɛ sune, o soɡa bini do wer kɛŋɔ, daa waa kpeɡa harɛdɛɛɡe ta ken, kɛ a ta biɡre bɛlbwa, o den sewɛ, n ɡaaɡe o bɔr, n ta on nae.
Hé nyiŋi nɛra ba wa aa toɡra na, ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ba kerekere soɡa bini.
Kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa ɛɛ serewoo, ba naanar aa kae ba harɛ nɔ ta.
Korowii dɛ lɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, dɛɛ lɛɛ ba ba wenaale ta.
O kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ, dɛɛ lɛɛ ba, o lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta, dɛkalkɛ, onee ba chwa kaa marɛ.
Bonyɛɡa wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel he baah di he pwaah mɛ, bɛ ɡel he baah di kohona, he tɛr n deŋne.
He ta he hɛma yaɡ mɛ, dɛ lɔ mɛ bil.
He bandia ɡelɔ n bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ mɛ, n wechɔɡa nomanta, n bwadabii bwa ne weelaa.
N wechɔɡa ɡwaa n nɛɛ kohona, a do kɛ bontɔɡa maa wola won che.
N wechɔɡa aa ɡela n ɡɛn nomanta, n ŋwɛra pɔɔh, dɛ do sɔɔh.
N weweele ɡwaa n nɛ, a ɡel maa won che, dɛɛ wi tɔpebir bwa kɛŋɔ, nɛn waa dɛ ɛ lwe ken.
N nyaŋ dɛ nyaa mɛ, dɛɛ wee mɛ, n bokpeɡa tonɛ.
N ɡwɛɡrɔ, n bwara bini bwa sɔɔh, suna dii ɡel mɛɛ pɛmɛ.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡbabir jemɛ n waa bwa aa chɔ he sie, he dɛ no n pɛma maa dɛ pɛmɛ bwa.
N bambile dɛ lɔ, n bokpeɡa tonɛ, n sibie ɡe aa na kɛrɛdɛ kpa.
N daamanar ne n soma bwa chwa mɛ n ŋwɛra wa, hale n lolanar bwa ɡe chwa mɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo, haɡre mɛ bela, nɛra baa dɛ nyin n chɔɡa dɛ́ aah mɛ, tɔpere bɛlbwaa baa vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa, dɛ́ chɔɡ mɛ.
N do kɛ nɛn o deŋne aa wola waa no, kɛŋɔ amumu maa wola won bol wa.
N do kɛ nɛn waa wola waa no, ba bol wa waa wola won chaŋe la ken.
Kɛ N Naa Korowii, he nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, henee dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ.
Bɛ ɡel n dɔma mam mɛ n wenaale wa, bɛ ɡel n chola ɛɛ ba silɛɛ.
N dɛ ba chola, wee n bwara aa dɛ wee mɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa wa.
N dɛ bol n wechɔɡa, a ɡelɔ mɛɛ ɔmɛ kwara.
N dɔma warɔ, dɛ do kpeɡri, ba warɔ, dɛ hah mɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Nɛra baa kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ bɔ wedɛɛɡa kem cheɡɛ n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra.
N Naa Korowii, bɛ habɔɔ berɛ kpo mɛ, Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, bɛ bojaŋ kaa ɡel mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, henee ɛ n Lɛɛ, ba warane, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.
Nɛn o bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ wechɔɡa bola Kooro Devid yel N lii n nyu bini ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ nyiŋi n ŋwɛnɛre ta kɛrɛdɛɛ, maa ɡel a che n nyoa wobol ta, n ɛ wechɔɡa.
Nɛnchɔɡa bɛn mɛ naa, maa wobɛlbwaa bol.” Kɛ n fa aa tɔ nyoa maa wola wobɛlbwa bolɛ, n ta wedɛɛɡe bɛlbwa ɡe bolɛ la, a taa n bonyɛɡa ɡwaa n nɛɛ kohona.
N bambile chɔɡɔ kohona, maa ŋɔ ń kpɔ liire la, name tenee a yon ɡwaa, asɛ n ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, chaɡ mɛ saŋ maa so ka tel, ne n tɔpera aa ka n sie.
Aa biɡri dɛ n sewɔ.
He ɡelɔ me mkpa do bori, a ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ he siwi ta, nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa mkpa do kɛŋɔ peu he be.
Nɛwɛnyini mkpa do kɛŋɔ lileo, ba wobɛlbwa ɛ wepuu.
Wɛɛ nyin kondɔɔh cheɡ kohona, kɛ waa jemɛ naate aa ba ɛ o kwa.
N Naa Korowii, bɔkwaa mɛɛ nyin taraken jaɔ?
N hwɛɡa bwa lɔ he nɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛ le n wechɔɡa bwa ta, bɛ ɡel nɛra baa ɡɛna dɔɔ mɛ, dɛ́ mam mɛ.
N tɔ nyoa name, maa wobɛlbwaa bol kpa, henee ɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ.
Bɛ n deŋne tɛr kpa!
He deŋnetɛra la ɡwaa n nɛ.
He bol wa bandia ne, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tɛr ya deŋne, ya wechɔɡa wa, ɡɛ dudul yon di kon dɛ chɔɡo la, ɡɛɛ he chɔɡ ya kondɔɔh, nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa do kɛŋɔ peu ken.
N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, no n wii dɛ́ cha mɛ, bɛ he deŋna laa kpɔ n be.
N do kɛŋɔ hɔɔh harɛ nɔ ta he sie, kɛŋɔ ya naawa bwa fa aa ɛa la.
Laa sie kpɔ n nɛ, ásɛ n sie berɛ lɛ ja, mɔɔ n sewɛ le harɛ nɔ ta.”
Kpɛɛra yel Kooro Devid yel N wio no Korowii, dɛ lawɛ bambile dɛɛ kpao, asɛ o na n sum, dɛ no n wii.
O laɡ mɛ le lalabwɛ waa do kɛŋɔ bɔluŋ ta, n le seo nyoa.
O kpɔ mɛ ba chɔŋɛ bwetal ta, n bwara sɔɔh mɛ, asɛ n che kiŋkiŋ.
O kpɔ yelfale do n nyoa, kpɛɛra yel waa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la kan. Nɛra ɡalɡa ɛɛ na waa waa ɛa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛ.
Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ la, ba na som.
Nɛra baa wola mbarafo tena we-ɛɛla nyiŋi, kɛɛ baa wola voɡa tomɛ la.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, nyokpowe-ɛɛla haa ɛa la warɔ ɡa.
Yaa won baɡle wejena haa vɔrɔwa bil tɛ yaa la, a warɔ kohona, yaa wola won kura.
Konaatena ne koŋkwaa baa kpɔa ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛɛ la, he sie aa a ta lɛ, he tɛ mɛ deŋne ŋɔ, n kpɔ no he wa.
He siwi aa konaatena baa dɛ fuah ambire dɛɛ tɛɛ, ne sarahare baa ɛa, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ soŋe nɛra wechɔɡa la su.
Belaa n ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, menee la.
N balɔ.
Ba chwerɛ n waa do he Mmara tɔn la bini.
N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin he waa ɛɛ, n kpɔ he webaɡla la do n bambile bini.” He nɛra baa cheme warɛ aa, n dɛ bol amanesoma aa dɛ ba mkpa ne, maa n nyoa tɔ.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡbabir jemɔ kɛ maa a bolaa ɡel.
Maa amanesoma aa dɛ lɛ nɛra la kpɔe dɛɛ sɔh n bambile bini, n dɛ bol he kasinteŋ ne he chae waa la.
He nɛra chemo warɛ aa, maa nyoa tɔ, he waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ, ne he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta.
N Naa Korowii, n jemɔ kɛ haa n sum nae ɡel bwa, he nyina ne kasinteŋ ɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbee saŋ bɛlbwa.
Chae wesoŋa N dɔma baa wola nyoa dɔe bar mɛ cheme, n wechɔɡa ɡwaa n nɛ, maa jemɛ bela maa kpɔ.
A warɔ ɡwaa n nyumpona kwara, a ɡel n hwɛɡa bwa ta.
N Naa Korowii, n dɛ soŋe, lɛɛ mɛ, ba warane, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.
Gel nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo la, sihiih kpo ba, bá wili.
Nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ n wenaale ta la, ber ba kaa, dɛ́ ɡel sihiih kpo ba.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel banɔ la baa dɛ mam mɛ la bambile chɔɡ, pɔe haa pɔ ba nɛɛ la wa.
Nɛra baa laŋa kaa tomɛ la, ɡel bá dɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ hɛɡre.
Gel nɛra haa lɛɛ ba ba dɔ mkpa la ɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ Korowii aa kana!” N nyao, dɛ ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre, kɛ he ta n waa soɛh.
Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, henee ɛ n Lɛɛ, n poori, ba warane, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.
Weela ta chɔe wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel Nɛra baa dɛ dawɛ nyaara waa la, ba na som, wenaale puu ba aa, Korowii lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le a nyoa.
Korowii dɛ́ tɔ ba ɡbemɡbe, ásɛ ba soɡa bini do wer, o swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba harɛ la ta, ba dɔma lii wechɔɡa tɛɛ ba aa, o kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ cha baa ba weela bini, dɛ́ ɡel ba berɛ dɔ bokpeɡa.
N ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, na n sum, chaah mɛ, dɛkalkɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo he nɛ.” N dɔma dɛ bol n bwara wechɔɡe ŋɔ, “Bɛweeree ó sewɛ ásɛ o sɔn he te nɔ?” Nomɛlbwa na mɛ naa, nyosonee wɛɛ teŋe, liichɔɡa yon su o bambile, dɛ́ le kaa bola bobɛlbwa.
N dɔma pɛo dɛɛ ŋwal mɛ, ba lii wechɔɡa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ ŋɔ, “Weechɔɡa lɔɔ bil, waa won ir le o chɔɔbɔr.” Hale n dansom maa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛ, nɛn n ne waa pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwaa la, ɛ n dɔm.
N Naa Korowii, na n sum, laɡ mɛ ir, ásɛ n bɔ n dɔma kem, waa baa ɛɛ mɛ la wa.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he sie lɛ n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n dɔma ta wone pɔ n nɛ.
N waa toɡrɔ nomanta, hɛɛ laɡ mɛɛ do he sie, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɔ jam, le saŋ waa wola jaɡa dɔe dɛɛ la.
Aamen!
Yela tɔn nɛɛte Nɛn waa lɔ harɛfale ta wesoŋa Kora dea bii yel N Naa Korowii, ɡɛ nyɔɡre kpo welo, o siwi yon swɛɛ, wɛɛ nyin nepale waa sɔna la, ɡɛɛ n siwi swɛɛ he wa.
Korowii haa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, n dɛ nyini kɛ nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo nɛn ken.
Bɛweeree ń won ba he sie, dɛ́ ba tomɛ nɔ?
Sinii ber mɛ kondikwa, chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa n dɔma ɛɛ pɛɛ mɛ ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔɔ?” N lii n saŋ la aa, dɛ n bambile chɔɡɔ, n ne nɛnlaa bwa fa yon la hen Korowii Dea, ásɛ n tɔ ba sie ba teŋɛ, ba sie lɛ ba ɡo yela, dɛɛ hɛɡre dɛɛ kpɛɛre.
Ɛrɛɛ n tea bini chɔɡ ken?
Ɛrɛɛ n liire bwa chɔɡ ken nɔɔ?
N kpɔ n hwɛɡa bwa do hen Korowii nɛ, dɛ berɛ kwaa dɛɛ kpɛɛre ja.
Henee ɛ n Lɛɛ, ne Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ.
N bambile chɔɡɔ kohona, anomanta, mɛɛ lii he waa, dɛ́ le Jɔɔdan Moo nyuune ta, ne Misar ne Hɛmɔn Bwejena dor.
He ɡelɔ bɔchuubu nee lɔ dɛɛ kpɔ n nɛ mɛɛ di suna, kɛŋɔ nɛn nee aa sua dɛ kpɔɔ kaa ken.
Korowii dɛ baɡle o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe n nɛɛ webaŋa, a ɡel n ɡo yel tɛo jwaana, dɛ soŋe Korowii waa ɡela n so le.
N ŋɔ Korowii waa do kɛ Bwetal n chwa kaa marɔ be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he soh n waa nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ wi n dɔma, ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa nɔn ta nɔɔ?” N hoɡa bwa dɛ wee mɛ, n dɔma aa dɛ muɡli n baah la wa, dɛɛ bɔɔ mɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔɔ?” Ɛrɛɛ tebinichɔɡ su n bwa ken?
Ɛrɛɛ n bambile chɔɡ ken nɔɔ?
N kpɔ n hwɛɡa bwa dawɛ hen Korowii nɛ, dɛ berɛ kwaa dɛɛ kpɛɛre ja, henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, henee n Lɛɛ.
Nomɛl waa lɔ harɛfale ta wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, pa mɛ boldɛɛɡe, che n habɔɔ, dɛ́ bol n waa tɛ mɛ, nɛra baa wola hen Korowii tomɛ nɔ be, lɛɛ mɛ le nyosonteŋna, ne nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.
Henee dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe.
Ɛrɛɛ he vɛɛh mɛ nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ n dɔma ɡel n bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ, dɛɛ muɡli n baah nɔɔ?
Kpɔ he nii waa do kɛ kandea, ne he kasinteŋ ba tɔ n sie, ba n ne he bwe waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, he Dea bela haa lole la.
Ásɛ n la hen Korowii saraha kon la ta, henee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa, dɛ́ lɔ janjela kpɛɛre, henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ n tea bini chɔɡ ken?
Ɛrɛɛ n liire bwa chɔɡ ken nɔɔ?
N kpɔ n hwɛɡa bwa do hen Korowii nɛ, dɛ berɛ kwaa dɛɛ kpɛɛre ja, henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, henee ɛ n Lɛɛ.
Korowii nɔn kpɔe dɛ́ tɔ nɛn nɛɛ wesoŋa Kora dea bii yel N Naa Korowii, ya noa deŋne ne, ya naawa bol wejena haa ɛa, ba bere saŋ la ya be.
He kpeɡri nee he doŋi harɛre nɛra, dɛ kpɔ ya naawa ka so ba harɛ la ta.
He chɔɡ ba, dɛ ɡel ya naawa wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba.
Ba tokobie ne laa ba yo lɛ harɛ la, kɛɛ ba ɡbaɡba bokpeɡa ne laa, he ɡbabir kpeɡri nee, dɛkalkɛ he baɡ ba nyoa ŋɔ, he ja ba nɛ, dɛɛ nyin ba.
Henee kooro ne Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, dɛ ɡel he nɛra Israel tena yo, dɛɛ pɔ ya dɔma nɛ.
He kpeɡri taa a che, ya won pɔ ya dɔma nɛ, he sɔn taa ya che, dɛ tiɡri ba nɛ.
N to kɛɛ n tokobi, laa ɡela n won pɔ n dɔma nɛ.
Henee tɛ yaa kpeɡri, ya pɔ ya dɔma nɛ, dɛ ɡel sihiih kpo nɛra baa hah yaa.
N Naa Korowii, he nɛɛ yaa tamane tɔpere bɛlbwa, yaa kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Kɛ taraken, he vɛh yaa dɛ ɡel ba pɔ ya nɛ, haa ya laa tena nɛɛ ja, dɛɛ la laa kpa.
He ɡelɔ ya chwa le ya dɔma sie, asɛ ba ba kam ya laala, kɛ laa ta kwa.
He ɡelɔ ba kpoo yaa kɛŋɔ peera ken, dɛ lɔ yaa peɡre harɛre ta.
He yoɡ yaa tɛ ya dɔma pɛɛpɛɛ, he ta komɛlbwa dɔe le a ta.
He ɡelɔ ya bala nyiŋi yaa dɛɛ vah, nɛra baa soɡa bar yaa dɛ mamɛ yaa.
Yanee harɛre tena bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ, ba nyiŋi yaa dɛɛ viiɡi nyuune.
Tɔpere bɛlbwaa mɛɛ di sihiih, sihiih ɡboo n bwa, nɛra dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, dɛɛ muɡli n baah, dɛkalkɛ, n dɔma cheɡɛ ɡɛ ta, dɛɛ tɔ ba wel.
A lole kɛŋɔ anɔ bwa pu yaa, kɛ dɛ ya ta he waa soɛh, kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡ ya ne he fɔo yaa fɔwa la.
He waa ta lɔ ya bambile ta, ya ta waa haa do yaa a ta la vɛɛh, kɛ he ɡel yaa tɛ kpɔɡ bini ola, biro tenten tɔ ya nɛ.
Dɛ ya fe vɛh hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, dɛ kaa tomɛ harɛfala ta voɡa aa, he fe nao, dɛkalkɛ, he jemɛ ya nyu bini liire aa sɔah bwa.
He nomanta, ya cheɡɛ seo nyoa saŋ bɛlbwa, baa ɛ yaa kɛ peera baa dɛ la ka kpoora ken.
N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne, ɛrɛɛ a do kɛŋɔ he chɔ dom nɔɔ?
Gɔɔ he te, dɛ bɛ yaa vɛh kwaraa.
Ɛrɛɛ he kpɔ sie sɔh yaa nɔɔ?
Bɛ ya dɔma wenaale baa do yaa a ta la soh.
Ya cholo chɔ bomboɡ ta, yaa wola won ir kpa.
Ir nyu ne, dɛ́ ba cha yaa!
Lɛ yaa he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la wa.
Kooro hanfale lawa yel Kora dea bii yel Wobol aa wera su n nyoa, mɛɛ ba kpɔe ɡo yel tɛ kooro.
N nyoa wobol do kɛŋɔ, kon nɛn waa jemɛ chwera kɛrɛdɛ, aa kpoŋa dɛɛ chwerɛ.
Henee wera kohona, baala bwa bini, he nyoa jemɛ wobol ɡe, dɛkalkɛ Korowii sweere andɛɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Banyoo, ir kpɔ he dɔmkon sɛɡle, he ɛ koojen, waa haa dɛ ɛ kan dɛ dɔ jirima.
Che kan haa doa ta ka yo, dɛ́ pɔ he dɔma nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ kasinteŋ ne toɡra he wa aa toɡra, bol waa dɛɛ pa bole.
He kpeɡri kohona ɛɛ ɡeloo hé pɔ he dɔma nɛ.
He hɛma nyɛɡre, dɛɛ jo he dɔma bambile bini, harɛre nɛra choɡli he sie.
He kora Korowii aa lea cheɡe, ɛɛ cheo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, kasinteŋii hɛɛ ba kpɔe, dɛ́ nyiŋi he nɛra nɛ.
He dɛ nyin waa aa toɡra, dɛ ki wechɔɡa.
A waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ lee cheɡ he bala koranar bwa bini, dɛ fuɡe noo do he nyu ta dɛ tɛɛ silɛɛ.
He laala sɔɔh tɔ konsɔɔhsoma bwa soo siwi, ba kpɔ bala nyena kwaa he kooderemi, yelɡoola kpɔ janjela lɔ yela, dɛɛ lɛ he sie.
Koranar bihaahna ja haahna baa dɔ jirima, dɛ do he dem nɛ, asɛ hanfale do kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛa, dɛ che he diɡ pera.
Kooro hanfale, dɛɛ no waa maa dɛ ba bola nɔ, soh he nɛra ne he lolanar wa.
He wer ɡelɔ kooro bambile do he nɛ, dɛɛ duuru, dɛkalkɛ he dɔɔree on.
Bwɛjen Taaya tena ɛɛ ba koŋkɛɛla nee ba tɛɛ, suuɡa tena ɛɛ nyin bá kpɔ ba kwaa ba di he liire.
Kooro hanfale lɔ koodem, o wer dɔŋ toole, ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ŋwɛɛra sɔh ja ŋwɛɛra baa kpɔa sɔh o batakaarejaŋ la ta.
O do batakaarejaŋ ba sɔh kwaa dawɛ o ta, baa ba o ne hen kooro be, o toli teŋɛ o nɛ, baa ba ba ɡe ne he be.
Ba kpɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ ba, dɛ hɛɡre ba jo he koodem bela.
N naa kooro, hɛɛ lolɛ bibaalaa taeh, bá ba chiɡ he naawa naa ta ɛ koranar, ásɛ he ɡel baa nyiŋi harɛ la bwa ta.
N yel la ɛɛ ɡeloo hé dɔ sɔn kohona dɛɛ la, ásɛ harɛre nɛra kpɛɛre, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii ja ya nɛ Kora dea bii yel Korowiirii ya chwa kaa marɛ wɛɛ tɛ yaa bokpeɡa ya wenaale bwa ta, o ja ya nɛ.
Dɛ harɛ jiɡro kwaraa, bwejena chuɡri ka le mpo vile ta, hale mpo nehɛma nyoa kpeɡri, dɛɛ si ɡɛ bɛlbwa, dɛ ɡel bwejena ɛɛ yiiɡi aa, yaa ɔmɛ.
Nee bɛl ɡelɔ nɛra ɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ, Korowii bwɛjen la ta, Nemenɛ Korowii Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.
Korowii lɔ bwɛjen la ta, waa won chɔɡ, Korowii ɛɛ bao bɔr chaahna saŋ, dɛ́ ba cha ba.
Korowii kpɔ ɔmee ba ta harɛre nɛra nɛ, o kɔrɔ kɛŋɔ bwaala, asɛ harɛ mwɛɛ.
Korowii waa ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro ja ya nɛ, Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ laanee do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ, ya chwa kaa marɔ.
Hé ba dɛ́ ba na toma Korowii aa ɛa, nyokpowaa waa ɛa a do ɔma ya harɛ nɔ ta.
O won laa nyoa sɔɔhna harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, dɛɛ kuuɡi tori ne lampeare, dɛɛ fuh kwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe, dɛɛ yo laa.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel yoi, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ menee Korowii, menee kana harɛre nɛra bwa bini, n dɔŋ toole harɛ nɔ bwa ta.” Nemenɛ Korowii ja ya nɛ, Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ laanee do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ, ya chwa kaa marɔ.
Koojen tenten wa Kora dea bii yel Harɛre bwa nɛra, hé lɔ kpaŋa, á baɡle kɛ he sie lɛo, hé do lɔŋɔre kpɛɛ Korowii silɛɛ yela ne.
Nemenɛ Korowiirii ɔma kohona, onee koojen waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ nɔ bwa ta.
Onee ɡela ya yo harɛre nɛra, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, ba ba do ya lɔɡa.
Onee le ya harɛ yaa soɡe o ta nɔ cheɡ tɛ yaa, o ɡbabir nɛra Israel tena waa dɛ nyin yaa, dɛ kpɔ tɛ yaa o ɛ ya kapɛrɛ kon la.
Korowii iro dɛɛ la ka so o kookara ta, nɛra hoh bɛle silɛɛ ne dɛɛ moo.
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ on waa ɛ ya kooro la.
Korowii dɛ di kora harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro.
Korowii soɡe o kookara waa do ɡoroŋ ta, dɛɛ di kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.
Harɛ nɔ ta koranar chemo, ba ne Korowii Abraham aa tomɔ nɛra.
Harɛ nɔ ta koranar bwa lɔ o lɔɡa, o dɔŋ toole.
Korowii bwɛjen Saayɔn wa Kora dea bii yel Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ kan, a chɛ kɛ yá kpɛɛro o bwɛjen waa chɔŋɛ bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.
Korowii Saayɔn Bwejen wer, dɛ do jaŋne kohona, koojen la bwɛjen kpɔ silɛɛ baa tɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa.
Korowii lɔ o bwɛjen la ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa lɔ o ta nɛ.
Koranar boa ba laa tena nyoa, dɛɛ ba ba yo nɛra baa soɡe Saayɔn Bwejen ta, kɛ baa ba bwɛjen la ta la, ba bwara yɔrɔ, ɔmee kohona ɡel ba chwa kaa.
Bochela laɡ ba bela, kɛŋɔ loltea aa lɔ haah ken, kɛŋɔ peuchɔɡe aa taa le wee leebɔr dɛ lɔ stiimaere dɛɛ kaa la.
Ya no waa Korowii aa ɛa, dɛ ɡbaɡba naa siwi ne, Nemenɛ Korowii waa ɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ bwɛjen la ta.
Wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ o bwɛjen la taa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
N Naa Korowii, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ɡbo waa lɔ ya nyu bini, yaa lii he Dea bela.
N Naa Korowii, ɡɛ he sɔn aa kana la, ɡɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ kpɛɛre le harɛ jaɡa bwa, he kpeɡri kohona nomanta, he bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Nɛra haa lɔ Saayɔn Bwejen doa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ.
Juda harɛ bwɛjeɡre tena ɡe sie lɛ, kɛ haa dɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Hé valɛ bar Saayɔn, dɛ́ kure o dejaŋa, hé nyiŋi o danjwɛɛre ne o danjwɛkpeɡa, dɛ́ dɔ waa bol baɡle he naanar baa ka ba, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ Korowii nɔɔ yaa tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, wɛɛ tɔ ya siee, dɛɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛ yaa kpɔ o ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gɛnee dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ o kondɔɔh ta Kora dea bii yel Nómɛlbwa no waa nɔ, nɛra haa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, dansaara ne nɛnjena, dɔɔhna ne nyaara bwa.
Mɛɛ bol wejemwaa, á ɡel he liire bini chaah, hɛɛ no waa mun.
Mɛɛ cheɡ deŋnee dɛɛ no wobosɛɡla, dɛ́ kpɔ janjela lɔ dɛɛ baɡle a mun.
Dɛ wenaale balɔ, n dɔma bar mɛ cheme, kwaraa naa, maa ɔmɛ.
Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ ba kondɔɔh ta koh a waa dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo aa, maa ɔmɛ.
Nomɛlbwa aa won lɛ o dɔŋ mkpa, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ komɛl charɛ o nyu Korowii be.
Nɛwɛnyini mkpa yoɡ kpeɡri, komɛlbwa toole bá won kpɔ yawɔ, ásɛ o won so le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, waa wola sewɛ.
Nomɛlbwa nao kɛŋɔ wejerema dɛ sewɛ, ɡɛna ne banɔ la baa wola liire dɔe ɡe ɛɛ sewɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba kondɔɔh tɛ bane.
Ba lalbɔɔne ɛɛ ber ba deenee bá chɔ a bini, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ ba fa dɔ harɛre, baa do belaa saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.
Nɛra dɔ kondɔɔh ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, aa won lɛɛ ba ba bɛ sewɛ, baa serewoo kɛ ola ken.
Waa aa chɔ le dɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ ba ɡbaɡba nɛɛ, ne nɛra baa teŋɛ ba nɛɛ dɛɛ no waa baa dɛ bol ta laanee.
Baa na waa, dɛ́ serewe kɛ peera, seo tɔ ba sie dɛ́ kaa ba ne lalbɔɔne bini.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ tiɡri ba nɛɛ, ba pɔh ba lalbɔɔne bini, ba ne ba deremi baah do jaŋne.
Kɛ Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ, wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ le kpeɡri seo aa dɔa la nyoa.
Dɛ nɛn dɔ kondɔɔh kohona naa, bɛ ɡel a we he nɛ, hale dɛ a nao dɛɛ dawɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, o baa sewaa, waa komɛlbwa ne kaala ba, waa won kpɔ a bɛlbwa kaa o be lalbɔɔ bini.
Gɛ saŋ waa soɡe le la, dɛ o dɛ lii o te nɛn waa na som, nɛra ɛɛ kpɛɛro a wa aa, wɛɛ sewɔɔ ka pu o naawa, waa wola bɔr chaahnaa na kpa.
Nɛn waa dɔ kondɔɔh waa wola waa mun no la, ɡɛ ola aa dɛ sewɛ laanee o ɡe ɛɛ ba sewa.
Korowii toma ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta Asaf yel Nemenɛ Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri kohona yerɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa ba cheme, le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Korowii do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah dɛ le bwɛjen Saayɔn waa wera kohona ta.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ dɛ ba naa, waa sɔeh dɛɛ ba, nijena dɛ́ tɔ o sie, ásɛ peukpeɡ ta baro dɛɛ cheme.
O ŋɔ nyundua ne harɛ di danseɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra, ásɛ o bol o nɛra wa, dɛ́ pa ba bole.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ n nɛra maa lee ba cheɡ tɛ n te boa ba nyoa, nɛra baa kpo kon ɛ saraha, a che tɛ fɔo n ne baa fɔwa la.” Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii waa toɡrɔ, dɛkalkɛ onee bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé no, n nɛra Israel tena, maa he waa bola ba dɛ́ tɛ heya, menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.
Maa heyaa kah ŋɔ kwaa haa kpoora ɛ sarahare, kɛɛ kwaa haa fuah ɛ sarahare n sie saŋ bɛlbwa la aa were.
Maa nabala nyin dɛ́ le he naleɡa ta, kɛɛ boohna dɛ́ le he boohna leɡa bini, dɛkalkɛ kpɔɡ bini ola bwa ɛ n kwa, a ne nae aa lɔ deŋɡarere kaɡboŋa ta bwa.
N jemɛ jumbii aa lɔ bwejena dor wa, asɛ koŋkwaa maa taa bwa ɛ n kwa.
Dɛ lɔr dɛ kpo mɛ naa, maa he bee bol, dɛkalkɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa ɛ n kwa.
N dɛ chwe nabala ol kɛɛ boohna chalee mɛɛ diɔ?
Hé kpɔ jam ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii, dɛ́ ka chuɡri he nyobaɡa bwa Nemenɛ Korowii be.
Hé yer mɛ he wenaale tɔpere aa, mɛɛ ba lɛ heyaa, ásɛ he kpɔ duure tɛ mɛ.” Kɛ Korowii ŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ me Mmarare dawɛ he nyoo hɛɛ kura, kɛɛ hɛɛ bol n ne he fɔo la waa nɔɔ?
He hah waa maa do heyaa a ta la, dɛ kpɔa ta habɔɔ.
He na ŋwɛɛ bɛlbwa naa, he kpɔɔ dɛɛ berɛ he dam, he ne nɛra baa dɛ bɔ jwamanee dɛɛ valɛ.
Wobochɔɡa ɡboo su he nyoo, he do ɡbaŋre nyosone teŋa ta.
He won soɡa dɛɛ bol he dɔŋa bwara wechɔɡa, dɛɛ chɔɡ he ɡbaɡba nyabii.
Anɔ bwaa hɛɛ ɛ, asɛ n tɔ nyoa, he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ n do kɛ heya.
Kɛ n dɛ kah heya, dɛ́ kpɔ waa haa ɛa bwa bil he sie.” Hé no, he banɔ la haa soh men Korowii waa la, ɡɛ laa aa, mɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa, nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛ heya.
Nomɛlbwa kpɔ jam tɛ mɛ naa, dɛ sarahaa o ɛ tɛ mɛ la, onee dɛɛ duu mɛ.
O kpɔɔ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ cheɡ, dɛ́ na ɡɛ men Korowii aa won nɛra lɛɛ.
Wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, koh he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la wa, dɛ́ na n sum.
Koh he tedoma kohona la wa, dɛ́ fee n wechɔɡa.
Sɔ n wechɔɡa ta, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ nee dɛɛ yaɡle doŋa la, ásɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa le n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n jemɔ kɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɔ n sie saŋ bɛlbwa.
He ɡbosoroo n ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wola were he sie.
Anomanta, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ, he won bol n waa dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ tɛr n deŋne.
N lola saŋ bwaa n le ɛ wechɔɡa, hale saŋ n nya aa kpoŋe n tea.
Kasinteŋ ne waa aa weraa hɛɛ nyin, anomanta, tɛ mɛ he wejema.
Fee n wechɔɡa, ásɛ doŋa bɛlbwa le n nɛ, laa doŋa kpɔ n bini, ásɛ n bambile to kɛ yabi.
Gel n no silɛɛ ne hɛɡra ɡbɔɡa, a lole kɛŋɔ he lɔ mɛ bil, n hoɡa bini ɛɛ wee mɛ, mɛɛ berɔ dɔ silɛɛ ja.
Laa sie kpɔ n wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ fee n wechɔɡa bwa.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel n bambile bini to, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ dadɛɛɡe.
Bɛ men doŋi le he sie, kɛɛ dɛ́ laa he Doma kpɔ n nɛ.
Berɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ he lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ bambidɛɛɡe ń won dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta.
Ásɛ n baɡle wechɔɡ-ɛɛra he Mmarare la, bá charɛ ba liire, dɛ́ berɛ ba he be.
N Naa Korowii, dɛ n kpo nɛn dɛ di a bolchɔɡe aa, lɛɛ mɛ.
Ásɛ n ɡo yela silɛɛ ne, dɛ́ baɡle ɡɛ he wa aa toɡra.
N Naa Korowii, cha mɛ ń won waa bola, ásɛ n won kpɛɛre.
He sie aa kwaa kpoora dɛ ɛ saraha tɛɛ ta lɛ, ásɛ n fee kpɔ ba tɛɛ.
He sie aa saraha kwaa baa fuah ɡe ta lɛ, ń fee kpɔ ba tɛɛ.
N kpɔ n bambile waa chɔɡa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛɛ.
Bambile waa chɔɡa dɛ won chara laanee hen Korowii ɛɛ nyin.
N Naa Korowii, sune Saayɔn tena nɛ, dɛ́ cha ba, kwaa ma Jerusalam danjwɛɛ waa kuuɡa la.
Ásɛ mɔɔ he sie lɛ saraha aa wera dɛ toɡre, ne saraha kwaa baa fuah la ta, mɔɔ yá kpoo nabala tɛɛ he saraha kon la ta.
Korowii nɔn taa wobɛlbwa do Kooro Devid yel Nomonjen, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ baɡle he te wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta nɔɔ?
Korowii nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa, lole saŋ bɛlbwa.
He vɔrɔwe nɛra vɔrɔwa dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, he nyondoŋe do kɛŋɔ naŋɡɔse ken, saŋ bɛlbwaa hɛɛ teŋe nyosone.
He dɛ nyin wechɔɡa dɛ ɡwaa wedɛɛɡa, dɛɛ nyin nyosone dɛ ɡwaa kasinteŋ dii.
Nyosontenŋi bɛl le!
He dɛ chɔɡ nɛra he nyoa wobol ne!
Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛ́ ba jo he dem tɛre le, dɛ́ lawɛ le harɛ nɔ ta.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la ɛɛ nao dɛ́ ɔmɛ, baa dɛɛ mamɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na, baa waa wola Korowii kpɔe ɛ o Kpeɡnɛn laanee la.
O kpɔ o hwɛɡa bwa do o kondɔɔh ta, o nyu bini do kpeɡri kohona o bala chɔɡa ta.” Kɛ n te, n do kɛŋɔ ɔleve da, dɛ che Korowii Dea dɛɛ kpeɡ.
N dɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.
Mɛɛ kpɛɛree saŋ bɛlbwa, he waa haa ɛa wa, he sɔn la taa mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, dɛkalkɛ he waa wer, dɛ́ kpɛɛre he nɛra ba wa aa toɡra sie.
Nɛwɛnyini nyubinikpeɡ wa Kooro Devid yel Gɛna ɡboo yon ŋɔ, “Korowii toole.” Nɛndɛɛɡe bɛlbwa toole ba bini, wechɔɡa ɡboo ba bwa, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Korowii lɔ nyundua, dɛ ba sie ne harɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛwɛnyina kɛŋɔ bɛl dɔ wejema dɛɛ nyin o Korowii bɔr dɛ́ tomɔ.
Nomɛlbwa berɛ habɔɔ kpoo, nɛndɛɛɡe bɛlbwa toole ba bini, bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Amɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ hweli waa bwaa yaa?
Ba dɛ liɡli n nɛra kɛŋɔ baa dɛ di kwaa ken, baa wola wi dɛɛ no men Korowii.” Belaa ba do ɔmee su ba bwa, kɛ dɛ a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá fe ɔmɛ.
Korowii lɔ nɛra baa yo heyaa la hoɡa peɡre, he ɡelɔ sihiih kpo ba, dɛkalkɛ Korowii vɛɛh ba.
N dɛ soŋe kɛŋɔ mkpa lɛɛ le Saayɔn, dɛ́ ba o nɛra Israel tena be.
Dɛ Korowii berɔ ba lɛ o nɛra Israel tena ja aa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛo.
Nɔn kpɔe dɛ́ tɔ nɛn nɛɛ wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, che he sɔnjen la ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ, che he kpeɡri ta, dɛ́ pa mɛ bole!
N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, no n waa maa dɛ bol!
Nɛŋhɔɔhra balɔ dɛɛ ba ba yoo mɛ, nyubinikpeɡ tena ba siwi aa kpeɡa, dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo.
Banee nɛra baa wola hen Korowii komɛl yerɛ la.
N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ cha mɛ, henee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa.
Gel n dɔma vɔrɔwa baa vɔrɔwa ɡure ba nyu ta, che he kasinteŋ ta dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.
N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ɛ saraha aa le n bambile taa tɛɛ, mɛɛ kpɛɛ he sɔn laanee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he waa wer.
Henee lɛɛ mɛ n wahala bwa ta, dɛ ɡel n na n dɔma chola.
Nomɛl o dɔŋ aa leo tɛ wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, bɛ sie laa kpɔ waa maa dɛ soŋe nɔ ta, no n be dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ, n liire chɔɡ waa aa dɛ ha mɛ ta, n dɔma aahra baa dɛ aah mɛ, ne fiiɡa baa dɛ fiɡ mɛ nomanta, ba kpɔ wenaale ba ta n nɛ, ba muɡli n baah dɛ hah mɛ.
N bambile dɛ lɔ, seo ɡelɔ n bwara yɔr n ɔmɛ dɛɛ chel kohona.
Ɔmee ne bochela chole n nɛ, asɛ n bambile teŋe kohona.
Dɛ n dɔ kena kɛŋɔ kweah aa, n fe ɛɛ iruu kaa bojaŋ dɛ́ ka onɛ.
N fe ɛɛ iruu kaa bojaŋ, dɛ́ ka so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Dɛ́ ɛ warane ka nyin sobɔr, dɛ́ le peukpeɡ waa dɛ ta dɛɛ nɛ bwaala bini.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel n dɔma wili, ba bɛ won bol wa!
N na wesaɡasaɡare ne yoi bwɛjen la ta, ba bɛɛlɔ dɛɛ bar o danjwɛɛre chɔɔ ne jwaana, dɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ne waa aa wola were su o bwa.
Nɛnchɔɡa lɔ bwɛjen la ta bobɛlbwa.
Ba cheɡɛ ba kpeɡri ta, dɛɛ fiɡ ba dɛɛ neɡ ba o fɔɡbaahna.
Dɛ n dɔmee dɛɛ chɛɡre mɛ naa, n fe ɛɛ lɛo do.
Dɛ nɛn waa hah mɛ ɡee dɛɛ mam mɛ naa, n fe ɛɛ laa n tenee kpɔ o nɛ.
Kɛ hen haa ɛ n chamenate la, henee dɛɛ ɛɛ mɛ.
N dam n ne haa dɛ valɛ, ya bwa fa pɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa kɛrɛdɛ ken, dɛ kaa tomɛ Korowii o Dea.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel n dɔma piɡri serewe, ɡel ba huɡ ba dɛ ba siwi ta lole, dɛkalkɛ wechɔɡa lɔ ba bambile ne ba deremi.
Kɛ n wio no hen Korowii, asɛ he no dɛ cha mɛ.
Jwaana, chɔɔ ne webaŋa, n suna wii ne n pɛma dɛ tel he be, asɛ hɛɛ no n taa.
Hɛɛ berɔ lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma baa wara, laa maa kaa yoo ba ta, dɛ́ ba n ne sɔnɔnɔɔ ken.
Hen Korowii, henee dɛɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa, hɛɛ no n wesoŋaa dɛ́ yoo ba, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh ba liire chara, baa hen ɔmɛ.
N dam tenten n ne o fa aa dɛ valɛ yo o daamanar, dɛ chɔɡ fɔo o ne baa fɔwa.
O nyoa wobol pwɛre kɛŋɔ noo ken, kɛ dɛ liichɔɡa lɔ o bambile ta, dɛ won mɔna kɛŋɔ kerenyɛɡ ken.
Kpɔ he waa bwa dawɛ Korowii nɛ, wɛɛ che he habɔɔ, waa ɡel nɛra ba wa aa toɡra chole bwa.
Kɛ hen Korowii, hɛɛ taɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra, ne nyosonteŋna laanee do ba lalbɔɔne bini, bá serewe mɔɔ ba saŋ tel.
Kɛ n te, n kpɔ n te dawɛ hen Korowii nɛ.
Korowii yaradae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, na n sum, n dɔma dɛ ti mɛ sibeɡra ne tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛ́ yoo mɛ.
Tɔpere bɛlbwaa ba teŋɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe n bɔr, ba warɔ kohona dɛɛ yoo mɛ.
Nemenɛ Korowii, ɔmee laɡ mɛ naa, mɛɛ kpɔ n tenee dawɛ he nɛ.
Hen Korowii nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ, maa ɔmɛ, henee mɛɛ ba kpɛɛra, he nyoa haa baɡ mɛ la wa.
Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini waa won sewa ɛɛ ba wona ɛɛ mɛ nɔ?
N dɔma nyin waa dɛɛ dawɛ n nɛɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, saŋ bɛlbwaa baa vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa dɛ́ kpo mɛ.
Ba pɛ nyoa ka sɔh, dɛɛ nyiŋi wobɛlbwa maa dɛ ɛ, ba siwi beɡre n kpoe wa.
N Naa Korowii, tɛr ba deŋne ba wechɔɡa wa, yoo ba, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ he bandia ne.
He na ɡɛ n bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ, he ɡbabir jemɛ n suna maa dɛ di.
A toole he tɔn bini ɡɛ naa?
Awola maa wi yerɛ la, n dɔma ɛɛ berɛ habɔɔ, waa maa jema laanee kɛŋɔ hen Korowii ja n nɛ.
Hen Korowiirii mɛɛ kpɛɛ, he waa laanee mɛɛ duu.
He nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ, maa wola ɔmɛ, bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini waa won sewa ɛɛ ba wona ɛɛ mɛ nɔ?
N Naa Korowii, henee n baɡɛ nyoa, mɛɛ kpɔ n jam kwaa ba tɛɛ.
He lɛɛ mɛ le seo ta, he ta ɡelɛ n dɔma pɔ n nɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ wono dɛɛ valɛ he sie, he nii waa dɛ chaah dɛɛ tɛ nɛra mkpa la bini.
Chae Wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, na n sum, dɛkalkɛ henee n chwa baa marɛ dɛ dɔ bosɔɔhna.
He lɔɡaa n chwa baa sɔh, kɛŋɔ jal yon lawɛ o bii do o kena lɔɡre, ka tel saŋ harɛ chɔɡa aa baa kaa.
N wio dɛɛ no hen Nemenɛ Korowii, henee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ komɛlbwa maa dɛ nyin.
Hɛɛ no n wesoŋaa le nyundua dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ, dɛ́ pɔ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ mɛ nɛ.
Hen Korowii ɛɛ baɡle he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne he kasinteŋ haa dɔa laanee n nɛ.
N dɔma bar mɛ cheme, ba do kɛŋɔ nyujentena lɔr aa dɛ kpoa, aa nyin nɛra ola dɛ́ di ken.
Ba nyena do kɛŋɔ lampeare ne hɛma, ba nyondoŋa nyɛɡre kɛ keri ken.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel ya na he kan haa doa nyundua, ásɛ he jirima tɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
N dɔma haɡre bela, dɛ́ laɡ mɛ, suna ɡboo mɛɛ di.
Ba kwi nafuɡe n ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ fee laɡ mɛ, kɛ ba ɡbaɡba berɔ le o bini.
N Naa Korowii, he nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kohona, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre.
Mɛɛ iruu che, dɛ́ kpɔ janjela ne kwaa bwa soo siwi lɔ yela!
Mɛɛ feluu ir mɔɔ bɔr chaah.
N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ jaame harɛre nɛra bwa binii, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre nɛnlaa baahnee.
He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe kan dɛɛ tel nyundua, he wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ ɡe ɛɛ tel bela.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel ya na he kan haa doa nyundua, ásɛ he jirima tɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena deŋne tɛra wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel Hé koranar, hé bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta naa?
Hé bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole ɡɛ aa chɛ aa?
Akai, wechɔɡa haa lii dɛ́ ɛa ɡboo lɔ he bambili bini, waa aa ba naɡra ne ɡboo hɛɛ ɛ harɛ la ta.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa ba soɡa bini bwa, dɛ le awola baa lol ba, dɛɛ teŋe nyosone.
Ba nyoa wobol do kɛ tɛɡchɔɡa, kɛŋɔ harɛkonchɔɡe aa choɡe nɛn dɛ tɔɔɡe o deŋna ken.
Waa tɛɛɡa te waa dɛ ɡo harɛkon yela be no, hale dɛ o jemɛ waa la ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa noo.
N Naa Korowii, fome n dɔma nyena aa do kɛŋɔ nyujentena nyenkpaahna.
Gel ba nyoɡre kɛŋɔ nee aa pala ba kaa ken.
Ba harɛ ba tori dɛɛ ba tae yaa, ɡel ba hɛma nyoo taŋ.
Gel ba hol kɛŋɔ ketere dɛ́ serewe, kɛɛ bie baa haro ta, waa wola wee nae mɔɔ la.
Mɔɔ ba jemɛ la, dɛ ba teŋ ba ta kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken, hen Korowii ɛɛ perewi baa ta he bandia kohona la ne, ɡɛ saŋ ba taa soɡe le la.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɔ deŋnetɛra, baa valɛ ba chal taa.
Belaa nɛra ɛɛ ba ŋɔe ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɔ ba kembɔr, Korowii lole kpela, dɛ bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole, harɛ nɔ ta.”
Nɔn kpɔe dɛ́ tɔ nɛn nɛɛ wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ta, kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛɛ le nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ nɔn ta.
Lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔn ta, banɔ la baa dɛ kpoo nɛra la.
Na ɡɛ baa kaa sɔh dɛɛ kpaah mɛ!
Nɛnchɔɡa dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa, kɛ dɛ n ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ.
N ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, kɛ ba ɡe ɡarɛ dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ yoo mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ cha mɛ n waa nɔ ta.
Korowii waa ɛ Koronar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ ba tɛr nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ la deŋne, bɛ dɔma baa ɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena la nɛɛ sune.
Ba yon berɛ ba jɔmɔra, dɛ nyee nyena kɛŋɔ nyootena ken, dɛɛ bɛɛ bwɛjen la fɔɡbaahna.
No chɛɡa ne waa aa dɛ le ba nyoo, ba nyondoŋa do kɛ keri ken, kɛ dɛ ɡee lii kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa ba be no.
Kɛ hen n Naa Korowii te, he dɛ mam ba, he dɛ di nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ la loro.
N Naa Korowii haa ɛ n Kpeɡnɛn, he do kɛŋɔ danjwɛkpeɡ n chwa baa marɛ.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he dɛ nyin n wa, hɛɛ ba n bee dɛ́ ɡel n na n dɔma chola.
Korowii haa dɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe, bɛ ban kpoo, ɡɛ laa aa, n nɛra ɛɛ ba sooh.
Che he kpeɡri ta dɛ́ lɔ ba peɡre, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ sɔɔh ba nyoa.
Wechɔɡa su ba nyoo, che ba nyoa wobol ta dɛ́ ɡel ba laɡ ba ba mbarafo baa dɛ ɛ ta.
Koh nyosone ne taahna baa dɛ taah nɛra la wa, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba he bandia ne, ka tel kɛŋɔ ba bwa aa tona.
Ásɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ hen Korowii, he dɛ di kora Israel tena nɛ.
Ba yon berɛ ba jɔmɔra, dɛ nyee nyena kɛŋɔ nyootena ken, dɛɛ bɛɛ bwɛjen la fɔɡbaahna.
Ba dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin kondikwa, ba ta vaɡrɛ aa, ba yon dɛɛ ŋoo kɛŋɔ nyootena ken.
Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre he kpeɡri la wa, ásɛ chɔɔ bɛlbwa ɡe n ɡo yela kpɛɛre he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la wa, dɛkalkɛ he do kɛŋɔ danjwɛkpeɡ, waa puu mɛ naa, ń chwa baa marɛ.
N Naa Korowii haa ɛ n Kpeɡnɛn, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre, he do kɛŋɔ danjwɛkpeɡ n chwa baa marɛ, N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ nyin n wa.
Lɛɛ wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, he baah fa di ya nɛɛ dɛ vɛh yaa, he baah di ya nɛɛ te, kɛ berɛ lawɛ yaa ba he be taraken.
He ɡelɔ harɛ jiɡri, o bini pere.
Berɛ kwaa tɔɔɡe bɔɔne la, dɛkalkɛ a dɛ paɡri.
He ɡelɔ he nɛra na wahala kohona, ya valɛ dɛɛ yɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ yaa nyɔ sen dɛ dɛɛ ken.
He ir he fraŋkaa dɛ́ kpɔ kah nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba dɔma bɛ ban kpoo.
Lɛ yaa he kpeɡri ne, dɛ́ no ya wesoŋa, ɡɛ aa ɛ he lɛ nɛra haa dɛ nyin ba la.
