Korowii bol waa o Dea bela waa do ɡoroŋ la dɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ yo bwɛjen Sɛkem tenaa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ bɔne o ne Sukot Fɛlembɔjen bini tɛ n nɛra.
Gelead harɛ ne Manasɛ dea harɛ bwa ɛ n kwa.
Efrem harɛ do kɛŋɔ n laa ɡbɛrɛ, asɛ Juda harɛ ɡe do kɛŋɔ n koodaŋɡbala.
Moab harɛ nɛra ɛ n bonɔɔna, ba do kɛ loɡ maa dɛ loo kwaa o bini ken, mɛɛ kpɔ n naŋɡawaa ta Edom harɛ ta.
N dɛ moo, dɛkalkɛ n pɔ Filisti tena nɛ.” N Naa Korowii, umee dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ jo bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro nɔ ta nɔ?
Umee dɛ́ tɔ n sie kaa Edom ɔ?
He deno berɛ habɔɔ kpo yaa kɛɛ?
Haa ya laa tena sie tɔ ka yo ya dɔma kpa aa?
Cha yaa yá won pɔ ya dɔma nɛ, nɛwɛnyini chae ɡɛ bɛlbwa naa, a bwa dɛ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Korowii ja ya nɛ aa, yaa yoo, dɛ́ pɔ ya dɔma nɛ.
Wɛɛ tiɡri ya dɔmaa do harɛ.
Nɔn kpɔe dɛ́ tɔ nɛn nɛɛ wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, no n wii, no n wesoŋa!
N lɔ bojaŋ harɛ jaɡa, dɛ di suna wi dɛɛ noe!
Laɡ mɛ kaa bela maa ka dɔ n nyu, dɛkalkɛ henee kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ n nɛ, dɛ do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ n dɔma sie.
Gel n so he Dea bela saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, laɡ mɛ sɔh he lɔɡa, kɛŋɔ jal yon lawɛ o bii do o kena lɔɡre la.
N Naa Korowii, he no nyoa maa baɡɛ la, dɛ tɛ mɛ kwaa haa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ.
Kpɔ tɔpera ja kooro mkpa ta, dɛ́ ɡel o wobɛlbwa do wer dɛɛ tɛo, ka tel o naanar baa ka ba bwa bini.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel ó so he sie di kora dɛɛ la, dɛ́ kpɔ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne he kasinteŋ haa dɔa tɔ o nɛ.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel n ɡo yela kpɛɛ he sɔn saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛɛ chuɡri n nyobaɡa tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Korowii nɛɛ hwɛɡa Kooro Devid yel N soɡo jeih ken, dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii siwi ta kɛ ó ba lɛɛ mɛ, o ɡbo nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.
O ɡboo do kɛŋɔ Bwetal, n chwa kaa marɔ wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ, onee cheɡɛ n habɔɔ, maa chole bwa.
Saŋ besoo hé bwa ɛɛ ba nɛn waa wola kpeɡe kɛ danjwɛɛ waa kɔɔhna dɛ́ chole nɔ yoi ɡela ɔ?
He dɛ nyin kɛ he lɔɔ harɛ le bodɛɛɡe waa soɡa, he sie dɛ lɛ nyosone teŋa ta.
Wobosoma dɛ le he nyoo, kɛ he bambile ta te, taahna ɡbosoo.
Korowii ɡbosoo nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ, o nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.
O ɡboo do kɛŋɔ Bwetal, n chwa kaa marɔ wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ, onee cheɡɛ n habɔɔ, maa chole bwa.
Korowii nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ dɛɛ tɛ mɛ jirima, onee do kɛ Bwetal maa chwaa kaa marɔ.
Yabala, hé kpɔ he hwɛɡa do Korowii nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ kpɔ he wehiah bwa bil o sie, dɛkalkɛ onee ya chwa kaa marɛ wɛɛ lɛ yaa.
Nɛwɛnyina bwa do kɛŋɔ nyoa peu ken, nyaara ne kondɔɔhna bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ ba kpɔ ba dawɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ kari kwaa ta naa, ba fɛɡre dɛ ɡwaa nyoa peu ɡba.
Hé laa he te kpɔ nɛra ɛɡra dɛ́ dɔ kwa, kɛɛ he sie lɛ ŋwɛɛ kwaa ta.
Dɛ he kondɔɔh teŋɔ dɛɛ warɛ kwaraa naa, hé laa he bambile kpɔ a ta.
N noɔ Korowii aa bola keraŋwɛnɛ bwa kɛŋɔ onee dɔ kpeɡri, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ɡe do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Kasinteŋ, o dɛ bɔ nɛra kem ɡɛ ba we-ɛɛla aa doa.
Korowii nyina ɡwaa mkpa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, n pɛla dɔe sibeɡra ne, n bambile lawɛ kɛ nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo nɛn, wɛɛ nyin nee dɛ nyɔ, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, bela nee aa wola toole.
N na ɡɛ he kpeɡri ne he jirima aa doa, he Dea bela.
He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la toole naa, nɛn toole wobɛlbwa bini, anomanta, mɛɛ kpɛɛree.
Mɛɛ kpɛɛree n soɡa bini bwa, mɛɛ ɡɔɔ n nɔɔraa nyundua, dɛ́ kpɔ n wesoŋa bil he sie.
N sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛ maa di silɛɛ kondikonjena dɛ vaɡɛ ken, dɛ́ ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ he sɔn.
N chɔ kalaŋ ta naa, n dɛ lii he wa, he waa dɛ do n bambile bini jwaana bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee dɛɛ cha mɛ, he lɔɡaa n chwa baa sɔh, kɛŋɔ jal yon lawɛ o bii do lɔɡa la, mɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yela.
Mɛɛ lawɛɛ kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ he tɔ n nɛɛ he kpeɡri ne.
Nɛra baa dɛ nyin n kpoe, ɛɛ serewoo kaa lalabwɛ.
Baa kpo ba laa taa, ásɛ kalampoŋare di ba ola.
Korowii aa ɡela kooro pɔ o dɔma nɛɛ nomanta, o sie ɛɛ lɛo.
Nɛra baa dɛ yerɛ Korowii sɔn bwa ɛɛ kpɛɛroo, kɛ nyosonteŋna te, wɛɛ tɔ ba nyoo.
Nɔn kpɔe dɛ́ tɔ nɛn nɛɛ wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, cheɡ deŋne no n wesoŋa nɔ, kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le ɔma maa dɛ ɔmɛ n dɔma ta.
Lɛɛ mɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena vɔrɔwa nyoa, lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa wara nɔn ta.
Ba nyoa wobol nyɛɡre kɛŋɔ, kere, dɛɛ yaɡɛ kɛŋɔ kpaah yon ta hɛmchɔɡe la ken.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena baa wola ɔmɛ la, ta hɛma wɔrɔbe nɛɛ le ba sɔɔhbɔr, dɛɛ yaɡɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra.
Ba dɛ do dɔŋa ɡbemba ba wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa ta, dɛɛ baɡle bela baa kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔ haɡre bela la sɔh.
Ba yon ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa aa yaa na.” Ba dɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Waa yaa vɔrɔwa nɔ maɡrɔ kɛrɛdɛ!” Kasinteŋ, nɛwɛnyini tea bini aa jemɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, ba ne jara dɛ ba choɡlo chɔ, kɛŋɔ baa ta hɛma yaɡ ba ken.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo ba vɔrɔwa la bwa ɡure ba nyu ta, ásɛ nɛra na ba dɛɛ viiɡi ba nyuune, dɛɛ mam ba.
Nɛwɛnyina bwa ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ, dɛ́ na waa Korowii aa ɛa, dɛ́ kpɔ do ba liire bini.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa ɛɛ hɛɡroo, dɛ́ chwa ka marɔ, ásɛ nɛra ba bambile bini aa toa kpɛɛro.
Korowii kpɛɛra ne o jaama Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, henee chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ duure tɛɛ bwɛjen Saayɔn, dɛ́ chuɡri ya nyobaɡa yaa baɡɛ la, dɛkalkɛ henee dɛɛ no ya wesoŋa.
Nɛra ɛɛ le bobɛlbwaa ba he be dɛ́ ba tomɛ, ba wechɔɡa aa ɡwaa ba nɛɛ la wa, ásɛ he kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba.
Nɛra haa lee ba ŋɔ bá ba so he Dea bela la, ba na som.
Ya sie ɛɛ lɛ kondɛɛɡa haa swee yaa a do he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la taa.
N Naa Korowii haa dɛ lɛ yaa, he cheɡɛ he nyokpowe-ɛɛla ta, dɛ no ya wesoŋa.
He nɛɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa, ne banɔ la baa lɔ mpo jaɡa bwa ɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.
He kpeɡri taa he che dɛ ta bwejena dɛ chaɡle kpeɡri kohona haa dɔa.
He ɡelɔ mpo nehɛma sii nyoa hel, asɛ harɛre nɛra nyoa sɔɔh, moola baa dɛ moo ta.
Bambiteŋa kohona chole harɛre nɛra nɛ, he wejena haa ɛa la wa.
He we-ɛɛla ba silɛɛ ne ba tɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ bwa ta, baa moo.
He dɛ dawɛ ya wa, dɛ ɡel bwaala ɛɛ nɛ harɛ nɔ ta, o do wer dɛɛ ɛ konduula kohona.
He ɡelɔ nenabɔɔne bwa suuɡi, nɛra dɔ kondikwaa dɛɛ di.
Gɛ haa ɛa laanee teŋa nɔ, he nɛ bwaala tɔɡa kooni baa para ta, asɛ harɛ bwa sɔɔh kohona.
He ɡelɔ o nɛ kompar ta, harɛ pwɛr a won le dɛ kpeɡ.
He wer haa doa nomanta, he ɡelɔ kondikwaa ba kohona, dɛ bu harɛ ta bobɛlbwa.
Hale kpɔɡa moɡɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, asɛ deŋɡarere do wer kɛŋɔ nɛra sie aa lɛa ken.
Peera lɔ kpɔɡ bini bobɛlbwa, dɛɛ di, fɛlembɔjena bwa su mea, aa ɡo yela dɛɛ moo silɛɛ ne kɛ nɛra ken.
Korowii kpɛɛra ne o jaama Yelɡoɡoo bɛl yel Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta, hé ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ Korowii!
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ o sɔn waa dɔ jirima la, hé duuru dɛ́ kpɔ jirima tɛo.
Hé ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “He we-ɛɛla dɔ nyokpoa, he kpeɡri haa dɔa ɡe do kan kohona a ɡel he dɔma kpɔ ɔmee baa ɡuŋi he sie.
Harɛre nɛra bwa dɛ tomɛ, dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛre, ba ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ he sɔn.” Hé ba, dɛ́ ba na waa Korowii aa ɛa, nyokpowe-ɛɛla waa koh nɛwɛnyina waa dɛ ɛ. Onee ɡela mpo hweeh, harɛpɛɛ hol chɔ, ya naawa valɛ kpɔ o ta le.
Belaa ya sie lɛ, waa Korowii aa ɛa wa.
O cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa.
O sie lɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛ, deŋnekpeɡ tena bɛ habɔɔ berɛ kpoo.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, hé ɡel baa no kpɛɛra haa dɛ kpɛɛro la bobɛlbwa.
O nyiŋi ya nɛɛ ya ta so le, o ta ɡelɛ ya lɔ naa dɛ chole.
N Naa Korowii, he daah yaa na kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ suuɡapoŋ do nii ta, dɛ laa o doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ o ta la ken.
He ɡelɔ ya le bel haa harɛ yaa ta, dɛ kpɔ bontɔɡa dawɛ ya nɛ.
He ɡelɔ ya dɔma pɔ ya nɛ, ya na wahala kɛŋɔ nii ne nee aa chɔɡ nɛra kwaa ken, kɛ taraken, he berɔ kpɔ yaa ba harɛ o taa soma ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ba tɛɛ he Dea, dɛ́ chuɡri n nyobaɡa maa baɡɛ la.
Mɛɛ kpɔ kwaa maa baɡɛ nyoa n wenaale saŋ laanee ba tɛɛ.
Mɛɛ kpoo peeraa bá fuh ɛ saraha he saraha kon la ta, dɛ́ lawɛ pebala ne nabala dɛ boohna ba tɛɛ, ásɛ a ninchuu la tɛr dɛɛ kaa nyundua.
Hé ba, dɛ́ ba no, he nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, ásɛ n baɡle waa waa ɛa tɛ mɛ.
N wio noo ŋɔ ó cha mɛ, asɛ dɛ ɡo kpɛɛra yela tɛo.
Dɛ n vɛh n wechɔɡa bola aa, Korowii fe ta n be noɛ.
Kasinteŋ, Korowii no n wesoŋa, o no n wii maa wia noo la.
Korowiirii dɔ jam, dɛkalkɛ o ta n wesoŋa vɛɛh, kɛɛ dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ne.
Korowii jaama Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, na ya sum dɛ swee yaa andɛɛɡa, nyiŋi ya nɛɛ dɛ́ na ya sum, ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa jemɛ waa haa dɛ nyin, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba bwa na ɡɛ haa won nɛra lɛɛ.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa kpɛɛre, kasinteŋ, a chɛ kɛ bá bwa kpɛɛre.
Gel harɛre nɛra bwa ɡo silɛɛ yela, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ o ta.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa kpɛɛre, kasinteŋ, a chɛ kɛ bá bwa kpɛɛre.
Kondikwa ɛɛ wonoo ɛ ya harɛ nɔ ta kohona, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ swee yaa andɛɛɡaa.
Korowii ɛɛ swee yaa andɛɛɡaa, ásɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa ɛɛ tomɔ.
Harɛ bɛl dɔma nɛɛ pɔe Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne ásɛ dɛ lɔ he dɔma peɡre, he dɔma ɛɛ chwao le he sie.
Gɛ peu yon ta dɛ́ kpɔ ninchuu kaa la, ɡɛɛ he kpɔ ba kaa ta.
Gɛ ba yon kpɔ nii dɛɛ mwɛɛ tohkel la, ɡel nɛnchɔɡa sewɛ he sie ɡɛ.
Kɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra sie lɛo, baa hɛɡre hen Korowii sie, ba sie lɛo baa moo.
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii sɔn, hé kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛo, o le baama bini dɛɛ ba.
O sɔne Korowii, hɛɛ hɛɡre o sie.
O ɛ bilalbii mɛɛ, dɛɛ che luhaahna habɔɔ.
Onee Korowii waa soɡe o Dea waa do ɡoroŋ bini.
Korowiirii tɛ nɛra baa nya nɛra bɔr, ba yon so, dɛ le nɛra baa do ba dea, dɛ ɡel ba sie lɛ baa di ba nyu.
Bambikpeɡ tena te, harɛ waa chɔɡa taa baa ba soɡa.
N Naa Korowii, haa tɔ he nɛra sie, dɛ valɛ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la, harɛ jiɡro asɛ bwaala nɛ he sie.
Henee Sinai Bwejen Dɔɔ, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ bwaala nɛ kohona, dɛ sɔɔh harɛ haa kpɔa baɡɛ yaa nyoa la ta.
He ɡelɔ he nɛra so o ta, asɛ he tesom kohona nomanta, he kpɔ tɛ nyaara.
Korowii bol wa, ásɛ haahna warɛ kohona dɛ́ kaa bola ŋɔ, “Koranar ne ba laa tena chwao le dɛɛ kaa!” Haahna baa ka dem la kpɔ laala baa kpɔa laa ta la bɔne dɔŋa.
Nɛra baa kaa dɛ do bela dɛɛ daah peera la, dɔ suuɡapoŋa baa kpɔa dawɛ kwehre kena ta.
Suuɡaswɛm dawɛ a kena nyoo dɛɛ nyɛɡle.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ aa lɔ koranar peɡre harɛ la ta la, a do kɛŋɔ dombwea aa lee Salmɔn Bwejen ta ken.
Bwejena aa lɔ Basan harɛ jaŋne kaa nyundua kɛrɛdɛ, bwea paaɡe a dor kɛŋɔ deŋɡarere ken.
Ɛrɛɛ he bwejena haa lɔ Basan, ɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii bwe waa do ɡoroŋ, kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ we o dɔŋ bwara dɛɛ nyiŋu nɔɔ?
Korowii ɛɛ so bela saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la!
Korowii dɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, baa wola won kura, dɛ le Sinai Bwejen ta, dɛɛ ba o Dea la ta.
O teehnɔ kaa nyundua, dɛ lawɛ nɛra waa laɡ ba laa ta kaa, asɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena kpɔ koŋkɛɛla baa tɛo dɛ ŋɔ, Korowii ɛɛ ba so belaa.
Ya kpɛɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, onee ya Lɛɛ la.
Tɔpere bwaa wɛɛ nyiŋi ya nɛ, ya waa bwa dawɛ o nɛ.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ɛ Korowii waa dɛ lɛ yaa, Nemenɛ Korowii won yaa lɛɛ dɛ́ le seo nyoa.
Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɛɛ paɡre o dɔma nyuunee, banɔ la ba taa lɔ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta la.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ le he dɔma ne Basan harɛɛ ba, mɛɛ le ba ne mpo vile binii, ásɛ he valɛ kpɔ ba chal ta, he nyootena ɡe kpɛla ɡɛ aa dɛ nyin.” N Naa Korowii, nɛra bwa nae he valɛ baa kaa, Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ o ɛ n kooro la baa jo o Dea bini.
Yelɡoola tɔ sie, nɛra baa dɛ lɔ yela teŋɛ, asɛ bitoli baa dɛ yiiɡi loŋa do ba baah ta.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii bela o nɛra aa wara dɛ cheme.
Israel tena bwa, hé cheme dɛ́ kpɛɛro.
Bɛnjamen dea nɛra baa wola kanɛ la tɔ sie, Juda dea nomonome teŋɛ, ásɛ Sebulon ne Naftale deene nomonome ɡe teŋɛ.
Ya Naa Korowii, chaɡle he kpeɡri, kpeɡri he fa aa chaɡle ya nɛɛ la.
He Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam nomanta, koranar ɛɛ kpɔ koŋkɛɛlaa ba tɛɛ.
Tɛr Ijipt nɛra baa do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini ola, aa chɔ nee nyoa la deŋne.
Tɛr harɛre nɛra baa do kɛŋɔ nabala, dɛ koo nabii bini la deŋne, ka tel saŋ baa ba ɡuŋi harɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ ba suuɡapoŋa ba tɛɛ.
Lɔ harɛre nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ laa yoi ta la bwa peɡre.
Nomonome ɛɛ che Ijipt tena naa taa ba, ásɛ Itiopia tena ɡe kpɔ ba te ba do Korowii lɔɡa.
Harɛre nɛra, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro, onee soɡe nyundujaɡla, dɛ do le saŋ la bwa.
Hé cheɡ deŋne no kɔɡra waa dɛ kɔɡre kohona.
Hé bol o kpeɡri waa dɔa wa, o nyanyini bɔle Israel tena nɛ, o kpeɡri do nyundua ɡe.
Korowii le o Dea dɛɛ ba naa, ɔmee kohona dɛ chole nɛra nɛ.
Onee Israel tena ɛɛ tomɛ, wɛɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri.
Hé kpɛɛro!
Chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ, n wenaale do kɛŋɔ nee aa sua dɛ ba maɡɛ n baŋa ta.
A do kɛŋɔ maa dɛ morɛ vil kpechɛɡre aa lɔ o bini, n ta bodɛɛɡe dɔe ń kpɔ n naa cheɡ.
A do kɛŋɔ maa le vil bini nehɛma ɛɛ ba lɔe ba tɔ n nɛ.
N wio noe ŋɔ hé ba cha mɛ, dɛ ba koh, n lobi bwa holɔ.
N nyiŋi he siwi ta, he ba cha mɛ kahonɛ.
Nɛra baa hah mɛ pɛɛ warɔ ɡwaa n nyumpona.
N dɔma teŋe nyosone dɛɛ dawɛ n nɛ, ba bwara kpeɡri baa nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo, ba ɡelɔ n berɛ bɔ kwaa maa wola ŋwɛɛ kem tɛɛ ba.
N Naa Korowii, n wechɔɡa bwa chɔ he sie, he jemɛ n ɡɛnewaa bwa.
Nemenɛ Korowii, bɛ ɡel nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ he nɛɛ la di sihiih n wa.
Bɛ ɡel a che n nɛɛ sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ.
Henee Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ.
He waa ba koh dɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ, asɛ sihiih kpo mɛ.
N berɛ hɔɔh n lolanar be, dɛ do kɛ nomɛl waa le harɛfale bɛl ta, n ɡbaɡba nɛra bini.
He Dea la waa swɛɛ n siwi taeh, chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡre bwa ɡe dawɛ n nɛ.
N vɔwɛ nyoa dɛɛ di suna, asɛ nɛra ɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ.
N tɔ lweyal asɛ baa mam mɛ.
Ba dɛ bol n waa fɔɡbaahna, sennyɔdɛɛra kpɔ mɛ dɛɛ ɡo yela.
Kɛ N Naa Korowii, henee n wi dɛɛ no, le saŋ haa dɛ nyin cheɡ dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ.
Chaŋ mɛ he nyina waa kana la wa, he nyoa haa baɡ mɛ nomanta, hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale aa do kɛ maa dɛ morɛ vil kpechɛɡre aa lɔ o bini ta.
Lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ne vile ta.
Bɛ ɡel nee la su ba kpɔ mɛ, bɛ ɡel ń ka chɔ vile bini, kɛɛ seo ba kpo mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ta, dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ.
Berɛ sie n be, dɛ́ sune n nɛɛ kohona.
Bɛ he sie laa kpɔ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛ, n lɔ wenaale kohona bini, ba dɛ́ ba cha mɛ warane!
Ba n be dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ta.
He ɡbabir na ɡɛ baa dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, ɡɛ sihiih aa dɛ kpo mɛ, baa wola men komɛlbwa yerɛ, he dɛ na n dɔma bwa.
Chɛɡa ɡelɔ n bambile chɔɡ, dɛ ɡel n liire bwa damɛ.
N dɛ nyin nomɛl ó fee ba larawe n bwara, n ta nɛn nae, kɛɛ nomɛl ba do mɛ ɡbemba, kɛ nɛn toole.
Lɔr aa dɛ kpo mɛ la, ba kpɔ tɛɡkpela do kondikwaa ta tɛ mɛ n di, nyoɡre ɡe aa dɛ kpo mɛ la, sennyɛɡaa ba tɛ mɛ n nyɔ.
Gɛ saŋ baa dɛɛ di kwaa dɛɛ lɛ ba sie la, ɡel siswɛm piɡ ba, ɡel ba kondikonjena dii ber ba kwaa baa lɔ naa a ta dɛ́ choɡli.
Gel ba nyoŋe, ásɛ dɛɛ na wahala saŋ bɛlbwa.
Gel he bandia kohona la ba ba nɛ, kpɔ he bandia waa do ɔma kohona ta ba nɛ.
Gel ba sobɔr chɔ pɛɛ, nomɛlbwa bɛ ba tɛnte deene bini do, dɛkalkɛ ba dɛ ɛ nɛra haa tɛr ba deŋne la hɔhɔrɔwa, dɛɛ bol nɛra haa do ba bola, ba bonyɛɡa baa dɛ na la wa.
Chwerɛ ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa bwa bil, bɛ ɡel ba ja he lɛɛ haa dɛ lɛ nɛra la ta.
Gel ba fee ba sɔna le Mkpa Tɔn la bini, bɛ ba sɔna kpɔ ja he nɛra nɛ.
N Naa Korowii, n bwara dɛ nyɛɡ, n hwɛɡa tonɛ, laɡ mɛ ir dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ Korowii sɔn, dɛ́ kpɔ jam tɛo o kan waa doa wa.
Anee dɛ su o siwi dɛ́ ɡwaa, kɛ baa kpɔ nabal baa sao ɛ saraha tɛo, a ɡwaa kɛ baa kpo nabal waa kpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ tɛo.
Nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la na ɡɛ naa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛo, ásɛ banɔ la baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii dɔ ɡbemba.
Korowii dɛ no nɛŋɡwɛɡra wii, waa nɛra baa laɡ ba do dea waa soh.
Korowii kontaala aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ kwaa bwa kpɛɛ Korowii, mpo ne kwaa aa lɔ o bini bwa ɡe kpɛɛro.
Korowii ɛɛ lɛ Jerusalam tenaa, dɛ́ berɛ kwaa ma Juda harɛ bwɛjena, ásɛ o nɛra berɛ ka kpɔ harɛ la, dɛ́ so o ta.
O bonɔɔna naanaree dɛ́ ka so o ta, nɛra baa dɛ nyin o waa laanee dɛ́ ka so bela.
Chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, n dɛ soŋe, lɛɛ mɛ.
Ba warane, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.
Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo la, bá wili.
Nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ n wenaale ta la, ber ba kaa, dɛ́ ɡel sihiih kpo ba.
Gel banɔ la baa dɛ mam mɛ la bambile chɔɡ, he pɔe haa pɔ ba nɛɛ la wa.
Nɛra baa laŋa kaa tomɛ la, ɡel ba dɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ hɛɡre.
Gel nɛra haa lɛɛ ba ba dɔ mkpa la ɛɛ ŋɔ, “Na ɡɛ Korowii aa kana!” N Naa Korowii, n nyao dɛ ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre, ba n be warane.
Henee n Lɛɛ, n poori, ba warane dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.
Banjena bɛl wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, henee n chwa baa marɛ, bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ.
Che toɡra he wa aa toɡra ta, dɛ́ cheɡ deŋne no n be, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.
He do kɛŋɔ Bwetal maa chwaa baa marɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, che he waa haa bola la ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.
Henee n Bwetal, ne n danjwɛkpeɡ.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, lɛɛ mɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena, ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔn ta.
Dɛkalkɛ Nemenɛ Korowii, he nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, n kpɔ n te dawɛ he nɛ, dɛ le n bechale saŋ bwa.
N soɡa bini bwaa n le, dɛ kpɔ n te dawɛ he nɛ, baa lol mɛ bwaa he le, dɛ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ.
Mɛɛ kpɛɛree saŋ bɛlbwa.
Nɛra ɡalɡa hweli n we-ɛɛla, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa, dɛkalkɛ henee cheɡɛ n habɔɔ.
Tɔpebir bwaa mɛɛ kpɛɛre, dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ he jirima aa doa.
Bɛ men ta n hwɛɛhra bini, bɛ men vɛh n ɡwɛɡra saŋ.
N dɔma dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo, ba dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa.
Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Korowii vɛoh, hé ɡel ya tiu dɛ́ lawɔ, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ lɛo.” N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel n ne he baah do jaŋne, ba warane dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.
Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛ, nɛra baa dɛ nyin n ne wechɔɡa la, ɡel ba di ncho kohona.
Kɛ n te, mɛɛ kpɔ n hwɛɡaa do he nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, maa he kpɛɛraa ɡel bwa.
Mɛɛ bol he wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa, dɛ́ bol lɛɛ haa dɛ lɛ nɛra tɔpebir bwa wa, a lole kɛ a ɡwaa n liire ta kɛ ń won jemɛ.
Nemenɛ Korowii, mɛɛ bol he wejena haa ɛa waa, mɛɛ bol toɡra he wa aa toɡra waa, he ɡbosoo waa toɡra.
N bechale saŋ bwaa he le baɡ mɛ he nyokpowe-ɛɛla wa, n ta ɛɛ bola dɛ ba le fini.
Hale n hwɛɛhrɔ n nyumpona to kwaraa naa, N Naa Korowii, bɛ men ta.
Ja n nɛ, ásɛ n bol he kpeɡri ne he kan haa doa waa baɡle n naanar baa ka ba bwa.
N Naa Korowii, toɡra he wa aa toɡra kan kohona, he we-ɛɛla ɡe kan kohona.
He habɔɔ, nomɛlbwa toole.
A lole kɛŋɔ he ɡelɔ n na wahala kohona te, kɛ hɛɛ berɔ ɡel n dɔ bokpeɡa ja, hɛɛ laɡ mɛɛ le seo nyoa, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ mkpa.
Hɛɛ ɡeloo ń ɛ nɛnjen kohona, dɛ́ berɛ kwaa larawe n bwara ja.
Mɛɛ lɔ janjelaa kpɛɛre, N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, mɛɛ kpɛɛree he kasinteŋ haa dɔa la wa.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n janjelaa lɔ yela kpɛɛ hen Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la.
Mɛɛ do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ nee, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre, he lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.
Mɛɛ bol he toɡra haa toɡra waa tɔpebir bwaa, dɛkalkɛ nɛra ba fe aa dɛ nyin n ne wechɔɡa la, sihiih kpo ba, ba wili.
Korowii soŋa dɛ́ tɛ kooro N Naa Korowii, baɡle kooro ɡɛ waa bol wa, dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, ɡɛ he wa aa toɡra.
Baɡlo o do ɡɛ haa doa la, ásɛ dɛ bol he nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ nyiŋi he nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne.
Gel kondikwaa ba ya harɛ ta kohona, toɡra he nɛra wa aa toɡra la wa.
Gel kooro bol nyaara waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ cha ba bii, dɛ́ pɔ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la nɛ.
Gɛ wee ne korobie aa dɛ chaah saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ, ɡɛɛ he naanar baa ka ba ɡe, ɛɛ ba he toma saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gel kooro do kɛŋɔ bwaala waa ɡela koo kwa ɛɛ do wer, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ bwaala nee aa ɡela harɛ sɔɔh, dɛɛ do wer la ken.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel waa aa wera dɛ toɡre la do harɛ nɔ ta, o kora dii ta saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ka tel kɛŋɔ, korobie aa ɡel chaahna.
Wɛɛ di koraa le mpo bɛl ta ba kaa bɛl ta, dɛ le Yufretis Moo ta ba kaa harɛ jaɡa.
Nɛra baa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi o siee, ásɛ o dɔma chole chɔ bomboɡ ta.
Taases harɛ koranar, ne nɛra baa soɡe mpo nyoa bojaŋa ɛɛ kpɔ ba harɛre kwaa ba tɛo.
Seeba ne Seba koranar ɡee kpɔ koŋkɛɛlaa ba tɛo.
Koranar bwa ɛɛ ba ɡuŋuu, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa tomɔ.
Kooro la ɛɛ lɛ nyaara baa wia dɛɛ noo, ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra baa wola nɛra dɔe bá cha ba laanee.
Wɛɛ na nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra sumii, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le seo nyoa.
Wɛɛ lɛɛ ba le fiiɡa ne nɛnchɔɡa nɔn taa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba mkpa dɔe waa hiaoh.
N Naa Korowii tɛ kooro mkpajaŋ!
Gel nɛra le Seeba harɛ ta dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ba tɛo.
Gel nɛra sweero andɛɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ soŋe dɛɛ tɛo tɔpere bɛlbwa ɡe.
Gel boyu perɛ harɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ mea ɡe bu deŋɡarere bwa dor.
Gel a ɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ anɔ la aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ bwejena dor, ásɛ nɛra ɡe su bwɛjena la ta, kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa lɔ koo ta ken.
Gel kooro sɔn do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛŋɔ, wee aa lole dɛɛ lɔ saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ.
Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ che o nɛɛ dɔ andɛɛɡa ásɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ Korowii sweero andɛɛɡa.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ!
O ɡboo dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla.
Hé kpɛɛ o sɔn waa dɔ jirima saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Hé ɡel o jirima su harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Aamen.
Jese bibaa Kooro Devid wesoŋa la jaɡaa nɔ.
Yela tɔn toorote Korowii kasinteŋ waa dɔa Asaf yel Kasinteŋ, Korowii waa wer tɛ o nɛra Israel tena, banɔ la ba tea bini aa toa dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa ta la.
Kɛ n te, a ka tama n liire fe chɔɡ, n yarada ɡe fee tonɛ, dɛkalkɛ n na ɡɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena, ne mbarafo tena wa aa wera dɛɛ tɛɛ ba la aa, dɛ n dɛ wee ba bwara.
Baa bonyɛɡa bɛlbwa na, ba bwara kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ.
Baa wenaale aa dawɛ nɛwɛnyina nɛɛ la na.
Baa weechɔɡa aa dɛ ba nɛra nɛɛ la we.
Anomanta, ba kpɔ mbarafo do baŋa kɛŋɔ baŋa kwa, asɛ naɡrenyin ber ba yal ba kpɔ tɔ.
Wechɔɡa su ba bambili, nyubinikpeɡ vɔrɔwa ɡbo waa swɛɛ ba siwi baa lii.
Ba dɛ mamɛ ba bala, dɛɛ bol ba bwara wechɔɡa, ba dɔ mbarafo, dɛɛ vɔrɔwe ɡɛ baa fiiɡi ba bala.
Ba bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ Korowii waa lɔ nyundua, dɛ che mbarafo ta dɛɛ do nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta wechɔɡa ta.
Anomanta, Korowii nɛra berɔ baa teŋɛ ba nɛ, dɛɛ yarada waa baa dɛ ɛ la bambile bwa ne kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba wona jemɛ ɔ?
Nemenɛ Korowii ta a wejema dɔe.” Gɛɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena waa do, wobɛlbwa aa ban ha, ba dɔ kondɔɔh saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ ja.
Amɔ pɛɛpɛɛ n ɡel n bambile bini to, n ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ nɔ naa?
N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ n bwara nyɛɡ mɛ tɔpebir bwa, chɔɔ bɛlbwaa hɛɛ tɛr n deŋne.
Dɛ n bol ɡɛ waa la bɛlbwa naa, n fe le he nɛra la tɛ.
N fe takapɔ kɛŋɔ n no ɡɛ waa nɔ mun, kɛ a kpeɡri tɛ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, nemenɛ maa jo hen Korowii Dea mɔɔ, dɛ jemɛ waa aa pu nyubinikpeɡ tena la.
Kasinteŋ, hɛɛ ɡeloo ba lɔ na, dɛ́ choɡli baa wola won ir kpa.
Ba chɔɡɔ buɡ la ta, dɛ sewɛ seo wɔb.
Ba do kɛŋɔ nɛn yon chɔ dɛ́ dee, tɔɔ ne pera dɛ o soɔh la ken.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡɔɔ he te naa, ba bwa dɛ́ peɡre.
N bambile aa chɔɡa, n loo ku la, dɛ n ɡɛnɔ kɛŋɔ ol ken, n ta he waa mun noɛ.
Kɛ dɛ saŋ bɛlbwa n ja he nɛ, he lawɛ n nɔn kpoŋe.
He dɛ baɡ mɛ asɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he waa la ta.
A habɔɔ la, hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ ń dɔ jirima.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡboo lɔ nyundua dɛ́ won cha mɛ.
He habɔɔ, maa komɛlbwa nyin harɛ nɔ ta.
N bwadabii ɡwɛɡrɔ n liire chɔɡ aa, hen Korowiirii dɛ́ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa, henee n komɛlbwa.
Nɛra baa berɛ habɔɔ kpoe la bwa ɛɛ serewoo, ɡɛɛ nɛra baa wola he waa ta teŋɛ la, hɛɛ ba ɡela ba ɡe serewe.
Kɛ n te, a wer kɛŋɔ ń bɛne hen Korowii.
Hen Nemenɛ Korowiirii n chwa baa marɛ, hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ, mɛɛ bol he nyokpowaa haa ɛa bwaa baɡle nɛra.
Israel harɛ nɛra lɛɛ wesoŋa Asaf yel N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ he den vɛh yaa kwaraa ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin he baah di he ɡbabir nɛra nɛɛ ka tel ɔ?
Lii he nɛra saŋ la haa lee ba cheɡ tɛ he te la wa, nɛra haa lɛɛ ba le fiiɡa baa dɛ fiɡ ba ta.
Lii Saayɔn Bwejen he fa aa soɡe o ta la wa.
Ba dɛ́ ba na he Dea ya dɔma aa kuuɡu, o chɔɡ dɛ berɛ dimɡbia la.
He dɔma moolo dɛɛ hɛɡre he Dea la bini, ba kpɔ ba fraŋkaare pa, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba pɔ ya nɛ.
Ba do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa kpɔ kpanfɛre dɛɛ teŋni daa ken.
Ba kpɔ ba kpanfɛre ne ba saahne chɔɡ kwaa baa kpɔ daa sɛah la bwa.
Ba fuh he Dea la, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah bela baa dɛ tomɛ la.
Ba bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Yaa chɔɡ baa kwaraa!” Ba fuh dea bɛlbwa baa dɛ tomɛ hen Korowii o ta harɛ la ta.
Korowii keamere toole kpa, ásɛ ya na he nyokpowe-ɛɛla.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe aa jemɛ saŋ ya wenaale aa ba a jaɡa.
N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo ya dɔma mamɛ ka tel ɔ?
Bá na dɛ́ bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ he sɔn saŋ bɛlbwa ɡɛ kɛɛ?
Ɛrɛɛ he laa sie kpɔ ya nɛ haa wola yaa ba cha nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he fɔɔ nɔɔra haa wola ba deŋnee ba tɛr nɔɔ?
N Naa Korowii, henee Kooro le saŋ la bwa, henee bala dɛ́ ba lɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra.
He cheɡɛ he kpeɡri kohona ta, dɛ ɡel mpo pere, dɛ paɡre mpo bini oljena nyuune.
Henee paɡre mpo bini oljen baa dɛ yerɔ Lɛvayatan la nyuune, dɛ kpɔ tɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta olchɔɡa a di.
He ɡelɔ buli ne nenabɔɔne ɛɛ palɛ, dɛ ɡel mojena hweeh.
Henee ta bɔchaah ne biro, dɛ kpɔ wee ne korobie cheɡ a chebɔra, henee bil harɛ jwɛhre, dɛ ta bwaala ne lɔmɔɡa saŋ.
N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ he dɔma aa dɛ mamɛ, na ɡɛ nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ aa dɛ ɛɛ nɛnhɛla.
Bɛ he nɛra baa ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra, ɡel tɛ ba dɔma ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa kohona nɔ.
Bɛ he nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la waa soh.
Lii fɔo ya ne haa fɔwa la wa.
Nɛra sɔɔh dɛɛ ɛ naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla biro bini, harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la, ɡel nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra kpɛɛ he sɔn.
N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ nyiŋi he waa ta, dɛ́ dɔ waane bol, bɛ soh kɛŋɔ ɡɛna dɛ mamɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Bɛ ɡbɔɡa he dɔma aa doa dɛɛ muɡli he baah la soh, ɡbɔɡa he dɔma aa teŋa dɛɛ do la.
Korowii waa dɛ pa bole Asaf yel N Naa Korowii, ya kpɔ jam dɛɛ tɛɛ, ya dɛ bol kan haa doa, ne nyokpowaa haa ɛa wa.
Korowii ŋɔ, “N le saŋ bɛl cheɡ dɛ́ bol nɛra wa, dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Dɛ harɛ jiɡro Korowii kontaala bwa ɛɛ chel aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo kwaa aa lawɔ kpoŋe la che kiŋkiŋ.
N dɛ ŋɔ mbarafo tena be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel mbarafo ɛɛ’, dɛ ŋɔ nyubinikpeɡ tena ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel mbarafo wobol bola.
He bɛ waa bol yaɡɛ men Korowii.’ ” Nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole toole wee leebɔr kɛɛ wee cholibɔr, weekaŋle harɛbɔr kɛɛ weekaŋle nyundua.
Korowiirii bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.
Onee dɛɛ pa boldɛɛɡe, dɛɛ pa bolchɔɡe ɡe.
Korowii kpoŋe numol, o bandia aa do kɛŋɔ danana nee suu.
O fuɡa kɛŋɔ seŋkpeɡa tɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena bwa ba nyɔ, ba nyɔ a bwa a tonɛ kwaraa.
Kɛ n te, maa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ waa bolaa ɡel saŋ bɛlbwa bwa, mɛɛ ɡo kpɛɛra yelaa tɛo.
Wɛɛ sɔɔh kpeɡri nɛnchɔɡa aa dɛ di la nyoaa, kɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra te, wɛɛ berɔ tɛɛ ba bokpeɡa.
Korowii pɔ o dɔma nɛ Asaf yel Nɛra baa lɔ Juda harɛ ta jemɛ Korowii, hale Israel harɛ ta tena dɛ́ bol ŋɔ Korowii sɔn kan. Jerusalamee o bwɛ, o so Saayɔn Bwejen doa.
Belaa o kuuɡi o dɔma hɛma, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe ne keri, dɛ dɔmkwaa bwa soo siwi.
N Naa Korowii, he jirima kan, he kpɔ le bwejena haa yo he dɔma, dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ a ta la dor.
Ba lɛ dɔmkwaa bwa aa lɔ ba banyoola be, asɛ ba serewe chɔ.
Ba kpeɡri ne ba wejema bwa ɛ wepuu.
Korowii Jekɔb aa dɛ tomɛ, haa aah ba la, ba jaɡre ne nɛra baa soɡe a ta bwa serewɔ.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡbosoo nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɔmɛ, he baah diu waa, nomɛlbwa aa won che he sie.
Nyundua he che bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole, asɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ɔmɛ dɛ hel jeih ken, ɡɛ saŋ haa ira che dɛ́ pa nɛra bole dɛ́ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba harɛ nɔ ta la.
Kasinteŋ, he baah di nɛra nɛ aa, a ɡelɔ baa kpɛɛre.
Banɔ la baa le he bandia nyoa la, ba dɛ nyiŋi ba te kɛrɛdɛ.
Hé kpɔ kwaa haa baɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nyoa la ba tɛo.
Harɛre nɛra haa bɛna bwa, hé kpɔ koŋkɛɛla ba tɛo, onee chɛ kɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɔmɛ.
O dɛ sɔɔh koranar bambikpeɡ nyoa, koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa dɛ ɔmɔ.
Bolarawa dɔe suna dii ta Asaf yel N wio no Korowii ŋɔ, ó cha mɛ, n wio noo asɛ o no n be.
Gɛ saŋ wa aa puu mɛ la, n wio no Korowii, n ɡɔɔ nɔɔra jwaana bwa dɛ soŋo, kɛ n ta bolarawa bɛlbwa dɔe.
N Naa Korowii, n lii he wa aa, n bambile chɔɡɔ mɛɛ hime.
N lii he wa aa, n bwara dɛ yɔr.
He ɡelɔ maa won dom chɔ, n bwara dɛ nyɛɡ n bol waa kahonɛ.
N lii tɔpera, ne bene aa baa kaa saŋ la wa.
N chɔɔ jwaana bɛlbwa naa, n liire ɡwaa n nɛ.
N liira ɡɛ naa, waa maa dɛ bɔɔ n te laanee kɛŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ den vɛh yaa kwaraa ɡɛ naa?
Waa ya nɛɛ sune kpa aa?
O nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la toole ya nɛɛ kpa aa?
Nyoa waa baɡɛ yaa la toole kpa aa?
Korowii soɔh kɛŋɔ ó sune ya nɛ aa?
Bandia baa chiɡ tedoma waa dɔa tɛ nɛra la naa ta kɛɛ?” Asɛ n ŋɔ, “Waa aa dɛ ha mɛ kohona laanee kɛ, Nemenɛ Korowii ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ won lɛ yaa kpa kɛɛ?” N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ lii he wejena haa ɛa la waa, he nyokpowaa haa ɛa saŋ la.
Mɛɛ lii waa haa ɛa laanee, ásɛ dɛ lii he wejena haa ɛa la bwa.
N Naa Korowii, he wobɛlbwa do ɡoroŋ, voɡa nɛra aa dɛ tomɛ la ta kpeɡri dɔe kɛŋɔ, hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ nɔ.
Henee Korowii haa dɛ ɛ nyokpowa, he baɡle he kpeɡri harɛre nɛra bwa bini.
He cheɡɛ he kpeɡri ta dɛ lɛ he nɛra, Jekɔb ne Josef naanar bwa.
N Naa Korowii, neerare do kɛŋɔ nɛra, dɛ nae dɛɛ ɔmɛ, asɛ mpo vile ɡe ɛɛ chel he sie.
Baama nɛ bwaala, dɛ nyɛɡle le nyundua, asɛ dɛ kɔɡre dɛɛ nyɛɡle bobɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, haa ta he hɛma la ken.
He ɡelɔ bwaala nyɛɡle dɛɛ kɔɡre kohona, dɛɛ nyɛɡle harɛ nɔ ta bwa, asɛ harɛ jiɡri.
He valɛ mpo nehɛma ta dɛ ɡale o vile, kɛ ba ta he nabuɡe nae.
He tɔ he nɛra sie kɛŋɔ peteɡre ken, asɛ Mosis ne Arɔn chɔ ba nyoa.
Korowii ne o nɛra wa Asaf yel N nɛra, hé no waa maa dɛ baɡle heya, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa maa dɛ bol.
Mɛɛ kpɔ sɛɡlaa bol waa chaɡle heya, waa nomɛlbwa aa wola jemɛ bwa, le harɛ nɔ mumpar, waa yaa noa dɛ jema, anɔ la ya naawa aa bola baɡle yaa.
Yaa kpɔ sɔh ya bii, yaa boloo baɡle ya naanar baa ka ba, dɛ́ kpɛɛ Korowii kpeɡri ne o wejena, dɛ o nyokpo we-ɛɛla waa ɛa.
O kpɔ o Mmarare tɛ Israel tena baa ɛ Jekɔb naanar, a do le tɛɛ ba.
O baɡle ya naawa ŋɔ, bá kpɔ baɡle ba ɡe bii, ásɛ ya naanar baa ka ba la hweli le ba be, ba baa kpeɡ aa, bá ɡe bol baɡle ba bii.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel ba kpɔ ba hwɛɡa dawɛ Korowii nɛ, dɛ bɛ waa waa ɛa la soh, dɛ́ na dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare la ta.
Baa doe ba kɛŋɔ ba naawa, ba ɛ bambikpeɡ tena ne nɛra baa wola waa bu.
Baa ba te kpɔe dɛɛ dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛo.
Efrem laa tena kpɔ ba tori, kɛ aa tel laa ta la, ba berɔ chwa kaa dem.
Ba ta Korowii fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la ta teŋɛ, dɛ vɛh o Mmarare la.
Ba soh waa waa ɛa, nyokpowaa waa ɛa baɡ ba la.
O ɛ nyokpowaa ba naawa siwi ta, Soan harɛ waa chɔa kaa dɛ do Ijipt harɛ ta.
O ɡelɔ mpo pere anɛ, dɛ tɔ ba sie, asɛ ba valɛ o bini le kɛŋɔ harɛpɛɛ ken.
O ɡelɔ nee la teŋe che kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ diɡ ne ɡal.
O cheɡɛ bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua ta, dɛ tɔ ba sie webaŋa, asɛ jwaana bwa ɡe, o kpɔ nii waa tɛra kaa nyundua tɔ ba sie wɛɛ chaah ba ba won vala.
O pere bwea aa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta nee kohona le a bini, kɛŋɔ mpo nee ken tɛɛ ba.
O ɡelɔ nee le bwe ta, dɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ nenapale ken.
Kɛ ba teŋɔ ɛ Korowii wechɔɡa, dɛɛ ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii deŋnekpeɡ, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Ba saahnɔ daah Korowii na, dɛɛ nyin kondikwaa ba pɛla aa lawa.
Ba bol waa yaɡɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ won tɛ yaa kondikwaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bonɔ naa?
A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ o kpɔ kon lɔ bwe, asɛ nee fuɡe le kohona.
Aah wɛɛ won tɛ yaa kondikwaa dɛ tɛ yan yaa ɛ o nɛra nɔ ola ja aa?” Korowii aa no ba waa la, o baah diu, bandia kohona la ɡelɔ nii ba le o nɛra Israel tena nɛ, asɛ a ɡwaa ba nɛɛ kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ta o waa yaradae, ba ta lɛɛ do kɛŋɔ wɛɛ won lɛɛ ba.
Kɛ ane a bwa, Korowii nyoa wobol ɡelɔ nyundua pili.
O tɛɛ ba kondikwa ane soo siwi aa le nyundua baa dɛ yera maana ba di.
Anomanta, ba di kondikwa nyundua toroma aa dɛ di, o tɛɛ ba ba di dɛ vaɡre.
O ɡelɔ wee leebɔr peu ta, dɛ che o kpeɡri ta ɡel weekaŋle harɛbɔr kon ɡe ta, asɛ dɛ ɡel jumbii ba lee o nɛra la bini.
A warɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.
O ɡelɔ a ba lee bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la dembaah, dɛ bar ba tɛnte deene la bwa.
Ba diu dɛ vaɡre, dɛkalkɛ kondikwaa ba pɛla aa lawa laanee Korowii kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Ba taa dɛ di ba pɛla kondikwa a ta su ba nyoo la, Korowii baah di ba nɛ, o kpoo ba bini nɛŋkpeɡa, bonɔɔna ba bwara aa kpeɡa kohona Israel harɛ ta la.
Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ ba ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, o nyokpo we-ɛɛla la bwa habɔɔ, ba ta on yaradae.
Anomanta, o ɡelɔ ba teŋe sewɛ kɛŋɔ peu aa taa ba kaa ken, dɛ piɡri kpɔ wekpeɡa ba ta ba nɛ.
O baa kpoo ba bini bane aa, banɔ la baa kaa la yon berɛ ba o be, dɛ́ charɛ ba liire, dɛɛ soŋo sibeɡra ne.
Ba liiro kɛŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowiirii fa do kɛŋɔ Bwetal dɛɛ tɔ ba ɡbemɡbe, dɛ ɛ ba Lɛɛ.
Kɛ dɛ neɡra ɡboo baa neɡro, ba wobɛlbwa ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ.
Baa o waa ta teŋɛ, baa fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la ta teŋɛ.
Kɛ Korowii sune o nɛra nɛ, o kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, o ta ban chɔɡɛ.
Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa o lawɛ bambile, dɛ ɡel o bandia nyoa sɔɔh.
O liiro kɛŋɔ ba ɛ nɛwɛnyina baa dɛ ba wona sewɛ, dɛ do kɛŋɔ peu aa taa baa kaa ken.
Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ o nɛ, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ teŋɛ ɡel o bambile chɔɡ.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa ba na dɛ daah Korowii dɛɛ na, dɛɛ ir Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la bwaawee.
Ba soh o kpeɡri kohona ne tɔpere waa lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta, dɛ ɛ wejena ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla, Soan harɛ waa chɔa kaa, dɛ do Ijipt harɛ ta la wa.
O ɡelɔ Ijipt harɛ neerare bwa berɛ chal, ba nyin nee dɛ́ nyɔ kahonɛ.
O ɡelɔ chwɛɛhne fuɡe le ba nɛ, dɛ baa ha ba, asɛ sapone ɡe ba chɔɡ ba harɛ.
O ɡelɔ tontombɛ ba chɔɡ ba kondikwa, dɛ chɔɡ ba kooni.
O ɡelɔ dombwea ba chɔɡ ba ɡrepo, ne pur daa kooni bwa.
O kpoo ba nae dombwea ne, dɛ ɡel bwaala kɔr kpoo ba peera.
O kpɔ o bandia kohona ba ta ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba waa do sum kohona, a do kɛŋɔ baa tomɛ toroma ŋɔ, bá ba kpoo ba ken.
O ta ɡelɛ o bandia nyoa sɔɔh, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ba bwara kɛ ba, o kpoo ba weechɔɡa ne.
O kpoo Ijipt harɛ bibanloɡla, dem bɛlbwa ta.
Asɛ dɛ tɔ o nɛra sie kɛŋɔ peteɡre ken, dɛ kpɔ ba valɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
O tɔ ba sie dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ ba ta ɔmɛ, kɛ ba dɔma la te, mpo bɔle ba nɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba kaa.
O kpɔ ba ba o harɛ waa do ɡoroŋ ta, deŋɡarere harɛ nɛra aa soɡe a ta, o yo dɛ lɛa la.
O tɔ sie doŋi nɛra baa soɡe harɛ la ta, dɛ bɔne harɛ la denaa ta tɛ Israel tena, dɛ kpɔ ba ka so ba deene la ta.
Kɛ ba ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ daahno na, ba vɛh o Mmarare ta teŋa.
Ba deŋne kpeɡri, baa waa bu kɛ ba naawa ken, ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe.
Ba kpɔ bela baa dɛ tomɛ ba voɡa dɛɛ muɡli o baah, dɛ kpɔ ba voɡa dɛɛ ir o bwaawee.
Korowii aa no ba waa la, o baah diu kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, o vɛh Israel tena kwaraa.
O ɡel o Tɛnte Dea waa lɔ Silo, waa ɡela ba baŋro o ɛ o dobɔr harɛ nɔ ta la.
O ɡelɔ ya dɔma ba kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la.
Onee cheɡa tɛ o kpeɡri ne o jirima.
O baah di o ɡbaɡba nɛra nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba dɔma kpoo ba.
O ɡelɔ ba kpoo ba bonɔɔna laa ta, ba toli ta baala dɔe dɛ yalɛ.
Ba kpoo ba sɔfore laa ta, ba ta ɡelɛ ba luhaahna wi.
Belaa Korowii ir, a do kɛ nɛn waa ir dom ta ken, kɛŋɔ nɛn o bwara aa kpeɡa, dɛ nyɔ sen a dɛɛro, o bwara yon ir la.
O ɡelɔ o dɔma peɡre, ba di sihiih saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O vɛh Josef naanar, o ta Efrem dea nɛra leɛ.
Kɛ Juda dea nɛraa o le, ne Saayɔn Bwejen waa dɛ nyin bela kohona la.
Belaa o ma o Dea, o do jaŋne kɛ bwejena ken.
O mao o che kɛ harɛ waa tao nɔ, dɛ che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O le o bonɔɔ Devid ɡɛ saŋ waa dɛ nyiŋi peera nɛɛ kpɔɡ bini, dɛ ba o ne ŋɔ, ó ba tɔ o nɛra Israel tena baa ɛ o kapɛrɛ nɛra la sie, kɛŋɔ peteɡre.
Devid nyiŋi ba nɛɛ bambile bwa ne, dɛ tɔ ba sie wejema ne.
Israel harɛ nɛra lɛɛ wesoŋa Asaf yel N Naa Korowii, nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola hen tomɛ, baa lɛ he harɛ la dɔɔh.
Ba kpɔ doŋa kah he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la, dɛ ɡel Jerusalam berɛ dimɡbia.
Ba kpɔ he nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ serewa la tɛ kɔkɔsakire aa di.
Ba berɛ kpɔɡ bini ola kondikwa.
Ba kpoo nɛra ba chal fuɡe dɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ nee ken, dɛɛ palɛ Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna bwa, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ huɡ ba.
Harɛre aa bar yaa cheme nɛra dɛ chɛɡre yaa, ba kpɔ yaa berɛ akwekwe nɛra.
N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo he baah di ya nɛɛ ka tel ɔ?
He bandia ɛɛ teŋɔ ɡwaa ya nɛɛ ɡɛ dɛɛ la naa?
Gel he baah di harɛre nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ la nɛ, nɛra baa wola hen jemɛ dɛ́ soŋe la, dɛkalkɛ ba kpoo he nɛra Israel tena, dɛ chɔɡ he harɛ.
Bɛ ya naawa wechɔɡa baa ɛa kpɔ tɛr ya deŋne.
Na ya sum warane, ya hwɛɡa bwa tonɔ.
N Naa Korowii, ba cha yaa dɛ́ lɛ yaa.
Ba lɛ yaa dɛ́ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa kɛ yaa, he sɔn la wa.
Ɛrɛɛ harɛre nɛra ɛɛ bɔɔ yaa ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ dɔɔ nɔɔ?” Tɛr nɛra baa kpoo he bonɔɔna deŋne, ya siwi ta bonɔ.
No nɛra baa laɡ ba do dea la hima baa dɛ hime.
Che he kpeɡri ta, dɛ́ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ba ba kpoora.
N Naa Korowii, bɔ harɛre baa kaa la kem bele anuanɛ, chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡre la wa.
Ásɛ he nɛra yaa do kɛŋɔ peera he sie nɔ, ɛɛ kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛ́ le fini kaa ya naanar baa ka ba bwa nɛ.
Israel harɛ nɛra Korowii aa bera lɛɛ ba wesoŋa Asaf yel Israel Peteɡre, no ya wii.
Henee tɔ Josef naanar sie kɛŋɔ peteɡre, dɛ so he kookara ta, Kerobim la baah ta.
Kpɔ he te chaɡle Efrem ne Bɛnjamen dɛ Manasɛ deene tena, che he kpeɡri ta, dɛ́ ba lɛ yaa.
N Naa Korowii, berɛ lɛ yaa, sune ya nɛ, ásɛ dɛ lɛ yaa.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, saŋ besoo he bandia nyoa ɛɛ ba sɔɔhna, he nɛra wesoŋa ta nɔ?
He ɡelɔ suna do kɛŋɔ kondikwaa yaa di, siniire ɡe do kɛ nee yaa nyɔ.
He ɡelɔ harɛre nɛra baa bar yaa cheme yo dɔŋa ya harɛ wa, asɛ ya dɔma chɛɡre yaa.
Korowii Haa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, berɛ ba lɛ yaa, sune ya nɛ, ásɛ dɛ lɛ yaa.
He lawɛ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, kɛŋɔ haa teŋe ɡrepo da, dɛ ba doŋi harɛ la nɛra le o ta, dɛ kpɔ yaa chɔɔ bela.
He parɛ daa waa cheɡa tɛ he nɛra Israel tena la mun.
O lune kaa bini, dɛ kpeɡ tɔ harɛ la bwa ta, kɛŋɔ he nɛra aa kaa so Keenan harɛ ba mun ya la ken.
Daa la kpeɡo o kpala tɔ bwejena ta, hale pelema bwa ta.
Daa la ta kpala ka le Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta, dɛ teŋe ba kaa Yufretis Moo ta.
Ɛrɛɛ he ɡel nɛŋhɔɔhra dɔ bɔr kuuɡi kon baa kpɔa ke daa la nɔɔ?
Nomɛlbwa teŋo baa kaa laa, wɛɛ won ba tɔɔ o nɔna di.
Nɛŋhɔɔhra do kɛŋɔ chweri dɛɛ tiɡri harɛ la ta, kpɔɡ bini ola ɡee chɔɡo.
Korowii Haa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ, berɛ sie ya be.
Che nyundua nyiŋi, dɛ́ ba lɛ yan yaa ɛ he nɛra, haa kpɔ yaa ba so bonɔ, dɛ ɡel ya mun ya kohona nɔ.
Ya dɔma chɔɡ yaa kɛŋɔ baa teŋe da, dɛ kpɔ do nii ta o fuh la ken.
Gel he baah di ba nɛ, he chɔɡ ba.
Kpɔ nɔn tɔ nɛra haa lee ba tɛ he te la nɛ, lɛ nɛra haa lee ba dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri kohona la.
Yaa habɔɔ berɛ kpoe kpa, tɛ yaa bokpeɡfala, ásɛ ya won kpɛɛre.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, berɛ ba lɛ yaa, sune ya nɛ, ásɛ dɛ lɛ yaa.
Tɔpejen bɛl dii yel Asaf yel Hé ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ Korowii waa dɛ tɛ yaa bokpeɡa.
Hé ɡo yela kohona kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ.
Hé pa mun ɡo yela, dɛ́ yiiɡi loŋa, hé kpɔ janjela lɔ yelsoma.
Hé hoh pebal nyeɡle bɛla Korobifale Tɔpejen ta, korobie baa kpeɡ ɡe aa, hé berɛ hoh.
Mmara waa chɔ le dɛ tɛ Israel tena laanee, Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ laanee kpɔa tɛ yaa.
A ɡɛ Mmara nɔɔ Korowii kpɔ tɛ Israel tena, ɡɛ saŋ waa kaa yo Ijipt tena la.
N no taa bɛl o ŋɔ, “N lɛ he bone haa cheɡa dɛɛ koh, dɛ choɡ he bontɔɡa cheɡ harɛ.
Gɛ saŋ haa lɔ wenaale ta la, he yerɛ men Korowii, asɛ n ba lɛ heya.
N cheɡɛ peukpeɡ bini dɛ chaŋe heya, dɛ daah heyaa na Mɛreba, bela ne aa bula la.
Israel tena, hé cheɡ deŋne no n wejaala nɔ.
N nɛra, n dɛ nyin kɛ he fe aa no n be!
He bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ ka ja n nɛ, he bɛ an dɛɛ ɡuŋi.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tomɛ, n le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Hé waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ mɛ naa, mɛɛ tɛ heya kondikwaa kɛŋɔ, jumbie aa dɛ tɛ o bii la.
Kɛ ane abwa, Israel tena aa n be no, baa n waa ta teŋɛ.
Anomanta, n ɡel ba deŋnekpeɡ waa tɛɛ ba, ba kaa ɛ anɔ la aa too ba tea.
N dɛ nyin kɛ n nɛra fe aa no n deŋna wa, ásɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ta.
N fe ɛɛ yo ba dɔmaa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ warane.
Nɛra baa hah men Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ ɔmee ba ɡuŋi n sie.
Ba deŋnetɛra ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Kɛ ane a bwa, mɛɛ tɛ heyaa mendɛɛɡa, ne tohdɛɛɡa he di dɛ vaɡɛ.”
Korowiirii koojen Asaf yel Korowii soɡe o kookara ta nyundua, koŋkwaare aa dɛ tomɔ bwa cheme o sie, asɛ o bol a waa dɛɛ pa bole dɛ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo he ɡel nɛra sie nyiŋa dɛ́ɛ pa bole ɔ?
Hé ɡel nyubinikpeɡ tena nɛɛ suna bole pae ta.
Hé bol nyaara ne bilalbii waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛ bɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra ne nɛra, baa wola nɛra dɔe bá cha ba pere dɛɛ ta.
Hé lɛɛ ba le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.
Haa wobɛlbwa jemɛ, hé ɡɛnɔ!
Neɡraa hɛɛ neɡre nɛra, kasinteŋ tonɛ harɛ nɔ ta.
Men Korowii maa lɔ nyundua ŋɔ, ‘He bɛlbwa do kɛ Korowii, kɛɛ men Nemenɛ Korowii bii.’ Kɛ he bwa ɛɛ serewoo kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini waa won sewa la ken, he ne koranar bwa.” N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ bol harɛ nɔ nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Henee dɔ harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa.
Israel dɔma nɛɛ pɔe wesoŋa Asaf yel N Naa Korowii, bɛ nyoa tɔ!
Ir nyu ne.
Na ɡɛ he dɔma aa ir he nɛ, nɛra baa haeh ba deŋne do kpeɡri la.
Ba sɔɔh dɛɛ vɔrɔwe he nɛra vɔrɔwa, ba dɛ vɔrɔwe nɛra haa kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛɛ la vɔrɔwa.
Ba ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya chɔɡ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta, ásɛ Israel harɛ sɔn den nyoɡre kwaraa.” Ba nyoa pɛo baa vɔrɔwe he vɔrɔwa.
Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dɛɛ ba ba yoi laanee nɔ, Edom ne Ismael tena, ne Moab dɛ Haɡri tena, ne Gebal ne Amɔn ne Amalɛk, ne Filisti dɛ Taaya tena.
Hale Asiiria tena kpɔ ba bokpeɡa ba ja ba nɛ, dɛ́ ba cha Amɔn ne Moab tena baa ɛ Lɔt naanar la.
Ɛɛ ba ɡɛ haa ɛ Midian tena la, chɔɡ ba ɡɛ haa chɔɡ Sisera ne Jabin, baa ɛ laa nomonome Kesɔn nenabɔɔ ta la.
He kpoo ba bil Ɛndɔr, ba chɔ bela dɛ pɔh.
Ɛ ba nomonjena ɡɛ haa ɛ Kooro Oreb ne Kooro Siib la, dɛ́ yo ba koranar bwa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ haa yo Kooro Seba ne Kooro Salmuna la.
Ba ŋɔ, “Yaa kpɔ Korowii harɛ laanee berɛ ya kon.” N Naa Korowii, lɔ ba peɡre kɛŋɔ tutuɡ, kɛŋɔ peu aa taa dɛ kpɔ haahra kaa ken.
Gɛ nii yon fuh kɔr dɛ́ kpɛle bwejena dor bwa la, kpɔ bwaala peu doŋ ba, dɛ́ ɡel peukpeɡ kpɔ ɔmee kohona ba ta ba nɛ.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel sihiih kpo ba, dɛ́ ɡel ba na he kpeɡri.
Gel ba bwara yɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ ɔmee ta ba nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, ɡel ba sewɛ sihihseo.
Gel ba jemɛ kɛ he ɡbosoo Nemenɛ Korowii, he habɔɔ, kooro bɛlbwa toole harɛ nɔ ta.
Nɛn o bambile aa lawɛ Korowii Dea ka soɡa wa Kora dea bii yel Nemenɛ Korowii, n bambile lawɛ he Dea kɛrɛdɛ.
Bela waa dɛ ɛɛ mɛ taeh!
N dɛ nyin kɛ n fe aa lɔ he Dea.
Mɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yela n bambile bwa nee tɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la.
Joŋa kwara sɔh kɔne, bilore ɡe dɔ a kɔne, a bii yon do a bini, he saraha kon la jwɛh, bela baa fuh kwaa dɛɛ tɛɛ la.
Nemenɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, henee n kooro.
Nɛra baa lɔ he Dea la, ba na som.
Ba ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwa.
Nɛra baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ he nɛɛ la, ba na som.
Banɔ la ba bambile aa lawa kɛ ba valɛ kaa Saayɔn Bwejen doa la.
Ba valɔ kpɔ Baka Fɛlembɔjen bini Korowii ɡel wɛɛ bule o su, kɛŋɔ yoo saŋ bwaala aa nɛa dɛ ɡel o su.
Ba dɔ bokpeɡa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, ka tel kɛ baa na Korowii o kpeɡri aa ɡwaa voɡa bwa, Saayɔn Bwejen doa la.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, no n wesoŋa, Korowii Jekɔb aa dɛ tomɛ, no n be!
N Naa Korowii, swee ya kooro waa dɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe andɛɛɡa, kooro haa leo cheɡ tɛ he te la.
Nɛn soɡe he Dea tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo aa, a bɔ kɛ waa kaa di tɔpera kaɡboŋ bobɛl.
N fe ɛɛ che Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ Dea doonyoa dɛɛ daah bela, dɛ́ ɡwaa kɛ maa kaa so nyubinikpeɡ tena deremi.
Korowiirii dɛɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe, dɛ ɛ ya kooro waa dɔ jirima.
O swee yaa andɛɛɡa, dɛ sune ya nɛ, dɛ tɛ yaa jirima.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la, waa ban kondɛɛɡe bɛlbwa vɔmɛ.
Nemenɛ Korowii, nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te dawɛ he nɛɛ la, o na som.
Deŋnesɔɔhna wesoŋa Kora dea bii yel N Naa Korowii, he sune he harɛ nɛra nɛ, he berɔ ɡel Israel tena wobɛlbwa maɡre tɛɛ ba.
He kpɔ he nɛra wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ kɛ ba, he tɔ ba wechɔɡa ta.
He ta ɡelɛ he baah di ba nɛ, he laa he bandia kohona kpɔ ba nɛ.
Ya naa Korowii haa ɛ ya Lɛɛ, berɛ ɡel ya wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ yaa, bɛ ɡel he baah di ya nɛɛ kpa.
He baah ɛɛ di ya nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la ɡɛ naa?
He bandia nyoa aa sɔɔh bwa naa?
Berɛ tɛ yaa bokpeɡfala ja, ásɛ yan yaa ɛ he nɛra nɔ kpɛɛre.
N Naa Korowii, chaɡle he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ya nɛ, ásɛ dɛ lɛ yaa.
N dɛ no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol la, o baɡɛ yaa nyoa ŋɔ, dɛ ya ta berɛ kaa ya ɡɛne we-ɛɛla ta naa, wɛɛ tɛ yaa deŋnesɔɔhnaa.
Kasinteŋ, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tomɔ la, wɛɛ lɛo, ásɛ o jirima do ya harɛ nɔ ta.
Korowii nyina ne o kasinteŋ do kɛŋɔ nɛra banɛ aa chema ken, asɛ waa aa toɡra ne deŋnesɔɔhna ɡe ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ harɛ ta ɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii, ásɛ Korowii che toɡra waa toɡra ta le nyundua dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ya wobɛlbwa do wer, ásɛ kondikwa kohona ba ya harɛ nɔ ta.
Toɡra Korowii aa toɡra la ɛɛ tɔ o siee kɛŋɔ nɛn, dɛɛ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ ó kpɔ o ta.
Chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ, n ɛ nyaa dɛ ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre.
N kpɔ n te tɛɛ nomanta, kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ.
Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, anomanta, lɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ he nɛɛ nɔ.
N Naa Korowii, na n sum dɛkalkɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa n wi dɛɛ noe.
Tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ silɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ he siee n kpɔ n wesoŋa dɛɛ bil.
N Naa Korowii, he waa wer tɛ yaa, kpɔ ya wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ yaa, he kpɔ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, dɛɛ nyin nɛra baa wia dɛɛ yerɛ bwa.
N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, no n suna wii, dɛ́ cha mɛ.
N wio dɛɛ noe n wenaale tɔpere, dɛkalkɛ henee dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, voɡa nɛra aa dɛ tomɛ ta kpeɡri dɔe kɛ hen, nomɛlbwa ta he we-ɛɛla dɔŋa ɛɛ bwa.
Harɛre nɛra haa ta ba bwa ɛɛ ba he siee, dɛ́ ba ɡuŋi, dɛ́ kpɔ jirima tɛ he sɔn haa dɔa.
He kpeɡri dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowa, he ɡboo ɛ Korowii.
N Naa Korowii, chaɡ mɛ he ŋwɛnɛ, ásɛ n tomɛ kasinteŋ ne.
Gel n kpɔ bambibeŋkpoŋ tomɛ, dɛɛ ɔmɛ he sɔn.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, mɛɛ kpɛɛre n bambile bwa nee, dɛ́ kpɔ jirima tɛ he sɔn saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la kan tɛ mɛ!
He lɛɛ mɛ le seo nyoa.
N Naa Korowii, nyubinikpeɡ tena ne mbarafo tena dɛ yoo mɛ.
Ba pɛ nyoa dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo, baa hen komɛl yerɛ.
Kɛ hen Korowii te, he dɔ tedoma tɛ nɛra, dɛɛ nyin ba.
He baah aa di warawara, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ, hɛɛ nyin nɛn.
Berɛ sie n be, dɛ́ na n sum.
Tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ bokpeɡa.
Lɛɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ n tomɛ n bambile bwa ne.
Gel n na waane, á baɡle kɛŋɔ he waa wer tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n dɔma na sihiih kpo ba, dɛkalkɛ henee cha mɛ dɛ larawe n bwara.
Bwɛjen Jerusalam kpɛɛra Kora dea bii yel Korowii ma o bwɛjen Jerusalam o do bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ doa.
O dɛ nyin bwɛjen la, dɛ ɡwaa Israel harɛ bobɛlbwa.
Bwɛjen Jerusalam, no ɡɛ waa bol he jirima haa dɔa wa.
O ŋɔ, “Dɛ mɛɛ chwerɛ bwɛɛre ba nɛra aa dɛ no n deŋna waa yaa, Ijipt ne Babelɔn harɛre nɛra waa mɛɛ ba chwera.
Mɛɛ kure Filisti ne Taaya tena, dɛ Itiopia tena bwaa, ásɛ ba ŋɔ Jerusalamee ba lolɛ yaa.” Baa bol bwɛjen Jerusalam waa ŋɔ, o binii harɛre nɛra bwa le dɛ ba, Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ó do kpeɡri.
Korowii ɛɛ chwerɛ nɛra la sɔnaa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ja Jerusalam tena nɛ.
Baa ɡo yelaa dɛɛ sa ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Jerusalam taa ya wedɛɛɡa bwa ɛɛ le.”
Chae wesoŋa Kora dea bii yel N Naa Korowii, henee ɛ n Lɛɛ, chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa n kpɔ n wii dɛɛ bil he sie.
No n wesoŋa, cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no n wii maa dɛ wi, dɛ́ cha mɛ.
N dɛ na wahala kohona, a ɡelɔ a ka tama n sewɛ.
N do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ ba sewa, n bokpeɡa bwa tonɔ.
He kur mɛ ja nɛra baa serewa nɛ, n do kɛ nɛra baa serewa chɔ lalbɔɔne bini.
Nɛra hen Korowii aa soh ba waa kwaraa, haa wola won cha ba la ken.
He taɡ mɛ ta lalbɔɔ waa luŋa ne biro kohona bini.
He bandia ɡwaa n nɛɛ kohona, dɛ ba tɔ n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma ken.
He ɡelɔ n chamene tena chwa mɛ, baa n siwi ɡba nyin dɛ́ na.
N do kɛ maa le bel ta, maa wola won chwa.
Suna dii ɡelɔ mɛɛ ba nyoŋa.
N Naa Korowii, tɔpere bɛlbwaa n wi dɛɛ yerɛ, n ɡɔɔ nɔɔra dɛɛ soŋe.
He dɛ ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla nɛra baa serewa bini naa?
Baa won ir che dɛ́ kpɛɛre.
Ba dɛ bol he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la waa lalbɔɔ bini, kɛɛ he kasinteŋ waa la lalabwɛ aa?
Ba dɛ na he nyokpowaa biro ta bela, kɛɛ he wedɛɛɡa lalabwɛɛ bela baa dɛ soh wobɛlbwa nɔ naa?
N Naa Korowii, n wio dɛɛ noe kɛ he cha mɛ, chɔɔ bɛlbwaa n kpɔ n wesoŋa dɛɛ bil he sie.
N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ he berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛ laa sie kpɔ n nɛɛ nɔɔ?
Le n bechale saŋ bwaa n bwara wee mɛ, a ka tama n sewɛ.
N ɡwɛɡrɔ dɛ le deŋnetɛra haa kpɔa ba ta n nɛɛ mɛɛ di suna la wa.
He bandia kohona la ɡwaa n nɛ, he yoi haa dɛ yoo mɛ chɔɡ mɛ.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa ba bar mɛ dɛɛ cheme kɛŋɔ nee aa sua ken, ba le baŋ bɛlbwa ta dɛ baa tɔ n nɛ.
He ɡelɔ n daamanar tenten ne nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ ɡba chwa mɛ, biro ɡboo berɛ n dam name.
Kooro Devid ne Korowii fɔo baa fɔwa Esera te Etan yel N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ɡo he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la yelee dɛɛ bol he waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la saŋ bɛlbwa.
Mɛɛ boloo ŋɔ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa, cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
He waa dɔ kasinteŋ saŋ bɛlbwa, ɡɛ nyundua aa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la.
He ŋɔ, “N ne nɛn maa leo tɛ n te la fɔwɛ fɔo.
N baɡɛ n bonɔɔ Kooro Devid nyoa ŋɔ, ‘He naanaree mɛɛ ba ɡela bá di kora saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ ɡel he kora che kiŋkiŋ, ka tel he naanar baa ka ba bwa nɛ.’ ” Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua dɛ kpɛɛ he nyokpowe-ɛɛla, nyundua toroma ɡe ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ he kasinteŋ haa dɔa.
N Naa Korowii, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ do nyundua kɛ hen, koŋkwaa aa lɔ nyundua la bini bɛlbwa ta hen tele.
Nyundua toroma bwa chemaa, hen Korowiirii do ɔma kohona, a bwa dɛ ɔmɛ, dɛ kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛɛ.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, umee dɔ kpeɡri kɛ hen ɔ?
N Naa Korowii, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ wobɛlbwa ta.
Mpo nehɛma dɛ ta kohona naa, henee dɛɛ di kpeɡri o ta, he wono ɡel wɛɛ hel.
He kpo oljen waa lɔ mpo ta, he kpeɡri nee he pɔ he dɔma nɛ.
Nyundua ne harɛ bwa ɛ he kwa, henee ta harɛ ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta.
Henee ta weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Tabɔ ne Hɛmɔn Bwejena ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛre kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ ɡo yela ken.
He kpeɡri kan, he dɔ bokpeɡa ɡe kohona!
Waa aa toɡra ne waa bola dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, nee hɛɛ di kora.
Nɛnnyin ne kasinteŋ ɡboo he kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ he wa.
Nɛra baa ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛre, ne banɔ la baa dɛ valɛ bɔr waa chaah he sie la, ba na som.
Ba dɛ hɛɡre he waa saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛɛ kpɛɛre toɡra haa toɡra wa.
Henee tɛɛ ba he kpeɡri ne jirima kohona, he cheɡɛ he nyina ta dɛ ɡel ya pɔ ya dɔma nɛ.
N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe, henee Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ, dɛ le ya kooro tɛ yaa la.
Korowii nyoa waa baɡɛ Kooro Devid N Naa Korowii, saŋ la he pili he waa bini baɡle he nɛndɛɛɡa ŋɔ, “N tɛ banyoo bɛl kpeɡri, n kpɔ kora tɛ nɛn maa leo cheɡ le nɛra bini.
N fuɡe noo aa do ɡoroŋ do n bonɔɔ Devid nyu ta, dɛ cheɡo kora ta.
Mɛɛ ja o nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa, dɛ́ chao dɛɛ tɛo bokpeɡa.
O dɔma aa won yoo, dɛ́ lawɔ do ba lɔɡa, nyubinikpeɡ te bɛlbwa aa won pɔ o nɛ.
Mɛɛ lɔ o dɔmaa bil, dɛ́ kpo nomɛlbwa waa haoh.
N nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la nee mɛɛ ba o nyina, ásɛ o che n sɔn ta pɔ o bala nɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o harɛ do kan, le Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta ba kaa Yufretis Moo ta.
Devid ɛɛ yer mɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Henee n Mɛɛ ne Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he do kɛ Bwetal maa chwaa baa marɛ hɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ.’ Mɛɛ leo cheɡ tɛ n te kɛ n bibanloɡle, ó ɡwaa koranar bwa baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n nyina do o nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ n ne o fɔo yaa fɔwɛ la bɛ chɔɡ bwa.
O naanar ɛɛ dɛɛ di koraa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O kora dii ɛɛ cheo kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa, ɡɛ nyundua aa lole saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ.
Kɛ dɛ o naanar vɛh me Mmarare ta teŋa, dɛ vɛh ɡɛ maa do ba a ta, dɛ laa sie kpɔ waa maa chaɡ ba ta, baa men Mmarare ta teŋɛ aa, mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa waa, ba bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ ba a waa.
Kɛ maa Devid nyinaa ɡel bwa, kɛɛ dɛ́ vɛh n ne o baah fɔo la.
Maa n ne o fɔo yaa fɔwa laanee chɔɡ, kɛɛ dɛ́ charɛ nyoa maa baɡɔ la beŋkpoŋ kwara.
N berɔ ŋwɛɛ n sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ, maa wola nyoa berɛ, maa Devidii neɡre bwa, wɛɛ dɔ naanaree saŋ bɛlbwa, mɛɛ nyiŋi o harɛ taa ó che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ wee aa dɛ chaah saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ.
O kora ɛɛ cheo kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la ɡɛ korobie aa lɔ nyundua saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ, dɛ́ ɛ danseɛ.” Kooro dɔma aa yoo dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ wiile He baah di kooro haa leo cheɡ tɛ he te la nɛ, he berɛ habɔɔ kpoo dɛ vɛoh.
He chɔɡ he ne he bonɔɔ fɔo haa fɔwa la, dɛ kpɔ o kooɡbɛrɛ ta harɛ.
He kuuɡi o bwɛjen danjwɛɛre bwa, o danjwɛkpeɡa bwa chɔ harɛ.
Nɛra baa vala baa kaa bwa dɛ ŋwɛ o laala, o bala bwa dɛ mamɔ.
He ɡelɔ o dɔma pɔ o nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba bwa sie lɛ.
He ɡelɔ o dɔmkwaa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, dɛ ɡel ba pɔ o nɛɛ laa ta.
He laa o koodaŋɡbala lɛ, dɛ lɛ o kora o be.
He teŋe o bonɔɔne saŋ tɔpere ta, dɛ ɡel o di ncho.
Korowii lɛɛ wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba he te sɔeh ka tel ɔ?
Saŋ besoo he baah ɛɛ ba dii kohona dɛɛ la ɡɛ nɔ?
Jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn mkpa aa jaŋɛ bɛlbwa.
Lii kɛŋɔ he ta yaa ya ɛ nɛwɛnyina yaa dɛ ba wona sewɛ.
Umee dɛ́ so le waa wola sewɛ bwa nɔ?
Nɛwɛnyinii ume, dɛ́ ŋɔ, waa lalbɔɔ binii kaa lɔ?
N Naa Korowii, he nyina o fa aa kana la sɛ?
Nyoa he fa aa baɡɛ Devid la ɡe sɛ?
N Naa Korowii, lii men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ wa, n bwara dɛ nyɛɡ bammuɡla ne chɛɡa nɛra aa dɛ chɛɡ mɛ.
He dɔma dɛ chɛɡre kooro haa leo cheɡ la.
Bela waa kpɔ bwa, ba dɛ chɛɡro.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la!
Aamen!
Yela tɔn naarɛte Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, he demii ya chwa baa marɛ, he kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ya nɛ, le saŋ la ba le fini.
Mɔɔ he ta bwejena kɛɛ harɛ nɔ la, dɛ he ɛ Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
He won ɡela ya sewɛ, dɛ́ berɛ kaa teera haa kpɔa ma yaa la ta.
Bene kaɡboŋ do kɛ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ he be, a do kɛŋɔ dɛ tɔpere aa baa kaa ken, kɛɛ jwaana saŋ bɛl aa teŋa ba kaa ken.
He won ɡela nɛwɛnyina teŋe sewɛ kɛŋɔ dom yon piɡri lawɛ nɛn la ken.
Ba do kɛ kpɔɡlwɛɛ haa naa chɔɔ, a dɛ kpeɡ dɛ́ fe, jɔmɔra ne tela dɛ a holɔ dɛ́ sewɛ.
He bandia chɔɡ yaa, yaa ɔmɛ he bandia kohona haa kpɔa ba ta ya nɛɛ la wa.
Ya wechɔɡa chɔ he sie, hɛɛ na anɔ la yaa ɛa dɛɛ sɔh bwa.
He bandia ɡelɔ ya tɔpera do bori, a dɛ kaa warawara kɛŋɔ hweera ken.
Bene yaa di lɔ fifraanuanɛ ɡbo, kɛɛ dɛ bokpeɡa ta lole naa, bene fifraanuatoro.
Kɛ a bwa ɡe ta la, hɔhɔrɔwa ne suna dii ɡboo, aa biɡri dɛ a baa kaa, ya serewe.
Umee nyɔ he bandia danana nee kaɔ?
Umee jemɛ ɔmee aa lɔ he bandia kohona ta nɔ?
Gel yá jemɛ ya tɔpera nyoa, ásɛ ya won jemɛ wa.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel he baah sɔɔh!
Saŋ besoo he bandia nyoa ɛɛ ba sɔɔhna ɔ?
Dɔ tedoma tɛ he bonɔɔna.
Gel he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la do ya nɛɛ chɔɔ bɛlbwa, ásɛ ya ɡo silɛɛ yela dɛɛ hɛɡre ya soɡa bini bwa.
Gel yá dɔ silɛɛ kohona taraken, ɡɛ tenten he fa aa ɡela ya di suna, saŋ bɛl waa baa kaa la.
Gel yan yaa ɛ he bonɔɔna nɔ na he nyokpowaa haa dɛ ɛ, ɡel ya naanar na he jirima aa kana la.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, swee yaa andɛɛɡa.
Gel ya wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ yaa kɛrɛdɛ!
Korowii waa kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ya nɛ Nomɛlbwa waa chwa ka so Nemenɛ Korowii lɔɡa o kpɔ nɔn tɔ o nɛ, nomɛlbwa waa ka do On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ lɔɡa la, ɛɛ won ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, henee cheɡɛ n habɔɔ, dɛ ɛ n danjwɛkpeɡ n chwa baa marɛ.
Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ he nɛ.” Wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛɛ le wekpeɡa aa sɔah bwa ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ le weechɔɡa bwa nyoa.
Wɛɛ tɔ he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ jal yon lawɛ o bii do o kena lɔɡre la ken.
Wɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ he dɔ bosɔɔhna, dɛ́ che o kasinteŋ ta nyiŋi, dɛ́ tɔe ɡbemɡbe.
Haa komɛlbwaa ɔmɛ jwaana, kɛɛ dɔma hɛma baa piɡri taa webaŋa, kɛɛ weechɔɡa aa dɛ ba jwaana, kɛɛ weela aa dɛ kpo webaŋa.
Nɛra kaɡboŋ ɛɛ serewoo chɔ he jwɛh, kaɡboŋa fi chɔ dɛ́ bare, kɛ wobɛlbwa aa hen ɛ. Siwii hɛɛ ba kpɔe dɛ́ na wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋnetɛra.
He kpɔ Korowii kɛŋɔ onee hɛɛ ba chwae kaa marɛ.
He ŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowiirii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ he nɛ, anomanta, wenaale bɛlbwa aa hen pu bwa, wekpeɡa bɛlbwa ɡe aa he dem kwaraa bɛne!
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo o nyundua toroma ɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛ bobɛlbwa haa kaa.
Baa lawɛɛ haa wola nakpala kwaraa lɔ.
Hɛɛ tiɡri nyujentena ne harɛkwaare nɛɛ, nyujentena aa ɔma ne domkpuli nɛɛ.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ laanee, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ nɛra baa jem mɛ kɛ ba dɔɔree men la nɛ.
Ba wio yer mɛ naa, mɛɛ no ba bee, wenaale puu ba ɡe aa, mɛɛ che ba habɔɔ.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ baa dɛ́ tɛɛ ba jirima.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo bá so dɛ́ biɡri, ásɛ n lɛɛ ba.”
Kpɛɛra yel baa dɛ ɡo Ona Tɔpere ta N Naa Korowii, a wer kɛ ya kpɛɛre, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛ hen Nemenɛ Korowii sɔn, dɛ́ bol he nyina haa dɛ nyin ya wa chɔɔ, ásɛ jwaana ɡe dɛ́ bol ɡɛ he wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ, dɛ́ lɔ janjela ne kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ ɡo yela kpɛɛre.
He nyokpowe-ɛɛla ɡelɔ n sie ɛɛ lɛ, n dɛ ɡo silɛɛ yela a wa.
N Naa Korowii, he waa haa dɛ ɛ kan, he wejema ta jaɡa dɔe.
Nɛn waa wola liire dɔe la aa won jemɛ, nɛn waa ɡɛna ɡe aa won no a mun.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ won dɛɛ kpeɡ kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa, ásɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡe wobɛlbwa do wer dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, kɛ ba bwa ɛɛ ba chɔɡoo kwaraa.
Kɛ hen Korowii kan saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
N Naa Korowii, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ he dɔma bwa ɛɛ serewoo, ásɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena bwa lɔ peɡre.
He ɡelɔ n do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini nabal, dɛ swee mɛ andɛɛɡa, dɛ ɡel n dɔ silɛɛ.
N na n dɔma chola, dɛ no nyubinikpeɡ tena wii baa dɛ wi.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ dɛɡoo kɛŋɔ kpor daa ken, baa kpeɡuu kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn peleme dajena.
Ba do kɛŋɔ daa baa dua Korowii Dea, aa dɛɡ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea bela ken.
A ɛ dabena dɛ ta won nɔna, dɛ dɔ papooni kohona, dɛ che kɛrɛdɛ.
Anee dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, “Korowii waa toɡrɔ.
Onee Bwetal n chwa kaa marɔ, o nyu bini ɡe aa kpeɡe.”
Korowii ɛ Kooro Korowii dɛ di kora, o do laala kɛŋɔ kooro, dɛ dɔ jirima kohona dɛɛ di kpeɡri.
O ta harɛ dɛ ɡel o che kiŋkiŋ, nomɛlbwa aa wola won kpɔ le o buɡ ta.
Saŋ la bwaa he kora le.
Mɔɔ wobɛlbwa pa mun la, dɛ he lole.
N Naa Korowii, mpo vile dɛ si, a taɡɛ nehɛma aa kana dɛɛ ba, dɛɛ si kohona.
Kɛ hen Korowii te, he dɛ di kora nyundua, dɛ do kan ɡwaa mpo sii waa dɛ si.
He kpeɡri ɡwaa mpo nehɛma kwara.
He mmarare cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
He Dea do ɡoroŋ kohona, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii waa bol nɛra bwa waa dɛɛ pa bole N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ tɛr nɛra deŋne, ɡel ba na he bandia.
Henee bol nɛra bwa waa dɛɛ pa bole, ir dɛ́ bɔ mbarafo tena kem ɡɛ aa chɛa.
N Naa Korowii, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba soɡa nyiŋi, dɛ́ ɡel nyubinikpeɡ tena lɛ ba sie ka tel ɔ?
Ba dɛ bol mbarafo wobol, mbarafo ɡboo su wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa.
N Naa Korowii, ba dɛ chɔɡ he nɛra, dɛɛ fiiɡi he ɡbabir nɛra haa lee ba tɛ he te.
Ba dɛ kpoo luhaahna ne bilalbii, dɛɛ kpoo nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe ya harɛ ta.
Ba yon dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, “Korowii aa yaa na, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la sie toole ya be.” N nɛra, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɡɛn ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba waa hwela ɔ?
Korowii laa tɛ yaa deŋna ne sibie aa?
Waa waa no aa?
Waa na naa?
Korowii waa dɛ kah nɛra la aa won tɛr ba deŋne aa?
Nɛn waa dɛ baɡle nɛra waa la, o nya liire kɛɛ?
Korowii jemɛ nɛwɛnyini liire kɛŋɔ a ɛ wepuu.
N Naa Korowii, nɛra haa dɛ baɡ ba wa, ne banɔ la haa dɛ baɡ ba he Mmarare la, ba na som.
Wenaale ane dɛ ba ba nɛ aa, he ɡelɔ baa dɔ bosɔɔhna, ka tel kɛŋɔ baa forɛ bɔɔ, dɛ́ harɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena bel.
Korowii aa o nɛraa vɛh, waa nɛra waa lee ba cheɡ tɛ o te laanee ɡel bwa.
Waa bola dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ berɔ do le, ásɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Umee dɛ́ che n habɔɔ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta nɔ?
Umee dɛ́ che tɛ mɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔ be nɔ?
Dɛ Korowii laa cha mɛ naa, n fe sewɔ warane kaa lalabwɛ.
Asɛ n ŋɔ, “N keero dɛɛ ba chola,” kɛ Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la laɡ mɛ kpoŋe.
N liire baa chɔɡ kohona aa, he dɛ larawe n bwara dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ.
He ne nɛnchɔɡa baa wola waa bol aŋwɛnɛ ta, ne nɛra baa kpɔ nyosone berɛ kasinteŋ la toole wobɛlbwa bini.
Ba pɛ nyoa dɛɛ vɔrɔwe nɛndɛɛɡa vɔrɔwa, dɛ ɡel ba pa nɛra baa di boldɛɛɡe la bolchɔɡe ŋɔ, bá ka kpo ba.
Kɛ Korowii do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ, dɛ che n habɔɔ, onee do kɛ Bwetal n chwa kaa marɔ.
Wɛɛ bɔ ba kem ba wechɔɡa waa, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba ba nyubinikpeɡ wa.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ chɔɡ baa.
Korowii kpɛɛra yel Hé ba ya kpɛɛ Korowii!
Hé ɡel ya ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛro, onee do kɛ Bwetal ya chwa kaa marɔ.
Hé ɡel ya ba o sie ba jaamo, dɛ́ ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛro.
Dɛkalkɛ Korowii dɔ kpeɡri kohona, onee dɛɛ di kora voɡare bwa nɛ.
O dɛ di kora harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛ, hale bwebɔɔne aa luŋa ta ne bwejena dor.
Onee ta mpo ne harɛ, dɛɛ di a kpeɡri.
Hé ba ya ɡuŋu dɛ́ tomɔ, yá ɡuŋi Korowii waa ta yaa la sie!
Onee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, o nɛraa yan wɛɛ nyiŋi ya nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre yon dɛɛ nyiŋi peera nɛɛ la ken.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be fini laanee nɔ, “He bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ kɛŋɔ he naawa fa aa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Mɛreba, dɛ vɛh o waa noe, dɛ jo o nɛɛ la, ɡɛ baa ɛa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta Maasa la.
He naawa na waa maa ɛa tɛɛ ba bela, kɛ ba daah mɛ na.
Bene fifraanaarɛ bwaa n baah di ba nɛ, asɛ n ŋɔ, ‘Ba deŋne kpeɡri!
Ba vɛh waa maa do ba a ta.’ N baah aa dia la, n ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, ‘Baa ona maa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ba onɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ onɛ la dɔe ba bwa.’ ”
Korowii ɛ Koojen tenten Hé ɡo yelfale kpɛɛ Korowii!
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro!
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii sɔn!
Hé bol o lɛɛ waa dɛ lɛ nɛra tɔpere bɛlbwa wa.
Hé bol o jirima waa baɡle harɛre nɛra, dɛ́ bol o nyokpowe-ɛɛla waa baɡle nɛra bwa.
Korowii kan, a chɛ kɛ ya kpɛɛro kohona.
Onee chɛ kɛ ya kpɔ duure tɛ dɛ́ ɡwaa voɡa.
Harɛre bwa voɡare ɛ konsale baa kpɔ nɔɔra ɛa, kɛ Korowiirii ta nyundua.
O kan dɛ dɔ jirima kohona, kpeɡri ne jirima su o Dea.
Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii.
Hé kpɛɛro, o jirima ne kpeɡri waa dɔa wa.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ jirima aa chɛ o sɔn la tɛo.
Hé kpɔ saraha kwaa ba tɛo o Dea.
Hé kpɔ jirima tɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ la.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa, hé ɔmɔ!
Hé ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa no kɛŋɔ, “Korowii dɛ di kora!
O ta harɛ o che kiŋkiŋ waa wola yiiɡi, dɛ bol nɛra bwa waa dɛɛ pa ba bole ɡɛ aa chɛa.” Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ lɛ ba sie.
Mpo ne kwaa aa lɔ o bini bwa ɡe, hé do lɔŋɔre.
Kooni ne kwaa aa lɔ a bini bwa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ lɛ ba sie!
Ásɛ kɔr bini daa ɡe ɛɛ hɛɡre, saŋ Korowii aa ba di kora harɛ nɔ ta la.
Wɛɛ ba bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta ne kasinteŋ ne.
Korowii Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra, hé ɡel he sie lɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ di kora.
Gel nɛra baa soɡe ekwie harɛre ta la ɡe hɛɡre.
Baama ne biro baro cheme, waa aa toɡra ne kasinteŋ nee wɛɛ di kora.
Nii tɔ o sie dɛɛ lawɛ, dɛɛ fuh o dɔma baa baro cheme.
Nii la dɛ lawɛ kohona kɛŋɔ bwaala nyɛɡla ken, asɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra na dɛɛ chel.
Bwejena dɛ mwɛɛ kɛŋɔ tohkel, Korowii waa dɛ di kora harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛɛ la sie.
Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua dɛ baɡle kɛ o waa toɡrɔ, asɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ na o jirima.
Sihiih kpo nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa bwa, nɛra baa kpɔ voɡare dɛɛ maŋkura ba te, ne voɡa bwa dɛ ɡuŋi Korowii sie.
Bwɛjen Saayɔn tena noɔ ba sie lɛ, Juda bwɛjena tena ɡee hɛɡre, hen Korowii waa bola dɛ́ pa bole wa.
Nemenɛ Korowii, henee dɛɛ di kora harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ, henee kana ɡwaa voɡare bwa.
Nɛra baa hah wechɔɡa la, Korowii dɛ nyin ba wa.
O kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛo nɛ, dɛ lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.
Nii dɛ chaah nɛra ba wa aa toɡra sie, nɛra ba wa aa wera ɡe ɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ.
Nɛra he wa aa toɡra bwa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ, waa Korowii aa ɛa wa.
Hé lii waa Korowii waa do ɡoroŋ aa ɛa, dɛ́ kpɔ jam tɛo.
Korowii dɛ di kora harɛ nɔ bwa ta Hé ɡo yelfale tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o ɛ waa aa dɛ kpo nyoa!
O cheɡɛ kpeɡri ne ɡoroŋ waa doa ta, dɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛ.
Korowii bol pɔe waa pɔ o dɔma nɛɛ wa, dɛ ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa jemɛ lɛɛ waa lɛ o nɛra wa.
O teŋɛ nyoa waa baɡɛ Israel tena kasinteŋ ne nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa ne.
Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa na ɡɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa lɛ o nɛra.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa, hé ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro dɛ́ moo silɛɛ ne.
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé kpɔ janjela lɔ yela kpɛɛro.
Hé hoh bɛle ne pebala nyeɡlare kohona, dɛ́ moo silɛɛ ne kpɛɛ Korowii waa ɛ ya kooro la.
Mpo ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa ɡe moo, harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ne koŋkwaa bwa ɡo yela kpɛɛro.
Neerare ne deŋɡarere pɛ lɔ kpaŋa, dɛ́ ɡo yela silɛɛ ne kɛŋɔ nɛra ken kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o dɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta ba di kora.
Wɛɛ ba bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, ne kasinteŋ ne.
Korowii Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro Korowii dɛ di kora, asɛ harɛre nɛra bwara ɛɛ chel.
O soɡe kookara ta nyundua Kerobim baah ta, asɛ harɛ ɛɛ jiɡri.
Korowii kan dɛ do bwɛjen Saayɔn dɛɛ di kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ kpɛɛ o sɔn waa kana dɛ dɔ jirima laanee, onee do ɡoroŋ kohona.
Korowii ɛ kooro, dɛ dɔ kpeɡri kohona, dɛɛ nyin waa aa toɡra, o ɡelɔ kasinteŋ do Israel harɛ ta.
O ba wa aa toɡra dɛ do wer ne.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la, hé ɡuŋi o kookara sie dɛ́ tomɔ, onee do ɡoroŋ kohona!
Dɛ Mosis ne Arɔn fa ɛ o sɔfore, asɛ Samoɛl che o sɔn ta dɛɛ soŋo.
Ba soŋe Korowii, asɛ o no ba be.
O cheɡɛ bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua ta, dɛ bol waa ba be, asɛ ba teŋɛ mmarare ne waa waa do ba a ta.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he no he nɛra wesoŋa.
A lole kɛ he tɛr ba deŋne te, kɛ he ɡelɔ ba jemɛ kɛ he kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ tomɔ o bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ ta.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la do ɡoroŋ.
Korowii kpɛɛra yel Harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa, hé ɡo silɛɛ yela kpɛɛ Korowii.
Hé kpɔ silɛɛ tomɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ silɛɛ yela ba o sie!
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ onee Korowii.
Onee ta yaa, dɛ dɔ yaa, O nɛraa yan, ya do kɛŋɔ peera ken o sie.
Hé kpɔ silɛɛ ɡo yela jaamo, dɛ́ jo o Dea bini kpɛɛro.
Hé jaamo dɛ́ kpɛɛ o sɔn la.
Korowii waa wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa ne o kasinteŋ lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Kooro nyobaɡa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ he nyina ne he kasinteŋ haa dɔa wa, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre.
Mɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi n we-ɛɛla bini kɛrɛdɛɛ.
Saŋ besoo he ba cha mɛ nɔ?
Mɛɛ kpɔ bambidɛɛɡee so n dem, dɛ́ laa n te kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.
N hah nɛra baa berɛ habɔɔ kpo hen Korowii la we-ɛɛla, n ne ba toole wobɛlbwa bini.
N ne nɛnchɔɡa baah ɛɛ do jaŋnee.
Mɛɛ laa n tenee kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa sɔah dɛɛ chɔɡ o dɔŋ la, mɛɛ doŋu le n be.
N ne nomɛlbwa waa dɛ na o nyu aa won pɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n sie do n nɛra Israel tena ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la nɛ, ásɛ n ne ba pɛ so n koodem.
Nɛra ba wa aa wera kɛrɛdɛ laanee mɛɛ ba ɡela baa tom mɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ neɡre o dɔŋ, aa n demii so.
Nyosonteŋna ɡe aa won che n sie.
Mɛɛ dɛɛ kpoo nɛra ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa harɛ nɔ ta tɔpere bɛlbwaa.
Mɛɛ doŋi wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwaa le Korowii bwɛjen nɔ taa.
Bonɔɔ o bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, no n wii maa dɛ wi dɛ́ cha mɛ.
Dɛ waa puu mɛ naa, bɛ sie laa kpɔ n nɛ.
Cheɡ deŋne no n be, dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ warane.
N tɔpera dɛ kaa warane kɛ chuu, n hoɡa bini ɛɛ wee mɛ kɛŋɔ hɔla aa dɛ fuh ken.
N do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa hola dɛ kuuɡi chɔ la ken, n pɛla aa kondikwa bɛlbwa lawɛ.
N hima kohona nomanta, n ɡwaŋɔ ka hoɡa ɡbo.
A ka n ɡbo kɛŋɔ kwiu beŋkpoŋ waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken, n do kɛŋɔ kwiu waa lɔ bwɛɛ waa paɡra ta.
N chɔɔ n sie kpaŋe, n do kɛ jumbibeŋkpoŋ waa joŋi dea doa.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa n dɔma ɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ, n sɔnee ba yerɛ dɛɛ taah nɛra.
Tɔɔ ber mɛ kondikwa, siniire koo nee ta mɛɛ nyɔ, he bandia kohona nomanta, he laɡ mɛ dɛ ɡɔɔ mɛ viɡri.
N tɔpera dɛ ba warane kɛŋɔ wee yon le harɛ, bɔr ɛɛ bir la, n holɔ kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken.
Kɛ hen Korowii te, he di kora saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Naanar baa ka ba bwa ɛɛ lii he waa.
Hɛɛ sune bwɛjen Saayɔn tena nɛɛ, saŋ haa lea cheɡ la telo kɛ he dɔ tedoma tɛɛ ba.
Yan yaa ɛ he toroma sie dɛ lɛ bwɛjen Saayɔn wa, a lole kɛŋɔ o bwa paɡrɔ kwaraa.
Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowiirii, ásɛ koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ɡe kpɛɛ o jirima waa dɔa.
Wɛɛ berɔ ba kwaa ma bwɛjen Saayɔn ja, ásɛ dɛ forɛ le o jirima ne.
Wɛɛ no he nɛra baa vɛɛh ba la bee, dɛ́ no ba wesoŋa.
Hé chwerɛ waa Korowii aa ɛa nɔ bil tɛ naanar baa ka ba kerekere, ɡɛ aa ɛ nɛra baa wola ban lolɛ mɔɔ la kpɛɛro.
Korowii lɔ o sobɔr waa do ɡoroŋ nyundua, dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ, dɛɛ no nɛra baa laɡ ba do dea hima, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le kpoora baa dɛ ba ba kpoora ta, dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔ ba te.
Anomanta, baa kpɛɛ Korowii sɔn bwɛjen Saayɔnee, dɛ́ kpɔ duure tɛo Jerusalam, awola harɛre nɛra ne ba koranar aa cheme, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la.
N taa dɔ bokpeɡa maa wola hwɛɛhrɛ mɔɔ la Korowii ɡelɔ n ɡwɛɡre, dɛ teŋe me mkpa tɔpera ta.
Anomanta, n ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, bɛ ɡel ń teŋe sewɛ.
He lole saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le naanar baa ka ba bwa.
Wobɛlbwa mumpar la, henee ta harɛ, kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ɡe, he nɔn tomaa a bwa.
A bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, aa wola lee do kpa, kɛ he te ɛɛ do lee dɛɛ la.
A bwa ɛɛ ba ɛ kombenaa ba kpɔ ta kɛŋɔ yal yon hɛh la.
Kɛ he te, hɛɛ do ɡɛ haa doa saŋ bɛlbwaa, ásɛ he bene ɡe aa jaɡaa dɔ bwa.
Ya bii ɛɛ so he siee ásɛ he kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ dɛ nyiŋi ba naanar nɛ ba bwara sɔɔh ba.”
Korowii nyina wa Kooro Devid yel N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne!
N kpɔ n bwadabii bwa dɛɛ kpɛɛ o sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la!
N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne, maa o wedɛɛɡa la waa soh.
O kpɔ n wechɔɡa bwa dɛɛ kɛ mɛ, dɛɛ chah n weela ɡe bwa.
O lɛɛ mɛ dɛɛ le seo nyoa, dɛɛ swee mɛ andɛɛɡa o nyina ne tedoma waa dɔa tɛ mɛ ne.
O dɛ tɛ mɛ n konnyina n soɡa bini bwa, a ɡel n berɛ bonɔɔ dɛ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ kee ken.
Korowii bol nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛ ɡel baa dɔ waa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá dɔ.
O kpɔ o waa baɡle Mosis, dɛ ɡel Israel tena na o wejena waa dɛ ɛ. Nɛra waa dɛ domɛ Korowii tea wɛɛ sune ba nɛ, o baah aa di warawara, o nyina ɡe ta jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Waa teŋɛ dɛɛ pwah yaa, o baah diu waa, o dɛ sɔɔh warane.
Waa ya deŋne tɛr ɡɛ aa chɛa, kɛɛ dɛɛ bɔ yaa ya wechɔɡa kem.
Gɛ harɛ ne nyundua baah aa do jaŋa la, ɡɛɛ o nyina do kan nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɔ la nɛ.
Gɛ wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr baah aa jaŋa la, ɡɛɛ ya ne wechɔɡa waa laa kpɔ ya nɛɛ la baah do jaŋne.
Gɛ mɛɛ yon dɔ tedoma o bii nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ Korowii tea ɛɛ domɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɔ nɛ, dɛkalkɛ o jemɛ ɡɛ yaa doa, o dɛ lii kɛŋɔ teera nee o ma yaa.
Kɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa do kɛ kpɔɡa, ba mkpa ɡe do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa fee, kpɔɡa dɛ sewɛ a fee ɡe ɛɛ lee, kɛ dɛ peu tao waa, a bwa dɛ hol o kaa a ne, bɛlbwa aa an na kpa.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la te, o nyina lɔ ba nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, asɛ dɛɛ ɛ ba bii ne ba naanar andɛɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Banee nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ fɔo o ne baa fɔwa ta, dɛ lii dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta kasinteŋ ne la.
Korowii kpɔ o kookara cheɡ nyundua, dɛɛ di kora harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ.
Nyundua toroma haa kana dɛ do kpeɡri, heyaa dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta, hé kpɛɛ Korowii.
Korowii dɔm haa wara dɛ do o be nyundua, hé kpɛɛro.
Korowii kontaala bwa, hé kpɛɛro bela bwa waa dɛ di kora.
N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne.
Korowii waa ta komɛlbwa kpɛɛra yel N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne, Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he kan kohona!
He kpɔ he kan ne he jirima tɔ kɛŋɔ yal ken, asɛ nii bare cheme, dɛ paɡri nyundua kɛŋɔ tɛnte, dɛ ma he sobɔr baama baŋ nyundua.
He kpɔ baama berɛ kon waa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo, dɛ so o bini dɛɛ kaa, a do kɛŋɔ peu aa dɔ kena dɛɛ kaa he ne la ken.
He ɡelɔ he nyundua toroma do kɛŋɔ peu ne ninlao.
He kpɔ harɛ chɔŋɛ kwaa ta a lawɔ kpoŋe, o che kiŋkiŋ waa wola yiiɡi bwa.
He kpɔ mpo bɔle o ta kɛŋɔ yal ken, asɛ nee la bɔle bwejena ta.
He kɔr neerare dɛ ɡel a hweeh, he kɔra la ɡelɔ a nee la palɛ kaa warane.
A palɔ kpɔ bwejena ta dɛ kaa fɛlembɔjena ta, dɛ kaa bela haa kwaara cheɡa la.
He maɡɛ bela aa jaɡɛ tɛa, ásɛ a bɛ won su bɔle harɛ bwa ta kpa.
He ɡelɔ buli bule jo fɛlembɔjena bini, neerare palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ bwejena baah.
A ɡel kpɔɡ bini ola dɔ nee dɛɛ nyɔ, kpɔɡ bini keeɡore nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpoa ɡe dɔ ane nyɔ.
Jumbii sɔh a kɔne, daa aa cheɡɛ neerare la nyoo ta dɛɛ si.
He ɡelɔ bwaala le nyundua, dɛ nɛ bwea dor, asɛ harɛ bwa vaɡɛ ne.
He ɡelɔ kpɔɡa moɡɛ nae dɔ dɛɛ di, dɛ ɡel nɛwɛnyina dɔ koo kwaa ɡɛ aa ɛ bá dɔ kondikwaa dɛɛ di, dɛ́ dɔ sen nyɔ ba sie lɛ, ne noo baa kpɔ fɔɡle ba siebɔra á do wer, dɛ kondikwa aa tɛɛ ba bokpeɡa ɡe.
Peleme daa aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn, Korowii aa dua la, dɔ bwaala nee kohona.
Jumbii sɔh kɔne a ta, hale chaŋɡale bwa so dakpeɡa la ta.
Kpɔɡ bini boohna soɡe bwejena dor, asɛ kukubane ɡe dɔ sɔɔhbɔra bwea baah.
Henee ta korobie wɛɛ baɡle saŋ, dɛ ɡel wee ɡe ɛɛ jo o saŋ ta.
He ɡelɔ bɔr bir dɛ ɛ jwaana, asɛ kpɔɡ bini ola bwa le dɛɛ valɛ.
Nyujentena bii kpaahnɔ dɛɛ kɔɡre, dɛɛ nyin kondikwa hen Korowii aa tɛa.
Wee baa le aa, dɛ a bwa berɔ ka jo a bɔɔne bini chɔ, mɔɔ nɛra le kaa ɛ ba tomare ka tel jɔmɔra.
N Naa Korowii, he cheɡɛ he wejema ta, dɛ ɛ wejena taeh, harɛ nɔ bwa su he kontaala haa taa.
Mpo ɡe kan dɛ do paɡri chɔ, he kontaala anjeɡre ne anjena, aa wola nyoa dɔe bwa su o bini.
Stiimaere kpɔ o sie dɛ la dɛɛ ba, asɛ mpo bini oljen Lɛvayatan, haa tao la ɛɛ hɛlɛ o bini.
Hen Korowii nɛɛ a bwa sie dawɛ kɛŋɔ, he tɛa kondikwaa á di a saŋ ta.
He dɔɔ dɛ tɛa aa, anee á ɡe dɔ di, he nɔn ta kondikwaa a dɔ di dɛɛ vaɡɛ.
He laa sie kpɔ a be naa, dɛ ɔmee chole a nɛ, he lɛ hweera haa kpɔa tɛa la aa, a dɛ serewe, dɛ́ berɛ kaa teera haa kpɔa maa la ta.
Hweeraa he hwee do a bini dɛ taa, dɛ ɡel kwaa haa taa bwa dɔ mkpa harɛ ta.
N dɛ soŋe kɛŋɔ, N Naa Korowii jirima do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la!
N dɛ soŋe kɛŋɔ, o sie lɛ kwaa waa taa la ta.
O nyiŋi harɛ aa, o dɛ jiɡri, o leɡe bwejena chuu ɛɛ le a ta.
Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ Korowii n soɡa bini bwa, n ta soɡe le tenaa, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa dɛ́ kpɛɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ.
N dɛ soŋe kɛ Korowii sie lɛ yel maa dɛ ɡo nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛ onee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ.
N Naa Korowii, n dɛ soŋe kɛ he chɔɡ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra le harɛ nɔ ta, nyubinikpeɡ tena bɛ le do kpa.
N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne!
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii.
Korowii ne o nɛra Hé jam Korowii dɛ́ yerɛ o sɔn, hé ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa jemɛ waa waa ɛa.
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro, dɛ́ bol o nyokpowe-ɛɛla wa.
Hé ɡel he sie lɛ o sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, nɛra haa dɛ tomɔ, hé ɡel he sie lɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii dɛ́ na o kpeɡri, dɛ́ɛ tomɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Hé lii o nyokpowaa waa ɛa, o wejena ne o waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la wa, he Abraham naanar, haa ɛ Jekɔb bibaala waa le heyaa tɛ o te la.
Onee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, o bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.
Wɛɛ lii o fɔo la waa saŋ bɛlbwaa, o nyoa waa baɡɛ naanar kaɡboŋa baa ka ba la bwa.
Wɛɛ teŋɛ fɔo o ne ya naa Abraham aa fɔwa, ne nyoa waa baɡɛ Aesek la taa.
Korowii ne Jekɔb fɔwɛ fɔo, o do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O ŋɔ, “He ne he naanaree mɛɛ ba Keenan harɛ kpɔe tɛ, ó ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon.” Gɛ saŋ dɛ Korowii nɛra aa kanɛ, dɛ ɛ hɔɔhra do Keenan harɛ ta.
Dɛ harɛre taa ba do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
Ba le harɛ bɛl ta naa, dɛ ba kaa bɛl ta.
Kɛ Korowii ta ɡelɛ nomɛlbwa fiɡ ba, ba lɛɛ nomanta, o kah koranar ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa bɛ nɔn kpɔ leɡe n bonɔɔna maa lee ba cheɡ tɛ n te nɔ, he bɛ n keamere nɔ bini bɛlbwa ha.” Korowii ɡelɔ lɔr chole harɛ la ta, kondikwaa bwa chɔɡ.
Kɛ dɛ o tɔ sie ɡel ba yoɡ Josef, Ijipt harɛ ta kɛ yom.
Ba kpɔ bune jɔɡrɔre do o nakpale ne o baŋa, ka tel kɛŋɔ waa waa bola aa ɛa.
Korowii waa laanee baɡla kɛŋɔ o waa la ɛ kasinteŋ.
Belaa Ijipt kooro waa dɛ di kora harɛre nɛra nɛɛ la, ɡel ba ka leo ba tɛo.
O kpɔɔ chɔ harɛ la nyoa, wɛɛ nyiŋi o kwaa bwa ta, dɛɛ di kpeɡri o nomonjena bwa nɛ, dɛɛ baɡle o nomonome baa dɛ jao la wa.
Ate, Jekɔb ne o bii ir dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta ka so kɛŋɔ hɔɔhra ken.
Korowii kpɔ ba ɛ o nɛra, dɛ ɡel ba mun ya ɡwaa ba dɔma.
O berɛ Ijipt harɛ tena liire, dɛ ɡel ba hah o nɛra, dɛ dɔ liichɔɡa tɛɛ ba.
Belaa o tomɛ o bonɔɔna Mosis ne Arɔn waa lee ba tɛ o te la.
Ba kaa ɛ nyokpowaa ne wekpeɡa ba bini Ijipt harɛ ta.
O ɡelɔ biro tenten ba tɔ harɛ la bwa ta, kɛ Ijipt tena ta o waa ta teŋɛ.
O ɡelɔ ba neerare berɛ chal a pɛŋa bwa serewe.
Sapone baa su harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa, hale koodem ne ba chɔɔbɔra bwa.
Korowii bol wa, asɛ chwɛɛhne ne konjeɡre ba su harɛ la ta bwa, dɛ ɡel dombwea ber ba bwaala, asɛ bwaala kɔɡre dɛɛ nyɛɡle.
O chɔɡ ba daa kooni, dɛ kuuɡi harɛ la daa bwa.
O bol waa asɛ tontombɛ ba su harɛ la ta bwa, baa wola won kura.
A di harɛ la ta konlwɛɛ te bɛlbwa, hale koo kondikwaa bwa.
O kpoo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla bwa, dem bɛlbwa bibanloɡle ta kae.
Belaa Korowii tɔ Israel tena sie le Ijipt harɛ ta, ba cheɡɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ba bwara do kpeɡri.
Ijipt tena la sie lɛo kɛŋɔ Israel tena la aa dɛ kaa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba dɛ ɔm ba.
Korowii ɡelɔ bam bɛl waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua tɔ Israel tena sie, dɛɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ, asɛ nii waa tɛra kaa nyundua ɡe tɔ ba sie jwaana, dɛɛ chaah ba ba vala bini.
Ba bɔɔro kondikwaa baa di wa, asɛ o tɛɛ ba chayambwibwi ba chwe, dɛ le kondikwaa ne nyundua ba tɛɛ ba ba di vaɡre.
O ɡelɔ bwe bini pere, asɛ nee le dɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ, nenapale ken, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Korowii lii nyoa waa baɡɛ o bonɔɔ Abraham, o do ɡoroŋ la wa.
Gɛɛ a do Korowii tɔ o nɛra waa lee ba tɛ o te la sie le Ijipt harɛ, asɛ ba ɡo yela dɛ do lɔŋɔre dɛɛ hɛɡre.
O kpɔ nɛra bane harɛre ne ba kooni tɛɛ ba a berɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwa, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ baa teŋɛ o Mmarare, ne waa waa do ba a ta la ta.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Korowii wer waa doa tɛ o nɛra Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii dɛkalkɛ o wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa ta jaɡa dɔe.
Umee dɛ́ won baɡle wejena waa ɛa kɛɛ dɛ kpɛɛro kɛrɛdɛ nɔ?
Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta, ba waa toɡre saŋ bɛlbwa la, ba na som.
N Naa Korowii, he dɛ ba he nɛra chae yaa, lii n wa, he dɛ ba ba lɛɛ yaa, he cha n ɡe, ásɛ n dɔ wedɛɛɡa he nɛra aa dɛ ba dɔe la ane, n ne ba bwa dɔ silɛɛ, ásɛ n ne he nɛra haa lee ba cheɡ la hɛɡre kohona.
Ya ɛ wechɔɡa kɛ ya naawa ken, ya ɛ nyubinikpeɡ dɛ koni.
Ya naawa fa ta hen Korowii nyokpowe-ɛɛla waa mun noɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Ba soh nyina haa nyin ba la keraŋwɛnɛ bwa, dɛ ɛɛ deŋnekpeɡ Mposwɛm la ta.
Kɛ he lɛɛ ba ɡɛ haa baɡ ba nyoa la, dɛ baɡle ɡɛ haa dɔ kpeɡri kohona.
He kɔr Mposwɛm asɛ o hweeh, asɛ he tɔ he nɛra sie ba valɛ harɛpɛɛ ta kɛŋɔ, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken dɛ ɛɡɛ le o baŋ.
He lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta, nɛra baa hah ba la nɔn ta, dɛ ɡel nee bɔle ba dɔma bwa nɛ, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.
Belaa he nɛra yarada waa haa baɡ ba nyoa la, dɛ ɡo yela kpɛɛre.
Kɛ ba soh waa haa ɛa tɛɛ ba buɡ la ta, ba ta bwara sɔɔhnɛ, dɛ no waa haa bol ba be.
Ba pɛla lawɛ kondikwa, asɛ dɛ daah hen Korowii na, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela.
Anomanta, he tɛɛ ba kwaa baa soŋe la, dɛ berɛ kpɔ weechɔɡa ta ba nɛ.
Ba sie beɡre Mosis ne he bonɔɔ Arɔn haa lee ba cheɡ, ba do ɡoroŋ tɛɛ la nɛɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela.
Belaa harɛ pere asɛ Datan le o bini, dɛ tɔ Abiram ne o haah ne bii nɛ.
Korowii ɡelɔ nii le nyundua, dɛ ba le nɛra baa teŋɛ ba nɛɛ la nɛ, dɛ fuh nyubinikpeɡ tena baa lɔ ba bini.
Ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ nabale Sinai Bwejen ta, dɛɛ tomɔ kɛ voɡ ken.
Ba kpɔ jirima baa kpɔ tɛ hen Korowii la, berɛ kaa tɛ kon o mar aa le nabale, waa dɛ chwe kpɔɡa.
Ba soh hen Korowii, haa cheɡɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla ta, dɛ lɛɛ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la wa.
Nyokpowaa haa ɛa Mposwɛm ta, ne ɔmewaa haa ɛa bela kan kohona.
He baah diu dɛ fee ŋɔ hɛɛ chɔɡ baa, kɛ Mosis waa ɛ he bonɔɔ, he leo tɛ he te la soŋe, dɛ sɔɔh he bandia nyoa, he ta ban chɔɡɛ kpa.
A habɔɔ, ba vɛoh kɛ baa jo harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la taa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ta he waa haa baɡ ba nyoa la yaradae.
Ba soɡe ba tɛnte deene bini dɛɛ naɡre wa, ba ta he waa la ta teŋɛ.
Anomanta, he ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡ ba ŋɔ, hɛɛ ɡeloo bá serewe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ lɔ ba naanar peɡre nɛra baa wola hen Korowii tomɛ bini, ásɛ ba serewe harɛfala ta.
Baa tel Peɔ la, ba kpɔ ba te ka do voɡ Baal lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ di saraha kwaa baa ɛa tɛ voɡa aa wola mkpa dɔe.
Ba we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ hen Korowii baah di, asɛ he ɡel weechɔɡa ba le ba nɛ.
Kɛ Fenehas iro, dɛ tɛr nɛra baa di a bolchɔɡe la deŋne, asɛ hen Korowii ɡel weechɔɡa la nyoa sɔɔh.
Nɛra lii waa waa ɛa la kɛŋɔ waa aa toɡra, a chɔ le baa liira saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ba ɡelɔ hen Korowii baah di ba nɛɛ bule waa lɔ Mɛreba la ta, a kpɔ sibeɡra ta Mosis nɛ.
Ba ɛ hen Korowii Doma deŋnekpeɡ, anomanta, Mosis piɡro bol waa o fe aa wola liire tɛɛ ba.
Ba ta nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ kpoorɛ ɡɛ haa do ba la, kɛ ba sɛoh ba bii ɛɛ kpɔ dɔŋa, a che a ta, ba kpɔ ba voɡa toma da la.
He nɛra tomɛ ba voɡa la, asɛ a ɛ bela dɛ laɡ ba.
Ba kpoo ba bibaala ne bihaahna ɛ sarahare tɛ Keenan voɡa.
Ba kpoo bii baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, dɛ ɛ sarahare tɛ voɡa aa lɔ Keenan, asɛ ba chal kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ la.
A cheɡɛ ba we-ɛɛla ta, ba kpɔ doŋa kah ba te, ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ hen Korowii.
Anomanta, he baah di he nɛra nɛɛ kohona, asɛ he ki ba we-ɛɛla.
He vɛɛh ba tɛ nɛra baa wola hen Korowii tomɛ la, asɛ ba do ba lɔɡa dɛɛ tom ba.
Ba dɔma fiɡ ba dɛ ɡel ba do ba lɔɡa.
Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa he lɛ he nɛra, kɛ dɛ ba sie ta lɔ lwɛmkpeɡ we-ɛɛla ta, a kaa ba ne wechɔɡa kohona ta.
Kɛ baa lɔ wenaale ta la, he chaŋ ba dɛ no ba suna baa dɛ di.
He koh ba waa dɛ lii fɔo he ne baa fɔwa la, dɛ che he nyina waa kana la ta, dɛ charɛ he liire.
He ɡelɔ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la bwa berɛ na ba sum.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, lɛ yaa dɛ́ berɛ lawɛ yaa le harɛre ta ba, ásɛ ya kpɔ jam tɛɛ dɛ́ kpɛɛ he sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, hé kpɛɛro saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gel nɛra bwa ŋɔ, “Aamen.” Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Yela tɔn nuete Korowii wer waa doa kpɛɛra Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o waa wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
He nɛra Korowii aa lɛ heyaa la, hé bol o kpɛɛra waa baɡle nɛra, dɛkalkɛ o lɛ heyaa le he dɔma nɔn ta, dɛ lawɛ heyaa le harɛfala ta ba le wee leebɔr, dɛ́ ba kaa wee cholibɔr ne weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ́ ba kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Bane nyoɡre pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela, ba ta bwɛɛ bɛlbwa nae dɛ́ ka so o ta.
Lɔr ne nyɔɡre kpo ba, asɛ ba hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ.
Asɛ ba wahala nae bini la, ba wi no Korowii, asɛ o lɛɛ ba le suna baa dɛ di ta.
O tɔ ba sie dɛ kpɔ ba pa sie kaa bwɛjen baa ka so o ta.
A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne nyokpowaa waa ɛa tɛɛ ba la wa, dɛkalkɛ o tɛ nɛra nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo ba nee ba nyɔ, dɛ tɛ banɔ la lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba ɡe kondikondɛɛɡa ba di.
Dɛ ba bini bane soɡe biro tenten ta, ba do ba jɔɡrɔre dɛ laɡ ba do dea, ba bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ vɛh waa waa baɡ ba ta teŋa.
Anomanta, o do ba dɛ ɡel ba ɛ tomkpeɡa dɛ ba koh, ba ta nomɛlbwa dɔe o lɛɛ ba.
Asɛ ba wahala nae bini la, ba wi no Korowii, asɛ o lɛɛ ba le suna baa dɛ di ta.
O laɡ ba le biro tenten ta dɛ chaa jɔɡrɔre baa kpɔa do ba.
A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne o nyokpowaa waa ɛa tɛɛ ba la wa, dɛkalkɛ o kuuɡi ayaawa ɡbeni, dɛ teŋni bune baa kpɔa kaɡra.
Deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ ba bini bane ɡɛn, ba wechɔɡa ɡel ba bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ, dɛ baa kondikwa kwaraa nyin dɛ na, dɛ so dɛɛ kpa seo.
Asɛ ba wahala nae bini la, ba wi no Korowii, asɛ o lɛɛ ba le suna baa dɛ di ta.
O nyoa wobol chaah ba, dɛ lɛɛ ba le seo ta.
A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne o nyokpowaa waa ɛa tɛɛ ba la wa.
A chɛ kɛ bá kpo kwaa ba ɛ sarahare dɛ́ jam Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ silɛɛ ɡo yela baɡle waa waa ɛa.
Bane kpɔ stiimaere dɛɛ kpɔ mpo sie, dɛ kaa nyin ba nyoa kondikwa.
Ba na waa Korowii aa ɛa, nyokpowaa waa ɛa mpore ta.
O nyoa wobol ɡelɔ peukpeɡ ta, asɛ dɛ ir mpo nehɛma kohona.
Nehɛma la ɡɔɔ stiimaere la kaa nyundua a ba le vil bini, dɛ ɡel nɛra baa lɔ a bini bambile teŋe.
Ba valɔ dɛɛ yɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛra ken, ba ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe.
Asɛ ba wahala nae bini la, ba wi no Korowii, asɛ o lɛɛ ba le suna baa dɛ di ta.
O ɡelɔ peukpeɡ la nyoa sɔɔh, asɛ nehɛma la ɡel lɔe.
Nehɛma la nyoa aa sɔɔhna la, ba sie lɛo, asɛ o tɔ ba sie ba bela baa dɛ nyin ba chuɡe.
A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne o nyokpowaa waa ɛa tɛɛ ba la wa.
A chɛ kɛ bá bol ɡɛ o sɔn aa kana nɛnlaa baah, dɛ́ kpɛɛro bela ba nomonjena aa chema o Dea.
O ɡelɔ nenabɔɔne hweeh pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, buli ɡe ɡel pala, dɛ ɡel harɛ waa wera berɛ harɛ komɛlbwa aa wola won do wer o ta, nyubinikpeɡ tena ba fa aa soɡe bela la wa.
O ɡelɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ berɛ taama, asɛ nee ɛɛ palɛ harɛ waa hola ta.
O tɛ nɛra lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba ŋwɛnɛ ba ba so bela, asɛ ba ma bwɛjen dɛ so o ta.
Ba parɛ daa kooni, asɛ a nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ ba chaa.
O swee ba andɛɛɡa ba dɔ bii kohona, ba nae ɡe ya kohona.
