Korowii nɛra dɔma aa fiɡ ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ nomanta, a ɡelɔ ba nyoa sɔɔh baa di suna.
Korowii siwi ta ba nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la sui, a ɡel ba do pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, bela ŋwɛnɛre aa wola toole dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
Kɛ o lawɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra le ba wenaale ta, dɛ ɡel ba bii warɛ kɛŋɔ peera ken.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nao ba sie lɛ, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena te, ba helɔ.
Nɛra baa jemɛ waa la, bá kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ do ba liire bini, dɛ́ lii Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la wa.
Chae wesoŋa dɛ́ yo dɔma Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, he nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kohona, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre n bambile bwa ne.
Mɛɛ iruu che, dɛ́ kpɔ janjela ne kwaa bwa soo siwi lɔ yela!
Mɛɛ feluu ir mɔɔ bɔr chaah.
N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ jaamee harɛre nɛra bwa binii, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre nɛnlaa baahnee.
He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe kan dɛɛ tel nyundua, he wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ ɡe ɛɛ tel bela.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel ya na he kan haa doa nyundua, ásɛ he jirima tɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Lɛ yaa he kpeɡri ne dɛ́ no ya wesoŋa, ɡɛ aa ɛ he lɛ nɛra haa dɛ nyin ba la.
Korowii bol waa o Dea bela waa do ɡoroŋ la dɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ yo bwɛjen Sɛkem tenaa dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ bɔne o ne Sukot Fɛlembɔjen bini tɛ n nɛra.
Gelead harɛ ne Manasɛ dea harɛ bwa ɛ n kwa, Efrem harɛ do kɛŋɔ n laa ɡbɛrɛ, asɛ Juda harɛ ɡe do kɛŋɔ n koodaŋɡbala.
Moab harɛ nɛra ɛ n bonɔɔna, ba do kɛ loɡ maa dɛ loo kwaa o bini ken, mɛɛ kpɔ n naŋɡawaa ta Edom harɛ ta.
N dɛ moo, dɛkalkɛ n pɔ Filisti tena nɛ.” N Naa Korowii, umee dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ jo bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro nɔ ta nɔ?
Umee dɛ́ tɔ n sie kaa Edom ɔ?
He deno berɛ habɔɔ kpo yaa kɛɛ?
Haa ya laa tena sie tɔ ka yo ya dɔma kpa aa?
Cha yaa ya won pɔ ya dɔma nɛ, nɛwɛnyini chae ɡɛ bɛlbwa naa, a bwa dɛ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Korowii ja ya nɛ aa, yaa yoo, dɛ́ pɔ ya dɔma nɛ.
Wɛɛ tiɡri ya dɔmaa do harɛ.
Nɛn waa lɔ wenaale ta wobol Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii maa dɛ kpɛɛre, ir nyu ne, bɛ nyoa tɔ, dɛkalkɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena ne nyosonteŋna dɛ yoo mɛ, ba teŋe nyosone bol waa dɛɛ yaɡ mɛ.
Haeh wobol ɡboo ba bol dɛɛ yaɡ mɛ, dɛɛ yoo mɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Ba kpɔ haeh chiɡ darame naa ta, kɛ n te, hen Korowiirii n soŋe dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Ba kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ bɔ mɛ wedɛɛɡa kem, dɛ kpɔ haeh bɔ mɛ nyina kem.
N Naa Korowii, le nɛnchɔɡe waa bol n dɔm waa dɛ́ pao bole, ɡel o dɔm ɡbaɡba che o nɛ.
Gel ba bol o waa ó di bolchɔɡe, ɡel o wesoŋa kwaraa berɛ wechɔɡa tɛo.
Gel o tɔpera waa di do boraa ken, ásɛ nɛnfale di nomonome waa dɛ di la.
Gel o bii berɛ bilalbii, ásɛ o haah ɛ luhaah.
Gel o bii ɡaaɡe dɛɛ soŋe kwa, ɡel ba doŋ ba le dimɡbeeni baa lɔ a ta la ta.
Gel nɛra waa di ba kema pa o kondɔɔh bwa kaa, dɛ́ ɡel hɔɔhra pa komɛlbwa waa koah dɛ dɔ.
Bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa ɛɛ sune o nɛ, dɛ́ ɛo wedɛɛɡa kɛɛ dɛ́ na o bilalbii la sum.
Gel o naanar bwa serewe, dɛ́ ɡel o sɔn nyoɡre naanar baa ka ba bwa bini.
N Naa Korowii, lii o naawa wechɔɡa o sie.
Bɛ o nya wechɔɡa kpɔ kɛo bwa.
N Naa Korowiirii dɛ́ lii ba wechɔɡa saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ ɡel nomɛlbwa bɛ ba waa lii harɛ nɔ ta kpa.
Dɛkalkɛ dɛ waa wedɛɛɡa lii, dɛ o dɛ kpoo dɛɛ do nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra, dɛ banɔ la ba bambile aa chɔɡa hɔhɔrɔwa.
N dɔm la dɛ nyin nɛra taahna, ɡel o taahna ɡure o nyu ta.
O hah sweera dɛ tɛ o dɔŋ, bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa swee tɛ o ɡe.
O kpɔ nɛra taahna berɛ batakaare dɛɛ do.
Gel o nɛra taahna sɔɔ kɛŋɔ ne, dɛ́ jooɡe o hoɡa bini kɛŋɔ no.
Gel a do kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ batakaare fɔrɔwo, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ kiriso vɔwɔ saŋ bɛlbwa ken!
N Naa Korowii, tɛr n dɔm deŋne n wa, tɛr nɛra baa dɛ bol n bwara wechɔɡa la deŋne.
Kɛ hen, Nemenɛ Korowii, che he sɔn ta dɛ́ cha mɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛ he wer ne he nyina haa dɔa la wa, dɛkalkɛ n ɛ nyaa dɛ ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre, asɛ n bambile bwa ɛɛ wee mɛ.
N dɛ ba nyoɡra kɛŋɔ bɔr aa joa dɛɛ bir ken.
N do kɛŋɔ hɔɔhre peu aa kpɔ mɛ ka ta.
Nyoa vɔwa ɡelɔ n natuune ɛɛ sa, n ɡwaŋɛ ka hoɡa.
Ba na mɛ naa, ba dɛ muɡli n baah, dɛɛ viiɡi ba nyuune.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, cha mɛ, koh he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la waa dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel n dɔma jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee lɛɛ mɛ.
Baa taah mɛɛ, kɛ hɛɛ swee mɛ andɛɛɡaa.
Ba dɛ yoo mɛ naa, hɛɛ ɡeloo sihiih kpo ba, ásɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ sie lɛ.
Gel sihiih kpo n dɔma kohona, dɛ́ bɔle ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ batakaarejaŋ ken.
Mɛɛ jam Korowii kohonaa, dɛ́ kpɛɛro nɛnlaa bini, dɛkalkɛ o dɛ che nyaara habɔɔ, dɛ lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le nɛra baa kpoo ba nɔn ta.
Korowii ne Kooro waa leo cheɡ tɛ o te wa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii ŋɔ n Dɔɔ be ŋɔ, so nomombɔr n diɡ ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba he dɔma ne harɛ he tiɡri ba nɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛɛ kpeɡrii Saayɔn, ásɛ he di kora he dɔma baa bare cheme nɛ.
Awola haa yo he dɔma la, he nɛra ɛɛ sɛoh dɛ́ ba teŋɛ he nɛ.
He bonɔɔna ɛɛ leo ba he be kɛŋɔ chɔɔlen mɛn ken, he bwe waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.
Korowii baɡɛ nyoa waa wola o liiree charɛ ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ ɛ sɔfoo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk.” Korowii ɛɛ che he mun taa, o baah diu waa, wɛɛ yo koranaree dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Wɛɛ bol harɛre nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole, ba serewe warɛ chɔ laa ta, dɛ́ kpoo harɛ nɔ ta koranar bwa.
Kooro la ɛɛ nyɔ nee ŋwɛnɛ nyoa nepale taa, dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa, dɛ́ yo o dɔma dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Korowii kpɛɛra yel Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Mɛɛ jam Korowii n bambile bwa nee, o nɛnlaa baa chema bini.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ ɛ dɔ nyokpoa, nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta kpɔa do ba liire ta dɛɛ lii saŋ bɛlbwa.
Jirima ne nyanyini lɔ waa waa dɛ ɛ ta.
O waa toɡrɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O ɡelɔ yaa lii nyokpowaa waa ɛa, Korowii dɔ tedoma tɛ yaa dɛɛ na ya sum.
O dɛ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ tomɔ kondikwa, waa o fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la waa soh saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.
O ɡelɔ o nɛra na o kpeɡri waa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma, dɛ lɛ harɛre nɛra bane harɛre tɛɛ ba.
O waa waa dɛ ɛ bwa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛ toɡre.
Waa waa dɛ do nɛra a ta bwa wer, baa hwɛɡɛ a ta.
A lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, Korowii cheɡɛ toɡra o wa aa toɡra ne kasinteŋ ta, dɛ kpɔ tɛ o nɛra.
O berɔ kwaa lɛ o nɛra, dɛ ɡel ba di ba nyu.
O ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo waa do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O sɔn do ɡoroŋ dɛ do ɔma kohona.
Korowii ɔmaa dɛɛ ba ɡela he dɔ wejema.
Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta la, o ɡelɔ baa no waa mun kohona.
Onee chɛ kpɛɛra saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Nɛndɛɛɡe silɛɛ dɔe wa Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, o sie ɛɛ lɛ o Mmarare ta kohona la, o na som.
Naate bii ɛɛ di kpeɡri harɛ taa, ásɛ Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ o naanar.
Kondɔɔh ne suuɡa ɛɛ do naate demii, ásɛ o wobɛlbwa do wer, ó ɛ kondɔɔh saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Hale biro ta, nii dɛ chaah nɛn o wa aa toɡra sie, nɛn waa dɔ tedoma ne nɛn nɛɛ suna o waa dɔ kasinteŋ la.
Nomɛlbwa waa ta tea dɛɛ kemɛ o bala suuɡa dɛɛ di kasinteŋ o toma ta la, o na som.
Nɛndɛɛɡe wobɛlbwa dɛ do wer dɛɛ tɛo.
Nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ lii o waa saŋ bɛlbwa.
Waa wechɔɡa noɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ, o yarada kan, o kpɔ o te dawɛ Korowii nɛ.
O bambile cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ, waa ɔmɛ.
O jemɔ kɛ Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ó pɔ o dɔma nɛ.
Waa nɔn nyore, o dɛ tɛ nyaara tɛɛ tenten, o wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta jaɡa dɔe, wɛɛ di kpeɡrii dɛ dɔ jirima.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ nao ba baah di kohona, ásɛ ba liire chɔɡ ba che dɛɛ nyiŋi ba hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ.
Korowii wer waa doa kpɛɛra Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, hé kpɛɛro dɛ́ yerɛ o sɔn.
Hé kpɛɛro dɛ́ tɛo sɔn, le saŋ nɔ ne saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Korowii dɛ di kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.
Nɛra dɛ kpɛɛ o jirima waa dɔa nyundua.
Umee do kɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, o so o kookara ta nyundujaɡla, dɛ ba sie ne harɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi nyundua ne harɛ nɔɔ?
O lawɛ nɛra dɛɛ le ba nyaa ta, dɛ lɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra dɛɛ le ba sum ta.
O dɛ do ba koobii bini ba ne baa di kora, hale Korowii nɛra baa ɛ nomonjena bini.
O swee hambara andɛɛɡa o dem, o berɛ won dɔ bii o sie lɛ.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Galekaa Tɔpejen dii yel Awola Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ta, Jekɔb naanar aa le harɛ baa kaa ɛ hɔɔhra o ta la, Korowii kpɔ Juda tena ɛ o nɛra baa do ɡoroŋ, Israel tena ɡe ɛ o kapɛrɛ nɛra.
Mposwɛm pere anɛ ba siwi ta, asɛ Jɔɔdan Moo ɡe ɡel pala.
Bwejena dɛ jah kɛŋɔ pebala, asɛ deŋɡarere ɡe ɛɛ jah kɛŋɔ pebiiri ken.
Bɔkwa waa bala Mposwɛm pere anɛ, asɛ Jɔɔdan Moo ɡe ɡel pala ɔ?
Bwejena, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ jah kɛŋɔ pebala nɔɔ?
Deŋɡarere, ɛrɛɛ he ɡe ɛɛ jah kɛŋɔ pebiiri nɔɔ?
Hárɛ, jiɡri Korowii sie, Korowii Jekɔb aa dɛ tomɔ sie.
Onee ɡela nee bule le bwe ta dɛ berɛ tam, dɛ ɡel nee le bwekpeɡ ta, dɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ nenapale.
Korowii o ɡbo wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ N Naa Korowii, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne he kasinteŋ nomanta, he ɡbosoroo chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ jirima tɛ, ya te laa.
Ɛrɛɛ harɛre nɛra ɛɛ bɔɔ yaa ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔɔ nɔɔ?” Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la lɔ nyundua, waa aa too o tea laanee wɛɛ ɛ. Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm nee ba ɛ ba voɡare, nɛwɛnyinii kpɔ nɔɔra ɛa.
A dɔ nyoo, aa won bol wa, dɛ dɔ sibie, aa na.
A dɔ deŋna, aa waa no, dɛ dɔ mee, aa sɔɔh no.
A dɔ nɔɔra, aa won kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa, dɛ dɔ nakpale, aa won valɛ, aa won do ɡbɔɡa bɛlbwa ɡe.
Nɛra baa kwaara ne nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ a nɛɛ bwa ɛɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋii.
Israel tena, hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛ, onee dɛɛ cha heya, dɛɛ tɔ heyaa ɡbemɡbe.
Korowii sɔfore, hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛ, onee dɛɛ cha heya, dɛɛ tɔ heyaa ɡbemɡbe.
Nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, hé kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛ, onee dɛɛ cha heya, dɛɛ tɔ heyaa ɡbemɡbe.
Korowii ɛɛ lii ya waa, dɛ swee yaa andɛɛɡa.
Wɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ Israel tena ne o sɔfore bwa.
Wɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ, nɛnjena ne nɛmpɛɛne bwa.
Korowii ɡel hé ya, he ne he bii bwa.
Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ la, swee heya andɛɛɡa.
Korowii kpɔ nyundua ɛ o dobɔr, dɛ kpɔ harɛ nɔ tɛ ya nɛwɛnyina.
Nɛn sewaa, waa won kpɛɛ Korowii, nomɛlbwa aa won kpɛɛro lalabwɛɛ kpa.
Kɛ yan ya taa soɡe le nɔ te, yaa kpɛɛroo le fini ne saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Nomɛl Korowii aa lɛo le seo nyoa Korowii kpɛɛra N dɛ nyin Korowii wa, dɛkalkɛ o no n be, o no n wii dɛ sune n nɛ.
N wio noo waa, o cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no n be saŋ bɛlbwa.
Seo vɔɡ mɛ bil, lalbɔɔ weweele bɔle n nɛ n liire chɔɡ, ɔmee su n bwa.
Belaa n yerɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ!” Korowii waa toɡrɔ wɛɛ sune nɛn nɛ.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ dɔ tedoma.
Nɛra baa wola won cha ba te la, Korowii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ.
Gɛ saŋ maa lɔ sibeɡra ta la, o lɛɛ mɛ.
Anomanta, n liiro ŋɔ, N wee, ɡel he baah sɔɔh name, nyiŋa Korowii aa nyiŋi n nɛɛ la wa.
N Naa Korowii, he lee mɛ seo nyoa, dɛ fee n siniire, he ta ɡelɛ n lɔ na, dɛ ɡel n won dɛɛ valɛ he sie weera harɛ nɔ ta.
N yaradae, hale n ŋɔ, “Weweele ta ɡelɛ n bwara ɛɛ sɔɔh mɛ.” N liire aa chɔɡa la, n ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe!” Bɔkwaa mɛɛ ba wona kpɔ chiɡ hen Korowii wedɛɛɡa haa ɛa tɛ mɛ nɔ naa ta nɔ?
Mɛɛ ɛ sen sarahaa tɛɛ, dɛ jaame, lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.
He nɛra warɔ dɛ cheme aa, belaa mɛɛ ba n nyobaɡa maa baɡɛ la chuɡra.
Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra o be la waa hiaoh, ba seo ɡelɔ o loo ɛɛ ku.
N Naa Korowii, n ɛ he bonɔɔ kpela, n tomɛ ɡɛ n nya aa tomɛ.
He lɛɛ mɛ le seo nyoa.
Mɛɛ kpo kwaa ɛ jam sarahaa tɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ n wesoŋa bil he sie.
He nɛra warɔ dɛ cheme aa, belaa mɛɛ ba n nyobaɡa maa baɡɛ la chuɡra, he Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bini.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Korowii kpɛɛra yel Harɛre nɛra bwa, hé jam N Naa Korowii, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛro!
O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa kan kohona.
O waa dɔ kasinteŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Korowii jaama wesoŋa Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o waa wer.
O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Israel tena, hé ŋɔ, “O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Arɔn naanar, hé ŋɔ, “O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” He banɔ la bwa haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, hé ŋɔ, “O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Maa lɔ weweele ta la, n wio no Korowii, asɛ o chaŋ mɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.
Korowii ja n nɛ, maa ɔmɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba wona ɛɛ mɛ nɔ?
Korowii ja n nɛɛ dɛɛ cha mɛ, anomanta, mɛɛ won pɔ n dɔma nɛ.
A wer kohona kɛ nɛn kpɔ o te do Korowii lɔɡa, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ waa kpɔ o te dawɛ nɛwɛnyini nɛ.
A wer kohona kɛ nɛn kpɔ o te do Korowii lɔɡa, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ waa kpɔ o te dawɛ harɛ nɔ ta nomonjena nɛ.
Harɛre nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ bwa bar mɛ cheme, kɛ Korowii cheɡɛ n habɔɔ dɛ ɡel n pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba bar mɛ cheme, kɛ Korowii cheɡɛ n habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel n pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba warɔ bar mɛ cheme, kɛŋɔ toohna ken, kɛ ba serewɔ wɔrɔbe nɛ, kɛŋɔ nii aa le sɔɔhne baah ken, asɛ Korowii che n habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel n pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba baa yoo mɛ, a ka tama ba fee pɔ n nɛ, kɛ Korowii cha mɛ.
N bokpeɡa maa dɔa ne n kpeɡri bwa le Korowii be, onee nɛn waa dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.
Hé no nɛra ba wa aa toɡra silɛɛ moola aa dɛ le ba tɛnte deene bini, pɔe baa pɔ ba dɔma nɛɛ la wa.
Ba ŋɔ, “Korowii kpeɡri, o won wekpeɡa kohona ɛɛ.
O kpeɡri ɡelɔ ya pɔ ya dɔma nɛ, o won wekpeɡa kohona ɛɛ.” Maa sewa ba, mɛɛ so lee dɛ́ baɡle waa Korowii aa ɛa.
Korowii tɛr n deŋne kohona, kɛ o ta ɡelɛ n sewɛ.
Hé pili Korowii Dea doonyoo tɛ mɛ, bela nɛra ba wa aa toɡra aa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, ásɛ n jo kpɔ jam ka tɛ Korowii.
Korowii Dea doonyoa laanee la, o taa nɛra ba wa aa toɡra che dɛɛ jo.
N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ kpɔ jamee tɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ he no n be dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.
Bwe la mamaala aa vɛoh dɛ liiru konsala laanee bera ba lawɛ dea la kpoŋe la.
Korowiirii ɡela a ɛ ɡɛ, asɛ a ɛ yaa nyokpowa.
Finii ɛ tɔpere yaa kpɔa dɛɛ lii awola Korowii aa pɔ o dɔma nɛ.
Hé ɡel ya sie lɛ, yaa hɛɡre a wa.
N Naa Korowii, ba lɛ yaa, ɡel ya wobɛlbwa chiɡ yaa kɛrɛdɛ.
Korowii swee naate waa valɛ o sɔn ta dɛɛ ba nɔ andɛɛɡa.
Ya cheɡɛ Korowii Dea dɛɛ sweere andɛɛɡa.
Korowii beŋkpoŋ ɡboo lole, on sune ya nɛɛ dɛ lɛ yaa.
Hé pa he tɔpejen dii la mun, dɛ́ kpoŋe bambie daa, dɛ́ ka valɛ bar kwaa aa do kɛ nyeɡlare, dɛ do Korowii saraha on la bɔr la.
Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, n kpɔ jam dɛɛ tɛɛ, mɛɛ bol he kan haa doa waa.
Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o waa wer.
O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii Mmara la Nɛra ba we-ɛɛla aa toɡra, baa teŋɛ Korowii Mmarare ta la, ba na som.
Nɛra baa dɛ nyin o waa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta bambile bwa ne la, ba na som.
Baa wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛ, ba dɛ valɛ o ŋwɛnɛre waa baɡla la ta.
N Naa Korowii, he kpɔ he Mmarare tɛ yaa, dɛ ŋɔ yá kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
N dɛ nyin kɛ n waa fe dɔ kasinteŋ, mɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta!
Dɛ n do sie dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta naa, sihiih aa men kpo bwa.
Dɛ n dɛ hweli he wa aa toɡra dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta naa, mɛɛ dɔ bambidɛɛɡee dɛɛ kpɛɛre.
Mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare taa, bɛ men vɛh kwara.
Korowii Mmarare ta teŋa Ɛrɛɛ bonɔɔ we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ba wona do wer he be nɔ?
Nemenɛ wɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.
N dɛ tomɛ n bambile bwa ne.
Bɛ ɡel n vɛh waa haa do mɛ a ta la ta teŋa.
N kpɔ he waa do n bambile bini, dɛ bɛ hen wechɔɡa ɛ. N Naa Korowii, n dɛ kpɛɛre, baɡ mɛ he Mmarare la.
Mɛɛ dɛɛ bol he waa haa kpɔa baɡ mɛ laanee nɛra be.
N sie dɛ lɛ he waa ta teŋa, ɡwaa kɛ maa dɔ kondɔɔh kohona.
N kpɔ he waa la do n nyu bini, dɛɛ kari a bwa.
N dɛ nyin he Mmarare la kohona, maa he waa laanee vɛh.
Korowii waa ta teŋa dɔ silɛɛ Nyiŋi men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ n won so dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa haa baɡ mɛ la ta.
Pili n sie, ń won jemɛ he waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ he Mmarare ta la.
N ɛ hɔɔh harɛ nɔ ta, bɛ he waa haa do mɛ a ta la kpɔ sɔɔh mɛ.
N bambile lawɔ kɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare la ta, saŋ bɛlbwa.
He dɛ kah mbarafo tena, dɛɛ taah nɛra baa vɛh he waa ta teŋa.
Lɛɛ mɛ le chɛɡa ne sihiih ta, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.
A lole kɛ nɛra baa dɛ di kpeɡri dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa, kɛ mɛɛ kpɔ he waa laanee do n nyu bini.
He Mmarare laanee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ, anee dɛɛ ja mɛ.
Korowii Mmara ta teŋa siswɛm ne N cheɡɛ seo nyoa, ɡel he waa la tɛ mɛ bokpeɡfala, ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.
N bol n wenaale baɡle, asɛ he chaŋ mɛ, baɡ mɛ he ŋwɛnɛre.
Cha mɛ ń won no he waa la mun, ásɛ mɛɛ lii he nyokpowe-ɛɛla la.
N dɛ di suna kohona, tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa, ɡɛ haa baɡɛ nyoa la.
Lee mɛ waa aa ɛ nyosone ta, he wa aa toɡra nomanta, chaɡ mɛ he Mmarare la.
N dɛ nyin kɛ n waa dɔ kasinteŋ, dɛ kpɔ n te dawɛ he waa ta.
N Naa Korowii, n lawɛ he Mmarare la kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ, bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ.
Mɛɛ swɛɛ siwii dɛɛ teŋɛ he webaɡla ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he cha mɛ, dɛ ɡel mɛɛ no waa mun kɛrɛdɛ.
Waa mun noe wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, baɡ mɛ he Mmarare la, ásɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ a ta saŋ bɛlbwa.
Cha mɛ n won dɛɛ no waa mun, ásɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta, n bambile bwa ne.
Chaɡ mɛ he waa ŋwɛnɛre mɛɛ kpɔ a ta, dɛkalkɛ a taa mɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ.
Gel mɛɛ nyin he waa ta teŋa ta, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ maa dɔ kwa.
Bɛ ɡel n pɛla do kwaa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe ta.
Tɛ mɛ mkpa ɡɛ he waa la aa baɡla la.
Tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ kon haa baɡ mɛ nyoa, ɡɛ haa baɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ la.
Lɛɛ mɛ le chɛɡa maa dɛ ɔmɛ kohona ta, dɛkalkɛ he waa dɔ nyokpoa.
N dɛ nyin he waa la ta teŋa kohona.
Che toɡra he wa aa toɡra ta dɛ tɛ mɛ mkpa.
Korowii waa la yaradae N Naa Korowii, ɡel n na he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.
Lɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ haa baɡɛ nyoa la.
Ásɛ n won chaŋe nɛra baa dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, dawa maa kpɔ n te dawɛ he waa ta nomanta.
Gel n won kasinteŋ bola saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n hwɛɡa bwa lɔ he waa la ta.
Mɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare la taa, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Mɛɛ valɔɔ maa wola ɔmɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.
Mɛɛ bol he waa koranar sie, sihiih aa wola men kpo.
Maa dɛ nyin he Mmarare la nomanta, n sie dɛ lɛ a ta teŋa ta.
N dɛ nyin he waa la dɛɛ duura, mɛɛ kpɔa do n nyu bini.
Yarada dɔe Korowii Mmara ta wa Lii men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ waa haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.
A ɡelɔ n dɔ hwɛɡa.
Bolarawa maa dɔa dɛ le n wenaale bini laanee kɛŋɔ, he nyoa haa baɡ mɛ la ɡelɔ n dɔ mkpa.
Mbarafo tena aa n loro dii ɡel bwa, kɛ a ta ɡelɛ n laa n te kpɔ he Mmarare ta teŋa ta.
N Naa Korowii, n lii he Mmarare aa lole dɛ le saŋ la bwa wa aa, dɛ n dɔ bolarawa.
N nao kɛ nɛnchɔɡa vɛh he Mmarare la ta teŋa aa, dɛ n baah diu.
N soɡa tama harɛ nɔ ta nɔ, he waa laanee ber mɛ yela mɛɛ ɡo.
N Naa Korowii, hale jwaana n dɛ lii he wa, dɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.
Anee ɛ waa maa dɛ ɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa la ta tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Korowii Mmarare ta teŋa kasinteŋ ne N Naa Korowii, henee n komɛlbwa.
N sɛoh kɛŋɔ mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare la taa.
N bambile bwa nee mɛɛ nyin he bɔr.
Sune n nɛ, ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.
N nyiŋi ɡɛ n we-ɛɛla aa doa dɛ charɛ n liire, dɛ baa teŋɛ he waa la ta.
Mɛɛ ɛ waranee maa wola hɛlɛ, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ waa haa do mɛ a ta la.
Hale nɛnchɔɡa har mɛ bela kwaraa naa, maa he Mmarare laanee soh bwa.
Harambaŋa n yon ir dɛ́ɛ kpɛɛre, ɡɛ he waa la aa toɡra wa.
N kpɔ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tomɛ la ɛ n dam, nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta bwa.
N Naa Korowii, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe su harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Baɡ mɛ he Mmarare la.
Korowii Mmarare wer aa doa N Naa Korowii, he teŋɛ he nyobaɡa ta, dɛ ɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ wedɛɛɡa.
Tɛ mɛ wejema ne liire, dawa maa kpɔ n te dawɛ he Mmarare ta la nomanta.
Mɔɔ he tɛr n deŋne la, dɛ wechɔɡaa n ɛ, kɛ taraken te n dɛ teŋɛ waa haa do mɛ la ta.
He waa wer, he wobɛlbwa ɡe wer, chaɡ mɛ he waa la.
Mbarafo tena teŋe nyosone dawɛ n nɛ, kɛ n bambile bwa nee mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.
Ba nyu bini kpeɡri, ba tea aa nɛn nɛɛ domɛ, kɛ he Mmarare la taa mɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ.
A wer kɛ maa dɔ deŋnetɛra, dɛkalkɛ a ɡelɔ n won hweli he waa la.
Mmarare haa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la ɡwaa mɛ harɛ nɔ ta suuɡa bwa, hale suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ta an tele.
Korowii Mmara kasinteŋ aa dɔa Henee ta mɛ, dɛ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ.
Tɛ mɛ waa mun noe, ń kpɔ hweli he Mmarare la.
Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ la na mɛ naa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛo, dɛkalkɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ he waa la ta.
N Naa Korowii, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ he bole pae toɡrɔ, he che kasinteŋ ta dɛ tɛr n deŋne.
Kpɔ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la larawe n bwara ɡɛ haa baɡɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nyoa la.
Sune n nɛ, ásɛ n won so le, dɛkalkɛ n sie dɛ lɛ he Mmarare la ta teŋa ta.
Gel sihiih kpo mbarafo tena, nyosone baa teŋa dɛɛ dawɛ n nɛ pɛɛpɛɛ wa, kɛ n te, mɛɛ dɛɛ lii he waa laanee.
Gel nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ la berɛ ba n be, nɛra baa jemɛ he Mmarare la bwa.
Gel n bambile lawɛ he waa la, mɛɛ teŋɛ a ta kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ sihiih bɛ men kpo.
Korowii nɛn lɛɛ wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, n nyiŋi he siwi ta kɛ hɛɛ ba lɛɛ mɛɛ kahonɛ, n hwɛɡa bwa lɔ he waa la ta.
N nyiŋi waa haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la ŋwɛnɛ dɛ ba koh, dɛɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba n bwara larawa ɔ?” N do kɛ yakwajɛɡla, baa wola men kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa ken, kɛ n ta he Mmarare la soɛh.
N kpae ka tel saŋ besoo?
Bɛweeree hɛɛ ba n dɔma deŋne tɛra ɔ?
Mbarafo tena baa wola he Mmarare ta teŋɛ kwi bɔɔne, dɛ́ kpɔ har mɛ bela.
He Mmarare la wer, kɛ nɛn kpɔ o te dawɛ a ta kohona.
Lɛɛ mɛ le nɛra baa hah mɛ pɛɛpɛɛ nɔn ta.
A ka tama ba kpo mɛ, kɛ n ta he Mmarare ta teŋa ɡelɛ bwa.
Che he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, ásɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he webaɡla bwa ta.
Yarada dɔe Korowii Mmara ta N Naa Korowii, he waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, a cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ nyundua.
He kasinteŋ lole ka tel ya naanar baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ bwa.
Henee kpɔ harɛ cheɡ o chebɔr asɛ o do le.
He nyoa wobol nee he ta kwaa bwa, asɛ a do le ba le fini, dɛkalkɛ a bwa lɔ he lɔɡa.
Dɛ he waa ta laa n silɛɛ che naa, n fe sewɛ n wenaale ta.
Maa he waa laanee vɛh bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ maa dɛ teŋɛ a ta waa he ɡel n so le.
Lɛɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ henee dɔɔ mɛ, n takapɔ dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa la ta.
Nɛnchɔɡa dɛ́ kpa kɛŋɔ bá kpo mɛ, kɛ ane a bwa, maa he Mmarare la ta teŋaa ɡel, mɛɛ dɛɛ liiraa.
N nao kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa dɔ a jaɡa, kɛ he Mmarare la te lole dɛɛ la.
Korowii Mmarare la nyina N Naa Korowii, n dɛ nyin he Mmarare la kɛrɛdɛ, tɔpere bɛlbwaa mɛɛ lii a wa.
He Mmarare la lɔ n liire bini tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛ ɡel n dɔ wejema, dɛ ɡwaa n dɔma.
N dɛ no waa mun ɡwaa nɛra maa hweli waa le ba be, dɛkalkɛ he Mmarare la waa lɔ n nyu bini mɛɛ liira.
N dɔ wejema dɛ ɡwaa nomonome baa hwɛɛhra, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta.
Maa dɛ nyin mɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta nomanta, n laa n te kpɔ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta.
N ta he Mmarare la vɛɛh, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee baɡ mɛ wa.
He waa la som n be kohona, a som dɛ ɡwaa tooh kwara.
A taa n dɔ wejema dɛɛ le, anomanta, n hah wechɔɡa nɛra aa dɛ ɛ. Korowii Mmara waa dɛ chaah bɔr kɛŋɔ kandea He waa la do kɛ kandea dɛ tɛ mɛ, dɛ ɛ nii dɛɛ chaah mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, bela bwa maa kpɔ.
N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare aa toɡra la taa.
N Naa Korowii, n na wahala kohona, tɛ mɛ bokpeɡfala ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.
N Naa Korowii, no n jaama maa dɛ jaame nɔ, dɛ́ chaɡ mɛ he Mmarare la.
Saŋ bɛlbwa n cheɡɛ seo nyoa, n ta he waa soɛh bwa.
Nɛnchɔɡa har mɛ bel, kɛ n ta habɔɔ berɛ kpo he Mmarare la bwa.
He Mmarare la do kɛ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa tɛ mɛ saŋ bɛlbwa ken, anee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ.
N bambile lawɔ kɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ he waa la taa, ka tel tɔpere maa sewɛ.
Bosɔɔhna aa lɔ Korowii Mmara ta N hah nɛra baa wola bambile bwa kpɔe dɛɛ tomɛ, kɛ n te dɛ nyin he Mmara la.
Henee n chwa baa marɛ hɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, n kpɔ n hwɛɡa bwa do he waa la ta.
Hé le n nɛɛ kaa, wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, ásɛ n won dɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa do mɛ ta!
Tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa ásɛ n won so le, ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.
Bɛ ɡel n hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ.
Laɡ mɛ kpoŋe, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ, ásɛ n cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no waa he Mmarare la aa dɛ baɡle.
Haa nɛra baa vɛh he Mmarare ta teŋa nyin, dɛkalkɛ ba nyosone vɔrɔwa bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Nɛnchɔɡa do kɛŋɔ haahra he siwi ta, anomanta, n sie dɛ lɛ he webaɡla ta.
He ɔma ɡelɔ n bwara ɛɛ chel, n dɛ ɔmɛ he Mmarare la.
Korowii Mmarare ne a ta teŋa N ɛ wa aa toɡra dɛ do wer, bɛ men ɡel tɛ n dɔma.

N nyiŋi he siwi ta dɛ ba koh kɛ hɛɛ ba lɛɛ mɛɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi nyoa haa baɡ mɛ ŋɔ, hɛɛ ba lɛɛ mɛɛ la.
Kpɔ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la nyin mɛ, dɛ́ chaɡ mɛ he Mmarare la.
Tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ waa mun noe, ásɛ n won no he waa la mun.
N Naa Korowii, saŋ telo kɛ he ir nyu ne, dɛkalkɛ nɛra vɛh he Mmarare la ta teŋa.

Korowii Mmara ta teŋa nyina He webaɡla waa dɔ nyokpoa, anomanta, n dɛ teŋɛ a ta n bambile bwa ne.
He waa la baɡla ɡelɔ nɛra liire bini ɛɛ chaah, dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ wejema.
N pɛla lawɛ he Mmarare kohona, n sie beɡrɔ kɛ ń jemɛ waa aa dɛ baɡle.

He waa bwa ɛ kasinteŋ, he Mmarare la toɡre, dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa.

Ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba he deŋnetɛra ɔ?

Korowii waa kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛɛ la aa dom chɔ.
Korowii waa kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ Israel tena nɛɛ la siwi lole saŋ bɛlbwa, waa dom chɔ.
Wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛ, o lɔ he jwɛɛh dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa kpoŋe, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ.
Wɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ webaŋa ne jwaanaa, wobɛlbwa aa heyaa ha.
Korowii ɛɛ lɛ heyaa le siswɛm bɛlbwa taa, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ ken.
Wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛɛ he buse bala ne he buse lee bini, le fini ne saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Bwɛjen Jerusalam kpɛɛra Kooro Devid yel N sie lɛo kɛ baa ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ir ya la Korowii Dea.” Taraken Jerusalam, he doonyoonee ya che nɔ.
Jerusalam ɛ bwɛjen baa ma o deene a farɛ, dɛ do wer kɛrɛdɛ.
Belaa Israel deene bwa ɛɛ cheme dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, ɡɛ waa do ba la.
Belaa Kooro Devid luɡe koranar fa so, dɛ bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.
Soŋe deŋnesɔɔhna tɛ Jerusalam tena ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa dɛ nyin hen Jerusalam la, ba wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba.
Kórowii ɡel deŋnesɔɔhna do Jerusalam baa ma danjwɛjen baro, ne o kooderemi bwa ta.” N lolanar ne n daamanar nomanta, n soŋe deŋnesɔɔhna dɛɛ tɛ Jerusalam tena!
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea nomanta, n dɛ soŋe ŋɔ hé wobɛlbwa chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ.
Nɛn nɛɛ suna wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, he siwi taa mɛɛ nyiŋi nyundua, bela haa dɛ di kora la.
Gɛ bonɔɔ yon dɛɛ nyiŋi o dɔɔ siwi ta, kɛɛ tolo yon dɛɛ nyiŋi o nomoa siwi ta la, ɡɛɛ yaa nyiŋi hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ siwi ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ haa sune ya nɛ.
N Naa Korowii, sune ya nɛ, nɛra aa yaa komɛl yerɛ.
Dɔɔhna mamɛ yaa biɡri, mbarafo tena nyiŋi yaa vah.
Korowii waa kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra nɛ Kooro Devid yel Dɛ Korowii fe ta ya nɛɛ jae yaa, ɛrɛɛ ya fe ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?
Israel tena, hé bwa chaŋe!
Dɛ Korowii fe ta ya nɛɛ jae, ɡɛ saŋ ya dɔma aa baa yo yaa la aa, ba bandia kohona nomanta, ba fe kpoo ya bwa.
A fe ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nee aa sua ba bɔle ya nɛɛ ken, dɛ́ fee kpɔ yaa kaa.
Nehɛma a nyoa aa kpeɡa fe lɔɔ ba tɔ ya nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ yaa kaa.
Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ Korowii, waa wola ɡelɛ ya dɔma chɔɡ yaa la wa.
Ya ɛo kɛŋɔ jumbie waa foora le kpaah bel ta ken.
Bel la kuuɡo asɛ ya dɔ ya nyu.
Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ bee ya chae bwa le.
Korowii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra nɛ Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ la do kɛŋɔ Saayɔn Bwejen.
Baa yiiɡi bwa, dɛ che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gɛ bwejena aa bar Jerusalam dɛɛ tɔɔ ɡbemɡbe la, ɡɛɛ Korowii bar o nɛra cheme fini ne tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena aa won dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ waa ɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra kon ta saŋ bɛlbwa.
A ɛ ɡɛ naa, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra laanee bá na kɛŋɔ ba ken ɛ wechɔɡa.
N Naa Korowii, ɛ nɛra ba wa aa wera wedɛɛɡa, nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta la.
Kɛ dɛ he tɛr nɛnchɔɡa deŋne aa, tɛr nɛra baa vɛh he waa ta teŋa la ɡe deŋne.
Israel tena, Korowii tɛ heyaa deŋnesɔɔhna!
Korowii nɛra lɛɛ wesoŋa Korowii aa bera lawɛ yaa ba Jerusalam la, dɛ a do kɛŋɔ deera ken ya be.
Ya sie lɛo kohona, ya mamɛ dɛɛ ɡo yela, asɛ harɛre nɛra bwa bol ya waa ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛ wejena tɛɛ ba.” Kasinteŋ, ya sie lɛo kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ɛ wejena tɛ yaa.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel ya wobɛlbwa berɛ do wer tɛ yaa kɛŋɔ, bwaala yon nɛ do nenabɔɔne aa hola ta á suuɡi la ken.
Nɛra baa kpɔ siniire du kwaa la, baa koma silɛɛ nee dɛɛ ɡo yela.
Nɛra baa kpɔ siniire dɛ che ba kondwee le ka du la, baa komaa dɛ chea ba silɛɛ yela ne.
Korowii kpɛɛra o wer waa doa wa Kooro Solomɔn yel Dɛ Korowii ta chae ba ma dea aa, mamaala koeh bwa ɛ pɛɛ.
O ɡbabir ta bwɛɛ daahnɛ aa, nɛra baa dɛ daah la dɛ koh pɛɛ.
A ɛ wepuu kɛ nɛwɛnyini le chɔɔ ɛ toma ka tel jɔmɔra, kondikwaa waa di ɡbo wa, dɛkalkɛ nɛra Korowii aa dɛ nyin ba la, ba chɔ dom kwara naa, o dɛ tɛɛ ba ba konnyina.
Bii ɛ kwaa Korowii aa swee nɛra andɛɛɡa, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ kɛ ba.
Bibaala baa aa lola o bonɔɔne saŋ la, do kɛŋɔ laa te waa kpoŋe hɛma ken.
Baa bɛlbwa waa dɔ ɡɛ bibaala la, o na som.
O ne o dɔma chemo aa, baa won pɔ o nɛɛ bwa.
Korowii waa ta teŋa kembɔr Nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta la, ba na som.
Naate ɛɛ di o koeh tɔnɔɔ, dɛ́ na som o wobɛlbwa do wer tɛo.
O haah ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ daa waa won nɔna kohona ken.
O bii ɛɛ do kɛ daa o nɔna aa wara, dɛ́ baro cheme.
Nɛn waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba andɛɛɡa sweera tɛ o ɡe.
Kórowii che o Dea waa lɔ Saayɔn sweere andɛɛɡa he soɡa bini bwa, dɛ́ ɡel he na Jerusalam wer doe.
Ó ɡel he so biɡri, dɛ́ na he naanar.
Israel tena, Korowii tɛ heya deŋnesɔɔhna!
Korowii soŋa ó pɔ Israel tena dɔma nɛɛ tɛɛ ba N bonɔɔne saŋ bwaa ba le fiɡ mɛ kohona.
Israel tena, hé chaŋe ŋɔ, “Le ya bonɔɔne saŋ bwaa ya dɔma yo yaa taeh, kɛ ba ta wone pɔ ya nɛ.
Ba chɛwɛ ya nyaŋre yaa na wahala, kɛŋɔ paa yon kpɔ par chɛwɛ harɛ la ken.
Kɛ Korowii o wa aa toɡra la lɛ yaa le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.” Kórowii ɡel sihiih kpo nɛra baa hah bwɛjen Saayɔn la, bá berɛ habɔɔ kaa.
Kórowii ɡel bá do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa le saldoa, aa wola won kpeɡ dɛ a holɔ la ken.
Aa kpeɡ ba won dɛɛ boa a nyoa kɛɛ a won su nɔn.
Nomɛlbwa aa teŋe ba kaa dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Kórowii sweere andɛɛɡa!” dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Ya cheɡɛ Korowii sɔn ta soŋe andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ bwa.”
Chae wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, n bambichɔɡ do kɛŋɔ maa le vil bini, dɛ wi dɛɛ yerɛ!
No n wii maa wia dɛɛ yerɛ.
Cheɡ deŋne no n be, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.
Dɛ he fe chwerɛ nɛn wechɔɡa waa dɛ ɛ dɛɛ bil aa, umee dɛ́ fe leɔ?
Kɛ he kpɔ ya wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ yaa, asɛ a che a ta yaa ɔmɛ.
N dɛ kpa sibeɡra ne kɛŋɔ Korowii ba cha mɛ.
O waa la taa mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.
N dɛ kpa Korowii sibeɡra ne, ɡwaa ɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah bɔr jwaana, yon dɛɛ nyiŋi bɔr chaahna ŋwɛnɛ kohona la.
Israel tena, hé kpɔ he hwɛɡa bwa do Korowii nɛ, dɛkalkɛ o nyina ta jaɡa dɔe, dɛ́ sɛh kɛ saŋ bɛlbwa wɛɛ lɛ heyaa.
Wɛɛ lɛ o nɛra Israel tenaa le ba wechɔɡa bwa ta.
Hwɛɡa dɔe Korowii nɛɛ kɛ bechala wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, n ɡel mbarafo ɛɛ, maa n te ɡɔɔ kpa.
N liire toole wejena kɛɛ nyokpowa aa ɡwaa n nɛɛ ta.
N liire ba harɛ n deŋne sɔɔh mɛ.
Gɛ bechala yon dawɛ o nya nakpale ta jeiih o bwara sɔɔhno la, ɡɛɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ.
Israel tena, hé kpɔ hwɛɡa do Korowii nɛ, le saŋ nɔ dɛɛ la.
Korowii Dea kpɛɛra wa N Naa Korowii, lii Kooro Devid ne wahala waa naa wa.
O ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡle hen Korowii, Nemenɛ Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɛ la ŋɔ, “Maa n demii la, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ chɔ n kalaŋ taa.
Maa domii chuɡli, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ chɔ domii, ka tel kɛŋɔ maa nyin sobɔr tɛ N Naa Korowii, Nemenɛ Korowii, Jekɔb Kpeɡnɛn waa tomɔ la.” Yaa lɔ Bɛtlɛham la, ya no Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la wa, dɛ ka nao Kiriat Jearim tena kooni ta.
Belaa ya ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel yá kaa Korowii be o Dea, dɛ́ ka tomɔ o kookara la sie.” N Naa Korowii, ir kpɔ He Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka waa cheɡa tɛ he kpeɡri la ba he Dea, dɛ́ ba so bonɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gel he sɔfore teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra, ásɛ he nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa ɡe do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ ne.
N Naa Korowii, lii nyoa haa baɡɛ he bonɔɔ Kooro Devid la wa.
Bɛ kooro haa leo cheɡ tɛ he te la vɛh.
He baɡɛ Kooro Devid nyoa, haa wola nyoa charɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar bini bɛl ba di he kara.
Dɛ he bibaala baa ba chiɡ he naa ta la ɛɛ teŋɛ fɔo n ne haa fɔwa, ne me Mmarare maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba taa yaa, ba ɡe bii ɛɛ di he kara nɔɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Korowii le Saayɔn cheɡ, dɛ kpɔ bela ɛ o soŋnibɔr.
O ŋɔ, “Bonɔɔ mɛɛ ba soɡa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, bonɔɔ mɛɛ nyin ń so dɛ́ di kora.
Mɛɛ tɛ Saayɔn tena ba konnyinaa, dɛ́ tɛ ba nyaara kondikwaa bá di dɛ́ vaɡre.
Mɛɛ swee Saayɔn sɔfore andɛɛɡaa wobɛlbwa baa dɛ ɛ ta, ásɛ o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yela saŋ bɛlbwa.
Mɛɛ lawɛ Kooro Devid naanar la bini bɛlee, dɛ́ cheɡo kora ta Saayɔn wɛɛ di kpeɡri, dɛ́ ɡel kooro maa leo cheɡ la jirima ɛɛ chaah, kɛŋɔ nii waa dɛ chaah saŋ bɛlbwa ken.
Sihiih ɛɛ kpo o dɔmaa kohona, kɛ o te kora ɛɛ dɔ jirimaa kɛrɛdɛ.”
Deŋnesɔɔhna ta soɡa kpɛɛra Kooro Devid yel Na wer ne silɛɛ aa dɔa kohona, kɛ nɛn ne o dɔŋa aa soɡe sodɛɛɡa nyopɛo ne!
A wer dɛ do kɛŋɔ, baa dɛ cheɡ Arɔn sɔfore ta, dɛ fuɡe noo a yoɡ aa kpeɡa do o nyu ta, a palɛ jo o tampona ta, dɛ ba le o batakaare baŋa ta ken.
A wer kɛŋɔ mɛn aa le Hɛmɔn Bwejen ta, dɛɛ lee Saayɔn Bwejen doa ken.
Belaa Korowii baɡɛ o nɛra nyoa ŋɔ, wɛɛ swee o nɛra andɛɛɡaa, bá dɔ mkpa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Nɛra yera bá ba kpɛɛ Korowii yel Hé kpɛɛ Korowii, hé nɛra haa ɛ o bonɔɔna bwa, hé banɔ la haa dɛ tomɔ o Dea jwaana.
Hé ɡɔɔ nɔɔra Korowii Dea bela dɛ́ kpɛɛro.
Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ la, ó le Saayɔn dɛ́ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa.
Korowii kpɛɛra yel Hé kpɛɛ Korowii, he nɛra haa ɛ o bonɔɔna la, hé kpɛɛro, he nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ o Dea la.
Hé kpɛɛro, o wer waa doa wa, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ o sɔn, dɛkalkɛ o wer.
O le Jekɔb luɡe tena, Israel tena baa ɛ o ɡbaɡba nɛra la tɛ o te.
N jemɔ kɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kan. O kan ɡwaa voɡare bwa.
Gɛ waa dɛ nyin laanee wɛɛ ɛ nyundua ne harɛ, mpo ne o vile bwa ta.
O ɡelɔ baama aa dɛ nɛ bwaala ir dɛɛ le harɛ jaɡa, dɛ ɡel bwaala ɛɛ nɛ dɛɛ nyɛɡle, asɛ dɛ ɡel peu ta le bela waa lole.
O kpoo Ijipt harɛ nɛra biloɡla, ne kondɛɛra ɡe biloɡla.
O ɛ nyokpowaa Ijipt tena bini, dɛ tɛr Ijipt kooro ne o nomonome bwa deŋne.
O kpoo harɛre nɛra ɡalɡa, hale koranar baa dɔ kpeɡri.
Banee, Amɔre tena Kooro Sihon ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ, dɛ Keenan harɛ koranar bwa, asɛ dɛ kpɔ ba harɛre la tɛ o nɛra Israel tena a ɛ ba kwa.
N Naa Korowii, he sɔn haa dɔa la ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Naanar baa ka ba bwa ɛɛ dɛɛ lii he waa.
Korowii ɛɛ bol o nɛra waa tɛɛ ba ásɛ dɛ dɔ tedoma tɛ o bonɔɔna.
Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm nee ba ɛ harɛre la voɡare.
Nɔɔra nee ba kwaara.
A dɔ nyoo, kɛ aa waa bol, dɛ dɔ sibie, kɛ aa na.
A dɔ deŋna, aa waa no, aa won hwee ɡe.
Nɛra baa kwaara ne nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ a nɛɛ bwa beŋkpoŋ.
Israel tena, hé kpɛɛ Korowii, hé nɛra haa ɛ o sɔfore ɡe kpɛɛro.
Lewi dea tena, hé kpɛɛ Korowii, hé nɛra haa dɛ tomɔ bwa ɡe kpɛɛro.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii waa lɔ o Dea bwɛjen Saayɔn, dɛ do Jerusalam waa ɛ o dem la.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Korowii jaama yel Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii o wer.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii waa ɡwaa voɡa bwa.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Hé kpɔ jam tɛ kpeɡnɛra bwa dɔɔ.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O ɡboo dɛɛ ɛ wejena aa ɛ nyokpoa.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O cheɡɛ o wejema ta dɛ ta nyundua.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Onee ta harɛ o chɔŋɛ neerare sie.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Onee ta wee ne korobie.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O ɡelɔ wee ɛɛ chaah webaŋa.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korobie ne weweela ɡe ɛɛ chaah jwaana.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Onee kpoo Ijipt harɛ bibanloɡla.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O tɔ Israel tena sie le Ijipt harɛ.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O kpeɡri nee o lɛɛ ba.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Onee ɡela Mposwɛm pere anɛ.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Asɛ o tɔ Israel tena sie ba valɛ o bini le.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Kɛ o ɡelɔ Ijipt kooro ne o dɔm ka nee ta.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Onee tɔ o nɛra sie ba kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Onee kpoo koranar baa kpeɡa kohona.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Asɛ dɛ kpoo koranar baa lɛ sɔn.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O kpo Amɔre tena Kooro Sihon.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O kpo Basan tena Kooro Ɔɡ.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O kpɔ ba harɛre tɛ o nɛra.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O kpɔɔ tɛ Israel tena baa ɛ o bonɔɔna.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Onee lii ya waa dɛ na ya sum, ɡɛ saŋ yaa lɔ wahala ta.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O lɛ yaa le ya dɔma nɔn ta.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Onee dɛɛ tɛ hweera kwaa bwa kondikwa aa di.
O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua O nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Baa lawɛ Israel tena kaa harɛfale ta wiile Ya soɡe Babelɔn harɛ neerare nyoo, belaa ya lii Saayɔn waa dɛ wi.
Belaa ya kpɔ ya janjelare saɡɛ daa ta, dɛ ɡel a lɔe.
Nɛra baa lawɛ yaa la ŋɔ yá ɡo yela, ba ŋɔ yá ɡo yela lɛ ba sie ŋɔ, “Hé ɡo yela aa dɛ baɡle Saayɔn waa ya no.” Yaa lɔ harɛfale ta nɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona ɡo yela tɛ Korowii ɔ?
Jerusalam, dɛ n soh he wa aa, Korowii ɡel n bɛ won kpɔ nɔn lɔ janjela kpa.
Dɛ n ta he waa liire kɛŋɔ henee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ silɛɛ kohona naa, Korowii ɡel n bɛ won ɡo yela kpa.
N Naa Korowii, lii waa Edom tena aa ɛa awola Babelɔn tena aa pɔ Jerusalam tena nɛɛ la.
Ba do lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Hé kuuɡu, ó bwa chɔ harɛ.” Babelɔn tena, ɡɛ haa kpɔa ɛ yaa nɔ, Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ nɛra baa bá bɔ heya a kem.
Nɛra baa bá lawɛ he bechasɔɔhne, dɛ́ kpɔ ba cha bwea la, Korowii swee ba andɛɛɡa.
Korowii jaama wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ kpɛɛre n bambile bwa nee, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛre voɡa sie.
Mɛɛ kpɔ sie pa he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la taa, dɛ́ ba harɛ dɛɛ kpɛɛre, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ne kasinteŋ dɔe la wa.
Dɛkalkɛ he sɔn ne waa haa ŋɔa hɛɛ ɛo kan ɡwaa komɛlbwa.
Maa wia noe la, he noɔ dɛ chaŋ mɛ, he cheɡɛ he kpeɡri ta dɛ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa.
N Naa Korowii, koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ɛɛ kpɛɛree, dɛkalkɛ ba no waa haa bola.
Baa kpɔ waa haa ɛa laanee ɡo yela, dɛkalkɛ he jirima kan kohona.
A lole kɛŋɔ he lɔ nyundujaɡla dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛŋɡwɛɡra nɛ, kɛ mbarafo tena te, he dɛ na ba.
N ba dɛ na wahala kohona naa, henee kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ n nɛ.
He dɛ yo n dɔma ba baah aa di n nɛ, dɛ che he kpeɡri ta dɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, hɛɛ ɛ waa haa baɡ mɛ nyoa laanee.
He nyina haa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, anomanta, bɛ he ɡbaɡba nɛra haa ta yaa la vɛh.
Korowii wejema ne nɔn kpɔe dɛ́ tɔ nɛra nɛ Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, he pese mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ jemɛ n wobɛlbwa.
He jemɛ n harɛ soɡa ne n ira dɛ che bwa bini, n ne he baah jaŋne kwaraa naa, he jemɛ n nyu bini liire bwa.
Dɛ n chɔɔ kɛɛ n iro dɛ valɛ dɛɛ kaa laa, he te jemɛ anɔ la maa dɛ ɛ bwa.
Mɔɔ n pili nyoa dɛ́ bol waa la, dɛ he jemɛ waa maa bol bwa.
He lɔ n sie dɛ do n habɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ n nɛɛ he kpeɡri ne.
Gɛ haa jemɛ n waa la kpo n nyoa kohona, maa wone dɛɛ no a mun.
Leperaa n kpɔ haa wola men na nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona chwa le he sie nɔ?
N la nyundua aa, he lɔ bela, n kaa chɔ lalabwɛɛ kwaraa naa, he lɔ bela.
N iro kaa bojaŋ wee leebɔr, kɛɛ dɛ ka so bojaŋ wee cholibɔr kwaraa naa, he lɔ bela dɛ tɔ n sie he kpeɡri ne dɛɛ cha mɛ.
N ŋɔ ń ka sɔh biro ta ó tɔ n nɛ, kɛɛ bɔr waa chaahna bar mɛ la bir tɔ n nɛ, kɛŋɔ jwaana aa, biro ta komɛl waa won tɔ waa ta he be, jwaana do kɛŋɔ webaŋa he be, dɛkalkɛ biro ne bochaah bwa beŋkpoŋ.
Henee ta n bwa, dɛ ta mɛ pɛ n nya tea bini.
N dɛ kpɛɛre, he we-ɛɛla haa cheɡɛ a ta dɛ ta mɛ la bwa ɔma, dɛ dɔ nyokpoa kohona.
N jemɛ a bwa kɛrɛdɛ ken.
Haa ta n hoɡa dɛɛ pɛ kɛrɛdɛ ken n nya tea bini n sɔh bela dɛɛ kpeɡ la, dɛ he jemɛ n wa.
He na ɡɛ maa doa mɔɔ ba lol mɛ.
He chwerɛ tɔpera maa di harɛ ta do he tɔn bini mɔɔ a bɛlbwa pa mun.
N Naa Korowii, he liire kan maa wola won jemɛ!
A kan, a ɡwaa n liire!
N ŋɔ n kura aa, a ɡwaa mpo nyoa hɛŋle.
N chɔɔ dɛ har kwaraa naa, n ne henee ta.
N Naa Korowii, n dɛ nyin kɛ he fe aa kpoo nyubinikpeɡ tena!
N dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra fee ɡel mɛ, ásɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ.
Ba dɛ bol he bwara wechɔɡe, dɛ bol waa dɛɛ chɔɡ he sɔn.
N Naa Korowii, n hah nɛra baa haeh!
N kii nɛra ba deŋne aa kpeɡa baa jo he nɛ!
N hah ba kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ n dɔma.
N Naa Korowii, pese mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ n liire, daah mɛ na, dɛ́ jemɛ n nyu bini.
Nyiŋi dɛ na kɛ wechɔɡa ane lɔ n bini, dɛɛ tɔ n sie ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta, saŋ bɛlbwa.
Nɔn kpɔe dɛ́ tɔ nɛn nɛɛ wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ le nɛnchɔɡa nɔn ta, lɛɛ mɛ le naɡrenyine be.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa baa vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa, dɛɛ ba waa aa dɛ ir nɛra bambile baa yo tɔpere bɛlbwa ne.
Ba nyoa wobol dɛ kpo kɛ tɛɡchɔɡa ken, dɛ do kɛŋɔ domkpuli aa choɡe nɛn.
N Naa Korowii, kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.
Lɛɛ mɛ le naɡrenyine baa dɛ vɔrɔwe n chɔɡa vɔrɔwa be.
Mbarafo tena sɔɔh dɛ haɡre mɛ bela, ba kpɔa bil ŋwɛnɛ maa dɛ kpɔ o ta la ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔɔ mɛ lawɛ.
N ŋɔ n Naa Korowii be ŋɔ, “Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ.” No n wii dɛ́ cha mɛ!
Nemenɛ Korowii, he kpeɡri dɛɛ che n habɔɔ, henee tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe laa ta, bɛ ɡel nɛnchɔɡa dɔ ba tetoowa, bɛ ɡel ba vɔrɔwa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe maɡre, asɛ baa ɛ mbarafo a wa.
Bɛ ɡel n dɔma won pɔ n nɛ, ɡel ba aahra baa dɛ aah mɛ ɡure ba nyu ta.
Chure ninhɔla ta ba nɛ, ɡel ba taɡ ba do bɔluŋ bini baa wola won le kpa.
Bɛ ɡel nɛra baa teŋe nyosone dɛɛ dawɛ nɛra nɛɛ waa maɡre tɛɛ ba.
Gel waa pu naɡrenyine, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii bol nyaara waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛɛ lɛ ba nyoa.
Kasinteŋ, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la ɛɛ kpɛɛree, baa do he siee.
Jɔmɔra wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, n dɛ yerɛ, ba dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ warane.
No n wii maa dɛ wi, dɛ́ no n be.
No n wesoŋa kɛŋɔ daawiile baa dɛ fuah a sɔɔh do som.
Lɛ n nɔɔra maa ɡɔɔra dɛɛ soŋe nɔ, ɡɛ haa dɛ lɛ jɔmɔr saraha la.
N Naa Korowii, cha mɛ, mɛɛ nyiŋi wobol aa dɛ le n nyoaa.
Laa n bambile kpɔ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, bɛ ɡel n ja wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, kɛɛ n ne ba pɛ nɔn di ba silɛɛ kondikwa.
Gel nɛn o wa aa toɡra kah mɛ dɛ́ toɡ mɛ, nyina waa dɛ nyin mɛ wa.
Maa duure bɛlbwa nyin wechɔɡ-ɛɛra be, dɛkalkɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa mɛɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ ó chɔɡ ba wobɛlbwa.
Baa ba che bwejena dor dɛ́ taɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra sitɔɔla ta harɛ la, anee dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ n waa la ɛ kasinteŋ.
Baa boloo ŋɔ, “Gɛ ba yon buɡli harɛ la, ɡɛɛ ya hoɡa lɔ peɡre lalbɔɔ nyoa.” Kɛ hen Nemenɛ Korowii nɛɛ mɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, henee n chwa baa marɛ, bɛ ɡel n sewɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛ le bela baa har mɛ ta, wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bela nɔɔ n ŋɔ nɔ.
Gel ba ɡbaɡba lee bela baa hara ta, ásɛ n te valɛ ba kaa sɔnɔnɔɔ ken.
Chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N do lɔŋɔ yerɛ Korowii, n soŋo ŋɔ ó na n sum.
N kpɔ n waa bwa bil o sie, dɛ bol n wahala nae baɡlo.
Dɛ n bambile chɔɡɔ aa, onee dɛɛ baɡ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ.
N dɔma sɔɔh kpɔ bel harɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa dɛ kpɔ o ta la ta.
N keo nyiŋi na naa, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ cha mɛ.
N ta nɛn maa chwa ka sɔh o be dɔe, nomɛlbwa waane laa n nyu dɔe wa.
N Naa Korowii, n wio dɛɛ noe ŋɔ he cha mɛ, henee dɛ waa puu mɛ naa, n chwa baa marɛ harɛ nɔ ta.
Cheɡ deŋne no n wii, dɛkalkɛ n siwi beɡrɔ.
Lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ta, ba kpeɡri ɡwaa n nɛ.
Lee mɛ suna maa dɛ di nɔ ta, ásɛ n kpɛɛre he nɛra baa chema warɛ bini, he wer haa doa tɛ mɛ la wa.
Chae wesoŋa Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii, no n wesoŋa, che toɡra haa toɡra ta, dɛ́ na n sum.
Chaŋ mɛ he kasinteŋ haa dɔa la ne.
Bɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ daah na, nomɛlbwa toole o waa toɡre he sie.
N dɔma ti mɛ, dɛ lɔ mɛ bil harɛ, dɛ ɡel n do biro ta, kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa kaa biɡri ken.
Anomanta, n hwɛɡa bwa tonɔ tonɛ, n bambile bwa chɔɡɔ.
N lii tɔpera aa baa kaa la, dɛ lii toma haa ɛa bwa naa, n dɛ na we-ɛɛla haa ɛa bwa.
N ɡɔɔ nɔɔra dɛ wi dɛɛ noe, n bambile lawɛ kɛŋɔ harɛ hole aa hiah nee ken.
N Naa Korowii, chaŋ mɛ warane, dɛkalkɛ n hwɛɡa bwa tonɔ.
Bɛ sie laa kpɔ n nɛ, ɡɛ laa aa, mɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa kaa lalabwɛɛ ken.
Dɛɛ lii mɛ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la chɔɔ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ he nɛɛ n kpɔ n te dawɛ.
Henee n wi dɛɛ no, baɡ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa kpɔ o ta.
N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ta, dɛkalkɛ he bee n chwa baa sɔh.
Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ.
Baɡ mɛ mɛɛ ɛ waa haa dɛ nyin.
Nyiŋi n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡel mɛɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta.
N Naa Korowii, lɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la, che he toɡra haa toɡra ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale ta.
Koh nyina haa dɛ nyin mɛ la wa, dɛ́ kpoo n dɔma, dɛ́ chɔɡ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ mɛ bwa, dɛkalkɛ n ɛ he bonɔɔ.
Kooro dɔma nɛɛ pɔe jaama Kooro Devid yel N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, onee do kɛ Bwetal, n chwa baa marɔ.
Onee chaɡ mɛ n jemɛ laa yoi.
Onee Korowii waa do kɛ danjwɛjen, dɛɛ nyin n waa n chwa baa marɔ.
Onee dɛɛ tɔ n nɛ, dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe, n chwa baa sɔh o lɔɡa.
O ba harɛre nɛra ne harɛ, asɛ ba do n lɔɡa.
N Naa Korowii, nɛwɛnyina ɡee bɔkwa, hɛɛ lii ba waɔ?
Ba ɡee bɔkwa, hɛɛ dawɛ ba waɔ?
Ba do kɛ nyoa peu, ba tɔpera do kɛ lileo ken, tama dɛ ba nyoɡrɔ.
N Naa Korowii, forɛ le nyundua, dɛ́ tu ba harɛ.
Kpɔ nɔn leɡe bwejena, dɛ́ ɡel chuu le a ta.
Gel bwaala nyɛɡle, dɛ́ lɔ he dɔma peɡre.
Ta he hɛma do ba bini, bá chwa kaa.
Le nyundua tɛr nɔn, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le suna maa dɛ di nɔ ta.
Lɛɛ mɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa dɛ yoo mɛ nɔn ta.
Nyosone ɡboo su ba nyoo, hale ba ŋwɛɛ dɛɛ ja ba nyosone ta.
N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ ɡo yelfalee tɛɛ, mɛɛ kpɔ janjelaa lɔ yela kpɛɛre.
Henee ɡela Israel koranar yo dɛɛ pɔ ba dɔma nɛ, dɛ lɛ he bonɔɔ Kooro Devid le seo nyoa.
Lɛɛ mɛ le nɛŋhɔɔhra baa dɛ yoo mɛ nɔn ta, nyosone ɡboo su ba nyoo, hale ba ŋwɛɛ dɛɛ ja ba nyosone ta.
Gel ya bibaala bonɔɔne saŋ do kɛŋɔ daa baa nyiŋi a ta kɛrɛdɛ, á kpeɡ dɛ́ do kpeɡri.
Gel ya bihaahna ɡe do kɛŋɔ pilare baa paaɡa koodem, a ɡel o do o wer la.
Gel koo kondikwaare bwa soo siwi su ya dɔndɔŋre bini.
Gel ya peera ya kaɡboŋa, hale kaɡboŋa fifi.
Gel ya nae loɡle, dɛ́ ya kohona dɛ bɛ a bii har dɛɛ ta.
Bɛ ɡel wii ne suna dii do ya fɔɡbaahna.
Nɛra baa dɔ a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba na som.
Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la, ba na som!
Korowii kpɛɛra yel Kooro Devid yel N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, ne n kooro, mɛɛ jaame saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.
Tɔpere bɛlbwaa mɛɛ ba he kpɛɛra.
Mɛɛ kpɛɛre saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.
N Naa Korowii, he kan dɛ chɛ kpɛɛra.
He kan haa doa ɡwaa nɛwɛnyina liire ta.
Fini bii ɛɛ baɡle waa haa ɛa baɡle kerekere biirii, baa bol he wejena haa ɛa waa.
Baa bol he jirima, ne nyɛl ne kpeɡri haa doa waa.
Mɛɛ lii nyokpowaa haa ɛa la waa.
Baa bol he kpeɡri ne he we-ɛɛla aa do ɔma kohona waa, ásɛ n bol he kan haa doa wa.
Baa bol he wer haa doa waa bwaa, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛ he suna haa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ kohona wa.
N Naa Korowii, he dɛ nyin yaa dɛ dɔ tedoma, he baah aa di warawara, he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ɡe do kan.
He wer tɛ nomɛlbwa, dɛ dɔ tedoma tɛ kwaa haa taa bwa.
N Naa Korowii, kwaa haa taa bwa ɛɛ kpɛɛree, ásɛ he nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa ɡe kpɛɛre.
Baa bol jirima he kora aa dɔa waa, dɛ́ bol kan haa doa wa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa jemɛ he wejena haa dɛ ɛ, ne jirima he kora aa dɔa wa.
He kora dii ta jaɡa dɔe, hɛɛ di koraa saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.
N Naa Korowii, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ hɛɛ teŋɛ he nyobaɡa ta, dɛ dɔ nyina tɛ kwaa haa taa bwa.
He lawɛ nɛra baa chola dɛɛ ir, dɛɛ cha banɔ la wenaale aa lɔ ba nɛ.
Kwaa haa taa bwa sie dawɛ he nɛ, hɛɛ tɛa kondikwaa saŋ aa chɛa ta.
He ta tea dɛɛ tɛa kohona, bɛlbwa dɔ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin.
N Naa Korowii, waa haa dɛ ɛ bwa toɡrɔ, he dɛ nyin he kontaala bwa.
He bɛne banɔ la baa dɛ yerɛ bwa, nɛra baa dɛ yerɛ kasinteŋ ne la.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ la, he dɛ tɛɛ ba ba konnyina, dɛ no ba wii dɛɛ lɛɛ ba.
Nɛra baa dɛ nyin he waa la, he kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ, kɛ nɛnchɔɡa te, hɛɛ chɔɡ baa.
Mɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii saŋ bɛlbwaa.
Korowii kontaala bwa, hé kpɛɛ o sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ kpɛɛra Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
N wee, kpɛɛ Korowii!
Mɛɛ kpɛɛro n soɡa bini bwaa, dɛ́ ɡo yela ɡe kpɛɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Bɛ he te kpɔ dawɛ koranar kɛɛ sitɔɔ bɛlbwa nɛ, nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa aa won lɛɛ.
Ba sewɔ aa, ba dɛ huɡ ba.
Le awola tɔpere la, ba liire ne vɔrɔwa baa vɔrɔwa bwa dɛ ba a jaɡa.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ hwɛɡa do Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ nɛɛ wɛɛ chao la, o na som.
Korowiirii ta nyundua ne harɛ, mpo ne kwaa aa lɔ a ta bwa.
O dɛ teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta saŋ bɛlbwa.
O bol nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, nɛra lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba ɡe, o dɛ tɛɛ ba kondikwa.
O ɡelɔ nɛra baa laɡ ba do dea ɛɛ di ba nyu, dɛ ɡel nyoŋa berɛ dɛɛ na.
O lawɛ nɛra baa chola dɛɛ ir, o dɛ nyin nɛra ba wa aa toɡra wa.
O kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ hɔɔhra baa soɡe ya harɛ ta nɛ, dɛɛ cha luhaahna ne bilalbii.
Kɛ nɛnchɔɡa te, o dɛ chɔɡ vɔrɔwa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe.
Korowii waa dɛ di kora Saayɔn, ɛɛ di koraa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Nemenɛ Korowii kpɛɛra Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
A wer kɛ yá ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, a dɔ silɛɛ dɛ chɛ kɛ yá kpɛɛro.
Korowii berɔ kwaa ma Jerusalam, dɛ lawɛ Israel tena baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfala ta la ba.
O ɡelɔ nɛra ba bambile aa chɔɡa dɔ bolarawa, dɛ vɔrɔwe ba ŋwɛra.
Onee ta weweela dɛ jemɛ a nyoa, dɛ pa bɛlbwa sɔn.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ kan, dɛɛ di kpeɡri kohona, o wejema ɡe ta jaɡa dɔe.
O dɛ cha nɛŋɡwɛɡra, kɛ nɛnchɔɡa te, o dɛ lɔ ba harɛ.
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, hé kpɔ janjela lɔ yela tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ.
Onee kpɔ baama tɔ nyundua bwa, dɛ ɡel bwaala ɛɛ nɛ harɛ ta, kpɔɡa ɡe ɛɛ moɡɛ deŋɡarere ta.
Onee dɛɛ tɛ ola kondikwa, dɛɛ tɛ ɡaahɡaah bii lɔr aa dɛ kpoa kondikwa aa di.
O sie aa jaɡre a bwara aa kpeɡa, kɛɛ banyoola nɛɛ lɛ, o sie dɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɔ, ne nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛ, ne o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta.
Nɛra haa lɔ Jerusalam, hé kpɛɛ Korowii.
Saayɔn tena, hé kpɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ!
Onee ɡela bune baa kpɔa dɛɛ karɛ he ɡbeni do kpeɡri, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ he nɛra baa soɡe he bini.
Onee tɛ heyaa deŋnesɔɔhna he harɛ jwɛhre ta, asɛ dɛ tɛ heyaa mea aa do wer.
O bol waa harɛ nɔ ta tena be naa, ba dɛ ɛa wɔrɔbe nɛ.
O nɛ dombwea perɛ kɛŋɔ baa paɡri bombo, dɛ ɡel mɛn ta kɛŋɔ tɔɔ ken.
O ɡelɔ dombwea lee kɛŋɔ bwea ken.
Umee dɛ́ won che dombwea la sɔne nyoa ɔ?
O bol waa asɛ dombwea la mwɛɛ, dɛ ta peu a nee la palɛ.
O pili o Mmarare ne o waa bini chaɡle Jekɔb naanar baa ɛ o nɛra Israel tena la.
O ta anɔ ɛɛ tɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra, baa o Mmarare jemɛ.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Korowii kontaala bwa, hé kpɛɛro!
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
He kpɛɛ Korowii le nyundua, kwaa haa lɔ o be nyundua la.
Nyundua toroma, hé kpɛɛro, Korowii dɔm haa wara dɛ do o be nyundua bwa, hé kpɛɛro.
Wee ne korobie bwa, hé kpɛɛro, weweela aa dɛ chaah bwa, hé kpɛɛro.
Nyundujaɡla ne neerare aa lɔ bela bwa, hé kpɛɛro.
Á bwa kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o nyoa wobol taa o che taa.
O nyoa wobol nee o cheɡa a chebɔra, a do le saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ ɡel a do le ɡɛ dɛɛ la, aa wola won charɛ.
Harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ne mpo bini oljena ne mpo vile bwa, hé kpɛɛro.
Bwaala nyɛɡla ne dombwea, ne baama dɛ peukpeɡa aa dɛ no o be, bwejena ne deŋɡarere, ne daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ, dɛ peleme daa bwa, ne kpɔɡ bini ola ne nae, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne kwaa aa dɛ huuh, dɛ jumbii bwa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Koranar ne harɛre nɛra bwa, nomonome ne sitɔɔla bwa, ne bonɔɔna ne toli, ne banjeni ne hanjeni, dɛ bechale ɡe bwa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii.
Hé bwa kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o sɔn laanee kana ɡwaa sɔn bɛlbwa, o jirima ɡwaa nyundua ne harɛ.
O ɡelɔ o nɛra Israel tena ba waa aa toɡra, waa do o bambile ta kohona, ásɛ ba bwa kpɛɛro.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Korowii kpɛɛra yel Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Hé ɡo yelfale tɛ Korowii!
Hé kpɛɛro bela o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra aa wara dɛ cheme!
Israel tena, hé ɡel he sie lɛ he hɛɡre, Korowii waa ta heyaa la wa.
Saayɔn tena, hé hɛɡre he kooro wa!
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro dɛɛ sa, hé lɔ ɡboŋri ne janjela kpɛɛro.
Korowii sie dɛ lɛ o nɛra nɛ, dɛɛ cha nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te, dɛ ɡel baa pɔ ba dɔma nɛ.
Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la hɛɡre, dɛ́ ɡo silɛɛ yela jwaana bwa, pɔe baa pɔ ba dɔma nɛɛ wa.
Bá do lɔŋɔre dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpoŋe tokobijen sie anɛ te waa nyɛɡa, dɛ́ pɔ harɛre nɛra nɛɛ, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne.
Bá vɔrɔwe ba koranar jɔɡrɔre ne, dɛ́ do kwaa ba nomonjena nakpale.
Bá tɛr harɛre nɛra la deŋne, ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.
Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa jirimaa la.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii o Dea bela!
Hé kpɛɛro, o kpeɡri waa dɔa nyundua wa!
Hé kpɛɛro o wejena waa ɛa wa.
Hé kpɛɛro o kan waa doa kohona ɡwaa komɛlbwa wa.
Hé hoh bɛle kpɛɛro, dɛ́ lɔ janjela ne kwaa bwa soo siwi kpɛɛro.
Hé yiiɡi loŋa kpɛɛro dɛɛ sa.
Hé lɔ janjela, dɛ́ hoh kalipere kpɛɛro.
Hé lɔ ɡboŋri kpɛɛro.
Hé kpɔ ayaawa kwaa anɛ dɛ́ɛ lɔ dɔŋa, dɛ́ɛ hɛlɛ kohona.
Korowii kontaala aa dɛ hwee bwa, hé kpɛɛro!
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Mosis Tɔne anue la wa Tɔne anue aa tɔ sie Korowii Tɔn bini la, ba dɛ yera Mosis Tɔne.
A ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ onee chwerɛ a bwa, kɛ a dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ o Mmara tɛo, asɛ o che Korowii ne o nɛra baah ta, Korowii ɛ waa ba bini saŋ la.
Komɛlbwa Mumpar Tɔn Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Komɛlbwa Mumpar Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa pa wobɛlbwa mun.
O dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa ta harɛ ne nyundua, ne koŋkwaa dɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa.
O dɛ baɡle ɡɛ wechɔɡa aa ɡela wobɛlbwa chɔɡ, ne ɡɛ Korowii aa ɛ o liire, dɛ́ kwaa wahala ne wechɔɡa aa ɡela nɛwɛnyina ne Korowii baah do jaŋne.
Nyuune — dɛ baɡle ya naa Adam ne Hawa, ne Keen ne Ebel, ne Nowa ne dakajen la dɛ Babelɔn Dejaŋ wa.
Nyuune kabora —, dɛ baɡle Korowii nyoa waa baɡa dɛ swee Abraham ne o naanar, ne ɡɛ waa ɛ Israel nabaala kɛŋɔ Aesek ne Jekɔb dɛ Josef.
O berɔ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta, hale dɛ a kpeɡri kɛŋɔ o nyobaɡa la aa won ɛ ɡɛ waa baɡla la kwara noo.
Gɛ Korowii aa ta komɛlbwa Komɛlbwa mumpar la, Korowii ta nyundua ne harɛ.
A ɡɛ saŋ la dɛ harɛ ta mar dɔe, dɛ komɛlbwa toole o ta.
Dɛ nee tɔ komɛlbwa ta asɛ bɔr bir kpirkpir ken, asɛ Korowii Doma do nee la sie dɛ la dɛɛ ba.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ, <<Bɔ́r chaah.>> Asɛ bɔr chaah.
O na bochaah la kɛŋɔ o wer.
Asɛ o pere bochaah la le biro la bini, dɛ pa bochaah la sɔn <bɔrchaahna> asɛ dɛ pa biro la ɡe sɔn <bɔrjoe>.
Asɛ bɔr jo dɛ chaah.
Onee tɔpere waa tɔ sie.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, <<Née la pere anɛ ásɛ ane kaa nyundua ásɛ ane ka harɛ.>> Gɛɛ Korowii ta bɔr nyundua dɛ pere nee la, ane kaa nyundua ane ɡe ka harɛ.
Asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ.
Asɛ o pa bɔr waa chɔ a baah ta la sɔn <nyundua>.
Asɛ bɔr jo dɛ chaah.
Onee tɔpere waa teŋa nɛɛ.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ, <<Née la aa ka harɛ la ka chɔ bobeŋkpoŋ ásɛ a ka harɛpɛɛ chɔ.>> Asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ.
Asɛ o pa harɛpɛɛ la sɔn <harɛ>, dɛ pa nee la aa chɔ bobeŋkpoŋ la ɡe sɔn <mpo>, dɛ na kɛŋɔ a wer.
Dɛ ŋɔ, <<Hárɛ pɛɛ la le kpɔɡa ne daa bwa soo siwi.
Anɔ la aa dɛ ɛ bie ne daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ dɛ dɔ bie a bini bwa.>> Asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ.
Harɛpɛɛ la le kpɔɡa ne daa bwa soo siwi.
Anɔ la aa dɛ ɛ bie ne daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ dɛ dɔ bie a bini bwa.
Asɛ Korowii na kɛŋɔ a wer.
Asɛ bɔr jo dɛ chaah, onee tɔpere waa teŋa tooro.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, <<Kwáa chaah nyundua dɛ́ korɛ webaŋa le jwaana ta, dɛ́ baɡle tɔpera ne bene ne saŋ bɛla dɛ́ɛ chaah nyundua ne harɛ bwa.>> Asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ.
Korowii ta konjena anɛ aa chaah.
Anee wee ne korobie.
Wee la kan dɛɛ chaah kohona bɔr chaahna saŋ, asɛ korobie waa do jeɡa la ɡe ɛɛ chaah jwaana.
O ta weweela ɡe.
O kpɔ ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwa do nyundua asɛ aa chaah harɛ, bɛl dɛ ɛ toma jwaana bɛl ɡee ɛ toma bɔr chaahna saŋ, dɛ pere biro le bochaah ta.
Asɛ Korowii na kɛŋɔ a wer.
Asɛ bɔr jo dɛ chaah, onee tɔpere waa teŋa naarɛ.
O berɔ ŋɔ, <<Pɛ́ŋa ne nee bini koŋkwaa su nee la ta pirim ásɛ jumbii ne koŋɡaahla do nyundua dɛɛ ɡah.>> Korowii ta mpo bini oljena ne koŋkwaa bwa aa lɔ nee bini pirim, ne jumbii ne koŋɡaahla ɡɛ a bwa soo siwi aa doa.
Asɛ o na kɛŋɔ a wer.
Asɛ Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛa dɛ ŋɔ, <<Hé loɡle dɛ́ warɛ dɛ su neerare ne mpo, ásɛ jumbii la ɡe loɡle dɛ́ su harɛ.>> Asɛ bɔr jo dɛ chaah, onee tɔpere waa teŋa nue.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, <<Hweera kwaa bwa soo siwi ba harɛ ta, kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa, ne kondɛɛra ne anɔ la aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, a bwa ne a soo siwi.>> Asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ.
Korowii ta a bini bɛlbwa soo siwi.
Waa na kwaa waa taa la, o nao kɛŋɔ a wer.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ, <<Yá ta nɛwɛnyina bá do kɛ yan, dɛ́ɛ di kpeɡri pɛŋa ne jumbii ne kondɛɛra ne kpɔɡ bini ola, anjena ne anjeɡre, dɛ hweera kwaa aa dɛ huuh dɛɛ tuuɡi tea ta bwa nɛ.>> Anomanta, o ta nɛwɛnyina, ɡɛ tenten waa doa laanee o ta ba.
Baa ne haahnee o ta.
Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba dɛ ŋɔ, <<Hé loɡle dɛ́ su harɛ ta pirim, ásɛ dɛɛ di kpeɡri pɛŋa aa lɔ mpo ta, ne jumbii ne koŋɡaahla aa lɔ nyundua, dɛ hweera kwaa aa dɛ huuh dɛɛ tuuɡi tea ta bwa nɛ.>> Dɛ ŋɔ, <<N tɛ heyaa kwaa aa dɛ ɛ bie ne daa aa nɔnɛ, dɛ dɔ bie a bini bwa soo siwi harɛ nɔ bwa ta, ásɛ a ɛ kondikwaa tɛ heya, dɛ kpɔ kpɔɡa ne papooni dɛ tɛ ola ne jumbii, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, dɛ hweera kon te bɛlbwa ásɛ a ɛ a kondikwa.>> Asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Korowii nyiŋi kwaa waa taa la bwa dɛ na kɛŋɔ a bwa wer kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ bɔr jo dɛ chaah, onee tɔpere waa teŋa numɛl.
Gɛɛ a do Korowii ta nyundua ne harɛ, ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ a ta dɛ tonɛ.
Tɔpenuanɛ te ne tela la, dɛ o tonɛ o toma bwa.
Anomanta, o onɔ tɔpenuanɛ te la ta.
Anomanta, o le tɔpenuanɛ la cheɡ tɛ o te, o do ɡoroŋ dɛ sweero andɛɛɡa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o taa o ɡel toma ɛɛ kwaa waa taa la bwa ta.
Baa ne haah Korowii aa kpɔ ba do Eden bodɛɛɡe wa Kenii Korowii ta nyundua ne harɛ.
Korowii aa ta nyundua ne harɛ la, dɛ konduula ne kpɔɡa ta harɛ la ta leɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o ta ɡelɛ bwaala nɛ o ta mɔɔ.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe toole dɛ́ parɛ harɛ la.
Nee yon le harɛ bini dɛɛ sɔɔh harɛ la.
Asɛ Korowii kpɔ teera ma baa, dɛ hwee do o mebɔɔne bini, o dɔ mkpa dɛ so.
A habɔɔ la, Korowii du daa bodɛɛɡe bobɛl baa yerɔ Eden wee leebɔr, dɛ kpɔ baa waa tao la ka so bela.
O ɡelɔ daa bwa soo siwi le bela dɛ do wer siwi ta a nɔna dɔ pɛla kɛŋɔ nɛn di.
Daa anɛ ane cheɡɛ konduula la baah ta.
Bɛl dɛ tɛ mkpa, bɛl ɡe ɡel nɛn ɛɛ jemɛ wedɛɛɡa ne anchɔɡa.
Moo bɛl nyu le Eden bodɛɛɡe bela dɛ palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ daa la baah dɛɛ sɔɔh harɛ la.
Waa le bela la, o peɡri bɔre anaarɛ.
O kpale waa tɔ sie la sɔne Pesɔn Moo.
O palɔ dɛ ɡoli kpɔ Havila harɛ ta bela suuɡaswɛm aa lole.
Suuɡaswɛm tenten ne bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, ne konsɔɔhsoma a sɔɔh aa soma lɔ bela.
O kpal nɛɛte la sɔne Gehɔn Moo.
O palɔ dɛ ɡoli kpɔ Kus harɛ ta.
O kpal toorote la sɔne Tiɡris Moo.
O palɔ dɛɛ kaa Asiiria harɛ wee leebɔr pera.
Asɛ naarɛte la sɔne Yufretis Moo.
Korowii kpɔ baa waa tao la ka so Eden bodɛɛɡe bela waa du daa la dɛ ŋɔ, wɛ́ɛ parɛ o ta dɛɛ nyiŋi bela, asɛ dɛ jao ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ wonoo di daa la bɛlbwa sese nɔn.
Kɛ bɛ onɔ la waa dɛ tɛ liire dɛ́ ɡel nɛn jemɛ wedɛɛɡa ne anchɔɡa la te nɔn di.
Awola haa di a ɡɛ daa la nɔn la bɛl la, sewaa hɛɛ ba sewa.” Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Aa were kɛŋɔ baa la ɡbo so.
Mɛɛ kwaa o dɔŋee ja o nɛ, ásɛ wɛɛ chao.” Ate, o kpɔ teera dɛ ma ola ne jumbii.
Asɛ dɛ kpɔ a bwa ba baa la be dɛ ŋɔ ó paa sɔna.
Gɛ waa yerɛ kon la bɛlbwa la, o sɔnee.
Baa la pa kpɔɡ bini ola, kondɛɛra ne jumbii bwa sɔna.
Kɛ dɛ o te ta o dɔŋ waa chao dɔe ja o nɛ.
Anomanta, o ɡelɔ baa la chɔ dom ka ɡarɛ, o laa o kuɡlambi beŋkpoŋ kpɔ dɛ kpɔ ol tɔ bela.
O kuɡlambi la waa kpɔa la, o kpɔɔ ka kwaa haah dɛ kpɔ ba tɛ baa la.
Asɛ baa la ŋɔ, “Yɔɔ!
Taraken te, n ɡbaɡba hoɡ ne n bo-ol tentenee nɔ.
O sɔne ‘haah’.
Baa binii o le.” A waa ɡela baa yon ɡel o nya ne mɛɛ, dɛ́ ka kpɔ haah ba yon pɛ so, dɛ́ ɛ beŋkpoŋ la.
Dɛ baa la ne o haah la bwa dɛ valɛ mumɡbal, kɛ dɛ sihiih aa ban kpo.
Nɛwɛnyina deŋnekpeɡ wa Ola Korowii aa taa la bini la, dɛ harɛkon sie pilo ɡwaa a bwa.
Harɛkon la baa pɛɛ haah la ŋɔ, “Kpelaa Korowii ŋɔ he bɛ daa nɔ bɛlbwa nɔn di naa?” Asɛ haah la chaŋo ŋɔ, “Dɛ́ ya won daa nɔ bɛlbwa nɔn dii.
Atane kɛŋɔ onɔ waa cheɡɛ bodɛɛɡe baa du daa nɔ baah tenten nɔ, Korowii ŋɔ ya bɛ o te leɡe a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ yaa di o nɔnee.
Ya diu waa, yaa sewɔɔ.” Belaa harɛkon la ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “Nyosonee.
Háa sewa ba.
Korowii jemɔ kɛŋɔ dɛ he di daa la nɔn aa, he sie dɛ ba pila, he jemɛ wedɛɛɡa ne anchɔɡa kɛ on ken.
A waa o ŋɔ he bɛ di la.” Dɛ haah la nao kɛŋɔ daa la nɔn la ɡe wer siwi ta dɛ do wer ne dii, dɛɛ tɛ wejema ɡe ja.
Anomanta, o haŋrɔ kahonɛ dɛ cha ane di, dɛ kpɔ ane ka tɛ o jaa ɡe o di.
Baa dia tonɛ la, buɡ la ta, ba bwa sie pilo, ba na kɛŋɔ ba cheɡɛ mumɡbal.
Anomanta, ba nyin ɔɡ papooni dɛ nyara dɛ kpɔ li.
Awola jɔmɔra ne la, ba noɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ valɛ bodɛɛɡe baa du daa la bini, asɛ ba chwa ka sɔh baŋ pera daa la bini ásɛ o bɛ ban na.
Anee Korowii yerɛ baa la ŋɔ, “Lee he dɔɔ?” O sɛh dɛ ŋɔ, “N no he ɡbɔɡa daa la baah ta bela, asɛ n ɔmɛ dɛ ka sɔh dɛkalkɛ n cheɡɛ mumɡbal.” Anee Korowii pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Umee ŋɔ he be ŋɔ he cheɡɛ mumɡbal ɔ?
He di daa la maa kaeh ŋɔ he bɛ o nɔn di la kɛɛ?” Asɛ baa la ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh.
Haah la haa kpɔɔ ja n nɛɛ la, onee tɛ mɛ bɛl n di.” Belaa Korowii pɛɛ haah la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Harɛkon laanee neɡ mɛ asɛ n di.” Korowii taah baa ne haah dɛ harɛkon Belaa Korowii ŋɔ harɛkon la be ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa ɛa nɔ nomanta, N taahne, ásɛ a do kpeɡri tɛɛ ɡwaa kpɔɡ bini ola ne kondɛɛra bwa.
He tea taa hɛɛ ba tuuɡa, dɛɛ di teera ka tel he serewe bena.
Mɛɛ kpɔ danchɔɡee ta he ne haah la baah ta, ásɛ he naanar ne o naanar hah dɔŋa dɛɛ la.
Saŋ bɛlbwa waa nae la, wɛɛ paɡre he nyuu, ásɛ he ɡe choɡe o nalume.” Korowii ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “Weweele binii hɛɛ ba tea kpoŋa, dɛ́ lolɛ bonyɛɡa bini.
He sie ɛɛ beɡre he jaa nɛɛ, ásɛ o di kpeɡri he nɛ.” Dɛ ŋɔ baa la be ŋɔ, “Haa no he haah nyoa dɛ di daa nɔn maa ŋɔa he bɛ di nomanta, N taah harɛ nɔ waa haa ɛa la wa, tomkpeɡaa hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ kwee bɔwɔb mɔɔ dɛ́ di kwa he soɡa bini bwa.
Sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛree dɛɛ ba harɛ la ta lee tɛɛ.
Ásɛ hɛɛ di kpɔɡ bini kondikwa.
Hɛɛ kwee bɔwɔbee mɔɔ dɛ́ di kwa ka tel kɛŋɔ haa berɛ kaa teera maa kpɔa mae la bini, dɛkalkɛ teera hen, teera binii he berɛ dɛɛ ba kaala.” Baa la sɔne Adam.
O pa haah la ɡe sɔn Hawa dɛkalkɛŋɔ on dɛɛ ba nɛwɛnyina bwa nya ɛɛ.
Korowii kpɔ ola tɔne tɛɛ ba ba kpɔ tɔ ba bwara.
Korowii doŋi Adam ne Hawa le Eden bodɛɛɡe bela Belaa Korowii lii kɛŋɔ, “Name baa la jemɛ wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa kɛŋɔ yan.
Yá nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ o bɛ daa waa dɛ tɛ mkpa la te nɔn ba tor di dɛ́ do le saŋ bɛlbwa.” Anomanta, Korowii doŋu le Eden bodɛɛɡe bela waa du daa la, dɛ ɡel o kaa parɛ harɛ waa mao le o ta la ta.
Waa doŋi baa la le bela habɔɔ la, o kpɔ Kerobim ne tokobii bɛl waa dɛ nyɛɡle kɛ ninlao dɛɛ beɡre bobɛlbwa, dɛ ka cheɡ Eden bodɛɛɡe wee leebɔr pera, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won di daa la nɔna.
Keen ne Ebel wa Adam la o haah Hawa be, asɛ o kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bie, asɛ haah la lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Korowii alaworomɛ, n dɔ bibaa, dɛ pa o sɔn Keen.” A habɔɔ, o lolɛ bɛl ɡe dɛ pa o sɔn Ebel.
Ebel aa kpeɡa la, dɛ peeraa wɛɛ dɛɛ asɛ Keen ɡe ɛ paa.
A habɔɔ la, Keen kpɔ o koo kondikwa ane ba, dɛ ba ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Asɛ Ebel ɡe nyiŋi o peera la bini dɛ lawɛ a biloɡla la dɛ kpoora, asɛ dɛ kpɔ a bodɛɛɡa bɔra la ka ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Korowii sie lɛ saraha Ebel aa baa ɛ tɛo la ta taeh, kɛ o vɛh Keen ne kwaa waa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha tɛo la.
Belaa Keen baah di asɛ o ŋweh.
Anee Korowii bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he baah di he ŋweh ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Wedɛɛɡaa he ɛa, he sie ɛɛ lɛo.
Kɛ haa ɛ anɔ la aa wola were la nomanta, wechɔɡa dɛ yoi.
Kɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé won le a ta.” Belaa Keen ŋɔ o nime Ebel be ŋɔ bá la koo.
Baa lɔ bela la, Ebel ne ŋɔ o jemɛ dɛ Keen lawɔ asɛ dɛ kpoo.
Belaa Korowii bɔɔ Keen ŋɔ, “Leperaa Ebel dɔɔ?” Anee Keen ŋɔ, “N nɔn ta laa n nime do mɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛ.
Maa jemɛ bela waa lole.” Asɛ Korowii berɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ waa aa do ken nɔɔ?
He nime chal aa le harɛ la ta la dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡa a chɛ kɛŋɔ ń bɔe a kem.
N taahne, dɛ doŋi le harɛ nɔ ta, haa won parɛ o ta kpa, he nime haa kpoo la nomanta.
He paraa, he kondikwa aa ɛɛ ba.
Haa soŋnibɔr ɡee dɔ.
Gaaɡa ɡboo hɛɛ ba dɛɛ ɡaaɡa.” Anee Keen ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “N wechɔɡa maa ɛa nɔ kembɔr ɡwaa n nɛɛ kohona to.
Na, he doŋ mɛ le he sie ne para ta.
Taraken nɔ, maa soŋnibɔree dɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa kpa.
Gaaɡa ɡboo mɛɛ ba mɛɛ ɡaaɡe, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa na mɛ la, ó kpo mɛ.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ laa, nomɛlbwa waa kpoe la, wɛɛ dɔ he wechɔɡa nɔ kembɔr nɔ bele anuanɛɛ.” Asɛ Korowii do Keen dema, ásɛ a baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii bɛ on kpo.
Belaa Keen le Korowii sie, dɛ ka so harɛ bɛl waa lɔ Eden wee leebɔr bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Nɔd.
Keen naanar wa A habɔɔ, Keen ne o haah kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Enɔk, asɛ dɛ vɔrɔwe bwɛjen dɛ kpɔ bie la sɔn pao.
Enɔk ɡe aa kpeɡa la, o lolɛ bie dɛ pa o sɔn Irad.
Irad aa baa kpeɡ la, o lolɛ Mahujael.
Asɛ Mahujael ɡe aa ira la, o lolɛ Metusael.
Asɛ Metusael ɡe aa baa kpeɡ la, o lolɛ Lamɛk.
Asɛ Lamɛk aa baa ir la, o mo haahna banɛ.
Bɛl sɔne Ada asɛ nɛɛte la ɡe sɔne Siila.
Ada bie waa lolɔ sɔne Jabal.
Onee nɛra baa tɔ sie dɛ yon so tɛnte deene bini dɛɛ nyiŋi kondɛɛra ta bwa naa.
A habɔɔ la, Ada berɔ lolɛ bibaa, o sɔne Jubal.
Onee nɛra baa tɔ sie kwaa bɛle ne janjelare la bwa naa.
Siila ɡe lolɛ bibaa, dɛ pa o sɔn Tubal Keen.
Onee ira dɛ pa mun loɡɛ.
Siila berɔ lolɛ bihaah, dɛ pa o sɔn Naama.
Awola bɛl, Lamɛk ŋɔ o haahna la be ŋɔ, “Ada ne Siila, hé cheɡ deŋne no n waa nɔ.
N haahna, hé no n be!
Bonɔɔ bɛl do mɛ bol, asɛ n kpoo.
Dɛ nɛn kpo Keen, wɛɛ dɔ o wechɔɡa kembɔr bele anuanɛɛ yaa, nomɛlbwa waa kpo mɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ n wechɔɡa kembɔr dɔŋa bele fifraanuanɛ dɛ anuanɛɛ.” Sɛt ne Enɔs wa Adam ne o haah berɔ lolɛ bibaa.
Anee o haah ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛ mɛ bie o ba chiɡ Ebel, Keen aa kpoo la naa ta.” Anomanta, o pa o sɔn Sɛt.
Sɛt ɡe aa baa ir la, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Enɔs.
Le a ɡɛ saŋee nɛwɛnyina pa mun dɛɛ yerɛ Korowii sɔn dɛɛ tomɔ.
Adam naanar wa Kenii Adam naanar teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Korowii aa ta nɛwɛnyina la, o ta ba ɡɛ o tenten aa doa.
Baa ne haahnee o ta, asɛ dɛ swee ba andɛɛɡa, dɛ yer ba “nɛwɛnyina.” Adam aa di bene lafa fifraatoro la, o lolɛ bibaa o le o ɡbaɡba, asɛ dɛ pa o sɔn Sɛt.
Sɛt lola habɔɔ la, o berɔ so bene lafraanuatoro, dɛ lolɛ o bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Bene lafraanuanaarɛ fifraatoroo Adam di dɛ sewɛ.
Sɛt aa baa kpeɡ dɛ di bene lafa dɛ anue la, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Enɔs, waa di bene lafraanuatoro dɛ anuanɛ la, o lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Waa sewa dɛ o di bene lafraanuanaarɛ dɛ fi dɛ anɛ.
Enɔs ɡe aa baa kpeɡ dɛ di bene fifraanuanaarɛ la, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Kenan.
A habɔɔ la, o berɔ di bene lafraanuatoro dɛ fi dɛ anue dɛ ɡe lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Waa baa sewɛ dɛ o di bene lafraanuanaarɛ dɛ anue.
Kenan ɡe aa baa kpeɡ dɛ di bene fifraanuanaarɛ la, o ɡe lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Mahalalel.
A habɔɔ la, o berɔ di bene lafraanuatoro fifraanaarɛ dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
O ɡe aa baa sewɛ dɛ o di bene lafraanuanaarɛ dɛ fi.
Mahalalel ɡe aa baa di bene fifraanumɛl dɛ anue la, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Jarɛd.
Jarɛd habɔɔ la, o berɔ di bene lafraanuatoro dɛ fifraatoro, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Waa baa sewɛ la, dɛ o di bene lafraanuatoro fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anue.
Jarɛd ɡe baa kpeɡ.
O bene lafa fifraanumɛl dɛ anɛ ta la, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Enɔk.
A habɔɔ la, o berɔ di bene lafraanuatoro dɛ ɡe lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Waa baa sewɛ la, dɛ o di bene lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanumɛl dɛ anɛ.
Enɔk ɡe aa baa kpeɡ dɛ di bene fifraanumɛl dɛ anue la, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Mɛtusala.
A habɔɔ la, o ne Korowii kpɔ darame bene lafraatoro dɛ lolɛ o bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Waa baa sewɛ la, dɛ o di bene lafraatoro fifraanumɛl dɛ anue.
Waa kpɔ Korowii darame dɛ biɡri o soɡa bini nomanta, Korowii baa kpɔɔ kaa o be nyundua.
Nomɛlbwa ta on nae kpa.
Mɛtusala ɡe aa baa kpeɡ dɛ di bene lafa fifraanuatoro dɛ anuanɛ la, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Lamɛk.
Lamɛk lola habɔɔ la, o berɔ di bene lafraanuanɛ fifraanuatoro dɛ anɛ, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Waa baa sewɛ la, dɛ o di bene lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanumɛl dɛ anuanaarɛ.
Lamɛk ɡe aa kpeɡa dɛ di bene lafa fifraanuatoro dɛ anɛ la, o lolɛ bibaa, dɛ pa o sɔn Nowa dɛ ŋɔ, “Bie nɔɔ dɛ́ ba tɛ yaa bosɔɔhna, dɛ́ lɛ yaa le Korowii taahna waa taah harɛ nɔ dɛ ɡel yaa koh ya tomare ta la ta.” A habɔɔ, Lamɛk berɔ di bene lafraanue fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anue, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Waa baa sewɛ la, dɛ o di bene lafraanuanɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ anuanɛ.
Nowa ɡe aa baa kpeɡ dɛ di bene lafraanue la, o lolɛ bibaala batoro, asɛ dɛ pa bɛl sɔn Sɛm, bɛl ɡe Ham, asɛ toorote la ɡe Jafɛt.
Nowa bere saŋ nee waa sua wa Nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ warɛ harɛ nɔ ta asɛ dɛɛ loɡle bihaahna la, belaa nyundua nɛra la aa naa kɛŋɔ harɛ nɛra la bihaahna la wer la, ba kpɔ ba bini bane mo, asɛ ba ne ba so.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Maa ɡel n Doma waa dɛ tɛ mkpa la do nɛwɛnyini bini saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Baa wonoo sewɛ.
Taraken, nɛn aa biɡra kwaraa la, anee bene lafa fifraanɛ ɡbo, dɛ o sewɔ.” A ɡɛ saŋ ne a habɔɔ bwa la, dɛ nɛra bane lole baa yer ba Nefilim dɛ do harɛ nɔ ta, ba kpeɡo kohona dɛ do kpeɡri.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛ harɛ nɛra la bihaahna baa lol ba ne nyundua nɛra la naanar.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ kpeɡa kohona a ɡɛ saŋ tena la bini dɛ dɔ sɔna la.
Korowii aa baa na ɡɛ nɛwɛnyina nyubinikpeɡ aa kana kohona harɛ nɔ ta dɛ dɔ liichɔɡa ɡbosoroo tɔpere bɛlbwa la, o bambile bini chɔɡɔ kɛ waa ta nɛwɛnyina ba harɛ nɔ ta.
Gɛ waa nɔ aa we o nɛɛ kohona nomanta o ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ chɔɡ nɛwɛnyina maa taa bwaa, ne ola ne jumbii ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh bwa, dɛkalkɛ a dɛ we n nɛɛ kɛ maa taa.” Kɛ Korowii sie lɛ Nowa te nɛ.
Nowa wa Kenii Nowa bwara waa do.
Waa ira ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ o ɡboo ɛ nomɛl o wa aa toɡra, wechɔɡa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ.
Anomanta, o ne Korowii kpɔ darame.
O lolɛ bibaala batoro asɛ dɛ pa bɛl sɔn Sɛm, nɛɛte ɡe Ham, asɛ toorote la ɡe Jafɛt.
Dɛ nɛra baa kaa la te bwa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra Korowii be, asɛ naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla su harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa.
Korowii aa nyiŋi nɛra la, o nao kɛ ba bwa ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛkalkɛ bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin dɛ nyoɡre Korowii ŋwɛnɛ.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Nowa be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba nɛra bwa chɔɡa le harɛ nɔ ta.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ baa, dɛkalkɛ ba ɡelɔ naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla perɛ harɛ ta bwa.
Kasinteŋ, mɛɛ chɔɡ ba ne harɛ bwaa.
Anomanta, Nowa, ka nyin daa waa kpeɡa, dɛ́ kwaa dakajen waa won nee sie vala kɛŋɔ ɡbera, ásɛ dɛ bɔne o bini kɛŋɔ deene, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ kootal maa o bini ne o habɔɔ bwa.
Dɛ he dɛ ba daka la kwaara aa, ɡel o jaŋne ɛ naɡale lafraanaarɛ fifraanue, ásɛ o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, ásɛ o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua la ɡe ɛ naɡale fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue.
Ásɛ he tɔ o nyundua, kɛ dɛ́ ɡel bɔr chɔ o ne daka la baah ta dɛ baro dɛ ɛ naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama.
Dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ daa, dɛ́ bɔne o bini chɔŋre dɔŋa nɛɛ atoro kaa nyundua, ásɛ dɛ nyin ɡbera do o ta.
N dɛ ba ɡela nee su dɛ́ tɔ harɛ nɔ bobɛlbwa, ásɛ dɛ chɔɡ n kontaala bwa.
Komɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta te bwa dɛ ba sewa.
N ne hɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee, ásɛ he kpɔ he haah ne he bibaala, ne ba ɡe haahna bwa jo daka la bini dɛ́ ja he nɛ.
Ásɛ dɛ lawɛ komɛlbwa soo siwi anɛnɛ, a bini bɛlbwa onnee ne ombal.
Jumbii bwa ne ola ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh harɛ nɔ ta bwa anɛnɛ, onnee ne ombal ɛɛ ba he bee he lawa do daka la bini, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ a bini bɛlbwa mun bɛ he.
Ásɛ dɛ nyin he ne kwaa la bwa kondikwaa do daka la bini.” Nowa ɡe ɛ komɛlbwa Korowii aa doo ŋɔ o ɛ la bwa.
Nee waa sua la wa Korowii ŋɔ Nowa be ŋɔ, “He ne he bii ne he bii haahna bwa ka jo daka la bini.
N nao kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ta, he ɡboo ɛ nɛn he wa aa toɡra.
Kpɔ ola bwa soo siwi maa wola an kie bele anuanɛ, a bini bɛlbwa onnee ne bal kaa daka la bini, ásɛ ola bwa soo siwi maa kia ɡe bɛlbwa beŋkpoŋ, onnee ne ombal.
Jumbii ɡe, he kpɔ bele anuanɛ, onnee ne ombal.
N dɛ nyin kɛ he ɛ ɡɛ maa baɡla nɔ, ásɛ a bini bɛlbwa soo siwi mun bɛ he, dɛ́ won ya kerekere.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa o yawanyoa, n dɛ ba ɡela bwaala nɛ kohona, waa ɡel bwa tɔpera fifraanaarɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ komɛlbwa maa tao.” Asɛ Nowa ɡe no wobɛlbwa Korowii aa doo la bwa.
Nowa bene lafraanumɛl taa a ɡɛ nee nɔ su dɛ chɔɡ harɛ nɔ la.
O ne o haah ne o bii, ne o bii haahna bwaa kaa jo daka la bini, ásɛ nee la bɛ ban kpɔ kaa.
Ola Korowii aa wola an kie ne anɔ la waa kia, ne jumbii ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, anneena ne ambala bwa ja Nowa nɛ dɛ jo daka la bini ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.
Tɔpera anuanɛ la habɔɔ la, nee la suu dɛ ba bɔle harɛ la bobɛlbwa.
Nowa aa di bene lafraanumɛl korobinɛɛte ta, tɔpera fi dɛ anuanɛ la taa harɛ bobɛlbwa bule, asɛ nyundua pili dɛ nɛ bwaala kohona.
Bwaala nɛo, waa ɡel bwa tɔpera fifraanaarɛ.
Awola bwaala la aa pa mun laanee Nowa ne o haah ne ba bii batoro, Sɛm ne Ham ne Jafɛt dɛ ba ɡe haahna bwa ka jo daka la bini.
Kpɔɡ bini ola bwa soo siwi ne kondɛɛra bwa, anjena ne anjeɡre, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, ne jumbii bwa soo siwii ba lawɛ do daka la bini.
Korowii kontaala te bɛlbwa, anneena ne ambalaa ja Nowa nɛ dɛ jo daka la bini, ɡɛ Korowii aa do Nowa la.
Asɛ Korowii laa doonyoa waa ŋɔa Nowa forɛ daka la ta la ɡbera laa tɔ o nɛ.
Nee la aa sua tɔpera fifraanaarɛ la, o wono ɡɔɔ daka la asɛ o jaah.
Waa baa su kohona la, bobɛlbwa baa do luŋri asɛ daka la won dɛɛ valɛ nee sie.
O wono su dɛ bɔle bwejena aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ta, O suu dɛ ka tel kɛ waa bɔle bwejena ta asɛ dɛ ɡwaala a ka tama á ɛ naɡale fifraanɛ dɛ atoro kwara.
Korowii kontaala bwa, nɛwɛnyina ne ola, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, dɛ jumbii bwaa serewa.
Nɛwɛnyina ne ola ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, ne jumbii bwaa o chɔɡ kwara.
Nemenɛ Nowa ne banla baa dɔ bɔr ja o nɛɛ dɛ jo daka la bini laanee baa ka.
Korowii chɔɡ hweera kwaa bwa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta.
Nee la suu dɛ dɔ tɔpera lafa fifraanue dɛ o ta kan ɡɛ.
Nee la aa sua dɛ hweeh la habɔɔ Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Korowii ta Nowa ne kpɔɡ bini ola, ne kondɛɛra bwa aa ja o nɛɛ dɛ jo daka la bini la waa soɛh.
O ɡelɔ peu ta asɛ nee la ɛɛ hweeh.
Bobɛlbwa nee aa bula dɛɛ le harɛ bwa tɔɔɡɔ, asɛ nyundua bwa ɡe tɔɔɡe, bwaala ɡel nɛɛ.
Nee la aa hweehra dɛ dɔ tɔpera lafa fifraanue la, dɛ o ba harɛ tama.
Asɛ korobinuanɛ tɔpera fi dɛ anuanɛ ta la, daka la ka che Ararat Bwejen ta.
Nee la hweehrɔ ɡɛ aaa, asɛ korobie fi tɔpere waa tɔ sie la ta la, dɛ o le bwejena dor asɛ baa naa.
Tɔpera fifraanaarɛ aa baa kaa la, Nowa pili tokoro waa forɔ do daka la ta la, asɛ o ɡel ɡaahɡaah le dɛ kaa ɡaaɡe soŋnibɔr dɛ ka tel saŋ nee la aa baa hweeh kwaraa.
Anee o ɡel kweah bɛl ɡe le dɛ́ la ka na dɛ nee la hweehrɔ harɛpɛɛ chɔ kɛɛ?
Waa lea kaa la, o ta nakpatiɡri bɔr bobɛlbwa ka dɔe.
Dɛ nee la ta bɔle harɛ bwa, asɛ o berɛ ba joŋi daka la ta, asɛ Nowa lawɔ do o be daka la bini.
Aa baa dɔ tɔpera anuanɛ la, o berɔ tomɛ kweah la.
Waa lea dɛ kaa la, o kaa ba jɔmɔra dɛ daa bɛl papo-lwɛɛ faɡɛ o nyoa kɛŋɔ som papoo ken.
Belaa Nowa na kɛŋɔ nee la hweehrɔ tama dɛ le harɛ ta.
A tɔpera anuanɛ ta la, o berɔ ɡel kweah le ja, asɛ waa kaala la, o ta o be balɛ kpa.
Nowa aa baa dɔ bene lafraanumɛl dɛ beŋkpoŋ, korobie waa tɔ sie tɔpeloɡle ta la, dɛ nee la toole harɛ sie bobɛlbwa kpa.
Belaa o pili komɛl waa tɔ daka la ta la.
Waa nyiŋa na la, o nao kɛ nee la hweehrɔ.
Korobinɛɛte tɔpera fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue ta la, dɛ harɛ ta bobɛlbwa hwaahrɔ.
Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Nowa be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ he haah ne he bii, ne ba ɡe haahna le daka la bini.
Lawɛ ol bɛlbwa, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, ne jumbii bwa soo siwi aa lɔ he be daka la bini la le, ásɛ a ya, dɛ́ warɛ su harɛ ta bwa.” Asɛ Nowa ne o haah ne o bii, ne ba ɡe haahna le daka la bini.
Ola ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, ne jumbii bwa aa dɛ le la, dɛ a bini bɛlbwa ne a soo siwii, asɛ a teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ le.
Nowa fuh saraha jam Korowii Nowa pa bwea dawɛ dɔŋa nɛ, asɛ dɛ lawɛ ola ne jumbii Korowii aa ŋɔa bá di la bini beŋkpoŋa, dɛ kpoora dɛ fuah ɛ saraha kon la ta, dɛ kpɔ jam Korowii.
Ola baa fuah la sɔɔh do Korowii som kohona asɛ o ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini le o wechɔɡa ne o bechale saŋ, anomanta, maa nɛwɛnyina ne komɛlbwa maa taa chɔɡ ɡɛ maa tɔ sie chɔɡ bane la kpa.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Harɛ ta aa lole nɔ, ɡɛɛ kwaa dui ne a koma ne bɔwɔb ne waa saŋ ɛɛ ba le doe, ɡɛɛ bwaala ne lɔmɔɡa saŋ, ne webaŋa ne jwaana bwa ɛɛ ba le doe.”
Korowii ne Nowa fɔo fɔwa wa Asɛ Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Nowa ne o bii dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé loɡle bii kohona dɛ́ ya dɛ́ warɛ do harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
N kpɔ ola ne jumbii aa dɛ ɡah nyundua, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, ne pɛŋa bwa do he nɔn ta, ásɛ a bwa ɛɛ ɔmɛ heya.
Hɛ́ɛ won di a ɡɛ ola a siwi aa lole la, hɛ́ɛ wonoo kpoora di.
Gɛ maa tɛ heyaa papooni, asɛ a ɛ kondikwaa tɛ heyaa la, ɡɛɛ n kpɔ a ɡe dɛɛ tɛ heya.
Kɛ he bɛ konlale di, dɛkalkɛ o sewɔ ta baŋa.
Komɛlbwa mkpa lɔ o chal ta.
Gɛɛ nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa ɡe waa kpo o dɔŋ la, mɛɛ ba o deŋne tɛra.
Ásɛ olchɔɡe bɛlbwa ɡe waa kpo nɛwɛnyini la, ń tɛr o deŋne.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpo o dɔŋ la, ɡɛɛ o dɔŋ bɛl ɡe ɛɛ ba o kpoe, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa doa laanee o ta nɛwɛnyini.
Hé loɡle bii, ásɛ dɛ ya warɛ kohona, ásɛ he naanar su harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ Nowa ne o bii baa ja o nɛɛ la be ŋɔ, “Taraken n ne hen, ne he naanar dɛ ba fɔo fɔwa, ne kpɔɡ bini ola ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, ne jumbii ne kondɛɛra bwa aa ja he nɛɛ dɛ le daka la bini la.
Waa aa lɔ n ne he fɔo nɔ ta laanee kɛŋɔ, saŋkama bɛlbwa toole mɛɛ ba ɡela nee su dɛ́ ba chɔɡ kontaala bɛlbwa kpa, ásɛ nee bɛlbwa ɡe aa won su kohona dɛ́ chɔɡ harɛ nɔ.” Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tɛɛ kon waa dɛ baɡle fɔo n ne haa fɔwa laanee, ó do le tɛ he ne hweera kwaa bwa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n bwaala deŋɡare do nyundua baama bini, dɛɛ baɡle fɔo n ne haa fɔwa harɛ nɔ ta la.
Dɛ baama baa tɔ bobɛlbwa, asɛ bwaala deŋɡare le a bini naa, a taa mɛ ba fɔo la n ne hen ne hweera kwaa bwa soo siwi aa fɔwa la nae.
Aa won ba kɛ nee ɛɛ ba suu dɛ́ ba chɔɡ kontaale bɛlbwa kpa.
Saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ bwaala deŋɡare baa le baama bini naa, a taa mɛɛ ba nae dɛ́ lii fɔo la n ne hweera kwaa bwaa fɔwa harɛ nɔ ta la.” Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ Nowa be ŋɔ, “N bwaala deŋɡare nɔɔ dɛ́ baɡle kɛ n ne hweera kwaa bwa fɔwɛ fɔo harɛ nɔ ta.” Nowa ne o bibaala wa Nowa bibaala baa ja o nɛɛ dɛ le ɡbera la bini laanee Sɛm ne Ham dɛ Jafɛt.
Dɛ Ham bibaa sɔne Keenan.
Banɔɔ Nowa bibaala batoro la, asɛ a che ba nɛɛ nɛwɛnyina warɛ harɛ nɔ ta la.
Dɛ Nowa dɛ parɛ.
Onee pa mun parɛ daa koo, dɛ du daa ane ba kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen. Waa kpɔ ane ɛ sen dɛ nyɔ la, o dɛɛrɔ dɛ ka chɔ mumɡbal o dea.
Asɛ o bibaa Ham, waa ɛ Keenan mɛɛ la, na kɛ o mɛɛ chɔ mumɡbal, asɛ o le dɛ ka taa baɡle o bala banɛ la.
Belaa Sɛm ne Jafɛt kpɔ yal, asɛ dɛ ka paɡri bɔle ba vaama ta, dɛ valɛ mumur, dɛ kpɔ yal la ka tɔ ba mɛɛ.
Baa wola nyin kɛ ba siwi na ba mɛɛ mumɡbal la waa ba berɛ ba habɔɔ chaɡɔ dɛ kpɔ yal la ka tɔɔ la.
Sen la aa baa le Nowa sie ta o ir la, o no waa la o bii la bwa bini bechala la aa ɛɔ la.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Bwɛɛlɛ Keenan!
Hɛɛ ɛ yomii, dɛ́ do he dɔɔranar lɔɡa.” Asɛ o berɛ ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii Sɛm aa dɛ tomɔ, Keenan ɛɛ tomɛ Sɛmii.
Kórowii tɛ Jafɛt naanar kohona, ba ne Sɛm bwa pɛ so bobeŋkpoŋ!
Keenan ɛɛ ɛ yomii do Jafɛt lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ.” Nee la aa sua dɛ ba hweeh la, Nowa berɔ so dɛ di bene lafraatoro fifraanue.
Waa baa sewɛ la, dɛ o di bene lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanue.
Nowa bibaala la naanar Kenii Nowa bibaala Sɛm ne Ham dɛ Jafɛt waa do.
Nee la aa sua dɛ hweeh la, ba bwa loɡle bibaala.
Jafɛt bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Goma ne Maɡɔɡ ne Madai ne Javan ne Tubal ne Mɛsɛk dɛ Tiras.
Goma naanaree, Askenas ne Rifat dɛ Toɡama.
Javan naanaree, Elaisa ne Speen ne Saepros dɛ Roods tena.
Ba biirii nɛra baa peɡra dɛ ka so neerare nyoo, asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ ba wobol dɛ so ba harɛre ta.
Ham tena wa Ham bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Kus ne Misraim ne Put dɛ Keenan.
Ba sɔna nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ ba naanar sɔna.
Kus naanaree, Seba ne Havila ne Sabta ne Raama dɛ Sabtɛka tena.
Raama ɡe naanaree, Seeba ne Dedan tena.
Kus bibaa bɛl ɡee Nimrod.
Onee waa baa kpeɡ la, o yo laa dɛ do kpeɡri kohona harɛ nɔ ta la.
Dɛ o ɛ kpaah o bambile aa kpeɡa Korowii sie, a waa ba yon ŋɔ, “Kpaah waa dɔ bambikpeɡ Korowii sie kɛ Nimrod la.” Bwɛjena waa tɔ sie di o kora a ta laanee, Babelɔn ne Ɛrɛk ne Akad dɛ Kalne aa lɔ Sina harɛ ta.
Waa le harɛ la ta la, o berɔ kaa Asiiria harɛ ta, asɛ dɛ ka vɔrɔwe bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Niniwe ne Rɛhɔbɔt Ir dɛ Kala, ne Resen waa chɔ Niniwe ne Kala baah ta la.
Onee ɛ bwɛjen kohona la.
Lud ne Anam ne Lɛhab dɛ Naftu tena nabaalee Misraim, ne Patrus ne Kaslu dɛ Kaftɔ tena.
Ba binii Filisti tena le.
Keenan ɡe aa baa kpeɡ la, o lolɛ o bibanloɡle dɛ pa o sɔn Sidon, dɛ lolɛ Hiti tena nabaa ɡe.
Ba sɔna nɔɔ ba kpɔ dɛɛ yerɛ ba naanar, ne Jebus ne Amɔre dɛ Girɡasi tena, ne Hivi ne Aaki dɛ Sen tena, ne Aavad ne Semari dɛ Hamat tena.
A habɔɔ, Keenan tena lolanar bwa peɡre.
Asɛ a che a ta Keenan tena dɔ ba jwɛh dɛ le bwɛjen Sidon dɛ kpɔ ka le bwɛɛ bɛl sɔne Gerar ne bwɛjen Gasa, dɛ ka tel Sodom ne Gomoora ne Adma ne Seboiim dɛ ka tel Lasa.
Banɔɔ Ham bibaala la, ɡɛ bɛlbwa wobol ne ba deene ne harɛ baa soɡe a ta aa doa.
Sɛm tena wa Sɛm waa ɛ Jafɛt dɔɔ la ɡe lolɛ bibaala.
Hibru tena bwa naa Sɛm.
Sɛm bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Elam ne Assur ne Aafaksad ne Lud dɛ Aram.
Aram ɡe aa ira la, o bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Us ne Hul ne Geta dɛ Mɛsɛk.
Aafaksadee lolɛ Seela asɛ Seela ɡe lolɛ Iba.
Iba ɡe aa baa kpeɡ la, o lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Bɛl sɔne Pɛlɛɡ.
O munii peɡra, dɛkalkɛ o saŋ taa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bini peɡri la.
Dɛ o nime ɡe sɔne Joktan.
Joktan naanaree, Almodad ne Sɛlɛf ne Hasamavɛt dɛ Jera tena, ne Hadoram ne Usal dɛ Dikla tena, ne Obal ne Abemɛl dɛ Seeba tena, ne Ofir ne Havila dɛ Jobab tena.
Dɛ banɔ bwa ɛ Joktan bibaala.
Asɛ ba so bela harɛ la ta, dɛ le harɛre ane sɔne Mesa dɛ kaa Sefa waa lɔ wee leebɔr deŋɡarere harɛ ta.
Banɔɔ Sɛm bibaala la, ɡɛ bɛlbwa wobol ne ba deene ne harɛre baa soɡe a ta aa doa.
Banɔɔ Nowa naanar, harɛre baa soɡe a ta ne ɡɛ ba deene waa aa doa, ne ɡɛ baa soɡa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Nee la aa sua bɔle harɛ bwa habɔɔ la, a ɡɛ Nowa bibaala batoro nɔɔ loɡle bii asɛ ba mun ya, nɛwɛnyina warɛ harɛ nɔ ta la.
Babelɔn Dejaŋ wa Wubwa la, dɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa fa ɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛɛ bol wobol beŋkpoŋ.
Ba iro dɛ ɡaaɡe wee leebɔr dɛ ka le Babelɔn tena deŋɡarere harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta, dɛ ka so bela.
Belaa ba ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Bwɛɛla, hé ɡel ya teŋe berekese, dɛ́ wɔɔra a won do kpeɡri kohona.” Ba ta bwea dɔe bela dɛ́ ma deene, a waa ba kpɔ berekese dɛ nyin kwaa aa won kwaa mara kɛ kootal dɛ kpɔ ma deene la.
Belaa ba yerɛ dɔŋa dɛ ŋɔ, “Amɔ hé ɡel ya pɛ nyoa, dɛ́ vɔrɔwe bwɛjen dɛ́ ma dejaŋ o ka tel nyundujaɡla, ásɛ a ɛ sɔn tɛ yaa ya bɛ lɔ peɡre harɛ nɔ ta.” Asɛ Korowii tu ba harɛ dɛ ba na bwɛjen la ne dejaŋ nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ ma la ɡɛ waa kaa nyundua.
Anee o ŋɔ, “Dɛ nɛnsiwi beŋkpoŋ ne wobol beŋkpoŋ nɛra soɡe harɛ nɔ ta, asɛ dɛ dɔ nyopɛo dɛ den won ɛ anɔ bwa ken tenaa, ate aa biɡri bɛlbwa komɛlbwa toole bá ŋɔ baa ɛɔ baa wola won ɛ.” Korowii aa bera kaa nyundua la, o ŋɔ, “Amɔ hé ɡel ya tu kaa harɛ ta ásɛ dɛ ka beɡre ba wobol, ásɛ bane kapa bɛ ba dɔŋa wobol no kpa.” Ate, Korowii ɛ ɡɛ dɛ lɔ ba peɡre harɛ ta bwa, asɛ ba vɔrɔwe bwɛɛ la kahonɛ.
Asɛ bɛlbwa nyin o bɔr kpɔ.
Gɛɛ a ɛ baa yerɛ bwɛjen la Babelɔn, o munii kɛŋɔ kooraŋkoora, dɛkalkɛŋɔ belaa Korowii ka koɡre nɛra wobol asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ o wobol korɛ, asɛ dɛ lɔ ba peɡre harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
Sem naanar wa Kenii Sɛm naanar bwara waa do.
Nee la fa aa sua bɔle harɛ nɔ ta bwa la, bene anɛ habɔɔ la, a taa Sɛm di bene lafa, asɛ dɛ lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Aafaksad.
A habɔɔ la, o berɔ so bene lafraanue, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne haahna bane ɡe.
Aafaksad ɡe aa kpeɡa dɛ di bene fifraatoro dɛ anue la, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Seela.
A habɔɔ la, o berɔ so bene lafraanaarɛ dɛ atoro, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne haahna bane ɡe.
Seela ɡe aa kpeɡa dɛ di bene fifraatoro la, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Iba.
A habɔɔ la, o berɔ so bene lafraanaarɛ dɛ atoro, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Iba ɡe aa kpeɡa dɛ di bene fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛ la, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Pɛlɛɡ.
A habɔɔ la, o berɔ so bene lafraanaarɛ fifraatoro, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Pɛlɛɡ ɡe aa kpeɡa dɛ di bene fifraatoro la, o lolɛ Reu.
A habɔɔ la, o berɔ so bene lafraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Reu ɡe aa kpeɡa dɛ di bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ la, o lolɛ Sɛrɔɡ.
A habɔɔ la, o berɔ so bene lafraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Sɛrɔɡ ɡe aa kpeɡa dɛ dɔ bene fifraatoro la, o lolɛ Neehɔ.
A habɔɔ la, o berɔ so bene lafraanɛ, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
