Neehɔ ɡe aa di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ la, o lolɛ Tɛɛra.
A habɔɔ, la o berɔ so bene lafa dɛ fi dɛ anuanaarɛ, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bane ɡe.
Tɛɛra ɡe aa kpeɡa dɛ di bene fifraanuanɛ la, o lolɛ Abram ne Neehɔ dɛ Haaran.
Tɛɛra naanar wa Kenii Tɛɛra bwara waa do.
Onee lolɛ Abram ne Neehɔ dɛ Haaran.
Asɛ Haaran ɡe aa kpeɡa la, o lolɛ Lɔt.
Haaran mɛɛ ta soɡe le, asɛ o sewɛ bwɛɛ baa lolɔ o ta baa yerɔ Ur, o do Kaldea harɛ ta.
Abram ne Neehɔ bwa aa baa kpeɡ la, ba mo haahna.
Abram haah sɔne Sarai, asɛ Neehɔ ɡe haah sɔne Milka, o ne Eska bwa mɛɛ baa yerɛ Haaran la.
Dɛ Sarai te ɛ hambara o ta bie dɔe.
Asɛ Tɛɛra kpɔ o bie Abram, ne o bibaa Haaran ɡe bibaa Lɔt, ne Sarai waa ɛ o hela dɛ ɛ o bibaa Abram haah la.
Ba le Ur waa lɔ Kaldea harɛ ta la ŋɔ ba dɛ kaa Keenan harɛ ta.
Baa bera ba tel Haran harɛ ta la, ba soɡe bela.
Belaa Tɛɛra soŋni asɛ waa baa di bene lafraanɛ dɛ anue la, o sewɛ.
Korowii yera waa yerɛ Abram Awola bɛl, Korowii ŋɔ Abram be ŋɔ, “Ir, dɛ́ le harɛ haa soɡe o ta la ta, ásɛ dɛ bɛ he nɛra dawɛ, bɛ he mɛɛ buse nɛra ɡe dawɛ, dɛ́ kaa harɛ maa dɛ ba he baɡla nɔ ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he mun ya, dɛ́ warɛ su harɛ ta bwa, ásɛ dɛ tɛɛ hɛɛra.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he sɔn le ásɛ a che he nɛɛ nɛwɛnyina dɔ andɛɛɡa.
Mɛɛ cha nɛra la baa soŋe andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ la.
Nomɛlbwa waa taahnee la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba o ɡe taahna, ásɛ a che he nɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa dɔ andɛɛɡa.” Anomanta, Abram iro dɛ kaa ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ o be la.
O lawɛ Lɔt ja o nɛ ba bwa kaa.
Waa le Haran ɡɛ saŋ dɛɛ kaa la, dɛ o di bene fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.
O kpɔ o haah Sarai ne o nime Haran bie Lɔt, ne ba bwara laala bwa ne nɛndɔɔla baa dɔɔ ba Haran bela la, asɛ dɛɛ kaa Keenan harɛ ta.
Baa tel Keenan la, Abram ɡaaɡe harɛ la ta dɛ ka tel dajen bɛl mun More, o lɔ bwɛjen Sɛkem, dɛɛ nyin wɛɛ tomɛ Korowii bela.
A ɡɛ saŋ baa tel bela la, dɛ Keenan tena soɡe harɛ la ta.
Belaa Korowii ba Abram be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Harɛ nɔɔ mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ he naanar.” Anomanta, Abram pa bwea dawɛ dɔŋa nɛ bobɛl, dɛ kwaa saraha kon dɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii bela, kpɔe Korowii aa kpɔ o te baɡlo la wa.
Waa le bela la, o kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Bɛtel wee leebɔr.
Bela ɛ deŋɡarere harɛ.
O kwaa bobɛl dɛ baŋre o tɛnte dea Bɛtel ne Ai baah ta, asɛ Bɛtel do wee cholibɔr, Ai ɡe do wee leebɔr.
Belaa o ɛ kon baa kpo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii.
Asɛ Abram berɛ le bela dɛ ir ka so bofale harɛ la tenten ta.
Gɛɛ o so dɛɛ ir dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Abram Ijipt harɛ ta ka soɡa wa A kaa ba kɛ lɔrchɔɡe bɛl o nyoa aa kpeɡa chole Keenan harɛ la ta.
Asɛ o ir bela dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta ka so.
Baa dɛ kaa a ka tama ba tel Ijipt la, o ŋɔ o haah Sarai be ŋɔ “Gɛ haa wera tolo nɔ, dɛ ya jo bwɛɛ nɔ ta ba na n ne hen, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ he jaaree men naa, baa kpo mɛɛ dɛ́ ɡele.
Anomanta, ba pɛɛre ɡɛ naa, he ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ he dɔɔree men, ásɛ ba ɡel mɛ dɛ́ nyiŋ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ.” Abram aa jo Ijipt harɛ ta la, ba na o haah la kɛ o wer kpela.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, Ijipt kooro nomonome nao kɛŋɔ haah la wer tolo, anomanta, ba kaa taa kooro la be asɛ o ɡel ba ka lawɔ ba o dem.
Kooro la koh o waa dɛ nyiŋi Abram kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ dɛ lawɛ boohna ne peera ne nae ne nyoɡmare ne yoma dɛ keeɡore tɛo.
Kɛ Korowii koh Sarai waa dɛ ɡel weechɔɡa ane ba le kooro la ne o dem tena bwa nɛ.
Belaa kooro la aa na ɡɛ la, o tomɛ ba ka yerɛ Abram ba, asɛ o pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he ɛɛ mɛ kenɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he ta n be ŋɔe ŋɔ he haahnee yɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he ŋɔ he nimambiee dɛ ɡel n kpɔɔ ɛ n haah nɔɔ?
He haahnee la.
Ba lawɔ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔɔ le kaa.” Kooro la ŋɔ o bonɔɔna be asɛ ba lawɔ le o harɛ la ta.
O ne haah la ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa bwa.
Abram ne Lɔt dɔŋa baah peɡra Asɛ Abram kpɔ o haah ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa le Ijipt harɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ kaa Keenan harɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
O kpɔ Lɔt ja ba kaa.
Dɛ Abram nɔn bini wer, peera te kɛɛ, boohna kɛɛ nae ɔ?
Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm bwa, dɛ o dɔa.
Waa le bela la, o ɡaaɡɔ dɛ choɡ bwɛɛre ta ɡɛ naaa dɛ ba tel bela o fa aa baa choɡ mumpar bwa la.
Bela lɔ Bɛtel ne Ai baah ta, bela o fa aa pa bwea dawɛ dɔŋa nɛ dɛ kwaa kon dɛ kpo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la, dɛ tomɛ Korowii bela kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Lɔt ɡe dɔ kondɛɛra kɛŋɔ peera, boohna ne nae taeh, dɛ dɔ haah ne bii dɛ bonɔɔna ɡe.
Dɛ harɛ baa soɡe o ta la aa kanɛ ásɛ ba bwa kondɛɛra la won dɔ dibɔra.
A ɡɛ nomanta, naɡra chole Abram bonɔɔna baa dɛ nyiŋi o kondɛɛra ta la, ne Lɔt bonɔɔna baa dɛ nyiŋi o ɡe kwaa ta la baah.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Keenan harɛ tena ne nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Pɛrɛs tena ta soɡe harɛ la ta.
Belaa Abram ŋɔ Lɔt be ŋɔ, “Nɛmbeŋkpoŋii n ne he bwa, anomanta, a ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ n ne he yo, a ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ n bonɔɔna ne he bonɔɔna ɡe yo.
Anomanta, ya peɡri dɔŋa baah.
Nyiŋi harɛ nɔ waa chɔa kaa nɔ bwa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ baŋ bela bwa waa wera he be, ásɛ he do baŋ bɛl, ń ɡe do baŋ bɛl.” Belaa Lɔt ha sie dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la, asɛ dɛ na ɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa harɛ aa sɔna ka le Soar harɛ ta, dɛ do wer kɛŋɔ bela Korowii aa du daa Eden bodɛɛɡe ne Ijipt harɛ la ken.
Gɛ waa nɔ chiɡo mɔɔ Korowii chɔɡ bwɛɛre ane baa dɛ yera Sodom ne Gomoora la.
Lɔt kpɔ deŋɡarere doa harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa la te bwa, asɛ dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ wee leebɔr pera.
Gɛɛ a do ba nɛra banɛ la peɡri dɔŋa baah.
Abram soɡe Keenan harɛ ta, asɛ Lɔt te ka baŋre o tɛnte deene deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa bwɛɛre ane baah ta dɛ bɛne Sodom.
A ɡɛ Sodom tena nɔ, dɛ ba nyubini kpeɡri ba wechɔɡa do kan Korowii be.
Abram kaa so Hɛbrɔn Belaa Abram ne Lɔt aa peɡri dɔŋa baah la, asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Abram be ŋɔ, “Che bela haa lole nɔ, dɛ́ nyiŋi he sie ne habɔɔ, he diɡ ne ɡal.
A ɡɛ harɛ nɔ bwaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ he ne he naanar ó den ɛ he kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar warɛ kɛŋɔ hɛŋle ken, nomɛlbwa aa wola won jemɛ ba nyoa bwa.
Anomanta, ɡaaɡe harɛ la bwa ta, dɛ́ na ɡɛ waa doa dɛkalkɛŋɔ he nɔn taa mɛɛ ba kpɔe do.” Asɛ o ir bela waa soɡa la, dɛ ba so dajena ane mun Mamre, o bɛne bwɛɛ bɛl sɔne Hɛbrɔn.
Asɛ o kwaa kon waa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii bela.
Abram lɛɛ waa lɛ Lɔt A kaa ba kɛŋɔ koranar banaarɛ banee lole.
Ba sɔnaa nɔ.
Amrafɛl waa ɛ Babelɔn kooro ne Areɔk waa ɛ Elasar kooro, ne Kedolaoma waa ɛ Elam kooro dɛ Tidal waa ɛ Goiim kooro.
Ba nyoa pɛo ba yo koranar banue bane.
Banee nɔ.
Sodom Kooro Bɛra, ne Gomoora Kooro Birsa ne Adma kooro Sinab ne Seboiim kooro Sɛmɛba dɛ Bɛla kooro.
Bɛla nɔ sɔn bɛl ɡee Soar.
Gɛ nɛmbele banue nɔ baa cheme Sidim Fɛlembɔjen ta.
Ba berɔ dɛɛ yerɔ Yar Mpo taraken.
Bene fi dɛ anɛ bwa dɛ ba lɔ kooro Kedolaoma lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ, asɛ bene fi dɛ atoro ta la, ba ɛɔ dɔm ŋɔ baa on tomɛ kpa.
Asɛ bene fi dɛ anaarɛ ta la, Kedolaoma ne koranar bane baa ja o nɛɛ ka yo Refa tena baa lɔ Astarɔt Kanaim, ne Susi tena baa lɔ Ham, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Dɛ berɛ yo Emi tena ba harɛ bɛl waa chɔa dɛ kaa baa yerɛ bela Kiriataim ta dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba yo nɛra bane ɡe baa dɛ yer ba Hɔr tena baa lɔ deŋɡarere harɛ Sɛɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ ka le bwɛɛ Ɛlparan waa bɛne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ bɛl ta, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba berɔ laa berɛ dɛ yo ba Kades, o sɔn bɛl ɡee Ɛn Mispat.
Ba yoo dɛ lɛ Amalɛk tena harɛ bwa, asɛ dɛ pɔ Amɔre tena baa soɡe Hasasɔn Taama la ɡe nɛ.
Belaa Sodom kooro ne Gomoora kooro, ne Adma kooro ne Seboiim kooro, dɛ Bɛla baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Soar kooro bwa boa ba laa tena nyoa, dɛ kaa Sidim Fɛlembɔjen ta ka yo Elam Kooro Kedolaoma ne Goiim Kooro Tidal ne Sina Kooro Amrafɛl dɛ Elasar Kooro Areɔk.
Koranar banue ne koranar banaarɛɛ yoa.
Dɛ Sidim Fɛlembɔjen la ɛ bɔɔne bɔɔne kootal su o bwa nomanta, Sodom kooro ne Gomoora kooro ne ba nɛra aa chwaa dɛɛ kaa la, ba bini bane kaa lee bɔɔne la bini asɛ koranar batoro la ɡe ne ba nɛra la chwa kaa bwejena la dor.
Belaa koranar banaarɛ la pa Sodom ne Gomoora tena laala bwa ne ba kondikwaare bwa dɛ kpɔ kaa.
Dɛ Abram nime bie Lɔt soɡe Sodom.
Ba lawɔ dɛ pa o laala bwa ɡe ja.
A habɔɔ la, nɛra baa chwaa la bini bɛl ba Abram waa ɛ Hibru te la be, dɛ ba bol ɡɛ waa la o be.
Dɛ o soɡe Mamre dajena ane aa lɔ Amɔre te bɛl harɛ ta la mune.
Dɛ Mamre ne o nimanar Ɛskɔl ne Aner bwa ja Abram nɛ baa cha dɔŋa laa ta.
Abram aa noa kɛŋɔ ba lawɛ o lole dɛɛ kaa o ne la, o kpɔ o dem bonɔɔna lafraatoro fi dɛ banuatoro baa dɔ laa wejema dɛ ti ba ka tel bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Dan.
Bɔr aa joa la, Abram bɔne o bonɔɔna la bini kuore ta, asɛ ba ka yo nɛra la dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba doŋ ba ɡɛ naaa dɛ ka tel bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Hoba waa lɔ Damaskɔs weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Abram berɔ lɛ laala la bwa, ne o lole Lɔt ne o laala ne o haahna baa laɡ ba ja o nɛɛ la, dɛ nɛra bwa baa laɡ ba ja la, dɛ ba bane.
Mɛlkesɛdɛk swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Abram Waa kaa yo Kooro Kedolaoma ne koranar baa ja o nɛɛ tonɛ la, o berɔ ba.
O bala bini la, Sodom kooro kaa chemo fɛlembɔjen Savɛ ta.
O sɔn bɛl ɡee Kooro Fɛlembɔjen.
Belaa Salɛm Kooro Mɛlkesɛdɛk, waa ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii sɔfo la kpɔ paanoo ne sen ba tɛo, dɛ soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛo ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii waa dɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri dɛ ta nyundua ne harɛ la kwaa he kwaa tɛɛ.
Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɔ jam kɛŋɔ waa ba he dɔma ne harɛ asɛ he tiɡri ba nɛɛ nɔ.” Asɛ Abram bɔne koŋkwaare waa kaa lɛ o dɔma la be la bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛ kooro Mɛlkesɛdɛk.
Belaa Sodom kooro ŋɔ Abram be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ n nɛra tɛ mɛ dɛ́ kpɔ laala la bwa.” Anee Abram chaŋo ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ ntam, Nemenɛ Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ la sie kɛŋɔ, maa kapɛrɛ kɛɛ yakwara kɛɛ komɛlbwa waa ɛ he konee lɛ he be he ba ŋɔ, ‘Menee ɡela Abram dɔ kwa.’ Maa sɛh lɛ komɛlbwa nemenɛ anɔ la bonɔɔna la aa dia la.
Baala baa ja n nɛɛ dɛ la laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ he tɛɛ ba ba bɔr.
Banee Aner ne Ɛskɔl dɛ Mamre.”
Korowii ne Abram fɔo fɔwa Waa la habɔɔ la, Korowii pili waane bini baɡle Abram dɛ ŋɔ, “Abram, bɛ ɔmɛ.
Mɛɛ tɔe ɡbemɡbee dɛ́ tɛɛ kembɔr kohona.” Anee Abram ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, bɔkwa konee hɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ mɛ ó ɡwaa kɛŋɔ maa wola bie lolɛ bwa nɔɔ?
N bonɔɔ Eliesa waa le Damaskɔs laanee dɛɛ ba n kapɛrɛ dii.
He nao kɛŋɔ he ta men bie tɛɛ anomanta, n bonɔɔna la bini bɛlee dɛ́ di n kapɛrɛ.” Belaa o berɛ no kɛŋɔ Korowii aa bol waa o be ja ŋɔ, “N dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ a ɡɛ bonɔɔ nɔ laa dɛ́ di he kapɛrɛ, he ɡbaɡba biee dɛ́ di.” O nao kɛŋɔ Korowii aa lawɔ le buse dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Ha sie nyiŋi nyundua, dɛ́ na ɡɛ weweela aa wara, hɛɛ won kura aa?
Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɡela he naanar warɛ.” Belaa o yarada Korowii, asɛ Korowii che o yarada ta dɛ lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi.
O ŋɔ o be ja ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii, menee kpɔe le Ur waa lɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta, dɛ ba kpɔ harɛ nɔ tɛɛ o ɛ he ɡbabir kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Belaa Abram bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, ɛrɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ ń jemɛ kɛŋɔ n konee yɔ?” Anee Korowii chaŋo ŋɔ, “Lawɛ nao ne booh dɛ pebal, a bini bɛlbwa waa di bene atoro, ne borɔnoma ne kulukuku bie ba tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ o lawɛ a ɡɛ kwaa waa baɡla la ba tɛo, dɛ pere a bɛlbwa bini anɛ, dɛ bila asɛ a peɡra la sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa.
Kɛ jumbii la te, o ta a bini peɡre.
Belaa kokosakire tu ba harɛ ŋɔ á ba di ola la, asɛ Abram doŋa.
Aa baa ka tama asɛ wee le harɛ la, Abram chɔ dom ka ɡarɛ.
O dom chɔe bini la, bɔr biro kpirkpir ken ta o nɛ, asɛ ɔmee lawɔ kohona.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Jemɛ kɛŋɔ he naanar ɛɛ ka ɛ hɔɔhra nɛra bane harɛ taa, dɛ́ ɛ yoma, ásɛ ba ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa bene lafraanaarɛ.
Kɛ mɛɛ tɛr a ɡɛ harɛ la tena deŋnee.
Ba ne bela lee dɛ ba la, kondɔɔh tenten nee baa ba bela lee ba.
Kɛ he te la, he nyumpona ɛɛ too kpelkpel ken mɔɔ he sewɛ bambisɔɔhna ne bá huɡe.
He naanar bele banaarɛ ɛɛ ba kaaloo mɔɔ, he naanar berɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Amɔre tena wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ la ta tele kɛ bá dɔ deŋnetɛra mɔɔ.” Wee aa joa asɛ bɔr bir la, kapɛla waa dɛ lawɛ nii ne vii bɛl soo siwi nii aa lɔ o ta wɛɛ le chuu deno ba kpɔ ola la baah.
Awolaa Korowii ne Abram fɔwɛ fɔo.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He naanaree n kpɔ a ɡɛ harɛ nɔ dɛɛ tɛ.
O le Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta dɛ ba Yufretis Moo ta.
Ken ne Kenis dɛ Kadmɔn tena harɛre bwa jao, dɛ kpoŋe ka le Hiti ne Pɛrɛs dɛ Refa tena, ne Amɔre ne Keenan ne Girɡasi dɛ Jebus tena harɛre ta bwa.”
Heeɡa ne Ismael Abram haah Sarai ta bie lolɛ tɛo.
Dɛ o dɔ tolo bɛl waa ɛ Ijipt te baa yerɔ Heeɡa o do o sie, asɛ o ŋɔ Abram be ŋɔ, “Korowii ta ɡelɛ n lolɛ, anomanta, berɛ kpɔ n tolo nɔ.
A ken ɛɛ che o nɛɛ n dɔ bie.” Asɛ o sɛh a ta.
Anomanta, o lawɛ Heeɡa tɛo.
Dɛ Abram soɡe Keenan harɛ bene fi mɔɔ a ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡ.
Abram lawɔ chɔ o kpoŋe tea.
Heeɡa aa baa na kɛŋɔ o kpoŋe tea la, o hah Sarai dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah.
Anee Sarai ŋɔ Abram be ŋɔ, “Henee ɡela Heeɡa dɛɛ ɛɛ mɛ la.
Menee lawɛ n tolo tɛɛ, kɛ taraken waa bera jemɛ kɛŋɔ o kpoŋe tea la, o siwi aa men tɔɡɛ kpa.
Korowiirii dɛ́ baɡle n ne hen naate waa ɛ wechɔɡa.” Belaa Abram ŋɔ Sarai be ŋɔ, “He toloo, he dɔ o kpeɡri dɛ́ doo ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin.” Asɛ Sarai fiiɡu kohona o ba chwa le o be.
Waa dɛ kaa la, belaa Korowii nyundua torome bɛl ba o be.
Dɛ o lɔ bobɛl nee aa dɛ bule pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ bɛl ta, dɛ do bwɛɛ Suur ŋwɛnɛ ta.
Korowii nyundua torome la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Sarai tolo Heeɡa, leperaa hɛɛ kaalɔ?” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Chwae n chwa le n nya Sarai be.” Asɛ Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kaa o be dɛ́ kaa tomɔ.” Korowii nyundua torome la berɔ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar warɛ, nɛn aa wola won kur ba.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ o be ja ŋɔ, “Bie lɔ he be.
Hɛɛ lolɛ bibaalee dɛ́ pa o sɔn Ismael, dɛkalkɛ Korowii no he suna wii.
Kɛ he bibaa la ɛɛ do kɛŋɔ keeɡo kpaŋii o soɡa bini, ásɛ o ne nomɛlbwa aa somee do.
Mɛɛ korɛ o soŋnibɔree dɛ́ le o lolanar bini.” Korowii aa bol waa Heeɡa be la nomanta, o pa bie la sɔn ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ na mɛ,” dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowiirii n na dɛ ta so le nɔ naa?” Anee ɡela nɛra ɛɛ yerɛ bule la Beɛ Lahae Rɔe, o munii kɛŋɔ, ‘Nɛn waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ na mɛ.’ O chɔ bwɛɛ Kades ne Bɛrɛd baah ta.
Heeɡa lolɛ bibaa tɛ Abram, asɛ o pa o sɔn Ismael.
A ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Abram di bene fifraanuatoro dɛ anumɛl.
Abram ne Korowii penteŋa fɔo fɔwa wa Abram aa di bene fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ la, Korowii ba o be deera ta dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Menee Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la.
Dɛɛ no n wa, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n ne he baah fɔo la che, ásɛ he ne he naanar warɛ kohona.” Belaa Abram kpɔ sie pi harɛ asɛ Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Fɔo n ne haa dɛ fɔwɛ laanee kɛŋɔ mɛɛ ɡeloo he ɛ harɛre damanta nɛra naa.
Baa hen Abramee yerɛ kpa, kɛ baa dɛɛ yerɛ Abraham, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee mɛɛ ba ɡela he ɛ nɛnfuuh bwa mɛɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar ya taeh, ásɛ a che he nɛɛ nɛra warɛ harɛre ta, ásɛ ba bini bane ɛ koranar.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n fɔo la do n ne hen ne he naanar baah saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, ásɛ n ɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba la bwa Korowii haa dɛɛ tom mɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛ he ne he naanar Keenan harɛ haa ɛ hɔɔhra dɛ so o ta taraken nɔ bwaa, ásɛ o ɛ he kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, ásɛ n ɛ Korowii haa dɛɛ tom mɛ.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Abraham be ŋɔ, “He ɡe la, he ne he naanar baa ka ba la chɛ kɛŋɔ hé teŋɛ n fɔo nɔ ta.
N fɔo maa dɛ nyin o chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar, ásɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ o ta laanee kɛ, hɛ́ɛ teŋni he bibaala bwa pena.
Penteŋa nɔɔ dɛ́ baɡle fɔo waa chɔ n ne he baah.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa, bibaa te bɛlbwa baa lolɔ la, hé teŋe o pen.
He bini bɛlee kɛɛ nɛndɔɔlee yoo, o di tɔpera anuatoro naa, hé teŋe o pen.
Nomɛlbwa baa lolɔ o ɛ he ɡbaɡba bini bɛl, kɛɛ onɔ la haa yawɔ bwa, chɛ kɛ bá teŋe o pen, ásɛ n fɔo la do he bwadabii ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Bɛlbwa waa wola o pen teŋe la ta n nɛra nɛɛ jae kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta n fɔo la ta teŋɛ.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Abraham be ŋɔ, “He haah sɔn laa Sarai kpa.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa o sɔne Saara.
Mɛɛ tɛo hɛɛraa, ásɛ o lolɛ bibaa tɛɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o ɛ harɛre nɛra bwa naa, ásɛ ba bini bane ɛ koojena.” Anee Abraham kpɔ sie pi harɛ, asɛ dɛ mamɛ o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Amɔ baa lɛɛ won di bene lafa dɛ lolaa?
Saara aa di bene fifraanuanaarɛ nɔ, amɔ o ɡe ɛɛ won lolɛ kenɛ?” Belaa o ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he fe ɡelɔ ɡɛ hɛɛra nɔ ba Ismael nɛɛ sɛ?” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ, “N noɔ, kɛ Saara ɛɛ lolɛ bibaalee tɛɛ he pa o sɔn Aesek.
Onee mɛɛ ba ɡela n fɔo la chɔ n ne o baah ta, dɛ́ chɔ tɛ n ne o ɡe naanar.
Wɛɛ ɛ fɔo waa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
N no Ismael haa soŋ mɛ o waa la wa.
Mɛɛ tɛo hɛɛraa dɛ́ ɡel o bii ne o naanar warɛ kohona.
Mɛɛ ɛo deene fi dɛ anɛ nomonome mɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ ɡel o naanar do kan ba harɛ ta.
Kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo n fɔo la do n ne he bie Aesek Saara aa dɛ ba o lola benanyoa saŋ nɔ bɔr la baah.” Korowii aa bol waa Abraham be tonɛ la, o le o be dɛ kaa.
Awola tɔpere la, Abraham lawɛ o bie Ismael ne baala baa lɔ o dem bwa, banɔ la baa ɛ yoma ne bibaala baa lol ba o dem, dɛ teŋe ba pena ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ o be la.
Abraham aa di bene fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ la taa o teŋe o pen, dɛ o bie Ismael ɡe di bene fi dɛ atoro.
Tɔpebeŋkpoŋii ba teŋe ba nɛra banɛ la bwa, ne baala baa lɔ o dem, ne banɔ la baa ɛ o nɛndɔɔla dɛ bibaala baa lol ba o dem bwa.
Bibaa Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham nyoa wa Awola webaŋkpela bɛl, Abraham soɡe o tɛnte dea doonyoa Mamre dajena la bɔr, asɛ Korowii berɛ ba o be ja.
Abraham ha sie nyiŋi dɛ baala batoro banee ka cheɡa.
Waa na ba la, o den ɛ warane dɛɛ chem ba, dɛ ɡuŋ ba harɛ dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomonome, dɛ men maa ɛ he bie chɛo kɛŋɔ hé choɡ mɛ naa, he bɛ men ɡarɛ ta kaa.
Hé ɡel n ba tɛ heyaa nee tama he sarame he nakpale, ásɛ dɛ ka onɛ daa nɔ mun bela.
Haa dɔa ba he bie be nɔ, hé ɡel n nyin kondikwaa tɛ heyaa he di, ásɛ he won dɔ bokpeɡfala dɛ́ kaa.” Anee ba sɛh ŋɔ o ɛ ɡɛ tɛɛ ba.
Belaa o ɛ warane ka jo o tɛnte dea la bini Saara be, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir warane ka ɛ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ kuruwa anumɛl, dɛ́ kpɔ wɔɔ paanoo.” O berɔ chwa la o naleɡ bini, dɛ ka lawɛ nao bie o bwara aa wera, dɛ kpɔ ba tɛ o bonɔɔ bɛl, ásɛ o ɛ warane kpoo dɛ́ daalo.
Ate, o ka kpɔ waɡasi ne na-elne, ne nao bie baa daalo la ba cheɡ ba sie.
Asɛ dɛ te berɛ kaa ka che daa la bɛl mun bela ba jwɛh, asɛ baa di kwaa la.
Belaa ba pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Lee he haah Saara dɔɔ?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “O lɔ tɛnte dea la bini bela.” Asɛ baala la bɛl ŋɔ Abraham be ŋɔ, “Benanyoa ne chema saŋ nɔ bɔr ja mɛɛ berɔɔ ba he be.
Kɛ n ne bala la, dɛ Saara lolɛ bibaa dawɛ o nakpale ta.” Dɛ Saara ɡe soɡe tɛnte dea la doonyoa Abraham habɔɔ dɛɛ no a bwa.
A ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Abraham ne o haah Saara bwa hwɛɛhrɔ, asɛ Saara ɡarɛ dahara lee.
Anomanta, o mamɛ o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Taraken n ne n jaa bwa aa hwɛɛhra tonɛ nɔɔ mɛɛ ba silɛɛ kon nɔ dɔŋ dɔe yaa?” Belaa Korowii bɔɔ Abraham ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ Saara mamɛ o nyu bini dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ won berɛ dɔ bie taraken maa hwɛɛhra nɔ naa?’ Bɔkwa waa kpeɡa men Korowii be maa wola won ɛɔ?
Anee n faa bol he be la, benanyoa ne chema saŋ nɔ bɔr n berɛ ba he be la, dɛ Saara dɔ bibaa dawɛ o nakpale ta.” Dɛ Saara dɛ ɔmɛ, anomanta, o tɔɔh ŋɔ, “N ta mamɛ.” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, he mamɔ.” Abraham soŋɔ tɛ Sodom tena Belaa baala la ir, dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Sodom pera dɛɛ kaa, asɛ Abraham ir dɛ ka do ba ŋwɛnɛ.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Amɔ ń kpɔ waa maa dɛ ba ɛɛ nɔ sɔh Abraham kɛɛ?
Akai, o naanar ɛɛ yao dɛ́ do kpeɡri, ásɛ ba sɔn le a che o nɛɛ ń tɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa hɛɛra.
Onee n le kɛŋɔ wɛɛ do o naanaree ba no n deŋna waa dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wera, ne anɔ la aa toɡra, ásɛ n wobɛlbwa maa baɡɔ nyoa la, ń ɛ tɛo.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Abraham be ŋɔ, “Sodom ne Gomoora tena wechɔɡa waa maa dɛ no la kan kohona to, anomanta, mɛɛ la belaa, dɛ́ ɡbabir kpɔ n siwi ka na kɛŋɔ ɡɛ maa dɛ no ba waa la ɛ kasinteŋ, kɛɛ ɡɛ laa a doɔ?” Belaa baala banɛ la pe do dɛɛ kaa Sodom, asɛ Abraham ta che Korowii sie bela.
Asɛ o suuh tel Korowii dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, aah wedɛɡ-ɛɛra ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwaa hɛɛ ba pɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ aa?
Dɛ nɛndɛɛɡa tel fifraanue bwɛɛ la ta naa, hɛ́ɛ chɔɡo waa?
Nɛra fifraanue nɔ nomanta, haa ban ɡel aa?
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ haa pɛ kpo nɛnchɔɡa ne nɛndɛɛɡa.
Akai, haa ɡɛɛ ɛ.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, nɛndɛɛɡa ne nɛnchɔɡa bwaa hɛɛ ba pɛɛ tɛr ba deŋne la.
A ne he sɔn ta maɡrɛ kwaraa!
He nɛn haa ba bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la ta chɛɛ kɛ he ɛ anɔ la aa maɡraa?” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ n dɔ nɛra fifraanue ba ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa Sodom aa, mɛɛ koh ba waa, dɛ́ ɡel bwɛɛ la ne nɛra la chɔɡa.” Asɛ Abraham berɛ ŋɔ, “Kaforachɛ, a fe ta chɛɛ kɛ n maɡa nɔ dɔŋ maa ɛ nɛwɛnyini nɔ su baah che n Dɔɔ sie dɛ bol wa.
Dɛ nɛra fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, ba ta fifraanue tele ɡe sɛ?
Hɛɛ chɔɡ bwɛɛ laanee nɛra banue baa kaa nɔ waa yaa?” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ nɛndɛɛɡa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue lɔ bwɛɛ la ta naa, maa bwɛɛ laanee chɔɡ.” Asɛ o berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nɛra fifraanaarɛ ɡee sɛ?” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛra fifraanaarɛ lɔ bela dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa aa, maa ban chɔɡ.” Ate, Abraham ŋɔ, “N poori, n Dɔɔ, bɛ ɡel he baah di, n dɛ nyin ń bol waa ja.
Dɛ nɛra fifraatoro ɡee sɛ?” O ŋɔ, “Dɛ mɛɛ dɔ nɛra fifraatoro kwaraa yaa, n fe ɛɛ ɡeloo.” Abraham berɛ ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe, n Dɔɔ, nɛnhɛla laa mɛɛ ɛɛ, kɛŋɔ maa su baah dɛ ta teŋɛ dɛɛ bol waa he be nɔ.
Dɛ nɛra fifraanɛ ɡbo ɡee sɛ?” O ŋɔ, “Dɛ n dɔ nɛra fifraanɛ naa, maa bwɛɛ la chɔɡa ba.” Asɛ o berɛ ŋɔ, “N poori, n Dɔɔ, bɛ ɡel he baah di.
N dɛ nyin n soŋe webeŋkpoŋ ɡbo ja.
Dɛ nɛra fi ɡbo ɡee sɛ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Dɛ nɛra fi ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa bwɛɛ la ta naa, maa bwɛɛ laanee chɔɡ.” Korowii ne Abraham aa bol waa tonɛ la, o kaalɔ asɛ Abraham berɛ ba buse.
Sodom ne Gomoora chɔɡa wa Nyundua toroma la tel Sodom jɔmɔrane.
Dɛ Lɔt soɡe bwɛjen la doonyoa baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ jo la ta.
Waa na ba la, o iro dɛɛ chem ba, asɛ dɛ ba harɛ dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔranar n dɛ soŋe heya, hé pere kpɔ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ be bonɔ, dɛ́ ba sarame nakpale ásɛ dɛ chɔ kere hé kaa.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Ɔɔhɔh, yaa chɔ buse baahnee.” Asɛ o soŋ ba sibeɡra ne kohona mɔɔ ba sɛh, dɛ pere kpɔ o be dɛ ba dem.
Anee o ɡel o bonɔɔna wɔɔ paanoo baa wola iisi a ta doe, dɛ ɛ kondikondɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba ba di.
Baa wola chɔɔɡɛ mɔɔ la, bwɛɛ la baala, bechale ne nomonome bwa, den ba bar dem la cheme.
Asɛ ba ba bɔɔ Lɔt ŋɔ, “Leperaa hɔɔhra baa baa choɡe jɔmɔra nɔ ne la dɔɔ?
Le ba ne tɛ yaa yá laɡ ba ka chɔ.” Belaa Lɔt le, dɛ laa ɡbera tɔ, dɛ ba ba be.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “Bwɛɛla, n dɛ soŋe heya, he bɛ ɡɛ wedoŋa nɔ ɛ. N dɔ bihaahna banɛ baa wola baa jemɛ bwa.
Hé ɡel n le ba ne tɛ heya, ásɛ he ka ɛɛ ba ɡɛ he tea aa toora.
Kɛ baala nɔ te, he bɛ ban wobɛlbwa ɛ kwaraa.
Baa baa choɡ mɛ nɔ, a chɛ kɛ n nyiŋi ba nɛ.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Haa waa nyin aa, le ya sie.
Hɔɔhree hen bonɔ, henee dɛ́ won baɡle yaa wa aa?
He ta bela leɛ he kwaa ɛɛ ɡwaa ba kwaa.” Belaa ba ka lɔ tɔ o nɛ, dɛ́ fe taɡɔ le bela, dɛ́ dɔ bɔr ka ku ɡbera la.
Anee baala banɛ la aa na ɡɛ la, ba ha nɔn lawɛ Lɔt jo buse la bini, dɛ laa ɡbera tɔ.
Asɛ ba ɡel nɛra baa cheɡɛ baŋ la bwa piɡri nyoŋe, ba ta wone na buse la doonyoa bɔr kpa.
Lɔt le Sodom kaa Belaa ba ŋɔ Lɔt be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he dɔ bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna, ne ba jaranar kɛɛ lolanar ba do bwɛɛ nɔ ta naa, kpɔ ba le kaa, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ ba wechɔɡa aa le nɛra bwa mee baa bola la kan to.
Anomanta, Korowii tomɛ yaa ŋɔ yá ba chɔɡ bwɛɛ nɔ.” Ate, Lɔt ka ŋɔ baala baa dɛ ba o bihaahna la moe la be ŋɔ, “Korowii dɛ ba bwɛɛ nɔ chɔɡa.
He le o ta warane!” Dɛ ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ sɛndɛɛ wɛɛ bɔ.
Bɔr aa dɛ ba chaahna la, Korowii toroma la kaa che Lɔt nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛ warane lawɛ he haah ne he bihaahna banɛ nɔ le bonɔ kaa, ásɛ dɛ bwɛɛ nɔ dɛ ba chɔɡa aa, he te bɛ ba nɛɛ ja dɛ́ chɔɡ.” Dɛ waa too dɛ́ le warane, anomanta, ba lawɛ o ne o haah ne o bihaahna la nɔɔra, dɛ kpɔ ba le bwɛɛ la ta.
Dɛkalkɛ Korowii na ba te sum.
Belaa Korowii toroma la bini bɛl ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He chwa dɛ́ lɛ he nyu.
Bɛlbwa bɛ ke nyiŋi.
He bɛ deŋɡarere doa harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta che, he chwa kaa deŋɡarere dor, dɛ́ dɔ he nyu.” Asɛ Lɔt soŋe ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n poori bɛ ɡel a ba ɡɛ.
He sune n nɛɛ kohona dɛ ɡel n dɔ n nyu, kɛ bwea nɔ dor bela haa dɛ baɡle nɔ jaŋne kohona kɛŋɔ, n ne bela tela dɛ siswɛm nɔ puu mɛ n sewɛ.
He nyiŋo na naa, bwɛjeɡa bɛlee lɔ ya sie tenten la.
Waa kanɛ kwaraa.
Belaa bora nomanta, ɡel n kaa bela, ásɛ dɛ dɔ n nyu.” Anee o sɛh ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n sɛh ɡɛ.
Maa o tenee chɔɡ.
Ɛ warane, dɛ́ chwa kaa.
Dɛ he ta bela telaa, maa won ɛ wobɛlbwa.” A waa ba pa bwɛɛ la sɔn Soar.
Lɔt aa tel bwɛɛ la ta la, dɛ wee leɔ.
Buɡ la ta, Korowii chure nii ne jebɔrɔwe aa dɛ fuh le nyundua ta Sodom ne Gomoora dɛ chɔɡ ba.
O chɔɡ deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa la bwa ne bwɛɛre aa lɔ o ta, nɛra baa lɔ bela bwa sekwaraa, ne konduula aa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa.
Lɔt haah te keo nyiŋi, anomanta, o berɛ yabwejen che bela.
Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Abraham berɔ la bela waa cheɡa Korowii bol waa o be la.
O ta sie nyiŋi Sodom ne Gomoora pera, ne deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa la bwa dɛ na chuu aa tɔ bela bwa kɛŋɔ kpɔɡjen bɛl aa dɛ fuh ken.
Gɛɛ a do Korowii aa chɔɡ bwɛɛre aa lɔ deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta bwa la, o lii Abraham waa dɛ le Lɔt ne bela mɔɔ dɛ chɔɡa.
Lɔt ne o bihaahna wa Dɛ Lɔt dɛ ɔmɛ Soar soɡa, anomanta, o ne o bihaahna banɛ la ir bela dɛ kaa deŋɡarere la ta, dɛ ka jo bwebɔɔ bɛl ta so.
Belaa o binomoa la ŋɔ o nime be ŋɔ, “Name te ya mɛɛ dɛ hwɛɛh, asɛ baala toole harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa dɛ ba mo yaa ya dɔ bii ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛa bobɛlbwa la.
Anomanta, ɡel ya tɛ n mɛɛ sen o nyɔ dɛɛ, ásɛ ya ne o chɔ dɛ́ lolɛ bii ya mun bɛ he.
Awola jwaana la ne la, ba tɛo sen o nyɔ, asɛ o ne o binomoa la chɔ.
Waa dɛɛra nomanta, o ta o ne o bihaah la chɔe ne o ira saŋ bɛlbwa nae.” Tɔ aa pera la, o bol o nime la be ŋɔ, “N ne n mɛɛ chɔɔ dɛ jwaana ne.
Ɛrɛ ɡel ya tɛo ane jwaana nɔ ne ɡe ja, ásɛ he ɡe ne o chɔ.
Ásɛ a che ya mɛɛ nɛɛ ya mun bɛ he.” Anomanta, awola jwaana la, ba tɛo sen o nyɔ dɛɛ ja, asɛ o bihahbechala la ɡe ir o ne o ka chɔ.
Dɛɛra kohona nomanta, o ta o ne o bihaah la chɔe ne o ira saŋ bɛlbwa nae.
Kenii Lɔt bihaahna banɛ la bwa ɛ ba ne ba mɛɛ kpoŋe teene.
Binomoa la lolɛ bibaa, asɛ dɛ pa o sɔn Moab.
Onee Moab tena bwa naa.
Bechala la ɡe lolɛ bibaa, asɛ dɛ pa o sɔn Bɛn Ami.
O ɡee Amɔn tena bwa naa.
Abraham ne Abemɛlɛk A habɔɔ la, Abraham kpɔ sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera bobɛl pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ baa yerɔ Nɛɡɛv, dɛ ka so Kades ne Suur baah ta.
O berɔ ka so Gerar ɡe tama.
Belaa o ŋɔ o nimambiee o haah Saara.
Anomanta, Gerar kooro baa dɛ yerɔ Abemɛlɛk tomɛ nɛra ba ka lawɛ Saara ba tɛo.
Jwaana bɛl, Korowii ba o be deera ta, dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Na!
Haah la haa kpɔɔ nomanta, hɛɛ sewɔɔ, dɛkalkɛ nomɛl haahnee.” Dɛ o ne haah la ta baa ne haah chɔe mɔɔ, anomanta, o ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, amɔ hɛɛ kpo ya ne ya tepoŋee yaa?
Abraham ɡbaɡbaa ŋɔa ŋɔ o nimambiee, asɛ haah la ɡe ŋɔ ɡɛ tenten.
Liichɔɡa bɛlbwa laa n lii.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ o be deera ta ŋɔ, “Kpelaa.
N ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ liichɔɡa laa he lii.
Menee lawɛ kpoŋe, ásɛ he bɛ n nɛɛ jo.
A waa n ta ɡelɛ he kpɔ he te leɡo la.
Anomanta, berɛ ɡel haah la kaa o jaa be, dɛkalkɛ n keamee o jaa la.
Wɛɛ soŋ mɛɛ, ásɛ he dɔ he nyu.
Kɛ dɛ he ta o haah la berɛ ka tɛo te naa, hee he ne kwaa haa dɔa bwa ɛɛ ba hee.” Anomanta, tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi ne la, Kooro Abemɛlɛk yerɛ o nomonome bwa cheme, dɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ba be, asɛ ɔmee laɡ ba kohona.
Belaa o yerɛ Abraham dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he ɛ yaa ken?
Bɔkwa waa n den ɛɛ, asɛ he fe ɛɛ ba wechɔɡa damanta nɔ dɔŋa kpɔe ba ta n ne n nɛra nɛɛ nɔɔ?
A ta chɛ kɛ he kpɔ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ mɛ.
Bɔkwa waa ba he nyu bini he ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ nɔɔ.” Asɛ Abraham chaŋe ŋɔ, “N liiro kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii baah bonɔ.
Dɛ n dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ baa koh n haah waa dɛ́ kpo mɛ.
Kasinteŋ, n nimambie tentenee.
N mɛɛ biee, n nya te bie laa asɛ n moo.
Korowii aa ɡela n le n mɛɛ dem dɛ do pua dɛɛ ɡaaɡe la, n ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘He dɛ nyin mɛ naa, bobɛlbwa yaa tel bwa la, he dɛ ba n waa bolaa, ŋɔ he dɔɔree men.’ ” Asɛ Abemɛlɛk lawɛ peera ne nae, ne yombaala ne yomhaahna dɛ kpɔ tɛ Abraham, asɛ dɛ kpɔ o haah Saara tɛo.
Belaa Abemɛlɛk ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Na, harɛ nɔ aa chɔa kaa nɔ, n konee o bwa.
Hɛɛ won ka so bobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.” Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Saara ɡe be ŋɔ, “N tɛ he dɔɔ suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋ.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel banɔ la baa ja he nɛɛ la bwa jemɛ he nyu bini, ásɛ nɛra bwa tae tɔɔ.” Asɛ Abraham soŋe Korowii tɛ Abemɛlɛk ne o haah dɛ o yomhaahna la bwa kɛ ó pili ba lol, asɛ o pili ba lol ba won loɡle, dɛkalkɛ Saara nomanta, Korowii tɔ Abemɛlɛk dem haahna bwa lol.
Aesek lola wa Korowii aa baɡɛ Saara nyoa la, o chao dɛ ɡel o nyobaɡa la ɛ ɡɛ.
Saara kpoŋe tea, dɛ lolɛ bibaa tɛ Abraham o hwɛɛhra bini, ɡɛ saŋ tenten Korowii aa baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ baa lolɛ bie laanee la.
Asɛ Abraham pa bie la Saara aa lola tɛo la sɔn Aesek.
O bie Aesek aa dɔ yawanyoa la, o teŋe o pen ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ o be la.
Baa lolɛ Aesek la, dɛ Abraham dɔ bene lafa.
Anee Saara ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛ mɛ silɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ n mamɛ name, nomɛlbwa waa ba no ɡɛ waa nɔ la ɡe sie ɛɛ lɛo ó mamɛ.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nɛn ŋɔ Abraham be ŋɔ n ɡe Saara ɛɛ sɔɔh biirii yaa, ba fe aa ŋɔ n nyosone naa?
Kɛ n lolɛ bibaa tɛo o banjeni saŋ.” Heeɡa ne o bie Ismael doŋa wa Aesek kpeɡo ba teŋo el.
Awola baa teŋo el la tenten la, Abraham ɡelɔ ba ɛ kondikwaa ba kpɔ lɛ ba sie.
Awola bɛl, Saara na Heeɡa waa le Ijipt harɛ la bie o ne Abraham aa lolɔ la kɛŋɔ, o ne o bie la aa dɛ hɛlɛ wɛɛ muɡli o baah.
Belaa o ŋɔ Abraham be ŋɔ, “Doŋi yomhaah la ne o bie la.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ yomhaah la bie ne n bie Aesek aa won pɛ di he kapɛrɛ a maɡre.” Gɛ waa nɔ ha Abraham taeh dɛkalkɛ, o bie a ɡɛ bie la ɡe.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡel he yomhaah Heeɡa ne o bie la waa hiaeh kwara.
He te dɛɛ no Saara be dɛkalkɛ, Aesek luɡe taa hɛɛ ba he naanar maa baɡɛ nyoa la dɔe.
He yomhaah bie la ɡe la, wɛɛ yao taeh, dɛ́ ɡe dɔ ba harɛ, dɛkalkɛ he bie o ɡe.” Anomanta, Abraham iro chɔmbibii dɛ kpɔ kondikwaa ne oltɔn pur, dɛ do nee o bini o su dɛ kpɔ chɔŋɛ Heeɡa vaama ta.
O lawɛ bie la ja o nɛ, dɛ ta ba ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa.
Heeɡa aa lea kaa la, bobɛl waa ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ baa yerɔ Beɛseebaa o ka do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
Pur bini nee la baa tonɛ o kpɔ bie la ka bil dajeɡa bɛl lɔɡa, asɛ dɛ kaa ɡelo dɛ ɛ naɡale lafa del dɛ ka so.
O lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Maa won che nyiŋi, ásɛ n bie sewɛ n siwi ta.” O soɡe bela dɛ wi kohona.
Belaa Korowii no bie la wii, asɛ o nyundua torome che nyundua ŋɔ Heeɡa be ŋɔ, “Heeɡa, bɔkwa waa dɛɛ hae nɔ?
Bɛ ɔmɛ.
Korowii no he bie la waa chɔ bela la wii.
Anomanta, ir ka kpɔɔ dɛ́ ɡbɛɡbɛo.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o ya taeh o harɛ do kan.” Belaa Korowii ɡel o sie chole bule bɛl ta, asɛ o la ka dɔ nee do oltɔn la bini, dɛ ka tɛ bie la ane o nyɔ.
Korowii kpɔ nɔn tɔ bie la nɛɛ o ba kpeɡ, dɛ so bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Paran.
Bela ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, asɛ o so bela dɛɛ kpaah to ne kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ o nya nyin Ijipt haah tɛo.
Abraham ne Abemɛlɛk fɔo fɔwa wa A ɡɛ saŋ la, Kooro Abemɛlɛk kpɔ o laa tena nomoa Fekɔl dɛ la Abraham be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “He wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ la, Korowii ja he nɛ.
Anomanta, ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ haa n ne n bii ne naanaree neɡre.
Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ wedɛɛɡa maa ɛɛ la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ɡɛ ɛ n ne harɛ nɔ haa baa so o ta taraken dɛ ɛ hɔɔhra nɔ tena bwa.” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛɛ.” Belaa o bol o kɔlɔŋ bɛl Kooro Abemɛlɛk bonɔɔna aa kpɔ kpeɡri lɛ la waa baɡlo.
Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Maa nɛra baa ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ jemɛ bwa.
Dɛ fini laa hɛɛ bola nɔ naa, n fe ta an noɛ bwa.” Abraham kpɔ peera ne nae tɛo, asɛ ba che a ta dɛ fɔwɛ fɔo.
Abraham berɔ chale peloni anuanɛ, dɛ le o peera bini dɛ kpɔa ka che baŋ bɛl.
Asɛ Kooro Abemɛlɛk bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ a mun ɛɛ chaɡle ɔ?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Lɛ peloni anuanɛ nɔ, ásɛ a ɛ danseɛ kɛŋɔ he sɛoh kɛ menee kwi kɔlɔŋ nɔ.” Ba pa bela sɔn Beɛseeba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ belaa ba nɛra banɛ la cheme dɛ fɔwɛ fɔo.
Ba Beɛseeba fɔo nɔ habɔɔ la, Kooro Abemɛlɛk ne Fekɔl berɔ kaa Filisti tena harɛ ta.
Asɛ Abraham chɔɔ daa bɛl Beɛseeba bela, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la bela.
Abraham soɡe Filisti tena harɛ ta bela biɡri.
Korowii aa daah Abraham na wa Waa nɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Korowii daah Abraham dɛ́ na ɡɛ waa dɛ yaradao.
O yerɔ, “Abraham,” asɛ o sɛh ŋɔ “N Naa Korowii, menee nɔ.” Belaa o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he bibeŋkpoŋ Aesek haa dɛ nyin o waa la kaa Moria harɛ ta dɛ́ ka kpoo, dɛ́ fuuh ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.
Mɛɛ baɡlee bwejen bɛl haa ka ɛ saraha la o taa.” Tɔ aa per chɔmbibii la, o iro do o bone dɛ vɔwɛ dawɛ keeɡo nɛ.
O kpɔ o bonɔɔna banɛ ne o bie Aesek, ne daa waa ka mar dɛ ɛ saraha la, asɛ ba chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa bela Korowii aa baɡlo la.
Tɔpetooro wee la, o ha sie nyiŋi dɛ na bela Korowii aa baɡlo la bojaŋ.
O ŋɔ o bonɔɔna la be ŋɔ, “Hé ne keeɡo nɔ che bonɔ, ásɛ n ne bie nɔ ka soŋe Korowii dɛ́ berɛ ba.” Ate, o laa daa baa ka mar la kpɔ choɡ Aesek, dɛ ɡe kpɔ kere ne nii kpoŋe baa kaa.
Belaa Aesek yerɛ o mɛɛ Abraham ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ,” asɛ o sɛh ŋɔ, “N biee hen.” Anee Aesek chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nii ne daaree nɔ, aah leperaa pee haa dɛ ba kpɔe ɛ saraha la te dɔɔ?” Asɛ Abraham chaŋe ŋɔ, “N bie, Korowii ɡbaɡbaa dɛ́ tɛ pee maa kpɔ ɛ saraha la.” Ba nɛra banɛ la bwa berɛ tɛr do dɛɛ kaa.
Baa kaa tel bela Korowii aa chaɡle Abraham la, o kwaa kon baa dɛ fuh kwaa o ta dɛɛ jam Korowii la bɛl bela, asɛ dɛ pa daa darawe o ta.
O vɔrɔwe o bie Aesek dɛ kpɔɔ dawɛ daa la doa.
Belaa o ha nɔn kpɔ kere la dɛ́ fee kpɔ kpo o bie la.
Asɛ Korowii nyundua torome bɛl che nyundua yerɔ, “Abraham!” Anee o sɛh ŋɔ, “Menee nɔ.” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ bie la wobɛlbwa ɛɛ.
Namee n ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ he ta men he bibeŋkpoŋ nɔ kwaraa vɔmɛ.” Abraham ha sie nyiŋi, asɛ dɛ na pebal o nyeɡlare aa karɛ kaɡra ane ta o che.
Asɛ o ka lawɔ dɛ kpoo, dɛ kpɔ chiɡ o bie la naa ta, dɛ fuh ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Anomanta, o pa bela sɔn ‘Korowii Dɛɛ Tɛ.’ Dɛ ba le fini, ba dɛ bol bela waa ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ tɛo o bwe la doa.” Belaa Korowii nyundua torome la che nyundua dɛ yerɛ nɛɛtena ja dɛ ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ n ɡbaɡba kɛŋɔ waa nɔ haa ɛa he ta men he bibeŋkpoŋ kwaraa vɔmɛ nomanta, mɛɛ tɛɛ hɛɛra tentenee.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar warɛ kɛŋɔ weweela ne mpo nyoa hɛŋle.
He naanar ɛɛ yoo lɛ ba dɔma bwɛɛre dɛɛ di a kpeɡri, ásɛ a che ba nɛɛ ń tɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa hɛɛra.
Mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛɛ dɛkalkɛ, he ɛ waa maa dɛ nyin.” Belaa Abraham berɛ ba o bonɔɔna la be, asɛ ba ir ba Beɛseeba, Abraham so bela.
Neehɔ bibaala wa Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, ba ŋɔ Abraham be ŋɔ Milka lolɛ bibaala banuatoro tɛ o nime Neehɔ.
O biloɡlee Us.
Us nimanar ɡee Bus ne Kɛmoɛl waa lolɛ Aram, ne Kɛsɛd ne Haso ne Peldas ne Jidlaf dɛ Bɛtoɛl.
Bɛtoɛl lolɛ Rebɛka.
A ɡɛ bii banuatoro nɔɔ Milka lolɛ tɛ Abraham nime Neehɔ.
Dɛ o ne haah bɛl soɡo o ɛ o sɛno baa yerɔ Reuma.
O ɡe bii waa lol ba laanee Teba ne Gaham ne Tahas dɛ Maaka.
Saara seo wa Saara di bene lafa fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ.
Keenan harɛ ta bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Kiriat Aaba, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ yerɛ bela Hɛbrɔnee o ka sewɛ.
Asɛ Abraham la ka ɛ o lwe dɛ wiu.
Abraham le bela o haah lale aa chɔa la, dɛ ka na Hiti tena o ne ba bol o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N ɛ hɔɔh dɛ ba pu heyaa so, bonɔ laa n le.
Anomanta, hé tɛ mɛ harɛ asɛ n yawɛ dɛ huɡe n haah.” Asɛ ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, dɛɛ no, nomonjenii hen ya bini bonɔ.
Yaa won vɔmɛ lalbɔɔ ŋɔ he bɛ he lale huɡe.
He won o huɡa ya lalbɔɔne nɔ bɛlbwa he tea aa too o ta bini.” Belaa Abraham ir dɛ baa ba harɛ, dɛ soŋ ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ he sɛoh ŋɔ n huɡe n nɛn tenaa, amɔ he no n be, dɛ́ soŋe Soha bie Efron tɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ ó tɛ mɛ bwebɔɔ waa lɔ Makpɛla dɛ ɛ o kon dɛ chɔ o harɛ nyoa la.
He ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó yoɡu ɡɛ o yoɡ aa chɛa tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n dɔ lala huɡri bɔr he be bonɔ.” Anee Efron chaŋe Abraham o bala Hiti tena baa soɡe bwɛɛ la doonyoa la sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Akai, nomoa, dɛɛ no n be.
N kpɔ harɛ la tɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ bwebɔɔ la ɡe tɛɛ.
N nɛra nɔ bwa siwi taa n kpɔ harɛ la dɛɛ tɛɛ.
Huɡe he nɛn o ta.” Asɛ Abraham ba Hiti tena la harɛ ja, dɛ ŋɔ Efron be nɛra la bwa sie ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ no, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh tenaa, mɛɛ bɔe harɛ la kemee.
N dɛ soŋe kɛ he lɛ, ásɛ n won huɡe n lale la bela.” Belaa Efron chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, dɛɛ no.
Harɛ la yoɡ lɔ suuɡapoŋa lafraanaarɛ, kɛ a ta kwaane ɛɛ n ne he baah.
He te ka huɡe he nɛn.” Asɛ Abraham sɛh dɛ bɔ suuɡapoŋa lafraanaarɛ, ɡɛ Efron aa di harɛ la yoɡ ba bala la bwa no la tɛo ba siwi ta.
O bɔ ba ɡɛ ba bonadiire aa dɛ peɡra ɡɛ saŋ la.
Belaa ba kpɔ Efron harɛ waa lɔ Makpɛla dɛ do Mamre wee leebɔr la, ne bwebɔɔ la, ne daa aa lɔ koo la ta bwa, dɛ do Abraham nɔn ta Hiti tena baa lɔ bwɛɛ doonyoa la ta la bwa sie.
A habɔɔ la, Abraham huɡe o haah Saara bwebɔɔ la ta.
Belaa baa yerɛ Hɛbrɔn, o do Keenan harɛ ta la.
Gɛɛ a ɛ Hiti tena kpɔ harɛ la ne bwebɔɔ la do Abraham nɔn ta ŋɔ ó kpɔ ɛ o lala huɡribɔr.
Aesek ne o haah Rebɛka Abraham biɡro dɛ hwɛɛh ɡe kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Korowii tɛo hɛɛra o wobɛlbwa ta.
Asɛ o ŋɔ o bonɔɔna bwa nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi o komɛlbwa ta dem bela la be ŋɔ, “Gɔɔ nɔɔra nyundua, dɛ́ ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa la, kɛŋɔ haa Keenan tena maa soɡe ba baah nɔ bihaahnee nyin tɛ n bie nɔ.
N ɡbaɡba harɛ ta ne n lolanar binii mɛɛ nyin kɛ he mo haah tɛ n bie Aesek.” Belaa o bonɔɔ la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Dɛ haah maa nyin tɛo la ŋɔ waa won teŋɛ n nɛɛ dɛ́ ba harɛ nɔ ta naa, ń kpɔ he bie la berɛ kaa harɛ haa le o ta ba bonɔ la ta kɛɛ?” Asɛ o ɡe chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ berɛ kpɔ n bie la kaa harɛ la ta kpa.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua laanee kpɔ mɛ le n mɛɛ dem ne harɛ baa lol mɛ o ta la ta, dɛ ŋwɛɛ baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ n naanaree wɛɛ ba ɡɛ harɛ nɔ kpɔe tɛ.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo o nyundua torome tɔ he sie, ásɛ he won ka dɔ haah ba tɛ n bie nɔ.
Kɛ dɛ haah la ta sɛɛh dɛ teŋɛ ba naa, amɔ dɛ he ta ŋwɛɛra haa ŋwɛɛra la ta toe.
Kɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta la haa n bie kpɔ kaa bela.” Asɛ Abraham bonɔɔ la ɡɔɔ nɔɔra nyundua o sie, asɛ dɛ ŋwɛɛ a ɡɛ ŋwɛɛra la baɡlo.
Belaa bonɔɔ la kpɔ o nomoa nyoɡmare fi, dɛ kpɔ nomoa la laaladɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi ja, dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa Neehɔ bwɛ, Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta.
Waa vala dɛ tel bwɛɛ la dahare awola bɛl la, dɛ bɔr dɛ jo haahna ɛɛ la jɔmɔrpoli, asɛ o ɡel nyoɡmare la ɡuŋi harɛ bule bɛl nyoa.
Ate, o soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii n dɔɔ Abraham aa dɛ tomɛ, n dɛ soŋe, ɡel a chiɡ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ fini, dɛ́ teŋɛ nyoa haa baɡɛ n dɔɔ la ta.
Bule nɔ jwɛɛh bonɔ maa cheɡa nɔ, dɛ bwɛɛ nɔ toli balɔ ŋɔ bá ba dɔ ne aa, ɡel onɔ la maa ŋɔ ó choɡ o nee ásɛ n nyɔ ane la sɛh, dɛ́ berɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ tɛ n nyoɡmare nɔ ɡe anee á nyɔ la, ó ɛ haah haa dɛ ba kpɔe tɛ Aesek la.
A taa mɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ he teŋɛ nyoa haa baɡɛ n nomoa la ta.” O nyoa taa lɔ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta wɛɛ bol la, dɛ tolo Rebɛka polvii chɔŋɛ o vam ta o ba le.
Abraham nime Neehɔ ne o haah Milka bibaa Bɛtoɛl biee.
Rebɛka wer tolo kɛrɛdɛ.
Waa baa jemɛ bwa.
O kaa dɔ nee dɛɛ ba.
Asɛ bonɔɔ la chwa dɛ ka chemo dɛ ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe ɡel n nyɔ he nee nɔ tama ane.” Anee o chaŋo ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, nyɔ ane.” Asɛ o ɛ warane choɡ nee la dɛ kpoŋa nɔn ta dɛ ɡel o nyɔ.
Waa ɡela o nyɔ tonɛ la, Rebɛka berɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ka dɔ anee ba tɛ he nyoɡmare nɔ ɡe a nyɔ vaɡɛ.” O ɛ warane dɛ fuɡe nee la kar do kon kondɛɛra aa dɛ nyɔ o bini la ta, dɛ berɛ ɛ warane kaa bule la ta ja, dɛ ka dɔ ane ba tɛa a nyɔ vaɡre.
Bonɔɔ la nyiŋu jeiih, o ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ o ŋwɛnɛ waa bao la, Korowii ɡelɔ wɛɛ ba hɛɛra dɔe kɛɛ?
Belaa nyoɡmare la aa nyɔ nee la tonɛ la, bonɔɔ la laa suuɡaswɛm noniseɡ baa kpɔa dɛɛ do mee o yoɡ do kpeɡri kohona do Rebɛka mee ta, dɛ berɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa do o nɔɔra.
Asɛ dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N poori, ume biee hen ɔ?
Yaa dɔ chɔɔbɔr he mɛɛ deemii yaa.” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Milka ne Neehɔ bie Bɛtoɛl bihaahnee men.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Ya dɔ kpɔɡa, ne kondɛɛra kondikwaa kohona, dɛ bela haa chɔ bwa.” Anee Abraham bonɔɔ la ɡuŋi harɛ dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii n dɔɔ Abraham aa dɛ tomɛ, jam kɛŋɔ haa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin n dɔɔ nɔ.
Asɛ dɛ kpɔ n naa andɛɛɡa ba n dɔɔ lolanar buse nɔ.” Belaa bitolo la chwa la o nya be dem, dɛ ka bol waa la bwa baɡle dem bela tena.
Dɛ Rebɛka nimambie bɛl lole baa yerɔ Laban.
Laban chwao le buse dɛ la baa la be bule la ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o na noniseɡ la aa lɔ o nime mee ta ne nɔnloɡa la aa lɔ o nɔɔra ta, dɛ no ɡɛ Rebɛka aa bol waa baa la aa bol o be la.
O la baa la be, dɛ ka nao kɛŋɔ waa cheɡɛ o nyoɡmare jwɛɛh bule la ta.
Asɛ dɛ jaamo dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowiirii kpɔ he naa la.
Dɛɛ ba!
Ɛrɛɛ he ba che dahara ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Dea haa chɔ ne bela he nyoɡmare nɔ aa chɔ bwa lole.” Belaa Laban kpɔ o ne nyoɡmare la kaa dem, dɛ ka laa laala nyoɡmare la aa cheɡa la pur.
Dɛ tɛa kpɔɡa ne kondikwa.
Asɛ dɛ tɛ baala baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la nee ŋɔ bá sarame nakpale.
Ba baa tɛɛ ba kondikwa, anee Abraham bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, “Maa di, nemenɛ maa bɔ me amaneɛ mɔɔ.” Asɛ Laban ŋɔ, “Amɔ bɔ he amaneɛ ɔ.” Ate o ŋɔ, “Abraham bonɔɔnee men.
Korowii ɛ n dɔɔ andɛɛɡa kohona dɛ tɛo kondɔɔh.
O tɛo peera ne nae ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ suuɡaswɛm, dɛ tɛo yombaala ne yomhaahna ne nyoɡmare dɛ keeɡore.
N dɔɔ Abraham haah Saara lolɛ bibaa tɛo o hanjeni bini.
Asɛ Abraham kpɔ o komɛlbwa waa dɔa tɛ bie la.
O ɡelɔ n ŋwɛɛ ntam ŋɔ, ‘Bɛ Keenan harɛ nɔ maa soɡe o ta nɔ haah mo tɛ n bie nɔ, kɛ ka mo haah le n mɛɛ dea tɛo.’ Belaa n pɛɛ n dɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Aah dɛ haah la ŋɔ waa n nɛɛ teŋɛ ba sɛ?’ Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ tomɛ o nyundua toromee o ba ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel he dɔ hɛɛra, dɛ́ ka dɔ haah waa le ya dea ba tɛ n bie nɔ.
Dɛ he la dea maa le o ta, dɛ ba ta hen haah la tɛɛ kwaraa ɡba aa, dɛ he ta ntam toe kpa.’ Maa tel bule la ta fini la, n ŋɔ, ‘Korowii n dɔɔ Abraham aa dɛ tomɛ, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, tɛ mɛ hɛɛra waa maa dɛ ba ba ɛ nɔ ta.
Gel bule nɔ maa baa che o nyoa nɔ, tolo bɛlbwa waa ba dɛ́ ba dɔ nee ásɛ n soŋo ŋɔ ó tɛ mɛ nee tama ń nyɔ la, ásɛ o sɛh dɛ́ ŋɔ wɛɛ berɔɔ ka ɛ ane tɛ n nyoɡmare ɡe la, ɡel o ɛ haah hen Korowii aa kpɔɔ dɛɛ ba n dɔɔ bie la tɛɛ.’ Maa dena soŋe a ɡɛ wesoŋa nɔ n nyu bini tonɛ, buɡ la ta, dɛ Rebɛka deno forɛ le, asɛ o polvii chɔŋɛ o vam ta, dɛ baa kaa bule la ta dɛ́ ka dɔ nee la.
Asɛ n ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Tolo, n dɛ soŋe, tɛ mɛ nee nɔ ane n nyɔ.’ Belaa o ɛ warane dɛ choɡ o nee la dɛ ŋɔ n nyɔ, asɛ n nyɔ.
Asɛ o ka dɔ ane ba tɛ nyoɡmare la ɡe a nyɔ.
Anee n pɛɛro ŋɔ, ‘Ume biee hen ɔ?’ Asɛ o ŋɔ, ‘Neehɔ ne Milka bie Bɛtoɛl biee men.’ Belaa n kpɔ noniseɡ do o mee ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ nɔnloɡa ɡe do o nɔɔra.
Belaa n ɡuŋi dɛ jam Korowii, dɛ kpɛɛ n dɔɔ Abraham Korowii waa kpɔ n naa andɛɛɡa kɛŋɔ ń ka mo n dɔɔ nime bie ba tɛ o bie la.
Taraken dɛ hɛɛ won cha n dɔɔ, ásɛ o yarada waa yarada heyaa la bɛ pɛɛ ɛ aa, hé di mɛ kasinteŋ.
Ásɛ n jemɛ ɡɛ maa ɛ.” Belaa Laban ne Bɛtoɛl chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii bee waa nɔ bwa le, anomanta, ya ta liire bɛlbwa dɔe kpa.
Rebɛkaa la, kpɔɔ kaa ásɛ o ka yalɛ he dɔɔ bie ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.” Abraham bonɔɔ la aa no ba waa la ɡɛ la, o ɡuŋi harɛ asɛ dɛ jam Korowii.
Asɛ bonɔɔ la laa kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋ ɛa la ne yale tɛ Rebɛka, dɛ berɛ kpɔ laala a ɡe yoɡ aa kpeɡa tɛ haah la dɔɔ ne o nya.
Awola ba hɔɔh o ne baala baa ja o nɛɛ la kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba chɔ bela jwaana la ne.
Asɛ tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, o soŋ ba ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ́ berɛ kaa o dɔɔ be.
Anee Rebɛka dɔɔ ne o nya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Gel haah la so ya be tama dɛ́ ɛ tɔpera fi mɔɔ dɛ́ kaa.” Asɛ o ɡe berɛ ŋɔ, “He bɛ men lawɛ so bonɔ.
Korowii aa dɔa ɡel n ŋwɛnɛ nɔ do wer tɛ mɛ nɔ, he tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, ásɛ n berɛ kaa n dɔɔ be.” Anee ba berɛ ŋɔ, “Gel ya yerɛ haah la ɡbabir ba dɛ́ ba bɔɔro.” Asɛ ba yerɔ dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “He ne wɛɛ kaaloo kɛɛ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n ne wɛɛ kaaloo.” Belaa ba ta Rebɛka ne haah waa kaa chao, ne Abraham bonɔɔ la ne o bala la bwa ŋwɛnɛ.
Asɛ ba swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Rebɛka ŋɔ, “Ya nimambie, Korowii ɡel he ya kohona, he mun ya kohona aa wola nyoa dɔ, ásɛ he naanar yo lɛ ba dɔma bwɛɛre dɛɛ di a kpeɡri.” Anee Rebɛka ne o toli ir, dɛ teeh so nyoɡmare la ta, dɛ teŋɛ bonɔɔ la nɛ.
Asɛ dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa.
Kenii Abraham bonɔɔ la kpɔ Rebɛka kaa.
Dɛ Aesek ɡe lɔ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Beɛ Lahae Rɔe waa lɔ Nɛɡɛv harɛ ta.
Awola jɔmɔra bɛl o leɔ kaa bwɛɛ la dahare dɛɛ kpɔ liire, dɛ ŋɔ o nyiŋi dɛ na nyoɡmare aa dɛ ba.
Belaa Rebɛka na Aesek asɛ dɛ tu nyoɡma waa soɡe o ta la ta, asɛ dɛ pɛɛ Abraham bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, “Baa bisoo dɛɛ cheme yaa nɔɔ?” Asɛ bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, “N dɔɔree.” Ate, Rebɛka laa konchaahne bɛl kpɔ bɔle o nyu.
Bonɔɔ la bol wobɛlbwa waa kaa ɛ bwa chaɡle Aesek.
Asɛ Aesek kpɔ Rebɛka ba o nya tɛnte dea o fa aa lɔ o bini la bini, asɛ o ɛ o haah.
Dɛ Aesek dɛ nyin Rebɛka kɛrɛdɛ.
Anee ɡela o dɔ bolarawa o nya seo la habɔɔ.
Abraham seo wa Abraham berɔ kpɔ hanɛɛte baa yerɔ Ketura.
O ne on lolɛ Simran ne Joksan ne Medan ne Midian ne Esbak dɛ Suwa.
Joksan ɡe bibaalaa Seeba ne Dedan.
Dedan naanaree Assur ne Lɛtos dɛ Leum tena.
Midian bibaalaa Efa ne Efar ne Hanɔk ne Abida dɛ Ɛldaa.
Ketura naanaree banɔ bwa.
Abraham ɡel o kapɛrɛ waa dɔa bwa tɛ Aesek o di.
Waa soɡe le waa wola sewɛ mɔɔ la, o kɛ bii o ne o sɛnanar bane aa bera dɔ ja la koŋkwaare, asɛ dɛ ta ba ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa wee leebɔr pera dɛ le Aesek jwɛh.
Abraham bene waa dia dɛ sewɛ la bwa lɔ lafa fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.
Dɛ o hwɛɛhrɔ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ sewɛ dɛ ka pu o naawa.
O bie Aesek ne Ismael kaa huɡo Makpɛla bwebɔɔ la bini.
Bwebɔɔ la lɔ Hiti te baa dɛ yerɔ Efron o ɛ Soha bie la harɛ bɛl ta dɛ do Mamre wee leebɔr.
Gɛ harɛ Abraham aa yawa le Hiti tena be ba huɡe o haah Saara la, belaa ba huɡe o ɡe.
Abraham seo habɔɔ la, Korowii swee o bie Aesek andɛɛɡa.
Asɛ o so Beɛ Lahae Rɔe jwɛh.
Ismael bibaala wa Kenii Abraham bie Ismael waa do.
Onee Ijipt te Heeɡa waa ɛ Saara tolo lolɛ tɛ Abraham la.
Ismael bii waa lol ba la, kenii ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, Nɛbayɔt ne Keda ne Adbeel dɛ Mibsam, ne Misma ne Duma dɛ Masa, ne Hadad ne Tema ne Jetur ne Nafis dɛ Kedema.
Banɔɔ Ismael bii.
Ba sɔna nɔ cheɡɔɔ tɛ deene fi dɛ anɛ nomonome ne a bwɛɛre.
Ismael di bene lafa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ dɛ ka pu o naawa.
O naanar soɡo dɛ le bwɛɛ Havila, dɛ ka le Suur waa bɛne Ijipt jwɛh ta dɛ kaa Asiiria.
Ismael naanar ne Abraham bii baa kaa la naanar aa somɛ.
Jekɔb ne Esɔ wa Kenii Abraham bibaa Aesek soɡa bini waa do.
Waa di bene fifraanaarɛ la o mo Rebɛka.
Bɛtoɛl waa le Mɛsopoteemea harɛ dɛ ɛ Aram te la bihaahnee, asɛ o ɛ Laban nimambie.
Dɛ hambaraa.
Asɛ Aesek soŋe Korowii o haah Rebɛka kpoŋe tea.
Kpara teaa o kpoŋe.
Baa lɔ o tea bini la, dɛ ba dɛ lɔ dɔŋa.
Anee o ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa ɡe waa nɔɔ.” Dɛ kpɔ ka bil Korowii sie dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa bala.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra banɛ nomonomaa lɔ he tea bini.
Ba baah dɛ́ ba doe kɛŋɔ kolmaala ken.
Beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ dɔ kpeɡrii ɡwaa o dɔŋ, ásɛ nomoa la ɛɛ tomɛ bechala la.” O tɔpere aa tela kɛ o lolɛ la, o lolɛ kpara.
Waa lolɛ onɔ la aa tɔ sie la, dɛ o swɛɛrɔ, o bwara bwa ɡe ne ponaa.
A waa ba pa o sɔn Esɔ.
O munii pona te.
Ba lola bini la, dɛ muŋkaa la lawɛ sitɔte la kpoŋe.
A waa ba pa o sɔn Jekɔb.
O munii kɛŋɔ nalume kpoŋri.
Baa lol ba la, dɛ Aesek dɔ bene fifraanumɛl.
Bii la bwa baa kpeɡ.
Asɛ Esɔ kpɔ o te ɛ kpɔɡ bini nɛn dɛɛ kpaah kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Jekɔb te dɛ so dem.
Dɛ Aesek dɛ nyin Esɔ dɛkalkɛ dɛ o kpaahnɔ baa tɛo wɛɛ di.
Asɛ Rebɛka ɡe sie ɛɛ lɛ Jekɔb nɛ.
Awola bɛl, Jekɔb dɛ daa kondikwaa ane, dɛ lɔr lawɛ Esɔ taeh o le kpɔɡ bini ba.
Belaa o ŋɔ Jekɔb be ŋɔ, “Ɛ warane dɛ́ tɛ mɛ he kondikonswɛɛma nɔ ane.
Dɛkalkɛ lɔr dɛ kpo mɛ taeh.
Anomanta, ba kpɔɔ dɛɛ yerɛ Edom.
O munii kɛŋɔ konswɛm.” Anee Jekɔb ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ kpɔ he nomonomee charɛ tenaa, mɛɛ tɛɛ.” Anee Esɔ chaŋe ŋɔ, “Sewaa mɛɛ ba sewa la, bɔkwaa nomonome dii ɡe ɛɛ ba wona ɛɛ mɛ nɔ?” Asɛ o nime la ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔ he nomonomee tɛ mɛ fini.” O ŋwɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛo.
Ate, Jekɔb tɛ Esɔ paanoo ne kwaa waa daala la o di, dɛ nyɔ nee dawɛ dɛ ir chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa o bɔr.
Kenii Esɔ koh kondikwaa wa, dɛ kpɔ o nomonome ta.
Aesek ne Abemɛlɛk Asɛ lɔr bɛl chole harɛ la ta.
Gɛ lɔr nɔ korɛ Abraham saŋ lɔr la ta.
Anee Aesek ir kaa Filisti tena Kooro Abemɛlɛk be Gerar.
Dɛ Korowii fa kpɔ o te baɡle Aesek dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ Ijipt laŋa kpa.
So harɛ maa chaɡle nɔ ta.
So bonɔ tama.
Mɛɛ che he mun taa dɛ́ tɛɛ hɛɛra, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ne he naanaree mɛɛ ba ń kpɔ harɛ nɔ bwa tɛ, ɡel n nyoa maa baɡɛ he mɛɛ Abraham la che kɛrɛdɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar warɛ kɛŋɔ weweela, dɛ́ kpɔ harɛre nɔ bwa tɛɛ ba.
He naanar nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa dɔ hɛɛra.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Abraham no n be, dɛ ɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin, ne ɡɛ maa doo ŋɔ o ɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmara te bɛlbwa ta.” Asɛ Aesek so Gerar.
Asɛ bela tena bɔɔro o haah wa, anee o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “N nimambiee.” Dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ o bol ŋɔ o haahnee.
Gɛ laa aa, Rebɛka wer waa doo la nomanta, bela tena ɛɛ kpoo.
Waa ba dɛ biɡri bela tama la, Filisti tena Kooro Abemɛlɛk cheɡɛ tokoro ta, dɛ na kɛŋɔ Aesek ne o haah dɛ hɛlɛ.
Anee kooro la yerɔ dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Tolo la, he haahnee.
Aah ɛrɛɛ a ɛ asɛ he ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ he nimambiee yɔ?” Asɛ Aesek ŋɔ, “N liiro kɛŋɔ a ɡɛ ken ɛɛ ɡeloo n dɔ seo.” Belaa Kooro Abemɛlɛk ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa he ɛ yaa ken?
A ka tamaa ken ya bini bɛl fe nyin he haah nɔ, dɛ he fe ɡelɔ ya ɛ wechɔɡa dawɛ ya nɛ.” Ate, kooro la kah nɛra la bwa ŋɔ, bɛlbwa waa leɡe baa nɔ kɛɛ o haah la, a chɛ kɛ ba kpoo.
A bena la, Aesek parɔ dɛ dɔ kondikwaa kohona.
Kwaa waa para la bele lafaa o dɔ dɛkalkɛ Korowii tɛo hɛɛra.
O teŋɔ dɔ kwaa ɡɛ naaa ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa ɛ kondɔɔh tenten.
O dɔ kondɛɛra ne bonɔɔna kohona, asɛ Filisti tena la sie beɡre o nɛ.
A cheɡɛ a ta ba che teera tɔɔɡe kɔlɔŋa o mɛɛ Abraham bonɔɔna aa kwia o bere saŋ la.
Belaa Kooro Abemɛlɛk ŋɔ Aesek be ŋɔ, “Le ya harɛ nɔ ta.
He berɔ dɔ he te kohona ɡwaa yaa.” Anee o ir dɛ kaa nenabɔjen Gerar ta, dɛ ka so bela.
Asɛ o berɛ ka kwaa pili kɔlɔŋa la baa kwia o mɛɛ bere saŋ mɔɔ o sewɛ la, dɛ berɛ paa sɔna la o mɛɛ fa aa paa la.
Aesek bonɔɔna la kwi kɔlɔŋ nenabɔɔ la bini, asɛ dɛ ka pu ne.
A kaa ba kɛ nɛra bane baa dɛ nyiŋi kondɛɛra nɛ dɛ le Gerar balɔ, ba ne Aesek bonɔɔna baa dɛ nyiŋi o ɡe kondɛɛra ta la ɛɛ yo.
Asɛ bela tena la baɡle ŋɔ, “Ya konee kɔlɔŋ la.” Anomanta, Aesek pa kɔlɔŋ la sɔn Esɛk.
O munii webeɡra.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba beɡre o wa.
Belaa ba berɛ kwi onfale, asɛ ba yo o ɡe waa ja.
Anee o pa o sɔn Sitna.
O munii nɛn nɛɛ cheɡa.
O berɔ le bela kwara dɛ ka kwi onfale, kɛ o te la, o ne nomɛlbwa ta o waa beɡrɛ kpa.
Asɛ o pa o sɔn Rɛhɔbɔt.
O munii bɔr dɔe.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “Taraken Korowii tɛ yaa bɔr ya so dɛ́ ya.” Asɛ Aesek ir bela dɛ berɛ kaa Beɛseeba ka so.
Awola jwaana la ne la, Korowii ba o be kɛŋɔ deera ta ken dɛ ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii he mɛɛ Abraham aa tomɔ la.
Bɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ, mɛɛ che he habɔɔ.
Mɛɛ koh n bonɔndɛɛɡe Abraham waa dɛ́ tɛɛ hɛɛra dɛ́ ɡel he naanar warɛ.” Belaa Aesek ɛ kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii bela dɛɛ tomɔ.
O baŋre o tɛnte dea, asɛ o bonɔɔna la kwi kɔlɔŋ bela ja.
Kooro Abemɛlɛk ne o nomoa Ahusat ne o laa tena nomoa Fekɔl le Gerar dɛ ba Aesek be.
Asɛ Aesek bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa he berɛ dɛɛ ba n be nɔɔ, kɛ he hah mɛ dɛ doŋ mɛ le he be nɔ?” Ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ya nao kɛŋɔ Korowii teŋɛ he nɛ.
Anomanta, ya liiro ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ya ne he fɔwɛ fɔo.
Gel ya ne he fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ he bɛ yaa wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛ, ɡɛ ya fa aa wola hen hɔhɔrɔwa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, dɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ tae ŋwɛnɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ta he kaa la.
Taraken ya nao kɛŋɔ Korowii tɛɛ hɛɛra.” Asɛ Aesek ɡel ba daa kondikwaa tɛɛ ba ba di, dɛ nyɔ sen lɛ ba sie.
Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, ba ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡle dɔŋa, asɛ ba fɔo la che, o ta ba ŋwɛnɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ta ba kaa.
Awola tɔpere la, Aesek bonɔɔna balɔ dɛ ba bol kɔlɔŋ baa kwiu la waa o be ŋɔ, “Ya pu ne.” Asɛ baa yerɔ Seeba.
Anomanta, dɛ ba le fini, ba dɛ yerɛ bwɛɛ la Beɛseeba.
Esɔ aa di bene fifraanaarɛ la, o mo Hiti bihaahna banɛ.
Beeri bihaah Judit dɛ Ɛlɔn bihaah Basemat.
Ba baa do Aesek ne Rebɛka bonyɛɡa ba bambile chɔɡ.
Aesek swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Jekɔb Aesek baa hwɛɛh dɛ nyoŋe.
Awola bɛl, o yerɛ o binomoa Esɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “N bie.” O sɛh ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ men la.” Belaa o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Taraken n hwɛɛhrɔ, maa n seo tɔpere jemɛ.
Anomanta, kpɔ he laala, he hɛma ne to, dɛ́ kaa kpɔɡ bini ka nyin ol dɛ́ ba daa n pɛla kondikwaa tɛ mɛ n di, ásɛ n soŋe andɛɛɡa le Korowii be tɛɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ sewɛ.” Gɛ saŋ Aesek aa dɛ bol waa Esɔ be la, dɛ Rebɛka dɛ no.
Anomanta, Esɔ aa kaa kpɔɡ bini dɛ́ ka nyin ol ba tɛ o mɛɛ la, Rebɛka ŋɔ Jekɔb be ŋɔ, “Na, n noɔ kɛŋɔ he mɛɛ aa dɛ bol he dɔɔ be ŋɔ ó kaa kpɔɡ bini ka nyin ol ba daa o pɛla kondikwaa ba tɛo ó di, ásɛ o soŋe Korowii andɛɛɡa tɛo mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ.
Anomanta, n bie, cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa maa dɛ ba he be bola nɔ dɛ́ ɛa.
Ir la kondɛɛra la bini dɛ́ ka lawɛ bohloni anɛ aa wera ba tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n kpɔ daa he mɛɛ pɛla kondikwaa tɛo ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin.
Ásɛ he kpɔ ka tɛo o di, dɛ́ soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛɛ mɔɔ wɛɛ sewɔɔ waa o sewɛ.” Anee Jekɔb ŋɔ o nya be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ aa dɔ pona, n te aa wola pona dɔe nɔ, dɛ n mɛɛ kaa laɡ mɛ dɛ kpɔ nɔn valɛ n bwara aa, aa ka ɛ kɛŋɔ neɡraa mɛɛ neɡro wa aa?
Taahna kwaraa wɛɛ ba n taahna, dɛ́ ɡel andɛɛɡa soŋa dɛ́ tɛ mɛ.” Belaa o nya chaŋo ŋɔ, “N bie, he te ka ɛ wobɛlbwa maa bola la, ásɛ a habɔɔ wobɛlbwa ba dawɛ n nɛ.” Ate, o la ka lawɛ boohna la ba tɛ o nya, asɛ o kpɔ ɛ kondikwaa aa do som ɡɛ o mɛɛ aa dɛ nyin.
O kpɔ Esɔ bonɔnlaala ba do Jekɔb.
O berɔ kpɔ boohna la tɔne bɔle o nɔɔra, ne o baŋa bela pona aa wola toole la.
O kpɔ kondikonsoma la ne paanoo waa ɛa la do Jekɔb nɔn ta o ka tɛ o mɛɛ.
Waa la kondikwaa la ne la, o yerɛ o mɛɛ, asɛ o sɛh dɛ pɛɛ ŋɔ, “Umee yɔ?” Anee Jekɔb sɛh ŋɔ, “Menee he binomoa Esɔ, n ba ol la ne dɛ́ ba ɛ ɡɛ haa ŋɔa la.
Ir so dɛ́ di kwaa la, ásɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ Aesek ŋɔ, “N bie, he denɔ dɔ warane to.” Anee Jekɔb chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee tɛ mɛ hɛɛra.” Anee Aesek ŋɔ Jekɔb be ŋɔ, “Tuuh ba ásɛ n lawɛ na kɛŋɔ Esɔɔ hen kpelaa?” Asɛ o suuh tel o mɛɛ be o kpɔ o nɔn laɡro dɛ ŋɔ, “Taa nɔ te dɛ le Jekɔb taa, kɛ nɔɔra nɔ te le Esɔ nɔɔra.” O ta wone jemɛ kɛŋɔ Jekɔboo dɛkalkɛŋɔ, dɛ o nɔɔra dɔ pona kɛŋɔ Esɔ nɔɔra.
Anomanta, o fe dɛ nyin o soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛo.
O berɔ pɛɛro ja ŋɔ, “Esɔɔ hen kpelaa?” O ɡe sɛh ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, menee.” Anee Aesek ŋɔ, “N bie, kpɔ kondikwaa la tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n kpɔ ol la bɛl chwe, dɛ́ soŋe andɛɛɡa le Korowii be tɛɛ.
Asɛ o kpɔ tɛo o di, dɛ kpɔ senfala ɡe tɛo o nyɔ ja.” Belaa o mɛɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N bie suuh tel, dɛ́ ɡbaa mɛ pɛl he bambile, dɛ́ mo n lwɛɛma.” Asɛ o suuh tel o mɛɛ, dɛ ɡbaaro pɛl o bambile, dɛ mo o lwɛɛma.
Waa no o bie Jekɔb laala la sɔɔh la, o soŋe andɛɛɡa Korowii be tɛo dɛ ŋɔ, “N bie sɔɔh do kɛŋɔ harɛ Korowii aa ɡela o ɛ harɛdɛɛɡe sɔɔh.
Kórowii pili nyundua dɛ́ nɛ bwaala, dɛ́ tɛɛ hɛɛra he konduula bwa do wer, he dɔ kondikwaa ne senfala kohona.
Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ tomɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡuŋii harɛ.
Hɛɛ ɛ nomoa he nya bii bwa nɛɛ, ásɛ ba ɡuŋi harɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa taahnee la, á berɛ ɡure o nyu ta, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛɛ la, ó ɡe dɔ andɛɛɡa.” Aesek aa soŋe Korowii andɛɛɡa tɛ Jekɔb tonɛ asɛ o le kaa la, o dɔɔ Esɔ ɡe le kpaah bɔr ba.
O ɡe daa kondikonsoma ba tɛo.
Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir so ásɛ dɛ di ol maa kaa kpoo ba ɛ kondikwaa ba tɛɛ nɔ, dɛ́ soŋe Korowii andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ.” Belaa o mɛɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Umee hen ɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Menee he binomoa Esɔ.” Anee o mɛɛ kpɔ bochechela dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Aah dɛ umee kpɔ kpɔɡ bini ol dɛ daa ba tɛ mɛ laɔ?
Gɛ kondikwaa laanee n di tonɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii andɛɛɡa tɛ naate, dɛ he ɡe deno baa jo la.
Kasinteŋ, o wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛo!” Esɔ aa no ɡɛ la, o do lɔŋɔ kohona lokua ne, dɛ ŋɔ o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ, amɔ soŋe Korowii andɛɛɡa tɛ n ɡeɔ?” Asɛ o mɛɛ ŋɔ, “He nime baa neɡ mɛ dɛ ɡel n soŋe anla n fe aa soŋe tɛɛ la tɛo.” Anee Esɔ ŋɔ, “O sɔn Jekɔb la maɡre o ne.
O munii neɡra.
Anɔɔ jaa nɛɛtena waa faah mɛ.
O lɛ n nomonome, asɛ dɛ lɛ soŋa he fe aa soŋe tɛ mɛ la ɡe ja.” Dɛ berɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Amɔ he ta wobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ soŋe Korowii andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ kpa aa?” Belaa Aesek chaŋo ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ kpɔɔ ɛ he nomoa, dɛ kpɔ he lolanar bwa ɛ o bonɔɔna.
N tɛo hɛɛra ásɛ o konduula bwa do wer o dɔ kondikwaa ne senfala kohona.
Bɔkwaa kaa ń soŋe tɛɛ jaɔ?” Esɔ toɔh marɛ o mɛɛ dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “Amɔ wesoŋa beŋkpoŋ ɡboo he dɔ dɛ tɛ Jekɔb haa wola bɛlee dɔ tɛ n te kpa aa?
Soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ n ɡe.” Asɛ dɛ wi kohona.
Belaa o mɛɛ Aesek ŋɔ, “Korowii aa nyundua pili dɛ́ nɛ bwaala tɛɛ, waa hen harɛdɛɛɡee tɛ he so dɛ́ dɔ kondikwa.
Yoi ɡboo hɛɛ ba dɛɛ yoi mɔɔ dɛ́ dɔ kwaa di, dɛɛ tomɛ he nime.
Kɛ he baa tomɔ la sie tama naa, hɛɛ yoo, dɛ́ berɛ won lɛ he te.” Jekɔb aa chwaa kaa Laban be Gɛ Jekɔb aa neɡre o mɛɛ o soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛo la, Esɔ haoh.
O lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Aa biɡri bɛlbwa n mɛɛ sewɛ.
Ba baa ɛ o lwe tonaa, ásɛ n kpo Jekɔb.” Waa dɛ kpɔ ɡɛ liire nɔ la, Rebɛka noɔ asɛ dɛ tomɛ ba ka yerɛ Jekɔb ba, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He dɔɔ Esɔ dɛ vɔrɔwe he vɔrɔwa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ kpoe.
Taraken n bie, no n waa nɔ.
N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he le bonɔ warane, dɛ́ kaa n dɔɔ Laban be Haran.
He laŋaa, he so bela tama ka tel kɛ he dɔɔ baah aa sɔɔhno mɔɔ.
He dɔɔ baa soh wobɛlbwa o baah sɔɔhnoo waa, mɛɛ tomɛ nɛra he bee ásɛ he berɛ ba.
Maa won so nyiŋi n bii banɛ bwa serewe tɔpebeŋkpoŋ.” Belaa Rebɛka ŋɔ Aesek be ŋɔ, “N sie aa Hiti bitoli nɔ nɛɛ lɛ.
N kii ba kɔkɔkɔ.
Dɛ Jekɔb ŋɔ wɛɛ mo ba bini bɛlee yaa, mɛɛ sewɔɔ hɛo.”
Belaa Aesek yerɛ Jekɔb dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛo dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Bɛ Keenan harɛ nɔ ta haahna nɔ bini bɛlbwa mo.
Ir dɛ́ kaa Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta, dɛ ka mo haah le he nya mɛɛ Bɛtoɛl dem.
Ka mo he naara Laban bihaahna la bini bɛl.
Kórowii Waa ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la che he mun ta, dɛ́ swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ he hahmor ta, ásɛ he lolɛ bii kohona á che a ta he ɛ harɛre nɛra ɡalɡa naa.
Onee dɛ́ che he ne he naanar mun ta, ɡɛ waa cheɡɛ Abraham mun ta la, ásɛ harɛ nɔ yaa ɛ hɔɔhra o ta Korowii kpɔ tɛ Abraham nɔ ɛ he kon.” Belaa Aesek ta Jekɔb ŋwɛnɛ o kaa Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta Bɛtoɛl bibaa Laban be.
Rebɛka waa lolɛ Jekɔb ne Esɔ la dɔɔree.
O ɛ Aram te.
Esɔ nao kɛŋɔ Aesek swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Jekɔb, dɛ tao ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ o kaa Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ka mo haah bela, dɛ ŋɔ o bɛ Keenan harɛ bihaah mo, asɛ Jekɔb no o nya ne o mɛɛ deŋna wa dɛ kaa bela.
Esɔ ɡe nao kɛŋɔ Keenan harɛ haahna wa aa were o mɛɛ be kwaraa, asɛ o chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ kaa Ismael waa ɛ Abraham bie la be dɛ ka mo o bihaah baa dɛ yerɔ Mahalat la ja o haahna la nɛ.
O nime sɔne Nɛbayɔt.
Jekɔb deera waa deera Bɛtel Belaa Jekɔb le Beɛseeba dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa Haran.
Waa dɛ kaa la, o kaa tel bobɛl bɔr joo o chɔ, dɛ kpɔ nyu serɛ bwe bɛl.
O chɔe bini la, o deero dɛ na kɛŋɔ sanjol le nyundua ba chiɡ harɛ, asɛ nyundua toroma teeh dɛ la dɛɛ ba.
Dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o jwɛh dɛ ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii, menee he mɛɛ Abraham ne Aesek tomɛ la.
Harɛ haa chɔ o ta nɔ, he ne he naanaree mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ.
He naanar ɛɛ warɔɔ kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ta teera, dɛ́ yɛɛ kaa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
He ne he naanar nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa, ásɛ n swee andɛɛɡa tɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa.
Berɛ lii kɛŋɔ mɛɛ teŋɛ he nɛɛ, dɛ́ tɔ he nɛɛ bobɛlbwa haa dɛ ba kaala, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne harɛ nɔ ta ja.
Maa hen ta bwa, nemenɛ n ɛ waa maa baɡɛ nyoa la.” Jekɔb aa ir dom ta la, o ŋɔ, “Amɔ Korowii lɔ bonɔ asɛ n ta jemɛ!” Asɛ ɔmee lawɔ o ŋɔ, “Bonɔ ɔma kɛrɛdɛ!
Bonɔ ɛɛ ɛ Korowii demii.
Bonɔ ɛ doonyoa baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ kaa nyundua.” Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, o kpɔ bwe waa kpɔ o nyu serɛ o ta la pa bela harɛ la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ lii bela, dɛ fuɡe noo ta o ta dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta.
Dɛ pa bela sɔn Bɛtel.
Wubwa la dɛ o sɔne Lus.
Asɛ Jekɔb baɡɛ Korowii nyoa ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ ja n nɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛɛ n ŋwɛnɛ maa dɛ kaa nɔ ta, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ kondikwaa ne yal maa tɔ, ásɛ n berɛ ba n mɛɛ dem deŋnesɔɔhna ne naa, hɛɛ ɛ Korowii maa dɛɛ tomɛɛ.
Bwe maa kpɔa pa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ liiri nɔɔ dɛɛ ba he torome bɔr ɛɛ.
Ásɛ komɛlbwa ɡe haa tɛ mɛ la, bɔre fi bɛlbwa la, mɛɛ tɛɛ bɔrbeŋkpoŋii.”
Jekɔb aa ba Laban be o dem wa Jekɔb ŋwɛnɛ waa valɔ la, o kpɔ sie chaɡɛ wee leebɔr dɛ kaa bela harɛ la ta.
Waa kaa tel kpɔɡ bini bobɛl la, o na kɔlɔŋ, asɛ peera aa wara kuore atoro chɔ baro.
Gɛ kɔlɔŋ nɔ taa ba dɔ nee tɛa aa nyɔ.
Bwe baa kpɔa tɔ o nyoa la kan kɛrɛdɛ.
Peera la bwa baa cheme kɔlɔŋ la ta naa, ɡɛɛ peteɡre la ɡbili bwe la le o nyoa, dɛ́ dɔ nee tɛa á nyɔ, ásɛ o berɛ ɡbili tɔ.
Belaa Jekɔb pɛɛ peteɡra la ŋɔ, “Yabala, leperaa he leɔ?” Asɛ ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ya le Haran.” O berɔ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “He jemɛ Neehɔ naa baa dɛ yerɔ Laban la aa?” Ba ɡe ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, ya jemɔ.” Anee Jekɔb bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “O lea aa?” Ba ŋɔ, “O bwara kpeɡri.” Ba ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na, o bihaah baa dɛ yerɔ Rakɛl la ne o peeraa dɛɛ ba la.” Asɛ Jekɔb ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Wee ta nyɛɡre he ba boa peera nɔ nyoa la, hé tɛa nee a nyɔ dɛ berɛ kpɔa kaa dibɔr.” Belaa ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Yaa won ɛ ɡɛ, nemenɛ a bwa ba boa nyoa bonɔ, ásɛ ya ɡbili bwe nɔ le kɔlɔŋ nɔ nyoa mɔɔ dɛ́ tɛa nee a nyɔ.” O ne ba ta aa dɛ bol waa la dɛ Rakɛl ne o mɛɛ peera la ɡe balɔ dɛ ba jo.
O te la, dɛ peera nɛɛ wɛɛ nyiŋi.
Jekɔb aa na o naara peera kɛ Rakɛl dɛ ba a ne la, o la kɔlɔŋ la ta dɛ ka ɡbili bwe la le o nyoa, dɛ dɔ nee tɛa a nyɔ.
Asɛ dɛ ka ɡbaa Rakɛl pɛl o bambile, dɛ mo o lwɛɛma dɛ wi.
Jekɔb ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He mɛɛ lolee men, n nyaa Rebɛka.” Asɛ Rakɛl chwa dɛ ka ŋɔ o mɛɛ be.
Laban aa no o manaara Jekɔb waa la, o chwao ka chemo dɛ ɡbaaro pɛl o te dɛ ba o ne dem.
Asɛ Jekɔb bɔ o amaneɛ bwa.
Asɛ Laban ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋii, n lole tentenee hen.” Asɛ Jekɔb so o be korobibir bwa.
Jekɔb tomɛ o naara dɛ kpɔ o bihaahna mo Belaa Laban ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɛ koh kɛŋɔ n lolee hen nomanta hɛɛ ɛ tomaa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ pɛɛ.
Suuɡa aŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń bɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ nɔ?” Dɛ o dɔ bihaahna banɛ.
Nomoa la sɔne Lea asɛ bechala la ɡee Rakɛl.
Dɛ Lea sibie aa were kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ dɛ Rakɛl te wer tolo kohona.
Bii la bwa bini la, dɛ Rakɛl nɛɛ Jekɔb sie ɛɛ lɛ, anomanta, o ŋɔ Laban be ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ tɛ mɛ Rakɛlee n mo te naa, mɛɛ ɛ he tomaa tɛɛ bene anuanɛ.” Anee Laban ŋɔ, “Dɛ he laa aa, maa on kpɔ tɛ nomɛlbwa.
So n be.” Anomanta, Jekɔb koh Rakɛl waa dɛ ɛ toma tɛ Laban bene anuanɛ.
Nyina waa dɛ nyin Rakɛl kohona la ɡelɔ bene anuanɛ la do kɛŋɔ tɔpera tamaa ane ken o be.
Tɔpere la aa tela la, Jekɔb ŋɔ Laban be ŋɔ, “Bene anuanɛ la telo, tɛ mɛ n haah la ásɛ n mo name.” Anomanta, Laban daa hanfalkondikwa dɛ yerɛ bwɛɛ la tena bwa ba cheme dɛ lɛ ba sie.
Kɛ a jwaana la, Leaa Laban berɛ lawɛ ba tɛ Jekɔb asɛ o ne o ka chɔ.
Dɛ berɛ lawɛ tolo baa dɛ yerɔ Silpa la ba tɛ Lea ŋɔ ó do o sie.
Jekɔb ne haah la aa kaa chɔ la, bɔr chaahnɔ mɔɔ o ta na kɛŋɔ Leaa o ne o chɔ la.
Belaa o la Laban be dɛ ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he ɛɛ mɛ ken?
Rakɛl waa laa n koh dɛ ɛ he toma aa?
Aah ɛrɛ he berɛ neɡ mɛ ken nɔɔ?” Asɛ Laban chaŋe ŋɔ, “Gɛ laa a do ya harɛ nɔ ta.
Nomoaa ba lawɛ dɛɛ tɛ yal mɔɔ bechala.
Gel hanfalwaa nɔ yawanyoa ba kaa, ásɛ n kpɔ Rakɛl ɡe tɛɛ.
Dɛ hɛɛ berɔ tom mɛ bene anuanɛ jaa.” Jekɔb sɛh ɡɛ waa ŋɔ o be la ta.
Anomanta, yawanyoa la aa baa kaa la, Laban lawɛ Rakɛl ɡe tɛo ja.
Asɛ dɛ lawɛ o tolo baa dɛ yerɔ Bilha tɛo ŋɔ ó do o sie.
Jekɔb lawɛ Rakɛl ɡe o ne o chɔ.
Dɛ o dɛ nyinu dɛ ɡwaa Lea dɛ koh a waa dɛ tomɛ Laban bene anuanɛ ja.
Jekɔb bii wa Belaa Korowii aa naa kɛŋɔ o dɛ nyin Rakɛl waa dɛ ɡwaa Lea la, o tɛ Lea lol asɛ Rakɛl te ɛ hambara.
Lea kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Rubin.
O munii kɛŋɔ Korowii na wahala maa lɔ a bini.
“Name te n jaa ɛɛ dɛɛ nyin mɛɛ.” A habɔɔ, o berɔ kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa ja asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii noɔ kɛŋɔ baa men nyin a waa o tɛ mɛ bie nɔ ja nɔ.” Dɛ pa o sɔn Simeon.
O berɔ kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa ja.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “Namee n jaa ɛɛ ba o bambile bwa kpɔe tɛ mɛ dɛkalkɛ n lolɛ bibaala batoro bwa tɛo.” Dɛ pa o sɔn Lewi.
O berɔ kpoŋe tea ja, waa baa lolɛ la, dɛ bibaalee ja, asɛ o ŋɔ, “Name te mɛɛ jam Korowiirii.” Asɛ dɛ pa o sɔn Juda.
A habɔɔ o lol che.
Rakɛl aa naa kɛŋɔ o ta bie lolɛ tɛ Jekɔb la, o mee Lea dɛ ŋɔ Jekɔb be ŋɔ, “Gel n lolɛ bii, dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, amɔ te mɛɛ sewɔɔ.” Anee Jekɔb baah di o nɛ, o ŋɔ, “Bɛ n nɛɛ nya, n laa Korowii dɛ tɛɛ bii.” Belaa Rakɛl ɡe chaŋe ŋɔ, “N tolo Bilhaa la, kpɔɔ ásɛ o lolɛ bie tɛ mɛ, á che o nɛɛ ń ɡe dɔ bii.” Anomanta, o lawɔ tɛ Jekɔb o mo.
Asɛ o kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa tɛ Jekɔb.
Anee Rakɛl ŋɔ, “Korowii bol n waa tɛ mɛ.
O no n wesoŋa dɛ tɛ mɛ bibaa, asɛ dɛ pa o sɔn Dan.” Bilha berɔ kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa ja.
Asɛ Rakɛl ŋɔ, “N ne n nahaah yoo taeh, kɛ n pɔ o nɛ.” Anomanta, o pa bie la sɔn Naftale, o munii yoi.
Lea ɡe aa baa na kɛŋɔ o lol teŋo la, o lawɛ o tolo Silpa tɛ Jekɔb o mo.
Asɛ o lolɛ bibaa tɛo.
Anee o ŋɔ, “N nyu wer,” asɛ dɛ pa bie la sɔn Gad.
Silpa berɔ lolɛ bibaa tɛ Jekɔb ja, asɛ Lea ŋɔ, “N sie lɛo name.
Taraken n bala ɛɛ dɛɛ yer mɛɛ nɛn waa na som.” Asɛ dɛ pa bie la sɔn Aasa.
Rubin aa baa kpeɡ la, o la koo jaaɡe koma saŋ, dɛ ka kpɔ kwaane aa won ɡela baa ne haah ɛɛ nyin dɔŋa dɛ́ dɔ bii ba tɛ o nya Lea.
Asɛ Rakɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Tɛ mɛ he bie kwaa nɔ ane.” Asɛ Lea ŋɔ, “Lɛɛ haa lɛ n jaa nɔ ɡbo ta maɡra aa, he berɔ dɛɛ nyin he lɛ n bie kwaa nɔ o be ja aa?” Anee Rakɛl ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ tɛ mɛ he bie kwaa nɔ anee yaa, mɛɛ sɛoh dɛ tɛ he ne Jekɔb kalaŋre jwaana nɔ ne.” Belaa Jekɔb aa le koo dɛɛ ba jɔmɔra la, Lea ka chemo dɛ ŋɔ, “N ne henee dɛɛ ba chɔe fini jwaana nɔ ne, dɛkalkɛ n kpɔ n bie kwaa la ane lɛɛ le Rakɛl be.” Asɛ o ne o chɔ jwaana la ne.
Korowii no o wesoŋa asɛ o kpoŋe tea ja dɛ lolɛ binuete tɛ Jekɔb.
Anee Lea ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛ mɛ n kembɔr, dɛkalkɛ n lawɛ n tolo tɛ n jaa asɛ o ne o chɔ.” Anomanta, o pa o sɔn Isaaka.
O berɔ kpoŋe binumɛlte tea, dɛ lolɛ bibaa tɛ Jekɔb.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Korowii kɛ mɛ kondɛɛɡe.
Name te n jaa ɛɛ dɛɛ duu mɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ n lolɛ bibaala banumɛl bwa tɛo.” Anomanta, o pa bie la sɔn Sebulon.
A habɔɔ la, o lolɛ bihaah dɛ pa o sɔn Daena.
Korowii no Rakɛl wa dɛ no o wesoŋa dɛ tɛo lol.
Anomanta, o lolɛ bibaa dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛ mɛ bibaa dɛ laa sihiih kpɔ n sie.” O pa bie la sɔn Josef.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii berɔ jaa mɛ bibaa.” Jekɔb kondɛɛra yae wa Josef lola habɔɔ la, Jekɔb ŋɔ Laban be ŋɔ, “Tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ásɛ n berɛ kaa n bwɛ.
Gel n kpɔ n haahna ne bii maa ba he be dɛ ba ɛ toma dɔɔ ba la kaa.
He ɡbabir na ɡɛ maa tomɛ.” Anee Laban ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, ɡel n ne he so.
N nao kɛŋɔ he nomanta, Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ.
Gel n jemɛ kembɔr maa chɛ kɛ n kpɔ tɛɛ, ásɛ n nyin tɛɛ.” Belaa Jekɔb ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He ɡbabir jemɛ ɡɛ maa tomɛ ka tel, ne ɡɛ maa nyiŋi he kondɛɛra ta a do wer nyiŋa maa nyiŋi a ta kɛrɛdɛ la wa.
A fa lɔ tamaa ken mɔɔ n ba, a berɔ ya kohona, asɛ Korowii tɛɛ hɛɛra bobɛlbwa maa dɛ la.
Taraken, tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ n ɡbabir ɡe vɔrɔwe n dem.” Anee Laban bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Aŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ nyin kɛ n bɔe nɔ?” Jekɔb ŋɔ, “Maa kembɔr bɛlbwa nyin.
Dɛ he fe ɛɛ sɛh ɡɛ maa dɛ ba bola nɔ taa tɛ mɛ tenaa, he kondɛɛra la taa mɛɛ ba nyiŋa.
Anee kɛŋɔ, ɡel n ka nyiŋi he kondɛɛra la bwa bini fini dɛ́ lawɛ pebie bɛlbwa waa ɛ ombiŋi ne bombiire aa lɛɡra kɛɛ dɛ peeɡe la.
Anee ɛ kembɔr maa dɛ nyin.
A ba ɡɛ naa, kerekere hɛɛ won jemɛ kɛŋɔ n ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe.
Tɔpebɛl haa ba ŋɔ he nyiŋi n toma ɛɛ bini la, pebie bɛlbwa waa wola ombiŋi ɛɛ ne bombiire aa wola lɛɡrɛ kɛɛ dɛ peeɡe koo n kwaa ta naa, amɔ jemɛ kɛ dɛ ŋwɛɛ n ŋwɛ.” Anee Laban ŋɔ, “N sɛh ɡɛ.
Yaa ɛ ɡɛ haa bola nɔɔ.” Awola tɔpere la, Laban lawɛ bombala aa lɛɡra ne anloni aa peeɡa kɛɛ anɔ la aa lɛɡre ampoŋa do o bii nɔn ta baa nyiŋi a ta.
O lawɛ peera aa bira bwa ɡe jaa ba.
Asɛ dɛ ɡel tɔpera atoro ŋwɛnɛ ta o ne Jekɔb baah ta, asɛ Jekɔb ɡe ɛɛ nyiŋi kondɛɛra la kar ta.
Belaa Jekɔb teŋe daa ane kɛŋɔ sɛsɛ ne chɛnchɛne daa kpala, dɛ lɔ a pɛɡa peri ta, asɛ a to dɛ peeɡe.
O kpɔ daa la paaɡe kon aa dɛ nyɔ nee o bini la sie.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ belaa aa jwee.
Anomanta, aa ba dɛɛ nyɔ nee la asɛ daa la paaɡe ɡɛ la, aa kpoŋe teene dɛɛ ba loɡla la, a loɡle bii aa peeɡa, anla aa lɛɡra ne anchɛchɛra.
Jekɔb pere a bii la le anɔ la ta, dɛ ɡel anɔ la aa kaa la sie chaɡɛ Laban kwaa la waa paaɡe daa a sie la ne ambiŋere la be.
Asɛ dɛ teɡɛ o ɡbabir kwaa la kaa baŋ bɛl, o ta an kpɔe koo Laban kwaa la ta.
Jekɔb kpɔ daa la ba pa a sie a nenyɔɔ kwaa la bɔr bela, ásɛ anɔ la a bwara aa kpeɡa dɛ peeɡe la ba dɛ jwee dɔŋa aa, á kpoŋe teene a bii la do kɛŋɔ daa la ken.
Kɛ anɔ la a bwara aa wola kpeɡe la te, o ta daa la kpɔe paaɡe a sie.
Labanee dɔ anɔ la aa wola kpeɡe la, asɛ Jekɔb ɡe dɔ anɔ la aa kpeɡa la.
A cheɡɛ a ta Jekɔb ba ɛ kondɔɔh dɛ dɔ kondɛɛra ne nɛndɔɔla ne nyoɡmare dɛ keeɡore kohona.
Jekɔb chwao le Laban be Jekɔb noɔ kɛŋɔ Laban bibaala aa dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Jekɔb kpɔ ya mɛɛ kwaa waa dɔa la bwa.
O kondɔɔh waa dɔa nɔ bwa le ya mɛɛ kwaa ta.” Jekɔb nyiŋi Laban dɛ na kɛŋɔ ɡɛ o ne o fa aa doa wubwa la ta ɡɛ doe kpa.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Jekɔb be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kaa he lolanar bini, he naawa harɛ la ta.
Mɛɛ teŋɛ he nɛɛ.” Anomanta, o tomɔ ba ka yerɛ Rakɛl ne Lea ŋɔ bá chemo kpɔɡ bini bela o ne o kondɛɛra aa lole la.
Asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N nao kɛŋɔ n ne he mɛɛ ta ɡɛ ya fa aa doa wubwa la doe kpa.
Kɛ Korowii n naawa aa tomɔ la ta teŋɛ n nɛ.
He bwa ɡe nao ɡɛ maa kpɔ n bokpeɡa bwa ɛ toma dɛ tɛ he mɛɛ.
O ɡarɔ faah mɛ n kembɔr dɛ beɡra kera fi.
Kɛ Korowii ta on ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ asɛ o won ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa.
Saŋ bɛlbwa waa ŋɔ, ‘Peera ne boohna aa lɛɡre laanee dɛ́ ɛ he kembɔr’ la, ɡɛɛ a bwa loɡle dɛ lɛɡre.
O berɔ ŋɔ, ‘Pera ne boohna aa peeɡe laanee dɛ́ ɛ he kembɔr’ aa, ɡɛɛ a bwa loɡle dɛ peeɡe.
Gɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ taa a che Korowii ɡel n dɔ kondɛɛra le he mɛɛ kwaa ta.
Peera la teene kpoŋa saŋ la, n deero dɛ na kɛŋɔ bombala aa dɛ jweera la peeɡɔ dɛ lɛɡre.
Belaa nyundua torome bɛl yer mɛ deera la ta dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Jekɔb’ asɛ n sɛh ŋɔ ‘Menee nɔ.’ Anee o ŋɔ, ‘Ha sie dɛ nyiŋi na, bombala bwa aa dɛ jwee la peeɡɔ dɛ lɛɡre.
Dɛkalkɛ n na ɡɛ Laban aa dɛ ɛɛ bwa.
Menee Korowii maa kpɔ n te baɡle Bɛtel asɛ he kpɔ bwe bɛl pa bela, dɛ fuɡe noo ta o ta, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii mɛ, dɛ baɡ mɛ nyoa la.
Ir dɛ́ kpɔ he te dɛ́ berɛ kaa harɛ baa lolɛ o ta la ta.’ ” Belaa Rakɛl ne Lea ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ kon bɛlbwa ta kae dɛ o sewaa yá dɔ kpa.
O ɛ yaa kɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra dɛ yoɡ yaa.
Suuɡa waa yoɡ yaa dɛ lɛ la ɡe, o di a bwa.
Kondɔɔh Korowii aa ɡela he dɔ le ya mɛɛ kwaa ta la berɛ ya ne ya bii kwa.
Ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii aa ŋɔa he ɛ.” Belaa Jekɔb kpɔ o te, dɛ lawɛ o haahna ne bii so nyoɡmare ta, dɛ́ kaa Keenan o mɛɛ harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ o kondɛɛra waa dɔa Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta bwa, ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa ɡe ja dɛɛ kaa o mɛɛ Aesek be Keenan harɛ ta.
Laban kaa o peera pona fona, asɛ Rakɛl ŋwɛ ba dem voɡa aa lɔ o mɛɛ be.
Jekɔb ta ɡelɛ Laban jemɛ kɛŋɔ o dɛ kaa o bwɛ.
O kpɔ komɛlbwa dɛ ɛ warane dɛ le kaa.
O kaa ɡale Yufretis Moo la, dɛ kpɔ sie pa Gelead deŋɡarere harɛ ta dɛɛ kaa.
Laban ti Jekɔb A tɔpetooro wee laanee ba ŋɔ Laban be ŋɔ Jekɔb chwao.
Belaa o kpɔ o lolanar bane ja o nɛɛ ba ti Jekɔb, dɛ ka puu Gelead deŋɡarere harɛ ta bela.
Aa ɛ tɔpera anuanɛ ŋwɛnɛɛ.
Korowii ba Laban be deera ta awola jwaana, dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ Jekɔb ba aah ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.” Dɛ Jekɔb baŋre o tɛnte dea Gelead deŋɡarere harɛ ta, asɛ Laban ɡe ne o nɛra baŋre ba kon baŋ bɛl.
Laban la Jekɔb be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
He neɡ mɛ dɛ kpɔ n bihaahna chwa kɛŋɔ haa kaa yo laa dɛ laɡ ba la.
Ɛrɛɛ he neɡ mɛ dɛ sɔh dɛ chwa he ta men amaneɛ ba bɔe nɔɔ?
He ɡelɔ n deŋne no aa, n fe kpɔ janjela ne kwaa baa dɛ yiiɡa kɛŋɔ loŋa ba tae ŋwɛnɛ silɛɛ ne.
He ta ɡelɛ n mo n bii ne naanar lwɛrɛme dɛ ta ba ŋwɛnɛ.
Gɛnewaa he ɛ ɡɛ la!
N fe dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ń won ɛɛ wechɔɡa, kɛ dɛ jwaana ne la, Korowii he mɛɛ aa tomɔ la kah mɛ ŋɔ n bɛ hen aah ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he sie cheɡɛ chiŋ hɛɛ nyin bɔr dɛ́ kaa he bwɛ.
Aah dɛ ɛrɛ waa he berɛ ŋwɛ n voɡa nɔɔ?” Belaa Jekɔb chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ɔmaa n ɔmɛ, n liiro ŋɔ he ken ɛɛ lɛ he bihaahna la n bee.
Nyiŋi, nomɛlbwa haa na voɡa la o be la, a chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
Ya nɛra nɔ ɡe lɔ bonɔ dɛ́ di yaa danseɛ, komɛlbwa waa ɛ he kon la, ásɛ he kpɔ.” Dɛ Jekɔb ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ Rakɛlee ŋwɛ o mɛɛ Laban voɡa la.
Laban kaa jo Jekɔb tɛnte dea bini dɛ ka ɡaaɡe, dɛ le ka jo Lea ne o toli la ɡe kon bini o ta voɡa la nae.
Belaa o berɛ la Rakɛl ɡe kon bini.
Ajaah dɛ onee kpɔa do kon baa kpɔa dawɛ nyoɡma ta dɛɛ so o ta la lɔɡa dɛ so a ta.
Dɛ Laban kaa nyiŋi o dea kɛ o ta an nae.
Asɛ Rakɛl ŋɔ o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, “N poori n mɛɛ, bɛ ɡel he baah di.
Maa won ir che he sie, dɛkalkɛ n le dahara.” Laban nyiŋi o tɛnte dea bini kɛ wɛɛ na voɡa laanee, kɛ o ta an nae.
Belaa Jekɔb kpɔ bandia dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa wechɔɡaa n ɛɔ?
Mmara besoo n koni asɛ he ti mɛ kɛŋɔ nɛnchɔɡe nɔɔ?
Haa nyiŋi n bone bwa bini nɔ, he dem kon besoo he na nɔ?
Kpɔ bil n ne he nɛra baa lɔ bonɔ nɔ sie, ásɛ ba pa bole.
N ne he soɡoo bene fifraanɛ, he boohna ne peera maa nyiŋi a ta ɡe ya tɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
N ta he pebal bɛlbwa ɡe kpoe di bwa.
Anɔ la konchɔɡa aa dɛ kpoora bwa la, n ɡbabirii dɛɛ bɔe a kem.
Anɔ la baa dɛ ŋwɛa webaŋa ne jwaana ɡe bwa la, he ɡelɔ mɛɛ bɔe a kem.
Dɛ n dɛ na wahala, webaŋa wee dɛ kpo mɛ jwaana waa ɛɛ kpo mɛ, dɛ maa won dom chɔ.
Dɛ kenii mɛɛ na bene fifraanɛ la bwa n ne haa soɡa.
Bene fi dɛ anaarɛɛ n ɛ toma dɛ dɔ he bihaahna banɛ, asɛ bene anumɛl ɡe n ɛ toma dɛ dɔ kondɛɛra.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, he beɡre n kembɔr kera fi.
Korowii n nabaa Abraham ne n mɛɛ Aesek aa tomɔ la laa teŋɛ n nɛɛ aa, he fe ɡelɔ n kpɔ nɔŋɡbala kaa.
Kɛ Korowii na n wenaale ne n toma maa ɛa, a waa dɛ jwaana ne o ba pa bole la.” Jekɔb ne Laban fɔo fɔwa Ate, Laban chaŋe ŋɔ, “N biirii haahna nɔ, ba bii ɡe n kwaa, asɛ kondɛɛra nɔ bwa ɡe ɛ n kwa.
Komɛlbwa aa lɔ bonɔ ɛ n kon.
Kɛ n bihaahna nɔ ne ba ɡe bii nɔ, maa won kpoŋ ba.
Taraken n sɛoh kɛŋɔ n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo.
Gel ya pa bwea dawɛ dɔŋa nɛ á baɡle ya fɔo la.” Asɛ Jekɔb kpɔ bwe bɛl pa bela ŋɔ bá kpɔ dɛɛ lii ba fɔo la.
Jekɔb ɡelɔ o bonɔɔna pa bwea a daŋɛ chɔ, asɛ Jekɔb ne Laban dɛ bonɔɔna la bwa pɛ so a jwɛh, dɛ di kwa.
Laban pa bela sɔn Jeɡar Sahaduta, asɛ Jekɔb ɡe pa o sɔn Galiid.
Belaa Laban ŋɔ Jekɔb be ŋɔ, “Bwea nɔ aa darawe dɔŋa nɛɛ nɔɔ dɛ́ lii ya nɛra banɛ nɔ fɔo la.” A waa ba pa bela sɔn Galiid, o munii danseɛ bwea la.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “Yaa dɛ peɡri dɔŋa baah nɔ, Korowii nyiŋi ya nɛ.” Asɛ dɛ pa bela sɔn Mispa.
Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ka dɛ fiiɡi n bihaahna nɔ kɛɛ dɛ ka mo haahna ja ba nɛ aa, a lole kɛŋɔ maa belaa do te, kɛ Korowii te ɛɛ nao.
Bwea aa darawe dɔŋa nɛɛ laanee nɔ, asɛ bwe maa kpɔa pa n ne he bwa kpɔ dɛɛ lii waa nɔ ɡee nɔ.
Bwea aa darawe dɔŋa nɛɛ nɔ ne onɔ maa kpɔa pa nɔɔ dɛɛ ba chɔe dɛ lii yaa.
Maa bwea nɔɔ ɡale dɛ́ ba yoi, hé ɡe bɛ an ɡale dɛ́ ba yoo mɛ.
Korowii ya nabaa Abraham ne Neehɔ aa tomɔ laanee dɛ́ bol ya baah waa dɛ́ pa bole.” Anomanta, Jekɔb ŋwɛɛ Korowii o mɛɛ Aesek aa ɔmɔ dɛ tomɔ la kɛŋɔ wɛɛ teŋɛ waa waa bola la taa.
O ɛ saraha deŋɡarere harɛ baa soɡa la ta, dɛ yerɛ o lolanar la ba ba di kondikwaa la.
Baa dia tonɛ la, ba chɔ bela awola jwaana.
Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Laban mo o bihaahna ne o naanar la lwɛrɛme, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba dɛ berɛ kaa o bwɛ.
Jekɔb kpɔ o te dɛ́ ka cheme Esɔ Jekɔb chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa, asɛ nyundua toroma ba chemo.
Waa na ba la, anee o ŋɔ, “Korowii soŋnibɔree bonɔ.” Asɛ dɛ pa bela sɔn Mahanaim.
Belaa Jekɔb tomɛ toroma ŋɔ bá tɔ o sie dɛ́ kaa o dɔɔ Esɔ be.
Dɛ Esɔ soɡe harɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Edom.
Jekɔb do toroma la ŋɔ bá ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔ Jekɔb ŋɔ, o kaa so Laban be, belaa o do dɛ ba le fini, o dɔ nae ne keeɡore, ne boohna ne peera dɛ nɛndɔɔla baala ne haahna bwa.
Taraken, o dɛ tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ ba ba bol hen haa ɛ o dɔɔ be, ásɛ he jemɛ o waa dɛ́ lɛo silɛɛ ne.” Toroma la aa bera ba la, ba baa bol o be ŋɔ, “Ya kaa bol he dɔɔ Esɔ be.
Baala lafraanaarɛ ja o nɛ do ŋwɛnɛ ta taraken dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba cheme.” Jekɔb aa no ɡɛ la, o ɔmɔ kohona o bwara yɔr, asɛ dɛ bɔne o nɛra la ne peera ne nae, dɛ nyoɡmare la bini bɔre anɛ.
O liiro kɛŋɔ dɛ Esɔ ba dɛ yo baŋ bɛl nɛra aa, ba kar la ɛɛ won dɔ bɔr dɛ́ chwa kaa.
Belaa o soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Korowii n nabaa Abraham ne n mɛɛ Aesek aa tomɛ, hen ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń berɛ kaa n bwɛ n lolanar bini, dɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ ɡeloo n wobɛlbwa do wer.
He teŋa haa teŋa dɛɛ nyin mɛ, ne he kasinteŋ haa ɡela n na nɔ bini bɛlbwa ta men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ chɛɛ.
N fa aa ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la, dɛ n ta komɛlbwa kpoŋe nemenɛ n daŋɡbala ɡbo, taraken he berɛ ɡel n ya dɛ ɛ nɛmbele banɛ.
N dɛ soŋe kɛŋɔ he lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔɔ Esɔ nɔn ta.
N dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ o bɛ yaa ba yo, dɛ́ kpoo n ne n haahna ne bii bwa.
Henee ŋɔa ŋɔ hɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar warɛ kɛŋɔ, mpo nyoa hɛŋle nomɛlbwa aa wola won kur ba.” Jekɔb chɔ bela awola jwaana la bwa, asɛ dɛ chale o kondɛɛra la bini ane dɛ́ kpɔ ka tɛ Esɔ.
O lawɛ bohneenanar lafraanɛ ne bombala fifraanɛ, peneenanar lafraanɛ dɛ pebala fifraanɛ, nyoɡma neenanar fifraatoro ne a bii, naneenanar fifraanaarɛ ne ambala ɡe fi ne keeɡo neenanar fifraanɛ dɛ ambala ɡe fi.
Kondɛɛra waa peɡri a bini la, o ŋɔ bá kpɔ ka tɛ o dɔɔ, a bɛlbwa kapa ne nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋa.
Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ o bonɔɔna la be ŋɔ, “Hé tɔ n sie, ásɛ dɛ ɡel he baahna tɛr.” O ŋɔ o bonɔɔ waa tɔ sie la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ n dɔɔ Esɔ cheme dɛ bɔɔre ŋɔ he dɔɔree umeo?
Leperaa hɛɛ kaa lɔ?
Ume kondɛɛraa he kpɔ dɛɛ kaa laa, he chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘He bonɔɔ Jekɔb kwaa.
O lawa ŋɔ ń kpɔ ka tɛ o dɔɔ Esɔ.
O ɡe lɔ mun ta dɛɛ ba.’ ” Gɛ tentenee o ŋɔ nɛn nɛɛte, ne toorote, ne banɔ la bwa waa kpɔ kondɛɛra do ba nɔn ta la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he cheme Esɔ aa, hé bwa ɡe ŋɔ o be ɡɛ.
Hé berɛ ɡel ó jemɛ kɛŋɔ o bonɔɔ Jekɔb ɡe lɔ habɔɔ dɛɛ ba.
Dɛ ń tɔ sie, dɛ́ kpɔ koŋkɛɛla nɔ ba tɛɛ, ásɛ mɔɔ o tel he be.
Ásɛ dɛ he nao waa, he ken ɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛɔ.” Ba kpɔ koŋkɛɛla la tɔ sie dɛ kaa asɛ o te berɛ chɔ bela waa choɡa la.
Jekɔb ne nyundua torome jwiira wa Awola jwaana ne la, o iro dɛ kpɔ o haahna banɛ Bilha ne Silpa, dɛ o toli banɛ ne o bii fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ la dɛ kpɔ ba le Jabɔk Moo leebɔɔ.
Waa kpɔ ba le nee la tonɛ la, o berɛ ba kpɔ komɛlbwa ɡe waa dɔa la ɡe le, asɛ dɛ ɡbo ka baŋ bela.
Belaa baa bɛl ba jwiiru, ba kpoŋe dɔŋa bini awola jwaana la ne, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ aa baa ka tama ásɛ bɔr chaah.
Baa la aa baa na kɛŋɔ waa won ɡo Jekɔb la, o kpɔ nɔn lɔ Jekɔb kɛɡra asɛ o sor.
Baa la ŋɔ, “Kpɔ mɛ ta n kaa, bɔr dɛ chaah.” Asɛ Jekɔb ŋɔ, “Maa hen ta, nemenɛ haa swee andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ mɔɔ.” Baa la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He sɔne ɛrɔɔ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “N sɔne Jekɔb.” Asɛ baa la berɛ ŋɔ, “He sɔne laa Jekɔb kpa.
He ne Korowii ne nɛwɛnyina yoo, ba ta wone pɔ he nɛ, anomanta, he sɔne Israel.” Jekɔb ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N poori, chaɡ mɛ he sɔn.” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa hɛɛ nyin dɛ́ jemɛ n sɔn nɔɔ?” Asɛ o swee andɛɛɡa tɛo bela.
Belaa o ŋɔ, “N na Korowii siwi ne dɛ ta so mkpa ta.” Anomanta, o pa bela sɔn Pɛneɛl.
Jekɔb aa le Pɛneɛl dɛɛ kaa la dɛ wee leɔ.
O kɛɡra la aa sora nomanta, dɛ o dɛ chole o ta.
Dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini Israel tena aa ol kɛɡra di.
Baa la aa kpɔ nɔn lɔ Jekɔb kɛɡra ta o sor la nomanta.
Jekɔb kaa cheme Esɔ Jekɔb aa dɛ kaa la, o ha sie dɛ na kɛŋɔ Esɔ ne o bonɔɔna lafraanaarɛ aa dɛ ba, asɛ Jekɔb bɔne o bii la bini tɛ o haahna Lea ne Rakɛl dɛ ba toli banɛ la.
O ɡelɔ o toli la lawɛ ba bii tɔ sie mɔɔ Lea ne o bii teŋɛ, asɛ Rakɛl ne Josef ka mun ta.
Jekɔb berɔ ka tɔ ba bwa sie, asɛ waa dɛ bɛne Esɔ la, o ba harɛ kera anuanɛ mɔɔ dɛ tel o be.
Esɔ aa nao la, o chwao dɛ ka ɡbaaro pɛl o te dɛ kpɔ o nɔɔra dawɛ o vaama ta dɛ mo o lwɛɛma, ba bwa berɛ wi.
Esɔ na haahna la ne bechale la, dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Aah bamewa ɡee ja he nɛɛ nɔɔ?” Asɛ Jekɔb chaŋe dɛ ŋɔ, “A ɡɛ bii nɔ, Korowiirii sune n nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ.” Anee o toli la ne ba bii ba ɡuŋi Esɔ harɛ, asɛ Lea ɡe ne o bii ba ɡuŋu, asɛ Josef ne Rakɛl ɡe ka mun dɛ ba ɡuŋu harɛ.
Esɔ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Nɛra maa chem ba ba kpɔ kondɛɛra damanta dɛɛ kaa la ɡe sɛ?” Anee Jekɔb chaŋe ŋɔ, “N kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba tɛɛ ásɛ he sie lɛ n nɛ.” Belaa Esɔ ŋɔ, “N nime dɛɛɡe, anɔ la n ɡbabir aa dɔa warɔ.
Gel a che tɛɛ.” Anee Jekɔb ɡe ŋɔ, “Akai, n dɛ soŋe dɛ he sie lɛ n nɛɛ tenaa he kpɔ.
Taraken maa nae nɔ, a denɔ ɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ maa na Korowii ken.
N poori, sɛh dɛ́ lɛ kwaa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛɛ nɔ.
Korowii cha mɛ kohona dɛ sune n nɛɛ asɛ dɛ tɛ mɛ komɛlbwa.” Ba bolɔ la sie kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ Esɔ ta ba lɛ.
Asɛ Esɔ ŋɔ, “Ya kaa.
Kɛ mɛɛ tɔ he siee.” Jekɔb ɡe berɔ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He nao kɛŋɔ n bii nɔ nɔn kao, asɛ n peera ne nae ne a bii aa dɛ ɔr la bwa ɡe waa hiah mɛ.
Maa won kpɔa valɛ kohona tɔpebir a ba serewe.
Amɔ tɔ sie ásɛ n ɡe ne n nae nɔ ne n bii nɔ valɛ tama tama ka tel kɛŋɔ yaa ba he be Edom.” Anee Esɔ ŋɔ, “Amɔ mɛɛ ɡel n bonɔɔna nɔ bini banee tɛɛ he ne baa ba.” Asɛ Jekɔb ŋɔ, “Bonɔɔna la ɡela dɛ tɛ mɛ te waa ta hiaeh.
Nyinaa mɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he sie lɛ n nɛ.” Awola tenten la, Esɔ ne o bonɔɔna la chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ kaa Edom harɛ ta.
Kɛ Jekɔb te kaa Sukot harɛ ta, dɛ ka do o dea, asɛ dɛ do patare tɛ o kondɛɛra ɡe.
A waa ba pa bela sɔn Sukot la.
O munii patare.
Waa le Mɛsopoteemea la, o kaa bwɛjen Sɛkem waa lɔ Keenan harɛ ta, dɛ ka baŋre o tɛnte dea bɛne bwɛjen la.
O yawɛ harɛ waa baŋre o tɛnte dea o ta la suuɡapoŋa lafa le Sɛkem mɛɛ Hamɔ bii be.
O ɛ kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii bela, asɛ dɛ pa o sɔn ‘Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ’.
Daena ne Sɛkem tena wa Awola bɛl, Jekɔb ne o haah Lea bihaah Daena iro ŋɔ o dɛ la ka chɔɔ Keenan haahna bane.
Hivi tena Kooro Hamɔ bibaa Sɛkem nao dɛ lawɔ, dɛ ɡuɡru o ne o chɔ.
Dɛ o sie lɛ bitolo la nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ o bambile lawɔ wɛɛ di o deŋna.
Sɛkem ŋɔ o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ, n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he ka nyin Daena tɛ mɛ ń mo.” Dɛ Jekɔb noɔ kɛŋɔ Sɛkem ɡuɡri o bihaah Daena o ne o chɔ, kɛ bela la, o ta wobɛlbwa chaŋɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o bibaala la kaa nae ne dibɔr ba ta balɛ mɔɔ.
Kooro Hamɔ la Jekɔb be o ne o ka bol wa, dɛ Jekɔb bii la ɡe denɔ le kpɔɡ bini ba.
Baa baa no waa la la, a we ba nɛ, asɛ ba baah di kohona kɛŋɔ Sɛkem aa ɛ wedoŋa dɛ nyiŋi Israel tena nyubaah kɛŋɔ waa ɡuɡri ba nimambie o ne o chɔ la.
Belaa Kooro Hamɔ ŋɔ Jekɔb be ŋɔ, “N bie Sɛkem dɛ nyin he bie Daena.
N poori, kpɔɔ tɛ mɛ n tɛo ó mo.
Gel ya nyoa pɛ yaa mo he bihaahna, ásɛ he ɡe ɛɛ mo ya kwa.
Hɛɛ won so ya be bonɔ, harɛ ɡee dena chɔ kaa la.
Hɛɛ won ka so bobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin, dɛɛ di bona dɛ́ dɔ kwa.” Asɛ Sɛkem ŋɔ Daena mɛɛ ne o dɔɔranar be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ sɛoh dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ tɛ mɛ naa, komɛlbwa haa lɛ la, mɛɛ tɛ heyaa.
Hé chaɡle kwaa haa ŋɔ ń kpɔ ba ɛ haah la bwara wa.
Hé baɡle ɡɛ bwa haa dɛ ba lɛɛ, ásɛ n bɔ tɛ heya, he sɛoh kɛŋɔ n moo ɡbosoroo tenaa.” Sɛkem aa ɡuɡri ba nimambie Daena o ne o chɔ nomanta, Jekɔb bii la neɡre o ne o mɛɛ Hamɔ.
Ba ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Yaa won ɛ ɡɛ.
Yaa sɛh ya nimambie yalɛ baa waa wola o pen teŋe.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ sihihwa dɛ tɛ yaa.
Waa aa ɡel ya sɛh laanee kɛŋɔ, hé ɡel he bibaala bwa teŋni ba pena kɛ yan.
Ate naa, aa maɡroo kɛŋɔ ya mo dɔŋa bihaahna.
Ya ne hɛɛ pɛo so dɛ́ ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ.
Dɛ he ta penteŋ la ta sɛɛh tenaa, yaa kpɔ ya nimambiee dɛ́ ir harɛ nɔ ta kaa.” Waa baa bola la wer dɛ tɛ Hamɔ ne o bie Sɛkem.
Sɛkem aa dɛ nyin tolo la kohona nomanta, o ta waa la kpɔe tuuɡi harɛ.
Dɛ o waa dɔ nyɛl ɡwaa nɛra baa lɔ o mɛɛ dem bela bwa.
Kooro Hamɔ ne o bie Sɛkem la ba bwɛɛ la doonyoa baa soɡa dɛɛ bol waa la, dɛ ka cheme bwɛɛ la tena dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya ne nɛra la som, hé ɡel ba so dɛɛ ɛ ba toma.
Harɛ la kan ba dɔ bɔr dɛ so.
Yaa wonoo mo ba bii, ásɛ ba ɡe mo ya kwa.
Dɛ yaa ɛ waa baa kpɔ bil ya sie yaa, anee dɛ́ ɡel ba sɛh ya ne ba so.
Anee kɛ yaa teŋe ya pena kɛ ban.
A ba ɡɛ naa, ba kondɛɛra ne komɛlbwa aa ya kwaa ɛa?
Hé ɡel ya sɛh ásɛ ya ne ba so.” Bwɛɛ la tena bwa sɛh waa Hamɔ ne o bie Sɛkem aa bola la ta, asɛ ba teŋni bwɛɛ la baala bwa pena.
Baa teŋni ba pena tɔpetooro wee a ta ɛɛ wee ba la, Jekɔb bibaala banɛ baa dɛ yer ba Simeon ne Lewi, ba ne Daena aa pɛ nya la iro kpɔ ba tokobie, asɛ dɛ piɡri bwɛɛ la tena dɛ jo ba bini dɛ kpoo ba baala te bwa.
Ba kpo Kooro Hamɔ ne o bie Sɛkem ɡe, dɛ lawɛ Daena le Sɛkem dem bela dɛ kpɔɔ kaa.
Baa kpoo ba tonɛ la, Jekɔb bibaala baa kaa la jo bwɛɛ la bini dɛ pa ba komɛlbwa dɛ kpɔ tɔ ɡuɡra baa ɡuɡri ba nimambie dɛ lawɔ chɔ la wel.
