Ba larawe peera ne nae, keeɡore ne kwaa aa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta, dɛ ka pa ba kooni kwaa bwa ɡe, ne kondɔɔhkwaa te bwa ne haahna ne bechale, asɛ dɛ pa ba deene bini laala bwa dɛ chea kaa.
Asɛ Jekɔb ŋɔ Simeon ne Lewi be ŋɔ, “He nyin waa dɛ ba dawɛ n nɛ, dɛ ɡel dɔm ba chɔ n ne Keenan ne Pɛrɛs tena baa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta la baah ta.
Yaa wola kanɛ nɔ, dɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ kaa pɛ nyoa ŋɔ bá ba yoo mɛ naa, amɔ dɛ ya bwaa dena dɛɛ ba hee laɔ.” Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Yaa won so nyiŋi ba ɛ ya nimambie kɛŋɔ hanjwamane.”
Jekɔb bera dɛ ba Bɛtel Anee Korowii ŋɔ Jekɔb be ŋɔ, “Ir kaa Bɛtel ásɛ dɛ ka so bela.
Dɛ́ ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la tɛ men Korowii maa kpɔ n te baɡle ɡɛ saŋ haa chwaa dɛ le he dɔɔ Esɔ be la.” Anomanta, Jekɔb ŋɔ o haahna ne o bii ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ harɛfala voɡa haa dɔa la bwa ta, dɛ́ sɔ he doŋa bɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ charɛ he laala.
Ya dɛ ba bonɔ ira dɛ́ kaa Bɛtel ka so.
Mɛɛ ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o taa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii waa cha mɛ ɡɛ saŋ waa puu mɛ dɛ ja n nɛɛ bobɛlbwa maa laŋa la.” Anomanta, ba pa ba voɡa aa lɔ ba be la bwa ne deŋna kwaa baa doa la tɛ Jekɔb.
Asɛ o huɡe a ɡɛ laala la bwa dajen bɛl waa cheɡa bɛne bwɛjen Sɛkem la mun.
Jekɔb ne o bii aa dɛ ba bela ira la, Korowii ɡelɔ ɔmee kohona chole nɛra baa lɔ bwɛɛre aa bɛne bela tena bwa nɛ ba ta wone ti ba dɛ ɛɛ ba wobɛlbwa.
O ne o nɛra bwa ba Keenan harɛ ta bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Lus, baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Bɛtel taraken la.
Asɛ dɛ ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii bela, dɛ pa bela sɔn El Bɛtel.
O munii Bɛtel Korowii.
Dɛkalkɛ Korowii kpɔ o te baɡlo ŋwɛnɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ waa chwaa dɛɛ le o dɔɔ be la.
Dɛbora waa dɛɛ Rebɛka o bechale saŋ sewɔ, asɛ ba huɡo dajen bɛl mun Bɛtel.
Anomanta, o pa bela sɔn Alɔn Bakut.
Jekɔb aa le Mɛsopoteemea ba la, Korowii berɔ kpɔ o te baɡlo dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛo.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He sɔne Jekɔb, kɛ le fini dɛɛ kaa baa hen ɡɛɛ yerɛ kpa, baa berɔ dɛɛ yerɛ Israel.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii Maa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la.
Hɛɛ yao dɛ́ warɛ kohona.
He luɡe taa harɛre nɛra ɛɛ ba lee, ásɛ koranar le ba bini.
Harɛ maa kpɔa baɡɛ he nabaa Abraham ne he mɛɛ Aesek nyoa la, he ne he naanar baa ka ba habɔɔ laanee mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ.” Asɛ Korowii ɡelo bela dɛ kaa.
Jekɔb kpɔ bwe bɛl pa bela dɛ kpɔ lii o ne Korowii waa baa ɛa, dɛ fuɡe sen ɛ saraha bwe la ta, dɛ berɛ fuɡe noo ɛ o ta tɛ Korowii.
Dɛ pa bela sɔn Bɛtel.
Rakɛl ne Aesek seo wa Asɛ ba ir Bɛtel dɛ kaa.
Baa dɛ kaa a ka tama ba tel bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Efrat la, loltea lɔ Rakɛl.
Asɛ a do kpeɡri.
O lola bini aa dɛ do kpeɡri la, haah waa dɛ lɛo lol la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɔmɛ, bibaalee hɛɛ ba lola ja.” Dɛ Rakɛl dɛ ba sewa, anomanta, o pa bie la sɔn Bɛn Oni.
Bɛn Oni munii n wenaale bie.
Asɛ o mɛɛ ɡe pa o sɔn Bɛnjamen.
Bɛnjamen munii n nɔndiɡ bie.
Rakɛl aa sewa la, ba huɡo bwɛɛ Efrat la ŋwɛnɛ nyoa.
Ba berɔ dɛɛ yerɔ Bɛtlɛham.
Jekɔb kpɔ bwe bɛl pa Rakɛl ŋwam la ta o ta do le ba le fini.
Jekɔb berɔ ir dɛ ka baŋre o tɛnte dea bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Ida Dejaŋ bɛl baŋ.
Waa kaa so harɛ la ta la, Rubin kaa lawɛ tolo baa dɛ yerɔ Bilha baa lawa tɛ o mɛɛ o ɛ o sɛno la chɔ, asɛ Jekɔb no.
Bii fi dɛ banɛɛ Jekɔb lolɛ.
Lea bii waa lol ba laanee nɔ.
Rubin, onee binomoa, dɛ Simeon ne Lewi ne Juda ne Isaaka dɛ Sebulon.
Rakɛl ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Josef ne Bɛnjamen.
Rakɛl tolo Bilha bibaalaa nɔ, Dan ne Naftale.
Lea ɡe tolo Silpa bibaalaa nɔ, Gad ne Aasa.
Mɛsopoteemea harɛ taa ba lolɛ Jekɔb bibaala fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ nɔ bwa.
Asɛ Jekɔb la o mɛɛ Aesek be Mamre, waa bɛne Hɛbrɔn bela Abraham ne Aesek fa aa soɡa ka la.
Aesek di bene lafa fifraanuatoro mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ.
Asɛ o bii Esɔ ne Jekɔb huɡo.
Esɔ naanar wa Kenii Esɔ baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Edom la bii ne o naanar waa do.
Esɔ mo haahna batoro baa ɛ Keenan tena.
Bɛl sɔne Ada, o mɛɛ ɛ Hiti te baa yerɔ Ɛlɔn, hanɛɛte ɡe sɔne Oholibama, o mɛɛ sɔne Ana.
O nabaa sɔne Sibeon o ɛ Hivi te.
O hantoorote sɔne Basemat, o mɛɛ sɔne Ismael, o nimambie sɔne Nɛbayɔt.
Ada lolɛ bie baa yerɔ Elifas, asɛ Basemat ɡe lolɛ bɛl baa yerɔ Ruwɛl.
Oholibama lolɛ bibaala batoro baa yer ba Jeyus ne Jalam dɛ Kora.
Bii Esɔ aa lol ba Keenan harɛ ta laanee la.
Esɔ kpɔ o haahna ne bibaala ne bihaahna, o dem tena bwa ne o kondɛɛra, ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa Keenan harɛ la ta bwa le o nime Jekɔb jwɛh dɛ kaa harɛfale bɛl ta ka so.
Dɛkalkɛ dɛ harɛ o ne Jekɔb aa soɡe o ta la aa kanɛ tɛɛ ba.
Ba dɔ kondɛɛra asɛ a ya, anomanta, dɛ a chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa nyin bofale dɛ́ ka so o kwaa ne.
Asɛ Esɔ ka so Edom harɛ ta deŋɡarere ta.
Kenii Esɔ waa ɛ Edom tena naa la bii ne o naanar teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Esɔ bibaala waa lol ba laanee teŋa nɔ.
O haah Ada lolɛ Elifas, asɛ Basemat ɡe lolɛ Ruwɛl.
Elifas bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Teman ne Omar ne Sefo ne Gatam dɛ Kenas.
Esɔ bibaa Elifas berɔ dɔ sɛno bɛl baa yerɔ Timna, asɛ dɛ lolɛ Amalɛk.
Banɔ bwa ɛ Esɔ haah Ada naanar.
Ruwɛl bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Nahat ne Sɛra ne Samaa dɛ Misa.
Banɔ bwa ɛ Esɔ haah Basemat ɡe naanar.
Esɔ haah Oholibama, waa ɛ Ana bihaah, dɛ berɛ ɛ Sibeon naa la bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Jeyus ne Jalam dɛ Kora.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ aa teŋa nɔ ɛ koranar Esɔ naanar bini.
Esɔ biloɡle Elifas bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Teman ne Omar ne Sefo dɛ Kenas, ne Kora ne Gatam dɛ Amalɛk.
Banɔɔ ɛ Elifas naanar dɛ ɛ koranar dɛ so Edom.
Ba berɔ ɛ Ada ɡe naanar.
Esɔ bibaa Ruwɛl bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Nahat ne Sɛra ne Samaa dɛ Misa.
Banɔɔ ɛ Esɔ haah Basemat naanar dɛ ɛ koranar dɛ so Edom.
Esɔ haah Oholibama bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Jeyus ne Jalam dɛ Kora.
Banɔɔ ɛ Esɔ haah Oholibama naanar dɛ ɛ koranar.
Oholibama nya sɔne Ana.
Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Esɔ bibaala, dɛ bwa ɛ koranar.
Sɛɛ waa ɛ Hɔr te bibaala waa lol ba asɛ ba so Edom laanee, Lotan ne Sobal ne Sibeon dɛ Ana, ne Dison ne Esa dɛ Disan.
A ɡɛ Sɛɛ bibaala nɔ, dɛ ba ɛ Hɔr tena koranar dɛ so Edom.
Lotan ɡe bibaalaa, Hɔr ne Homam.
Dɛ Lotan nimambie sɔne Timna.
Sobal ɡe bibaalaa, Alvan ne Manahat ne Ebal ne Sɛfo dɛ Onam.
Sibeon ɡe bibaalaa, Aeya ne Ana.
A ɡɛ Ana nɔ kaa na newɔb a bule dɛɛ le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, ɡɛ saŋ dɛ o dɛ nyiŋi o mɛɛ Sibeon keeɡore ta.
Ana bii waa lol ba laanee, Dison ne Oholibama waa ɛ Ana bihaah la.
Dison ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ, o bibaalaa, Hɛmdan ne Ɛsban ne Itran dɛ Keran.
Asɛ Esa ɡe bibaalaa, Bilhan ne Saavan dɛ Akan.
Disan ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ, bibaalaa nɔ, Us ne Aran.
Hɔr tena koranaree, Lotan ne Sobal ne Sibeon dɛ Ana, ne Dison ne Esa dɛ Disan.
Banɔ nɔɔ Hɔr tena koranar ɡɛ ba fa aa soɡe ba harɛre ta Edom harɛ ta la.
Edom koranar Koranar baa tɔ sie di Edom kora, mɔɔ Israel te bɛlbwa ɡe ba di la sɔnaa teŋa nɔ.
Beɔ bibaa Bɛla di kora Edom.
Dɛ o bwɛjen sɔne Dinhaba.
Kooro Bɛla aa baa sewɛ la, Sɛra bibaa Jobab waa le bwɛjen Bosra baa so o buɡ ta.
Kooro Jobab ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Husam waa le Teman harɛ taa baa di kora.
Asɛ Kooro Husam ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Bɛdad bibaa Hadad ɡee baa chiɡ o naa ta di kora.
Onee fa yo Midian tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ Moab harɛ ta la.
O bwɛjen sɔne Avit.
Kooro Hadad ɡe baa sewɛ, asɛ Samla waa le bwɛjen Masrɛka ba di kora.
Kooro Samla ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Swaul waa le Rɛhɔbɔt waa chɔa bɛne nee laanee baa di kora.
Kooro Swaul ɡe baa sewɛ, asɛ Akbɔ bibaa Baal Hanan ɡe ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Kooro Baal Hanan ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Hadad chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Dɛ o bwɛjen sɔne Pau.
O haah ɡe sɔne Mɛhetabɛl, o ɛ Matrɛd bihaah.
Matrɛd ɡe nya sɔne Mɛsahab.
Gɛɛ koranar baa le Esɔ be pera ɡe waa do.
Ba sɔna ne ba deene ta ne ɡɛ baa soɡaa nɔ.
Timna ne Alva dɛ Jetɛt, ne Oholibama ne Ɛla dɛ Penɔn ne Kenas ne Teman dɛ Mibsar ne Maɡdiel dɛ Iram.
Banee di kora Edom.
Gɛ baa sosoɡa ba harɛre ta ne ɡɛ bɛlbwa wobol baa dɛ bol laanee la.
Esɔ ɛ ba bwa naa.
Josef ne o dɔɔranar wa Jekɔb soɡe Keenan harɛ ta, bela o mɛɛ fa aa soɡa la.
Kenii o bii ne o naanar waa do, Jekɔb bie Josef aa di bene fi dɛ anuanɛ la, dɛ o ne o dɔɔranar dɛ nyiŋi kondɛɛra ta.
O mɛɛ haahna banɛ baa dɛ yer ba Bilha ne Silpa la biirii ban.
Josef yon ba taa dichɔɡa o dɔɔranar aa dɛ di o mɛɛ be.
Dɛ Josef ɛ Jekɔb banjenbie, anomanta, dɛ o dɛ nyin o waa ɡwaa o bii la bwa.
Asɛ o nyarɛ batakaarejaŋ ondɛɛɡe bɛl baa di ɡwini dawɛ o ta tɛo.
O dɔɔranar aa baa na kɛŋɔ o mɛɛ dɛ nyin o waa dɛ ɡwaa ba la, ba haoh, baa on sie tɛ kwaraa.
Awola jwaana bɛl Jekɔb deero dɛ taa baɡle o dɔɔranar.
A taa ba haoh kohona kwara.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n deera nɔ.
Ya dɛ vɔwɛ jaaɡe koo ta, asɛ bɛlbwa bil o kwaa dɛɛ korɛ.
Belaa n kwaa maa vɔwa la ir che, asɛ he kwaa la ba bar n kwaa la cheme dɛɛ ɡuŋa.” Asɛ o dɔɔranar la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Amɔ he dɛ lii kɛ he dɛ ba bá di kora dɛ́ nyiŋi ya nɛɛ kɛɛ?” Belaa o haeh la berɛ ɡwaa kohona kwara.
O berɔ dee anfala ja dɛ taa baɡle o dɔɔranar la ŋɔ, “Hé no, n deero asɛ wee ne korobie dɛ weweela fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ ɡuŋ mɛ.” Josef aa taa ɡɛ waa nɔ o mɛɛ ne o dɔɔranar be la, o mɛɛ kaoh dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa ɡe deeraa do ken?
Amɔ n ne he nya ne he dɔɔranar ɛɛ bao dɛ́ ba ɡuŋi kɛɛ?” Ate, o dɔɔranar la bwaawee ir o nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ o mɛɛ te kpɔ waa la do o nyu bini.
Josef dɔɔranar yoɡu Awola bɛl, o dɔɔranar la kpɔ o mɛɛ kondɛɛra la kaa dibɔr Sɛkem pera, asɛ Jekɔb ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ, “He dɔɔranar kpɔ kondɛɛra kaa dibɔr Sɛkem pera, n dɛ́ tomɛ ba be.” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ, mɛɛ lao.” O mɛɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “La dɛ́ ka na he dɔɔranar ne ɡɛ kondɛɛra la aa doa, ásɛ dɛ ba bol n be.” O tomɔ le Hɛbrɔn Fɛlembɔjen bɔr pera dɛ kaa Sɛkem.
Waa le Sɛkem dɛ kaa ɡaaɡe ba bɔr la, baa bɛl nao kɛŋɔ waa lɔ kpɔɡ bini bela dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
Asɛ dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin bonɔ nɔ?” Asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “N dɔɔranar ne ba kondɛɛra bɔree mɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
N poori, hɛɛ won chaɡ mɛ bela baa lole naa?” Baa la chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ba le bonɔ.
N noɔ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ ba kaa Dotan.” Anomanta, o ti o dɔɔranar la dɛ ka na ba Dotan bela.
Waa dɛ tel bela la, o dɔɔranar la te tɔ sie nao kɛŋɔ o taa lɔ bojaŋ.
O ne bela tela la, dɛ ba te vɔrɔwɔ tonɛ kɛŋɔ ba kpoo.
Ba ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Deera te laanee ka dɛ ba la.
Hé ba ya kpoo, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ta kɔlɔŋ nɔ bɛl nee aa wola toole o bini nɔ bini, dɛ́ ka ŋɔ olchɔɡe bɛl lawɔ chwe, dɛ́ na ɡɛ o deera waa deera la aa dɛ ba chiɡa.” Rubin takapɔ kɛŋɔ o fee lɛo ta, dɛ ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡel ya kpoo.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “He bɛ on kpo.
Hé kpɔɔ ta kɔlɔŋ nɔ bɛl bini.” Gɛ aa ɛ o won lɛo le ba nɔn ta, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka tɛ ba mɛɛ la waa o bol ɡɛ.
Josef aa tel o dɔɔranar la be la, ba laa o batakaarejaŋ ondɛɛɡe baa di ɡwini dawɛ o ta la wur, dɛ kpɔɔ ka ta kɔlɔŋ la bini.
Dɛ nee bɛlbwa toole o bini.
Ba soɡo dɛɛ di kwa, belaa ba ha sie nyiŋi, dɛ na Ismael bonadiire ne ba nyoɡmare aa cheɡɛ konsɔɔhsoma baa dɛ fuah, ne dapɛɡa ane baa dɛ ɛ ane tɛɛɡa, ne korobo le Gelead harɛ baa kaa Ijipt harɛ.
Anee Juda ŋɔ o bala la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ ya kpo ya nime nɔ dɛ tɔ a ta naa, bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ yaa ba dɔe yɔ?
Hé ɡel ya yoɡu tɛ Ismael tena nɔ dɛ bɛ o haakɛ lɛ, o ɛ ya nime, ya bini bɛlee.” Asɛ ba sɛh ɡɛ waa bola la ta.
Bonadiire la aa tel ba be la, o dɔɔranar la lawɔ le kɔlɔŋ la bini, dɛ yoɡu tɛɛ ba suuɡapoŋa fifraanɛ, asɛ ba kpɔɔ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta.
Rubin aa bera la kɔlɔŋ la ta dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ o toole bela la, asɛ o laa o batakaare kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛŋɔ o loo kuu.
O berɔ ba o bala la be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “N nime la toole bela!
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?” Anee ba kpo booh la bɛl, dɛ kpɔ Josef batakaare la mili o chal la, asɛ dɛ kpɔ ka chaɡle ba mɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Batakaare nɔɔ ya na, nyiŋi na kɛŋɔ he bie la kon laanee kɛɛ?” Waa nyiŋa na la, o jemɔ asɛ dɛ chaŋe ŋɔ, “N bie batakaaree kpela!
Olchɔɡe bɛl lawɔ chwe, o ka toɡri o bini.” Belaa Jekɔb loo ku o laa o batakaare kɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ lweyal tɔ dɛ ɛ o bie la lwe dɛ la sie.
Asɛ o bii ne o lolanar bwa ba dɛ ba larawe o bwara.
Kɛ o ta larawa la noɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “N wii nɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ kaa n bie be lalabwɛ.” Anomanta, o wi o bie la kɛrɛdɛ.
Ismael bonadiire la ɡe yoɡ Josef tɛ Ijipt te Pɔtefa.
O ɛ Ijipt harɛ ta kooro laa tena baa dɛ daah o dem la bwa nomoa.
Juda ne Taama A ɡɛ saŋ la, Juda ɡel o bala la, dɛ ka so Hira be, bwɛɛ Adulam ta.
Waa kaa so bela la, o na bihaah bɛl dɛ moo, o mɛɛ ɛ Keenan te baa yerɔ Sua.
Juda ne haah la kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Ɛr.
A habɔɔ, o ne o kpoŋe tea ja dɛ lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Onan.
O berɔ lolɛ bibaa ja, asɛ dɛ pa o sɔn Seela.
Gɛ saŋ baa lolɔ la, dɛ ba soɡe bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kesib.
Baa lɔ bela la, Juda mo haah tɛ o binomoa Ɛr.
Haah la sɔne Taama.
Dɛ Ɛr ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ Korowii be, asɛ Korowii kpoo.
Anee Juda ŋɔ Onan be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he dɔɔ haah mo, dɛ́ lolɛ bii tɛo o mun bɛ he.” Dɛ Onan jemɔ kɛŋɔ a ɡɛ bii la aa won ɛ o kwa, anomanta, o ne haah la chɔɔ waa, o bane aa dɛ ba la, ɡɛɛ o ɡel a ba ta harɛ, ásɛ o bɛ won kpoŋe tea, dɛ́ lolɛ bii ba ɛ o dɔɔ kwa.
Korowii be la, dɛ a ɡɛ liire nɔ ɛ wechɔɡa, asɛ dɛ kpo o ɡe.
Belaa Juda ŋɔ o hela Taama be ŋɔ, “Kaa ka so doŋa ta he mɛɛ dem, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ n bie Seela aa baa kpeɡ.” O liiro kɛŋɔ o ɡe ken ɛɛ ba sewɔɔ kɛŋɔ o dɔɔranar.
Asɛ haah la kaa o mɛɛ dem dɛ ka so.
Aa baa la sie la, Juda haah sewɔ.
Waa baa dɔ bolarawa tonɛ la, o ne o dam Hira waa le Adulam la Temna, bela baa dɛ fonɛ o peera pona.
Belaa nomɛl ŋɔ Taama be ŋɔ, “He helabaa dɛ ba ba kaa Temna dɛ ka fonɛ o peera pona.” Asɛ o foo o laala waa doa so doŋa ta la bil, dɛ kpɔ kon waa chaahna bɔle nyu, dɛ ka so bwɛɛ Enaem doonyoa, Temna ŋwɛnɛ ta.
Dɛkalkɛ dɛ o nao kɛŋɔ Seela kpeɡo, asɛ ba ɡe ta on kpɔe tɛo ŋɔ o yalɔ.
Juda aa fɛra baa kaa Timna la, o nao kɛŋɔ waa kpɔ kon bɔle o nyu dɛ so, dɛ liiru hanjwamane bɛl.
Belaa o pere kpɔ o be dɛ ŋɔ, “Gel n ne he ka chɔ,” Dɛ waa jemɛ kɛŋɔ o hela Taamaa.
Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Aah bɔkwaa hɛɛ ba n tɛɛ mɔɔ n ne he chɔɔ?” Asɛ Juda ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba lawɛ bombie ba tɛɛ.” Anee haah la ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ mɛ ń cheɡ ka tel saŋ haa ba o ne nɔ?” Anee Juda ɡe bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa konee hɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ n kpɔ tɛɛ he cheɡ ɔ?” O ŋɔ, “He noniseɡ he sɔn aa dawɛ o ta ne he daŋɡbala.” Ate, o kpɔa tɛo mɔɔ o ne o ta chɔ, asɛ o kpoŋe tea.
Baa chɔa tonɛ la, haah la iro dɛ ka laa kon waa kpɔa bɔle o nyu la kpɔ bil, dɛ kpɔ laala waa kpɔa so doŋa ta la do.
Juda aa kaala la, o kaa kpɔ bombie la tomɛ o dam Hira waa ɛ Adulam te la ŋɔ, ó kpɔ ba tɛ haah la dɛ́ lɛ kwaa waa kpɔa tɛo o cheɡ la ba.
Waa laŋa la, o ta haah la ka pue bela.
O kaa pu baala bane bela asɛ dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Leperaa hanjwamane bɛl o fa aa soɡe Enaem doonyoa bonɔ la dɔɔ?” Asɛ ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Hanjwamane bɛlbwa toole bonɔ.” Asɛ o berɛ la Juda be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Maa laŋa la, n ta on nae, asɛ dɛ bɔɔ baala bane baa lɔ bela o wa, ba ɡe ŋɔ hanjwamane bɛlbwa toole bela.” Belaa Juda chaŋe ŋɔ, “Gel laala la do o be.
Ya bɛ a waa ta teŋɛ nɛra ba na dɛ mamɛ yaa.
N lawɛ bombie tɛɛ ŋɔ he ka tɛo he ta on pue yaa, anee ɡɛ.” Dɛ ɛ korobie atoro habɔɔ nomɛl ba ŋɔ Juda be ŋɔ, “He helahaah kaa bɔ jwamane dɛ kpoŋe tea.” Belaa o ŋɔ, “He lawɔ le dɛ́ ka fuuh!” Baa lawɔ dɛɛ le la, anee o ŋɔ bá ka ŋɔ o helabaa Juda be ŋɔ, “Naate waa dɔ a ɡɛ noniseɡ ne daŋɡbala nɔ laanee do mɛ tea la.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ ba nyiŋi kwaa la dɛ́ na naate aa ɛ o kwa.
Juda ɡe nao kɛŋɔ onee, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Haah la waa toɡrɔ ɡwaa mɛ.
N na n wechɔɡa maa ɛa kɛŋɔ maa wola ɡelɛ o yalɛ n bibaa Seela la.” A habɔɔ la, o ta o be laŋɛ kpa.
Loltea aa baa lɔɔ la, ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ kparaa wɛɛ ba lola.
Waa dɛ ba lola la, bii la bɛl tɔ sie kpɔ o nɔn le, asɛ haah waa dɛ lɛo lol la kpɔ jiseswɛm vɔwɛ o nɔn la ta dɛ ŋɔ “Onɔɔ tɔ sie.” Waa kpɔ jiseswɛm la vɔwɛ o nɔn tonɛ la, bie la berɔ kpɔ jo, asɛ nɛɛte la berɛ tɔ sie ba.
Asɛ haah waa dɛ lɛo lol la ŋɔ, “Amɔ ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta dɛ ba laanee nɔ kenɛ?” Asɛ o pa o sɔn Pɛrɛs.
Dɛ berɛ lolɛ onɔ la jiseswɛm aa vɔwɛ o nɔn la.
Asɛ ba pa o sɔn Sɛra.
Josef ne Pɔtefa haah wa Ismael tena la kpɔ Josef kaa Ijipt, dɛ ka yoɡu tɛ Pɔtefa waa ɛ Ijipt kooro nɛra baa dɛ daahno la nomonome la bɛl.
Korowii teŋɛ Josef nɛ, anomanta, o ɡelɔ o wobɛlbwa do wer tɛo asɛ o so nomoa la dem.
O nomoa la ɡe nao kɛŋɔ Korowii teŋɛ o nɛ dɛ ɡel o wobɛlbwa do wer tɛo.
Anomanta, Pɔtefa sie lɛ o nɛ asɛ dɛ kpɔɔ ɛ o bonɔɔ, dɛ ɡel wɛɛ nyiŋi o dem ne o komɛlbwa waa dɔa ta.
Dɛ le a ɡɛ saŋ nomoa la aa kpɔ o dem do o nɔn ta la, Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ nomoa la ne o dem komɛlbwa dɛ o koo kwa.
Pɔtefa kpɔ komɛlbwa do o nɔn ta dɛ laa liire kpɔ a ta.
Kwaa waa dɛ lii a waa kondikwa waa di ɡbo.
Dɛ Josef mao kɛrɛdɛ dɛ do wer bonɔɔ ɡe.
Aa ba dɛ la sie la, Pɔtefa haah pɛla lawɛ Josef dɛ ŋɔ o ne o chɔ.
Kɛ Josef ta sɛɛh, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ o nomoa haah la be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ aa dɛ yarada mɛ kohona nomanta, o kpɔ komɛlbwa waa lɔ o dem bonɔ, ne o komɛlbwa waa dɔa do n nɔn ta, waa wola a waa lii kpa.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ dɔ kpeɡri n nɛɛ dem bonɔ nemenɛ on.
O ta komɛlbwa ɡe waa lɔ dem bonɔ kpɔe sɔɔh mɛ, nemenɛ he ɡbosoroo dɛkalkɛ o haahnee hen.
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona ɛ a ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ dɔŋa dɛ́ jo Korowii nɛɔ?” Dɛ tɔperee bwaa o swe dɛɛ marɛ Josef nɛɛ ŋɔ o ne o chɔ asɛ o yon vɛh, hale waa o jwɛɛh kwaraa la.
Awola bɛl, Josef lɔ dem bela dɛɛ ɛ o toma.
Dɛ dem bela bonɔɔna la bɛlbwa toole.
Belaa haah la ta lawɛ o yal kpoŋe dɛ ŋɔ, “Gel n ne he chɔ.” O ta sɛɛh, dɛ yo lɛ o te dɛ chwa le buse, asɛ a ka o yal la do haah la nɔn ta.
Haah la aa naa kɛŋɔ o ɡel o yal la do o nɔn ta kaa la, o yerɛ bonɔɔna baa lɔ dem bela la dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé no waa nɔ.
Hibru te nɔ n jaa aa kaa lawɛ ba dem bonɔ nɔ dɛ ɛ yaa sisawa.
O baa jo n be dea ŋɔ o fee paɡ mɛ, asɛ n do lɔŋɔ kohona.
Maa dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ɡɛ la, o chwao le a ka o yal chɔ n jwɛh.” Haah la kpɔ yal la cheɡ, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ Pɔtefa aa bala.
Belaa o bol waa la o be dɛ ŋɔ, “Hibru te bonɔɔ haa ba o ne dem bonɔ la ba n be dea dɛ ba ɛɛ mɛ chɔɡa wa.
Kɛ maa do lɔŋɔ la, o chwao le buse warane dɛ ɡel o yal.” Pɔtefa aa no ɡɛ la, o baah diu dɛ ɡel ba ka lawɛ Josef ba do dea, bela kooro aa lawɛ nɛra dɛɛ do la, asɛ o chɔ bela.
Kɛ Korowii teŋɛ o nɛ, dɛ tɛo jirima dɛ ɛo kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ɡel nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ dea bela la sie lɛ o nɛ.
Anomanta, o kpɔɔ ɛ o bala baa do ba dea la bwa nomoa, asɛ wɛɛ nyiŋi ba wobɛlbwa baa dɛ ɛa bela ta.
Korowii aa dɛ nyin Josef waa dɛɛ nyin kɛ o wobɛlbwa do wer tɛo la nomanta, o ɡelɔ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la laa o sie kpɔ waa Josef aa chɔ a nyoa la ta.
Ijipt kooro sendoo ne paanowɔɔ wa A ɡɛ waa nɔ habɔɔ la, nɛn waa dɛ do Ijipt kooro sen, ne paanowɔɔra nomoa bwa ɛ kooro wechɔɡa.
Kooro la baah di a ɡɛ nomonome banɛ nɔ nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ dɛ laɡ ba do dea.
Nomoa waa chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah kooro dem la, o deemii o kpɔ ba do.
A ɡɛ dea la binii ba lawɛ Josef ɡe do.
Ba chɔ bela biɡri, asɛ nomoa la kpɔ wobɛlbwa do Josef nɔn ta wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Jwaana bɛl baa chɔ dea la bini la, kooro nomonome la deero.
Bɛlbwa deera waa deera la ɡe korɔ.
Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la Josef ba ba be, waa baa na ba la, o nao kɛŋɔ ba liire chɔɡɔ.
Asɛ o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he so sum ne ɡɛ nɔɔ?” Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ya deero, kɛ bɛlbwa deera waa deera la ɡe korɔ, ya ta nomɛlbwa dɔe ó baɡle yaa a mun bonɔ yaa lole nɔ.” Ate Josef ŋɔ, “Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ nɛn wejema ó won baɡle nɛn deera mun.
Hé baɡle ásɛ n no.” Belaa sendoola nomoa la baɡle o deera la dɛ ŋɔ, “N deera la ta la, n na daa baa kpɔ o nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen la kɛ waa cheɡɛ n sie, asɛ kpala atoro do o ta.
Waa moɡɛ papooni la, dɛ fee ɡe deno do a ta.
Dɛ nɔna ba a ta a den be ɡe.
Dɛ n kpoŋe kooro numol dɛ harame daa la nɔna nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ́ kpɔ tɛo.” Anee Josef ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kenii he deera la mun ɛɛ baɡle.
Daa kpala atoro la cheɡɔɔ tɛ tɔpera atoro.
Tɔpetooro wee la, kooro ɛɛ lee dɛ́ berɛ kaa he ne he tombena ta.
Ásɛ he kpɔ kooro numol do o nɔn ta kɛŋɔ he fa aa dɛ doo sen la.
Kɛ dɛ wobɛlbwa ba dɛ kaa kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ naa, lii n wa.
Berɛ takapɔ na n sum, dɛ́ bol n waa baɡle kooro, ásɛ o lee mɛ dea maa chɔa nɔ.
Kpeɡri nee ba kpɔ mɛ le Hibru tena harɛ ta, dɛ ba n ne Ijipt bonɔ.
Maa lɔ bonɔ ɡe nɔ, n ta waa maa ɛa a chɛ kɛ ba do mɛ dea nae.” Paanowɔɔra nomoa la aa noa kɛŋɔ Josef wono baɡle o dɔŋ la deera la mun tɛo a do som la, o bol o be ŋɔ, “N ɡe deero dɛ che paanoo wɛɡrɛre atoro.
Dɛ paanoo bwa soo siwi aa ɛ Ijipt kooro kwaa su wɛɡrɛ waa chɔŋɛ nyundua tenten la bini, asɛ jumbii ɛɛ dia.” Belaa Josef chaŋe dɛ ŋɔ, “Kenii he deera la mun ɛɛ baɡle.
Wɛɡrɛre atoro la cheɡɔɔ tɛ tɔpera atoro.
Tɔpetooro wee la, kooro ɛɛ teŋe he nyuu, dɛ́ kpɔe ka saɡɛ daa ta, ásɛ jumbii ba di he ola.” A habɔɔ tɔpetooro wee la, kooro la dɛ di o lola tɔpere, asɛ dɛ yerɛ o nomonome bwa.
O le o sendoola nomoa la ne paanowɔɔra nomoa la, dɛ kpɔ ba ba o nɛra la sie.
O berɛ sendoola nomoa la toma tɛo asɛ dɛ teŋe paanowɔɔra nomoa la nyu ɡɛ Josef aa bola la.
Kɛ sendoola nomoa la aa bera kaa o toma ta kooro dem la, o soh wobɛlbwa.
O ta wone lii Josef waa tamaa bɛlbwa.
Ijipt kooro deera Bene anɛ habɔɔ la, awola bɛl, Ijipt harɛ ta kooro deero, dɛ o cheɡɛ Nael Moo nyoa o harɛ ta bela, o na nae anuanɛ aa do bwara, dɛ le moo la ta dɛ baa chwe kpɔɡa o nyoa.
Belaa nae anuanɛ ane ɡe le moo la ta ba.
Dɛ ate ɡwaŋrɔ dɛ doŋ dɛ ka che anɔ la jwɛh, asɛ nae aa ɡwaŋra la lawɛ anɔ la aa do bwara la liɡli, asɛ o den har dom ta.
O berɔ chɔ dom, dɛ dee ja asɛ boyu anuanɛ sɛɡle daa beŋkpoŋ ta dɛ ta pure.
A bwa ɡe mao kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ anfala anuanɛ ɡe berɛ sɛɡle daa la bampera.
Peuwɔb bɛl tao le wee leebɔr dɛ ba chɔɡ a te, a ta wone ta pure.
Boyu aa wola wone ta pure la kpɔ anɔ la aa ta pure la liɡli, asɛ kooro la har dom ta.
Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, dɛ o liire chɔɡɔ, anomanta, o yerɛ dobodobo tena ne wejerema baa lɔ harɛ la ta ba o be.
O taa o deera la ba be, kɛ bɛlbwa ta wone baɡle a mun.
Belaa sendoola nomoa la ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin ń bol fini kɛŋɔ n ɛ wechɔɡa.
He baah fa di n ne paanowɔɔra nomoa nɛ, a che a ta he lawɛ yaa do dea nɛra baa dɛ daahne la nomoa dem.
Awola bɛl, n ne paanowɔɔra nomoa la deero asɛ a mune koɡre.
Dɛ ya ne Hibru te bonɔɔ bɛlee ba pɛ do dea.
Dɛ o ɛ nomoa la waa dɛ daah yaa la bonɔɔ.
Yaa bol ya deera la baɡlo la, o wono baɡle yaa a mun.
Gɛ waa baɡle ya deera la mun la a ɛ ɡɛ.
He berɔ kpɔ n toma do n nɔn ta, asɛ dɛ kpo paanowɔɔra nomoa la.” Belaa kooro tomɛ ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ Josef ba.
Ba kaa lawɔ le dea warane, dɛ fonɛ o nyu ne o tampona, dɛ kpɔ laalafala doo, dɛ ba o ne kooro sie.
Kooro ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ, “N deero, kɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ baɡ mɛ a mun, n no he waa kɛŋɔ he won deera mun baɡla.” Anee Josef ŋɔ, “N naa, n laa dɛ́ baɡle deera nɔ mun.
Korowiirii dɛ́ won baɡle a mun tɛɛ.” Asɛ kooro ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N deero dɛ che Nael Moo nyoa, belaa n na nae anuanɛ aa do bwara dɛ do wer, dɛ le nee la ta baa chwe kpɔɡa o nyoa.
A habɔɔ, nae anuanɛ ane ɡe le nee la ta ba.
Dɛ a te ɡwaŋrɔ dɛ doŋ kɛrɛdɛ.
N ta nae aa doŋa ɡɛ nae Ijipt harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa bwa.
Nae aa ɡwaŋra dɛ doŋ la kpɔ nae anuanɛ aa do bwara dɛ tɔ sie le la liɡli.
Aa lawɛ a bala la liɡli tonɛ la, aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ a di kwaane kwara.
Dɛ a ta doŋo ɡɛ aa doa la.
N den har dom ta.
N berɔ chɔ dom dɛ dee ja, asɛ boyu anuanɛ sɛɡle daa beŋkpoŋ ta dɛ ta pure, a bwa ɡe mao kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ anfala anuanɛ ɡe berɛ sɛɡle daa la bampera.
Peuwɔb bɛl tao le wee leebɔr dɛ ba chɔɡ a te, a ta wone ta pure.
Anɔ la aa wola wone ta pure la kpɔ anuanɛ aa ta pure la liɡli.
Maa taara baɡle dobodobo tena la, bɛlbwa ta wone baɡ mɛ a mun.” Belaa Josef ŋɔ Ijipt kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he deera anɛ la bwa dɛ baɡle webeŋkpoŋ.
Korowii ɡelɔ he na waa waa dɛ ba ɛɛ.
Nae anuanɛ aa do bwara la cheɡɔ tɛ bene anuanɛ, asɛ boyu anuanɛ aa ta pure kɛrɛdɛ la ɡe che tɛ bene anuanɛ.
Webeŋkpoŋii a bwa ɛɛ baɡle.
Asɛ naɡwaŋre anuanɛ aa doŋa dɛ ka mun le nee la ta ba la, ne boyu waa sɛɡla anuanɛ peuwɔb le wee leebɔr ba chɔɡa a ta wone ta pure la, ɡe cheɡɔ tɛ kɛŋɔ lɔr ɛɛ bao bene anuanɛ.
N naa kooro, ɡɛ n fa aa bol he be la, waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin ɛɛ laanee o ɡel he na la.
Kondikwa ɛɛ ba Ijipt harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwaa taeh bene anuanɛ.
A habɔɔ la, lɔr ɛɛ chiɡ harɛ nɔ taa bene anuanɛ, ásɛ nɛn soh kɛŋɔ kondikwaa fa balɔ ka.
Dɛkalkɛ lɔr la ɛɛ chɔɡ harɛ nɔɔ.
Lɔr la kpeɡri waa dɛ ba doe harɛ nɔ ta kohona nomanta, nɛn dɛ ba soeh kɛŋɔ kondikwaa fa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta taeh.
He deera bele anɛ la dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡbaɡbaa ɛa ɡɛ, kɛ waa ɡel a biɡri ásɛ a chiɡ.
Anomanta, n naa kooro, nyin nɛn waa ɛ wejereme dɛɛ no waa mun, dɛ́ kpɔ Ijipt harɛ nɔ do o nɔn ta.
A chɛ kɛ he nyin nomonome bane ɡe, ba nyiŋi dɛɛ lɛ kondikwaare bene anuanɛ la ta, ɡɛ saŋ kondikwa aa ba warɛ harɛ nɔ ta kohona la.
Bá bɔne a bini bɔre anue dɛ́ lɛ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ.
Gel ba lɛ boyu a ɡɛ bene la ta bwɛjena ta cheɡ he sɔn ta.
Anee dɛ́ ba ɛ kondikwa bene anuanɛ lɔr waa dɛ ba bala harɛ nɔ ta la.
Ásɛ lɔr bɛ harɛ nɔ ba chɔɡ.” Kooro ne o nomonome bwa sɛh ɡɛ waa la ta.
Asɛ kooro ŋɔ o nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ Josef laa, nomɛlbwa toole, o nɛɛ Korowii Doma so, onee dɛ́ won nyiŋi kondikwaa nɔ ta.” Belaa kooro ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ, “Korowiirii baɡle anɔ bwa, anomanta, ya bwa nao kɛŋɔ he dɔ wejema dɛɛ no waa mun dɛ ɡwaa nomɛlbwa.
Mɛɛ kpɔe he chɔ n harɛ nɔ bwa nyoa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta.
Kora nɔ ɡbo taa n ɡwaale.” Dɛ ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ, “N kpɔ Ijipt harɛ nɔ bwa do he nɔn ta.” Kooro laa o noniseɡ o nyanyini kon aa dawɛ o ta la foo do Josef, dɛ kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe batakaare ɡe doo, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm jɔɡrɔre baŋa kwaa ɡe do o baŋa.
O ɡelɔ o so o koo kon waa do kɛ torɔɡo bini, asɛ nɛra tɔ o sie dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé tɛ ŋwɛnɛ!
Hé tɛ ŋwɛnɛ!” Gɛɛ a do ba kpɔ Josef cheɡ ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi Ijipt harɛ la bwa ta.
Asɛ kooro la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Menee kooro te, kɛ nomɛlbwa ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ o ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ le he habɔɔ.” O kpɔ Ijipt harɛ sɔn pao ŋɔ baa yerɔ Safenat Panea, dɛ mo haah ɡe tɛo.
O haah la sɔne Asenat.
Sɔfo Pɔtefɛra bihaahnee.
Dɛ sɔfo nɔ soɡe bwɛjen On, o sɔn bɛl ɡee Hɛleopɔles.
Asɛ Josef ka ɡaaɡe Ijipt harɛ ta bwa.
Josef di bene fifraatoro mɔɔ dɛ pa kooro toma la mun.
Bene anuanɛ kondikwa aa ɛa kohona la, koo kwaa ɛo kohona harɛ la ta, asɛ Josef ɡel ba boa kondikwaa aa bala bene anuanɛ la ta la nyoa cheɡ bwɛjena ta.
Bwɛɛre aa bar bwɛjen bɛlbwa kondikwaa la, ba dɛ cheɡa bwɛjen la ta.
Josef ɡelɔ ba lɛ kondikwaa cheɡ a warɛ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken, anomanta, o berɔ ɡel a maɡa.
Sɔfo Pɔtefɛra waa le bwɛjen On bihaah Asenat lolɛ bibaala banɛ tɛ Josef mɔɔ lɔrchɔɡe la ba.
Josef pa o binomoa la sɔn Manasɛ.
O munii Korowii ɡelɔ n soh n wenaale ne n mɛɛ lolanar bwa wa.
O pa binɛɛte la ɡe sɔn Efrem.
O munii Korowii tɛ mɛ bii harɛ maa na wahala o ta la ta.
Bene anuanɛ kondikwaa aa bu Ijipt harɛ ta la ba a jaɡa, asɛ bene anuanɛ lɔr Josef aa bol o waa la ɡe pa mun.
Lɔr chole harɛre bwa ta, kɛ dɛ kondikwaa bu Ijipt te.
Lɔr aa baa pa mun Ijipt harɛ ta bwa ɡe la, bela tena wio no kooro la ŋɔ ó tɛɛ ba kondikwa.
Asɛ o ŋɔ bá la Josef be, ásɛ ɡɛ bwa waa ŋɔ la, bá ɛ. Lɔr la aa chole Ijipt harɛ la ta o nyoa do kpeɡri la, Josef ɡelɔ ba pili deene baa kwaa boyu cheɡ a bini la bwa, dɛ yoɡ dɛɛ tɛ Ijipt tena.
Nɛra le harɛre ta dɛ la Josef be Ijipt harɛ, dɛ kaa yawɛ boyu, dɛkalkɛ dɛ lɔr la nyoa kpeɡri bobɛlbwa.
Josef dɔɔranar Ijipt laŋa wa Jekɔb noɔ kɛŋɔ boyu lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta, asɛ o bɔɔ o bibaala la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he so dɛɛ nyiŋi dɔŋa sie ta nɔɔ?
N noɔ kɛŋɔ kondikwaa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta, hé la bela ka yawɛ ane ba, ásɛ lɔr bɛ yaa kpo ya serewe.” Belaa Josef dɔɔranar fi la ir la Ijipt harɛ, dɛ́ ka yawɛ boyu la.
Jekɔb ta ɡelɛ Bɛnjamen waa ɛ Josef nime pɔrɔdɔ la ja ba nɛɛ dɛ la.
Dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ waane ken ɛɛ ka ɛɔ.
Jekɔb bii la ne Keenan harɛ ta tena banee pɛa la, dɛ ka yawɛ boyu la, dɛ harɛ la ta bwaa lɔr la do.
Dɛ Josef ɛ Ijipt harɛ la nomoa ne nɛn waa yoɡ boyu dɛɛ tɛ harɛre bwa nɛra.
Anomanta, o dɔɔranar la aa bala la, ba kaa ɡuŋi o sie, dɛ kpɔ sie piiɡi harɛ.
Josef aa na ba la, dɛ o te deno jem ba, kɛ o ɛ o te kɛŋɔ waa ban jemɛ ken.
Asɛ dɛ nyɛɡ ba nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Leperaa he leɔ?” Asɛ ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Keenan harɛ taa ya le dɛɛ ba ba yawɛ boyu.” Dɛ Josef te jemɛ o dɔɔranar la, kɛ ba te ta on jemɛ.
Belaa o lii deera o fa aa dee ba la wa, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He balɔ dɛ́ ba sɔh nyiŋi ya harɛ nɔ dɛ́ na kɛ ya chɔ pɛɛ.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Akai, nomoa, boyuu he bonɔɔna, yaa ba dɛ́ ba yawɛ.
Babeŋkpoŋ biirii yan, ya ne ya tepoŋee.
Ya ta balɛ dɛ́ ba sɔh nyiŋi harɛ nɔ.” Ate, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nyosone.
He balɔ dɛ́ ba sɔh nyiŋi na kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ chɔ pɛɛ.” Ba ɡe ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he bonɔɔna, ya lɔ bii fi dɛ banɛ, dɛ ɛ babeŋkpoŋ bii, dɛ le Keenan harɛ ta.
Ya bini bechala te lɔ ya mɛɛ be dem, asɛ ya bini beŋkpoŋ ɡe toole.” Anee Josef ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ haa doa laanee n den bol la.
He balɔ dɛ́ ba sɔh nyiŋi ya harɛ nɔ.
Kenii mɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ jemɛ he kasinteŋ.
N ŋwɛɛ Ijipt kooro kɛŋɔ he bini bɛlbwa aa bɔree dɔ kaa, nemenɛ he nime bechala la ba bonɔ mɔɔ.
Hé ɡel he bini bɛl la ka kpɔ he nime la ba, ásɛ ba do he kar ɡe dea ka tel kɛŋɔ yaa na waa haa bola nɔ kasinteŋ.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa tenaa, n ŋwɛɛ kooro kɛŋɔ he ɛ nɛra haa dɛ ba ba sɔh nyiŋi harɛ nɔ.” Asɛ dɛ laɡ ba do dea tɔpera atoro.
Tɔpetooro wee la, Josef ŋɔ o dɔɔranar la be ŋɔ, “N te, n ɛ nɛn maa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛ mɛɛ ɡel heyaa yaa, aa che webeŋkpoŋ taa.
He ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa aa, he ɡel he bini beŋkpoŋ ka dea bonɔ, ásɛ he kabora la ka kpɔ boyu la ka tɛ he lolanar lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba la.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ he nime la ba tɛ mɛ, á baɡle kɛ he waa la ɛ kasinteŋ, ásɛ n bɛ ɡel ba kpoo heya.” Ate, ba sɛh waa waa bola la ta.
Dɛ ba dɛ bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Taraken waa yaa dɛ na nɔ bwa le waa ya fa aa kpɔa ɛ ya nime Josef la.
Ya na wenaale waa lɔ a ta dɛ soŋe yaa, kɛ ya ta noɛ.
Anee ɡela ya ɡee na ɡɛ waa nɔ taraken la.” Belaa Rubin ŋɔ, “N te ŋɔ he be ŋɔ he bɛ bie la wobɛlbwa ɛ, kɛ he ta noɛ.
Taraken, kpoe yaa kpoo laanee ɡure ya nyu ta la.” Baa cheɡɛ nomɛl nɛɛ dɛ bol waa dɛɛ tɛ Josef nomanta, dɛ baa jemɛ kɛ o dɛ no ba wobol la.
Belaa Josef le ba be bela dɛ ka wi.
Dɛ berɛ ba ba be ja o ne ba bol wa, asɛ o lawɛ Simeon le ba bini dɛ ɡel ba vɔrɔwo ba siwi ta.
Josef dɔɔranar berɔ kaa Keenan harɛ Asɛ Josef ɡel ba do boyu o dɔɔranar la bɔɡtɔre bini a suuɡi, dɛ berɛ kpɔ ba suuɡare do a bini tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ berɛ tɛɛ ba kondikwaa baa ka dia ŋwɛnɛ ta.
Asɛ ba ɛ ɡɛ tɛɛ ba, ba kpɔ ba boyu la dawɛ ba keeɡore ta dɛ kaa.
Baa dɛ kaa la, bɔr kaa joo ba ŋwɛnɛ ta asɛ ba chɔ bela, asɛ ba bini bɛl ŋɔ ó pur o bɔɡtɔ dɛ́ tɛ o keeɡo kondikwa, asɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ baa vɔwɛ suuɡa o pur la nyoa.
Anee o ŋɔ o bala la be ŋɔ, “Ba berɛ n suuɡa tɛ mɛ.
Anee lɔ n bɔɡtɔ bini la.” Ba bwara yɔrɔ, asɛ ba kpɔ bochela dɛ ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa Korowii ɛ yaa ken?” Baa la ba mɛɛ Jekɔb be Keenan harɛ ta la, ba bol waa aa puu ba bwa baɡlo dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomoa harɛ la wobɛlbwa aa lɔ o nɔn ta la nyɛɡ ya nɛɛ dɛ ɛ yaa kɛŋɔ nɛra yaa laŋa dɛ́ ka sɔh nyiŋi ba harɛ dɛ́ ɛɛ ba waane ken.” Asɛ ya ŋɔ, “Ya ne ya tepoŋee, ya ta balɛ dɛ́ ba sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la.
Ya lɔ bibaala fi dɛ banɛ, dɛ ɛ babeŋkpoŋ bii, ya bini beŋkpoŋ toole, asɛ ya bini bechala ɡe lɔ ya mɛɛ be taraken Keenan harɛ ta.” Belaa nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi bela harɛ ta la ŋɔ, waa waa dɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ jemɛ ya kasinteŋ laanee kɛŋɔ, yá ɡel ya bini beŋkpoŋ o be, dɛ́ kpɔ boyu la ba tɛ ya dem tena lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba la.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ya nime bechala la ba tɛo, ásɛ o jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya ta nɛra yaa laŋa dɛ́ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la ɛɛ, kɛ ya ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa.
Ásɛ o le ya dɔŋ la tɛ yaa, yaa di harɛ la ta bona.
Baa dɛ pur ba bone la, bɛlbwa nao kɛŋɔ suuɡa vɔwɛ o bɔɡtɔ nyoa, asɛ ɔmee lawɛ ba ne ba mɛɛ bwa.
Ate, ba mɛɛ Jekɔb ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé dɛ nyin kɛ n paŋɛ n bii bwa kɛɛ?
Josef toole, Simeon ɡe kao.
Hé berɔ dɛɛ nyin kɛ he kpɔ Bɛnjamen ɡe kaa.
Menee dɛɛ ba waa nae!” Asɛ Rubin ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ n ta Bɛnjamen ne balɛ ba tɛɛ naa, he kpoo n bibaala banɛ nɔ.
Kpɔ o waa do n nɔn ta, mɛɛ berɔɔ ba o ne ba tɛɛ.” Ate Jekɔb ŋɔ, “Maa sɛh he kpɔ n bie nɔ kaa, o dɔɔ toole, o ɡboo kaa.
N ɡe hwɛɛhrɔ tonɛ.
Wobɛlbwa kaa ɛo ŋwɛnɛ ta bela haa dɛ kaa nɔ naa, n ne n tebinichɔɡee dɛɛ ba sewa.”
Josef dɔɔranar ne Bɛnjamen Ijipt harɛ ta kaala Lɔr la nyoa baa do kpeɡri Keenan harɛ la ta, Jekɔb ne o bii aa di boyu baa kaa yawɛ le Ijipt harɛ ta ba tonɛ la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ la ka yawɛ boyu la tama ba ja.” Anee Juda ŋɔ o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, “Baa la kpɔ kon kpaa ya nyu ta ŋɔ ya ta ya nime la ne balaa, ya bɛ ɡel o na ya siwi.
Dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh ya ne ya nime la kaa tenaa, yaa lao dɛ́ ka yawɛ kondikwaa la ba tɛɛ.
Kɛ dɛ haa sɛh tenaa, yaa la.
Baa la ɡelɔ ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ ya ta ya nime la ne balaa, waa ya siwi nyin dɛ na kwara.” Anee Jekɔb ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa dɔ baa nɔ be ŋɔe ŋɔ he dɔ nime bɛl dɛ kpɔ waa nɔ ba ta n nɛɛ ken?” Asɛ ba ɡe chaŋe ŋɔ, “O teŋɔ dɛɛ bɔɔ ya ne ya lolanar wa.
Dɛ́ ya mɛɛ ta soɡe le naa?
Ya dɔ nime bɛl dɛ ja ya nɛ aa?
Waa waa bɔɔra laanee ya ɡe chaŋe.
N mɛɛ, dɛ ya ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ŋɔɔ ya kpɔ ya nime la ba.” Belaa Juda ŋɔ o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ Bɛnjamen do n nɔn ta n ne o kaa warane, ásɛ lɔr bɛ yaa kpo ya ba serewe.
Mɛɛ cheo tɛ wobɛlbwa.
Dɛ n ta o ne balɛ ba tɛɛ naa, bɔɔ mɛ.
Dɛ n ta o ne balɛ sɔnɔnɔɔ ba tɛɛ naa, n nɛɛ wobɛlbwa dawɛ.
Ken laa ya do waa nɔ ta dɛɛ tɛɡre aa, ya fe la kera anɛ ba.” Ba mɛɛ ɡe ŋɔ, “Dɛ ɡɛɛ tenaa, hé kpɔ ya harɛ nɔ ta kwaa kɛŋɔ, noo tama ne tooh tama ne konsɔɔhsoma, ne korobo ne daa nɔna aa dɔ pɛla do he pure bini ka tɛ nomoa la.
Bɛ́lbwa kpɔ suuɡa bele anɛ, anɔ la haa naa he bɔɡtɔre nyoo la ken ɛ soohla.
Hé lawɛ he nime Bɛnjamen, he ne o kaa baa la be warane.
Kórowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel nomoa la na he sum, dɛ́ kpɔ Simeon ne Bɛnjamen tɛ heya he ba tɛ mɛ.
Dɛ baa le n nɔn taa yaa, ba den le n nɔn ta.” Kɛ ane a bwa, ba kpɔ koŋkɛɛla la ne suuɡa bele anɛ la ne Bɛnjamen, dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa Ijipt harɛ ta warane, dɛ kpɔ ba te ka chaɡle Josef.
Josef aa naa kɛ Bɛnjamen ja ba bini la, o ŋɔ o bonɔɔ waa dɛ nyiŋi o dem la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ nɛra nɔ kaa n dem, dɛ́ ka kpo kon ɛ kondikwa, n dɛ́ ba n ne bá di kondikwa webaŋa nɔ ne.” Bonɔɔ la ɛ ɡɛ Josef aa doo la, asɛ dɛ lawɛ nɛra la kaa o dem.
Waa kpɔ ba dɛɛ kaa dem la, dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ, asɛ dɛɛ bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Suuɡa la baa bera do ya bone bini la waa baa ba ya ne dem bonɔ la.
Baa ɡuɡri yaa, dɛ́ lawɛ yaa yoma, dɛ́ kpɔ ya keeɡore.” Anomanta, baa tel dem la doonyoa la, ba ŋɔ bonɔɔ la be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya fa ba bonɔ dɛ ba yawɛ kondikwa, yaa chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta bɔr jo ya ka chɔ bobɛl la, ya pur ya bɔɡtɔre nyoo, dɛ na kɛŋɔ ya suuɡare yaa kpɔa ba yawɛ kondikwaa la lɔ a bini.
Anomanta, ya berɔ ba a ne, anee la.
Ya berɔ ba suuɡa ne, dɛ́ ba yawɛ kondikwaa ja.
Ya ta wone jemɛ naate waa kpɔ anɔ la do ya bɔɡtɔre la bini.” Anee bonɔɔ la chaŋe ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡel a hiah heya hɛɛ ɔmɛ.
Korowii he ne he nimanar aa dɛ tomɔ laanee ken kpɔa do he bone bini la.
Gɛ suuɡa la tel n be.” Asɛ o le Simeon tɛɛ ba.
Ate, o laɡ ba jo dem dɛ tɛɛ ba nee ba sarame ba nakpale, dɛ tɛ ba keeɡore ɡe kwaa a di.
Ba noɔ kɛŋɔ baa di webaŋkwaa dem belaa, anomanta, ba kwaa ba koŋkɛɛla la cheɡ dɛɛ kpa Josef bala webaŋa la ne.
Josef aa ba dem la, ba kpɔ koŋkɛɛla la ka ɡuŋi o sie dɛ kpɔ tɛo.
Asɛ o bɔɔ ba ɡɛ ba bwara aa doa dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Hé fa bol he mɛɛ wa n be.
Ɛrɛɛ o bwara doɔ?
O ta soɡe le o bwara do kpeɡri aa?” Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he bonɔɔ waa ɛ ya mɛɛ la ta soɡe le o bwara do kpeɡri.” Asɛ ba ɡuŋi o sie dɛ kpɔ ba sie piiɡi harɛ.
Josef aa nyiŋa dɛ na Bɛnjamen waa ɛ o nyabie pɔrɔdɔ la, o ŋɔ, “Hé nime haa bol o waa n be laanee nɔ naa?
Korowii chae, n bie.” Nyina Josef aa dɛ nyin o nime la kohona nomanta, o haŋrɔ kahonɛ, dɛ le bela warane, dɛ ka jo o dea dɛ wi.
Waa tona la, o samɛ o sie dɛ le buse dɛ kwaa sie do, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ bá kpɔ kondikwaa la le ba bá di.
Ba kpɔ Josef kwaa cheɡo korɛ, asɛ o dɔɔranar la ɡe kwaa korɛ.
Dɛ Ijipt tena bane jao dɛ ɡee di kwaa la ane.
Dɛ Ijipt tena kii ba ne Hibru tena nɔn pɛɛ dɛ́ di kwa, anomanta, ba korɛ ba kwa.
Josef dɔɔranar ne o nime la soɡo ba sie pa dɔŋa nɛ.
O ɡelɔ ba so teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ le ba nomonome bini kaa bechale ta.
Baa na ɡɛ baa soɡa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ la, ba nyoa kpoo.
Ba kpɔ Josef kondikwaa la ane ba bɔne ba.
Ba tɛ Bɛnjamen bɔre anue, dɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ baa tɛ ba kar la.
Ba di kondikwaa la dɛ vaɡre, dɛ nyɔ sen lɛ ba sie.
Suuɡapoŋ numol wa Josef ŋɔ bonɔɔ waa dɛ nyiŋi dem bela la be ŋɔ, “Do kondikwaa baala nɔ bɔɡtɔre bini a suuɡi, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bɛlbwa suuɡa vɔwɛ o bɔɡtɔ nyoa.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ n suuɡapoŋ numol, ne bechala la suuɡa do o bone bini.” Asɛ o ɛ ɡɛ waa ŋɔa la.
Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, ba ta ba ŋwɛnɛ ba ne ba keeɡore kaa.
Baa dɛ kaa baa wola bobɛlbwa tele mɔɔ la, Josef ŋɔ bonɔɔ waa dɛ nyiŋi dem bela la be ŋɔ, “Ɛ warane dɛ́ ti baala la.
He kaa puu ba aa, hé bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ he kpɔ wechɔɡa bɔ wedɛɛɡa kem nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛ waa he ŋwɛ n dɔɔ suuɡapoŋ numol nɔɔ?
O nee wɛɛ nyɔ ne, dɛ che o ta dɛɛ jemɛ kerekere wa.
Gɛ haa ɛa nɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kohona.’ ” Waa ti ba dɛ ka puu ba la, ɡɛ waa laanee o bol ba be.
Asɛ ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin he chaɡle nɔɔ?
Korowii ɛɛ kisi yaa, yaa ɡɛɛ ɛ.
Ya ta suuɡa yaa naa ya bone bini Keenan harɛ la berɛ ba tɛ heya aa?
Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona ŋwɛ suuɡapoŋ kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm he nomoa dem ɔ?
Nomoa, ya bini bɛlbwa haa nao o be la, bá kpoo, ásɛ ya kar ɡe ɛ he yoma.” Asɛ o sɛh ɡɛ baa bola la dɛ ŋɔ, “A wer, kɛ naate maa nao o be la ɡboo dɛ́ berɛ n yom, ásɛ he kabora te kaa.” Belaa bɛlbwa ɛ warane dɛ choɡ o bone cheɡ, dɛ laa a nyoa pur.
Ate, Josef bonɔɔ la nyiŋi ba bone la bini.
O pa mun le ba bini nomoa be dɛ ba tonɛ bechala la be, asɛ dɛ na numol la Bɛnjamen waa ɛ bechala la be.
A we ba nɛ, ba laa ba laala kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ ba tea bini chɔɡɔ, dɛ kwaa vɔwɛ ba bone choɡ keeɡore la, dɛ laa berɛ ba bwɛjen la ta.
Juda ne o bala aa tel Josef dem la, dɛ o ta lole, asɛ ba ka ɡuŋu harɛ.
O bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he ɛ ken?
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ n won chaahna nae, dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa kerekere kɛɛ?” Anee Juda chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba he be bola ɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona tɔŋle ŋɔ ya laa ɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona ŋɔ ya waa dɔ kasinteŋ kpa ɔ?
Korowii le ya mun ne.
Taraken naate baa na numol nɔ o be ɡbo laa dɛ́ ɛ he yom, ya bwa ɛɛ ɛ he yomaa.” Anee Josef ŋɔ, “Akai, maa an ɡɛɛ ɛ bwa.
Nemenɛ naate baa na numol la o be la ɡboo dɛ́ ɛ n yom.
He kabora la te ɛɛ won kaa he mɛɛ be deŋnesɔɔhna ne.” Ate, Juda suuh tel Josef, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, bɛ ɡel he baah di n nɛ.
He do kɛŋɔ Ijipt kooro ɡbaɡba ken, kɛ n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ n ne he won bol wa.
Nomoa, he fa ta yaa bɔɔrɛ kɛ ya dɔ mɛɛ kɛɛ nime bɛl a?
Asɛ ya chaŋe ŋɔ ya dɔ mɛɛ o hwɛɛh dɛ dɔ nime bɛl ɡe.
Ya mɛɛ aa hwɛɛhra la taa o lolɔ, asɛ o dɔɔ o ne waa pɛ nya la sewɛ a ka o ɡbo, anomanta, o mɛɛ dɛ nyin o waa taeh.
He ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ ya la ka kpɔɔ ba he nao, asɛ ya ŋɔ bie la aa won le o mɛɛ jwɛh, dɛkalkɛ o le o jwɛh aa, o mɛɛ la ɛɛ sewɔɔ.
Asɛ he berɛ ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ haa nyin kɛ he na yaa dɛ ya nime la ta jae.
Nomoa, yaa bera kaa ya mɛɛ be la, ya kaa bol waa bwa haa bola la o be.
O berɔ ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ ya berɛ ba dɛ́ ba yawɛ kondikwaa tama.
Asɛ ya chaŋo ŋɔ yaa won la.
Ya ɡbo laŋɔ dɛ ya nime nɔ ta ya nɛɛ jae yaa, yaa won la o sie.
Dɛ ya nime la ɛɛ lao tenaa, ya ɡee lao.
Anee ya mɛɛ ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ ya ɡbabir jemɔ ŋɔ bibaala banɛ ɡboo Rakɛl lolɛ tɛo.
Beŋkpoŋ te le o nɔn ta.
O jemɔ kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini ola ka toɡri o bini, o ta on nae kpa ba le fini.
Ya berɔ kpɔ onɔ le o nɔn ta taraken asɛ waane ka ɛɔ waa, waa hwɛɛhra tonɛ nɔ, tebinichɔɡ ɡboo dɛɛ ba o kpoe.” “Nomoa, taraken n berɔ kaa n mɛɛ be dɛ ya nime nɔ ta jae yaa, wɛɛ sewɔɔ.
O dɛ nyinu kohona, ɡɛ waa hwɛɛhra la, dɛ o ta ya nɛɛ jae yaa, sum ɡbo ɛɛ kpoo.
Anɔ la aa jaa laanee kɛŋɔ, n lɛ bie nɔ waa dawɛ n nɛ.
N baɡɛ n mɛɛ nyoa kɛŋɔ dɛ n ta o ne balaa, menee waa dawɛ n nɛ n soɡa bini bwa.
Anomanta, nomoa, n dɛ́ soŋe, mɛɛ chiɡ bie nɔ naa taa, dɛ́ so dɛ́ ɛ he yom, ásɛ o pu o dɔɔranar kaa.
Dɛ bie nɔ ta n nɛɛ teŋaa, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won la n mɛɛ be nɔ?
Maa won ka na wechɔɡa aa dɛ ba n mɛɛ nɛɛ bala.”
Josef baɡle o nɛnsoo Josef ta wone lawɛ o te o bonɔɔna la sie, o kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ nomɛlbwa le buse, asɛ dɛ kpɔ o te baɡle o dɔɔranar la.
O wio kohona, asɛ Ijipt harɛ tena la no, kooro dem tena la bwa no.
A habɔɔ la, Josef ŋɔ o dɔɔranar la be ŋɔ, “Menee Josef.
N mɛɛ ta lole naa?” Waa bɔɔ ba ɡɛ la, ba ta wone chaŋe wobɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ ɔmee laɡ ba.
Anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N poo heya, hé suuh tel mɛ.” Baa suuhna telo la, asɛ o ŋɔ, “Menee he nime Josef haa yoɡ mɛ tɛ Ijipt tena la.
He bɛ ɡel a we he nɛ, he bɛ he te pwah kɛŋɔ haa yoɡ mɛ.
Korowiirii cheɡa ɡɛ dɛ lee mɛ, n tɔ he sie dɛ́ ba lɛ nɛra mkpa.
Lɔr nɔ bene anɛɛ la.
A ta ka bene anue nomɛlbwa aa wola won du kwaa a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa.
Korowiirii cheɡa ɡɛ, dɛ lee mɛ ŋɔ n tɔ he sie, dɛ́ ba lɛ heyaa ɡɛ nyokpoa ŋwɛnɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ he ne he naanar dɔ mkpa.
He laa ba n ne bonɔ, Korowiirii ba n ne.
Onee ɛɛ mɛ nomonjen n ja kooro nɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi o dem tena ne Ijipt harɛ bwa ta.
He ɛ warane ka ŋɔ n mɛɛ be ŋɔ men o bie Josef ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɛɛ mɛ nomonjen Ijipt harɛ bwa ta.’ Ó ba n be warane.
Ó ba, dɛ́ ba so Gosen waa lɔ Ijipt harɛ nɔ ta dɛ́ bɛn mɛ.
Ó kpɔ o bii ne o naanar ne peera ne boohna, ne o nae dɛ komɛlbwa waa dɔa ba.
O baa so Gosen aa, anee mɛɛ ba wona nyiŋu.
Lɔr nɔ ta ka bene anue, anomanta, maa nyin kɛŋɔ lɔr kpo o ne o bii ne kondɛɛra.” O berɔ ŋɔ, “Taraken, he ne Bɛnjamen bwa nao kɛŋɔ menee dɛɛ bol waa he be la.
He ka ŋɔ n mɛɛ be n kpeɡri maa dɔɔ Ijipt harɛ ta bonɔ, ne wobɛlbwa haa naa bonɔ bwa, ásɛ dɛ ɛ warane, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ba n be bonɔ.” Belaa o kpɔ o nɔɔra dawɛ o nime Bɛnjamen vaama ta dɛ wi, asɛ o ɡe lawɔ pɛl o te dɛɛ wi.
O mo o dɔɔranar la lwɛrɛme dɛ wi.
Asɛ a habɔɔ o ne ba bol wa.
Baa no koodem kɛŋɔ Josef dɔɔranar balɔ la, kooro ne o nomonome bwa sie lɛo.
Asɛ kooro ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ ó ŋɔ o dɔɔranar la be ŋɔ bá kpɔ ba bone la dawɛ keeɡore la ta, ásɛ dɛ berɛ kaa Keenan harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka kpɔ ba mɛɛ ne ba bii ne ba dem tena bwa ba Ijipt harɛ ta.
Dɛ́ wɛɛ tɛɛ baa bela waa wera Ijipt harɛ ta bonɔɔ, ásɛ ba dɔ komɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.
Berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá kpɔ kwaa aa dɔ tɔre baa taɡa kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ pɛl jaɡre, dɛ́ ka kpɔ ba haahna ne bii, dɛ́ kpɔ ba mɛɛ ɡe ba.
Ba bɛ komɛlbwa waa lii a we ba nɛ.
Kondɛɛɡa aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta la bwa ɛ ba kwa.
Anomanta, Jekɔb bii la ɛ ɡɛ baa bol ba be la bwa.
Josef kpɔ torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la ane tɛɛ ba ɡɛ kooro aa bola la.
Asɛ dɛ tɛɛ ba kondikwaa baa di ŋwɛnɛ ta ɡe ja.
O berɔ tɛ ba bini bɛlbwa laalafala, dɛ tɛ Bɛnjamen te suuɡapoŋa lafraatoro ne laalafala bele anue.
Dɛ kpɔ Ijipt harɛ laala aa wera kohona tɛ ŋɔ ba ka tɛ o mɛɛ, keeɡore fii cheɡaa, asɛ keeɡoneenanar fi ɡe che boyu ne kondikwaa bwa soo siwi waa di ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ́ berɛ ba.
O kaa do o dɔɔranar ŋwɛnɛ asɛ baa dɛ kaa la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ berɛ ka yoi ŋwɛnɛ ta noo!” Ba le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ ba Keenan harɛ ta ba mɛɛ be.
Baa tel ba mɛɛ be dem la, ba bol o be ŋɔ, “Josef ta lole!
Onee dɛɛ nyiŋi Ijipt harɛ ta.” Baa bol ɡɛ o mɛɛ be la, o nyoa kpoo, o ta ɡɛ waa ɛ nae.
Kɛ baa bol waa Josef aa bol ba be baɡlo o no, dɛ na kwaa aa dɔ tɔre baa taɡa kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwa pɛl jaɡre, Josef aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá kpɔ ba kpɔɔ ba Ijipt la, o berɔ wɛr.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Anɔɔ mɛɛ nyin dɛ́ no.
N bie Josef ta lole!
Mɛɛ lao ka nao mɔɔ dɛ́ sewɛ.”
Jekɔb Ijipt harɛ ta kaala wa Jekɔb kpɔ kwaa waa dɔa bwa, dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ ba tel Beɛseeba.
O kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii o mɛɛ Aesek aa tomɔ la bela.
Korowii kpɔ o te baɡlo bela deera ta jwaana dɛ yerɔ ŋɔ, “Jekɔb.” Asɛ o sɛh dɛ ŋɔ, “Menee la.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii he mɛɛwa aa tom mɛ la.
Bɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he mun ya bela taeh.
Mɛɛ teŋɛ he nɛɛ kaa bela, ásɛ dɛ berɛ ba he naanar ne a ɡɛ Keenan harɛ nɔ ta.
He dɛ ba sewaa, Josef ɛɛ lawɛɛ he sewɛ.” Belaa o le Beɛseeba asɛ o bii la kpɔ o ne ba ɡe bii ne haahna do kon waa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ pɛl jaɡre Ijipt kooro aa kpɔa tom ba ŋɔ bá kpɔ ba kpɔɔ ba la bini.
Ba kpɔ ba kondɛɛra ne kwaa baa dɔa Keenan harɛ bwa ba Ijipt.
Jekɔb kpɔ o naanar bwa ja kaa, o bibaala ne o bihaahna ne o naanar baa ɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bwa.
Jekɔb bibaala baa ja o nɛɛ dɛ la Ijipt harɛ ta laanee nɔ, Rubinii ɛ o binomoa.
Rubin bibaalaa nɔ, Hanɔk ne Palu ne Hɛsrɔn dɛ Kaami.
Simeon bibaalaa nɔ, Jɛmoɛl ne Jamin ne Ohad ne Jakin ne Soha dɛ Swaul.
Swaul nɔ nyaa ɛ Keenan te la.
Lewi ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Gɛsɔn ne Kohat dɛ Merari.
Juda ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Ɛr ne Onan ne Seela ne Pɛrɛs dɛ Sɛra.
Kɛ Ɛr ne Onan te sewɛ Keenan harɛ ta.
Pɛrɛs bibaalaa nɔ, Hɛsrɔn ne Hamul.
Isaaka ɡe bibaala nɔ, Tola ne Pua ne Jasub dɛ Simron.
Sebulon ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Sered ne Ɛlɔn dɛ Jaleel.
A ɡɛ bibaala nɔɔ Lea lolɛ tɛ Jekɔb ɡɛ saŋ baa soɡe Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta Daena waa ɛ o bihaah la habɔɔ.
Dɛ o bihaahna ne bibaala dɛ naanar o ne Lea aa dɔa la bwa lɔ fifraatoro dɛ batoro.
Gad ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Sefon ne Haɡi ne Suni ne Ɛsbɔn ne Ɛre ne Arodi dɛ Areli.
Aasa ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Imna ne Isva ne Isvi dɛ Bɛrea.
Sera ɡee jaa dɛ ɛ bihaah.
Bɛrea ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Heba ne Malkeɛl.
A ɡɛ bibaala fi dɛ banumɛl nɔɔ Silpa waa ɛ Lea tolo la lolɛ ba ɛ o ne Jekɔb naanar.
Onee Laban lawɛ tɛ o bihaah Lea tolo la.
Jekɔb haah Rakɛl ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Josef ne Bɛnjamen.
Josef aa lɔ Ijipt la, o lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee Manasɛ ne Efrem.
Haah o ne waa lol ba la sɔne Asenat waa ɛ sɔfo Pɔtefɛra bihaah, dɛ o soɡe On.
O sɔn bɛl ɡee Hɛleopɔles.
Bɛnjamen ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Bɛla ne Bɛka ne Asbɛl ne Gɛra ne Naaman ne Ehi ne Rɔs ne Mupim ne Hupim dɛ Aad.
A ɡɛ bii nɔɔ Rakɛl ne Jekɔb lolɛ.
Ba lɔ fi dɛ banaarɛ.
Dan ɡe bibaalee nɔ, Husim.
Naftale ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Jaseel ne Guni ne Jesa dɛ Silem.
A ɡɛ bibaala banuanɛ nɔɔ Bilha waa ɛ tolo Laban aa lawa tɛ o bihaah Rakɛl la lolɛ, ba ɛ Jekɔb bibaala ne naanar.
Jekɔb naanar baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ dɛ la Ijipt la lɔ fifraanumɛl dɛ banumɛl.
O bibaala haahna te ta jae.
Josef lolɛ bibaala banɛ Ijipt.
Anomanta, dɛ ba jao waa, dɛ Jekɔb ne o bii dɛ o naanar baa la Ijipt la lɔ fifraanuanɛ.
Baa dɛ tel Ijipt la, Jekɔb tomɛ Juda ŋɔ ó la ka ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ ó ba tɔ o sie dɛ́ kaa o ne Gosen harɛ.
Baa tel bela la, Josef jo o kon waa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo la bɛl bini, asɛ dɛ ka cheme o mɛɛ.
Baa chema la, Josef ɡbaaro pɛl o te dɛ wi taeh.
Belaa Jekɔb ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ, “Taraken maa nae dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ he ta soɡe le nɔ, mɛɛ won sewɛ name.” Asɛ Josef ŋɔ o dɔɔranar ne o mɛɛ lolanar baa kaa la be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ ń la ka ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ n dɔɔranar ne n mɛɛ lolanar bwa baa soɡe Keenan harɛ ta la ba n be.
Mɛɛ ŋɔ o bee ŋɔ he ɛ peteɡra dɛɛ nyiŋi kondɛɛra ta, anomanta, he ba he kondɛɛra ne he kwaa haa dɔa bwa ne.
Dɛ Kooro baa yerɛ heya dɛ bɔɔ toma haa dɛ ɛ wa aa, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ haa ira bwa, kondɛɛra ta nyiŋa toma ɡboo hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ ya naawa aa ɛa wubwa la.
O no ɡɛ naa, wɛɛ ɡeloo he so Gosen harɛ bonɔ.” Dɛ Ijipt tena kii peteɡra, a waa Josef ŋɔ ba ŋɔ ɡɛ la.
Josef la Ijipt kooro be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ ne n dɔɔranar kpɔ ba peera ne nae ne ba komɛlbwa baa dɔa le Keenan harɛ ta dɛ ba, taraken ba lɔ Gosen harɛ ta.” Asɛ dɛ kpɔ o dɔɔranar la bini banue ka baɡle kooro la.
Belaa kooro bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa tomaa hɛɛ ɛɔ?” Asɛ ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya ɛ peteɡra kɛŋɔ ya naawa fa aa ɛa la.
Ya balɔ dɛ́ ba so harɛ nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛ lɔr chole Keenan harɛ ta taeh, kondikwaa toole ya kondɛɛra kwaraa di.
Nomoa, ya dɛ soŋe kɛ he tɛ yaa bɔr ya so Gosen harɛ ta.” Ate, kooro ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ, “Taraken he mɛɛ ne he dɔɔranar aa bala nɔ, Ijipt harɛɛ chɔa kaa la.
Harɛ la bela waa wera la, kpɔ he mɛɛ ne he dɔɔranar ka so o ta.
Dɛ he nyiŋi ba bini dɛ na kɛŋɔ bane ɛɛ won nyiŋi kondɛɛra ta kɛrɛdɛ naa, kpɔ n ɡbaɡba kondɛɛra la do ba nɔn ta.” Belaa Josef ka kpɔ o mɛɛ Jekɔb ba baɡle kooro la, asɛ Jekɔb swee andɛɛɡa tɛ kooro, asɛ kooro la bɔɔ Jekɔb ŋɔ, “He di bene aŋwɛnɛ ɔ?” Anee Jekɔb chaŋe ŋɔ, “Bene maa kpɔa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe la lɔ lafa fifraatoro, a kwaraa la dɛ a kpeɡri tɛ mɛ.
A ta n naawa bene baa dia ba ɡaaɡa bini dɛ so biɡri la tele.” Asɛ Jekɔb swee andɛɛɡa tɛ kooro ja dɛ kpɔ kalo.
Josef kpɔ o mɛɛ ne o dɔɔranar ka so harɛ la ta, bela waa wera ŋɔ ó ɛ ba kon, ɡɛ kooro aa bola la.
Dɛ bela bɛne bwɛjen Rameses, Gosen bela.
Josef tɛ o mɛɛ ne o dɔɔranar, ne o mɛɛ lolanar bwa kondikwaa baa di.
O tɛɛ ba ɡɛ del aa tel ba.
Lɔr waa chole Ijipt harɛ ta wa Lɔr bɛl baa chole Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ o nyoa kpeɡri kohona.
Anomanta, kondikwaa toole bobɛlbwa kpa dɛ ɡwɛɡre Ijipt ne Keenan tena bwa.
Nɛra baa yawɛ boyu aa, ɡɛɛ Josef kpɔ suuɡa la kaa koodem ka cheɡ.
Ijipt tena ne Keenan tena baa di ba suuɡare tonɛ, asɛ Ijipt tena ba Josef be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Lɔr kpo yaa yaa ba serewa.
Ya suuɡare bwa tonɔ.
Tɛ yaa kondikwa.” Belaa Josef chaŋe dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he suuɡa tonɔ aa, hé ka lawɛ kondɛɛra ba charɛ kondikwa.” Anomanta, ba kaa lawɛ ba kondɛɛra ba tɛ Josef dɛ kpɔ charɛ kondikwa.
Jaɡre ne peera ne boohna ne nae, dɛ keeɡore bwa nee ba ba charɛ kondikwa a ɛ kooro la kwa.
Benanyoa aa chema la, ba berɔ ba o be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Nomoa, yaa ya wobɛlbwaa kpɔ sɔeh.
Ya suuɡare bwa tonɔ, asɛ ya kondɛɛra bwa ɡe ɛ he kwa.
Taraken komɛlbwa toole ya be ka ja ya bwadabii ne ya harɛre ta.
Bɛ ɡel ya serewe!
Bɛ ɡel ya harɛ chɔ pɛɛ.
Yawɛ ya ne ya harɛre, dɛ́ tɛ yaa kondikwa.
Yaa ɛ kooro bonɔɔnaa, ásɛ o kpɔ ya harɛre ɡe ja.
Tɛ yaa kondikwaa ya ka di dɛ́ dɔ mkpa, dɛ́ tɛ yaa kondwee yá kpɔ ka du ya harɛ ta, ásɛ dɛ bɛ serewe.” Anomanta, Josef yawɛ Ijipt harɛ bwa, dɛ kpɔ tɛ kooro.
Lɔr la nyoa aa kana kohona nomanta, nomɛlbwa waa lɔ Ijipt yoɡ o harɛ, asɛ a bwa ba do kooro lɔɡa.
Josef kpɔ nɛra baa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta bwa ɛ o nɛndɔɔla.
Sɔfore ɡbo harɛɛ kaa ba ta yawɛ.
Ba te ta ba harɛ yoɡe, dɛkalkɛ dɛ kooro tɛɛ ba kondikwaa baa di.
Josef ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “He nao maa yawɛ he ne he harɛre dɛ tɛ kooro kenɛ?
Kondwee laanee la, hé kpɔ dɛ́ ka du harɛ la ta.
A ɡɛ saŋ a koma aa ba tel la, a chɛ kɛ he bɔne a bini bɔre anue, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ba tɛ kooro.
Ásɛ dɛ ɡe kpɔ a kar, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɛ dwee cheɡ, ásɛ he ne he dem tena ɡe di a kabora.” Asɛ ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he lɛ ya nyu dɛ nyiŋi yaa kɛrɛdɛ.
Yaa ɛ kooro bonɔɔnaa.” Anomanta, Josef ɛ mmara harɛ la ta kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa komɛ o koo kwa aa, ó bɔne a bini bɔre anue, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ba tɛ kooro.
A ɡɛ mmara la ta lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta ba le fini.
Nemenɛ harɛ waa ɛ sɔfore kon la ɡboo wola jae.
Israel tena soɡe Ijipt harɛ Gosen pera, dɛ dɔ kondɔɔh asɛ ba mun ɡe ya kohona.
Jekɔb soɡe Ijipt bene fi dɛ anuanɛ.
O bene waa dia mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ la lɔ lafa fifraanaarɛ dɛ anuanɛ.
O seo tɔpere aa dɛ tel la, o yerɛ Josef dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ nɔn do n hwie baah dɛ́ ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ nyina haa dɛ nyin mɛ ne kasinteŋ haa dɔa kohona tɛ mɛ nomanta, n sewaa, haa men Ijipt harɛ taa huɡe.
N dɛ nyin kɛ he ka huɡ mɛ bela baa huɡe n mɛɛwa.
Kaa n ne bela ka huɡe.” Asɛ Josef sɛh ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛɛ.” Anee Jekɔb ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛɛ.” Asɛ o ɡe ŋwɛɛ, asɛ Jekɔb ɡuŋi mpa ta dɛ jam Korowii.
Manasɛ ne Efrem Awola bɛl, ba baa ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ o mɛɛ bwara dɛ weo.
Belaa o kpɔ o bibaala banɛ, Manasɛ ne Efrem asɛ ba ka nao.
Jekɔb aa noa kɛŋɔ o bie Josef balɔ dɛ́ ba nao la, o takapɔ dɛ ir so mpa ta.
Jekɔb ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ, “Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la kpɔ o te baɡ mɛ Bɛtel baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Lus, Keenan harɛ ta dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ.
O baɡ mɛ nyoa ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo he mun ya, ásɛ he naanar warɛ kohona.
Mɛɛ kpɔ harɛ nɔɔ tɛ he naanar ó ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’ ” Jekɔb berɔ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He bibaala banɛ, Manasɛ ne Efrem haa lol ba Ijipt mɔɔ n ba la bwa ɛ n kwa, kɛŋɔ n bibaala Rubin ne Simeon.
Dɛ he dɔ bii bane ja kwaraa naa, n kwaa laa ba te.
Ba kapɛrɛ diile ɛɛ le Manasɛ ne Efrem luɡe taa.
He nya Rakɛl waa mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ la.
Maa le Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, o baa sewɛ Keenan harɛ ta.
Bela lɔ Efrat ŋwɛnɛ nyoa asɛ n huɡo bela.” Ba berɔ dɛɛ yerɛ Efrat la, Bɛtlɛham fini.
Jekɔb aa na Josef bibaala la, o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bamewa ɡee nɔɔ?” Asɛ Josef chaŋe o mɛɛ ŋɔ, “N bii Korowii aa tɛ mɛ Ijipt harɛ ta bonɔ laanee.” Anee Jekɔb ŋɔ, “Kpɔ ba ba, ásɛ n swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba.” Dɛ hwɛɛhra kohona ɡelɔ waa na kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ Josef kpɔ ba ba o be, asɛ o ɡbaa ba pɛl o bambile dɛ mo ba lwɛrɛme.
Anee Jekɔb ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N ta liire ŋɔ mɛɛ nae kpa.
Kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ n nae, hale dɛ berɛ na he bii ɡe.” Belaa Josef ɡɔɔ ba le o mɛɛ nakpale ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ o sie.
Josef kpɔ Efrem cheɡ o mɛɛ ɡal ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ Manasɛ cheɡ o diɡ ta, kɛ Jekɔb aa dɛ ba soŋa tɛɛ ba la, o ɡaɡre nɔɔra dɛ kpɔ nɔndiɡ dawɛ Efrem waa ɛ bechala la nyu ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ nɔŋɡal dawɛ Manasɛ waa ɛ nomoa la ɡe nyu ta.
Asɛ o soŋe tɛ Josef ŋɔ, “Korowii n mɛɛ Abraham ne Aesek aa tomɔ la swee bii nɔ andɛɛɡa.
Korowii waa dɛ nyiŋi n nɛɛ, dɛ ba le fini tɔpere nɔ swee ba andɛɛɡa.
Korowii torome waa lee mɛ le n wenaale bwa ta la swee bii nɔ andɛɛɡa.
Korowii ɡel n sɔn ne n mɛɛ Abraham ne Aesek sɔn teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Korowii ɡel ba dɔ bii ne naanar kohona.” Josef aa naa kɛŋɔ o mɛɛ kpɔ nɔn diɡ dawɛ Efrem nyu ta la, a ta o som doe.
Anomanta, o laa o mɛɛ nɔn kpɔ Efrem nyu ta, dɛ kpɔ ba dawɛ Manasɛ nyu ta.
Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ, Manasɛɛ binomoa, kpɔ he nɔndiɡ dawɛ o nyu ta.” O mɛɛ ta sɛɛh dɛ ŋɔ, “N jemɔ, n bie.
Manasɛ naanar ɡe ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ nɛnjena.
Kɛ o nime ɛɛ ba ɛ nɛnjenii ɡwaalo, ásɛ o naanar ɡe warɛ kohona.” Anomanta, o swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba awola tɔpere la dɛ ŋɔ, “Israel tena dɛ ba andɛɛɡa sweeraa, baa ŋɔɔ, ‘Korowii ɡel he do kɛŋɔ Efrem ne Manasɛ.’ ” A waa o kpɔ Efrem sɔn tɔ Manasɛ sie la.
Jekɔb ŋɔ Josef be ŋɔ, “Taraken n seo telo, kɛ Korowiirii dɛ́ teŋɛ he nɛ, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ heyaa ba Keenan, waa ɛ he naawa harɛ ta.
N kpɔ Sɛkem harɛ waa wera la dɛɛ tɛɛ, he dɔɔranar laa n kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ.
N dɔmkwaa nee n yo dɛ lɛ le Amɔre tena be.”
Jekɔb swee andɛɛɡa tɛ o bibaala Jekɔb yerɛ o bibaala asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé bwa ba cheme, ásɛ n baɡle heyaa waa aa dɛ ba he nɛɛ bala kerekere.
Hé bwa ba cheme dɛ no.
Hé ba no he mɛɛ Jekɔb wa.
Rubin haa ɛ n binyoa nɔ, henee n kpeɡri.
Henee n tɔ sie lolɛ n bonɔɔne saŋ, dɛ dɔ jirima ne bokpeɡa ɡwaa n bii bwa.
He we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ nehɛma, he jirima tonɔ.
Dɛkalkɛ he lawɛ n hanɛɛte chɔ n chɔɔbɔr, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah mɛ.
Simeon ne Lewi ɛ nimanar.
Ba kpɔ ba dɔmkwaa dɛɛ ba yoi ne.
Maa ba nɛɛ ja ba wobɛlbwa baa vɔrɔwe ta.
Ba baah diu waa, ba dɛ kpoo nɛra, dɛɛ ŋwɛne nae ɡe nakpale pɛɛpɛɛ á bɛ won valɛ.
Ba bandia ne ba nyubinikpeɡ nomanta, bá bwɛɛlɛ!
Mɛɛ lɔ ba naanaree peɡre Israel harɛ bwa.
Dɛ laɡ ba le ba nɛra bini.
Juda, he dɔɔranar ɛɛ duurii, ásɛ he nɔn dawɛ he dɔma nɛ.
He dɔɔranar ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi he siee.
Juda do kɛŋɔ nyujente ken.
Kpaahna taa he che dɛ kpeɡ.
O chɔ harɛ kɛ nyujente aa, umee dɛ wonu wɔ?
Koodaŋɡbala aa o nɔn ta lee ba, mmarare doe ɡe aa o habɔɔ le, ásɛ harɛre nɛra kpɔ koŋkɛɛla baa tɛo, dɛ́ ba ɡuŋi o sie dɛɛ duuru.
Daa baa kpɔ o nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen la taa wɛɛ ba o keeɡo bie lawa vɔwɛ.
A sen nee wɛɛ ba o laala chɛɡa.
Sen ɛɛ ɡeloo o sibie swɛɛ, ásɛ na-elne kohona ɡe ɡel o nyena to.
Sebulon sobɔree mpo nyoa, o jwɛh ka tel Sidon, ásɛ stiimaere che bela wobɛlbwa aa wola an ɛ. Isaaka do kɛŋɔ keeɡo ɡwaŋe, dɛ chɔ o bone baah ta, o nao kɛŋɔ bela waa dɛ ba ona la ɛ bodɛɛɡe asɛ silɛɛ do bela aa, wɛɛ kpɔ vaamaa lɛa, dɛ́ kpɔ o te tɛ tomkpeɡa.
Dan ɛɛ ba nyiŋi o nɛra nɛɛ.
Baa doo kɛŋɔ Israel deene aa kaa la.
Wɛɛ ɛɔ kɛŋɔ domkpule, dɛ́ chɔ ŋwɛnɛ nyoa, dɛ́ choɡe jaaɡɔ nakpala, ásɛ nɛn waa soɡe o ta la ka le habɔɔ.
N Naa Korowii, n soɡoo dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ he ba dɛ́ ba lɛ yaa.
Ŋwɛɛra ɛɛ bao dɛ́ ba yo Gad.
Kɛ o ɡe ɛɛ berɔ teŋɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ yoo ba.
Aasa harɛ ɛɛ ɛ kondikondɛɛɡaa, wɛɛ kpɔ anɔ la aa dɔ pɛlaa ka tɛ kooro.
Naftale ɡe ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ welo waa kpaŋa dɛ chwa dɛɛ kaa.
Wɛɛ lolɛ bii ba do wer.
Josef ɡe do kɛŋɔ daa waa won nɔna kohona, dɛ che nee nyoa, o kpala ɛɛ teeh danjwɛɛ.
O dɔma ɛɛ ba yoo á do kpeɡri, dɛ́ teŋɛ o nɛɛ dɛɛ tao hɛma.
Nemenɛ Korowii, o mɛɛ Jekɔb Kpeɡnɛn waa tomɔ nomanta, wɛɛ do kpeɡrii dɛ́ kpoŋe o to bini kiŋkiŋ.
Peteɡre waa dɛ lɛ Israel tena, dɛ do kɛ Bwetal laanee dɛ́ chao.
Korowii he mɛɛ aa tomɔ laanee dɛ́ chae.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ sweere andɛɛɡa dɛ́ pili nyundua bwaala nɛ tɛɛ, dɛ́ tɛɛ nee aa le harɛ bini.
Onee dɛ́ tɛɛ kondɛɛra ne naanar kohona.
He naawa sweera baa sweera tɛ he mɛɛ la ɡwaa kondɛɛɡa haa dɛ naa deŋɡarere dor.
Korowii le Josef cheɡ dɛ tɛo a ɡɛ hɛɛra nɔ a dawɛ o tile ta, dɛkalkɛ o ɡwaa o dɔɔranar.
Bɛnjamen do kɛŋɔ noniete o sie aa beɡre ol lawa dɛ́ di.
Chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra bwaa o te ɛɛ kpoo ola dɛɛ dia.” Gɛɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la waa do.
Gɛɛ ba mɛɛ Jekɔb bol ɡɛ saŋ waa sweera tɛɛ ba la.
Jekɔb seo ne o huɡa wa Ate, Jekɔb berɛ ŋɔ o bii la be ŋɔ, “Taraken, n dɛ ba sewa.
N baa sewaa, hé ka huɡ mɛ n mɛɛwa huɡri bɔr o fa aa lɔ Hiti te Efron koo ta.
Makpɛlaa o do, o bɛne Mamre waa lɔ Keenan harɛ ta.
Abraham yawɛ a ɡɛ bɔr nɔ ne koo la le Efron be o ɛ ba huɡri bɔr.
Belaa ba huɡe Abraham ne o haah Saara.
Dɛ huɡe Aesek ne o haah Rebɛka ɡe.
Belaa n huɡe Lea ɡe.
Koo la ne bwebɔɔ waa lɔ o ta la, yawaa n naa Abraham yawɔ le Hiti tena be.
Hé huɡ mɛ bela.” Jekɔb aa bol o waa bwa tonɛ o bii la be la, o kpɔ o nyu bil kapuri ta dɛ sewɛ.
Josef kaa pi o mɛɛ nɛ, dɛ wi dɛ mo o lwɛɛma.
Josef ɡelɔ ba kpɔ tɛɛɡa ka fɔɡle o mɛɛ bwara o bɛ pɔh warane.
Chɔɔ la di tɔpera fifraanaarɛ, ɡɛɛ ba kwaa bwadabi la o chɔ ka tel.
Ijipt tena wiu tɔpera fifraanuanɛ.
A ɡɛ tɔpera la aa baa kaa la, Josef ŋɔ o nomondɔŋa be ŋɔ, “N poo heya, hé ka ŋɔ kooro be tɛ mɛ.
N mɛɛ aa dɛ ba sewa la, o ɡelɔ n ŋwɛɛ baɡlo kɛŋɔ mɛɛ huɡoo bwebɔɔ waa kwaaro o do Keenan harɛ ta laanee.
Anomanta, n dɛ soŋe, ó ɡel ń la ka huɡe n mɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ berɛ ba.” Baa laŋa dɛ́ ka bol kooro be la, o chaŋɔ ŋɔ, “Kaa dɛ ka huɡe he mɛɛ ɡɛ haa ŋwɛɛra baɡlo la.” Anomanta, o laŋɔ dɛ́ ka huɡe o mɛɛ.
Kooro nomonome bwa, ne nomonome baa lɔ bela baa dɛ di waa bwa, ne Ijipt harɛ ta nomonome bwa teŋɛ Josef nɛɛ dɛ la.
O lolanar ne o dɔɔranar, ne o mɛɛ lolanar kar bwa teŋɛ o nɛɛ dɛ la.
Ba bii, ne peera ne boohna dɛ nae ɡboo kaa dɛ do Gosen harɛ ta.
Baala baa soɡe kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwa pɛl jaɡre, ne nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta ɡe bwa jao dɛ teŋɛ la bɛl.
Nɛnlaa tentenee laŋa.
Ba baa tel Atad mea lɔbɔr.
O lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr, asɛ ba wi bela kohona.
Josef ɛ o mɛɛ lwe tɔpera anuanɛ.
Keenan tena baa soɡa bɛne bela la aa no ɡɛ baa dɛ wi Atad pɛla ta la, ba ŋɔ, “Ijipt tena lwejen tentenee nɔ.” Anomanta, ba pa bela sɔn Ebel Misraim.
O munii Israel tena lwe ɛɛ.
Kenii a ɛ Jekɔb bibaala ɛ ɡɛ waa do ba ŋɔ ba ɛ la.
Ba cheɡɔɔ kaa Keenan harɛ ta, dɛ ka huɡo bwebɔɔ waa lɔ Makpɛla.
O bɛne Mamre wee leebɔr koo Abraham aa yawɔ le Hiti te Efron be dɛ kpɔ ɛ huɡri bɔr la.
Josef aa huɡe o mɛɛ tonɛ la, o ne o dɔɔranar ne nɛra baa kaa doo la bwa berɔ ba Ijipt harɛ ta.
Josef kpɔ o dɔɔranar wechɔɡa kɛ ba Josef mɛɛ aa sewa la, o dɔɔranar la ŋɔ, “Dɛ Josef ŋɔ wɛɛ hah yaa dɛ́ bɔ yaa ya wechɔɡa yaa ɛo la kem sɛ?” Anomanta, ba tomɛ nɛn Josef be ŋɔ, “Ya mɛɛ aa dɛ ba sewa la, o ŋɔ ya ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Hé kpɔ ya wechɔɡa yaa ɛɛ la bwa kɛ yaa.
Ya dɛ soŋe, kpɔ ya wechɔɡa kɛ yaa.
Kpɔ Korowii he mɛɛ aa tomɔ la bonɔɔna wechɔɡa kɛ yaa.’ ” Waa la aa tel o be la, o wio.
Belaa o dɔɔranar la ɡbabir la dɛ ka ɡuŋi o sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Kpɔ yaa ɛ he bonɔɔna.” Asɛ Josef ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɔmɛ, n laa Korowii.
He te la, he lii n ne wechɔɡa, kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ a berɛ wedɛɛɡa, ɡɛ aa ɛ ó won lɛ nɛndamanta mkpa ɡɛ waa ɛa fini nɔ.
A ta chɛ kɛ he ɔmɛ.
Mɛɛ nyiŋi he ne he bii bwaa.” O bol anɔ dɛ kpɔ larawe ba bwara ba baah sɔɔh.
Josef seo wa Josef ne o mɛɛ lolanar soɡe Ijipt harɛ ta.
Waa baa sewɛ la, dɛ o dɔ bene lafa dɛ fi.
O soɡo dɛ na Efrem bii ne o naanar.
Manasɛ bibaa Makir ɡe bii waa lol ba la, o naa taa ba lol ba dawɛ.
Josef ŋɔ o dɔɔranar la be ŋɔ, “N dɛ́ ba sewa, kɛ Korowii ɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ ásɛ dɛ kpɔ heyaa le harɛ nɔ ta kaa harɛ waa baɡɛ Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb nyoa la ta.” Asɛ Josef berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ŋwɛɛ baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii tɔ he sie dɛ kaa he ne harɛ la ta naa, hɛɛ kpɔ n lalee kaa.” Gɛɛ a do Josef sewɛ Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ o di bene lafa dɛ fi, asɛ ba kpɔ tɛɛɡa fɔɡle o bwara dɛ kpɔɔ do daka bini.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Israel Tena Ira Dɛ Kaa Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ lɛ o nɛra Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta, ɡɛ saŋ baa ɛ yoma bela wa.
Korowii kpɔ o te baɡle Mosis dawii ane aa dɛ fuh baah, dɛ doo ŋɔ ó tɔ o nɛra Israel tena sie le Ijipt harɛ ta.
Nyiŋi nyu .
Korowii ɡelɔ Mposwɛm pere anɛ, asɛ ba valɛ harɛ waa hola ta le o baŋ.
Korowii cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ o Mmarare fi tɛɛ ba Sinai Bwejen ta.
Mmarare fi la habɔɔ la, o berɔ tɛɛ ba ane ɡe, ɡɛ baa che a ta dɛ́ won ba o be dɛ́ baa tomɔ.
O baɡle Mosis ŋwɛnɛre waa kpɔ ɛ Tɛnte Dea baa dɛ ba wona cheo dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, ásɛ dɛ baŋro bobɛlbwa baa ka so, ásɛ o ɛ bɔr baa cheme Korowii bela dɛɛ tomɔ.
Israel tena fiiɡa wa Jekɔb bibaala ne ba haahna ne bii baa ja o nɛɛ dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ laanee nɔ.
Rubin ne Simeon ne Lewi dɛ Juda, ne Isaaka ne Sebulon dɛ Bɛnjamen, ne Dan ne Naftale ne Gad dɛ Aasa.
Nɛra baa le Jekɔb luɡe ta nɔ bwa lɔ fifraanuanɛ, kɛ dɛ Josef te soɡe Ijipt harɛ ta.
Aa ba dɛ la sie la, Josef ne o dɔɔranar ne nimanar ne ba bii la te kapa baa serewe, kɛ ba bii baa lola la baa warɛ, dɛ ɡel Israel tena mun ya kohona, dɛ su Ijipt harɛ bwa ta.
Belaa koofale bɛl waa wola Josef waa jemɛ ba di kara Ijipt harɛ ta.
Awola bɛl, kooro la iro dɛ ŋɔ o nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Israel tena baa lɔ ya harɛ nɔ ta berɔ dɛɛ warɛ kohona, dɛ́ ba di kpeɡri ya nɛɛ tɔpetooro bɛl.
Hé ɡel ya kpɔ liire ɡɛ yaa ɛ ásɛ ba bɛ won warɛ ya harɛ nɔ ta kohona kpa.
Gɛ laa dɛ laa baa chole harɛ nɔ ta naa, baa ja ya dɔma nɛɛ dɛ́ yo yaa dɛ́ chwa le harɛ nɔ ta kaa.” Anomanta, ba le nomonome ba chɔ ba nyoa, dɛ do ba baa ɛ tomkpeɡa.
Dɛ ɡel ba do bwɛjena Petɔm ne Rameses, dɛɛ cheɡ kondikwaa a bini dɛɛ tɛ kooro.
Kɛ Ijipt tena la aa dɛ fiɡ ba kohona la, dɛ nae ba ɡe na dɛɛ ya kwara dɛɛ perɛ harɛ la bwa ta.
Asɛ Ijipt tena berɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ Israel tena la kohona.
Ijipt tena ta ɡelɛ ba sie lɛ ba soɡa bini, ba do ba baa ɛ tomkpeɡa.
Ba ɡelɔ baa teŋe berekese, dɛɛ ma Ijipt tena deene, dɛɛ ɛ ba kooni toma te bwa soo siwi.
Ba ta ba nɛɛ sune, ba fiɡ ba taeh.
Dɛ haahna bane lole baa yer ba Sifra ne Pua baa dɛ lɛ Hibru haahna lol.
Awola bɛl, Ijipt kooro la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he dɛ lɛ Hibru haahna lol dɛ na kɛŋɔ bibaalaa yaa, hé kpoo ba, kɛ dɛ bihaahnaa tenaa, hé ɡel ba.” Haahna la baa dɛ lɛ haahna lol la dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, anomanta, ba ta ɡɛ Ijipt kooro aa ŋɔ ba be la ta teŋɛ.
Ba ɡelɔ bii la do le.
Belaa Ijipt kooro la yer ba dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɡel bii la haa wola ban kpoo nɔɔ?” Anee ba chaŋo dɛ ŋɔ, “Hibru haahna lola aa kpeɡe kɛŋɔ Ijipt haahna.
Ba lola aa kpeɡri doe dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Ba lolɛ ba bii dɛɛ tonɛ mɔɔ ya yon tel bela.” Anomanta, Korowii nyiŋi haahna baa dɛ lɛ haahna lol la nɛ, dɛ ɡel Israel tena mun ya kohona.
Haahna baa dɛ lɛ lol la aa ɛ ɡɛ nomanta, Korowii ɛɛ ba andɛɛɡa dɛ ɡel ba dɔ bii.
Ate, Ijipt kooro la ŋɔ nɛra bwa be ŋɔ, “Bibaa bɛlbwa Hibru te haah naa lolɔ la, hé lɛo dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka ta Nael Moo ta.
Kɛ dɛ bihaahnee te naa, hé ɡel ó do le.”
Mosis lola wa A ɡɛ saŋ baa dɛ kpoo Hibru bibaala ɡɛ la, baa bɛl le Lewi dea, dɛ mo a ɡɛ dea la haah, asɛ o haah la kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa.
Haah la aa naa kɛ bie la wer kohona la, o kpɔɔ sɔh korobie atoro.
Waa baa na kɛ waa won sɔɔh la sie bɛlbwa kpa la, o nyin komɛl baa kpɔ kpɔɡa sɔɔh kɛŋɔ fufu ken, o ne o tɔ dɛ kpɔ kootal maa o habɔɔ ásɛ nee bɛ won jo o bini.
Dɛ kpɔ bie la do o bini ka cheɡ kpɔɡjaŋa ane aa cheɡɛ Nael Moo nyoa.
Asɛ bie la nahaah ka che sie tama dɛɛ nyiŋi waa aa chiɡ bie la nɛ.
Belaa Ijipt kooro la bihaah la moo la ta ŋɔ o ka sɔ ne, dɛ o ne o tolii laŋa, asɛ ba kaa valɛ nee la nyoa.
O baa ŋɔ o nyiŋi dɛ na fufu kpɔɡjaŋa la baah, asɛ dɛ tomɛ o toli la bɛl ŋɔ ó ka kpɔ ba.
Waa ba o ne ba tɛo la, o pilu dɛ na bechasɔɔhna o bini.
Dɛ bie la dɛ wi asɛ o waa do o sum.
Anee o ŋɔ, “Hibru tena bii la bɛlee nɔ.” Anee bie la nahaah la ŋɔ Ijipt kooro bihaah la be ŋɔ, “Amɔ ń la ka yerɛ Hibru haah ó ba ɔro tɛɛ kɛɛ?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, la dɛ́ ka yerɛ bɛl ba.” Asɛ o la dɛ ka kpɔ bie la nya ɡbaɡba ba.
Belaa Ijipt kooro bihaah la ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ bie nɔ, dɛ́ ka dɛɛro tɛ mɛ ásɛ n bɔe kem.” Asɛ o kpɔ bie la dɛ kaa.
Bie la aa baa kpeɡ tama la, o kpɔɔ ka tɛ Ijipt kooro bihaah la o berɛ o bie.
O ŋɔ, “O sɔne Mosis, dɛkalkɛ nee taa n kpɔɔ le.” Mosis chwae kaa Midian harɛ ta wa Mosis aa kpeɡa la, awola bɛl, o iro dɛ ka chɔɔ o bala Hibru tena, dɛ na ɡɛ baa do ba baa ɛ tomkpeɡa.
Asɛ Mosis na Ijipt te kɛŋɔ waa dɛ lɔɔ o bwɛɛ Hibru te.
Waa nyiŋa bar o ta nomɛlbwa nae la, o kpo Ijipt te la dɛ ɡbaa hɛŋle tɔ o nɛ.
Tɔ aa pera la, o laŋɔ ŋɔ ó ka chɔɔ o bala la ja dɛ na Hibru tena baala banɛ aa dɛ yo.
Belaa o bɔɔ onɔ la o kon aa wola maɡrɛ la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lɔɔ he dɔŋ nɔɔ?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Umee cheɡe kora ta ŋɔ hé baa nyiŋi ya nɛɛ dɛ́ bol ya waa dɛɛ pa bole ɔ?
He dɛ nyin he kpo mɛ ɡɛ haa kpo Ijipt te la kɛɛ?” Ate, Mosis ɔmɛ, dɛ lii kɛŋɔ, “Jamɔ nɛra na n waa maa ɛa la.” Ijipt kooro baa no waa la, dɛɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛre waa kpɔ a ta dɛ́ kpo Mosis, asɛ o chwa le bela dɛ ka so Midian harɛ ta.
Dɛ kɔlɔŋ bɛl lɔ bela, asɛ awola bɛl, Mosis la ka so o nyoa.
Dɛ Midian sɔfo bɛl sɔne Jetro, o bihaahna banuanɛ ba ba viine ne dɛ́ ba dɔ nee tɛ ba mɛɛ peera ne boohna a nyɔ bela.
Belaa peteɡra bane den ba dɛ ba doŋi Jetro bihaahna la.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ ba yon dɛɛ ɛɛ ba.
Kɛ Mosis ta sɛɛh, o lɛɛ ba ta dɛ ɡbabir ir dɔ nee tɛ ba kondɛɛra la a nyɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Bihaahna la aa bera la dem ba mɛɛ be la, o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ fini te he ba warane ken?” Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ijipt te bɛlee lɛ yaa ta peteɡra bane nɔn ta.
O ɡbabirii dɔ ya nee tɛ yaa dɛ tɛ kondɛɛra la ɡe ane a nyɔ.” Belaa o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Leperaa o dɔɔ?
Ɛrɛ waa he ɡelo bela nɔɔ?
He la ka yerɔ ó ba ya di kwa.” Ba kaa yerɛ Mosis ó ba, waa bala la o sie baa lɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ so ba bee.
O ne baa soɡa la sie tama la, sɔfo Jetro lawɛ o bihaah Sepora tɛo o mo.
Ba lolɛ bibaa, asɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “O sɔne Gɛɛsɔm dɛkalkɛŋɔ, hɔɔhree men harɛ nɔ ta.” A biɡro tama, asɛ Ijipt kooro la ba sewɛ.
Kɛ dɛ Israel tena ta dɛ ɛ ba tomkpeɡa la, dɛ wi dɛɛ yerɛ Korowii ŋɔ ó ba lɛɛ ba.
Korowii no ba wii, dɛ lii fɔo o ne Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa fɔwa la wa.
Korowii na Israel tena wenaale, asɛ ba waa we o nɛɛ kohona.
Mosis ne dawii ane aa dɛ fuh wa Awola bɛl, Mosis kpɔ o helabaa Jetro waa ɛ Midian sɔfo la kondɛɛra kaa di bɔr.
O teɡa ka ɡarɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ ka le bwe waa do ɡoroŋ baa yerɔ Sinai la ta.
Belaa Korowii nyundua torome bɛl kpɔ o te baɡlo dawii ane aa dɛ lawɛ nii baah ta.
Mosis nao kɛŋɔ nii dɛ le bela, kɛ dɛ dawii la ɡe aa fuh.
Anomanta, o lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ te ɔma.
Mɛɛ suuhnu tel, dɛ́ na ɡɛ aa ɛa dawii nɔ aa wola fuh nɔ.” Korowii aa naa kɛŋɔ o ba sie dɛ́ ba na la, o yerɔ dawii la bini ŋɔ, “Mosis!
Mosis!” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, menee nɔ.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Bɛ suuh tel.
Foo he naŋɡawa, dɛkalkɛ bela haa cheɡa la ɛ boɡoroŋ.
Menee Korowii he nabaala Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tom mɛ la.” Belaa Mosis kpɔ sie sɔh dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ó nyiŋi Korowii.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “N na sibeɡra kohona baa dɛ do n nɛra baa lɔ Ijipt.
N no ba wii, dɛ le ba dɔɔranar tonchɔɡa baa dɛ do ba la ta, anomanta, ba waa hiah mɛ kohona.
N tuo ba dɛ́ ba lɛɛ ba le Ijipt tena nɔn ta, ásɛ dɛ berɛ kpɔ ba ba harɛpare ondɛɛge ta.
O do som Keenan ne Hiti ne Amɔre ne Pɛrɛs ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena harɛ baa soɡe o ta la ta.
Taraken Israel tena wii la tel n be, asɛ n na ɡɛ Ijipt tena la aa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa.
N dɛ tomɛ Ijipt kooro be, ásɛ he tɔ n nɛra sie ba won le o harɛ la ta.” Anee Mosis ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Umee n ɡe kɛŋɔ ń won la Ijipt kooro be dɛ́ ka ŋɔ ń kpɔ Israel tena le o harɛ ta bela ɔ?” Asɛ Korowii chaŋo ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ he baa kpɔ n nɛra le Ijipt harɛ ta ba naa, bá baa tom mɛ bwejen nɔ ta.
Anee dɛɛ ba baɡla kɛŋɔ menee tomɛ.” Belaa Mosis chaŋo dɛ ŋɔ, “Amɔ dɛ n la Israel tena be dɛ ka ŋɔ, Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ laanee tom mɛ ba be, asɛ ba bɔɔ mɛ o sɔn aa, bɔkwa waa ń bol ba be nɔ?” Anee Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Menee Men.
Kenii chɛ kɛ he ŋɔ ba be kɛŋɔ naate baa dɛ yerɔ, ‘Menee Men laanee tom mɛ he be.’ ” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ‘Men Korowii ba nabaala Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tomɔ laanee tomɛ ba be.’ A ɡɛ sɔn nɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ n sɔn saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ásɛ naanar baa ka ba bwa ɡe ɛɛ yer mɛ ɡɛ.
La ka cheme Israel nomonome dɛ́ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii he naawa Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb aa tomɔ la ba n be dɛ ba ŋɔ, o nyiŋo, dɛ na ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa Ijipt harɛ.
Anomanta, o ŋɔ, wɛɛ lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ bela baa dɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa kohona la, dɛ́ kaa he ne harɛpare ondɛɛɡe ta.
Bela Keenan ne Hiti ne Amɔre ne Pɛrɛs ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena aa soɡa la.’ Nomonome la ɛɛ no he waa haa bol ba be laanee, ásɛ he ne ba la Ijipt kooro be dɛ́ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii Hibru tena aa dɛ tomɔ la kpɔ o te chaɡle yaa.
Anomanta, tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ yá ka ɡaaɡe tɔpera atoro pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ.’ N jemɔ kɛŋɔ Ijipt kooro aa sɛh ŋɔ he kaa nemenɛ wekpeɡa ane aa puu mɔɔ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ che n kpeɡri taa dɛ́ ɡel Ijipt tena na n nyokpowe-ɛɛla maa dɛ́ ba ɛɛ ba bini la, mɔɔ ó ɡel he kaa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba siwi su heya, ásɛ dɛ he ba dɛ kaa laa, he bɛ nɔŋɡbala kpɔ kaa.
Israel haah bɛlbwa la o dɔŋ Ijipt handɔŋ be, ne banɔ la bane baa pɛa so deremi ta ka soŋe kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ɛa dɛ yale, dɛ́ kpɔ do he bibaala ne bihaahna.
Ásɛ ba laala la berɛ kwaa haa kaa paa laa ta.”
Kpeɡri Korowii aa tɛ Mosis Anee Mosis chaŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ ba ta men yaradae dɛ cheɡ deŋne no n be, dɛ ŋɔ he ta he te kpɔe baɡ mɛ naa, n ŋɔ ɛrɔɔ?” Belaa Korowii bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa lɔ he nɔn ta nɔɔ?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Daŋɡbalaa lɔ n nɔn ta.” Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Kpɔ ta harɛ.” Mosis aa kpɔa ta harɛ la, o berɛ harɛkon, asɛ o chwa le o jwɛh.
Ate, Korowii berɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Tɛr nɔn lawɛ o din.” Waa lawɔ la, asɛ o berɛ daŋɡbala do o nɔn ta.
Asɛ o berɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba yarada kɛŋɔ Korowii ba naawa Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb aa tomɔ la kpɔ o te baɡle laanee la.” O berɔ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he nɔn do he batakaare bini,” asɛ o ɛ ɡɛ.
Waa laa nɔn kpɔ la, dɛ o lɛɡrɔ kɛŋɔ bwadabii weechɔɡa yon lawɛ nɛn la ken.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Berɛ kpɔ he nɔn la do.” Asɛ o ɛ ɡɛ.
Waa bera laa nɔn kpɔ la, dɛ o bwa kwaarɔ dɛ do kɛŋɔ o fa aa doa wubwa la.
Korowii bol o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ ba ta hen yaradae nyokpowe-ɛɛla aa tɔ sie la ta tenaa, ba ken ɛɛ yarada anɔ aa teŋa nɛɛ nɔ ta tenee.
Kɛ dɛ ba ta hen yaradae nyokpowe-ɛɛla nɔ bwa ta, kɛɛ dɛ taŋ deŋne aa, ka ɛ nee le Nael Moo ta dɛ́ fuɡa ta harɛ.
Nee la ɛɛ berɛ chalee dawɛ harɛ la sie.” Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n nyoa aa kpɛlɛ ń won bol waa a do som.
Dɛ le n bechale saŋ ne ɡɛ saŋ haa kpɔ he te baɡ mɛ bwaa n nyoa aa wola kpɛlɛ ne wobol.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Umee tɛ nɛn nyoa o kpɔ dɛɛ bol waɔ?
Kɛɛ umee dɛɛ ɛ nɛn amumu ne deŋneɡbeŋa te, kɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ na ne onɔ la waa wola na nɔ?
Men Korowii laa aa?
Ir kaa, mɛɛ chae he bol wa, dɛ́ baɡle ɡɛ bwa haa bol.” Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n dɛ soŋe amɔ he fe tomɛ nɛnfale bɛl sɛ?” Belaa Korowii baah di o nɛɛ kohona asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “He dɔɔ baa dɛ yerɔ Arɔn o ɛ Lewi dea te la sɛ?
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ o te ɛɛ won bol waa kɛrɛdɛ.
Hale o lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta taraken dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba cheme.
O balɔ ba nae naa, o sie ɛɛ lɛo taeh.
Bol ɡɛ bwa haa dɛ nyin bola bwa do o nyoa.
Mɛɛ cha heyaa he bol wa, dɛ́ baɡle heya ɡɛ bwa haa ɛ. Arɔn ɛɛ dɛɛ bol waa nɛra la bee, ásɛ a ɛ kɛŋɔ henee dɛɛ bol.
Aa ka ɛɔ kɛŋɔ henee ɛ Korowii, asɛ o bol he waa nɛra la be dɛɛ tɛɛ.
Kɛ kpɔ daŋɡbala nɔ kpoŋe, onee hɛɛ ba wona kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowa.” Mosis bera dɛ́ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta Belaa Mosis berɛ kaa o helabaa Jetro be dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe, ɡel ń berɛ kaa n lolanar be Ijipt dɛ́ ka na kɛŋɔ ba ta lole kɛɛ.” Anee o sɛh dɛ tao ŋwɛnɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ta o kaa.
Mosis taa lɔ Midian harɛ ta la, Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ nɛra la ba fa aa dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo la bwa serewɔ.” Anomanta, o kpɔ o haah ne bibaala so keeɡo ta, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ, dɛ kpɔ daŋɡbala Korowii aa bol o waa o be la kpoŋe.
Belaa Korowii berɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Haa bera dɛɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta nɔ, na kɛŋɔ kpeɡri maa tɛɛ he kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa la, hɛɛ ɛa Ijipt kooro siwi taa.
Kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo o deŋne do kpeɡri, waa wola ɡel n nɛra la kaa.
Ásɛ he ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, Israel tena do kɛŋɔ n bibanloɡle ken, asɛ n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, he tɛ n bibaa ŋwɛnɛ ásɛ o ka tom mɛ.
Kɛ he vɛoh, anomanta, mɛɛ kpo he ɡe bibanloɡlee.” Baa dɛ kaa la, Korowii baa cheme Mosis Ijipt ŋwɛnɛ ta, bobɛl hɔɔhra tel bela ba yon chɔ la, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin o kpoe.
Belaa o haah Sepora kpɔ bwepɛla o nyoa aa do kɛŋɔ kere teŋe o bie la pen, dɛ kpɔ chal la ka leɡe Mosis napaala dɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ maa ɛa nɔ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ n ne he ɛ beŋkpoŋ ya soɡa nɔ bini.” Anomanta, Korowii ɡel Mosis kpoe.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Ir la pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka cheme Mosis.” Asɛ o ir dɛ la ka chemo Korowii bwe waa do ɡoroŋ ta dɛ jaamo.
Belaa Mosis bol wobɛlbwa Korowii aa tomɔ ŋɔ ó ka bol, ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla la bwa waa doo ŋɔ ó ɛ la bwa chaɡle Arɔn.
Anomanta, o ne Arɔn bwa la Ijipt dɛ ka boa Israel nomonome la bwa nyoa, asɛ Arɔn chaɡle wobɛlbwa Korowii aa bola baɡle Mosis la ba be.
Mosis berɔ ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla la ba siwi ta, asɛ ba yaradao.
Baa noa kɛŋɔ Korowii na ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa asɛ ba waa hiaoh kohona la, ba ɡuŋo dɛ duuru.
Mosis ne Arɔn Ijipt kooro be laŋa A habɔɔ la, Mosis ne Arɔn la kooro la be dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Tɛ n nɛra ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa, ásɛ dɛ ka di Tɔpejen tɛ mɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.’ ” Anee kooro la ŋɔ, “Umee Korowii n duuru, dɛ́ tɛ Israel tena ŋwɛnɛ ba kaalɔ?
Maa Korowii bɛlbwa jemɛ, anomanta, maa ban ŋwɛnɛɛ tɛ ba kaa.” Asɛ Mosis ne Arɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii Hibru tena aa dɛ tomɛ la ba ya be, anomanta, tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ ya ka ɡaaɡe tɔpera atoro pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa, wɛɛ kpɔ laa kɛɛ weechɔɡaa ba kpoo yaa.” Belaa Ijipt kooro ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin he kpɔ ba kaa, ásɛ ba ɡel toma baa dɛ ɛ nɔɔ?
Ba berɛ ba kaa ba toma ta!
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ warɔ ɡwaa Ijipt tena harɛ nɔ ta, asɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin ba ɡel toma ɛɛ la!” Awola tɔpere la tenten la, kooro do Ijipt tena baa dɛ nyiŋi Hibru tena baa ɛ yoma dɛ chɔ ba bala nyoa la be ŋɔ, “He bɛ kpɔɡhola nɛra la aa kpɔa dɛɛ teŋe berekese la tɛ kpa.
Hé ɡel ba ɡbabir kaa nyin ba kpɔɡa, kɛ dɛ ta ɛɛ teŋe ɡɛ tenten baa dɛ teŋe wubwa la.
He bɛ ane laa kpɔ a ta.
Ba ɛ nɛra ba sie aa dɛ hwah toma ɛɛ, a waa baa wi ŋɔ, ń ɡel ba la ka kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la.
Hé tɛɛ ba tomkpeɡa aa ɡwaa wubwa kwaa la, ásɛ ba bɛ bɔr dɔ dɛɛ no nyosonteŋna wobol.” Belaa Ijipt tena baa dɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra la nɛ, ne Hibru tena baa chɔ ba bala nyoa la le dɛ ka ŋɔ nɛra la be kɛŋɔ kooro ŋɔ, “Maa heyaa kpɔɡholee tɛ kpa.
Hé ɡbabir ka ɡaaɡe nyin he kpɔɡa.
Kɛ ɡɛ tenten maa maɡa tɛ heyaa wubwa laanee hɛɛ ba ɛɛ.” Asɛ ba lɔ jo Ijipt harɛ ta bwa dɛ ka nyin kpɔɡa la.
Dɛ Ijipt tena baa dɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra la nɛɛ la teŋɔ dɛɛ do ba ŋɔ, “Hé do sie dɛ́ ɛ toma ɡɛ wubwa yaa dɛ tɛ heyaa kpɔɡa hɛɛ ɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa la.” Asɛ Ijipt nomonome la lɔɔ Hibru tena baa ɡela ba chɔ ba bala la nyoa la.
Dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ta wone ɛ toma ɡɛ he fa aa dɛ ɛ wubwa la nɔɔ?” Anee Israel tena baa ɡela ba chɔ ba bala nyoa la la Ijipt kooro be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ɛrɛɛ he ɛ yaa ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Ba ta yaa kpɔɡa bɛlbwa tɛɛ, kɛ dɛ ɡe teŋɛ dɛɛ ŋɔ ya teŋe berekese ɡɛ baa maɡa tɛ yaa wubwa la, dɛɛ lɔɔ yaa kɛ dɛ he ɡbabir nɛra la bee a le.” Anee Ijipt kooro la ŋɔ, “Bɔhwaahra bane le!
A waa laa hɛɛ bol ŋɔ, n ɡel hé la ka kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ naa?
Hé berɛ kaa toma ta.
Nomɛlbwa aa heya kpɔɡa tɛɛ ba, kɛ he ɡee teŋe berekese laanee kɛ wubwa la.” Hibru tena baa chɔ ba bala nyoa la aa noa kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ teŋe berekese ɡɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa baa maɡa tɛɛ ba wubwa la, belaa ba na kɛŋɔ taraken te waa puu ba.
Baa le Ijipt kooro be dɛɛ kaa la, ba kaa pu Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ ba cheɡɔ dɛɛ kpaa ba.
Asɛ ba ŋɔ Mosis wa be ŋɔ, “Korowiirii dɛ tɛr he deŋne kɛŋɔ haa ɡela kooro ne o nomonome hah yaa la.
A deno do kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ keri do ba nɔɔra ta ŋɔ bá kpoo yaa ken.” Mosis naɡre Korowii wa Belaa Mosis berɛ ka bɔɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ do he ɡbabir nɛra hɔhɔrɔwa ta ken?
Anɔ waa he tom mɛ ba be kɛɛ?
Le a ɡɛ saŋ maa cheɡɛ he sɔn ta dɛ ka bol waa la Ijipt kooro be la, teŋaa ba teŋɛ dɛɛ na wahala, asɛ he ɡe den vɛh ba lɛɛ kwara.”
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Taraken n dɛ ba ɡela he jemɛ waa maa dɛ ba kpɔe ɛ Ijipt kooro la.
Aa che n kpeɡri taa ó tɛ n nɛra la ŋwɛnɛ bá kaa.
Hale dɛ́ ɡel ó doŋ ba le o harɛ ta.” Korowii yerɛ Mosis Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii.
Men kpɔ n te baɡle Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb kɛ Menee Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la.
Kɛ n ta ɡelɛ ba jemɛ n sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la te.
Asɛ n ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo kɛŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ Keenan harɛ baa soɡe o ta kɛŋɔ hɔɔhra laanee tɛɛ ba ó ɛ ba kon.
N na wahala Israel tena aa dɛ na Ijipt tena nɔn ta baa ɛɛ ba kɛ yoma la, dɛ lii n ne ba fɔo yaa fɔwa la.
Anomanta, ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ‘Menee Korowii.
Mɛɛ lɛ heyaa le Ijipt tena hɔhɔrɔwa baa dɛ ɛ heyaa la taa.
Mɛɛ che n kpeɡri ne n nyokpowe-ɛɛla taa, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne ásɛ dɛ lɛ heya.
Mɛɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ n nɛra, ásɛ n ɡe ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii haa dɛ tomɛ n lɛ heyaa le Ijipt tena nɔn ta.
N baɡɛ Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb nyoa kpeɡri nɛ harɛ maa ŋɔa mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba la wa.
Mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heya ó ɛ he kon pi.
Men Korowii bola.’ ” Mosis bol ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡle Israel tena la kɛ, bambichɔɡ kohona ne ba dochɔɡa la nomanta, ba ta noɛ.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “La ka ŋɔ Ijipt kooro la be ŋɔ ó ɡel Israel tena la le o harɛ la ta.” Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Israel tena ɡba aa wola a mun noɛ nɔ, ɛrɛɛ kooro te ɛɛ ba a mun noe yɔ?
N nyoa aa kpɛlɛ ń won bol waa á do som.” Korowii berɔ bol Israel tena ne Ijipt kooro waa baɡle Mosis ne Arɔn, dɛ do ba ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta.
Mosis ne Arɔn naawa wa Rubin waa ɛ Jekɔb bibanloɡle la bibaalaa Hanɔk ne Palu ne Hɛsrɔn dɛ Kaami.
Ba sɔna nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ Rubin dea sɔna.
Simeon ɡe bibaalaa Jɛmoɛl ne Jamin ne Ohad ne Jakin ne Soha dɛ Swaul o nya aa ɛ Keenan te.
Simeon dea bii sɔnaa.
Lewi ɡe bibaala ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ laanee, Gɛsɔn ne Kohat dɛ Merari.
Bene lafa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛɛ Lewi di dɛ sewɛ.
Asɛ Gɛsɔn bibaalaa Libni ne Simee.
Ba dea sɔnaa.
Kohat ɡe bibaalaa Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.
O di bene lafa fifraatoro dɛ atoro mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ.
Merari ɡe bibaalaa Maali ne Musi.
Gɛɛ Lewi naanar teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛ le o dea.
Amram kpɔ o mɛɛ nimambie Jɔkɛbɛd mo, asɛ dɛ lolɛ Arɔn ne Mosis.
O di bene lafa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ.
Isiha ɡe bibaalaa Kora ne Nɛfɛɡ dɛ Sikri.
Asɛ Usiel ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee Mesael ne Ɛlsafan dɛ Sitri.
Arɔn ɡe mo haah.
O sɔne Eliseba.
Dɛ Aminadab bihaahnee o ɛ Naasɔn nimambie.
Bibaala baa lola laanee Nadab ne Abihu ne Eliasa dɛ Itama.
Kora ɡe bibaalaa Asir ne Ɛlkana dɛ Abiasaf.
Banee Kora dea sɔna.
Arɔn bibaa Eliasa mo Putiel bihaah bɛl, asɛ dɛ lolɛ Fenehas.
Banɔɔ le Lewi luɡe ta dɛ chɔ ba deene nyoo.
A ɡɛ Arɔn nɔ ne Mosisii Korowii ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Ba tentenee ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ ó tɛ Israel tena ŋwɛnɛ bá kaa la.
Arɔn cheɡɛ Mosis naa ta dɛɛ bol wa Korowii aa bol waa Mosis be Ijipt harɛ ta la, o ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii.
Bol wobɛlbwa maa bol he be baɡle Ijipt kooro la.” Anee Mosis chaŋe ŋɔ, “N nyoa aa wola kpɛlɛ n won bol waa a do som nɔ, wɛɛ no a munii yaa?”
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ no.
N dɛ ba ɡela he do kɛŋɔ men Korowii ken Ijipt tena kooro sie, ásɛ he dɔɔ Arɔn ɛ keame dɛɛ bol waa o be.
Ka ŋɔ wobɛlbwa maa dɛ bol he be nɔ baɡle Arɔn ó ŋɔ kooro be ó tɛ Israel tena la ŋwɛnɛ ba le o harɛ ta.
Kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo kooro la deŋne do kpeɡri dɛ bɛ he be no, ásɛ dɛ n ɛ nyokpowaa kohona harɛ la ta kwaraa naa, waa he bee no.
Waa wola he bee no nomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ deŋnetɛraa ba harɛ la ta dɛ́ do ba sibeɡra kohona dɛ́ lawɛ n nɛra Israel tena bwa le bela.
Mɛɛ baɡle n kpeɡri Ijipt harɛɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, dɛ́ lawɛ n nɛra Israel tena le, ásɛ Ijipt tena bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Asɛ Mosis ne Arɔn ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa bol ba be bwa.
Baa kaa bol waa la kooro be la, dɛ Mosis di bene fifraanuatoro, asɛ Arɔn ɡe di fifraanuatoro dɛ atoro.
Arɔn daŋɡbala waa berɛ harɛkon wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Dɛ Ijipt kooro dɛ nyin kɛ he ɛ nyokpo waane o na naa, he ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ ó kpɔ o daŋɡbala ta kooro sie.
Wɛɛ berɛ harɛkonee.” Anee ba la Ijipt kooro be dɛ ka ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa ba ɛ la bwa.
Asɛ Arɔn kpɔ o daŋɡbala la ta kooro ne o nomonome sie o berɛ harɛkon.
Ijipt kooro yerɛ Ijipt wejerema ne dobodobo tena cheme, asɛ dobodobo tena ɡe ɛ ba wa.
Bɛlbwa kpɔ o daŋɡbala ta harɛ o berɛ harɛkon, kɛ Arɔn kon la wono lawɛ ba kwaa la liɡli.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, dɛ Ijipt kooro deŋne ta kpeɡri o ŋɔ waa ba waa la munii no ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.
Nael Moo ne neerare bwa chal bera wa Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ijipt Kooro deŋne kpeɡri o vɛh nɛra la ŋwɛnɛ tae ba kaa kenɛ?
La o be chɔɔbɔr, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ waa dɛ kaa Nael Moo ta.
Ka che nee la nyoa kpao dɛ́ kpɔ daŋɡbala o fa aa berɛ harɛkon la kpoŋe.” Kenii chɛ kɛ he ŋɔ o be, “Korowii Hibru tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee tom mɛ he be ŋɔ he ta o nɛra Israel tena ŋwɛnɛ bá kaa, dɛ́ won ka tomɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Kɛ, ba le saŋ nɔ he ta o be noɛ.” Anomanta, o ŋɔ, “Anɔɔ hɛɛ ba kpɔe dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ onee Korowii.
N dɛ ba daŋɡbala nɔ kpɔe lɔ nee nɔ sie, ásɛ o bwa berɛ chal.
Pɛŋa aa lɔ o bini bwa ɛɛ serewoo, ásɛ o do sɔɔh kohona Ijipt te bɛlbwa aa wola won nyɔ o ne.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Arɔn be ó tɛr o daŋɡbala dɛ́ kpɔ pa Ijipt neerare bwa ta, nenabɔɔne ne taama dɛ buli bwa, ásɛ a berɛ chal.
Chal ɛɛ perɛ harɛ la ta bobɛlbwaa.
Hale komɛlbwa nee aa lɔ o bini bwa.” Asɛ Mosis ne Arɔn ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do ba la.
Arɔn kpɔ o daŋɡbala la lɔ nee la Ijipt kooro ne o nomonome sie, asɛ nee la bwa berɛ chal.
Pɛŋa aa lɔ Nael Moo ta bwa serewɔ, dɛ do sɔɔh kohona Ijipt te bɛlbwa ta wone nyɔ o ne.
Asɛ chal perɛ harɛ la ta bwa.
Belaa Ijipt dobodobo tena ba ɛ ba wa dɛ ɡe ɛ ɡɛ tenten.
Dɛ kooro ta lɔ o deŋnekpeɡ la ta, o ta ba waa la ta noɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.
O berɔ kaa o koodem, dɛ ka laa o liire kpɔ waa waa naa la bwa ta.
Ijipt tena bwa ka dɛ kwi bɔɔne Nael Moo nyoa dɛɛ nyin nee ba nyɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ baa won ba nee la nyɔ kpa.
Sapone ane wa Korowii aa ɡela nee la berɛ chal la, a yawanyoa habɔɔ o berɛ bol waa Mosis be.
Belaa Korowii bol waa Mosis be ŋɔ, “La Ijipt tena kooro be, dɛ́ ka ŋɔ n ŋɔ o tɛ n nɛra ŋwɛnɛ, ásɛ ba kaa tom mɛ.
Dɛ o ta sɛɛh dɛ ɡel ba kaa laa, mɛɛ ɡeloo sapone ba su harɛ nɔ bwa ta.
Aa su Nael Moo bwaa dɛ́ ba le koodem ne o dea ne o chɔɔbɔr bwa.
O nomonome ne o nɛra bwa deremi, ne bela baa dɛ ɛ kondikwaare, ne bela baa dɛ wɔɔ paanoo, dɛ kwaa baa dɛ charame paanoo a bini bwa taa aa ba sui.
