O ne o nomonome ne harɛ la ta tena bwa nɛɛ sapone la ɛɛ ba jaeh dɛɛ teeh.” Korowii ɡelɔ Mosis ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Tɛr he daŋɡbala pa buli ne taama dɛ neerare ta, ásɛ sapone le ba su Ijipt harɛ bwa ta.” Asɛ Arɔn tɛr pa neerare la ta, asɛ sapone la ba tɔ harɛ la bwa ta.
Dobodobo tena la ɡe ɛ ba we-ɛɛla dɛ ɡel sapone ba harɛ la ta.
Belaa Ijipt kooro yerɛ Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé soŋe Korowii ásɛ o laa sapone nɔ kpɔ n ne n nɛra nɛ, ásɛ n tɛ he nɛra ŋwɛnɛ bá ka kpoo kwaa tɛ Korowii.” Anee Mosis ŋɔ, “A wer ɡa, mɛɛ soŋoo tɛɛ.
Kɛ n poori, baɡle tɔpere haa dɛ nyin, ásɛ n soŋe tɛ he ne he nomonome ne he nɛra á le he nɛ, a ka Nael Moo kwaa la ɡbo.” Asɛ Ijipt kooro chaŋo ŋɔ, “Soŋe tɛ mɛ kere.” Anee Mosis ŋɔ, “N noɔ, mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa ŋɔa nɔɔ, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔ dɔŋ toole.
Sapone la ɛɛ le he ne he nomonome ne nɛra ne he deremi taa, ásɛ a ka Nael Moo kwaa la ɡbo.” Ba le Ijipt kooro be bela, asɛ Mosis wi no Korowii ŋɔ ó laa sapone waa kpɔa ba ta kooro nɛɛ la kpɔ o nɛ.
Asɛ Korowii no o wesoŋa la, dɛ ɡel sapone aa lɔ deene ne dembaahna ne kooni bwa serewe.
Anee ba boa a nyoa a dadaŋɛ chɔ, bobɛlbwa taŋre.
Bosɔɔhna aa bala la, kooro berɔ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh Mosis ne Arɔn waa la ta teŋa ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.
Konjeɡre ane wa Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Arɔn be ó kpɔ daŋɡbala la lɔ harɛ, ásɛ konjeɡre fuɡe le Ijipt harɛ bwa ta.
Anee Arɔn kpɔ daŋɡbala la lɔ harɛ asɛ bomboɡ aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta bwa berɛ konjeɡre tɔ nɛra ne ola nɛ.” Dobodobo tena la ɛ ba we-ɛɛla bwa baa ɛ dɛ ɡe ɡel konjeɡre ba kahonɛ.
Dɛ konjeɡre la tɔ nɛra ne ola bwa nɛ.
Anee dobodobo tena la ŋɔ kooro la be ŋɔ, “Korowii we-ɛɛlaa nɔ noo!” Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ Ijipt kooro deŋne ta kpeɡri o vɛh waa la noe, ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.
Chwɛɛhne ane wa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kere chɔmbibii he ir.
Kooro ɛɛ iruu dɛɛ kaa nee la ta, ásɛ he la o be dɛ́ ka ŋɔ kenii men Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Tɛ n nɛra ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa dɛ́ kaa tom mɛ.
He vɛh n nɛra ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ba kaa laa, mɛɛ ɡeloo chwɛɛhne fuɡe le he ne nɛra ne nomonome nɛ, dɛ deene bwa bini.
Ijipt tena deene ne harɛ la bwa ɛɛ su chwɛɛhnee.
Kɛ awola tɔpere la, Ijipt harɛ Gosen n nɛra aa soɡe bela la te aa ɡɛ waa nɔɔ na.
Chwɛɛhne la aa ba te nɛɛ ba, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii maa lɔ n nɛra baah ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he jemɛ kɛŋɔ n nɛra korɛ he nɛra bini.
Kere ɡbosoroo a ɡɛ nyokpowaa nɔ ɛɛ ba ɛɛ.’ ” Asɛ Korowii ɛ ɡɛ, dɛ ɡel chwɛɛhne fuɡe le, dɛ ba su koodem ne o nomonome deremi, dɛ chɔɡ harɛ la bwa.
Belaa Ijipt kooro yerɛ Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ir kaa dɛ́ ka kpoo kwaa tɛ Korowii n harɛ ta bonɔ.” Anee Mosis chaŋe ŋɔ, “A ta maɡrɛ kɛ ya ɛa bonɔ.
Kwaa yaa kpɔ tɛ Korowii la ɛ kwaa haa kia.
Dɛ ya ŋɔ ya ɛa he siwi ta naa, he nɛra aa yaa bwea foɡre kpo aa?
Gɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa ŋɔ ya be la, a chɛ kɛ yá valɛ tɔpera atoro ŋwɛnɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka kpoo kwaa tɛo.” Anee Ijipt kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tɛ ŋwɛnɛɛ he la ka kpo kwaa tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, kɛ he bɛ bojaŋ kaa.
Hé soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ mɔɔ.” Asɛ Mosis chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ n le bonɔ naa, mɛɛ ka soŋe Korowii, ásɛ kere ɡbosoroo chwɛɛhne la le he ne nomonome ne he nɛra bwa nɛ.
Kɛ na kɛŋɔ haa nyosonee teŋe kpa, haa wola ɡel Korowii nɛra la bɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɔ ka kpoo kwaa tɛo.” Belaa Mosis le Ijipt kooro be bela dɛ ka soŋe Korowii tɛo.
Asɛ Korowii ɛ ɡɛ waa soŋa la.
O ɡelɔ chwɛɛhne la bwa le kooro ne o nomonome ne o nɛra bwa nɛ, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.
Kɛ Ijipt kooro berɔ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ anɔ ɡe ta ja, o ta ɡelɛ nɛra la kaa.
Weechɔɡa aa ba kondɛɛra nɛɛ wa Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó la Ijipt kooro la be dɛ́ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kenii men Korowii Hibru tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la ɛɛ bol.
N ŋɔ, tɛ n nɛra ŋwɛnɛ ásɛ ba ka tom mɛ.
Dɛ he vɛh ban ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ba kaa laa, Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔ weechɔɡaa ba ta he kondɛɛra bwa nɛ.
He jaɡre ne keeɡore ne nyoɡmare ne nae ne boohna dɛ peera bwa ɛɛ we weelaa.
Kɛ Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ Israel tena kondɛɛra nɛɛ ásɛ a te bɛ serewe á baɡle kɛ o nɛra korɔ.” Asɛ Korowii do tɔpere dɛ ŋɔ, “Keree men Korowii ɛɛ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta.” Tɔ aa pera la, Korowii ɛ ɡɛ waa bola la.
Kondɛɛra aa ɛ Ijipt tena kwaa la bwa serewɔ.
Kɛ anɔ la aa ɛ Israel tena kwaa la te, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta sewɛ.
Belaa kooro tomɛ nɛra a wa, asɛ ba la dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ Israel tena te kondɛɛre beŋkpoŋ ɡba ta sewɛ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, o ta o deŋnekpeɡ la ɡelɛ.
O ta nɛra la ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ba kaa.
Ɔɡra ane wa Anee Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Hé ɛ tɔɔ nɔn dela le nimar bɔr, ásɛ Mosis ka che Ijipt kooro sie dɛ́ taa nyundua.
Aa berɛ tutuɡii dɛ́ tɔ Ijipt harɛ bwa, ásɛ ɔɡra chole kondɛɛra ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa nɛ dɛ́ pili ŋwɛra.” Mosis ne Arɔn ɛ tɔɔ la, dɛ ka che kooro sie.
Asɛ Mosis taa nyundua, asɛ ɔɡra chole lee nɛra ne kondɛɛra nɛ, dɛ pili ŋwɛra.
Anɔ te la, dobodobo tena la ta wone ba che Mosis sie kpa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ɔɡra la ɔɡre ba ne ba bwɛɛ la tena bwa.
Kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ Ijipt kooro deŋne do kpeɡri o ta Mosis ne Arɔn be noɛ ɡɛ waa bola la.
Dombwea ane wa Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ir kere chɔmbibi dɛ́ la Ijipt kooro be dɛ́ ka ŋɔ ‘Kenii men Korowii Hibru tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la ŋɔ.
Tɛ n nɛra ŋwɛnɛ ásɛ ba kaa tom mɛ, A laa ɡe aa, mɛɛ tɛr he ne he nomonome ne he nɛra deŋnee á ɡwaa kohona, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ do kɛŋɔ men harɛ nɔ bwa ta.
Dɛ n fe dɛ nyin aa, n fe kpɔ serewe weela ba kpoo he bwa.
Kɛ n ɡelɔ he do le, ásɛ he na ɡɛ maa dɔ kpeɡri, ásɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa che he nɛɛ dɛɛ yerɛ n sɔn harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
Kɛ ane a bwa, he ta dɛ maŋkura he te dɛɛ tɔ n nɛra nɛɛ ŋɔ haa ɡel ba kaa.
Anomanta, n dɛ ba ɡela dombwea aa tɔɡa lee kere saŋ nɔ bɔr.
Le saŋ la baa vɔrɔwe Ijipt bwa ɡɛ dombwea nɔ dɔŋa ta o ta leere mɔɔ.
Gel ba ka teɡɛ kondɛɛra bɛlbwa aa lɔ dibɔr ba do deene.
Dombwea la dɛ ba leera dɛ́ kpoo nɛra ne kondɛɛra aa lɔ kooni ta, ne komɛlbwa kon aa wola o nɛɛ tɔe.’ ” Kooro nomonome baa ɔmɛ Korowii waa la ɛ warane kpɔ ba nɛndɔɔla ne kondɛɛra ba dem.
Kɛ banɔ la baa taŋ deŋne Korowii waa la ta la te ɡel ba nɛndɔɔla ne ba kondɛɛra kooni ta.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Tɛr he nɔn pa nyundua, ásɛ dombwea lee nɛra ne kondɛɛra ne koo kondikwa, dɛ komɛlbwa aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ bwa ta.” Mosis aa tɛr o daŋɡbala la waa lɔ o nɔn ta la, Korowii ɡelɔ bwaala kɔr dɛɛ nyɛɡle, bɔr bwa chaah asɛ dombwea ɡe lee.
Gɛɛ a do Korowii ɡel dombwea lee Ijipt harɛ.
A leero asɛ bwaala ɛɛ nyɛɡle bobɛlbwa pelɔpelɔ ken dɛɛ kɔɡre dɛ do ɔma.
A dɔŋa ta Ijipt harɛ ta chiɡe bwa.
A chɔɡ kwaa komɛlbwa aa wola o ta tɔe.
Le nɛra nɛɛ ba le kondɛɛra ta.
Hale koo kwa ne daa bwa.
Gosen harɛ, bela Israel tena aa soɡa la ɡboo a ta leere.
Belaa Ijipt kooro yerɛ Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ ŋɔ, “Taraken n nao kɛŋɔ n ɛ wechɔɡa, Korowii waa toɡra.
N ne n nɛra sɛh chɔɡre.
Soŋe Korowii tɛ yaa.
Bwaala kɔɡra ne dombwea la ɡwaalɔ to.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he kaa, maa heyaa lawɛ so kpa.” Ate, Mosis chaŋe dɛ ŋɔ, “N baa le bwɛɛ nɔ ta naa, mɛɛ ɡɔɔ n nɔɔra nyunduaa dɛ́ soŋe Korowii.
Bwaala kɔɡra la ɛɛ ɡeloo, dombwea la ɡe ɡel leera, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɔ harɛ bwa.
Kɛ ane a bwa, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ he ne he nomonome deŋne ta kpeɡri haa Korowii ɔmɛ dɛ ba le fini.” Dombwea la chɔɡ koo kwaa aa kpɔ bie bwa.
Koo kwaa aa ka mun a ta bie kpɔe mɔɔ la te ta chɔɡɛ.
Mosis aa le Ijipt kooro be dɛ le bwɛɛ la ta la, o ɡɔɔ nɔɔra nyundua dɛ soŋe Korowii.
Belaa bwaala kɔɡra, ne dombwea leera dɛ bwaala la bwa ɡel.
Kooro aa na ɡɛ la, o berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa ja.
Anee kɛ o ne o nomonome la berɔ ɛ ba deŋnekpeɡ la ja.
Ba vɛh Israel tena ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ bá kaa, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ Mosis be la.
Tontombɛ ane wa Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “La Ijipt kooro be, n ɡelɔ o ne o nomonome deŋne do kpeɡri ɡɛ aa ɛ ń won ɡel ba na n nyokpowe-ɛɛla ba baah, ásɛ kerekere he bol baɡle he bii ne naanar ɡɛ maa do Ijipt tena sibeɡra dɛ ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla la, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Anomanta, Mosis ne Arɔn la Ijipt kooro be dɛ ka ŋɔ kenii Korowii Hibru tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba he liire ne harɛ bala dɛ́ ɡel he deŋnekpeɡ nɔɔ?
Gel n nɛra kaa dɛ́ kaa tom mɛ.
He vɛoh he ta ɡelɛ ba kaa laa, kere mɛɛ ɡeloo tontombɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo a ba dɛ́ ba tɔ harɛ nɔ bwa, nɛn aa wola harɛɛ na.
Aa ba di kookwaa ne daa dombwea la aa wola chɔɡɛ bwaa.
Aa su he dem ne he nomonome deremi ne Ijipt te bɛlbwa demii.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ waa he naawa aa wola a dɔŋa nae ka.” Mosis aa tona la, o le kooro be kaa.
Ate, kooro nomonome la soŋo ŋɔ, “N naa, ɡel Hibru tena la kaa dɛ́ ka tomɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la kɛŋɔ baa nɔ aa naa dɛɛ tɛ yaa waa la.
Chɔɡaa harɛ nɔ na dɛɛ chɔɡ la oo!” Belaa ba yerɛ Mosis ne Arɔn ba kooro be ja, asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kaa dɛ́ ka tomɛ he Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la.
Aah he bini bamewa tenee dɛɛ kaa nɔɔ?” Asɛ Mosis chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ya bwaa dɛɛ ba kaala.
Bechale ne hanjeni ne banjeni, ne bibaala ne bihaahna dɛ ya kondɛɛra bwa, dɛkalkɛ ya dɛ la ka di tɔpejen bɛl Korowii sɔn ta.” Kooro la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ he Korowii la kɛŋɔ maa ɡel he kpɔ he haahna ne bechale la kaa.
Liichɔɡaa lɔ he nyu bini ɡɛ la.
Aa ɡɛɛ maɡre, hé ɡel baala la ɡbo kaa dɛ́ ka tomɛ he Korowii la.
Gɛɛ he ŋɔ la.” Asɛ ba doŋi Mosis ne Arɔn le kooro sie bela.
Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Tɛr he nɔn pa Ijipt harɛ ta, ásɛ tontombɛ fuɡe le dɛ́ ba di koo kwaa aa kaa ne komɛlbwa dombwea la aa wola wone chɔɡ la.” Asɛ o tɛr o daŋɡbala laa lɔ o nɔn ta la pa harɛ la ta, asɛ Korowii ɡel peu bɛl le wee leebɔr, dɛ ta harɛ la ta awola tɔpere la ne o jwaana bwa.
Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, dɛ peu la kpɔ tontombɛ la ba.
A balɔ warɛ dɛ ba tɔ Ijipt harɛ bwa.
A ɡɛ tontombɛ nɔ dɔŋa ta balɛ bwa, a dɔŋa ɡe aa ba kpa bwa.
A balɔ warɛ dɛ tɔ harɛ la sie bwa o bir ken.
A di kwaa dombwea la aa wola chɔɡɛ la bwa.
Kwaa aa lɔ koo ne daa nɔna bwa.
Konduuli bɛlbwa toole dɛ ka.
Komɛlbwa ta Ijipt harɛ ta kae.
Belaa Ijipt kooro ɛ warane dɛ ɡel ba yerɛ Mosis ne Arɔn tɛo dɛ soŋ ba ŋɔ, “N ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ne he bwa wechɔɡa.
Hé kpɔ n wechɔɡa kɛ mɛ ja dɛ́ soŋe Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la o laa serewe waa nɔ kpɔ n nɛ.” Ate, Mosis le kooro be bela dɛ ka soŋe Korowii.
Korowii beɡre peu la o ta kpeɡri nɛɛ le wee cholibɔr dɛ kpɔ tontombɛ la ka ta Mposwɛm ta.
Beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta harɛ la ta kae kpa.
Kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ kooro la bambile ta do kpeɡri o vɛh Israel tena la ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ bá kaa.
Biro tenten wa Korowii berɛ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Tɛr he nɔn pa nyundua ásɛ biro kpirkpirkpir ba tɔ Ijipt harɛ bwa.” Asɛ o tɛr o nɔn pa nyundua, asɛ biro kpirkpirkpir la ba tɔ Ijipt harɛ ta tɔpera atoro.
Nomɛlbwa aa won o dɔŋ na á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ iruu le bela waa soɡa tɔpedɛɛɡa atoro.
Kɛ dɛ bɔr chaah Israel tena la te be.
Belaa kooro yerɛ Mosis dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé kaa ásɛ dɛ ka tomɛ he Korowii la.
Hé kpɔ haahna ne bechale kaa dɛ́ ɡel kondɛɛra la te.” Asɛ Mosis chaŋe ŋɔ “A chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ kondɛɛra yaa ka kpoo ɛ saraha dɛ́ fuh ane tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la.
A chɛ kɛ yá kaa ya kondɛɛra ɡe bwa ne beŋkpoŋ kwaraa aa wola ka.
A bini anee yaa ba kpɔe ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la, kɛ dɛ ya ta bela telaa, yaa won jemɛ anɔ la yaa lawɛ ɛ.” Korowii ɡelɔ Ijipt kooro deŋne ta do kpeɡri, o ta ɡelɛ ba kaa.
Asɛ o ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Le n sie bonɔ kaa!
Dɛɛ berɛ n sie bonɔ bala kpa.
Awola haa ba n sie bonɔ la, dɛ he sewee.” Anee o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋii, maa he sie bonɔɔ ba kpa.”
Ijipt tena bibanloɡla sewa wa Asɛ Korowii berɛ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba deŋnetɛra beŋkpoŋ kpɔe ba ta Ijipt kooro la ne o nɛra nɛɛ ja.
A habɔɔ la, wɛɛ ɡeloo he kaa.
Doŋa kwaraa wɛɛ ba heyaa doŋa.
Berɛ ɡel Israel tena no kɛŋɔ, ba baala ne haahna bwa soŋe ba bala Ijipt tena suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa kwa.” Korowii ɡelɔ Ijipt tena sie lɛ Israel tena la nɛ, asɛ kooro ne o nomonome ne harɛ la ta nɛra bwa kpɔ Mosis ɛ nɛnjen.
Belaa Mosis ŋɔ Ijipt kooro be ŋɔ, “Kenii Korowii ɛɛ bol, dɛ wɛɛ valɛ harɛ nɔ bwa ta harambaŋaa, ásɛ dɛ kpoo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla bwa.
Dɛ́ le kooro waa soɡe kara ta bibanloɡle nɛ, dɛ́ ba le yomhaah waa lɔ nam ta bibanloɡle nɛ dɛ nae biloɡla.
Nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔree dɛɛ wi kohona harɛ la ta a dɔŋa aa wola chiɡ bwa.
A dɔŋa ɡe aa chiɡ kpa bwa.
Kɛ Israel tena te bini la, nyoate aa nɛn kɛɛ kondɛɛre kwaraa wor.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ nyin o nɛra Israel tena dɛ ɡel ba korɛ Ijipt tena bini.
He nomonome nɔ bwa ɛɛ berɔɔ ba n be, dɛ́ ba ɡuŋ mɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ ń kaa, n ne n nɛra bwa baa teŋɛ n nɛ.
Ásɛ mɔɔ ń kaa.” Belaa Mosis kpɔ bandia kohona le kooro sie kaa.
Korowii fa bol Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ijipt kooro ɛɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡii dɛ́ vɛh he be noe, ásɛ n nyokpowaa maa ɛ Ijipt harɛ la do kan.” Mosis ne Arɔn ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla nɔ bwa kooro sie.
Korowii ɡelɔ o deŋne ta do kpeɡri o ta ɡelɛ Israel tena la le o harɛ ta kaa.
Galekaa Tɔpejen dii Korowii bol waa baɡle Mosis ne Arɔn Ijipt harɛ ta ja, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ korobie nɔ ɛ he korobiloɡle bena bɛlbwa.
Hé ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ a ɡɛ korobie nɔ tɔpera fi ta la, bɛlbwa lawɛ pebie ó che tɛ o ne o dem tena.
Dem te bɛlbwa lawɛ pebie beŋkpoŋ.
Dɛ dem bɛl nɛra aa kanɛ dɛ́ won chwe pebir la aa, ba ne dem waa bɛna ɛɛ won bɔne.
Hé bɔna ɡɛ del aa chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa dɔ.
Kondɛɛre ombal waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, dɛ di benanyoa laanee chɛ kɛ hé lawɛ ba ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ.
He ta pebie dɔe yaa, bohnee chɛ kɛ hé lawɛ.
Hé nyiŋa dɛ ka tel korobie nɔ tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta, a ɡɛ saŋee Israel tena ɛɛ ba a kpoora jɔmɔra.
Ásɛ ba kpɔ a chale la ane ɛ ba doonyoo daa nyundua, ne a keŋkeŋni dem bela baa dɛ ba ola la chwee la.
Awola jwaana la tenten la, bá wɔɔ ola la, dɛ́ kpɔ papooni aa kpela ne paanoo baa wola iisi a ta doe la ja a ta dɛ́ di.
He bɛ ola la an lwɛɛ kɛɛ an daala chwe.
Hé wɔɔ ane a nyuune ne nakpale ne a tea bini kwaa te bwa.
He bɛ di a ka tɔɔ per a ta.
Anɔ la aa ka la bwa chɛ kɛ hé fuah.
Gɛ haa dia laanee nɔ.
Hé bini bɛlbwa kpɔ o batakaarejaŋ dɛ́ kpɔ kiriso vɔwɛ o ta, dɛ́ do naŋɡawa ásɛ dɛ kpoŋe o daŋɡbala kɛŋɔ waa dɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ bɛl kaala.
Warane ɡee chɛ kɛŋɔ hé dia.
Anee ɛ Galekaa kondikwa haa dɛ ba dii n sɔn ta.
Awola jwaana la tenten la, mɛɛ valɛ Ijipt harɛ ta bwaa, dɛ́ kpo bibanloɡle bɛlbwa waa ɛ binyoa, ne kondɛɛre bɛlbwa ɡe biloɡle ombal.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ voɡa aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta bwaa.
Menee Korowii.
Chal haa kpɔ ɛ he doonyoo laanee dɛ́ baɡle deene haa soɡe a bini.
N teŋo baa kaa dɛ na chal laa, maa heyaa wobɛlbwaa ɛ, mɛɛ ɡale heyaa ta, ásɛ dɛ jo Ijipt tena la deremi dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne.
Hé di a ɡɛ tɔpere nɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛ́ kpɔ lii men Korowii waa maa ɛa tɛ heya.
Hé ɡel tɔpere nɔ chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Hé di paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpere waa tɔ sie la, hé laa iisi bɛlbwa kpɔ he deene bini.
Nomɛlbwa waa di paanoo iisi aa do o ta a ɡɛ tɔpera nɔ ta la, dɛ o ta n nɛra baa ɛ Israel tena la bini jae kpa.
Tɔpere waa tɔ sie ne tɔpenuanɛ wee la taa chɛ kɛ hé cheme dɛ́ tom mɛ.
Nomɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛ ó ɛ toma bɛlbwa, nemenɛ kondikwaa waa ɛ dɛ́ di ɡbo.
Hɛ́ɛ di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta Tɔpejen la dɛ́ kpɔ lii men Korowii, dɛkalkɛ a ɡɛ tɔpere la taa n lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta denaa ta.
Hé ɡel tɔpere nɔ chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korobie waa tɔ sie la, tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta jɔmɔra, hé pa mun di paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta ka tel korobie la tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ la ɡe jɔmɔra.
He bɛ ɡel ba na iisi he deremi tɔpera anuanɛ la ta.
Nomɛlbwa wáa di kondikwa iisi do a ta la, bá doŋu le Israel tena bini.
Dɛ nɛŋhɔɔh kɛɛ bwɛɛlembiee yoo, bá doŋu.
He bɛ iisi kondikwa bɛlbwa di.
Bobɛlbwa haa so la, hé di paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta.” Belaa Mosis yerɛ Israel nomonome la bwa cheme dɛ ŋɔ, “He bɛlbwa ka lawɛ pee kɛɛ booh waa ka kpo o ne o dem tena kpɔ di Galekaa la.
Hé kpɔ hesɔp daa li ola la chal ta loɡbaa bini ɛ he doonyoo keŋkeŋna ne a nyundua daa la ta.
He bini bɛlbwa bɛ buse le ka tel kɛ tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ mɔɔ.
Korowii dɛ ba harɛ la ta joe, dɛ́ kpo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla bwa.
O teŋo baa kaa dɛ na chal la doonyoo daa nyundua ne a keŋkeŋni ɡɛ naa, wɛɛ ɡelaa dɛ́ ba kaa.
Waa ɡel Korowii nyundua torome waa dɛ kpoo Ijipt bibanloɡla la jo he deremi ta dɛ́ kpoo heya.
Hé ne he bii ne naanar teŋɛ waa maa dɛ do heyaa nɔ ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
He baa tel harɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heyaa la ta naa, hé teŋɛ tɔpejen nɔ dii waa ta dɛɛ ɛa.
Dɛ he bii baa bɔɔ heya ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ a ɡɛ tɔpejen nɔ dii mun ɛɛ chaɡle aa,’ hé ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Galekaa saraha taa Korowii kpoo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla bwa ba deremi ta, dɛ ɡale ya Israel tena deremi ta kaa.’ ” Mosis aa bol waa tonɛ la, Israel tena ɡuŋo dɛ tomɛ Korowii.
Asɛ ba la dɛ ka ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis ne Arɔn ŋɔ ba ɛ la.
Bɔr aa joa harambaŋa la, Korowii kpo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla bwa.
O kpɔɔ le Ijipt kooro waa soɡe kara ta la bibanloɡle nɛ, dɛ ba nɛn baa lawɔ do dea bibanloɡle nɛ, dɛ kondɛɛra bwa ɡe biloɡla nɛ.
Awola jwaana la, kooro ne o nomonome bwa ne Ijipt tena iro dɛɛ wi kohona harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ dem bɛlbwa toole nɛn aa wola o ta sewɛ.
Jwaana la tenten la, Ijipt kooro yerɛ Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé kaa!
He ne Israel tena bwa ir le harɛ nɔ ta.
Hé kaa dɛ́ ka tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ haa soŋa la.
Hé kpɔ he peera ne boohna ne nae bwa kaa ɡɛ haa bola la, ásɛ dɛ soŋe andɛɛɡa le he Korowii be tɛ mɛ.” Ijipt tena la iro che ba nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ɛ warane dɛ́ le ya harɛ nɔ ta.” Ba liiro ŋɔ dɛ ba ta ɡelɛ ba kaa laa, ba bwa ɛɛ serewoo.
Anomanta, ba kpɔ men baa wola iisi a ta doe mɔɔ dɛ kpɔ ɛ paanoo do loɡa bini, dɛ kpɔ yale vɔrɔwa dɛ kpɔ chɔŋɛ ba vaama ta.
Ba ɛ ɡɛ Mosis aa do ba la, dɛ soŋe Ijipt tena la suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm kwa dɛ yale.
Korowii ɡelɔ Ijipt tena sie lɛ ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba tɛɛ ba komɛlbwa baa soŋ ba la.
Anɔ taa a che ba che Ijipt kondɔɔh bwa kaa.
Israel tena le Rameses waa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ ba Sukot.
Baala baa valɛ naa ta la ɡbo ɛɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa lafraanumɛlee.
Haahna ne bechale te ta jae.
Nɛmpɛɛne warɔ dɛ ja ba nɛɛ kaa.
Peera ne boohna dɛ nae kohona bwa ɡe jao.
Ba kpɔ men baa ɛa dɛ le ane Ijipt la ɛ paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta.
Dɛkalkɛ baa doŋ ba le bela la, ba ta bɔr dɔe dɛ́ ɛ ba kondikwa bɛlbwa.
Bene lafraanaarɛ fifraatoroo Israel tena so Ijipt harɛ ta.
A ɡɛ bene lafraanaarɛ fifraatoro nɔ jaɡa taa Korowii nɛra baa lɔ Ijipt harɛ la bwa ir le bela.
Awola baa le harɛ la ta la ɛ jwaana, asɛ Korowii kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛ dɛ daah ba.
Anomanta, benanyoa bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ Israel tena bwa nyiŋi daahna Korowii aa daah ba dɛ kpɔ ba le Ijipt harɛ awola jwaana la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡe so dɛɛ daah dɛ́ kpɔ jirima tɛ Korowii, á chɔ le tɛ ba naanar baa ka ba.
Mmara aa lɔ Galekaa Tɔpejen dii ta Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛre haa kpɔ a ta di Galekaa kondikwa laanee nɔ.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hɔɔh dia.
Yom bɛlbwa haa yawɔ ba teŋe o pen la ɛɛ won di, kɛ hɔɔh waa baa choɡe tama dɛ kaa, ne nɛn waa ba toma ɛɛ bɔr dɛ́ ba nyin o suuɡa kaa la aa won dia.” “Hé dɛ ba a dii yaa, dembeŋkpoŋ taa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé dia, dɛ bɛ ol la bɛlbwa kpɔ le fɔɡ.
He bɛ a hoɡa ɡe paɡre.
Israel tena bwaa chɛ kɛ bá di a ɡɛ tɔpere nɔ.
Nɛŋhɔɔh bɛlbwa waa baa so he bini dɛ nyin o di Galekaa kondikwaa nɔ Korowii sɔn ta naa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó teŋe o bibaala ne baala baa lɔ o dem bwa pena, ásɛ he ne ba bwa ɛ nɛnsiwi beŋkpoŋ mɔɔ dɛ́ won di ane.
Bibaa te bɛlbwa baa wola o pen teŋe la ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó di ane.
Gɛ mmara nɔ chɔɔ tɛ harɛ nɔ ta bie ne nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe o ta bwa.” Asɛ Israel tena la bwa ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis ne Arɔn ŋɔ ba ɛ la.
Awola tɔpere la tentenee Korowii lawɛ o nɛra Israel tena bwa le Ijipt harɛ denaa ta.
Bibanloɡla kpɔe dɛ́ tɛ Korowii Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Le bibanloɡle bɛlbwa cheɡ tɛ mɛ ó ɛ n kon.
Israel te bibanloɡle bɛlbwa ne kondɛɛre bɛlbwa ɡe biloɡle ombal bwa ɛ n kwa.” Belaa Mosis ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ lii a ɡɛ tɔpere nɔ haa kpɔa le Ijipt harɛ he fa aa dɛ di somanjiri o ta la, dɛkalkɛ Korowii kpeɡri ne o bokpeɡaa o kpɔ lɛ heya.
He bɛ paanoo iisi aa lɔ o ta di.
Fini haa dɛ le Ijipt harɛ ta nɔ ɛ Abib korobie ta.
Dɛ Korowii baa kpɔ heyaa tel Keenan ne Hiti ne Amɔre ne Hivi, dɛ Jebus tena harɛ waa ŋwɛɛra baɡle he naawa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heya ó ɛ he kon la ta, harɛpare ondɛɛɡe ta naa, a chɛ kɛ hé di a ɡɛ tɔpere nɔ korobie nɔ ta.
Dɛkalkɛ o ba he ne harɛ o taa soma ta.
Tɔpera anuanɛɛ hɛɛ ba paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta la dii.
Kɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee la te, hé ɛo tɔpejen tɛ Korowii.
Hé di paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta tɔpera anuanɛ la ta.
He bɛ ɡel komɛlbwa iisi aa lɔ o ta do he be.
Hale he harɛ jwɛh ta bobɛlbwa kwara.
Awola haa dɛɛ di tɔpere la, hé ŋɔ he bii be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii kpeɡri ne bokpeɡa waa kpɔa lɛ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la waa yaa ɛ ɡɛ.’ Gel tɔpere la dii do kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡ, kɛɛ komɛl haa kpɔ vɔwɛ he tile ta, dɛɛ liiri Korowii Mmara la ta teŋa.
Dɛkalkɛ Korowii kpeɡri ne o bokpeɡaa o kpɔ lawɛ le Ijipt harɛ ta.
Hé teŋɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ta dɛɛ ɛa tɔpere waa chɛa ta bena bɛlbwa.
Bibanloɡla wa Korowii baa kpɔ heyaa ba Keenan harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ tɛ heyaa ɡɛ waa ŋwɛɛra dɛ baɡɛ he ne he naawa nyoa la tonaa, a chɛ kɛ hé kpɔ bibanloɡle bɛlbwa tɛo.
Kondɛɛre bɛlbwa ɡe biloɡle ombal ɛ Korowii kon.
Keeɡo biloɡle bɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ pee charɔ.
Kɛ dɛ haa on charaa, hé ku o baŋa.
Hɛɛ won charɛ bibanloɡle bwa ɡe nyu.
Tɔpebɛl dɛ he bibaa bɔɔre ŋɔ ɛrɛɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ chaɡle aa, he ŋɔ, ‘Korowii kpeɡri ne o bokpeɡaa o kpɔ lawɛ yaa le somanjiri dii ta Ijipt harɛ.
Ijipt kooro aa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh yaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ya kaa la, Korowii kpoo nɛra bii baa ɛ bibanloɡla ne kondɛɛre bɛlbwa biloɡle Ijipt harɛ ta.
Anee ɡela n kpɔ n kondɛɛra biloɡla ambala dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ berɛ charɛ n bibanloɡle nyu la.’ Gɛ waa nɔ do kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡ kɛɛ kon yaa kpɔ vɔwɛ tili ta aa lii yaa Korowii kpeɡri, ne o bokpeɡa waa kpɔa lawɛ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la.” Korowii tɔ Israel tena sie ba ɡale Mposwɛm Ijipt kooro tɛ nɛra la ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ bá kaa, kɛ Korowii ta ba sie tɔe ba kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa Filisti tena harɛ ta la, dɛ onee fe bora.
Asɛ Korowii lii ŋɔ, “Dɛ ba kaa cheme laa laa, baa charɛ ba liiree dɛ́ berɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta.” Anomanta, o kpɔ ba bar kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, Mposwɛm pera.
Dɛ Israel tena vɔwɛ ntoa, dɛ le Ijipt harɛ dɛɛ ba ba yo.
Mosis aa dɛ kaa la, o pa Josef hoɡa dɛkalkɛ Josef ɡelɔ Jekɔb bii fa ŋwɛɛ baɡlo.
O ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ ba lɛ heyaa, anomanta, a chɛ kɛ hé kpɔ n chɔɔ le bonɔ harɛ nɔ ta.” Baa le Sukot la, ba kaa baŋre ba tɛnte deene Etaam.
O chɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta nyoa bobɛl.
Korowii kpɔ bam bɛl waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua ba tɔ ba sie webaŋa wɛɛ chaɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ, asɛ jwaana ɡe o kpɔ nii waa tɛra kaa nyundua tɔ ba sie wɛɛ chaah ba won vala.
Gɛɛ a ɛ ba won webaŋa ne jwaana bwa vala.
Bam la teŋɔ dɛɛ tɔ ba sie webaŋa, asɛ nii la ɡe teŋɛ dɛɛ chaah ba bɔr jwaana.
Mposwɛm ɡala wa Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ ba berɛ ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene Pi Haherɔt jwɛh waa lɔ Miɡdol ne Mposwɛm baah ta la.
Bá so mpo nyoa ásɛ Baal Sefon ɡe do baŋ bɛl.
Ijipt kooro ɛɛ liiruu kɛŋɔ Israel tena nyoɡre pua waa ɛ hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta belaa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe ba bɔr.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o deŋne do kpeɡri o ŋɔ wɛɛ ti baa.
Mɛɛ pɔ o ne o laa tena nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ jirima.
Ásɛ Ijipt tena bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii kpela.” Anomanta, ɡɛɛ Israel tena ɛ. Baa baa bol Ijipt kooro be ŋɔ nɛra la chwao la, o ne o nomonome charɛ ba liire dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa ya ɛ ken ɔ?
Ya ɡelɔ Israel tena la kaa yaa wola ban dɔ ba ɛ ya tomare kpa.” Ate, kooro ɡel ba kpɔ kon waa do kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ pɛl jaɡre dɛɛ so a bini ba cheɡ, asɛ dɛ boa o laa tena nyoa.
O kpɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ bwa ta ne anɔ la aa kpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ la lafraanumɛl, asɛ dɛ le o laa nomonome ba chɔ a nyoo.
Korowii ɡelɔ Ijipt kooro la deŋne do kpeɡri, asɛ o ti Israel tena baa kpɔ silɛɛ le dɛɛ kaa la.
Kooro kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore la bwa, ne nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta, dɛ laa tena la ti Israel tena, dɛ ka bɛn ba bela baa baŋre tɛnte deene Mposwɛm nyoa la.
Bela bɛne Pi Haherɔt asɛ Baal Sefon ɡe do baŋ bɛl.
Kooro ne o laa tena aa dɛ bɛn ba asɛ Israel tena ke nyiŋi la, ba nao kɛŋɔ Ijipt tena puu ba tonɛ.
Asɛ ɔmee kohona nomanta, ba wi dɛɛ yerɛ Korowii ŋɔ ó ba cha ba.
Dɛ bɔɔ Mosis ŋɔ, “Lalbɔɔnee wola toole Ijipt harɛ ta waa he ba ya ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ŋɔ yá ba serewe nɔ kɛɛ?
Bɔkwa waa he ɛ yaa ken?
Ya ta he be bolɛ Ijipt ŋɔ he ɡel ya so dɛɛ tom ba aa?
A wer kɛŋɔ ya fe aa lɔ bela dɛɛ tom ba, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ yaa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bonɔ dɛɛ ba serewa nɔ.” Asɛ Mosis chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɔmɛ, hé che kiŋkiŋ dɛ na lɛɛ Korowii aa dɛ ba heyaa lɛɛ fini.
Ijipt tena haa dɛ na ba fini nɔ, haa ban na kpa bwa.
Korowiirii dɛ́ yo tɛ heya, hé te hel.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he wi dɛɛ yer mɛ nɔɔ?
He te ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ bá pa sie dɛɛ la.
Tɛr he daŋɡbala la pa Mposwɛm la ta, ásɛ o bini pere Israel tena la won valɛ o bini le kɛŋɔ harɛpɛɛ ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo Ijipt tena deŋne do kpeɡri, ásɛ ba ti heya.
Belaa mɛɛ ba n jirima dɔe dɛ́ le Ijipt kooro ne o laa tena ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ so jaɡre ta la bwa nɛ.
Maa ba pɔ kooro ne o nɛra nɛɛ la, anee baa ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Korowii torome waa tɔ Israel tena sie o ne baa valɛ la le ba sie dɛ ba che ba habɔɔ.
Bam la waa tɔ ba sie la ɡe le ba sie dɛ ba che ba habɔɔ, dɛ do Ijipt laa tena ne Israel laa tena baah ta.
Awola jwaana la, bam la baa tɔ baŋ bɛl, baŋ bɛl tena do biro ta asɛ bɔr chaah baŋ bɛl tena ɡe be.
Anomanta, bɛlbwa ta wone la o dɔŋ be awola jwaana la bwa.
Mosis tɛr daŋɡbala waa lɔ o nɔn ta la pa mpo la ta, asɛ awola jwaana la bwa Korowii ɡel peujen bɛl ta le wee leebɔr, dɛ taɡɛ nee la kaa habɔɔ o berɛ harɛpɛɛ dɛ hol chɔ.
Mpo la bini pero, asɛ Israel tena valɛ harɛpɛɛ waa hola ta dɛ le o baŋ.
Nee la pero che kɛŋɔ danjwɛ dɛ do ba diɡ ne ɡal, ne Ijipt tena baa soɡe jaɡre ta, ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo la bwa ti ba dɛ ka jo mpo la ta.
Aa baa ka tama bɔr chaah la, Korowii cheɡɛ bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua la ne nii waa tɛra kaa nyundua la ta dɛ nyiŋi Ijipt laa tena dɛ chɔɡ ba liire.
O ɡelɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore la nakpale chɔɡ a tɛɡra do kpeɡri.
Asɛ Ijipt tena la ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya ɡel Israel tena nɔ nɛɛ teŋa oo!
Korowiirii cha ba dɛɛ yo yaa la.” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Tɛr daŋɡbala waa lɔ he nɔn ta la pa mpo la ta, ásɛ o palɛ tɔ Ijipt tena ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore dɛ nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta la bwa nɛ.” Asɛ Mosis tɛr pa mpo la ta, bɔr chaahna bini la, o berɛ ba che o buɡ ta.
Dɛ Ijipt tena chwao dɛ fe ɛɛ ba lee, asɛ Korowii taɡ ba do mpo la bini.
Nee la palɔ dɛ ba tɔ o laa tena la bwa nɛ.
Kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ne nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta dɛɛ ti Israel tena la bwa ka mpo la bini, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.
Kɛ Israel tena la te valɛ harɛpɛɛ waa hola ta mpo la bini, nee la pere kɛŋɔ danjwɛ dɛ do ba diɡ ne ɡal ta ba le o baŋ.
Kenii Korowii lɛ Israel tena le Ijipt tena nɔn ta awola tɔpere, asɛ Israel tena na ba kɛ baa serewa dɛ chɔ Mpo la nyoa.
Israel tena aa na Korowii kpeɡri kohona waa kpɔa chɔɡ Ijipt tena la, ba ɔmɔ asɛ dɛ yarada Korowii ne o bonɔɔ Mosis.
Mosis yel Belaa Mosis ne Israel tena la ɡo yel kpɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡo yelee kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o lɛ sɔn kohona.
O kpɔ jaɡre ne nɛra baa soɡe a ta bwa ka do mpo bini.
Korowiirii n bokpeɡa, o sɔn ber mɛ yel mɛɛ ɡo, onee n Lɛɛ, onee mɛɛ tomɛ dɛɛ kpɛɛro, Korowii n naa wa aa tomɔ laanee on, o sɔnee mɛɛ ba yera dɛɛ tomɔ.
Korowiirii yoa dɛɛ tɛ yaa, Korowiirii o sɔn.
Ijipt kooro kwaa baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre ne o laa tena, o taɡɛ a bwa do mpo bini, Kooro nomonome tenten bwa sirimi mpo la bini.
Vil tentenee bɔle ba nɛ, ba chɔ vil la mun ta kɛŋɔ bwe ken.
N Naa Korowii, he nɔn diɡ dɔ jirima kpeɡri do o ta, he kpɔ chɔɡ ya dɔma.
He kpeɡri ne he jirimaa he kpɔ taɡɛ he dɔma ta.
He ɡelɔ he bandia kohona ba fuuh ba kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken.
He nyoa peu ɡbo ɡelɔ mpo bini pere, dɛ che diɡ ne ɡal kɛŋɔ danjwɛ, o holɔ vile aa lɔ o baah ta chɔ pɛɛ.
Ya dɔma tamanɔ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ti baa dɛ́ ka pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba kondɔɔh bwaa mɛɛ ba pae ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin.
Mɛɛ tɛr n kere ba nɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ ba bwa.’ Kɛ haa hweera kerabeŋkpoŋ ɡbo la, a ɡelɔ mpo nee bɔle banɛ.
Ba sirimo kɛŋɔ kpana aa sirimi vil bini la ken.
N Naa Korowii, voɡ bisoo do kɛ hen ɔ?
He do ɡoroŋ ɡa, he jirima do kan kohona.
Umee won nyokpowaa ɛɛ kɛ he nɔ?
He tɛr he nɔndiɡ, asɛ harɛ kpɔ ya dɔma lile.
He nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe nomanta, hɛɛ tɔ he nɛra haa lɛɛ ba la siee.
Hɛɛ kpɔ he kpeɡrii dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa harɛ waa do ɡoroŋ ta.
Harɛre ta nɛra ɛɛ no he waa ásɛ ɔmee laɡ ba, bambichɔɡ ɛɛ ɡeloo Filisti tena bwara yɔr kɛŋɔ loltea yon lɔ haah la.
Ɔmee ɛɛ lawɛ Edom koranaree kohona, Moab nomonome bwara yɔr baa chel, Keenan tena ɡe bwa ɛɛ heo kwara.
Ɔmee kohona ɛɛ chole ba nɛɛ, á che he kpeɡri ta bá ka che bobeŋkpoŋ kɛŋɔ bwe ken, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ he nɛra aa teŋe ba kaa mɔɔ.
N Naa Korowii, nemenɛ he nɛra haa lɛɛ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la teŋe ba kaa mɔɔ.
He kpɔ ba ka so he be bwe doa, bwe la doa waa ɛ he soŋnibɔr la, he ɡbaɡba Dea waa do ɡoroŋ he che he kpeɡri ta cheɡo la.
N Naa Korowii, hɛɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.” Gɛɛ a do Ijipt kooro kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre, ne baala baa soɡe jaɡre ta bwa jo mpo la bini, asɛ Korowii ɡel nee la ba bɔle ba nɛ.
O ɡelɔ Israel tena la te valɛ harɛpɛɛ waa hola ta mpo la bini dɛ le.
Belaa Arɔn nimambie Miriam waa ɛ Korowii keame kpɔ loŋ, asɛ haahna la bwa ɡe ja dɛ kpoŋe ane ba yiiɡa dɛ sa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Asɛ Miriam ɡo yel dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii.
O lɛ sɔn kohona ɡa.
O kpɔ jaɡre ne nɛra baa soɡe a ta bwa ka ta mpo bini.” Neerare ane aa lɔ Mara ne Elim wa Ate, Mosis tɔ Israel tena la sie le Mposwɛm la nyoa, dɛ kpɔ ba kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Suur.
Ba ɡaaɡe harɛ la ta tɔpera atoro dɛ ba ta nee nae.
Ba baa tel bobɛl baa yerɔ Mara dɛ na nee bɛl.
Ba ta wone nyɔɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o kpeli.
Gɛɛ a do baa yerɛ bela Mara.
O munii kpeli.
Anomanta, nɛra la naɡre wa dɛ pɛɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “Leperaa ya dɔ nee dɛ́ nyɔɔ?” Ate, Mosis wi no Korowii asɛ o baɡlo daa bɛl.
O kpɔ ta nee la ta nee la do som ba bwa nyɔ.
Bela la, Korowii do Mmarare tɛɛ ba asɛ dɛ kpɔ daah ba na.
Korowii bol ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ cheɡ deŋnee dɛɛ no men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ nɔ dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa toɡra n be, dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare bwa ta ɡɛ naa, ate maa weela maa kpɔa ba ta Ijipt tena nɛɛ la bɛlbwaa kpɔ ba he nɛ.
Menee Korowii maa dɛ chah heya weela.” Ba berɔ ba tel Elim.
Buli fi dɛ anɛ dɛ bambie daa fifraanuanɛ lɔ bela, asɛ ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene nee la jwɛɛh bela.
Maana ne chayambwibwi wa Israel tena bwa iro le Elim, dɛ ba pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sen, baa le Ijipt harɛ ta korobie anɛ tɔpera fi dɛ anue habɔɔ.
Bela lɔ Elim ne Sinai baah ta.
Baa lɔ bela la, dɛ ba dɛ naɡre Mosis ne Arɔn wa, dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii fe den kpoo yaa Ijipt harɛ ta kwaraa naa, a fe bɔ.
Yaa lɔ bela dɛ ola su viine, yaa di kondikwa ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyin.
Dɛ a bɛlbwa ta yaa nyae, asɛ he kpɔ yaa ba ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bonɔ lɔr kpo yaa ya bwa ɛɛ ba serewa nɔ.” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo kondikwa le nyundua lee kɛŋɔ bwaala tɛ heya.
Gel nɛra la le tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛ́ ka tɔɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ kwaa aa tel ba.
Anee ń kpɔ daah ba na kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ teŋɛ n webaɡla taa kɛɛ baa teŋɔɔ?
Tɔpenumɛl wee kwaa haa ka tɔɔ la te, hé tɔɔra ɡɛ haa dɛ tɔɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ kwaa la bele anɛ cheɡ.” Asɛ Mosis ne Arɔn ŋɔ Israel tena la bwa be ŋɔ, “Jɔmɔra nɔ ne, hɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii kpɔ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, ásɛ tɔɔ perɔ chɔɔ ɡe aa, he na Korowii jirima chaahna, dɛkalkɛ o noɔ kɛŋɔ haa dɛ naɡre o wa.
Ya ɡee bamewa hɛɛ naɡre ya waɔ?” Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɛ́ tɛ heya ola he chwe jɔmɔra, ne kondikwa bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin dɛ́ di chɔɔ, dɛkalkɛ o na ɡɛ haa dɛ naɡre o wa kohona.
Ya ɡee bamewa hɛɛ naɡre ya waɔ?
Ya waa laa hɛɛ naɡre la, Korowii waa hɛɛ naɡre.” Ate, Mosis ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Israel tena la bwa be ŋɔ bá ba Korowii sie, dɛkalkɛ o no naɡra baa dɛ naɡre o waa la bwa.” Arɔn aa dɛ bol waa la Israel tena bwa be la, ba nyiŋo dɛ na pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela kɛŋɔ Korowii jirima aa chaahna le bam bɛl ta nyundua.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “N no Israel tena naɡra baa dɛ naɡre n waa la bwa.
Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ baa chwe ola jɔmɔraa, dɛ́ di kondikwaa chɔɔ dɛ́ vaɡɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.” Awola jɔmɔra la, chayambwibwi balɔ ba tɔ bela baa soɡa la bwa.
Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, mɛn leo dɛ bar bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la dɛ pwe harɛ la bwa.
Mɛn la aa baa le la, dɛ kwaa ane aa do pɛlɛpɛlɛ kɛŋɔ pɛŋe pɛɡa chɔ harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa.
Israel tena laa naa la, ba bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa ɡee nɔɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ baa a konsoo jemɛ.” Anee Mosis ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kondikwaa Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé di laanee.
Anɔɔ Korowii do heya ŋɔ he bɛlbwa tɔɔ ɡɛ del aa maɡre o ne la.
Aa ɛ kuruwa beŋkpoŋii dɛ maɡre nomɛlbwa ne dem bɛlbwa ta.” Israel tena la ɛ ɡɛ baa bol ba be la bwa.
Ba bini bane tɔɔ kohona, bane ɡe tɔɔ tamaa ken.
Baa maɡa kuruware ta la, banɔ la baa tɔɔ kohona la ta dɔe a ɡwaa ba nɛ, asɛ banɔ la baa tɔɔ tama la ɡe kwaa maɡre ba ne.
Bɛlbwa dɔ ɡɛ del aa maɡre o ne.
Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “Bɛ́lbwa bɛ ɡel tɔɔ per o kwaa ta.” Ba bini bane ta o waa la kpɔe dɛ kwaa ane cheɡ.
Tɔ aa pera la, dɛ dudule lɛ a bwa a do sɔɔh.
Anomanta, Mosis baah di ba nɛ.
Tɔɔ perɔ chɔɔ bɛlbwa naa, bɛlbwa ka dɛ tɔɔ ɡɛ del aa maɡre o ne, asɛ wee baa baŋɛ aa, anɔ la aa kaa dɛ chɔ la bwa yon mwɛɛ.
Tɔpenumɛl wee la, ba dɛ tɔɔra bele anɛnɛ ɡɛ aa maɡre bɛlbwa ne, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa dɛ dɔ dɛ ɛ kuruwa dela anɛ.
Asɛ nomonome la ba Mosis be dɛ ba taa baɡlo.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ do heya a ta laanee nɔ, kere ɛ Ona Tɔpere, o ɛ tɔpere waa do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ Korowii.
Anomanta, hé wɔɔ paanoo haa dɛ nyin wɔɔra, dɛ́ daa anɔ la haa dɛ nyin daala fini.
Anɔ la haa di a ka la, he kwaa cheɡ tɔɔ per a ta.” Anomanta, ba kwaa anɔ la aa kaa la cheɡ ka tel kɛŋɔ tɔ aa pera chɔɔ, ɡɛ Mosis aa do ba la.
A ta sɔɔh doe á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ dudule ɛɛ do a taa.
Ate, Mosis ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé dia fini, dɛkalkɛ fini ɛ Ona Tɔpere dɛ tɛ Korowii.
Kondikwaa bɛlbwa toole he na harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa dɛ tɔɔra fini.
Tɔpera anumɛlee chɛ kɛ hé kpɔ tɔɔ kondikwa la, kɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee waa ɛ Ona Tɔpere la te, kondikwaa bɛlbwa aa lee he tɔɔ.” Ane a bwa, tɔpenuanɛ wee la, nɛra la bane leɔ ŋɔ ba fee ka tɔɔ kondikwaa la ane, kɛ ba ta ane dɔe.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Dɛ ka tel saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin he vɛh waa maa do heyaa ta teŋa ɔ?
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii tɛ heyaa tɔpere haa onɛ o ta.
A waa tɔpenumɛl wee ta wɛɛ tɛ heya tɔpenuanɛ wee kondikwa dɛɛ ja la.
Bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ ó so o buɡ ta tɔpenuanɛ wee la ta, dɛ bɛ le kaa bobɛlbwa.” Anomanta, nomɛlbwa onɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee la ta.
Israel tena la ŋɔ kondikwaa la sɔne ‘maana’.
A do kɛŋɔ boyubi dɛ to.
He dia aa, o som kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ tooh do biskeeti ta la ken.
Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa do yaa a ta laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel maana dɛ ɛ kuruwa del cheɡ, ásɛ he naanar baa ka ba la jemɛ kondikwaa la soo maa tɛ heya he di pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, ɡɛ saŋ maa lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la.’ ” Anomanta, Mosis berɔ ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ vii dɛ́ fuɡe maana kuruwa del do o bini, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ cheɡ Korowii sie á che tɛ ya naanar baa ka ba la.” Arɔn kpɔ maana la cheɡ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, asɛ ba kwaa cheɡ ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la.
Bene fifraanaarɛɛ Israel tena di maana mɔɔ dɛ tel Keenan harɛ jwɛh ta.
Mea kuruwa fii dɛɛ ɛ efa Israel tena kwaa maɡa ta.
Nee aa bula le bwetal ta wa Israel tena bwa iro le Sen pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, dɛ so dɛɛ ir ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ do ba la.
Ba ɡaaɡɔ dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene so bobɛl ɡe baa dɛ yerɔ Refidim.
Dɛ nee toole harɛ la ta bá nyɔ.
Anomanta, ba ne Mosis naɡrɔ, asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Tɛ́ yaa nee yá nyɔ.” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ne he naɡra munii ame o?
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin he daah Korowii dɛ́ na nɔɔ?” Nyɔɡre kohona nomanta, ba teŋɔ naɡre Mosis waa bela.
Ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he lawɛ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ɡel nyɔɡre baa kpo ya ne ya bii ne kondɛɛra ya bwa serewe nɔɔ?” Ate, Mosis soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona ɛ tɛ nɛra nɔ te nɔ?
Ba dɛ nyin kɛ ba foɡ mɛ bwea kpo kwara.” Anee Korowii chaŋe Mosis ŋɔ, “Tɔ nɛra la sie.
Kpɔ nomonome la bini bane ja he nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ daŋɡbala la haa kpɔa lɔ Nael Moo sie la ɡe kpoŋe kaa.
Mɛɛ ka che bwe bɛl jwɛɛh Sinai Bwejen ta belaa dɛɛ kpa heya.
Dɛ he tel belaa, kpɔ daŋɡbala la lɔ bwe la, nee ɛɛ le o taa ba, ásɛ nɛra la dɔ nyɔ.” Asɛ Mosis ɡe ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa Israel nomonome la siwi ta.
Mosis pa bela sɔn Maasa ne Mɛreba, dɛkalkɛ Israel tena la naɡre wa dɛ daah Korowii na dɛɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii ja ya nɛɛ kɛɛ o ta ya nɛɛ jae yɔ?” Israel tena yo Amalɛk tena Amalɛk tena balɔ ba lɔ tɔ Israel tena nɛ Refidim dɛ yoo ba.
Anee Mosis ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Le ya baala nɔ bini bane, ásɛ he ka yoo ba.
Kere mɛɛ ka che deŋɡare bɛl doa belaa dɛ́ kpoŋe Korowii daŋɡbala la.” Anomanta, Josua leɔ dɛ kaa yo Amalɛk tena la ɡɛ Mosis aa doo la, asɛ Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Hur kaa deŋɡare la doa.
Mosis baa ir o nɔɔra aa, dɛ Israel tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
O ba nɔɔra ne harɛ naa, dɛ Amalɛk tena ɡe berɔ dɛɛ pɔ Israel tena nɛ.
O nɔɔra aa baa koh la, Arɔn ne Hur kpɔ bwe ba bil Mosis o so o ta.
Bɛl lɔ o ɡal asɛ bɛl ɡe do o diɡ, asɛ ba ɡɔɔ o nɔɔra nyundua, ásɛ o nɔɔra won che dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ wee aa baa jo.
Gɛɛ a do Josua ka yo Amalɛk laa tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ do tɔn bini á ɛ waa aa chɔ kerekere.
Gel Josua no dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ba Amalɛk tena chɔɡa baa wola ba waa no harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa kpa.” Mosis ɛ kon waa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii bela, dɛ pa o sɔn ŋɔ, “Korowiirii yoa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii nɛɛ n kpɔ sie dawɛ o yo dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ teŋɔɔ yo Amalɛk tena saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la!”
Jetro kaa chɔɔ Mosis Mosis helabaa Jetro waa ɛ Midian harɛ sɔfo la, no Korowii waa waa ɛa tɛ Mosis ne o nɛra Israel tena, dɛ kpɔ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la wa.
Mosis fa ɡelɔ o haah Sepora kaa o helabaa Jetro be ka so, o ne o bibaala banɛ bwa.
Ba bini bɛl sɔne Gɛɛsɔm dɛkalkɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “N kaa ɛ hɔɔh harɛfale ta.” O pa binɛɛte la sɔn Eliesa dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii n mɛɛwa aa tomɔ laanee cha mɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le Ijipt kooro nɔn ta, o ta men kpoe.” Jetro ne Mosis haah ne o bibaala banɛ la bwaa la o be pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, bela waa soɡa dɛ baŋre o tɛnte dea Korowii bwe la jwɛɛh la.
Dɛ Jetro tɔ sie kpɔ kala tɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “Men maa ɛ he helabaa, ne he haah dɛ he bibaala banɛ la dɛ ba he be.” Ate, Mosis le dɛ ka chemo, dɛ ɡuŋu harɛ dɛ jaamo.
Ba jam dɔŋa tonɛ dɛ lawɛ dɔŋa ka jo tɛnte Dea la bini.
Asɛ Mosis bol o helabaa be ɡɛ bwa Korowii aa koh Israel tena wa dɛ ɛ Ijipt kooro ne o nɛra, dɛ laɡ ba le ba harɛ ta.
O berɔ bol ba wekpeɡa baa naa ŋwɛnɛ ta, ne lɛɛ Korowii aa lɛɛ ba bwa la wa.
Jetro aa no ɡɛ la, o sie lɛ wedɛɛɡa Korowii aa ɛ Israel tena dɛ lɛɛ ba le Ijipt tena nɔn ta la ta.
Asɛ Jetro ŋɔ, “Korowiirii dɔ jam kɛŋɔ waa lɛ heyaa le Ijipt tena ne ba kooro nɔn ta.
N deno jemɛ name kɛŋɔ Korowii kpeɡri ɡwaa voɡa bwa kpeɡri, dɛ le anɔ waa kpɔa ɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Israel tena nyubaahna la wa.” Ate, Jetro kpɔ kon waa fuh ɛ saraha ne saraha kwaa ane ɡe ba tɛ Korowii.
Asɛ Arɔn ne Israel nomonome bwa le ba, asɛ ba ne o di kwa Korowii sie.
Nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole lee wa Tɔ aa pera la, Mosis soɡe ba waa ta dɛɛ bola.
Asɛ nɛra la ba che baro ka tel jɔmɔra.
O helabaa Jetro aa nao la, o bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he ɛ dɛɛ tɛ nɛra la bwa nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he ɡbo so ba waa ta dɛɛ bola, hale ba che bare dɛ le chɔɔ ka tel jɔmɔra bwa nɔɔ?” Asɛ Mosis chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nɛra la ba n be dɛ́ ba hweli waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin.
Dɛ bɛl ne o dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, n siee ba yon ba a ne, ásɛ n so a ta dɛ́ pa bole dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ Korowii Mmarare la wa.” Anee o helabaa chaŋo ŋɔ, “Aŋwɛnɛ ta laa hɛɛ ɛa ɡɛ la.
Koeh he ne nɛra nɔ baa dɛ ba he be nɔ ɛɛ koh la.
Toma la ɡwaa he nɛ, he ɡbo aa won ɛa.
Cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no n be ń tɛɛ a wejema, ásɛ Korowii ja he nɛ.
A chɛ kɛ he che tɛ nɛra la Korowii sie, dɛ́ kpɔ ba waa baa bil o sie.
Gel ba jemɛ Korowii Mmarare la, dɛ́ baɡ ba ɡɛ baa so sodɛɛɡa.
Berɛ le ba bini wejerema, baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ, ba siwi aa wola suuɡa beɡre.
Dɛ́ kpɔ ba chɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa ne lafare, ne fifraanunue dɛ fifi nyoo.
Dɛ waane aa kpeɡe kohona naa, ɡel tɛɛ ba ba ɡbo ɛɛ bola saŋ bɛlbwa.
Kɛ dɛ ane baa do kpeɡri dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aa, bá kpɔ ba he sie, anee dɛ́ ɡel he toma do fɛɡre.
He wono ɛ ken ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ doe la aa, haa koeh ba kohona kpa.
Ásɛ dɛ nɛra nɔ bini bɛlbwa berɔ dɛɛ kaa o dem aa, o kaa tetoora ne.” Mosis no o helabaa waa waa bola la dɛ ɛ a bwa.
O le Israel baala bini wejerema la ba ɛ nomonome dɛ chɔ ba nyoo.
Nɛra kaɡboŋa ne ba nomonome, nɛra lafare ne ba nomonome, nɛra fifraanunue ne ba nomonome, asɛ nɛra fifi ɡe ne ba nomonome.
Banee chɔ ba bala nyoo dɛɛ bol ba waa saŋ bɛlbwa.
A bini ane baa do kpeɡri aa, bá kpɔ ba Mosis be, anɔ la aa wola kpeɡe ɡe la, ba ɡbabir bola.
Ate, Mosis ka do o helabaa Jetro ŋwɛnɛ o kaa o bwɛ.
Israel tena teehnɔ kaa Sinai Bwejen doa Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ta korobie atoro ta la, ba baa tel Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Baa le Refidim la, ba baa tel Sinai Bwejen ta, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Asɛ ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene bwe la bɔr bela.
Anee Mosis teeh la Korowii be bwe la doa.
Asɛ Korowii yerɔ bwe la doa ŋɔ ó ka ŋɔ Israel tena baa ɛ Jekɔb naanar be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡbabir na ɡɛ maa ɛa Ijipt harɛ ta, ne ɡɛ maa kpɔ heyaa kɛŋɔ kee yon kpɔ o bii o kena ta dɛ ba he ne n be.
Dɛ hɛɛ dɛɛ no n deŋna waa, dɛ́ ɡel n ne he fɔo la che kɛrɛdɛ tenaa, mɛɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ n nɛra n siwi aa dɛ su ba harɛ nɔ ta bwa nɛra bini.
Menee dɔ harɛ nɔ bwa te, mɛɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ n sɔfore maa le heyaa cheɡ hɛɛ ɛ n toma.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛ hé bol baɡle Israel tena.” Asɛ Mosis berɛ kaa dɛ ka cheme nɛra la nomonome la, asɛ dɛ kpɔ waa Korowii aa doo ŋɔ ó bol la bwa bil ba sie.
Ate, nɛra la bwa sɛh dɛ ŋɔ, “Yaa ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa bola bwaa.” Asɛ Mosis ba bol sɛɛh baa sɛh waa la ta la Korowii be.
Belaa Korowii bol o be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba bam waa bira kpirkpir kohona bini cheɡa dɛ́ ba he be, ásɛ nɛra la bwa no kɛŋɔ n ne he dɛ bol wa, á che a ta baa yaradae saŋ bɛlbwa.” Ate, Mosis bol waa baa bola la chaɡle Korowii.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “La nɛra la be dɛ́ ka ŋɔ ba le fini ne kere dɛ́ sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta, dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ n be pera.
Bá chɛɡɛ ba laala, dɛɛ kpa tɔpetooro wee la ta, dɛkalkɛ awolaa men Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ ba Sinai Bwejen ta bala nɛra bwa siwi ta.
Kpɔ kon pe harɛ ó ɛ jwɛh bar bwe la, dɛ́ ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ bɛ́lbwa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ jwɛh la ba ɡale, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa teeh bwe laanee.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡe bwe la kwaraa la, kpoe chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo.
Bá foɡro bwea kpo kɛɛ dɛ́ yaɡɔ hɛma ne dɛ bɛ nɔn kpɔ leɡo.
Dɛ nɛnee kɛɛ olii yoo, o bɛ o nyu dɔ kpa.
Kɛ dɛ ba no bɛla sii biɡri aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa chwa kaa bwe la lɔɡa.” Mosis tuo ba nɛra la be, dɛ ɡel ba sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta, dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ Korowii be pera.
Asɛ ba chɛɡɛ ba laala.
Asɛ o ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ he te dɛɛ kpa tɔpetooro wee la.
Bɛlbwa ɛɛ berɛ haah chɔe.” Tɔpetooro wee la chɔɔ, bwaala nyɛɡlɔ dɛɛ kɔɡre kohona bam tɔ bwejen la doa bwa kpirkpir ken, asɛ bɛla sii ɛɛ le kohona.
Nomɛlbwa waa soɡe o tɛnte dea bini ɔmɔ kohona.
Anee Mosis tɔ nɛra la sie ba le dɛɛ la ka cheme Korowii, ba kaa che bwejen la lɔɡa.
Dɛ chuu tɔ Sinai Bwejen la bwa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii cheɡɛ nii ta dɛ ba tu o doa.
Chuu la nyundua kaala do kɛŋɔ nijena chuu ken.
Dɛ bwejen la bwa dɛ jiɡri kikikiki ken, asɛ bɛla la ɡee si kpeɡri nɛɛ kohona dɛɛ ja.
Belaa Mosis bol wa, asɛ Korowii chaŋo kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra ken.
Korowii tuo ba bwejen la doa, dɛ yerɛ Mosis ŋɔ ó ba o be nyundua bela.
Asɛ o teeh la o be, asɛ Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Berɛ tu ka kah nɛra la ŋɔ ba bɛ lii kɛŋɔ baa ɡale jwɛh laanee dɛ́ kpɔ siwi na men Korowii.
Ba lii ɡɛ naa, ba kɛrɛdɛ bwa ɛɛ serewoo.
Sɔfore kwaraa baa dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ ba n be la, atane bá sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ n be pera.
Gɛ laa aa, mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee.” Anee Mosis chaŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛra nɔ aa won teeh ba he be bwejen nɔ doa, dɛkalkɛ he ɡbabir kah yaa ŋɔ yá kpɔ kon pe ó ɛ jwɛh bar bwe la, ásɛ bela do ɡoroŋ.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Berɛ tu ka kpɔ Arɔn ja he nɛɛ he bwa ba.
Kɛ sɔfore la ne nɛra la te bɛ lii kɛŋɔ baa ɡale jwɛh laanee dɛ́ ba n be bwe nɔ ta.
Gɛ laa aa, mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee.” Asɛ Mosis tu ba nɛra la be, dɛ ba bol waa Korowii aa bola la chaɡ ba.
Korowii Mmarare fi la wa Korowii bol waa aa teŋa nɔ bwa ɡe dɛ ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta somanjiri dii ta la.
He bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ ka ja n nɛ.
He bɛ komɛlbwa waa lɔ nyundua kɛɛ harɛ ta hale nee bini bɛlbwa chaa ɛ.
He bɛ an ɡuŋi á ba ɛ kɛ hɛɛ tomaa, dɛkalkɛ menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, n dɛ mee.
N dɛ tɛr banɔ la baa hah mɛ deŋne, hale dɛ́ kpoŋe ka tel ba bii ne ba naanar bele batoro kɛɛ banaarɛ baa ka ba la nɛ.
Dɛɛ nyin banɔ la baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmara ta, hale dɛ́ kpoŋe ka tel ba naanar bele kaɡboŋ nɛ.
He bɛ men maa ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ wesale bɛlbwa ta.
Mɛɛ tɛr naate waa dɛ ŋwɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ la deŋnee.
Hé di Ona Tɔpere la, dɛ́ ɛo tɔpedɛɛɡe o do ɡoroŋ.
Tɔpera anumɛlee hé dɔ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ he toma bɛlbwa, kɛ Ona Tɔpere la te ɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la tɔpere.
O telaa, he bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ o ta.
He ne he bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna kɛɛ bonɔɔna, kɛɛ toli bɛlbwa bɛ toma ɛ. Hale he kondɛɛra te bɛlbwa, ne hɔɔhra kwaraa baa lɔ he dem.
Tɔpera anumɛlee n kpɔ ta nyundua ne harɛ, mpo ne koŋkwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa, asɛ dɛ onɛ tɔpere waa teŋa nuanɛ la ta.
A waa n ɡel Ona Tɔpere la ɛ tɔpedɛɛɡe dɛ ɡel o do ɡoroŋ.
Hé duu he nyare ne he mɛɛnanar.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel he dɔ mkpajaŋ harɛ men Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa ŋɔ he so o ta la ta.
He bɛ nɛn kpo.
He bɛ jwamane dɛɛ bɔ.
He bɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛ.
He bɛ dansewea dɛɛ di.
He bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre he dɔŋa deremi.
He bɛ ɡel he dɔŋa haahna pɛla dɔ heya.
He bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre he dɔŋa bonɔɔna kɛɛ toli, ba nae ne keeɡore, dɛ komɛlbwa aa ɛ ba kwa.” Nɛra la aa na bwaala nyɛɡla dɛ no o kɔɡra, ne bɛla la sii dɛ na chuu tɔ bwe la ta la, ɔmee laɡ ba dɛ kpɔ bochechela ta ba nɛ ba ka che bojaŋ.
Anee ba ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “He ɡbabir bol waa ya be, yaa noo.
Bɛ ɡel Korowii bol ásɛ ya ba serewe.” Asɛ o ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɔmɛ.
Korowiirii bala dɛ́ ba daah heyaa na, ásɛ hɛɛ ɔmɔ dɛ́ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ.” Dɛ ba ta cheɡɛ bojaŋ, asɛ Mosis ɡe ka bɛne bam waa bira kpirkpir bela Korowii aa lole la.
Voɡa ne kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ó bol ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡle Israel tena ŋɔ, “He ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ men Korowii aa le nyundua dɛ bol waa he be.
He bɛ suuɡapoŋa kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm bɛlbwa kpɔ ɛ voɡa dɛɛ toma ka ja n nɛ.
Hé kpɔ teera ma saraha kon haa lawɛ peera ne boohna ne nae dɛ́ fuah dɛɛ tɛ mɛ o ta, ásɛ dɛ berɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha ɡe tɛ mɛ o ta.
Bela maa le tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tom mɛ la, mɛɛ ba he be belaa dɛ́ ba swee heyaa andɛɛɡa.
He dɛ ba bwea kpɔe kwaa kon haa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ mɛ naa, hé ɡel bwea la do ɡɛ aa doa la, he bɛ an sɛh.
Hé kpɔ kon sɛah aa, aa werii do tɛ n toma kpa.
He bɛ n saraha kon ɛ tɛ mɛ dɛ́ ɛ sanjol teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta, dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ he mumɡbalee he kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle la.”
Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Mmarare nɔɔ chɛ kɛ he kpɔ tɛ Israel tena.
Hibru tena baa yaɡ ba yoma He bɛlbwa yawɛ Hibru te aa, bene anumɛlee chɛ kɛ ó tomɛ.
Bennuanɛ te la chɛ kɛ ó dɔ o te.
O ta komɛlbwa bɔe dɔe.
Dɛ o ɡboo he yawɛ aa, o ɡboo chɛ kɛ he ta ŋwɛnɛ ó kaa.
Kɛ dɛ o ne o haahnee yaa, o ne o haah bwaa dɛ́ kaa.
Dɛ nɛn waa yawɔ la ɡe tɛo haah o ne o dɔ bihaahna kɛɛ bibaala aa, haah la ne bii la bwa ɛ nomoa la kwa.
Baa la ɡboo dɛ́ dɔ o te kaa.
Kɛ dɛ yom la ŋɔ, o dɛ nyin o nomoa ne o haah dɛ bii ŋɔ waa kaa laa, nomoa la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó la o ne nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole sie, dɛ́ lawɛ o deŋne marɛ doonyoa daa keŋkeŋ, dɛ́ forɔ ó ɛ o nɛndɔɔle dɛɛ la, hale o serewe bena.
Dɛ baa yoɡ o bihaah tɛ nomɛl kɛŋɔ yom aa, baa o te ŋwɛnɛ ta ó dɔ o te kɛŋɔ, ba yon ta baala ŋwɛnɛ baa dɔ ba te la.
Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa yawɔ kɛ o fe ɛ o haah la aa on nyin kpa aa, ó berɔ tɛ o nɛra dɛ́ lɛ o suuɡa.
O bɛ on yoɡ tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra dɛkalkɛ o neɡro.
Dɛ naate lawɔ tɛ o bibaa ɡe aa, a chɛ kɛ ó den kpɔɔ ɛ o bihaah.
A ɡɛ baa la berɔ kpɔ hanɛɛte ja o nɛ aa, a chɛ kɛ ó teŋɛ dɛɛ tɛ hanomoa la kondikwa ne yal, o ne wɛɛ chɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Baa la ta wone ɛ a ɡɛ kombele atoro nɔ dɛɛ tɛ haah la aa, o dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ó kaa waa wola suuɡa bɛlbwaa bɔ tɛo.
Dɔŋa kpoora Mmarare Nomɛlbwa waa lɔ o dɔŋ o sewɛ la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpo o ɡe.
Kɛ dɛ o laa saahna, Korowii we-ɛɛlaa yaa, ó chwa kaa bela maa lea cheɡ heya, ásɛ o dɔ o nyu.
Kɛ dɛ nomɛlbwa dɔ o dɔŋ liire dɛ ka kpoo waa, hale o chwao ka marɛ n saraha kon la dɛ́ dɔ o nyu kwaraa naa, hé lawɔ le, ásɛ dɛ ka kpoo.
Nomɛlbwa waa lɔɔ o nya kɛɛ o mɛɛ la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo.
Nomɛlbwa waa ɡuɡri o dɔŋ dɛ lawɔ ka yoɡ, kɛɛ dɛ o ta lɔ o nɔn ta ba lawɔ waa, kpoe chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
Nomɛlbwa waa taah o nya kɛɛ o mɛɛ la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ baala banɛ dɛ yo asɛ bɛl kpɔ bwe forɛ o dɔŋ, kɛɛ dɛ ume nɔn lɔɔ o ta sewɛ dɛ chɔ weela ta, asɛ dɛ ba won ir kpɔ daŋɡbala valɛ le buse naa, ba bɛ naate la waa lɔɔ la deŋne tɛr.
Kɛ ó cha weela te la o chɔe la bini ka tel kɛŋɔ waa dɔ bokpeɡa.
A chɛ kɛ ó berɛ chao dɛɛ tɛo kwaa waa paŋa o weela ta chɔe bini la ɡe bwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ yombaa kɛɛ yomhaah, dɛ kpɔ daa lɔɔ o sewɛ buɡ ta la chɛ kɛ bá tɛr o deŋne.
Kɛ dɛ o wono dɔ bokpeɡa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ kɛɛ tɔpera anɛ naa, ate a ta chɛ kɛ ó dɔ deŋnetɛra, dɛkalkɛ o ɡbaɡba suuɡa nee o yawɔ.
A balɔ kɛŋɔ baala banɛ dɛ yo, asɛ bɛl koni ka lɔ tekpoŋri o piɡri lolɛ dɛ waane ta a habɔɔ balaa, naate la chɛ kɛŋɔ haah la jaa yoɡu ɡɛ bwa waa dɛ nyin, ne ɡɛ nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la ɡe aa tɛ ŋwɛnɛ.
Kɛ dɛ nɛn doe bol aa, he ɡe doo bol.
Dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, bá kpo o ɡe.
Dɛ nomɛl fome he siwii aa, hé ɡe fome o siwi.
Dɛ o fome he nyen aa, hé ɡe fome o nyen.
O nɔnee yaa, hé ɡe ɛ o kon ɡɛ, o napaa ɡee yaa, hé ɡe ɛ o kon ɡɛ.
Niinii naate kpɔ bwɛ o dɔŋ aa, o ɡe bwɛo ɡɛ, bolee o doo waa, bá do o ɡe bol, dɛ o bwara malaa yaa, bá mali o ɡe bwara ɡɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ yomhaah kɛɛ yombaa dɛ lɔ o siwi ta o chɔɡ la, o siwi la nomanta, ó kaa pɛɛpɛɛ.
Dɛ o yom nyenee o fome aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó kaa.
Dɛ nabal chuɡe baa kɛɛ haah o sewaa, a chɛ kɛ bá foɡre nao la bwea kpo.
A ta chɛ kɛ bá chwe o ol, nao te la ɡe ta chɛ kɛ bá tɛr o deŋne.
Kɛ dɛ ɡɛɛ nao la ɛɛ chuɡe nɛra asɛ ba ɡel kon te jemɛ, o vɛh o lawa dɛ do leɡ bini o kpo haah kɛɛ baa laa, a chɛ kɛ bá foɡre nao la kpo, dɛ́ kpo o dɔɔ la ɡe ja.
Kɛ dɛ a chɛ kɛ nao te la bɔ komɛl dɛ́ charɛ o nyu aa, ɡɛ bwa baa dɛ nyin laanee bá maɡɛ tɛo ó bɔ.
Mmara beŋkpoŋ nɔɔ lole dɛ tɛ nao waa chuɡe bihaah kɛɛ bibaa bɛlbwa.
Dɛ nabal chuɡe yom waa ɛ haah kɛɛ baa laa, a chɛ kɛ nao te la bɔ suuɡapoŋa fifraatoro tɛ yom la dɔɔ, ásɛ ba foɡre nao la bwea kpo.
Nomɛl pili bɔluŋ, kɛɛ dɛ kwii o kwiu dɛ vɛh o ta tɔe, asɛ nabal kɛɛ keeɡo ka le o bini dɛ sewaa, naate la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ kon la kem tɛ o dɔɔ ásɛ o ɛ o kon.
Nomɛl nabal chuɡe o dɔŋ kon kpo aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá yoɡ onɔ la o siwi taa lole la, ásɛ dɛ bɔne o suuɡa tɛ dɔŋa, dɛ́ berɛ bɔne onɔ la ɡe waa sewa la ol bini kɛrɛdɛ tɛ dɔŋa.
Kɛ dɛ ba jemɛ ɡɛ nao la waa kɛŋɔ, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ chuɡri kwaa wubwa asɛ ba bol kon te be o vɛh o teɡa dɛ do leɡ bini naa, a chɛ kɛ kon te la nyin bɛl chiɡ onɔ la waa sewa la naa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ onsewe la.”
Kwaa kema bɔe Mmarare Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa ŋwɛ nao kɛɛ pee dɛ kpo kɛɛ dɛ yoɡu waa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ nae anue, kɛɛ dɛ bɔ peera anaarɛ chiɡ pee la naa ta.
Ba lawɛ ŋwɛɛ wɛɛ ku bobɛl dɛ́ ka ŋwɛ asɛ ba lɔɔ o sewaa, naate waa lɔɔ la ta bolchɔɡe dii.
Kɛ dɛ bɔr chaahnɔ mɔɔ a chiɡ aa, dɛ naate la kpo nɛn dɛ di bolchɔɡe.
Ŋwɛɛ bɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ kon waa ŋwɛa la kem.
Kɛ dɛ o ta komɛlbwa dɔe yaa, bá yoɡ o ɡbabir dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ kem la.
Dɛ kon waa ŋwɛa la ɛ kondɛɛre o ta sewɛ mɔɔ naa, nabal kɛɛ keeɡo kɛɛ dɛ pee kwaraa yoo, a chɛ kɛ ó bɔ bele anɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ kondɛɛra la dibɔr, dɛ ɡela a ka jo bɛl koo ta kɛɛ daa koo ta, dɛ ka di o bini kwaa la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ o ɡbabir koo kondikwa kɛɛ daa nɔna aa ɛa kɛrɛdɛ la bɔ o dɔŋ la kem.
Dɛ nɛn do nii o koo ta asɛ a fuh ka jo nomɛl koo ta, dɛ fuh mea baa koma bil kɛɛ anɔ la a taa cheɡa kɛɛ dɛ koo la bwa sekwaraa naa, nɛn waa do nii la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ a bwa kem.
Dɛ nomɛl kpɔ suuɡapoŋa kɛɛ laala ane tɛ o dɔŋ ŋɔ o cheɡ, asɛ a ba kɛŋɔ ba ŋwɛa asɛ ba lawɛ ŋwɛɛ la aa, ó bɔ a bele anɛ.
Kɛ dɛ ba ta ŋwɛɛ la lawaa, dem te la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá la o ne nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole sie, dɛ́ ka nyiŋi a ta kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba bee a ka kɛɛ.
Dɛ nomɛl nao kɛɛ keeɡo kɛɛ pee kɛɛ yal kɛɛ komɛlbwa nyoɡrɔ o ka nao o dɔŋ bɛl be dɛ ŋɔ o konee yaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra banɛ la bwa kpɔ la nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la sie.
Ba bini bɛlbwa baa na kɛŋɔ o di bolchɔɡe la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ ɡɛ kwaa aa nyoɡra la bele anɛ tɛ o dɔŋ la.
Nomɛl kpɔ keeɡo kɛɛ nao kɛɛ pee dɛ kondɛɛre bɛlbwa tɛ o dɔŋ o nyiŋi o ta dɛɛ tɛo, asɛ a ba kɛŋɔ o sewɔ kɛɛ dɛ bolee ba doo, kɛɛ lawaa nomɛl ba lawɔ bɛlbwa sie aa wola toole bela aa, ba nɛra banɛ la bwa la Korowii sie, ásɛ naate waa dɛ nyiŋi kon la ta la ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ kon la toole o be.
Kon te la chɛ kɛ ó no a mun ɡɛ, ate komɛlbwa toole naate bɔ tɛo kpa.
Kɛ dɛ a berɔ ba kɛŋɔ onee ŋwɛ o dɔŋ la kondɛɛre la aa, a chɛ kɛ ó nyin bɛl chiɡ o naa ta tɛo.
Dɛ kpɔɡ bini ol ɡee chweo waa, ó kpɔ bela waa kaa la ka baɡle á ɛ danseɛ.
O bɛ bɛl nyin cheɡ o naa ta kpa.
Dɛ nɛn kemɛ o dɔŋ kondɛɛre, asɛ a ka ba kɛŋɔ ba doo bol kɛɛ o sewɛ dɛ kon te la toole bela aa, a chɛ kɛ ó nyin bɛl chiɡ o naa ta tɛ kon te la.
Kɛ dɛ kon te la siwi ta waa yaa, nɛn waa kemɛ kondɛɛre la ta komɛl bɔe dɔe dɛ́ tɛo kpa.
Dɛ hanaa kon te la kpɔ hane aa, suuɡa waa lɛ la dɛ chiɡ kondɛɛre la kem bɔe naa ta.
Mmarare aa chɔ le tɛ Israel tena Nomɛlbwa waa neɡre bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ, o nɛra ɡe ta sɛɛh kɛŋɔ o ne baa bɛlbwa so mɔɔ o lawɔ chɔ la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ o bwara wa, ásɛ o den ɛ o haah.
A balɔ kɛŋɔ haah la mɛɛ ta sɛɛh kɛ o kpɔɔ tɛo waa, a chɛ kɛ baa la bɔ suuɡa aa chɛa dɛ chɔ le tɛ bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ nyin suuɡa.
Haah bɛlbwa waa dɛɛ ɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ kondɛɛre chɔ kɛ baa ne haah la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ voɡ bɛlbwa, dɛ ɡel men Korowii la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ nɛŋhɔɔh hɔhɔrɔwa doe kɛɛ dɛɛ fiiɡu, dɛkalkɛ he ɡe fa ɛ hɔɔhra Ijipt harɛ ta ka.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ luhaahna kɛɛ bilalbii fiiɡa.
He fiɡ ba asɛ ba wi no men Korowii aa, mɛɛ cha baa.
Ásɛ n baah di he nɛɛ kohona he serewe laa ta.
He haahna ɛɛ ɛ luhaahnaa, ásɛ he bii ɡe berɛ bilalbii.
A hiah n nɛra baa ɛ he bini bane nɔ bɛlbwa he kemɔ suuɡa aa, he bɛ a nee kpɔ dawɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ kemɛ suuɡa yon dɛɛ ɛ la.
He lɛ he dɔŋ yal cheɡ awɔba aa, berɛ o kon tɛo mɔɔ wee le harɛ, o ɡboo ken ɛ yal waa dɔa dɛ́ kpɔ tɔ.
A ba ɡɛ naa, bɔkwaa wɛɛ ba dɔe dɛ́ kpɔ tɔ chɔɔ?
O wio no men Korowii aa, mɛɛ no o bee, dɛ́ chao dɛkalkɛ n dɔ tedoma dɛ tɛ nɛra.
He bɛ nɛnhɛlwobol bol yaɡɛ men Korowii kɛɛ dɛ́ taah he harɛ nomoa.
Hé kpɔ he mea ne sen kɛɛ ɔleve noo ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ saŋ aa chɛa ta.
Hé lawɛ he bibanloɡla ba tɛ mɛ.
Gɛ tentenee chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ he nae ne peera bwa ta.
Hé ɡel a do a nyare be yawanyoa, ásɛ tɔpenuatoro ta la, hé kpɔa ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.
A chɛ kɛ hé ɛ n nɛra haa do ɡoroŋ.
Anomanta, he bɛ ol kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡaa aa kpoo la dɛɛ chwe.
Nyootenaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔa tɛ.”
Kasinteŋ ne waa aa wera Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “He bɛ waa haa wola a bini jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
He bɛ dansewea di cha nɛnchɔɡe.
He bɛ nɛndamanta nɛɛ teŋɛ dɛ́ ɡee ɛ wechɔɡa.
He dɛ di waane danseɛ kɔɔto aa, he bɛ nɛndamanta nɛɛ teŋɛ dɛ́ berɛ waa la sie.
He bɛ nomɛl nyae waa koh dɛ́ sune o nɛɛ kɔɔto.
He na he dɔm nao kɛɛ keeɡo o yeŋe jo dɛɛ kaa laa, hé takapɔ dɛ́ lawɔ ba tɛo.
He na he dɔŋ waa haeh keeɡo o chole bone ɛɡɛ o nɛ aa, he bɛ on ɡarɛ ta kaa.
He takapɔ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ chao.
He bɛ nɛn nyae waa koh dɛ́ pao bolchɔɡe kɔɔto.
He bɛ nyosone teŋe dawɛ nɛn nɛ.
He bɛ nɛn waa wola waane bini jemɛ, kɛɛ nɛn o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ bolchɔɡe pa dɛ́ kpoo.
Maa nomɛlbwa waa di bolchɔɡe la bwaraa kpɔ kɛo.
He bɛ nɛn sen dɛɛ yawɛ, nɛn sen yawa dɛ tɔ nɛra baa dɛ bol waa la sie, dɛɛ ɡole nɛn o wa aa toɡra waa sie.
He bɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra hɔhɔrɔwa dɛɛ ɛ.
He ɡbabir jemɛ ɡɛ hɔɔh wa aa doa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ɡɛɛ he faa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra Ijipt harɛ ta.
Ona Tɔpere Mmarare Bene anumɛlee chɛ kɛ hé parɛ dɛ́ kpɔ he kooni kondikwa, kɛ bennuanɛ ta te, hé ɡel harɛ la chɔ, he bɛ on parɛ.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel nyaara baa lɔ he bini la ɡe dɔ anɔ la aa lee bela la di, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini ola ɡe dɔ a kar dɛ́ di.
Hé ɛ ɡɛ tenten he daa kooni nɔna ne ɔleve daa nɔna bwa ta.
Tɔpera anumɛlee hé dɔ kɛ he ɛ toma, kɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee ta te, he bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ, ásɛ he nabala ne keeɡore ne nɛndɔɔla baa lol ba he deremi dɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ɡe won dɔ bɔr onɛ.
Hé do sie dɛ́ ɛ wobɛlbwa maa bol he be nɔ.
He bɛ voɡare dɛɛ tomɛ.
He bɛ ɡel ba no a sɔna kwaraa he nyoo.
Benanyoa Tɔpejena atoro ane wa Hé di tɔpejena atoro benanyoa bɛlbwa n sɔn ta.
Hé di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole A Ta Tɔpejen la.
Tɔpera anuanɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ hé di paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta ɡɛ maa do heyaa la.
Hé di tɔpejen nɔ tɔpera maa lea cheɡ tɛ heyaa ta Abib korobie la ta, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ korobie la taa he le Ijipt harɛ ta.
Bɛlbwa bɛ nɔŋɡbala kpɔ ba n sie.
Hé di Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen la he koo kondikonloɡla ne.
Hé di Koo Kondikwaa Nyoa Boara Tɔpejen la, benanyoa la aa ba kaa o jaɡa he yon boa he kooni kondikwaa bwa nyoa ba cheɡ dem la ta.
Kera atoroo chɛ kɛ baa bɛlbwa ba men Nemenɛ Korowii sie benanyoa bɛlbwa ɡɛ tɔpejena nɔ ta, dɛ́ ba tom mɛ.
He bɛ komɛlbwa baa kpo ɛ saraha chal kpɔ ja komɛlbwa iisi aa lɔ o ta tɛ mɛ.
Ola baa kpoora n tɔpejena ta noorare ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé cheɡa tɔɔ per a ta.
Hé kpɔ he koo kondikonloɡla ba men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la Dea.
He bɛ bombie daa o nya elnee ne.
Nyobaɡa ne webaɡla ane wa Hɛ́ɛ no, n dɛ tomɛ n nyundua torome ó tɔ he sie dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ, dɛ́ ba he ne bela maa kwaara tɛ heya.
Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no wobɛlbwa waa bol he be.
He bɛ lwɛmkpeɡ ɛ, he ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ aa, waa he bwaraa kpɔ kɛ heya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee chiɡ n naa ta.
Dɛ he cheɡ deŋne o be kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la maa bola bwa naa, mɛɛ hah he dɔmaa, n ne baa jo ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
N nyundua torome ɛɛ tɔ he siee, dɛ́ ba he ne Amɔre ne Hiti, ne Pɛrɛs ne Keenan ne Hivi, dɛ Jebus tena harɛ ta.
Mɛɛ kpo ba bwaa harɛ la ta.
He bɛ ba voɡare dɛɛ tomɛ a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ ba we-ɛɛla taa.
Hé paɡre a ne ba bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura la bwa burbur ken.
Dɛ hɛɛ teŋɔ dɛɛ tomɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ nɔɔ yaa, mɛɛ swee heyaa andɛɛɡaa he kondikwa ne he neerare dɛ weela bwa ta.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa har ta kɛɛ dɛ ɛ hambara he harɛ la ta.
Mɛɛ tɛ heyaa mkpajaŋ tentenee.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ɔmee kohona chole he dɔma nɛ, ásɛ harɛ bɛlbwa ta tena haa ka chem ba bwa wili.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma bwa berɛ habɔɔ, dɛ́ chwa kaa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo jeŋibotoola tɔ he sie, dɛ́ doŋi Hivi ne Keenan dɛ Hiti tena le he ŋwɛnɛre ta.
Benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ɡbo ta laa mɛɛ ba ba doŋa, dɛkalkɛ a ba ɡɛ naa, harɛ la dɛ ba pɛɛ chɔe, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa warɛ he nɛ.
Tama tamaa mɛɛ ba ba doŋa le he sie ka tel kɛŋɔ haa ba warɛ kohona, dɛ́ won kpɔ harɛ la.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he jwɛh le Mposwɛm la ta ka le Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ka le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ kaa Yufretis Moo la ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ la ta bela laanee do he nɔn ta, ásɛ he doŋ ba le he sie.
Hé ne ban, kɛɛ ba voɡa bɛ fɔo bɛlbwa fɔwɛ.
He bɛ ɡel ba so he harɛ la ta, ásɛ a che ba nɛɛ he ba ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa, dɛkalkɛ ba voɡare toma la ɛɛ lawɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ baa harɛ heyaa bela ken.”
Korowii ne o nɛra fɔo baa fɔwa wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “He ne Arɔn ne Nadab ne Abihu dɛ Israel nomonome fifraanuanɛ la teeh bwe ba n be.
Hé che bojaŋ tama dɛɛ tom mɛ.
Hen Mosis ɡbosoroo chɛ kɛŋɔ he ba n jwɛh, ba te laa.
Bɛ ɡel Israel tena kar la bɛlbwa teeh ŋɔ wɛɛ ba n bee.” Mosis aa la nɛra la be dɛ ka bol Korowii waa ne o Mmarare bwa ba be la, ba bwa kpɔ taa beŋkpoŋ sɛh ŋɔ, “Wobɛlbwa Korowii aa bol la, yaa ɛɔ.” Mosis chwerɛ komɛlbwa Korowii aa bola.
Tɔ aa dɛ per chɔmbibii la, o iro dɛ kwaa saraha kon tɛ Korowii bwe la lɔɡa, dɛ paaɡe bwea fi dɛ anɛ a che tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la.
Asɛ o tomɛ Israel bonɔɔna ba ka fuh kwaa ɛ saraha, dɛ kpoo nabali ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛo.
Mosis kpɔ kwaa la chale la pera do loɡa bini, asɛ dɛ kpɔ a kar la merɛ saraha kon la ta.
Ate, dɛ kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Tɔn la kure baɡle nɛra la.
Ba bwa sɛh ŋɔ, “Yáa ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii aa ŋɔa laanee, yaa dɛɛ teŋɛ a taa.” Belaa o berɛ kpɔ chal la merɛ nɛra la nɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Chal nɔɔ ɡela fɔo he ne Korowii aa fɔwa dɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta la won che tɛ heya.” Ate, Mosis ne Arɔn ne Nadab dɛ Abihu ne Israel nomonome fifraanuanɛ la bwa teeh kaa bwe la doa, dɛ ka na Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la.
Harɛ waa cheɡɛ o ta la ɛ bobɛl baa mao bwea ne o ir nyundua, dɛ do ɡereŋ kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡe baa dɛ yerɔ safaaya la, dɛ ɛ burum kɛŋɔ nyundua ken.
Kɛ Korowii ta Israel nomonome la wobɛlbwa ɛɛ.
Ba na Korowii dɛ ta so le dɛ di kwaa dɛ nyɔ sen. Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Teeh ba bwe nɔ doa, dɛ́ ba soŋni n be bonɔ.
Mɛɛ tɛɛ bwepɛle maa chwerɛ me Mmarare haa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta, ásɛ nɛra la ka hweli dɛ́ jemɛ waa maa do ba a ta.” Ate, Mosis ne Josua waa dɛ chao la kpɔ ba te le kaa Korowii be bwe la doa.
Mosis aa dɛ ba lee kaa la o ŋɔ nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ kpa yaa bonɔ ka tel kɛŋɔ yaa berɛ ba he be.
Arɔn ne Hur aa lɔ he be nɔ, hé bini bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, hé kpɔ la ba be.” Mosis aa dɛ teeh Sinai Bwejen la, bam baa bɔle o bwa, asɛ Korowii jirima tɔ o bwa.
Tɔpera anumɛl dɛ bam la ta bɔle bwe la bwa ɡɛ, asɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee ta la, Korowii bol waa le bam la ta dɛ yerɛ Mosis.
Israel tena te be la, Korowii jirima aa lɔ bwejen la doa la do kɛŋɔ nii aa won kwaa chɔɡa kohona la ken.
Mosis jo bam la bini dɛ teeh kaa bwejen la doa.
O soɡe bela tɔpera fifraanaarɛ chɔɔ ne jwaana.
Saraha kwaa baa ɛa Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Israel tena la be bɛ́lbwa ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.
Henee chɛ kɛ he lɛ saraha kwaa la ɡɛ bɛlbwa bambile aa lawa kɛ ó kpɔ tɛ mɛ.
Koŋkɛɛla haa lɛ le ba be laanee suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ ayaawa, ne jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm ne yadɛɛɡa ampoŋa dɛ booh pona, ne pebala tɔne baa doa konswɛɛma, ne mpo nae tɔne dɛ akaasia daa, ne ɔleve noo baa kpɔ do kandea ta, ne konsɔɔhsoma baa kpɔ koo noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do nɛn sɔfore ta, ne anɔ la baa kpɔ koo daawiile ta dɛ́ fuah, ne bwedɛɛɡa ane baa dɛ yera onis, ne anɔ la baa kpɔ dawɛ Sɔfonomoa batakaarebora efɔd la vaama ta, dɛ kon waa dawɛ o bambile ta la ta.
Gel ba ɛ Tɛnte Dea waa do ɡoroŋ tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n ba so ba bini.
Gɛ maa baɡle heyaa hé ɛ Tɛnte Dea ne o dor ne o bini kwaara la, ɡɛ tentenee chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛo.
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka Hé kpɔ akaasia daa kwaa Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka o jaŋne ka tama ó ɛ naɡale anaarɛ, o paɡri ɡwaa naɡale anɛ, ásɛ o daŋa ɡe ɡwaa naɡale anɛ.
Hé kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛ o bini ne o baŋ bwa, dɛ́ berɛ ɛ suuɡaswɛm bar o nyoo.
Ɛ suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡa ken, dɛ́ kpɔ marɛ o nakpale anaarɛ la ta, anɛ do o baŋ bɛl, ásɛ anɛ ɡe do baŋ bɛl.
Kpɔ akaasia kwaa dajaŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara.
Kpɔ daa la su nɔnloɡa aa lɔ Daka la baŋne anɛ la ta bá won kpɔ dɛɛ cheo.
Daa la chɛ kɛŋɔ á den do nɔnloɡa la ta, a ta chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa laa kpɔ.
Ásɛ he kpɔ bwepɛle anɛ me Mmarare la aa dawɛ a ta mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛɛ la, do Daka la bini.
Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛ daka la tɔ bela maa ba cheme heyaa dɛ kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛ heyaa la, o jaŋne ka tama ó ɛ naɡale anaarɛ, ásɛ o paɡri ɡe ɡwaa naɡale anɛ.
Berɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa Kerobim la do o tɔ la nyoo.
Kerobim la beŋkpoŋ chɔŋɛ o baŋ bɛl, ásɛ bɛl ɡe do baŋ bɛl.
Kombeŋkpoŋii chɛ kɛ he kpɔ kwaa Kerobim la ne daka la tɔ la bwa.
Kerobim la chɛ kɛŋɔ á sie ɡba dɔŋa daka la doa, a kena paɡri kaa nyundua dɛɛ cheme dɔŋa dɛɛ tɔ o tɔ la ta.
Kpɔ bwepɛle anɛ maa kpɔ tɛɛ la do Daka la bini dɛ́ kpɔ o tɔ la tɔ.
N ne he Danseɛ Daka la doa Kerobim la baah taa mɛɛ ba he chema, dɛ́ kpɔ me Mmarare bwa tɛɛ hé kpɔ tɛ Israel tena.
Teebur baa kpɔ paanoo dawɛ o ta Korowii sie Kpɔ akaasia daa kwaa teebur, dɛ́ ɡel o jaŋne ɛ naɡale atoro, o paɡri ɛ naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama, ásɛ o daŋa ɡe ka tama ó ɡwaa naɡale anɛ.
Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛ o bwa, dɛ́ berɛ ɛ ane bar o nyoo.
Ɛ kon o paɡri del aa do kɛŋɔ nɔmpaa del baro, dɛ́ ɛ suuɡaswɛm dawɛ o ɡe ta bar.
Ɛ suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡa anaarɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ marɛ o loŋkoni ta o nakpale la bɔr bela.
Nɔnloɡa la chɛ kɛŋɔ á do kon waa bar o nyoo la ta, bá won kpɔ dajaŋa su a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ cheo.
Kpɔ akaasia kwaa dajaŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara bá kpɔ dɛɛ che teebur la.
Berɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten kwaa loɡbakorɔre ne dompaane, ne numoli dɛ loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ fuɡe sen saraha kwaa la.
Kpɔ paanoo haa kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ la dɛɛ dawɛ teebur nɔ ta saŋ bɛlbwa.
Kandea daa wa Berɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten loɡɛ kandea da.
Le o mun ta kaa o nyundua chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ suuɡaswɛm beŋkpoŋ.
Ɛ o numoli á do kɛŋɔ daa fee yon pili la, dɛ́ ɛ anɔ la aa jaa bwa do kandea daa la ta suuɡaswɛm beŋkpoŋ la ne.
Ɛo ó dɔ kpala anumɛl.
Atoro do baŋ bɛl ásɛ atoro ɡe do baŋ bɛl.
Numoli do kɛŋɔ daa baa dɛ yerɔ almɔn fee dɛ ɛ atotoro, dɛ́ do kpale bɛlbwa ta.
Ásɛ anaarɛ ɡe do kandea daa la tenten ta.
Ɛ anɔ la aa wola sie pile mɔɔ la beŋkpoŋ do kpala anɛ aa tɔ sie chenchema la lɔɡa, dɛ́ do bɛl kpala anɛ aa teŋa nɛɛ chenchema la lɔɡa, dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ tenten do kpala anɛ aa teŋa tooro la ɡe chenchema la lɔɡa.
Á bwa ɛ kpala anumɛl.
Kandea daa la ne o kpala ne o fee la bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ suuɡaswɛm beŋkpoŋ la kwaara.
Ásɛ dɛ ɛ kandere anuanɛ dɛ́ kpɔa chɔŋre kandea daa la ta aa chaah bela o sie aa chaɡa.
O kon baa kpɔ dɛɛ fee ŋwɛn la doŋa ne o loɡbakorɔre bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ á ɛ suuɡaswɛm tenten.
Suuɡaswɛm o tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛɛ chɛ kɛ he kpɔ kwaa kandea daa la ne o konjeɡre bwa.
Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɛa ɡɛ tenten maa baɡle bwejen la doa la.”
Korowii Tɛnte Dea Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ jisepondɛɛɡe ne jiseburum ne jisekɔl dɛ jiseswɛm sɔh pateesanre fi, dɛ́ ɡel nɛn waa dɔ kwaa sɔeh wejema ɛ Kerobim dawɛ a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa Tɛnte Dea waa ɛ n dobɔr tɛ mɛ.
Pateesanre la bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ á ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
A jaŋne ɛ naɡale fifraanaarɛ dɛ anɛ, ásɛ a paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale anumɛl.
Nyarɛ a bini anue pɛ dɔŋa, ásɛ dɛ ɛ anue la ɡɛ tenten.
Kpɔ yakwara waa ɛ burum, dɛ́ ɛ tora do pateesanre anue baa nyara pɛ la bɛl nyoa, ásɛ dɛ ɛ ane do onɔ la ɡe nyoa ta.
Tora fifraanuee chɛ kɛ he do baŋ bɛl ta, ásɛ dɛ berɛ do tora fifraanue onɔ la ɡe ta a bwa sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa.
Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ kwaa fifraanue haa doa tora a sie aa chaɡɛ dɔŋa la pɛ, á ɡel n Tɛnte Dea la bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Kpɔ booh pona sɔh pateesanre dɛ́ kpɔ bɔle n Tɛnte Dea, a bwa ɛ pateesanre fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
A ɡɛ pateesanre fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ la bwa chɛ kɛ á ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
A jaŋne ɛ naɡale fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue, a paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale anumɛl.
Kpɔ pateesanre la anue pɛ dɔŋa á ɛ beŋkpoŋ, ásɛ dɛ pɛ anumɛl la kar la ɡe á ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Kpɛwɛ pateesan numɛlte la ó do Tɛnte Dea la doonyoa bela.
Do tora fifraanue pateesan baa nyara pɛ dɔŋa la baŋ bɛl ta, ásɛ dɛ berɛ do tora fifraanue onɔ la ɡe ta ɡɛ tenten.
Berɛ kpɔ ayaawa ɛ kwaa fifraanue baa doa tora, a sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa la pɛ, á ɡel Tɛnte Dea la bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Kɛ pateesan baa kpɛwɔ la chɛ kɛ ó vah n Tɛnte Dea la habɔɔ.
Pateesanre la baa kpɔ booh pona sɔah la jaŋne ɛɛ ɛ naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama dɛ ɡwaa anɔ la baŋre anɛ la bwa ta.
Anɔ la aa ɡwaa bwa laanee dɛ́ saɡɛ dɛ́ tɔ n Tɛnte Dea la.
Kpɔ pebal tɔne baa doa konswɛɛma tɔ tɛnte la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne bɔlo ja.
Kpɔ akaasia daa ɛ dachiɡri dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa n Tɛnte Dea la.
Dachiɡe bɛlbwa jaŋne chɛ kɛ ó ɛ naɡale fi dɛ anue, ásɛ o bare ɡe ka tama ó ɡwaa naɡale anɛ, dɛ́ sɛh o mun, ó dɔ naa anɛ ásɛ a bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛ daa aa lɔ n Tɛnte Dea la bɛlbwa ta.
Ɛ dachiɡri fifraanɛ paaɡe o weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera, ásɛ dɛ ɛ suuɡapoŋa loɡa fifraanaarɛ do a mune, o nakpale anɛ la bɛlbwa dɔ beŋkpoŋ.
Berɛ paaɡe dachiɡri fifraanɛ ɡe o weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera, dɛ́ ɛ suuɡapoŋa loɡa fifraanaarɛ do a mune.
O nakpale anɛ la bɛlbwa dɔ beŋkpoŋ.
Paaɡe dachiɡri anumɛl o wee cholibɔr bela, ásɛ dɛ paaɡe dachiɡri anɛ o loŋkoni anɛ ta, wee cholibɔr bela.
O loŋkoni anɛ dachiɡri nɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa lawɛ o dɔŋ le mun ta, dɛ́ ka su nɔnloɡ beŋkpoŋ ta nyundua.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛ anɛ la bwa.
Gɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel dachiɡri la ɛ anuatoro ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa fi dɛ anumɛl, ásɛ suuɡapoŋa loɡa anɛ do daa bɛlbwa mun ta.
Berɛ kpɔ akaasia daa ɛ doli anue dawɛ dachiɡri la aa lɔ n Tɛnte Dea la baŋ bɛl ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ anue dawɛ dachiɡri aa lɔ baŋ bɛl ɡe ta, ásɛ anue ɡe dawɛ dachiɡri aa lɔ wee cholibɔr baŋ bɛl la ɡe ta.
Dola haa dawɔ baah ta la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó won le o baŋ bɛl ba kaa baŋ bɛl nyoa ta.
Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ dachiɡri la bwara, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɛ nɔnloɡa á lawɛ doli la kpoŋe.
Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ doli la ɡe.
Gɛ maa chaɡle bwejen la doa laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ he baŋre n Tɛnte Dea la.
Gel nɛn waa dɔ kwaa nyara wejema kpɔ jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm dɛ jisepondɛɛɡe nyarɛ pateesan, dɛ́ ɡel nɛn waa jemɛ kwaa sɔeh ɛ Kerobim dawɛ o ta.
Kpɔ saɡɛ suuɡaswɛm bune aa paaɡe akaasia daa anaarɛ haa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara a ta su suuɡapoŋa loɡa ta la ta.
Kpɔ paateesan la saɡɛ bune la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ o habɔɔ.
Pateesan laanee dɛ́ pere Boɡoroŋ la le Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ta.
Kpɔ N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ waa ɛ bela maa lole dɛ kpɔ he wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ heyaa la tɔ o ta Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ta.
Kpɔ teebur la ba cheɡ pateesan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera n Tɛnte Dea la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ kandea daa la ɡe cheɡ o baŋ bɛl weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Korowii Tɛnte Dea doonyoa bela la, kpɔ jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm dɛ jisepondɛɛɡe nyarɛ pateesan, dɛ́ ɡel nɛn waa dɔ kwaa sɔeh wejema ɛ kwaa dawɛ o ta, dɛ́ kpɔ saɡɛ o ta.
Ɛ suuɡaswɛm bune aa lawɛ pateesan nɔ kpoŋe, dɛ́ ɛ akaasia dachiɡri anue haa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, ásɛ dɛ ɛ ayaawa loɡa anue haa kpɔ do a mune ta.”
Kon baa fuh saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ akaasia daa kwaa kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
Gel o jaŋne ne o paɡri bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
O jaŋne ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, o paɡri ɡe naɡale anuanɛ ne tama.
O daŋa ɡe ɛ naɡale anaarɛ ne tama.
Sɛh o loŋkoni anaarɛ la bwa á kaa nyundua tama kɛŋɔ nyeɡlare ken.
Daa beŋkpoŋii chɛ kɛ he kpɔ ɛ saraha kon la ne o nyeɡlare bwa, kpɔ ayaawa ɛ o bwara.
Kpɔ ayaawa ɛ o kwaa bwa, o loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ pa o tɔɔ, ne soofire ne loɡa baa do chal kɛɛ nee a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o ta, ne bune baa kpɔ toh ola dɛ kwaa baa kpɔ dɛɛ buh nii.
Kpɔ ayaawa ɛ kafola do o ta, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ ane ɛ nɔnloɡa do o baŋne anaarɛ bwa ta.
Kpɔ do saraha kon la bini, o baah ta.
Kpɔ akaasia daa ɛ dajaŋa haa kpɔ dɛɛ cheo, dɛ́ kpɔ ayaawa ɛ a bwara.
Kpɔ daa la su nɔnloɡa aa lɔ saraha kon la baŋne anɛ la ta bá kpɔ dɛɛ cheo.
Daa chɛ kɛ he kpɔ kwaa saraha kon la, dɛ́ ɡel o bini chɔ bɔɔ ɡɛ tenten maa chaɡle bwejen la doa la.
Korowii Tɛnte Dea dembaah wa Ɛ dembaah ja n Tɛnte Dea la ta dɛ́ keo.
O weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera bela jaŋne ɛ naɡale lafa fifraanue, ásɛ dɛ dɔ pateesanre baa kpɔ jisepondɛɛɡe sɔah kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dachiɡri la ɛ fifraanɛ, ayaawa loɡa fifraanɛ do a mune ta.
Bune aa lawɛ dachiɡri la kpoŋe la bwa chɛ kɛ he kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ɛ a bwara.
O weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera la ɡe chɛ kɛ o jaŋne ɛ naɡale lafa fifraanue, dɛ́ dɔ pateesanre ásɛ o dachiɡri ɛ fifraanɛ ayaawa loɡa do a mune ta.
Bune aa lawɛ dachiɡri la kpoŋe la chɛ kɛ he kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ɛ a bwara.
Dembaah wee cholibɔr pera chɛ kɛŋɔ o paɡri ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue dɛ́ dɔ pateesanre, ásɛ dɛ dɔ dachiɡri fi ayaawa loɡa fi do a mune ta.
Dembaah wee leebɔr ɡe chɛ kɛŋɔ o paɡri ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.
Pateesanre a jaŋne aa ka tama a ɛ naɡale fifraanɛ dɛ atoro laanee chɛ kɛ a do doonyoa baŋ bɛl ta, ásɛ dachiɡri la ɡe ɛ atoro, ásɛ ayaawa loɡa atoro do a mune ta.
Ásɛ pateesanre a jaŋne aa ka tama á ɛ naɡale fifraanɛ dɛ atoro ɡe do o baŋ bɛl, ásɛ dachiɡri la ɛ atoro ayaawa loɡa atoro do a mune ta.
Dembaah doonyoa bela la chɛ kɛ ó dɔ pateesan o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale fifraatoro, bá kpɔ jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm dɛ jisepondɛɛɡe sɔɔh.
Ásɛ nɛn waa dɔ kwaa nyara wejema ɛa dawɛ a ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔ dachiɡri anaarɛ loɡa anaarɛ do a mune ta.
Dembaah dachiɡri la bwa chɛ kɛ á dɔ suuɡapoŋ kwaa baa kpɔa lawa kpoŋe, ásɛ ayaawa loɡa do a mune ta.
Dembaah la jaŋne chɛ kɛ ó ɛ naɡale lafa fifraanue, ásɛ o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.
O pateesanre chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ jisedɛɛɡa sɔah a nyundua kaala ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, ásɛ o dachiɡri loɡa la bwa ɛ ayaawa baa kpɔa ɛa.
N Tɛnte Dea la bini kwaa kar aa jaa ba kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ o bini toma ne kwaa baa kpɔa baŋro, ne anɔ la baa kpɔa baŋre dembaah bela bwa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ ayaawa ɛa.
Noo baa kpɔ do kandea daa ta Do Israel tena bá kpɔ ɔleve nodɛɛɡa baa harama ba tɛɛ he do numoli aa lɔ kandea daa la ta la ta, ásɛ a won hɔe dɛ bɛ dɛɛ dime bwa.
N Dea Cheremibɔr pateesan waa lɔ N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la habɔɔ la, Arɔn ne o bibaalaa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá nyiŋi kandere la ta aa hɔ Korowii sie le jɔmɔra ba le chɔɔ bwa.
Gɛ waa nɔ chɛ kɛ á ɛ Mmara dɛ́ chɔ le tɛ Israel tena ne ba naanar baa ka ba bwa.”
Sɔfore laala wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Gel bá kpɔ he dɔɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala Nadab ne Abihu ne Eliasa dɛ Itama le Israel tena bini, ásɛ ba ɛ sɔfore dɛɛ tom mɛ.
Nyarɛ laala aa do ɡoroŋ tɛ Arɔn ó dɔ jirima ne duure.
Ŋɔ baala bwa maa tɛɛ ba kwaa nyara wejema la be ŋɔ, ba nyarɛ laala baa kpɔ do Arɔn baa kpɔ doo sɔfore dii ta, ásɛ o won dɛɛ tom mɛ kɛ sɔfo.
Laala haa nyarɛ laanee, kon waa dawɛ o bambile ta ne batakaarebora, ne batakaarejaŋ ne onɔ la baa sɔɔh ó do mun ta, ne yal baa kpɔ vɔwɛ nyu dɛ kiriso waa kpɔ dɛɛ vɔwɛ chara.
Gɛ laala aa do ɡoroŋ nɔɔ baa ba nyara tɛ he dɔɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala, ásɛ ba ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ mɛ kɛ sɔfore.
Gel ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne jiseburum ne jisekɔl, ne jiseswɛm dɛ jisepondɛɛɡe ɛa.
Sɔfonomoa batakaarebora efɔd Batakaarebora efɔd la, ɡel nɛn waa dɔ kwaa ɛɛ wejema kpɔ suuɡaswɛm, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm ne jisepondɛɛɡe ɛo.
Bá kpɔ yal la pera nyarɛ nɔɔra á lawɛ baŋre anɛ habɔɔ yal la, dɛ́ kpɔ o vaama ta ba lawɛ o sie yal á pɛ dɔŋa.
O batakaare nyunduabɔr la chɛ kɛ ó do kɛ batakaare la ɡbaɡba bá nyara pɛ.
Nɛn waa dɔ kwaa nyara wejema la kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm dɛ jisepondɛɛɡe la ɛo.
Kpɔ onis bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa anɛ, ásɛ dɛ chwerɛ Jekɔb bibaala sɔna dawɛ a ta.
Gɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ lola binii chɛ kɛŋɔ he chwera dawɛ.
Banumɛl sɔna dɛ do beŋkpoŋ ta, ásɛ banumɛl ɡe sɔna do bɛl ɡe ta.
Gɛ nɛn waa dɔ a wejema aa dɛ ɛa laanee chɛ kɛ he ɛ Israel bii sɔna la dawɛ bwe la ta.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ cheɡ suuɡaswɛm kwaa ta a lawa kpoŋe, dɛ́ lawa pɛ o batakaare la vam nyuune ta dɛ́ che tɛ Israel deene.
Gɛɛ sɔna nɔ ɛɛ ba Arɔn vaama ta dawa men Korowii sie, ń kpɔ dɛɛ lii ba wa.
Ɛ bwedɛɛɡa cheɡbɔra suuɡaswɛm kwaa ta a lawa kpoŋe, ne suuɡaswɛm tenten jɔɡrɔre anɛ aa ɡaɡre dɔŋa dɛ́ do kɛ ŋwɛn ken, dɛ́ kpɔ lawɛ bwedɛɛɡa cheɡbɔra la ta.
Sɔfonomoa kon waa dɛ dawɛ bambile ta Ɛ kon waa dawɛ Sɔfonomoa la bambile ta, ó kpɔ dɛɛ jemɛ waa aa wera dɛɛ le Korowii be, nɛn waa dɔ o wejemaa chɛ kɛ ó ɛo.
Ɛo kɛŋɔ batakaarebora efɔd la siwi baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne jiseburum ne jisekɔl ne jiseswɛm dɛ jisepondɛɛɡe sɔɔh la ken.
A chɛ kɛ he kpɛwɔ kera anɛ o jaŋne ne o paɡri bwa ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
O jaŋne ɛ nɔmpaa del o paɡri ɡe ɡɛ.
Bil bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bɔre anaarɛ á dawɛ o ta.
Anɔ la aa tɔ sie la chɛ kɛŋɔ á ɛ bwe bɛl waa swɛɛra peihpeih baa yerɔ rubi, ne bweswɛm bɛl waa do kɛŋɔ solmen baa yerɔ topas, dɛ bwelwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ bɛrel.
Anɔ la aa teŋa nɛɛ la ɛ bwe burum baa dɛ yerɔ tɛɛkoes, ne bwe waa ɛ burum kohona baa yerɔ safaaya, dɛ bwe waa ɛ onlwɛɛ dɛ do ɡereŋ baa yerɔ ɛmeral.
Toorote la ɡe ɛ bwe burum baa dɛ yerɔ jansɛf, ne bwe waa dɛ nyɛɡle baa yerɔ aɡat, dɛ bwekɔl baa dɛ yerɔ ametes.
Naarɛte la ɛ bwe waa ɛ solmen dɛɛ nyɛɡle baa yerɔ kresolet, ne bwelwɛɛ onis dɛ bwelwɛɛ waa dɛ nyɛɡle baa yerɔ jasepa.
Cheɡa suuɡaswɛm kwaa la ta á lawa kpoŋe.
A bwa ɛ bwea fi dɛ anɛ, beŋkpoŋ che tɛ Jekɔb bibaala la bɛlbwa.
Ɛ bɛlbwa sɔn dawɛ ó che tɛ o dea.
Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛ jɔɡrɔre dɛ́ ŋwɛɛra kɛŋɔ ŋwɛn ken kon waa dɛ dawɛ o bambile ta la ta.
Dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ nɔnloɡa do o loŋkoni anɛ ta.
Suuɡaswɛm jɔɡrɔre anɛ la, kpɔa do nɔnloɡa aa lɔ o loŋkoni ta la ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ jɔɡrɔre la nyoo kar la ɡe lawɛ cheɡbɔra anɛ la ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ ó lawɛ batakaarebora efɔd la vaama ta dɛɛ ba o siebɔr.
Berɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ nɔnloɡa anɛ do o loŋkoni aa lɔ o lɔɡa la bini dɛ bɛne batakaarebora efɔd la.
Berɛ ɛ suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa anɛ, dɛ́ kpɔa lawɛ o nɔɔra la harɛbɔr, dɛ bɛne bela baa nyara pɛ batakaarebora efɔd la nyunduabɔr.
Ŋwɛmburumee chɛ kɛŋɔ he kpɔ lawɛ nɔnloɡa aa lɔ kon waa dawɛ o bambile la ta dɛ́ ba nɔnloɡa aa lɔ o batakaarebora efɔd la ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ o bɛ batakaare la ta ba le.
Saŋ bɛlbwa Arɔn aa jo Boɡoroŋ men Korowii sie la, Israel bii sɔna la ɛɛ dawɛ bambile kon la taa dɛɛ lii Korowii ba waa tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Berɛ kpɔ Urim ne Tumim la do kon waa dawɛ Arɔn bambile ta la bini saŋ bɛlbwa waa dɛɛ ba men Korowii sie.
Gɛɛ Arɔn ɛɛ ba ɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa waa dɛɛ ba men Korowii sie.
Sɔfore laala ane ɡe wa Batakaarejaŋ waa do ásɛ ombora la ɛɛ dawɛ o ta la, jiseburum ɡbosoroo nee chɛ kɛŋɔ he sɔɔh, ásɛ dɛ pere o baah ta ó ɛ o nyu bɔr.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ bá sɔh o nyu bɔr nyoa la bar kɛrɛdɛ o bɛ won kɛɛ.
Kpɔ jiseburum ne jisekɔl dɛ jiseswɛm nyarɛ kwaa aa do ɡuleɡule kɛŋɔ daa bɛl nɔna baa dɛ yera pɔmeɡranet do batakaare la nyoa bar, dɛ́ ɛ suuɡaswɛm dorɔŋre saɡre a baahna ta.
He do suuɡaswɛm dorɔŋre aa, dɛ he do konɡuleɡule la bɛl ɡe, ásɛ a do ɡɛ bar o nyoa cheme.
Arɔn aa baa ɛ sɔfore toma men Korowii sie laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do a ɡɛ batakaare nɔ.
O ba dɛ ba men Korowii sie Boɡoroŋ bela dɛ berɛ dɛɛ le aa, baa no dorɔŋre la sii, ásɛ Arɔn bɛ ba sewɛ.
Kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten kwaa kon waa do kpɛlɛntɛŋ dɛ́ ɛ dawɛ o ta ŋɔ, kon baa lea cheg tɛ korowii o do goroŋ.
Kpɔ ŋwɛmburum do o ta dɛ́ kpɔ ka vɔwɛ yal baa kpɔa vɔwɛ o nyu la ta, ásɛ o do ɡbɛrɛ la sie.
Wɛɛ dawɛ Arɔn tile taa ásɛ dɛ Israel tena kpɔ ba saraha kwaa bɛlbwa soo siwi ba tɛ mɛ dɛ ba koni a ta naa, bolchɔɡe la ba dawɛ Arɔn nɛ.
Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba o tile ta dawa saŋ bɛlbwa ásɛ n lɛ ba saraha kwaa la.
Kpɔ jisepondɛɛɡe sɔh batakaare waa doo mun ta ne o yal waa kpɔ vɔwɛ nyu la bwa.
Kɛ kiriso la te chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɔ kwaa nyara wejema nyarɛ dawɛ o ta.
Nyarɛ batakaare Arɔn aa doa mun ta la siwi ne kirisopaŋa, dɛ yal tɛ Arɔn bibaala bá kpɔ vɔwɛ ba nyuune, á tɛɛ ba jirima ne duure.
Haa kpɔ laala nɔ do he dɔɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala tonɛ la, hé fuɡe noo do ba nyuune ta dɛ́ kpɔ ba sɔfo toma do ba nɔn ta.
Ɛɛ ba bá do ɡoroŋ dɛ́ won dɛɛ ɛ n toma kɛŋɔ sɔfore.
Kpɔ yapondɛɛɡa nyarɛ yapeene baa doa mun ta, le chara ta ba hwie ta dɛɛ tɔ ba mune ta.
Arɔn ne o bibaala chɛ kɛŋɔ báa do laala nɔ saŋ bɛlbwa baa jo n Dea Cheremibɔr bela, kɛɛ dɛ la kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta dɛ́ ka tomɛ Boɡoroŋ bela, dɛ bɛ bolchɔɡe ba di dɛ́ serewe.
Gɛ waa nɔɔ chɛ kɛ á chɔ le tɛ Arɔn ne o naanar saŋ bɛlbwa.”
Sɔfore lee cheɡ bá do ɡoroŋ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kenii hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ le Arɔn ne o bibaala cheɡ bá do ɡoroŋ, ásɛ dɛɛ ɛ n toma kɛŋɔ sɔfore.
Lawɛ nabale ne pebala anɛ aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, kpɔ mea aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ iisi aa wola toole a ta ɛ paanoo, ne anɔ la baa do noo a ta dɛ anɔ la aa do kɛ biskeeti ken mɔɔ dɛ do noo a ta.
Kpɔa do wɛɡrɛ bini dɛ́ lawɛ kondɛɛre la ja dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala la ba n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela dɛ́ sɔ ba ne.
Do Arɔn o sɔfore laala la.
Batakaare waa doo mun ta ne batakaarejaŋ, ne batakaarebora efɔd la ne kon waa dawɛ o bambile ta.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ kiriso baa sɔh kwaa do o ta kɛrɛdɛ la vɔwɛ batakaarebora la ta.
Kpɔ ɡbɛrɛjen la piu, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kon waa do ɡoroŋ la vɔwɛ o ta.
Ásɛ dɛ fuɡe noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do ba sɔfore ta la ane do o nyu ta.
Do o bibaala la batakaarejaŋ la dɔŋa, dɛ́ pi ba ɡbɛrɛre.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ kirisore vɔwɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala la.
Ba ne ba naanar ɛɛ ɛ sɔfore, dɛɛ tom mɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ le Arɔn ne o bibaala dɛ́ kpɔ ba toma do ba nɔn ta.
Lawɛ nabale la ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela, ásɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nyu ta.
Teŋe o baŋa men Korowii sie n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bɔr bela.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ noni ɛ nao la chal la ane ɛ kwaa aa paaɡe saraha kon la loŋkoni ta la ta, dɛ́ fuɡe a kar ta saraha kon la mun ta.
Laa o noyal bwa ne o pwɛ bela waa wera, ne o kporombie anɛ la dɛ a noorare bwa kpɔ, dɛ́ fuah saraha kon la ta.
Nao la te bwa la, fuh o ol ne o tɔn ne o tea bini kwaa bwa bela baa soɡa la dahara.
O ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha kon.
Lawɛ pebal la beŋkpoŋ ba, ásɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nyu ta.
Teŋe o baŋa ásɛ dɛ ɛ o chal la ta saraha kon la baŋne bwa ta.
Mɔne a bini dɛ́ yaɡle o tea bini kwaa ne o nakpale, dɛ́ kpɔa ja o nyu ne anɔ la aa kaa la bwa ta.
Ásɛ dɛ fuh o bwa saraha kon la ta.
A ɛ saraha kon baa dɛ fuh o bwa o sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be.
Berɛ kpɔ penɛɛte la ɡe ba, ásɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nyu ta.
Teŋe o baŋa dɛ ɛ o chal la ane leɡe Arɔn ne o bibaala diɡ deŋna nyoo, ne ba diɡ nonibala dɛ ba diɡ nanibala ta.
Ásɛ dɛ ɛ chal la ta saraha kon la baŋne la bwa ta.
Berɛ kpɔ chal la aa lɔ saraha kon la ta la ane, ásɛ dɛ fuɡe noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do ba sɔfore ta la ane do Arɔn nyu ne o laala ta, dɛ́ berɛ do ane o bibaala la ɡe nyuune ta, dɛ́ ɛ merɛ ba ɡe laala ta.
Gɛɛ dɛ ɡel o ne o bibaala la ne ba laala bwa do ɡoroŋ.
Kpɔ pee la no ne anɔ la aa lɔ o muŋɡo ta bwa, ne o noyal ne o pwɛ bela waa wera, ne o kporombie anɛ ne noorare aa ja a ta bwa dɛ o nadiɡ hwi.
Kpɔ paanoo beŋkpoŋ le wɛɡrɛ baa do paanoo baa wola iisi a ta doe dɛ che men Korowii sie la bini ne paanoo baa do noo a ta mɔɔ dɛ wɔɔra ne biskeeti.
Kpɔa do Arɔn ne o bibaala nɔɔra ta, ásɛ ba ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa men Korowii sie.
Berɛ lɛ saraha kwaa la ba be, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ja anɔ la baa fuah la ta, dɛ́ fuah saraha kon la ta.
A ɛ saraha baa fuh a bwa a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be.
Haa kpɔ pebal la bambile dɛ kpɔ ɛ we-ɛɛle ba do Arɔn sɔfore toma ta tonɛ la, ɡɔɔro nyundua dɛ́ viiɡu men Korowii sie, ásɛ o berɛ he dibɔr.
Ɛ pebal ola la peri baa ɛ ane we-ɛɛle dɛ do Arɔn ne o bibaala sɔfore ta la a do ɡoroŋ.
O bambile baa ɡɔɔro nyundua dɛ viiɡu men Korowii sie la ne o hwii baa kpɔa ba la.
Anee ɛ dibɔra aa chɛ kɛŋɔ saŋ bɛlbwa Israel tena kpɔ baa tɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala.
A ɛ bɔra aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ ba tɛ men Korowii dɛ le deŋnesɔɔhna saraha kwaa ta.
