Ane lole dɛ uɡe dɛɛ di, kɛɛ a nafikoko ɡbo pere, ane ɡe lole a nafikoko pere kɛ aa kwaa uɡe dɛɛ di.
He bɛ an di.
Nyoɡma uɡe o kondikwa dɛ berɛ dɛɛ dia kɛ o nafikoko ta pere, waa were ne dii.
He bɛ aah di.
A lole kɛŋɔ o uɡo dɛ berɛ dɛɛ dia te, kɛ o nafikoko ta anɛ pere.
Waa were tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ he diu.
Chooma ɡe di kwa aa, o berɔ uɡa dɛɛ di, kɛ o nafikoko ta pere.
Waa were tɛ heyaa kɛ he di.
Parako ɡe aa were tɛ heyaa ne dii.
A lole kɛŋɔ o pere nafikoko, kɛ waa won kwaa uɡe dɛɛ di.
He bɛ nɔn kpɔ leɡe a ola a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dia.
A sewɔ kwaraa naa, he bɛ an leɡe.
Koŋkwaa aa lɔ nee bini ɡe la, hɛɛ won di anɔ la aa dɔ kena ne pɛɡa.
Pɛŋa aa lɔ nee bini dɛ ja anɔ la aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh te bɛlbwa aa wola kena ne pɛɡa dɔe la chɛ kɛ hé kia.
Aa chɛ kɛ he kia nomanta, he bɛ nɔn kpɔ leɡa a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dia.
Kwaa aa lɔ nee bini aa wola pɛɡa ne kena dɔe la te bɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kia.
Jumbii ane lole a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kia dɛ bɛ an dɛɛ di.
A ɡɛ jumbii nɔɔ kɔla ne kɔkɔsaki, ne ɛɡre ne a soo siwi bwa, ne ɡaahɡaah te bwa soo siwi, ne kwiu bwa soo siwi, ne jumbijen waa lɔ mpo ta dɛ kɔla te bwa soo siwi, ne kwiujeɡa ne seralɛŋhaah dɛ kwiujen, ne kwiu bwa soo siwi, ne anɔ la bwa aa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ kee, ne nyeŋɡboŋ ne bambaŋkɔɡre bwa soo siwi ne lalakpale dɛ jem.
Koŋɡaahla aa dɔ naa anaarɛ kɛɛ dɛ dawɛ la aa wera tɛ heya.
Hé kia.
Nemenɛ anɔ la aa dɛ jah ɡboo wera tɛ heya kɛ hé di.
A bini anɔ la haa di laanee, tontombɛ te bwa soo siwi, ne pom kɛɛ hɔɔhre.
Ate habɔɔ, koŋɡaahla aa dɔ naa anaarɛ dɛ dawɛ la te bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ hé kia.
Nomɛlbwa dɛ hɛlɛ a ta naa, o kah doŋa.
Bɛlbwa leɡe a lala kwaraa naa, o kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Bɛlbwa waa ka kpɔ a bɛlbwa lale la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó chɛɡɛ o laala.
O kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Ol bɛlbwa waa ɛ nafeate o nafikoko baah aa wola pere kɛrɛdɛ, kɛɛ waa wola berɛ uɡe kwaa dɛɛ dia la aa were tɛ heya ne dii.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡe a lala la kah doŋa.
Ola aa wola nafea tena ɛɛ dɛ dɔ nanie la aa were tɛ heya ne dii.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡe a lala la kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa kpɔ bɛl lale la, a chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala.
Dɛ naate kah doŋa ɡe ka tel jɔmɔra.
Aa were tɛ heya.
Ola ane ɡe lole aa wola were tɛ heyaa ne dii.
Ola ane kɛŋɔ damɡboŋri te bwa soo siwi, mare ne baah bɛlbwa soo siwi, ne ɡer ne taŋɡar ne deabie, ne sɛɡrɛbɛdom dɛ karaŋɡboŋa.
Anee ɛ ola aa dɛ huuh kɛɛ dɛɛ tuuɡi tea ta aa wola were tɛ heyaa ne dii.
Nomɛlbwa bɛl aa sewɛ o ka leɡo la, kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Dɛ a bini bɛl sewɔ dɛ le ba le komɛl waa do wer bɛlbwa ta naa, dɛ a ɡɛ kon la kah doŋa.
Dɛ daa ba kpɔ ɛo kɛɛ yal, kɛɛ oltɔn kɛɛ dɛ yakwara taa o le aa, o kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
A chɛ kɛ hé kpɔ do nee ta ásɛ jɔmɔra mɔɔ o berɛ do wer.
A bini bɛl le vii bini naa, komɛlbwa aa lɔ vii la bini la kah doŋa.
A chɛ kɛ hé paɡre vii la ɡe.
Kondikwaa bɛlbwa baa dia a ɡɛ vii nɔ bini nee bɛlbwa ane aa leɡa la, dɛ a kah doŋa.
Asɛ komɛlbwa aa ɛ nee kwaa dɛɛ jo nyoa la ɡe kah doŋa.
Komɛlbwa sese o ol aa leɡo la kah doŋa.
Dɛ kon baa dɛ mar nii o bini kɛɛ vii baa dɛ daa o ne kondikwa kwaraa yoo, a chɛ kɛ bá paɡre a bwa.
A ɛ kwaa doŋa aa lɔ a ta dɛ tɛ heya.
Dɛ nee nyuune ta kɛɛ kɔlɔŋ bini nee yaa, a ɡbo wer.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa leɡe kon la lale la, o kah doŋa.
Dɛ kon la lale leɡe kondwee aa, dɛ a ta wer, doŋa bɛlbwa toole a ta.
Kɛ dɛ ba kpɔ kondwee la senɛ nee ta, asɛ kon la lale la bɛl le a ta naa, dɛ aa were tɛ heyaa kpa.
Dɛ ol waa wera kɛ he diu la ɡee sewa aa, nomɛlbwa waa leɡe o lale la kah doŋa dɛ ka tel jɔmɔra.
Nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ konlale la ol la, a chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala.
Naate kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa ka kpɔ o lale la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala, o kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra ɡe.
Koŋkwaa bwa aa dɛ huuh kɛɛ dɛɛ tuuɡi tea ta la chɛ kɛ hé kia.
He bɛ an di.
Anɔ la aa dɛ huuh kɛɛ dɛɛ tuuɡi tea ta kɛɛ dɛ dɔ nakpale anaarɛ kɛɛ nakpale aa wara la bwa, hé kia.
He bɛ ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bɛlbwa di, dɛ́ ba kah doŋa.
He bɛ a nɛɛ che kɛɛ dɛ koh a wa, dɛ́ ba kah doŋa.
Hé do ɡoroŋ dɛkalkɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, n do ɡoroŋ.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta hé ba ɛ n nɛra, anomanta, hé do ɡoroŋ ɡɛ maa do ɡoroŋ la.
Mmarare aa chɔ le tɛ ola ne koŋkwaa aa lɔ nee ta ne anɔ la aa lɔ harɛ ta dɛɛ huuh, kɛɛ dɛɛ tuuɡi tea ta dɛ jumbii laanee la.
Hé pere kwaa aa wera ne dii le anɔ la aa wola were ne dii ta.
Ola ane lole dɛ do wer ne dii ane ɡe aa were ne dii.”
Doŋa laa dɛ́ kpɔ haah waa lola nɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ó ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Haah kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa laa, dɛ o kah doŋa tɔpera anuanɛ ɡɛ tenten o yon kah doŋa o bochɔɡa saŋ la.
Tɔpenuatoro wee la, bá teŋe bie la pen.
Doŋa ɛɛ do haah la nɛɛ tɔpera fifraatoro dɛ atoroo mɔɔ ba laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛ.
A ta chɛ kɛ ó leɡe komɛlbwa waa do ɡoroŋ, kɛɛ dɛ́ jo Korowii Dea bela ka tel kɛŋɔ doŋa bɛlbwa aa le o nɛɛ mɔɔ.
Dɛ bihaah ɡee o lolɛ aa, yawanyoa anɛɛ wɛɛ ba doŋa kaeh kɛŋɔ o bochɔɡa saŋ la.
Wɛɛ berɔ kah doŋa tɔpera fifraanumɛl dɛ anumɛl mɔɔ ba laa o doŋa la kpɔ o nɛ.
Tɔpere baa laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛɛ habɔɔ la, dɛ bibaalee kɛɛ bihaahnee yaa, haah la ɛɛ kpɔ pebie waa di benanyoa ba tɛ sɔfo n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela, ásɛ o kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah tɛ men Korowii, kɛɛ dɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ɡe yaa, ó kpɔ borɔnoma kɛɛ kulukuku ba.
Sɔfo la ɛɛ kpɔ naate saraha kwaa laanee ba n sie, dɛ́ ba fuah soŋe o wechɔɡa tɛo, ásɛ o chal aa fuɡo doŋa la bwa le o nɛ.
Anɔɔ ɛ waa aa chɔ le dɛ tɛ haah bɛlbwa waa lolɛ baa kɛɛ haah la kɛŋɔ o ɛ. Dɛ haah la aa won dɔ pebie aa, ó nyin borɔnomare anɛ kɛɛ kulukukure anɛ dɛ́ kpɔ bɛl ɛ saraha baa fuh tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ onɔ la ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.
Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ soŋe naate wechɔɡa n be, ásɛ o doŋa bwa le o nɛ.”
Bwadabii weechɔɡa Mmarare wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Bwadabii weela kɛŋɔ ɔr kɛɛ kure, kɛɛ wee foɡra aa dɛ ba wona ɛ weela aa bu lawɛ nɛn aa, bá kpɔ naate ka baɡle Arɔn kɛɛ o bibaala baa ɛ sɔfore la bini bɛl.
Sɔfo la nyiŋi ŋwɛr la dɛ pona aa lɔ o ta la too, asɛ ŋwɛr la yɛ kaa bini naa, amɔ dɛ bwadabii weechɔɡa aa dɛ buu.
Sɔfo la ɛɛ ŋɔ weela la ɛ weela aa dɛ bu nomanta, naate la kah doŋa.
Kɛ dɛ ŋwɛr la bini too dɛ o ta yɛɛ kaa bini pona la ɡe ta toe yaa, ate sɔfo la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó pere naate le o bala bini tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la baa tel aa, sɔfo la berɛ ba nyiŋu ja.
O baa nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ ŋwɛr la ta do ɡɛ o fa aa doa, o ta yɛɛ kaa sie naa, ó pero le o bala bini tɔpera anuanɛ ja.
Tɔpera anuanɛ la baa tel ja o ba nyiŋu dɛ na kɛŋɔ o sie chɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ o ta yɛɛrɛ ɡe aa, sɔfo la ɛɛ ŋɔɔ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛɛ kpa, kur pɛɛpɛɛ.
A ɡɛ nɛn la ka chɛɡɛ o laala, ásɛ o doŋa bwa le o nɛ.
Kɛ dɛ sɔfo la baa nyiŋi dɛ ŋɔ doŋa toole o nɛɛ kpa, asɛ a habɔɔ kur la berɛ yɛ aa, a chɛ kɛ ó berɛ kpɔ o te ka chaɡle sɔfo la ja.
O berɔ ba nyiŋu dɛ kur la yɛo waa, ó ŋɔ naate kah doŋa.
A ɛ weechɔɡa aa dɛ bu.
Nomɛlbwa bwadabii weebuula aa lɔ o nɛɛ la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá lawɔ ba sɔfo sie.
O baa nyiŋu na dɛ ɔr la too asɛ pona aa lɔ o sie la ɡe to o bini la beɡre ŋwɛr aa, dɛ a ɛ bwadabii weechɔɡa dɛ do o bwadabii ta.
Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.
A ta chɛ kɛ ó pero le o bala bini dɛ́ nyiŋu mɔɔ, dɛkalkɛ doŋa dɔɔ do o nɛ.
Dɛ sɔfo la nao kɛŋɔ weela la lɔ naate bwadabii bwa ta, le o nyundua ba ta harɛ naa, wɛɛ berɔɔ nyiŋu.
Dɛ o nao kɛŋɔ weela la lawɛ o bwadabii bwa kpelaa, ó ŋɔ naate be ŋɔ doŋa toole o nɛ.
O bwadabii bwa aa toa nomanta, amɔ dɛ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ.
Kɛ a habɔɔ o berɛ ŋwɛr aa, dɛ o kah doŋa.
Sɔfo la berɛ ba nyiŋu, dɛ o na ŋwɛr kpelaa, ó ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.
Ŋwɛr waa pila la dɛ́ chaɡle kɛŋɔ a ɛ weechɔɡa aa dɛ bu.
Kɛ dɛ ŋwɛr la sewɔ o buɡ la berɛ to aa, náate la berɛ kpɔ o te ka chaɡle sɔfo la ásɛ o kwaa nyiŋu ja.
Dɛ ŋwɛr la buɡ too waa, ásɛ sɔfo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛɛ kpa.
Dɛ ɔr ɔrɛ nomɛl dɛ ba tonɛ, asɛ o buɡ la to kɛɛ dɛ swɛɛraa, a chɛ kɛ naate kpɔ o te ka chaɡle sɔfo.
Sɔfo la nyiŋu dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ o buɡ la kaa bini asɛ pona aa lɔ o bini ɡe to aa, ó ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.
A ɛ weebuula dɛ ba ɛ ɔr la buɡ ta.
Kɛ dɛ sɔfo la nyiŋi naate dɛ pona aa toa toole o ta, o ta berɛ kaa bini o sie chɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ ó pero le o nɛra bini tɔpera anuanɛ.
Dɛ o buɡ la berɔ yɛɛraa, sɔfo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.
A ɛ weebuula.
Kɛ dɛ buɡ la ta, do ɡɛ waa doa o ta yɛɛraa, dɛ ɔr la pɛl la ɡboo.
Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ.
Dɛ nii ɡee fuh nomɛl asɛ o ŋwɛr la chɛchɛr dɛ to kɛɛ dɛ swɛɛraa, sɔfo la nyiŋu.
O baa nyiŋu dɛ na kɛŋɔ pona aa lɔ o ta la too asɛ o buɡ la kaa bini naa, amɔ dɛ weebuula baa jo o ta.
Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.
Kɛ dɛ pona aa lɔ o ta la ta toe asɛ o buɡ la ɡe ta bini kaalɛ o sie chɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ sɔfo la pero le o nɛra bini tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la telaa, sɔfo la berɛ ba nyiŋu.
O baa na kɛŋɔ ŋwɛr la yɛo waa, ó ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.
A ɛ bwadabii weebuula.
Kɛ dɛ buɡ la ta, do ɡɛ waa doa, o ta yɛɛrɛ o sie chɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, amɔ dɛ nii laanee ɡela a ba ɡɛ.
Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ naate be ŋɔ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ.
O ɛ nii la fuih pɛl ɡbo.
Baa bɛlbwa kɛɛ haah ŋwɛr aa ɛ o nyu kɛɛ o taŋɡbaɡre la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ sɔfo ba nyiŋu na ɡɛ waa doa.
Ŋwɛr la kaa bini asɛ o bini pona ɛ solmen a ta berɛ warɛ kpa aa, dɛ bwadabii weebuula kɛŋɔ masakurkur aa dɛ we nyu kɛɛ taŋɡbaɡre laanee.
Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.
Kɛɛ dɛ sɔfo la baa nyiŋu dɛ na kɛ ŋwɛr la ta bini kaalɛ, o pona sie chɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, ó pere naate le o nɛra bini tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la telaa, sɔfo la berɛ ba nyiŋi ŋwɛr la.
O baa nyiŋi dɛ o ta yɛɛrɛ, o pona ɡe ta solmen ɛɛ dɛ kaa bini naa, naate la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá fonɛ o ŋwɛr la bɔr bar.
Sɔfo la ɛɛ berɔɔ pero le o nɛra bini tɔpera anuanɛ ja.
Tɔpera anuanɛ la baa tel ja aa, sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó nyiŋi ŋwɛr la ja.
O nao kɛŋɔ o ta yɛɛrɛ kaa bini bɛlbwa naa, ó ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o ta doŋa bɛlbwa kaeh.
Náate la chɛɡɛ o laala, dɛ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛɛ kpa.
Kɛ dɛ ŋwɛr la berɔ yɛ a habɔɔ baa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ doŋa toole o nɛɛ la aa, sɔfo la berɛ nyiŋu ja.
Dɛ ŋwɛr la yɛo kpela aa, sɔfo la bɛ berɛ nyiŋi na kɛŋɔ pona aa ɛ solmen lɔ o ta kɛɛ a toole o ta kpa.
Ó den ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa.
Kɛ dɛ sɔfo la liiree kɛŋɔ ŋwɛr la ta yɛɛrɛ, asɛ pona aa dɛ chaɡle kɛŋɔ o dɛ tonɛ ba o ta naa, amɔ dɛ o tonɔ.
Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ naate la be ŋɔ doŋa toole o nɛɛ kpa.
Dɛ akaba lɔ baa kɛɛ haah nɛ aa, sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó nyiŋi naate dɛ́ na.
Dɛ kompoŋa la ta denɛ to kpelkpel ɡɛ naa, amɔ dɛ bwadabii weepɛɛ, doŋa toole naate nɛ.
Dɛ baa nyu ɡbao o nyumpona bwa tonɛ kwaraa naa, doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ.
Dɛ o tile bɔr ɡe ɡboo ɡbaa aa, doŋa toole o nɛ.
Kɛ dɛ ŋwɛr waa swɛɛra dɛ to lɔ o nyu bela waa ɡbaa la ta kɛɛ o tile ta naa, amɔ dɛ weebuulaa.
Sɔfo la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó nyiŋi ŋwɛr la.
O baa nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ o swɛɛrɔ dɛ to kɛŋɔ weebuula aa, weela la ɡelɔ naate kah doŋa.
Sɔ́fo la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o kah doŋa, weechɔɡa lɔ o nyu ta.
Nɛn waa dɔ ɡɛ weebuula nɔ la chɛ kɛŋɔ wɛ́ɛ do laalajɛɡle, dɛ bɛ o nyumpona lee dɛ́ kpɔ kon tɔ o nyoa ásɛ dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, ‘N kah doŋa!
N kah doŋa!’ Weela la taa lɔ o nɛɛ nɔ, ɡɛɛ doŋa ɡe ɛɛ ba o nɛɛ doe.
A chɛ kɛ ó le nɛra bini, dɛ́ ɡbo ka so bela baa soɡa la dahara.
Kwaa aa fɔɔla Mmarare Dɛ kwaane le yatɔɔle kɛɛ yal baa wola on nyarɛ mɔɔ ta dɛ fɔɔlo, dɛ pee pona nee ba sɔɔh kɛɛ jisepondɛɛɡe kɛɛ oltɔn ne komɛlbwa soo siwi baa kpɔ oltɔn ɛo ta naa, dɛ a ɡɛ konfɔɔla nɔ le yal, kɛɛ kon baa kpɔ oltɔn ɛo, kɛɛ yal baa sɔɔh dɛ lɛɡre o ta kɛ papo-lwɛɛ, kɛɛ konswɛɛma aa, dɛ a ɛ kombuula.
A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔa ka chaɡle sɔfo.
Sɔ́fo la nyiŋi kon la na, dɛ́ kpɔ le nɛra bini tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la, o baa nyiŋi ja dɛ kwaa la ta lɔ kon la ta dɛ yɛɛraa, a ɛ konchɔɡa dɛ ɡel kon la kah doŋa.
A chɛ kɛ sɔfo la fuh kon la, konfɔɔla aa yɛɛra jo o ta la wa.
Kɛ dɛ sɔfo la baa nyiŋi dɛ konfɔɔla la ta kon la ta yɛɛraa, ó ŋɔ bá ka chɛɡɛ kon la dɛ́ kwaaro bil bokɛre tɔpera anuanɛ ja.
A habɔɔ baa chɛɡɛ kon la, sɔfo la ɛɛ nyiŋuu na ja.
Dɛ o ta do ɡɛ waa doa, hale dɛ o ta yɛɛrɛ kwaraa ɡe aa, doŋa ta lɔ o ta.
Dɛ o sie kɛɛ o habɔɔ bɛlbwa taa a lɛɡre aa, fuih chɛ kɛ ba fuuh.
Kɛ dɛ kon la chɛɡa habɔɔ sɔfo la nyiŋo dɛ na kɛŋɔ konfɔɔla la ta lɔ kon la ta tama aa, ó kɛɛ baŋ bela konfɔɔla la aa lɛɡra la le o ta.
Ba berɔ naa kon la ta naa, amɔ dɛ yɛɛraa a yɛɛ.
Fuih chɛ kɛ bá den fuh kon la.
Ba chɛɡɛ kon la asɛ konfɔɔla aa lɔ o ta la bwa kaalaa, a chɛ kɛ bá kwaa chɛɡɔ nɛɛtena, dɛ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o ta kpa.” Gɛɛ mmarare aa chɔ le tɛ konfɔɔla aa won yatɔɔle kɛɛ yal baa wola on nyarɛ mɔɔ, kɛɛ pee pona nee ba sɔɔh kɛɛ jisepondɛɛɡe, kɛɛ komɛlbwa soo siwi baa kpɔ oltɔn ɛo ta joe la, ne ɡɛ baa jemɛ kɛŋɔ doŋa bɛlbwa toole a ta, ne doŋa aa lɔ a ta la bwa waa do.
Doŋa laa dɛ́ kpɔ bwadabii weebuula te nɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Dɛ bwadabii weebuula lɔ nɛn nɛ ba chaoh dɛ la o ne sɔfo be naa, waa aa chɔ le ó laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ o nɛɛ laanee nɔ.
Sɔfo la ɛɛ le bwɛɛ la daharaa dɛ́ ka nyiŋu na, o nao kɛŋɔ a toole o nɛɛ kpa aa, ó ŋɔ ba nyin jumbii anɛ aa wera ne dii, ne peleme daa ne jiseswɛm, dɛ hesɔp daa ba tɛ weela te baa dɛ ba o doŋa laa dɛ kpɔ o nɛɛ la.
Sɔfo la ɡel ba dɔ nee waa dɛ palɛ do vii bini, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ jumbii la bɛl ba chaɡɛ vii la ta dɛ́ kpoo.
Ó kpɔ onɔ la waa wola on kpoe la ne peleme daa la, ne jiseswɛm la ne hesɔp daa la bwa pɛ su jumbie baa kpoo la chal la ta, ásɛ dɛ ɛ chal la merɛ naate weebuula aa lɔ o nɛɛ baa ba o doŋa laa dɛ kpɔ o nɛɛ la kera anuanɛ, dɛ́ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ doŋa toole o nɛɛ kpa.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ jumbie waa wola on kpoe la ta kpɔɡ bini ó ir kaa.
Nɛn baa laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛɛ la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala, dɛ́ fonɛ o pona bwa ta dɛ́ sɔ ne, ásɛ o doŋa le o nɛ.
Anɔ habɔɔ, wɛɛ wono berɛ ba bela baa soɡa la, kɛ a chɛ kɛ o so o tɛnte dea dahara tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la telaa, a chɛ kɛ ó berɛ fonɛ o nyu, ne tampona ne sikoŋpona dɛ o bwara pona te bwa.
Ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, ásɛ doŋa la bwa den le o nɛɛ kwaraa.
Tɔ aa per tɔpenuatoro wee la, ó lawɛ pebali anɛ ne pelor aa di benanyoa, a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii la, ne men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruware atoro noo aa koo a ta, dɛ noo pɛrɛntoa fah.
Sɔfo waa baɡle kɛŋɔ doŋa toole naate nɛɛ la ɛɛ kpɔ o ne ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwaa ba men Korowii sie, n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.
Ásɛ sɔfo la lawɛ pebali la bɛl dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa fah la ja, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha.
Ó ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa n sie.
Ó teŋe pee la baŋa boɡoroŋ bela baa dɛ kpoo wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kwaa ne saraha kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ, dɛkalkɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kwaa la ɛ sɔfo la kwa.
A ɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona.
Sɔ́fo la kpɔ bolchɔɡe dii saraha pee la chal la ane ɛ naate baa laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ o nɛɛ la diɡ deŋne nyoa, ne o diɡ nonibal dɛ o nadiɡ nanibal ta.
Sɔ́fo la berɛ kpɔ noo la ane dɛ́ fuɡe do o ɡbabir ɡal nɔmpaa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ o diɡ noni do a ta, dɛ́ ɛ ane merɛ n sie bela kera anuanɛ.
Ó kpɔ noo aa ka o nɔmpaa bini la ane dawɛ chal o fa aa kpɔa ɛ naate la diɡ deŋne nyoa, ne o diɡ nonibal dɛ o nadiɡ nanibal ta la ta.
Ásɛ sɔfo la kpɔ noo la kabora aa lɔ o nɔn ta la do naate baa dɛ ba doŋa laa dɛ́ kpɔ o nɛɛ la nyu ta.
Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ soŋe naate wechɔɡa tɛo men Korowii sie ásɛ n kpɔ kɛo.
A habɔɔ sɔ́fo la kpo wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kon la dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe naate la wechɔɡa, ásɛ o doŋa la le o nɛ.
A chɛ kɛ ó teŋe saraha kon baa fuuh la baŋa.
Dɛ́ kpɔ o ne mea saraha la pɛ ka fuah saraha kon la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe o wechɔɡa n be.
Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ ásɛ o doŋa le o nɛ.
Dɛ naate la ɛo kɛŋɔ o nyao waa won dɔ a ɡɛ koŋkwaa nɔ naa, a chɛ kɛ ó lawɛ pebie waa ɛ ombal ba ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha, dɛ́ ɡɔɔro nyundua dɛ́ viiɡu n sie soŋe o wechɔɡa tɛo.
Dɛ́ kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruwa del noo aa koo a ta, ásɛ a ɛ mea saraha ne noo pɛrɛntoa fah, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ borɔnomare anɛ kɛɛ kulukukure anɛ a bini bɛlbwa waa dɛ ba wona dɔ ba, dɛ́ kpɔ beŋkpoŋ ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ bɛl la ɡe che tɛ saraha kon baa fuah.
A chɛ kɛ naate kpɔa ba sɔfo be tɔpenuatoro wee la ta n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela n sie, ásɛ o kpɔ laa o doŋa kpɔ o nɛ.
Sɔfo la ɛɛ kpɔ pebie waa ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha kon la, ne noo pɛrɛntoa fah laanee dɛ́ ba ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa n sie.
Ásɛ dɛ teŋe bolchɔɡe dii saraha pee la baŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ chal la ane ɛ naate la baa dɛ ba doŋa laa dɛ́ kpɔ o nɛɛ la diɡ deŋne nyoa, ne o diɡ nonibal dɛ o nadiɡ nanibal ta.
Sɔ́fo la fuɡe noo la ane do o ɡbabir ɡal nɔmpaa ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ o diɡ nonii ɛ ane merɛ n sie bela kera anuanɛ.
Ó berɛ ɛ noo la ane dawɛ bɔra o fa aa ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha kon chal merɛ la ɡɛ tenten.
Naate la diɡ deŋne nyoa ne diɡ nonibal dɛ o diɡ nanibal ta.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ noo la kabora aa lɔ o nɔmpaa bini la do naate baa dɛ ba o doŋa laa dɛ́ kpɔ o nɛɛ la nyu ta, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe naate la wechɔɡa tɛo men Korowii sie ń kpɔ kɛo.
O ɛ ɡɛ tonaa, wɛɛ won kpɔ borɔnomare la kɛɛ kulukukure naate la aa dɛ ba wona kpɔ ba ɛ saraha la, beŋkpoŋ che tɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bɛl la ɡe ɛ saraha baa fuah, dɛ́ kpɔ mea saraha la ja a ta.
Gɛɛ sɔfo la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ che naate baa laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ o nɛɛ la naa ta soŋe o wechɔɡa n sie ń kpɔ kɛo.” Anee ɛ Mmarare aa chɔ le dɛ tɛ nɛn waa dɔ bwadabii weebuula waa wola won dɔ kwaa waa kpɔ ɛ saraha ɡɛ aa chɛa, ásɛ doŋa bɛlbwa le o nɛ.
Konfɔɔla aa lɔ deremi ta Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he jo Keenan harɛ maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ ó ɛ he kon la ta, asɛ nomɛl na kɛŋɔ n kpɔ konfɔɔla aa won bui ta dem bɛl danjwɛɛ ta naa, dem te la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó la sɔfo be ka ŋɔ o na konfɔɔla ane o dem.
A ba ɡɛ naa, sɔfo la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel ba pa laala aa lɔ dem bela bwa le mɔɔ o ba nyiŋi konfɔɔla la, ɡɛ aa ɛ komɛlbwa sese aa lɔ dem bela la bɛ doŋa ba kah.
Ba dɔɔ pa le tonaa, sɔfo la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó la ka nyiŋi dem bela.
A chɛ kɛ ó nyiŋi konfɔɔla la danjwɛɛ ta dɛ́ na, dɛ a ɛo kɛŋɔ papo-lwɛɛ kɛɛ dɛ swɛɛ dɛ di jo danjwɛɛ la ta naa, a chɛ kɛ sɔfo la le dem la bini dɛ́ ba laa o doonyoa ɡbera tɔ tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la telaa, sɔfo la berɛ ba nyiŋi dem la.
O baa nyiŋi dɛ konfɔɔla la diu jo danjwɛɛ la ta kaa sie kohona naa, ó ɡel ba laa bwea la konfɔɔla la aa jo a ta la kpɔ ka ta bwɛɛ la dahara bela baa pa kondoŋa kaa ta.
Anɔ habɔɔ, a chɛ kɛ ó sɛh dem la bini danjwɛɛ bwa ta, ásɛ dɛ chea ka ta bwɛɛ la dahara bela.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bwefala ba su anɔ la baa cheɡa ka ta la naa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ tefala kwaa maa o bwa.
Dɛ bwea baa kpɔa le dɛ sɛh danjwɛɛ la dɛ kwaa maalo la habɔɔ, konfɔɔla la berɔ ba dem la ta naa, a chɛ kɛ sɔfo la berɛ la dɛ́ ka nyiŋi na.
O kaa nyiŋi dɛ a berɔ dawɛ danjwɛɛ la sie ta naa, dɛ a ɛ konfɔɔla dɛɛ chɔɡ dem la, anomanta, dem la kah doŋa.
A chɛ kɛ bá kuuɡi dem la te bwa, o bwea ne daa ne teera baa kpɔa maalo bwa, dɛ́ paa le bwɛɛ la dahara bela.
Nomɛlbwa waa jo dem baa koh konfɔɔla la wa dɛ tɔ o ɡbera la kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa ka chɔ kɛɛ dɛ́ di kondikwaa dem la bini la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala.
Kɛ dɛ ba maa dem la asɛ a habɔɔ sɔfo la ba nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ konfɔɔla la ta dii jo aa, wɛɛ ŋɔɔ doŋa toole o ta, dɛkalkɛ konfɔɔla la toole o ta kpa.
Kwaa waa kpɔ laa dem la doŋa laa kpɔ laanee jumbii anɛ, ne peleme daa ane ne jiseswɛm dɛ hesɔp da.
Sɔfo la ɡel ba dɔ nee waa dɛ palɛ do vii bini, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ jumbii la bɛl chaɡɛ vii la ta dɛ́ kpoo.
Ó kpɔ onɔ la waa wola on kpoe la, ne peleme daa la ne jiseswɛm ne hesɔp daa la bwa pɛ su jumbie baa kpoo la chal ne nee la ta, dɛ́ ɛ merɛ dem la ta kera anuanɛ.
Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ jumbie la chal ne nee la, ne jumbie o siwi taa lole, ne sida ne hesɔp daa la dɛ jiseswɛm la laa doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ dem la ta kpɔ.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ jumbie o siwi aa lole la le ka ta kpɔɡ bini ó ir kaa.
Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ dem la ta ó berɛ do wer.” Anɔɔ ɛ Mmarare aa chɔ le tɛ bwadabii weebuula bɛlbwa ne konfɔɔla aa jo yal kɛɛ dem ta, ne ɔɡra kɛɛ kure dɛ anɔ la aa dɛ lɛɡre bwadabii ta bwa.
Anee ɛ waa aa chɔ le nɛn che a ta jemɛ kondoŋa kaeh ne o wer doe.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ chɔ le dɛ tɛ bwadabii weebuula ne konfɔɔla te bɛlbwa.
Nee aa le nɛn bini dɛ ɛ doŋa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ja ŋɔ bá bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Baa waa so pɛɛpɛɛ o bane ɛɛ le la, a nee la ɛ doŋa, hale a ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ba kɛɛ dɛ teŋaa, aa ɡeloo ó kah doŋa.
Waa aa che a ta o kah doŋa laanee nɔ, komɛlbwa waa chɔ o ta kɛɛ dɛ so o ta la berɛ doŋa kon.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡe o chɔɔbɔr chɛ kɛŋɔ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne.
O kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Nomɛlbwa waa so komɛlbwa naate aa soɡe o ta ka la, ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne.
O kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa kpɔ nɔn leɡe a ɡɛ nɛn la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, naate kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Dɛ o berɔ ta nentane ta nɛn doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ aa, naate chɛ kɛŋɔ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, naate kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Komɛlbwa ɡe a ɡɛ nɛn nɔ aa teeh so o ta la kah doŋa.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡe kon naate aa soɡe o ta la kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Nomɛlbwa waa ka kpɔ komɛlbwa a ɡɛ nɛn la aa soɡe o ta la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, dɛ o kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Nomɛlbwa a ɡɛ nɛn nɔ aa leɡo dɛ o ta nɔɔra samɛ mɔɔ la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, naate la kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Dɛ vii ɡee naate leɡaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá paɡro.
Dɛ komɛlbwa sese baa kpɔ daa ɛo ɡee yaa, a chɛ kɛ bá looru.
Ba chah nomɛl waa do ɡɛ naa, tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ naate won laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛ.
A chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala, dɛ́ dɔ nee waa dɛ palɛ ba tɛo ó sɔ, dɛ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛɛ kpa.
Ásɛ tɔpenuatoro wee ta la, ó kpɔ kulukukure anɛ kɛɛ borɔnoma bii anɛ ba, n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela men Korowii sie, dɛ́ kpɔ ba tɛ sɔfo.
Sɔfo la kpɔa dɛ́ kpɔ bɛl ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bɛl la ɡe ɛ saraha baa fuah.
Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ soŋe naate la weela tɛo n sie dɛ́ laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛ.
Dɛ baa bane bala aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ nee dɛ́ sɔ o bwara bwa, o kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Dɛ komɛl kɛŋɔ yal kɛɛ dɛ oltɔn taa o bane la jo aa, a chɛ kɛ bá chɛɡɔ, o kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Dɛ baa la ne haah chɔɔ waa, a chɛ kɛ bá bwa sɔ ne.
Ba bwa kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Dɛ haah bwara chɔɡɔ aa, dɛ o kah doŋa tɔpera anuanɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡo la kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Komɛlbwa waa chɔ o ta kɛɛ dɛ so o ta bochɔɡa saŋ la bwa kah doŋa.
Bɛlbwa waa leɡe o chɔɔbɔr la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, naate kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Nomɛlbwa leɡe komɛlbwa waa so o ta la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, o kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Dɛ kon naate aa chɔ o ta kɛɛ dɛɛ so o taa nɛn leɡe aa, naate kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Dɛ haah la bochɔɡa ta leɛ mɔɔ baa lawɔ ka chɔ aa, dɛ baa la ɡe kah doŋa tɔpera anuanɛ, o kwaa waa chɔ a ta la ɡe bwa kah doŋa.
Dɛ chal dɛ fuɡe haah dɛ biɡri dɛ o bochɔɡa laa, kɛɛ dɛ o bochɔɡa saŋee a ta teŋe dɛɛ fuɡo waa, dɛ o kah doŋa ɡɛ tenten a yon do o bochɔɡa saŋ mɔɔ o chal teŋe la.
Komɛlbwa waa chɔ o ta kɛɛ dɛ so o ta ɡɛ saŋ nɔ la kah doŋa ɡɛ tenten o bochɔɡa saŋ waa kah doŋa la.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡo la kah doŋa.
A chɛ kɛ naate chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne.
O kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Dɛ chal la fuɡo tonɛ o dɔ chaah naa, ó so tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ, dɛ doŋa la le o nɛ.
Tɔpenuatoro wee ta la, ó kpɔ kulukukure anɛ kɛɛ borɔnomare bii anɛ ba tɛ sɔfo la n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.
Sɔfo la kpɔ beŋkpoŋ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ bɛl la ɡe ó kpɔ ɛ saraha baa fuah.
Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe naate la doŋa waa kaah la tɛo n sie.
Anɔɔ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel Israel tena laa ba te dɛɛ kpɔ doŋa waa ta, dɛ bɛ doŋa kpɔ kah n Tɛnte Dea waa lɔ he bini la dɛ́ ba serewe.” Waa aa chɔ le tɛ baa o bane aa dɛ ba dɛ o ta haah chɔe dɛ kah doŋa, ne haah o bochɔɡa saŋ aa tela kɛɛ chal aa dɛ fuɡo pɛɛpɛɛ, kɛɛ baa haah lawa ka chɔ o doŋa kaeh saŋ laanee la.
Wechɔɡa Soŋa Korowii Be Ó Kpɔ Kɛ Tɔpejen Korowii berɔ bol waa Mosis be ɡɛ saŋ Arɔn bibaala banɛ aa wola ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta cheɡɛ ba Korowii sie dɛ serewe la habɔɔ.
O ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ he dɔɔ Arɔn be kɛŋɔ, o bɛ pateesan waa tɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la habɔɔ jo kaa bela N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ la aa lole la warawara, dɛ́ ba sewɛ.
Dɛkalkɛ Daka la tɔ doa belaa n che dɛɛ ba he be bam ta.
Dɛ wɛɛ won jo Korowii Dea belaa, atane ó kpo nabale dɛ́ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ne pebal dɛ́ ɛ saraha baa fuuh tɛ mɛ la mɔɔ.
A chɛ kɛ ó do sɔfo laala aa do ɡoroŋ baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe nyara.
O yapebora waa lawɛ o bwadabi, ne batakaare baa dɛ doo mun ta ne o kiriso, dɛ o yal waa kpɔ vɔwɛ nyu.
A do ɡoroŋ nomanta, a chɛ kɛ ó sɔ nee mɔɔ dɛ́ doa.
Israel tena la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá tɛ Arɔn bombala anɛ ó kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ pebal waa kpɔ ɛ saraha baa fuah la.
Árɔn tɔ sie kpɔ nabale la ba ó ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe o ne o dem tena wechɔɡa, ásɛ n kpɔ kɛ ba.
Ásɛ dɛ lawɛ boohna anɛ la ba n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela n sie.
Dɛ́ bil daa ásɛ beŋkpoŋ ɛ n kon, nɛɛte la ɡe ɛ onɔ la baa kpɔ nɛra la bwa wechɔɡa dawɛ o nyu ta.
Árɔn kpo booh baa bil daa o ɛ n kon la, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.
Ásɛ booh baa bil daa dɛ lawɔ ba kpɔ nɛra la bwa wechɔɡa dawɛ o nyu ta la, bá lawɛ o ne o siwi ba n sie, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Arɔn chɛ kɛ ó lawɛ nabale la waa kpɔ ba ɛ o ɡbabir wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ soŋe o ne o dem tena wechɔɡa name, dɛ́ teŋe o baŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha la.
Ó kpɔ kon buh nii le saraha kon la ta n sie, dɛ́ ɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma ba nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ nɔndela anɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ jo ba Boɡoroŋ Tenten pateesan la habɔɔ.
Ó kpɔ daawiile la do nii la ta n sie bela, ásɛ a chuu la bɔle N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ la ta, ásɛ o bɛ o tɔ la na dɛ́ ba sewɛ.
Ó kpɔ nonii ɛ nao la chal la ane merɛ N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ la ta o sie, dɛ́ berɛ merɛ ane ɡe o sie tenten kera anuanɛ.
A habɔɔ la, ó kpɔ booh la, dɛ́ kpo ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ nɛra la, dɛ́ kpɔ o chal la ba pateesan la habɔɔ, dɛ́ ɛa ɡɛ tenten waa ɛ nao la chal la.
Ó merɛ ane N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ la ta, dɛ́ merɛ ane ɡe o sie bela.
Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ, dɛ́ fee doŋa ne deŋnekpeɡ, ne wechɔɡa bɛlbwa soo siwi Israel tena aa ɛa bwa ta Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela.
A chɛ kɛ ó ɛ ɡɛ tenten n Dea Cheremibɔr la bini ɡe, waa cheɡɛ a baah ta nomanta, a bwaa kah doŋa.
Arɔn aa ka jo Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela dɛ ka soŋe o ne o dem tena, ne Israel tena bwa wechɔɡa la, nomɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛ ó do n Dea Cheremibɔr la bini ka tel kɛŋɔ waa ba le mɔɔ.
Wɛɛ berɔɔ le ba saraha kon la ta bela n sie, dɛ́ ba laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ o ta.
A chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ nao la chal la ane ne booh la chal ane, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ kwaa aa paaɡe saraha kon la loŋkoni bwa ta.
Ó kpɔ o nonii ɛ chal la ane merɛ saraha kon la ta kera anuanɛ, dɛ́ laa doŋa kpɔ o ta.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ dɛ laa Israel tena wedoŋa bwa kpɔ saraha kon la ta, dɛ́ leo cheɡ o do ɡoroŋ.
Booh waa lɛ Israel tena wechɔɡa dawɛ o nɛɛ kaa wa Arɔn laa ba doŋa kpɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela, ne n Dea Cheremibɔr la bini dɛ saraha kon la ta tonaa, a chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ booh la o siwi aa lole la ba che n sie.
Ó kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ booh la nyu ta, ásɛ dɛ bol Israel tena chɔɡre, ba wechɔɡa ne ba deŋnekpeɡ bwa baa ɛa dɛ ta o nyu ta, dɛ́ kpɔ do nomɛl nɔn ta, ásɛ o teɡɔ kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Naate la ɛɛ kpɔɔ ka ta harɛ nomɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta, ásɛ ba wechɔɡa bwa dawɛ booh la nɛ ó kpɔ kaa.
Arɔn tonaa, ó berɛ jo n Dea Cheremibɔr la bini, dɛ́ ka foo sɔfo laala waa kpɔa do mɔɔ dɛ jo Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela la bil.
A chɛ kɛ ó ka sɔ nee bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ laalafala do.
Ásɛ dɛ le ka kpɔ o ne Israel tena saraha kwaa baa fuah la fuh, dɛ́ soŋe o ne Israel tena bwa wechɔɡa, ásɛ n kpɔ kɛ ba.
Ó berɛ kpɔ ol waa kpɔa ɛ saraha la noo ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ fuah saraha kon la ta.
Naate la ɡe waa kpɔ booh la kaa ka ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ nee mɔɔ dɛ́ ba bela baa soɡa la.
Nabale la ne booh baa kpɔa ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ kpɔ a chal ba Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela ba soŋe wechɔɡa la, a ɡe chɛ kɛ bá chea le bela baa soɡa la dahara dɛ́ ka fuah.
A tɔne ne ola, dɛ a tea bini kwaa bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá fuah.
Naate waa fuah la chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ nee mɔɔ dɛ́ berɛ ba bela baa soɡa la.
A ɡɛ Mmarare nɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ á chɔ le tɛ heyaa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korobinuanɛ te la tɔpera fi ta, a chɛ kɛ hé vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ, Israel te kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he binii yoo, dɛkalkɛ awola tɔpere laanee baa ba he wechɔɡa bwa soŋa, ásɛ dɛ laa he doŋa kpɔ he nɛ.
Gɛɛ dɛɛ ba ɡela wechɔɡa bɛlbwa aa he nɛɛ do kpa men Korowii sie.
O ɛ tɔpere haa onɛ o ta dɛɛ vɔwɛ nyoa.
Á ɛ Mmara dɛ́ chɔ tɛ heyaa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Nɛn baa fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ doo sɔfore toma ta o ba chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta kɛŋɔ Sɔfonomoa laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ ó soŋe tɛ nɛra.
Ó kpɔ sɔfo laala baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡa nyara la do, dɛ́ ɛ we-ɛɛla Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela ne n Dea Cheremibɔr bini dɛ saraha kon la ta, dɛ́ laa sɔfore la ne Israel tena la wechɔɡa bwa kpɔ ba nɛ.
Mmarare nɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Bena bɛlbwa, kerabeŋkpoŋii chɛ kɛ bá soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa bwa ń kpɔ kɛ ba.” Asɛ ba ɛ a bwa ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis ŋɔ ba ɛ la.
Chal bɛ dii wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ waa maa dɛ ba he be bola nɔ tɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala dɛ Israel tena bwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpo nao, pee kɛɛ booh bela baa soɡa kɛɛ o dahara, dɛ o ta kpɔe ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa, dɛ ba kpo ɛ saraha n sie tɛ mɛ naa, dɛ o fuɡe chal ta dɛ di bolchɔɡe.
Maa naate laanee kure ja n nɛra nɛɛ kpa.
Gɛɛ dɛɛ ba ɡela Israel tena baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha kpɔɡ bini taraken nɔ ɡel a ɛɛ.
Bá kpɔa ba sɔfo be n Dea Cheremibɔr bela n sie ba ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ mɛ.
Sɔfo la tonaa, ó ɛ a chale merɛ men Korowii saraha kon la ta, n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela, dɛ́ fuh a noorare, ásɛ a sɔɔh do n som kohona.
A ta chɛ kɛ Israel tena vɛh men Korowii toma, dɛ́ ka ɛ saraha tɛ voɡa dɛɛ toma.
Gɛ Mmara nɔ chɛ kɛ á chɔ le tɛ ba ne ba naanar baa ka ba bwa.
Berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ Israel te bɛlbwa kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe ba bini dɛɛ nyin ó ɛ saraha baa fuah, kɛɛ saraha te bɛlbwa, dɛ o ta a ne n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa balɛ ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ bá pere naate le o nɛra bini.
Israel te, kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he bini dɛɛ di ol chal la, n sie ɛɛ beɡre naate nɛɛ dɛ́ pero le o nɛra bini.
Komɛlbwa o siwi aa lole la mkpa lɔ o chal ta, a waa n kpɔ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ soŋe he wechɔɡa saraha kon ta la.
Chal laanee bá kpɔ soŋe nɛn wechɔɡa dɛɛ tɛo wɛɛ dɔ mkpa.
A waa n ŋɔ he Israel tena ne nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe he bini bɛlbwa bɛ chal di la.
Israel te bɛlbwa kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he bini dɛ la kpaah bɔr ka kpo ol, kɛɛ jumbie waa wera ne dii la, ó teŋe o baŋa o chal bwa le, dɛ́ ɛ teera tɔ a ta, dɛkalkɛ komɛlbwa mkpa lɔ o chal ta.
A waa n ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ bɛlbwa bɛ ol ne o chal di la.
Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ ɡɛ la, mɛɛ pero le n nɛra bini.
Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ bwɛɛlembie kɛɛ hɔɔh dɛ di ol waa sewa, kɛɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡe aa lawɔ o ka kpɔ o kabora ba di la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne.
O kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra mɔɔ o doŋa la bwa le o nɛ.
Kɛ dɛ naate ta o laala chɛɡɛ dɛ sɔ ne aa, wɛɛ dɔ a waa.”
Kii aa lɔ nɛn kɛɛ ol lawa dɛ chɔ wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
He bɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ Ijipt tena he fa aa soɡe ba bini la, ne Keenan tena maa dɛ kaa he ne ba bini nɔ.
He bɛ ba we-ɛɛla la kpɔ.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa dɛ do heyaa bwa ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta la bwa ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛɛ teŋɛ waa aa lɔ Mmara la bwa ta la, wɛɛ dɔ mkpaa le Mmara la ta teŋa ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Nomɛlbwa, dɛ baa kɛɛ haahnee yoo, o ta chɛ kɛ o ne o lole tenten ka chɔ baa ne haah.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Bɛ he nya lawɛ ka chɔ dɛ do he mɛɛ sihiih.
O ɛ he nya, anomanta, a ta chɛ kɛ he lawɔ chɔ.
Bɛ he mɛɛ haah lawɛ chɔ.
A ba ɡɛ naa, dɛ duure bɛlbwa toole he ne he mɛɛ baah ta.
Dɛ́ɛ berɛ he nime kɛɛ nahaah lawa ka chɔ.
Dɛ he mɛɛ, kɛɛ nya bie ɡboo ba pɛ lolɛ he ne on dembeŋkpoŋ ta kɛɛ dɛ bobɛlee ba lolɔ kwaraa noo.
Dɛ́ɛ berɛ he bibaa bihaah kɛɛ he bihaah ɡe bihaah lawɛ chɔ.
A ɛ sihihwa dɛ tɛɛ.
A ta chɛ kɛ he lawɛ he mɛɛ haah bihaah waa ɛ he mɛɛ bie ka chɔ.
He ne o bwa pɛ mɛɛ o ɛ he nimambie.
Bɛ he nyaana lawɛ chɔ.
O ɛ he mɛɛ lole tenten.
Dɛ́ɛ berɛ he nyawee kɛɛ nyajen lawa ka chɔ.
He nya lole tentenee.
Bɛ he mɛnjen kɛɛ mɛnwee haah lawɛ chɔ.
A ɛ sihihwaa tɛ he mɛnjen kɛɛ mɛnwee la.
Dɛ́ɛ lii kɛŋɔ o ɛ he nya.
Bɛ he bie haah lawɛ chɔ.
A chɛ kɛ he jemɛ kɛ he helaa.
Aa were kɛ he lawɔ chɔ.
Bɛ he nime kɛɛ he dɔɔ haah lawɛ chɔ, a ɛ sihihwaa tɛ he dɔɔ kɛɛ nime la.
Bɛ haah nyin dɛ berɛ ka nyin o bie ɡe.
Dɛɛ berɛ o bibaa bihaah, kɛɛ o bihaah ɡe bihaah nyina.
Ba ɛ haah la lolanar tenten.
A ɛ wedoŋa.
Dɛ he haah ta soɡe le o ta sewɛ mɔɔ naa, dɛɛ berɛ o nime kɛɛ nahaah moe dɛ́ ja o nɛ dɛ́ lawɔ chɔ, a ba ɡɛ naa, baa toŋroo.
Bɛ haah lawɛ chɔ o bochɔɡa saŋ.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ o ta lɔ doŋa ta.
Bɛ he dɔŋ haah lawɛ chɔ dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kah he bwa.
Bɛ he bie bɛlbwa lawɛ tɛ bá kpo ɛ saraha tɛ voɡ Molɛk.
Dɛɛ berɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ nɔ sɔn chɔɡ ɡɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Bɛ he bandɔŋ lawɛ chɔ baa ne haah.
A ɛ waa baa kia.
Baa bɛlbwa bɛ ol lawɛ chɔ dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kah o te.
Haah bɛlbwa ɡe ta chɛ kɛ o ne ol chɔ baa ne haah, a ɛ waa aa wola were kɛ nɛn ɛ.
He bɛ he te kpɔ do ɡɛ waa nɔ bɛlbwa ta dɛ́ kah doŋa.
Gɛɛ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ maa dɛ ba kpɔe tɛ heyaa nɔ ta ɛ, asɛ dɛ kah doŋa mɛɛ ba ba doŋa le o ta la.
Ba we-ɛɛla chɔɡ harɛ la ɡba o doŋ dɛ ba deŋnetɛra ne o ta asɛ o lee ba tɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne n waa maa dɛ do heyaa la bwa ta.
Hé ne nɛŋhɔɔhra bwa baa soɡe he bini ta chɛ kɛ he teŋɛ waa baa kia nɔ ta dɛɛ ɛa, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛɛ nɛra baa tɔ sie ba so harɛ nɔ ta la we-ɛɛla chɔɡ harɛ la o doŋ la.
Hé ɡe baa chɔɡ harɛ la aa, wɛɛ le heyaa tɛ ɡɛ waa le nɛra baa tɔ he sie tɛ la.
Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bini bɛlbwa baa kia nɔ la chɛ kɛ bá pero le o nɛra bini.
Hɛɛ ɛ waa maa dɛ nyin, dɛ bɛ nɛra baa tɔ sie ba so harɛ nɔ ta la we-ɛɛla maa kia la ta teŋɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kah he te.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.”
Goroŋ doe ne waa aa toɡra Mmarare Korowii bol Mosis be ja ŋɔ, ó ŋɔ Israel tena la bwa be ŋɔ, “Hé do ɡoroŋ, dɛkalkɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, n do ɡoroŋ.
He bini bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ wɛ́ɛ duu o nya ne o mɛɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ di n Ona Tɔpera maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
He bɛ he liire charɛ dɛ́ kaa tomɛ voɡa kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ bune ɛ voɡa dɛɛ toma.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
Hé ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha dɛɛ ba n tɛɛ yaa, he ɛa ŋwɛnɛ aa chɛa ta, ásɛ a do wer tɛ mɛ ń lɛ.
Awola tenten haa kpo ol la ne tɔɔ aa per o ta laanee o do wer ne dii.
Kɛ dɛ o pera kao ba le tɔpetooro wee ta naa, a chɛ kɛ bá fuuh.
Nomɛlbwa waa di ol la tɔpetooro wee la, maa o saraha waa ɛa tɛ mɛ laanee lɛ.
A ɛ waa maa kia.
Nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ ol la chɛ kɛ bá tɛr o deŋne, dɛkalkɛ o chɔɡ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ men Korowii.
A chɛ kɛ ba pere naate le o nɛra bini.
He dɛ komɛ he koo kondikwaa aa, he bɛ anɔ la aa lɔ koo nyoa tenten la komɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ anɔ la aa leera la ɡe pa dɛɛ ja.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ he daa kooni nɔna aa ka mun lee kɛɛ a taa ka daa ta la ta dalwe dɛ́ tɔɔra.
Hé ɡela tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ne nyaara he ne baa soɡa la.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
He bɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛ.
He bɛ nyosone dɛɛ teŋe.
He bɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ neɡre.
He bɛ n sɔn kpɔ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ waa aa ɛ nyosone, dɛ́ chɔɡ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ sɔndɛɛɡe la.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ he dɔŋa faahra, kɛɛ dɛ́ ŋwɛo.
He bɛ ɡel nɛn ɛ he toma ásɛ he di o kem tɔɔ per a ta.
Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, dɛ bɛ amumu taah kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ komɛl bil nyoŋe sie ó lɔ na dɛ́ chole.
Hé nyiŋi dɛɛ pa waa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Naate ɛ nyaaraa, he bɛ o nɛɛ sune, he bɛ suuɡa te ɡe siebɔr nyiŋi.
Kpɔ kasinteŋ pa he dɔŋ bole.
He bɛ he dɔŋa waa kpɔ ɡaaɡe dɛ́ teŋe nyosone dɛɛ dawɛ ba nɛ.
Dɛ seo nyoa he dɔŋ che naa, bɛ on chɔɡ.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Dɛ́ɛ berɛ he dɔŋ haeh.
La o be ka diu kasinteŋ, ásɛ o wechɔɡa bɛ he nɛɛ dawɛ.
Bɛ he dɔŋ wechɔɡa waa ɛa la kpɔ do he bambile bini dɛ́ ɡe bɔɔ a kem.
Hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa kɛ he ɡbaɡba.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ n waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta.
He bɛ ɡel he kondɛɛra aa wola siwi beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ jwee dɔŋa.
He bɛ kondwee aa wola siwi beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ pɛ du harɛ beŋkpoŋ ta.
He bɛ yal baa kpɔ jisepondɛɛɡe ne pee pona sɔh la tɔ.
Baa bɛlbwa lawɛ yomhaah baa lawɔ tɛ baa waa wola o bwara waa ɛɛ mɔɔ ka chɔ, dɛ ba ta o nyu kem bɔe o dɔ o te mɔɔ naa, a chɛ kɛ bá tɛr ba deŋne.
Ba bɛ ban kpo dɛkalkɛ haah la ta ɛ nɛndɔɔle.
Baa la te, a chɛ kɛ ó lawɛ pebal ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha tɛ mɛ.
Sɔfo la kpɔ pebal la, dɛ́ soŋe naate wechɔɡa waa ɛa tɛo n sie, ásɛ n kpɔ kɛo.
He baa tel Keenan harɛ ta dɛ du daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ aa, bene atoro aa tɔ sie la chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ki a nɔna bɛlbwa aa nɔnɛ la.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé di daa la nɔn bɛlbwa a ɡɛ bene atoro nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛ aa were tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ hé dia.
Bennaarɛ ta la, dɛ a bwa wer dɛ ɛ men Korowii kwa, hé kpɔ ɛ saraha kpɛɛ n sɔndɛɛɡe la.
Dɛ he dɔ ŋwɛnɛ name, dɛ́ di daa la nɔna bennue te la ta.
Gɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ he daa won nɔnɛ kohona tɛ heya.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
He bɛ ol ne o chal di.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ he te kpɔe dɛ do voɡra kɛɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla soo siwi bɛlbwa ta.
He bɛ he nyu keŋkeŋna kɛɛ he tampona dɛɛ kuu.
He bɛ lala waa koh, dɛ́ mɔne he bwara kɛɛ dɛ́ do he bwadabii ɡwine.
Men Korowiirii bola.
He bɛ he bihaahna chɔɡ baa bɔ jwamane.
He dɛ ɛɛ ba ɡɛ naa, aa bu harɛ la bwaa, dɛ́ ɡel chɔɡre warɛ o ta.
Hɛ́ɛ di n Ona Tɔpera la, ásɛ dɛ ɡel duure do bela haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ nɛra baa dɔ daabii ba ne lala ɛɛ bol waa be la.
He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ he kpɔ doŋa dɛɛ kah he te.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
Hé kpɔ jirima dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa hwɛɛhra, ásɛ dɛɛ duu ba, dɛ́ɛ duu men Korowii haa dɛ́ tom mɛ ɡe.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe he harɛ ta hɔhɔrɔwa dɛɛ ɛ. Hɛ́ɛ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ he bala Israel tena, dɛ́ɛ nyin ba wa kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba.
He na kɛŋɔ he ɡbabir fa ɛ hɔɔhra Ijipt harɛ ta ka.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
He bɛ nɛra dɛɛ faah kwaa maɡa ta.
Hé kpɔ kwaa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ maɡɛ kwaa maɡɛ ɡɛ a bɛlbwa aa chɛa.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n kpɔ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba la.
Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa dɛ́ do heyaa bwa ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Wechɔɡa deŋnetɛra wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “He bini bɛlbwa kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he bini, dɛ lawɛ o bie bɛlbwa ɛ saraha ba kpo tɛ voɡ Molɛk la chɛ kɛ bwɛɛ la ta tena foɡro bwea kpo.
N sie ɛɛ beɡre naate nɛɛ dɛ́ pero le o nɛra bini, dɛkalkɛ lawa waa lawɛ o bie tɛ Molɛk la ɡelɔ o kpɔ doŋa kah n Dea, dɛ chɔɡ n sɔndɛɛɡe waa do ɡoroŋ la.
Dɛ bwɛɛla ɡe na naate dɛ laa sie kpɔ ba ta on kpoe yaa, n ɡbabir ɛɛ kpɔ sibeɡraa ta naate la ne o lolanar bwa nɛɛ, dɛ́ pere ba ne ba nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ dɛ vɛh n toma dɛ kaa tomɛ Molɛk la bwa le ba nɛra bini.
Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh n toma dɛɛ la nɛn waa dɔ daabii dɛɛ yerɛ lala be la, n sie ɛɛ beɡre o nɛɛ dɛ́ pero le o nɛra bini.
Hé laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ he nɛɛ dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ, dɛkalkɛ menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.
Hé lawɛ me Mmarare bini kpoŋe dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a bwa ta, dɛkalkɛ menee Korowii, menee ɡela he do ɡoroŋ.
Nomɛlbwa waa taah o mɛɛ kɛɛ o nya la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
Naate wechɔɡa ɡure o nyu ta.
Dɛ baa nyin o dɔŋ haah naa, dɛ ba bwa bɔ jwamane, a chɛ kɛ bá kpo baa la ne haah la bwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ o mɛɛ haah o ne o chɔ la lawɛ o mɛɛ sie teɡɛ harɛ.
Baa la ne haah la bwa chɛ kpoe.
Ba sewɔ ɡe aa, ba wechɔɡa ɡure ba nyu ta.
Baa bɛlbwa waa lawɛ o bie haah o ne o chɔ la chɛ kɛ bá kpo ba bwa.
Ba ɛ waa aa wola were, ba sewɔ ɡe aa, ba wechɔɡa ɡure ba nyu ta.
Dɛ baa lawɛ o bandɔŋ chɔ kɛŋɔ baa ne haah naa, a ɛ waa baa kia, a chɛ kɛ bá kpoo ba.
Ba sewɔ ɡe aa, ba wechɔɡa ɡure ba nyu ta.
Dɛ baa mo haah ne o nya bwa naa, a ɛ wedoŋa.
Ba nɛra batoro la bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá fuuh ba, ásɛ a ɡɛ wedoŋa nɔ le he bini.
Dɛ baa lawɛ ol chɔ kɛŋɔ baa ne haah naa, a chɛ kɛ bá kpo naate la dɛ́ kpo ol la ɡe.
Dɛ haah ɡe kpɔ o te tɛ ol o ne o chɔ baa ne haa naa, a chɛ kɛ bá kpo o ne ol la bwa.
Ba sewɔ ɡe aa, ba wechɔɡa ɡure ba nyu ta.
Dɛ baa mo o nimambihaah o ne waa pɛ mɛɛ kɛɛ nya, kɛɛ o nimambihaah o ne waa pɛ mɛɛ ne nya bwa naa, a ɛ sihihwa tenten.
A chɛ kɛ bá laɡ ba ka che nɛnfuuh baah ta, dɛ́ per ba le ba nɛra bini.
O do o nimambie la sihiih dɛ chɛ deŋnetɛra.
Baa lawɛ haah o bwara aa chɔɡa chɔ aa, ba nɛra banɛ la bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá doŋ ba le ba nɛra bini, dɛkalkɛ ba bwa chɔɡ me Mmarare aa chɔ le dɛ tɛ haah o ta aa lɔ o bochɔɡa saŋ ta aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ o ne baa chɔ la.
Dɛ baa lawɛ o nyawee kɛɛ nyajen kɛɛ o nyaana chɔ aa, a ɛ sihihwa dɛ chɔɡ lola, nɛra banɛ la bwa chɛ deŋnetɛra.
Baa bɛlbwa waa lawɛ o naara kɛɛ o mɛnjen kɛɛ mɛnwee haah chɔ la, dɛ o lawɛ o lole la sie teɡɛ harɛ.
Haah la ne baa la bwa chɛ deŋnetɛra, ba bɛlbwa ɡe aa bie ba dɔ ka tel ba serewe bena.
Baa bɛlbwa waa kpɔ o dɔɔ kɛɛ o nime haah mo la ɛ waa aa wola were, dɛ lawɛ o dɔɔ kɛɛ o nime la sie teɡɛ harɛ.
Ba bɛlbwa aa bie dɔ ka tel ba serewe bena.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa dɛ do heyaa bwa ta, ásɛ harɛ maa kpɔ heyaa dɛɛ ba o ta ba soŋni nɔ bɛ heyaa ba le tɛ.
He bɛ nɛra la maa dɛ ba doŋa he sie he kpɔ ba harɛ la da ba kpɔ, ba kpoŋe da waa wola were waa n kii ba.
N baɡɛ heyaa nyoa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ ba harɛɛ tɛ heya hé so o ta o den ɛ he kon, harɛpare ondɛɛɡe.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n le heyaa korɛ harɛre nɛra bwa bini la.
Anomanta, hé pere ola ne jumbii aa wera dɛ chɛ kɛ he dia le anɔ la aa wola were ne dii ta.
He bɛ ol bɛlbwa kɛɛ jumbie kɛɛ anɔ la aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh harɛ nɔ ta n lea cheɡ ŋɔ aa were ne dii la ba di dɛ́ kah doŋa.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé do ɡoroŋ dɛ́ che tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ men Korowii n do ɡoroŋ, asɛ dɛ le heyaa cheɡ harɛre nɛra bwa bini, dɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ n nɛra.
Baa kɛɛ haah bɛlbwa waa dɔ daabii dɛɛ bol waa lala be dɛ do he bini la chɛ kɛŋɔ hé foɡro bwea kpo.
Naate seo ɡe dɛ ɡure o nyu ta.”
Mmarare aa chɔ le tɛ sɔfore Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó bol Arɔn bibaala sɔfore la be kɛŋɔ dɛ bɛl lole sewaa, o bɛ o te kpɔ dɛɛ jo o lole la lwe we-ɛɛla ta, dɛ́ kah doŋa, nemenɛ o lole tenten kɛŋɔ nya ne mɛɛ, ne o bihaah kɛɛ bibaa, dɛ nime bibaa kɛɛ dɔɔ, kɛɛ nimambihaah waa wola yalɛ mɔɔ o ne o ta so dembeŋkpoŋ ta wɛɛ nyiŋu.
A ta chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ o te jo o lolanar baa yala we-ɛɛla ta dɛ́ kah doŋa.
Sɔfo bɛlbwa bɛ o nyu fonɛ kɛɛ dɛ kuu o tampona dɛ́ mɔne o bwara á baɡle kɛ o dɛ ɛ lwe.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do ɡoroŋ dɛ́ che tɛ Korowii dɛ bɛ o sɔndɛɛɡe la chɔɡ.
Dɛkalkɛ onee kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah a ɛ kondikwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɛ Korowii kwaa la baa tɛo.
A ta chɛ kɛ sɔfo mo haah waa bɔ jwamane dɛ kah doŋa kɛɛ haah o jaa aa vɛoh.
Dɛkalkɛ sɔfore ɛ nɛra baa do ɡoroŋ.
Nɛra la ɛɛ nyiŋi sɔfore kɛŋɔ nɛra baa do ɡoroŋ, banee kpɔ saraha kondikwaa aa do ɡoroŋ baa tɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la.
Onee Korowii, o do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɡel o nɛra ɡe ɛɛ do ɡoroŋ.
Dɛ sɔfo bihaah dɛ bɔ jwamane dɛ kah doŋa aa, dɛ o mɛɛ wɛɛ do sihiih la.
A chɛ kɛ bá fuuh.
Sɔfo baa leo o bala bini dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ ɛo Sɔfonomoa dɛ doo laala la ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel o nyumpona loromi kɛɛ ó kɛɛ o laala á baɡle kɛ o lɔ lwe ta.
Sɔfonomoa la bɛ bela nɛn aa sewa dɛ chɔ la jo.
O ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe hale dɛ o mɛɛ kɛɛ o nyaa sewa oo, ó ka jo o be dɛ́ kah doŋa, kɛɛ dɛ́ le Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ Dea ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel o kah doŋa, dɛkalkɛ ba fuɡe noo do o nyu ta dɛ ɛo Sɔfonomoa tɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ.
Korowiirii bola.
Haah waa wola baa jemɛ bwa laanee chɛ kɛ ó mo.
O bɛ luhaah kɛɛ haah o jaa aa vɛoh, kɛɛ haah waa ɛ jwamane te dɛ kah doŋa mo.
O dea waa le o ta haah waa wola baa jemɛ bwa laanee chɛ kɛ ó mo.
Gɛɛ dɛ ɡel o bɛ doŋa kpɔ kah o bii o nɛra bini.
Korowiirii leo o do ɡoroŋ.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ó bol Arɔn be kɛŋɔ, o naanar baa ka ba bini bɛlbwa waa di kirihiah la ta chɛ kɛ o kpɔ saraha kondikwaa ba tɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.
Baa bɛlbwa waa di kirihiah ta a ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɔe.
Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ nyoŋe kɛɛ boobi, kɛɛ o bobɛl aa di kirihiah, ne onɔ la o nɔn kɛɛ o nakpala aa sewa, ne chacha te kɛɛ kiribi te, ne nɛn waa dɔ siweela te bwa soo siwi kɛɛ bwadabii weela kɛŋɔ ŋwɛra aa dɛ wi ne, kɛɛ o lure aa chɔɡa.
Arɔn naa te bɛlbwa waa di kirihiah la ta chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ saraha kwaa ba Korowii sie dɛ́ ba fuah.
O di kirihiah, anomanta, a ta chɛ kɛ o kpɔ saraha kwaa ba n sie ba tɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ.
Kɛ wɛɛ won di saraha kwaa baa kpɔa ba tɛo la, anɔ la aa do ɡoroŋ kohona dɛ ɛ o kwaa la ne anɔ la aa do ɡoroŋ la bwa, kɛ o kirihiah dii nomanta, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó suuh tel pateesan la á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ bɛne saraha kon laanee, dɛ́ ba kpɔ doŋa kah o bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ la.
Korowiirii ɡela a do ɡoroŋ.
Gɛ waa nɔɔ Mosis bol Arɔn ne o bibaala dɛ Israel tena bwa be.
Saraha kwaa ɡoroŋ doe wa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Arɔn ne o bibaala be kɛŋɔ, bá nyiŋi Israel tena saraha aa do ɡoroŋ ba yon kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ la ta kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ n sɔndɛɛɡe waa do ɡoroŋ la chɔɡ.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Berɛ ŋɔ ba be kɛŋɔ, ba naanar baa ka ba la bini bɛlbwa waa kah doŋa dɛ ɡarɛ ba Israel tena saraha aa do ɡoroŋ ba kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ la jwɛɛh la, bá bara naate n sie bala.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Arɔn naanar bini bɛlbwa bwadabii weebuula aa lɔ o nɛ, kɛɛ o bwara aa won bala saŋ bɛlbwa la ta chɛ kɛ ó di saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la, nemenɛ a ɡɛ doŋa le o nɛɛ mɔɔ.
O berɔ leɡe komɛlbwa konlale aa kpɔ doŋa kaoh, kɛɛ nomɛlbwa o bwara aa won bala saŋ bɛlbwa, kɛɛ dɛ leɡe kontuuɡi waa ɡela o kah doŋa, kɛɛ dɛ nɛnee yoo, kɛɛ komɛlbwa waa ɡel ó kah doŋa bwa la, nemenɛ doŋa la le o nɛɛ mɔɔ.
Sɔfo bɛlbwa waa leɡe a ɡɛ kon nɔ bɛlbwa la kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Waa berɛ won di saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la bɛlbwa, nemenɛ ó sɔ nee mɔɔ.
Wee aa le harɛ la, dɛ naate doŋa bwa le o nɛ, ásɛ mɔɔ o won di saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la, dɛkalkɛ a ɛ sɔfo la kondikwa.
A ta chɛ kɛ ó di konlale waa kaa piu, kɛɛ onɔ la kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡe aa lawɔ á che a ta ó kah doŋa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Sɔfore bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la maa do ba a ta, dɛ bɛ sie laa kpɔ a ta, dɛ́ di bolchɔɡe dɛ́ ba sewɛ.
Menee Korowii, menee lee ba cheɡ dɛ ɡel ba do ɡoroŋ.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola sɔfore dea leɛ la ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ó di saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ nɔ.
Hɔɔh waa baa choɡo, kɛɛ nɛn waa lɔ o be dɛɛ ɛ toma wɛɛ bɔɔ kem ɡe ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ ó di.
Kɛ dɛ sɔfo yawɛ yom aa, o won ɡɛ kwaa la dii, ɡɛɛ nɛndɔɔle baa lolɔ dem bela ɡe won a dii.
Sɔfo bɛlbwa bihaah waa ka yalɛ nɛmpɛɛ waa wola sɔfo ɛɛ la, ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ó di saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ nɔ.
Kɛ sɔfo bɛlbwa bihaah o jaa aa sewa kɛɛ dɛ vɛoh dɛ o ta bii dɔe, asɛ dɛ berɛ ba so o mɛɛ be wɛɛ nyiŋu kɛ o bechale saŋ la, o dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ó di kondikwaa bɛlbwa aa ɛ o mɛɛ kwaa la.
Kɛ nɛmpɛɛ waa wola ŋwɛnɛ dɔe la te ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó dia.
Nomɛlbwa waa koni di saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ nɔ la chɛ kɛ ó nyin a nachiɡe ba tɛ sɔfo.
Dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ ane ja.
Ba bɔne o bini bɔre anue naa, ó kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ja tɛ sɔfo la.
Sɔfore la ta chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ doŋa kah Israel tena saraha aa do ɡoroŋ ba kpɔ ba ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra baa wola ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ba dia la di.
Sɔfore baa laa sie kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ ta la ɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra di bolchɔɡe, dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra.
Menee Korowii, men ɡela a do ɡoroŋ.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ó bol Arɔn ne o bibaala dɛ Israel tena bwa be ŋɔ, “He bini bɛlbwa, kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he bini kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah la, dɛɛ ba ba tɛ mɛ dɛ nyobaɡa chuɡra saraha kɛɛ saraha aa le o bambile taa yaa, a chɛ kɛ náate lawɛ kondɛɛre waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, ombal waa ɛ nao kɛɛ pee kɛɛ booh waa maɡra dɛ tɛ saraha la, ásɛ n won lɛ dɛ́ ɛ waa naate aa dɛ nyin tɛo.
Nomɛlbwa bɛ kon waa di kirihiah kpɔ ba ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii, dɛkalkɛ maa lɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ waa waa dɛ nyin tɛo.
Nomɛlbwa lawɛ kondɛɛre ba ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha dɛɛ ba bá tɛ men Korowii aa, dɛ nyobaɡa chuɡra kɛɛ saraha aa le o bambile taa yoo, naate ɡel a ɡɛ kondɛɛre la su siwi dɛ bɛ kirihiah bɛlbwa di.
Nomɛlbwa bɛ kondɛɛre waa nyoŋa kɛɛ dɛ kuuɡi, kɛɛ baa doo bol kɛɛ waa kwaɡa, ne onɔ la ŋwɛra aa lɔ o nɛɛ dɛɛ wi ne, kpɔ ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.
Kondɛɛre waa do ken nɔ bɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛ, ó kpɔ ba saraha kon la ta ŋɔ, bá fuh tɛ men Korowii.
Saraha aa le he bambile ta la te, hɛɛ won kpɔ nao kɛɛ pee o bobɛl aa di kirihiah kɛɛ dɛ mule ba.
Kɛ waa were tɛ nyobaɡa chuɡra saraha.
Kondɛɛre lur waa mala, kɛɛ dɛ paɡraa ba paɡra kɛɛ teŋa ba teŋo woo, he bɛ kwaa aa do ɡɛ nɔ kpɔ ɛ saraha he harɛre ta.
He bɛ ɡɛ kondɛɛre nɔ bɛlbwa lɛ le nɛŋhɔɔh be ba ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.
Waa were dɛɛ su men Korowii siwi kɛ ń lɛo, o bobɛl aa di kirihiah la nomanta.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Dɛ nao, pee kɛɛ booh lolɔ aa, o bie la chɛ kɛ ó do o nya lɔɡa tɔpera anuanɛ.
Le tɔpenuatoro wee dɛɛ kaa la, o wer kɛŋɔ he won kpɔ ɛ saraha ba fuuh tɛ men Korowii.
He bɛ nao kɛɛ pee ne o bie bwa pɛ teŋe a baŋa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ.
Hé kpɔ jam kwaa dɛɛ ba saraha ɛɛ tɛ mɛ naa, hé ɛa ɡɛ aa chɛa dɛ́ won su siwi ń lɛa.
A chɛ kɛ hé di o bwa awola tenten.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ o pera ɡela tɔɔ per o ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.
He bɛ n sɔndɛɛɡe waa do ɡoroŋ la chɔɡ.
A chɛ kɛ Israel tena bwa jem mɛ kɛŋɔ n do ɡoroŋ.
Menee Korowii, menee ɡela hɛɛ do ɡoroŋ, dɛ lawɛ heya le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ɛ Korowii haa dɛɛ tom mɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Tɔpejena Korowii aa lea cheɡ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Anɔɔ ɛ n tɔpejena maa lea cheɡ a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé bwa cheme dɛ́ɛ tom mɛ a ta.
Ona Tɔpere wa Tɔpera anumɛlee lole kɛ hé kpɔ ɛ he tomare, kɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee la ɛ Ona Tɔpere.
O ɛ tɔpere hé bwa aa cheme dɛ́ɛ tom mɛ o ta.
He bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ o ta bobɛlbwa haa soɡa, o ɛ Ona Tɔpere dɛ tɛ Korowii.
Galekaa ne Paanoo Baa Wola Iisi A Ta Do Tɔpejena Tɔpejena men Korowii aa lea cheɡ ŋɔ hé cheme dɛ́ɛ di laanee nɔ.
Korobiloɡle la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ, wee aa dɛɛ le harɛ la, hé pa Galekaa Tɔpejen la dii mun n sɔn ta.
A ɡɛ korobie nɔ tenten ta tɔpera fi dɛ anue ta la, hé pa Paanoo Baa Wola Iisi A Ta Do Tɔpejen dii la mun.
Hé di paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpere waa tɔ sie a ɡɛ tɔpera nɔ dii ta la, hé bwa cheme dɛ́ tomɛ men Korowii dɛ bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ.
A ɡɛ tɔpera anuanɛ nɔ bwa taa chɛ kɛ bɛ́lbwa kpɔ o saraha baa fuah bá tɛ mɛ.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la telaa, a chɛ kɛ hé berɛ cheme dɛ́ tom mɛ, kɛ bɛlbwa bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa tel harɛ maa dɛ ba kpɔe tɛ heyaa la ta, asɛ hɛɛ komɛ he koo kondikwa aa, hé kpɔ mea vɔwa del aa ɛ loɡla kwaa la ka tɛ sɔfo.
Sɔfo la ɡee kpɔɔ ka ɡɔɔra nyundua, dɛ́ viiɡa n sie ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ Ona Tɔpere la habɔɔ, ásɛ n lɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ waa waa dɛ nyin la tɛo.
Awola tenten haa ɛ saraha nɔ la, a chɛ kɛ hé lawɛ pebie ombal waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii dɛ di benanyoa la ɛ saraha baa fuuh tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ mea saraha men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ kuruware anɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ noo koo a ta ja fuh tɛ mɛ.
A ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuh a bwa a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be.
Dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ sen pɛrɛntoa beŋkpoŋ ne fah ɛ sen saraha ja a ta.
He bɛ paanoo bɛlbwa kɛɛ mefala anwɔɔra kɛɛ aŋhuuhne chwe, nemenɛ awola tenten haa ɛ saraha nɔ ba tɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la mɔɔ.
Gɛ waa nɔɔ chɛ kɛ á chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba bwa, bobɛlbwa haa soɡa.
Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen dii Hé kure yawanyoa anuanɛ dɛ́ le awola sɔfore la aa ka kpɔ mea vɔwa del ba ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ la ta.
Ona Tɔpera bele anuanɛ ta, tɔpere waa teŋa dɛ ɛ tɔpera fifraanue ta la, hé kpɔ meloɡla ba ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii.
Hé kpɔ paanobire anɛnɛ le dem bɛlbwa ta ba ɛ saraha baa ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ viiɡa men Korowii sie, a ɛ kondikonloɡla saraha tɛ mɛ.
Men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ kuruware anɛ iisi aa lɔ a ta laanee hé kpɔ wɔɔra.
Pebali anuanɛ a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ, ne pebala anɛ a bini bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii chɛ kɛ hé lawɛ ja paanoo la ta ɛ saraha.
Baa fuah tɛ men Korowii dɛ́ kpɔ mea sarahare ne sen saraha la ja a ta.
A ɛ saraha baa fuah a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som n be.
Hé berɛ kpɔ bombal ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ pebiiri anɛ bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa ɡe ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
Sɔ́fo la kpɔ kondikonloɡla paanoo la ne pebiiri anɛ la, dɛ́ ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa n sie ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.
Anee ɛ saraha aa do ɡoroŋ kohona ba ɛa dɛɛ tɛ men Korowii a ɛ sɔfore la kwa.
Awola tɔpere la chɛ kɛ hé ɡel he tomare bwa bil, dɛ́ cheme dɛ́ tom mɛ.
A chɛ kɛ á ɛ waa aa chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba bobɛlbwa haa soɡa.
He dɛ komɛ he koo kondikwa aa, he bɛ anɔ la aa lɔ koo nyoa tenten la komɛ.
He bɛ anɔ la aa leera la ɡe kuuh dɛɛ ja.
He ɡela tɛ nyaara ne hɔɔhra.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.” Bɛle Hoeh Tɔpejen dii Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Korobinuanɛ tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, hé onɛ dɛ́ bwa cheme bɛle hoeh ne dɛ́ɛ tomɛ men Korowii.
He bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ ásɛ dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ba tɛ mɛ.” Wechɔɡa Soŋa Korowii Be Ó Kpɔ Kɛ Tɔpejen Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Korobie anuanɛ nɔ ta, o tɔpera fi ɛ Wechɔɡa Soŋa Korowii Be Ó Kpɔ Kɛ Tɔpejen.
Hé bwa vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ́ cheme, dɛ́ tom mɛ awola tɔpere, dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ba tɛ mɛ.
He bɛ toma ɛ awola tɔpere la ta, o ɛ Wechɔɡa Soŋa Korowii Be Ó Kpɔ Kɛ Tɔpejen.
Awola tɔpere laanee bá soŋe he wechɔɡa men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la be, ń kpɔ dɛɛ kɛ heya.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola nyoa vɔwɛ awola tɔpere la chɛ kɛ bá pero le o nɛra bini.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa ɛ toma tɔpere la ta la, mɛɛ kpoo.
He bɛ toma bɛlbwa sese ɛ. Gɛ waa nɔ chɛ kɛ á chɔ le tɛ he ne naanar baa kaa ba bobɛlbwa haa soɡa.
O ɛ Ona Tɔpere tɛ heya, a chɛ kɛŋɔ nómɛlbwa vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ́ onɛ o ta.
Ó pa mun le korobie la tɔpera anuanaarɛ wee aa jo la ta, dɛ́ ba o tɔpera fi ta jɔmɔra.” Kukure Tɔpejen dii Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Korobie anuanɛ la tɔpera fi dɛ anue taa Kukure Tɔpejen dii ɛɛ pa mun.
Tɔpera anuanɛɛ baa diu.
Tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, hé cheme dɛ́ tom mɛ dɛ́ ɡel he tomare bwa bil.
Hé kpɔ kwaa haa fuah ɛ saraha tɔpera anuanɛ la bwa ba tɛ mɛ, ásɛ tɔpenuatoro wee la, hé bwa cheme dɛ́ tom mɛ dɛ́ fuh saraha kwaa tɛ mɛ.
A ɡɛ tɔpere laanee dɛ́ ka mun he tɔpejen chema la ta, anomanta, hé ɡel he tomare bwa bil.
Anɔɔ n tɔpejena maa lea cheɡ kɛŋɔ hé cheme dɛ́ɛ tom mɛ a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah ba tɛ mɛ.
Saraha kwaa baa fuah ne mea sarahare dɛ sen sarahare te bɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ tɔpejena nɔ bɛlbwa ta laanee la.
Gɛ saraha kwaa nɔ ja Ona Tɔpere saraha kwaa ne koŋkɛɛla, ne nyobaɡa chuɡra sarahare dɛ sarahare aa le he bambile ta haa kpɔ baa tɛ men Korowii bwa ta.
Anomanta, korobinuanɛ tɔpera fi dɛ anue haa ba komɛ he kooni kondikwaa tonɛ la, hé di Kukure Tɔpejen nɔ tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpere waa tɔ sie la ɛ Ona Tɔpere, asɛ tɔpenuatoro la ɡe, hé onɛ o ta.
Tɔpere waa tɔ sie la, hé kpɔ daa nɔna aa wera kohona, dɛ́ kpɔ bambie papooni ne daa a papooni aa wara ne daa ane aa cheɡɛ nee nyoa a fee warɛ a ta, dɛ lɛ he sie tɔpera anuanɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ nɔ sɔn ta.
Hé di ɡɛ tɔpejen nɔ bena bɛlbwa tɔpera anuanɛ.
Gɛ waa nɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ á chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba bwa.
Hɛ́ɛ diu korobie anuanɛ ta.
Israel tena bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ so kukure lɔɡre tɔpera anuanɛ, ásɛ he naanar jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii ɡela Israel tena so kukure lɔɡre ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.” Gɛɛ a do Mosis baɡle Israel tena tɔpejena Korowii aa lea cheɡ ŋɔ baa dia la.
Ɔleve noo ne paanoo aa cheɡɛ Korowii sie Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ɔleve nodɛɛɡa baa harama kɛrɛdɛ ba tɛo ó kpɔ dɛɛ do kandea daa la bini, ásɛ o kandere che le dɛɛ hɔ dɛ bɛ dime bwa.
Arɔn chɛ kɛ o che pateesan la sie Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la bini, Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la habɔɔ bela dɛɛ nyiŋi a ta.
Aa che n sie bela jɔmɔraa dɛɛ hɔ tɔɔ ba per chɔɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.
A ɛ waa aa chɔ le tɛ he ne he naanar baa ka ba bwa.
Kandere aa lɔ kandea daa la baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɡbo ɛo o che Korowii sie la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá nyiŋa aa hɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Kpɔ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ ɛ paanoo fi dɛ anɛ.
Kuruware anɛɛ chɛ kɛ hé kpɔ ɛ paanoo la beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa.
Kpɔ paanoo la bil teebur waa cheɡɛ Korowii sie ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛo la ta.
A chɛ kɛ hé bila bɔre anɛ, anumɛl teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ do baŋ bɛl, ásɛ anumɛl ɡe do baŋ bɛl ɡɛ tenten.
Baŋ bɛlbwa ta la, ɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma bil a jwɛh a ɛ saraha kwaa baa fuh cheɡ paanoo la naa ta tɛ Korowii.
Arɔn che Israel tena naa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ paanoo la baa bil Korowii sie Ona Tɔpere bɛlbwa ta.
Ó teŋɛ dɛ́ kpɔa baa bil Korowii sie ɡɛ, á ɛ fɔo Korowii ne Israel tena aa fɔwa o do n ne ba baah ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Paanoo la ɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala kwa aa chɛ kɛ bá dia bela waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛkalkɛ paanoo laanee ɛ saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona, dɛ le saraha kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ tɛ Korowii dɛ ɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala dibɔr la ta.
Nɛnhɛl we-ɛɛla te bwea foɡra Baa bɛl fa lole o mɛɛ ɛ Ijipt te, asɛ o nya ɡe le Israel.
O iro awola bɛl, dɛ la bela Israel tena aa soɡa, asɛ yoi ka chole o ne Israel te bɛl baah.
Dɛ o nya sɔne Sɛlomet, Dibri waa le Dan dea biee on.
Sɛlomet bie la ɛ nɛnhɛlwa dɛ taah Korowii, asɛ ba lawɔ ba Mosis sie, dɛ lawɔ do dea dɛɛ kpa waa Korowii aa ŋɔ bá ɛo.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Hé lawɛ baa waa bol nɛnhɛlwobol la le kaa bela haa soɡa la dahara.
Nomɛlbwa waa noa kɛŋɔ o bol mɛ nɛnhɛlwobol la, bá kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o nyu ta, ásɛ nɛra la bwa foɡro bwea kpo.
Berɛ ŋɔ Israel tena be kɛŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa taah men Korowii waa dɛ tom mɛ la chɛ kɛ ó dɔ deŋnetɛra.
A chɛ kɛ bá kpo nomɛlbwa waa bol men Korowii nɛnhɛlwobol la.
Israel tee kɛɛ nɛŋhɔɔhree yoo, a chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra la bwa foɡre naate bwea kpo.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpo o dɔŋ la chɛ kɛ bá kpo o ɡe, ásɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa kpo o dɔŋ kondɛɛre la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó nyin bɛl ba chiɡ o naa ta tɛ kon te.
Kondɛɛre o siwi taa lolee chɛ kɛ ó lawɛ ba chiɡ onɔ la waa kpoo la naa ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa do o dɔŋ bol la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá do o ɡe bol bɔ kem.
Dɛ naate la hoɡii o ku aa, bá ku o ɡe kon, o siwi beŋkpoŋii o fome aa, bá fome o ɡe kon ɡɛ.
O nyenee o fome aa, bá fome o ɡe nyen.
Gɛ bwa naate aa do o dɔŋ bol laanee chɛ kɛ bá ɛ o ɡe bɔ kem.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpo o dɔŋ kondɛɛre la chɛ kɛ ó nyin bɛl ba chiɡ o naa ta.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa kpo o dɔŋ la te chɛ kɛ bá kpo o ɡe.
Mmara beŋkpoŋii chɛ kɛ ó chɔ le tɛ deela ne hɔɔhra bwa.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.’ ” Mosis aa bol anɔ baɡle Israel tena la, ba kpɔ baa la le kaa bela baa soɡa la dahara, dɛ ka foɡro bwea kpo.
Gɛɛ a do Israel tena la ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la.
Bennuanɛ baa wola harɛ ta parɛ wa Korowii berɔ bol waa Mosis be Sinai Bwejen la ta dɛ ŋɔ ó ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “He baa tel harɛ maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la ta naa, hé koh men Korowii wa, dɛ́ ɡel harɛ la ɡbabir dɔ ona saŋ bɛl tɛ mɛ.
Hé dɔ bene anumɛl dɛ́ parɛ, dɛ́ kuu he ɡrepo daa nyoo ásɛ a won nɔnɛ, dɛ́ boa he koo kondikwaare nyoa.
Kɛ bena waa teŋa nuanɛ ta te, a chɛ kɛ hé ɡel he harɛ la onɛ dɛ tɛ mɛ.
A ta chɛ kɛ he parɛ kooni kɛɛ dɛ́ kuu he ɡrepo daa nyoo.
Hé ɡel tɛ men Korowii.
Kondikwaa a ɡbo aa le he kooni ta he ɡbabir aa wola an due la, hé dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ ka kpɔ tama ba di, kɛ he bɛ an komɛ.
Hé dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ ka tɔɔ ɡrepo daa haa wola a nyoo kuure la nɔna tama, kɛ he bɛ an chaa.
Harɛ la chɛ kɛ ó onɛ ɡɛ bena la ta.
Anɔ la haa ka kpɔa le kooni ta ba di a bena laanee dɛ́ ɛ kondikwaa tɛ he ne he yoma baala ne haahna, ne nɛra baa ɛ toma hɛɛ bɔ ba kem, ne hɔɔhra baa baa so he bini tama, ne he kondɛɛre dɛ kpɔɡ bini ola aa lɔ harɛ la ta te bwa dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ dia.
Komɛlbwa aa le harɛ la ta bwa, ba won a dii.
Benanyoa baa berɛ kwaa dɛɛ tɛ a tena Dɛ he kure Ona Tɔpera anuanɛ bele anuanɛ naa, aa ɛ bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ anuanaarɛɛ.
A ɡɛ bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ la habɔɔ, korobie anuanɛ tɔpera fi ta la, hé ɡel ba hoh bɛla harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa.
O ɛ Wechɔɡa Soŋa Korowii Be Ó Kpɔ Kɛ Tɔpejen, a chɛ kɛ bá hoh bɛla harɛ la ta.
Benanyoa waa teŋa fifraanue la te, hé le cheɡ kɛ bena waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛ́ ɡel nomɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ la ta no kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa won o nyu dii name.
O ɛ bena komɛlbwa kɛɛ nomɛlbwa aa bera dɛɛ kaa bela waa lea.
Dɛ nomɛl fa yoɡ o kon kɛŋɔ, harɛ waa ɛ o dea kondɔɔh tɛ o dɔŋ aa, o berɛ kaa kon tena be.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe baa yoɡu o ɛ yom la berɛ kaa o nɛra be, dea waa le o ta.
A ɡɛ benanyoa waa teŋa fifraanue nɔ, a ta chɛ kɛ hé du komɛlbwa he kooni ta, kɛɛ hé komɛ anɔ la a ɡbo aa lea, kɛɛ dɛ́ chaa ɡrepo daa nɔna haa wola a nyoo kuure dɛ kwaara cheɡ.
O ɛ bena komɛlbwa kɛɛ nomɛlbwa aa bera dɛɛ kaa bela waa lea.
A chɛ kɛ ó do ɡoroŋ tɛ heya.
Hɛɛ di kondikwaa haa dɔa le kooni ta la ɡbo.
A ɡɛ bena nɔ ta, nomɛlbwa kon waa yawa le o dɔŋ be chɛ kɛ ó berɛ kaa o dɔɔ be.
Anomanta, dɛ he yoɡ harɛ kɛɛ dɛ yawɛ le he dɔŋ be naa, a ta chɛ kɛ he den kpɔ berɛ he kon kwara.
Dɛ he dɛ yoɡ harɛ kɛɛ dɛ yawɛ dɛɛ le he dɔŋ be naa, nyiŋi bene haa dɔa dɛ́ kpɔ parɛ harɛ la mɔɔ dɛ́ di o yoɡ.
Gɛ del haa parɛ la taa chɛ kɛ hé nyiŋi dɛ́ yawɛ.
Dɛ naate dɛ yawɛ harɛ la ó biɡri o nɔn ta naa, a chɛ kɛ yoɡ la kaa nyundua, kɛ dɛ tɔpere la aa jaŋne doe ba naa, amɔ yoɡ la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ba harɛ.
Dɛkalkɛ kondikwaa aa le harɛ la ta ɡboo o yoɡ dɛɛ tɛɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ́ɛ berɛ dɔŋa faahra.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare bwa ta, ásɛ dɛ won so sodɛɛɡa harɛ nɔ ta he bwara sɔɔh heya.
Harɛ la ɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa tɛ heyaa he di ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ so bosɔɔhna ta.
Bɛl ɛɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, ‘Bena waa teŋa nuanɛ yaa wola komɛlbwa kooni ta due kɛɛ yaa wola daa nɔna chaa nɔ, dɛ bɔkwaa yaa ba dɔe dɛ diɔ?’ Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la do wer kohona bennumɛl la ta, ásɛ kondikwaa aa le o ta ba la won tel heya bene atoro.
Haa parɛ bennuatoro ta la, bennumɛl kondikwaa la ane ta ɛɛ kao, dɛ́ tel heyaa ka tel saŋ haa berɛ ba komɛ bennuanaarɛ kwa.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ harɛ yoɡa tɛ nɛn o den ɛ o kon kwara, dɛkalkɛ he ɡbabir kon laa.
Men Korowii konee.
He do kɛŋɔ hɔɔhra dɛɛ nyiŋi o ta.
Nomɛlbwa baa yoɡ harɛ tɛo la, ó jemɛ kɛŋɔ harɛ te la dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ó berɛ ba lɛ o kon.
Dɛ he bini bɛl nyao dɛɛ yoɡ o kondɔɔh kon bɛl aa, o lole tenten lɛ yawɛ.
Naate la ta lole bɛlbwa dɔe o yawɛ kon la dɛ berɛ ba dɔ suuɡa aa, ó kpɔ kon la ɛ o ɡbabir kon.
Dɛ nɛmpɛɛ yawa aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔɔ kem, dɛ harɛɛ yaa, ɡɛ naate fe aa parɔ ka tel mɔɔ bodia benanyoa tel la, ó bɔɔ o kem ɡɛ.
Kɛ dɛ kon te la aa suuɡaa dɔ dɛ́ kpɔ lɛ o kon la tenaa, ó do naate nɔn ta ka tel bodia benanyoa la ta mɔɔ kon te la lɛ o kon.
Dɛ nomɛl yoɡ dem waa lɔ bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛjen baro ta naa, o berɔ dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ berɛ bɔ o kem, dɛ́ lɛ o kon benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta.
Kɛ dɛ naate ta wone bɔ kem la dɛ lɛ dem la benanyoa beŋkpoŋ la tenten ta naa, o ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ ó won lɛ kpa.
O berɛ naate waa yawa la ne o naanar kon, baa wola berɛ kpɔ kon te kon tɛo kpa.
Hale bodia bena la ta.
Deene aa lɔ bwɛjeɡre ta baa wola danjwɛjen bɛlbwa mae bara la tena te dɔ ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ́ bɔ a kem dɛ́ berɛ lɛ.
Bodia bena la ɡe telaa, naate la won kon te kon kpɔe dɛ tɛo.
Lewi dea tena te dɔ ŋwɛnɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ bɔ ba deene baa yoɡa ba bwɛɛre ta kem dɛ́ lɛ.
Dɛ Lewi dea te dɔ dem bwɛjena nɔ bɛlbwa ta dɛ yoɡ, o ta wone berɛ bɔ o kem dɛ lɛ aa, naate waa yawa la chɛ kɛ ó berɛ kon la tɛ bodia benanyoa la ta.
Dɛkalkɛ deremi baa dɔa ba bwɛjena ta laanee ɛ ba ɡe kondɔɔh tenten Israel tena bini.
Kondɛɛra dibɔra aa bar Lewi dea tena bwɛɛre dahare la ta chɛ kɛ ba yoɡa.
A ɛ ba kondɔɔh aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ a le ba nɔn ta saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.
He dɔŋ Israel te soɡe he baah dɛ nya o ta suuɡa dɔe dɛ́ cha o te naa, hé chao kɛŋɔ haa cha hɔɔh he ne waa soɡa, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ o ta won so he baah ta.
Hɛɛ berɛ a nee bɛlbwa kpɔe dɛ́ chɔŋɛ a ta, he ɔmɛ Korowii ásɛ o won so he baah ta.
Suuɡa bɛlbwa haa kemɔ la, hɛɛ berɛ a nee bɛlbwa kpɔe dɛ́ chɔŋɛ a ta, ɡɛɛ aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ yoɡ dawɛ kondikwaa haa yoɡ tɛo ta.
Men Korowiirii bola, menee le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ Keenan harɛ tɛ heyaa o ɛ he kon, dɛ ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.
He dɔŋ Israel te nyao dɛɛ nyin o yoɡ o te tɛɛ kɛŋɔ yom aa, a ta chɛ kɛ hé ɡel o ɛ toma kɛŋɔ yom.
Gel ó so kɛŋɔ nɛn waa ba dɛ ɛ toma hɛɛ bɔɔ kem, kɛɛ hɔɔh waa bala dɛ ba so tama, dɛɛ tomɛ ka tel bodia benanyoa la ta.
Gɛ saŋ nɔɔ naate ne o bii ɛɛ ba ba lolanar be kaala, dɛ́ ka so ba kondɔɔh ta.
Israel tena aa ɛ n bonɔɔna n kpɔ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta ba nomanta, a ta chɛ kɛ bá yoɡ ba kɛŋɔ yoma.
Hé ɔmɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ ban fiiɡi.
Dɛ he dɛ nyin yoma aa, hɛɛ won yaɡ ba le harɛre aa bar heyaa la ta.
Hɛɛ won yawɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa baa so he bini tama, dɛ́ loɡle he harɛ ta bii bá ɛ he nɛndɔɔla.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ he kondɔɔh, dɛ́ kpɔ ba do he bii ɡe nɔn ta kɛŋɔ he kapɛrɛ kwa, ásɛ baa tom ba dɛ ka tel saŋ baa ba serewe.
Kɛ hɛɛ berɛ he bala Israel tena fiiɡa.
Dɛ nɛŋhɔɔh waa soɡe he bini dɔ suuɡa, asɛ he bini bɛl nya dɛ yoɡ o te tɛo kɛŋɔ yom kɛɛ dɛ tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra la lolanar bini bɛlbwa naa, o ta dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ bá lɛo ba o nɛra bini.
O lolanar bini bɛl ɛɛ won bɔ o nyu kem la dɛ́ lɛo.
O naara kɛɛ o naara ɡe bie, kɛɛ o lole tenten bini bɛlbwa ɛɛ won bɔ o nyu kem dɛ́ lɛo.
Dɛ o ɡbabir ɡee bera ba dɔ suuɡa aa, wɛɛ won bɔ o nyu kem la, dɛ́ lɛ o te.
O ne naate waa yawɔ la kure saŋ waa yoɡ o te tɛo dɛ ka tel bodia benanyoa la ta.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔɔ ɡɛ haa kpɔ nɛn o ɛ toma tɛɛ bene waa ɛ toma, he yon bɔɔ kem la.
Dɛ bene aa kaa la ta kan aa, a chɛ kɛ ó nyin suuɡa baa kpɔa yawɔ la pera tɛo, dɛ́ le ɡɛ bene aa kaa la aa doa.
Dɛ a ka tama mɔɔ bodia benanyoa la tel aa, he nyiŋi dɛ́ bɔ suuɡa tama aa chɛa tɛo dɛ́ lɛ o te.
Nɛŋhɔɔh la nyiŋi naate kɛ o bonɔɔ waa kpɔɔ dɛɛ bɔɔ kem benanyoa bɛlbwa ken.
Nyiŋi kɛŋɔ haa on fiiɡa bɛlbwaa fiiɡi.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, o ta wone lɛ o te dɛ ta do nɛn waa yawɔ la lɔɡa aa, o ne o bii bwa dɛ dɔ ba te bodia benanyoa la ta, dɛkalkɛ n bonɔɔnaa Israel tena n laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.”
Deŋnepwɛr Kembɔr Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “He bɛ voɡa kɛɛ kon haa sɛoh kɛɛ bwe kpɔ pa dɛɛ tomɔ.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
Hɛ́ɛ di n Ona Tɔpera la, ásɛ dɛ ɡel duure do n Dea bela.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hé dɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta kɛrɛdɛ naa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bwaala nɛ o saŋ ta kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ harɛ la ɛ kondikwaa kohona, daa haa dua he kooni ta ɡe bwa won nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Kondikwaa bala aa ba kohona nomanta, hɛɛ do mea lɔɔra taa dɛ daa nɔna chaara joɔ, ásɛ haa ba chaa daa nɔna ɡe la, dɛ mea ɡe dui saŋ telo.
Hɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyinii dɛ́ di, dɛ́ so deŋnesɔɔhna ta he harɛ ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo hé dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna harɛ la ta, ásɛ dɛ he chɔɔɡɔ kwaraa naa, nomɛlbwa aa won ba aah heya.
Mɛɛ le kpɔɡ bini ola aa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa nee.
Haa laa ɡbɔɡa ɡee no kpa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo hé ti he dɔma dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ he nɛra banue yo nɛra lafa dɛ́ won pɔ ba nɛ, he nɛra lafa ɡe won yo nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Mɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel he mun ya kohona, ásɛ n ne he fɔo yaa fɔwɛ la che.
Hɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa di a ka anfala baa pua, ásɛ he le ambena la ne ka ta, dɛ́ dɔ bɔr do anfala la.
Mɛɛ so he be n Tɛnte Dea la binii.
Maa habɔɔ berɛ kpo heyaa bwa.
Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ, dɛ́ ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ he ɡe ɛ n nɛra.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, ásɛ he bɛ yoma ɛ tɛɛ ba kpa.
Menee le heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa ta, dɛ́ ɡel a le he baŋa he paŋi dɛɛ valɛ la.
Deŋnekpeɡ ɛɛ deŋnetɛra Dɛ he ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛɛ no waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta nɔ, dɛ vɛh me Mmarare ne n waa ta teŋa, dɛ chɔɡ fɔo n ne haa fɔwa la aa, mɛɛ kpɔ ɔmee tenten ne bambiteŋa ne weela aa ba he nɛɛ he chah kahonɛ, ne bɔwɔrɔba aa kpɔ nyoŋa ba ta he nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ heya.
Hɛɛ du kondikwa he kooni ta pɛɛpɛɛ, he dɔmaa dɛ́ ba dia.
N sie ɛɛ beɡre he nɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he dɔma pɔ he nɛ, dɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he nɛ.
Ɔmee kohona nomanta, hɛɛ dɛɛ chwaaɡoo dɛ nomɛlbwa aa heyaa doŋi.
Hale anɔ bwa habɔɔ dɛ haa n be no aa, mɛɛ berɔ ja he deŋnetɛra ta bele anuanɛ.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ he deŋnekpeɡ mbarafo we-ɛɛla bwaa, maa ɡel bwaala nɛ, ásɛ harɛ bwa hol dɛ́ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ buni ken.
He koeh bwa dɛ ba pɛɛ ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ kondikwaa bɛlbwa ɛɛ chɔɡ he harɛ la taa, ásɛ daa ɡe aa nɔnɛ.
He ta teŋɛ he deŋnekpeɡ la ta haa n waa ta teŋaa, mɛɛ berɔɔ ja he deŋnetɛra la ta bele anuanɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ba jo he bini, dɛ́ ba kpoo he bii, dɛ́ chɔɡ he kondɛɛra bwa soo siwi.
He bini tamaa kenii dɛɛ ba kae, anomanta, he ŋwɛnɛre ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ.
Dɛ deŋnetɛra nɔ habɔɔ, haa n waa ta teŋɛ, dɛ taŋ deŋne haa men bu aa, n ɡbabir ɛɛ beɡre sie he nɛɛ, dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne kohona a ɡwaa loɡla kwaa la bele anuanɛ ja.
Laa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta he nɛ, chɔɡa haa chɔɡ n ne he fɔo la wa.
He dɛ nyin he nyuune dɛ chwa kaa bwɛɛre ta kaa sɔh aa, mɛɛ kpɔ weechɔɡaa ba ta he nɛ.
Anɔ taa aa ba cheɡa hé kpɔ he te do he dɔma nɔɔra ta, ásɛ dɛɛ tom ba.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo kondikwaa waa do kpeɡri, ásɛ haahna fi pɛ wɔɔ he paanoo bwa kombeŋkpoŋ baa kpɔa dɛɛ wɔɔ paanoo bini.
Baa maɡa tɛ heya he di haa vaɡre.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, he ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ haa n waa ta teŋaa, ate mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia kohonaa ba ta he nɛ, dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne bele anuanɛ ɡwa wubwa la.
Lɔr la nomanta, hɛɛ chwe he bibaala ne he bihaahna olaa.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ bela haa dɛ tomɛ voɡa a do deŋɡarere dor laanee, ne he daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma fuih bɔra, ásɛ dɛ boa he lala nyoa dawɛ he voɡa aa wola mkpa bɛlbwa dɔe la ta, dɛ́ berɛ habɔɔ kpo heya.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ he bwɛjena ne bela haa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la bwaa.
Ásɛ he sarahare haa fuah dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la, n sie aa a sɔɔh taa lɛ kpa.
Gɛ maa chɔɡ harɛ la ɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma baa ba so o ta la bambile chɔɡ kohona.
Kɛ he te, mɛɛ ɡeloo he peɡre, dɛ́ ka so nɛra bane harɛre ta.
Laa nee mɛɛ ba heyaa doŋa, ásɛ dɛ paɡre he bwɛjena a berɛ dimɡbeeni.
Belaa he harɛre la ɛɛ ba ona dɛ le saŋ haa peɡra dɛ ka soŋni he dɔma harɛre ta la ta.
Nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ so harɛ la ta nomanta, wɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ ásɛ dɛ ɡe di Ona Tɔpera saŋ haa soɡe o ta he ta ɡelɛ o won onɛ la.
Kɛ he nɛra haa ba ka la te la, mɛɛ ɡeloo ɔmee chole banɛɛ kohona ba dɔma harɛre baa soɡe a ta la ta, ásɛ peu ta ba no papooni kwaraa sii dɛɛ chwa.
Hɛɛ kpɔ sibeɡraa dɛɛ chwa kɛŋɔ baa pamɛ kere teŋɛ he nɛɛ la ken, ásɛ he ka choɡli dɛ nɛn aa heyaa doŋi.
Hɛɛ ka lɔ dɔŋaa, dɛ́ choɡli dɛ nomɛlbwa ta he nɛɛ teŋɛ.
Haa won che he dɔma bɛlbwa sie he ne ba yo.
Nɛra bane harɛre taa hɛɛ ba serewa, ásɛ ba huɡe heya.
Hé banɔ la haa ba ka dɛ́ do he dɔma harɛre ta la, he ne he naawa wechɔɡa nomanta, aa hiah heyaa.
Kɛ dɛ ba bol ba ne ba naawa wechɔɡa, ne deŋnekpeɡ baa ɛɛ mɛ dɛ lɛ ɡaeh n nɛ, dɛ ɡel n baah di ba nɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba ka ta ba dɔma harɛ ta ŋɔ ba ka bela.
Ba baa charɛ ba liire dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ aa, belaa mɛɛ ba ń lii n fɔo n ne Jekɔb ne Aesek dɛ Abraham aa fɔwa la wa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ harɛ maa baɡ ba nyoa la tɛɛ ba.
Kɛ ba bwa ɛɛ chwao le harɛ la ta, ásɛ o chɔ pɛɛ dɛ́ onɛ ɡɛ aa chɛa.
Ásɛ dɛ bɔ ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la bwa kem, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh me Mmarare ta teŋa.
Dɛ ba ta lɔ ba dɔma harɛre ta kwaraa naa, maa ban ɡel, mɛɛ chɔɡ baa kɛŋɔ baa chɔɡ n ne ba fɔo yaa fɔwa la.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
Mɛɛ koh ba waa, dɛ́ lii n ne ba naawa fɔo yaa fɔwa la.
Gɛ maa ɡela harɛre na n kpeɡri, dɛ lawɛ n nɛra le Ijipt harɛ ba siwi ta la wa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Anɔɔ ɛ Mmarare Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ Sinai Bwejen la ta dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena.
Koŋkɛɛla kpɔe ba tɛ Korowii Mmarare Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Kpɔ waa maa dɛ ba bola nɔ tɛ Israel tena.
Dɛ nomɛl kpɔ nɛn tɛ Korowii dɛ́ kpɔ pur nyobaɡa aa, suuɡa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá bɔ o nyu ta ó dɔ o te laanee ɡɛ bɛlbwa baa sɛah kɛŋɔ bá bɔ.
Baa waa di bene dɛ le fifraanɛ ka tel fifraanumɛl la, bá bɔ suuɡapoŋa fifraanue, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la.
Hanomoa ɡe, suuɡapoŋa fifraatoroo chɛ kɛŋɔ bá bɔ.
Ásɛ bibaa waa di bene dɛ le anue ka tel bene fifraanɛ la ɡe suuɡapoŋa fifraanɛ.
Bihaahna ɡe suuɡapoŋa fi, ásɛ baala bechajeɡre ɡe baa wola bene anue dɔe mɔɔ la suuɡapoŋa anue.
Bechale baa ɛ haahna la, suuɡapoŋa atoro.
Banomonome ɡe baa ɡwaa bene fifraanumɛl la, suuɡapoŋa fi dɛ anue, ásɛ haahna baa ɡwaa bene fifraanumɛl la ɡe suuɡapoŋa fi.
Dɛ nɛn waa baɡɛ nyoa la ɛ nomɛl waa wola won dɔ suuɡa dɛ́ bɔ ɡɛ baa teŋa bil nɔ naa, ó lawɛ o nɛn la ba sɔfo sie, ásɛ o nyiŋi suuɡa aa chɛ kɛ ó bɔ la ta tɛo ó bɔ.
Dɛ naate nyobaɡa kon la ɛ kondɛɛre waa wera kɛ ba kpɔ ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ ɡɛ kondɛɛre la do ɡoroŋ.
Ba bɛ ondoŋ kpɔ charɛ ondɛɛɡe kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ondɛɛɡe charɛ ondoŋ.
A ba ɡɛ naa, dɛ a bwa berɛ Korowii kwa dɛ do ɡoroŋ.
Kɛ dɛ o ɛ kondɛɛre waa wola were kɛ ba kpɔ ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ naate kpɔ ka chaɡle sɔfo.
Onee dɛ́ nyiŋi dɛ́ baɡle o wer ne o wer bɛ doe bwa dɛ́ baɡle o yoɡ.
Gɛ bwa waa baɡle la, dɛ o yoɡii.
Dɛ naate berɔ dɛɛ nyin kɛ ó yawɛ aa, a chɛ kɛ ó bɔ suuɡa la dɛ́ bɔne a bini bɔre anue dɛ́ bɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ja a ta.
Dɛ nɛn kpɔ o dem tɛ ŋɔ o ɛ men Korowii kon aa, sɔfoo chɛ kɛŋɔ ó baɡle o wer ne o wer bɛ doe bwa dɛ́ baɡle o yoɡ.
Gɛ bwa waa baɡle la, dɛ o yoɡii.
Naate waa kpɔ dem la tɛ mɛ la berɔ dɛɛ nyin o yawɛ aa, a chɛ kɛ ó bɔ yoɡ baa teŋa bil la, dɛ́ bɔne suuɡa la bini bɔre anue, dɛ́ bɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ja a ta.
Dɛ nɛn kpɔ o harɛ pera tɛ men Korowii aa, kondwee baa du harɛ la taa baa ba cheɡa, dɛ́ chaɡle harɛ la yoɡ.
Mea kuruware fi bɛlbwa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanue.
Dɛ naate kpɔɔ tɛ mɛ a bena baa berɛ bɛlbwa kon dɛɛ tɛo la ta naa, a chɛ kɛ yoɡ la che ɡɛ.
Kɛ dɛ a habɔɔ, o berɔ kpɔ tɛ mɛ naa, sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó na bene aa kaa mɔɔ ba berɛ bɛlbwa kon dɛɛ tɛo o ta la, dɛ́ ɡel o yoɡ ba harɛ tama.
Dɛ naate la berɔ dɛɛ nyin o kon aa, a chɛ kɛ ó bɔ yoɡ la, ásɛ dɛ bɔne yoɡ la bini bɔre anue, dɛ́ bɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ja a ta dɛ́ berɛ lɛ.
Kɛ dɛ o yoɡo tɛ nɛmpɛɛ dɛ men Korowii nɔn ta laa o do kpa aa, o ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe dɛ́ yawɔ kpa.
Benanyoa baa berɛ bɛlbwa kon dɛɛ tɛo la telo aa, wɛɛ do ɡoroŋee dɛ́ berɛ n kon dɛ́ do sɔfore la nɔn ta.
Dɛ nɛn yawɛ harɛ waa wola ba dem kon pera ɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ mɛ naa, sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó na yoɡ waa chɛa dɛ́ teŋe, dɛ́ ka tel a bena baa berɛ bɛlbwa kon dɛɛ tɛo la ta, ásɛ naate la bɔ yoɡ baa teŋa la awola tɔpere la tenten.
Suuɡa waa bɔ la ɛ men Korowii kwa.
A ɡɛ benanyoa la ta la, a chɛ kɛ naate berɛ harɛ la tɛ kon te waa yawa dɛ le o be la.
Gɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea a ɛ suuɡa bwejeɡre fifraanɛ la taa baa ba nyiŋa, dɛ́ baɡle komɛlbwa yoɡ.
Nomɛlbwa bɛ kondɛɛre biloɡle kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ a ɛ n kwaa wubwa.
Dɛ nao kɛɛ peerii yoo, o ɛ n kon.
Dɛ kondɛɛre waa wola were ne dii yaa, kon te la ɛɛ berɔɔ won yawɔ ɡɛ baa teŋe o yoɡ la, dɛ́ bɔne yoɡ baa teŋa bil la bini bɔre anue dɛ́ bɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ja a ta.
Dɛ kon te la ta berɛ won yawɛ aa, nɛnfale ɛɛ won yawɛ ɡɛ baa teŋe o yoɡ bil la.
Nomɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛ ó yoɡ kɛɛ dɛ berɛ yawɛ kon waa kpɔa ba tɛ mɛ dɛ ku n nɔn la.
Dɛ nɛnee kɛɛ kondɛɛre kɛɛ harɛɛ yoo, o do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ mɛ, dɛ ɛ n kon pi.
Dɛ nɛn kwaraa ba kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta naa, nɛn aa won berɛ yawɔ kpa.
Kpoe dena chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
Kondikwaa bɛlbwa aa le harɛ la ta dɛ ɛ mea kɛɛ daa nɔna la, a chɛ kɛ he bɔne a bɛlbwa bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋa ba tɛ men Korowii.
A ɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ mɛ.
Dɛ nomɛl dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ó berɛ yawɛ a bini bɛlbwa naa, a chɛ kɛ ó bɔ yoɡ baa teŋa bil la, ásɛ dɛ bɔne yoɡ la bini bɔre anue, dɛ́ bɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ja a ta.
Kondɛɛre bɛlbwa bini onɔ la waa ja fi la do ɡoroŋ, dɛ ɛ men Korowii kon.
Haa dɛɛ kura la, hé kpɔ konswɛm pe o bwara á chaɡle kɛ o ɛ n kon.
A ta chɛ kɛ kondɛɛre te la chale a bini, dɛ́ kpɔ bɛl charɛ o dɔŋ.
O ɛ ɡɛ naa, kondɛɛre anɛ la bwa ɛɛ berɔ ɛ men Korowii kwa dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa won berɛ yawa kpa.” Mmarare nɔɔ Korowii che Mosis nɛɛ Sinai Bwejen ta, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Nɛra Kura Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle waa aa chiɡa ɡɛ saŋ Mosis aa tɔ Israel tena sie bene fifraanaarɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la wa.
Dɛ Israel tena sie aa lɛ, asɛ ba baah yon di Mosis ne Korowii nɛ.
Ba liiro kɛŋɔ dɛ ba soɡe Ijipt harɛ ta kwaraa fe bɔ, dɛkalkɛ baa lɔ bela dɛ ba soɔh kɛŋɔ ba ɛ yoma.
Kɛ Korowii nyiŋi ba nɛ, dɛ baɡle Mosis ɡɛ waa bol ba be, ne ɡɛ waa tɔ ba sie, ɡɛ aa ɛ bá won tel harɛ waa ŋɔa wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba la jwɛh ta.
Kera anɛ bwaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó kure ba bwa ba ɡaaɡa la bini.
Nyiŋi nyuune ne .
A taa a che baa yerɛ tɔn nɔ Nɛra Kura Tɔn.
Israel tena kura loɡla Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ta la, ba soɡe Sinai Bwejen pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Ba soɡa bini bennɛɛte korobie waa teŋa nɛɛ o tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, Korowii bol waa Mosis be o Dea Cheremibɔr bela dɛ ŋɔ, “Kure Israel tena bwa.
Kure dea bɛlbwa ne ba lolanar, dɛ́ chwerɛ baala bwa sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa.
Hé ne Árɔn kur ba ɡɛ.
Hé kure le baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ dɛ́ won la laa.
Hé ɡel Israel dea bɛlbwa le nomonnyu ó cha heya.” Baala baa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá cha heyaa laanee nɔ.
Rubin dea, Sɛdor bibaa Elisur, Simeon dea, Surisadai bibaa Sɛlomeɛl, Juda dea, Aminadab bibaa Naasɔn, Isaaka dea, Suar bibaa Nɛtanɛl, Sebulon dea, Hɛlɔn bibaa Eliab.
Josef naanar la ɡe bini, Efrem dea, Amihud bibaa Elisama, Manasɛ dea, Pedasur bibaa Gamaleɛl, Bɛnjamen dea, Gedeɔne bibaa Abidan, Dan dea, Amisadai bibaa Ahiesa, Aasa dea, Okran bibaa Paɡiel, Gad dea, Dewɛl bibaa Eliasaf, Naftale dea, Enan bibaa Ahira.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ le Israel tena bini dɛ ɛ ba deene nomonnyuune.
Banee chɔ Israel tena nyoa.
Mosis ne Arɔn kpɔ ɡɛ nɛra baa kpɔ ba sɔna tɛɛ ba la, asɛ dɛ yerɛ Israel tena bwa cheme korobinɛɛte la tɔpere waa tɔ sie la ta.
Nɛra la yerɛ ba deene ne ba lolanar sɔna a baɡle bela baa lea, asɛ ba chwerɛ baala baa di bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ la sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la.
O kur ba Sinai Bwejen pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Ba pa mun dɛ kure le Jekɔb baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Israel la biloɡle Rubin naanar nɛ.
Baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ, dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Rubin dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banumɛl lafraanue.
Simeon naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ, dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Simeon dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue dɛ banuanaarɛ lafraatoro.
Gad naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ, dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Gad dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue, lafraanumɛl fifraanue.
Juda naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ, dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Juda dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banaarɛ lafraanumɛl.
Isaaka naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ, dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Isaaka dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ lafraanaarɛ.
Sebulon naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ, dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Sebulon dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue dɛ banuanɛ lafraanaarɛ.
Josef bibaala ɡe bini, Efrem naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ, dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Efrem dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ lafraanue.
Manasɛ naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ, dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Manasɛ dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ banɛ lafraanɛ.
Bɛnjamen naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Bɛnjamen dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ banue lafraanaarɛ.
Dan naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Dan dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanumɛl dɛ banɛ lafraanuanɛ.
Aasa naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Aasa dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ lafraanue.
Naftale naanaree, baala baa dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ dɛ́ won la laa laanee ba chwerɛ ba sɔna beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ le ba deene ne ba lolanar tɔne bini.
Naftale dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue dɛ batoro lafraanaarɛ.
Mosis ne Arɔn ne nomonnyuune fi dɛ banɛ baa cheɡa tɛ ba deene laanee chwerɛ baala la sɔna ɡɛ baa baɡla la.
Israel baala baa di bene fifraanɛ kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa dɛ́ won ka yo laa la, ba kur ba ɡɛ baa chwerɛ ba sɔna ba lolanar bini.
Dɛ ba bwa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafraanumɛl dɛ batoro, lafraanue fifraanue.
Lewi dea tena te, ba ta ban kure ja a ɡɛ deene la baala nɛ.
Dɛ Korowii fa ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Bɛ Lewi dea tena te kure á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔ baa ja ba bala Israel tena baa kur ba la nɛ.
Kɛ kpɔ n Tɛnte Dea, ne laala aa lɔ o bini dɛ o komɛlbwa do Lewi dea tena la nɔn ta bá chɔ a nyoa.
Banee dɛɛ ba baa che o ne laala aa jaa bwa.
Banee dɛ́ nyiŋi o ta dɛ́ baŋre ba tɛnte deene baro.
Saŋ bɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ n Tɛnte Dea la kaa bobɛl la, Lewi dea tena laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ bá foromu.
Dɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá baŋro ɡe aa, banee dɔ o baŋra.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola dea la ta jae bɛne belaa, bá kpoo.
Israel tena la bɛlbwa baŋre o tɛnte dea bela o ɡbaɡba dea tena aa soɡa, dɛ́ pa ba ɡbaɡba dea fraŋkaa.
Kɛ Léwi dea tena la te baŋre ba tɛnte deene bar n Tɛnte Dea la, ásɛ n bandia bɛ Israel tena la bwa nɛɛ ba.
Lewi dea tena laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ báa nyiŋi n Tɛnte Dea la bwa ta.” Israel tena la ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa kɛrɛdɛ ken, ɡɛ tenten Korowii aa do Mosis la.
Gɛ Israel deene nɛra aa baŋre ba tɛnte deene Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛŋɔ Israel tena la baŋre ba tɛnte deene bar n Dea Cheremibɔr, ba ne o baah tɛr tama.
Nómɛlbwa so o dea fraŋkaa jwɛh, bela o dea tena fraŋkaare aa lole.” Juda dea tena la, a chɛ kɛ bá bɔne ba bini, dɛ́ baŋre ba tɛnte deene wee leebɔr pera, dɛ́ so denaa ta ba fraŋkaa jwɛh.
Aminadab bibaa Naasɔn ɛ Juda dea nɛra la sitɔɔ.
O dea tena la lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banaarɛ lafraanumɛl.
Isaaka dea tena ɡe baŋre ba tɛnte deene teŋɛ Juda dea tena nɛ.
Suar bibaa Nɛtanɛl ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ lafraanaarɛ.
Sebulon dea tenaa dɛ teŋɛ.
Hɛlɔn bibaa Eliab ɡee ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue dɛ banuanɛ lafraanaarɛ.
Dɛ he kure Juda dea tena ne debele anɛ la ba bwa aa dɛ so dɔŋa jwɛh bela la baala aa, ba bwa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanuatoro dɛ banumɛl lafraanaarɛ.
Dɛ Israel tena iro ŋɔ bá kaa bofale aa, banee chɛ kɛŋɔ bá tɔ sie.
Weekaŋle harɛbɔr peraa chɛ kɛŋɔ Rubin dea tena ne debele anɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ bwa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ́ so ba fraŋkaa jwɛh.
Sɛdor bibaa Elisur ɛ Rubin dea nɛra la sitɔɔ.
