O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banumɛl lafraanue.
Simeon dea tena ɡe baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ́ so teŋɛ Rubin dea tena nɛ.
Surisadai bibaa Sɛlomeɛl ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue dɛ banuanaarɛ lafraatoro.
Gad dea tena ɡe baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ́ so teŋɛ Simeon dea tena nɛ.
Dewɛl bibaa Eliasaf ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue, lafraanumɛl fifraanue.
Dɛ he kure Rubin dea tena ne debele anɛ la ba bwa aa dɛ so dɔŋa jwɛɛh bela la baala aa, ba bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanue dɛ beŋkpoŋ lafraanaarɛ fifraanue.
Dɛ Israel tena iro ŋɔ bá kaa bofale aa, banee chɛ kɛŋɔ bá teŋɛ nɛɛ.
Dɛ Israel tena dɛ iraa, Lewi dea tena la dɛ che n Dea Cheremibɔr ne o laala, dɛ́ do banɔ la baa tɔ sie ne banɔ la baa ka mun ta la baah ta, ba bwa ɛɛ kaa.
Gɛ ba bɛlbwa aa pɛa dɛ so la, ɡɛ tentenee dɛ ba iro dɛɛ kaa bofale aa, baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, bɛlbwa ne o fraŋkaa.
Wee cholibɔr peraa chɛ kɛ Efrem dea tena ne debele anɛ aa ja ba nɛɛ baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ́ so ba fraŋkaa jwɛh.
Amihud bibaa Elisama waa le Efrem dea ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ lafraanue.
Asɛ Manasɛ dea tena chɛ kɛ ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene, dɛ́ so teŋɛ Efrem dea tena nɛ.
Pedasur bibaa Gamaleɛl ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ banɛ lafraanɛ.
Bɛnjamen dea tena ɡee dɛ́ teŋɛ Manse dea tena nɛ.
Gedeɔne bibaa Abidan ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ banue lafraanaarɛ.
Dɛ he kure Efrem dea tena ne debele anɛ la ba bwa aa dɛ so dɔŋa jwɛɛh bela la baala aa, ba lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa dɛ banuatoro dɛ lafa.
Dɛ Israel tena iro ŋɔ ba kaa bofale aa, a ɡɛ deene nɔɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ bá teŋɛ tooro.
Weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ɡe, Dan dea tena ne debele anɛ tena baa ja ba nɛɛ baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ́ so ba fraŋkaa jwɛh.
Amisadai bibaa Ahiesa waa le Dan dea ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanumɛl dɛ banɛ lafraanuanɛ.
Aasa dea tena chɛ kɛ bá so teŋɛ Dan dea tena nɛ.
Okran bibaa Paɡiel ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ lafraanue.
Naftale dea tena ɡee dɛ́ so teŋɛ Aasa dea tena nɛ.
Enan bibaa Ahira ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O dea tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue dɛ batoro lafraanaarɛ.
Dɛ he kure Dan dea tena ne debele anɛ la ba bwa aa dɛ so dɔŋa jwɛɛh bela la baala aa, ba bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanue dɛ banuanɛ lafraanumɛl.
Dɛ Israel tena iro ŋɔ bá kaa bofale aa, banee dɛɛ ka mun, bɛlbwa kpoŋe o fraŋkaa.
Israel tena baa kure ba deene nɛra bwa laanee la.
Dɛ he kpɔ debele atotoro baa kura la dɛ ja dɔŋa nɛ aa, ba bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa lafraanumɛl dɛ batoro lafraanue fifraanue.
Gɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la, Lewi dea tena te, ba ta ban kure ja Israel deene la nɛ.
Gɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la, ɡɛɛ Israel tena la ɛ. Dea bɛlbwa vɔrɔwe o sobɔr bela o fraŋkaa aa paa.
Dɛ ba dɛ nyin ira dɛ́ kaa bofale ɡe aa, ɡɛ tentenee bɛlbwa ne o dea ne o lolanar jemɛ ba bɔr dɛ teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ valɛ.
Arɔn bibaala wa Kenii Arɔn ne o bibaala dɛ Mosis waa do, ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa bol waa Mosis be Sinai Bwejen ta la.
Arɔn dɔ bibaala banaarɛ.
Banee Nadab waa ɛ binomoa, ne Abihu ne Eliasa dɛ Itama.
Dɛ ba fuɡe no do ba nyuune ta dɛ ɛɛ ba sɔfore.
Kɛ Nadab ne Abihu kpɔ ba ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ buh nii aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ fuh ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii, Sinai Bwejen pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, asɛ o kpoo ba.
Ba ta bii dɔe, anomanta, dɛ Eliasa ne Itama ɡboo ja ba mɛɛ Arɔn nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ sɔfore toma.
Lewi dea tena lee bá cha sɔfore Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ Lewi dea tena ka tɛ sɔfo Arɔn, ásɛ ba ja o nɛɛ dɛɛ cha sɔfore toma.
Baa dɛɛ ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr la tomaa, dɛɛ tɛ o ne Israel tena la bwa.
Lewi dea tenaa chɛ kɛ bá nyiŋi n Dea Cheremibɔr kwaa bwa ta, dɛ́ berɛ dɛɛ ɛ Israel tena la bwa toma ba fe aa dɛɛ ɛ bela dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Kpɔ Lewi dea tena la tɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala báa cha ba.
Israel tena bini, ba ɡboo chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ ba te dɛɛ ɛ o toma.
Le Arɔn ne o bibaala dɛ́ kpɔ sɔfore toma la do ba nɔn ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola sɔfo ɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ sɔfo toma la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Le awola maa kpoo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla bwa laanee n le Israel tena bibanloɡla tɛ n te, nɛra ne kondɛɛra bibanloɡla bwa ɛ n kwa.
N kpɔ Lewi dea tena le Israel tena bini, dɛ kpɔ chiɡ Israel bibanloɡle naa ta, ba ɛ n kwa.
Menee Korowii.” Lewi dea tena kura Korowii berɔ bol waa Mosis be Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta dɛ ŋɔ, “Kure Lewi dea tena ne ba lolanar bwa.
Kure baala bwa, le bechale baa dɔ korobie beŋkpoŋ ka tel banomonome ta.” Asɛ Mosis kur ba ɡɛ Korowii aa doo ŋɔ ó ɛ la.
Lewi bibaalaa nɔ, Gɛsɔn ne Kohat dɛ Merari.
Gɛsɔn dea biirii nɔ, Libni ne Simee.
Kohat ɡe dea biirii nɔ, Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.
Merari dea biirii nɔ, Maali ne Musi.
Kenii Lewi dea tena ne ba lolanar waa do.
Gɛsɔn dea biirii Libni ne Simee tena.
Baa kur ba le bibaala baa di korobie beŋkpoŋ dɛ kaa banomonome ta la, ba lɔ kaɡboŋa banuanɛ lafraanue.
Gɛsɔn naanar la chɛ kɛ bá baŋre ba tɛnte deene Korowii Tɛnte Dea la habɔɔ wee cholibɔr.
Gɛsɔn naanar bwa nomoa waa tɔ ba sie laanee Lael bibaa Eliasaf.
N Dea Cheremibɔr toma baa kpɔa do ba nɔn ta laanee kɛŋɔ, báa nyiŋi o ne kwaa baa kpɔa bɔle o bini ne baŋ, dɛ o doonyoa pateesan la ta, ne pateesanre aa bar bela dembaah la ne saraha kon la, ne pateesan waa tɔ dembaah la doonyoa, ne o ŋwɛɛra ta.
Gɛ bwa aa chɛ kɛ bá ɛ anɔ bwa lɔ ba nɔn ta.
Kohat dea biirii Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.
Ba bini baala baa kur ba ba di korobie beŋkpoŋ dɛ́ kaa banomonome ta lɔ kaɡboŋa banuatoro lafraanumɛl.
A ɡɛ Kohat tena nɔɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ báa nyiŋi Korowii Tɛnte Dea la ta.
Banee chɛ kɛ bá baŋre ba tɛnte deene Korowii Tɛnte Dea la habɔɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera.
Asɛ Usiel bibaa Elisafan ɛ Kohat dea nomoa.
Ba tomaa kɛŋɔ báa nyiŋi Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ta, ne teebur ne kandea daa ne kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta la, ne koŋkwaa sɔfore aa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela, ne pateesan waa tɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ta.
Gɛ bwa aa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ kwaa nɔ bwa ɛ toma lɔ ba nɔn ta.
Dɛ sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Eliasaa Lewi dea tena la nomoa.
Onee ba le o chɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma Boɡoroŋ bela nyoa.
Merari dea biirii Maali ne Musi tena.
Dɛ ba bini baala baa kur ba dɛ le korobie beŋkpoŋ, dɛ kaa banomonome ta lɔ kaɡboŋa banumɛl lafraanɛ.
Abihail bibaa Suriel ɛ Merari dea bii bwa nomoa.
Banee chɛ kɛ bá baŋre ba tɛnte deene Korowii Tɛnte Dea la habɔɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera.
Banee ba le ŋɔ báa nyiŋi Korowii Tɛnte Dea la daa, ne o dachiɡri ne loɡa aa lɔ a mune, ne o doli ne o koŋkwaa aa jaa bwa ta.
Gɛ bwa aa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ anɔ bwa ɛ toma lɔ ba nɔn ta, ne kwaa baa kpɔa baŋre bar o dembaah la, ne loɡa aa lɔ a mune ta, ne kwaa baa kpɔa baŋre tɛnte la, dɛ o ŋwɛɛra.
Mosis ne Arɔn ne o bibaala chɛ kɛ bá baŋre ba tɛnte deene Korowii Tɛnte Dea la sie wee leebɔr.
Banee dɛɛ ba báa ɛ Boɡoroŋ bela toma, dɛ́ɛ tɛ Israel tena bwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ Mosis toma ne sɔfo Arɔn toma la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
Lewi dea tena Mosis ne Arɔn aa kur ba ɡɛ Korowii aa do ba dɛ le bibaala baa di korobie beŋkpoŋ ta kaa banomonome ta la lɔ baala kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Kure Israel deene bibanloɡla baa di korobie beŋkpoŋ dɛɛ kaa la pɛ, dɛ́ chwerɛ ba bwa sɔna.
Le Lewi dea tena la tɛ mɛ bá chiɡ Israel biloɡla naa ta.
Ba kondɛɛra ɡe ɛ n kwa dɛ chiɡ Israel tena bwa kondɛɛra aa loɡla la naa ta.
Menee Korowii.” Ate, Mosis kure Israel tena bibanloɡla bwa baa di korobie beŋkpoŋ dɛ ka tel banomonome ta, dɛ chwerɛ ba sɔna ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.
Dɛ ba bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ lafraanɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ batoro.
Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Lewi dea tena ne ba kondɛɛra bwa chɛ kɛ bá ɛ n kwa, dɛ́ chiɡ Israel tena bibanloɡla naa ta.
Ba kondɛɛra la ɡe chiɡ Israel tena kondɛɛra biloɡla naa ta.
Menee Korowii.
Israel tena bibanloɡla aa ɡwaa Lewi dea baala lafraanɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ batoro nɔ, bá kpɔ suuɡapoŋa anue charɛ bɛlbwa nyu, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea a ɛ suuɡa bwejeɡre fifraanɛ la.
Kpɔ nɛra baa ɡwaala la suuɡa tɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala.” Gɛɛ a do Mosis lɛ nɛra baa ɡwaala la suuɡa ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.
Suuɡapoŋa la bwa lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraatoro fifraanumɛl dɛ anue, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la.
Asɛ Mosis kpɔ suuɡapoŋa la tɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.
Lewi dea bii baa ɛ Kohat tena toma Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Kure Lewi dea bii baa ɛ Kohat naanar ne ba lolanar.
Kure baala baa di bene fifraatoro ka tel bene fifraanue, baa dɛ ba wona ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr la toma.
Kohat naanar la tomaa kɛŋɔ, báa nyiŋi kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ tenten ta, n Dea Cheremibɔr bela.
Dɛ Israel tena la ŋɔ bá ir kaa bofale aa, Arɔn ne o bibaalaa chɛ kɛ bá jo dɛ́ ka laa pateesan waa saɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, kpɔ dɛ́ kpɔ tɔ o ta.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne la bɔle pateesan la ta.
Dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ yal waa ɛ burum tenten bɔle o ta, ásɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔ daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheo la suuɡi nɔnloɡa aa lɔ o loŋkoni la ta.
Bá paɡri yaburum bɛl bɔle teebur Korowii paanoo aa dɛ dawɛ o ta la ta, dɛ́ pa tafolabɔtɔre ne loɡa ne lerwe baa dɛ do sen a bini, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ saraha dawɛ bela.
Paanoo la baa yon kpɔ dawɛ o ta la chɛ kɛ ó ta dawɛ bela.
Bá kpɔ yaswɛm bɔle ɡɛ laala la ta, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne bɔle a ta ja, ásɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔ daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ che teebur la suuɡi o nɔnloɡa aa lɔ o loŋkoni la ta.
Bá kpɔ yaburum bɛl bɔle kandea daa la ne o kandere la ta, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ kwaa o ŋwɛɛra la, ne o loɡbakorɔre ne loŋa baa kpɔ noo dɛɛ do a bini, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ do kandere la ta.
Ásɛ ba kpɔ mpo nae tɔne dɛ fɔrɔwe kandea la ne o kwaa bwa, dɛ́ kpɔ dawɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ chea la ta.
Bá kpɔ yaburum bɛl paɡri bɔle suuɡaswɛm kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la, dɛ́ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne bɔle, ásɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔ daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheo la suuɡi nɔnloɡa aa lɔ o loŋkoni la ta.
Bá kpɔ yaburum bɛl fɔrɔwe koŋkwaa bwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma Boɡoroŋ bela la, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne bɔle a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ dawɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ chea la ta.
Bá laa tɔɔ aa lɔ saraha kon baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo la pa, dɛ́ kpɔ yakɔl bɔle o ta.
Ásɛ dɛ pa koŋkwaa bwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma saraha kon la ta.
Anee kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ buh nii, ne bune baa kpɔ toh ola, ne soofire, ne loɡa baa do chal kɛɛ nee a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ, dɛ́ kpɔa chɔŋɛ o ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ mpo nae tɔne la bɔle a ta.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheo la suuɡi nɔnloɡa aa lɔ o loŋkoni ta la.
Dɛ he dɛ ba ira kaa bofale, asɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala tɔ laala aa do ɡoroŋ ne kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma la ta tonaa, mɔɔ Kohat naanar ká kpɔ che kaa.
Kɛ ba bɛ a ɡɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la leɡe, ásɛ dɛ ba sewɛ.
Banee dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ bá che n Dea Cheremibɔr laala ne o koŋkwaa bwa.
Arɔn bibaa Eliasaa dɛɛ ba wɛɛ nyiŋi noo baa kpɔ dɛɛ choŋi kandere, ne daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, ne tɔpere bɛlbwa mea saraha, ne noo baa kpɔa dɛɛ do nɛn sɔfore ta.
Onee chɛ kɛ wɛɛ nyiŋi n Tɛnte Dea la ne o laala ne o koŋkwaa bwa ɡe ta.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ Kohat dea tena mun bɛ he le Lewi dea tena la bini.
Waa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ ásɛ ba dɔ ba nyu dɛ bɛ serewe laanee kɛŋɔ, ba bɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona la bɛne.
Arɔn ne o bibaalaa chɛ kɛ bá tɔ sie, ásɛ dɛ chaɡle bɛlbwa o toma ne o bone waa che.
Kohat naanar ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá jo, dɛ́ nyiŋi kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la, á ba ɛ kɛ baa kpɔ sie keŋkeŋnaa nyiŋi dɛ́ ba serewe.” Lewi dea bii baa ɛ Gɛsɔn dea tena Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Kure Gɛsɔn dea tena ɡe, dɛ́ jemɛ ba nyoa.
Kure ba bini baala baa di bene fifraatoro, dɛ́ ka jaɡɛ fifraanue la bwa baa dɛ ba wona ɛ toma n Dea Cheremibɔr bela.
Gɛsɔn dea tena toma baa dɛɛ ɛa ne bone baa dɛɛ che laanee nɔ.
A chɛ kɛ báa che n Tɛnte Dea waa ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr la pateesanre, ne kwaa baa kpɔa bɔle o bini, ne mpo nae tɔne baa kpɔa bɔle o baŋ, ne pateesan waa tɔ n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa la, ne dembaah pateesanre aa bar n Tɛnte Dea la ne kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta, ne pateesan waa tɔ dembaah doonyoa bela, ne a ŋwɛɛra ne koŋkwaa bwa baa dɛ ɛ ane toma bela.
Gɛ bwa aa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ kwaa nɔ bwa ɛ toma lɔ Gɛsɔn dea tena nɔn ta.
Gel Arɔn ne o bibaala baɡle Gɛsɔn dea tena toma bɛlbwa baa ɛ, ɡɛ baa dɛɛ che bone ne ba toma bɛlbwa ta.
Mosis, kpɔ ba bone baa dɛ ba cheɡa we-ɛɛla bɛlbwa do ba nɔn ta baa nyiŋi a ta.
Toma Gɛsɔn dea tena aa dɛ ba baa ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr laanee la.
Sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Itamaa chɛ kɛ wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ ba toma bwa ta.” Lewi dea bii baa ɛ Merari dea tena Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kure Merari dea tena dɛ́ jemɛ ba nyoa.
Kure ba bini baala baa di bene fifraatoro, dɛ́ ka tel bene fifraanue baa dɛ́ ba wona ɛ toma n Dea Cheremibɔr bela.
Ba toma baa ɛ belaa kɛŋɔ, bá che daa baa kpɔa baŋre n Dea Cheremibɔr la, o dachiɡri ne loɡa aa lɔ a mune dɛ a doli bwa, ne dembaah dachiɡri ne a loɡa aa lɔ a mune, ne kwaa baa kpɔa baŋre tɛnte la ne ŋwɛɛra ne koŋkwaa bwa ne komɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ ɛ toma.
Yerɛ baa bɛlbwa, dɛ́ kpɔ o bone waa dɛ ba cheɡa do o nɔn ta.
Toma Merari dea tena aa dɛ ba báa ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr laanee la.
Sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Itamaa chɛ kɛ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ báa ɛ toma.” Lewi dea tena kura Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Israel tena nomonome kure Kohat dea tena ne ba lolanar.
Baa kure ba baala baa di bene fifraatoro ka tel bene fifraanue, baa dɛ ba wona ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr la toma la, dɛ ba lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
Gɛɛ Kohat dea tena baa dɛ ba wona ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr toma la nyoa do.
Mosis ne Arɔn kur ba ɡɛ maa do Mosis la.
Ba kure Gɛsɔn dea tena ne ba lolanar ɡe.
Baa kure ba baala baa di bene fifraatoro ka tel fifraanue dɛ́ won ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr toma bwa la, ba lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafraanumɛl fifraatoro.
Gɛɛ Gɛsɔn dea tena baa dɛ ba wona ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr toma la waa do.
Mosis ne Arɔn kur ba ɡɛ maa do ba la.
Ba kure Merari dea bii ne ba lolanar.
Baa kure baala baa di bene fifraatoro ka tel bene fifraanue dɛ́ won ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr toma la, dɛ ba lɔ kaɡboŋa batoro lafraanɛ.
Gɛɛ Merari dea tena baa kur ba la nyoa do.
Mosis ne Arɔn kur ba ɡɛ maa do Mosis la.
Gɛɛ aa do Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Israel nomonome kure Lewi dea tena ne ba lolanar bwa.
Baala baa di bene fifraatoro dɛ kaa bene fifraanue, dɛ́ won ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela toma, dɛ́ won che o laala dɛɛ kaa bofale la bwa, ba lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa banuatoro lafraanue fifraanuatoro.
Ba baɡle nomɛlbwa o toma ne bone waa dɛɛ che, ɡɛ tenten maa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ do ba la.
Gɛɛ aa do ba kure ba bwa ɡɛ maa do Mosis la.
Nɛra doŋa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ wa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Do Israel tena la kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa dɔ bwadabii weebuula, ne nomɛlbwa nee ane aa dɛ fuɡo, ne nomɛlbwa waa leɡe ol-lale kɛɛ chɔɔ la, o kah doŋa.
Bá le o ne ba baah ta.
Haahna ne baala bwa baa do ɡɛ la, bá le ba ne dahara, ásɛ ba bɛ doŋa ba kpɔ kah bela haa soɡa n do he baah ta la.” Israel tena la ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ le ɡɛ nɛra la le ba baah ta baa so dahara, ɡɛ tenten maa bol Mosis be la.
Wechɔɡa kem bɔe Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, Dɛ haah kɛɛ baa ɛ o dɔŋ bɛl wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta naa, dɛ o jo men Korowii nɛ.
Naate di bolchɔɡe.
A chɛ kɛ ó bol wechɔɡa waa ɛa la, dɛ́ bɔ kwaa baa lɛo la bwa, dɛ́ berɛ bɔne anɔ la waa bɔa la bini bele anue, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ja a ta tɛo.
Dɛ naate waa ɛo wechɔɡa la sewaa, a chɛ kɛ ó bɔ tɛ o lole tenten.
Dɛ o ta ɡɛ nɛn dɔe yaa, a ɛ men Korowii kwa.
Ó bɔ tɛ sɔfo la dɛ́ kpɔ pebal ja, ásɛ sɔfo la kpɔ soŋe naate wechɔɡa n be ń kpɔ kɛo.
Kwaa nɔ bwa Israel tena aa kpɔa baa tɛ men Korowii la ɛ sɔfo kwa.” Baa bɛlbwa kwaa waa kpɔ ba tɛ sɔfo ɛ sɔfo la kwa.
Haah waa le o jaa habɔɔ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Dɛ bɛl haah le o habɔɔ, dɛ ka chɔ banfale dɛ o jaa la ta jemɛ, doŋa waa kaah la ɡe ta baŋ leɛ nɛn di danseɛ, kɛɛ dɛ lawɛ o nɔn a ta, dɛ o jaa la baa dɔ a liire kɛŋɔ haah la kah doŋa dɛɛ meeraa, hale dɛ o ta doŋa kaeh yoo, a chɛ kɛ báa la kpɔ o haah la la sɔfo be, dɛ́ che haah la naa ta, dɛ́ nyin men aa kpera kuruwa beŋkpoŋ, dɛ bɛ noo kɛɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma baa dɛ fuah a ta do, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɛ mea saraha dɛ tɛ meera.
A ɛ saraha aa dɛ baɡle kɛ nɛn di bolchɔɡe kɛɛ o ta bolchɔɡe dii.
Sɔfo la chɛ kɛŋɔ, ó kpɔ haah la ba che men Korowii sie, ásɛ dɛ ɛ vii bini nee aa do ɡoroŋ la, dɛ́ ɛ n Tɛnte Dea bela harɛ teera, dɛ́ kpɔ do nee la ta, ásɛ a do kpeli.
Sɔfo la aa kpɔ haah la ka che men Korowii sie la, ó laa kon kpɔ o nyu ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ meera mea saraha la do o nɔn ta.
Anee dɛ baɡle kɛ haah la di bolchɔɡe kɛɛ o ta bolchɔɡe dii.
Sɔfo la ɛɛ kpɔ nee aa do kpeli o ɛa do kon ta dɛ do teera a ta aa ba nyotaahna ne laanee kpoŋe.
Ásɛ sɔfo la ɡel haah la ŋwɛɛ ntam dɛ́ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ he ta he jaa habɔɔ leɛ dɛ ka chɔ banfale dɛ kah doŋa aa, nyotaahna aa lɔ nee aa do kpeli nɔ ta bɛ won ɛɛ wobɛlbwa.
Dɛ he ta lɔ he jaa dea dɛ le o habɔɔ ka chɔ banfale dɛ kah doŋa aa, Kórowii ɡel he hwie serewe, dɛ́ do jeɡre he tea su, dɛ́ ɡel he nɛra taahne dɛ́ vɛɛh.
Kórowii ɡel nee nɔ aa dɛ ba nyotaahna ne nɔ jo he bwara, dɛ́ ɡel he hwie serewe, dɛ́ do jeɡre, he tea su.’ Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, a chɛ kɛ haah la ŋɔ, ‘N sɛh ɡɛ.
Kórowii ɡel á ɛ ɡɛ!’ Sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó chwerɛ nyotaahna waa la dawɛ kon ta, dɛ́ yaɡla do nee aa do kpeli la ta, dɛ́ ɡel haah la nyɔ nekpela la aa dɛ ba nyotaahna ne o nɛɛ bala la, ásɛ a jooɡo dɛ́ ɡel o bwara nyɛɡo kɛrɛdɛ.
Ásɛ sɔfo la laa meera mea saraha la lɛ haah la nɔn ta, dɛ́ ɡɔɔra nyundua men Korowii sie, dɛ́ kpɔ kaa kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta, dɛ́ ɛ mea la nɔndel, dɛ́ fuah bela tɛ men Korowii, name dɛ́ ɡel haah la nyɔ nee la.
Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ o le o jaa habɔɔ kpela dɛ ka chɔ banfale dɛ kah doŋa dɛ nyɔ nee la aa, aa jooɡoo, dɛ́ ɡel o bwara nyɛɡo kɛrɛdɛ o tea su, o hwie serewe dɛ́ do jeɡre, ásɛ o nɛra na kɛŋɔ nyotaahna lawɔ.
Dɛ haah la ta doŋa kaeh o tea too te naa, baa tao tɔɔ, o ta bolchɔɡee dii kpa, dɛ́ won dɛɛ lolɛ.
Dɛ haah le o jaa habɔɔ dɛ ka chɔ banfale dɛ kah doŋa aa, a ɡɛ waa nɔɔ ɛ meera Mmara, kɛɛ dɛ baa dɔ liire kɛŋɔ o haah le o habɔɔ dɛ ka chɔ banfale dɛɛ meeraa, sɔ́fo la ɡel ó ba che men Korowii sie, dɛ́ teŋɛ waa bwa Mmara la aa baɡla la ta.
Baa la te aa bolchɔɡee di a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, dɛ haah la di bolchɔɡe aa, o ɡboo dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra o wechɔɡa la wa.”
Mmarare aa lole tɛ Nasiri tena Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Dɛ haah kɛɛ baa dɛ nyin kɛ o baɡɛ nyoa dɛ́ kpɔ o te tɛ men Korowii kɛŋɔ Nasiri te aa, amɔ te, o bɛ ɡrepo daa nɔna baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen ne seŋkpeɡa bɛlbwa nyɔ.
O bɛ sennyɛɡa baa kpɔ ɡrepo nɔna kɛɛ seŋkpeɡa bɛlbwa ɛa la nyɔ.
O bɛ ɡrepo nɔnlwɛɛ kɛɛ daa nɔna aa hola di, dɛ bɛ a nee ɡe nyɔ.
Le saŋ la waa ɛ Nasiri te la, komɛlbwa baa chaara le ɡrepo daa ta la, o nɔn oo, o bi oo, o pɛɡ oo, ó bɛ di.
Le saŋ waa kpɔ o te tɛ men Korowii kɛŋɔ Nasiri te la, o bɛ o nyu ne o tampona fonɛ bwa.
A chɛ kɛ ó do ɡoroŋ ka tel kɛŋɔ saŋ waa kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ la aa baa ɡale.
A chɛ kɛ ó ɡel o nyu moɡɛ ba dawɛ o vaama ta.
O bɛ nɛn waa sewa jwɛɛh la saŋ waa kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ la bwa.
Hale dɛ o nya kɛɛ mɛɛ yoo, o dɔɔ kɛɛ nime bibaa kɛɛ nimambiee sewa a ɡɛ saŋ aa, o bɛ o jwɛɛh la dɛ́ kah doŋa.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ o nyumpona laanee dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o pere o te dɛ kpɔ o te tɛ men Korowii.
Le saŋ waa pere o te dɛ kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ la bwa la, o do ɡoroŋ tɛ men Korowii.
Dɛ Nasiri te siwi pa nomɛl nɛɛ o sewaa o kah doŋa, ó so ka tel tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ fonɛ o nyu ne o tampona, ate dɛ doŋa waa kaah laanee o sɔ ta la.
Ásɛ tɔpenuatoro wee la, ó lawɛ borɔnomare anɛ kɛɛ kulukukure bii anɛ ba tɛ sɔfo, n Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.
Sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ jumbie la bɛl ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ nɛɛte la ɡe ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe naate wechɔɡa tɛo n be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɛ wechɔɡa dawɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ o siwi aa pa o nɛɛ o sewɛ la.
Ó laa doŋa bwa kpɔ o nyu ta awola tenten dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ tɛ mɛ.
A chɛ kɛ ó berɛ kwaa kpɔ o te tɛ men Korowii kɛŋɔ Nasiri te, kɛ ó kpɔ pebale waa di benanyoa ba ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha tɛ mɛ.
Tɔpera la o fa aa baɡɛ nyoa la ta jae kpa, dɛkalkɛ a taa o kah doŋa la.
Saŋ nɛn aa kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ kɛ Nasiri te la baa ɡaraa, a chɛ kɛ bá kpɔɔ ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela, ásɛ o kpɔ saraha kwaa ba tɛ mɛ.
Anee pebal waa di benanyoa waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne pelor waa di benanyoa waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ pebal waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
Ó kpɔ mea sarahare ne sen sarahare ne paanoo wɛɡrɛ del iisi aa wola toole a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ do noo a ta, ne biskeeti baa kpɔ noo koo a ta dɛ́ kpɔ ba.
Sɔfo la kpɔa ba men Korowii sie ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ne saraha baa dɛ fuah tɛ mɛ.
Ó kpɔ paanoo wɛɡrɛ del iisi aa wola toole a ta la tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ kpo pebal la ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ mea saraha la ne sen saraha la ja.
A chɛ kɛ a ɡɛ Nasiri te la ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa, dɛ́ ba fonɛ o nyumpona waa kpɔ o te tɛ men Korowii dɛ ŋɔ waa an fonɛ la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ nyumpona la do deŋnesɔɔhna saraha nii la ta.
Nasiri te la aa fonɛ o nyumpona tonɛ la, sɔfo la kpɔ pebal vam baa daalo ne paanoo ane soo siwi baa dɛ do noo a ta, ne biskeeti baa wola iisi a bɛlbwa ta doe beŋkpoŋa le wɛɡrɛ la bini do o nɔn ta.
Ásɛ sɔfo la berɛ laa lɛ, dɛ́ ɡɔɔra nyundua, dɛ́ viiɡa men Korowii sie, a ɛ saraha aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɛ sɔfo la kwa, ane pee la bambile baa ɡɔɔro nyundua, ne o hwii baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha la.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ habɔɔ la, Nasiri te la dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ó nyɔ sen. A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ chɔ le tɛ Nasiri te waa kpɔ o te tɛ men Korowii mɔɔ dɛ́ won le ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la ta, dɛ́ berɛ won kpɔ kwaa waa dɛ ba wona bwa ja a ta.
A chɛ kɛ ó teŋɛ o nyobaɡa la bwa ta ɡɛ Nasiri tena mmarare aa dɛ baɡle la.” Sɔfore andɛɛɡa sweera dɛ́ tɛ nɛra Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ó bol Arɔn ne o bibaala be kɛŋɔ kenii chɛ kɛ bá swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Israel tena, “Kórowii kwaa he kwa, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛ.
Ó nyiŋi he nɛɛ, dɛ́ na he sum.
Ó ɛ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa deŋnesɔɔhna.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala ɛɛ ba sweera tɛ Israel tena, ásɛ n ɡel ba na som.”
Israel nomonome saraha kwaa ne Tɛnte Dea bala Mosis aa tonɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea la ne kwaa aa lɔ o bini toma bwa la, o fuɡe noo yɔɔ a ta a do ɡoroŋ dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta.
O berɔ ɛ ɡɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta ne o koŋkwaa bwa ta, dɛ kpɔa do Korowii nɔn ta a ɛ o kwa.
Asɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ nomonome la ba fa aa lee ba le ba deene ne lolanar bini ba kure nɛra la ɛ sarahare.
Ba kpɔ kwaa aa dɔ tɔre baa taɡa kɛŋɔ torɔɡore anumɛl, ne nabala baa fɔɡa fi dɛ anɛ ba tɛ Korowii.
Nomoa bɛlbwa ba nabal beŋkpoŋ ne, asɛ ba bini banɛ bɛlbwa berɛ pɛ ba kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore la beŋkpoŋ ne, dɛ kpɔ ba tɛ Korowii o Tɛnte Dea la sie.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Lɛ kwaa baa kpɔ ba ɛ toma n Dea Cheremibɔr bela la.
Kpɔa tɛ Lewi dea tena la, ɡɛ ba bini bɛlbwa toma aa doa.” Asɛ Mosis lɛ kwaa la bwa, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena la.
O kpɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore anɛ, ne nabala anaarɛ tɛ Gɛsɔn dea tena, dɛ le ɡɛ ba toma aa doa.
Dɛ kpɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo la anaarɛ ne nabala anuatoro tɛ Merari dea tena, dɛ le ɡɛ ba toma aa doa.
Sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Itamaa ba sitɔɔ.
Kɛ Mosis ta Kohat dea tena te tɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la, anee ba kpɔ do ba nɔn ta, baa dawa vam.
Baa fuɡe noo do kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta o do ɡoroŋ tonɛ la, nomonome la kpɔ ba sarahare ba saraha kon la sie, dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa la do men Korowii nɔn ta o ɛ n kon.
Dɛ Korowii fa ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Tɔpere bɛlbwa ɡel nomonome la kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔ tɛ men Korowii la beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la do n nɔn ta ó ɛ n kon.” Naate waa kpɔ o saraha kwaa ba tɔpere waa tɔ sie laanee Aminadab bibaa Naasɔn waa le Juda dea.
O saraha kwaa ɛ suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini, dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ ne pebal beŋkpoŋ, dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue, dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa, bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
A nɔɔ ɛ Aminadab bibaa Naasɔn saraha kwaa waa ba ane.
Tɔɔ a pera nɛɛ la, Suar bibaa Nɛtanɛlee kpɔ o kwaa ba, Isaaka dea o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Saraha kwaa waa kpɔa ba laanee, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ ɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
A nɔɔ ɛ Suar bibaa Nɛtanɛl saraha kwaa waa ba a ne.
Tɔpetooro wee la, Hɛlɔn bibaa Eliabee kpɔ o kwaa ba.
Sebulon deaa o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
O ɡe saraha kwaa ɛ, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini, dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
A nɔɔ ɛ Hɛlɔn bibaa Eliab saraha kwaa waa ba a ne.
Tɔpenaarɛ wee la, Sɛdor bibaa Elisurii kpɔ o kwaa ba.
Rubin deaa o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Saraha kwaa waa kpɔa ba laanee, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ ɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
Anɔɔ ɛ Sɛdor bibaa Elisur saraha kwaa waa ba a ne.
Tɔpenue wee, Surisadai bibaa Sɛlomeɛlee kpɔ o kwaa ba.
Simeon deaa o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Saraha kwaa waa kpɔa ba laanee, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ ɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
A nɔɔ ɛ Surisadai bibaa Sɛlomeɛl saraha kwaa waa ba a ne.
Tɔpenumɛl wee, Dewɛl bibaa Eliasaf kpɔ o kwaa ba.
Gad deaa o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Saraha kwaa waa kpɔa ba laanee, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ ɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
A nɔɔ ɛ Dewɛl bie Eliasaf kwaa waa kpɔa ba.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la, Amihud bibaa Elisamaa kpɔ o kwaa ba.
Efrem deaa o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Saraha kwaa waa kpɔa ba laanee, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ ɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
Anɔɔ ɛ Amihud bibaa Elisama kwaa waa kpɔa ba.
Tɔpenuatoro wee la, Pedasur bibaa Gamaleɛlee kpɔ o kwaa ba.
Manasɛ deaa o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Saraha kwaa waa kpɔa ba laanee, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ ɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
Anɔɔ ɛ Pedasur bibaa Gamaleɛl kwaa waa kpɔa ba.
Tɔpenuanaarɛ wee la, Gedeɔne bibaa Abidanee kpɔ o kwaa be.
Bɛnjamen dea o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Saraha kwaa waa kpɔa ba laanee, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ ba kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ ɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
Anɔɔ ɛ Gedeɔne bibaa Abidan kwaa waa kpɔa ba.
Tɔperafi ta la Amisadai bibaa Ahiesaa kpɔ o kwaa ba.
O le Dan dea dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Saraha kwaa waa kpɔa ba laanee, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ ɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
Anɔɔ ɛ Amisadai bibaa Ahiesa kwaa waa kpɔa ba.
Tɔpera fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ wee la, Okran bibaa Paɡiel kpɔ o kwaa ba.
Aasa dea o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Saraha kwaa waa kpɔa ba laanee, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ ɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
Anɔɔ ɛ Okran bibaa Paɡiel kwaa waa kpɔa ba.
Tɔpera fi dɛ anɛ wee la, Enan bibaa Ahira kpɔ o kwaa ba.
Naftale deaa o le dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Saraha kwaa waa kpɔa ba laanee, suuɡapoŋ tafolabɔtɔ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋ loɡ beŋkpoŋ baa ɛ nee dɛɛ do o bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea la, bɛlbwa del mea baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta a ɛ mea saraha, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡ o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi daawiile baa dɛ fuah suu, ne nabale beŋkpoŋ dɛ pebale beŋkpoŋ aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne bombal beŋkpoŋ bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ ɛ saraha, ne nabala anɛ baa fɔɡa, ne pebala anue ne bombala anue dɛ pebali anue a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa bá kpɔ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
Anɔɔ ɛ Enan bibaa Ahira kwaa waa kpɔa ba.
Kwaa Israel tena nomonome la aa kpɔa ɛ saraha saŋ la baa kpɔ noo yɔɔ saraha kon la ta dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta laanee teŋa nɔ, suuɡapoŋa tafolabɔtɔre fi dɛ anɛ, ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa baa do nee a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ suuɡaswɛm loɡa fi dɛ anɛ.
Suuɡapoŋa tafolabɔtɔre la bɛlbwa tɔɡre lɔ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa baa do nee a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ la bɛlbwa tɔɡre lɔ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ.
Dɛ he kpɔ suuɡapoŋa kwaa la bwa tɔɡre pɛ aa, a lɔ suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋa anɛ lafraanaarɛ, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil men Korowii Dea bela.
Suuɡaswɛm loɡa baa do a dela daawiile baa dɛ fuah tɔɡre lɔ suuɡaswɛm fi, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil men Korowii Dea bela.
Dɛ he lɔ ɡɛ loɡa la bwa tɔɡre pɛ aa, a lɔ suuɡaswɛm lafa fifraanɛ.
Kondɛɛra baa kpɔa ka kpo ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah la bwa lɔ nabali fi dɛ anɛ, ne pebala fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ pebali fi dɛ anɛ a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa ne mea saraha baa kpɔa ja a ta.
Bombala fi dɛ anɛ ɡee ba kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.
Kondɛɛra baa kpɔa ka ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha la ɡe lɔ nae fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ, ne pebala fifraanumɛl ne bombala fifraanumɛl, dɛ pebali fifraanumɛl a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa.
A ɡɛ kwaa nɔɔ ba kpɔ tɛ, dɛ kpɔ saraha kon baa fuɡe noo yɔɔro la do men Korowii nɔn ta.
Saŋ bɛlbwa Mosis aa jo Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela, o ne Korowii bol waa la, o dɛ no taa la dɛɛ le Kerobim la baah ta.
Ba sɛah chɔŋɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka tɔ la doa.
Belaa Korowii do dɛ bol waa o be.
Kandea da ne o kandere cheɡa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Arɔn be kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ kandea daa la ne o kandere anuanɛ la ba cheɡ, ásɛ a sie chaɡɛ boɡoroŋ bela dɛ́ won chaahna kɛrɛdɛ.” Arɔn ɛ ɡɛ.
O kpɔ kandere la chɔŋɛ asɛ a sie chaɡɛ boɡoroŋ bela dɛ won chaahna kɛrɛdɛ.
Gɛ tenten Korowii aa do Mosis laanee o ɛ. Gɛ baa ɛ kandea daa la, suuɡaswɛm ɡbosoo nee ba loɡɔ, le o mun ta kaa o numoli aa do kɛ daa fee la ta.
Gɛ tenten Korowii aa baɡle Mosis laanee o ɛo.
Lewi dea tena lee cheɡ tɛ Korowii Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ Lewi dea tena le ba dɔŋa Israel tena la bini, dɛ́ sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta dɛ́ lee ba cheɡ tɛ mɛ.
Kenii hɛɛ ba ɛɛ, dɛ́ sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta, kpɔ nee baa kpɔa dɛɛ sɔ nɛn doŋa ta la merɛ ba nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba fonɛ ba bwadabii bwa, ásɛ dɛ chɛɡɛ ba laala bwa ɡe.
Gɛɛ baa ba ɛɛ, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛ.
Gel ba kpɔ nabale ba, dɛ́ kpɔ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ noo koo a ta ɛ mea saraha ja o ta.
Berɛ lɛ nabale la bɛl ja, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.
Yerɛ Israel tena la bwa cheme, dɛ́ ɡel Lewi dea tena la ba che n Dea Cheremibɔr la sie.
Ba Lewi dea tena la ne men Korowii sie, ásɛ Israel tena la kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ ba nɛ.
Arɔn chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ Lewi dea tena ba kɛŋɔ saraha kwaa Israel tena aa ba a ne, ásɛ o ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ saraha baa ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ viiɡa n sie ken, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dɛ́ won ɛ men Korowii toma.
Lewi dea tena la aa kpɔ nɔɔra darawe nae la nyuune ta tonɛ la, bá kpɔ beŋkpoŋ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ mɛ, asɛ dɛ kpɔ nɛɛte la ɡe ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe Lewi dea tena wechɔɡa n be tɛɛ ba.
Gel Lewi dea tena la che Arɔn ne o bibaala sie, ásɛ he kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ saraha kwaa baa ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ viiɡa n sie ken.
Gɛ we-ɛɛla nɔ taa aa ba cheɡa he le Lewi dea tena le Israel tena baa kaa la bini tɛ mɛ, ásɛ ba ɛ n nɛra.
Sɔ Lewi dea tena la doŋa ta, bá do ɡoroŋ, dɛ́ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ saraha kwaa baa ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ viiɡa n sie.
He tonaa, a chɛ kɛ ba ba n Dea Cheremibɔr bela, dɛ́ ba ɛ ba toma.
Israel tena bini, banee chɛ kɛ ba kpɔ ba te tɛ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Menee lee ba tɛ n te, dɛ kpɔ ba chiɡ Israel tena bibanloɡla naa ta, Israel tena bibanloɡla bwa ɛ n nɛra.
Gɛ saŋ n fa aa kpo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla la taa n le Israel tena bibanloɡla, hale ba kondɛɛra biloɡla bwa, ba ɛ n kwa.
N kpɔ Lewi dea tena nɔ chiɡ Israel tena bibanloɡla naa ta.
Israel tena bwa bini la, Lewi dea tenaa n kpɔ do Arɔn ne o bibaala nɔn ta baa cha ba, dɛ́ che Israel tena naa ta dɛɛ ɛ toma n Dea Cheremibɔr bela.
Bá soŋe ba wechɔɡa men Korowii be dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, ásɛ dɛ bɛlbwa la Boɡoroŋ la jwɛɛh kwara naa, weechɔɡa bɛlbwa bɛ on pu.” Gɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la, ɡɛɛ o ne Arɔn dɛ Israel tena bwa ɛ Lewi dea tena la.
Lewi dea tena la sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta dɛ do ɡoroŋ, dɛ chɛɡɛ ba laala.
Asɛ Arɔn ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ saraha kwaa baa ɡɔɔra nyundua, dɛ viiɡa Korowii sie ken, dɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa tɛɛ ba, dɛ sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta ba do ɡoroŋ.
Baa ɛ ɡɛ tonɛ la, Lewi dea tena pa mun kaa ɛ toma Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela, asɛ Arɔn ne o bibaala ɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Gɛ Korowii aa do Mosis ŋɔ bá ɛ Lewi dea tena la, ɡɛɛ ba ɛ. Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ja ŋɔ, “Lewi dea te bɛlbwa waa di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue dɛɛ kaa laanee chɛ kɛ o ba ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr la toma, kɛ dɛ o baa di bene fifraanue naa, ó ɡel toma baa dɛ ɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa la ɛɛ, dɛ bɛ an ɛ kpa.
A ɡe habɔɔ la, wɛɛ cha o bala n Dea Cheremibɔr bela, kɛ o bɛ toma la lɛ dawɛ o nɛ.
Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ Lewi dea tena toma baa dɛ ba ɛɛ do ba nɔn ta.”
Galekaa Tɔpejen dii Mosis aa kpɔ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta, bennɛɛte korobie beŋkpoŋ ta la, Korowii bol waa o be Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Israel tena la be baa di Galekaa Tɔpejen la o saŋ ta.
A chɛ kɛ baa diu saŋ men Korowii aa lea cheɡ la ta.
Korobie nɔ tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ jɔmɔraa wee aa dɛɛ le harɛ la, bá diu.
Bá teŋɛ o we-ɛɛla bwa ta, dɛ́ diu aŋwɛnɛ ta.” Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ bá di Galekaa Tɔpejen la, anee ba di ɡɛ tɔpejen la Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, korobie waa tɔ sie, tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta jɔmɔra wee aa le harɛ la.
Ba ɛ wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ tenten Korowii aa do Mosis la.
Ba bini bane ta wone di Galekaa Tɔpejen la awola, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba leɡe nomɛl waa sewa dɛ kah doŋa.
Anomanta, ba la Mosis ne Arɔn be awola tenten, dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Ya ta wone di tɔpere la doŋa yaa kaah dɛ le nomɛl aa sewa ya leɡo la wa.
Kɛ bɔkwaa dɛɛ tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ, ya ne yabala Israel tena la bwa aa wola won pɛ kpɔ ya saraha kwaa saŋ nɔ ta ba tɛ Korowii ɔ?” Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “Hé che bonɔ ásɛ n la ka no le Korowii be, ɡɛ waa do mɛ he waa nɔ wa.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Gel Israel tena la no kɛŋɔ, dɛ ba bini bɛlbwa kɛɛ ba naanar bɛlbwa leɡe nɛn waa sewa dɛ kah doŋa, kɛɛ dɛ bobɛlee ba kaa ba ta wone di Galekaa Tɔpejen la aa, a chɛ kɛ bá diu korobinɛɛte tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta jɔmɔra wee aa le harɛ.
Bá kpɔ pebie ja papojeɡre ane aa do nyɛɡre ne paanoo baa wola iisi a ta doe ta dɛ́ di.
Ba bɛ ane kpɔ cheɡ tɔɔ per a ta, ba bɛ pebie la hoɡa ɡe bɛlbwa paɡre.
Bá di Galekaa Tɔpejen la aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ teŋɛ o we-ɛɛla bwa ta.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa ta doŋa kaeh, o ta bobɛlbwa ɡe kaalɛ dɛ saah vɛh tɔpejen la dii yaa, baa naatee kure ja n nɛra nɛɛ kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta o saraha kwaa kpɔe ba tɛ men Korowii a saŋ ta.
Naate nyin waa dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ chɛ deŋnetɛra.
Dɛ hɔɔh bɛl soɡe he bini dɛɛ nyin kɛ o ɡe di tɔpejen la aa, hé tɛo ŋwɛnɛ.
Kɛ hé ɡel o teŋɛ a ŋwɛnɛre ne a we-ɛɛla la bwa ta.
A chɛ kɛ wesiwi beŋkpoŋ chɔ tɛ hɔɔhra ne Israel tena bwa.” Bam waa baa tɔ Korowii Tɛnte Dea Awola tɔpere baa tonɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea waa ɛ o Dea Cheremibɔr dɛ cheɡ o koŋkwaa bwa la, bam baa tɔ o bwa.
Dɛ o baa tɔ le jɔmɔra ka tel tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔbɔr aa, dɛ o do kɛŋɔ nii ken.
Gɛɛ aa ɛ, dɛ bam la baa tɔ o ta webaŋa ɡe aa, jwaana dɛ o berɔ do kɛŋɔ nii ken.
Dɛ bam la baa le o nyundua bela aa, ɡɛɛ Israel tena la yon ir teŋɛ ka so bela waa ka che.
Gɛ Korowii aa do ba la taa ba teŋɛ dɛ ir dɛɛ kaa, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ so.
Dɛ bam la ta o nyundua leɛ yaa, baa bela ir.
Saŋ te bɛlbwa bam la aa tɔ o nyundua bela biɡri la, Israel tena la dɛ no ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ baɡ ba dɛ so dɛɛ biɡri.
Ane ta bam la dɛ tɔ bela tɔpera tama ane.
Dɛ baa iruu kɛɛ baa soo waa, Korowiirii dɛɛ baɡle.
Ane ɡe ta bam la dɛ tɔ bela jwaana beŋkpoŋ, ásɛ tɔɔ perɔ chɔɔ aa, o yon le o ta, ásɛ ba ir dɛɛ kaa.
Saŋ bɛlbwa bam la aa ba le o ta la, chɔɔree yoo, jɔmɔraa yoo, dɛ ba iro teŋɛ.
Tɔpera anɛ kɛɛ korobie kɛɛ benanyoaa bam la ɛɛ ba Korowii Tɛnte Dea la nyundua tɔe ka tel aa, ba dɛ so bela.
Kɛ awola waa den le o ta la, dɛ ba iro teŋɛ.
Korowii do ba ŋɔ bá so naa, ba dɛ so, o berɔ ŋɔ bá ir aa, ba dɛ ir.
Ba ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ do ba la.
Suuɡapoŋa bɛle ane wa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Gel bá kpɔ suuɡapoŋa loɡɛ bɛle anɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ hoh dɛɛ yerɛ Israel tena ba chema bini, ne ba ira dɛ́ kaa bofale ta.
Dɛ ba hoh bɛle anɛ la bwa naa, nɛra la bwa chɛ kɛ bá cheme he sie n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela.
Bɛla beŋkpoŋii ba hoh aa, dɛ Israel deene nomonomee chɛ kɛ bá ba cheme he sie.
Dɛ bɛla la baa si kɛŋɔ bá ir le bela dɛ́ kaalaa, deene la nɛra baa soɡe Korowii Tɛnte Dea wee leebɔr la chɛ kɛ bá ir dɛ́ tɔ sie.
O baa si nɛɛtena aa, nɛra baa soɡe Korowii Dea la weekaŋle harɛbɔr denaa ta la ɡe ir teŋɛ.
Bɛle sii laanee dɛɛ baɡle ba ira dɛ́ kaa.
Dɛ nɛra la bwa yera dɛ cheme ɡee yaa, bɛle la sii korɛ.
Arɔn bibaala sɔfore la ɡboo chɛ kɛŋɔ baa hoh bɛle la.
A ɛ Mmara dɛ chɔ le tɛ ba naanar baa ka ba bwa.
Dɛ ba kaa jo ba harɛ ta, asɛ ba dɔma ba puu ba dɛɛ yo aa, bá hoh bɛle la.
Men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la ɛɛ lii ba waa, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta.
Ba sie baa lɛ ba benanyoa ne Korobifala Tɔpejena baa lea cheɡ dɛɛ dia ta naa, bá hoah bela baa kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah, ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha dɛɛ ba la, ásɛ a chɔ le dɛɛ lii ba n wa.
Menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.” Israel tena Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ira dɛ́ kaa Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ta bennɛɛte korobie anɛ, tɔpera fifraanɛ habɔɔ la, bam la le Korowii Tɛnte Dea la nyundua bela.
Ate, Israel tena la le Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, ba ɡaaɡa dɛ so dɛɛ ir bwa bini la, bam la berɔ ka che Paran pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Belaa ba pa mun ir, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ do ba la.
Juda dea ne deene aa ja ba nɛɛ tɔ sie, ba ne ba fraŋkaa.
Asɛ Aminadab bibaa Naasɔn ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Suar bibaa Nɛtanɛl ɡe chɔ Isaaka dea tena nyoa.
Hɛlɔn bibaa Eliab ɡe chɔ Sebulon dea tena nyoa.
Asɛ ba foromi Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bwa dɛ kpɛrɛwo, asɛ Gɛsɔn ne Merari dea tena la chea dɛ teŋɛ.
Rubin dea tena ne deene aa ja ba nɛ ɡee ira teŋɛ, ba ne ba fraŋkaa.
Asɛ Sɛdor bibaa Elisur ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Surisadai bibaa Sɛlomeɛl ɡee chɔ Simeon dea tena nyoa.
Asɛ Dewɛl bibaa Eliasaf chɔ Gad dea tena nyoa.
Kohat dea tena laanee cheɡɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bini laala aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɡe teŋɛ.
Gɛrsɔn ne Merari dea tena la dɛ baŋre Korowii Tɛnte Dea la mɔɔ Kohat naanar yon tel bela.
Efrem dea tena ne deene aa ja ba nɛɛ ɡe le dɛ kpoŋe ba fraŋkaa teŋɛ.
Asɛ Amihud bibaa Elisama ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Pedasur bibaa Gamaleɛl ɡee chɔ Manasɛ dea tena nyoa.
Asɛ Gedeɔne bibaa Abidan chɔ Bɛnjamen dea tena nyoa.
Dan dea tena ne deene baa ja ba nɛɛ ɡe ka Israel tena la bwa mun ta, dɛ kpoŋe ba fraŋkaa.
Banee yon ka mun ásɛ ba dɔma bɛ won dɔ bɔr dɛ́ le bobɛlbwa ba yoo ba.
Asɛ Amisadai bibaa Ahiesa ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Okran bibaa Paɡiel ɡee chɔ Aasa dea tena nyoa.
Asɛ Enan bibaa Ahiraa chɔ Naftale dea tena nyoa.
Israel tena vala baa valɔ la, ɡɛɛ ba valɔ denaa ta.
Dɛ Mosis helabaa sɔne Jetro dɛ ɛ Midian te.
O bibaa sɔne Hobab.
Awola bɛl, Mosis ŋɔ Hobab be ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ ba ira kaa harɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ yaa la ta.
O baɡɛ yaa nyoa ŋɔ bela ɛɛ do werii tɛ yaa.
Yaa ka nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛɛ, anomanta, ɡel ya ne he kaa.” Anee Hobab chaŋe ŋɔ, “Akai, maa la.
Mɛɛ berɔɔ kaa n harɛ ta n nɛra be.” Ate Mosis ŋɔ, “N poori, bɛ kaa ɡel yaa.
Henee jemɛ bɔra aa wera ya ka baŋre ya tɛnte deene, dɛ́ so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɔ ta.
Hɛɛ won nyin bodɛɛɡe tɛ yaa.
Dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh ya ne he kaa laa, kondɛɛɡa Korowii aa ka tɛ yaa la, yaa tɛɛ anee.” Anomanta, ba pa mun valɛ le Sinai Bwejen la ta, dɛ valɛ tɔpera atoro.
Lewi dea tena cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la tɔ ba sie tɔpera atoro, dɛɛ ɡaaɡe bela waa dɔ tɛɛ ba bá so.
Tɔɔ perɔ ba ir dɛɛ kaa bofale aa, bam la dɛ tɔ ba nɛɛ baa ɡaaɡe.
Saŋ bɛlbwa baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la tɔ sie baa kaa la, Mosis yon ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ir tɔ ya sie!
Lɔ he dɔma bwa peɡre, ɡel ba bwa chwa le he sie!” Saŋ bɛlbwa baa ka choɡ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la, Mosis yon berɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, berɛ ba ja he nɛra Israel tena kaɡboŋa baa wola won kur ba nɛ.”
Nii aa le Korowii be A kaa ba kɛŋɔ Israel tena la dɛ naɡre ba wenaale wa, asɛ a chole Korowii deŋne ta.
Waa noa la, bwaawee lawɔ, o ɡel nii le bela baa soɡa la, dɛ chɔɡ o baŋ bɛl.
Belaa ba wi no Mosis, asɛ o soŋe Korowii nii la dime.
Anomanta, ba pa bela sɔn Tabera, dɛkalkɛŋɔ belaa Korowii ɡel nii le dɛ ba fuh.
Chayambwibwi Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ Israel tena Dɛ nɛra bane baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ lɔ ba bini ba ne baa kaa, ba pɛla lawɛ kondikwaa tenten.
Asɛ Israel tena la ɛɛ wi kohona ŋɔ, “Leperaa yaa ba ola dɔe dɛ́ chwe o?
Ya dɛ lii pɛŋa yaa dɔa pɛɛpɛɛ dɛɛ chwe Ijipt harɛ ta, ne kwaane baa dɛ yera kokumba ne kɛɛne, ne ɡaabu ne jende, dɛ kwaane baa dɛ yera ɡaalek.
Taraken komɛlbwa pɛla aa yaa dɔ, komɛlbwa toole yá di ka ja maana nɔ nɛ.” Maana la do kɛŋɔ boyubi waa toa.
Israel tena yon valɛ dɛɛ tɔɔra, dɛ nama kɛɛ dɛ tuɡa.
Ba dɛ daala, dɛ́ koo noo a ta dɛ́ hala.
Maana la som kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ ɔleve noo ɛa ken.
Jwaana kɔɔla aa ta bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la, dɛ maana la ɡe le nyundua ba lee.
Israel tena la ne ba haahna ne bii baa ir dɛ do ba tɛnte deene doonyoo dɛɛ wi, asɛ Mosis no.
A ɡelɔ Korowii baah di taeh, dɛ kpɔ sibeɡra ta Mosis nɛ.
Asɛ Mosis pɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, bɔkwa waa he kpɔ ɡɛ wahala nɔ dawɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛɛ ken ɔ?
Bɔkwaa n ɛ dɛ jo he nɛɛ, he kpɔ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ waa bwa dawɛ n nɛɛ ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ nɔɔ?
Menee kpoŋe ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa teene dɛ lol ba kɛɛ?
Ɛrɛɛ he ŋɔ ń nɔɡ ba kɛ haah ne bie, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa harɛ haa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa dɛ ŋwɛɛ ja a ta la ta nɔɔ?
Leperaa mɛɛ ba ola dɔe dɛ́ tɛ nɛra nɔ bwa dɔŋa ba chwe o?
Ba teŋɔ wi dɛɛ noo mɛ ŋɔ ń tɛɛ ba ola bá chwe.
N ɡbo aa won kpoŋe ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa, ba ɡwaa n nɛ.
Dɛ kenii hɛɛ ba men ɛɛ te naa, den kpo mɛ taraken.
Dɛ n we-ɛɛla su he siwi te naa, bɛ ɡel n do le ásɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ba di mɛ.” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Le Israel tena nomonome fifraanuanɛ baa wona dɛɛ ɛ toma la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ba n Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa, he ne ba che bela.
Mɛɛ tuu ba, n ne he ba bol waa bela.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n Doma waa lɔ he Mosis nɛɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ kpeɡri la ba so ba nɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe lɛɛ waa aa ɡwaa he nɛɛ la ane, ásɛ a bɛ he ɡbo nɛɛ dawɛ.
Ŋɔ nɛra la be bá sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta, dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ Korowii be pera dɛɛ kpa kere.
Hɛɛ dɔ olaa chwe.
Korowii no he wii kɛŋɔ he fa aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta la dɛ a wer tɛ heya, he dɔ ola dɛɛ chwe taeh, kɛ taraken te haa dɔe dɛɛ chwe kpa.
Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ tɛ heyaa olaa hɛɛ chwe name.
Tɔpebeŋkpoŋ kɛɛ tɔpera anɛ kɛɛ tɔpera anue, kɛɛ tɔpera fi kɛɛ tɔpera fifraanɛ laa.
Hɛɛ chwea korobibir bwaa a ba lawɛ heya, dɛ́ pe heya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he vɛh Korowii, onee ja he nɛɛ he soɡa bini.
Kɛ he wi o siwi ta ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwaa ɡela ya le Ijipt harɛ te nɔ?’ ” Belaa Mosis ŋɔ, “Nɛra n ne baa dɛ valɛ nɔ lɔ baala kaɡboŋa lafraanumɛl, ɡɛɛ he ŋɔ hɛɛ tɛɛ baa olaa korobibir bwa naa?
Dɛ ya kpoo ya peera ne nae, hale pɛŋa aa lɔ mpo bini bwa kwaraa naa, aa tel baa yaa?” Korowii chaŋe Mosis ŋɔ, “N kpeɡri aa won tel ɡɛ kɛɛ?
Hɛɛ nao name kɛŋɔ waa maa bola la ɛ kpela kɛɛ a ɛ nyosone.” Ate, Mosis la waa la ne nɛra la be dɛ ka bol waa Korowii aa bola la bwa baɡ ba.
O lawɛ nomonome waa lee ba la ba che bar Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela.
Asɛ Korowii do bam la bini, o ne Mosis bol wa, dɛ ɡel o Doma waa soɡe Mosis nɛɛ dɛɛ tɛo kpeɡri la ba so nomonome la nɛ.
Korowii Doma la aa baa so ba nɛɛ la, ba dɔ kpeɡri dɛ won bol Korowii wa.
A habɔɔ la, ba ta wone bol Korowii waa la kpa.
Dɛ nomonome la banɛ ta nomonome fifraanuanɛ la nɛɛ jae dɛ ba Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela dɛ te so ba tɛnte deene bini bela baa soɡa la.
Banee Eldad ne Medad.
Korowii Doma la kaa so ba ɡe nɛɛ kpeɡri ne bela baa lole la, asɛ ba bol Korowii wa.
Asɛ bonɔɔ bɛl chwa le bela baa soɡa tɛnte deene la bini dɛ ka ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Korowii Doma la baa so Eldad ne Medad nɛɛ kpeɡri ne dɛ ɡel baa bol Korowii wa.” Dɛ Nun bibaa Josua le o bonɔɔne saŋ bwa dɛ teŋɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛɛ chao.
O ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ Mosis, ɡel bá ka kah ba, bá ɡel bola!” Anee Mosis ŋɔ, “He meerɔ dɛɛ tɛ mɛ kɛɛ?
N te fe dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡel o Doma ba so o nɛra bwa nɛ, ásɛ ba won dɛɛ bol o waa o kpeɡri ne.” Mosis ne Israel nomonome fifraanuanɛ la bwa berɔ ba bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la.
Korowii ɡelɔ peu bɛl ta, dɛ kpɔ chayambwibwire le mpo nyoa, dɛ ba perɛ bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la.
A dawɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ kaa nyundua dɛ ɛ naɡale atoro, dɛ chɔ kaa bobɛlbwa kaa bojaŋ.
A wola tɔpere la ne o jwaana bwa, hale tɔɔ aa baa per bwa la, Israel tena la lɔɔ jo a ta dɛɛ paa.
Bɛlbwa dɔ dɛ ɛ kuruwa dela fifraanue ne a habɔɔ, dɛ pa nyenɛ bar bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la bwa.
Ba taa lɔ ola la ta dɛɛ chwe aa wola tonɛ la, Korowii baah di ba nɛ, asɛ o kpɔ weechɔɡa ane ba ta ba nɛ.
Gɛɛ a do ba pa bela sɔn Kebrɔt Hataava, dɛkalkɛŋɔ belaa ba bini banɔ la ba pɛla aa dɔ kondikwaa tenten la serewe, ba huɡ ba.
Ba iro le Kebrɔt Hataava, dɛ valɛ kaa Haserɔt, dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so bela.
Miriam ne Arɔn naɡra baa naɡre Mosis wa Awola bɛl, Miriam ne Arɔn pa mun dɛɛ naɡre Mosis waa kɛŋɔ waa mo haah le Kus harɛ ta baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Itiopia la.
Ba ŋɔ, “Mosis ɡbo nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ bol waa kɛɛ?
O ta ya te nɛɛ cheɡɛ dɛ bol wa aa?” Asɛ Korowii no waa la.
Dɛ Mosis ɛ nomɛl waa pwɛra kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ɡwaa nomɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta.
Buɡ la ta, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Miriam be ŋɔ, “He nɛra batoro la bwa le ba n Dea Cheremibɔr bela.” Asɛ ba bwa le kaa.
Korowii cheɡɛ bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua ta, dɛ tu ba che o Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela, dɛ yerɛ Arɔn ne Miriam, asɛ ba le ba che sie.
O ŋɔ, “Hé no n waa nɔ, Dɛ n keame lɔ he bini naa, chaahna taa n che dɛ kpɔ n te dɛɛ baɡlo, dɛɛ bol waa o be deera ta.
Gɛ laa n ne n bonɔɔ Mosis waa do.
O waa dɔ kasinteŋ, n kpɔ n nɛra bwa do o nɔn ta.
N ne o bol wa dɔŋa be, a bini chɔ kɛrɛdɛ, wobobeela laa.
O dɛ na ɡɛ maa doa kɛrɛdɛ.
Ɛrɛ waa haa wola ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ he bol n bonɔɔ Mosis waa nɔɔ?” Korowii baah di ba nɛɛ kohona, dɛ kaa ɡel ba.
Bam la aa le Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la ta la, bwadabii weechɔɡa ane den le Miriam nɛ, o bwara bwa to kɛŋɔ yabi ken.
Asɛ Arɔn ke nyiŋi Miriam, dɛ na kɛŋɔ bwadabii weechɔɡa le o nɛ.
Ate, Arɔn ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, bɛ wechɔɡa yaa ɡɛna dɛ ɛ nɔ ne daŋre, dɛ́ tɛr ya deŋne.
Bɛ ɡel Miriam do kɛŋɔ bifol waa sewa mɔɔ o nya lolɔ, mɔɔ o bampera chɔɡ.” Anee Mosis wi no Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n dɛ soŋe, chaoh!” Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ Miriam mɛɛ fe ta nentane ta o sie ta naa, ba fe ta on kpɔe le he baah ta o ka so dahara tɔpera anuanɛ sihiih kpoo waa?
Hé le Miriam ne dahara, dɛ́ ɡel o so bela tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ he berɛ ba o ne.” Anomanta, ba le Miriam ne, dɛ ɡel o so dahara tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ dɛ berɛ ba o ne.
Israel tena la ta ire le bela ka tel kɛŋɔ baa ba o ne mɔɔ.
Dɛ ba soɡe Haserɔt, asɛ dɛ ir le bela dɛ kaa Paran pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bobɛl dɛ ka so.
Keenan harɛ ta sɔeh ka nyiŋi Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Le baala la bini bane bá ka sɔh nyiŋi Keenan harɛ maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba Israel tena tɛɛ la.
Deene la bɛlbwa le o nomonnyu bá kaa.” Anomanta, ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis laanee o lee ba bá le Paran pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ kaa.
Dɛ ba bini bɛlbwa ɛ nomonnyu Israel tena bini.
Nɛra waa tom ba la sɔnaa teŋa nɔ, Rubin dea, Sakur bibaa Samoa.
Simeon dea, Hɔr bibaa Safat.
Juda dea, Jefune bibaa Kaleb.
Isaaka dea, Josef bibaa Iɡal.
Efrem dea, Nun bibaa Hosia.
Bɛnjamen dea, Rafu bibaa Palti.
Sebulon dea, Sodi bibaa Gadeɛl.
Manasɛ dea, Susi bibaa Gaadi waa ɛ Josef naa.
Dan dea, Gemali bibaa Ameɛl.
Aasa dea, Maekel bibaa Sɛtur.
Naftale dea, Vofsi bibaa Naabi.
Gad dea, Maki bibaa Gewɛl.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ Mosis tomɛ ba ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la.
Dɛ Mosis tɛ Nun bibaa Hosia sɔnfale bɛl baa yerɔ Josua.
Waa tom ba ŋɔ bá ka sɔh nyiŋi Keenan harɛ la, o ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ́ kaa deŋɡarere harɛ la ta.
Hé pese harɛ la, dɛ́ na ɡɛ waa doa, dɛ́ berɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ nɛra baa soɡe o ta la kpeɡri kɛɛ baa kpeɡe, ba warɔ kɛɛ ba ta warɔɔ.
Hé nyiŋi ɡɛ harɛ la mar aa doa ba so o ta la, o wer kɛɛ waa weroo?
Ne ɡɛ bwɛɛre la aa doa ba so a ta.
Ba ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara kɛɛ, ba ta mae bara ɔ?
Hé nyiŋi bela harɛ teera la na, harɛdɛɛɡee kɛɛ harɛdɛɛɡe laa ɔ?
Daa lɔ o ta kɛɛ daa toole o ta nɔ?
Hé takapɔ ba daa aa lɔ bela nɔna ane ne.” Dɛ ɡrepo nɔnloɡla swɛɛra saŋee.
Ate, ba chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la.
Ba cheɡɛ Sin pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ ka le Rehob waa lɔ Lebo Hamat ŋwɛnɛ ta.
Ba kpɔ Nɛɡɛv waa ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ ka tel Hɛbrɔn.
Dɛ nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Anak naanar soɡe bela.
Banee Ahiman ne Sɛsae dɛ Talmai tena.
Dɛ ba vɔrɔwe Hɛbrɔn bene anuanɛ mɔɔ dɛ vɔrɔwe Soan waa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta.
Nɛra waa tom ba la aa tel Ɛskɔl Fɛlembɔjen ta la, ba teŋe ɡrepo kpale o nɔna aa warɛ o ta.
Ba bini banɛ kpɔɔ saɡɛ daa ta, dɛ cheo vaama ta.
Ba tɔɔ daa bɛl nɔna aa do ɡuleɡule baa yera pɔmeɡranet ne fiɡ nɔna ɡe dɛ ja.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ taa a che ba pa bela sɔn Ɛskɔl Fɛlembɔjen, dɛkalkɛŋɔ belaa Israel tena la teŋe ɡrepo kpale o nɔna aa warɛ o ta.
Tɔpera fifraanaarɛ ne tela la, dɛ ba sɔɔh dɛ ka nyiŋi harɛ la waa bwa tonɛ, asɛ dɛ berɛ ba.
Toroma la berɔ ba Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Israel tena la bwa be Kades waa lɔ Paran pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Dɛ ba bol waa baa kaa na la Israel tena la bwa be, dɛ kpɔ harɛ la ta daa nɔna la baɡ ba.
Ba ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ya laŋɔ ka nyiŋi harɛ haa tomɛ yaa o ta la.
Kasinteŋ, o ɛ harɛ waa soma dɛ won kondikwaa ɛɛ kohona.
Daa nɔna aa le o taa la.
Kɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela te kpeɡri, ba bwɛɛre la kan, ba ma danjwɛjena bara.
Hale ya na Anak tena naanar bela.
Amalɛk tena soɡe Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, Hiti ne Jebus dɛ Amɔre tena so deŋɡarere harɛ ta, asɛ Keenan tena ɡe so bɛne Mɛdetereenea Mpo ne Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa.” Dɛ harɛ la waa beɡra baa chole nɛra baa cheme Mosis sie la nɛ, asɛ Kaleb waa ɛ nɛra baa tom ba la bini bɛl ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ yá ka puu ba yo, dɛ́ lɛ harɛ la.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ yaa wonoo lɛ.” Anee nɛra o ne baa laŋa la ŋɔ, “Yaa won puu ba yo, ba kpeɡri ɡwaa yaa.” Ate, ba kpɔ harɛ la waa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe ba bala Israel tena la bini, dɛ teŋe nyosone dɛɛ chɔɡ ba liire ŋɔ, “Harɛ la aa were dɛ́ won cha yaa kohona, nɛra yaa na ba bela ɡe bwa kpekpeɡo kɛrɛdɛ.
Ya na nɛra baa kpekpeɡa kohona dɛ ɛ Anak tena naanar bela.
Yaa na ba la, dɛ ya jeɡre kɛŋɔ hɔɔhre ken ba siwi ta.”
Israel tena lwɛmkpeɡ wa Awola jwaana la ne bwa, Israel tena bwa dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛ wi kohona.
Ba naɡre Mosis ne Arɔn wa dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya soɡe Ijipt harɛ dɛ fee serewe, kɛɛ dɛ serewe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bonɔ kwaraa naa, ya fe dɛ nyin!
Ɛrɛ waa Korowii kpɔ yaa dɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta ásɛ ba ba kpoo yaa nɔɔ?
Baa lawɛ ya haahna ne biirii kaa.
Ya berɔ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta fe ta bɔ naa?” Asɛ ba ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ yá le nomoa waa tɔ ya sie, dɛ́ berɛ kaa ya ne Ijipt harɛ ta.” Belaa Mosis ne Arɔn kpɔ ba sie pi harɛ Israel tena baa chema la bwa sie.
Anee Nun bibaa Josua ne Jefune bibaa Kaleb ba fa aa ja nɛra la nɛɛ dɛ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la laa ba laala baa doa la peeɡe, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba dɛ di suna, dɛ ŋɔ Israel tena baa cheme bela la bwa be ŋɔ, “Harɛ yaa ɡaaɡe o ta dɛ ka sɔh nyiŋu la ɛ harɛdɛɛɡe kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Korowii sɛoh waa, wɛɛ tɔ ya siee, dɛ́ la ya ne harɛ la ta.
O ɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe, wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ yaa.
He bɛ ɡaeh lɛ Korowii nɛɛ dɛ vɛoh.
He bɛ harɛ la ta nɛra ɡe ɔmɛ.
Yaa wono pɔ ba nɛ, kwaa baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ a ta la toole kpa.
Korowii teŋɛ ya nɛ, he bɛ ban ɔmɛ.” Kɛ ane a bwa, nɛra la bwa bolɔ ŋɔ baa foɡre Josua ne Kaleb bweaa kpo.
Belaa Korowii jirima ba o Dea Cheremibɔr bela, Israel tena la bwa na.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo nɛra nɔ ɛɛ ba n nyubaah nyiŋa ɡela ɔ?
Ba teŋɔ dɛɛ vɛɛh mɛ ŋɔ baa men yarada, hale n nyokpowe-ɛɛla maa ɛa ba bini la bwa habɔɔ.
Weechɔɡaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta ba nɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba, kɛ he te, mɛɛ ɡeloo he mun ya kohona dɛ́ warɛ, dɛ́ do kpeɡri ɡwaa ba ɡɛ n fe aa ŋɔa mɛɛ ɛɛ ba la.” Mosis berɔ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Dɛ Ijipt tena no a wa aa, ɛrɛɛ baa ba bola ɔ?
Ba ɡbabir na he kpeɡri haa kpɔa lɛ nɛra nɔ le ba be.
A ba ɡɛ naa, baa boloo baɡle nɛra baa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta bá ɡe jemɛ a wa.
Ba noɔ wubwa dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ he cheɡɛ ba habɔɔ he ne ba bol wa, he bam tɔ ba nɛɛ baa valɛ.
He tɔ ba sie webaŋa bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua bini, asɛ dɛ bɔr joɔ ɡe aa, o yon berɛ nii tɔ ba sie.
He pɛo kpoo ba bwa kera beŋkpoŋ aa, harɛre ta nɛra baa no la, baa dɛɛ boloo ŋɔ, ‘Ntam Korowii aa ŋwɛɛra dɛ baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ la Israel tena ne Keenan harɛ taa la, o horɔ, anomanta, o kpoo ba ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.’ Anomanta, n Naa Korowii, ɡel ya na he kpeɡri ya baah, ɡɛ he fa aa baɡla la.
He ŋɔ he baah aa di warawara, he nyina do kan kohona, dɛ kpɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ne lwɛmkpeɡ tena waa dɛɛ kɛ ba.
Kɛ he dɛ tɛr nomɛlbwa waa di bolchɔɡe deŋne, dɛɛ tɛr nɛra baa ɛ wechɔɡa la deŋne, hale dɛ kpoŋe ka tel ba naanar bele batoro kɛɛ banaarɛ baa ka ba la.
Che he nyina waa kana kohona la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ nɛra nɔ wechɔɡa kɛ ba, ɡɛ haa kpɔa dɛɛ kɛ ba le saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ ba le taraken nɔ la.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “N kpɔɔ kɛ ba ɡɛ haa soŋa la.
Kɛ dɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ kɛ n lole, n jirima ɡe su harɛ bwa ta naa, nɛra la baa na n jirima ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla maa ɛa Ijipt harɛ ta ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, ba ta n waa noe dɛ ta daah mɛ dɛɛ na hale kera fi bwa la, ba bini beŋkpoŋ ɡba aa harɛ maa ŋwɛɛ ntam dɛ baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba la taa tel.
Nomɛlbwa o siwi aa wola men tɔɡɛ la aa harɛ la taa tel.
Kɛ n bonɔɔ Kaleb te aa wola doe kɛŋɔ ban, dɛ dɔ yarada kohona dɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ bambile bwa ne nɔ, mɛɛ la o ne harɛ waa la o ta la taa, ásɛ o ɛ o naanar kon.
Amalɛk ne Keenan tena aa soɡe felembɔjena la bini nɔ, kere hé laa berɛ dɛ́ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa dɛ kaa Mposwɛm ta la.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Ń lawɛ bambile nɛnchɔɡa baa dɛ naɡre n waa nɔ nɛɛ ka tel saŋ besoo?
N no waa Israel tena aa dɛ naɡre la bwa.
Anomanta, ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Men Korowii taa lole nɔ, wobɛlbwa aa le nɛn nyoa n no la taa mɛɛ ba teŋa dɛ́ ɛ tɛo.
Hɛɛ serewoo pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɔ ta.
Bɛlbwa waa di bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ ba kuro dɛ chwerɛ o sɔn, asɛ o naɡre n waa laanee dɛɛ ba sewa.
He bini bɛlbwa aa harɛ maa ŋwɛɛra sibeɡra ne ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heyaa he so la taa tel, atane Jefune bibaa Kaleb ne Nun bibaa Josua ɡbo.
He bii haa ŋɔa baa laɡ ba laa taa kaa la, mɛɛ la ba ne harɛ haa vɛah la taa bá ka na som dɛ́ di o tɔnɔ.
He te, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɔ taa hɛɛ ba serewa.
Asɛ he bii ɛ peteɡra dɛɛ ɡaaɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɔ ta bonɔ bene fifraanaarɛ dɛɛ koh, á ɛ yarada haa wola dɔe la kembɔr, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ he bwa aa baa serewe kwaraa.
Bene fifraanaarɛɛ hɛɛ ba he deŋnetɛra kembɔr dɔe, benanyoa bɛlbwa cheɡɔ tɛ tɔpera fifraanaarɛ la tɔpebeŋkpoŋ haa kpɔa ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la.
Ásɛ he na kɛŋɔ men Korowii, dɛ n ŋɔ mɛɛ tɛr he deŋne yaa, dɛ a ɛ sibeɡra.’ Nɛnchɔɡa bane le, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba kpɔe ɛ nɛra nɔ bwa, kɛŋɔ baa pɛ nyoa dɛɛ yoo mɛ nɔ.
Pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɔ taa baa ba kae, dɛ́ bwa serewe kwaraa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Nɛra Mosis aa tom ba ba ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la aa bera ba la, ba ta kasinteŋ ba bolɛ ŋɔ harɛ la wer, a ɡel nɛra la ɛɛ naɡre Mosis wa.
Korowii ɡelɔ weechɔɡa ane ba le nɛra baa ɡela waa la perɛ kɛŋɔ harɛ la aa were la nɛ, ba bwa serewe o siwi ta.
Baala baa laŋa dɛ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la bwa bini, Nun bibaa Josua ne Jefune bibaa Kaleb ɡboo kaa baa wola serewɛ.
Mosis aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡle Israel tena bwa la, ba wio kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, tɔɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, ba iro kaa deŋɡarere harɛ la ta dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya ɛ wechɔɡa, yáa la harɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ yaa nyoa la taa.” Belaa Mosis ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ dɛɛ vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa nɔɔ?
Ken te aa maɡre.
He bɛ kaa!
He dɔma ɛɛ kpoo heyaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ta he nɛɛ jae.
Korowii laa nɔn kpɔ he nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he le o habɔɔ.
Amalɛk ne Keenan tena ɛɛ cheme heya belaa dɛ́ kpoo heya.” Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ ba ɛ ba liire kɛŋɔ aa maɡroo, dɛ teeh dɛɛ kaa deŋɡarere harɛ la ta, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ Mosis kɛɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ta cheɡɛ o buɡ ta bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la.
Ate, Amalɛk ne Keenan tena baa soɡe deŋɡarere harɛ la ta la tu ba lɔ tɔ ba nɛ, ba lɔɔ ba dɛ doŋ ba ka tel bwɛɛ Hɔrma ta.
Kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ja saraha kwaa ta Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he kaa tel harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ he so o ta la, dɛɛ nyin he fuh saraha kwaa tɛo dɛ́ le he nae kɛɛ peera bini a sɔɔh do som o be naa, dɛ saraha kwaa haa fuah kɛɛ nyobaɡa saraha, kɛɛ anɔ la aa le he bambile ta, kɛɛ he tɔpejena la dii saraha bɛlbwa ɡee yaa, a chɛ kɛ náate waa kpɔ saraha kwaa dɛɛ ba la ɛ mea kuruwa beŋkpoŋ del ja a ta ba tɛ Korowii.
Á ɛ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa beŋkpoŋ ne fah koo a ta.
Pebie bɛlbwa waa kpɔ ba ɛ saraha baa fuh kɛɛ saraha bɛlbwa la, náate kpɔ sen dɛ ɛ pɛrɛntoa beŋkpoŋ ne fah ja a ta ɛ sen saraha.
Dɛ pebal ɡee hɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii naa, hé kpɔ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ kuruware anɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anɛ koo a ta á ɛ mea saraha dɛ ja a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ sen dɛ ɛ pɛrɛntoa dela anɛ ja a ta ɛ sen saraha, ásɛ a sɔɔh do som Korowii be.
Dɛ he kpɔ nabale dɛɛ ba ba ɛ saraha baa fuuh kɛɛ nyobaɡa saraha kɛɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ Korowii aa, hé kpɔ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ɛ kuruware atoro ja nabale la ta ba ɛ mea saraha la, dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela atoro koo a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ja ba.
Hé kpɔ sen pɛrɛntoa dela atoro ja, dɛ́ ba ɛ sen saraha.
A ɛ saraha baa fuah a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som Korowii be.
Nabal bɛlbwa kɛɛ pebal, pebie kɛɛ bombie bɛlbwa la, ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛ he ɛo.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛ hé ɛ a bini bɛlbwa haa dɛ ba kpɔe ɛ saraha la.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛ Israel te bɛlbwa waa ba saraha kwaa ne ŋɔ bá fuh a sɔɔh do som Korowii be la ɛ. Hale he naanar baa ka ba, dɛ hɔɔh bɛl baa choɡ heya kɛɛ dɛ ba so he bini dɛɛ nyin ó ɛ ɡɛ saraha baa fuah a sɔɔh do som Korowii be naa, ó ɛa ɡɛ tenten haa dɛ ɛa nɔ.
Wesiwi beŋkpoŋii chɛ kɛ á chɔ le tɛ Israel tena ne hɔɔhra bwa.
Gɛ waa nɔ chɔ le saŋ te bɛlbwa, dɛ tɛ he naanar baa ka ba bwa.
He ne hɔɔhra la bwa ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ men Korowii sie.
A ɡɛ Mmara nɔ chɔ le tɛ he ne hɔɔhra baa soɡe he bini la bwa.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa tel harɛ Korowii kpɔ heyaa dɛɛ kaa o ta la ta, asɛ dɛ dɔ harɛ la ta kondikwaa ane di aa, hé kpɔ a bini ane ɛ saraha tɛo.
Hé kpɔ meloɡla haa tɔ sie nama la ane ɛ paanoo ane so siwii baa dɛ do noo a ta la ɛ saraha tɛo.
Le he naanar baa ka ba bwa bini, a chɛ kɛ hé kpɔ meloɡla haa nama nɔ ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Dɛ he ta wone teŋɛ waa Korowii aa do Mosis nɔ bɛlbwa ta, dɛ he laa saahna, kɛɛ mmarare waa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ heyaa dɛ le awola waa bol waa la dɛ kpoŋe kaa he naanar baa ka ba bwa bini, dɛ he bwa laa saahna, asɛ nɛra la bwa jemaa, amɔ te bá bwa kpɔ nabale ɛ saraha baa fuuh o sɔɔh do som Korowii be, dɛ́ kpɔ mea ne sen sarahare waa baɡle a waa la ja, ne bombal ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.
Sɔfo la chɛ kɛ ó soŋe Israel tena bwa wechɔɡa tɛɛ ba Korowii be, ásɛ o kpɔ kɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba laa saahna.
Bá berɛ kpɔ kwaa dɛ ba fuh ɛ saraha, ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Wɛɛ kpɔ he Israel tena ne hɔɔhra baa soɡe he bini la bwa wechɔɡaa kɛ heya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ waa haa wola saahnɛ ɛ la maah he bwa.
Kɛ dɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ta saahnɛ dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, a chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ bohlor waa di benanyoa ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.
Sɔfo la kpɔ soŋe naate la wechɔɡa waa wola saahnɛ ɛ la tɛo Korowii be, ásɛ o kpɔ kɛo.
A ɡɛ Mmara nɔ chɔɔ tɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola saahnɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, hale Israel te kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe he bini.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa saahnɔ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, bwɛɛlembie yo, hɔɔhree yo, naate ɛ Korowii nɛnhɛla.
Gɛ nɛn la ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kuro ja o nɛra bini.
Waa ɛ Korowii nɛnhɛla dɛ chɔɡ o Mmarare nomanta, naate ta chɛ kɛ bá kuro ja o nɛra bini kpa.
O wechɔɡa dawɛ o nɛ.” Nɛn waa chɔɡ Ona Tɔpere kpoe Israel tena taa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela la, ba na baa bɛl wɛɛ nyin damara Ona Tɔpere ta.
Nɛra baa nao la lawɔ la Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Israel tena la bwa sie, dɛ ka lawɔ do dea, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba ta ɡɛ baa ɛo nae mɔɔ.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ chɛ kpoe.
A chɛ kɛ Israel tena la bwa lawɔ kaa bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la dahara, dɛ́ ka foɡro bwea kpo.” Ate, ba bwa den lawɔ le dahara dɛ ka foɡro bwea kpo, ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la.
Jɔɔra nyara dɛ do batakaarere nyoo Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “He ne he naanar baa ka ba bwa, a chɛ kɛ hé nyarɛ jɔɔra dɛɛ do he batakaarere nyoo.
Hé pɛrɛ ŋwɛn waa ɛ burum dɛ́ do jɔɔra la bɛlbwa ta.
Jɔɔra nɔɔ dɛɛ ba Korowii waa maa do heyaa a ta la dɛɛ liira, á ɡel hɛɛ teŋɛ a ta dɛ bɛ Korowii waa vɛh, dɛ́ kaa teŋɛ he pɛlchɔɡa kwaa haa dɛ naa, ne anɔ la aa lɔ he bambili ta la.
Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛɛ lii o Mmarare waa do heyaa a ta la bwa ta, dɛ do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ waa le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta ŋɔ hé baa tomɔ la.
Onee Korowii.”
Kora ne Datan dɛ Abiram Awola bɛl, Isiha bibaa Kora, ne Kora naa Kohat.
Kora nɔ nabaalee Lewi.
Kora ne Eliab bibaala Datan ne Abiram, dɛ Pɛlet bibaa Ɔn, ba bwa aa le Rubin dea la ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ ɛ Mosis dɔm.
Ba ja baala lafraanɛ fifraanue bane baa lee ba ba ɛ nomonnyuune nomɛlbwa jemɛ ba wa, asɛ ba chɔ Israel tena bwa nyoa.
Ba pɛo dɛ la Mosis ne Arɔn be dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ɡwaa nomɛlbwa kɛɛ?
Israel te bɛlbwa ɛ Korowii nɛra, o ja ya bwa nɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ he ɡbo ɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ɡwaa Korowii nɛra bwa nɔɔ?” Mosis aa no ɡɛ la, o kpɔ o sie pi harɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii.
Belaa o ŋɔ Kora ne o bala baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa be ŋɔ, “Kere chɔɔ Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo yá jemɛ naate waa ɛ o nɛn, dɛ́ ɡel naate ba o sie.
Nomɛlbwa waa leo laanee dɛɛ ba wona la o sie.
Kɛ hen Kora te, waa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ he ne he bala la ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, hé kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ buh nii la, ásɛ dɛ do nii a ta kere, dɛ́ kpɔ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma do a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ka cheɡ Korowii sie bela.
Yaa na naate Korowii aa leo o ɛ o kon.
He Lewi dea tena te dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ɡwaa nomɛlbwa kohona!” Mosis berɔ ŋɔ Kora be ŋɔ, “Lewi dea tena, hé no.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa pere heyaa le he bala Israel tena bini, dɛ kpɔ heyaa bɛno ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ɛ o Tɛnte Dea la toma, dɛ́ berɛ che Israel tena bwa sie, dɛ́ cha ba baa tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ aa chɛa la, a ɡbo ta maɡraa?
Korowii kpɔ he ne he bala Lewi dea tena bwa bɛne o te, kɛ taraken he berɔ dɛɛ nyin sɔfore ɡe dɛ di ja.
Korowiirii he ne he bala baa teŋɛ he nɛɛ pɛ nyoa dɛɛ ɛo dɔm la.
Arɔn te laa, asɛ hɛɛ naɡre o wa.” Asɛ Mosis yerɛ Eliab bibaala Datan ne Abiram ŋɔ bá ba, asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Yaa ba.
Kpɔe haa kpɔ yaa le Ijipt harɛpare ondɛɛɡe ta, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ba ba kpoo yaa ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bonɔ ta maɡraa?
Gɛɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ di kpeɡri ya nɛ aa?
Anɔ la aa bera ja laanee kɛŋɔ, he ta ya ne harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la ta balɛ.
He ta yaa harɛ ne daa kooni tɛɛ yaa di a ta.
Bɛ nepor lɔ ta ya sie ta.
Akai, yaa ba!” Belaa Mosis baah di ba nɛɛ kohona dɛ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n poori, bɛ ba saraha kwaa baa kpɔ ba tɛɛ lɛ!
N ta komɛlbwa waa ɛ konjeɡa kɛŋɔ keeɡo kwaraa ba be lɛɛ, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ n ɛ ba bini bɛl wechɔɡa.” Mosis ŋɔ Kora be ŋɔ, “Kere he ne he bala baa ja he nɛɛ la bwa ba Korowii sie, Arɔn ɡe ɛɛ ba bɛlee.
Gel he bala lafraanɛ fifraanue la bɛlbwa kpɔ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ buh nii, dɛ́ kpɔ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma do a bini ba Korowii sie.
He ne Arɔn dɛ ba bwaa chɛ kɛ hé ba a ne.” Anomanta, nomɛlbwa kpɔ o kon, dɛ buh nii dɛ kpɔ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma do a ta dɛ kpɔ ba, asɛ ba ne Mosis ne Arɔn che Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.
Kora aa yerɛ o bala baa wara la bwa cheme Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela la, Korowii jirima balɔ, nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa na.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Hé pere he te le ɡɛ nɛra nɔ nɛ, ásɛ n won kpoo ba, ba waa den tonɛ buɡ nɔ ta.” Ate, Mosis ne Arɔn kpɔ ba sie pi harɛ dɛ do lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, nɛwɛnyina bwa mkpa lɔ he be, dɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, hɛɛ koh a waa he baah di ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa nɛ aa?” Anee Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ bá laa ba tɛnte deene laa kpɔ Kora ne Datan dɛ Abiram kwaa jwɛh.” Belaa Mosis den ir la Datan ne Abiram be, asɛ Israel nomonome la teŋɛ o nɛ.
O kah nɛra baa cheme bela la ŋɔ, “Hé laa he te kpɔ nɛnchɔɡa nɔ tɛnte deene jwɛh!
He bɛ ba komɛlbwa leɡe, ásɛ ba wechɔɡa maah heya, ásɛ he ne ba bwa bɛ pɛ serewe.” Ate, nɛra la le Kora ne Datan dɛ Abiram tɛnte deene la jwɛh.
Dɛ Datan ne Abiram ne ba haahna ne bii dɛ bechajeɡre bwa leɔ ba che ba tɛnte deene doonyoo.
Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “Anɔ taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba liire ne laa mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, kɛ Korowiirii tom mɛ.
Dɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ sewɔ ɡɛ nɛra bwa aa dɛ sewɛ, ba seo ta koraa, amɔ te Korowii laa tom mɛ.
Kɛ dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ waane aa wola chiɡe ka bwa ta, dɛ ɡel harɛ pere asɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ne ba komɛlbwa baa dɔa jo kaa harɛ bini ba serewe aa, anee hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ baala nɔ ɛ Korowii sisawa.” Mosis aa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa tonɛ la, belaa harɛ baa cheɡɛ o ta la den pere, dɛ kpɔ ba ne ba dem tena ne Kora ne o nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa, dɛ laala baa dɔa bwa jo kaa harɛ bini.
Ba joɔ kaa harɛ bini dɛ ba siwi ta lole, a den do kɛŋɔ baa huɡ ba ken, ba ne ba komɛlbwa baa dɔa.
Harɛ nyoorɔ tɔ ba nɛ, ba nyoɡre kwaraa.
Nɛra la aa joa dɛɛ kaa harɛ bini dɛɛ wi la, Israel tena baa lɔ baah bela chwao dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ chwa!
Harɛ dɛ ba pera ya ɡe jo o bini kaa.” Asɛ nii le Korowii be, dɛ ba fuh nɛra lafraanɛ fifraanue baa dɛ fuh daawiile la bwa.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Eliasa be ŋɔ ó laa kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ fuh daawiile la le kwaa aa dɛ fuh la ta, dɛ́ fuɡe a hɔla ka ta bojaŋ.
A do ɡoroŋ.
Kwaa nɛra la aa kpoŋaa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ fuh daawiile a ta dɛ serewe la, hé lɔɔra a paɡri dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ tɔ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta.
A te do ɡoroŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba kpɔa baa fuh daawiile Korowii sie.
Hé ɡel a ɡɛ kwaa baa lɔɔra dɛ tɔ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta nɔ do le dɛ́ ja Israel tena bwa.” Gɛɛ a do sɔfo Eliasa lɔɔ ayaawa kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ fuh daawiile baala baa fuah la aa kpɔa ba dɛ serewe la, ba kpɔ dɛɛ tɔ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ baɡle Eliasa la.
Anɔɔ dɛ́ ja Israel tena kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola Arɔn naa mun leɛ ta chɛ kɛ ó la Korowii sie ka fuh daawiile.
Bɛlbwa ɛ ɡɛ naa, Kora ne o bala waa aa puu ba laanee wɛɛ ba nae.
Tɔ aa pera la, Israel tena la bwa berɔ naɡre Mosis ne Arɔn waa ŋɔ, “He nɛra banɛ nɔɔ kpoo Korowii nɛra la.” Israel tena la aa pɛa dɛɛ naɡre waa Mosis ne Arɔn be la, ba berɛ sie ta Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela, buɡ la ta, ba na kɛŋɔ bam la baa tɔ o ta, asɛ Korowii jirima tɔ o bwa.
Ate, Mosis ne Arɔn la ka che Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la sie, asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Hé laa he te kpɔ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bini, ásɛ n won kpoo ba buɡ nɔ ta ba waa tonɛ.” Asɛ Mosis ne Arɔn kpɔ ba sie pi harɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii.
Belaa Mosis ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile o bini la dɛ́ do ane o ta, dɛ́ buh nii le saraha kon la ta do o ta.
Ɛ warane kpɔ kaa nɛra la baah ta, dɛ́ ka soŋe ba wechɔɡa Korowii be ó kpɔ kɛ ba.
Korowii baah di ba nɛ, weechɔɡa la pa mun ba bini.” Ate, Arɔn ɛ ɡɛ Mosis aa ŋɔ o be la, dɛ den kpɔ ɛ warane chwa ka jo nɛra la baah ta.
Dɛ weechɔɡa la dɔɔ pa mun, asɛ Arɔn fuh daawiile la, dɛ ka soŋe ba wechɔɡa Korowii be tɛɛ ba o kpɔ kɛ ba.
Arɔn kaa che nɛra baa serewa chɔ ne weera la baah ta, asɛ weechɔɡa la ɡel.
Nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banaarɛ lafraanuanɛɛ sewa weechɔɡa la ta, dɛ ja banɔ la baa koh Kora waa sewɛ la nɛ.
Weechɔɡa la nyoa aa sɔɔhna la, Arɔn berɛ kaa Mosis be Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa bela.
Arɔn daŋɡbala papooni moɡa wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Yerɛ Israel tena dɛ lɛ daŋɡbale fi dɛ anɛ le ba deene nomonnyuune la be.
Dea bɛlbwa kon beŋkpoŋ, ásɛ dɛ chwerɛ dea bɛlbwa nomoa sɔn dawɛ o daŋɡbala ta.
Chwerɛ Arɔn sɔn dawɛ Lewi dea daŋɡbala la ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ dea nomonnyu bɛlbwa dɔ o daŋɡbala.
Kpɔ daŋɡbale la ka bil n Dea Cheremibɔr, N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie bela maa dɛ cheme heyaa la.
Naate máa leo ó ɛ sɔfo la, o daŋɡbala la ɛɛ moɡɛ papoonii, ásɛ n teŋe saŋ bɛlbwa naɡra Israel tena aa dɛ naɡre he waa a pe mɛ la ta.” Ate, Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be, asɛ ba nomonnyuune la kpɔ daŋɡbale fi dɛ anɛ tɛo, bɛlbwa kon beŋkpoŋ.
Dɛ Arɔn ɡe kon jao.
Ate, Mosis pa ka teɡli Korowii Tɛnte Dea, O Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie.
Tɔ aa pera la, Mosis kaa jo Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela, dɛ Arɔn daŋɡbala waa cheɡa tɛ Lewi dea tena la moɡɛ papooni, hale dɛ fe, dɛ nɔnɛ daa bɛl nɔna baa dɛ yera almɔn.
Ate, Mosis pa daŋɡbale la bwa aa lɔ Korowii sie bela la le dɛ ba baɡle Israel tena la, asɛ nomoa bɛlbwa ba nyiŋi dɛ kpɔ o kon.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kpɔ Arɔn daŋɡbala la ka tel N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, ó do le dɛɛ baɡle lwɛmkpeɡ tena wa.
Anee dɛ́ teŋe n waa baa dɛ naɡre nɔ ta dɛ bɛ serewe.” Asɛ Mosis ɛ ɡɛ tenten Korowii aa doo la bwa.
Ate, Israel tena la ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Amɔ te, yaa serewoo!
Ya waa bwa tonɔ kwaraa!
Nomɛlbwa waa bɛne Korowii Tɛnte Dea la kwaraa ɛɛ sewɔɔ.
Ya bwa dɛ ba tona!”
Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena toma Korowii ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “He ne he bibaala ne Kohat dea tena baa le Lewi dea nɔn taa n Tɛnte Dea la wobɛlbwa do.
Dɛ sɔfore toma ane ta aŋwɛnɛ ta kpɔe yaa, he ne he bibaala ɡbo deŋnee mɛɛ ba tɛra.
Saŋ bɛlbwa he ne he bii aa dɛɛ ba toma ɛɛ n Tɛnte Dea waa ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela la, yerɛ he bala Lewi dea tena la bá ba cha he ne he bibaala haa dɛ cha nɛra la, ásɛ ba won tom mɛ ɡɛ aa chɛa la.
Ba toma ɛɛ bwa lɔ he nɔn ta.
Gel ba nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma bɛlbwa sese aa lɔ n Tɛnte Cheremibɔr dembaah bela la bwa.
Kɛ ɡel ba nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ laala baa kpɔa kwaa Boɡoroŋ la bini, kɛɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ba leɡe.
A ba ɡɛ naa, he ne ba bwa ɛɛ serewoo.
Lewi dea tena la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá ba ja he nɛ, dɛɛ ɛ toma bɛlbwa sese aa lɔ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela.
Kɛ nɛmpɛɛ bɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ba bela haa lole la.
He ɡbabir chɛ kɛŋɔ hé nyiŋi Boɡoroŋ la ne kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta, ásɛ n baah bɛ Israel tena la nɛɛ ba di kpa.
Men Korowii ɡbabirii le he bala Lewi dea tena le Israel tena bini, dɛ́ kpɔ ba tɛɛ, ásɛ ba kpɔ ba te che tɛ mɛ dɛɛ ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela toma.
He ne he bibaala la ɡboo chɛ kɛ hé ɛ sɔfore toma kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta ne pateesan la bini toma.
N kpɔ sɔfore toma la dɛɛ kɛ heya.
Nɛmpɛɛ bɛlbwa waa ba Boɡoroŋ la jwɛɛh la chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.” Saraha kwaa aa ɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena kwa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “N ɡbabirii kpɔe chɔ sarahare baa kpɔa baa tɛ mɛ la nyoa.
Saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ Israel tena kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ la bwa, he ne he bibaalaa n kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ, á ɛ he dibɔr saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Heyaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha baa wola an fuih a do ɡoroŋ kohona la bwa.
Koŋkɛɛla bwa baa kpɔa baa tɛ mɛ a do ɡoroŋ kohona la, hale dɛ mea saraha, kɛɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, kɛɛ bolchɔɡe dii sarahaa yoo, a ɛ he ne he bibaala dibɔr.
Hé dia kɛŋɔ kwaa aa wera dɛ do ɡoroŋ kohona.
Baa bɛlbwa won ane dii.
A chɛ kɛ hé jemɛ kɛ a ɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona.
Anɔ la aa jaa dɛ ɛ he dibɔr laanee nɔ.
Kwaa ba yon kwaa ane cheɡ dɛ́ le saraha kwaa bwa Israel tena yon kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ ɡɔɔra men Korowii sie la, n kpɔa tɛ he ne he bibaala ne bihaahna, á ɛ he dibɔr saŋ bɛlbwa.
He dem nɛn bɛlbwa waa wola doŋa kaeh won a dii.
Kondikonloɡla ane kɛŋɔ ɔleve noo aa wera ne senfala aa wera dɛ meloɡla baa kpɔa baa tɛ men Korowii laanee n kpɔ tɛ heya.
Konloɡla ane bɛlbwa aa le harɛ la ta ba kpɔ ba tɛ men Korowii la bwa ɛ he kwa.
He dem nɛn bɛlbwa waa wola doŋa kaeh won a dii.
Israel harɛ ta komɛlbwa baa kpɔ ba ó ɛ men Korowii ɡbo kon la ɛ he kwa.
Israel tena bibanloɡla ne ba konaatena biloɡla ambala baa kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ la ɛ he kwa.
Kɛ bibanloɡla ne konaatena baa kia biloɡla ambala te, a chɛ kɛ hé ɡel ba charɛ a nyuune.
Bibanloɡle waa di korobie la, hé kpɔ suuɡapoŋa anue charɛ o nyu, ɡɛ baa maɡa bil Korowii Dea bela aa ɛ suuɡa bwejeɡre fifraanɛ la.
Nao kɛɛ pee, kɛɛ booh biloɡle waa ɛ ombal te, he bɛ a nyuune charɛ.
A te ɛ n kwa.
Hé kpɔ a chale merɛ saraha kon la ta, ásɛ dɛ fuh a noorare la kɛŋɔ saraha baa dɛ fuah.
A sɔɔh ɛɛ do men Korowii somee.
Ola la kabora chɛ kɛ a ɛ he kwa, ɡɛ ba yon kpɔ a bambili ne a nadiɡ hwie ɛ saraha dɛ́ ɡɔɔra nyundua dɛ́ viiɡa men Korowii sie a ɛ he kwaa la.
Saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ bwa Israel tena aa kpɔa baa tɛ mɛ he yon le ane cheɡ la, n kpɔɔ tɛ he ne he bibaala ne bihaahna á ɛ he dibɔr saŋ bɛlbwa.
A ɛ fɔo dɛ chɔ le waa wola chɔɡ bwa dɛ tɛ n ne hen ne he naanar bwa.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Haa dibɔr bɛlbwa Israel harɛ la taa dɔ ó ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon.
Menee he dibɔr ne he kapɛrɛ.
Lewi dea tena te, Israel tena kwaa baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ baa tɛ mɛ laanee n kpɔ tɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ ba kapɛrɛ, toma baa dɛ ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela nomanta.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa, dɛ Lewi dea tena laa aa, Israel te bɛlbwa bɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela bɛne.
Aa ɛ wechɔɡaa dɛ́ kaa naate ne seo ta.
Lewi dea tenaa chɛ kɛŋɔ báa ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela toma, ásɛ dɛ toma ane ta aŋwɛnɛ ta kpɔe yaa, banee dɛ́ dɔ a deŋnetɛra le n be.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ chɔ lee dɛɛ la, hale naanar baa ka ba bwa bini.
Ba te ta kapɛrɛ bɛlbwa dɔe Israel tena bini.
Israel tena kwaa baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ baa tɛ mɛ laanee ɛ ba kapɛrɛ.
A waa n ŋɔ ba te ta kapɛrɛ bɛlbwa dɔe Israel tena bini la.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó bol Lewi dea tena la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he dɔ dibɔr bɔrbeŋkpoŋ la le kwaa Israel tena aa bɔne a bini fi la ta naa, hé ɡe bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛ men Korowii a ɛ saraha tɛo.
He saraha ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ mea aa le pɛla ta, kɛɛ ɡrepo daa nɔna baa harame a nee la ken tɛ heya.
Gɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ he ɡe won kpɔ he saraha kwaa aa le Israel tena be bɔrbeŋkpoŋ la ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.
Anɔ la aa ɛ men Korowii bɔr dɛ le a ta la chɛ kɛ hé kpɔ tɛ Arɔn waa ɛ sɔfo la.
Kwaa baa kpɔa ba la bini andɛɛɡa ne anɔ la aa do ɡoroŋ kohona laanee chɛ kɛ hé kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ.
Berɛ ŋɔ Lewi dea tena la be ŋɔ, ‘Hé kpɔ a bini andɛɛɡa ne anɔ la aa do ɡoroŋ ba tɛ mɛ naa, aa doo kɛŋɔ mea aa le pɛla ta kɛɛ ɡrepo daa nɔna baa harame a nee la ken tɛ heya.
He Lewi dea tena ne nɛra baa lɔ he dem, ɛɛ won di a kabora bobɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ a ɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr bela toma haa dɛ ɛ la kembɔr.
Dɛ he pɛne a bini andɛɛɡa ba tɛ men Korowii aa, haa bolchɔɡee di a bɔr.
Haa doŋaa kpɔ kah kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ Israel tena aa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha la, ásɛ dɛ bɛ serewe.’ ”
Nee baa kpɔ sɔ nɛn waa kah doŋa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Mmara maa dɛ nyin n do Israel tena a ta laanee kɛŋɔ, bá lawɛ naneswɛm waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, baa wola daa kpɔe dawɛ o nɛɛ dɛ kpɔɔ parɛ ka ba tɛ mɛ.
Hé lawɔ tɛ sɔfo Eliasa, ásɛ o le o ne he bini kaa dahara dɛ́ ka kpoo n siwi ta.
Ásɛ sɔfo Eliasa kpɔ nonii leɡe nao la chal, dɛ́ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ n Dea Cheremibɔr, dɛ́ ka ɛ merɛ bela kera anuanɛ.
Wɛɛ cheo nyiŋi bá fuh nabir la.
O tɔn ne o ol, ne o chal dɛ o tea bini kwaa bwa.
Sɔfo Eliasa chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ peleme daa ane, ne hesɔp ne pee pona baa doa konswɛɛma ta nao waa dɛ fuh la nɛ.
Waa ɛ ɡɛ tonɛ la, ó sɔ ne, dɛ́ chɛɡɛ o laala mɔɔ dɛ́ won berɛ ba bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la.
Kɛ o doŋa ɛɛ do o nɛɛ ka tel jɔmɔra.
Naate waa fuh nao la ɡe chɛ kɛŋɔ o sɔ ne dɛ chɛɡɛ o laala.
O ɡe kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra mɔɔ o doŋa le o nɛ.
Nɛn waa wola doŋa kaeh laanee chɛ kɛ ó pa nao la tɔɔ ka ta bela doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole tɛnte deene la dahara.
Israel tena la kwaara cheɡ, ásɛ dɛ ba dɛ nyin dɛ sɔ nɛn waa kah doŋa ne aa, bá doa nee ta dɛ́ kpɔ sɔɔ.
Anee dɛ́ baɡle kɛ o wechɔɡa bwa le o nɛ.
Naate waa pa nao la tɔɔ ka cheɡ la ɡe chɛ kɛŋɔ ó sɔ nee dɛ́ chɛɡɛ o laala.
O ɡe kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra mɔɔ o doŋa le o nɛ.
Gɛ waa nɔ chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ tɛ Israel tena ne hɔɔhra baa soɡe ba bini bwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡe nɛn waa sewa la kah doŋa tɔpera anuanɛ.
Naate chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ nee la ane sɔ tɔpetooro wee waa kah doŋa la, ne tɔpenuanɛ wee mɔɔ dɛ́ le o doŋa waa kaah la ta.
Kɛ dɛ o ta o doŋa sɔe ta tɔpetooro wee ne tɔpenuanɛ wee la aa, o ta kah doŋa.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡe nɛn waa sewa dɛ vɛh o doŋa sɔe dɛ ta la kpɔ doŋa kah n Tɛnte Dea la.
A ta chɛ kɛ bá kuro ja Israel tena bini.
Baa wola nee aa laa nɛn doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ o nɛɛ Tɛnte la ɛɛ merɛ naate nɛɛ nomanta, o kah doŋa.
O doŋa ta lɔ o nɛ.
Mmara waa lole dɛ tɛ nomɛl waa sewɛ tɛnte dea bini laanee nɔ.
Nomɛlbwa waa lɔ ɡɛ tɛnte dea la bini, ne nomɛlbwa waa ka jo bela bwa kah doŋa tɔpera anuanɛ.
Komɛlbwa waa dɔ tɔ baa wola o ta tɔe ɡɛ saŋ la ɡe kah doŋa.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡe nɛn baa kpoo, kɛɛ nɛn waa sewɛ ɡɛ nɛra bwa aa dɛ sewɛ, kɛɛ o hoɡ, kɛɛ dɛ o ŋwamee yaa, o kah doŋa ka tel tɔpera anuanɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa kah doŋa la, ɛ nao la tɔɔ aa laa nɛndoŋa dɛɛ kpɔ o nɛɛ la ane do kon bini, dɛ́ do nefala a ta.
Naate waa wola doŋa kaeh chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ hesɔp daa su nee la ne tɔɔ la ta, dɛ́ ɛ merɛ tɛnte dea nɛn aa sewɛ o bini la ta, ne nɛra baa lɔ o bini, dɛ o laala bwa ta.
Dɛ nomɛl leɡe nɛn waa sewa hoɡ kɛɛ ŋwam, kɛɛ nɛn baa kpoo, kɛɛ dɛ sewɛ ɡɛ nɛra bwa aa dɛ sewɛ aa, ó ɛ nee la merɛ o ɡe nɛɛ ɡɛ.
Naate waa wola doŋa kaeh la kpɔ hesɔp daa la su nee la ta, dɛ́ ɛ merɛ naate waa kah doŋa la nɛ tɔpetooro wee ne tɔpenuanɛ wee la ta.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la, ó laa doŋa kpɔ doŋa te la nɛ.
Naate baa laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛɛ la chɛɡɛ o laala dɛ́ sɔ ne, ásɛ awola jɔmɔra la, dɛ o le doŋa ta.
Dɛ nomɛl kah doŋa dɛ vɛh a sɔe dɛ ta aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá sɔɔ lola, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o kpɔ doŋa kah n Tɛnte Dea la.
Ba ta doŋa laa kpɔ o nɛ, o ta kah doŋa.
Mmara nɔ chɔ le tɛɛ ba saŋ bɛlbwa.
Naate waa ɛ nee la dɛɛ merɛ la ɡe chɛ kɛ ó chɛɡɛ o laala.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡe nee la ɡba ɡe kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.
Komɛlbwa naate waa kah doŋa aa leɡo la ɡe kah doŋa.
Nomɛlbwa waa leɡo la ɡe kah doŋa ka tel jɔmɔra.”
