Nee aa le bwe ta Mɛreba Israel tena la bwa tel Sin pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ korobiloɡle ta, dɛ bwa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so Kades.
Belaa Miriam sewɛ ba huɡo.
Dɛ nee toole bela bá nyɔ, asɛ ba bwa ɛɛ naɡre Mosis ne Arɔn wa.
Ba ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ya ne yabala la bwa fe pɛo sewɛ Korowii sie bela fe bɔ.
Bɔkwa waa he ba ya ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɔ ta ya ne ya kondɛɛra bwa ɛɛ ba serewa nɔɔ?
Bɔkwa waa he le ya ne Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ yaa ba ta bochɔɡe nɔ ta ken?
Harɛ yaa wola won parɛ komɛlbwa.
Mea kɛɛ fiɡ daa nɔna kɛɛ ɡrepore kɛɛ pɔmeɡranet nɔna toole.
Nee kwaraa toole ya nyɔ.” Ate, Mosis ne Arɔn le nɛra la bwa be, dɛ la Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela, dɛ ka kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii, asɛ Korowii jirima ba ba nɛ.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ daŋɡbala la ásɛ he ne Arɔn ka cheme nɛra la bwa.
Bol wa, nee ɛɛ le bwe la taa, ásɛ nɛra la ne ba kondɛɛra bwa nyɔ.” Anee Mosis kpɔ daŋɡbala la le Korowii Dea Cheremi Bɔr doonyoa bela, dɛ ka ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.
O ne Arɔn yerɛ nɛra la bwa cheme bwe la jwɛh, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Lwɛmkpeɡ tena, a chɛ kɛ yá dɔ nee le bwe nɔ ta tɛ heya aa?” Ate, o ɡɔɔ daŋɡbala la lɔ bwe la kera anɛ, asɛ nee palɛ le bwe la ta yɔɔ ken, ba ne ba kondɛɛra bwa nyɔ.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Haa wola men yaradae, dɛ kpɔ jirima tɛ mɛ kɛ n do ɡoroŋ Israel tena siwi ta nɔ, haa ba sie tɔ dɛ́ kpɔ ba ka jo harɛ maa baɡ ba nyoa la ta.” Ba pa bela sɔn Mɛreba, dɛkalkɛ belaa Israel tena naɡre Korowii wa, asɛ o baɡ ba kɛŋɔ o do ɡoroŋ.
Edom tena ŋɔ Israel tena bɛ ba harɛ ta kpɔ Kades belaa Mosis tomɛ toroma Edom kooro be ŋɔ, “He lolanar Israel tenaa yaa, he jemɛ ya wenaale yaa lɔ a ta wubwa la.
Gɛ ya naawa aa kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, asɛ ya ka bela biɡri, Ijipt tena fiiɡi yaa, asɛ ya wi no Korowii o no yaa, dɛ ɡel nyundua torome ba kpɔ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta.
Taraken ya lɔ Kades, bwɛɛ waa lɔ he harɛ jwɛh ta.
N poori tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ yá kpɔ he harɛ ta ba kaa.
Yaa kooni ne daa kooni taa kpɔ.
Yaa bule bɛlbwa nee nyɔ, yaa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛjen la taa ba kaa yaa wola bobɛlbwaa bɛɡɛ dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ yaa le he harɛ ta.” Anee Edom kooro ŋɔ, “Akai!
Dɛɛ berɛ n harɛ ta kpɔe, dɛ he hɛlɛ ɡɛ naa, yáa cheme heyaa laa nee.” Asɛ Israel tena la ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛjen la taa yaa ba kpɔe ba kaa.
Dɛ ya bɛlbwa nyɔ he ne, hale ya kondɛɛra kwaraa naa, yaa bɔ a kemee, wobɛlbwa ta jae kpa.” Asɛ Edom tena la berɛ ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ berɛ ya harɛ ta kpɔe.” Ate, dɛ le laa tena baa wara dɛ do kpeɡri ba la ka chem ba.
Edom tena aa wola sɛɛh kɛŋɔ Israel tena kpɔ ba harɛ ta la, ba barɔ kpɔ baŋ bɛl kaa.
Arɔn seo wa Israel tena la bwa le Kades, dɛ ka tel Hɔr Bwejen ta.
Gɛ Hɔr Bwejen nɔ lɔ Edom tena harɛ jwɛh ta.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Arɔn be ŋɔ, “Arɔn ɛɛ sewɔɔ ka pu o naawa.
Waa harɛ maa baɡɛ Israel tena nyoa la taa tel.
He nɛra banɛ nɔ ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ waa maa do heyaa a ta Mɛreba la.
Mosis, kpɔ Arɔn ne o bibaa Eliasa he ne ba kaa Hɔr Bwejen nɔ doa.
Ka foo Arɔn sɔfo laala la dɛ́ kpɔ do o bibaa Eliasa.
Arɔn ɛɛ sewɛ belaa ka pu o naawa.” Ate, Mosis ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.
Ba teehnɔ kaa bwejen la doa Israel tena la bwa siwi ta.
Asɛ Mosis foo Arɔn laala la, dɛ kpɔ do Eliasa, asɛ Arɔn den sewɛ bwejen la doa bela.
Asɛ Mosis ne Eliasa tu le bwe la doa.
Israel tena la bwa aa naa kɛŋɔ Arɔn sewɔ la, ba ɛ o lwe tɔpera fifraatoro.
Israel tena yo Keenan tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ Keenan tena kooro bɛl di kora dɛ so Arad o do Keenan weekaŋle harɛbɔr, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Nɛɡɛv ta.
Waa noa kɛŋɔ Israel tena lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ ba bwɛɛ Atarim la, o iro ka yoo ba dɛ larawe ba bini bane.
Anee Israel tena ŋwɛɛ baɡle Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ he cha yaa ya pɔ Keenan tena nɔ nɛ aa, yaa chɔɡ ba bwɛjena bwaa kwaraa.” Asɛ Korowii no ba wesoŋa la, dɛ laa nɔn kpɔ Keenan tena la nɛ, dɛ ɡel Israel tena pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba kpoo ba, dɛ chɔɡ ba bwɛjena bwa.
Anomanta, ba pa bela sɔn Hɔrma.
Ayaawa harɛkon wa Israel tena le Hɔr Bwejen la bɔr dɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa kaa Mposwɛm ta, dɛ bar kpɔ Edom tena harɛ nyoa.
Baa dɛ kaa la ba ta bambile lawɛ, dɛ bol waa yaɡɛ Korowii ne Mosis ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he kpɔ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta yaa ba ba serewe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken?
Kondikwaa tenten bɛlbwa toole bonɔ, nee ɡe kwaraa toole.
Yaa maana nɔ ɡe nyin kpa.” Belaa Korowii ɡel harɛkonchɔɡa ba ba baah, dɛ choɡri ba ɡalɡa ba serewe.
Israel tena la berɔ ba Mosis be, dɛ ba sɛh ba chɔɡre dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya ɛ wechɔɡa kɛ yaa bol waa yaɡɛ Korowii ne hen.
Soŋe Korowii tɛ yaa, ásɛ o le harɛkwaare nɔ ne tɛ yaa.” Asɛ Mosis soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ ayaawa ɛ harɛkon, dɛ́ kpɔ saɡɛ dajaŋ ta, ásɛ nomɛlbwa harɛkon la bɛl aa choɡo la nyiŋi dajaŋ kon la dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.” Asɛ Mosis kpɔ ayaawa ɛ harɛkon la bɛl, dɛ kpɔ saɡɛ dajaŋ ta.
Dɛ harɛkon choɡe ba bini bɛlbwa o nyiŋi dajaŋ kon la aa, dɛ o dɔ o nyu.
Moab harɛ ta kaala Israel tena la iro, dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene Ɔbɔt, dɛ so bela.
Dɛ berɛ ir Ɔbɔt, dɛ ka so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Iye Abarim.
Bela chɔ Moab sideŋ wee leebɔr.
Ba berɔ le lye Abarim ɡe, dɛ ka so Sɛrɛd Fɛlembɔjen ta.
Dɛ berɛ le Sered Fɛlembɔjen ta bela, dɛ ka so Aanɔn Moo nyoa.
Gɛ moo la chɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛɛ kaa Amɔre tena harɛ ta.
Aanɔn Moo la chɔ Moab tena ne Amɔre tena baah ta, dɛ ɛ ba jwɛh.
A waa ɡela Korowii Laa Waa Yoa Tɔn ɛɛ baɡle ŋɔ, ‘Wahab bwɛɛ ne o nenabɔɔne aa lɔ Sufa harɛ ta.
Dɛ berɛ baɡle Aanɔn Moo la ne o felembɔjena aa le Moab tena jwɛh ta, dɛ wili kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Ar.’ Israel tena le Aanɔn Moo ta, dɛ kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Beɛ, belaa kɔlɔŋ bɛl do, asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Gel nɛra la bwa cheme, ásɛ n tɛɛ ba nee ba nyɔ.” Asɛ Israel tena ɡo yel ŋɔ, “Kɔlɔŋ, ɡel nee ba!
Hé ɡo yel ŋɔ, kɔlɔŋ koobii aa kwiu.
Harɛ nɔ ta nomonjena aa kwiu, ba kpɔ ba koodaŋɡbale ne daŋɡbale kwiu.” Ba le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ kaa Matana, dɛ le Matana kaa Nahaleɛl, dɛ le Nahaleɛl kaa Bamɔt, dɛ le Bamɔt dɛ kaa fɛlembɔjen waa lɔ Moab, Pesɡa Bwejen o sie aa chaɡɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ waa chɔa kaa Yar Mpo ta la ta.
Kooro Sihon ne Kooro Ɔɡ nɛɛ pɔe Israel tena tomɛ nɛra Amɔre Kooro Sihon be ŋɔ, “Tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ ya kpɔ he harɛ ta ba kaa, yaa bɛɡɛ kpɔ kooni kɛɛ daa kooni ta.
Yaa kɔlɔŋ bɛlbwa nee nyɔ.
Yaa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛjen la taa, dɛ́ kpɔ he harɛ la ta ba kaa.” Kooro Sihon ta Israel tena ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ba kpɔ o harɛ ta.
Kɛ dɛ yerɛ o laa tena bwa ba ka pu Israel tena pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ yoo ba.
O kaa puu ba Jahas, asɛ o ne ba yo.
Israel tena kpo Kooro Sihon kere ne, dɛ lɛ o harɛ la dɔɔh.
Le Aanɔn Moo ta dɛ kaa Jabɔk Moo ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Amɔn tena jwɛh ta.
Dɛ Amɔn tena cheɡɛ ba jwɛh ta dɛ do kpeɡri.
Israel tena lɛ Amɔre tena bwɛjena bwa dɔɔh, dɛ so a ta.
Hɛsbɔn ne bwɛɛre aa baro bwa jao.
Dɛ Hɛsbɔn fa ɛ Amɔre Kooro Sihon bwɛjen waa soɡe o ta, o ne Moab kooro bɛl yo laa, asɛ Kooro Sihon lɛ o harɛ bwa ka jaɡɛ Aanɔn Moo ta.
A waa ba bol wobobeela kɛŋɔ, “Hé ba Hɛsbɔn dɛ́ ba kwaa mao, hé ba vɔrɔwe Kooro Sihon bwɛjen ó berɛ do ɡɛ o fa aa doa.
Kooro Sihon laa tena le Hɛsbɔn kɛ nii ken, kɛŋɔ ninlao dɛ le Kooro Sihon bwɛjen ta, dɛ ba chɔɡ Moab harɛ bwɛjen Ar, dɛ ka chɔɡ nɛra baa lɔ Aanɔn Moo deŋɡarere ta.
Moab tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
Voɡ Kemɔs toroma chɔɡɔ!
Voɡ la ɡelɔ ba lawɛ o bibaala laa ta kaa, ba lawɛ o bihaahna tɛ Amɔre tena Kooro Sihon.
Ya pɔ Hɛsbɔn tena nɛ, ya chɔɡ ba dɛ kpoŋe ka le Debɔn, dɛ ka tel Nɔfa kaa Medeba bwa.” Gɛɛ a do Israel tena so Amɔre tena harɛ ta.
A habɔɔ la, Mosis tomɛ nɛra ba ka sɔh nyiŋi Jasa, asɛ dɛ yo bela tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Asɛ Israel tena ka lɛ bwɛjeɡre aa baro cheme dɔɔh, dɛ doŋi Amɔre tena baa lɔ bela.
Ba berɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa kaa Basan harɛ ta, asɛ Basan Kooro Ɔɡ kpɔ o laa tena bwa, dɛ ka cheme Israel tena Edrei dɛ yoo ba.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Bɛ Kooro Ɔɡ ɔmɛ, n kpɔ o ne o laa tena ne harɛ la bwa do he nɔn ta.
Ɛo ɡɛ haa ɛ Amɔre Kooro Sihon waa di kora Hɛsbɔn la.” Ate, Israel tena kpo Kooro Ɔɡ ne o bibaala, dɛ o laa tena la bwa dɛ lɛ harɛ la.
Ba ta nomɛlbwa ɡelɛ, asɛ dɛ so harɛ la ta.
Kooro Balak yerɛ Balam Israel tena berɔ ir dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene, dɛ so Moab harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa, asɛ Jeriko do baŋ bɛl.
Belaa Sepɔ bibaa Balak, na waa bwa Israel tena aa kpɔa ɛ Amɔre tena, asɛ ɔmee lawɛ Moab tena bwa kohona baa ɔmɛ Israel tena.
Belaa Moab tena ka ŋɔ Midian nomonome be ŋɔ, “Nɛnlaa tenten dɛ́ ba dɛ́ ba chɔɡ ya ne ya komɛlbwa kwaraa kɛŋɔ nao aa dɛ chwe kpɔɡa.” Ate, Sepɔ bibaa Kooro Balak tomɛ toroma ba ka kpɔ Beɔ bibaa Balam.
Dɛ o lɔ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Pɛtɔ, o bɛne Yufretis Moo nyoa.
Kooro Balak ŋɔ, “Nɛra bane warɔ pirim dɛ le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ba su bɔr bwa dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba lɛ n harɛ.
Ba kpeɡri ɡwaa mɛ, anomanta, ba tomɛ ba toma tɛ mɛ, n ken ɛɛ wonoo pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ doŋ ba le n harɛ nɔ ta.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa haa sweero andɛɛɡa la, dɛ́ dɔ wedɛɛɡa.
Banɔ la ɡe haa taah ba dɛ́ na a wa.” Ate, Moab nomonome ne Midian nomonome la kpɔ suuɡa baa kpɔ ka tomɛ toma la kaa.
Baa la Balam be la, ba bol waa Kooro Balak aa ŋɔa la.
Asɛ Balam ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé chɔ ásɛ n ɛ dɛ́ bol he be waa Korowii aa ŋɔ n be.” Ate, nomonome la so Balam be.
Jwaana la ne, Korowii bɔɔ Balam ŋɔ, “Nɛn besooree lɔ he be nɔɔ?” Anee Sepɔ bibaa Balam chaŋe ŋɔ, “Balak waa ɛ Moab harɛ ta kooro laanee tom ba n be ŋɔ, ‘Nɛra bane baa wara pirim dɛ le Ijipt harɛ ta, baa su bɔr bwa ken.
Dɛ he ba, dɛ́ ba tomɛ ba toma tɛo, o ken ɛɛ won yoo ba dɛ́ doŋ ba.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ Balam be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ban pu kaa, bɛ nɛra la ɡe toma tomɛ.
Israel tena ɛ nɛra maa swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba.” Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Balam ŋɔ Kooro Balak nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ kaa he harɛ ta, Korowii ta sɛɛh kɛ n ne he kaa.” Ate, nomonome la berɛ kaa Kooro Balak be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Balam ta sɛɛh kɛ ya ne ó ba.” Asɛ Balak berɛ tomɛ o nomonome baa dɔ sɔna dɛ warɛ ɡwaa banɔ la.
Ba la Balam be dɛ kpɔ kala la ka tɛo ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa tɔe ŋwɛnɛ n be bala.
Mɛɛ bɔe kemee kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ wobɛlbwa ɡe haa bol la, mɛɛ ɛo.
Ba tomɛ ba toma tɛ mɛ.” Anee Balam ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hale Kooro Balak kpɔ o kara mun suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm bwa tɛ mɛ naa, maa won ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii aa do mɛ ŋɔ n bɛ ɛ la.
Hale kohona kɛɛ tama bɛlbwa.
He ɡe chɔ bonɔ fini ɡɛ banɔ la aa chɔa la, ásɛ n no waa Korowii aa dɛ ba n be bola.” Awola jwaana la, Korowii ŋɔ Balam be ŋɔ, “Nɛra nɔ aa bala dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba kpɔe nɔ, kpɔ he te he ne ba kaa, kɛ ka ɛ anɔ la maa ŋɔ he ɛ ɡbo.” Balam ne o keeɡo Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Balam iro dɛ pa yale dawɛ o keeɡo ta dɛ teeh so o ta, o ne Moab nomonome la chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ kaa.
Waa dɛ kaa la, Korowii baah diu, asɛ o ɡel o nyundua torome ba che ŋwɛnɛ la baah ta dɛ tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ.
Dɛ Balam soɡe o keeɡo la ta, o bonɔɔna banɛ ja o nɛ.
Keeɡo la na Korowii nyundua torome la kɛŋɔ waa pamɛ kere dɛ che ŋwɛnɛ la ta, asɛ o bɛɡɛ jo kpɔɡ bini.
Asɛ Balam lɔɔ dɛ ɡel o ba chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta.
Asɛ Korowii nyundua torome la berɛ ka che daa kooni anɛ ane baah ta, asɛ danjwɛɛ do diɡ ne ɡal, ŋwɛnɛ chɔ a baah ta feelɔɔ ken.
Keeɡo la na Korowii nyundua torome la ja, dɛ kpɔ o te ka pɛl danjwɛɛ la, anee Balam nakpala seeɡe danjwɛɛ la.
O berɛ lɔ keeɡo la ja.
Korowii nyundua torome la berɛ kaa sie, dɛ ka che bofeelɔɔ bobɛl keeɡo la aa wola won bɛɡɛ kpɔ diɡ kɛɛ ɡal.
Keeɡo la aa na Korowii nyundua torome la, o chɔ harɛ, asɛ Balam baah di o kpɔ o daŋɡbala lɔɔ.
Asɛ Korowii ɡel keeɡo la bol waa ta Balam nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ n ɛɛ he lɔɔ mɛ kera atoro bwa ken?” Anee Balam chaŋe keeɡo la ŋɔ, “Haa ɡela n di sihiih la waa!
Dɛ n dɔ kere aa, n fe kpoe buɡ nɔ ta.” Keeɡo la ŋɔ, “He laa dɔɔ mɛ hɛɛ so n nɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa ba le fini nɔ naa?
N ɛɛ ken ka bwa naa?” Balam chaŋe ŋɔ, “Akai.” Ate, Korowii pili Balam sie, asɛ o na Korowii nyundua torome waa pamɛ kere che ŋwɛnɛ la ta.
Asɛ Balam ba harɛ dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Korowii nyundua torome la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he lɔɔ he keeɡo nɔ kera atoro bwa ken?
Na, n balɔ dɛ́ ba tɔe ŋwɛnɛ dɛkalkɛŋɔ n ta hen ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ kɛŋɔ he la Moab harɛ ta.
Keeɡo la na mɛ kera atoro bwa dɛɛ kee mɛ.
Dɛ o fe ta kee yaa, n fe kpoe dɛ ɡelo.” Balam ŋɔ Korowii nyundua torome la be ŋɔ, “N ɛ wechɔɡa, n ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ he cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ.
Dɛ he sie ta lɛɛ yaa, mɛɛ berɔɔ laa berɛ.” Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “He ne nɛra la kaa, kɛ ka bol anɔ la maa bol he be.” Anee Balam ne Kooro Balak nomonome la kaa.
Kooro Balak aa noa kɛŋɔ Balam dɛ ba la, o laŋɔ ka chemo Moab harɛ bwɛjen Ar waa chɔ Aanɔn Moo nyoa, bela ɛ o harɛ jwɛh ta.
Kooro Balak ŋɔ Balam be ŋɔ, “N ta nɛra tomɛ ŋɔ ba ba kpɔe kɛ a hiah mɛ naa?
Ɛrɛɛ haa wola balɔɔ?
Maa won bɔe kem kɛrɛdɛ kɛɛ?” Balam chaŋe ŋɔ, “Taraken n balɔ, kɛ maa won bol wobɛlbwa nemenɛ anɔ la Korowii aa ŋɔa n bol.” Asɛ Kooro Balak ne Balam kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kiriat Hosɔt.
Kooro Balak kpo nae ne peera, dɛ kpɔ ane tɛ Balam ne nomonome baa ja o nɛɛ la.
Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Kooro Balak kpɔ Balam kaa Bamɔt Baal ba ka che bela na Israel tena la bane.
Waa Korowii aa tɔ sie bol Balam be Balam ŋɔ Kooro Balak be ŋɔ, “Ma kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta anuanɛ, ásɛ dɛ nyin nabala anuanɛ ne pebala anuanɛ ba tɛ mɛ.” Kooro Balak ɛ ɡɛ Balam aa ŋɔa la, ba nɛra banɛ la kpɔ nabal ne pebal ɛ saraha, saraha kon la bɛlbwa ta.
Balam ŋɔ Kooro Balak be ŋɔ, “Che saraha kwaa la jwɛɛh ásɛ n le kɛrɛ, Korowii ken ɛɛ bol waa n bee.
Wobɛlbwa waa pili a bini baɡ mɛ la, mɛɛ ŋɔ he bee.” Asɛ dɛ kaa deŋɡare bɛl doa.
Asɛ Korowii ka chemo dɛ bol waa o be, asɛ Balam ŋɔ, “N ma kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta anuanɛ, asɛ dɛ kpo nabal ne pebal a bɛlbwa ta.” Asɛ Korowii kpɔ waane tɛ Balam ŋɔ ó ka bol Kooro Balak be.
Ate, o la dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ Kooro Balak ne Moab nomonome la bwa cheɡɛ o saraha kwaa la jwɛh.
Balam bol waa Korowii aa bola la dɛ ŋɔ, “Kooro Balak kaa kpɔ mɛ le Siiria harɛ ta, Moab harɛ ta wee leebɔr bwejena bɔr.
Dɛ ŋɔ n ba tomɛ Israel tena toma tɛo, ba chɔɡ Israel tena tɛ mɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona chɔɡ nɛra Korowii aa swee ba andɛɛɡa ɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona chɔɡ nɛra Korowii aa wola ban chɔɡɔ ɔ?
N cheɡɛ bwejena dor dɛ na ba, n cheɡɛ deŋɡarere ta dɛ veeh ba.
N nao kɛ ba ɛ nɛra baa pere ba te, baa ba te kpɔe dɛɛ ja harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bini.
Umee dɛ́ won kure Israel tena ɔ?
Dɛ he bɔne ba bini bɔre anaarɛ kwaraa naa, umee dɛ́ won jemɛ ba nyoa ɔ?
N dɛ nyin n sewɛ kɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, ɡel n seo do kɛ ban!” Anee Kooro Balak ŋɔ Balam be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he ɛɛ mɛ ken?
N kaa kpɔe ba ŋɔ hé ba tomɛ n dɔma toma, kɛ he ta wobɛlbwa ɛɛ, andɛɛɡaa he berɛ ŋɔ ba dɔ!” Ate Balam ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ ń bol waa Korowii aa ŋɔa n bol ɡbo.” Waa Korowii aa bol Balam be nɛɛtena Kooro Balak ŋɔ Balam be ŋɔ, “Ba ya kaa bofale, bela haa dɛ ba wona na Israel tena la.
Ba bini banee hɛɛ ba nae, ba bwa laa.
Che bela tomɛ ba toma tɛ mɛ.” Dɛ kpɔɔ kaa kpɔɡ baah bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Sofim, Pesɡa Bwejen doa.
O ma kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta anuanɛ, dɛ kpɔ nabal ne pebal ɛ saraha bɛlbwa ta.
Balam ŋɔ Kooro Balak be ŋɔ, “Che he saraha kwaa nɔ jwɛh ásɛ n ka na, Korowii ken ɛɛ bol waa n bee.” Ate, Korowii bol waa Balam be ŋɔ, “Berɛ la Kooro Balak be dɛ́ ka ɡel o no.” Asɛ Balam berɛ la Kooro Balak be dɛ o ne Moab nomonome ta cheɡɛ saraha kwaa la jwɛh.
Anee Kooro Balak bɔɔ Balam ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa Korowii bol ɔ?” Balam bol waa Korowii aa bola la dɛ ŋɔ, “N naa Kooro Balak, ir dɛ́ no n be.
Sepɔ bibaa, no n waa nɔ.
Korowii ta nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ wɛɛ teŋe nyosone, kɛɛ nɛn dɛ́ charɛ o liire.
O dɛ bol waa dɛ́ ɡel a ɛɛ yaa?
Wɛɛ baɡɛ nyoa waa a taa teŋaa?
O do mɛ ŋɔ n swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba.
O swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba maa wola won bera.
N ta wahala bɛlbwa nae Israel tena nɛ.
N ta tebinichɔɡ nae ba bini.
Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ ja ba nɛ.
Ba kooroo on baa kpɛɛro.
Korowii laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ yo dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini nao ken.
Sɔm we-ɛɛla aa won ɛ Israel tena wobɛlbwa, voɡre bɛlbwa ɡe aa ban wo.
Taraken baa bol Israel tena waa ŋɔ, ‘He na waa Korowii aa ɛa tɛɛ ba.’ Ba do kɛŋɔ nyujente nee ken, waa soɡe dɛɛ biɡri, dɛ o di ol waa kpoo.
Waa so biɡri, dɛ o kpɛle kon waa kpoo chal bwa.” Ate, Kooro Balak ŋɔ Balam be ŋɔ, “Dɛ haa ba tomaa tomɛ aa, bɛ andɛɛɡa ɡe swee tɛɛ ba.” Anee Balam chaŋo ŋɔ, “N ta he be ŋɔe ŋɔ waa Korowii aa bola laanee mɛɛ ba ɛɛ yaa?” Waa Korowii aa bol Balam be toorotena Kooro Balak berɔ ŋɔ Balam be ŋɔ, “Ba ya kaa bofale, a ken ɛɛ too Korowii tea, ásɛ he won che bela tomɛ ba toma tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ Kooro Balak kpɔ Balam kaa Peɔ Bwejen doa, bela haa che dɛ́ na pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la.
Asɛ Balam ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ma kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta anuanɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ nabala anuanɛ ne pebala anuanɛ ba tɛ mɛ.” Kooro Balak ɛ waa Balam aa ŋɔ o be la, dɛ kpɔ nabal beŋkpoŋ ne pebal beŋkpoŋ ɛ saraha kon la bɛlbwa ta.
Balam aa naa kɛŋɔ a too Korowii tea kɛŋɔ o swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Israel tena la, o ta laŋɛ ka voɡɛ ɡɛ o fa aa dɛ ɛ la.
O berɛ sie chaɡɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Balam ha sie dɛ na Israel tena la kɛŋɔ baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so denaa ta.
Korowii Doma baa so o nɛ, asɛ o bol waa Korowii aa bol o be la ŋɔ, “Waa men Beɔ bibaa Balam aa noa le Korowii be, Waa waa naa chaahna ta kɛrɛdɛ ken, nɛn waa dɛ no Korowii waa waa bola.
Nɛn waa dɛ na waa Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ aa pili a bini, dɛ chole chɔ harɛ o sie pili wɛɛ nyiŋi.
He na ɡɛ he tɛnte deene aa wera, Israel tena, he sobɔra wer.
A do kɛŋɔ fɛlembɔjena aa chɔa kaa, a wer kɛŋɔ bodɛɛɡa baa du daa a chɔ nee nyoa.
A do kɛŋɔ Korowii aa du daa ane baa dɛ yera alore, ne peleme daa a cheɡɛ nee nyoa.
Bwaala ɛɛ nɛɔ taeh, ásɛ kwaa baa dua dɔ nee kohona.
Ba kora ɛɛ do kanee ɡwaa Amalɛk Kooro Aɡaɡ.
Ba harɛ do kan, dɛ́ dɔ jirima kohona.
Korowii laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ yo dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini nao ken.
Ba pɔ ba dɔma nɛɛ dɛ kuuɡi ba hoɡa, dɛ yaɡ ba hɛma ne.
Ba do kɛŋɔ nyujente waa chɔa, nyujente nee chɔɔ waa, umee dɛ́ won lɔ bambile chumu wɔ?
Nomɛlbwa waa swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Israel tena dɔ andɛɛɡa, nomɛlbwa waa taah ba la, á ɡure o ɡbaɡba nyu ta!” Ate, Kooro Balak baah di Balam nɛ.
O ume nɔɔra lɔ dɔŋa kohona dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N dɔma taahna waa n ka kpɔe ba, kɛ he berɔ swee ba andɛɛɡa kera atoro bwa.
Le warane kaa bela haa lea!
N ŋɔ n fe ɛɛ bɔe kemee kɛrɛdɛ ɡa, kɛ Korowii tɔa ŋwɛnɛ.” Asɛ Balam ŋɔ, “N ta nɛra haa tom ba n be la be ŋɔe ŋɔ, ‘Hale dɛ Kooro Balak kpɔ o kara mun suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm bwa tɛ mɛ naa, maa won le Korowii habɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ n bambile wa, dɛ́ ɡel anɔ la Korowii aa do mɛ ŋɔ n bɛ ɛ la.
A wer oo, aa were oo, a ta chɛ kɛ ń ɛ anɔ la Korowii aa bola ɡbo aa?’ Taraken n berɔ dɛɛ kaa n nɛra be, kɛ ɡel ń ŋɔ he be waa Israel tena aa dɛ́ ba kpɔe ɛ he nɛra kerekere.” Waa Korowii aa bol Balam be naarɛtena Ate, Balam bol waa aa le Korowii be ŋɔ, “Waa aa le men Beɔ bibaa Balam be, n na waa chaahna ta kɛrɛdɛ ken.
Nɛn waa dɛ no Korowii waa waa bola la, dɛ́ dɔ waa mun noe le Nemenɛ Korowii be.
Nɛn waa na wepila le Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ be, dɛ chole chɔ harɛ asɛ n sie pili wɛɛ nyiŋi.
N na Israel tena wa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere, kɛ taraken laa.
N nyiŋa, kɛ a ta men bɛnɛ.
Kooro bɛl ɛɛ le Israel tena binii ba kɛŋɔ wewee ken.
Nomoa bɛl ɛɛ ir ba binii, dɛ́ kpoŋe koodaŋɡbala.
Wɛɛ kpoo Moab sitɔɔlaa, dɛ́ chɔɡ Sɛt naanar baa ɛ naɡrenyin tena.
Israel tena ɛɛ pɔ Edom tena nɛɛ, baa pɔ ba dɔma Sɛɛ tena nɛɛ.
Kɛ dɛ ta do kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ.
Kooro la ɛɛ le Israel tena binii dɛ́ ba kpoo nɛra baa ka bwɛjen la ta bwa.” Waa aa ka mun Korowii bol Balam be Balam na Amalɛk tena wa chaahna ta dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Amalɛk tenaa fa kpeɡa harɛre bwa bini, kɛ a habɔɔ wɛɛ ba paɡroo kwara.” O na Ken tena ɡe wa dɛ ŋɔ, “He soɡe bwea baah ta, he sobɔr do wer.
Kɛ ane a bwa, baa pɔ he nɛɛ, ásɛ Asiiria tena lawɛ heyaa laa ta kaa.” Balam berɔ ŋɔ, “Akwe, dɛ Korowii ɛ ken aa, umee dɛ́ dɔ o nyu ɔ?
Stiimaere ɛɛ kpɔ nɛraa le Saepros harɛ taa ba, dɛ́ ba lɔ tɔ Asiiria tena ne Iba tena nɛ.
Saepros tena ɡe kwara ɛɛ heo.” Balam aa tona la, o kaa o bwɛ.
Kooro Balak ɡe kpɔ pera kaa.
Israel tena ne Moab tena wa Israel tena aa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ ta so Akaasia Fɛlembɔjen bini la, ba bini baala pa mun lawɛ Moab haahna dɛɛ chɔ.
Haahna la yerɛ Israel baala la dɛɛ la ba voɡa mune, dɛ ka kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡa, ba ne ba di dɛɛ ɡuŋi voɡa la harɛ.
A cheɡɛ a ta Israel tena la ne Moab tena la bwa ɛɛ tomɛ voɡ Baal waa lɔ Peɔ la.
Asɛ Korowii bwaawee ir ba nɛ.
Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Kpoo ɡɛ Israel nomonome la webaŋa n siwi ta tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n baah bɛ ba nɛɛ di kohona kpa.” Ate, Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena sitɔɔla be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ hé bini bɛlbwa kpo baa bɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te ka ja dɛɛ tomɛ voɡ Baal waa lɔ Peɔ la.” Mosis ne Israel tena la bwa aa cheme Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la doonyoa dɛɛ wi ba te la, ba bwa siwi ta, Israel tena baala la bɛl lawɛ Midian haah ba jo o tɛnte dea, o ne o chɔ.
Asɛ sɔfo Arɔn naa Fenehas, waa ɛ Eliasa bibaa na ɡɛ dɛ le nɛra la bini dɛ ka kpɔ o lampea, dɛ ka pu baa la tɛnte dea la bini dɛ yaɡɔ vah ka yaɡɛ haah la, ate weechɔɡa aa lɔ Israel tena la nyoa sɔɔh.
Nɛra baa serewe weechɔɡa la ta lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Fenehas sie aa wola waa la ta lɛɛ la, a ɡelɔ n baah sɔɔh Israel tena nɛ.
Anomanta, n ta ban hee.
Ŋɔ Fenehas be ŋɔ, n dɛ fɔwɛ deŋnesɔɔhna fɔo n ne o baah ta.
Ásɛ a chɔ le tɛ o ne o naanar baa ka ba bwa, kɛ bá ɛ sɔfore saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta nomɛlbwa toma sɛɛh ka ja men Korowii waa dɛ tom mɛ nɛ, dɛ́ soŋe Israel tena bwa wechɔɡa tɛɛ ba.” Israel baa Fenehas aa kpo o ne Midian haah la sɔne Simri.
Simeon dea nomoa Salu bibaalee.
Midian haah la ɡe sɔne Kosbi.
Midian tena dea nomoa Sor bihaahnee.
Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Midian tena la ɛ he dɔma, hé kpoo ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba kpɔ heyaa ɛ dɔma, dɛ neɡre heyaa he tomɛ ba voɡ Baal waa lɔ Peɔ.
Midian nomoa bihaah Kosbi ɡe dɔ seo a ɡɛ weechɔɡa la ta.”
Nɛra kura nɛɛtena Weechɔɡa la habɔɔ, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne sɔfo Arɔn bibaa Eliasa be ŋɔ, “Hé kure Israel deene la bwa ne ba naanar baala baa baa di bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ dɛ́ won la laa la.” Anomanta, ɡɛ saŋ Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa dɛ Israel tena la aa lɔ Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo ta asɛ Jeriko do o baŋ la, ba ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kure baala baa di bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la.” Israel tena baa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba laanee nɔ.
Rubin waa ɛ Jekɔb bibanomoa la dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ.
Hanɔk ne o dea nɛra, ne Palu ne o dea nɛra, ne Hɛsrɔn ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Kaami ne o dea nɛra.
Gɛ nɛra nɔɔ Rubin dea nɛra, baala baa kur ba lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafraanaarɛ dɛ batoro, lafraanuanɛ fifraatoro.
Palu bibaa sɔne Eliab, o bibaalaa Nemoɛl ne Datan dɛ Abiram.
Gɛ Datan nɔ ne Abiram fa ɛ Israel tena sitɔɔla, dɛ ka teŋɛ Kora ne o nɛra nɛɛ dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Korowii nɛ.
A che a ta harɛ pere ba ne Kora jo o bini, asɛ nii fuh Kora nɛra lafraanɛ fifraanue a ɛ waa chɔ tɛ nɛra bá hweli.
Kɛ Kora luɡe nɛra te ta serewɛ.
Simeon dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ, Nemoɛl ne o dea nɛra, ne Jamin ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Jakin ne o dea nɛra, ne Sɛra ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Swaul ne o dea nɛra.
Simeon dea nɛraa ba nɔ bwa.
Baala baa kur ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ, lafraanɛ.
Gad ɡe dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ, Sefon ne o dea nɛra, ne Haɡi ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Suni ne o dea nɛra, ne Osni ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Ɛre ne o dea nɛra, ne Arodi ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Areli ne o dea nɛra.
Gad dea nɛraa ba bwa.
Baala baa kur ba la lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ lafraanue.
Juda bibaalaa sɔne Ɛr ne Onan, kɛ ba serewe Keenan harɛ ta.
Juda dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ, Seela ne o dea nɛra, ne Pɛrɛs ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Sɛra ne o dea nɛra.
Pɛrɛs ɡe dea nɛraa nɔ.
Hɛsrɔn ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Hamul ne o dea nɛra.
Juda dea nɛraa ba bwa.
Baala baa kur ba la lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banumɛl lafraanue.
Isaaka dea nɛraa ɡee teŋa nɔ.
Tola ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Pua ne o dea nɛra, ne Jasub ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Simron ne o dea nɛra.
Isaaka dea nɛraa ba bwa.
Baala baa kur ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanumɛl dɛ banaarɛ lafraatoro.
Sebulon ɡe dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ.
Sered ne o dea nɛra, ne Ɛlɔn ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Jaleel ne o dea nɛra.
Sebulon dea nɛraa ba bwa.
Baala baa kur ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanumɛl lafraanue.
Josef bibaalaa Manasɛ ne Efrem dea.
Manasɛ dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ.
Makir ne o dea nɛra, ne Gelead dɛ o dea nɛra.
Gelead ɡe dea nɛraa, Jesa ne o dea nɛra, ne Hɛlɛk dɛ o dea nɛra, ne Asriel ne o dea nɛra, ne Sɛkem dɛ o dea nɛra, ne Sɛmeda ne o dea nɛra, ne Hɛfa ne o dea nɛra.
Hɛfa bibaa Selofehad te ta bibaala dɔe, bihaahna ɡboo o dɔ.
Ba sɔnaa nɔ.
Maala ne Nowa ne Hoɡla ne Milka dɛ Tirsa.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Manasɛ dea nɛra.
Baala baa kur ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue dɛ banɛ, dɛ lafraanuanɛ.
Efrem ɡe dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ.
Sutela ne o dea nɛra, ne Bɛka ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Tahan ne o dea nɛra.
Sutela dea nɛraa nɔ.
Eran ne o dea nɛra.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Efrem dea nɛra.
Baala baa kur ba la lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ banɛ lafraanue.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ le Josef luɡe ta.
Bɛnjamen dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ.
Bɛla ne o dea nɛra, ne Asbɛl ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Ahiram ne o dea nɛra, ne Sufam ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Hufam ne o dea nɛra.
Bɛla bibaalaa Aad ne Naaman.
Aad ne o dea nɛra, ne Naaman ne o dea nɛra, A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena.
Baala baa kur ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue lafraanumɛl.
Dan ɡe dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ, Suham ne o dea nɛra, Dan dea nɛraa ba bwa.
Suham ne o dea nɛra ɡboo Dan dea tena.
Baala baa kur ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanumɛl dɛ banaarɛ lafraanaarɛ.
Aasa dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ.
Imna ne o dea nɛra, ne Isvi ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Bɛrea ne o dea nɛra.
Bɛrea dea nɛra ɡe bini la, Heba ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Malkeɛl ne o dea nɛra.
Dɛ Aasa dɔ bihaah baa yerɔ Sera.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Aasa dea nɛra.
Baala baa kur ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue dɛ batoro lafraanaarɛ.
Naftale dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ.
Jaseel ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Guni ne o dea nɛra, ne Jesa ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Silem ne o dea nɛra.
Banɔ bwaa Naftale dea nɛra.
Baala baa kur ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue lafraanaarɛ.
Israel baala bwa baa kur ba la lɔ kaɡboŋa lafraanumɛl dɛ beŋkpoŋ, lafraanuanɛ fifraatoro.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Bɔne Keenan harɛ la tɛ deene la ɡɛ bɛlbwa nɛra kan aa doa, ó ɛ ba kon.
Dea bɛlbwa o nɛra aa wara la, ɡel ba kon do kan, bɛlbwa ɡe o nɛra aa wola kanɛ la, tɛɛ ba onjeɡa.
Nyiŋi deene la nɛra kan ta, dɛ́ ɡel dea bɛlbwa dɔ o kon.
Gel dea bɛlbwa ta bie mɔɔ dɛ́ dɔ o harɛ.
Che deene la sɔna la ta ba ta bie la.
Che bie tae la ta dɛ́ bɔne tɛɛ ba, deene aa kana ne anɔ la aa wola kanɛ la bwa.” Lewi dea nɛraa teŋa nɔ.
Gɛsɔn ne o dea nɛra, ne Kohat ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Merari ne o dea nɛra.
Banɔ ɡee ɛ Lewi dea nɛra.
Libni ne o dea nɛra, ne Hɛbrɔn ne o dea nɛra, ne Maali ne o dea nɛra, ne Musi bibaala ne o dea nɛra, dɛ Kora bibaala ne o dea nɛra.
Amram nabaalee Kohat.
Amram haah sɔne Jɔkɛbɛd, Lewi naa.
Ijipt harɛ taa ba lolɔ.
Amram ne Jɔkɛbɛd lolɛ bibaala banɛ, banee Arɔn ne Mosis, ba nimambiee Miriam.
Arɔn lolɛ bibaala banaarɛ, banee Nadab ne Abihu, ne Eliasa dɛ Itama.
Nadab ne Abihu kpɔ nii aa wola chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ do kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii ta dɛ serewe.
Lewi dea baala baa dɔ korobie beŋkpoŋ ne a habɔɔ laanee ba kure.
Dɛ ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
Ba ta ban kure ja deene baa kure a nɛra la ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ta ba te harɛ tɛɛ.
Banɔɔ Israel tena Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa aa kura Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa Jeriko do baŋ bɛl la.
Banɔ la Mosis ne sɔfo Arɔn fa aa kur ba Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la bwa serewɔ, beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa ta kae.
Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ ɡɛ Israel tena la be ŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la taa baa ba serewa.
Beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa ta kae, nemenɛ Jefune bibaa Kaleb ne Nun bibaa Josua.
Selofehad bihaahna Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Selofehad, o mɛɛ sɔne Hɛfa.
Hefa ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Gelead.
Gelead ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Makir, Makir ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Manasɛ, Manasɛ ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Josef dɛ le Manasɛ dea.
Selofehad dɔ bihaahna banue.
Banee Maala ne Nowa ne Hoɡla, ne Milka dɛ Tirsa.
Awola bɛl, haahna nɔ kpɔɔ ka bil Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa ne Israel nomonome dɛ Israel tena la bwa sie, Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya mɛɛ aa sewɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta la, o ta bibaala dɔe.
O ta Kora ne o bala baa pɛ nyoa dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Korowii nɛɛ la bini jae.
O wechɔɡa sewee o sewɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ waa ɡela ya mɛɛ sɔn he Israel tena bini nɔɔ?
Waa wola bibaala dɔe waa kɛɛ?
Tɛ yaa harɛ ɡɛ haa tɛ o lolanar baa le ya dea la, ásɛ ya mɛɛ sɔn bɛ he.” Ate, Mosis kpɔ waa la ka bil Korowii sie, asɛ Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Waa Selofehad bihaahna aa bola la ɛ kasinteŋ.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé tɛɛ ba harɛ la pera.
Ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, dɛ baa bɛlbwa sewɔ dɛ o ta bibaa dɔe yaa, bá kpɔ o harɛ tɛ o bihaah.
Dɛ o ta bihaah dɔe yaa, bá kpɔ harɛ la tɛ o nimanar.
O ta nimanar ɡe dɔe yaa, bá kpɔ tɛ o mɛɛ nimanar.
O mɛɛ ta nimanar dɔe yaa, bá kpɔ tɛ o lole tenten ba dea la ta.
Waa nɔɔ Korowii do Mosis a ɛ mmara dɛ chɔ le tɛ Israel tena.” Josua chiɡ Mosis naa ta Awola bɛl, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Teeh kaa Abarim Bwejena dor, dɛ́ ka na harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ Israel tena.
Dɛ he kaa na harɛ la tonaa, he ɡee sewɔɔ ka ja he nɛra nɛɛ ɡɛ aa pu he dɔɔ Arɔn la.
He ne o bwaa fa vɛh n wa, he ta waa maa do heya a ta la ta teŋɛ dɛ yarada kpeɡri maa dɔa la.” Gɛ saŋee Israel tena la ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Mɛreba waa bɛne Kades dɛ do Sin pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la.
Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ tɛ mkpa, mɔɔ haa kpo mɛ la, n poori le nɛn waa nyiŋi nɛra nɔ nɛ.
Naate waa kpɔ ba kaa dɛ berɛ ba ba ne, ásɛ he nɛra bɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ Nun bibaa Josua, onee N Doma so o nɛ.
Kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o nɛɛ dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛo.
Kpɔɔ ka che sɔfo Eliasa ne nɛra la bwa sie, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ toma la do o nɔn ta.
Tɛo kpeɡri haa dɔa la pera, ásɛ nɛra la bwa ɛɛ no o be.
Josua chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ o te dawɛ sɔfo Eliasa nɛ, dɛ́ che kwaa baa dɛ yera Urim ne Tumim ta, dɛ́ jemɛ waa men Korowii aa dɛ nyin kɛ wɛɛ ɛ.
A ɡɛ taa sɔfo Eliasa ne Israel tena nɔ ɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ na ɡɛ baa dɛɛ ɛ.” Mosis no Korowii waa la, dɛ kpɔ Josua la sɔfo Eliasa ne Israel tena la bwa baah ta.
Mosis ɡbabir kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ toma la do o nɔn ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ o be la.
Tɔpere bɛlbwa sarahare Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ mea aa chɛ kɛ hé kpɔ ba ɛ saraha saŋ aa chɛa ta, dɛ́ fuah a sɔɔh do som Korowii be.
Kwaa haa kpɔ ba ɛ saraha dɛ́ fuah dɛɛ tɛo tɔpere bɛlbwa laanee, pebali anɛ bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii.
Hé kpo pebali la beŋkpoŋ chɔɔbɔr, asɛ onɔ la ɡe jɔmɔra.
Hé kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruwa del, dɛ́ kpɔ ɔleve noo pɛrɛntoa beŋkpoŋ ne fah koo men la ta ba ɛ mea saraha.
A ɛ saŋ bɛlbwa saraha baa dɛ fuh a bwa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, a sɔɔh ɛɛ do o som.
Sinai Bwejen taa bá pa a mun, á ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah.
Hé kpɔ sen pɛrɛntoa beŋkpoŋ ne tama ne loɡla pebale la, dɛ́ ba fuɡe sen la ta saraha kon la ta, ásɛ a ɛ sen saraha.
Jɔmɔra saraha la ɡe, hé ɛa ɡɛ haa ɛ anɔ la la, dɛ́ kpɔ a ɡe sen ja pebale nɛɛte la ta ɛ sen saraha.
A ɡe ɛ mea saraha a sɔɔh aa dɛ do Korowii som.
Ona Tɔpere sarahare Ona Tɔpere ta, hé kpɔ pebali anɛ bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa, aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, dɛ́ kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruware anɛ koo ɔleve noo ta, á ɛ mea ne sen saraha.
Anee ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah Ona Tɔpere, a ja saraha haa dɛɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa ne sen saraha ta.
Korobie bɛlbwa tɔpeloɡle saraha Korobie bɛlbwa tɔpeloɡle ta la, hé kpɔ nabali anɛ ne pebal dɛ pebali anuanɛ a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa, aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Hé kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruware atoro, dɛ́ kpɔ koo ɔleve noo ta ne nabal beŋkpoŋ la ta, á ɛ mea saraha.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ men kuruware anɛ ja pebal la ta.
Pebali anuanɛ la bɛlbwa ɡe la, hé kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruwa del koo ɔleve noo ta.
A ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah aa sɔɔh ɛɛ do som Korowii be.
Nabal la bɛlbwa la, hé kpɔ sen pɛrɛntoa dela atoro, dɛ́ kpɔ sen pɛrɛntoa anɛ ja pebal la bɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ sen pɛrɛntoa beŋkpoŋ ne fah ja pebiiri la ɡe ta.
Anɔɔ ɛ saraha haa fuah korobie bɛlbwa ta benanyoa bɛlbwa.
Saraha haa dɛɛ ɛa dɛɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa, ne a sene habɔɔ la, bombal beŋkpoŋii chɛ kɛŋɔ, hé kpɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Galekaa Tɔpejen dii Korobie waa tɔ sie tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ la ɛ Galekaa Tɔpejen dɛ tɛ Korowii, a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé diu.
Korobie la tenten tɔpera fi dɛ anue la ɛ tɔpejen haa lɛ sie o ta.
Hé di paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta la tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpejen la tɔpeloɡle la, hé cheme dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii, dɛ bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ. Hé kpɔ nabali anɛ ne pebal ne pebali anuanɛ, a bɛlbwa aa dɔ benanyoa aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ saraha, dɛ́ fuah tɛ Korowii.
Nabal bɛlbwa la, hé kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruware atoro koo ɔleve noo ta.
Pebal la ɡe la, hé kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruware anɛ.
Pebali la bɛlbwa ɡe, hé kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ la kuruwa ja.
Hé kpɔ bombal beŋkpoŋ ja ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ soŋe he wechɔɡa Korowii be.
Hé ɛ ɡɛ ja chɔɔbɔr saraha haa dɛ ɛ dɛɛ fuah la ta.
Tɔpera anuanɛ la ta la, hɛ́ɛ ɛ mea saraha la tɔpere bɛlbwa, ásɛ a sɔɔh ɛɛ do Korowii som.
Hé ɛa dɛɛ ja saraha haa ɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛɛ fuah la, ne sen saraha la ta.
Tɔpenuanɛ ta, hé cheme dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii, dɛ bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ. Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen dii Awola haa kpɔ mefala dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba tɛ Korowii la, a ɡɛ Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen la dii ta, hé cheme dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii dɛ bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ. Hé kpɔ nabali anɛ ne pebal ne pebali anuanɛ a bɛlbwa aa di benanyoa, aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ saraha, dɛ́ fuah tɛ Korowii a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som o be.
Nabal bɛlbwa la, hé ɛ mea saraha dɛ́ kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruware atoro dɛ́ koo ɔleve noo a ta.
Pebal la ɡe, hé kpɔ men kuruware anɛ ja.
Pebali anuanɛ la bɛlbwa ɡe, hé kpɔ men la kuruwa beŋkpoŋ ja a ta.
Dɛ́ kpɔ bombal beŋkpoŋ ja ɛ saraha soŋe he wechɔɡa.
Hé ɛ a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ ne a sen sarahare, dɛ́ kpɔ ja saraha haa ɛa dɛɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa la ne a mea sarahare bwa ta.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nae ne peera ne boohna la bɛlbwa ta kirihiah dii.”
Bɛle Hoeh Tɔpejen dii Mosis berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korobinuanɛ tɔpeloɡle ta, hé cheme dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii dɛ bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ. Hé hoh bɛle awola.
Ásɛ he ɛ saraha dɛ́ fuah, ásɛ a sɔɔh ɛɛ do Korowii som.
Hé kpɔ nabale beŋkpoŋ ne pebal dɛ pebali anuanɛ aa dɔ benanyoa, a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii.
Hé ɛ mea saraha men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ ne.
Nabale la, hé kpɔ men kuruware atoro dɛ́ kpɔ ɔleve noo koo a ta.
Pebal la ɡe, hé kpɔ men kuruware anɛ ja.
Ásɛ pebali anuanɛ la ɡe, hé kpɔ men kuruwa beŋkpoŋ ja a bɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ bombal ja ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha soŋe he wechɔɡa Korowii be.
A ɡɛ sarahare nɔ ja korobie bɛlbwa ne saŋ bɛlbwa sarahare, ne a mea sarahare ne sen sarahare ɡɛ waa baɡla la ta.
Á ɛ sarahare haa fuah baa tɛ Korowii a sɔɔh ɛɛ do som o be.
Wechɔɡa Soŋa Korowii Be Ó Kpɔ Kɛ Tɔpejen Korobinuanɛ tɔperafi ta, hé vɔwɛ nyoa, dɛ́ cheme, dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii dɛ bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ. Hé kpɔ saraha kwaa haa fuah a sɔɔh ɛɛ do Korowii som la ba tɛo.
Nabale beŋkpoŋ ne pebal ne pebali anuanɛ aa dɔ benanyoa, aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii.
Hé ɛ mea saraha men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ ne.
Nabale la, hé kpɔ men kuruware atoro, dɛ́ kpɔ ɔleve noo koo a ta.
Pebal la ɡe, men kuruware anɛ.
Pebali la ɡe, hé kpɔ men la kuruwa beŋkpoŋ ja bɛlbwa ta.
Hé kpɔ bombal beŋkpoŋ ja ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ ja sen la ne saraha kwaa haa dɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.
Kukure Tɔpejen dii Korobinuanɛ tɔpera fi dɛ anue ta, hé cheme dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii dɛ bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ. Hé di Kukure Tɔpejen tɔpera anuanɛ dɛ́ lɛ he sie dɛ́ tɛ Korowii.
Hé kpɔ kwaa ɛ saraha a sɔɔh aa soma ba tɛ Korowii.
Hé kpɔ nabali fi dɛ atoro ne pebala anɛ ne pebali fi dɛ atoro, a bɛlbwa aa dɔ benanyoa aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba fuh ɛ saraha.
Hé ɛ mea saraha men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ ne.
Nabali fi dɛ atoro la bɛlbwa, hé kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ kuruware atoro, dɛ́ kpɔ ɔleve noo koo a ta.
Pebal la bɛlbwa ɡe, men kuruware anɛ.
Pebali fi dɛ anaarɛ la bɛlbwa, hé kpɔ men kuruwa beŋkpoŋ ja a ta.
Hé kpɔ bombal ja ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ ja mea sarahare ne sen sarahare haa dɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.
Korobinuanɛ la tɔpenɛɛte ta, hé berɛ kpɔ nabali fi dɛ anɛ ne pebala anɛ dɛ pebali fi dɛ anaarɛ aa dɔ benanyoa, aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii.
Hé ɛ nae la bɛlbwa ne pebala la bɛlbwa ne pebali la bɛlbwa mea saraha ne a sene saraha, ɡɛ maa baɡla la, dɛ́ kpɔ bombal ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ja mea saraha ne sen sarahare haa dɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.
O tɔpetooro wee, hé kpɔ nabali fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ne pebala anɛ, dɛ pebali fi dɛ anaarɛ aa dɔ benanyoa, a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii ɛ saraha.
Nae la ne pebala ne pebali la, hé kpɔ ɛ mea sarahare ne sen sarahare ɡɛ maa baɡla la.
Dɛ́ kpɔ bombal ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ja mea saraha ne sen saraha haa dɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.
Tɔpenaarɛ wee, hé kpɔ nabali fi ne pebala anɛ ne pebali fi dɛ anaarɛ aa dɔ benanyoa a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii ba ɛ saraha.
Nae la ne pebala ne pebali la, hé kpɔ ɛ mea sarahare ne a sen sarahare ɡɛ maa baɡla la.
Dɛ́ kpɔ bombal ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ja mea saraha ne sen saraha haa dɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.
Tɔpenue wee, hé kpɔ nabali anuanaarɛ ne pebala anɛ, dɛ pebali fi dɛ anaarɛ aa dɔ benanyoa a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ba ɛ saraha.
Nae la ne pebala dɛ pebali la, hé kpɔ ɛ mea sarahare ne a sen sarahare ɡɛ waa baɡla la.
Hé kpɔ bombal ja ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ja mea saraha ne sen saraha haa dɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.
Tɔpenumɛl wee, hé kpɔ nabali anuatoro ne pebala anɛ dɛ pebali fi dɛ anaarɛ aa dɔ benanyoa bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii ba ɛ saraha.
Nabali la ne pebala dɛ pebali la, hé kpɔ ɛ mea sarahare ne a sen sarahare ɡɛ waa baɡla la.
Dɛ́ kpɔ bombal ja ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ja mea saraha ne sen saraha haa dɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee, hé kpɔ nabali anuanɛ ne pebala anɛ dɛ pebali fi dɛ anaarɛ aa dɔ benanyoa a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii ba ɛ saraha.
Nae la ne pebala dɛ pebali la, hé kpɔ ɛ mea sarahare ne a sen sarahare ɡɛ maa baɡla la.
Dɛ́ kpɔ bombal ja ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ja mea saraha ne sen saraha haa dɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.
Tɔpenuatoro la, hé cheme dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii dɛ bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ. Hé kpɔ nabale ne pebal dɛ pebali anuanɛ aa dɔ benanyoa aa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii ɛ saraha dɛ fuah tɛ Korowii, a sɔɔh do o som.
Nao la ne pebal dɛ pebali la, hé kpɔ ɛ mea sarahare ne a sen sarahare ɡɛ waa baɡla la.
Dɛ́ kpɔ bombal ja ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha ja mea saraha ne sen saraha haa dɛ fuah saŋ bɛlbwa la ta.
Ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ a ta dɛ ɛ saraha kwaa haa dɛ fuah, ne mea sarahare ne sen sarahare, dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare tɛ Korowii he tɔpejena haa lea cheɡ, dɛ́ɛ dia ta laanee la.
He nyobaɡa kwaa haa ba a ne ne kwaa aa le he bambili ta bwa jao.” Mosis bol Israel tena la be waa Korowii aa doo a ta bwa.
Nyoa baɡa Mmarare Mosis ŋɔ nomonome baa chɔ Israel deene nyoo la be ŋɔ waa Korowii aa do ba a ta laanee nɔ.
“Dɛ nomɛlbwa baɡɛ Korowii nyoa kɛɛ dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam waane ta naa, o bɛ ɡel a chɔ.
Ó ɛ wobɛlbwa waa ŋɔa wɛɛ ɛo la.
Dɛ haah baɡɛ Korowii nyoa kɛɛ dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam waane ta o toli saŋ waa lɔ o mɛɛ dem, asɛ o mɛɛ no o nyobaɡa la, kɛɛ ŋwɛɛra la, o ta wobɛlbwa bolaa, a ta chɔ le.
O mɛɛ noɔ dɛ kaoh waa, a ta chɛ kɛ haah la teŋɛ a ta kpa.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛo dɛkalkɛ o mɛɛ ta sɛɛh.
Dɛ o yalɔ mɔɔ dɛ baɡɛ nyoa la kɛɛ a le o nyoa warane o baɡɛ dɛ kpɔ vɔrɔwe o te, asɛ o jaa no dɛ tɔ nyoa o ta wobɛlbwa haah la be bolaa, amɔ te ntam kɛɛ nyoa waa baɡa dɛ kpɔ vɔrɔwe o te la ta chɔ le.
Dɛ o jaa noɔ dɛ kaoh ŋɔ o kpɔ nyobaɡa kwaa la la naa, o bɛ ɡel a chɔ.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛo.
Luhaah kɛɛ haah o ne o jaa aa vɛh dɔŋa, o ŋwɛɛ ntam kɛɛ dɛ baɡɛ nyoa la, a dawɛ o nɛ.
Dɛ haah yalɔ asɛ dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam kɛɛ dɛ baɡɛ nyoa dɛ le waane ta, asɛ o jaa no o ta o haah kaeh yaa, dɛ ntam kɛɛ nyobaɡa la ta chɔ le.
Dɛ o jaa la noɔ dɛ kaoh ŋɔ ó kpɔ ntam kɛɛ nyobaɡa kwaa la la, kɛ a ta chɛ kɛ ó ɡel a chɔ aa, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o jaa kaoh.
O jaaree dɔ kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ó sɛh kɛɛ dɛ vɛh nyobaɡa kɛɛ ntam haah la aa ŋwɛɛra la.
Dɛ o jaa la ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ awola waa noa kɛŋɔ o baɡɛ nyoa la aa, amɔ te dɛ o sɛh haah la ntam ne nyobaɡa waa kpɔa vɔrɔwe o te la.
A waa o ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ la.
O jaa la noɔ mɔɔ dɛ kaoh waa, amɔ te haah la wechɔɡa dawɛ o jaa la nɛ.” A ɡɛ Mmarare laanee Korowii do Mosis ŋɔ a chɔ le tɛ baa ne o haah, dɛ baa ne o bihaah o taa soɡe o mɛɛ dem.
Korowii yo Midian tena bɔ kem Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Tɛr Midian tena deŋne waa baa kpɔa ɛ Israel tena la wa.
Ásɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ chɔ he banɔn ta.” Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé vɔwɛ baala la bane ntoa, bá ka pu Midian tena yo, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne bɔ kem tɛ Korowii.
Hé kpɔ baala kaɡboŋ le Israel deene la bɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ la laa la.” Anomanta, baala kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛɛ vɔwɛ ntoa, dɛ́ ka yo.
Baala kaɡboŋii le Israel deene la bɛlbwa ta.
Mosis ɡelɔ ba kaa laa la, asɛ sɔfo Eliasa bibaa Fenehas kpɔ laala aa do ɡoroŋ la ane, ne bɛle ba hoh dɛɛ baɡle laa la wa.
Ba kaa yo Midian tena ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la, dɛ kpoo baala bwa.
Ba kpoo Midian koranar banue ja nɛra baa kpoora la ta.
Banee koranar baa dɛ yer ba Evi ne Rekem ne Sor, ne Hur dɛ Reba.
Ba kpo Beɔ bibaa Balam ɡe tokobii ne.
Israel tena la lawɛ Midian haahna ne bechale, dɛ lawɛ ba nae ne peera, dɛ kpɔ ba laala ɡe bwa kaa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.
Ba fuh Midian tena bwɛɛre ne bela baa kaa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so la bwa.
Ba pa laala dɛ larawe nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa laa la ta ba tɛ Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa ne Israel tena.
Dɛ ba soɡe Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo ta, Jeriko do baŋ bɛl.
Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa dɛ nomonome baa chɔ Israel tena nyoa la bwa kaa cheme laa tena la bela baa baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so la dahare.
Mosis baah di laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo dɛ le laa ta ba la nɛ.
O bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Kɛ he ɡel Midian haahna la te nyu kɛ ba kenɛ?
Banee no Balam waa ta, a che a ta dɛ ɡel ya laa ya te kpɔ Korowii nɛɛ Peɔ Bwejen ta, asɛ weechɔɡa ba ya Korowii nɛra nɛɛ la.
Hé kpoo bibaala la bwa dɛ́ kpo haah bɛlbwa waa chɔ baa ka, dɛ́ ɡel toli baa wola baala chɔe ka la tɛ he te.
He bini bɛlbwa waa kpo nɛn kɛɛ dɛ leɡe nɛn waa sewa la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó so tɛnte deene la dahare tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpetooro wee ne tɔpenuanɛ wee la, hé sɔ he ne nɛra haa laɡ ba laa ta la doŋa bwa ta.
Hé laa doŋa kpɔ yale ne kwaa baa kpɔ oltɔn ne booh pona ne daa ɛa bɛlbwa ta.” Asɛ sɔfo Eliasa ŋɔ laa tena baa la laa la be ŋɔ, “Mmara Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ Mosis laanee nɔ, Suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne ayaawa ne buni, dɛ kwaane baa dɔa dɛɛ le bwe ta, kpana ne kwaane baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ koŋkori, ne kwaa nii aa wola won ɛa wobɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ do nii ta mɔɔ a doŋa le a ta.
Hé berɛ kpɔ do nee baa kpɔa sɔ kon doŋa dɛɛ ta la ta.
Komɛlbwa ɡe waa wola nii wone la, hé kpɔ do nee la ta.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la, hé chɛɡɛ he laala dɛ́ laa he te kpɔ doŋa bɛlbwa ta ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛa la, ásɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ won jo he sobɔr bela.” Laa ta kwaa bɔna Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “He ne sɔfo Eliasa ne dea nomonome baa chɔ nɛra la nyoa kure nɛra la bwa baa kaa laɡ ba, ne kondɛɛra baa larawa ba la.
Ásɛ dɛ bɔne laa ta kwaa la tɛ banɔ la baa kaa yo la ne nɛra la bwa.
Banɔ la baa kaa yo kwaa baa dɔa la, hé lɛa ba be cheɡ tɛ men Korowii.
Hale nɛra kɛɛ nae kɛɛ keeɡore kɛɛ peera kɛɛ boohna oo, lafraanue bɛlbwa la hé lɛ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ.
Hé lɛa le ba kwaa baa dɔ la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛ sɔfo Eliasa á ɛ men Korowii kwa.
Israel tena la ɡe kwaa la, hé lɛ nɛra ne nae ne keeɡore, ne peera ne boohna dɛ kondɛɛre te bɛlbwa ta, fifraanunue bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋa dɛ́ kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena baa dɛ ɛ n Tɛnte Dea la toma dɛɛ nyiŋi o ta la.” Gɛɛ a do Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do Mosis ŋɔ ó ɛ la.
Laa tena laala baa kaa yo dɛ dɔ la lɔ peera kaɡboŋa lafraanumɛl fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, nae lɔ kaɡboŋa lafraanuanɛ dɛ anɛ, keeɡore kaɡboŋa fifraanumɛl dɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ haahna kaɡboŋa lafraatoro dɛ banɛ baa wola baala chɔe bwa.
Laa tena baa kaa yo kwaa baa dɔa laanee teŋa nɔ, peera lɔ kaɡboŋa lafraatoro fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, asɛ Korowii kwaa lɔ peera lafraanumɛl fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.
Nae lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anumɛl, asɛ Korowii kwaa lɔ fifraanuanɛ dɛ anɛ, keeɡore lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ lafraanue, asɛ Korowii kwaa lɔ fifraanumɛl dɛ beŋkpoŋ, nɛra ɡe lɔ kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banumɛl, asɛ Korowii dɔ nɛra fifraatoro dɛ banɛ.
Mosis kpɔ ɡɛ kwaa la ne nɛra la bwa tɛ sɔfo Eliasa ba ɛ Korowii kwa, ɡɛ Korowii aa do ba la.
Anɔ la Mosis aa kpɔa le laa tena baa kaa yo kwaa la ta dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena baa wola ka yoi laanee nɔ.
Ba dɔ peera kaɡboŋa lafraatoro fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ dɛ lafraanue, nae lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anumɛl, keeɡore lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ lafraanue dɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banumɛl.
Israel tena baa wola laa la laŋɛ kwaa baa dɔa laa ta la, Mosis kpɔ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ le nɛra fifraanue bɛlbwa bini, ne kondɛɛra fifraanue bɛlbwa bini, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena baa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Tɛnte Dea la ta dɛɛ ɛ o toma la.
Asɛ sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo la la Mosis be, dɛ ka ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔna baa kure laa tena baa lɔ ya nɔn ta, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta nyoɡrɛ.
Anomanta, ya kpɔ jam kwaa dɛɛ ba ba tɛ Korowii.
Suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaare ya bini bɛlbwa aa dɔa, ne baŋere ne jɔɡrɔre, ne noniseɡa ne deŋna kwa dɛ baŋa kwaare, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe ya wechɔɡa Korowii be.” Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa lɛ suuɡaswɛm la baa kpɔa ɛ koŋkwaare la.
Suuɡaswɛm aa le laa sitɔɔla la be Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa kpɔ ka tɛ Korowii la tɔɡre lɔ suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
Anɔ la laa tena la bɛlbwa aa kpɔa la te, a ɛ ba kwa.
Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa lɛ suuɡaswɛm la le laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo la be, dɛ kpɔ kaa Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela, asɛ Israel tena la che o ta dɛɛ lii waa aa chiɡa.
Israel deene aa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr Rubin ne Gad dea tena kondɛɛra warɔ taeh.
Ba nao kɛ Jasa ne Gelead harɛre wer ne kwaa dɛɛra.
Anomanta, ba la Mosis ne sɔfo Eliasa dɛ ba Israel tena nomonome be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Atarɔt ne Debɔn ne Jasa ne Nimra ne Hɛsbɔn ne Eleale ne Sebam ne Nɛbo dɛ Beɔn harɛre, Korowii aa sɔɔh a nɛra kpeɡri nyoa dɛ lɛ tɛ ya Israel tena la wer ne kwaa dɛɛra, he bonɔɔna ɡe, ya dɔ kondɛɛra.
Ya dɛ soŋe he kpɔ harɛ la tɛ yaa ó ɛ ya kon, dɛ bɛ ɡel ya le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ.” Anee Mosis ŋɔ Gad ne Rubin dea tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé bala dɛ kaa laa, asɛ he te so bonɔ naa?
He bɛ he bala Israel tena bwara hwah harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la ta kaala wa.
Kenii he naawa faa ɛ ɡɛ saŋ yaa lɔ Kades Baanea, asɛ n tom ba ŋɔ bá ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la.
Ba laŋɔ ka tel Ɛskɔl Fɛlembɔjen ta dɛ ka na harɛ la, dɛ ba hwah ba bala Israel tena la bwara, harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la ta laŋa.
Asɛ Korowii baah di awola o ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Baala baa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba, dɛ dɔ bene fifraanɛ ne a habɔɔ la aa harɛ maa ŋwɛɛra, dɛ baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ n kpɔɔ tɛ Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb naanar laanee na, ba ta n nɛɛ teŋɛ bambile bwa ne.
Nemenɛ Kenis te Jefune bibaa Kaleb, ne Nun bibaa Josua, banee teŋɛ men Korowii nɛɛ ba bambile bwa ne.’ Korowii baah di Israel tena la nɛ, asɛ dɛ ɡel ba ɡaaɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta bene fifraanaarɛ, ka tel kɛŋɔ a ɡɛ nɛra la ka pa bwa baa ɛ wechɔɡa la aa baa he.
Taraken, he iro kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra dɛ chiɡ he naawa naa ta, dɛɛ ba ɡela Korowii baah di kohona Israel tena nɛ.
Dɛ he berɛ habɔɔ kpoo waa, wɛɛ ɡel baa ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɔ taa ja, dɛ heyaa ɡela o chɔɡ ba ta la.” Ate, ba suuh tel Mosis dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ya do leɡa bonɔ tɛ ya peera, ásɛ dɛ vɔrɔwe bwɛjena tɛ ya haahna ne bii.
Yaa vɔwɛ ntoa tɔ ya Israel tena la kabora siee, dɛ́ la ba ne ka tel bela Korowii aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba yaa tɛɛ.
Dɛ ya haahna ne bechale te dɔ bwɛjena danjwɛɛre aa bara harɛ la ta nɛra aa wola won ba yoo ba.
Israel tena la bɛlbwa ɛɛ dɔ bɔr waa ɛ o konee mɔɔ ya laa berɛ kaa ya soŋnibɔra.
Yaa bobɛlbwaa lɛ le ba be Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ le kpa, ya dɔ ya bɔr Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr bela.” Anee Mosis ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ vɔwɛ ntoa Korowii sie dɛ́ ka yo, dɛ́ bwa vɔwɛ ntoa, dɛ́ le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la ka tel kɛ waa doŋi he dɔma he sie, dɛ Korowii sɔɔh harɛ la nɛra kpeɡri nyoa mɔɔ he laa berɛ aa, dɛ he ɛ waa aa wera tɛ Korowii ne Israel tena, dɛ Korowii sɛoh kɛ harɛ la ɛ he kon.
Dɛ he vɛoh he ta ɡɛ ɛɛ yaa, dɛ he ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, aa ɡure he nyu taa.
Hé vɔrɔwe bwɛɛre tɛ he haahna ne bii, dɛ́ ɛ leɡa tɛ he peera, ásɛ dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ haa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ hɛɛ ɛo la ta.” Ate, Gad ne Rubin dea tena la ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Ya dɔɔ, he bonɔɔna ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa bola laanee.
Ya haahna ne bii, ne peera dɛ nae ɛɛ ka Gelead bwɛjena nɔ taa.
Kɛ he bonɔɔna, baa bɛlbwa waa vɔwɛ ntoa dɛ la laa la ɛɛ le Jɔɔdan Moo baŋee, ásɛ Korowii tɔ ya sie yá ka yo ɡɛ haa ŋɔa la.” Asɛ Mosis kpɔ ba wobɛlbwa do sɔfo Eliasa ne Nun bibaa Josua ne nomonome baa chɔ Israel deene la nyoo nɔn ta.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ Gad ne Rubin dea tena, baa bɛlbwa vɔwɛ ntoa he ne o le Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ Korowii sie, dɛ ka yo dɛ sɔɔh harɛ la nɛra kpeɡri nyoa aa, hé kpɔ Gelead harɛ tɛɛ ba ó ɛ ba kon.
Kɛ ba ta ntoa vɔwɛ he ne ba le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ aa, ate a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá dɔ Keenan harɛ la pera ɡɛ haa dɛ ba dɔe la.” Asɛ Gad ne Rubin dea tena la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he bonɔɔna ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa laanee.
Yaa vɔwɛ ntoa tɔ Korowii siee, dɛ́ ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la kaa Keenan harɛ ta, kɛ kondɔɔh yaa dɔa la te ɛɛ ka Jɔɔdan wee leebɔr baŋ bonɔɔ.” Asɛ Mosis kpɔ Amɔre Kooro Sihon, ne Basan tena Kooro Ɔɡ harɛre baa dɛ di kora a ta, ne a bwɛjena ne bwɛɛre aa bara bwa tɛ Gad ne Rubin dea tena, dɛ Josef bibaa Manasɛ dea pera tena.
Gad dea tena la kwaarɔ vɔrɔwe bwɛjena Debɔn ne Atarɔt dɛ Arowa, ne Atrɔt Sofan ne Jasa dɛ Joɡbeha, ne Bɛt Nimra dɛ Bɛt Haran, dɛ ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara dɛ do leɡa a ta tɛ ba peera ɡe.
Rubin dea tena la ɡe kwaarɔ vɔrɔwe Hɛsbɔn ne Eleale dɛ Kiriataim ne Nɛbo dɛ Baal Meɔn, ba berɔ beɡre ɡɛ sɔna nɔ.
Ba kwaarɔ vɔrɔwe Sibma ɡe, dɛ berɛ kwaa pa bwɛjena baa kwaara vɔrɔwe la ɡe sɔna.
Manasɛ bibaa Makir naanar la Gelead dɛ ka yo Amɔre tena ba fa aa lɔ bela dɛ doŋ ba.
Anomanta, Mosis kpɔ Gelead tɛ Makir naanar baa ɛ Manasɛ dea tena la asɛ ba so bela.
Manasɛ naa Jɛɛ kaa yo lɛ bela bwɛjeɡre ane dɛɛ yera Havɔt Jɛɛ.
Asɛ Nɔba yo lɛ Kenat ne bwɛjeɡre aa baro dɛ kpɔ o sɔn Nɔba paa.
Israel tena vala dɛ le Ijipt kaa Moab harɛ ta Gɛ Mosis ne Arɔn aa kpɔ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ tɔ ba sie ba valɛ denaa ta laanee teŋa nɔ.
Korowii do Mosis o chwerɛ ɡɛ baa soɡa dɛɛ ir ba vala bini bwa.
Kenii ba so dɛɛ ir.
Israel tena la iro le Rameses korobiloɡle la tɔpera fi dɛ anue ta, Galekaa Tɔpejen la habɔɔ tɔ aa pera la.
Ba leɔ bambile bwa ne Ijipt tena la bwa siwi ta dɛ kaa.
Dɛ Ijipt tena la dɛ huɡe ba bibanloɡla Korowii aa kpoo ba ba deremi ta dɛ kpɔ baɡle o kpeɡri waa dɔa ɡwaa ba voɡa.
Israel tena la le Rameses dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene Sukot.
Dɛ ir Sukot dɛ ka so Etaam, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la nyoa.
Dɛ berɛ ir Etaam dɛ laa berɛ ba Pi Haherɔt waa lɔ Baal Sefon wee leebɔr, dɛ ka so bɛne Miɡdol.
Dɛ ir Pi Haherɔt dɛ kpɔ mpo ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Ba valɛ tɔpera atoro Etaam pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta dɛ ka so Mara.
Dɛ ir Mara dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so Elim.
Buli fi dɛ anɛ nyuune ne bambie daa fifraanuanɛ lɔ bela.
Dɛ ir Elim dɛ ka so Mposwɛm nyoa.
Dɛ ir Mposwɛm nyoa dɛ ka so Sen pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Dɛ ir Sen pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta dɛ ka so Dɔfka.
Dɛ ir Dɔfka dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so Alus.
Dɛ ir Alus dɛ ka so Refidim.
Ba ta nee bela dɔe dɛ nyɔ.
Dɛ ir Refidim dɛ ka so Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Dɛ ir Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta dɛ ka so Kebrɔt Hataava.
Dɛ ir Kebrɔt Hataava dɛ ka so Haserɔt.
Dɛ ir Haserɔt dɛ ka so Ritma.
Dɛ ir Ritma dɛ ka so Remɔn Pɛrɛs.
Dɛ ir Remɔn Pɛrɛs dɛ ka so Lebna.
Dɛ ir Lebna dɛ ka so Risa.
Dɛ ir Risa dɛ ka so Kehelata.
Dɛ ir Kehelata dɛ ka so Sɛfa Bwejen ta.
Dɛ ir Sɛfa Bwejen ta dɛ ka so Harada.
Dɛ ir Harada dɛ ka so Makhɛlɔt.
Dɛ ir Makhɛlɔt dɛ ka so Tahat.
Dɛ ir Tahat dɛ ka so Tɛɛra.
Dɛ ir Tɛɛra dɛ ka so Mitka.
Dɛ ir Mitka dɛ ka so Hasmona.
Dɛ ir Hasmona dɛ ka so Moserɔt.
Dɛ ir Moserɔt dɛ ka so Bɛne Jaakan.
Dɛ ir Bɛne Jaakan dɛ ka so Hɔr Haɡidiɡad.
Dɛ ir Hɔr Haɡidiɡad dɛ ka so Jotbata.
Dɛ ir Jotbata dɛ ka so Abrona.
Dɛ ir Abrona dɛ ka so Eseɔn Gɛba.
Dɛ ir Eseɔn Gɛba dɛ ka so Kades, o lɔ Sin pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Dɛ ir Kades dɛ ka so Hɔr Bwejen ta, o lɔ Edom harɛ jwɛh ta.
Hɔr Bwejen taa sɔfo Arɔn sewɛ korobinue tɔpeloɡle ta, bene fifraanaarɛ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta la ta.
Sɔfo Arɔn dɔ bene lafa fifraanɛ dɛ atoro mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ Hɔr Bwejen ta.
Gɛ saŋee Keenan harɛ ta Kooro Arad no kɛŋɔ Israel tena dɛ ba.
Dɛ o soɡe Keenan harɛ ta weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Israel tena la ir Hɔr Bwejen ta dɛ ka so Salmona.
Dɛ ir Salmona dɛ ka so Punon.
Dɛ ir Punon dɛ ka so Ɔbɔt.
Dɛ ir Ɔbɔt dɛ ka so Iye Abarim, o lɔ Moab harɛ jwɛh ta.
Dɛ ir Iye Abarim dɛ ka so Debɔn Gad.
Dɛ ir Debɔn Gad dɛ ka so Almɔn Diblataim.
Dɛ ir Almɔn Diblataim dɛ ka so Abarim Bwejena bɔr, dɛ bɛne Nɛbo Bwejen.
Dɛ ir Abarim Bwejena bɔr dɛ ka so Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo ta, asɛ Jeriko do baŋ bɛl.
Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta la, ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa, dɛ so Bɛt Jɛsemɔt dɛ kpoŋe kaa Ebel bela baa du akaasia daa.
Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo la ta, Jeriko aa lɔ baŋ bɛl la, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “He ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la le dɛ jo Keenan harɛ ta naa, hé doŋi bela tena baa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa le.
Hé chɔɡ ba voɡa baa sɛah ne anɔ la baa loɡa, dɛ́ chɔɡ bela baa chema dɛɛ toma bwa.
Hé kpɔ harɛ la ó ɛ he kon dɛ́ so o ta, n kpɔɔ tɛ heya.
Hé che bie tae ta dɛ́ bɔne harɛ la.
Dea o nɛra aa wara la, hé ɡel ba bɔr do kan, banɔ la baa wola warɛ la, hé tɛɛ ba onjeɡa.
Dɛ ba ta bie la aa, bela bwa aa chole la, ɛ he bɔr.
Hé bɔna denaa ta.
Dɛ he ta bela tena la doŋe le aa, banɔ la haa ɡel ba ba so la ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ daa waa dɛ ba he siwi tɔɡa, kɛɛ sɔɔh waa tɔɡɛ he kuɡri la ken.
Baa tɛ heyaa waa, harɛ haa dɛ ba o ta soɡa la ta.
He ta ban doŋe le aa, mɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa ɡɛ maa liira kɛ mɛɛ chɔɡ baa la.”
Keenan harɛ jwɛhre Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he tel Keenan harɛ baa dɛ ba bɔna ó ɛ he kon la ta naa, bá do jwɛhre nɔ.
Weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh la le Sin pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Edom harɛ jwɛh ta.
Wee leebɔr ɡe le Yar Mpo ta kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ́ teŋɛ kaa bela baa kpɔa dɛɛ kaa Akrabim weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ́ kaa Sin, dɛ́ le bela kaa Kades Baanea weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Dɛ́ le bela kaa Hasar Adaar dɛ́ kaa Asmɔn.
Belaa wɛɛ ba ɡola le Asmɔn dɛ́ kaa Ijipt Fɛlembɔjen jwɛh ta, dɛ́ ka jaɡɛ Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta.
Wee cholibɔr jwɛh la, Mɛdetereenea Mpo nyoa ɛ́ he jwɛh.
Weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jwɛh ɡe teŋɔ le Mɛdetereenea Mpo la ta kaa Hɔr Bwejen ta, dɛ́ le Hɔr Bwejen ta kaa Lebo Hamat.
Ásɛ jwɛh la chɔ kaa Sedad.
Weekaŋle nyundua pera jwɛh la le Sedad kaa Sifron dɛ́ ka jaɡɛ Hasar Enan.
Wee leebɔr jwɛh la, teŋe le Hasar Enan kaa Sɛfam, ásɛ jwɛh la le Sɛfam dɛ́ kaa Ribla waa lɔ Ain wee leebɔr, dɛ́ kpoŋe wili kaa Galilia Moo nyoa wee leebɔr.
Jwɛh la ɛɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Moo la taa, dɛ́ ka jaɡɛ Yar Mpo ta.
Gɛɛ he harɛ jwɛhre la ɛɛ ba doe.” Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Harɛ laanee la, Korowii ŋɔ hé che bie tae ta, dɛ́ bɔne tɛ deene anuanaarɛ ne pera ó ɛ ba kon, Rubin ne Gad dea tena, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena dɔ ba bɔr.
Gɛ deene anɛ nɔ ne Manasɛ dea pera tena la dɔ ba bɔr Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr, Jeriko do baŋ bɛl.” Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Baala baa dɛ́ ba harɛ la bɔna tɛ heyaa laanee sɔfo Eliasa ne Nun bibaa Josua.
Le dea bɛlbwa nomoa, ásɛ ba cha dɛ́ bɔne harɛ la.
Ba sɔnaa nɔ.
Jefune bibaa Kaleb waa le Juda dea, ne Amihud bibaa Sɛmoɛl waa le Simeon dea, ne Keslɔn bibaa Elidad waa le Bɛnjamen dea, ne Joɡli bibaa Buki waa le Dan dea, ne Efɔd bibaa Haneɛl waa le Manasɛ dea, ne Siftan bibaa Kɛmoɛl waa le Efrem dea, ne Panak bibaa Elisafan waa le Sebulon dea, ne Asaan bibaa Paltiel waa le Isaaka dea, ne Sɛlome bibaa Ahihud waa le Aasa dea, dɛ Amihud bibaa Pɛdahɛl waa le Naftale dea.” Banɔɔ Korowii le ŋɔ bá bɔne Keenan harɛ la tɛ Israel tena la.
Lewi dea tena bwɛjena Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa dɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Moo ta asɛ Jeriko do o baŋ bɛl belaa Korowii bol waa Mosis be ŋɔ, “Do Israel tena la dɛ́ ŋɔ bwɛjena baa dɔ la, bá tɛ Lewi dea tena la ane bá so a ta.
Bwɛɛre la dahare harɛre ɡe ɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Ásɛ bwɛɛre la ɛ ba kwa, a dahare harɛre la ɛ́ ba nae ne peera dɛ kondɛɛra aa kaa la bwa dibɔr.
Bwɛɛre haa kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena ba kondɛɛre ɛɛ di a dahare la, á pa mun le bwɛɛ la danjwɛɛ baa maa baro la, dɛ́ ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋ lafraanue.
Bwɛɛre la wee leebɔra, hé maɡɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa atoro, wee cholibɔr kaɡboŋa atoro, weekaŋle harɛbɔr kaɡboŋa atoro, ásɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ɡe naɡale kaɡboŋa atoro, ásɛ bwɛɛ la do baah ta.
Gɛ bɔra nɔɔ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Bwɛjena nɛra aa ka so a ta dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu Bwɛjena anumɛl haa kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena la ɛ bwɛɛre dɛ nomɛl kpo o dɔŋ aa, o chwa ka so bɛl ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
Hé tɛɛ ba bwɛɛre fifraanaarɛ dɛ anɛ ja a ta.
Bwɛɛre háa tɛ Lewi dea tena la ɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ anuatoro, ja ba kondɛɛra dibɔra la ta.
Bwɛɛre Israel deene la aa dɔ harɛ la ta la, hé kpɔ ane tɛ Lewi dea tena la.
Banɔ la ba bwɛɛre aa wara la, hé lɛ bwɛɛre kohona le ba be, ásɛ banɔ la ba bwɛɛre aa wola warɛ la, hé lɛ bwɛɛre tamaa ken le ba be.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ ó bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé le Jɔɔdan Moo la kaa Keenan harɛ ta naa, hé le bwɛɛre ane cheɡ, ásɛ dɛ nomɛl ta saahnɛ kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so bɛl ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
Gɛ bwɛɛre laanee dɛ́ lɛ nɛn nyu le nɛn waa kpoo la nɛra nɔn ta, ásɛ ba bɛ won dɔ bɔr kpoo bɔ kem dɛ nɛra ta cheme dɛ bol o wa.
Bwɛɛre nɛra aa chwa ka so a ta dɛɛ dɔ ba nyuune la ɛ anumɛl.
Hé le bwɛɛre atoro Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ bonɔ cheɡ, ásɛ Keenan harɛ ta ɡe atoro.
Bwɛɛre anumɛl la ɛ bwɛɛre Israel tena ne nɛŋhɔɔhra ne nomɛlbwa ba ne waa soɡa, dɛ bɛl ta saahnɛ kpo nɛn aa, ó chwa ka so bela dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
Dɛ nomɛl kpɔ buni kon lɔ o dɔŋ o sewaa, naate kpo nɛn.
Kpoe chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpo o ɡe.
Dɛ nomɛl kpoŋe bwe waa dɛ́ ba wona kpɔ kpo nɛn, asɛ o kpɔ forɛ o dɔŋ o sewaa, naate kpo nɛn.
Kpoe chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpo o ɡe.
Dɛ nomɛl kpoŋe daa waa dɛ ba wona kpo nɛn, asɛ dɛ kpɔ lɔ o dɔŋ o sewaa, naate kpo nɛn.
Kpoe chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpo o ɡe.
Naate baa kpoo la lole tenten kaa pu nɛn waa kpo o lole laa, a chɛ kɛ ó kpo naate bɔ kem.
Dɛ nomɛl hah o dɔŋ dɛ taɡɔ ɡo, kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ komɛl lɔɔ o sewɛ, kɛɛ dɛ ume nɔn lɔɔ dɛ kpoo waa, o kpo nɛn, o di bolchɔɡe.
Naate baa kpoo la nɛn dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ó kpo ɡɛ nɛn la bɔ kem, dɛ o nao waa.
‘Dɛ nomɛl ta o dɔŋ haeh kɛɛ o laa saahna kpɔ komɛl lɔɔ kɛɛ dɛ taɡɔ ɡo, kɛɛ naate ta nyiŋe dɛ ta bwe o ka lɔ nomɛl dɛ kpoo dɛ o laa saahna, o dɔm ɡe laa aa, nɛra baa bol waa la che ɡɛ Mmara nɔ ta, dɛ́ bol ɡɛ nɛn waa wola saahnɛ kpo o dɔŋ, ne o dɔŋ waa dɛ nyinu dɛ kpo la wa.
Nɛra baa chema dɛ bol waa la lɛ nɛn waa kpo o dɔŋ la le nɛn waa dɛ nyinu dɛ́ kpo bɔ kem la nɔn ta, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔɔ kaa bwɛɛ waa chwaa dɛɛ la ka so o ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu la ta.
Ó so bela ka tel kɛŋɔ Sɔfonomoa baa fuɡe noo do o nyu ta Korowii sɔn ta la, aa baa sewɛ mɔɔ.
Dɛ naate waa kpo nɛn la berɔ le bwɛɛ waa chwaa ka so o ta, asɛ naate waa sewa la nɛn waa dɛ nyin ɡɛ nɛn la dɛ́ kpoo bɔ kem la ka nao dɛ kpoo waa, o ta bolchɔɡe dii.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ ó so bwɛɛ waa chwaa kaa la ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ Sɔfonomoa waa lole ɡɛ saŋ la aa sewa mɔɔ ɡɛ nɛn la won kaa bwɛɛ waa le o ta.
A ɡɛ Mmara la ɛ nɛŋkpoa waa dɛ chɔ tɛ heya bela haa soɡa, dɛ́ ka tel he naanar baa ka ba bwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpo nɛn la, dɛ baa kpoo waa, á che o nyoa wobol ta mɔɔ ba won kpoo.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá che danseɛ te beŋkpoŋ nyoa wobol ta dɛ́ kpo nomɛlbwa.
He bɛ suuɡa lɛ le nomɛlbwa waa kpo nɛn a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo la be, dɛ́ kpɔ o nyu kɛo.
He bɛ suuɡa lɛ dɛ́ ɡel nomɛlbwa waa chwa ka so a ɡɛ bwɛɛre la ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu la berɛ kaa o bwɛ, dɛ Sɔfonomoa waa lole ɡɛ saŋ la ta sewɛ.
Bobɛlbwa haa lole, he bɛ ɡɛ ɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ harɛ la.
Nɛŋkpoa dɛ chɔɡ harɛ haa soɡe o ta la.
Haa won kpɔ komɛlbwa kwaa harɛ la, nemenɛ naate waa kpo nɛn la ɡbaɡba chal.
He bɛ doŋa kpɔ kah harɛ haa soɡe o ta la, Korowii lɔ he Israel tena baah ta.’ ”
Selofehad bihaahna kapɛrɛ Josef naanar baa ɛ Manasɛ dea pera naa Makir bibaa Gelead la Mosis ne Israel sitɔɔla ne deene nomonome be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Korowii aa do heyaa ŋɔ hé che bie tae ta, dɛ́ bɔne harɛ la tɛ ya Israel tena ya so o ta la, o berɔ ŋɔ hé kpɔ ya dɔɔ Selofehad harɛ tɛ o bihaahna.
Dɛ a kaa ba kɛŋɔ ba yalɛ deene nɔ ane ta naa, ba kapɛrɛ la ɛɛ ɛ deene la kwaa, dɛ ya kapɛrɛ peraa lea la.
Dɛ benanyoa nomɛl kon lɔ nomɛl be Israel tena yon berɛ tɛo la telaa, ba bɔr la ɛɛ le ya naawa kon taa, dɛ́ ka ja dea baa yalɛ o ta la kon ta.” Asɛ Mosis che waa Korowii aa doo a ta la ta dɛ ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Waa Josef naanar la aa dɛ bol la ɛ kpela.
Waa Korowii aa bera do Selofehad bihaahna a ta laanee kɛŋɔ, baa yalɛ nomɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin ba mɛɛ dea la ta.
Israel dea bɛlbwa harɛ waa dɔa la bɛ o dɔŋ dea kon ta ka ja, nomɛlbwa kpɔ o naa harɛ ó ɛ o kon.
Israel haah bɛlbwa waa dɔ o naa harɛ pera la yalɛ dea o mɛɛ aa le o ta, ɡɛɛ dɛ ɡel bɛlbwa dɔ o mɛɛ harɛ ó ɛ o kon.
Dea bɛlbwa harɛ bɛ o dɔŋ kon ta ka ja, dea bɛlbwa kpɔ o kon.” Gɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la, ɡɛɛ Selofehad bihaahna la ɛ. Selofehad bihaahna laanee, Maala ne Tirsa ne Hoɡla ne Milka dɛ Nowa.
Ba yalɛ ba mɛɛ naaranar.
Ba yalɛ Josef bibaa Manasɛ dea la ta, asɛ ba harɛ baa dɔa la ka ba mɛɛ lolanar harɛ ta.
Mmarare ne waa Korowii aa kpɔa che Mosis nɛɛ dɛ tɛ Israel tena laanee.
Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo ta, asɛ Jeriko do baŋ bɛl la taa Korowii bola.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Korowii Mmarare Tɛɛ Nɛɛtena Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle waa aa chiɡa ɡɛ saŋ Israel tena aa valɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bene fifraanaarɛ habɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ nyin bá jo Keenan harɛ ta wa.
Mosis lii ba wobɛlbwa Korowii aa ɛa dɛ ba bane bela.
O berɔ lii ba Korowii Mmarare aa dɛ baɡle ɡɛ baa ka so harɛfale Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ka so o ta la wa.
Korowii ta ɡelɛ Mosis naa tire harɛ waa baɡ ba nyoa la ta, kɛ o cheɡɛ bojaŋ dɛ nao siwi ne.
Mosis sewɔ asɛ ba huɡo Moab harɛ ta.
Wobol aa lɔ tɔn nɔ jaɡa ŋɔ, ‘Gɛɛ Korowii keame bɛlbwa aa wola wone ɛ wejena ne waa aa do ɔma kɛŋɔ Mosis aa ɛa nɔ Israel tena la siwi ta.’
Mosis do Israel tena ŋɔ bá kaa Sinai Bwejen ta Kenii Mosis bol Israel tena be ɡɛ saŋ baa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr.
Bela lɔ Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ bɛne bwɛɛ Suf, o do Paran ne Tofɛl ne Laban, ne Haserɔt dɛ Disahab baah ta.
Le Sinai Bwejen ta dɛ́ fɛrɛ Sɛɛ Bwejen la dɛ́ kaa Kades Baanea ɛɛ ɛ tɔpera fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ŋwɛnɛɛ.
Baa le Ijipt harɛ bene fifraanaarɛ habɔɔ, korobie fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ tɔpere waa tɔ sie la taa Mosis bol waa Korowii aa ŋɔa o bol ba be bwa.
Dɛ Korowii tɔ sie yo Amɔre tena Kooro Sihon o fa aa di kora Hɛsbɔn, ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ waa di kora Astarɔt ne Edrei, dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ mɔɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡ.
Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ wee leebɔr, Moab harɛ taa Mosis pa mun dɛ baɡ ba Korowii Mmara la bini.
O ŋɔ, “Gɛ saŋ ya fa aa lɔ Sinai Bwejen ta la, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ŋɔ, ‘He soɡe bwejen nɔ ta biɡri.
Hé ir bonɔ dɛ́ kaa Amɔre tena deŋɡarere harɛ, ne harɛre aa bɛne bela dɛ do Araba Fɛlembɔjen la ta, bwejena harɛ ne wee cholibɔr deŋɡarere ta ne Nɛɡɛv waa ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ dɛ kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo nyoa.
Dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Keenan tena harɛ ta, ne Lɛbanɔn harɛ, hale dɛ́ kaa Yufretis Moo ta.
Harɛ nɔ waa chɔ he sie nɔ, hé kaa dɛ́ ka kpɔ.
Harɛ nɔɔ n baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ he naawa, Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb dɛ ba naanar baa ka ba la.’ ” Mosis le sitɔɔla Mosis fa ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “He ɡwaa n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ n ɡbo won tɔ he sie.
Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ ɡelɔ taraken he mun ya dɛ warɛ kɛŋɔ weweela ken.
Ó ɡel he ya ɡɛ bele kaɡboŋ, dɛ́ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heya, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.
Kɛ ɛrɛɛ n ɡbo ɛɛ ba wona kpoŋe heyaa dɛ́ nyiŋi he waa bini ne waa aa dawɛ he nɛɛ dɛɛ tɛ heya ɔ?
Hé nyiŋi he ɡbaɡba deene bini wejerema, nɛra baa dɛ no waa mun, ne nɛra ba wa aa dɔ nyɛl, ásɛ n kpɔ ba cheɡ he nyoa.
Asɛ he sɛh kɛŋɔ waa maa liira ŋɔ mɛɛ ɛo la wer.
Anee n kpɔ wejerema ne nɛra baa dɛ no waa mun ba waa dɔ nyɛl dɛ le dea bɛlbwa bini, dɛ kpɔ ba chɔ he nyoa.
Bane chɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa nyoo, bane chɔ lafare nyoo, bane ɡe chɔ fifraanunue nyoo, asɛ bane ɡe chɔ nɛra fifi nyoo.
Dɛ le bane ɡe baa nyiŋi deene la bɛlbwa waa ta.
Dɛ ŋɔ ɡɛ sitɔɔla la be ŋɔ, ‘Hé no waa aa ba he baah ta kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ bola a toɡre, hale dɛ he Israel tena ɡbaɡba baah taa yoo, dɛ hɔɔhra he ne baa pɛa baah taa yoo, he bɛ nɛra siebɔr dɛɛ nyiŋi.
Hɛ́ɛ no nomɛlbwa waa kɛrɛdɛ.
Bechale ne nomonome bwa, hé nyiŋi ba bwa waa bini kɛrɛdɛ.
He bɛ nomɛlbwa siebɔr ɔmɛ, Korowii ɛɛ che he nɛɛ dɛ́ pa bole.
Dɛ waane bola kpeɡri tɛ heya aa, bá ba a ne n sie ásɛ n bola.’ Gɛɛ n kpɔ wobɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ do he nɔn ta.
Toroma baa sɔah ka nyiŋi harɛ Asɛ ya ir le Sinai Bwejen ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ ya be la, dɛ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ waa do kan kohona dɛ do ɔma la ta, dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Amɔre tena deŋɡarere harɛ he fa aa naa la ta dɛ ka tel Kades Baanea.
Asɛ n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Hé tel Amɔre tena deŋɡarere harɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ta.
Hé na, Korowii kpɔ harɛ la do he nɔn ta.
Hé teeh ka kpɔ, ɡɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ aa ŋɔ he be la.
He bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ.’ Ate, he bwa ba n be dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Gel ya tomɛ nɛra ba tɔ ya sie, dɛ́ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la ba tɛ yaa, ásɛ ya jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ ne bwɛɛre yaa dɛ́ ba a ta kpɔe waa dɛ́ ba ŋɔ ya be.’ Gɛ liire la wer tɛ mɛ, anomanta, n le dea bɛlbwa bini nɛmbeŋkpoŋ, ba ɛ nɛra fi dɛ banɛ.
Ba kpɔ deŋɡarere la dor dɛ ka le Ɛskɔl Fɛlembɔjen ta dɛ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la, dɛ kpɔ daa nɔna ane le bela harɛ la ta ba baɡle yaa dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Harɛdɛɛɡee Korowii kpɔ tɛ yaa la.’ Kɛ haa nyin bela laŋa, anomanta, he ta Korowii nyoa wobol noɛ.
He naɡre waa he tɛnte deene bini dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii hah yaa, a waa ɡela o le ya ne Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ kpɔ yaa ba do Amɔre tena nɔn ta ásɛ ba kpoo yaa.
Leperaa yaa ba chaɡa ɔ?
Ya bala baa laŋa ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la ŋɔ, nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta bwara kpeɡri, ba kpeɡo ɡe kohona dɛ ɡwaa yaa.
Ba bwɛjena, ba ma danjwɛkpeɡa a kaa nyundua bara, nomɛlbwa aa wola won dɔ bɔr jo a ta.
Dɛ ba na Anak naanar bela, ba kpeɡo kɛrɛdɛ.’ Anee men Mosis ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ tɔ he siee yo tɛ heya, ɡɛ waa ɛa Ijipt harɛ ta he na la.
Hé berɔ na ɡɛ waa ɛa tɛ heyaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta ja, ɡɛ waa kpɔ heyaa kɛŋɔ mɛɛ yon kpɔ o bie la.
O kpɔ heyaa le bela bwa dɔŋ haa lea dɛ ba tel bonɔ nɔ.’ Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, he ta Korowii yaradae.
Onee tɔ he sie he vala bini, dɛ kpɔ nii dɛɛ tɔ he sie jwaana, dɛ kpɔ bam ɡe dɛɛ tɔ he sie webaŋa, dɛ nyin bela haa dɛɛ chɔ, dɛ baɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta.
Korowii aa no ɡɛ haa dɛ naɡre o waa la, o baah diu asɛ o ŋwɛɛ ntam ŋɔ, ‘Nɛra nɔ te kapa wechɔɡa aa su ba nɔ bini bɛlbwa aa harɛpare ondɛɛɡe maa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ ba naawa la aa belaa la, nemenɛ Jefune bibaa Kaleb laanee dɛɛ ba bela laŋa ó ɛ o kon.
Mɛɛ kpɔ harɛ la waa kaa valɛ o ta laanee tɛ o ne o naanar, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o teŋɛ men Korowii nɛɛ o bambile bwa ne.’ He Israel te waa anomanta, Korowii baah fa di men Mosis nɛɛ o ŋɔ, ‘He ɡba kwara aa harɛ la taa la.
Nun bibaa Josua waa dɛ chae laanee dɛɛ ba bela tela.
Anomanta, doo ɡbemba dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee dɛɛ ba he sie tɔe he ka kpɔ harɛ la ɛ he kon.
He bechale haa ŋɔa baa laɡ ba laa taa baa wola wechɔɡa ne wedɛɛɡa jemɛ mɔɔ la, banee dɛɛ ba harɛ la ta tela.
Banee mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ ó ɛ ba kon.
Kɛ he te, he laa berɛ dɛ́ kpɔ he sie chaɡɛ Mposwɛm ŋwɛnɛ ta bɔr, dɛ́ kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.’ Anee he ŋɔ men Mosis be ŋɔ, ‘Ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
Yaa ka yoo baa ɡɛ Korowii aa do yaa la.’ Asɛ bɛlbwa kpɔ o dɔmkwa, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ deŋɡarere baah yoi ken pwɛre.
Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Ŋɔ ba be, n ta ba nɛɛ jae, ba bɛ la ka yo.
Gɛ laa aa ba dɔma ɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ.’ N bol he be he ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ he ta Korowii waa waa bola la ta teŋɛ dɛ teeh kaa deŋɡarere la ta.
Belaa Amɔre tena baa soɡe bela la le ba tɔ he nɛ, dɛ ɡbaa heyaa kɛŋɔ toohna, dɛ kpoo heyaa le Sɛɛ ka tel Hɔrma.
He baa wi no Korowii, kɛ o ta heyaa chaŋɛ.
Anomanta, he berɔ ba so Kades he tɔpera haa dia la bwa.”
Pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ɡaaɡa Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Ate, ya laa berɛ dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ waa lɔ Mposwɛm ŋwɛnɛ ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa bol n be la.
Ya ɡaaɡɔ kpɔ Sɛɛ deŋɡarere dor kɛrɛdɛ dɛ biɡri bela.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘He biɡri deŋɡarere la bɔr to, anomanta, hé kpɔ sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
A ka tama hé ka kpɔ he lolanar baa ɛ Esɔ naanar dɛ do Sɛɛ harɛ jwɛh ta kaa.
Baa dɛɛ ɔmɛ heyaa, kɛ hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.
He bɛ yoi kpɔ puu ba, maa ɡel he dɔ ba harɛ la naɡale del ɡba.
N dɔɔ kpɔ bela tɛ Esɔ naanar.
Hé yawɛ kondikwa ba be dɛɛ di, dɛ́ yawɛ nee ɡe dɛɛ nyɔ.’ Korowii swee heyaa andɛɛɡa toma haa ɛa bwa ta.
Onee nyiŋi he nɛɛ he vala ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ waa do kan kohona ta la.
Korowii ja he nɛɛ bene fifraanaarɛ nɔ bwa ta, o ta ɡelɛ komɛlbwa paŋɛ heya.
Anomanta, ya kpɔ Esɔ naanar baa lɔ Sɛɛ harɛ la ta, dɛ ɡel Araba ŋwɛnɛ waa kaa Elat ne Eseɔn Gɛba, dɛ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa kaa Moab harɛ ta la.
Bela ɡe la, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ Moab tena baa ɛ Lɔt naanar nɔ baah muɡli he ba yo.
N kpɔ bwɛjen Ar tɛɛ ba ŋɔ ó ɛ ba kon baa di o kpeɡri.
Anomanta, maa heyaa ba harɛ nɔ peraa tɛ hé di o kpeɡri.’ ” Nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Emi tenaa fa soɡe Ar bela.
Ba kpeɡo dɛ warɛ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ Anak tena ken.
Gɛ Anak tena nɔ, dɛ ba fa dɛ yer ba Refa tena.
Moab tena dɛ yer ba Emi tena.
Dɛ Hɔr tena ɡee fa soɡe Sɛɛ, asɛ Esɔ naanar ba doŋ ba bela, ba kpoo ba dɛ so ba buɡ ta, ɡɛ Israel tena aa ɛa harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o ɛ ba kon la ta.
“Asɛ Korowii berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé ir kaa dɛ́ ka le Sɛrɛd Fɛlembɔjen la.’ Anee ya ka le ɡɛ fɛlembɔjen la dɛ kaa o baŋ.
Le ɡɛ saŋ yaa le Kades Baanea dɛ ba le Sɛrɛd Fɛlembɔjen la lɔ bene fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.
Dɛ laa tena la bwa serewɔ.
Gɛɛ Korowii ŋwɛɛ baɡ ba.
Dɛ Korowii laa nɔn kpɔ ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ he baa, ka tel kɛŋɔ ba bwa aa tona.
Ba laa tena la bwa aa serewa tonɛ la, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Fini hé ir, dɛ́ valɛ ka ɡarɛ Ar waa lɔ Moab jwɛh ta la, kɛ dɛ he tel Amɔn tena harɛ ta naa, he bɛ ba baah muɡli dɛ́ ba puu ba yo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ maa ɡel he dɔ ba harɛ la pera ó ɛ he kon bwa.
N kpɔɔ tɛ Lɔt naanar kɛ ó ɛ ba harɛ.’ Gɛ harɛ nɔ, dɛ nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Refa tenaa fa soɡe o ta.
Amɔn tena dɛ yer ba Samsum tena.
Dɛ ɡɛ Refa tena nɔ warɔ ba bwara do kpeɡri, dɛ kpeɡ kohona kɛŋɔ Anak tena ken.
Kɛ Korowii kpoo ba Amɔn tena bwa siwi ta, dɛ ɡel ba so ba buɡ ta.
Korowii ɛ ɡɛ tenten tɛ Esɔ naanar baa soɡe Sɛɛ ɡe.
O kpoo Hɔr tena ba siwi ta, dɛ ɡel ba so ba buɡ ta ba le fini.
Gɛɛ Avi tena baa soɡe bwɛjeɡre ane ta ka tel Gasa ɡe faa na.
Nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Kaftɔ tena aa le Kaftɔ dɛɛ ba la, ba kpoo ba dɛ so ba buɡ ta.
Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon yoi dɛ́ pɔ o nɛ Yaa kpɔ Moab harɛ ta ba kaa habɔɔ la, Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, ‘Hé ir, dɛ́ kpɔ he te dɛ́ ka le Aanɔn Moo la.
Hé no!
N kpɔ Sihon waa ɛ Amɔre kooro dɛ so Hɛsbɔn ne o harɛ do he nɔn ta.
Hé ka pa mun dɛ́ lɛ harɛ la dɔɔh ásɛ dɛ yoo laa.
Fini tɔpere nɔ, mɛɛ pa munii dɛ́ ɡel harɛre bwa nɛra baa no he waa la ɛɛ ɔmɛ kohona, dɛ́ kpɔ ɔmee ne bochela ta ba nɛ.’ Anomanta, n tomɛ toroma le Kedemɔt pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta Kooro Sihon be Hɛsbɔn bansɔɔh wobol ne dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Gel ya kpɔ he harɛ la ta ba kaa.
Ŋwɛnɛ taa yaa ba kpɔe, yaa bobɛlbwaa bɛɡɛ.
Yaa yawɛ kondikwaa di, dɛ́ yawɛ nee ɡe nyɔ.
He harɛ la ta ɡboo yaa soŋe dɛ́ valɛ naa ta ba kaa, ɡɛɛ Esɔ naanar baa soɡe Sɛɛ, ne Moab tena baa soɡe Ar ɛ yaa.
Ya dɛ kaa ka le Jɔɔdan Moo dɛ kaa harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ta.’ Kooro Sihon ta yaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ya kpɔ o harɛ ta dɛ kaa.
Dɛ Korowii ɡelɔ o deŋne do kpeɡri wɛɛ lɛ ɡaeh, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ya won pɔ o nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛ harɛ haa lɔ o ta fini nɔ.
Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘N kpɔ Kooro Sihon ne o harɛ nɛra bwa do he nɔn ta.
Hé pu sie yoo ba dɛ́ lɛ harɛ la.’ Ate, Kooro Sihon ne o laa tena bwa le dɛɛ ba ba yo yaa bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jahas.
Asɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laa nɔn kpɔ o nɛɛ ya kpoo o ne o bibaala ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa.
Ya lɛ o bwɛɛre bwa dɛ chɔɡa, dɛ kpoo baala ne haahna dɛ bechale bwa.
Ya ta ɡelɛ nomɛlbwa won dɔ bɔr chwa.
Kondɛɛra ne laala ne kwaa yaa dɔa bwɛɛre la ta te, ya kaa a ne a ɛ ya kwa.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laa nɔn kpɔ ba nɛɛ tɛ yaa, le bwɛɛ Arowa waa chɔ Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen la doa, dɛ berɛ kpɔ bwɛɛ bɛl waa chɔ o bini, hale dɛ kaa bwɛɛ Gelead, bɛlbwa ta wone dɔ kpeɡri kɛ yan.
Ya ta Amɔn tena harɛ ta bɛnɛ, Jabɔk Moo nyoa bwɛɛre ne bwɛɛre aa lɔ deŋɡarere dor ɡe, ya ta a bɛlbwa bɛnɛ.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la kah yaa a wa.”
Basan Kooro Ɔɡ yoi dɛ́ pɔ o nɛ Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Ate, ya laa berɛ, dɛ kpɔ sie pa Basan harɛ dɛɛ kaa, belaa Basan Kooro Ɔɡ kpɔ o laa tena bwa dɛ ba yo yaa.
Dɛ ya dɛ tel Edrei.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Dɛɛ berɛ o ɔma, n kpɔ o ne o nɛra ne harɛ la bwa do he nɔn ta.
Ɛo ɡɛ haa ɛ Amɔre Kooro Sihon o fa aa dɛ di kora Hɛsbɔn la.’ Gɛɛ Korowii kpɔ Kooro Ɔɡ ne o nɛra do ya nɔn ta.
Asɛ ya kpoo ba bwa nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ɡba ta kae.
A ɡɛ saŋ la ya lɛ o bwɛjena bwa.
Dɛ a lɔ bwɛjena fifraanumɛl, bɛlbwa toole yaa wola ba be lɛɛ, Aaɡob harɛ Kooro Ɔɡ aa dɛ di kora o ta Basan harɛ bwa.
Ba ma danjwɛkpeɡa a kaa nyundua bar bwɛjena la bwa, dɛ kpɔ bune dɛɛ kaɡre a doonyoone.
Dɛ bwɛjeɡre baa wola danjwɛɛ mae bara ɡe warɛ bela.
Ya chɔɡ a ɡɛ bwɛɛre la bwa, dɛ kpoo baala ne haahna dɛ bechale bwa kwaraa, ɡɛ yaa ɛ Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon harɛ ta la.
Kɛ kondɛɛra ne laala aa ka bwɛɛre la ta la te, ya kpɔa kɛ laa ta kwaa kaa a ne a ɛ ya kwa.
Gɛɛ a do ya lɛ Jɔɔdan baŋ wee leebɔr harɛ la le Amɔre tena koranar banɛ, Sihon ne Ɔɡ nɔn ta.
Harɛ la chɔɔ le Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta dɛ ka tel Hɛmɔn Bwejen ta.
Hɛmɔn Bwejen nɔ, Sidon tena dɛ yerɔ Sereɔn, Amɔre tena ɡee yerɔ Senir.
Ya lɛ bwɛɛre aa lɔ harɛ aa chɔa kaa la bwa, ne Gelead ne Basan harɛ dɛ ka tel wee leebɔr bwɛɛre ane baa dɛ yera Saleka ne Edrei, Basan Kooro Ɔɡ faa di kora a ta bwa.
Dɛ Kooro Ɔɡ ɡboo fa baa ka Refa tena baa kpeɡa la bini.
Bunii ba kpɔ ɛ o mpa, dɛ o jaŋne ɛ naɡale fi dɛ atoro ne tama, o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale anumɛl.
Mpa la ta lɔ Amɔn tena bwɛɛ Raba la ta, dɛ ba le fini.” Israel harɛ la bɔna Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Harɛ a ɡɛ saŋ yaa yoa lɛ la, n kpɔ anɔ la aa lɔ Arowa ne Aanɔn Moo weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne Gelead deŋɡarere harɛ pera ne a bwɛɛre tɛ Rubin ne Gad deene tena.
Gelead harɛ kar waa kaa la, ne Basan harɛ bela Kooro Ɔɡ fa aa dɛ di kora la bwa, n kpɔɔ tɛ Manasɛ dea tena bane kapa.
Dɛ Aaɡob harɛ waa ɛ Basan harɛ pera bwaa ba fa ɛɛ yerɛ Refa tena baa kpeɡa la harɛ.
Manasɛ dea bie bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jɛɛ kpɔ Aaɡob waa ɛ Basan harɛ la bwa, dɛ kpoŋe ka le Gesur ne Maaka tena jwɛh ta.
O kpɔ o sɔn pa bela, asɛ baa yerɛ bela Havɔt Jɛɛ dɛ ba le fini.
N kpɔ Gelead harɛ tɛ Makir waa ɛ Manasɛ bie la.
Rubin ne Gad deene tena ɡe la, le Gelead harɛ ta kaa Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen taa n kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen weekaŋle harɛbɔr baah taa ɛ ba jwɛh.
Jabɔk Moo ɡe ɛ ba weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jwɛh tɛ ba ne Amɔn tena.
Le wee cholibɔr ɡe, ba bɔr kaa Jɔɔdan Moo ta, dɛ le Galilia Moo weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛ kpoŋe kaa Yar Mpo weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ kpɔ ka jaɡɛ Pesɡa Bwejen wee leebɔr.
N ŋɔ ba be ɡɛ saŋ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee tɛ heyaa harɛ nɔ ŋɔ hé so o ta.
Kɛ he laa tena la vɔwɛ ntoa dɛ́ le Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ, dɛ́ tɔ he bala Israel tena sie dɛ́ ka cha ba ba ɡe dɔ ba harɛ.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he dɔ kondɛɛra taeh, hé ɡel he haahna ne bii ne kondɛɛra la baŋ bonɔ bwɛɛre maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa nɔ ta.
Hé cha he bala la ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii aa tɛɛ ba bɔr bá so dɛ́ onɛ, ɡɛ waa tɛ heyaa nɔ, ba ɡe dɔ harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o do Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ le.
A habɔɔ la, bɛlbwa ɛɛ won kaa harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta ja.’ A ɡɛ saŋ la, n ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, ‘He ɡbabir na waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa ɛ ɡɛ koranar banɛ nɔ.
Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba koranar haa dɛ ba ba harɛre lɛɛ la bwa ɡe ɛɛ.
He bɛ ban ɔmɛ, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɡbaɡba ɛɛ yoo tɛ heya.’ A ɡɛ saŋ la, n soŋe Korowii sibeɡra ne ŋɔ, ‘Nemenɛ Korowii, he pa mun dɛ kpɔ he kan ne he kpeɡri haa dɔa baɡle men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ.
Komɛlbwa toole nyundua kɛɛ harɛ dɛ́ won ɛ wejena nɔ dɔŋa.
N dɛ soŋe, le n ne Jɔɔdan Moo nɔ baŋ n ka na harɛdɛɛɡe la, ne deŋɡarere harɛ dɛ Lɛbanɔn harɛ la.’ He nomanta, Korowii bandia ta lɔ n nɛ o ta n wesoŋa la noɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘He fele!
Dɛɛ berɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ n be bola kpa.
Kɛ kaa ka teeh Pesɡa Bwejen kaa o nyundujaɡla dɛ́ nyiŋi bar.
Nyiŋi harɛ la aa lɔ Jɔɔdan baŋ la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nee la baŋ te, haa le.
Kpɔ waa la do Josua nɔn ta dɛ́ doo ɡbemba ó dɔ bokpeɡa, dɛkalkɛ onee dɛ́ tɔ nɛra nɔ sie dɛ́ kpɔ ba le nee la baŋ, bá ka lɛ harɛ la haa dɛ ba o nae la dɛ́ so o ta.’ Anomanta, ya soɡe fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, asɛ ya sie dawɛ Bɛt Peɔ ta baŋ bɛl.”
Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena pwɛr ba te teŋɛ Korowii waa ta Ate, Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé no Mmarare bwa maa dɛ ba heyaa baɡla nɔ.
Hé teŋɛ a ta dɛ́ dɔ he nyu ásɛ dɛ ka kpɔ harɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la.
He bɛ wobɛlbwa kpɔ ja waa maa do heyaa a ta la ta, he bɛ ane ɡe laa kpɔ.
Hé lawɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ bini.
Hé ɡbabir na ɡɛ Korowii aa ɛa Peɔ Bwejen ta siwi ne.
O kpoo he bini banɔ la baa dɛ tomɛ voɡ Baal la.
Kɛ he banɔ la haa kpɔ he te pɛl Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la te ta lole fini.
Hé na, n baɡle heyaa Mmarare bwa ɡɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa ŋɔ n be la, ásɛ he ɡe kaa teŋɛ a ta harɛ haa dɛ la ka kpɔ ó ɛ he kon la ta.
Hé noa kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela harɛre nɛra no he waa kɛŋɔ he ɛ wejerema.
Dɛ ba no Mmarare nɔ naa, ba ŋɔ ɡɛ nɛra baa dɔ sɔn kohona nɔ ɛ wejerema dɛɛ no waa mun.
Harɛ besoo nɛraa lole dɛ dɔ sɔn kohona, dɛ dɔ voɡ o bɛn ba dɛɛ no ba be ɡɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa bɛne yaa dɛɛ no ya wesoŋa nɔɔ?
Harɛ bɛlbwa ɡe toole, hale o ne o sɔn dɔe bwa, dɛ dɔ mmarare aa toɡra kɛŋɔ anɔ nɔ maa dɛ dalwe a ta nɔ bwa.
A bwaa kɛŋɔ hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ, hɛɛ berɛ waa haa naa la soeh.
Hé bola baɡle he bii ne he naanar.
Gɛ saŋ haa cheɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ sie Sinai Bwejen ta asɛ o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Yerɛ nɛra la bwa ba cheme n sie bá ba no n waa dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ baa duu mɛ.
Gel ba ka so harɛ la ta bwa dɛ́ bol baɡle ba bii ne ba naanar ba ɡe ɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.’ Hé bol ba be ɡɛ chuu kohona ne baama aa bira kpirkpir ane aa tɔa, ninlao ɛɛ hɔ a bini dɛɛ kaa nyundua, ɡɛ saŋ he fa aa cheɡɛ bwejen la lɔɡa la wa, ne ɡɛ haa no Korowii taa nii la ta wɛɛ bol waa he be, kɛ dɛ haa on na la wa.
O bol he be he ne o fɔo la ta teŋa wa.
Mmarare fi waa chwera dawɛ bwepɛle anɛ ta dɛ ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a ta la.
Korowii ŋɔ n be ɡɛ saŋ ŋɔ ń baɡle heyaa Mmarare aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé teŋɛ a ta harɛ haa dɛ la ka le Jɔɔdan Moo la dɛ́ ka lɛ so o ta la wa.” Voɡa toma jae wa Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “A ɡɛ saŋ haa no Korowii taa nii la ta Sinai Bwejen ta la, he ta komɛlbwa nae, anomanta, he nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ he pɛla bɛ wechɔɡa ba lawɛ dɛ́ sɛh komɛl o le nɛn kɛɛ haah, kɛɛ ol waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta, kɛɛ jumbii aa dɛ ɡah, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh kɛɛ pɛŋe te bɛlbwa soo siwi dɛɛ tomɔ.
He bɛ ɡel he pɛla ba lawɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie ne weweela, ásɛ he ba duura dɛ́ toma.
Harɛre ane nɛraa Korowii ŋɔ baa toma, he te laa.
He te la, Korowiirii kpɔ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ bela waa do wɔrɔbe he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ bela loɡre aa dɛ do buni wɛɛ be la, dɛ ŋɔ hé ba ɛ o ɡbaɡba nɛra ba le fini la.
He waa ɡela Korowii baah di n nɛɛ o ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, maa Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ waa wera o kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la taa la la.
Mɛɛ sewɛ harɛ nɔ taa, maa Jɔɔdan Moo baŋee le.
Heyaa dɛɛ ba he le dɛ́ ka so bela harɛdɛɛɡe ompare la ta ó ɛ he kon.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ fɔo he ne Korowii aa fɔwa la waa soh.
He bɛ komɛlbwa kwaa dɛ tomɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa do heyaa la.
Korowii do kɛŋɔ ninlao ken dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa, o dɛ mee.
Anomanta, he Israel tena ne waa won pɛ dɛ he ɡelo dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡaa.
Dɛ he kaa so harɛ la ta biɡri dɛ loɡle bii ne naanar aa, he bɛ ɡel he pɛla ba dɔ voɡa toma he ɛ wechɔɡa.
A ɛ wechɔɡa Korowii be, dɛ ɡel o baah ɛɛ di.
Harɛ ne nyundua ɛ n danseɛ fini, dɛ he kaa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ n waa nɔ ta harɛ haa dɛ ba Jɔɔdan Moo lee dɛ́ ka so o ta la ta naa, hee hɛɛ ba hee le harɛ la ta.
Haa belaa so biɡri, he bwa ɛɛ heo kwaraa.
Korowii dɛ́ ba heyaa lɔe peɡre ja harɛre ta, he bini tama banee dɛ́ ba ka.
Bela haa ka so la te, hɛɛ tomɛ voɡa nɛwɛnyini aa ɛa, daa ne bwea aa wola na, aa waa no, aa kwaa di aa wola sɔɔh ɡe no.
A tel belaa, hɛɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe Korowii bɔree dɛ́ nao, dɛ he dɛ nyin o bɔr he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ne naa, hɛɛ nao.
Dɛ ɡɛ wahala nɔ bwa ba he nɛ aa, he siwi ɛɛ beɡroo ásɛ he ba Korowii be dɛ́ baa duuru.
O dɛ na nɛn sum, waa nɔnee laa kpɔ he nɛɛ bwa á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa.
Waa fɔo o ne he naawa aa fɔwa o ŋwɛɛ o waa laanee soh bwa.
Hé ta sie nyiŋi waa aa bala mɔɔ ba lolɛ heyaa la.
Dɛ́ berɛ le ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa ta nɛn ba harɛ nɔ ta la na.
Hé ta sie nyiŋi harɛ nɔ bwa ta, waane aa do kan ɡwaa anɔ dɔŋ chiɡo kɛɛ he no a dɔŋa kaa?
Nɛra bane ɡe no Korowii taa nii ta ɡɛ haa noa nɔ dɛ ta so le naa?
Voɡ bɛl wono che nyokpowe-ɛɛla ta dɛ lawɛ o nɛra le nɛra bane harɛ ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa ɛa tɛ heyaa ɡɛ saŋ haa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta la kaa?
O cheɡɛ o kpeɡri waa kana kohona la ne hɔhɔrɔwa ne laa ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla dɛ waa aa do ɔma ta, dɛ lawɛ heyaa le.
Korowii cheɡɛ anɔ ta dɛɛ baɡle heya ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ do kɛ on.
O ɡelɔ he no o taa dɛ le nyundua, dɛ chaɡle heyaa anɔ la aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ. Dɛ ɡel he na o nii waa dɛ lawɛ kohona harɛ nɔ ta, asɛ dɛ ɡel he no o taa le nii la ta.
Nyina waa dɛ nyin he naawa nomanta, o le heyaa tɛ o te dɛ che o kpeɡri kohona waa dɔa ta dɛ ɡbaɡba ja he nɛɛ dɛ le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta.
O doŋi nɛra le ba harɛre ta, banɔ la baa kana dɛ do kpeɡri ɡwaa heya, dɛ kpɔ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ kapɛrɛ kwa, ɡɛ aa doa fini nɔ.
Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ lii dɛ bɛ soh kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ di kora nyundua ne harɛ ta bwa, komɛlbwa toole dɛ ka ja Korowii nɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa maa dɛ bol he be fini nɔ ta, ásɛ a do wer tɛ he ne he bii ne naanar baa ka ba, ásɛ he won so harɛ waa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la ta saŋ bɛlbwa.” Bwɛjena nɛra aa ka so a ta dɛ́ dɔ ba nyuune Ate, Mosis laa bwɛjena atoro ane le cheɡ a do Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ wee leebɔr, ásɛ dɛ nomɛl baa koni kpo nɛn dɛ o dɔm laa wubwa naa, ó chwa kaa bɛl ta ka so dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
A ɡɛ bwɛjena laanee, Bɛsa waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta dɛ le Rubin dea harɛ ta, ne Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta dɛ le Gad dea harɛ ta, dɛ Golan o ɡe aa lɔ Basan harɛ ta dɛ le Manasɛ dea tena harɛ ta.
