Korowii Mmarare waa kpɔa tɛ Israel tena Mosis kpɔ Korowii Mmarare ne o webaɡla bil Israel tena la sie.
Anee ɛ webaɡla ne Mmarare Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba a ɡɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba habɔɔ, dɛ ba lɔ Fɛlembɔjen bɛl waa chɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr dɛ bɛne Bɛt Peɔ.
Amɔre Kooro Sihon fa aa di kora Hɛsbɔn asɛ Mosis ne Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta ba yoo dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ la harɛ.
O ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ ba bwa aa ɛ Amɔre tena koranar dɛ do Jɔɔdan Moo la wee leebɔr la harɛree ba lɛ.
Harɛ la chɔɔ le Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen la doa bwɛɛ Arowa ta dɛ ka le Sereɔn Bwejen baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Hɛmɔn la ta, ne harɛ waa chɔ Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ wee leebɔr bwa ka tel weekaŋle harɛbɔr Yar Mpo ta dɛ kaa Pesɡa Bwejen la lɔɡa.
Korowii Mmarare fi Mosis cheme Israel tena bwa dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé no waa maa dɛ ba bola fini nɔ kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
A ɛ Korowii Mmarare waa kpɔa tɛ heya.
Sinai Bwejen taa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ne ya fɔwɛ fɔo.
O ne ya naawa ɡbo laa fɔwɛ ɡɛ fɔo nɔ.
O ne banɔ la baa lole ɡɛ saŋ dɛ́ kpoŋe ba le ya banɔ la yaa lole fini nɔ bwa nɛ.
Sinai Bwejen la doaa Korowii che nii ta bol waa he be he siwi ta.
Dɛ n cheɡɛ he ne Korowii baah ta ɡɛ saŋ dɛ baɡle heyaa o waa bini he ɔmɛ nii la.
He ta bwe la teehnɛ.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, n le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta somanjiri dii ta la.
He bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ ka ja n nɛ.
He bɛ komɛlbwa waa lɔ nyundua kɛɛ harɛ ta, hale nee bini bɛlbwa chaa ɛ.
He bɛ an dɛɛ ɡuŋi a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ tomaa.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, n dɛ mee.
N dɛ tɛr banɔ la baa hah mɛ deŋne.
Hale dɛ́ kpoŋe ka tel ba naanar bele batoro kɛɛ banaarɛ baa ka ba la nɛ, dɛɛ nyin banɔ la baa nyin mɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ men Mmarare ta la wa.
Hale dɛ́ kpoŋe ka tel ba naanar bele kaɡboŋ nɛ.
He bɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ nɔ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ wesale bɛlbwa ta.
Mɛɛ tɛr naate waa dɛ ŋwɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ la deŋnee.
Hé di Ona Tɔpere la, dɛ́ ɛo tɔpedɛɛɡe ó do ɡoroŋ, ɡɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ nɔ aa do heyaa wubwa la.
Tɔpera anumɛlee he dɔ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ he toma bɛlbwa, kɛ tɔpenuanɛte la ɛ Ona Tɔpere tɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.
O telaa, he bɛ toma bɛlbwa ɛ o ta.
He ne he bibaala ne bihaahna kɛɛ bonɔɔna, kɛɛ toli bɛlbwa bɛ toma ɛ. Hale he nae ne keeɡore, ne kondɛɛre te bɛlbwa, dɛ hɔɔhra kwaraa baa lɔ he deremi bɛ toma ɛ. Gɛ aa ɛ bonɔɔ kɛɛ tolo waa lɔ he sie la ɡe won dɔ bɔr onɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ onɛ la.
Hé ta sie dɛ́ na ɡɛ saŋ haa lɔ somanjiri dii ta Ijipt harɛ la, men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ nɔ cheɡɛ n kpeɡri ne n bokpeɡa ta dɛ lɛ heyaa le bela.
A waa ɡela mɛɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé di Ona Tɔpere la la.
Hé duu he nyare ne he mɛɛnanar, ɡɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la aa do heyaa la.
Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he dɔ mkpajaŋ, wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ heya harɛ maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.
He bɛ nɛn kpo.
He bɛ jwamane dɛɛ bɔ.
He bɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛ.
He bɛ dansewea dɛɛ di.
He bɛ ɡel he dɔŋa haahna pɛla dɔ heya.
He bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre he dɔŋa deremi, ba harɛre ne ba bonɔɔna kɛɛ toli, ba nae ne keeɡore, dɛ komɛlbwa aa ɛ ba kwa.’ A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ Korowii che nii ta dɛ bol takpeɡ ne baama aa bira kpirkpir bini bwe la ta he bwa be la, o ta wobɛlbwa kpɔe ja a ta ɡɛ saŋ.
Dɛ chwera bwepɛle anɛ ta dɛ kpɔ tɛ mɛ.
Haa no taa la le bwejen la bɔr bela nii la aa dɛ hɔ biro la ta la, he dea nomonnyuune dɛ nomonome baa jaa bwa ba n be, dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɡelɔ ya na o jirima ne ɡɛ waa do kan, ya no o taa nii la ta.
Fini ya nao kɛŋɔ Korowii bol waa nɛn be naa, naate ta won o nyu dɔe dɛ́ ta so le.
Aah bɔkwaa ɡela ya berɛ jo seo ta jaɔ?
Dɛ ya berɔ ba no Korowii taa ja aa, nidamanta aa do ɔma la dɛ ba yaa fuih ya serewe.
Nɛwɛnyini besoo no Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa wobol le nii ta kɛ yan, dɛ ta dɔ o nyu dɛ so le nɔ?
Hen Mosis, la dɛ́ ka no waa bwa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ ba bola, dɛ́ ba ŋɔ ya be.
Yaa noo dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.’ Korowii no ɡɛ haa bola la dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N no ɡɛ nɛra la aa bol he be la, anɔ la bwa baa bola la wer.
Dɛ ba pɛla fe ɛɛ lawɔɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ duu mɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa bwa ta naa, ba ne ba naanar wobɛlbwa fe ɛɛ maɡroo tɛɛ ba.
La ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá berɛ ka jo ba tɛnte deene bini.
Ásɛ a ka n ne hen Mosis ɡbo bonɔ, ásɛ n bol men Mmarare ne waa maa dɛ ba ban doe a ta bwa la he be, ka bol baɡ ba ásɛ ba kaa ɛa harɛ maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ka so o ta la ta.’ ” Asɛ Mosis ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ bol he be nɔ.
He bɛ sie laa kpɔ a ta.
Waa Korowii aa do heyaa a ta la taa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé do sie, ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu á chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ dɔ mkpajaŋ harɛ haa dɛ la ka so o ta la.”
Korowii Mmarare la bini onjen Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Mmarare Korowii aa do mɛ ŋɔ ń baɡle heyaa laanee mɛɛ ba heyaa baɡla nɔ.
Hé kaa do sie a ta, harɛ haa dɛ ba o ta kaala ka so la ta.
Hé ne he bii ne naanar bwa ɔmɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, dɛ́ teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ ta, ásɛ he won so biɡri.
Israel tena, hé noa dɛ́ kaa teŋɛ a ta, ásɛ a do wer kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ tɛ heya.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel hé ya kohona harɛpare ondɛɛɡe ta, ɡɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ aa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.
Israel tena, hé no.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ habɔɔ, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa.
Hé nyin Korowii he bambile bwa, he hweera ne he bokpeɡa bwa ne.
Mmarare nɔ maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ á do he bambili bini hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a ta dɛ bɛ soh.
Hé kpɔa baɡle he bii.
Hɛ́ɛ dalawe a ta, he dem soɡa bini ne ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa haa dɛ kaa, hale he chɔe ne he ira bini bwa.
Hé kpɔa ɛ kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡ do he nɔɔra, dɛ́ kpɔa vɔwɛ he tili ta ásɛ aa lii heya.
Hé chwera dawɛ he deene ɡbeni daa ne he deremi ɡbeni ta.” Deŋnekpeɡ tena jae Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii kpɔ heyaa ka tel harɛ waa baɡɛ he naawa, Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb nyoa kɛ wɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta, bwɛjena aa wera he laa vɔrɔwa, ne deene kondɛɛɡa aa sua he laa nyina do, ne buli haa wola an kwii, ne daa kooni ne ɔleve kooni he laa dua, asɛ he di kwaa dɛ vaɡɛ aa, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ Korowii waa soh.
Onee le he ne Ijipt harɛ he fa aa di somanjiri o ta la.
Hɛ́ɛ duu Korowii dɛ́ɛ tomɛ o ɡbo, dɛɛ baɡɛ nyoa o sɔn ta.
He bɛ komɛlbwa nɛɛ teŋɛ dɛ tomɔ, he bɛ harɛre aa bar heyaa nɔ voɡare tomɛ.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o do he baah ta nɔ dɛ mee.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, wɛɛ kpɔ o bandiaa ba chɔɡ heyaa kɛŋɔ nii ken le harɛ la ta.
He bɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ daah na ɡɛ haa daahno na Maasa la.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ mmarare waa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la bwa ta.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ anɔ la Korowii aa ŋɔa a wer dɛɛ su o siwi, ásɛ a chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ he won lɛ harɛdɛɛɡe waa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa dɛ ŋwɛɛ o waa la wa, dɛ́ doŋi he dɔma bwa he sie ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la.
Kerekere dɛ he naanar bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ŋɔ yaa teŋɛ Mmarare nɔ ta nɔɔ?’ He ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Ya fa dɛ di somanjiri Ijipt kooro harɛ ta, asɛ Korowii che o kpeɡri ta dɛ le ya ne bela.
Ya siwi ta, Korowii ɡelɔ nyokpowaa ne wejena aa do ɔma kohona chole Ijipt harɛ ta, ne kooro ne o dem tena bwa nɛ.
Kɛ ya te, o le ya ne bela dɛ ba tɛ yaa harɛ waa baɡɛ ya naawa nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ yaa la.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ yáa teŋɛ Mmarare nɔ ta dɛ́ɛ duuru.
Dɛ ya dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, aa chiɡ yaa kɛrɛdɛɛ ya dɔ mkpa ɡɛ yaa doa fini nɔ.
Dɛ ya do sie Mmarare waa kpɔa tɛ yaa nɔ ta naa, anee dɛ́ ɡel o tea too ya nɛ.’ ”
Korowii nɛra Mosis berɔ ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ dɛ la he ne harɛ haa dɛ la ka so o ta ó ɛ he kon la ta naa, wɛɛ doŋi wobobele anuanɛ bwa nɛra baa kana dɛ do kpeɡri ɡwaa heyaa le ba harɛre ta tɛ heya.
Banee Hiti ne Girɡasi ne Amɔre tena, ne Keenan ne Pɛrɛs ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena.
Dɛ Korowii laa nɔn kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ ɡel he pɔ ba nɛ aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpoo ba kwaraa.
Hé ne ba bɛ fɔo fɔwɛ, he bɛ ba sum ɡe na.
He bɛ ɡel he bihaahna yalɛ ba bibaala, dɛ bɛ ɡel he bibaala ɡe mo ba bihaahna.
Gɛ laa aa, baa berɛ he bii liiree baa wola Korowii nɛɛ teŋɛ, dɛ́ kaa tomɛ voɡa, ásɛ o baah di he nɛɛ dɛ́ den kpoo heyaa warane.
Waa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛɛ ba laanee kɛŋɔ, hé paɡre bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛ fuah dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare, dɛ́ kuuɡi bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura la, dɛ́ teŋni voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa la ta, dɛ́ fuh ba voɡare.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ he do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ.
Onee le heyaa cheɡ tɛ o te le harɛre nɛra bwa bini, dɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ o nɛra he waa ɛɛ su o siwi.
Wara laa he warɛ Korowii koh a waa nyin heyaa dɛ le heyaa kɛ o nɛra, heyaa fe wola kanɛ kwaraa.
Nyina waa dɛ nyin heyaa la, ne o baɡa waa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa la waa o che o kpeɡri ta lɛ heyaa le Ijipt kooro nɔn ta ne somanjiri dii waa dɛ do heyaa a ta la ta.
Anomanta, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole o habɔɔ.
O waa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ teŋɛ o fɔo waa fɔwa, dɛ kpɔ o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe baɡle banɔ la baa dɛ nyin o wa, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta la naanar bele kaɡboŋ baa ba lol ba la.
Kɛ banɔ la baa haoh la te, wɛ́ɛ tɛr ba deŋnee waa wola kpɔ hɛlɛ kwaraa.
Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ Mmarare waa baɡle heyaa dɛ kpɔ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta.
Dɛ he no ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ teŋɛ a ta kasinteŋ ne naa, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ ɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛ́ kpoŋe o fɔo la bini, dɛ́ɛ nyin he waa ɡɛ waa ŋwɛɛra baɡle he naawa la.
Wɛɛ nyin heyaa dɛ́ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa, dɛ́ ɡel he mun ya kohona.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he loɡle, he kooni kwaa kɛŋɔ mea ne ɡrepore ne ɔlevere bwa do wer, ásɛ he kondɛɛra ɡe ya.
A ɡɛ hɛɛra nɔ bwaa wɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ heyaa harɛ la waa ŋwɛɛra baɡle he naawa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heyaa la ta.
Korowii ɛɛ swee heyaa andɛɛɡaa ɡwaa harɛ nɔ ta nɛra, bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ɡwaa heyaa kondɔɔh ta, he bini baala ne haahna bɛlbwa toole waa wola lolɛ, hale he kondɛɛra kwara.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛɛ dɛ́ le weela bɛlbwa ta.
Waa ɡel weechɔɡa haa naa Ijipt harɛ ta la ba he nɛ.
Nɛra baa hah heyaa la nɛɛ wɛɛ ba kpɔe ta.
Harɛre nɛra Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa kpɔa do he nɔn ta la, hé chɔɡ ba bwa.
He bɛ ba sum na dɛ́ tomɛ ba voɡare ɡe, a do kɛŋɔ bela dɛ́ lawɛ heya.
He bɛ dɛɛ bol kɛŋɔ, ‘Nɛra nɔ sii ya nɛ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won doŋ ba ɔ?’ He bɛ ban ɔmɛ, hé lii ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa ɛ Ijipt kooro ne o harɛ nɛra bwa la.
Hé lii hɔhɔrɔwa ne nyokpowaa ne kpeɡri, ne bokpeɡa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa ɛ Ijipt tena dɛ lawɛ heyaa le la.
Gɛ tentenee wɛɛ ba nɛra haa dɛ ɔm ba taraken nɔ ɛɛ.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ ɡeloo jeŋibotoola jo ba bini, hale dɛ́ kpoo ba bini banɔ la baa kaa sɔh dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba dɔ ba nyu la kwara.
Anomanta, he bɛ ban ɔmɛ.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ lɔ he baah ta, o kan o waa do ɔma kohona.
Tama tamaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ ba ba doŋa ta, haa ba bwa kerabeŋkpoŋii kpoo.
A ba ɡɛ naa, kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛɛ aah heya.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ laa nɔnee kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel ba wili, ásɛ he kpoo ba bwa.
Ba koranar ɡe la, wɛɛ kpɔ baa do he lɔɡa, ásɛ he kpoo ba le harɛ nɔ ta ba waa tonɛ.
Nomɛlbwa aa won che he sie, hɛɛ chɔɡ ba bwaa.
Hé fuh ba voɡare, he bɛ ɡel he pɛla lawɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm aa lɔ a ta la ásɛ dɛ ba kpɔa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a do kɛŋɔ bela, dɛ́ won lawɛ heya.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kii.
Hɛɛ berɛ ɡɛ voɡare la bɛlbwa ne he deremi bala, ɡɛ laa aa, he ne a bwa ɛɛ cheo tɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii chɔɡ heya.
A ɛ kondoŋa he kia, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii lea cheɡ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡaa.”
He bɛ Korowii waa soh Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ Mmarare maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu, hé mun ya dɛ́ won jo harɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa la ta dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ he kon.
Hé lii ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa tɔ he sie ŋwɛnɛjaŋ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bene fifraanaarɛ bwa, dɛ daah heyaa na wekpeɡa ne, dɛ tɛr he deŋne he pwɛr he te la.
Asɛ a che a ta o won jemɛ he bambili bini kɛ he dɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare waa do heya la ta, kɛɛ haa teŋɛ.
O ɡelɔ lɔr kpo heyaa he pwɛr he te, asɛ o tɛ heyaa kondikwaa ane baa dɛ yera maana la he di, kondikwaa he ne he naawa aa wola an jemɛ bwa.
O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ ɡel he jemɛ kɛŋɔ kondikwaa ɡbo laa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn mkpa.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol la bwa ɡe dɛ tɛ nɛn mkpa.
He vala bini bene fifraanaarɛ bwa ta la, he laala ta he bwara ta kɛɛrɛ á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ he nakpale ɛɛ darawoo.
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ, ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ tɛr o bie deŋne la, ɡɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ ɡe ɛɛ ɛ heya.
Anomanta, hé teŋɛ waa la Korowii aa dɛ do heyaa la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛo.
Korowii dɛ kaa he ne harɛpare ondɛɛɡe ta.
Nenabɔɔne aa dɛ palɛ ɡboo o bwa.
Neerare bulo dɛɛ le o ta, ɡɛɛ ane palɛ dɛɛ jo felembɔjena ta, ane ɡe palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ deŋɡarere dor.
Mea ne daa aa dɔ nɔna baa dɛ dia kɛŋɔ ɡrepore, ne fiɡ daa ne daa bɛl nɔna baa dɛ yera pɔmeɡranet ne ɔleve no, dɛ tohno ɡboo harɛ la bwa.
Kondikwaa ne komɛlbwa ɡe aa heyaa nya bela.
Ba dɔ bune dɛɛ le bela bwea la ta, asɛ a deŋɡarere ɡe taa baa kwi suuɡa te bɛlbwa.
Dɛ he baa di kwaa dɛ vaɡre aa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, harɛpare ondɛɛɡe waa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la wa.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ haa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la waa soh, dɛ́ ba vɛh o Mmarare maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ.
He baa di kwaa dɛɛ vaɡre, dɛ do he dedɛɛɡa dɛ so a bini, asɛ he nae ne peera ne suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ komɛlbwa ya aa, he bɛ he te maŋkura dɛ́ ba soh Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta somanjiri dii ta la wa.
Onee tɔ he sie dɛ kpɔ heyaa kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ waa kana dɛ do ɔma, nyɔɡre ne hwel ne harɛkonchɔɡa, ne nɔrɔme aa lɔ o ta la.
Onee ɡela nee le bwe ta dɛ tɛ heyaa he nyɔ la.
O tɛ heyaa maana he di pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, kondikwaa he naawa aa wola an jemɛ bwa.
Nee ne kondikwaa nyae nɔɔ o kpɔ daah heyaa na, asɛ wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ heyaa he daahna dɛ na la habɔɔ.
Anomanta, he bɛ ba lii kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ne he bokpeɡa taa a che he dɔ kwa.
Hé lii Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee tɛ heyaa wejema he kondɔɔh dɔe ta.
Anee ɡela o nyoa waa baɡɛ he naawa la chɔ le ba le fini la.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la waa soeh, dɛ́ berɛ kaa tomɛ voɡare ane dɛɛ ɡuŋa.
N dɛ ŋɔ he be fini kɛŋɔ, ate o fe ɛɛ kpoo heyaa, kɛŋɔ harɛre ane nɛra waa tɔ he sie dɛ kpoo ba la.
Dɛ he ta o waa noɛ yaa, ɡɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ ba heyaa ɛɛ.”
Israel tena deŋnekpeɡ ɛɛ Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Israel tena hɛ́ɛ no, fini hɛ́ɛ le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ harɛ taa dɛ́ ka doŋi harɛre nɛra baa kana dɛ do kpeɡri ɡwaa heya.
Ba dɔ bwɛjena dɛ ma danjwɛkpeɡa a kaa nyundua bara.
Ba ɛ nɛra bane baa do kpeɡri dɛ kpeɡ kohona baa yer ba Anak tena la.
He ɡbabir jemɔ dɛ no ɡɛ ba yon ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won che Anak tena sie la.’ Kɛ he te, hé jemɛ kpela kɛŋɔ fini Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɛ́ tɔ he sie le moo la baŋ.
O do kɛŋɔ nii naa dɛ chɔɡ kwaa la, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ doŋ baa le, dɛ́ kpoo ba warane ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ baa tɔ he sie dɛ doŋ ba le aa, a habɔɔ la he bɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Ya nɛndɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa Korowii kpɔ harɛ nɔ tɛ yaa.’ Akai, ɡɛ nɛra nɔ nyubinikpeɡ waa Korowii ɛɛ ba sie tɔe dɛ́ doŋ ba le.
A ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wera waa hɛɛ la dɛ́ ka lɛ ba harɛ so.
Ba nyubinikpeɡ waa ɡela Korowii ɛɛ ba he sie tɔe dɛ́ doŋ ba le tɛ heya, ásɛ dɛ ɡel waa waa koh a waa baɡɛ he naawa, Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb nyoa la won che.
Anomanta, hé no a mun kɛŋɔ he nɛndɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa laa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ koh kpɔ ɡɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la ɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ ŋɔ ó ɛ he kon.
A waa laa, he ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ nɛra.
Hé lii ɡɛ saŋ haa ɛ Korowii o baah di pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ ɛo deŋnekpeɡ dɛ le ɡɛ saŋ haa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ ba tel bonɔ la.
Sinai Bwejen la lɔɡaa he ɡel o baah di kohona kɛŋɔ o fee kpoo heya.
Gɛ saŋ maa la bwejen la ta dɛ ka lɛ bwepɛle Korowii aa chwerɛ fɔo he ne waa fɔwa dawɛ a ta la, n soɡe bela webaŋa ne jwaana ɡɛ tɔpera fifraanaarɛ.
N ta kwaa dii, n ta nee ɡe nyɔe.
Asɛ Korowii kpɔ bwepɛle anɛ o ɡbaɡba aa kpɔ o nɔn chwerɛ mmarare la bwa a ta tɛ mɛ.
O cheɡɛ nii ta bol he be awola haa cheme bwejen la lɔɡa la.
Tɔpera fifraanaarɛ webaŋa ne jwaana la aa tela la taa Korowii kpɔ bwepɛle anɛ waa chwerɛ fɔo la dawɛ a ta la tɛ mɛ.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Tu le bonɔ kaa warane, he nɛra haa le ba ne Ijipt harɛ ta ba la ɛ wechɔɡa.
Ba deno le waa maa do ba a ta la ta dɛ ɛ voɡ dɛɛ tomɔ.’ Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘N na nɛra nɔ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ tena kohona!
Gel mɛ ń kpoo ba ásɛ ba sɔn den he harɛ nɔ ta.
Ásɛ n ɛɛ harɛ bir nɛra mɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel hé warɛ dɛ́ do kpeɡri ɡwaa ba.’ Anee men Mosis laa berɛ dɛ tu, dɛ kpoŋe bwepɛle anɛ la fɔo la aa lɔ a ta la, dɛ nii la ta dɛ lawɛ bwejen la ta.
N nao kɛŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɛɛ kohona.
He ɛ voɡ o le nabale dɛ tɛ he te.
He deno laa he te kpɔ ŋwɛnɛre Korowii aa do heyaa la ta.
Anomanta, n kpɔ bwepɛle anɛ la ɡo harɛ a bwa paɡre wɛjɛwɛjɛ ken he siwi ta.
Asɛ n berɛ chole dɛ kpɔ n sie pi harɛ Korowii sie tɔpera fifraanaarɛ webaŋa ne jwaana ɡɛ n fa aa kaa di bwejen la ta la.
Dɛ maa kwaa di maa nee ɡe nyɔ, he wechɔɡa haa ɛ Korowii o baah di la nomanta.
N ɔmɛ Korowii bandia la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o baah di he nɛɛ kohona kɛŋɔ o fee chɔɡ heya.
Asɛ o berɛ no n wesoŋa ja.
Korowii baah fa di Arɔn ɡba nɛɛ ɡɛ saŋ taeh kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡoo, asɛ n soŋe tɛ o ɡe ɡɛ.
Asɛ dɛ kpɔ nabale haa ɛo o ɛ wechɔɡa tɛ heyaa la do nii ta, asɛ dɛ paɡro dɛ namɔ o ɛ mohooh ken, dɛ pa ta nee bɛl waa pala le bwejen la ta.
Gɛ tentenee he berɛ ɡel Korowii baah di Tabera ne Maasa, dɛ Kebrɔt Hataava.
Gɛ saŋ Korowii aa le he ne Kades Baanea la, O ŋɔ, ‘Hé kaa dɛ́ ka kpɔ harɛ la maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la so ó ɛ he kon.’ Kɛ he le Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ habɔɔ he ta on yaradae, he ta duure kpɔe tɛo.
Le ɡɛ saŋ maa jemɛ heyaa bwaa he le ɛ Korowii lwɛmkpeɡ.
Anomanta, n kpɔ n sie pi harɛ Korowii sie ɡɛ tɔpera fifraanaarɛ la ta webaŋa ne jwaana bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n nao kɛŋɔ o dɛ nyin o chɔɡ heya.
N soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ, ‘Nemenɛ Korowii haa dɛ di komɛlbwa kpeɡri, n poori bɛ he nɛra haa kpɔ he kpeɡri waa kana dɛ lɛɛ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la chɔɡ ta.
Kpɔ he sie dawɛ he bonɔɔna Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb nɛ, ásɛ dɛ laa sie kpɔ nɛra nɔ deŋnekpeɡ ne ba nyubinikpeɡ dɛ ba wechɔɡa ta.
Gɛ laa aa, harɛ haa lawɛ yaa le o ta la nɛra ɛɛ ŋɔɔ, he ta wone kpɔ he nɛra kaa harɛ haa baɡ ba nyoa la ta, dɛ ka kpoo ba pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, haeh haa hah ba la wa.
Kɛ dɛ ba ɛ he nɛra, he kapɛrɛ diile haa kpɔ he kpeɡri waa kana ne he bokpeɡa dɛ lee ba tɛ he te.’ ”
Korowii berɔ kpɔ bwepɛle anfala anɛ tɛ Mosis “Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Mosis be a ɡɛ saŋ ja ŋɔ, ‘Sɛh bwepɛle anɛ á do kɛŋɔ wubwa kwaa la.
Berɛ kwaa daa daka ja a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ teeh bwejen la ba n be.
Ásɛ n chwerɛ waa n fa aa chwera dawɛ anɔ la haa laa paɡre la, ásɛ he kpɔ do daka la bini.’ Ate, n kpɔ akaasia daa dɛ kwaa daka la, dɛ berɛ sɛh bwea la a do kɛŋɔ wubwa kwaa la ken, dɛ kpɔa teeh bwejen la.
Asɛ Korowii ka chwerɛ waa o fa aa chwera dawɛ wubwa la, Mmarare fi o fa aa cheɡɛ nii ta bol he be bwe la ta, ɡɛ saŋ haa chema la, asɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ mɛ.
Ate, n berɛ kpɔa tu dɛ ba kpɔ do daka la bini ɡɛ Korowii aa do mɛ la.
A ta lɔ o bini ba le fini.” Dɛ nɛra bane lole baa yer ba Jaakan tena.
Israel tena baa tel ba buli ta dɛ so bela.
Ba ir bela dɛ ba Mosera.
Belaa sɔfo Arɔn sewɛ ba huɡo.
O bibaa Eliasa ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ ɛ sɔfo.
Ba le bela dɛ kaa Gudɡuda, dɛ berɛ le bela kaa Jotbata.
Nenabɔɔne ɡboo bela bwa.
Gɛ saŋee Korowii le Lewi dea tena ŋɔ baa nyiŋi O Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ta, dɛ́ berɛ ɛ sɔfore dɛ́ che o sɔn ta dɛɛ swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra.
A ta chɔ ɡɛ ba le fini.
Anee ɡela Lewi dea tena ta harɛ waa baɡ ba nyoa la pera dɔe kɛ ba bala la.
Korowiirii ba kaparɛ kon, ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa ŋɔ ba be la.
“N berɔ so bwejen la ta tɔpera fifraanaarɛ webaŋa ne jwaana, ɡɛ n fa aa ɛa loɡla la, asɛ Korowii berɛ no n wesoŋa ja, dɛ ŋɔ waa heyaa kpoo.
Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Kaa dɛ́ ka tɔ nɛra la sie, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa harɛ maa ŋwɛɛraa baɡle ba naawa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba, bá ka so ó ɛ ba kon la ta.’ ” Korowii ɔma Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Israel tena, waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin dɛ le he be taraken laanee kɛŋɔ, hɛ́ɛ ɔmɔ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o waa bwa ta, dɛ́ nyinu dɛ́ɛ tomɔ he bambile ne he hweera bwa ne, ásɛ dɛ berɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne o waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta fini nɔ, ásɛ a chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ.
Nyundua ne harɛ ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta bwa ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kwa.
Kɛ he naawa ɡbosoo nɛɛ Korowii kpɔ sie dawɛ kɛ wɛɛ nyin baa, dɛ berɛ le he nɛra haa ɛ ba naanar nɔ harɛre nɛra bwa bini, dɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ o nɛra ɡɛ aa doa fini nɔ.
Anomanta, hé ɡel he tea to ásɛ dɛ bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ kpa.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɡwaa voɡa bwa, onee dɔɔranar bwa Dɔɔ, O kan, o waa do ɔma kohona.
Waa nɛn siebɔr nyiŋi, haa won yawɔ sen ɡe.
O dɛ nyiŋi bilalbii ne luhaahna kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ nyin nɛŋhɔɔhra ɡe ba kondikwaa dii ne ba yale tɔe bini.
Anomanta, hé ɡe nyin hɔɔhra wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɡe fa ɛ hɔɔhra Ijipt harɛ ta ka.
Hɛ́ɛ duu Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, hé tomɔ.
Hé kpɔ he te pɛlo, o ɡbo sɔn taa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ŋwɛɛ.
Hé kpɛɛro, onee Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o ɛ wejena aa do ɔma kohona he na ka la.
He naawa ba fa aa kaa Ijipt harɛ ta la, dɛ ba lɔ nɛra fifraanuanɛ ɡbo.
Kɛ taraken Korowii ɡelɔ he mun ya he warɛ kɛŋɔ weweela ken.”
Korowii nyina ne o duura Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ nyin Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa ta.
Fini, hé lii dɛ́ berɛ ta sie na waa Korowii aa ɛa dɛ baɡle heya.
Heyaa, he bii laa.
Hé na ɡɛ Korowii wa aa dɔ nyɛl, ne o kan ne o kpeɡri, dɛ nyokpowaa waa kpɔa ɛ Ijipt kooro ne harɛ la bwa nɛra.
He na waa waa ɛ Ijipt laa tena ne ba jaɡre, ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛla la.
Gɛ saŋ baa ti heyaa ka tel Mposwɛm la ta dɛ bwa ka nee ta kwaraa la, ne ɡɛ waa ɛa tɛ heyaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ba tel bonɔ nɔ.
He na waa waa kpɔa ɛ Eliab bibaala Datan ne Abiram baa le Rubin dea, ɡɛ waa ɡela harɛ pere asɛ ba ne ba haahna ne bii, ne ba tɛnte deene ne ba bonɔɔna dɛ ba kondɛɛra bwa jo kaa harɛ bini he baah ta la.
He siwi na wejena nɔ Korowii aa ɛa bwa sekwaraa.
Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ Mmarare nɔ bwa maa dɛ do heyaa fini nɔ ta, ásɛ dɛ won ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la, dɛ́ ka kpɔ harɛ la so, ásɛ dɛ dɔ mkpajaŋ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe, Korowii aa ŋwɛɛ o waa he naawa be ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ ba ne ba naanar la.
Harɛ haa dɛ kaa o ta la ta doe kɛŋɔ Ijipt harɛ haa le o ta la.
Ijipt harɛ he yon du kwaa dɛ́ pere nee bɔra tɛa dɛ́ dɔ nee dɛɛ do a ta la.
Harɛ haa dɛ ba Jɔɔdan ɡala ka so o ta nɔ ɛ bwejena ne nenabɔjena harɛ bwaala aa dɛ nɛ o ta.
O ɛ harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa dɛ nyiŋi o ta saŋ te bɛlbwa, o siwi lɔ o ta tɔpere bɛlbwa ka tel benanyoa aa ba cheme.
Anomanta, dɛ he teŋɛ Korowii Mmarare maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta, dɛ nyin Korowii dɛ tomɔ he bambile ne he hweera bwa ne naa, wɛɛ ɡeloo bwaala nɛ heyaa saŋ aa chɛa ta, bwaala loɡla ne yoo bwaala bwa, ásɛ mea ne senfala ne ɔleve noo bu he nɛ, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he kondɛɛra dɔ kpɔɡa di, he ɡe dɔ kondikwaa di dɛɛ vaɡɛ.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ berɛ he te laa dɛ́ kpɔ Korowii nɛɛ dɛ́ kaa tomɛ voɡa dɛ́ɛ ɡuŋa.
Ásɛ Korowii baah bɛ he nɛɛ di, dɛ́ ɡel bwaala ɡel nɛɛ hwel che he kooni kondikwaa chɔɡ, ásɛ he serewe le harɛdɛɛɡe waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.
Hé kpɔ waa nɔ do he nyuune ne bambili bini dɛɛ liira, hé ɛa kɛŋɔ nɔnloɡ dɛ́ kpɔ do nɔɔra, dɛ́ kpɔa vɔwɛ hé tili ta á ɛ waa chɔ dɛ́ɛ lii heya.
Hé bol baɡle he bii, hɛ́ɛ bola he dem soɡa ne he vala bini.
He chɔe ne ira bini bwa, hɛ́ɛ bol a wa.
Hé chwera dawɛ he deene ɡbeni daa ta ne he ɡbeni ta, ásɛ he ne he bii dɔ mkpajaŋ harɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heyaa la ta.
Gɛ nyundua aa saɡa biɡri la, ɡɛɛ he ɡe ɛɛ ba biɡra harɛ la ta.
Dɛ he no waa maa dɛ do heya a ta nɔ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ teŋɛ a ta kasinteŋ ne, dɛ nyin Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ dɛ duuru, dɛ kpɔ he te pɛlo waa, ate Korowii ɛɛ doŋi harɛre aa lɔ he sie la bwa nɛra baa wara dɛ do kpeɡri ɡwaa heyaa laanee ta, ásɛ he ka kpɔ ba harɛre la so.
Bobɛlbwa haa kpɔ kaa la ɛɛ ɛ he konee.
He harɛ ɛɛ le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la taa, dɛ́ kaa Lɛbanɔn dɛ́ berɛ le Yufretis Moo ta dɛ́ kaa wee cholibɔr Mɛdetereenea Mpo la ta.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won che he sie.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo bobɛlbwa haa kpɔ la nɛra ɛɛ ɔmɛ heyaa kohona, ásɛ a ka ɡɛ, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la.
Fini n kpɔ andɛɛɡa sweera ne nyotaahna dɛɛ bil he sie.
Dɛ hé no Korowii waa nɔ dɛ teŋɛ a ta naa, hɛɛ dɔ andɛɛɡaa, kɛ dɛ he vɛoh dɛ laa he te kpɔ a ta dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa tenaa, amɔ te nyotaahna ɛɛ lawɛ heyaa.
Dɛ Korowii baa tel he ne harɛ haa dɛ́ la ka kpɔ so la ta naa, hé bol wedɛɛɡa waa Geresim Bwejen ta, dɛ́ berɛ bol nyotaahna waa Ebal Bwejen la ɡe ta.
Gɛ bwejena nɔ lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo ŋwɛnɛ wee cholibɔr, Araba Fɛlembɔjen bela Keenan tena aa soɡa harɛ ta.
A bɛne More dajena Gelɡal sideŋ.
He dɛ ba Jɔɔdan Moo la lee dɛ́ ka kpɔ harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ he so o ta la ta.
He kaa kpɔ dɛ so o ta naa, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare la bwa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta.”
Bobeŋkpoŋ baa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii bela Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ hé baa tel harɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé so o ta la aa, Mmarare aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé teŋɛ a ta laanee kɛŋɔ, hé ka chɔɡ nɛra haa dɛ la ka doŋ ba le harɛ la ta la voɡtubɔra aa lɔ bwejena ne deŋɡarere ne daa lɔɡre la bwa sekwara.
Hé kuuɡi bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare, dɛ́ paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura la.
Dɛ́ berɛ fuh ba voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa, dɛ́ huɡri voɡa baa ɛa cheɡ dɛɛ toma la, dɛ́ chɔɡ a bwa le bela a waa bwa le kwara.
He bɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɛ nɔ dɛɛ tomɛ ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa la.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔɔ dɛɛ ba he deene la bwa baɡla harɛ la ta, bela waa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he bwa kaa cheme dɛɛ tomɔ.
Belaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ saraha kwaa haa fuh ne anɔ la haa kpoo tɛo, ne komɛlbwa haa dɔa bɔre fi bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ne he koŋkɛɛla ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, ne he ɡbaɡba bambile bini kwa, ne he nae dɛ peera biloɡla dɛɛ la kaa tɛo.
Korowii sie belaa he ne he dem tena ɛɛ ba kwaa dii, dɛ́ɛ lɛ sie toma haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ wa.
Gɛ haa dɛ ɛ Korowii toma bonɔ fini nɔ, haa an ɛ bela ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin, ɡɛ nomɛlbwa aa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ a wer o be nɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ta dɔe tel bela haa onɛ dɛ́ dɔ kapɛrɛ kwaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la.
Kɛ hɛɛ le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋee, dɛ́ ka so bela Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ ó ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon, dɛ́ ɡel he onɛ le he dɔma nɔn ta, ásɛ dɛ so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ baɡle heyaa bobeŋkpoŋ bela he bwa aa ka cheme dɛɛ tomɔ.
Belaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ saraha kwaa haa fuh dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ jaamo, ne kwaa haa kpoa dɛɛ tɛo, ne he komɛlbwa haa dɔa bɔre fi bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋ, ne he koŋkɛɛla kpɔe tɛo, ne he nyobaɡa kwaa ɡɛ maa ŋɔ he be saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Belaa he ne he bibaala ne bihaahna ne bonɔɔna, dɛ he toli sie ɛɛ ba lɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ sie, ne Lewi dea tena baa soɡe he bwɛɛre ta ba ɡbaɡba aa wola harɛ dɔe la.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ saraha kwaa haa kpo dɛ́ fuah tɛ Korowii la dɛɛ ɛ bobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.
Hé kpɔa ba bela Korowii aa le tɛ heya dɛ le he deene la bɛl harɛ ta la, belaa chɛ kɛ hé ɛ wobɛlbwa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta nɔ.
Kɛ kondɛɛra haa di he deremi te, hɛɛ wonoo kpoora bela haa soɡa, dɛ́ won chwe ɡɛ bɛlbwa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa tɛ heya, ɡɛ haa dɛ chwe kweɡli ne ahre la.
He banɔ la haa kah doŋa ne banɔ la haa wola doŋa kaeh Korowii be pera bwa ɛɛ wono chwe.
He bɛ a chale te di, hé teŋni a baŋa ásɛ chal la fuɡe kɛŋɔ nee ken.
Komɛlbwa haa wola kpɔe tɛ Korowii la, hé dia bela haa soɡa, nemenɛ he mea bɔre fi bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋ, he sen bɔre fi bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋ, ɔleve noo bɔre fi bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋ, ne he nae ne peera biloɡla, dɛ he nyobaɡa kwaa ne he bambile bini kwa, dɛ saraha bɛlbwa aa jaa.
He ne he bibaala ne bihaahna ne bonɔɔna ne toli, dɛ Lewi dea tena baa lɔ he bwɛɛre ta bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ di a ɡɛ saraha kwaa nɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ sie, bobeŋkpoŋ waa le tɛ heyaa la, dɛ́ ɡel he sie lɛ wobɛlbwa haa ɛa ta.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ Lewi dea tena la ba ta he soɡa bini bwa harɛ la ta.
Dɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ baa ɡel he harɛre do kan ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo, asɛ he pɛla lawɛ ol kohona naa, hɛɛ wonoo chwe saŋ bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.
He harɛre la baa do kan asɛ bela haa chema dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la do jaŋne aa, saŋ bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la, hɛɛ wonoo kpoo nae kɛɛ peera Korowii aa tɛ heyaa la, ásɛ dɛ chwe ola la he deremi ɡɛ maa ŋɔ he be la.
Hɛ́ɛ won dia ɡɛ haa dɛ di kweɡli ne ahre, hale nɛra baa kah doŋa ne banɔ la baa wola doŋa kaeh Korowii be pera bwa.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ a chale la te di, dɛkalkɛŋɔ komɛlbwa chal ɛ o mkpa, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé di chal la ja ol la ta.
He bɛ chal la di, hé fuɡe ta kɛŋɔ nee ken.
He bɛ an di, ásɛ a chiɡ he ne he bii ba taa dɛ ba bala la kɛrɛdɛ.
He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ he dɛ ɛ waa aa wera Korowii be.
Saraha kwaa ne nyobaɡa kwaa la te, hé kpɔa la bela Korowii aa le cheɡ tɛ heyaa la.
Ásɛ he kpɔ ol la ne chal la bwa ɛ saraha bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛ fuah dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la, dɛ́ fuɡe ol la bɛl ɡe chal ta bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ fuah la, ásɛ dɛ di ol la te.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ waa maa ŋɔ he be bwa ta, ásɛ a chiɡ he ne he bii ba taa dɛ ba bala bwa kɛrɛdɛ, ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ be.
Dɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ chɔɡ harɛre haa dɛ la ka so a ta la nɛra dɛ ɡel he so a ta naa, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ŋwɛnɛre baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡare la ba nyiŋi, dɛ́ ɡe ɛɛ teŋɛ a ta, a do kɛŋɔ bela, dɛ́ lawɛ heya.
He bɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ tomɛ ŋwɛnɛ baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛ tomɛ ba voɡa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba dɛ ɛ kii waa bwa soo siwi Korowii aa haah.
Hale ba kpoo ba bibaala ne bihaahna dɛ fuuh ba dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare.
Hé do sie dɛ́ ɛ waa maa do heyaa a ta nɔ, he bɛ waane kpɔ ja a ta, he bɛ ane ɡe laa kpɔ le a ta.”
Voɡare ane toma wa Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ keame nyosonteŋni bɛl kɛɛ nɛn waa won deera mun baɡla ba he be dɛ ba bol nyokpowaa bɛlbwa he be, asɛ waa waa bola la ɛ kpela, asɛ o ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel ya tomɛ voɡfala’ aa, he bɛ a ɡɛ nɛn la be no.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ dɛ daah heyaa, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ he dɛ nyinu he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ne kɛɛ.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ hé teŋɛ, onee chɛ kɛ hé ɔmɛ.
Hé teŋɛ o waa ta dɛɛ duuru, hé tomɔ dɛ́ kpɔ he te pɛlo.
Keame nyosonteŋni kɛɛ nɛn waa won deera mun baɡla la chɛ kpoe, o baɡle heyaa waa a ɡel he ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ le Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o le he ne somanjiri dii ta Ijipt harɛ ta la habɔɔ, dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he laa he te kpɔ waa haa dɛ teŋɛ a ta la aa, hé kpoo dɛ́ le ɡɛ liichɔɡa la ne he bini.
He bini bɛlbwa dɔɔ kɛɛ o nime pɔrɔdɔ, kɛɛ o bibaa kɛɛ bihaah, hale o haah kwara kɛɛ o dansom lɔɡɔ ŋɔ, ó berɛ ka tomɛ voɡa he ne he naawa aa wola an tomɛ bwa, nɛra baa bar heyaa nɔ voɡa oo, hale banɔ nɔ baa bɛne heyaa kɛɛ bojaŋa tena voɡa oo, he bɛ sɛh, he bɛ on sie tɛ, he bɛ o sum ɡe na.
A chɛ kɛ hé kpoo!
Tɔ sie ta bwe forɔ mɔɔ nomɛlbwa ɡe forɔ.
Hé foɡro bwea kpo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o fe tɛɡre heyaa dɛɛ le Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta he fa aa di somanjiri bela la nɔn ta.
Ásɛ Israel tena bwa no dɛ́ ɔmɛ, ásɛ bɛlbwa bɛ a ɡɛ wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ nɔ ta ba kpɔ kpa.
Dɛ he baa no bwɛɛre Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa tɛ heyaa ŋɔ he so a ta la bɛl, ɡɛ hiribi nɛra nɔ iro dɛɛ neɡre nɛra ŋɔ baa tomɛ voɡfala aa, hé bɔɔ dɛ́ nyiŋi a bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ kpela kɛŋɔ wedoŋa aa do ken chiɡ he bini naa, hé kpoo ɡɛ bwɛɛ la tena bwa, dɛ́ chɔɡ bwɛɛ la bwa kwara, hale kondɛɛra aa lɔ bela bwa.
Hé pa kwaa aa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta bil bwɛɛ la baah ta bela baa dɛ cheme, ásɛ dɛ kpaa nii do bwɛɛ la ne kwaa la bwa ta tɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ saraha kwaa ken.
Gɛ bwɛɛ la te, ó chɔ dimɡbia, ba bɛ on vɔrɔwe kpa.
He bɛ ɡɛ kwaa la bɛlbwa ba kpɔ, ásɛ a ba ɛ musu tɛ heya, ásɛ Korowii baah bɛ hé nɛɛ ba di.
Ó na he sum, dɛ́ dɔ tedoma tɛ heya, dɛ́ ɡel he ya kohona ɡɛ waa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he dɛ no Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ deŋna waa, dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa bwa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta, dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa toɡra o be.”
Kondikwa aa wera ne anɔ la aa wola were ne dii Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “He ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ bii, anomanta, he bɛ nɛn waa sewa waa koh dɛɛ mɔne he bwara kɛɛ dɛɛ fonɛ he tili bɔra dɛɛ ta, ɡɛ nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ yon dɛɛ ɛ la.
He ɛ Korowii nɛra dɛ do ɡoroŋ, onee le heyaa le harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa bini dɛ kpɔ heyaa ɛ o ɡbaɡba nɛra he wa ɛɛ su o siwi.
He bɛ komɛlbwa Korowii aa ŋɔa waa were ne dii la ba di.
Ola aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé dia laanee nao ne pee dɛ booh, ne ah ne welo, ne kweɡla.
Ol te bɛlbwa waa dɔ nafikoko a baah pere, asɛ o di kwaa dɛ́ berɛ won uɡa dɛ́ chwea la, anee chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ di.
Ola a nafikoko baah aa wola pere kɛɛ aa wola uɡe dɛɛ chwe la te, hɛ́ɛ berɛ a dii.
Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ berɛ nyoɡma, ne chooma ne aah di.
A lole kɛŋɔ a uɡo dɛɛ chwe te, kɛ a nafikoko baah ta pere, aa were ne dii.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ parakoo ɡe dii, o nafikoko baah pero te kɛ waa kwaa di dɛ́ berɛ won uɡa dɛ́ chwe.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ a dii a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ leɡe a lalaa.
Nee bini kwaa ɡe, anɔ la aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé di laanee anɔ la aa dɔ pɛɡa ne kena, kɛ a bini bɛlbwa waa wola kaaɡa ne pɛɡa dɔe la, aa were ne dii.
Jumbii aa wera ne dii la, hé dia.
Kɛ jumbii aa wola were ne dii laanee kee ne ɛɡre, ne ɡbeelemɡbe dɛ kela, ne ɡaahɡaah bwa soo siwi, ne kɔlbiŋi ne koŋkolombie dɛ kɔle bwa soo siwi, ne kwiu bwa soo siwi, ne bɔmbɔm ne kɔkɔsaki dɛ ɡaahɡaah ane aa lɔ nee nyoa.
Dɛ nemorɛre bwa soo siwi dɛ jem.
Koŋɡaahla aa dɛ ɡah te bɛlbwa aa were, he bɛ an di.
Kɛ koŋɡaahla aa wera ne dii la, hé dia.
He bɛ ol waa sewa ta baŋa la di.
Hé kpɔ tɛ nɛra baa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra dɛ so he baah ta.
Gɛ laa ɡe aa, hé yoɡ tɛ nɛn waa wola he nɛɛ jae.
He ɛ Korowii nɛra dɛ do ɡoroŋ.
He bɛ pebie kɛɛ bombie daa o nya elnee ne.” Kwaa bini bɔna bɔre fi Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Bena bɛlbwa koo kwaa haa dɔ la, hé bɔne a bini bɔre fi dɛ laa bɔrbeŋkpoŋ kwaa cheɡ.
Hé kpɔ he mea ne sen ne ɔleve noo haa bɔne a bini bɔre fi la bɔrbeŋkpoŋ, ne nao ne pee dɛ booh biloɡla kaa bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ he tomɔ la, ásɛ dɛ ka dia o sie bela.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ɛ duu Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.
Dɛ bela ne he dem jaŋne kohona haa won che kwaa Korowii aa chae he dɔ la kaa bela aa, amɔ te yoɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡa la la bela Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa lea tɛ heya la.
Dɛ́ kpɔ yawɛ komɛlbwa he pɛla aa lawa, nao kɛɛ pee kɛɛ sen, ásɛ he ne he dem tena bwa pɛ dia bela Korowii sie, dɛ́ kpɔ lɛ he sie.
Hé bɛ Lewi dea tena baa lɔ hé baah ta baa wola harɛ dɔe dɛ́ parɛ la vɔmɛ.
Bene atoro bɛlbwa ta la, he bɔne he koo kwaa bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ cheɡ he bwɛɛre ta bela baa dɛ cheɡ kwa.
Lewi dea tena la ta harɛ dɔe dɛ́ di o ta, anomanta, ɡɛ kondikwaa la ɛ ba ne hɔɔhra ne bilalbii ne luhaahna baa lɔ he baah ta la kwa.
Anee ba ɡee ba dii dɛ vaɡɛ, ásɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa he toma haa dɛ ɛa ta.”
Bena baa kpɔ kema dɛɛ kɛ Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Bene anuanɛ bɛlbwa chemaa, nomɛlbwa waa di he kem la, ɡel kɛo.
Kenii chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛ. Nomɛlbwa o dɔŋ Israel te aa kemɛ suuɡa o be la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel á ta.
O bɛ suuɡa la lɛ kpa bwa.
Korowii ɡbabirii tɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la.
Dɛ hɔɔh te di he kem aa lɛ, kɛ he bini bɛl te di o dɔŋ kem aa, wɛɛ berɛ lɛɛ.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa kohonaa, he bini bɛlbwa aa wola nya bwa, harɛ waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.
Dɛ hɛɛ no Korowii deŋna waa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ teŋɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta tenaa.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ swee heyaa andɛɛɡaa, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.
Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ baa kemɛ suuɡa he bee, kɛ he te aa ba bee la ka kemɛ bwa.
Gɛ ɡee hɛɛ ba kpeɡri dii harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra nɛ, harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra te aa won di kpeɡri he nɛɛ bwa.
Dɛ a hiah he bini bɛl bwɛɛ bɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la ta naa, he bɛ nyubinikpeɡ ɛ dɛ́ vɛh o chae.
Hé ta tea, dɛ́ kemɔ anɔ la aa telu.
Dɛ benanyoa nɛn aa di he kem he ɡel a ta la dɛ tel, asɛ nomɛl ba dɛ ba kemɛ suuɡa he be naa, bɛ koh kɛŋɔ ɡɛ tɔpere la dɛ tel dɛ́ vɔmɔ.
Bɛ ɡel ɡɛ liichɔɡa nɔ ba he nyu bini, ásɛ o bɛ ba wi no Korowii ta he nɛ, á ba ɛ wechɔɡa tɛɛ.
Bɛ on nyubinikpeɡ ɛ, ta tea dɛ́ kpɔ tɛo pɛɛpɛɛ, ásɛ Korowii ɡel he dɔ andɛɛɡa wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ ta.
Nyaara aa he binii paŋɛ harɛ la ta saŋ bɛlbwa.
Anomanta, n dɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé ta tea dɛ́ɛ cha a ɡɛ nɛra la.” Yoma ɡela ba di ba nyuune Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he dɔŋ Israel te, haah kɛɛ baa kpɔ o te tɛɛ suuɡa waa dɛ tomɛ kɛŋɔ yom bene anumɛl aa, bennuanɛ te la, tao ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ ɡel o dɔ o te.
Dɛ he tɛo ŋwɛnɛ aa, bɛ ɡel o kaa pɛɛpɛɛ.
Tɛo he peera ne boohna ne mea dɛ sen haa dɔa la ane.
Tɛo ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa ɡela he dɔ andɛɛɡa la.
Hé lii kɛŋɔ he fa di somanjiri Ijipt harɛ ta, asɛ Korowii lɛ heyaa le a ta.
A waa mɛɛ do heyaa waa nɔ ta fini la.
Dɛ a ɛo kɛŋɔ he yom la ŋɔ waa he bee le, kɛ o dɛ nyin he ne he bii wa, he dɛ ɛo kɛrɛdɛ naa, lawɛ o deŋne marɛ he dea ɡbera dɛ́ forɔ, ó ɛ he nɛndɔɔle saŋ bɛlbwa hale o serewe bena.
Dɛ haahnee yaa, ɛ o ɡe ɡɛ.
Bɛ ɡel á do kpeɡri tɛ heyaa kɛ haa dɛ ta he yoma ŋwɛnɛ ba kpɔ ba te kaa.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba toma baa ɛa tɛ heyaa bene anumɛl la do kɛŋɔ paa tena banɛ toma.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ heyaa he wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ la ta.” Kondɛɛra biloɡla ambala wa Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Hé le he nae ne peera biloɡla aa ɛ ambala la cheɡ, a ɛ Korowii kwa.
He bɛ he nae biloɡla kpɔ parɛ, he bɛ peera biloɡla ɡe pona fonɛ.
Bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ la, belaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ne he haahna ne bii la ane bena bɛlbwa, dɛ́ ka kpoora dɛ́ dia Korowii sie.
Dɛ kondɛɛre la bɛlbwa di kirihiah o nakpala kɛɛ o sibie kɛɛ o bobɛl aa, he bɛ on kpɔ ka ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Hé kpoo he dem, dɛ́ diu kɛŋɔ ɡɛ he yon la kpaah bɔr, dɛ́ ka kpo kweɡla kɛɛ ah dɛɛ dia la.
Hale banɔ la baa kah doŋa, ne banɔ la baa wola doŋa kaeh Korowii be pera la bwa ɛɛ wonoo di.
He bɛ a chale la te daa dɛɛ di, hé fuɡa ta kɛŋɔ nee ken.”
Galekaa Tɔpejen dii Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Abib korobie la ta Korowii sɔn ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ korobie la taa o lɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ jwaana bɛl.
He bɛlbwa lawɛ o pee kɛɛ nao le o kondɛɛra bini, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ la bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ la, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ Galekaa Tɔpejen saraha tɛ Korowii o sɔn ta.
He bɛ paanoo baa do iisi a ta la kpɔ ja Galekaa ol la ta dɛ́ di.
Hé di paanoo baa wola iisi a ta doe la teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ tɔpera anuanɛ, ɡɛ haa ɛa Ijipt harɛ a ba kɛ he le bela wɔrɔbe nɛɛ la.
Hɛ́ɛ yerɔ wahala paanoo, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii he soɡa bini bwa tɔpere haa le Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Tɔpere la telaa, nomɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ la ta bɛ ɡel paanoo iisi aa lɔ a ta do o dea tɔpera anuanɛ.
Ásɛ ol haa kpoo tɔpere waa tɔ sie jɔmɔra la, hé di o bwa awola tenten.
He bɛ Galekaa kondɛɛre la kpo bwɛɛ bɛlbwa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.
Nemenɛ bwɛɛ waa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ tomɔ o ta la ɡbo ta.
Belaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ kpoa, jɔmɔra wee aa baa jo la, ɡɛ korobie la ne tɔpere haa kpɔa dɛ le Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Hé daa ol la, dɛ́ so bela haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la dɛ́ chwe, ásɛ tɔɔ perɔ chɔa he kaa bela haa soɡa.
Tɔpera anumɛl aa tɔ sie la, he bɛ paanoo baa do iisi a ta di, ásɛ tɔpenuanɛ wee la he bɛ toma ɛ. Hé bwa cheme dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ.” Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen dii Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Hé kure yawanyoa anuanɛ le awola tɔpere haa pa mun komɛ mea la.
Ásɛ dɛ di Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ sɔn ta.
Hé kpɔ kwaa he bambile aa lawa ba ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Andɛɛɡa waa ɡela he dɔ la taa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé nyiŋi dɛ́ ba kwaa la ne.
Hé ne he bii, ne he bonɔɔna, ne toli ne Lewi dea tena, ne hɔɔhra ne bilalbii, dɛ luhaahna baa lɔ he bwɛɛre la ta bwa pɛ, dɛ́ lɛ sie bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ la.
Hé lii kɛŋɔ he fa di somanjiri Ijipt harɛ ta ka, anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ta.
Kukure Tɔpejen dii He baa komɛ mea dɛ lɔa tonɛ, dɛ chaa daa nɔna baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen la dɛ harama tonaa, hé kpɔ tɔpera anuanɛ di Kukure Tɔpejen la.
Hé ne he bii, ne he bonɔɔna ne toli, dɛ Lewi dea tena ne hɔɔhra, ne bilalbii, dɛ luhaahna baa lɔ he bwɛɛre la ta bwa pɛ, dɛ́ di lɛ he sie.
Hɛ́ɛ di tɔpejen nɔ tɔpera anuanɛ bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé cheme dɛ́ɛ tomɔ la o sɔn ta.
Hé ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ waa ɡela he kondikwaa ne he tomare do wer.
Benanyoa bɛlbwa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ baa bɛlbwa la bela Korowii aa lea tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ la, dɛ́ ka tomɔ kera atoro.
Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta Tɔpejen la ne Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen ne Kukure Tɔpejen la ta.
Nomɛlbwa bɛ nɔŋɡbayeeɡa ne bela la, nomɛlbwa nyiŋi ɡɛ Korowii aa swee andɛɛɡa tɛo o dɔ la ta dɛ́ tɛ.” Sitɔɔla lee bá nyiŋi dɛɛ bol nɛra wa Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Bwɛɛ bɛlbwa Korowii aa ka kpɔ heyaa so o ta la, hé le nomonome ne nɛra báa nyiŋi he waa ta dɛ́ɛ bola kasinteŋ ne.
Hɛ́ɛ bol waa kasinteŋ dɛ bɛ a sie laa dɛɛ berɛ.
He bɛ nɛra siebɔr dɛɛ nyiŋi, he bɛ ɡel baa yawɛ heyaa sen, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ dɛ berɛ waa sie, dɛ berɛ ɡel nɛn waa jemɛ waa o waa dɔ kasinteŋ la ɛɛ teŋe nyosone.
Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ waa ɡbo ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔ mkpa dɛ́ ka kpɔ harɛ la Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la.
Voɡare ane toma He bɛ voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa paaɡe ja kon haa ɛo dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ta.
He bɛ bwe kpɔ pa dɛ́ɛ tomɔ.
Korowii kii ɡɛ kwaa la.”
Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “He bɛ nao kɛɛ pee waa di kirihiah kpɔ ka ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ.
O kii ɡɛ kwaa la.
Dɛ a kaa ba kɛŋɔ he noɔ kɛŋɔ baa kɛɛ haah ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ chɔɡ he ne Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ fɔo he bwɛɛre la bɛlbwa ta, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ tomɛ voɡare ane, kɛɛ wee ne korobie dɛ weweela aa, amɔ o vɛh Korowii waa la ta teŋa.
Dɛ he baa no ɡɛ waa nɔ naa, hé nyiŋi a bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ wechɔɡa la chiɡ Israel harɛ ta naa, ba kii.
Hé lawɛ ɡɛ nɛn la le bwɛɛ la dahara, dɛ́ ka foɡro bwea kpo.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra banɛ kɛɛ batoro di danseɛ mɔɔ bá kpo a ɡɛ nɛn la.
Dɛ nɛn beŋkpoŋ ɡbo di danseɛ aa, he bɛ on kpo.
Dɛ a ba ɡɛ naa, danseɛ tena la tɔ sie kpɔ bwea foɡro mɔɔ nomɛlbwa teŋɛ.
Gɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ taa hɛɛ ba wona laa ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ kpɔ he bini.
Waa bola kɔɔto Dɛ waane bole pae baa do kpeɡri tɛ nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole he bwɛɛre la ta, kɛŋɔ nomɛl aa saahna kpo o dɔŋ kɛɛ waa wola saahnɛ, kɛɛ laala ane wa aa lɔ bɛl ne o dɔŋ baah ta, kɛɛ nomɛl aa saahna do o dɔŋ bol kɛɛ waa wola saahnaa, hé kpɔ la bela Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa lea tɛ heyaa la, dɛ́ kpɔ ka bil Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore la ne nɛn waa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole dɛ do bela ɡɛ saŋ la sie, ásɛ ba pa bole.
Bole baa pa bela la, dɛ anee.
Hé no ɡɛ baa bola la.
Hé den kpɔ a ta dɛ bɛ ane laa kpɔ, dɛ bɛ ane ɡe kpɔ ja.
Dɛ nomɛl baah suu o ta waa nɛn waa dɛ pa bole kɛɛ sɔfo waa cheɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la naa ta waa ta teŋaa, kpoe chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo.
Gɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ le ɡɛ wechɔɡa la ne Israel harɛ ta.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa no dɛ́ ɔmɛ dɛ bɛ bansua waa aa do ɡɛ la dɔŋa ba ɛ kpa.” Kooro lee wa Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa tel harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ he dɔ dɛ so o ta dɛ lii kɛŋɔ, he chiɡ kooro wɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ harɛre aa bar heyaa nɔ naa, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ na onɔ la Korowii aa leo.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ he bini bɛl.
He bɛ hɔɔh kpɔ, hé kpɔ Israel te.
Kooro la bɛ jaɡre kohona nyin, o bɛ ɡel nɛra la Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ́ ka yawɛ jaɡre, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ŋɔ o nɛra bɛ berɛ la Ijipt harɛ ta kpa.
Kooro la bɛ haahna mo warɛ, a ba ɡɛ naa, waa sie Korowii waa taa do.
O bɛ kondɔɔh kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋa kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm kohona nyin.
Dɛ naate baa so kara ta naa, o nyiŋi Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore la be, dɛ́ lɛ Korowii tɔn la dɛ́ nyiŋi o ta dɛ́ chwerɛ bɛl.
Ásɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel wɛɛ paŋɔ, wɛɛ kuro saŋ te bɛlbwa o soɡa bini bwa.
Gɛɛ dɛɛ ba ɡela ó jemɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la duura kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa waa bola a do tɔn la bini.
Gɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel ó jemɛ kɛŋɔ o ta o bala Israel tena ɡwaalɛ.
O bɛ tɔn la waa la ane laa kpɔ, dɛ bɛ ane ɡe kpɔ ja, ásɛ a ɡel o ne o naanar di kora dɛɛ biɡri Israel harɛ ta.”
Saraha kwaa baa kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena ne sɔfore Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore la aa Israel harɛ la peraa dɔ, kɛ baa di koŋkɛɛla ne kwaa haa kpɔ ba ɛ saraha dɛ fuah dɛɛ tɛ Korowii laanee.
Baa harɛɛ dɔ ɡɛ deene aa kaa la aa dɔa la, kon baa dɔ laanee Korowii sɔfore dii, ɡɛ waa baɡ ba nyoa la.
Dɛ he kpɔ nao kɛɛ pee ɛ saraha aa, sɔfore la di bɔree o vam ne o kaŋe dɛ o tea bini kwa.
Banee bera chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ he mea aa tɔ sie ne he senfala, ne ɔleve noo dɛ peera pona he yon tɔ sie fona bena bɛlbwa la tɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ne ba naanaree Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ le he deene la bwa bini ŋɔ bá che o sɔn ta, dɛ́ɛ ɛ o toma saŋ bɛlbwa.
Lewi dea te bɛlbwa waa so Israel harɛ bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ta dɛ nyin aa, wɛɛ won ba bela Korowii aa lea cheɡ ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ bela la, ásɛ dɛ ɛ sɔfo dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma kɛŋɔ ɡɛ ba bala Lewi dea tena la aa dɛ ɛ bela la.
Gɛ del ba bala la aa dɛ dɔ la, ɡɛ tentenee chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɡe dɔ, hale dɛ suuɡaa o dɔ le o mɛɛ kɛɛ o nya kwaa waa yoɡa ta noo.” We-ɛɛla ane aa ɛ kii wa Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he tel harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta naa, he bɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela la ba chaa, dɛ́ hweli ba wedoŋa ŋwɛnɛre la.
Korowii kia taeh.
He bɛ he bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna kpoo, dɛ́ fuuh ba tɛ voɡa.
He bɛ ajɔ kɛɛ sɔm ne voɡra ne bebee wa, ne kabere dɛ lala yera we-ɛɛla ta jo.
Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ wedoŋa nɔ, a ɡɛ kii we-ɛɛla nɔ waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ tɔ he sie, dɛ doŋi ɡɛ harɛre nɛra baa dɛ ɛa dɛ do he sie la.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé waa do kaih Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ be.” Korowii tomɛ o keame bɛl Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra haa doŋ ba la dɛ no nɛra baa dɛ voɡɛ dɛɛ ɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla la wa.
Kɛ he te, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ta heyaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ kɛ he ɛ ɡɛ.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ tomɛ o keamee ó ba bol o waa dɛɛ tɛ heya ɡɛ waa tom mɛ nɔ.
He ɡbaɡba dwee binii wɛɛ ba o lee.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no o wobol.
Gɛ awola haa cheme Sinai Bwejen la lɔɡa dɛ soŋe Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Bɛ ɡel yá no Korowii taa kɛɛ dɛ́ na nijena nɔ dɔŋa kpa, ɡɛ laa aa, yaa serewoo.’ Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Gɛ baa bola nɔ wer.
Mɛɛ tomɛ n keamee ó ba bol n waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba ɡɛ maa tomɛ nɔ.
Ba ɡbaɡba dwee binii wɛɛ ba lee.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n waa tɛo, ásɛ o bol anɔ la bwa maa doo bwa baɡ ba.
Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛl ta n waa waa cheɡɛ n sɔn ta dɛ bol ta teŋaa, naate deŋnee mɛɛ ba tɛra.
Dɛ keame bɛl ɡe baah suu ŋɔ wɛɛ che n sɔn taa dɛ́ bol waa maa wola on a ta doe, kɛɛ keame waa che voɡ bɛlbwa sɔn ta, dɛ́ bol waane la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo.’ Hɛɛ dɛɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii nyoa wobol laa ɔ?’ Dɛ keame cheɡɛ Korowii sɔn ta dɛ bol waa asɛ a ta ɡɛ ɛɛ yaa, amɔ te dɛ Korowii nyoa wobol laa.
O ɡbaɡba kpeɡri taa o che dɛ bol.
He bɛ ɡɛ nɛn la ɔmɛ.”
Bwɛjena nɛra aa ka so a ta dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ chɔɡ nɛra haa dɛ la ka kpɔ ba harɛre so a ta nɔ, asɛ he ka kpɔ ba bwɛɛre ne deremi so naa, hé le bwɛjena atoro cheɡ harɛ la baah ta Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.
Hé peɡri ŋwɛnɛre ta a ta, ásɛ dɛ peɡri harɛ la Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ kɛ kapɛrɛ la bini bɔre atoro, ásɛ dɛ nomɛl kpo o dɔŋ aa, o won chwa kaa bɛl ta.
Dɛ nomɛl dɔm laa o dɔŋ asɛ o koni kpoo ɡe aa, ó chwa kaa bwɛjen la bɛlbwa ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔ o nyu.
A kaa ba kɛŋɔ, dɛ nomɛl ne o dɔŋ la kɔr bini dɛ ka teŋe da, asɛ kpanfɛbii la fome le o daa ta dɛ ka ŋwɛnɛ o dɔŋ la o sewɛ aa, onɔ la chwa kaa ɡɛ bwɛjen la bɛl ta, dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
Dɛ he le bwɛjen beŋkpoŋ ɡbo aa, a baah la ɛɛ do jaŋnee, ásɛ nɛn waa sewa la nɛra won ti naate waa wola saahnɛ kpo o dɔŋ la, dɛ́ kpɔ bandia ka kpoo, kɛ dɛ o ta chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ waa n doe ŋɔ he le bwɛjena atoro cheɡ la.
Dɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ baa ɡel he harɛ la do kan ɡɛ waa ŋwɛɛra baɡle he naawa, asɛ dɛ kpɔ harɛ la bwa tɛ heya aa, haa dɛ teŋɛ mmarare nɔ bwa maa do heyaa fini nɔ ta kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ nyin Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ dɛɛ valɛ o ŋwɛnɛre ta la nomanta, hé le bwɛjena atoro cheɡ ja.
He ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ chale ba fuɡe ta harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ kɛŋɔ kapɛrɛ kon la ta, ásɛ dɛ bɛ nɛŋkpoa bolchɔɡe ba di.
Kɛ dɛ nomɛl hah o dɔŋ, dɛ bɛɛlo dɛ ka lɔɔro kpo, dɛ chwa kaa bwɛjen la bɛl ta naa, bwɛɛ la naate aa le o ta la nomonome tomɛ toroma bá la ka kpɔɔ ba, ásɛ ba kpɔɔ do nɛn waa sewa la lolanar nɔn ta bá kpoo bɔ kem.
He bɛ o sum na, ásɛ a chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ.
Gɛɛ dɛ le nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ ba kpoo la bolchɔɡe dii le Israel harɛ ta.
Harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ ŋɔ he ka so o ta la, saŋ la tena kpɔ bwea pa ba jwɛhre ta.
He kon haa dɔ la, he bɛ bwea aa pa he ne he dɔŋ jwɛh ta la huɡri ta.” Danseɛ dii Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ aa won di danseɛ nomɛl wedoŋa kɛɛ wechɔɡa waa ɛa ta, ásɛ ba pao bolchɔɡe a maɡre.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra banɛ kɛɛ batoro di danseɛ mɔɔ.
Dɛ nomɛl di dansewea dɛɛ dawɛ nomɛl nɛ aa, ate hé kpɔ nɛra banɛ waa la aa lɔ ba baah ta la la Korowii sie, sɔfore ne nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole dɛ do le ɡɛ saŋ la be, ásɛ nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la nyiŋi a bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ danseɛ te la ɛ nyosonteŋni dɛ di dansewea dɛɛ dawɛ o dɔŋ nɛ aa, ate hé ɛ dansewea te la ɡɛ o fe aa dɛ nyin kɛ ba ɛ o dɔŋ la, ásɛ dɛ laa wechɔɡa la kpɔ le he bini.
Banɔ la baa kaa la ɛɛ noo, dɛ́ ɔmɛ dɛ bɛ wechɔɡa aa do ɡɛ la ba ɛ he baah kpa.
He bɛ nomɛlbwa sum dɛɛ na, dɛ he kpo nɛn aa, a nyoa hɛɛ ba kae.
He fome he dɔŋ siwi aa, bá fome he ɡe kon, he ku he dɔŋ nyen aa, bá ku he ɡe kon, he teŋe he dɔŋ nɔn aa, bá teŋe he ɡe kon, he teŋe he dɔŋ nakpala aa, bá teŋe he ɡe kon.”
Laa yoi wa Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he kaa cheme he dɔma laa ta, asɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ dɔma la torɔɡore baa vɔwɛ jaɡre pɛla la warɔ ɡwaa heya aa, he bɛ ban ɔmɛ.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o le he ne Ijipt harɛ ta la ɛɛ che he mun taa.
Dɛ he dɛ ba laa yoi yaa, sɔfo ba che he laa tena la sie, dɛ́ bol waa baɡ ba ŋɔ, ‘Israel tena, fini he ne he dɔma dɛ ba yoi, anomanta, he bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr, he bɛ ɡel he bwara ɛɛ sa, he bɛ ban ɔmɛ.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ne Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔɔ dɛɛ kaa dɛ́ ka yoo ba, hɛɛ yoo le.’ Ásɛ laa sitɔɔla la ŋɔ laa tena la be ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ bɛlbwa do demfale o ta on pile dɛ ka so o ta mɔɔ naa, ó berɛ kaa dem.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa o kaa ka laa la ta naa, nɛnfalee dɛ́ pili dea la, dɛ́ so o ta.
Dɛ he bini bɛl ɡe du daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen waa wola an chaarɛ bwa naa, o ɡe berɛ kaa dem.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa o ka laa la ta naa, nomɛlee dɛ́ chaara dɛ́ nyɔ a sen. Gɛɛ dɛ nomɛl ɡe nyin haah dɛ haah la ta o dea balɛ mɔɔ naa, o kaa dem dɛ́ ka mo o haah la.
Gɛ laa dɛ o ka laa la ta naa, nomɛl ɛɛ kpɔ haah laanee mo.’ Sitɔɔla la teŋɛ dɛ bol ja ŋɔ, ‘Hé bini bɛlbwa o bwara aa yɔra wɛɛ ɔmɛ la, kaa dem dɛ bɛ ba kpɔ maah o bala.’ Nomonome la bol waa tonaa, bá le laa sitɔɔla bá chɔ ba nyoa.
Dɛ he dɛ ba bwɛjen bɛl yoi yaa, hé tɔ sie bol bansɔɔh wobol tɛ nɛra baa lɔ o ta.
Dɛ ba sɛoh dɛ ya ba bwɛɛ ɡbeni tɛ heyaa, ate dɛ ba berɛ he yoma dɛ́ ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ heya.
Dɛ ba ta sɛɛh dɛ ŋɔ baa yoo waa, hé kpɔ he te dɛ́ chɔ bar bwɛɛ la cheme, ásɛ dɛ Korowii háa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kpɔ bwɛɛ la do he nɔn ta naa, hé kpoo bwɛɛ la baala bwa.
Kɛ haahna ne bechale ne kondɛɛra ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta la, hé kpɔa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee laa lɛ he dɔma be tɛ heyaa la.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ bwɛjena aa lɔ bojaŋ aa wola harɛ haa dɛ ba o ta soɡa bɛne la ta.
Harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ hé so o ta la te, he bɛ hweera kon te bɛlbwa ɡel a bwɛɛre ta.
Hé kpoo a bwa, Hiti ne Amɔre ne Keenan tena, ne Pɛrɛs ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena.
Hé ɛ ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa do heyaa la.
Gɛ laa aa, baa baɡle heyaa waa baa ɛa dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡare Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kia la ta teŋaa, ásɛ he ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ́ jo o nɛ.
Dɛ he kaa pu bwɛɛ bɛl dɛɛ ba o bara cheme dɛ́ yoo ba biɡri aa, he bɛ bela daa teŋni ta.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ hɛɛ di a nɔnaa, daa la ta he dɔma ɛɛ.
Daa baa wola a nɔna di kɛɛ aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe la te, hɛɛ won teŋna, dɛ́ pa darawe dɔŋa nɛɛ bar bwɛɛ la, dɛ́ yoo ba ka tel kɛŋɔ haa pɔ ba nɛ.”
Nɛn waa kpo o dɔŋ baa wola on jemɛ Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “A kaa ba kɛŋɔ dɛ nomɛl kpo nɛn o chɔ kpɔɡ bini, harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ nɔ ta, dɛ háa naate waa kpoo jemaa, he nomonome ne nɛra baa bol he waa dɛɛ pa bole la, la dɛ́ ka maɡɛ le bela nɛn waa sewa la aa chɔa la ne bwɛɛre aa lɔ bela la baah ta.
Bwɛɛ waa bɛne bela waa chɔa la nomonome nyin nalor baa wola on kpɔe parɛ bwa la, dɛ́ kpɔ ɡɛ nao la la nenabɔɔ waa wola hweeh nyoa, baa wola bela parɛ bwa la, dɛ́ ka laa nao la baŋa ku bela.
Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore la tɔ sie, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔɔ lee ba ŋɔ baa ɛ o toma dɛ́ soŋe andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra o sɔn ta.
Ba nyoa wobol taa bá che dɛ́ bol wobɛlbwa aa lɔ nɛra baah ta, ne dɔŋa lɔɔra waa bɛlbwa ta.
Ásɛ bwɛɛ waa bɛne bela nɛn waa sewa la aa chɔa la, nomonome bwa sarame ba nɔɔra ta nao la nɛɛ nenabɔɔ la bini, dɛ́ bwa ŋɔ, ‘Ya laa kpoo, ya ta o kpoe nae.
N Naa Korowii, lɛ nalor nɔ dɛ́ kpɔ ɡɛ nɛŋkpoa wechɔɡa nɔ kɛ Israel tena haa lɛ yaa la, dɛ bɛ ɡel nɛn yaa wola o waa jemɛ nɔ waa dawɛ ya nɛ.’ Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba he te laa dɛ́ kpɔ nɛŋkpoa haa wola a wobɛlbwa jemɛ bolchɔɡe dii ta, a ɡɛ ɛ waa aa wera Korowii be.” Haahna baa laɡ ba laa ta moe wa Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ne he dɔma cheme laa ta, asɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kpɔ ba do he nɔn ta asɛ he laɡ ba yoma aa, he baa nyiŋi ba bini dɛ na bechatolo waa wera he pɛla dɔɔ waa, hɛɛ won kpɔɔ mo.
Kpɔɔ kaa he dem dɛ́ ka ɡel o fonɛ o nyu, dɛ́ kuu o nonie ne nanie, ásɛ dɛ ɡel o foo komɛlbwa aa lɔ o bwara ta wubwa mɔɔ he lawɔ yomhaah la bil, dɛ́ kpɔ anfala do.
Gel ó wi o nya ne o mɛɛ korobie mɔɔ he la o be dɛ́ moo o ɛ he haah.
Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ haa on nyin kpa aa, kpɔ o bwara kɛo.
Bɛ on yoɡ lɛ suuɡa, bɛ on ɛ kɛ yom, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee chemo.” Bibanloɡla kapɛrɛ dii wa Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he mo haahna banɛ asɛ dɛɛ nyin bɛl, haa bɛl nyin, he ne ba bwa loɡle bibaala kɛ he chanche la bie laa nomoa, asɛ a ba kɛŋɔ he bɔne he laala dɛɛ tɛ he bii la aa, bɛ he chanche bie la kpɔ ɛ nomoa onɔ la haa wola on nyin, o bie ɛ nomoa la nɛ.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé tɛ bie waa ɛ nomoa la bele anɛ, hale dɛ he chanche la bie laa kwaraa noo.
A ɡɛ bie laanee o mɛɛ bonɔmbie, anomanta, biloɡle dibɔr chɛo.
Bibaa o deŋne aa kpeɡa wa Dɛ nomɛlbwa bibaa deŋne kpeɡri wɛɛ lɛ ɡaeh waa o nya ne o mɛɛ deŋna waa no, hale ba tɛr o deŋne o ta do ɡɛ naa, o nya ne o mɛɛ lawɔ la bwɛɛ la nomonome sie bwɛɛ la doonyoa baa soɡa dɛɛ bol waa la.
Bá ŋɔ nomonome la be ŋɔ, ‘Ya bie nɔ deŋne kpeɡri, o dɛ lɛ ɡaeh, waa ya deŋne waa ɡe no.
O ɛ sennyɔɔ dɛ ɛ nɛnsala.’ Ásɛ bwɛɛ la baala foɡro bwea kpo, dɛ́ le ɡɛ wechɔɡa la le he bini.
Ásɛ Israel tena bwa no dɛ́ ɔmɛ.” Mmarare ane ɡe wa Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛl ɛ wechɔɡa a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo, asɛ ba kpoo dɛ kpɔɔ ka saɡɛ daa ta naa, he bɛ ɡel o saɡɛ daa la ta tɔɔ per.
Hé nyiŋi dɛ́ huɡo awola tenten, ásɛ dɛ bɛ doŋa ba kah harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ he so o ta la.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii taah nomɛlbwa waa saɡɛ daa ta sewɛ.”
Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he na he dɔŋ nao kɛɛ pee o nyoɡre dɛɛ kaa laa, bɛ sie laa kpɔ, lawɔ ka tɛo.
Dɛ he ne kon te la jaŋne kɛɛ dɛ haa kon te jemaa, lawɔ kaa he dem.
Ásɛ dɛ kon te ba dɛ bɔɔ o wa aa, hé kpɔ tɛo.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛ he dɔŋ keeɡo kɛɛ o yal kɛɛ komɛlbwa waa ɛ he dɔŋ kon dɛ nyoɡre, bɛ sie laa kpɔ.
Dɛ he dɔŋ keeɡo kɛɛ nao cholo chɔ ŋwɛnɛ baah ta naa, bɛ sie laa kpɔ o nɛɛ dɛ ɡarɔ ta kaa, chao dɛ́ horo che chiŋ.
Haah ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do baa laala, ɡɛɛ baa ɡe aa wola chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do haah kwa.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kii ɡɛ.
Dɛ he na jumbie ŋwɛnɛ nyoa daa doa, kɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ nyoa harɛ o pi o bii nɛɛ kɛɛ o hala ta naa, bɛ on lawɛ dɛ́ ɡel o bii la kɛɛ o hala la.
Pa o bii la dɛ́ ɡel o nya la te o kaa, ásɛ a chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ hé dɔ mkpajaŋ.
Dɛ he do dea aa, ɛ kon bar sal la nyoa, ásɛ a bɛ ba kɛŋɔ nomɛl teeh sal la, dɛ́ le nyundua bela dɛ́ ba le harɛ sewɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ waa do he nyoa.
Bɛ komɛlbwa du ja daa haa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen la ta koo beŋkpoŋ ta.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa won di kwaa la bɛlbwa.
Bɛ daa vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl nao ne keeɡo á parɛ.
Bɛ yal baa kpɔ pee pona ne yabi pɛ sɔh la tɔ.
Nyarɛ jɔɔra do he yal haa dɛ tɔ la nyoo anaarɛ la bwa ta.” Baa ne haah yal chɔɡa wa Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he mo haah, asɛ a habɔɔ he ŋɔ haa on nyin, dɛ kpɔ sɔnchɔɡe dawɛ o nɛɛ ŋɔ, he ta haah la pue, o jemɛ baala aa, haah la nya ne o mɛɛ kpɔ kon baa chɔ o ta o ɛ chal la la bwɛɛ la nomonome baa soɡe bwɛɛ la doonyoa dɛɛ bol waa la sie.
Ásɛ haah la mɛɛ ŋɔ nomonome la be ŋɔ, ‘N kpɔ n bihaah nɔ tɛ baa ŋɔ o mo kɛ waa on nyin kpa.
O kpɔ sɔnchɔɡe dɛɛ dawɔ ŋɔ, tolo waa wola baa jemɛ laa.
Kon waa lawɔ hanfale ba chɔ o ta laanee la.’ Ásɛ dɛ paɡri baɡle nomonome la.
Ásɛ bwɛɛ la nomonome la tɛr baa la deŋne, dɛ́ yoɡu lɛ suuɡapoŋa lafa tɛ haah la mɛɛ, sɔnchɔɡe waa kpɔa dawɛ Israel tolo waa wola baa jemɛ bwa la wa.
Ó ta moo dɛ bɛ on vɛh, nemenɛ seo.
Dɛ ɡɛ waa la ɛ kpela, ba ta komɛlbwa dɔe dɛ kpɔ di danseɛ kɛŋɔ haah la aa baa jemɛ bwa naa, ate bá lawɛ haah la ka so o mɛɛ dem doonyoa, ásɛ o bwɛɛ baala foɡro bwea kpo, dɛ́ le ɡɛ wechɔɡa la ne Israel harɛ ta.
O ɛ sihihwa kɛŋɔ waa soɡe o mɛɛ dem dɛ bɔ jwamane la.
Dɛ he na baa dɛ o lawɛ o dɔŋ haah chɔ aa, hé kpo baa la ne haah la bwa, dɛ́ le ɡɛ wechɔɡa la ne Israel harɛ ta.
Dɛ he berɔ too na baa bwɛɛ bini o lawɛ tolo baa lawɔ tɛ yal chɔ aa, hé kpɔ ba nɛra banɛ la bwa kaa bwɛɛ la doonyoa dɛ́ ka foɡ ba bwea kpo.
Haah la kpoe munii kɛŋɔ, o ta lɔŋɔre doe soŋe lɛɛ, bwɛɛ bini ɡee.
Baa la kwaa munii kɛŋɔ, o chɔɡ o dɔŋ haah.
Gɛɛ dɛ́ le ɡɛ wechɔɡa la ne Israel harɛ ta.
Dɛ baa bɛlbwa ɡuɡri tolo baa kpɔɔ tɛ yal kpɔɡ bini dɛ chɔ o ne naa, amɔ te hé kpo baa la ɡbo.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ haah la te wobɛlbwa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta wobɛlbwa aa chɛ seo ɛɛ.
A do kɛŋɔ nomɛl aa cheɡɛ o dɔŋ nɛɛ dɛ kpoo ken.
Kpɔɡ binii baa la ɡuɡru, asɛ tolo la dooɡe lɔŋɔre nyin lɛɛ o ta nɛn dɔe ó ba lɛo.
Dɛ he na baa o ɡuɡri tolo waa wola baa jemɛ, asɛ ba ta on kpɔe tɛ yal o ne o chɔ aa, ɡɛ baa la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ suuɡapoŋa fifraanue dɛ tɛ haah la mɛɛ á ɛ haah la nyin suuɡa ásɛ dɛ moo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee cheme haah la.
Ó ɛ o haah ka tel o serewe bena.
Nomɛlbwa bɛ o mɛɛ haah ba mo dɛ́ kpɔ sihiih kpo o mɛɛ.”
Nɛn doŋa dɛ le Korowii nɛra bini Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa baa fɔɡɛ o lure kɛɛ baa teŋe o pen ta, ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ja Korowii nɛra bini.
Sɛmbie ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ja Korowii nɛra bini, hale o naanar baa teŋa bele fi ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá ja Korowii nɛra bini.
Amɔn tena kɛɛ Moab tena, hale ba naanar baa teŋa bele fi aa won ja Korowii nɛra bini.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ haa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, ba vɔmɛ heyaa nee ne kondikwa.
Beɔ bibaa Balam, waa le Pɛtɔ dɛ do Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta la, ba kaa bɔɔ paa ŋɔ ó ba taah heya.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa dɛ nyin heyaa nomanta, o ta sie doe Balam wesoŋa la ta dɛ berɛ ɡel taahna la berɛ andɛɛɡa tɛ heya.
He ne ba bɛ chamene di saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.
He bɛ nɛra baa dɛ yer ba Edom tena hah, he lolanaree dɔŋa.
Gɛɛ Ijipt tena ɡe, he bɛ ba ɡe hah, he fa soɡe ba harɛ ta kɛ hɔɔhra ka.
Le ba naanar baa teŋa bele batoro ta, dɛɛ kaa la ken ɛɛ ba ja Korowii nɛra nɛɛ.” Bela nɛra aa soɡa wedoŋa we-ɛɛla Anee Mosis berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he kaa baŋre he tɛnte deene bobɛl dɛ́ ka yo he dɔma aa, hé laa he te kpɔ waa aa ɡel hé kah doŋa ta.
Dɛ he bini bɛl chɔɔ dɛ dee o bwara ba naa, a ɛ doŋa wa.
Ó le he bini dɛ́ ka so he habɔɔ.
Ásɛ aa dɛɛ ɛ jɔmɔra la ó sɔ ne, ásɛ wee joɔ waa, ó ba jo he bini.
Hé kwaa bɔr bela haa baŋre he tɛnte deene dɛ so la habɔɔ, ásɛ dɛɛ bɛɡɛ dahara bela.
Hé nyin kon haa kpɔ dɛɛ forɛ bɔɔ do he be, ásɛ dɛ dahara dɛ le heya aa, hé kpɔ forɛ bɔɔ dɛ́ la do dɛ tɔ a ta.
A munii kɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ lɔ he baah ta dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he pɔ he dɔma nɛ.
Anomanta, hé ɡel bela haa cheme la do ɡoroŋ, ásɛ Korowii bɛ doŋa bɛlbwa he nɛɛ na, dɛ ba berɛ habɔɔ kpo heya.” Mmarare ane ɡe wa Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛl yom chwao dɛ ba marɛ naa, bɛ on lawɛ ka tɛ o dɔɔ kpa.
O dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ó so he bwɛɛre la bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin ta.
Kɛ bɛ on fiiɡi.
Israel baa kɛɛ haah bɛlbwa bɛ ɡel voɡ kpɔɔ ó do o toma ta dɛɛ bɔ jwamane.
Bɛ jwamansuuɡa ne Korowii Dea ba dɛ́ ba bɔ nyobaɡa bɛlbwa.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kii.
Dɛ he tɛ he dɔŋ Israel te suuɡa kɛɛ kondikwaa o kemaa, hale komɛlbwa a fe aa chɛ a nee lɛɛ la, bɛ lɛ.
He dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ he lɛ hɔɔh te kon haa kpɔa kemɔ la ne.
Kɛ he dɔŋ Israel tee yaa, ŋwɛnɛ toole kɛ he lɛ, ásɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ sweere andɛɛɡa komɛlbwa haa ɛ harɛ haa dɛ la ka so o ta la ta.
Dɛ he baɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nyoa aa, chuɡra warane ásɛ a bɛ wechɔɡa ba berɛ tɛɛ.
A ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ lɛo le he be.
Dɛ he ta nyoa baɡaa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Anɔ la aa le he nyoa la, nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɛa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee ta tea dɛ baɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nyoa.
Dɛ he jo he dɔŋ bɛl daa koo ta naa, di daa la nɔna bɛlbwa ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin, kɛ bɛ ane kpɔ do he pur bini.
Gɛ tentenee dɛ he tel he dɔŋ mea koo ta naa, kpɔ nɔn kuuɡi ane, bɛ kere kpɔ jo a ta.”
Baa haah vɛɛh dɛ berɛ ka mo onfale Mosis ŋɔ, “Dɛ baa bɛlbwa mo haah asɛ dɛ berɛ ba na sihihwaane o nɛ, o pɛla le o nɛɛ wɛɛ nyin dɛ́ vɛoh waa, ó chwerɛ tɔn tɛo dɛ́ le o ne o dem.
Dɛ haah la berɔ ka yalɛ banfale, asɛ a ka ba kɛŋɔ baa la ɡe aa on nyin dɛ chwerɛ tɔn tɛ haah la dɛ vɛoh dɛ le o ne o dem, kɛɛ sewaa o janɛɛte la sewaa, o jaloɡle la aa won moo, doŋa waa kpɔa dawɛ haah la nɛɛ la wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii kii ɡɛ.
He bɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ la harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ kɛ he kon la ta.
Dɛ baa bɛlbwa mo haah dɛ a ta benanyoa dɔe yaa, he bɛ o ne laa la, he bɛ wobɛlbwa kpɔ do o nɔn ta.
Hé ɡel o so dem o ne o haah lɛ ba sie.
Aŋwɛnɛ ta laa kɛŋɔ dɛ he dɔŋ kemɛ he komɛl aa, he lɛ o nam kɛɛ nambwe cheɡ awɔba, o nyoa kondikwaa he lɛ la.
Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ o dɔŋ bokpeɡa ne, dɛ ɛo o yom kɛɛ dɛ yoɡu he na la, o chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpoo, ásɛ ɡɛ wechɔɡa la le Israel harɛ ta.
Dɛ bwadabii weechɔɡa ane le he nɛ aa, do sie dɛ́ pɛɛ a waa Lewi dea sɔfore la be.
N bol ba be, anomanta, ɡɛ baa ŋɔ he be la, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ teŋɛ a ta.
Hé lii ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa ɛa tɛ Miriam ŋwɛnɛ baah ta, ɡɛ saŋ haa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la.
Dɛ he dɔŋ kemɛ komɛl dɛ lɛ yal cheɡ awɔba aa, bɛ o dea jo dɛ́ ka kpɔ yal la.
Che buse ásɛ o ɡbaɡba kpɔ le ba tɛɛ.
Dɛ naate ɛ nyaaraa, bɛ ɡel bɔr chaah yal la ta.
Bɔr dɛ jo aa, berɛ kpɔ o yal ka tɛo ásɛ o kpɔ tɔ chɔ.
Wɛɛ jaamee á baɡle kɛŋɔ he ɛ wedɛɛɡa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ be.
He bɛ nyaa kɛɛ nomɛl aa hiaoh o ɛ he toma tɛɛ la faah, hale dɛ he bini Israel tee yoo dɛ hɔɔhre o so he bwɛɛ yoo.
Tɔpebir toma waa ɛ tɛɛ la, bɔɔ kem dɛ bɛ ɡel wee jo a ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a hiaoh, a taa o sie dawɛ.
Dɛ he ta on tɛɛ yaa, wɛɛ wiu no Korowii ta he nɛ, ásɛ a ɛ wechɔɡa tɛɛ.
He bɛ nomɛlbwa ba kpo o bie wechɔɡa waa ɛa wa.
Gɛɛ he bɛ bie ɡe ba kpo o mɛɛ wechɔɡa wa.
Bɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó sewɛ o wechɔɡa waa ɛa wa.
Hé bol waa kasinteŋ dɛɛ tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ne bilalbii.
He bɛ luhaahna yale lɛ dɛ́ɛ cheɡ awɔba.
Hé lii kɛŋɔ he fa di somanjiri Ijipt harɛ ta, asɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ lɛ heyaa le bela.
A waa ɡela mɛɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé ɛ ɡɛ la.
Dɛ he komɛ koo kondikwa dɛ soh ane waa bela aa, he bɛ ka kpɔ kpa.
Hé ɡela tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ne bilalbii ne luhaahna, ásɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ ta.
Dɛ he chaa ɔleve aa, he bɛ beŋkpoŋa aa kaa saɡre la kuuh, hé ɡela tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ne bilalbii ne luhaahna.
Dɛ he la he daa kooni ta dɛ ka chaa a nɔna aa, he bɛ la ka kuuh kpa.
Hé ɡela tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ne bilalbii ne luhaahna.
Hé lii kɛŋɔ he fa di somanjiri Ijipt harɛ ta ka, a waa n do heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ la.”
Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ waane chiɡ baala banɛ baah ta naa, hé kpɔ la kɔɔto ásɛ nɛn waa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la ka pa onɔ la waa di boldɛɛɡe la bole, dɛ́ pa onɔ la ɡe bolchɔɡe.
Dɛ bolchɔɡe te la chɛ lɔɔra aa, nomoa waa bol waa la ɡel ó chɔ harɛ, ásɛ ba lɔɔro chweema ne o siwi ta.
O wechɔɡa waa ɛa la taa a chɛ kɛ bá nyiŋi dɛ́ lɔɔro.
Aa ɡwaala kwaraa la kera fifraanaarɛ, a bɛ ɡɛ ɡwaa ásɛ a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ o te ta nɛn ɛɛ.
He bɛ nabal waa dɛ ɛ toma he koo ta la nyoa vɔwɛ, dɛ́ ŋɔ o bɛ kwaa di.
Dɛ bɛl ne o nime kɛɛ dɔɔ soɡo, bɛl mo haah o ta bie dɔe dɛ sewɛ ɡel haah la aa, luhaah la bɛ nomɛl waa wola o jabene la nime kɛɛ dɔɔ ɛɛ yalɛ.
O jabene la nime kɛɛ o dɔɔree chɛ kɛŋɔ ó mo haah la, dɛ́ lolɛ bie tɛ onɔ la waa sewa la.
Biloɡle haah la aa lolɔ la, hé kpɔ o jaa la aa sewa la sɔn pa bie la, ásɛ baa la sɔn bɛ Israel harɛ ta he.
Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ jaa la aa sewa la nime kɛɛ o dɔɔ ŋɔ waa haah laanee mo aa, haah la kpɔ kaa bwɛɛ la doonyoa ka bil bwɛɛ la nomonome sie dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘N jaa nime kɛɛ o dɔɔ ŋɔ waa men mo, ásɛ n jabene la sɔn ka Israel harɛ nɔ ta.
Waa nyin kɛ o ɛɛ mɛ dɔɔ kɛɛ nime haah we-ɛɛla.’ Ásɛ nomonome la yerɛ baa la dɛ́ bol waa baɡlo.
Dɛ o ta cheɡɔ ŋɔ, waa on nyin aa, haah la laa ɡɛ baa la naŋɡawa beŋkpoŋ foo nomonome la sie ta bela, dɛ́ ta nentane ta o sie ta dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Anɔɔ ba kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ baa waa wola nyin kɛ o dɔɔ kɛɛ nime dɔ dwee.’ Ásɛ baa yerɛ baa la bii Israel harɛ ta ŋɔ, ‘Baa la ba fa aa laa o naŋɡawa beŋkpoŋ foo la bii.’ Dɛ baala banɛ dɛ yo asɛ bɛl haah ba dɛ ba cha o jaa, dɛ lawɛ o jaa dɔŋ la lur aa, hé teŋe o nɔn la ta, dɛ bɛ o sum na.
He bɛ kon haa kpɔ maɡɛ kwaa tɔɡre bele anɛ nyin, ásɛ bɛl do kan ɡwaa bɛl.
Gɛɛ kon haa kpɔ maɡɛ kwaa dem ɡe, he bɛ ɡel bɛl do kan ɡwaa bɛl.
A chɛ kɛ hé di kasinteŋ kwaa maɡa ta, ásɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ tɛ heyaa mkpajaŋ harɛ waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ kii nɛn waa wola kasinteŋ di dɛɛ faah nɛra.
Hé lii waa Amalɛk tena aa kpɔa ɛ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ haa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la.
Gɛ baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ dɛ ba pu heyaa ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ he koɔh dɛ ɡwɛɡre, asɛ ba kpoo banɔ la baa ka mun ta la.
Dɛ Korowii baa kpɔ harɛ la tɛ heyaa dɛ kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛɛ he dɔma baa bar heyaa cheme nɔ be pera aa, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ kpoo Amalɛk tena la bwa, dɛ́ he ba ásɛ ba waa tonɛ.
He bɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ soh!”
Koo Kondikonloɡla Koma Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he kaa jo harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ kapɛrɛ kon la ta naa, hé bini bɛlbwa do kwaa waa para harɛ la ta konloɡla wɛɡrɛ del, dɛ́ kpɔ la bela Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa le tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ tomɔ la.
Hé kpɔ ka tɛ sɔfo waa so bela ɡɛ saŋ la dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Fini n cheɡɛ bonɔ dɛ bol dɛɛ baɡle Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ be kɛŋɔ, n tel harɛ waa ŋwɛɛ o waa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ ya naawa la ta.’ Sɔfo la ɛɛ lɛ wɛɡrɛ la ne kwaa laanee, dɛ́ kpɔ cheɡ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ saraha kon la sie.
Ásɛ name he che bela dɛ́ bol Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ sie ŋɔ, ‘N nabaa fa ɛ Aram te dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, nɛra tamaa kenii o kpɔ dɛ ka so Ijipt harɛ ta, kɛ ba baa warɛ kohona, dɛ ɛ harɛbir nɛra dɛ dɔ kpeɡri ɡe ja.
Ijipt tena la fiiɡi yaa dɛ ɡel ya ɛ tomkpeɡa dɛ na wahala.
Anee ya wi no Korowii ya naawa aa dɛ tomɔ la, asɛ o no ya be.
O na ɡɛ baa dɛ do yaa tomkpeɡa ta ne wahala yaa lɔ a ta.
Asɛ Korowii che o kpeɡri ne o bokpeɡa kohona waa dɔa la ta dɛ lɛ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta.
O ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla ne waa aa do ɔma kohona ɡe bela.
O kpɔ yaa ba harɛpare ondɛɛɡe nɔ ta dɛ ba kpɔ tɛ yaa.
Anomanta, n kpɔ harɛ Korowii aa tɛ mɛ koo konloɡla ba.’ Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ wɛɡrɛ la ne kwaa la cheɡ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ sie dɛ́ ɡuŋi o sie.
Ásɛ he ne Lewi dea tena ne hɔɔhra baa lɔ he baah la sie lɛ kondɛɛɡa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa tɛ he ne he dem tena la wa.
Bene atoro bɛlbwa he bɔne he koo kwaa bini bɔre fi, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛ Lewi dea tena ne hɔɔhra ne bilalbii dɛ luhaahna baa soɡe he baah la, ásɛ ba bwa dɔ di dɛ vaɡre.
He ɛ ɡɛ tonaa, he ŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ be ŋɔ, ‘Komɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛ ń bɔne a bini bɔre fi la, n kpɔ a bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛ Lewi dea tena ne hɔɔhra ne bilalbii ne luhaahna ɡɛ haa do mɛ la, bɛlbwa ta n be kae.
N ta he Mmara kone, n ta a waa soɛh.
Gɛ saŋ maa lɔ lwe ta dɛɛ wi la n ta bɔrbeŋkpoŋ kpɔe, ɡɛɛ maa wola ane kpɔe dɛ kah doŋa.
N ta ane bɛlbwa ɡe kpɔe ɛ wobɛlbwa tɛ lala.
N no Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ nɔ wa.
N Naa Korowii, che he sobɔr waa lɔ nyundua ba sie ne harɛ, dɛ́ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ he nɛra Israel tena, harɛ haa tɛ yaa ɡɛ haa ŋwɛɛ ntam, dɛ baɡɛ ya naawa nyoa harɛpare ondɛɛɡe nɔ.’ ” Korowii Mmarare ta teŋa Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Fini tɔpere nɔ, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ dɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa ta.
He teŋɛ a ta kɛrɛdɛ he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ne.
Fini he bolɔ ŋɔ, Korowiirii hɛɛ ba toma dɛ́ɛ valɛ o ŋwɛnɛre ta, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne waa waa do heyaa a ta dɛ́ɛ duuru.
Fini Korowii sɛoh kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba nɛraa heya he waa ɛɛ su o siwi, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa wubwa la, dɛ ŋɔ hé teŋɛ o waa waa do heyaa a ta, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡɔɔ heyaa dɛ́ ɡel he sɔn le ɡwaa harɛre nɛra waa ta ba bwa.
Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo he do ɡoroŋ tɛo, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.”
Korowii Mmarare baa chwera dawɛ bwepɛle ta Mosis ne Israel nomonome do Israel tena ŋɔ, “Hé teŋɛ ɡɛ Mmarare nɔ bwa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta.
Dɛ he le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heya tɛɛ la ta naa, hé paaɡe bwea dɛ maala, ásɛ dɛ chwerɛ Mmarare la dawɛ a ta.
Gɛ saŋ haa jo harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la ta la.
O ɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe, ɡɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ aa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.
Dɛ he ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la le aa, hé kpɔ bwea la ka paaɡe Ebal Bwejen ta ásɛ dɛ maala, ɡɛ maa do heyaa ŋɔ hé ɛ fini la.
Ásɛ he ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ bela.
He bɛ buni kpɔ ɛ o toma.
Bwea baa wola an sɛɛh nee chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la.
O taa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé fuh kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ.
Hé ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha bela, dɛ́ di dɛ́ lɛ sie Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ sie.
Hé chwerɛ Mmara la bini waa bwa dawɛ bwea la haa kpɔ paaɡe la ta á chɔ kɛrɛdɛ.” Taahna aa lɔ deŋnekpeɡ waa ɛɛ ta Mosis ne Lewi dea sɔfore la ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Israel tena, hé hel dɛ́ no!
Hé lii kɛŋɔ he ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nɛra.
Anomanta, hé do sie o be dɛ́ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne waa waa do heyaa mɛɛ do heyaa a ta fini nɔ ta.” Mosis do Israel tena la awola tenten ja ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la le tonaa, Simeon ne Lewi ne Juda, ne Isaaka ne Josef dɛ Bɛnjamen deene tena che Geresim Bwejen ta, dɛ́ soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ nɛra la bwa.
Ásɛ nyotaahna waa ɡe, Rubin ne Gad ne Aasa, ne Sebulon ne Dan dɛ Naftale deene tena bwa bola Ebal Bwejen la ta.
Ásɛ name Lewi dea tena kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ Israel tena la bwa be ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa sɛh komɛl chaa kɛɛ dɛ sɔh cheɡ voɡ dɛɛ tomɔ la, Kórowii taahno, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o kii.’ Ásɛ Israel tena la ɡe chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Ásɛ ba berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa wola o nya ne o mɛɛ duu la, Kórowii taahno.’ Ásɛ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Bá berɛ teŋɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa laa o ne o dɔŋ jwɛh bwe kpɔ la, Kórowii taahno.’ Ásɛ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Ásɛ ba berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa tɔ nyoŋe sie dɛ ɡel o nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ la, Kórowii taahno.’ Ásɛ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Bá berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa wola hɔɔhra kɛɛ bilalbii kɛɛ luhaahna waa bolɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta la, Kórowii taahno.’ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Bá berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ o mɛɛ haah chɔ la, Kórowii taahno, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a do kɛŋɔ waa wur o mɛɛ ken.’ Ásɛ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Bá berɛ teŋɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ ol te bɛlbwa chɔ kɛŋɔ haah ne baa la, Kórowii taahno.’ Ásɛ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Bá berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ o nimambie pɔrɔdɔ kɛɛ o mɛɛ bie kɛɛ o nya bie chɔ la, Kórowii taahno.’ Ásɛ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Bá berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ o helahaah chɔ la, Kórowii taahno.’ Ásɛ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Bá berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa sɔh dɛ́ kpo o dɔŋ la, Kórowii taahno.’ Ásɛ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Bá berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa daŋre suuɡa ne dɛ́ kpo nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ la, Kórowii taahno.’ Ásɛ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ Ásɛ ba berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa wola Korowii Mmarare ne o webaɡla ta teŋɛ la, Kórowii taahno.’ Israel tena la bwa chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Aamen!’ ”
Hɛɛra aa lɔ Korowii waa ta teŋa ta Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he do sie dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa maa dɛ bol he be fini nɔ ta kɛrɛdɛ naa, wɛɛ ɡeloo he sɔn le ɡwaa harɛre nɛra bwa.
Anomanta, hé duu Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, ásɛ a ɡɛ wedɛɛɡa nɔ bwa ɛ he kwa.
Wɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ he bwɛɛre ne he koonii.
Wɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ heya dɛ́ tɛ heyaa lol, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he kooni do wer, ásɛ he kondɛɛra kɛŋɔ nae ne peera ya.
Wɛɛ cha heyaa hé dɔ mea haa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa, ásɛ dɛ dɔa kohona.
Wɛɛ berɔɔ cha heyaa wobɛlbwa haa ɛ ta.
Korowii ɛɛ pɔ he dɔma nɛɛ tɛ heya.
Baa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ beŋkpoŋ taa dɛ́ ba yo heya, kɛ wɛɛ ɡeloo ba chwa peɡre.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ cha heyaa he toma taa, ásɛ he dɔndɔŋre su mea.
Wɛɛ cha heyaa harɛ waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ taa.
Dɛ he no Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa dɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa waa dɛ bol ta naa, wɛɛ kpɔ heyaa cheɡ kɛ o nɛra he do ɡoroŋ ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la.
A ba ɡɛ naa, harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii le heyaa kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba nɛraa heya, ásɛ dɛ ɔmɛ heya.
Wɛɛ tɛ heyaa biirii taeh, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa nae kohona, ásɛ dɛ berɛ ɡel he dɔ koo kondikwaa kohona, harɛ waa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heyaa la ta.
Wɛɛ pili nyundua dɛ́ nɛ bwaala saŋ waa wera ta, dɛ́ kpɔ cha he toma ásɛ he dɔ dɛ́ kpɔ ane cha harɛre ane ɡe, he te aa wola ba bee la ka kemɛ bwa.
Dɛ he teŋɛ o waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta naa, wɛɛ ɛ heyaa sitɔɔla harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.
Haa ba nɛɛ teŋɛ bwa, he wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii haa wola harɛɛ lɔ bwa.
He bɛ he te laa kpɔ le waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta fini nɔ bɛlbwa ta.
He bɛ a ta le dɛ́ ka teŋɛ voɡa nɛɛ dɛɛ toma.
Taahna aa lɔ deŋnekpeɡ waa ɛɛ ta Dɛ he ta Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa noɛ dɛ teŋɛ o waa ne o Mmarare ta naa, taahna maa bol a waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ ba he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡure he nyu ta.
Korowii ɛɛ berɔɔ taah he bwɛɛre ne he koonii.
Wɛɛ taah mea haa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa.
Korowii taahna ɛɛ lawɛ heyaa he bii dɔe bini, ne koo kwaa ne nae dɛ peera yae ta.
He toma ne wobɛlbwa haa ɛ la, Korowii taahna ɛɛ lawɛ heyaa.
Dɛ he vɛh Korowii aa, wɛɛ kpɔ wekpeɡaa ta he nɛ, he berɛ wili dɛɛ na waa wobɛlbwa haa dɛɛ ɛ ta, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa chɔɡ heyaa warane kwaraa.
Wɛɛ ba weela nee ba ta he nɛɛ harɛ haa dɛ la ka kpɔ so la ta ka tel kɛŋɔ he bwa aa hea le o ta.
Wɛɛ ba weela aa dɛ bu nee, kabul ne ɔɡra, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel hwel che bɔr wɔrɔbe, ásɛ he konduula chɔɡ.
A ɡɛ wekpeɡa nɔ bwa ɛɛ chole he nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ haa serewa.
Bwaala aa nɛɛ ba, ásɛ he harɛ hol dɛ́ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwe ken.
Korowii ne bwaala nɛɛ dɛ tɛ heyaa la, tutuɡ ne tɔɔ wɛɛ ba ɡela a le nyundua ba he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ nɛ la, ka tel kɛŋɔ he bwa aa serewa.
Ásɛ he dɔma berɛ pɔ he nɛ.
Hɛɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ beŋkpoŋii ŋɔ he ka yoo ba, kɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ berɔɔ nyin bɔr kpɔ dɛ́ chwa peɡre jo harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Ásɛ dɛ he baa serewe aa, jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola di he ola nomɛlbwa aa wola an doŋi ta.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ɔɡra ne ŋwɛra aa ba Ijipt tena nɛɛ la dɔŋa chole he nɛ, haa wola won chah.
Dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he liire chɔɡ, hé nyoŋe ásɛ he tea bini ɡe chɔɡ.
Hɛɛ dɛɛ laɡre bɔree webaŋa kɛŋɔ nyoŋa ken haa wola bɔree na.
Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ ɡe aa heyaa kɛrɛdɛɛ chiɡ bwa.
Baa lɔɔ heyaa dɛ́ pa he laala kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa ken, nomɛlbwa aa wola lee do dɛ́ cha heya.
Nɛn ɛɛ ɛ haah bwara waa, kɛ nomɛlee dɛ́ berɛ moo.
Hɛɛ ma deaa, ásɛ nomɛl laa lɛ he be haa wola o binii dɔ chɔ.
Hɛɛ du daa haa a nɔnaa dɔ di.
Baa lawɛ he nawee kpo he siwi ta haa wola o olii dɔ chwe, dɛ́ teɡɛ he keeɡore dɛɛ kaa he siwi na haa an dɔ kpa.
Dɛ́ berɛ lawɛ he peera tɛ he dɔma nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ lɛa tɛɛ.
Baa lawɛ he bibaala ne bihaahnaa he che dɛɛ nyiŋi bá yoɡ ba kɛŋɔ yoma, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa harɛfale ta, ásɛ he siwi swɛɛ hɛɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ he bii ɛɛ bao á ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Kwaa haa koh dɛ́ para la, harɛ bɛl tenaa dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba kpɔa kaa ka di, ásɛ a ka he ne tɔpere bɛlbwa wahala ne fiiɡa.
Hɔhɔrɔwa haa na la ɛɛ berɛɛ choɡlaa.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ŋwɛra aa dɛ we haa wola won chaah chole he nɛ, ɔɡra ɔɡre le he nyu ta ba ta he napaala ta.” Mosis berɔ ŋɔ, “Wɛɛ kpɔ he ne he kooroo kaa harɛ he ne he naawa aa wola bela jemɛ, ásɛ he kaa tomɛ voɡa, kwaa baa kpɔ daa ne bwea ɛa.
Harɛre Korowii aa lɔ heyaa peɡre a ta la, bela tena nyoa ɛɛ kpo he waa, hé berɛ wesoma tena baa di he loro.
Hɛɛ parɔɔ taeh kɛ kondikwaa tamaa kenii hɛɛ ba dɔe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tontombɛɛ dɛɛ ba a dii.
Hɛɛ parɛ daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen koonii, kɛ haa a nɔnaa dɔ chaa, haa a senee dɔ nyɔ dɛkalkɛŋɔ dudule ɛɛ chɔɡaa.
Hɛɛ dɔ ɔleve he harɛ taa ɡa, kɛ haa a noo dɔe ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a nɔna dɛ ba chaara lee.
Hɛɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahnaa kɛ baa he biirii ɛ, baa berɛ nɛra bane yomaa.
Daa ne kondikwaa haa du la, tontombɛ ɛɛ chɔɡ a bwaa.
Hɔɔhra baa so he bini la ɛɛ nao dɛɛ dɛɡ, dɛɛ di kpeɡri he nɛ, ásɛ he te na dɛɛ kaa mun ta.
Baa dɔ suuɡaa ásɛ he kaa kemɛ, kɛ he te aa anee dɔ dɛ kem ba bwa, ba den ɛ he nomonome dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ.
Wekpeɡa maa bol a waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ ba he nɛɛ, dɛ́ ka he nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ he bwa aa serewa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ta Korowii waa noɛ.
He ta o Mmarare waa do heyaa a ta la ta teŋɛ.
Anɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ deŋnetɛra Korowii aa ŋɔa wɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta he nɛɛ la danseɛ, dɛ́ chɔ tɛ he ne he naanar saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ta silɛɛ ne bambidɛɛɡe kpɔe tomɛ Korowii saŋ waa ɡela he do wer wobɛlbwa ta la.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he tomɛ he dɔma waa dɛ ba ɡela ba yo heya, ásɛ dɛ lawɛ heyaa yoma hé paŋɛ komɛlbwa.
Haa kwaa dɔ di, haa nee ɡee dɔ nyɔ.
Hɛɛ so mumɡbalee ba do heya hɛɛ tom ba.
Hɛɛ di somanjirii ka tel kɛŋɔ haa serewe.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra haa wola ba wobol no, le harɛ jaɡa dɛ́ ba he nɛɛ wɔrɔbe nɛɛ kɛŋɔ kee yon ba ta la.
Ba ɛ harɛre nɛra ba siwi aa kpeɡa, baa wola nomoa duu kɛɛ baa wola bechala sum na.
Baa di he kondikwaa bwaa ásɛ lɔr kpo heyaa he serewe.
Baa di he mea bwaa, dɛ́ nyɔ he sen dɛ́ kpɔ he ɔleve no, dɛ́ larawe he nae bii ne peera bii bwa, ka tel kɛŋɔ he kondɔɔh bwa aa le he nɔn ta.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma tɔ heyaa do bwɛjena waa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la bwa ta, ásɛ he lɔ harɛ.
Ásɛ danjwɛkpeɡa haa maa bara dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta la choɡli.
Tɔe baa tɔ heyaa do dɛ so bar heyaa hɛɛ na wahala la nomanta, lɔr ɛɛ kpo heyaa, ásɛ he chwe he ɡbaɡba bilola.
Ásɛ nɛn waa jemɛ waa dɛ do pwɛre aa tedomaa dɔ tɛ o ɡbaɡba nime, kɛɛ o dɔɔ kɛɛ o haah kɛɛ o bii baa kaa.
O ɡbaɡba bilole ol waa dɛ chwe la, waa o nime kɛɛ o dɔɔ kɛɛ o haah kɛɛ o bii baa kaa laanee tɛ.
Wahala ba dɔma la aa tɔ ba do baa na la nomanta.
Gɛɛ haah waa jemɛ waa dɛ do pwɛre, dɛ dɔ o te, waa wola valɛ saɡasaɡa la ɡe ɛɛ ba ɛɛ.
Hale haah la ɛɛ sɔɔh, dɛ́ kpɔ o bie ne o dɔm chwe a ɡɛ saŋ he dɔma aa kpɔ ɡɛ wekpeɡa nɔ pu heyaa la.
Dɛ he ta duure kpɔe tɛ Korowii kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ no waa bwa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔ, dɛ ɔmɛ o jirima ne o sɔnjen la aa, wɛɛ kpɔ weechɔɡa ne wekpeɡa haa wola won na a nyoa bwaa ba ta he ne he naanar nɛ.
Wɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ serewe weela haa naa Ijipt harɛ ta ka laanee ba ta he nɛɛ he chah kahonɛ.
Wɛɛ kpɔ weela bwa soo siwi ne wekpeɡa waa wola an chwerɛ do Mmara Tɔn nɔ binii ba ta he nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ haa serewe.
Hɛɛ warɔɔ kɛŋɔ weweela, kɛ dɛ he ta Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa ta teŋɛ aa, he bini tamaa kenii dɛ́ ba ka.
Gɛ Korowii tea aa too he waa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo he do wer, ásɛ dɛ berɛ ɡel he ya la, ɡɛ tentenee o tea ɛɛ ba toora he chɔɡa dɛ ta wa, dɛ́ chuɡri heyaa le harɛ haa dɛ la ka so o ta nɔ ta.
Wɛɛ lɔ heyaa peɡre harɛre ta bobɛlbwa kaa o jaɡa, ásɛ he kaa tomɛ kwaa baa kpɔ daa ne bwea ɛa.
Voɡa he ne he naawa aa wola an jemɛ bwa.
A ɡɛ harɛre nɛra la bini la, haa bosɔɔhnaa dɔ bobɛlbwa, haa onaa dɔ bobɛlbwa haa la.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he bambile chɔɡ, he sie che chiŋ he bwara yɔr.
Hɛɛ so seo nyoa saŋ te bɛlbwaa dɛɛ ɔmɛ webaŋa ne jwaana, dɛ́ so tɛ seo.
Ɔmee waa aa lɔ he bambile ta la ne waa haa dɛ ba nae nomanta, dɛ chɔɔbɔree yaa, hɛɛ ŋɔɔ, ‘Dɛ jɔmɔraa fe sɛ?’ Asɛ dɛ jɔmɔra ɡee yaa, he ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ chɔɔbɔree fe sɛ?’ Wɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ heyaa do stiimaere bini, dɛ́ kaa he ne Ijipt harɛ ta.
Kɛ onee fa ŋɔ he be ŋɔ haa belaa tire kpa la.
Ásɛ he yoɡ he te tɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ yoma ba vɛh he yawa.”
Korowii ne Israel tena fɔo fɔwa Moab harɛ ta Waa aa lɔ fɔo Korowii aa do Mosis ŋɔ o ne Israel tena fɔwɛ Moab harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ ja Sinai Bwejen kon la ta laanee teŋa nɔ.
Mosis yerɛ Israel tena la bwa dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé na waa Korowii aa kpɔa ɛ Ijipt kooro ne o nomonome, ne nɛra baa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta la bwa.
He na wekpeɡa ne waa aa chiɡa ne nyokpowaa Korowii aa ɛa kohona.
Kɛ kpoŋe ba le fini Korowii saa he liire, dɛ tɛ heyaa sibie aa wola kasinteŋ laanee na, ne deŋna aa wola kasinteŋ laanee no.
Korowii tɔ he sie bene fifraanaarɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta he laala haa doa ta kɛɛrɛ, ɡɛɛ he naŋɡaware ɡe aa wola chɔɡɛ.
He ta kondikwaa kɛɛ sen bɛlbwa dɔe nyɔ.
O ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ onee Korowii haa dɛ tomɛ la.
Haa ba bonɔ la, Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ baa yo yaa asɛ ya pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ lɛ ba harɛre dɛ bɔne tɛ Rubin ne Gad deene tena, dɛ Manasɛ dea la pera nɛra.
Anomanta, hé do sie fɔo nɔ ta ásɛ wobɛlbwa haa ɛ la chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ.” Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena la be ja ŋɔ, “Korowii siee he bwa che fini la, onee hɛɛ tomɛ.
He nomonome, ne nɛra baa dɛ tɔ he sie, ne baala, ne haahna, ne bechale dɛ hɔɔhra he ne baa soɡa ba che daa ne nee dɛɛ tɛ heyaa bwa, kɛŋɔ he bwa ɛɛ sɛh fɔo he ne Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa fɔwa nɔ taa dɛ́ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Ásɛ Korowii kpɔ heyaa kɛŋɔ o nɛra hɛɛ tomɔ ɡɛ waa baɡɛ he naawa Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb nyoa la.
He nɛra haa cheɡɛ bonɔ ɡbo waa laa Korowii ne he fɔwɛ fɔo o ŋwɛɛ ntam la.
O ɛo, aa ba le chɔe tɛ ya ne ya naanar ne banɔ la ba taa dɛ́ ba ba lola bwa.
He fa na ɡɛ ya fa aa soɡe Ijipt harɛ ta ne ɡɛ yaa vala kpɔ harɛre ta dɛ ba tel bonɔ.
He na voɡa aa ɛ kii kwaa ba kpɔ daa ne bwea ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ suuɡaswɛm ɛa.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ he nɛra haa cheɡɛ bonɔ fini nɔ, baa kɛɛ haah kɛɛ lolanar, kɛɛ dea bɛl tena aa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔ tomaa ɡel dɛ́ ka tomɛ harɛ bɛl voɡa.
Ásɛ a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ daa lur aa pama le dɛ nɔnɛ nɔnchɔɡa dɛ he diu waa he sewɛ la.
Haa dɛ no ntam nɔ bini waa nɔ, nomɛlbwa bɛ o liire ba ɛ kɛŋɔ o na som dɛɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ́ kpɔ o ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛ aa maɡre tɛo.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel Israel tena bwa dɔ deŋnetɛra.
Korowii aa kpɔ kɛ ɡɛ nɛn la.
Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela o baah di naate nɛɛ kohona, ásɛ taahna waa bol a waa tɔn nɔ bini la bwa dawɛ he nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa chɔɡo le harɛ nɔ ta kwara.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nyotaahna waa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔɔ dawɛ o nɛɛ he Israel deene bwa siwi ta, ɡɛ waa baɡle a waa Korowii Fɔo Tɔn la bini.
He bii ne he naanar baa ka ba ne hɔɔhra baa le bojaŋa ɛɛ na weela ne ɡɛ Korowii aa chɔɡ he harɛ nɔɔ.
He harɛ ɛɛ chɔɡoo komɛlbwa aa wola won le o ta.
Jebɔrɔwe ne yaree dɛɛ ba chura ta o ta.
Haa won du komɛlbwa, kpɔɡa kwaraa aa won le o ta.
Ásɛ he harɛ la do kɛŋɔ Sodom ne Gomoora ne Adma dɛ Seboiim, Korowii aa kpɔ bandia chɔɡa la.
Ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛ waa Korowii baah di kohona o ɛ harɛ nɔ ken nɔɔ?’ Waa la bwaa kɛŋɔ, ‘Korowii ba naawa aa dɛ tomɔ o le ba ne Ijipt harɛ ta ba la chɔɡ fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la.
Ba kaa tomɛ voɡa baa wola an tomɛ bwa, voɡa Korowii aa kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ an tomɛ la.
