Anee ɡela Korowii baah di kohona nɛra nɛ, asɛ dɛ kpɔ taahna waa baa chwera tɔn nɔ bini la ta ba nɛɛ la.
Bandia kohona nee Korowii ir ba le ba harɛ ta, dɛ ba taɡ ba ta hɔɔhra harɛ ta, ba ta do bela ba le fini la.’ Waane lole Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa wola yaa baɡlɛ dɛ kpɔ sɔh yaa, kɛ o pili o Mmara waa bini ásɛ ya ne ya naanar baa ka ba la ɛɛ teŋɛ a ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”
Korowii be bala som nae Mosis ŋɔ Israel tena be ja ŋɔ, “N tɛ heyaa webele anɛ, ɡɛ haa ɛ dɛ́ na som, ne waa aa ba taahna ne he nɛ.
Dɛ anɔ bwa baa chiɡ asɛ Korowii lɔ heyaa peɡre harɛre ta naa, belaa hɛɛ ba webele anɛ maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la liira.
Dɛ he ne he naanar berɔ ba Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ be, dɛ no o waa maa dɛ do heyaa fini nɔ ta he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ne naa, ate Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ heya, dɛ le he ne harɛre waa lɔ heyaa peɡre a ta la ta, ásɛ he ba pɛ, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he do wer.
Hale dɛ harɛ jaɡaa he peɡre ka do kwaraa naa, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ boa he nyoa, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne.
Ásɛ he berɛ ba kpɔ harɛ he naawa fa aa soɡe o ta wubwa la so ó ɛ he kon.
Wɛɛ berɔɔ ɡel he do wer dɛ́ warɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ he naawa fa aa doa la.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɛɛ tɛ he ne he naanar bambidɛɛɡee, ásɛ hɛɛ nyinu he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ne, ásɛ dɛ ta so harɛ la ta dɛɛ la.
Korowii ɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ taahna la bwaa ta he dɔma baa hah heyaa dɛɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa la nɛ, ásɛ he berɛ ba no Korowii waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare la ta ja.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he do wer wobɛlbwa haa ɛ ta, dɛ́ ɡel he dɔ bii ne kondɛɛra kohona, he koo kondikwaa ɡe ɛ kohona.
Korowii sie ɛɛ lɛ he nɛɛ ja, ásɛ dɛ ɡel he do wer wobɛlbwa ta, ɡɛ o fe aa liira tɛ he naawa la, dɛ he teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa aa lɔ o Mmarare Tɔn nɔ bini nɔ ta, dɛ kpɔ he bambile bwa ne he hweera bwa ba o be naa.
Korowii waa nɔ maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ aa kpeɡe kohona, a toole bojaŋ ɡe.
A toole nyundua ásɛ he bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ la nyundua dɛ́ ka kpɔ ba ya no dɛ́ teŋɛ a ta nɔ?’ Kɛɛ mpo baŋ ásɛ he bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ ka kpɔ ba tɛ yaa ásɛ ya teŋɛ a ta nɔ?’ Waa la pu heyaa tonɛ.
A lɔ he nyoo hɛɛ bola kɛɛ he bambile ta kwara, anomanta, hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Fini tɔpere nɔ, n kpɔ wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa, mkpa ne seo dɛɛ bil he sie, onɔ la bwa haa kpɔ.
Dɛ he teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa fini nɔ ta, dɛɛ nyinu dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa ta kɛrɛdɛ naa, he wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛ heya taeh.
Wɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ heya he dɔ mkpa harɛ haa dɛ la ka so o ta la ta.
Dɛ he ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh noe yaa, he liire ɛɛ charɔɔ he ka tomɛ voɡa.
N dɛ ŋɔ he be kɛŋɔ sewaa hɛɛ ba sewa.
Haa harɛ haa dɛ ba Jɔɔdan Moo ɡala dɛ́ ka so o ta nɔ taa biɡri.
Nyundua ne harɛ ɛ danseɛ fini kɛŋɔ n tɛ heyaa mkpa ne seo, dɛ som Korowii aa dɛ tɛ ne taahna.
Kɛ hé kpɔ a bini bɛl.
Hé kpɔ mkpa.
He nyin Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ, dɛ́ teŋɛ o waa ta kasinteŋ ne, dɛ́ kpɔ he te pɛlo, ásɛ he ne he naanar biɡri harɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ he naawa Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb la ta.”
Josua baa chiɡ Mosis naa ta Mosis teŋɔ dɛ bol waa baɡle Israel tena ja.
O ŋɔ, “Taraken n di bene lafa fifraanɛ, maa won tɔ he sie kpa.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, maa Jɔɔdan Moo baŋee le.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɡbabir ɛɛ tɔ siee, dɛ́ ka chɔɡ harɛre aa lɔ bela la nɛra, ásɛ mɔɔ he won dɔ bɔr dɛ́ ka so ba buɡ ta.
Korowii ŋɔ Josua ɡe tɔ he sie.
Gɛ Korowii aa chɔɡ Sihon ne Ɔɡ baa ɛ Amɔre koranar ne ba harɛ la, ɡɛ tentenee wɛɛ ba ɡɛ nɛra la ɡe ɛɛ.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he pɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ dɛ ɛɛ ba ɡɛ n fa aa ŋɔ he be la.
Hé che kiŋkiŋ, he bɛ ɔmɛ.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ ɡbaɡba ɛɛ che he mun taa.
Waa he jwɛɛh le, waa heyaa ta.” Ate, Mosis yerɛ Josua dɛ bol o be Israel tena la bwa siwi ta ŋɔ, “Che kiŋkiŋ, bɛ ɔmɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee dɛɛ ba nɛra nɔ sie tɔe, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ka so harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa la ta.
Korowii ɛɛ tɔ he siee dɛ́ ja he nɛ, anomanta, bɛ ɡel he bwara hwah, bɛ ɔmɛ.” Korowii Mmara la kura Ate, Mosis chwerɛ Korowii Mmara la dɛ kpɔ do Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore la ne Israel nomonome la nɔn ta.
Sɔfore laanee dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka o ne Israel tena fɔo baa fɔwa ba chwerɛ dɛ kpɔ do o bini la ta.
Mosis do ba ŋɔ, “Bene anuanɛ bɛlbwa ɡɛ he yon kpɔ nɛra baa di kema dɛɛ kɛ ba la, dɛ a telo hɛɛ ba he tɔpejen haa dɛ yerɔ Kukure Tɔpejen la dii yaa, hé kuro a le baŋ kohona a ɡɛ tɔpere la ta, ɡɛ saŋ Israel tena nɔ bwa aa ba cheme bela Korowii aa lea tɛɛ ba ŋɔ baa tomɔ la.
Gel harɛ la ta baala, ne haahna, ne bechale dɛ hɔɔhra baa lɔ he bwɛɛre la ta bwa cheme dɛ́ no, dɛ́ hweli Korowii duura, dɛɛ teŋɛ o webaɡla ta kɛrɛdɛ.
A ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ taa he naanar baa wola Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ waa noɛ bwa la che dɛ́ no.
Ásɛ dɛ jemɛ waa la ta teŋa harɛ baa dɛ ba Jɔɔdan Moo ɡala dɛ́ ka so o ta la ta.” Korowii bol Israel tena deŋnekpeɡ wa Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Tɔpere waa kaa he sewɛ la aa kanɛ kpa, anomanta, yerɛ Josua ba n Dea Cheremibɔr nɔ bini, ásɛ n kpɔ n waa bwa do o nɔn ta.” Anee Mosis ne Josua la Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela.
Asɛ Korowii che bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua bini, dɛ ba ba be dɛ ba che doonyoa bela.
Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Aa biɡri bɛlbwa ásɛ he chɔ he banɔn ta.
A ba ɡɛ naa, nɛra haa tɔ ba sie nɔ ɛɛ chɔɡ fɔo n ne baa fɔwa laanee.
Baa le n habɔɔ, dɛ́ ka tomɛ harɛ baa dɛ ba o ta joe nɔ voɡaa.
A ba ɡɛ naa, n baah ɛɛ di ba nɛɛ, ásɛ n laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ ba chɔɡ.
Wechɔɡa ne wahala ɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ taeh, ásɛ ba sɛh ŋɔ, ‘Waa nɔ aa pu yaa nɔ, Korowii ya fa aa dɛ tomɔ la laa nɔn kpɔ ya nɛ.’ Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ, waa baa ɛa a ɛ wechɔɡa kɛŋɔ baa bera kaa tomɛ voɡa la wa.” Korowii ŋɔ Mosis ne Josua be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba heyaa yel baɡla, he chwerɛ bil, dɛ́ kpɔ baɡle Israel tena, ásɛ a ɛ waa dɛ́ chɔ tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ ŋɔ, Mɛɛ kpɔ baa kaa harɛpare ondɛɛɡe maa baɡɛ ba naawa o waa la ta.
Baa dɔ kondikwaa bɛlbwa baa dɛ nyinii dɛ́ di ba bwara sɔɔh ba.
Kɛ ane a bwa, baa ka le n habɔɔ, dɛ́ ka tomɛ voɡa.
Baa vɛɛh mɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ fɔo n ne baa fɔwa la.
Ásɛ wekpeɡa ba ba nɛɛ taeh, kɛ ba taa teŋɔɔ dɛ́ ɡo yel la, ásɛ a ɛ waa dɛ́ chɔ tɛɛ ba.
Taraken kwara, n jemɛ liire baa dɛ lii mɔɔ mɛɛ ba ba ne harɛ maa baɡ ba nyoa la ta kaala.” Awola tɔpere la, Mosis chwerɛ yel la dɛ baɡle Israel tena la.
Josua mɛɛ sɔne Nun.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Josua, che kiŋkiŋ, bɛ ɔmɛ.
Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel he tɔ Israel tena sie, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa harɛ maa baɡ ba nyoa la ta.” Mosis chwerɛ Korowii Mmarare la do tɔn ta tonɛ, dɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ o ta wobɛlbwa ɡelɛ.
Waa tona la, o ŋɔ Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ta be ŋɔ, “Hé lɛ tɔn nɔ, Korowii Mmarare lɔ o ta.
Hé kpɔ bil O Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka nɔ jwɛh, ásɛ o do bela dɛɛ lii ba ɡɛ baa so kɛrɛdɛ.” Mosis ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “N jemɛ he lwɛmkpeɡ ne he habɔɔ bera dɛ́ kpo Korowii wa.
Hale n ne haa lole n ta sewɛ mɔɔ nɔ, he fa berɛ habɔɔ kpo Korowii.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛo ɡwaa ɡɛ n seo habɔɔ.
Anomanta, he yerɛ he deene la nomonome, ne banɔ la baa chɔ he nyoa ba cheme n sie, ásɛ n bol waa nɔ bwa tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ yerɛ nyundua ne harɛ a chɔ dɛ́ ɛ danseɛ.
Dɛ ŋɔ, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ n seo habɔɔ la, baa ɛ nɛnchɔɡaa dɛ́ vɛh waa maa bola baɡ ba bwa dɛ chwerɛ bil la.
Aa ba la sie la, baa na wekpeɡaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa ɛ waa Korowii aa kia, ásɛ o baah di.” Mosis yel la Ate, Mosis baɡle yel la bini waa tɛ Israel tena bwa baa chema la ba no.
Waa aa lɔ Mosis yel la bini laanee nɔ.
“Nyundua ne harɛ hé no n be, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa maa dɛ ba bola nɔ.
N webaɡla ɛɛ ba he bee kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ wiri, n wobol do kɛŋɔ chɔɔlen mɛn, ne bwaala wira waa ɡela kpɔɡa ɛɛ le la.
Korowii sɔnee mɛɛ ba yera, ásɛ o nɛra kpɔ duure tɛo o kan waa doa wa!
O do kɛŋɔ Bwetal dɛɛ lɛ yaa, o wobɛlbwa toɡrɔ dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ.
Waa nyosone teŋe, waa aa maɡra dɛ toɡree wɛɛ ɛ.
He waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, he ta chɛɛ kɛ he ɛ o nɛra wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ne nyosonteŋna ɡbo.
He kpɔ sihiih kpo he te.
Korowii hɛɛ ɛ ken aa, nɛra haa ɡɛna haa wola liire dɔe.
He mɛɛ, onee ta heya dɛ ɡel he ɛ harɛbir nɛra.
Hé lii fafa la, nɛra baa lole ɡɛ saŋ la.
Hé bɔɔ he nɛmbena ba baɡle waa aa chiɡa.
Hé bɔɔ ba bá baɡle saŋ la waa he be.
Nemenɛ Korowiirii tɛ harɛre nɛra ba harɛre.
Onee nyiŋa dɛ jemɛ bela Israel tena aa so, dɛ tɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nyundua torome wɛɛ daah ba.
Dɛkalkɛ Jekɔb naanar te, Korowii ɡbaɡba lee ba dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ o nɛra.
Korowii na ba baa ɡaaɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, harɛ waa chɔ pɛɛ olchɔɡa sii ɡbo tɔ bela peujena ɛɛ ta bela.
O tɔ ba ɡbemɡbe dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba ken.
Korowii dɛ nyiŋ ba kɛŋɔ kee yon dɛɛ baɡle o bii ira, dɛ́ ir kpɔ kena tɔ a nɛɛ a bɛ ba le la, ɡɛɛ o ɛ Israel tena.
Korowii ɡboo tɔ o nɛra sie, voɡ bɛlbwa ta o nɛɛ jae.
O ɡelɔ ba won kpɔ bwea dor dɛ kaa, dɛ di kwaa baa dua harɛ la ta.
Asɛ dɛ berɛ dɔ tooh bwea la baah di, dɛ ɡel ba ɔleve daa baa dua bwea harɛ la ta do wer.
Ba dɔ nae ne boohna elnee kohona, ba peera ne boohna ne nae do wer, dɛ dɔ Basan harɛ pebala aa wera tɛɛ ba la ane.
Ba dɔ mendɛɛɡa ne sen baa dɛ nyin dɛɛ nyɔ.
Israel tena, he kpeɡo dɛ je, kɛ dɛ berɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena.
He bare, dɛ do tɔɡre he bwara do wer.
He berɛ habɔɔ kpo Korowii waa ta heya, dɛ vɛh he Lɛɛ waa do kɛ Bwetal dɛɛ tɛ heyaa mkpa la.
Ba dɛ tomɛ harɛre ane voɡa aa ɛ kii kwa, a ɡel Korowii baah di banɛ, wechɔɡa haa ɛa la ɡelɔ o baah di.
He kpoo kwaa tɛ daabii yaa wola an na, voɡfala he naawa aa wola an jemɛ, voɡa he Israel tena aa wola sie a be doe ka.
He soh Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o do kɛŋɔ Bwetal dɛɛ lɛ heyaa kohona, naate waa tɛ heyaa mkpa la wa.
Korowii na ɡɛ waa nɔ o baah di, o laa sie kpɔ he bibaala ne bihaahna nɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ, maa ban chaŋe.
Mɛɛ nao ɡɛ aa chiɡ heya, lwɛmkpeɡ tena haa wola kasinteŋ bol.
Ba ɡelɔ mɛɛ meeh voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe hɛɛ toma la, n bwaawee ir ba voɡpuune nɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ bɔweela nɛra baa wola ban kure dɛɛ ja n nɛra nɛɛ la nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he bwaawee ir harɛ o nɛra aa ɡɛna nɛ.
N bwaawee ɛɛ iruu kɛŋɔ ninlao, dɛ́ fuh komɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta.
Aa fuuh tel harɛ bini ne bwejena mune bwa.
Mɛɛ kpɔ wahala kohonaa ta he nɛ, mɛɛ kpɔ n hɛma bwaa ta heya.
Lɔr ɛɛ kpo heyaa kohona he ɡwaŋre dɛ serewe, weechɔɡaa dɛɛ ba heyaa kpoora.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo kpɔɡ bini ola lawɛ heya, domkpuli choɡe heya.
Laa ɛɛ chole he nɛɛ he serewe fɔɡbaahna, ɔmee kohona chole he deremi.
Toli ne bonɔɔna serewe, hale bechale ba taa dɛ ɔr ne banjeni kwara aa kae ba.
N fe ŋɔ mɛɛ lɔ he bwaa peɡre, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ he waa lii kpa.
Dɛ berɛ lii kɛŋɔ he dɔma bɛ ba te ba maŋkura dɛ́ ŋɔ banee pɔ n nɛra nɛ, kɛ dɛ menee wona ɛ ɡɛ.’ Israel tena ɛ nɛra haa wola liire dɔe, he ta wejema dɔe kwaraa.
Dɛ he ɛ wejerema dɛɛ no waa mun aa, he fe jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa ɡɛ waa nɔ ba he nɛ.
Dɛ Korowii waa ɛ he Bwetal dɛɛ lɛ heyaa la laa le he habɔɔ aa, ɛrɛɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ fe ɛɛ ba wona doŋi nɛra kaɡboŋ, kɛɛ nɛra banɛ won doŋi nɛra kaɡboŋa fiɔ?
He dɔma jemɔ kɛŋɔ he voɡa ta voɡa ɛɛ, a ta doe kɛŋɔ Korowii waa do kɛ Bwetal Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ nɔ.
Ya dɔma la wechɔɡa do kɛŋɔ Sodom ne Gomoora tena wechɔɡa ken.
Ba do kɛŋɔ daa nɔna baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen, dɛ do kpeli dɛɛ kpo ɡe.
Ba do kɛŋɔ sen dɛɛ kpo kɛŋɔ harɛkonchɔɡe aa dɛ kpo la.
Korowii dɛ lii anɔ la bwa dɔma la aa ɛa, dɛɛ kpa saŋ waa wera ta, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛr ba deŋne.
Korowii ɛɛ tɔ a peɡee, wɛɛ bɔ ba a kemee.
Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba ba chole, ba chɔɡa tɔpere dɛ tel.
Korowii ɛɛ lɛ o nɛraa ɡɛ saŋ ba bokpeɡa aa ba tonɛ.
Wɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɔɔ, ɡɛ saŋ baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó cha ba.
Korowii ɛɛ bɔɔ o nɛraa ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa voɡjena haa kpɔ he hwɛɡa dawɛ a nɛɛ la dɔɔ?’ Dɛ ŋɔ, ‘He fa kpoo kwaa aa do noo tɛa, dɛ tɛa sen a nyɔ.
Hé ɡel a ba cha heyaa taraken nɔ, a chwa ba lɛ heya.’ Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Men, n ɡbosoo Korowii, voɡ bɛlbwa toole.
Menee dɛɛ chɔɡ, dɛɛ tɛ mkpa, menee dɛɛ do nɛn bol, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ chah naate.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ.
Maa dɔa ɛ Korowii maa wola sewɛ nɔ, n ir nɔn dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ sar n tokobi waa dɛ nyɛɡle laanee dɛ́ ba pa bole.
Dɛ́ bɔ n dɔma kem, dɛ́ tɛr banɔ la baa hah mɛ deŋne.
N hɛma ɛɛ jo ba chal taa, ásɛ n tokobii ɡe kpoo banɔ la baa dɛ tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ.
Maa nomɛlbwa waa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ ɡel, banɔ la baa do ba bola, ne banɔ la baa laɡ ba bwa ɛɛ sewɔɔ.’ Harɛre nɛra, hé pu Korowii nɛra hɛɡre.
Korowii dɛ tɛr nɛra baa dɛ kpoo o nɛra deŋne.
O dɛ bɔ ba dɔma kem dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛ kpɔ o nɛra wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ ba.” Mosis ne Nun bie Josua bwaa pɛa ba, o baɡle yel nɔ bini waa bwa tɛ Israel tena la.
Mosis aa baɡle waa aa lɔ Korowii yel la bini tɛ nɛra la tonɛ la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta fini nɔ taa.
Hé kpɔ do he bii ásɛ ba ɡee teŋɛ Korowii webaɡla la ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Gɛ waa nɔ ta wepuu ɛɛ, a ɛ waa haa che a ta dɛ́ dɔ he nyu.
Hé teŋɛ a ta, aa ɡeloo he dɔ mkpajaŋ harɛ waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ hɛɛ la dɛ ka so o ta la ta.” Mosis aa dɛ ba sewa Nɛbo Bwejen ta wa A wola tenten la, Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “La Abarim Bwejen waa lɔ Moab harɛ ta o ne Jeriko sie ɡba dɔŋa la ta.
Teeh kaa Nɛbo Bwejen doa dɛ́ nyiŋi harɛ la waa chɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ bela la, Keenan harɛɛ, onee mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ Israel tena la.
Bwejen la taa hɛɛ ba sewa dɛ́ kaa he naawa be, kɛŋɔ he dɔɔ Arɔn aa sewɛ Hɔr Bwejen ta dɛ kaa o naawa be la.
A munii kɛŋɔ he bwa ta duure kpɔe tɛ mɛ Israel tena la bwa sie, ɡɛ saŋ he fa aa lɔ Mɛreba nee waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bobɛl baa yerɔ Sin la.
Hɛɛ na harɛ maa dɛ ba kpɔe tɛ Israel tena la ɡɛ waa chɔ bojaŋee, kɛ haa belaa tire.”
Mosis swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Israel deene Gɛ Mosis waa ɛ Korowii nɛn aa swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Israel tena mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ laanee nɔ.
O ŋɔ, “Korowii le Sinai Bwejen ta ba ya be, o ɛɡɔ le Edom kɛŋɔ wee ken, dɛ́ chaah o nɛra nɛɛ Paran bwe ta.
Nyundua toroma kaɡboŋa fi ja o nɛ, ninlao do o diɡ bɔr.
Kpelaa, Korowii dɛ nyin o nɛra, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ banɔ la baa lɔ o be pera nɛ.
Ba bwa ɛɛ ɡuŋi he siee dɛɛ no he wa.
Ya dɛ teŋɛ Mmara Mosis aa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ta, o ɛ ya harɛ nɔ kpaŋjoɡo yaa dɔa.
Korowii ɛ Israel tena Kooro ɡɛ saŋ Israel deene ne ba nomonome fa aa chema la.
Mosis bol Rubin dea tena waa ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɡel Rubin dea tena bɛ he, a lole kɛŋɔ baa kanɛ te.’ O bol Juda dea tena ɡe waa ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, no ba wii baa wia dɛɛ nyin chae.
Gel ba ne deene aa kaa la dɔ nyopɛo.
Yo tɛɛ ba, ásɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta.’ O bol Lewi dea tena ɡe waa ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, he cheɡɛ he nɛndɛɛɡa Lewi dea tena nɛ Urim ne Tumim ta, dɛ pili ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin baɡ ba, dɛ daah ba na Maasa, asɛ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ ba ɛ kasinteŋ tena Mɛreba nee ta.
Banee lawɛ he waa bini kpoŋe ɡwaa ba nyare ne mɛɛnanar, ne ba dɔɔranar kɛɛ biirere.
Ba teŋɛ he waa ta dɛɛ di kasinteŋ he fɔo he ne baa fɔwa la ta.
Báa dɛɛ baɡle he nɛra he Mmara ta teŋa taa, dɛ́ kpoo jam kwaa dɛɛ tɛɛ he saraha kon la ta.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel ba dea tena do kpeɡri.
Gel ba wobɛlbwa baa dɛ ɛ su he siwi.
Chɔɡ ba dɔma dɛ bɛ ɡel ba ir kpa bwa.’ Bɛnjamen dea tena ɡe, o bol ba waa ŋɔ, ‘Dea nɔ tenaa Korowii ɛɛ nyin, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ.
O dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ do ba baah ta.’ O bol Josef dea tena ɡe waa ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, ɡel bwaala nɛ ba harɛ ta o do wer.
Ásɛ nee bule dɛɛ le harɛ bini ó do sɔne.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel wee lɔ ásɛ ba harɛ daa nɔna do wer.
Saŋ bɛlbwa ɡel daa nɔndɛɛɡa do ba harɛ ta.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel ba dɔ kwaa baa di le bwea aa lole le saŋ la ba le fini la lɔɡre.
Tɛɛ ba harɛ kondɛɛɡa aa lɔ o ta.
N Naa Korowii, he fa bol waa le dawii aa dɛ lawɛ nii Sinai Bwejen ta, asɛ wedɛɛɡa su he bwa.
Gel Josef dea tena na som, dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee dɔɔranar la bwa sitɔɔ.
O kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nabal ken, o nyeɡlare do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini nao.
O nyeɡlare laanee Manasɛ dea nɛra kaɡboŋ bokpeɡa, Efrem dea nɛra ɡe kaɡboŋa fi bokpeɡa.
A nee wɛɛ chuɡe harɛre nɛra, dɛ taɡ ba kaa tel harɛ jaɡa.’ Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, ɡel Sebulon dea tena do wer bona baa ɡaaɡa dɛɛ di ta, ásɛ Isaaka dea tena ɡe kondɔɔh do kan bela baa soɡa.
Baa yerɛ hɔɔhraa dɛɛ ba bwejen baa ɛ saraha aa wera dɛɛ tɛɛ la ta.
Baa dɔ kondɔɔh le mpo ne o nyoa hɛŋle taa.’ Dɛ ŋɔ Gad dea tena be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɡel he dɔ harɛ kohona.
Anomanta, hé kpɛɛro.
He dea nɔ do kɛŋɔ nyujente waa dɛ toɡri ola nɔɔra ne nyuune.
Ba kpɔ harɛ la bodɛɛɡe, nomombɔree ba kpɔ.
Ba teŋɛ Korowii waa ne o Mmarare ta, ɡɛ saŋ Israel nomonome fa aa chema la.’ Dan dea ɡe la, o ŋɔ, ‘Dan dea tena do kɛŋɔ nyujente bie.
O jaoh le Basan harɛ.’ Naftale dea ɡe, o ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɡelɔ he na som taeh.
He kpɔ harɛ waa chɔa le Galilia Moo weekaŋle harɛbɔr.’ O ŋɔ Aasa dea tena ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɡel he waa su siwi he bala bwa bini, Korowii ɡel he harɛ do wer tɛ ɔleve daa.
Gel ba kpɔ bune kaɡre ba bwɛɛre doonyoo a do kpeɡri.
Bɛ ɡel wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ba ba nɛ.’ O ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ do kɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ.
O lɔ nyundua kohona dɛ che o kpeɡri ta bol dɛɛ tɛ heya.
O cheɡɛ baama ta dɛ baa cha heya.
Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ lɛ heya, o nɔn waa do kpeɡri laanee o kpɔ dɛɛ cha heya.
Wɛɛ doŋi he dɔmaa le he sie dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé chɔɡ ba!” Anomanta, Jekɔb naanar, bosɔɔhna taa hɛɛ ba soɡa.
Harɛ mea ne sen aa lɔ o ta asɛ mɛn ɛɛ ta dɛɛ pwe harɛ la.
Israel tena, he na som to.
Nomɛlbwa ta heyaa tele, he ɛ nɛra Korowii aa lɛ heya.
O ɡbaɡbaa he ɡbemɡbe ne he tokobi.
Onee dɛ́ lɛ heya dɛ́ ɡel he yo le.
He dɔma ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi he siee, dɛɛ soŋe ŋɔ he sune ba nɛ, ásɛ he tiɡri ba nɛ.’ ”
Mosis seo wa Mosis berɔ le Moab deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta, dɛ ka teeh Nɛbo Bwejen dɛ kaa Pesɡa Bwejen doa.
Jeriko lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ wee cholibɔr.
Asɛ Korowii baɡlo harɛ waa kpɔ Israel tena dɛɛ ba o ta la bwa.
O nao le Gelead dɛ kpoŋe ka le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr harɛ waa kpɔa tɛ Dan dea tena la, ne Naftale ne Efrem ne Manasɛ dɛ Juda deene harɛ, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo la ta wee cholibɔr.
Korowii berɔ baɡlo harɛ la tenten waa chɔa kaa Nɛɡɛv weekaŋle harɛbɔr Jeriko Fɛlembɔjen, dɛ ka le bwɛɛ Soar harɛ ta.
Dɛ ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Harɛ nɔɔ n kpɔ baɡɛ Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb nyoa, ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba naanar la.
N ɡelɔ hɛɛ nao te, kɛ maa ɡel he tel o ta.” Anomanta, Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis sewɛ Moab harɛ ta bela ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa waa ɡel o la harɛ la ta la.
Korowii huɡo fɛlembɔjen bɛl waa lɔ Moab harɛ ta, bwɛɛ Bɛt Peɔ sideŋ.
Kɛ le ɡɛ saŋ dɛ ba le fini nomɛlbwa aa bela yiso o ŋwam aa chɔa jemɛ.
Dɛ Mosis dɔ bene lafa fifraanɛ mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ, kɛ dɛ o bwara ta kpeɡri ɡɛ o fa aa doa, asɛ dɛɛ na ɡe kɛrɛdɛ.
Israel tena la ɛ o lwe tɔpera fifraatoro Moab harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta.
Nun bibaa Josua ɡe dɔ wejema kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Mosis leo ŋɔ ó chiɡ o naa ta.
Dɛ Israel tena la dɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ Josua la ta dɛɛ no o be.
Mosis habɔɔ la, Korowii keame bɛlbwa ta berɛ le Israel kɛŋɔ on kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o ne Korowii dɛ bol wa.
Korowii ta o keame bɛlbwa ɡe nɛɛ cheɡɛ dɛ ɛ nyokpowaa kɛŋɔ anɔ la waa ɡela Mosis ɛa Ijipt kooro ne o nɛra baa chɔ o harɛ nyoa, ne Ijipt harɛ la bwa ta la.
Gɛɛ Korowii keame bɛlbwa aa wola wone ɛ wejena ne waa aa do ɔma kɛŋɔ Mosis aa ɛa Israel tena la siwi ta la.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Josua Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Mosis aa sewa, asɛ Josua ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ kpɔ Israel tena ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo le, dɛ kaa bane Keenan harɛ ta wa.
Keenan harɛ ɛ harɛdɛɛɡe Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ o nɛra Israel tena ŋɔ bá ka so o ta, kɛ dɛ a chɛ kɛ bá tɔ sie doŋi nɛra baa soɡe harɛ la ta mɔɔ.
Ba pa mun kɛrɛdɛ ken le Jeriko, kɛ ba ta wone doŋi nɛra la le Keenan harɛ la bwa ta, asɛ a ba waa ne ba tɛɛ ba.
Kɛ ane a bwa, Josua bɔne harɛ la dɛ kpɔ bɔre fi dɛ anɛ tɛ deene baa le Israel tena nabaa Jekɔb luɡe ta.
Dɛ Jekɔb sɔn bɛl ɡee Israel.
O tɛ Lewi dea tena bwɛɛre ba so a ta ja deene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ la ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ banee cheɡɛ nɛra la naa ta, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii o Dea.
Mɔɔ Josua sewɛ la, o do ba ŋɔ baa teŋɛ Korowii waa la ta ba bambile bwa ne.
Korowii baɡle Josua waa waa ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis seo habɔɔ la, Korowii ŋɔ Nun bibaa Josua, o fa aa dɛ cha Mosis la be ŋɔ, “Josua, n bonɔɔ Mosis sewɔ, anomanta, he ne Israel tena kpɔ he te dɛ́ ir ɡale kaa Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ harɛ maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ la ta.
Gɛ n fa aa baɡɛ Mosis nyoa laanee kɛŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ harɛ la bobɛlbwa haa kpɔ o ta laanee tɛ heya.
He harɛ la nyoa ɛɛ le weekaŋle harɛbɔr pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la taa, dɛ́ kaa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr Lɛbanɔn bwejena ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Yufretis Moo ta wee leebɔr, dɛ́ kaa Hiti tena harɛ ta bwa, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa wee cholibɔr Mɛdetereenea Mpo la ta.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won pɔ he nɛɛ wobɛlbwa ta he soɡa bini.
Gɛ maa ja Mosis nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba he ɡe nɛɛ jae maa wola habɔɔ le bwa.
Kɛ che kiŋkiŋ, dɔ bambile, henee dɛɛ ba Israel tena sie tɔe ba ka so harɛ maa kpɔa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa la ta.
Che kiŋkiŋ, dɔ bambile kohona.
Gel he sie chɔ harɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare la bwa n bonɔɔ Mosis aa kpɔa tɛɛ la ta.
Bɛ sie laa kpɔ a ta dɛ́ dɔ kɛrɛdɛ bela bwa haa kaa.
Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel waa aa lɔ mmarare tɔn la bini paŋɛ saŋ te bɛlbwa.
Dɛɛ kuro chɔɔ ne jwaana dɛ́ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa aa lɔ o bini taa.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ heya, he won ka so harɛ la ta.
Bɛ soh kɛŋɔ maa ŋɔ he be ŋɔ he che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ dɔ bambile la!
Bɛ ɔmɛ, bɛ ɡel he bwara ɡe yɔr.
Men, Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, n teŋɛ he nɛɛ bobɛlbwa haa kaa.” Ate, Josua ŋɔ ba bini nomonome be ŋɔ, “Hé valɛ Israel tena be bela bwa baa soɡa, dɛ́ ɡel ba no kɛŋɔ kerele ɡbosoo yaa le Jɔɔdan Moo baŋee, dɛ́ ka lɛ harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa ŋɔ he kpɔ la.
Anomanta, he nyin kondikwaa cheɡ.” Josua ŋɔ Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena bane be ŋɔ, “He bɛ soh kɛŋɔ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis fa aa ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa ŋɔa wɛɛ kpɔ harɛ waa chɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔree tɛ heyaa he so o ta la.’ Anomanta, hé ɡel he haahna ne bii ne he kondɛɛra te ka harɛ Mosis aa bɔna tɛ heyaa Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr la ta bela, ásɛ he laa tena kpɔ ba te dɛ́ tɔ sie ɛɡɛ Moo la le he bala Israel tena la nɛ, dɛ́ ka cha ba, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii aa ɡela ba bwara sɔɔh ba ɡɛ waa ɛa tɛ heyaa la, ka tel kɛŋɔ ba ɡe aa kaa dɔ harɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa tɛɛ baa la.
Mɔɔ he berɛ kaa he ɡbaɡba harɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa o do Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr la ta.” Anee ba ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Yaa ɛ wobɛlbwa haa bol ya be nɔɔ, dɛ́ la bobɛlbwa ɡe haa tomɛ yaa.
Yaa no he nyoa wobolee ɡɛ ya fa aa dɛ no Mosis waa la.
Ya dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ ó ja he nɛ ɡɛ o fa aa ja Mosis nɛɛ la.
Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ waa wola he waa taa teŋɛ la, kpoe yaa ba o kpoe.
He te che kiŋkiŋ, dɔ bambile!”
Josua tomɛ nɛra ba sɔh ka nyiŋi Keenan harɛ Dɛ Israel tena la bwa cheme bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sitim dɛ so bela.
Asɛ Josua sɔh dɛ le ba bini baala banɛ dɛ tom ba ŋɔ, “Hé ka sɔh nyiŋi Keenan harɛ dɛ́ na ɡɛ waa doa, bwɛjen Jeriko te fanfa.” Asɛ ba sɔh dɛ la bela, dɛ ka choɡ hanjwamane Rahab.
Dɛ Jeriko kooro noɔ kɛŋɔ Israel tena bane sɔɔh ba jo bwɛɛ la ta awola jwaana la ne, dɛ́ ba sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la.
Kooro la tomɛ nɛn haah la be kɛŋɔ ó ka ŋɔ o be Israel baala baa baa choɡ o dem la, ó lee ba tɛɛ ba.
Ba balɔ dɛ́ ba sɔh nyiŋi ɡɛ harɛ la bwa aa doa.
Dɛ Rahab te felo dɛ kpɔ baala banɛ la sɔh, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, kɛ maa bela baa lea jemɛ.
Wee aa dɛ ba joe baa ba bwɛjen doonyojen la tɔe la, ba leɔ kaa, n ta bela baa chaɡa nae.
Amɔ aa do ɡɛ nɔ hé ti ba warane, he ken ɛɛ puu baa.” Dɛ o kpɔ ba sɔh saldoa yabi daa lɔɡa.
Ate, kooro nɛra la le bwɛɛ la ta dɛ chiɡ leebɔɔ baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ le Jɔɔdan Moo la, dɛ ti ba kaa ɡaaɡe ba bɔr.
Ba den laa bwɛjen la doonyoa laa tɔ.
Mɔɔ Israel baala la ka chɔ jwaana la, Rahab teehnɔ la ba be dea la doa, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ ya harɛ nɔ tɛ heya, a ɡelɔ ɔmee kohona lawɛ yaa he wa.
Nomɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta no he wa aa, dɛ o bwara yɔrɔ.
Ya no ɡɛ Korowii aa ɡela Mposwɛm teŋe, asɛ he won le o baŋ ɡɛ saŋ haa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, dɛ berɛ no kpoe haa kpoo Amɔre tena koranar banɛ Sihon ne Ɔɡ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr dɛ chɔɡ ba harɛ bwa kwaraa la.
Yaa no ɡɛ la, ya jum jaoh ya bambile chɔɡ ɡɛ haa ɛa la wa.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee nyundua ne harɛ bwa kooro.
Rahab berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ dɛ ba dɛ ba dɛ́ ba yo Jeriko tena aa, baa na o ne o lolanar sumii ɡɛ waa na ba sum la.
Dɛ ŋɔ ba ɛ we-ɛɛle bɛl ásɛ o na dɛ́ yarada kɛŋɔ baa baɡɔ nyoa kɛŋɔ baa lɛ o nya ne o mɛɛ ne o nimambii dɛ ba biirere nyuu ba bɛ ban kpoo.” Anee nɛra la baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ, “Dɛ ya ta waa yaa bola la ta teŋaa, Korowii kpoo yaa.
Dɛ he ta yaa leɛ tɛ tenaa, ya ɡee nyiŋuu dɛ bɛ ɡel bá kpo he ne he nɛn bɛlbwa awola Korowii aa kpɔ he harɛ nɔ do ya nɔn ta la.” Dɛ dea Rahab aa lɔ o ta la, ba ma bwɛjen la danjwɛɛ choŋi o ta.
Anomanta, Rahab cheɡɛ dea la tokoro ta dɛ vɔwɛ ɡboɡbii ba ta harɛ, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Israel baala la be ŋɔ báa won che o ta dɛ́ tu bwɛjen la dahara.
Haah la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ka sɔh deŋɡarere nɔ ta, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ ti heyaa la bɛ heyaa na.
Hé sɔh bela tɔpera atoro ka tel saŋ baa berɛ ba, ásɛ he kaa bela haa lea ba.” Nɛra la aa dɛ kaa la ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Yaa nyoa yaa baɡɛ laanee soh.
Waa yaa dɛ nyin he ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, awola ya laa tena la aa ba jo harɛ nɔ ta la, kpɔ ŋwɛnswɛm nɔ vɔwɛ he tokoro nɔ ta.
Ásɛ dɛ yerɛ he nya ne hɛɛh, ne he nimambii ne he nimanar dɛ he lolanar bwa, ba jo he dem bonɔ.
Ba bini bɛlbwa le he dem bonɔ kaa laa, dɛ o ɡbabirii ɛ o nyu dɛ nyin o seo, dɛ ya be laa a le.
Kɛ dɛ bɛlbwa ta lɔ dem bela asɛ waane ɛo waa, dɛ ya bee a le.” Nɛra la berɔ ŋɔ Rahab be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he le yaa tɛ tenaa, amɔ te fɔo haa ɡela ya ne he fɔwɛ la aa won ɛ toma kpa.” Ate, haah la sɛh dɛ ta ba ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa.
Baa kaala tonɛ la, o kpɔ ŋwɛnswɛm la vɔwɛ tokoro la ta.
Israel baala la aa kaala la, ba kaa sɔh deŋɡarere la ta tɔpera atoro ɡɛ haah la aa baɡla la.
Kooro nɛra la ɡe kaa ɡaaɡe ba bɔr harɛ la ta bwa ba ta ban nae, dɛ laa berɛ ba Jeriko.
Ate, nɛra baa sɔah dɛ ka nyiŋi harɛ la le deŋɡarere la ta, dɛ ka ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo le, dɛ kaa bela baa lea.
Baa laŋa la, ba kaa bol Josua be waa baa kaa na bwa.
Ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya nao kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ harɛ la bwa do ya nɔn ta.
Bela tena bwa jum jah ya wa.”
Israel tena Jɔɔdan Moo ɡala Ate, tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Josua ne Israel tena la le Sitim dɛ ka so Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa tama mɔɔ dɛ ɛɡɛ le o baŋ.
Tɔpera atoro habɔɔ la, nomonome la valɛ ba be bela baa soɡa la, dɛ ŋɔ, “He baa na kɛŋɔ Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore la cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka dɛɛ kaa laa, bɛlbwa ir dɛ́ teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Haa ŋwɛnɛ la ta jemɛ, banee dɛɛ ba he sie tɔe, dɛ́ baɡle heyaa bela haa kpɔ.
He bɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la dɛɛ bɛne, hé ɡel dɛ ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa atoro ta he ne o baah ta.” Josua ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé laa he te kpɔ doŋa bɛlbwa ta dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ, kere Korowii ɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa tɛ heya.” Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Josua ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la che, dɛ́ tɔ sie nɛra la teŋɛ.” Asɛ ba kpɔ che dɛ tɔ ba sie.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Finii mɛɛ ba mun pae dɛ́ ɡel Israel tena bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee ba sitɔɔ, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ n ja he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ n fa aa ja Mosis nɛɛ la.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ sɔfore baa cheɡɛ N Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la be ŋɔ, ‘Haa dɛɛ jo Jɔɔdan Moo nee la ta la, hé den che bela, dɛ bɛ sie kaa.’ ” Anee Josua yerɛ Israel tena la ŋɔ, “Hé ba, dɛ́ ba no waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ bol.
Anɔ taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la ja he nɛ, dɛ́ doŋi nɛra baa soɡe harɛ waa kpɔa tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé ka so o ta he sie, baa yer ba Keenan ne Hiti ne Hivi ne Pɛrɛs ne Girɡasi ne Amɔre dɛ Jebus tena la.
Hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ sɔfore baa cheɡɛ Korowii waa dɔ harɛ nɔ bwa, O Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la aa tɔ he sie dɛɛ ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la.
Name, hé le nɛmbeŋkpoŋa le ya Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la bɛlbwa ta.
Sɔfore baa cheɡɛ Korowii waa dɔ harɛ nɔ bwa Daka la jo moo la ta naa, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ó ɡel pala dɛ́ teŋe.” Belaa a ba kɛ Israel tena la chuɡro le ba sobɔr bela dɛ ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la, asɛ sɔfore la kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la che dɛ tɔ ba sie.
Dɛ koo kwaa koma saŋee, asɛ moo la su halalaa ken.
Sɔfore baa cheɡɛ Daka la aa kaa tel nee la nyoa la, ba napaala ne o leɡa dɛ o teŋo, o nyunduabɔr la tenɛ chɔ kaa kɛŋɔ baa teŋo bio ken.
O chɔɔ kaa bojaŋ bwɛjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Adam, o bɛne Saretan.
O harɛbɔr pera waa kaa su Yar Mpo ta la hweehrɔ kwaraa, asɛ ba den kpɔ bela ɛɡɛ le, bela ne bwɛjen Jeriko sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa.
Sɔfore baa cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la valɛ harɛpɛɛ ta, Jɔɔdan Moo nenabɔɔ la bini dɛ ka jaɡɛ che, asɛ nɛra la bwa sekwaraa kpɔ harɛpɛɛ la ta ba bɛɡ ba dɛ le o baŋ.
Bwea baa paaɡa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii wa Israel tena la bwa sekwaraa aa ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo le la, Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Le baala beŋkpoŋa le Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la bɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ ŋɔ bá la bela tenten sɔfore la aa cheɡɛ Korowii Fɔo Daka la nenabɔɔ la baah ta, ásɛ bɛlbwa ka kpɔ bwe beŋkpoŋ ka bil bela baa dɛ ba chɔe jwaana nɔ ne.” Ate, Josua yerɛ baala waa lee ba le Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ bɛlbwa ta la, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ “Hé berɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Moo nenabɔɔ la baah ta bela sɔfore la aa cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, ásɛ bɛlbwa ka kpɔ bwe beŋkpoŋ dawɛ o vam á che tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la.
Bwea nɔɔ dɛ́ lii heya waa Korowii aa ɛa tɛ heya.
Dɛ kerekere he bii ba dɛ bɔɔ ɡɛ bwea la aa cheɡa tɛ aa, ásɛ he ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘A cheɡɔ dɛ tɛ saŋ bɛl baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Jɔɔdan Moo dɛ ba bonɔ la, moo la teŋo ba valɛ o baah harɛpɛɛ ta dɛ le.’ Anomanta, bwea nɔɔ ya Israel tena kpɔ dɛɛ lii ɡɛ waa nɔ á chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Israel tena ɛ ɡɛ Josua aa do ba ŋɔ ba ɛ la.
Dea bɛlbwa kpɔ bwe beŋkpoŋ a ɛ bwea fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ le Jɔɔdan Moo nenabɔɔ la baah ta, dɛ che tɛ Israel deene la bɛlbwa, asɛ ba kpɔ ka bil bela baa soɡa.
Josua ɡe kaa kpɔ bwefala fi dɛ anɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la nenabɔɔ baah ta, dɛ kpɔ paaɡe bela sɔfore baa cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la fa aa cheɡa la.
A ta cheɡɛ bela ba le fini.
Sɔfore baa cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la cheɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo nenabɔɔ la baah ta ka tel kɛŋɔ, waa Korowii aa do Josua ŋɔ ó ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ ba ɛ la aa tona, ɡɛ tenten Mosis aa bol Josua be la.
Dɛ nɛra la ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la le kaa warane.
Nɛra la bwa aa lea tonɛ la, sɔfore la ɡe kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le ba ka tɔ ba sie ba bwa siwi ta.
Belaa Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea la pera tena bane baa tela ne yoi kpɔ ba te, dɛ ka tɔ Israel tena la bwa sie, ɡɛ Mosis aa ŋɔ ba be la.
Nɛra dɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ baa tela ne yoi kpɔ ba te, dɛ ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la le harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa dɛ bɛne bwɛjen Jeriko ta.
Dɛ Korowii ja ba nɛ.
Awola Korowii ɛ waa Israel tena bwa siwi ta ba na kɛ Josua ɛ nɛnjen.
Ba kpɔ duure tɛo o soɡa bini bwa, ɡɛ tenten baa duu Mosis la.
Sɔfore la taa cheɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo nenabɔɔ baah ta la, Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Gel sɔfore la baa cheɡɛ Korowii Fɔo Daka la le moo la baah ta ba baŋ.” Josua ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “Hé le baŋ.” Ate, sɔfore baa cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le ba che baŋ.
Baa lea ba che moo la nyoa la, buɡ la ta, dɛ nee o fa aa teŋa la berɔ su dɛɛ palɛ kɛ wubwa la.
Korobie waa tɔ sie, o tɔpera fi taa ba le Jɔɔdan Moo la, dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene Gelɡal.
O lɔ bwɛjen Jeriko harɛ jwɛh wee leebɔr.
Gelɡal belaa Josua ɡel ba kpɔ bwea fi dɛ anɛ la baa paa le Jɔɔdan Moo nenabɔɔ baah ta la tɛo o kpɔ paaɡe.
Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Israel tena la be ja ŋɔ, “Kerekere dɛ he bii ba dɛ bɔɔ heya bwea nɔ mun aa, hé ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Harɛpɛɛ taa Israel tena kpɔ ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo le.’ Hé berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɡelɔ Jɔɔdan Moo teŋe ya won ɛɡɛ le o baŋ ɡɛ waa ɡela Mposwɛm teŋe tɛ ya naawa la.
Korowii ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ o kpeɡri kan, ásɛ hɛɛ duu Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.’ ”
Pena teŋa Gelɡal Amɔre tena baa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la wee cholibɔr koranar, ne Keenan tena baa lɔ Mɛdetereenea Mpo nyoa koranar aa noa kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡelɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la teŋe, asɛ Israel tena won ɛɡɛ le o baŋ la, ba jum jaoh, ba hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ kɛŋɔ ba ne Israel tena aa won yo.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Gel bá kpɔ kwɛrboɔ loɡɛ keri, dɛ́ teŋni Israel tena baa wola ba pena teŋne la pena.” Asɛ Josua ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.
O kpɔ kwɛrboɔ loɡɛ keri dɛ teŋni ba pena, bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Penteŋ Deŋɡare ta.
Waa aa bala Josua ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ laanee nɔ.
Gɛ saŋ Israel tena aa ira le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, ba bini baala baa tela ne laa yoi la kɛrɛdɛ bwa serewe ŋwɛnɛ ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Banɔ la baa lol ba Ijipt harɛ ta la te, ba teŋni ba pena, kɛ banɔ la baa lol ba ŋwɛnɛ ta la, ba ta ba pena teŋni.
Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ta la, ba ɡaaɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bene fifraanaarɛ, ka tel kɛ baala baa tela ne laa yoi bwa aa serewa.
Ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ ba ta Korowii waa la ta teŋɛ.
Dɛ Korowii ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa wola o waa ta teŋɛ la aa harɛpare ondɛɛɡe o kpɔ baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa la taa tel.
A ɡɛ baala baa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ nɔ, dɛ ba ta ba bii pena teŋni, ba habɔɔ biirii Josua teŋni pena.
Josua ɡelɔ ba teŋni nɛra la bwa pena, asɛ dɛ ɡel ba so ba buɡ ta bela ka tel kɛŋɔ ŋwɛra la aa tona.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “N laa yoma haa ɛa Ijipt harɛ ta la sihiih kpɔ he sie ta fini.” Anomanta, ba dɛ yerɛ bela Gelɡal dɛ ba le fini.
Israel tena kaa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so Gelɡal, o bɛne bwɛjen Jeriko harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta.
Dɛ ba dɔ Galekaa Tɔpejen dɛɛ ba dii korobie la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta jɔmɔra.
Baa di ba tɔpejen la asɛ tɔɔ per awola tenten la, a taa ba di Keenan harɛ ta kondikwa ane soo siwi.
Ba di paanoo baa wola iisi a ta doe ne mea baa hala.
Baa dena di Keenan harɛ kondikwaa la habɔɔ, maana ta leere ba dɔ ane di kpa.
Harɛ la ta kondikwaa ɡboo baa ka.
Awola bɛl, Josua ne Israel tena dɛ bɛne bwɛjen Jeriko, asɛ o na baa bɛl o kpoŋe kere dɛ che o sie.
Josua la o be dɛ ka pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ya bini bɛlee hen kɛɛ ya dɔmee hen ɔ?” Asɛ baa la chaŋe ŋɔ, “N toole a bɛlbwa bini, Korowiirii lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ba tɔ o laa tena sie, asɛ n ba nɔ.” Ate, Josua ɡuŋu dɛ duuru ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ he bonɔɔ ɛ tɛɛ nɔ?” Anee Korowii laa sitɔɔ la ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Laa he naŋɡawa foo, bela haa cheɡa nɔ do ɡoroŋ.” Ate, Josua laa o naŋɡawa la foo.
Bwɛjen Jeriko paɡra Bwɛjen Jeriko tena koh Israel tena waa dɛ laa ɡbeni baa kpɔ a ta dɛɛ jo bwɛɛ la ta kaɡre tɔ ba nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa aa won le bwɛɛ la ta kɛɛ dɛ́ jo bela.
Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “N kpɔ bwɛjen Jeriko ne o kooro ne o laa tena bwa do he nɔn ta.
He ne he laa tena la valɛ dɛ́ bar bwɛjen la bwa cheme kera beŋkpoŋ, tɔpere bɛlbwa ɡɛ tɔpera anumɛl.
Gel sɔfore banuanɛ kpɔ pebal nyeɡle bɛle tɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la, he ne he laa tena valɛ bar bwɛjen la kera anuanɛ, ásɛ sɔfore la ɛɛ hoh bɛle la.
Bɛlhoohla la ɛ dɛ́ hoh ba bɛle la kohona, ásɛ nɛra la bwa ɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre kohona.
Danjwɛɛ baa mao bar bwɛɛ la ɛɛ choɡluu, ásɛ nomɛlbwa den jo bwɛjen la ta.” Asɛ Nun bibaa Josua yerɛ sɔfore la dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la che, ásɛ he bini banuanɛ ɡe kpɔ bɛle tɔ o sie.” Asɛ o berɛ ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé pa sie dɛɛ kaa!
Hé valɛ dɛɛ bar bwɛjen la, laa tena la kpɔ ba dɔmkwa dɛ́ tɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie.” Josua aa bol waa la baɡle nɛra la tonɛ la, sɔfore banuanɛ bɛlbwa waa kpoŋe bɛla la den ka tɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie dɛɛ hoh, asɛ banɔ la ɡe baa cheɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Laa tena la kpɔ ba dɔmkwaa tɔ sɔfore baa dɛ hoh bɛle la sie, asɛ laa tena la baa lɔ habɔɔ la ɡe teŋɛ Daka la nɛ, dɛ bɛlhoohla la ɡe teŋɔ dɛ hoh dɛɛ do.
Dɛ Josua kah ba ŋɔ, “He bɛ lɔŋɔre do, hé hel, hɛ́ɛ berɛ wobɛlbwa bola ka tel kɛŋɔ tɔpere maa ŋɔ he be ŋɔ hé do lɔŋɔre mɔɔ he do!” Gɛɛ Josua do sɔfore la, asɛ ba che Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la dɛ bar bwɛjen la cheme kera beŋkpoŋ, dɛ berɛ laa berɛ kaa bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la dɛ ka chɔ.
Tɔ aa pera la, Josua felo ir, asɛ sɔfore la kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la che.
Sɔfore banuanɛ baa kpoŋe bɛle anuanɛ la kaa tɔ Daka la sie, dɛ valɛ dɛɛ hoh ba bɛle la.
Laa tena baa tɔ ba sie, asɛ laa tena baa lɔ habɔɔ la teŋɛ, asɛ bɛle la sii ɛɛ le.
Tɔpenɛɛte ta la, ba berɔ valɛ bar bwɛjen la kera beŋkpoŋ, dɛ berɛ kaa bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la.
Ba valɔ baro ɡɛ tɔpera anumɛl.
Tɔpenuanɛ te la ta la, ba iro valɛ bar bwɛjen la ɡɛ ba yon dɛɛ ɛ la.
Awola ɡboo ba valɛ bar bwɛjen la kera anuanɛ.
Baa bara kera anuanɛ ta la, sɔfore la hoh ba bɛle la, asɛ Josua ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé do lɔŋɔre!
Korowii kpɔ bwɛjen nɔ do he nɔn ta!
Hé paɡre bwɛjen la kwaraa, ásɛ dɛ le komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta cheɡ tɛ Korowii.
Hanjwamane Rahab ne o nɛra baa lɔ o dem te, he bɛ ban wobɛlbwa ɛ. Onee lɛ nɛra yaa tom ba ŋɔ bá ba sɔh nyiŋi bwɛjen nɔ la sɔh.
Hé laa nɔn kpɔ kwaa haa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii la ta, ásɛ a bɛ heyaa bichɔɡe ba lolɛ.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, chɔɡa tentenee he nyin baa dawɛ he Israel tena nɛɛ bela haa baŋre he tɛnte deene la.
Kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ne ayaawa dɛ bune ɛa la te, a do ɡoroŋ kohona tɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ ba tɛo o Dea bela baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.” Bɛle la aa sia la, nɛra la do lɔŋɔre kohona asɛ danjwɛɛ baa maa bar bwɛjen la den kuuɡi kwaraa.
Ate, laa tena la den jo bwɛjen la ta dɛ lɛ bwɛɛ la bwa dɔɔh.
Ba kpoo baala ne haahna, ne bechale ne nomonome, ne nae ne peera dɛ keeɡore aa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta, dɛ lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii.
Josua ŋɔ baala banɛ baa laŋa dɛ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la be ŋɔ, “Hé la hanjwamane la dem, dɛ́ ka kpɔ o ne o nɛra bwa baa ja o nɛɛ le, ɡɛ haa baɡɔ nyoa la.” Anee ɡɛ baala la baa sɔah ka nyiŋi harɛ la la hanjwamane la dem, dɛ kpɔ o ne o nya ne o mɛɛ, ne o dɔɔranar ne o nimanar, ne o nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ bwa, dɛ kpɔ ba ka so bela Israel tena aa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la dahara.
Asɛ ba fuh bwɛjen la ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta.
Kɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ne kwaa baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa la ne bune kwaa la te, ba paa ka cheɡ Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.
Hanjwamane Rahab ne o lolanar dɛ o dem tena te, Josua lɛ ba nyu, dɛkalkɛ o lɛ o nɛra baa kaa sɔh nyiŋi bwɛjen Jeriko la sɔh.
O naanar ta lɔ Israel harɛ ta ba le fini.
Bwɛjen Jeriko paɡra bini la, Josua ŋwɛɛ ntam kɛŋɔ Korowii taah nomɛlbwa waa berɛ ba vɔrɔwe Jeriko ja.
“Nomɛlbwa waa ba pe bwɛjen la mun la, o bibanloɡle sewɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa ba cheɡ o doonyoo la, o bibambechala sewɛ.” Gɛɛ Korowii ja Josua nɛ dɛ ɡel o sɔn le harɛ la ta bwa.
Akan wechɔɡa waa ɛa Israel tena la ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ kpɔ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii waa ŋɔa ba bɛ kpɔ la ta.
Baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Akan, o mɛɛ sɔne Kaami.
Kaami ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Simri, asɛ o nabaa sɔne Sɛra, o le Juda dea.
A ɡɛ Akan nɔɔ kpɔ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii waa ŋɔa ba bɛ kpɔ la, asɛ a che a ta Korowii baah di ba nɛɛ kohona la.
Josua tomɛ nɛra bane le bwɛjen Jeriko ŋɔ bá la bwɛjen Ai ta.
O bɛne bwɛɛ Bɛt Avɛn, dɛ do Bɛtel wee leebɔr.
O ŋɔ baala la be ŋɔ, “Hé la dɛ́ ka sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la.” Ate, ba la dɛ ka sɔh nyiŋi bela.
Baa bera ba la, ba ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Ya bwa laa chɛ kɛŋɔ yá ka pu Ai tena yo, baa kanɛ.
Gel nɛra kaɡboŋa banɛ kɛɛ batoro ka yoo ba, ya bwa bɛ koh ta pɛɛ.” Ate, baala dɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa batoro la bela, kɛ Ai tena kpeɡri ɡwaa banɛ, asɛ ba laa berɛ.
Ai tena doŋi Israel tena la le ba bwɛɛ doonyojen ta, dɛ kaa ba ne bobɛl baa dɛ pɛɡre bwea baa yerɔ Sebarem, dɛ kpoo ba nɛra fifraatoro dɛ banumɛl ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa tu deŋɡare la ta.
Israel tena baa ka dem la aa no waa la, ba bwara yɔrɔ taeh, ba sɔɔh kɛŋɔ noo ken.
Ate, Josua kɛɛ laala waa doa la, dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, dɛ chɔ bela ka tel jɔmɔra.
Israel nomonome la ɡe ɛ ɡɛ, ba ne Josua bwa ɛ teera do ba nyuune ta a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba loo kuu.
Asɛ Josua ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, ɛrɛɛ he le ya ne Jɔɔdan Moo nɔ baŋ bonɔ dɛ ba do Amɔre tena nɔn ta bá kpoo yaa nɔɔ?
Ya fe ta soɡe Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ le fe bɔ.
Korowii, n ta ɡɛ bwa maa bol nae kpa.
Israel tena dɔma teŋɛ ba nɛ ba laa berɛ.
Keenan tena ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa ɛɛ no waa nɔɔ, dɛ́ ba bar yaa, dɛ́ kpoo yaa, dɛ́ ɡel ya sɔn nyoɡre harɛ nɔ ta.
Ɛrɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ he sɔn kan ɔ?” Anee Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Ir che!
Ɛrɛɛ he kpɔ sie pi harɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa, ba chɔɡ n ne ba fɔo yaa fɔwa n do ba ŋɔ baa teŋɛ a ta la ta.
Ba kpɔ kwaa maa ŋɔa ba le cheɡ tɛ mɛ la ane.
Ba ŋwɛa dɛ teŋe nyosone, dɛ paa ja ba laala ta.
Anɔ waa Israel tena aa wola won che ba dɔma sie la.
A chɛ kɛ bá sewɛ ba wechɔɡa la wa.
Maa he nɛɛ ja kpa, nemenɛ he chɔɡ kwaa maa ŋɔa he le cheɡ tɛ mɛ, a do he be la bwa.
Ir la nɛra la be, dɛ́ ka sɔ ba doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ ta.
Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá sɔ ba doŋa ta dɛɛ kpa kere.
Ŋɔ men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la ŋɔ, kwaa maa ŋɔa he le cheɡ mɛ la lɔ he be.
Haa won che he dɔma sie dɛ he ta a ne leɛ.
Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ chɔɔbɔr, denaa bɛlbwa tena ba n sie, dea bɛlbwa men Korowii aa lawɛ la, bá le ba n sie, dɛ́ le denaa ta ba n sie lolanar ta, ásɛ lolanar bɛlbwa nɛra maa lawɛ la, bá ba n sie beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa.
Naate maa lawɔ ŋɔ kwaa maa ŋɔa ba le cheɡ mɛ la lɔ o be la chɛ kɛŋɔ, bá fuh o ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa.
O chɔɡ n fɔo n ne baa fɔwa la, dɛ ɛ sihihwa Israel harɛ ta.” Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Josua ɡelɔ Israel tena la le denaa bɛlbwa tena ba Korowii sie, asɛ a ba kɛŋɔ Juda dea tenaa o lawɛ.
Ate, Juda dea tena le dɛ ba che sie, asɛ Korowii lawɛ Sɛra tena.
Asɛ o ɡel Sɛra tena ba o sie lolanar ta, asɛ o lawɛ Simri dem tena.
Asɛ Josua ɡel Simri ne o lolanar le ba che beŋkpoŋa, asɛ Korowii lawɛ Akan, o mɛɛ sɔne Kaami.
Kaami mɛɛ sɔne Simri, Simri ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Sɛra, dɛ le Juda dea.
Anee Josua ŋɔ Akan be ŋɔ, “N bie, ɔmɛ Korowii, kpɔ duure tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la, dɛ́ bol he wechɔɡa haa ɛa la, dɛ bɛ nyosone teŋe.
Bol wobɛlbwa haa ɛa, bɛ kpɔ sɔɔh mɛ.” Asɛ Akan ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, n ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la nɛ.
Waa maa ɛa laanee nɔ.
Laa la ta la, n na batakaaredɛɛɡe bɛl Babelɔn tena aa sɔɔh, suuɡapoŋa lafraanɛ ne suuɡaswɛm bwe o tɔɡre aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanue del, asɛ n pɛla lawa kohona n kpɔ.
N kpɔ suuɡaswɛm la ne batakaare la ka huɡe harɛ n tɛnte dea bini, asɛ suuɡapoŋa la do mun ta.” Ate, Josua tomɛ toroma Akan tɛnte dea bini, ba kpɔ chwae la dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ o kpɔ kwaa la sɔh o tɛnte dea la bini, asɛ suuɡapoŋa la do a mun ta.
Ba kpɔ kwaa la le tɛnte dea la bini, dɛ kpɔ ba tɛ Josua ne Israel tena la bwa, dɛ kpɔa bil Korowii sie.
Ate, Josua ne Israel tena la lawɛ Akan, dɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa la ne batakaare la ne suuɡaswɛm bwe, ne o bii bwa ne o nae ne keeɡore ne peera, dɛ o tɛnte Dea ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa bwa, dɛ kpɔ ba ne a bwa kaa Akɔ Fɛlembɔjen bini.
Asɛ Josua bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he tɛ yaa waa ken?
Fini he ne Korowii ɛɛ dɔɔ taeh.” Israel tena bwa foɡro bwea dɛ kpoo, dɛ foɡre ba kabora, dɛ pɛ fuh ba bwa.
Ba pa bwea dawɛ Akan nɛɛ a daŋɛ kohona, a ta chɔ le ba le fini.
Asɛ Korowii baah waa dia kohona la sɔɔh.
A waa baa yerɛ bela Akɔ Fɛlembɔjen saŋ la bwa ba le fini la.
Bwɛjen Ai chɔɡa wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr.
Kpɔ he laa tena bwa dɛ́ ka pu Ai tena yo.
N kpɔ ba kooro ne o nɛra ne bwɛjen la dɛ harɛ la bwa do he nɔn ta.
Gɛ haa chɔɡ Jeriko ne o kooro la, he ka ɛ Ai ɡe ɡɛ.
Kɛ laala ne kondɛɛra te, he bɛ an chɔɡ, hɛɛ won kpɔ a te.
He ka sɔh bwɛjen la dahara dɛ́ chɔ kpaa ba.” Ate, Josua ne o nɛra kpɔ ba te dɛ kaa Ai dɛ ka yoo ba.
Josua kpɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraatoro baa jemɛ laa yoi le Israel tena la bini dɛ tom ba jwaana, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no kɛrɛdɛ, hé ka sɔh chɔ bwɛjen la dahare dɛɛ kpa.
He bɛ ɡel he ne o baah do jaŋne kohona.
Bɛlbwa ɡel o sie chɔ harɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
N ne banɔ la baa ja n nɛɛ la bwa ɛɛ kpɔ sie pa bwɛjen la taa dɛɛ kaa ba be.
Bwɛɛ la baala leɔ dɛɛ ba dɛ ba pu yaa yo, ɡɛ ba fa aa ɛa la aa, yaa berɔɔ dɛɛ chwa.
Baa chwao ti yaa ka tel kɛŋɔ yaa kpɔ ba le bwɛjen la ta.
Baa ŋɔɔ, ‘Israel tena la berɔ chwa dɛɛ kaa ɡɛ ba fa aa ɛa la.’ Dɛ ya baa chwa le ba be tonaa, he banɔ la haa kaa sɔh chɔ dɛɛ kpa la ɛ warane, dɛ́ ka lɛ bwɛjen la dɔɔh.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ kpɔ bwɛjen laanee do he nɔn ta.
Hé baa lɛ bwɛjen la tonaa, hé kpaa nii do o ta.
Hé no waa maa do heyaa a ta nɔ kɛrɛdɛ.” Ate, Josua tɛ laa tena la ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa bela baa sɔah chɔ dɛɛ kpa ɡɛ waa ŋɔa la.
Ai wee cholibɔr dɛɛ kaa Bɛtel baah taa ba ka sɔh.
Josua ɡe ne laa tena baa kaa la kaa chɔ bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la.
Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Josua yerɛ o laa tena la cheme, o ne Israel nomonome tɔ ba sie ba valɛ kaa bwɛjen Ai ta.
O ne laa tena bwa baa ja o nɛɛ la valɔ dɛ ka tel bwɛjen la doonyojen ta, dɛ baŋre ba tɛnte deene bwɛjen Ai weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, asɛ fɛlembɔjen la chɔ bane bwɛjen Ai baah ta.
Dɛ Josua kpɔ laa tena la dɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa banue ka sɔh ba chɔ dɛɛ kpa Bɛtel ne bwɛjen Ai baah ta, o wee cholibɔr.
Josua kpɔ laa tena la, bɛlbwa ka che o chebɔr, banɔ la baa wara la lɔ bwɛjen la weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ba bini tama la ɡe sɔh dɛ chɔ bwɛjen la wee cholibɔr.
Josua kaa chɔ fɛlembɔjen la bini awola jwaana la ne.
Bwɛjen Ai kooro aa na Josua laa tena la, kooro ne o bwɛɛ tena la bwa kpɔ ba te dɛ le warane chɔmbibii la ne, dɛ le ka pu Israel tena la yo bobɛl waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo Fɛlembɔjen la nyundua.
Dɛ o ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ Israel tena sɔɔh chɔ dɛɛ kpa o bwɛɛ la dahare.
Josua ne o nɛra saahnɔ berɛ habɔɔ dɛɛ chwa dɛ ɡel Ai tena ɛɛ doŋ ba, ba chwao dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Dɛ bwɛjen Ai nomonome yerɛ baala bwa baa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta ŋɔ bá ba, dɛ́ ba ti Josua ne o nɛra, asɛ ba chwa ti ba.
Ba le bwɛɛ la ta kwaraa.
Baa bɛlbwa ta bwɛjen Ai ne Bɛtel kae baa wola leɛ dɛ ti Israel tena.
Ba ɡel bwɛjen la o chɔ pɛɛ dɛ ti ba kaa.
Baa bɛlbwa toole o ta dɛ́ yo kpa.
Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Tɛr he lampea la pa bwɛjen Ai ta, he nɔn taa mɛɛ ba bwɛɛ la kpɔe dɛ́ do.” Asɛ Josua tɛr o lampea pa Ai.
Josua aa ɛ ɡɛ la, laa tena baa sɔah dɛɛ kpa la leɔ warane dɛ ka jo bwɛjen la ta dɛ lɛ o bwa dɔɔh, dɛ kpaa nii do o ta.
Bwɛjen Ai tena la kaa ke nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ chuu tɛrɔ le ba bwɛjen la ta dɛɛ kaa nyundua, dɛ lee ta kpaɔ.
Ba ta bɔr dɔe ba chwa kpɔ.
Dɛ Israel tena baa chwaa kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la kaa laa berɛ, dɛ kpɔ sie pa Ai tena baa dɛ ti ba la nɛ.
Josua ne Israel tena la bwaa naa kɛŋɔ laa tena baa kaa sɔh chɔ dɛɛ kpa la kaa lɛ bwɛjen la dɔɔh asɛ chuu tɛr dɛɛ le o ta la, ba laa berɛ dɛɛ kpoo ba.
Israel tena ba fa aa kaa sɔh chɔ dɛɛ kpa dɛ jo bwɛɛ la bini la berɔ le ba, dɛ ba cheme bwɛjen Ai tena, asɛ Israel tena do baŋ bɛl, ba tɔ ba do baah ta dɛ kpoo ba bwa, ba bɛlbwa ɡe ta bɔr dɔe dɛ chwa, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae, nemenɛ ba kooro ɡbo.
O te ba lawɔ ka tɛ Josua.
Israel tena aa ti bwɛjen Ai tena dɛ ka kpoo ba kooni ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta tonɛ la, ba berɔ la bwɛjen Ai ta ɡe dɛ ka kpoo nɛra baa ka o bini bwa.
Baala ne haahna nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛɛ ba kpoo awola tɔpere, Ai tenaa ba bwa.
Josua tɛr o lampea la pa bwɛjen Ai ɡɛ dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ baa kpoo o ta nɛra bwa tonɛ.
Kondɛɛra ne laala aa ka laa la ta te, Israel tena kaa ane, ɡɛ Korowii aa do Josua la.
Josua ɡelɔ ba fuh bwɛjen Ai o berɛ dimɡbia, o chɔ ɡɛ ba le fini.
O ɡelɔ ba saɡɛ bwɛjen Ai kooro daa ta, ka tel jɔmɔra.
Wee aa baa jo la, o ɡelɔ ba fooru dɛ kpɔɔ ka ta Ai doonyojen baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ jo bwɛɛ la ta la.
Ba pa bwea dawɛ o nɛɛ a daŋɛ, dɛ ta chɔ bela ba le fini.
Korowii Mmara kura Ebal Bwejen ta Asɛ Josua ma kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la, Ebal Bwejen ta, ɡɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa do Israel tena la.
Josua ɡelɔ ba ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta ɡɛ tenten baa chwera do Mosis Mmara Tɔn la bini.
Ba ta buni kon kpɔe sɛh bwea la bɛlbwa.
Ba ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah dɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha o ta tɛ Korowii.
Ebal Bwejen la taa Josua berɛ kwaa chwerɛ Mosis Mmara o fa aa chwera la tenten bwea ta, Israel tena bwa siwi ta.
Dɛ Israel tena bwa, hɔɔhra ne deela, koranar ne nomonome, dɛ ba bini nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole bwa kaa che Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la baŋne anɛ ta, ba sie chaɡɛ Lewi dea sɔfore baa cheɡɛ daka la.
Nɛra la bini bane cheɡɔ ba habɔɔ chaɡɛ Geresim Bwejen la, asɛ ba pera ɡe che ba habɔɔ chaɡɛ Ebal Bwejen la.
Ba cheɡɔ ɡɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa do ba la, asɛ Korowii ɡel sɔfore la swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba.
A habɔɔ la, Josua kure Mmara la bwa baɡ ba, anɔ la Korowii aa swee andɛɛɡa do a ta, ne anɔ la aa ɛ taahna waa bwa.
O kura ɡɛ tenten baa chwera la.
Wobɛlbwa toole Mosis aa chwera, Josua aa wola an kure.
O kure wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ ken dɛ baɡle Israel tena la baa cheme bela la bwa.
Haahna ne bechale ne hɔɔhra ba ne baa soɡa bwa.
Gebeɔn tena neɡra baa neɡre Josua Koranar baa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee cholibɔr no ɡɛ Josua ne Israel tena aa dɛ pɔ nɛra nɛ, banɔ la baa lɔ deŋɡarere ta ne banɔ la baa lɔ deŋɡarere harɛbɔr wee cholibɔr, ne banɔ la baa lɔ Mɛdetereenea Mpo nyoa bwa, dɛ kpoŋe kaa weekaŋle nyundua Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta.
A ɡɛ koranar laanee, Hiti ne Amɔre ne Keenan ne Pɛrɛs ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena koranar.
A ɡɛ koranar nɔ bwa pɛo dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛŋɔ bá yo Josua ne Israel tena.
Gebeɔn tena aa no ɡɛ Josua ne Israel tena aa ɛ bwɛjena Jeriko ne Ai la, ba kpɔ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ dɔ ba nyu.
Ba nyin bɔɡtɔ bena do kondikwa, dɛ kpɔ ola tɔmbena dɛ nyarɛ loŋa baa kpɔ sen do a ta dɛ vɔrɔwe choɡ keeɡore.
Ba kpɔ naŋɡaobena aa kɛɛra baa nyara do, dɛ pa laala jɛɡle do.
Dɛ paanoo baa kpoŋa la bwa holɔ dɛ kɔlɔme.
Belaa nɛra la la Josua ne Israel tena la be bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene Gelɡal.
Ate, Gebeɔn tena la ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ya le bojaŋ harɛ bɛl ta, ya dɛ nyin kɛ ya ne he fɔwɛ darame fɔo.” Anee Israel tena la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ ya ne hɛɛ ba wona fɔwɛ fɔo a maɡre ɔ?
He ken ka soɡe ya jwɛɛh bonɔ tenten.” Anee Gebeɔn tena la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Kɛ he bonɔɔnaa yaa ɔ?” Asɛ Josua bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Nɛmbesooree heya ɔ?
Leperaa he leɔ?” Ba ŋɔ, “Bojaŋ harɛ bɛl taa he bonɔɔna le, noe ya no Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la wa.
Ya no wejena waa ɛa Ijipt harɛ ta, ne ɡɛ waa ɛ Amɔre tena koranar banɛ bane Jɔɔdan Moo la wee leebɔr.
Kooro Sihon o fa aa soɡe bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn, ne Kooro Ɔɡ o ɡe fa aa ɛ kooro Basan harɛ ta, dɛ so bwɛjen Astarɔt ta.
A waa ya harɛ ta nomonome ne nɛra baa lɔ ya harɛ la ta bwa ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ, ‘Yá kpɔ kondikwa do ya be ya vala la bini, dɛ́ ba bol ya harɛ nɔ waa baɡle heya kɛŋɔ he bonɔɔnaa yan.
Ásɛ ya ne he fɔwɛ darame fɔo.’ Hé na ya paanoo, dɛ a wɔrɔbe ya kpɔ do ya bone bini dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta, taraken a holɔ dɛ kɔlɔme.
Ola tɔne yaa do sen a bini nɔ, dɛ anfalaa, kɛ hé nyiŋi na ɡɛ aa doa taraken, a bwa kɛɛrɔ.
Ya laala ne naŋɡaware yaa doa bwa kɛɛrɔ, jaŋne ŋwɛnɛ la aa doa nomanta.” Josua ne Israel tena ta Korowii bɔɔrɛ no kɛŋɔ ba sɛh ba ne ba fɔwɛ ba fɔo la.
Asɛ Josua ne Gebeɔn tena la fɔwɛ darame fɔo kɛŋɔ waa ban kpoo, asɛ Israel nomonome la ɡe ŋwɛɛ ntam dawɛ waa la ta.
Fɔo la tɔpetooro wee la, Israel tena la noɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra la ta bojaŋ bobɛlbwa leɛ, ba lɔ ba jwɛɛh tenten.
Belaa Israel tena la ir chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa nɛra la be, tɔpera atoroo ba kpɔ jo ba bwɛjena la ta.
Bwɛjena laanee Gebeɔn ne Kefira ne Beɛrɔt dɛ Kiriat Jearim.
Israel tena la ta ban kpoorɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba nomonome ne ba fa tɔ sie fɔwɛ darame fɔo Israel tena Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta.
Dɛ Israel tena la dɛ naɡre ba nomonome la waa kɛŋɔ baa ɛ ɡɛ la.
Anee nomonome la ŋɔ, “Ya ŋwɛɛ Korowii ya Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ntam, anomanta, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ yá kpɔ nɔn leɡ ba.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ yá ɡel ba dɔ ba nyu ntam la wa, ásɛ Korowii baah bɛ ya nɛɛ ba di kɛŋɔ ya to ntam yaa ŋwɛɛra baɡ ba la.” Ba berɔ ŋɔ, “Bá so, kɛ baa teŋni daa dɛ che nee dɛɛ tɛ Israel tena bwa.” Asɛ ba no waa nomonome la aa kpɔa baɡ ba nyoa la ta.
Ate, Josua yerɛ Gebeɔn tena la bwa cheme dɛ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa he ba neɡre yaa ŋɔ he le bojaŋ, jaah dɛ he le ya mee lɔɡa bonɔ tenten nɔɔ?
A ɡɛ waa haa ɛa nɔ, Korowii taah heya, haa ba he ba dɔ he nyu dɛɛ di pɛɛpɛɛ kpa bwa.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa hɛ́ɛ dɛɛ teŋni daa, dɛ́ che nee dɛɛ la Korowii Dea.” Asɛ Gebeɔn tena la ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, yan yaa ɛ he bonɔɔna, ya noɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii aa do o bonɔɔ Mosis ŋɔ ó kpɔ harɛ nɔ bwa tɛ he Israel tena, ásɛ dɛ kpoo nɛra baa soɡe o ta bwa le he sie nomanta, ɔmee lawɛ yaa ɡɛ yaa ɛ dɛ́ dɔ ya nyu, a waa ya ɛ ɡɛ la.
Yanee la, ya lɔ he nɔn ta, anɔ la bwa aa wera kɛ hé ɛ yaa la, hé ɛ.” Josua lɛɛ ba Israel tena nɔn ta, ba ta ban kpoorɛ.
Le awola tɔpere la ba le fini, ɡɛɛ Gebeɔn tena ɛɛ teŋni daa, dɛ che nee dɛɛ tɛ Israel tena, dɛ kpɔ ane dɛɛ la saraha kon la ta bobɛlbwa Korowii aa baɡ ba.
Israel tena yo Amɔre tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ A kaa ba kɛ Kooro Adoni Sɛdɛk o fa aa di kora Jerusalam noɔ kɛŋɔ Josua ne o nɛra kaa yo bwɛjen Ai, dɛ chɔɡo kwaraa.
Gɛ tenten Josua aa ɛ bwɛjen Jeriko tena ne o kooro la, ne ɡɛ Gebeɔn tena aa la Israel tena be ba ne ba ka fɔwɛ darame fɔo dɛ so bɛne ba la.
Ɔmee chole Kooro Adoni Sɛdɛk ne o nɛra nɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Gebeɔn ɛ bwɛjen dɛ ɛ koobwɛɛre la bini bɛl, dɛ do kan ɡwaa bwɛjen Ai, o nɛra ɡe jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ.
Ate, Kooro Adoni Sɛdɛk kpɔ kala tɛ Hɛbrɔn Kooro Hoham ne Jaamut Kooro Piram, ne Lakes Kooro Jafia dɛ Ɛɡlɔn Kooro Debir ŋɔ, “Hé ba cha mɛ ń ka yo bwɛjen Gebeɔn tena.
Ba ne Josua ne o nɛra Israel tena kaa fɔwɛ darame fɔo.” Ate, a ɡɛ Amɔre koranar banue baa le Jerusalam ne Hɛbrɔn ne Jaamut ne Lakes dɛ Ɛɡlɔn la kpɔ ba laa tena dɛ ka bar bwɛjen Gebeɔn dɛɛ ba ba yoi.
Belaa Gebeɔn tena den tomɛ nɛra Josua ne o nɛra Israel tena be bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene Gelɡal la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, Amɔre harɛ koranar baa lɔ deŋɡarere bwɛɛre ta bwa lɔɔ pɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba laa tena dɛɛ ba ba yo yaa, anomanta, kpɔ he nɛra ba warane dɛ́ ba cha he bonɔɔna, dɛ́ lɛ yaa ta.” Ate, Josua kpɔ o laa tena bwa, banɔ la baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ le Gelɡal.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ ba ɔma, n dɔɔ kpɔ ba do he nɔn ta.
Ba bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won che he sie.” Josua ne o laa tena valɔ jwaana la ne bwa le Gelɡal ba bwɛjen Gebeɔn ta, dɛ ka piɡri Amɔre tena bela baa soɡa, dɛ yoo ba.
Ate, Korowii den ɡel Amɔre tena la wili Israel laa tena la sie, asɛ ba pɔ ba nɛɛ kohona dɛ kpoo ba Gebeɔn.
Israel tena ti ba kaa bwɛɛ Bɛt Hɔrɔn ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ teŋɛ kpoo ba kaa bwɛɛre Aseka ne Makeda.
Amɔre tena la aa chwaa tɔ Israel tena laa tena sie dɛ ka tel Bɛt Hɔrɔn dɛɛ kaa Aseka la, Korowii ɡelɔ dombwea lee ba nɛɛ kohona asɛ ba ɡalɡa bwa serewe ɡwaa ɡɛ Israel tena la aa kpoo ba la kwara.
Awola tɔpere Korowii aa kpɔ Amɔre tena do Israel tena nɔn ta la, Josua soŋe Korowii kohona Israel tena la bwa siwi ta ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ɡel wee che bobeŋkpoŋ Gebeɔn harɛ ta, ɡel korobie ɡe che bobeŋkpoŋ Aejalɔn fɛlembɔjen ta kiŋkiŋ ken!” Anee wee che bobeŋkpoŋ, korobie ɡe ta che bobeŋkpoŋ, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ Israel tena aa kpoo ba dɔma la tonɛ.
Gɛɛ a do ba chwerɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ do tɔn baa dɛ yerɔ Jashar Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Wee cheɡɛ nyufala o ta harɛ lee tɔpebir bwa la.” Waa nɔ dɔŋa ta chiɡe saŋ bɛlbwa bwa, kɛɛ Korowii no nɛwɛnyini wesoŋa ken bwa.
Kasinteŋ, dɛ Korowiirii fa yoa dɛɛ tɛ Israel tena.
Laa la aa tona la, Josua ne o laa tena bwa berɔ kaa Gelɡal bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so la.
Amɔre koranar banue kpoora Gɛ saŋ la, Amɔre koranar banue la chwao ka sɔh Makeda bwebɔɔ bɛl bini.
Dɛ Josua noɔ kɛŋɔ ba ŋɔ koranar banue la chwao ka sɔh bwebɔɔ bini Makeda, asɛ o ŋɔ, “Hé ɡbili bwejena ba tɔ bwebɔɔ la nyoa, dɛ́ le n nɛra la bane bá che dɛɛ daah bela.
Hé ɡbabir bɛ bela che.
Hé ti he dɔma la, he bɛ ban ɡel.
Hé teŋɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ɛ yoo ba, he bɛ ɡel ba dɔ bɔr ba jo ba bwɛjena ta.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la laa nɔn kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ ba do he nɔn ta.” Josua ne Israel tena la kpoo nɛra la ɡalɡa bwa.
Tamaa kenii baa ka dɛ won tel ba bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara ta.
Laa tena la bwa berɔ ba Josua be Makeda bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la sɔnɔnɔɔ ken.
Nomɛlbwa ta liire kɛ wɛɛ bol Israel tena wechɔɡe bɛlbwaa harɛ la ta kpa.
Ate Josua ŋɔ, “Hé ka ɡbili bwea la le bwebɔɔ la nyoa, dɛ́ lawɛ koranar banue la ba tɛ mɛ.” Ate, ba ka ɡbili bwea la le bɔɔ la nyoa, dɛ lawɛ a ɡɛ koranar baa le Jerusalam ne Hɛbrɔn ne Jaamut ne Lakes, dɛ Ɛɡlɔn le bwebɔɔ la bini.
Baa laɡ ba le ba tɛ Josua la, o yerɛ Israel tena la ne laa nomonome la bwa cheme, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ he nakpale ɛɡre a ɡɛ koranar nɔ baŋare ta.” Ate, koranar la le dɛ ba chɔ harɛ, ba kpɔ ba nakpale ɛɡre ba baŋare ta.
Josua berɛ ŋɔ laa nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ berɛ ɔma, he bɛ ɡel he bambile ɡe chɔɡ.
Hé che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ dɔ bambile.
Kenii Korowii ɛɛ ba he dɔma bwa he ne baa dɛ ba yoi ɛɛ.” Ate, Josua kpoo koranar la, dɛ kpɔ ba saɡre daa anue ta, ba saɡre ɡɛ naa, dɛ ka tel jɔmɔra.
Wee aa dɛ ba joe la, o ɡelɔ ba ka laa ba kpɔ le daa baa saɡre a ta la ta, dɛ paa ba ka ta bwebɔɔ ba fa aa chwaa ka sɔh o bini la bini.
Bwea baa ɡbila tɔ bwebɔɔ la nyoa kan kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ta tɔ o nyoa ba le fini.
Awola tɔpere la, Makeda bwɛdaa do kɛŋɔ jahal ken Josua nɔn ta.
O ne o laa tena kpoo bela kooro ne nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta bwa, o ta nɛn ɡelɛ.
Gɛ waa ɛ bwɛjen Jeriko kooro laanee o ɛ Makeda kooro ɡe.
Weekaŋle harɛbɔr bwɛjena yoi dɛ́ pɔ a nɛ Ate, Josua ne o laa tena kpɔ le Makeda, dɛ ka pu bwɛjen Lebna dɛ ka yo nɛra baa lɔ o ɡe ta.
Korowii cheɡɛ Josua ne o laa tena mun ta, dɛ kpɔ bwɛjen la ne o kooro do ba nɔn ta.
Ba kpoo nɛra baa lɔ o ta bwa, nomɛlbwa ta kae.
Gɛ baa ɛ bwɛjen Jeriko kooro laanee ba ɛ kooro la ɡe.
Josua ne o laa tena berɔ kpɔ le Lebna ɡe, dɛ kpɔ ka pu bwɛjen Lakes tena, dɛ ka bar ba dɛ yoo ba.
Tɔpera anɛ habɔɔ la, Korowii laa nɔn kpɔ bwɛjen Lakes tena ne o nɛra bwa nɛ, asɛ Josua ne o laa tena kpoo ba bwa sekwaraa ɡɛ waa ɛ Lebna la.
Ba yoi la ta la, Horam waa ɛ bwɛjen Gɛsa kooro kpɔ o laa tena dɛ ba cha Lakes tena, kɛ ane a bwa, Josua ne o laa tena wono pɔ o ne o laa tena nɛ dɛ kpoo ba bwa, nomɛlbwa ta kae.
Josua ne o laa tena berɔ kpɔ le Lakes ka pu bwɛjen Ɛɡlɔn tena dɛ ka bar ba ɡe dɛ yoo ba.
Ba wono ka pɔ bwɛjen Ɛɡlɔn ne o nɛra bwa nɛɛ awola tenten dɛ kpoo ba bwa, dɛ ɛ bela kɛŋɔ baa ɛ Lakes la ken.
Dɛ berɛ kpɔ le bwɛjen Ɛɡlɔn ka pu bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn ne o nɛra dɛ ka yo ba ɡe.
Ba pɔ ba ɡe nɛɛ dɛ kpoo ba ne ba kooro bwa, dɛ ka yo ba bwɛjeɡre nɛra dɛ kpoo ba bwa, nomɛlbwa ta kae, dɛ ɛ bela kɛŋɔ baa ɛ bwɛjen Ɛɡlɔn la ken.
Josua ne o laa tena la berɔ laa berɛ dɛ ba yo bwɛjen Debir tena ɡe.
Ba pɔ bwɛjen Debir kooro ne o nɛra bwa nɛ, dɛ ka yo bela bwɛjeɡre bwa dɛ kpoo a nɛra bwa kwaraa, nomɛlbwa ta kae.
Gɛ baa ɛ bwɛjen Debir ne o kooro la, ɡɛ tentenee ba ɛ Hɛbrɔn ne Lebna koranar ɡe.
Josua pɔ harɛre la bwa nɛ, bwɛɛre aa lɔ deŋɡarere ta ne Nɛɡɛv, ne anɔ la aa lɔ wee cholibɔr, ne anɔ la aa lɔ mpo nyoa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, ne anɔ la aa chɔ bwea lɔɡre ne a koranar bwa.
Nomɛlbwa ta o nyu dɔe.
Ba kpo hweera kon te bɛlbwa.
Gɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa doo laanee o ɛ. Josua pɔ harɛre ane baa dɛ yera Kades Baanea dɛ kpoŋe kaa bwɛjen Gasa ne Gosen harɛ ta, dɛ ka tel bwɛjen Gebeɔn ne o harɛre aa baro cheme ta.
Josua ne o laa tena kaa yo a ɡɛ koranar nɔ ne ba nɛra, dɛ ba harɛre la teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee yoa tɛɛ ba.
Anɔ habɔɔ la, Josua ne o laa tena bwa kaa Gelɡal bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la dɛ ka so.
Josua pɔ weekaŋle nyundua koranar nɛ Dɛ Kooro Jabin dɛ di kora Hasɔ.
O baa no kɛŋɔ Josua ne o nɛra Israel tena pɔ harɛre nɛɛ warɛ, asɛ o ɡel koranar bane kɛŋɔ Jobab waa ɛ Madɔn kooro ne Simron dɛ Aksaf ɡe no a wa.
O ɡelɔ koranar baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr deŋɡarere ta dɛ do Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta, ne Galilia Moo weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ne banɔ la baa lɔ deŋɡarere lɔɡre, ne banɔ la baa lɔ mpo nyoa weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ bɛne bwɛjen Dɔr, nɛra ɡe no dɛ ba chao.
Kooro Jabin berɔ ɡel Keenan tena baa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋne anɛ la bwa no.
Amɔre ne Hiti ne Pɛrɛs dɛ Jebus tena baa soɡe bela deŋɡarere ta, ne Hivi tena baa soɡe Hɛmɔn Bwejen lɔɡa dɛ do Mispa harɛ ta.
Ate, koranar la bwa sɛh dɛ kpɔ ba laa tena pɛ, ne kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwa pɛl jaɡre dɛɛ yo ane la ba cheme.
Laa tena la warɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.
A ɡɛ koranar nɔ bwa kpɔ ba laa tena pɛ, dɛ baŋre ba tɛnte deene nee Mɛrɔm nyoa, dɛ́ yo Israel tena.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ berɛ ɔma, kere saŋ nɔ bɔr, mɛɛ kpɔ baa do he Israel tena nɔn taa hé kpoo ba.
Hé ɛ dɛ́ chaa ba jaɡre la nadɛɛne, dɛ́ fuh kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la.” Ba ne jara dɛ Josua ne o laa tena bwa deno ba lɔ tɔ ba nɛɛ Mɛrɔm nee la nyoa bela, asɛ Korowii den kpɔ ba do Israel tena nɔn ta.
Ba pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ ti ba ka le weekaŋle nyundua bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Sidon ne Mesrefɔt Maim, ne wee leebɔr ka le Mispa Fɛlembɔjen ta, hale ba bini beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.
Josua ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.
O ɡelɔ ba chaa ba jaɡre la nadɛɛne, dɛ fuh torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la.
Dɛ bwɛjen Hasɔɔ ɛ harɛre aa lɔ bela bwa bwɛjen.
Josua berɔ ba o ta ɡɛ saŋ dɛ ba yo ba ɡe, dɛ kpo bela kooro kere ne.
Ba kpo nomɛlbwa waa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta, bɛlbwa ta kae, dɛ fuh bwɛɛ la ɡe bwa.
Josua yo a ɡɛ bwɛjena nɔ bwa ne a koranar, dɛ kpo nɛra baa lɔ a ta bwa, ɡɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa doo la.
Josua ta ɡelɛ ba fuh bwɛjena aa lɔ deŋɡarere ta la bɛlbwa, nemenɛ Hasɔ ɡbo.
Israel tena la cheɡɛ kondɛɛɡa ne kondɛɛra aa lɔ ɡɛ bwɛjena la ta bwa kaa a ɛ ba kwa.
Ba kpo nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjena la ta bwa, bɛlbwa ta kae.
Gɛ Korowii aa do o bonɔɔ Mosis la, ɡɛɛ Mosis ɡe do Josua, asɛ o teŋɛ a ta.
O ɛ waa Korowii aa do Mosis la bwa.
Josua ne o laa tena yoo dɛ kpɔ harɛ la bwa, deŋɡarere ne bwea lɔɡre bwɛɛre, anɔ la aa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua ne weekaŋle harɛbɔr harɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ bwa ta.
Le Gosen harɛ dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta bwa.
Dɛ́ kpoŋe le Halak Bwejen dɛ́ kaa Sɛɛ Bwejen ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Baal Gad waa lɔ Lɛbanɔn Fɛlembɔjen bini dɛ do Hɛmɔn Bwejen la lɔɡa.
Josua yo koranar la bwa, dɛ kpoo ba.
Josua yo ɡɛ koranar nɔ biɡri taeh, kɛ o pɔ ba bwa nɛɛ dɛ kpoo ba.
Nemenɛ Hivi tena baa lɔ bwɛjen Gebeɔn la ɡbosoo ne Israel tenaa pɛa fɔwɛ nyopɛo fɔo ba ta dɔŋa yoi.
Ba kpoo banɔ la baa lɔ bwɛjena la bini bwa laa ta.
Korowiirii saahna dɛ ɡel ba bambile do kpeɡri ba ka pu Israel tena yo, ásɛ Israel tena bɛ ba sum na, dɛ́ kpoo ba dɛ́ he ba.
Gɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ Mosis be la.
A ɡɛ saŋ la ta la, Josua kaa kpoo Anak tena baa soɡe deŋɡarere ta, dɛ kpoŋe le bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Hɛbrɔn ne Debir dɛ Anab, dɛ deŋɡarere bwɛɛre aa lɔ Juda ne Israel harɛ ta.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ kpeɡo taeh.
A ɡɛ Anak tena nɔ bɛlbwa ta Israel harɛ ta kae.
Nemenɛ bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Gasa ne Gat dɛ Asdɔdee tamaa bane ka.
Josua yoo lɛ ɡɛ harɛ la bwa, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ o bonɔɔ Mosis be la.
O bɔna tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la, asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ o bɔr.
A habɔɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ba harɛ la ta, bɛlbwa ta yoi kpa.
Koranar Mosis aa yoa dɛ pɔ ba nɛ Koranar Israel tena aa yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ lɛ ba harɛre laanee nɔ.
Harɛre la le Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr, dɛ le Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen dɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Hɛmɔn Bwejen weekaŋle nyundua.
Koranar banɛɛ ba yo dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Kooro la bɛl sɔne Sihon, Amɔre tena kooroo wɛɛ di kora bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn.
O harɛ nyoa le bwɛjen Arowa, o lɔ Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen nyoa, dɛ le fɛlembɔjen la baah ta dɛ kaa Jabɔk Moo waa ɛ Amɔn tena harɛ jwɛh ta.
Gelead harɛ pera ɡe ja o ta.
O harɛ la teŋɔ ba le Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen la ta, dɛ le Galilia Moo weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ kaa Bɛt Jɛsemɔt harɛ ta, o lɔ Yar Mpo wee leebɔr.
Dɛ kpoŋe kaa Pesɡa Bwejen lɔɡa.
Basan Kooro Ɔɡ harɛ ja a ta.
O ɛ Refa tena kooro waa ka mun dɛ di kora bwɛjena Astarɔt ne Edrei ta.
O harɛ la pera berɔ le Hɛmɔn Bwejen ta, dɛ kaa bobɛla baa dɛ yera Saleka ne Basan bwa, dɛ kpoŋe ka le Gesur ne Maaka harɛre jwɛh ta.
Dɛ́ berɛ kpoŋe le Gelead harɛ pera dɛ́ kaa Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon harɛ jwɛh ta.
Mosis ne Israel tena la kpoo ba, asɛ dɛ kpɔ ɡɛ harɛ la tɛ Israel deene atoro ŋɔ bá kpɔ.
Banee Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera bane.
Josua ne Israel tena yoo dɛ pɔ koranar baa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee cholibɔr nɛ.
Dɛ le bwɛjen Baal Gad, waa lɔ Lɛbanɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ kaa Halak Bwejen weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Sɛɛ Bwejen pera.
Josua bɔne ɡɛ harɛ la tɛ Israel deene la ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ɛ ba kon kwaraa.
Harɛre a ɡe aa jaa laanee, deŋɡarere ta ne wee cholibɔr deŋɡarere lɔɡa ne Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ne o bwejena lɔɡre, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ne Nɛɡɛv.
Dɛ harɛre Hiti ne Amɔre ne Keenan ne Pɛrɛs ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena aa soɡe a ta laanee.
Koranar Israel tena aa yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ laanee koranar baa le Bwɛjena Jeriko ne Ai, aa bɛne Bɛtel.
Jerusalam ne Hɛbrɔn koranar, Jaamut ne Lakes koranar, Ɛɡlɔn ne Gɛsa koranar, Debir ne Gɛda koranar, Hɔrma dɛ Arad koranar.
Lebna ne Adulam koranar, Makeda ne Bɛtel koranar, Tapua ne Hɛfa koranar, Afɛk ne Lasarɔn koranar.
Madɔn ne Hasɔ koranar Simron Mɛrɔn ne Aksaf koranar, Taanak ne Meɡido koranar Kedes ne Jokneam koranar, a lɔ Kaamɛl Bwejen lɔɡa.
Dɔr, o ɡe lɔ mpo nyoa ne Goim, dɛ do Galilia harɛ ta, dɛ Tirsa kooro.
Koranar la bwa lɔ fifraatoro dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Harɛ waa kaa Israel tena ka yo dɛ lɛ Josua baa hwɛɛh kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Taraken he hwɛɛhrɔ kohona, kɛ a ta ka harɛre warɛ kɛŋɔ Israel tena yo dɛ lɛ.
Harɛre aa kaa laanee Filisti ne Gesur harɛre, dɛ kpɔ le Sehɔ Moo waa lɔ Ijipt wee leebɔr, dɛ ka tel Ekron tena jwɛh ta weekaŋle nyundua, a bwa lɔ Keenan harɛ ta.
Dɛ Filisti tena koranar banue soɡe bwɛjena Gasa ne Asdɔd ne Askɛlɔn ne Gat dɛ Ekron, dɛ Avi tena ɡe harɛ.
Keenan tena harɛre bwa ne bwɛjen Meara waa lɔ Sidon tena harɛ ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa bwɛjen Afɛk waa lɔ Amɔre tena harɛ jwɛh ta jao.
Dɛ a chɛ kɛ hé yo Gebal tena harɛ dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ teŋɛ kaa Lɛbanɔn harɛ bwa wee leebɔr, le Baal Gad waa lɔ Hɛmɔn Bwejen lɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa Lebo Hamat.
Harɛ aa chɛ kɛ hé ka yo dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ ja laanee Sidon tena harɛ baa soɡe deŋɡarere bwɛɛre ta dɛ do Lɛbanɔn bwejena ne Mesrefɔt Maim harɛ baah ta bwa la.
N ɡbaɡba ɛɛ doŋi nɛra la bwaa le he sie, ásɛ he nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ bɔne harɛ la tɛ Israel tena la, ó ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon ɡɛ maa ŋɔ he be la, ásɛ dɛ bɔne harɛ la tɛ deene anuanaarɛ aa kaa la ne Manasɛ dea pera tena bane, ásɛ o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.” Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr harɛ bɔna Dɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis tɔ sie kpɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr harɛ tɛ Rubin ne Gad dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena la bane, ásɛ o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.
Harɛ la chɔɔ ka le Arowa, o lɔ Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen la nyoa ne bwɛjen bɛl waa lɔ fɛlembɔjen la bini dɛ kpɔ harɛpɛɛ bɛl waa chɔa le Medeba dɛ kaa Debɔn.
Harɛ la le Amɔre tena Kooro Sihon waa di kora Hɛsbɔn la bwɛjena bwa ta, dɛ ka le Amɔn tena harɛ jwɛh ta, o teŋɔ ka le Gelead waa lɔ Gesur ne Maaka harɛre ta, ne Hɛmɔn Bwejen la bwa ne Basan harɛ bwa dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Saleka bwa jao.
Kooro Ɔɡ waa ka mun ɛ Refa te dɛ di kora Astarɔt ne Edrei la harɛ jao.
Dɛ Mosis yo a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ doŋ ba le harɛ la ta.
Israel tena ta Gesur tena ne Maaka tena te doŋe, bane ba ta pɛo so dɛ ba le fini.
Mosis ta Lewi dea tena la te harɛ tɛɛ, kwaa nɛra aa kpɔ ba fuh ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee chɛ kɛŋɔ bá dɔ.
Gɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ Mosis be la.
Mosis kpɔ harɛ la pera tɛ Rubin dea tena kɛŋɔ ó ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.
Ba harɛ nyoa le Arowa, o lɔ Aanɔn Fɛlembɔjen la nyoa dɛ kaa bwɛjen waa lɔ fɛlembɔjen la baah ta, dɛ kpɔ harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa dɛ ka ɡarɛ bwɛjen Medeba, ne Hɛsbɔn ne bwɛjena bwa aa lɔ harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta, Debɔn ne Bamɔt Baal dɛ Bɛt Baal Meɔn, ne Jahas ne Kedemɔt dɛ Mɛfaat, ne Kiriataim ne Sibma dɛ Sɛrɛt Saha aa lɔ deŋɡare waa lɔ fɛlembɔjen bini la doa, ne Bɛt Peɔ ne Pesɡa Bwejen la lɔɡa dɛ kaa Bɛt Jɛsemɔt, ne bwɛjena aa lɔ harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta bwa, ne Amɔre Kooro Sihon o fa aa di kora bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn ka la harɛre bwa.
Mosis yo Kooro Sihon ne Midian koranar bane baa dɛ yer ba Evi ne Rekem ne Sor ne Hur dɛ Reba dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Dɛ Midian koranar la bwa ɛ koojeɡre dɛ do Kooro Sihon lɔɡa ba ne o nyoa pɛ harɛ la ta.
Nɛra baa jaa Israel tena la kpoo ba laa ta la, ba bini bɛlee Balam, o mɛɛ sɔne Beɔ.
Dɛ a ɡɛ Balam nɔ ɛ voɡre.
Jɔɔdan Moo wee cholibɔree ɛ Rubin dea tena harɛ jwɛh ta.
Bwɛjena ne bwɛjeɡre aa lɔ bela laanee Mosis kpɔ tɛ Rubin dea tena o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.
Harɛ la pera Mosis aa kpɔa tɛ Gad dea tena ɡe ŋɔ ó ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon laanee nɔ, Jasa ne Gelead bwɛjena bwa, ne Amɔn tena harɛ la pera, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Arowa waa lɔ bwɛjen Raba wee leebɔr, dɛ́ le bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn dɛ́ kaa bwɛjena Ramat Mispa ne Bɛtɔnem, dɛ́ berɛ le bwɛjen Mahanaim dɛ́ kaa Debir harɛ ta.
Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta ɡe, bwɛjena Bɛt Haram ne Bɛt Nimra ne Sukot dɛ Safɔn, dɛ Kooro Sihon waa di kora bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn la harɛ bwa.
Jɔɔdan Moo la wee leebɔr, harɛ la teŋɔ kaa Galilia Moo nyoa.
Bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre nɔ ɛ Gad dea tena kapɛrɛ kwa.
Dɛ Mosis kpɔ harɛ la pera tɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena la ɡe o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.
Harɛ la nyoa le Mahanaim jwɛh ta dɛ kaa Kooro Ɔɡ waa di kora Basan harɛ bwa, ne bwɛjeɡre fifraanumɛl baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jɛɛ aa yoa dɛ pɔ ba nɛ a do Basan harɛ, ne Gelead harɛ pera ne bwɛjena Astarɔt dɛ Edrei jao, a bwa ɛ Basan harɛ Kooro Ɔɡ koobwɛjena.
Anɔɔ ɛ Makir bibaa Manasɛ naanar bwɛjena baa dɔa.
Harɛ Mosis aa bɔna tɛ Israel tena o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon, ɡɛ saŋ waa lɔ bwɛjen Jeriko wee leebɔr ne Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta, ɡɛ saŋ waa tel Moab harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa ta laanee la.
Kɛ Lewi dea tena la te, Mosis ta ban harɛ tɛɛ o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ kwaa nɛra aa kpɔ ba ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la peraa dɛɛ ba ba kwaa ɛɛ.
Jɔɔdan Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ bɔna Kenii Keenan harɛ waa lɔ Jɔɔdan wee cholibɔr la bɔna waa do.
Sɔfo Eliasa ne Nun bibaa Josua, dɛ nomonome baa chɔ Israel deene la nyoo laanee bɔna tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ Mosis be wubwa kɛŋɔ, Jɔɔdan Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ waa dɛ ba bɔna tɛ deene anuanaarɛ ne dea beŋkpoŋ pera la, bá bil daa ásɛ bɛlbwa dɔ o kon.
Dɛ Mosis dɔɔ kpɔ harɛ waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr la tɛ deene anɛ ne beŋkpoŋ pera tena, a ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwa.
Kɛ Lewi dea tena te, o ta ban harɛ la bɛl tɛɛ.
Josef dea tena lɔ bele banɛ, Manasɛ ne Efrem deene tena.
Lewi dea tena ta harɛ la bɛlbwa dɔe, nemenɛ bwɛɛre waa ɡela ba so a ta ne bela waa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ ba nae ne peera ɛɛ di la ɡbo.
Gɛ Korowii aa do Mosis la taa Israel tena che dɛ bɔne harɛ la.
Josua kpɔ bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn do Kaleb nɔn ta Awola bɛl, Juda dea tena bane ne Kaleb, baa dɛ yerɛ o mɛɛ Jefune o ɛ Kenis te iro, dɛ la Josua be Gelɡal, asɛ Kaleb ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Lii ɡɛ saŋ yaa lɔ Kades Baanea asɛ Korowii bol n ne he waa baɡle Mosis waa ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ waa ya be la.
A ɡɛ saŋ la dɛ n di bene fifraanaarɛ.
Asɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis tom mɛ le Kades Baanea ba Keenan harɛ nɔ ta ŋɔ ń ba sɔh nyiŋi harɛ la.
Asɛ n berɛ laa berɛ ba baɡle ɡɛ tenten harɛ la waa aa doa o be.
Nɛra n ne baa laŋa la ɡelɔ ya nɛra la bwara yɔr baa ɔmɛ, kɛ n te, dɛ n dɛ yarada Korowii kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, awola tɔpere la, Mosis ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡ mɛ ŋɔ, ‘Harɛ haa laŋa ka valɛ o ta la ɛɛ ɛ he ne he bii kapɛrɛ konee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛkalkɛ he yarada Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la bambile bwa ne.’ Na, bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue la, Korowii aa bol waa nɔ Mosis be.
Gɛ saŋee Israel tena do pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe la.
Asɛ Korowii ɡel n ta so le dɛ ba le fini ɡɛ waa baɡ mɛ nyoa la.
Na, fini nɔ, n di bene fifraanuatoro dɛ anue, n ta kpeɡri fini kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ Mosis aa tom mɛ la.
N ta kpeɡri dɛ́ won la laa kɛŋɔ wubwa la ken.
Anomanta, n dɛ soŋe kɛ hé kpɔ deŋɡarere harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa baɡ mɛ nyoa awola tɔpere la tɛ mɛ fini.
He ɡbabir noɔ kɛŋɔ Anak tena baa kpeɡa kohona lɔ harɛ la ta, asɛ ba bwɛjena do kan ba ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara.
Kɛ dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ n mun ta naa, mɛɛ won doŋ ba le, ɡɛ waa bola la.” Ate, Josua swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Jefune bibaa Kaleb, dɛ kpɔ bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn tɛo ŋɔ ó ɛ o kapɛrɛ kon.
Kaleb yarada Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ o bambile bwa ne kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, Korowii kpɔ bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn tɛo.
O naanar ta soɡe bela ba le fini.
Ba fa dɛ yerɛ Hɛbrɔn, bwɛjen Aaba.
Dɛ Aaba ɛ nɛnjen tenten Anak tena la bini.
Ate, deŋnesɔɔhna berɛ ba harɛ la ta.
Juda dea tena harɛ Josua aa bɔna tɛɛ ba Juda dea tena harɛ baa bɔna lolanar ta la kaa tel Edom.
Dɛ kpoŋe ka le Sin pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr le.
Harɛ la jwɛh le Yar Mpo nyoa weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ chɔ kaa ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔ Akrabim Bwejen baah ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Sin pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ kaa Kades Baanea weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
O kaa ɡarɛ Hɛsrɔn dɛ kaa Adaar a bwa aa ɛ bwɛjena, dɛ berɛ ɡoŋe kaa bwɛjen Kaaka ta.
Harɛ la berɔ chɔ ka le bwɛjen Asmɔn dɛ ka chiɡ nenabɔjeɡa bɛl waa lɔ Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta, dɛ ka jaɡɛ Mɛdetereenea Mpo la nyoa.
Belaa ɛ Juda dea tena harɛ jwɛh, weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Harɛ la wee leebɔr jwɛh le Yar Mpo la ta dɛ kpoŋe kaa Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa.
O weekaŋle nyundua jwɛh ɡe le Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa, dɛ chɔ kaa Bɛt Hoɡla, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Bɛt Araba weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ ka le Bohan ŋwam ta.
Dɛ Rubin biee a ɡɛ Bohan nɔ.
Harɛ la jwɛh le bela kaa Akɔ Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa bwɛjen Debir, dɛ berɛ ɡole kpɔ weekaŋle nyundua dɛ kaa Gelɡal, o sie aa chaɡɛ bobɛl ŋwɛnɛ aa chɔa dɛ kaa Adumim Bwejen weekaŋle harɛbɔr fɛlembɔjen la baŋ.
Dɛ kpoŋe le Ɛn Sɛmɛs nee nyoa dɛ ka tel Ɛn Roɡel nyoa.
O berɔ chɔ kaa Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ kaa Jebus tena bwɛjen Jerusalam weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Jwɛh la le bela dɛ kpɔ deŋɡare bɛl waa lɔ Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen doa wee cholibɔr, dɛ berɛ kaa Refaim Fɛlembɔjen ta weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Jwɛh la berɔ le deŋɡare la ta dɛ chɔ kaa Neftoa bule ta, dɛ kpɔ bwɛɛre ane aa chɔa bɛne Efron Bwejen la, dɛ ɡole kaa bwɛjen Baala.
O berɔ ɡole kpɔ Baala wee cholibɔr dɛ kaa Sɛɛ Bwejen waa lɔ Edom harɛ ta, dɛ kaa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera Jearim Bwejen ta, dɛ kaa bwɛjen Bɛt Sɛmɛs dɛ ka ɡarɛ bwɛjen Temna.
Jwɛh la nyoa berɔ ka fɛrɛ Ekron deŋɡare weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ berɛ chaɡɛ kaa Sekerɔn Bwejen dɛ ka ɡarɛ Baala Bwejen, dɛ kpoŋe kaa bwɛjen Jabneel.
O nyoa kaa jaɡɛ Mɛdetereenea Mpo la nyoa.
Harɛ la wee cholibɔr jwɛh la jaɡɛ Mpo la nyoa.
Harɛ la jwɛhre Juda dea tena ne ba lolanar aa sosoɡe a ta laanee la.
Jefune bibaa Kaleb waa le Juda dea tena bini la dɔ harɛ la pera, ɡɛ Korowii aa do Josua la.
Bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn waa ɛ Aaba kon laanee ba kpɔ tɛ Kaleb.
Anak tena nabaalee a ɡɛ Aaba nɔ.
Kaleb doŋi Anak naanar baa soɡe bela la bwa le bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn la ta.
Dɛ nɛmbele batoro baa ɛ Anak tenaa lɔ bela.
Banee Sɛsae ne Ahiman dɛ Talmai tena.
O le bela dɛ ka yo bwɛjen Kiriat Sɛfa tena.
Asɛ Kaleb ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa won yo Kiriat Sɛfa dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ la, mɛɛ lawɛ n bihaah Aksaa tɛo ó mo.” Kaleb dɔɔ sɔne Kenas, o bibaa Otniel wono ir, dɛ ka yo bwɛjen Debir tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, asɛ Kaleb lawɛ o bihaah la tɛo o mo.
Baa ɛ ba hanfalwaa tonɛ la, Otniel ŋɔ Aksa be ŋɔ ó ka ŋɔ o mɛɛ be ó tɛo harɛ.
Waa la o mɛɛ Kaleb be dɛ tu o keeɡo ta la, o mɛɛ den bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ń ɛ tɛɛ nɔ?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi n nɛ.
He tɛ mɛ harɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ Nɛɡɛv.
Tɛ mɛ bela nee aa bula dɛɛ le ɡe.” Asɛ o ka tɛo harɛ nee aa bula dɛɛ le o ta.
Bɛl do nyunduabɔr, bɛl do harɛbɔr pera.
Harɛ Juda dea bii ne ba lolanar aa dɔa ó ɛ ba kon laanee nɔ.
Bwɛjena aa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwa, dɛ bɛne Edom jwɛh ta laanee Kabseel ne Ida dɛ Jaɡur, ne Kina ne Dimona dɛ Adada, ne Kedes ne Hasɔ dɛ Itnan, ne Sif ne Telem dɛ Bealɔt, ne Hasɔ Hadata dɛ Kereɔt Hɛsrɔn.
Amam ne Sema dɛ Molada, ne Hasar Gada ne Hɛsmɔn dɛ Bɛt Pɛlɛt, ne Hasar Sual ne Beɛseeba dɛ Bisiotia ne Baala ne Iim dɛ Esem, ne Ɛltola ne Chesel dɛ Hɔrma, ne Siklaɡ ne Madmana dɛ Sansana ne Lebaot ne Silhim ne Ain dɛ Remɔn.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Bwɛjena aa lɔ deŋɡarere lɔɡre wee cholibɔr la ɡee Ɛstaol ne Sora dɛ Aasna, ne Sanoa ne Ɛn Ganim ne Tapua dɛ Enam, ne Jaamut ne Adulam ne Soko dɛ Aseka, ne Saaraim ne Aditaim ne Gɛdɛra dɛ Gɛdɛrɔtaim.
A ɡe lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anaarɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre bwa.
Anɔ la aa jaa Senan ne Hadaasa dɛ Miɡdal Gad ne Dilian ne Mispa dɛ Jokteel, ne Lakes ne Boskat dɛ Ɛɡlɔn, ne Kabɔn ne Laamam dɛ Ketles, ne Gɛdɛrɔt ne Bɛt Daɡɔn ne Naama dɛ Makeda.
A lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anumɛl, a ne a bwɛjeɡre bwa.
Ane ɡee Lebna ne Ɛta dɛ Asan, ne Ifta ne Aasna dɛ Nesɛb, ne Keila ne Aksib dɛ Maresa.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena anuanaarɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Bwɛjen Ekron ɡe ne bwɛjeɡre aa baro, Ekron wee cholibɔr, ne bwɛjena bwa aa bɛne Asdɔd, ne a bwɛjeɡre, Asdɔd ne bwɛjena ne anjeɡre aa baro, ne Gasa ne bwɛjena ne bwɛjeɡre aa baro, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Ijipt jwɛh ta ne Mɛdetereenea Mpo la nyoa.
Deŋɡarere bwɛjena la ɡee Samir ne Jatir dɛ Soko, ne Dana dɛ Kiriat Sana ne Anab ne Ɛstemo dɛ Anim, ne Gosen ne Holon dɛ Gilo.
A lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre bwa.
Anɔ la aa jaa ɡee Arab ne Duma dɛ Esan, ne Janem ne Bɛt Tapua dɛ Afɛka, ne Humta ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Sior.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena anuanaarɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Ane ɡee Mayɔn ne Kaamɛl ne Sif dɛ Juta, ne Jesreel ne Jokdeam dɛ Sanoa, ne Keen ne Gebea dɛ Temna.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fi, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Bwɛjena la ane ɡee Halhul ne Bɛt Sor dɛ Gedɔr, ne Maarat ne Bɛt Anɔt dɛ Ɛltekɔn.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena anumɛl, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Ane ɡee Kiriat Baal, dɛ Raba.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena anɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bwɛjena ane ɡee Bɛt Araba ne Meden dɛ Sekaka, ne Nibsan, ba dɛ yerɔ Yar Bwɛjen dɛ Ɛn Gedi.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena anumɛl, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Juda dea tena la ta wone doŋi Jebus tena baa soɡe Jerusalam la, ba ne ba bwa ta soɡe bela ba le fini.
Efrem ne Manasɛ deene harɛ baa dɔa Harɛ baa kpɔa tɛ Josef naanar la jwɛh le weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ pa mun le Jɔɔdan Moo la bɛne Bwɛjen Jeriko, bobɛl neerare aa chɔa wee leebɔr, dɛ kpɔ bela kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, dɛ kaa Bɛtel waa lɔ deŋɡarere harɛ ta.
Dɛ le bwɛjen Bɛtel, dɛ ɡale kaa bwɛjen Atarɔt ta.
Nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Aaki tena soɡe bela, dɛ berɛ wili kpɔ wee cholibɔr Jaflɛt tena harɛ ta, dɛ kaa Bɛt Hɔrɔn harɛbɔr, dɛ kaa ka jaɡɛ Mɛdetereenea Mpo nyoa Gɛsa.
Harɛ Josef naanar baa ɛ deene ane baa dɛ yera Efrem ne Manasɛ aa dɔa o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon laanee.
Efrem dea tena harɛ wa Harɛ Efrem dea tena aa dɔa lolanar ta laanee nɔ.
Ba harɛ baa dɔa o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon la jwɛh le bwɛjen Atarɔt Adaa wee leebɔr dɛ kaa Bɛt Hɔrɔn harɛ nyunduabɔr, dɛ chɔ kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo nyoa.
Dɛ le bwɛjen Mekmɛtat weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ ɡoŋe kpɔ wee leebɔr kaa bwɛjena Taanat Silo, dɛ fɛrɔ kaa Janoa ɡe wee leebɔr.
O berɔ le Janoa dɛ wili kaa bwɛjena Atarɔt ne Naara, dɛ ka jaɡɛ bwɛjen Jeriko, dɛ ka tonɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa.
Harɛ la jwɛh kpɔ Tapua wee cholibɔr, dɛ kaa Kana nenabɔjeɡa ta, dɛ kaa ka tonɛ Mɛdetereenea Mpo la ta.
A ɡɛ harɛ nɔɔ Efrem dea lolanar dɔ o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.
Bwɛjena ne bwɛjeɡre ane aa lɔ Manasɛ dea tena harɛ jwɛh ta ɡe jao, kɛ ba kpɔɔ ja Efrem dea tena.
Efrem dea tena la ta Keenan tena baa soɡe Gɛsa la doŋe le bela.
Anomanta, ba ne ba bwa pɛo so dɛ ba le fini.
Kɛ Efrem dea tena la ɡelɔ baa ɛ toma kɛŋɔ ba yoma ken.
Manasɛ dea tena harɛ baa dɔa Ba bɔne Jɔɔdan wee cholibɔr harɛ la pera tɛ Josef binomoa Manasɛ ne o lolanar, o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.
Josef binomoa sɔne Manasɛ, asɛ o ɡe binomoa sɔne Makir.
Makirii Gelead tena naa, dɛ o jemɛ yoi taeh.
Anomanta, Gelead ne Basan harɛ aa lɔ Jɔɔdan wee leebɔr la baa ɛ o kwa.
Harɛ waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee cholibɔr la baa ɛ Manasɛ lolanar baa kaa la ɡe kapɛrɛ kon.
Banee, Abeɛsa ne Hɛlɛk ne Asriel ne Sɛkem ne Hɛfa dɛ Sɛmeda.
Banɔɔ Josef bibaa Manasɛ naanar bibaala, dɛ ba bwa ɛ nomonnyuune.
Manasɛ bibaa sɔne Makir, Makir ɡe bibaa sɔne Gelead, o ɡe bibaa sɔne Hɛfa, Hɛfa ɡe lolɛ bibaa, o sɔne Selofehad.
Selofehad te aa ira la, o ta bibaa dɔe, bihaahna ɡboo o lolɛ.
Banee Maala ne Nowa ne Hoɡla ne Milka dɛ Tirsa.
Gɛ haahna nɔ la sɔfo Eliasa ne Nun bibaa Josua, ne nomonome baa chɔ ba nyoa la be ŋɔ, “Korowii bol Mosis be ŋɔ ó tɛ ya ne ya lolanar baala harɛ la pera ó ɛ ya kapɛrɛ kon.” Anomanta, Josua tɛ bihaahna ne ba lolanar bibaala bwa harɛre ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la.
A waa Manasɛ dea tena dɔ harɛ la bɔre fi dɛ ja Gelead ne Basan harɛ aa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la wee leebɔr, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Manasɛ dea bihaahna la, ne ba lolanar bibaala la dɔ harɛ bɛl o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.
Gelead harɛ la baa ɛ Manasɛ naanar baa kaa la ɡe kapɛrɛ kon.
Manasɛ dea tena harɛ le Aasa dea tena harɛ ta dɛ kaa bwɛjen Mekmɛtat, Sɛkem wee leebɔr.
Harɛ la jwɛh chɔɔ kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ che bela kaa bela nɛra bane aa soɡa baa yerɛ bela Ɛn Tapua.
Manasɛ dea tenaa dɔ Tapua harɛ la, kɛ Tapua bwɛdaa waa lɔ ba harɛ jwɛh ta la te ɛ Efrem dea tena kon.
Harɛ la jwɛh kaalɔ ka tel Kana nenabɔjeɡa ta.
Dɛ bwɛjena ane lɔ nenabɔɔ la weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ do Manasɛ dea harɛ ta, kɛ dɛ ɛ Efrem dea tena kwa.
Manasɛ dea tena harɛ la jwɛh berɔ kpɔ nenabɔɔ la weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ ka chiɡ Mɛdetereenea Mpo la ta.
Efrem dea tena harɛ lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ Manasɛ dea tena kon do weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Manasɛ dea tena harɛ kaa chiɡ Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta, ba ne Aasa dea tena harɛ jwɛh ta do weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, asɛ ba ne Isaaka dea tena jwɛh ɡe do wee leebɔr.
Isaaka dea tena harɛ ne Aasa dea tena harɛ ta la, Manasɛ dea tena dɔ bwɛjena.
Anee Bɛt San ne Ibleam ne Dɔr ne Ɛndɔr ne Taanak ne Meɡido dɛ a bwɛɛre aa bara.
Manasɛ dea tena la ta wone doŋi nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjena la ta, anomanta, Keenan tena la kwaarɔ so bela.
A habɔɔ Israel tena aa baa do kpeɡri la, ba ta Keenan tena la bwa doŋe.
Ba ɡelɔ ba so dɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Asɛ Josef naanar ir la Josua be dɛ ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa he tɛ yaa harɛ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ɡbo o ɛ ya kapɛrɛ kon nɔɔ?
Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ yaa, dɛ́ ɡel ya warɛ.” Anee Josua chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ he warɔ asɛ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ la aa kanɛ tɛ heya aa, hé kaa Pɛrɛs ne Refa tena kɔne la bini, dɛ́ ka parɛ bela dɛ́ so.” Asɛ Josef dea bii la ŋɔ, “Deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa la aa kanɛ tɛ yaa, kɛ Keenan tena baa soɡe harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa ta la, ba dɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ba vɔwa dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre, ba ne Bɛt San tena ne o bwɛɛre aa baro, dɛ banɔ la baa soɡe Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen la ta bwa.” Josua ŋɔ Efrem ne Manasɛ deene tena la be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, he warɔ, dɛ do kpeɡri ɡe kohona.
Hɛɛ dɔ bɛlee dɛ́ kpɔ deŋɡarere harɛ waa ɛ kɔr la ɡe ja.
Hé teŋni kɔr la daa la, dɛ́ parɔ kaa sie.
A lole kɛŋɔ Keenan tena dɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ba vɔwa pɛl jaɡre dɛ do kpeɡri te, kɛ hɛɛ won doŋ ba le.”
Josua harɛ la kabora bɔna Israel tena aa yo harɛ la tonɛ la, ba bwa kaa cheme bwɛjen Silo ta, belaa sɔfore la ne ba bala baŋre Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr, kɛ dɛ a ta ka Israel deene anuanɛ nɛra baa wola harɛre dɔe a ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwaa mɔɔ.
Asɛ Josua pɛɛ Israel tena la ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he so ka tel mɔɔ, dɛ́ ta ka lɛ harɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ la aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa laɔ?
Hé le nɛra batoro le dea bɛlbwa ta ba tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n tom ba bá ka ɡaaɡe harɛ la ta, dɛ́ nyiŋi bela baa dɛ nyin dɛ́ chwerɛ o wa, ɡɛ bɛlbwa kapɛrɛ kon aa doa, ásɛ dɛ berɛ ba n be.
