Hé bɔne harɛ la bini bɔre anuanɛ tɛɛ ba.
Juda dea tena so ba harɛ ta weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ásɛ Josef naanar ɡe so ba harɛ ta weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Hé chwerɛ harɛ la bɔre anuanɛ la bɛlbwa waa tonaa, hé kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ.
Ásɛ n bil daa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la sie tɛ heya.
Lewi dea tena te aa harɛ la peraa dɔ he bini, ba kapɛrɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ Korowii sɔfore dɛɛ di a ta.
Dɛ Gad ne Rubin deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena te dɔ ba harɛre a ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwa Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr bela wubwa.
Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis bɔna tɛɛ ba.” Ate, nɛra la chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ kaa harɛ la ta ɡɛ Josua aa do ba la.
Mɔɔ baa kaa la, o dalawe waa la ta ja ŋɔ, “Hé ka ɡaaɡe harɛ la ta, dɛ́ chwerɛ ɡɛ o waa aa doa ba tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n bil daa Korowii sie Silo bonɔ tɛ heya.” Asɛ nɛra la kaa, dɛ ka ɡaaɡe harɛ la bwa ta, dɛ chwerɛ wobɛlbwa ɡɛ báa bɔne bwɛɛ bɛlbwa waa lɔ o ta bele anuanɛ, dɛ berɛ ba Josua be Silo bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la.
Ate, o bil daa Korowii sie Silo bela tɛɛ ba, asɛ dɛ bɔne harɛ la tɛ Israel deene aa kaa la.
Bɛnjamen dea tena harɛ baa dɔa Bɛnjamen dea lolanaree tɔ sie dɔ ba harɛ.
O chɔ Juda dea tena harɛ ne Josef naanar harɛ baah ta.
Bɛnjamen dea harɛ la jwɛh pa mun le Jɔɔdan Moo weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ kaa Jeriko weekaŋle nyunduabɔr deŋɡarere harɛ ta, dɛ ba jaɡɛ Bɛt Avɛn pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Ba jwɛh la berɔ kpɔ bwɛjen Lus, weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ wili kaa Atarɔt Adaa, deŋɡare bɛl ta Bɛt Hɔrɔn harɛbɔr.
Jwɛh la berɔ kpɔ bobɛl dɛ ba kpɔ bwe la wee cholibɔr, dɛ berɛ kpɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ kaa Kiriat Baal, waa ɛ Juda dea tena harɛ ta.
Ba jwɛh waa lɔ wee cholibɔr laanee la.
O weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh ɡe kpɔ bwɛjen Kiriat Jearim dahare wee cholibɔr, asɛ ba jwɛh ba jaɡɛ Neftoa bule ta.
Harɛ la jwɛh berɔ le bela dɛ kpɔ bwejen bɛl lɔɡa o sie aa chaɡɛ Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen ta, o lɔ Refaim Fɛlembɔjen weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Dɛ kpoŋe kaa Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen ta dɛ kaa Jebus tena bwɛjen Jerusalam harɛbɔr, weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ kaa Ɛn Roɡel nee nyoa.
O berɔ ɡole kpɔ weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ kaa Ɛn Sɛmɛs nee nyoa, ne Gelilɔt o sie aa chaɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa Adumim, dɛ che bela kaa Rubin bibaa Bohan ŋwam ta.
O berɔ kpɔ Bɛt Araba weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Moo Fɛlembɔjen bini.
Dɛ berɛ kpɔ Bɛt Hoɡla harɛbɔr weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ ba le Yar Mpo la ta bela Jɔɔdan Moo la aa baa su o ta.
Belaa ɛ harɛ la weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh ta.
Jɔɔdan Moo laanee ba wee leebɔr harɛ jwɛh ta.
Gɛɛ harɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena kapɛrɛ kon baa bɔna lolanar ta la jwɛhre la bwa waa do.
Bwɛjena aa ɛ Bɛnjamen dea lolanar kwaa laanee Jeriko ne Bɛt Hoɡla dɛ Ɛmɛk Kesis, ne Bɛt Araba ne Semaraem dɛ Bɛtel, ne Avim ne Para dɛ Ofra, ne Kefa Amɔne ne Ofni dɛ Geba.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Ane ɡee Gebeɔn ne Rama dɛ Beɛrɔt, ne Mispa ne Kefira dɛ Moosa, ne Rekem ne Irpeel dɛ Tarala, ne Sɛla ne Haelef ne Jebus, ne Gebea dɛ Kiriat Jearim.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anaarɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Harɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena lolanar aa dɔa o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon laanee la.
Simeon dea tena harɛ baa dɔa Simeon dea tena lolanar harɛ ɡee teŋa nɛɛ ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Harɛ baa dɔa la lɔ Juda dea tena harɛ baah ta.
Bwɛjena laanee Beɛseeba ne Seeba dɛ Molada, ne Hasar Sual ne Bala dɛ Esem, ne Ɛltola ne Bɛtol dɛ Hɔrma, ne Siklaɡ ne Bɛt Makabɔt dɛ Hasar Susa, ne Bɛt Lebaot dɛ Sarohen.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ atoro, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Ane ɡee Ain ne Remɔn ne Ɛta dɛ Asan, a ɡe lɔ bwɛjena anaarɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre, ne bwɛjeɡre aa bara dɛ kpoŋe ka le Baalat Beɛ, o do weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Simeon dea tena lolanar harɛ baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon laanee la.
Dɛ Juda dea tena harɛ baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la kan kohona to, asɛ ba pere o pera ja Simeon dea tena kon ta o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon.
Sebulon dea tena harɛ baa dɔa Sebulon dea lolanar harɛɛ teŋa tooro ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Ba harɛ jwɛh la kaa tel wee leebɔr bwɛjen Sarid ta.
O chɔɔ kaa wee cholibɔr dɛ kaa bwɛjena Marala, dɛ le bela kaa Dabesɛt, dɛ kpoŋe ka le fɛlembɔjen bɛl waa chɔ Jokneam wee leebɔr.
Jwɛh la berɔ le Sarid wee leebɔr, dɛ kaa Keslɔt Tabɔ harɛ ta, dɛ teŋɛ ka le bwɛjen Daberat, dɛ ka tel bwɛjen Jafia.
O teŋɔ kpɔ wee leebɔr ɡɛ dɛ kaa bwɛjena Gat Hɛfa ne Ɛt Kasin, dɛ ka le Remɔn dɛ che bela ɡole kaa Nea.
Jwɛh la le bela dɛ ɡole kpɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛ kaa bwɛjen Hanatɔn, dɛ ka jaɡɛ Ifta Ɛl Fɛlembɔjen ta.
Anɔ la aa jaa ɡee Katat ne Nahalal ne Simron ne Idala dɛ Bɛtlɛham.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Gɛ bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre lɔ Sebulon dea tena lolanar harɛ baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon la ta.
Isaaka dea tena harɛ baa dɔa Isaaka dea tena lolanar harɛɛ teŋa naarɛ ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Ba harɛ ta bwɛjenaa Jesreel ne Kɛsolɔt dɛ Sunem, ne Hafaraim ne Sion dɛ Anaharat, ne Rabet ne Keseɔn dɛ Ibes, ne Rɛmɛt ne Ɛn Ganim ne Ɛn Hada, dɛ Bɛt Pasɛs.
Ba harɛ la jwɛh kaa tel Tabɔ ne Sahasuma ne Bɛt Sɛmɛs, dɛ ka jaɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la ta.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anumɛl, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Gɛ bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre lɔ Isaaka dea tena lolanar harɛ, baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon la ta.
Aasa dea tena harɛ baa dɔa Aasa dea tena lolanar harɛ ɡee teŋa nue ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Bwɛjena aa lɔ ba harɛ ta laanee, Hɛlkat ne Hali ne Beten dɛ Aksaf, ne Alamɛlɛk ne Amad dɛ Misal.
O wee cholibɔr jwɛh la kaa tel Sehɔ Lebnat ne Kaamɛl Bwejen ta.
Jwɛh la berɔ kpɔ wee leebɔr, dɛ chɔ kaa bwɛjena Bɛt Daɡɔn, dɛ ka tel Sebulon ne Ifta Ɛl Fɛlembɔjen ta.
O berɔ kaa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ kaa bwɛjena Bɛt Ɛmɛk ne Neyɛl, dɛ teŋɛ kpɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr kaa Kabul, ne Ɛbrɔn ne Rehob ne Hamɔn ne Kana, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Sidon.
Ba jwɛh la berɔ berɛ dɛ kaa bwɛjena Rama ne Taaya baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ bara, dɛ teŋe ba kaa Hosa, dɛ ka jaɡɛ mpo ta Aksib harɛ ta, ne Uma ne Afɛk dɛ Rehob.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Gɛ bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre nɔ lɔ Aasa dea tena lolanar harɛ baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon la ta.
Naftale dea tena harɛ baa dɔa Naftale dea tena lolanar harɛɛ teŋa numɛl ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Ba harɛ jwɛh la le Hɛlɛf, dɛ kpoŋe kaa dajen bɛl waa lɔ Saananim, dɛ kaa Adami Nekeb ne Jabneel, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Lakum, dɛ ka chiɡ Jɔɔdan Moo ta.
O berɔ kpɔ wee cholibɔr, dɛ kaa bwɛjena Asnɔt Tabɔ ne Huukok.
O kaa chiɡ Sebulon dea tena harɛ nyoa weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ ka chiɡ Aasa dea tena harɛ ta wee cholibɔr, dɛ berɛ ka chiɡ Jɔɔdan Moo ta wee leebɔr.
Ba bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara laanee Siidim ne Sɛɛr ne Haamat ne Rakat dɛ Kenerɛt, ne Adama ne Rama dɛ Hasɔ, ne Kedes ne Edrei dɛ Ɛn Hasɔ, ne Iron ne Miɡdal Ɛl ne Hɔrma ne Bɛt Anat dɛ Bɛt Sɛmɛs.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ anuanaarɛ, a ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Gɛ bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre nɔɔ ba kpɔ tɛ Naftale dea tena lolanar a ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwa.
Dan dea tena harɛ baa dɔa Dan dea tena lolanar harɛɛ teŋa nuanɛ ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Bwɛjena aa lɔ ba harɛ ta laanee, Sora ne Ɛstaol dɛ Ir Sɛmɛs, ne Saalabim ne Aejalɔn dɛ Itla, ne Ɛlɔn ne Temna dɛ Ekron, ne Ɛlteke ne Gebɛtɔn dɛ Baalat, ne Jehud ne Bɛne Bɛrak dɛ Gat Remɔn, ne Me Jaakɔn ne Rakon, dɛ kpoŋe ka le Jopa harɛ ta bwa.
Dɛ a kpeɡri tɛ Dan dea tena lolanar kɛŋɔ ba lɛ harɛ la, anomanta, ba iro dɛ ka pu bwɛjen Lɛsem tena yo, dɛ kpoo ba dɛ lɛ bela so.
Ba soɡe bela dɛ kpɔ ba nabaa Dan sɔn pao.
Gɛ bwɛjena nɔ ne a bwɛjeɡre nɔ ɛ Dan dea tena lolanar kapɛrɛ kwa.
Josua harɛ waa dɔa Baa bɔne harɛ la tonɛ la, Israel tena tɛ Nun bibaa Josua ɡe ɡbo bɛl o ɛ o kapɛrɛ kon.
Bɔr waa ŋɔa o dɛ nyin laanee ba kpɔ tɛo ɡɛ Korowii fa aa bola la.
Bwɛjen Timnat Seraa ba kpɔ tɛo, o lɔ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta.
Asɛ o berɛ kwaa vɔrɔwe bwɛjen la dɛ so bela.
Gɛɛ sɔfo Eliasa ne Nun bibaa Josua, dɛ Israel deene nomonome la bil daa bela baa soɡa bwɛjen Silo, Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la sie, dɛ bɔne harɛ la tonɛ.
Bwɛjena nɛra aa ka so a ta dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu Korowii ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ bá le bwɛjena nɛra aa chwa ka so a ta, dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu cheɡ, ɡɛ maa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ bol he be la, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola saahnɛ dɛ kpo o dɔŋ la chwa ka so bela, dɛ́ lɛ o nyu le nɛn waa sewa la nɛn bɛl waa dɛ nyin dɛ kpoo bɔ kem la nɔn ta.
Dɛ naate chwao dɛɛ kaa bwɛjena la bɛlbwa ta naa, ó ka che o doonyoa, dɛ́ bol ɡɛ waa ɛa baɡle bwɛjena la nomonome, mɔɔ ba den lɛo dɛ́ tɛo bɔr o ne ba so.
Naate waa dɛ nyin dɛ́ kpoo bɔ kem la tiu la bela aa, bwɛjen la tena bɛ nɛn baa lɛo so la le tɛo, saahna waa wola saahnɛ dɛ kpo o dɔŋ la wa.
Bwɛɛ la tena ɡel ó so bela ka tel kɛŋɔ baa cheme, dɛ́ nyiŋi naate waa kpo nɛn dɛ chwa ba ba be la waa bini.
Sɔfo nomoa waa soɡe le ɡɛ saŋ la ɡe chɛ kɛ ó sewɛ mɔɔ naate waa kpo nɛn la won dɔ bɔr kaa bwɛɛ waa le o ta ba.” Asɛ Israel tena la le bwɛjen Kedes waa lɔ Galilia harɛ dɛ do Naftale dea deŋɡarere ta.
Dɛ le bwɛjen Sɛkem waa lɔ Efrem dea tena harɛ deŋɡarere ta, dɛ bwɛjen Kiriat Aaba, o do Juda dea tena harɛ deŋɡarere ta.
Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr pera, deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa bwɛjen Jeriko wee leebɔr ɡe, ba le bwɛjen Bɛsa waa lɔ Rubin dea harɛ ta ne bwɛjen Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ, o lɔ Gad dea tena harɛ ta, dɛ bwɛjen Golan waa lɔ Basan harɛ, o ɡe aa lɔ Manasɛ dea tena harɛ ta.
Gɛ bwɛjena nɔɔ Korowii che Mosis nɛɛ ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ bá le cheɡ, ásɛ dɛ ba bini bɛlbwa kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe ba bini ta saahnɛ kpo nɛn baa nyinu dɛ́ kpo aa, ó chwa ka so a ta.
Asɛ naate waa dɛ nyinu dɛ́ kpo bɔ kem la bɛ on kpo, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ ɡɛ bwɛjen waa chwaa ka so o ta la tena bwaa chema, dɛ́ nyiŋi naate waa kpo nɛn la waa bini mɔɔ.
Lewi dea tena bwɛjena Lewi dea lolanar nomonome la sɔfo Eliasa ne Nun bibaa Josua, dɛ Israel deene la lolanar nomonome kar be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Korowii cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ hé tɛ yaa bwɛjena ya so, ne bɔra ya kondɛɛra aa dɛɛ di.” Gɛ saŋee Israel tena la bwa baŋre ba tɛnte deene, dɛ ta so Silo waa lɔ Keenan harɛ ta bela la.
Anomanta, Israel tena la tɛ Lewi dea tena la bwɛjena ane, ne ba kondɛɛra dibɔra, dɛ le ba harɛre ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la.
Kohat dea tena lolanar baa le Lewi deaa ba tɔ sie tɛ bwɛɛre.
Asɛ Lewi dea tena baa le sɔfo Arɔn luɡe ta ɡe, ba tɛɛ ba bwɛjena fi dɛ atoro dɛ le Juda ne Simeon dɛ Bɛnjamen deene harɛre ta.
Kohat dea lolanar bane baa kaa ɡe dɔ bwɛjena fi dɛ le Efrem ne Dan deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera harɛ ta.
Gɛsɔn dea lolanar ɡe, ba tɛɛ ba bwɛjena fi dɛ atoro dɛ le Isaaka ne Aasa ne Naftale deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera harɛ waa lɔ Basan harɛ ta.
Merari dea lolanar ɡe, ba tɛɛ ba bwɛjena fi dɛ anɛ dɛ le Rubin ne Gad dɛ Sebulon deene harɛre ta.
Gɛɛ a do Israel tena la bɔne bwɛjena ne kondɛɛra dibɔra tɛ Lewi dea tena la, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ bol ba be la.
Bwɛjena ane aa le Juda ne Simeon deene harɛre ta ba kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena laanee, a ɡɛ bwɛjena baa kpɔa tɛ Kohat dea lolanar baa le Arɔn luɡe ta, dɛ le Lewi dea bini la, banee ba tɔ sie tɛ.
Bwɛjen Kiriat Aaba waa lɔ Juda dea deŋɡarere harɛ ta, ne ba kondɛɛra dibɔraa Israel tena kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Anak nabaa sɔne Aaba.
Bwɛjen la harɛpare ne o bwɛjeɡre te, dɛ ba kpɔɔ tɛ Jefune bibaa Kaleb o ɛ o kapɛrɛ kon.
Bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn habɔɔ la, o ɛ bwɛɛ baa lea cheɡ dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so o ta dɛ dɔ o nyu, Arɔn waa ɛ sɔfo naanar bwɛjena baa tɛɛ ba teŋa nɔ, Lebna ne Jatir dɛ Ɛstemoa, ne Holon dɛ Debir, ne Ain ne Juta dɛ Bɛt Sɛmɛs.
A lɔ bwɛjena anuanaarɛ, a bwa ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra dɛ le Juda ne Simeon deene harɛre ta.
Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta ɡe, bwɛjena baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba laanee, Gebeɔn ne Geba, ne Anatɔt ne Almɔn, dɛ a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
A lɔ bwɛjena anaarɛ.
Arɔn naanar baa ɛ sɔfore bwɛjena baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la lɔ fi dɛ atoro, ane a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Kohat dea tena lolanar kabora baa le Lewi dea la, ba dɔ bwɛjena ane le Efrem dea harɛ ta.
Bwɛjena anaarɛɛ ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Anee Sɛkem ne o kondɛɛra dibɔra waa lɔ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta.
O ɛ bwɛɛ dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so o ta, dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
Bwɛɛre la ane ɡee, Gɛsa, ne Kebsaim ne Bɛt Hɔrɔn, dɛ a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Dan dea harɛ ta ɡe, ba dɔ Ɛlteke ne Gebɛtɔn, ne Aejalɔn ne Gat Remɔn, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Manasɛ dea pera tena ɡe dɔ Taanak ne Gat Remɔn, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra.
A lɔ bwɛjena anɛ.
A ɡɛ bwɛjena la ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra la, Kohat dea lolanar kaboraa ba kpɔ tɛ.
Gɛsɔn tena lolanar baa le Lewi dea la, ba tɛɛ ba bwɛjena anɛ.
Manasɛ dea pera harɛ ta la, Golan ɛ bwɛɛ dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so o ta, dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
O lɔ Basan harɛ ta, bɛl ɡee Be Ɛstɛra, dɛ a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Isaaka dea ɡe harɛ ta, Gɛrsɔn dea lolanar dɔ Keseɔn ne Daberat, ne Jaamut dɛ Ɛn Ganim.
A lɔ bwɛjena anaarɛ, a ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Ba berɔ dɔ bwɛjena ane le Aasa dea ɡe harɛ ta, anee Misal ne Abdɔn, ne Hɛlkat dɛ Rehob.
A lɔ bwɛjena anaarɛ, a ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Naftale dea harɛ ta ɡe, bwɛjena baa dɔa laanee Kedes, o ɛ bwɛɛ dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so o ta, dɛ́ dɔ o nyu, o lɔ Galilia harɛ ta, ne Hamɔt Dɔr ne Kaatan.
A lɔ bwɛjena atoro, ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Gɛsɔn dea lolanar bwɛjena baa dɔa lɔ fi dɛ atoro, a ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Merari dea lolanar kabora ɡe bwɛjena baa dɔa dɛ le Sebulon dea harɛ ta laanee, Jokneam ne Kaata, ne Dimna dɛ Nahalal.
A lɔ bwɛjena anaarɛ, a ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Ba berɔ dɔ bwɛjena ane le Rubin dea tena ɡe be.
Anee Bɛsa ne Jahas, ne Kedemɔt dɛ Mɛfaat.
A lɔ bwɛjena anaarɛ, a ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Ba berɔ dɔ bwɛjena ane le Gad dea.
Anee Ramɔt, o ɛ bwɛɛ dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so o ta, dɛ́ dɔ o nyu, o lɔ Gelead harɛ ta, ne Mahanaim, ne Hɛsbɔn dɛ Jasa.
A lɔ bwɛjena anaarɛ, a ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Lewi dea kabora, baa ɛ Merari dea lolanar bwɛjena baa dɔa lɔ fi dɛ anɛ.
Lewi dea tena bwɛjena baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba Israel harɛ ta bwa lɔ fifraanaarɛ dɛ anuatoro, a ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra.
A ɡɛ bwɛjena nɔ bɛlbwa dɔ kondɛɛra dibɔra a baro cheme, dɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ ɡe.
Korowii teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta Gɛɛ a do Korowii kpɔ harɛ waa baɡɛ Israel tena nyoa ŋɔ, wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ ba naawa la tɛɛ ba, asɛ ba ka kpɔ o ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon dɛ so o ta.
Korowii ɡelɔ ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ɡɛ waa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa la.
Ba dɔma bɛlbwa ta wone che ba sie, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii cha ba ba won dɛɛ pɔ ba dɔma bwa nɛ.
Korowii ta nyoa waa baɡɛ Israel tena la bɛlbwa tae, o teŋɛ a bwa ta.
Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera dem kaala Josua yerɛ Rubin ne Gad deene, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera nɛra cheme, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa do heyaa a ta la tonɛ, dɛ berɛ teŋɛ n waa maa do heyaa a ta la ɡe bwa ta.
Le saŋ la bwa dɛ ba le fini, he ta he bala Israel tena chae ɡelɛ.
He ta waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la bɛlbwa vɛɛh.
Gɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa ɡela he bala la dɔ bosɔɔhna ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la nomanta, hé berɛ kaa harɛre Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr la ta.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ Mmara Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa do heyaa a ta la soh.
O ŋɔ hé nyin N Naa Korowii dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa ta, dɛɛ tomɔ he bambile bwa, ne he hweera bwa ne.” Asɛ Josua swee ba andɛɛɡa, dɛ ta ba ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa ba sobɔra.
Dɛ Mosis dɔɔ tɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena la harɛ o do Basan harɛ ta, asɛ ba kabora la, Josua tɛ ba dɔɔranar ne nimanar ɡe harɛ Jɔɔdan Moo wee cholibɔr pera.
Josua ta ba ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ swee ba andɛɛɡa baa kaa bela baa soɡa, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé dɔma laala haa paa laa ta la ɡelɔ he ɛ kondɔɔhna kohona.
He dɔ kondɛɛra kohona, ne suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ne ayaawa ne bune, dɛ yale pirim.
Hé kpɔ a bwa kaa, ásɛ he ne he bala la ka bɔne.” Asɛ Rubin ne Gad deene, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena la le bela bane Israel tena laa soɡa bwɛjen Silo, o lɔ Keenan harɛ ta, dɛ laa berɛ ba kaa ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta Gelead, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ do ba la.
Saraha kon baa ɛo cheɡ Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa Baa kaa tel Gelilɔt, Keenan harɛ waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa wee cholibɔr pera la, Rubin ne Gad dɛ Manasɛ dea pera deene ma kon baa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii cheɡ Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa bela, o kan dɛ do wer kɛrɛdɛ.
Israel tena kabora la aa noa kɛŋɔ Rubin ne Gad, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera deene la ma kon baa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii Gelilɔt ba harɛ ta la, ba bwa chemo Silo bela kɛŋɔ ba la ka puu ba yo.
Anomanta, Israel tena la tomɛ sɔfo Eliasa bibaa Fenehas a ɡɛ deene la nɛra be, Gelead harɛ ta bela.
Israel tena la le baala fi le dea bɛlbwa ta ja Fenehas nɛ.
Ba ɛ nomonnyuune dɛ chɔ dea lolanar nyoo, dɛ le Israel deene kabora la bɛlbwa ta.
Asɛ ba la Gelead harɛ ta bela Rubin ne Gad deene, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera la be ka ŋɔ, “Ya cheɡɛ Korowii nɛra naa ta dɛɛ bɔɔ heya kɛŋɔ, Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ wechɔɡa aa do ken nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona le o habɔɔ dɛ́ ka ma kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ he te nɔ?
He vɛh o nɛɛ teŋa.
Ya wechɔɡa yaa ɛ Korowii Peɔ ɡɛ saŋ yaa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe o tɛr ya deŋne la ɡbo ta maɡraa?
A lole kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ weechɔɡa ba ta ya nɛɛ te, kɛ ya ta charɛ, wechɔɡa la ta lɔ ya nɛɛ dɛ ba le fini.
He laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ Korowii nɛɛ taraken ja aa?
He vɛoh fini naa, kere o baah ɛɛ di Israel tena bwa nɛɛ.
Dɛ hé dɛ lii kɛ he harɛ baa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la kah doŋa aa, hé le Jɔɔdan baŋ, dɛ́ ba so harɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea aa lɔ o ta nɔ.
He bɛ sie laa kpɔ Korowii nɛɛ kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ yaa berɛ dɔma, dɛ́ ma kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ he te ja Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ kon nɔ ta.
Hé lii ɡɛ saŋ Sɛra bibaa Akan aa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii la wa.
Korowii baah ta Israel tena bwa nɛɛ dii o tɛr ba deŋne aa?
Akan ɡbo laa sewa o wechɔɡa wa.” Asɛ Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ soŋe Nemenɛ Korowii waa do kpeɡri, ásɛ o ɛ ya danseɛ, ásɛ Israel tena jemɛ kɛŋɔ saraha kon yaa mao tɛ ya te nɔ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, kɛɛ dɛ vɛɛh ya vɛoh waa, ó bɛ yaa ɡel fini.
Dɛ ya ɛo deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ ma ya ɡbaɡba saraha kon dɛɛ fuh kwaa o ta, kɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ mea saraha kɛɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha o ta naa, Korowii ɡbaɡba tɛr ya deŋne.
Ɔmaa ya ɔmɛ dɛ ɛ ɡɛ, dɛkalkɛ kerekere he naanar ɛɛ ba bɔɔ ya naanaree ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa binii he ne Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ doɔ?’ Korowii kpɔ Jɔɔdan Moo ɛ ya ne he Rubin dea ne Gad dea jwɛh.
He ne Korowii toole wobɛlbwa bini, ásɛ he naanar ba ɡel yá ɡel Korowii toma.
A waa ya ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel ya pa mun ma saraha kon, kɛ dɛ fuh kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha kɛɛ dɛɛ kpoo kwaa o ta waa laa.’ Akai!
Ya mao kɛŋɔ ó ɛ ya ne heya ne ya naanar baa ka ba la danseɛ kɛŋɔ yaa tomɛ Korowii o Dea la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ne kwaa baa kpoora ne sarahare dɛɛ ba o sie.
Gɛ aa ɛ kerekere he naanar bɛ ba ŋɔ ya naanar ne Korowii toole wobɛlbwa bini.
Asɛ ya ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ ba baa bɔɔ ya ne ya naanar aa, yaa ŋɔɔ, “Hé na kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii ya naawa aa maa la siwi.
Kwaa fuih kɛɛ kwaa kpoora o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii waa laa ba mao, kɛ o ɛ ya ne he baah danseɛ kon.” ’ Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛ ya ɛo deŋnekpeɡ dɛ́ vɛh o nɛɛ teŋa, dɛ́ ma saraha kon baa dɛ fuh kwaa dɛɛ tɛo ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ ɛ mea saraha kɛɛ dɛɛ kpoo kwaa o ta, dɛ́ le onɔ la baa mao o che Korowii Tɛnte Dea sie la.” Sɔfo Fenehas ne nomonome fi baa ja o nɛɛ la aa no ɡɛ Rubin ne Gad deene, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera aa ŋɔa la, a do ba som.
Ate, sɔfo Eliasa bibaa Fenehas ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ya jemɔ name kɛŋɔ Korowii ja ya nɛɛ fini, he ta he te laa kpɔ Korowii nɛɛ waa nɔ ta, he lɛ Israel tena bwa nyu le tɛra Korowii fe aa tɛr he deŋne la ta.” Belaa sɔfo Eliasa bibaa Fenehas, ne nomonome baa ja o nɛɛ la le Gelead harɛ bela baa cheme Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea tena la, dɛ ba Keenan harɛ ta dɛ ba bol Israel tena la be.
Israel tena kabora aa no waa la la, ba sie lɛo dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii.
Ba ta berɛ lii kɛŋɔ baa vɔrɔwe laa, dɛ́ ka chɔɡ harɛ Rubin ne Gad deene aa soɡe o ta laanee kpa.
Asɛ Rubin ne Gad deene tena ŋɔ, “Saraha kon nɔ ɛ danseɛ tɛ ya bwa kɛŋɔ Korowiirii ya dɔɔ.” Asɛ dɛ pa o sɔn “Danseɛ.”
Josua kal Israel nomonome Korowii baa ɡel Israel tena dɔ ba te ba dɔma nɔn ta biɡri, dɛ Josua hwɛɛhrɔ kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, Josua yerɛ Israel tena, ne nomonome bwa dɛ nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole cheme dɛ ŋɔ, “Taraken, n hwɛɛhrɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Hé ɡbabir na ɡɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa koh he waa dɛ ɛ harɛre nɛra ba fa aa soɡe bonɔ.
Dɛ on Korowiirii yoa dɛɛ tɛ heya.
Hé na kɛŋɔ, n kpɔ harɛ aa kaa maa wola yoi lɛ la, ne anɔ la maa yoa lɛ la bwa tɛ he Israel deene kɛ á ɛ he kapɛrɛ kwa.
Harɛ la le Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr, dɛ kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta wee cholibɔr.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma chwa le he sie.
Wɛɛ doŋ baa tɔ sie, ásɛ he ka kpɔ ba harɛ la ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ teŋɛ nyobaɡa nɔ taa, dɛ́ doŋi harɛre nɛra ba taa ka o ta la.
Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ waa Mosis aa chwera do Korowii Mmara tɔn la bini la, dɛ bɛ ba koni.
Hé laa he te kpɔ harɛre nɛra baa kaa he ne ba so nɔ nɛ, he bɛ ba voɡare sɔna dɛɛ yerɛ kɛɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛra.
He bɛ an tomɛ, he bɛ an ɡuŋi ɡe.
Hé kpɔ he te pɛl Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la kiŋkiŋ, ɡɛ haa ɛa dɛ ba le fini nɔ.
Korowii doŋi harɛre aa kana dɛ do kpeɡri nɛra le he sie, ba le fini bɛlbwa ta wone ba che he sie kpa.
He bini beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ won doŋi kɛɛ dɛ́ pɔ laa tena kaɡboŋ nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee yoa dɛɛ tɛ heya, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.
Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ nyin Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la wa.
Kɛ dɛ he kpɔ he te ka pɛ ɡɛ nɛra baa kaa he ne ba so nɔ nɛ, dɛ mo ba bihaahna asɛ ba ɡe mo he kwa aa, ate he jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa he sie tɔ dɛ́ doŋ ba tɛ heyaa kpa.
Baa doo kɛŋɔ bela ken dɛ́ tɛ heya, ne chweremi dɛɛ cha he nyaŋ ta, dɛ sɔɔhne aa tɔɡre he sibie, ka tel kɛŋɔ he bwa aa serewa le harɛdɛɛɡe nɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa nɔ ta.” Josua ŋɔ, “N tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ n sewɛ.
Hé bwa jemɛ he bambile ne he liire bwa bini kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ wedɛɛɡa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la bwa ɛɔ beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.
Gɛ Korowii aa wona baɡɛ heyaa nyoa a bwa won ɛ nɔ, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba wona chɔɡ heya, ka tel kɛŋɔ waa kpoo heyaa le harɛdɛɛɡe nɔ waa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta.
Dɛ he koni fɔo he ne Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la aa fɔwa o do heyaa a ta la, dɛ berɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa dɛɛ ɡuŋa aa, o baah ɛɛ di he nɛɛ kohonaa, ásɛ he serewe le harɛdɛɛɡe waa kpɔa tɛ heyaa nɔ ta.”
Josua bol waa Israel tena be Sɛkem Josua berɔ yerɛ Israel deene la bwa, ba nomonome la ne nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole bwa cheme bwɛjen Sɛkem.
Baa tel bela la, o yerɛ ba bwa ka che Korowii sie.
Asɛ Josua ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korowii ya Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘A saŋ la, he nabaala fa soɡe Yufretis Moo la baŋ le dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa.
Ba bini bɛlee Tɛɛra waa ɛ Abraham ne Neehɔ bwa mɛɛ.
Asɛ n lawɛ he nabaa Abraham le Yufretis Moo la baŋ bela, dɛ tɔ o sie ba o ne Keenan harɛ ta, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛo o dɔ naanar warɛ.
O lolɛ Aesek, asɛ Aesek lolɛ Jekɔb ne Esɔ.
N kpɔ Edom deŋɡarere harɛ tɛ Esɔ, asɛ Jekɔb te ne o bibaala kaa Ijipt harɛ ta.
A habɔɔ la, n tomɛ Mosis ne Arɔn, dɛ ɡel ba kpɔ wahala ta Ijipt tena nɛ, asɛ n lawɛ heyaa le he dɔ he te.
Maa lawɛ he naawa le Ijipt harɛ la, asɛ Ijipt tena so torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre ta, ne laa tena baa soɡe jaɡre ta ti ba ka tel Mposwɛm ta.
Ba wio no men Korowii ŋɔ ń cha ba, asɛ n ɡel bɔr bir ba ne Ijipt tena la baah ta.
Anee n ɡel mpo la nee su ba bɔle ba nɛ.
He ɡbabir na ɡɛ maa ɛ Ijipt tena la.
Asɛ he so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ biɡri taeh.
N ba he ne Amɔre tena harɛ waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr la ta.
He ne ba yoo, asɛ n che he mun ta he pɔ ba nɛ, asɛ he ka kpɔ ba harɛ la ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon.
Dɛ Sepɔ bibaa Balak di kora Moab harɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ.
O kpɔ o te dɛ ka yo Israel tena, dɛ ɡel Beɔ bibaa baa dɛ yerɔ Balam no kɛŋɔ ó ba dɛ́ ba taah heya.
Kɛ n ta sɛɛh o taah heya, n ɡelɔ o swee heyaa andɛɛɡa kohona, dɛ lɛ heyaa le o nɔn ta.
Asɛ he le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ dɛ ba bwɛjen Jeriko ta.
Jeriko tena yo heya, ɡɛɛ Amɔre tena ɡe ne Pɛrɛs ne Keenan ne Hiti ne Girɡasi ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena ɡe yo heya, kɛ n ɡelɔ he pɔ ba nɛ.
N ɡelɔ jeŋibotoola tɔ he sie dɛ ba doŋ ba, bane Amɔre tena koranar banɛ la.
Hɛma ne keri laa he kpɔ yoo ba.
N tɛ heyaa harɛ haa wola o ta koɛh, dɛ so bwɛjena aa wera haa wola an vɔrɔwɛ ta, dɛ di daa kooni ne ɔleve kooni nɔna haa wola an due.’ ” Asɛ Josua berɛ ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ kasinteŋ ne.
Hé pa he naawa voɡa baa toma Yufretis Moo la baŋ le ne Ijipt harɛ ta la ta, ásɛ dɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡbo.
Dɛ a ta maɡrɛ he be kɛŋɔ hé tomɛ Korowii aa, amɔ te hé le fini nyin kon haa tomɛ.
Dɛ he naawa voɡare baa toma moo la baŋ le kɛɛ Amɔre tena haa soɡe ba harɛ ta taraken nɔ voɡaree yoo.
N te ne n dem tena te, yaa tomɛ Korowiirii.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛŋɔ ya ɡel o toma, dɛ́ berɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔɔ le ya ne ya naawa le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ya ɛ yoma bela.
Ya na nyokpowaa kohona waa ɛa.
O kpɔ nɔn tɔ ya nɛɛ ya vala bini bwa, ne harɛre yaa kpɔ a ta bwa.
Onee doŋi harɛre nɛra bwa ya sie, ne Amɔre tena bwa ba fa aa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta la.
Ya ɡee tomɔɔ, onee Korowii aa chɛ kɛŋɔ yá tomɛ.” Ate, Josua ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “He ken aa won tomɛ Korowii, o do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ we bwara.
Waa he kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe ne he wechɔɡaa kpɔ kɛ heya.
He bɛ Korowii toma ɡel, dɛ́ kaa tomɛ harɛre ane voɡa.
A lole kɛŋɔ o fa ɛ wedɛɛɡa tɛ heya te, o bandia ɛɛ ir he nɛɛ ó tɛr he deŋne ka tel kɛŋɔ waa chɔɡ heyaa kwaraa.” Asɛ Nɛra la bwa ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Akai!
Korowiirii yaa ba toma.” Anee Josua ŋɔ, “Heyaa he ɡbaɡba danseɛ kɛŋɔ haa le Korowii cheɡ ŋɔ onee hɛ́ɛ ba toma nɔ.” Ba ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, ya ɛ ya ɡbaɡba danseɛ.” Josua ŋɔ, “Amɔ te hé pa harɛre ane voɡare aa lɔ he be la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ he bambili bwa tɛ Korowii he Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la.” Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɡboo yaa ba toma, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ waa waa do yaa a ta la ta.” Awola tɔpere la, Josua ne Israel tena la fɔwɛ fɔo Sɛkem bela baa chema la, asɛ o berɛ kpɔ mmarare ane báa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta tɛɛ ba.
Josua chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ do Korowii Mmara tɔn bini, dɛ berɛ kpɔ bwe damanta bɛl pa dajen bɛl mun, Korowii boɡoroŋ la jwɛh.
Dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé na, bwe nɔɔ ɛ ya bwa danseɛ, o no wobɛlbwa Korowii aa bol ya be.
Wɛɛ ɛ danseɛɛ, dɛ he baa le habɔɔ ŋɔ haa Korowii tomɛ kpa aa, o le heyaa tɛ.” Asɛ Josua ta ba ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa kaa ba harɛre ta.
Josua seo wa Anɔ habɔɔ la, Korowii bonɔɔ Josua baa dɛ yerɛ o mɛɛ Nun baa sewɛ.
Dɛ o di bene lafa dɛ fi.
Ba huɡo o ɡbaɡba harɛ ta Timnat Sera.
O lɔ Efrem deŋɡarere ta, dɛ do Gaas Bwejen weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Israel tena la tomɛ Korowii le ɡɛ saŋ Josua ne baa lole bwa.
Waa sewa habɔɔ kwaraa la, dɛ ba ta teŋɔ dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ nomonoma baa ja Josua nɛ dɛ na nyokpowaa Korowii aa ɛa tɛ Israel tena la bwa ta lole.
Gɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, ba kpɔ Josef hoɡa kaa dɛ ka huɡe Sɛkem.
Harɛ Jekɔb aa yawa le Sɛkem bibaa Hamɔ bibaala be suuɡapoŋa lafa la ta.
Harɛ la baa ɛ Josef naanar kapɛrɛ kon.
Sɔfo Eliasa ɡe baa sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo bwɛjen Gebea harɛ waa ɛ o bibaa Fenehas kon ta.
O lɔ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Dɛ Korowii aa nyin kɛ o nɛra Israel tena dɔ kooro ɡɛ harɛre ane aa dɔa la, dɛkalkɛ o ɡbabirii dɛ́ ɛ Kooro ne ba Lɛɛ.
Dɛ Israel tena waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe dɛɛ tɛo.
Ba berɛ habɔɔ kpo Korowii aa, ɡɛɛ o tɛ harɛre ane nɛra ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ bá ba yoo ba.
Saŋ bɛlbwa baa wi noo ŋɔ ó cha ba la, o yon le sitɔɔ o lɛɛ ba le ba wenaale ta, dɛ́ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ waa toɡra baa kpɔ o ta.
Sitɔɔ la baa sewaa, dɛ ba deno soh Korowii wa, dɛ́ berɛ kaa ɛ wechɔɡa ja.
Kɛ ane a bwa, Korowii waa dɔ kasinteŋ saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ ba berɛ habɔɔ dɛ ba o be dɛ ba wi noo ŋɔ ó cha ba aa, wɛɛ cha baa.
Israel tena yo Keenan tena Josua seo habɔɔ la, Israel tena soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Ya deene nɔ, bamewaa dɛ́ tɔ ya sie yá ka yo Keenan tena ba harɛ ta nɔ?” Anee Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, “Juda dea tenaa dɛ́ tɔ sie mɔɔ.
Banee mɛɛ ba harɛ la kpeɡri kpɔe do ba nɔn ta.” Belaa Juda dea tena ŋɔ ba lolanar Simeon dea tena be ŋɔ, “Harɛ la bela Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ yaa la, Keenan tena soɡe o ta.
Hé ba ja ya nɛɛ yá ka yoo ba.” Anomanta, Simeon dea tena ne Juda dea tena pɛo dɛ la ka yoo ba.
Korowii cha ba asɛ ba pɔ Keenan ne Pɛrɛs tena nɛ, asɛ dɛ kpoo baala kaɡboŋa fi bwɛjen Bɛsɛk.
Belaa ba na Bɛsɛk Kooro Adoni Bɛsɛk dɛ yo o ɡe dɛ won do o ne nɛra la sibeɡra.
Kooro la chwao kaa, asɛ ba tiu dɛ ka lawɔ, dɛ teŋe o nonibala ne o nanibala.
Belaa kooro la ŋɔ, “N fa teŋni koranar fifraanuanɛ nanibala ne nonibala, ba tɔɔ kondikompuɡrere dɛɛ di n tiɡ ta.
Korowiirii ɡela waa maa ɛɛ ba la ɡure n nyu ta la.” Ba kpɔɔ kaa bwɛjen Jerusalam o ka sewɛ.
Juda dea tena kaa yo Jerusalam tena ɡe, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba kpoo nɛra baa lɔ o ta dɛ fuuh.
Baa le bela la, ba kaa yo Keenan tena baa soɡe deŋɡarere harɛ ne bwejena lɔɡre, dɛ Nɛɡɛv waa ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ dɛ chɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Ba berɔ ka pu Keenan tena baa soɡe bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn la yo, dɛ pɔ Sɛsae ne Ahiman dɛ Talmai deene tena nɛ.
Otniel yo bwɛjen Debir tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ Baa le bela la, ba berɔ la ka pu bwɛjen Debir tena ɡe yo.
Asɛ Kaleb ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa won yo Kiriat Sɛfa dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ la, mɛɛ lawɛ n bihaah Aksaa tɛo ó mo.” Kaleb nime Kenas bibaa baa dɛ yerɔ Otniel laanee wona ka yo bwɛɛ la dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Anomanta, Kaleb lawɛ o bihaah la tɛo o mo.
Baa ɛ ba hanfalwaa tonɛ la, o jaa Otniel ŋɔ, “Ka soŋe he mɛɛ ó tɛɛ harɛ.” Asɛ o kpɔ o keeɡo dɛ kaa.
Waa laŋa la o mɛɛ bɔɔro kon waa dɛ nyin.
Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi n nɛ.
He tɛ mɛ harɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ Nɛɡɛv.
Tɛ mɛ bela nee aa bula dɛɛ le ɡe.” Asɛ o ka tɛo harɛ nee aa bula dɛɛ le o ta.
Bɛl do nyunduabɔr, bɛl do harɛbɔr pera.
Mosis helabaa naanar Ken tena le Jeriko, dɛ ba ja Juda dea tena nɛɛ ba ka so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɛra bini waa lɔ Nɛɡɛv, dɛ bɛne bwɛɛ Arad.
Belaa Juda dea tena ne ba lolanar Simeon dea tena pɛ ka yo Keenan tena baa soɡe Sɛfat, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba chɔɡ bwɛɛ la kwaraa, dɛ pa o sɔn Hɔrma.
Juda baala la pɔ Gasa ne Askɛlɔn dɛ Ekron bwɛjena la bwa nɛ ne harɛre aa bara bwa.
Korowii cha Juda dea tena ba pɔ deŋɡarere harɛ tena nɛ, kɛ ba ta wone doŋi bwɛɛre aa chɔ harɛ deŋɡarere aa wola toole a ta la te nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba dɔ bune kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre la ane.
Ba kpɔ bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn tɛ Kaleb, ɡɛ Mosis aa bola la, asɛ o doŋi Anak tena deene atoro nɛra baa lɔ bela la.
Bɛnjamen dea tena ɡe ta wone doŋi Jebus tena baa soɡe bwɛjen Jerusalam, anomanta, ba bwa pɛo so le ɡɛ saŋ bwa ba le fini.
Josef bibaala Efrem ne Manasɛ dea tena kaa yo bwɛjen Bɛtel, asɛ Korowii che ba habɔɔ.
Ba tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá ka sɔh nyiŋi Bɛtel, asɛ nɛra la na baa bɛl kɛ waa le bwɛjen la ta dɛɛ ba.
Asɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Chaɡle yaa ɡɛ yaa ɛ dɛ́ won jo bwɛjen nɔ bini, ásɛ ya bɛ hen wobɛlbwa ɛ.” Anomanta, o baɡ ba, ba jo o bini dɛ ka kpoo bela tena bwa, dɛ ɡel baa la ne o dem nɛra ɡbo.
Baa la la Hiti harɛ ta dɛ ka vɔrɔwe bwɛ, dɛ pa o sɔn Lus.
Ba ta dɛ yerɔ ɡɛ ba le fini.
Manasɛ dea tena ta nɛra baa soɡe bwɛɛ Bɛt San ne Taanak ne Dɔr ne Ibleam ne Meɡido dɛ bwɛɛre aa bara cheme la doŋe, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba sie beɡrɔ kɛŋɔ ba so bela.
Israel tena aa baa dɔ kpeɡri la, ba ɡelɔ Keenan tena la ɛɛ ɛ tomkpeɡa, kɛ ba ta ban doŋe le kwaraa.
Gɛɛ Efrem tena aa wola Keenan tena doŋe le Gɛsa, asɛ ba ne ba pɛ so bela.
Sebulon dea tena ta Keenan tena baa soɡe bwɛjena Ketrɔn ne Nahalal doŋe.
Ba ne ba pɛo so, kɛ tomkpeɡaa ba ɡel baa ɛ. Gɛɛ Aasa dea tena ɡe aa wola nɛra baa lɔ Ako ne Sidon ne Alab ne Aksib ne Hɛlba ne Afɛk kɛɛ Rehob la doŋe.
A ɡɛ nomanta, Aasa dea tena la ne Keenan tena pɛo so harɛ la ta.
Gɛɛ Naftale dea tena ta Keenan tena baa soɡe bwɛjena Bɛt Sɛmɛs ne Bɛt Anat la doŋe, kɛ tomkpeɡaa ba ɡel baa ɛ. Ba ɡe soɡe Keenan tena la baah ta.
Amɔre tena chaɡle ba kpeɡri, ba ta ɡelɛ Dan dea tena so bela waa wera, dɛ ɡel ba ka so deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta.
Ba ta ɡelɛ ba tu ba so harɛ aa chɔa kaa deŋɡarere aa wola toole a ta la ta.
Amɔre tena la sie beɡrɔ ba ta so Heres Bwejen ne Aejalɔn dɛ Saalabim ta.
Kɛ Josef dea tena baa dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ ɡel baa ɛ tomkpeɡa.
Amɔre tena jwɛh chɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔ Akrabim Bwejena baah ta dɛ ka ɡarɛ Sela.
Korowii nyundua torome ba Bokim tena be Korowii nyundua torome le bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Gelɡal dɛ ba bol waa Bokim tena be ŋɔ, “Menee lɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ba he ne harɛ maa baɡɛ he naawa nyoa kɛŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heyaa la ta la.
N bol he be ŋɔ maa fɔo n ne haa fɔwa laanee chɔɡ bwa.
N ŋɔ he ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta la bɛ fɔo bɛlbwa fɔwɛ, dɛ́ kuuɡi kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡa la.
Kɛ he ta waa maa do heyaa a ta la noɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Anomanta, n dɛ bol he be kɛŋɔ maa ban doŋi tɛ heya.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba berɛ sɔɔhne dɛɛ tɔɡre heya, ásɛ ba voɡa ɡe berɛ do kɛŋɔ baa harɛ heyaa bela.” Korowii nyundua torome la aa bol waa nɔ baɡle Israel tena la bwa la, ba wio kohona.
A waa ba pa bela sɔn Bokim.
Ba kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii bela.
Josua seo wa Josua ɡelɔ Israel tena la peɡre, bɛlbwa ka so harɛ waa bɔna tɛɛ ba la ta.
Ba tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ saŋ Josua aa soɡe le la bwa.
O seo habɔɔ ɡba la, ba tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ saŋ bwa nomonome ba siwi aa na wejena Korowii aa ɛa tɛɛ ba la aa lole la.
Korowii bonɔɔ Nun bibaa Josua, dɔ bene lafa dɛ fi mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ.
Ba huɡo harɛ baa bɔna o dɔ la ta, Timnat Heres waa lɔ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta, Gaas Bwejen weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Josua ne o nɛra la kapa aa baa serewe la, bane ɡe iro dɛ baa jemɛ kɛ Korowii lole, á ba ɛ kɛ baa na waa waa ɛa tɛ Israel tena laanee.
Israel tena la ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa Baalre.
Ba vɛh Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ o lɛɛ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la toma, dɛɛ tomɛ nɛra baa soɡa bar ba la voɡa, a ɡel Korowii baah di ba nɛ ɡɛ baa vɛh o toma dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa Baalre ne voɡhaah Astɔrɛt la wa.
Korowii baah aa di Israel tena nɛɛ la, o ɡelɔ nɛra ba lɔ tɔ ba nɛ, dɛ pa ba laala bwa kaa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.
O berɔ kpɔ ba do ba dɔma baa soɡa bar ba la nɔn ta, baa di kpeɡri ba nɛ ba lɛ ba te kahonɛ.
Saŋ bɛlbwa Israel tena aa ka yo laa la, Korowii yon laa nɔn kpɔ ba nɛ, asɛ ba dɔma pɔ ba nɛɛ ɡɛ waa ŋwɛɛra la.
Dɛ ba waa sum kɛrɛdɛ.
Ate, Korowii tɛɛ ba sitɔɔla, asɛ ba lɛɛ ba le nɛra ba yon ba lɔ tɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ pa ba laala la nɔn ta.
Kɛ ba vɛh sitɔɔla la be noe, dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛ voɡa dɛɛ toma.
Ba ta doe kɛŋɔ ba naawa ba fa aa dɛ no Korowii wa dɛɛ teŋɛ waa waa do ba a ta la ta.
Ba vɛh o ŋwɛnɛ ta teŋa buɡ ta.
Saŋ bɛlbwa Korowii aa tɛɛ ba sitɔɔ la, o dɛ chao dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta ɡɛ saŋ sitɔɔ la taa soɡe le la.
Korowii dɔ tedoma dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, wii baa dɛ wi hɔhɔrɔwa nɛra aa dɛ ɛɛ ba la wa.
Kɛ sitɔɔ la baa sewaa, dɛ ba berɔ kaa ba webena aa ɡwaa ba naawa kwaa la, dɛ kaa teŋɛ voɡare nɛɛ dɛɛ toma.
Baa nyin ba ɡel ba wechɔɡa ne ba deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla.
Anomanta, Korowii baah di Israel tena nɛɛ o ŋɔ, “Chɔɡa nɛra nɔ aa chɔɡ fɔo n ne ba naawa aa fɔwa dɛ vɛh n waa noe nɔ, maa harɛre nɛra Josua aa sewa ɡel ba laanee doŋi le ba harɛre ta tɛɛ ba kpa.
Mɛɛ kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔɔ daah Israel tena na kɛ baa dɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ dɛɛ tom mɛ, ɡɛ ba naawa fa aa dɛ ɛ la kɛɛ.” Gɛɛ a do Korowii ɡel nɛra la bane ka harɛ la ta, o ta ban kpɔe do Josua nɔn ta o doŋ ba le harɛ la ta kera beŋkpoŋ.
Harɛre nɛra baa ka Keenan harɛ ta Korowii ɡelɔ a ɡɛ harɛre la nɛra bane so harɛ la ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ daah Israel tena baa wola Keenan harɛ ta laa laŋɛ ka la na.
A ɡbo waa o ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ kpɔ daah Israel tena naanar baa wola laa laŋɛ ka la, ásɛ ba jemɛ laa wa.
Nɛra waa ɡel ba laanee Filisti tena koranar banue, ne Keenan tena bwa, ne Sidon ne Hivi tena baa soɡe Lɛbanɔn bwejena ta, dɛ kpoŋe le Baal Hɛmɔn ka tel Lebo Hamat.
Gɛ nɛra laanee Korowii ɡel ba so, dɛ́ kpɔ daah Israel tena, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ teŋɛ waa waa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ do ba naawa la taa yaa.
Israel tena la ne Keenan ne Hiti ne Amɔre ne Pɛrɛs, ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tenaa pɛa so Keenan harɛ la ta.
Ba mo ba bihaahna dɛ lawɛ ba bihaahna tɛ ba ɡe ba mo, dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa.
Otniel wa Israel tena la ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
Ba berɛ habɔɔ kpo Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa Baalre ne Asera.
Anomanta, Korowii baah di ba nɛɛ kohona dɛ kpɔ ba do Mɛsopoteemea Kooro Kusan Risataim nɔn ta, asɛ ba tomɔ bene anuatoro.
Kɛ ba wio yerɛ Korowii, asɛ o le Kenas bibaa Otniel o ba lɛɛ ba.
Dɛ Kaleb nimee on.
Korowii Doma baa so o nɛ o ɛ ba sitɔɔ dɛ tɔ ba sie dɛɛ la laa.
Korowii tɛo kpeɡri o won ka yo dɛ pɔ Mɛsopoteemea Kooro Kusan Risataim nɛ.
Anomanta, deŋnesɔɔhna ba Israel harɛ ta bene fifraanaarɛ mɔɔ Otniel sewɛ.
Ehud wa Israel tena berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ja, asɛ o ɡel Moab Kooro Ɛɡlɔn ɛɛ di kpeɡri ba nɛ.
O yerɛ Amɔn ne Amalɛk tena ja o nɛra nɛɛ ba ka yo Israel tena dɛ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ Jeriko ta.
Israel tena tomɛ Moab Kooro Ɛɡlɔn bene fi dɛ anuatoro.
Israel tena wio no Korowii ja, asɛ o le Bɛnjamen dea te Gɛra bibaa Ehud tɛɛ ba, ó ba lɛɛ ba.
O ɛ ɡal te.
Gɛ Ehud nɔɔ Israel tena tomɛ o kpɔ suuɡa ne kwaa baa bɔa dɛɛ tɛ Moab Kooro Ɛɡlɔn la dɛ ka tɛo.
Dɛ Ehud loɡɛ tokobi o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama, dɛ kpɔ sɛɡle o diɡ kɛɡra yapea bini.
Suuɡa ne kwaa Israel tena aa kpɔa tɛo la, o la a ne ka tɛ Moab Kooro Ɛɡlɔn.
Dɛ kooro la ɛ nɛn waa bara kɛrɛdɛ.
Ehud aa kpɔ kwaa la ka tɛ kooro la, o ɡelɔ baala baa cheɡɛ kwaa la ka doo, dɛ laa berɛ kaa dem.
Ehud ne ba kaa tel voɡa aa bɛne Gelɡal, asɛ o te laa berɛ dɛ ba Kooro Ɛɡlɔn be ba ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, n dɔ wesɔɔhla ane dɛɛ ba he be bola.” Kooro la ŋɔ ó hel mɔɔ, asɛ o bonɔɔna la bwa le o jwɛɛh kaa.
Ate, Ehud suuh bɛno, dɛ o ɡbo soɡe saldoa bela waa dɛ lɛ peu la dɛ ŋɔ, “N dɔ waane le Korowii be dɛɛ ba he tɛɛ.” Kooro aa ira le o kara ta la, Ehud kpɔ nɔŋɡal dɛ laa tokobi la tɛr le o diɡ kɛɡra ta, dɛ kpɔ tɔɡɛ kooro tea.
Hale kere la daa la bwa joɔ o nyoa vah le o nyaŋ ta.
Ehud ta kere la tɛrɛ le o tea ta, asɛ o noyal bɔle o ta.
Asɛ o le dea bela dɛ karɛ ɡbeni tɔ kooro la nɛɛ dɛ le kaa.
Waa kaala tonɛ la, kooro bonɔɔna la balɔ dɛ ba na kɛŋɔ kooro sobɔr ɡbeni la bwa kaɡrɔ.
Dɛ ba liiree kɛŋɔ o ken kaa dahara.
Ba cheɡɛ bela biɡri, dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ kooro ɛɛ ya ɡberaa.
Waa wola ya la, ba lii kɛŋɔ ba dɛ ɛ bechawa, dɛ kpɔ safoa laa ɡbera la ya, dɛ na kɛŋɔ ba nomoa sewɔ chɔ.
Kooro bonɔɔna la aa cheɡɛ bela la, dɛ Ehud te le bela dɛ chwa kpɔ voɡa la bɔr kaa Sɛɛra biɡri.
Waa tel Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta la, o hoh bɛla yerɛ Israel tena, asɛ ba teŋɛ o nɛɛ le deŋɡarere la dor o tɔ ba sie ba kaa laa.
O do ba ŋɔ, “Hé teŋɛ n nɛ, Korowii ɛɛ lɛ heyaa le Moab tena baa ɛ he dɔma nɔn taa.” Anomanta, ba teŋɛ Ehud nɛɛ dɛ kaa bɔra baa kpɔ a ta dɛɛ ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo dɛ kaa Moab harɛ ta la dɛ ka tɔɔɡa.
Ba ta ɡelɛ nomɛlbwa ɡale moo la.
Awola ba kpoo Moab laa tena dɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa fi baa ɡbaŋa dɛ do kpeɡri, bɛlbwa ta wone chwa kaa.
Le awola tɔpere dɛɛ kaa la, Israel tena dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna bene fifraanuatoro, asɛ Moab tena ɛɛ tom ba.
Samɡa wa Ehud aa bala habɔɔ la, Anat bibaa Samɡa ɡe kpoo Filisti tena lafraanumɛl daa waa seɡre o nyoa, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ teɡɛ o nae la ne.
O ɡe jao dɛ lɛ Israel tena.
Dɛbora ne Barak Ehud aa sewa habɔɔ la, Israel tena berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ja.
Anomanta, Korowii kpɔ ba do Keenan Kooro Jabin waa di kora bwɛjen Hasɔ nɔn ta.
Kooro Jabin laa nomoa sɔne Sisera, dɛ so bwɛɛ Harɔsɛt Haɡoyim ta.
Dɛ Kooro Jabin dɔ bune kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre la lafraanuanaarɛ.
O fɔɡɛ Israel tena kɛrɛdɛ bene fifraanɛ, asɛ ba berɛ wi no Korowii ŋɔ ó cha ba.
Dɛ haah bɛl sɔne Dɛbora dɛ ɛ Korowii keame, dɛ ɛ Israel tena sitɔɔ ɡɛ saŋ.
O jaa sɔne Lapedɔt.
Dɛ bambi daa bɛl cheɡɛ Rama ne Bɛtel baah ta Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta baa yerɔ Dɛbora Bambi wɛɛ so o mun, asɛ Israel tena yon la o be o bol ba waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Awola bɛl, Dɛbora ɡelɔ ba ka yerɛ Abinoam bibaa Barak waa le bwɛɛ Kedes o do Naftale harɛ ta o ba, asɛ o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ ń ŋɔ he be hé ka kpɔ Naftale ne Sebulon deene baala kaɡboŋa fi ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ tɔ ba sie kaa Tabɔ Bwejen ta.
Korowii ɛɛ ba Kooro Jabin laa nomoa Sisera ne torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la ne o laa tena nee Kesɔn Moo la nyoa, ásɛ dɛ ɡel he pɔ ba nɛ.” Anee Barak chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ puu mɛɛ kaa laa, mɛɛ lao.
Kɛ dɛ haa la tenaa, n ɡe aa la.” Dɛbora ɡe ŋɔ, “A wer, n ne hɛɛ kaaloo.
Kɛ ŋwɛnɛ yaa dɛ ba kaala nɔ, he laa dɛ dɔ sɔn o ta.
Haahnee Korowii ɛɛ ba ɡela o pɔ Sisera nɛ.” Anomanta, Dɛbora ja Barak nɛɛ ba kaa Kedes.
Barak yerɛ Sebulon ne Naftale deene baala kaɡboŋa fi ba teŋɛ o nɛ, asɛ Dɛbora ɡe ja ba kaa.
Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Heba dɛ ɛ Ken te.
O le o nɛra bini dɛ ka baŋre o tɛnte dea dajen bɛl waa cheɡɛ Saananim dɛ bɛne Kedes mun.
Ken tena nɔ ɛ Mosis menchoro Hobab naanar.
Baa bol Sisera be ŋɔ Abinoam bibaa Barak kaa Tabɔ Bwejen ta la, o kpɔ bune kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre la lafraanuanaarɛ ne o laa tena baa lɔ o be bwa, dɛ kpoŋe le Harɔsɛt Haɡoyim kaa Kesɔn Moo la nyoa.
Dɛbora ŋɔ Barak be ŋɔ, “Kaa!
Fini tɔpere nɔɔ Korowii kpɔ Sisera do he nɔn ta hé pɔ o nɛ.
Korowii te tɔ he sie kaa.” Anomanta, Barak ne o laa tena kaɡboŋa fi la tuo le Tabɔ Bwejen doa ba harɛ.
Barak aa dɛ tel Sisera be la, Korowii yoo tɛ Israel tena ba pɔ Sisera ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛla la bwa, ne o laa tena nɛɛ ba wili, asɛ Sisera tu le o bune kon waa do kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ pɛl jaaɡɔ la dɛ kpɔ nakpale ta chwa kaa.
Kɛ Barak ti kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore la ne laa tena la ka tel Harɔsɛt Haɡoyim.
Ba kpoo Sisera laa tena la bwa kere ne, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.
Dɛ Sisera te kpɔ nakpale ta, dɛ chwa kaa Ken te Heba haah Jael tɛnte bɔr, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Hasɔ Kooro Jabin ne Ken te Heba dem tena som.
Jael le buse ka cheme Sisera dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ ba nomoa, den dɛɛ ba.
Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma.” Anomanta, o jo o tɛnte dea la bini, asɛ o kpɔ yal bɔlo.
Sisera ŋɔ, “Nyɔɡre dɛ kpo mɛ, n dɛ soŋe, tɛ mɛ nee ń nyɔ.” O kpɔ oltɔn loŋ ne na-elne tɛo o nyɔ, dɛ kwaa kon tɔ o nɛ.
Sisera ŋɔ Jael be ŋɔ, “Ir che tɛnte doonyoa bela.
Dɛ nomɛl baa bɔɔ ŋɔ nɛn lɔ bonɔ naa, he ŋɔ ɔɔhɔh.” Koeh kohona nomanta, Sisera chɔ dom kwaraa, asɛ Heba haah Jael kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ baŋre tɛnte la bɛl ne hamba, dɛ ɛ bɔeeh dɛ kpɔ kon la jaɡɛ o lwɛɛma ta, dɛ kpaa do o ka marɛ harɛ o sewɛ.
Barak ti Sisera dɛɛ ba, asɛ Jael le buse ka chemo dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ ba, mɛɛ chaɡle nɛn haa dɛ ɡaaɡe o bɔr nɔɔ.” Anomanta, o ne Jael jo tɛnte la bini, o na kɛ ba kpɔ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ baŋre tɛnte jaɡɛ o lwɛɛma ta marɛ harɛ o sewɛ.
Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɡelɔ kpeɡri Keenan harɛ Kooro Jabin aa dɔa la nyoa sɔɔh Israel tena bwa siwi ta.
Israel tena berɔ ba dɔ kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ Keenan tena Kooro Jabin nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ baa kpoo.
Dɛbora ne Barak yel Awola tɔpere la Dɛbora ne Abinoam bibaa Barak ɡo yel nɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Israel sitɔɔla tɔ sie dɛɛ la laa, ásɛ ba nɛra ɡe kpɔ ba te tɛ silɛɛ ne.
Koranar, nɛra haa dɛ nyiŋi harɛre ta, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no!
Mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ Korowii.
Yelsomaa mɛɛ ba ɡoe tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ.
N Naa Korowii, haa le Sɛɛ Bwejen ta Edom harɛ ta la, harɛ jiɡro baama tɔ, asɛ bwaala nee fuɡe le nyundua.
Bwejena jiɡro hen Korowii waa ɛ Sinai Bwejen dɔɔ sie, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la bala ta.
Anat bibaa Samɡa bere saŋ la, Jael ɡe aa lole la, nɛra vɛh ŋwɛnɛjena ta kpɔe, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛbie ta.
Nɛra tama banee ka Israel bwɛjeɡre ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ men Dɛbora aa bala dɛ berɛ Israel tena nya.
Gɛ saŋ Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la, laa ba bwɛɛre la ta.
Baala kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ baa lɔ harɛ la ta, bɛlbwa ta lampea kɛɛ dɔmkon bɛlbwa kpoŋe.
N bambile lɔ sitɔɔla baa lɔ Israel harɛ nɛ, nɛra baa kpɔ silɛɛ le ba te cheɡ la.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Hé no, he banɔ la haa soɡe keeɡopoŋa ta, dɛ so kwaa baa paa dawɛ a ta, ne he banɔ la haa dɛ valɛ nakpale ta.
Hé no nɛra baa dɛ ɡo yela ɡbɔɡa aa dɛ le buli ta, dɛɛ baɡle Korowii laa waa yoa dɛ pɔ nɛra nɛ, ne Israel banyoola ɡe yoi baa yoa.
Asɛ Korowii nɛra valɛ teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ le ba bwɛjena ta dɛ ŋɔ, Dɛbora, ir dɛɛ ɡo yela!
Ir che dɛ́ pa mun ɡo yela dɛɛ la!
Barak, ir dɛ́ tɔ sie, Abinoam bibaa, ir lawɛ nɛra haa laɡ ba kaa harɛfale ta la kaa.
Belaa Korowii nɛra baa kaa la ba ja ba nomonome la nɛ, Korowii nɛra la ba n be dɛ ba ja banyoola la nɛ.
Bane le Efrem dea harɛ ta dɛ le Amalɛk tena luɡe ta, bane le Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta dɛ ba, laa sitɔɔla le Makir harɛ ne Sebulon dea harɛ ta dɛ ba.
Isaaka dea nomonome ja Dɛbora nɛ, ba ja Barak nɛɛ dɛ chwa jo fɛlembɔjen la bini.
Rubin dea tena te bini peɡro, ba ta wone la.
Bɔkwa waa he ta so peera nɔ baah nɔ?
Peteɡra la foola baa foola dɛɛ yerɛ ba peera laanee hɛɛ no kɛɛ?
Rubin dea tena bini peɡro, ba ta wone la.
Gelead tena soɡe Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ, asɛ Dan dea tena ta do bela stiimaere aa dɛ chuɡe.
Aasa dea tena ɡe ka mpo nyoa dɛ den so bela.
Sebulon ne Naftale dea tena kpɔ ba nyu charɛ seo dɛ do laa ta.
Koranar balɔ dɛ ba yo, Keenan harɛ ta koranar balɔ dɛ ba yo.
Ba baa yo Taanak waa bɛne nenabɔɔ Meɡido, kɛ ba ta wone kpɔ suuɡapoŋa kɛɛ komɛlbwa laa la ta.
Hale weweela kwara aa lɔ nyundua, iro dɛɛ yo Sisera.
Kesɔn Moo palɛ laa tena kaa, Kesɔn Moo waa lole saŋ la bwa lɔ ba kaa.
Mɛɛ kaa bambikpeɡ nee!
Belaa Sisera jaɡre chwa dɛ baa kaa a nakpale ɛɛ si harɛ, a dɛ jah a nakpale ɛɛ si harɛ kip kip kip.
Korowii nyundua torome bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Taah Mɛrɔs bwɛ, dɛ́ taah nɛra baa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta kohona.
Ba ta Korowii ba chae.
Ba ta leɛ dɛ ba yo Korowii dɔma ba bwara aa kpeɡa.’ Haah waa na som bwaa Jael, Ken te Heba haah.
Onee na som haahna baa soɡe tɛnte deene bini bwa nɛ.
Sisera soŋe nee Jael be, o tɛo na-elne o nyɔ.
Numol o fe aa chɛ nɛnjena binii o do na-elne aa soma tɛo.
Jael kpɔ nɔŋɡal kpɔ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ baŋre tɛnte la, dɛ kpɔ nɔndiɡ kpɔ hamba, dɛ kpɔ lɔ Sisera lwɛɛma, dɛ laa o nyu paɡre.
Jael naa lɔɡree o chole.
Waa chola la belaa o sewɛ dɛ sɔɔh chɔ.
Sisera nya cheɡɛ tokoro ta dɛ nyiŋi bojaŋ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ Sisera biɡri o ta balɛ mɔɔ nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ yaa wola torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la ɡbɔɡa noɛ mɔɔ nɔɔ?’ Gɛɛ haahna baa jemɛ waa dɛ so o jwɛɛh la chaŋe, o ɡe ta teŋɛ dɛɛ dalwe a ta dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ba ken pa laa ta kwaa dɛɛ bɔna, baa bɛlbwa dɔ haah beŋkpoŋ kɛɛ banɛ, Sisera ɡe dɔ laaladɛɛɡa baa sɔh kwaa dawɛ a ta, haahna laaladɛɛɡa aa wera dɛ́ ba tɛ mɛ.
Anɔ bwa ɛ kwaa baa paa laa ta.’ N Naa Korowii, ɡel he dɔma bwa serewe, Kɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyini la, ɡel ba dɔ kpeɡri kɛŋɔ wee yon le kpeɡri nɛɛ la.” Ate, deŋnesɔɔhna ba harɛ la ta bene fifraanaarɛ.
Gedeɔn wa Israel tena berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ja, asɛ o kpɔ ba do Midian tena nɔn ta ba di kpeɡri ba nɛɛ bene anuanɛ.
Midian tena nyu bini aa baa do kpeɡri Israel tena nɛɛ kohona la, ba chwao kaa bwejena bɔɔne bini ne bela baa wola ban na, dɛ kpɔ bela berɛ deene dɛ so a bini.
Saŋ bɛlbwa Israel tena la aa parɛ ba kooni dɛ du kwaa la, ɡɛɛ Midian ne Amalɛk tena dɛ harɛre aa lɔ wee leebɔr nɛra yon ka jo harɛ la ta dɛ́ lɛ dɔɔh.
Ba dɛ baŋre ba tɛnte deene harɛ la ta dɛ́ so bela, dɛ́ chɔɡ kwaa baa dua dɛ kpoŋe ka le Gasa.
Baa peera ne nae dɛ keeɡore, hale hweera kon te bɛlbwa ɡelɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Ba cheɡɛ ba tɛnte deene ba ne ba kondɛɛra fuɡe le aa, ba do kɛŋɔ tontombɛ ken.
Haa won kure ba ne ba nyoɡmare.
Ba dɛ so harɛ la ta dɛ́ chɔɡ ba kwaa bwa.
Midian tena la ɡelɔ Israel tena la nya komɛlbwa kwaraa, asɛ ba wi no Korowii ŋɔ ó cha ba.
Israel tena aa wia no Korowii Midian tena waa la, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ ɡelɔ o keame bɛl ba ba be ŋɔ, “Men lɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta somanjiri dii ta.
N lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt tena ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa nɔn ta kpeɡri ne.
N doŋi harɛre nɛra le he sie dɛ kpɔ ba harɛ tɛ heya.
N ŋɔ he be kɛŋɔ menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.
He bɛ Amɔre tena haa soɡe ba harɛ ta voɡare la dɛɛ tomɛ.
Kɛ he vɛh n waa la noe.” Awola bɛl, Korowii nyundua torome baa so dajen bɛl mun bwɛɛ Ofra.
Gɛ daa la ɛ Abeɛsa te baa dɛ yerɔ Joas kon.
Dɛ o bibaa Gedeɔn sɔɔh dɛɛ lɔ mea daa la mun bobɛl baa dɛ harame daa nɔna baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen, ásɛ Midian tena la bɛ on na.
Korowii nyundua torome la kpɔ o te baɡle Gedeɔn, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Banyoo, Korowii ja he nɛ.” Anee o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, dɛ Korowii ja ya nɛ aa, ɛrɛɛ anɔ bwa berɛ pu yaa nɔɔ?
Nyokpowaa ya naawa aa bol a waa baɡle yaa ŋɔ Korowii ɛa dɛ lɛ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la, ɛrɛɛ waa wola ane ɛɛ ya ɡe na nɔɔ?
Taraken o ta yaa, dɛ kpɔ yaa do Midian tena nɔn ta.” Belaa Korowii ɡbabir ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gedeɔn, menee dɛɛ tomɛ.
Kpɔ bokpeɡa haa dɔa la ka lɛ Israel tena le Midian tena nɔn ta.” Asɛ Gedeɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won lɛɛ baɔ?
Manasɛ dea tena bini la, n dem nɛraa ɡwɛɡra, asɛ n lolanar ɡe be pera la, n toole wobɛlbwa bini.” Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ ásɛ he kpoo Midian tena bwa, kɛŋɔ haa yo nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ken.” Anee Gedeɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ he sie lɛ n nɛ aa, ɛ waane ásɛ n jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee dɛɛ bol waa n be nɔ.
N poori so bonɔ ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba saraha kwaa ne ba tɛɛ.” Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ soo ka tel kɛŋɔ haa ba.” Gedeɔn kaa kpo bohlor dɛ daalo, dɛ kpɔ men kuruware fi ɛ paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta.
O pa ola la do wɛɡrɛ bini, asɛ dɛ fuɡe yooma la do vii bini, dɛ kpɔ ba tɛo dajen la mun.
Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ ola la ne paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta la ba chɔŋɛ bwe nɔ ta, dɛ́ fuɡe yooma la do ola la ta.” Asɛ Gedeɔn ɛ ɡɛ.
Dɛ Korowii nyundua torome la kpoŋe daŋɡbala bɛl.
O kpɔ daŋɡbala la nyoa leɡe ola la ne paanoo la, asɛ nii le bwe la ta dɛ fuh ola la ne paanoo la bwa.
Asɛ Korowii nyundua torome la den nyoɡre le o sie kaa.
Gedeɔn aa baa na kɛŋɔ Korowii nyundua toromee la, o do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ, “Ei!
Nemenɛ Korowii, n ne he nyundua torome sie ɡba dɔŋa.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Sɔɔh bwara!
Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, haa sewa ba.” Anomanta, Gedeɔn ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii bela dɛ pa o sɔn ŋɔ, ‘Korowiirii Deŋnesɔɔhna’.
Kpoŋe ba le fini, kon la ta cheɡɛ Abeɛsa dea tena bwɛɛ Ofra.
Awola jwaana la tenten Korowii ŋɔ Gedeɔn be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ he mɛɛ nabal, ne nabal bɛl waa di bene anuanɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ ka ɛ we-ɛɛla, dɛ́ kuuɡi kon he mɛɛ aa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ voɡ Baal, ásɛ dɛ teŋe voɡhaah Asera dajaŋ waa cheɡɛ o jwɛɛh la ta, ásɛ dɛ pa bwea darawe dɔŋa nɛ, dɛ́ ɛ saraha kon waa chɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la deŋɡare nɔ doa.
Kpɔ voɡ Asera daa haa teŋa ta la dawɛ saraha kon la ta, dɛ́ fuh nabal nɛɛte la, dɛ́ ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.” Anomanta, Gedeɔn kpɔ o bonɔɔna la bini fi dɛ ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa bol o be la.
Kɛ waa dɛ ɔmɛ o dem nɛra ne bwɛɛ la baala la nomanta, o ta an webaŋa ɛɛ dɛ ɛa jwaana.
Bwɛɛ la tena aa ira chɔɔ la, ba nao kɛŋɔ ba kuuɡi voɡ Baal saraha kon la, dɛ teŋe voɡ Asera dajaŋ waa cheɡɛ o jwɛɛh la, dɛ berɛ fuh nabal nɛɛte saraha konfale la ta.
Anee baa bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Umee baa ɛ ken nɔɔ?” Ba nyiŋi waa la ta kɛrɛdɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ Joas bibaa Gedeɔnee ɛa.
Ate, bwɛɛ la baala la Joas be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Le he bibaa Gedeɔn ne ba.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ ó sewɛ, dɛkalkɛ o kuuɡi ya voɡ Baal saraha kon la dɛ berɛ teŋe voɡ Asera dajaŋ waa cheɡɛ o jwɛɛh la ɡe ta.” Kɛ Joas chaŋe baala baa wura ba o be bandia ne la ŋɔ, “Hé dɛ nyin kɛ he lɛ voɡ Baal waa bol kɛɛ?
Hé dɛ nyin hé yo lɛo waa?
Naate waa ŋɔ wɛɛ yoo dɛ́ lɛo la, chɔmbibii baa ba o kpoe.
Dɛ Baal ɛ voɡ kasinteŋ aa, baa dɛ kuuɡi o saraha kon la, o fe wono yo lɛ o te.” Anomanta, le awola tɔpere la, ba pa Gedeɔn sɔn Jerub Baal.
O munii o ne voɡ Baalee dɔ wa, dɛkalkɛ onee kuuɡi o saraha kon.
Midian ne Amalɛk tena dɛ nɛra baa soɡe wee leebɔr la bwa pɛo, dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen bini.
Korowii Doma baa so Gedeɔn nɛ, asɛ o hoh bɛla dɛɛ yerɛ Abeɛsa tena bá ba teŋɛ o nɛ.
O tomɛ toroma ba kpɔ Manasɛ harɛ ta dɛɛ yerɛ nɛra bá ba yo laa.
Dɛ berɛ kpɔ Aasa ne Sebulon ne Naftale harɛre ta, dɛ yerɛ ba ɡe bá ba ja ba nɛ.
Belaa Gedeɔn ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, dɛ hɛɛ che n nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛ Israel tena ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ nyoa la aa, mɛɛ kpɔ pee ponaa bil pɛla nɔ ta.
Tɔɔ perɔ chɔɔ dɛ pee pona la pweɔh asɛ bela aa chɔa la te ta pweɛh yaa, ate dɛ n jemɔ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ che n nɛɛ lɛ Israel tena ɡɛ haa bola la.” Gɛ waa la ɛ ɡɛ.
Gedeɔn iro chɔmbibi, o harame pee pona mɛn le a ta dɛ dɔ nee hɛna del.
Gedeɔn berɔ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡel he baah di n nɛ.
Tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń soŋe webeŋkpoŋ ja.
Gel n kpɔ pee pona nɔ daah na ja.
Taraken nɔ, ɡel pee pona nɔ hol ásɛ bela aa chɔa la pweh.” Awola jwaana la, Korowii ɛ ɡɛ.
Pee pona la ɡboo hola asɛ bela aa chɔa la pweh.
Gedeɔn yo Midian tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ Tɔɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Gedeɔn baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Jerub Baal ne o laa tena bwa iro, dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene bobɛl nee aa bula dɛɛ le baa yerɔ Harɔd.
Dɛ Midian tena ɡe baŋre ba tɛnte deene Gedeɔn laa tena la weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, fɛlembɔjen waa bɛne More Deŋɡare ta.
Korowii ŋɔ Gedeɔn be ŋɔ, “He laa tena la warɔ ɡwaa ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin kɛ ń kpɔ Midian tena do ba nɔn ta bá pɔ ba nɛɛ la.
Gɛ aa ɛ Israel tena bɛ ba lii kɛŋɔ ba ɡbaɡba kpeɡrii lɛɛ ba kɛ n ta wobɛlbwa ɛɛ la, bol ba be kɛŋɔ nómɛlbwa waa dɛ ɔmɛ la le Gelead bwe nɔ ta dɛ berɛ kaa dem.” Anomanta, laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ laa berɛ kaa, asɛ a ka kaɡboŋa fi.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ o be ja ŋɔ, “Nɛra la ta warɔ kohona.
He ne ba kaa nee nyoa bá ka nyɔ ne, ásɛ n chalɛ ba bini tɛɛ.
Bɛlbwa maa ŋɔ ó pui kaa la, he ne ó kaa.
Dɛ n berɔ ŋɔ bɛl bɛ kaa laa, bɛ ɡel ó teŋɛ he nɛ.” Anomanta, Gedeɔn kpɔ ba kaa nee nyoa.
Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Chale banɔ la baa kpɔ nɔn lɔ nee dɛɛ ta nyoa kɛ nyootena la le banɔ la baa ɡuŋa dɛ kpɔ nyoa pi dɛɛ nyɔ la nɛ.” Baala lafraatoroo lɔ nee ta nyoa.
Banɔ la baa kaa la te bwa, ɡuŋaa ba ɡuŋi dɛ kpɔ nyoa pi nyɔ.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Gedeɔn be ŋɔ, “Nɛra lafraatoro baa lɔ nee ta nyoa la nɛɛ mɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ lɛ heyaa he pɔ Midian tena nɛ.
Gel ba kar la bɛlbwa kaa bela waa lea ba.” Gedeɔn ɡelɔ nɛra lafraatoro la so, asɛ o lɛ banɔ la baa kaa la kondikwaare ne ba bɛle, dɛ́ ɡel ba kaa ba tɛnte deene bini, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kondikwaare ne bɛle la tɛ baala lafraatoro la.
Dɛ Midian tena lɔ fɛlembɔjen la bini, asɛ Gedeɔn ne o laa tena ɡe do o diŋɡoŋ ta.
Awola jwaana la, Korowii ŋɔ Gedeɔn be ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ́ kaa Midian tena sobɔr bela ka yoo ba.
N dɛ ba ba kpɔe do he nɔn ta.
Dɛ he dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ he yoo ba aa, he ne he bonɔɔ Pura la bela baa lole.
Hɛɛ ka no waa baa dɛ bolee, dɛ́ won che a ta dɛ́ dɔ bambikpeɡ dɛ́ yoo ba.” Anomanta, o ne o bonɔɔ Pura kaa pɛl ba dɔma la dahara.
Dɛ Midian ne Amalɛk tena ne wee leebɔr tena la su fɛlembɔjen la bini pirim kɛŋɔ tontombɛ ken.
Ba nyoɡmare ɡe warɛ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken, haa won kur ba.
Gedeɔn aa dena tel bela la, dɛ baa bɛl dɛ baɡle deera waa deera o dɔŋ be ŋɔ, “N deero dɛ na kɛŋɔ paanoɡuɡule aa ɡbila jo ya Midian sobɔr bonɔ dɛ ba lɔ ya tɛnte dea kpeɡri nɛ asɛ o chole chɔ harɛ.” Asɛ o dɔŋ la chaŋo ŋɔ, “Waa aa dɛ baɡle bwaa kɛŋɔ Joas bibaa Gedeɔn waa ɛ Israel te dɛ́ ba ba yo yaa.
Korowii kpɔ ya Midian tena ne nɛra baa bala dɛ́ ba cha yaa la bwa do o nɔn ta.” Gedeɔn aa no deera la ne ɡɛ naate la aa baɡle a bini la, o ɡuŋo dɛ jam Korowii, dɛ laa berɛ ba ba sobɔr dɛ ba ŋɔ takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “Hé ir, Korowii kpɔ Midian tena do he nɔn ta.” O bɔne o laa tena lafraatoro la bini kuore atoro, dɛ kpɔ bɛla ne vii kapɛla aa lɔ o bini dɛɛ hɔ tɛ bɛlbwa.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋ mɛ, dɛ́ teŋɛ n nɛ.
Ya kaa bɛne ba aa, ɡɛ bwa maa ɛ la, hé ɡe ɛ ɡɛ tenten.
Dɛ he baa no banɔ la maa ja ba bini la hoh ya bɛle aa, hé kar la haa bar ba cheme la ɡe hoh hé kwaa dɛ́ moo ŋɔ, ‘Hé yo tɛ Korowii, hé yo tɛ Gedeɔn!’ ” Gedeɔn ne o nɛra lafa la tel Midian tena sobɔr dahara bela harambaŋa.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Midian tena la le nɛnfala ba baa daah ba sobɔr bela.
Asɛ Gedeɔn ne o laa tena la hoh bɛle la dɛ paɡre viine baa kpoŋa la.
Kuore atoro la bwa hoh ba kwaa dɛ paɡre ba viine la.
Ba kpoŋe kapɛle la nɔŋɡal ta, dɛ kpoŋe bɛle baa hoah la ɡe nɔndiɡ ta dɛɛ moo ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ keri yo tɛ Korowii ne Gedeɔn!” Gedeɔn nɛra la cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ bar Midian tena sobɔr la, asɛ Midian tena la ɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ chwa.
Nɛra lafraatoro la aa hoh ba bɛle la, Korowii ɡelɔ Midian tena baa lɔ ba sobɔr la bwa la ɡbaɡba ɛɛ kpoo dɔŋa.
Asɛ ba bini laa tena baa kaa la chwa kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Sɛrɛra dɛ kaa Bɛt Sita dɛ kpoŋe kaa Ebel Mehola jwɛh waa bɛne Tabat la ta.
Gedeɔn ɡelɔ ba yerɛ Naftale ne Aasa dɛ banɔ la baa le Manasɛ deene ta bwa, asɛ ba ti Midian tena la.
Gedeɔn tomɛ nɛra Efrem dea tena be deŋɡarere harɛ la bwa ta ŋɔ, “Hé ba yo Midian tena la, dɛ́ ka tɔɔɡe bɔra baa kpɔ a ta ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le Bɛt Bara.” Anomanta, Efrem laa tena bwa baa tɔɔɡe bɔra la ka le Bɛt Bara.
Ba berɔ lawɛ Midian tena nomonome bane baa dɛ yer ba Oreb ne Seeb.
Ba kpo Oreb bwe baa dɛ yerɔ Oreb ta, asɛ dɛ kpo Seeb ɡe bobɛl baa dɛ harame daa nɔna baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen baa yerɛ bela Seeb.
Ba ti nɛra la asɛ dɛ teŋe Oreb ne Siib nyuune ba tɛ Gedeɔn Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa bela.
Seba ne Salmuna Efrem dea tena la bɔɔ Gedeɔn ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ yaa ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he ta yaa yerɛ ya ba chae yo Midian tena ɔ?” Ba pwaoh sibeɡra ne.
Asɛ o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Amee n ɛ a tel anɔ haa ɛa nɔɔ?
Efrem tena daa nɔna baa kuuhna la ta Abeɛsa kobir ɡrepo daa nɔna baa chaara la ɡwaalaa?
Korowii kpɔ Midian nomonome Oreb ne Siib do he nɔn ta.
Bɔkwa waa ń won ɛ dɛ́ kpɔ maɡɛ ɡɛ haa ɛa nɔɔ?” A ɡɛ wobol nɔ sɔɔh ba bandia la nyoa tama.
Gedeɔn ne o laa tena lafraatoro la koɔh kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ ba ti nɛra la dɛ ba ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la.
Ba kaa tel Sukot, asɛ o ŋɔ bela tena be ŋɔ, “Hé tɛ n nɛra nɔ kondikwaa bá di.
Ba koɔh taeh, kɛ n ta dɛ ti Midian tena koranar Seba ne Salmuna.” Anee Sukot nomonome la ŋɔ, “He ta Seba ne Salmuna lawɛ mɔɔ.
Bɔkwa waa chɛ kɛ yá tɛ he laa tena nɔ kondikwa ɔ?” Anee Gedeɔn chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa bola nɔ nomanta, dɛ Korowii kpɔ Seba ne Salmuna do n nɔn ta naa, sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛree mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba lɔɔ heya.” Waa le bela la, o la Pɛneɛl tena ɡe be, dɛ ka soŋ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ tenten, asɛ ba ɡe chaŋo ɡɛ Sukot tena aa chaŋo la.
Anomanta, o ŋɔ Pɛneɛl tena la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ n kaa yo n dɔma dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ ba silɛɛ ne naa, mɛɛ ba kuuɡi he dejaŋ nɔɔ!” Dɛ Seba ne Salmuna laa tena baa kaa la lɔ kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banue ba ne ba do Kaakɔ.
Banee kaa dɛ le wee leebɔr laa tena la bini, asɛ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanɛ ɡe serewe.
Gedeɔn kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ nɛra baa wola soŋnibɔr dɔe yon kpɔ o ta o chɔ Nɔba ne Joɡbeha wee leebɔr la, dɛ ba piɡri Midian laa tena baa lɔ bela dɛ yoo ba.
Midian koranar banɛ, Seba ne Salmuna chwao, kɛ Gedeɔn ti ba ka laɡ ba, asɛ ba laa tena la bwa chwa kaa.
Waa bera baa kaa la, o kpɔ Heres ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔ bwejena baah ta.
Gedeɔn lawɛ Sukot bonɔɔ bɛl dɛ bɔɔro nomonome baa lɔ Sukot wa.
Asɛ o chwerɛ Sukot nomonome fifraanuanɛ dɛ banuanɛ sɔna tɛo.
Gedeɔn la Sukot nomonome la be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Seba ne Salmuna laanee la.
Banee he muɡli n baah ŋɔ dɛ n ta ban lawɛ aa, haa n laa tena baa koah kohona la kondikwaa tɛ la.” O lawɛ bwɛɛ la nomonome dɛ lɔɔ ba sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛre ne, dɛ tɛr ba deŋne bá kpɔ hweli wa.
O berɔ la dɛ ka kuuɡi dejaŋ waa lɔ Pɛneɛl la dɛ kpoo baala baa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta.
Ate, Gedeɔn bɔɔ Seba ne Salmuna ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ baala haa kpoo ba Tabɔ la doɔ?” Asɛ ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Baala baa do kɛ hen, dɛ do kɛ koobiirii.” Gedeɔn ŋɔ, “Ba ɛ n dɔɔranar ne nimanar, n ne ba pɛ nya.
N ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ dɛ he ta ban kpooraa, n ɡe fe aa heyaa kpoo.” Anee o ŋɔ o bibaa nomoa baa dɛ yerɔ Jɛta be ŋɔ, “Kpoo ba.” Kɛ bie la ta o kere kpɔe a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ kpoo baa.
O ɛ bechala dɛɛ ɔmɛ.
Asɛ Seba ne Salmuna ŋɔ, “He ɡbaɡba den kpoo yaa, a ta chɛ kɛ he kpɔ nomoa toma tɛ bechala.” Anomanta, o suuhno tel ba be dɛ kpoo ba, dɛ laa kondɛɛɡa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa a do ba nyoɡmare baŋa la foo.
Gedeɔn voɡ kwaara wa Laa la habɔɔ la, Israel tena ŋɔ Gedeɔn be ŋɔ, “Ɛ ya kooro, ásɛ dɛ he baa sewaa, he bibaa ɡe di, dɛ o baa sewaa he naa ɡe di, dɛkalkɛ henee lɛ yaa Midian tena nɔn ta.” Anee o ŋɔ, “Maa won di kora he nɛ, ɡɛɛ n bibaa kɛɛ n naa ɡe aa wola won di kora he nɛ.
Korowiirii dɛ́ di he kora.” O berɔ ŋɔ, “Kombeŋkpoŋii mɛɛ ba heyaa soŋa.
Hé bini bɛlbwa tɛ mɛ deŋne kon beŋkpoŋ dɛ́ le laala haa paa laa ta la ta.” Midian tena la nawee waa suuɡaswɛm deŋna kwaa doe.
Ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ya sie lɛɔ, yaa tɛɛ.” Asɛ ba paɡri yal bil, nomɛlbwa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm deŋne kon dɛ le kwaa waa dɔa laa ta baa bil o ta.
Suuɡaswɛm deŋna kwaa baa ba a ne la tɔɡre ɛɛ ɛ suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋ lafraanuanɛɛ.
Ba dɔ bwara kondɛɛɡa ne baŋa kwaa ne laala kɔla Midian koranar aa dɛ do, dɛ kwaa aa lɔ ba nyoɡmare baŋa baa wola a te kure ja.
Gedeɔn kpɔ suuɡaswɛm la ɛ voɡ dɛ kpɔ cheɡ o bwɛɛ Ofra.
Israel tena la bwa berɔ vɛh Korowii toma, dɛ ka tomɛ voɡ la, asɛ o ɛ bel dɛ chɔ kpa Gedeɔn ne o dem tena.
Gedeɔn seo wa Gɛɛ a do Israel tena pɔ Midian tena nɛɛ ba ta kpeɡri dɔe kpa.
Israel tena dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ Gedeɔn ta soɡe le.
Joas bibaa Gedeɔn baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Jerub Baal berɔ kaa o bwɛɛ ka so.
Dɛ o haahna warɔ, anomanta, o bibaala lɔ fifraanuanɛ.
Dɛ o dɔ haah bɛl o do Sɛkem o ne wɛɛ di sɛm o lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Abemɛlɛk.
Joas bibaa Gedeɔn biɡro kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo o mɛɛ buɡ ta Ofra waa ɛ Abeɛsa dea tena bwɛ.
Gedeɔn aa sewa la, Israel tena berɔ vɛh Korowii dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡ Baal ja.
Ba cheɡ Baal Bɛret dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛ soh Korowii waa lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma baa soɡa bar ba cheme nɔn ta la.
Wedɛɛɡa Gedeɔn baa dɛ yerɔ Jerub Baal aa ɛa tɛ Israel tena la, ba te ta wone ɛ ane tɛ o dem tena.
Abemɛlɛk wa Gedeɔn bibaa Abemɛlɛk la Sɛkem o nya nimambii ne o nɛra bwa be, dɛ ka ŋɔ bá bɔɔ Sɛkem tena ŋɔ, “Umee hɛɛ nyin kɛ ó ɛ he kooro ɔ?
Gedeɔn bibaala fifraanuanɛ la kɛɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ɔ?
Hé jemɛ kɛ n ɛ he bini bɛl.” O nya nimambii la aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ Sɛkem nɛra be la, ba sɛoh teŋɛ Abemɛlɛk nɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya nimee.” Ba kpɔ suuɡapoŋa fifraanuanɛ le ba voɡ Baal Bɛret dea ba tɛo.
O kpɔ ɡɛ suuɡa la bɔ nɛra ba siwi aa kpeɡa paa ba ba teŋɛ o nɛ.
Abemɛlɛk la o mɛɛ Gedeɔn bwɛɛ Ofra, dɛ ka kpoo o mɛɛ bii fifraanuanɛ baa ɛ o dɔɔranar ne nimanar bwetal bɛl ta.
Kɛ ba bini bechala baa dɛ yerɔ Jotam la kpɔ o te sɔh.
Ate, nɛra baa lɔ Sɛkem ne Bɛt Milo cheme pila bɛl jwɛh dajen la mun, dɛɛ ba Abemɛlɛk kora ta cheɡa.
Jotam aa no waa nɔ la, o teeh Geresim Bwejen dɛ ka che o doa, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Sɛkem tena, hé no n be ásɛ Korowii ɡe no he wa.
Awola bɛl, daa bwa kaa cheme dɛ ŋɔ a dɛ cheɡ a kooro.
A ŋɔ ɔleve daa be ŋɔ ó ɛ a kooro.
Anee ɔleve daa ŋɔ, ‘Maa won ɡel noo maa ɛa dɛɛ tɛ voɡa ne nɛra baa dɔ jirima nɔ, dɛ́ ba di kora he nɛ.’ Belaa daa la bwa berɛ la fiɡ daa ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Ba ɛ ya kooro.’ Fiɡ daa la ɡe ŋɔ, ‘Maa won ɡel n nɔna aa do som kohona nɔ nɔna, dɛ́ ba di kora he nɛ.’ Asɛ a berɛ ŋɔ ɡrepo daa be ŋɔ ó ba ɛ ba kooro.
O ɡe ŋɔ, ‘Maa won ɡel sen maa dɛ tɛ nɛra ne voɡa baa dɔ silɛɛ nɔ, dɛ́ ba di kora he nɛ.’ A bwa habɔɔ la, daa la bwa ŋɔ sɔɔh daa be ŋɔ ó ba ɛ ba kooro.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, ‘He dɛ nyin kɛ he cheɡ mɛ kooro aa, hé ba sɔh n chunchule ta.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa tenaa, mɛɛ ɡeloo nii le dɛ́ ba fuh peleme daa aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta.’ ” Jotam berɔ ŋɔ, “Haa cheɡ Abemɛlɛk kora ta la, ŋwɛnɛ waa wera ne kasinteŋ taa he kpɔ aa?
He ɛ Gedeɔn ne o dem tena kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ aa chɛa aa?
N mɛɛ Gedeɔn kpɔ o nyu charɛ seo dɛ yo Midian tena dɛ lɛ heyaa le ba nɔn ta, haa ɡɛ waa la liiraa?
Kɛ fini, he cheɡɛ n mɛɛ dem tena nɛɛ dɛ kpoo o bibaala fifraanuanɛ bwe beŋkpoŋ ta, asɛ dɛ ɡel o yomhaah bibaa Abemɛlɛk di kora Sɛkem tena nɛ, waa ɛ he lole la nomanta.
Dɛ he kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa wera ne kasinteŋ ta dɛ ɛ Jerub Baal ne o dem tena aa, amɔ hé ɡel he sie lɛ he koofale Abemɛlɛk nɛ, ásɛ o ɡe sie lɛ he nɛ.
Dɛ ɡɛ haa ɛ n mɛɛ Gedeɔn ne o bii nɔ ta maɡrɛ tenaa, amɔ nii le Abemɛlɛk be dɛ́ fuh he Sɛkem ne Bɛt Milo tena, nii berɛ le he Sɛkem tena ne Bɛt Milo tena be dɛ́ ba fuh Abemɛlɛk.” Jotam nyoa aa chiɡa la, o chwao le bela dɛ ka so Beɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o dɛ ɔmɛ o dɔɔ Abemɛlɛk.
Abemɛlɛk aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene atoro habɔɔ la, Korowii kpɔ waa ba ta Abemɛlɛk ne Sɛkem tena baah ta, asɛ ba leo tɛ.
Korowii ɛ ɡɛ dɛ kpɔ bɔ Abemɛlɛk ne Sɛkem tena baa chao dɛ kpoo Gedeɔn bibaala fifraanuanɛ la kem.
Sɛkem tena le Abemɛlɛk habɔɔ dɛ ɡel nɛra ka sɔh deŋɡarere dor, dɛ che bela ɛɡre nɛra baa dɛ kpɔ bela dɛɛ lɛ ba kwa, asɛ nomɛl ka taa Abemɛlɛk be.
Dɛ Ɛbɛd bibaa sɔne Gaal.
Awola bɛl, Gaal ne o nimanar iro ka so Sɛkem, asɛ bwɛɛ la tena ɛɛ yaradao.
Ba kaa chaa ba ɡrepo nɔna dɛ harame a nee dɛ kpɔ ɛ sen. Asɛ ba tɔpejen bɛl ta, ba ka so ba voɡ dea dɛ di kwaa dɛɛ nyɔ sen asɛ dɛ taah Abemɛlɛk.
Anee Ɛbɛd bibaa Gaal ŋɔ, “Umee Abemɛlɛk ɔ?
Ɛrɛwaa ya Sɛkem tena do o lɔɡa ɔ?
O laa Gedeɔn bibaa la aa?
Sebul ɡe ɛ o nachiɡe.
Hé tomɛ Sɛkem mɛɛ Hamɔ naanar, banee Sɛkem tena!
Ɛrɛɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ yáa tomɛ Abemɛlɛk ɔ?
Dɛ menee nɛra nɔ kooro aa, n fe ɡelɔ ba iru kora ta, dɛ́ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ka kpɔ o laa tena bwa dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yo.” Sebul waa dɛ nyiŋi bwɛjen la ta aa no waa Ɛbɛd bibaa Gaal aa bola la, o baah diu kɛrɛdɛ.
O sɔɔh tomɛ nɛra Abemɛlɛk be ŋɔ, “Ɛbɛd bibaa Gaal ne o dɔɔranar ne nimanar ba Sɛkem dɛ baa vuuɡi bwɛɛ la dɛɛ nyin ba yoi.
Jwaana he ne he laa tena le ba sɔh kpɔɡ bini dɛ́ɛ kpaa ba.
Tɔɔ perɔ wee ɛɛ le aa, hé le bela dɛ́ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ bwɛjen la ta dɛɛ la.
Dɛ Gaal ne o nɛra leɔ dɛ́ ba yo heya aa, ásɛ he ɛɛ ba ɡɛ bwa haa wona.” Anomanta, Abemɛlɛk ne o laa tena bwa kpɔ ba te jwaana, dɛ bɔne ba bini kuore anaarɛ, dɛ ba sɔh bɛne Sɛkem.
Tɔ aa pera la, Ɛbɛd bibaa Gaal le buse dɛ che bwɛjen la doonyojen ta, dɛ Abemɛlɛk ne o laa tena le bela baa sɔah la dɛɛ ba.
Gaal na ba dɛ ŋɔ Sebul be ŋɔ, “Na, nɛra le bwejena la dor dɛɛ ba!” Asɛ Sebul ɡe ŋɔ, “Gɛ laa.
Bwea chunchulii he na dɛ ŋɔ nɛraa la.” Gaal berɔ bol o be ja ŋɔ, “Na!
Nɛra le bwejen la doa dɛɛ ba, asɛ bane ɡe le voɡra daa la mun dɛɛ ba.” Anee Sebul ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He mbarafo wobol haa bola la, ɛrɛɛ a do taraken ɔ?
Henee fa bola ŋɔ, ‘Umee Abemɛlɛk ya kpɔ ya te kaa do o lɔɡa la.’ A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ he faa mamɛ la.
Le ka yoo ba!” Anomanta, Gaal tɔ Sɛkem tena sie dɛ ka yo Abemɛlɛk ne o laa tena.
Abemɛlɛk ne o laa tena doŋ ba ba berɛ chwa dɛɛ kaa Sɛkem, asɛ ba do ba ɡalɡa bwa bola ka tel bwɛɛ la doonyojen ta.
Abemɛlɛk kaa so Aruma, asɛ Sebul doŋi Gaal ne o dɔɔranar ne nimanar la le Sɛkem.
Tɔ aa pera la, Sɛkem tena la berɔ la kpɔɡ bini bela, asɛ ba ka ŋɔ Abemɛlɛk be.
Anomanta, o bɔne o laa tena la bini kuore atoro dɛ ɡel bɛlbwa kaa ka sɔh.
Baa naa kɛŋɔ Sɛkem tena la leɔ dɛɛ ba la, ba iro le ba sɔɔhbɔr bela dɛ́ ba yoo ba.
Abemɛlɛk ne o laa tena kuo beŋkpoŋ ɛ warane dɛ ka tɔ bwɛjen la doonyoa.
Asɛ kuore anɛ baa kaa la ɛ warane, dɛ ka yo banɔ la baa lɔ kpɔɡ bini la dɛ kpoo ba.
Awola tɔpere la bwa, Abemɛlɛk yo bwɛjen la tena, ka tel kɛŋɔ waa kpoo ba bwa.
O paɡre bwɛjen la dɛ kpɔ yar merɛ o ta.
Banɔ la baa lɔ dejaŋ waa lɔ Sɛkem la aa fela no la, ba bwa chwao ka jo ba voɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Ɛl-Berit la dekpeɡ bini.
Abemɛlɛk aa noa kɛ ba bwa lɔ bela la, o ne o laa tena la bwa teehnɔ kaa Salmɔn Bwejen doa.
O kpɔ kpanfɛ teŋe daa dawɛ vam, dɛ do nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la ŋɔ, “Hé ɛ ɡɛ maa ɛa nɔ warane!” Nɛra la bwa teŋni daa dawɛ vaama teŋɛ o nɛ, dɛ kpɔa ka teɡli dekpeɡ la bwa bar, dɛ tɔ nɛra la do dɛ kpaa nii do o ta ba fuh.
Nɛra baa fuah, baala ne haahna bwa, ɛɛ ɛ nɛra kaɡboŋii dɛ ja nɛra baa kpoa mɔɔ la nɛ.
Abemɛlɛk ne o laa tena teŋɔ la Tɛbɛs dɛ ka chɔ baro, dɛ yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Dɛ dejaŋ bɛl lɔ bwɛɛ la ta.
Bela baala ne haahna bwa chwao ka jo o bini dɛ laa ɡbera karɛ ba nɛ, dɛ teeh kaa o saldoa.
Abemɛlɛk ne o laa tena la dejaŋ la bɔr dɛ kpɔ kpeɡri dɛɛ nyin ba jo o bini.
Abemɛlɛk aa suuhna tel ŋɔ ó ka fuh dea la ɡbera la, haah bɛl ɡɔɔ nambwe bɛl lɔ o nyu ta, o nyu paɡre.
O yerɛ o bonɔɔ waa cheɡɛ o dɔmkwaa la dɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛ warane dɛ́ kpɔ he kere ba kpo mɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ ba bɛ ba ŋɔ haahnee kpo mɛ.” Asɛ o bonɔɔ la laa kere pamɛ dɛ tɔɡɔ o sewɛ.
Israel tena la aa naa kɛ ba nomoa Abemɛlɛk sewɔ la, ba berɔ kaa dem.
Gɛɛ a do Korowii tɛr Abemɛlɛk deŋne dɛ le nyubinikpeɡ waa ɛ o mɛɛ dɛ kpoo o dɔɔranar ne nimanar fifraanuanɛ ɡe la.
Korowii berɔ bɔ Sɛkem tena nyubinikpeɡ baa ɛa la kem, dɛ ɡel Gedeɔn bibaa Jotam nyotaahna la laɡ ba.
Tola wa Abemɛlɛk seo habɔɔ la, baa bɛl le Isaaka dea baa yerɔ Tola, o mɛɛ sɔne Pua, o nabaa ɡe sɔne Dodo.
Tolaa baa lɛ Israel tena.
O le Samir, waa lɔ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta.
O tɔ Israel tena sie bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo Samir.
Jɛɛ wa Tola seo habɔɔ la, Jɛɛ waa le Gelead harɛ, baa tɔ Israel tena sie bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ.
Dɛ o dɔ bibaala fifraatoro ba so keeɡore fifraatoro ta dɛɛ nyiŋi bwɛɛre fifraatoro Gelead harɛ ta.
Ba dɛ yerɛ bela Havɔt Jɛɛ ba le fini.
Jɛɛ aa baa sewɛ la, ba kaa huɡo Kamone.
Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ja.
Dɛ voɡa Baalre aa ɛ baala ne voɡhaahna Astɔrɛt, ne voɡa aa lɔ Aram ne Sidon, ne Moab ne Amɔn harɛre, dɛ voɡa Filisti tena aa dɛ tomɛ laanee baa tomɛ.
Baa laa sie kpɔ Korowii nɛɛ dɛ vɛh o toma la, o baah di ba nɛ.
O kpɔ ba do Filisti ne Amɔn tena nɔn ta, ba yoo ba a bena la, dɛ den pɔ ba nɛɛ kwaraa.
Ba ɛ Israel tena la bwa baa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr, dɛ do Gelead harɛ o fa aa ɛ Amɔre tena la harɛ hɔhɔrɔwa bene fi dɛ anuatoro.
Amɔn tena la ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo dɛ ka yo Juda ne Bɛnjamen dɛ Efrem deene tena, asɛ Israel tena do bonyɛɡa ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ Israel tena wi no Korowii ŋɔ, “Ya ɛ wechɔɡa kɛ yaa vɛh he toma, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡ Baal ne o voɡa bwa.” Belaa o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Ijipt ne Amɔre ne Amɔn, dɛ Filisti tena ne Sidon ne Amalɛk, dɛ Mayɔn tena aa ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa, he wi yer mɛ la, n laa lɛ heyaa le ba nɔn ta naa?
Kɛ he laa sie kpɔ n nɛɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa.
Anomanta, maa heyaa lɛ kpa.
Waa pu heya aa, hé ka wi no voɡa haa lea cheɡ tɛ he te la, ásɛ a lɛ heya.” Asɛ Israel tena la ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Ya ɛ wechɔɡa.
Ɛ yaa ɡɛ bɛlbwa haa naa kɛ a wer he be.
Kɛ soŋe, dɛ́ lɛ yaa taraken.” Anomanta, ba laa ba te kpɔ voɡa aa lɔ bela la ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.
Asɛ ba waa domɛ o tea, o sune ba nɛ.
Amɔn laa tena aa kpɔ ba te dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene Gelead harɛ ta dɛ so la, dɛ Israel laa tena ɡe kaa baŋre ba kwaa Mispa harɛ ta.
Asɛ Gelead nomonome la bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Naate waa tɔ sie yá ka yo Amɔn tena la, onee dɛɛ ba nɛra baa lɔ Gelead harɛ nɔ ta sitɔɔ ɛɛ.”
Jɛfta wa Dɛ Gelead te bɛl fa lole baa yerɔ Jɛfta, o ɛ banyoo.
O mɛɛ sɔne Gelead, asɛ o nya ɛ hanjwamane.
Gelead haah ɡbaɡba ɡe lolɛ bibaala tɛo, asɛ baa kpeɡa la ba doŋi Jɛfta.
Ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Haa kapɛrɛ komɛlbwa dɔe ba dɛ́ le ya dem bonɔ.
He nya korɔ.” Anomanta, o chwao le ba bini dɛ ka so Tob harɛ ta.
Belaa nɛra bane baa wola waane dɔe dɛɛ ɛ la, ba ja o nɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o nɛ.
Aa baa tel saŋ bɛl la, Amɔn tena baa yo Israel tena laa, asɛ Gelead harɛ nomonome tomɛ nɛn Jɛfta be Tob harɛ ta, o ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ba ɛ ya laa sitɔɔ, ásɛ ya won ka yo Amɔn tena nɔ.” Belaa Jɛfta chaŋe ŋɔ, “He hah mɛ, dɛ doŋ mɛ le n mɛɛ dem.
Ɛrɛɛ waa aa pu heyaa name te la, he berɛ ba n be nɔɔ?” Gelead nomonome la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpelaa he ŋɔ.
Kɛ name te ya dɛ ba he be.
Ba ja ya nɛɛ yá won ka yo Amɔn tena, ásɛ he ɛ ya Gelead tena bwa sitɔɔ.” Anee Jɛfta ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “A balɔ kɛŋɔ n ne he laŋɔ dɛ ka yoo ba, asɛ Korowii sɛh n pɔ ba nɛ aa, hɛɛ ɡeloo ń ɛ he sitɔɔ kpela aa?” Gelead nomonome la ŋɔ, “Korowiirii ya danseɛ.
Yaa ɛ ɡɛ tenten haa bola nɔɔ.” Anomanta, Jɛfta pu nomonome la kaa, asɛ ba ɛo ba sitɔɔ ne ba laa nomoa.
O ɡe ŋwɛɛ a ɡɛ waa la tenten Korowii sie Mispa.
Jɛfta tomɛ toroma ba la Amɔn kooro be dɛ ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa ya ne he dɔ asɛ hɛɛ ba ba yo yaa ɔ?” Amɔn kooro chaŋe Jɛfta toroma la ŋɔ, “Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ba la, ba lɛ n harɛ le Aanɔn Moo ta ka tel Jabɔk Moo ta, dɛ kpoŋe ka tel Jɔɔdan Moo ta bwa.
Taraken nɔ, berɛ kpɔ tɛ mɛ jeih ken.” Ate, Jɛfta ɡe berɛ tomɛ toroma Amɔn kooro be ŋɔ, “Israel tena ta Moab kɛɛ Amɔn harɛre lɛɛ.
Kɛ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta la, ba valɔ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ ka le Mposwɛm ta, dɛ ka so Kades.
Israel tena tomɛ nɛra Edom kooro be ŋɔ ó tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ ba kpɔ o harɛ ta, kɛ Edom kooro vɛoh.
Ba tomɛ nɛra Moab kooro ɡe be, asɛ o ɡe vɛh.
Anomanta, ba soɡe Kades bela.
Ba berɔ valɛ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ fɛre Edom ne Moab harɛre la, dɛ kpɔ ka le Moab wee leebɔr pera dɛ ka so Aanɔn Moo baŋ bɛl.
Ba ta Moab harɛ la ta joɛ, dɛkalkɛ Aanɔn Moo ɛ ba jwɛh.
Israel tena tomɛ nɛra Amɔre kooro baa dɛ yerɔ Sihon o so bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn be ŋɔ, ‘Tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ yá kpɔ he harɛ ta dɛ́ ba kaa ya ɡbaɡba harɛ ta.’ Kɛ ane a bwa, Kooro Sihon ta Israel tena la yaradae kɛ bá kpɔ o harɛ la ta.
O cheme o laa tena bwa ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so Jahas, asɛ o ne Israel tena yo.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la kpɔ Kooro Sihon ne o nɛra bwa do Israel tena nɔn ta, dɛ ɡel ba pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba harɛre la bwa.
Ba lɛ harɛ la bwa dɛ kpoŋe ka le Aanɔn Moo dɛ kaa Jabɔk Moo ta, dɛ berɛ lɛ le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, dɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Moo ta.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la aa doŋi Amɔre tena le ba harɛ ta dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la, ŋwɛnɛ besoo he dɔ dɛ lɛo wɔ?
Kon he voɡ Kemɔs aa tɛɛ la, he dɛ lɛ.
Gɛɛ a do, kon Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la aa tɛ yaa la, ya ɡe won lɛ.
He ɡwaa Moab Kooro Sepɔ bibaa Balak aa?
O ne Israel tena ta waa beɡrɛ á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa yoo.
Bene lafraatoroo nɔ, Israel tena aa lɛ Hɛsbɔn ne Arowa ne bwɛɛre aa bara, dɛ bwɛɛre aa lɔ Aanɔn Moo la nyoa.
Ɛrɛɛ haa wola berɛ lɛa saŋ laɔ?
N ta hen wechɔɡa ɛɛ, he tenee dɛɛ ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ vɔrɔwe n yoi vɔrɔwa.
N dɛ soŋe kɛŋɔ Korowii waa dɛ pa bole la pa waa aa lɔ Israel tena ne Amɔn tena baah ta nɔ bole fini.” Kɛ ane a bwa, Amɔn kooro ta sie waa Jɛfta aa ɡela ba ba bol la ta doe.
Anee Korowii Doma ba so Jɛfta nɛ, asɛ o ne o laa tena tawɛ Gelead ne Manasɛ deene harɛre ta, dɛ ba Mispa waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta la, dɛ le bela ka yo Amɔn tena.
Asɛ o baɡɛ Korowii nyoa ŋɔ, “Dɛ he kpɔ Amɔn tena do n nɔn ta n pɔ ba nɛ aa, kon te bɛlbwa waa le n dem, dɛ ba chem mɛ ɡɛ saŋ maa kpɔ silɛɛ le Amɔn tena be dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ba dem la, mɛɛ kpoo dɛ́ fuuh ɛ saraha tɛɛ.” Anomanta, Jɛfta ɡale Moo la dɛ́ ka yoo ba, asɛ Korowii kpɔ ba do o nɔn ta o pɔ ba nɛ.
O chɔɡ bwɛɛre fifraanɛ, kpoŋe le Arowa dɛ kaa Minit pera ka tel Ebel Keramim.
Gɛɛ a do Israel tena pɔ Amɔn tena nɛ.
Jɛfta bihaah wa Jɛfta aa bera dɛɛ ba o dem Mispa la, dɛ o bihaahnee lea ba chemo, dɛ yiiɡi kwaa kɛŋɔ loŋa dɛɛ sa.
Dɛ o ɡbosoroo ɛ o bie.
O ta bie bɛlbwa dɔe kpa.
Waa na o bihaah la, o tea bini chɔɡɔ, o laa laala waa doa la kɛɛ dɛ do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ, “Aa, n bie!
He ɡelɔ n loo ku!
N baɡɛ Korowii nyoa maa wola won berɛ nyoa kpa.” O bie la ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ, he dɔɔ baɡɛ Korowii nyoa.
Kpɔ mɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa baɡɔ nyoa la.
Korowiirii tɛ kpeɡri he won kpoo he dɔma Amɔn tena tɔ he wel la.
Kɛ no n webeŋkpoŋ nɔ tɛ mɛ.
Tɛ mɛ korobie anɛ, ásɛ n ne n chamene tena ɡaaɡe deŋɡarere nɔ ta, dɛ́ wi suna dɛkalkɛŋɔ maa yala ba.” O mɛɛ ɡe ŋɔ, “He won kaala.” Asɛ o kaa korobie anɛ.
O ne o bala la kaa wi suna, yala waa wola won yalɛ la wa.
Korobie anɛ la habɔɔ la, o berɔ ba o mɛɛ be, asɛ o kpɔɔ ɛ ɡɛ waa baɡɛ Korowii nyoa la.
O ɛ bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ bwa.
Gɛ waa nɔ taa Israel tena dɔ ba nawee waa bɛl le.
Benanyoa bɛlbwaa toli yon le kaa tɔpera anaarɛ dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ lii Gelead te Jɛfta bihaah la wa.
Jɛfta ne Efrem dea tena wa Efrem dea tena yerɛ ba laa tena cheme dɛ ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo kaa bwɛjen Safɔn ka ŋɔ Jɛfta be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ka yo Amɔn tena haa wola yaa yerɛ ja he nɛɔ?
Yaa fuh he dem nɔɔ ta he nɛ.” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ne n nɛra fa aa lɔ wekpeɡa ta, dɛ yo Amɔn tena la, n yerɛ heya, he vɛh bala dɛ́ ba lɛ yaa le ba nɔn ta.
Maa naa kɛ haa men cha la waa n kpɔ n nyu charɛ seo dɛ ɡale ka yo Amɔn tena, asɛ Korowii ɡel n pɔ ba nɛ.
Aah ɛrɛ waa he ba taraken dɛ́ ba yoo mɛ nɔɔ?” Jɛfta yerɛ Gelead harɛ ta laa tena cheme dɛ ka yo Efrem dea tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Efrem tena bolɔ ŋɔ Gelead tena pere ba te le Efrem ne Manasɛ deene tena nɛ.
Gelead tena kaa teŋe leebɔɔne baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛ ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo dɛɛ kaa Efrem harɛ ta la.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa chwao le laa la ta dɛ ba tel bela aa, ɡɛɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Efrem dea tee hen aa?” Dɛ o ŋɔ, “Ɔɔhɔh” naa, ɡɛɛ ba yon ŋɔ ó si “Shibolet”.
Dɛ o ta jemɛ siu kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ŋɔ “Sibolet” aa, ɡɛɛ ba lawɔ dɛ kpoo Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa bela.
Efrem dea tena kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛɛ ba kpoo bela ɡɛ saŋ.
Jɛfta tɔ Israel tena sie bene anumɛl mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo Gelead harɛ bwɛɛre la bɛl ta.
Ibsan ne Ɛlɔn dɛ Abdɔn wa Jɛfta habɔɔ, Bɛtlɛham te Ibsan baa ɛ Israel tena sitɔɔ.
Dɛ o dɔ bibaala fifraatoro dɛ bihaahna ɡe fifraatoro.
O kpɔ o bihaahna la tɛ baala baa wola o dea ta leɛ ba mo.
Asɛ dɛ ka mo toli fifraatoro baa wola o dea ta leɛ tɛ o bibaala la.
Ibsan tɔ Israel tena sie bene anuanɛ.
O baa sewɛ asɛ ba huɡo Bɛtlɛham.
O ɡe seo habɔɔ la, Ɛlɔn waa le Sebulon deaa baa so o buɡ ta dɛ ɛ Israel tena sitɔɔ.
O ɡe tɔ Israel tena sie bene fi.
Waa baa sewa la, ba huɡo Aejalɔn Sebulon dea harɛ ta.
O habɔɔ, Abdɔn baa so o buɡ ta, dɛ tɔ Israel tena sie.
O mɛɛ sɔne Helɛl dɛ le bwɛɛ Peratɔn.
O dɔ bibaala fifraanaarɛ dɛ naanar fifraatoro, baa so keeɡore fifraanuanɛ ta.
Bene anuatoroo o ɛ Israel tena sitɔɔ.
Helɛl bibaa Abdɔn baa sewɛ ba huɡo Peratɔn, Efrem dea deŋɡarere harɛ Amalɛk tena fa aa soɡe bela la ta.
Samsen lola wa Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ja, anomanta, o kpɔ ba do Filisti tena nɔn ta ba fiɡ ba bene fifraanaarɛ.
Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Manoa dɛ le bwɛɛ Sora, dɛ do Dan dea tena harɛ ta.
Dɛ o haah ɛ hambara.
Korowii nyundua torome ba o be ba ŋɔ, “He ɛ hambara, kɛ hɛ́ɛ kpoŋe tea dɛ́ lolɛ bibaa.
Taraken, nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ seŋkpeɡa bɛlbwa dɛɛ nyɔ, bɛ komɛlbwa waa ɛ n kii kon ɡe di.
He tea haa dɛ ba kpoŋa la, bibaalee hɛɛ ba lola.
Dɛ́ɛ berɛ o nyu fona bwa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɛɛ leo cheɡ ó ɛ Nasiri te dɛ́ le o lola saŋ bwa.
Onee dɛɛ ba mun pae dɛ́ lɛ Israel tena le Filisti tena nɔn ta.” Asɛ haah la la o jaa be ka ŋɔ, “Korowii nɛn bɛl ba n be.
O le Korowii nyundua torome, o ɔma kɛrɛdɛ.
N ta on bɔɔrɛ bela waa lea, o ta men o sɔn ɡe baɡlɛ.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ mɛɛ kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa.
Anomanta, n bɛ seŋkpeɡa bɛlbwa nyɔ, kɛɛ dɛ di kii kon bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii le bie la cheɡ o lola saŋ bwa, ó ɛ Nasiri te ka tel o serewe wee.” Asɛ Manoa soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n dɛ soŋe, ɡel he torome la ba ya be ja dɛ́ ba baɡle yaa ŋwɛnɛ yaa kpɔ o ta nyiŋi bie yaa dɛ́ ba o lola nɔ.” Korowii no Manoa wesoŋa la asɛ dɛ ɡel o nyundua torome ba haah la be ja, dɛ haah la lɔ kpɔɡ bini ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ o jaa ta o nɛɛ jae.
Haah la ɛ warane dɛ ka ŋɔ o jaa be ŋɔ, “Baa la waa ba n be awola la balɔ ja!” Ate, Manoa ir dɛ teŋɛ o haah nɛɛ ba kaa.
Waa la baa la be la, o ŋɔ, “Henee bol waane n haah be la aa?” Anee baa la ŋɔ, “Menee.” Belaa Manoa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he waa nɔ baa ɛ kpela aa, ɛrɛɛ bie la nyiŋa bini ne o toma ɛɛ bini ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?” Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ he haah ɛ ɡɛ bwa maa bol o be la.
O bɛ ɡrepo nɔn komɛlbwa di, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ nyɔ seŋkpeɡa bɛlbwa kɛɛ wɛɛ di kii konee.
A chɛ kɛ ó ɛ anɔ la bwa maa doo la.” Manoa ŋɔ Korowii nyundua torome la be ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ nyin kɛ he so ka tel kɛ yaa kpo bombie bɛl tɛɛ.” O chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Hé laɡ mɛ so ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, maa kondikwaa di.
Dɛ hɛɛ fuh kwaa ɛ sarahaa te naa, hé ɛ tɛ Korowii.” Dɛ Manoa ta jemɛ kɛ Korowii nyundua toromee on.
Manoa berɔ bɔɔro ja ŋɔ, “He sɔne ɛrɔɔ?
Gɛ aa ɛ dɛ he waa haa bola nɔ baa ɛ kpela aa, yá tɛɛ duure.” Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ bɔɔ mɛ n sɔn nɔɔ?
A mun noe ɡwaa he liire ta.” Asɛ Manoa kpo bombie dɛ kpɔ mea ja ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii bwetal bɛl ta.
Korowii ɛ nyokpowaa Manoa ne o haah siwi ta bela.
Ninlao le kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta, dɛ hɔ dɛɛ kaa nyundua, asɛ Korowii nyundua torome la kpɔ ninlao la bini kaa nyundua.
Manoa ne o haah aa na ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba cholo dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Baa wola on nae kpa la, Manoa ne o haah jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii nyundua toromee kpela.
Manoa ŋɔ o haah be ŋɔ, “Serewaa yaa ba serewa, dɛkalkɛ ya na Korowii.” Haah la ŋɔ o jaa be ŋɔ, “Korowii dɛ nyin ya kpoe yaa, o fe ta kwaa yaa fuah ɛ saraha nɔ ne mea nɔ lɛɛ.
O fe ta ɡelɛ ya na nyokpowaa nɔ bwa, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ waa nɔ ya be nɔ.” Haah la aa dɛ ba lola la, bibaalee o lolɛ, asɛ ba pa o sɔn Samsen.
O kpeɡo asɛ Korowii sweero andɛɛɡa.
Korowii Doma ɡe baa so o nɛ, dɛ pa mun kpɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma ɡɛ saŋ waa lɔ bwɛɛ Mahane Dan, o lɔ Sora ne Ɛstaol baah ta.
Samsen haah moe wa Awola bɛl, Samsen iro dɛ la Temna, dɛ ka na Filisti tolo bɛl.
Waa bera ba dem la, o ŋɔ o nya ne o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, “Maa la Temna la, n na Filisti tolo bɛl n sie lɛ o nɛ.
N dɛ nyin kɛ hé ka moo tɛ mɛ.” Anee ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Haahna toole ya dea kɛɛ ya Israel tena bini hɛɛ la ka mo haah Filisti tena voɡtoroma nɔ bini naa?” Asɛ o ŋɔ o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, “Onee n bambile lawɛ, nyinu tɛ mɛ.” O mɛɛ ne o nya ta wone jemɛ kɛ Korowii bee a le wɛɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta Samsen won ka yo Filisti tena.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ banee dɛɛ nyiŋi Israel tena nɛ.
Samsen ne o nya ne o mɛɛ bwa pɛo la Temna.
Baa dɛ tel bwɛɛ la daa kooni ta la, buɡ la ta, nyujente bie den le dɛ kɔɡre dɛɛ ba o be.
Korowii Doma den ba so Samsen nɛɛ kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ tɛo kpeɡri, asɛ o lawɛ nyujente la dɛ kpɔ nɔn toɡru kɛŋɔ bombie ken.
O ta o nya ne o mɛɛ be ɡɛ waa ɛa la bolɛ.
Samsen aa la Temna la, o kaa bol waa haah la be, o pɛla lawɔ.
Aa dɛ la sie la, o berɔ la ŋɔ ó ka nyin haah la, dɛ ka bɛɡɛ jo bela waa kpo nyujente la, dɛ na kɛ toohna aa do noo nyujente la lale ta.
O kwɛɛ tohnoo la do o nɔɔra ta dɛ di dɛɛ kaa.
Waa la o nya ne o mɛɛ be la, o tɛɛ ba ane ba di, kɛ o ta ba be bolɛ ŋɔ nyujente lale la taa o le a ne.
O mɛɛ laŋɔ ka na haah la.
Samsen ɡelɔ ba ɛ kondikonjena ɡɛ hanfale jaa bɛlbwa aa dɛ ɛ la.
Baa na Samsen la, ba tɛo bonɔɔna fifraatoro ba so o jwɛh.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel n bɔɔ heyaa wobobeele bɛl.
Dɛ he wono baɡ mɛ o mun tɔpera anuanɛ yaa dɛ ba dii hanfalkondikwaa nɔ mun aa, mɛɛ tɛ heya yapondɛɛɡa fifraatoro ne yabele fifraatoroo.
Dɛ he baɡ mɛ kahonɛ ɡe aa, mɛɛ lɛ heya yapondɛɛɡa fifraatoro ne yabele fifraatoroo.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Bol waa la ya no.” Anee o ŋɔ, “Didii bee kondikwaa le, bokpeɡa te bee kontora do.” Tɔpera atoro bwa dɛ ba ta wone baɡle ɡɛ waa la mun.
Tɔpenaarɛ wee la, ba ŋɔ Samsen haah la be ŋɔ, “Yeraa he yerɛ yaa dɛ́ ba ŋwɛ yaa kɛɛ?
Ta he jaa baradeɛ ó baɡle yaa waa nɔ mun.
Gɛ la aa, yaa fuh he ne he mɛɛ dem tena bwaa.” Samsen haah la kpɔ wii la o be ka ŋɔ, “He hah mɛ, haa men nyin.
He tɛ n nɛra wobobeele kɛ he ta men a mun baɡlɛ.” Anee o ŋɔ, “N ta n nya ne n mɛɛ ɡba baɡlɛ.
Ɛrɛ waa mɛɛ baɡle he te nɔ?” O wio tɔpera anuanɛ baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ hanfalwaa la bwa.
Waa teŋa dɛɛ pɛɛro la, o sɛh dɛ baɡlo a mun tɔpenuanɛ wee la ta.
Asɛ o ɡe ka bol o nɛra la be.
Wee aa dɛ ba joe la, nɛra la baɡle Samsen waa la mun ŋɔ, “Tohnoo som ɡwaa komɛlbwa.
Nyujente bwara kpeɡri ɡwaa komɛlbwa.” Anee Samsen chaŋe ŋɔ, “N haah laa baɡle heya aa, he fe aa won jemɛ waa nɔ mun.” Korowii Doma baa so Samsen nɛɛ dɛ tɛo kpeɡri.
O la Filisti tena bwɛɛ Askɛlɔn, dɛ ka kpoo baala fifraatoro, dɛ pa ba laala ba tɛ nɛra baa baɡlo wobobeele la mun la.
O baah diu kɛrɛdɛ, o chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa o bwɛ o mɛɛ be.
Haah la mɛɛ berɔ kpɔ Samsen haah la tɛ o dam tɛnte waa soɡe o jwɛh hanfalkondikwaa la mun la.
Samsen tɔ o wel Filisti tena nɛ A habɔɔ la, dɛ mea koma saŋ telo, asɛ Samsen lawɛ bombie ŋɔ ó kpɔ ka tɛ o haah.
Waa laŋa la o ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ jo n haah be deaa.” Kɛ o haah mɛɛ ta on ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ o jo.
