Haah la mɛɛ ŋɔ, “N ken ŋɔ he vɛoh, haa on nyin kpa.
N kpɔɔ tɛ he daamanar baa ba he hanfalkondikwa mun la bɛl.
O dɔ nime bɛl o do wer ɡwaalo kwara, amɔ kpɔɔ chiɡ o naa ta.” Anee Samsen ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Taraken te n dɔ ŋwɛnɛ ń so Filisti tena nɛ, mɛɛ ɛɛ ba tomaa kɛrɛdɛ.” Samsen kaa lawɛ kalampoŋare lafraatoro dɛ vɔrɔwe a dini pɛ anɛnɛ, dɛ vɔwɛ kapɛle su a dini la ta.
O choŋi nii do kapɛle la ta dɛ ɡel kalampoŋare la ta Filisti tena mea a taa cheɡɛ kooni ta, dɛ fuh mea ne daa kooni la bwa.
Filisti tena la bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “Amɔ umee ɛ ken ɔ?” Asɛ ba bol ba be ŋɔ, “Samsen o helabaa aa ɛ Temna te laanee.
O hela lɛ o haah la tɛ o dam bɛl.” Anomanta, Filisti tena la kaa fuh tolo la ne o mɛɛ bwa.
Anee Samsen ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Waa haa ɛa nɔ nomanta, maa ɡela ba, ka tel kɛŋɔ maa tɔ n wel he nɛ.” O kaa yoo ba sibeɡra ne dɛ kpoo ba ɡalɡa, dɛ ka so bwe Etam bɔɔ bini.
Filisti laa tena kaa baŋre ba tɛnte deene Juda dea harɛ ta, dɛ ka yo bwɛɛ bɛl waa bɛne ba baa yerɔ Lehi.
Asɛ Juda harɛ ta baala bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa hɛɛ ba ba yo yaa nɔɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Samsenee yaa ba bá lawɛ, dɛ́ ka ɛo ɡɛ waa ɛ yaa la bɔ kem.” Ate, Juda harɛ baala kaɡboŋa batoro la Samsen be Etam bwebɔɔ la bɔr dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Filisti tenaa dɛɛ di kpeɡri ya nɛɛ kɛɛ?
Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ yaa ken nɔɔ?” Anee o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Gɛ baa ɛɛ mɛ la, ɡɛ ɡboo n ɡe ka ɛɛ ba.” Ba ɡe ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya balɔ dɛ́ ba vɔrɔwe, dɛ́ kpɔe ka do Filisti tena nɔn ta.” Ate, Samsen ɡe ŋɔ, “Hé ŋwɛɛ baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba aa men kpo.” Ba sɛoh ŋɔ, “Yaa hen kpo.
Vɔrɔwaa yaa ba he vɔrɔwa dɛ́ kpɔe ka do ba nɔn ta.” Anomanta, ba vɔrɔwo ŋwɛnfala anɛ ne dɛ le o ne bwebɔɔ la ta kaa.
Waa dɛ bɛne Lehi la, Filisti tena la ɛɛ moo dɛ kpɔ sie pa o be dɛɛ ba.
Buɡ la ta, Korowii Doma ba so o nɛ dɛ tɛo kpeɡri kohona.
Asɛ ŋwɛɛra baa kpɔa vɔrɔwo la ɛ kɛŋɔ kwaa baa fuah ken dɛ le o nɔɔra ta.
O na keeɡo kaŋe hoɡfale harɛ, asɛ o laa kee dɛ kpɔ kpoo baala kaɡboŋ.
Anomanta, Samsen ŋɔ, “Keeɡo kaŋe hoɡ nee n kpoo baala kaɡboŋ, n kpoo ba ba daŋɛ chɔ.” Waa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, o kpɔ keeɡo kaŋe hoɡ la viɡri, asɛ ba pa bela sɔn Ramat Lehi.
Dɛ nyɔɡre dɛ kpoo kohona, anomanta, o wio no Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, henee tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ kpeɡri n won ɛ wejena nɔ dɔŋ dɛ pɔ n dɔma nɛ, asɛ nyɔɡre ɛɛ kpo mɛ.
Ń sewɛ voɡtoroma nɔ nɔn ta naa?” Asɛ Korowii ɡel bɔɔ bɛl pili Lehi, asɛ nee le o bini.
Samsen aa nyɔa la, o bwara berɔ ir o dɔ bokpeɡfala ja.
Anomanta, ba pa bela nee aa bula le la sɔn Ɛn Hakore.
O ta chɔ Lehi ba le fini.
Samsen tɔ Israel tena sie bene fifraanɛ ɡɛ saŋ Filisti tena aa dɛ di kpeɡri ba nɛɛ la.
Samsen ba Gasa Awola bɛl, Samsen la Filisti tena bwɛɛ Gasa ta.
O na jwamanhaah bɛl dɛ ka chɔ o be.
Asɛ nɛra bol bwɛɛ la tena be ŋɔ, “Samsen ba bonɔ!” Anomanta, ba bar bwɛɛ la cheme jwaana la ne dɛɛ kpao bwɛɛ la doonyoa.
Ba ta bela leɛ jwaana la ne bwa dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, “Bɔr chaahna binii yaa ba o dɔe dɛ́ kpoo.” Samsen chɔ bela ka tel harambaŋa ɡbo.
Asɛ o ir dɛ ka lawɛ bwɛɛ la doonyoa ɡbeni, dɛ laa a daa ne buni baa kpɔa karɔ la bwa huɡri dawɛ o vam ta, dɛ kpɔ kaa deŋɡare bɛl waa chaɡɛ Hɛbrɔn ta.
Samsen ne Delaela A habɔɔ la, o pɛla lawɛ haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Delaela.
O soɡe fɛlembɔjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sorek bini.
Filisti nomonome la la haah la be ŋɔ, “Takapɔ dɛ tao baradeɛre, ásɛ o baɡle o bokpeɡa kohona waa dɔa nɔ mun, ne ɡɛ yaa dɛ ba wona pɔ o nɛɛ dɛ́ won vɔrɔwo o sɔɔh.
Ya bini bɛlbwa fe ɛɛ tɛɛ suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋ dɛ lafaa.” Anomanta, Delaela ŋɔ Samsen be ŋɔ, “Baɡ mɛ he bokpeɡa kohona haa dɔa nɔ mun, ne ŋwɛnɛ yaa kpɔ o ta dɛ́ won vɔrɔwe he sɔɔh.” Anee Samsen chaŋo ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa kpɔ ol tɔnlwɛɛ ŋwɛɛra bele anuanɛ aa wola holɛ vɔɡ mɛ naa, mɛɛ ɡwɛɡroo dɛ do kɛ baa bɛlbwa aa doa.” Filisti nomonome la nyin ol tɔnlwɛɛ ŋwɛɛra bele anuanɛ aa wola holɛ tɛ haah la ásɛ o vɔrɔwo.
Dɛ baala bane sɔh o be dea, asɛ o yerɔ takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “Samsen, Filisti tena dɛ ba he nɛ!” O chaa ol tɔn ŋwɛɛra la kɛŋɔ jise baa choŋi nii leɡo ken.
Anomanta, ba ta wone jemɛ o bokpeɡa waa dɔa la mun.
Delaela ŋɔ Samsen be ŋɔ, “Gɛnee men hɛɛ neɡ mɛ naa?
Name te, chaɡ mɛ ɡɛ baa ɛ dɛ́ won vɔrɔwe.” Samsen ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ ba vɔɡ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ ŋwɛnfala baa wola a ne wobɛlbwa ɛɛ mɔɔ ne naa, mɛɛ ɡwɛɡroo dɛ́ do kɛ baa bɛlbwa aa doa.” Anomanta, Delaela kpɔ ŋwɛnfala ba vɔrɔwo, dɛ baala bane sɔh dea.
O yerɔ takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “Samsen, Filisti tena dɛ ba he nɛ!” O berɔ chaa ŋwɛɛra la kɛŋɔ jise ken.
Delaela berɔ ŋɔ o be ja ŋɔ, “He kpɔ mɛ ɛ ɡɛne dɛ ba le saŋ nɔ dɛ ta na dɛɛ neɡ mɛ.
Name te, den chaɡ mɛ ɡɛ baa vɔrɔwe.” Anee o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Dɛ he kpɔ n nyumpona baa pɛra anuanɛ dɛ do kokorowa kon ta dɛ sɔh pɛ, dɛ kpɔ dajeɡa la hama aa, mɛɛ ɡwɛɡroo dɛ́ do kɛ baa bɛlbwa aa doa.” Anomanta, waa baa chɔ dom la, Delaela ɛ ɡɛ.
O lawɛ o nyumpona baa pɛra anuanɛ la dɛ sɔah ja jisere la ta, dɛ kpɔ dajeɡa la hama kiŋkiŋ ken.
O yerɔ takpeɡ ne ja ŋɔ, “Samsen, Filisti tena la dɛ ba he nɛ!” O ir dom ta dɛ tɛr dajeɡa la ne kokorowa kon ne jisere la bwa le.
Anee o ŋɔ Samsen be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ŋɔ he dɛ nyin mɛ, dɛ haa he tea bini waa n be bol nɔɔ?
Tooro tenaa he ta na dɛɛ ɛɛ mɛ ɡɛne, haa wola men he bokpeɡa haa dɔa kohona nɔ mun baɡlɛ la.” Tɔpere bɛlbwaa haah la teŋɛ dɛɛ bɔɔro, a ba le o mee.
Anomanta, Samsen bol o tea bini waa bwa chaɡlo ŋɔ, “Ba ta fon kpɔe fonɛ n nyu bwa.
Nasiri tee men.
Korowii lee mɛ cheɡ tɛ o te, dɛ le n lola saŋ bwa.
Ba fonɛ n nyu aa, n bokpeɡa maa dɔa nɔ bwa dɛ ba tona n ɡwɛɡre kɛ baa bɛlbwa ken.” Delaela nao kɛŋɔ o bol o kasinteŋ bwa baɡlo, anomanta, o tomɛ nɛra ba ka ŋɔ Filisti tena nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Name te hé den ba kerabeŋkpoŋ.
O baɡ mɛ o kasinteŋ bwa.” A ɡelɔ anɔ te, ba kpoŋe suuɡapoŋa la dɛ la.
Haah la ɡbɛɡbɛ Samsen o chɔ dom dawɛ o nakpale ta.
Asɛ o yerɛ baa bɛl o ba fonɛ o nyumpona baa pɛra anuanɛ la.
Belaa o pa mun ɡwɛɡre, o bokpeɡa la bwa tonɛ.
Delaela yerɔ ŋɔ, “Samsen, Filisti tena la pui!” O ir dom ta dɛ lii kɛŋɔ, “Mɛɛ le busee ɡɛ n fa aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ́ kpɔ n bokpeɡa lɛ n te.” Dɛ o ta jemɛ kɛ Korowii laa nɔn kpɔ o nɛ.
Filisti tena la lawɔ, dɛ foromi o sibie dɛ kaa o ne Gasa.
Ba doo ayaawa jɔɡrɔre dɛ doo dea, dɛ ɡel wɛɛ namɛ kwa.
Baa fonɛ o nyu la habɔɔ, o nyumpona berɔ pa mun dɛɛ moɡɛ ja.
Samsen seo A balɔ kɛŋɔ Filisti tena nomonome chemo dɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahajen tɛ ba voɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Daɡɔn dɛɛ lɛ ba sie.
Ba ŋɔ, “Ya voɡ kpɔ Samsen waa ɛ ya dɔm la do ya nɔn ta.” Nɛra la aa na Samsen la, ba duu ba voɡ la ŋɔ, “Ya voɡ kpɔ ya dɔm do ya nɔn ta.
Naate waa chɔɡ ya harɛ, dɛ kpoo nɛra kohona la lɔ ya nɔn ta.” Ba sie lɛo kohona, ba moo ŋɔ, “Hé ba Samsen ne ó ba lɛ ya sie.” Anomanta, ba kaa lawɔ le dea baa doo la bini, ó ba ɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin bwa tɛɛ ba.
Ba kpɔɔ ka che pilare ane baah ta, asɛ Samsen ŋɔ bonɔɔ waa lawɛ o nɔn la be ŋɔ, “Kaa n ne pilare aa lawɛ voɡ dea nɔ kpoŋe nɔ jwɛh ásɛ n ka yala.” Dɛ baala ne haahna bwaa su dea la bini, asɛ Filisti nomonome bwa ɡe do bela.
Asɛ nɛra dɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa batoro, haahna ne baala, do dea la saldoa dɛɛ nyiŋi we-ɛɛla Samsen aa dɛ ɛ la.
Belaa Samsen soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, n dɛ soŋe, dɛɛ lii n wa.
N Naa Korowii, n poori, ɡel n bokpeɡa berɛ ba kerabeŋkpoŋ ja, ásɛ n ɛ we-ɛɛle beŋkpoŋ dɛ́ kpɔ tɔ n wel Filisti tena baa foromi n sibie nɔ nɛ.” Anomanta, o suuhno bɛne baah ta pilare anɛ aa lawɛ dea la kpoŋe la.
O kpɔ nɔndiɡ lawɛ bɛl asɛ dɛ kpɔ nɔŋɡal lawɛ nɛɛte, dɛ kpɔ o bokpeɡa bwa ta a ta dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ɡel n ne Filisti tena nɔ pɛ serewe!” Asɛ o taɡɛ pilare la o bokpeɡa bwa ne, asɛ dea la chole pi Filisti nomonome ne nɛra baa lɔ o bini bwa nɛ.
Gɛɛ a do nɛra o ne baa pɛa dɛ sewɛ la ɡwaa banɔ la ɡɛ saŋ o siwi aa lole o kpoo ba la.
Asɛ o dɔɔranar ne nimanar ne o mɛɛ nɛra bwa la ka kpɔ o lale, dɛ ba o ne dɛ ba pili bɔɔ baa huɡe o mɛɛ Manoa o bini la ta dɛ huɡo.
Lalbɔɔ la lɔ bwɛɛre Sora ne Ɛstaol baah ta.
Samsen tɔ Israel tena sie bene fifraanɛ.
Maeka voɡa wa Baa bɛlee fa lole baa yerɔ Maeka.
O le Efrem dea dɛ so Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta.
Awola bɛl, o iro dɛ ŋɔ o nya be ŋɔ, “N noɔ kɛ haa dɛ taah naate waa kpɔ he suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋ dɛ lafa.
Menee kpɔa, a lɔ n be.” Asɛ o berɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa la tɛ o nya, anee o nya ŋɔ, “N bie, Korowiirii dɛ sweere andɛɛɡa.” Waa kpɔa tɛ o nya la, o nya ŋɔ, “N kpɔɔ do Korowii nɔn ta, ásɛ n bie Maeka kpɔ ɛ voɡ dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa la maɡre o ta.
Anomanta, n bie, n kpɔɔ tɛɛ.” O kpɔ suuɡapoŋa la tɛ o nya, o ɡe kpɔ a bini lafraanɛ ka tɛ nɛn waa dɔ suuɡapoŋa kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema, asɛ o kpɔ ɛ voɡ, ba kpɔ ka cheɡ Maeka dem.
Dɛ Maeka nɔ dɔ voɡ dea, asɛ o ɛ batakaarebora kɛŋɔ sɔfo batakaare baa dɛ yerɔ efɔd la ken ne voɡa ane, dɛ kpɔ o bibaala la bɛl ɛ o kerekpoŋri.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Israel tena ta kooro dɔe, asɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ ɛ waa waa dɛ nyin.
Dɛ bonɔɔ bɛl ɛ Lewi dea te dɛ le Bɛtlɛham waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ so Juda dea tena bini.
O le Bɛtlɛham dɛɛ la ka nyin bofale dɛ́ so.
Waa chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la, o kaa le Maeka dem Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ la ta.
Anee Maeka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa he leɔ?” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “N ɛ Lewi dea te, n le Bɛtlɛham Juda harɛ ta dɛɛ nyin bobɛl dɛ́ so.” Anee Maeka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “So n be bonɔ dɛ berɛ n mɛɛ ne n kerekpoŋri, ásɛ benanyoa bɛlbwa mɛɛ tɛɛ suuɡapoŋa fi ne laala dɛ kondikwa.” Anomanta, bonɔɔ la sɛoh so Maeka be, o kpɔɔ ɛ o bibaala la bɛl.
Maeka kpɔɔ ɛ o voɡ la kerekpoŋri, o do dem bela.
Ate, Maeka ŋɔ, “Taraken maa dɔ Lewi dea te o ɛ n kerekpoŋri nɔ, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo n wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ mɛ.”
Dan dea tena Lais soɡa wa Kooro toole Israel tena harɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ.
Dɛ Dan dea tena ta harɛ dɔe o ɛ ba ɡbaɡba kon Israel harɛ ta, ba ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin bela baa so.
Anomanta, Dan dea tena tomɛ laa tena banue le bwɛɛre Sora ne Ɛstaol ŋɔ bá ka sɔh ɡaaɡe harɛ la ta dɛ́ na ɡɛ waa doa.
A ɡɛ laa tena nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ Dan dea tena bwa.
Ba ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ka ɡaaɡe harɛ la dɛ́ na ɡɛ waa doa.” Ba jo Efrem dea tena deŋɡarere harɛ ta, dɛ ka le Maeka dem dɛ chɔ bela.
Baa lɔ dem bela la, ba no Lewi bonɔɔ bɛl taa, dɛ la o be ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Umee ba he ne bonɔ nɔ?
Bɔkwaa hɛɛ ɛ bonɔ nɔ?
Bɔkwa waa he do bonɔ nɔ?” O ŋɔ ba be ɡɛ Maeka aa ɛa tɛo dɛ ŋɔ, “O kpɔ mɛ ɛ o voɡ kerekpoŋri dɛɛ bɔ mɛ kem.” Ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya poori, bɔɔ Korowii na kɛ ya ŋwɛnɛ yaa dɛ kaa nɔ ɛɛ ka do werii tɛ yaa kɛɛ?” Anee kerekpoŋri la ŋɔ, “Hé kaa deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
Korowii ja he nɛ.” Anomanta, baala banue la leɔ dɛ kaa Lais harɛ.
Belaa ba ka na kɛŋɔ bela nɛra la soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta kɛŋɔ Sidon tena ken, dɛ so kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa aa ban pu.
Komɛlbwa lɔ ba harɛ la ta, ba dɔ ba te.
Ba ne Sidon tena baah jaŋne, ba ne nomɛlbwa aa chamene di.
Nɛra banue la aa bera ba Sora ne Ɛstaol la, ba bala bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa he ka na nɔ?” Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé ba yá ka yoo ba!
Ya nao kɛŋɔ harɛ la wer kɛrɛdɛ.
Hé ɛ warane, hɛɛ berɛ ɔma.
Yá kaa, yaa pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ harɛ la.
Hé laŋaa, hɛɛ pu nɛra baa wola lii kɛŋɔ waane ɛɛ pu baa.
Harɛ la kan. Korowii kpɔɔ do he nɔn ta.
Komɛlbwa ta o ta nyae.” Anee baala lafraanumɛl le Dan dea dɛ vɔrɔwe laa le Sora ne Ɛstaol dɛɛ kaa ka yoo ba.
Baa dɛ kaa la, ba kaa baŋre ba tɛnte deene Kiriat Jearim, o lɔ Juda harɛ ta.
A ɡɛ nomanta, ba dɛ yerɛ Kiriat Jearim wee cholibɔr Mahane Dan, dɛ ba le fini.
Baa le bela la, ba kaa Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta, dɛ ka le Maeka dem.
Baala banue baa laŋa ka sɔh nyiŋi Lais harɛ la ŋɔ ba bala laa tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé jemɔ kɛŋɔ batakaarebora waa do kɛŋɔ efɔd ne dem voɡare baa sɛah kɛɛ dɛ loɡa lɔ deremi nɔ bɛl ta naa?
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ yá ɛɔ?” Ba bɛɡɔ jo Maeka dem dɛ ka na Lewi bonɔɔ la bela dɛ chɔɔro.
Dan dea laa tena baa kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ka yo la cheɡɛ dem la doonyoa.
Baala banue baa kaa sɔh ɡaaɡe harɛ la ta la joɔ kaa dem la bini, dɛ ka kpɔ batakaarebora waa do kɛ efɔd la, ne voɡ baa sɛah la, ne deremi voɡa ane ne voɡ baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ɛo la, dɛ anɔ la aa jaa bwa.
Asɛ kerekpoŋri la ne laa tena lafraanumɛl la ɡe che doonyoa la ta.
Nɛra nɔ aa kaa jo Maeka dem dɛ ka pa a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ la, kerekpoŋri la bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ ɡee hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?” Anee ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Tɔ nyoa, bɛ nyoa pili bol wa.
Ba ja ya nɛɛ dɛ́ ɛ ya mɛɛ ne nɛn waa dɛɛ ja yaa.
Dɛ he tomɛ Israel dea bɛl nɛra kwaraa naa, a laa wera ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa dɛ tomɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ne o dem tena ɡbo naa?” Sɔfo la sɛoh silɛɛ ne dɛ pa batakaarebora waa do kɛ efɔd, ne voɡ baa sɛah ne deremi voɡa dɛ kwaa aa jaa bwa, dɛ teŋɛ nɛra la nɛɛ kaa.
Ba kpɔ ba bii ne ba laala dɛ teɡɛ ba kondɛɛra tɔ ba sie kaa.
Baa vala le Maeka dem tel sie tama la, Maeka yerɛ nɛra o ne ba deremi aa bɛne dɔŋa la, dɛ ti Dan dea tena la dɛ ka puu ba.
Ba teŋɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ yer ba, asɛ Dan dea tena la laa berɛ dɛ bɔɔ Maeka ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa yɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he yerɛ he nɛra bá ba yo yaa nɔɔ?” Anee o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Haa jemɛ waa haa ɛa aa?
He kpɔ n voɡa maa ɛa ne n Kerekpoŋri kaa.
Bɔkwaa n dɔ jaɔ?” Asɛ Dan dea tena la ŋɔ, “Bɛ yaa tɔŋle, ya bini bane baah aa biɡri dii.
Ba baah diu waa, baa yo heyaa dɛ́ kpoo he ne he dem tena bwa.” Anomanta, Dan dea tena la kaalɔ, asɛ Maeka aa naa kɛŋɔ ba kpeɡri ɡwaalo la, o berɛ kaa dem.
Asɛ ba kpɔ kwaa Maeka aa ɛa la ne o sɔfo la kaa Lais harɛ ta, dɛ yo nɛra ba fe aa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, baa wola lii kɛ wobɛlbwa ɛɛ puu baa la, dɛ fuh ba bwɛɛ la.
Ba ta lɛɛ bɛlbwa dɔe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ne Sidon tena baah jaŋne.
Ba ta nomɛlbwa ɡe dɔe ba ne baa di chamene.
Bwɛɛ la chɔ fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini dɛ bɛne bwɛɛ Bɛt Rehob.
Dan dea tena kwaarɔ vɔrɔwe bwɛɛ la dɛ so o ta.
Ba kpɔ ba nabaa Dan sɔn pa bwɛɛ la, ba bwa nabaa Jekɔb aa lolɔ la.
Dɛ ba fa dɛ yerɛ bwɛɛ la Lais.
Dan dea tena cheɡ voɡa la bwɛɛ la ta dɛɛ toma, asɛ dɛ kpɔ Jonatan ɛ ba kerekpoŋri.
O mɛɛ sɔne Gɛɛsɔm, Gɛɛsɔm ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Mosis.
Jonatan bibaala ɛ ba sɔfore dɛ kpoŋe ka tel saŋ nɛra bane aa baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa harɛfale ta.
Gɛ saŋ Korowii Tɛnte Dea aa lɔ Silo la bwa, dɛ ba ta teŋɔ dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa Maeka aa ɛa la.
Lewi dea te bɛl ne o sɛno wa A saŋ la, dɛ kooro toole Israel harɛ ta.
Dɛ Lewi dea te bɛl soɡe bojaŋ bwɛɛ bɛl ta, Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta, dɛ ka kpɔ haah Bɛtlɛham waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta o ne wɛɛ di nyoa sɛm.
Haah la le baa la habɔɔ dɛ ka chɔ banfale be, dɛ berɛ le o sɛno la be dɛ kaa Bɛtlɛham ka so o mɛɛ dem korobie anaarɛ.
Banloɡle la la o be dɛ ka larawo ásɛ o berɛ ba.
Keeɡore anɛɛ o kpɔ o ne o bonɔɔ bɛl kaa.
Haah la kpɔ baa la la o mɛɛ dem, o mɛɛ ɡe lɛo silɛɛ ne.
Dɛ haah la mɛɛ aa nyin kɛ baa la kaa dɛ ŋɔ ó so bela tama.
Anomanta, o soɡe bela tɔpera atoro, belaa wɛɛ di kwaa dɛɛ nyɔ sen dɛɛ chɔ ɡe.
Tɔpenaarɛ wee la, ba felo ir asɛ o kpɔ o te dɛ fe ɛɛ kaa.
Anee haah la mɛɛ ŋɔ, “Chɔɔ nyoa mɔɔ dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa dɛɛ la.” Anomanta, baala banɛ la soɡo dɛ pɛ di kwaa la.
A habɔɔ la, haah la mɛɛ berɔ ŋɔ baa la be ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe, lɛ he sie dɛ chɔ.” Baa la aa ira dɛɛ ba kaala la, o hela la ta sɛɛh, asɛ o berɛ chɔ bela awola tɔpere la.
Tɔpenue wee waa ira chɔmbibii dɛɛ ba kaala la, o hela la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “So dɛ́ di kwa, webaŋa mɔɔ dɛ kaa.” Asɛ ba nɛra banɛ la so dɛ di kwaa la.
Baa la ne o sɛno la ne bonɔɔ la aa ira dɛɛ ba kaala la, haah la mɛɛ ŋɔ ba be ja ŋɔ, “Taraken bɔr joɔ tonɛ, so lɛ he sie dɛ chɔ, ásɛ kere chɔmbibii, hé chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa.” Kɛ dɛ baa la aa nyin kɛ o chɔ bela jwaana kpa, dɛ pa kwaa baa paa dawɛ keeɡo ta dɛɛ so o ta la dawɛ keeɡore anɛ la ta, asɛ o ne o sɛno la kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Jebus waa ɛ Jerusalam.
Baa dɛ tel Jebus waa ɛ Jerusalam bɔr ɛɛ ba joe la, bonɔɔ la ŋɔ o dɔɔ be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, yá chɔ Jerusalam bonɔ, ásɛ kere chɔɔ dɛ́ kaa.” Nomoa la ŋɔ, “Akai, yaa nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ bee chɔ.
Yaa kaa Gebeaa.” O bolɔ ja ŋɔ, “Yáa la!
Yá takapɔ tel Gebea kɛɛ Rama, dɛ́ ka chɔ a ɡɛ bwɛɛre nɔ bɛl ta.” Ba kaalɔ ka bɛne Gebea waa lɔ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta, dɛ wee le harɛ.
Belaa ba choɡ ŋɔ bá chɔ.
Ba kaa so bela bwɛɛ la tena aa dɛ cheme, kɛ nomɛlbwa ta ban kpɔe kaa dɛ́ ka tɛɛ ba bɔr bá chɔ.
Awola jɔmɔra la, dɛ banjena bɛl le koo dɛɛ ba.
Dɛ o le Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ dɛ ba so Gebea bela, Bɛnjamen dea tena bwɛɛ.
Banjena la aa na hɔɔhra la bela bwɛɛ la tena aa dɛ cheme la, o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Leperaa hɛɛ kaalɔ?
Lee he leɔ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Ya le Bɛtlɛham waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta dɛɛ kaa Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ bojaŋ, belaa n so.
N dɛ kaa n bwɛ, kɛ nomɛlbwa ta yaa kpɔe kaa o dem yá ka chɔ.
Nomoa, ya dɔ kondikwaa dɛ́ tɛ ya keeɡore nɔ, dɛ dɔ ya ɡbaɡba kondikwaa ne sen. N ne n sɛno ne bonɔɔ nɔ dɔ komɛlbwa ya be.” Ate, banjena la ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kaa he ne n demii.
Mɛɛ tɛ heyaa komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyinii, kɛ waa aa hiah mɛɛ kɛ he bɛ bwɛɛ nɔ cheremibɔr bonɔ chɔ jwaana nɔ ne.” Anomanta, o kaa ba ne o dem, dɛ tɛ keeɡore la kwaa a di.
O tɛ nɛra la nee ba sarame ba nakpale, dɛ tɛɛ ba kondikwaa ba di dɛ tɛɛ ba sen ɡe ba nyɔ.
Baa dɛ lɛ ba sie la, nɛnchɔɡa bane baa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta baa bar dem la cheme, dɛɛ lɔ dem la doonyoa ɡbera la, dɛɛ kɔɡre dem te la ŋɔ, “Le baa la waa ba he dem bonɔ la ne tɛ yaa yá lawɔ ka chɔ kɛ baa ne haah.” Dem te la le buse dɛ ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Akai!
Ya bala, he bɛ wedoŋa nɔ ɛ. N hɔɔhree, hɛɛ berɛ a ɡɛ sihihwaa nɔ ɛɛ.
N bihaah waa wola baa jemɛ bwa lole, mɛɛ le o ne n hɔɔh nɔ sɛnoo tɛ heya, ásɛ he ne ba ka chɔ.
Kɛ baa nɔ te, he bɛ on a ɡɛ sihihwaa nɔ ɛ.” Nɛra la vɛh banjena la waa la.
Anomanta, hɔɔh la lawɛ o sɛno la le buse tɛɛ ba, ba lawɔ dɛ ka ɡuɡru ba ne o chɔ jwaana la ne bwa.
Bɔr aa dɛ chaah la, ba tao ŋwɛnɛ o kaa.
Bɔr aa dɛ chaah la, haah la berɔ kaa dem bela o dɔɔ aa lole la.
O cholo chɔ dem la doonyoa ka tel kɛŋɔ bɔr aa chaahna.
Baa la aa ira chɔɔ ne la, o kaa ya dem la ɡbera dɛ le buse dɛ́ kaa, asɛ dɛ na ɡɛ o sɛno la aa chɔa o nɔɔra ba dawɛ doonyojoo ɡbera daa la ta.
Anee o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir ya kaa!” Kɛ haah la ta on chaŋɛ, asɛ o na kɛŋɔ o sewɔ.
Belaa o kpɔ o lale dawɛ keeɡo ta dɛɛ kaa o bwɛ.
Waa tel dem la, o kpɔ kere mɔne o sɛno la bini bɔre fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ kpɔ ka tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la bwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la ŋɔ, “Dɛ le kɛŋɔ Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba la, ya ta waa nɔ dɔŋa nae bwa, ya ta a dɔŋa noɛ ɡe bwa.
Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ yɔ?
Yá nyiŋi a ta kɛrɛdɛ.
A chɛ kɛ yá ɛ waane.”
Israel tena kaa yo Bɛnjamen dea tena Israel tena baa soɡe Dan dea harɛ ta dɛ kpoŋe kaa Beɛseeba, dɛ banɔ la baa soɡe Gelead harɛ ta bwa baa cheme Korowii sie Mispa kɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ.
Nomonome baa chɔ Israel deene nyoo la bwa baa ja Korowii nɛra baa chema la nɛ.
Asɛ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanaarɛ kpoŋe tokobie.
Dɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena la noɔ kɛŋɔ Israel tena la kaa cheme Mispa.
Israel tena la ŋɔ, “Hé baɡle yaa waa aa cheɡɛ a ta wedoŋa nɔ ba.” Anee Lewi dea te baa kpo o sɛno la ŋɔ, “N ne n sɛnoo ba Gebea Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta dɛ ba chɔ.
Jwaana la ne Gebea baala koh n wa dɛ bar dem la cheme dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ kpo.
Ba ɡuɡri n sɛno la ba ne o chɔ, asɛ o sewɛ.
N kpɔ o lale la dɛ ba mɔne o bini bɔne tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la bɛlbwa, ásɛ a chaɡle wedoŋa ne waa baa kia ba ɛa Israel harɛ ta la.
Israel tena, he bwa aa chema nɔ, hé bol a waa dɛ́ baɡle ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ yá ɛ.” Nɛra la bwa pɛo dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya bini bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ba dem kaala.
Akai!
Ya bini bɛlbwa aa o bwɛɛ kaa.
Kenii yaa ba Gebea tena ɛɛ.
Yáa bil daa, ásɛ dɛ ka yoo ba ɡɛ daa la aa baɡla la.
Yá kpɔ nɛra fi le nɛra lafa bɛlbwa bini Israel dea bɛlbwa ta, ásɛ baa tɛ ba laa tena la kondikwa.
Ásɛ dɛ laa tena la tel Gebea waa lɔ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta naa, bá dɔ kondikwaa á tel ba, bá won yo Gebea tena la dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne, wedoŋa baa ɛa Israel harɛ ta la wa.” Anomanta, Israel nɛra la bwa pɛo kɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ ka yo Gebea tena.
Israel deene la tomɛ nɛra Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta bobɛlbwa ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he na wedoŋa baa ɛa he bini nɔ waɔ?
Hé le Gebea nɛnchɔɡa nɔ tɛ yaa yá kpoo ba, ásɛ ɡɛ wedoŋa nɔ le Israel harɛ ta.” Kɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena la ta ba bala Israel tena waa la mun noɛ, dɛ ɡe le ba bwɛɛre ta ba cheme Gebea dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛ bá yo Israel tena.
Buɡ la ta, Bɛnjamen dea tena boa laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banumɛl nyoa le ba bwɛɛre ta ba kpoŋe tokobie, dɛ kpɔ ja baala lafraanuanɛ baa lee ba le Gebea bela la nɛ.
Laa tena baa lee ba nɔ bwa bini, lafraanuanɛ ɛ ɡal tena ba nɔɔra aa dɛ na kɛrɛdɛ, baa wola kon waa do kɛ nyumpon kwaraa kur ta.
Israel tena dɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanaarɛ baa dɛ yo kɛrɛdɛ.
Bɛnjamen dea tena ta ba nɛɛ jae.
Israel tena la Bɛtel dɛ ka bɔɔ le Korowii be ŋɔ, “Ya bini bamewaa dɛɛ ba sie tɔe ka yo Bɛnjamen dea tena nɔɔ?” Belaa Korowii chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Juda dea tenaa dɛ́ tɔ sie ka yo.” Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Israel tena iro dɛ ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene bɛne Gebea, dɛ kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ka yo Gebea tena la.
Bɛlbwa kaa che bela waa che dɛ kpɔ o te dɛ́ yoo ba.
Bɛnjamen dea tena la le Gebea, dɛ ba kpoo Israel tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ laa la ta awola tenten.
Kɛ Israel tena la do dɔŋa ɡbemba ja, dɛ berɛ ka che bela bɛlbwa fa aa cheɡa loɡla la.
Israel tena la kaa wi no Korowii ka tel jɔmɔra, dɛ berɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “Yá ka pu ya bala Bɛnjamen dea tena la yo ja aa?” Anee Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé kaa ka yoo ba.” Tɔpenɛɛte ta la, Israel tena suuhno tel Bɛnjamen dea tena la.
Awola tɔpere la Bɛnjamen dea tena le Gebea dɛ ba yo, dɛ kpoo Israel tena kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banuatoro, dɛ ba bwa kpoŋe tokobie.
Asɛ Israel tena la bwa la Bɛtel dɛ ka so Korowii sie dɛ wi noo ja.
Ba vɔwɛ nyoa awola tɔpere le chɔɔ ka tel jɔmɔra.
Ba fuh kwaa ɛ saraha ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ Korowii.
Israel tena la bɔɔ Korowii dɛ́ no le o be.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la lɔ Bɛtel.
Dɛ Eliasa bibaa Fenehas lɔ bela dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma, o nabaalee Arɔn.
Israel tena la bɔɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “Yá ka yo ya bala Bɛnjamen dea tena nɔ kɛɛ yá ɡelɔ?” Anee Korowii sɛh ŋɔ, “Hé kaa!
Kere te mɛɛ kpɔ baa do he nɔn ta, ásɛ he pɔ ba nɛ.” Baa lea kaa la, ba kaa chɔ bar Gebea.
Tɔpetooro wee la, ba kaa che ba chebɔra ɡɛ ba fa aa ɛa la, ásɛ dɛ yo Gebea tena.
Bɛnjamen dea tena la leɔ ba cheme Israel tena la, asɛ Israel tena saah kpɔ ba le bwɛɛ la dahare kaa sie.
Ba pa mun dɛ kpoo Israel tena ɡɛ ba fa aa ɛɛ ba la.
Nɛra fifraatoroo ba kpoo, ba chɔ kooni ne Bɛtel dɛ Gebea ŋwɛnɛre ta.
Dɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena la dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ ja.” Asɛ Israel tena la ɡe ŋɔ, “Yá chwa, ásɛ ba teŋɛ ya nɛɛ dɛ́ le bwɛɛ nɔ ta ba ŋwɛnɛre ta.” Israel tena la bwa le ba chebɔra dɛ berɛ ka che Baal Taama, asɛ banɔ la baa chɔa bar la ɡe den ɛɡɛ le ba sɔɔhbɔra Gebea wee cholibɔr wɔrɔbe nɛ.
Israel tena kaɡboŋa fi baa jemɛ yoi kohona laanee lea dɛ ba yo Gebea tena, dɛ yoi la kpeɡri awola tɔpere.
Dɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena la ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba seo tɔperee awola.
Korowii cha Israel tena la ba pɔ Bɛnjamen dea tena nɛ.
Ba kpoo ba laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banue dɛ nɛra lafa, ba bwaa kpoŋe tokobie awola tɔpere.
Ate, Bɛnjamen tena na kɛŋɔ Israel tena pɔ ba nɛ.
A ɡɛ waa Israel tena chwa le Bɛnjamen dea tena nɛ, dɛ ba dɛ hwɛɡɛ ba bala baa chɔ kpɔɡ bini Gebea dahare la nɛ.
Israel tena baa chɔa bar Gebea la lɔɔ jo bwɛɛ la bini bwa wɔrɔbe nɛ, dɛ kpoo bwɛɛ la tena bwa tokobie ne.
Dɛ Israel tena la vɔrɔwɔ kɛŋɔ banɔ la baa chɔ kpɔɡ bini la ɡel chuu vɔwɛ bwɛɛ la ta bwa, ásɛ banɔ la baa kaa la jemɛ dɛ berɛ ba laa la ta.
Gɛ saŋ Israel tena la aa laa berɛ dɛɛ ba bwɛɛ la ta la, dɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena dɔɔ kpoo Israel tena la nɛra fifraatoro asɛ dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ loɡla yoi la.” Kɛ chuu aa dɛ le bwɛɛ la ta dɛ tɛr dɛɛ kaa nyundua la, Bɛnjamen dea tena la keo nyiŋi dɛ na kɛ ba bwɛɛ la bwa vɔwɛ chuu.
Israel tena aa laa berɛ dɛ ba yo baa la, ɔmee lawɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena la kohona, ba ɡbabir jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba serewɔ tonɛ.
Ba chwao le Israel tena la be dɛ chaɡɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, kɛ ba ta wone chwa le laa la ta.
Israel tena la le bwɛɛ la ta dɛ ba kpoo ba bela.
Ba bar Bɛnjamen dea tena la, dɛ chwa teŋɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ ka puu ba Gebea wee leebɔr.
Ba kpoo Bɛnjamen dea laa tena kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banuatoro baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ.
Bɛnjamen dea tena la pa sie pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta dɛɛ kaa Remɔn Bwe ta, asɛ Israel tena la kpoo ba bini kaɡboŋa banue, ba chɔ ŋwɛnɛre la ta.
Ba nao teŋɛ ba nɛɛ ka le bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Gedɔm dɛ berɛ kpoo ba bini kaɡboŋa banɛ ja.
Awola tɔpere la, Bɛnjamen dea laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banue baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ kpoŋe tokobiee serewa.
Kɛ ba bini lafraanumɛl ɡboo wona chwa kaa Remɔn Bwe la ta dɛ ka so bela korobie anaarɛ.
Israel tena la laa berɛ kaa Bɛnjamen dea tena harɛ ta, dɛ ka kpoo nɛra baa lɔ bwɛɛre la ta bwa, ne ba kondɛɛra, dɛ kon te bɛlbwa baa nao.
Ba fuh bwɛɛre la bwa.
Bɛnjamen dea tena haahna moe wa Israel tena la aa cheme Mispa la, ba ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ ba bini bɛlbwa bɛ o bihaah kpɔ tɛ Bɛnjamen dea bie ó mo.
Israel tena la Bɛtel dɛ ka so Korowii sie dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ wi noo kohona ka tel jɔmɔra.
Ba wio ŋɔ, “Korowii ya Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, ɛrɛ taa a che ɡɛ waa nɔ pu yaa nɔɔ?
Bɔkwa waa debeŋkpoŋ tena nyoɡre le ya bini fini nɔɔ?” Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, nɛra la ɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta bela, dɛ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha o ta tɛ Korowii.
Israel tena la bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Israel deene nɔ bwa bini, debesoo tenaa wola Korowii sie bonɔ balɔɔ?” Ba fa ŋwɛɛrɔ bil kɛŋɔ dea bɛlbwa waa wola Korowii sie Mispa bonɔ balɛ la, bá kpoo o nɛra.
Israel tena la wio tɛ ba bala Bɛnjamen dea tena la ŋɔ, “Fini tɔpere nɔ, dea beŋkpoŋ nɛra toole ya bini.
Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ won dɔ haahna tɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena baa kaa nɔɔ?
Ya ɡe dɔɔ ŋwɛɛ Korowii sɔn ta kɛŋɔ ya bɛ ya bihaahna kpɔ tɛɛ ba bá mo.” Ba berɔ ŋɔ, “Israel dea besoo nɛraa vɛah ba ta Korowii sie Mispa balɔɔ?” Ba baa na kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ta bwɛɛ Jabes Gelead ta leɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa kure nɛra baa ba bela la, ba nao kɛŋɔ Jabes Gelead harɛ ta te beŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole bela.
Anomanta, nɛra baa cheme bela la le laa tena kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ baa jemɛ yoi, dɛ do ba ŋɔ bá ka kpoo nɛra baa lɔ Jabes Gelead, dɛ́ kpoo hale ba haahna ne bechale bwa ja.
Ba ŋɔ, “Hé kpoo baala ne haahna baa jemɛ baala bwa, dɛ́ ɡel toli baa wola baala jemɛ ka.” Ba na toli lafraanaarɛ Jabes Gelead baa wola baala jemɛ bwa, asɛ ba laɡ ba kaa bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene Silo waa lɔ Keenan harɛ ta.
Nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa tomɛ nɛra Remɔn Bwe la ta bá ka larawe Bɛnjamen dea tena baa lɔ bela.
Anomanta, Bɛnjamen dea tena la berɔ ba ɡɛ saŋ, asɛ Israel tena la kpɔ haahna baa laɡ ba le Jabes Gelead baa wola ban kpoorɛ la tɛɛ ba ba mo, kɛ ba ta baala la nyoa tele.
Israel tena la tea bini chɔɡɔ Bɛnjamen dea tena la wa, ɡɛ Korowii aa ɡela dea beŋkpoŋ tena aa wola toole ba bini la.
Nomonome baa lɔ nɛra baa cheme bela la ŋɔ, “Bɛnjamen dea haahna aa serewa nɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ haahna tɛ baala baa kaa nɔɔ?” Ba ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena baa dɔ ba nyu ba ta serewɛ nɔ mo haahna dɛ́ dɔ bii bá di ba kwa, ɡɛ aa ɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la bɛl sɔn bɛ he.
Ya Israel tena aa ŋwɛɛ ntam nɔ, yáa won kpɔ ya bihaahna tɛɛ ba ba mo.
Ya bini bɛlbwa waa ɡela o bihaah yalɛ Bɛnjamen dea bie la, nyotaahna ɛɛ lawɔɔ.
Kɛ hé no!
Ya dɛ ba tɔpejen bɛl dii Silo waa lɔ Bɛtel weekaŋle nyundua, ne ŋwɛnɛ waa lɔ Bɛtel ne Sɛkem wee leebɔr, ne Lɛbɔna weekaŋle harɛbɔr.” Israel tena la do Bɛnjamen dea tena la ŋɔ, “Hé ka sɔh ɡrepo daa kooni ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi.
Hé na Silo bitoli ba baa sa aa, hé ɛ warane dɛ́ le daa kooni la baah, ásɛ bɛlbwa ka lawɛ bɛl kaa he Bɛnjamen dea tena harɛ ta ó ɛ he haah.
Ba mɛɛnanar kɛɛ ba dɔɔranar ba dɛ bol ba waa ya be naa, ya ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Hé takapɔ dɛ́ cha yaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya ta haahna dɔe tɛɛ ba laa la nomanta.
He kon som haa wola he bihaahna kpɔe tɛɛ ba la.
Nyotaahna aa he nɛɛ ba.’ ” Anomanta, ɡɛɛ Bɛnjamen dea tena la ɛ. Haahna la aa ba dɛ sa la, asɛ bɛlbwa le ba lawɛ o kon dɛ kaa o ne, ó ɛ o haah.
Ba berɔ kaa ka so ba harɛ ta, dɛ ka kwaa vɔrɔwe ba bwɛɛre dɛ so a ta.
Israel tena le bela dɛ berɛ kaa ba harɛ ta ba lolanar be ne ba bwɛɛre ta.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ kooro toole Israel harɛ ta, asɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ aa wera o be.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Rut fa ɛ Moab harɛ haah, asɛ o jaa sewɛ.
O sɛoh ŋɔ o ne o helahaah Naomi ɛɛ soo, ɡɛ saŋ o hela aa ira dɛɛ kaa o bwɛɛ Bɛtlɛham ka so.
Korowii tɔ Rut sie dɛ ɡel o dɔ jafale baa dɛ yerɔ Boas.
Waa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ jaɡa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid le Boas ne Rut luɡe ta, asɛ ya bwa ɡe jemɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ luɡe la tenten taa Yeesu Kristo ɡe le.
Nyiŋi Matiu nyu :-.
Naomi Ne Rut wa Saŋ la Israel tena aa wola kooro dɔe mɔɔ, asɛ sitɔɔla yon dɛɛ nyiŋi bela harɛ ta la, dɛ lɔr lɔ harɛ la ta.
Belaa baa bɛl waa le Bɛtlɛham o do Juda harɛ ta, ne o haah ne bibaala banɛ ir dɛ ba so Moab harɛ ta.
Baa la sɔne Ɛlemɛlɛk, o haah ɡe sɔne Naomi.
O bibaala la bɛl sɔne Maalɔn, asɛ nɛɛte la ɡe sɔne Keleɔn.
Dɛ Efrat dea naanaree ban, ba le Bɛtlɛham waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta.
Baa kaa so bela la, Ɛlemɛlɛk sewɔ, asɛ a ka Naomi ne bibaala banɛ la ɡbo.
Bibaala la mo Moab haahna.
Bɛl sɔne Ɔpa, asɛ bɛl ɡe Rut.
Baa soɡa bene fi habɔɔ la, Maalɔn ne Keleɔn baa sewɛ.
Aa ba ɡɛ la a ka Naomi ɡbo.
A habɔɔ la, o baa no kɛŋɔ Korowii cha o harɛ ta nɛra dɛ ɡel ba dɔ kondikwa.
Anomanta, o ne o bii la haahna la kpɔ ba te ásɛ dɛ berɛ kaa o bwɛ.
Ba bwa leɔ dɛ kpɔ Juda ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa.
Ŋwɛnɛ ta la, Naomi ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ kaa he nyawa be.
Korowiirii dɛ́ cha heya, ɡɛ haa cha n ne n jaa ne n bii la.
Korowiirii dɛ́ cha heya, ásɛ bɛlbwa berɛ dɔ jaa dɛ́ dɔ bodɛɛɡe so.” Belaa o ka mo ba lwɛɛma dɛ kal ba.
Asɛ ba pa mun dɛɛ wi, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Akai, ya ne henee dɛ́ kaa he nɛra be.” Anee Naomi chaŋe ŋɔ, “N bii, hé berɛ kaa he bwɛ.
N ne he kaala mun ɔ?
N lol tonɔ, mɛɛ won berɛ lolɛ bii bá kpɔ heyaa mo ja aa?
Hé berɛ kaa he bwɛ.
Taraken bela maa tela nɔ, maa jaaree dɔ kpa.
Dɛ hwɛɡa lole kɛŋɔ ń dɔ jaa aa, hale n ne o chɔɔ fini kwara naa, maa won den kpoŋe tea dɛ́ loɡle bibaala tɛ heya.
Dɛ a ba ɡɛ kwara naa, hɛɛ won soŋni ka tel kɛŋɔ baa kpeɡ aa?
Hɛɛ won so dɛ́ ŋɔ haa yalaa?
Akai n bii, he ɡbabir jemɔ ŋɔ ɡɛ aa won maɡre.
N nyuu wola were mɛɛ di suna, he te laa chɛ kɛŋɔ he di suna.
Korowiirii ɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ.” Asɛ ba berɛ wi anɔ ɡe ta ja.
Belaa Ɔpa mo o lwɛɛma dɛ kalo.
Kɛ Rut te ta lawɔ kpoŋe dɛ ŋɔ waa on ta.
Anee Naomi ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na, he nahaahnee bera dɛɛ kaa o harɛ ta ne ba voɡa bini la.
He ɡe ka puu hé kaa.” Asɛ Rut chaŋo ŋɔ, “Bɛ n be ŋɔ n ɡele.
Bobɛlbwa haa kaa ne bela haa so la, n ɡee so belaa.
Mɛɛ kpɔ he nɛraa ɛ n nɛra, ásɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la, ń ɡee tomɔ.
Bela haa sewɛ laanee n ɡee ba sewa, ásɛ ba huɡ mɛ bela.
Dɛ seo laa aa, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa aa won pere ya baah.” Naomi aa naa kɛŋɔ Rut marɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ o ne ó kaa la, o ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ kpa.
Anomanta, haahna banɛ nɔ valɔ dɛ ba tel Bɛtlɛham, asɛ bwɛɛ la tena bwa lɔ kpu dɛɛ pɛɛ ŋɔ, “Naomii nɔ tenaa?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “He bɛ men Naomi yerɛ.
Hɛɛ yer mɛ Mara dɛkalkɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ta ɡelɛ n sie lɛ n soɡa bini.
Maa dɛ le bonɔ dɛ́ kaa la, dɛ n dɔ kwaa kohona.
Kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ n valɛ nɔŋɡbala ba.
Ɛrɛɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ɛɛ mɛ nyuchɔɡe te dɛ ɡel mɛɛ na wahala nɔ, asɛ hɛɛ yer mɛ Naomi nɔɔ?” Gɛɛ a do Naomi ne o helahaah Rut waa ɛ Moab te la ɛ dɛ ba Bɛtlɛham.
Dɛ mea koma dɛ pa mun.
Rut kaa cheme Boas Dɛ Naomi jaa Ɛlemɛlɛk dɔ lole bɛl baa yerɔ Boas.
O ɛ nɛn waa dɔ o te dɛ dɔ jirima.
Awola bɛl, Rut ŋɔ Naomi be ŋɔ, “N poori, tɛ́ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń la nomɛlbwa waa na n sum koo ta dɛ́ ka kuuh mea.” Anee o sɛh dɛ ŋɔ, “N bie, kaa.” Anomanta, o la koo bɛl ta, dɛ ka teŋɛ tom-ɛɛra nɛ dɛɛ kuuh mea la.
Jaah dɛ Ɛlemɛlɛk lole Boas koo taa.
Baa lɔ bela la, Boas le dem ba, dɛ ba jam tom-ɛɛra la, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé jam ne ɛɛ.
Korowii dɛ kwaa he kwa.” Asɛ ba ɡe sɛh ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛɛ hɛɛra.” Belaa o bɔɔ tom-ɛɛra la nomoa ŋɔ, “Tolo besoo ɡee lɔ bela nɔɔ?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Bitolo bɛl waa le Moab harɛ ta dɛ teŋɛ Naomi nɛɛ ba laanee.
O baa soŋ mɛ ŋɔ ń ɡel ó teŋɛ tom-ɛɛra nɔ nɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ kuuh anɔ la aa leera la.
Chɔɔ bwaa o le ɛ toma asɛ dɛ baa onɛ pata bini tama la.” Asɛ Boas suuh tel Rut dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɛ koo bɛlbwa ta la ka kuuh mea kpa ka ja koo nɔ ta.
Dɛɛ teŋɛ haahna baa dɛ ɛ toma koo nɔ ta nɔ nɛ.
Dɛɛ do sie baala la nɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ toli la nɛ.
N ŋɔ baala la be ŋɔ ba bɛ hen panya.
Nyɔɡre dɛ kpoe naa, ka nyɔ nee baa dɔa ba nɔ ane.” Belaa Rut ɡuŋu harɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Jam kɛŋɔ maa ɛ hɔɔh n ɡe waa hiaih ɡɛ nɔ.” Asɛ Boas chaŋe ŋɔ, “He jaa seo habɔɔ la, n no waa bwa haa ɛa dɛ tɛ he helahaah.
N no ɡɛ haa ɡel he nya ne he mɛɛ, ne harɛ haa le o ta, dɛ ba so nɛra haa wola ban jemɛ bwa bini nɔ.
Korowiirii dɛ́ tɛɛ he kembɔr he waa la haa ɛa la wa.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ he chwa ba marɔ nɔ, ó tɔ he nɛ kɛ jal yon kpɔ kena tɔ o bii nɛɛ la, dɛ́ kwaa he kwaa tɛɛ kohona.” Anee Rut ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, a lole kɛŋɔ n ta he tom-ɛɛra la bɛl ɛɛ te, kɛ he nyin n waa kohona, dɛ larawe n bwara ɡe.” Kondikwaa dii saŋ aa tela la, Boas ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ba lɛ paanoo tama dɛ́ kpɔ li sennyɛɡa nɔ ta.” O ne tom-ɛɛra la aa soɡa dɛɛ di kwaa la, Boas berɛ kpɔ mea baa hala tɛo ja.
O diu dɛ vaɡɛ asɛ ane ka.
Rut aa baa ir dɛ kuuh mea la la, Boas ŋɔ o bonɔɔna la be ŋɔ, “O ɡaaɡɔ dɛ ka kuuh anɔ la baa boa a nyoa bil la jwɛh kwaraa naa, he bɛ on panya.
Hɛ́ɛ won tɛr ane le anɔ la haa boa a nyoa bil la ta, ásɛ o ba pa.
He bɛ o nɛɛ nyɛɡ.” Anomanta, Rut ɡaaɡe koo la ta dɛ ka tel jɔmɔra.
O lɔ mea waa dɔa la bwa asɛ a ɛ kuruware fi.
O cheɡaa ba dem asɛ o helahaah na ɡɛ del waa dɔa.
Rut kpɔ kondikwaa waa dia a ka la ɡe tɛo.
Asɛ Naomi bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa he ka ɡaaɡe fini nɔ?
Ume koo taa he ka kuuh dɛ dɔ anɔ bwa ken?
Korowiirii dɛ cha naate waa na he sum nɔ.” Anee Rut ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Boas koo taa n ka ɡaaɡe.” Naomi ŋɔ, “Korowiirii dɛ́ kwaa Boas kwaa tɛo.
N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii ta teŋɔ dɛɛ nyin weera ne serewa.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “A ɡɛ baa la ɛ ya lole tenten.
O ɛ nɛra baa chɛ kɛŋɔ báa nyiŋi ya nɛɛ la bini bɛl.” Belaa Rut ŋɔ, “Silɛɛ wa aa jaa laanee kɛŋɔ, o ŋɔ ń teŋɛ o tom-ɛɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ kuuh mea ka tel kɛŋɔ baa teŋe tonɛ.” Naomi ɡe ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋii, a wer kɛŋɔ he ne toli la bwa pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma Boas koo ta.
He la nomɛl koo ta naa, ba ken ɛɛ panyae.” Gɛɛ a do o ne ba ɛ toma asɛ o kuuh mea la ka tel saŋ baa koma tonɛ.
Asɛ o so o helahaah be.
Rut jaa ɡaaɡa wa Awola bɛl, Naomi ŋɔ Rut be ŋɔ, “N bie, a chɛ kɛ ń nyin jaa tɛɛ ásɛ he ne ó so.
Baa n liire aa lɔ o nɛɛ laanee Boas he ne o toli aa pɛa dɛɛ ɛ toma la, o ɛ ya lole.
Fini jwaana nɔ ne o dɛ ba mea lɔe.
Anomanta, sɔ ne dɛ́ fɔɡle nosɔɔhsoma dɛ́ do he laaladɛɛɡa dɛ́ kaa bela.
Bɛ ɡel o nae ka tel kɛŋɔ waa di kondikwaa dɛ nyɔ sen tonɛ mɔɔ.
Pese bela waa chɔ, ásɛ waa ba chɔ dom la, hé ka laa yal kpɔ o nakpale ta, dɛ́ chɔ o naa bɔr.
Wɛɛ ŋɔ he bee ɡɛ haa ɛ.” Asɛ Rut ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa haa bol n be nɔɔ.” Anomanta, o la pɛla la ta jwaana la ne la, asɛ dɛ ka ɛ ɡɛ Naomi aa baɡlo la.
Boas aa di kondikwaa la dɛ nyɔ sen o sie lɛ la, o kaa chɔ mea baa boa a nyoa bil la jwɛh.
Asɛ Rut ɛ bɔeeh dɛ ka laa yal kpɔ o nakpale ta dɛ chɔ bela.
Boas aa chɔa harambaŋa baah ta la, o jarɔ dɛ na kɛŋɔ haah chɔ o naa bɔr.
Anee o bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Umee nɔɔ?” Asɛ Rut chaŋe ŋɔ, “Menee he bitolo Rut.
Haa ɛ n lole tenten nɔ, paɡri he yal la pera bɔle n nɛ.” Asɛ Boas ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛɛ hɛɛra.
He baɡle he nyina ɡwaa ɡɛ haa ɛa tɛ he helahaah la kwara.
Bonɔɔna nɛɛ chɛ kɛ he fe ɛɛ pɛlɛ, hale ba dɔ suuɡa kɛɛ ba nyao.
Kɛ he ta an ɡɛ ɛɛ.
N bie, bɛ ɡel a hiaih.
Mɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyinii tɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛɛ nɔ ta bwa jemɛ ɡɛ he wa aa do kaih.
A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ ya ɛ lolanar.
Kɛ bɛl tɔ n sie mɔɔ n teŋɛ.
Chɔ n be bonɔ jwaana nɔ ne, ásɛ tɔɔ perɔ chɔɔ aa, ya na kɛŋɔ wɛɛ moe kɛɛ waa hen moɔ.
O sɛoh ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔe yaa, a fe wer kohona.
Kɛ dɛ o ta sɛɛh yaa, n ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔe.
He te chɔ bonɔ ka tel kere chɔɔ.” Anomanta, o chɔ o naa bɔr bela asɛ dɛ fel ir chɔmbibii bɛlbwa ta on nae, dɛkalkɛ Boas ŋɔ o be ŋɔ waa nyin kɛ nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ haah ba pɛla la ta.
Asɛ Boas ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Foo he batakaare ásɛ dɛ paɡru.” Waa paɡru la, asɛ o fuɡe mea dɛ ɛ kuruwa anue doo o kpɔ kaa dem.
Rut aa tel dem la, o helahaah bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Naomi ɛrɛɛ a ka chiɡ ɔ?” Asɛ Naomi baɡle waa baa la aa ɛa tɛo bwa.
O ŋɔ, “O tɛ mɛ mea nɔ ŋɔ ń kpɔ ba, dɛ ŋɔ a ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ n valɛ nɔŋɡbala ba he be ɡɛ.” Anee Naomi ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N bie, lawɛ bambile dɛ́ na ɡɛ aa ka chiɡ.
Dɛ Boas ta waa nɔ sie nae fini naa, o ta ona dɔe.”
Boas mo Rut Boas la bwɛɛ la doonyoa baa soɡa dɛɛ kpɔ liire la, dɛ ka so bela.
Belaa baa la Boas fa aa ŋɔa on tɔ sie o ɡe teŋɛ dɛ dɔ Rut nyiŋa la den baa kaa, asɛ o yerɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “N dam, ba so n be bonɔ tama.” Asɛ o ɡe la dɛ ka so o be bela.
Belaa Boas ka yerɛ bwɛɛ la nomonome fi ba ba ja o nɛ ba bwa soŋni, ba bwa aa baa soŋni la, o ŋɔ o lole la be ŋɔ, “Taraken Naomi aa le Moab harɛ ta dɛ ba nɔ, o dɛ nyin o yoɡ ya lole Ɛlemɛlɛk koo la, mɛɛ nyin kɛ he ɡe jemɛ a wa.
Dɛ he ɡbabir dɛ nyin koo la aa, n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he den yawɛ ya ne nomonome nɔ bwa sie bonɔ.
Dɛ haa nyin ɡe aa, ɡel ya jemɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ won yawɛ aa, atane o tɔ sie nae mɔɔ ásɛ n ɡe teŋɛ.” Anee o sɛh ŋɔ “Mɛɛ yawɔɔ.” Asɛ Boas ŋɔ, “Gɛ wer, kɛ dɛ he yawɛ harɛ la le Naomi ne Rut waa ɛ Moab te la be tenaa, hɛɛ kpɔ ya lole waa sewa la luhaah Rut la ɡee ja, ásɛ he ne o dɔ bie ya lole la sɔn bɛ he harɛ la ta.” Belaa baa la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ yawɔɔ n bii aa harɛ la kpeɡrii ba dɔ tenaa, maa won.
Hɛɛ wonoo waa, he yawɛ.” Dɛ a saŋ la Israel tena nawee waa kɛŋɔ dɛ nomɛl dɔ o komɛl dɛɛ nyin o yoɡ asɛ nɛra cheme ken aa, o dɛ foo o naŋɡawa, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛ nɛn waa dɛ yawɛ la á ɛ danseɛ.
Anomanta, baa la ŋɔ Boas be ŋɔ, “He won yawa.” Asɛ dɛ foo o naŋɡawa tɛ Boas.
Belaa Boas bol nomonome ne nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa no kɛŋɔ, “Heyaa ɛɛ mɛ danseɛ fini tɔpere nɔ, kɛŋɔ n yawɛ Ɛlemɛlɛk komɛlbwa ne o bibaala Keleɔn ne Maalɔn kwaa bwa le Naomi be.
N berɔ dɔ Maalɔn luhaah Rut la ó ɛ n haah, ásɛ ya won lolɛ bie, dɛ́ ɡel ya lole waa sewa la sɔn bɛ he dea nɔ ta.
Fini a ɛ he bwa siwi ta wa.” Belaa nomonome la ne nɛra baa lɔ doonyoa bela la sɛh ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, ya bwa ɛ danseɛ tena.
Korowiirii dɛ́ ɡel he haah nɔ waa dɛ ba he be bala nɔ do kɛŋɔ Rakɛl ne Lea baa lolɛ bii kohona, dɛ vɔrɔwe Israel la.
Korowii ɡel he dɔ chebɔr Efrat baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Bɛtlɛham la, he náanar Korowii aa dɛ ba he tɛɛ dɛ le ɡɛ haah nɔ be la do kɛŋɔ Taama ne Juda bibaa Pɛrɛs lolanar.” Boas ne o naanar Asɛ Boas ir dɛ kpɔ o haah Rut kaa dem o ɛ o haah, asɛ o ne o chɔ Korowii chao, asɛ o kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa.
Anee haahna la ŋɔ Naomi be ŋɔ, “Korowii jam kɛŋɔ fini waa tɛɛ lole tenten wáa di he kwaa nɔ.
Korowiirii dɛ́ ɡel o sɔn le Israel harɛ ta bwa!
Wɛɛ tɛɛ silɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ lawɛ kpoŋe he hwɛɛhra bini.
Dɛkalkɛ Rut waa dɛ nyini lolɛ bibeŋkpoŋ ɡwaa he be kɛŋɔ he fe aa lolɛ bibaala banuanɛ.” Asɛ Naomi lɛ bie la dɛɛ nyiŋu.
Haahna baa lɔ bela la ŋɔ, “Naomi dɔ naa,” dɛ pa o sɔn Ɔbɛd.
On lolɛ Jese, asɛ Jese nɔ lolɛ Kooro Devid.
Banɔɔ ɛ Pɛrɛs bii ne o naanar.
O lolɛ Hɛsrɔn, asɛ Hɛsrɔn lolɛ Ram, Ram ɡe lolɛ Aminadab.
Aminadab lolɛ Naasɔn, asɛ Naasɔn lolɛ Salmon, Salmon lolɛ Boas, asɛ Boas ɡe lolɛ Ɔbɛd, Ɔbɛd lolɛ Jese, asɛ Jese lolɛ Kooro Devid.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Samoɛl Tɔn Loɡle nɔ dɛ baɡle Korowii bonɔɔ Samoɛl, ne Kooro Sɔɔl dɛ Kooro Devid baa tɔ sie di kora Israel harɛ ta wa.
Gɛ saŋ la, tamaa ken dɛ Filisti ne Israel tena dɛ yo laa.
Devid kpo Filisti te Goliat waa kpeɡa dɛ do kpeɡri kohona, asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl kpɔɔ ɛ o bonɔɔ.
Kooro Sɔɔl baa na kɛŋɔ Korowii le Devid ó ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ́ di kora, asɛ dɛɛ nyinu dɛ́ kpo.
Kɛ Korowii kpɔ nɔn tɔ Devid nɛɛ ka tel saŋ aa tela kɛ ó di kora.
Devid ne Kooro Sɔɔl bibaa Jonatan kpɔ darame.
Samoɛl lola wa Baa bɛlee fa lole baa yerɔ Ɛlkana, o le Efrem dea.
Dɛ o soɡe Rama waa lɔ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta.
O mɛɛ sɔne Jɛroham, o nabaa ɡe sɔne Elihu.
Elihu ɡe mɛɛ Tohu, asɛ Tohu ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Suf.
Dɛ Ɛlkana mo haahna banɛ.
Bɛl sɔne Hana, asɛ nɛɛte ɡe Pɛnena.
Pɛnena dɔ bii, asɛ Hana te ta bie dɔe.
Bena bɛlbwaa Ɛlkana yon le o bwɛɛ Rama kaa bwɛjen Silo, dɛ́ ka tomɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛo.
Dɛ Eli ɛ sɔfo, dɛ dɔ bibaala banɛ bane ba ɡe aa ɛ sɔfore.
Bɛl sɔne Hofni nɛɛte ɡe Fenehas.
Saŋ bɛlbwa waa ka kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha la, o yon kpɔ o ola waa dɔa la ane ba tɛ Pɛnena, dɛ kpɔ ane ɡe tɛ bii la bɛlbwa.
A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ Korowii ta ɡelɛ Hana dɔ bii te, dɛ Ɛlkana dɛ nyinu taeh, anomanta, o yon tɛo bɔre anɛ.
Waa wola bii dɔe nomanta, Penina waa ɛ o toŋre la yon dɛɛ ɛo sisawa dɛɛ muɡli o baah.
Bena bɛlbwaa Penina na dɛɛ ɛo ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Saŋ bɛlbwa baa la Korowii Dea kaa tomɔ la, o yon muɡli o baah ó wi, hale dɛ́ vɛh kondikwaa kwaraa dii.
O jaa yon bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ wiɔ?
Bɔkwa waa he ŋɔ haa kwaa diɔ?
Saŋ bɛlbwa he bambile yon chɔɡ kohona ɡɛ nɔ wer aa?
N ne he soɡa nɔ ta ɡwaalɛ kɛ he fe aa lolɛ bibaala fi aa?” Awola bɛl, ba di saraha kondikwaa bwɛjen Silo bela tonɛ, asɛ Hana ir dɛ kaa soŋe Korowii.
Dɛ sɔfo Eli soɡe kara ta Korowii Dea doonyoa la jwɛh.
Dɛ o bambile chɔɡɔ kɛrɛdɛ, o wi dɛɛ soŋe Korowii.
Belaa Hana baɡɛ Korowii nyoa ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, na n sum, bɛ n waa soh.
No he tolo wa, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ bibaa, ásɛ n leo cheɡ tɛɛ o soɡa bini bwa, baa o nyumpon beŋkpoŋ kwaraa fonɛ bwa.” Hana teŋɔ soŋe Korowii la sie taeh, asɛ sɔfo Eli ɛɛ nyiŋi a bwa.
Dɛ o pili nyoa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii, kɛ dɛ wobol la aa baŋ le.
A ɡelɔ sɔfo Eli lii kɛŋɔ o ken nyɔ sen dɛɛ, dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Haa won teŋɛ dɛ dɛɛ dɛɛ la ken.
Gel sen nyɔe, dɛ́ ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ.” Belaa o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n ta dɛɛrɛ, maa sen nyɔ, n bambilee chɔɡa mɛɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ kpɔ n waa dɛɛ bil o sie.
Dɛɛ berɛ he tolo liira kɛŋɔ n ɛ hansala.
Korowii soŋa taa n do, dɛkalkɛ n waa sum.” Ate, sɔfo Eli ŋɔ, “Kaa deŋnesɔɔhna ne, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la tɛɛ komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.” Hana chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɡel he sie lɛ he bitolo nɛ.” Asɛ o le bela kaa, dɛ ka nyin kondikwaa di, asɛ bambichɔɡ la bwa kaa.
Tɔɔ aa pera chɔmbibii la, Ɛlkana ne o haahna ne bii iro dɛ ka tomɛ Korowii dɛ berɛ ba kaa Rama bela baa soɡa.
Ɛlkana ne Hana chɔɔ, asɛ Korowii no o wesoŋa la.
Gɛɛ a do o kpoŋe tea, dɛ lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Samoɛl, dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowiirii n soŋe o tɛ mɛ.” Bena bɛl telo ja kɛŋɔ Ɛlkana ne o haahna ne bii kaa bwɛjen Silo ka ɛ benanyoa saraha tɛ Korowii, ásɛ dɛ ka chuɡri o nyobaɡa la ɡe.
Baa dɛ kaa la, Hana te ta bɛl jae dɛ́ la.
Dɛ o tɔ sie ŋɔ o jaa be ŋɔ, “N baa teŋe bie la el aa, mɛɛ kpɔɔ kaa Korowii Dea ó den ka so bela kwaraa.” Anee sɔfo Ɛlkana chaŋo ŋɔ, “A wer, ɛ ɡɛ bwa aa too he tea.
So dem ka tel kɛŋɔ haa teŋe bie la el.
Korowii sɛh he nyobaɡa la ta tɛɛ.” Anomanta, Hana soɡe dem ka tel kɛ waa baa teŋe bie la el.
Hana aa teŋe bie la el la, o lawɛ nabal waa di bene atoro, dɛ ɛ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ kuruware fi, dɛ sen oltɔn pur del, asɛ o ne o jaa kpɔ bie la ja kaa Korowii Dea waa lɔ Silo la.
Baa kpo nabal la tonɛ la, ba kpɔ bie la do sɔfo Eli nɔn ta, asɛ Hana bɔɔ sɔfo Eli ŋɔ, “N poori, n dɔɔ, he dɛ lii mɛ naa?
Menee he faa na n che bonɔ dɛɛ soŋe Korowii la.
N kpɔɔ bil Korowii sie ŋɔ ó tɛ mɛ bie nɔ, asɛ o sɛh n nyoa dɛ tɛ mɛ.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa, n leo cheɡ tɛ Korowii, wɛɛ ɛ Korowii konee o soɡa bini bwa.” Asɛ ba tomɛ Korowii bela.
Hana Korowii jaama Anee Hana jam Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ n sie lɛ kohona, n sie lɛ waa haa ɛa wa!
He ɡelɔ n sie lɛ mɛɛ mamɛ n dɔma, lɛɛ haa lɛɛ mɛ la wa.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ do ɡoroŋ kɛ hen Korowii, he habɔɔ nɛn toole, Lɛɛ bɛlbwa toole kɛ hen Korowii haa ɛ Bwetal yaa tomɛ nɔ.
Gel mbarafo wobol bola, bɛ wobosale dɛɛ bol.
Hen Korowii te, he jemɛ wobɛlbwa, he jemɛ wobɛlbwa nɛn aa dɛ ɛ, dɛɛ pa a bole.
He kuuɡi banyoola tori, dɛ ɡel nɛra baa ɡwɛɡra dɔ bokpeɡa.
Nɛra ba fa aa dɔ kondikwaa kohona la, ba ɛ toma tɛ ba bala mɔɔ dɛɛ di kwa, banɔ la ba fa aa dɛ chɔ lɔr ɡe dɔ dɛɛ di name.
Hambara wono lolɛ bii banuanɛ, onɔ la waa dɔ bibaala kohona ɡe ta dɔe kpa.
Hen Korowiirii dɛɛ kpo, dɛ́ berɛ tɛ mkpa, henee ɡela nɛra sewɛ baa huɡ ba, dɛ́ berɛ ir dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.
Henee ɡela nɛra ɛɛ nya, dɛ́ berɛ ɛ bane kondɔɔhna, dɛ́ lɔ nɛra harɛ dɛ́ berɛ ɡɔɔ bane ɡe.
He lawɛ nɛra baa nyaa le ba nyaa bini, dɛ lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le ba sum ta.
He ɡelɔ nɛŋɡwɛɡra ne koranar pɛ dɛɛ so, dɛ ɡel baa dɔ jirima.
Hen Korowii dɔ kwaa aa lawɛ harɛ nɔ kpoŋe kpeɡri, a taa he ma harɛ nɔ chɔŋɛ.
He dɛ tɔ he nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɡbemɡbe, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena te, he dɛ kpoo ba.
Nɛn aa won che o bokpeɡa ta ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Nɛra baa ɛ hen Korowii dɔm bwa ɛɛ serewoo, hɛɛ kɔro kɛŋɔ bwaala le nyundua, dɛ́ ba chɔɡ ba.
Hen Korowiirii dɛ́ ba bol harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Hɛɛ tɛ he kooro haa leo cheɡ kpeɡrii ó pɔ o dɔma nɛ.” Belaa Ɛlkana ne Hana berɛ kaa Rama bela baa soɡa.
Kɛ Samoɛl te soɡe Silo bela sɔfo Eli be, dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma.
Sɔfo Eli bibaala wa Dɛ sɔfo Eli bibaala nyu bini kpeɡri, baa Korowii ɔmɛ.
Waa aa chɔ le tɛ nɛra baa ba kpo kwaa ɛ saraha a do bane sɔfore baah laanee kɛŋɔ, ol la taa chɔŋɛ nii ta la, sɔfo bonɔɔ waa lɔ o sie la yon kpɔ buni o nyoo aa ɛ atoro kpoŋe.
Wɛɛ taɡɔɔ su ola la bini, asɛ bɛlbwa waa le o ne la ɛ sɔfo la kon.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ ba kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ Israel tena baa ba Silo bela baa ɛ saraha bwa.
Mɔɔ baa fuh ol la noo la, sɔfo la bonɔɔ yon ba naate waa ba dɛ ɛ saraha la be ŋɔ, “Tɛ mɛ ol n ka wɔɔ tɛ sɔfo, waa ondaale nyin, atane onlwɛɛ.” Dɛ nɛn waa baa ɛ saraha la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Fuh ol la noo tonɛ mɔɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ onɔ la haa dɛ nyin” aa, bonɔɔ la ɛɛ chaŋoo ŋɔ, “Akai, kpɔ tɛ mɛ taraken, dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, amɔ te kpeɡri nee mɛɛ ba kpɔe.” Sɔfo Eli bibaala wechɔɡa baa do kan Korowii sie.
Dɛ ba ta ɡelɛ duure do kwaa baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Samoɛl ta ɛ bechala dɛ do sɔfo batakaarebora efɔd baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe nyarɔ dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma.
Bena bɛlbwa, o nya ne o mɛɛ dɛ́ la ka ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii Silo aa, o nya yon nyarɛ batakaarebora ka tɛo.
Sɔfo Eli yon swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Ɛlkana ne o haah ŋɔ, “Korowii ɡel he ne haah nɔ dɔ bii, bá ba chiɡ onɔ haa soŋo o waa dɛ kpɔ ba tɛo nɔ naa ta.” Ásɛ o ne haah la bwa yon berɛ kaa ba bwɛ.
Korowii na Hana sum dɛ tɛo bibaala batoro dɛ bihaahna banɛ.
Samoɛl lɔ Silo bela Korowii sie dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛ ba kpeɡ.
Sɔfo Eli baa hwɛɛh name, dɛ no waa o bibaala la aa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ Israel tena bwa, ne ɡɛ baa lawɛ haahna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela dɛɛ chɔ.
Anee Eli bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
N no dichɔɡa haa dɛ di, dɛ le nɛra la bwa be.
Akai, n bii, he bwara wechɔɡa maa dɛ no Korowii nɛra nyoo la perɛ harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Nɛn ɛ o dɔŋ wechɔɡa aa, Korowiirii dɛ́ won kwaa ba baah.
Kɛ dɛ nɛn ɛ Korowii wechɔɡa aa, nɛn toole dɛ́ cha naate kpa.” Bii la ta ba mɛɛ kaeh waa kah ba la noɛ, dɛ Korowiirii ɛa ɡɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba.
Samoɛl nao dɛ ɡee kpeɡ, o waa do wer Korowii ne nɛwɛnyini bwa be.
Waa Korowii aa bola dɛ chɔɡ Eli ne o dem tena Awola Korowii keame bɛl Korowii aa pili waane bini baɡlo ba sɔfo Eli be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘N fa ta n te kpɔe baɡle he naawa kɛrɛdɛ Ijipt harɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ baa lɔ Ijipt kooro lɔɡa la aa?
Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ bwa binii n le he naa Arɔn ne o bibaala cheɡ ŋɔ, bá ɛ n sɔfore, dɛ́ɛ la bela baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ men Korowii, dɛ́ ka fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛ́ɛ tom mɛ, dɛ́ do sɔfo batakaarebora efɔd ba n sie.
N berɔ tɛ he naawa dea tena ŋwɛnɛ Israel tena kwaa baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha dɛ fuh dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la, baa kpɔ a bini ane.
Ɛrɛɛ n saraha kwaa ne kwaa baa dɛ kpoora, n lea cheɡ ŋɔ bá kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ bela maa lole la, he nyiŋa dɛɛ vah nɔɔ?
He duu he bibaala dɛɛ ɡwaa mɛ, saraha kwaa n nɛra Israel tena aa kpɔa baa tɛ mɛ la, he kpɔ a bodɛɛɡa bɔra la di dɛ je faɡra.’ Anomanta, men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ fa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa kɛŋɔ, he dem nɛra ne he mɛɛ dem nɛraa dɛ́ do n sie, dɛ́ɛ tom mɛ kɛ sɔfore saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Taraken te maa an ɡɛɛ ɛ kpa.
Nɛra baa dɛ duu mɛ la, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá dɔ duure, nɛra baa nyiŋ mɛ dɛɛ vah la, n ɡee nyiŋ baa vah.
Dɛɛ no, saŋ bɛl dɛ́ ba bala ásɛ n kpoo bonɔɔna baa le dea haa le o ta ne he lolanar bini, ásɛ bɛlbwa aa hwɛɛh he bini kpa.
Hɛɛ di suna bela maa lole laanee, ásɛ n swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Israel tena baa kaa la.
Kɛ he lolanar bini te, bɛlbwa aa kpeɡ dɛ́ ba hwɛɛh bwa.
He naanar bini beŋkpoŋii mɛɛ ba ɡela o ɛ n sɔfo.
Kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo ó nyoŋe, o bambile chɔɡ, ásɛ he naanar baa kaa bwa piɡri serewe laa ta ba bonɔɔne saŋ.
Waa aa pu he bibaala banɛ Hofni ne Fenehas laanee kɛ, ba bwa ɛɛ pɛo sewɛ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ waa maa bola la ɛ kasinteŋ.
N ɡbaɡba ɛɛ le sɔfo o waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ ɛ n bambile bini waa tɛ n te, dɛ́ ɡel o dɔ naanar kohona, ásɛ baa tomɛ kooro maa leo cheɡ tɛ n te la.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa kaa he lolanar bini la ba ɡuŋi sɔfo la sie, dɛ́ soŋo suuɡa ne kondikwa.
Dɛ berɛ soŋo ŋɔ ó kpɔɔ sɔfore toma ta, ásɛ o won dɔ kondikwaa dɛɛ di.”
Korowii yerɛ Samoɛl Samoɛl lɔ sɔfo Eli sie dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Korowii waa waa cheɡɛ nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ bol la ta warɛ.
Dɛ waa nae chaahna ta ɡe aa kanɛ.
Awola jwaana bɛl dɛ Eli chɔ dea, hwɛɛhra kohona nomanta, dɛ waa na kɛrɛdɛ kpa.
Dɛ kandea waa lɔ Korowii Dea Boɡoroŋ la ta dɛ chaah, asɛ Samoɛl chɔ bela Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la aa cheɡa.
Asɛ Korowii yerɛ Samoɛl, o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, menee la.” Ate, o chwa la Eli be ka ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ he yer mɛ, menee la.” Eli chaŋo ŋɔ, “N ta hen yerɛ, berɛ kaa ka chɔ.” Asɛ o berɛ kaa.
A habɔɔ Korowii berɛ yerɔ ja, asɛ o ir dɛ la Eli be ka ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, he yer mɛ, menee la.” Eli chaŋo ŋɔ, “N bie, n ta hen yerɛ, berɛ kaa ka chɔ.” Dɛ Korowii ta waa Samoɛl be bolɛ bwa mɔɔ, anomanta, dɛ waa jemɛ kɛŋɔ onee dɛɛ yerɔ.
Korowii yerɔ toorotena, asɛ o berɛ ir la Eli be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, he yer mɛ, menee la.” Belaa Eli na kɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɛɛ yerɔ la.
Ate, Eli ŋɔ Samoɛl be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kaa ka chɔ, he baa no kɛ ba dɛ yerɛ jaa, he ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, bol waa he bonɔɔ be, n dɛ no.’ ” Asɛ Samoɛl berɛ kaa o chɔɔbɔr bela ka chɔ.
Korowii berɔ ba che o jwɛh dɛɛ yerɔ kɛ wubwa la ŋɔ, “Samoɛl!
Samoɛl!” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, bol waa he bonɔɔ be, n dɛ no.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ Samoɛl be ŋɔ, “Na, n dɛ ba waane ɛɛ Israel tena bini ásɛ bɛlbwa waa no la, o bwara yɔr kohona dɛɛ chel.
Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ tɛr Eli ne o dem tena deŋnee ɡɛ aa chɛa, maa wola beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta.
N tɔ sie ɡel o jemɛ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ tɛr o ne o dem tena deŋnee o bibaala waa baa bola yaɡ mɛ la wa, dɛkalkɛ o ta ban kasinteŋ dii.
Gɛ waa nɔ nomanta, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ Eli ne o dem tena wechɔɡa baa ɛa la, hale kwaa kpoora kɛɛ saraha bɛlbwa ɛɛ aa won larawe tɛɛ ba.” Samoɛl chɔɔ asɛ tɔɔ per chɔmbibi o ir dɛ ka ya Korowii Dea ɡbeni la.
Dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ o bol waa waa noa le Korowii be la Eli be, kɛ Eli yerɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “N bie Samoɛl.” Asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, menee la.” Eli bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa Korowii bol he be nɔ?
Bɛ wobɛlbwa kpɔ sɔɔh mɛ.
Dɛ he kpɔ wobɛlbwa Korowii aa bol he be sɔɔh mɛ naa, ó tɛr he deŋne kohona.” Anomanta, Samoɛl bol waa la bwa baɡlo, o ta bɛlbwa kpɔe sɔɔh.
Ate Eli ŋɔ, “Onee Korowii, ɡel o ɛ waa aa too o tea.” Korowii ja Samoɛl nɛ o ba kpeɡ, dɛ ɡel o wobɛlbwa ɡe waa dɛ bol la ɛ kasinteŋ.
Anomanta, Israel harɛ ta bwa, le Dan dea harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ka tel bwɛɛ Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua bwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ Samoɛl ɛ Korowii keame.
Korowii teŋɔ kpɔ o te baa baɡle Samoɛl Silo bela, dɛ baɡlo waa waa bol.
Belaa Samoɛl bol waa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡlo la tɛ Israel tena bwa.
Filisti tena kaa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka A balɔ kɛŋɔ Israel tena vɔrɔwɔ kɛŋɔ bá ka yo Filisti tena.
Israel tena kaa baŋre ba tɛnte deene Ɛbɛneesa harɛ ta, asɛ Filisti tena ɡe do Afɛk.
Filisti tena laa tena lɔɔ ka tɔ Israel tena la nɛ, dɛ yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba kpoo ba nɛra kaɡboŋa banaarɛ.
Israel laa tena baa kaa la aa bera ba bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la, ba nomonome la bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɡel Filisti tena pɔ ya nɛɛ fini ken?
Hé ɡel yá ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Silo ba, ásɛ ya ne wɛɛ valɛ ó lɛ yaa dɛɛ le ya dɔma nɔn ta.” Anomanta, ba tomɛ baala ba la Silo, dɛ ka kpɔ Nemenɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka le bela Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro aa soɡe Kerobim la doa o kookara ta la ba.
Eli bibaala banɛ, Hofni ne Fenehas, teŋɛ Daka la nɛɛ dɛ ba.
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la aa ba bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la, Israel tena la bwa moolo kohona silɛɛ ne, asɛ harɛ jiɡri.
Filisti tena la aa no Israel tena ɡbɔɡa la, ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa ɡe ɡbɔɡaa dɛɛ le Israel tena tɛnte deene bini ken?” Baa noa kɛŋɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la nee ba ba bela la, ɔmee lawɛ Filisti tena la, asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ba kpɔ voɡ ba cheɡ bela baa soɡa la.
A dɔŋa ta chiɡe bwa, namete ya na wa!
Ya bwɛɛlɛ!
Umee dɛ́ lɛ yaa le voɡkpeɡa nɔ nɔn ta nɔ?
Anee fa kpɔ weechɔɡa bwa soo siwi ta Ijipt tena nɛɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la.
Filisti tena, hé dɔ bambile, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ kɛŋɔ baala, dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, hɛ́ɛ ka do Israel tena lɔɡaa ɡɛ ba fa aa lɔ ya lɔɡa la.
Hé che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ yo.” Anomanta, Filisti tena la yo Israel tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, asɛ bɛlbwa chwa ka so ba deremi.
Nɛra baa serewa warɔ taeh, Israel laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraatoroo ba kpoo.
Filisti tena kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la, dɛ kpo sɔfo Eli bibaala Hofni ne Fenehas ɡe.
Sɔfo Eli seo wa Awola tenten, baa bɛl waa le Bɛnjamen dea chwao le laa la ta dɛ ba Silo, dɛ o laala kɛɛrɔ asɛ teera do o nyu ta a baɡle kɛ o bambile chɔɡɔ.
Waa bala la, dɛ Eli soɡe o kara ta ŋwɛnɛ nyoa dɛɛ nyiŋi, dɛkalkɛ ɔmee lawɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la wa.
Baa la aa baa jo bwɛɛ la bini dɛ baɡle waa aa chiɡa la, ɔmee chole bɛlbwa nɛɛ baa wi bɔr bwa.
Eli no wii la dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa bala ɔ?” Ate, baa la ɛ warane dɛ la sɔfo Eli be, ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Eli di bene fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anuatoro.
Hwɛɛhra kohona nomanta, dɛ waa na kɛrɛdɛ kpa.
Baa la ŋɔ Eli be ŋɔ, “Fini tɔpere tenten nɔɔ n chwa le laa ta dɛ ba la.” Asɛ Eli ŋɔ, “N bie, bɔkwa waa chiɡa ɔ?” Ate, baa la ŋɔ, “Laa la ta la, Israel tena chwao, asɛ Filisti tena kpoo ba kohona.
He bibaala Hofni ne Fenehas ɡe, ba kpoo ba, dɛ kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ɡe kaa.” Sɔfo Eli aa no Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la waa la, o le o kara waa soɡe o ta la ta chole hanjala ɡbera jwɛh, asɛ o baŋa ku o sewɛ, dɛkalkɛ o hwɛɛhrɔ dɛ do tɔɡre.
Bene fifraanaarɛ bwaa o tɔ Israel tena sie.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ o bibaa Fenehas haah kpoŋe tea a ka tama ó lolɛ.
Waa no Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la waa kɛŋɔ Filisti tena kpɔɔ kaa, asɛ o hela Eli ne o jaa sewɛ la, loltea piɡro lɔɔ o lolɛ, kɛ dɛ a ɡwaa o nɛ.
Aa ba dɛ ɡwaa kohona wɛɛ ba sewa la, haahna baa dɛ lawɔ lol la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ, he lolɛ bibaa.” Kɛ dɛ waa no, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chaŋoo.
O pa bie la sɔn Ikabod, dɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii jirima le Israel kaa, dɛkalkɛ ba kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la kaa, asɛ o helabaa ne o jaa bwa ɡe sewɛ.
O ŋɔ, “Korowii jirima toole Israel tena nɛɛ kpa, Daka la Filisti tena aa kpɔa kaa la wa.”
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka kpɔe dɛ́ kaa wa Filisti tena la aa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la, ba le o ne bwɛɛ Ɛbɛneesa, dɛ kaa ba bwɛjen Asdɔd ta.
Asɛ ba kpɔ ka cheɡ ba voɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Daɡɔn dea, o che voɡ la jwɛh.
Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Asdɔd tena nao kɛŋɔ ba voɡ Daɡɔn la cholo o sie pi harɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, asɛ ba ka kwaaro pa o buɡ ta.
Tɔ aa pera ja la, ba iro dɛ na kɛŋɔ voɡ la berɔ chole o sie pi harɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, asɛ o nyu ne nɔɔra kuuɡi o chɔ doonyoa, a ka o kpul chɔ.
A waa dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini, nɛra baa dɛ kpoŋe Daɡɔn kere kɛɛ bɛlbwa waa dɛ tomɔ dɛ ba dea la bini joe yaa, ba yon ɡale doonyoa bela mɔɔ dɛɛ jo la.
Korowii tɛr Asdɔd ne bwɛɛre aa baro cheme nɛra deŋne kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta ba nɛ.
O kpɔ ɔɡra ne ŋwɛra ta ba nɛ.
Asdɔd tena aa na waa aa dɛ chiɡ la, ba ŋɔ, “Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ta chɛ kɛ ó che ya be kpa, dɛkalkɛ o dɛ tɛr ya ne ya voɡ Daɡɔn deŋne.” Anomanta, ba yerɛ Filisti koranar baa dɛ nyiŋi ba harɛre ta bwa cheme dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ yá ɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka nɔɔ?” Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ kaa bwɛjen Gat ka cheɡ.” Gɛɛ a do ba kpɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Fɔo Daka la le bela kaa.
Baa kpɔ Daka la kaa Gat kwaraa la, Korowii tɛr bwɛjen Gat tena deŋne ɔmee kohona chole ba nɛ.
O kpɔ ɔɡra ba ta bechale ne nomonome bwa nɛ.
Ate, ba berɛ kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la kaa Ekron, dɛ o ɡe ɛ Filisti tena bwɛjena la bini bɛl.
Bwɛjen la bini nɛra aa naa la, ba wio ŋɔ, “Ba kpɔ Israel tena Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba jo ya baah, dɛ́ ba kpoo yaa.” Anomanta, ba yerɛ Filisti koranar la bwa cheme dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ kpɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ka cheɡ o buɡ ta, ásɛ o bɛ ya ne ya bii ba kpoo.” Dɛ deŋnetɛra Korowii aa kpɔa ba ta ba nɛɛ la ɡelɔ sibeɡra chole ba nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ bwɛjen la ta.
Banɔ la baa wola serewɛ la, ɔɡra ɔɡ ba ba wi dɛɛ yerɛ ba voɡa ŋɔ á ba lɛɛ ba.
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka ne Israel bala Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la lɔ Filisti tena nɔn ta korobie anuanɛ, asɛ Filisti tena la yerɛ kerekpoŋra baa soɡe voɡa ta ne voɡra baa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa cheme dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yá ɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka nɔɔ?
Hé baɡle ɡɛ yaa ɛ dɛ́ berɛ kaa o ne o buɡ ta.” Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la berɛ dɛɛ kaa o buɡ ta tenaa, he bɛ o ne kaa pɛɛpɛɛ.
Hé kpɔ bolchɔɡe dii saraha kwaa ja ka tɛ Korowii.
Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he dɔ chaeh, ásɛ he jemɛ he deŋnetɛra mun.” Filisti tena la bɔɔrɔ ja ŋɔ, “Bolchɔɡe dii saraha besoo yá kpɔ ka tɛo wɔ?” Ate, ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ suuɡaswɛm loɡɛ konɡuleɡule anue kɛŋɔ ɔɡra, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɡe loɡɛ kwaane kɛŋɔ mari anue, ásɛ a che tɛ Filisti koranar banue la, dɛkalkɛ he ne ba bwaa weechɔɡa la lawɛ.
Hé kpɔ suuɡaswɛm konɡuleɡule anue la ne mari anue la aa dɛ chɔɡ he ne he harɛre ta nɛra bwa la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ duure tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la.
O ken ɛɛ laa deŋnetɛra laanee kpɔ he ne he harɛ dɛ he voɡa bwa nɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ he deŋne do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ Ijipt kooro ne o nɛra nɔɔ?
Hé lii ɡɛ Korowii fa aa tɛr ba deŋne kohona, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ baa tɛ Israel tena ŋwɛnɛ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta kaa la.
Anomanta, hé kpɔ konfala aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo dɛ dɔ tɔre, dɛ́ lawɛ naneene anɛ a bii ta aa dɛ ɔra, baa wola ane parɛ bwa vɔwa, ásɛ dɛ pere a bii la le anɛ ka do leɡ bini.
Hé kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ka chɔŋɛ torɔɡo la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa haa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm loɡa la bil o jwɛh.
Hé kpɔ bolchɔɡe dii saraha kwaa la do dakajeɡa bɛl bini, ásɛ o che Daka la jwɛh a kpɔ dɛɛ kaa, dɛɛ nyiŋi a kaala bini.
Hé nao kɛŋɔ a kpɔ sie chaɡɛ bwɛɛ Bɛt Sɛmɛs pera dɛɛ kaa laa, amɔ dɛ Korowiirii kpɔ wahala kohona nɔ ba ta ya nɛ.
A ta sie kpɔe chaɡɛ bela bɔr ɡe aa, yaa jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii be laa aa le, ya nyuchɔɡee ɡelaa a ba ɡɛ.” Anomanta, ba ɛ ɡɛ.
Ba lawɛ naneene anɛ la, dɛ vɔwa pɛl kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo dɛ dɔ tɔre la nɛ, dɛ pere a bii la le a nɛ ka do leɡ bini.
Ba kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ka chɔŋɛ o ta, dɛ kpɔ dakajeɡa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa la do o bini la ɡe ka cheɡ o jwɛh.
Nae la aa lea la, a den kpɔ sie pa Bɛt Sɛmɛs ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa, a ta bɛɡɛ kpɔ diɡ kɛɛ ɡal, dɛ si dɛɛ kaa.
Filisti tena koranar banue la teŋɛ a nɛɛ ka tel Bɛt Sɛmɛs jwɛh ta.
Dɛ Bɛt Sɛmɛs tena lɔ fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini dɛɛ komɛ mea.
Baa ha sie nyiŋi dɛ na Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la, ba sie lɛo kɛrɛdɛ.
Nae la ne torɔɡo la baa tel Josua waa le Bɛt Sɛmɛs la koo ta, dɛ che bwe bɛl jwɛh.
Asɛ bela tena la paɡre daa baa kpɔa kwaa torɔɡo baa vɔwa pɛl nae la, dɛ kpoo nae la ɛ saraha baa fuah tɛ Korowii.
Lewi dea tena la kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ne dakajeɡa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa do o bini la chɔŋɛ bwe la ta.
Bɛt Sɛmɛs tena kpoo kwa, dɛ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah tɛ Korowii awola.
Filisti tena koranar banue la na a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, dɛ berɛ kaa bwɛjen Ekron ta awola tenten.
Gɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ ɔɡra, ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa Filisti tena la kpɔ ka ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha tɛ Korowii laanee la.
Bɛlbwa cheɡɔ tɛ ba bwɛjena Asdɔd ne Gasa ne Askɛlɔn ne Gat dɛ Ekron.
Ba berɔ kpɔ mari anue baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa la, a ɡe che tɛ Filisti koranar banue bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛjena bara ne a bwɛjeɡre.
Bwe baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la chɔŋɛ o ta Josua waa le Bɛt Sɛmɛs koo ta la, o ta ɛ danseɛ kon ba le fini.
Korowii kpoo Bɛt Sɛmɛs baala fifraanuanɛ, nyiŋa baa kaa nyiŋi Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la bini la wa.
Bela tena la wii ba kohona, Korowii kpoe waa kpo ba la wa.
Anee Bɛt Sɛmɛs baala ŋɔ, “Umee dɛ́ won che Korowii o wa aa do ɡoroŋ nɔ sie nɔ?
Leperaa ya kaa Daka nɔ ne ó le ya nɛɔ?” Ba kpɔ kala tɛ Kiriat Jearim tena ŋɔ, “Filisti tena la berɔ kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba, hé ba dɛ́ ba kpɔ kaa he be.”
Kiriat Jearim baala baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la, dɛ kaa o ne Abinadab dem deŋɡare bɛl doa.
Ba sɔ o bibaa baa dɛ yerɔ Eliasa doŋa ta o do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii, dɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Fɔo Daka la ta.
Samoɛl nyiŋi Israel tena nɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la cheɡɛ Kiriat Jearim biɡri taeh, dɛ ɛ bene fifraanɛ bwa.
Gɛ saŋ la, dɛ Israel tena bwa wio dɛɛ no Korowii ŋɔ ó cha ba.
Asɛ Samoɛl ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ berɔɔ ba Korowii be dɛɛ nyinu he bambile bwa ne, dɛ́ laa he te kpɔ voɡa toma ne voɡhaahna Astɔrɛt nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛo dɛɛ tomɛ o ɡbo aa, wɛɛ lɛ heyaa le Filisti tena kpeɡri baa dɛ di he nɛɛ la taa.” Anomanta, ba pa Baal ne voɡhaahna Astɔrɛt aa lɔ ba be ta, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡbo.
Asɛ Samoɛl berɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ŋɔ Israel tena be bá bwa cheme bwɛjen Mispa, ásɛ n soŋe andɛɛɡa le Korowii be tɛ heya.” Ba bwa aa baa cheme Mispa la, ba dɔ nee dɛ fuɡe ta Korowii sie a baɡle wechɔɡa baa ɛa la saraha.
Ba vɔwɛ nyoa tɔpebir la bwa, dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.” Mispa belaa Samoɛl do dɛ tɔ ba sie, dɛ bol bane ba bala waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Filisti tena la aa noa kɛŋɔ Israel tena cheme Mispa la, ba koranar banue la kpɔ ba laa tena dɛ́ ka yoo ba.
Israel tena la no ba wa, asɛ ɔmee chole ba nɛ.
Israel tena la ŋɔ Samoɛl be ŋɔ, “Bɛ soŋa haa cheɡɛ ya naa ta soŋe le Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ be la ɡel.
Ó lɛ yaa le Filisti tena nɔn ta.” Ate, Samoɛl lawɛ pebie o taa dɛ ɔr ba ɛ saraha, dɛ fuuh tɛ Korowii.
O cheɡɛ Israel tena naa ta, dɛ wi yerɛ Korowii asɛ Korowii sɛh o nyoa.
Waa dɛ fuh saraha kon la, dɛ Filisti tena la kpɔ ba te dɛɛ ba ba puu ba yo.
Asɛ Korowii ɡel bwaala kɔr kohona jo Filisti tena la bini, ɔmee chole ba nɛɛ ba wili, dɛ kpɔ bambiteŋa chwa le Israel tena sie.
Israel laa tena le Mispa dɛ ti ba, ba kpoo ba le ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa chɔa kaa bwɛɛ Bɛt Kaa harɛbɔr.
Ate, Samoɛl kpɔ bwe bɛl pa Mispa ne Sɛn baah ta.
Dɛ pa o sɔn Ɛbɛneesa dɛ ŋɔ, “Bonɔɔ Korowii cha yaa ya ba tel.” Gɛɛ a do Israel tena yo Filisti tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Samoɛl soɡa bini bwa, Korowii ta ɡelɛ Filisti tena won ba Israel harɛ jwɛh ta kpa.
Israel harɛ bwɛjena ane kɛŋɔ le Ekron ka tel Gat Filisti tena aa lɛa le ba be la, ba bera tɛɛ ba ba dɔ ba harɛ bwa.
Asɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ba ba ne Amɔre tena baah.
Samoɛl soɡa bini bwa la, o lawɛ Israel tena dɛ kwaa ba ne ba bala waa dɛɛ pa bole.
Bena bɛlbwa, o dɛ ɡaaɡe ba nɛɛ le bwɛjena Bɛtel kaa Gelɡal ne Mispa bwa, dɛ bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.
O yon berɛ ba kaa Rama, bela waa soɡa.
Bela ɡe, o bol Israel tena ne ba bala waa dɛɛ pa bole, asɛ o ma kon baa ɛ saraha o ta bela tɛ Korowii.
Israel tena kooro nyina Samoɛl baa hwɛɛh, asɛ o le o bibaala banɛ ŋɔ bá chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ́ ɛ Israel tena sitɔɔla, dɛɛ bol ba ne ba bala waa dɛɛ pa bole.
O bibaa waa tɔ sie sɔne Joel, nɛɛte la ɡe sɔne Abija.
Dɛ ba ɛ sitɔɔla dɛ so Beɛseeba dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra la nɛ.
Kɛ dɛ ba te ta doe kɛŋɔ ba mɛɛ.
Dɛ ba sie beɡre suuɡa, anomanta, ba ɡelɔ nɛra ɛɛ yaɡ ba sen, baa waa aŋwɛnɛ ta bol.
Anomanta, Israel nomonome la bwa chemo dɛ la Samoɛl be Rama, dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Taraken he hwɛɛhrɔ, asɛ he bii la ɡe ta do kɛ hen, ba we-ɛɛla aa were.
Nyin kooro tɛ yaa wɛɛ tɔ ya sie ɡɛ harɛre nɛra bwa aa dɔa la.” Baa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó tɛɛ ba kooro wɛɛ tɔ ba sie la, a ta o som doe asɛ o soŋe Korowii a wa.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Samoɛl be ŋɔ, “No waa bwa nɛra la aa dɛ bol he be la, he laa ba vɛh kɛ ba kooro, men Korowiirii ba vɛh.
Gɛɛ ba ɛɛ mɛ dɛ le ɡɛ saŋ maa le ba ne Ijipt harɛ ta.
Ba vɛɛh baa vɛɛh mɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ harɛre ane voɡa la taa ba ta do ba le fini, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ he ɡe la.
Name cheɡ deŋne no waa baa bol, kɛ kah ba kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ ɡɛ ba koranar aa dɛ ba kpɔe dɛɛ ɛɛ ba.” Samoɛl bol waa Korowii aa bol o be la bwa baɡle nɛra baa dɛ bɔɔ kooro dɔe waa la.
O ŋɔ, “He baa dɔ kooro aa, waa waa dɛ ba ɛɛ laanee nɔ.
Wɛɛ kpɔ he bibaalaa ɛ o laa tena, bane so kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ pɛl jaɡre la ta, ásɛ bane ɡe so jaɡre ta, bane ɡe chwa tɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ba kpɔ dɛɛ la laa la sie.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo ba bini bane ɛ laa nomonome dɛ́ chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa nyoa, bane ɡe chɔ laa tena fifraanue nyoa, ásɛ bane ɡe ɛɛ parɛ o koo dɛɛ komɛ o koo kondikwa.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo bane ɡe ɛɛ kwaa dɔmkwa baa kpɔ dɛɛ la laa, ne bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ kwaa laa torɔɡore la.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he bihaahna ɛɛ ɛ konsɔɔhsoma, bane ɛɛ daa kondikwa ásɛ bane ɡe ɛɛ wɔɔ paanoo.
Wɛɛ lɛ he harɛdɛɛɡa ne he daa koonii tɛ o nomonome.
Wɛɛ bɔne he mea ne he daa kooni bini bɔre fii, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛ o nomonome ne bonɔɔna.
Dɛ́ kpɔ he bonɔɔna ne toli bwa, ne he nae aa wera ne keeɡore ɛ o kwa áa ɛ o toma.
He peera ɡe la, wɛɛ bɔne a bini bɔre fii, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ heyaa berɛ o yoma.
Awola tɔpere la, hɛ́ɛ dɛɛ wiu, dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he fe aa le kooro he ɡbabir aa leo la nɔn ta, kɛ Korowii aa heyaa chaŋe.” Kɛ ane a bwa, nɛra la vɛoh ba ta Samoɛl waa la noɛ.
Ba ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ nyin kooro ó baa nyiŋi ya nɛ.
Ásɛ ya dɔ kooro kɛŋɔ harɛre nɛra aa dɔa la, ó tɔ ya sie dɛɛ la ya ne laa.” Samoɛl aa no waa bwa baa bola la, o berɔ kpɔ bil Korowii sie ja.
Anee Korowii chaŋo ŋɔ, “No ba wesoŋa la tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba kooro.” Ate, Samoɛl ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ nomɛlbwa berɛ kaa o bwɛ.
Korowii le Sɔɔl asɛ Samoɛl fuɡe noo do o nyu ta Baa bɛlee fa lole dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea baa yerɔ Kes.
O mɛɛ sɔne Abiel, o nabaa sɔne Sɛrɔ.
Sɛrɔ mɛɛ sɔne Bɛkɔrat, o ɡe mɛɛ Afiaa.
Dɛ a ɡɛ Kes nɔ ɛ nɛnjen dɛ ɛ kondɔɔh.
Dɛ o dɔ bibaa bɛl baa yerɔ Sɔɔl.
O wer bonɔɔ, dɛ kpeɡ kɛrɛdɛ o dɔŋ aa wola toole Israel harɛ ta.
Awola bɛl, Sɔɔl mɛɛ Kes keeɡo neenanar baa nyoɡre, asɛ Kes ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ n bonɔɔna la bini bɛl ja he nɛ ásɛ he la ka ɡaaɡe a bɔr.” Baa lea la, ba kpɔ Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta, dɛ ka le Salisa harɛ ta, kɛ ba ta an nae.
Ba ɡaaɡɔ ka le Saalim harɛ ta ɡe, ba ta an nae, dɛ berɛ le bela ka kpɔ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta, kɛ ba ta keeɡo beŋkpoŋ kwaraa nae.
Ba ɡaaɡɔ dɛ ba tel Suf harɛ ta, asɛ Sɔɔl ŋɔ bonɔɔ waa ja o nɛɛ la be ŋɔ, “Yá berɛ kaa dem, ɡɛ laa aa, n mɛɛ sie ɛɛ berɔ beɡre ya wa, dɛ́ ɡwaa kɛ keeɡore nɔ aa nyoɡra nɔ.” Anee bonɔɔ la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Na, Korowii nɛn bɛl lɔ bwɛɛ nɔ ta.
O wobɛlbwa waa bol dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ, baa duuru kohona ɡe.
Gel ya la o be, o ken ɛɛ won baɡle yaa bela yaa kpɔ dɛ́ na keeɡore nɔ.” Ate, Sɔɔl bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ya la baa la be naa, bɔkwaa yaa ba dɔe tɛo wɔ?
Kondikwaa aa lɔ ya pure bini bwa tonɔ.
Komɛlbwa toole yá dɔ ka tɛo.” Bonɔɔ la berɛ chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔ suuɡapoŋ jeɡaa bɛl n be, yá kpɔ ka tɛ Korowii nɛn waa dɛ na chaahna la, ásɛ o baɡle yaa bela yaa kpɔ dɛ́ naa.” Saŋ la dɛ Israel te dɛ nyin o bɔɔ waane le Korowii be naa, o yon ŋɔ, “Ba ya la ka na nɛn waa dɛ na chaahna.
A ɡɛ nɛn nɔɔ baa yerɛ Korowii keame fini la.” Anee Sɔɔl chaŋe ŋɔ, “A wer, ya kaa.” Asɛ ba chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ kaa bwɛɛ Korowii nɛn la aa lole la ta.
Baa teeh deŋɡare bɛl dɛɛ kaa bwɛɛ la ta la, ba cheme bitoli bane baa dɛ ba bá dɔ ne.
Asɛ ba bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Korowii nɛn bɛl waa dɛ na chaahna lɔ bonɔ naa?” Ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, bɛl lole.
O tɔ he sie, hé ɛ warane, finii o den ba ya bwɛɛ nɔ ta.
Bwɛɛ la tena dɛ la ka kpoo kwaa bela baa dɛ ɛ saraha la.
Hé deno jo bwɛɛ la bini naa, hɛɛ nao mɔɔ dɛ́ kaa saraha la bɔr ka di kwa.
Onee dɛ́ swee saraha kwaa ta tɛ nɛra la mɔɔ bá di, ásɛ mɔɔ nɛra baa ta nɔn yer ba la ɡe di.
Hé kaa taraken, hɛ́ɛ ka nao.” Sɔɔl ne bonɔɔ la aa kaa jo bwɛɛ la ta ba den na Samoɛl o valɛ dɛɛ chem ba dɛ baa kaa saraha la bɔr.
Tɔ aa per mɔɔ Sɔɔl ba la, dɛ Korowii pili waa la bini baɡle Samoɛl ŋɔ, “Kere saŋ nɔ bɔr, mɛɛ tomɛ baa bɛlee le Bɛnjamen dea harɛ taa he be.
O balaa, fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ́ ɛo n nɛra Israel tena sitɔɔ.
Onee dɛ́ ba lɛɛ baa le Filisti tena nɔn ta.
N na wenaale baa lɔ a ta, ba wii ɡe tel n be.” Samoɛl siwi aa dena dawɛ Sɔɔl nɛɛ la, Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Baa la maa bol o waa he be laanee la, onee dɛ́ ba nyiŋi n nɛra nɛ.” Sɔɔl kaa cheme Samoɛl doonyoa dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii nɛn waa dɛ na chaahna la dem doɔ?” Anee Samoɛl chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Menee a ɡɛ nɛn la, hé tɔ n sie kaa saraha bɔr bela.
Fini n ne heyaa dɛɛ ba kwaa dii, ásɛ tɔɔ perɔ chɔɔ aa, waa aa lɔ he be bwa la, ń bol baɡle heya, dɛ́ ta heyaa ŋwɛnɛ hé kaa.
Keeɡore aa nyoɡra tɔpera atoro bwaa nɔ la te, he bɛ ɡel a waa hiah heya, ba naa.
Hen Sɔɔl nɛɛ Israel tena bwa sie dawɛ.
Nomɛlbwa toole ka ja he ne he mɛɛ dem tena nɛ.” Ate, Sɔɔl chaŋe ŋɔ, “Bɛnjamen dea o nɛra aa wola kanɛ Israel deene bwa binii n le.
N lolanar ɡe toole wobɛlbwa bini.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ n be nɔɔ?” Belaa Samoɛl tɔ Sɔɔl ne bonɔɔ la sie, dɛ kpɔ ba ba so nomombɔr dejen bɛl bini kondikwaa la mun.
Dɛ nɛra fifraatoro baa ta nɔn yer ba la soɡo bar teebur la.
Samoɛl ŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ daa kondikwa la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ oldɛɛɡe maa ŋɔa he kwaa cheɡ mɛ la ba.” Asɛ o kpɔ ol la hwii ne o nakpala bwa ba cheɡ Sɔɔl sie.
Ate, Samoɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ol maa kpɔa cheɡe laanee la.
Chwe, dɛkalkɛ anee n kpɔ cheɡe, he ne nɛra maa ta nɔn yer ba nɔ pɛ di.” Sɔɔl ne Samoɛl pɛo di kondikwaa awola.
Baa le saraha bɔr bela dɛ ba bwɛɛ la ta la, Samoɛl ɡelɔ ba pa kalaŋ tɛ Sɔɔl o chɔ o saldoa, asɛ o la o ne o ka bol wa.
Ba iro bɔr chaahna saŋ, asɛ Samoɛl la Sɔɔl be saldoa bela dɛ ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ́ kpɔ he te, ásɛ n ka doe ŋwɛnɛ.” Asɛ o kpɔ o te ba bwa le kaa.
Baa dɛ tel bwɛɛ la dahare la, Samoɛl ŋɔ Sɔɔl be ŋɔ ó ŋɔ bonɔɔ la be ásɛ wɛɛ tɔ sie, asɛ o ba tɔ ba sie dɛɛ kaa.
O ŋɔ Sɔɔl be ŋɔ, “He te so bonɔ tama, ásɛ n bol waa aa le Korowii be baɡle.”
Belaa Samoɛl kpɔ ɔleve noo loŋbir dɛ fuɡe do Sɔɔl nyu ta, dɛ ɡbaaro pɛl bambile dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii lee he ɛ o nɛra Israel tena sitɔɔ.
Hɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma baa bar ba cheme nɔn ta.
Anee dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii lee he ɛ o nɛra Israel sitɔɔ.
He le n be bonɔ fini dɛɛ kaa laa, hɛɛ cheme baala banɛ bane Rakɛl ŋwam taa, o lɔ Sɛlsa ne Bɛnjamen dea harɛ jwɛh ta.
Baa ŋɔ he bee ŋɔ, ‘Keeɡore aa nyoɡra hɛɛ ɡaaɡe a bɔr la, ba naa.
A waa laa bera hiah he mɛɛ kpa, o dɛ bɔɔ bela waa nae.’ He le bela dɛɛ kaa laa, hɛɛ ka tel dajen bɛl waa lɔ bwɛɛ Tabɔ munii.
Hɛɛ ka pu baala batoro bane baa dɛ kaa bwɛjen Bɛtel ka ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Ba bini bɛl lawɛ bombiire atoro teŋɛ o nɛ, nɛɛte kpoŋe paanoo atoro, asɛ toorote la ɡe kpoŋe sen aa lɔ oltɔn pur bini.
Baa jaamee, dɛ́ kpɔ paanoo anɛ baa ɡɔɔra nyundua tɛ Korowii tɛɛ, ásɛ he lɛ.
A habɔɔ, hɛɛ ka tel Korowii deŋɡare waa lɔ Gebea la taa, belaa Filisti tena baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so.
Haa dɛɛ jo bwɛɛ la doonyojen bini la, hɛɛ cheme Korowii keamere baa le saraha bɔr deŋɡare la ta dɛ teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ ba, dɛɛ lɔ janjela ne ɡboŋri, dɛɛ hoh kalipere.
Baa bol Korowii waa.
Korowii Doma ɛɛ ba so he nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛɛ, dɛ́ beɡre nɛnfale, ásɛ he ne ba bwa ɛɛ bol Korowii waa aa dɛ́ ba bala kerekere.
Gɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛo waa, Korowii ɛɛ ba ja he nɛɛ he ɛ waa waa dɛ nyin kɛ he ɛ. Berɛ tɔ n sie dɛ kaa bwɛjen Gelɡal.
Mɛɛ pui belaa dɛ́ ba fuh kwaa ɛ saraha ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha.
Kɛ so ka tel tɔpera anuanɛ mɔɔ ń ba baɡle waa haa ɛ.” Ba cheɡ Sɔɔl kora ta Sɔɔl aa dɛ le Samoɛl be la, Korowii charɛ Sɔɔl liire asɛ waa Samoɛl aa bola la bwa ɛ ɡɛ.
Baa tel Gebea la, Korowii keamere teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ ba chemo, asɛ Korowii Doma ba so o nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛ, o ka ja ba nɛ baa bol Korowii waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere.
Nɛra ba fa aa jemɛ Sɔɔl, dɛ na kɛ o berɔ ja Korowii keamere nɛɛ o ne baa bol Korowii waa ɡɛ la bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa ba Kes bibaa nɔ nɛɔ?
O ɡe berɔ ɛ Korowii keame la bɛl kɛɛ?” Anee baa bɛl waa soɡe bela bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Ba mɛɛnanaree bame waɔ?” Anomanta, ba kpɔɔ dɛɛ bol waa ŋɔ, “Sɔɔl ɡe ɛ Korowii keamere la bɛl kɛɛ?” Sɔɔl aa bol Korowii waa tonɛ la, o berɔ kaa saraha bɔr deŋɡare la ta.
Asɛ Sɔɔl mɛwee bɔɔ o ne o bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, “Leperaa he kaalɔ?” Sɔɔl ɡe chaŋo ŋɔ, “Keeɡore la bɔree ya kaa ɡaaɡe, asɛ yaa wola an na la ya kaa Samoɛl be.” Sɔɔl mɛwee la ŋɔ, “Bol waa Samoɛl aa bol he be la baɡ mɛ.” Anee Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “Samoɛl ɡelɔ ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba na keeɡore la.” Kɛ o ta kara dii waa Samoɛl aa bola la te baɡlɛ.
Sɔɔl lɛɛ dɛ do kɛ kooro Samoɛl cheme Israel tena la bwa Korowii sie Mispa, dɛ ŋɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Menee lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ lɛ heyaa le Ijipt tena ne harɛfala nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi heyaa nɔn ta.
Kɛ taraken he vɛh men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, n lɛ heyaa le wahala ne wekpeɡa bwa ta la.
He berɔ ŋɔ ń tɛ heyaa kooro wɛɛ tɔ he sie.
Anomanta, he bwa ba cheme n sie deenaa ta.” Samoɛl aa ɡela Israel deene bwa ba cheme la, Bɛnjamen dea tenaa Korowii lawɛ.
O berɔ ɡel Bɛnjamen dea nɛra ba o sie lolanar ta, asɛ Korowii lawɛ Matri lolanar.
A habɔɔ la, Sɔɔl waa ɛ Kes bibaa laanee Korowii lawɛ, kɛ baa nyiŋa la dɛ Sɔɔl toole ba bini.
Anee ba ka bɔɔ le Korowii be ŋɔ, “Sɔɔl ta bonɔ balɛ mɔɔ kɛɛ?” Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “O sɔh bone la habɔɔ.” Ate, ba chwa ka kpɔɔ ba, dɛ o cheɡɛ nɛra bini, dɛ kpeɡ ɡwaa ba bwa.
Samoɛl ŋɔ nɛra la bwa be ŋɔ, “Kɛ he bwa na nɛn Korowii aa leo kenɛ?
Ya bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ do kɛ on.” Anee nɛra la bwa moo ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ kooro mkpajaŋ!” Samoɛl kure kara mun mmarare baɡle nɛra la.
O chwera do tɔn bini dɛ kpɔ ka bil Korowii sie bela.
Asɛ Samoɛl ta ba ŋwɛnɛ, bɛlbwa kaa bela waa lea ba.
Sɔɔl ɡe berɔ kaa Gebea bela waa soɡa.
Korowii ɡelɔ laa tena baa kpeɡa sie lɛ o nɛ, asɛ ba teŋɛ o nɛɛ kaa.
Kɛ nɛnchɔɡa bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ nɛn waa do ken ɡe ɛɛ ba wona lɛ yaa ɔ?” Ba haoh dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah, ba ta on koŋkɛɛla bɛlbwa ba tɛɛ.
Sɔɔl ɡe ta ba waa la kpɔe ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Sɔɔl yo Amɔn tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ Dɛ ɛ korobie beŋkpoŋ habɔɔ la, Amɔn Kooro Nahas tɔ o laa tena sie ba ka bar bwɛɛ Jabes waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta dɛ́ yoo ba.
Anee Jabes baala bwa ŋɔ Kooro Nahas be ŋɔ, “Gel ya ne he fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ ya do he lɔɡa.” Anee Kooro Nahas chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ne hɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee yaa, webeŋkpoŋ taa aa ba cheɡa.
Atane n fome he bini bɛlbwa diɡ siwi, ásɛ a ɛ sihihwa tɛ Israel tena bwa.” Belaa Jabes nomonome ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Tɛ yaa tɔpera anuanɛ ásɛ ya tomɛ nɛra Israel harɛ ta bwa, dɛ ya ta nomɛlbwa dɔe ó ba lɛ yaa aa, yáa kpɔ ya tenee do he lɔɡa.” Toroma la aa tel Gebea bela Sɔɔl aa soɡa dɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ ba be la, ba wio kɛrɛdɛ.
Buɡ la ta, dɛ Sɔɔl teŋɛ o nae baa kpɔa dɛɛ parɛ le koo ta dɛɛ ba.
Waa no wii la, o bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa chiɡa ɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ wi ɡɛ nɔɔ?” Asɛ ba bol waa Jabes baala la aa baa bol la ba be.
Sɔɔl aa no waa nɔ la, Korowii Doma baa so o nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛ, asɛ o baah di kohona.
O lawɛ nabala anɛ kpo, dɛ chɛwa dɛ kpɔ tomɛ nɛra Israel harɛ ta bwa ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa wola Samoɛl ne Sɔɔl nɛɛ teŋɛ la, kenii baa ba o nae kpoe dɛ chɛwa.” Korowii ɡelɔ ɔmee kohona chole ba bwa nɛ, asɛ ba pɛ nyoa ba ja Samoɛl ne Sɔɔl nɛ.
Sɔɔl aa boa ba bwa nyoa bwɛɛ Bɛsɛk la, dɛ Israel baala lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafraatoro, asɛ Juda baala ɡe ɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraatoro.
Sɔɔl ne o nomonome ŋɔ toroma baa le Jabes la be ŋɔ, “Hé ka ŋɔ he nɛra be kɛŋɔ, ‘Le kere wee ne ŋɔ o che nyufala dɛ he dɔ lɛɛ.’ ” Toroma la aa laŋa dɛ ka bol Jabes tena la be la, ba sie lɛo kohona, dɛ ŋɔ Amɔn tena la be ŋɔ, “Kere yaa kpɔ ya tenee ba do he lɔɡa, ásɛ he ɛ yaa ɡɛ bwa haa dɛ nyin.” Tɔ aa pera la, Sɔɔl bɔne o laa tena bini kuore atoro, asɛ bɔr aa dɛ chaah la ba ka lɔ tɔ Amɔn tena la nɛ bela baa soɡa, dɛ kpoo ba ka tel webaŋa.
Banɔ la baa kaa la ɡe lɔ peɡre, bɛlbwa chwa dɛɛ nyin o nyu.
Sɔɔl lɛɛ dɛ do kɛ kooro Ate, Israel tena la ŋɔ Samoɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛn besooree ŋɔa ŋɔ Sɔɔl bɛ ya kooro ɛ laɔ?
Le ba ne tɛ yaa ya kpoo ba.” Anee Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “Baa nomɛlbwa kpoe ba fini, fini tɔperee Korowii lɛ o nɛra Israel tena.” Ate, Samoɛl ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya bwa kaa Gelɡal dɛ́ ka che Sɔɔl mun ta dɛ́ lɛo do kɛ ya kooro kɛrɛdɛ.” Anomanta, nɛra la bwa la Gelɡal bela, Korowii sie, dɛ ka lɛo do kɛ ba kooro.
Ba kpoo kwaa ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha, asɛ Sɔɔl ne Israel tena la bwa di kondikonjena dɛ lɛ ba sie.
Samoɛl wobol aa ka mun Samoɛl ŋɔ Israel tena la bwa be ŋɔ, “N no waa haa bɔɔra la, dɛ nyin kooro tɛ heya o tɔ he sie dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ.
Taraken he dɔ kooro o ɛ he sitɔɔ.
N hwɛɛhrɔ n nyumpona to, asɛ n bibaala do he bini bonɔ.
N bonɔɔne saŋ bwaa n le dɛ tɔ he sie dɛ ba le fini.
N cheɡɛ bonɔ fini, dɛ n ɛ nomɛl wechɔɡe bɛl aa, bɛlbwa bol Korowii ne nɛn waa leo cheɡ o ɛ kooro nɔ sie.
N lɛ nomɛl keeɡo kɛɛ nao o be naa?
N faah nomɛl kɛɛ dɛ fiiɡi nomɛl aa?
Umee n ɡel o yaɡ mɛ sen ɔ?
Dɛ n ɛ anɔ bini bɛlbwa naa, mɛɛ bɔ naate a kemee.” Ba ɡe chaŋe ŋɔ, “He ta yaa faahrɛ kɛɛ dɛ fiiɡi bɛlbwa, he ta komɛlbwa ɡe lɛɛ le nomɛlbwa be.” Anee Samoɛl ŋɔ, “Korowii ne kooro waa leo laanee ɛ he danseɛ fini kɛŋɔ he ta wechɔɡe bɛlbwa n nɛɛ nae.” Asɛ ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, Korowiirii ya danseɛ.” Ate, Samoɛl berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korowiirii le Mosis ne Arɔn ba ka lawɛ he naawa le Ijipt harɛ ta.
Name, hé che bonɔ, ásɛ n ɡel Korowii bol he be hé jemɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla waa ɛa dɛ́ lɛ he ne he naawa la.
Jekɔb ne o bii aa kaa jo Ijipt harɛ ta asɛ baa fiɡ ba la, he naawa wio no Korowii ŋɔ ó cha ba.
Asɛ o tomɛ Mosis ne Arɔn ba ba lawɛ he naawa le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ ba ba so bonɔ.
Kɛ ba soh Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la wa, anomanta, o ɡelɔ Filisti tena ne Moab kooro dɛ Sisera waa ɛ laa sitɔɔ dɛ do bwɛjen Hasɔ ba yo he naawa dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba wio yerɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Korowii, ya ɛɛ wechɔɡa dɛ vɛh he toma dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa Baalre aa ɛ baala ne voɡhaahna Astɔrɛt.
Name te lɛ yaa le ya dɔma nɔn ta ásɛ yaa tomɛ.’ Korowii tomɛ Gedeɔn ne Barak ne Jɛfta dɛ men Samoɛl asɛ ya ba lɛ heyaa le he dɔma nɔn ta, he so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Háa na Amɔn Kooro Nahas wɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yo heyaa la, he le Korowii waa ɛ he kooro la habɔɔ, dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɛ nyin kooro wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ya nɛ.’ Taraken, kooro haa ŋɔa he dɛ nyinu laanee la, Korowiirii leo tɛ heya.
Dɛ he dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta, hale he ne he kooro bwa naa, he wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛ heya.
Kɛ dɛ haa duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛo, dɛ vɛh o Mmarare ta teŋa aa, o baah ɛɛ di he ne he kooro nɛɛ ɡɛ o baah fa aa di he naawa nɛɛ la.
Anomanta, hé che bela haa cheɡa, dɛ́ na wejena Korowii aa dɛ́ ba ɛɛ he siwi ta.
Lɔmɔɡa saŋ laa nɔ naa?
Mɛɛ soŋe Korowiirii ó ɡel bwaala nɛ dɛ kɔr.
Anee hɛɛ ba nae kɛŋɔ kooro haa soŋa la ɛ wechɔɡa Korowii be.” Anee Samoɛl soŋe Korowii awola, asɛ bwaala nɛ dɛ kɔr kohona.
Asɛ ɔmee kohona lawɛ nɛra la bwa Korowii ne Samoɛl wa.
Ate, nɛra la bwa ŋɔ Samoɛl be ŋɔ, “Soŋe Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la, ásɛ yan yaa ɛ he bonɔɔna nɔ bɛ serewe.
Ya wechɔɡa la habɔɔ, ya berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kɛŋɔ yaa ŋɔa ya dɛ nyin kooro la.” Samoɛl ŋɔ, “A lole kɛŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡa nɔ bwa te, kɛ hɛɛ berɛ ɔma, he bɛ habɔɔ berɛ kpo Korowii, hɛ́ɛ tomɔ bambile bwa ne.
Hé laa sie kpɔ voɡa ta.
Wedɛɛɡa bɛlbwa toole a toma ta.
Aa won lɛ heya, a wobɛlbwa ɛ wepuu.
Korowii ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, waa o nɛraa vɛh.
O sie lɛo kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ heyaa ɛ o nɛra.
Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛŋɔ n ɛo wechɔɡa dɛ́ vɛh kɛ mɛɛ soŋo tɛ heya.
Mɛɛ baɡle heyaa waa aa wera ne anɔ la aa toɡraa.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta dɛ́ɛ tomɔ kasinteŋ ne bambile bwa ne, dɛ́ɛ lii wejena waa ɛa tɛ heya la.
Kɛ dɛ he ta nao dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, he ne he kooro bwa ɛɛ serewoo.”
Filisti tena ka yoi Sɔɔl bonɔɔne saŋee o di kora Israel harɛ ta.
Bene anɛɛ o di kora.
Kooro Sɔɔl le baala kaɡboŋa batoro le Israel harɛ, ba bini kaɡboŋa banɛ do o be Mikmas ne Bɛtel waa chɔ deŋɡarere doa, asɛ kaɡboŋ ɡe do Jonatan be Gebea waa lɔ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta.
Dɛ ɡel ba kabora kaa ba deremi.
Jonatan kaa kpo Filisti tena laa nomoa bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Geba la ta, asɛ Filisti tena la bwa no.
Kooro Sɔɔl ɡelɔ ba hoh bɛla harɛ la bwa ta ŋɔ, “Hibru tena, hé ir dɛ́ kpɔ he te yá kaa laa.” Anomanta, Israel tena la bwa aa noa kɛŋɔ Sɔɔl kpo Filisti tena laa nomoa bela o ne o laa tena aa soɡa la, Filisti tena hah Israel tena kohona.
Israel laa tena la bwa baa cheme, dɛ ka ja Sɔɔl nɛɛ Gelɡal.
Filisti tena la chemo kɛ bá ka yo Israel tena.
Ba dɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre kaɡboŋa atoro, asɛ laa tena kaɡboŋa banumɛl so jaɡre ta, dɛ laa tena baa wara kohona kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.
Ba kaa cheme Mikmas, waa lɔ bwɛɛ Bɛt Avɛn wee leebɔr.
Israel laa tena la aa naa kɛŋɔ a kpeɡri tɛɛ ba name la, ba chwao ka sɔh bwebɔɔne ne sɔɔhne bini, ne bwea ne bɔɔne dɛ kɔlɔŋa bini dɛ́ lɛ ba nyuune.
Ba bini banɔ la baa kaa ɡe ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo, dɛ kaa Gad ne Gelead harɛre ta.
Kooro Sɔɔl te ka Gelɡal, asɛ ɔmee chole laa tena baa ja o nɛɛ la nɛɛ kohona baa chel.
Kooro Sɔɔl soɡe bela ka tel tɔpera anuanɛ ɡɛ Samoɛl aa doo la.
Kɛ Samoɛl ta wone ba o be Gelɡal ɡɛ waa doo la, asɛ Sɔɔl nɛra la pa mun dɛɛ peɡre.
Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha kwaa ba.” Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl kpɔ fuh ɛ saraha.
Waa ɛ saraha la dɛɛ tonɛ la, buɡ la ta, Samoɛl ɡe den tel bela.
Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl le dɛ ba chemo.
Samoɛl bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he ɛ nɔɔ?” Kooro Sɔɔl chaŋo ŋɔ, “Saŋ haa doa la aa baa kaa haa wola balɛ mɔɔ, asɛ nɛra la ɛɛ peɡre, asɛ Filisti tena ɡe baa cheme Mikmas la, n liiro kɛ Filisti tena ɛɛ ba yoo mɛɛ Gelɡal, maa wola chae soŋɛ le Korowii be wa.
Anomanta, n nao kɛ a chɛ kɛ ń fuh saraha kwaa tɛ Korowii.” Samoɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He ɛ ɡɛnewa.
He ta Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ doe waa doe la kpɔe ɛ toma ɡɛ aa chɛa.
He fe teŋɛ ɡɛ waa doe la ta naa, o fe ɛɛ ɡeloo he ne he naanar di kora Israel harɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Taraken he kora aa lee do kpa.
Korowii ɛɛ le nɛnfale o bambile aa lawaa, ásɛ o tɔ o nɛra sie.
Dɛkalkɛ he ta o waa ta teŋɛ.” Samoɛl le Gelɡal dɛ kaa Gebea waa lɔ Bɛnjamen harɛ ta, asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl kure baala baa ja o nɛɛ la.
Baa ɛ nɛra lafraanumɛlee.
Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaa Jonatan ne baala baa ja ba nɛɛ la soɡe Gebea waa lɔ Bɛnjamen harɛ ta, asɛ Filisti tena la ɡe ka baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so Mikmas.
Filisti laa tena le bela baa soɡa, ba bɔne ba bini kuore atoro ba ka yo dɛ pa laala dɛɛ ba.
Beŋkpoŋ kpɔ sie pa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr bwɛjen Ofra waa lɔ Sual harɛ ta, Bɛl ɡe kpɔ sie pa wee cholibɔr Bɛt Hɔrɔn pera.
Banɔ la baa kaa la ɡe kpɔ sie chaɡɛ wee leebɔr pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ jwɛh ta, asɛ Seboim Fɛlembɔjen la sie chaɡɛ bela.
Dɛ loɡre bɛlbwa toole Israel harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ Filisti tena la ta sɛɛh kɛŋɔ Hibru tena la loɡɛ buni kon bɛlbwa.
Gɛ laa aa, baa loɡɛ lampeare ne kerii.
Anomanta, dɛ Filisti tena harɛ taa Israel tena la kaa sar ba para ne kpanfɛre ne ɡoori dɛ buni kon te bɛlbwa.
Ba sar Israel tena la kwaa tɛɛ ba aa, ɡɛɛ ba lɛɛ ba yokpeɡ.
