Suuɡabwe jeɡaa ba lɛ dɛɛ sar kpanfɛre ne buni baa kpɔ lɔ nao o do sie parɛ, ne para nae aa dɛ parɛ ane ne para te bwa soo siwi la, suuɡabwea anɛɛ baa lɛ.
Anomanta, dɛ laa baa chole aa, Israel te bɛlbwa aa kere kɛɛ lampea kpoŋe ka ja Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaa Jonatan nɛ.
Filisti tena le laa tena la bini bane, ba ka che ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa Mikmas dɛɛ daah bela.
Awola bɛl, Jonatan waa ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bibaa la ŋɔ o bechala waa dɛ che o dɔmkwaa be ŋɔ, “Ba yá kaa baŋ le bela Filisti tena aa soɡa la.” Kɛ o ta o mɛɛ te be bolɛ.
Dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl baŋre o tɛnte dea daa bɛl o nɔna aa do ɡuleɡule baa yerɔ pɔmeɡranet mun, bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Meɡrɔn, o ne Gebea aa jaŋɛ.
Dɛ laa tena dɛ ɛ lafraanumɛl ja o nɛ, dɛ sɔfo Ahija do sɔfo batakaarebora efɔd dɛ ja ba nɛ.
Baa bɛl waa ɛ Ikabod dɔɔ Ahitub biee on, Ahitub ɡe mɛɛ Fenehas.
Ahitub nabaalee Sɔfo Eli, dɛ o lɔ Korowii sie dɛɛ tomɔ Silo.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Jonatan le ba bini kaa.
Dɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl chɔɔ kaa Mikmas, asɛ Jonatan ɛɛ nyin kɛ ó kpɔ o ta kaa bela Filisti tena aa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so la.
Dɛ bwea ane aa kana cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la baŋ bɛlbwa ta.
Bɛl sɔne Bɔsɛs asɛ nɛɛte la ɡe sɔne Sene.
Bwe la beŋkpoŋ cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la weekaŋle nyunduabɔr o sie chaɡɛ Mikmas, asɛ nɛɛte la ɡe che weekaŋle harɛbɔr, o sie chaɡɛ Geba.
Jonatan ŋɔ o bonɔɔ waa cheɡɛ o dɔmkwa la be ŋɔ, “Ba yá ɡale kaa Filisti tena baa wola Korowii tomɛ nɔ be.
Korowii ken ɛɛ cha yaa.
Komɛlbwa aa won tɔ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ yaa wola won pɔ ba nɛ, ya warɔ kɛɛ ya ta warɛ kwara noo.” O bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, “Ɛ ɡɛ bwa haa dɛ nyin he ɛ, n cheɡɛ he habɔɔ kiŋkiŋ ken.” Anee Jonatan ŋɔ, “Ba yá ɡale ka kpɔ Filisti tena la sie ásɛ ba na yaa.
Dɛ ba ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ, ‘Hé che bela ya ba pu heya aa,’ yaa che ya buɡ ta belaa.
Kɛ dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Hé ba ya be bonɔ naa,’ yaa teehnoo kaa ba be, anee dɛ́ chaɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ ba do ya nɔn ta.” Anomanta, Jonatan ne o bonɔɔ la ɡelɔ Filisti tena la na ba.
Asɛ Filisti tena la ŋɔ, “Hé na, Hibru tena la bane huuhno le bɔɔne baa chwaa ka sɔh a bini la bini dɛɛ ba.” Ate, Filisti tena baa lɔ bela la nyɛɡ Jonatan ne o bonɔɔ la nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya be nyundua bonɔ, ásɛ ya baɡle heyaa waane.” Anee Jonatan ŋɔ o bonɔɔ la be ŋɔ, “Teŋɛ n nɛ dɛɛ ba, Korowii kpɔ ba do Israel tena nɔn ta.” Jonatan kpɔ nakpale ne nɔɔra huuh dɛɛ kaa, asɛ o bonɔɔ la ɡe teŋɛ.
Jonatan kaa yo Filisti tena la dɛ pɔ ba nɛ ba choɡli chɔ, asɛ o bonɔɔ la ɡe teŋɛ dɛɛ kpoo ba.
Laa la mumpar la, Jonatan ne o bonɔɔ la kpoo nɛra fifraanɛ, harɛ baa kpoo ba o ta la, wɛɛ ɛ dɛ ɛ kato delee.
Israel tena lɔɔ ka tɔ Filisti tena nɛ Belaa ɔmee kohona chole laa tena la bwa nɛɛ baa chel, banɔ la baa lɔ bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene ne banɔ la baa lɔ kpɔɡ bini, dɛ nɛra baa laŋa dɛɛ la ka yo bwa.
Korowii ɡelɔ harɛ jiɡri ɔmee kohona chole ba nɛ.
Kooro Sɔɔl laa tena baa dɛ daahno dɛ do Bɛnjamen harɛ ta Gebea la na Filisti tena kɛŋɔ baa wila, dɛ chwa sibeɡra ne bobɛlbwa dɛɛ kaa.
Anee o ŋɔ laa tena o ne baa lɔ bela la be ŋɔ, “Hé bwa ba boa nyoa dɛ́ na he bini banɔ la baa wola toole.
Baa chema la, dɛ Jonatan ne o bonɔɔ waa dɛ che o dɔmkwaa laanee wola toole ba bini.” Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ sɔfo Ahija be ŋɔ, “Ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba.” Gɛ saŋ dɛ Israel tena bee o do.
O taa dɛ bol waa sɔfo la be la, dɛ name te kwaraa a ɡɛ bambiteŋa la ɡwaa Filisti tena la nɛ bela baa soɡa la.
Anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gel wobɛlbwa ɛɛ.” Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl ne o laa tena la bwa cheme, dɛ kaa laa la ta.
Ba kaa pu Filisti tena la kɛŋɔ ba wilo kohona, dɛ berɛ sie ta dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ kpoo.
Hibru tena bane ba fa aa la Filisti tena be ba ne ba kaa ba soŋnibɔr la, berɔ kaa Israel tena baa ja Kooro Sɔɔl ne Jonatan nɛɛ la be.
Israel tena baa sɔh Efrem deŋɡarere ta aa noa kɛŋɔ Filisti tena la dɛ chwa la, ba kaa ja ba bala Israel tena la nɛɛ laa la ta, dɛ chwa ti ba dɛɛ yoo ba.
Gɛɛ a do Korowii lɛ Israel tena awola, asɛ ba ka yo dɛ ɡale Bɛt Avɛn.
Waa aa chiɡa laa la habɔɔ Lɔr kpo Israel tena ba ɡwɛɡre awola, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ ba bini bɛlbwa waa di kondikwaa mɔɔ wee le la, nyotaahna lawɛ naate mɔɔ ó tɔ o dɔma wel.
Anomanta, o laa tena la bɛlbwa ta kondikwaa dii.
Ba bwa kaa jo kɔr bɛl bini, dɛ tooh lɔ daa ta bobɛlbwa tohnoo kor dɛɛ lee.
Baa tel bela tohnoo la aa kora dɛɛ lee la, bɛlbwa ta ane kpɔe do nyoa, dɛkalkɛ ba ɔmɛ Kooro Sɔɔl nyotaahna la.
Kɛ dɛ Jonatan te ta noɛ kɛ o mɛɛ ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ bɛlbwa bɛ ɡel kondikwaa leɡe o nyoa.
O tɛr daŋɡbala do tohvaahna la ta dɛ di ane, buɡ la ta, o sie deŋu o dɔ bokpeɡa.
Belaa laa tena la bɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He mɛɛ ŋwɛɛrɔ dawɛ ya nɛɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa di kwaa fini naa, nyotaahna lawɔ.
A waa lɔr ɛɛ kpo yaa ya bwa ɡwɛɡre la.” Anee Jonatan ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ kpɔ waa aa wola were ba ta ya harɛ nɔ nɛra nɛ.
Na ɡɛ n bwara bini aa chaah mɛ, tooh tama maa dia nɔ nomanta.
Dɛ laa tena nɔ fe dɔ kondikwa baa paa laa ta le ba dɔma be nɔ ane di aa, ba bwara fe kpeɡri.
Filisti tena baa kpoora fe ta ken ɡwaalaa?” Awola tɔpere la, Israel tena kpoo Filisti tena le Mikmas ka tel bwɛjen Aejalɔn, dɛ ba bwa koɔh, lɔr ɡe kpo ba ba ɡwɛɡre.
Buɡ la ta, ba den ka su kwaa baa paa laa ta le ba dɔma be la ta dɛɛ kama, peera ne nae ne a bii, ba kpoora dɛ chɛwa buɡ la ta bela, dɛ chwea ane chal ɡɛ.
Anee nomɛl ka ŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl be ŋɔ, “Na, laa tena la dɛ chwe ol lwɛɛ ne chal, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.” Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “Hé ɛ nɛnchɔɡa kohona.
Hé ɡbili bwejen ba tɛ mɛ bonɔ warane.” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Hé jo ba bini dɛ́ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Bɛlbwa lawɛ o nao ne pee dɛ́ ba kpoa bwe nɔ ta.
He bɛ ol ne o chal di dɛ́ ba ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii nɛ.’ ” Anomanta, jwaana la ne, bɛlbwa ba o kon ne dɛ ba kpo bela.
Kooro Sɔɔl ma kon baa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii bela.
Onee ɛ saraha kon waa tɔ sie ma tɛ Korowii.
Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya ti Filisti tena la jwaana nɔ ne, dɛ́ ka tel bɔr chaahna saŋ, dɛ́ ka yoo ba dɛ́ pa ba laala.
Ya kpoo ba bwa, dɛ bɛ ba bini beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ɡel.” Anee ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa aa too he tea.” Kɛ sɔfo Ahija ɡe ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya bɔɔ le Korowii be ó baɡle ɡɛ yaa ɛ mɔɔ.” Anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl bɔɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ won la ka yo Filisti tena la kɛɛ?
Yaa won pɔ ba nɛ aa?” Kɛ Korowii ta on chaŋɛ awola tɔpere.
Kooro Sɔɔl yerɛ nomonome baa chɔ laa tena nyoa la bwa dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya cheme dɛ́ na wechɔɡa yaa ɛa fini.
N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa ɛ Israel tena Lɛɛ la kɛŋɔ, hale dɛ n bibaa Jonatan ɛ wechɔɡa ane kwaraa naa, a chɛ kɛ ó sewɛ.” Kɛ ba bini bɛlbwa ta waane bolɛ.
Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ Israel tena la bwa be ŋɔ, “He bwa ka che le, ásɛ n ne n bibaa Jonatan ɡe che bonɔ.” Asɛ ba bwa ŋɔ, “Ɛ ɡɛ bwa aa too he tea.” Kooro Sɔɔl soŋe Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ɡel n jemɛ waa nɔ kasinteŋ.” Asɛ ba bil daa a lawɛ o ne o bibaa Jonatan, asɛ nɛra la kar te, bie la ta ba tɔɔ.
Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ sɔfo Ahija be ŋɔ, “Berɛ bil daa n ne n bibaa Jonatan nyu ta ja, dɛ́ na naate waa ɛ wechɔɡa la.” Asɛ a lawɛ Jonatan.
Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl bɔɔ Jonatan ŋɔ, “Baɡ mɛ waa haa ɛa.” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “N daŋɡbala nyoa n kpɔ li tooh tama di, dɛɛ ba sewa taraken la.” Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “Dɛ hen Jonatan ta sewaa, Korowii bɛ men ɡel.” Kɛ nɛra la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Jonatan aa cheɡɛ o nɛɛ Israel tena bwa dɔ lɛɛ nɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ ó sewaa?
Akai, ya ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa aa won ɛo wobɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ Korowiirii chao o won ɛ waa waa ɛa fini nɔ.” Gɛɛ a do nɛra la lɛ Jonatan ba ta on kpoe.
Belaa Kooro Sɔɔl ɡel Filisti tena la tii, ba bwa berɛ kaa ba harɛ ta.
Kooro Sɔɔl aa baa di kora dɛɛ nyiŋi Israel tena nɛɛ la, o yo dɔma baa baro cheme la bwa.
Moab ne Amɔn tena ne Edom ne Soba koranar, dɛ Filisti tena.
Bobɛlbwa waa ka yo la, o dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
O yoo bambile bwa ne, dɛ pɔ Amalɛk tena nɛ, dɛ lɛ Israel tena, nomɛlbwa ta wone ba yoo ba kpa.
Kooro Sɔɔl haah ne o bii Kooro Sɔɔl bibaala waa lol ba laanee Jonatan ne Isvi dɛ Malki Sua.
O bihanomoa sɔne Merab asɛ bechala la ɡe Mikal.
Dɛ o haah sɔne Ahinoam, o nya ɛ Ahimas.
Kooro Sɔɔl laa nomoa sɔne Abna, o mɛɛ sɔne Nɛr, asɛ Nɛr ɛ Sɔɔl naara.
Abiel bibaalaa Sɔɔl mɛɛ Kes ne Abna mɛɛ Nɛr.
Kooro Sɔɔl soɡa bini bwa, o ne Filisti tena yo laa taeh.
Anomanta, o na banyoo bɛlbwa naa, ɡɛɛ o lawɔ ba ja o laa tena nɛ.
Korowii vɛɛh waa vɛh Sɔɔl kɛ kooro Samoɛl ŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl be ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii tomɛ n fuɡe noo do he nyu ta, dɛ cheɡe kooro tɛ o nɛra Israel tena.
Berɛ no waa aa le Korowii be taraken.
Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ tɛr Amalɛk tena deŋnee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba naawa teŋe Israel tena ŋwɛnɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt dɛɛ ba la.
Hé kaa taraken dɛ́ ka yo Amalɛk tena la, dɛ́ chɔɡ kwaa baa dɔa bwa kwaraa.
He bɛ ba sum na, hé kpoo baala ne haahna, ne bechale ne bechasɔɔhne, ne nae ne peera dɛ ba nyoɡmare ne keeɡore bwa.’ ” Anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl yerɛ o laa tena la cheme Telaim dɛ kur ba.
Ba lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ dɛ le Israel harɛ, asɛ kaɡboŋa fi ɡe le Juda harɛ ta.
Kooro Sɔɔl ne o laa tena la Amalɛk tena bwɛjen bɛl ta, dɛ ka sɔh chɔ fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini bar bwɛɛ la.
O kah Ken tena ba ne baa soɡa la ŋɔ, “Hé le Amalɛk tena la bini kaa, ásɛ n bɛ pɛ kpo he ne ban.
Israel tena aa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, hé nyin ba wa.” Asɛ Ken tena la le ba bini kaa.
Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl yo Amalɛk tena la le Havila harɛ ta ka tel Suur, o lɔ Ijipt wee leebɔr.
O lawɛ Amalɛk tena Kooro Aɡaɡ nɔn ne, dɛ kpoo o nɛra baa kaa la bwa ɡe.
Kooro Sɔɔl ne o laa tena la ɡel Kooro Aɡaɡ ne o peera ne nae ne nabali aa wera kohona, ne pebali ne nae bii dɛ koŋkwaa aa wera la te bwa.
Kwaa aa wera dɛ dɔ tɔnɔ la te, ba ɡela, kɛ anɔ la aa wola were la, ba chɔɡa.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ Samoɛl be ŋɔ, “A dɛ we n nɛɛ kɛ maa cheɡ Sɔɔl kooro, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta n waa ta teŋɛ dɛ vɛɛh mɛ.” Samoɛl liire chɔɡ ɡɛ waa nɔ waa kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ o wi no Korowii awola jwaana la bwa.
Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Samoɛl iro la ka ɡaaɡe Kooro Sɔɔl bɔr, asɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ó kaa Kaamɛl.
Asɛ o ma kon cheɡ bela o sɔn ta, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii laa waa yoa dɛ pɔ nɛra nɛɛ la wa, dɛ berɛ kaa Gelɡal.” Samoɛl aa tel o be la, Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ!
N ɛ waa Korowii aa do mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ la.” Anee Samoɛl ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa ɡe peera ne nae sii mɛɛ no ken?” Anee Kooro Sɔɔl chaŋe ŋɔ, “Laa tena laanee le ane Amalɛk tena be ba.
Ba ɡel peera aa wera kohona ne nae, dɛ́ ba kpoora ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la.
Kɛ kwaa aa wola were la te, ba kpoo a bwa sekwaraa.” Ate, Samoɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gel, ásɛ n baɡle waa Korowii aa bol n be dɛ jwaana ne.” Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “Bol ń no.” Samoɛl ŋɔ, “A lole kɛ he dɛ lii he te nɛnjeɡa, he laa bera ba ɛ Israel deene bwa nyu te nɔ naa?
Korowii fuɡe noo do he nyu ta, dɛ cheɡe kora ta Israel.
Waane le Korowii be ba he be kɛŋɔ, ‘Kaa dɛ́ ka chɔɡ Amalɛk nyubinikpeɡ tena la bwa sekwaraa.
Yoo ba ka tel kɛŋɔ haa he ba bwa.’ Ɛrɛɛ haa wola Korowii waa noɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he la ka kam kwaa baa paa laa ta dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa Korowii sie ken?” Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “N teŋɛ Korowii waa la ta.
Waa waa do mɛ a ta la, n ɛa.
N chɔɡ Amalɛk tena la bwa kwaraa.
Hale dɛ lawɛ ba Kooro Aɡaɡ nɔn ne, dɛ ba o ne.
Laa tena la larawe ba peera ne nae aa wera kohona, dɛ lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii laa la ta, dɛ́ ba a ne Gelɡal, dɛ́ kpoora ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la.” Kɛ Samoɛl chaŋo ŋɔ, “Korowii sie dɛ lɛ saraha baa fuah ne kwaa baa kpoora, ɡwaa kɛ haa no o deŋna wa aa?
Korowii deŋna waa noe wer ɡwaa kɛ haa kpo pedɛɛɡe ɛ saraha tɛo.
Dɛ he ɛ Korowii deŋnekpeɡ aa, a do kɛŋɔ haa dɛ tomɛ voɡa ken, bambikpeɡ ɡe do kɛŋɔ voɡa toma.
Haa vɛh Korowii waa la nomanta, o ɡe vɛɛh kooro.” Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ Samoɛl be ŋɔ, “N ɛ wechɔɡa, n vɛh Korowii waa waa do mɛ a ta, ne waa haa ŋɔa n ɛ la.
Ɔmaa n ɔmɛ nɛra la waa n teŋɛ waa baa dɛ nyin ta.
Taraken n dɛ soŋe kɛ he kpɔ n wechɔɡa kɛ mɛ, ásɛ n ne he berɛ kaa, ń kaa tomɛ Korowii.” Asɛ Samoɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N ne haa berɛ kaa.
He vɛh waa Korowii aa bola he be, asɛ o vɛɛh kɛŋɔ he ɛ kooro Israel tena nɛ.” Samoɛl aa bera dɛɛ ba kaala la, Kooro Sɔɔl tao lawɛ o batakaare nyoa asɛ o kɛɛ.
Anee Samoɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii chɔɡ Israel kora la kɛŋɔ batakaare nɔ dɛ le he nɔn ta fini, dɛ kpɔ tɛ he dɔŋ o wa aa wera ɡwaale.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la dɔ jirima, waa nyosone teŋe, waa o liire ɡe charɛ.
Nɛwɛnyini laa on ó charɛ o liire.” Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ɛ wechɔɡa te, kɛ ɡel ń dɔ duure Israel tena bwa ne ba nomonome sie.
Gel n ne he kaa, ásɛ n kaa tomɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la.” Gɛɛ a do Samoɛl ne Kooro Sɔɔl berɛ kaa o kaa tomɛ Korowii.
Samoɛl ŋɔ, “Hé ka kpɔ Amalɛk tena Kooro Aɡaɡ ba tɛ mɛ.” Anee Aɡaɡ lɔ bambile dɛ ba o be, dɛɛ lii ŋɔ, “N jemɔ taraken kɛ baa men kpo kpa.” Ate, Samoɛl berɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa kpoo bechale ba nyare paŋɛ bii la, ɡɛɛ he nya ɡe ɛɛ ba bie paŋa.” Asɛ Samoɛl kpo Kooro Aɡaɡ Korowii sie Gelɡal bela.
Ate, Samoɛl le bela dɛ kaa Rama, kɛ Kooro Sɔɔl te berɔ kaa o bwɛ Gebea.
Samoɛl ta Kooro Sɔɔl nae kpa, dɛ ka tel o serewe wee.
Dɛ o wio dɛɛ tɛo te.
A we Korowii nɛɛ kɛ waa cheɡo kora Israel.
Samoɛl fuɡe noo do Devid nyu ta o ɛ kooro Awola bɛl, Korowii ŋɔ Samoɛl be ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin he wi Sɔɔl ka tel, dɛ́ le vɛɛh maa vɛoh kɛ Israel kooro nɔɔ?
Do noo pebal nyeɡle ta, ásɛ dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta ń tomɛ Jese be Bɛtlɛham.
N le o bibaala la bini bɛl dɛ cheɡo kooro tɛ Israel tena.” Anee Samoɛl ŋɔ, “Dɛ n laŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl noɔ kɛ n ba bela aa, wɛɛ kpo mɛɛ.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Lawɛ nalor ásɛ he laŋaa, he ŋɔ he dɛ ba ba kpo ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii.” Yerɛ Jese ó ba saraha la bɔr.
Mɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ haa ɛ. Bɛl la háa fuɡe noo do o nyu ta la, dɛ onee n le kooro.
Samoɛl ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡlo la bwa.
Waa tel bwɛjen Bɛtlɛham la, bwɛɛ la nomonome ɔmɔ, dɛ kpɔ bochechela ka chemo dɛɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Deŋnesɔɔhna nee he ba tenaa?” Anee Samoɛl chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, deŋnesɔɔhna taa.
N balɔ dɛ́ ba kpo kon ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Hé sɔ he doŋa bwa ta Korowii be pera, dɛ́ ba ja n nɛɛ saraha la mun.” Ate, o sɔ Jese ne o bibaala doŋa bwa ta dɛ ta nɔn yer ba saraha la mun.
Baa tel bela la, Samoɛl na Eliab dɛ lii ŋɔ, “N jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn Korowii aa fuɡe noo do o nyu ta laanee cheɡɛ o sie bela nɔ.” Kɛ Korowii ŋɔ Samoɛl be ŋɔ, “Bɛ o jaŋne ne o wer nyiŋi, o laa mɛɛ nyin, n vɛoh.
Kwaa nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ nyiŋi la korɛ anɔ la Korowii aa dɛ nyiŋi ta.
Nɛwɛnyini dɛ nyiŋi siebɔr, kɛ Korowii te, nɛn bambile binii wɛɛ nyiŋi.” Ate, Jese yerɛ Abinadab dɛ ɡel o valɛ kpɔ Samoɛl sie ba kaa.
Asɛ Samoɛl ŋɔ, “Korowii ta onɔ ɡe leɛ.” Jese berɔ ɡel Samaa ɡe valɛ Samoɛl sie ba kaa.
Anee Samoɛl ŋɔ, “Korowii ta onɔ ɡe leɛ.” Jese ɡelɔ o bibaala banuanɛ bwa kpɔ Samoɛl sie ba kaa.
Anee Samoɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii ta ba bini bɛlbwa leɛ.” Samoɛl bɔɔ Jese ŋɔ, “He bibaala haa dɔa bwaa nɔ naa?” Anee o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ba bini bechala ta lole, kɛ o dɛ teɡɛ peera.” Anee Samoɛl ŋɔ, “Tomɛ bá ka yerɔ ba.
O ta balaa, ya ta saraha la ɛɛ.” Anomanta, o ɡelɔ ba ka yerɔ ba.
O mao dɛ do wer bonɔɔ, o siwinyiŋi ɡe do wer kɛrɛdɛ.
Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ́ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, onee ɛ nɛn maa leo.” Samoɛl kpɔ pebal nyeɡle noo aa lɔ o bini la fuɡe do Devid nyu ta ba siwi ta.
Dɛ onee Korowii le.
Le awola dɛɛ kaa la, Korowii Doma baa so o nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛ, asɛ Samoɛl berɛ kaa Rama.
Devid lɔ Kooro Sɔɔl dem dɛɛ tomɔ Dɛ Korowii Doma la le Kooro Sɔɔl nɛ, asɛ o ɡel kwaa ir o nɛɛ dɛ ɡel o bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ.
Kooro Sɔɔl bonɔɔna la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Na ɡɛ kwaa aa ir he nɛɛ dɛɛ doe bonyɛɡa ta ɡɛ.
Ya naa kooro, tomɛ bonɔɔna bá ka nyin nɛn waa jemɛ janjela lɔe.
O baa lɔ, ásɛ dɛ kwaa ir he nɛɛ aa, he bwara ɛɛ sɔɔhnee.” Anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl tomɛ o bonɔɔna la ŋɔ, “Hé la ka nyin nɛn waa jemɛ janjela lɔe kɛrɛdɛ ba tɛ mɛ.” Belaa bonɔɔna la bɛl chaŋe ŋɔ, “N na Jese bibaa bɛl, o lɔ Bɛtlɛham dɛ jemɛ janjela lɔe.
O ɛ banyoo, o bambile ɡe do kpeɡri, o jemɛ wobol dɛ do wer bonɔɔ ɡe.
Asɛ Korowii ja o nɛ.” Kooro Sɔɔl tomɛ nɛra Jese be ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe, ɡel he bibaa Devid waa dɛ teɡɛ peera la ba n be.” Anomanta, Jese kpɔ keeɡo, dɛ kpɔ paanoo ne oltɔn pur sen aa suu, ne bombie ja ŋɔ Devid kpɔ ka tɛ Kooro Sɔɔl.
Devid la Kooro Sɔɔl be dɛ kaa tomɔ.
Dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl sie dɛ lɛ o nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ɡel wɛɛ che o dɔmkwa.
Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl ɡel ba ka ŋɔ Jese be ŋɔ, “Gel Devid so n be dɛɛ tom mɛ, n sie dɛ lɛ o nɛ.” Le bela dɛɛ kaa la, saŋ bɛlbwa kwa aa ba ir Sɔɔl nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ Devid yon kpɔ o janjela lɔ, asɛ a le o nɛɛ o bwara sɔɔhno.
Devid ne Goliat A balɔ kɛŋɔ Filisti tena lawɛ ba laa tena cheme Soko waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta.
Ba kaa baŋre ba tɛnte deene bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Efes Damim, o lɔ Soko ne Aseka baah ta.
Kooro Sɔɔl ne Israel tena la chemo, dɛ baŋre ba tɛnte deene Ɛla Fɛlembɔjen bini, ásɛ ba ne Filisti tena ka yo.
Filisti tena la cheɡɛ deŋɡare bɛl ta baŋ bɛl, asɛ Israel tena ɡe che bɛl ta, fɛlembɔjen la chɔ ba baah ta.
Dɛ Filisti tena banyoo bɛl sɔne Goliat, o le Gat.
O jaŋne ɡwaa naɡale anuanaarɛ, o le bela Filisti tena aa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la bini ba che.
Ayaawaa ba kpɔ ɛ o ɡbɛrɛ, o laa batakaare ɡe ɛ ayaawa, a tɔɡre lɔ suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋa anue.
Ayaawaa ba kpɔ ɛ kwaa bɔle o nakpale, asɛ ayaawa lampea saɡɛ o vam ta.
O lampea daa bare do kɛŋɔ yasɔɔh kokorowa ken, o nyoa buni tɔɡre ɡe lɔ suuɡapoŋa lafraanumɛl.
Nɛn waa kpoŋe kon waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ o te ɡbemɡbe tɔ o sie.
Goliat iro che, dɛ nyɛɡ Israel laa tena nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hé ba che bonɔ dɛɛ nyin kɛ hé ba yo yaa nɔɔ?
Filisti te laa men asɛ he ɡe ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bonɔɔna aa?
Hé le nɛmbeŋkpoŋ, ásɛ o ba puu mɛ yo.
Dɛ o wono yoo mɛ dɛ kpo mɛ naa, yaa ba do he lɔɡaa dɛɛ tomɛ heya.
Kɛ dɛ menee pɔ o nɛɛ dɛ kpoo ɡe aa, hɛɛ ba do ya lɔɡaa dɛɛ tomɛ yaa.
Fini tɔpere nɔ, he jeɡa n siwi ta kwaraa!
Hé nyiŋi he Israel tena bini bwa, dɛ́ le baa waa won ba che ásɛ n ne ó yo.” Baa no waa Filisti te la aa bola la, Kooro Sɔɔl ne Israel tena la bambile teŋo kɛrɛdɛ.
Devid mɛɛ sɔne Jese.
O le Efrat waa lɔ Bɛtlɛham, Juda harɛ ta.
Jese bibaala lɔ banuatoro.
Gɛ saŋ Kooro Sɔɔl aa di kora Israel la, dɛ o hwɛɛhrɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Jese bibanomonome batoro teŋɛ Kooro Sɔɔl nɛɛ kaa laa la ta.
Biloɡle la sɔne Eliab, nɛɛte la Abinadab, toorote ɡe Samaa.
Ba bwa kaloɡee Devid.
Nomonome batoro la ɡe teŋɛ Kooro Sɔɔl nɛ, kɛ Devid yon le Kooro Sɔɔl be kaa Bɛtlɛham dɛ́ ka teɡɛ o mɛɛ peera tama, dɛ́ yon berɛ ba.
Tɔpera fifraanaarɛ, chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra bwaa Goliat waa ɛ Filisti te la yon le ba che, dɛɛ muɡli Israel tena la baah.
Awola bɛl, Jese ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ boyuhala kuruware fi ne paanoo fi nɔ chwa warane ka tɛ he dɔɔranar bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so la.
Kpɔ waɡasi fi nɔ ka tɛ ba laa nomoa la ɡe, ásɛ dɛ dɔ waane ba bol n be á baɡle kɛ he dɔɔranar ta waane doe.
Ba ne Kooro Sɔɔl ne laa tena la bwa lɔ Ɛla Fɛlembɔjen la bini, ba ne Filisti tena ɛɛ yo.” Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Devid ɡel peera la tɛ peteɡre bɛl, dɛ kpɔ o bone chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa, ɡɛ o mɛɛ aa ŋɔa la.
Waa tel bela baa soɡa la, dɛ laa tena la ɡe deno le dɛɛ kaa bela baa dɛ la ka yo laa la, dɛɛ dooɡe laa lɔŋɔre.
Israel laa tena la kaa che, asɛ Filisti laa tena ɡe ka che ba bɔr, ba bwa sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa.
Devid kpɔ o kondikwaa ja nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi ba laala ta la, dɛ chwa kaa o dɔɔranar be laa la ta, dɛ ka na ɡɛ baa doa.
Waa la ba be o ne baa bol waa la, Filisti tena kpeɡnɛn waa le Gat baa yerɔ Goliat la suuhno ba sie, dɛ kpɔ nyɛɡa dɛɛ muɡli ba baah, asɛ Devid no.
Israel tena la aa na Goliat la, ba jum jaoh dɛ bwa chwa le o sie.
Name dɛ Israel tena la dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ baa nɔ aa naa dɛɛ ba ya be nɔ kenɛ?
O balɔ dɛ baa muɡli ya Israel tena baah.
Nomɛlbwa waa won kpo baa nɔ la, kooro ɛɛ tɛo kondɔɔh kohonaa.
Wɛɛ berɔ lawɛ o bihaah tɛo ó mo, ásɛ dɛ ɡel naate mɛɛ nɛra ɡel toɔ bɔe Israel harɛ ta.” Anee Devid bɔɔ nɛra baa cheɡɛ o jwɛɛh la ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛl wono kpo Filisti baa nɔ dɛ le Israel tena sihiih nɔ ta naa, bɔkwaa wɛɛ ba dɔe yɔ?
Umee Filisti te nɔ waa wola Korowii tomɛ, dɛ ɡe won dɛɛ muɡli Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa laa tena baah nɔɔ?” Ba berɔ bol waa ba fa aa dɛ bol o be ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ baa ba ɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ba wona kpo Goliat.” Devid dɔɔ nomoa Eliab aa noa kɛŋɔ Devid ne baala la dɛ bol waa la, o baah di o nɛ, dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin bonɔ nɔ?
Umee he kpɔ peera la kabora ja pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela wɛɛ nyiŋi a ta nɔ?
N jemɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ ɡɔɔ he te, ne ɡɛ he bambile aa kpeɡa, he balɔ dɛ́ ba nyiŋi laa nɔ.” Devid ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa n ɛɔ?
N bɛ waa ɡe bolaa?” O berɔ bɔɔ nɛnfala waa o fa aa bɔɔ baala la, asɛ ba chaŋo ɡɛ baa chaŋo wubwa la.
Baala bane no waa Devid aa bola la, dɛ la ka bol Kooro Sɔɔl be, asɛ o ɡel ba yerɛ Devid tɛo.
Asɛ Devid ŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl be ŋɔ, “Bɛlbwa bɛ ɡel o bambile chɔɡ Filisti te nɔ wa, men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ ɛɛ lao dɛ́ ka yoo.” Kooro Sɔɔl chaŋo ŋɔ, “Bechalaa hen, haa won ka puu yo.
O bonɔɔne saŋ bwaa o le dɛɛ yo.” Kɛ Devid ŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he bonɔɔ dɛ teɡɛ o mɛɛ peera, dɛ nyujente kɛɛ sisire baa lawɛ bɛl dɛɛ kaa laa, n dɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ dɛ́ yo, dɛ́ lɛo le o be.
O berɛ sie dɛɛ ba n be naa, n dɛ hamɛ o baŋa dɛ́ lɔɔro kpo.
Gɛ Korowii aa ɡela he bonɔɔ won kpo nyujente ne sisire kwaraa la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba Filisti te waa wola Korowii tomɛ nɔ ɡe ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la sisawa.
Korowii waa lɛɛ mɛ le nyujente ne sisire nɔn ta la, wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ le Filisti te nɔ nɔn ta.” Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “Kaa, Korowii ja he nɛ.” Asɛ Sɔɔl kpɔ o ɡbaɡba laa batakaare ne kwaa waa kpɔa dɛɛ yo do Devid, dɛ kpɔ o ayaawa ɡbɛrɛ piu.
Devid kpɔ o laa kere sɛɡle laa batakaare la ta, dɛ kpɔ valɛ bar tama, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ɡɛ laala ta on manɛ.
O ŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl be ŋɔ, “Maa won valɛ ane, n ta ane doe bwa,” anomanta, o foo laala la bil.
O kpɔ o daŋɡbala kpoŋe, dɛ tɔɔ bwea a bwara aa loɡa anue le fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, dɛ kpɔa do o pur bini, dɛ kpoŋe o vamtor, asɛ dɛ suuh dɛɛ tel Filisti te la.
Dɛ Goliat ne o bonɔɔ waa tɔ o sie dɛ kpoŋe kon waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ o te ɡbemɡbe la, ɡe pa mun valɛ dɛɛ ba Devid be.
Waa na Devid la, o nyiŋu vah, dɛ na kɛ o jeɡa o siwi ta dɛ do wer bonɔɔ.
O bɔɔ Devid ŋɔ, “Nyoatee men he kpoŋe daa dɛɛ ba n be naa?” Asɛ o ŋwɛɛ voɡa ta Devid nɛɛ dɛ taahno.
“Ba bonɔ, mɛɛ kpoe ásɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola di he ola!” Anee Devid ŋɔ Goliat be ŋɔ, “Kere ne lampeaa he kpoŋe dɛɛ ba ba yoo mɛ, kɛ n te Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro wɛɛ teŋɛ Israel laa tena nɛɛ he nyiŋu dɛɛ vah la sɔn nee mɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yoi.
Fini tɔpere nɔ, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔe do n nɔn taa, ásɛ n kpoe dɛ́ teŋe he nyu.
Ásɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola ba di he ne Filisti laa tena bwa ola, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la lole.
Nɛra baa cheme bonɔ bwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ kere kɛɛ lampea ne laa Korowii ɛɛ lɛ nɛn, yoi la ɛ Korowii kon, wɛɛ kpɔ he bwaa do ya nɔn ta.” Goliat aa suuhna dɛɛ tel dɛ́ ba yoo la, Devid chwao ka puu bela baa dɛ ba yoi la warane.
Devid do nɔn pur bini dɛ kpɔ bwe do vamtor la ta, dɛ kile o ka forɛ Goliat tile.
Bwe la joɔ kaa bini, asɛ o chole kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Gɛɛ a do, Devid kpo Goliat vamtor bwe ne, dɛ kere ne laa.
Ate, Devid chwa kaa Goliat be, dɛ ka laa o kere pamɛ le o tɔɔ ta, dɛ teŋe o nyu.
Filisti laa tena aa naa kɛŋɔ ba banyoo sewɔ la, ba berɔ, dɛ chwa kaa.
Name, Israel ne Juda tena laa tena moo teŋɛ Filisti tena nɛ ka tel Gat ne Ekron doonyoo.
Filisti tena la sewɔ chɔ perɛ le bwɛjen Saaraim ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ kaa Gat ne Ekron.
Israel tena la aa ti Filisti tena la dɛ berɛ ba la, ba la bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so la, dɛ ka pa ba laala.
Devid kpɔ Goliat nyu ba Jerusalam, dɛ kpɔ o dɔmkwaa la ba bil o tɛnte dea bini.
Gɛ saŋ Kooro Sɔɔl aa nyiŋi Devid o le dɛɛ la ka yo Goliat la, o bɔɔ Abna waa ɛ laa sitɔɔ la ŋɔ, “Ume bie bonɔɔ nɔɔ?” Ate, Abna chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, maa o wobɛlbwa jemɛ.” Asɛ Kooro la ŋɔ, “Ka bɔɔ dɛ́ jemɛ naate o bie aa ɛo.” Devid aa kpo Goliat dɛ den baa jo la, Abna lawɔ dɛ ba o ne Kooro Sɔɔl sie dɛ o ta kpoŋe o nyu la.
Kooro Sɔɔl bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bonɔɔ, ume bie hen nɔ?” Anee Devid chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, he bonɔɔ Jese waa le Bɛtlɛham la biee men.”
Kooro Sɔɔl we Devid bwara Devid ne Kooro Sɔɔl baa bol waa tonɛ, asɛ Jonatan sie lɛ Devid nɛ, asɛ o ne o kpɔ darame wɛɛ nyinu kɛ o ɡbaɡba ken.
Le awola tɔpere la, Kooro Sɔɔl ɡelɔ Devid do o sie dɛɛ tomɔ, o ta ɡelɛ o kaa o mɛɛ dem kpa.
Jonatan ne Devid vɔwɛ darame fɔo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o dɛ nyin o waa kɛ o ɡbaɡba.
Jonatan foo o batakaare waa doa, ne o laa batakaare tɛ Devid, hale o kere ne o to, dɛ o kiriso.
Kooro Sɔɔl tomɛ Devid ŋɔ ó ka ɛ wobɛlbwa naa, o dɛ ɛa kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, o ɛo o laa nomonjena la bini bɛl.
Gɛ waa nɔ lɛ Kooro Sɔɔl nomonome ne o nɛra bwa sie.
Devid aa kpo Goliat asɛ laa tena la berɛ dɛɛ kaa dem la, haahna le Israel bwɛɛre bwa ta ba cheme Kooro Sɔɔl.
Ba yiiɡi loŋa, dɛ lɔ janjela silɛɛ ne dɛɛ sa.
Baa saa dɛɛ hɛɡre la, ba ɡo yela ŋɔ, “Kooro Sɔɔl kpo nɛra kaɡboŋa, Devid ɡe kpo nɛra kaɡboŋa fi.” Gɛ waa nɔ ta Kooro Sɔɔl som doe, o baah di dɛ ŋɔ, “Ba ŋɔ Devid kpo nɛra kaɡboŋa fi, asɛ n te kpo nɛra kaɡboŋ ɡbo.
Onee baa ba lawa cheɡ kora ta.” Le awola dɛɛ kaa la, Kooro Sɔɔl pa mun fome siwi pa Devid nɛ dɛɛ weo bwara.
Tɔ aa pera la, Korowii ɡelɔ kwaa ir Kooro Sɔɔl nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛ, o do dem dɛɛ bol waa kɛŋɔ choɡla te ken.
Dɛ Devid ɡe soɡo dɛɛ lɔ o janjela kɛ wubwa la, anɔ te la dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl kpoŋe lampea.
O ta lampea la dɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ yaɡɛ Devid nɔɔ pɛl danjwɛ.” O ta lampea la kera anɛ, kɛ Devid ke o te, o ta on dɔe.
Dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl dɛ ɔmɛ Devid dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ɡelo dɛ ka ja Devid nɛ.
Anomanta, o ɡelɔ Devid kaa tɔ o laa tena kaɡboŋ sie, dɛɛ la bane laa.
Korowii aa ja Devid nɛɛ nomanta, wobɛlbwa waa ɛ́ la, dɛ a maɡrɔ tɛo.
Kooro Sɔɔl aa naa kɛŋɔ o wobɛlbwa wer dɛɛ tɛo la, dɛ o dɛ ɔmɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Kɛ dɛ Israel ne Juda tena bwa dɛ nyin Devid wa, waa tɔ ba sie dɛ kpɔ ba dɛɛ la laa a maɡre dɛɛ tɛɛ ba la wa.
Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “N lawɛ n bihanomoa baa dɛ yerɔ Merab dɛɛ tɛɛ hé mo.
Dɛ hɛɛ dɛɛ tom mɛɛ, dɛ́ yo Korowii laa kasinteŋ ta dɛɛ tɛo tenaa.” Kooro Sɔɔl liiro kɛŋɔ anɔ taa aa ba cheɡa Filisti tena kpoo, kɛ o ɡbaɡba laa dɛ́ kpoo.
Ate, Devid ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Umee n ɡeɔ?
Israel dejen besoo taa n le dɛ́ ɛ kooro hela ɔ?” Aa baa tel kɛ ba kpɔ Kooro Sɔɔl bihaah Merab tɛ Devid ó mo la, ba kpɔɔ tɛ Adreɛl waa le Mehola.
Dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bihaah bɛl ɡe baa dɛ yerɔ Mikal dɛ nyin Devid.
Baa bol Kooro Sɔɔl be a waa la, o sie lɛo.
Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl lii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ Mikalee tɛo, dɛ́ kpɔ harɔ bel, ásɛ Filisti tena la dɔɔ kpo.” Anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “He dɔ bɔr nɛɛtena name kɛ he ɛ n hela.” Belaa Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o nomonome be ŋɔ, “Hé yerɛ Devid le bokɛre dɛ́ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Na, kooro sie dɛ lɛ he nɛ, o nomonome la bwa ɡe ɛɛ nyin he waa kɛŋɔ hé ɛ o hela.’ ” Ba kaa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ Devid be.
Anee o ŋɔ, “Hé dɛ lii kɛ a ɛ wekokori kɛ nɛn ɛ kooro hela kɛɛ?
Nyaaree men, n ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre.” Kooro Sɔɔl nomonome la aa kaa bol waa Devid aa bola o be la, o ŋɔ, “Hé ka ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ kooro aa komɛlbwa nyin dɛ́ tɛ hanfale la ka ja Filisti tena lafa baa serewa pena tɔne, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ ba kem.” Kooro Sɔɔl ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ Filisti tena la dɔ Devid kpo.
Nomonome la aa baa bol Devid be la, o sie lɛo kɛ ó ɛ kooro hela.
Anomanta, mɔɔ hanfalwaa la tel la, Devid ne o laa tena leɔ kaa dɛ ka kpoo Filisti tena lafraanɛ.
O ba nɛra pena tɔne kooro aa ŋɔa o dɛ nyin la ne, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ o ɛ kooro hela.
Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl lawɛ o bihaah Mikal tɛo o mo.
Kooro Sɔɔl aa naa kɛŋɔ Korowii ja Devid nɛɛ, asɛ o bihaah la ɡe ɛɛ nyinu la, dɛ name kwaraa Kooro Sɔɔl ɛɛ ɔmɔ kohona.
O kpɔ Devid ɛ o dɔm o soɡa bini bwa.
Filisti laa nomonome teŋɔ kpɔ ba laa tena dɛɛ la laa, kɛ saŋ bɛlbwa ba ne Devid aa yo la, o dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Devid lɛ sɔn kohona, dɛkalkɛ Kooro Sɔɔl laa nomonome bwa bini la, dɛ onee yo laa dɛ kpoo nɛra kohona.
Kooro Sɔɔl dɛ nyin Devid kpoe Awola bɛl, Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o bibaa Jonatan ne o nomonome be ŋɔ bá kpo Devid.
Kɛ dɛ Jonatan dɛ nyin Devid waa taeh, asɛ Jonatan kah Devid ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ dɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ kpoe.
Dɛɛ nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ, kere chɔɔ nyin bobɛl waa sɔah dɛ́ chwa ka so bela.
N ne n mɛɛ ɛɛ ka che bela haa ka sɔh laanee, ásɛ n bol he waa baɡlo, ásɛ dɛ o bol waane aa, ń ba bol he be.” Jonatan bol Devid bwara wedɛɛɡe baɡle o mɛɛ Kooro Sɔɔl dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɛ he bonɔɔ Devid wechɔɡa ɛ, o ta hen wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, waa waa ɛa la ɡe chae kohona.
O sɛh seo dɛ ka pu Goliat yo dɛ kpoo.
Korowiirii ɡela o yo tɛ he ne Israel tena bwa, asɛ he bwa sie lɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona kpo nɛndɛɛɡe waa do ken pɛɛpɛɛ ɔ?” Kooro Sɔɔl no o bibaa Jonatan waa la dɛ ŋwɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, maa Devidii kpo.” Anomanta, Jonatan yerɛ Devid dɛ bol waa la bwa o be.
O lawɔ ba Kooro Sɔɔl be asɛ o ne o so kɛ wubwa la.
Laa berɔ ba chole ja, asɛ Devid la dɛ ka yo Filisti tena la.
O kpoo ba kɛrɛdɛ, ba kar bwa ɡe chwa kaa.
Kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ kwaa ir Kooro Sɔɔl nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛ, dɛ o soɡe o dem dɛ kpoŋe lampea.
Dɛ Devid ɡe dɛ lɔ o janjela, asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl fe ɛɛ nyin o yaɡɔ marɛ danjwɛɛ ta, asɛ o ke o te lampea la ka yaɡɛ danjwɛɛ la ta.
Awola jwaana la, Devid chwao le dem bela.
Kooro Sɔɔl tomɛ bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá la Devid dem jwaana ka kpaahno, ásɛ bɔr ne chaahna la dɛ ba kpoo.
Kɛ Devid haah Mikal kaoh ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ta bɔr nyine dɛ chwa jwaana nɔ ne naa, tɔɔ ne pera dɛ ba kpoe.” Anomanta, Mikal cha Devid o kpɔ tokoro ta, dɛ tu bwɛɛ la dahara chwa kaa.
Mikal kpɔ yal fɔrɔwe ba buse bela voɡ dɛ kpɔ bil mpa ta, dɛ kpɔ booh pona bil o nyu bɔr.
Kooro Sɔɔl aa tomɛ o bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá ka lawɛ Devid ba la, Mikal ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “O bwara dɛ weo.” Anee Kooro Sɔɔl berɛ tom ba Devid be ja ŋɔ, “Hé la ka kpɔɔ le o mpa ta ba tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n kpoo.” Kɛ bonɔɔna la aa laŋa dɛ ka jo dea la, dɛ voɡ bɛl chɔ mpa la ta asɛ boohpona ane chɔ o nyu bɔr.
Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o bie Mikal be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he neɡ mɛ dɛ ɡel n dɔm dɔ bɔr chwa kaa ken?” Mikal chaŋe ŋɔ, “O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ n ta on chae o dɔ bɔr kaa laa, wɛɛ kpo mɛɛ.” Devid aa chwaa kaa la, o kaa Samoɛl be Rama dɛ ka bol ɡɛ Kooro Sɔɔl aa kpɔa ɛo bwa.
Ate, o ne Samoɛl kaa Nayɔt, dɛ ka so bela.
Belaa Kooro Sɔɔl aa noa kɛŋɔ, Devid lɔ Nayɔt waa lɔ Rama la, o tomɛ o bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá la ka lawɔ.
Baa laŋa la, ba nao kɛŋɔ Korowii keamere aa wara dɛɛ bol Korowii wa, asɛ Samoɛl tɔ ba sie.
Belaa Korowii Doma ba so Sɔɔl bonɔɔna la nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛ, asɛ ba ɡe ɛɛ bol waa la ane dɛɛ sa.
Ba kaa bol Kooro Sɔɔl be a wa, asɛ o berɛ tomɛ bonɔɔna la bane ja, ba ɡe ba bol Korowii waa la ane dɛɛ sa.
Kooro Sɔɔl tomɛ bonɔɔna toorotena, ba ɡe ka bol Korowii waa dɛɛ sa.
Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ɡbaɡba chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa Rama, dɛ ka tel kɔlɔŋ bɛl waa lɔ bwɛɛ Seku.
Asɛ o bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Leperaa Samoɛl ne Devid dɔɔ?” Ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ba lɔ Nayɔt waa lɔ Rama la.” Anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl la Nayɔt waa lɔ Rama asɛ Korowii Doma ba so o ɡe nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛ, o valɛ bol Korowii waa la dɛɛ sa ka tel kɛŋɔ waa tel Nayɔt.
O foo o laala dɛ ka che Samoɛl sie, dɛɛ bol Korowii waa la dɛɛ sa.
O chɔ mumɡbal ɡɛ tɔpebir la bwa, webaŋa ne jwaana.
A waa nɛra yon dɛɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Kooro Sɔɔl ɡe ja Korowii keamere la nɛɛ kɛɛ?”
Devid ne Jonatan Anee Devid chwa le Nayɔt waa lɔ Rama dɛ la Jonatan be ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa n ɛɔ?
N wechɔɡaa ame o?
Bɔkwaa n ɛ he mɛɛ wɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo nɔɔ?” Jonatan chaŋo ŋɔ, “Akai, Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛ he sewɛ!
Dɛ n mɛɛ ɛɛ ɛ wejena kɛɛ wejeɡa bɛlbwa kwaraa yaa, o ɡelɔ mɛɛ jemɛ a bini.
Waa kpɔ sɔɔh mɛ.
A ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ.” Anee Devid ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, “He mɛɛ jemɔ kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin he wa, asɛ o lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, ‘Jonatan ta chɛ kɛ ó jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ, ɡɛ laa aa, o bambile ɛɛ chɔɡoo.’ N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ kɛŋɔ, n ne seo baah aa jaŋɛ kpa.” Jonatan ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “Komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin kɛ ń ɛ la, mɛɛ ɛo tɛɛ.” Ate Devid ŋɔ, “Keree Korobifale Tɔpejen, a chɛ kɛ n ne kooro di kwa.
Kɛ ɡel ń chwa ka sɔh kpɔɡ bini ka tel kerele jɔmɔra.
Dɛ he mɛɛ ta men ba nae yaa, he ŋɔ, ‘Devid soŋ mɛ, n tɛo ŋwɛnɛ o ɛ warane kaa o bwɛɛ Bɛtlɛham, dɛkalkɛ o lolanar bwa dɛ ba kwaa kpoora ɛ benanyoa saraha.’ Dɛ o sɛoh waa, ate mɛɛ dɔ n nyuu.
Kɛ dɛ o baah diu waa, dɛ he jemɔ kɛŋɔ o dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo.
He te sune men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ nɛ, ásɛ dɛ teŋɛ fɔo n ne haa fɔwa Korowii sie la ta.
Dɛ n di bolchɔɡe aa, he ɡbabir den kpo mɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ he kpɔ mɛ tɛ he mɛɛ ɔ?” Jonatan ŋɔ, “Akai, dɛ n noɔ tamaa bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ n mɛɛ siwi beɡrɔ wɛɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo aa, n fe ta he be bolaa?” Anee Devid bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Dɛ he mɛɛ baah diu o ta sɛɛh yaa, umee dɛ́ bol n be nɔ?” Jonatan ŋɔ, “Ba ya kaa kpɔɡ bini.” Asɛ ba bwa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ kaa.
Ate, Jonatan ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ɛ ya bwa danseɛ.
Kerele saŋ nɔ bɔr, mɛɛ bɔɔ n mɛɛ waa nɔɔ, dɛ o ta liichɔɡa bɛlbwa dɔe he nɛ aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo he no.
Dɛ n mɛɛ dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpoe naa, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛ dɛ n ta he be bolɛ dɛ ɡel he dɔ bɔr chwa aa, Kórowii tɛr n deŋne kohona.
Korowiirii dɛ́ ja he nɛɛ ɡɛ waa ja he mɛɛ nɛɛ la.
Kɛ dɛɛ nyin mɛ kohona n soɡa bini bwa ɡɛ Korowii aa nyini la, ásɛ ba bɛ men kpo.
Baɡle ɡɛ nyina la n lolanar nɛ, ásɛ dɛ Korowii chɔɡ n dɔma bwa le harɛ nɔ ta kwaraa naa.
Bɛ ɡel fɔo n ne haa fɔwa la chɔɡ.
A ba ɡɛ naa Korowii ɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee.” Jonatan ɡelɔ Devid berɛ kwaa baɡɛ nyoa kɛ wɛɛ dɛɛ nyin o waa kohonaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o dɛ nyin Devid waa kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba ken.
Ate, Jonatan ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “Korobifale Tɔpejen dii kere, baa hen na, he kara ɛɛ che pɛɛ.
Le kere jɔmɔra bɔr la, berɛ kaa bela haa kaa sɔh ɡɛ saŋ waa nɔ aa pa mun la, dɛ́ sɔh Esel bwetal la jwɛh.
Mɛɛ ta hɛma atoroo yaɡɛ o keŋkeŋ kɛŋɔ maa dɛ nyin komɛl dɛ́ yaɡɛ ken.
Mɛɛ tomɛ n bonɔɔnee dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘La ka ɡaaɡe hɛma la bɔr.’ Dɛ n ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Na, hɛma la lɔ he baŋ bonɔ, kpɔa ba bonɔ naa,’ a dɛ baɡle kɛ he dɔ he nyu name, ásɛ he le ba.
N ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ dɛ ɔmee bɛlbwa toole kpa.
Kɛ dɛ n ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Hɛma la lɔ he sideŋ bela aa,’ amɔ le kaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ŋɔa ŋɔ he kaa, ásɛ he lii waa n ne haa bola la, Korowii ɛ ya bwa danseɛ, á do ya baah saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Devid sɔh kpɔɡ bini bela asɛ Korobifale Tɔpejen la dii aa tela la, Kooro Sɔɔl ka so dɛɛ ba kwaa dii.
Kooro soɡo pɛl danjwɛ bela waa ɛ o soŋnibɔr, asɛ Jonatan so o sie chaɡɔ, Abna ɡe so teŋɛ Kooro Sɔɔl nɛ, kɛ dɛ Devid sobɔr la te chɔ pɛɛ.
Awola tɔpere la, Kooro Sɔɔl ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ, dɛ o dɛ lii ŋɔ, “Waane ken ka chiɡ Devid nɛɛ dɛ ɡel o kah doŋa waa wola won ba Tɔpejen nɔ dii ta.” Tɔ aa pera Korobifale Tɔpejen tɔpenɛɛte ta la, dɛ Devid sobɔr la chɔ pɛɛ ja.
Anee Kooro Sɔɔl bɔɔ o bibaa Jonatan ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa bala Jese bibaa la aa wola kondikwaa nɔ bɔr balɛ dɛ ne fini bwa nɔɔ?” Asɛ Jonatan chaŋe ŋɔ, “Devid soŋ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ o dɛ la Bɛtlɛham.
O ŋɔ ń tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó kaa, dɛkalkɛ o lolanar kpo kwaa dɛɛ ba saraha ɛɛ ba bwɛ, asɛ o dɔɔ wa ta nɔn yerɔ ŋɔ ó ba.
Dɛ n nao kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin o wa aa, n tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó la ka na o lolanar.
A waa haa wola on o sobɔr nae la.” Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl baah di Jonatan nɛ dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bie o nya deŋne aa kpeɡa o waa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe kohona!
N nao kɛŋɔ he ne Jese bibaa bwa nyoa pɛo dɛ́ kpɔ sihiih kpo he ɡbaɡba ne he nya.
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Devid taa soɡe le nɔ, haa won ɛ kooro ya harɛ nɔ ta naa?
Kaa taraken dɛ́ ka kpɔɔ ba bonɔ, a chɛ kɛ ó sewɛ.” Asɛ Jonatan bɔɔ o mɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo wɔ?
Bɔkwa waa o ɛɔ?” Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl ta o lampea ŋɔ, ó kpo Jonatan.
A ɡelɔ o jemɛ kɛŋɔ o mɛɛ siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ó kpo Devid kpela.
Jonatan iro o baah di kohona o le teebur ta, a ɡɛ Korobifale Tɔpejen la tɔpenɛɛte la ta.
O ta kwaa dii, dɛkalkɛ a dɛ we o nɛ, sihihwaa o mɛɛ aa ɛa dɛ chɛɡre Devid la.
Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Jonatan kaa kpɔɡ bini dɛ ka cheme Devid, dɛ bechala bɛl ja o nɛ.
Asɛ o ŋɔ bie la be ŋɔ, “Chwa dɛ́ ka ɡaaɡe hɛma maa taa la bɔr.” Bie la aa chwaa dɛɛ kaa la, dɛ Jonatan tao dɛɛ ta o sie.
Bie la aa tel bela hɛm la aa kaa le la, Jonatan nyɛɡ o nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hɛm la chɔ he sideŋ.” Anee o kɔr bie la ŋɔ, “Ɛ warane kaa.
Bɛ che!” Bie la kaa kpɔ hɛm la dɛ berɛ ba o nomoa be.
Dɛ bechala la aa waa nɔ bɛlbwa bini jemɛ, Jonatan ne Devid ɡboo jema.
Jonatan kpɔ o dɔmkwaa la choɡ bie la ŋɔ ó kpɔ kaa dem.
Bie la aa kaala la, Devid iro le Esal bwetal o fa aa kaa sɔh o ta la ta, dɛ ba ɡuŋi Jonatan sie, dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ kera atoro.
Asɛ ba ɡbaa dɔŋa pɛl ba te, dɛ bwa ɛɛ wi, kɛ Devid wii laanee ɡwaala.
Jonatan ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “Kaa deŋnesɔɔhna ne, ya bwa ŋwɛɛrɔ Korowii sɔn ta ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɛ ya danseɛ dɛ́ chɔ le tɛ n ne hen, he naanar ne n ɡe naanar baah saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’ ” Belaa Devid kaa asɛ Jonatan ɡe berɛ kaa bwɛɛ la ta.
Devid chwao le Kooro Sɔɔl be Devid la sɔfo Ahemɛlɛk be Nɔb.
Sɔfo Ahemɛlɛk aa nao la, o leɔ ba chemo, dɛ o bwara dɛ sa, asɛ Ahemɛlɛk bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɡbo ɛɛ valɛ nɔɔ?
Bɔkwa waa nomɛlbwa ta he nɛɛ jae yɔ?” Devid chaŋe sɔfo Ahemɛlɛk ŋɔ, “Kooro Sɔɔl tom mɛ waane ta dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛ ó jemɛ waa haa koh a waa dɛɛ valɛ, ne anɔ la maa ŋɔa he ɛ.’ Kɛ laa tena baa ja n nɛɛ la te, n ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá chem mɛ bobɛl.
Taraken, kondikwaa besoo lɔ he be nɔ?
Tɛ mɛ paanoo anue kɛɛ kon te bɛlbwa haa dɔa.” Anee sɔfo la chaŋe Devid ŋɔ, “N ta paanoo pɛɛ bɛlbwa dɔe, atane onɔ la baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii la ɡbo.
Dɛ he laa tena nɔ ta haahna chɔe baah nɔ ta tenaa, he lɛ tɛɛ ba.” Devid ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n ne laa tena nɔ dɛ kaa wepɛɛ ta kwaraa naa, ba laa ba te dɛɛ kpɔ haahna chɔe ta, doŋa bɛlbwa le ba nɛ, ń baa bol waa aa hiah dɛ do ken nɔ.” Anomanta, sɔfo la kpɔ paanoo baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii o do ɡoroŋ la tɛo, dɛkalkɛ dɛ paanoo bɛlbwa toole ka ja anɔ la baa kpɔa dɛɛ bil Korowii sie.
O laa kpɔ teebur waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, dɛ kpɔ anɔ la aa wɔba ba chiɡ a naa ta.
Dɛ Doeɡ waa le Edom, dɛ ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl peteɡre nomoa lɔ bela awola tɔpere la dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.
Devid bɔɔ sɔfo Ahemɛlɛk ŋɔ, “He dɔ lampea kɛɛ kere he be bonɔ naa?
N ta kere kɛɛ dɔmkon bɛlbwa ne bonɔ balɛ, dɛ kooro toma la waa hiaoh kohona, asɛ mɛɛ too nomanta, n ta wone kpɔ komɛlbwa.” Sɔfo la chaŋo ŋɔ, “Goliat waa ɛ Filisti te he kpoo Ɛla Fɛlembɔjen bini la kere lɔ n be bonɔ.
Ba kpɔ yal fɔrɔwo o tel sɔfo batakaarebora efɔd la habɔɔ.
He dɛ nyin aa, he ka kpɔ.
Kere bɛlbwa toole bonɔ ka ja o nɛɛ kpa.” Ate Devid ŋɔ, “Keredɛɛɡe toole bobɛlbwa, kpɔ tɛ mɛ.” Devid la bwɛjen Gat Awola tɔpere la, Devid chwao le Kooro Sɔɔl be dɛ kaa bwɛjen Gat Kooro Akis be.
Anee Kooro Akis nomonome bɔɔ Devid ŋɔ, “Hen Devid nɔ laa ɛ kooro he harɛ ta la aa?
He laa ba kpɔ ɡo yela dɛɛ sa ŋɔ, ‘Kooro Sɔɔl kpo nɛra kaɡboŋa, asɛ Devid ɡe kpo nɛra kaɡboŋa fi la aa?’ ” Devid kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ do o nyu bini, dɛ koh a waa dɛɛ ɔmɛ bwɛjen Gat Kooro Akis kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, o saahnɔ dɛɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ waa dɛ we choɡla ken ba sie, o taa lɔ ba nɔn ta la, dɛ o we-ɛɛla bwa ɛ choɡla wa, dɛ kpɔ kon dɛɛ peeɡe ba doonyojen ɡbeni ta, asɛ dɛ ɡel nentane ɛɛ yɔɔ o tampona.
Kooro Akis ŋɔ o nomonome be ŋɔ, “Hé na baa la!
O dɛ we choɡla!
Bɔkwaa dɔ o ne n be bonɔ bala ɔ?
N nya choɡla tena asɛ he berɛ lawɛ onɔ ɡe ba n sie o baa ɛ anɔ bwa nɔ naa?
Nɛn waa do ken chɛ kɛ ó ba dem bonɔ naa?”
Devid la bwɛjena Adulam ne Mispa Devid le bwɛjen Gat dɛ chwa ka sɔh bwɛjen Adulam bwebɔɔ bini.
O dɔɔranar ne o mɛɛ dem tena aa no o waa la, ba la o be bela.
Banɔ la baa dɛ fiɡ ba ne nɛra baa di kema, dɛ banɔ la ba bambile aa chɔɡa bwa baa teŋɛ o nɛ.
Nɛra dɛ ɛ lafraanaarɛɛ baa cheme o sie, o ɛ ba nomoa.
Devid le bela dɛ la Mispa waa lɔ Moab harɛ ta, dɛ ka ŋɔ bela kooro be ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ sɛoh dɛ́ ɡel n mɛɛ ne n nya ba so he be bonɔ ka tel saŋ maa na waa Korowii aa ɛ tɛ mɛ naa?” Anomanta, o ɡelɔ ba so kooro la be ɡɛ saŋ waa kaa sɔh bwebɔɔ la bini la bwa.
Ate, Korowii keame baa dɛ yerɔ Gad ba ŋɔ Devid be kɛŋɔ, ó le bwebɔɔ la bini bela dɛ́ kaa Juda harɛ ta.
Anomanta, Devid le bela dɛ kaa Hɛrɛt kɔne bini.
Kooro Sɔɔl kpoo Nɔb sɔfore Awola bɛl, Kooro Sɔɔl baa no kɛŋɔ ba na Devid ne o laa tena.
Dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl kpoŋe o lampea dɛ so dajen bɛl mun Gebea deŋɡare doa, asɛ o laa nomonome bwa che baro.
Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N bala haa le Bɛnjamen dea, hé no!
Jese bibaa nɔ ɛɛ won tɛ he bwa harɛre ne daa kooni aa?
Wɛɛ won cheɡ heyaa nomonome he chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa kɛɛ lafare nyoa aa?
Amɔ a waa he bwa sɔh dɛɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa nɔ naa?
Nomɛlbwa ta n be bolɛ ŋɔ n bie ne Jese bie fɔwɛ fɔo.
Bɛlbwa waane laa n wa kɛɛ dɛ bol n be ŋɔ n bie ɡelɔ n bonɔɔ Devid ɛɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa dɛ́ kpo mɛ, ɡɛ waa ɛa fini nɔ.” Ate, Edom te Doeɡ o ne Kooro Sɔɔl laa nomonome la aa cheɡa la ŋɔ, “N na Jese bibaa la o ba Nɔb, Ahitub bibaa sɔfo Ahemɛlɛk be.
Ahemɛlɛk kaa bɔɔ le Korowii be tɛo, dɛ berɛ kpɔ kondikwaa ne Goliat waa ɛ Filisti te kere tɛo.” Belaa Kooro Sɔɔl tomɛ ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ Ahitub bibaa sɔfo Ahemɛlɛk ne o mɛɛ dem tena bwa baa ɛ sɔfore dɛ so Nɔb la, ásɛ ba bwa ba kooro be.
Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “Ahitub bibaa, dɛɛ no n be name.” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa, n dɛ no he be.” Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ne Jese bibaa sɔh dɛɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa, he tɛo kondikwa ne kere dɛ berɛ bɔɔ le Korowii be tɛo nɔɔ?
A ɡelɔ o ɛɛ mɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo fini tɔpere.” Sɔfo Ahemɛlɛk chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “He nomonome nɔ bwa bini ume waa dɔ kasinteŋ kɛ Devid waa ɛ he hela, dɛ berɛ chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daahne nyoa, dɛ dɔ duure kohona he dem ɔ?
A ɡɛ tɔpere la ɡboo n bɔɔ waa le Korowii be tɛo waa?
Akai, ɡɛ laa a do.
N naa kooro, bɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ ne n mɛɛ dem nɛra wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛ, he bonɔɔ aa waa nɔ wobɛlbwa jemɛ.” Anee Kooro la ŋɔ Ahemɛlɛk be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, he ne he mɛɛ dem tena bwa ɛɛ serewoo.” Belaa kooro la ŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ daahno dɛ che o baŋ bɛl la be ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ he te dɛ́ kpoo Korowii sɔfore nɔ, dɛkalkɛ ba ɡe teŋɛ Devid nɛ.
Ba jemɔ kɛ o dɛ chwa, kɛ ba ta n be bolɛ.” Kɛ dɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah kooro la aa nyin kɛ bá kpoo ba.
Ate, kooro berɛ ŋɔ Doeɡ waa le Edom la be ŋɔ, “Berɛ he te, dɛ́ kpoo sɔfore nɔ.” Anomanta, o berɛ o te dɛ kpoo ba.
O kpoo sɔfore fifraanuatoro dɛ banue baa do sɔfo batakaarebori efɔd baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡa ɛa.
O ɡelɔ ba kpoo nɛra baa kaa dɛ do Nɔb waa ɛ sɔfore bwɛɛ la bwa, ne baala ne haahna, ne bechale ne bechasɔɔhne, ne nae ne keeɡore dɛ peera bwa.
Kɛ Abiata waa ɛ sɔfo Ahemɛlɛk bibaala la bini bɛl chwao dɛ ka ja Devid nɛ.
Abiata ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl kpoo Korowii sɔfore la bwa.
Anee Devid ŋɔ Abiata be ŋɔ, “Awola Doeɡ aa lɔ bela la, dɛ n jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ bol Kooro Sɔɔl bee.
N nɛɛ a che ba kpoo he mɛɛ dem nɛra bwa la.
So n be bonɔ, dɛɛ berɛ ɔma.
Nɛn waa dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo la, dɛ́ nyin n ɡe dɛ́ kpo.
He lɔ n be bonɔ naa, hɛɛ dɔ he nyuu.”
Devid lɛ Keila tena Devid baa no kɛŋɔ Filisti tena dɛ yo bwɛɛ Keila dɛ ŋwɛ mefala le o ta dɛɛ kaa.
Asɛ o bɔɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “Ń ka yo Filisti tena nɔ naa?” Anee Korowii chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kaa ka yoo ba, dɛ́ lɛ Keila tena ta.” Kɛ baala baa ja Devid nɛɛ la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Juda harɛ ta bonɔ kwaraa yaa ɔmɛ nɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona la Keila dɛ́ ka pu Filisti laa tena yoo?” Devid berɔ bɔɔ waa le Korowii be asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kaa Keila dɛ́ ka puu ba yo, mɛɛ ɡeloo he pɔ Filisti tena la nɛ.” Anomanta, Devid ne o laa tena la Keila, dɛ ka yo Filisti tena dɛ larawe ba kondɛɛra bwa kaa.
O kpo Filisti tena ɡalɡa dɛ lɛ Keila tena ta.
Dɛ Abiata waa ɛ sɔfo Ahemɛlɛk bibaala la kpɔ sɔfo batakaarebora efɔd la kpoŋe ɡɛ saŋ waa chwaa ba Devid be Keila la.
Kooro Sɔɔl ti Devid Ba ŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl be ŋɔ Devid kaa Keila asɛ o ŋɔ, “Korowiirii kpɔ Devid do n nɔn ta la.
O ɡbabirii kaa tɔ o te dea, dɛ ka jo bwɛɛ baa ma danjwɛɛ baro, dɛ kpɔ bune kaɡre o doonyojena ta.” Belaa Kooro Sɔɔl yerɛ o laa tena ŋɔ bá la Keila dɛ́ ka bar Devid ne o laa tena cheme dɛ́ yoo ba.
Devid aa naa kɛŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl dɛ vɔrɔwe o kpoe waa la, o ŋɔ sɔfo Abiata be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ sɔfo batakaarebora efɔd la ba tɛ mɛ, ásɛ ya bɔɔ le Korowii be ɡɛ yaa ɛ.” Asɛ Devid ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, he bonɔɔ noɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl koh n waa dɛɛ ba ba yo Keila tena dɛ́ chɔɡ bwɛɛ la.
Keila tena ɛɛ sɛoh dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ tɛo wa aa?
Kooro Sɔɔl ɛɛ bao ɡɛ he bonɔɔ aa noa la aa?
N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, ɡel he bonɔɔ jemɛ.” Anee Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, “Kooro Sɔɔl ɛɛ bao.” Devid berɔ bɔɔ ja ŋɔ, “Keila tena ɛɛ le n ne n laa tenaa tɛ yá do Kooro Sɔɔl lɔɡa kɛɛ?” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Baa le heyaa tɛo.” Anomanta, Devid ne o laa tena dɛ ɛ nɛra lafraanumɛl le Keila warane dɛ kaa.
Kooro Sɔɔl aa noa kɛŋɔ Devid chwao le Keila la, o ta bela laŋɛ kpa.
Devid la deŋɡarere harɛ ta Devid kaa sɔh Sif pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ne o deŋɡarere ta.
Tɔpere bɛlbwaa Kooro Sɔɔl ɛɛ ɡaaɡe o bɔr, kɛ Korowii ta ɡelɛ o dɔ Devid lawɛ.
Waa lɔ bwɛɛ Hɔrɛs waa bɛne Sif pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la, o noɔ kɛŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl dɛ́ nyinu dɛ́ kpo.
Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bibaa Jonatan la Devid be Hɔrɛs, dɛ ka doo ɡbemba kɛŋɔ Kórowii kpɔ nɔn tɔ o nɛ.
O ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, n mɛɛ aa hen wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba.
Henee dɛɛ ba Israel kora dii, ásɛ he toole naa, menee dɛ́ teŋɛ.
Hale n mɛɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ɡbabir jemɔ.” Belaa ba nɛra banɛ la fɔwɛ fɔo Korowii sie, Jonatan berɛ kaa dem, asɛ Devid te so Hɔrɛs bela.
Sif tena la Kooro Sɔɔl be Gebea dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Devid sɔh ya baah nɔ ta, Hɔrɛs deŋɡarere ta Hakila Bwejen waa lɔ Jasimɔn weekaŋle harɛbɔr doa.
N naa kooro, ya bwa nao ɡɛ haa dɛ nyinu dɛ́ lawɛ, ba ya be bonɔ ásɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta la, yá ɡel he dɔɔ lawɛ.” Kooro Sɔɔl chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Kórowii swee heyaa andɛɛɡa kɛ haa dɛ dawɛ n waa nɔ.
Hé berɛ kaa dɛ́ ka nyiŋi a bini kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ na bela Devid aa lole, ne naate waa nao bela.
Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ o keo taeh.
Hé ka ɡaaɡe bɔra o yon kaa sɔh a ta la, dɛ́ berɛ ba bol kasinteŋ aa lɔ a ta n be.
Ásɛ n ne he kaa, dɛ o lɔ bela ɡbosoroo tenaa, mɛɛ ɡaaɡe o bɔree, hale Juda harɛ bwa ta.” Anomanta, ba tɔ Kooro Sɔɔl sie dɛ kaa Sif.
Dɛ Devid ne o laa tena lɔ Mayɔn pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta, Jesimɔn weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Kooro Sɔɔl ne o laa tena pa mun dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, asɛ Devid no kɛŋɔ ba dɛ ɡaaɡe o bɔr, asɛ o chwa ka so deŋɡare bɛl doa Mayɔn pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Kooro Sɔɔl ɡe aa noa kɛ o lɔ bela la, o tiu bela dɛ kaa ɡaaɡe o bɔr.
Kooro Sɔɔl ne o laa tena kpɔ bwejen la baŋ bɛl dɛɛ kaa, asɛ Devid ɡe ne o nɛra do o baŋ bɛl dɛ ɛ warane dɛɛ nyin ba le Kooro Sɔɔl ne o laa tena be.
O ne o nɛra aa dɛ tel Devid ne o nɛra be dɛ laɡ ba la, dɛ torome bɛl deno ba Kooro Sɔɔl be dɛ ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, berɛ ɛ warane ba taraken!
Filisti tena baa su harɛ la bwa dɛɛ ba o chɔɡa.” Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl den ɡel Devid bɔr ɡaaɡa dɛ berɛ kaa dɛ ka yo Filisti tena la.
A waa ba pa bela sɔn Sela Hamalekɔt la.
Asɛ Devid le bela dɛ kaa Ɛn Gedi harɛ ta, bela waa chwaa ka sɔh la.
Devid sune Kooro Sɔɔl nɛ Kooro Sɔɔl aa kaa ti Filisti tena dɛ berɛ ba la, ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Devid lɔ Ɛn Gedi pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela.” Anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl le laa tena kaɡboŋa batoro baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ le Israel tena bwa bini ŋɔ bá ka ɡaaɡe Devid ne o nɛra bɔr deŋɡare bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kpɔɡ Bini Boohna Bwea ta.
Kooro Sɔɔl baa tel peera leɡa ane aa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ la nyoa bwebɔɔ bɛl bɔr, asɛ o jo o bini ka kwaa o te.
Dɛ Devid ɡe ne o nɛra lɔ bwebɔɔ la jaɡa.
Asɛ Devid nɛra la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Fini tɔpere nɔ, Korowii dɛ bol he be ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ kpɔ he dɔmee do he nɔn ta he ɛo ɡɛ bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.’ ” Ate, Devid huuh dɛ sɔh ka mɔn Kooro Sɔɔl batakaare nyoa, dɛ waa jemɛ.
A habɔɔ la, Devid liire chɔɡɔ kɛ waa kaa mɔn Kooro Sɔɔl batakaare nyoa la.
Asɛ o ŋɔ o laa tena la be ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛŋɔ n ɛ nɛn n dɔɔ Korowii aa fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ cheɡo kora ta wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.” Devid cheɡɛ waa nɔ ta dɛ kah o laa tena la, o ta ɡelɛ ba ka yo Kooro Sɔɔl.
Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl le bwebɔɔ la bini dɛ kaa.
Belaa Devid ɡe le bwebɔɔ la bini dɛ yerɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “N naa kooro.” Kooro Sɔɔl aa kea nyiŋu la, Devid ɡure nyu su, dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
O ŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no nɛra nyoa wobol kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin hen waane ɛɛ nɔɔ?
He ɡbabir nao fini ɡɛ Korowii aa kpɔe do n nɔn ta bwebɔɔ la bini.
Bane ŋɔ ń kpoe, kɛ n ɡele dɛ ŋɔ maa nɛn n dɔɔ Korowii aa fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ cheɡo kora ta la wechɔɡa bɛlbwaa ɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
N naa, nyiŋi na, he batakaare peraa n kpoŋe la!
Menee baa laa mɔn, kɛ n ta hen kpoe.
Jemɛ name kɛŋɔ maa he ne wechɔɡa lii, kɛɛ dɛ́ ɛɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa.
N ta hen wobɛlbwa ɛɛ, kɛ he teŋɛ n nɛɛ dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo.
Korowiirii dɛ́ bol n ne he baah waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Onee dɛ́ bɔe kem waa haa liira n nɛɛ la wa, kɛ n te maa hen waanee ɛ bwa.
Saŋ la tena bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bee dichɔɡa le,’ anomanta, maa n nɔnee kpɔ leɡe.
Umee Israel kooro ɛɛ nyin o bɔr dɛ́ kpo nɔɔ?
Men maa do kɛ nyoate lale maa wola toole wobɛlbwa bini, kɛɛ koŋɡaahle nɔ naa?
Korowiirii dɛ́ bol n ne he baah waa dɛ́ na naate waa di bolchɔɡe.
Onee dɛ́ nyiŋi waa nɔ ta ásɛ dɛ cha mɛ, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le he nɔn ta.” Devid aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, Kooro Sɔɔl bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He taa nɔ naa, n bie Devid?” Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl wi kohona.
O ŋɔ, “He waa toɡrɔ dɛ ɡwaa mɛ.
He te nyiŋi n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ menee wola hen nyiŋe.” Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “Namee he baɡle wedɛɛɡa haa ɛɛ mɛ bwa, Korowii kpɔ mɛ do he nɔn ta, kɛ he ta men kpoe.
Dɛ nɛn dɔ o dɔm aa, o ɡelo wɛɛ kaa pɛɛpɛɛ aa?
Korowiirii dɛ́ chae kohona wedɛɛɡa haa ɛa dɛ ɡel n kpoe nɔ wa.
N jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ henee dɛ́ di kora Israel harɛ, dɛ harɛ la ɛɛ cheo kɛrɛdɛ naa, he bee aa ba lee.
Taraken nɔ, ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ haa n naanaree kpo kɛɛ haa n sɔnee fee le n mɛɛ lolanar bini.” Anomanta, Devid ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡle Kooro Sɔɔl.
Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl berɛ kaa dem, kɛ Devid ne o laa tena la berɔ kaa bela ba fa aa kaa sɔh la.
Devid ne Nabal dɛ Abiɡel Samoɛl baa sewɛ, asɛ Israel tena bwa cheme dɛ wiu, dɛ huɡo Rama bela waa soɡa.
Asɛ Devid berɛ kaa Mayɔn pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Dɛ baa bɛl lɔ bela dɛ bɛne bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kaamɛl dɛ dɔ suuɡa ne harɛ kohona.
O berɔ dɔ boohna kaɡboŋ, dɛ peera ɡe kaɡboŋa atoro dɛɛ fonɛ a pona Kaamɛl bela.
O sɔne Nabal asɛ o haah ɡe sɔne Abiɡel.
Dɛ o haah la ɛ wejereme, dɛ do wer tolo.
Kɛ o jaa waa le Kaleb lolanar bini la te, dɛ o nyu bini kpeɡri, o baah ɡe ɛɛ di warawara.
Devid taa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela la, o noɔ kɛŋɔ Nabal dɛ fonɛ o peera pona bela.
Anomanta, o tomɛ bonɔɔna fi dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé la Nabal be Kaamɛl dɛ́ ka chɔɔro ba tɛ mɛ.
Hé ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Kórowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ!
Ó tɛ he ne he dem tena ne he komɛlbwa haa dɔa bokpeɡa!
N noɔ taraken kɛŋɔ peera pona fona saŋee la.
He peteɡra fa aa lɔ ya be la, ya ta ban chɔɡre ɛɛ, ba komɛlbwa ɡe ta nyoɡrɛ ɡɛ saŋ baa lɔ Kaamɛl la bwa.
Bɔɔ he bonɔɔna la, bá bol waa aa lole.
Anomanta, nyiŋi n bonɔɔna kɛrɛdɛ tɔpejen dii saŋ nɔ ta.
N dɛ soŋe, tɛ he bonɔɔna ne he bibaa Devid kon te bɛlbwa haa dɔa.’ ” Devid toroma la laŋɔ dɛ ka bol waa la Nabal be Devid sɔn ta.
Asɛ ba so tama.
Belaa Nabal chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Umee a ɡɛ Devid nɔɔ, Jese bie ɛ?
O ɛ bonɔɔna baa chwaa dɛɛ le ba nomonome be tɔpera anɛ nɔ bini bɛl kɛɛ?
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ ń kpɔ n paanoo ne n ne, dɛ ola maa kpoora tɛ nɛra baa dɛ fonɛ n peera tɛ nɛra maa wola ba leebɔr jemɔɔ?” Ate, Devid bonɔɔna la berɛ ba o be, dɛ ba bol wobɛlbwa Nabal aa bola la.
Devid ŋɔ o nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ he keri.” Asɛ ba kpɔ ba keri sɛɡle ba te, Devid ɡe kpɔ o kon.
Laa tena dɛ ɛ lafraanaarɛɛ ja Devid nɛ o ne ba kaa, asɛ lafraanɛ te ka ba ne nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi laala ta la be.
Nabal bonɔɔna la bɛl ŋɔ o haah Abiɡel be ŋɔ, “Devid tomɛ toroma le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ŋɔ bá ba chɔɔ ya nomoa tɛo, kɛ o chɛɡ ba.
Kɛ nɛra la ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, ba ta yaa wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ ya ne ba lɔ kpɔɡ bini, ba ta ya komɛlbwa ɡe ŋwɛɛ.
Ba daah yaa webaŋa ne jwaana, saŋ bɛlbwaa ya ja ba nɛɛ dɛɛ teɡɛ ya peera.
Kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ liire, dɛ́ na ɡɛ haa dɛ ba wona ɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ wenaale dɛ ba n nomoa Nabal ne o dem tena bwa nɛ.
O bambile kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nɛn bol waa ó no a mun.” Abiɡel ta hɛlɛ dɛ den kpɔ paanoo lafraanɛ, ne sen oltɔn pure dela anɛ ne peera anue ola baa hala, ne mea baa hala dɛ ɛ baaɡere anue, ne daa nɔna aa hola dɛ ɛ lakaja anue, dɛ fiɡ nɔna dɛ ɛ nɔndela lafraanɛ dɛ kpɔa choɡ keeɡore.
Ate, o ŋɔ o bonɔɔna la be ŋɔ, “Hé tɔ sie, n ɡe teŋɔ dɛɛ ba.” Kɛ o ta o jaa Nabal be bolɛ a wa.
Abiɡel soɡe keeɡo ta dɛɛ teeh deŋɡare bɛl dɛ den cheme Devid ne o laa tena ba tu dɛɛ ba o be.
Dɛ Devid fa liiro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa bala n nyiŋi a ɡɛ nɛn nɔ kwaa ta tɛo pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela kwaraa te nɔ?
N ta o komɛlbwa ŋwɛɛ ɡe.
N kembɔree chɛɡa nɔ naa?
Bɔr ne chaahna dɛ n ta baala nɔ bwa kpooraa, Korowii kpo mɛ!” Abiɡel aa na Devid la, o ɛ warane dɛ tu o keeɡo ta, dɛ ka ɡuŋu dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɡel wechɔɡa la dawɛ n ɡbo nɛ.
N dɛ soŋe, tɛ men maa ɛ he tolo ŋwɛnɛ n won bol waa he be.
N dɔɔ, laa sie kpɔ nyubinikpeɡ te Nabal nɔ nɛ.
O deno do kɛŋɔ o sɔn aa doa baa yerɔ ɡɛne nɔ.
Kɛ men maa ɛ he tolo te, n ta bonɔɔna haa tom ba la nae.
Taraken, Korowii aa lɛɛ le nɛra kpoora dɛ tɔ wel ta nɔ, n ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa asɛ he ɡe so le nɔ, ó ɡel he dɔma baa dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo la do kɛŋɔ Nabal ken.
Koŋkɛɛla he tolo aa ba a ne nɔ, n dɛ soŋe kɛ he lɛa dɛ́ kpɔ tɛ he bonɔɔna baa dɛ teŋɛ he nɛɛ la.
N poori, kpɔ he tolo wechɔɡa kɛo.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo n dɔɔ kora che saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛkalkɛ Korowii laalee hɛɛ yo.
Bɛ ɡel wechɔɡa bɛlbwa do he waa bini he soɡa bini bwa.
Hale dɛ nomɛl dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo kwara naa, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛ, kɛŋɔ nomɛl aa dɛ nyiŋi kondɛɛɡe bɛl o waa hiah la ken.
Kɛ he dɔma te, wɛɛ viɡ baa kɛŋɔ vamtor bwea ken.
Dɛ Korowii ɛ wedɛɛɡe bɛlbwa waa baɡɛ nyoa la dɛ cheɡe kora ta Israel harɛ ta naa, he liire ɛɛ ba harɛɛ, ásɛ o baa swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ naa, haa nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa ɛɛ kpoo bɔ kem, dɛ́ di a bolchɔɡe kpa.
N dɔɔ, n dɛ soŋe bɛ n waa soh.” Devid ŋɔ Abiɡel be ŋɔ, “Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la chɛ jam, kɛŋɔ waa tomɛ fini he ba chem mɛ nɔ.
Korowii jam, he liidɛɛɡa ne waa haa ɛa tɛ mɛ fini dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le nɛŋkpoa ta, n fee ka kpoo nɛra baa wola waane ɛɛ nɔ.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee ɡela n ta hen wobɛlbwa ɛɛ la.
Kɛ n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ dɛ he fe ta warane ɛɛ dɛ ba chem mɛ naa, tɔɔ ne pera Nabal dem baa te bɛlbwa fe aa ka.” Belaa Devid sɛh, dɛ lɛ kwaa waa kpɔa ba tɛo la dɛ ŋɔ, “Berɛ kaa dem deŋnesɔɔhna ne, mɛɛ ɛ waa haa dɛ nyin laanee tɛɛ.” Abiɡel aa la Nabal be la, dɛ o lɔ o dem dɛɛ di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ o sie kɛŋɔ kooro ken.
Dɛ o dɛɛrɔ o sie lɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, o ta wobɛlbwa o be bolɛ ka tel kɛ tɔ aa pera chɔɔ.
Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ sen la le o sie la, o haah la bol waa aa chiɡa la bwa o be.
O bambile teŋo kohona, asɛ o beŋri chɔ.
Dɛ ɛ tɔpera fi habɔɔ la, Korowii ɡelɔ Nabal sewɛ.
Devid baa no kɛ Nabal sewɔ, asɛ o ŋɔ, “Korowii jam kɛŋɔ waa bɔ Nabal kem n chɛɡa waa chɛɡ mɛ wa, asɛ o ta ɡelɛ men maa ɛ o bonɔɔ ɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa nɔ.
Korowiirii tɛr o deŋne o wechɔɡa waa ɛa waa la.” Asɛ Devid tomɛ ba ka ŋɔ Abiɡel be ŋɔ o dɛ nyinu dɛ́ mo.
O bonɔɔna la la Kaamɛl dɛ ka ŋɔ Abiɡel be ŋɔ, “Devid tomɛ yaa he be ŋɔ yá ba kpɔe ba o moe.” Ate, o ɡuŋi dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “O toloo men, mɛɛ tomɔɔ dɛɛ sarame o bonɔɔna nakpale.” Abiɡel den ɛ warane ka so o keeɡo ta, asɛ o toli banue teŋɛ, bane Devid bonɔɔna la kaa o ka yalɛ Devid.
Dɛ Devid tɔ sie mo Ahinoam waa le Jesreel la, ba bwa ɛ o haahna.
Kɛ dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl berɔ kpɔ o bihaah Mikal waa ɛ Devid haah la tɛ Laes bibaa Paltiel waa le Galim la ŋɔ ó moo.
Devid sune Kooro Sɔɔl nɛɛ ja Baala bane le bwɛjen Sif ta, dɛ la Kooro Sɔɔl be Gebea ka ŋɔ Devid sɔh Hakila Bwejen o sie aa chaɡɛ Juda pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la nyoa.
Anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl le Israel laa tena kaɡboŋa batoro baa jemɛ yoi Sif pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela dɛ́ ka ɡaaɡe Devid bɔr.
Kooro Sɔɔl baŋre o tɛnte dea Hakila Bwejen ŋwɛnɛ nyoa, o sie chaɡɛ Jesimɔn pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ bela Devid aa soɡa la.
Waa baa no kɛ Kooro Sɔɔl teŋɛ o nɛɛ dɛɛ nyin o bɔr la, o tomɛ nɛra ba ka sɔh nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl lɔ bela kpela.
Ate, Devid kpɔ o te warane, dɛ kaa bela Kooro Sɔɔl ne Nɛr bibaa Abna waa ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl laa tena nomoa aa chɔa.
Dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl chɔ tɛnte dea bini bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene la baah ta, asɛ laa tena chɔ ane bini, dɛ baro.
Anee Devid bɔɔ Ahemɛlɛk waa ɛ Hiti te, ne Seruya bibaa Abisae waa ɛ Joab dɔɔ la ŋɔ, “He bini umee dɛ́ ja n nɛɛ la Kooro Sɔɔl be bela baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so laɔ?” Asɛ Abisae ŋɔ, “N ne hɛɛ lao.” Anomanta, Devid ne Abisae la Kooro Sɔɔl ne o laa tena be jwaana, dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl chɔ dom bela baa soɡa la baah ta, asɛ lampea pa o nyu bɔr pera.
Asɛ Abna ne laa tena la ɡe chɔ baro.
Abisae den ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “Korowii kpɔ he dɔm do he nɔn ta fini.
Gel n kpɔ o ɡbaɡba lampea nɔ yaɡɔ marɛ harɛ kera beŋkpoŋ ɡbo, kera anɛ kwaraa laa.” Kɛ Devid ŋɔ, “Bɛ on kpo!
Nomɛlbwa waa kpo nɛn Korowii aa fuɡe noo do o nyu ta dɛ cheɡo kora ta la ɛɛ di bolchɔɡee.” Dɛ berɛ ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii aa lole nɔ, dɛ o seo tɔpere ta tele o sewɛ, kɛɛ o sewɛ laa ta naa, Korowii ɡbabirii dɛ́ kpoo.
Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛ n kpo nɛn Korowii aa fuɡe noo do o nyu ta dɛ cheɡo kora ta.
Gel ya kpɔ o lampea ne loŋ waa dɛ do nee o bini a che o nyu bɔr nɔ kaa.” Anomanta, Devid kpɔ lampea ne loŋ waa dɛ do nee o bini o che o nyu bɔr la, asɛ ba kaa.
Nomɛlbwa ta nae, bɛlbwa ɡe ta harɛ.
Ba bwa chɔɔ ka ɡarɛ dɛkalkɛ Korowiirii ɡela a ba ɡɛ.
Belaa Devid ɡale kaa fɛlembɔjen la baŋ bɛl dɛ ka chɔŋɛ deŋɡare la ta, o ne ba baah do jaŋne.
Asɛ dɛ yerɛ laa tena ne Nɛr bibaa Abna ŋɔ, “Haa men chaŋe aa, Abna?” Ate, Abna chaŋe ŋɔ, “Umee kooro chɔ wɛɛ doo ɡbɔɡa ɡɛ nɔɔ?” Devid chaŋe ŋɔ, “Laa nomonjen laa hen Israel harɛ ta naa?
Bɔkwa waa bala he ta kooro waa ɛ he nomoa la daahnɛ ɔ?
A ta biɡre bɛlbwa nomɛl ba jo ŋɔ ó fe den ba kpo kooro.
He ta he toma ɛɛ, Abna.
N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, a chɛ kɛ he bwa sewɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ta he dɔɔ Korowii aa cheɡo kora ta daahnɛ.
Leperaa kooro lampea ne loŋ waa dɛ do nee o bini a che o nyu bɔr la dɔɔ?” Kooro Sɔɔl jemɛ Devid taa dɛ ŋɔ, “Henee nɔ naa, n bibaa Devid?” Asɛ Devid chaŋe ŋɔ, “Menee, n naa kooro.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ n ɛɛ hɛɛ ti men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ ken te nɔ?
Bɔkwa waa n ɛɔ?
N ɛ wechɔɡa ane kɛɛ?
N naa kooro, no men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ waa maa dɛ bol.
Dɛ Korowiirii ɡela he fome siwi pa n nɛ aa, mɛɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa tɛo.
Kɛ dɛ nɛwɛnyinii dɛɛ ɛ aa, Korowii nyotaahna laɡ ba.
Dɛkalkɛ, ba doŋ mɛ le Korowii be o harɛ ta, n ka do harɛfale baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa ɡbo o ta.
Bɛ ɡel ba kpo mɛ harɛfale ta, maa wola Korowii sie do.
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ Israel kooro le dɛ baa kpaah men maa do kɛŋɔ nyuhɔl kɛɛ jumbie nɔɔ?” Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “N bie Devid, n ɛ wechɔɡa, berɛ ba n be.
Maa hen kpo kpa, dɛkalkɛ he dɔɔ mɛ he ta men kpoe jwaana nɔ ne.
N ɛ ɡɛnewaa kohona ne waa aa wola were.” Asɛ Devid chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he lampea laanee la, ɡel he bonɔɔna nɔ bini bɛl ba, dɛ́ ba lɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ di kasinteŋ Korowii waa ta ba waa toɡre la, Korowii dɛ bɔ ba kem.
O kpɔe do n nɔn ta fini, kɛ waa lee cheɡ kora ta nomanta, n ta hen kpoe.
Gɛ maa sune he nɛɛ n ta hen kpoe fini nɔ, Korowii cha mɛ ɡɛ tenten, dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale bwa ta.” Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “N bie, Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ, ásɛ wobɛlbwa haa ɛ la, á chiɡi kɛrɛdɛ.” Asɛ Devid chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa, Kooro Sɔɔl ɡe berɛ kaa o dem.
Devid kaa so Filisti tena bini Devid baa lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Tɔpebɛl Kooro Sɔɔl ɛɛ ba kpo mɛɛ.
Chwae chɛ kɛ ń chwa kaa Filisti tena harɛ ta ka so.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel ó ɡel n bɔr ɡaaɡa Israel harɛ ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ bɛ men dɔ lawɛ.” Anomanta, Devid ne o laa tena lafraanumɛl leɔ warane, dɛ kaa Mayɔk bibaa Akis waa ɛ Gat kooro be.
Devid ne o laa tena soɡe Gat bela Kooro Akis be, bɛlbwa ne o haahna ne o bii.
Devid ne o haahna banɛ, Ahinoam waa le Jesreel, ne Abiɡel o ɡe aa ɛ Nabal luhaah dɛ le Kaamɛl.
Baa bol Kooro Sɔɔl be kɛ Devid chwao ka so Gat la, o ta o bɔr ɡaaɡɛ kpa.
Devid ŋɔ Kooro Akis be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he sie lɛ n nɛ aa, ɡel ba tɛ mɛ he bwɛjeɡre nɔ bɛl ń ka so o ta.
He ne he bonɔɔ aa won pɛ so bwɛjen beŋkpoŋ ta ɡɛ.” Anomanta, awola tɔpere la, Kooro Akis kpɔ bwɛɛ Siklaɡ tɛo o ka so bela.
Le ɡɛ saŋ dɛ kaa la, Siklaɡ ɛ Juda koranar bwɛɛre la bɛl.
Devid soɡe Filisti harɛ ta benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ne korobie anaarɛ.
Devid ta aa soɡe Siklaɡ la, o ne o laa tena la kaa lɔ tɔ Gesur ne Girsi dɛ Amalɛk tena nɛ.
Saŋ la dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ soɡe Suur harɛ dɛ kpoŋe ka le Ijipt harɛ ta.
Saŋ bɛlbwa Devid aa ka yo bobɛl tena la, waa baa kɛɛ haah bɛlbwa ɡel.
O dɛ kpɔ peera ne nae ne keeɡore ne nyoɡmare dɛ yale bwa kaa.
A habɔɔ la, o yon berɛ ba Kooro Akis be.
Kooro Akis bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa he ka yo dɛ pa laala fini naa,” ɡɛɛ Devid yon ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N kaa yo Juda weekaŋle harɛbɔr tena” kɛɛ “Jeramiil dea harɛ tena,” kɛɛ “Ken harɛ tena.” O ta baa kɛɛ haah bɛlbwa ɡelɛ o ka Gat.
O liiro ŋɔ, “Baa ka bol waa n ne n laa tena aa ɛa laanee.” Devid aa soɡe Filisti tena harɛ ta la, dɛ waa waa dɛ ɛ laanee la.
Kooro Akis yarada Devid, asɛ dɛ lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, “O nɛra Israel tena haoh kohona nomanta, wɛɛ so n bee dɛ́ tom mɛ dɛɛ la.”
Kooro Sɔɔl ne Ɛndɔr haah waa dɛ voɡɛ wa A habɔɔ la, Filisti tena boa ba laa tena nyoa dɛ́ ka yo Israel tena.
Anee Kooro Akis waa ɛ Filisti tena koranar la bini bɛl ŋɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ he ne he laa tena nɔ ɛɛ ja n ne n laa tena nɛɛ yá ka yo.” Ate Devid ŋɔ, “A wer.
Men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ, hɛɛ kpɔ siwii na waa maa dɛ ba wona ɛ.” Asɛ Kooro Akis chaŋe ŋɔ, “A wer, henee mɛɛ ba ɡela hɛɛ daah mɛ he soɡa bini bwa.” Samoɛl baa sewɛ, asɛ Israel tena bwa wiu, dɛ huɡo o ɡbaɡba bwɛ bwɛjen Rama.
Dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl doŋi nɛra baa voɡa dɛɛ yerɛ lala ne voɡra bwa le harɛ la ta.
Filisti laa tena chemo dɛ ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene bwɛɛ Sunem, asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ɡe boa Israel laa tena bwa nyoa ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene Gelboa Bwejen ta.
Kooro Sɔɔl aa na Filisti laa tena la, o ɔmɔ kohona.
O bɔɔrɔ le Korowii be dɛ na ɡɛ o fe aa ɛ, kɛ Korowii ta on chaŋɛ deera ta kɛɛ Urim ne Tumim waa ɛ komɛl baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ jemɛ waa aa wera Korowii be, kɛɛ Korowii keamere be.
Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o laa nomonome be ŋɔ, “Hé nyin haah waa voɡa dɛɛ yerɛ lala tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n la ka bɔɔ le o be.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Bɛl lɔ bwɛɛ Ɛndɔr.” Anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl kpɔ laalafala do, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ on jemɛ, asɛ dɛ kpɔ nɛra banɛ ja o nɛ, ba la haah la be jwaana la ne.
Asɛ o ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “Yerɛ lale maa yerɛ o sɔn tɛɛ nɔ tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ haah la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, he jemɛ waa Kooro Sɔɔl aa ɛa dɛ doŋi voɡra ne nɛra baa dɛ yerɛ lala le Israel harɛ nɔ ta.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ neɡ mɛ dɛ́ dɔɔ mɛ kpo nɔɔ?” Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole kɛŋɔ, haa deŋnetɛra bɛlbwa dɔe ba dɛ́ le ɡɛ waa nɔ ta.” Haah la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ume lalee hɛɛ nyin ń yerɛ tɛɛ nɔ?” Kooro Sɔɔl chaŋe ŋɔ, “Yerɛ Samoɛl lale tɛ mɛ.” Haah la aa na Samoɛl la, o do lɔŋɔ kohona dɛ ŋɔ Sɔɔl be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he neɡ mɛ nɔɔ?
Henee Sɔɔl.” Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ, bɛ ɔmɛ?” Anee haah la ŋɔ, “N dɛ na komɛl waa do kɛŋɔ lale dɛ le lalabwɛɛ dɛɛ ba.” Kooro Sɔɔl bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa wɛɛ leɔ?” Haah la chaŋe ŋɔ, “O do kɛŋɔ banjena bɛl waa do batakaarejaŋ dɛɛ ba.” Ate, Kooro Sɔɔl jemɛ kɛŋɔ Samoɛlee, asɛ o kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ duuru.
Samoɛl ŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ta ɡelɛ n chɔ jeih asɛ he yer mɛ le baŋ nɔɔ?” Anee Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ, “N bambile chɔɡɔ kohona.
Filisti tena dɛ yoo mɛ, asɛ Korowii berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ.
Waa Korowii keamere kɛɛ deera ta cheɡɛ dɛɛ chaŋ mɛ kpa.
A waa mɛɛ yerɛ he baɡ mɛ ɡɛ maa ɛ.” Anee Samoɛl ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii berɛ habɔɔ kpoe dɛ ɛ he dɔm aa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ yer mɛ ŋɔ n ɛɔ?
Korowii cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛ ɛ waa waa ŋɔa wɛɛ ɛɔ la.
O lɛ harɛ la kpeɡri he be dɛ kpɔ tɛ he dɔŋ Devid.
Haa wola waa Korowii aa doe a ta teŋɛ, he ta Amalɛk tena yoi dɛ kpoo ba kɛrɛdɛ la, a waa Korowii kpɔ waa nɔ ba ta he nɛɛ taraken la.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ he ne Israel tena bwaa do Filisti tena nɔn ta, ásɛ kere he ne he bibaala bwa sewɛ ba n be.
Korowii ɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ Israel laa tena bwa ɡe do Filisti tena nɔn ta.” Buɡ la ta, Kooro Sɔɔl den chole dɛ toɡre chɔ, ɔmee lawɔ kohona waa Samoɛl aa bola la wa.
Dɛ o ɡwɛɡrɔ dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta kondikwaa dii chɔɔ ne awola jwaana la bwa.
Haah la aa ba Kooro Sɔɔl be dɛ na o chɔ dɛɛ chel kohona la, o ŋɔ, “N naa, he toloo men, dɛ seo kwaraa yaa, n sɛoh dɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa haa ŋɔa n ɛ la.
Taraken, no he tolo wa ásɛ n tɛɛ kondikwa he di, dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡfala dɛ́ won kaa bela haa dɛ kaa.” O vɛoh dɛ ŋɔ, “Máa di.” Kɛ o nomonome banɛ la ja haah la nɛ ba soŋo o no ba waa la.
Ate, o ir harɛ dɛ so karajaŋ ta.
Dɛ haah la dɔ nabale bɛl waa do noo dem bela, asɛ o den kpoo buɡ la ta.
O kpɔ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ dɛ kpɔ ɛ paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta.
Asɛ dɛ kpɔ cheɡ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o nomonome la sie ba di.
Awola jwaana la tentenee ba ir dɛ kaa.
Devid berɔ kaa Siklaɡ Filisti tena boa ba laa tena bwa nyoa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Afɛk, asɛ Israel tena ɡe baŋre ba tɛnte deene bule bɛl waa lɔ Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen la bini jwɛh.
Filisti koranar banue aa bɔne ba laa tena bini lafare ne kaɡboŋa dɛɛ valɛ la, dɛ Devid ne o laa tena ne Kooro Akis ɡe ka mun ta, dɛ teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Filisti laa nomonome la na ba dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa Hibru tena nɔ ɛɛ nyin bonɔ nɔɔ?” Anee Kooro Akis chaŋe ŋɔ, “Devid o fa aa ɛ Israel Kooro Sɔɔl nomonome la bini bɛlee.
O soɡe n be dɛ ɡwaa benanyoa nɔ, dɛ le saŋ waa le Kooro Sɔɔl be dɛ ba n be, n ta o wechɔɡe bɛlbwa nae bwa.” Kɛ Filisti tena laa nomonome la baah di Kooro Akis nɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Gel o berɛ kaa ka so bwɛɛ haa kpɔa tɛo la ta.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ yá ne o pɛ la laa, ɡɛ laa aa, o ken ɛɛ berɛ siee chaɡɛ ya nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo yaa.
Dɛ Devid wono kpoo ya laa tena dɛ dɔ ba nyuune ka tɛ Kooro Sɔɔl aa, o sie ɛɛ lɛ o nɛɛ ó berɛ lɛo.” Devid nɔ laa haahna kpɔ ɡo yela dɛɛ sa ŋɔ, “Kooro Sɔɔl kpoo nɛra kaɡboŋa, asɛ Devid ɡe kpoo kaɡboŋa fi la aa?” Belaa Kooro Akis yerɛ Devid dɛ ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ o do le saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ mɛ.
N sie fe ɛɛ lɛo kɛ he ja n nɛɛ dɛ́ ka yo laa nɔ.
Dɛ le awola haa ba n be ba le fini, n ta he wechɔɡe bɛlbwa nae, kɛ koranar la bane sie ta he nɛɛ lɛɛ.
Berɛ kaa deŋnesɔɔhna ne, bɛ wobɛlbwa ɛ ásɛ dɛ jo Filisti koranar la nɛ.” Anee Devid chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ n ɛɔ?
Wechɔɡ besoo he na men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛɛ dɛ le tɔpere maa ba he be dɛ ba le fini nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ maa wola won ka yo n dɔɔ kooro dɔma ɔ?” Kooro Akis ŋɔ, “N jemɔ kɛ he waa wer, wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole he nɛɛ kɛ nyundua torome ken.
Kɛ ane a bwa, koranar la bane ŋɔ haa won ja ya nɛɛ dɛ́ la laa.
Anomanta, fel ir kere chɔɔ, he ne banɔ la haa le Kooro Sɔɔl be dɛ ba la bwa, ásɛ he le kaa bɔr chaahna saŋ.” Asɛ Devid ne o baala baa ja o nɛɛ la fel ir chɔmbibii dɛ berɛ kaa Filisti tena harɛ ta, asɛ Filisti tena la ɡe kaa Jesreel.
Devid yo Amalɛk tena Tɔpetooro wee la, Devid ne o laa tena valɔ dɛ berɛ ba bwɛjen Siklaɡ.
Dɛ Amalɛk tena baa yo Juda weekaŋle harɛbɔr bwɛɛre, dɛ ba pa ba laala dɛ fuh Siklaɡ, dɛ lawɛ haahna ne bechale, dɛ nomonome baa kaa dɛ do bwɛɛ la bini la bwa laa la ta kaa.
Ba ta ba bini bɛlbwa kpoe, dɛ laɡ ba kaa.
Devid ne o laa tena aa tel Siklaɡ la, ba nao kɛŋɔ Amalɛk tenaa fuh bwɛɛ la, dɛ lawɛ ba haahna ne bii bwa kaa.
Devid ne o laa tena la wio kohona ka tel kɛŋɔ baa koah baa wola won wi kpa.
Ba lawɛ Devid haahna banɛ, Ahinoam waa le Jesreel, ne Abiɡel waa ɛ Nabal luhaah dɛ le Kaamɛl la kaa.
Devid bambile chɔɡɔ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a dɛ we o laa tena la nɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ ba bii kaa la, asɛ dɛɛ nyin ba foɡre Devid bwea kpo.
Kɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la doo ɡbemba.
Ate, Devid ŋɔ Ahemɛlɛk bibaa Abiata waa ɛ sɔfo la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ sɔfore batakaarebora efɔd la ba tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n bɔɔ le Korowii be.” Asɛ o kpɔ ba tɛo.
Asɛ Devid bɔɔ le Korowii be ŋɔ, “Ń ti laa tena la kɛɛ?
Mɛɛ puu baa yaa?” Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ti ba, hɛɛ ka puu baa dɛ́ lɛ nɛra baa laɡ ba dɛɛ kaa la ta.” Devid ne o laa tena lafraanumɛl la iro dɛ ba Beso Fɛlembɔjen bini, asɛ ba bini bane so bela.
Dɛ ba bini lafraanɛ te koɔh kɛrɛdɛ, baa wola won ɡale Beso Fɛlembɔjen la.
Kɛ Devid ne laa tena lafraanaarɛ wono ɡale, dɛ ti ba kaa.
Ba na Ijipt te bɛl kpɔɡ bini bela dɛ lawɔ ba tɛ Devid.
Ba tɛo nee ne kondikwaa o di, ne fiɡ nɔna nɔndel tama, dɛ daa nɔna aa hola nɔndela anɛ.
Waa dia tonɛ la, o berɔ dɔ bokpeɡa dɛkalkɛ dɛ o ta kondikwaa dii, o ta nee ɡe nyɔe tɔpera atoro la bwa.
Devid bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He dɔɔree ume ɔ?
Leperaa he leɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ijipt tee men, n ɛ Amalɛk te bɛl yom.
Tɔpera atoroo nɔ weela aa lɔ mɛ bil, asɛ n dɔɔ chwa kaa ɡel mɛ.
Ya kaa yo Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ bela nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Kɛrɛt tena baa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ pa ba laala, ne Kaleb dea lolanar ba ɡe aa soɡe bela, dɛ fuh bwɛjen Siklaɡ ɡe.” Devid bɔɔ Ijipt te la ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ won tɔ n sie dɛ́ la n ne n laa tena nɔ be naa?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ haa men kpo kɛɛ haa men le tɛ n dɔɔ, ásɛ n tɔ he sie la he ne ba be.” O tɔ Devid ne o laa tena la sie ba la Amalɛk tena la be, dɛ ba lɔɔ peɡre harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ di kwaa dɛ nyɔ sen dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba pa laala aa wara laa la ta le Filisti ne Juda harɛ ta.
Devid yoo ba le chɔmbibii ka tel tɔ aa pera jɔmɔra.
Ba bini bɛlbwa ta wone dɔ bɔr chwa, nemenɛ bonɔɔna lafraanaarɛ baa soɡe nyoɡmare taa wona dɔ bɔr chwa kaa.
Devid berɔ lɛ kwaa Amalɛk tena aa paa la bwa, dɛ kpɔ o haahna banɛ la bwa ja.
Komɛlbwa ta nyoɡrɛ, bechale kɛɛ nomonome, bibaala ne bihaahna, komɛlbwa baa paa laa ta kaa la, Devid berɔ ba a bwa ne.
O lɛ peera ne nae Amalɛk tena aa paa kaa la, asɛ o bonɔɔna la teɡa tɔ ba sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Devid laa ta kwaa waa kaa pa laanee la.” Asɛ Devid berɛ ba o laa tena lafraanɛ ba fa aa ɡwɛɡra ba ta wone teŋɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ so Beso Fɛlembɔjen bɔr la be.
Ba leɔ ba cheme Devid ne laa tena baa ja o nɛɛ la, asɛ Devid ka jam ba.
Kɛ ba bini nyubinikpeɡ tena ne nɛnchɔɡa bwa baa ja Devid ne o laa tena nɛɛ la ŋɔ, “Baa wola ya nɛɛ jae ya ne ba ka yo nɔ, ya ne baa won bɔne kwaa yaa kaa paa laa ta nɔ.
Kɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ won kpɔ o haah ne bii te kaa.” Devid chaŋe ŋɔ, “Akai, he bɛ laala Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ɡɛ ɛ!
O kpɔ nɔn tɔ ya nɛ dɛ ɡel ya yo, dɛ pɔ ba laa tena la nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ no he waa nɔ mun.
Bɛl la waa soɡa dɛɛ daah laala, ne bɛl la waa la laa bwa chɛ kɛ he bwa bɔna kɛrɛdɛ.” Devid ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ mmara dɛ tɛ Israel tena, a ta do le ba le fini.
Devid aa tel Siklaɡ la, o kpɔ laala la ane ka tɛ Juda nomonome baa ɛ o daamanar la dɛ ŋɔ, “Kwaa maa paa laa ta dɛ le Korowii dɔma be, dɛ kpɔ a bini ane dɛɛ ba ba tɛ heyaa laanee la.” O kpɔ kwaa la ane ka tɛ banɔ la baa lɔ bwɛjena Bɛtel ne Ramɔt ne Jatir aa lɔ Juda weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ne banɔ la baa lɔ Arowa ne Sefmɔt dɛ Ɛstemoa, ne Rakal, ne Jeramiil tena bwɛɛre, dɛ Ken tena, ne banɔ la baa lɔ Hɔrma, ne Bor Asan dɛ Atak, ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛre Devid ne o laa tena aa ɡaaɡe a ta bwa.
Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala seo A kaa ba kɛ Filisti tena ne Israel tena cheme Gelboa Bwejen ta dɛ yo laa.
Ba kpoo Israel tena ɡalɡa bela, asɛ ba kar ne Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala chwa.
Filisti tena la chwao ti Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro, Jonatan ne Abinadab dɛ Malki Sua sibeɡra ne dɛ kpoo o bibaala la.
Laa la baa do kpeɡri tɛ Kooro Sɔɔl, asɛ o dɔma la bɛl ta hɛm yaɡɔ dɛ doo bol kohona.
Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o bonɔɔ waa dɛ che o dɔmkwaa la be ŋɔ, “Pamɛ he kere la, dɛ́ ba tɔɡ mɛ kpo, ásɛ nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ nɔ bɛ men ba kpo dɛ́ chɛɡ mɛ ja.” Kɛ dɛ bonɔɔ la dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ó ɛ ɡɛ, anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl pamɛ o ɡbaɡba kere dɛ chole o ta.
Bonɔɔ la aa naa kɛ Kooro Sɔɔl sewɔ la, o ɡe chole o kon ta dɛ sewɛ ja o nɛ.
Gɛɛ a do Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro ne o bonɔɔ dɛ o laa tena bwa sewɛ awola tenten.
Israel tena baa lɔ Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen la baŋ bɛl, ne Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr aa noa kɛŋɔ Israel laa tena la chwao, asɛ ba kpo Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala ɡe la, ba chwao ɡel ba bwɛɛre.
Asɛ Filisti tena la ba kpɔ dɛ so a ta.
Tɔ aa pera la, Filisti tena la laŋɔ dɛ ka pa laa tena baa kpoo ba la laala, asɛ dɛ na Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro la kɛ baa serewa chɔ Gelboa Bwejen ta.
Ba teŋe Kooro Sɔɔl nyu dɛ pa o dɔmkwa, asɛ dɛ do toroma Filisti harɛ la ta bwa ŋɔ bá ka bol amanesoma nɔ ba voɡa deene ne nɛra bwa be.
Ba kpɔ Kooro Sɔɔl dɔmkwaa la ka bil ba voɡhaah Astɔrɛt dea, dɛ kpaa o lale pɛl Bwɛjen Bɛt San danjwɛɛ ta.
Bwɛjen Jabes waa lɔ Gelead harɛ tena la aa noa ɡɛ Filisti tena aa ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl la, bansua tena baa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta kpɔ ba te, dɛ valɛ jwaana la bwa kaa bwɛjen Bɛt San.
Ba laa Kooro Sɔɔl lale kpɔ danjwɛɛ la ta, dɛ kpɔ o bii la ja, dɛ ba ba ne Jabes dɛ ba fuuh ba.
Ba pa ba hoɡa ka huɡe dajen bɛl waa lɔ Jabes mun, asɛ dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Samoɛl Tɔn Nɛɛte nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Kooro Sɔɔl aa dɛ ba sewa, ásɛ Devid ba di kora Israel harɛ ta wa.
Dɛ Devid dɛ nyin Korowii taeh, asɛ waa baa di kora la, o tɔ Israel tena sie kɛrɛdɛ.
Kɛ o berɔ ɛ wedoŋa ane ɡe, asɛ Korowii baah di o nɛɛ kohona.
Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Kooro Devid yon ɛ wechɔɡa saŋ bɛl, kɛ dɛ Korowii teŋɔ dɛɛ nyiŋi o ne o nɛra nɛ.
Devid no Kooro Sɔɔl seo Kooro Sɔɔl seo habɔɔ, Devid le laa o ne Amalɛk tena aa kaa yo o pɔ ba nɛɛ la ba, dɛ ba so bwɛjen Siklaɡ tɔpera anɛ.
Tɔpetooro wee ta la, baa bɛl le bela Kooro Sɔɔl aa baŋre o tɛnte deene dɛ so la ba.
Dɛ o kɛɛ o laala bwa, dɛ ɛ teera su o nyu ta a baɡle kɛ o loo kuu.
O la Devid be, dɛ ka ba harɛ dɛ kpɔ duure tɛo.
Anee Devid bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa he leɔ?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Chwae n chwa le bela Israel tena aa baŋre ba tɛnte deene dɛ so la.” Devid berɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa bala ɔ?
Gel n jemɛ.” Asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kooro Sɔɔl laa tena chwa laa la ta, asɛ ba kpo Filisti tena la ɡalɡa.
Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaa Jonatan ɡe sewɔ.” Anee Devid bɔɔ bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bie Jonatan sewɔ ɔ?” Ate, o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ n lɔ Gelboa Bwejen doa dɛ na Kooro Sɔɔl kɛŋɔ waa kpoŋe o lampea dɛ kpɔ o te dawɛ o ta, asɛ nɛra baa soɡe kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ pɛl jaɡre, ne nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta siwi beɡre dɛɛ bɛno dɛ́ lawɔ.
Belaa Kooro Sɔɔl ke nyiŋi dɛ yer mɛ, asɛ n bɔɔro ŋɔ, ‘N naa, bɔkwa waa hɛɛ nyin ń ɛ tɛɛ nɔ?’ O bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, ‘Umee hen ɔ?’ Asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Amalɛk tee men.’ Belaa o ŋɔ, ‘Ba, dɛ́ ba kpo mɛ.
Ba do mɛ bol kohona, mɛɛ ba sewa.’ Anomanta, n laŋɔ dɛ ka kpoo, dɛkalkɛ n jemɔ kɛŋɔ waa dɔa ɡwɛɡre la, o chola bini la, dɛ o ne sewee.
Ate, n laa o kooɡbɛrɛ ne o baŋe kpɔ ŋɔ ń kpɔ ba tɛɛ la, n dɔɔ.” Belaa Devid ne laa tena baa ja o nɛɛ bwa kɛɛ ba laala a baɡle kɛ ba loo kuu.
Ba ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ne Jonatan ne Israel tena baa ɛ Korowii nɛra la lwe dɛ wii ba, dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa ka tel jɔmɔra, dɛkalkɛ nɛra ɡalɡaa sewɛ laa la ta.
Ate, Devid bɔɔ baa o fa aa baa bol waa o be la ŋɔ, “Leperaa he leɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ ɛ Amalɛk te ya so Israel harɛ ta.” Devid berɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ta ɔmɛ tamaa bɛlbwa dɛ won kpo nɛn Korowii aa cheɡo kora ta nɔɔ?” Ate, Devid yerɛ o laa tena la bini bɛl ŋɔ, “Ír la ka kpoo.” Asɛ o la dɛ ka kpoo.
Dɛ Devid fa bol baa la be ŋɔ, “He waa haa ɛa laanee ɡure he nyu ta la.
Waa aa le he nyoa he ŋɔ henee kpo nɛn Korowii aa cheɡo kora ta laanee ɛ danseɛ.” Devid wi Kooro Sɔɔl ne Jonatan Devid taa ɡɛ wiile aa teŋa nɔ tɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaa Jonatan, dɛ ŋɔ bá kpɔ baɡle Juda baala bá hweli.
Ba chwera do tɔn bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jasar Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Ya nomonome serewɔ Israel deŋɡarere dor.
Na ɡɛ banyoola tenten aa serewa chɔ.
He bɛ an bol bwɛjena Gat tena be, kɛɛ Askɛlɔn fɔɡbaahna.
He bɛ ɡel Filisti haahna no ba sie lɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ bihaahna sie ɛɛ lɛo.
Mɛn kɛɛ bwaala bɛ Gelboa deŋɡarere ta nɛ, o harɛre bɛ won dɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa ɡe kpa!
Banyoola kwaa baa kpɔa tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe dɛɛ yo chɔ bela, baa noo kpɔe dɛɛ fɔɡɛ Kooro Sɔɔl kon waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ o te ɡbemɡbe wɛɛ nyɛɡle kpa.
Jonatan ta o hɛma aa, a nyoa wɔrɔbe, Kooro Sɔɔl ɡe kere aa dawɛ dɛɛ kpo banyoola ne o dɔma.
Kooro Sɔɔl ne Jonatan waa wer ba soɡa bini dɛ dɔ nyokpoa kohona, ba baah ta pere ba seo bini bwa.
Ba ɡbaŋre ɡwaa kee bɛlbwa, dɛ do kpeɡri ɡwaa nyujentena.
Israel haahna, hé wi Kooro Sɔɔl, a do kɛ waa kpɔ yaswɛm dɛɛɡe tɔ heya, dɛ kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa do heya.
Na ɡɛ banyoola aa sewɛ laa ta!
Jonatan sewɔ chɔ Gelboa bwejen doa.
N wio dɛɛ tɛɛ, n nime Jonatan, dɛ n fa dɛ nyin he waa taeh.
He nyina he fa aa dɔa tɛ mɛ dɔ nyokpoa, a ɡwaa ɡɛ haah naa dɛ nyin o bii kɛɛ o jaa kwara.
Na ɡɛ banyoola aa serewa, asɛ ba dɔmkwa chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ!”
Ba cheɡ Devid kora Juda harɛ ta A habɔɔ la, Devid bɔɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, mɛɛ won la ka so Juda bwɛɛre nɔ bɛl ta naa?” Anee Korowii chaŋo ŋɔ “Ɔɔh.” Asɛ Devid berɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Bwɛ besoo ta nɔ?” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Ka so Hɛbrɔn.” Anomanta, Devid ne o haahna banɛ, Ahinoam waa le Jesreel, ne Abiɡel waa ɛ Nabal luhaah dɛ le Kaamɛl la iro, dɛ kaa Hɛbrɔn.
O berɔ kpɔ laa tena baa ja o nɛɛ la ne bɛlbwa haah ne o bii, asɛ ba ka so Hɛbrɔn ne bwɛɛre aa baro la ta.
Belaa Juda baala ba Hɛbrɔn bela, dɛ ba fuɡe noo do Devid nyu ta, dɛ cheɡo Juda harɛ ta kooro.
Devid aa baa no kɛ Jabes Gelead baalaa huɡe Kooro Sɔɔl la, o tomɛ toroma Jabes Gelead baala la be ŋɔ, “Korowii swee heyaa andɛɛɡa kɛ haa nyin he dɔɔ Kooro Sɔɔl dɛ huɡo nɔ.
Kórowii sune he nɛ, dɛ́ cha heya.
N ɡee sune he nɛɛ, dɛ́ cha heya waa haa ɛa nɔ wa.
He bɛ ɔmɛ, hé che kiŋkiŋ, Kooro Sɔɔl waa ɛ he dɔɔ la sewɔ, asɛ Juda dea tena fuɡe noo do n nyu ta, dɛ cheɡ mɛ kora ta.” Ba cheɡ Esbɔsɛt kora Israel harɛ ta Nɛr bibaa Abna waa ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl laa nomoa la lawɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bibaa baa dɛ yerɔ Esbɔsɛt ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la, dɛ ba o ne Mahanaim.
Abna cheɡo kora ta wɛɛ nyiŋi Gelead ne Asuri ne Jesreel ne Efrem ne Bɛnjamen dɛ Israel harɛre bwa ta.
Kooro Sɔɔl bibaa Esbɔsɛt aa baa di kora la, dɛ o di bene fifraanaarɛ.
Bene anɛ ɡboo o di kora.
Kɛ dɛ Juda dea tena te teŋɛ Kooro Devid nɛ.
Kooro Devid di kora Hɛbrɔn Juda dea harɛ ta bene anuanɛ korobie anumɛl.
Awola bɛl, Nɛr bibaa Abna ne Esbɔsɛt nomonome iro le Mahanaim dɛ ba bwɛjen Gebeɔn ta.
Asɛ Joab baa dɛ yerɛ o nya Seruya, ne Kooro Devid nomonome ir le ka chem ba tam bɛl waa chɔ Gebeɔn nyoa.
Kooro Devid ne o nɛra soɡe tam la baŋ bɛl, asɛ banɔ la ɡe so o baŋ bɛl.
Belaa Abna ŋɔ Joab be ŋɔ, “Gel ya yerɛ bonɔɔna le baŋ bɛlbwa ta ba, bá yo ya siwi ta.” Ate, Joab chaŋe ŋɔ, “A wer.” Ate, baala fi dɛ banɛ le Esbɔsɛt ne Bɛnjamen dea, ba ne baala fi dɛ banɛ ba ɡe aa le Devid be pera yo.
Bɛlbwa hamɛ o dɔŋ nyu kpoŋe, ba kpɔ keri tɔɡɛ dɔŋa baŋ bɛla, asɛ ba nɛra fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ la bwa chole dɛ serewe.
Anomanta, ba dɛ yerɛ bela Hɛlkat Hasurim o do Gebeɔn harɛ ta.
Belaa laa chole sibeɡra ne awola, asɛ Kooro Devid baala la pɔ Abna ne Israel tena la nɛ.
Dɛ Seruya bibaala batoro lɔ bela.
Banee Joab ne Abisae dɛ Asahɛl.
Dɛ Asahɛl won chwae kɛŋɔ kweɡla ken.
O chwao ti Abna, o ta kee nyiŋi diɡ kɛɛ ɡal.
Abna baa ke nyiŋi dɛ nao, dɛ ŋɔ, “Henee nɔ naa, Asahɛl?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, menee.” Belaa Abna berɛ ŋɔ, “Bɛ chwa teŋɛ n nɛ, chwa teŋɛ laa tena la bɛl nɛ dɛ́ ka lɛ o dɔmkwa.” Kɛ Asahɛl ta noɛ, dɛ ta chwa teŋɛ o nɛɛ ɡɛ.
Abna berɔ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɛ chwa teŋɛ n nɛɛ ɡɛ.
Bɛ ɡɛ ɛ, ásɛ n ba kpoe.
A ba ɡɛ naa, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona nyiŋi he dɔɔ Joab siwi ta nɔ?” Kɛ Asahɛl vɛoh dɛ ta teŋɛ o nɛ, asɛ Abna ta o lampea la habɔɔ, asɛ o mun daa la ka yaɡɛ o tea dɛ vah le o nyaŋ ta.
Buɡ la ta, o chole chɔ dɛ sewɛ.
Nomɛlbwa valɔ ba tel bela aa, o yon che dɛ́ nyiŋi.
Kɛ Joab ne Abisae ti Abna, wee aa ba dɛ jo la, ba baa tel deŋɡare bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Ama ta.
O bɛne bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Gia ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ kaa Gebeɔn harɛpɛɛ waa chɔa kaa ta.
Ate, Bɛnjamen dea baala ba bar Abna cheme.
Ba boa ba nyoa, asɛ dɛ ka che deŋɡare bɛl doa.
Anee Abna ŋɔ Joab be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ yá yo dɛɛ la ɡɛ naa?
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ bambichɔɡa nee aa ba bala ba tɛ yaa aa?
Harɛ beŋkpoŋ nɛraa yan, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba ɡela he nɛra ɡel chwae dɛɛ ti yaa ɔ?” Anee Joab chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, dɛ ken laa he bol aa, n nɛra la fe ɛɛ ti heyaa ka tel kere chɔɔ.” Belaa Joab hoh bɛla a baɡle kɛ o laa tena la ɡel Israel tena la tii, ba ta yoi kpa.
Awola jwaana la bwa Abna ne o laa tena la valɔ kpɔ Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen bini, mɔɔ dɛ ɛɡɛ le o baŋ.
Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, ba valɔ dɛ ba le Mahanaim.
Joab aa ɡel Abna tii la, o boa o laa tena la bwa nyoa, dɛ na kɛŋɔ ba bini fi dɛ banuanaarɛ sewɔ dɛ ja Asahɛl nɛ.
Dɛ Kooro Devid laa tena la kpoo Abna laa tena lafraatoro fifraanumɛl baa le Bɛnjamen dea.
Joab ne o laa tena kpɔ Asahɛl, dɛ ka huɡo ba lolanar bwebɔɔ waa lɔ Bɛtlɛham bini.
Asɛ ba valɛ awola jwaana la bwa, dɛ ba tel Hɛbrɔn bɔr chaahna saŋ.
Laa la chɔ nɛra ba fa aa teŋɛ Kooro Sɔɔl nɛ ne Kooro Devid laa tena baah biɡri taeh.
Kooro Devid ne o nɛra teŋɔ dɛɛ do kpeɡri, asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o nɛra te nyoa ɛɛ sɔɔh.
Kooro Devid lolɛ bibaala banumɛl Hɛbrɔn.
Biloɡle la sɔne Amnɔn.
O nya sɔne Ahinoam dɛ le Jesreel, nɛɛte sɔne Keleab, o nya sɔne Abiɡel waa ɛ Nabal luhaah dɛ le Kaamɛl, toorote ɡe Absalɔm, o nyaa Maaka.
Gesur Kooro Talmai bihaahnee.
Bibaa waa teŋa naarɛ sɔne Adonija, o nya sɔne Haɡit.
Binue te la ɡe sɔne Sɛfatea, o nya sɔne Abital, binumɛl te la sɔne Itriam, Kooro Devid haah Eɡla biee.
A ɡɛ bibaala nɔɔ Kooro Devid lolɛ Hɛbrɔn.
Abna baa ja Kooro Devid nɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o laa tena ne Kooro Devid ne o laa tena laa la ta la, dɛ nɛra baa teŋɛ Kooro Sɔɔl nɛɛ la dɛ nyin Abna waa taeh.
Dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl fa dɔ sɛno bɛl baa yerɔ Rispa, o nya sɔne Aeya.
Anee Esbɔsɛt bɔɔ Abna ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he lawɛ n mɛɛ haah chɔ nɔɔ?” Asɛ o baah di kohona waa waa bɔɔro la wa dɛ ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛ n ɛ nyoatechɔɡe dɛ do Juda dea tena bini kɛɛ?
Le fini dɛɛ kaa, n kpɔ n te do he mɛɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o lolanar dɛ o daamanar lɔɡa.
N ta he bwara wechɔɡe bolɛ tɛ Kooro Devid, kɛ he dɛ bol ŋɔ n lawɛ he mɛɛ haah chɔ a ɛ waa aa wola were.
N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ dɛ n ta waa Korowii aa baɡɛ Kooro Devid nyoa la ɛɛ tɛo waa, ó tɛr n deŋne kohona, dɛ́ berɛ kora waa lɔ Kooro Sɔɔl luɡe ta la, dɛ́ ɡel Kooro Devid kora che kɛrɛdɛ Israel ne Juda, dɛ́ le Dan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua dɛ́ ba kaa Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr.” Esbɔsɛt ta wone bɔɔ Abna wobɛlbwa kpa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɛ ɔmɔ.
Belaa Abna tomɛ toroma bá ka ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, “Umee dɔ harɛ nɔ kpeɡri ɔ?
Gel n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ n chae dɛ́ ba Israel tena bwa ne he be.” Ate, Kooro Devid sɛh ŋɔ, “A wer ɡa!
N ne hɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee.
Kɛ kombeŋkpoŋii n hiah dɛ́ le he be.
Dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bihaah Mikal ta he nɛɛ jae yaa, bɛ ɡel he naa tire n sie kwara.” Belaa Kooro Devid tomɛ toroma Kooro Sɔɔl bibaa Esbɔsɛt be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ n haah Mikal maa kpɔ Filisti tena lafa pen nyoa tɔne ba ɛ o bwara waa dɛ dɔɔ la tɛ mɛ.” Anomanta, Esbɔsɛt ɡelɔ ba lawɛ Mikal le o jaa Paltiel waa ɛ Laes bibaa dea.
Baa lawɔ dɛɛ kaa la, o jaa Paltiel wio teŋɛ o nɛɛ ka tel bwɛɛ Bahurim ta.
Belaa Abna ŋɔ o be ŋɔ “Berɛ kaa dem!” Asɛ o berɛ kaa.
Abna fa la Israel nomonome be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Saŋ la bwaa he le dɛɛ nyin hé cheɡ Devid he kooro.
Saŋ laanee nɔ!
Hé lii ɡɛ Korowii fa aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, ‘N bonɔɔ Devid nɛɛ mɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ lɛ n nɛra Israel tena le Filisti tena ne ba dɔma bwa nɔn ta.’ ” Abna fa bol Bɛnjamen dea tena be, dɛ la Hɛbrɔn, Kooro Devid be, dɛ ka bol waa Israel tena ne Bɛnjamen dea tena aa sɛah ŋɔ baa ɛo la.
