Ate, baala fifraanɛ ja Abna nɛ ba ba Kooro Devid be Hɛbrɔn, asɛ Kooro Devid ɡel ba daa kondikonjena tɛ o ne baala baa ja o nɛɛ la.
Ate, Abna ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɡel n ir warane dɛ́ la ka bol waa baɡle Israel tena ásɛ ba lɛɛ do, ba ne he fɔwɛ fɔo he di kora harɛ la bwa ta, ɡɛ he fa aa dɛ nyin la, dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.” Anomanta, Devid tɛ Abna ŋwɛnɛ o kaa deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
Abna kpoe wa A habɔɔ la, Kooro Devid laa tena tama bane ne Joab kaa le laa ta ba, ba pa laala pirim le laa la ta ba.
Kɛ dɛ Abna toole Kooro Devid be Hɛbrɔn kpa, dɛ kooro dɔɔ tao ŋwɛnɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ne o kaa.
Joab ne o laa tena bwa aa kaa ba la, ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ Abna ba Kooro Devid be asɛ o tao ŋwɛnɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ne o kaa.
Anomanta, Joab la kooro be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, bɔkwa waa he ɛ ken?
Abna ba he be he berɛ tao ŋwɛnɛ o kaalaa?
Taraken he ɡelɔ o dɔ bɔr kaa!
He ɡbabir jemɛ Abna, o balɔ dɛ́ ba neɡre, dɛ́ ba nyiŋi he ŋwɛnɛre, dɛ́ jemɛ waa bwa haa dɛ ɛ.” Ate, Joab le Kooro Devid be, dɛ ka tomɛ toroma ba chwa ti Abna dɛ ka lawɔ kɔlɔŋ bɛl waa chɔ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sira, dɛ ba o ne.
Dɛ Kooro Devid te aa a wobɛlbwa jemɛ.
Abna aa bera ba Hɛbrɔn la, Joab lawɔ o ne o ka che bwɛjen la doonyojen keŋkeŋ, a do kɛŋɔ waa dɛ nyin kɛ o ne o ɡbo bol waane ken.
Belaa o kpɔ kere tɔɡɛ o tea dɛ kpoo.
Gɛɛ a do Joab kpo Abna bɔ kem, o nime Asahɛl o fa aa kpoo la wa.
A habɔɔ Kooro Devid aa baa no la, o ŋɔ, “N ne n harɛ nɔ ta nɛn bɛlbwa ta bolchɔɡe dii Korowii sie, Abna seo wa.
Korowiirii dɛ́ tɛr Joab ne o lolanar deŋne a wa.
Kórowii kpɔ ŋwɛra kɛɛ bwadabii weechɔɡa, kɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ valɛ daa ne, kɛɛ laa ta seo, kɛɛ kondikwaa nyae, ba ta ba naanar baa ka ba bwa nɛ!” Gɛɛ a do Joab ne o nime Abisae kpo Abna bɔ kem, kpoe waa kpo ba nime Asahɛl laa ta Gebeɔn la wa.
Ate, Kooro Devid ŋɔ Joab ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la be ŋɔ, “Hé kɛɛ he laala dɛ́ kpɔ lweyale tɔ á baɡle kɛŋɔ he loo kuu dɛ́ tɔ Abna lale sie.” Kooro Devid ɡbabir ɡe teŋɛ lale la nɛ.
Ba huɡe Abna Hɛbrɔn asɛ kooro ne nɛra la bwa wiu kohona, o huɡribɔr bela.
Kooro Devid taa wiile nɔ tɛ Abna ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ a chɛ kɛ Abna sewɛ ɡɛne seo waa do ken nɔɔ?
Abna, ba ta he nɔɔra vɔrɔwɛ, kɛɛ dɛ do kwaa he nakpale.
He sewɔ kɛŋɔ nɛn nɛnchɔɡa aa lawɔ ka kpo.” Asɛ nɛra la bwa berɛ wiu ja.
Nɛra la bwa soŋe Kooro Devid ŋɔ ó nyin komɛl do nyoa mɔɔ wee le harɛ.
Kɛ o ta sɛɛh dɛ ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ n kpɔ komɛlbwa do nyoa mɔɔ wee le harɛ naa, Kórowii tɛr n deŋne kohona.” Nɛra la bwa sie lɛ waa kooro aa ɛa la ta, dɛ kpɔ do ba liire bini.
Kasinteŋ, kooro wobɛlbwa waa ɛa lɛ nɛra la bwa sie.
Awola tɔpere la, nɛra la bwa ne Israel tena bwa nao kɛŋɔ kooro nɔn toole Abna seo ta.
Belaa kooro ŋɔ o nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomonjen tenten cholo fini Israel harɛ nɔ ta naa?
Fini, Korowii fuɡe noo do n nyu ta dɛ lee mɛ cheɡ kɛ kooro te, kɛ n ɡwɛɡrɔ.
Seruya bibaala nɔ kpeɡri ɡwaa n nɛ.
Korowiirii dɛ́ bɔ nɛnchɔɡe waa ɛ ɡɛ nɔ kem ɡɛ aa chɛa.”
Esbɔsɛt kpoe wa Kooro Sɔɔl bibaa Esbɔsɛt aa baa no kɛŋɔ Abna sewɛ Hɛbrɔn la, o ɔmɔ asɛ Israel tena bwa ɡe bambile teŋe.
Dɛ Esbɔsɛt dɔ baala banɛ bane ba chɔ nɛra ba yon la ka lɔ tɔ bwɛɛre nɛra nɛɛ dɛ́ pa ba laala nyoa.
Bɛl sɔne Baana, asɛ nɛɛte la ɡe Rekab.
Remɔn waa le Beɛrɔt harɛ ta biirii ban, Bɛnjamen dea.
Ba kpɔ Beɛrɔt nɔ ɛ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ pera, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa lɔ o ta chwao le bela ka so bwɛɛ Getaim.
Ba ɛ hɔɔhra so bela ba le fini.
Dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bibaa Jonatan dɔ bie bɛl baa yerɔ Mɛfebɔsɛt, o ɛ boobi.
Waa di bene anue taa a le Jesreel ba kɛŋɔ Kooro Sɔɔl ne Jonatan sewɔ.
Haah waa dɛ nyiŋi o nɛɛ la aa noa la, o kpɔɔ chwa.
Waa dɛ too nomanta, bie la le o nɔn ta le harɛ, a taa a che o ɛ boobi.
Remɔn bibaala Rekab ne Baana iro ŋɔ ba dɛ kaa Esbɔsɛt dem.
Baa kaa tel bela la, dɛ wee cheɡɛ nyufala, asɛ Esbɔsɛt so dɛɛ onɛ.
Asɛ ba jo kaa dea waa chɔ o bini la ta kɛŋɔ baa dɛ la ka nyin mea ken.
Asɛ dɛ kpɔ kere tɔɡɛ o tea ta dɛ le chwa kaa.
Gɛ saŋ baa lɔ dea la bini la, dɛ Esbɔsɛt chɔ mpa ta.
Baa tɔɡɔ o sewɛ tonɛ la, ba teŋe o nyu.
Ba kpɔɔ valɛ awola jwaana la bwa Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen bini dɛ kaa.
Ba kpɔ Esbɔsɛt nyu ba tɛ Kooro Devid Hɛbrɔn dɛ ŋɔ, “N naa, Esbɔsɛt nyuu la, o mɛɛ fa ɛɛ dɔm dɛɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo la.
Fini Korowii ɡelɔ kooro tɔ o wel Kooro Sɔɔl ne o naanar nɛ.” Ate, Kooro Devid chaŋe Remɔn bibaala Rekab ne Baana ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale bwa ta, kɛŋɔ torome waa ba n be Siklaɡ dɛ ba bol Kooro Sɔɔl seo waa n be la, o liiro kɛŋɔ amanesoma nee o fe ɛɛ ba.
N lawɔ dɛ kpoo, a ɛ amanesoma la kembɔr.
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ chɔ o dea mpa ta nyubinikpeɡ tena ka kpoo waa bola ɔ?
A ta chɛ kɛ o seo ɡure he nyu ta ń kpoo heyaa bɔ kem le harɛ nɔ ta naa?” Anomanta, Kooro Devid tɛ o laa tena ŋwɛnɛ asɛ ba ka kpoo Rekab ne Baana.
Ba teŋni ba nɔɔra ne napaala, dɛ kpɔ ba saɡɛ tam bɛl waa lɔ Hɛbrɔn nyoa.
Kɛ Esbɔsɛt te, ba kpɔ o nyu kaa ka huɡe Abna ŋwam ta Hɛbrɔn.
Devid ɛ Israel harɛ bwa kooro Israel deene la bwa ba Kooro Devid be Hɛbrɔn dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ya bwa ɛ he lolanar dɛ ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ.
Kooro Sɔɔl fa aa ɛ ya kooro la, dɛ henee tɔ ya Israel tena sie dɛɛ la ya ne laa.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Henee dɛ́ nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre ken, dɛ́ ɛ ba kooro.’ ” Anomanta, Israel nomonome la bwa ba Kooro Devid be Hɛbrɔn, o ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo Korowii sie bela, asɛ ba fuɡe noo do Devid nyu ta dɛ cheɡo kora ta Israel harɛ.
Kooro Devid aa di bene fifraatoro taa ba cheɡo kora ta, asɛ o di kora bene fifraanaarɛ.
Waa soɡe Hɛbrɔn la, o di kora Juda bene anuanɛ korobie anumɛl, asɛ Jerusalam ɡe, o di kora Israel ne Juda bwa bene fifraatoro dɛ atoro.
Kooro Devid pɔ Jerusalam tena nɛ Kooro Devid ne o laa tena kpɔ ba te kaa Jerusalam dɛ́ ka yo Jebus tena baa soɡe bela la.
Belaa Jebus tena la ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “Haa won ba ya be bonɔ, hale nyoŋa ne boobie kwaraa ɛɛ won doŋi he berɛ kaa.” Dɛ ba liire bwaa kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid aa won la bela.
Kɛ ane a bwa, o yoo dɛ lɛ Jerusalam baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro la, asɛ baa yerɔ ‘Kooro Devid Bwɛjen’.
Awola tɔpere la, Kooro Devid ŋɔ laa tena la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ won pɔ Jebus tena nɛ aa, atane ó kpɔ bɔɔ nee aa kpɔ o bini dɛɛ ba la ta mɔɔ dɛ́ tel boobie ne nyoŋa la baa ɛ n dɔma la be.
Gɛɛ a do ba yon ŋɔ, ‘Nyoŋa kɛɛ boobie aa koodem la nɔ.’ ” Kooro Devid aa kaa yo Jerusalam dɛ pɔ o nɛra nɛɛ la, o kaa so bela dɛ pa o sɔn Kooro Devid Bwɛjen.
O ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro dɛ le deŋɡare la wee leebɔr pera harɛ waa baro la ta.
Kooro Devid teŋɔ di kpeɡri kohona dɛkalkɛ dɛ Korowii waa ɛ Koronar Bwa Kooro ja o nɛ.
Bwɛjen Taaya Kooro Hiram tomɛ nɛra Kooro Devid be ba kpɔ peleme daa ne kapenta tena, dɛ nɛra baa dɔ bwea kpɔe dɛ́ ma dea wejema, bá ma koodem tɛ Kooro Devid.
Kooro Devid jemɔ kɛŋɔ, Korowiirii cheɡo kora ta Israel harɛ bwa, dɛ ɡel o dɔ kpeɡri o harɛ do wer kohona, o nɛra Israel tena wa.
Kooro Devid aa ir Hɛbrɔn dɛɛ kaa Jerusalam la, o kpɔ o sɛnanar ne o haahna tenten bane ja kaa bela, asɛ o ne ba loɡle bibaala ne bihaahna kohona ja.
Bii baa lola tɛo Jerusalam laanee, Samoa ne Sobab ne Netan dɛ Solomɔn, ne Ibha ne Elisua ne Nɛfɛɡ dɛ Jafia, ne Elisama ne Eliada dɛ Ɛlefɛlɛt.
Kooro Devid pɔ Filisti tena nɛ Filisti tena aa noa kɛŋɔ ba fuɡe noo do Devid nyu ta dɛ cheɡo kora ta Israel harɛ bwa ta la, ba laa tena bwa iro dɛ kaa nyin o bɔr sibeɡra ne, asɛ Kooro Devid ɡe no ba wa, dɛ le ka chem ba bela waa soɡa danjwɛkpeɡ la ta.
Filisti tena la balɔ dɛ ba su Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini bwa.
Belaa Kooro Devid ka bɔɔ le Korowii be ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ń la ka yo Filisti tena nɔ naa?
Hɛɛ kpɔ baa do n nɔn taa kɛɛ?” Asɛ Korowii chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ir kaa, mɛɛ kpɔ baa do he nɔn taa, ásɛ he pɔ ba nɛ.” Anomanta, Kooro Devid iro, dɛ ka yoo ba Baal Pɛrasem, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ nee yon su ba tɔ bobɛlbwa la, ɡɛɛ Korowii ba tɔ n dɔma nɛɛ n sie.” Anomanta, ba dɛ yerɛ bela Baal Pɛrasem.
Filisti tena chwao ɡel ba voɡare bela, asɛ Kooro Devid ne o laa tena paa kaa.
Filisti tena la balɔ ba su Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini ja, asɛ Kooro Devid ka bɔɔ le Korowii be ja, asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ berɛ sie pae dɛ́ kaa ba be.
Hé bar ba ka che ba habɔɔ dɛ́ yoo ba daa ane baa dɛ yera balsam sie bela.
Hé ba dɛ no ba naɡime sii daa la dor aa, hé pa mun dɛɛ yo, a dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii baa tɔ he sie, dɛ́ ka yo Filisti tena la dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.” Gɛɛ Kooro Devid ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa doo bwa, dɛ won doŋi Filisti tena le Gebeɔn ba Gɛsa.
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka ne Jerusalam bala Kooro Devid berɔ boa Israel laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ nyoa ba cheme.
Ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraatoro.
O ne o laa tena la iro le bwɛjen Baala baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Kiriat Jearim waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le bela dɛ́ kaa Jerusalam.
Nemenɛ Korowii sɔn dawɛ Daka la ta, asɛ o so o kookara ta, kena kwaa baa dɛ yera Kerobim la baah ta.
Ba kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Abinadab dem deŋɡare bɛl doa, dɛ kpɔ chɔŋɛ torɔɡofale bɛl ta nabala ɛɛ tɛro.
Abinadab bibaala bane baa dɛ yer ba Ussa ne Ahio, banee ba le ŋɔ baa daah torɔɡo la, asɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la chɔŋɛ o ta, Ahio tɔ sie baa kaa.
Dɛ Kooro Devid ne Israel tena la bwa dɛ lɛ ba sie.
Ba ɡo yela silɛɛ ne kohona, dɛɛ lɔ janjela dɛɛ hoh kalipere, dɛɛ lɔ kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa, dɛɛ yiiɡi loŋa ɡe Korowii sie.
Ba valɔ ba tel Nakɔn mea lɔ bɔr, asɛ nabala aa dɛ tɛɡre Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la lɔ na, asɛ Ussa ta lawɛ Korowii Fɔo Daka la kpoŋe.
Korowii baah di Ussa nɛɛ kohona, dɛkalkɛ o kono kɛ waa lawɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la kpoŋe la.
Anomanta, Ussa sewɔ chɔ Korowii Fɔo Daka la keŋkeŋ.
Belaa Kooro Devid ɡe baah di, ɡɛ Korowii baah aa di Ussa nɛɛ dɛ tɛr o deŋne la wa.
Anomanta, dɛ ba le fini ba dɛ yerɛ bela Pɛrɛs Ussa.
Kooro Devid ɔmɛ Korowii awola tɔpere dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ n kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka nɔ ba n be bonɔ naa, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona nyiŋi o ta nɔ?” Dɛ waa berɛ dɛɛ nyin ó ba Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ne o be Jerusalam kpa.
O ɡelɔ ba kpɔ ba cheɡ Ɔbɛd Edom dem, o le bwɛjen Gat.
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la cheɡɛ Ɔbɛd Edom dem korobie atoro, asɛ Korowii swee o ne o dem tena andɛɛɡa.
Kooro Devid baa no kɛŋɔ Korowii swee Ɔbɛd Edom ne o dem tena, dɛ komɛlbwa waa dɔa andɛɛɡa Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la wa.
Anomanta, o ne Israel tena bane la Ɔbɛd Edom dem silɛɛ ne, dɛ ka kpɔ Daka la ba Jerusalam waa ɛ Devid Bwɛjen la ta.
Baala baa cheɡɛ Daka la aa ta naɡale anumɛl la, Kooro ɡelɔ ba che asɛ o kpo nabal dɛ nao bie waa do noo kohona, dɛ ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Dɛ Kooro Devid do sɔfo batakaarebora efɔd baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe nyarɔ, dɛɛ sa silɛɛ bwa ne Korowii sie o bokpeɡa bwa ne, asɛ o ne Israel tena la bwa kpɔ silɛɛ lɔŋɔre dɛɛ hoh bɛle, dɛ kpɔ Daka la ba Jerusalam.
Baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la dɛɛ jo Jerusalam Devid Bwɛjen la ta la, Kooro Sɔɔl bihaah Mikal aa cheɡɛ tokoro ta dɛ na Kooro Devid o sa dɛɛ hɛɡre la, o sie ta o nɛɛ lɛɛ, dɛ nyiŋu vah.
Israel tena la kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ o chebɔr, tɛnte dea Kooro Devid aa baŋro la bini, asɛ dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah, ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare ba Korowii sie bela.
Kooro Devid aa kpoo kwaa dɛ fuh ɛ sarahare ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare tonɛ la, o soŋe andɛɛɡa Nemenɛ Korowii be tɛ nɛra la.
Belaa o kpɔ paanoo ne daa nɔna ane aa hola dɛ ɛ nɔndel, dɛ ɡrepo daa nɔna aa hola nɔndel tɛ Israel haah ne baa te bɛlbwa.
Asɛ bɛlbwa berɛ kaa o dem.
A habɔɔ Kooro Devid aa kaa dem dɛ ka soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ o dem tena la, Kooro Sɔɔl bihaah Mikal leɔ ba chemo dɛ ŋɔ, “Na ɡɛ Israel kooro aa lɛ sɔn tɛ o te fini ɡɛ.
O ɛ o te kɛ ɡɛne dɛɛ sa o bitoli sie!” Belaa Kooro Devid chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii siee mɛɛ sa.
Onee cheɡ mɛ kora Israel harɛ ta, he mɛɛ kɛɛ he dem te bɛlbwa laa.
Mɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ lɛ n sie Korowii wa, dɛɛ duuru.
A lole kɛŋɔ he dɛ lii kɛ n sae la ɛ sihihwa, kɛ bitoli haa dɛ bol ba waa nɔ ɛɛ kpɔ duuree tɛ mɛ.” Le ɡɛ saŋ la, Kooro Sɔɔl bihaah Mikal ta bie lolɛ kpa dɛ ba sewɛ.
Korowii baɡɛ Kooro Devid nyoa Kooro Devid baa so o koodem asɛ Korowii ɡel o dɔ bosɔɔhna dɛ le o dɔma baa baro cheme bwa be.
Belaa o ŋɔ Korowii keame bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Netan be ŋɔ, “N soɡe koodem baa kpɔ peleme daa kwaaro bini, asɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la te ta che tɛnte dea bini.” Anee Netan chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛ wobɛlbwa aa lɔ he liire bini, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ja he nɛ.” Kɛ awola jwaana la, Korowii ŋɔ Netan be ŋɔ, ó ir la ka ŋɔ o bonɔɔ Devid be ŋɔ, “Henee dɛ́ do dea tɛ mɛ n ba so o bini naa?
Le awola tɔpere maa kpɔ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta ba le fini, n ta dea bini soɡe bwa.
Tɛnte dea binii mɛɛ so ba kpɔ mɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
Bobɛlbwa n ne Israel tena aa laŋa bwa, n ta ba sitɔɔla bɛlbwa maa do ba ŋɔ baa nyiŋi n nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peera be ŋɔe ŋɔ, ba ta peleme daa aa kpeɡa kpɔe kwaa dea tɛ mɛ.
N bonɔɔ Devid, peeraa he teɡɛ dɛɛ la ane dibɔr n ka lawɛ dɛ ba cheɡe kora ta n nɛra Israel tena nɛ.
N ja he nɛ bobɛlbwa haa laŋa, dɛ yo he dɔma baa lɔ he sie dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ tɛɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he sɔn le kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛnjena ken.
Mɛɛ kpɔ harɛ waa ɛ n nɛra Israel tena ɡbaɡba konee tɛɛ ba, bá ka so o ta ba bwara sɔɔh ba.
Nɛnchɔɡa aa ban fiiɡi kpa, ɡɛ a fa aa doa wubwa la, ne ɡɛ maa ɛa dɛ le saŋ maa le sitɔɔla tɛ n nɛra Israel tena la.
Mɛɛ berɔ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna le he dɔma bwa nɔn ta.
Men Korowii, n bol he be ŋɔ he ne he naanaree dɛɛ ba koranar ɛɛ.
Haa ba sewɛ ka pu he naawa la, mɛɛ ɡeloo he ɡbabir bibaala la bini bɛl bá chiɡ he naa ta dɛ́ di kora, ásɛ o kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Onee dɛ́ do n Dea tɛ mɛ n sɔn ta, ásɛ n ɡel o kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Mɛɛ ɛ o mɛɛ, ásɛ o ɛ n bie.
O ɛ wechɔɡa aa, mɛɛ tɛr o deŋnee kɛŋɔ mɛɛ yon dɛɛ tɛr o bie deŋne o wechɔɡa waa la.
Maa n nyinaa laa kpɔ o nɛ, kɛŋɔ maa le Kooro Sɔɔl ne dɛ ɡel he ba chiɡ o naa ta di kora la.
He naanar ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ n ɡel he kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Ate, Netan bol waa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡlo la bwa baɡle Kooro Devid.
Kooro Devid wesoŋa Belaa Kooro Devid ka jo Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr waa baŋro la bini, dɛ ka so Korowii sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, umee n ɡe ne n lolanar, asɛ he ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ dɔŋa bwa tɛ mɛ ken nɔɔ?
Nemenɛ Korowii, he ta ɡelɛ a jaɡɛ bela dɛ ta teŋɛ ɛ ane dɛɛ ja, he berɔ bol he bonɔɔ naanar baa ka ba kerekere ɡe wa.
Nemenɛ Korowii, waa haa ɡela a chɔ le tɛ nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa laanee nɔ naa?
Bɔkwaa men Devid dɔ dɛ́ bol he be jaɔ?
Nemenɛ Korowii, he ɡbabir jemɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ wa.
N Naa Korowii, he cheɡɛ waa haa bola ne waa haa dɛ nyin ɛɛ ta dɛ ɛ wejena nɔ bwa, asɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ jemɛ a wa.
Nemenɛ Korowii, he kan kohona.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ do kɛ hen, ya te jemɔ saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ he ɡboo Korowii.
Harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra toole dɛ do kɛŋɔ he nɛra Israel tena, harɛ beŋkpoŋ nɛra hen Korowii aa lɛɛ ba le wenaale ta Ijipt harɛ dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ he nɛra la.
Wejena ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla haa ɛa tɛɛ ba la bwa ɡelɔ he dɔ sɔn harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
He berɔ doŋi harɛre ane nɛra ne ba voɡa le ba sie.
He lɛ he nɛra Israel tena cheɡ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, asɛ dɛ ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɛ.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel he nyobaɡa haa baɡɛ he bonɔɔ ne o naanar la do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ɛ ɡɛ haa ŋɔa la, á che a ta he dɔ sɔn kohona saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ásɛ nɛra na dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Korowiirii Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛɛ nyiŋi Israel tena nɛ!’ Ásɛ men, he bonɔɔ Devid naanar che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ do he sie saŋ bɛlbwa.
Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, he pili waa nɔ bini baɡle men he bonɔɔ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar ɛ koranar’ Nemenɛ Korowii, henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ!
He waa ɛ kasinteŋ kɛ yaa teŋɛ a ta, asɛ he kpɔ wedɛɛɡa aa do ken baɡɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nyoa nɔ.
N dɛ soŋe kɛ he swee n naanar andɛɛɡa, ásɛ baa di he laworomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Hen Nemenɛ Korowiirii baɡ mɛ a ɡɛ nyoa nɔ.
Sweera haa sweera tɛ n naanar la ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”
Kooro Devid dɔma nɛɛ pɔe A habɔɔ la, Kooro Devid berɔ ka yo Filisti tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ lɛ bwɛjen Gat ne o bwɛɛre aa baro bwa le Filisti tena ba fa aa dɛ di a kpeɡri la be.
O berɔ ka yo Moab tena ɡe dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
O ɡelɔ nɛra baa laɡ ba laa la ta la chɔ harɛ bɔre atoro, asɛ o maɡ ba ŋwɛn ne.
O kpoo nɛra baa chɔa teŋɛ nɛɛ la, dɛ ɡel banɔ la baa chɔa teŋɛ tooro la, o ta ban kpoorɛ.
Gɛɛ a do Moab tena ba do Kooro Devid lɔɡa, dɛ kpɔ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛo.
Belaa Kooro Devid berɛ ka yo Rehob bibaa Soba Kooro Hadadesa, ɡɛ saŋ waa la Yufretis Moo nyoa dɛ ka lɛ bela harɛ ba do o lɔɡa ja la.
Kooro Devid lawɛ Kooro Hadadesa kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore kaɡboŋ, ne laa tena baa soɡe laa torɔɡore bini kaɡboŋa banuanɛ, ne laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ baa dɛ valɛ.
O ɡel kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore la lafa, ne jaɡre ane aa dɛ ba torɔɡore la tɛɡra, dɛ chaa a kabora habɔɔ nadɛɛne.
Siiria tena baa le Damaskɔs balɔ dɛ ba cha Soba Kooro Hadadesa, asɛ Kooro Devid kpoo ba bini nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Kooro Devid bɔne laa tena la bini ba so kuore ta Damaskɔs harɛ ta, asɛ Siiria tena la do o lɔɡa dɛ kpɔ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛo.
Korowii ja Kooro Devid nɛɛ dɛ ɡel bobɛlbwa waa la ka yo la, o pɔ ba nɛ.
Kooro Devid kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa Kooro Hadadesa nomonome aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta la, dɛ ba a ne Jerusalam.
O berɔ pa ayaawa aa wara le Kooro Hadadesa bwɛjena Teba ne Bɛrɔtae ta.
Hamat Kooro Tou aa baa no kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid yo Kooro Hadadesa dɛ pɔ o ne o laa tena bwa nɛɛ la, o tomɛ o bibaa Hadoram Kooro Devid be, o ka jaamo yoi waa kaa yo Kooro Hadadesa dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ la wa.
Dɛ o ne Kooro Tou nɔ yo laa ka.
Hadoram kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ ayaawa kwaa bwa soo siwi ba tɛ Kooro Devid.
Kooro Devid kpɔ a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ dɛ lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii toma, ɡɛ o fa aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm waa paa le harɛre waa kaa yo dɛ pɔ a nɛra nɛɛ la.
A ɡɛ harɛre laanee, Edom ne Moab, ne Amɔn ne Filisti, dɛ Amalɛk.
O berɔ kpɔ kwaa waa paa laa ta le Soba Kooro Rehob bibaa Hadadesa be la ɡe le cheɡ tɛ Korowii toma.
Kooro Devid aa le laa ta ba dɛ kpoo Edom tena nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banuatoro Yar Fɛlembɔjen ta la, o sɔn leo kohona.
O bɔne laa tena la bini kuore ta ba so bwɛɛre ta Edom harɛ bwa, asɛ harɛ la tena bwa do o lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ.
Korowii ja o nɛ, bobɛlbwa waa laŋa ka yo bwa.
Kooro Devid nomonome Kooro Devid di kora Israel harɛ bwa, dɛ nyiŋi o nɛra waa aa toɡra ne kasinteŋ ne.
Dɛ haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Seruya bibaa Joab laanee chɔ laa tena nyoa, asɛ Ahilud bibaa Jehosafat ɡe chwerɛ waa aa chiɡa bwa dɛɛ bil, asɛ Ahitub bibaala Sadɔk ne Abiata bibaala Ahemɛlɛk ɡe ɛ sɔfore, asɛ Seraya ɡe ɛ ba karake waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ do tɔne bini.
Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ɡe ɛ Kɛrɛt ne Pɛlet tena baa dɛ daah kooro la nomoa, asɛ Kooro Devid bibaala ɛɛ ja kooro o waa ta.
Kooro Devid ne Mɛfebɔsɛt Awola bɛl, Kooro Devid bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛl ta ka Kooro Sɔɔl dem ásɛ n koh Jonatan wa dɛ́ ɛo wedɛɛɡe aa?” Dɛ bonɔɔ bɛl lɔ Kooro Sɔɔl dem baa yerɔ Siba.
Ba yerɔ ba kooro sie asɛ o bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Henee baa yerɛ Siba la aa?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ menee, he bonɔɔ.” Belaa kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Nomɛl ta ka Kooro Sɔɔl dem ń nyin o wa ɡɛ maa baɡɛ Korowii nyoa la aa?” Anee Siba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Jonatan bibaa bɛl lole.
O ɛ boobi.” Asɛ kooro bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Leperaa o dɔɔ.” Anee Siba chaŋe ŋɔ, “O lɔ Ameɛl bibaa Makir dem Lo Debar.” Anomanta, Kooro Devid ɡelɔ ba ka kpɔɔ le Makir dem ba.
Jonatan bibaa Mɛfebɔsɛt waa ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl naa aa ba Kooro Devid be la, o ɡuŋu dɛ kpɔ duure tɛo.
Belaa Kooro Devid ŋɔ, “Mɛfebɔsɛt!” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa menee, he bonɔɔ.” Kooro Devid ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, mɛɛ koh he mɛɛ Jonatan waa dɛ́ nyini kɛrɛdɛ.
Mɛɛ berɛ he naa Kooro Sɔɔl harɛ la bwaa tɛɛ, ásɛ n ne he pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwa saŋ bɛlbwa n dem.” Asɛ Mɛfebɔsɛt ɡuŋu ja dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ, maa wola toole wobɛlbwa bini kɛ nyoate lale, ɛɛ ba wona su he siwi ɔ?” Belaa Kooro Devid yerɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bonɔɔ Siba dɛ ŋɔ, “N kpɔ he nomoa komɛlbwa aa ɛ o ne o bii kwaa bwa tɛ o naa Mɛfebɔsɛt.
He ne he bii ne bonɔɔna chɛ kɛŋɔ hé parɛ harɛ la, dɛ́ kpɔ o ta kondikwaa baa tɛo, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ he nomoa naa dɔ kondikwa dɛɛ di.
Onee n ne wɛɛ ba kondikwa dɛɛ dii n dem saŋ bɛlbwa.” Dɛ Siba dɔ bibaala fi dɛ banue dɛ bonɔɔna ɡe fifraanɛ.
Belaa Siba ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ haa do mɛ a ta bwaa.” Anomanta, dɛ Mɛfebɔsɛt dɛ di kondikwa Kooro Devid dem kɛŋɔ koobie ken.
Dɛ Mɛfebɔsɛt bibaa bɛl sɔne Mika, asɛ Siba dem nɛra bwa ɡe ɛ Mɛfebɔsɛt bonɔɔna.
Anomanta, Mɛfebɔsɛt waa ɛ boobi la soɡe Jerusalam, dɛɛ di kwaa kooro dem tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Kooro Devid pɔ Amɔn tena nɛ A habɔɔ la, Amɔn Kooro Nahas baa sewɛ, asɛ o bibaa Hanun ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Anee Kooro Devid lii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ Kooro Nahas bibaa Hanun daramee, ɡɛ n ne o mɛɛ fa aa kpɔ darame la.” Anomanta, kooro tomɛ toroma o be ba ka bwɛɛlo o mɛɛ seo wa.
Toroma la aa tel Kooro Hanun be Amɔn tena harɛ ta la, anee Amɔn nomonjena ŋɔ Kooro Hanun be ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ duuree Kooro Devid kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ he mɛɛ dɛ tomɛ toroma ŋɔ bá ba bwɛɛle nɔ naa?
Toma laa o tom ba ŋɔ bá ba sɔh nyiŋi ya harɛ nɔ, dɛ́ won ba yo yaa dɛ́ pɔ ya nɛ aa?” Anomanta, Kooro Hanun lawɛ Kooro Devid toroma la dɛ fonɛ bɛlbwa tampona pera ta, dɛ teŋni ba laala baa doa la muŋkela bɔra ta, dɛ ɡel ba ba kaa.
Kooro Devid aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o tomɛ toroma ŋɔ bá kpɔ kala ka tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛ ba ɡelɔ sihiih kpo ba kohona.
O ŋɔ toroma la be kɛŋɔ bá ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá so Jeriko ka tel kɛŋɔ ba tampona la aa moɡa mɔɔ bá berɛ ba.
Amɔn tena la aa na Kooro Devid bandia kɛŋɔ o mee le ba we-ɛɛla ta la, ba kaa kpɔ Siiria laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ baa dɛ valɛ le bwɛjena Bɛt Rehob ne Soba, ne Maaka Kooro ne o laa tena kaɡboŋ, dɛ laa tena kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ baa le Tob harɛ ta ɡe ba ba cha ba.
Kooro Devid aa no waa nɔ la, o tomɛ Joab ne laa tena la bwa ŋɔ bá ka yoo ba.
Amɔn tena la kpɔ ba te, dɛ ba che Raba waa ɛ ba bwɛjen la doonyoa, asɛ Siiria tena baa le Soba ne Rehob dɛ laa tena baa le Tob ne Maaka ɡe ka che bwɛɛ la dahare.
Joab nao kɛŋɔ laa tena lɔ o sie ne habɔɔ, anomanta, o le Israel laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba ka che Siiria tena la sie ba ne ba yo.
O kpɔ laa tena la kabora do o nime Abisae nɔn ta, asɛ Abisae kpɔ ba ka che Amɔn tena la sie, ba ne bá yo.
Belaa Joab ŋɔ Abisae be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa na kɛŋɔ Siiria tena la dɛ pɔ n nɛ aa, he ba dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ, dɛ Amɔn tena ɡe kpeɡri ba dɛ ɡwaa he nɛ aa, ń ɡe ba lɛɛ.
Dɔ bambile, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ ɡel ya won yo bansua ne lɛ ya nɛra ne Korowii bwɛjena cheɡ.
Waa aa too Korowii tea laanee wɛɛ ba ɛɛ.” Ate, Joab ne o laa tena kpɔ ba te dɛ ka yo Siiria tena la, asɛ ba chwa le ba sie kaa kwaraa.
Amɔn tena aa na Siiria tena ba chwa dɛɛ kaa la, ba chwao le Abisae be dɛ kaa bwɛjen la bini.
Anomanta, Joab ɡel Amɔn tena la yoi dɛ berɛ ba Jerusalam.
Siiria tena aa naa kɛŋɔ Israel tena pɔ ba nɛɛ la, ba yerɛ ba laa tena la bwa cheme ja.
Asɛ Kooro Hadadesa ɡel ba ka kpɔ Siiria tena baa lɔ Yufretis Moo wee leebɔr baŋ le, asɛ ba ba Helam.
Asɛ Sobak waa ɛ laa sitɔɔ tɔ ba sie.
Kooro Devid aa no waa nɔ la, o boa Israel laa tena bwa nyoa, asɛ ba ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo le dɛ kaa Helam.
Dɛ Siiria laa tena la kpɔ ba te dɛɛ cheme Kooro Devid dɛ́ yoo.
Kɛ Siiria laa tena ta wone che Israel laa tena la sie.
Kooro Devid ne o laa tena kpoo nɛra baa soɡe kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore bini lafraanuanɛ, ne laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ baa dɛ valɛ.
Ba kpo Sobak waa chɔ ba laa tena nyoa la ɡe.
Koranar baa lɔ Kooro Hadadesa lɔɡa aa naa kɛŋɔ Israel tena pɔ ba nɛɛ la, ba ne Kooro Devid kaa fɔwɛ deŋnesɔɔhna fɔo, dɛ kpɔ ba te do o lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ.
Gɛɛ a do Siiria tena ɔmɛ, ba ta Amɔn tena chae kpa.
Kooro Devid ne Batsiiba Lɔmɔɡa saŋ koranar yon dɛɛ la laa la, Kooro Devid tomɛ Joab ne o laa nomonome dɛ Israel laa tena bwa.
Ba kaa yo Amɔn tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ ka bar bwɛjen Raba ɡe cheme dɛ chɔɡ o bwa o berɛ dimɡbia, kɛ Kooro Devid te soɡe Jerusalam.
Awola jɔmɔra bɛl, kooro iro le o chɔɔbɔr dɛ baa valɛ saldoa koodem bela.
O cheɡɛ bela na haah bɛl waa dɛ sɔ ne.
Dɛ o wer tolo taeh, asɛ o tomɛ nomɛl ŋɔ ó ka pɛɛ haah la waa ba tɛo.
Asɛ naate chaŋo ŋɔ, “Eliam bihaah Batsiiba laa aa?
Hiti te baa dɛ yerɔ Uria la haahnee.” Ate, kooro tomɛ toroma ba ka kpɔɔ ba.
Waa bala la, kooro lawɔ chɔ.
Dɛ o bochɔɡa leɔ doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛɛ kpa.
Asɛ o berɛ kaa dem.
A habɔɔ haah la nao kɛŋɔ o kpoŋe tea, asɛ dɛ ɡel Kooro Devid no.
Anomanta, Kooro Devid ɡelɔ ba ka ŋɔ Joab be ŋɔ o dɛ nyin ó na Uria waa ɛ Hiti te la.
Ate, o la ka ŋɔ o be asɛ o ba.
Uria aa bala la, Kooro Devid bɔɔro ɡɛ Joab ne laa tena la bwara aa doa, ne laa la bini waa ɡe bwa.
Ate, kooro ŋɔ Uria be ŋɔ, “La dem dɛ́ ka onɛ tama.” Anomanta, Uria le bela kaa asɛ kooro ɡel ba kpɔ koŋkɛɛla ka tɛo.
Kɛ Uria ta dem kaalɛ, o ne kooro nɛra baa dɛ daahno bwa pɛo chɔ koodem doonyoa bela.
Kooro Devid aa noa kɛŋɔ Uria ta dem kaalɛ la, o yerɔ dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Haa le dem biɡro, aah ɛrɛɛ he ta dem kaalɛ ɔ?” Belaa o chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ne Israel tena, dɛ Juda tena bwa soɡe tɛnte deene bini, asɛ n nomoa Joab ne n dɔɔ kooro laa tena ɡe do laa ta dɛ baŋre ba tɛnte dɛ so kpɔɡ bini.
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona kaa n dem dɛ́ ka di kwaa nyɔ sen lɛ n sie, dɛ́ lawɛ n haah chɔ ɔ?
N ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛ he taa lole nɔ, maa won ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ!” Ate, kooro ŋɔ, “So bonɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ja, ásɛ kere ń ɡel he kaa.” Anomanta, o berɔ chɔ Jerusalam awola tɔɔ per.
Kooro ta nɔn yerɔ o ba o ne o di kwa, o tɛo sen o nyɔ dɛɛ.
Kɛ jɔmɔra la, Uria berɔ kaa ka pu nɛra baa dɛ daah kooro doonyoa bela la, dɛ chɔ o kalaŋ ta o ta dem laŋɛ.
Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Kooro Devid chwerɛ tɔn dɛ kpɔ tɛ Uria ŋɔ ó kpɔ ka tɛ Joab.
Waa aa lɔ tɔn la bini laanee nɔ, “Laa la baa do kpeɡri aa, ɡel Uria ka tɔ sie ásɛ he le habɔɔ, bá kpoo.” Anomanta, Joab ne laa tena la aa bar bwɛjen la cheme la, o kpɔ Uria ka do bela waa jema kɛŋɔ ba dɔma kpeɡri la.
Baala baa lɔ bwɛjen la bini balɔ dɛ ba yo Joab ne o laa tena.
Kooro Devid laa tena la bane serewe, hale Uria waa ɛ Hiti te la ɡe sewɔ.
Asɛ Joab tomɛ torome o kpɔ waa aa chiɡ laa la ta bwa ka tɛ Kooro Devid.
O ŋɔ torome la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ waa aa chiɡ laa la ta bwa ka tɛ kooro tonɛ aa, o baah ken ɛɛ diu o bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ he suuh tel bwɛjen la kohona dɛ yoo ba nɔɔ?
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ baa won che bwɛɛ la danjwɛɛ ta dɛ́ ta heya hɛma kɛɛ?
Hé soh ɡɛ baa kpo Gedeɔn bibaa Abemɛlɛk la aa?
Haah bɛlee cheɡɛ danjwɛɛ ta bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Tɛbɛs dɛ viɡri nambwe o ba le o nɛɛ dɛ kpoo.
Ɛrɛɛ he suuh tel danjwɛɛ la kohona ɡɛ nɔɔ?’ Dɛ kooro bɔɔre naa, he ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘He bonɔɔ Uria waa ɛ Hiti te la ɡe sewɔ.’ ” Anomanta, torome la la kooro be dɛ ka bol waa Joab aa doo ŋɔ ó ka bol o be la bwa.
Torome la ŋɔ, “Ya dɔma la kpeɡri ɡwaa ya nɛ, ba le bwɛjen la bini ba yo yaa baŋ, kɛ ya wono doŋ ba ba berɛ, dɛ chwa kaa bwɛɛ la doonyojen la ta.
Ba cheɡɛ bwɛɛ la danjwɛɛ la ta, dɛ ta yaa hɛma, asɛ kooro bonɔɔna la bane serewe.
He bonɔɔ Uria, Hiti te la ɡe sewɔ.” Belaa Kooro Devid ŋɔ torome la be ŋɔ, “Ka do Joab ɡbemba, dɛ́ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó bɛ ɡel o liire chɔɡ, dɛkalkɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ won sewɛ laa ta.
Ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó takapɔ dɛ́ kpɔ o te kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ka yoo ba ja dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.” Uria haah Batsiiba aa baa no kɛŋɔ o jaa sewɔ la, o wiu.
Waa wiu tonɛ la, kooro ɡelɔ ba ka kpɔɔ ba o be dem o berɛ o haah, dɛ lolɛ bibaa tɛo.
Kɛ Korowii sie ta waa kooro aa ɛa la ta lɛɛ.
Netan di Kooro Devid kasinteŋkpeɡ Awola bɛl, Korowii tomɛ o keame bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Netan Kooro Devid be o ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Baala banɛ banee fa soɡe bwɛɛ bɛl ta.
Bɛl ɛ suuɡate, asɛ bɛl ɡe ɛ nyaa.
Dɛ suuɡate la dɔ peera ne nae kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ dɛ nyaa la ta komɛlbwa dɔe ka ja pelor beŋkpoŋ waa yawɔ ta.
O dɛɛro o ba kpeɡ, o ne o bechale do dem bela.
O kondikwaa tama waa dɔa la binii o bɔne dɛɛ tɛo, wɛɛ nyɔ nee ɡee yaa, atane o numol waa dɛ nyɔ o bini ne, asɛ o lawɔ dɛɛ dawɛ o nakpale ta.
Dɛ pee la do kɛŋɔ bihaah dɛ tɛo.
Awola bɛl, hɔɔh bɛl ba dɛ kaa o ŋwɛnɛ dɛ ba choɡ suuɡa te la.
Kɛ suuɡa te la ta wone kpo o peera kɛɛ nae la bini bɛl ɛ kondikwa tɛo.
Nyaa la pelor beŋkpoŋ laanee o ka lawɛ dɛ ba kpo ɛ kondikwa tɛ hɔɔh la.” Kooro Devid aa no waa nɔ la, o baah di suuɡa te la nɛɛ kohona, dɛ ŋɔ Netan be ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole kɛŋɔ, naate waa ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ deno chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo!
A chɛ kɛ ó bɔ pee la kem bele anaarɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ta nyaa la nɛɛ sune.” Belaa Netan ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, “Henee a ɡɛ nɛn la!
Waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘Menee lɛɛ le Kooro Sɔɔl nɔn ta, dɛ fuɡe noo do he nyu ta, dɛ cheɡe kora Israel harɛ ta.
N kpɔ he dɔɔ Kooro Sɔɔl dem ne o haahna ɡe tɛɛ, dɛ cheɡe kora ta Israel ne Juda bwa ɡe.
Dɛ anɔ ɡbo aa kanaa, n fe berɔ jae ane.
Ɛrɛɛ he vɛh men Korowii waa maa doe a ta dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa ɡɛ nɔɔ?
He ɡelɔ ba kpo Uria Hiti te la, asɛ he kpɔ o haah mo.
Amɔn tena nɔn taa he kpɔɔ do, dɛ ɡel ba kpoo laa ta.
Haa wola n waa ta teŋɛ dɛ ka kpɔ Uria haah mo nomanta, he naanar baa ka ba bwa la ɛɛ sewɛ laa taa, haa deŋnesɔɔhnaa dɔ he dem ɡe bwa.
Men Korowii, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba dem nɛnee mɛɛ ba ɡela ó kpɔ sibeɡra ba ta he nɛ.
Mɛɛ lawɛ he haahnaa tɛ naate he siwi ta, ásɛ o laɡ ba chɔ webaŋa.
Sɔeh he sɔh dɛ ɛ he kwaa la, kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo anɔ chiɡ webaŋa, ásɛ Israel tena bwa na.’ ” Ate, Kooro Devid ŋɔ Netan be ŋɔ, “N ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.” Asɛ Netan ɡe chaŋo ŋɔ, “Korowii kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛɛ, haa sewɛ.
Kɛ haa wola duure kpɔe tɛ Korowii nomanta, he bibaa ɛɛ sewɔɔ.” Kooro Devid bibaa seo wa A habɔɔ la, Netan kaa dem.
Korowii lɔ bibaa Uria haah aa lola tɛ Kooro Devid la bil, wɛɛ we weela.
Kooro Devid soŋe Korowii, kɛŋɔ ó ɡel bie la dɔ bokpeɡa.
Dɛ o vɔwɛ nyoa, dɛ́ yon ka jo dea jwaana dɛ́ chɔ harɛ.
Nomonome baa lɔ o dem yon ba che dɛ́ ŋɔ ó takapɔ ir harɛ, kɛ waa sɛh, dɛ́ vɛh o ne ba pɛɛ dɛ di kwaa kwara.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la, bie la sewɔ.
Dɛ kooro bonɔɔna la dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ baa bol o bee, dɛkalkɛ ba liiro ŋɔ, “Bie la ta aa soɡe le kwaraa la, ya bol waa o be naa, waa chaŋe.
Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona bol o bie nɔ seo waa o be nɔ?
O bambile ken ɛɛ chɔɡoo ó ɛ waane.” Kooro Devid baa na kɛŋɔ o bonɔɔna la ɡbo dɛ ŋwalɛ waane dɔŋa be, asɛ o jemɛ kɛŋɔ o bie la sewɔ.
Belaa o bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Bie la sewɔ kɛɛ?” Ba ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɔɔh o sewɔ.” Ate, o ir che o naa ta dɛ ka sɔ ne, dɛ fɔɡle nosɔɔhsoma dɛ ka kpɔ laalafala do, dɛ kaa Korowii Tɛnte Dea bini dɛ ka tomɔ.
O berɔ le ba kaa o dem, dɛ ɡel ba tɛo kondikwaa o di.
O bonɔɔna la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he we-ɛɛla berɛ do ken?
Bie la ta aa soɡe le la, he vɔwɛ nyoa dɛɛ wi, taraken waa bera sewɛ nɔ, he berɔ ir dɛɛ di kwa.” Asɛ Kooro Devid chaŋe ŋɔ, “O ta aa soɡe le la, n vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ wi kpela.
N liiro kɛŋɔ Korowii ken ɛɛ sune n nɛɛ, ásɛ bie la bɛ sewɛ.
Kɛ taraken waa sewa nɔ, ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ ń berɛ vɔwɛ nyoa jaɔ?
Maa won berɛ ba o ne mkpa ta kpa.
Menee dɛ́ sewɛ kaa o be, o te laa dɛ́ ba n be kpa.” Belaa Kooro Devid larawe o haah Batsiiba bwara, asɛ o ne o chɔ o kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Solomɔn.
Dɛ Korowii dɛ nyin bie la waa taeh, anomanta, Korowii tomɛ o keame Netan ŋɔ ó pa bie la sɔn Jɛdidia.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, Joab teŋɔ dɛ kpɔ o laa tena ka yo Amɔn tena bwɛjen baa dɛ yerɔ Raba o ɛ koobwɛɛ la ta, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ate, Joab tomɛ toroma Kooro Devid be dɛ ŋɔ, “N yo bwɛjen Raba tena dɛ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ bela baa dɔ nee dɛɛ le bwa ta.
Boa he laa tena baa kaa la bwa nyoa, ásɛ ba ba bar bwɛjen la dɛ́ laɡ ba.
Gɛ laa, dɛ menee dɛ́ ka yoo ba dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ aa, n sɔnee bá kpɔ pao.” Anomanta, Kooro Devid boa laa tena la bwa nyoa dɛ la ba ne Bwɛjen Raba dɛ ka yoo ba, dɛ kpɔ bwɛɛ la.
A habɔɔ, Kooro Devid la Raba dɛ ka laa ba voɡ Molɛk kooɡbɛrɛ kpɔ o nyu ta.
O tɔɡre ɛɛ ɛ suuɡaswɛm kilore fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛɛ, ba bil bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa o ta asɛ o kpɔ pi.
O pa ba laaladɛɛɡa kɛrɛdɛ le bwɛjen la ta kaa, asɛ dɛ lawɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta, dɛ ɡel baa peɡri daa dɛɛ loɡɛ para ne kpanfɛre, dɛ ɡel baa teŋe berekese ɡe.
Gɛɛ o ɛ Amɔn bwɛɛre la bwa ta, asɛ o ne o laa tena la bwa berɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Amnɔn ne Taama A habɔɔ la, Kooro Devid bibaa Absalɔm dɔ nimambihaah bɛl waa wola yalɛ baa yerɔ Taama, asɛ Kooro Devid bibaa Amnɔn ɛɛ nyinu.
Dɛ o wer tolo kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Amnɔn sie dɛ lɛ Taama nɛɛ kohona, a ɡel a berɔ weela, dɛkalkɛ a kpeɡri kɛ o dɔɔ, dɛ waa baa bɛlbwa ɡe jemɛ mɔɔ.
Kɛ dɛ Amnɔn dɔ dam bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jonadab.
O mɛɛ sɔne Simea, onee nomoa ka tɛ Kooro Devid lola bini.
Dɛ Jonadab keo taeh.
Awola bɛl, Jonadab bɔɔ Amnɔn ŋɔ, “He ɛ kooro bie, kɛ saŋ bɛlbwa n nae naa, a do kɛŋɔ he sie aa lɛ.
Bɔkwa waa dɛɛ hae nɔ?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin Taama waa ɛ n dɔɔ Absalɔm nimambihaah la.” Ate, Jonadab ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Saah ka chɔ mpa ta kɛŋɔ he bwara dɛ wee ken.
He mɛɛ balɔ ba nae naa, he ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘N dɛ́ soŋe, yerɛ n nimambihaah ó ba tɛ mɛ kondikwa ń di.
Ó ba daa kondikwaa la n siwi ta bonɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛ mɛ ń di.’ ” Anomanta, Amnɔn saahnɔ ka chɔ mpa ta kɛŋɔ o bwara aa dɛ weo ken.
Kooro balɔ ba nao asɛ o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe, ɡel Taama ba dɛ́ ba ɛ n pɛla kondikwaa n siwi ta bonɔ tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n dɔ o nɔn ta kondikwaa di.” Anomanta, Kooro Devid tomɛ nɛra Taama be o koodem bela ŋɔ, “La he dɔɔ Amnɔn be o dem dɛ́ ka daa kondikwaa tɛo.” Asɛ Taama la Amnɔn be o dem dɛ o chɔɔ.
O kpɔ men baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ paanoo la ane dɛ koora, dɛ ɛ o pɛla kondikwaa la o siwi ta.
O kpɔ kondikwaa la do loɡ bini tɛo, o ŋɔ waa di.
Belaa Amnɔn ŋɔ, “Gel nomɛlbwa le bonɔ kaa.” Asɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela bwa kaa.
Belaa Amnɔn ŋɔ Taama be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ kondikwaa la ba tɛ mɛ n chɔɔbɔr, ásɛ n dɔ he nɔn ta kwaa di.” Asɛ o kpɔ kondikwaa la jo dea ka tɛ o dɔɔ Amnɔn.
Waa kpɔa jo ka tɛo la, o ɡuɡru dɛ ŋɔ, “N nimambihaah, ɡel n ne he chɔ.” Asɛ o ŋɔ o dɔɔ be ŋɔ, “Akai, bɛ men ɡuɡri.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ ta chɛ kɛ bá ɛa Israel harɛ nɔ ta!
A ɛ wedoŋa kohona.
Dɛ a ba ɡɛ naa, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona ɡɔɔ nyu nɛra bini nɔ?
He ɡe kwaraa la, sihiih ɛɛ kpoe Israel harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
N poori, ka bol kooro be mɔɔ, waa sɛh ŋɔ n bɛ hen yalɛ.” Kɛ Amnɔn ta o waa la ta sɛɛh, o bokpeɡa aa ɡwaalo nomanta, o wono ɡuɡru o ne o chɔ.
Belaa Amnɔn berɛ haoh kohona.
Kasinteŋ, o haoh dɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ o fa aa dɛ nyinu la.
Asɛ o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir le kaa!” Anee Taama ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Akai.
He doŋ mɛ ŋɔ n le kaa laa, a ɛ wechɔɡa kohona dɛ ɡwaa waa haa kpɔa ɛɛ mɛ nɔ.” Kɛ Amnɔn ta sɛɛh.
O yerɛ o bonɔɔ bɛl dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ haah nɔ le bonɔ kaa dɛ́ laa ɡbera karɛ habɔɔ.” Anomanta, bonɔɔ la lawɔ le dɛ laa ɡbera la laa karɛ habɔɔ.
Dɛ o do batakaarejaŋ ondɛɛɡe bɛl.
Dɛ ɡɛ batakaani laanee kooro bihaahna baa wola baala jemɛ bwa ɛɛ do.
Taama ɛ tɔɔ do o nyu ta dɛ kɛɛ o batakaarejaŋ ondɛɛɡe la.
Dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ nyu dɛ wi kohona dɛɛ kaa.
Belaa o dɔɔ Absalɔm bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He dɔɔ Amnɔn la ɡelɔ he ne o chɔ kɛɛ?
He te hel n nimambie, he dɔɔree on, bɛ nomɛlbwa be bol.” Asɛ Taama so o dɔɔ dem bela, bambichɔɡ ne.
Kooro Devid aa no waa nɔ la, o baah diu kohona.
Absalɔm ɡe ta wedɛɛɡe kɛɛ wechɔɡe bɛlbwa bolɛ baɡle Amnɔn, kɛ dɛ o waa lɔ o bini o haoh, dɛkalkɛ o ɡelɔ sihiih kpo o nimambihaah Taama.
Absalɔm kpo Amnɔn Bene anɛ habɔɔ la, Absalɔm nɛra baa dɛ fonɛ o peera lɔ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Baal Hasɔ.
O bɛne Efrem dea harɛ jwɛh ta, asɛ o ta nɔn yerɛ kooro bibaala bwa ŋɔ bá ba bela.
Belaa Absalɔm la kooro be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa, he bonɔɔ dɔ nɛra ba baa fonɛ o peera pona.
N poori, he ne he nomonome ɛɛ won ba ja ya nɛ aa?” Anee kooro chaŋe ŋɔ, “Akai, n bie, a ta chɛ kɛ ya bwa kaa ka dawɛ he nɛɛ ɡɛ.” Absalɔm soŋe kooro la sie kɛ o ta sɛɛh, kɛ o soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛo.
Ate, Absalɔm berɛ ŋɔ, “A wer, dɛ ɡɛɛ tenaa, tɛ n dɔɔ Amnɔn ŋwɛnɛ ó ba ja ya nɛ.” Asɛ kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ ó ba ja he nɛɔ?” Dɛ Absalɔm ta teŋɔ dɛɛ soŋe, asɛ kooro tɛ Amnɔn ne o bibaala la kar ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa ka ja o nɛ.
Absalɔm daa kondikonjena aa chɛ kooro, dɛ ŋɔ o bonɔɔna be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel he sie do Amnɔn be ɡɛ saŋ waa nyɔ sen dɛ dɛɛ la, mɛɛ lɔ sie he bee, ásɛ he kpoo.
Hé te bɛ ɔmɛ.
Mɛɛ lɛ wobɛlbwaa dawɛ n nɛ.
He bɛ ɔmɛ, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ.” Anomanta, o bonɔɔna la teŋɛ o waa waa baɡ ba la ta, dɛ kpo Amnɔn.
Belaa kooro bibaala la bwa ir, dɛ kpɔ ba keeɡore dɛ chwa kaa.
Ba ta aa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ waa la tɔ sie tel Kooro Devid be kɛŋɔ, “Absalɔm kpoo he bibaala la bwa, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.” Belaa kooro ir che dɛ kɛɛ o laala, dɛ chole harɛ, a baɡle kɛ o loo kuu.
O bonɔɔna baa ja o nɛɛ bela la ɡe kɛɛ ba laala.
Kɛ Kooro Devid dɔɔ Simea, o bibaa baa dɛ yerɔ Jonadab ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he bibaala la bwa laa ba kpoo, Amnɔn ɡboo ɛ nɛn waa sewa.
He ɡbabir ɛɛ won na kɛŋɔ le ɡɛ saŋ Amnɔn aa ɡuɡri Absalɔm nimambie Taama o ne o chɔ la bwaa o le dɛ dɔ ɡɛ liire nɔ o nyu bini.
Anomanta, n dɔɔ, bɛ waa la yarada kɛŋɔ he bibaala la bwa serewɔ, Amnɔn ɡboo ɛ nɛn waa sewa.” Anɔ bwa la, dɛ Absalɔm chwao.
Kooro nɛn waa dɛ daahno la nyiŋo dɛ na nɛra baa wara dɛ do ŋwɛnɛ ta o wee cholibɔr Horonaim pera, deŋɡare bɛl doa.
Waa le belaa o la ka ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N na baala bane baa le deŋɡare la ta Horonaim pera dɛɛ ba.” Anee Jonadab ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa, he bibaala laanee la, a deno ɛ ɡɛ he bonɔɔ aa bola la.” O nyoa aa dena dɛɛ chiɡ, dɛ Kooro Devid bibaala la ɡe deno baa jo dɛɛ wi kohona.
Kooro ne o bonɔɔna la bwa ɡe wio kɛrɛdɛ.
Absalɔm chwao ka so bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Gesur, Kooro Amihud bibaa Talmai be bene atoro.
Dɛ tɔpere te bɛlbwaa Kooro Devid ɛɛ wi o bibaa la wa.
Absalɔm aa chwaa ka so Gesur la, o soɡe bela bene atoro.
Dɛ kooro bambile lawɔ kɛŋɔ ó la Absalɔm be ka nao, dɛkalkɛ o dɔ bolarawa le Amnɔn seo la ta.
Absalɔm berɔ ba Jerusalam Dɛ Seruya bibaa Joab na ɡɛ Kooro Devid aa dɛ lii o bibaa Absalɔm wa o bambile ta.
Anomanta, o ɡelɔ ba ka kpɔ haah bɛl waa jemɛ waa kohona le Tekoa ba.
Haah la aa bala la, o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Saah ɛ he te kɛŋɔ haa lɔ lwe ta ken.
Li he lweyal dɛ bɛ toli di.
Ɛ he te kɛŋɔ haah waa lɔ lwe ta biɡri.
Ásɛ he la kooro be dɛ́ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ o be.” Asɛ Joab baɡlo waa waa ka bol.
Haah baa kaa kpɔɔ le Tekoa la aa la kooro be la, o ba harɛ dɛ kpɔ duure tɛo, dɛ ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, cha mɛ!” Belaa Kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa dɛɛ hae nɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa, luhaahnee men, n jaa sewɔ.
N naa kooro, men maa ɛ he tolo, dɛ n dɔ bibaala banɛ.
Yoi chole ba baah ta awola bɛl kpɔɡ bini, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ larawe ba, asɛ bɛl kpo o dɔŋ.
Anomanta, dea bii la bwa cheɡɛ he tolo nɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Le he bie la waa lɔ o dɔŋ kpo la tɛ yaa ásɛ ya kpoo, o dɔŋ la waa kpoo la wa.’ Ba ɛ ken aa, maa bie bɛlbwaa dɔ kpa.
N hwɛɡa bwa ɡe dɛ ba tona, ásɛ n jaa ɡe aa bibaa bɛlbwaa dɔ o sɔn den he kwaraa.” Ate, kooro ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “Kaa dem, mɛɛ nyiŋi waa la binii dɛ́ bol tɛɛ.” Kɛ haah la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ɡel sɔnchɔɡe la dawɛ n ne n mɛɛ lolanar nɛ, ásɛ he bɛ bolchɔɡe bɛlbwa di.” Ate, kooro chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa bol wobɛlbwa naa, he ba o ne n be, ásɛ o laa sie kpɔ he nɛ.” Haah la ŋɔ, “Amɔ soŋe Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, ásɛ n lole waa chɛ kɛ ó kpo nɛn waa kpo o dɔŋ bɔ kem la, o bɛ wechɔɡa kohona ba ɛ, n binɛɛte la kpoe wa.” Anee kooro chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole kɛŋɔ, wobɛlbwa aa he bie la ɛɛ ba.” Anee haah la berɛ ŋɔ, “N naa, n poori, tɛ men maa ɛ he tolo ŋwɛnɛ ń bol webeŋkpoŋ bɛl ja.” Asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “A wer, bol.” Anee haah la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ Korowii nɛra waa aa wola were ken nɔɔ?
He ta ɡelɛ he ɡbaɡba bie baa lawɔ laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta berɛ ba, anomanta, he ɡbaɡba nyoa wobol pae bolchɔɡe.
Ya bwa ɛɛ serewoo kɛŋɔ baa fuɡe nee ta aa palɛ harɛ, baa wola won berɛ boa a nyoa kpa la ken.
Kɛ Korowii aa ɡel nɛn waa sewa berɛ ba mkpa ta, kɛ kooro fe ɛɛ won che ŋwɛnɛ bɛl ta, dɛ́ ɡel nɛn baa lawɔ laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta berɛ ba o harɛ ta.
N balɔ taraken dɛ́ ba bol waa nɔ n naa kooro be, dɛkalkɛ aahraa nɛra la aah mɛ.
He tolo liiro ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ba ŋɔ kooro bee, o ken ɛɛ no n waa tɛ mɛ.
N naa kooro ken ɛɛ sɛoh dɛ́ lɛ o tolo le nɛn waa dɛ nyin o kpo n ne n bie le harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ yaa nɔ ta.’ N berɔ lii ja kɛŋɔ, hɛɛ ɡeloo n dɔ bosɔɔhna, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he do kɛŋɔ Korowii torome, he jemɛ wechɔɡa ne wedɛɛɡa.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ja he nɛ.” Anee kooro chaŋe haah la ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin n bɔɔre waane, ásɛ he ɡel ń jemɛ a kasinteŋ bwa.” Ate, o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa, wobɛlbwa haa dɔa la, bɔɔ mɛ.” Asɛ kooro la bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Joab nɔn toole waa nɔ ta naa?” Anee o ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, n ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa aa won kpɔ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ sɔeh.
Kpelaa, he bonɔɔ Joab, onee chaɡ mɛ ɡɛ maa ɛ, ne anɔ la maa bol bwa.
He bonɔɔ Joab ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ fee berɛ waa nɔ sie.
N dɔɔ, he dɔ wejema kɛŋɔ Korowii torome, dɛ jemɛ wobɛlbwa aa dɛ chiɡ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.” A habɔɔ la, kooro ŋɔ Joab be ŋɔ, “A wer, mɛɛ ɛo.
Kaa, dɛ́ ka kpɔ Absalɔm ba.” Belaa Joab chole dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ Kooro Devid sie, dɛ kpɔ duure tɛo, dɛ soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ kooro!
O ŋɔ, “N nao kɛŋɔ he sie lɛo, dɛkalkɛ he ɛ waa maa dɛ nyin tɛ mɛ.” Belaa Joab ir dɛ la Gesur ka kpɔ Absalɔm ba Jerusalam.
Anee kooro ŋɔ, “A ta chɛ kɛ Absalɔm so koodem bonɔ, maa nyin kɛ n siwi nao, ó kaa o dem ka so.” Anomanta, Absalɔm kaa so o dem, o ta kooro sie laŋɛ.
Dɛ Israel harɛ ta bwa nomɛlbwa toole dɛ dɔ sɔn o wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ wa kɛŋɔ Absalɔm.
O ta kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, le nyundua ba ta harɛ.
Bena bɛlbwaa wɛɛ fonɛ o nyu, o nyumpona waa fona la ɡbo tɔɡre ɛɛ ɡwaa kilore anɛɛ, ɡɛ kooro aa maɡa bil harɛ la ta.
Bibaala batoro ne bihaah beŋkpoŋii Absalɔm lolɛ.
Bihaah la sɔne Taama.
Dɛ o wer tolo kɛrɛdɛ.
Absalɔm soɡe Jerusalam bene anɛ dɛ o siwi ta kooro nɛɛ dawɛ.
Belaa Absalɔm tomɛ ba ka yerɛ Joab, ásɛ o tomɔ kooro be.
Kɛ o vɛoh, o ta balɛ.
O berɔ tomɛ nɛɛtena ŋɔ bá ka yerɔ, o ta balɛ ja.
Anomanta, Absalɔm ŋɔ o bonɔɔna be ŋɔ, “He nao kɛŋɔ Joab koo teŋɛ n kon ta asɛ o du mea.
Hé la dɛ́ ka kpaa nii do o ta.” Anomanta, o bonɔɔna la laŋɔ dɛ ka kpaa nii do koo la ta.
A habɔɔ, Joab la Absalɔm dem dɛ ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɡel he bonɔɔna ka fuh n koo nɔɔ?” Anee Absalɔm chaŋo ŋɔ, “N tomɔ ŋɔ bá ka ŋɔ he be ŋɔ he ba ásɛ n tomɛ kooro be, dɛ́ fee ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa n le Gesur ba bonɔ nɔ?
A wer kɛ n fe ta aa soɡe bela!’ N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ n la kooro sie, dɛ bolchɔɡe bɛlbwa kwaraa n di aa, he ɡel o kpo mɛ.” Anomanta, Joab la Kooro Devid be dɛ ka bol waa nɔ baɡlo.
Belaa o yerɛ Absalɔm o ba ɡuŋi o sie, asɛ kooro jaamo dɛ ɡbaaro pɛl o te.
Absalɔm vɔrɔwe Kooro Devid vɔrɔwa A habɔɔ la, Absalɔm nyin torɔɡo baa vɔwa dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre la bɛl ne jaɡre, dɛ baala fifraanue baa tɔ o sie.
Absalɔm yon fel ir chɔmbibi, dɛ́ ka che ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa bwɛjen la doonyoa la keŋkeŋ.
Dɛ nomɛl ba waa ne dɛɛ nyin kooro nyiŋi a ta tɛo waa, o yon yerɛ naate dɛ́ bɔɔro bela waa lea.
Dɛ naate chaŋo ŋɔ o le Israel deene la bɛl bini naa, o yon ŋɔ naate be ŋɔ, “He waa la wer dɛ toɡre, kɛ kooro nachiɡnɛn bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ no he waa nɔ.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ n fe aa ɛ nɛn maa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole Israel harɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ nomɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ dɔ wa aa, ń bol dɛ́ fee pa bole ɡɛ aa chɛa tɛo.” Dɛ nomɛlbwa ba Absalɔm sie dɛ ba ɡuŋu waa, ó yon ha nɔn lawɛ naate dɛ́ ɡbaaro pɛl o te.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ɛ Israel tena bwa ba yon kpɔ ba waa ba kooro be ŋɔ ó nyiŋi a ta tɛɛ ba la, asɛ ba bwa berɛ dɛɛ nyin o wa.
Bene anaarɛ habɔɔ la, Absalɔm ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, “Tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń la Bwɛjen Hɛbrɔn, dɛ́ ka chuɡri n nyobaɡa maa baɡɛ Korowii.
Gɛ saŋ he bonɔɔ fa aa lɔ Gesur Siiria harɛ ta la, n baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ Korowii wono berɛ kpɔ mɛ ba Jerusalam aa, mɛɛ tomɔɔ Hɛbrɔn.’ ” Belaa kooro ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kaa deŋnesɔɔhna ne.” Asɛ o kaa Hɛbrɔn.
Absalɔm sɔɔh tomɛ toroma Israel tena deene la be ba ka ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa no bɛle sii yaa, he ŋɔ, ‘Absalɔm di kora Hɛbrɔn.’ ” Dɛ Absalɔm ta nɔn yerɛ baala lafraanɛ le Jerusalam ba ja o nɛɛ kaa, dɛ baa waa la wobɛlbwa jemɛ dɛ ɡe teŋɛ o nɛɛ kaa ɡɛ.
Absalɔm aa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha la, o ɡe tomɔ ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ Ahetofɛl waa ɛ Gilo te la ó le o bwɛɛ Gilo ba.
Dɛ o ɛ nɛn waa dɛ ja Kooro Devid la bini bɛl.
Dɛ Kooro vɔrɔwa Absalɔm aa dɛ vɔrɔwe la waa wer kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ nɛra warɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o nɛ.
Kooro Devid chwao le Jerusalam Awola bɛl, torome bɛl baa ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, “Israel tena bwa bambile lawɛ Absalɔm waa dɛɛ teŋɛ o nɛ.” Belaa Kooro Devid ŋɔ o nomonome baa ja o nɛɛ Jerusalam la be ŋɔ, “Hé dɛ nyin ya chwa le Absalɔm be tenaa, hé ɡel ya le warane!
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, waa biɡri ba bonɔ ba yo yaa, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra yaa lɔ bwɛjen nɔ bini bwa.” Anee nomonome la chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, wobɛlbwa haa ŋɔa la, he bonɔɔna ɛɛ ɛo.” Anomanta, kooro leɔ, asɛ o dem nɛra bwa ne nomonome la teŋɛ o nɛ.
Kɛ o ɡel o sɛnanar fi la te, baa nyiŋi koodem bela.
Kooro ne o nɛra la bwa aa lea dɛ tel sie tama la, ba kaa che.
O nɛra la bwa baa ɡarɔ ta kaa sie, bane Kɛrɛt tena ne Pɛlet tena baa dɛ daahno dɛ Giti tena baa le Gat, dɛ nɛra lafraanumɛl baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la bwa tɔ o sie baa kaa.
Belaa Kooro Devid bɔɔ Itai, Giti te waa le Gat la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he teŋɛ ya nɛɔ?
Berɛ ka so Kooro Absalɔm be.
He ɛ hɔɔh haa le harɛfale ta dɛ ba so bonɔ.
Dɛ tɔpere nɔ ɡbosoroo he den ba.
Maa wola jemɛ bela maa dɛ kaa nɔ, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona ɡel he teŋɛ ya nɛɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe ɔ?
Berɛ kaa ka tɔ he nɛra sie.
Kórowii sune he nɛ, dɛ́ chae.” Anee Itai chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa ne n dɔɔ kooro o ta aa soɡe le kɛŋɔ, bobɛlbwa n dɔɔ kooro aa kaa, dɛ sewee kɛɛ mkpaa yoo, belaa men maa ɛ o bonɔɔ ɡe ɛɛ ba doe.” Kooro Devid ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “A wer, he te pa sie dɛɛ la.” Anomanta, Itai Giti te waa le Gat la ne baala la, dɛ o lolanar baa ja o nɛɛ bwa pa sie kaa.
Nɛra la bwa aa teŋa baa kaa ɡɛ la, bwɛɛ la tena bwa wio kɛrɛdɛ.
Kooro ɡe ɛɡɛ Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen la le, asɛ o nɛra la bwa kpɔ sie pa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ kaa.
Dɛ sɔfo Sadɔk lɔ bela, asɛ Lewi dea tena bwa baa ja o nɛɛ la che Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la.
Ba kpɔɔ cheɡ harɛ, asɛ sɔfo Abiata kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha ka tel kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid ne o nɛra la bwa aa le bwɛjen la ta.
Belaa Kooro Devid ŋɔ sɔfo Sadɔk be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la kaa bwɛjen la ta.
Dɛ Korowii sie lɛ n nɛ aa, wɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ mɛ ba, dɛ́ ɡel n nao ne bela waa cheɡa bwa.
Kɛ o sie ta n nɛɛ lɛɛ yaa, ó ɛ ɡɛ bwa aa too o tea.” Kooro Devid berɔ ŋɔ sɔfo Sadɔk be ŋɔ, “He dɛ no waa mun.
Lawɛ he bibaa Ahimas ne Abiata bibaa Jonatan, ásɛ he berɛ kaa bwɛjen la ta deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Mɛɛ dɛɛ kpa leebɔɔ baa cheɡɛ o ta le dɛɛ kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta belaa, ka tel kɛŋɔ maa no waane le he be.” Anomanta, Sadɔk ne Abiata baa ɛ sɔfore berɔ kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la kaa Jerusalam dɛ ka so bela.
Kooro Devid teŋɔ teeh kaa Ɔlevere Bwejen la doa dɛ kaa wi, o kpɔ kon bɔle nyu dɛɛ valɛ nakpapɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ o loo kuu.
Nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa ɡe kpɔ kwaa tɔ nyuune dɛ wi teŋɛ, dɛ teeh dɛɛ kaa.
Dɛ ba ŋɔ Kooro Devid be kɛŋɔ Ahetofɛl ja Absalɔm nɛra o ne baa dɛ vɔrɔwe waa la nɛ.
Anomanta, Kooro soŋɔ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ɡel Ahetofɛl liire bwa berɛ wepuu.” Kooro Devid aa tel bwe la doa, bela nɛra yon dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la, dɛ Husai waa ɛ Aaki te lɔ bela, dɛ ba chemo.
Dɛ o batakaare kɛɛrɔ, asɛ teera su o nyu bwa.
Anee Kooro Devid ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He ŋɔ hɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ kaa laa, aa tɔnɔ bɛlbwaa dɔ tɛ mɛ.
Waa haa ɛ á won cha mɛ laanee kɛ, he berɛ kaa bwɛjen la ta, dɛ́ ka ŋɔ Absalɔm be kɛŋɔ taraken te hɛɛ berɔ tomɔ kasinteŋ ne, ɡɛ haa tomɛ o mɛɛ la.
Ásɛ he takapɔ kɛŋɔ Ahetofɛl liire bɛlbwa waa ba a ne la, hɛɛ lɔɔ ta.
Sadɔk ne Abiata baa ɛ sɔfore bwa ɛɛ do he be belaa, wobɛlbwa haa no kooro dem bela la, bol ba be.
Dɛ sɔfo Sadɔk bibaa Ahimas ne Sɔfo Abiata bibaa Jonatan ja ba nɛɛ bela.
He dɔ wobɛlbwa naa, hɛɛ won tom ba n be ba ba bol.” Gɛɛ a do, asɛ Kooro Devid dam Husai berɛ kaa bwɛjen Jerusalam, dɛ namee Absalɔm ɡe den dɛɛ jo bwɛɛ la bini.
Kooro Devid ne Siba Kooro Devid aa kaa sie tama bwe la doa la, Mɛfebɔsɛt bonɔɔ Siba den le bela ba chemo.
Dɛ o dɔ keeɡore ane, dɛ kpɔ paanoo lafraanɛ ne ɡrepo daa nɔna aa hola nɔndela lafa, ne fiɡ daa nɔna aa hola nɔndela lafa, dɛ sen oltɔn pur del.
Asɛ Kooro Devid bɔɔ Siba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ la ka ɛ anɔ bwa ne nɔ?” Ate, o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, keeɡore nɔ ɛ hen n naa kooro ne he haahna, ne bii bwa kwa, ásɛ baa so a ta.
Paanoo la ne daa nɔna nɔ ɡe ɛ kwaa baala nɔ aa di, asɛ sen la ɡe, banɔ la baa ka ɡwɛɡre pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la nyɔ dɛ́ do kpeɡri.” Belaa kooro bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Leperaa he nomoa naa Mɛfebɔsɛt la dɔɔ?” Anee Siba chaŋo ŋɔ, “O soɡe Jerusalam dɛkalkɛ o liiro ŋɔ, ‘Fini Israel tena ɛɛ berɔ kpɔ mɛ cheɡ n nabaa Kooro Sɔɔl naa ta, ń di kora.’ ” Ate, kooro ŋɔ Siba be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ŋɔ he be kɛŋɔ komɛlbwa aa ɛ Mɛfebɔsɛt kwaa la ɛ he kwaa taraken.” Asɛ Siba ŋɔ, “N dɛ duuri, N naa kooro, ɡel he sie lɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛ.” Simei taah Kooro Devid Kooro Devid aa baa tel bwɛɛ Bahurim la, Gɛra bibaa Simei waa le dea Kooro Sɔɔl aa le o ta balɔ ba chemo.
Waa lea dɛɛ ba dɛ o dɛ taahno.
Dɛ a lole kɛŋɔ Kooro laa tena ne nɛra baa dɛ daahno bwa baro cheme te, kɛ dɛ Simei dɛ foɡre o ne o nomonome bwa bwea, Simei taahno dɛ ŋɔ, “Le bonɔ kaa!
Le bonɔ kaa!
Nɛŋkpoa nɛn bɛl le!
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ kohona!
Korowiirii bɔe kem Kooro Sɔɔl dem nɛra haa kpoora dɛ ba so o buɡ ta la.
Korowii kpɔ he kora la tɛ he bibaa Absalɔm.
He kora chɔɡɔ, nyubinikpeɡ haa ɛa kohona dɛ kpoo nɛra la wa.” Belaa Abisae baa dɛ yerɛ o nya Seruya la ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa, ɛrɛɛ he ɡel nɛn waa wola toole wobɛlbwa bini kɛ nyoate lale ɡe ɛɛ taahne ken?
Gel n la ka teŋe o nyu le bela!” Ate, kooro ŋɔ, “Abisae ne Joab, bɔkwa waa n ne he dɔ ɛɛ yɔ?
Dɛ Korowiirii ŋɔa Abisae taah men Devid aa, umee dɛ́ won bɔɔ ŋɔ ɛrɛ waa wɛɛ ɛ ken ɔ?” Belaa Kooro Devid ŋɔ Abisae ne o nomonome la bwa be ŋɔ, “N bilole ɡbabir dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo, ɛrɛɛ he ɡel Bɛnjamen dea nɛn nɔ wa ɛɛ ɛɛ nyokpoa ɔ?
Hé ɡelo wɛɛ taah, Korowiirii tɛo ŋwɛnɛ.
Korowii ken ɛɛ na n suna maa dɛ di nɔɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ wedɛɛɡa ba chiɡ taahna aa dɛ ba n nɛɛ fini nɔ naa ta.” Kooro Devid ne o nɛra kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ la ta dɛɛ kaa, asɛ Simei ɡe kpɔ deŋɡare la ta ba baŋ bɛl dɛɛ taah, dɛɛ foɡ ba bwea, dɛ ɡo tee dɛɛ ta ba nɛ.
Kooro ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa koɔh ken ɡɛ saŋ baa kaa tel Jɔɔdan Moo ta, asɛ dɛ onɛ.
Absalɔm la Jerusalam Absalɔm ne Israel tena bwa ba Jerusalam, dɛ Ahetofɛl ja ba bini.
Belaa Husai waa ɛ Aaki te, Kooro Devid dam la, la Absalɔm be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛ kooro mkpajaŋ!
Korowii tɛ kooro mkpajaŋ!” Anee Absalɔm bɔɔ Husai ŋɔ, “He nyina haa dɛ chaɡle he dam Kooro Devid nɛɛ nɔ naa?
Ɛrɛɛ he ne waa wola kaalɛ ɔ?” Ate, Husai ɡe ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Akai, nɛn Korowii ne Israel tena nɔ bwa aa leo la, o nɛɛ mɛɛ ba teŋa n ne ó do le.
Dɛ Absalɔm laa ń tomaa, umee ń tomɛ jaɔ?
Gɛ maa tomɛ he mɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba he ɡe toma.” Ate, Absalɔm ŋɔ Ahetofɛl be ŋɔ, “Yaa lɔ bonɔ nɔ, baɡle yaa ɡɛ yaa ɛ.” Anee Ahetofɛl chaŋe ŋɔ, “La ka lawɛ he mɛɛ sɛnanar waa ɡel ba habɔɔ baa daah koodem la he ne ba chɔ.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel Israel tena bwa no kɛŋɔ he ɛ he mɛɛ dɔm kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra baa ja he nɛɛ la bwara do kpeɡri name.” Anomanta, ba baŋre tɛnte dea koodem bela saldoa tɛ Absalɔm, asɛ o lawɛ o mɛɛ sɛnanar la chɔ Israel tena la bwa siwi ta.
Saŋ la, dɛ Ahetofɛl bol wobɛlbwa naa, Kooro Devid ne Absalɔm dɛ yaradao kɛŋɔ a ɛ waa waa bɔɔra le Korowii be.
Husai neɡre Absalɔm A ta biɡre Ahetofɛl berɛ ŋɔ Absalɔm be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ laa tena la kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛɛ le jwaana nɔ ne, dɛ́ ti Kooro Devid.
Mɛɛ lao ka lɔ tɔ o nɛ ɡɛ saŋ waa koah dɛ ɡwɛɡre.
A ba ɡɛ naa, ɔmee ɛɛ chole o nɛɛ, ásɛ o nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa chwa kaa.
Mɛɛ kpo Kooro Devid ɡboo, dɛ́ berɛ lawɛ nɛra la bwa ba tɛɛ.
Naate haa dɛ nyinu la sewaa, anee dɛ́ baɡle kɛ nɛra la bwa berɔ ba he be, wobɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ba ba nɛ.” Absalɔm ne Israel nomonome la bwa lii a ɡɛ waa nɔ kɛŋɔ a ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Anee Absalɔm ŋɔ, “Yerɛ Husai Aaki te la, ásɛ ya no waa waa dɔa dɛ bol.” Husai aa bala la, Absalɔm ŋɔ, “Waa Ahetofɛl aa baɡle yaa laanee nɔ.
Yá teŋɛ a ta naa?
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, ɛrɛɛ he liire ɔ?” Anee Husai chaŋo ŋɔ, “Waa Ahetofɛl aa baɡla la aa were tɛ yaa taraken.
He ɡbabir jemɛ ɡɛ he mɛɛ ne o laa tena aa kpeɡa dɛ won yoi.
Ba kpeɡri dɛ do ɔma kɛŋɔ sisire hansɔɔh baa pa o bii kaa ken.
He mɛɛ jemɛ yoi waa kɛrɛdɛ, waa sɛh so o ne o laa tena so jwaana beŋkpoŋ ɡba.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, o ka sɔh bwebɔɔ bɛl bini kɛɛ bobɛl kwara.
O tɔ sie kpɔ o laa tena ba yoi asɛ nomɛlbwa no a wa aa, wɛɛ ŋɔɔ o pɔ he nɛ.
Hale banyoola baa do ɔma kɛŋɔ nyujente ɡba la dɛ ɔmɔ, dɛkalkɛ nomɛlbwa waa lɔ Israel harɛ ta jemɔ kɛ he mɛɛ ɛ banyoo tenten, o laa tena ɡe do kpeɡri.
Anomanta, waa maa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, he boa Israel tena nyoa le Dan dea waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua pera, dɛ́ ba kaa Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr baa wara kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle dɛ do harɛ la bobɛlbwa, ásɛ he ɡbaɡba tɔ ba sie la ba ne laa.
Ásɛ bobɛlbwa Kooro Devid aa lole la, yaa ɡaaɡe o bɔree dɛ́ nao, o ne jara dɛ ya kaa yoo.
O ne o laa tena la bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ka.
Dɛ o berɔ ba jo bwɛjen la bini naa, Israel tena bwa ɛɛ kpɔ ŋwɛɛraa ba tɛɡre danjwɛkpeɡ la ó kuuɡi chɔ fɛlembɔjen la bini, ka tel kɛŋɔ nɛn aa wola bwe beŋkpoŋ kwaraa na bela kpa.” Belaa Absalɔm ne Israel tena la bwa ŋɔ, “Husai waa ɛ Aaki te waa waa dɛ baɡle la ɡwaa anɔ la Ahetofɛl aa bola la.” Korowii ɡbabirii ɛa kɛŋɔ wedɛɛɡa Ahetofɛl aa bola la, ba bɛ a ta teŋɛ, ásɛ a ba wenaale ne ba ta Absalɔm nɛ.
Anee Husai ŋɔ Sadɔk ne Abiata baa ɛ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “Ahetofɛl baɡle Absalɔm ne Israel nomonome ŋɔ bá ɛ ken ne ken, kɛ n ja ba ŋɔ ba bɛ anɔ ɛ.” Husai berɔ ŋɔ, “Tomɛ nɛra Kooro Devid be warane ŋɔ, ‘Dɛɛ berɛ leebɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela chɔe jwaana, hé ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la le warane, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba bɛ kooro ne o laa tena bwa lawɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba.’ ” Dɛ sɔfo Abiata bibaa Jonatan ne sɔfo Sadɔk bibaa Ahimas lɔ Jerusalam dahare, bule waa chɔ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Ɛn Roɡel ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ baa nyin kɛ nomɛl na ba báa jo bwɛjen la bini.
Dɛ bitolo bɛlee lɔ bela dɛ yon la ba be dɛ kaa bol waa aa dɛ chiɡ, ásɛ ba ɡe berɛ ka bol kooro be.
Kɛ awola bɛl, bonɔɔ bɛl na ba asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Absalɔm be, anomanta, ba nɛra banɛ la ɛ warane chwa ka sɔh baa bɛl waa lɔ Bahurim dem.
O dɔ kɔlɔŋ bɛl o dembaah, asɛ ba ka jo o bini.
Baa la haah paɡri kon bɔle kɔlɔŋ la nyoa, dɛ kpɔ boyu yaa o ta, nomɛlbwa ta jemɛ kɛ ba lɔ o bini.
Absalɔm nɛra la ba dem bela dɛ ba bɔɔ haah la ŋɔ, “Leperaa Ahimas ne Jonatan dɔɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ba ɛɡɛ nenabɔɔ la le kaa.” Baala la nyin ba bɔr, ba ta ban nae, dɛ berɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Baala la aa kaala habɔɔ la, Ahimas ne Jonatan le kɔlɔŋ la bini, dɛ kpɔ ba te ka baɡle Kooro Devid.
Ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he te, dɛ́ ɛ warane ka ɛɡɛ nee la le, dɛ́ chwa kaa.
Ahetofɛl dɛ vɔrɔwe he vɔrɔwa.” Anomanta, Kooro Devid ne o nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa kpɔ ba te, dɛ ka ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la kaa o baŋ.
Tɔɔ ne pera dɛ ba bwa ɡalɔ kaa.
Ahetofɛl aa naa kɛŋɔ ba ta o waa la ta teŋɛ la, o pa laala dawɛ o keeɡo ta dɛ kpɔ sie pa o bwɛɛ dɛ kaa.
O baa kwaa o dem wobɛlbwa tonɛ dɛ ka saɡɛ o te.
Waa sewa la, o mɛɛwa huɡri bɔree ba ka huɡo.
Kooro Devid la bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Mahanaim asɛ Absalɔm ne Israel laa tena la bwa ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la.
Dɛ Absalɔm le Amasa o chiɡ Joab naa ta dɛ chɔ laa tena la nyoa.
Amasa mɛɛ sɔne Jɛta, o le Israel harɛ ta.
O nya sɔne Abiɡel.
Abiɡel ɡe nya sɔne Nahas asɛ o nahaah ɛ Joab nya baa dɛ yerɔ Seruya la.
Israel tena la ne Absalɔm baŋre ba tɛnte deene Gelead harɛ ta.
Kooro Devid aa tel Mahanaim la, Nahas bibaa Sobi waa le bwɛjen Raba waa lɔ Amɔn harɛ laanee baa chemo, dɛ Ameɛl bibaa Makir waa le Lo Debar, ne Baasilai waa le Roɡelim dɛ do Gelead harɛ ta, ba kpɔ laala baa dɛ chɔ a ta ne loɡa, dɛ kwaa baa maa ba tɛo.
Ba kpɔ mea ne mendɛɛɡa aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ ne boyuhala ne chebe, ne tohno ne peera dɛ waɡasi ba tɛ kooro ne o nɛra ba di.
Ba liiro ŋɔ lɔr ne nyɔɡre ɛɛ kpo Kooro Devid ne o nɛra laanee, ásɛ ba koh pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela.
Absalɔm seo wa Kooro Devid boa laa tena baa ja o nɛɛ la nyoa, dɛ bɔne ba bini kaɡboŋa ne lafare, dɛ le nomonome ba chɔ ba nyoo.
O bɔne laa tena la bini kuore atoro dɛ tom ba.
Joab chɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ nyoa, asɛ Seruya bibaa Abisae waa ɛ Joab nime la chɔ nɛɛte nyoa, asɛ Itai waa ɛ Gat te la ɡe chɔ toorote nyoa.
O ŋɔ o laa tena la be ŋɔ, “N ne heyaa dɛɛ ba kaala.” Anee ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “N naa, a ta chɛ kɛ he ja ya nɛɛ kaa ɡɛ.
A kaa ba kɛ ya dɔma sii ya nɛɛ yaa chwa aa, a ta waane ɛɛ.
Ya pera kwaraa serewɔ aa, aa ban waanee ɛ.
He ɡwaa yaa nɛra kaɡboŋa fi, a wer kɛŋɔ he te so bwɛjen nɔ bini, ásɛ ya hiah chae bɛl aa, he ba cha yaa.” Anee kooro chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa too he tea laanee.” Anomanta, kooro kaa che bwɛɛ la doonyoa la jwɛh, asɛ laa tena la ɛ ɡɛ baa bɔne ba bini lafare ne kaɡboŋa la.
Kooro berɔ ŋɔ Joab ne Abisae dɛ Itai be ŋɔ, “Hé koh n waa dɛ́ nyiŋi Absalɔm kɛrɛdɛ.” Asɛ laa tena la bwa no kooro waa waa kpɔa tɛ nomonome la.
Kooro Devid laa tena la kaa kpɔɡ bini dɛ ka yo Israel tena, kɔr bɛl bini, Efrem dea harɛ ta.
Kooro laa tena la yoo, dɛ pɔ Israel tena la nɛ.
Nɛra baa serewa awola tɔpere warɔ taeh.
Baala kaɡboŋa fifraanɛɛ serewa.
Laa la yɛɛrɔ kaa bwɛɛ la dahare bwa, asɛ nɛra serewe kɔr la bini dɛ ɡwaa banɔ la baa sewɛ laa la ta.
Absalɔm soɡe keeɡo bie ta dɛ den cheme kooro laa tena la, dɛ keeɡo la dɛ jo dajen bɛl lɔɡa, asɛ Absalɔm nyu ka karɛ daa la kpala ta.
O saɡɛ daa la ta, asɛ keeɡo la na tɛr do dɛɛ kaa.
Kooro Devid laa tena la bɛl nao dɛ ŋɔ Joab be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n na Absalɔm o saɡɛ dajen bɛl ta.” Belaa Joab chaŋe ŋɔ, “Haa nao ɡɛ la, ɛrɛɛ he ta on kpoe buɡ ta nɔ?
N ɡbabir fe ɛɛ tɛɛ suuɡapoŋa fi ne banyoo kiriso waa dɛ yo o ne laalee.” Anee baa la ɡe chaŋɔ ŋɔ, “He tɛ mɛ suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋ kwaraa naa, maa nɔnee kpɔ leɡe n dɔɔ kooro bibaa.
Ya bwa no kooro waa waa bol he ne Abisae dɛ Itai be ŋɔ, ‘He koh n wa dɛ́ nyiŋi Absalɔm kɛrɛdɛ.’ Dɛ n vɛh kooro waa la dɛ fee kpo Absalɔm aa, o fe no a wa, wobɛlbwa toole waa wola no.
He fe aa n habɔɔ cheɡa ba, ásɛ n fee di a bolchɔɡe.” Ate, Joab ŋɔ, “Maa ŋɔ n dɛ che dɛ biɡri kpa.” Anomanta, o kpɔ lampeare atoro dɛ yaɡɛ Absalɔm bambile ta, o siwi ta aa lole o saɡɛ dajen la ta la.
Asɛ Joab laa tena la fi den ba lɔ tɔ Absalɔm nɛ dɛ kpoo.
Belaa Joab hoh bɛla, asɛ Kooro Devid laa tena la ɡel Israel tena nɛɛ teŋa dɛ yoo ba.
Ba kpɔ Absalɔm chɔɔ la ta bɔluŋ bɛl bini kɔr la bini, dɛ pa bwea dawɛ o nɛ a daŋɛ kohona.
Asɛ Israel tena la bwa chwa kaa ba deremi.
Absalɔm fa aa soɡe le la, o ma komɛl dɛ kpɔ tɛ o te ba kpɔ dɛɛ liiru bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kooro Fɛlembɔjen ta.
O liiro ŋɔ, “N ta bibaa lolɛ á che o nɛɛ ń dɔ sɔn.” O kpɔ kon la sɔn pa o te, anomanta, ba le fini ba dɛ yerɛ kon la Absalɔm Kon Baa Kpɔ Dɛɛ Liiru.
Kooro Devid wi o bie Absalɔm Belaa sɔfo Sadɔk bibaa Ahimas ŋɔ Joab be ŋɔ, “Gel n chwa la ka ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ Korowii lɛo le o dɔma nɔn ta.” Belaa Joab ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Akai, he laa dɛ́ la kala nɔ ne fini.
Gel tɔpebɛl wee mɔɔ, fini te laa, dɛkalkɛ kooro bibaa sewɔ.” Belaa Joab ŋɔ o bonɔɔ bɛl waa le Itiopia harɛ be ŋɔ, “La dɛ́ ka baɡle waa haa naa kooro be.” Ate, o ɡuŋi Joab dɛ chwa kaa.
Anee sɔfo Sadɔk bibaa Ahimas ŋɔ Joab be ŋɔ, “Gɛ bɛlbwa aa do, ɡel n chwa teŋɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ nɛ.” Kɛ Joab chaŋo ŋɔ, “N bie, bɔkwa waa he siwi beɡre kɛ he la bɛl nɔɔ?
Komɛlbwa toole he dɔ le a ta.” Ahimas berɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ aa doa bwa, mɛɛ chwao teŋɛ.” Anomanta, Joab ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ chwae kaa!” Belaa Ahimas chwa kpɔ deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa Jɔɔdan Moo pera la ta, dɛ tɔ Itiopia bonɔɔ la sie.
Dɛ Kooro Devid ta soɡe bwɛjen la bini doonyoa ne baŋ kon la baah ta, nɛn waa dɛ daah bela la teehnɔ kaa danjwɛɛ la kaa ka che o doa, dɛ ka pɛl o doonyoa.
Waa dɛ nyiŋi la o na baa bɛl waa dɛ chwa.
Belaa o yerɛ kooro dɛ ŋɔ o be.
Asɛ kooro ŋɔ, “Dɛ o ɡboo tenaa, o ken dɛ ba amanesoma ne.” Dɛ balaa baa la ɡe na dɛɛ ba.
Nɛn waa dɛ daah bela la berɔ na baa bɛl ɡe o ɡbo aa dɛ chwa, asɛ o yerɛ nɛn waa dɛ daah doonyoa la ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na, baa bɛl ɡe ɡbo chwao dɛɛ ba.” Anee kooro ŋɔ, “Amanesoma nee o ken ɛɛ ba.” Belaa nɛn waa dɛ daah bela la ŋɔ, “N dɛ na kɛŋɔ baa waa tɔ sie la dɛ le sɔfo Sadɔk bibaa Ahimas.” Asɛ kooro ŋɔ, “O ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe.
Amanesoma nee wɛɛ ba.” Ate, Ahimas kpɔ silɛɛ yerɛ kooro ŋɔ, “Wobɛlbwa maɡrɔ.” O ɡuŋi kooro sie dɛ kpɔ duure tɛo dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɔ jam!
O ɡelɔ he pɔ nɛra baa ɛɛ dɔm la nɛ!” Belaa kooro bɔɔ bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, “Absalɔm le a nyoa aa?” Anee Ahimas chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa, Joab aa dɛ ba men toma la, n na wesaɡasaɡare ane, kɛ men he bonɔɔ aa a ɡɛ waa la bɛlbwa bini jemɛ.” Ate, kooro ŋɔ, “Kaa ka che baŋ bɛl dɛɛ kpa.” Anomanta, o kaa che baŋ bɛl dɛɛ kpa.
Belaa Itiopia bonɔɔ la ba dɛ ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛɛ no amanesoma nɔ!
Korowii lɛɛ le he dɔma baa cheɡɛ he nɛɛ nɔn ta fini.” Anee Kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N bibaa Absalɔm dɔ o nyu tenaa?” Asɛ Itiopia te la chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa, n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ anɔ la aa puu la, ɡe pu he dɔma bwa.” Ate, dɛ kooro soɡo dɛɛ chel.
O cheɡɛ doonyoa la nyundua dɛ kaa dea dɛ ka wi.
Waa dɛ kaa la, dɛ o dɛ wi ŋɔ, “N bidɛɛɡe, Absalɔm, menee fe sewa sɛ?”
Joab baa no kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid dɛ wi o bibaa Absalɔm waa sewa la kohona.
Anomanta, silɛɛ waa lole dɛ le yoi baa kaa yo dɛ pɔ ba dɔma nɛɛ awola tɔpere la berɛ laa tena la bwa bambichɔɡa, dɛkalkɛ ba noɔ kɛŋɔ kooro dɛ wi o bie waa sewa la.
Laa tena la ba dɛ jo bwɛjen la bini sum ne kɛŋɔ, baa pɔ ba nɛɛ laa ta ba kpɔ sihiih chwa la ken.
Kooro kpɔ nɔɔra tɔ sie dɛ do lɔŋɔ kohona ŋɔ, “N bidɛɛɡe Absalɔm, n bidɛɛɡe kohona.” Belaa Joab jo kooro dem bela dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa, he ɡelɔ sihiih kpo he laa tena baa lɛ he ne he bibaala, ne bihaahna ne haahna dɛ he sɛnanar la nyu.
He dɛ nyin nɛra baa haeh, dɛ hah nɛra baa dɛ nyin he wa!
He berɔ ɡel ya jemɛ fini kɛŋɔ laa tena ne nomonome baa chɔ ba nyoa la ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ he be.
N nao kɛŋɔ he sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ Absalɔm fe aa lole ásɛ ya bwa serewe.
Ir le ka larawe he laa tena la bwara.
N ŋwɛɛ Korowii o sɔn aa kana la kɛŋɔ dɛ he ta leɛ kaa laa, bɔr ne joe nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwara aa he bee ka.
Dɛ a fe ɛ wedoŋa dɛ ɡwaa anɔ la bwa haa naa le he bonɔɔne saŋ ba le fini.” Ate, kooro ɡel wii dɛ ir dɛ ka so bwɛjen la doonyojen la jwɛh.
O laa tena la noɔ kɛŋɔ o leɔ dɛ ba so bela, asɛ ba la ka che baro.
Kooro Devid berɔ ba Jerusalam Anɔ bwa aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ Israel tena la bwa berɔ kaa ba deremi.
Dɛ Israel tena la bwa dɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa ŋɔ, “N naa kooro lɛ yaa le ya dɔma nɔn ta, dɛ́ lɛ yaa Filisti tena ɡe nɔn ta, kɛ o berɔ koh Absalɔm wa, dɛ chwa le harɛ nɔ ta.
Absalɔm ɡe yaa fuɡe noo do o nyu ta dɛ cheɡo ŋɔ ó ɛ ya kooro la ɡe ka laa ta.
Ɛrɛɛ haa wola Kooro Devid ka kpɔe ba te waa bol kpa nɔɔ?” Kooro Devid no waa Israel tena la aa dɛ bol la, anomanta, o tomɛ Sadɔk ne Abiata baa ɛ sɔfore la ŋɔ bá ka bɔɔ Juda harɛ nomonome ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ nɛra haa ka mun dɛɛ ba men kooro ne n koodem nɔɔ?
He ɛ n lolanar, ya bwa ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ.
Ɛrɛɛ he ta sie tɔe dɛ berɛ ka mun, n kpɔe dɛ ba n koodem nɔɔ?” Kooro berɔ ŋɔ ba bɔɔ Amasa ŋɔ, “N lole laa hen ya bwa ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ aa?
Le fini dɛɛ kaa dɛ he laa dɛ́ ɛ nomoa dɛ́ chiɡ Joab naa ta, dɛ́ chɔ n laa tena nyoa aa, amɔ te Kórowii tɛr n deŋne kohona.” Juda harɛ laa tena bwa bambile lawɛ Kooro Devid waa la, asɛ ba bwa nyoa pɛ, dɛ kpɔ kala tɛo ŋɔ o ne o laa tena la bwa berɛ ba.
Kooro Devid aa bera dɛɛ ba la, Juda harɛ laa tena bwa baa chemo Jɔɔdan Moo ta.
Dɛ ba ba Gelɡal, dɛ́ ba kpɔɔ ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo.
Gɛ saŋ la tenten Gɛra bibaa Simei waa le Bahurim dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea, ɡe ɛ warane kaa Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa dɛ́ ka cheme Kooro Devid.
Dɛ Bɛnjamen dea laa tena kaɡboŋ ja o nɛ.
Dɛ Siba ɡe waa dɛ daah Kooro Sɔɔl dem la kpɔ o bibaala fi dɛ banue, dɛ bonɔɔna fifraanɛ ja o nɛ.
Ba ɛ warane ba Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa dɛ ba cheme Kooro Devid.
Ba cheɡɛ leebɔɔ la ta, dɛ́ ka kpɔ kooro ne o dem nɛra ɛɡɛ le, dɛ́ ɛ wobɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin tɛo.
Belaa Simei aa ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la le la, o baa chole chɔ kooro sie, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, Korowii bɛ ɡel he pa mɛ bolchɔɡe kpa.
Bɛ wechɔɡa maa ɛa awola haa dɛ le Jerusalam la lii.
N dɛ soŋe kɛ he laa kpɔ he nyu bini.
Men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ jemɔ kɛŋɔ n ɛ wechɔɡa, kɛ fini n balɔ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa tɔ sie dɛ le Josef dem dɛ ba cheme n dɔɔ kooro.” Belaa Seruya bibaa Abisae ŋɔ, “A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpo Simei ɡɛ waa nɔ wa aa?
O taah nɛn Korowii aa leo dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ cheɡo kora ta.” Anee Kooro Devid chaŋe ŋɔ, “Seruya bii, bɔkwa waa n ne he dɔ ɛɛ yɔ?
He nyin wa ba dawɛ n nɛ, dɛ berɛ n dɔma!
A chɛ kɛ bá lawɛ nɛn kpo Israel harɛ ta fini ɡɛ naa?
N laa kooro Israel harɛ ta taraken nɔ naa?” Asɛ kooro ŋɔ Simei be ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoe.” Kooro Sɔɔl naa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Mɛfebɔsɛt ɡe laŋɔ ka cheme kooro.
O ta o naa saramɛ kɛɛ dɛ kuu o tampona, kɛɛ dɛ chɛɡɛ o laala, dɛ le awola kooro aa lea kaa, dɛ ba le tɔpere waa bera ba deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Mɛfebɔsɛt aa le Jerusalam ba dɛ ba cheme kooro la, kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ta ɡelɛ n ne he kaalɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, maa ɛ boobi nomanta, n ŋɔ n bonɔɔ Siba be ŋɔ ó kpɔ kon ba dawɛ n keeɡo ta, ásɛ n so o ta n ne he kaa, kɛ o ta waa maa bola la ta teŋɛ.
O teŋe nyosone dawɛ n nɛɛ tɛ hen n dɔɔ kooro.
N dɔɔ, he do kɛŋɔ Korowii torome ken anomanta, ɛ wobɛlbwa aa too he tea.
N nabaa naanar bwa chɛ kɛ n naa kooro kpoo ba, kɛ he tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ n ne he pɛ nɔn di kwa.
N ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ń berɛ soŋe waane le hen n naa kooro be kpa.” Belaa Kooro chaŋe ŋɔ, “A ta chɛ kɛ he bol waane kpa.
He ne Siba la ka bɔne Kooro Sɔɔl kondɔɔh.” Anee Mɛfebɔsɛt ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro aa dɛ ba dem deŋnesɔɔhna ta nomanta, ɡel Siba kpɔ o komɛlbwa.” Belaa Baasilai le Roɡelim Gelead harɛ ba, dɛ ba kpɔ kooro ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la le, asɛ o kaa.
Dɛ Baasilai hwɛɛhrɔ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ o dɔ bene fifraanuatoro.
O dɔ suuɡa taeh, ɡɛ saŋ kooro fa aa soɡe Mahanaim la, dɛ onee dɛɛ tɛo kondikwa.
Belaa kooro ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir ja n nɛɛ yá kaa Jerusalam he ka puu mɛ so, ásɛ mɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ.” Ate, o chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “Bene aŋwɛnɛɛ ka mɛ jaɔ?
N naa kooro, a ta chɛ kɛ n ne he kaa Jerusalam ka so.
Taraken n di bene fifraanuatoro, n sie aa komɛlbwa ta lɛ kpa.
Komɛlbwa aa somɛ n nyoa ta, ba dɛ ɡo yela ɡe aa, maa no.
N naa kooro, n dɛ la ka dawɛ he nɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ ta ɡɛ waa nɔ chɛɛ.
Mɛɛ teŋɛ he nɛɛ ka ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo tama.
Bɔkwa waa n ɛ tɛɛ hɛɛ tɛ mɛ a kembɔr ɔ?
Gel he bonɔɔ berɛ ba kaa dem dɛ́ ka sewɛ bɛne n lolanar huɡribɔr.
N bibaa Kimham ɡee nɔ, kpɔɔ kaa ó kaa tomɛ.
N naa kooro, ɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa aa too he tea tɛo.” Asɛ kooro ŋɔ, “N ne Kimham ɛɛ kaaloo ka ɛɡɛ moo le kaa, ásɛ n ɛ wobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin tɛo.
He bɔɔ mɛ komɛlbwa ɡe aa, mɛɛ ɛo tɛɛ.” Anomanta, nɛra la bwa ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la le asɛ Kooro Devid ɡe teŋɛ.
Asɛ kooro kal Baasilai dɛ ɡbaaro pɛl o te, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛo, asɛ Baasilai berɛ kaa dem.
Kooro aa kaa ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo le dɛ kaa Gelɡal la, dɛ Kimham ja o nɛ.
Dɛ Juda laa tena bwa ne Israel laa tena pera bwa teŋɛ o nɛ dɛ kpɔɔ ɡale.
Belaa Israel tena la bwa ba kooro be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ɛrɛɛ Juda tena baa ɛ ya lolanar ŋwɛ kooro ne o dem tena, dɛ o laa tena bwa, dɛ kpɔ ba ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la kaa nɔɔ?” Belaa Juda laa tena la bwa chaŋe Israel laa tena la ŋɔ, “Ya ne kooro bwa ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ waa ya ɛ ɡɛ la.
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ he baah diɔ?
Ya kpɔ kooro kwaane di kɛɛ?
Ya kpɔ o komɛl ɡe kɛɛ?” Asɛ Israel laa tena la chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Ya dɔ kooro baŋne fi bwa.
A habɔɔ ya ne o pɛo ɡwaa kɛ he ne waa doa.
Ɛrɛ waa hɛɛ nyiŋi ya nyubaahna nɔɔ?
Ya laa tɔ sie bol kooro ka kpɔe dɛ́ ba wa aa?” Kɛ Juda laa tena la chaŋɔ bandia kohona ne, dɛ ɡwaa Israel baala la kwara.
Seeba ɛ Kooro Devid deŋnekpeɡ A balɔ kɛŋɔ Bikri bibaa Seeba lɔ Gelɡal harɛ, o le Bɛnjamen dea.
Dɛ o dɔ dichɔɡa o nyu bini.
O hoh bɛla dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya ta dibɔr bɛlbwa dɔe Kooro Devid be, yaa Jese bibaa nɛɛ teŋɛ!
Israel baa bɛlbwa berɛ kaa dem.” Anomanta, Israel laa tena la bwa le Kooro Devid habɔɔ, ba ne Seeba kaa.
Kɛ Juda laa tena la teŋɛ Kooro Devid nɛɛ le Jɔɔdan Moo la ta dɛ ba Jerusalam.
Kooro Devid aa bera kaa o koodem Jerusalam la, o lawɛ o sɛnanar fi baa dɛ daah koodem la do dea, baa daah ba.
Dɛ o dɛ tɛɛ ba komɛlbwa kɛ dɛ o ne baa chɔ.
Ba chɔ dea ka tel ba serewe wee, kɛŋɔ luhaahna ken.
Belaa kooro ŋɔ Amasa be ŋɔ, “Yerɛ Juda laa tena la bwa, he ne ba ba cheme n sie tɔpera atoro nɔ ta.” Amasa laŋɔ ka yerɛ Juda laa tena la cheme, kɛ o berɔ biɡri asɛ saŋ kooro aa doo la ɡarɛ.
Belaa kooro ŋɔ Abisae be ŋɔ, “Seeba nɔ ɛɛ ba waa nee ba ta ya nɛ ɡwaa Absalɔm.
Kpɔ he dɔɔ laa tena la dɛ ti ba, o ken ɛɛ ka nyin bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛjena bara la bɛl binii ka sɔh, dɛ́ chwa yaa.” Anomanta, Abisae kpɔ Joab ne o laa tena la ne kooro nɛra baa dɛ daahno, dɛ laa tena baa ka Jerusalam bwa le, ba ne o ti Seeba.
Ba tel bwe bɛl waa lɔ Gebeɔn ta, asɛ Amasa ba chem ba.
Dɛ Joab do o laa batakaare, dɛ vɔwɛ kiriso asɛ kerejeɡa do o tɔɔ bini dɛ sɛɡle o ta.
Waa dɛ tel o be la, kere la le o tɔɔ bini le harɛ.
Joab bɔɔ Amasa ŋɔ, “N dam, ɛrɛɛ he bwara doɔ?” Belaa Joab kpɔ nɔndiɡ lawɛ Amasa tampona dɛ ɡbaaro pɛl o te.
Dɛ Amasa aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Joab kpoŋe kere o nɔn bɛl la ta, asɛ Joab kpɔ yaɡɛ o tea o looni le dɛ ba le harɛ.
O sewɛ buɡ ta, anomanta, o ta on wobɛlbwa ɛɛ kpa.
Belaa Joab ne o nime Abisae ti Seeba ɡe.
Joab laa tena la bɛl cheɡɛ Amasa chɔɔ la jwɛh dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin Joab wa dɛɛ teŋɛ Kooro Devid nɛɛ la, ó teŋɛ Joab nɛ!” Chal tɔ Amasa chɔɔ la o chɔ ŋwɛnɛ baah.
Baa la nao kɛŋɔ laa tena la bɛlbwa tel belaa o dɛ che.
Waa na ɡɛ la, o tuuɡu le ŋwɛnɛ la ta ka ta kpɔɡ bini dɛ kpɔ yal tɔ o nɛ.
Waa laa Amasa chɔɔ la laa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ la ta tonɛ la, laa tena la bwa teŋɛ Joab nɛ ba ka ti Seeba.
Seeba kpɔ Israel deene harɛre bwa ta ka le bwɛjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Ebel Bɛt Maaka, asɛ Bɛr dea tena bwa cheme dɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ ba jo o ta.
Joab laa tena la bwa balɔ dɛ ba chɔ bar Ebel Bɛt Maaka, dɛ ba noɔ kɛŋɔ Seeba lɔ bela.
Ba ma kwaa báa kpɔ a ta jo bwɛjen la ta, a pɛl danjwɛkpeɡa baa maa bar bwɛjen la.
Baa kpɔ bune dɛɛ chuɡe danjwɛɛ la dɛɛ kuuɡu la, haah bɛl waa jemɛ waa baa che bwɛɛ la danjwɛkpeɡ doa dɛ do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ, “Hé yerɛ Joab tɛ mɛ bonɔ, ń bol waane o be.” Ate, Joab ba asɛ haah la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Henee Joab la aa?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, menee.” Asɛ haah la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no men maa ɛ he tolo be.” Ate, o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɛ no he be.” Haah la ŋɔ, “Saŋ la ba yon ŋɔ, ‘He dɛ nyin wejema aa, la bwɛjen Ebel,’ dɛ ɡɛɛ baa ɛ. Nɛra yaa soɡe bwɛjen nɔ ta waa dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna kohona ne kasinteŋ Israel harɛ, asɛ hɛɛ nyin he chɔɡ bwɛjen Ebel.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin he chɔɡ Korowii kapɛrɛ kwaa nɔɔ?” Anee Joab chaŋe ŋɔ, “Akai, Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛŋɔ ń ba chɔɡ bwɛjen nɔ.
Gɛ laa waa la do.
Bikri bibaa Seeba waa le Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta laanee ɛ Kooro Devid deŋnekpeɡ.
Hé le Seeba ɡbo ne tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n ɡel wobɛlbwa dɛ́ berɛ kaa.” Belaa haah la ŋɔ Joab be ŋɔ, “Yaa kpoo dɛ́ kpɔ o nyu ba che danjwɛɛ ta viɡri tɛɛ.” Ate, haah la kpɔ o liire waa ba a ne la tɛ nɛra la bwa, asɛ ba sɛh dɛ teŋe Seeba nyu dɛ kpɔ viɡru.
Belaa o hoh bɛla la, asɛ o laa tena la bwa peɡre le bwɛjen la ta, asɛ bɛlbwa kaa o dem.
Asɛ Joab ɡe berɛ kaa kooro be Jerusalam.
Dɛ Joab, onee chɔ Israel laa tena bwa nyoa, asɛ Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya chɔ Pɛlet ne Kɛrɛt tena baa dɛ daah kooro la nyoa, asɛ Adoniram chɔ nɛra baa dɛ do ba tomkpeɡa ta nyoa, Ahilud bibaa Jehosafat ɡe chɔ waa aa chiɡa ba chwera dɛɛ bil dɛ́ kwaa cheɡ nyoa.
Sɛva ɛ kɔɔto karake, asɛ Sadɔk ne Abiata ɛ sɔfore, dɛ Ira waa ɛ Jɛɛ te ɡe ɛ Kooro Devid sɔfore la bɛl.
Kooro Sɔɔl naanar kpoora wa Kooro Devid kora dii saŋ la, lɔr chole harɛ la ta teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ bene atoro.
Anomanta, o bɔɔrɔ le Korowii be.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Kooro Sɔɔl ne o lolanar di bolchɔɡe nɛŋkpoa wa, dɛkalkɛ o kpoo Gebeɔn tena la ɡalɡa.” Kooro yerɛ Gebeɔn tena baa kaa la, dɛ bol waa baɡ ba.
Dɛ Gebeɔn tena la ta Israel tena ɛɛ.
Ba ɛ Amɔre tena bane Israel tena aa baɡ ba nyoa ŋɔ baa ban kpoo.
Kɛ Kooro Sɔɔl siwi beɡrɔ wɛɛ nyin ba dɛ́ kpo, Israel ne Juda tena wa.
Kooro bɔɔ Gebeɔn tena la ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń ɛ tɛ heya ɔ?
Bɔkwaa mɛɛ ba wona ɛ ásɛ he berɛ won swee Korowii andɛɛɡa tɛ nɛra baa ɛ o kapɛrɛ nɛra nɔɔ?” Ba ɡe chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ya ne Kooro Sɔɔl lolanar waa nɔ ta suuɡapoŋa kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm waa ɛɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ ya dɛ nyin Israel te bɛlbwa dɛ́ kpo.” Ate, Kooro Devid bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń ɛ tɛ heya ɔ?” Anee ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kooro Sɔɔl dɛ nyin ó kpoo yaa, ásɛ ya bini bɛlbwa bɛ ka Israel harɛ nɔ ta.
Anomanta, lawɛ o naanar banuanɛ baa ɛ baala tɛ yaa yá kpoo ba dɛ́ saɡ ba Korowii sie Gebea waa ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bwɛɛ nɔ ta.” Asɛ kooro chaŋe ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ lee baa tɛ heya.” Kooro Devid ne Jonatan ŋwɛɛra baa ŋwɛra baɡle dɔŋa Korowii sie nomanta, kooro ta Jonatan bibaa Mɛfebɔsɛt leɛ.
Kooro lawɛ Aamoni ne Mɛfebɔsɛt baa ɛ haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Aeya, o bitolo Rispa bibaala waa lol ba tɛ Kooro Sɔɔl, dɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ɡbaɡba bihaah Merab bibaala banue ja.
Bibaala la ɡe mɛɛ Adreɛl waa ɛ Baasilai bie, Mehola te la.
Kooro Devid kpɔ ba do Gebeɔn tena nɔn ta ba kpoo ba, dɛ kpɔ ba saɡɛ deŋɡare bɛl ta Korowii sie.
Nɛra banuanɛ la bwa sewɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ.
Awola laanee baa pa mea koma mun, asɛ dɛ kpoo ba.
Aeya bihaah Rispa, waa ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl sɛno, kpɔ lweyal paɡri tɔ bwe bɛl ta, dɛ so o lɔɡa dɛɛ daah nɛra baa serewa la.
Le jaaɡe koma mumpar ka tel kɛŋɔ bwaala aa nɛa la, o ta ɡelɛ jumbii dɔ ba ola di webaŋa, kɛɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ba dia jwaana.
Kooro Devid aa no waa Rispa aa ɛa la, o iro la ka pa Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaa Jonatan hoɡa le Jabes Gelead tena be.
Dɛ ba ŋwɛa le Bɛt San, bela nɛra yon kaa soŋni bwɛjen la doonyoa.
Belaa Filisti tena kpɔ ba saɡɛ ɡɛ saŋ baa kpo Kooro Sɔɔl Gelboa Bwejen ta la.
Kooro Devid pa Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaa Jonatan hoɡa, dɛ nɛra banuanɛ baa kpoo ba dɛ saɡ ba la ɡe hoɡa.
Ba huɡe Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaa Jonatan hoɡa la bwebɔɔ baa huɡe Kooro Sɔɔl mɛɛ Kes bini Sela, Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta.
Gɛ Kooro Devid aa do ba laanee ba ɛ.
A habɔɔ, Korowii no harɛ la tena wesoŋa.
Israel ne Filisti tena laa yoi Laa berɔ chole Filisti ne Israel tena baah.
Kooro Devid ne o laa tena leɔ kaa dɛ ka yoo ba.
Yoi la bini la, Kooro Devid baa koh dɛ ɡwɛɡre.
Belaa baa bɛl waa kpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ɛ Rafa naa baa yerɔ Esbe Bɛnɔb, ŋɔ wɛɛ kpo Kooro Devidii.
Dɛ o kpoŋe ayaawa lampea, o nyoa buni tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore atoro ne fah, dɛ berɛ kpoŋe tokobifale ɡe.
Asɛ Seruya bibaa Abisae ba dɛ ba lɛ kooro.
O baa yo Filisti te la dɛ kpoo.
Belaa Kooro laa tena la ŋwɛɛ baɡlo ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, haa ya nɛɛ teŋɛ la laa kpa, ɡɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel hen haa do kɛŋɔ kandea dɛ tɔ ya Israel tena sie nɔ, ba bɛ hen ba kpo, ásɛ Israel kandea dime, ya paŋɛ.” Anɔ habɔɔ, ba ne Filisti tena berɔ yo laa Gɔb.
Laa la ta la, Sibekai waa le Husa kpo Rafa waa kpeɡa, o bwara do kpeɡri kohona naanar la bini bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Saf.
Ba ne Filisti tena berɔ yo laa bɛl Gɔb ja, anee Jɛɛ bibaa Ɛlhanan waa le Bɛtlɛham kpo Goliat waa le Gat.
O lampea nyoa buni tɔɡre kɛŋɔ yasɔɔh kokorowa daa ken.
Laa bɛl ɡe chole Gat ja.
Dɛ baa bɛl kpeɡo o bwara do kpeɡri kohona.
O nɔn bɛlbwa ta, o dɔ nonie anumɛl, o nanie ɡe ɛ anumɛl o nakpale ta.
A bwa lɔ fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ.
O ɛ Rafa naa.
O muɡli Israel tena baah, asɛ Simea waa ɛ Kooro Devid dɔɔranar la bini bɛl bibaa Jonatan kpoo.
A ɡɛ nɛra banaarɛ nɔɔ Rafa naanar baa lɔ Gat, asɛ Kooro Devid ne o laa tena kpoo ba.
Kooro Devid ɡo yel kpɛɛ Korowii Kooro Devid ɡo yel kpɛɛ Korowii ɡɛ saŋ waa lɛo le Kooro Sɔɔl ne o dɔma bwa nɔn ta.
O ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii do kɛŋɔ Bwetal maa chwaa kaa marɛ, ne danjwɛkpeɡ dɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ, Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ do kɛŋɔ Bwetal maa chwaa kaa marɛ.
Onee dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe dɛ ɛ n Kpeɡnɛn.
Onee n chwa baa pɛl dɛɛ dɔ n nyu, dɛ ɛ n Lɛɛ le nɛra baa dɛ nyin yoi nɔn ta.
N wio dɛɛ yerɛ Korowii waa chɛ kpɛɛra kohona, on lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ta.
Seo do kɛŋɔ nehɛma dɛ lɔ baa tɔ n nɛ, a lɔɔ ba tɔ n nɛ kɛŋɔ ne aa sua, mɛɛ ba sewa.
A do kɛŋɔ seo aa dɔ ŋwɛɛra dɛ laɡ mɛ kpoŋe, kɛŋɔ lalbɔɔ aa har mɛ bela ken.
N wenaale ta la, n wio yerɛ Korowii, n wio yerɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ ó cha mɛ.
O lɔ o Dea bela baa dɛ tomɔ dɛ no n taa, n wii maa dɛ wi la tel o be.
Harɛ jiɡro jiɡra tenten, asɛ kwaa aa lawɛ nyundua kpoŋe yiiɡi, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Korowii baah diu.
Korowii hwee chuu le o mebɔɔne bini, nii aa dɛ chɔɡ kwa ne hɔla ɛɛ le o nyoa.
O forɔ le nyundua dɛ ba harɛ, asɛ baama biŋere do o naa lɔɡre.
O soɡe Kerobim aa ɛ kena kwaa ta ir kaa nyundua, a do kɛŋɔ peu aa dɔ kena dɛ kpɔɔ ir dɛɛ kaa ken.
O kpɔ biro tɔ o te kɛŋɔ yal, baama biŋere aa dɛ nɛ bwaala baro cheme.
Bwaala kɔrɔ, dɛ nyɛɡle, asɛ nii chaah o sie.
Nemenɛ Korowii kɔrɔ le nyundua kɛŋɔ bwaala ken, asɛ nɛra no o taa.
O ɡelɔ bwaala nyɛɡle dɛ lɔ o dɔma peɡre, a do kɛŋɔ waa ta hɛma do ba bini ken.
Korowii baah diu dɛ kah o dɔma aa, mpo vile bwa dɛ chɔ baŋ, baa na kwaa aa lawɛ harɛ kpoŋe.
O ha nɔn le nyundua ba laɡ mɛ kpoŋe, dɛ kpɔ mɛ le vile bini.
O lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma baa kpeɡa nɔn ta, nɛra baa hah mɛ, dɛ do kpeɡri kohona ɡwaa mɛ.
N fa aa lɔ wenaale ta la, ba baa yoo mɛ, kɛ Korowii baa che n habɔɔ.
O cha mɛ dɛ laɡ mɛ le wekpeɡa nyoa, o sie aa dɛ lɛ n nɛɛ nomanta, o lɛɛ mɛ.
Korowii cheɡɛ toɡra n wa aa toɡra ta dɛ cha mɛ, o swee mɛ andɛɛɡa, dɛkalkɛ n di boldɛɛɡe.
N dɛ teŋɛ Korowii Mmarare la ta, n ta habɔɔ berɛ kpo Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la.
N dɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa ta, n ta waa waa do mɛ a ta ɡelɛ.
O jemɔ kɛ wechɔɡe bɛlbwa toole n nɛ, n laa n te kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.
A waa o che toɡra n waa aa toɡra ta dɛ cha mɛ, o jemɔ kɛ n di boldɛɛɡe.
N Naa Korowii, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ nɛn o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ, ɡɛ haa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe la, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ nyin nɛndɛɛɡe wa.
Gɛ he tea aa toa la, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ baɡlo ɡɛ he tea aa toa wa, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena te, he dɛ baɡ ba kɛ he dɔ wejema dɛ bol ba waa dɛɛ pa bole.
He dɛ lɛ nɛra ba wa a pwɛra, kɛ mbarafo tena te, he dɛ ba ba ne harɛ.
N Naa Korowii, henee do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah mɛ, henee ɡela biro ber mɛ bɔr waa chaahna.
He tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa n won ka yo n dɔma, hale bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro nɛra dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ te, o ŋwɛnɛre toɡrɔ, o waa waa bol bwa ɛ kasinteŋ.
Nɛra baa chwaa kaa marɔ la, o dɛ tɔ ba ɡbemɡbe dɛɛ lɛɛ ba.
Korowii habɔɔ, nomɛlbwa toole.
O ɡbosoo do kɛ Bwetal n chwa kaa marɔ wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ.
Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa, dɛ ɡel n ŋwɛnɛre bwa do wer tɛ mɛ.
O ɡelɔ n nakpale do kɛŋɔ chwae kwaa ken, n won bwejena dor cheɡa, n bwara ɛɛ sɔɔh mɛ.
O dɛ baɡ mɛ ɡɛ maa yo laa nɔɔra ne, ɡɛ maa ɡure to baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo dɛ́ yo.
N Naa Korowii, henee tɔ mɛ ɡbemɡbe dɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ, he balɔ ba cha mɛ dɛ ɡel n dɔ sɔn.
He kwaa ŋwɛnɛ o do paɡri tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n bɛ naa lɔ.
N ti n dɔma dɛ ka pɔ ba nɛ, maa ba nɛɛ teŋaa ɡel, ka tel kɛŋɔ maa kpoo ba.
N kpoo ba bil, baa wola won ir, n pɔ ba nɛɛ ba serewe chɔ n sie.
Hen Korowiirii tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa mɛɛ yo laa, he ɡelɔ n pɔ n dɔma nɛ.
He ɡelɔ n dɔma chwa le n sie, n kpoo ba.
Ba wio dɛɛ nyin nɛn ó ba cha ba, kɛ nomɛlbwa ta balɛ dɛ ba lɛɛ ba.
Ba wio no hen Korowii, he ta ban chaŋɛ.
N pɔ ba nɛɛ ba chɔ harɛ kɛŋɔ bomboɡ peu aa taa dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ kaa, n tiɡri ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ kpechɛɡre ken fɔɡbaahna.
He lɛɛ mɛ le n nɛra baa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena nɔn ta, dɛ lee mɛ cheɡ kɛŋɔ harɛre bwa nyu te.
Nɛra maa wola ban jemɛ baa do n lɔɡa.
Nɛŋhɔɔhra baa ɡuŋ mɛ, ba no n wa aa, ba dɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Ba bambile chɔɡɔ, dɛ kpɔ bochela le ba dekpeɡa bini dɛɛ ba.
N jemɔ kɛ Korowii lole saŋ bɛlbwa, o chɛ kpɛɛra.
N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii waa do kɛ Bwetal n chwa kaa marɔ wɛɛ lɛɛ mɛ la!
Onee ɡela n yo n dɔma dɛɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ lawɛ harɛre nɛra baa do n lɔɡa, dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma be.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ n pɔ n dɔma nɛ, dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le naɡrenyine nɔn ta.
Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɛɛree harɛre nɛra bwa siee, mɛɛ ɡo yelaa kpɛɛ he sɔn la.
He ɡelɔ kooro haa leo cheɡ tɛ he te la yo lajena, dɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛ, dɛ kpɔ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe nyin nɛn haa fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ tɛ men Kooro Devid ne n naanar saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”
Kooro Devid nyoa wobol aa ka mun Jese bibaa Kooro Devid ɛ nomɛl Nemenɛ Korowii aa ɛo nɛnjen.
Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ laanee leo cheɡ tɛ o te, asɛ o ɛ yelɡoɡoo Israel harɛ ta.
Waa Kooro Devid aa ka mun bol laanee nɔ, “Korowii Doma baa so n nɛ, dɛ kpɔ o waa do n nyoa.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ bol wa, Korowii waa do kɛ Bwetal ba chwa kaa marɔ la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Kooro bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyiŋi o nɛra nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la, do kɛŋɔ chɔɔlen wee yon dɛɛ chaah kohona kɛɛ bwaala yon nɛ tonɛ, wee pili mɛn do kpɔɡa ta dɛɛ nyɛɡle la.’ Gɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba n naanar andɛɛɡa sweera, dɛkalkɛ n ne o fɔwɛ fɔo waa do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, fɔo waa wola chɔɡ bwa, nyobaɡa waa wola charɛ.
Waa bwa maa dɛ nyin laanee la, Korowiirii dɛ́ ɡel a bwa ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ tɛ mɛ.
Kɛ nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ do kɛ sɔɔhne baa paa ta, nomɛlbwa aa won kpɔ nɔn lawa.
Buni kon kɛɛ lampeaa chɛ kɛ nɛn won kpɔ lawa, ásɛ a fuh kwaraa.” Kooro Devid banyoola wa Kooro Devid banyoola baa yoa tɛo la sɔnaa teŋa nɔ.
Joseb Basebɛt, onee tɔ sie dɛ ɛ Hakmoni bibaa.
Dɛ ba lɔ banyoola batoro, dɛ onee chɔ ba nyoa.
O wono kpɔ o lampea yo baala lafraanuatoro dɛ kpoo ba laa bɛl ta.
Nɛɛte ɡee Dodai bibaa baa dɛ yerɔ Eliasa, o le Aho dea.
Dɛ o ɛ banyoola batoro la bini bɛl, anomanta, o ja Kooro Devid nɛɛ ba ka muɡli Filisti tena baa kaa cheme bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Pas Damim baah, dɛ yoo ba laa.
Israel laa tena la le habɔɔ, kɛ o cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ, dɛ kpoo Filisti tena la ka tel kɛŋɔ o nɔn aa baa koh, dɛ sɔɔh waa wola won lawɛ kere kpa.
Korowii ɡelɔ o pɔ ba nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ awola.
Laa tena la berɔ kaa bela Eliasa aa cheɡa, dɛ ka pa nɛra baa kpoo ba la dɔmkwa.
Toorote o ɡe aa ja banyoola la bini la sɔne Samaa, o mɛɛ sɔne Aɡee dɛ le bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Harar.
Dɛ Filisti laa tena boa ba nyoa koo bɛl baa du chebe o ta, asɛ Israel laa tena chwa le bela kaa.
Kɛ Samaa lɔ bambile che koo la baah ta, dɛ yo lɛ koo la cheɡ, dɛ kpoo Filisti tena la.
Korowii ɡelɔ o kpoo ba kɛrɛdɛ awola.
Aa ka tama kwaa koma saŋ tel la, nomonome fifraatoro la bini batoro ba Kooro Devid be Adulam bwebɔɔ la ta.
Dɛ Filisti laa tena ɡe boa ba nyoa dɛ cheme Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini.
A ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Kooro Devid soɡe bela baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro deŋɡare bɛl doa, asɛ Filisti laa tena la ɡe bar Bɛtlɛham dɛɛ daah bela.
Nyɔɡre dɛ kpo Kooro Devid, asɛ o ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin nomɛl fe aa kaa dɔ nee kɔlɔŋ waa chɔa bɛne Bɛtlɛham doonyojen la ta ba tɛ mɛ ń nyɔ!” Anomanta, banyoola batoro la kpɔ bansua jo harɛ Filisti laa tena la aa soɡe o ta la ta, dɛ ka dɔ nee le kɔlɔŋ waa chɔa bɛne Bɛtlɛham doonyojen bini la ba tɛo.
Kɛ o ta berɛ nyɔ, dɛ fuɡe ta ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
O ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛŋɔ n nyɔ nee nɔ.
Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ maa dɛ nyɔ baala baa ta ba nyu dɛ won la ka dɔ nee nɔ ba tɛ mɛ nɔ chal.” Anomanta, o vɛh nee la nyɔe.
Waa banyoola batoro la aa ɛa laanee la.
Ate, Joab nime Abisae, onee fa chɔ nomonome batoro ba ɡe aa ɛ banyoola la nyoa.
O kpɔ lampea ka yo baala lafraatoro dɛ kpoo ba.
Gɛ taa a che o lɛ sɔn kɛŋɔ banyoola batoro la.
A lole kɛ dɛ baa on kure dɛɛ ja banyoola batoro la nɛ, kɛ onee bera ba chɔ ba bwa nyoa.
Dɛ Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ɛ nɛn waa won yoi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ le bwɛjen Kabseel ta, o ɡe ɛ wejena kɛrɛdɛ.
