Onee wona ka kpo Moab baala banɛ baa won yoi kɛrɛdɛ la.
O berɔ jo bɔɔ bini awola bɛl, dɛ dombwea leero dɛ ka kpo nyujente.
O berɔ kpo Ijipt te bɛl ɡe dɛ o kpeɡo kɛrɛdɛ.
A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ Ijipt te la kpoŋe lampea, kɛ Bɛnaya kpɔ o ɡuli la o be sibeɡra ne, dɛ ka to o lampea le o nɔn ta dɛ kpɔ kpoo.
Waa Bɛnaya aa ɛa laanee la.
O ɡe lɛ sɔn kɛŋɔ banyoola batoro la ken.
Ba tɛo duure kohona ɡwaa banyoola fifraatoro la bini bɛlbwa, kɛ ba ta on kpɔe ja banyoola batoro la nɛ.
Asɛ Kooro Devid ɡel o chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daahno la nyoa.
Banyoola fifraatoro bane ɡe baa jaa laanee, Joab nime Asahɛl, ne Dodo waa le Bɛtlɛham bibaa Ɛlhanan, ne Samaa, ne Elika baa le Harɔd, ne Hɛlɛs waa le Palti, ne Ikes bibaa Ira waa le Tekoa, ne Abeɛsa waa le Anatɔt, ne Mebunai waa le Husa, ne Salmɔn waa le Aho dea, ne Maharai waa le Nɛtɔfa, ne Baana bibaa Hɛlɛd waa le Nɛtɔfa, ne Ribai bibaa Itai waa le Gebea, Bɛnjamen dea, ne Bɛnaya waa le Peratɔn, ne Hedai waa le Gaas nenabɔɔne ta, ne Abi Albɔn waa le Aaba, ne Asmavɛt waa le Bahurim, ne Eliaba waa le Saalbɔn, ne Jaasen bibaala, ne Jonatan, ne Samaa bibaa waa le Harar, ne Sarar bibaa Ahiam waa le Harar, ne Ahasbae bibaa Ɛlefɛlɛt waa le Maaka, ne Ahetofɛl bibaa Eliam waa le Gilo, ne Hesro waa le Kaamɛl, ne Paarai waa le Arab, ne Netan bibaa Iɡal waa le Soba, ne Haɡri bibaa, ne Sɛlɛk waa le Amɔn, ne Naharai waa le Beɛrɔt.
Dɛ onee dɛɛ che Seruya bibaa Joab dɔmkwa, ne Ira waa le Itri, ne Gareb o ɡe aa le Itri, dɛ Uria waa ɛ Hiti te la.
Ba bwa lɔ nɛra fifraatoro dɛ banuanɛ.
Kooro Devid kure o laa tena A habɔɔ la, Korowii baah di Israel tena baa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua la nɛɛ ja, dɛ ɡel Kooro Devid dɔ liire kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ó la ka kure ba ne Juda tena baa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr bwa ɡe.
Anomanta, Kooro Devid ŋɔ Joab ne laa nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Hé valɛ Israel deene la bwa ta, le Dan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera, dɛ́ ba kaa Beɛseeba weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ́ chwerɛ ba sɔna dɛ́ ba bol n be, ásɛ n jemɛ ba nyoa.” Anee Joab chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɡel laa tena la warɛ bele lafa dɛ́ ɡwaa, ásɛ he na.
N naa, aah bɔkwa waa hɛɛ nyin he kur ba ɛɔ?” Kooro Devid waa la tɔɔɡe Joab ne laa nomonome la waa la ta, anomanta, ba le kooro sie bela kaa dɛ ka chwerɛ Israel baala baa dɛ ba wona yo la sɔna.
Ba kaa ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo la, dɛ baŋre ba tɛnte deene bɛne Arowa, weekaŋle harɛbɔr bwɛjen waa lɔ fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, dɛ teŋe kpɔ Gad harɛ ta kaa Jasa.
Ba la Gelead harɛ ne bwɛjen Kades waa lɔ Hiti tena harɛ ta, dɛ kpoŋe ka le Dan dɛ bar kaa bwɛjen Sidon bwa.
Ate, ba berɛ teŋe kpɔ bwɛjen Taaya danjwɛkpeɡ baa maa baro bɔr, dɛ kaa Hivi tena bwɛɛre ne Keenan tena harɛ bwɛɛre ta bwa.
Ba berɔ la Beɛseeba waa lɔ Juda harɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Baa lea dɛ ka ɡaaɡe harɛ la bwa ta la, ba di korobie anuanaarɛ tɔpera fifraanɛ mɔɔ dɛ berɛ ba Jerusalam.
Joab ba kooro be ba baɡle laa tena la nyoa baɡlo ŋɔ, Israel harɛ ta ɡbo, ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanuatoro, asɛ Juda harɛ ta ɡe, ba lɔ baala kaɡboŋa lafraanue.
Kooro Devid aa kure laa tena la tonɛ la, o liire ɛo anebɛlbwa asɛ o ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Waa maa ɛa nɔ ɡelɔ n ɛ wechɔɡa kohona.
N dɛ soŋe, laa bolchɔɡe men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ aa dia nɔ kpɔ n nɛ.
N ɛ ɡɛnewa tenten.” Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ mɔɔ kooro ir la, Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Devid keame Gad be ŋɔ, “La ka ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, ‘Kenii men Korowii ɛɛ bol, webele atoroo n kpɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, kpɔ a bini beŋkpoŋ ń kpɔ tɛr he deŋne.’ ” Anomanta, Gad la Kooro Devid be ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ lɔr chole he harɛ ta bene atoro, kɛɛ he teŋɛ chwa dɛɛ le he dɔma be, ásɛ ba ɡe chwa dɛɛ tii korobie atoro bwa nɔ?
Kɛɛ weechɔɡa chole he harɛ ta tɔpera atoro nɔ?
He ɡbaɡba kpɔ a liire, dɛ́ ɡel n jemɛ waa maa ka bol naate waa tom mɛ be.” Anee Kooro Devid chaŋo ŋɔ, “N lɔ suna kohona dii ta.
Maa nyin kɛ nɛwɛnyini te dɔɔ mɛ dɛ́ tɛr n deŋne, Korowii ɡbabirii dɛ́ tɛr n deŋne, dɛkalkɛ onee dɛɛ sune nɛn nɛɛ kohona.” Anomanta, Korowii kpɔ weechɔɡa ba ta Israel harɛ ta, le awola chɔɔ ka tel saŋ waa lea cheɡ ta, asɛ baala kaɡboŋa fifraanuanɛ sewɛ dɛ le Dan ba kaa Beɛseeba.
Dɛ Korowii le o nyundua torome bɛl dɛ tɛo kpeɡri ŋɔ ó ba chɔɡ Jerusalam.
Waa dɛ la ka chɔɡo la, Korowii berɔ charɛ o liire, dɛ ŋɔ nyundua torome la be ŋɔ, “Gel!
A maɡre ɡɛ.” Gɛ saŋ dɛ torome la lɔ Jebus te Arauna mea lɔ bɔr.
Kooro Devid aa na ɡɛ nyundua torome la aa dɛ kpoo nɛra la, o soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, menee ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ di bolchɔɡe.
Nɛra nɔ baa do kɛŋɔ peera nɔ laa ɛ waane.
Kpɔ deŋnetɛra bɛlbwa ba ta n ne n haahna ne bii nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he nɛra Israel tena.” Kooro Devid ma saraha kon Awola tɔpere la, Gad la Kooro Devid be dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir la Jebus te Arauna mea lɔ bɔr bela, dɛ́ ka ma kon baa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii.” Anomanta, kooro teŋɛ Korowii nyoa wobol Gad aa baa bol o be la ta, dɛ ka ɛ ɡɛ tenten.
Arauna lɔ mea lɔ bɔr bela dɛ na kooro ne o nɛra aa dɛ ba, asɛ o le ka chemo, dɛ ka ɡuŋu dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Arauna bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N Naa kooro, a som he ba n be bonɔ naa?” Anee Kooro Devid chaŋo ŋɔ, “N balɔ dɛ́ ba yawɛ he mea lɔ bɔr nɔ, dɛ́ ma kon maa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ weechɔɡa la ɡel nɛra kpoora.” Ate, Arauna ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, kpɔ komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin ka ɛ saraha la tɛ Korowii.
Nabala haa kpɔ ɛ saraha baa fuah, ne daa aa sarawe mea lɔ bɔr, ne daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ dawɛ nae anɛ nɛɛ aa parɛ la ɡee nɔ bá kpɔ mar.
N naa kooro, n kpɔ anɔ bwa dɛɛ tɛɛ.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɛ́ no he wesoŋa.” Asɛ kooro chaŋo ŋɔ, “Akai, n ta cheɡɔɔ kɛ ń bɔe o kem.
Maa kwaa kpo dɛ́ fuah ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ pɛɛpɛɛ maa wola kem bɛlbwaa bɔ.” Anomanta, o yawɛ mea lɔ bɔr la ne nabala la bwa suuɡapoŋa fifraanue.
Kooro Devid ma kon waa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii bela, dɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare baa fuah, ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare tɛo.
Asɛ Korowii na Israel tena sum dɛ ɡel weechɔɡa la le harɛ la ta, nɛra aa serewe kpa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Koranar Tɔn Loɡle nɔ dɛ baɡle Israel koranar waa kohona.
Kooro Devid aa sewa la, o bibaa Solomɔn chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Dɛ Kooro Solomɔn ɛ wejereme dɛ dɔ suuɡa kohona.
Korowii ɡelɔ o do o Dea Jerusalam chiɡ o Tɛnte Dea baa dɛ tomɛ o bini la naa ta.
Kooro Solomɔn seo habɔɔ la, Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la bini peɡri anɛ.
Ba dɛ yerɛ weekaŋle nyundua deene la Israel kɛɛ Samaria kɛɛ Efrem.
Dɛ Juda ne Bɛnjamen ɛ deene anɛ dɛ do weekaŋle harɛbɔr harɛre ta.
A habɔɔ la, a bwa baa pɛ baa yerɔ Juda harɛ.
Koranar warɔ dɛ ba di harɛ bele anɛ nɔ kora, kɛ dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ɡe toole.
Korowii tomɛ o keamere bane baa do kɛŋɔ Elaeja bá ba bol waa baɡle koranar ne nɛra la.
Adonija cheɡ o te kora ta A balɔ kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid baa hwɛɛh, dɛ o biɡro ɡe kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ka kalaŋ ta.
Ba kpɔ yale tɔɔ ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, dɛ waa ta dɛ kpoo.
Anomanta, o bonɔɔna ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ɡel ya ka nyin bechatolo waa wola baa bɛlbwa jemɛ mɔɔ ba tɛɛ, ásɛ wɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ.
Wɛɛ dɛɛ chɔ he habɔɔ dɛ́ ɡel hɛɛ wɔrɔbe.” Ate, ba ɡaaɡe Israel harɛ ta bwa dɛɛ nyin bechatolo waa wera tolo, asɛ dɛ ka dɔ bɛl bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sunem ta baa yerɔ Abisaɡ, dɛ kpɔɔ ba tɛ Kooro Devid.
O wer tolo kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ so kooro be dɛ nyiŋu taeh, kɛ o ne o ta baa ne haah chɔe bwa.
Adonija le o te kɛŋɔ kooro sibeɡra ne Asɛ Kooro Devid ne o haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Haɡit bibaa Adonija ɛ karamani kɛŋɔ, wɛɛ chiɡ o mɛɛ naa taa dɛ́ di kora.
Anomanta, o nyin kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre ne jaɡre dɛ baala fifraanue ba tɔ o sie.
O mɛɛ Kooro Devid ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ baɡlo, dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɛ waa ɡɛ nɔɔ?” Dɛ Adonijaa teŋɛ o dɔɔ bɛl waa sewa baa yerɔ Absalɔm la nɛ, dɛ o wer bonɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Adonija ne Joab waa ɛ Seruya bibaa, dɛ Abiata waa ɛ sɔfo la ɛ nyoa beŋkpoŋ asɛ ba teŋɛ o nɛɛ dɛ chao.
Kɛ Sadɔk waa ɛ sɔfo ne Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya, ne Korowii keame Netan ne Simee ne Rei, dɛ Kooro Devid bonɔɔna baa dɛ daahno te ta Adonija nɛɛ jae.
Awola bɛl, Adonija laŋɔ dɛ ka kpo peera ne nae dɛ nabiiri aa jea kohona ɛ saraha Sohelɛt Bwe ta, o bɛne Ɛn Roɡel bule ta.
O yerɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Devid bibaala baa ɛ o nimanar dɛ Juda baala ba ɡe aa ɛ kooro nomonome bwa.
Kɛ o ta Korowii keame Netan kɛɛ Bɛnaya, kɛɛ laa tena baa dɛ daah kooro, kɛɛ o nime Solomɔn te bɛlbwa yerɛ.
Ba cheɡ Solomɔn kora ta Belaa Korowii keame Netan la Batsiiba waa ɛ Solomɔn nya be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Jamɔ he ta noɛ kɛŋɔ Haɡit bibaa Adonija cheɡ o te kora ta ya naa Kooro Devid aa wola jemaa?
Taraken n dɛ jae kɛŋɔ, dɛ he dɛ nyin he ne he bie nyu tenaa, amɔ te no waa maa dɛ ba he be bola nɔ.
La Kooro Devid be dɛ́ ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, ‘N naa kooro, he laa baɡ mɛ nyoa ŋɔ he bibaa Solomɔnee dɛ́ di he kwa dɛ́ ɛ kooro la aa, aah ɛrɛɛ Adonija berɛ ba ɛ kooro nɔɔ?’ He taa lɔ o be dɛɛ bol waa la, mɛɛ bao dɛ ba dalawe a ɡɛ waa la ta.” Ate, Batsiiba la Kooro Devid waa hwɛɛhra kɛrɛdɛ la be o chɔɔbɔr, dɛ Sunem tolo Abisaɡ la lɔ bela dɛɛ nyiŋu.
Belaa Batsiiba ɡuŋi kooro, asɛ kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ɔ?” O chaŋo ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he ŋwɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta ŋɔ n bie Solomɔnee dɛ́ ba ɛ kooro dɛ́ chiɡ he naa ta.
Kɛ taraken Adonija dɛ di kora haa wola jemɛ.
O kaa kpoo peera ne nabala ne nabiiri aa jea kohona, dɛ ta nɔn yerɛ he bibaala ne sɔfo Abiata dɛ Joab waa dɛ tɔ laa tena sie.
Kɛ o ta he bibaa Solomɔn te yerɛ.
N naa, Israel tena bwa dɛ nyiŋi he siwi ta, kɛ he baɡle nɛn waa di kora he habɔɔ.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, he seo habɔɔ la, baa ɛ n ne n bie Solomɔnee kɛŋɔ nɛnchɔɡa ken.” Batsiiba nyoa taa lɔ waa la ta wɛɛ bol kooro be la, dɛ Korowii keame Netan tel ba be.
Asɛ ba ka ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “Korowii keame Netan balɔ.” Asɛ o la kooro be dɛ ka ɡuŋu.
Belaa Netan ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he bolɔ ŋɔ he habɔɔ Adonijaa dɛ́ di kora kɛɛ?
Fini o iro dɛ la ka kpoo nae ne nabiiri aa jea, dɛ peera aa wara.
O ta nɔn yerɛ he bibaala bwa, ne Joab waa chɔ he laa tena nyoa dɛ sɔfo Abiata.
Maa dɛ bol nɔ, taraken ba ne o pɛo dɛɛ di kondikonjena, dɛ nyɔ sen dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛɛ do lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, ‘Kórowii tɛ Kooro Adonija mkpajaŋ!’ Kɛ o ta men Netan maa ɛ he bonɔɔ, ne sɔfo Sadɔk ne Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya kɛɛ Solomɔn te bɛlbwa yerɛ.
Kpelaa kɛŋɔ n naa kooro, he ɛ waa aa do ken asɛ he ta ɡelɛ he bonɔɔna bini bɛlbwa jemɛ naate waa ba di kora he habɔɔ nɔ naa?” Kooro Devid cheɡ Solomɔn kora ta Anee Kooro Devid ŋɔ, “Hé yerɛ Batsiiba tɛ mɛ bonɔ.” Asɛ o ba dɛ ba che o sie.
Asɛ Kooro Devid ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le wekpeɡa bɛlbwa ta nɔ, fini n ta cheɡɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta, dɛ ŋwɛɛ dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he bie Solomɔnee dɛ́ ɛ kooro n habɔɔ dɛ́ di kora.” Asɛ Batsiiba ba ɡuŋi Kooro Devid sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ Kooro Devid mkpajaŋ!” Ate, Kooro Devid ŋɔ, “Hé yerɛ sɔfo Sadɔk ne Korowii keame Netan dɛ Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya tɛ mɛ.” Baa ba o be la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ n koodem nomonome, dɛ n bie Solomɔn so n keeɡo la ta ja kaa Gehɔn bule ta.
Hé tel Gehɔn bela aa, hé ɡel sɔfo Sadɔk ne Korowii keame Netan fuɡe noo do Solomɔn nyu ta, dɛ́ cheɡo Israel harɛ bwa kooro.
Hé ɡel nomɛl hoh bɛla ásɛ hɛɛ moo ŋɔ, ‘Korowii tɛ Kooro Solomɔn mkpajaŋ!’ Ásɛ he ne o berɛ ba, ó ba so n kookara ta dɛ́ chiɡ n naa ta dɛɛ di kora.
N leo ŋɔ ó di kora Israel ne Juda bwa ta.” Anee Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ŋɔ, “A ɛ ɡɛ!
Korowii n naa kooro aa dɛ tomɔ la sɛh a ta.
Gɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ hen n naa kooro mun ta la, ó che Solomɔn ɡe mun ta ɡɛ, dɛ́ ɡel o kora do kan ɡwaa n naa Kooro Devid kwara.” Ate, sɔfo Sadɔk ne Korowii keame Netan ne Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah kooro la la ka kpɔ Solomɔn so Kooro Devid keeɡo ta, dɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ kaa o ne Gehɔn.
Asɛ sɔfo Sadɔk kpɔ nyeɡle bɛl noo aa lɔ o bini le Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr, dɛ ba fuɡe do Solomɔn nyu ta.
Ba hoh bɛla la, asɛ nɛra baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ bwa ɛɛ moo kohona ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛ Kooro Solomɔn mkpajaŋ!” Nɛra la bwa teŋɛ o nɛ dɛɛ hoh kalipere dɛɛ hɛɡre kohona, asɛ harɛ bwa ɛɛ jiɡri kohona.
Dɛ Adonija ne nɛra waa ta nɔn yer ba baa di kwaa dɛɛ lɛ ba sie la, deno dɛɛ tonɛ dɛ no ɡbɔɡa la.
Baa dɛ no bɛla la sii la, Joab bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “Gbɔɡa aa dɛ le bwɛjen nɔ ta nɔ munii ɛrɔɔ?” O nyoa taa lɔ waa la ta la, dɛ sɔfo Abiata bibaa Jonatan deno ba jo ba be.
Asɛ Adonija ŋɔ, “Ba, he ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe, jamɔ he ba amanesoma ne.” Jonatan chaŋe ŋɔ, “Akai, ya naa Kooro Devid cheɡ Solomɔn kora ta.
Kooro ɡelɔ sɔfo Sadɔk ne Korowii keame Netan, ne Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya, dɛ o nɛra baa dɛ daahno, kpɔ Solomɔn so o ɡbaɡba kooro keeɡo la ta, asɛ sɔfo Sadɔk ne Korowii keame Netan ka fuɡe noo do o nyu ta dɛ cheɡo kora Gehɔn bule ta, dɛ berɛ baa kaa asɛ bwɛɛ bwa ɛɛ moo ɡɛ la.
Hale taraken Solomɔn soɡe kookara la ta.
Anɔ la aa jaa ɡee kɛŋɔ, Kooro Devid nomonome ɡe la o be dɛ kaa jaamo ŋɔ, ‘Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɡel Solomɔn sɔn le ɡwaale, ásɛ o kora ɡe do kan ɡwaa he kon!’ Asɛ Kooro Devid ir so o chɔɔbɔr dɛ soŋe ŋɔ, ‘Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee chɛ kpɛɛra kɛŋɔ waa ɡela n na n bibaa Solomɔn o ba chiɡ n naa ta dɛɛ di kora fini nɔ.’ ” Belaa nɛra Adonija aa ta nɔn yer ba la ɔmɛ dɛ bwa ir peɡre, bɛlbwa kaa o dem.
Dɛ Adonija ɡbabir dɛ ɔmɛ Kooro Solomɔn, anomanta, o iro jo Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la bini, dɛ ka lawɛ kwaa aa paaɡe saraha kon la loŋkoni ta kɛŋɔ nyeɡlare la kpoŋe.
Ate, ba ka ŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Adonija dɛ ɔmɛ, dɛ ka lawɛ kwaa aa paaɡe saraha kon la ta kɛŋɔ nyeɡlare la kpoŋe dɛɛ soŋe kɛŋɔ, ‘Kooro Solomɔn ŋwɛɛ baɡ mɛ fini kɛŋɔ waa men kpo.’ ” Anee Kooro Solomɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ wɛɛ kpɔ o tenee do n lɔɡa aa, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa tenaa, wɛɛ sewɔɔ.” Belaa Kooro Solomɔn tomɛ nɛra ba ka lawɛ Adonija le saraha kon la ta dɛ kpɔɔ ba, asɛ o ba ɡuŋi Kooro Solomɔn sie, asɛ o ŋɔ Adonija be ŋɔ, “Kaa he dem.”
Kooro Devid wobol aa ka mun o bol baɡle Solomɔn Kooro Devid seo aa dɛ tel la, o yerɛ o bibaa Solomɔn dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Saŋ telo kɛŋɔ n sewɛ name, anomanta, lawɛ he te dɛ che kiŋkiŋ dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la waa waa doe a ta la ta kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne waa aa dɛ baɡle ɡɛ baa chwera do Mosis Tɔn la bini la ta, ásɛ kerekere wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ, ne bobɛlbwa haa la la, a do wer tɛɛ.
Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa, Korowii ɛɛ teŋɛ nyoa waa baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ waa ŋɔa ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ he naanar soɡo kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ aa wera dɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ ba bambile ne ba liire bwa ne naa, banee dɛɛ ba baa di Israel harɛ ta kora la.’ ” Kooro Devid berɔ ŋɔ, “He ɡbabir na ɡɛ Seruya bibaa Joab aa ɛɛ mɛ dɛ kpo Israel laa sitɔɔla banɛ.
Nɛr bibaa Abna ne Jɛta bibaa Amasa.
O saahnɔ kpoo ba kɛŋɔ nɛra baa kpoo ba laa ta bɔ kem, ɡɛ saŋ yaa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, laa yoi aa wola toole kpa ta.
O kpɔ ba chale fɔɡɛ o kiriso ne o naŋɡawa, ba seo ɡure o nyu ta.
Anomanta, he ɡbaɡba nyiŋi dɛ́ na ɡɛ haa tɛr o deŋne he wejema ne, dɛ bɛ ɡel o sewɛ nyumpompoŋ ne bansɔɔhna ta.
Kɛ dɛɛ ɛ Baasilai waa le Gelead la bibaala la te kɛrɛdɛ.
Gel ba ja nɛra he ne baa pɛa so dɛɛ di kondikwaa la nɛ.
Ba cha mɛ ɡɛ saŋ maa chwaa le he dɔɔ Absalɔm be la.
Berɛ no, Gɛra bibaa Simei waa le Bɛnjamen dea dɛ le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Bahurim la lɔ bela.
Onee taah mɛ kohona awola maa la bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Mahanaim la, kɛ a habɔɔ waa baa chem mɛ Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa la, n ŋwɛɛrɔ Korowii sɔn ta baɡlo kɛŋɔ maa on kpo.
Kɛ a ta chɛ kɛ he ɡelo o kaa bosɔɔhna ne, he jemɛ waa ɡa.
Na ɡɛ háa ɛ ásɛ o sewɛ.” Kooro Devid seo wa Asɛ Kooro Devid chɔ o banɔn ta ba huɡo Jerusalam Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta o ka pu o naawa.
O di kora Israel harɛ bene fifraanaarɛ.
Hɛbrɔn lɔ bene anuanɛ, asɛ bene fifraatoro dɛ atoro ɡe Jerusalam.
Kooro Solomɔn soɡe o mɛɛ Devid kora la ta asɛ o kora che kiŋkiŋ.
Adonija seo wa A balɔ kɛ Adonija baa dɛ yerɛ o nya Haɡit la Batsiiba waa ɛ Solomɔn nya be.
Waa dɛ tel Batsiiba be la, o bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Deŋnesɔɔhna nee hɛɛ ba naa?” Adonija ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh,” dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Waanee mɛɛ ba bá bol he be.” Ate, Batsiiba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa yɔ?” Anee Adonija ŋɔ, “He jemɔ kɛŋɔ kora la fa ɛ n kon, n nɛɛ Israel tena bwa sie dawɛ kɛŋɔ menee dɛ́ ɛ ba kooro.
Kɛ waa la sie berɔ, asɛ a ɛ kɛŋɔ n nime di, dɛkalkɛ Korowiirii ɛa ɡɛ.
Taraken, kombeŋkpoŋii mɛɛ soŋe dɛ́ le he be, kɛ bɛ men vɔmɛ.” Anee Batsiiba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa yɔ?” Adonija ŋɔ, “Soŋe Kooro Solomɔn tɛ mɛ ásɛ o kpɔ Abisaɡ, Sunem te la tɛ mɛ ń mo.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he bolaa, wɛɛ sɛoh.” Ate, Batsiiba chaŋe ŋɔ, “A wer, mɛɛ soŋe kooroo tɛɛ.” Ate, Batsiiba la Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ o dɛ la ka bol Adonija waa la tɛo.
Kooro iro ka chemo, dɛ ɡuŋu harɛ dɛ berɛ ka so o kookara ta.
Ba kpɔ kookara bɛl ɡe ka cheɡ kooro nomombɔr diɡ ta, asɛ o nya ka so o ta.
Batsiiba ŋɔ, “Wejeɡa bɛl nee n ba dɛ́ ba soŋe, bɛ men vɔmɛ.” Anee kooro ŋɔ, “N nya bol, maa hen vɔmɛ.” Asɛ Batsiiba ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin he lawɛ Sunem tolo Abisaɡ tɛ he dɔɔ Adonija ó mo.” Anee Kooro Solomɔn chaŋe o nya ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa hɛɛ soŋe Abisaɡ Sunem te nɔ dɛɛ tɛ Adonija ó mo nɔɔ?
Den bol kora la waa ɡe tɛo, on ɡee n dɔɔ.
Bol tɛ o ne sɔfo Abiata ne Seruya bibaa Joab, dɛkalkɛ ba bwa teŋɛ o nɛ.” Ate, Kooro ŋwɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ Adonija ta o nyu kpɔe bol o wesoŋa nɔ wa aa, Korowii tɛr n deŋne kohona ɡɛ bwa aa chɛa.
N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole dɛ kpɔ mɛ chiɡ n mɛɛ Devid buɡ ta kiŋkiŋ kɛŋɔ kooro, dɛ tɛ n ne n naanar ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la, a chɛ kɛ bá kpo Adonija fini ɡbo.” Anomanta, Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ka kpo Adonija.
Sɔfo Abiata lawa dɛ́ kaa harɛfale ta ne Joab seo wa Kooro Solomɔn ŋɔ Sɔfo Abiata be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kaa he bwɛ, Anatɔt harɛ ta.
He chɛ kpoe, kɛ maa hen kpo taraken, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ n mɛɛ Devid aa ɛ kooro la, dɛ henee dɛɛ che Nemenɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la, dɛ berɛ na wahala n mɛɛ aa naa la ane.” Gɛɛ a do Kooro Solomɔn le Abiata sɔfore dii ta, dɛ ɡel waa Korowii aa bola Silo, a ɛ sɔfo Eli dem waa la ɛ kpela.
Joab aa wola Absalɔm chae o di kora dɛ cha Adonija la, waa noa kɛŋɔ ba kpo Adonija la, o chwao ka jo Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bini, dɛ ka lawɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ nyeɡlare dɛ paaɡe kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta loŋkoni la kpoŋe.
Kooro Solomɔn noɔ kɛŋɔ Joab chwao ka marɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bini.
Anomanta, o do Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ŋɔ, “La ka kpo Joab!” Asɛ Bɛnaya la Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela dɛ ka ŋɔ Joab be ŋɔ “Kooro ŋɔ, ‘Le ba.’ ” Anee o ŋɔ, “Akai, bonɔɔ mɛɛ ba sewa.” Ate, Bɛnaya berɛ kaa kooro be dɛ ka ŋɔ waa Joab aa bola la.
Anee kooro ŋɔ Bɛnaya be ŋɔ, “Ɛ ɡɛ waa bola la, kpoo dɛ́ huɡo ásɛ dɛ laa nɛra Joab aa kpoo ba pɛɛpɛɛ la waa kpɔ le n ne n mɛɛ nɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ bɔɔ kem nɛra waa kpoo ba la waa, dɛkalkɛ o le n mɛɛ habɔɔ dɛ ka yo nɛra banɛ dɛ kpoo ba kere ne.
Banee, Nɛr bibaa Abna waa ɛ Israel laa sitɔɔ, ne Jɛta bibaa Amasa o ɡe aa ɛ Juda laa sitɔɔ.
Dɛ ɡɛ nɛra la do kaih dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ɡwaalo.
Korowii ɡel ba deŋnetɛra ba dawɛ Joab ne o naanar nyu ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Kɛ Devid ne o naanar ne o dem dɛ o kora te, Korowii tɛɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna.” Asɛ Bɛnaya berɛ la Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela, dɛ ka kpo Joab dɛ kpɔɔ le ka huɡe o ɡbaɡba dem pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Kooro kpɔ Bɛnaya chiɡ Joab naa ta kɛŋɔ laa sitɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ Sadɔk chiɡ sɔfo Abiata ɡe naa ta.
Simei seo wa Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba ka yerɛ Simei ba tɛo, asɛ o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ma dem Jerusalam bonɔ dɛ so, dɛ bɛ bobɛlbwa kaa.
Awola haa le Jerusalam, dɛ́ ka ɡale Kedrɔn nenabɔjen la, jemɛ kɛŋɔ he sewee, dɛ he ɡbaɡbaa nyin he seo.” Asɛ Simei chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, waa haa bola nɔ wer, men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa bola laanee.” Anomanta, o soɡe Jerusalam biɡri.
Bene atoro habɔɔ la, Simei yoma bini banɛ bane chwao ka do Maaka bie Kooro Akis be Gat, asɛ Simei aa noa kɛŋɔ ba lɔ Gat la, o kpɔ o keeɡo chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa Kooro Akis be bwɛjen Gat dɛ ka ɡaaɡe o yoma la bɔr.
Waa kaa na ba la, o laɡ ba ba Jerusalam.
Kooro Solomɔn aa noa kɛŋɔ Simei le Jerusalam kaa Gat dɛ berɛ ba la, o tomɔ ba ka yerɔ asɛ o bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N ta hen kaeh dɛ ɡel he ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ awola haa le Jerusalam dɛ́ kaa bobɛlbwa la, jemɛ kɛŋɔ he sewee, asɛ he ŋɔ he noɔ la aa?
Aah ɛrɛ waa haa wola ɡɛ haa ŋwɛɛra baɡle Korowii la ta teŋɛ, dɛ vɛh waa maa doe a ta nɔɔ?
He ɡbabir jemɛ chɔɡre haa di n mɛɛ Kooro Devid.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr he deŋne a waa.
Kɛ Korowii ɛɛ swee mɛ andɛɛɡaa, dɛ́ ɡel n mɛɛ Kooro Devid kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Asɛ kooro yerɛ Bɛnaya ŋɔ ó ba lawɛ Simei le buse dɛ́ ka kpoo.
Ásɛ name te kora la che Solomɔn nɔn ta kiŋkiŋ ken.
Kooro Solomɔn soŋe wejema Kooro Solomɔn ne Ijipt harɛ kooro nyoa pɛo asɛ Kooro Solomɔn mo o bihaah.
O kpɔ haah la ba Kooro Devid Bwɛjen Jerusalam mɔɔ dɛ ma koodem ne Korowii Dea dɛ danjwɛɛ bar bwɛɛ la.
Baa wola Korowii Dea mae mɔɔ la, dɛ deŋɡarere taa baa ɛ sarahare.
Kooro Solomɔn teŋɛ waa o mɛɛ Kooro Devid aa ŋɔa la ta, dɛ baɡle nyina waa dɛ nyin Korowii, kɛ dɛ deŋɡarere baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa doree o ɡe ɛɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma dɛɛ ɛ sarahare.
Kooro Solomɔn la bwɛjen Gebeɔn ta, dɛ belaa kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta do, nɛra bwa ɛɛ la o ta.
O kaa ɛ sarahare bele kaɡboŋ o ta dɛ fuah.
Waa lɔ Gebeɔn bela la, Korowii ba o be jwaana deera ta dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Baɡle komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin ásɛ n kpɔ tɛɛ.” Kooro Solomɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “He nyin n mɛɛ Kooro Devid waa ɛ he bonɔɔ kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ, o waa toɡrɔ o tea ɡe to.
He teŋɛ he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ta, dɛ tɛo bibaa o chiɡ o naa ta, dɛɛ di kora fini nɔ.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he ɡelɔ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ chiɡ n mɛɛ naa ta dɛɛ di kora.
Kɛ n nɔn ta kao, maa n sie ne habɔɔ jemɛ.
He bonɔɔ ja nɛndamanta haa lee ba tɛ he te baa wola nyoa dɔe bini bonɔ.
Anomanta, tɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ wejema, dɛ́ ɡel n jemɛ wechɔɡa ne wedɛɛɡa.
Ɛrɛɛ n ɡbo ɛɛ ba wona nyiŋi he nɛra baa wara ken nɔ nɛɔ?” Kooro Solomɔn wesoŋa la too Korowii tea.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ haa soŋa haa wola mkpajaŋ kɛɛ he ɡbaɡba kondɔɔh soŋɛ kɛɛ he dɔma serewe, kɛ dɛ soŋe wejema dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne nɔ, mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa soŋa laanee tɛɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛɛ wejema ne waa mun noe, he kpɔ dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra nɛ, nomɛlbwa aa wola won do kɛŋɔ hen, a dɔŋa ɡe aa wola chiɡ bwa.
Mɛɛ berɔ tɛɛ anɔ la ɡe haa wola soŋɛɛ, mɛɛ tɛɛ suuɡa ne jirima kohonaa he soɡa bini bwa he dɔŋ aa wola lee do koranar bwa bini.
Dɛ hɛɛ dɛɛ yarada mɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ta kɛ he mɛɛ Kooro Devid aa ɛa la aa, mɛɛ tɛɛ mkpajaŋee.” Ate, Kooro Solomɔn har dom ta dɛ na kɛŋɔ deeraa o dee.
Asɛ o ba Jerusalam dɛ la ka che Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, dɛ fuh kwaa ɛ saraha ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha tɛ Korowii.
A habɔɔ, o ɛ kondikonjena, dɛ ta nɔn yerɛ o nomonome bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn pa bole bɛl aŋwɛnɛ ta Awola bɛl, hanjwamanere banɛ bane lawɛ dɔŋa ba Kooro Solomɔn be.
Beŋkpoŋ ŋɔ, “N naa kooro kaforachɛ, n ne n dɔŋ nɔɔ pɛa so dembeŋkpoŋ ta.
N lolɛ bibaa o siwi ta.
Maa lola tɔpetooro wee la, o ɡe lolɛ bibaa.
Nomɛlbwa ta ya nɛɛ jae dem bela, ya ɡboo.
Ya bwa aa chɔa jwaana la, o ɡbilo ɛɡɛ o bie nɛɛ o sewɛ.
Jwaana la ne la, o iro dɛ ba kpɔ n bie la ka bil o jwɛh, dɛ kpɔ o kon waa sewa la ba bil n jwɛh.
Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ n kpɔɔ ŋɔ o ɔr dɛ o sewɔ.
Maa kpɔɔ le bochaah ta dɛ peseo la, dɛ n bie la laa.” Ate, hanɛɛte la ŋɔ, “Akai, n bie siwii lole la, he konee sewa la.” Sitɔ te la ɡe ŋɔ, “Akai, he konee sewa la, n kon siwii lole la.” Gɛɛ ba tɔŋle waa la kooro siwi ta.
Anee Kooro Solomɔn ŋɔ, “Onɔ ŋɔ n kon siwii lole nɔ, he konee sewa la, onɔ ɡe ŋɔ he konee sewa la, n kon siwii ta lole la.” Kooro berɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la be ŋɔ, “Hé tɛ mɛ kere.” Asɛ ba kpɔ kere ba tɛo.
Anee o ŋɔ, “Hé pere bie waa wola sewɛ la bini dɛ́ kpɔ bɛl tɛ onɔ, dɛ kpɔ bɛl tɛ onɔ ɡe.” Belaa haah la o bie aa ɛ onɔ la waa wola sewɛ la tea domɔ o ŋɔ, “Akai, N naa kooro, he bɛ on kpo, he kpɔɔ tɛ n dɔŋ la.” Nɛɛte la ŋɔ, “A wer ɡa, waa won ɛ he kon kɛɛ n kon, bɔne o bini tɛ yaa!” Ate, kooro la ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ bie la tɛ haah waa ŋɔa ya bɛ on kpo la, bie la nyaa.” Israel tena bwa aa no ɡɛ Kooro Solomɔn aa pa bole la, a ɛɛ ba nyokpoa, ba na kɛŋɔ Korowiirii tɛo wejema o kpɔ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta la.
Kooro Solomɔn nomonome Kooro Solomɔn di kora Israel harɛ ta bwa.
Dɛ nomonome baa ja o nɛɛ laanee nɔ.
Sadɔk bibaa Asaria ɛ sɔfo, Sisa bibaala Elihoref ne Ahija ɛ karakere dɛɛ chwerɛ, Ahilud bibaa Jehosafat ɛɛ cheɡ webena baa chwera bil.
Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ɛ laa sitɔɔ, Sadɔk ne Abiata ɛ sɔfore, Netan bibaa Asaria chɔ harɛre nomonome nyoa.
Netan bibaa Sabud ɛ sɔfo dɛ berɛ bol waa dɛɛ baɡle kooro, Ahisa ɛɛ nyiŋi koodem wobɛlbwa ta, Abda bibaa Adoniram chɔ nɛra baa kpɔ ba dɛɛ ɛ tomkpeɡa nyoa.
Kooro Solomɔn le nomonome fi dɛ banɛ ba chɔ harɛre nyoo Israel bwa.
Ba tomaa kɛŋɔ bá lɛ kondikwaa le nɛra be baa tɛ kooro ne o dem tena.
Nomonome la bɛlbwa dɔ korobie beŋkpoŋ dɛ́ kpɔ kondikwa ba tɛ kooro benanyoa bɛlbwa.
Gɛ nɛra la sɔnaa teŋa nɔ, Bɛn Hur chɔ a ɡɛ kondikwaa la waa ta deŋɡarere harɛ bwɛɛre aa lɔ Efrem harɛ.
Bɛn Deka chɔ bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Makas ne Saalabim ne Bɛt Sɛmɛs dɛ Ɛlɔn Bɛt Hanan nyoa.
Bɛn Hɛsɛd chɔ bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Arubot ne Soko dɛ Hɛfa harɛre bwa nyoa.
Bɛn Abinadab chɔ Nafɔt Dɔr harɛ bwa nyoa, dɛ o mo Kooro Solomɔn bihaah baa dɛ yerɔ Tafat.
Ahilud bibaa Baana chɔ bwɛjena Taanak ne Meɡido nyoa, dɛ berɛ kpoŋe ka le Bɛt San harɛ waa bɛne Saretan Jesreel weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ le Bɛt San dɛɛ kaa bwɛjen Ebel Mehola, dɛ ka le bwɛjen Jokmeam baŋ.
Bɛn Gɛba chɔ bwɛjen Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta nyoa, dɛ Jɛɛ dea tena, o ɛ Manasɛ naa, bwɛɛre aa lɔ bela, ne Aaɡob harɛ waa lɔ Basan.
A bwa lɔ bwɛjena fifraanumɛl baa ma danjwɛjena bara, dɛ kpɔ ayaawa kwaa a doonyoo bune.
Ido bibaa Ahinadab chɔ Mahanaim harɛ nyoa.
Ahimas chɔ Naftale harɛ nyoa.
Dɛ o mo Kooro Solomɔn bihaah baa dɛ yerɔ Basemat.
Husai bibaa Baana chɔ Aasa harɛ ne bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Bealɔt nyoa.
Parua bibaa Jehosafat chɔ Isaaka dea harɛ nyoa.
Ela bibaa Simei chɔ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ nyoa.
Uri bibaa Gɛba chɔ Gelead harɛ nyoa.
Bela fa ɛ Amɔre tena Kooro Sihon ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ harɛre.
Dɛ Gɛba ɡboo dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta.
Kooro Solomɔn kondɔɔh ne o kora dii Kooro Solomɔn bere saŋ dɛ Juda ne Israel tena warɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.
Kɛ dɛ bɛlbwa dɔɔ dɛɛ di dɛɛ nyɔ, ba sie ɛɛ lɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn harɛ waa di kora o ta la le Yufretis Moo ta, dɛ kaa Filisti tena harɛ, dɛ ka le Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta.
Dɛ ɡɛ harɛre la bwa nɛra kpɔ harɛ la ta kwaa baa tɛo, dɛ kpɔ ba te do o lɔɡa ɡɛ saŋ waa di kora bwa.
Kondikwa aa chɛ kɛ aa ba kooro dem tɔpere bɛlbwa laanee nɔ, loɡ baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwa, mendɛɛɡa bɔɡtɔre lafa fifraanue, ne jule bɔɡtɔre lafraatoro, ne nae aa do bwara fi, ne nae baa dɛ la ane dibɔr ɡe fifraanɛ, ne peera ne boohna lafa, ne kweɡli ne nampoŋa ne ahre, dɛ jala bwa.
Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ bwa taa Solomɔn di kora.
Le Tifsa teŋe kaa wee cholibɔr ka tel Bwɛjen Gasa, dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna lɔ harɛ la bwa ta.
O ta aa soɡe le la, dɛ nɛra baa soɡe Juda ne Israel harɛ bwa ta ɡɛ saŋ lɔ bosɔɔhna ta.
Le Dan dea harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ́ ba kaa Beɛseeba o ɡe aa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Dɛ dea bɛlbwa nɛra dɔ bosɔɔhna, dɛ dɔ fiɡ ne ɡrepo daa kooni.
Kooro Solomɔn dɔ jaɡre kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ baa vɔwɛ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo pɛla chɔɔbɔra, dɛ jaɡre kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anɛ ɡe nɛra aa dɛ so a ta.
Nomonome fi dɛ banɛ baa lɛ kondikwaa baa tɛ Kooro Solomɔn ne o dem tena korobie bɛlbwa la, ba a ne baa tɛ o ne nɛra baa ba o be baa di kondikwaa bwa.
Ba ta ɡelɛ kondikwa ɛɛ paŋɔ.
Bɛlbwa kpɔ jaaɡe ne kpɔɡa baa tɛ jaɡre baa kpɔ torɔɡore vɔwa ne mea aa kaa la bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn wejema waa dɔa Korowii tɛ Kooro Solomɔn wejema ne waa mun noe kohona aa wola nyoa dɔe kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.
Kasinteŋ, dɛ o dɔŋ toole wejema dɔe ta wee leebɔr harɛre ta ba kaa Ijipt harɛ bwa ta.
Dɛ o jemɛ waa ɡwaa nomɛlbwa.
O ɡwaa Etan waa ɛ Esera te ne Mahɔl bibaala Heman ne Kalkol dɛ Daada.
O sɔn leɔ kohona harɛre aa bar ba la bwa ta.
Kooro Solomɔn sɛɡlɔ beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa ɡɛ kaɡboŋa atoro, dɛ ɡo yela ɡe kaɡboŋ dɛ anue.
Dɛ o jemɛ daa ne kpɔɡa waa kɛrɛdɛ, hale o baɡle peleme daa aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn dɛ hesɔp aa moɡa tɔ danjwɛɛre ta, ne ola ne jumbii ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh dɛ pɛŋa bwa wa.
Harɛ nɔ ta koranar bwa no o wejema waa dɔa wa, dɛ tomɛ nɛra ba la o be kaa no.
Kooro Solomɔn pa mun dɛ́ ma Korowii Dea Dɛ Taaya Kooro Hiram chamenatee Kooro Devid, anomanta, waa noa kɛŋɔ ba cheɡ Solomɔn kora o so o mɛɛ Kooro Devid buɡ ta la, o tomɛ o nomonome ba ba na Kooro Solomɔn.
Asɛ Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ kala tɛɛ ba ba ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He na ɡɛ n mɛɛ fe aa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ o fee do Korowii Dea, kɛ dɔma baa baro cheme kpɔ yoi puu o ta wone do ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii aa ɡela o pɔ ba bwa nɛɛ mɔɔ.
Taraken, Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ alaworomɛ, o tɛ mɛ deŋnesɔɔhna, wechɔɡa kɛɛ dɔm bɛlbwa toole n harɛ ta kpa.
N ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ ń do dea tɛ Korowii, ɡɛ waa ŋɔ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, ‘He bie maa ba ɡel o so he buɡ ta dɛ́ di kora laanee dɛ́ do n Dea tɛ mɛ’ la.
Anomanta, cha mɛ dɛ́ ɡel he nɛra ka teŋe peleme daa le Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta tɛ mɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n nɛra ba ja he nɛra nɛ, ásɛ n bɔ he nɛra la kem ɡɛ bwa haa baɡle.
He ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ta daa teŋa wejema dɔe ka ja he nɛra baa le bwɛjen Sidon ta nɔ nɛ.” Kooro Hiram aa no Kooro Solomɔn kala nɔ la, o sie lɛo kohona o ŋɔ, “Fini, Korowii chɛ kpɛɛra kɛŋɔ waa tɛ Kooro Devid bibaa waa jemɛ waa ŋɔ ó nyiŋi Israel harɛ damanta nɔ ta nɔ.” Asɛ dɛ ɡe tomɛ nɛra Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “N no he wesoŋa la, mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin la bwaa dɛ tɛɛ peleme daa ne dadɛɛɡe te bɛlbwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n nɛra le a ne Lɛbanɔn harɛ dɛ́ ba a ne mpo nyoa, dɛ́ ba vɔrɔwa pɛ dɛ́ taɡɛ do nee ta ba tɛɛ bela haa dɛ nyin, ásɛ dɛ pura he nɛra ba kpɔ kaa.
Waa n ɡe aa dɛ nyin laanee kɛŋɔ he ɡe ba tɛ mɛ kondikwa ń tɛ n dem tena.” Gɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ taa Kooro Hiram kpɔ dɛ tɛ Kooro Solomɔn daa te bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin, asɛ Kooro Solomɔn tɛ Hiram ne o koodem nɛra jaaɡe bɔɡtɔre kaɡboŋa lafa, dɛ ɔleve noo ɡalɔŋre kaɡboŋa lafa benanyoa bɛlbwa o ne o dem tena ɛɛ di.
Korowii tɛ Kooro Solomɔn wejema ɡɛ waa bola la.
O ne Kooro Hiram baah do wer, asɛ ba fɔwɛ deŋnesɔɔhna fɔo.
Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ tom-ɛɛra kaɡboŋa fifraatoro le Israel harɛ ta bwa, dɛ kpɔ Adoniram chɔ ba nyoa.
O bɔne ba bini kuore atoro, kaɡboŋa fifi.
Nɛra kaɡboŋa fi la Lɛbanɔn ka ɛ toma korobie aa, dɛ ba berɔ ba dɛ ba di korobie anɛ Israel harɛ.
Gɛɛ ba la dɛɛ beɡre.
Dɛ Kooro Solomɔn dɔ tom-ɛɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanuatoro ɡe ba do deŋɡarere harɛre ta dɛɛ pɛɡre bwea, asɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanuanɛ ɡe ɛɛ chea.
O kpɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa batoro lafraatoro baa nyiŋi toma la ta ne tom-ɛɛra la nɛ.
Kooro do tom-ɛɛra la ba pɛɡre bwedɛɛɡa dɛ kwaa a bwara dɛ́ kpɔ pa Korowii Dea la mun.
Kooro Solomɔn ne Kooro Hiram, dɛ nɛra baa le bwɛjen Gebal, dɛ dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema kwaa bwea ne daa baa kpɔ do Korowii Dea la.
Kooro Solomɔn do Korowii Dea Israel tena aa ira le Ijipt harɛ ta bene lafraanaarɛ fifraanuatoro habɔɔ Kooro Solomɔn ba di kora Israel harɛ ta.
Waa di kora bene anaarɛ, korobinɛɛte baa dɛ yerɔ Siv taa o ɡel ba pa mun dɛɛ ma Korowii Dea la.
Korowii Dea la sie jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanaarɛ, o paɡri naɡale fifraatoro, asɛ o jaŋne dɛ kaa nyundua ɡe lɔ naɡale fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue.
Pato lɔ Dea la sie, o paɡri lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anue, asɛ o jaŋne dɛ le Dea la ta kaa sie ɡe ɛ naɡale fi dɛ anue, o ne Dea la sie bwa paɡri kɛrɛdɛ.
Tokorore aa lɔ Dea la ta la sie jeɡre o habɔɔ, asɛ o bini ɡe la, a ka do paɡri.
Ba ma deene sawɛ Korowii Dea la, ne danjwɛɛ waa lɔ o bini tenten la dɛ bar o bwa dɛ ma dejeɡre sarawa.
Deene aa lɔ harɛbɔr la paɡri lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, asɛ baah ta deene la ɡe paɡri ɛ naɡale anuanaarɛ, nyundua kwaa la ɡe paɡri ɛ naɡale fi ne tama.
Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba bɛ bɔɔne ba foɡre Korowii Dea la danjwɛɛ ta la, ba kpɔ doli ɡo Korowii Dea la danjwɛɛ la ta a le baŋ, dɛ do deene la chɔŋre a ta.
Ba pɛɡre bwea baa kpɔ ma Korowii Dea la dɛ kwaara bela baa dɛ kwia mɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔ ba, ɡɛ aa ɛ ba bɛ hambare ne kpanfɛre kɛɛ buni bɛlbwa ɡbɔɡa no Korowii Dea la bela.
Abrɔsane baa doa pɛl Korowii Dea la ta weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera la, doonyoa bɛl lɔ bela ba kpɔ bela teeh dɛɛ kaa nɛɛte ne toorote la ta.
Kooro Solomɔn ma Korowii Dea la tonɛ, dɛ kpɔ doli ne peleme daa tɔɔ.
O do deene sarawe Korowii Dea la bar, dea la bɛlbwa jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, asɛ peleme daa doli le Korowii Dea la ta dɛ lawa kpoŋe.
Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Dea haa dɛ ma nɔ, dɛ he no n deŋna waa dɛ teŋɛ n waa bwa ta naa, mɛɛ che he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel nyoa maa baɡɛ he mɛɛ Kooro Devid la maɡre.
Mɛɛ so n nɛra Israel tena baahnee Korowii Dea haa dɛ do nɔ bini, maa ban ta bwa.” Gɛɛ Kooro Solomɔn ɛ dɛ do Korowii Dea la bwa tonɛ.
Korowii Dea bini kwaara wa O kpɔ dadɛɛɡa ane soo siwi sam le harɛ dɛ kpɔ peleme daa marɛ danjwɛɛ le harɛ ka le o nyundua baa ɡoo la bwa.
O kpɔ peleme daa la ane teŋe Korowii Dea la bini, Boɡoroŋ Tenten la baah ta kɛŋɔ pateesan ken le nyundua ba chiɡ harɛ.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraatoro.
Dea waa lɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la sie jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanumɛl.
Peleme daa ba kpɔ ɛ Dea la bini bwa, ba kwaa kwaa aa do ɡuleɡule kɛ loŋa ne anɔ la aa do kɛ daa fee pɛɡle danjwɛɛre la bwa ta, nɛn cheɡɔɔ waa aa, waa bwea baa kpɔa mao la na.
O kwaa bɔr Korowii Dea la bini tenten, o do Dea la habɔɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la cheɡ.
Korowii Dea la bini tenten la paɡri lɔ naɡale fifraatoro, o jaŋne dɛ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale fifraatoro, asɛ o jaŋne ɡe naɡale fifraatoro.
Ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten kwaa o bini bwa, dɛ kpɔ peleme daa pɛɡle kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛ Korowii Dea la bini, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm jɔɡrɔre teŋe o bini tenten la sie, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ o ɡe bini.
Korowii Dea la bini bwa ne kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta o do o bini tenten bela la, o kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba kpɔ ɔleve daa sɛh Kerobim aa do kɛŋɔ hweera kwaa anɛ ane cheɡ Korowii Dea la bini tenten bela.
Bɛlbwa jaŋne dɛ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anue.
Kerobim la bɛlbwa dɔ kena anɛ.
Keni bɛlbwa jaŋne lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, a baahna ɛ naɡale fi dɛ anue.
A bwa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ le dɔŋa, bɛlbwa kpeɡa ɛɛ ɛ naɡale fi dɛ anuee.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba kpɔa cheɡ dɔŋa jwɛh Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela.
Ba ɛa a kena anɛ nyoo ɛɛ chuɡe danjwɛ, asɛ anɛ ɡe ba cheme dea la baah ta.
O ɡelɔ ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba sɛh Kerobim ne bambie daa ne kwaa aa do kɛ daa fee dɛ dia ɡwine dawɛ Korowii Dea la ne Boɡoroŋ Tenten la danjwɛɛre ta.
O ɡelɔ ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ deene la harɛ ɡe bwa.
Korowii Dea la bini tenten doonyoa bela la, Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba kpɔ ɔleve daa kwaa doonyoa ɡbeni anɛ, asɛ o doonyoo daa ɡe lɔ anue.
Dea la ɡbeni anɛ ta, o ɡelɔ ba sɛh Kerobim ne bambie daa, dɛ kwaa kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ daa fee dɛ dia ɡwine dawɛ a ta, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara.
Gɛ tentenee o ɡel ba ɛ dejen waa lɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la sie doonyoa ɔleve daa ne, dɛɛ yao bɔre anaarɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn berɔ ɡel ba kpɔ dadɛɛɡe bɛl soo siwi ɛ dea la ɡbeni anɛ.
Ba ɛa a pɛ dɔŋa ba won a kpɛwa.
O ɡelɔ ba sɛh Kerobim ne bambie daa ne kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ daa fee dɛ dia ɡwine dawɛ ɡɛ ɡbeni la ta, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara kɛrɛdɛ ken.
Korowii Dea la sie la, o ɡelɔ ba ma dembaah, dɛ ɡel ba kpɔ bwea baa sɛah ma danjwɛɛ baro.
Ba kpɔ bwea atoro ma chɔŋɛ aa, dɛ ba kpɔ dola dawɛ a ta.
Kooro Solomɔn aa di kora bennaarɛ te ta, korobinɛɛte baa dɛ yerɔ Siv taa o ɡel ba pa Korowii Dea la mae mun.
Ba do Dea la dɛ tonɛ o wobɛlbwa, o kora dii bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta, korobinuatoro baa dɛ yerɔ Bul ta.
Anomanta, bene anuanɛɛ Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ ma Dea la tonɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn do o ɡbaɡba koodem Kooro Solomɔn do o ɡbaɡba koodem, kɛ a di bene fi dɛ atoro mɔɔ o won do tonɛ.
Dea bɛl lɔ koodem bela baa yerɔ Lɛbanɔn Kɔr Bini Koodem.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue, o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, asɛ o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɡe naɡale fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue.
Ba paaɡe peleme dachiɡri a teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ bele anaarɛ dɛ lawɛ peleme dabaŋa aa ɛ doli kpoŋe.
Ba kpɔ peleme daa ɡoo dawɛ doli aa dawɛ pilare baa paaɡa a teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ la ta.
Doli la lɔ fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue, fi dɛ anue dawɛ pilare baa paaɡa a teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ la bɛlbwa ta.
Tokorore aa lɔ o ta teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ bele atoro a sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa.
Dea la doonyoa ɡbeni lɔ bele atoro dɛ ɛ fɔɔskwɛɛ a sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa.
Dea bɛl o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue lɔ bela, pato do o sie ba tɔɔ, asɛ pilare lawɔ kpoŋe.
Dea bɛl lole baa yerɔ Kookara Dea, ba berɔ dɛɛ yerɔ Waa Bola Aŋwɛnɛ Ta Dea.
Belaa Kooro Solomɔn so bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.
O kpɔ peleme daa sam dea la bini le harɛ kaa o saldoa bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn dem waa soɡe o ta bɛne Kookara Dea la, a bwa le dɔŋa.
O ma dem tɛ Ijipt Kooro bihaah waa moo la kɛŋɔ o kon la ken.
A ɡɛ deene la bwa, bwea aa wera a yoɡ do kpeɡri kohona nee ba maa le Dea la mumpar dɛ kaa nyundua.
Ba sɛah bela baa pɛɡra la fɔɔskwɛɛ, saradaa ba kpɔ sɛh a sie ne habɔɔ.
Bwea aa kana dɛ do wer kohona nee ba kpɔ pa o mun.
Ane lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anue, ane ɡe naɡale fi dɛ anɛ.
Bwea baa kpɔa ma chɔŋɛ mumpar kwaa la ta la ɡe wer kɛrɛdɛ, ba sɛah fɔɔskwɛɛ dɛ kpɔ peleme daa doli ja a ta.
Koodem la dembaah ne Korowii Dea dembaah, dɛ pato baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ jo Korowii Dea la, ba kpɔ bwea baa kwaara la ma sola atoro dɛ kpɔ peleme daa a teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dawɛ a ta.
Hiram toma wa Kooro Solomɔn tomɔ ba ka kpɔ Hiram waa soɡe bwɛjen Taaya, dɛ dɔ ayaawa kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema.
A ɡɛ Hiram nɔ, luhaah bɛl waa le Naftale dea biee on.
Dɛ o mɛɛ le bwɛjen Taaya, dɛ dɔ ayaawa kpɔe dɛ́ ɛ kwaa wejema.
O wejema ne liire waa dɔa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ ayaawa kwaa bwa soo siwi kan taeh.
O la Kooro Solomɔn yer la, dɛ ka ɛ toma bwa waa ŋɔa o ɛ. Hiram kpɔ ayaawa ɛ pilare anɛ, beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ, asɛ a bare ɡe naɡale fi dɛ anuatoro dɛ bar.
O berɔ kpɔ ayaawa la ane ɛ pilare tɔre anɛ chɔŋɛ a ta, bɛlbwa jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama.
Pilare la tɔre la, Hiram kpɔ ayaawa ɛ kwaane aa do kɛ jɔɡrɔre dawɛ a ta.
O ɛ jɔɡrɔre anuanɛ dawɛ bɛlbwa ta.
O kpɔ ayaawa la ane aa do ɡuleɡule kɛŋɔ daa nɔna ane baa dɛ yera pɔmeɡranet dawɛ pilare tɔ la ta, dɛ bar jɔɡrɔre la waa ɛa dawɛ a bɛlbwa ta la.
Pilare la aa lɔ pato la bini tɔre la do kɛŋɔ daa fee ken, a jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale anumɛl.
Pilare tɔre la bwa la, kwaa baa ɛa ɡuleɡule dawɛ jɔɡrɔre la ta la lɔ lafraanɛ teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛ bar a bwa.
Hiram kpɔ pilare la paaɡe Korowii Dea pato la ta.
Pila waa pa weekaŋle harɛbɔr la, o pa o sɔn Jakin.
Asɛ bɛl waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ɡe sɔne Boas.
Pilare la tɔre la, ba ɛa kɛŋɔ daa fee ken.
Gɛɛ ba ɛa dɛ kpɔ tonɛ pilare la toma.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ Hiram kpɔ ayaawa ɛ komɛl waa do ɡuleɡule kɛ loɡbajen baa yerɔ Mpo.
O paɡri sie lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anue, o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɡe ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, asɛ he valɔ baro ɡe aa, o lɔ naɡale fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue.
Loɡ la nyoa dɛ́ bar la, ba kpɔ ayaawa ɛ kwaane kɛ lukoli ken bar o bwa.
Ayaawa baa kpɔa loɡɛ Mpo la, o tenten nee ba kpɔ ɛ lukoli la ɡe.
Ayaawa loɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo la chɔŋɛ ayaawa waa kpɔa ɛ nabala fi dɛ anɛ nɛ, atoro sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera, atoro sie chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr, ta atoro sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ atoro ɡe sie chaɡɛ wee leebɔr.
Loɡ la chɔŋɛ a nɛ a habɔɔ, asɛ a sie chaɡɛ baŋ.
Loɡ la pipiripi do kɛŋɔ nɔmpaa del, asɛ o nyoa la ɡe do kɛŋɔ numol nyoa dɛ paɡri kɛŋɔ daa fee yon pili la ken.
O won nee ɡalɔŋre kaɡboŋa fi lɛɛ.
O berɔ ɡel Hiram kpɔ ayaawa ɛ kwaane aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore fi ane baa won a taɡa.
Bɛlbwa jaŋne ne o paɡri lɔ naɡale anumɛl, a jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɡe naɡale anaarɛ ne tama.
Ayaawaa ba kpɔ ɛ kwaa dɛ kpɔ maɡre o keŋkeŋni bwa, ba di kwaane kɛŋɔ nyujentena ne nabala dɛ kena kwaa ɡwine dawɛ a ta.
Kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo la bɛlbwa dɔ nakpale anaarɛ baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa, asɛ ba won a taɡa.
Ayaawa la ane ɡee ba kpɔ kwaa kon a nakpale suuɡi a ta.
Kwaa la bɛlbwa dɔ komɛl kɛŋɔ loɡ ken o chɔŋɛ o ta, asɛ dɛ dɔ kwaa anaarɛ loɡ la ɡe aa chɔŋɛ a ta.
Kwaa la bɛlbwa loɡ la aa chɔŋɛ o ta la, ba kpɔ ayaawa ɛ komɛl waa do ɡuleɡule ken do o bini, le bela dɛ kaa o nyundua ɛ naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama.
O luŋri ɡe ɡwaa naɡale anɛ ne tama, ba di ɡwine dawɛ o nyundua.
A nakpale anaarɛ la lɔ kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ kon la lɔɡa, asɛ kwaa a nakpale la aa suuɡi a ta la lawɛ kon la.
Nakpala la bɛlbwa bini paɡri ka tama á ɡwaa naɡale anɛ.
A nakpale do kɛŋɔ kon waa do kɛ torɔɡo baa vɔwa dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre la nakpale ken, kwaa a nakpale aa dɛ suuɡi a ta, ne a nakpala la ɡbaɡba ne spokire dɛ hɔpore, ayaawaa ba mwɛɛ ɛ a bwa.
Kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo la bɛlbwa dɔ nɔɔra anaarɛ, o loŋkoni bɛlbwa dɔ nɔn beŋkpoŋ, dɛ paaɡe o ta.
Ba ɛ kon ɡuleɡule bar kon la doa.
A ka tama ó ɛ naɡale beŋkpoŋ, o lawɛ kwaa baa kpɔa maɡre kon la kpoŋe.
Kerobim ne nyujentena ne bambie daa nee ba di ɡwine dawɛ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo la bobɛlbwa bar cheme.
Gɛɛ ba ɛ kwaa fi aa do kɛ torɔɡore baa taɡa la bwa, kombeŋkpoŋii ba kpɔ ɛ a bwa, dɛ bwa ɛ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ le dɔŋa.
Hiram berɔ kpɔ ayaawa ɛ loɡa fi, bɛlbwa dɛ lɛ nee ɡalɔŋre lafraanɛ, asɛ a bɛlbwa paɡri sie ɡe lɔ naɡale anumɛl.
Loɡ la bɛlbwa dɛ chɔŋɛ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo la bɛlbwa ta.
O kpɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore anue cheɡ Korowii Dea la weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera, dɛ kpɔ anue ɡe cheɡ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Dɛ kpɔ loɡbaa baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo la cheɡ Dea la weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛɛ kaa wee leebɔr loŋkora bobɛl.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ Hiram berɛ ɛ loɡa ne soofire, dɛ loɡa báa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ.
Gɛɛ Hiram ɛ dɛ tonɛ Korowii Dea bela toma bwa ɡɛ waa baɡɛ Kooro Solomɔn nyoa la.
Kwaa waa ɛa laanee, pilare anɛ dɛ a tɔre aa do kɛ loɡa dɛ chɔŋre a ta, dɛ ɡwine waa dia dawɛ tɔre aa chɔŋre pilare la ta, ne kwaane aa do ɡuleɡule kɛŋɔ daa nɔna baa yera pɔmeɡranet lafraanaarɛ baa bila teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ bele anɛ a do pilare la dor, ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore fi baa taɡa, bɛlbwa dɔ a loɡa, ne loɡbajen waa chɔŋɛ nabala fi dɛ anɛ nɛɛ baa yerɔ Mpo, ne loɡa ne soofire ne loɡa báa do chal kɛɛ nee a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ.
Kwaa Kooro Solomɔn aa ɡela Hiram Abi ɛ tɛo ó kpɔ cheɡ Korowii Dea la, ayaawa aa dɛ nyɛɡlee ba kpɔ ɛa.
Jɔɔdan Moo deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa dɛ do Sukot ne Saretan baah ta chooh ba kpɔ, dɛ charama ɛ komɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin dɛ fora bɔɔ, asɛ dɛ kpɔ ayaawa ɛ a bini.
Kooro Solomɔn ta kwaa waa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa nɔ tɔɡre maɡɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a warɔ kohona.
Gɛɛ a do baa wola a tɔɡre ɡe jemɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn berɔ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ Korowii Dea la bini laala.
Anee, suuɡaswɛm kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta, ne teeburre baa kpɔ paanoo baa bil o ta Korowii sie, kandea daa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛa la, kandere anue chɔŋɛ diɡ pera, anue ɡe chɔŋɛ ɡal pera Korowii Dea la bini tenten la sie, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ nyɛwɛ kandea ŋwɛn doŋa, ne kwaa ane kɛŋɔ daa fee, dɛ kandere.
Suuɡaswɛm tenten nee o ɛ a bwa.
O berɔ ɛ suuɡaswɛm tenten loɡbaala, ne kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ fee kandea ŋwɛn la doŋa, ne loɡa baa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ, ne loɡa ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ buh nii, ne dea la ɡbeni baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, ne ɡbeni aa lɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela ɡbeni, dɛ ɡbeni aa lɔ Dea la nyoa bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn aa ɛ Korowii Dea la toma bɛlbwa tonɛ la, o kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ne laala bwa o mɛɛ Kooro Devid aa kpɔa tɛ Korowii la ka cheɡ dea baa dɛ cheɡ laala o bini Korowii Dea la bini.
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka ne Korowii Dea bala Ate, Kooro Solomɔn yerɛ Israel nomonome, ne nomonome baa chɔ ba deene nyoo, ne nomonome baa chɔ ba lolanar nyoo bwa ba cheme o sie Jerusalam, kɛŋɔ bá la ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta ba cheɡ Korowii Dea.
Ba bwa balɔ dɛ ba cheme Kooro Solomɔn sie, Kukure Tɔpejen dii saŋ, korobinuanɛ waa ɛ Etanim ta.
Israel nomonome la bwa aa baa cheme la, sɔfore la kaa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la, dɛ kpɔ o ne kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ do o bini la bwa ba cheɡ Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la bini.
Sɔfore la ne Lewi dea tenaa la a ne, asɛ Kooro Solomɔn ne Israel tena baa chema la bwa che Fɔo Daka la sie, dɛ kpoo peera ne nae baa wola won kura ɛ saraha.
Asɛ sɔfore la kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ka cheɡ Korowii Dea la bini, Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela Kerobim la kena lɔɡre.
Kerobim la kena bɔle bela Fɔo Daka la aa cheɡa la bwa, dɛ tɔ o ne daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheo bwa ta.
Daa aa suuɡi o ta la jaŋne nomanta, dɛ nɛn cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la bini Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela aa, o dɛ naa.
Haa won che bobɛlbwa ɡe dɛ naa.
A ta lɔ bela ba le fini.
Komɛlbwa toole Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la bini ka ja bwepɛle anɛ Mosis aa kpɔa teɡli o bini Sinai Bwejen ta, bela Korowii ne Israel tena aa fɔwɛ fɔo ɡɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Sɔfore la aa dɛ le Korowii Dea bela la, bam den ba tɔ Korowii Dea la bwa ta.
Bam la nomanta, sɔfore la ta wone ɛ ba toma Korowii Dea bela, dɛ Korowii jirima su o bini bwa.
Anee Kooro Solomɔn soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he ŋɔ hɛɛ so baama biŋere binii.
N do Dedɛɛɡe tenten waa kana tɛɛ, bela haa so saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Israel tena la bwa taa cheɡɛ Kooro Solomɔn sie bela la, o berɛ sie chaɡ ba, dɛ swee Korowii be andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii ya Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ!
O teŋɛ nyoa waa baɡɛ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid la ta dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Le awola tɔpere maa kpɔ n nɛra Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta la, n ta ŋɔe bá do Dea n sɔn ta Israel harɛ bwɛjen bɛlbwa ta dɛɛ tom mɛ bela.
Kɛ n le hen Kooro Devid ŋɔ hɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛ.’ ” Anee Kooro Solomɔn berɛ ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ Kooro Devid lii o nyu bini dɛ fee ŋɔ wɛɛ do Dea Korowii sɔn taa, ásɛ ya Israel tena ɛɛ tomɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la bela.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, ‘Haa dɔ liire kɛŋɔ hɛɛ do Dea n sɔn taa nɔ, he ɛ waa kɛŋɔ haa lii ɡɛ, kɛ ane a bwa, he laa dɛ́ do Dea la, he ɡbaɡba bilolee dɛ́ do Dea la n sɔn ta.’ ” Ate, Kooro Solomɔn ŋɔ, “Korowii teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta.
N baa chiɡ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid naa ta, dɛ berɛ ɛ Israel kooro.
N do Dea Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la sɔn ta, ya Israel tena ɛɛ tomɔ o bini.
Korowii ne ya naawa fɔo baa fɔwa ɡɛ saŋ waa le ba ne Ijipt harɛ ta la nomanta, n kwaa bɔr Dea la bini tɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka bwepɛle anɛ aa teɡli o bini la o ba che o bini.” Kooro Solomɔn wesoŋa Asɛ Kooro Solomɔn ir ka che kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la sie Israel tena baa chema la bwa sie, dɛ paɡri o nɔɔra nyundua soŋe Korowii, dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, voɡa nɛra aa dɛ tomɛ ta kpeɡri dɔe nyundua kɛɛ harɛ kɛ hen!
He dɛ teŋɛ fɔo he ne he nɛra aa fɔwa ta, dɛɛ nyin nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ he waa ta bambile bwa ne.
He teŋɛ nyoa haa baɡɛ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid la ta, he ɡelɔ wobɛlbwa ɛ ɡɛ fini.
Name, n Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, teŋɛ nyoa haa baɡɛ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid waa ɛ he bonɔɔ la ta, ɡɛ haa ŋɔa ŋɔ dɛ o bii do sie dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta, ɡɛ he Mmarare aa dɛ baɡle la aa, o naanar bini bɛlee dɛ́ so Israel tena kora ta he sie.
N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, ɡel wobɛlbwa haa baɡɛ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid waa ɛ he bonɔɔ nyoa la ɛ kpela.
N Naa Korowii, a ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ hɛɛ won ba so harɛ nɔ ta naa?
Hale nyundua ɡba aa kanɛ tɛɛ kɛŋɔ he so.
Maa lii kɛŋɔ hɛɛ won ba so Dea waa do jeɡa maa doa tɛɛ nɔ ta.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he bonɔɔnee men, no n wesoŋa dɛ́ ɛ waa maa dɛ soŋe nɔ tɛ mɛ fini.
Dɛɛ daah Dea nɔ chɔɔ ne jwaana, bonɔɔ he le cheɡ ŋɔ baa tomɛ.
Dɛ n kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Dea nɔ ta dɛɛ soŋe naa, no n be.
No men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ wesoŋa, ne he nɛra Israel tena wesoŋa, ɡɛ saŋ báa kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Dea nɔ ta dɛɛ soŋe.
Che nyundua bela haa lole dɛ́ no, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa kɛ yaa.
Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛl kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ dawɛ o dɔŋ, asɛ a ba kɛŋɔ o ba he Dea nɔ bini dɛ ba che saraha kon la sie dɛ ŋwɛɛraa, noa nyundua bela, dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ tɛr onɔ la waa di bolchɔɡe la deŋne dɛ́ ɡel boldɛɛɡe te la.
Dɛ ya Israel tena yaa ɛ he nɛra nɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ, a che a ta ya dɔma pɔ ya nɛ, ya berɛ ba he be Dea nɔ bini dɛ ba soŋe ya wechɔɡa aa, noa nyundua bela, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ he nɛra Israel tena wechɔɡa kɛ ba.
Dɛ berɛ ba ba ne harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ ba naawa la ta.” Kooro Solomɔn berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ ya Israel tena yaa ɛ he nɛra ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ, asɛ he koh a waa dɛ lawɛ bwaala kpoŋe, asɛ ya charɛ ya liire dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ he Dea nɔ bini dɛɛ soŋe naa, noa nyundua bela haa soɡa la, dɛ́ kpɔ he bonɔɔna yaa ɛ he nɛra wechɔɡa kɛ yaa, dɛ́ baɡle yaa ɡɛ yaa so sodɛɛɡa.
Ásɛ he nɛ bwaala harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ yaa o ɛ ya kapɛrɛ kon la ta.
Dɛ lɔr chole harɛ la ta, kɛɛ weechɔɡa kɛɛ peuchɔɡe tao dɛ chɔɡ harɛ la kondikwa, kɛɛ tontombɛ fuɡo le harɛ la ta, kɛɛ dɔma balɔ ba lɔ tɔ he nɛra nɛɛ ba bwɛjena la bɛlbwa ta, harɛchɔɡ kɛɛ weela ba ba nɛɛ kwaraa naa, nɛra yaa ɛ he nɛra nɔ bini bɛlbwa koh a waa le o bambile ta dɛ ir nɔɔra nyundua chaɡɛ he Dea nɔ dɛ soŋe naa, noa nyundua bela haa soɡa la, dɛ́ kpɔ kɛ ba.
He ɡboo jemɛ nɛn bambile bini wa, che waa bɛlbwa aa ɛa ta dɛ́ tɛr o deŋne.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel ya ɔmɛ, dɛɛ tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa harɛ la haa kpɔa tɛ ya naawa la ta.
Hɔɔhra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ ɛɛ le bojaŋ harɛ bɛl taa dɛ́ ba tomɛ he Dea nɔ bini, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, ba no kpeɡri haa dɔa ne he sɔn ne wejena haa ɛa wa.
Dɛ ba bini bɛlbwa kpɔ sie chaɡɛ he Dea nɔ dɛ soŋe naa, noa nyundua bela haa soɡa la, ásɛ dɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa baa bɔɔra dɛɛ le he be la, ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra jemɛ dɛ́ kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛɛ, ɡɛ Israel tena yaa ɛ he nɛra aa dɛ ɛ la.
Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ Dea maa doa tɛɛ nɔ ɛ bela nɛra aa dɛɛ tomɛ.” Kooro Solomɔn berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he do he nɛra bobɛlbwa ŋɔ bá ka yo ba dɔma, asɛ ba berɛ sie chaɡɛ he bwɛjen ne he Dea maa doa he sɔn ta dɛ soŋe naa, noa nyundua bela haa soɡa, dɛ́ ɡel bá pɔ ba dɔma nɛ.
Dɛ ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa toole waa wola wechɔɡa ɛ, asɛ he baah di ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba dɔma pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ kɛɛ boboraa yoo, hale ba lɔ ba dɔma la harɛ ta, dɛ charɛ ba liire dɛ sɛh ba wechɔɡa dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ya ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ ɛ waa aa wola were.’ Dɛ ba berɔ ba he be ba bambile ne ba liire bwa ne dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ ba naawa bwɛjen haa lea cheɡ, asɛ n do he Dea tɛɛ he sɔn ta nɔ naa, noa nyundua bela haa soɡa la, ásɛ dɛ na ba sum.
Kpɔ he nɛra wechɔɡa baa ɛa bwa ne deŋnekpeɡ kɛ ba, dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔma nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Ya ɛ he nɛra, he kapɛrɛ diile haa kpɔ yaa le Ijipt harɛ ta yaa na bonyɛɡa kohona la.
N Naa Korowii, no he bonɔɔna yaa ɛ he nɛra Israel tena wesoŋa.
Dɛɛ no ya wesoŋa saŋ bɛlbwa yaa wi dɛɛ noe.
Henee le yaa le harɛre bwa nɛra bini dɛ kpɔ yaa ɛ he kapɛrɛ diile.
Nemenɛ Korowii, ɡɛɛ he che he bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ bol ɡɛ saŋ haa le ya naawa le Ijipt harɛ ta la.” Kooro Solomɔn wesoŋa aa ka mun Kooro Solomɔn aa ir nɔɔra nyundua dɛ soŋe Korowii tonɛ la, o iro ka che saraha kon la sie, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Israel tena baa chema la bwa dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ waa ɡela o nɛra Israel tena dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ɡɛ waa baɡɛ yaa nyoa la.
Wedɛɛɡa waa cheɡɛ o bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ baɡɛ yaa nyoa la, o ta o wobɛlbwa waa bola vɛɛh.
Ya dɛ soŋe Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ kɛ o ja ya nɛɛ ɡɛ o fa aa ja ya naawa nɛɛ la.
O bɛ yaa ɡel, o bɛ yaa ta.
O ɡel ya bambili lawɔ, ásɛ ya do ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin, ásɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne waa waa do ya naawa la bwa ta.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, lii n waa maa dɛ soŋe nɔ saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ dɛɛ na he bonɔɔ ne n harɛ Israel tena bwa sum tɔpere bɛlbwa, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he ɡboo Korowii.
N dɛ soŋe kɛ he nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii ɛɛ di kasinteŋ dɛɛ valɛ o Mmarare ne waa waa do heyaa la ta ɡɛ aa doa fini nɔ.” Korowii Dea kpɔe dɛ́ do o nɔn ta wa Belaa Kooro Solomɔn ne Israel tena baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare Korowii sie bela.
Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ nae kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ, ne peera dɛ boohna kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare tɛ Korowii.
Gɛɛ Kooro Solomɔn ne Israel tena bwa ɛ dɛ kpɔ Dea la do Korowii nɔn ta.
Awola tenten la, Kooro Solomɔn le dembaah waa lɔ Korowii Dea sie la cheɡ o do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii.
Belaa o kpo kwaa dɛ fuah, dɛ ɛ mea sarahare, dɛ fuh ola la noorare ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, dɛkalkɛŋɔ saraha kon baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo la aa kanɛ kɛ a ɡɛ kwaa la bwa won jo o ta.
Korowii Dea belaa Kooro Solomɔn ne Israel tena la bwa di Kukure Tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ.
Nɛnlaa tenten le ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa chɔa kaa bwɛjen Hamat waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ ba.
Tɔ aa pera la, Kooro Solomɔn tɛ bɛlbwa ŋwɛnɛ o kaa o bwɛ.
Ba sie lɛ andɛɛɡa Korowii aa sweera tɛ o nɛra Israel tena ne Kooro Devid dɛ Solomɔn la wa.
Korowii kpɔ o te baɡle Solomɔn deera ta Kooro Solomɔn aa do Korowii Dea la ne o koodem dɛ tonɛ ne anɔ la waa dɛ nyin bwa la, Korowii ba o be ja, ɡɛ waa la o be Gebeɔn la.
Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N no he wesoŋa ne waa haa kpɔa bil n sie la.
N le Dea haa doa tɛ mɛ cheɡ dɛ ɡel o do ɡoroŋ tɛ mɛ ŋɔ baa tom mɛ o ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n sie ne n bambile do bela mɛɛ daahno saŋ bɛlbwa.
Dɛ hen Solomɔn tom mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa doe a ta ɡɛ he mɛɛ Devid aa ɛa la aa, amɔ te, mɛɛ ɡeloo kora haa dɛ di Israel tena nɛɛ la che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa, ɡɛ maa baɡɛ he mɛɛ Devid nyoa ŋɔ, ‘He naanaree dɛɛ ba Israel tena nɛɛ nyiŋa saŋ bɛlbwa’ la.
Kɛ dɛ he ne he nɛra berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛ vɛh me Mmarare ta teŋa, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa ane dɛɛ ɡuŋa aa, ate, mɛɛ le Israel tenaa le harɛ maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba nɔ ta, dɛ́ vɛh n Dea maa lea cheɡ dɛ ɡel o do ɡoroŋ ŋɔ ó ɛ bela baa dɛɛ tom mɛ nɔ ta.
Ásɛ Israel tena berɛ wesoma nɛra, harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Dea nɔ dɛ ba kuuɡa chɔ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa teŋe ba kaa la nyoa kpo o bwara yɔr ó ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa ɡela Korowii ɛ harɛ nɔ ne Dea nɔ ken?’ Ásɛ nɛra chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Baa le Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ, o le ba naawa ne Ijipt harɛ ta habɔɔ, dɛ berɛ kaa yarada voɡa ane dɛɛ toma la waa Korowii kpɔ ɡɛ wekpeɡa nɔ ta ba nɛɛ la.’ ” Kooro Solomɔn ne Kooro Hiram fɔo fɔwa Bene fifraanɛɛ Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ do Korowii Dea ne o koodem la.
Taaya Kooro Hiram kpɔ peleme daa ne dadɛɛɡa ane soo siwi dɛ suuɡaswɛm Kooro Solomɔn aa dɛ nyin dɛ kpɔ ɛ o toma la bwa ba tɛo.
Anomanta, Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ Galilia harɛ ta bwɛɛre fifraanɛ tɛ Kooro Hiram.
Kooro Hiram aa laŋa ka nyiŋi bwɛɛre Kooro Solomɔn aa kpɔa tɛo la, o sie ta a ta lɛɛ.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, “N dam, bwɛ besooree he kpɔ tɛ mɛ ken?” Anomanta, o pa baah bela bwɛɛre la sɔn Kabul Harɛ.
Gɛ sɔn la ta lole ba le fini.
Dɛ Kooro Hiram tɛ Kooro Solomɔn suuɡaswɛm tenten a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa anaarɛ fifraanuatoro.
Kooro Solomɔn waa waa bera ɛa ja Ŋwɛnɛ Kooro Solomɔn aa kpɔa ɛɡre nɛra ba ma Korowii Dea ne o ɡbaɡba koodem, ne bwea waa ɡela ba che su bwɛjen Jerusalam wee leebɔr pera waa ɛ bɔɔ la bini o su, ne danjwɛjen waa baro, ne bwɛjena Hasɔ ne Meɡido dɛ Gɛsa laanee la.
Ijipt kooro yo Gɛsa tena dɛ fuh bwɛɛ la, dɛ kpoo Keenan tena baa lɔ bela, dɛ kpɔ bwɛɛ la kɛ o bihaah Kooro Solomɔn aa moo la, kɛŋɔ kon waa kpɔa kɛo ó kpɔ ka yalɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn kwaarɔ vɔrɔwe Gɛsa, dɛ kwaa vɔrɔwe Bɛt Hɔrɔn harɛbɔr pera, ne bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Baalat ne Tadmɔ aa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta Juda harɛ ta, ne bwɛjena baa do deene dɛɛ cheɡ kwaa a bini ne bwɛɛre kwaa baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre ne o jaɡre aa dɛ do, ne komɛlbwa o pɛla aa dɔa kɛŋɔ ó ma Jerusalam, ne Lɛbanɔn ne harɛ la bobɛlbwa waa dɛ di o ta kora.
Amɔre ne Hiti ne Pɛrɛs ne Hivi dɛ Jebus tena baa kaa baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ la, ba naanaree kaa Israel tena aa wola wone kpoo ba.
Banee Kooro Solomɔn ɛɛ ba yoma baa ɛ tomkpeɡa Israel harɛ ta ba le fini.
Kɛ Israel tena la te, Kooro Solomɔn ta bɛlbwa kpɔe ɛ yom.
Bane ɛ laa tena dɛ yo dɛɛ tɛo, ne nomonnyuune ne laa sitɔɔla ne nomonome baa chɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡo ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre, dɛ banɔ la baa dɛ so jaɡre ta bwa nyoa.
Kooro Solomɔn nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ ɛ tomkpeɡa nɛɛ la lɔ lafraanue fifraanue.
Ijipt kooro bihaah Kooro Solomɔn aa moo la, le Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta dɛ ba koodemfale o jaa Kooro Solomɔn aa doa tɛo la ta.
O berɔ ɡel nɛra che bwea su bwɛjen Jerusalam wee leebɔr pera waa ɛ bɔɔ la bini.
Kooro Solomɔn dɛ ɛ sarahare kera atoro bena bɛlbwa, saraha kon waa ɛa tɛ Korowii la ta.
Sarahare baa dɛ fuah ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare bwaa o ɛ. O fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma ja a ta Korowii sie.
Gɛɛ a do o tonɛ Korowii Dea la doe.
Kooro Solomɔn berɔ ɛ stiimaere bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Eseɔn Gɛba ta, o bɛne Elat waa lɔ Edom harɛ ta, Mposwɛm nyoa.
Kooro Hiram tomɛ o nɛra baa jemɛ mpo nee toma wa ba ne Kooro Solomɔn nɛra pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma mpo ta.
Ba la harɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Ofir ta, dɛ ka lɛ suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anaarɛ lafraanɛ fifraanuatoro ba tɛ Kooro Solomɔn.
Seeba kooro waa ɛ haah la Kooro Solomɔn be Seeba kooro waa ɛ haah baa no Kooro Solomɔn sɔn lee waa lea kohona.
Anomanta, o la Kooro Solomɔn be Jerusalam, dɛ kpɔ wobobeela a bini aa kpeɡa dɛ́ ba daahno na.
Seeba kooro la kpɔ nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ dɛ warɛ ja o nɛ, ne nyoɡmare aa cheɡɛ konsɔɔhsoma ne suuɡaswɛm kohona, ne bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa kohona, dɛ la Kooro Solomɔn be.
Waa laŋa o ne o ka cheme la, o bɔɔ Kooro Solomɔn waa aa lɔ o nyu bini bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn chaŋe waa waa bɔɔro bwa kɛrɛdɛ ken tɛo, wobɛlbwa toole dɛ do kpeɡri waa wola wone baɡle a bini.
Seeba kooro la aa na wejema Kooro Solomɔn aa dɔa ne koodem waa doa, ne kondikwaa aa cheɡɛ o kondikondibɔr, ne o nomonome sobɔr, ne o bonɔɔna baa dɛ tomɔ, ne ba laala baa doa, ne bonɔɔna baa do batakaani dɛɛ doo sen, dɛ kwaa waa kpoora dɛ fuah dɛɛ ɛ sarahare Korowii Dea la, a ɛo nyokpoa.
Anee o ŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Waa haa ɛa ne wejema haa dɔa n do n harɛ ta dɛ no la ɛ kpela.
N ta ɡɛ baa bola la yaradae, atane n ɡbabir aa baa naa siwi ne nɔ.
Waa la baa bola la ta waa nɔ bɛne kwara.
He wejema ne he kondɔɔh ɡwaa anɔ la maa noa la kohona.
He nɛra nyu som, he nomonome baa dɛ che he jwɛɛh saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ no he wejemwaa la ɡe na som.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɔ jam.
O sie lɛ he nɛ, dɛ cheɡe kora ta Israel.
Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa o kpɔ dɛɛ nyin o nɛra Israel tena la nomanta, o cheɡe kora ŋɔ he nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne waa aa toɡra ne.” O kpɔ suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɡwaa kilore kaɡboŋa anaarɛ, ne konsɔɔhsoma aa wara pirim, dɛ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa tɛ Kooro Solomɔn.
Seeba kooro waa ɛ haah konsɔɔhsoma waa kpɔa ka tɛ Kooro Solomɔn kan aa doa la, nomɛlbwa ta a dɔŋa ne balɛ ɡɛ bwa.
Kooro Hiram stiimaere la Ofir harɛ ta, dɛ ka kpɔ suuɡaswɛm, dɛ kpɔ dadɛɛɡa ane, ne bwedɛɛɡa a bwa yoɡ aa kpeɡa ba.
Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ dadɛɛɡa la ɛ bela waa kpɔa teeh dɛɛ kaa Korowii Dea la ta ne koodem bela, dɛ kpɔ ane ɛ janjelare ne kwaa bwa soo siwi baa dɛ ɛ ane yela.
Ba ta ɡɛ daa la dɔŋa ne Israel harɛ ta balɛ kpa bwa, hale ba le fini.
Kooro Solomɔn berɔ tɛ Seeba kooro waa ɛ haah komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin, anɔ la bwa aa chɛ kɛ ó tɛo bwa la habɔɔ.
Ate, kooro la ne o nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ berɛ kaa Seeba harɛ ta.
Kooro Solomɔn kondɔɔh wa Suuɡaswɛm Kooro Solomɔn aa dɛ dɔ benanyoa bɛlbwa la tɔɡre ɛɛ ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ, lafraanumɛl fifraanaarɛ dɛ anaarɛɛ.
Anɔ la waa dɔa dɛɛ le bonadiire ne kon-yoɡra ne Arab harɛ koranar dɛ nomonome baa chɔ harɛre nyoo be te ta jae.
Kooro Solomɔn loɡɛ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta anjena lafraanɛ.
Suuɡaswɛm aa bɔle bɛlbwa ta tɔɡre lɔ kilore anuanɛ.
O berɔ ɛ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta anjeɡre lafraatoro, suuɡaswɛm aa bɔle bɛlbwa ta tɔɡre lɔ kilore atoro.
Asɛ o ɡel ba kpɔ kwaa la ka do o koodem dejen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Lɛbanɔn Kɔr Bini Koodem bini.
Kooro Solomɔn berɔ ɡel ba kwaa kookara waa kana.
Ba kpɔ bala nyen ɛ o pera, asɛ o kabora ɛ suuɡaswɛm tenten ba ɛ dawɛ o ta.
Ba ɛ bɔre anumɛl, bela waa che teeh kaa so kookara la ta.
Ba ɛ kara la habɔɔ ɡuleɡule ken.
Dɛ ɛ bela waa kpɔ nɔɔra dɛɛ dawɛ kara la ta, baŋne anɛ.
Dɛ berɛ ɛ kwaane aa le nyujentena anɛ a che kara la jwɛh.
Ba ɛ nyujentena fi dɛ anɛ chɔŋre kwaa waa cheɡɛ a ta teeh kaa so kookara la ta.
Ba ta ɡɛ kookara nɔ dɔŋ bɛlbwa ɛɛ ken tɛ koojen bɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn numoli bwa, suuɡaswɛmee ba kpɔ ɛa.
Laala aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn Kɔr Bini Koodem ɡe, suuɡaswɛm tenten nee ba ɛ a bwa.
Ba ta suuɡapoŋa kpɔe ɛ komɛlbwa dɛkalkɛŋɔ, Kooro Solomɔn bere saŋ la, dɛ suuɡapoŋa ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ, dɛ baa a ne wobɛlbwa ɛ. Dɛ kooro dɔ stiimaere baa kpɔa dɛɛ di bona mpo ta a ja Kooro Hiram kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma la ta.
Bene atoro bɛlbwa a dɛ ba suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne bala nyena, dɛ ɡbɛɛne bwa soo siwi ne.
Dɛ Kooro Solomɔn dɔ suuɡa ne wejema dɛ ɡwaa kooro bɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta.
Nɛra bwa yon dɛɛ nyin o be bala dɛ́ ba no wejemwaa Korowii aa tɛo la.
Benanyoa bɛlbwa ba dɛ ba o be naa, koŋkɛɛla aa ɛ kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ɛa, ne batakaani ne dɔmkwa ne konsɔɔhsoma ne jaɡre, dɛ keeɡoree ba kpɔ baa tɛo.
Kooro Solomɔn dɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore kaɡboŋ lafraanaarɛ ba kpɔ dɛɛ la laa.
O dɔ jaɡre ɡe kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anɛ.
O kpɔ ane ka do bwɛjena ane ta, ane ɡe do o be Jerusalam.
O bere saŋ dɛ suuɡapoŋa ta nyae Jerusalam kɛŋɔ bwea aa wola nyae nɔ.
Peleme daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ do deene ɡe bu kɛŋɔ, fiɡ daa aa cheɡɛ Juda harɛ deŋɡarere lɔɡre ken.
Kooro Solomɔn bonadiire yon ka yawɛ o jaɡre a yoɡ aa wera dɛɛ le Ijipt harɛ ne Kue.
Ba le kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba.
Beŋkpoŋ yoɡ lɔ suuɡapoŋa lafraanumɛl, jaɡre la ɡe beŋkpoŋ lɔ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraanue.
Ba le ane bela baa tɛ Hiti ne Siiria koranar bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn charɛ o liire le Korowii be Ijipt Kooro bihaah Kooro Solomɔn aa moo la habɔɔ, o berɔ nyin Moab ne Amɔn ne Edom ne Sidon dɛ Hiti tena bihaahna.
Ba ɛ nɛra Korowii aa bol ba waa Israel tena be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ban mo ásɛ ba ba berɛ he liire kaa ba voɡare ta.” Kɛ ane a bwa, ɡɛ nɛra laanee Kooro Solomɔn ka mo.
O mo haahna baa ɛ koobii lafraanuanɛ, o sɛnanar ɡe lafraatoro.
O haahna la ɡelɔ o liire charɛ le Korowii be.
Waa baa hwɛɛh la, haahna la berɛ o liire kaa voɡare toma ta.
Dɛ o bambile toole Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ nɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ o mɛɛ Kooro Devid fa aa ɛa la.
Kooro Solomɔn kaa teŋɛ Sidon voɡhaah Astɔrɛt dɛ Amɔn tena voɡ Molɛk aa ɛ kii kwaa la nɛ.
A cheɡɛ a ta Kooro Solomɔn ɛ Korowii wechɔɡa dɛ jo o nɛ, o waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛo kɛŋɔ o mɛɛ Kooro Devid.
Kooro Solomɔn do dea bwe bɛl ta Jerusalam wee leebɔr, dɛ kwaa bɔr baa dɛɛ tomɛ Moab tena voɡ Kemɔs ne Amɔn tena voɡ Molɛk aa ɛ kii kwaa la.
O do voɡa deene tɛ o haahna la bwa, asɛ ba kaa fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ ɛ sarahare a ta.
Korowii baah di Kooro Solomɔn nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o bambile le on Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ o kpɔ o te baɡlo kera anɛ bwa la nɛ.
Korowii fe kaoh ŋɔ o bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ, kɛ o ta waa waa doo a ta la ta teŋɛ.
Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Haa saahna chɔɡ n ne he fɔo yaa fɔwa dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ waa maa doe a ta nomanta, mɛɛ laa kora laanee lɛ he be, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛ nomonome baa lɔ he lɔɡa la bini bɛl.
He mɛɛ Kooro Devid nomanta, he saŋ ta laa mɛɛ ba ɡela a chiɡ, he bibaa bɛl waa ba di kora saŋ bɛl taa mɛɛ ba ɡela a ɛ. Kɛ mɛɛ koh n bonɔɔ Kooro Devid ne bwɛjen Jerusalam maa kpɔa ɛ n bwɛɛ la waa, maa kora la bwaa lɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡel dea beŋkpoŋ nɛraa tɛ he bie.” Kooro Solomɔn dɔma wa Belaa Korowii ɡel Hadad ɛ Kooro Solomɔn dɔm.
Edom tee Hadad nɔ, o le Edom koranar dea.
Kooro Devid ne Edom tena fa yoo, asɛ Joab waa ɛ laa sitɔɔ la ka huɡe nɛra baa serewe laa ta la bela.
O ne o laa tena kaa kpoo Edom baala bwa.
Joab ne Israel tena la bwa soɡe Edom korobie anumɛl ka tel kɛŋɔ baa kpoo bela baala bwa.
Hadad ne o mɛɛ bonɔɔna baa ɛ Edom tena bane ɡboo wona dɔ bɔr chwa kaa Ijipt harɛ ta.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Hadad ɛ bechala.
Ba le Midian dɛ kaa Paran, dɛ ka kpɔ baala bane ja ba nɛɛ ba kaa Ijipt Kooro be.
Asɛ Kooro la tɛ Hadad dem ne harɛ, dɛɛ tɛo kondikwaa ɡe.
Kooro la tea too Hadad nɛ, asɛ o lawɛ o ɡbaɡba haah waa ɛ haŋkooro baa yerɔ Tapenes nime bihaah tɛ Hadad o mo.
Tapenes nime lolɛ bibaa asɛ ba pa o sɔn Genubat, asɛ Tapenes kpɔ bie la kaa koodem dɛ ka dɛɛro o ne kooro bii do bela.
Hadad baa no kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid sewɔ, Joab waa ɛ o laa sitɔɔ ɡe sewɛ.
Belaa o ŋɔ Ijipt Kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa, n poori tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń berɛ kaa n harɛ ta.” Anee Ijipt Kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin n ta hen tɛɛ hɛɛ nyin he berɛ kaa he harɛ ta nɔ?” Hadad chaŋe ŋɔ, “Wobɛlbwa laa, he te tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ásɛ n berɛ kaa.” Korowii berɔ ɡel Eliada bibaa Resɔn ɛ Kooro Solomɔn dɔm.
Dɛ o fa ɛ Soba Kooro Hadadesa bonɔɔ, dɛ chwa le o be.
Resɔn nɔɔ fa boa baala bane nyoa dɛ ɛ ba nomoa ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Devid aa kpoo Soba tena la.
Asɛ ɡɛ dɔm la kaa bwɛjen Damaskɔs, dɛ ka lɛ bela dɔɔh dɛɛ di bela kora.
Kooro Solomɔn saŋ bwa dɛ Resɔn ɛ Israel tena dɔm, dɛ ja anɔ la Kooro Hadad aa ɛa la ta dɛ hah Israel tena.
Anomanta, Resɔn di kora Aram harɛ ta dɛ ɛ Israel dɔm.
Jɛroboam ɛ Kooro Solomɔn deŋnekpeɡ Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Jɛroboam, o mɛɛ sɔne Nɛbat, Efrem tee on o le Sɛrɛda.
O nya ɡe sɔne Sɛroa dɛ ɛ luhaah.
Dɛ Jɛroboam ɛ Kooro Solomɔn nomonome la bini bɛl dɛ do o lɔɡa, dɛ ɛ Kooro dɔm.
Gɛ aa ɛa o ɛ Kooro Solomɔn deŋnekpeɡ laanee nɔ.
Gɛ saŋ Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba che bwea su Jerusalam wee leebɔr pera waa ɛ bɔɔ dɛ ma o danjwɛɛre o mɛɛ Kooro Devid aa maa la.
Dɛ Jɛroboam ɛ bonɔɔ he kpɔ toma do o nɔn ta naa, ó won ɛa kɛrɛdɛ, Kooro la aa na ɡɛ o toma ɛɛ aa doa la, o kpɔɔ chɔ Manasɛ ne Efrem deene tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ ɛ tomkpeɡa nyoa.
Awola bɛl, Jɛroboam le Jerusalam dɛɛ kaa, asɛ Korowii keame bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Ahija, o le Silo leɔ dɛ ka chemo ŋwɛnɛ ta kpɔɡ bini.
Dɛ Korowii keame la do o batakaare onfale.
Dɛ ba nɛra banɛ la ɡboo ŋwɛnɛ baah ta bela.
Belaa Korowii keame Ahija laa batakaare waa doa la foo, dɛ laa peeɡe bɔre fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ ŋɔ Jɛroboam be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ a bini bɔre fi dɛkalkɛ, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Na, n dɛ ba Kooro Solomɔn kora laa lɛ o nɔn ta, dɛ́ kpɔ deene fi nɛra tɛɛ.
N bonɔɔ Kooro Devid ne bwɛjen Jerusalam maa lea le Israel deene bwa bini la nomanta, dea beŋkpoŋ nɛraa dɛ́ ɛ o nɛra.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛɛh mɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ Sidon tena voɡhaah Astɔrɛt, ne Moab tena voɡ Kemɔs, dɛ Amɔn tena voɡ Molɛk.
Ba ta n ŋwɛnɛre ta kpɔe, ba ta waa aa wera n be ɛɛ, kɛɛ dɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ta kɛŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn mɛɛ Devid aa ɛa la.
Kɛ maa kora la bwaa lɛ le Kooro Solomɔn be.
Mɛɛ koh Kooro Devid maa leo cheɡ tɛ n te wɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ta la waa, dɛ́ ɛo harɛ la ta nomoa o soɡa bini bwa.
Mɛɛ laa kora laanee lɛ Kooro Solomɔn bibaa la nɔn taa, dɛ́ kpɔ deene fi nɛra do he nɔn ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔ dea beŋkpoŋ nɛraa do o nɔn ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ n dɔ n bonɔɔ Devid naa saŋ bɛlbwa wɛɛ di kora Jerusalam, bwɛjen maa lea cheɡ ŋɔ baa tom mɛ la ta.
Jɛroboam, henee mɛɛ ba kpɔe he di kora dɛɛ nyiŋi Israel harɛ ta, hɛɛ di kora bobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.
Dɛ he noɔ dɛ ɛ waa maa doe a ta bwa, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra n be, dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ta kɛŋɔ n bonɔɔ Devid aa ɛa la aa, n fe ɛɛ che he mun taa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he kora che kiŋkiŋ kɛŋɔ maa ɛa tɛ Kooro Devid la, dɛ́ kpɔ Israel harɛ tɛɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn wechɔɡa nomanta, mɛɛ ba Kooro Devid naanar ne harɛɛ, kɛ dɛɛ la saŋ bɛlbwa laa.’ ” Kooro Solomɔn takapɔ kɛŋɔ ó kpo Jɛroboam, asɛ o chwa kaa Ijipt harɛ ta Kooro Sisak be ka tel kɛŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn aa sewa.
Kooro Solomɔn seo wa Kooro Solomɔn kora waa ne anɔ la waa ɛa bwa ne o wejemwaa waa ɛa, ba chwerɛ a waa do o tɔn bini.
Kooro Solomɔn di kora Israel harɛ ta Jerusalam bene fifraanaarɛ.
A habɔɔ, Kooro Solomɔn sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ ba huɡo Jerusalam, o mɛɛ Kooro Devid bwɛjen ta, asɛ o bibaa Rɛhoboam ba chiɡ o naa ta di kora.
Israel tena ɛ Kooro Rɛhoboam deŋnekpeɡ Kooro Rɛhoboam la bwɛjen Sɛkem, dɛ Israel tena bwa cheme bela, dɛ́ chiɡu kora ta.
Nɛbat bibaa Jɛroboam o fa aa chwaa le Kooro Solomɔn be dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta aa no ɡɛ waa la, o le Ijipt bela dɛ ba.
Ba tomɛ nɛra ba ka yerɛ Jɛroboam, asɛ o ne Israel tena la baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la bwa la ka ŋɔ Kooro Rɛhoboam be ŋɔ, “He mɛɛ fa ɡelɔ ya ɛ tomkpeɡa.
Taraken yaa sɛh dɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ tomkpeɡa la dɔŋa kpa.
Gel a do korokoro ásɛ yaa tomɛ.” Kooro Rɛhoboam ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kaa n kpɔ a liire, ásɛ tɔpetooro wee he berɛ ba.” Asɛ ba bwa kaa.
Ate, Kooro Rɛhoboam cheme nomonome ba ne o mɛɛ Kooro Solomɔn fa aa lole baa jao la, dɛ kpɔ bil ba sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Wejaala besoo he dɔ tɛ mɛ ń bol baɡle nɛra nɔɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ he sɛoh kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɛɛ tom baa dɛ sɛh dɛɛ bol wedɛɛɡa ba be tenaa, ate baa tomɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa.” Kooro Rɛhoboam ta nomonome la jae baa jao la noɛ, dɛ ka no o bala o ne baa ira baa tomɔ la wa.
Kooro Rɛhoboam kpɔɔ bil ba sie ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ ń chaŋe nɛra nɔ baa ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń ɡel ba toma do korokoro nɔ waɔ?” O bala o ne baa ira la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Waa aa chɛ kɛ he bol ba be laanee kɛŋɔ, n nonikekela kwaraa bare ɡwaa n mɛɛ chara.
N mɛɛ ɡelɔ he ɛ tomkpeɡa, n te ɛɛ ɡeloo he ɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ.
Chweema nee n mɛɛ tɛr he deŋne, kɛ n te ɛɛ kpɔ balansoo tɛr he deŋne.” Tɔpera atoro habɔɔ la, Jɛroboam ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa berɔ ba Kooro Rɛhoboam be ɡɛ waa ŋɔ ba be la.
Kooro Rɛhoboam vɛh nomonome la jae baa jao la, dɛ kpɔ nyɛɡa bol waa nɛra la be.
O kpɔ o bala o ne baa ira la jae la dɛ ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ ɡelɔ he ɛ tomkpeɡa, kɛ n te ɛɛ ɡeloo a ɡwaa ɡɛ.
Chweremi nee o tɛr he deŋne, kɛ n te ɛɛ kpɔ balansoo tɛr he deŋne!” Kooro la ta nɛra la waa la ta noɛ tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ Korowiirii ɛa ɡɛ, dɛ ɡel waa waa cheɡɛ Silo te Ahija nɛɛ dɛ bol Nɛbat bibaa Jɛroboam be la ɛ kpela.
Nɛra baa ja Kooro Jɛroboam nɛ aa naa kɛŋɔ kooro la ta ba waa la ta noɛ la, ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya ne Kooro Devid naanar toole wobɛlbwa bini.
Bɔkwaa ba ɛ tɛ yaa bwa nɔ?
Ya bala Israel tena, hé ɡel ya kaa dem.
Hé ɡel Kooro Rɛhoboam di o kora.” Gɛɛ a do Israel tena pa mun ɛo deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ bwa kaa ba deremi.
Kɛ, Israel tena baa lɔ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta la te, dɛ Kooro Rɛhoboam dɛ́ di kora ba nɛ.
Belaa Kooro Rɛhoboam tomɛ Adoniram waa chɔ tomkpeɡa ɛɛ nyoa ŋɔ o la Israel tena be.
Asɛ ba bwa foɡro bwea kpo.
Kooro Rɛhoboam dɔ warane dɛ jo o kon waa do kɛ torɔɡo bini, dɛ chwa ka sɔh Jerusalam.
Le a ɡɛ saŋee Israel tena baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ɛ Kooro Devid dem tena deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ pere ba te le ba nɛɛ dɛ ba le fini.
Baa noa kɛŋɔ Jɛroboam berɔ le Ijipt harɛ ta ba la, ba tomɛ nɛra ba ka kpɔɔ ba ba baah ta, dɛ ba cheɡo Israel harɛ ta bwa kooro.
Juda dea tena ɡboo teŋɛ Kooro Devid luɡe tena nɛ.
Kooro Rɛhoboam aa tel Jerusalam la, o boa Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene tena baala baa jemɛ yoi nyoa, nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanuatoro ŋɔ, bá ka yo Israel deene aa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ásɛ o won di kora harɛ la bwa ta.
Dɛ Korowii bol o keame Sɛmaya be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn bibaa Kooro Rɛhoboam, ne Juda dea kooro la ne Juda dea tena ne Bɛnjamen dea tena nɛra baa jaa la be ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ he bala Israel tena la ka pu yo.
Bɛlbwa berɛ kaa o dem, menee ɛa ɡɛ.’ ” Ate ba no, ba ta Jɛroboam ka yoi kpa, ate dɛ bwa berɛ kaa ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la.
Kooro Jɛroboam charɛ o liire le Korowii be Kooro Jɛroboam ɡelɔ ba ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar bwɛjen Sɛkem waa chɔ Efrem deŋɡarere ta dɛ lɛo cheɡ.
O le bela dɛ berɛ ka ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar Pɛnoɛl ɡe.
Kooro Jɛroboam liiro ŋɔ, “Name te, kora la ɛɛ berɔ ba Kooro Devid dem.
Dɛ n nɛra la Jerusalam dɛ ka ɛ sarahare Korowii Dea aa, baa charɛ ba liiree, dɛ́ ka teŋɛ ba dɔɔ Juda Kooro Rɛhoboam la nɛ.
Baa kpo mɛɛ dɛ́ berɛ kaa Kooro Rɛhoboam be.” O ja o te, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ nabali anɛ.
Dɛ ŋɔ Israel tena la be ŋɔ, “He bɛ he te koh dɛɛ la Jerusalam kpa.
He voɡa aa cha heyaa he won le Ijipt harɛ ta he naawa bere saŋ ba laanee la.” O kpɔ bɛl ka cheɡ Bɛtel waa bɛne Jerusalam ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ bɛl ɡe ka cheɡ Dan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua pera.
Gɛ waa nɔ ɡelɔ nɛra ɛ wechɔɡa, ba la Dan ne Bɛtel kaa toma.
Kooro Jɛroboam ɛ voɡa deŋɡarere doa dɛ le kerekpoŋra harɛ la ta, hale banɔ la baa wola Lewi dea leɛ ba so a ta.
O le tɔpejen cheɡ korobinuatoro o tɔpera fi dɛ anue ta, kɛŋɔ anɔ la baa dɛ dia Juda la ken, dɛ ɛ sarahare kon baa dɛ fuh kwaa o ta.
O ɛ saraha kon Bɛtel, ba kpɔ nabali ɛ sarahare beŋkpoŋ waa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛo la ta.
Bɛtel bela la, o kpɔ kerekpoŋra so voɡa waa ɛa deŋɡarere ta la ta.
Korobinuatoro, tɔpera fi dɛ anue waa lea cheɡ ta la, o la Bɛtel ka kpoo kwaa saraha kon la ta.
Gɛɛ o cheɡ tɔpejen tɛ Israel tena dɛ la kaa ɛ sarahare bela.
Korowii keame bɛl waa le Juda harɛ Awola bɛl, Korowii ɡelɔ o keame bɛl le Juda harɛ dɛ kaa Bɛtel.
Dɛ Kooro Jɛroboam lɔ kon baa ɛ saraha o ta la bɔr dɛɛ ba saraha ɛɛ.
Korowii keame la cheɡɛ Korowii waa ta dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Korowii tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta nɔ wa.
O ŋɔ, ‘Baa lolɛ bibaalee ó ɛ Kooro Devid naa baa yerɔ Josia.
He taa wɛɛ ba ó kpoo kerekpoŋra baa soɡe voɡa baa cheɡa deŋɡarere ta dɛɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛ́ fuh ba hoɡa he ta.’ ” Awola tenten, keame la baɡle waane aa dɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta nɔ bini ɛɛ peroo anɛ, ásɛ tɔɔ aa dawɛ o ta la fuɡe he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛɛ bol.” Kooro Jɛroboam aa no waa Korowii keame la aa bola la, o cheɡɛ kon la bɔr dɛ tɛr o nɔn pa Korowii keame la nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé lawɔ.” Buɡ la ta, nɔn waa tɛra pa Korowii keame la nɛɛ la ka ɡɛ, o ta wone ba o ne harɛ kpa.
Saraha kon la ɡe pero tɔɔ aa dawɛ o ta la fuɡe ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame la nɛɛ dɛ bol la.
Asɛ kooro la ŋɔ Korowii keame la be ŋɔ, “N poori, soŋe Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la tɛ mɛ ásɛ o chah n nɔn nɔ!” Ate, Korowii keame la soŋe Korowii, asɛ kooro nɔn la berɛ do ɡɛ o fa aa doa wubwa la.
Ate, Kooro Jɛroboam ŋɔ Korowii keame la be ŋɔ, “Ba ya kaa dem he ka di kwa, ásɛ n berɛ kɛɛ kwa waa haa ɛa nɔ wa.” Anee Korowii keame la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hale hɛɛ tɛ mɛ he kondɔɔh pera kwaraa yaa, n ne haa la á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ di kwaa dɛ nyɔ nee bonɔ.
Korowii do mɛ ŋɔ, ‘Bɛ kwaa di, bɛ nee nyɔ.
Bɛ ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta kaa la ta kpɔ ba.’ ” Anomanta, ŋwɛnɛfale taa o kpɔ kaa, o ta berɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta kaa Bɛtel la ta kpa.
Korowii keame banjena bɛl waa lɔ Bɛtel wa Dɛ Korowii keame banjena bɛl soɡe Bɛtel.
O bibaala kaa taa waa Korowii keame la aa baa ɛ awola, dɛ berɛ bol waa waa bol kooro ɡe be la.
Asɛ Korowii keame banjena la bɔɔ o bii la ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa o kpɔ kaalɔ?” Bii la baɡlo ŋwɛnɛ Korowii keame waa le Juda la aa kpɔ o ta kaa.
Asɛ o ŋɔ bii la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ kwaa pa keeɡo nɛɛ tɛ mɛ.” Ba pa kwaa pa o nɛ asɛ o ka so o ta, dɛ lawɛ ŋwɛnɛ Korowii keame la aa kpɔ o ta kaa la ta, dɛ ka puu dɛ o soɡe dajen bɛl mun.
Anee o bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Henee Korowii keame haa le Juda harɛ ba la aa?” O ŋɔ, “Menee.” Anee o ŋɔ Korowii keame la be ŋɔ, “Ba ya kaa dem he ka di kwa.” Korowii keame la ɡe chaŋo ŋɔ, “Maa won berɛ la mun ta kpa, maa won di kwaa kɛɛ dɛ́ nyɔ nee kwaraa bonɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ n bɛ komɛlbwa di kɛɛ dɛ́ nyɔ ne, dɛ bɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa kpɔ o ta kaa la ɡe ta kpɔ ba.” Ate, Korowii keame banjena la chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ɡe ɛ Korowii keame kɛ hen.
Korowii ɡelɔ nyundua torome ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń ba kpɔe kaa dem, dɛ ka tɛɛ kondikwaa ne nee he nyɔ.” Kɛ dɛ neɡraa wɛɛ neɡro.
Anomanta, o laa berɛ dɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ ba dem, dɛ ba di kwaa dɛ nyɔ ne.
Baa soɡa dɛɛ di kwaa la, Korowii bol waa banjena la waa kaa kpɔɔ ba la be.
Asɛ o kpɔ takpeɡ bol waa o dɔŋ waa le Juda harɛ la be ŋɔ, “Korowii ŋɔ, ‘He ta waa maa bola la noɛ, dɛ vɛh waa maa doe a ta la.
He berɔ ba di kwaa dɛ nyɔ nee bela maa ŋɔa, bɛ kwaa bela di, bɛ nee ɡe nyɔ la.
Gɛ nomanta, haa he naawa hoɡa taa chɔ.’ ” Waa di kwaa dɛ nyɔ nee la tonɛ la, keame banjena la waa kaa berɔ dɛ kpɔɔ ba la pa kwaa pa keeɡo la ta dɛ tɛo.
Waa chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la, o ne nyujente kaa cheme asɛ nyujente la kpoo.
O lale chɔ ŋwɛnɛ baah ta bela o keeɡo la che bela nyujente la ɡe che lale la jwɛh.
Nɛra bane ba dɛ kaa dɛ na kɛŋɔ waa sewa chɔ bela, asɛ nyujente che o jwɛh, ate ba la dɛ ka bol Bɛtel tena be, bela Korowii keame banjena la aa soɡa la.
Korowii keame waa kaa berɔ dɛ kpɔɔ ba la aa noa la, o ŋɔ, “Korowii keame waa vɛh Korowii waa laanee.
Korowiirii kpɔɔ tɛ nyujente o kpoo ɡɛ waa ŋɔa la.” Bela Korowii keame banjena la ŋɔ o bibaala be ŋɔ, “Hé pa kwaa dawɛ n keeɡo ta tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ ba ɛ ɡɛ.
O lawɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ o chɔɔ, keeɡo la ne nyujente la che o jwɛh.
Nyujente la ta on chwee, o ta keeɡo la ɡe kpoe.
Ate, o kpɔɔ dawɛ o keeɡo la ta, dɛ ba o ne Bɛtel, dɛ ba ɛ o lwe dɛ huɡo.
O huɡo o ɡbaɡba lalbɔɔ waa kwiu bini dɛ wi tɛo dɛ ŋɔ, “Bwɛɛlɛ n dɔŋ, bwɛɛlɛ ne seo.” Waa huɡo tonɛ la, o ŋɔ o bibaala be ŋɔ, “Dɛ n baa sewaa, hé huɡ mɛ bela baa huɡe Korowii keame nɔ.
Hé kpɔ o hoɡa bil n kwaa jwɛh.
Korowii waa waa bola saraha kon baa kpo kwaa o ta dɛɛ fuah Bɛtel bonɔ, ne voɡare aa lɔ deŋɡarere ta Samaria bwɛɛre ta bwa waa la ɛɛ chiɡuu kpela.” Ane a bwa, Israel Kooro Jɛroboam ta charɛ le o wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre la ta, dɛ teŋɛ le sɔfore bwa soo siwi baa lɔ bela dɛ ɛɛ ba kerekpoŋra voɡare aa lɔ deŋɡarere la ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o kpoŋe voɡ kere la, dɛ o cheɡo.
Gɛ wechɔɡa nɔɔ ba Kooro Jɛroboam dem ne o kora chɔɡa ne harɛ nɔ ta.
Kooro Jɛroboam bibaa seo wa A ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Kooro Jɛroboam bibaa Abija bwara dɛ weo, asɛ Kooro Jɛroboam ŋɔ o haah be ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ la Silo Korowii keame Ahija be, o lɔ bela.
Ka beɡre he te ásɛ ba bɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Kooro Jɛroboam haahnee hen.
Onee ŋɔ n be ŋɔ mɛɛ di kora Israel harɛ nɔ taa.
Kpɔ paanoo fi, ne kwaa baa kpɔ noo koo a ta dɛ wɔɔra la ane, ne tooh loŋ del la o be, ɡɛ bwa aa dɛ ba bie la chiɡa la, wɛɛ baɡlee.” Ate, Kooro haah la ir dɛ ɛ ɡɛ kooro aa bola la, dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta la Silo Korowii keame Ahija be o dem.
Dɛ Ahija hwɛɛhrɔ, waa na kɛrɛdɛ kpa.
Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ Ahija be ŋɔ, “Kooro Jɛroboam haah dɛ ba he be, o bie bwara dɛ weo wɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba bɔɔre a wa.” Asɛ Korowii baɡlo waa bwa waa bol o be.
Kooro Jɛroboam haah la aa bala la, o beɡre o te kɛŋɔ nɛmpɛɛ bɛl ken.
Korowii keame Ahija aa no Kooro Jɛroboam haah la nakpale sii o doonyoa la, o ŋɔ, “Kooro Jɛroboam haah dɛ ba.
Ɛrɛɛ he beɡre he te ɡɛ nɔɔ?
N dɔ waane dɛ bol he be, kɛ a ta amanesoma ɛɛ.
La ka ŋɔ Kooro Jɛroboam be ŋɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Menee lee le n nɛra Israel tena bini dɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ tɔ ba sie.
Menee laa Kooro Devid dem kora la pere dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ, kɛ he ta doe kɛŋɔ n bonɔɔ Kooro Devid waa teŋɛ men Mmarare ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ o bambile bwa ne dɛɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ too n tea ɡbo la.
He ɛ wechɔɡa kohona dɛ ɡwaa banɔ la baa tɔ he sie bwa.
He ɛ voɡa, dɛ kpɔ kwaa ɛ voɡa muɡli n baah, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ chɔɡ he koraa dɛ́ kpoo he bibaala, ne bechale ne nomonome baa lɔ Israel harɛ ta bwa, yoma ne banɔ la baa dɛ di ba nyuune bwa.
Mɛɛ fuh he demii kɛŋɔ baa dɛ fuh kondoŋa a bwa yon tonɛ la ken.
He dem nɛra baa serewe bwɛjena ta la, nyootenaa dɛ́ di ba ola, ásɛ jumbii ɡe di banɔ la baa serewe chɔ kpɔɡ bini la.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ” Korowii keame Ahija berɔ ŋɔ Kooro Jɛroboam haah la be ŋɔ, “Ir kaa, he nakpala aa dɛɛ tire he bwɛɛ la ta la, dɛ bie la dɛ sewɛ.
Israel tena bwa ɛɛ ɛ o lwee dɛ́ huɡo.
O ɡboo ɛ Kooro Jɛroboam nɛn baa dɛ ba huɡa, dɛkalkɛ Kooro Jɛroboam dem nɛra bwa bini, o ɡbo nɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la sie ɛɛ lɛ.
Korowii dɛ ba kooro lee Israel tena bini dɛ́ tɛ o te fini, dɛ chɔɡ Kooro Jɛroboam kora.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr Israel tena deŋnee, ba do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa pa nee ta dɛɛ yiiɡi la ken.
Wɛɛ chuɡri baa le harɛdɛɛɡe nɔ waa kpɔa tɛ ba naawa nɔ taa, dɛ́ lɔ ba peɡre Yufretis Moo baŋ le.
Ba kpɔ voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa paaɡe dɛ kpɔ muɡli o baah.
Kooro Jɛroboam wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛa nomanta, Korowii ɛɛ vɛɛh baa.” Ate, Kooro Jɛroboam haah la ir dɛ le kaa o bwɛɛ Tirsa.
Waa dena dɛɛ tel dem dɛ bie la dɛ sewɛ.
Israel tena bwa ɛ o lwe dɛ huɡo ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o bonɔɔ keame Ahija nɛɛ bol la.
Ba chwerɛ Kooro Jɛroboam bwara waa bwa, ne ɡɛ waa yoa, ne o kora dii waa bwa do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Jɛroboam di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ.
O sewɔ ba huɡo, asɛ o bibaa Nadab chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Rɛhoboam Kooro Solomɔn bibaa Kooro Rɛhoboam di kora Juda harɛ ta, dɛ o di bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
O di kora bene fi dɛ anuanɛ Jerusalam, bwɛjen Korowii aa lea le Israel deene bwɛɛre bini baa tomɔ bela la.
Kooro Rɛhoboam nya sɔne Naama, Amɔn tee.
Juda harɛ ta nɛra ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, a che a ta Korowii bandia ir ba nɛ.
Dɛ ba kwaa la ɡwaa anɔ la ba naawa aa ɛa la kwara.
Ba ɡe cheɡ voɡa deŋɡarere ta, dɛ paaɡe bwea, dɛ kpɔ voɡ Asera dajaŋa paaɡe deŋɡare bɛlbwa ta ne dajen bɛlbwa mun.
Hale dɛ baala dɛ bɔ jwamane voɡare mune harɛ la ta.
Juda harɛ ta tena jo kii we-ɛɛla bwa soo siwi nɛra ba fa aa lɔ bela dɛɛ ɛa mɔɔ Korowii doŋ ba le dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la ta.
Kooro Rɛhoboam aa di kora bene anue ta la, Ijipt Kooro baa dɛ yerɔ Sisak baa yo Jerusalam tena.
O pa kwaa aa lɔ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini Korowii Dea, ne anɔ la aa lɔ koodem bwa kaa.
Dɛ berɛ pa kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe Kooro Solomɔn aa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa la.
Anomanta, Kooro Rɛhoboam kpɔ ayaawa dɛ ɛ ane chiɡ suuɡaswɛm kwaa la naa ta, dɛ kpɔ do nɛra baa dɛ so koodem la doonyoa dɛɛ daah bela la nomonome nɔn ta ŋɔ báa nyiŋi a ta.
Saŋ bɛlbwa kooro aa la Korowii Dea la, nɛra baa dɛ daah bela yon kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe la kpoŋe, ásɛ a habɔɔ ba yon kpɔ ka cheɡ dea baa dɛ cheɡa a bini la ta.
Kooro Rɛhoboam kora dii saŋ waa aa bera chiɡ la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Dɛ yoi ta chɔ Kooro Rɛhoboam ne Kooro Jɛroboam baah ta.
Kooro Rɛhoboam sewɔ asɛ ba huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
O nya sɔne Naama, dɛ Amɔn tee.
Asɛ o bibaa Abija ba chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Abija Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anuatoro taa Abija di kora Juda harɛ ta.
Kooro Abija di kora Jerusalam bene atoro.
Abesalɔm bihaah Maaka biee Kooro Abija.
O ɡe ɛ o mɛɛ wechɔɡa la dɔŋa.
O ta o bambile bwa kpɔe tɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ kɛŋɔ o nabaa Kooro Devid aa ɛa la.
Kɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ koh Kooro Devid wa ɡɛ waa tomɔ nomanta, dɛ tɛo bibaa waa chiɡ o naa ta di kora Jerusalam, ásɛ Jerusalam won che.
Kooro Devid ɛ waa aa wera Korowii be, o ta wobɛlbwa Korowii aa doo a ta kone o soɡa bini bwa.
Atane Uria Hiti te la ɡbo waa ta.
Yoi chɔ Kooro Rɛhoboam ne Kooro Jɛroboam baah Kooro Abija kora dii saŋ bwa.
Ba chwerɛ Kooro Abija bwara waa bwa do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Dɛ yoi lɔ o ne Kooro Jɛroboam baah ta.
Kooro Abija sewɔ ba huɡo o naawa huɡribɔr Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
Asɛ o bibaa Asa chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Asa Kooro Jɛroboam aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ taa Kooro Asa di kora Juda harɛ ta.
Kooro Asa di kora Jerusalam bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
O naaa Maaka, Abesalɔm bihaah la.
Kooro Asa ɛ waa aa wera Korowii be, ɡɛ o nabaa Kooro Devid aa ɛa la.
O doŋi nɛra baa dɛ bɔ jwamane voɡare mun harɛ la ta, dɛ huɡri voɡa o naawa aa ɛa la bwa ta.
O ir o naa Maaka haŋkora ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, o ɛ voɡ Asera daa aa ɛ kii kwaa la.
Kooro Asa teŋni daa la dɛ fuah Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta.
