A lole kɛŋɔ Kooro Asa ta bela voɡtoroma aa soɡa dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa bwa chɔɡɛ le Israel harɛ ta te, kɛ dɛ o bambile cheɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ o soɡa bini bwa.
O kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm ne kwaa bwa o ne o mɛɛ aa dɔa dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta la ba Korowii Dea.
Dɛ yoi lɔ Kooro Asa ne Israel Kooro Baasa baah ba kora dii saŋ bwa ta.
Kooro Baasa kpɔ laa tena ka lɔ tɔ Juda Kooro Asa nɛ dɛ pɔ o nɛ, dɛ ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Rama, ásɛ bɛlbwa bɛ won le Juda harɛ ta kaa kɛɛ dɛ́ ba jo bela.
Kooro Asa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm bwa aa kaa, dɛ do deene baa kpɔ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛɛ cheɡ koodem bela, dɛ Korowii Dea la tomɛ nomonome ba kpɔ ka tɛ Kooro Bɛn Hadad.
Dɛ Kooro Hadad mɛɛ sɔne Tabrimɔn, o nabaa ɡe ɛ Aram Kooro Heseɔn dɛɛ di kora Damaskɔs.
Kooro Asa ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo, ɡɛ ya naawa fa aa ɛa la.
N kpɔ koŋkɛɛla aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, á ɛ fɔo dɛ́ chɔɡ he ne Israel Kooro Baasa fɔo la taraken, ásɛ o ne he laa tena le n harɛ nɔ ta kaa.” Kooro Bɛn Hadad no Kooro Asa be, dɛ tomɛ o laa sitɔɔla ba ka yo Israel harɛ bwɛɛre.
Ba pɔ bwɛɛre baa dɛ yera Ijon ne Dan dɛ Ebel Bɛt Maaka ne harɛ waa chɔa kaa Galilia Moo bwa dɛ Naftale dea harɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta.
Kooro Baasa aa no ɡɛ la, o ɡel danjwɛɛ la mae dɛ bar Rama dɛ ka so Tirsa.
Belaa Kooro Asa do Juda tena bwa ŋɔ bá la, dɛ́ ka che bwea ne daa Kooro Baasa aa kpɔa dɛɛ ma danjwɛɛ Rama la.
Anee Kooro Asa kpɔ ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar bwɛjena Geba ne Mispa aa lɔ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta.
O ta nomɛlbwa ɡelɛ Juda harɛ, bɛlbwa laŋɔ ka pa daa la ane.
Waa Kooro Asa aa ɛa o kora dii ta, ne bwɛɛre waa ma danjwɛɛ bara, ne laa waa yoa dɛ pɔ nɛra nɛɛ la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
O hwɛɛhra bini la, o we nakpaweela ane soo siwi.
Kooro Asa sewɔ ba huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
Asɛ o bibaa Jehosafat chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Israel Kooro Nadab Gɛ saŋ Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene anɛ taa Kooro Jɛroboam bibaa Nadab di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O di kora bene anɛ.
Gɛ o mɛɛ aa ɛa laanee o ɡe ɛ, o ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛ ɡel Israel tena bwa ɛ wechɔɡa.
Dɛ Kooro Ahija bibaa Kooro Baasa le Isaaka dea, o vɔrɔwe Kooro Nadab vɔrɔwa, dɛ kpoo Filisti tena bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Gebɛtɔn ta.
Dɛ Kooro Nadab ne Israel tena kaa bar Gebɛtɔn tena dɛ tɔ ba do.
Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ bene atoro taa Kooro Baasa kpo Kooro Nadab, dɛ chiɡ o naa ta di kora.
Kooro Baasa aa baa di kora la, o kpoo Kooro Jɛroboam dem tena bwa.
O ta Kooro Jɛroboam nɛn bɛlbwa ɡelɛ o so le, o kpoo ba bwa, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Ahija waa ɛ Silo te nɛɛ dɛ bol la.
Gɛ waa nɔ chiɡo dɛkalkɛ Kooro Jɛroboam ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ muɡli Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la baah.
Waa Kooro Nadab aa ɛa o kora dii ta ne anɔ la waa ɛa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Dɛ yoi lɔ Kooro Asa ne Israel Kooro Baasa baah ta ba kora dii saŋ bwa.
Israel Kooro Baasa Bentooro te ta Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ taa Ahija bibaa Baasa di Israel kora dɛ so Tirsa.
O di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ.
O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, o kpɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ŋwɛnɛ la ta, ɡɛ waa ɡela Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa la.
Ate, Korowii bol waa o keame bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jehu be, o mɛɛ sɔne Hanani ŋɔ ó bol Kooro Baasa be ŋɔ, “He fa toole wobɛlbwa bini, n lawɛ ba ŋɔ he baa nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛ, kɛ he kpɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ŋwɛnɛre la ta dɛ ɡel n nɛra Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo n nɛ, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ muɡli n baah.
Gɛ maa ɛ Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam dem la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba hen Kooro Baasa ne he dem tena chɔɡa.
He nɛnnɔn te bɛlbwa waa sewɛ bwɛjen la bini la, nyootenaa dɛ́ di ba ola, ásɛ jumbii di banɔ la ɡe baa serewe kpɔɡ bini la ola.” Waa Kooro Baasa aa di kora a chiɡ, ne anɔ la waa ɛa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Baasa sewɔ ba huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta Tirsa, asɛ o bibaa Ɛla chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o keame bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jehu nɛɛ bol wa, Hanani bibaalee on.
Keame Jehu baa bol Korowii wa Kooro Baasa ne o dem tena be, wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ muɡli on Korowii baah kɛŋɔ Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa, ne kpoe waa kpo o ne o dem tena bwa la wa.
Israel Kooro Ɛla Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ dɛ anumɛl taa Kooro Baasa bibaa Ɛla di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O soɡe Tirsa bene anɛ.
Kooro Ɛla bonɔɔ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Simri, dɛ onee dɛɛ nyiŋi kooro kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre ane ta.
O ɛ kooro dɔm.
Dɛ Kooro Ɛla lɔ nomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Arsa dem dɛ nyɔ sen dɛɛ.
Dɛ Aasaa dɛɛ nyiŋi koodem waa lɔ bwɛjen Tirsa ta.
Ate, Simri ka jo koodem bela dɛ lɔ Kooro Ɛla kpo, dɛ kpɔ kora la di.
Bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ ta Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ taa o kpoo.
Waa dena ba di kora la, o kpoo Kooro Baasa dem tena bwa.
O ta baa bɛlbwa ɡelɛ, hale o lole kɛɛ o dam.
Gɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Jehu nɛɛ bol Kooro Baasa waa la, Simri kpo Kooro Baasa ne o dem tena bwa, dɛkalkɛ, Kooro Baasa ne o bibaa Ɛla wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ laanee ɡela Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa.
Ba ɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe, dɛ kpɔ muɡli Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la baah.
Waa Kooro Ɛla aa ɛa o kora dii ta bwa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Israel Kooro Simri Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ taa Kooro Simri di kora Israel harɛ ta.
Tɔpera anuanɛ ɡboo o di kora dɛ so Tirsa.
Dɛ Israel laa tena vɔrɔwe laa dɛ ba so bɛne Filisti tena bwɛjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Gebɛtɔn.
Israel laa tena la aa noa kɛŋɔ Kooro Simri ɛ Kooro Ɛla dɔm dɛ kpoo la, ba bwa kpɔ ba laa sitɔɔ baa dɛ yerɔ Omri cheɡ Israel harɛ ta kooro awola tenten, bela baa soɡa la.
Asɛ Kooro Omri ne Israel laa tena baa ja o nɛɛ bwa le Gebɛtɔn dɛ ba lɛ Tirsa dɔɔh.
Kooro Simri aa naa kɛ ba kpɔ bwɛjen la, o kaa jo dekpeɡ waa lɔ koodem bela dɛ kpaa nii do o ta, o ne o dem la bwa fuh kwaraa, wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ kɛŋɔ waa kpɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ŋwɛnɛ la dɔŋ ta dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a che a ta Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa la wa.
Kooro Simri bwara waa ne dɔm waa ɛa bwa, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Israel Kooro Omri Israel tena bini pero anɛ, bane teŋɛ Ginat bibaa Tibni nɛ, dɛ fe ɛɛ chiɡu kora.
Banɔ la baa kaa la ɡe teŋɛ Kooro Omri nɛ.
Dɛ banɔ la baa teŋɛ Kooro Omri nɛɛ kpeɡri ɡwaa Tibni nɛra baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la.
Anomanta, Tibni baa sewɛ, asɛ Kooro Omri di o kora.
Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraatoro dɛ beŋkpoŋ taa Kooro Omri di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O di kora bene fi dɛ anɛ.
O soɡe Tirsa bene anumɛl o kara la ta.
Kooro Omri yawɛ deŋɡare bɛl, taraken baa dɛ yerɔ Samaria, dɛ le Sɛma be.
O yawɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore fifraanumɛl dɛ anuatoro, asɛ dɛ vɔrɔwe bwɛɛ bela dɛ ma danjwɛɛ baro, dɛ kpɔ Sɛma sɔn pao dɛɛ yerɔ Samaria.
Kooro Omri ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡwaa koranar baa tɔ sie la bwa.
Ŋwɛnɛ Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa kpɔ o ta, ne wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa, ba ɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe a di Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ baah la, ɡɛɛ Kooro Omri ɛ Korowii.
Waa aa chiɡ Kooro Omri kora dii saŋ ne waa waa ɛa bwa, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Omri sewɔ ba huɡo Samaria, asɛ o bibaa Ahab chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Israel Kooro Ahab Kooro Asa aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro taa Kooro Omri bibaa Kooro Ahab di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O di kora Israel harɛ, dɛ so Samaria bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ.
Kooro Ahab ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡwaa koranar baa tɔ sie la.
O ta ɡelɛ a jaɡɛ bela dɛ ɡe ɛ Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam wechɔɡa la dɔŋa.
O berɔ mo Sidon Kooro Etbaal bihaah Jɛsɛbɛl dɛ pa mun dɛɛ tomɛ voɡ Baal.
Kooro Ahab ma voɡ Baal dea Samaria, dɛ ɛ kon baa fuh saraha o ta dea la bini tɛo.
O pa voɡ Asera dajaŋ.
O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ muɡli Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la baah ɡwaa ɡɛ Israel koranar baa tɔ sie la aa ɛa.
Kooro Ahab saŋee baa bɛl waa le Bɛtel baa yerɔ Heɛl kwaa ma danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen Jeriko.
O bibanloɡle baa dɛ yerɔ Abiramee o kpɔ pa danjwɛɛ la mun, dɛ kpɔ o bibaa bechala Seɡub ɡe ma bwɛɛ la doonyoo, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Nun bibaa Josua nɛɛ bola la.
Elaeja ne hwel wa Korowii keame bɛl fa lole baa yerɔ Elaeja, o ɛ Tisbe te dɛ le Gelead harɛ ta.
Awola bɛl, o la Kooro Ahab be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N cheɡɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa Israel tena ɛɛ tomɔ sɔn ta dɛɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ mɛn aa ta, bwaala ɡe aa nɛɛ ba bene aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba nɔ ta, nemenɛ a le n nyoa mɔɔ.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ Elaeja be ŋɔ, “Ir le bonɔ kaa Kerit Fɛlembɔjen waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr ka sɔh.
Hɛɛ dɔ nee dɛɛ nyɔ.
N do ɡaahɡaahre ŋɔ á baa tɛɛ kondikwa.” Asɛ Elaeja ɛ waa Korowii aa doo a ta la, dɛ ka so bɛne Kerit Fɛlembɔjen waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr bela.
Gaahɡaahre kpɔ paanoo ne ola kaa tɛo chɔɔ ne jwaana.
Dɛ o dɔ nee ɡe dɛɛ nyɔ fɛlembɔjen la bini.
Aa dɛ biɡri bwaala aa wola nɛ la, nee la hweehrɔ.
Elaeja ne Sarefat luhaah bɛl wa Korowii ŋɔ Elaeja be ŋɔ, “Ir kaa Sarefat, o bɛne bwɛjen Sidon dɛ́ ka so bela.
Luhaah bɛl lɔ bela, n doo ŋɔ wɛɛ tɛɛ kondikwa.” Asɛ o ir kaa Sarefat.
Waa dɛ tel bwɛɛ la doonyoa la, dɛ luhaah bɛl lɔ bela dɛɛ nyin damara.
Anee Elaeja ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe, ka ɛ nee tama ba tɛ mɛ ń nyɔ.” Haah la aa dɛ kaa ka ɛ nee la, Elaeja berɛ ŋɔ, “Mɔn paanoo tama ja ba tɛ mɛ.” Anee haah la ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o do le saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ n ta paanoo dɔe, men tama ne noo tama anee ka vii bini, n ba dɛɛ ba ba nyin daa dɛ́ ka ɛ n ne n bie di.
A habɔɔ dɛ́ so lɔr sewɛ.” Anee Elaeja ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡel a we he nɛ, he te kaa dɛ́ ka ɛ he kondikwaa la.
Kɛ tɔ sie ɛ ane ba tɛ mɛ mɔɔ, dɛ́ ɛ he ne he bie la kwa.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Men aa lɔ vii la bini la aa tonɛ bwa, ɡɛɛ noo la ɡe aa wola tonɛ, ka tel saŋ maa dɛ ba ɡela bwaala nɛ kondikwaa ba.’ ” Luhaah la kaa ɛ ɡɛ Elaeja aa bola la, ate ba ne Elaeja dɔ kondikwaa dem bela dɛɛ di tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Gɛ Korowii aa bol Elaeja be la, men la ta vii la bini tonɛ bwa, ɡɛɛ noo la ɡe aa wola tonɛ.
A baa tel saŋ bɛl luhaah la bibaa bwara ɛɛ weo.
A baa ɡwaa asɛ o sewɛ.
Anee luhaah la ŋɔ Elaeja be ŋɔ, “Korowii keame, bɔkwa waa he ɛɛ mɛ ken?
He balɔ dɛ́ ba lii mɛ n wechɔɡa maa ɛa wa dɛ́ kpo n bie kɛɛ?” Elaeja ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he bie la ba tɛ mɛ,” dɛ lɛ bie la o be, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa abrɔsane doa dea o ɡbaɡba Elaeja aa soɡa la, dɛ kpɔɔ ka bil mpa ta.
Elaeja kpɔ takpeɡ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, bɔkwa sibeɡraa he kpɔ ba ta luhaah maa baa so o be nɔ dɛ ɡel o bie sewɛ ken?” Belaa Elaeja ka pi bie la nɛɛ kera atoro, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, n poori ɡel bie nɔ berɛ dɔ mkpa.” Asɛ Korowii no Elaeja wesoŋa la, bie la ir, dɛ berɛ dɔ mkpa.
Elaeja kpɔ bie la tu ba o nya be, dɛ ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na, he bie la iro.” Dɛ kpɔɔ tɛo.
Luhaah la chaŋe Elaeja ŋɔ, “Anɔ taa n jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii keamee hen, Korowii waa aa dɛ le he nyoa la ɛ kpela.”
Elaeja ne Obadia wa Hwel la aa cheɡa bene atoro la, Korowii bol Elaeja be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he te ka baɡle Kooro Ahab, ásɛ n ɡel bwaala nɛ harɛ la ta.” Anomanta, Elaeja kpɔ o te ka baɡle Kooro Ahab.
Dɛ lɔr waa chole bwɛjen Samaria kan taeh.
Anee Kooro Ahab yerɛ baa bɛl waa dɛ nyiŋi o koodem ta baa yerɔ Obadia.
Dɛ Obadia dɛ yarada Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Kooro Ahab haah Jɛsɛbɛl ɡelɔ ba kpoo Korowii keamere.
Asɛ Obadia kpɔ Korowii keamere lafa ka sɔh bwebɔɔne anɛ bini, dɛɛ tɛɛ ba nee ne kondikwa.
O bɔne ba bini, fifraanunue ba do bɔɔ beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa bini.
Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Obadia be ŋɔ, “Yá ka ɡaaɡe harɛ nɔ bwa ta, neerare nyuune ne fɛlembɔɔne bwa ta, ya ken ɛɛ dɔ kpɔɡaa ba tɛ ya jaɡre ne keeɡore nɔ, ásɛ ya bɛ an kpoo.” Ba pere ba bini, Kooro Ahab chaɡɛ harɛ la baŋ bɛl, Obadia ɡe chaɡɛ baŋ bɛl.
Obadia aa dɛ kaa la, o kaa cheme Elaeja dɛ jemɔ, asɛ o ɡuŋu dɛ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ Elaeja, henee nɔ naa?” Anee Elaeja chaŋo ŋɔ, “Menee, la ka ŋɔ he dɔɔ kooro la be ŋɔ n lɔ bonɔ.” Obadia ŋɔ, “Wechɔɡa besoo n ɛ asɛ he le men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ dɛɛ tɛ Kooro Ahab ó kpo mɛ nɔɔ?
N ŋwɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ o do le nɔ kɛŋɔ, kooro ɡelɔ ba ka ɡaaɡe he bɔr harɛre bwa ta.
Bobɛlbwa toole baa wola he bɔr ɡaaɡɛ.
Bobɛlbwa nomoa ŋɔ o ta hen nae o harɛ ta naa, Kooro Ahab yon ɡel o ŋwɛɛ ntam kɛŋɔ o ta hen nae.
Taraken he dɛ nyin ń la ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ he lɔ bonɔ kɛɛ?
Dɛ n kaalɔ Korowii Doma la kpɔe kaa bobɛl, asɛ n ka ŋɔ o be o ta hen ba nae yaa, wɛɛ kpo mɛɛ.
Men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ, n bechale saŋ bwaa n yarada Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ.
N dɔɔ, he ta noɛ ɡɛ maa ɛa ɡɛ saŋ Jɛsɛbɛl aa dɛ kpoo Korowii keamere la kɛɛ?
N sɔh keamere lafa bwebɔɔne anɛ bini.
N pere ba bini fifraanunue bɔɔ beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa bini, dɛɛ tɛɛ ba nee ne kondikwa.
Haa ŋɔa n la ka ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ he lɔ bonɔ nɔ, waa men kpo aa?” Belaa Elaeja ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa mɛɛ tomɔ nɔ kɛŋɔ, fini mɛɛ kpɔ n tenee ka baɡle Kooro Ahab.” Ate, Obadia la dɛ ka ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be, asɛ o ba dɛ ba na Elaeja.
Kooro Ahab aa baa na Elaeja la, Kooro ŋɔ, “Nɛn haa ba waa ne ba ta Israel harɛ ta laanee nɔ naa!” Elaeja ŋɔ, “N laa ba waa ne Israel harɛ nɔ ta, he ne he mɛɛ dem nɛraa.
Heyaa vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa dɛ kaa teŋɛ voɡa Baalre nɛ.
Yerɛ Israel tena, ba bwa ba chem mɛ Kaamɛl Bwejen doa.
Yerɛ Baal waa ɛ voɡbaa tena lafraanaarɛ fifraanue, ne voɡhaah Asera tena lafraanaarɛ, ba ne haŋkooro Jɛsɛbɛl pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwa o dem la.” Ate, Kooro Ahab tomɛ nɛra ba valɛ Israel harɛ ta bwa, ba yerɛ Israel tena ne Baal voɡ tena la bwa ba cheme Kaamɛl Bwejen doa.
Belaa Elaeja ka che Israel tena la bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin he kpɔ nyiŋi webele anɛ nɔ bini nɔ?
Dɛ Korowii ɡwaa Baal aa, hé tomɛ Korowii, dɛ Baal ɡe ɡwaa Korowii aa, hé tomɛ Baal.” Kɛ nɛra la ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ.
Elaeja ŋɔ, “N ɡboo Korowii keame waa kaa, kɛ voɡ Baal te dɔ voɡ tena lafraanaarɛ fifraanue.
Hé tɛ yaa nabala anɛ, ásɛ Baal voɡ tena la kpo bɛl dɛ chɛwɔ dawɛ daa ta, dɛ bɛ nii a ta do.
N ɡe ɛ onɔ la waa kaa la ɡɛ, maa niinii do.
Ásɛ Baal voɡ tena la soŋe ba voɡ, ásɛ n ɡe soŋe Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ.
Bɛl la o kon aa do nii o kwaa ta la, onee chɛ kɛŋɔ yaa tomɔ.” Ate, nɛra la bwa sɛh, dɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ wer.” Elaeja yerɛ Baal voɡ tena la dɛ ŋɔ, “Haa wara nɔ, hé tɔ sie kpɔ nabal nɔ bɛl dɛ kwaaro, he bɛ nii o ta do, dɛ́ soŋe voɡ Baal.” Ate, ba lawɛ nao baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la, dɛ ɛo dɛ soŋe voɡ Baal ɡwɛeh le chɔɔbɔr ka tel webaŋa wee aa baa tel nyufala.
Dɛɛ ŋɔ, “N naa Baal, no yaa ɔ.” Ba sao bar kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la, ba ta wobɛlbwa nae, ba ta wobɛlbwa ɡe noɛ.
Wee aa baa tel nyufala la, Elaeja mam ba, dɛ di ba loro ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ yerɔ kohona, o ɛ voɡ kɛrɛdɛ, o ken ta dɛ lii, kɛɛ o ken kaa bobɛl.
O ka lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta.
O ken ka chɔ dom, a chɛ kɛ he ka chumu.” Baal voɡ tena la soŋo kohona takpeɡ ne, dɛ kpɔ tokobie ne keri dɛɛ mɔne ba bwara.
Dɛ ba nawee waa baa ɛa dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa laanee ɡɛ, asɛ chal ɛɛ pal ba.
Ba teŋɔ soŋe ka tel kɛŋɔ webaŋa aa baa ɡarɛ, kɛ o ta ban chaŋɛ, ba ta wobɛlbwa ɡe noɛ.
Ate, Elaeja ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé bɛn mɛ.” Asɛ ba baro cheme.
O pa mun dɛɛ kwaa kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, ba fa aa laa chɔɡ la.
Elaeja pa bwea fi dɛ anɛ, bɛlbwa che tɛ Jekɔb bii fi dɛ banɛ baa cheɡa tɛ Israel deene la.
Dɛ Korowiirii pa Jekɔb sɔn Israel.
O kpɔ bwea la dɛ berɛ ɛ saraha kon la Korowii sɔn ta, dɛ ɡel ba kwi bɔɔ waa won nee ɡalɔŋre atoro lɛɛ baro.
O pa daa dawɛ saraha kon la ta, dɛ kpo nabal la dɛ chɛwɔ dawɛ daa la ta.
Dɛ ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé dɔ nee do polviine anaarɛ bini á su, ásɛ dɛ ɛ nee la ta ola la ne daa la ta.” O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ do nee ja.” Asɛ ba ɛ ɡɛ.
O berɛ ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ ɛ ɡɛ toorotena ja.” Asɛ ba ɛ ɡɛ.
Nee la palɔ jo bɔɔ waa ɡela ba kwi bar saraha kon la o su.
Saŋ aa tela Elaeja ɛ saraha la, o kaa che saraha kon la jwɛh dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb baa ɛ ya naawa aa tomɛ, fini ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la.
Dɛ́ berɛ ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ he bonɔɔnee men, hen do mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ waa nɔ bwa.
N Naa Korowii, chaŋ mɛ ásɛ nɛra nɔ jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee Korowii, he laɡ ba dɛɛ ba he be.” Ate, Korowii ɡel nii ba le saraha kwaa la ta, dɛ fuh a ne daa la ne bwea dɛ harɛ la bwa, nee aa lɔ bɔɔ la bini ɡe hweeh.
Nɛra la aa na ɡɛ la, ba cholo dɛ kpɔ sie piiɡi harɛ, dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Korowiirii ya Dɔɔ!
O ɡbosoroo chɛ toma!” Elaeja do nɛra la ŋɔ, “Hé lawɛ Baal voɡ tena la, he bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa dɔ bɔr chwa!” Ba lawɛ ba bwa asɛ Elaeja ɡel ba kpɔ ba kaa Kesɔn Fɛlembɔjen bini ka kpoo ba.
Elaeja ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Kaa dɛ́ ka di kwa name, n no bwaala jiɡra kohona.” Kooro Ahab aa kaa kwaa dii la, Elaeja berɔ teeh kaa Kaamɛl Bwejen doa dɛ ka boŋɛ dɛ kpɔ o nyu do o naa baah.
Elaeja ŋɔ o bonɔɔ be ŋɔ, “La ka che dɛ́ nyiŋi mpo ta.” Ate, o bonɔɔ la la dɛ berɛ ba o be dɛ́ ba ŋɔ, “N ta komɛlbwa nae.” Kera anuanɛ bwaa o ŋɔ bonɔɔ la be ŋɔ ó la mpo ta ka nyiŋi.
Kera anuanɛ ta la, bonɔɔ la baa ŋɔ, “N na bam jeɡaa bɛl kɛŋɔ nɛn nɔn wɛɛ le mpo ta.” Anee Elaeja ŋɔ, “La ka ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, ‘Ɛ warane kpɔ he torɔɡo ha vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔ la dɛ kaa dem, ásɛ bwaala bɛ hen ba kpo.’ ” A ta biɡre nyundua den kɔl, bwaala nɛ kohona dɛɛ ta peu, asɛ Kooro Ahab jo o torɔɡo waa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔ la bini dɛ kaa bwɛjen Jesreel.
Korowii tɛ Elaeja kpeɡri bɛl o kwaa o yal vɔwɛ chara kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ won takapɔ chwa tɔ Kooro Ahab jaaɡɔ la sie dɛ kaa Jesreel.
Elaeja aa lɔ Sinai Bwejen doa Kooro Ahab bol o haah Jɛsɛbɛl be ɡɛ Elaeja aa ɛa bwa, ne ɡɛ waa kpɔ tokobii kpo Baal voɡ tena la.
Anee o haah la tomɛ torome Elaeja be ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ kere saŋ nɔ dɛ n ta hen kpoe kɛŋɔ haa kpoo voɡ tena la aa, voɡare la kpo mɛ.” Elaeja ɔmɔ, dɛ kpɔ o bonɔɔ chwa kaa Beɛseeba waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔ o nyu.
O baa ɡel o bonɔɔ la bela, dɛ valɛ tɔpebir kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
O kaa so chunchule ta daa bɛl mun, dɛ soŋe seo tɛ o te kɛŋɔ o fee sewɛ.
O soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, name te a maɡre ɡɛ, ɡel ń sewɛ.
N ta n naawa baa serewa la ɡwaalɛ.” O chɔ daa la mun chɔ dom.
Buɡ la ta, nyundua torome den ba leɡo dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ di kwa.” Elaeja iro nyiŋi dɛ na paanoo ne loŋ bɛl ne nee o nyu bɔr, dɛ kpɔ di dɛ nyɔ nee la, dɛ berɛ kwaa chɔ ja.
Korowii nyundua torome la berɔ ba chumu nɛɛtena dɛ ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ di kwa, ŋwɛnɛ haa valɛ la jaŋne taeh.” Asɛ o ir di kwaa la, dɛ nyɔ ne.
Kondikwaa la chao dɛ tɛo bokpeɡa o won valɛ tɔpera fifraanaarɛ chɔɔ ne jwaana, dɛ kaa Korowii Sinai Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la bɔr.
Waa tel bela la, o kaa jo bwebɔɔ bini chɔ jwaana.
Korowii ba Elaeja be Belaa Korowii bol waa Elaeja be ŋɔ, “Elaeja, bɔkwaa hɛɛ ɛ bonɔ nɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii Haa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, he ɡboo mɛɛ tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, kɛ Israel tena chɔɡ he ne ba fɔo la, dɛ paɡre kwaa baa ɛ saraha a ta dɛɛ tɛɛ la, dɛ berɛ kpoo he keamere bwa tokobie ne.
N ɡboo kaa baa nyin n ɡe dɛ́ kpo.” Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Le ka che bwe la doa n sie.
Asɛ men Korowii teŋe ba kaa.” Asɛ peu o nyoa aa kpeɡa tɔ o sie, dɛ paɡre deŋɡarere, dɛ peɡri bweɡuŋe.
Kɛ dɛ Korowii toole peu la bini.
Peu la aa taa tonɛ la, harɛ jiɡro, kɛ dɛ Korowii toole harɛ waa jiɡra la ta.
Harɛ jiɡra la ɡe habɔɔ la, nii balɔ.
Kɛ dɛ Korowii toole nii la ta.
Nii la ɡe habɔɔ, taa bɛl leɔ bɔeeh ken.
Elaeja aa no taa la la, o kpɔ batakaare tɔ sie dɛ le bwebɔɔ la bini ba che o nyoa.
Asɛ taa bɛl le dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Elaeja, bɔkwaa hɛɛ ɛ bonɔ nɔ?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii waa ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, he ɡboo mɛɛ tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, kɛ Israel tena chɔɡ he ne ba fɔo la, dɛ paɡre kwaa baa ɛ saraha a ta dɛɛ tɛɛ la, dɛ berɛ kpoo he keamere bwa tokobie ne.
N ɡboo kaa, baa nyin n ɡe dɛ́ kpo.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Berɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta ba la, dɛ́ kaa Damaskɔs pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
He tel bela aa, kpɔ noo fuɡe do Hasael nyu ta, dɛ́ cheɡo Siiria harɛ ta kooro.
Berɛ la Israel harɛ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ane fuɡe do Nimsi bibaa Jehu ɡe nyu ta, dɛ́ cheɡo Israel harɛ ta kooro, ásɛ dɛ fuɡe ane do Safat bibaa Elaesa waa le Ebel Mehola la ɡe nyu ta, ásɛ o ɛ keame chiɡ he naa ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa chwa le Hasael kpoe nyoa la, Jehuu dɛ́ kpoo.
Elaesa ɡee dɛ́ kpo banɔ la Jehu aa wola ban dɔ kpo la.
Nɛra kaɡboŋa banuanɛ lɔ Israel harɛ ta baa wola voɡ Baal ɡuŋe bwa, mɛɛ ɡel baa, maa ba tenee kpoo.” Elaesa yera wa Ate, Elaeja le bela dɛɛ kaa, waa dɛ kaa la, o kaa na Safat bibaa Elaesa ne nɛra baa kpɔ daa dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ.
Dɛ a lɔ bele fi dɛ anɛ, asɛ o teŋɛ fi dɛ anɛ te la nɛ.
Asɛ Elaeja la Elaesa be dɛ ka foo o batakaare ta o nɛ.
Elaesa ɡel nae la dɛ chwa teŋɛ Elaeja nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Gel ń ka kal n nya ne n mɛɛ dɛ́ ba n ne he kaa.” Anee Elaeja ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ won berɛ kaa, kɛ lii anɔ la bwa maa ɛa tɛɛ.” Asɛ Elaesa laa berɛ dɛ kpoo nae waa teŋɛ a nɛɛ la, dɛ fuh daa waa kpɔa dawɛ nae anɛ nɛɛ aa parɛ la, dɛ daa ola la tɛ nɛra la ba chwe.
Asɛ o ka teŋɛ Elaeja nɛɛ dɛɛ chao.
Kooro Bɛn Hadad kaa yo bwɛjen Samaria tena Siiria Kooro Bɛn Hadad boa o laa tena bwa nyoa, dɛ koranar fifraatoro dɛ banɛ, ne ba jaɡre ne torɔɡore baa vɔwɛ jaɡre pɛla.
Ba laŋɔ ka chɔ bar Samaria tena ba ne ba yo.
Dɛ Kooro Bɛn Hadad tomɛ toroma Israel Kooro Ahab be o bwɛjen Samaria ta ŋɔ, “He suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ne he haahna baa wera, ne he bii ba bwara aa kpeɡa bwa ɛ n kwa.” Anee Kooro Ahab ŋɔ, “Hé ka ŋɔ n dɔɔ Kooro Bɛn Hadad be ŋɔ n sɛoh, onee dɔ n ne n komɛlbwa.” Kooro Ahab toroma la berɔ ba dɛ ba ŋɔ waa Kooro Bɛn Hadad aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, “N tomɛ toroma he be ŋɔ he kpɔ he suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ne he haahna ne bii bwa tɛ mɛ.
Kere saŋ nɔ, mɛɛ tomɛ n nomonomee bá ba nyiŋi he koodem ne he nomonome deremi, dɛ́ pa kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bɛlbwa baa naa.” Belaa Kooro Ahab yerɛ Israel harɛ ta nomonome bwa cheme dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ Kooro Bɛn Hadad aa dɛ nyin ya ne waa ɡɛ.
O tomɛ toroma n be dɛɛ lɛ n haahna ne n bii ne suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, asɛ n sɛh.” Asɛ nomonome la ŋɔ, “Bɛ no, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ sɛh a taa tɛo.” Anee Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Kooro Bɛn Hadad toroma la be ŋɔ, “Hé ka ŋɔ n dɔɔ kooro be ŋɔ anɔ la o fa aa bola la n sɛoh, kɛ taraken kwaa nɔ te, maa sɛh.” Toroma la berɛ kaa dɛ ka bol Kooro Bɛn Hadad be.
Belaa Kooro Bɛn Hadad berɛ tomɛ nɛra Kooro Ahab be dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ n ta ɡelɛ ba chɔɡ Samaria kwaraa naa, voɡare la tɛr n deŋne kohona.” Kooro Ahab ŋɔ, “Hé ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ laa te tenten bɛlbwa aa won maŋkura o te, nemenɛ laa la aa tona mɔɔ.” Kooro Bɛn Hadad aa no ɡɛ waa la, dɛ o ne o koranar soɡe ba tɛnte deene lɔɡre dɛ nyɔ sen dɛɛ lɛ ba sie.
Asɛ o ŋɔ o laa tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ he te dɛ́ ka yo.” Anomanta, ba iro kpɔ ba te dɛ ka yo bwɛjen Samaria.
Kooro Ahab pɔ Kooro Bɛn Hadad nɛ Anɔ bwa la, dɛ Korowii keame bɛl ba Israel Kooro Ahab be dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii ŋɔ kɛ he na laa tena baa wara nɔ kenɛ?
Mɛɛ kpɔ baa do he nɔn taa fini, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Anee Kooro Ahab ŋɔ, “Umee dɛ́ tɔ n sie ń ka yoo baɔ?” Korowii keame la ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ laa tena bechale baa lɔ laa sitɔɔla lɔɡa harɛ nɔ ta nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa.” Anee Kooro Ahab berɛ ŋɔ, “Umee dɛ́ pa yoi la mun ɔ?” Korowii keame la ŋɔ, “Henee dɛ́ pa laa la mun.” Anomanta, Kooro Ahab yerɛ laa tena bechale baa lɔ laa sitɔɔla lɔɡa harɛ la ta, dɛ ba lɔ nɛra lafraanɛ fifraatoro dɛ banɛ.
O berɔ boa Israel harɛ laa tena kabora nyoa, dɛ ba ɡe bwa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa banuanɛ.
Laa tena la leɔ webaŋa, ɡɛ saŋ wee aa cheɡɛ nyufala.
Dɛ Kooro Bɛn Hadad ne o koranar fifraatoro dɛ banɛ baa ja o nɛɛ soɡe ba tɛnte deene bini dɛ nyɔ sen dɛɛ dɛɛ.
Israel laa tena bechale baa lɔ laa sitɔɔla lɔɡa harɛ la ta laanee tɔ sie le.
Dɛ Kooro Bɛn Hadad ɡe tomɛ nɛra ba tɔ sie ka nyiŋi, asɛ ba ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Laa tena bane le Samaria dɛɛ ba.” Anee Kooro Bɛn Hadad chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛra nee baa ba naa, he bɛ ban kpoo, dɛ yoi ɡe nee baa ba naa, he bɛ ban kpoo dɛ́ laɡ ba ba.” Belaa Israel laa tena bechale la tɔ sie le bwɛɛ la bini, asɛ ba kabora la ɡe teŋɛ, bɛlbwa kpo o dɔŋ o ne waa dɛ yo, anomanta, Siiria tena la chwao, asɛ Israel tena la kpɔ teŋɛ sibeɡra ne.
Kooro Bɛn Hadad kpɔ jaaɡɔ waa soɡe o ta chwa kaa, nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta bane ja o nɛɛ chwa.
Israel Kooro Ahab teŋɔ dɛ ka lawɛ Siiria tena baa soɡe jaɡre ta ne torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre dɛ kpoo ba kohona.
A habɔɔ la, Korowii keame la berɔ ba Israel kooro be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Berɛ la ka nyin laa tena la bane ja, dɛ na ɡɛ haa ɛ dɛkalkɛ benanyoa chemaa, Siiria tena ɛɛ ba yoi ja.” Ba baa yo Siiria tena nɛɛtena ja A habɔɔ la, Siiria Kooro nomonome baa jao ŋɔ, “Israel tena voɡare lɔ deŋɡarere ta, a waa ba won pɔ ya nɛɛ la.
Kɛ dɛ ya ne ba yo harɛpɛɛ ta naa, ya bokpeɡa ɛɛ ɡwaa ba nɛɛ.
Ir koranar fifraatoro dɛ banɛ la bwa, dɛ kpɔ laa sitɔɔla chiɡ ba buɡ ta.
Berɛ nyin laa tena haa paŋa la dɔŋa, dɛ jaɡre ne torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la dɔŋa.
Ya ne ba cheme harɛpɛɛ ta naa, ya bokpeɡa ɛɛ ɡwaa ba nɛɛ, yá pɔ ba nɛ.” Asɛ kooro sɛh ba be dɛ ɛ ɡɛ.
Benanyoa aa chema lɔmɔɡa saŋ la, Kooro Bɛn Hadad kpɔ o laa tena la bwɛjen Afɛk, dɛ́ ka yo Israel tena.
Kooro Ahab boa Israel laa tena nyoa, dɛ tɛɛ ba komɛlbwa baa hiah laa la ta, asɛ ba le dɛ ka pu Siiria tena la.
Israel tena laa tena la kaa so ba sie chaɡɛ Siiria tena.
Dɛ Israel tena bɔne ba bini kuore anɛ, dɛ do kɛŋɔ boohna tamaa ane ken, asɛ Siiria laa tena la te warɛ dɛ tɔ harɛ bwa.
Belaa Korowii keame la la Israel Kooro Ahab be dɛ ŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “Siiria tena dɛ lii kɛŋɔ men Korowii lɔ deŋɡarere ta, n toole harɛre aa chɔa kaa ta nomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ laa tena damanta nɔɔ do he nɔn taa, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Laa tena la bwa kaa so ba tɛnte deene bini, ba sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa tɔpera anuanɛ.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee la, ba kpɔ yoi lɔ dɔŋa, Israel tena la kpoo Siiria laa tena baa valɛ naa ta la nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ.
Siiria tena baa kaa la chwao kaa bwɛjen Afɛk ta, asɛ danjwɛɛ baa maa bar bwɛɛ la chole, nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banuanɛ nɛɛ dɛ kpoo ba.
Kooro Bɛn Hadad chwao jo bwɛjen la bini dɛ ka sɔh dejeɡa bɛl bini dem bela.
Kooro Bɛn Hadad nomonome la o be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Ya noɔ kɛŋɔ Israel koranar dɛ na nɛra sum.
Gel ya kpɔ lweyale mile chara, dɛ kpɔ ɡboɡbie vɔwɛ nyuune, dɛ la kooro la be, o ken ɛɛ lɛɛ, dɛ bɛ hen kpo.” Ate, ba kpɔ lweyale mile chara dɛ kpɔ ɡboɡbie vɔrɔwe nyuune, dɛ la Israel Kooro Ahab be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔ Kooro Bɛn Hadad dɛ soŋe ŋɔ he ɡel ó dɔ o nyu.” Anee Israel Kooro Ahab chaŋe ŋɔ, “N lolee, o ta lole naa?” Ate, bonɔɔna la na kɛŋɔ a ɛ wedɛɛɡa, asɛ dɛ sɛh Israel Kooro waa la ta warane dɛ ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, he lole Bɛn Hadadee.” Anee Kooro Ahab ŋɔ, “Hé ka kpɔɔ ba!” Kooro Bɛn Hadad aa lea dɛ ba o be la, o ɡelɔ o jo torɔɡo baa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔ bini.
Kooro Bɛn Hadad ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ berɛ bwɛjena n mɛɛ aa lɛa le he mɛɛ be laanee tɛɛ, ásɛ he ɛ he ɡbaɡba bonadibɔra Damaskɔs, ɡɛ n mɛɛ aa ɛa Samaria la.” Asɛ Kooro Ahab ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ɡelɔ ya fɔwɛ ɡɛ fɔo aa, mɛɛ kpɔe ta he kaa.” Anomanta, o ne o fɔwɛ fɔo asɛ o tao ŋwɛnɛ o kaa.
Korowii keame bɛl pwah Kooro Ahab Ate, Korowii do o keamere baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ la bɛl ŋɔ, ó ŋɔ o dɔŋ be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he tokobii ŋwɛn mɛ.” Asɛ o vɛh.
Anee keame la ŋɔ o dɔŋ la be ŋɔ, “Haa vɛh Korowii waa nomanta, haa den le n be bonɔ dɛɛ kaa la, nyujente ɛɛ kpoe.” Waa dena le bela la, nyujente lawɔ dɛ kpoo.
Korowii keame la berɛ na o keame dɔŋ bɛl ɡe dɛ ŋɔ, “Lɔ mɛ!” Asɛ o lɔɔ kohona dɛ doo bol.
Keame la kpɔ kon vɔwɛ sie dɛ kpɔ o te sɔh, dɛ ka che ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kpa Israel Kooro Ahab.
Kooro aa ba dɛ kaa la, Korowii keame la yerɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he bonɔɔ lɔ laa ta asɛ laa tena la bɛl lawɛ dɔma la bɛl ba tɛ mɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nyiŋi baa nɔ nɛɛ tɛ mɛ o bɛ chwa, dɛ o chwao waa hɛɛ kpɔ he nyuu charɛ, kɛɛ he bɔ suuɡapoŋa kilore fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛ.
Kɛ n sie berɔ do waane ta mɛɛ ɛ asɛ baa la dɔ bɔr chwa.’ ” Anee Kooro Ahab chaŋe ŋɔ, “He ɡbaɡbaa baɡle ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ ba tɛr he deŋne.” Korowii keame la pur yal waa kpɔa vɔwɛ o siebɔr la, buɡ la ta, Kooro na kɛŋɔ Korowii keamere la bini bɛlee.
Belaa Korowii keame la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Haa ɡela baa maa kpɔɔ do he nɔn ta ŋɔ o chɛ kpoe, asɛ he ɡel o dɔ bɔr chwa dɛ dɔ o nyu nomanta, hɛɛ kpɔ he nyuu charɛ o kon, ásɛ he laa tena ɡe kpɔ ba nyuune charɛ o laa tena nyuune.’ ” Ate, Kooro Ahab kpɔ sum ne bandia kaa o koodem Samaria.
Nabɔt daa koo wa Awola bɛl, baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Nabɔt dɛ le bwɛɛ bɛl sɔne Jesreel.
Dɛ o dɔ daa koo o bɛne Samaria Kooro Ahab dem jwɛɛh Jesreel bela.
Awola bɛl, Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Nabɔt be ŋɔ, “He bodɛɛɡe haa du daa nɔ bɛne n koodem, kpɔ tɛ mɛ ń parɛ papooni baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ dɔkpɔɡa dɔr ne kela ne ntoosi dɛ ŋwana.
Mɛɛ tɛɛ daa koo waa wera ɡwaalo, dɛ he dɛ nyin ɡe aa, n tɛɛ suuɡa aa chɛ o yoɡ.” Anee Nabɔt ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, n naawa kapɛrɛ koo, asɛ n di, Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛŋɔ ń kpɔ ya kapɛrɛ kon tɛɛ.” Ate, Kooro Ahab kpɔ sum ne bandia kaa dem, waa Nabɔt aa bola baɡlo kɛŋɔ “Maa n naawa kapɛrɛ konee kpɔ tɛɛ” la wa.
Asɛ bwaawee farɔ o ka chɔ dɛ vɛh kwaa dii.
Kooro haah Jɛsɛbɛl la o be dɛ ka pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he kpɔ sum ne bandia so, haa wola kwaa kwaraa di nɔɔ?” Kooro chaŋe o haah ŋɔ, “Nabɔt waa lɔ Jesreel la bee n ŋɔ ó yoɡ o daa koo tɛ mɛ, dɛ ɡɛ laa ɡe aa, ń tɛo bɛl o chiɡ o kon la naa ta.
Kɛ o vɛoh ŋɔ waa kpɔ tɛ mɛ.” Anee Jɛsɛbɛl ŋɔ, “Kenii hɛɛ ba kora dii Israel tena nɛ aa?
Ir dɛ ɡel he sie lɛ dɛ di kwa.
Mɛɛ lɛ Nabɔt Jesreel te daa koo laanee tɛɛ.” Jɛsɛbɛl kpɔ Kooro Ahab sɔn chwerɛ tɔne asɛ o kpɔ o noniseɡ ɛɡre a ta, dɛ tomɛ ba kpɔ ka tɛ nomonome ne banɔ la baa soɡe nomombɔra Jesreel bela Nabɔt aa lole la.
Tɔne la bini waa nɔ.
“Hé bol nɛra be bá le tɔpebeŋkpoŋ cheɡ, dɛ́ cheme vɔwɛ nyoa, dɛ́ ɡel Nabɔt so nomonsobɔr.
Hé nyin nyosonteŋna banɛ ba so, ásɛ ba ne o sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa.
Ásɛ ba haŋɛ o nyoa nɛra la baah ta kɛŋɔ o taah Korowii ne kooro, dɛ́ lawɔ le bwɛjen la ta dɛ́ ka foɡro bwea kpo.” Ate, nomonome ne banɔ la baa soɡe nomombɔra Jesreel la ɛ ɡɛ Jɛsɛbɛl aa chwerɛ tɔne, dɛ do ba ŋɔ bá ɛ la.
Ba le tɔpebeŋkpoŋ cheɡ dɛ cheme vɔwɛ nyoa, dɛ yerɛ nɛra cheme dɛ tɛ Nabɔt nomonsobɔr.
Nyosonteŋna banɛ la baa so ba ne o sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa, ba haŋɛ o nyoa nɛra la bwa baah ta kɛŋɔ o taah Korowii ne kooro la.
Anomanta, ba lawɔ le bwɛjen la ta dɛ ka foɡro bwea kpo.
Asɛ ba kpɔ kala tɛ ba ka ŋɔ Jɛsɛbɛl be ŋɔ, “Ba foɡre Nabɔt bwea kpo.” Jɛsɛbɛl aa dena no kɛŋɔ ba foɡre Nabɔt bwea kpo la, o ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ́ ka kpɔ daa koo Nabɔt aa vɛah kɛ wɛɛ yoɡu tɛɛ la.
O toole kpa, o sewɔ.” Kooro Ahab aa noa buɡ la ta, o den la Nabɔt daa koo la ta dɛ ka kpɔ ɛ o kon.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ o keame Elaeja waa le Tisbe be ŋɔ, “La Samaria Israel Kooro Ahab be, o lɔ Nabɔt daa koo ta dɛɛ ba kpɔe berɛ o kon.
Ŋɔ o be ŋɔ men Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Ahab, he kpo nɛn dɛ berɛ kpɔ o kwaa di aa?
Bela nyootena aa kpɛle Nabɔt chal la, bela tentenee aa ba he ɡe chal kpɛla.’ ” Kooro Ahab na Elaeja dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N dɔm, he na mɛ.” Elaeja ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ, he ta he nyu dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa Korowii siwi ta.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ kpɔ wenaalee ba ta he nɛ.
Mɛɛ kpo he ne bibaa bɛlbwa waa lɔ he deemii le Israel harɛ ta, yoma ne nɛra baa dɛ di ba nyu bwa.
Mɛɛ ɛ he demii ɡɛ maa ɛ Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam ne Ahija bibaa Kooro Baasa dem la.
He ɡelɔ n baah di dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo n nɛ.’ Korowii ŋɔ Jɛsɛbɛl ɡe waa ŋɔ, ‘Nyootenaa dɛ́ di o ola bwɛjen Jesreel.’ He lole bɛlbwa waa sewɛ bwɛjen la ta la, nyootenaa dɛ́ di o ol.
Bɛlbwa ɡe waa ka sewɛ kpɔɡ bini la, jumbii di o ol.” Nomɛlbwa toole o siwi swɛɛ wechɔɡa ɛɛ Korowii siwi ta kɛŋɔ Kooro Ahab waa teŋɛ o haah Jɛsɛbɛl nyoa wobol ta la.
O ɛ kii wa, teŋa waa teŋɛ voɡa ta kɛŋɔ Amɔre tena Korowii aa doŋ ba le ba harɛ ta dɛ kpɔ tɛ he Israel tena ɡɛ saŋ waa lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Kooro Ahab aa no waa Korowii keame Elaeja aa bola la, o laa o ɡbaɡba laala waa doa la kɛɛ dɛ ka kpɔ lweyal tɔ.
O vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ tɔ o lweyal la dɛɛ chɔ, a baɡle kɛŋɔ o dɛ di suna.
Ate, Korowii bol waa Elaeja be ŋɔ, “He na ɡɛ Kooro Ahab aa pwɛr o te tɛ mɛ kenɛ?
A ɡɛ nomanta, maa ɡɛ wenaale laanee kpɔ ba o nɛɛ o saŋ nɔ ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba o dem tena nɛɛ o bibaa saŋ ta.”
Korowii keame Mikaya kah Kooro Ahab A habɔɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ba Israel ne Siiria tena baah bene anɛ, asɛ bentooro te ta la, Juda harɛ Kooro Jehosafat la dɛ ka na Israel Kooro Ahab.
Kooro Ahab ŋɔ o nomonome be ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ɛ ya kon, ɛrɛɛ yaa wola won ɛ waane dɛ́ berɛ lɛ le Siiria Kooro be nɔ?” Asɛ Kooro Ahab bɔɔ Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ ja n nɛɛ yá ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena aa?” Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “N sɛh ɡɛ, n ne he bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
N nɛra ɛ he nɛra, n jaɡre ɡe ɛ he kwa.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Gel ya soŋe le Korowii be mɔɔ.” Anomanta, Kooro Ahab yerɛ Korowii keamere lafraanaarɛ, dɛ kpɔ bil ba sie ŋɔ, “Ń ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena kɛɛ ń ɡel ɔ?” Ba ŋɔ, “La ka yoo ba.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ baa do he nɔn taa.” Ate, Kooro Jehosafat bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Amɔ Korowii keame bɛlbwa toole ya che o nɛɛ dɛ́ soŋe le Korowii be naa?” Anee Kooro Ahab chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii keame beŋkpoŋ bɛl lole.
Onee Imla bibaa Mikaya.
Kɛ n ne waa somɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ta wobɛlbwa nae le Korowii be dɛ tɛ mɛ a ɛ wedɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ bwa, atane wechɔɡa ɡbo.” Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, bɛ ɡɛ ŋɔ.” Asɛ Kooro Ahab yerɛ o nomonome la bini bɛl dɛ ŋɔ, “La ka kpɔ Imla bibaa Mikaya ba taraken.” Dɛ Israel Kooro Ahab ne Juda Kooro Jehosafat do ba koolaala, dɛ so ba kookane ta, pɛla bɛl waa bɛne bwɛjen Samaria doonyoa, asɛ Korowii keamere la bwa che ba sie dɛɛ bol waa baa naa ba be.
Korowii keamere la bini bɛlee Kenaana bibaa Sedekia.
O kpɔ bune ɛ kwaane a do kɛ nyeɡlare.
O ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
‘Kwaa nɔɔ hɛɛ ba kpɔe yo Siiria tena, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.’ ” Dɛ ɡɛ tentenee keamere la bwa bol Korowii waa dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena, hɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he pɔ ba nɛ.” Torome waa laŋa ka ɡaaɡe Mikaya bɔr la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii keamere la bwa nyoa pɛo ba bol ŋɔ kooro wobɛlbwa chiɡo kɛrɛdɛ.
Sɛh dɛ́ ɡel he ne ba waa la ɛ beŋkpoŋ.” Anee Korowii keame Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole kɛŋɔ, mɛɛ bol waa Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa ŋɔa ń bol o bee.” Mikaya aa ba Kooro Ahab be la, Kooro pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N ne n dɔŋ Kooro Jehosafat ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena kɛɛ yá ɡel ɔ?” Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé la ka yoo ba, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo hé pɔ ba nɛ.” Asɛ Kooro Ahab ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Keraŋwɛnɛɛ ń ɡel he ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ he bol kasinteŋ Korowii sɔn ta nɔ?” Mikaya ŋɔ, “N na Israel laa tena baa perɛ deŋɡarere ta kɛŋɔ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe ken.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Ba ta sitɔɔ dɔe, ɡel bá berɛ kaa dem deŋnesɔɔhna ne.’ ” Belaa Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “N ta he be ŋɔe ŋɔ o ta wedɛɛɡa bolɛ n be bwa atane wechɔɡa ɡbo aa?” Korowii keame Mikaya berɛ teŋɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “No waa Korowii aa bola.
N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii aa soɡe o kookara ta nyundua, o dɔm baa ja o nɛ dɛɛ tomɔ che baro.
Ate, Korowii pɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ neɡre Kooro Ahab ásɛ o la Ramɔt Gelead dɛ́ ka yoo ba ásɛ ba kpoo bela ɔ?’ Korowii dɔm baa cheɡa baro nyundua la bwa waa koɡrɔ.
Bane ŋɔ ken, bane ɡe ŋɔ ken.
Ate, doma bɛl ba che Korowii sie dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ neɡroo.’ Asɛ Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa hɛɛ ba kpɔe neɡro wɔ?’ Asɛ doma la ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo Korowii keamere baa dɛ tomɛ Kooro Ahab neɡro.’ Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Kaa dɛ́ ka ɛ ɡɛ.’ ” Korowii keame Mikaya berɛ ŋɔ, “Korowiirii ɡela he keamere la neɡre, o ɡbabirii bol he chɔɡa waa kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ hé sewɛ.” Ate, Kenaana bibaa Korowii keame Sedekia la dɛ ka kpaa Korowii keame Mikaya lwɛɛma dɛ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo Korowii Doma ɡel mɛ dɛ ba bol wa he be bwa nɔ?” Korowii keame Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ naa, awola haa ŋɔ he ka jo dea bini ka sɔh la.” Belaa Israel Kooro Ahab ŋɔ o nomonome la bɛl be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ Korowii keame Mikaya kaa Amɔn waa dɛ nyiŋi bwɛjen nɔ ta, ne n bibaa Joas be, dɛ́ ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, n ŋɔ bá lawɔ do dea, dɛɛ tɛo paanoo ne nee ɡbo ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba jo sɔnɔnɔɔ.” Korowii keame Mikaya ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa jo sɔnɔnɔɔ naa, amɔ dɛ Korowii laa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛ bol wa.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa kpɔ waa nɔ do o nyu bini.” Kooro Ahab seo wa Ate, Israel Kooro Ahab ne Juda Kooro Jehosafat la bwɛjen Ramɔt Gelead dɛ ka yoo ba.
Israel Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ beɡre n tenee dɛ́ ka ja laa tena nɔ nɛ, kɛ he te, do he koolaala.” Anomanta, Kooro Ahab beɡre o te dɛ kaa laa la ta.
Dɛ Siiria kooro do o laa sitɔɔla fifraatoro dɛ banɛ baa dɛ nyiŋi torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la ŋɔ, “He bɛ nomɛlbwa ka yo ka ja Israel kooro ɡbo nɛ.” Laa sitɔɔla la aa na Kooro Jehosafat la, ba liiro ŋɔ Israel kooroo, asɛ ba laa berɛ ŋɔ bá ka yoo.
Kɛ waa dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre la, mɔɔ ba na kɛŋɔ Israel kooro laa, ba ta on yoi kpa.
Siiria laa tena la bɛl ta hɛm o ka yaɡɛ Israel Kooro Ahab kon waa kpɔa tɔ ɡbemɡbe la keŋkeŋ, asɛ dɛ yaɡɛ o bambinyoa dɛ o laa saahna.
Asɛ kooro la ŋɔ nɛn waa soɡe o torɔɡo baa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔ la be ŋɔ, “Ba do mɛ bol, le n ne laa nɔ ta.” Dɛ yoi la kpeɡri tɔpebir la bwa, asɛ ba lawɛ kooro la kpoŋe o so torɔɡo la bini, o sie chaɡɛ Siiria laa tena la.
Chal palɔ dɛɛ chiɡ kon la bini, jɔmɔra ne tela dɛ o sewɔ.
Wee aa dɛ jo la, takpeɡ le laa tena la baah ta ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa berɛ kaa o bwɛɛ ne o harɛ ta!” Anomanta, Kooro Ahab sewɔ ba kaa o ne Samaria ka huɡe.
Ba loo torɔɡo baa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔ, o che o bini chal ɛo la Samaria tam bɛl hanjwamanere aa dɛ sɔ nee o ta, asɛ nyootena ka kpɛle o chal la, ɡɛ Korowii aa bol o waa la.
Kooro Ahab bwara waa ne o kora ne koodem waa doa dɛ kpɔ bala nyen kwaa o bini ne bwɛjena waa ma danjwɛɛ bara bwa, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Ahab sewɔ ka chɔ o naawa hoɡa ta, asɛ o bibaa Ahasia ba chiɡ o naa ta di kora.
Juda Kooro Jehosafat Kooro Ahab aa di kora Israel harɛ bennaarɛ taa Asa bibaa Jehosafat di kora Juda harɛ.
Waa di kora dɛ o di bene fifraatoro dɛ anue.
O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue.
Dɛ o nya sɔne Asuba, o ɛ Silhi bihaah.
Kooro Jehosafat ɛ ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Asa aa ɛa wobɛlbwa ta, o ta an ɡelɛ.
O ɛ waa aa toɡra Korowii be.
Deŋɡarere voɡtoroma aa dɛ kpoo kwaa a ta la te, o ta an chɔɡɛ, ba ta teŋɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma bela.
Dɛ beŋkpoŋri lɔ Kooro Jehosafat ne Israel kooro baah ta.
Kooro Jehosafat bwara waa ne waa waa ɛa, o bambikpeɡ ne laa waa yoa la, ba chwerɛ a bwa do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
O le voɡare baala ne haahna aa dɛ bɔ jwamane harɛ la ta la ne, ɡɛ saŋ o mɛɛ Asa aa di kora harɛ la bwa ta.
Dɛ kooro toole Edom harɛ ta, nɛnee Juda kooro le o ka chiɡ o naa ta dɛɛ di kora bela.
Kooro Jehosafat kwaa stiimaere asɛ dɛ fee kpɔ la Ofir harɛ ta kaa di suuɡaswɛm bona.
Kɛ a kaa paɡre Eseɔn Gɛba a ta wone tel Ofir.
Kooro Ahab bibaa Ahasia ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ɡɛ saŋ ŋɔ, “Gel he nɛra ne n nɛra pɛ kpɔ stiimaere la.” Asɛ Kooro Jehosafat vɛh.
Kooro Jehosafat sewɔ ka chɔ o naawa hoɡa ta Jerusalam, o naa Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
Asɛ o bibaa Jehoram chiɡ o naa ta di kora.
Israel Kooro Ahasia Kooro Jehosafat aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anuanɛ taa Kooro Ahab bibaa Ahasia di kora bene anɛ Israel harɛ ta, dɛ so Samaria.
Kooro Ahasia ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Ahab ne o nya Jɛsɛbɛl aa ɛa, dɛ Kooro Jɛroboam waa ɡela Israel tena bwa ɛ wechɔɡa la.
O tomɛ voɡ Baal dɛ ɡuŋu, dɛ muɡli Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la baah ɡɛ o mɛɛ aa ɛa la.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Koranar Tɔn Nɛɛte nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Israel harɛ bini aa peɡri anɛ, asɛ Juda harɛ dɔ o kooro, Israel harɛ ɡe dɔ o kooro.
Korowii tomɛ o keamere pirim, kɛŋɔ Elaesa ne Aesaya ɡe ja bá ba kah ba ŋɔ bá berɛ ba o be.
A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ koranar la bane waa wer, kɛ Korowii cheɡɛ Israel ne Juda dɔma nɛɛ dɛ tɛr ba bwa deŋne.
Asiiria koojen ne o laa tena baa yo Israel tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Bene ane habɔɔ la, Babelɔn kooro ne o laa tena ɡe baa yo Juda tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba lawɛ nɛra la ɡalɡa kaa bojaŋ harɛfala ta.
Korowii pa Kooro Ahasia bole Israel Kooro Ahab seo habɔɔ la, Moab harɛ ta tena le o bibaa Kooro Ahasia habɔɔ.
Awola bɛl, Kooro Ahasia le o abrɔsane waa lɔ Samaria saldoa bobɛl waa kpɔ daa sam o koodem bela, dɛ le ba le harɛ dɛɛ we weela.
Asɛ o tomɛ toroma Filisti tena bwɛjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Ekron voɡ Baal Sibab ta ŋɔ bá ka voɡɛ kɛ wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu yaa.
Kɛ Korowii nyundua torome bɛl ŋɔ Korowii keame Elaeja waa le Tisbe be ŋɔ, ó ka cheme Samaria kooro toroma la dɛ́ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ toole kpa, asɛ he berɛ dɛɛ la Ekron voɡ Baal Sibub ta ka bɔɔ le o be nɔ naa?
Anomanta, ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Haa ɡbaŋre dɛ́ ir le bela haa chɔa la, hɛɛ sewɔɔ.’ ” Asɛ Elaeja ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa doo la.
Asɛ toroma la berɛ laa berɛ ba Kooro Ahasia be, asɛ o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he den ba warane ken?” Ba ŋɔ, “Baa bɛl cheme yaa ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ ŋɔ yá berɛ ka ŋɔ kooro waa tomɛ yaa be ŋɔ, waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘Korowiirii wola toole Israel harɛ ta waa he tomɛ baala ŋɔ, bá la ka bɔɔ le Ekron tena voɡ Baal Sibub ta he weela waa nɔ naa?
Anomanta, hɛɛ ka kalaŋ taa, sewaa chɛ kɛŋɔ he sewɛ.’ ” Kooro la berɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ baa waa cheme heyaa dɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ la doɔ?” Ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Batakaare waa doa la ɛ oltɔn, dɛ berɛ kpɔ oltɔn ɡe vɔwɛ kiriso.” Kooro la ŋɔ, “Tisbe te Elaeja laanee.” Ate, kooro la tomɛ o laa sitɔɔ, dɛ laa tena fifraanue ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ Elaeja ba.
Dɛ Elaeja soɡe deŋɡare bɛl doa, asɛ laa sitɔɔ la la o be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Korowii keame, kooro ŋɔ he tu ba o be he ne ó bol wa.” Anee Elaeja ŋɔ laa sitɔɔ la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii keamee men aa, ate nii le nyundua dɛ́ ba fuh he ne he laa tena fifraanue nɔ bwa.” Buɡ la ta, nii den le nyundua dɛ ba fuh laa sitɔɔ la ne o laa tena la bwa ba serewe.
Asɛ Kooro Ahasia berɛ tomɛ laa sitɔɔ bɛl ɡe ne o laa tena fifraanue Elaeja be ja, asɛ laa sitɔɔ la ka ŋɔ Elaeja be ŋɔ, “Korowii keame, kooro ŋɔ he tu ba o be he ne ó bol wa taraken.” Elaeja ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii keamee men aa, ate nii le nyundua dɛ́ ba fuh he ne he laa tena fifraanue nɔ bwa.” Ate, Korowii den ɡel nii le nyundua, dɛ ba fuh laa sitɔɔ la ne o laa tena la bwa ba serewe.
Kooro Ahasia berɔ tomɛ laa sitɔɔ bɛl ɡe ne o laa tena fifraanue ɡe toorotena.
Nomontooro te la teehnɔ la Elaeja be, dɛ ka ɡuŋi harɛ o sie dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “Korowii keame, na n ne n laa tena fifraanue nɔ sum, dɛ́ ɡel ya dɔ ya nyuune.
Nyiŋi na, ɡɛ nii aa le nyundua dɛ ba fuh laa sitɔɔla banɛ la ne ba laa tena bwa ɡɛ!
N poori, na n sum dɛ bɛ ɡel a ba n nɛ.” Belaa Korowii nyundua torome bɛl ŋɔ Elaeja be ŋɔ, “Tu he ne o kaa, dɛɛ berɛ ɔma.” Asɛ Elaeja tu ba o ne nomoa la la kooro la be.
Elaeja aa tel bela la, o ŋɔ Kooro Ahasia be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be laanee kɛŋɔ, Korowiirii wola toole Israel harɛ ta waa he tomɛ toroma ŋɔ bá la ka bɔɔ le Ekron voɡ Baal Sibub ta he weela nɔ waa naa?
A ɡɛ nomanta, haa kalaŋ ta ira ba, sewaa chɛ kɛ he sewɛ.” Anomanta, Kooro Ahasia sewɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Elaeja nɛɛ dɛ bol la ta.
Dɛ Kooro Ahasia ta bibaa dɔe, asɛ o nime Joram chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di Israel kora.
Kooro Jehosafat bibaa Kooro Jehoram aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bennɛɛte taa Kooro Joram di kora.
Waa Kooro Ahasia aa ɛa o kora dii ta bwa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Korowii kpɔ o keame Elaeja kaa nyundua Saŋ bɛl telo kɛŋɔ dɛ Korowii dɛ ba Elaeja kpɔe dɛ́ kaa nyundua kawulewule ne.
Dɛ Elaeja ne o bonɔɔ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Elaesa dɛ ba Gelɡal lee dɛ́ kaa.
Baa dɛ kaa la, Elaeja ŋɔ Elaesa be ŋɔ, “So bonɔ, Korowii tom mɛ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Bɛtel.” Anee Elaesa ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, asɛ he ɡe do le nɔ kɛŋɔ n ne henee.” Asɛ ba bwa chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa Bɛtel.
Dɛ Korowii keamere bane baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ lɔ Bɛtel.
Ba ba Elaesa be dɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He jemɔ kɛŋɔ fini Korowii dɛ ba he dɔɔ kpɔe le he be kaa a ka he ɡbo aa?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N jemɔ, hé hel, he bɛ a waa bol.” Elaeja ŋɔ Elaesa be ja ŋɔ, “Korowii tom mɛ bwɛjen Jeriko, so bonɔ.” Elaesa ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole, asɛ he ɡe do le nɔ kɛ n ne henee.” Anomanta, ba kaa Jeriko.
Korowii keamere baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ dɛ do Jeriko baa bɔɔ Elaesa ŋɔ, “He jemɔ kɛŋɔ fini Korowii dɛ ba he dɔɔ kpɔe le he be kaa a ka he ɡbo aa?” Elaesa ŋɔ, “N jemɔ, hé hel, he bɛ a waa bol.” Elaeja berɛ ŋɔ Elaesa be ja ŋɔ, “Korowii tom mɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la ta, kɛ so bonɔ.” Elaesa ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole, asɛ he ɡe do le nɔ kɛ n ne henee.” Asɛ ba bwa kaa.
Korowii keamere baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ fifraanue teŋɔ, dɛ ka jaɡɛ che ba ne ba baah tɛr tama, ba sie chaɡɛ bela Elaeja ne Elaesa aa kaa che Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa la.
Asɛ Elaeja foo o batakaare, dɛ laa kpɛwɛ dɛ kpɔ lɔ nee la, asɛ nee la bini pere anɛ, asɛ ba valɛ kpɔ harɛpɛɛ ta le nee la baŋ.
Baa le nee la baŋ la, Elaeja ŋɔ Elaesa be ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ ba kpɔ mɛɛ kaa taraken, bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń ɛ tɛɛ mɔɔ ó ba kpɔ mɛ kaalɔ?” Asɛ Elaesa chaŋe ŋɔ, “Tɛ mɛ he kpeɡri nɔ dɔŋa bele anɛ, ásɛ n chiɡ he naa ta.” Anee Elaeja ŋɔ, “Waa haa dɛ soŋe la kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ń won tɛɛ.
Dɛ he na mɛ mɛɛ kaa tenaa, hɛɛ dɔɔ, kɛ dɛ he ta men nae tenaa, haa dɔ.” Ba taa bol waa dɛ valɛ dɛɛ kaa la, buɡ la ta, dɛ torɔɡo ne jaɡre baa che Elaesa ne Elaeja baah ta a bwa ɛɛ lawɛ nii, asɛ buɡ la ta, kawulewule den ba kpɔ a ne Elaeja kaa nyundua.
Elaesa nao dɛ do lɔŋɔ yerɛ Elaeja ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ!
N dɔɔ!
Nɛn waa cheɡɛ Israel tena habɔɔ!
He kaalɔ.” Elaesa ta on nae kpa.
O kɛɛ o laala waa doa la bini anɛ, a baɡle kɛŋɔ o loo kuu kohona.
Dɛ Elaeja yal waa tɔɔ dɛɛ dawɛ o laala ta la leo le, asɛ Elaesa kpɔ dɛ berɛ la ka che Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa.
O kpɔ Elaeja yal la lɔ nee la dɛ lii ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii Elaeja aa tomɔ la dɔɔ?” Waa bera kpɔ lɔ nee la, o bini pero anɛ, asɛ harɛpɛɛ chɔ o valɛ o bini le o baŋ.
Dɛ Korowii keamere baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ fifraanue ba le Jeriko la ta cheɡɛ bela nao, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Elaeja kpeɡri la ba Elaesa nɛ!” Asɛ ba la o be, dɛ ka ɡuŋi o sie, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Yan yaa ɛ he bonɔɔna lɔ baala fifraanue ya bwara aa kpeɡa bonɔ.
Gel yá ka ɡaaɡe he nomoa bɔr, Korowii domaa ken baa kpɔɔ kaa dɛ ka ɡelo bwejen bɛl doa kɛɛ fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini.” Anee Elaesa ŋɔ, “Akai, he bɛ nomɛlbwa tomɛ.” Ba soŋo a ba peo, asɛ o ŋɔ, “Hé tom ba.” Asɛ ba tomɛ baala fifraanue la ba ka ɡaaɡe Elaeja bɔr tɔpera atoro ba ta on nae.
Asɛ ba laa berɛ ba Jeriko, dɛ Elaesa ta lɔ bela, anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N ta he be ŋɔe ŋɔ hé ɡel o bɔr ka ɡaaɡa aa?” Elaesa nyokpowa waa ɛa Awola bɛl, bwɛjen Jeriko tena la Elaesa be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Ya dɔɔ, he ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ ya bwɛɛ nɔ chɔe wer, kɛ nee yaa dɛ nyɔ aa were, kondikwaa ɡe aa wer do ya harɛ nɔ ta.” Asɛ Elaesa ŋɔ, “Hé ɛ yar tama do loɡfale ta ba tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ ba ɛ ba tɛo.
Anee o kpɔ la ba bule la ta, dɛ ka fuɡe yar la do o ta dɛ ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘N ɡelɔ nee nɔ do wer, harɛ la ɡe ta kwaa ɛɛ do wer nomɛlbwa aa wola sewɛ kpa.’ ” Nee la wer dɛ ba le fini ɡɛ Elaesa aa ŋɔa o do la.
Elaesa le Jeriko dɛɛ kaa Bɛtel, waa dɛ kaa la, bechale bane le bwɛɛ la ta dɛ baa ɛo nɛnhɛla ŋɔ, “Le bonɔ, nyuɡbaale te bɛl le!” Asɛ Elaeja ke nyiŋ ba dɛ taah ba Korowii sɔn ne, asɛ sisirere anɛ le daa ane bini, dɛ ba kpoo bii la bini fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ dɛ toɡri ba ola.
Elaesa le bela dɛ teeh kaa Kaamɛl Bwejen doa, dɛ le bela kaa bwɛjen Samaria ta.
Israel ne Moab tena laa yoi Kooro Jehosafat aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anuatoro taa Kooro Ahab bibaa Kooro Joram di kora Israel harɛ ta.
Kooro Joram di kora bene fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ so bwɛjen Samaria.
Kooro Joram ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, kɛ dɛ a ta do kɛ anɔ la o mɛɛ ne o nya Jɛsɛbɛl aa ɛa la.
O le voɡ Baal o mɛɛ aa cheɡo dɛɛ tomɔ la ne.
Dɛ o teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam wechɔɡa waa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ la ane.
Dɛ Moab Kooro Mesa dɛ dɛɛ peera.
Bena bɛlbwa, o yon kpɔ harɛ la ta kwaa kɛŋɔ pebiiri kaɡboŋa lafa, ne pebala pona kaɡboŋa lafa kaa tɛ Israel Kooro Joram.
Kɛ Kooro Ahab seo habɔɔ, Moab tena ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ Israel Kooro Joram nɛ.
Gɛ saŋ la, Kooro Joram le Samaria, dɛ ka boa Israel laa tena bwa nyoa.
Dɛ tomɛ toroma Juda Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “Moab kooro ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ n nɛ, hɛɛ ja n nɛɛ ń ka yoo wa aa?” Anee Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n teŋɛ he nɛ, n laa tena ne n jaɡre bwa lɔ he nɔn ta.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa yá kpɔ dɛ́ ka yoo?” Asɛ Kooro Joram ŋɔ, “Yaa kpɔ Edom pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la taa.” Ate, Israel Kooro Joram ne Juda Kooro Jehosafat, dɛ Edom kooro kpɔ ba laa tena le.
Ba valɔ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa ɡoɡla ta tɔpera anuanɛ, asɛ ba nee ba tonɛ, ane toole nɛra ne ba kondɛɛra nyɔ.
Anee Kooro Joram ŋɔ, “Akwe!
Ya na wa.
Korowii kpɔ ya koranar batoro nɔ do Moab kooro ne o laa tena nɔn ta!” Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “Korowii keame bɛl lɔ bonɔ, ásɛ ya che o nɛɛ bɔɔ le Korowii be naa?” Asɛ Israel Kooro Joram laa nomonome la bɛl ŋɔ, “Safat bibaa Elaesa lɔ bonɔ, dɛ onee dɛɛ cha Elaeja.” Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “Korowii keame tentenee.” Asɛ koranar batoro la bwa la Elaesa be.
Anee Elaesa ŋɔ Israel Kooro Joram be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa nee he ba dɛɛ nyin ń chae nɔ?
La keamere he nya ne he mɛɛ aa la ba be la be.” Kooro Joram ŋɔ, “Akai!
Korowiirii yerɛ ya koranar batoro nɔ bonɔ, dɛ kpɔ yaa ba do Moab laa tena nɔn ta.” Asɛ Elaesa ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii waa lole mɛɛ tomɔ kɛŋɔ, dɛ Juda harɛ ta Kooro Jehosafat maa dɛ duuru waa laa aa, n fe aa he siwi taa nyiŋi.” Dɛ ŋɔ, “Nyin nɛn waa jemɛ janjela lɔe ba tɛ mɛ.” Janjela te la aa dɛ lɔ la, Korowii kpeɡri ba Elaesa nɛ, asɛ Elaesa ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Hé kwi bɔɔne nenabɔɔ nɔ bini bwa.
He nɛra batoro nɔ aa peu kɛɛ bwaalaa na, kɛ nee ɛɛ su nenabɔɔ nɔ bini bwaa, ásɛ he ne he nae ne kondɛɛra bwa dɔ nyɔ.’ ” Elaesa berɔ ŋɔ, “A ɡɛ waa nɔ pwɛre Korowii be, wɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ Moab laa tena do he nɔn ta he pɔ ba nɛ.
Hɛɛ yo bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara ne bwɛɛre nɛra bwaa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ teŋni daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ bwa ta, dɛ́ tɔɔɡe neerare aa dɛ palɛ bwa nyuune.
Dɛ kpɔ bwea tɔɔɡe ba harɛdɛɛɡa bwa dɛ́ chɔɡa.” Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ ɡɛ saŋ ba yon dɛɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la, nee den palɛ le Edom harɛ pera dɛ ba tɔ harɛ la bwa ta.
Moab tena aa noa kɛŋɔ koranar batoro la dɛ ba bá yoo ba la, ba le baa bɛlbwa waa dɛ ba wona yo, bechale ne nomonome bwa, asɛ ba ka che ba harɛ jwɛh ta nee nyoa.
Baa ira chɔmbibi wee le dɛɛ yaɡɛ nee la sie la, Moab tena baa lɔ ba baŋ bɛl la nao kɛŋɔ nee la aa swɛɛra kɛŋɔ chal ken.
Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Chalee!
Koranar batoro la ne ba laa tena ka yoo dɛ kpoo ba te.
Hé ba ya ka pa ba laala kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa!” Kɛ Moab tena aa ba bela Israel tena aa soɡa la, Israel tena la yoo ba ba chwa.
Israel tena la chwao ti ba dɛɛ kpoo ba.
Ba chɔɡ ba bwɛjena, asɛ Israel tena baa chwaa dɛɛ kaa la, bɛlbwa kpɔ vamtor bwe ta harɛdɛɛɡe la ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ waa sua, asɛ nenapale bɛlbwa nyu teŋe, dɛ teŋni daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ ɡe bwa ta.
Ba bwɛjen baa dɛ yerɔ Kir Haresɛt ɡboo baa ka, kɛ baala baa kpoŋe vamtore baa bar bwɛjen la dɛ yoo ba.
Moab kooro nao kɛŋɔ ba dɛ ba o nɛɛ pɔe, asɛ o kpɔ laa tena lafraanuanɛ ba kpoŋe tokobie, dɛ́ fee ka tawɛ kpɔ ba bini kaa Edom kooro be, kɛ o ta wone.
Asɛ o lawɛ o bibanloɡle waa chiɡ o naa ta dɛ́ di kora la, dɛ kpɔɔ ɛ saraha danjwɛɛ baa maa bar bwɛjen la ta tɛ Moab harɛ voɡ.
Israel laa tena la aa na ɡɛ la, ba bambile teŋo kohona ba laa berɛ kaa ba harɛ ta.
Elaesa luhaah bɛl chae Awola bɛl, luhaah bɛl o jaa fa aa ɛ Korowii keamere bane baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ bini bɛl la Elaesa be, dɛ ka wi noo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n jaa sewɔ.
He ɡbabir jemɛ ɡɛ waa tomɛ, ne ɡɛ waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii ɡe.
Taraken, o di nomɛl kem wɛɛ ba dɛ ba lawɛ n bibaala banɛ yoma bɔ kem.” Elaesa pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Baɡle kon haa dɛ nyin ń ɛ tɛɛ.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa he dɔ he dem ɔ?” Luhaah la ŋɔ, “He bitolo, n ta komɛlbwa dɔe ka ja ɔleve noo tama ane ɡbo.” Elaesa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “La he bala be dɛ́ ka soŋe viine.
Soŋa a warɛ.
Kaa he dem dɛ́ ka laa ɡbera tɔ he ne he bibaala la nɛ, ásɛ dɛ ka pa mun fuɡe noo le he noo vii bini do viine la bini.
A suu waa, he kwaa cheɡ.” Anomanta, haah la kaa dem dɛ ka laa ɡbera tɔ o ne o bibaala la nɛ ɡɛ Elaesa aa ŋɔ o be la.
O bii pa viine tɛo, asɛ o fuɡe noo la dɛɛ do a bini.
Asɛ viine la bwa su laɡlaɡ ken, o ŋɔ o bie la bɛl be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ vii la bɛl ba.” Bie la ŋɔ, “Vii bɛlbwa toole kpa.” Ate, vii waa fuɡe noo dɛɛ le o bini la noo la nyoa teŋe.
Haah la berɔ la Korowii keame Elaesa be dɛ ka bol waa aa chiɡa, asɛ o ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “Ka yoɡa dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ he kema, ásɛ he ne he bii di a kar.” Elaesa ne Sunem haah bɛl waa ɛ kondɔɔh wa Awola bɛl, Elaesa la bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sunem ta, dɛ haah bɛl o nɔn bini aa wera lɔ bela.
Haah la yerɛ Elaesa la o dem o ne o ka di kwa.
Le awola tɔpere dɛɛ kaa la, Elaesa aa kpɔ bwɛɛ la ta baa kaa bwa, ɡɛɛ o la dem bela dɛ ka di kwa.
Haah la ŋɔ o jaa be ŋɔ, “N nao kɛŋɔ baa nɔ waa dɛ ba ya be saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ ɛ Korowii keame tenten.
Gel ya ma dejeɡa bɛl ya dem nɔ saldoa, dɛ́ ɛ mpa ne teebur ne kara dɛ kandea cheɡ o bini tɛo, ásɛ o balaa wɛɛ do o bini.” Asɛ o sɛh.
Awola bɛl, Elaesa berɔ la Sunem dɛ teeh ka jo o dea la bini dɛɛ onɛ.
O ŋɔ o bonɔɔ baa dɛ yerɔ Gehasi be ŋɔ, “La ka yerɛ Sunem haah la ba tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ o yerɔ o ba che o sie.
Anee Elaesa ŋɔ Gehasi be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ haah nɔ be kɛŋɔ, o kaa nyin waa ba dawɛ ya nɛɛ a ɛ waa tɛ yaa.
Bɔkwaa yaa ba wona ɛ tɛo wɔ?
Yaa won bol o waa tɛo kooro be kɛɛ laa sitɔɔ be naa?” Haah la chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔ komɛlbwa maa dɛ nyin, n nɛra maa baa so ba baah ta nɔ.” Anee Elaesa bɔɔ Gehasi ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa yaa ba wona ɛ tɛo wɔ?” Gehasi ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, o ta bie dɔe, asɛ o jaa ɡe hwɛɛhrɔ.” Ate, Elaesa ŋɔ Gehasi be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ ó suuh tel n be.” Asɛ haah la ba, dɛ ba che doonyoa.
Elaesa ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “Benanyoa saŋ nɔ dɛ he kpoŋe bibaa.” Haah la ŋɔ, “Akai, n dɔɔ.
Korowii keamee hen, bɛ nyosone teŋe tɛ he tolo!” Ate, haah la ba kpoŋe tea benanyoa Elaesa aa doo la, dɛ lolɛ bibaa.
Bie la baa kpeɡ.
Awola bɛl, dɛ o mɛɛ ne nɛra dɛ komɛ mea koo ta, asɛ o la o be.
Kerabeŋkpoŋ bie la den do lɔŋɔ dɛ ŋɔ o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, “N nyu!
N nyu dɛ wee mɛ!” Asɛ o mɛɛ ŋɔ o bonɔɔna la bɛl be ŋɔ, “Kpɔɔ ka tɛ o nya.” Bonɔɔ la kpɔɔ ka tɛ o nya, asɛ o lɛo so o nakpale ta, ane ŋɔ a tel webaŋa dɛ bie la sewɔ.
Haah la kpɔ bie la teeh kaa Korowii keame la dea, dɛ kpɔɔ ka bil mpa ta, dɛ laa ɡbera tɔ dɛ ɡelo bela.
O yerɛ o jaa dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N poori, ɡel bonɔɔna la bɛl kpɔ keeɡo ba, ásɛ n ɛ warane la Korowii keame Elaesa be dɛ ba taraken.” Anee o jaa la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa hɛɛ nyin he la o be fini nɔ?
Korobifale Tɔpejen kɛɛ Ona Tɔpere laa fini.” O ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡel a hae.” Ate, o pa kwaa pa keeɡo la ta dɛ ŋɔ o bonɔɔ la be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ kaa warawara, nemenɛ n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ hɛɛ kaa tama tama.” Anomanta, ba leɔ dɛɛ kaa Korowii keame Elaesa be Kaamɛl Bwejen ta.
Korowii keame la aa nao bojaŋ la, o ŋɔ o bonɔɔ Gehasi be ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na, haah la waa le Sunem laanee dɛɛ ba la.
Chwa ka chemo dɛ́ pɛɛro ŋɔ, ‘He wobɛlbwa wer tɛɛ naa?
He jaa ne he bii leaa?’ ” Haah la ŋɔ Gehasi be ŋɔ, “Ya bwa bwara kpeɡri.” Haah la aa kaa pu Korowii keame la bwe la ta la, o chole Korowii keame la sie, dɛ lawɛ o nakpale kpoŋe.
Asɛ Gehasi ŋɔ o ka taɡɔ ta, anee Korowii keame la ŋɔ, “Gelo, o loo kuu kohona.
Korowii kpɔ waa aa puu la sɔɔh mɛ.” Haah la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n soŋe bie aa?
N ta he be ŋɔe ŋɔ he bɛ men neɡre, dɛ́ ɡel n kpɔ hwɛɡa ta waane ta pɛɛpɛɛ aa?” Anee Elaesa ŋɔ Gehasi be ŋɔ, “Gbaa he batakaare dɛ́ vɔwɛ kiriso, dɛ́ kpɔ n daŋɡbala kpoŋe, dɛ́ chwa dɛɛ kaa.
He kaa pu nomɛlbwa naa, bɛ waa o be bol.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe bol waa he be naa, bɛ on chaŋe.
Kpɔ n daŋɡbala la ka bil bie la sie.” Bie la nya la ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole, asɛ he ɡe do le kɛŋɔ maa kaa ɡele.” Anomanta, ba bwa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ kaa.
Dɛ Gehasi tɔ sie kaa dɛ ka kpɔ daŋɡbala la bil bie la sie, kɛ o ta wobɛlbwa ɛɛ á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ iruu.
Anomanta, Gehasi laa berɛ dɛ ka cheme Elaesa dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bie la ta ire.” Elaesa tel dem bela dɛ ka jo o dea, dɛ bie la sewɔ chɔ o mpa ta.
Asɛ o laa ɡbera tɔ o ne bie la nɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii.
O teeh mpa la dɛ ka pi bie la nɛ, dɛ kpɔ o nyoa pi o nyoa ta, o sibie pa o sibie ta, dɛ kpɔ o nɔɔra do o nɔɔra ta.
Waa tɛɡra chɔ bie la nɛɛ ɡɛ la, bie la bwara pa mun dɛɛ do wɔrɔbe.
Elaesa ir bie la nɛ, dɛ valɛ dea la bini dɛ la dɛɛ ba, dɛ ka teeh mpa la dɛ ka pi o nɛɛ ja.
Asɛ bie la chweremi kera anuanɛ dɛ laa sie pili.
Asɛ Elaesa yerɛ Gehasi ŋɔ, “Yerɛ bie la nya la.” Haah la aa bala la, o ŋɔ, “He bie laanee la, kpɔɔ kaa.” Asɛ o ɡuŋi Elaesa harɛ, dɛ kpɔ o bie dɛ le buse.
Nyokpowe-ɛɛla anɛ ane ɡe ja Lɔr baa chole Gelɡal harɛ la bwa ta, asɛ Elaesa berɛ kaa bela.
O ne Korowii keamere bane baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ cheme, asɛ o ŋɔ o bonɔɔ be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ vijen chɔŋɛ nii ta dɛ́ pile dɔr tɛ nɛra nɔ.” Ba bini bɛl iro jo kpɔɡ bini, dɛ ka toɡri papooni ane baa dɛ dia.
Waa laŋa la, o kaa na kpɔɡ bini juɡ dɛ pa o nɔna do o yal ta.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa aa a konsoo jemɛ, dɛ ba peɡra dɛ pa do vii la ne dɔr la ta.
Baa doɡ dɔr la, asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ o kwaa ba pa mun dɛɛ di la, ba kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Korowii keame, aa somɛ, ya diu yaa serewoo.” Elaesa ŋɔ, “Hé nyin mendɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ o kpɔ do vii la bini dɛ ŋɔ, “Kpɔ tɛɛ ba bá di.” Asɛ ba di wobɛlbwa ta ban ɛɛ.
Awola bɛl, baa bɛl le bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Baal Salisa, dɛ kpɔ meloɡla baa koma le koo ta a bena la, dɛ kpɔ ɛ paanoo fifraanɛ, dɛ kpɔ boyulwɛɛ ane ɡe ja ba tɛ Korowii keame Elaesa.
Anee Elaesa ŋɔ, “Kpɔ tɛ n bala Korowii keamere baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ nɔ bá di.” Anee bonɔɔ la bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, a kan dɛ́ won tel nɛra lafa aa?” Elaesa chaŋe ŋɔ, “He te kpɔ tɛɛ ba bá di, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Baa diu ane kwaraa ka.’ ” Anomanta, bonɔɔ la kpɔɔ ka cheɡ ba sie, o tɛɛ ba ba di ane ka, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la.
Naaman wee chaeh wa Dɛ baa bɛl lole baa yerɔ Naaman.
Dɛ onee Siiria kooro laa sitɔɔ.
Dɛ o ɛ nɛnjen asɛ o dɔɔ kooro ɛɛ duuru kohona.
Dɛkalkɛ a cheɡɛ o nɛ Korowii cha ba, dɛ ɡel ba pɔ ba dɔma nɛ.
Kɛ dɛ wee lɔ Naaman nɛ.
Dɛ Siiria laa tena boa nyoa ka yo dɛ lawɛ Israel bitolo bɛl laa ta, o do Naaman haah sie.
Awola bɛl, bitolo la ŋɔ o nya la be ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ n dɔɔ fe aa la Korowii keame bɛl waa lɔ Samaria be!
O fe ɛɛ chaoh o wee nɔ kaa.” Ate, Naaman ka bol kooro be ɡɛ Israel harɛ ta tolo la aa bola la.
Kooro la ŋɔ, “Ir, mɛɛ chwerɛ tɔnee tɛɛ he kpɔ ka tɛ Israel kooro.” Ate, Naaman ir kpɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore lafraatoro fifraanaarɛ, ne suuɡaswɛm kaɡboŋa anumɛl, dɛ yadɛɛɡa bele fi.
Waa aa lɔ tɔn Siiria kooro aa chwera ba kpɔ ka tɛ Israel kooro laanee kɛŋɔ, “Menee dɛɛ tomɛ n bonɔɔ Naaman tɔn nɔ ne, kɛŋɔ wee lɔ o nɛ hé chaoh.” Israel kooro aa cha tɔn la nyoa dɛ kure la, o kɛɛ o batakaare a baɡle kɛ o liire chɔɡɔ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Na Siiria kooro aa dɛ nyin n ne waa ɡɛ!
Korowiirii men n dɔ mkpa ne seo kpeɡri, he ŋɔ n chah baa nɔ naa?
A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ o dɛ nyin mɛ naɡra!” Korowii keame Elaesa aa noa kɛŋɔ Israel kooro laa o batakaare kɛɛ la, o tomɔ ba ka pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa bala he laa he batakaare kɛɛ?
Tomɛ Naaman ó ba n be, ásɛ n baɡlo kɛŋɔ Korowii keame bɛl lɔ Israel harɛ ta.” Naaman kpɔ o jaɡre ne o torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre, dɛ ir la Elaesa be dɛ ka che o dem doonyoa.
Elaesa tomɛ o bonɔɔna la bini bɛl o be dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir la ka sɔ Jɔɔdan Moo kera anuanɛ, wee la ɛɛ le he nɛɛ he bwara berɛ kwaa kɛrɛdɛ.” Ate, Naaman baah di o laa berɛ dɛɛ naɡre waa ŋɔ, “N te dɛ lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ leo dɛ́ ba soŋe Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ o nɔn viwe wee la ta dɛ́ chaah mɛ.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, bwɛjen Damaskɔs Mojena Abana ne Faapar laa wera Israel harɛ ta neerare bwa ta, ń fee ka sɔ n bwara kwaa raa?” Anomanta, o laa berɛ bandia ne dɛ kaa.
Belaa Naaman bonɔɔna suuh tel o jwɛh dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, dɛ wejena anee Korowii keame la ŋɔ he be ŋɔ he ɛ aa, he fe aa sɛh aa?
Ɛrɛɛ haa wola won ka sɔ nee la ɡɛ waa bola la, ásɛ dɛ dɔ chaah nɔɔ?” Anomanta, Naaman iro dɛ ka jo Jɔɔdan Moo la bini, dɛ sɔ kera anuanɛ ɡɛ Korowii keame la aa ŋɔ o be la, asɛ o bwara berɛ kwaa dɛ do wer kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ bechala bwara ken.
Naaman ne o bonɔɔna la bwa berɔ ba Korowii keame Elaesa be, asɛ Naaman ka che o sie dɛ ŋɔ, “N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii bɛlbwa toole harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa ka ja Israel harɛ ta.
N dɔɔ, n poori lɛ koŋkɛɛla he bonɔɔ aa ba a ne ba tɛɛ nɔ.” Belaa Elaesa chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole mɛɛ tomɔ kɛŋɔ, maa komɛlbwaa lɛ.” Naaman cheɡɛ o nɛɛ nɔ bwa o vɛh.
Ate, Naaman ŋɔ, “Dɛ haa komɛlbwaa lɛ tenaa, amɔ tɛ men he bonɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ n ɛ bonɔ teera keeɡore anɛ aa dɛ ba wona che kaa dem.
Maa kwaa kpoo fuh ɛ saraha tɛ voɡ bɛlbwa kpa atane Korowii ɡbo.
Kɛ kombeŋkpoŋ maa dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ, dɛ n ne n dɔɔ kooro kaa jo Siiria harɛ voɡ Remɔn dea dɛ ɡuŋu harɛ naa, ó kpɔ kɛ mɛ.” Anee Elaesa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ deŋnesɔɔhna kaa.” Asɛ Naaman kaa, waa tel sie tama la, Korowii keame Elaesa bonɔɔ Gehasi lii dɛ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ kpɔ Siiria te Naaman nɔ bwara kɛo, o ta koŋkɛɛla waa ba a ne bɛlbwa lɛɛ.
N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole kɛŋɔ mɛɛ chwao tiu dɛ́ ka lɛ komɛl le o be.” Ate, Gehasi chwa tiu, Naaman aa naa kɛŋɔ nomɛl chwao teŋɛ o nɛɛ la, o tuo le torɔɡo la bini dɛɛ chemo, dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “A som aa?” Gehasi ŋɔ, “A som, n dɔɔree tom mɛ he be ŋɔ Korowii keamere baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ banɛ bane le Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ ta dɛ ba o be taraken.
Dɛ he tɛo suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛ ne yadɛɛɡa bele anɛ.” Ate, Naaman ŋɔ, “Lɛ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore fifraanumɛl dɛ anuatoro,” dɛ kpɔ do pure anɛ bini ja yadɛɛɡa bele anɛ ta dɛ tɛ Gehasi o lɛ.
Dɛ ɡel o bonɔɔna banɛ kpɔ che tɔ Gehasi sie.
Ba tel deŋɡare harɛ ta bela Elaesa aa soɡa la, asɛ Gehasi lɛ kwaa la dɛ kpɔ ka bil dea, dɛ ɡel bonɔɔna la laa berɛ kaa.
Ate, Gehasi berɛ la ka che o dɔɔ Elaesa sie.
Elaesa bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa he leɔ?” Gehasi ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, n ta bobɛlbwa laŋɛ.” Elaesa ŋɔ, “Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ Naaman aa le o torɔɡo bini, dɛ ba cheme he ne wɛɛ bol waa la, dɛ n lɔ bela n doma ja he nɛɛ kɛɛ?
Saŋ ta tele kɛ he lɛ suuɡa kɛɛ yale ne ɔleve ne daa kooni, ne kooni ne peera, dɛ nae kɛɛ bonɔɔna ne toli.
Gɛ haa ɛa nɔ nomanta, wee a fa aa lɔ Naaman nɛɛ la ɛɛ ba he ne he naanar nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Asɛ Gehasi le Elaesa be kaa, dɛ wee lawɛ o bwa dɛ to kɛŋɔ yabi ken.
Kpanfɛbii waa jaah nee sie wa Awola bɛl, Korowii keamere bane baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ ŋɔ Elaesa waa ɛ ba sitɔɔ be ŋɔ, “Bela ya ne haa dɛ cheme la aa kanɛ.
Gel ya kaa Jɔɔdan Moo ta, daa lɔ bela, ya ka teŋe dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa bɔr dɛ́ so bela.” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Hé kaa.” Ba bini bɛl ŋɔ Elaesa be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, n poori ba ja ya nɛɛ ya kaa,” asɛ o sɛh ba bwa kaa.
Baa tel Jɔɔdan Moo ta la, ba pa mun teŋni daa la.
Ba bini bɛl kpanfɛbii fomo le nee bini, asɛ o do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, nomɛl konee n ka kemɛ, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?” Anee Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ, “Leperaa o leo?” Asɛ o baɡlo, Elaesa teŋe daa dɛ kpɔ ta bela, asɛ kpanfɛ la le jaah.
Elaesa ŋɔ, “Laa kpɔ.” Asɛ baa la ha nɔn, dɛ laa kpɔ.
Siiria laa tena nɛɛ pɔe wa Dɛ laa chɔ Siiria kooro ne Israel tena baah.
Siiria kooro ŋɔ o laa nomonome be, asɛ ba le bobɛl baa kpɔ ba laa tena ka so cheɡ.
Asɛ Korowii keame Elaesa tomɛ ba ka ŋɔ Israel kooro be ŋɔ, ó nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel Israel tena la kpɔ bela, dɛkalkɛ Siiria kooro ne o laa tena soɡe bela.
Anee Israel kooro pese bela Korowii keame la aa ŋɔa la.
Dɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa Elaesa teŋɛ dɛɛ bol ɡɛ bɔra la waa Israel kooro be, asɛ wɛɛ do a waa dɛɛɡɔ.
Siiria kooro baa na waa aa dɛ chiɡ, asɛ o baah di kohona o yerɛ o laa nomonome cheme dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He bini umee kpɔ ya waa kaa taa Israel kooro be nɔ?” Ba bini bɛl ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ya bini bɛlbwa laa.
Korowii keame Elaesa waa lɔ Israel laanee.
Onee dɛɛ no wobɛlbwa haa dɛ bol, dɛ́ ka bol Israel kooro be.
Hale waa haa sɔh so he dea dɛ́ bol bwa.” Kooro la ŋɔ, “Hé nyin bela waa lole, mɛɛ ɡeloo ba ka lawɔ ba.” Asɛ ba no kɛŋɔ o lɔ bwɛjen Dotan.
Belaa kooro tomɛ laa tena baa wara, dɛ tɛɛ ba jaɡre ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore bela.
Ba leɔ jwaana dɛ ka bar bwɛjen la cheme.
Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Korowii keame Elaesa bonɔɔ iro dɛɛ le buse dɛ na kɛŋɔ, laa tena kpɔ jaɡre dɛ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore bar bwɛjen la cheme.
Anee o ka ŋɔ o dɔɔ be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, akwe!
Ya na wa.
Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ yɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, ya dɔ laa tena ba warɛ ɡwaa ba kwa.” Belaa Elaesa soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, pili o sie ó won dɛɛ na.” Asɛ Korowii ɡel bonɔɔ la sie pili, o na kɛŋɔ jaɡre ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, ne niirare su deŋɡarere la ta dɛ bar Elaesa.
Siiria laa tena la aa dɛ tel Elaesa be la, o soŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ɡel baala nɔ nyoŋe, ba bɛ won na bela baa dɛ kaa.” Asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ.
Anee Elaesa ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He koni ŋwɛnɛ, bwɛjen haa dɛ kaa o ta la laa nɔ.
Hé teŋɛ n nɛ, ń la he ne nɛn haa dɛ nyinu la be.” Asɛ o tɔ ba sie dɛ kaa ba ne bwɛjen Samaria.
Baa dena jo bwɛjen Samaria la, Elaesa soŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ɡel ba berɛ dɛɛ na.” Asɛ Korowii no o wesoŋa dɛ pili ba sie, ba na kɛŋɔ ba cheɡɛ Samaria fɔɡbaah.
Israel kooro aa na ba la, o bɔɔ Elaesa ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ń kpoo ba kɛɛ?” Elaesa ŋɔ, “Akai, he yo nɛra laa dɛ laɡ ba aa, he dɛ kpoo ba aa?
Tɛɛ ba kondikwaa ne nee bá nyɔ, dɛ́ berɛ tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa ba dɔɔ be.” Anomanta, kooro ɡelɔ ba ɛ kondikonjena tɛɛ ba ba di, o tɛɛ ba nee ne sen ba nyɔ.
Dɛ ta ba ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa ba dɔɔ be.
Le bela dɛɛ kaa la, a biɡro Siiria laa tena ta Israel harɛ ta balɛ dɛ ba lɔ tɔ ba nɛɛ kpa.
Laa tena baa kaa chɔ bar bwɛjen Samaria A habɔɔ la, Siiria Kooro Bɛn Hadad kpɔ o laa tena bwa ba ka yo Israel tena, dɛ ka chɔ bar bwɛjen Samaria tena ɡe.
Baa tɔ Samaria tena do la ɡelɔ lɔr chole Samaria, asɛ ba yoɡ keeɡo nyu suuɡapoŋa fifraanuatoro.
Dɛ yoɡ kweah bena lakaja del suuɡapoŋa anue.
Awola bɛl, dɛ Israel kooro dɛ valɛ Samaria danjwɛɛ baa maa baro doa, asɛ haah bɛl do lɔŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, n poori cha mɛ!” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii ta hen chae yaa, bɔkwaa mɛɛ ba wona ɛɔ?
N ta mea kɛɛ sen dɔe dɛ́ chae.” Kooro la berɛ bɔɔ haah la ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa dɛɛ hae nɔ?” Haah la ŋɔ, “Awola bɛl, n dɔŋ nɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ yá lawɛ n bie chwe, ásɛ tɔɔ peraa, yá lawɛ o ɡe kon.” N sɛoh ya daa n kon la chwe, asɛ tɔ aa pera la n la dɛ ka ŋɔ ó ɡel ya kpo o kon la chwe, asɛ o lawɔ sɔh.
Kooro la aa no ɡɛ haah la aa bola la, o laa o batakaare kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ a we o nɛ.
Kooro la aa dɛ valɛ danjwɛɛ la doa la, nɛra nao kɛŋɔ waa tɔ lweyal do o batakaare lɔɡa, aa baɡle kɛŋɔ o lɔ lwe ta.
A habɔɔ, kooro la ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ n ta Safat bibaa Elaesa nyu teŋe fini naa, Korowii kpo mɛ!” Asɛ o tomɛ ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ Elaesa ba, dɛ o lɔ o dem Israel nomonome so o be.
Torome la aa wola tele mɔɔ la, Elaesa ŋɔ nomonome la be ŋɔ, “He ta nae kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ kpoo nɛra nɔ aa tomɛ nɛn ŋɔ ó ba kpo mɛ naa?
Dɛ torome la balaa, hé laa ɡbera tɔ dɛ bɛ ɡel o dɔ bɔr jo.
O dɔɔ kooro nakpale sio teŋɛ o nɛɛ wɛɛ ba.” Elaesa ne ba ta aa dɛ bol waa la, dɛ kooro la dɛ tel o be dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowiirii ɡela wechɔɡa nɔ ba, n berɛ kpa Korowii ka tel saŋ besoo jaɔ?”
Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ, “Hé no Korowii wa.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Kere saŋ nɔ bɔr tenten, lakaja baa do mea o ta Samaria aa yoɡii dɔ, baa yawɔɔ suuɡapoŋ beŋkpoŋii.’ ” Anee nomoa waa dɛ cha kooro ŋɔ Korowii keame la be ŋɔ, “Hale Korowii ɡelɔ bwaala mun pili kohona bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ won maɡre aa?” Elaesa ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ aa chiɡuu, kɛ kondikwaa la bɛlbwa aa he nyoa jo.” Siiria laa tena kaala wa Dɛ baala banaarɛ bane weechɔɡa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ soɡe bwɛjen Samaria doonyoa.
Ba ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Ásɛ ya so bonɔ dɛ́ serewe aa?
Dɛ ya jo bwɛɛ nɔ ta naa, lɔr la lɔ bela, yaa serewoo.
Ya soɡe bonɔ ɡe aa, yaa serewoo, he den ɡel yá kaa bela Siiria laa tena aa soɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ ya te ka do ba nɔn ta.
Dɛ ba ɡel yaa aa, dɛ ya dɔ ya nyu, ba kpoo yaa ɡe aa, ya den serewe.” Bɔr aa dɛ jo la, baala banaarɛ la leɔ dɛ kaa bela Siiria laa tena la aa soɡa la.
Baa tel bela dɛ nomɛlbwa toole, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɡelɔ Siiria laa tena la no ɡbɔɡa kɛŋɔ torɔɡore, ne jaɡre nakpale sii dɛ laa tena damanta ɡbɔɡa kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ba ba be, asɛ ba ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Hé na, Israel kooro kaa kpɔ Hiti ne Ijipt koranar ŋɔ, ba laa tena ba yo yaa.” Gɛ aa ɛ bá dɔ ba nyuune nomanta, ba iro chwa awola jɔmɔra la ne, dɛ ɡel ba tɛnte deene ne jaɡre dɛ keeɡore, bela chɔ pɛɛ.
Baala weechɔɡa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ la aa dɛ tel bela Siiria laa tena la fa aa soɡa la, ba kaa jo tɛnte deene la bɛl bini, dɛ ka di kwaa dɛ nyɔ sen, dɛ pa suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ne yale dɛ kpɔ ka sɔh.
Dɛ berɛ ka jo tɛnte denɛɛte bini, dɛ pa o ɡe bini laala ka sɔh.
Dɛ ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Kɛrɛdɛ laa yaa ɛ la, fini ɛ amanesoma tɔpere asɛ ya ɡbo kpɔ so la.
Dɛ ya ɡelɔ bɔr chaah a ta naa, yaa dɔ waa.
Ya den la kooro dem dɛ́ ka bol a wa.” Asɛ ba la dɛ ka yerɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah bwɛjen la doonyoone ta, dɛ bol ba be ŋɔ, “Ya la bela Siiria laa tena aa baa so la, ba kaalɔ dɛ ɡel ba tɛnte deene a che pɛɛpɛɛ.
Ba jaɡre ne keeɡore ta vɔrɔwɔ che, ya ta nɛn nae, ya ta nɛn ɡbɔɡa ɡe noɛ.” Ate, nɛra baa dɛ daah bwɛjen la doonyoone la kpɔ takpeɡ bol waa la, asɛ nɛra baa lɔ koodem bwa ɡe no.
Anee kooro la ir jwaana la ne dɛ ŋɔ o nomonome be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo he jemɛ waa Siiria tena aa ɛ yaa.
Ba nao kɛŋɔ lɔr chole ya nɛ, anomanta, ba le bela baa soɡa la dɛ ka sɔh kpɔɡ bini, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ yaa leo dɛ baa nyin kondikwa, ásɛ ba lawɛ yaa dɛ́ ba jo bwɛjen nɔ ta dɛ́ lɛ dɔɔh.” Belaa o nomonome la bɛl ŋɔ, “Nɛra yaa lɔ bwɛjen nɔ ta lɔ bonyɛɡa ta wubwa kɛŋɔ, banɔ la baa serewa la ken.
Gel ya tomɛ baala bá kpɔ jaɡre anue aa ka bwɛjen nɔ ta nɔ, dɛ́ la Siiria tena sobɔr bela ka na waa aa chiɡa.” Ba le baala bane, dɛ nyin kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore anɛ, ne a jaɡre ŋɔ bá ti Siiria tena, asɛ kooro do baala baa dɛ ba laŋa la ŋɔ, “Hé la ka na waa aa chiɡ Siiria laa tena sobɔr bela.” Ba ti ba ka tel Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa, dɛ Siiria tena pa ba yale ne ba laala ta ŋwɛnɛ ta, warane baa dɛ nyin dɛ chwa kaa nomanta.
Asɛ toroma la berɛ ba dɛ ba ŋɔ kooro be.
Ate, nɛra le bwɛjen Samaria ta, dɛ ka kah kwaa aa lɔ bela Siiria tena aa baa so la.
Ba pa kwaa kohona, a ɡel ba yoɡ lakaja baa do mea suuɡapoŋ beŋkpoŋ, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la.
Dɛ Israel kooro kpɔ o laa sitɔɔla la bini bɛl waa dɛ chao ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi bwɛjen la doonyojen la ta, asɛ nɛra aa wura dɛɛ le la, ba tiɡri o nɛ dɛ kpoo.
Gɛ Korowii keame Elaesa faa ŋɔ kooro la be ɡɛ saŋ kooro aa la o dem la.
Gɛ Korowii keame la aa bola la, ɡɛɛ a chiɡ.
O ŋɔ, “Kere saŋ nɔ bɔr tenten, lakaja baa do mea o ta Samaria aa yoɡii dɔ, baa yawɔ suuɡapoŋ beŋkpoŋii.” Dɛ kooro nomoa waa dɛ chao la fa ŋɔ Korowii keame la be ŋɔ, “Hale Korowii ɡelɔ bwaala mun pili kohona bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ won maɡre aa?” Asɛ Korowii keame la fa chaŋo ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ aa chiɡuu, kɛ kondikwaa la bɛlbwa aa he nyoa jo.” Gɛ waa la tentenee puu, nɛra tiɡri o nɛɛ bwɛjen la doonyojen ta bela o sewɛ.
Sunem haah bera dɛ́ ba wa Dɛ Korowii keame Elaesa fa ŋɔ haah bɛl waa le Sunem o chum o bie seo ta la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he dem tena ka so bobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin tama.
Korowii ŋɔ lɔr ɛɛ chiɡ harɛ nɔ ta bonɔɔ bene anuanɛ.” Haah la ɛ ɡɛ Elaesa aa ŋɔa la, o ne o dem tena iro, dɛ ka so Filisti tena harɛ ta bene anuanɛ.
Bene anuanɛ la habɔɔ la, haah la le Filisti harɛ ta dɛ berɛ kaa Israel harɛ ta.
Waa laŋa la, o la kooro be dɛ ka soŋo kɛŋɔ ó berɛ kpɔ o dem ne o harɛ tɛo.
Dɛ kooro fa bol waa Korowii keame Elaesa bonɔɔ Gehasi be ŋɔ, “Baɡ mɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla bwa Elaesa aa ɛa.” Gehasi aa dena dɛɛ bol kooro be ɡɛ Elaesa aa chum bibaa bɛl seo ta la, dɛ haah la Elaesa aa chum o bibaa seo ta la, deno baa soŋe kooro ŋɔ, ó berɛ kpɔ o dem ne o harɛ tɛo.
Gehasi ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, haah laanee la, o bie Elaesa aa ɡela o berɛ dɔ mkpa la ɡee la.” Asɛ kooro la pɛɛ haah la, o ŋɔ, “Kpelaa.” Anee kooro ŋɔ o nomoa bɛl be ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he berɛ kpɔ haah nɔ komɛlbwa, ne kwaa aa le o koo ta suuɡa bwa tɛo, dɛ le ɡɛ saŋ waa le bonɔ dɛ kaa bwa.” Elaesa ne Siiria Kooro Bɛn Hadad Korowii keame Elaesa la bwɛjen Damaskɔs dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ Siiria Kooro Bɛn Hadad bwara dɛ weo.
Kooro Bɛn Hadad aa noa kɛŋɔ o ba bela la, o ŋɔ Hasael waa ɛ o nomonome la bini bɛl be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ koŋkɛɛla, dɛ́ la Korowii keame la be, dɛ́ ɡel ó bɔɔ le Korowii be kɛŋɔ mɛɛ ir n weela nɔ taa yaa?” Ate, Hasael kpɔ kondɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi baa dɛ ɛa Damaskɔs choɡ nyoɡmare fifraanaarɛ dɛ ka kɛ Elaesa.
O laŋɔ dɛ ka che o sie dɛ ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔ Siiria Kooro Bɛn Hadad tom mɛ ŋɔ n bɔɔ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɡbaŋre o weela la taa yaa?” Elaesa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡbaŋroo te, kɛ kasinteŋ, Korowii pili a bini baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ sewɔɔ.” Asɛ Elaesa kpɔ sie pa Hasael nɛɛ dɛ nyiŋu jeiih ken, sihiih kpo Hasael.
Ate, buɡ la ta, Elaesa pa mun dɛɛ wi.
Anee Hasael ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ wi nɔɔ?” Elaesa ŋɔ, “N jemɛ wechɔɡa haa dɛ ba Israel tena ɛɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ fuh ba bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara laanee.
Dɛ́ kpoo ba bonɔɔna keri ne, dɛ́ tiɡri ba bechale nɛɛ do harɛ, dɛ́ ya ba tekpoŋra teene keri ne.” Anee Hasael bɔɔ ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔ, n ɡee ume maa wola toole wobɛlbwa bini kɛ nyoate, ásɛ n won ɛ ɡɛ wejena nɔ dɔŋa ɔ?” Elaesa chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii ɡelɔ n jemɛ kɛŋɔ, henee dɛ́ chiɡ Kooro Bɛn Hadad naa ta di kora Siiria harɛ ta.” Asɛ Hasael berɛ kaa Kooro Bɛn Hadad be, asɛ o pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa Elaesa bol he be nɔ?” Hasael chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ ɡbaŋroo.” Kɛ tɔ aa pera la, Hasael kpɔ yatɔɡ pweh ne, dɛ kpɔ tɔ Kooro Bɛn Hadad siebɔr asɛ o sewɛ.
Asɛ o chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora Siiria harɛ ta.
Juda Kooro Jehoram Kooro Ahab bibaa Joram aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene anue taa Jehosafat bibaa Jehoram ba di kora Juda harɛ ta.
Kooro Jehoram di bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ mɔɔ dɛ di kora, dɛ so Jerusalam di kora bene anuatoro.
O teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta.
Dɛ o mo Kooro Ahab bihaah, anomanta, o ɛ wechɔɡa Kooro Ahab ne o dem tena aa ɛa la dɔŋa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ Korowii koh o bonɔɔ Kooro Devid waa dɛ ŋɔ waa Juda harɛɛ chɔɡ.
Dɛ Korowii baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ Kooro Devid naanar la bini bɛlee dɛ́ di kora Jerusalam saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Kooro Jehoram aa di kora saŋee Edom tena vɛh o toma, dɛ ka chiɡ ba kooro.
Belaa Kooro Jehoram kpɔ o laa sitɔɔla ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, dɛ ka yo bwɛjen Sai tena.
Edom tena la bar o ne o laa sitɔɔla baa dɛ nyiŋi kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, kɛ o ne o laa tena iro dɛ ka yoo ba.
Kooro Jehoram ne o laa sitɔɔla iro jwaana, dɛ jo ba baah le dɛ chwa kaa, asɛ laa tena la ɡe chwa kaa ba deremi.
Ba le fini, Edom tena vɛh Juda kooro toma.
Gɛ saŋee bwɛjen Lebna tena ɡe vɛh o toma.
Kooro Jehoram bwara waa kabora ne waa waa ɛa bwa la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Jehoram baa sewɛ ka pu o naawa, asɛ ba ka huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
Asɛ o bibaa Ahasia chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Ahasia Ahab bibaa Joram aa di kora Israel harɛ bene fi dɛ anɛ ta la, a taa Jehoram bibaa Ahasia di kora Juda harɛ ta.
Kooro Ahasia di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ mɔɔ dɛ di kora.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora benanyoa beŋkpoŋ.
O nya sɔne Atalia, dɛ Kooro Omri o fa aa di kora Israel harɛ ta ka la naa.
Kooro Ahasia aa ɛ Kooro Ahab lole nomanta, o teŋɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta dɛ di kora la ta, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii nɛɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ Kooro Ahab dem tena aa ɛa la.
Kooro Ahasia ne Israel Kooro Joram pɛ nyoa ka yo Siiria Kooro Hasael Ramɔt Gelead.
Yoi la ta la, Siiria laa tena do Kooro Joram bol.
Anomanta, Kooro Joram laa berɛ ba bwɛjen Jesreel dɛ baa chah, asɛ Kooro Ahasia la bela dɛ ka nao o bol baa doo la wa.
Ba chiɡ Jehu Israel kora ta Awola bɛl, Korowii keame Elaesa yerɛ Korowii keamere bane baa pɛa dɛɛ valɛ la bɛl dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gbaa he batakaare kaa nyundua dɛ́ vɔwɛ kiriso, dɛ́ kpɔ noo nɔ aa lɔ loŋ nɔ bini nɔ la Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta.
He tel belaa, ɡaaɡe Jehosafat bibaa Jehu, o nabaa aa ɛ Nimsi bɔr.
La o be, dɛ́ yerɔ le o bala bini he ne o jo kaa dea bini, dɛ́ fuɡe noo la do o nyu ta dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘On Korowiirii fuɡe noo dɛɛ do he nyu ta, dɛɛ cheɡe kora Israel harɛ ta.’ ” Ásɛ he ya ɡbera, dɛ chwa le warane, dɛɛ berɛ cheɡa.
Ate, Korowii keame bechala la ir, dɛ la Ramɔt Gelead.
Waa tel bela la, o na laa nomonome baa pɛa so.
O yerɛ Jehu dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, n poori n dɔ kala bɛl dɛ bol he be.” Anee Jehu bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Ya bini umeo?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, n poori, henee.” Asɛ Jehu ir o ne o jo dea, Korowii keame la ka fuɡe noo la do o nyu ta dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Men Korowiirii fuɡe noo do he nyu ta, dɛɛ cheɡe kora ta n nɛra Israel tena nɛ.
A chɛ kɛ he kpo he dɔɔ Kooro Ahab luɡe nɛra, dɛ́ he ba kwaraa, ásɛ n bɔ Jɛsɛbɛl kem n keamere ne n bonɔɔna waa kpoo ba la wa.
Kooro Ahab dem nɛra ne o naanar bwa chɛ kɛ bá serewe.
Mɛɛ kpo baa te bɛlbwa waa le o demii le Israel harɛ ta.
Hale yoma kɛɛ nɛra baa dɛ di ba nyuune bwa.
Mɛɛ ɛ Ahab lolanaree kɛŋɔ Israel Kooro Jɛroboam, ne Ahija bibaa Kooro Baasa lolanar ken.
Kɛ Jɛsɛbɛl te, nyootenaa dɛɛ ba o ola dii bwɛjen Jesreel bwɛdaa ta.
Nomɛlbwa aa o huɡa ba.’ ” Ate, Korowii keame la laa ɡbera ya dɛ chwa kaa.
Jehu aa le buse dɛ la o nomondɔŋa la be la, asɛ bɛl pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa choɡla te la ba he be ba ɛɔ?
Wobɛlbwa maɡraa?” O chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He ɡbabir jemɔ, dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ bol wa.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Nyosone yaa jemɛ, bol ya be.” Ate Jehu ŋɔ, “Waa waa bol n be laanee nɔ, ‘Waa Korowii aa bol n be laanee kɛŋɔ, ń fuɡe noo do he nyu ta dɛ́ cheɡe kora Israel harɛ ta.’ ” Buɡ la ta, ba ir ɛ warane, dɛ wur ba batakaani, dɛ kpɔ pa kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh dɛ jo dea la, asɛ Jehu valɛ a ta.
Dɛ hoh bɛle dɛ moo ŋɔ, “Jehu di kora.” Israel Kooro Joram kpoe Anomanta, Jehosafat bibaa Kooro Jehu, o nabaa aa ɛ Nimsi la vɔrɔwe Kooro Joram vɔrɔwa dɛ ɛo dɔm.
Dɛ Kooro Joram ne Israel tena bwa fa lɔ Ramɔt Gelead, ba ne Siiria Kooro Hasael ne o laa tena ɛɛ yo.
Kɛ dɛ Kooro Joram te berɔ ba do bwɛjen Jesreel, dɛɛ chah bol o ne Siiria Kooro Hasael laa baa dɛ yo, asɛ Siiria tena doo bol la.
Belaa Kooro Jehu ŋɔ o bala la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ja n nɛɛ tenaa, he bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa le bwɛɛ nɔ ta, dɛ́ ka bol waa nɔ Jesreel tena be.” Ate, Kooro Jehu ka jo o torɔɡo bini dɛ kaa Jesreel.
Dɛ Kooro Joram ta chɔ bela dɛɛ chah, asɛ Juda Kooro Ahasia te la bela dɛɛ la ka nao.
Dɛ nomɛl waa dɛ daah Jesreel cheɡɛ dejaŋ doa dɛ na Kooro Jehu ne o laa tena aa dɛ ba, asɛ o do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N na laa tena bane aa dɛ ba.” Anee Kooro Joram ŋɔ, “Tomɛ nomɛl ó so jaaɡɔ ta dɛ́ ka bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, ‘A somaa?’ ” Ate, torome la kpɔ jaaɡɔ dɛ ka bɔɔ Kooro Jehu ŋɔ, “Kooro ŋɔ n bɔɔre ŋɔ a somaa?” Kooro Jehu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhna dɛ ɛɔ?
Ba kaa n habɔɔ ka che.” Nɛn waa cheɡɛ jɛŋla la doa dɛɛ daah bwɛɛ la ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “Torome la tel Kooro Jehu ne o nɛra la be, kɛ o berɔ ka ja ba nɛ, waa berɛ dɛɛ ba kpa.” Asɛ kooro la berɛ tomɛ torome bɛl ja o so jaaɡɔ ta, dɛ la ka bɔɔro waa la tenten.
Waa tel ba be la, o ŋɔ, “Kooro ŋɔ, ‘A somaa?’ ” Ate, Kooro Jehu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhna dɛ ɛɔ?
Ba kaa n habɔɔ ka che.” Ate, nɛn waa dɛ daah bwɛɛ la berɛ ŋɔ, “Torome la telo kɛ waa berɛ dɛɛ ba kpa.
Nɛn waa tɔ ba sie baa ba la le Nimsi naa Kooro Jehu.
O soɡe torɔɡo bini dɛɛ ba, dɛ le choɡla te.” Kooro Joram ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ torɔɡo maa vɔwa dɛɛ pɛl jaaɡɔ la vɔwɛ warane.” Baa tona la, asɛ Kooro Joram waa ɛ Israel harɛ kooro ne Juda Kooro Ahasia bɛlbwa kpɔ o torɔɡo, dɛ ka cheme Kooro Jehu.
Ba kaa chemo harɛ waa ɛ Jesreel te baa yerɔ Nabɔt koo ta.
Kooro Joram aa na Kooro Jehu la, o bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Kooro Jehu, a somaa?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ɛɛ ba wona do le nɔ?
He nya Jɛsɛbɛl ɡelɔ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ tomɛ voɡa dɛɛ ɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla.” Kooro Joram laa o jaaɡɔ sie berɛ, dɛ ŋɔ Ahasia be ŋɔ, “Gel yá le bonɔ warane, o dɛ neɡre yaa.” Ate, Kooro Jehu laa o to ne hɛm kpɔ dɛ ta yaɡɛ Kooro Joram nyaŋ o vah ba le o tom ta, asɛ o sewɛ chɔ o torɔɡo bini.
Kooro Jehu ŋɔ o bonɔɔ bɛl waa dɛ chao baa yerɔ Bidka be ŋɔ, “Laa Kooro Joram kpɔ ta Jesreel te Nabɔt koo nɔ ta.
Lii ɡɛ saŋ n ne he fa aa soɡe torɔɡo ta, dɛ teŋɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Ahab nɛɛ la, Korowii bol o waa nɔ bil.
‘N na Nabɔt ne o bii kpoe nɔ wa, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛ mɛɛ bɔɔ a kemee ɡɛ harɛ nɔ tenten ta.
Gɔɔro, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka ta koo nɔ ta ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.’ ” Juda Kooro Ahasia kpoe Juda harɛ Kooro Ahasia aa na ɡɛ la, o chwao kpɔ o torɔɡo la, dɛ lawɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Bɛt Haɡan ta.
Asɛ Kooro Jehu tiu dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre o laa tena la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpo o ɡe.” Ba do Kooro Ahasia bol ɡɛ saŋ waa cheɡɛ o torɔɡo la bini, asɛ jaɡre la tɛɡre torɔɡo la, dɛ chwa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa kaa bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Gur, waa bɛne Ibleam.
Kɛ o berɔ won teŋɛ chwa kaa bwɛjen Meɡido ta, dɛ ka sewɛ bela.
Asɛ o bonɔɔna kpɔɔ do torɔɡo la bini, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Jerusalam baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta, dɛ ka huɡo o naawa lalbɔɔ bini.
Kooro Ahab bibaa Joram aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ taa Kooro Ahasia di kora Juda harɛ ta.
Haŋkooro Jɛsɛbɛl kpoe Ate, Kooro Jehu la Jesreel.
Jɛsɛbɛl aa no o bala waa la, o do jeemina dɛ ɛ o nyumpona a do wer.
O laa dejaŋ waa soɡe o bini tokoro pili dɛɛ kpao.
Kooro Jehu aa baa tel bwɛɛ la doonyojen ta la, Jɛsɛbɛl ŋɔ, “He ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne naa?
Nɛŋkpoa te bɛl le!
Henee Simri waa kpo o dɔɔ la!” Asɛ Kooro Jehu ha sie dɛ nao tokoro ta dɛ ŋɔ, “Umee ja n nɛɔ?” Asɛ nomonome banɛ kɛɛ batoro baa lɔ koodem bela ba fɔɡɛ ba lure baa daah kooro haahna ba sie ne harɛ dɛɛ nyiŋu.
Anee Kooro Jehu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé lawɔ dɛ́ kpɔɔ viɡri harɛ.” Asɛ ba lawɛ Jɛsɛbɛl viɡri harɛ, o chal yaɡre danjwɛɛ ne jaɡre la, asɛ a tiɡru do harɛ.
Asɛ Kooro Jehu jo koodem bela, dɛ ka di kwaa dɛ nyɔ sen. Dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ka kpɔ haah baa taahno la dɛ́ ka kwaaro, o fa ɛ koobie, hé nyiŋi dɛ́ huɡo kɛrɛdɛ.” Baa laŋa ŋɔ ba ka kpɔɔ ka huɡe la, ba ta o bobɛlbwa nae ka ja o nyuhoɡ ne nakpahoɡa dɛ o nɔnhoɡa nɛ.
Ate, ba la dɛ ka ŋɔ Kooro Jehu be.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, “A ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Elaeja Tisbe te nɛɛ dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Jesreel harɛ taa nyootena ɛɛ ba Jɛsɛbɛl ola dii la ɛ kasinteŋ.
O hoɡa ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ bena aa chɔ puldoa ken do harɛ la ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola o jema ba.’ ”
Kooro Ahab naanar kpoora Dɛ Kooro Ahab dɔ bibaala fifraanuanɛ ba do bwɛjen Samaria.
Kooro Jehu chwerɛ tɔne, dɛ tomɛ nɛra ba kpɔ la Samaria ka tɛ Jesreel nomonnyuune baa lɔ bela, ne bela nomonome ne nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Kooro Ahab bii nɛ.
Tɔn la bini waa kɛŋɔ, “Kooro Ahab bii lɔ he be, asɛ he dɔ torɔɡore, ne jaɡre dɛ dɔmkwa, asɛ ba ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar he bwɛjen o do kpeɡri.
Dɛ tɔn nɔ tel he be naa, hé nyiŋi he dɔɔ bii la bini onɔ la waa maɡra o waa do wer, ásɛ he kpɔɔ so o mɛɛ buɡ ta ó di kora, ásɛ he che o mun ta dɛ́ yo dɛɛ tɛo.” Baa kure tɔn la, ba ɔmɔ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Kooro Joram ne Kooro Ahasia kwaraa ta wone che Kooro Jehu sie, ɛrɛɛ ya te ɛɛ ba wona ɔ?” Koodem bela nomoa, ne onɔ la waa dɛ nyiŋi bwɛjen la ta, ne nomonnyuune ne nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Kooro Ahab bii nɛɛ tomɔ ba ka ŋɔ Kooro Jehu be ŋɔ, “He bonɔɔnaa yan, wobɛlbwa haa bol ya be la, yaa ɛo.
