Yaa kooro bɛlbwa cheɡa ba, ɛ ɡɛ bwa aa maɡra tɛɛ.” Anee Kooro Jehu berɛ chwerɛ tɔn nɛɛte ja ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ja n nɛɛ dɛɛ no n waa tenaa, hé kpɔ Kooro Ahab bibaala nyuune ba tɛ mɛ Jesreel kere saŋ nɔ bɔr.” Dɛ Kooro Ahab bibaala fifraanuanɛ la lɔ bwɛjen Samaria nomonnyuune la be baa nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Tɔn la aa tel ba be la, ba lawɛ koobii fifraanuanɛ la, dɛ teŋni ba nyuune, dɛ pa do wɛɡrɛre bini, dɛ kpɔ la Jesreel ka tɛ Kooro Jehu.
Torome la aa bala la, o ŋɔ Kooro Jehu be kɛŋɔ, nɛra bane kpɔ kooro naanar nyuune la ba Jesreel.
Asɛ Kooro Jehu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá pa darawe dɔŋa nɛɛ bɔre anɛ bwɛjen la doonyojen bela, á chɔ ka tel kere chɔɔ.
Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Kooro Jehu le buse dɛ ba che bwɛɛ la tena bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ta bolchɔɡe dii, menee vɔrɔwe Kooro Joram vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo.
Aah umee kpoo banɔ bwa ɡeɔ?
Anɔ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Kooro Ahab dem nɛra waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Elaeja nɛɛ dɛ bol la bwa ɛ kpela.” Kooro Jehu kpoo Kooro Ahab dem nɛra baa kaa dɛ do Jesreel bwa, ne o nomonjena ne o daamanar dɛ voɡra bwa.
O ta o nomɛlbwa ɡelɛ.
Kooro Ahasia lolanar kpoora Awola bɛl, Kooro Jehu chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa Samaria, dɛ ka tel bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Bɛt Ɛkɛd, o munii kɛŋɔ Peteɡra Cheremibɔr.
Kooro Jehu cheme Juda Kooro Ahasia lolanar bini bane bela, asɛ dɛ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Heyaa bamewa ɔ?” Ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Kooro Ahasia lolanaree yan.
Ya dɛ la Jesreel ka chɔɔ haŋkooro Jɛsɛbɛl bii ne o lolanar bwa.” Ate, Kooro Jehu do o nɛra baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé laɡ ba dɛ bɛ ban kpoo!” Asɛ ba laɡ ba, dɛ ba lɔ nɛra fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
Ba kpoo ba bwa Bɛt Ɛkɛd bela bule bɛl bɔr, bɛlbwa ta kae.
Kooro Ahab lolanar kabora kpoora Kooro Jehu aa le bela ɡe dɛɛ kaa la, o cheme Rekab bibaa Jɛhɔnadab.
Asɛ Kooro Jehu jaamo dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N ne he liire bwa beŋkpoŋ, hɛɛ ja n nɛɛ kɛɛ?” Jɛhɔnadab chaŋe ŋɔ, “N sɛh ɡɛ.” Kooro Jehu ŋɔ, “Dɛ ɡɛɛ tenaa ɡwaa mɛ.” Asɛ ba ɡwa dɔŋa, Jehu chao dɛ lawɔ o teeh torɔɡo waa soɡe o bini la.
Kooro Jehu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya kaa ásɛ he ka na ɡɛ Korowii waa aa lɔ n bini kɛrɛdɛ.” Asɛ ba bwa che Kooro Jehu torɔɡo la bini, dɛ kaa bwɛjen Samaria.
Baa tel Samaria la, Kooro Jehu kpoo Kooro Ahab nɛra baa kaa dɛ do bela la bwa.
Beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Elaeja nɛɛ dɛ bol la.
Voɡ Baal toroma kpoora Ate, Kooro Jehu yerɛ Samaria tena bwa cheme dɛ ŋɔ, “Kooro Ahab tomɛ voɡ Baal tama, kɛ n te ɛɛ tomɔɔ kohona.
Hé yerɛ Baal voɡra ne o kerekpoŋra ne o keamere bwa ba.
He bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa ka, n dɔ sarahajen dɛɛ ba ɛɛ tɛ Baal.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola balɛ la aa o nyuu dɔ.” Kɛ dɛ neɡra ŋwɛnɛɛ Kooro Jehu ɛɛ kpɔ, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡ Baal bwa.
Kooro Jehu ŋɔ, “Hé bol dɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛ ya le tɔpere yaa cheme cheɡ dɛ́ tomɛ voɡ Baal.” Asɛ ba bol.
Ate, Kooro Jehu tomɛ nɛra Israel harɛ ta bwa, asɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡ Baal bwa la, bɛlbwa toole waa wola laŋɛ.
Ba bwa kaa su voɡ Baal dea, le doonyoa kaa bini bwa.
Ate, Kooro Jehu ŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi kon voɡ batakaani aa lɔ o bini be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ batakaani ba tɛ Baal toroma bwa.” Asɛ o ka pa batakaani la ba tɛɛ ba.
Kooro Jehu ne Rekab bibaa Jɛhɔnadab jo Baal dea bela.
Kooro Jehu ŋɔ voɡ Baal toroma la be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi he bini dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ Korowii toroma toole he bini, voɡ Baal toroma ɡboo he bwa.” Asɛ Baal toroma jo dea la bini dɛ ka ɛ sarahare ne saraha baa dɛ fuah tɛ voɡ Baal.
Dɛ Kooro Jehu le laa tena fifraanuatoro ba che buse dɛ bar dea la.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ hé kpoo nɛra nɔ bwa, he bini bɛlbwa waa ɡel bɛlbwa dɔ bɔr chwa la, wɛɛ kpɔ o nyuu charɛ o kon!” Kooro Jehu aa dena ka ɛ saraha baa fuah la tonɛ la, o baa do nɛra baa cheɡɛ buse dɛɛ daah ne nomonome la ŋɔ, “Hé la ka kpoo ba, he bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa dɔ bɔr chwa.” Anomanta, ba kaa kpoo ba keri ne, dɛ pa ba lala ta buse, dɛ jo voɡ Baal dea la bini kaa, dɛ kpɔ bwe baa pao ɛ voɡ dɛɛ tomɔ la le dea la bini dɛ fuuh.
Anomanta, ba paɡre voɡ Baal bwe la, dɛ kuuɡi o dea la dɛ kpɔ bela berɛ bembɔɔ dɛ ba le fini.
Gɛɛ Kooro Jehu chɔɡ voɡ Baal toma le Israel harɛ ta.
Kɛ dɛ o ta teŋɛ Kooro Jɛroboam wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ la ta, suuɡaswɛm baa kpɔa ɛ nabali a che bwɛɛre anɛ ane baa dɛ yera Bɛtel ne Dan la.
A habɔɔ Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Jehu be ŋɔ, “He ɛ ɡɛ maa ŋɔa he chɔɡ Kooro Ahab naanar bwa, anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo he naanar ɛ koranar ka tel naanar bele banaarɛ baa ka ba nɛ, dɛɛ di kora Israel harɛ ta.” Kɛ ane a bwa, Kooro Jehu ta Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la mmarare ta teŋɛ o bambile bwa ne, dɛ teŋɛ wechɔɡa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la ta.
Kooro Jehu seo A ɡɛ saŋ Korowii pa mun dɛ ɡel Israel harɛ mule, Siiria Kooro Hasael yoo ba, dɛ lɛ ba harɛ la bobɛla, le Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr harɛ dɛ kaa Arowa weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ kaa Aanɔn Moo ta, dɛ kpɔ Gelead harɛ bwa ne Basan, bela Gad ne Rubin deene, dɛ Manasɛ wee leebɔr dea tena aa soɡa bwa.
Kooro Jehu bwara waa kar ne anɔ la waa wona ɛ bwa, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Jehu sewɔ ba huɡo Samaria, asɛ o bibaa Jehoahas chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Kooro Jehu soɡe Samaria dɛ di Israel harɛ ta kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuatoro.
Juda haŋkooro Atalia Kooro Ahasia nya baa dɛ yerɔ Atalia aa naa kɛ o bibaa Kooro Ahasia sewɔ la, o ŋɔ bá kpoo koobii baa ba di kora la bwa.
Kɛ Jehoseba waa ɛ Kooro Jehoram bihaah, dɛ berɛ ɛ Ahasia nimambie, lawɛ Ahasia bibaa Joas la le koodem bela.
Dɛ ba fe dɛ nyin bá kpo o ne o bala.
Anomanta, o nyaana la lawɛ o ne naate waa dɛ nyiŋi o nɛɛ la ka sɔh Korowii Dea, bobɛl baa dɛ chɔ o bini le Atalia nɔn ta, asɛ ba ta on kpoe.
Jehoseba kpɔ Joas sɔh Korowii Dea bela bene anumɛl, ɡɛ saŋ haŋkooro Atalia aa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta la.
Joas lawa ka sɔh bene anuanɛ habɔɔ la, sɔfo Jehoiada ɡelɔ ba yerɛ laa sitɔɔla baa dɛ nyiŋi laa tena baa dɛ daah kooro, ne laa tena baa dɛ daah koodem.
Asɛ o ɡel ba ba bane o be Korowii Dea, o ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo ba ŋwɛɛ ntam Korowii Dea bela.
O kpɔ Kooro Ahasia bibaa Joas baɡ ba.
O do ba ŋɔ, “Gɛ maa dɛ nyin kɛ he ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, he balɔ dɛɛ ba ba daah Korowii Dea Ona Tɔpere aa, he bini bele batoro ba daah koodem, bele batoro ɡe ka so doonyoa baa dɛ yerɔ Sur la nyoa, ásɛ bele batoro ɡe ɛɛ daah doonyoa waa lɔ koodem doonyoa habɔɔ la.
Nɛmbele banɛ baa wola la ka daah Ona Tɔpere la bwa ka so Korowii Dea dɛɛ daah kooro.
Hé kpɔ he dɔmkwaa kpoŋe dɛ́ che bar kooro, dɛ́ so o jwɛh bobɛlbwa waa kaa.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa ba dɛ kaa kooro jwɛh aa, hé kpoo.” Laa sitɔɔla la ɛ ɡɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa do ba la bwa.
Ba bini bɛlbwa kpɔ o nɛra baa dɛ ba toma ta Ona Tɔpere ta, ne banɔ la baa wola toma ta ba Ona Tɔpere ta la bwa ba sɔfo Jehoiada be.
Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ lampeare ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta, a ɛ Kooro Devid kwaa ba kpɔ cheɡ Korowii Dea la tɛ laa sitɔɔla la.
Ate, o ɡel nɛra baa dɛ daah la bɛlbwa kpoŋe o dɔmkon ba che Korowii Dea, ne saraha kon la sie, dɛ bar Kooro Joas.
Name sɔfo Jehoiada ka lawɛ Joas le buse, dɛ kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ piu, dɛ kpɔ fɔo baa fɔwa dɛ che o ta dɛɛ di kora harɛ la ta do o nɔn ta.
Dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta dɛ cheɡo kora ta, asɛ ba lɔ kpaŋa dɛ moo ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ kooro mkpajaŋ!” Haŋkooro Atalia aa no moola nɛra baa dɛ daah ne nɛra baa lɔ bela aa dɛ moo la, o ɛ warane la ba be Korowii Dea bela.
O baa na kɛŋɔ kooro la cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la sie pila bɛl jwɛh ɡɛ ba nawee wa aa doa.
Asɛ laa sitɔɔla ne bɛlhoohla che kooro jwɛh.
Asɛ harɛ la ta nomɛlbwa sie lɛ, baa hoh bɛle.
Belaa haŋkooro Atalia laa o batakaare kɛɛ a baɡle kɛ o baah diu kohona, dɛ ŋɔ, “He bwa lee mɛ tɛ!
He ɛɛ mɛ dɔm!” Dɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa nyin kɛ bá kpo Atalia Korowii Dea bɔr bela, anomanta, o do laa sitɔɔla la ŋɔ, “Hé lawɔ le laa tena nɔ baah ta, dɛ́ kpo nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛ ó ba lɛo.” Ate, ba tɛɡro le, dɛ kpoo Jaɡre Doonyoa, bela jaɡre aa cheɡa dɛɛ jo koodem la ta.
Jehoiada mmara waa chara Sɔfo Jehoiada ne Kooro Joas fɔwɛ fɔo, o chɔ Korowii ne kooro ne harɛ la ta nɛra baah ta, kɛŋɔ nɛra la ɛ Korowii nɛra.
Sɔfo Jehoiada bɔɔ Kooro Joas ne o nɛra ŋɔ bá baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ ba wa ɛɛ dɔ kasinteŋii tɛ dɔŋa ne Korowii.
Harɛ la ta nɛra bwa la voɡ Baal dea, dɛ ka paɡre kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo, ne voɡare aa lɔ dea la bini bwa kwaraa.
Dɛ lawɛ o kerekpoŋri baa dɛ yerɔ Matan, dɛ kpoo kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la sie.
Asɛ sɔfo Jehoiada ɡel nɛra baa dɛ daah la ka che dɛɛ daah Korowii Dea la.
Sɔfo Jehoiada ɡelɔ laa sitɔɔla baa dɛ nyiŋi laa tena baa dɛ daah kooro, ne laa tena baa dɛ daah koodem, ne harɛ la ta nɛra bwa kpɔ kooro la le Korowii Dea bela, dɛ kpɔɔ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah la aa dɛ kpɔ o ta, dɛ ba o ne koodem o ba so kookara ta.
Asɛ harɛ la ta nɛra bwa sie lɛ, bwɛjen la sɔɔh, kpoe baa kpo haŋkooro Atalia koodem la wa.
Kooro Joas aa di kora Juda harɛ dɛ o dɔ bene anuanɛ.
Juda Kooro Joas Kooro Jehu aa di kora Israel harɛ bene anuanɛ taa Kooro Joas di kora Juda harɛ ta.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanaarɛ.
O nya sɔne Sebea, dɛ le bwɛjen Beɛseeba.
Kooro Joas ɛ waa aa dɛ too Korowii tea, dɛkalkɛ sɔfo Jehoiada baɡlo wa.
Kɛ Kooro Joas ta ɡelɛ ba chɔɡ bɔra voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ ba voɡa, asɛ ba ta teŋɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma bela.
Awola bɛl, Kooro Joas ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “Hé lɛ suuɡare baa dɛ ba a ne baa ɛ sarahare Korowii Dea la bwa.
Anɔ la baa dɛ ba a ne tɔpere bɛlbwa, ne deŋnesɔɔhna kwaa ne an la aa le bambile bini ba kpɔ dɛɛ ba bwa.
Sɔ́fo bɛlbwa lɛ suuɡare la le nɛra baa dɛ cheɡ suuɡare la be, dɛ́ ɡel bá kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la bela waa chɔɡa bwa.” Kɛ Kooro Joas aa di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro la, dɛ sɔfore la ta Korowii Dea la bobɛlbwa kwaarɛ mɔɔ.
Anomanta, o yerɛ sɔfo Jehoiada ne sɔfore baa jaa la dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ haa wola Korowii Dea la kwaa nɔɔ?
Le fini dɛɛ kaa, he bɛ suuɡare dɛɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ cheɡ suuɡa la be kpa, he ba a ne bá kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la.” Asɛ sɔfore la sɛh kɛŋɔ baa suuɡaa lɛ le nɛra la be, ba ɡbaɡba ɡe aa Korowii Dea laanee kwaa.
Asɛ sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ daka bɛl dɛ forɛ o tɔ bɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ ka cheɡ kon baa kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la jwɛh, doonyoa baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ jo Korowii Dea la diɡ bɔr.
Sɔfore baa dɛ daah ɡɛ doonyoa la, yon kpɔ suuɡare nɛra aa dɛ ba a ne Korowii Dea bela la bwa do o bini.
Ba nao kɛŋɔ suuɡa warɛ o bini naa, koodem karake ne Sɔfonomoa yon ba kure dɛ́ pa do pure bini.
Ba kuro dɛ jemɛ a nyoa aa, ba yon kpɔ do nɛra baa lee ba baa nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea toma la nɔn ta.
Ba yon kpɔ a ne bɔ kapenta tena ne mamaala baa dɛ kwaa Korowii Dea la, ne nɛra baa dɛ peɡri bwea, ne anɔ la baa kpɔ yawɛ daa, ne bwea baa sɛah dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la, dɛ ane bɛlbwa ɡe aa jaa.
Ba ta suuɡa la bɛlbwa kpɔe bɔ suuɡapoŋ loɡa, ne loɡa baa do chal kɛɛ nee a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ kwaa ta, ne bune baa kpɔa dɛɛ menɛ kandere ŋwɛɛra ne bɛle, kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm komɛlbwa, kɛɛ suuɡapoŋ dɛ cheɡ Korowii Dea bela.
Ba kpɔ suuɡa la bwa tɛ tom-ɛɛra la, bá kpɔ yawɛ kwaa báa kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la ɡbo.
Nɛra baa kpɔ suuɡa la tɛ baa ɛ toma la ta soɡe ba ne tom-ɛɛra la bu nkontaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba ɛ toma la kɛrɛdɛ ba waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
Bolchɔɡe dii saraha ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha suuɡa te, baa a te kpɔe baa do daka la bini, a te ɛ sɔfore la kwa.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Siiria Kooro Hasael ne o laa tena laŋɔ ka yo bwɛjen Gat tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Jerusalam dɛ́ fe ba yo ba ɡe.
Asɛ Kooro Joas kpɔ kondɛɛɡa aa do ɡoroŋ o ne o naawa koranar Jehosafat, ne Jehoram dɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Ahasia aa kpɔa do Korowii nɔn ta, dɛ kpɔ o kwaa ja dɛ suuɡaswɛm aa lɔ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini Korowii Dea ne koodem bwa, ka kɛ Kooro Hasael, asɛ o ɡel Jerusalam tena ba yoi.
Wobɛlbwa Kooro Joas aa ɛa ɡɛ saŋ waa dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
O nomonome vɔrɔwe o vɔrɔwa dɛ ɛo dɔm, dɛ kpoo Bɛt Milo, o chɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sila.
O nomonome baa kpoo ba la bɛl sɔne Josabad, o mɛɛ sɔne Simiat, dɛ Jehosabad, o ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Soma.
Kooro Joas aa sewa la, ba huɡo o naawa lalbɔɔ bini Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, asɛ o bibaa Amasea ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Israel Kooro Jehoahas Kooro Ahasia bibaa Joas aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro taa Kooro Jehu bibaa Kooro Jehoahas di kora Israel harɛ ta.
Dɛ bwɛjen Samariaa o so, dɛ di kora bene fi dɛ anuanɛ.
Kooro Jehoahas teŋɛ waa Kooro Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena che a ta ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ la ta, o ta an ɡelɛ.
Anomanta, Korowii baah di Israel tena nɛɛ taeh, asɛ o kpɔ ba do Siiria Kooro Hasael, ne o bibaa Bɛn Hadad lɔɡa biɡri.
Kooro Jehoahas soŋe Korowii a wa, asɛ o no.
Dɛ Korowii na fiiɡa Siiria kooro aa dɛ fiiɡi Israel tena kohona.
Korowii le nɛn tɛ Israel tena, asɛ o lɛɛ ba le Siiria tena lɔɡa, ba berɛ so deŋnesɔɔhna ta ɡɛ ba fa aa soɡa wubwa la.
Kɛ ba ta wechɔɡa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɡela Israel tena ɛ dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ la ta leɛ, dɛ ta teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛa.
Ba ta voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa baa paaɡa Samaria la chɔɡɛ.
Siiria Kooro Hasael ne o laa tena pɔ Israel tena nɛ, dɛ ɡel Kooro Jehoahas laa tena mule.
O laa tena baa kaa laanee, nɛra baa jemɛ jaɡre ta soɡa fifraanue, ne torɔɡore fi, dɛ laa tena baa dɛ valɛ harɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa fi.
Siiria laa tena kpoo ba kabora, dɛ tiɡri ba do harɛ kɛŋɔ pɛla ta teera ken.
Wobɛlbwa ɡe Kooro Jehoahas aa ɛa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Jehoahas baa sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo bela baa huɡe o naawa bwɛjen Samaria.
Asɛ o bibaa Jehoas chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Israel Kooro Jehoas Kooro Joas aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ taa Kooro Jehoahas bibaa Kooro Jehoas di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O soɡe Samaria di kora bene fi dɛ anumɛl.
Kooro Jehoas ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛ teŋɛ wechɔɡa Kooro Jɛroboam waa ɛ Nɛbat bibaa waa waa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la ta.
Wobɛlbwa Kooro Jehoas aa ɛa ne laa o ne Juda Kooro Amasea aa yoa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Jehoas sewɔ dɛ ka chɔ o naawa Israel koranar hoɡa ta Samaria.
Asɛ o bibaa Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Elaesa seo wa Korowii keame Elaesa bwara weo, a taa o che dɛ sewɛ.
Asɛ Israel Kooro Jehoas la dɛ ka nao dɛ wi baɡlo dɛ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ!
N dɔɔ!
Nɛn waa cheɡɛ Israel tena habɔɔ!” Anee Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ, “Ka kpɔ to ne hɛma ba.” Asɛ kooro la ka kpɔ ba tɛo.
Asɛ Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ Israel kooro la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ to la kpoŋe.” Asɛ o kpɔ kpoŋe, asɛ Elaesa kpɔ o nɔɔra dawɛ o nɔɔra ta.
Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ kooro la be ŋɔ, “Laa wee leebɔr tokoro nɔ pili.” Asɛ o laa pili.
Elaesa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ta hɛm la.” Asɛ kooro la ta hɛm la ta.
Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ, “Henee cheɡa tɛ Korowii hɛm waa che o ta dɛ́ ɡel he pɔ Siiria tena nɛ.
Hɛɛ yoo ba bwɛjen Afɛk waa lɔ Siiria harɛ taa, ka tel kɛŋɔ haa pɔ ba nɛ kwaraa ken.” Asɛ Korowii keame Elaesa ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ hɛma aa kaa la lɔ harɛ.” Asɛ kooro la kpɔ hɛma la lɔ harɛ kera atoro dɛ ɡel.
Korowii keame Elaesa baah di kooro la nɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛŋɔ he fee kpɔ lɔ harɛ kera anue kɛɛ kera anumɛl, dɛ́ fee won pɔ Siiria tena nɛɛ kwaraa dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, kɛ kera atoro ɡboo hɛɛ ba wona pɔ ba nɛ.” Korowii keame Elaesa baa sewɛ asɛ ba huɡo.
Dɛ benanyoa bɛlbwa, Moab tena yon lɔ ba tɔ Israel tena nɛɛ dɛ́ kah ba kwa, dɛ́ berɛ kaa warane.
Awola bɛl, dɛ Israel tena dɛ huɡe nomɛl, asɛ dɛ na Moab nɛnlaa bane baa dɛ ba ba kah ba kwa.
Anee Israel tena la kpɔ chɔɔ la ta bwebɔɔ baa huɡe Elaesa o bini la, dɛ chwa kaa.
Chɔɔ la aa dena ka leɡe Elaesa hoɡa la, o berɔ dɔ mkpa dɛ ir che o naa ta.
Israel ne Siiria tena laa yoi Siiria Kooro Hasael fiiɡi Israel tena, ɡɛ saŋ bwa Kooro Jehoahas fa aa di kora Israel harɛ ta la, kɛ Korowii dɔ tedoma ba nɛ dɛ na ba sum, fɔo o ne ba naawa Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb aa fɔwa la wa.
Ba le fini, waa nyin kɛŋɔ ó chɔɡ ba, kɛɛ dɛ́ doŋ ba le o sie.
Siiria Kooro Hasael baa sewɛ, asɛ o bibaa Bɛn Hadad chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Asɛ Israel Kooro Jehoas waa ɛ Kooro Jehoahas bibaa la, berɛ ba lɛ Israel harɛ ta bwɛjena Kooro Bɛn Hadad be.
Dɛ ɡɛ saŋ o mɛɛ Jehoahas aa di kora laanee ba lɛ Israel bwɛjena la.
Kera atoro bwaa Kooro Jehoas ne o laa tena ka yo Siiria tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Juda Kooro Amasea Kooro Jehoahas bibaa Jehoas aa di kora Israel harɛ bennɛɛte taa Kooro Joas bibaa Amasea di kora Juda harɛ ta.
O di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue mɔɔ, dɛ di kora.
O di kora Jerusalam bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ.
O nya sɔne Jehoadin dɛ le Jerusalam.
Kooro Amasea ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, kɛ dɛ a ta o nabaa Kooro Devid kwaa tele.
Wobɛlbwa ta la, dɛ o dɛ teŋɛ waa o mɛɛ Kooro Joas aa ɛa ta.
O ta ɡelɛ ba chɔɡ bɔra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la, asɛ ba ta kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛɛ fuh daawiile bela.
Kooro Amasea kora aa baa che kiŋkiŋ name la, o kpoo nomonome baa kpo o mɛɛ o fa aa di kora la.
Kɛ o ta ɡɛ nomonome la bii kpoorɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa chwera Mosis Mmara la ta kɛŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kɛɛ nya ɛ wechɔɡa aa, haa won kpɔ kpo o bie, bii ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa aa, haa won kpɔ kpo mɛɛ kɛɛ nya.
Nɛn o ɡbabir aa ɛ wechɔɡa laanee chɛ kɛ ó sewɛ o wechɔɡa wa.” Kooro Amasea ne o laa tena kpoo Edom laa tena kaɡboŋa fi Yar Fɛlembɔjen ta.
Dɛ berɛ yo lɛ bwɛjen Sela, dɛ kwaa pa o sɔn Jokteel, ba ta dɛ yerɔ ɡɛ ba le fini.
Awola bɛl, Kooro Amasea tomɛ toroma Israel Kooro Jehoas be dɛ ŋɔ, “Ba chem mɛ ásɛ ya yo laa.” Anee Juda Kooro Amasea tomɛ toroma Israel Kooro Jehoas be, dɛ sɛɡlo ŋɔ, “Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta jabalnadaŋɛ bɛlee fa ira, dɛ ka ŋɔ bela dajen bɛl be ŋɔ, ‘Kpɔ he bihaah tɛ mɛ ń tɛ n bie ó mo.’ Asɛ kpɔɡ bini ol bɛl ɡe ir, dɛ ba tiɡri jabalnadaŋɛ la ta dɛ laa kuuɡi.
Na, he fa yo Edom tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, he nyu bini do he som, ɡel a maɡre he ne dɛ́ so he dem.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin waa ba dawɛ ya nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ he kora ne Juda tena nɔɔ?” Kooro Amasea ta a mun noɛ, anomanta, Israel Kooro Jehoas kpɔ laa tena ba ne Kooro Amasea ne o laa tena ka cheme Bɛt Sɛmɛs waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ yo.
Israel laa tena pɔ Juda laa tena nɛ, asɛ ba chwa peɡre kaa ba bwɛɛre.
Israel Kooro Jehoas lawɛ Juda Kooro Amasea, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ka kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa baro la.
Ba kuuɡu le Efrem Doonyoa ka tel bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Loŋkora Doonyoa.
O jaŋne ɛɛ ɛ naɡale lafraanumɛlee.
Kooro Jɛhoas pa suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne kwaa aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne koodem bela laala a yoɡ aa do kpeɡri kaa Samaria.
O lawɛ nɛra ɡe ja kaa.
Waa Kooro Jehoas aa ɛa ja, ne laa o ne Juda Kooro Amasea a yoa la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Jehoas baa sewɛ, ba ka huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta Samaria, bela baa dɛ huɡe Israel koranar.
Asɛ o bibaa Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ, ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Amasea seo Juda Kooro Joas bibaa Kooro Amasea di bene fi dɛ anue, Israel Kooro Jehoahas bibaa Kooro Jehoas seo habɔɔ.
Waa aa bera chiɡ Juda Kooro Amasea kora dii ta la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Dɛ ba dɛ vɔrɔwe Kooro Amasea kpoe vɔrɔwa Jerusalam, anomanta, o chwao kaa bwɛjen Lakes ta, asɛ ba tomɛ nɛra ba teŋɛ dɛ ka kpoo bela.
Ba kpɔ o chɔɔ dawɛ jaaɡɔ ta ba Jerusalam, asɛ ba huɡo bela baa huɡe o naawa Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta.
Ate, Juda tena bwa lawɛ Kooro Amasea bibaa Ussia, o chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta dɛ di kora, dɛ o di bene fi dɛ anumɛl.
Onee yoa dɛ berɛ lɛ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Elat tɛ Juda tena dɛ kwaa vɔrɔwo, o mɛɛ Kooro Amasea seo habɔɔ.
Israel Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ Kooro Amasea aa di kora Juda harɛ bene fi dɛ anue taa Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ ba di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O soɡe Samaria di kora bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
Wechɔɡa Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa a che a ta Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la, o ta an ɡelɛ.
Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ yoo lɛ Israel harɛ o jwɛhre aa lɔ Hamat waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ kaa Yar Mpo waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la che o keame Jona nɛɛ dɛ bol.
Jona le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Gat Hɛfa, o mɛɛ sɔne Amitai.
Dɛ Korowii na wahala kohona Israel tena aa lɔ a ta, deheɛre ne yoma bwa, nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ lɛɛ ba.
Korowii aa wola ŋɔe ŋɔ, wɛɛ ɡeloo Israel nɛra tonɛ kwaara le harɛ la ta la, o cheɡɛ Kooro Jehoas bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ la nɛ, dɛ lɛɛ ba.
Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ bwara waa aa kaa, ne anɔ la waa ɛa, laa waa yoa, ne ɡɛ waa lɛ bwɛjena Damaskɔs ne Hamat aa lɔ Juda harɛ ta tɛ Israel tena la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ sewɔ ka pu o naawa Israel koranar, asɛ o bibaa Sekaria chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Ussia Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ taa Kooro Amasea bibaa Ussia di kora Juda harɛ ta.
Waa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fi dɛ anumɛl.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanue dɛ anɛ.
O nya sɔne Jekolia dɛ le Jerusalam.
Kooro Ussia ɛ waa a too Korowii tea ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Amasea fa aa ɛa la.
O ta bɔra voɡtoroma aa dɛ ɛ sarahare la chɔɡɛ.
Dɛ nɛra la teŋɔ kpo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma bela.
Korowii kpɔ wee ta Kooro Ussia nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa sewɛ.
O ta koodem soɡee kpa, asɛ o bibaa Jotam so koodem bela, dɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ la ta.
Waane aa chiɡ Kooro Ussia kora dii ta, ne anɔ la bwa waa ɛa la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Ussia baa sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo Jerusalam, bela baa huɡe o naawa, Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
O bibaa Jotam chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Israel Kooro Sekaria Juda Kooro Ussia di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.
A taa Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ bibaa Sekaria di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O soɡe Samaria di kora korobie anumɛl.
Kooro Sekaria ɛ wechɔɡa ɡɛ o naawa fa aa ɛa la, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
Wechɔɡa Kooro Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la, o ta an ɡelɛ.
Asɛ Jabes bibaa Salum vɔrɔwe o vɔrɔwa, dɛ kpoo nɛra o siwi ta Ibleam, dɛ kpɔ kora la di.
Waa ane ɡe Kooro Sekaria aa ɛa o kora dii ta la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Anee Korowii baɡɛ Kooro Jehu nyoa dɛ teŋɛ a ta la.
Korowii ŋɔ, “He naanar ɛɛ ɛ koranaree ka tel naanar bele banaarɛ baa ka ba nɛ, dɛɛ di kora Israel harɛ ta.” Israel Kooro Salum Kooro Ussia aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanaarɛ taa Jabes bibaa Salum di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O soɡe Samaria di kora korobie.
Dɛ Gadi bibaa Kooro Mɛnahem le Tirsa, dɛ la Samaria dɛ ka kpo Jabes bibaa Kooro Salum, dɛ chiɡ o naa ta di kora.
Kooro Salum waane ɡe waa ɛa ɡɛ saŋ waa di kora la, ne vɔrɔwa waa tɔ a sie la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Kooro Mɛnahem iro le Tirsa, dɛ la bwɛjen Tifsa, o ne o laa tena ka kpoo nɛra baa lɔ o ta, dɛ bwɛɛre aa baro tena.
Dɛkalkɛ ba ta ba te kpɔe ba do o lɔɡa.
O doŋi Tifsa tena, dɛ ya tekpoŋra teene.
Israel Kooro Mɛnahem Kooro Ussia aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanaarɛ taa Gadi bibaa Kooro Mɛnahem di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O soɡe Samaria di kora bene fi.
Kooro Mɛnahem ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ o kora dii ta bwa, ka tel o serewe wee.
Wechɔɡa Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la, Kooro Mɛnahem ɡe ta an ɡelɛ.
Asiiria harɛ ta Koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa la Israel harɛ ta ka yoo ba, asɛ Kooro Mɛnahem tɛo suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kaɡboŋa lafraatoro fifraanaarɛ ŋɔ ó chao, ásɛ o kora la do kpeɡri.
Kooro Mɛnahem lɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanue le baa bɛlbwa o nɔn bini aa wera be, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Asiiria koojen la, asɛ o le Israel harɛ ta dɛ kaa.
Waa ane ɡe Kooro Mɛnahem aa ɛa ɡɛ saŋ waa dɛ di kora la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Mɛnahem baa sewɛ, ba ka huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta, asɛ o bibaa Pɛkahea chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Israel Kooro Pɛkahea Juda Kooro Ussia di kora bene fifraanue.
A taa Kooro Mɛnahem bibaa Pɛkahea di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O soɡe Samaria di kora bene anɛ.
O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
O ta wechɔɡa Kooro Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la ta leɛ.
Anee Remalia bibaa Pɛka waa ɛ Kooro Pɛkahea laa nomoa vɔrɔwe Kooro Pɛkahea vɔrɔwa, dɛ kpɔ Gelead tena fifraanue ja o nɛ.
Ba kaa kpo Kooro Pɛkahea ne baala bane baa dɛ yer ba Aaɡob ne Arie, koodem bela waa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro bwɛjen Samaria.
Asɛ dɛ chiɡ o naa ta di kora.
Wobɛlbwa ɡe Kooro Pɛkahea aa ɛa o kora dii ta ne anɔ la waa ɛa bwa, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Israel Kooro Pɛka Kooro Ussia aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fifraanue dɛ anɛ taa Remalia bibaa Kooro Pɛka di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O soɡe Samaria di kora bene fifraanɛ.
Kooro Pɛka ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
Wechɔɡa Kooro Nɛbat bibaa Jɛroboam aa ɛa, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa la, o ta an ɡelɛ.
Kooro Pɛka aa di kora Israel harɛ ta la taa Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa kpɔ o laa tena ba yo, dɛ lɛ bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Ijon ne Ebel Bɛt Maaka, ne Janoa ne Kedes dɛ Hasɔ.
O berɔ ka lɛ Gelead ne Galilia harɛre, dɛ kpɔ Naftale dea harɛ bwa ja, dɛ larawe Israel tena baa lɔ bela kaa Asiiria harɛ ta.
Ussia bibaa Kooro Jotam aa di kora Juda harɛ bene fifraanɛ taa Ɛla bibaa Hosia vɔrɔwe Remalia bibaa Kooro Pɛka vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo.
O chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di Israel harɛ ta kora.
Waa Kooro Pɛka aa ɛa o kora dii ta la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Juda Kooro Jotam Remalia bibaa Kooro Pɛka aa di kora Israel harɛ ta la, bennɛɛte taa Kooro Ussia bibaa Jotam di kora Juda harɛ ta.
Kooro Jotam aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ anumɛl.
O nya sɔne Jerusa, asɛ o nya ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Sadɔk.
Kooro Jotam ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, dɛ teŋɛ waa o mɛɛ Kooro Ussia aa ɛa la ta.
O ta voɡa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ fuh daawiile a ta la chɔɡɛ.
Nɛra teŋɔ kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare dɛɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma a ta.
Kooro Jotam berɔ kwaa ma Korowii Dea doonyoa baa dɛ yerɔ Weekaŋle Nyundua Doonyoa la.
Waa aa chiɡ Kooro Jotam kora dii ta ne waa waa ɛa, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Jotam kora dii saŋ taa Korowii ɡel Siiria Kooro Resin, ne Remalia bibaa Israel Kooro Pɛka pa mun ka yo Juda tena.
Kooro Jotam aa baa sewɛ la, ba huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen bela baa huɡe o naawa.
Asɛ o bibaa Ahas chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Ahas Remalia bibaa Kooro Pɛka aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anuanɛ la, a taa Juda Kooro Jotam bibaa Kooro Ahas di kora Juda harɛ ta.
Kooro Ahas di bene fifraanɛ mɔɔ dɛ di kora.
O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora bene fi dɛ anumɛl.
Dɛ o ta doe kɛŋɔ o nabaa Kooro Devid.
O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ nɛ, dɛ teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta.
Hale o kpo o bibaa dɛ fuuh ɛ saraha.
Dɛ ɡɛ waa la ɛ voɡtoroma harɛre nɛra Korowii aa doŋ ba tɛ Israel tena, ba tɔ sie ba so o ta la nawee wa.
Dɛ Korowii kia.
Kooro Ahas kpoo kwaa dɛ ɛ saraha, dɛ fuh daawiile tɛ voɡare bela voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ, ne deŋɡarere dor, dɛ dajen bɛlbwa mun.
Asɛ Siiria Kooro Resin ne Israel Kooro Pɛka kpɔ laa tena dɛ ba yo Jerusalam tena dɛ tɔ Kooro Ahas do, kɛ ba ta wone pɔ o nɛ.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Siiria Kooro Resin berɔ ba lɛ bwɛjen Elat, dɛ doŋi Juda tena le o ta.
Asɛ Edom tena ba so bela, ba soɡe bela ba le fini.
Ate, Kooro Ahas tomɛ nɛra Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa be kɛŋɔ, “N ɛ he bonɔɔ tenten, ba lɛɛ mɛ, Siiria kooro ne Israel kooro dɛ yoo mɛ.” Anee Juda Kooro Ahas kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini koodem la, dɛ tomɛ ba kpɔ ka kɛ Asiiria koojen la.
Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa aa sɛh waa la ta la, o kpɔ o laa tena ba Siiria dɛ ba yo bwɛjen Damaskɔs tena.
Dɛ larawe bela tena ka so bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kir, dɛ kpo Kooro Resin.
Asɛ Kooro Ahas la Damaskɔs, dɛ ka pu Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa.
Waa la bela la, o na kon baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta bela, dɛ nyiŋi o mar, dɛ ma o dɔŋ dɛ tomɛ torome o kpɔ ka baɡle sɔfo Uria.
Asɛ sɔfo Uria ɡel ba ma kon baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta la dɔŋ.
O mao tonɛ mɔɔ Kooro Ahas le Damaskɔs dɛ la.
Kooro Ahas aa le Damaskɔs kaa la, o kaa na kon la, asɛ dɛ ka ɛ saraha o ta.
O ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah ne mea saraha, dɛ fuɡe sen saraha ta o ta, dɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha waa ɛa la chal merɛ saraha kon la ta.
Dɛ ɛ ayaawa kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta, dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta, o che saraha konfale la ne Korowii Dea la baah ta.
Anomanta, Kooro Ahas kaa kpɔ ombene la ka cheɡ onfale la weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Anee Kooro Ahas ŋɔ sɔfo Uria be ŋɔ, “Chɔɔbɔr sarahare baa fuah ne mea sarahare baa ɛa jɔmɔra, ne kooro sarahare waa fuah ne mea sarahare ne harɛ la nɛra bwa sarahare baa fuah, ne mea sarahare dɛ sen sarahare bwa la, ɛa saraha konjen onfale la ta.
Kpɔ kwaa baa kpoora fuh ɛ saraha la chal merɛ saraha kon la ta.
Kɛ saraha kon baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo, dɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta la te, ó ɛ n ɡbo kon ń kpɔ dɛɛ voɡɛ.” Asɛ sɔfo Uria ɛ ɡɛ Kooro Ahas aa doo ŋɔ ó ɛ la.
Ate, Kooro Ahas laa kwaa aa maɡre ayaawa saraha kon la keŋkeŋni la, ne loɡa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo nakpale la laa kpɔ a chebɔra.
Dɛ berɛ laa ayaawa loɡbajen baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo o chɔŋɛ nabali fi dɛ anɛ baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa la ta, dɛ kpɔ chɔŋɛ bwe ta.
Asiiria koojen nomanta, Kooro Ahas laa Korowii Dea baa dɛ tomɔ o bini Ona Tɔpere la kpɔ.
Dɛ tɔ doonyoa Juda harɛ koranar aa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ jo Korowii Dea la.
Wobɛlbwa Kooro Ahas aa ɛa la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Ahas sewɔ, asɛ ba ka huɡo Jerusalam o naawa huɡribɔr, Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
Asɛ o bibaa Hɛsɛkea chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Israel Kooro Hosia Juda Kooro Ahas aa di kora bene fi dɛ anɛ ta la, a taa Ɛla bibaa Kooro Hosia di kora Israel harɛ ta.
O soɡe Samaria dɛ di kora bene anuanaarɛ.
Kooro Hosia ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, kɛ o wechɔɡa la ta Israel koranar baa tɔ sie la kwaa baa ɛa la tele.
Kooro Hosia kora dii saŋee Asiiria harɛ Koojen Salmaneesa yo Israel tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, asɛ Kooro Hosia kpɔ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛo benanyoa bɛlbwa.
Koojen Salmaneesa baa na kɛŋɔ Kooro Hosia aa toɔ bɔe dɛɛ tɛo ɡɛ o fa aa dɛ bɔa benanyoa bɛlbwa la kpa.
Dɛ Kooro Hosia ɛo dɔm, dɛ ɡel torome ka ŋɔ Ijipt Kooro baa dɛ yerɔ So be kɛŋɔ ó chao, ásɛ o le Asiiria koojen lɔɡa.
Asɛ Koojen Salmaneesa no, dɛ ɡel ba ka lawɛ Kooro Hosia ka do dea.
Dɔma yo bwɛjen Samaria dɛ chɔɡo Asiiria koojen kaa yo Israel tena, dɛ lɛ harɛ la bwa dɔɔh, dɛ tɔ Samaria tena do bene atoro.
Kooro Hosia aa di kora bene anuanaarɛ taa Asiiria koojen yo lɛ Samaria.
O lawɛ Israel tena kaa Asiiria harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ ba ka so bwɛjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Hala, bane ɡe so Habɔ Moo nyoa Gosan harɛ ta, bane ɡe so Midia tena bwɛjena ane ta.
Samaria chɔɡɔ dɛkalkɛ, dɛ Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ nɛ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ Korowiirii lɛɛ ba le Ijipt harɛ, Ijipt kooro nɔn ta.
Dɛ ba dɛ tomɛ voɡa ɡe, dɛɛ teŋɛ harɛre Korowii aa doŋi a nɛra tɛɛ ba la we-ɛɛla, ne wechɔɡa ba Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta.
Waa aa ɡwaala kwaraa kɛŋɔ, Israel tena sɔɔh ɛ waa aa wola Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ tea toorɛ.
Ba cheɡ voɡare ba bwɛjeɡre ne bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛɛre bara bwa ta.
Ba kpɔ bwea ne dajaŋa paaɡe deŋɡarere dor, ne dajen bɛlbwa mun tɛ ba voɡ Asera dɛɛ tomɔ.
Ba dɛ fuh daawiile kon baa dɛ ɛ sarahare a ta ne deŋɡare bɛlbwa ta, kɛŋɔ ɡɛ nɛra Korowii aa doŋ ba le ba harɛre ta tɛɛ ba fa aa dɛ ɛ la.
Israel tena ɛ wedoŋa tenten a di Korowii baah taeh.
Korowii do Israel tena la ŋɔ ba bɛ voɡa tomɛ, kɛ ba ɡe ɡarɔ toma.
Dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o keamere ne nɛra baa dɛ na chaahna ta, dɛ kah Israel ne Juda tena ŋɔ, “Hé le he wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre ta, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa do heyaa a ta la ta.
N kpɔɔ tɛ he naawa ŋɔ báa teŋɛ a ta, dɛ che n keamere ɡe nɛɛ ŋɔ bá dalwe a ta baɡle heya.” Kɛ Israel tena ta noɛ, dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ ba naawa aa wola Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ yaradae la.
Ba vɛh waa Korowii aa do ba a ta la, dɛ vɛh fɔo o ne ba naawa aa fɔwa, ne kaeh waa kah ba la.
Ba teŋɛ voɡa aa ɛ konsale nɛ, dɛ ɡbabir ɡe ɛ nɛnsale.
Ba chaa harɛre aa bar ba la nɛra nawee we-ɛɛla, dɛ kpɔ ba da.
Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛ la ɛ.” Kɛ ba ɡarɔ ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ ɛ la.
Ba ɡel Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la mmarare bwa ta teŋa, dɛ loɡɛ nabali anɛ, dɛ ɛa voɡa dɛɛ toma.
Dɛ paaɡe ba voɡ Asera dajaŋa dɛɛ tomɛ weweela ne voɡ Baal.
Ba lawɛ ba ɡbaɡba bibaala ne bihaahna kpoo, dɛ fuuh ba ɛ sarahare tɛ ba voɡare.
Ba la voɡra ne dobodobo tena be, dɛ kpɔ ba te do waa aa ɛ wechɔɡa ta, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ dɛ ir o bwaawee.
Anomanta, Korowii baah di Israel tena nɛɛ taeh, dɛ doŋ ba le o sie.
Juda dea tena ɡboo baa ka.
Juda dea tena la ɡe ta wone teŋɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la mmarare ta.
Ba ɡe hweli we-ɛɛla aa wola were Israel tena aa ɛa la.
Anomanta, Korowii berɛ habɔɔ kpo Israel tena bwa.
O tɛr ba deŋne, dɛ kpɔ ba do ba dɔma nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ waa doŋ ba le o sie.
Korowii aa pere Israel harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr le Juda harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr nɛɛ la, Israel tena kpɔ Nɛbat bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam ɛ ba kooro.
Kooro Jɛroboam ɡelɔ ba ɡel Korowii toma, a ɡel ba ɛ wechɔɡa kohona.
Ba teŋɛ Kooro Jɛroboam wechɔɡa ta, dɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛa, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii aa doŋ ba le o sie, ɡɛ waa cheɡɛ o keamere nɛɛ dɛ bol la.
Anomanta, ba lawɛ Israel tena laa ta kaa bojaŋ Asiiria harɛ, ba ta ka bela ba le fini.
Asiiria tena Israel harɛ ta ka soɡa Asiiria koojen kpɔ nɛra le Babelɔn harɛ bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Kuta ne Ava ne Hamat dɛ Sefavaim, dɛ kpɔ ba ka so Samaria bwɛjena ta, Israel tena baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa la buɡ ta.
Ba kpɔ bela berɛ ba bwɛjena dɛ so bela.
Baa baa so bela loɡla la, dɛ baa Korowii tomɛ, anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ nyujentena ba kpoo ba bini bane.
Ate, ba ka ŋɔ Asiiria koojen be ŋɔ, “Nɛra haa kpɔ ba kaa Samaria ka so la aa harɛ la voɡ we-ɛɛla jemɛ dɛɛ tomɔ.
O ɡelɔ nyujentena ba kpoo ba.” Asɛ koojen la ŋɔ, “Hé nyin Israel sɔfore la yaa laɡ ba le bela la bɛl, dɛ́ kpɔɔ kaa bela ó ka so, dɛɛ baɡle nɛra ɡɛ bela voɡ baa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ nyin.” Anomanta, Israel tena baa laɡ ba laa ta le Samaria la bini bɛl waa ɛ sɔfo baa so Bɛtel, dɛɛ baɡ ba ɡɛ baa tomɛ Korowii.
Kɛ ane a bwa, nɛŋhɔɔhra baa kaa so Samaria la ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ ba voɡare dɛɛ toma.
Ba kpɔ voɡa la do voɡa deene Israel tena la aa maa bini.
Nɛra baa le Babelɔn la ɛ ba voɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Sukot Bɛnɔt, banɔ la baa le Kuta ɛ ba voɡ Nɛrɡal.
Asɛ banɔ la ba ɡe aa le Hamat ɛ ba ɡe voɡ Asima.
Avi tena ɛ ba voɡa baa dɛ yera Nibhas ne Tatak, asɛ Sefavaim tena fuh ba bii ɛ sarahare tɛ Sefavaim tena voɡa baa dɛ yera Adramɛlɛk ne Anamɛlɛk.
Ba tomɛ Korowii, dɛ berɛ kpɔ ba bini bane so voɡare la ta ŋɔ, bá ɛ kerekpoŋra.
Anomanta, ba tomɛ Korowii dɛ berɛ tomɛ ba voɡare ɡɛ bɛlbwa harɛ ta nawee waa aa doa.
Ba ta dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa la ba le fini.
Baa Korowii tomɛ kasinteŋ ne, kɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne waa waa do ba a ta, dɛ kpɔa tɛ Jekɔb baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Israel la naanar.
Korowii ne Israel tena aa fɔwɛ fɔo la, o do ba ŋɔ, “He bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ, he bɛ an ɡuŋi kɛɛ dɛ́ kpo kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛa.
Hé tomɛ men Korowii maa cheɡɛ n kpeɡri ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla ta, dɛ kpɔ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la ɡbosoo.
N ɡbosoo chɛ kɛ hé tomɛ, dɛ́ kpo kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛ mɛ.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare, ne webaɡla ne waa maa do heyaa a ta, dɛ chwerɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.
He bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ.
He bɛ fɔo n ne haa fɔwa la soh, he bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa tomɛ.
Kɛ hɛ́ɛ tomɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la ɡbo, ásɛ n lɛ heyaa le he dɔma bwa nɔn ta.” Ba ta noɛ, dɛ ta teŋɛ ba webena ta.
Hale baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la, dɛ ba ta dɛ tomɛ ba voɡare.
Dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini, ba naanar ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ waa ba naawa fa aa dɛ ɛ la.
Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea Ɛla bibaa Kooro Hosia aa di kora Israel harɛ bene atoro la, a taa Kooro Ahas bibaa Hɛsɛkea di kora Juda harɛ ta, dɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea dɔ bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ.
O nya sɔne Abija.
Abija ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Sekaria.
O ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea kɛŋɔ o nabaa Kooro Devid ken.
O chɔɡ bɔra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡare, dɛ paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura, dɛ teŋni voɡ Asera dajaŋa ta.
O kuuɡi ayaawa Mosis fa aa kpɔa ɛ harɛkon baa yerɔ Nehustan la.
Dɛ ba tel ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ Israel tena dɛ fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ harɛkon la.
Dɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la nɛɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea kpɔ o te dawɛ.
Juda harɛ ta koranar la bwa bini, banɔ la baa di kora mɔɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ba di, ne banɔ la waa dia mɔɔ ba ba di la, dɛ o dɔŋ toole.
O kpɔ o te pɛl Korowii, o ta o nɛɛ teŋa ɡelɛ, dɛ do sie dɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ Mosis la bwa ta.
Anomanta, Korowii ja o nɛ, asɛ wobɛlbwa waa ɛa la do wer.
O ɛ Asiiria koojen dɔm, dɛ laa o te kpɔ o lɔɡa, dɛ ŋɔ waa on tomɛ kpa.
O yo Filisti tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, bwɛjena ne anɔ la baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ bara bwa, dɛ kpoŋe ka le bwɛjen Gasa bwa.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora bene anaarɛ ta la, dɛ Kooro Ɛla bibaa Kooro Hosia di kora Israel harɛ ta bene anuanɛ.
A taa Asiiria koojen Salmaneesa ne o laa tena ba yo bwɛjen Samaria tena dɛ tɔ ba do la.
Asiiria tena aa tɔ ba do bene atoro la, ba wono pɔ ba nɛ.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea di kora bene anumɛl, asɛ Kooro Hosia ɡe dɔ bene anuanaarɛ o kora ta.
Asiiria koojen lawɛ Israel tena kaa o harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ bane so Hala, bane so Habɔ Moo nyoa Gosan harɛ ta, bane ɡe ka so Midia tena bwɛjena ane ta.
Samaria chɔɡɔ dɛkalkɛ, dɛ Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ nɛ.
Ba koni fɔo ba ne waa fɔwa la, ba ta waa Korowii fa aa cheɡɛ o bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba la noɛ, dɛ kpɔ ɛ wa.
Asiiria koojen Senakerib aah Jerusalam tena Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora bene fi dɛ anaarɛ ta la, Asiiria koojen Senakerib kpɔ o laa tena, dɛ ba yo Juda harɛ ta bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea tomɛ ŋɔ bá la Asiiria koojen be bwɛjen Lakes ta, dɛ́ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa, n poori, n ɛ wechɔɡa, suuɡa bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la mɛɛ bɔɔ tɛɛ, ásɛ he le n nɛɛ kaa.” Asɛ Asiiria koojen ŋɔ o kpɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fi lafraanɛ, ne suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋ fifraanɛ ba tɛo.
Asɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea kpɔ suuɡapoŋa aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne anɔ la aa lɔ dejeɡre baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini koodem bwa ka tɛo.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea berɔ laa suuɡaswɛm o ɡbabir aa kpɔa bɔle Korowii Dea ɡbeni, ne anɔ la waa kpɔa bɔle doonyoa daa la ta swe, dɛ kpɔa ja ka tɛ Asiiria koojen la.
Asiiria koojen tomɛ o nomonjena batoro, laa sitɔɔla nomoa ne o ɡbaɡba nachiɡe ne o laa nomoa ŋɔ, bá le Lakes, dɛ́ kpɔ laa tena baa wara ja, dɛ́ la Kooro Hɛsɛkea be Jerusalam.
Baa laŋa la, ba kaa che ŋwɛnɛ waa bɛne bobɛl nee aa pala dɛɛ kpɔ, dɛ le nyundua tam bɛl ta dɛɛ jo bwɛjen la ta, bela nɛra bane baa dɛ ɛ yale aa lole.
Ba kaa yerɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea, asɛ o tomɛ Hilkia bibaa Eliakim, onee dɛɛ nyiŋi koodem bela waa ta, ne Sɛbna waa ɛ koodem bela karake, dɛ Asaf bibaa Joa waa chwerɛ harɛ la waa dɛɛ do tɔne bini, asɛ ba bwa le, dɛ ka chem ba.
Asiiria laa sitɔɔla la bini bɛl ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, Asiiria koojen dɛ nyin ó jemɛ waa Kooro Hɛsɛkea a dena dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta.
O ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ nyoa wobol do kɛ wejema, ne kpeɡri ba kpɔ dɛɛ yo laa kɛɛ?
Ume nɛɛ he kpɔ he te dawɛ, dɛ ɛɛ mɛ dɔm nɔɔ?
Na, dɛ Ijipt Kooro nɛɛ he kpɔ he te dawɛ aa, aa doo kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ pul ɛ daŋɡbala, ásɛ o ku dɛ́ tɔɡɛ he nɔn.
Gɛɛ Ijipt kooro do tɛ nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛɛ bwa.” Asiiria nomoa la berɛ ŋɔ, “Kɛ, hɛɛ ŋɔɔ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la nɛɛ hɛɛ hwɛɡɛ aa?
Saraha kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la laa on Kooro Hɛsɛkea chɔɡ, dɛ ŋɔ Juda ne Jerusalam tena bwa be ŋɔ, báa tomɛ Jerusalam bonɔ ɡbo la aa?
N ne hɛɛ ŋwɛɛroo n naa Asiiria koojen sɔn ta.
Mɛɛ tɛɛ jaɡre kaɡboŋa anɛɛ, dɛ hɛɛ won dɔ laa tena ba so a bwa ta naa.
Haa won kpɔ he te maɡɛ Asiiria koojen nomonome la bini bechala kwara, kɛ he dɛ hwɛɡɛ Ijipt kooro nɛɛ kɛ ó ba tɛɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore, ne laa tena baa dɛ so jaɡre ta.
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii habɔɔ n le dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yo he harɛ nɛra nɔ kɛɛ?
Korowii ɡbabirii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ń ba dɛ́ ba chɔɡ harɛ nɔ.” Anee Eliakim baa dɛ yerɛ o mɛɛ Hilkia ne Sɛbna, dɛ Joa ŋɔ Asiiria koojen laa sitɔɔ la be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya dɛ soŋe, bol Aram tena wobol baɡle he bonɔɔna.
He bolaa, ya dɛ no.
Bɛ Hibru tena wobol kpɔ bol ya be.
Nɛra baa cheɡɛ bwɛjen nɔ danjwɛɛ nɔ ta dɛ no he be.” Anee laa sitɔɔ la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ne he kooro ɡbo bee n nomoa tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol waa nɔ kɛɛ?
He ɡbo laa, nɛra baa sosoɡe bwɛjen nɔ danjwɛɛ nɔ ta ɡe jao, baa di ba ɡbaɡba benaa, dɛ́ nyɔ ba feene kɛ heya.” Ate, laa sitɔɔ la ir che, dɛ kpɔ Hibru tena wobol bol waa takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “Hé no waa Asiiria koojen la aa dɛ bol he be!
O dɛ kah heyaa ŋɔ he bɛ ɡel Kooro Hɛsɛkea neɡre heya.
Waa won lɛ heyaa le n nɔn ta.
He bɛ o nɛɛ teŋɛ, dɛ́ ɡel hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ ŋɔ, wɛɛ lɛ heyaa, waa bwɛjen nɔɔ kpɔ do Asiiria koojen nɔn ta.
He bɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea waa no.
Asiiria koojen dɛ bol ŋɔ, hé le bwɛjen la bini ba o be, dɛ́ kpɔ he te ba do o lɔɡa.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he bini bɛlbwa dɔ o fiɡ ne o ɡrepo daa kooni nɔna di, dɛ́ nyɔ o kɔlɔŋ bini ne.
Ásɛ mɔɔ koojen la ba kpɔ heyaa kaa bojaŋ harɛ waa do kɛŋɔ he kon nɔ ta.
Harɛ daa kooni aa lole he dɔ sen le a ta, ne mea baa kpɔ ɛ paanoo.
O ɛ harɛ ɔleve no ne tooh aa lɔ o ta kohona.
Hé teŋɛ waa koojen la aa do heyaa a ta la tenaa, hɛɛ dɔ he nyuunee.
He bɛ ɡel Kooro Hɛsɛkea neɡre heyaa ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ lɛ heyaa.
Harɛ bɛl voɡ wono lɛ harɛ la nɛra le Asiiria koojen nɔn ta ka aa?
Leperaa bwɛjena Hamat ne Aapad tena voɡa dɔɔ?
Sefavaim ne Hena dɛ Iva tena ɡe voɡare sɛ?
A wono lɛ Samaria tena aa?
Harɛre nɔ voɡ besoo wona lɛ o harɛ le n be nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba wona lɛ Jerusalam ɔ?” Asɛ nɛra la hel jeiih ken, ba ta nentane tae ta harɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea tɔ sie ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ ba bɛ on chaŋe.
Ate, Eliakim ne Sɛbna, dɛ Joa kɛɛ ba laala, a baɡle kɛ ba loo kuu, dɛ la Kooro Hɛsɛkea be, dɛ ka bol waa Asiiria koojen laa sitɔɔ la aa bola la o be.
Korowii keame Aesaya ja Kooro Hɛsɛkea Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa no waa la, o ɡe laa o yal waa tɔɔ la kɛɛ, dɛ ka kpɔ lweyal tɔ dɛ ka jo Korowii Dea.
O tomɛ Eliakim waa dɛ nyiŋi koodem waa ta, ne Sɛbna waa ɛ karake, dɛ bela sɔfore nomonome ba ɡe aa tɔ lweyale ŋɔ, bá la Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya be.
Waa waa kpɔa tɛ ŋɔ bá ka ŋɔ Aesaya be laanee kɛŋɔ, “Wahala ne deŋnetɛra ne sihiih tɔperee fini.
Ya do kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ o ɡwɛɡre waa wola won lolɛ la ken.
Asiiria koojen tomɛ o laa sitɔɔla nomoa, ó ba chɛɡre Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la.
N dɛ soŋe Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ kɛ, ó tɛr a ɡɛ nɛra la deŋne a wa, anomanta, soŋe Korowii tɛ ya nɛra ya taa kaa nɔ.” Kooro Hɛsɛkea toroma la aa ba Aesaya be la, anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ka ɡel he dɔɔ no kɛŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Bɛ Asiiria koojen waa la ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ maa won lɛ heya.
No, mɛɛ ɡeloo koojen la no waane aa ɛ ɔmewa, ásɛ a ɡel o berɛ kaa o harɛ ta, ásɛ Korowii ɡel bá ka kpoo kere ne.’ ” Asiiria tena kaa aah Jerusalam tena nɛɛtena Asiiria laa nomoa la noɔ kɛŋɔ Asiiria koojen ne o laa tena le Lakes dɛ kaa yo bwɛjen Lebna tena baa bɛn ba, asɛ o ir la koojen la be bela.
Belaa Asiiria koojen no kɛŋɔ, Ijipt Kooro Tirhaka waa le Itiopia ne o laa tena dɛ́ ba ba yoo.
Anomanta, o chwerɛ tɔn, dɛ kpɔ tomɛ toroma Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ, “Bɛ he Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ dɛ kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛɛ la neɡre kɛŋɔ, Asiiria koojen la aa won yo lɛ Jerusalam.
A lole kɛŋɔ he no ɡɛ Asiiria koojen bɛlbwa aa ɛ harɛre nɔ bwa, dɛ chɔɡa kwaraa.
He te ɛɛ won le a nyoa aa?
N naawa yo harɛre nɛra bane baa le Gosan ne Haran ne Rɛsɛf dɛ chɔɡ ba harɛre, dɛ kpoo Bɛt Eden tena baa soɡe Tɛl Asa, ba voɡare wono lɛɛ ba aa?
Leperaa bwɛjena Hamat ne Aapad ne Sefavaim dɛ Hena kɛɛ Iva koranar dɔɔ?” Kooro Hɛsɛkea wesoŋa Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea lɛ tɔn la dɛ kure, dɛ kpɔ la Korowii Dea, dɛ ka laa paɡri bil Korowii sie.
Asɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, he so kena kwaa Kerobim doa.
Korowii bɛlbwa toole ka ja he nɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛre bwa ta.
Henee ta nyundua ne harɛ.
Ir nyu ne, dɛ́ no n wesoŋa nɔ, no waa Koojen Senakerib aa ba a ne, dɛ baa chɛɡre hen Korowii haa lole saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ.
A ɛ kpela, Korowii, kɛŋɔ Asiiria koojena yo harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra, dɛ chɔɡ ba harɛre a chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Ba pa ba voɡare do nii ta a fuh, dɛkalkɛ a ɛ daa ne bwea nɛn aa sɛah.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, lɛ yaa le Asiiria koojen Senakerib nɔn ta, ásɛ harɛre bwa nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ he ɡboo Korowii.” Korowii keame Aesaya bol waa Kooro Hɛsɛkea be Ate, Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya kpɔ kala tɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, o no Asiiria koojen Senakerib wesoŋa haa soŋo la, Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Jerusalam waa do kɛ bechatolo, waa wola baa jemɛ la hah hen Koojen Senakerib, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyubaah.
Koojen Senakerib, umee hɛɛ lii he nyu bini kɛ onee hɛɛ chɛɡre dɛɛ ɛo nɛnhɛla nɔɔ?
Men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ laanee hɛɛ ɛ sisawaa la.
He tomɛ he toroma ba ɛ mbarafo baɡ mɛ ŋɔ, he wono kpɔ torɔɡore teeh kaa bwejena aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn dor.
He ŋɔ belaa he teŋni peleme daa aa jaŋa kohona, ne dadɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi, dɛ jo kaa kɔr la baah tenten.
He ɛ mbarafo ŋɔ, he kwi buli harɛfala ta, dɛ nyɔ a bini nee bela.
Dɛ ŋɔ he laa tena nakpale ɡbo ɡelɔ Ijipt Nael Moo hweeh.
He ta noɛ kɛ saŋ la bwaa n le vɔrɔwa bil kɛɛ?
N tɛɛ kpeɡri he ɡel bwɛɛre danjwɛkpeɡa aa bara kuuɡi, dɛ berɛ dimɡbeeni.
N ɡelɔ a nɛra bwa ɡwɛɡre, ba bwara yɔr ba di sihiih.
Ba ɛo kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa lɔ koo ta, kɛɛ kpɔɡa aa lɔ lɔɡ doa, asɛ wee leebɔr peu chɔɡe yon ta a sewɛ la ken.
N jemɛ he wobɛlbwa bini, he laŋa ne he bala bwa, ne he deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla haa dɛ ɛɛ mɛ.
N no he deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla, ne mbarafo haa dɛ ɛ, a chole n deŋna ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔ ɡoŋaa do he mee ta, dɛ́ kpɔ kabaɡrare do he nyoa, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔe kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta ba la ta kaa.’ ” Ate, Aesaya ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ, “Waa aa che a ta, n naa Kooro Hɛsɛkea, he jemɛ laanee nɔ.
‘Koo kwaa baa koma bena nɔ la, ane ɛɛ le a buɡ taa, ásɛ he dia, ásɛ benanyoa chemaa, hé di a tenten.
A bentooro te la, hé du mea dɛ́ koma, dɛ́ parɛ daa kooni, dɛ́ di a nɔna.
Nɛra baa ka, dɛ́ le Juda dea la ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ, daa waa ta lune kaa bini, dɛ won nɔna la ken.
Bane ɛɛ kao dɛ́ do Jerusalam Saayɔn Bwejen ta.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ do siee, dɛ́ ɛ anɔ bwa.’ Asiiria koojen waa Korowii aa bola laanee nɔ.
‘Waa bwɛjen nɔ taa dɔ jo, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ta hɛm bonɔɔ.
Waa konee kpɔ tɔ o te ɡbemɡbe dɛ́ ba o doonyoa, kɛɛ dɛ́ ma kon waa che o ta teeh jo o bini dɛ́ yo.
Ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta ba la, wɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ o ta kaa waa wola won jo bwɛjen nɔ ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ tɔ bwɛɛ nɔ ɡbemɡbee dɛ́ lɛo, n jirima ne nyoa maa baɡɛ n bonɔɔ Devid nomanta.’ ” Ate, awola jwaana, Korowii nyundua torome la bela Asiiria laa tena aa lole la, dɛ ka kpoo ba bini kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanuatoro dɛ banue.
Nɛra iro chɔɔ dɛ ba na ɡɛ nɛra la aa serewa chɔ bobɛlbwa.
Aa ba ɡɛ la, Asiiria koojen Senakerib ɡel laa la yoi, dɛ ir ka so Asiiria bwɛjen Niniwe.
Dɛ belaa ɛ koojen soŋnibɔr.
Awola bɛl, o ka dɛ tu voɡa o voɡ Nesrɔk dea, asɛ o bibaala banɛ, Adramɛlɛk ne Saresa ka kpoo kere ne, dɛ chwa le kaa Ararat harɛ ta.
Asɛ o bibaa Esaahadon chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea weela wa Aa ba dɛ la sie la, weela lɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea wɛɛ ba sewa.
Asɛ Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya la o be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ɛ he dem ne he wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haa he weela nɔ taa ir, hɛɛ chɔ he banɔn taa!” Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea berɛ o sie chaɡɛ danjwɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n poori, lii ɡɛ maa ta tea bwa tɛɛ, dɛ tomɛ kasinteŋ ne, dɛ ɛ waa haa dɛ nyin.” Dɛ wi lokua ne kohona.
Mɔɔ Korowii keame Aesaya aa le koodem dembaah bela la, Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ó berɛ dɛ́ ka ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea waa dɛ tɔ o nɛra sie be ŋɔ, “Men Korowii he nabaa Devid fa aa tomɔ la, n no he wesoŋa, dɛ na siniire aa dɛ yɔɔre.
Mɛɛ chaeh, asɛ tɔpetooro wee la he ir, dɛ́ la men Korowii Dea.
Mɛɛ kpɔ bene fi dɛ anuee ja he mkpa ta.
Mɛɛ lɛ he ne bwɛjen Jerusalam tenaa, ásɛ Asiiria koojen bɛ won pɔ he nɛ.
Mɛɛ che bwɛjen nɔ habɔɔ, dɛ́ tɔɔ ɡbemɡbe n jirima maa dɔa wa, ne waa maa baɡɛ n bonɔɔ Devid la wa.” Ate, Aesaya ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea bonɔɔna be ŋɔ, “Hé chaa fiɡ nɔna, dɛ́ nama tɔ o ɔr la ta, wɛɛ ɡbaŋroo.” Dɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea fa bɔɔ Aesaya kɛŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa Korowii ɛɛ ba ɡela ń na, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chaah mɛɛ, ásɛ a tɔpetooro wee ń la Korowii Dea ɔ?” Anee Aesaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ ba ɛɛ he jemɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, wɛɛ ɛ waa waa baɡɛ nyoa laanee.
He dɛ nyin wee chunchule kaa sie ka dawɛ kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh dɛɛ jo dea la fite ta, kɛɛ o kaa habɔɔ ka dawɛ kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh dɛɛ jo la fite ta nɔ?” Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “A pwɛre kɛŋɔ chunchule kaa sie, ka dawɛ kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh dɛɛ jo dea la ta.
Gel chunchule la kaa habɔɔ, ka dawɛ kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ jo dea la fite ta.” Ate, Korowii keame Aesaya soŋe Korowii, asɛ o ɡel chunchule la kaa habɔɔ, dɛ ka dawɛ Kooro Ahas kwaa waa cheɡɛ a ta teeh dɛɛ jo dea la ta.
Toroma bane baa le Babelɔn harɛ ta A ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Babelɔn harɛ ta kooro bɛl sɔne Mɛrɔdak Baladan, o mɛɛ sɔne Kooro Baladan.
Kooro Mɛrɔdak Baladan aa no Kooro Hɛsɛkea weela waa la, o chwerɛ tɔne dɛ kpɔ koŋkɛɛla ja tomɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ka tɛo.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea lɛ toroma la, asɛ dɛ kpɔ o kara mun kwaa aa lɔ dem, suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, ne konsɔɔhsoma ne nodɛɛɡa, dɛ o dɔmkwaa ne bela waa dɛ cheɡa bwa baɡ ba.
Komɛlbwa toole dɛ do o dem kɛɛ harɛ la ta waa wola ban baɡlɛ.
Ate, Korowii keame Aesaya la ka bɔɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Leperaa ɡɛ nɛra nɔ leɔ?
Dɛ ba amaneɛ ɔ?” Anee Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Ba le bojaŋ harɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Babelɔn ta.” Aesaya pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa ba na he koodem ɔ?” Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Ba na komɛlbwa aa lɔ n koodem.
Komɛlbwa toole n kara mun maa wola kpɔe baɡ ba.” Aesaya ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ nɛra ba kpɔ komɛlbwa aa lɔ he koodem ne kwaa he naawa aa nyina cheɡ ba le fini nɔ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta, komɛlbwa aa wola ka.
Baa larawe he ɡbaɡba naanar la banee kaa, dɛ́ ka fɔɡɛ ba lure, bá do Babelɔn koodem dɛɛ tomɛ.” Kooro Hɛsɛkea chaŋe ŋɔ, “Waa haa ɡela n no le Korowii be nɔ wer.” Dɛkalkɛŋɔ, o liiro kɛ wɛɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna o kora che kɛrɛdɛ o saŋ.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea kora dii jaɡa Waa aa kaa ne anɔ la Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa wona ɛ, ne tam waa kwia, dɛ kwi bɔɔ nee kpɔ o bini dɛɛ ba Jerusalam la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ o bibaa Manasɛ ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Manasɛ Kooro Manasɛ aa baa di kora Juda harɛ ta la, dɛ o di bene fi dɛ anɛ.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanue dɛ anue.
Dɛ o nya sɔne Hɛpseba.
O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛ teŋɛ harɛre nɛra baa tɔ sie ba so bela, Korowii aa doŋ ba le ba harɛre ta tɛ Israel tena we-ɛɛla baa ɛa Korowii kia la ta.
Kooro Manasɛ kwaarɔ cheɡ voɡa o mɛɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa paɡra bela voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ la, dɛ berɛ ɛ kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta tɛ voɡbaa Baal, dɛ paaɡe voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa, ɡɛ Israel Kooro Ahab fa aa ɛa la.
O berɔ tomɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie dɛ weweela bwa.
O ɛ kwaa voɡtoroma aa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta Korowii Dea, bela Korowii aa ŋɔa belaa a chɛ kɛ baa tomɔ la.
Korowii Dea dembaahna anɛ la bini la, o ɛ kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta baa tomɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie, dɛ weweela.
O kpo o bibaa dɛ fuuh ɛ saraha, dɛ ɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla dɛ voɡɛ dɛ yerɛ lala, dɛ la tɛɡre tena ɡe be.
O ɛ wechɔɡa taeh dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ dɛ ir o bandia kohona.
Kooro Manasɛ sɛh Asera voɡ dajaŋ, dɛ kpɔ ka pa Korowii Dea, bela Korowii aa ŋɔ Kooro Devid ne o bibaa Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Dea nɔ ne Jerusalamee n le cheɡ, dɛ le Israel deene bwa bini kɛŋɔ baa tom mɛ o bini saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la la.
Dɛ Israel tena ɛɛ teŋɛ waa maa do ba a ta, ne mmarare la bwa n fa aa cheɡɛ n bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba la ta tenaa, maa ɡel bá doŋ ba le harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ ba naawa la ta.” Kɛ Juda tena vɛoh, Kooro Manasɛ ɡelɔ ba nyoɡre, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa ɡwaa harɛre nɛra Korowii fa aa doŋ ba le o nɛra Israel tena sie la.
Korowii cheɡɛ o bonɔɔna baa ɛ o keamere nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Juda Kooro Manasɛ ɛ kii wa.
O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ Amɔre tena ba fa aa soɡe bonɔ la, dɛ ɡel Juda tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ tomɛ o voɡa.
Anomanta, men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la ɛɛ kpɔ sibeɡraa ba ta Jerusalam ne Juda tena nɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa no dɛɛ ɔmɛ.
Mɛɛ bol Jerusalam tena waa dɛ́ pa ba bolchɔɡe kɛŋɔ maa ɛ Samaria tena, ne Israel Kooro Ahab, dɛ o naanar la.
Mɛɛ le Jerusalam tena bwa nee kɛŋɔ, ba yon kpɔ kon fee hɛna bini, dɛ laa o doŋa bwa kpɔ dɛ berɛ pi la ken.
Mɛɛ vɛh n nɛra baa kaa laanee, dɛ́ kpɔ ba do ba dɔma nɔn ta.
Ásɛ ba dɔma la yoo ba, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ ba harɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ pa laa ta kwaa ken.
Dɛkalkɛ, ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo n nɛ, dɛ ir n bandia le awola ba naawa aa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba le fini.” Kooro Manasɛ kpoo nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ warɛ taeh, asɛ ba chale ɛɛ palɛ Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna bwa.
O berɔ ɡel Juda harɛ tena jo voɡa toma ta, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii nɛ.
Kooro Manasɛ waa waa ɛa bwa, ne wechɔɡa waa ɛa te, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Manasɛ sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ ba huɡo bodɛɛɡe bobɛl baa du daa koodem la jwɛh, ba dɛ yera Kooro Usa Daa.
O bibaa Amɔn baa chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Amɔn Kooro Amɔn aa di kora la, dɛ o di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene anɛ.
O nya sɔne Mɛsolɛmɛt, Mɛsolɛmɛt mɛɛ sɔne Harus dɛ le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jotba.
Kooro Amɔn ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Manasɛ aa ɛa la.
O teŋɛ o mɛɛ we-ɛɛla la bwa ta.
O tomɛ voɡa o mɛɛ aa toma la dɛɛ ɡuŋa.
O berɛ habɔɔ kpo Korowii o naawa aa toma la, dɛ vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa.
Kooro Amɔn nomonome la bini bane vɔrɔwe o vɔrɔwa, dɛ kpoo o koodem.
Asɛ Juda harɛ nɛra kpoo nɛra baa vɔrɔwe Kooro Amɔn vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo la.
Dɛ kpɔ o bibaa Josia chiɡ o naa ta, o di kora.
Waa bwa Kooro Amɔn aa ɛa la te, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Ba huɡo Kooro Amɔn bodɛɛɡe bobɛl baa du daa o do Usa, asɛ o bibaa Josia chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Josia Juda Kooro Josia aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene anuatoro.
O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
O nya sɔne Jedida dɛ le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Boskat.
O nya la mɛɛ sɔne Adaya.
O ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, o teŋɛ waa o nabaa Kooro Devid aa ɛa ta.
O teŋɛ Korowii waa ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Korowii Mmara Tɔn nae wa Kooro Josia aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuatoro ta la, o tomɛ o koodem karake baa dɛ yerɔ Safan Korowii Dea.
O mɛɛ sɔne Asalia, o nabaa sɔne Mɛsolam.
O ŋɔ Safan be ŋɔ, “La Sɔfonomoa Hilkia be, ásɛ o lɛ suuɡa nɛra aa dɛ ba a ne Korowii Dea la le nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi doonyoone ta la be cheɡ.
Ŋɔ ó kpɔ do nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea la kwaara ta la nɔn ta, ásɛ ba kpɔ bɔ tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ kwaa Korowii Dea la kem.
Kapenta tena ne mamaala ne nɛra baa dɛ sɛh bwea, dɛ́ ɡel ba kpɔ suuɡa la ane yawɛ daa ne bwea baa sɛah, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la.
Nɛra suuɡa la aa lɔ ba be la dɛ di kasinteŋ ba toma ta, anomanta, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá bu nkontaa bɛlbwa.” Sɔfo nomoa Hilkia ŋɔ koodem karake Safan waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil la be ŋɔ, “N na Korowii Mmara Tɔn waa nyoɡra la Korowii Dea.” Asɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ Safan o kure.
Ate, Safan berɛ kaa Kooro Josia be, dɛ ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he nomonome la kpɔ suuɡa aa lɔ Korowii Dea la do nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra la nɛɛ ne tom-ɛɛra la nɔn ta.” Safan berɛ ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa, sɔfo Hilkia kpɔ tɔn bɛl tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ Safan kure waa aa lɔ o bini baɡle kooro.
Kooro la aa no Mmara Tɔn la bini waa la, o laa o laala waa doa la kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ o loo kuu.
Buɡ la ta, Kooro do sɔfo Hilkia ne Safan bibaa Ahikam, ne Mikaya bibaa Akbɔ, ne Safan waa ɛ karake dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, dɛ o bonɔɔ Asaya be ŋɔ, “Hé la ka bɔɔ le Korowii be tɛ n ne nɛra baa ka Israel ne Juda, tɔn nɔ baa ɡaaɡa dɛ ka nao nɔ wa.
Korowii baah di n ne Juda harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛɛ taeh, dɛkalkɛ ya naawa ta waa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔ ta teŋɛ.” Anee sɔfo Hilkia ne Ahikam ne Akbɔ ne Safan, dɛ Asaya la Korowii keame bɛl waa ɛ haah baa yerɔ Hulda be, dɛ ka bɔɔ le o be.
Dɛ Korowii keame Hulda soɡe Jerusalam bampera bofale.
O jaaree Tikva bibaa Salum, asɛ o nabaa sɔne Haahas.
Onee dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea batakaarere ta.
Korowii keame Hulda ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Hé la ka ŋɔ Kooro Josia waa tomɛ heyaa la be ŋɔ, Korowii ŋɔ o dɛ ba Jerusalam nɛra deŋne tɛra, ɡɛ waa baa chwera do Juda kooro tɔn bini aa dɛ baɡle la, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛɛh mɛ, dɛ ka fuh konsɔɔhsoma voɡa ta, dɛɛ muɡli n baah voɡa ba ɡbaɡba aa ɛa ne.
N baah ɛɛ di ba nɛɛ bonɔ kohonaa, aa wola sɔɔh bwa.
Hé ŋɔ Juda kooro waa tomɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé ka bɔɔ le Korowii be la be ŋɔ, waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa bola, waa waa noa dɛ le tɔn la bini laanee nɔ, ‘Haa kure tɔn la, dɛ no Jerusalam nɛra deŋnetɛra, ne ba taahna waa he loo ku he kɛɛ he batakaare haa doa, dɛ ba he te ne harɛ dɛɛ wi nomanta, n no he wii haa wia la bwa.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo he sewɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ta ka pu he naawa.
Haa deŋnetɛra kohona men Korowii aa dɛ ba a ne bala ba ta Jerusalam ta laanee na.’ ” Asɛ toroma la ka ŋɔ waa la Kooro Josia be.
Kooro Josia chɔɡ voɡtoroma Asɛ Kooro Josia yerɛ Juda ne Jerusalam nomonome bwa cheme.
O ne Juda baala ne Jerusalam tena, ne sɔfore ne Korowii keamere, le bechale nɛɛ ba kaa nomonjena bwa nɛɛ ba la Korowii Dea.
Asɛ o ɡel ba kure Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Tɔn waa nyoɡra ba nao Korowii Dea la, asɛ ba bwa no.
Kooro Josia cheɡɛ o koochebɔr pila bɛl jwɛh, o ne Korowii berɛ kwaa fɔwɛ fɔo ŋɔ wɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ waa waa bola ne o Mmarare ta o bambile ne o liire bwa ne, ɡɛ tɔn la bini fɔo waa la aa dɛ baɡle la.
Asɛ nɛra la bwa baɡɛ nyoa kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ teŋɛ fɔo la taa.
Kooro Josia ɡelɔ Sɔfonomoa Hilkia ne sɔfore baa ja o nɛ, ne nɛra baa dɛ che Korowii Dea la doonyoa la laa kwaa baa ɛa tɛ voɡ Baal, ne voɡ Asera ne kwaa aa lɔ nyundua a do Korowii Dea la laa pa le.
Kooro la fuah bwɛjen la dahare Kedrɔn fɛlembɔjen jwɛh, dɛ pa a tɔɔ la kaa Bɛtel.
O ir kerekpoŋra Juda koranar aa cheɡ ba baa fuh konsɔɔhsoma deŋɡarere aa lɔ Juda harɛ ne bwɛɛre aa bar Jerusalam bwa ta, dɛɛ tɛ voɡ Baal ne wee ne korobie ne weweela, dɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa.
Dɛ fuɡri voɡ Asera dajaŋa le Korowii Dea, dɛ kpɔ le Jerusalam dahare, dɛ ka fuah Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta o ɛ mohooh ken, dɛ pa ka ta nɛra ŋwama ta.
Kooro Josia ɡelɔ ba kuuɡi voɡ Asera dea baala aa lɔ a bini dɛɛ bɔ jwamane ba mao o do Korowii Dea la bɔr la.
Dɛ belaa haahna so, dɛ sɔh laala tɛ nɛra ba kpɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Asera voɡ.
Kooro la ɡelɔ ba ka kpɔ sɔfore baa lɔ Juda harɛ bwɛjena ta ba Jerusalam, dɛ kuuɡi voɡare baa dɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma a ta, le Geba kaa Beɛseeba.
O ɡelɔ ba chɔɡ voɡa aa lɔ doonyoo la ta, doonyoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Josua Doonyoa la ɡal bɔr.
Dɛ ɡɛ Josua la ɛ bwɛjen la nomonjen.
Kerekpoŋra baa dɛ ɛ toma voɡare ta la ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe dɛ́ ɛ saraha Korowii saraha kon waa lɔ Jerusalam la ta.
Kɛ dɛ ba ne ba bala baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea won paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta dii.
Kooro Josia ɡelɔ nɛra la Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ ka paɡre kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta baa yerɔ Tɔfɛt la.
Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nɛra bɛ won kpɔ ba bibaala kɛɛ ba bihaahna ɛ sarahare dɛ́ fuuh ba dɛɛ tɛ voɡ Molɛk kpa.
O berɔ laa jaɡre ane baa mwɛɛ bune ane soo siwi ɛa Juda harɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tomɛ wee la le Korowii Dea la doonyoa.
Dɛ Juda koranaree fa ɛa dɛ kpɔ tɛ voɡa.
O ɡelɔ ba fuh kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore ba kpɔ dɛɛ tomɛ la.
Dɛ ba kpɔa ka bɛne dea nomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Netan Mɛlɛk bela o fa aa soɡa bini.
O ɡelɔ ba paɡre Juda koranar kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta Kooro Ahas abrɔsane doa, ne ane Kooro Manasɛ ɡe aa kwaara a do Korowii Dea dembaahna anɛ ta.
Dɛ paɡra a do mohooh ken ka ta Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta.
Kooro Josia chɔɡ saraha kwaa Kooro Solomɔn aa maa cheɡ Jerusalam wee leebɔr, ne Ɔlevere Bwejen weekaŋle harɛbɔr baa tomɛ voɡhaah Astɔrɛt, Sidon tena aa dɛ tomɛ, dɛ Moab tena voɡ Kemɔs, dɛ Amɔn tena voɡ Molɛk a bwa aa ɛ kii kwaa la.
Kooro Josia ɡelɔ ba paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura, dɛ kuuɡi voɡ Asera dajaŋa ta, dɛ pa nɛra hoɡa bil a buɡ ta.
O berɔ ɡel ba paɡre kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa a ta, Nɛbat bie Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa Bɛtel la.
Kooro Jɛroboam ɡelɔ Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, hale Kooro Josia paɡre kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta, dɛ fuh bela baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa a ɛ mohooh kɛŋɔ bomboɡ ken, dɛ fuh voɡ Asera dajaŋ ɡe.
Kooro Josia nyiŋo, dɛ na ŋwama ane deŋɡare bɛl ta.
Asɛ o ɡel ba huɡri hoɡa la, dɛ fuah kon voɡtoroma aa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta.
Gɛɛ o ɛ dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaoh, asɛ waa Korowii keame la fa aa tɔ sie bol ba tɔpejen bɛl dii, ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Jɛroboam aa cheɡɛ saraha kon jwɛh la ɛ kasinteŋ.
Kooro Josia ŋɔ, “Ume ŋwamee ka lɔ le nɔɔ?” Asɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen Bɛtel ta la ŋɔ, “Korowii keame waa le Juda, dɛ ba bol waa haa ɛ saraha kon nɔ ta la ŋwamee.” Kooro Josia ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ŋwam la, nomɛlbwa bɛ o hoɡa la huɡri.” Asɛ ba ta o ne Korowii keame waa le Samaria la hoɡa huɡre.
Gɛ waa ɛ Bɛtel la, Kooro Josia paɡre kwaa baa dɛ ɛ voɡa sarahare a ta aa lɔ Samaria bwɛɛre ta, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaah, Israel koranar aa maa dɛ kpɔ ir Korowii bandia kohona la.
Kooro Josia kpoo kerekpoŋra baa soɡe voɡa la ta bwa, dɛ fuh nɛra hoɡa saraha kwaa la ta, dɛ laa berɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Kooro Josia Galekaa Tɔpejen Dii Kooro Josia do harɛ la ta bwa nɛra ŋɔ, “Hé di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Tɔn bini la.” Dɛ Israel koranar kɛɛ Juda koranar bɛlbwa ta Galekaa Tɔpejen bɛlbwa waa do ken dii bwa, le ɡɛ saŋ koranar aa wola toole, asɛ sitɔɔla yon tɔ Israel tena sie dɛɛ nyiŋi ba waa bini la.
Kɛ a bwa habɔɔ la, Kooro Josia aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuatoro taa ba di ɡɛ Galekaa Tɔpejen nɔ Jerusalam.
Kooro Josia wefala ane ɡe ja Waa aa jaa laanee kɛŋɔ, Kooro Josia le nɛra baa dɛ yerɛ lala, ne tɛɛɡa tena ne deremi voɡa, dɛ voɡa baa ɛa cheɡ, dɛ kii kwaa waa naa Juda harɛ ta ne Jerusalam bwa ne.
Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ tɔn waa nyoɡre Korowii Dea sɔfo Hilkia ka nao la waa won ɛ kasinteŋ.
Kooro bɛlbwa ta do kɛ Kooro Josia, dɛ nyin Korowii o bambile bwa, o hweera dɛ o bokpeɡa bwa ne, ɡɛ waa aa lɔ Mosis Mmara la bini bwa aa dɛ baɡle la.
Kɛ ane a bwa, Korowii bandichɔɡe waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta tena nɛɛ la, dɛ o ta sɔɔhnɛ, Kooro Manasɛ waa waa ɛa dɛ kpɔ ir o bandia la wa.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ le Juda harɛ nɛra ɡe nee, ɡɛ maa le Israel harɛ nɛra ne la.
Dɛ́ vɛh bwɛjen Jerusalam tena maa lee ba cheɡ tɛ n te, ne Dea nɔ maa ŋɔa baa tom mɛ o bini nɔ ta.” Kooro Josia kora dii jaɡa Wobɛlbwa Kooro Josia aa ɛa la bwa, ba chwera do saŋ la Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Gɛ saŋ Kooro Josia aa di kora la, Ijipt harɛ ta Kooro Neko kpɔ o laa tena ba Yufretis Moo ta ba cha Asiiria koojen.
Kooro Josia kpɔ o laa tena ka pu Kooro Neko yo, asɛ Kooro Neko kpoo bwɛjen Meɡido.
Kooro Josia bonɔɔna kpɔ o chɔɔ la do torɔɡo bini, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ka huɡo o ɡbaɡba lalbɔɔ bini.
Juda harɛ tena lawɛ Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoahas, dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, o chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Jehoahas Kooro Jehoahas di bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro mɔɔ dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora korobie atoro.
Dɛ o nya sɔne Hamutal, o ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Jeremia, o le bwɛjen Lebna ta.
Kooro Jehoahas teŋɛ o naawa wechɔɡa baa ɛa ta dɛ ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii nɛ.
Ijipt Kooro baa dɛ yerɔ Neko yo Kooro Jehoahas, dɛ lawɔ bwɛjen Ribla waa lɔ Hamat harɛ ta, dɛ vɔrɔwo jɔɡrɔre ne, asɛ o kora dii jaɡɛ bela.
Dɛ ɛɡre Juda tena lɛ toɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, ne suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛ.
Ijipt Kooro Neko kpɔ Kooro Josia bibaa Eliakim chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, o di kora Juda harɛ.
Kooro Neko charɛ Eliakim sɔn la dɛ pao Jehoiakim.
Dɛ kpɔ Kooro Jehoahas kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, asɛ o ka sewɛ bela.
Kooro Jehoiakim bɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm Ijipt Kooro Neko aa ɛɡ ba dɛɛ lɛ la.
Gɛ nomɛlbwa aa dɔa taa Kooro Jehoiakim nyiŋi dɛ lɛ suuɡa la, ɡɛ aa ɛ ó won bɔ toɔ la ɡɛ Kooro Neko aa dɛ nyin la.
Juda Kooro Jehoiakim Kooro Jehoiakim di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue mɔɔ dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Dɛ o nya sɔne Sebida, o ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Pɛdaya, o le Ruma.
Kooro Jehoiakim ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡɛ o naawa fa aa ɛa la.
Kooro Jehoiakim kora dii saŋ, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena dɛ ka lɛ Juda harɛ dɔɔh, asɛ Kooro Jehoiakim do o lɔɡa bene atoro dɛɛ tomɔ.
Kɛ o berɔ le Kooro Nebukadnesa habɔɔ.
Korowii tomɛ laa tena le Babelɔn ne Siiria ne Moab, dɛ Amɔn harɛre ta ŋɔ bá ba yo Kooro Jehoiakim dɛ́ chɔɡ Juda harɛ, ɡɛ o fa aa cheɡɛ o bonɔɔna keamere nɛɛ dɛ bol ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo la.
Gɛ waa nɔ ɛo ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa wɛɛ ɛo dɛ́ doŋ ba le o sie, Juda tena wechɔɡa Kooro Manasɛ aa ɛa la wa ne nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa ɛɛ o kpoo ba warɛ Jerusalam la wa.
Dɛ Korowii aa nyin kɛ ó kpɔ kɛo.
Wobɛlbwa Kooro Jehoiakim aa ɛa o kora dii saŋ bwa, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Jehoiakim sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ o bibaa Jehoiachin ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Ijipt kooro ne o laa tena ta wone le o harɛ la ta kpa.
Dɛ Babelɔn kooro lɛ harɛ Ijipt kooro fa aa dɔa la.
O leɔ le Yufretis Moo ta ba kaa Ijipt weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jwɛh ta.
Juda Kooro Jehoiachin Kooro Jehoiachin di bene fi dɛ anuatoro mɔɔ dɛ di kora.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora korobie atoro.
O nya sɔne Nehusta, o mɛɛ ɡe sɔne Ɛl Netan, o le Jerusalam.
Kooro Jehoiachin ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, ɡɛ o mɛɛ aa ɛa la.
O kora dii saŋee Babelɔn Kooro kpɔ o laa tena ba Jerusalam, dɛ ba chɔ baro dɛ yoo ba.
Gɛ saŋ Kooro Nebukadnesa laa tena aa chɔa bar Jerusalam la o ɡbabir ɡe la bela, asɛ Juda harɛ Kooro Jehoiachin ne o nya ne o bonɔɔna ne o nomonome, dɛ nɛra baa lɔ koodem bwa sɛh, dɛ kpɔ ba te do Kooro Nebukadnesa lɔɡa.
Kooro Nebukadnesa aa di kora bene anuatoro taa o ba lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiachin kaa bojaŋ Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Kooro Nebukadnesa ne Babelɔn tena la kaa jo Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bini ne koodem, dɛ pa suuɡaswɛm kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa Kooro Solomɔn aa kpɔa cheɡ bela.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ Korowii fa bol ŋɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ ɛo.
Kooro Nebukadnesa larawe Jerusalam nomonome ne laa tena bwa, ne nɛra baa jemɛ kwaa sɛɛh ne loɡra bwa kaa.
Dɛ ba lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fi, ba ta nomɛlbwa ɡelɛ, nemenɛ nɛra baa nyaa kohona, dɛ do bela ɡbosoo.
O kpɔ Kooro Jehoiachin ne o nya ne o haahna, ne nɛra baa lɔ koodem dɛ harɛ la ta nomonome, dɛ kpɔ ba kaa bojaŋ Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Babelɔn kooro ɡelɔ ba kpɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa banuanɛ ba bwa aa kpeɡa dɛ́ won yo laa, ne nɛra kaɡboŋ baa jemɛ kwaa sɛɛh ne kwaa loɡa, dɛ kpɔ ba kaa bojaŋ Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa cheɡ Kooro Jehoiachin mɛɛ nime baa dɛ yerɔ Matania kooro, o so Kooro Jehoiachin buɡ ta, dɛ ɛ Juda harɛ kooro.
Dɛ beɡre Matania sɔn Sedekia.
Juda Kooro Sedekia Kooro Sedekia di bene fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛ di kora.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
O nya sɔne Hamutal, Jeremia bihaahnee o le Lebna.
Kooro Sedekia ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, ɡɛ Kooro Jehoiakim aa ɛa la.
Korowii baah di Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ nɛra nɛɛ kohona, anomanta, o doŋ ba le o sie.
Kooro Sedekia baa ɛ Babelɔn kooro deŋnekpeɡ.
Jerusalam paɡra wa Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene anuanaarɛ, korobie fi tɔpera fi ta la, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena bwa kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ka yoo ba.
Ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene bwɛɛ la dahare, dɛ ma kwaa sawɛ bwɛjen la danjwɛɛ baa che a ta teeh jo o bini.
Ba teŋɔ tɔ bwɛɛ la tena do, ka tel Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta.
A ɡɛ benanyoa la korobinaarɛ tɔpenuanaarɛ ta, dɛ lɔr o nyoa aa do kpeɡri kohona chole bwɛjen Jerusalam, kondikwaa toole nɛra di.
Babelɔn laa tena la kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la.
Kooro Sedekia ne Jerusalam laa tena kpɔ doonyoa bɛl waa chɔ danjwɛɛre anɛ baah ta, ba kpɔ bela dɛɛ kaa kooro bodɛɛɡe waa du daa ta, dɛ le kpɔ sie chaɡɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta jwaana, kɛ Babelɔn laa tena la ti Kooro Sedekia, dɛ ka lawɔ Jeriko harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta, asɛ o laa tena bwa chwa ɡelo.
Ba lawɔ kaa bwɛjen Ribla ka tɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa o ka bol o waa dɛ pao bolchɔɡe.
Ba kpoo Kooro Sedekia bibaala o siwi ta, dɛ foromi o ɡe sibie, dɛ doo ayaawa jɔɡrɔre, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Babelɔn.
Korowii Dea chɔɡa wa Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuanaarɛ, korobie anue tɔpera anuanɛ ta la, o laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan la Jerusalam.
O kaa fuh Korowii Dea ne koodem, dɛ Jerusalam deremi bwa.
O fuh nomonjena dedɛɛɡe te bɛlbwa, asɛ Babelɔn laa tena Nebusaradan aa chɔ ba nyoa la kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la.
Laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan lawɛ nɛra baa ka bwɛjen la ta, ne tom-ɛɛra, dɛ banɔ la baa le Kooro Sedekia habɔɔ, dɛ ka teŋɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa nɛɛ la bwa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Kɛ o ɡel nyaara baa lɔ Juda harɛ la bane ŋɔ baa ɛ toma daa kooni ne kooni aa lɔ bela la ta.
Babelɔn laa tena la kuuɡi ayaawa pilare ne kwaa aa dɔ nakpale baa taɡa a do Korowii Dea, dɛ ayaawa loɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo la, dɛ kpɔ a bwa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Dɛ berɛ pa viine ne soofire ne kwaa baa pa tɔɔ dɛɛ do a bini, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ menɛ kandea ŋwɛɛra, ne loɡa baa kpɔa dɛɛ chaɡɛ kwaa baa dɛ kpoo chale, ne loɡa baa dɛ fuh daawiile a bini, dɛ ayaawa kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea bwa kaa.
Laa sitɔɔ la kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ buh nii, ne loɡa baa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ la, komɛlbwa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ne suuɡapoŋ ɛa te, ba kaa a bwa ne.
Ayaawa aa lɔ pilare anɛ la ta, ne kwaa aa dɔ nakpale baa taɡa, ne loɡbajen baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo Kooro Solomɔn ɛa cheɡ Korowii Dea la, a kan kohona kɛŋɔ ba won maɡɛ a tɔɡre.
Pilare anɛ la le dɔŋa, bɛlbwa jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ, asɛ ayaawa baa kpɔa ɛ a tɔɡre la, ɡe jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɛɛ ɛ naɡale anaarɛ ne tama.
Asɛ ba kpɔ ayaawa ɛ kafola a do ɡuleɡule kɛŋɔ, daa nɔna ane baa dɛ yera pɔmeɡranet ken, dawɛ pila la bɛlbwa doa dɛ bar.
Juda tena lawa dɛ́ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta Laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan lawɛ Sɔfonomoa Seraya ne o dɔŋ Sefania o ɡe aa dɛ chao, dɛ nomonome batoro bane baa dɛ daah doonyoa la laa ta kaa.
Ba bini banɔ la baa ka bwɛjen la bini la, o lawɛ nomoa waa chɔ laa tena nyoa, ne nɛra banue baa dɛ ja kooro la.
Dɛ lawɛ laa nomoa la nɛn waa dɛ chao dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, dɛ laa tena fifraanumɛl baa jaa dɛ do bwɛɛ la bini.
Babelɔn laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan kpɔ ba bwa kaa bwɛjen Ribla ka tɛ Babelɔn koojen.
Ribla waa lɔ Hamat harɛ taa Babelɔn kooro ɡel ba kpoo ba bela.
Gɛɛ a do ba lawɛ Juda tena le ba harɛ ta, dɛ kaa ba ne bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Gedalia ɛ Juda harɛ nomoa Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa le Ahikam bibaa Gedalia ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa ka Juda harɛ la nɛ.
Ahikam ɡe mɛɛ Safan.
Juda laa nomonome la bwa ne ba laa tena baa wola ban lawɛ kaa la aa noa kɛŋɔ Babelɔn kooro le Gedalia o ɛ ba harɛ nomoa la, ba la o be Mispa.
Banee Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael, ne Karea bibaa Johanan, ne Tanhumet bibaa Seraya, o ɛ Nɛtɔfa te.
Dɛ Jaasania, waa ɛ Maaka te bɛl bie, dɛ ba bala.
Belaa Gedalia ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡ ba ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ berɛ Babelɔn nomonome nɔ ɔma, hé so bonɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Babelɔn kooro, aa chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛɛ.” Korobie anuanɛ ta la, Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael, waa ɛ koobie, iro dɛ lawɛ baala fi ja o nɛɛ ba la Gedalia be Mispa, dɛ ka kpoo o ne Juda ne Babelɔn tena baa lɔ bela.
Ismael nabaa sɔne Elisama.
Aa ba ɡɛ la, Juda tena nyaara ne kpeɡnɛra bwa, dɛ ba laa nomonome la chwao kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ Babelɔn tena.
Ba le Kooro Jehoiachin dea Baa lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiachin laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ la, ɡɛ saŋee Babelɔn Kooro Evil Mɛrɔdak di kora.
O tɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ ɡel ba le Kooro Jehoiachin dea korobie fi dɛ anɛ, tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ ta.
Kooro Evil Mɛrɔdak bol wobodɛɛɡa tɛ Kooro Jehoiachin, dɛ tɛo jirima ɡwaa koranar baa ja o nɛɛ ba laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta Babelɔn bela la bwa.
Anomanta, Kooro Jehoiachin dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ laa laala waa doa ba doo dea la foo bil, dɛ kpɔ anfala do, asɛ o ne Babelɔn kooro pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwa o soɡa bini bwa.
Kooro Jehoiachin soɡa bini bwa la, dɛ Babelɔn Kooro Evil Mɛrɔdak dɛ tɛo suuɡa waa kpɔ yawɛ kwaa aa hiaoh.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Webena Baa Chwera Bil Tɔn Loɡle nɔ dɛ baɡle Israel harɛ webena baa chwera, dɛ kpɔa ja anɔ la aa lɔ Korowii Tɔn bini la ta, asɛ yaa kura la wa.
Ba chwerɛ Israel tena naanar waa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ do nyuune —, ne Korowii Dea tom-ɛɛra ne laa tena dɛ sitɔɔla waa do nyuune —.
Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle Kooro Devid waa kohona, ne ɡɛ waa nyin laala cheɡ tɛ o bibaa Solomɔn, ó do Korowii Dea bela baa dɛɛ tomɔ.
Le Adam ba Abraham bere saŋ Ya naa Adam aa ira la, o lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Sɛt.
Sɛt ir dɛ lolɛ Enɔs, Enɔs ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Kenan.
Kenan lolɛ Mahalalel, asɛ Mahalalel ɡe lolɛ Jarɛd.
Jarɛd ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Enɔk, Enɔk lolɛ Mɛtusala.
Asɛ o ɡe lolɛ Lamɛk, Lamɛk ɡe lolɛ Nowa.
Bibaala batoroo Nowa lolɛ.
Banee Sɛm ne Ham dɛ Jafɛt.
Jafɛt bii waa lol ba laanee teŋa nɔ, Goma ne Maɡɔɡ ne Madai ne Javan ne Tubal ne Mɛsɛk dɛ Tiras.
Ba sɔna nɔɔ ba kpɔ pa ba naanar.
Goma naanaree, Askenas ne Rifat dɛ Toɡama.
Javan naanaree, Elaisa ne Speen ne Saepros dɛ Roods tena.
Ham bibaala waa lol ba laanee teŋa nɔ, Kus ne Misraim ne Put dɛ Keenan.
Ba sɔna nɔɔ ba kpɔ pa ba naanar.
Kus naanaree, Seba ne Havila ne Sabta ne Raama dɛ Sabtɛka tena.
Raama ɡe naanaree, Seeba ne Dedan tena.
Kus bibaa bɛl ɡee Nimrod.
Onee waa baa kpeɡ la, o ɛ banyoo dɛ do kpeɡri kohona harɛ nɔ ta la.
Lud ne Anam ne Lɛhab dɛ Naftu tena nabaalee Misraim, ne Patrus ne Kaslu dɛ Kaftɔ tena.
Ba binii Filisti tena le.
Keenan ɡe aa baa kpeɡ la, o lolɛ o bibaa waa tɔ sie, dɛ pa o sɔn Sidon, asɛ a habɔɔ o berɛ lolɛ Hiti.
Ba sɔna nɔɔ ba kpɔ pa ba naanar, ne Jebus ne Amɔre dɛ Girɡasi tena, ne Hivi ne Aaki dɛ Sen tena, ne Aavad ne Semari dɛ Hamat tena.
Sɛm bibaala waa lol ba laanee teŋa nɔ, Elam ne Assur ne Aafaksad ne Lud dɛ Aram.
Aram ɡe aa ira la, o bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Us ne Hul ne Geta dɛ Mɛsɛk.
Aafaksadee lolɛ Seela, asɛ Seela ɡe lolɛ Iba.
Iba ɡe aa baa kpeɡ la, o lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Bɛl sɔne Pɛlɛɡ, dɛkalkɛ o saŋ taa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bini peɡri la.
Dɛ o nime ɡe sɔne Joktan.
Joktan naanaree, Almodad ne Sɛlɛf ne Hasamavɛt dɛ Jera tena, ne Hadoram ne Usal dɛ Dikla tena, ne Obal ne Abemɛl dɛ Seeba tena, ne Ofir ne Havila dɛ Jobab tena.
Kenii Sɛm ne o naanar dɛ kpoŋe ka le Abram nɛɛ waa do, Sɛm ne Aafaksad dɛ Seela, ne Iba ne Pɛlɛɡ dɛ Reu, ne Sɛrɔɡ ne Neehɔ ne Tɛɛra, dɛ Abram, baa bera baa yerɔ Abraham la.
Abraham naanar Abraham bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Aesek ne Ismael.
Ismael bibaala waa lol ba la, kenii ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, Nɛbayɔt ne Keda ne Adbeel dɛ Mibsam, ne Misma ne Duma ne Masa ne Hadad dɛ Tema ne Jetur ne Nafis dɛ Kedema.
Abraham berɔ kpɔ sɛno baa yerɔ Ketura.
O ne on lolɛ Simran ne Joksan ne Medan ne Midian ne Esbak dɛ Suwa.
Joksan ɡe bibaalaa, Seeba ne Dedan.
Midian bibaalaa, Efa ne Efar ne Hanɔk ne Abida dɛ Ɛldaa.
Ketura naanaree banɔ bwa.
Abraham lolɛ Aesek.
Aesek ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Esɔ ne Jekɔb.
Esɔ naanar Esɔ ɡe aa ira la, bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Elifas ne Ruwɛl ne Jeyus ne Jalam dɛ Kora.
Elifas naanaree, Teman ne Omar ne Sefo ne Gatam, ne Kenas ne Timna dɛ Amalɛk tena.
Ruwɛl naanaree, Nahat ne Sɛra ne Samaa dɛ Misa tena.
Nɛra baa tɔ sie ka so Edom harɛ ta Sɛɛ ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Lotan ne Sobal ne Sibeon dɛ Ana, ne Dison ne Esa dɛ Disan.
Lotan ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Hɔr ne Homam.
Dɛ Lotan nimambie sɔne Timna.
Sobal ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Alvan ne Manahat ne Ebal ne Sɛfo dɛ Onam.
Sibeon ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Aeya ne Ana.
Ana bibaa waa lolɔ sɔne Dison.
Dison ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ bibaala nɔ, Hɛmdan ne Ɛsban ne Itran dɛ Keran.
Asɛ Esa ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Bilhan ne Saavan dɛ Akan.
Disan ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ bibaala nɔ, Us ne Aran.
Edom koronar Koranar baa tɔ sie di Edom kora, mɔɔ Israel te bɛlbwa ɡe ba di la sɔnaa teŋa nɔ, Beɔ bibaa Bɛla di kora Edom.
Dɛ o bwɛjen sɔne Dinhaba.
Kooro Bɛla aa baa sewɛ la, Sɛra bibaa Jobab waa le bwɛjen Bosra baa so o buɡ ta.
Kooro Jobab ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Husam waa le Teman harɛ taa baa di kora.
Asɛ Kooro Husam ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Bɛdad bibaa Hadad ɡee baa chiɡ o naa ta di kora.
Onee fa yo Midian tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ Moab harɛ ta la.
O bwɛjen sɔne Avit.
Kooro Hadad ɡe baa sewɛ, asɛ Samla waa le bwɛjen Masrɛka ba di kora.
Kooro Samla ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Swaul waa le Rɛhɔbɔt waa chɔa bɛne nee laanee baa di kora.
Kooro Swaul ɡe baa sewɛ, asɛ Akbɔ bibaa Baal Hanan ɡe ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Kooro Baal Hanan ɡe aa baa sewɛ la, Hadad ɡe ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Dɛ o bwɛjen sɔne Pau.
O haah ɡe sɔne Mɛhetabɛl, o ɛ Matrɛd bihaah.
Matrɛd ɡe nya sɔne Mɛsahab.
Kooro Hadad ɡe baa sewɛ.
Edom tena koranaree nɔ, Timna ne Alva dɛ Jetɛt, ne Oholibama ne Ɛla dɛ Penɔn, ne Kenas ne Teman dɛ Mibsar, ne Maɡdiel dɛ Iram.
Bibaala Jekɔb aa lol ba Bibaala Jekɔb aa lol ba laanee nɔ.
Rubin ne Simeon ne Lewi ne Juda ne Isaaka dɛ Sebulon, ne Dan ne Josef ne Bɛnjamen ne Naftale ne Gad dɛ Aasa.
Juda ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee nɔ.
Ɛr ne Onan dɛ Seela.
A ɡɛ bibaala batoro nɔ, o ne o haah Sua waa ɛ Keenan te laanee lol ba.
Dɛ Ɛr waa ɛ Juda biloɡle la ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, anomanta, Korowii kpoo.
Juda bibaa haah waa ɛ o helahaah sɔne Taama, o ne o lolɛ Pɛrɛs ne Sɛra.
Juda bibaala waa lol ba bwa lɔ banue.
Pɛrɛs lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee, Hɛsrɔn ne Hamul.
Sɛra ɡe lolɛ bibaala banue.
Banee, Simri ne Etan ne Heman ne Kalkol dɛ Daada.
Kaami ɡe lolɛ bibaa, o sɔne Akan.
Onee kpɔ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii berɛ o kwa, dɛ ba waa ne ba tɛ Israel tena la.
Etan ɡe lolɛ bibaa beŋkpoŋ, o sɔne Asaria.
Kooro Devid luɡe nɛra Bibaala batoroo Hɛsrɔn lolɛ.
Banee, Jeramiil ne Ram dɛ Kaleb.
Ram iro dɛ lolɛ Aminadab, Aminadab ɡe lolɛ Naasɔn, o ɛ Juda tena sitɔɔla bini bɛl.
Naasɔn iro dɛ lolɛ Salmon, Salmon lolɛ Boas, Boas lolɛ Ɔbɛd, Ɔbɛd lolɛ Jese.
Jese lolɛ o biloɡle baa yerɔ Eliab, nɛɛte sɔne Abinadab, toorote ɡe Simia, Nɛtanɛl teŋɛ naarɛ, Radai teŋɛ nue, Osem teŋɛ numɛl, Devid teŋɛ nuanɛ.
Ba nimambihaahnaa, Seruya ne Abiɡel.
Seruya bibaala batoro waa lol ba sɔne Abisae ne Joab dɛ Asahɛl.
Abiɡel lolɛ Amasa, o mɛɛ baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jɛta, o ɛ Ismael naa.
Hɛsrɔn naanar Hɛsrɔn bibaa Kaleb mo haahna banɛ, bɛl sɔne Asuba, bɛl ɡe Jɛreɔt.
Asuba lolɛ bibaala batoro, banee, Jɛsa ne Sobab dɛ Aadɔn.
A habɔɔ, Asuba baa sewɛ, asɛ Kaleb ka mo Efrat dɛ lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Hur.
Hur ɡe iro dɛ lolɛ Uri, Uri ɡe lolɛ Besalɛl.
A habɔɔ, Hɛsrɔn aa dɔ bene fifraanumɛl la, o mo Makir bihaah waa ɛ Gelead nimambie.
Ba lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Seɡub, asɛ Seɡub ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Jɛɛ.
Dɛ Jɛɛ dɛ nyiŋi bwɛjena fifraanɛ dɛ atoro ta Gelead harɛ ta.
Kɛ Gesur ne Aram harɛre tena yo bwɛɛre fifraanumɛl.
Havɔt Jɛɛ ne Kenat, dɛ bwɛɛre aa baro cheme bwa ɡe jao.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ baa soɡe bela bwa ɛ Gelead mɛɛ Makir naanar.
Hɛsrɔn aa sewɛ Kaleb Efrata habɔɔ la, Hɛsrɔn haah Abija lolɛ Asur waa vɔrɔwe bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Tekoa.
Jeramiil naanar Hɛsrɔn binomoa Jeramiil bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Ram, o ɛ biloɡle, ne Buna ne Oren ne Osem dɛ Ahija.
Dɛ Jeramiil dɔ haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Atara, o bibaa sɔne Onam.
Jeramiil binomoa Ram bibaala waa lol ba laanee nɔ, Maas ne Jamin dɛ Eka.
Onam ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee, Samai ne Jada.
Asɛ Samai ɡe bibaala banɛ waa lol ba laanee, Nadab ne Abisur.
Dɛ Abisur haah sɔne Abihel, o ne o lolɛ Aban ne Molid.
Nadab ɡe bibaalaa, Sɛlɛd ne Apaem.
Kɛ Sɛlɛd te ta bii dɔe, dɛ sewɛ.
Apaem ɡe bibaa sɔne Isi, o ɡe aa ira la, o lolɛ Sɛsan.
Asɛ Sɛsan ɡe lolɛ Alae.
Jada waa ɛ Samai nime ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee, Jɛta ne Jonatan.
Jɛta te ta bii lolɛ dɛ sewɛ.
Jonatan lolɛ bibaala, banee, Pɛlet ne Sasa.
Jeramiil naanaree a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa.
Sɛsan ta bibaala lolɛ, bihaahna ɡboo.
Dɛ o dɔ Ijipt bonɔɔ bɛl baa yerɔ Jarha.
O lawɛ o bihaah la bɛl tɛ o bonɔɔ Jarha o mo, dɛ lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Atai.
Atai lolɛ Netan, Netan lolɛ Sabad, Sabad lolɛ Eflal, Eflal ɡe lolɛ Ɔbɛd, Ɔbɛd lolɛ Jehu, Jehu ɡe lolɛ Asaria.
Asaria lolɛ Hɛlɛs, Hɛlɛs ɡe lolɛ Eleasa.
Eleasa lolɛ Sismai, asɛ Sismai lolɛ Salum.
Salum lolɛ Jekamia, Jekamia ɡe lolɛ Elisama.
Kaleb naanar bane ɡe Jeramiil nime Kaleb bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Mesa waa ɛ o binomoa, onee lolɛ Sif, asɛ Sif ɡe lolɛ Maresa waa ɛ Hɛbrɔn tena nabaa.
Hɛbrɔn ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee.
Kora ne Tapua ne Rekem dɛ Sema.
Sema ɡee lolɛ Raham, Raham ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Jɔɔkeam, Rekem ɡe lolɛ Samai.
Samai bibaa waa lolɔ sɔne Mayɔn, asɛ Mayɔn ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Bɛt Sor.
Kaleb sɛno baa dɛ yerɔ Efa la bibaalaa, Haaran ne Mosa dɛ Gasɛs.
Haaran ɡe lolɛ Gasɛs.
Jadai ɡe lolɛ bibaala banumɛl, banee, Rɛɡɛm ne Jotam ne Gɛsan ne Pɛlɛt ne Efa dɛ Saaf.
Kaleb dɔ sɛno bɛl baa yerɔ Maaka.
O lolɛ bibaala banɛ, Sebar dɛ Tirihana.
Maaka berɔ lolɛ Saaf waa vɔrɔwe Madmana, ne o bibaa Sɛva o ɡe aa vɔrɔwe Makbɛna ne Gibia.
Dɛ Kaleb bihaah sɔne Aksa.
Gɛɛ Kaleb naanar waa do.
Kaleb binomoaa Hur, o ne o haah Efrataa lolɔ.
Hur ɡe bibaa sɔne Sobal, onee vɔrɔwe Kiriat Jearim, o binɛɛte sɔne Salma, onee vɔrɔwe Bɛtlɛham.
Bitoorote ɡe sɔne Harɛf, o ɡee vɔrɔwe Bɛt Gada.
Sobal waa vɔrɔwe Kiriat Jearim la naanaree, Harowɛ tena ne Manahat tena pera, ne Kiriat Jearim deene ane kɛŋɔ, Itri ne Put ne Sumat dɛ Misra tena.
Ba binii Sora tena ne Ɛstaol tena le.
Salma naanaree, Bɛtlɛham ne Nɛtɔfa ne Atrɔt Bɛt Joab, ne Manahat tena pera baa ɛ Sor tena, ne deene nɛra baa dɔ waa chwera dɛ bil wejema soɡe Jabɛs.
Banee Tira ne Simeat dɛ Suka tena.
Banɔɔ Ken tena baa le Haamat dɛ ɛ Rekab mɛɛ dea luɡe nɛra.
Kooro Devid bibaala Kooro Devid bibaala waa lol ba Hɛbrɔn laanee teŋa nɔ.
Binomoa sɔne Amnɔn, o nyaa Ahinoam, o le Jesreel, nɛɛtee Daneɛl, o nyaa Abiɡel, waa le Kaamɛl, toorote ɡe Absalɔm, o nyaa Maaka.
Gesur Kooro Talmai bihaahnee, naarɛte ɡee Adonija, o nyaa Haɡit, Sɛfatea teŋɛ, o nyaa Abital, asɛ Itriam teŋɛ, o nya sɔne Eɡla.
Kooro Devid aa di kora Hɛbrɔn bene anuanɛ korobie anumɛl la, a ɡɛ bibaala banumɛl nɔɔ o lolɛ.
O soɡe Jerusalam bene fifraatoro dɛ atoro dɛ di kora.
Bibaala baa lola tɛo Jerusalam laanee, Samoa ne Sobab ne Netan dɛ Solomɔn.
O ne o haah Batsiiba waa ɛ Ameɛl bihaah la bibaalaa banaarɛ nɔ.
Dɛ o dɔ bibaala banuanaarɛ bane ɡe.
Banee, Ibha ne Elisua dɛ Ɛlefɛlɛt, ne Nɔɡa ne Nɛfɛɡ dɛ Jafia, ne Elisama ne Eliada dɛ Ɛlefɛlɛt.
A ɡɛ bibaala nɔ bwa habɔɔ, dɛ Kooro Devid ne haahna baa ɛ o sɛnanar lolɛ bibaala bane ɡe.
Bihaah waa ja ba nɛɛ la sɔne Taama.
Kooro Solomɔn naanar Kooro Solomɔn naanar ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ nɔ.
Rɛhoboam ne Abija ne Asa dɛ Jehosafat, ne Jehoram ne Ahasia dɛ Joas, ne Amasea ne Ussia dɛ Jotam, ne Ahas ne Hɛsɛkea dɛ Manasɛ, ne Amɔn dɛ Josia.
Josia dɔ bibaala banaarɛ, banee, Johanan ne Jehoiakim ne Sedekia dɛ Salum.
Jehoiakim ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ, banee Jehoiachin ne Sedekia.
