Kooro Jehoiachin naanar Kooro Jehoiachin baa lawɔ laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta naanar waa nɔ.
Dɛ o dɔ bibaala banuanɛ, banee teŋa nɔ.
Sealteɛl, ne Malkiram ne Pɛdaya ne Sɛnasa ne Jekamia ne Hosama dɛ Nedabia.
Pɛdaya ɡe iro, dɛ lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee, Sɛrobabɛl ne Simee.
Sɛrobabɛl ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee, Mɛsolam ne Hanania.
Ba nimambie sɔne Sɛlomet.
Dɛ o dɔ bibaala banue bane ɡe.
Banee, Hasuba ne Ohel ne Bɛrekea ne Hasadia dɛ Jusab Hɛsɛd.
Hanania ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee Pɛlatea ne Jesaya, Jesaya lolɛ Refaya, o ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Aanan, o ɡe lolɛ Obadia, asɛ o ɡe lolɛ Sɛkania.
Sɛkania lolɛ bibaa beŋkpoŋ baa dɛ yerɔ Sɛmaya, asɛ o ɡe lolɛ bibaala banue.
Banee, Hatus ne Iɡal ne Baria ne Nearia dɛ Safat.
Nearia ɡe lolɛ bibaala batoro.
Banee, Elionai ne Hiskia dɛ Asrikam.
Elionai ɡe lolɛ bibaala banuanɛ.
Banee, Hodavia ne Eliasib ne Pɛlaya ne Akub ne Johanan ne Delaya dɛ Anani.
Juda naanar Juda ɡe naanaree, Pɛrɛs ne Hɛsrɔn ne Kaami ne Hur dɛ Sobal.
Sobal bibaalee Reaya, o ɡe lolɛ Jahat, Jahat lolɛ Ahumai dɛ Lahad.
Banɔɔ Sora tena naawa, dɛ che tɛ ba deene.
Etam bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Jesreel ne Isma dɛ Idbas.
Ba nimambihaah sɔne Haselelponi.
Pɛnoɛl bibaa sɔne Gedɔr, asɛ Esa ɡe lolɛ Husa.
Banee Hur waa ɛ Efrata binomoa, waa vɔrɔwe Bɛtlɛham la naanar.
Asur waa vɔrɔwe Tekoa la mo haahna banɛ.
Banee, Hela ne Naara.
Naara bibaala waa lol ba laanee Ahusam ne Hɛfa ne Temeni dɛ Haahastari.
Banee Naara naanar.
Hela ɡe bibaalaa, Sɛrɛt ne Soha dɛ Ɛtnan.
Kos ɡe bibaalaa Anub ne Hasobeba, dɛ deene ba naa aa le Harum bibaa Ahahɛl luɡe ta.
Dɛ Jabɛs lolanar bini la, dɛ onee dɔ duure kohona.
O nya pa o sɔn Jabɛs dɛ ŋɔ, “N bwara nyɛɡ mɛ o lola bini.” Jabɛs wio no Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, swee mɛ andɛɛɡa, dɛ́ ɡel n harɛ do kan!
Kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, dɛ́ lee mɛ waa aa kpɔ bonyɛɡa ba ta n nɛɛ ta.” Asɛ Korowii no o wesoŋa.
Lolanar bane baa jaa Suha dɔɔ Kelub, onee lolɛ Mehir, Mehir ɡe lolɛ Ɛstɔn.
Ɛstɔn ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Bɛt Rafa ne Pasea dɛ Tehina, asɛ Tehina ɡe lolɛ Ir Nahas.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ naanar fa soɡe Reka.
Kenas ɡe bibaalaa, Otniel ne Seraya.
Otniel ɡe bibaalaa, Hatat ne Meɔnɔtae.
Meɔnɔtae ɡee lolɛ Ofra.
Seraya ɡe lolɛ Joab, asɛ Joab ɡe ir, dɛ ka vɔrɔwe bwɛɛ fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, Ge Harasim.
Gɛɛ ba pa bela sɔn, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa soɡe bela dɛ sɛh kwa.
Jefune bibaa Kaleb bibaalaa, Iru ne Ɛla dɛ Naam.
Ɛla ɡe bibaalee, Kenas.
Jehalelɛl ɡe bibaalaa, Sif ne Sifa ne Tiria dɛ Asarɛl.
Ɛsera ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Jɛta ne Mɛrɛd ne Efar dɛ Jalɔn.
Mɛrɛd aa ira la, o mo haahna banɛ.
Ba bini bɛl bii waa lola laanee Miriam.
Dɛ o ɛ bihaah, ne Samai dɛ Isba ba ɡe aa ɛ bibaala.
Esba ɡe bibaalee Ɛstemoa.
Ɛstemoa haah Juda te laanee lolɛ Jɛrɛd, o ɡe lolɛ Gedɔr ne Heba, Heba lolɛ Soko dɛ Jekutiel, o ɡe lolɛ Sanoa.
A ɡɛ bibaala nɔɔ Ijipt kooro bihaah Bitia, Mɛrɛd aa moo la lolɛ.
Naham nahaah waa ɛ Hodia haah bibaalaa, Keila waa ɛ Gam te la mɛɛ, ne Maaka te Ɛstemoa.
Simon ɡe bibaalaa, Amnɔn ne Rina ne Bɛn Hanan dɛ Telɔn.
Asɛ Isi ɡe naanaree, Sohɛt ne Bɛn Sohɛt.
Seela naanar Seela ɛ Juda bibaala la bini beŋkpoŋ.
O naanaree Ɛr waa lolɛ Leka ne Laada waa lolɛ Maresa, ne dea bɛl nɛra baa dɛ ɛ yasɔɔhŋwɛɛra, dea waa lɔ Bɛt Asbea, ne Jokim ne baala baa lɔ Kosiba, ne Joas ne Saraf waa di kara Moab, dɛ Jasubi Lɛhɛm.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ le anɔ la saŋ la tena aa chwera bil la ta.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛ mamaala dɛ faa so Nɛtaem ne Gɛdɛra.
Dɛ ba soɡe bela dɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ kooro la.
Simeon naanar Simeon naanaree, Nemoɛl ne Jamin ne Jarib ne Sɛra dɛ Swaul, asɛ Swaul lolɛ Salum, Salum lolɛ Mibsam, Mibsam ɡe lolɛ Misma.
Misma ɡe luɡee la.
O lolɛ Hamoɛl, Hamoɛl lolɛ Sakur, Sakur lolɛ Simee.
Simee dɔ bibaala fi dɛ banumɛl ne bihaahna banumɛl, kɛ o nimanar te ta bii loɡlɛ kohona, anomanta, ba dea bii ta warɛ kɛ Juda dea tena.
Dɛ ba soɡe bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ Beɛseeba ne Molada ne Hasar Sual, ne Bilha ne Esem dɛ Tolad, ne Bɛtoɛl ne Hɔrma dɛ Siklaɡ, ne Bɛt Makabɔt ne Hasar Susim ne Bɛt Biri dɛ Saaraim.
Dɛ a ɡɛ bwɛɛre nɔ taa ba so mɔɔ Kooro Devid ba di kora.
Bwɛɛre aa bar ba cheme laanee, Etam ne Ain ne Remɔn ne Token dɛ Asan.
A bwa lɔ bwɛɛre anue, dɛ bwɛɛre aa bar bela dɛ kpoŋe kaa Baalat.
Dɛ belaa ba soŋni, asɛ ba chwerɛ ɡɛ ba naanar aa soɡa denaa ta.
Banee, Mɛsobab ne Jamlɛk dɛ Amasea bibaa Josa, ne Joel ne Josibia bibaa Jehu, ne Seraya bibaa Josibia, dɛ Aseɛl bibaa Seraya, ne Elionai ne Jaakoba ne Jesohia ne Asaya ne Adeɛl ne Jesimiel dɛ Bɛnaya, ne Sifi bibaa Sesa ne Alɔn bibaa Sifi, ne Jedaya bibaa Alɔn ne Simri bibaa Jedaya, dɛ Sɛmaya bibaa Simri.
Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛ nomonome, dɛ chɔ ba deene nyoo.
Ba mun yao kohona, asɛ dɛ yon le kaa Gedɔr dahare fɛlembɔjen la wee leebɔr, dɛ ka nyin dibɔra tɛ ba peera.
Ba dɔ harɛdɛɛɡe waa wera tɛ ba peera, dɛ harɛ la paɡri, deŋnesɔɔhna ɡe do o ta, dɛ sɔɔh.
Dɛ Ham tena bini bane fa soɡe bela.
Baala baa chwerɛ ba sɔna la balɔ Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea bere saŋ.
Ba kaa yo Ham tena la ba soŋnibɔra, ne Meuni tena ba ɡe aa lɔ bela, dɛ chɔɡ ba kwaraa.
A ɛ danseɛ dɛ ba le fini.
Ba kpɔ ba soŋnibɔra la so, dɛkalkɛ ba peera dɔ kondikwaa kohona dɛ́ di bela.
Belaa Simeon dea tena nɛra lafraanue ne ba nomonome, Pɛlatea ne Nearia ne Refaya ne Usiel baa ɛ Isi bibaala tɔ ba sie, ba ka yo harɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sɛɛ waa ɛ deŋɡarere harɛ.
Ba kpoo Amalɛk tena baa kaa la bwa, dɛ kpɔ bela so, dɛ ba le fini.
Rubin naanar Jekɔb binomoa sɔne Rubin, dɛ onee biloɡle, kɛ waa lawɛ o mɛɛ haah chɔ la nomanta, ba laa o nomonome lɛ o be tɛ o nime Josef.
A ɡɛ nomanta, o sɔn toole ɡɛ baa lol ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ la ta.
Dɛ Juda dea tena dɔ kpeɡri ɡwaa deene la bwa.
Kooro le bela dɛ tɛ deene la bwa, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ Josef dea fe dɔ kpeɡri kɛ biloɡle.
Rubin waa ɛ Jekɔb binomoa la bibaala waa lol ba laanee, Hanɔk ne Palu ne Hɛsrɔn dɛ Kaami.
Joel bie ne o naanar ɡee nɔ, Onee lolɛ Sɛmaya, Sɛmaya lolɛ Gɔɡ, Gɔɡ lolɛ Simee, Simee lolɛ Maeka, Maeka lolɛ Reaya, Reaya ɡe lolɛ Baal, Baal lolɛ Beera.
A ɡɛ Beera nɔɔ Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa lawɛ laa ta kaa harɛfale ta la.
Dɛ onee Rubin dea tena sitɔɔ.
Kenii ba chwerɛ Rubin dea nomonome lolanar ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Jeyɛl waa ɛ ba sitɔɔ ne Sekaria, ne Asas bibaa Bɛla, Sema bibaa Asas, dɛ Sema bibaa Joel.
Dɛ ba soɡo le harɛ waa le Arowa, dɛ kpoŋe ba le Nɛbo ne Baal Meɔn.
Harɛ la wee leebɔr, ba soɡo ka le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ kaa Yufretis Moo ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba kondɛɛra yao Gelead harɛ ta.
Kooro Sɔɔl bere saŋ la, ba kaa yo Haɡri tena laa dɛ kpoo ba, dɛ kpɔ ba harɛ waa lɔ Gelead wee leebɔr pera la so.
Gad dea tena Gad dea tena ɡe soɡo teŋɛ ba nɛ Basan harɛ ta, dɛ kpoŋe ka le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Saleka.
Joel ɛ ba sitɔɔ, asɛ Safam teŋɛ, asɛ Janai ne Safat ɡe ja ba bwa so Basan harɛ ta.
Ba lola bini, ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ laanee, Maekel ne Mɛsolam ne Seeba ne Jorai ne Jakan ne Siia dɛ Iba.
Ba lɔ nɛra banuanɛ.
Dɛ ba ɛ Huri bibaa Abihel bibaala, Jaroa bibaa Huri ne Jaroa bibaa Gelead, ne Gelead bibaa Maekel ne Maekel bibaa Jesisai, ne Jesisai bibaa Jado, dɛ Jado bibaa ne Bus, ne Abdeɛl bibaa Ahi, o naa ɛ Guni la, onee ɛ nomonnyu dɛ chɔ ba nyoa.
Dɛ Gad tena soɡe Gelead ne Basan harɛre ta ne bwɛɛre aa bara bwa, dɛ kondɛɛra dibɔra aa chɔa dɛ kaa dɛ do Sarɔn bwa.
Ba chwerɛ ɡɛ naanar nɔ bwa sɔna, ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Jotam aa di kora, ne Israel Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ aa di kora.
Rubin ne Gad dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena lɔ baala kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banaarɛ, lafraanuanɛ fifraanumɛl baa dɛ ba wona yo laa.
Ba ɛ baala baa dɛ ba wona kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe, dɛɛ yo laa ne keri ne tori, dɛ dɔ laa yoi wejema.
Ba kaa yo Haɡri ne Jetur ne Nafis dɛ Nɔdab tena bwa.
Korowii cha ba dɛ ɡel ba pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ kpɔ Haɡri tena ne nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ bwa do ba nɔn ta, dɛkalkɛ laa la ta la, ba wio no Korowii.
Ba lawɛ Haɡri tena kondɛɛra bwa kaa.
Nyoɡmare lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue, ne peera kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ fifraanue, dɛ keeɡore kaɡboŋa anɛ.
Ba lawɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa laa la ta, asɛ dɛ kpoo nɛra baa wara keri ne, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Korowiirii yoa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Ate, ba so harɛ la ta ka tel kɛŋɔ baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfale ta.
Manasɛ dea pera nɛra Manasɛ dea pera tena la warɔ, dɛ so le Basan harɛ ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Baal Hɛmɔn ne Senir, dɛ Hɛmɔn Bwejen ta.
Nomonnyuune baa chɔ ba nyoo laanee, Efar ne Isi ne Eliel, ne Asriel ne Jeremia ne Hodavia dɛ Jadiel.
Dɛ ba ɛ nomonnyuune, dɛ ɛ banyoola dɛ berɛ dɔ sɔna kɛrɛdɛ.
Kɛ dɛ ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la be, dɛ ɡelo kaa tomɛ nɛra Korowii aa doŋa ba siwi ta voɡare.
Anomanta, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ ɡelɔ Asiiria koojen Pul baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Tiɡlat Pilesa ka yoo ba, dɛ lawɛ Rubin ne Gad dea, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena bwa laa ta kaa harɛfale ta.
O kaa bane Hala ne Habɔ ne Hara dɛ Gosan Moo ta.
Ba lɔ bela dɛ ba le fini.
Lewi dea tena Lewi bibaalaa, Gɛsɔn ne Kohat dɛ Merari.
Kohat ɡe bibaalaa, Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.
Amram ɡe dɔ bibaala banɛ, Arɔn ne Mosis, asɛ o bihaah beŋkpoŋ sɔne Miriam.
Arɔn ɡe bibaalaa, Nadab ne Abihu ne Eliasa dɛ Itama.
Eliasaa lolɛ Fenehas, Fenehas ɡe lolɛ Abisua, Abisua ɡe lolɛ Buki, Buki ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Usi, Usi ɡe lolɛ Serahia, Serahia ɡe lolɛ Merayɔt.
Merayɔt lolɛ Amaria, Amaria lolɛ Ahitub, Ahitub lolɛ Sadɔk, Sadɔk lolɛ Ahimas, Ahimas lolɛ Asaria, Asaria ɡe lolɛ Johanan.
Johanan lolɛ Asaria, a ɡɛ Asaria nɔɔ fa di sɔfore Korowii Dea Kooro Solomɔn aa doa Jerusalam la.
Asaria lolɛ Amaria, Amaria ɡe lolɛ Ahitub, Ahitub lolɛ Sadɔk, Sadɔk ɡe lolɛ Salum, Salum lolɛ Hilkia, Hilkia ɡe lolɛ Asaria, Asaria lolɛ Seraya, Seraya ɡe lolɛ Jehosadak.
Korowii ɡelɔ Kooro Nebukadnesa lawɛ Jehosadak, ne Juda tena bane, ne Jerusalam tena bane laa ta kaa harɛfale ta.
Lewi naanar bane ɡe Lewi bibaalaa, Gɛsɔn ne Kohat dɛ Merari.
Gɛsɔn ɡe bibaalaa, Libni ne Simee.
Kohat ɡe bibaalaa, Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.
Merari ɡe bibaalaa, Maali ne Musi.
Banɔɔ Lewi dea nomonome, ne ɡɛ ba mɛɛnanar aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, Gɛsɔn lolɛ Libni, Libni lolɛ Jahat, Jahat ɡe lolɛ Sima, Sima lolɛ Joa, Joa lolɛ Ido, Ido lolɛ Sɛra, Sɛra ɡe lolɛ Jeaterai.
Kenii Kohat naanar teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Onee lolɛ Aminadab, Aminadab lolɛ Kora, Kora ɡe lolɛ Asir.
O ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Ɛlkana, Ɛlkana lolɛ Ɛbeasaf, Ɛbeasaf ɡe lolɛ Asir.
Asir ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Tahat, Tahat ɡe lolɛ Uriel.
O ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Ussia, Ussia ɡe lolɛ Swaul.
Bibaala banɛɛ Ɛlkana lolɛ.
Banee, Amasae ne Ahemɔt.
Ahemɔt aa ira la o lolɛ Ɛlkana, Ɛlkana lolɛ Sofai, o ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Nahat, Nahat lolɛ Eliab, Eliab lolɛ Jɛroham, o ɡe lolɛ Ɛlkana, Ɛlkana lolɛ Samoɛl.
Samoɛl ɡe bibaalaa, o binomoa sɔne Joel, nɛɛte ɡe Abija.
Merari ɡe lolɛ Maali, Maali lolɛ Libni, Libni lolɛ Simee, Simee ɡe lolɛ Ussa.
Ussa lolɛ Simia, Simia lolɛ Haɡia asɛ Haɡia ɡe lolɛ Asaya.
Korowii Dea hɛhɛla ne yelɡoola Baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka ba Jerusalam bela baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la, baala Kooro Devid aa lee ba ba chɔ yela nyoa laanee nɔ.
Dɛ banee dɛɛ nyiŋi, baa ɡo yela Korowii Tɛnte Dea, waa ɛ o Dea Cheremibɔr bela, mɔɔ Kooro Solomɔn ba do Korowii Dea Jerusalam la.
Ba ɛ ba toma ɡɛ baa lea cheɡ ba ŋɔ ba ɛa ta.
Baala ba ne ba bibaala aa pea ɛ toma laanee nɔ.
Nɛra baa le Kohat tena bini laanee, Joel bibaa Heman waa ɛ yelɡoɡoo, Samoɛl bibaa Joel, Ɛlkana bibaa Samoɛl, Jɛroham bibaa Ɛlkana, ne Eliel bibaa Jɛroham, dɛ Toa bibaa Eliel, ne Suf bibaa Toa, ne Ɛlkana bibaa Suf, ne Mahat bibaa Ɛlkana, dɛ Amasae bibaa Mahat, ne Ɛlkana bibaa Amasae, ne Joel bibaa Ɛlkana, ne Asaria bibaa Joel, dɛ Sefania bibaa Asaria ne Tahat bibaa Sefania, ne Asir bibaa Tahat, ne Ɛbeasaf bibaa Asi, dɛ Kora bibaa Ɛbeasaf, ne Isiha bibaa Kora, Kohat bibaa Isiha, ne Lewi bibaa Kohat, dɛ Jekɔb bibaa Lewi, ne Heman dɔŋ Asaf waa chao dɛɛ tomɛ, ne Barakia bibaa Asaf, dɛ Simia bibaa Bɛrekea, ne Maekel bibaa Simia, ne Baaseya bibaa Maekel, dɛ Malkija bibaa Baaseya, ne Ɛtini bibaa Malkija, ne Sɛra bibaa Ɛtini, dɛ Adaya bibaa Sɛra, ne Etan bibaa Adaya, dɛ Sima bibaa Etan, dɛ Simee bibaa Sima, ne Jahat bibaa Simee, ne Gɛsɔn bibaa Jahat, dɛ Lewi bibaa Gɛsɔn, ne Merari tena baa jaa dɛ che o ɡal, ne Kisi bibaa Etan, ne Abdi bibaa Kese, dɛ Maluk bibaa Abdi, ne Hasabia bibaa Maluk, ne Amasea bibaa Hasabia, dɛ Hilkia bibaa Amasea, ne Amsi bibaa Helkaya, ne Bani bibaa Amsi, dɛ Sɛma bibaa Bani, Maali bibaa Sɛma, ne Musi bibaa Maali, ne Merari bibaa Musi, dɛ Lewi bibaa Merari.
Ba bala Lewi dea tena la nɔn taa ba kpɔ Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela baa dɛ tomɛ la toma aa kaa la do.
Arɔn naanar Arɔn ne o naanar ɡboo dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ba kon baa dɛ fuh saraha o ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɡe ba kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile o ta la ta.
Banee dɛɛ ɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela toma, dɛ́ soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa Korowii be ó kpɔ kɛ ba, ɡɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa do ba la.
Kenii Arɔn bibaala ne o naanar ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, onee lolɛ Eliasa, Eliasa lolɛ Fenehas, Fenehas ɡe lolɛ Abisua, Abisua lolɛ Buki, Buki lolɛ Usi, Usi ɡe lolɛ Serahia, Serahia lolɛ Merayɔt, Mɛrayɔt lolɛ Amaria, Amaria lolɛ Ahitub, Ahitub lolɛ Sadɔk, Sadɔk ɡe lolɛ Ahimas.
Bela Lewi dea tena aa soɡa Harɛ baa kpɔa tɛ Arɔn naanar baa le Kohat dea laanee nɔ.
Banee dɔ bɔr waa tɔ sie baa kpɔa tɛ Lewi dea tena o ɛ ba kon.
Hɛbrɔn waa lɔ Juda harɛ ne o kondɛɛra dibɔra aa baro laanee ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Kɛ harɛpare ne bwɛɛre aa bar bwejen la, ba kpɔɔ tɛ Jefune bibaa Kaleb.
Gɛɛ ba kpɔ Hɛbrɔn, o ɛ bwɛjen dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so o ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu, ne Lebna, ne Jatir dɛ Ɛstemoa, ne Hilen dɛ Debir, ne Asan ne Juta, dɛ Bɛt Sɛmɛs ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa tɛ Arɔn naanar.
Bɛnjamen dea tena ɡe, ba kpɔ Gebeɔn ne Geba ne Alemɛt ne Anatɔt dɛ a kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa jaa ba.
Bwɛɛre baa bɔna tɛ Kohat dea tena nɔ bwa lɔ fi dɛ atoro.
Kohat dea naanar baa kaa la, bwɛɛre fii ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba dɛ le Manasɛ dea pera tena be.
Gɛsɔn naanar ɡe bini deenaa ta la, bwɛɛre fi dɛ atoroo ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba, dɛ le Isaaka ne Aasa ne Naftale dɛ Manasɛ dea pera waa lɔ Basan harɛ la be.
Merari naanar deenaa ta ɡe, ba dɔ bwɛɛre fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ le Rubin ne Gad dɛ Sebulon deene tena be.
Gɛɛ Israel tena tɛ Lewi dea tena bwɛɛre nɔ ne ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa ba so.
Juda ne Simeon dɛ Bɛnjamen deene bwɛɛre baa tɔ sie kpɔ tɛɛ ba la, daa ba bil, dɛ bɔɔ le Korowii be mɔɔ.
Ba tɛ Kohat dea bii la bane bwɛɛre ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra dɛ le Efrem dea tena harɛ ta.
Efrem dea tena harɛ waa ɛ deŋɡarere harɛ la, ba tɛɛ ba bwɛjen Sɛkem, dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so o ta dɛ dɔ o nyu, dɛ Gɛsa, ne Jokmeam dɛ Bɛt Hɔrɔn, ne Aejalɔn ne Gat Remɔn, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwaa ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Kohat dea tena kabora la ɡe, Israel tena tɛɛ ba bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ, Ana ne Beleam ne ba kondɛɛra dibɔra, dɛ le Manasɛ dea pera kon ta.
Gɛsɔn tena ɡe bɔr baa dɔa laanee nɔ.
Dɛ le Manasɛ dea pera tena be harɛ ta la, bwɛɛre baa dɔa laanee, Golan waa lɔ Basan harɛ ta ne Astarɔt, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa.
Isaaka dea tena ɡe be ba dɔ Kedes ne Daberat ne Ramɔt ne Anem, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa, Aasa dea tena ɡe be ba dɔ Masal ne Abdɔn ne Hukok ne Rehob, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa, Naftale dea tena ɡe be ba dɔ Kedes waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta ne Hamɔn ne Kiriataim, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa.
Merari tena baa ɛ Lewi dea tena kabora ɡe bwɛɛre baa dɔa, dɛ le Sebulon dea tena be laanee nɔ.
Jokneam ne Kaata ne Rimono ne Tabɔ, dɛ ba kondɛɛre dibɔra bwa.
Rubin dea tena ɡe be, bwɛɛre aa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ, Jeriko wee leebɔr, ba dɔ Bɛsa waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ne Jaasa, ne Kedemɔt ne Mɛfaat, dɛ ba kondɛɛre dibɔra bwa.
Asɛ Gad dea tena ɡe be, ba dɔ Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta ne Mahanaim ne Hɛsbɔn ne Jasa, dɛ ba kondɛɛre dibɔra bwa.
Isaaka dea tena Isaaka bibaalaa, Tola ne Pua ne Jasub ne Simron.
Ba lɔ bibaala banaarɛ.
Tola ɡe bibaalaa, Usi ne Refaya ne Jeriel ne Jamai ne Ibsam dɛ Samoɛl.
Dɛ ba bwa ɛ nomonnyuune.
Kooro Devid bere saŋ la, dɛ Tola naanar baa tela ne laa laŋa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ lafraanumɛl.
Usi ɡe bibaalee, Israhia.
Israhia ɡe bibaalaa, Maekel ne Obadia ne Joel dɛ Isihia.
Bii banue nɔ bwa ɛ koranar.
Ba mo haahna warɛ, asɛ ba bibaala ɡe warɛ, anomanta, ba dɔ baala kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ banumɛl baa tela ne laa laŋa.
Isaaka dea bibaala baa tela ne laa laŋa, ba kur ba dɛ́ le o dea bwa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanuatoro dɛ banuanɛ.
Bɛnjamen ne Dan naanar Bɛnjamen dɔ bibaala batoro, banee, Bɛla ne Bɛka dɛ Jedial.
Bɛla ɡe bibaalaa, Ɛsbɔn ne Usi ne Usiel ne Jerimot dɛ Iri.
Ba lɔ nɛra banue, dɛ bwa ɛ nomonnyuune.
Ba baala baa tela ne laa laŋa ba kur ba lɔ, nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ dɛ fifraatoro nɛra banaarɛ.
Bɛka ɡe bibaalaa, Sɛmira ne Joas ne Eliesa ne Elionai ne Omri ne Jɛremɔt ne Abija ne Anatɔt dɛ Alemɛt.
Ba bwa lɔ bibaala banuanaarɛ.
Ba kure ba dea nomonnyuune, asɛ baala baa tela ne laa laŋa lɔ, nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ lafraanɛ.
Jedial ɡe bibaalee, Bilhan.
Bilhan ɡe bibaalaa, Jeyus ne Bɛnjamen ne Ehud ne Kenaana ne Sɛtan ne Taases dɛ Ahisaha.
Dɛ Jedial bibaala nɔ bwa ɛ nomonnyuune.
Ba dɔ baala kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banuanɛ lafraanɛ baa dɛ ba wona la laa.
Ir naanaree Supi tena ne Hupi tena.
Asɛ Hus tena ɡe ɛ Aha naanar.
Naftale naanar Naftale bibaalaa, Jaseel ne Guni ne Jesa dɛ Silem.
Bilha naanaree ba bwa.
Manasɛ naanar Manasɛ naanar ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ nɔ.
O ne Aram te waa ɛ o sɛno la lolɛ Asriel ne Makir, Makir ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Gelead.
Makir mo haah tɛ Hupim, dɛ mo bɛl tɛ Supim ɡe.
Dɛ Makir dɔ nimambie bɛl baa yerɔ Maaka.
O dɔ bibaa bɛl baa yerɔ Selofehad.
Bihaahna ɡboo o te lolɛ.
Makir haah Maaka lolɛ bibaala banɛ, bɛl sɔne Pɛres asɛ nɛɛte ɡe Sɛrɛs.
Pɛres ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Ulam ne Rakem.
Ulam ɡe bibaalee, Bɛdan.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Gelead o mɛɛ aa ɛ Makir, o nabaa ɛ Manasɛ la naanar.
Dɛ Gelead dɔ nimambie bɛl baa yerɔ Hamɔlɛkɛt.
Onee lolɛ Esɔd ne Abeɛsa dɛ Maala.
Sɛmeda bibaalaa, Ahian ne Sɛkem ne Liki dɛ Aniam.
Efrem naanar Efrem ɡe bibaala ne o naanar wa.
Onee lolɛ Sutela, Sutela lolɛ Bɛrɛd, Bɛrɛd lolɛ Tahat, Tahat lolɛ Eleada, Eleada ir, dɛ lolɛ Tahat, Tahat lolɛ Sabad, Sabad ɡe lolɛ Sutela.
Efrem berɔ lolɛ bibaala bane ɡe baa yer ba Esa ne Elead.
Esa ne Elead iro ŋɔ ba ka ŋwɛ Gat tena kondɛɛra, asɛ ba kpoo ba.
Ba mɛɛ Efrem ɛ ba lwe biɡri, asɛ o lolanar ba larawe o bwara.
A habɔɔ, o haah kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Bɛrea, dɛkalkɛ o ne o bibaala dɛ na wahala ba soɡa bini.
Efrem dɔ bihaah baa yerɔ Seera.
Seera vɔrɔwe Bɛt Hɔrɔn waa chɔ nyunduabɔr, ne Bɛt Hɔrɔn waa chɔ harɛbɔr dɛ Usen Seera.
Efrem dɔ bie bɛl ɡe baa yerɔ Refa, asɛ o lolɛ Resɛf, Resɛf lolɛ Tela, Tela ɡe lolɛ Tahan, Tahan lolɛ Ladan, Ladan lolɛ Amihud, Amihud ɡe lolɛ Elisama, Elisama lolɛ Nun, asɛ Nun ɡe lolɛ Josua.
Ba harɛ baa dɔa dɛ so o ta le Bɛtel ne bwɛjeɡre aa baro, dɛ kpoŋe ka le Naaran wee leebɔr, ne Gɛsa ne bwɛɛre aa baro wee cholibɔr, ne Sɛkem ne bwɛɛre aa lɔ Aeja ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ a bwɛɛre aa baro bwa.
Dɛ kpoŋe ka le Manasɛ dea jwɛh ta kaa Bɛt San ne Taanak ne Meɡido ne Dɔr, dɛ bwɛɛre aa bar bela bwa.
Dɛ Jekɔb bibaa Josef naanaree sosoɡe a ɡɛ bwɛɛre nɔ ta.
Aasa naanar Aasa ɡe bibaalaa, Imna ne Isva ne Isvi dɛ Bɛrea.
Bihaah beŋkpoŋ waa ja ba nɛɛ sɔne Sera.
Bɛrea ɡe bibaalaa, Heba ne Malkeɛl, asɛ Malkeɛl ir dɛ lolɛ Birsait.
A ɡɛ Malkeɛl nɔɔ vɔrɔwe bwɛjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Birsait.
Heba ɡe bibaalaa, Jaflɛt ne Soma dɛ Hotam.
Ba nimambie sɔne Sua.
Jaflɛt ɡe bibaalaa, Pasak ne Bimhal dɛ Asvat.
Soma ɡe bibaalaa, Ahi ne Roɡa ne Huba, dɛ Aram.
O nime Hɛlɛm ɡe bibaalaa, Sofa ne Imna ne Sɛlɛs dɛ Amal.
Sofa ɡe bibaalaa, Suua ne Haanefa ne Sual ne Bɛre dɛ Imra ne Bɛsa ne Hod ne Sama ne Silsa ne Itran dɛ Beera.
Jɛta ɡe bibaalaa, Jefune ne Pispa dɛ Ara.
Ula ɡe bibaalaa, Ara ne Haneɛl dɛ Risia.
Aasa naanaree a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa.
Ba ɛ nomonnyuune ne banyoola, dɛ dɔ sɔna kohona.
Ba baala baa kpeɡa ba kur ba bá won la laa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banumɛl.
Bɛnjamen naanar Bɛnjamen biloɡle la sɔne Bɛla, Asbɛl teŋɛ nɛɛ, asɛ Ahara teŋɛ tooro, Nɔha teŋɛ naarɛ, asɛ Rafa teŋɛ nue.
Bɛla ɡe bibaalaa, Adaar ne Gɛra dɛ Abihud ne Abisua ne Naaman dɛ Ahoa ne Gɛra ne Sɛfofan dɛ Hiram.
Ehud naanar baa ɛ nomonnyuune tɛ nɛra baa soɡe Geba, ba laɡ ba kaa harɛfale Manahat ta laanee, Naaman ne Ahija dɛ Gɛra bwa ɛ Ehud bibaala, asɛ Gɛra waa ɛ Usa ne Ahihud mɛɛ la tɔ ba sie.
Saharaim baa vɛh o haahna Husim ne Baara, asɛ o berɛ mo hanfale baa dɛ yerɔ Hodes, dɛ lolɛ bibaala bane Moab harɛ ta.
Bii o ne waa lol ba laanee, Jobab ne Sibia ne Mesa ne Malkam ne Jeyus ne Sakia dɛ Mirma.
Dɛ a ɡɛ bibaala nɔ bwa ɛ nomonnyuune.
O haah Husim lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Bɛl sɔne Abitub, nɛɛte ɡe Ɛl Paal.
Ɛl Paal ɡe bibaalaa, Iba ne Misam ne Sɛmɛd, onee vɔrɔwe Ono ne Lod bwɛɛre, dɛ bwɛjeɡre aa bara cheme bwa.
Bɛrea ne Sema ba ɡe aa ɛ nomonnyuune, dɛ chɔ nɛra bane baa soɡe bwɛjen Aejalɔn nyoa, dɛ berɛ doŋi Gat tena baa soɡe bela la.
Ahio ne Sasak dɛ Jɛremɔt ne Sebadia ne Arad dɛ Ida ne Maekel ne Ispa dɛ Joha bwa ɛ Bɛrea naanar.
Ɛl Paal naanaree, Sebadia ne Mɛsolam ne Hiski dɛ Heba, ne Ismerai ne Islia dɛ Jobab.
Jakim ne Sikri dɛ Sabdi ne Elienai ne Siletai dɛ Eliel ne Adaya ne Bɛraya dɛ Simrat bwa ɛ Simee naanar.
Asɛ Ispan ne Iba dɛ Eliel ne Abdɔn ne Sikri dɛ Hanan, ne Hanania ne Elam dɛ Antotija, ne Ifdeya dɛ Pɛnoɛl bwa ɛ Sasak ɡe naanar.
Samserai ne Seharia dɛ Atalia, ne Jaaresia ne Elaeja dɛ Sikri bwa ɛ Jɛroham naanar.
Banɔ bwa ɛ nomonnyuune ne koranar ba deremi, ba kur ba ba bwa so Jerusalam.
Jeyɛl vɔrɔwe bwɛjen Gebeɔn dɛ so bela.
O haah sɔne Maaka.
O binomoa sɔne Abdɔn.
O bibaala baa jaa laanee, Sor ne Kes ne Baal ne Nɛr dɛ Nadab, ne Gedɔr ne Ahio dɛ Sɛka, dɛ Meklɔt o ɡe aa lolɛ Simea.
Dɛ ba ɡe soɡo bɛne ba lolanar Jerusalam.
Nɛr lolɛ Kes, Kes ɡe lolɛ Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl lolɛ Jonatan ne Malki Sua ne Abinadab dɛ Ɛsbaal.
Jonatan ɡe bibaalee, Mɛreb Baal, o ɡe aa lolɛ Maeka.
Maeka ɡe bibaalaa, Petɔn ne Mɛlɛk ne Tarea dɛ Ahas.
Ahas ɡee lolɛ Jehoada, Jehoada ɡe lolɛ Alemɛt ne Asmavɛt dɛ Simri, asɛ Simri ɡe lolɛ Mosa.
Mosa ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Binia, Binia ɡe lolɛ Raafa, Raafa ɡe lolɛ Eleasa, asɛ Eleasa ɡe lolɛ Asɛl.
Bibaala banumɛlee Asɛl ɡe lolɛ.
Banee, Asrikam ne Bokeru ne Ismael ne Searia ne Obadia dɛ Hanan.
O nime Esɛk ɡe bibaalaa, Ulam, onee binomoa, Jeyus teŋɛ nɛɛ, Ɛlefɛlɛt ɡe teŋɛ tooro.
Ulam bibaala waa lol ba ɛ banyoola dɛ jemɛ to ne yoi kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba dɔ bibaala ne naanar taeh, ba lɔ nɛra lafa fifraanue.
Bɛnjamen naanaree ba nɔ bwa.
Ba chwerɛ Israel tena bwa sɔna denaa ta do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Nɛra baa soɡe Jerusalam Juda tena wechɔɡa nomanta, ba laɡ ba laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛr ba deŋne.
Nɛra baa tɔ sie dɛ berɛ ba so ba ɡbaɡba deremi ta ne ba bwɛɛre ta laanee, Israel tena la bini bane ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea toma.
Banɔ la baa le Juda ne Bɛnjamen ne Efrem dɛ Manasɛ deene ta dɛ ba so Jerusalam laanee nɔ.
Amihud bibaa Utai ne Omri bibaa Amihud, Imri bibaa Omri, asɛ Bani bibaa Imri, Bani ɛ Juda bibaa Pɛrɛs naa la.
Silo tena baa jaa laanee, Asaya, onee binomoa dɛ o bibaala.
Sɛra te waa jaa laanee, Jeyuwel.
Nɛra baa le Juda dea lɔ nɛra lafraanumɛl fifraanuanaarɛ.
Bɛnjamen dea tena ɡee, Mɛsolam bibaa Sallu, ne Hodavia bibaa Mɛsolam ne Hasenua bibaa Hodavia, ne Jɛroham bibaa Ibneya, ne Usi bibaa Ɛla, ne Mikri bibaa Usi, ne Sɛfatea bibaa Mɛsolam, ne Ruwɛl bibaa Sɛfatea, dɛ Ibnija bibaa Ruwɛl.
Nɛra baa le Bɛnjamen dea ba chwerɛ ba sɔna bwa lɔ nɛra lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanue dɛ banumɛl.
Dɛ ba ɛ nomonnyuune.
Sɔfore ɡee, Jedaya ne Jehoiarib dɛ Jakin, ne Hilkia bibaa Asaria, ne Mɛsolam bibaa Hilkia ne Sadɔk bibaa Mɛsolam, ne Merayɔt bibaa Sadɔk, ne Ahitub bibaa Merayɔt.
Asaria, dɛ onee nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea la ta.
Jɛroham bibaa Adaya, ne Pasur bibaa Jɛroham, ne Malkija bibaa Pasur, ne Adeɛl bibaa Maasai, ne Jasera bibaa Adeɛl ne Mɛsolam bibaa Jasera, ne Mɛselɛmet bibaa Mɛsolam, dɛ Ima bibaa Mɛselɛmet.
Dɛ sɔfore baa ɛ nomonnyuune la bwa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋ lafraanuanɛ fifraanumɛl, dɛ dɔ wejema dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea.
Lewi dea tena ɡee, Hasub bibaa Sɛmaya, ne Asrikam bibaa Hasub dɛ Hasabia bibaa Asrikam, o ɛ Merari te, ne Bakbakaa, ne Hɛrɛs ne Galal, ne Mika bibaa Matania, ne Sikri bibaa Mika, dɛ Asaf bibaa Sikri, ne Sɛmaya bibaa Obadia, ne Galal bibaa Sɛmaya, ne Jedutun bibaa Galal, ne Asa bibaa Bɛrekea, dɛ Ɛlkana bibaa Asa, o fa soɡe Nɛtɔfa tena harɛ ta.
Nɛra ba ɡe aa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa laanee, Salum ne Akub, ne Talmɔn ne Ahiman dɛ ba dɔɔranar ne nimanar.
Asɛ Salum ɛ ba bwa nyu te dɛ so doonyoa bɛl nyoa baa yerɔ Kooro Doonyoa wee leebɔr.
Dɛ banɔɔ dɛɛ daah bela Lewi dea tena aa soɡa la doonyoo a ɡɛ saŋ.
Kore bibaa Salum waa ɛ Ɛbeasaf naa ne o bala baa le Kora dea, dɛ banee dɛɛ daah Korowii Dea la doonyoa ba naawa fa aa toma la.
Wubwa la, dɛ Eliasa bibaa Fenehas nɛɛ Korowii ja wɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo la nɛ.
Mɛselemea bibaa Sekaria ɡe fa dɛ daah Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.
Nɛra baa lee ba baa daah doonyoo aa lɔ bela la bwa lɔ nɛra lafraanɛ dɛ fi dɛ banɛ.
Ba chwerɛ ba sɔna teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛ le ba bwɛɛre ta.
Kooro Devid ne Samoɛl waa dɛ na chaahna laanee lee ba, dɛ kpɔ ba chɔ ba tomare nyoo, dɛ ŋɔ ba ɛa kasinteŋ ne.
Ba ne ba naanar nɔn taa ba kpɔ Korowii Dea doonyoo la daahna do.
Dɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo la lɔ baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta.
O wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr, ne weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ ba nomoa.
Bane ba lolanar le ba bwɛɛre ta, dɛ baa cha ba.
Bane balɔ ba ɛ toma yawanyoa beŋkpoŋ aa, dɛ ba kaalɔ, asɛ bane ɡe ba.
Kɛ nomonome banaarɛ baa ɛ Lewi dea tena dɛ chɔ doonyoo la nyoo la, ba nɔn taa ba kpɔ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini bela la do.
Baa dɛ daah bela la nomanta, jwaana bwaa ba yon so dɛ bar, doonyoo la safoone do ba be ba kpɔ dɛɛ pila chɔɔ bɛlbwa.
Ba bini bane chɔ laala baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma bela nyoa.
Mɔɔ bá paa le kɛɛ dɛ́ paa baa jo dea la bini la, ba dɛ kura.
Ba bini bane ɡe, Boɡoroŋ la bini kwaara ne laala aa kaa dɛ do bela la lɔ ba nɔn ta.
Dɛ kwaane kɛŋɔ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ, ne sen ne ɔleve no ne daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, dɛ konsɔɔhsoma.
Kɛ konsɔɔhsoma la koora te, sɔfore la bini bane nɔn taa a do baa ɛ. Lewi dea te bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Matitia, Kora te bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Salum binomoaa, onee ba kpɔ paanoo baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ saraha wɔɔra do o nɔn ta.
Kohat dea bibaala la bane ɡee dɛɛ ɛ paanoo baa dɛ dawa teebur ta Ona Tɔpera ta.
Banɔ la baa ɛ yelɡoola ne Lewi nomonnyuune la soɡe deene la bini, ba ta ɡelɛ baa ɛ toma bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ ba nɔn taa ba kpɔ bela toma ɛɛ do chɔɔ ne jwaana.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Lewi dea tena nomonnyuune ne koranar ba kur ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, dɛ ba bwa soɡe Jerusalam.
Kooro Sɔɔl nabaala ne o naanar Dɛ Jeyɛl waa vɔrɔwe Gebeɔn la soɡe bwɛjen Gebeɔn.
O haah sɔne Maaka, O binomoa sɔne Abdɔn, banɔ la baa jaa laanee, Sor ne Kes ne Baal ne Nɛr dɛ Nadab, ne Gedɔr ne Ahio ne Sekaria dɛ Meklɔt.
Meklɔt ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Simiam.
Ba ɡe soɡo bɛne ba lolanar Jerusalam.
Nɛr ɡe bie sɔne Kes, Kes lolɛ Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl lolɛ Jonatan ne Malki Sua ne Abinadab dɛ Ɛsbaal.
Jonatan ɡe bibaalaa, Mɛreb Baal, asɛ o ɡe lolɛ Maeka.
Maeka ɡe bibaalaa, Petɔn ne Mɛlɛk ne Tarea dɛ Ahas.
Ahas ɡee lolɛ Jaada, Jaada ɡe lolɛ Alemɛt ne Asmavɛt dɛ Simri.
Asɛ Simri ɡe lolɛ Mosa.
Mosa ɡee lolɛ Binia, Binia ɡe lolɛ Refaya, Refaya ɡe lolɛ Eleasa, asɛ Eleasa ɡe lolɛ Asɛl.
Asɛl ɡe lolɛ bibaala banumɛl.
Ba sɔnaa, Asrikam ne Bokeru ne Ismael ne Searia ne Obadia dɛ Hanan.
Kooro Sɔɔl seo wa A kaa ba kɛ Filisti tena ne Israel tena cheme Gelboa Bwejen ta dɛ́ yo laa.
Ba kpoo Israel tena ɡalɡa Gelboa Bwejen ta.
Filisti tena la chwao ti Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro, Jonatan ne Abinadab dɛ Malki Sua sibeɡra ne dɛ kpoo o bibaala la.
Laa la baa do kpeɡri tɛ Kooro Sɔɔl, asɛ o dɔma la bɛl ta hɛm yaɡɔ dɛ doo bol kohona.
Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o bonɔɔ waa dɛ che o dɔmkwaa la be ŋɔ, “Pamɛ he kere la dɛ́ ba tɔɡ mɛ kpo, ásɛ nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ nɔ, bɛ men ba kpo dɛ́ chɛɡ mɛ ja.” Kɛ dɛ bonɔɔ la dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ó ɛ ɡɛ, anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl pamɛ o ɡbaɡba kere dɛ chole o ta.
Bonɔɔ la aa naa kɛ Kooro Sɔɔl sewɔ la, o ɡe chole o kon ta dɛ sewɛ ja o nɛ.
Gɛɛ a do Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro ne o dem tena bwa serewe, nomɛlbwa ta o luɡe ta leɛ ba di kora kpa.
Israel tena baa soɡe Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen bini aa noa kɛŋɔ laa tena la bwa chwao, asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala bwa ɡe serewe la, ba chwao ɡel ba bwɛɛre, asɛ Filisti tena la ba so a ta.
Tɔ aa pera la, Filisti tena la laŋɔ dɛ ka pa laa tena baa kpoo ba la laala, asɛ dɛ na Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro la kɛ baa serewa chɔ Gelboa Bwejen ta.
Ba teŋe Kooro Sɔɔl nyu, dɛ pa o dɔmkwaa ja, dɛ tomɛ toroma Filisti harɛ la ta bwa ŋɔ bá ka bol amanesoma nɔ ba voɡa deene ne nɛra bwa be.
Ba kpɔ Kooro Sɔɔl dɔmkwaa la ka bil ba voɡare deene bini, dɛ kpɔ o nyu saɡɛ ba voɡ Daɡɔn dea.
Bwɛjen Jabes waa lɔ Gelead harɛ tena la aa noa ɡɛ Filisti tena la aa ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl la, ba bini banyoola laŋɔ ka kpɔ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala baa kpoo ba, dɛ ba ba ne Jabes.
Ba huɡ ba dajen bɛl mun bela, dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa tɔpera anuanɛ.
Kooro Sɔɔl kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe dɛ tɛ Korowii waa o sewɛ.
O ta Korowii waa ta teŋɛ, hale dɛ ka bɔɔ dɛɛ le nɛn waa dɛ yerɛ lala be, ó baɡlo waa waa ɛ, dɛ vɛh Korowii nɛɛ teŋa.
A waa Korowii kpoo, dɛ berɛ kora la tɛ Jese bibaa Devid.
Devid di kora Israel ne Juda harɛ Israel tena bwa ba Devid be Hɛbrɔn dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ya bwa ɛ he lolanar dɛ ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ.
Kooro Sɔɔl fa aa ɛ ya kooro la, dɛ henee tɔ ya Israel tena sie dɛɛ la ya ne laa.
Asɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ la ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Henee dɛ́ nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre ken, dɛ́ ɛ ba kooro.’ ” Anomanta, Israel nomonome la bwa ba Devid be Hɛbrɔn, o ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo Korowii sie bela, asɛ ba fuɡe noo do Devid nyu ta dɛ cheɡo kora ta Israel harɛ ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Samoɛl nɛɛ dɛ bol la.
Kooro Devid yo Jerusalam tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ Kooro Devid ne Israel tena bwa kpɔ ba te kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ba fa dɛ yerɔ Jebus, dɛ ka yo Jebus tena baa soɡe bela, Jebus tena la ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, “Haa won ba ya be bonɔ.” Kɛ ane a bwa, o yoo dɛ lɛ Jerusalam, asɛ baa yerɔ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ne o danjwɛkpeɡ.
Dɛ Kooro Devid fa bolɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa tɔ laa sie dɛ́ ka yo Jebus tena la, onee dɛ́ ɛ nomoa dɛɛ tɔ laa tena sie.” Joab o nya aa ɛ Seruya laanee wona ir dɛ tɔ ba sie la ba be, asɛ ba kpɔ laa sitɔɔ la tɛo.
Belaa Kooro Devid ka so Jerusalam baa ma danjwɛɛ baro la ta.
Gɛɛ a do baa yerɔ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen.
O berɔ kwaa ma deene bar danjwɛɛ la.
Deŋɡare la wee leebɔr pera harɛ waa baro la taa, ba che bwea su bɔɔ la mɔɔ, o le bela dɛ mao, asɛ Joab ba kwaa ma o kar.
Kooro Devid teŋɔ di kpeɡri kohona, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Nemenɛ Korowii ja o nɛ.
Kooro Devid banyoola baa dɔ sɔna Kooro Devid banyoola ne Israel tena bwa baa chao o won di kora, ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡ ba nyoa, o kora che kiŋkiŋ laanee teŋa nɔ.
Banyoo waa ɛ banyoola batoro la bwa nomoa laanee Hakmɔn te Jasobeam.
Onee kpɔ o lampea yo baala lafraatoro, dɛ kpoo ba laa bɛl ta la.
Nɛɛte waa ja banyoola batoro la nɛɛ ɡee Dodai bibaa Eliasa, o le Aho dea.
Dɛ o ja Kooro Devid nɛɛ o ka yo Filisti tena, Pas Damim.
Dɛ mea koo bɛl chɔ bela, asɛ ba chwa le Filisti tena la be.
Kɛ o ne o laa tena lɔ bambile che koo la baah ta, dɛ yo Filisti tena la.
Korowii ɡelɔ o kpoo ba kɛrɛdɛ awola.
Awola bɛl, laa nomonome la bini fifraatoro la bini batoro ba Kooro Devid be, Adulam bwebɔɔ la ta.
Dɛ Filisti laa tena ɡe boa ba nyoa, dɛ cheme Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini.
A ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Kooro Devid soɡe bela baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro deŋɡare bɛl doa, asɛ Filisti laa tena ɡe do Bɛtlɛham.
Nyɔɡre dɛ kpo Kooro Devid, asɛ o ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin nomɛl fe aa kaa dɔ nee kɔlɔŋ waa chɔa bɛne Bɛtlɛham doonyojen la ta ba tɛ mɛ ń nyɔ!” Anomanta, banyoola batoro la kpɔ bansua jo harɛ Filisti laa tena la aa soɡe o ta la ta, dɛ ka dɔ nee le kɔlɔŋ waa chɔa bɛne Bɛtlɛham doonyojen bini la ba tɛ Kooro Devid.
Kɛ o vɛh nee la nyɔe, dɛ fuɡe ta harɛ tɛ Korowii.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛŋɔ ń nyɔ nee nɔ.
Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ maa dɛ nyɔ baala baa ta ba nyu, dɛ won la ka dɔ nee nɔ ba tɛ mɛ nɔ chal.” Anomanta, o vɛh nee la nyɔe.
Waa banyoola batoro la aa ɛa laanee la.
Ate, Joab nime Abisae, onee fa chɔ nomonome batoro, ba ɡe aa ɛ banyoola la nyoa.
O kpɔ lampea ka yo baala lafraatoro dɛ kpoo ba.
Gɛ taa a che o lɛ sɔn kɛŋɔ banyoola batoro la.
A lole kɛ dɛ baa on kure dɛɛ ja banyoola batoro la nɛ, kɛ onee bera ba chɔ ba bwa nyoa dɛ lɛ sɔn kohona.
Dɛ Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ɛ nɛn waa won yoi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ le bwɛjen Kabseel ta, o ɡe ɛ wejena kɛrɛdɛ.
Onee wona kpo Moab baala banɛ baa won yoi kɛrɛdɛ la.
O berɔ jo bɔɔ bini, awola bɛl, dɛ dombwea leero dɛ ka kpo nyujente.
O berɔ kpo Ijipt te bɛl ɡe, dɛ o kpeɡo kɛrɛdɛ, o jaŋne ɛɛ ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tamaa.
A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ Ijipt te la kpoŋe lampeajen, kɛ Bɛnaya kpɔ o ɡuli la o be sibeɡra ne, dɛ ka to o lampea le o nɔn ta, dɛ kpɔ kpoo.
Waa Bɛnaya aa ɛa laanee la.
O ɡe lɛ sɔn kɛŋɔ banyoola batoro la ken.
Ba tɛo duure kohona ɡwaa banyoola fifraatoro la bini bɛlbwa, kɛ ba ta on kpɔe ja banyoola batoro la nɛ.
Asɛ Kooro Devid ɡel o chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daahno la nyoa.
Banyoola bane ɡe ba jaa laanee, Joab nime Asahɛl, ne Dodo waa le Bɛtlɛham bibaa Ɛlhanan, ne Samɔt waa le Harɔd, ne Hɛlɛs waa le Pɛlɔn, ne Ikes waa le Tekoa bibaa Ira, ne Abeɛsa waa le Anatɔt, ne Sibekai waa le Husa, ne Ilai waa le Aho dea, ne Maharai waa le Nɛtɔfa, ne Hɛlɛd, o mɛɛ sɔne Baana dɛ le Nɛtɔfa, ne Itai o mɛɛ aa ɛ Ribai waa le Gebea, dɛ do Bɛnjamen dea, ne Bɛnaya waa le Peratɔn, ne Hurai waa le Gaas Fɛlembɔjena bɔr, ne Abiel waa le Aaba, ne Asmavɛt waa le Baharum, ne Eliaba waa le Saalbɔn, ne Hasem waa le Gesɔn bibaala, ne Jonatan, o mɛɛ sɔne Saɡee dɛ le Harar, ne Ahiam, o mɛɛ sɔne Saka dɛ le Harar, ne Ur bibaa Elifal, ne Hɛfa waa le Mɛkera, ne Ahija waa le Pɛlɔn, ne Hesro waa le Kaamɛl, ne Ɛsbae bibaa Naarai, ne Joel, o nime sɔne Netan, ne Haɡri bibaa Mibhar, ne Amɔn te baa dɛ yerɔ Sɛlɛk, ne Naharai waa le Bɛrɔt, onee dɛɛ che Seruya bibaa Joab dɔmkwa, ne Ira waa le Itri, ne Gareb o ɡe aa le Itri, ne Uria waa ɛ Hiti te, ne Alae bibaa Sabad, ne Sisa bibaa Adina waa le Rubin dea, dɛ o ɛ Rubin dea kooro asɛ nɛra fifraatoro bane ja o nɛ, ne Maaka bibaa Hanan, ne Josafat waa le Mitan, ne Usia waa le Astɛra, ne Jeyɛl ne Sama, ba mɛɛ sɔne Hotam dɛ le Arowa, ne Simri bibaa Jedial, dɛ o nime Joha waa le Tis ne Eliel waa le Mahava, ne Jɛrebai dɛ Josavia, baa ɛ Ɛlnaam bibaala, ne Itma waa le Moab, ne Eliel ne Ɔbɛd, dɛ Jaaseɛl waa le Mɛsoba.
Banyoola bane baa kaa teŋɛ Kooro Devid nɛ A balɔ kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid chwao le Kooro Sɔɔl be dɛ ka so Siklaɡ.
Waa lɔ bela la, banyoola bane la o be bela, dɛ ba ja laa tena baa chao yo laa la nɛ.
Ba kpoŋe tori, dɛ jemɛ ane yoi kɛrɛdɛ, kɛɛ dɛ won vamtor bwea tae diɡ ne ɡal bwa.
Ba le Kooro Sɔɔl luɡe ta, dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea.
Ba sitɔɔla sɔne Ahiesa ne Joas, ba mɛɛ Sɛmaa, o le Gebea.
Laa tena baa jaa la ɡee, Asmavɛt bibaala Jesial ne Pɛlɛt, ne Bɛraka dɛ Jehu waa le Anatɔt, ne Ismaya waa le Gebeɔn.
O ja banyoola fifraatoro la nɛɛ dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔla la bini bɛl, ne Jeremia ne Jehaseɛl ne Johanan dɛ Josabad waa le Gɛdɛra, ne Elusai ne Jerimot ne Bealia ne Sɛmaria dɛ Sɛfatea, waa le Haruf, ne Ɛlkana ne Isihia ne Aasarɛl ne Joesa dɛ Jasobeam baa le Kora dea, ne Joela ne Sebadia baa ɛ Jɛroham waa le Gedɔr bibaala.
Baala bane le Gad dea dɛ ba ja Kooro Devid laa tena la nɛɛ dekpeɡ la ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bobɛl.
Ba ɛ banyoola baa kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa tɔ ɡbemɡbe dɛɛ yo laa ne lampeare.
Ba siebɔra do ɔma kɛŋɔ nyujentena ken, dɛ do ɡbaŋre kɛŋɔ kweɡli aa lɔ bwejena dor.
Ba sitɔɔ sɔne Esa, Obadia teŋɛ nɛɛ, Eliab teŋɛ tooro, Mismana teŋɛ naarɛ, Jeremia teŋɛ nue.
Atai teŋɛ numɛl, Eliel teŋɛ nuanɛ.
Johanan teŋɛ nuatoro, Ɛlsabad teŋɛ nuanaarɛ.
Jeremia teŋɛ fi, Makbanai teŋɛ fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Gɛ nɛra baa le Gad dea nɔ bwa ɛ laa sitɔɔla, bane chɔ laa tena lafa nyoa, bane ɡe chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋ nyoa.
Banee ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo, korobiloɡle ta ɡɛ saŋ waa sua kohona, dɛ doŋi nɛra baa soɡe fɛlembɔjena bini, wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr ba bwa peɡre la.
Awola bɛl, laa tena bane le Bɛnjamen ne Juda deene ta ɡe, dɛ la Kooro Devid be bela waa soɡa o dekpeɡ la bini.
Asɛ Kooro Devid ir ka chem ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna nee hɛɛ ba n be dɛ́ ba cha mɛ naa, n sɛoh kɛŋɔ ya nyoa pɛ.
Kɛ dɛ he balɔ, dɛ́ ba lee mɛ tɛ n dɔma maa wola wechɔɡe bɛlbwa lii nɔ tenaa, Korowii ya naawa aa tomɔ laanee dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne.” Korowii Doma baa so Amasae waa baa ɛ banyoola fifraatoro sitɔɔ la nɛ, asɛ o ŋɔ, “N naa Kooro Devid, henee dɔ yaa!
He ne nɛra baa dɛ chae bwa dɔ hɛɛra.
Korowii ɛɛ ja he nɛɛ.” Anomanta, Kooro Devid lɛɛ ba dɛ ɡel ba ɛ o laa sitɔɔla.
Manasɛ dea laa tena bane pere ba te, dɛ ba ja Kooro Devid nɛɛ ɡɛ saŋ o ne Filisti tena aa dɛ la ka yo Kooro Sɔɔl la.
Kɛ o ne o laa tena ta Filisti tena la chae.
Dɛ Filisti koranar la dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ le ba habɔɔ dɛ́ berɛ kaa o nomoa Sɔɔl be.
Anomanta, ba ɡelɔ o berɛ ba Siklaɡ.
Devid aa dɛ ba Siklaɡ la, Manasɛ dea laa tena pere ba te, dɛ ba ja o nɛ.
Banee, Adna ne Josabad ne Jedial ne Maekel ne Josabad ne Elihu dɛ Siletai.
Dɛ banee Manasɛ dea laa sitɔɔla, dɛ chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa nyoo.
Banee cha Kooro Devid wɛɛ yo nɛra laa, dɛ yon lɔ ka tɔ nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ pa ba laala, dɛkalkɛ ba bwa ɛ banyoola, dɛ ɛ o laa sitɔɔla.
Tɔpere bɛlbwaa nɛra yon baa ja Kooro Devid laa tena nɛ, a ta biɡre o laa tena warɛ, dɛ do kpeɡri kohona.
Kooro Devid laa tena Laa tena baa kpɔ ba te dɛ ba Kooro Devid be Hɛbrɔn, dɛ́ ba yo Kooro Sɔɔl, dɛ́ lɛ o kora tɛo ɡɛ Korowii aa bola laanee teŋa nɔ.
Juda dea laa tena baa kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe, ne lampeare lɔ kaɡboŋa banumɛl lafraanuatoro, Simeon dea banyoola baa kpɔ ba te, dɛ́ ba yo laa lɔ kaɡboŋa banuanɛ dɛ lafa, Lewi dea laa tena ɡe lɔ kaɡboŋa banaarɛ lafraanumɛl, ne Jehoiada waa ɛ Arɔn dem nomoa.
O kpoŋe laa tena kaɡboŋa batoro lafraanuanɛ, ne Sadɔk waa ɛ banyoo waa kpeɡa kohona, nomonome fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ le o dem dɛ ja o nɛ, ne Bɛnjamen dea laa tena, ba ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl lolanar.
Ba lɔ kaɡboŋa batoro, dɛ ba fa teŋɛ Kooro Sɔɔl nɛ, dɛ le o habɔɔ taraken, ne banyoola baa le Efrem dea, dɛ ba dɔ sɔna ba deene.
Ba ɡe lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ lafraanuatoro, ne Manasɛ dea pera tena baa lee ba cheɡ ŋɔ bá ba cheɡ Devid kora ta.
Ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banuatoro, ne Isaaka dea baala, banee dɛ wobɛlbwa ba Israel harɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ aa, ba yon tɔ a sie dɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ a ta.
Ba lɔ koranar lafraanɛ, ba lolanar bwa ja ba nɛ, ne Sebulon dea laa tena baa dɔ laa yoi wejema kpɔ ba te, dɛ kpoŋe dɔmkwaa bwa soo siwi.
Ba balɔ dɛ ba cha Devid bambile bwa ne, dɛ yo tɛo.
Ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue.
Naftale dea ɡe laa nomonome lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋ, dɛ baala kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ banuanɛ, baa cheɡɛ kwaa baa kpɔ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta ne lampeare, ne Dan dea laa tena baa kpɔ ba te, dɛ́ ba yo laa, ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro lafraanumɛl, ne Aasa dea laa tena baa dɔ laa yoi wejema, dɛ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ ba bá yo laa.
Ba lɔ baala kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ, ne Rubin ne Gad deene, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera laa tena baa le Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr baa kpoŋe dɔmkwaa bwa soo siwi.
Ba ɡe lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanɛ.
Gɛ laa tena nɔ bwa kpɔ ba te, dɛ ba Hɛbrɔn sibeɡra ne kɛŋɔ, bá ba cheɡ Devid kora Israel harɛ ta.
Dɛ Israel tena la kar bwa dɔ liire beŋkpoŋ kɛŋɔ, Devid ɛ kooro Israel harɛ.
Laa tena la di Devid be bela tɔpera atoro, dɛ di kwaa dɛɛ nyɔ sen ba bala Israel tena aa ɛa ba tɛɛ ba la.
Deene ane kɛŋɔ Isaaka ne Sebulon, dɛ Naftale deene tena ɡe le bojaŋa, dɛ kpɔ nyoɡmare ne keeɡore ne nabala aa cheɡɛ kondikwa ne men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ, ne fiɡ daa nɔna aa hola nɔn del, ne daa nɔna ane ɡe aa hola nɔn del, ne sen dɛ ɔleve no.
Ba kpɔ nae ne peera aa wara ba ba kpo di, dɛkalkɛ silɛɛ tentenee ba Israel harɛ ta bwa.
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka kpɔe le Kereat Jearim Kooro Devid ne o laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo chemo dɛ kpɔ liire.
Asɛ o ŋɔ Israel tena bwa be ŋɔ, “Dɛ a ɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la nyina, ya sɛh ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin ta naa, yá tomɛ toroma ya bala baa kaa ne sɔfore dɛ Lewi dea tena baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa be, ásɛ ya bwa cheme.
Ásɛ ya la ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba bonɔ, dɛkalkɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bere saŋee yaa wola o waa bɔɔrɛ.” Israel tena baa cheme bela la bwa sɛh a ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a wer dɛ tɛ ba bwa.
Anomanta, Israel tena bwa baa cheme Kooro Devid sie, le Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta Sehɔ Moo ta ba le Lebo Hamat, dɛ́ ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Kiriat Jearim ba Jerusalam.
O ne Israel tena la iro le bwɛjen Baala baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Kiriat Jearim waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le bela dɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Nemenɛ Korowii sɔn dawɛ Daka la ta, asɛ o so o kookara ta, kena kwaa baa dɛ yera Kerobim la baah ta.
Ba kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Abinadab dem, dɛ kpɔ chɔŋɛ torɔɡofale bɛl ta nae ɛɛ tɛɡro.
Asɛ Ussa ne Ahio ɛɛ baɡla bela aa kpɔ.
Dɛ Kooro Devid ne Israel tena la bwa dɛ lɛ ba sie.
Ba ɡo yela silɛɛ ne kohona, dɛɛ lɔ janjela ne kalipere, ne kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, dɛɛ yiiɡi loŋa ɡe Korowii sie.
Ba valɔ ba tel Kedɔn tena mea lɔ bɔr, asɛ nabala aa dɛ tɛɡre Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la lɔ na, asɛ Ussa ta lawɛ Daka la kpoŋe.
Korowii baah di Ussa nɛɛ dɛ kpoo buɡ la ta, dɛkalkɛ o kpɔ nɔn lawɛ Daka la.
Anomanta, Korowii sie belaa o sewɛ.
Belaa Kooro Devid ɡe baah di, ɡɛ Korowii baah aa di Ussa nɛɛ dɛ tɛr o deŋne la wa.
Anomanta, dɛ ba le fini, ba dɛ yerɛ bela Pɛrɛs Ussa.
Kooro Devid ɔmɛ Korowii awola tɔpere dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ n kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka nɔ ba n be bonɔ naa, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona nyiŋi o ta nɔ?” Dɛ waa berɛ dɛɛ nyin o ba Daka la ne o be Jerusalam kpa.
O ɡelɔ ba kpɔ ba cheɡ Ɔbɛd Edom dem, o le bwɛjen Gat.
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la cheɡɛ Ɔbɛd Edom dem korobie atoro, asɛ Korowii swee o ne o dem tena ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa andɛɛɡa.
Waa Kooro Devid aa ɛa Jerusalam Bwɛjen Taaya Kooro Hiram tomɛ nɛra Kooro Devid be ba kpɔ peleme daa ne kapenta tena, dɛ nɛra baa dɔ bwea kpɔe dɛ́ ma dea wejema, bá ma koodem tɛ Kooro Devid.
Kooro Devid jemɔ kɛŋɔ, Korowiirii cheɡo kora ta Israel harɛ bwa, dɛ ɡel o dɔ kpeɡri o harɛ do wer kohona, o nɛra Israel tena wa.
Kooro Devid mo haahna warɛ Jerusalam bela, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna kohona.
Bii baa lola tɛo bela laanee Samoa ne Sobab ne Netan dɛ Solomɔn, ne Ibha ne Elisua dɛ Ɛlpɛlɛt, ne Nɔɡa ne Nɛfɛɡ dɛ Jafia, ne Elisama ne Beeliada dɛ Ɛlefɛlɛt.
Kooro Devid yo Filisti tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ Filisti tena aa noa kɛŋɔ ba fuɡe noo do Devid nyu ta, dɛ cheɡo kora ta Israel harɛ bwa ta la, ba laa tena bwa iro, dɛ kaa nyin o bɔr sibeɡra ne, asɛ Kooro Devid ɡe no ba wa, dɛ le ka chem ba.
Dɛ Filisti tena la balɔ ba lɔ tɔ Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini dɛɛ kah kwa.
Belaa Kooro Devid ka bɔɔ le Korowii be ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ń la ka yo Filisti tena nɔ naa?
Hɛɛ kpɔ baa do n nɔn ta kɛɛ?” Asɛ Korowii chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ir kaa, mɛɛ kpɔ baa do he nɔn ta, ásɛ he pɔ ba nɛ.” Anomanta, Kooro Devid iro, dɛ ka yoo ba Baal Pɛrasem dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ nee yon su ba tɔ bobɛlbwa la, ɡɛɛ Korowii ba tɔ n dɔma nɛɛ n sie.” Anomanta, ba dɛ yerɛ bela Baal Pɛrasem.
Filisti tena chwao ɡel ba voɡare bela, asɛ Kooro Devid tɛ o nɛra ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ ba fuah.
Filisti tena la balɔ ba lɔ tɔ Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini ja dɛɛ kah kwa, asɛ Kooro Devid ka bɔɔ le Korowii be ja, asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ berɛ sie pae dɛ́ kaa ba be.
Hé bar ba ka che ba habɔɔ, dɛ́ yoo ba daa ane baa dɛ yera balsam sie bela.
Hé ba dɛ no ba naɡime sii daa la dor aa, hé pa mun dɛɛ yo, a dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii baa tɔ he sie, dɛ́ ka yo Filisti tena la dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.” Gɛɛ Kooro Devid ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa doo bwa ta, dɛ won doŋi Filisti tena le Gebeɔn ba Gɛsa.
Kooro Devid sɔn le harɛre bwa ta, asɛ Korowii ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɔmɔ.
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka ne Jerusalam bala Kooro Devid aa do deene o ɡbabir aa so a bini Jerusalam waa ɛ o Bwɛjen ta tonɛ la, o kwaa bobɛl dɛ baŋre tɛnte dea ba kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la cheɡ o bini.
Ate, Kooro Devid ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ che Daka nɔ ka ja Lewi dea tena nɛ, dɛkalkɛ banee Korowii le ŋɔ baa cheo, dɛɛ tomɔ o sie saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Anomanta, o yerɛ Israel tena bwa Jerusalam ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ bɔr waa kwaara la bini.
O berɔ yerɛ Arɔn naanar ne Lewi dea tena naanar bwa ɡe ja.
Kohat naanar bini, Uriel, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra lafa fifraanɛ nyoa, Merari naanar bini, Asaya, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra lafraanɛ fifraanɛ nyoa, Gɛsɔn naanar bini, Joel, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra lafa fifraatoro nyoa, Elisafan naanar bini, Sɛmaya, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra lafraanɛ nyoa, Hɛbrɔn naanar bini, Eliel, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra fifraanuatoro nyoa, Usiel naanar bini, Aminadab, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra lafa dɛ fi dɛ banɛ nyoa.
Belaa Kooro Devid yerɛ Sadɔk ne Abiata baa ɛ sɔfore la, ne Uriel ne Asaya ne Joel, ne Sɛmaya ne Eliel, dɛ Aminadab baa ɛ Lewi dea tena la cheme.
Dɛ ŋɔ Lewi dea tena la be ŋɔ, “Heyaa ɛ nomonnyuune, dɛ chɔ Lewi deene nyoo, hé ne he bala Lewi dea tena chɛ kɛ he sɔ he doŋa bɛlbwa ta Korowii be pera, ásɛ dɛ won ka kpɔ Korowii ya Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ bɔr maa kwaara tɛ ŋɔ ó ba che la.
He Lewi dea tena aa wola toole loɡla dɛ́ cheo la waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ baah di ya nɛ.
Ya ta on bɔɔrɛ dɛ jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ yaa kpɔ o ta cheo.” Anomanta, sɔfore la ne Lewi dea tena la sɔ ba doŋa bɛlbwa ta Korowii be pera, dɛ ka kpɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba.
Daa Lewi dea tena kpɔ su Daka la keŋkeŋni, dɛ dawa ba vaama ta cheo, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o nyoa wobol ta do Mosis la.
Kooro Devid ŋɔ Lewi dea nomonome la be ŋɔ, bá le ba bini bane, bá ɡo silɛɛ yela dɛɛ lɔ janjelare, ne kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ.
Anomanta, Lewi dea tena le Joel bibaa Heman le o nimanar bini, ne Bɛrekea bibaa Asaf ɡe le Merari tena bini, ne Kusaya bibaa Etan, banɔ la baa cha ba laanee, Sekaria ne Jaasiel ne Sɛmeramɔt ne Jehiel ne Uni, ne Eliab ne Bɛnaya ne Maaseya ne Matitia, ne Elifɛlɛhu ne Mekneya ne Ɔbɛd Edom, dɛ Jeyɛl baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea bela.
Yelɡoola ɡee, Heman ne Asaf dɛ Etan, banee dɛɛ lɔ kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa, asɛ Sekaria ne Aseɛl ne Sɛmeramɔt ne Jehiel, ne Uni ne Eliab ne Maaseya dɛ Bɛnaya, banee chɛ kɛ baa lɔ janjelare ɡɛ aa chɛa, ásɛ Matitia ne Elifɛlɛhu ne Mekneya, ne Ɔbɛd Edom ne Jeyɛl, dɛ Asasia ɡee dɛɛ lɔ janjelare, dɛ́ nyiŋi ɡɛ baa dɛ lɔa ta.
Kenania waa ɛ Lewi dea nomonnyu la, dɛ o dɔ yela ɡoe wejema anomanta, ba leo o chɔ yelɡoola nyoa.
Bɛrekea ne Ɛlkana ɡee ba le baa daah Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la.
Sebania ne Josafat ne Nɛtanɛl, ne Amasae ne Sekaria ne Bɛnaya, dɛ Eliesa baa ɛ sɔfore laanee, dɛ́ tɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie dɛɛ hoh bɛle.
Ɔbɛd Edom ne Jehia ɡe ja dɛɛ daah Daka la.
Anomanta, Kooro Devid ne Israel nomonome, dɛ laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa nyoo, la Ɔbɛd Edom dem silɛɛ ne, dɛ ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba.
Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ Korowii cha Lewi dea tena, ásɛ ba won che Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la nomanta, ba kpoo nabala anuanɛ ne pebala anuanɛ ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Dɛ Kooro Devid do batakaarejaŋ baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe nyarɔ, ɡɛɛ Lewi dea tena baa cheɡɛ Daka la ne yelɡoola la, ne Kenania waa chɔ yelɡoola nyoa la ɡe do ane.
Dɛ Kooro Devid berɔ do sɔfo batakaarebora efɔd baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe nyarɔ.
Gɛɛ Israel tena bwa kpɔ silɛɛ lɔŋɔre teŋɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la nɛɛ ba Jerusalam.
Dɛɛ hoh pebal nyeɡle bɛle, ne bɛle tenten ne kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, dɛ janjelare dɛɛ lɔ yela.
Baa kpɔ Korowii Fɔo Daka la dɛɛ jo Jerusalam Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta la, Kooro Sɔɔl bihaah Mikal, aa cheɡɛ tokoro ta dɛ na Kooro Devid o sa dɛɛ hɛɡre la, o sie ta o nɛɛ lɛɛ, dɛ nyiŋu vah.
Israel tena la kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ tɛnte dea Kooro Devid aa baŋro la bini, asɛ ba kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare ba Korowii sie bela.
Kooro Devid aa kpoo kwaa dɛ fuh ɛ sarahare, ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare tonɛ la, o soŋe andɛɛɡa Nemenɛ Korowii be tɛ nɛra la.
Belaa o kpɔ paanoo ne daa nɔna ane aa hola dɛ ɛ nɔndel, dɛ ɡrepo daa nɔna aa hola nɔndel tɛ Israel haah ne baa te bɛlbwa.
O berɔ le Lewi dea tena la bane ba baa ɛ toma Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, dɛ baa soŋe dɛɛ jam, dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la.
Asaf ɛ ba nyu te, Sekaria teŋɛ, ne Jeyɛl ne Sɛmeramɔt ne Jehiel ne Matitia, ne Eliab ne Bɛnaya ne Ɔbɛd Edom, dɛ Jeyɛl ɡe ja.
Banee dɛɛ lɔ janjela ne anɔ la baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ bwa.
Asaf ɡee dɛɛ lɔ kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, asɛ Bɛnaya ne Jahaseɛl baa ɛ sɔfore la, ɡe ɛɛ hoh bɛle la tɔpere bɛlbwa, Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie.
Kooro Devid kpɛɛra yel Le awola tɔpere laanee Kooro Devid kpɔ do Asaf ne o nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ nɔn ta ŋɔ, bá ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii.
Hé jam Korowii, dɛ́ yerɛ o sɔn, hé ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa jemɛ waa waa ɛa.
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro, dɛ́ bol o nyokpowe-ɛɛla wa.
Hé ɡel he sie lɛ o sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, nɛra haa dɛ tomɔ, hé ɡel he sie lɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii dɛ́ na o kpeɡri, dɛ́ɛ tomɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Hé lii o nyokpowaa waa ɛa, o wejena ne o waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la wa, O bonɔɔ Jekɔb naanar, Jekɔb bibaala waa lee ba cheɡ tɛ o te.
Onee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, o bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.
Wɛɛ lii o fɔo la waa saŋ bɛlbwaa, o nyoa waa baɡɛ naanar kaɡboŋa baa ka ba la bwa.
Fɔo o ne ya naa Abraham aa fɔwa, ne nyoa waa baɡɛ Aesek la.
Korowii ne Jekɔb fɔwɛ fɔo, o do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O ŋɔ, “He ne he naanaree mɛɛ ba Keenan harɛ kpɔe tɛ, ó ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon.” Gɛ saŋ dɛ Korowii nɛra aa kanɛ, dɛ ɛ hɔɔhra do Keenan harɛ ta, dɛ harɛre taa ba do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, ba le harɛ bɛl ta naa, dɛ ba kaa bɛl ta.
Kɛ Korowii ta ɡelɛ nomɛlbwa fiɡ ba, ba lɛɛ nomanta, o kah koranar ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa bɛ nɔn kpɔ leɡe n bonɔɔna maa lee ba cheɡ tɛ n te nɔ, he bɛ n keamere nɔ bini bɛlbwa ha.” Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii!
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro!
Hé bol o lɛɛ waa dɛ lɛ nɛra tɔpere bɛlbwa wa.
Hé bol o jirima waa baɡle harɛre nɛra, dɛ́ bol o nyokpowe-ɛɛla waa baɡle nɛra bwa.
Korowii kan, a chɛ kɛ ya kpɛɛro kohona, onee chɛ kɛ ya kpɔ duure tɛ dɛ ɡwaa voɡa.
Harɛre bwa voɡare ɛ konsale, kɛ Korowiirii ta nyundua.
O kan dɛ dɔ jirima kohona, kpeɡri ne jirima su o Dea.
Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa, hé kpɛɛ Korowii.
Hé kpɛɛro, o jirima ne kpeɡri waa dɔa wa.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ, dɛ́ kpɔ jirima aa chɛ o sɔn la tɛo.
Hé kpɔ saraha kwaa ba tɛo o Dea.
Hé kpɔ jirima tɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ la.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ chel o sie!
O ta harɛ o che kiŋkiŋ, waa wola yiiɡi.
Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ lɛ ba sie.
Hé ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa no kɛŋɔ, “Korowii dɛ di kora.” Mpo ne kwaa aa lɔ o bini bwa ɡe ɛɛ do lɔŋɔre ɡɛ.
Kooni ne kwaa aa lɔ a bini bwa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ lɛ ba sie!
Ásɛ kɔr bini daa ɡe ɛɛ hɛɡre ɡɛ, saŋ Korowii aa ba di kora harɛ nɔ ta la.
Wɛɛ ba bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!
Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii dɛkalkɛ o wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa ta jaɡa dɔe.
Hé do lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, lɛ yaa, henee ya Lɛɛ, berɛ lawɛ yaa le harɛre ta ba.
Ásɛ ya kpɔ jam tɛɛ dɛ́ kpɛɛ he sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la.” Hé kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, hé kpɛɛro saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Nɛra la bwa ŋɔ, “Aamen” ne “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii!” Korowii ka toma Jerusalam ne Gebeɔn Kooro Devid ɡelɔ Asaf ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ do Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie bela, baa ɛ toma ɡɛ aa chɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa.
O ɡelɔ Ɔbɛd Edom ne o bala fifraanumɛl dɛ banuatoro, ba ja ba nɛɛ baa ɛ toma bela.
Dɛ Jedutun bibaa Ɔbɛd Edom ne Hosa ɡee dɛɛ daah doonyoa bela.
Kooro Devid kpɔ sɔfo Sadɔk ne o bala sɔfore so Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela baa chema dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii o do Gebeɔn.
Dɛ a chɛ kɛ ŋɔ bá kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah baa tɛ Korowii bela, kon baa dɛ fuh saraha o ta chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra, ɡɛ aa lɔ Korowii Mmarare bini o kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la.
Nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ laanee, Heman ne Jedutun, dɛ banɔ la bwa baa lee ba cheɡ ŋɔ bá ɡo yela dɛɛ jam Korowii, dɛkalkɛ o nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Heman ne Jedutun chɔ bɛle hoeh ne kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, dɛ anɔ la aa jaa ba kpɔ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii la nyoa.
Jedutun bibaala la te, doonyoa belaa ba ɡel ba so dɛɛ daah bela.
Belaa nɛra la bwa le bela kaa ba deremi, asɛ Kooro Devid ɡe kaa o dem, dɛ ka soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ o dem tena.
Korowii keame Netan kpɔ kala tɛ Kooro Devid Kooro Devid baa so o koodem, asɛ Korowii ɡel o dɔ bosɔɔhna dɛ le o dɔma bwa baa baro cheme be.
Belaa o ŋɔ Korowii keame Netan be ŋɔ, “N soɡe koodem baa kpɔ peleme daa kwaaro bini, asɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la te ta che tɛnte dea bini.” Anee Netan chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛ wobɛlbwa aa lɔ he liire bini, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ja he nɛ.” Kɛ awola jwaana la, Korowii bol waa Netan be ŋɔ ó ir la ka ŋɔ o bonɔɔ Devid be ŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “He laa dɛ do dea tɛ mɛ ń ba so o bini.
Le awola tɔpere maa kpɔ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta ba le fini, n ta dea bini soɡe bwa.
Tɛnte dea binii mɛɛ so ba kpɔ mɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
Bobɛlbwa n ne n nɛra Israel tena aa kaala bwa, n ta ba sitɔɔla bɛlbwa maa do ba ŋɔ baa nyiŋi n nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peera be ŋɔe ŋɔ, ba ta peleme daa waa kpeɡa kpɔe kwaa dea tɛ mɛ.
Waa men Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol la ɡee nɔ, peeraa he teɡɛ dɛɛ la ane dibɔr n ka lawɛ, dɛ ba cheɡe kora ta n nɛra Israel tena nɛ.
N ja he nɛ bobɛlbwa haa laŋa, dɛ yo he dɔma baa lɔ he sie, dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ tɛɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he sɔn le kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛnjena ken.
Mɛɛ kpɔ harɛ waa ɛ n nɛra Israel tena ɡbaɡba konee tɛɛ ba, bá ka so o ta ba bwara sɔɔh ba.
Nɛnchɔɡa aa ban fiiɡi kpa, ɡɛ a fa aa doa wubwa, ne ɡɛ maa ɛa dɛ le saŋ maa le sitɔɔla tɛ n nɛra Israel tena la.
Mɛɛ berɔ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna le he dɔma bwa nɔn ta.
Men Korowii, n bol he be ŋɔ he ne he naanaree dɛɛ ba koranar ɛɛ.
Haa ba sewɛ ka pu he naawa la, mɛɛ ɡeloo he ɡbabir bibaala la bini bɛl bá chiɡ he naa ta dɛ́ di kora, ásɛ o kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Onee dɛ́ do n Dea tɛ mɛ n sɔn ta, ásɛ n ɡel o kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Mɛɛ kpɔɔ ɛ n bie, ásɛ n ɡe ɛ o mɛɛ.
Mɛɛ che o mun taa, maa n nyinaa laa kpɔ o nɛ, kɛŋɔ maa le Kooro Sɔɔl ne, dɛ ɡel he ba chiɡ o naa ta di kora la.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n nɛra ne n harɛɛ do o nɔn ta, ásɛ n ɡel o kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Ate, Netan bol waa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡlo la bwa baɡle Kooro Devid.
Kooro Devid Korowii wesoŋa Belaa Kooro Devid ka jo Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr waa baŋro la bini, dɛ ka so Korowii sie dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, umee n ɡe ne n lolanar asɛ he ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ dɔŋa bwa tɛ mɛ ken nɔɔ?
N Naa Korowii, he ta ɡelɛ a jaɡɛ bela dɛ ta teŋɛ ɛ ane dɛɛ ja, he berɔ bol he bonɔɔ naanar baa ka ba kerekere ɡe wa.
He berɔ ɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ nɛnjen kohona.
Bɔkwaa men Devid dɔ dɛ́ bol he be jaɔ?
He ɡbabir jemɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ wa.
N Naa Korowii, he cheɡɛ waa haa bola ne waa haa dɛ nyin ɛɛ ta dɛ ɛ wejena nɔ bwa, asɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ jemɛ a wa.
N Naa Korowii, he kan kohona.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ do kɛ hen, ya te jemɔ saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ he ɡboo Korowii.
Harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra toole dɛ do kɛŋɔ he nɛra Israel tena.
Harɛ beŋkpoŋ nɛra hen Korowii aa lɛɛ ba le wenaale ta Ijipt harɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ he nɛra la.
Wejena ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla haa ɛa tɛɛ ba la bwa ɡelɔ he dɔ sɔn harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
He berɔ doŋi harɛre ane nɛra le ba sie.
He lɛ he nɛra Israel tena cheɡ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, asɛ dɛ ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɛ.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel he nyobaɡa haa baɡɛ he bonɔɔ, ne o naanar la do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ɛ ɡɛ haa ŋɔa la, á che a ta he dɔ sɔn kohona saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ásɛ nɛra na dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi Israel tena nɛ!’ Ásɛ men, he bonɔɔ Kooro Devid naanar che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ do he sie saŋ bɛlbwa.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he pili waa nɔ bini baɡle men he bonɔɔ dɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ ɡeloo n naanar ɛ koranar.
N Naa Korowii, henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ!
He waa ɛ kasinteŋ kɛ yaa teŋɛ a ta, asɛ he kpɔ wedɛɛɡa aa do ken baɡɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nyoa nɔ.
N dɛ soŋe kɛ he swee n naanar andɛɛɡa, ásɛ baa di he laworomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Hen N Naa Korowiirii sweera tɛ n naanar a do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”
Kooro Devid laa waa yoa A habɔɔ la, Kooro Devid berɔ ka yo Filisti tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ lɛ bwɛjen Gat ne o bwɛɛre aa baro bwa le Filisti tena ba fa aa dɛ di a kpeɡri la be.
O berɔ ka yo Moab tena ɡe dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, ba ba do o lɔɡa dɛ kpɔ harɛ la ta kwaa baa tɛo.
Belaa Kooro Devid berɛ ka yo Soba Kooro Hadadesa, hale dɛ ka le Hamat, ɡɛ saŋ waa la Yufretis Moo nyoa dɛ ka lɛ bela harɛ ba do o lɔɡa ja la.
Kooro Devid lawɛ Kooro Hadadesa kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore kaɡboŋ, ne laa tena baa soɡe laa torɔɡore bini kaɡboŋa banuanɛ, dɛ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ baa dɛ valɛ.
O ɡel kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore la lafa, ne jaɡre ane aa dɛ ba torɔɡore la tɛɡra, dɛ chaa a kabora habɔɔ nadɛɛne.
Siiria tena baa le Damaskɔs balɔ dɛ ba cha Soba Kooro Hadadesa, asɛ Kooro Devid kpoo ba bini nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Kooro Devid bɔne laa tena la bini ba so kuore ta Damaskɔs harɛ ta, asɛ Siiria tena la do o lɔɡa, dɛ kpɔ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛo.
Korowii ja Kooro Devid nɛɛ dɛ ɡel bobɛlbwa waa la ka yo la, o pɔ ba nɛ.
Kooro Devid kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa Kooro Hadadesa nomonome aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta la, dɛ ba a ne Jerusalam.
O berɔ pa ayaawa aa wara le Kooro Hadadesa bwɛjena Teba ne Kun ta.
A habɔɔ la, Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ ayaawa la ɛ loɡbajen ne pilare ne ayaawa loɡa, a do Korowii Dea bela.
Hamat Kooro Tou aa baa no kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid yo Soba Kooro Hadadesa, dɛ pɔ o ne o laa tena bwa nɛɛ la, o tomɛ o bibaa Hadoram Kooro Devid be o ka jaamo yoi waa kaa yo Kooro Hadadesa, dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ la wa.
Dɛ o ne Kooro Tou nɔ yo laa ka.
Hadoram kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ ayaawa kwaa bwa soo siwi ba tɛ Kooro Devid.
Kooro Devid kpɔ a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ dɛ lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii toma, ɡɛ o fa aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm waa paa le harɛre waa kaa yo, dɛ pɔ a nɛra nɛɛ la.
A ɡɛ harɛre laanee, Edom ne Moab, ne Amɔn ne Filisti, dɛ Amalɛk.
Abisae nya Seruya kpoo Edom tena nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banuatoro, Yar Fɛlembɔjen bini.
O bɔne laa tena la bini kuore ta ba so bwɛɛre ta Edom harɛ bwa, asɛ harɛ la tena bwa do o lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ.
Korowii ja o nɛ, dɛ ɡel o pɔ bobɛlbwa nɛra waa laŋa ka yo bwa nɛ.
Kooro Devid nomonome Kooro Devid di kora Israel harɛ bwa, dɛ nyiŋi o nɛra waa aa toɡra ne kasinteŋ ne.
Dɛ Seruya bibaa Joab, onee chɔ laa tena la nyoa, asɛ Ahilud bibaa Jehosafat ɡe chwerɛ waa aa chiɡa bwa dɛɛ bil, asɛ Ahitub bibaa Sadɔk, ne Abiata bibaa Ahemɛlɛk ɡe ɛ sɔfore, asɛ Seraya ɡe ɛ ba karake waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ do tɔne bini, Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ɡe ɛ Kɛrɛt ne Pɛlet tena baa dɛ daah kooro la nomoa, asɛ Kooro Devid bibaala ɛɛ ja kooro o waa ta.
Kooro Devid yo Amɔn ne Siiria tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ A habɔɔ la, Amɔn Kooro Nahas baa sewɛ, asɛ o bibaa Hanun ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Anee Kooro Devid lii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ Kooro Nahas bibaa Hanun daramee, ɡɛ n ne o mɛɛ fa aa kpɔ darame la.” Anomanta, kooro tomɛ toroma o be ba ka bwɛɛlo o mɛɛ seo wa.
Toroma la aa tel Kooro Hanun be Amɔn tena harɛ ta la, anee Amɔn nomonjena ŋɔ Kooro Hanun be ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ duuree Kooro Devid kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ he mɛɛ, dɛ tomɛ toroma ŋɔ bá ba bwɛɛle nɔ naa?
Toma laa o tom ba ŋɔ bá ba sɔh nyiŋi ya harɛ nɔ, dɛ́ won ba yo yaa, dɛ́ pɔ ya nɛ aa?” Anomanta, Kooro Hanun lawɛ Kooro Devid toroma la dɛ fonɛ bɛlbwa tampona pera ta, dɛ teŋni ba laala baa doa la muŋkela ta, dɛ ɡel ba bá kaa.
Kooro Devid aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o tomɛ toroma ba kpɔ kala ka tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛ ba ɡelɔ sihiih kpo ba kohona.
O ŋɔ toroma la be kɛŋɔ bá ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá so Jeriko ka tel kɛŋɔ ba tampona la aa moɡa mɔɔ ba berɛ ba.
Amɔn tena aa na Kooro Devid bandia kɛŋɔ o mee le ba we-ɛɛla ta la, Kooro Hanun ne Amɔn tena la kpɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa lafraatoro fifraanaarɛ, dɛ kpɔ nyin kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, ne laa tena baa dɛ so jaɡre ta le Mɛsopoteemea ne Siiria bwɛɛre Maaka ne Soba ba.
Kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anɛ la ne nɛra baa so a ta baa nyina la, ba soŋe Maaka kooro ne o laa tena ja, asɛ ba ba so Medeba, asɛ Amɔn tena bwa ɡe le ba bwɛɛre ta dɛ́ ba yo.
Kooro Devid aa no waa nɔ la, o tomɛ Joab ne laa tena la bwa, ŋɔ bá ka yoo ba.
Amɔn tena la kpɔ ba te, dɛ ba che Raba waa ɛ ba bwɛjen la doonyoa, asɛ koranar baa bala dɛ ba cha la ɡe che bwɛɛ la dahare.
Joab nao kɛŋɔ laa tena lɔ o sie ne habɔɔ, anomanta, o le Israel laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba ka che Siiria tena la sie ba ne ba yo.
O kpɔ laa tena la kabora do o nime Abisae nɔn ta, asɛ Abisae kpɔ ba ka che Amɔn tena la sie ba ne bá yo.
Belaa Joab ŋɔ Abisae be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa na kɛŋɔ Siiria tena la dɛ pɔ n nɛ aa, he ba dɛ́ ba lɛɛ mɛ, dɛ Amɔn tena ɡe kpeɡri ba dɛ ɡwaa he nɛ aa, ń ɡe ba lɛɛ.
Dɔ bambile dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ ɡel ya won yo bansua ne lɛ ya nɛra ne Korowii bwɛjena cheɡ.
Waa aa too Korowii tea laanee wɛɛ ba ɛɛ.” Ate, Joab ne o laa tena kpɔ ba te dɛ ka yo Siiria tena la, asɛ ba chwa le ba sie kaa kwaraa.
Amɔn tena aa na Siiria tena ba chwa dɛɛ kaa la, ba chwao le Abisae be dɛ kaa bwɛjen la bini.
Anomanta, Joab berɔ ba Jerusalam.
Siiria tena aa naa kɛŋɔ Israel tena pɔ ba nɛɛ la, asɛ ba tomɛ toroma ba ka kpɔ laa tena le Yufretis Moo wee leebɔr baŋ le, asɛ Kooro Hadadesa laa sitɔɔ Sobak tɔ ba sie.
Kooro Devid aa no waa nɔ la, o boa Israel laa tena bwa nyoa, asɛ ba ɛɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo le.
Ba bɔne o laa tena la bini ba ka che ba chebɔra dɔma la baŋ bɛl.
Ba pa yoi la mun, kɛ Siiria laa tena la ta wone che Israel laa tena la sie.
Kooro Devid ne o laa tena kpoo nɛra baa soɡe kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore bini kaɡboŋa banuanɛ, ne laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ baa dɛ valɛ.
Ba kpo Sobak waa chɔ ba laa tena nyoa la ɡe.
Koranar baa lɔ Kooro Hadadesa lɔɡa aa naa kɛŋɔ Israel tena pɔ ba nɛɛ la, ba ne Kooro Devid kaa fɔwɛ deŋnesɔɔhna fɔo, dɛ kpɔ ba te do o lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ.
Gɛɛ a do Siiria tena ɔmɛ, ba ta Amɔn tena chae kpa.
Kooro Devid pɔ bwɛjen Raba tena nɛ Lɔmɔɡa saŋ koranar yon dɛɛ la laa la, Kooro Devid tomɛ Joab ŋɔ ó tɔ o laa tena sie, dɛ́ ka yo laa.
Ba kaa yo Amɔn tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ ka bar bwɛjen Raba ɡe cheme, dɛ chɔɡ o bwa o berɛ dimɡbia, kɛ Kooro Devid te soɡe Jerusalam.
A habɔɔ, Kooro Devid la Raba dɛ ka laa ba voɡ Molɛk kooɡbɛrɛ kpɔ o nyu ta.
O tɔɡre ɛɛ ɛ suuɡaswɛm kilore fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛɛ, ba bil bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa o ta, asɛ o kpɔ pi.
O pa ba laaladɛɛɡa kɛrɛdɛ le bwɛjen la ta kaa, asɛ dɛ lawɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta, dɛ ɡel baa peɡri daa dɛɛ loɡɛ para ne kpanfɛre.
Gɛɛ o ɛ Amɔn bwɛɛre la bwa ta, asɛ o ne o laa tena la bwa berɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Filisti tena yoi wa Anɔ habɔɔ, ba ne Filisti tena berɔ yo laa Gɛsa.
Laa la ta la, Sibekai waa le Husa kpo Refa te waa kpeɡa, o bwara do kpeɡri kohona naanar la bini bɛl baa yerɔ Sipai, asɛ Filisti tena ba do ba lɔɡa.
Ba ne Filisti tena berɔ yo laa, asɛ Jɛɛ bibaa Ɛlhanan kpo Laami waa ɛ Goliat nime, waa le Gat.
O lampea nyoa buni tɔɡre kɛŋɔ yasɔɔh kokorowa daa ken.
Laa bɛl ɡe chole Gat ja.
Dɛ baa bɛl kpeɡo o bwara do kpeɡri kohona.
O nɔn bɛlbwa ta, o dɔ nonie anumɛl, o nanie ɡe ɛ anumɛl o nakpale ta.
A bwa lɔ fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ.
O ɛ Rafa naa.
O muɡli Israel tena baah, asɛ Simea waa ɛ Kooro Devid dɔɔranar la bini bɛl bibaa Jonatan kpoo.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ Rafa naanar baa lɔ Gat, asɛ Kooro Devid ne o laa tena kpoo ba.
Kooro Devid kure o laa tena Bɔnsam dɛ nyin Israel tena na wa, dɛ ɡel Kooro Devid dɔ liire kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ó kure Israel tena.
Anomanta, Kooro Devid ŋɔ Joab ne laa nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Hé valɛ Israel deene la bwa ta, le Dan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera dɛ́ ba kaa Beɛseeba weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ́ chwerɛ ba sɔna dɛ́ ba bol n be, ásɛ n jemɛ ba nyoa.” Anee Joab chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɡel laa tena la warɛ bele lafa dɛ́ ɡwaa, ásɛ he na.
N naa, he bonɔɔna laa ba bwa naa, aa ɡel ya harɛ nɔ tena bwa di bolchɔɡe aa?” Kooro waa la tɔɔɡe Joab waa la ta, anomanta, Joab iro ka ɡaaɡe Israel harɛ bwa ta, dɛ berɛ ba Jerusalam.
Joab ba kooro be ba baɡle laa tena la nyoa baɡlo ŋɔ Israel harɛ ta ɡbo, ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa bele kaɡboŋ, dɛ kaɡboŋa lafa, asɛ Juda harɛ ta ɡe kaɡboŋa lafraanaarɛ fifraanuanɛ.
Joab ta Lewi dea tena ne Bɛnjamen dea tena kure ja, dɛkalkɛ dɛ kooro waa la aa somɛ o be.
Dɛ Korowii ɡe sie ta waa la ta lɛɛ, anomanta, o kpɔ deŋnetɛra ba ta Israel tena nɛ.
Belaa Kooro Devid ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Waa maa ɛa nɔ ɡelɔ n ɛ wechɔɡa kohona.
N dɛ soŋe, laa bolchɔɡe men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ aa dia nɔ kpɔ n nɛ.
N ɛ ɡɛnewa tenten.” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Devid keame Gad be ŋɔ, “La ka ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, ‘Kenii men Korowii ɛɛ bol, webele atoroo n kpɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, kpɔ a bini beŋkpoŋ, ń kpɔ tɛr he deŋne.’ ” Anomanta, Gad la Kooro Devid be ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa bola laanee nɔ, ‘Baɡle onla haa dɛ nyin.
He dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ lɔr chole he harɛ ta bene atoro, kɛɛ he teŋɛ chwa dɛɛ le he dɔma be, ásɛ ba ɡe chwa dɛɛ tii korobie atoro bwa naa?
Kɛɛ Korowii che o nyundua torome nɛɛ kpɔ weechɔɡa ba ta he harɛ nɛra bwa nɛɛ bobɛlbwa.’ Gel ń jemɛ waa maa ka bol naate waa tom mɛ la be.” Anee Kooro Devid chaŋo ŋɔ, “N lɔ suna kohona dii ta.
Maa nyin kɛ nɛwɛnyini te dɔɔ mɛ dɛ́ tɛr n deŋne.
Korowii ɡbabirii dɛ́ tɛr n deŋne, dɛkalkɛ onee dɛɛ sune nɛn nɛɛ kohona.” Anomanta, Korowii kpɔ weechɔɡa ba ta Israel harɛ ta, asɛ baala kaɡboŋa fifraanuanɛ serewe.
Korowii le nyundua torome bɛl dɛ tɛo kpeɡri ŋɔ ó ba chɔɡ Jerusalam.
Waa dɛ la ka chɔɡo la, Korowii berɔ charɛ o liire, dɛ ŋɔ torome la be ŋɔ, “Gel!
A maɡre ɡɛ.” Gɛ saŋ dɛ torome la lɔ Jebus te Arauna mea lɔ bɔr.
Kooro Devid ha sie nyiŋi dɛ na Korowii nyundua torome la kɛŋɔ waa cheɡɛ harɛ ne nyundua baah, dɛ pamɛ kere pa Jerusalam dɛɛ ba o chɔɡa.
Dɛ Kooro Devid ne o nomonome tɔ lweyale, ba cholo dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Kooro Devid soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, menee ɡela ba kure nɛra la, anomanta, menee ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ di a bolchɔɡe.
Nɛra nɔ baa do kɛŋɔ peera nɔ laa ɛ waane.
Kpɔ deŋnetɛra bɛlbwa ba ta n ne n haahna ne n bii nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he nɛra Israel tena.” Belaa Korowii nyundua torome bɛl ŋɔ Gad be ŋɔ, ó ka ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ ó la Jebus te Arauna mea lɔ bɔr bela dɛ́ ka ma kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii.
Anomanta, kooro teŋɛ Korowii nyoa wobol Gad aa baa bol o be la ta, dɛ ka ɛ ɡɛ tenten.
Dɛ Arauna ne o bibaala banaarɛ lɔ mea lɔ bɔr bela dɛɛ lɔ mea.
Baa na nyundua torome la, bibaala la chwao ka sɔh.
Ate, Kooro Devid suuh tel, asɛ Arauna nao dɛ le ka chemo, dɛ ka ɡuŋu dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Kooro Devid chaŋo ŋɔ, “N balɔ dɛ́ ba yawɛ he mea lɔ bɔr nɔ, dɛ́ ma kon maa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ weechɔɡa la ɡel nɛra kpoora.
Yoɡ tɛ mɛ ɡɛ bwa aa chɛa.” Ate, Arauna ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, kpɔ komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin ka ɛ saraha la tɛ Korowii.
Nabala haa kpɔ ɛ saraha baa fuah, ne daa aa sarawe mea lɔ bɔr la ɡee nɔ bá kpɔ mar, ne mea ɡe haa kpɔ ɛ saraha.
N naa kooro, n kpɔ anɔ bwa tɛɛ.” Asɛ kooro chaŋo ŋɔ, “Akai, n ta cheɡɔɔ kɛ ń bɔe o kem.
Maa kwaa kpo, dɛ́ fuah ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ pɛɛpɛɛ, maa wola kem bɛlbwaa bɔ.” Anomanta, o yawɛ mea lɔ bɔr la suuɡaswɛm bwea lafraanumɛl.
Kooro Devid ma kon waa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii bela, dɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare baa fuah ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare tɛo.
O soŋe Korowii asɛ o ɡel nii le nyundua, dɛ ba fuh saraha kwaa la bwa.
Ate, Korowii bol waa nyundua torome la be, asɛ o berɛ kere la su o tɔɔ ta.
Kooro Devid aa naa kɛŋɔ Korowii no o wesoŋa Arauna waa ɛ Jebus te mea lɔ bɔr la, o kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare bela.
Dɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea Mosis aa baŋro pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, ne kon baa dɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta la bwa ta lɔ bela baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii Gebeɔn.
Kɛ Kooro Devid ta wone la o ta ka soŋe Korowii, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ kere Korowii nyundua torome la aa pama la.
Belaa Kooro Devid ŋɔ, “Korowii Dea la ne kon Israel tena aa dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó che bonɔ.” Korowii Dea mae mumpar Anomanta, Kooro Devid ɡelɔ ba boa hɔɔhra baa lɔ Israel harɛ nyoa, asɛ o le ba bini bane baa dɛɛ peɡri bwea baa kpɔ ma Korowii Dea la.
O nyin bune a warɛ ba kpɔ kwaa dadowɛre ne njinasoɔre baa kpɔ do ɡbeni ta, dɛ ayaawa aa wara baa wola won maɡa.
Kooro ɡelɔ bwɛjena Sidon ne Taaya tena ɡe ba tɛo peleme daa aa wara kɛrɛdɛ.
Belaa o lii ŋɔ, “N bie Solomɔn nɔn ta kao, waa wobɛlbwa jemɛ, Korowii Dea waa dɛ ba doe nɔ ɡe chɛ kɛ ó do wer kohona, dɛ́ lɛ sɔn harɛre bwa ta.
Amɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ ń nyiŋi dɛ́ kpɔ o laa kɛrɛdɛ.” Anomanta, o nyin laala waa kpɔ ma Dea la bil warɛ mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ.
Kooro yerɛ o bibaa Solomɔn dɛ doo ŋɔ onee chɛ kɛ ó do Dea tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la.
O ŋɔ Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “N bie, dɛ n bambile fe lawɔ kɛŋɔ ń do Dea tɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la.
Kɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘He yo laa dɛ kpoo nɛra kohona.
Anomanta, he laa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé do Dea tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ he fuɡe chal ta kohona harɛ nɔ ta n sie.
Hɛɛ ba dɔ bibaa bɛlee, o ɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhna, mɛɛ ɡeloo o dɔ bosɔɔhna le o dɔma bwa nɛ.
Baa dɛɛ yerɔ Solomɔnee.
O bere saŋ, mɛɛ ɡeloo deŋnesɔɔhna ba Israel harɛ ta ba bwara sɔɔh ba.
Onee dɛ́ ba do n Dea tɛ mɛ.
Mɛɛ kpɔɔ ɛ n bie n ɡe ɛ o mɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel o kora che kiŋkiŋ Israel harɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’ N bidɛɛɡe, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ tɛɛ hɛɛra he won do Dea tɛo ɡɛ waa bola la.
Ó tɛɛ wejema ne waa mun noe kɛrɛdɛ, he won kpɔ nyiŋi o nɛra Israel tena nɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare bwa ɡe ta.
He do sie dɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la ta naa, anee dɛ́ ɡel he wobɛlbwa do wer.
Bɛ ɔmɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he sie beɡre waa maa doe nɔ ta kɛrɛdɛ.
N takapɔ dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋ bele kaɡboŋa atoro, dɛ kaɡboŋa lafraanaarɛ, ne suuɡapoŋa a ɡe tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋ bele kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛ, ne ayaawa dɛ bune aa wara ne daa ne bwea bwa ba, ásɛ he nyin ane ja do dea la.
Nɛra baa ɛ toma la warɔ, banɔ la baa peɡri bwea ne mamaala ne kapenta tena, dɛ baala baa dɔ toma bwa soo siwi wejema, kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ta, ne ayaawa ne bune.
Nɛra baa jemɛ kwaa bwa soo siwi sɛɛh baa wola nyoa dɔe.
Name, pa toma la mun, Kórowii ja he nɛ.” Ate, Kooro Devid ŋɔ Israel nomonome bwa be ŋɔ bá cha o bibaa Solomɔn.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kórowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ja he nɛ.
O ta ɡelɛ he so deŋnesɔɔhna ta he bwara sɔɔh heya aa?
O ɡelɔ n yo dɛ pɔ nɛra ba fa aa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta nɛ, ba do on Korowii ne ya lɔɡa.
Name, le fini kpɔ he bambile ne liire bwa ne dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.
Pa mun ma Korowii Dea la, ásɛ dɛ won kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ne laala aa do ɡoroŋ ba kpɔ dɛɛ tomɔ la bwa ba cheɡ o bini.”
Lewi dea tena Kooro Devid aa baa hwɛɛh kohona la, o kpɔ o bibaa Solomɔn cheɡ Israel kora ta.
O yerɛ Israel nomonome bwa, ne Lewi dea tena dɛ sɔfore bwa cheme.
O kure Lewi dea tena baa dɔ bene fifraatoro ne a habɔɔ la, ba ɛ baala kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ banuatoro.
Belaa Kooro Devid ŋɔ, “Gɛ baala nɔ, ba bini kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ baa nyiŋi toma aa lɔ Korowii Dea bonɔ ta, ásɛ ba bini kaɡboŋa banumɛl ɡe ɛ karakere, dɛ bɛl ne o dɔŋ dɔ wa aa, ba bini bane nyiŋi dɛɛ bola.
Ba bini kaɡboŋa banaarɛ ɛɛ daah doonyoo la, ásɛ kaɡboŋa banaarɛ ɡe kpɔ kwaa baa dɛ hɛlɛ ane ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii.
N nyin a bwa, bá kpɔ ɛ toma nɔ.” Kooro Devid bɔne Lewi dea tena denaa ta.
Gɛsɔn ne Kohat dɛ Merari luɡri nɛra.
Gɛsɔn dea nɛra Gɛsɔn bibaalaa, Ladan ne Simee.
Ladan ɡe bibaalaa, Jehiel, onee biloɡle ne Sɛtam dɛ Joel.
Ba lɔ bibaala batoro.
Simee ɡe bibaalaa, Sɛlomɔt ne Haseɛl dɛ Haaran.
Ba lɔ bibaala batoro.
Banee Ladan dea nomonnyuune.
Simee ɡe bibaalaa, Jahat ne Sesa ne Jeyus dɛ Bɛrea.
Ba lɔ bibaala banaarɛ.
Jahat, onee biloɡle asɛ Sesa teŋɛ, kɛ Jeyus ne Bɛrea te ta bibaala lolɛ warɛ.
Anomanta, baa dɛ kur ba la, ba kur ba pɛ dɛ kpɔ tombeŋkpoŋ do ba nɔn ta.
Kohat dea nɛra Kohat bibaalaa, Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.
Ba lɔ bibaala banaarɛ.
Amram ɡe bibaalaa, Arɔn ne Mosis.
Ba le Arɔn cheɡ, asɛ o ne o naanar ɛɛ nyiŋi kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii a do ɡoroŋ kohona ta.
Asɛ ba kpɔ saraha kwaa dɛɛ la Korowii sie, dɛɛ ɛ toma o sie dɛ che o sɔn ta swee andɛɛɡa tɛ nɛra saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ba kure Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis bibaala kɛŋɔ Lewi dea tena pera.
Mosis bibaalaa, Gɛɛsɔm ne Eliesa.
Gɛɛsɔm ɡe naanaree, Subael, onee binomoa.
Eliesa ɡe naanaree, Rehabia, onee ɛ binomoa.
Eliesa ta bibaa bɛlbwa lolɛ kpa, kɛ Rehabia te lolɛ bibaala warɛ.
Isiha ɡe bibaalaa, Sɛlomet, onee binomoa.
Hɛbrɔn ɡe bibaalaa, Jɛrea, onee binomoa, ne Amaria ne Jahaseɛl dɛ Jekameam.
Ba lɔ bibaala banaarɛ.
Usiel ɡe bibaalaa, Maeka, onee binomoa asɛ Isihia ɡe teŋɛ.
Merari dea nɛra Merari ɡe bibaalaa, Maali ne Musi.
Maali ɡe bibaalaa, Eliasa ne Kes.
Eliasa aa baa sewɛ la o ta bibaala lolɛ, bihaahna ɡboo o lolɛ.
Kes bibaala baa ɛ ba nimanar laanee kpɔ ba mo.
Musi ɡe bibaalaa, Maali ne Ida dɛ Jerimot.
Ba lɔ bibaala batoro.
Dɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ le Lewi dea dɛ ɛ ba nomonnyuune, ba kur ba beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa dɛ chwerɛ ba sɔna la.
Ba bini tom-ɛɛra baa di bene fifraanɛ kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la.
Kooro Devid fa bolɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ ɡelɔ o nɛra dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna, asɛ Korowii ɡbabir ɛɛ ba ba so Jerusalam saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, ɡɛ nomanta, Lewi dea tena la ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá che Korowii Tɛnte Dea la kɛɛ komɛlbwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la kpa.” A cheɡɛ waa Kooro Devid aa bola ta, ba kure Lewi dea tena la le banɔ la baa di bene fifraanɛ kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa la.
Dɛ Lewi dea tena la tomaa kɛŋɔ baa cha Arɔn naanar Korowii Dea bini toma ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi dembaahna la ne dejeɡre aa lɔ o ta, dɛ laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ bɛlbwa aa lɔ bela ta.
Ba tomaa kɛŋɔ ba nyiŋi dɛ kpɔ paanoo ba dawɛ teebur ta, ne men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ ba kpɔ ɛ mea saraha, ne biskeeti baa wola iisi a ta do, a charama ne ɡɛ baa maɡa bwa.
Toma ane ɡee kɛŋɔ chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra bɛlbwa, bá ir dɛɛ jam dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, ne saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah nɛra aa dɛ ba a ne Ona Tɔpera ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, ne anɔ la aa jaa Korowii lea cheɡ.
Saŋ bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ bá warɛ do bela dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ baa kpɔa do ba nɔn ta.
Gɛɛ Lewi dea tena ɛ ba tomare baa kpɔa do ba nɔn ta Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la bini ne Boɡoroŋ bela, ba do Arɔn naanar lɔɡa, dɛɛ cha ba Korowii Dea bela.
Toma baa kpɔa do sɔfore nɔn ta Kenii Arɔn bibaala ne o naanar waa do.
O bibaalaa, Nadab ne Abihu ne Eliasa dɛ Itama.
Kɛ Nadab ne Abihu te sewɔ mɔɔ ba mɛɛ sewɛ, ba ta bibaala lolɛ anomanta, Eliasa ne Itama ɛ sɔfore toma.
Eliasa naa Sadɔk ne Itama ɡe naa Ahemɛlɛk cha Kooro Devid, asɛ o bɔne Arɔn naanar la bini kuore ta, dɛ kpɔ bɛlbwa toma do o nɔn ta.
Nomonome warɔ le Eliasa naanar bini ɡwaa Itama naanar.
Dɛ ba bɔne ba kuore fi dɛ banumɛl.
Nomonnyuune fi dɛ banumɛl le Eliasa naanar bini, asɛ banuatoro ɡe le Itama naanar bini.
Ba ta bɛl nyine dɛ ɡwaa o dɔŋ dɛ bil daa, dɛ nomonome baa nyiŋi Korowii Dea bela lole, asɛ sɔfore ɡe do le, bane ɛ Eliasa naanar bane ɡe ɛ Itama naanar.
Nɛtanɛl bibaa Sɛmaya waa ɛ Lewi dea te, onee chwerɛ ba sɔna Kooro Devid ne o nomonome bwa sie.
Sadɔk waa ɛ sɔfo ne Abiata bibaa Ahemɛlɛk, ne sɔfore dea ne Lewi dea nomonnyuune ɡe jao, ba chwerɛ sɔna la.
Ba le dea beŋkpoŋ le Eliasa naanar bini, dɛ le bɛl le Itama naanar ɡe bini.
Loɡle kon lawɛ Jehoiarib, nɛɛte ɛ Jedaya, toorote Harim, naarɛte ɛ Seorim, nuete Malkija, numɛlte ɛ Mijamin, nuanɛte Hakɔs, nuatoro ɛ Abija.
Anuanaarɛ Jesua, fite ɛ Sɛkania, fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ɛ Eliasib, fi dɛ anɛ Jakim, fi dɛ atoro ɛ Hupa, fi dɛ anaarɛ ɛ Jesebeab, fi dɛ anue ɛ Bilɡa, fi dɛ anumɛl ɛ Ima.
Fi dɛ anuanɛ ɛ Hesir, fi dɛ anuatoro ɛ Hapesɛs, fi dɛ anuanaarɛ ɛ Pɛtahea, fifraanɛ ɛ Jehɛskɛl.
Fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ ɛ Jakin, fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ ɛ Gamul, fifraanɛ dɛ atoro ɛ Delaya, fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ ɛ Maasia.
Gɛɛ ba lee ba dɛ kpɔ do ba nɔn ta, ba teŋɛ kaa jo Korowii Dea bela kaa ɛ toma, ɡɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa cheɡɛ ba nabaa Arɔn nɛɛ do ba la.
Lewi dea nɛra kabora Lewi naanar kar.
Le Amram bibaala, Subael.
Le Subael ɡe bibaala, Jedeya.
Rehabia ɡe bibaala bini, Isihia, onee biloɡle.
Isiha tena ɡe la, Sɛlomɔt.
Sɛlomɔt bibaala ɡe bini, Jahat.
Hɛbrɔn bibaala waa lol ba laanee Jɛrea, onee biloɡle asɛ Amaria teŋɛ nɛɛ, Jahaseɛl teŋɛ tooro asɛ Jekameam teŋɛ naarɛ.
Usiel bibaa, Maeka.
Maeka ɡe bibaala, Samir.
Maeka nime, Isihia.
Isihia bibaala, Sekaria.
Merari bibaala, Maali ne Musi.
Jaasia bibaa, Beno.
Merari bibaala, Jaasia luɡe ta, Soham ne Sakur dɛ Ibri.
Maali ɡe bibaala, Eliasa ne Kes, kɛ Eliasa ta bibaala lolɛ.
Kes luɡe ta, o bibaa Jeramiil.
Musi ɡe bibaala, Maali ne Ida dɛ Jerimot.
Banee Lewi naanar ne ba lolanar.
Ba ɡe bil daa kɛŋɔ ba dɔɔranar Arɔn naanar aa ɛa la, Kooro Devid ne Sadɔk ne Ahemɛlɛk dɛ sɔfore nomonnyuune ne Lewi dea nomonnyuune la bwa sie.
Ba nyiŋi dea bɛlbwa binomoa, dɛ nyiŋi bechale bwa kɛrɛdɛ, bɛl ta bɛl ɡwaalɛ.
Korowii Dea yelɡoola Kooro Devid ne o laa nomonome le Asaf bibaala Heman ne Jedutun baa bol Korowii wa, dɛɛ lɔ janjela ne kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ dɛɛ ɡo yela.
Nɛra baa jaa dɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ toma nɔ laanee teŋa nɔ.
Asaf bibaala, Sakur ne Josef ne Nɛtanea dɛ Asarɛla.
Dɛ Asaf bibaala lɔ Asaf lɔɡa wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Onee dɛ Kooro dɛ nyin waane bini dɛ jemaa, o yon ɡel o bol Korowii waa.
Jedutun bibaala lɔ nɛra banumɛl, banee teŋa nɔ, Gedalia ne Sɛre ne Jesaya ne Simee ne Hasabia dɛ Matitia.
Dɛ ba mɛɛ Jedutun dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ dɛɛ bol Korowii wa, dɛ lɔ janjela ja dɛɛ kpɛɛ dɛɛ jam Korowii.
Heman ɡe bibaalaa nɔ, Bukia ne Matania ne Usiel ne Subael ne Jerimot ne Hanania ne Hanani ne Eliata ne Gedalti ne Romamti Esa ne Josbekasa, ne Maloti ne Hotir dɛ Mahasiot.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ kooro keame Heman waa dɛ na chaahna dɛɛ bol o be la bibaala.
Korowiirii kpɔa dɛɛ tɛo o kpɔ dɛɛ kpɛɛ kooro.
Korowii tɛ Heman bibaala fi dɛ banaarɛ, dɛ bihaahna batoro.
Dɛ ba bwa lɔ ba mɛɛ sie dɛɛ lɔ kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, ne janjela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii o Dea.
Asɛ Asaf ne Jedutun ne Heman ɡe do kooro lɔɡa wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Ba ne ba lolanar baa ja ba nɛɛ bwa lɔ nɛra lafraanɛ fifraanuatoro dɛ banuatoro, ba chaɡ ba ba dɔ yela ɡoe wejema, dɛ ɡo dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii.
Ba ne ba nomonome ne bechale bwa, chichare ne nɛra ba ta aa dɛ hweli, ba bil daa mɔɔ bɛlbwa jemɛ o toma waa ɛ. Loɡle kon waa ɛ Asaf kon la luɡe ta la lawɛ Josef, o ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, nɛɛte lawɛ Gedalia, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, toorote lawɛ Sakur, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, naarɛte lawɛ Isri, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, nuete lawɛ Nɛtanea, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, numɛlte lawɛ Bukia, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, nuanɛte lawɛ Jesarela, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, nuatorote lawɛ Jesaya, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, nuanaarɛte lawɛ Matania, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fite lawɛ Simee, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ lawɛ Aasarɛl, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fi dɛ anɛ lawɛ Hasabia, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fi dɛ atoro lawɛ Subael, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fi dɛ anaarɛ lawɛ Matitia, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fi dɛ anue lawɛ Jerimot, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fi dɛ anumɛl lawɛ Hanania, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fi dɛ anuanɛ lawɛ Josbekasa, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fi dɛ anuatoro lawɛ Hanani, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fi dɛ anuanaarɛ lawɛ Maloti, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fifraanɛ lawɛ Eliata, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ lawɛ Hotir, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ lawɛ Gedalti, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fifraanɛ dɛ atoro lawɛ Mahasiot, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar, fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ lawɛ Romamti Esa, o ɡe ne o bibaala dɛ o lolanar.
Nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa Kenii ba bɔne nɛra baa dɛɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa la bini.
Kora dea bini la, Kore bibaa Mɛselemea, o ɛ Asaf naa.
Mɛselemea ɡe bibaalaa, Sekariaa biloɡle, Jedial waa teŋa nɛɛ, Sebadia teŋɛ tooro, Jatneɛl teŋɛ naarɛ.
Elam teŋɛ nue, Jehohanan teŋɛ anumɛl, Eliehonai teŋɛ anuanɛ.
Ɔbɛd Edom ɡe bibaalaa, Sɛmayaa biloɡle, Jehosabad teŋɛ nɛɛ, Joa teŋɛ tooro, Saka teŋɛ naarɛ, asɛ Nɛtanɛl teŋɛ nue.
Ameɛl teŋɛ numɛl, Isaaka teŋɛ nuanɛ, asɛ Peuletai teŋɛ nuatoro.
Dɛ Korowii swee Ɔbɛd Edom andɛɛɡa.
O bibaa Sɛmaya ɡe lolɛ bibaala ba ɛ nomonome ba mɛɛ dem, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba dɔ ba te.
Sɛmaya bibaalaa, Otni ne Refaɛl ne Ɔbɛd dɛ Ɛlsabad.
Dɛ o lolanaree, Elihu ne Sɛmakia, dɛ ba ɡe dɔ ba te.
Ɔbɛd Edom naanaree a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa, dɛ ba ne ba bibaala ne ba lolanar dɔ ba te, dɛ dɔ bokpeɡa dɛɛ ɛ toma la.
O naanar lɔ nɛra fifraanumɛl dɛ banɛ.
Mɛselemea dɔ bibaala ne lolanar baa dɔ ba te kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba lɔ nɛra fi dɛ banuatoro.
Hosa waa ɛ Merari te bibaalaa, Simri, onee o mɛɛ leo binomoa, kɛ dɛ o laa fe, asɛ Hilkia teŋɛ nɛɛ, Tabalia teŋɛ tooro, asɛ Sekaria teŋɛ naarɛ.
Hosa bibaala ne o lolanar bwa lɔ nɛra fi dɛ batoro.
Ba bɔne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa la kuore ta.
Ba dɔ ba nomonome baa nyiŋi ba nɛɛ toma baa kpɔa tɛɛ ba ta bela, ɡɛ ba lolanar baa tɔ sie faa ɛa la.
Doonyoa bɛlbwa ta la, ba bil daa lolanar bɛlbwa bini, le bechale nɛɛ ba nomonome nɛ, dɛ jemɛ onɔ la waa nyiŋi o ta.
Wee leebɔr doonyoa la lawɛ Sɛlɛmia, asɛ o bibaa Sekaria waa dɛ ja nɛra la, weekaŋle nyundua doonyoa lawɛ o ɡe.
Weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa kon lawɛ Ɔbɛd Edom, asɛ dea baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa o bini kon lawɛ o bibaala ɡe.
Wee cholibɔr doonyoa kon, ne Saleket Doonyoa waa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔ dea la nyunduabɔr la ɡe lawɛ Supim ne Hosa.
Ba bɔne tɔpera tɛ bɛlbwa ba la kaa daahna.
Tɔpebeŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa, Lewi dea nɛra banumɛl lɔ wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, banaarɛ do o weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, banaarɛ do o weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ ba nɛra banɛnɛ ɡe pɛ dɛɛ so dea baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa o bini la doonyoa.
Wee cholibɔr dembaah la ta te, nɛra banaarɛ dɛ daah ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔ bela, asɛ banɛ do dembaah bela tenten.
Gɛɛ ba bɔne Kora ne Merari naanar bini, dɛ kpɔ do ba nɔn ta ŋɔ baa daah doonyoa bela.
Korowii Dea la tomare ane ɡe Ba bala Lewi dea tenaa chɔ laala aa lɔ Korowii Dea bela ne deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini, ne anɔ la baa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii la bwa nyoa.
Ladan ɛ Gɛsɔn tena la bini bɛl, o naanar warɔ taeh.
O bibaa Jehieli bibaala ne naanar ɡe jao.
