Ladan bibaala banɛ Sɛtam ne Joel, dɛ ba ɡee chɔ laala aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini la nyoa.
Amram naanar, ne Isiha naanar, ne Hɛbrɔn naanar dɛ Usiel naanar dɔ toma baa kpɔa do ba nɔn ta.
Subael waa ɛ Mosis bibaa Gɛɛsɔm naa laanee chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah laala la nyoa.
A cheɡɛ o lole Eliesa nɛ o ne Sɛlomet ɛɛ di lola.
Eliesaa lolɛ Rehabia, o ɡe lolɛ Jesaya, Jesaya ɡe lolɛ Joram, Joram lolɛ Sikri, asɛ Sikri lolɛ Sɛlomet.
Dɛ Sɛlomet ne o lolanaree chɔ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, Kooro Devid aa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii nyoa, ne nomonnyuune baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo, dɛ laa tena nomonome bane baa kaa la nyoa.
Ba kpɔ laala baa paa laa ta la ane ba tɛ, ba kpɔ ɛ Korowii Dea la toma.
Komɛlbwa Samoɛl waa dɛ na chaahna ne Kes bibaa Sɔɔl, ne Nɛr bibaa Abna, dɛ Seruya bibaa Joab aa kpɔa tɛ Korowii ne laala aa jaa bwa, dɛ Sɛlomet ne o lolanaree dɛɛ nyiŋi a ta.
Isiha naanar bini, Kenania ne o bibaalaa ba kpɔ toma aa wola Korowii Dea bela ta jae tɛ, dɛ ɛɛ ba nomonome baa bol nɛra ne ba bala baah ta wa Israel harɛ ta.
Hɛbrɔn naanar bini ɡe, Hasabia ne o lolanar kaɡboŋ lafraanuanɛ baa dɔ ba te kɛrɛdɛ, ɡee chɔ Jɔɔdan Moo wee cholibɔr ne Korowii toma bɛlbwa soo siwi, ne kooro toma nyoa Israel harɛ ta.
Hɛbrɔn naanar bini la, dɛ Jɛrea ɛ ba nyu te, ɡɛ baa chwerɛ ba sɔna denaa ta ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Kooro Devid aa di kora bene fifraanaarɛ ta la, ba nyiŋi tɔne bini, dɛ na kɛŋɔ ba bini laa tena baa kpeɡa bane soɡe Jasa waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta.
Kooro Devid le nomonnyuune kaɡboŋa banɛ lafraanuanɛ, baa dɔ ba te le Jɛrea lolanar bini, ba chɔ Rubin ne Gad deene dɛ Manasɛ dea pera, ne Korowii be pera waa ne kooro waa bwa nyoa ta.
Laa tena bini bɔna Kenii Israel tena nomonnyuune ne nomonome baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo, ne ba nomonome baa dɛ tomɛ kooro, dɛɛ nyiŋi laa waa bwa ta benanyobir korobie bɛlbwa ta waa do.
Dɛ ba bɔne ba bini, bɛlbwa dɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korobiloɡle ta la, Sabdiel bibaa Jasobeam.
Ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
O ɛ Pɛrɛs naa, asɛ dɛ ɛ laa sitɔɔla bwa nomoa korobiloɡle la ta.
Korobinɛɛte ta, Aho te Dodai ɛ ba bwa sitɔɔ, asɛ Meklɔt ɡe ja o nɛ.
Ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korobitooro te ta, sɔfo Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya, dɛ o ɛ laa sitɔɔ, asɛ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ do o lɔɡa.
A ɡɛ Bɛnaya nɔ ɛ banyoo tenten, dɛ fa chɔ banyoola fifraatoro bane nyoa.
O bibaa sɔne Amisabad, dɛ onee chɔ o laa tena nɔ nyoa.
Korobinaarɛ ta, Joab nime Asahɛl, dɛ o bibaa sɔne Sebadia dɛ ba chiɡ o naa ta.
Ba ɡe lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korobinue ta, Samhut waa le Isra.
Dɛ onee ba sitɔɔ, ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korobinumɛl ta, Ikes waa le Tekoa bibaa Ira.
O laa tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korobinuanɛ ta, ba sitɔɔ Hɛlɛs, Pɛlɔn te, waa le Efrem dea la, dɛ o dɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korobinuatoro ta, ba sitɔɔ Sibekai, waa le Husa, dɛ le Sɛra dea la, dɛ o dɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korobinuanaarɛ ta, sitɔɔ la sɔne Abeɛsa waa le Anatɔt, dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea.
Ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korobie fi ta, sitɔɔ la sɔne Maharai waa le Nɛtɔfa, dɛ le Sɛra dea.
Ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korobie fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta, sitɔɔ la sɔne Bɛnaya waa le Peratɔn, dɛ le Efrem dea.
Ba laa tena lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Korobie fi dɛ anɛ ta, sitɔɔ la sɔne Hɛldai waa le Nɛtɔfa, o ɛ Otniel naa.
Ba ɡe lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Nomonome baa chɔ deene nyoo Nomonome baa dɛɛ ɛ toma dɛ chɔ Israel deene nyoo laanee, Rubin dea, Sikri bibaa Eliesa.
Simeon dea, Maaka bibaa Sɛfatea.
Lewi dea, Kɛmoɛl bibaa Hasabia.
Arɔn dea, Sadɔk.
Juda dea, Elihu, o ɛ Kooro Devid dɔɔ.
Isaaka dea, Maekel bibaa Omri.
Sebulon dea, Obadia bibaa Ismaya.
Naftale dea, Asriel bibaa Jerimot.
Efrem dea, Asasia bibaa Hosia.
Manasɛ dea pera, Pɛdaya bibaa Joel.
Manasɛ dea pera tena baa soɡe Gelead, Sekaria bibaa Ido.
Bɛnjamen dea, Abna bibaa Jaaseɛl.
Dan dea, Jɛroham bibaa Aasarɛl.
Dɛ banee ɛ nomonome dɛɛ nyiŋi Israel deene ta.
Kooro Devid ta baala baa wola bene fifraanɛ tele la kure, dɛkalkɛ Korowii baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena warɛ kɛŋɔ weweela ken.
Dɛ Seruya bibaa Joab fe pa mun ŋɔ o kur ba kɛ o ta wone tonɛ.
Anomanta, Korowii tɛr Israel tena deŋne nɛra kura nɔ wa, ba ta nɛra baa kur ba la nyoa baɡlɛ do Kooro Devid Waa Tɔne bini.
Nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Kooro laala ta Adeɛl bibaa Asmavɛt, dɛ onee dɛɛ nyiŋi koodem deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini bwa ta.
Ussia bibaa Jonatan ɡe ɛɛ nyiŋi deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini, bwɛjeɡre ne bwɛjena dɛ jɛŋle ta.
Kelub bibaa Esri chɔ nɛra baa dɛ parɛ kooni nyoa.
Simee waa le Rama laanee dɛɛ nyiŋi daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ kooni ta.
Sabdi waa le Sɛfam ɡe ɛɛ nyiŋi daa nɔna baa chaara, dɛ́ kpɔ kaa bela baa harama ta.
Baal Hanan waa le Gɛda, ɡe chɔ ɔleve daa ne fiɡ daa aa lɔ wee cholibɔr deŋɡarere harɛ ta nyoa.
Asɛ Joas ɡe chɔ ɔleve noo nyoa.
Sitrai waa le Sarɔn, ɡee chɔ kooro nae nɛra aa kpɔa dɛɛ la a ne dibɔra Sarɔn nyoa.
Asɛ Adlai bibaa Safat ɡe chɔ kooro nae baa kpɔa dɛɛ la dibɔra fɛlembɔjena bini nyoa.
Obil waa le Ismael dea, ɡe chɔ nyoɡmare nyoa.
Jedeya waa le Mɛrɔnɔt ɡe chɔ keeɡore nyoa.
Jasis waa ɛ Haɡri te ɡe chɔ peera ne boohna nyoa.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Kooro Devid nomonome dɛɛ nyiŋi o laala ta.
Nɛra baa dɛ ja Kooro Devid Jonatan waa ɛ Kooro Devid mɛɛ nime la ɛ nɛn waa dɛ ja nɛra.
O dɔ wejema dɛ jemɛ tɔn ɡe.
O ne Hakmoni bibaa Jehiel ɡee dɛɛ nyiŋi kooro bibaala nɛ.
Dɛ Ahetofɛl ɡee dɛɛ ja kooro dɛɛ tɛo liire.
Husai waa ɛ Aaki te ɛ kooro dam.
Ahetofɛl aa baa sewɛ la, Bɛnaya bibaa Jehoiada ne Abiata baa chiɡ o naa ta, asɛ Joab ɛ kooro laa tena sitɔɔ.
Kooro Devid baɡle ɡɛ baa ma Korowii Dea Kooro Devid yerɛ Israel nomonome la bwa cheme Jerusalam.
Nomonome baa chɔ Israel deene nyoo ne nomonome baa chɔ kooro tomare nyoo, ne sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo, ne nomonome baa chɔ kooro bibaala ne o laala ne kondɛɛre nyoo, ne koodem nomonome dɛ banyoola bwa.
Ate, Kooro Devid ir che dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé no n be, bwɛɛla.
N liiro ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ń do dea dɛ́ kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ o bini, ó ɛ Korowii natiɡribɔr.
Asɛ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ baa mao.
Kɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ n laa dɛ́ do Dea tɛo, n yo laa dɛ kpoo nɛra kohona.
Kɛ ane a bwa, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ le n ne n naanar kɛ, yá ɛ Israel harɛ koranar saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O le nomoa le Juda dea tena bini, dɛ le nomoa le n mɛɛ wa luɡe waa le Juda.
N mɛɛ bibaala bwa bini ɡe menee o bambile lawɛ, dɛ cheɡ mɛ kora Israel harɛ bwa.
Korowii tɛ mɛ bibaala warɛ taeh, o le Solomɔn ba bini ŋɔ ó so Israel kora waa ɛ Korowii kon ta.
O berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘He bie Solomɔn, onee dɛ́ do n Dea ne a dembaahna bwa tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ n leo dɛ kpɔɔ ɛ n bie, o ɡe kpɔ mɛ ɛ o mɛɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o kora che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛ o sɛoh dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa kpɔa tɛo bwa ta, ɡɛ aa lole fini nɔ ta naa.’ Anomanta, n dɛ ŋɔ he be Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ne o nɛra Israel tena bwa siwi ta kɛŋɔ, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ nɔ mmarare ne waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa bwa ta, ásɛ dɛ won dɔ harɛdɛɛɡe nɔ, hale he naanar bwa ɡe bá dɔ ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Kooro Devid berɔ ŋɔ, “N bie Solomɔn, kpɔ he te do Korowii he naawa aa dɛ tomɔ la lɔɡa, dɛ́ tomɔ he bambile ne liire bwa ne.
Korowii dɛ nyiŋi bambile bini dɛ jemɛ liire bɛlbwa.
He kpɔ he te tɛo waa, hɛɛ nao, kɛ dɛ he berɛ habɔɔ kpoo tenaa, o ɡe ɛɛ vɛɛh saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee Korowii le ŋɔ he do o Dea tɛo.
Gel he siwi beɡre dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ waa doe la bwa.” Ate, Kooro Devid kpɔ ɡɛ baa ma dea la pato ne o bini deene, ne deene baa cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bini, ne nyundua deene ne o bini deene, dɛ bela baa kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa la Korowii be kaa soŋe, ó kpɔ kɛ ba tɛo.
O kpɔ ɡɛ dea la mar aa dɛ ba doe tɛo ɡɛ Korowii Doma la aa kpɔa do o liire bini.
O dembaahna ne deene aa baro baa kpɔ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, ne koŋkɛɛla baa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii dɛɛ cheɡ a bini bwa.
O baɡ ba ɡɛ baa le sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena baa ba ɛ toma Dea la bini bwa, dɛɛ nyiŋi loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma o bini bwa ɡe ta.
O baɡle ɡɛ baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm baa kpɔ kwaa loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ tomare Dea la bini.
Suuɡaswɛm baa kpɔ kwaa kandea daa la ne o kandere, ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ a bɛlbwa tɔɡre do, ne suuɡapoŋa baa kpɔ kwaa kandea daa ne o kandere, ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ a bɛlbwa tɔɡre do, ne ɡɛ baa kpɔ kandea bɛlbwa dɛɛ ɛ toma, ne suuɡaswɛm tenten baa kpɔ kwaa teebur bɛlbwa baa kpɔ paanoo baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii aa do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ dawɛ a ta ne a tɔɡre, ne suuɡapoŋa baa kpɔ kwaa teeburre ne a tɔɡre, ne suuɡaswɛm tenten baa kpɔ ɛ bune baa kpɔa dɛɛ toh ola, ne loɡa baa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ kwaa ta, ne viine, ne suuɡaswɛm baa kpɔ kwaa loɡ bɛlbwa, dɛ suuɡapoŋ baa kpɔ kwaa loɡ bɛlbwa ne a tɔɡre, ne suuɡaswɛm tenten baa kpɔ ɛ kon baa dɛɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma o ta ne a tɔɡre.
Kooro Devid kpɔ kon waa do kɛ torɔɡo baa kpɔ Kerobim baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛa, a paɡri kena tɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ta ne a tɔɡre ɡe baɡlo.
Kooro Devid ŋɔ, “Anɔ bwa, Korowiirii tɛ mɛ ɡɛ o Dea la mar aa doa wejema, n won no a mun, dɛ chwera bil.” Kooro Devid berɔ ŋɔ o bie Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Dɔ bambile dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ ɛ toma la.
Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ la ja he nɛ.
Waa he habɔɔ le bwa ka tel kɛŋɔ Dea la toma bɛlbwa aa tona.
Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la baa kpɔ tomare do ba nɔɔra ta dɛ kpa, dɛ́ ɛ toma Korowii Dea bela.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe aa le o bambile ta o dɔ wejema bwa soo siwi toma ɛɛ ta la ɛɛ bao, dɛ́ ba chae toma la ta.
Nomonome la ne nɛra la bwa ɛɛ no wobɛlbwa haa bol ba be laanee.”
Koŋkɛɛla baa kpɔ ma Korowii Dea Kooro Devid ŋɔ nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa be ŋɔ, “N bie Solomɔn Korowii aa leo la nɔn ta kao, waa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ mɔɔ.
Toma la kan, dɛkalkɛ Dea waa dɛ ba doe la ɛ Korowii kon, o ta nɛwɛnyini kon ɛɛ.
N takapɔ nyin laala baa kpɔ do Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ Dea la.
N dɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne ayaawa ne bune ne daa, ne bwedɛɛɡa ane a yoɡ aa kpeɡa baa yera onis ne tɛɛkoes, dɛ bwea bwa soo siwi, a warɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, maa dɛ nyin Korowii Dea la kɛrɛdɛ nomanta, n berɔ kpɔ n ɡbaɡba suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa dɛɛ tɛ bá kpɔ ɛ o toma.
Suuɡaswɛm tenten a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa lafa dɛ anɛ, ne suuɡapoŋa aa wera kɛrɛdɛ a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro, n kpɔ tɛ bá ɛa dawɛ o danjwɛɛ ta, ne anɔ la aa jaa bwa nɛra baa dɔ a wejema aa kpɔ ɛ toma bwa.
Umee dɛɛ nyin ó le o bambile bini, dɛ́ tɛ kwaa bá kpɔ ɛ Korowii toma fini nɔ?” Belaa nomonnyuune ne Israel deene nomonome ne laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo, dɛ kooro nomonome baa chɔ o tomare nyoo bwa, le ba bambile ta, dɛ kpɔ kwaa kɛ bá kpɔ ɛ Korowii Dea la toma.
Kwaa kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɡwaa kilore kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanuanɛ, ne suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa lafraatoro fifraanaarɛ, ne ayaawa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa lafraanumɛl dɛ fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ bune a ɡe tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋ bele kaɡboŋa atoro, dɛ kaɡboŋa lafraanaarɛ.
Nɛra baa dɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa la kpɔa ba tɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea laala ta baa yerɔ Jehiel waa le Gɛsɔn dea.
Nɛra la bwa sie lɛ ɡɛ ba nomonome la aa le ba bambile ta dɛ tɛ kwaa la, Kooro Devid ɡe sie lɛo kɛrɛdɛ.
Kooro Devid Korowii kpɛɛra Kooro Devid kpɛɛ Korowii nɛra la bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii ya naa Jekɔb aa tomɛ, henee chɛ kɛ ya kpɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Henee kana dɛ do kpeɡri, dɛ dɔ jirima dɛ dɔ sɔn kohona, dɛkalkɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa ɛ he kwa.
Henee dɛɛ di kora, dɛ ɡwaa nomɛlbwa.
Kondɔɔh ne jirima bwa le he be, dɛɛ di kpeɡri komɛlbwa nɛ.
He bee kpeɡri ne bokpeɡa le, he ɡɔɔ nɛra dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, ya dɛ jaame, dɛɛ kpɛɛ he sɔnjen la.
Menee ume, n ne n nɛra nɔ bwa, kɛŋɔ ya ɡe won dɔ kwaa nɔ bwa dɔŋa ŋɔ ya kpɔɔ dɛɛ kɛɛ nɔ?
Anɔ bwa yaa dɔa le he be laanee ya berɛ kpɔ baa tɛɛ la.
Ya ɛ hɔɔhra he sie kɛŋɔ ya naawa bwa fa aa ɛa la.
Ya tɔpera yaa di harɛ nɔ ta do kɛŋɔ lileo, tamaa ken dɛ o kaalɔ la ken.
Ya ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la waa ya kpɔ kondamanta nɔ bwa tɛ ŋɔ bá kpɔ do he Dea, he bee a bwa le, henee dɔ a bwa.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ bambile binii hɛɛ nyiŋi, he sie ɛɛ lɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ta.
Anɔ bwa, n ta n bambile dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ.
N berɔ na silɛɛ he nɛra baa lɔ bonɔ ɡe aa dɔa, dɛ le ba bambile ta, dɛ kpɔ kwaa ba tɛɛ.
N Naa Korowii, ya naa Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tomɛ, ɡel ɡɛ nyina nɔ do he nɛra bambile ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, asɛ ba waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ he ɡbo.
Gel n bie Solomɔn kpɔ o bambile bwa dɛɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa haa doo ta, ó won ma Korowii Dea maa kpɔ o laala tɛo nɔ.” Belaa Kooro Devid ŋɔ nɛra la bwa be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ.” Anomanta, ba kpɛɛ Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ, dɛ chole kpɔ sie pi harɛ Korowii ne kooro sie.
Tɔ aa pera la, ba fuh kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii saraha kon la ta.
Nabala kaɡboŋ ne pebala kaɡboŋ ne pebali kaɡboŋ, dɛ kpɔ sen saraha, dɛ sarahare aa wara ja a ta tɛ Israel tena bwa.
Ba di saraha kwaa la, dɛ nyɔ sen lɛ ba sie kohona Korowii sie awola.
Belaa ba lɛ Solomɔn waa ɛ Kooro Devid bibaa do nɛɛtena kɛŋɔ kooro, dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta Korowii sie, dɛ cheɡo kora ta, dɛ fuɡe noo do Sadɔk nyu ta o ɡe ɛ sɔfo.
Gɛɛ Kooro Solomɔn ba so kora Korowii aa cheɡo ta, o chiɡ o mɛɛ Kooro Devid naa ta.
O wobɛlbwa wer tɛo, Israel tena bwa kpɔ duure tɛo.
Nomonome la bwa ne banyoola, dɛ Kooro Devid bibaala bwa sɛoh, dɛ kpɔ ba te do Kooro Solomɔn lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ.
Korowii ɡɔɔ Kooro Solomɔn Israel tena bwa sie, dɛ tɛo jirima kohona Israel harɛ ta kooro bɛlbwa aa wola a dɔŋ dɔe.
Kooro Devid seo wa Jese bibaa Devid di kora Israel harɛ ta bwa.
O di kora Israel harɛ bene fifraanaarɛ.
Hɛbrɔn lɔ bene anuanɛ, asɛ bene fifraatoro dɛ atoro ɡe Jerusalam.
O biɡro kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛ ba sewɛ, dɛ o dɔ kondɔɔh ne jirima kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ o bibaa Solomɔn chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Ba chwerɛ Kooro Devid kora dii le mumpar dɛ ba a jaɡa, do Korowii keamere Samoɛl ne Netan dɛ Gad waa tɔne bini, ne ɡɛ waa di kora dɛ di kpeɡri, dɛ waa bwa aa chiɡa o bere saŋ, dɛ Israel harɛ ta waa ne harɛre ane ɡe ta waa bwa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Webena tɔn nɛɛte nɔ teŋɔ dɛɛ baɡle tɔn loɡle waa la.
O dɛ baɡle Kooro Solomɔn ne Korowii Dea waa kwaara ma Jerusalam wa.
Dɛ harɛ la bini peɡri anɛ, bɛl sɔne Israel asɛ bɛl ɡe Juda.
Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle waa aa chiɡ Juda ne koranar baa di kora bela wa.
Koranar ɡalɡa waa ta Korowii sie lɛɛ, kɛ bane ɛ waa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra jemɛ Korowii.
Kooro Josia takapɔ ba Korowii toma ne, asɛ ba chwera do nyuune —.
A ta biɡre Babelɔn kooro ba yo Bwɛjen Jerusalam, dɛ chɔɡ Korowii Dea la ɡe.
Kooro Solomɔn wejema soŋa Kooro Devid bibaa Solomɔn soɡo kiŋkiŋ o kora ta Israel harɛ ta bwa, asɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ che o mun ta, dɛ ɛo nɛnjen kohona.
Kooro Solomɔn bol waa baɡle Israel tena la bwa, laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo, ne sitɔɔla baa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta, ne nomonnyuune dɛ nɛra la kabora bwa, dɛ ŋɔ o ne ba bwa la bela baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii bwɛjen Gebeɔn, dɛkalkɛ dɛ belaa Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr, o bonɔɔ Mosis aa baŋro pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la do.
Dɛ Kooro Devid kaa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Kiriat Jearim ba, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o baŋre tɛnte dea Jerusalam ŋɔ bá kpɔ ba cheɡ o bini.
Kɛ dɛ ayaawa saraha kon Uri bibaa Besalɛl waa ɛ Hur naa aa ɛa la ɡe ta cheɡɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea la sie Gebeɔn.
Asɛ Kooro Solomɔn ne nɛra la bwa tomɛ Korowii bela.
Kooro Solomɔn laŋɔ ka kpo nae ne peera baa wola won kura saraha kon la ta Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr la sie, dɛ fuah tɛ Korowii.
Waa lɔ Gebeɔn bela la, Korowii ba o be jwaana deera ta, dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Baɡle komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin ásɛ n kpɔ tɛɛ.” Kooro Solomɔn chaŋe ŋɔ, “He nyin n mɛɛ Kooro Devid waa kohona, dɛ ɡel n ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛɛ di kora fini nɔ.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, ɡel nyoa haa baɡɛ n mɛɛ la che.
He ɡelɔ mɛɛ di kora nɛra baa wara baa wola won kur ba nɛ.
Tɛ mɛ wejema ne waa mun noe, ásɛ n won kpɔ nyiŋi nɛra nɔ nɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ n ɡbo ɛɛ ba wona nyiŋi he nɛra baa wara ken nɔ nɛɔ?” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Haa lii wedɛɛɡa aa do ken, he ta kondɛɛɡa kɛɛ kondɔɔh kɛɛ waa aa ɡel he dɔ sɔn, kɛɛ he dɔma fe serewe, hale he ta he mkpa dɔe waa soŋɛ, dɛ soŋe wejema ne waa mun noe dɛ́ won nyiŋi n nɛra maa ɡela hɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ nɔ nomanta, mɛɛ tɛɛ wejema ne waa mun noe.
Mɛɛ berɔ tɛɛ kondɔɔh ne kondɛɛɡa dɛ jirima kohona, he dɔŋ aa wola lee do koranar bwa baa tɔ sie ba di kora, ne banɔ la baa ba di kora he habɔɔ.” Ate, Kooro Solomɔn le Gebeɔn, Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr bela baa dɛ tomɛ la, dɛ ba Jerusalam.
Belaa o ba so dɛ di Israel harɛ ta kora.
Kooro Solomɔn dɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore kaɡboŋ lafraanaarɛ ba kpɔ dɛɛ la laa.
O dɔ jaɡre ɡe kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anɛ.
O kpɔ ane ka do bwɛjena ane ta, ane ɡe do o be Jerusalam.
O bere saŋ dɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ta nyae Jerusalam kɛŋɔ bwea aa wola nyae nɔ.
Peleme daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ do deene ɡe bu kɛŋɔ, pure daa aa cheɡɛ Juda harɛ deŋɡarere lɔɡre ken.
Kooro Solomɔn bonadiire yon ka yawɛ o jaɡre a yoɡ aa wera dɛɛ le Ijipt harɛ ne Kue.
Ba le kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba.
Beŋkpoŋ yoɡ lɔ suuɡapoŋa lafraanumɛl, jaɡre la ɡe beŋkpoŋ lɔ suuɡapoŋa lafa fifraanue.
Ba le ane bela baa tɛ Hiti ne Siiria koranar bwa.
Korowii Dea mae wa Kooro Solomɔn ɛ o liire kɛŋɔ wɛɛ do Dea tɛ Korowii baa tomɔ o bini Jerusalam, dɛ́ berɛ do o ɡbaɡba koodem.
O le nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanuanɛ ŋɔ baa che a laala, nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanuatoro ba ɡe aa dɛ peɡri bwea deŋɡarere ta.
Dɛ kpɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa batoro lafraanumɛl ba ɡe aa dɛɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra la nɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ kala tɛ Taaya Kooro Hiram ŋɔ, “Tɛ mɛ peleme daa ɡɛ haa tɛ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid o do koodem la.
N dɛ ba Dea doe tɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ, ásɛ baa tomɔ o bini.
Wɛɛ do ɡoroŋee, ásɛ n ne n nɛra fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tomɔ bela, dɛ́ kpɔ paanoo baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii o do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ ba o sie tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra, ne Ona Tɔpera ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, dɛ tɔpejena ane Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa lea cheɡ.
Gɛ waa nɔ chɔ le tɛ Israel tena saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii Dea maa dɛ ba doe nɔ kan, dɛkalkɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la kan ɡwaa voɡare bwa.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won do Dea tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛ nyundua ɡba aa kanɛ tɛo ó so bela.
N ɡee ume, n ŋɔ ń do Dea tɛo ó ba so o bini nɔ?
Atane bɔr baa fuh saraha kwaa dɛɛ tɛo o sie ɡbo.
Anomanta, tɛ mɛ nɛn waa dɔ wejema, dɛ́ won di ɡwine dawɛ suuɡaswɛm kɛɛ suuɡapoŋ kɛɛ ayaawa dɛ bune ta, dɛ́ berɛ won kpɔ jiseburum ne jisekɔl, dɛ onswɛm sɔh yal.
Wɛɛ ba ja Juda ne Jerusalam nɛra baa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema n mɛɛ Kooro Devid lee ba la nɛɛ baa ɛ toma.
N ɡbabir jemɛ ɡɛ he tom-ɛɛra aa dɔ daa teŋna wejema, anomanta, tɛ mɛ peleme daa ne dadɛɛɡa ane soo siwi aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ.
N nɛra ɛɛ ba ja ba nɛɛ, bá nyin daa a warɛ ba tɛ mɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Dea maa dɛ ba doe la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do kan dɛ́ do wer kohona.
Mɛɛ bɔ he nɛra baa ba ɛ daa la toma la kemee.
Mea a tɔɡre aa ɛ boyu baaɡe kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ, ne ane soo siwi a tɔɡre aa ɛ boyu baaɡe kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ, dɛ sen ɡalɔŋre kaɡboŋa lafa, dɛ ɔleve noo ɡalɔŋre kaɡboŋa lafa.” Asɛ bwɛjen Taaya Kooro Hiram chwerɛ tɔn ba tɛ Kooro Solomɔn ŋɔ, “Korowii aa dɛ nyin o nɛra la waa o cheɡe ŋɔ he ɛ ba kooro.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Yá kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, o ta nyundua ne harɛ.
O tɛ Kooro Devid bibaa waa dɔ wejema, dɛ dɔ waa mun noe kohona, dɛɛ ba Dea doe tɛ Korowii dɛ́ berɛ do o koodem.
N berɔ dɛɛ tomɛ nɛn waa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema kɛrɛdɛ, baa yerɔ Hiram Abi he be.
O nya le Dan dea, asɛ o mɛɛ le Taaya.
O dɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋ ne ayaawa dɛ bune ne bwea, dɛ daa kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema.
Dɛ jemɛ jisekɔl ne jiseburum, ne onswɛm ne ompoŋ bwa kpɔe sɔh yapondɛɛɡe.
Wɛɛ di ɡwine bɛlbwa baa baɡlo dawɛ kon ta.
Gel o ba ja he nɛra baa dɔ kwaa ɛɛ wejema, ne he mɛɛ Kooro Devid nɛra baa dɔ kwaa ɛɛ wejema la nɛ.
Anomanta, ɡel mea ne ane soo siwi ne ɔleve noo dɛ sen haa baɡɛ nyoa la tel he bonɔɔ be.
Ásɛ ya teŋe daa haa dɛ nyin la bwa le Lɛbanɔn dɛ́ vɔrɔwa, ásɛ dɛ taɡa kpɔ mpo sie ba tɛɛ Jopa waa lɔ mpo nyoa, he ba kpɔ kaa Jerusalam.” Korowii Dea mae mumpar Ate, Kooro Solomɔn ɡel ba kure hɔɔhra baa soɡe Israel harɛ ta bwa, ɡɛ tenten o mɛɛ Kooro Devid fa aa kure nɛra la.
Ba lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanue dɛ batoro lafraanumɛl.
O le ba bini kaɡboŋa lafraanuanɛ baa che bone, kaɡboŋa lafraanuatoro baa peɡri bwea deŋɡarere ta, asɛ kaɡboŋa batoro lafraanumɛl ɡe ɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ, bɛlbwa ɛ toma aa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn Korowii Dea mae Kooro Solomɔn pa mun dɛ ma Korowii Dea la Jerusalam, Moria Bwejen ta.
Dɛ Korowii fa kpɔ o te baɡle o mɛɛ Kooro Devid bela ka, Jebus te Arauna mea lɔ bɔr bela Kooro Devid fa aa yawa la.
Kooro Solomɔn aa di kora bene anaarɛ, korobinɛɛte, tɔpera anɛ taa o pa Korowii Dea la mae mun.
Korowii Dea Kooro Solomɔn aa pa o mun la, o jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanaarɛ, asɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale fifraatoro.
Pato lɔ Dea la sie, o ne Dea la bwa paɡri kɛrɛdɛ, o jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraatoro, o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɡe ɛ naɡale fifraatoro.
O kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛ o bini bwa.
O kpɔ peleme daa marɛ dejen la bini danjwɛɛre ta, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛ a ta, dɛ ɛ kwaane kɛŋɔ bambie daa ne jɔɡrɔre dawɛ a ta.
Dɛ kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ɛ Korowii Dea la bwa o do wer.
Suuɡaswɛm waa yawa la le Paavaem harɛ ta.
O kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ dawɛ daa baa kpɔa ɡo Korowii Dea la, ne o ɡbeni daa ne danjwɛɛre ne ɡbeni la ta, dɛ sɛh Kerobim dawɛ danjwɛɛre la ta.
Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela la, dea waa lɔ Korowii Dea bini la, o kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ lafraanaarɛ ɛ bela bwa.
O jaŋne ne Korowii Dea la paɡri bwa kɛrɛdɛ, bɛlbwa lɔ naɡale fifraatoro.
Suuɡaswɛm waa kpɔa ɛ dadowɛre tɔɡre lɔ suuɡapoŋa fifraanue, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ deene aa lɔ nyundua la bini danjwɛɛre.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba ɛ Kerobim anɛ, asɛ dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara a che Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela.
Kerobim anɛ la paɡri a kena aa, o jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraatoro.
Beŋkpoŋ keni jaŋne lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama dɛɛ leɡe danjwɛɛ la, asɛ o keni bɛl la ɡe jaŋne lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama dɛɛ leɡe o dɔŋ la kon.
Gɛ tentenee Kerobim nɛɛte la ɡe kena do, bɛl jaŋne lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama dɛɛ leɡe dea la danjwɛɛ bɛl, o keni bɛl ɡe ɛɛ leɡe o dɔŋ la kon.
Kerobim anɛ la bwa kena paɡri lɔ naɡale fifraatoro, asɛ a che a sie chaɡɛ dejen la ta bela.
O kpɔ jiseburum ne oŋkɔl ne onswɛm ne yapondɛɛɡe ɛ pateesan, ba sɔh Kerobim dawɛ a ta.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba ɛ pilare anɛ Dea la sie, a jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ka tama a ɛ naɡale fifraanue dɛ atoro.
Ba ɛ a tɔre dawɛ a ta, bɛlbwa jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama.
O sɔh jɔɡrɔre ne daa nɔna ane aa do ɡuleɡule baa yera pɔmeɡranet, ba kpɔ ayaawa lafa ɛ dawɛ a ta.
O ɡelɔ ba paaɡe pilare la Dea la doonyoa, asɛ bɛl do weekaŋle harɛbɔr, bɛl ɡe do weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera kon la, o pa o sɔn Jakin, asɛ weekaŋle nyundua kon la ɡe o pao Boas.
Kwaa baa kpɔa kwaa Korowii Dea bini Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba kpɔ ayaawa ɛ saraha kon.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraatoro, o paɡri naɡale fifraatoro, asɛ o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɡe naɡale fi dɛ anue.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba kpɔ ayaawa ɛ komɛl waa do ɡuleɡule kɛ loɡbajen baa yerɔ Mpo.
O paɡri sie lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anue, o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɡe ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, asɛ he valɔ baro ɡe aa, o lɔ naɡale fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue.
Loɡ la nyoa dɛ bar la, ba kpɔ ayaawa ɛ kwaane aa do kɛ nabali bar o bwa.
Ayaawa baa kpɔa loɡɛ Mpo la, o tenten nee ba kpɔ ɛ nabali la ɡe.
Ayaawa loɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo la chɔŋɛ ayaawa waa kpɔa ɛ nabala fi dɛ anɛ nɛ, atoro sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera, atoro sie chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr, atoro sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ atoro ɡe sie chaɡɛ wee leebɔr.
Loɡ la chɔŋɛ a nɛ a habɔɔ, asɛ a sie chaɡɛ baŋ.
Loɡ la pipiripi do kɛŋɔ nɔmpaa del, asɛ o nyoa la ɡe do kɛŋɔ numol nyoa, dɛ paɡri kɛŋɔ daa fee yon pili la ken.
O won nee ɡalɔŋre kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue lɛɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba ɛ loɡbaala fi, dɛ kpɔ anue cheɡ Korowii Dea la weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ anue ɡe che weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Gɛ loɡbaala la binii baa yaɡle kwaa baa kpoora dɛɛ fuah la.
Kɛ Mpo la te bini nee laanee sɔfore la kpɔ dɛɛ sarame nɔɔra.
O berɔ ɡel ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ kandea daa fi, ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛa, dɛ kpɔ ka cheɡ Korowii Dea la bini.
Anue cheɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera, asɛ anue ɡe che weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera.
O ɡelɔ ba ɛ teeburre fi, dɛ kpɔ cheɡ Korowii Dea bela.
Anue cheɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera, anue ɡe che weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera.
O berɔ ɡel ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ loɡa lafa baa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ ba ɛ dembaah Korowii Dea la bini ne o baŋ tɛ sɔfore.
Gbeni aa lɔ dembaah doonyoo la baahna la, ba kpɔ ayaawa ɛ a bwara.
O ɡelɔ ba kpɔ Mpo la ka cheɡ Korowii Dea la weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛɛ bɛne wee leebɔr.
Kooro Solomɔn ɡelɔ Hiram berɛ ɛ viine ne soofire, dɛ loɡa báa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini dɛ́ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ.
Gɛɛ Hiram ɛ dɛ tonɛ Korowii Dea bela toma bwa ɡɛ waa baɡɛ Kooro Solomɔn nyoa la.
Kwaa waa ɛa laanee pilare anɛ, dɛ a tɔre aa do kɛ loɡa dɛ chɔŋre a ta, dɛ ɡwine waa dia dawɛ tɔre aa chɔŋre pilare la ta, ne kwaane aa do ɡuleɡule kɛŋɔ daa nɔna baa yera pɔmeɡranet lafraanaarɛ baa bila teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ bele anɛ a do pilare la doa, ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore fi baa taɡa, bɛlbwa dɔ a loɡa, ne loɡbajen waa chɔŋɛ nabala fi dɛ anɛ nɛɛ baa yerɔ Mpo, ne loɡa ne soofire ne bune baa kpɔa dɛɛ toh ola, dɛ anɔ la aa jaa bwa.
Kwaa Kooro Solomɔn aa ɡela Hiram Abi ɛ tɛo ó kpɔ cheɡ Korowii Dea la, ayaawa aa dɛ nyɛɡlee ba kpɔ ɛa.
Jɔɔdan Moo deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa, dɛ do Sukot ne Saretan baah ta chooh ba kpɔ, dɛ charama ɛ komɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin dɛ fora bɔɔ, asɛ dɛ kpɔ ayaawa ɛ a bini.
Kooro Solomɔn ta kwaa waa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa nɔ tɔɡre maɡɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a warɔ kohona.
Kooro Solomɔn berɔ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ Korowii Dea la bini laala.
Anee, suuɡaswɛm kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta, ne teeburre baa kpɔ paanoo baa bil o ta Korowii sie, kandea daa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛa ne a kandere aa dɛ chaah Korowii Dea la bini tenten la sie ɡɛ baa baɡla, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ nyɛwɛ kandea ŋwɛn doŋa, ne kwaa ane kɛŋɔ daa fee, dɛ kandere.
Suuɡaswɛm tenten nee o ɛ a bwa, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ fee kandea ŋwɛn la doŋa, ne loɡa baa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ, ne loɡa ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ buh nii, ne dea la ɡbeni baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, ne Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela ɡbeni, dɛ ɡbeni aa lɔ Dea la nyoa bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn aa ɛ Korowii Dea toma bɛlbwa tonɛ la, o kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ne laala bwa o mɛɛ Kooro Devid aa kpɔa tɛ Korowii la ka cheɡ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini, Korowii Dea la bini.
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka Korowii Dea bala Ate, Kooro Solomɔn yerɛ Israel nomonome, ne nomonome baa chɔ ba deene nyoo, ne nomonome baa chɔ ba lolanar nyoo bwa ba cheme o sie Jerusalam, kɛŋɔ bá la ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Saayɔn, Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, ba cheɡ Korowii Dea.
Dɛ ba bwa balɔ dɛ ba cheme Kooro Solomɔn sie Kukure Tɔpejen dii saŋ, korobinuanɛ ta.
Israel nomonome la bwaa baa cheme la, Lewi dea tena la kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la, dɛ berɛ kpɔ Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr, ne kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ do o bini la bwa ba cheɡ Korowii Dea la bini.
Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore laanee cheɡa ba, asɛ Kooro Solomɔn ne Israel tena baa chema la bwa che Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, dɛɛ kpoo peera ne nae baa wola won kura ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Asɛ sɔfore la kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ka cheɡ o Dea la bini, Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela, Kerobim la kena lɔɡre.
Kerobim la kena bɔle bela Korowii Fɔo Daka la aa cheɡa la bwa, dɛ tɔ o ne daa baa kpɔa suuɡi o keŋkeŋni dɛɛ cheo bwa ta.
Daa aa suuɡi o ta la jaŋne nomanta, dɛ nɛn cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la bini, Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela aa, o dɛ naa.
Haa won che bobɛlbwa ɡe dɛ naa, a ta lɔ bela ba le fini.
Komɛlbwa toole Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la bini ka ja bwepɛle anɛ Mosis aa kpɔa teɡli o bini Sinai Bwejen ta, bela Korowii ne Israel tena aa fɔwɛ fɔo ɡɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Ate, sɔfore la le Boɡoroŋ bela.
Sɔfore baa lɔ bela la sɔ ba doŋa bɛlbwa ta Korowii be pera, peɡra toole o dɔŋ ne o dɔŋ baah.
Dɛ Lewi dea yelɡoola baa ɛ Asaf ne Heman ne Jedutun nɛra, ne ba bibaala dɛ lolanar cheɡɛ saraha kon la wee leebɔr pera.
Dɛ do laala baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡa nyara, dɛɛ lɔ kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ ne janjelare, asɛ sɔfore lafa fifraanɛ ja ba nɛɛ dɛɛ hoh bɛle.
Bɛlhoohla la ne yelɡoola la bwa pɛo, dɛ kpɔ tabeŋkpoŋ ɡo yela kpɛɛ dɛɛ jam Korowii.
Asɛ bɛlhoohla ne nɛra baa dɛ lɔ kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, dɛ kwaa bwa soo siwi ɡe kpɔ ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Korowii wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Ate, bam ba tɔ Korowii Dea la ta ɡɛ saŋ sɔfore la aa dɛ le bela la.
Sɔfore la ta wone ɛ ba toma, bam waa baa tɔ Korowii Dea la bini la wa, asɛ Korowii jirima do Dea la bini bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn bol waa baɡle Israel tena Anee Kooro Solomɔn soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he ŋɔ hɛɛ so baama biŋere binii.
N do Dedɛɛɡe tenten waa kana tɛɛ, bela haa so saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Israel tena la bwa ta aa cheɡɛ Kooro Solomɔn sie bela la, o berɛ sie chaɡ ba, dɛ swee Korowii be andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii ya Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ!
O teŋɛ nyoa waa baɡɛ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid la ta dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Le awola tɔpere maa kpɔ n nɛra Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta la, n ta ŋɔe bá do Dea n sɔn ta Israel harɛ bwɛjen bɛlbwa ta dɛɛ tom mɛ bela.
N ta nomɛlbwa ɡe leɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛ.
Kɛ taraken te, n ŋɔ baa tom mɛ Jerusalam, ásɛ hen Kooro Devid ɡe ɛ ba nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.’ ” Anee Kooro Solomɔn berɛ ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ Kooro Devid lii o nyu bini dɛ fee ŋɔ wɛɛ do Dea Korowii sɔn taa, ásɛ ya Israel tena ɛɛ tomɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la bela.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, ‘Haa dɔ liire kɛŋɔ hɛɛ do Dea n sɔn taa nɔ, he ɛ waa kɛŋɔ haa lii ɡɛ, kɛ ane a bwa, he laa dɛ́ do Dea la, he ɡbaɡba bilolee dɛ́ do Dea la n sɔn ta.’ Korowii teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta.
N baa chiɡ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid naa ta, dɛ berɛ ɛ Israel kooro.
N do Dea Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la sɔn ta ya Israel tena ɛɛ tomɔ o bini.
Belaa n kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka bwepɛle aa teɡli o bini dɛɛ baɡle Korowii ne o nɛra Israel tena fɔo baa fɔwa la ba cheɡ.” Kooro Solomɔn wesoŋa Asɛ Kooro Solomɔn ir ka che kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la sie Israel tena baa chema la bwa sie, dɛ paɡri o nɔɔra nyundua soŋe Korowii.
Dɛ Kooro Solomɔn ɛ ayaawa ɛ komɛl baa dɛ che o ta Dea la dembaah.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, o paɡri ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama, o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɡe ɛ naɡale anaarɛ ne tama.
O baa ɡuŋi o ta Israel nɛra la bwa sie dɛ paɡri o nɔɔra nyundua.
O ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, voɡa nɛra aa dɛ tomɛ ta kpeɡri dɔe nyundua kɛɛ harɛ kɛ hen!
He dɛ teŋɛ fɔo he ne he nɛra aa fɔwa ta, dɛɛ nyin nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ he waa ta bambile bwa ne.
He teŋɛ nyoa haa baɡɛ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid la ta, he ɡelɔ wobɛlbwa ɛ ɡɛ fini.
Name, N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, teŋɛ he nyoa haa baɡɛ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid waa ɛ he bonɔɔ la ta, ɡɛ haa ŋɔa ŋɔ, dɛ o bii do sie dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa ta, ɡɛ he Mmarare aa dɛ baɡle la aa, o naanar bini bɛlee dɛ́ so Israel tena kora ta he sie.
N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, ɡel wobɛlbwa haa baɡɛ n mɛɛ Kooro Devid waa ɛ he bonɔɔ nyoa la ɛ kpela.
N Naa Korowii, a ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ hɛɛ won ba so harɛ nɔ ta naa?
Hale nyundua ɡba aa kanɛ tɛɛ kɛŋɔ he so, maa lii kɛŋɔ hɛɛ won ba so Dea waa do jeɡa maa doa tɛɛ nɔ ta.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, he bonɔɔnee men, no n wesoŋa dɛ́ ɛ waa maa dɛ soŋe nɔ tɛ mɛ.
Dɛɛ daah Dea nɔ chɔɔ ne jwaana, bonɔɔ he le cheɡ ŋɔ baa tomɛ.
Dɛ n kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Dea nɔ ta dɛɛ soŋe naa, no n be.
No men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ wesoŋa, ne he nɛra Israel tena wesoŋa, ɡɛ saŋ báa kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Dea nɔ ta dɛɛ soŋe.
Che nyundua bela haa lole dɛ́ no, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa kɛ yaa.
Dɛ a balɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛl kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ dawɛ o dɔŋ, asɛ a ba kɛŋɔ o ba he Dea nɔ bini, dɛ ba che saraha kon la sie dɛ ŋwɛɛraa, noa nyundua bela, dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ tɛr onɔ la waa di bolchɔɡe la deŋne, dɛ́ ɡel boldɛɛɡe te la.
Dɛ ya Israel tena yaa ɛ he nɛra nɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ, a che a ta ya dɔma pɔ ya nɛ, ya berɛ ba he be Dea nɔ bini dɛ ba soŋe ya wechɔɡa aa, noa nyundua bela, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ he nɛra Israel tena wechɔɡa kɛ ba.
Dɛ́ berɛ ba ba ne harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ ba ne ba naawa la ta.” Kooro Solomɔn berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ ya Israel tena yaa ɛ he nɛra ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ, asɛ he koh a waa dɛ lawɛ bwaala kpoŋe, asɛ ya charɛ ya liire dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ he Dea nɔ bini dɛɛ soŋe naa, noa nyundua bela haa soɡa la, dɛ́ kpɔ he bonɔɔna yaa ɛ he nɛra wechɔɡa kɛ yaa, dɛ́ baɡle yaa ɡɛ yaa so sodɛɛɡa.
Ásɛ he nɛ bwaala harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ yaa o ɛ ya kapɛrɛ kon la ta.
Dɛ lɔr chole harɛ la ta, kɛɛ weechɔɡa kɛɛ peuchɔɡe ta dɛ chɔɡ harɛ la kondikwa, kɛɛ tontombɛ fuɡo le harɛ la ta, kɛɛ dɔma balɔ ba lɔ tɔ he nɛra nɛɛ ba bwɛjena la bɛlbwa ta, harɛchɔɡ kɛɛ weela ba ba nɛɛ kwaraa naa, nɛra yaa ɛ he nɛra nɔ bini bɛlbwa koh a waa le o bambile ta, dɛ ir nɔɔra nyundua chaɡɛ he Dea nɔ dɛ soŋe naa, noa nyundua bela haa soɡa la, dɛ́ kpɔ kɛ ba.
He ɡboo jemɛ nɛn bambile bini wa, che waa bɛlbwa aa ɛa ta dɛ́ tɛr o deŋne.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel ya ɔmɛ, dɛɛ tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa harɛ la haa kpɔa tɛ ya naawa la ta.
Hɔɔhra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ ɛɛ le bojaŋ harɛ bɛl taa, dɛ́ ba tomɛ he Dea nɔ bini, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba no kpeɡri haa dɔa ne he sɔn ne wejena haa ɛa wa.
Dɛ ba bini bɛlbwa kpɔ sie chaɡɛ he Dea nɔ dɛ soŋe naa, noa nyundua bela haa soɡa la, ásɛ dɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa baa bɔɔra dɛɛ le he be la, ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra jemɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛɛ, ɡɛ Israel tena yaa ɛ he nɛra aa dɛ ɛ la.
Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ Dea maa doa tɛɛ nɔ ɛ bela nɛra aa dɛɛ tomɛ.” Kooro Solomɔn berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he do he nɛra bobɛlbwa ŋɔ bá ka yo ba dɔma, asɛ ba berɛ sie chaɡɛ he bwɛjen ne he Dea maa doa he sɔn ta dɛ soŋe naa, noa nyundua bela haa soɡa, dɛ́ ɡel ba pɔ ba dɔma nɛ.
Dɛ ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa toole waa wola wechɔɡa ɛ, asɛ he baah di ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba dɔma pɔ ba nɛ dɛ laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ kɛɛ boboraa yoo, hale ba lɔ ba dɔma la harɛ ta, dɛ charɛ ba liire dɛ sɛh ba wechɔɡa dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ya ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ ɛ waa aa wola were’.
Dɛ ba berɔ ba he be ba bambile ne ba liire bwa ne, dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ ba naawa bwɛjen haa lea cheɡ, asɛ n do he Dea tɛɛ he sɔn ta nɔ naa, noa nyundua bela haa soɡa la, ásɛ dɛ na ba sum.
Kpɔ he nɛra wechɔɡa baa ɛa bwa kɛ ba.
Name, Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ no ya wesoŋa yaa kpɔa dɛɛ bil he sie Dea nɔ bini.
N Naa Korowii, ir ba he Dea He Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka waa cheɡa tɛ he kpeɡri la ta, dɛ́ ba so bonɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gel he sɔfore teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra, ásɛ he nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa ɡe ɡo silɛɛ yela, he wedɛɛɡa haa ɛɛ ba la wa.
N Naa Korowii, lii he nyina haa dɔa tɛ he bonɔɔ Kooro Devid ne nyoa haa baɡɔ la wa, bɛ kooro haa leo cheɡ tɛ he te la vɛh.”
Korowii Dea kpɔe dɛ́ do o nɔn ta Kooro Solomɔn aa soŋe Korowii tonɛ la, nii le nyundua dɛ ba fuh kwaa baa kpoora ne kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare la, asɛ Korowii jirima su o Dea la bini bwa.
Korowii jirima aa su Dea la bini nomanta, sɔfore la ta wone jo o bini.
Israel tena la bwa aa na nii la ne Korowii jirima la, ba ɡuŋo, dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ bobɛl baa mao bwea ne o ir nyundua, dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Korowii wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Belaa Kooro Solomɔn ne Israel tena baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa kpɔ kwaa ɛ sarahare Korowii sie bela.
Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ nae kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ, ne peera dɛ boohna kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare tɛ Korowii.
Gɛɛ Kooro Solomɔn ne Israel tena bwa ɛ, dɛ kpɔ Dea la do Korowii nɔn ta.
Baa taa kpɔ Dea la dɛɛ do Korowii nɔn ta la, sɔfore kaa che ba chebɔr, Lewi dea tena ka che ba chebɔr, dɛ kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ Kooro Devid aa kpɔa tɛ la, dɛ ɡo kpɛɛra yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Gɛ Kooro Devid aa do ba la.
Sɔfore la sie chaɡɛ Lewi dea tena dɛɛ hoh bɛle, asɛ nɛra la kabora ɡe che.
Kooro Solomɔn le Korowii Dea dembaah sie la cheɡ o do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii.
Belaa o kpo kwaa dɛ fuah, dɛ ɛ mea sarahare, dɛ fuh ola la noorare ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, dɛkalkɛ saraha kon baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo la aa kanɛ kɛ a ɡɛ kwaa la bwa won jo o ta.
Kooro Solomɔn ne Israel tena la bwa di Kukure Tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ.
Nɛnlaa tenten le ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa chɔa kaa bwɛjen Hamat waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ ba.
Ba di tɔpera anuanɛ dɛ kpɔ kon baa kpo kwaa ɛ saraha o ta la do Korowii nɔn ta, dɛ kpɔ tɔpera anuanɛ di tɔpejen la ɡe.
Tɔpere waa ka mun la, ba kpɔ tɔpejen dii la ba a jaɡa.
Tɔ aa pera la, korobie anuanɛ la tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ atoro wee la, Kooro Solomɔn tɛ bɛlbwa ŋwɛnɛ o kaa o bwɛ.
Ba sie lɛ andɛɛɡa Korowii aa sweera tɛ o nɛra Israel tena, ne Kooro Devid dɛ Solomɔn la wa.
Korowii kpɔ o te baɡle Kooro Solomɔn ja Kooro Solomɔn aa do Korowii Dea la ne koodem, dɛ tonɛ anɔ la waa dɛ nyin bwa la, Korowii ba o be deera ta jwaana dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N no he wesoŋa la, n sɛoh kɛŋɔ Dea nɔ binii bá kpo kwaa ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
Dɛ n ta ɡelɛ bwaala nɛ, kɛɛ dɛ ɡel tontombɛ ba chɔɡ koo kwa, kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ weechɔɡa ba ta n nɛra nɛ, asɛ ba charɛ liire dɛ le wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ la ta, dɛ wi noo mɛ naa, mɛɛ no ba bee le nyundua, dɛ́ kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba dɛ́ berɛ ɡel ba harɛ la do wer.
Mɛɛ cheɡ deŋnee dɛɛ no wesoŋa baa dɛ ba a ne Dea nɔ bini, dɛkalkɛ n le Dea nɔ cheɡ dɛ ɡel o do ɡoroŋ, ásɛ baa tom mɛ o bini saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Mɛɛ dɛɛ daahno n sie do o ta.
Dɛ hen Solomɔn tom mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa doe a ta, ɡɛ he mɛɛ Devid aa ɛa la aa, amɔ te mɛɛ ɡeloo kora haa dɛ di Israel tena nɛɛ la che kiŋkiŋ saŋ bɛlbwa, ɡɛ maa baɡɛ he mɛɛ Devid nyoa ŋɔ, ‘He naanaree dɛɛ ba Israel tena nɛɛ nyiŋa saŋ bɛlbwa,’ la.
Kɛ dɛ he ne he nɛra berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛ vɛh me Mmarare ta teŋa, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa ane dɛɛ ɡuŋa aa, ate mɛɛ le Israel tenaa le harɛ maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba nɔ ta, dɛ vɛh n Dea maa lea cheɡ dɛ ɡel o do ɡoroŋ ŋɔ ó ɛ bela baa dɛɛ tom mɛ nɔ ta.
Ásɛ Israel tena berɛ wesoma nɛra, harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Dea nɔ dɛ ba kuuɡa chɔ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa teŋe ba kaa la nyoa kpo o bwara yɔr o ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa ɡela Korowii ɛ harɛ nɔ ne Dea nɔ ken?’ Ásɛ nɛra chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Baa le Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ, o le ba naawa ne Ijipt harɛ ta habɔɔ, dɛ berɛ kaa yarada voɡa ane dɛɛ toma la waa Korowii kpɔ ɡɛ wekpeɡa nɔ ta ba nɛɛ la.’ ”
Kooro Solomɔn waane waa wona ɛ Bene fifraanɛɛ Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ do Korowii Dea ne o koodem la.
Kooro Solomɔn kwaarɔ vɔrɔwe bwɛjena Kooro Hiram aa kpɔa tɛo la, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ka so a ta.
Kooro Solomɔn kaa yo dɛ lɛ bwɛjen Hamat Soba, dɛ ka vɔrɔwe bwɛjen Tadmɔ waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ bwɛjena aa lɔ Hamat harɛ waa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini bwa.
O berɔ kwaa vɔrɔwe bwɛjena Bɛt Hɔrɔn waa chɔ nyunduabɔr, ne Bɛt Hɔrɔn waa chɔ harɛbɔr.
O ma danjwɛɛre bara, dɛ do ɡbeni a nyoo, dɛɛ kaɡra bune ne, ne bwɛjen Baalat ne bwɛjena waa dɛ cheɡ laala a ta bwa, dɛ bwɛjena o jaɡre ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre aa lole.
O berɔ ɡel ba ma komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin Jerusalam, ne Lɛbanɔn dɛ harɛ waa dɛ di kora o ta bwa.
Nɛra baa kaa dɛ le Hiti ne Amɔre, ne Pɛrɛs ne Hivi, dɛ Jebus tena bini, ba ta Israel tena ɛɛ la, ba naanaree kaa Israel tena aa wola kpoorɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa doŋi nɛra baa tɔ sie so bela la.
Banee Kooro Solomɔn ɛɛ ba yoma baa ɛ tomkpeɡa Israel harɛ ta ba le fini.
Kɛ Israel tena la te, Kooro Solomɔn ta bɛlbwa kpɔe ɛ yom.
Bane ɛ laa tena dɛ yo dɛɛ tɛo, dɛ ɛ nomonnyuune, laa sitɔɔla ne nomonome baa chɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, dɛ banɔ la baa dɛ so jaɡre ta bwa nyoa.
Kooro Solomɔn nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ ɛ tomkpeɡa nɛɛ la lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanue.
Ijipt kooro bihaah Kooro Solomɔn aa moo la, le Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta, dɛ ba koodemfale o jaa Kooro Solomɔn aa doa tɛo ta.
O ŋɔ o haah ta chɛ kɛ ó so Kooro Devid koodem, dɛkalkɛŋɔ bobɛlbwa baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la jo la do ɡoroŋ.
Kooro Solomɔn kpoo kwaa dɛ fuah ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii, saraha kon baa mao cheɡ Korowii Dea pato la sie, ɡɛ Mosis aa doa ŋɔ baa ɛ sarahare tɔpere bɛlbwa, Ona Tɔpera ne Korobifala Tɔpejena.
Dɛ Tɔpejena atoro ane kɛŋɔ, Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole A Ta Tɔpejen, ne Koo Kondikwaa Koma Tɔpejen, dɛ Kukure Tɔpejen dii ta la.
O teŋɛ waa o mɛɛ Kooro Devid aa ɛa la ta.
O bɔne toma aa lɔ Korowii Dea bela tɛ sɔfore la ne Lewi dea tena la, asɛ Lewi dea tena la ɛɛ cha sɔfore la baa ɡo yela, dɛɛ ɛ ba toma ɡe.
O le nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo la, dɛ bɔne ba bini baa nyiŋi doonyoo la ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ɡɛɛ Korowii nɛn Kooro Devid do ba.
Ba ta waa kooro aa do ba a ta ŋɔ, ba ne sɔfore la ne Lewi dea tena ta leɛ, hale deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini waa bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn toma waa maɡla bil ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo la, ba ɛ a bwa tonɛ kɛrɛdɛ ken, le awola baa pa Korowii Dea la mun, hale dɛ ba tonɛ.
Ate, Kooro Solomɔn la Eseɔn Gɛba ne Elat aa ɛ leebɔɔ bwɛɛre, dɛ do Edom harɛ Mposwɛm nyoa.
Kooro Hiram tomɛ o nɛra baa jemɛ mpo nee toma wa, ba kpɔ stiimaere.
Ba ne Kooro Solomɔn nɛra pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma mpo ta.
Ba la Ofir harɛ ta, dɛ ka lɛ suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue lafraatoro, ba tɛ Kooro Solomɔn.
Seeba kooro waa ɛ haah baa na Kooro Solomɔn Seeba kooro waa ɛ haah baa no Kooro Solomɔn sɔn lee waa lea kohona.
Anomanta, o la Kooro Solomɔn be Jerusalam, dɛ kpɔ wobobeela a bini aa kpeɡa dɛ́ ba daahno dɛ na.
Haŋkooro la kpɔ nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ dɛ warɛ ja o nɛ, ne nyoɡmare aa cheɡɛ konsɔɔhsoma ne suuɡaswɛm kohona, ne bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa kohona, dɛ la Kooro Solomɔn be.
Waa laŋa o ne o ka cheme la, o bɔɔ Kooro Solomɔn waa aa lɔ o nyu bini bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn chaŋe waa waa bɔɔro bwa kɛrɛdɛ ken tɛo, wobɛlbwa toole dɛ do kpeɡri waa wola wone baɡle a bini.
Haŋkooro la aa na wejema Kooro Solomɔn aa dɔa ne koodem waa doa, ne kondikwaa aa cheɡɛ o kondikondibɔr, ne o nomonome sobɔr ne o bonɔɔna baa dɛ tomɔ, ne ba laala baa doa, ne bonɔɔna baa do batakaani dɛɛ doo sen, dɛ kwaa waa kpoora dɛ fuah dɛɛ ɛ sarahare Korowii Dea la, a ɛo nyokpoa.
Anee o ŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Waa haa ɛa ne wejema haa dɔa n do n harɛ ta dɛ no la ɛ kpela.
N ta ɡɛ baa bola la yaradae, atane n ɡbabir aa baa naa siwi ne nɔ.
Waa la baa bola la ta waa nɔ bɛne kwara.
He wejema ne he kondɔɔh ɡwaa anɔ la maa noa la kohona.
He nɛra nyu som, he nomonome baa dɛ che he jwɛɛh saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛɛ no he wejemwaa la ɡe na som.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɔ jam.
O sie lɛ he nɛ, dɛ cheɡe o kora ta Israel tena nɛ o sɔn ta ŋɔ hɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa o kpɔ dɛɛ nyin o nɛra Israel tena la nomanta, o cheɡe kora ŋɔ he nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne waa aa toɡra ne.” O kpɔ suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɡwaa kilore kaɡboŋa anaarɛ, ne konsɔɔhsoma aa wara pirim, dɛ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa tɛ Kooro Solomɔn.
Seeba kooro waa ɛ haah konsɔɔhsoma waa kpɔa ka tɛ Kooro Solomɔn kan aa doa la, nomɛlbwa ta a dɔŋa ne balɛ ɡɛ bwa.
Kooro Hiram nɛra ne Kooro Solomɔn nɛra kaa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne dadɛɛɡa ane, ne bwedɛɛɡa a bwa yoɡ aa kpeɡa le Ofir harɛ ta ba.
Kooro Solomɔn kpɔ dadɛɛɡa la ɛ bela waa kpɔa teeh dɛɛ kaa Korowii Dea la ta, ne koodem bela, dɛ kpɔ ane ɛ janjelare ne kwaa bwa soo siwi baa dɛ ɛ ane yela.
Ba ta ɡɛ daa la dɔŋa ne Juda harɛ ta balɛ kpa bwa, hale ba le fini.
Kooro Solomɔn berɔ tɛ Seeba kooro waa ɛ haah komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin, o tɛo anɔ la waa kpɔa ba tɛo, asɛ a ɡwaa.
Ate, haŋkooro ne o nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ berɛ kaa Seeba harɛ ta.
Kooro Solomɔn kondɔɔh Suuɡaswɛm Kooro Solomɔn aa dɛ dɔ benanyoa bɛlbwa la tɔɡre ɛɛ ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ, lafraanumɛl fifraanaarɛ dɛ anaarɛɛ.
Anɔ la waa dɔa dɛɛ le bonadiire ne kon-yoɡra ne Arab harɛ koranar, dɛ nomonome baa chɔ harɛre nyoo be te ta jae.
Kooro Solomɔn loɡɛ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta anjena lafraanɛ, suuɡaswɛm aa bɔle bɛlbwa ta tɔɡre lɔ kilore anuanɛ, O berɔ ɛ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta anjeɡre lafraatoro, suuɡaswɛm aa bɔle bɛlbwa ta tɔɡre lɔ kilore atoro.
Asɛ o ɡel ba kpɔ kwaa la ka do o koodem, dejen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Lɛbanɔn Kɔr Bini Koodem la bini.
Kooro Solomɔn berɔ ɡel ba kwaa kookara waa kana.
Ba kpɔ bala nyen ɛ o pera, asɛ o kabora ɛ suuɡaswɛm tenten ba kpɔ ɛ dawɛ o ta.
Ba ɛ bɔre anumɛl, bela waa che teeh kaa so kookara la ta.
Ba ɛ komɛl waa do kɛ karajeɡa, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ o ta, o kpɔ nakpale dɛɛ chɔŋɛ o ta.
Dɛ ɛ bela waa kpɔ nɔɔra dɛɛ dawɛ kara la ta, baŋne anɛ.
Dɛ berɛ ɛ kwaane aa le nyujentena anɛ a che kara la jwɛh.
Ba ɛ nyujentena fi dɛ anɛ chɔŋre kwaa waa cheɡɛ a ta teeh kaa so kookara la ta.
Ba ta ɡɛ kookara nɔ dɔŋ bɛlbwa ɛɛ ken tɛ koojen bɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Kooro Solomɔn numoli bwa, suuɡaswɛmee ba kpɔ ɛa.
Laala aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn Kɔr Bini Koodem ɡe, suuɡaswɛm tenten nee ba kpɔ ɛ a bwa.
Ba ta suuɡapoŋa kpɔe ɛ komɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn bere saŋ la, dɛ suuɡapoŋa ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ, dɛ baa ane wobɛlbwa ɛ. Dɛ kooro dɔ stiimaere baa kpɔa dɛɛ di bona mpo ta a ja Kooro Hiram kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma la ta.
Bene atoro bɛlbwa a dɛ ba suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne bala nyena, dɛ ɡbɛɛne bwa soo siwi ne.
Dɛ Kooro Solomɔn dɔ suuɡa ne wejema dɛ ɡwaa kooro bɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta.
Koranar bwa yon dɛɛ nyin o be bala dɛ́ ba no wejemwaa Korowii aa tɛo la.
Benanyoa bɛlbwa ba dɛ ba o be naa, koŋkɛɛla aa ɛ kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ɛa, ne batakaani ne dɔmkwa ne konsɔɔhsoma ne jaɡre, dɛ keeɡoree ba kpɔ baa tɛo.
Dɛ Kooro Solomɔn dɔ jaɡre deene kaɡboŋa anaarɛ, ne torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre.
Dɛ o dɔ jaɡre baa dɛ la ane laa kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anɛ ɡe.
Ane lɔ Jerusalam asɛ a kabora ɡe do bwɛjena ane ta.
Dɛ onee nomoa koranar baa le Yufretis Moo ta kaa Filisti tena harɛ ta, dɛ ba le Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta bwa nɛ.
O bere saŋ, dɛ suuɡapoŋa ta nyae Jerusalam kɛŋɔ bwea aa wola nyae nɔ.
Peleme daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ do deene ɡe bu kɛŋɔ, fiɡ daa aa cheɡɛ Juda harɛ deŋɡarere lɔɡre ken.
Kooro Solomɔn bonadiire yon ka yawɛ o jaɡre dɛɛ le Ijipt harɛ ne harɛre ane ɡe ta.
Kooro Solomɔn seo Waa ane ɡe Kooro Solomɔn aa ɛa o kora dii saŋ, le mumpar ba a jaɡa, ba chwera do Korowii Keame Netan tɔn bini, ne Silo Te Ahija, dɛ Ido waa dɛ na chaahna waa tɔne bini.
Ba berɔ chwerɛ Nɛbat bibaa Israel Kooro Jɛroboam ɡe bwara waa do a bini.
Kooro Solomɔn di kora Israel harɛ ta Jerusalam bene fifraanaarɛ.
A habɔɔ, Kooro Solomɔn sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ ba huɡo Jerusalam, o mɛɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, asɛ o bibaa Rɛhoboam ba chiɡ o naa ta di kora.
Israel tena ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Kooro Rɛhoboam nɛ Rɛhoboam la bwɛjen Sɛkem, dɛ Israel tena bwa cheme bela, dɛ́ chiɡu kora ta.
Nɛbat bibaa Jɛroboam o fa aa chwaa le Kooro Solomɔn be, dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta aa no ɡɛ waa la, o le Ijipt bela dɛ ba.
Ba tomɛ nɛra ba ka yerɛ Jɛroboam, asɛ o ne Israel tena baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la bwa la ka ŋɔ Kooro Rɛhoboam be ŋɔ, “He mɛɛ fa ɡelɔ ya ɛ tomkpeɡa.
Taraken yaa sɛh dɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ tomkpeɡa la dɔŋa kpa.
Gel a do korokoro, ásɛ yaa tomɛ.” Kooro Rɛhoboam ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kaa ń kpɔ a liire, ásɛ tɔpetooro wee he berɛ ba.” Asɛ ba bwa kaa.
Ate, Kooro Rɛhoboam cheme nomonome ba ne o mɛɛ Kooro Solomɔn fa aa lole baa jao la, o kpɔ bil ba sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Wejaala besoo he dɔ tɛ mɛ ń bol baɡle nɛra nɔɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ he sɛoh kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɛɛ tom baa dɛ sɛh dɛɛ bol wedɛɛɡa ba be tenaa, ate baa tomɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa.” Kooro Rɛhoboam ta nomonome la jae baa jao la noɛ, dɛ ka no o bala o ne baa ira baa tomɔ la wa.
Kooro Rɛhoboam kpɔɔ bil ba sie ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ n chaŋe nɛra nɔ baa ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ń ɡel ba toma do korokoro nɔ waɔ?” O bala o ne baa ira la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Waa aa chɛ kɛ he bol ba be laanee kɛŋɔ, n nonikekela kwaraa bare ɡwaa n mɛɛ chara.
N mɛɛ ɡelɔ he ɛ tomkpeɡa, n te ɛɛ ɡeloo he ɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ.
Chweema nee n mɛɛ tɛr he deŋne, kɛ n te ɛɛ kpɔ balansoo tɛr he deŋne.” Tɔpera atoro habɔɔ la, Jɛroboam ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa berɔ ba Kooro Rɛhoboam be ɡɛ waa ŋɔ ba be la.
Kooro Rɛhoboam vɛh nomonome la jae baa jao la, dɛ kpɔ nyɛɡa bol waa nɛra la be.
O kpɔ o bala o ne baa ira la jae la dɛ ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ ɡelɔ he ɛ tomkpeɡa, kɛ n te ɛɛ ɡeloo a ɡwaa ɡɛ.
Chweremi nee o tɛr he deŋne, kɛ n te ɛɛ kpɔ balansoo tɛr he deŋne!” Kooro la ta nɛra la waa la ta noɛ tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ Korowiirii ɛa ɡɛ, dɛ́ ɡel waa waa cheɡɛ Silo te Ahija nɛɛ dɛ bol Nɛbat bibaa Jɛroboam be la, ɛ kpela.
Nɛra baa ja Kooro Jɛroboam nɛ aa naa kɛŋɔ, kooro ta ba waa la ta noɛ la, ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya ne Kooro Devid naanar toole wobɛlbwa bini.
Bɔkwaa ba ɛ tɛ yaa bwa nɔ?
Ya bala Israel tena, hé ɡel ya kaa dem.
Hé ɡel Kooro Rɛhoboam di o kora.” Gɛɛ a do Israel tena pa mun ɛo deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ bwa kaa ba deremi.
Kɛ Israel tena baa lɔ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta la te, dɛ Kooro Rɛhoboam dɛ di kora ba nɛ.
Belaa Kooro Rɛhoboam tomɛ Adoniram, waa chɔ tomkpeɡa ɛɛ nyoa ŋɔ ó la Israel tena be.
Asɛ ba bwa foɡro bwea kpo.
Kooro Rɛhoboam dɔ warane, dɛ jo o torɔɡo bini, dɛ chwa ka sɔh Jerusalam.
Le a ɡɛ saŋee Israel tena baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ɛ Kooro Devid dem tena deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ pere ba te le ba nɛɛ dɛ ba le fini.
Kooro Rɛhoboam aa tel Jerusalam la, o boa Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene tena baala baa jemɛ yoi nyoa nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanuatoro ŋɔ, bá ka yo Israel deene aa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ásɛ o won di kora harɛ la bwa ta.
Dɛ Korowii bol o keame Sɛmaya be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn bie Kooro Rɛhoboam, Juda dea kooro la, ne Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene tena nɛra baa jaa la be ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ he bala Israel tena la ka pu yo.
Bɛlbwa berɛ kaa o dem, menee ɛa ɡɛ.’ ” Ate ba no, ba ta Jɛroboam ka yoi kpa, dɛ bwa berɛ kaa ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la.
Kooro Rɛhoboam danjwɛkpeɡa mae dɛ bar bwɛjena Kooro Rɛhoboam soɡe Jerusalam dɛ ɡel ba ma danjwɛkpeɡa bar Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene bwɛjena aa teŋa nɔ.
Bɛtlɛham ne Etam dɛ Tekoa, ne Bɛt Sor ne Soko dɛ Adulam, ne Gat ne Maresa dɛ Sif, ne Adoraim ne Lakes dɛ Aseka ne Sora ne Aejalɔn dɛ Hɛbrɔn.
Dɛ anɔɔ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene harɛre ta.
O ma danjwɛkpeɡa bar bwɛjena la a do kpeɡri, dɛ kpɔ laa sitɔɔla chɔ a nyoa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kondikwa ne ɔleve noo dɛ sen, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta ne lampeare.
Gɛɛ o ɛ dɛ lɛ Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene harɛ ba do o lɔɡa.
Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena baa lɔ Israel harɛ weekaŋle nyundua bwa ta balɔ, dɛ ba teŋɛ Kooro Rɛhoboam nɛ.
Lewi dea tena la ɡel harɛre aa ɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra dɛ ir ka so Juda ne Jerusalam, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ne o bibaala ta sɛɛh kɛŋɔ bá ɛ Korowii sɔfore.
Kooro Jɛroboam le o ɡbaɡba kerekpoŋra ba so voɡa ta, dɛɛ tomɛ daabii ne nabali, dɛ voɡa waa sɛah la.
Nɛra baa le Israel deene bwa bini dɛ le ba bambile bini ŋɔ, baa tomɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la teŋɛ Lewi dea tena nɛɛ ba Jerusalam, dɛ ba kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii ba naawa aa toma.
Ba cheɡɛ o habɔɔ dɛ ɡel Juda kora la che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ cha Kooro Solomɔn bibaa Kooro Rɛhoboam bene atoro, ɡɛ baa ɛa Kooro Devid ne Kooro Solomɔn saŋ la.
Kooro Rɛhoboam haahna ne bii Kooro Rɛhoboam mo haah, o sɔne Mahalat.
O mɛɛ sɔne Jerimot.
Jerimot mɛɛ sɔne Devid, asɛ Jerimot nya ɡe ɛ Abihel.
Abihel ɡe nya sɔne Eliab.
Abihel nabaa sɔne Jese.
Bibaala batoroo ba lolɛ.
Banee Jeyus ne Sɛmaria dɛ Saham.
Kooro Rɛhoboam berɔ mo Absalɔm bihaah Maaka.
Asɛ o lolɛ bibaala, Abija ne Atai ne Sesa dɛ Sɛlomet.
Dɛ Kooro Rɛhoboam dɛ nyin Absalɔm bihaah Maaka dɛ ɡwaa o haahna ne o sɛnanar bwa.
Dɛ o haahna lɔ fi dɛ banuatoro, asɛ o sɛnanar ɡe lɔ fifraanumɛl.
O bibaala lɔ fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro, asɛ bihaahna ɡe lɔ fifraanumɛl.
Kooro Rɛhoboam kpɔ o ne o haah Maaka bibaa Abija ɛ o bibaala la bwa nomoa, dɛɛ nyin ó cheɡo kora ta.
Kooro Rɛhoboam ɛ wejemwa, dɛ kpɔ o bibaala la bɛlbwa ka so Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene harɛre bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara la ta.
O ta tea, dɛ tɛɛ ba ba konnyina kohona, dɛ mo haahna ɡe tɛɛ ba warɛ.
Ijipt Kooro Sisak kaa yo Jerusalam tena Kooro Rɛhoboam kora aa baa che kiŋkiŋ la, o ne Israel tena bwa vɛh Korowii Mmarare ta teŋa.
Kooro Rɛhoboam aa di kora bene anue ta la, Ijipt harɛ Kooro Sisak baa yo Jerusalam tena, ba deŋnekpeɡ baa ɛa dɛ vɛh Korowii la wa.
O kpɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ, ne nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta kaɡboŋa fifraanumɛl, dɛ laa tena baa wola won kur ba, le Lebya ne Itiopia ne Suk tena ja o nɛɛ le Ijipt harɛ.
Ba yoo lɛ Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, hale dɛ ba tel Jerusalam.
Ate, Korowii keame Sɛmaya ba Kooro Rɛhoboam ne Juda nomonome baa kaa cheme Jerusalam la be, Kooro Sisak ɔma wa.
Asɛ Korowii keame Sɛmaya ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘He vɛɛh mɛ, anomanta, taraken n ɡe vɛh heyaa tɛ Kooro Sisak.’ ” Ate, kooro ne Israel nomonome sɛh kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii waa waa ɛa wer.” Korowii aa na ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la, o ŋɔ o keame Sɛmaya be ja ŋɔ, “Ba sɛh ba chɔɡre nomanta, maa ban chɔɡ kpa.
Kɛ dɛ Kooro Sisak baa yoo ba aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo ba le a nyoa.
Maa ɡel a che Kooro Sisak nɛɛ Jerusalam tena nyɔ n danana ne.
Kooro Sisak ɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ bá do o lɔɡa, ásɛ ba na ɡɛ n toma aa korɛ harɛre koranar toma ta.” Ijipt Kooro Sisak aa baa yo Jerusalam tena la, o pa kwaa aa lɔ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini Korowii Dea, ne anɔ la aa lɔ koodem bwa kaa.
Dɛ berɛ pa kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta Kooro Solomɔn aa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa la.
Anomanta, Kooro Rɛhoboam kpɔ ayaawa ɛ ane chiɡ suuɡaswɛm kwaa la naa ta, dɛ kpɔ do nɛra baa dɛ so koodem la doonyoa dɛɛ daah bela la nomonome nɔn ta, ŋɔ báa nyiŋi a ta.
Saŋ bɛlbwa kooro aa la Korowii Dea la, nɛra baa dɛ daah bela yon kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta la kpoŋe, ásɛ a habɔɔ ba yon kpɔ ka cheɡ dea baa dɛ cheɡa o bini la ta.
Kooro Rɛhoboam aa pwɛr o te tɛ Korowii nomanta, Korowii bandia le o nɛ, o ta on chɔɡɛ kwaraa kpa.
Kasinteŋ, dɛ wobɛlbwa pa mun dɛɛ do wer Juda harɛ ta tama tama.
Kooro Rɛhoboam di bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ mɔɔ dɛ di kora.
O kora cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ, o so Jerusalam Korowii aa lea cheɡ Israel harɛre bwa bini ŋɔ, baa tomɔ bela la, dɛ di kora bene fi dɛ anuanɛ.
O nya sɔne Naama, Amɔn tee.
Kooro Rɛhoboam ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ta o bambile bwa kpɔe tɛ Korowii.
Kooro Rɛhoboam kora dii le mumpar ba a jaɡa, ne o haahna ne bii wa, ba chwera do Korowii keamere Sɛmaya ne Ido waa dɛ na chaahna waa tɔne bini.
Dɛ yoi chɔ Kooro Rɛhoboam ne Kooro Jɛroboam baah ta saŋ bɛlbwa.
Kooro Rɛhoboam sewɔ, asɛ ba huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
Asɛ o bibaa Abija chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Abija Kooro Jɛroboam aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anuatoro taa Abija di kora Juda harɛ ta.
Kooro Abija di kora Jerusalam bene atoro.
Uriel waa le bwɛjen Gebea bihaah Maaka biee Kooro Abija.
Aa ba dɛ la sie la, laa chole Kooro Jɛroboam ne Kooro Abija baah.
Kooro Abija kpɔ laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kaɡboŋa lafraanaarɛ, asɛ Kooro Jɛroboam ɡe kpɔ laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kaɡboŋa lafraanuatoro, ba ka cheme dɔŋa.
Kooro Abija ne o laa tena la kaa che Semaraem Bwejen waa lɔ Efrem deŋɡare harɛ ta dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Kooro Jɛroboam ne Israel tena, hé no n be!
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la cheɡɛ fɔo waa chɔ le waa wola chɔɡ ta dɛ kpɔ Israel kora tɛ Kooro Devid ne o naanar saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛɛ?
Kɛ Nɛbat bibaa Jɛroboam fa aa wola kooro ɛɛ mɔɔ la, o ɛ o dɔɔ Kooro Solomɔn deŋnekpeɡ dɛ pere o te le o nɛ.
A habɔɔ, nɛnsale bane boa ba nyoa, dɛ ba ja o nɛ, dɛ vuuɡi Kooro Rɛhoboam, ɡɛ saŋ dɛ o nɔn ta kao waa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ, dɛ puu ba yo.
Taraken he dɛ nyin kɛ he yo Korowii Kora waa kpɔa do Kooro Devid naanar nɔn ta la.
He laa tena warɔ dɛ berɛ dɔ nabali Kooro Jɛroboam aa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, a ɛ voɡa haa dɛ toma.
He laa doŋi Korowii sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ berɛ le nɛra bane so ba buɡ ta, ɡɛ harɛre ane nɛra aa ɛa la aa?
Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ won kpɔ nabale kɛɛ peera anuanɛ ba ŋɔ bá sɔ o doŋa ta, dɛ́ ɛo kerekpoŋri kwaa haa dɛ yera he voɡa la ta.
Ya te, Korowiirii yaa tomɛ, ya ta on vɛɛh.
Arɔn naanar ɛ sɔfore dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma, asɛ Lewi dea tena ɡe ɛɛ cha ba.
Chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra bwaa ba kpɔ saraha kwaa ba baa fuh, dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tɛ Korowii.
Ba kpɔ paanoo dɛɛ dawɛ teebur waa do ɡoroŋ doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta, dɛ choŋi kandere aa lɔ kandea daa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛo jɔmɔra bɛlbwa.
Ya dɛ ɛ waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la aa do yaa, kɛ he te vɛoh.
Korowii ja ya nɛ, onee ya sitɔɔ.
O sɔfore ɛɛ hoh laa bɛlee yerɛ yaa yá ba yo heya.
Israel tena, he bɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ yo, haa won pɔ o nɛ.” Dɛ Kooro Jɛroboam ɡelɔ o laa tena la bane bar Juda laa tena la dɛ do habɔɔ, asɛ ba bini bane ɡe do ba sie.
Juda tena laa tena nao kɛŋɔ Israel laa tena la bar ba cheme, belaa ba do lɔŋɔ yerɛ Korowii.
Asɛ sɔfore la hoh bɛle, asɛ Juda laa tena la do laa lɔŋɔ, asɛ Kooro Abija tɔ ba sie ba ka yoo ba.
Korowii ɡelɔ ba pɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ne Israel tena nɛ.
Israel laa tena chwao le Juda tena la be, asɛ Korowii kpɔ ba do Juda tena nɔn ta.
Kooro Abija ne o laa tena kpoo Israel laa tena baa jemɛ yoi taeh, laa tena dɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa lafraanue.
Gɛɛ Juda tena pɔ Israel tena nɛ, dɛ sɔɔh ba nyoa, dɛkalkɛ ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ nɛ.
Kooro Abija ti Kooro Jɛroboam laa tena, dɛ ka lɛ ba bwɛjena Bɛtel ne Jesana dɛ Efron, ne a bwɛjeɡre aa bara cheme bwa.
Kooro Jɛroboam ta berɛ dɔ kpeɡri Kooro Abija bere saŋ kpa.
Korowii tɛr o deŋne asɛ o sewɛ.
Kɛ Kooro Abija te teŋɔ di kpeɡri kohona.
O mo haahna fi dɛ banaarɛ, bibaala lɔ fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ dɛ bihaahna ɡe fi dɛ banumɛl.
Waane ɡe Kooro Abija aa ɛa dɛ bol o kora dii ta la, ba chwera do Korowii keame Ido bwara waa tɔn bini.
Kooro Abija sewɔ ba huɡo o naawa huɡribɔr Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
Asɛ o bibaa Asa chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Kooro Asa bere saŋ la, deŋnesɔɔhna lɔ harɛ la ta bene fi.
Juda Kooro Asa pɔ Itiopia tena nɛ Kooro Asa ɛ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre, Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la be.
O le harɛre ane kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta, ne bela baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa deŋɡarere ta bwa ne.
O paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura, dɛ teŋe voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa ta.
O do Juda tena bwa ŋɔ, baa ɛ waa Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la aa dɛ nyin, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne o webaɡla ta.
O chɔɡ bela baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa, ne kwaa baa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma a ta bwa Juda harɛ bwɛjen bɛlbwa ta, asɛ deŋnesɔɔhna do harɛ la ta o bere saŋ.
O bere saŋ, o ma danjwɛkpeɡa bar Juda harɛ bwɛjena, dɛ laa toole harɛ la ta kpa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii tɛo deŋnesɔɔhna.
Kooro Asa ŋɔ Juda tena be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya ma danjwɛkpeɡa bar bwɛjena nɔ, dɛ́ ma dejaŋa dɛ́ do bune a nyoo, dɛɛ kaɡra bune ne.
Harɛ la ɛ ya kon.
Yaa ɛ waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ nyin la waa o ɡel ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna la.” Anomanta, ba ɛ ɡɛ asɛ a do wer tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ Kooro Asa dɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraatoro Juda dea ba kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta anjena ne lampeare.
Dɛ berɛ dɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ fifraanuatoro baa kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe anjeɡre laa ta, ne tori le Bɛnjamen dea.
Dɛ ba bwa ɛ banyoola kɛrɛdɛ!
Sɛra waa le Itiopia kpɔ laa tena baa wara kohona, ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore lafraatoro dɛ ba bwɛjen Maresa.
Ate, Kooro Asa le, dɛ ka puu yo, bɛlbwa ne o laa tena cheɡɛ ba chebɔra Sɛfata Fɛlembɔjen bini, o bɛne Maresa.
Asɛ Kooro Asa yerɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won cha nɛra baa wola kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe, bá won ka yo nɛra baa kpeɡa kɛ hen.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, cha yaa, he nɛɛ ya kpɔ ya te dawɛ.
He sɔn taa ya ba, dɛɛ ba ba yo laa tena baa wara nɔ la.
Bɛ ɡel nɛwɛnyini pɔ he nɛ.” Korowii cha Kooro Asa ne Juda laa tena, asɛ ba pɔ Itiopia tena la nɛ.
Ba chwao, asɛ Kooro Asa ne o laa tena ti ba ka tel Gerar.
Korowii ɡelɔ ba kpoo Itiopia laa tena la warɛ, ba kar ta wone yo kpa, asɛ ba pa ba laala.
Ate, ba chɔɡ bwɛjeɡre aa bar Gerar la bwa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɡelɔ ɔmee kohona chole ba nɛ.
Ba jo bwɛjeɡre la ta dɛ pa ba laala, dɛkalkɛ dɛ laala lɔ bela kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba kaa yo nɛra bane ɡe baa dɛ nyiŋi boohna ne peera nɛ, bela baa soɡa, dɛ larawe boohna ne peera, dɛ nyoɡmare kohona dɛ laa berɛ ba Jerusalam.
Juda Kooro Asa voɡa chɔɡa o harɛ ta A habɔɔ la, Korowii Doma baa so Ɔdɛd bibaa Asaria nɛ, asɛ o le ka cheme Kooro Asa, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa Kooro Asa ne Juda dɛ Bɛnjamen deene nɛra bwa, hé no n be.
Dɛ Korowii waa lɔ he bambile ta naa, wɛɛ ja he nɛɛ.
He dɛ nyin o bɔr aa, wɛɛ ɡeloo he nao, kɛ dɛ he berɛ habɔɔ kpoo waa, o ɡe ɛɛ vɛh heyaa.
Israel tena soɡo la sie baa wola kasinteŋ Korowii tomɛ.
Ba ta sɔfore dɔe bá baɡ ba wa, baa Korowii Mmara ɡe jemɛ.
Kɛ wenaale aa ba ba nɛɛ la, ba ɡaaɡe Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la bɔr, asɛ o ɡel ba nao.
A ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ a kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nɛn won dɛɛ ɡaaɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, dɛkalkɛ wenaale ne wesaɡasaɡare lɔ Israel harɛ la ta.
Harɛre nɛra yon dɛɛ yo dɔŋa, bwɛjena ɡe ɛɛ yo dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Korowiirii kpɔ wenaale baa ta ba nɛ harɛre la ta.
Kɛ he Juda tena te, hé che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ bɛ ɡel he bwara hwah, hɛɛ dɔ he kembɔree le teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ la ta.” Kooro Asa aa no Korowii waa Ɔdɛd bibaa Korowii keame Asaria aa bola la, a tɛo kpeɡri bɛl.
O le voɡa aa ɛ kii kwaa la bwa ne, Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene harɛre ta, ne anɔ la aa lɔ bwɛjena bwa waa yoa dɛ pɔ a nɛra nɛɛ Efrem deŋɡarere ta la.
O berɔ kwaa kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta o do Korowii Dea pato sie la.
Nɛra warɔ le Efrem ne Manasɛ ne Simeon deene ta dɛ ba ja Kooro Asa nɛ, dɛ so o harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ ba nao kɛŋɔ Korowii ja o nɛ.
Kooro Asa yerɛ ba bwa, ne Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene nɛra cheme.
Ba cheme Jerusalam ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Asa aa di kora bene fi dɛ anue, korobie atoro ta.
Awola tɔpere la, ba kpoo kwaa baa kpɔa le laa ta la ane ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii.
Nae lɔ lafraanuanɛ, asɛ peera ne boohna ɡe kaɡboŋa anuanɛ.
Juda tena la baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, baa tomɛ Korowii ba naawa fa aa tomɔ la ba bambile ne ba liire bwa nee.
Nomɛlbwa, bechala kɛɛ nomoa, haah kɛɛ baa waa wola Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la nɛɛ teŋɛ la, a chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.
Ba do lɔŋɔ kohona dɛ hoh bɛle, ne pee nyeɡle bɛle, dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡle Korowii ŋɔ, baa teŋɛ fɔo la taa.
Juda tena la bwa sie lɛo dɛɛ hɛɡre, dɛkalkɛ ba ŋwɛɛ ntam bambile bwa ne.
Ba nyin Korowii sibeɡra ne, asɛ dɛ nao.
Anomanta, Korowii tɛɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna le ba dɔma nɔn ta.
Kooro Asa ir o naa Maaka haŋkora ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɛ voɡ Asera daa aa ɛ kii kwaa la.
Kooro Asa teŋni daa la, dɛ fuah Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta.
A lole kɛŋɔ Kooro Asa ta bela voɡtoroma aa soɡa dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa bwa chɔɡɛ le Israel harɛ ta te, kɛ dɛ o bambile cheɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ o soɡa bini bwa.
O kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, ne kwaa bwa o ne o mɛɛ aa dɔa, dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta la ba Korowii Dea.
Dɛ laa toole kpa, dɛ ka tel Kooro Asa kora dii bene fifraatoro dɛ anue ta.
Israel Kooro Baasa kaa yo Juda Kooro Asa Kooro Asa aa di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ anumɛl taa Israel Kooro Baasa kpɔ laa tena ka lɔ tɔ Juda Kooro Asa nɛ dɛ pɔ o nɛ, dɛ ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar bwɛjen Rama, ásɛ bɛlbwa bɛ won le Juda harɛ ta kaa, kɛɛ dɛ́ ba jo bela.
Kooro Asa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm cheɡ deene baa kpɔ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛɛ cheɡ a bini Korowii Dea la, ne anɔ la aa lɔ o koodem bela, dɛ tomɛ ba kpɔ ka tɛ Siiria Kooro Bɛn Hadad, dɛ o soɡe Damaskɔs waa ɛ harɛ la bwɛjen tenten ta dɛɛ di kora.
Kooro Asa ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo, ɡɛ ya naawa fa aa ɛa la.
N kpɔ koŋkɛɛla aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, á ɛ fɔo dɛ́ chɔɡ he ne Israel Kooro Baasa fɔo la taraken, ásɛ o ne o laa tena le n harɛ nɔ ta kaa.” Kooro Bɛn Hadad no Kooro Asa be dɛ tomɛ o laa sitɔɔla ne ba laa tena ŋɔ, bá ka yo Israel harɛ bwɛɛre.
Ba pɔ Ijon ne Dan dɛ Ebel Bɛt Maaka bwɛɛre, dɛ Naftale dea harɛ bwɛjena baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini bwa.
Kooro Baasa aa no ɡɛ la, o ɡel danjwɛɛ mae dɛ bar Rama toma la a ka.
Belaa Kooro Asa do Juda tena bwa ŋɔ bá la, dɛ́ ka che bwea ne daa Kooro Baasa aa kpɔa dɛɛ ma danjwɛɛ Rama la.
Anee Kooro Asa kpɔ ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar bwɛjena Geba ne Mispa.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, Korowii keame Hanani ba Kooro Asa be dɛ ŋɔ, “Haa kpɔ he te dawɛ Siiria kooro nɛɛ dɛ vɛh he te kpɔe dɛ dawɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɛɛ nomanta, Siiria kooro laa tena la le he habɔɔ.
Itiopia tena ne Lebya laa tena fa ta warɛ taeh dɛ dɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore, ne nɛra baa dɛ so jaɡre ta naa?
Kɛ haa kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ la, o ɡelɔ he pɔ ba nɛ aa?” Korowii sie lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa, wɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛo, dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri.
He ɛ ɡɛnewa, le fini dɛɛ kaa, laa ɡboo hɛɛ ba dɛɛ yoi.
Kooro Asa baah di Korowii keame Hanani nɛɛ kohona, asɛ dɛ lawɔ do dea.
Dɛ berɛ le ɡɛ saŋ dɛɛ kaa la, Kooro Asa pa mun dɛɛ ɛ nɛra la bane hɔhɔrɔwa kohona.
Kooro Asa kora dii jaɡa Kooro Asa aa di kora le mumpar kaa a jaɡa la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔn bini.
Kooro Asa aa di kora dɛ dɔ bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanaarɛ la, o we nakpaweela ane soo siwi.
A lole kɛŋɔ weela la baa do kpeɡri, kɛ o ta Korowii soŋɛ ŋɔ ó chao, dɛ tɛɡre tena ɡbo bee wɛɛ la.
O kora dii bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta la, o sewɔ, asɛ ba huɡo Kooro Devid Bwɛjen Jerusalam, bwe bɛl waa komɔ kɛŋɔ dea o ɛ o ɡbaɡba huɡribɔr bini.
Ba kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma ne nosɔɔhsoma fɔɡlo dɛ huɡo.
Nɛra warɔ cheme dɛ mar nijena a fuh, a baɡle jirima baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛo o seo la wa.
Juda Kooro Jehosafat Kooro Asa bibaa Jehosafat chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, dɛ di kora.
O nyiŋo dɛ ɡel o laa tena do kpeɡri Israel tena nɛ.
O kpɔ laa tena ka so Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara bwa, ne bwɛɛre bwa ta, dɛ bwɛjena a fa aa lɔ Kooro Asa lɔɡa Efrem harɛ ta bwa.
Dɛ Korowii ja Kooro Jehosafat nɛ, dɛkalkɛ o teŋɛ waa o nabaa Kooro Devid fa aa ɛa la ta.
O ta voɡ Baalre tomɛ.
O tomɛ Korowii o mɛɛ aa toma la, dɛ teŋɛ waa waa doo ta.
O ta waa Israel koranar aa ɛa ta teŋɛ.
Korowii ɡelɔ o kora che kiŋkiŋ Juda harɛ, asɛ nɛra la bwa kpɔ koŋkɛɛla baa tɛo, a che a ta o dɔ kondɔɔh ne duure kohona.
O bambile lawɛ Korowii toma kohona, asɛ dɛ chɔɡ bɔra voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa ne voɡ Asera dajaŋa aa lɔ Juda harɛ ta.
Kooro Jehosafat aa di kora bene atoro ta la, o tomɛ o nomonome ŋɔ bá baɡle Korowii waa Juda harɛ bwɛjena ne bwɛjeɡre bwa ta.
Banee, Bɛn Hael ne Obadia ne Sekaria ne Nɛtanɛl dɛ Mikaya.
Dɛ Lewi dea tena banuanaarɛ ne sɔfore banɛ ja ba nɛ.
Lewi dea tena laanee, Sɛmaya ne Nɛtanea ne Sebadia, ne Asahɛl ne Sɛmeramɔt ne Jehonatan, ne Adonija ne Tobija dɛ Tob Adonija.
Asɛ sɔfore la ɡee, Elisama ne Jehoram.
Ba iro kpɔ Korowii Mmara Tɔn la, dɛ ɡaaɡe Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta, dɛɛ baɡle o bini waa nɛra be.
Korowii kpɔ ɔmee ta harɛre aa bar Juda la nɛ kɛŋɔ, bá la ka yo Kooro Jehosafat laa.
Filisti tena bane kpɔ harɛ la ta kwaa ne suuɡapoŋa ba kɛo, Arab tena ɡe ba tɛo peera kaɡboŋa anuanɛ lafraanuanɛ, dɛ boohna kaɡboŋa anuanɛ lafraanuanɛ.
Gɛ taa a che Kooro Jehosafat pa mun dɛɛ do kpeɡri kohona.
O ma dekpeɡa aa jaŋa ne deene baa cheɡ kondikwaa a bini bwɛjena Juda harɛ ta, dɛ dɔ kondikwaa kohona Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta.
O berɔ kpɔ laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ ba so Jerusalam.
Gɛ baa chwerɛ ba sɔna lolanar bini laanee teŋa nɔ, Dɛ le Juda dea, laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa nyoo laanee nɔ.
Adna waa ɛ laa sitɔɔ, on chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraatoro nyoa.
Nɛɛte sɔne Jehohanan, o ɛ sitɔɔ dɛ chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ fifraanuatoro nyoa.
Toorotee Sikri bie Amasia, o ɡbabir le o te tɛ Korowii toma, o chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ nyoa.
Dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea ɡe, Eliada waa jemɛ yoi kohona, o chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ baa kpoŋe tori ne hɛma, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe dɛɛ yo laa nyoa.
Nɛɛte sɔne Jehosabad, o ɡe chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanuatoro baa kpɔ ba te, dɛ́ ka yo laa nyoa.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Kooro Jehosafat Jerusalam.
Ba ta banɔ la waa kpɔ ba so Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara la nɛɛ jae.
Korowii keame Mikaya jae waa ja Kooro Ahab Kooro Jehosafat dɔ kondɔɔh, asɛ o sɔn ɡe le kohona.
O cheɡɛ hahmor ta o ne Kooro Ahab kpɔ darame.
Bene ane aa baa kaa habɔɔ la, Kooro Jehosafat la bwɛjen Samaria, dɛ ka na Kooro Ahab.
Kooro Ahab kpoo peera ne nae kohona tɛ Kooro Jehosafat, ne nɛra baa ja o nɛ, dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba jirima, dɛ soŋe Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, ó ja o nɛ, bá ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena.
Asɛ Israel Kooro Ahab bɔɔ Juda Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ ja n nɛɛ yá ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena aa?” Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “N sɛh ɡɛ, n ne he bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
N nɛra ɛ he nɛra, yaa ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ ka yo.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Gel ya soŋe le Korowii be mɔɔ.” Anomanta, Kooro Ahab yerɛ Korowii keamere lafraanaarɛ, dɛ kpɔ bil ba sie ŋɔ, “Ń ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena kɛɛ ń ɡel ɔ?” Ba ŋɔ, “La ka yoo ba, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ baa do he nɔn taa.” Ate, Kooro Jehosafat bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Amɔ Korowii keame bɛlbwa toole yá che o nɛɛ dɛ́ soŋe le Korowii be naa?” Anee Kooro Ahab chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii keame beŋkpoŋ bɛl lole.
Onee Imla bibaa Mikaya.
Kɛ n ne waa somɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ta wobɛlbwa nae le Korowii be dɛ tɛ mɛ a ɛ wedɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ bwa, atane wechɔɡa ɡbo.” Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, bɛ ɡɛ ŋɔ.” Asɛ Kooro Ahab yerɛ o nomonome la bini bɛl dɛ ŋɔ, “La ka kpɔ Imla bibaa Mikaya ba taraken.” Dɛ Israel Kooro Ahab ne Juda Kooro Jehosafat do ba koolaala, dɛ so ba kookane ta, pɛla bɛl waa bɛne bwɛjen Samaria doonyoa, asɛ Korowii keamere la bwa che ba sie, dɛɛ bol waa baa naa ba be.
Keamere la bini bɛlee, Kenaana bibaa Sedekia.
O kpɔ bune ɛ kwaane a do kɛ nyeɡlare.
O ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
‘Kwaa nɔɔ hɛɛ ba kpɔe yo Siiria tena dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.’ ” Dɛ ɡɛ tentenee keamere la bwa bol Korowii waa dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena, hɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he pɔ ba nɛ.” Torome waa laŋa ka ɡaaɡe Mikaya bɔr la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii keamere la bwa nyoa pɛo ba bol ŋɔ kooro wobɛlbwa chiɡo kɛrɛdɛ.
Sɛh dɛ́ ɡel he ne ba waa la ɛ beŋkpoŋ.” Anee Korowii keame Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole kɛŋɔ, mɛɛ bol waa Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa ŋɔa ń bol o bee.” Mikaya aa ba Kooro Ahab be la, kooro pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N ne n dɔŋ Kooro Jehosafat ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena kɛɛ yá ɡel ɔ?” Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé la ka yoo ba, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo hé pɔ ba nɛ.” Asɛ Kooro Ahab ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Keraŋwɛnɛɛ ń ɡel he ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ hé bol kasinteŋ Korowii sɔn ta nɔ?” Mikaya ŋɔ, “N na Israel laa tena baa perɛ deŋɡarere ta kɛŋɔ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe ken.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Ba ta sitɔɔ dɔe, ɡel bá berɛ kaa dem deŋnesɔɔhna ne.’ ” Belaa Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “N ta he be ŋɔe ŋɔ o ta wedɛɛɡa bolɛ n be bwa atane wechɔɡa ɡbo aa?” Korowii keame Mikaya berɛ teŋɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “No waa Korowii aa bola.
N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii aa soɡe o kookara ta nyundua, o dɔm baa ja o nɛ dɛɛ tomɔ che baro.
Ate, Korowii pɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ neɡre Kooro Ahab, ásɛ o la Ramɔt Gelead dɛ́ ka yoo ba, ásɛ ba kpoo bela ɔ?’ Korowii dɔm baa cheɡa baro nyundua la bwa waa koɡrɔ.
Bane ŋɔ ken, bane ɡe ŋɔ ken.
Ate, doma bɛl ba che Korowii sie dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ neɡroo.’ Asɛ Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa hɛɛ ba kpɔe neɡro wɔ?’ Asɛ doma la ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo Korowii keamere baa dɛ tomɛ Kooro Ahab neɡro.’ Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Kaa dɛ́ ka ɛ ɡɛ.’ ” Korowii keame Mikaya berɛ ŋɔ, “Korowiirii ɡela he keamere la neɡre, o ɡbabirii bol he chɔɡa waa kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ hé sewɛ.” Ate, Kenaana bibaa Korowii keame Sedekia la, dɛ ka kpaa Korowii keame Mikaya lwɛɛma dɛ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo Korowii Doma ɡel mɛ dɛ ba bol wa he be bwa nɔ?” Korowii keame Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ naa, awola haa ŋɔ he ka jo dea bini ka sɔh la.” Belaa Israel Kooro Ahab ŋɔ o nomonome la bɛl be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ Korowii keame Mikaya kaa Amɔn waa dɛ nyiŋi bwɛjen nɔ ta, ne n bibaa Joas be, dɛ́ ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, n ŋɔ ba lawɔ do dea, dɛɛ tɛo paanoo ne nee ɡbo ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba jo sɔnɔnɔɔ.” Korowii keame Mikaya ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa jo sɔnɔnɔɔ naa, amɔ dɛ Korowii laa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛ bol wa.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa kpɔ waa nɔ do o nyu bini.” Kooro Ahab kpoe Ramɔt Gelead Ate, Israel Kooro Ahab ne Juda Kooro Jehosafat la bwɛjen Ramɔt Gelead, dɛ ka yoo ba.
Israel Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ beɡre n tenee dɛ́ ka ja laa tena nɔ nɛ, kɛ he te, do he koolaala.” Anomanta, Kooro Ahab beɡre o te, dɛ kaa laa la ta.
Dɛ Siiria kooro do o laa sitɔɔla baa dɛ nyiŋi torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la be ŋɔ, “He bɛ nomɛlbwa ka yo ka ja Israel kooro ɡbo nɛ.” Laa sitɔɔla la aa na Kooro Jehosafat la, ba liiro ŋɔ Israel kooroo, asɛ ba laa berɛ ŋɔ bá ka yoo.
Kɛ waa dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre la, Korowii chao dɛ ɡel ba laa berɛ kaa.
Laa sitɔɔla la nao kɛŋɔ Israel kooro laa, anomanta, ba ɡel o nɛɛ teŋa.
Siiria laa tena la bɛl ta hɛm o ka yaɡɛ Israel Kooro Ahab kon waa kpɔa tɔ ɡbemɡbe la keŋkeŋ, asɛ dɛ ka yaɡɛ o bambinyoa, dɛ o laa saahna.
Asɛ kooro la ŋɔ nɛn waa soɡe o torɔɡo baa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔ la be ŋɔ, “Ba do mɛ bol, le n ne laa nɔ ta.” Dɛ yoi la kpeɡri tɔpebir la bwa, asɛ ba lawɛ kooro la kpoŋe o so torɔɡo la bini, o sie chaɡɛ Siiria laa tena la.
Jɔmɔra ne tela dɛ o sewɔ.
A balɔ kɛŋɔ Juda Kooro Jehosafat berɔ ba o koodem Jerusalam deŋnesɔɔhna ta, asɛ Hanani bibaa Jehu waa ɛ Korowii keame la ka cheme Kooro Jehosafat dɛ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé cha nyubinikpeɡ tena, ásɛ dɛɛ nyin nɛra baa hah Korowii aa?
Gɛ nomanta, Korowii bandia ba he nɛ.
Kɛ he ɛ wedɛɛɡa tama ane, dɛkalkɛ he teŋni voɡ Asera daa nɛra aa dɛ tomɛ le he harɛ ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin ta.” Kooro Jehosafat le o nomonome Dɛ Kooro Jehosafat soɡe Jerusalam, kɛ o yon ir la harɛ la nɛra be, le Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ne Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ charɛ ba liire le Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la be.
O le nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole bwɛjen bɛlbwa baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro Juda harɛ ta, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi dɛ́ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, nɛn kpeɡri ne laa, Korowii kpeɡri taa, wɛɛ ja he nɛɛ he waa bola dɛɛ pa bole ta.
Hé kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ bol waa aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ be te, waa waa sie berɛ bole pae ta, waa nɛn siebɔr kɛɛ sen yawa nyiŋi.” Jerusalam ɡe la, Kooro Jehosafat le Lewi dea tena ne sɔfore, dɛ Israel nomonnyuune baa chɔ ba lolanar nyoo ŋɔ, baa nyiŋi nomɛlbwa waa koni Korowii Mmara la, dɛ́ bol nɛn ne o dɔŋ baah wa, dɛɛ pa bole Jerusalam.
O do ɡɛ nomonome la ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ kasinteŋ ne bambidɛɛɡe, dɛ Korowii ɔma dɛɛ ɛ he toma.
He bini bɛlbwa le bwɛjena nɔ ta, dɛ ba waa aa ɛ nɛŋkpoa kɛɛ Korowii Mmara la bini bɛlbwa ne naa, hé kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ wechɔɡa ɛ dɛ́ jo Korowii nɛ, ásɛ o bandia bɛ he nɛɛ ba.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa bolchɔɡee di.
Sɔfonomoa Amariaa dɛɛ ba he sie tɔe Korowii waa bwa ta, ásɛ Ismael bibaa Sebadia waa ɛ Juda dea nomoa la chɔ waa aa ɛ kooro waa nyoa, ásɛ Lewi dea tena la ɡe ɛɛ cha heya.
Hé ɛa bambile bwa ne, Korowiirii dɛ ja banɔ la baa ɛa kɛrɛdɛ la nɛ.”
Kooro Jehosafat yo Amɔn ne Moab tena A habɔɔ la, Moab ne Amɔn dɛ Meuni tena vɔrɔwe laa, dɛ́ ba yo Juda Kooro Jehosafat ne o nɛra.
Asɛ nɛra bane ba ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “Laa tena damanta le Edom harɛ Yar Mpo baŋ le dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yoi.
Ba tel Hasasɔn Taama.” Kooro Jehosafat ɔmɔ, dɛ bɔɔ le Korowii be ŋɔ ó baɡlo ɡɛ waa ɛ, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Juda te bɛlbwa vɔwɛ nyoa, á baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna.
Juda tena baa cheme Jerusalam, dɛ ba bɔɔ le Korowii be.
Juda harɛ bwɛɛ bɛlbwa taa nɛra le, dɛ ba soŋe Korowii.
Ate, Kooro Jehosafat ir che nɛra baa le Juda ne Jerusalam bwa sie, Korowii Dea dembaah onfale la sie, dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii ya naawa aa tomɛ, henee dɛɛ di kora nyundua ne harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.
Henee dɔ bokpeɡa ne kpeɡri kohona, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won che he sie.
Henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ.
He doŋi nɛra ba fa aa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta le he nɛra Israel tena sie, dɛ kpɔ tɛ he dam Abraham naanar, o ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ba soɡe harɛ nɔ ta dɛ do Dea he sɔn ta dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ wechɔɡa ane bɛlbwa ba ya nɛ, dɛ laa kɛɛ weechɔɡa kɛɛ lɔr aa, yaa ka che Dea nɔ sie he siee, dɛ́ wi noe a wa, ásɛ he no dɛ́ lɛ yaa.’ Taraken, Amɔn ne Moab ne Edom tena balɔ dɛ́ ba yo yaa.
Ya naawa fa aa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, he ta ɡelɛ ba jo ɡɛ harɛre la ta.
Ba valɔ dɛ bar ba, dɛ ɡel ba kpoora.
Na waa taraken baa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba bɔ yaa kem kɛŋɔ, bá doŋi yaa le harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ yaa o ɛ ya kapɛrɛ kon la ta.
Henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ.
Tɛr ba deŋne, dɛkalkɛ ya ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ won che laa tena baa wara dɛɛ ba ya nɛɛ nɔ sie.
Yaa jemɛ ɡɛ yaa ɛ, he siwi taa yaa nyiŋi.” Dɛ Juda harɛ ta baala ne ba haahna ne bii bwa cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la sie.
Belaa Korowii Doma ba so Sekaria bie Jahaseɛl nɛɛ nɛnlaa la baah.
Sekaria mɛɛ sɔne Bɛnaya, Bɛnaya lolɛ Jeyɛl, Jeyɛl lolɛ Matania.
Jahaseɛl ɛ Lewi dea te dɛ le Asaf dea.
Anee Jahaseɛl ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ne nɛra haa lɔ Juda ne Jerusalam bwa, hé no.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be laanee nɔ, ‘He bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr laa tena baa wara nɔ wa.
Korowiirii dɛ́ yo tɛ heya.
Hé ir ka yoo ba kere, ɡɛ saŋ baa teeh kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa chɔa kaa Sis dɛɛ ba la.
Hɛɛ ka chem ba fɛlembɔjen la nyoa Jeruel waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la bɔr.
He laa dɛɛ ba laa nɔ yoi.
Hé te ka che he chebɔra dɛɛ kpa.
Hé che kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ dɛ na ɡɛ Korowii aa yo tɛ heya, dɛ́ ɡel he pɔ ba nɛ.
Juda ne Jerusalam tena, he bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr, hé te le ka puu ba kere, dɛ́ na ɡɛ Korowii aa ja he nɛ.’ ” Asɛ Kooro Jehosafat ɡuŋi dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Asɛ nɛra la ɡe bwa ɡuŋi dɛ jam Korowii.
Ate, Lewi dea tena bane baa le Kohat ne Kora deene ta la ir che, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ takpeɡ ne.
Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, ba leɔ kaa Tekoa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela.
Baa dɛ ba kaala la, Kooro Jehosafat iro che dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé no, Juda ne Jerusalam tena.
Hé yarada Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la, dɛ́ yarada waa o keamere ɡe aa bola la, aa chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛɛ.” Kooro ne nɛra la bane bol wa, asɛ o le yelɡoola bane ŋɔ bá ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, o ɡoroŋ waa doa dɛ do kan kohona la wa, asɛ ba tɔ laa tena la sie dɛɛ ɡo yela ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Baa pa mun dɛɛ ɡo yela la, Korowii ɡelɔ Amɔn ne Moab, dɛ Edom laa tena baa dɛ ba ba lɔ tɔ Juda tena nɛɛ dɛ́ yoo ba la wili.
Amɔn ne Moab laa tena pɛo, dɛ yo Edom laa tena dɛ kpoo ba bwa kwaraa.
Baa kpoo ba tonɛ la, ba berɛ sie dɔŋa be dɛɛ kpoo dɔŋa, ka tel kɛŋɔ ba bwa aa tona.
Juda laa tena la baa tel bobɛl o sie aa chaɡɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, asɛ dɛ ha sie nyiŋi, dɛ na kɛŋɔ laa tena damanta la bwa serewɔ chɔ.
Beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae.
Ate, Kooro Jehosafat ne o laa tena la ka pa ba laala kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.
Ba na nae ne dɔmkwa dɛ suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaare a yoɡ aa kpeɡa warɛ taeh.
Tɔpera atoroo ba won kpɔ boa a bwa nyoa, kɛ ba ta wone kpɔ a bwa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a warɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Tɔpenaarɛ wee la, ba kaa cheme Bɛraka Fɛlembɔjen ta ɡo yela, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii a wa.
A waa baa yerɔ Bɛraka Felembɔjen ba le fini la.
Ate, Kooro Jehosafat tɔ o laa tena sie, asɛ ba berɛ ba Jerusalam silɛɛ ne, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɡelɔ ba pɔ ba dɔma nɛ.
Baa tel Jerusalam la, ba lɔ janjelare dɛ hoh bɛle ka jo Korowii Dea.
Harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra no ɡɛ Korowii aa yo Israel tena dɔma tɛɛ ba la aa, dɛ ɔmee kohona laɡ ba.
Anee ɡela Kooro Jehosafat dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna o harɛ waa dɛ di kora o ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ ja o nɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
Kooro Jehosafat kora dii jaɡa Kooro Jehosafat aa di kora Juda harɛ dɛ o di bene fifraatoro dɛ anue.
O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue.
Dɛ o nyaa Silhi bihaah Asuba.
Kooro Jehosafat ɛ ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Asa aa ɛa wobɛlbwa ta, o ta an ɡelɛ.
O ɛ waa aa toɡra Korowii be.
Deŋɡarere voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la te, o ta an chɔɡɛ.
Ba ta ba bambile bwa kpɔe tomɛ Korowii ba naawa fa aa tomɔ la.
Waane ɡe Kooro Jehosafat aa ɛa, le mumpar ba a jaɡa, ba chwera ja Hanani bibaa Jehu bwara waa aa lɔ Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
A habɔɔ, Juda Kooro Jehosafat ne Israel Kooro Ahasia o nyu bini aa kpeɡa kohona la fɔwɛ nyopɛo fɔo.
Kooro Jehosafat ne Kooro Ahasia pɛo, dɛ ɛ stiimaere aa kpeɡa, ba kpɔ dɛɛ kpɔ mpo sie dɛɛ la bonadibɔr.
Baa kwaara Eseɔn Gɛba tonɛ la, Dodavahu waa le Maresa bibaa Korowii keame Eliesa cheɡɛ Korowii waa ta, dɛ kah Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “He ne Kooro Ahasia aa fɔwɛ nyopɛo fɔo nomanta, Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa haa ɛa nɔɔ.” Anomanta, stiimaere la paɡrɔ ba ta wone kpɔa la bonadibɔr.
Kooro Jehosafat sewɔ ka chɔ o naawa hoɡa ta Jerusalam, o naa Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
Asɛ o bibaa Jehoram chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Jehosafat bibaa Kooro Jehoram dɔ nimanar bibaala banumɛl.
Banee, Asaria ne Jehiel ne Sekaria, ne Asariahu ne Maekel, dɛ Sɛfatea.
Kooro Jehosafat bibaalaa a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa.
Ba mɛɛ tɛɛ ba suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa kohona, dɛ berɛ tɛ bɛlbwa Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara ba ka so a ta.
Kɛ Jehoram aa ɛ binomoa la, onee Kooro Jehosafat le o chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Jehoram Kooro Jehoram kora aa baa che kiŋkiŋ la, o kpoo o nimanar la ne Israel nomonome bane.
Kooro Jehoram di bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ mɔɔ dɛ di kora, dɛ so Jerusalam di kora bene anuatoro.
O teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta.
Dɛ o mo Kooro Ahab bihaah, anomanta, o ɛ wechɔɡa Kooro Ahab ne o dem tena aa ɛa la, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
Dɛ Korowii aa nyin kɛŋɔ o chɔɡ Kooro Devid dem kora, dɛkalkɛ o ne Devid fɔwɛ fɔo o baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ o naanar ɛɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.
Kooro Jehoram aa di kora saŋee Edom harɛ tena pere ba te le Juda tena nɛ, dɛ ka chiɡ ba kooro.
Belaa Kooro Jehoram kpɔ o laa sitɔɔla ne o torɔɡore la ba be.
Edom tena la bar o ne o laa sitɔɔla baa dɛ nyiŋi o torɔɡore la, kɛ Kooro Jehoram ne o laa sitɔɔla iro jwaana, dɛ jo ba baah le, dɛ chwa kaa.
Ba le fini, Edom harɛ tena pere ba te le Juda tena lɔɡa.
Gɛɛ bwɛjen Lebna tena ɡe pere ba te ɡɛ saŋ, dɛkalkɛ Kooro Jehoram vɛh Korowii o naawa aa tomɔ la.
Hale o kwaa bɔra Juda harɛ deŋɡarere ta baa tomɛ voɡa, a che a ta Juda ne Jerusalam tena ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
Korowii keame Elaeja chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Kooro Jehoram ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii he naa Devid aa tomɔ aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘He ta waa he mɛɛ Kooro Jehosafat, kɛɛ he nabaa Kooro Asa aa ɛa ta teŋɛ.
He teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta, a che a ta Juda ne Jerusalam tena kaa tomɛ voɡa, ɡɛ Kooro Ahab ne banɔ la baa di kora o habɔɔ aa ɛa la.
Hale he berɔ kpoo he nimanar ba waa aa wera ɡwaale la.
