Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ tɛr he nɛra deŋnee taeh, he bii ne he haahna, dɛ chɔɡ kwaa haa dɔa ɡe bwa.
He ɡbabir ɡe ɛɛ we teweelaa taeh, ka tel kɛŋɔ haa sewɛ.’ ” Dɛ Filisti tena bane ne Arab tena fa soɡo bɛne bela Itiopia tena bane fa aa soɡa mpo nyoa.
Korowii ɡelɔ ba ne Kooro Jehoram yo laa.
Ba kaa lɔ tɔ Juda tena nɛ, dɛ pa laala aa lɔ koodem ne o haahna ne bibaala kaa.
O bibaa bechala Ahasia ɡboo baa ka.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Korowii ɡelɔ teweela baa wola won chaah ba Kooro Jehoram nɛ.
Weela la kpoŋo ka tel dɛ ɛ bene anɛ, asɛ o looni le o sewɛ weweele ne.
O nɛra ta on koo huɡa huɡe, dɛ mar nijena, dɛ baɡle jirima baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛo o seo la wa.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ ba ɛ o naawa baa tɔ sie la.
Kooro Jehoram aa di kora dɛ o di bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene anuatoro.
O seo ta nomɛlbwa nɛɛ weɛ.
Ba huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, kɛ bela baa dɛ huɡe koranar la laa.
Juda Kooro Ahasia Arab tena bane aa baa lɔ tɔ Kooro Jehoram bibanomonome bwa nɛɛ dɛ kpoo ba, asɛ a ka o bibaa bechala Ahasia la, Jerusalam tena cheɡo kora, o so o mɛɛ buɡ ta.
Kooro Ahasia di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ mɔɔ dɛ di kora.
O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora benanyoa beŋkpoŋ.
O nya sɔne Atalia, dɛ Kooro Omri o fa aa di kora Israel harɛ ta ka la naa.
O ɡe teŋɛ waa Kooro Ahab ne o dem tena aa ɛa la ta, dɛkalkɛ o nya doo o ɛ wechɔɡa.
O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ kɛ Kooro Ahab ne o dem tena, dɛkalkɛ o mɛɛ seo habɔɔ la, dɛ banee dɛɛ jao, a che a ta o chole.
Kooro Ahasia teŋɛ jae baa jao la ta, o ne Israel Kooro Joram ka yo Siiria harɛ Kooro Hasael bwɛɛ Ramɔt Gelead.
Yoi la ta la, Siiria laa tena la do Kooro Joram bol.
Anomanta, o berɔ ba Jesreel dɛ baa chah, asɛ Juda Kooro Ahasia la ka nao.
Dɛ Korowiirii ɛa kɛŋɔ Kooro Ahasia ka na Kooro Joram dɛ kpoo.
Waa laŋa la, o ne Kooro Joram laŋɔ ka cheme Nimsi bibaa Jehu, Korowii aa leo ŋɔ ó ba kpo Kooro Ahab dem nɛra la.
Kooro Jehu aa dɛ kpoo ba la, o kaa tel Juda nomonome ne Kooro Ahasia naanar baa ja o nɛɛ la, asɛ dɛ kpoo ba bwa.
O ɡelɔ baa ɡaaɡe Kooro Ahasia bɔr, asɛ o nɛra ka nao bwɛjen Samaria dɛ lawɔ.
Ba kpɔɔ ba tɛ Kooro Jehu, asɛ o kpoo.
Asɛ ba koh ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Jehosafat aa nyin Korowii o bambile bwa ne waa dɛ huɡo.
Anomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa toole Kooro Ahasia dem, dɛ dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won nyiŋi Juda harɛ la ta kpa.
Juda Haŋkooro Atalia Kooro Ahasia nya Atalia aa naa kɛ o bibaa Kooro Ahasia sewɔ la, o ŋɔ ba kpoo koobii baa ba di kora Juda harɛ ta bwa.
Dɛ Kooro Ahasia mɛɛ bihaah bɛl sɔne Jehoseba, dɛ yalɛ sɔfo Jehoiada.
O sɔɔh dɛ lɛ Kooro Ahasia bibaa Joas le koobii baa dɛ ba ba kpoora la bini, dɛ kpɔɔ ka sɔh o be dea, dɛ ɡel haah bɛl ɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛɛ Korowii Dea.
O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ lɛo le haŋkooro Atalia kpoe o fe aa dɛ nyin o kpoe la nɔn ta.
Jehoseba kpɔ Joas sɔh Korowii Dea bela bene anumɛl, ɡɛ saŋ haŋkooro Atalia aa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta la.
Bene anuanɛ ta la, sɔfo Jehoiada baɡle o kpeɡri.
O ne laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena lafare nyoo, ne Jɛroham bibaa Asaria, ne Jehohanan bibaa Ismael, ne Ɔbɛd bibaa Asaria, ne Adaya bibaa Maaseya, dɛ Sikri bibaa Elisafat fɔwɛ fɔo.
Ba la Juda harɛ bwɛjena ta, dɛ ka kpɔ Lewi dea tena ne nomonnyuune baa chɔ Israel deene nyoo bwa ba Jerusalam.
Asɛ nɛra la bwa ne kooro bibaa Joas ba cheme Korowii Dea dɛ fɔwɛ fɔo.
Anee sɔfo Jehoiada ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kooro Ahasia bibaa Joas ɛɛ di koraa, ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ Kooro Devid naanar nyoa la.
Gɛ maa dɛ nyin kɛ he sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, he balɔ dɛɛ ba ba daah Korowii Dea Ona Tɔpere aa, he bini bele batoro ba daah doonyoone la, bele batoro ɡe ka daah koodem, bele batoro ɡe do Mumpar Doonyoa, ásɛ nɛra la kabora ka boa nyoa Korowii Dea dembaahna bela.
Nomɛlbwa bɛ Korowii Dea la bini jo, atane sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena baa lɔ bela dɛɛ ɛ toma.
Ba te ɛɛ won jo bela, dɛkalkɛ ba sɔ ba doŋa ta ba do ɡoroŋ.
Kɛ banɔ la baa kaa la te chɛ kɛ bá teŋɛ waa Korowii aa bola la ta, dɛ́ so dahara.
Lewi dea tena chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ ba dɔmkwaa kpoŋe, dɛ́ che bar Joas, dɛ́ so o jwɛh, bobɛlbwa waa kaa.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa ba dɛ jo Korowii Dea aa, bá kpoo.” Lewi dea tena ne Juda baala la ɛ ɡɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa do ba la bwa.
Ba bini bɛlbwa ta nɛra baa dɛ ba toma ta Ona Tɔpere ta, ne banɔ la baa wola toma ta ba Ona Tɔpere ta la ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ba kaa ba deremi.
Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ lampeare ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta, a ɛ Kooro Devid kwaa ba kpɔ cheɡ Korowii Dea la tɛ laa sitɔɔla la.
Ate, o ɡel nɛra baa dɛ daah la bɛlbwa kpoŋe o dɔmkon ba che Korowii Dea ne saraha kon la sie, dɛ bar Kooro Joas.
Name sɔfo Jehoiada ka lawɛ Joas le buse dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ cheɡo kora ta.
Ba kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ piu, dɛ kpɔ fɔo baa fɔwa dɛ che o ta dɛɛ di kora harɛ la ta do o nɔn ta.
Asɛ ba lɔ kpaŋa dɛ moo ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ kooro mkpajaŋ!” Haŋkooro Atalia aa no moola nɛra baa dɛ daah ne nɛra baa lɔ bela aa dɛ moo la, o ɛ warane la ba be Korowii Dea bela.
O baa na kɛŋɔ kooro la cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la sie pila bɛl jwɛh ɡɛ ba nawee wa aa doa.
Asɛ laa sitɔɔla ne bɛlhoohla che kooro jwɛh.
Asɛ harɛ la ta nomɛlbwa sie lɛ, baa hoh bɛle, dɛɛ lɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, asɛ yelɡoola ɡo yela tɔ ba sie.
Belaa haŋkooro Atalia laa o batakaare kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ o baah diu kohona, dɛ ŋɔ, “He bwa lee mɛ tɛ!
He ɛɛ mɛ dɔm!” Dɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa nyin kɛ bá kpo Atalia Korowii Dea bɔr bela, anomanta, o do laa sitɔɔla la ŋɔ, “Hé lawɔ le laa tena nɔ baah ta, dɛ́ kpo nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛ ó ba lɛo.” Ate, ba tɛɡro le, dɛ kpoo Jaɡre Doonyoa bela jaɡre aa cheɡa dɛɛ jo koodem la ta.
Sɔfo Jehoiada ne Kooro Joas fɔwɛ fɔo o chɔ Korowii ne harɛ la nɛra baah ta kɛŋɔ nɛra la ɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.
Ate, harɛ la ta nɛra bwa la voɡ Baal dea, dɛ ka paɡre kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo, ne voɡare aa lɔ dea la bini bwa, dɛ paɡre o dea la bwa ɡe kwaraa.
Dɛ lawɛ o kerekpoŋri baa dɛ yerɔ Matan, dɛ kpoo kwaa ba fa aa dɛ ɛ sarahare o ta la sie.
Ate, Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ Korowii Dea bela toma do sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena nɔn ta.
Banee Kooro Devid kpɔ do ba nɔn ta ŋɔ, báa fuh saraha kwaa baa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii la, ɡɛ aa lɔ Mosis Mmara Tɔn bini.
Dɛ banee chɔ yela ɡoe ne wobɛlbwa aa dɛ ba silɛɛ ne nyoa.
Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ nɛra ba che, baa daah Korowii Dea doonyoo la, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa kah doŋa la bɛ Dea la bini jo.
Sɔfo Jehoiada yerɛ laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena lafare nyoo ne nomonome dɛ nomonjena, asɛ ba kpɔ Kooro Joas le Korowii Dea bela ba.
Ba kpɔ koodem Nyundua Doonyoa la ta jo, asɛ kooro ba so o kookara ta, asɛ harɛ la ta nɛra bwa sie lɛ, bwɛjen la sɔɔh, kpoe baa kpo haŋkooro Atalia la wa.
Juda Kooro Joas Kooro Joas aa di kora Juda harɛ dɛ o dɔ bene anuanɛ.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanaarɛ.
O nya sɔne Sebea, dɛ le bwɛjen Beɛseeba.
Kooro Joas ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, ɡɛ saŋ sɔfo Jehoiada aa dɛ di sɔfore bwa.
Sɔfo Jehoiada mo haahna banɛ tɛ Kooro Joas, asɛ o dɔ bibaala ne bihaahna.
A habɔɔ la, Kooro Joas liiro kɛŋɔ wɛɛ berɔɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la.
Asɛ o yerɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena cheme, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡaaɡe Juda harɛ bwɛjena ta, dɛ́ lɛ toɔ aa chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa bɔ benanyoa la ba, ásɛ n kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la.
Hé ɛa warane.” Kɛ Lewi dea tena la ta mun pae warane.
Anomanta, o yerɛ Sɔfonomoa Jehoiada dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ta nyiŋe Lewi dea tena la Juda ne Jerusalam, dɛ ka lɛ benanyoa bɛlbwa toɔ, Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis ne Israel tena bwa aa ŋɔa bá ka lɛ ba kwaa Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr laɔ?” Dɛ Haŋkooro Atalia nyubinikpeɡ te la habɔteŋra ku Korowii Dea la, dɛ pa kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la bini ane kaa tomɛ voɡ Baalre.
Ate, Kooro Joas do Lewi dea tena la ŋɔ, bá kwaa daka cheɡ Korowii Dea la doonyoa dɛɛ lɛ suuɡare.
Ate, ba kpɔ kala ka tɛ Juda ne Jerusalam tena ŋɔ, nómɛlbwa kpɔ toɔ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis fa aa lɛa Israel tena be pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la ba.
Nɛra la ne ba nomonome kpɔ ba toɔre ba silɛɛ ne, asɛ daka la su.
Tɔpere bɛlbwa, Lewi dea tena la yon kpɔ daka la ba koodem karakere baa dɛ nyiŋi o ta la be.
Dɛ o suu waa, karakere la ne Sɔfonomoa nachiɡe yon fuɡa, dɛ berɛ kpɔ daka la ka cheɡ o buɡ ta.
Gɛɛ baa ɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛ dɔ suuɡa a warɛ.
Kooro Joas ne sɔfo Jehoiada yon kpɔ suuɡa la do nɛra Korowii Dea kwaara aa lɔ ba nɔn ta.
Ásɛ ba kpɔ mamaala ne kapenta tena, dɛ nɛra baa jemɛ bune ne ayaawa toma ŋɔ ba kwaa Dea la.
Tom-ɛɛra la do sie ɛ toma kohona, dɛ ɡel Korowii Dea la berɛ do ɡɛ o fa aa doa wubwa la, dɛ do kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ.
Tom-ɛɛra la aa tona la, ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa la kar tɛ kooro ne sɔfo Jehoiada, asɛ ba kpɔ kwaa loɡbaala ne konjeɡre bwa soo siwi baa hiah cheɡ Korowii Dea la bini.
Sɔfo Jehoiada bere saŋ, nɛra kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ ba Korowii Dea bela saŋ bɛlbwa.
Sɔfo Jehoiada hwɛɛhrɔ taeh mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ, dɛ o di bene lafa fifraatoro.
Ba huɡo koranar huɡribɔr Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, o wedɛɛɡa waa ɛa Israel harɛ tɛ Korowii ne Korowii Dea toma la wa.
Kooro Joas nyubinikpeɡ wa Kɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa sewa habɔɔ la, Juda nomonome ba Kooro Joas be, dɛɛ soŋo ŋɔ wɛɛ no ba deŋna wa.
Juda harɛ nɛra vɛh Korowii ba naawa fa aa dɛ tomɔ la ka toma o Dea bela, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa ne voɡa.
A ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ nomanta, Korowii baah di Juda tena ne Jerusalam tena nɛ.
Korowii tomɛ o keamere ba be, dɛ kah ba ŋɔ bá charɛ dɛ berɛ ba o be, kɛ ba vɛoh.
Belaa Korowii Doma ba so sɔfo Jehoiada bibaa Sekaria nɛ, asɛ o ka che nɛra la sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be laanee nɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ he vɛh n waa maa do heyaa a ta nɔɔ?
He wobɛlbwa aa werii do tɛ heyaa bwa.
Haa vɛh mɛ nomanta, n ɡe vɛh heya.’ ” Kooro Joas sɛoh o ne ba vɔrɔwe Sekaria vɔrɔwa.
Asɛ o ɡel ba foɡro bwea Korowii Dea dembaah dɛ kpoo.
Kooro Joas soh ɡɛ Sekaria mɛɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa chao la, dɛ ɡarɛ kpo Sekaria.
Waa chɔa dɛɛ sewɛ la o ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe kɛ Korowii na waa haa ɛa nɔ, dɛ́ bɔe a kem!” Kooro Joas kora dii jaɡa Lɔmɔɡa saŋ aa tela la, Siiria laa tena warɔ, dɛ ba Juda ne Jerusalam ba yoo ba, dɛ kpoo ba nomonome bwa.
Dɛ pa ba laala bwa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa ka tɛ ba kooro Damaskɔs.
Dɛ Siiria laa tena aa kanɛ, kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ ba yo, dɛ pɔ Juda laa tena baa wara kohona nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh Korowii ba naawa aa dɛ tomɔ la.
Gɛɛ a do Kooro Joas dɔ o deŋnetɛra.
Baa do Kooro Joas bol laa ta la, Siiria laa tena la kaalɔ, belaa o nomonome la banɛ vɔrɔwe o vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo, kpoe waa kpo sɔfo Jehoiada bibaa la wa.
Ba kpoo ɡɛ saŋ dɛ o chɔ mpa ta, asɛ ba huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, kɛ koranar huɡribɔr laa.
Nɛra baa vɔrɔwe o kpoe vɔrɔwa la bɛl sɔne Sabad.
O nya sɔne Simiat dɛ ɛ Amɔn te, ne Jehosabad, o ɡe nya sɔne Simrit dɛ ɛ Moab te.
Ba chwerɛ Kooro Joas bii waa ne ɡɛ Korowii keamere aa bol o wa, ne ɡɛ waa bera kwaa Korowii Dea la waa do Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
O bibaa Amasea baa chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Amasea Amasea di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue mɔɔ dɛ di kora.
O di kora Jerusalam bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ.
O nya sɔne Jehoadin dɛ le Jerusalam.
Kooro Amasea ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, kɛ dɛ o bambile bwa ne laa.
Kooro Amasea kora aa baa che kiŋkiŋ name la, o kpoo nomonome baa kpo o mɛɛ o fa aa di kora la.
Kɛ o ta ɡɛ nomonome la bii kpoorɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa chwera Mosis Mmara la ta kɛŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kɛɛ nya ɛ wechɔɡa aa, haa won kpɔ kpo o bie, bii ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa aa, haa won kpɔ kpo mɛɛ kɛɛ nya.
Nɛn o ɡbaɡba aa ɛ wechɔɡa laanee chɛ kɛ ó sewɛ o wechɔɡa wa.” Kooro Amasea boa baala bwa baa lɔ Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene, dɛ le ba nomonnyuune ba chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo ba deene ta.
Baala baa di bene fifraanɛ kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafraatoro.
Banee ba le ba kpɔ ba te dɛ jemɛ lampeare ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta ne yoi kɛrɛdɛ.
O berɔ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, dɛ ka bɔ Israel laa tena kaɡboŋa lafa paa ŋɔ bá ba yo tɛo.
Anee Korowii keame bɛl la kooro be ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, bɛ ɡel Israel laa tena teŋɛ he nɛ.
Korowii ta Israel tena baa le weekaŋle nyundua harɛ la nɛɛ teŋɛ.
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba ja he nɛ aa, anee he do kpeɡri laa la ta, kɛ Korowiirii dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ ɡel nɛn ɛɛ pɔ o dɔŋ nɛɛ kɛɛ wɛɛ chole.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma pɔ he nɛ.” Anee Kooro Amasea bɔɔ Korowii keame la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ maa bɔa tɛ Israel laa tena la waɔ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ won berɛ tɛɛ ane a ɡwaa ɡɛ.” Anomanta, Kooro Amasea ɡelɔ Israel laa tena la berɛ kaa ba bwɛɛre ta.
Ba baah di Juda tena nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ berɛ kaa.
Asɛ Kooro Amasea do ɡbemba dɛ tɔ laa tena la sie dɛ kaa Yar Fɛlembɔjen ta.
Ba kpoo Edom laa tena kaɡboŋa fi bela.
Ba berɔ lawɛ Edom laa tena la bini kaɡboŋa fi ɡe, dɛ kpɔ ba ka che bwejen bɛl doa waa lɔ bwɛjen Sela, dɛ taɡ ba ta, ba lee o lɔɡa dɛ serewe.
Israel laa tena Kooro Amasea aa ɡela ba berɛ kaa ŋɔ ba bɛ o nɛɛ teŋɛ la laa la ta la, kaa lɔ tɔ Juda bwɛjena ta, le Samaria kaa Bɛt Hɔrɔn, dɛ kpoo nɛra kaɡboŋa batoro, dɛ pa laala aa wara le bela kaa.
Kooro Amasea aa kaa kpoo Edom tena dɛ ba la, o pa bela voɡa dɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ toma dɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare a ta.
Anomanta, Korowii baah di Kooro Amasea nɛ, dɛ tomɛ o keame bɛl o be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ tomɛ harɛre ane voɡa aa wola wone lɛ a nɛra le he nɔn ta nɔɔ?” Korowii keame la nyoa taa lɔ waa la ta wɛɛ bol la, Kooro Amasea ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya lee ŋɔ hɛɛ ja kooro aa?
Tɔ nyoa!
Gɛ laa aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpoe.” Ate, Korowii keame la tɔ nyoa, dɛ berɛ pili nyoa ŋɔ, “Taraken te n jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ ba he kpoe, dɛkalkɛ he vɛh waa maa jae ŋɔ he bɛ ɛ la.” Juda Kooro Amasea ne nɛra baa dɛ jao vɔrɔwe Israel tena vɔrɔwa.
Belaa o kpɔ kala tɛ Israel Kooro Jehoas waa ɛ Kooro Jehoahas bibaa, dɛ ɛ Kooro Jehu o fa aa di kora Israel la naa ŋɔ bá cheme dɔŋa dɛ yo laa.
Anee Israel Kooro Jehoas ɡe tomɛ toroma Juda Kooro Amasea be, dɛ sɛɡlo ŋɔ, “Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta jabalnadaŋɛ bɛlee fa ira, dɛ ka ŋɔ bela dajen bɛl be ŋɔ, ‘Kpɔ he bihaah tɛ mɛ ń tɛ n bie ó mo.’ Asɛ kpɔɡ bini ol bɛl ɡe ir, dɛ ba tiɡri jabalnadaŋɛ la ta dɛ laa kuuɡi.” O berɔ ŋɔ Kooro Amasea be ŋɔ, “He yo Edom tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ he nyu bini do he som, ɡel a maɡre he ne dɛ́ so he dem.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin waa ba dawɛ ya nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ he kora ne Juda tena nɔɔ?” Kɛ Kooro Amasea ta a mun noɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ ba do Kooro Jehoas nɔn ta, toma baa dɛ tomɛ Edom harɛ ta voɡa la wa.
Anomanta, Israel Kooro Jehoas ne Juda Kooro Amasea kaa cheme dɔŋa Bɛt Sɛmɛs waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ yo laa.
Israel laa tena pɔ Juda laa tena nɛ, asɛ ba chwa peɡre kaa ba bwɛɛre.
Israel Kooro Jehoas lawɛ Juda Kooro Amasea, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ka kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa baro la.
Ba kuuɡu le Efrem Doonyoa ka tel bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Loŋkora Doonyoa.
O jaŋne ɛɛ ɛ naɡale lafraanumɛlee.
Kooro Jehoas pa suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne kwaa aa lɔ Korowii Dea, Lewi dea te Ɔbɛd Edom naanar aa dɛ nyiŋi a ta, ne koodem bela laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa kaa Samaria.
O lawɛ nɛra ɡe ja kaa.
Juda Kooro Joas bibaa Kooro Amasea di bene fi dɛ anue, Israel Kooro Jehoahas bibaa Kooro Jehoas seo habɔɔ.
Waa aa bera chiɡ Juda Kooro Amasea kora dii ta, le mumpar ba a jaɡa la, ba chwera do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Le ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Amasea aa vɛh Korowii toma la, dɛ ba dɛ vɔrɔwe o kpoe vɔrɔwa Jerusalam.
Anomanta, o chwao kaa bwɛjen Lakes ta, asɛ ba tomɛ nɛra ba teŋɛ la, dɛ ka kpoo bela.
Ba kpɔ o chɔɔ dawɛ jaaɡɔ ta ba Jerusalam, asɛ ba huɡo bela baa huɡe o naawa Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta.
Juda Kooro Ussia Kooro Amasea aa sewa la, Juda tena bwa lawɛ o bibaa Ussia baa chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta o di kora.
Dɛ o di bene fi dɛ anumɛl.
Kooro Ussia berɔ ka yo lɛ Elat dɛ kwaa vɔrɔwo, o mɛɛ seo habɔɔ.
Waa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fi dɛ anumɛl.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanue dɛ anɛ.
O nya sɔne Jekolia dɛ le Jerusalam.
Kooro Ussia ɛ waa a too Korowii tea, ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Amasea fa aa ɛa la.
O tomɛ Korowii o bambile bwa ne ɡɛ saŋ Korowii keame Sekaria, waa dɛ jao Korowii waa ta taa soɡe le, asɛ Korowii sweero andɛɛɡa.
Kooro Ussia ne Filisti tena yo laa, asɛ dɛ ka paɡre danjwɛkpeɡa aa bar bwɛjena Gat ne Jamnia dɛ Asdɔd.
O berɔ kwaa vɔrɔwe bwɛjena aa bɛne Asdɔd dɛ Filisti harɛ la ta bobɛla bwa.
Korowii chao o pɔ Filisti tena ne Arab tena baa soɡe Gur Baal, dɛ Meuni tena nɛ.
Amɔn tena kpɔ harɛ la ta kwaa baa tɛ Kooro Ussia, asɛ o sɔn le dɛ ba Ijipt harɛ ta bwa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɔ kpeɡri kohona.
Kooro Ussia ɡelɔ ba ma dejaŋa aa do kpeɡri Jerusalam Loŋkora Doonyoa, ne bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa, dɛ bela danjwɛɛ baa maa bar bwɛɛ la loŋkora ta.
O berɔ ɡel ba ma dejaŋa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ kwi bɔɔne aa won nee lɛɛ bwea lɔɡre, ne deŋɡarere harɛ aa chɔa kaa la ta, dɛkalkɛ o dɔ kondɛɛra kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ o dɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma o kooni ne daa kooni aa lɔ deŋɡarere ne harɛpare andɛɛɡa ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o sie dɛ lɛ para ta.
Dɛ o dɔ laa tena baa jemɛ yoi, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ́ ka yo laa.
O karakere banɛ Jeyɛl ne Maaseyaa chwerɛ waa aa dɛ chiɡ dɛɛ bil, asɛ kooro nomoa Hanania chɔ ba nyoa.
Dɛ nomonnyuune baa dɛ nyiŋi laa tena la nɛɛ lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafraanumɛl.
Laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraatoro dɛ banuanɛ lafraanue baa dɛ ba wona yo kooro dɔma tɛo kɛrɛdɛ la lɔ ba lɔɡa.
Kooro Ussia tɛ o laa tena la kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta, ne lampeare ne bune ɡbɛrɛre, ne laa batakaani ne tori, dɛ vamtor bwea.
O ɡelɔ nɛra baa dɔ wejema kpɔ bune kwaa kwaane nɛra aa dɛ ba wona che a ta dejaŋa dor, ne danjwɛkpeɡa aa bar bwɛjen Jerusalam loŋkoni ta, dɛɛ ta hɛma ne bwejena.
O sɔn leɔ kaa bobɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii chao kohona mɔɔ o dɔ kpeɡri.
Kɛ Kooro Ussia aa ba dɛ di kpeɡri la, mbarafo nomanta o cholo.
O waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ ka jo Korowii Dea ŋɔ o ka fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma kon baa dɛ fuah a ta la ta.
Sɔfo Asaria ne sɔfore fifraanuatoro bane ɡe ba bambile aa kpeɡa teŋɛ o nɛɛ kaa Korowii Dea bela.
Asɛ ba la o be ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ he fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma tɛ Korowii.
Sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar baa sɔ ba doŋa ta, ba do ɡoroŋ Korowii be pera la, banee dɔ a ŋwɛnɛ kɛ bá ɛ ɡɛ toma nɔ.
Le Korowii Dea bonɔ kaa, dɛkalkɛ he waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe o sie, waa andɛɛɡaa swee tɛɛ kpa.” Dɛ Kooro Ussia cheɡɛ Korowii Dea bela, kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma o ta la jwɛh, dɛ kpoŋe kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma.
O baah di sɔfore la nɛ, asɛ buɡ la ta, bwadabii weechɔɡa ane ba le o tile ta.
Sɔfo Asaria ne sɔfore la nyoa kpoo baa nyiŋu, dɛ na kɛ wee lɔ o tile ta, asɛ ba doŋu le buse warane.
Dɛ o ɡbabir kwaraa fe dɛ nyin buse lee wubwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛr o deŋne.
Korowii kpɔ wee ta Kooro Ussia nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa sewɛ.
O ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe jo Korowii Dea dɛ so o ɡbaɡba dem.
Wobɛlbwa toole wɛɛ ɛ kpa, asɛ o bibaa Jotam ba so koodem bela dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la tena nɛ.
Waane ɡe aa chiɡ Kooro Ussia kora dii ta, le mumpar kaa a jaɡa la, Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya chwera do tɔn bini.
Kooro Ussia baa sewɛ asɛ ba huɡo bɛne o naawa koo bɛl koranar harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ ba ŋɔ o we wee.
O bibaa Jotam chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Jotam Kooro Jotam aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ anumɛl.
O nya sɔne Jerusa, asɛ o nya ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Sadɔk.
Kooro Jotam ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, dɛ teŋɛ waa o mɛɛ Kooro Ussia aa ɛa la ta.
Kɛ o te ta Korowii Dea joɛ, dɛ ka fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii nɛ.
Dɛ harɛ la ta nɛra ta teŋɔ, dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Kooro Jotam berɔ kwaa ma Korowii Dea doonyoa baa dɛ yerɔ Weekaŋle Nyundua Doonyoa la.
Dɛ berɛ kwaa ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam Ofel deŋɡare ta.
O vɔrɔwe bwɛjena Juda harɛ bwejena ta, dɛ ma dekpeɡa ne dejaŋa kɔne bini ɡe.
O kaa yo Amɔn kooro ne o laa tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
O ham ba dɛ ɡel ba kpɔ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛo benanyoa bɛlbwa.
Kwaa kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, ne mea baaɡe a tɔɡre aa ɛ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ, dɛ mea ane ɡe soo siwi baaɡe a ɡe tɔɡre aa ɛ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ.
Ba teŋɔ kpɔ ɡɛ tenten ba tɛo bennɛɛte ne bentooro te ta.
Kooro Jotam baa do kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛ o teŋɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne.
Waa aa chiɡ Kooro Jotam kora dii ta, ne laa waa yoa, ba chwera do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Jotam aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ anumɛl.
Kooro Jotam aa baa sewɛ la, ba huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen bela baa huɡe o naawa.
Asɛ o bibaa Ahas chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Ahas Kooro Ahas di bene fifraanɛ mɔɔ dɛ di kora.
O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora bene fi dɛ anumɛl.
Dɛ o ta doe kɛŋɔ o nabaa Kooro Devid, o ta waa aa too Korowii tea ɛɛ.
O teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta, dɛ ɛ voɡa dɛɛ tomɛ voɡ Baalre.
O kpoo kwaa dɛ fuah ɛ saraha Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen bini.
O kpo o bibaala, dɛ fuuh ba ɛ saraha, dɛ teŋɛ harɛre ane nawee waa Korowii aa kia, dɛ koh a wa doŋ ba le ba Israel tena sie la ta.
Kooro Ahas kpoo kwaa dɛ ɛ saraha, dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma tɛ voɡare bela voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ, ne deŋɡarere dor, dɛ dajen bɛlbwa mun.
Anomanta, Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la kpɔɔ do Siiria kooro nɔn ta.
Siiria laa tena baa yoo dɛ pɔ o nɛ, dɛ lawɛ o nɛra ɡalɡa, dɛ ba ba ne Damaskɔs.
O berɔ kpɔɔ do Israel kooro nɔn ta o yoo, dɛ kpoo o laa tena taeh.
Tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo ta, Remalia bibaa Kooro Pɛka ne o laa tena iro ka kpoo Juda laa tena kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la.
Sikri waa ɛ banyoo dɛ le Efrem dea kpo Kooro Ahas bibaa baa dɛ yerɔ Maaseya, ne koodem nomoa Asrikam dɛ Ɛlkana.
Dɛ kooro toole naa Ɛlkanaa lole.
Israel tena lawɛ Juda tena ba fe aa ɛ ba lolanar laa ta, nɛra kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ baa ɛ ba haahna ne bihaahna dɛ bibaala.
Ba berɔ pa ba laala aa wara laa la ta, dɛ ba a ne Samaria.
Dɛ Korowii keame Ɔdɛd lɔ Samaria bela.
O iro dɛ la ka cheme laa tena la ɡɛ saŋ baa ba Samaria la.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ la baah di Juda tena nɛɛ waa o ɡel he yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ la.
Kɛ he berɔ kpoo ba warɛ kohona to.
Taraken he dɛ́ nyin he ɛ baala ne haahna baa lɔ Juda ne Jerusalam bwa he yoma.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he di bolchɔɡe dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la nɛ aa?
Hé no n be!
Hé ɡel he lolanar haa laɡ ba yoma nɔ berɛ kaa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii baah di he nɛɛ kohona.” Belaa Israel nomonome la bane baa ɛ Jehohanan bibaa Asaria, ne Mɛselɛmɔt bibaa Bɛrekea, ne Salum bibaa Jehiskia, dɛ Hadlai bibaa Amasa ir ka cheme nɛra baa le laa ta dɛɛ ba la.
Ba ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ nɛra haa laɡ ba la kpɔ ba bonɔ, ɡɛ laa aa, yaa di bolchɔɡe Korowii siee.
He bɛ ɡel ya kpɔ wechɔɡa ja bolchɔɡe dii ta, a kan ya nɛɛ wubwa, ásɛ Korowii baah di ya nɛɛ kohona.” Anomanta, laa tena la kpɔ nɛra la ne laala baa paa laa la ta bwa tɛ nomonome baa lɔ bela la bwa, ba siwi ta.
Asɛ nomonome banaarɛ la lawɛ nɛra la, dɛ ka kpɔ yale aa ja laala laa tena la aa paa la bini ane tɛ banɔ la baa cheɡɛ mumɡbal la, dɛ tɛɛ ba yale ne naŋɡaware ne kondikwa, dɛ noo baa kpɔ do ba ŋwɛra ta.
Ba bini banɔ la baa ɡwɛɡra ɡe la, ba kpɔ ba so keeɡore ta.
Gɛɛ a ɛ ba kpɔ ba bwa berɛ kaa ba bala be Jeriko baa dɛ yerɔ Bambie Bwɛjen la, dɛ berɛ ba Samaria.
Aa ba dɛ la sie la, Kooro Ahas tomɛ nɛra Asiiria koojen be ŋɔ ó ba chao.
Dɛ Edom tena berɔ ba yo Juda tena, dɛ lawɛ nɛra laa ta kaa, asɛ Filisti tena ɡe ba lɔ tɔ Juda harɛ ta bwɛɛre aa lɔ deŋɡarere ta, ne Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ tena nɛ.
Ba yoo dɛ lɛ bwɛjena Bɛt Sɛmɛs ne Aejalɔn, ne Gɛdɛrɔt ne Soko ne Temna dɛ Gimso, ne a bwɛjeɡre aa bara bwa dɛ so a ta.
Juda Kooro Ahas wechɔɡa waa ba a ne Juda harɛ ta, ne kasinteŋ waa wola dii tɛ Korowii la nomanta, Korowii kpɔ wahala ba ta Juda tena nɛ.
Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa ba o be, kɛ wenaale nee o ba ɡwaa kɛ o fe aa ba chao.
Anee Juda Kooro Ahas kpɔ suuɡaswɛm aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne anɔ la aa lɔ koodem, ne anɔ la aa le nomonnyuune be, dɛ tomɛ ba kpɔ ka kɛ Asiiria koojen la, kɛ a ta wone chao.
Kooro Ahas wenaale aa baa ɡwaa o nɛɛ bwa habɔɔ la, dɛ o ta teŋɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ kohona.
O kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare Damaskɔs tena baa yoo dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ voɡare ta, dɛkalkɛ o liiro ŋɔ, “Siiria koranar voɡa aa cha ba nomanta, mɛɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahaa tɛa, ásɛ a cha mɛ.” Kɛ anee ɡela o ne Israel tena lɔ harɛ.
Kooro Ahas berɔ pa kwaa aa lɔ Korowii Dea la, dɛ ka paɡra burbur ken.
O laa Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la ɡbeni tɔɔɡe, dɛ kwaa bɔra baa ɛ sarahare a ta dɛɛ tɛ voɡa Jerusalam bobɛlbwa.
O berɔ ɛ bɔr tɛ voɡtoroma Juda harɛ ta bwɛjena ne bwɛɛre ta, dɛ fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ harɛre ane voɡa.
Anɔ ɡelɔ Korowii o naawa aa tomɔ la baah di o nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Wobɛlbwa Kooro Ahas aa ɛa la, ba chwera do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Ahas sewɔ, asɛ ba ka huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta.
Kɛ ba ta on koranar huɡribɔr huɡe, asɛ o bibaa Hɛsɛkea ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ.
O nya sɔne Abija, Sekaria bihaahnee.
O ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea kɛŋɔ o nabaa Kooro Devid ken.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora benanyoa beŋkpoŋ korobiloɡle ta la, o berɔ kwaa pili Korowii Dea ɡbeni, dɛ ɡel ba kwaara.
Asɛ o ɡel sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ba cheme Korowii Dea dembaah wee leebɔr pera, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé Lewi dea tena hé no!
Hé tɔ sie le he te cheɡ tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ he nɛɛ dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ Korowii ya naawa aa tomɔ Dea nɔ ta.
Hé laa komɛlbwa aa ɡela o kah doŋa kpɔ o bini.
Ya naawa waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ.
Ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo o nɛɛ dɛ vɛoh, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoo bela waa lole.
Ba berɔ laa Korowii Dea la ɡbeni tɔɔɡe, dɛ ɡel kandere la dirimi, dɛ vɛh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, kɛɛ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah fueh Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la Dea bini.
Korowii koh a wa, asɛ o baah di Juda ne Jerusalam tena nɛ, asɛ o tɛr ba deŋne nomɛlbwa bwara yɔr dɛɛ ɔmɛ.
Hé ɡbabir jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba kpoo ya naawa laa ta, dɛ lawɛ ya haahna ne bii ɡe laa ta kaa.
Anomanta, men Kooro Hɛsɛkea kpɔ liire kɛŋɔ n ne Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ o baah bɛ ya nɛɛ di kohona.
N bii, he bɛ bɔhwaah dɛɛ ɛ, dɛkalkɛ heyaa Korowii le ŋɔ he che o sie fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tɛo, dɛ́ tɔ nɛra sie baa tomɔ.” Lewi dea tena baa lɔ bela dɛ pa mun dɛɛ ɛ toma laanee teŋa nɔ.
Le Kohat dea tena bini, Amasae bibaa Mahat ne Asaria bibaa Joel.
Le Merari dea tena bini, Abdi bibaa Kes ne Jehalelɛl bibaa Asaria.
Le Gɛsɔn dea tena bini, Sima bibaa Joa ne Joa bibaa Eden.
Le Elisafan naanar bini, Simri ne Jeyɛl.
Le Asaf naanar bini, Sekaria ne Matania.
Le Heman naanar ɡe bini, Jehiel ne Simee.
Le Jedutun naanar bini, Sɛmaya ne Usiel.
Baa yerɛ ba bala Lewi dea tena cheme, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ kpɔ dɛ do ɡoroŋ la, ba kaa jo Korowii Dea la ɡe bini, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ o ta o do ɡoroŋ, ɡɛ kooro la aa do ba ɡɛ Korowii wa aa dɛ baɡle la.
Sɔfore la ɡe jo Korowii Dea la bini, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta kpɔ, o do ɡoroŋ ɡɛ tenten.
Ba pa komɛlbwa aa lɔ o bini dɛ kah doŋa le ba Korowii Dea dembaah bela.
Asɛ Lewi dea tena la chea le bela ka ta Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen bini.
Ba pa ɡɛ waa nɔ mun korobie waa tɔ sie la tɔpeloɡle ta, asɛ tɔpenuatoro wee la, ba tel Korowii Dea pato la ta.
Tɔpera anuatoro ja, dɛ ba tonɛ Korowii Dea la bini tenten toma.
Ba tonɛ toma la bwa, korobie waa tɔ sie, o tɔpera fi dɛ anumɛl la ta.
Korowii Dea kpɔe dɛ́ do Korowii nɔn ta nɛɛtena Ate, Lewi dea tena la la Kooro Hɛsɛkea be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ya laa doŋa kpɔ Korowii Dea la bwa ta o do ɡoroŋ, ne kon baa dɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta ne o loɡa, ne teebur baa kpɔ paanoo aa do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ dawɛ o ta, dɛ o laala aa jaa bwa ta.
Ya berɔ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ kwaa ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Ahas aa di kora, o waa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii, o le a ne kaa la ba.
A cheɡɛ saraha kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la sie bela taraken.” Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Kooro Hɛsɛkea yerɛ Jerusalam nomonome bwa cheme, asɛ ba la Korowii Dea bela.
Ba kpɔ nabala anuanɛ ne pebala anuanɛ, ne pebiiri anuanɛ dɛ bombala anuanɛ, dɛ ka ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha tɛ harɛ la nɛra bwa, ne Korowii Dea la, dɛ Juda harɛ nɛra ɡe bwa.
Kooro do Arɔn naanar baa ɛ sɔfore la ŋɔ, bá kpoo kwaa la kon baa kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta.
Asɛ sɔfore la tɔ sie kpoo nabala, dɛ kpoo pebala ne pebiiri la, dɛ kpɔ a chal merɛ kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta.
Ba kpɔ boohna baa kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha la ba kooro ne nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa sie, asɛ ba kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ a nɛ.
Asɛ sɔfore la kpoo boohna la, dɛ ɛ a chal ba merɛ kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la ta, dɛ kpɔ soŋe Israel tena bwa wechɔɡa Korowii be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ kooro laanee do ba ŋɔ bá fuh kwaa ɛ saraha ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare la tɛ Israel tena bwa.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɡelɔ Lewi dea tena la do Korowii Dea bela, dɛ kpoŋe kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, ɡɛ Kooro Devid ne Gad waa dɛ na chaahna, dɛ Korowii keame Netan aa baɡla la.
Korowiirii cheɡɛ o keamere nɛɛ dɛ do ba.
Anomanta, dɛ Lewi dea tena iro che, dɛ kpoŋe Kooro Devid kwaa waa dɛ hɛlɛ ane la, asɛ sɔfore la ɡe kpoŋe ba bɛle.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ ba kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah la ba kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la ta.
Saraha ɛɛ la aa pa mun la, ba pa mun ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, asɛ bɛle ne kwaa Israel Kooro Devid aa kpɔa dɛɛ lɔ yela ɡe ja.
Nɛra baa cheme bela bwa pɛo dɛ ɡuŋi harɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, asɛ yelɡoola ɛɛ ɡo yela bɛlhoohla ɡee hoh ba bɛle.
Gɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛo ka tel kɛŋɔ baa fuh saraha kwaa la tonɛ.
Baa tonɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah tonɛ la, kooro ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la ɡuŋo, dɛ tomɛ Korowii.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne o nomonome ŋɔ Lewi dea tena be ŋɔ, bá kpɔ yela Kooro Devid ne o keame Asaf waa dɛ na chaahna aa chwera la kpɛɛ Korowii.
Anomanta, ba ɡo kpɛɛra yela silɛɛ ne, dɛ ɡuŋi tomɛ Korowii.
Anee Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Taraken te, he bwa kpɔ he te do Korowii nɔn ta, doŋa bɛlbwa toole he nɛɛ kpa.
Hé kpo kwaa ɛ sarahare, dɛ́ kpɔ jam kwaa ba Korowii Dea.” Anomanta, ba ba sarahare ne jam sarahare ne, asɛ bane le ba bambile bini, dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah ba.
Ba kpɔ nabala fifraanuanɛ ne pebala lafa, dɛ pebiiri lafraanɛ ba fuh ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii.
Kwaa baa kpoora ɛ sarahare la lɔ nabala lafraanumɛl, dɛ peera ne boohna kaɡboŋa atoro.
Dɛ sɔfore la ta warɛ, dɛ́ won swe ola baa kpoora dɛ́ fuah ɛ saraha la, anomanta, ba bala Lewi dea tena la cha ba dɛ swea tonɛ.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ sɔfore baa dɔ bɔr dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ warɔ.
Dɛ Lewi dea tena la waa dɔ kasinteŋ doŋa laa dɛ kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɡwaa sɔfore la kwara.
Dɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah la warɔ, dɛ ja ola noorare baa fuah ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, ne sen sarahare la ta.
Gɛɛ a do ba berɛ kwaa pa mun, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii Dea la bini.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne nɛra la bwa sie lɛo, Korowii chae waa cha ba ba ɛ a ɡɛ waa la bwa warane la.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea Galekaa Tɔpejen dii Kooro Hɛsɛkea tomɛ nɛra Israel ne Juda harɛ ta, dɛ chwerɛ tɔn ta nɔn yerɛ Efrem ne Manasɛ deene tena ŋɔ, bá cheme Korowii Dea Jerusalam, dɛ́ di Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Galekaa Tɔpejen la.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne o nomonome, dɛ nɛra baa cheme Jerusalam la bwa sɛoh kɛŋɔ bá di Galekaa Tɔpejen la, korobinɛɛte ta.
Dɛ baa di tɔpejen la o saŋ ta biɡro, dɛkalkɛ dɛ sɔfore ta warɛ dɛ́ won laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ bá do ɡoroŋ, asɛ dɛ nɛra la ɡe bwa aa won Jerusalam cheme.
Dɛ waa nɔ maɡrɔ tɛ kooro ne nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa.
Anomanta, ba yerɛ Israel harɛ nɛra le Dan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ka le Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr ŋɔ, bá ba cheme Jerusalam dɛ́ di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la sɔn ta.
Dɛ nɛra ta warɛ dɛ ba di tɔpejen la, ɡɛ baa chwerɛ o waa do tɔn bini la bwa.
Kooro la ɡelɔ toroma kpɔ tɔne la kaa Israel ne Juda harɛre bwa ta kɛŋɔ, “Israel tena, he le Asiiria tena laa baa yo heyaa la nyoa.
Hé berɛ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tomɔ la, ásɛ o ɡe lawɛ heyaa ba o be.
He bɛ do kɛ he naawa ne he bala Israel tena ba waa fa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la, asɛ o tɛr ba deŋne kohona ɡa he siwi ta la.
He bɛ lwɛmkpeɡ ɛ kɛ ban, dɛ́ kpɔ he te do Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la lɔɡa.
Hé ba o Dea waa ɡela o do ɡoroŋ saŋ bɛlbwa la bini Jerusalam, dɛɛ tomɔ ásɛ o bandia le he nɛ.
Dɛ he berɔ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii aa, aa ɡeloo nɛra baa lawɛ he lolanar laa ta kaa la dɔ tedoma tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ ba berɛ ba ya harɛ nɔ ta.
Dɛkalkɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔ tedoma dɛɛ na nɛn sum.
Hé ba o be naa, waa habɔɔ berɛ kpo heya.” Toroma la le bela, dɛ la bwɛjen bɛlbwa ta Efrem ne Manasɛ deene harɛre ta, dɛ ka le Sebulon dea harɛ ɡe ta bwa, kɛ nɛra la mam ba dɛɛ muɡli ba baah.
Kɛ dɛ ba bini bane le Aasa ne Manasɛ, dɛ Sebulon deene ta, dɛ sɛh kɛŋɔ baa ba Jerusalamee.
Gɛɛ Korowii ɛ, dɛ ja Juda tena nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba dɔ nyopɛo, dɛ teŋɛ waa kooro ne o nomonome aa do ba la ta, ɡɛ waa bola la.
Galekaa Tɔpejen dii Korobinɛɛte ta la, nɛra warɔ dɛ ba cheme Jerusalam, dɛ di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta Tɔpejen.
Ba le kwaa harɛre ane nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa aa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta ne Jerusalam, dɛ chɔɡ anɔ la baa dɛ fuh daawiile a ta, dɛ pa a bwa ka ta Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen bini.
Korobinɛɛte tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta la, ba kpo Galekaa Tɔpejen pebie la.
Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ do ɡoroŋ, dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah la ba Korowii Dea.
Ate, bɛlbwa ka che o chebɔr, ɡɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis Mmarare aa dɛ baɡle la.
Asɛ Lewi dea tena la kpɔ kwaa baa kpoora ɛ saraha chale la tɛ sɔfore la, asɛ ba ɛ merɛ saraha kon la ta.
Nɛra la ɡalɡa aa wola doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ laa kpɔ dɛ do ɡoroŋ nomanta, Lewi dea tena laanee kpoo Galekaa Tɔpejen pebiiri la ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii tɛɛ ba.
Nɛra ɡalɡa ba ɡe aa le Efrem ne Manasɛ ne Isaaka, dɛ Sebulon deene dɛ ba la, dɛ ba ta doŋa bɛlbwa laa kpɔ ba nɛ dɛ do ɡoroŋ, anomanta, dɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa nee baa di Galekaa Tɔpejen la.
Asɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii ya naawa aa tomɛ, che he wer haa doa ta dɛ́ kpɔ kɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ bambile bwa ne nɔ, a lole kɛŋɔ ba ta doŋa laa kpɔ ba nɛ.” Asɛ Korowii no Kooro Hɛsɛkea wesoŋa la, o kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, o ta ban wobɛlbwa ɛɛ.
Israel tena aa baa cheme Jerusalam la, ba di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta Tɔpejen la silɛɛ kohona ne, tɔpera anuanɛ.
Asɛ Lewi dea tena ne sɔfore ɡe kpɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ lɔ yela, dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii kohona tɔpere bɛlbwa, bokpeɡa bwa ne.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea jam Lewi dea tena wejema ne kpɛɛra baa dɔa, dɛ kpɔ cha tɔpejen la dii la.
Tɔpera anuanɛ bwa la, ba tɛɛ ba saraha kwaa aa ɛ ba dibɔra la ba di, dɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la.
Nɛra la bwa sɛoh kɛŋɔ ba berɛ di tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ ja.
Anomanta, ba berɔ di tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ silɛɛ ne ja.
Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea tɛ nɛra baa cheme bela nabala kaɡboŋ, dɛ boohna ne peera kaɡboŋa anuanɛ, asɛ o nomonome la ɡe tɛɛ ba nabala kaɡboŋ, dɛ boohna ne peera kaɡboŋa fi.
Asɛ sɔfore baa wara laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛ, ba do ɡoroŋ.
Anomanta, Juda tena baa cheme bela sie lɛo kohona, ba ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ Israel tena baa ba bela bwa, ne hɔɔhra baa le Israel ne Juda harɛre ta bwa.
Silɛɛ kohona ba Jerusalam, dɛkalkɛ, le Kooro Devid bibaa Kooro Solomɔn aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bwa, a ɡɛ waa nɔ dɔŋa ta chiɡe bwa.
Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la iro, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ nɛra la, asɛ Korowii no ba wesoŋa le nyundua dɛ ɛ tɛɛ ba.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea mmarafala dɔe wa Baa di tɔpejen la tonɛ la, Israel tena baa lɔ bela la jo Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta, dɛ paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura, dɛ teŋni voɡ Asera dajaŋa ta.
Ba chɔɡ bɔra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡare deŋɡarere ta, ne kwaa baa dɛ ɛ sarahare a ta, Juda harɛ ne Bɛnjamen ne Efrem, dɛ Manasɛ harɛre deene ta bwa.
Baa chɔɡ a bwa tonɛ la, asɛ ba bwa berɛ kaa ba bwɛɛre.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea bɔne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la bini, ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa ɛɛ ɛ o toma.
Asɛ ba fuh kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛro o Dea doonyoo la ta.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea lawɛ o ɡbaɡba nae ne boohna ne peera tɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ɛ sarahare baa dɛ fuah chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra, ne Ona Tɔpera ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, dɛ tɔpejena ane baa lea cheɡ ta, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Mmara tɔn bini la.
Kooro berɔ ŋɔ Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, bá kpɔ saraha kwaa aa chɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, ɡɛ aa ɛ, ásɛ ba won kpɔ ba te tɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ Korowii Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle.
Baa no waa kooro aa bola la, Israel tena la le ba bambile ta, dɛ kpɔ ba kooni kondikonloɡla kɛŋɔ mea ne senfala, ne ɔleve noo ne tooh dɛ kondikwa bɛlbwa baa dɔa dɛ le kooni ta, ba tɛ Korowii toma.
Kwaa baa ba a ne warɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Nomɛlbwa bɔne komɛlbwa waa dɔa bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ba.
Israel ne Juda baala baa soɡe Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta ɡe bɔne ba nae ne boohna dɛ peera bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋa ba.
Gɛɛ ba kpɔ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii ba, dɛ bila a daŋɛ chɔ.
Ba pa mun le korobitooro te ta ba koŋkɛɛla la ne, dɛ ba tel korobinuanɛ te ta.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne o nomonome aa baa na ɡɛ koŋkɛɛla la aa daŋa chɔ la, ba kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ o nɛra Israel tena.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea pɛɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la koŋkɛɛla nɔ wa, asɛ Sɔfonomoa Asaria waa ɛ Sadɔk lole la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ le saŋ nɛra la aa pa mun kpɔ koŋkɛɛla dɛɛ ba Korowii Dea bonɔ la, ya dɔɔ dɛɛ di, ásɛ ane ka chɔ warɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii swee o nɛra andɛɛɡa, asɛ andamanta nɔ ta ka dɛ daŋɛ chɔ la.” Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɡel ba kwaa deene baa dɛɛ cheɡ laala a bini Korowii Dea bɔr bela.
Asɛ ba pa koŋkɛɛla la ne kwaa baa bɔne a bini fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋa ba, dɛ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii la cheɡ bela.
Ba kpɔ Lewi dea te bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Konania ɛ nomoa ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi a ta, asɛ o nime Simee ja o nɛ.
Ba le Lewi dea tena nɛra fi ŋɔ bá do Konania ne o nime Simee lɔɡa dɛɛ ɛ toma bela.
Banee, Jehiel ne Asasia ne Nahat, ne Asahɛl ne Jerimot ne Josabad ne Eliel, ne Ismakia ne Mahat dɛ Bɛnaya.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Sɔfonomoa Asaria kpeɡri taa a che, ba lee ba.
Lewi dea te Imna bibaa Koree ba le wɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ chɔ sarahare koŋkɛɛla aa le nɛra bambile ta ba kpɔ baa tɛ Korowii ne a bɔna nyoa.
Dɛ Kore dɔ o bala Lewi dea tena baa chao bwɛɛre ane sɔfore aa soɡe a ta.
Banee, Eden ne Miniamin ne Jesua ne Sɛmaya ne Amaria dɛ Sɛkania.
Ba ɡe dɛ lɛ koŋkɛɛla la dɛ bɔna kasinteŋ ne tɛ Lewi dea tena baa lɔ bela ɡɛ bɛlbwa toma aa doa, bechala kɛɛ nomoa toole.
Ba berɔ dɛɛ tɛ bibaala baa di bene atoro, kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa ba chwerɛ ba sɔna teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ la.
Gɛ ba bini bɛlbwa waa jo Korowii Dea bela, ka ɛ toma baa kpɔa do o nɔn ta tɔpere bɛlbwa la aa doa.
Ba bɔne tomare tɛ sɔfore la ɡɛ baa chwerɛ ba sɔna teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ lolanar ta, dɛ tɛ Lewi dea tena ɡe baa di bene fifraanɛ kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa, ɡɛ bɛlbwa toma ne dea waa le o ta aa doa.
Bane ba haahna ne ba bechale, dɛ nɛra ba ne baa soɡa sɔnaa ba chwerɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ ɛ toma baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii.
Kɛ sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar dɛ so harɛre baa dɛ parɛ a ta, dɛ so ba bwɛɛre ta kɛɛ bobɛlbwa la te, ba le baala ba bɔne kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛ baala baa le sɔfore dea, ne nomɛlbwa baa chwerɛ o sɔn o le Lewi dea la bwa.
Gɛɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɛ Juda harɛ ta bwa, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la be.
Wobɛlbwa Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɛa Korowii Dea Jerusalam, ne ɡɛ waa teŋɛ Korowii Mmarare, ne waa waa doo a ta bambile bwa ne la ɡelɔ o wobɛlbwa chiɡu kɛrɛdɛ.
Asiiria Koojen Senakerib kaa yo Juda tena Waa Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɛa kasinteŋ ne la bwa habɔɔ, Asiiria koojen Senakerib kpɔ o laa tena ba lɔ tɔ Juda harɛ nɛra nɛ.
O ɡelɔ o laa tena chɔ bar bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara bwa, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ won yoo ba dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa naa kɛŋɔ Koojen Senakerib balɔ dɛɛ nyin ó ba yo Jerusalam tena la, o ne o nomonome ne o laa nomonome chemo, dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛŋɔ bá tɔɔɡe neerare nyuune aa lɔ Jerusalam dahare, asɛ ba sɛh dɛ chao.
Belaa nɛra warɛ dɛ cheme, dɛ tɔɔɡe neerare nyuune bwa, ne nee waa pala dɛ kpɔ harɛ la ta bwa dɛ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ Asiiria koranar ba ya be dɛ́ ba na nee nyɔ aa?” Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɛ toma taeh, dɛ ɡel ba kwaa ma danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la bobɛla aa kuuɡa la, dɛ ma dejaŋa chɔŋɛ danjwɛɛ la ta.
O berɔ ɡel ba ma danjwɛfale bɛl bar ombene la, dɛ che bwea su harɛ waa ɛ bɔɔ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta.
O berɔ ɛ dɔmkwaa ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta warɛ.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea le laa sitɔɔla ba chɔ baala baa lɔ Jerusalam nyoo, dɛ ɡel ba ba cheme o sie bela bwɛɛla bwa yon dɛɛ cheme bwɛjen la doonyojen ta, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé che kiŋkiŋ, hé dɔ bambile.
He bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr Asiiria koojen ne o laa tena baa wara kohona nɔ wa.
Kpeɡri waa ja ya nɛɛ la ɡwaa kpeɡri waa ja ba nɛ.
Nɛwɛnyini kpeɡrii ba dɔ, kɛ ya te, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɛ́ cha yaa, dɛ́ yo tɛ yaa.” Ate, nɛra la dɔ hwɛɡa dɛ le waa Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa bola la ta.
A habɔɔ la, Asiiria koojen Senakerib ne o laa tena baa chɔ bar bwɛjen Lakes, anomanta, o tomɛ o nomonome Jerusalam ba kpɔ kala ka tɛ Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne o nɛra baa lɔ bela ŋɔ, “Men Asiiria koojen Senakerib, n dɛ bɔɔ he Jerusalam tena waa haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta dɛ ta so bela n laa tena tɔ heyaa do la.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, ‘Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ lɛ heyaa le n nɔn taa,’ yaa, neɡraa wɛɛ neɡre heya, ásɛ nyɔɡre ne lɔr kpo heyaa he serewe.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea laa paɡre kwaa baa ɛ saraha a ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii ne bela baa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ ŋɔ Juda ne Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, báa tomɛ dɛɛ fuh daawiile saraha kombeŋkpoŋ ɡbo ta la aa?
Hé ta ɡɛ n ne n naawa aa kpɔa ɛ harɛre nɛra noɛ kɛɛ?
Gɛ harɛre la voɡare wono lɛ a nɛra le n nɔn ta naa?
Harɛre nɔ voɡ besoo n naawa aa chɔɡa wona lɛ a nɛra le n be nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ voɡ haa dɛ tomɔ ɛɛ ba wona lɛ heyaa le n nɔn ta nɔ?
He bɛ ɡel Kooro Hɛsɛkea lɔ nepor ta he sie ta, dɛɛ neɡre heyaa ɡɛ.
Harɛ bɛlbwa voɡ ta wone lɛ o harɛ le Asiiria koojen bɛlbwa nɔn ta bwa.
He voɡ haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ laa dɛ́ won lɛ heya!” Gɛɛ Asiiria koojen Senakerib nomonome teŋɛ bol waa yaɡɛ Korowii ne o bonɔɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea kohona.
Koojen Senakerib chwerɛ tɔne dɛ chɛɡre Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Gɛ harɛre ane voɡare aa wola wone lɛ a nɛra n be la, ɡɛɛ voɡ Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa dɛ tomɔ la aa wola won lɛ o nɛra.” Ate, nomonome la kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ bol waa waa bola la Hibru tena wobol ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ nɛra baa cheɡɛ Jerusalam danjwɛɛ ta ɔmɛ, ásɛ o dɔ bɔr ba lawɛ bwɛjen la tena.
Ba bol waa yaɡɛ Korowii Jerusalam tena aa dɛ tomɔ, ɡɛ tenten baa bol harɛre ane voɡare nɛwɛnyini aa kpɔ nɔn ɛa la.
Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya wi no Korowii ŋɔ ó cha ba.
Asɛ Korowii tomɛ nyundua torome bɛl o ba kpoo Asiiria laa tena ne ba laa sitɔɔla, dɛ nomonome baa lɔ bela baa soɡa bwa.
Anomanta, Koojen Senakerib kpɔ sihiih berɛ ba kaa Asiiria harɛ ta.
Waa laŋa la, o kaa jo o voɡ dea, asɛ o bibaala bane ka kpoo keri ne.
Gɛɛ a do Korowii lɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Jerusalam tena le Asiiria koojen Senakerib, ne ba dɔma baa kaa bwa nɔn ta.
O ɡelɔ ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna le harɛre aa bar ba nɛra nɛ.
Nɛra warɔ kpɔ saraha kwaa ba tɛ Korowii Jerusalam pirim, ne koŋkɛɛla a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ba tɛ Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea.
Le bela dɛɛ kaa la, harɛre nɛra bwa kpɔ jirima tɛo kohona.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea weela ne o mbarafo ɛɛ Aa ba dɛ la sie la, weela lɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea wɛɛ ba sewa.
Asɛ o soŋe Korowii a wa ŋɔ, ó ɡel o na waane kɛŋɔ waa sewɛ.
Kɛ mbarafo nomanta, o siwi ta waa Korowii aa ɛa tɛo la sui, anomanta, Korowii baah di o ne Juda ne Jerusalam tena nɛ.
Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Jerusalam tena charɛ ba liire le mbarafo we-ɛɛla la ta, anomanta, Korowii bandia ta ba nɛɛ balɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea bere saŋ waa di kora.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea dɔ kondɔɔh ne jirima taeh, asɛ dɛ ma deene dɛɛ cheɡ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, ne bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ne konsɔɔhsoma, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta, dɛ kondɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi a bini.
O berɔ ma dea waa dɛ cheɡ mea ne senfala, dɛ ɔleve no.
Dɛ do naleɡa ne peera leɡa tɛ o nae ne peera.
A habɔɔ la, Korowii ɡelɔ o dɔ suuɡa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ dɔ nae ne peera taeh, asɛ dɛ vɔrɔwe bwɛɛre ɡe.
Gɛ saŋ Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora la, onee ɡela ba kwi bɔɔ le Gehɔn bule ta, asɛ nee kpɔ o bini palɛ dɛɛ ba Jerusalam.
Kasinteŋ, wobɛlbwa Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɛa la, a chiɡu kɛrɛdɛ.
A balɔ kɛŋɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta nomonome tomɛ nɛra Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ, bá ba pɛɛro ŋwɛnɛ waa cheɡɛ o ta, dɛ ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla la o harɛ la ta.
Asɛ Korowii le o habɔɔ, dɛ daahno na kɛ wɛɛ di kasinteŋii kɛɛ.
Waane ɡe Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɛa o kora dii saŋ, ne ɡɛ waa kpɔ o te tɛ Korowii la bwa, ba chwera do Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya waa waa naa chaahna ta do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔn bini.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ ba huɡo deŋɡare bɛl ta, bela baa dɛ huɡe Kooro Devid naanar.
Juda ne Jerusalam tena bwa kpɔ duure tɛo o serewe wee.
Asɛ o bibaa Manasɛ ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Kooro Manasɛ di kora Juda harɛ Kooro Manasɛ aa baa di kora Juda harɛ ta la, dɛ o di bene fi dɛ anɛ.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanue dɛ anue.
O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛ teŋɛ harɛre nɛra baa tɔ sie ba so bela, Korowii aa doŋ ba le ba harɛre ta tɛ Israel tena we-ɛɛla baa ɛa Korowii kia la ta.
Kooro Manasɛ kwaarɔ cheɡ voɡa o mɛɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa paɡra bela voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ la, dɛ berɛ ɛ kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta tɛ voɡ Baal waa ɛ baa, dɛ paaɡe voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa, ɡɛ Israel Kooro Ahab fa aa ɛa la.
O berɔ tomɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie, dɛ weweela bwa.
O ɛ kwaa voɡtoroma aa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta Korowii Dea, bela Korowii aa ŋɔa belaa a chɛ kɛ baa tomɔ saŋ bɛlbwa la.
Korowii Dea dembaahna anɛ la bini la, o ɛ kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta, baa tomɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie, dɛ weweela.
O kpoo o bibaala, dɛ fuuh ba ɛ saraha Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen bini.
O ɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla, dɛ voɡɛ dɛ yerɛ lala, dɛ la tɛɡre tena be.
O ɛ wechɔɡa taeh, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ dɛ ir o bandia kohona.
Kooro Manasɛ sɛh voɡ dɛ kpɔ ka cheɡ Korowii Dea, bela Korowii aa ŋɔ Kooro Devid ne o bibaa Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Dea nɔ ne Jerusalamee n le cheɡ, dɛ le Israel deene bwa bini kɛŋɔ baa tom mɛ o bini saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la la.
Dɛ Israel tena ɛɛ teŋɛ waa maa do ba a ta, ne mmarare la bwa n fa aa cheɡɛ n bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba la ta tenaa, maa ɡel ba doŋ ba le harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ ba naawa la ta.” Kooro Manasɛ ɡelɔ Juda harɛ ta nɛra nyoɡre, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa ɡwaa harɛre nɛra Korowii fa aa doŋ ba le o nɛra Israel tena sie la.
Korowii kah Kooro Manasɛ ne o nɛra, kɛ ba vɛh o be noe.
Anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ Asiiria koojen laa sitɔɔla ne ba laa tena lɔ ba tɔ Juda harɛ tena nɛɛ dɛ yoo ba.
Ba lawɛ Kooro Manasɛ, dɛ do ɡoŋa o mee ta, dɛ vɔrɔwo ayaawa jɔɡrɔre ne, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
O bwara aa ba dɛ nyɛɡo la, o soŋe Korowii o naawa aa tomɔ la, dɛ pwɛr o te tɛo.
Korowii no o wesoŋa, a che a ta o ɡel ba berɛ kpɔɔ ba Jerusalam o ba di kora ja.
Anɔɔ ɡela Kooro Manasɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛ kasinteŋ Korowii.
A habɔɔ la, Kooro Manasɛ ɡelɔ ba kwaa ma danjwɛɛ waa lɔ Jerusalam, waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen habɔɔ la, dɛ le Gehɔn bule waa lɔ felembɔjen bini wee cholibɔr, dɛ kaa Pɛŋe Doonyoa waa bar Ofel deŋɡare bɔr.
O ɡelɔ ba mao o do jaŋne kohona, asɛ o kpɔ laa sitɔɔla ka so Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara bwa ta.
O berɔ le harɛre ane voɡa, ne voɡ waa sɛah ka cheɡ Korowii Dea, ne kwaa waa ɛa ba kpoo kwaa a ta ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ voɡare, a do Korowii Dea deŋɡare doa Jerusalam la bwa ne, dɛ paa le bwɛjen la bini ka ta.
O berɔ ɡel ba kwaa ma kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la, asɛ o kpoo kwaa ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ne jam sarahare o ta.
O ŋɔ Juda harɛ nɛra be ŋɔ, bá tomɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la.
A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ bela voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa laanee nɛra la kaa ɛ sarahare, kɛ dɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la ɡboo ba yon ɛ dɛɛ tɛ.
Kooro Manasɛ waa waa ɛa bwa, ne soŋa waa soŋe Korowii o naawa aa tomɔ, ne waa Korowii keamere aa bol o be Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne Bini.
Gɛ waa soŋe Korowii asɛ o no o be, ne o wechɔɡa waa ɛa mɔɔ dɛ charɛ o liire, ne bɔra waa ɛa tɛ voɡtoroma baa tomɛ voɡare, ne voɡ Asera dajaŋa waa paaɡa, dɛ voɡa waa toma la, ba chwera do Korowii Keamere Waa Tɔne bini.
Kooro Manasɛ sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ ba huɡo o koodem.
Asɛ o bibaa Amɔn chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Amɔn wa Kooro Amɔn aa di kora la, dɛ o di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene anɛ.
Kooro Amɔn ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Manasɛ aa ɛa la, dɛ tomɛ voɡa o mɛɛ fa aa toma la, dɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛa.
Kooro Amɔn ta o te pwɛrɛ tɛ Korowii kɛ o mɛɛ, dɛ o wechɔɡa ɡwaa o mɛɛ kwaa kohona.
Kooro Amɔn nomonome la bini bane vɔrɔwe o vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo o koodem.
Asɛ Juda harɛ nɛra kpoo nɛra baa vɔrɔwe Kooro Amɔn vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo la.
Dɛ kpɔ o bibaa Josia chiɡ o naa ta, o di kora.
Kooro Josia di kora Juda harɛ Josia aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene anuatoro.
O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
O ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, o teŋɛ waa o nabaa Kooro Devid aa ɛa ta.
O teŋɛ Korowii waa ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Kooro Josia aa di kora bene anuatoro la, dɛ o ta ɛ bonɔmbi, asɛ o pa mun dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii o nabaa Kooro Devid aa tomɔ la.
Bene fi dɛ anɛ ta la, o pa mun dɛɛ chɔɡ bela Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam tena aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa, ne voɡ Asera dajaŋa ne voɡare baa sɛah ne anɔ la bwa aa jaa.
Kooro Josia ɡelɔ ba chɔɡ voɡ Baalre kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛ paɡre kwaa baa dɛ fuh daawiile a ta a bɛna la, dɛ kuuɡi Asera voɡare ne voɡare bwa soo siwi burbur ken, dɛ paa ka ta nɛra baa ɛ sarahare a ta mɔɔ dɛ serewe la ŋwama ta.
O ɡelɔ ba fuh kerekpoŋra baa soɡe voɡa ta hoɡa kwaa baa ɛ sarahare a ta la doa.
Gɛɛ o ɛ dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ le voɡa toma ne, Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam.
Gɛ tentenee o ɛ Manasɛ ne Efrem ne Simeon, dɛ Naftale deene harɛ bwɛjena aa paɡra bwa ta.
Kooro Josia ɡelɔ ba paɡre kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta, dɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ voɡare la, dɛ chɔɡ voɡ Asera dajaŋa Israel harɛ ta bobɛlbwa.
O paɡre voɡare la mohooh ken, dɛ paɡre kwaa baa fuh konsɔɔhsoma a ta dɛɛ tɛ voɡare la ɡe, dɛ berɛ laa berɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Kooro Josia aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuatoro ta, dɛɛ nyin o laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ harɛ la ne Korowii Dea la, o tomɛ Asalia bibaa Safan, ne harɛ nomoa Maaseya waa lɔ Jerusalam, dɛ Joahas bibaa Joa waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ do tɔn bini ŋɔ, bá la ka kwaa Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la Dea.
Ba la Sɔfonomoa Hilkia be, dɛ kpɔ suuɡa Lewi dea tena baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo aa lɛa le Manasɛ ne Efrem deene tena, ne Israel tena baa kaa la be, ne Juda harɛ nɛra bwa, ne Bɛnjamen dea tena, dɛ nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam tena be la ba tɛo.
Asɛ ba kpɔ do nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea kwaara ta la nɔn ta, ásɛ ba kpɔ bɔ tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ kwaa Korowii Dea la kem.
Ba berɔ tɛ kapenta tena ne demamaala suuɡa ŋɔ bá kpɔ yawɛ daa ne bwea, dɛ́ kwaa deene Juda koranar aa ɡela a chɔɡ la.
Tom-ɛɛra la ɛ toma kasinteŋ ne.
Baala baa lee ba baa nyiŋi ba nɛɛ laanee, Lewi dea tena Jahat ne Obadia dɛ le Merari dea, ne Sekaria dɛ Mɛsolam ba ɡe aa ɛ Lewi dea tena dɛ le Kohat dea.
Dɛ ba bwa dɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛ hɛlɛ wejema, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ hɛlɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Lewi dea tena bane ɡe chɔ tom-ɛɛra nyoa, dɛɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra bwa soo siwi nɛ, ba tomare ta.
Ba bini bane chwerɛ waa dɛɛ do tɔne bini, bane ɡe chwerɛ webena aa chiɡa dɛɛ bil, bane ɡe ɛɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoone.
Ba na Korowii Mmara Tɔn la Baa laa suuɡa la dɛɛ kpɔ Korowii Dea bela baa cheɡa la, sɔfo Hilkia na Korowii Mmara Tɔn waa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ, o nyoɡre la.
Asɛ sɔfo Hilkia ŋɔ karake Safan waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil la be ŋɔ, “N na Korowii Mmara Tɔn waa nyoɡra la Korowii Dea.” Asɛ o kpɔ tɔn la tɛ Safan.
Ate, Safan kpɔ tɔn la la Kooro Josia be dɛ ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he nomonome ɛ wobɛlbwa haa kpɔa do ba nɔn ta kɛrɛdɛ.” Ba kpɔ suuɡa aa lɔ Korowii Dea la do nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra la nɛɛ, ne tom-ɛɛra la nɔn ta.
Ate, Safan waa ɛ karake dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil la, berɛ ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa, sɔfo Hilkia kpɔ tɔn bɛl tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ o che kooro sie bela kure tɔn la bini waa baɡlo.
Kooro Josia aa no Mmara Tɔn la bini waa la, o laa o batakaare kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ o dɛ di suna.
Buɡ la ta, kooro do sɔfo Hilkia ne Safan bibaa Ahikam, ne Maeka bibaa Abdɔn dɛ Safan waa ɛ karake, dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, dɛ o bonɔɔ Asaya be ŋɔ, “Hé la ka bɔɔ le Korowii be tɛ n ne nɛra baa ka Israel ne Juda, tɔn nɔ baa ɡaaɡa dɛ ka nao nɔ wa.
Korowii baah di n ne Juda harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛɛ taeh, dɛkalkɛ ya naawa ta waa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔ ta teŋɛ.” Anee sɔfo Hilkia ne Ahikam ne Akbɔ ne Safan, dɛ Asaya la Korowii keame bɛl waa ɛ haah baa yerɔ Hulda be, dɛ ka bɔɔ le o be.
Dɛ Korowii keame Hulda soɡe Jerusalam bampera bofale.
O jaaree Tikva bibaa Salum, asɛ o nabaa sɔne Haahas.
Onee dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea batakaarere ta.
Korowii keame Hulda ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Hé la ka ŋɔ Kooro Josia waa tomɛ heyaa la be ŋɔ, Korowii ŋɔ o dɛ ba Jerusalam nɛra deŋne tɛra, ɡɛ waa baa chwera do Juda kooro tɔn bini aa dɛ baɡle la, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛɛh mɛ dɛ ka fuh konsɔɔhsoma voɡa ta, dɛɛ muɡli n baah voɡa ba ɡbaɡba aa ɛa ne.
N baah ɛɛ di ba nɛɛ bonɔ kohonaa, aa wola sɔɔh bwa.
Hé ŋɔ Juda kooro waa tomɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé ka bɔɔ le Korowii be la be ŋɔ waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa bola, waa waa noa dɛ le tɔn la bini laanee nɔ.
Haa kure tɔn la dɛ no Jerusalam nɛra deŋnetɛra, he loo ku he kɛɛ he batakaare haa doa, dɛ ba he te ne harɛ dɛɛ wi nomanta, n no he wii haa wia la bwa.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo he sewɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ta ka pu he naawa.
Haa deŋnetɛra kohona men Korowii aa dɛ ba a ne bala ba ta nɛra baa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta laanee na.” Asɛ toroma la ka ŋɔ waa la Kooro Josia be.
Asɛ Kooro Josia yerɛ Juda ne Jerusalam nomonome bwa cheme.
O ne Juda baala ne Jerusalam tena, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, le bechale nɛɛ ba kaa nomonjena bwa nɛɛ ba Korowii Dea.
Asɛ kooro kure Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Tɔn waa nyoɡra ba nao Korowii Dea la, asɛ ba bwa no.
Kooro Josia cheɡɛ o koochebɔr pila bɛl jwɛh, o ne Korowii berɛ kwaa fɔwɛ fɔo ŋɔ wɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ waa waa bola ne o Mmarare ta o bambile ne o liire bwa ne.
Asɛ o ɡel Jerusalam ne Bɛnjamen dea tena bwa baa lɔ bela ŋwɛɛ ntam ŋɔ, baa dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la fɔo la taa.
Kooro Josia ɡelɔ ba le voɡa Korowii aa kia bwa ne Israel harɛ bwa ta, asɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra baa soɡe bela bwa tomɛ Korowii.
Waa soɡe le la, o ta ɡelɛ ba vɛh Korowii ba naawa fa aa tomɔ la toma bwa.
Kooro Josia Galekaa Tɔpejen dii Kooro Josia di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Jerusalam Korowii sɔn ta, dɛ kpo pebie waa kpɔa di tɔpejen la korobiloɡle tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta.
O kpɔ tomare sɔfore la aa ɛ do ba nɔn ta, dɛ do ba ɡbemba ŋɔ bɛlbwa ɛ o toma kɛrɛdɛ Korowii Dea bela.
O ŋɔ Lewi dea tena baa laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ, dɛ le ba te cheɡ tɛ Korowii dɛɛ ɛ toma o Dea, dɛɛ baɡle nɛra o Mmarare la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ Korowii Fɔo Daka waa do ɡoroŋ la ka cheɡ Korowii Dea Kooro Devid bibaa Kooro Solomɔn aa doo la bini.
He bɛ che dɛɛ ɡaaɡe kpa, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ne o nɛra Israel tena.
Hé ka che he chebɔra Korowii Dea la bini denaa ta, ɡɛ Israel Kooro Devid ne o bibaa Kooro Solomɔn aa bɔne tomare tɛ heya, Korowii Dea bela la.
Hé bɔne he bini, dɛ́ che Dea la bini, ásɛ dɛ won dɛɛ cha lolanar bɛlbwa baa lɔ bela Israel tena la bini.
Hé kpoo Galekaa Tɔpejen pebiiri la, dɛ́ sɔ he doŋa ta, dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ Korowii be pera, ásɛ dɛ kwaa saraha kwaa la tɛ he bala la, ásɛ ba won dɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ bol la ta.” Kooro Josia lawɛ peera ne boohna kaɡboŋa fifraatoro, dɛ nae kaɡboŋa atoro tɛ nɛmpɛɛne la ŋɔ bá kpɔ ɛ Galekaa sarahare.
Kooro nomonome ɡe le ba bambile ta kpɔ kwaa tɛ nɛra la ne sɔfore dɛ Lewi dea tena.
Asɛ Sɔfonomoa Hilkia ne Sekaria dɛ Jehiel baa ɛ nomonome, dɛɛ nyiŋi toma aa lɔ Korowii Dea la ɡe le ba bambile ta, dɛ tɛ nɛra la pebiiri ne boohna kaɡboŋa anɛ lafraanumɛl, dɛ nabala lafraatoro ŋɔ bá kpɔ ɛ sarahare Galekaa Tɔpejen la ta.
Konania ne o nimanar Sɛmaya ne Nɛtanɛl, ne Hasabia ne Jeyɛl dɛ Josabad, ba bwa aa ɛ Lewi dea tena nomonome la ɡe lawɛ pebiiri ne bombiire kaɡboŋa anue, ne nabala lafraanue tɛ Lewi dea tena la ŋɔ bá kpɔ ɛ Galekaa Tɔpejen sarahare la.
Baa ɛ wobɛlbwa tonɛ, dɛ pa Galekaa Tɔpejen la dii mun la, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la kaa che ba chebɔra ɡɛ Kooro Josia aa ŋɔa la.
Baa kpoo pebiiri ne bombiire la tonɛ la, sɔfore la kpɔ a chal merɛ kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta, asɛ Lewi dea tena la ɡe ɛɛ swea.
Ba laa anɔ la baa fuah ɛ sarahare la kpɔ, dɛ bɔna denaa ta tɛ nɛra la, asɛ ba kpɔ ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii ɡɛ aa lɔ Mosis Tɔn bini la.
Gɛ tentenee ba ɛ nabali la ɡe.
Lewi dea tena la wɔɔ Galekaa Tɔpejen ola la ɡɛ baa baɡla, dɛ daa anɔ la aa do ɡoroŋ la viine ne loɡa bwa soo siwi ne, dɛ bɔne ola la warane tɛ nɛra la bwa.
Anɔ habɔɔ, Lewi dea tena la yon kpɔ ola la ane, dɛ tɛ sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar sɔfore la ɡe, dɛkalkɛ jwaana bwaa sɔfore la yon so dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa ne a noorare bɔra la.
Gɛɛ Lewi dea tena la yon laa ba dibɔr kpɔ, dɛ laa anɔ la ɡe aa ɛ sɔfore baa le Arɔn luɡe ta dibɔr kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Asaf naanar bane baa ɛ yelɡoola, yon ka che ba chebɔra, ɡɛ Kooro Devid ne Asaf ne Heman, dɛ kooro keame Jedutun aa do ba la.
Nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo la ta chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa le kɛrɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba bala Lewi dea tena la daa Galekaa Tɔpejen kondikwaa la ane baa tɛɛ ba.
Anomanta, awola tɔpere la te, ba dɛ di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Korowii sɔn ta, dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa kon baa ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta, ɡɛ Kooro Josia aa do ba la.
Israel tena baa lɔ bela la di Galekaa Tɔpejen la, ne Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole A Ta Tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ.
Le Korowii keame Samoɛl bere saŋ, ba ta Galekaa Tɔpejen waa do ken dii bwa.
Gɛɛ Israel kooro bɛlbwa ɡe aa wola Galekaa Tɔpejen dii, kɛŋɔ Kooro Josia kon o ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea ne Juda ne Israel tena, dɛ Jerusalam tena nɔ dɔŋ dii bwa.
Kooro Josia aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuatoro taa ba di ɡɛ Galekaa Tɔpejen nɔ.
Kooro Josia Kora dii jaɡa Kooro Josia aa ɛ anɔ bwa, dɛ kwaa Korowii Dea tonɛ la, Ijipt Kooro Neko kpɔ o laa tena dɛ́ ka yo laa Kaakɛmes waa lɔ Yufretis Moo nyoa.
Kooro Josia kpɔ o laa tena ka chem ba, dɛ yoo ba.
Kɛ Kooro Neko kpɔ kala tɛ Juda Kooro Josia ŋɔ, “Juda kooro, n ne he laa dɛɛ yo laa nɔ, n ne n dɔmaa mɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yoo ba, asɛ Korowii ŋɔ ń ɛ warane, o cheɡɛ n mun ta, anomanta, bɛ men tɔŋle, ásɛ o ba kpoe.” Ane a bwa, dɛ Kooro Josia ta dɛ nyin ó ka yo.
O ta waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ Kooro Neko nɛɛ dɛ bol la ta teŋɛ, anomanta, o beɡre o te dɛ la ka yoo Meɡido harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta.
Baa dɛ yo la, Ijipt laa tena ta hɛm yaɡɛ Kooro Josia, asɛ o ŋɔ o bonɔɔna be ŋɔ, “Hé le n ne bonɔ kaa, ba do mɛ bol kohona.” Kooro Josia bonɔɔna lawɔ le o torɔɡo bini, dɛ kpɔɔ do onfale waa lɔ bela bini kaa Jerusalam.
O sewɛ bela ba huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta, asɛ Juda ne Jerusalam tena bwa ɛ o lwe.
Korowii keame Jeremia taa Kooro Josia wiile.
Dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini haahna ne baala dɛ́ taa wiile, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii Kooro Josia.
Ba chwera do Israel tena Wiile Taara Tɔn bini a ɛ ba nawee wa.
Wobɛlbwa Kooro Josia aa ɛa o kora dii saŋ, ne ɡɛ waa kpɔ o te tɛ Korowii ɡɛ aa lɔ Korowii Mmara tɔn bini, ne waa bwa waa ɛa le mumpar ba a jaɡa la, ba chwera do Israel ne Juda Koranar Waa Tɔn bini.
Juda Kooro Jehoahas Juda harɛ tena lawɛ Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoahas, dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, o chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, dɛ di kora Jerusalam.
Kooro Jehoahas di bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro mɔɔ dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora korobie atoro.
Ijipt Kooro Neko ir Kooro Jehoahas kora ta, asɛ dɛ ɛɡre Juda tena lɛ toɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, ne suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛ.
Ijipt Kooro Neko kpɔ Kooro Jehoahas nime Eliakim chiɡ o dɔɔ naa ta, o di kora Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ.
Dɛ kpɔ Kooro Jehoahas kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ charɛ Kooro Eliakim sɔn la, dɛ pao Jehoiakim.
Juda Kooro Jehoiakim Kooro Jehoiakim di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue mɔɔ dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ nɛ.
Asɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena dɛ ka lɛ Juda harɛ dɔɔh, dɛ lawɛ Kooro Jehoiakim dɛ doo ayaawa jɔɡrɔre, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Kooro Nebukadnesa berɔ pa laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, dɛ do Korowii Dea la kaa Babelɔn ka do o koodem bela.
Wobɛlbwa Kooro Jehoiakim aa ɛa ne kii wa, dɛ wechɔɡa waa ɛa bwa, ba chwera do Israel ne Juda Koranar Waa Tɔn bini.
Asɛ o bibaa Jehoiachin ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Jehoiachin Kooro Jehoiachin di bene fi dɛ anuatoro mɔɔ dɛ di kora.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora korobie atoro dɛ tɔpera fi.
Kooro Jehoiachin ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
Benanyoa aa chema la, Kooro Nebukadnesa ɡelɔ ba ba lawɛ Kooro Jehoiachin kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta, dɛ pa kondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ do Korowii Dea ja kaa.
O kpɔ Kooro Jehoiachin naara Sedekia chiɡ o naa ta, o ɛ Juda harɛ ta kooro, dɛ so Jerusalam.
Juda Kooro Sedekia Kooro Sedekia di bene fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛ di kora.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Kooro Sedekia ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, o ta o deŋne pwɛrɛ dɛ no Korowii keame Jeremia waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ o nɛɛ dɛ bol la.
Jerusalam paɡra wa Kooro Sedekia berɔ ɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa waa ɡela o ŋwɛɛ Korowii sɔn ta ŋɔ, wɛɛ kpɔ o tenee do o lɔɡa la deŋnekpeɡ.
O taŋ deŋne, o ta o liire charɛ dɛ ba Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la be.
Anɔ la aa bera ja laanee kɛŋɔ, Juda harɛ nomonome ne sɔfore, dɛ bela tena teŋɛ harɛre aa bar ba cheme kii we-ɛɛla Korowii aa kia ta, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa.
A che a ta, ba kpɔ doŋa kah Korowii Dea Korowii ɡbaɡba aa ɡela o do ɡoroŋ Jerusalam la.
Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la cheɡɛ o keamere nɛɛ bol waa baɡ ba keraŋwɛnɛ bwa, dɛkalkɛ o dɔ tedoma tɛ o nɛra ne o Dea la.
Kɛ ba nyiŋi keamere la nyubaah, dɛ mam ba, dɛ vɛh o waa la ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii baah aa di o nɛra nɛɛ kohona, baa wola won le a nyoa kpa.
Anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ba yoo ba, dɛ kpo bonɔmbie baa lɔ Korowii Dea keri ne.
Ba ta bonɔɔ kɛɛ tolo, banjena kɛɛ nomɛlbwa waa hwɛɛhra ɡelɛ.
O kpɔ ba bwa do Kooro Nebukadnesa nɔn ta.
Babelɔn Kooro ɡelɔ ba pa laala aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne anɔ la a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, dɛ do deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini Korowii Dea, dɛ anɔ la aa lɔ kooro ne o nomonome be bwa, kɛŋɔ laa ta kwaa kaa Babelɔn harɛ.
O ɡelɔ ba fuh Korowii Dea la, dɛ kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la, dɛ fuh kooderemi bwa ne komɛlbwa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa.
Nɛra baa kaa waa wola ban kpoorɛ la, o laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn, ba kaa tomɛ o ne o bii dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ harɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Pɛɛsea aa baa ir dɛɛ di kpeɡri.
Anee ɡela waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Jeremia nɛɛ bol la ɛ kpela.
O ŋɔ, “Harɛ la ɛɛ chɔɡoo, dɛ́ chɔ kɛ dimɡbia bene fifraanuanɛ baa wola won parɛ o ta.” Koojen Saeros berɔ ɡel Juda tena ba Jerusalam Koojen Saeros baa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta, o kora dii benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta la, Korowii ɡelɔ waa waa cheɡɛ o keame Jeremia nɛɛ bol la ɛ kpela.
O ɡelɔ Pɛɛsea harɛ Koojen Saeros chwerɛ tɔne kaa o harɛ bwa ta ŋɔ, “Waa men Pɛɛsea Koojen aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua laanee cheɡ mɛ kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, dɛ berɛ lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ma o Dea tɛo Jerusalam waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta.
Taraken, hé nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii bwa ir kaa bela, Kórowii haa dɛ tomɔ ja he nɛ.’ ”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Ɛsra Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa pili ŋwɛnɛ tɛ Juda tena, asɛ ba berɛ won ba ba harɛ ta, dɛ ba kwaa ma Korowii Dea Jerusalam wa.
Dɛ ba ɛ yoma dɛ do Babelɔn harɛ ta bene fifraanue, kɛ Pɛɛsea koojen cha ba, asɛ ba won berɛ ba ba deremi.
Bene fifraanɛɛ ba won kpɔ dɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea la.
Ba chwera do nyuune —.
A habɔɔ la, nɛra warɔ ja Ɛsra nɛɛ ba, asɛ o cha ba, ba so ɡɛ Korowii waa la aa dɛ baɡle.
Ba chwera do nyuune —.
Koojen Saeros berɔ ɡel Juu tena ba Jerusalam Koojen Saeros baa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta.
O kora dii benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta la, Korowii ɡelɔ waa waa cheɡɛ o keame Jeremia nɛɛ bol la ɛ kpela.
O ɡelɔ Koojen Saeros chwerɛ tɔne kaa o harɛ bwa ta.
O ŋɔ, “Waa men Pɛɛsea Koojen aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua laanee cheɡ mɛ kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, dɛ berɛ lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ma o Dea tɛo Jerusalam waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta.
Taraken, hé nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii bwa ir kaa bela, dɛ́ ka berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam.
Onee dɛ́ ja he nɛ.
Hé bala bane baa kaa dɛ ta so bojaŋ harɛre ta la, hé tɛɛ ba suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, ne laala baa kpɔ ɛ toma ne kondɛɛra, dɛ saraha kwaa aa le ba bambile ta, bá kpɔ ba Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bini.’ ” Asɛ Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene nomonnyuune, ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ nomɛlbwa Korowii aa ɡela o bambile aa lawa ir, dɛ́ ka berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la.
Ba bala la bwa cha ba, dɛ tɛɛ ba suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa koŋkwaa, ne laala baa kpɔ ɛ toma ne kondɛɛra, ne koŋkɛɛla a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, dɛ kpɔ ja saraha kwaa bwa aa le ba bambile ta.
A bwa habɔɔ la, Koojen Saeros berɔ kpɔ laala aa lɔ Korowii Dea Jerusalam Kooro Nebukadnesa fa aa paa, dɛ kpɔ ba cheɡ o voɡ dea bini la ba tɛɛ ba.
Koojen Saeros kpɔɔ do nomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Mitredat waa dɛ nyiŋi koodem laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa nɔn ta, o kura, dɛ kpɔ do Sɛsbasa waa dɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta nɔn ta.
Gɛ waa kure laala laanee teŋa nɔ.
Suuɡaswɛm loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ sarahare fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ sarahare kaɡboŋ, ne suuɡapoŋa loɡbaala fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡjeɡre fifraatoro, ne suuɡapoŋa loɡjeɡre lafraanaarɛ dɛ fi, dɛ loɡa ane ɡe aa jaa kaɡboŋ.
Suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa koŋkwaa ne anɔ la aa jaa bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa anue lafraanaarɛ.
Asɛ Sɛsbasa kpɔ a bwa, ɡɛ saŋ o ne nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta Babelɔn dɛɛ ba Jerusalam la ba.
Nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn ba wa Nɛra Babelɔn Koojen Nebukadnesa aa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn, asɛ ba berɛ won ba Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ ta, dɛ ba so ba bwɛɛre ta laanee teŋa nɔ, Sɛrobabɛl ne Jesua, ne Nehemia ne Seraya, ne Relaya ne Mɔdekae, ne Bilsan ne Mispar, ne Biɡvai ne Rehum, dɛ Baana.
Baala baa le Israel harɛ taa teŋa nɔ.
Parɔs naanar lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Sɛfatea naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Ara naanar lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ banue.
Pahat Moab ne Jesua dɛ Joab luɡe nɛra lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ, lafraanuatoro dɛ fi dɛ banɛ.
Elam naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ.
Satu naanar lɔ lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue.
Sakai naanar lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanumɛl.
Bani naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
Bebai naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
Asɡad naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Adonikam naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanumɛl dɛ banumɛl.
Biɡvai ɡe naanar lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ fifraanue dɛ banumɛl.
Adin naanar lɔ lafraanaarɛ fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ.
Ata waa le Hɛsɛkea luɡe ta, o ɡe naanar lɔ nɛra fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Bɛsae naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
Jora naanar lɔ lafa dɛ fi dɛ banɛ.
Hasum naanar ɡe lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
Giba naanar lɔ fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banue.
Baala baa le Bɛtlɛham lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
Baala baa le Nɛtɔfa lɔ fifraanue dɛ banumɛl.
Baala baa le Anatɔt lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Baala baa le Bɛt Asmavɛt lɔ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
Baala baa le Kiriat Jearim ne Kefira, dɛ Beɛrɔt lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ batoro.
Baala baa le Rama ne Geba lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Baala baa le Mikmas lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Baala baa le Bɛtel ne Ai lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
Baala baa le Nɛbo lɔ fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
Baala baa le Maɡbes lɔ lafa fifraanue dɛ banumɛl.
Baala baa le Elam ɡe lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ.
Baala baa le Harim lɔ lafraatoro fifraanɛ.
Baala baa le Lod ne Hadid, dɛ Ono lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanɛ dɛ banue.
Baala baa le Jeriko ɡe lɔ lafraatoro fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue.
Baala baa le Senaa lɔ kaɡboŋa batoro lafraanumɛl fifraatoro.
Sɔfore baa jaa ɡee nɔ.
Jedaya naanar baa le Jesua luɡe ta nɛra lɔ lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ batoro.
Ima naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
Pasur naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banuanɛ.
Harim naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ dɛ fi dɛ banuanɛ.
Lewi dea tena ɡee nɔ.
Jesua naanar dɛ le Kadmiel dɛ Hodavia luɡe nɛra lɔ fifraanuanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Yelɡoola baa jaa ɡee nɔ.
Asaf naanar lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo ɡee nɔ.
Salum ne Ata ne Talmɔn ne Akub ne Hatita dɛ Sobai naanar lɔ nɛra lafa fifraatoro dɛ banuanaarɛ.
Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ɡee nɔ.
Ba naanaree, Siha ne Hasufa dɛ Tabaot, ne Keros ne Siaha dɛ Padɔn, ne Lebana ne Haɡaba dɛ Akub, ne Haɡab ne Samlai dɛ Hanan, ne Gedɛl ne Gahar dɛ Reaya, ne Resin ne Nekoda dɛ Gasam, ne Usa ne Pasea dɛ Besai, ne Asna ne Meunim dɛ Nefusim, ne Bakbuk ne Hakufa dɛ Haahur, ne Baslut ne Mehida dɛ Haasa, ne Baakɔs ne Sisera dɛ Tɛma, ne Nɛsea dɛ Hatifa.
Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar ɡee nɔ.
Ba naanaree, Sotai ne Hasofɛrɛt dɛ Pɛruda, ne Jaalaa ne Daakon dɛ Gedɛl, ne Sɛfatea dɛ Hatil, ne Pɔkɛrɛt Hasebaim dɛ Ami.
Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ne Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
Nɛra baa teŋa nɔ le bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ Tɛl Mɛla ne Tɛl Hasa, ne Kɛrɔb ne Adon dɛ Ima.
Kɛ ba ta wone chaɡle kɛŋɔ ba lolanar mun le Israel harɛ ta.
Banee nɔ, Delaya ne Tobia dɛ Nekoda naanar, ba lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
Sɔfore ɡe pera, ba naanaree nɔ.
Hobaya ne Hakɔs dɛ Baasilai.
A ɡɛ Baasilai nɔɔ fa mo Baasilai waa le Gelead bihaah, a che a ta baa yerɔ ɡɛ sɔn nɔ.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɡaaɡe ba naawa luɡe tɔne bini kahonɛ, anomanta, ba kpɔ ba kɛŋɔ nɛra doŋa aa lɔ ba nɛ, baa wola won ɛ sɔfore.
Asɛ Juda harɛ nomoa ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, baa won di kondikwaa aa do ɡoroŋ bɛlbwa baa kpɔa ba tɛ Korowii la, atane sɔfo bɛl lɔ bela dɛ́ do batakaare baa sɔh Urim ne Tumim dawɛ o ta, dɛ́ che a ta bɔɔ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin la mɔɔ.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ, lafraatoro fifraanumɛl.
Ba bonɔɔna ne toli baa dɛ tomɛ ɡe lɔ kaɡboŋa banuanɛ lafraatoro fifraatoro dɛ banuanɛ.
Dɛ ba berɔ dɔ baala ne haahna yelɡoola lafraanɛ.
Ba jaɡre lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraatoro dɛ anumɛl, ba keeɡore aa jweera a loɡle la bii lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue.
Nyoɡmare ɡe lɔ lafraanaarɛ fifraatoro dɛ anue, ne keeɡore kaɡboŋa anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanɛ.
Nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛre ta la aa baa tel Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la, deene nomonnyuune la bini bane le ba bambile bini tɛ kwaa ba berɛ kpɔ ma Korowii Dea la cheɡ o buɡ bene ta bela.
Gɛ bɛlbwa aa wona laanee o tɛ ba kpɔ ɛ toma la.
Suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore lafraanue, ne suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa anɛ lafraanuatoro, dɛ sɔfore batakaani lafa.
Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne yelɡoola, ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo, dɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la soɡe ba bwɛɛre ta, ba ne nɛra la bane.
Asɛ Israel tena baa kaa la ka so bwɛɛre ba naawa fa aa soɡe a ta la ta.
Ba berɔ kwaa ma kon baa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii Korobie anuanɛ ta la, Israel tena bwa kaa so ba bwɛɛre ta.
Asɛ ba bwa pɛ ka cheme Jerusalam, asɛ Josadak bibaa Jesua ne o bala sɔfore, ne Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne o bala baa ja o nɛ, pa mun dɛ berɛ kwaa ma saraha kon tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis Mmara tɔn bini la.
A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ nɛra baa bar ba cheme la te, kɛ ba berɔ kwaa ma saraha kon la cheɡ o buɡ bene la ta, dɛ fuh kwaa chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta.
Ba di Kukure Tɔpejen ɡɛ baa chwerɛ o waa bil la, dɛ fuh kwaa ɛ sarahare ɡɛ aa chɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa ta.
A habɔɔ la, ba kpɔ kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ ɛ sarahare tɔpere bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ Korobifale ne saraha kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɔpejena aa do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii la ne, dɛ anɔ la aa le nɛra bambile ta, ba kpɔ ba ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii la.
Korobie anuanɛ tɔpeloɡle ta la, ba pa mun fuh kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ ba ta Korowii Dea la mun pae mɔɔ.
Korowii Dea kwaara dɛ́ ma mumpar Ate, nɛra la tɛ suuɡa baa kpɔ bɔ tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ peɡri bwea ne kapenta tena, dɛ berɛ kpɔ kondikwaa ne sen dɛ ɔleve noo ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ka tɛ bwɛjena Sidon ne Taaya tena, ásɛ ba kpɔ ka charɛ peleme daa le Lɛbanɔn, ásɛ dɛ taɡa kpɔ mpo sie ba Jopa, ɡɛ Pɛɛsea Koojen Saeros aa bola la.
Anomanta, bennɛɛte korobinɛɛte ta nɛra la aa le bojaŋ harɛfale ta ba la, dɛ daa la tel bela baa dɛ ba Korowii Dea la doe Jerusalam, asɛ ba pa o mun.
Ate, Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne Josadak bibaa Jesua, dɛ bwɛɛla la kar ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la bwa kaa ja dɛɛ ɛ toma la.
Ba le Lewi dea tena baa di bene fifraanɛ, kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa la ba ɛ nomonome dɛɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ ma Korowii Dea la nɛ.
Jesua ne o bibaala dɛ o nimanar, ne Kadmiel ne o bibaala baa ɛ Hodavia naanar, ne Henadad bibaala, ne ba ɡe bibaala ne ba dɔɔranar ne nimanar, ba bwa aa ɛ Lewi dea tena la bwa pɛo dɛ ba ja, dɛɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea toma la nɛ.
Mamaala la aa pa Korowii Dea la mun la, sɔfore do ba laala dɛ ka che ba chebɔra dɛ kpoŋe bɛle, asɛ Lewi dea tena baa ɛ Asaf bibaala kpoŋe kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, dɛ ka che ba chebɔra, dɛ lɔ dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, ɡɛ Israel Kooro Devid fa aa do Israel tena la.
Ba ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii dɛ jaamo ŋɔ, “Korowii wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin Israel tena lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Asɛ nɛra la bwa moo kohona dɛ jam Korowii, dɛkalkɛ ba pa Korowii Dea la mun.
Kɛ sɔfore baa ɛ nomonome ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ nomonnyuune baa tɔ sie na loɡle Dea la aa cheɡa dɛɛ nyiŋi baa pa Dea la mun la, ba wio dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ bane ɡe ɛɛ do silɛɛ lɔŋɔre.
Nomɛlbwa aa won jemɛ banɔ la baa dɛ wi, ne banɔ la baa sie aa lɛa kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ɡbɔɡa aa lɔ bela kan kohona dɛɛ la bojaŋ.
Korowii Dea kwaara dɛ́ do webeɡra Juda ne Bɛnjamen tena dɔma noɔ kɛŋɔ Israel tena baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta la berɔ ba, dɛ berɛ baa do Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la Korowii Dea.
Anomanta, ba ba Sɛrobabɛl ne deene nomonnyuune la be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya ba cha heya Korowii Dea nɔ toma ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii beŋkpoŋ nɔɔ ya bwa ɛɛ tomɛ, dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo dɛ le saŋ Asiiria koojen Esaahadon aa ba ya ne bonɔ ba so bwa.” Kɛ Sɛrobabɛl ne Jesua, dɛ Israel deene nomonnyuune la chaŋɔ ŋɔ, “Ya ta he chae hiaeh Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea toma nɔ ta.
Ya ɡbo ɛɛ doo, ɡɛ Pɛɛsea Koojen Saeros aa do yaa la.” Belaa nɛra baa soɡa bar ba la pa mun dɛɛ chɔɡ Juu tena la liire, a ɡel baa ɔmɛ Korowii Dea la toma ɛɛ.
Ba yawɛ Pɛɛsea harɛ nomonome sen ŋɔ bá chɔɡ vɔrɔwa bɛlbwa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe Dea la toma wa, dɛ le Pɛɛsea Koojena Saeros ne Dareɔs kora dii saŋ bwa.
Jerusalam kwaara dɛ́ ma webeɡra waa ja Koojen Sɛksɛs kora dii mumpar la, ba dɔma la chwerɛ waa yaɡɛ Juda ne Jerusalam tena.
A habɔɔ, Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa baa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta la, baala bane baa dɛ yer ba Bislam ne Mitredat, ne Tabeel dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛ chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Koojen Atasɛksɛs.
Aram tena wobol taa ba chwera, asɛ nɛn waa kure la, ó baɡle a mun.
Rehum waa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la bampera bobɛl, ne karake Simsai waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, chwerɛ Jerusalam waa aa teŋa nɔ ba tɛ Koojen Atasɛksɛs.
“Tɔn nɔ le Rehum waa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la bampera, ne karake Simsai waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil be.
Bane ba bala baa jaa bwa, nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole, dɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa le Tripolis, ne Pɛɛsea ne Ɛrɛk ne Babelɔn, dɛ Elam tena baa lɔ Susa, dɛ nɛra bane Koojen Asubanipal waa dɛ di kpeɡri dɛ dɔ jirima kohona, aa doŋ ba le ba deremi ba so bwɛjen Samaria, dɛ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛre ta la be.” Waa aa teŋa nɔɔ ba chwera do tɔn bini.
“Tɔn nɔ dɛ ba Koojen Atasɛksɛs be, dɛ le he bonɔɔna baa soɡe Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr la be.
Ya dɛ nae kohona.
N naa kooro, ya dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Juu tena baa le he harɛre ta dɛ ba la kaa Jerusalam, dɛ berɛ ka kwaa dɛɛ ma deŋnekpeɡ ne nyubinikpeɡ tena bwɛjen la ja.
Ba kwaarɔ dɛɛ ma o danjwɛɛre, dɛɛ kwaa a mune la ɡe.
N naa kooro, berɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ ba wono kwaa do bwɛjen nɔ tonaa, baa toɔ bɛlbwaa bɔ tɛɛ kpa, ásɛ komɛlbwa aa he kara munii do kpa.
Yaa lɔ he lɔɡa nɔ, yaa nyin kɛŋɔ sihiih ba kpoe haa wola duuree dɔ, anomanta, ya kpɔ kala nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, ásɛ he nyiŋi koranar baa tɔ he sie di kara la tɔne bini, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ Jerusalam ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena bwɛ, dɛɛ ha ba koranar ne harɛ nomonome.
Deŋnekpeɡ tena lɔ o ta le saŋ la bwa.
A waa o fa chɔɡ la.
Ya ɡelɔ hɛɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ, dɛ ba wono ma bwɛjen nɔ ne o danjwɛɛre tonaa, haa won di kpeɡri bɛlbwa harɛre aa chɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛre nɛra nɛɛ kpa.” Ate, koojen la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Tɔn nɔ dɛ ba Rehum waa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la bampera, ne Simsai waa ɛ karake dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛ, dɛ so bwɛjen Samaria ne Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr baŋ pera bobɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, n dɛ na ba.
Ba kure tɔn haa chwera la n sie, dɛ baɡle o bini waa n no.
N le nɛra ŋɔ bá nyiŋi tɔne bini, asɛ ba na kɛŋɔ, le saŋ la bwaa Jerusalam tena le dɛ le ba koranar habɔɔ, a che a ta deŋnekpeɡ ne wesaɡasaɡare su o ta.
Koranar baa kpeɡa Jerusalam di kora dɛ nyiŋi harɛ waa chɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr baŋ le bwa ta, dɛ ɡel ba bɔ toɔre dɛ lɛ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛɛ ba.
Anomanta, ɡel ba ŋɔ baala baa dɛ ɛ toma la be ŋɔ bá ɡel ka tel kɛŋɔ, n ɡbabir aa tɛ ŋwɛnɛ.
Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ waa nɔ vɛh, ásɛ a ba chɔɡ n liire maa dɔa Jerusalam tena nɛɛ la ta.” Baa kure Kooro Atasɛksɛs tɔn la waa baɡle Rehum ne Simsai dɛ nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la, ba ɛ warane la Jerusalam dɛ ka ŋɔ Juu tena la be ŋɔ bá ɡel Dea la toma ɛɛ.
Anomanta, ba ɡelɔ Korowii Dea la toma ka che, ka tel kɛŋɔ Koojen Dareɔs aa baa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ bene anɛ ta.
Tatenai tɔn waa chwera ka tɛ Kooro Dareɔs A ɡɛ saŋ la, Korowii keamere Haɡae ne Sekaria waa ɛ Ido naa, pa mun dɛɛ bol Korowii waa Juu tena ne banɔ la baa lɔ Jerusalam be, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta.
Ate, Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne Josadak bibaa Jesua aa no ba waa la, ba berɛ pa mun dɛɛ do Korowii Dea la Jerusalam ja, asɛ Korowii keamere banɛ la cha ba.
Gɛ saŋ la, Tatenai waa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Yufretis Moo harɛ baŋ ne Sɛta Bosenai, dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ la ba ba be, dɛ ka bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Umee tɛ heyaa kpeɡri ŋɔ he berɛ kwaa do Korowii Dea nɔ cheɡ o buɡ bene ta nɔ?” Ba berɔ bɔɔ ŋɔ “Nɛra baa dɛ ma Dea nɔ sɔne ɛrɔɔ?” Kɛ dɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la sie lɔ Juu tena nomonome la nɛ, a ɡel Pɛɛsea nomonome la ta wone ɛ wobɛlbwa, ka tel kɛŋɔ baa chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Koojen Dareɔs, asɛ o chaŋ ba mɔɔ.
Tatenai ne Sɛta Bosenai dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ bwa chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Kooro Dareɔs.
Kenii tɔn la bini wa ɛɛ baɡle.
“Tɔn nɔ dɛ ba Koojen Dareɔs be, Korowii ɡel he nyiŋi he nɛra nɛɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
N naa kooro, ya dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya la Juu tena harɛ ta, bela Korowii waa kana la Dea aa lole ba berɛ kwaa dɛɛ mao la.
Bwejena nee baa mao, dɛ kpɔ dadɛɛɡa dawɛ o danjwɛɛre ta.
Ba toma ɛɛ wer, dɛɛ kaa wɔrɔbe nɛ, ɡɛ baa chaɡ ba la.
Ya bɔɔ ba nomonome ŋɔ, ‘Umee tɛ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ he berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea nɔɔ?’ Ya berɔ bɔɔ ba ba nomonome sɔna, ɡɛ aa ɛ ya won ɡel he jemɛ nɛra baa chɔ ba nyoa.
Waa baa chaŋe yaa teŋa nɔ.
‘Ya ɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ne harɛ bonɔɔna, asɛ ya berɛ kwaa dɛɛ ma Korowii Dea ba fa aa mao saŋ la bwa la.
Israel kooro bɛl o fa aa dɛ di kpeɡri kohona laanee pa o mun dɛ tonɔ.
Kɛ ya naanar aa ir Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua bandia nomanta, o kpɔ ba do Kooro Nebukadnesa waa ɛ Babelɔn kooro nɔn ta.
Kooro Nebukadnesa chɔɡ o Dea la, dɛ lawɛ nɛra la kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn.
Kɛ a bwa habɔɔ, Babelɔn koojen Saeros aa di kora benanyoa waa tɔ sie ta la, o do mmara kɛŋɔ bá berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea nɔ.
O berɔ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa Kooro Nebukadnesa aa paa le Korowii Dea Jerusalam ba bil o voɡ dea bini Babelɔn la ba.
Ate, Koojen Saeros kpɔ ɡɛ loɡa la tɛ Sɛsbasa waa leo harɛ la nomoa, wɛɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta.
Dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kpɔ loɡa nɔ ka cheɡ Korowii Dea Jerusalam, dɛ́ berɛ kwaa ma Dea la cheɡ o buɡ bene la ta.” Anomanta, Sɛsbasa balɔ dɛ ba pa Korowii Dea la mun Jerusalam.
Nɛra ta lɔ o ta dɛɛ ɛ toma baa wola tonɛ mɔɔ.’ N naa kooro, dɛ he sie lɛo waa, ɡel ba nyiŋi koranar tɔne bini bwɛjen Babelɔn, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ Koojen Saeros tɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ bá kwaa ma Korowii Dea nɔ Jerusalam kɛɛ o ta ŋɔe, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ya jemɛ he liire aa lɔ waa nɔ ta.”
Koojen Dareɔs mmara Koojen Dareɔs do mmara ŋɔ, bá nyiŋi koranar tɔne baa kpɔa cheɡ Babelɔn la bini.
Baa ka dɛ nyiŋi la, ba na tɔn bɛl bwɛjen baa dɛ yerɔ Ɛkbatana waa lɔ Midia harɛ ta, asɛ ba chwerɛ waa aa teŋa nɔ o bini ŋɔ, Koojen Saeros aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta la, o do mmara Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la waa ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea la ó ɛ bɔr nɛra aa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare bela.
Gel ba ma chɔŋɛ Dea la buɡ bene la ta.
A chɛ kɛ o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɛ naɡale fifraanuanaarɛ, ásɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale fifraanuanaarɛ.
Ba kpɔ bwea atoro ma chɔŋɛ ɛ o danjwɛɛre ta bar aa, dɛ ba kpɔ dola dawɛ a ta.
Koodem bela suuɡaa bá kpɔ bɔ a kem.
Anɔ la aa jaa ɡee kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa aa lɔ Korowii Dea, Koojen Nebukadnesa aa paa le Jerusalam ba Babelɔn la, a chɛ kɛ bá berɛ kaa ane a buɡ ta bela tenten a fa aa cheɡa, Korowii Dea Jerusalam.” Koojen Dareɔs do nɛra bá berɛ ɛ toma Ate, Koojen Dareɔs chaŋe dɛ ŋɔ, “Name Tatenai waa ɛ nomonjen dɛɛ nyiŋi Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ ta, ne Sɛta Bosenai ne he bala nomonome haa lɔ harɛ la ta la, hé le bela kaa.
He bɛ wobɛlbwa ɛ dɛ́ tɔ Korowii Dea mae toma la ŋwɛnɛ.
Hé ɡel Juu tena harɛ nomoa, ne o nomonome ɡel ba berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea la cheɡ o buɡ bene ta bela.
N dɛ do heyaa kɛŋɔ hé cha ba, ásɛ ba won mao.
Hé kpɔ suuɡa aa le Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ baa bɔa dɛɛ do kara mun la, dɛɛ bɔ Dea la toma bɛlbwa kem, ɡɛ aa ɛ toma la bɛ ba ka che.
Tɔpere bɛlbwa a chɛ kɛ hé nyiŋi dɛɛ tɛ sɔfore baa lɔ Jerusalam kwaa baa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Nabali ne peera, dɛ pebiiri baa fuh ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua, ne jaaɡe ne yar ne sen dɛ ɔleve no.
He bɛ ban dɛɛ vɔmɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba won dɛɛ ɛ sarahare aa dɛɛ su Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua siwi, dɛ́ soŋe tɛ kooro ne o bibaala ɡe.
N berɔ dɛɛ do heyaa kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ waa nɔ ta la, bá tɛr dola le o dea ta dɛ́ seɡre o nyoa dɛ́ kpɔ tooh ó saɡɛ.
O wechɔɡa waa ɛa nomanta, o dem paɡre dɛ́ berɛ puldoa.
