Korowii waa le Jerusalam cheɡ ŋɔ nɛra ba bela dɛ́ baa tomɔ la, ó ir kooro kɛɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra baa vɛh waa nɔ ta teŋa, kɛɛ dɛ́ ka chɔɡ Korowii Dea nɔ la.
Men Koojen Dareɔs, menee do ɡɛ mmara nɔ.
Bɛlbwa nyiŋi dɛɛ teŋɛ o ta kɛrɛdɛ.” Korowii Dea kpɔe dɛ́ do o nɔn ta Belaa Tatenai waa ɛ nomoa harɛ la ta, ne Sɛta Bosenai dɛ ba bala baa ja ba nɛɛ la, bwa ɛ waa koojen la aa do ba a ta la bwa kɛrɛdɛ ken.
Korowii keamere Haɡae ne Sekaria ɡbemba baa do Juu tena nomonome la nomanta, Korowii Dea toma la kaa sie ɡɛ aa chɛa.
Ba tonɛ Dea la toma ɡɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, ne Pɛɛsea harɛ Koojena Saeros, ne Dareɔs dɛ Atasɛksɛs aa do ba la.
Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora bene anumɛl, Adar korobie tɔpetooro wee taa ba ma Korowii Dea la tonɛ.
Belaa Israel tena bwa, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ nɛra baa kaa dɛ le bojaŋ harɛ, dɛ berɛ ba la bwa kpɔ silɛɛ kohona, dɛ kpɔ Dea la do Korowii nɔn ta.
Dea la kpɔe dɛ do Korowii nɔn ta la, ba kpɔ nabala lafa ne pebala lafraanɛ, dɛ pebali lafraanaarɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛ berɛ kpɔ bombala fi dɛ anɛ, bɛlbwa che tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la, dɛ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ Israel tena bwa.
Ba bɔne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la bini ɡɛ bɛlbwa toma aa doa Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bini, ɡɛ baa chwera do Mosis Tɔn bini la.
Galekaa Tɔpejen dii Korobie waa tɔ sie la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta la, nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛ ba la, di Galekaa Tɔpejen la.
Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la tɔ sie laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛ, dɛ do ɡoroŋ.
Asɛ Lewi dea tena la kpo Galekaa pebie la tɛ nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛ ba la bwa, ne ba bala sɔfore dɛ ba ɡbabir.
Anomanta, Israel tena baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛ ba la, ne nɛra baa pere ba te le waa nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ aa dɛ ɛa nɛɛ, dɛ so harɛ la ta bwa pɛo, dɛ ba tomɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ di Galekaa Tɔpejen kondikwaa la.
Ba di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole A Ta Tɔpejen tɔpera anuanɛ silɛɛ ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii charɛ Asiiria koojen liire, o won cha ba ba ma Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Dea la.
Ɛsra Jerusalam bala Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, ɡɛ saŋ Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta la, dɛ baa bɛl lole baa yerɔ Ɛsra.
O mɛɛ sɔne Seraya, Seraya ɡe mɛɛ Asaria, asɛ Asaria ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Hilkia.
Salum lolɛ Hilkia, Sadɔk lole Salum, Ahitub lolɛ Sadɔk, Amaria lolɛ Ahitub, Asaria lolɛ Amaria, asɛ Merayɔt lolɛ Asaria.
Serahia lolɛ Merayɔt, Usi lolɛ Serahia, asɛ Buki lolɛ Usi.
Abisua lolɛ Buki, Fenehas lolɛ Abisua, Eliasa lolɛ Fenehas, asɛ Arɔn waa ɛ Sɔfonomoa la lolɛ Eliasa.
A ɡɛ Ɛsra nɔ ɛ sɔfo dɛ le Babelɔn ba.
Dɛ o ɛ chicha ɡe, dɛ jemɛ mmarare Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa tɛ Mosis la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ baɡla.
Komɛlbwa waa bɔɔ le koojen be la, o dɛ tɛo, dɛkalkɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la nɔn dawɛ o nɛ.
Israel tena la bane ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne yelɡoola, ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo, dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ɡe ba Jerusalam, ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Atasɛksɛs aa di kora bene anuanɛ ta.
Koojen la aa di kora bene anuanɛ, korobie anue taa sɔfo Ɛsra ba Jerusalam.
Korobiloɡle tɔpere waa tɔ sie taa ba pa mun le Babelɔn harɛ ta, asɛ korobie anue tɔpeloɡle ne tela dɛ Korowii chao o ba tel Jerusalam.
Sɔfo Ɛsra le o te cheɡ dɛ tɛ Korowii Mmarare la hwela ne a bini nyiŋa, asɛ dɛɛ chaɡle Korowii waa ne mmarare aa lɔ Israel harɛ ta.
Tɔn Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa chwera ka tɛ Ɛsra Koojen Atasɛksɛs chwerɛ waa aa teŋa nɔ tɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa bera ɛ chicha dɛ jemɛ Korowii Mmarare ne waa waa do Israel tena a ta la bini kɛrɛdɛ.
“Tɔn nɔ le men Atasɛksɛs maa ɛ koranar bwa koojen be.
N chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ sɔfo Ɛsra haa ɛ chicha, dɛɛ baɡle Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua la Mmarare.
N dɛ nae.
Taraken nɔ, n dɛ doe kɛŋɔ Israel te bɛlbwa waa lɔ n harɛ ta, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, ba bini bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ o pui kaa Jerusalam la won kaala.
Men Koojen, ne n nomonome banuanɛ baa dɛ ja mɛ, dɛ tomɛ ŋɔ he ka bɔɔ dɛ na kɛ nɛra dɛ teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la mmarare waa kpɔa do he nɔn ta la ta kɛɛ.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm koojen ne nɛra baa dɛ jao aa le ba bambile bini, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, o Dea do Jerusalam la.
Berɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm haa dɔa le Babelɔn harɛ ta, ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare Israel tena ne ba sɔfore aa kpɔa tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bwa.
Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ kpɔ a ɡɛ suuɡa nɔ yawɛ nabala ne pebala ne pebiiri, dɛ mea sarahare ne sen sarahare, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ saraha Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la Dea, kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta Jerusalam la ta.
Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm bɛlbwa aa ka la, he ne he bala Juu tena ɛɛ won kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa aa wera tɛ heya, ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin.
Kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm loɡa baa kpɔa do he nɔn ta, ba kpɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ Dea la bwa ka tɛo Jerusalam.
Komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin dɛ ja Korowii Dea bini la, hé lɛa le suuɡa aa le kooro kara mun ka yawɛ.
Taraken, men Koojen Atasɛksɛs dɛ do Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ nɛra baa dɛ cheɡ n harɛ suuɡare la ŋɔ, bá do sie tɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua chicha dɛɛ baɡle o Mmarare bini la komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin, he tɛo waa, he bɛ ɡel a ɡwaa suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, ne jaaɡe a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fi, ne sen aa ɛ ɡalɔŋre lafraanue, ne ɔleve no aa ɛ ɡalɔŋre lafraanue.
Kɛ yar te, he tɛo ɡɛ del bwa waa dɛ nyin.
Komɛlbwa Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua aa baɡla la, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɡel á ɛ ɡɛ aa chɛa tɛo o Dea bela.
Ásɛ o baah bɛ n nɛɛ kɛɛ kooro bɛlbwa waa ba di kora n habɔɔ nɛɛ di.
A chɛ kɛ hé jemɛ ja kɛŋɔ he ta kpeɡri dɔe kɛ he lɛ toɔ bɛlbwa soo siwi le sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, ne yelɡoola dɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo, ne bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea, kɛɛ tom-ɛɛ bɛlbwa waa kaa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea be.
Hen sɔfo Ɛsra, che wejema Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa tɛɛ ta, dɛ le nomonome ne banɔ la baa jemɛ waa bola dɛɛ pa bole, ásɛ baa nyiŋi nɛra baa lɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ ta nɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ Mmarare ta.
Takapɔ chaɡle banɔ la ɡe baa wola mmarare la jemɛ la.
Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ mmarare kɛɛ koojen mmarare ta la, a chɛ kɛ bá kpoo buɡ la ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ doŋu le o harɛ ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o komɛlbwa waa dɔa ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ lawɔ ka do dea, ásɛ a ɛ deŋnetɛra tɛo.” Sɔfo Ɛsra Korowii kpɛɛra Ate, sɔfo Ɛsra ŋɔ, “Korowii ya naawa aa tomɔ laanee dɔ jam.
Onee ɡela Koojen Atasɛksɛs dɔ liire, dɛ ɡel ba berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea waa do ken, dɛ dɔ jirima cheɡ Jerusalam.
O berɔ sune n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ n dɔ jirima koojen ne o nɛra baa dɛ jao, dɛ o nomonjena baa kpeɡa bwa sie.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa ja n nɛɛ nomanta, n dɔ ɡbemba dɛ won boa Israel deene nomonnyuune nyoa, asɛ n ne ba berɛ ba Jerusalam.”
Nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta ba wa Gɛ saŋ Israel deene nomonnyuune baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta Babelɔn la, nɛra baa teŋɛ sɔfo Ɛsra nɛɛ ba Jerusalam ɡɛ saŋ Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora laanee nɔ.
Fenehas naanar bini, Gɛɛsɔm.
Itama naanar bini, Daneɛl, Devid naanar bini, Hatus ne Sɛkania naanar.
Parɔs naanar bini, Sekaria.
Baala baa ja o nɛɛ ba chwerɛ ba sɔna lɔ lafa fifraanue.
Pahat Moab naanar bini, Serahia bibaa Eliehonai, asɛ baala lafraanɛ ja o nɛ.
Satu naanar bini, Jahaseɛl bibaa Sɛkania, asɛ baala lafraatoro ja o nɛ.
Adin naanar bini, Jonatan bibaa Ɛbɛd, asɛ baala fifraanue ja o nɛ.
Elam naanar bini, Atalia bibaa Jesaya asɛ baala fifraanuanɛ ja o nɛ.
Sɛfatea naanar bini, Maekel bibaa Sebadia, asɛ baala fifraanuatoro ja o nɛ.
Joab naanar bini, Jehiel bibaa Obadia, asɛ baala lafraanɛ dɛ fi dɛ banuatoro ja o nɛ.
Bani naanar bini, Josifia bibaa Sɛlomet, asɛ baala lafa fifraanumɛl ja o nɛ.
Bebai naanar bini, Bebai bibaa Sekaria, asɛ baala fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro ja o nɛ.
Asɡad naanar bini, Hakatan bibaa Johanan, asɛ baala lafa dɛ fi ja o nɛ.
Adonikam naanar bini, banɔ la baa ka mun ba laanee, Ɛlefɛlɛt ne Jeyuwel dɛ Sɛmaya, asɛ baala fifraanumɛl ja ba nɛ.
Biɡvai naanar bini, Utai ne Sakur, asɛ baala fifraanuanɛ ja ba nɛ.
Sɔfo Ɛsra berɔ ba Jerusalam Ate, men sɔfo Ɛsra boa nɛra baa le harɛfale ta ba la nyoa, bɔɔ bɛl baa kwiu asɛ nee palɛ kpɔ o bini dɛɛ kaa Ahava ta, asɛ ya so bela tɔpera atoro.
Maa nyiŋi nɛra la ne sɔfore la bini la, n ta Lewi dea te bɛlbwa nae.
Anomanta, n yerɛ Eliesa ne Areɛl ne Sɛmaya, ne Ɛl Netan ne Jarib ne Ɛl Netan, ne Netan ne Sekaria dɛ Mɛsolam ba fa aa ɛ nomonome, dɛ yerɛ Joiarib ne Ɛl Netan baa dɔ wejema kohona, dɛ tom ba bwɛɛ nomoa bɛl waa lɔ Kasifia baa yerɔ Ido be.
N bol waa baa ka bol Ido ne o bala baa ja o nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea be ŋɔ, bá tɛ yaa nɛra bá baa tomɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ o Dea.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa sune ya nɛ, dɛ ja ya nɛɛ nomanta, ba tɛ yaa Sɛrebea waa dɔ kwaa ɛɛ wejema kohona.
O ɛ Lewi dea te, dɛ le Maali dea, asɛ o bibaala ne o nimanar baala fi dɛ banuatoro ja o nɛɛ dɛ ba.
Ba ɡelɔ Hasabia dɛ Jesaya baa le Merari dea ɡe ba, ba lolanar fifraanɛ ja ba nɛ.
Ba berɔ ba bonɔɔna baa dɛɛ ɛ Korowii Dea bini toma nɛra lafraanɛ fifraanɛ ne, ba ɛ nɛra Kooro Devid aa le ba ne ba nomonome cheɡ ŋɔ baa cha Lewi dea tena la.
Ba chwerɛ ba bwa sɔna teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ do tɔn bini.
Ahava bela baa kwi bɔɔ nee ɛɛ palɛ o bini belaa n do ba ŋɔ ya vɔwɛ nyoa, ɡɛ aa ɛ yá won pwɛr ya te do Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ lɔɡa.
Ya soŋo o ja ya nɛɛ ya kpɔ ya bii dɛ kwaa yaa dɔa bwa kaa Jerusalam sɔnɔnɔɔ.
Dɛ sihiih dɛ kpo mɛ kɛ n soŋe laa tena ne nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta le koojen be ŋɔ, bá tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe le ya dɔma baa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta la be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya ŋɔ koojen la be ŋɔ Korowii dɛ sune nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te dɛɛ tɛo nɛ, kɛ nɛra baa vɛoh la te, o baah ɛɛ diu kohona ó tɛr ba deŋne.
Anomanta, ya vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ o lɛ yaa le ɡɛ waa nɔ ta.
Asɛ o no ya wesoŋa, dɛ lɛ yaa.
Koŋkɛɛla baa kpɔa ba Korowii Dea Ate, n le sɔfo nomonome fi dɛ banɛ, ne Sɛrebea ne Hasabia dɛ ba bala fi ja.
Asɛ n maɡɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, dɛ loɡa Koojen Atasɛksɛs ne o nɛra baa dɛ jao ne o nomonome, dɛ anɔ la Israel tena aa ba a ne bá kpɔ ɛ toma Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea.
Kwaa maa maɡa tɛɛ ba laanee, suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ dɛ lafa, suuɡapoŋa koŋkwaa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, dɛ suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, ne suuɡaswɛm loɡa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore anuatoro ne tama, dɛ ayaawa loɡa anɛ ne suuɡaswɛm loɡa a bwa tɔɡre aa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
N ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He fa le he ne laala nɔ bwa cheɡ tɛ Korowii dɛ do ɡoroŋ wubwa.
Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm la ɛ saraha kwaa aa le nɛra bambile bini ba kpɔ ba tɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ la.
Hé daahna kɛrɛdɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ haa jo Korowii Dea bini Jerusalam, ásɛ dɛ kari a tɔɡre sɔfo nomonome ne Lewi dea tena dɛ Israel nomonnyuune la sie.” Ate, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena lɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, dɛ koŋkwaa aa do ɡoroŋ ba kari a tɔɡre la dɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ kaa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea Jerusalam.
Korobiloɡle, tɔpera fi dɛ anɛ taa ya le bela baa kwi bɔɔ nee ɛɛ palɛ o bini dɛ do Ahava dɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ja ya nɛ, dɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe le ya dɔma ne ŋwɛɛra baa sɔh ŋwɛnɛ ta nɔn ta.
Yaa jo Jerusalam la, ya soɡo dɛ onɛ tɔpera atoro.
Asɛ tɔpenaarɛ wee la, ya la Korowii Dea, dɛ ka maɡɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ koŋkwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la do sɔfo Uria bibaa Mɛremɔt waa ɛ sɔfo la nɔn ta, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea la bini.
Dɛ Fenehas bibaa Eliasa ja o nɛ, ne Lewi dea tena baa ɛ Jesua bibaa Josabad dɛ Binui bibaa Noadia.
Ba kure kwaa la bwa dɛ jemɛ a nyoa ne ɡɛ a tɔɡre aa doa.
Dɛ chwerɛ a bwa do tɔn ta bil ɡɛ saŋ.
Nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta aa le bela ba la, ba kpɔ saraha kwaa ba ba fuh tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ.
Ba kpɔ nabala fi dɛ anɛ tɛ Israel harɛ tena bwa, pebala fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anumɛl ne pebali fifraanuanɛ dɛ anuanɛ, asɛ dɛ kpɔ bombala fi dɛ anɛ ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha soŋe ba wechɔɡa.
Ba fuh ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
Ba berɔ kpɔ tɔn koojen la fa aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la tɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi harɛre aa lɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ, ne o nomonome bwa, asɛ ba cha nɛra la ne Korowii Dea toma la.
Ɛsra soŋe Korowii hɔɔhra hahmor ne yal wa Baa ɛ anɔ bwa tonɛ la, nomonome la ba men sɔfo Ɛsra be ŋɔ, “Israel tena ne sɔfore, dɛ Lewi dea tena la ta ba te pere le Keenan ne Hiti ne Pɛrɛs, ne Jebus ne Amɔn ne Moab ne Ijipt, dɛ Amɔre tena we-ɛɛla Korowii aa kia aa wola were la ta.
Israel baala la kpɔ harɛre aa bar ba cheme la haahna mo, a che a ta ba ne Korowii nɛra ba wa aa do ɡoroŋ la, ne ba we-ɛɛla aa wola were la koo dɔŋa.
Nomonome ne sitɔɔla laanee tɔ ba sie ba ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ.” Maa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, n kɛɛ n batakaare, dɛ tɛr n nyumpona ne n tampona, asɛ dɛ so harɛ n bwara yɔr, n tea bini aa chɔɡa wa.
Nomɛlbwa waa no waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa bola la baa bar mɛ cheme dɛɛ chel, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛfale ta dɛ ba la waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe.
Asɛ n so bela dɛɛ di suna ka tel kɛŋɔ jɔmɔr saraha ɛɛ aa tela.
Jɔmɔr saraha ɛɛ aa tela la, n iro le bela maa soɡa dɛɛ di suna la, n batakaare maa kɛɛra ta do mɛ, asɛ n ɡuŋi harɛ dɛ ɡɔɔ n nɔɔra Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la be nyundua, dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, sihiih dɛ kpo mɛ n di ncho ɡe kohona, kɛ maa ɡɔɔ nyu dɛɛ nyiŋi he siwi ta nɔ, dɛkalkɛ ya wechɔɡa ɡwaa ya nɛ, hale dɛɛ tel he be nyundua.
Le ya naawa bere saŋ ba le fini, ya wechɔɡa kan kohona.
Anomanta, ya ne ya koranar ne sɔfore bwaa harɛre ane koranar lawɛ laa ta dɛ kpoo yaa, dɛ pa ya laala kaa.
A ɡel sihiih kpo yaa, asɛ ya do ba lɔɡa ba le fini nɔ.
Kɛ taraken nɔ, n Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he sune ya nɛɛ tama bɛl, dɛ ɡel ya bini bane won chwa le yoma yawa ta, dɛ ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta he Dea ta.
He ɡelɔ ya dɔ ya te, dɛ tɛ yaa mkpafale.
Dɛ ya ɛ yoma, kɛ hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ ta yaa ɡelɛ ya wenaale ta.
He baɡle he nyina ya nɛɛ Pɛɛsea harɛ koojena sie.
He tɛ yaa mkpafale ya berɛ won kwaa ma hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ Dea waa kuuɡa la, asɛ dɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe, dɛ ɡel ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam bwɛdaa ta.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, anɔ bwa habɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona bol ɔ?
Dɛkalkɛ ya ta waa haa do yaa a ta teŋɛ, he cheɡɛ he bonɔɔna baa ɛ he keamere la nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Harɛ haa dɛ kaa o ta ka so la, wechɔɡa ɡelɔ nɛra baa soɡe o ta chɔɡo.
Ba kpɔ we-ɛɛla men Korowii aa kia ne wedoŋa su harɛ la bwa.
Anomanta, he bɛ he bihaahna kpɔ tɛ ba bibaala bá mo, ɡɛɛ aa wola chɛɛ kɛ he ɡe bibaala mo ba bihaahna.
Hé ne ba bɛ nyopɛo fɔo bɛlbwa fɔwɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ he won so dɛ́ biɡri, dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa dɛ́ di harɛ la ta kondɛɛɡa, ásɛ a chɔ le tɛ he bii saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’ Waa aa pu yaa nɔ bwa le ya wechɔɡa aa ɡela ya di bolchɔɡe la.
Kɛ ane a bwa, N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, tamaa kenii he tɛr ya deŋne.
He ta ɡelɛ a ɡwaa ya nɛ, dɛ ɡel ya bini bane dɔ ya nyuune dɛ ta so le.
Yaa wono teŋɛ dɛɛ koni waa haa dɛ do yaa a ta, ya ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ waa baa kia nɔ kaa mo dɔŋa bihaahna, kɛɛ bihaahna kaa yalɛ ba bibaala aa?
He baah aa ya nɛɛ di kohona he chɔɡ yaa, ya bini bɛlbwa aa wola ka dɛ́ so le kpa aa?
N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, he waa toɡrɔ kohona!
He ɡelɔ ya bini bane ta so le.
Ya di bolchɔɡe dɛ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa dɛɛ bil he sie, anomanta, ya bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ba che he sie.”
Juu tena wechɔɡa bola Sɔfo Ɛsra taa ɡuŋa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii o Dea la sie, dɛ wi dɛɛ soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa la, Israel tena baa wara, baala ne haahna, dɛ bechale baa baro cheme la ɡe wio kɛrɛdɛ.
Belaa Jehiel bibaa Sɛkania waa ɛ Elam naa la bini bɛl ŋɔ Ɛsra be ŋɔ, “Ya waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, kɛŋɔ yaa dɛ mo harɛre nɛra baa soɡa bar yaa nɔ haahna nɔ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, ya Israel tena ta dɔ hwɛɡa.
Hé ɡel ya ne Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ ya doŋi haahna nɔ ne ba bii bwa kaa.
Yaa teŋɛ waa he ne nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta aa bola ŋɔ yá ɛ laanee.
Yaa ɛa ɡɛ Korowii Mmara aa dɛ baɡle la.
Anomanta, sɔfo Ɛsra, ir nyu ne, dɛkalkɛ he nɔn taa ɡɛ waa nɔ do.
Yaa che he habɔɔ, dɔ bambile dɛ́ ɛa.” Ate, Ɛsra ir che dɛ ɡel sɔfo nomonome ne Lewi dea tena dɛ Israel tena bwa ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa ɛ ɡɛ Sɛkania aa bola laanee.
Asɛ Ɛsra le Korowii Dea la sie bela dɛ kaa Eliasib bibaa Jehohanan dea.
Waa lɔ bela la, o ta kondikwaa dii dɛ vɛh nee ɡe nyɔe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o tea bini chɔɡɔ, nɛra baa kaa bane bojaŋ harɛfale ta, ba berɛ ba ba kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe la wa.
Anomanta, ba kpɔ kala tɛ ba bola Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam bwa ŋɔ, nɛra baa kaa bane bojaŋ harɛ ta ba berɛ ba la bwa cheme Jerusalam.
Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh a ɡɛ chema nɔ mun bala ka tel tɔpera atoro la, wɛɛ paŋɛ kwaa waa dɔa bwaa, ɡɛ nomonome aa bola la, ásɛ ba berɛ doŋu le o harɛ waa soɡe o ta la ta.
Tɔpera atoro la ne tela la, dɛ baala baa soɡe Juda harɛ ne Bɛnjamen dea harɛ bwa cheme Jerusalam.
Asɛ korobie anuanaarɛ tɔpera fifraanɛ ta la, ba ka so Korowii Dea dembaah bela.
Dɛ bwaala dɛ nɛ kohona, asɛ ba so o bini dɛɛ chel, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba chema la waa hiaoh kohona.
Belaa sɔfo Ɛsra ir che, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe.
Harɛfale ta haahnaa he mo, dɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ba ja bolchɔɡe Israel tena aa dia ta.
Taraken, hé bol he wechɔɡa baɡle Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ, dɛ́ɛ ɛ o bambile bini wa.
Hé laa he te kpɔ harɛfala aa bar heyaa cheme nɔ nɛra, ne haahna baa wola he harɛ ta tena ɛɛ he mo ba la nɛ.” Ate, nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa sɛh takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “He waa la wer dɛ toɡre, yaa ɛ ɡɛ haa bola nɔɔ.” Kɛ ba berɔ bol ja ŋɔ, “Ya warɛ bonɔ asɛ bwaala ɡe ɛɛ nɛ, anomanta, yaa won che o bini wɛɛ kpo yaa ɡɛ.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ ta tɔpebeŋkpoŋ kɛɛ tɔpera anɛ ɡbo waa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ ya nɛra yaa di bolchɔɡe ɡɛ waa nɔ ta warɔ.
Hé ɡel ya nomonome so dɛ́ nyiŋi a ta tɛ ya bwɛɛla bwa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa mo a ɡɛ haahna nɔ bɛl la, bá yerɔ ó ba tɔpere baa doo ta, dɛ́ kpɔ nomonome ne nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole harɛ waa soɡe o ta ja ba.
Kenii dɛ́ ɡel waa nɔ Korowii baah aa di ya nɛɛ a waa nɔ le ya nɛ.” Nɛra la bwa no waa la mun, atane Asahɛl bibaa Jonatan ne Tikva bibaa Jaseya ɡbo.
Mɛsolam ne Sabetai baa ɛ Lewi dea tena la ɡe ja ba nɛ.
Anomanta, nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta ba berɛ ba la sɛh ɡɛ baa bola la ta.
Asɛ sɔfo Ɛsra le baala baa ɛ deene nomonnyuune, asɛ ba chwerɛ bɛlbwa sɔn denaa ta.
Korobie fi tɔpeloɡle ta la, ba soɡe harɛ dɛ nyiŋi waa la ta, korobie atoro ne tela, dɛ ba bol baala baa mo haahna baa wola ba harɛ ta tena ɛɛ la waa tonɛ.
Baala baa mo harɛfala ta haahna Sɔfore naanar bini, nɛra baa mo harɛfala ta haahna laanee teŋa nɔ.
Josadak bibaa Jesua naanar ne o nimanar bini, Maaseya ne Eliesa ne Jarib dɛ Gedalia.
Ba bwa baɡɛ Korowii nyoa ŋɔ baa vɛh ba haahna laanee, asɛ bɛlbwa lawɛ pebal ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha, bolchɔɡe baa dia la wa.
Le Ima naanar ɡe bini, Hanani ne Sebadia.
Le Harim naanar bini, Maaseya ne Elaeja ne Sɛmaya ne Jehiel dɛ Usia.
Le Pasur naanar bini, Elionai ne Maaseya ne Ismael ne Nɛtanɛl ne Josabad dɛ Elasa.
Le Lewi dea tena ɡe bini, Josabad ne Simee ne Kelaya, ba berɔ dɛɛ yerɔ Kelita, ne Pɛtahea ne Juda dɛ Eliesa.
Le yelɡoola ɡe bini, Eliasib.
Le nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo bini, Salum ne Telem dɛ Uri.
Le Israel tena bane ɡe baa kaa bini, Parɔs naanaree nɔ, Ramia ne Isia ne Malkija ne Mijamin ne Eliasa ne Malkija dɛ Bɛnaya.
Le Elam naanar bini, Matania ne Sekaria ne Jehiel ne Abdi ne Jɛremɔt dɛ Elaeja.
Le Satu ɡe naanar bini, Elionai ne Eliasib ne Matania ne Jɛremɔt ne Sabad dɛ Asisa.
Bebai naanar bini, Jehohanan ne Hanania ne Sabai dɛ Atlai.
Le Bani ɡe naanar bini, Mɛsolam ne Maluk ne Adaya ne Jasub ne Seal dɛ Jɛremɔt.
Le Pahat Moab naanar bini, Adna ne Kelal ne Bɛnaya ne Maaseya ne Matania ne Besalɛl ne Binui dɛ Manasɛ.
Le Harim ɡe naanar bini, Eliesa ne Isihija ne Malkija ne Sɛmaya dɛ Simion, ne Bɛnjamen ne Maluk dɛ Sɛmaria.
Dɛ le Hasum ɡe naanar bini, Matinai ne Mataata ne Sabad ne Ɛlefɛlɛt ne Jɛremai ne Manasɛ dɛ Simee.
Bani naanar bini, Maadai ne Amram dɛ Uwɛl, ne Bɛnaya ne Bɛdeya dɛ Keluhi, ne Vania ne Mɛremɔt dɛ Eliasib, ne Matania ne Matinai dɛ Jaasu.
Binui naanar bini, Simee, ne Sɛlɛmia ne Netan dɛ Adaya, ne Maknadibai ne Sasai dɛ Saarai, ne Aasarɛl ne Sɛlɛmia dɛ Sɛmaria, ne Salum ne Amaria dɛ Josef.
Nɛbo ɡe naanar bini, Jeyɛl ne Matitia ne Sabad ne Sebina ne Jadai ne Joel dɛ Bɛnaya.
Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa mo haahna baa wola ba harɛ ta nɛra ɛɛ, hale ba bini bane ne ba haahna loɡle.
Asɛ ba doŋi haahna la ne ba bii bwa kaa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Nehemia Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Pɛɛsea koojen aa tɛo ŋwɛnɛ o ba bwɛjen Jerusalam dɛ ba kwaa ma o danjwɛɛre aa kuuɡa.
Nehemia boa nɛra nyoa baa ma danjwɛɛre la, dɛ berɛ tɔ dɔma ŋwɛnɛ ásɛ ba bɛ won ba chɔɡ toma la.
O kpɔ ɡɛ toma nɔ bwa do Ɛsra nɔn ta ja, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nɛra warɛ dɛ́ ba so Jerusalam dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii o Dea la bini, dɛkalkɛ ba kpɔ ba te tɛ Korowii waa la kɛrɛdɛ.
Nehemia wesoŋa Waa Hakalia bibaa Nehemia aa ɛa laanee teŋa nɔ.
Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ, Keslɛv ta, dɛ men Nehemia lɔ bwɛjen Susa.
Belaa n dɔŋ Hanani ne nɛra bane le Juda harɛ ta dɛ ba.
Asɛ n bɔɔ ba Juu tena baa wona chwa le bojaŋ harɛ baa laɡ ba kaa laa ta, ne bwɛjen Jerusalam wa.
Anee ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Banɔ la baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta la balɔ.
Ba lɔ wahala ne sihiih ta.
Danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la kuuɡo, asɛ bwɛɛ la doonyojen ɡbeni la ɡe, ba fuah a ɛ tɔɔ.” Maa no waa nɔ la, n soɡo dɛ wi.
N wio la sie tɔpere bɛl tama dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, dɛ soŋe Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii haa dɛ di kora nyundua, he kan dɛ do ɔma kohona.
He dɛ teŋɛ fɔo he ne nɛra baa dɛ nyini aa fɔwa, dɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta kasinteŋ ne.
Cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ wesoŋa maa kpɔa dɛɛ bil he sie chɔɔ ne jwaana, he bonɔɔna baa ɛ Israel tena nɔ wa.
N dɛ bol n wechɔɡa ne ya Israel tena bwa kwa, dɛ anɔ la n naawa aa ɛa dɛ jo he nɛɛ bwa.
Ya ɛ nyubinikpeɡ, dɛ jo he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Ya ta waa he fa aa kpɔa tɛ he bonɔɔ Mosis dɛɛ do yaa a ta, ne mmarare la ta teŋɛ.
Lii waa he fa aa do he bonɔɔ Mosis dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ he Israel tena waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe yaa, mɛɛ lɔ heyaa peɡre harɛre ta, kɛ dɛ he berɔ ba n be dɛ ba teŋɛ waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta tenaa, hale dɛ ba lawɛ heyaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ jaɡa kwaraa naa, mɛɛ boa he nyoaa, dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa ba bela maa lea cheɡ ŋɔ baa tom mɛ la.’ N Naa Korowii, ba ɛ he bonɔɔna ne he ɡbaɡba nɛra.
He kpeɡri ne he bokpeɡa nee he lɛɛ ba.
Cheɡ deŋne no n wesoŋa ne he bonɔɔna baa dɛ nyin ba kpɔ duure tɛɛ la wesoŋa.
Gel a chiɡ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ fini, dɛ́ ɡel koojen na n sum.” Gɛ saŋ dɛ menee dɛɛ do Koojen Atasɛksɛs sen.
Nehemia Jerusalam kaala Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora bene fifraanɛ, korobie Nisan ta la, ba ba sen ne ba tɛo.
Asɛ n lɛ dɛ kpɔ ka tɛo.
Dɛ o ta men nae n waa do sum o be bwa.
Anomanta, koojen la bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “He bwara aa hen we, aah bɔkwa waa ɡela he waa do sum he tea bini chɔɡ ken?” Ate, dɛ n dɛ ɔmɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Kórowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ!
Bɔkwaa dɛ́ ɡel n waa aa wola sumii doɔ?
Bwɛjen baa huɡe n naawa o bini paɡrɔ dɛ berɛ dimɡbia, o doonyojen ɡbeni ɡe bwa fuh.” Ate, Koojen Atasɛksɛs ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ n ɛ́ tɛɛ nɔ?” Asɛ n soŋe Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua, dɛ chaŋo ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ he tea too men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛɛ he no n wesoŋa nɔ naa, ɡel ń kaa Juda harɛ ta, bwɛjen Jerusalam baa huɡe n naawa la ta, dɛ́ ka kwaa vɔrɔwo.” Anee koojen la ne o haah waa soɡe o jwɛɛh bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Tɔpera aŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ ba kpɔe dɛ́ tel bela, dɛ́ berɛ ba nɔ?” Dɛ koojen la tea toorɔ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel n kaa, anomanta, n doo tɔpere.
Asɛ n berɛ ŋɔ Koojen Atasɛksɛs be ŋɔ, “Dɛ a too he tea aa, cha mɛ dɛ́ chwerɛ tɔne tɛ mɛ ń kpɔ ka tɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr baŋ harɛre ta la, ásɛ ba nyiŋi n nɛ, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń won kaa Juda harɛ ta sɔnɔnɔɔ.” N berɔ soŋo ŋɔ ó chwerɛ tɔn tɛ mɛ ń kpɔ ka tɛ Asaf waa dɛ nyiŋi koojen kɔne ta la, ásɛ o tɛ mɛ doli maa kpɔ ɛ dekpeɡ la doonyoo aa bɛne Korowii Dea, ne danjwɛkpeɡ waa bar bwɛjen la, dɛ dem maa ka so o ta.
Korowii ja n nɛɛ nomanta, koojen la tɛ mɛ komɛlbwa maa soŋo.
Koojen Atasɛksɛs kpɔ laa nomonome ne banɔ la baa soɡe jaɡre ta ba ja n nɛ, asɛ n la Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ ta, dɛ ka kpɔ tɔne waa chwera tɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi bela harɛre ta la ka tɛɛ ba.
Asɛ Sanbalat waa le Bɛt Hɔrɔn, ne Tobia waa ɛ Amɔn nomonome la bini bɛl noɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛl koh Israel tena kɛrɛdɛ doe wa dɛ ba, asɛ a we ba nɛ.
Nehemia kaa nyiŋi Jerusalam danjwɛɛre Belaa men Nehemia la Jerusalam, maa di bela tɔpera atoro habɔɔ la, baala tama banee ja n nɛ, n ne ba ir jwaana.
N ta waa Korowii aa kpɔa do n liire bini ŋɔ ń ɛ Jerusalam la bolɛ baɡle nomɛlbwa, keeɡo maa soɡe o ta ɡboo, ane ta jae kpa.
Asɛ n kpɔ Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa ta awola jwaana, dɛ kpɔ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kalampoŋa Kɔlɔŋ ne Puldoa Doonyoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Jerusalam danjwɛjena baa kuuɡa, ne ɡɛ baa fuh o doonyoone bwa la.
Ate, n berɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Nee Nyu Doonyoa ne Kooro Tam ta, kɛ dɛ bɔr toole keeɡo maa soɡe o ta la dɔ bɔr kpɔ, anomanta, n kpɔ Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen la bini jwaana la ne, dɛ ha sie dɛɛ nyiŋi danjwɛɛ la.
Asɛ n berɛ habɔɔ dɛ berɛ ka kpɔ Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa la ta dɛ jo bwɛjen la ta.
Nomonome baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta, ta bela maa laŋa kɛɛ waa maa dɛ ɛ jemɛ.
Dɛ n ta wobɛlbwa n bala Juu tena, ne sɔfore ne nomonjena ne nomonome, dɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ba jae dɛ́ ɛ toma la be bolɛ.
Ate, n ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé na waa yaa lɔ a ta!
Jerusalam berɛ dimɡbia, ba fuh o doonyojen ɡbeni.
Hé ɡel ya kwaa ma danjwɛɛ o fa aa baro la, ásɛ sihiih bɛ yaa kpo kpa.” N berɔ ŋɔ ba be ɡɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa sune n nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, ne koojen la waa waa bol n be la.
Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya pa mun kwaa dɛɛ ma.” Anomanta, ba kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ tondɛɛɡa nɔ.
Asɛ Sanbalat waa ɛ Hɔrɔn te, ne Tobia waa ɛ Amɔn tena nomonome la bini bɛl, dɛ Gɛsem o ɡe aa ɛ Arab te noɔ, asɛ ba mamɛ dɛɛ muɡli ya baah ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa hɛɛ ɛ nɔɔ?
Koojenii hɛɛ ba deŋnekpeɡ ɛɛ la.” Asɛ n chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ɛɛ ɡeloo wobɛlbwa kaa kɛrɛdɛ tɛ yaa.
Yan yaa ɛ o bonɔɔnaa ɛɛ pa munii dɛɛ ma.
Kɛ he te nɔn toole Jerusalam komɛlbwa ta.
He toole o saŋ la waa ɡe ta.”
Jerusalam danjwɛɛ kwaara dɛ́ ma Nɛra baa kwaara ma danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam laanee Sɔfonomoa Eliasib ne o bala.
Ba kwaarɔ ma Peera Doonyoa dɛ do o ɡbeni, dɛ ma danjwɛɛ kaa Lafa Dejaŋ ne Hananɛl Dejaŋ ta, dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta.
Asɛ Jeriko baala ɡe kwaa ma choŋi, Imri bibaa Sakur ɡe ne o nɛra ma onɔ la waa teŋa choŋi.
Hasena bibaala ɡe berɛ kwaa ma Pɛŋa Doonyoa, dɛ kpɔ doli dawɛ o ta, dɛ do ɡbeni ne bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ kara.
Uria bibaa Mɛremɔt o nabaa aa ɛ Hakɔs ne o nɛra ɡe ma choŋi.
Bɛrekea bibaa Mɛsolam o nabaa aa ɛ Mɛsesabɛl ne o baala ma choŋi.
Asɛ Baana bibaa Sadɔk ne o baala ɡe ma choŋi.
Tekoa baala kwaarɔ ma bampera, kɛ bwɛɛ la sitɔɔla ta ba te kpɔe ja nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi toma la ta nɛ.
Pasea bibaa Joiada ne Besodiya bibaa Mɛsolam ɡe berɛ kwaa ma Jesana Doonyoa.
Ba kpɔ doli ne ɡbeni do o ta, dɛ kpɔ bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ karɛ ɡbera la do o ta.
Asɛ Melatia waa le Gebeɔn ne Jadɔn waa le Mɛrɔnɔt, ne Gebeɔn dɛ Mispa baala ɡe ma choŋi ka tel harɛ nomoa waa lɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr dem.
Haahaya bibaa Usiel waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema ɡe ma choŋi.
Asɛ Hanania, waa jemɛ nosɔɔhsoma ɛɛ ma choŋi ka tel danjwɛɛ la bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Danjwɛpaɡ la ta.
Hur bibaa Refaya o fa aa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Jerusalam bampera ɡe kwaarɔ ma choŋi.
Asɛ Harumaf bibaa Jedaya kwaa ma choŋi, dɛ bela bɛne o dem.
Asɛ Hasabeneeya bibaa Hatus ɡe kwaa ma choŋi.
Asɛ Harim bibaa Malkija dɛ Pahat Moab bibaa Hasub ɡe kwaa ma bampera bobɛl ne dejaŋ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Fononoo Dejaŋ la.
Halɔhɛs bibaa Salum, o ɡe fa aa ɛ Jerusalam bampera nomoa kwaa ma choŋi.
O bihaahna chao.
Hanun ne nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjen Sanoa ɡe berɛ kwaa vɔrɔwe Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa.
Ba do ɡbera ne bune o ta, dɛ bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ karɔ.
Ba berɔ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la dɛ ka tel Puldoa Doonyoa la ta.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale kaɡboŋ lafraanue.
Puldoa Doonyoa la, Rekab bibaa Malkija o fa aa ɛ Bɛt Hakerem harɛ nomoa la ɡee kwaara mao.
O do ɡbera o nyoa, dɛ do bune o ta ba kpɔ dɛɛ karɔ.
Kol Hose bibaa Salum o fa aa ɛ Mispa harɛ nomoa laanee kwaara ma Nee Nyu Doonyoa.
O tɔɔ dɛ do ɡbeni o nyoa, dɛ do bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ kara.
Onee bera kwaa ma danjwɛɛ waa bar Siloam tam, waa bɛne Kooro bodɛɛɡe waa du daa jwɛh.
O mao ka tel kwaa baa kpɔ a ta tu dɛɛ le Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta.
Asɛ Asbuk bibaa Nehemia, o fa aa ɛ Bɛt Sor harɛ nomoa ɡe kwaa ma choŋi ka tel bobɛl o ne bela baa huɡe Kooro Devid sie aa chaɡɛ dɔŋa, ne tam bɛl baa kwiu, dɛ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Banyoola Dea.
Lewi dea tena baa teŋa nɔ ɡee kwaara ma danjwɛɛ la baŋ bɛla ane choŋi.
Banee, Bani bibaa Rehum waa ɛ ba sitɔɔ, ne Hasabia o fa aa ɛ Keila harɛ nomoa, o ɡee aa maa choŋi tɛ o harɛ tena.
Ba ɡe nɛɛ Henadad bibaa Bavae o ɡe fa aa ɛ Keila harɛ nomoa ne o nɛra teŋɛ dɛ berɛ kwaa ma choŋi.
Asɛ Jesua bibaa Esa o fa aa ɛ nomoa Mispa ɡe berɛ kwaa ma choŋi dea baa dɛ cheɡ dɔmkwa o ta la sie, ka jaɡɛ dea la loŋkora waa ɡoŋa ta.
Sabai bibaa Baruk ɡe kpɔ sibeɡra kwaa ma choŋi o ta, ka tel sɔfo Eliasib dem doonyoa.
Uria bibaa Mɛremɔt, o nabaa sɔne Hakɔs, on ɡe kwaara ma choŋi sɔfo Eliasib dem doonyoa bampera kaa o jaɡa.
Sɔfore baa teŋa nɔɔ bera kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la bamperi ɡalɡa.
Banɔ la baa soɡa bar Jerusalam laanee bera kwaa maa.
Bɛnjamen ne Hasub kwaarɔ ma choŋi.
Bela lɔ ba dem sideŋ.
Asɛ Maaseya bibaa Asaria, baa yerɛ o nabaa Anania ɡe berɛ kwaa ma choŋi.
Bela lɔ o dem jwɛh.
Henadad bibaa Binui ɡe berɔ kwaa ma choŋi le Asaria dem ka jaɡɛ danjwɛɛ la loŋkora bobɛl.
Asɛ Usai bibaa Palal kwaa ma choŋi le danjwɛɛ la loŋkora bela dɛ kaa dejaŋ waa lɔ koodem la nyundua.
O bɛne dembaah bela nɛra aa dɛ daah la.
Asɛ Parɔs bibaa Pɛdaya ɡe kwaa ma choŋi.
Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea dɛ so Ofel deŋɡare ta ɡe kwaa ma choŋi ka tel bobɛl o ne Nee Doonyoa sie aa chaɡɛ dɔŋa, dɛɛ kaa wee leebɔr ne dejaŋ waa tɔ Korowii Dea la ta.
Asɛ Tekoa baala ɡe kwaa ma choŋi le dejaŋ waa tɔ Korowii Dea la bɔr, dɛ ka tel Ofel danjwɛɛ ta.
Sɔfore bane pɛo, dɛ kwaa ma choŋi Jaɡre Doonyoa, weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Bɛlbwa mao chɔŋɛ o dem sie.
Asɛ Ima bibaa Sadɔk berɛ kwaa ma choŋi o dem sie.
Sɛkania bibaa Sɛmaya ɡe berɛ kwaa ma choŋi, dɛ onee dɛɛ daah Wee Leebɔr Doonyoa.
Sɛlɛmia bibaa Hanania, ne Salaf binumɛlte Hanun ɡe berɔ kwaa ma choŋi, asɛ Bɛrekea bibaa Mɛsolam kwaa ma choŋi o dem sideŋ.
Asɛ Malkija waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema, kwaa ma choŋi ka tel bobɛl waa ɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ne bonadiire dem.
O ne Kwaa Nyoa Boara Doonyoa sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa, dɛ teŋɛ kaa danjwɛɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua, o wee leebɔr loŋkora bɔr.
Nɛra baa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema ne bonadiire la kwaarɔ ma danjwɛɛ waa kaa la choŋi, dɛ le dea waa lɔ loŋkora dɛ kaa Peera Doonyoa la ta.
Nehemia di bole o dɔma nɛ o toma ɛɛ ta Sanbalat aa noa kɛŋɔ ya Juu tena berɔ kwaa dɛɛ ma Jerusalam danjwɛjen la, bwaawee lawɔ o baah di taeh, wɛɛ mamɛ yaa.
O cheɡɛ o bala ne Samaria laa tena sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa Juu tena baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ nɔ ɛɛ ɛ nɔɔ?
Baa won berɛ kwaa ma ba danjwɛɛ nɔ cheɡ aa?
Baa won ɛ sarahare aa?
Baa won ɛ sarahare ásɛ dɛ won tonɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo aa?
Baa won berɛ dɔ bwea le anɔ la baa fuah a daŋɛ chɔ nɔ ta naa?” Dɛ Tobia waa ɛ Amɔn te cheɡɛ nomoa la jwɛh.
O ŋɔ, “Danjwɛɛ baa dɛ ma nɔ, hale dɛ kɔkɔbo kwaraa teehno waa, wɛɛ taɡɔ ɡo.” Ate, men Nehemia soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ baa dɛ chɛɡre yaa, ɡel chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡre yaa nɔ ɡure ba nyu ta.
Gel ba paŋɛ komɛlbwa baa dɔa, ásɛ ba laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Bɛ ba bolchɔɡe dii ta tɔ, bɛ ba wechɔɡa soh, dɛkalkɛ ba chɛɡre ya nɛra yaa bera kwaa dɛɛ ma danjwɛɛ la.” Anomanta, ya teŋɔ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la ka tel bela waa kpeɡ ka tel la baah ta tonɛ, dɛkalkɛ nɛra la ɛ toma la sibeɡra ne.
Ate, Sanbalat ne Tobia ne Arab ne Amɔn, dɛ Asdɔd tena aa noa kɛŋɔ Jerusalam danjwɛɛ baa bera kwaa dɛɛ ma la chemo dɛɛ nyin tona la, ba baah diu kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ ba bwa pɛ, dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛŋɔ, bá ba yo Jerusalam, dɛ́ kpɔ sibeɡra ba ta nɛra baa lɔ bela nɛ.
Anee ya soŋe Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ daah toma la webaŋa ne jwaana, dɛ́ tɔ ba ŋwɛnɛ.
A bwa habɔɔ, dɛ Juda tena dɛ ɡo yel bɛl wáa do ba ɡbemba toma la ta ŋɔ, “Tom-ɛɛra la dɛ ɡwɛɡre, berekese aa kuuɡa warɔ, yaa wola won kpɔ dɛ́ berɛ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la.” Ya dɔma la berɔ ŋɔ, “Ba ne ŋɔ ba jemɛ kɛɛ dɛ na yaa la, dɛ ya jo ba bini dɛ́ kpoo ba, ásɛ toma la den ka dɛ́ ba a jaɡa.” Ate, Juu tena baa soɡa bɛne ya dɔma la ba ŋɔ ya be kera fi ne a habɔɔ bwa ŋɔ, “Bobɛlbwa haa kpɔ bwa, baa yo yaa.” Anomanta, men Nehemia, n kpɔ nɛra la bane so danjwɛɛ la habɔɔ bela waa wola nyundua kaalɛ.
N kpɔ ba so denaa ta, ba kpoŋe ba keri ne lampeare ne tori dɛ hɛma.
N iro dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ a ɛ waa tɛ nɛra la, anomanta, n ŋɔ ba ne ba sitɔɔla ne ba nomonome, ne banɔ la baa jaa la bwa be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ban ɔmɛ, hé lii ɡɛ Korowii aa do kan dɛ do ɔma kohona, ásɛ dɛ yo tɛ he bwɛɛ tena, ne he bibaala ne bihaahna, ne he haahna dɛ he deremi.” Ya dɔma noɔ kɛŋɔ ya jemɛ vɔrɔwa baa vɔrɔwa la, dɛ berɛ na kɛŋɔ Korowii chɔɡ ba wa.
Ate, ya bwa berɛ ba danjwɛɛ toma la ta, bɛlbwa baa ɛ o toma.
Le awola tɔpere dɛɛ kaa la, baala la pera ka dɛ ɛ danjwɛɛ la toma, asɛ bane ɡe kpoŋe lampeare, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta, ne tori ne hɛma, dɛ dɔmkwaa bwa soo siwi.
Asɛ ya nomonome ba che ya Juda tena yaa dɛ ma danjwɛɛ la habɔɔ.
Banɔ la baa dɛ che danjwɛɛ la laala la, ba bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛɛ ɛ toma, bɛlbwa kpoŋe dɔmkon nɔn beŋkpoŋ ɡe ta.
Mamaala la bɛlbwa kpɔ kere sɛɡle o kɛɡre ta dɛɛ ɛ toma.
Kɛ nɛn waa dɛ hoh laa bɛla la te soɡe n jwɛh.
Asɛ n ŋɔ nomonome ne sitɔɔla, dɛ nɛra baa kaa la be ŋɔ, “Toma la kan dɛ paɡri kaa, asɛ bɛlbwa ɡe ta o dɔŋ bɛnɛ danjwɛɛ nɔ mun.
Dɛ hé ba dɛ no laa bɛla nɔ sii aa, hé bwa chwa ba ya jwɛh.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ yoo tɛ yaa.” Anomanta, tɔpere bɛlbwaa ya bini bane ɛɛ ɛ toma, asɛ bane ɡe kpoŋe lampeare, dɛ che dɛɛ daah yaa.
Ya dɛ ɛ toma le chɔmbibi ka tel kɛ bɔr aa jo, weweela le.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, n ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Nómɛlbwa ne nɛn waa dɛ chao ɛɛ baa so Jerusalam jwaanaa, dɛ́ won dɛɛ daah bwɛjen nɔ jwaana, dɛ́ bwa berɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma webaŋa ɡe.
N ne n bala ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma dɛ banɔ la baa dɛ daah dɛ ja n nɛɛ la, bɛlbwa ta o laala waa doa la foore bil.
Bɛlbwa dɛ kpoŋe o dɔmkon hale o dɛ nyɔ ne.”
Nehemia nyaara chae Saŋ bɛl, Juu tena la ɡalɡa baala ne haahna bwa pa mun dɛɛ naɡre ba bala Juu tena la wa.
Ba bini bane ŋɔ, “Ya ne ya bii warɔ, ya dɛ nyin kondikwaa dɛ́ di, dɛ́ won so.” Bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Yá kpɔ ya kooni ne daa kooni, dɛ ya deremi cheɡ awɔba, dɛ́ kpɔ nyin kondikwaa cheɡ lɔr saŋ.” Asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Yá kemɛ suuɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ toɔ kooro aa dɛ lɛ yaa ya kooni ne daa kooni ta.
Ya ne ya bala Juu tena bwa beŋkpoŋ.
Gɛɛ ya bii ne ba ɡe bii ɛ kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ ya kpɔ ya bibaala ne bihaahna do ba lɔɡa kɛŋɔ yoma ken, ya bihaahna bane tɔ sie ɛ yoma.
Taraken ya ta kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe kpa, dɛkalkɛ ya kooni ne daa kooni berɛ nɛra bane kwa.” Men Nehemia aa no waa baa dɛ naɡre a waa la, n baah diu kɛrɛdɛ.
N lii a waa n nyu bini taeh, asɛ n kah sitɔɔla ne nomonome la ŋɔ, “He kemɛ he bala Juu tena suuɡa dɛɛ lɛ a ne!” Anomanta, n yerɛ nɛra la bwa cheme, dɛ nyiŋi waa la bini, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ya lɛ ya bala Juu tena baa yoɡ ba te tɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ.
Taraken he ɡe berɔ ɛɡre he ɡbaɡba nɛra ba yoɡ ba te dɛɛ tɛ yaa!” Ate, nomonome la hel, dɛkalkɛ ba ta wobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ bol.
N berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa dɛ ɛ nɔ aa were.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ́ ɛ wa aa toɡra.
Ásɛ dɛ bɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛ ɛ ya dɔma la ŋwɛnɛ tɛ, bá ba mamɛ yaa.
N ne n bala ne n nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma nɔ ɡba dɛ kem ba suuɡa ne kondikwa.
Hé ɡel ya kpɔ kema yaa dɛ kem ba kwaa dɛɛ lɛ a nee la kɛ ba.
Hé kpɔ ba kooni ne daa kooni, ne ɔleve kooni ne deremi, ne suuɡa haa dɛ lɛ a nee bɔre lafa, ne mea ne senfala, dɛ noo la kɛ ba buɡ nɔ ta.” Ate, nomonome la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Yaa berɛ ba kwaa tɛɛ ba, ɡɛ haa bola la, yaa komɛlbwaa lɛ le ba be kpa.” Asɛ n yerɛ sɔfore la cheme, dɛ ɡel sitɔɔla ne nomonome la ŋwɛɛ ntam ba sie kɛŋɔ, baa teŋɛ nyoa baa baɡa la taa.
N ɡe laa yal waa vɔwɛ n chara la kpɔ dɛ jwiiru, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kenii Korowii ɛɛ ba nomɛlbwa waa wola o nyobaɡa ta teŋɛ jwiira ta le o dem, ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa ta, ásɛ o nya so.” Asɛ nomɛlbwa waa lɔ bela ŋɔ, “Aamen!” dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii.
Asɛ nomonome la ɛ ɡɛ baa baɡɛ nyoa la.
Koojen Atasɛksɛs di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ.
Waa di kora bene fifraanɛ ta la, o le men Nehemia mɛɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anɛ.
Gɛ saŋ la bwa la, ba ta men kɛɛ n lolanar kondikwaa aa chɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta tɛɛ n di.
Nomonome baa tɔ n sie nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta mɔɔ la ɛɡre Juda harɛ ta nɛra dɛ lɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanaarɛ, dɛ kondikwaa ne sen. Hale ba bonɔɔna ɡba fiiɡi nɛra la.
Kɛ n te, ɔma maa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii nomanta, n ta ɡɛ ɛɛ.
N kpɔ n liire bwa do Jerusalam danjwɛɛ la kwaara dɛ ma toma ta.
Nɛra baa ja n nɛɛ la bwa chemo, toma la ɛɛ ta, ya ta harɛ bɛlbwa nyine tɛ ya te.
Waa aa jaa ɡee kɛŋɔ, dɛ Juu tena ne ba nomonome lafa fifraanue dɛ di kwaa n be, harɛre nɛra baa bar yaa cheme te ta jae.
Tɔpere bɛlbwaa n ɡel baa kpo nabal ne pedɛɛɡa anumɛl dɛ jala, asɛ tɔpera fi bɛlbwa ɡe, n ɡel baa tɛ sene bwa soo siwi kohona.
Anɔ bɛlbwa la, n ta kondikwaa aa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ tɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ ta waa pɛɛrɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a ɡwaa nɛra la nɛ.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, lii n wa, dɛ́ ɛɛ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, waa bwa maa ɛa tɛ nɛra nɔ wa.
Nehemia waa vɔrɔwa dɛ́ kpoo Sanbalat ne Tobia ne Arab te Gɛsem, dɛ ya dɔma baa kaa aa noa kɛŋɔ n berɔ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la tonɛ, bojeɡaa bɛlbwa ta kae, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ n ta ɡbeni o doonyoone la ta doe mɔɔ la, Sanbalat ne Gɛsem kpɔ kala tɛ mɛ ŋɔ, “Gel ya ne he cheme Ono deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa bwɛjeɡre la bɛl ta.” Dɛ n vɔrɔwaa baa vɔrɔwe dɛ́ che a ta ɛɛ mɛ waane, anomanta, n tomɛ toroma ba be ŋɔ, “Toma maa dɛ ɛ la waa hiaoh kohona, maa won tu ba he be bela.
Maa won ɡel toma la bil dɛ́ ba he be.” Ba kal mɛ ɡɛ kala nɔ kera anaarɛ, asɛ n ɡe kpɔ a ɡɛ kala la tenten tɛɛ ba.
Ate, Sanbalat tomɛ o bonɔɔna la bini bɛl n be anɔ la aa teŋa nue, ɡɛ waa la tenten ne.
Dɛ o kpoŋe tɔn la o nɔn ta, o ta o nyoa marɛ.
Gɛ o bini waa aa dɛ baɡle laanee nɔ.
“Gɛsem ŋɔ men Sanbalat be ŋɔ, harɛre nɛra dɛ bol ŋɔ he ne Juu tena dɛ nyin he pere he te, a waa he berɛ kwaa dɛɛ ma danjwɛɛ la.
Anɔ la aa jaa ɡee kɛŋɔ, he berɔ dɛɛ nyin he cheɡ he ɡbaɡba kora ta.
Hale he le Korowii keamere ŋɔ bá bol nɛra bwa no he waa Jerusalam kɛŋɔ, ‘Kooro bɛl lɔ Juda harɛ ta.’ N jemɔ kɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ tel Pɛɛsea koojen bee, anomanta, ba yá cheme dɛ́ kpɔ a liire.” Anee n tomɛ ba ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Waa haa dɛ bol nɔ bɛlbwa ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ, he ɡbabir nyu bini liiree.” Dɛ ba dɛ nyin ba aah yaa, ásɛ ya bwara yɔr ya ɡel toma la ɛɛ.
Asɛ n soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa!” Awola bɛl, n la Delaya bibaa Sɛmaya dem.
O nabaa sɔne Mɛhetabɛl.
Maa laŋa la, dɛ o laa ɡbera tɔ o nɛ.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Gel n ne he ka sɔh Korowii Dea Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela, dɛ́ laa ɡbeni la tɔ ya nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo.
Baa bao jwaana saŋ nɔ bɔr, dɛ́ ba kpoe.” Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N do ken dɛ́ chwa aa?
Nɛn waa do kɛ men koh n nyu lɛɛ waa dɛ́ chwa ka sɔh Korowii Dea aa?
Akai, maa la!” N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii laa tomɔ, kɛ yawaa Tobia ne Sanbalat yawɔ sen ŋɔ, ó ba bol ɡɛ waa la n be.
Ba kpɔɔ ŋɔ ó ba aah mɛ, ásɛ a che a ta n fee ɛ wechɔɡa, ásɛ ba dɔ n sɔnchɔɡe yerɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ mɛ.
Asɛ n soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, nyiŋi waa Tobia ne Sanbalat aa ɛa nɔ, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne a wa.
Berɛ lii kɛŋɔ he keame bɛl waa ɛ haah baa yerɔ Noadia, dɛ keamere baa jaa ɡe jao dɛɛ aah mɛ ɡɛ.” Toma la tona Ba ma danjwɛɛ la tonɛ Elul korobie tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anue ta, dɛ kpɔ tɔpera fifraanue dɛ anɛ tonɛ toma la bwa.
Ya dɔma aa no waa nɔ la, harɛre nɛra baa soɡa bar yaa la ɔmɔ, ba liire bwa chɔɡ, dɛkalkɛ bɛlbwa nao kɛŋɔ, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laanee cha yaa yá won tonɛ toma la bwa.
Gɛ saŋ la bwa, sitɔɔla baa lɔ Juda harɛ bwa chwerɛ tɔne kaa tɛ Tobia, asɛ o ɡe kwa ɛɛ la ba be, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Juda harɛ ta tena ɡalɡa ja Tobia nɛ.
Dɛ Ara bibaa Sɛkania helabaalee Tobia, asɛ Sɛkania bibaa Jehohanan mo Mɛsolam o mɛɛ aa ɛ Bɛrekea.
Nɛra yon baa bol Tobia wedɛɛɡa bwa waa ɛa n be, dɛ kaa bol anɔ la n ɡe aa bola o be.
Asɛ o teŋɛ chwerɛ tɔne dɛ baa aah mɛ.
Danjwɛɛ la kwaara dɛ ma aa tona asɛ n do o doonyoo ɡbeni la, men Nehemia le nɛra baa so doonyoa la ta dɛɛ daah, dɛ le Korowii Dea yelɡoola ne Lewi dea tena baa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea, dɛ kpɔ ba tomare do ba nɔn ta.
N kpɔ Jerusalam do n dɔŋ Hanani ne Hanania nɔn ta ŋɔ baa nyiŋi o ta.
Dɛ Hanania ɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi dekpeɡ la ta.
O waa dɔ kasinteŋ wɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, o dɔŋ aa wola toole.
N ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ chɔɔbɔr bá ɡel wee ɛɛ baŋɛ mɔɔ baa ya Jerusalam doonyoo ɡbeni la, ásɛ wee joɔ ɡe aa, ba tɔa dɛ́ kaɡra mɔɔ nɛra baa dɛ daahna la le bela.
N berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá le nɛra bane baa daah bwɛɛ la bobɛla, bane ɡe ɛɛ daah ba deremi bɔra.
Nɛra baa bera le bojaŋ harɛfale ta ba sɔna Dɛ Jerusalam kan, kɛ dɛ nɛra baa lɔ o ta aa kanɛ.
Dɛ ba ta berɛ kwaa ma deene a warɛ mɔɔ.
Korowii tɛ mɛ liire kɛŋɔ ń yerɛ bwɛɛ la sitɔɔla ne nomonome, dɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela la cheme, dɛ́ chwerɛ ba sɔna ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ lola ta.
N na banɔ la ba naawa aa tɔ sie le bojaŋ harɛfale ta dɛ ba la.
Kenii ba chwerɛ ba sɔna ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Nɛra Babelɔn Koojen Nebukadnesa aa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn, asɛ ba berɛ won ba Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ ta, dɛ ba so ba bwɛɛre ta laanee teŋa nɔ.
Nomonome baa tɔ ba sie laanee, Sɛrobabɛl ne Jesua ne Nehemia, ne Asaria ne Raamia ne Nahamani, ne Mɔdekae ne Bilsan ne Misperet, ne Biɡvai ne Nehum dɛ Baana.
Baala baa le Israel harɛ taa teŋa nɔ.
Parɔs naanar lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Sɛfatea naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Ara naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
Pahat Moab ne Jesua dɛ Joab luɡe nɛra lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafraanuatoro dɛ fi dɛ banuatoro.
Elam naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ.
Satu naanar lɔ lafraanuatoro fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue.
Sakai naanar lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanumɛl.
Binui naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanaarɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Bebai naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Asɡad naanar lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafraatoro fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Adonikam naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanumɛl dɛ banuanɛ.
Biɡvai naanar lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ fifraanumɛl dɛ banuanɛ.
Adin naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanue dɛ banue.
Ata waa le Hɛsɛkea luɡe ta ɡe naanar lɔ fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Hasum naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Bɛsae naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Harif naanar ɡe lɔ lafa dɛ fi dɛ banɛ.
Gebeɔn naanar lɔ fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banue.
Baala baa le Bɛtlɛham ne Nɛtɔfa lɔ lafa fifraanuatoro dɛ banuatoro.
Baala baa le Anatɔt lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Baala baa le Bɛt Asmavɛt lɔ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
Baala baa le Kiriat Jearim ne Kefira dɛ Beɛrɔt lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ batoro.
Baala baa le Rama ne Geba lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Baala baa le Mikmas lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Baala baa le Bɛtel ne Ai lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
Baala baa le Nɛbo lɔ fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
Baala baa le Elam lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ.
Baala baa le Harim lɔ lafraatoro fifraanɛ.
Baala baa le Jeriko lɔ lafraatoro fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue.
Baala baa le Lod ne Hadid dɛ Ono lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Baala baa le Senaa lɔ kaɡboŋa batoro lafraanuanaarɛ fifraatoro.
Sɔfore baa jaa ɡee nɔ.
Jedaya naanar dɛ le Jesua luɡe ta nɛra lɔ lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ batoro.
Ima naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
Pasur naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banuanɛ.
Harim naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ dɛ fi dɛ banuanɛ.
Lewi dea tena ɡee nɔ.
Jesua naanar dɛ le Kadmiel dɛ Hodavia luɡe nɛra lɔ fifraanuanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Yelɡoola baa jaa ɡee nɔ.
Asaf naanar, ba lɔ lafa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo ɡee nɔ.
Salum ne Ata ne Talmɔn, ne Akub ne Hatita dɛ Sobai naanar, ba lɔ nɛra lafa fifraatoro dɛ banuatoro.
Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ɡee nɔ, ba naanaree, Siha ne Hasufa dɛ Tabaot, Keros ne Sia dɛ Padɔn, Lebana ne Haɡaba dɛ Samlai, Hanan ne Gedɛl dɛ Gahar, Reaya ne Resin dɛ Nekoda, Gasam ne Usa dɛ Pasea, Besai ne Meunim dɛ Nefusesim, Bakbuk ne Hakufa dɛ Haahur, Baslut ne Mehida dɛ Haasa, Baakɔs ne Sisera dɛ Tɛma, Nɛsea ne Hatifa.
Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar ɡee nɔ.
Sotai naanaree, Soferet ne Pɛreda, Jaala ne Daakon dɛ Gedɛl, Sɛfatea ne Hatil, ne Pɔkɛrɛt Hasebaim dɛ Amɔn.
Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ne Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
Nɛra baa teŋa nɔ le bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ Tɛl Mɛla ne Tɛl Hasa, ne Kɛrɔb ne Adon dɛ Ima.
Kɛ ba ta wone chaɡle kɛŋɔ ba lolanar mun le Israel harɛ ta.
Banee nɔ.
Delaya ne Tobia dɛ Nekoda naanar, ba lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
Dɛ le sɔfore ɡe be peraa nɔ, ba naanaree, Hobaya ne Hakɔs dɛ Baasilai.
A ɡɛ Baasilai nɔɔ fa mo Baasilai waa le Gelead bihaah, a che a ta baa yerɔ ɡɛ sɔn nɔ.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɡaaɡe ba naawa luɡe tɔne bini kahonɛ, anomanta, ba kpɔ ba kɛŋɔ nɛra doŋa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ baa wola won ɛ sɔfore.
Asɛ Juda harɛ nomoa ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ baa won di kondikwaa aa do ɡoroŋ bɛlbwa baa kpɔa ba tɛ Korowii laa, atane sɔfo bɛl lɔ bela, dɛ́ do batakaare baa sɔh Urim ne Tumim dawɛ o ta ó che a ta bɔɔ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin la mɔɔ.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ, lafraatoro fifraanumɛl.
Ba bonɔɔna ne toli baa dɛ tomɛ ɡe lɔ kaɡboŋa banuanɛ lafraatoro fifraatoro dɛ banuanɛ.
Dɛ ba berɔ dɔ baala ne haahna yelɡoola lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue.
Ba jaɡre lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraatoro dɛ anumɛl, ba keeɡore aa jweera a loɡle la bii lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue, ba nyoɡmare lɔ lafraanaarɛ fifraatoro dɛ anue ne keeɡore kaɡboŋa anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanɛ.
Nomonnyuune la bini bane le ba bambile bini tɛ kwaa bá berɛ kpɔ cha Korowii Dea toma la.
Nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta tɛ suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore anuatoro ne tama, ne loɡa baa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini, dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ Korowii Dea fifraanue, dɛ sɔfore laala lafraanue fifraatoro.
Nɛra la nomonome la bini bane tɛ kwaa bá kpɔ cha toma la.
Ba tɛ suuɡaswɛm aa tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore lafa fifraanuanɛ, ne suuɡapoŋa aa tɔɡre aa ɛ boyu baaɡe fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ.
Nɛra la kabora kwaa baa tɛa lɔ suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore lafa fifraanuanɛ, ne suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ boyu baaɡe fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ, dɛ sɔfore batakaani fifraanumɛl dɛ anuanɛ.
Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo, ne yelɡoola ne bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea, ne nɛra la bane, dɛ Israel tena baa kaa la bwa kaa so ba bwɛɛre ta.
Ɛsra kure Korowii Mmara baɡle nɛra la Korobinuanɛ te ta la, dɛ Israel tena bwa kaa so ba bwɛɛre ta.
Asɛ o tɔpeloɡle ta ba bwa ba cheme Nee Doonyoa la sie Jerusalam kɛŋɔ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ bii.
Asɛ ba ŋɔ sɔfo Ɛsra ne tɔnjereme la be ŋɔ, ó kpɔ Korowii Mmara Tɔn o fa aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la ba.
Anomanta, korobie la tɔpeloɡle ta, sɔfo Ɛsra kpɔ Mmara Tɔn la, dɛ ba che baala ne haahna, dɛ bechale baa kpeɡa dɛ won waa mun noe sie.
O kure tɔn la Nee Doonyoa la sie, nɛnlaa la sie, le chɔmbibi ka tel kɛŋɔ wee aa baa che nyufala, asɛ ba bwa cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no waa aa lɔ Mmara Tɔn la bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ ba koh waa la waa dɛ kpɔ daa kwaa komɛl o kaa nyundua, asɛ Ɛsra ka che o ta.
Asɛ Matitia ne Sema ne Anaya, ne Uria ne Hilkia dɛ Maaseya che o diɡ pera.
Pɛdaya ne Mesael ne Malkija, ne Hasum ne Hasbadana ne Sekaria, dɛ Mɛsolam ɡe cheɡɛ o ɡal ta.
Ɛsra kaa che kon waa kaa nyundua la ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nomɛlbwa won dɛɛ nao.
Waa pili tɔn la asɛ nomɛlbwa den ir che.
Anee Ɛsra ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii waa ɛ Korowijen la.” Asɛ nɛra la bwa ir nɔɔra nyundua dɛ ŋɔ “Aamen, Aamen” Ba ɡuŋo, dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ tomɛ Korowii.
Ate, nɛra la ir che, asɛ Jesua ne Bani ne Sɛrebea, ne Jamin ne Akub ne Sabetai, ne Hodia ne Maaseya ne Kelita, ne Asaria ne Josabad ne Hanan, dɛ Pɛlaya, baa ɛ Lewi dea tena la baɡle Mmara la bini dɛɛ baɡ ba.
Ba kure Korowii Mmara Tɔn la, a bini chɔ chasee ken, asɛ nɛra la jemɛ dɛ no waa baa kura la mun kɛrɛdɛ.
Ate, Nehemia waa ɛ harɛ la ta nomoa, ne sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme, dɛ Lewi dea tena baa baɡle waa la bini tɛ nɛra la ŋɔ, “Fini tɔpere do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, he bɛ wi.” Dɛkalkɛ nɛra la aa dɛ no waa la, dɛ ba dɛ wi.
Nehemia ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé kaa dem, dɛ́ ka di he silɛɛ kondikwa, dɛ́ nyɔ sensoma, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ane ka tɛ banɔ la baa wola ane dɔe.
Fini tɔpere nɔ do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ.
He bɛ suna di, dɛkalkɛ silɛɛ Korowii aa tɛ heyaa la ɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ bokpeɡa.” Asɛ Lewi dea tena larawe nɛra la bwara dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé hel jeiih ken, fini tɔpere nɔ do ɡoroŋ, he bɛ suna dɛɛ di.” Ate, nɛra la bwa la ka di kwaa la dɛ nyɔ sen silɛɛ kohona ne, dɛ kpɔ ane kɛ banɔ la baa wola dɔe, dɛkalkɛ ba no waa baa bola baɡ ba la mun kɛrɛdɛ.
Kukure Tɔpejen dii Korobie anuanɛ tɔpenɛɛte ta la, nomonnyuune ne sɔfore, dɛ Lewi dea tena la kaa cheme Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme be, o baɡ ba Mmara waa la ja.
Ba nao kɛŋɔ Mmara Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la ŋɔ kukure lɔɡree chɛ kɛ Israel tena so, dɛ́ di Kukure Tɔpejen la korobinuanɛ ta, dɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ Korowii waa la perɛ ba bwɛɛre ne Jerusalam bwa, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé la deŋɡarere harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka teŋni dadɛɛɡa, ne ɔleve daa kpala, dɛ bambie ne daa bwa soo siwi kpala, ne a papooni, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ kukure ɡɛ baa chwera do Mmara Tɔn bini la.” Asɛ nɛra la ir ka nyin daa kpala la, dɛ ba ɛ kukure ba saldor, ne ba dembaahna ne Korowii Dea dembaahna, ne Nee Doonyoa sie bela nɛra aa dɛ cheme, dɛ Efrem Dea Doonyoa la sie.
Nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta la bwa berɔ ba, dɛ ba do kukure, dɛ so a bini, dɛ di Kukure Tɔpejen la.
Dɛ le Nun bibaa Josua bere saŋ ba ɡɛ tɔpere la ta la, Israel tena ta Tɔpejen nɔ ken dii bwa.
Ba sie lɛo kohona.
Sɔfo Ɛsra kure Korowii Mmara Tɔn la bini waa baɡle nɛra tɔpere bɛlbwa, le Tɔpejen la tɔpeloɡle ta ba kaa tɔpere waa ka mun ta.
Ba di Kukure Tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ, asɛ tɔpenuatoro wee la, ba cheme ɡɛ Mmara la aa baɡla la.
Israel tena bol ba wechɔɡa Korobinuanɛ la tenten, tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ ta, Israel tena chemo dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, dɛ kpɔ lweyale tɔ, dɛ ɛ teera do ba nyuune ta, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba tea bini chɔɡɔ ba wechɔɡa wa.
Ba bini banɔ la baa ɛ Israel tena naanar la, pere ba te le banɔ la baa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra naanar la bini, dɛ ka che dɛ bol ba wechɔɡa, ne ba naawa nyubinikpeɡ waa baɡle Korowii.
Ba cheɡɛ bela baa cheɡa, dɛ he bɔne tɔpebir bini bɔre anaarɛ naa, ba kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ kure Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ Mmara Tɔn la bini waa baɡ ba.
Asɛ dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ɡe bol ba wechɔɡa, asɛ dɛ tomɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la.
Asɛ Jesua ne Bani ne Kadmiel, ne Sebania ne Buni ne Sɛrebea, ne Bani dɛ Kanani baa ɛ Lewi dea tena la, ir ka che komɛl waa kaa nyundua ta, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ kohona yerɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ.
Ate, Jesua ne Kadmiel ne Bani, ne Hasabeneeya ne Sɛrebea ne Hodia, ne Sebania dɛ Pɛtahea ba ɡe aa ɛ Lewi dea tena la ŋɔ, “Hé ir che dɛ́ kpɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, onee lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Bɛ́lbwa kpɛɛ o sɔn waa dɔ jirima la, o kan ɡwaa ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini aa kpɔ nyoa bol.
He ɡboo Korowii, henee ta nyundua ne weweela bwa.
Henee ta harɛ ne mpo, dɛ kwaa aa lɔ a ta bwa, dɛ ɡel a bwa do le.
Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa dɛ ɡuŋi.
N Naa Korowii, henee le ya naa Abram, dɛ kpɔɔ le Ur waa lɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta, asɛ dɛ beɡre o sɔn Abraham.
He nao kɛŋɔ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛɛ, asɛ he ne o fɔwɛ fɔo.
He baɡɔ nyoa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔ Keenan ne Hiti ne Amɔre, ne Pɛrɛs ne Jebus, dɛ Girɡasi tena harɛree tɛ o naanar ba so a ta.
He teŋɛ he nyobaɡa ta, dɛkalkɛ he waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
He na wahala ya naawa aa naa Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ no ba wii Mposwɛm la ta, dɛ cha ba.
He ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla baɡle Ijipt kooro, ne o nomonome dɛ harɛ la tena bwa.
Dɛkalkɛ he na ɡɛ baa fiiɡi he nɛra, dɛ lɛ sɔn o ta chɔ le ba le fini.
He ɡelɔ ŋwɛnɛ chɔ mpo bini tɛ he nɛra, dɛ tɔ ba sie ba valɛ harɛ waa hola ta.
He ɡelɔ ba dɔma baa dɛ ti ba ka nee la ta, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ bwe ta mpo vil ta ken.
He cheɡɛ bam waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua tɔ ba sie webaŋa, jwaana ɡe, he kpɔ nii waa tɛra kaa nyundua tɔ ba sie wɛɛ chaah ba won vala.
He le nyundua ba Sinai Bwejen ta, dɛ ba bol waa baɡle he nɛra, dɛ kpɔ waa aa wera ne webaɡla aa toɡra baɡ ba.
He ŋɔ báa di he Ona Tɔpera a do ɡoroŋ, dɛ che he bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ kpɔ he Mmarare tɛɛ ba.
Lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba la, he tɛɛ ba kondikwaa le nyundua, nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo ba la, he ɡelɔ nee le bwe ta tɛɛ ba ba nyɔ.
He ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ harɛ haa baɡ ba nyoa ŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba la.
Kɛ ya naawa ɛ mbarafo ne deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ vɛh waa haa do ba a ta la ta teŋa.
Ba vɛh he waa la ta teŋa, dɛ soh nyokpowe-ɛɛla bwa haa ɛa.
Ba ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ, dɛ le nomoa ŋɔ ó berɛ kpɔ ba kaa ba somanjiri dii ta Ijipt harɛ.
Kɛ he ɛ Korowii haa kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ, he dɔ tedoma dɛɛ nyin nɛn, he baah aa di warawara ɡe.
He tedoma haa dɔa tɛ nɛra kan, he ta ban tae.
Ba ɛ voɡ waa do kɛ nabale, dɛ ŋɔ onee tɔ ba sie le bane Ijipt harɛ ta.
N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ baa bole nɛnhɛlwobol.
Kɛ he ta ban ɡelɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela, dɛkalkɛ tedoma haa dɔa tɛ nɛra kan kohona.
He ta bam kɛɛ nii waa tɔ ba sie dɛɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ webaŋa ne jwaana laa kpɔ.
He kpɔ he Doma waa wera tɛɛ ba wɛɛ baɡ ba wa, dɛ tɛɛ ba maana ba di, dɛ tɛɛ ba nee ɡe ba nyɔ.
He nyiŋi ba nɛɛ bene fifraanaarɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ tɛɛ ba komɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.
Ba bwara laala ta kɛɛrɛ, ba napaala ta ɔɡrɛ.
He ɡelɔ ba yo dɛ pɔ koranar ne harɛre nɛra nɛ, harɛre aa lɔ ba jwɛh ta.
Ba yo Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon, ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ lɛ ba harɛre.
He tɛɛ ba bii ba warɛ kɛŋɔ weweela ken, dɛ ɡel ba yo nɛra dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ so harɛ haa baɡɛ ba naawa ŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba la ta.
Ba naanar laŋɔ ka yo dɛ kpɔ harɛ la, o ɛ ba kon.
He tɔ ba sie dɛ sɔɔh nɛra baa soɡe harɛ la ta nyoa, dɛ tɛ he nɛra kpeɡri ba pɔ Keenan harɛ koranar ne nɛra baa lɔ bela nɛ, dɛ ɛɛ ba ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin.
He nɛra yoo dɛ pɔ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara nɛ, ne harɛpare ondɛɛɡe, ne deremi kondɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi aa lɔ a ta, ne bɔɔne baa kwia a won nee lɛɛ, ne ɡrepo daa kooni ne ɔleve daa kooni, dɛ daa baa dɛ di a nɔna bwa soo siwi aa wara.
Ba diu vaɡre dɛ je, ba sie lɛ kondɛɛɡa kohona haa tɛɛ ba la wa.
Kɛ ba ɛɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ le he habɔɔ.
Ba laa ba liire kpɔ he Mmara ta teŋa ta.
Ba kpoo he keamere baa kah ba ŋɔ, bá charɛ ba liire ba he be la.
Ba bol wedoŋa dɛ taah he sɔn la.
Anomanta, he ɡelɔ ba dɔma yoo ba, dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ fiɡ ba.
Kɛ ba wenaale ta la, ba wio noe asɛ he no le nyundua dɛ cha ba.
He cheɡɛ tedoma haa dɔa kohona ta dɛ le nomonome tɛɛ ba, ba ba lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta.
Deŋnesɔɔhna aa bala la, ba berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa ja, asɛ he ɡel ba dɔma ba yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ ja.
Kɛ baa charɛ ba liire dɛ wi noe ŋɔ hé lɛɛ ba la, he dɔ tedoma dɛ no le nyundua, dɛ teŋɛ no ba be, dɛ lɛɛ ba.
He kah ba ŋɔ baa teŋɛ he webaɡla ta, kɛ ba ɛ mbarafo ba ta he Mmarare ta teŋɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ he waa ta teŋa taa dɛɛ tɛ mkpa.
Ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoe, dɛ vɛh he waa ta teŋa.
He dɔ bambile tɛɛ ba bena bɛlbwa, dɛ che he Doma ta ɡel he keamere bol waa baɡ ba, kɛ ba ta noɛ, asɛ he kpɔ ba do harɛre nɛra nɔn ta, ba yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Kɛ he nɛn nɛɛ suna aa kana nomanta, he ta ban vɛɛh kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡ ba.
He ɛ Korowii haa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ na ba sum.
Nemenɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he kan dɛ do kpeɡri, he waa ɔma kohona.
He waa dɔ kasinteŋ hɛɛ teŋɛ fɔo he ne ya naawa aa fɔwa ta.
Dɛ le saŋ Asiiria koranar aa fiiɡi yaa dɛ ba le saŋ nɔ, na ɡɛ ya bwara aa nyɛɡa.
Ya koranar ne nomonome, ne sɔfore ne Korowii keamere ne ya naawa, dɛ nɛra bwa na bonyɛɡa, na ɡɛ ya bwara aa nyɛɡa.
He waa toɡrɔ dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ he tɛr ya deŋne, a lole kɛŋɔ ya ɛ wechɔɡa.
Ya koranar ne nomonome ne sɔfore, dɛ ya naawa ta he Mmarare ta teŋɛ.
Ba ta waa haa do ba a ta ne waa haa kah ba ta teŋɛ.
He swee koranar andɛɛɡa ba nyiŋi he nɛra nɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa soɡe harɛpare ondɛɛɡe waa kana he kpɔ tɛɛ ba la ta, kɛ ba vɛh ba liire chara, dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta dɛ tomɛ.
Taraken, ya berɛ yoma harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ yaa ta, harɛ o fe aa wera kohona ya dɔ kondikwaa dɛɛ di o ta la ta.
Ya wechɔɡa nomanta, harɛ la ta kondikwaa bwa dɛ kaa koranar yaa lɔ ba lɔɡa be.
Gɛ baa dɛ nyin laanee baa ɛ ya ne ya kondɛɛra, anomanta, ya lɔ wahala kohona ta.
Nɛra la fɔo fɔwa Anɔ bwa aa chiɡa nomanta, ya Israel tena dɛ baɡɛ nyoa dɛ́ chwera, ásɛ ya nomonome ne Lewi dea tena dɛ sɔfore kpɔ ba nonibala ɛɡre fɔo nɔ lɔɡa.”
Nɛra baa kpɔ ba nɔɔra ɛɡre do nyoa baa baɡa dɛ chwera la lɔɡa laanee, men Hakalia bibaa Nehemia maa ɛ harɛ la ta nomoa, ne Sedekia, ne Seraya ne Asaria dɛ Jeremia, ne Pasur ne Amaria dɛ Malkija, ne Hatus ne Sebania dɛ Maluk, ne Harim ne Mɛremɔt dɛ Obadia, ne Daneɛl ne Gineton dɛ Baruk, ne Mɛsolam ne Abija dɛ Mijamin, ne Maasia ne Bilɡai dɛ Sɛmaya.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ sɔfore.
Lewi dea tena baa jaa laanee nɔ, Asania bibaa Jesua ne Binui waa le Henadad dea dɛ Kadmiel, ne ba daamanar, Sebania, ne Hodia ne Kelita ne Pɛlaya dɛ Hanan, ne Mika ne Rehob dɛ Hasabia, ne Sakur ne Sɛrebea dɛ Sebania, ne Hodia ne Bani dɛ Bɛneno.
Harɛ la ta nomonome laanee nɔ, Parɔs ne Pahat Moab ne Elam ne Satu dɛ Bani, ne Buni ne Asɡad dɛ Bebai, ne Adonija ne Biɡvai dɛ Adin, ne Ata ne Hɛsɛkea dɛ Asuur, ne Hodia ne Hasum dɛ Bɛsae, ne Harif ne Anatɔt dɛ Nebai, ne Maɡpias ne Mɛsolam dɛ Hesir, ne Mɛsesabɛl ne Sadɔk dɛ Jadua, ne Pɛlatea ne Hanan dɛ Anaya, ne Hosia ne Hanania dɛ Hasub, ne Halɔhɛs ne Pelha dɛ Sobek, ne Rehum ne Hasabena dɛ Maaseya, ne Ahia ne Hanan dɛ Anan, ne Maluk ne Harim dɛ Baana.
Nɛra la kabora baa kaa, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa, ne yelɡoola ne bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea, dɛ nɛra baa koh Korowii Mmara la ta teŋa waa dɛ pere ba te le harɛre nɛra baa soɡa bar ba nɛ, ne ba haahna ne bibaala ne bihaahna baa dɛ no waa mun.
Ba bwa kpɔ ba te ja ba sitɔɔla nɛɛ dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam kɛŋɔ, baa teŋɛ Korowii Mmara waa cheɡɛ o bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ la taa, dɛ́ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa waa do ba a ta ne o webaɡla bwa ta.
Ba ŋɔ, dɛ ba ta a ta teŋaa, Kórowii taah ba.
Ya baɡɛ nyoa kɛ yaa ya bihaahnaa kpɔ tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡa bar yaa la yal, kɛɛ ba bihaahna ɡe tɛ ya bibaala ba mo ba.
Dɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡa bar yaa yoɡ mea kɛɛ komɛlbwa tɛ yaa Ona Tɔpere kɛɛ tɔpere waa do ɡoroŋ bɛlbwa ta naa, yaa yawɛ.
Bene anuanɛ bɛlbwa ta la, yaa ɡel ya harɛre ta paraa, dɛ́ kpɔ kema nɛra aa di yaa ɡe kɛ.
Ya sɛoh kɛŋɔ bena bɛlbwa yaa bɔ suuɡabwe jeɡaa, dɛ́ kpɔ cha Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea kema.
Kema kɛŋɔ, paanoo waa do ɡoroŋ bá kpɔ dawɛ teebur ta, ne mea sarahare baa dɛ ɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa, ne sarahare baa dɛ fuah, ne Ona Tɔpera sarahare, ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, ne tɔpejena baa lea cheɡ, ne sarahare kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ, ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare baa kpɔ soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa, dɛ tomare bwa aa lɔ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea.
Ya sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne nɛra la bwa ta bie, dɛ́ jemɛ dem bɛlbwa tena baa kpɔ damara ba Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea benanyoa bɛlbwa, bá kpɔ fuh sarahare kwaa la Korowii saraha kon la ta, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Mmara Tɔn bini la.
Ya bwa berɔ sɛh kɛŋɔ benanyoa bɛlbwa, yá kpɔ ya koo kondikonloɡla, ne daa bɛlbwa nɔna aa tɔ sie dɛɛ ba Korowii Dea.
Yaa kpɔ ya bibanloɡla ne nae biloɡla, ne ya boohna ne peera biloɡlaa ba Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea ba tɛ sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma bela la, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Mmara Tɔn bini la.
Yaa kpɔ ya kondikonloɡlaa la Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea, bela baa dɛ cheɡ kwaa la, dɛ́ kpɔ ka tɛ sɔfore la, ya mendɛɛɡa ne mea sarahare, ne ya daa nɔna, ne senfala dɛ ɔleve no.
Yaa bɔne komɛlbwa aa le ya kooni ta bɔre fii, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ka tɛ Lewi dea tena la, dɛkalkɛ banee dɛɛ lɛa ya bwɛɛre bwa ta.
Sɔfo waa le Arɔn luɡe ta teŋɛ Lewi dea tena baa dɛ lɛ kwaa nɛra aa bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋa dɛɛ ba a ne la nɛ, ásɛ Lewi dea tena la kpɔ anɔ la baa lɛa la bɔre fi bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ba Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea.
Dɛ́ kpɔ ba cheɡ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa la bini.
Israel tena ne Lewi dea tena la kpɔ ba mea ne senfala, dɛ ɔleve noo la kaa dejeɡre baa dɛ cheɡ laala baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la bini, bela sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma ne nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo dɛ yelɡoola aa dɛ so la.
Yaa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea vɛh.
Nɛra baa bera ba so Jerusalam Aa ba dɛ la sie tama la, harɛ la ta nomonome baa so Jerusalam, asɛ nɛra la kabora bil daa, dɛ le dembeŋkpoŋ nɛra le deremi fi bɛlbwa bini, ba ba so Jerusalam bwɛjen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, asɛ banuanaarɛ kar la ɡe ka so ba bwɛɛre ta.
Asɛ harɛ la ta tena jam nɛra baa le ba te cheɡ ŋɔ baa so Jerusalam la bwa.
Nɛra la bini bane baa soɡe bwɛɛre ne bwɛjena ta laanee, Israel tena la bini bane, ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, ne bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea.
Dɛ Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar soɡe Juda bwɛɛre ane ta.
Bɛlbwa kaa so o ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ waa le o ta, asɛ nɛra la bane le Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene ta, dɛ ba so Jerusalam.
Nɛra baa teŋa nɔɔ le Juda dea.
Ussia bibaa Ataya waa ɛ Sekaria naa.
O nabaala baa jaa nɔ, Amaria ne Sɛfatea dɛ Mahalalel, ba bwa ɛ Pɛrɛs waa ɛ Juda bibaa naanar.
Dɛ Baruk bibaa Maaseya, o nabaa aa ɛ Kol Hose.
O naawa baa jaa laanee Hasaya ne Adaya ne Joiarib, dɛ Sekaria ba bwa aa ɛ Seela waa ɛ Juda bibaa naanar.
Pɛrɛs naanar baa soɡe Jerusalam lɔ lafraanaarɛ fifraanumɛl dɛ banuatoro, ba ɛ baala baa kpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ.
Nɛra baa le Bɛnjamen dea laanee nɔ, Mɛsolam bibaa Sallu waa ɛ Joed naa.
O naawa baa jaa laanee, Pɛdaya ne Kolaya ne Maaseya ne Itiel dɛ Jesaya, ne Gabai ne Salai baa ɛ Sallu lolanar tenten.
Bɛnjamen dea nɛra baa kaa so Jerusalam la bwa lɔ lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Dɛ Sikri bibaa Joel ɛ ba sitɔɔ, asɛ Hasenua bibaa Juda ɛ nomoa waa teŋa nɛɛ dɛ ja o nɛ bwɛjen la ta.
Sɔfore ɡee teŋa nɔ, Joiarib bibaa Jedaya ne Jakin, dɛ Hilkia bibaa Seraya o nabaa aa ɛ Mɛsolam.
O nabaalaa Sadɔk ne Merayɔt dɛ Ahitub o fa aa ɛ Sɔfonomoa.
Dɛ ba bwa lɔ lafraanuatoro fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ, dɛ le sɔfore dea dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea.
Jɛroham bibaa Adaya o nabaa sɔne Pɛlalia.
O nabaala bane ɡee, Amsi ne Sekaria ne Pasur dɛ Malkija.
O ne o bala baa ja o nɛɛ dɛ ɛ nomonnyuune la, ba lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
Aasarɛl bibaa Amasae o nabaa aa ɛ Asai, o nabaala bane ɡee Mɛselɛmɔt dɛ Ima.
O ne o bala baa ja o nɛɛ lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
Dɛ ba ɛ laa tena baa kpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba sitɔɔ sɔne Sabdiel, o mɛɛ ɡe sɔne Haɡedolim.
Lewi dea tena ɡee nɔ, Hasub bibaa Sɛmaya, o nabaa sɔne Asrikam.
O nabaala bane ɡee Hasabia ne Buni, ne Sabetai ne Josabad baa ɛ Lewi dea nomonnyuune.
Dɛ ba ɡee Korowii Dea habɔɔ toma do ba nɔn ta.
Mika bibaa Matania, o nabaa sɔne Sabdi, o ɛ Asaf naa.
Dɛ Asaf nɔɔ dɛɛ tɔ yelɡoola sie Korowii Dea baa ɡo jam yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, ne Bakbukia, onee ja Matania nɛɛ dɛɛ chao, ne Samoa bibaa Abda, o nabaa aa ɛ Galal o ɛ Jedutun naa.
Dɛ Lewi dea tena baa soɡe bwɛjen Jerusalam waa do ɡoroŋ la bwa lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanuatoro dɛ banaarɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa laanee, Akub ne Talmɔn dɛ ba lolanar, ba bwa lɔ lafa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.
Israel tena baa kaa la ne sɔfore dɛ Lewi dea tena, soɡe ba ɡbaɡba bwɛɛre aa lɔ Juda harɛ ta.
Dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea soɡe Jerusalam bampera, Ofel deŋɡare ta, asɛ Siha ne Gispa ɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi Lewi dea tena baa soɡe Jerusalam nɛɛ sɔne Usi.
O mɛɛ sɔne Bani, o nabaalee Hasabia.
O nabaala bane ɡee Matania ne Mika.
Dɛ Usi ɛ Asaf naanar baa chɔ yela ɡoe nyoa Korowii Dea la bini bɛl.
Dɛ Pɛɛsea koojen do mmara tɛ yelɡoola la, ɡɛ dea bɛlbwa nɛra aa tɔ nɛra sie tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛɛ ɡo yela Korowii Dea.
Mɛsesabel bibaa Pɛtahea waa ɛ Sɛra naanar la bini bɛl dɛ le Juda dea, chiɡ Israel tena naa ta Pɛɛsea koodem.
Juu tena la ɡalɡa soɡe bwɛɛre aa bɛne ba kooni ta.
Banɔ la baa le Juda dea la soɡe bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ, Kiriat Aaba ne Debɔn dɛ Jekabsiil ne bwɛjeɡre aa bara ta, ne bwɛjena ane kɛŋɔ, Jesua ne Molada dɛ Bɛt Pɛlɛt, dɛ Hasar Sual ne Beɛseeba dɛ bwɛjeɡre aa bara ta, ne Siklaɡ ne Mekona dɛ bwɛjeɡre aa bara ta, ne Ɛn Remɔn ne Sora dɛ Jaamut, ne Sanoa ne Adulam dɛ a bwɛjeɡre ta, ne Lakes ne kooni aa baro ta, ne Aseka ne o bwɛjeɡre ta.
Gɛɛ ba so le Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ teŋe ba kaa Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen weekaŋle nyundua.
Bɛnjamen dea tena soɡe Geba ne Mikmas ne Aeja dɛ Bɛtel ne bwɛjeɡre aa bara ta, ne Anatɔt ne Nɔb dɛ Anania, ne Hasɔ ne Rama dɛ Getaim, ne Hadid ne Seboim dɛ Nebalat, ne Lod ne Ono, dɛ Baala Baa Dɛ Sɛh Kwaa Fɛlembɔjen bini.
Lewi dea tena la bini bane baa le Juda dea la koo Bɛnjamen dea tena la bini, ba ne ba so.
Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena baa teŋɛ Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne Sɔfonomoa Jesua nɛɛ ba le bojaŋ harɛ baa laɡ ba kaa ta ba laanee nɔ.
Seraya ne Jeremia dɛ Ɛsra, ne Amaria ne Maluk dɛ Hatus, ne Sɛkania ne Rehum dɛ Mɛremɔt, ne Ido ne Gineton dɛ Abija, ne Mijamin ne Moadia dɛ Bilɡa, ne Sɛmaya ne Joiarib dɛ Jedaya, dɛ Sallu ne Amɔk ne Hilkia dɛ Jedaya.
Banɔɔ sɔfore sitɔɔla ne banɔ la baa dɛ cha ba, Jesua bere saŋ.
Lewi dea tena ɡe sɔnaa, Jesua ne Binui ne Kadmiel, ne Sɛrebea ne Juda dɛ Matania, ne o bala baa ja o nɛ.
Banee chɔ yela baa ɡoa dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii Dea la nyoa.
Asɛ Bakbukia ne Uni dɛ ba bala baa ja ba nɛɛ ɡe che Korowii Dea bampera, ba ne ba sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa baa ɡo yela la ane.
Sɔfonomoa Jesua naanar Jesua lolɛ Joiakim, Joiakim lolɛ Eliasib asɛ Eliasab lolɛ Joiada, Joiada lolɛ Jonatan, Jonatan lolɛ Jadua.
A saŋ Joiakim aa ɛ Sɔfonomoa la, dɛ banɔɔ nomonnyuune ba lolanar bini, Seraya lolanar bini, Meraya, Jeremia lolanar bini, Hanania, Ɛsra lolanar bini, Mɛsolam, Amaria lolanar bini, Jehohanan, Maluk lolanar bini, Jonatan, Sɛkania lolanar bini, Josef, Harim lolanar bini, Adna, Mɛremɔt lolanar bini, Helkai, Ido lolanar bini, Sekaria, Gineton lolanar bini, Mɛsolam, Abija lolanar bini, Sikri, Miniamin ne Moadia lolanar bini, Peltae, Bilɡa lolanar bini, Samoa, Sɛmaya lolanar bini, Jehonatan, Joiarib lolanar bini, Matinai, Jedaya lolanar bini, Usi, Sallu lolanar bini, Kalai, Amɔk lolanar bini, Iba, Hilkia lolanar bini, Hasabia, Jedaya ɡe lolanar bini, Nɛtanɛl.
Ba chwerɛ Lewi dea nomonnyuune ne sɔfore sɔna bil ɡɛ saŋ Sɔfonomonome ba sɔna aa teŋa nɔ aa lole.
Banee, Eliasib ne Joiada ne Johanan, dɛ Jadua.
Ba chwerɛ ɡɛ sɔna nɔ tonɛ ɡɛ saŋ Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta.
Ba chwerɛ Lewi dea tena nomonnyuune sɔna do tɔne bini, ɡɛ saŋ Eliasib bibaa Johanan aa lole.
Dɛ Lewi dea tena nomonome laanee, Hasabia ne Sɛrebea dɛ Kadmiel bibaa Jesua, dɛ ba bala baa ja ba nɛ.
Ba bɔne ba bini kuore anɛ, beŋkpoŋ dɛ ɡo yela asɛ beŋkpoŋ ɡe ɛɛ sɛh ba nyoa.
Ba bwa pɛo dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ dɛɛ jam Korowii, ɡɛ Korowii nɛn Kooro Devid aa baɡla la.
Dɛ Matania ne Bakbukia ne Obadia, ne Mɛsolam ne Talmɔn dɛ Akub, dɛ daah dejeɡre baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini a bɛne Korowii Dea doonyoo la.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Jesua bibaa Joiakim, o nabaa aa ɛ Josadak, ne Nehemia waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta, dɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme la lole.
Jerusalam danjwɛɛ kpɔe dɛ́ do Korowii nɔn ta Baa dɛ ba bwɛjen Jerusalam danjwɛɛ baa maa baro kpɔe dɛ́ do Korowii nɔn ta la, ba yerɛ Lewi dea tena le bobɛlbwa baa soɡa ba.
Asɛ ba ba ja, dɛ ɡo jam yela, dɛ kpɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ lɔ yela lɛ ba sie.
Lewi dea tena baa dɛ ɡo yela la boa ba nyoa le bwɛɛre aa bar Jerusalam, dɛ Nɛtɔfa tena bwɛɛre ta, ne Bɛt Gelɡal ne Geba dɛ Asmavɛt, dɛkalkɛ dɛ yelɡoola la ma ba deene dɛ so bar Jerusalam.
Sɔfore la ne Lewi dea tena la ɛ we-ɛɛla, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ Korowii be pera, ne nɛra la ne doonyoo, dɛ danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen la bwa ta.
Ate, men Nehemia yerɛ Juda nomonome la cheme danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen la doa, dɛ ɡel ba chɔ yelɡoola kuore anɛ aa kana nyoa ŋɔ, bá valɛ bar bwɛjen la, dɛ́ ɡo yela jam Korowii.
Kuo beŋkpoŋ tɔ sie kpɔ sie chaɡɛ danjwɛɛ la diɡ pera, dɛ kaa Puldoa Doonyoa la ta.
Asɛ Hosaya ne Juda nomonome pera ɡe teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Ba ne Asaria ne Ɛsra dɛ Mɛsolam, ne Juda ne Bɛnjamen ne Sɛmaya dɛ Jeremia, dɛ sɔfore bane ba ɡe aa dɛ hoh bɛle, dɛ Jonatan bibaa Sekaria, o nabaa sɔne Sɛmaya.
O nabaala bane ɡee, Matania ne Mikaya dɛ Sakur, baa ɛ Asaf naanar.
O bala ba ɡe aa ɛ Asaf naanar la bane teŋɛ o nɛ.
Banee, Sɛmaya ne Aasarɛl ne Milalai, ne Gilalai ne Maai ne Nɛtanɛl, ne Juda dɛ Hanani.
Dɛ ba bwa kpoŋe Korowii nɛn Kooro Devid kwaa waa kpɔa dɛɛ lɔ yela la dɔŋa.
Asɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme tɔ ba sie.
Baa tel Nebule Doonyoa ta la, ba cheɡɛ kwaa ane a do kɛ sanjol ta teeh kaa Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, dɛ ɡarɛ Kooro Devid koodem, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ ba Nee Doonyoa waa lɔ bwɛjen la wee leebɔr pera ta.
Kuo nɛɛte baa ɡo yela jam Korowii la kpɔ ɡal pera, dɛ kpɔ danjwɛɛ la doa, asɛ n ne nomonome la bini bane teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Ya valɔ dɛ ka ɡarɛ Fononoore Dejaŋ dɛ kaa Danjwɛpaɡ la ta, dɛ le bela ka ɡarɛ Efrem ne Jesana ne Pɛŋa Doonyoo, ne Hananɛl ne Lafa Dejaŋa, dɛ kaa Peera Doonyoa la ta.
Yaa vala ka tel doonyoa waa bɛne Korowii Dea la, asɛ ya che.
Kuore anɛ baa ɡo yela jam Korowii la bwa kaa che ba chebɔra Korowii Dea bela, asɛ n ɡe ka che, n ne nomonome baa ja n nɛɛ la bwa, dɛ sɔfore bane kɛŋɔ, Eliakim ne Maaseya ne Miniamin, ne Mikaya ne Elionai ne Sekaria, dɛ Hanania kpoŋe ba bɛle.
Asɛ Maaseya ne Sɛmaya ne Eliasa, ne Usi ne Jehohanan ne Malkija, ne Elam dɛ Esa teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Asɛ Jesrahia tɔ yelɡoola la sie, ba kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ɡo yela.
Awola tɔpere la, ba kpoo kwaa warɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛɛ hɛɡre, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ɡelɔ ba dɔ silɛɛ kohona.
Haahna ne bechale ɡe sie lɛo, nɛra la silɛɛ ɡbɔɡa ɛɛ la bojaŋa bwa.
Gɛ saŋ la, ba le baala bane baa nyiŋi deene baa lɛ kwaa dɛ kpɔ baa cheɡ a bini Korowii Dea la ta.
Kondikonloɡla ne kwaa baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ a bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋa dɛɛ ba ne.
Ba lɛa le kooni aa bar bwɛɛre ta ba cheɡ deene la bini, ɡɛ Mmara aa chaɡla kɛŋɔ, anee chɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la.
Dɛkalkɛ, dɛ Juda tena bwa sie lɛ ba ne Lewi dea tena la nɛ.
Ba ɛ we-ɛɛla dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ be pera, ɡɛ Korowii aa do ba la.
Gɛɛ yelɡoola ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo ɡe ɛ, ɡɛ Kooro Devid ne o bibaa Solomɔn aa do ba la.
Le Kooro Devid ne Asaf bere saŋ, dɛ nɛra tɔ yelɡoola sie baa kpɛɛ dɛɛ jam Korowii yela ne.
Anomanta, le Sɛrobabɛl ne Nehemia bere saŋ bwaa Israel tena le, dɛɛ tɛ yelɡoola ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea kwa tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Ba kpɔ saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ tɛ Lewi dea tena, ásɛ ba ɡe kpɔ anɔ la aa chɛ sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar kwaa tɛɛ ba.
Hɔɔhra pera dɛ́ le Israel tena bini Awola tɔpere la, ba kure Mosis Mmara Tɔn la a le baŋ nomɛlbwa no.
Ba kure o bobɛl waa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, Amɔn te kɛɛ Moab te bɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii nɛɛ ja, dɛkalkɛ ba ta Israel tena kondikwaa ne nee tɛɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la.
Ba kaa kpɔ Balam ŋɔ, ó ba taah Israel tena, kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ taahna la berɛ hɛɛra.
Israel tena la aa no ɡɛ Mmara nɔ la, ba le nɛŋhɔɔhra baa koo ba bini la bwa ne harɛ la ta.
Gɛ waa nɔ aa wola balɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ sɔfo Eliasib dɛ nyiŋi deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini Korowii Dea.
Dɛ o ne Tobia som.
Asɛ Eliasib kpɔ dejen ba fa aa dɛ cheɡ mea baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha ne daawiile, ne laala bwa soo siwi aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne mea baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋa, ne senfala dɛ ɔleve noo aa chɛ kɛ ba kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena, ne Korowii Dea yelɡoola dɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi doonyoo ta, dɛ anɔ la baa kpɔ tɛ sɔfore bwa, do Tobia nɔn ta.
Gɛ waa nɔ bwa aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ men Nehemia toole Jerusalam, dɛkalkɛ Babelɔn Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ taa n berɛ kaa o be.
A habɔɔ n soŋo ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ berɛ ba Jerusalam.
Maa bala la, n nao kɛŋɔ Eliasib ɛ wechɔɡa kɛ waa kpɔ dea tɛ Tobia, o do o bini Korowii Dea la.
A ɛɛ mɛ bwaawee kohona taeh, asɛ n pa Tobia laala bwa aa lɔ Dea la bini ta buse.
Ate, n ɡel ba ɛ we-ɛɛla a ɡel deene la do ɡoroŋ, asɛ n berɛ kpɔ Korowii Dea laala la bwa ne mea sarahare, dɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma la ka cheɡ o bini.
N berɔ na kɛŋɔ Lewi dea tena baa dɛ ɡo yela Korowii Dea la, ne Lewi dea tena la bane ɡe le Jerusalam, dɛ berɛ kaa ba kooni ta, dɛkalkɛ nɛra la aa ban kwaa aa chɛ kɛ ba tɛɛ ba la tɛ.
N baah diu, n kah nomonome la ɡɛ baa ɡela Korowii Dea chɔ pɛɛ la.
Asɛ n berɛ ba Lewi dea tena la ne yelɡoola la ne Korowii Dea, ba baa ɛ ba tomare ja.
Asɛ Juda tena la bwa berɛ pa mun dɛɛ ba ba kwaa baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi bɔrbeŋkpoŋa kɛŋɔ, mea ne senfala dɛ ɔleve noo ne, dɛ kpɔ baa cheɡ deene aa lɔ Korowii Dea la bini ja.
N kpɔ nɛra ŋɔ baa nyiŋi deene baa kpɔ kwaa dɛɛ cheɡ a bini la ta.
Banee, sɔfo Sɛlɛmia ne tɔnjereme Sadɔk dɛ Lewi dea te Pɛdaya.
Asɛ Hanan ɛɛ cha ba, o mɛɛ sɔne Sakur, o nabaa sɔne Matania.
Banee n ŋɔ ba bɔne kwaa la dɛɛ tɛ ba bala tom-ɛɛra la.
Dɛ n dɛ yarada ba.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, nyiŋi waa maa ɛa kasinteŋ ne he Dea nɔ ta nɔ, ne ɡɛ baa dɛɛ tomɛ bela.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, n na Juda tena bane baa dɛ tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna ta, dɛ kpɔ a nee dɛɛ ɛ sen Ona Tɔpere ta.
Bane ɡe che mea ne sen ne ɡrepore, ne fiɡ daa nɔna, dɛ kwaa bwa soo siwi ba keeɡore ta, dɛɛ ba Jerusalam.
Anomanta, n kah ba ŋɔ, bá nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ komɛlbwa yoɡ Ona Tɔpere ta.
Dɛ bwɛjen Taaya tena bane soɡe Jerusalam, dɛ kpɔ pɛŋa ne laala bwa soo siwi ba yoɡ dɛɛ tɛ Juda tena Ona Tɔpere ta.
N baah di Juu tena nomonome nɛ, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Waa aa ɛ wechɔɡaa he ɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ chɔɡ Ona Tɔpere la.
Gɛ tentenee he naawa ɛ, asɛ Korowii tɛr ba deŋne, dɛ chɔɡ bwɛjen nɔ la.
Asɛ he ta teŋɛ dɛɛ chɔɡ Ona Tɔpere, dɛ kpɔ Korowii bandia kohona ba ta Israel harɛ ta la.” Anomanta, n ŋɔ bɔr aa dɛ ba joe ásɛ Ona Tɔpere tel la, bá laa bwɛjen la doonyoo ɡbeni tɔɔɡe ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa kaa.
N kpɔ n tom-ɛɛra la bane so doonyoo la ta, ásɛ ba nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ komɛlbwa kpɔ ba jo bwɛjen la ta Ona Tɔpere ta.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa bonadiire ne nɛra baa dɛ yoɡ kwaa bwa soo siwi yon dɛɛ so bwɛjen Jerusalam baŋ Fiara jɔmɔra dɛ́ yoɡ ba kwa.
Kɛ n kah ba, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “A ta aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ he baa so danjwɛɛ la baŋ jɔmɔra ka tel kɛ tɔ aa pera.
He berɔ ɛ ken ja aa, mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee.” A habɔɔ, ba ta Ona Tɔpere ta balɛ kpa.
Asɛ n ŋɔ Lewi dea tena la be ŋɔ, bá sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta Korowii be pera, dɛ́ kaa daah doonyoa la, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba di Ona Tɔpere la, o do ɡoroŋ.
N Naa Korowii, lii n waa anɔ ɡe ta ja, dɛ́ sune n nɛɛ ɡɛ he nyina kohona aa doa la.
A ɡɛ saŋ n berɔ na kɛŋɔ Juda baala la ɡalɡa mo Asdɔd ne Amɔn dɛ Moab haahna.
Ba bii la bini bane dɛ bol Asdɔd wobol, kɛɛ nɛra bane ɡe baa jaa wobol ane.
Baa won Juda wobol te bol.
Asɛ n baah di ba nɛ, dɛ taah ba.
N lɔɔ ba, dɛ chuɡri ba bini bane ɡe nyumpona, dɛ ɡel ba ŋwɛɛ ntam Korowii sɔn ta kɛŋɔ, ba ne ba bibaala ne bihaahna bɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola Korowii tomɛ mo, kɛɛ dɛ yalɛ kpa bwa.
Hahmor aa do ken taa a che Israel Kooro Solomɔn ɛ wechɔɡa la.
Dɛ o ɡwaa harɛre koranar bwa.
Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ nyin o wa, dɛ cheɡo kora ta wɛɛ nyiŋi Israel tena nɛ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, haahna baa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra moe ɡela o ɛ wechɔɡa.
A chɛ kɛ yá teŋɛ wechɔɡ damanta ne kasinteŋ haa wola dɔe dɛ tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nɛ, dɛ́ ɡe ka mo haahna baa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra kɛɛ?
Dɛ Sɔfonomoa Eliasib bibaa Joiada ɡe bibaa bɛl mo Sanbalat waa le Bɛt Hɔrɔn bihaah.
Anomanta, n doŋi o bibaa la le Jerusalam.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, tɛr ba deŋne kɛŋɔ, baa kpɔ doŋa kah sɔfore toma, ne fɔo waa chɔ he ne Lewi dea tena ne ba baah ta la wa.
Anomanta, n sɔ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la doŋa bɛlbwa ta Korowii be pera le wobɛlbwa aa ɛ wehɔɔhra ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ bɛlbwa toma do o nɔn ta, asɛ bɛlbwa jemɛ waa waa dɛɛ ɛ. N baɡle saŋ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ daa baa kpɔ dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa ne ba koo kondikonloɡla dɛɛ ba.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, lii n wa, dɛ́ sune n nɛ.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Ɛsta Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle Juu tena bane baa wola wone berɛ ba Jerusalam, dɛ ta so Pɛɛsea harɛ ta wa.
Baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Heeman swɛɛ siwi kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ Juu tenaa dɛ́ kpoo ba bwa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o hah ba.
Korowii le Juda harɛ bitolo Ɛsta, asɛ o ba ɛ kooro haah.
O le o te cheɡ, hale dɛ sɛh seo kwara, dɛ che o dɔɔ Mɔdekae nɛɛ lɛ o harɛ nɛra.
Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ di kpeɡri wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra nɛ.
Kooro Sɛksɛs vɛh o haah Vasti Waa aa chiɡ Koojen Sɛksɛs bere saŋ, ɡɛ saŋ waa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta laanee nɔ.
Dɛ o dɛ nyiŋi harɛre lafa fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ ta, le India harɛ dɛ́ kpoŋe ba kaa Itiopia harɛ ta.
Dɛ o soɡe Susa waa ɛ Pɛɛsea koobwɛɛ ta.
Waa di kora bentooro te ta la, o yerɛ o nomonjena ne o nomonome bwa ba cheme, asɛ ba di kondikonjena dɛ lɛ ba sie.
Pɛɛsea harɛ ne Midia harɛ laa nomonome, ne nomonome baa chɔ o harɛre bwa nyoo ne nomonjena balɔ.
O kpɔ kondɔɔh aa lɔ kara la mun bwa le asɛ nɛra ba naa, dɛ na ɡɛ o kondɔɔh ne o kora kan aa doa.
O ɛ ɡɛ korobie anumɛl bwa.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Kooro Sɛksɛs berɔ ɛ kondikonjena la ane ja, dɛ yerɛ o koobwɛɛ Susa tena bwa, hale dɛ́ le nomonjena nɛɛ dɛ́ kaa dansaara bwa nɛ.
Ba di kwaa la koodem bela, bodɛɛɡe bɛl baa du dadɛɛɡa ane lɔɡre tɔpera anuanɛ.
Bela baa di kwaa la, ba paaɡe pilare baa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane soo siwi maa bar, asɛ dɛ kpɔ pateesanpoŋa ne pateesanburumre saɡre a ta bar.
Ba berɔ pɛrɛ jisepoŋ ne jisekɔl pɛ, dɛ kpɔ do pateesanre la ta, dɛ lawɛ vɔwɛ suuɡapoŋa noniseɡa baa kpɔa paaɡe pilare la ta kaa.
Ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa, dɛ ɛ bobɛl o ir nyundua.
Ba kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ampoŋa ne answɛɛma, ne anɔ la aa dɛ nyɛɡle, dɛ anɔ la aa ɛ burum bwa, dɛ kwaa bela harɛ o do wer.
Kooro la ɡelɔ ba do sen tɛ nɛra suuɡaswɛm numoli bini ba nyɔ.
Numoli la koɡrɔ, asɛ sen la warɛ kohona a baɡle kooro bonya waa dɔa tɛ nɛra la.
O ŋɔ nɛra baa cheme bela la bɛlbwa nyɔ sen la ɡɛ del waa won nyɔ.
O ŋɔ o bonɔɔna la be ŋɔ bá do nomɛlbwa ɡɛ del waa dɛ nyin.
Dɛ Kooro Sɛksɛs haah sɔne Vasti.
O ɡe ɛ kondikonjena la ane, dɛ yerɛ haahna baa lɔ koodem bela la ba ba di.
Tɔpenuanɛ wee kooro aa nyɔ sen dɛ dɛɛ la, o yerɛ o bonɔɔna baa fɔɡɛ ba lure baa tomɔ la cheme.
Banee, Mehuman ne Bista ne Haabona, ne Biɡta ne Abaɡta ne Sɛta, dɛ Kaakas.
O ŋɔ bá lawɛ o haah Vasti ó kpɔ o ɡbɛrɛ waa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o ɛ kooro haah la pi, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ba o sie.
Vasti wer kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, kooro la dɛ nyin kɛ Vasti kpɔ o te ba baɡle nomonjena, ne nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa, ásɛ ba na o wer waa doa.
Kooro bonɔɔna aa la o haah Vasti be la, o vɛh bala.
Kooro aa noa la, o baah diu kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ kooro dɛ nyin nɛra chao waane ta naa, o kpɔɔ dɛɛ bil wejerema baa jemɛ mmarare ne bela waa bini sie, ásɛ ba yon jao.
Anomanta, o tao tɛ wejerema baa won waa bini baɡla, dɛ dɔ dibɔra kooloŋ ta bela.
Banee, Kaasena ne Sɛta ne Admata, ne Taases ne Meres ne Maasena, dɛ Mɛmokan.
Gɛ nomonjena banuanɛ nɔ le Pɛɛsea ne Midia harɛre ta, dɛ ɛ nomonjena ɡwaa nomonome baa lɔ o kora bini bwa.
Ate, kooro ŋɔ o nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Vasti vɛh yera men Kooro Sɛksɛs aa tomɛ n bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá yerɔ ó ba la.
Ɛrɛɛ mmara ɛɛ baɡle kɛ ń ɛo wɔ?” Asɛ Mɛmokan che kooro ne o nomonjena la bwa sie dɛ chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ he haah Vasti ɛ ɡɛ tenaa, o ɛ wechɔɡa.
He ɡbo sie laa o lawɛ teɡɛ harɛ.
Nomonjena ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛre nɔ bwa ta ɡe jao.
He haah waa waa ɛa nɔ, haahna noɔ waa, baa che a taa ba siwi sa ba jaranar, dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Kooro Sɛksɛs kwaraa aa do o bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ o haah la, o vɛoh.’ Fini tɔpere nɔ, dɛ Pɛɛsea ne Midia harɛre nomonjena haahna no he haah waa waa ɛa nɔ naa, ba ɡee dɛɛ ɛ yaa ɡɛɛ.
Haahna bwa aa yaa bu kpa, ásɛ ya baala ɡe baah ɛɛ di ba nɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.” Mɛmokan ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, do mmarafale bá chwerɛ ja Pɛɛsea ne Midia harɛre mmarare ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola won beɡra bwa, kɛŋɔ Vasti bɛ hen Kooro Sɛksɛs sie tire kpa.
O bɛ he haah ɡe ɛ kpa, bá nyin haah waa dɔ da dɛ ɡwaalo tɛɛ he moo.
Dɛ ba ɡelɔ mmarafale nɔ kaa he kora harɛre aa do kan kohona nɔ bwa ta naa, anee dɛ́ ɡel haah te bɛlbwa ɛɛ duu o jaa, hale dɛ́ le nomonjena nɛ dɛ́ kaa dansaara nɛ.” Kooro ne o nomonjena la sie lɛ Mɛmokan waa waa bola la ta, anomanta, o do mmara la.
O ɡelɔ ba kpɔ mmara la kaa harɛre waa dɛ di kora a ta la bwa ta.
Ba chwerɔ tɛ harɛ bɛlbwa tena, ɡɛ ba chwera ne ba wobol aa doa, kɛŋɔ baa bɛlbwa ɛɛ di nomonome o dem.
Ɛsta baa ɛ kooro haah A habɔɔ, Kooro Sɛksɛs baah sɔɔhnɔ tama, asɛ o lii Vasti wa, ne waa waa ɛa la, ne ɡɛ waa koh o waa do mmara la.
Anomanta, kooro ɡbaɡba bonɔɔna baa lɔ o jwɛɛh la ba liire ne ŋɔ, “N Naa kooro, ɡel bá nyiŋi harɛre la bwa ta, dɛ́ nyin toli baa wera, baa wola baa jemɛ bwa tɛɛ.
Hɛɛ won ɡel nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi harɛre haa dɛ di kora a ta la bwa, kpɔ toli baa wera ba koodem haahna dobɔr koobwɛɛ Susa nɔ ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ba do Heɡai baa fɔɡɔ o lur, o do koodem haahna dobɔr dɛɛ nyiŋi kooro haahna nɛɛ la nɔn ta, wɛ́ɛ di ba toli.
Ba bini bɛlbwa he sie aa lɛ o nɛɛ la, kpɔɔ ɛ he haah chiɡ Vasti naa ta.” Kooro aa no ɡɛ baa jao la, o sie lɛ a ta, dɛ ɡel ba ɛa ɡɛ.
Ate, Susa bwɛjen ta bela, dɛ Juu te bɛl lole baa yerɔ Mɔdekae.
Bɛnjamen dea o le.
O mɛɛ sɔne Jɛɛ, asɛ Jɛɛ ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Simee, asɛ Simee mɛɛ sɔne Kes.
Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiachin ne nɛra bane le Jerusalam kaa o harɛ ta, dɛ Mɔdekae ja ba nɛ.
Dɛ Mɔdekae mɛnjen bie bɛl sɔne Ɛsta.
O sɔn bɛl ɡee Hadasa, Hibru tena wobol ta.
O siebɔr ne o mar wer kɛrɛdɛ.
Ɛsta nya ne o mɛɛ aa sewa la, Mɔdekae kpɔɔ berɛ o ɡbaɡba bie dɛɛ nyiŋu.
Kooro Sɛksɛs aa ŋɔa bá ɡaaɡe toldɛɛɡa bɔr la, ba dɔ bane dɛ kpɔ ba kaa koobwɛɛ Susa koodem haahna dobɔr ka tɛ Heɡai ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Dɛ Ɛsta ɡe ja bɛl.
Heɡai sie lɛ Ɛsta nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ o waa su o siwi, anomanta, o do sie nyiŋu ɡɛ aa chɛa.
Buɡ la ta, o tɛo kwaa waa kpɔ dɛɛ di toli, ne kondikondɛɛɡa wɛ́ɛ di, dɛ berɛ tɛo haahna banuanɛ dɛ le koodem bela báa tomɔ, dɛ kpɔ ba ka do haahna dobɔr bela waa wera kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Mɔdekae fa kah Ɛsta ŋɔ ó bɛ ɡel ba jemɛ o nɛnsoo, anomanta, o ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ o ɛ Juu te.
Tɔpere bɛlbwaa Mɔdekae yon le o dem dɛ́ la haahna dobɔr la sie bela, dɛ́ ka valɛ la sie dɛɛ ba habɔɔ kɛŋɔ o ken ɛɛ na Ɛsta dembaah belaa ɡɛ waa doa.
Mɔɔ toli la bɛlbwa dɔ bɔr la kooro be o ne ó chɔ la, korobie fi dɛ anɛɛ o kpɔ dɛɛ kwaa o te.
Korobie anumɛlee o kpɔ dɛɛ fɔɡle nosɔɔhsoma baa dɛ yera korobo la, dɛ́ berɛ fɔɡle konsɔɔhsoma aa dɛ kwaa bwara ɡe korobie anumɛl.
Awola tɔpere toli la bɛlbwa aa le haahna dobɔr bela dɛɛ la kooro be la, komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin la, ba kpɔɔ dɛɛ tɛo.
Jɔmɔraa wɛɛ la o be dɛ́ ka chɔ.
