Tɔɔ perɔ aa, baa kpɔɔ la sɛnanar denɛɛte ta, dɛ́ ka do kooro bonɔɔ Saasɡas baa fɔɡɛ o lur, wɛɛ nyiŋi kooro haahna nɛɛ la nɔn ta.
Waa kooro bee la kpa, nemenɛ kooro sie lɛ o nɛɛ ó baɡle o sɔn ŋɔ bá yerɔ tɛo ja.
Aa tela kɛ Mɔdekae mɛnjen Abihel bie Ɛsta waa kpɔɔ berɛ o ɡbaɡba bie la kooro be la, o ta laala ne komɛlbwa soŋɛ ka ja anɔ la Heɡai waa dɛ nyiŋi kooro haahna nɛɛ la aa ŋɔa ŋɔ a wer tɛo la.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa na Ɛsta la, dɛ o dɛ nyin o wa.
Kooro Sɛksɛs kora dii bene anuanɛ Tɛbɛt korobie taa a tel kɛŋɔ Ɛsta la kooro be o koodem.
Ɛsta aa la o be la, kooro sie lɛ o nɛɛ kohona, o waa su o siwi dɛ ɡwaa o haahna ne toli la bwa.
Asɛ o kpɔ ɡbɛrɛ waa baɡla kɛŋɔ ó ɛ o haah la piu.
O kpɔɔ ɛ o haah chiɡ Vasti naa ta.
Kooro ɡelɔ ba ɛ kondikonjena a warɛ kohona tɛ Ɛsta waa ɛo o haah la.
O yerɛ o nomonjena ne nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ la bwa, ba ba di kwaa dɛ lɛ ba sie.
Dɛ ɛ awola tɔpere la ona tɔpere, dɛ kɛ nɛra kwaa kohona aa baɡle kan waa doa.
Mɔdekae lɛ Kooro mkpa Ba berɔ ba toli la ne koodem bela nɛɛtena, dɛ Mɔdekae dɔ nomonome dɛ so koodem doonyoa bela.
Mɔdekae aa ŋɔ Ɛsta be ŋɔ o bɛ ɡel ba jemɛ o nɛnsoo kɛŋɔ o ɛ Juu te la, o noɔ tɛo ɡɛ waa dɛ no o waa le o bechale saŋ bwa la.
Gɛ saŋ Mɔdekae aa lɔ toma ta koodem doonyoa la, dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ daah kooro dea doonyoa la bini banɛ baa dɛ yer ba Biɡtana ne Tɛrɛs la baah diu baa vɔrɔwe kɛ baa kpo kooroo.
Mɔdekae no waa la, dɛ ka taa baɡle kooro haah Ɛsta.
Asɛ o ɡe kpɔ ka taa kooro be kɛŋɔ, ɡɛɛ Mɔdekae no dɛ ba bol o be.
Kooro ɡelɔ ba nyiŋi waa la bini, asɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ a ɛ kasinteŋ, dɛ ɡel ba saɡɛ ɡɛ nɛra banɛ la.
O ɡelɔ ba chwerɛ ɡɛ waa la do Koojen Sɛksɛs harɛ waa dɛ di kora o ta la waa tɔn bini.
Heeman vɔrɔwe Juu tena kpoora vɔrɔwa Aa baa tel saŋ bɛl la, Koojen Sɛksɛs kpɔ nomonome tɛ Hamedata bibaa Heeman o nabaa aa ɛ Aɡaɡ, o ɛ nomonjen ɡwaa harɛ la nomonome bwa.
Koojen do nɛra baa lɔ koodem bela dɛɛ ɛ toma la bwa ŋɔ, báa ɡuŋi Heeman harɛ, dɛ́ɛ duuru saŋ bɛlbwa.
Ba bwa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ, kɛ dɛ Mɔdekae te aa on ɡɛ ɛ. Belaa Mɔdekae nomondɔŋa baa lɔ koodem la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ kooro do yaa ŋɔ yáa duu Heeman, he te aa wola a ta teŋɛ nɔɔ?” Tɔpere bɛlbwaa ba teŋɛ dɛɛ bol waa la o be, kɛ o ta ba be noɛ.
O ŋɔ, “Juu tee men.
Maa won ɡuŋi Heeman.” Anomanta, ba bol Heeman be, dɛ na kɛ o sie ɛɛ lɛ Mɔdekae waa la taa.
Heeman ɡbabir aa naa kɛŋɔ Mɔdekae aa on harɛ ɡuŋi dɛɛ duuru la, o baah diu kɛrɛdɛ.
Waa naa kɛ Mɔdekae ɛ Juu te la, o ɛ o liire kɛ waa o ɡboo kpo, dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛŋɔ wɛɛ kpoo o ne Juu tena baa lɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛ ta la bwaa.
Kooro Sɛksɛs kora dii bene fi dɛ anɛ Nisan korobie ta la, Heeman ɡelɔ ba bil daa o sie, dɛ́ lawɛ korobie ne tɔpere waa wera tɛo, ó kpɔ ɛ waa waa vɔrɔwa la.
Korobie baa lawɔ laanee Nisan korobie.
Belaa Heeman la ka ŋɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, nɛra bane perɛ he kora harɛre la ta bobɛlbwa.
Ba we-ɛɛla korɛ nɛra bwa we-ɛɛla ta.
Baa he kora mmarare ɡe ta teŋɛ, anomanta, dɛ he le ba ne naa, a fe wer.
Dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, do mmara, ásɛ ya kpoo ba.
A ba ɡɛ naa, mɛɛ bɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa lafraatoro fifraanaarɛɛ do he kara mun tɛ nɛra baa kpoo a ɡɛ nɛra la.” Belaa kooro sɛh, dɛ foo o noniseɡ waa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛɡɛ tɔn ta la, dɛ ɛ mmara la, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Hamedata bibaa Heeman waa hah Juu tena kohona la.
Kooro ŋɔ Heeman be ŋɔ, “Gel suuɡa la do he be, ásɛ dɛ ka ɛ nɛra la ɡɛ bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.” Korobiloɡle tɔpera fi dɛ atoro ta la, Heeman yerɛ kooro nomonome bwa cheme.
O ɡelɔ ba chwerɛ ɡɛ waa bol Juu tena waa la wobol bwa soo siwi aa lɔ harɛre la bɛlbwa ta, ne ɡɛ ba chwera aa doa, dɛ kpɔ ka tɛ koranar ne nomonome baa chɔ harɛ bɛlbwa nyoa, ne ba nomonjena bwa.
Kooro sɔn taa ba chwera, dɛ kpɔ o noniseɡ ɛɡɛ a ta, asɛ a ɛ mmara, dɛ chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa.
Ba le toroma bá kpɔ tɔne la kaa harɛre kooro aa di kora a ta la bwa ta.
A bini waa dɛ chaɡle kɛ bá kpoo Juu tena bwa.
Toli ne bonɔɔna ne nomonome, dɛ haahna ne bechale, bɛlbwa bɛ ka, bá ɛa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ.
Adar korobie o tɔpera fi dɛ atoro weeree aa ba chiɡa, ásɛ ba pa ba laala ɡe bwa.
Toroma la laŋaa, bá tɛ nomonome baa chɔ harɛre nyoo la bɛlbwa mmarafale tɔn la bɛl, ásɛ ba ɡel nɛra bwa soo siwi baa lɔ ba harɛre ta jemɛ a wa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ kpa tɔpere la.
Kooro aa do mmara la nomanta, toroma la ɛ warane dɛ kaa, asɛ bane kpɔ waa la perɛ koobwɛɛ Susa ta.
Dɛ kooro ne Heeman soɡo dɛɛ nyɔ sen, asɛ bwɛɛ la bwa ɛɛ vuuɡi.
Mɔdekae soŋe Esta ŋɔ ó chao Mɔdekae aa na waa baa ɛa la, o kɛɛ o laala dɛ kpɔ lweyal tɔ, dɛ ɛ tɔɔ do o nyu ta, a baɡle kɛŋɔ o tea bini chɔɡɔ.
O valɛ bwɛjen Susa fɔɡbaahna dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ wi kohona.
Koodem doonyoa ɡboo o jaɡɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa tɔ lweyal la ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ó jo bela.
Harɛre la bɛlbwa ta kooro mmara la aa tela la, Juu tena baa lɔ bela la tea bini chɔɡɔ baa dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ wi kohona.
Ba vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ kpɔ lweyale tɔ, dɛ ɛ tɔɔ merɛ harɛ dɛ chɔ a ta.
A baɡle kɛ ba lɔ sibeɡra ta.
Kooro haah Ɛsta toli ne baala baa fɔɡɛ ba lure baa nyiŋi o nɛɛ la aa kaa bol Mɔdekae waa o be la, a we o nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
O kpɔ laala tɛɛ ba ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ka tɛo ó do, dɛ́ foo lweyal la bil, asɛ o vɛh, o ta laala la lɛɛ.
Kooro haah berɔ yerɛ baa bɛl baa fɔɡɛ o lur baa yerɔ Hatak, kooro aa leo wɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛɛ la, dɛ doo ŋɔ ó ka bɔɔ Mɔdekae waa aa bala wɛɛ wi.
Anomanta, Hatak leɔ dɛ ka na Mɔdekae kɛ waa soɡe bwɛɛ la cheremibɔr, waa lɔ koodem doonyoa la sie.
Mɔdekae baɡle waa aa chiɡa la bwa, dɛ berɛ baɡle suuɡa Heeman aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, wɛɛ bɔɔ do kooro kara mun, ásɛ ba kpoo Juu tena bwa la.
O kpɔ tɔn baa chwera, asɛ ba bol o bini waa Susa la bɛl tɛ Hatak ŋɔ, ó kpɔ ka tɛ Ɛsta dɛ́ baɡle o bini waa o be, ásɛ o la kooro be, dɛ́ ka soŋo ŋɔ ó na o ne o nɛra bwa sum.
Hatak kaa bol waa Mɔdekae aa bola la bwa kooro haah Ɛsta be.
O berɔ tomɛ Hatak Mɔdekae be ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma koodem bela, ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛre la ta bwa jemɛ mmara la kɛŋɔ, baa kɛɛ haah aa won la kooro be kooloŋ ta, nemenɛ kooro yerɔ mɔɔ.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, kpoe chɛ kɛ bá kpoo, nemenɛ kooro tɛr o suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala la tɛo dɛ́ lɛ o nyu.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Kooro aa yer mɛ n la o be, tɔpera fifraatoroo nɔ.” Hatak aa kaa bol waa Ɛsta aa bola nɔ Mɔdekae be la, Mɔdekae berɔ chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kooro haah, bɛ lii kɛŋɔ haa lɔ koodem bela nomanta, dɛ ba kpoo Juu tena bwa naa, hɛɛ dɔ he nyuu.
He tɔ nyoa he ta waane bolɛ taraken nɔ naa, Juu tena ɛɛ dɔ nomɛlee ó cha ba, kɛ he te ne he mɛɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ serewoo.
Dɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ waa he ɛ kooro haah taraken nɔ naa, he jemaa?” Ɛsta berɔ ŋɔ bá ka ŋɔ Mɔdekae be ŋɔ, “Kaa dɛ́ ka yerɛ Juu tena baa soɡe bwɛjen Susa nɔ ta bwa cheme, ásɛ he vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ.
He bɛ kwaa di, dɛ bɛ nee ɡe nyɔ tɔpera atoro chɔɔ ne jwaana.
N ne n toli ɡe ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ kooro ta nɛn yerɛ aa waa o sie la, kɛ mɛɛ lao.
Hale seo kwaraa yaa, ń sewɛ.” Ate, Mɔdekae la dɛ ka ɛ ɡɛ kooro haah Ɛsta aa doo ŋɔ ó ka ɛ la bwa.
Ɛsta ta nɔn yerɛ Kooro Baa vɔwɛ ba nyoa tɔpetooro wee tonɛ la, Ɛsta kpɔ laala aa baɡla kɛ o ɛ kooro haah la do, dɛ ka che koodem baah bela kooro dea doonyoa aa chaɡa, dɛ kooro soɡe o kookara ta o sie chaɡɛ doonyoa.
Waa na o haah Ɛsta bela la, o sie lɛ o nɛ, dɛ tɛr o suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala waa kpoŋa la pa Ɛsta nɛ, asɛ o suuh tel o be dɛ kpɔ o nɔn leɡe suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala la nyoa.
Kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N haah Ɛsta, a som tenaa?
Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ɔ?
Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la, mɛɛ ɛo tɛɛ.
Hale harɛ maa dɛ di kora o ta nɔ peraa hɛɛ nyin kwaaraa naa, mɛɛ tɛɛ.” Belaa Ɛsta chaŋo ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, he ne Heeman ba fini dɛ́ ba di kondikonjena maa daala tɛɛ la.” Ate, kooro tomɛ o bonɔɔ Heeman be ŋɔ ó ba warane, ásɛ ba la o haah Ɛsta be.
Asɛ ba bwa pɛ la ka di kondikonjena la.
Baa dɛ nyɔ sen la, kooro bɔɔ o haah Ɛsta ja ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń ɛ tɛɛ nɔ?
Hale harɛ maa dɛ di kora o ta nɔ peraa hɛɛ nyin kwaraa naa, mɛɛ tɛɛ.” Asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kon maa dɛ nyin laanee kɛŋɔ, Dɛ n waa su he siwi hɛɛ nyin kɛ he cha mɛ naa, kere he ne Heeman ba n be dɛ́ ba di kondikonjena maa dɛ ba daala tɛɛ ja.
Gɛ saŋee mɛɛ ba kon maa dɛ nyin baɡla.” Heeman vɔrɔwɔ dɛ́ kpo Mɔdekae Heeman iro le bela, o sie lɛ kohona.
Kɛ waa na Mɔdekae o so koodem doonyoa bela, waa wola ire che dɛ kpɔ duure tɛo o ba kaa la, o baah berɔ di kohona.
Kɛ ane abwa, o lawɛ bambile dɛ kaa o dem, dɛ ka tomɛ nɛn ŋɔ ó ka yerɛ o daamanar ne o haah Seres tɛo.
Ba bwa aa baa cheme la, o kpɔ o kondɔɔh aa kana ne o bibaala wara baa wara dɛ ta nyoa.
Dɛ berɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛ kooro aa cheɡɛ o ta dɛ tɛo jirima, ne nomonome waa tɛo o ɡwaa o dɔŋa nomonjena ne banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ toma koodem la bwa.
O berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N ɡboo kooro haah yerɛ ka ja kooro nɛɛ ya pɛ di kondikonjena.
Kɛ a ɡbo laa, o berɔ dɛɛ yerɛ n ne kooro bwa kere ɡe ja.
Ane abwa, n ta sie na ɡɛ Juu te Mɔdekae aa soɡe koodem doonyoa bela la aa, anɔ bɛlbwa aa n siwi su kpa.” Heeman daamanar ne o haah la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gel ba pa daa o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue kaa nyundua, ásɛ he ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, ó ɡel ba saɡɛ Mɔdekae o ta kere chɔɔ.
A ba ɡɛ naa, he ne kooro ɛɛ won berɛ la kondikonjena la bɔr, ásɛ he sie lɛ.” Ba wobol la wer tɛ Heeman kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, o sɛoh dɛ ɡel ba pa daa la.
Kooro ɡɔɔ Mɔdekae sɔn Awola tɔpere la jwaana, kooro ta wone chɔ dom.
Anomanta, o ɡelɔ ba ba tɔne o kora dii waa aa lɔ a bini la ne bá kure tɛo.
Ba kuro ka tel bela Mɔdekae aa ɡela kooro dɔ o nyu la, Biɡtana ne Tɛrɛs, koodem bonɔɔna ba fa aa dɛ daah kooro dem doonyoa la vɔrɔwa ba fe aa vɔrɔwa ŋɔ, bá kpo kooro la.
Kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Webesoo ń ɛ tɛo ɡɛ waa nɔ ta nɔ?
Kembɔr besoo ń tɛo wɔ?” Anee o bonɔɔna la ŋɔ, “He ta wobɛlbwa ɛɛ tɛo.” O berɔ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “N nomonjena la bane lɔ dem bonɔ naa?” Gɛ saŋ dɛ Heeman ɡe deno ba jo koodem baah bela, dɛ́ ba soŋe ŋwɛnɛ kooro be ŋɔ, bá ka saɡɛ Mɔdekae daa waa pao la ta.
Kooro bonɔɔna la chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “N naa, Heeman lɔ bonɔ.” Asɛ kooro ŋɔ, “Hé yerɔ ba!” Waa bala la, kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Sɔn besoo ń tɛ nɛn n bambile aa lawɔ, o waa su n siwi ɔ?” Belaa Heeman lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Nomɛl lole kooro ɛɛ nyin kɛ ó duuru dɛ ɡwaa mɛ naa?” Anee Heeman chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “N naa, dɛ he bambile lawɛ nɛn o waa aa su he siwi kɛ he tɛo sɔn aa, kenii chɛ kɛ he ɛ. Ŋɔ he bonɔɔna la be bá kpɔ he ɡbaɡba laala haa dɛ doa la ane ba, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ jaɡre haa dɛ so a ta la bɛl ɡe ba.
Gel bá kpɔ kondɛɛɡe haa kpɔa dɛɛ dawɛ he jaaɡɔ nyu ta, aa baɡle kɛŋɔ he jaaɡɔɔ la ba dawɛ ɡɛ jaaɡɔ la nyu ta.
Ásɛ dɛ ɡel he nomonjena tenten la bɛl kpɔ koolaala la do naate, ó so jaaɡɔ la ta, ásɛ nomoa la tɔ o sie, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ɡaaɡe bwɛɛ nɔ fɔɡbaahna, dɛ́ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Kenii kooro ɛɛ tɛ ɡɛ nɛn nɔ sɔn.’ ” Kooro do Heeman ŋɔ, “Ɛ warane ka kpɔ koolaala la ne jaaɡɔ la, dɛ́ ka ɛ ɡɛ haa bola nɔ bwa tɛ Mɔdekae, Juu te la.
Bɛ a bini bɛlbwa ɡel.
Hɛɛ nao kɛ waa soɡe koodem doonyoa bela.” Anomanta, Heeman lɛ koolaala la ne jaaɡɔ la kaa Mɔdekae be, dɛ ka kpɔ laala la doo, asɛ Mɔdekae teeh so jaaɡɔ la ta.
Heeman kpɔɔ kpɔ bwɛɛ la fɔɡbaahna, o nyoa che chiŋ wɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ kooro aa ɛ nɛn o bambile aa lawɔ kɛ ó tɛo sɔn!” Baa tona la, Mɔdekae berɔ ka so koodem doonyoa la ta.
Heeman ɡe kpɔ sihiih ne baŋaɡola dɛ le bela kaa o dem warane.
Waa kaa jo dem la, o baɡle waa aa puu la bwa o haah ne o daamanar la be.
Asɛ ba jao ŋɔ, “Haa dena pa mun di sihiih Mɔdekae sie nɔ, o lɔɡaa hɛɛ ba doe, ásɛ o pɔ he nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɛ Juu te.” Ba ta aa soɡa dɛɛ bol waa la, kooro bonɔɔna baa fɔɡɛ ba lure la baa kpɔ Heeman kaa kooro haah Ɛsta be kondikonjena waa ɛa ŋɔ bá ba di la mun warane.
Ba saɡɛ Heeman Kooro Sɛksɛs ne Heeman dɛ kooro haah Ɛsta bwa pɛo di kwaa la.
Baa dɛ nyɔ sen ba kondikonjena nɛɛtena dii ta la, kooro bɔɔ o haah Ɛsta ja ŋɔ, “Ɛsta, bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ɔ?
Hale harɛ maa dɛ di kora o ta nɔ peraa hɛɛ nyin kwaraa naa, mɛɛ tɛɛ.” Anee Ɛsta chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, n wesoŋa bwaa kɛŋɔ dɛ n waa su he siwi hɛɛ nyin kɛ he cha mɛ naa, lɛ n nyu dɛ lɛ n nɛra ɡe nyu.
Ba yoɡ yaa tɛ ŋɔ bá kpoo yaa, dɛ́ he yaa kwaraa.
Dɛ yoɡaa ba yoɡ yaa kɛŋɔ yoma kwaraa naa, n fe ta waane dɔe dɛ́ bol dɛɛ hae.” Kooro Sɛksɛs bɔɔ Ɛsta ŋɔ, “Ume baahnee sua o won ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔɔ?
Naate sɛ?” Anee Ɛsta chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nɛnchɔɡe Heeman nɔɔ ya dɔm waa do yaa ɡɛ wahala nɔ ta.” Belaa ɔmee chole Heeman nɛɛ kohona kooro ne o haah Ɛsta sie.
Kooro baah diu kɛrɛdɛ o ir ɡel sen waa dɛ nyɔ la, dɛ le buse ka jo koodem bodɛɛɡe bobɛl baa du daa ane la.
Heeman nao kɛŋɔ kooro dɔɔ kpɔ liire ɡɛ waa dɛ ba o deŋne tɛra.
Anomanta, o soɡo dɛɛ soŋe kooro haah Ɛsta ŋɔ ó lɛo ta.
Kooro aa bera dɛɛ jo koodem la, dɛ Heeman marɛ o haah karajaŋ waa yale o ta la ta, dɛɛ soŋo sibeɡra ne, anee kooro nyɛɡ ŋɔ, “Ei!
Baa nɔ dɛ nyin kɛ ó paɡɛ n haah n siwi ta koodem bonɔ kwara!” Kooro nyoa ne chiɡa dɛ o bonɔɔna baa fɔɡɛ ba lure la kpɔ yal bɔle Heeman sie.
Kooro bonɔɔna la bini bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Haabona waa lɔ o jwɛɛh ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Heeman pa da o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue dɛ kaa nyundua o dem.
O ɛo kɛŋɔ bá fee saɡɛ Mɔdekae waa lɛ he nyu ta la o ta.” Belaa kooro la do ba ŋɔ, “Hé ka saɡɛ Heeman o ta.” Gɛɛ a do ba saɡɛ Heeman daa waa paa dɛɛ ba Mɔdekae o ta saɡa la, asɛ kooro baah sɔɔh tama.
Ba do Juu tena ŋɔ bá ka yo Awola tenten baa saɡɛ Heeman la, Kooro Sɛksɛs kpɔ Heeman waa ɛ Juu tena dɔm la dem ne o kondɔɔh te bwa do o haah Ɛsta nɔn ta.
Dɛ Ɛsta fa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ Mɔdekae ɛ o lole tenten.
Anomanta, le ɡɛ saŋ, Mɔdekae dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ó jo koodem dɛɛ la kooro sie, saŋ bɛlbwa.
Kooro laa o noniseɡ waa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛɡre tɔne ta aa ɛ mmarare o faa kpɔ tɛ Heeman la foo, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Mɔdekae.
O haah Ɛsta kpɔ Heeman kondɔɔh la bwa ɡe do Mɔdekae nɔn ta.
Kooro haah Ɛsta berɔ ba kooro sie, dɛ ba ɡuŋu harɛ siniire ne, dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, ó ɡel ba teŋe liichɔɡa Aɡaɡ naa Heeman aa liira kɛ ba kpoo Juu tena bwa la ta.
Ate, kooro tɛr o suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala la pa Ɛsta nɛɛ ja, asɛ o ir che o sie.
Belaa Ɛsta ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh, dɛ he sie lɛ n nɛ, n wesoŋa nɔ toɡrɔ aa, ɡel he karakere chwerɛ tɔne kɛŋɔ, Hamedata bibaa Heeman tɔne waa chwera kɛŋɔ, bá kpoo Juu tena baa lɔ he harɛre bwa ta la bɛ toma ɛ kpa.
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona so nyiŋi, ásɛ wechɔɡa nɔ bwa dɔŋa chiɡ n nɛra Juu tena nɛɔ?
Maa won so nyiŋi bá kpoo n dem nɛra.” Belaa Kooro Sɛksɛs chaŋe o haah ne Juu te Mɔdekae ŋɔ, “Vɔrɔwa Heeman aa vɔrɔwa ŋɔ bá kpoo Juu tena bwa la nomanta, n kpɔ o kondɔɔh bwa tɛ Ɛsta, dɛ ɡel ba ka saɡɔ.
Taraken nɔ, n tɛ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ kɛ hé kpɔ n sɔn, dɛ́ chwerɛ mmarafale ja ka tɛ nɛra baa lɔ n harɛre la bwa ta, dɛ́ tɔ Juu tena kpoora la ŋwɛnɛ.
Hé chwerɔ ɡɛ bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.
Hé chwerɔ tonaa, hé kpɔ n noniseɡ ɛɡre a ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tɔne baa chwerɛ n sɔn ta dɛ kpɔ n noniseɡ ɛɡre a ta la, nomɛlbwa aa won tire a ta.” Sevan korobie tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ atoro ta la, Mɔdekae yerɛ kooro nomonome la bwa cheme, dɛ ɡel ba chwerɛ mmara tɔne ka tɛ Juu tena ne koranar, ne nomonome baa chɔ harɛre bwa nyoa, ne nomonjena dɛ le harɛre lafa fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ la bwa ta, dɛ le India harɛ kpoŋe kaa Itiopia harɛ ta.
Ba chwerɔ ka tɛ wobobele aa lɔ harɛre la bwa ta, ne ɡɛ a bɛlbwa chwera aa doa, hale Juu tena bwa jao.
Kooro Sɛksɛs kpeɡri taa Mɔdekae che dɛ ɡel ba chwerɛ tɔne la, asɛ dɛ kpɔ noniseɡ la ɛɡre a ta, dɛ kpɔa tɛ nɛra ba so kooro jaɡre aa won chwae ta, dɛ kpɔ tɔne la ka bɔne tɛ nɛra baa soɡe o harɛre la bwa ta.
Kooro waa la tɛ Juu tena baa lɔ bwɛjena bwa ta la kpeɡri kɛŋɔ, bá cheme dɛ́ won yo lɛ ba nyu.
Ba dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ bá kpoo laa tena baa le wobol bɛlbwa ne harɛ bɛlbwa ta, dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yo ba ne ba haahna ne bii la, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kondɔɔh.
Tɔpere Mɔdekae aa lea tɛ Juu tena ŋɔ bá kpɔ ɛ ɡɛ waa la Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛre la bwa ta laanee Adar korobie, tɔpere fi dɛ atoro ta.
A chɛ kɛ tɔne la mmarafale la aa lɔ a ta la tel wobol te bɛlbwa tena baa lɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛre la bwa ta la be, ásɛ ba jemɛ a wa, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ Juu tena la won kpɔ ba te kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ won yo ba dɔma bɔ kem.
Kooro aa do mmara la nomanta, o toroma la soɡe o jaɡre la ta kaa wɔrɔbe nɛ.
Bane kpɔ waa la perɛ koobwɛɛ Susa ɡe bwa ta.
Mɔdekae aa le kooro sie bela dɛ kaa la, dɛ o do laalapoŋa ne laalaburum, dɛ berɛ do batakaare baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe ɛo dawɛ kɛŋɔ koolaala ken, dɛ pi suuɡaswɛm ɡbɛrɛdɛɛɡe bɛl.
Asɛ Susa bwɛɛ tena la bwa ɡe ɛɛ moo silɛɛ ne.
Dɛ a ɛ silɛɛ ne hɛɡra dɛ tɛ Juu tena la, baa duu ba bobɛlbwa.
Harɛ bɛlbwa ne bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ta toroma la aa la mmarafale nɔ ne la, Juu tena baa lɔ bela la bwa sie dɛ lɛ baa hɛɡre, dɛ so di kwaa dɛɛ lɛ ba sie.
Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la bini bane ɔmɔ, dɛ kpɔ ba te berɛ Juu tena, dɛkalkɛ ba we-ɛɛla la ɡelɔ ɔmee laɡ ba.
Juu tena yo ba dɔma dɛ kpoo ba Adar korobie tɔpera fi dɛ atoro weeree tɔpere kooro aa do mmara ŋɔ, Júu tena pɛ nyoa dɛ́ yo ba dɔma.
Dɛ ba dɔma la dɛ lii kɛ baa won yoo ba dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Kɛ waa la berɔ berɛ.
Juu tena la pɛ nyoa yo ba dɔma, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Juu tena baa lɔ bwɛɛre aa lɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛre ta la bwa chemo kɛ, bá yo ba dɔma baa dɛ ba bá ha ba la.
Nɛra la bɛlbwa ta wone puu ba yo, dɛkalkɛ wobobele aa lɔ bela la bwa nɛra dɛ ɔm ba.
Hale harɛre la bwa nomonjena ne koranar ne nomonome baa chɔ harɛre nyoo, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ kooro la bwa baa che Juu tena la habɔɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba bwa dɛ ɔmɛ Mɔdekae taeh.
Mɔdekae berɛ nomonjen koodem bela, nomɛlbwa no o waa harɛre la bwa ta, asɛ o ta na dɛɛ dɔ kpeɡri saŋ bɛlbwa.
Juu tena la kpɔ keri dɛ ka kpoo ba dɔma dɛ he ba.
Ba ɛɛ ba ɡɛ bwa baa dɛ nyin.
Koobwɛɛ Susa ɡbo ta la, Juu tena la kpoo nɛra lafraanue.
Ba kpoo Pasandata ne Dalfɔn dɛ Aspata, ne Porata ne Adalia dɛ Aridata, ne Pamasta ne Arisai, ne Aridai dɛ Vaisata, baa ɛ Hamedata bibaa Heeman bibaala.
Dɛ Heeman ɛ Juu tena dɔm.
Kɛ Juu tena la ta ba komɛlbwa kpɔe kaa.
Awola tenten la, ba baɡle nɛra baa kpoora koobwɛɛ Susa bela la kooro be.
Kooro Sɛksɛs ŋɔ Ɛsta be ŋɔ, “Koobwɛɛ Susa bonɔ ɡbo, Juu tena la kpoo nɛra lafraanue, dɛ kpo Heeman bibaala fi ja.
Dɛ he nyiŋaa, nɛra baŋwɛnɛɛ baa ba kpoora harɛre maa dɛ di kora a ta nɔ ta nɔ?” Dɛ berɛ bɔɔ Ɛsta ja ŋɔ, “Waane lole ń ɛ tɛɛ ja aa?
Baɡle kon haa dɛ nyin ásɛ n ɛ tɛɛ.” Belaa Ɛsta chaŋo ŋɔ, “N naa, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, tɛ Juu tena baa lɔ Susa bonɔ ŋwɛnɛ kere ɡe ba ɛ ɡɛ baa ɛa fini nɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ Heeman bibaala fi la lala la ka saɡɛ daa ta.” Kooro no ɡɛ dɛ ɡel Susa tena no dɛ ɡel ba saɡɛ Heeman bibaala fi la.
Adar korobie tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ wee la, Juu tena baa lɔ Susa la chemo.
Ba kpoo nɛra lafraatoro bwɛɛ la ta ja, kɛ ba ta ba komɛlbwa kpɔe.
Gɛ saŋ waa nɔ aa chiɡ Susa la, dɛ Juu tena baa lɔ harɛre la kabora ta ɡe chemo, dɛɛ kpa ba nyu.
Ba kpoo ba dɔma kaɡboŋa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banue, dɛ dɔ ba te.
Ba ta ba ɡe komɛlbwa kpɔe.
Adar korobie tɔpera fi dɛ atoro taa waa nɔ chiɡ, asɛ o tɔperafi dɛ anaarɛ ta ba onɛ, dɛ di kwaa dɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛ kpɔ a ɡɛ tɔpere la berɛ ba tɔpejen.
Purim Tɔpejen dii Juu tena baa lɔ Susa la yoo tɔpera fi dɛ atoro ne fi dɛ anaarɛ la ta.
Tɔpera fi dɛ anue wee la, ba ɡel yoi dɛ onɛ, dɛ di kwaa lɛ ba sie.
A waa Juu tena baa lɔ bwɛjeɡre ta kpɔ a ɡɛ korobie la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ wee la ɛ ba tɔpejen, dɛ di kwa dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ kɛ kwaa o ta.
Mɔdekae chwerɛ waa aa chiɡa la bwa bil.
O berɔ chwerɛ tɔne ka tɛ Juu tena baa soɡe Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛre bojaŋa ne bela aa bɛno bwa ta.
O ŋɔ bá kpɔ Adar korobie tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ne fi dɛ anue wee la ɛ tɔpejena dɛɛ dia bena bɛlbwa, dɛɛ lii tɔpera Juu tena aa lɛ ba te le ba dɔma nɔn ta, ne tɔpera ba suna dii aa ber ba silɛɛ, ba wii ɡe berɛ hɛɡra la.
Mɔdekae ŋɔ, dɛ ba dɛ di tɔpera la aa, báa di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa ne nyaara bwa kondikwa.
Anomanta, Juu tena la teŋɛ waa Mɔdekae aa chwera tɛɛ ba la ta, dɛɛ di ɡɛ tɔpejena nɔ bena bɛlbwa.
Gɛ tɔpera nɔ munii kɛŋɔ Hamedata bibaa Heeman waa ɛ Aɡaɡ naa, Juu tena bwa dɔm la, fa aa vɔrɔwa kɛŋɔ bá kpoo Juu tena bwa la.
O bil daa dɛ na tɔpere baa kpɔ kpoo ba dɛ́ he ba kwaraa.
Ɛsta aa la Kooro Sɛksɛs be dɛ ŋɔ Heeman vɔrɔwe Juu tena vɔrɔwa dɛ́ fee kpoo ba la, kooro do mmara dɛ ɡel Heeman liichɔɡa waa liira la ɡure o ɡbaɡba nyu ta, asɛ ba saɡɛ o ne o bibaala fi la.
Anomanta, dɛ ba dɛ yerɛ ɡɛ tɔpere nɔ Purim, tɔn Mɔdekae aa chwera ne waa aa puu ba la bwa wa.
Juu tena la lɛo dawɛ ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, ba ne ba naanar ɛɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛɛ, dɛɛ di ɡɛ tɔpera anɛ la bena bɛlbwa.
Hale banɔ la baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba te ba ja ba nɛɛ la bwa jao.
Asɛ baa dia ɡɛ Mɔdekae aa do ba, ne saŋ waa lea cheɡ tɛɛ ba la.
Ba ɛa a chɔ kɛŋɔ, Juu tena ne ba naanar baa lɔ harɛre ne bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ta, Kooro Sɛksɛs aa di kora a ta la ɛɛ di ɡɛ tɔpera anɛ nɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
A chɛ kɛ bá bwa won dɛɛ di a ɡɛ Purim tɔpera nɔ bɛlbwa.
Anomanta, Abihel bihaah Ɛsta waa ɛ kooro haah la kpɔ kpeɡri waa dɔa la, asɛ Juu te Mɔdekae la chao, dɛ chwerɛ o Ɛsta ɡbaɡba tɔn dɛ bol Purim dii la wa, ásɛ a ɡel Mɔdekae tɔn nɛɛte la won ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ.
Mɔdekae bɔne tɔne la tɛ Juu tena baa lɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛre lafa fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ la bwa ta.
O chwerɛ tɔne la, dɛ do ba ɡbemba kɛŋɔ tɔpera aa lɔ sie nɔ baa dɔ deŋnesɔɔhnaa, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel a ɡɛ Purim tɔpera nɔ che kiŋkiŋ baa dia saŋ la Juu te Mɔdekae ne kooro haah Ɛsta aa doa tɛ ba ne ba naanar kɛŋɔ, ba fa aa cheɡ nyoa vɔwa ne suna dii tɔpera la.
Ɛsta mmara la ɡelɔ ɡɛ baa dɛɛ di Purim tɔpera la che kiŋkiŋ, asɛ ba chwera do tɔn bini.
Kooro Sɛksɛs ne Mɔdekae A berɔ ba kɛŋɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs dɛ lɛ nɛra baa lɔ o harɛre ta bwa toɔ, hale dɛ kpoŋe kaa o harɛre aa lɔ mpo nyoa bwa.
Wejena waa ɛa o kora dii saŋ, ne ɡɛ bwa waa ɛ Mɔdekae nomonjen la, ba chwerɔ do Midia ne Pɛɛsea koranar waa tɔne bini.
Mɔdekae ɛ nomonjen, dɛ Kooro Sɛksɛs toole naa, dɛ onee lole.
O ɛ nɛnjen o dɔŋa Juu tena la bwa bini, asɛ baa tɛo jirima dɛɛ nyin o wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o nyin kɛrɛdɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhna tɛ o naanar bwa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Job Tɔn nɔ ɛ tɔn waa biɡra kɛrɛdɛ.
O dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Job bwara aa nyɛɡo kohona, asɛ a bwa habɔɔ o ta habɔɔ berɛ kpo Korowii.
Korowii tɛ Bɔnsam ŋwɛnɛ o daah Job na.
Dɛ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe dɛ dɔ kwaa ɡe.
Job bii bwa serewɔ, o paŋɛ o kondɔɔh dɛ we weela ɡe a ka tama o sewɛ.
O daamanar takapɔ ɡel o jemɛ kɛŋɔ o wechɔɡa waa Korowii ɛɛ tɛr o deŋne, kɛ dɛ baa waa Korowii aa dɛ ɛ la mun jemɛ.
Anɔ nomanta, ba ta Job chae kwaraa.
Job ta lɛɛ do kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ Korowii fee tɛr o deŋne ɡɛ.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Korowii ɡbaɡba bol waa o be.
Job ɡbabir baa na kɛŋɔ waa Korowii nyokpowe-ɛɛla bɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ jemɛ, dɛ na kɛŋɔ o bol ɡɛnewobol.
Korowii kpɔ Job ne o daamanar wechɔɡa kɛ ba ɡɛ saŋ Job aa soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba la.
Job bwara wa Baa bɛl fa lole, o sɔne Job, dɛ do harɛ bɛl ta baa yerɛ bela Us.
Wobɛlbwa toole o nɛ, o waa toɡre.
O dɛ tomɛ Korowii, dɛ laa o te dɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.
O lolɛ bibaala banuanɛ dɛ bihaahna batoro, dɛ dɔ peera kaɡboŋa anuanɛ, nyoɡmare kaɡboŋa atoro ne nae kaɡboŋ baa kpɔa dɛɛ parɛ, ne keeɡore lafraanue, dɛ dɔ bonɔɔna ne toli ɡe kohona.
Job aa dɔ kwaa kohona nomanta, dɛ onee suuɡate dɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa lɔ wee leebɔr harɛ la bwa ta.
O bibaala la bɛlbwa yon le o tɔpere cheɡ, dɛ́ ɡel ba daa kondikonjena o dem, dɛ́ yerɛ ba nimambihaahna batoro la, bá ka puu ba di kwaa la dɛ́ lɛ ba sie.
Ba di kondikonjena la dɛ bar chiɡ tonaa, ba mɛɛ Job yon ir chɔɔ, dɛ kpo kon ɛ saraha soŋe ba wechɔɡa Korowii be, bɛlbwa nyu ta.
O yon lii ŋɔ, “N bii nɔ ken ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ba ta jemɛ.” Dɛ waa Job aa dɛ ɛ saŋ bɛlbwa laanee la.
Job loɡla daahna dɛ́ na Awola bɛl, nyundua toroma la Korowii be, dɛ Bɔnsam ɡe ja bɛl.
Anee Korowii pɛɛ Bɔnsam ŋɔ, “Leperaa he le dɛ ba nɔ?” O ŋɔ, “Gaaɡaa n do harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ɡaaɡe la dɛɛ ba.” Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he na n bonɔɔ Job waɔ?
Nomɛlbwa toole o waa toɡre kɛ on harɛ nɔ ta, wechɔɡe bɛlbwa toole o nɛ, o dɛ tom mɛ, o laa o te dɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.” Ate, Bɔnsam chaŋe ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Job ɛɛ tomɛ pɛɛpɛɛ yaa?
He kpɔ nɔn tɔ o ne o dem tena ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa nɛ.
Dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛo o toma bɛlbwa ta, dɛ ɡel o kondɛɛra ya perɛ harɛ la bwa ta.
Laa nɔn kpɔ komɛlbwa waa dɔa ta dɛ́ na, wɛɛ taahnee he na.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ Bɔnsam be ŋɔ, “A wer, komɛlbwa waa dɔa la lɔ he nɔn ta, kɛ o te ɡbabir te, bɛ nɔn kpɔ leɡo.” Asɛ Bɔnsam le Korowii be dɛ kaa.
Awola bɛl, Job bibaala ne bihaahna la dɛ di kondikonjena la ane, dɛɛ lɛ ba sie ba dɔɔ nomoa dem, belaa torome bɛl kpɔ chwae ba Job be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ya kpɔ nae kaa parɛ, asɛ keeɡore ɡe do ya jwɛɛh dɛɛ di, asɛ Seba tena ba lɔ jo a bini, dɛ lawa kaa.
Ba kpoo n bala la bwa.
N ɡboo wona dɔ bɔr chwa, dɛ baa bol he be la!” Torome la nyoa taa lɔ waa la ta wɛɛ bol la, dɛ torome la bɛl ɡe balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Bwaala kɔrɔ jo ya ne kondɛɛra la bini, dɛ fuh a ne n bala la bwa.
N ɡboo le a nyoa, asɛ dɛ baa bol he be la.” O ɡe nyoa ta chiɡe, dɛ torome bɛl ɡe balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Kaldea tena baa kpoŋe dɔmkwaa dɛɛ ŋwɛ bɔne ba bini nɛmbele batoro, dɛ ba lɔ jo ya bini, dɛ lawɛ he nyoɡmare la bwa kaa.
Ba kpoo n bala la bwa.
N ɡboo wona dɔ bɔr chwa, dɛ baa bol he be la!” Torome la ɡe nyoa ta chiɡe, dɛ bɛl ɡe balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ he bibaala ne bihaahna la lɔ ba dɔɔ nomoa la dem, dɛɛ di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, asɛ peukpeɡ den ta le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ ba lɔ dem la, o bwa ku chole ba nɛɛ ba bwa serewe.
N ɡboo wona le a nyoa, dɛ baa bol he be la.” Job aa no ɡɛ la, o ir che dɛ laa o batakaare kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ o loo kuu, dɛ fonɛ o nyu.
Ate, dɛ chɔ kpɔ sie pi harɛ, dɛ jam Korowii, dɛ ŋɔ, “Ba lol mɛ mumɡbal, mumɡbal nee n berɛ dɛɛ ba kaala.
Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ, onee dɛɛ lɛ.
Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ o sɔn.” Waa nɔ bwa ta la, Job ta Korowii nɛɛ nyae a ɛ wechɔɡa tɛo.
Job nɛɛtena daahna dɛ́ na Awola bɛl ɡe ja, nyundua toroma la baa cheme Korowii sie, dɛ Bɔnsam ɡe ja bɛl.
Anee Korowii pɛɛ Bɔnsam ŋɔ, “Leperaa he le dɛ ba nɔ?” O ŋɔ, “Gaaɡaa n do harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ɡaaɡe la dɛɛ ba.” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he na n bonɔɔ Job waɔ?
Nomɛlbwa toole o waa toɡre kɛ on harɛ nɔ ta, wechɔɡe bɛlbwa toole o nɛ, o dɛ tom mɛ, dɛ laa o te dɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.
He ba n be ŋɔ n tɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ he ka chɔɡo, dɛ o ta waane ɛɛ, kɛ ane a bwa, o waa ta toɡrɔ.” Bɔnsam chaŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛn dɛ nyin o nyu aa, wɛɛ won kpɔ kwaa waa dɔa bwa charɛ.
Lɔɔ bil weela ta dɛ́ na, dɛ waa hen taah he na naa.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Bɔnsam be ŋɔ, “A wer ɡa, n kpɔɔ do he nɔn ta, kɛ na kɛ haa on kpo.” Anomanta, Bɔnsam le Korowii be bela dɛ ka kpɔ ŋwɛrchɔɡa ta Job nɛ, le o nyu ta ba ta o napaala ta.
Asɛ Job ka so tɔɔ ta a baɡle kɛ o loo kuu, dɛ kpɔ kaŋli dɛɛ paa ŋwɛra la.
Job haah ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He ta lɔ toɡra he wa aa toɡra la ta naa?
Taah Korowii dɛ́ sewɛ!” Asɛ Job chaŋo ŋɔ, “He dɛ bol ɡɛnewobol.
Wedɛɛɡa ɡboo yaa ba dɔe le Korowii be, yaa wola wechɔɡa tenee dɔ aa?” A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ta la, o ta waa bolɛ yaɡɛ Korowii bwa.
Job daamanar batoro wa Dɛ Job dɔ daamanar batoro bane.
Bɛlee Teman te Elifas, ne Bildad waa le Su harɛ ta, dɛ Sofar o ɡe aa le Naama harɛ ta.
Ba no wahala waa dɛ na la, dɛ ka cheme, dɛ bwa sɛh kɛŋɔ baa lao, dɛ́ ka bwɛɛlo.
O daamanar la aa dɛ ba, dɛ che bojaŋ nao la, ba ta on jemɛ.
Ba wio kohona, dɛ laa ba laala kɛɛ, dɛ ɛ tɔɔ do ba nyuune ta, a baɡle kɛ ba loo kuu.
Ba ne o soɡe harɛpɛɛ, chɔɔ ne jwaana, tɔpera anuanɛ.
Bɛlbwa ta waa o be bolɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba na ɡɛ o bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ.
Job waa naɡra Job ne o daamanar aa soɡa yawanyoa habɔɔ la, o taah nyoa tɔpere baa lolɔ.
O ŋɔ, “Korowii ɡel tɔpere baa lol mɛ o ta ne jwaana la baa kpoŋe n tea la bɛ ba kpa!
Korowii, ɡel tɔpere la te waa ta kwara, bɛ o waa lii kpa bwa, bɛ ɡel wee le o ta.
Gel biro o bini aa ɔma tɔ ɡɛ tɔpere la ta, kpɔ baama tɔ o ta o waa le, bochaah bɛ o ta ba kpa bwa.
Le ɡɛ tɔpere jwaana la le, o bɛ benanyoa bɛlbwa ta ba kpa, a ba ɛ kɛ baa lii o waa.
Bɛ ɡel ba kpoŋe bie tea a ɡɛ jwaana la ta, bɛ ɡel silɛɛ ɡbɔɡa bɛlbwa le o ta.
Gel voɡra taah a ɡɛ tɔpere la, nɛra baa won mpo bini oljen waa dɛ tuuɡi harɛ, waa do kɛŋɔ lɛŋɔ yera la.
Bɛ ɡel o chɔɔlen weweela chaah, bɛ ɡel bɔr chaah a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wee ɛɛ leo, dɛ́ chaah bɔr o ta.
Taah awola jwaana baa lol mɛ, n ba dɛ baa na wa, dɛɛ di suna o ta nɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ maa wola n nya tea bini sewɛ buɡ ta waa lol mɛ laɔ?
Bɔkwaa n nya kpɔ mɛ dawɛ o nakpale ta, kɛɛ dɛ ɔr mɛ elɔ?
Dɛ n fe sewɔ ɡɛ saŋ aa, n fe chɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ta, dɛɛ onɛ, n ne koranar ne nomonjena, ba fa aa ma dejena a saŋ la, dɛ so a ta bwa berɛ dimɡbia.
N ne koranar baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa su ba deene dɛ serewe la bwa fe chɔɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ maa wola doe kɛŋɔ bie baa haro ta dɛ huɡo, kɛɛ bechasɔɔhna waa sewa o ta wee nae bwa nɔ?
Lalbɔɔ binii nyubinikpeɡ tena we-ɛɛla ɛɛ tonɛ, nɛra baa ɛ toma koh la ɡe kaa onɛ.
Belaa nɛra baa laɡ ba do deene bwara ɛɛ sɔɔh ba, baa nyɛɡa ne dokpeɡa bɛlbwa na kpa.
Nomonjena ne dansaara bwa lɔ bela, bela te, yom toole o dɔɔ lɔɡa kpa.
Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɡel nɛra ba bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ so le nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ o tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ di suna mkpa nɔɔ?
Ba pɛla lawɔ kɛ bá sewɛ kɛ baa dɔ, dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyinu ɡwaa kondɛɛɡe bɛl waa sɔah, ba sie aa lɛ kɛrɛdɛ, kɛŋɔ ba fe aa sewa ba huɡ ba.
Korowii ɡelɔ baa ba kerekere waa jemɛ, dɛ tɔ ba do bobɛlbwa.
Suna dii ber mɛ kondikwa, maa won ɡel pɛma bwa.
Waa maa dɛ ɔma kohona, laanee ba n nɛ.
N ta deŋnesɔɔhna dɔe, n ta ona dɔe, atane wenaale ɡbo.”
Job dam Elifas Belaa Teman te Elifas ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ, “Dɛ n bol waa baɡle naa, hɛɛ no n bee yaa?
Maa won tɔ nyoa ɡɛ kpa.
He chaɡle nɛra ɡalɡa wa, dɛ cha banɔ la baa ɡwɛɡra ɡe ba dɔ bokpeɡa.
He wobol cha nɛra baa nyoɡre Korowii ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ ɡel ba won che ja.
He ɡe kwaa bala fini, dɛ kpɔ bambichɔɡa ba ta he nɛɛ la.
He tomɛ Korowii, wechɔɡa bɛlbwa aa wola toole he nɛ, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ yarada dɛ dɔ hwɛɡa.
Nyiŋi waa nɔ, umee wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛ sewɛ bwa nɔ?
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra ɡe dɛ dɔ wekpeɡa aa?
N ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa, ne banɔ la baa dɛ nyin waa la, anee baa dɔ.
Korowii bandia do kɛŋɔ dompeu, o hwee ta ba nɛɛ ba serewe.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena do kɛŋɔ nyujentena aa dɛ si, kɛ Korowii sɔɔh a nyoa dɛ kuuɡi a nyena.
Nyujente ta ol dɔe lawɛ di aa, o dɛ sewɛ, ásɛ o bii bwa ɡe lɔ peɡre.
Nomɛl sɔɔh ba lɔɡ mɛ waane tamaa ken, aa do ɡɛ la, n ta wone no a bini kɛrɛdɛ.
A do kɛŋɔ jwaanen deechɔɡa ken, a chɔɡ n dom, ɔmee ne bochela laɡ mɛ, n bwara bwa ɛɛ sa.
Komɛl ɡale n sie ta, asɛ n bwara ɛɛ mɛ nyirr.
Kon la cheɡɔ, kɛ n ta wone jemɛ o konsoo.
N na o dor o che n sie, asɛ n no taa bɛl o ŋɔ, ‘Nɛwɛnyini waa ɛɛ won toɡre ɡwaa Korowii aa?
Nɛn ɛɛ won do ɡoroŋ ɡwaa Korowii waa tao wa aa?
Dɛ Korowii ta hwɛɡa dɔe o nyundua toroma nɛ, hale o na wechɔɡa ba nɛ aa, he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ hwɛɡa nɛn waa kpɔ teera mao nɛɛ ya?
Wɛɛ won sewɛ warane kɛŋɔ baa dɛ kpo konɡaahle la!
Hɛɛ nao chɔɔ kɛ jɔmɔra ne tela dɛ o sewɔ dɛ he ta ɡɛ liire.
Baa pa o kondɔɔh bwaa kaa, o sewɛ dɛ o ta wejema bɛlbwa dɔe le Korowii be.’ ”
Elifas berɔ ŋɔ, “Job yerɛ na, umee dɛ́ chaŋe nɔ?
Nyundua torome bɛl lole dɛ́ no he be naa?
Akai!
Bandia dɛ kpo ɡɛne, sibeɡra ɡe ɛɛ kpo nɛn waa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ.
N ɡbabir na nɛn waa ɡɛna o soɡa bini do wer, kɛ buɡ la ta, nyotaahna chole o dem.
O bii dɛ na sibeɡrewaa kohona, nɛn toole dɛ́ bol ba waa tɛɛ ba kɔɔto.
Nɛn lɔr aa dɛ kpoo dɛ́ di ɡɛne kondikwaa waa dua, hale anɔ la aa lɔ sɔɔhne baah, asɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin kafo siwi ɛɛ beɡre ɡɛ ɡɛne la kondɔɔh.
Teera ta laa wechɔɡa le kɛŋɔ konduuli, a ta laa wenaale le.
Ba lolɛ nɛn aa, dɛ o ne waa, kɛŋɔ nihɛm yon chuɡri dɛɛ kaa nyundua la.
Kɛ dɛ menee yaa, n fe ɛɛ soŋe Korowiirii, dɛ́ kpɔ n waa bil o sie.
Wejena haa wola won no a munii Korowii ɛɛ ɛ, nyokpowaa haa wola won kuraa wɛɛ ɛ. O ɡelɔ bwaala ɛɛ nɛ harɛ ta, dɛ ɡel wɛɛ tel kpɔɡbaah bwa.
Korowii dɛ tɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra chebɔr, banɔ la baa dɛ wi ɡe dɔ silɛɛ.
O dɛ chɔɡ nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba jemɛ waa liire, dɛ ɡel baa won wedɛɛɡa bɛlbwa ɛ. O ɡelɔ nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba jemɛ waa la ɡbaɡba liire ɛɛ laɡ ba, wobɛlbwa baa ɛ la aa maɡre.
Biro dɛ ba ba nɛɛ webaŋa, baa laɡre bɔr kɛŋɔ jwaana ken.
Korowii lɛ nɛra dɛɛ le ba seo nyoa, o lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le fiiɡa ta.
Anomanta, banɔ la aa hiah ba dɔ hwɛɡa, nɛnchɔɡa ta waa dɔe dɛ́ bol kpa.
Nomɛlbwa Korowii aa dɛ kaoh la na som, anomanta, dɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la dɛ toɡre naa, bɛ an wesale lii.
Onee dɛɛ do nɛn bol dɛ berɛ dɛɛ vɔrɔwo, dɛɛ do nɛn weela dɛɛ chaoh.
Saŋ bɛlbwa Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ le wenaale ta.
Lɔr saŋ wɛɛ lɛɛ le seo nyoa dɛ́ lɛɛ le laa ta.
Wɛɛ lɛɛ le chɔɡa nɛra aa dɛ chɔɡe ta, wekpeɡa dɛ ba he nɛ aa, bɛ ɔmɛ, wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛ.
Lɔr ne wekpeɡa dɛ ba naa, hɛɛ soo dɛɛ mamɛ, haa kpɔɡ bini olaa ɔmɛ.
Koo haa parɛ la, bwea aa o taa do, kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa aa hen ɡbaa bwa.
Hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ he dem sɔɔhnɔ kɛrɛdɛ, he kure he kondɔɔh, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa ta nyoɡrɛ.
Hɛɛ nao ɡe kɛŋɔ he bii warɔ, ásɛ he naanar warɛ kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken.
Hɛɛ dɔ mkpajaŋee, he bwara ta do kpeɡri mɔɔ he sewɛ, kɛŋɔ mea yon be kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ ba koma la.
Job, ya ɡbabir nyiŋi ɡɛ waa nɔ, dɛ na kɛŋɔ a ɛ kasinteŋ.
Anomanta, kpɔ dɛ ɛ ɡɛ tenten.”
Job wobol Job chaŋe Elifas ŋɔ, “Dɛ ba fe kari n wenaale ne n suna maa dɛ di bwa naa, a fe ɛɛ do tɔɡree ɡwaa mpo nyoa hɛŋle bwa, a waa he na kɛŋɔ n wobol la bini nyɛɡre la.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la ta mɛ hɛma, asɛ tɛɛɡa aa lɔ a ta la jooɡe n bini.
Korowii kpɔ wenaale aa do ɔma teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ ta n nɛ.
Keeɡo dɔ kpɔɡa dɛɛ chwe aa, waa si, ɡɛɛ nabal ɡe dɔ kwaa dɛɛ dia aa, waa wola si.
Yar toole kondikwaa ta naa, a dɛ do som aa?
Jahal kompoŋ ɡbo som aa?
N pɛla aa ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ dɔ, a dɛ tɛ mɛ weela.
N dɛ soŋe Korowii ó tɛ mɛ anɔ la n pɛla aa lawa, kɛ ó fe tɛ mɛ komɛlbwa n hwɛɡa aa lɔ a ta, kɛŋɔ wɛɛ sɛoh ba kpo mɛ, ásɛ dɛ teŋe me mkpa ta.
Belaa mɛɛ ba bolarawa dɔe n sie lɛ, n weweele aa wola tonɛ bwa ta, á baɡle kɛŋɔ n ta Korowii O Wa Aa Do Goroŋ la waa vɛɛh.
N dɔ bokpeɡa dɛ ta dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛ mɛɛ so lee yaa?
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba le soɡa dɛ n ta hwɛɡa dɔe yɔ?
N bwara kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwe aa?
Kɛɛ n bwadabii do kɛŋɔ ayaawa ɔ?
N ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ lɛ n te, bobɛlbwa toole ń kpɔ sie chaɡɛ nɛn cha mɛ.
Dɛ waa pu nɛn aa, a chɛ kɛ o daamanar ɛɛ chao, hale dɛ o vɛh Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ɔma kwaraa noo.
Kɛ n bala ta nɛra maa kpɔ n te dawɛ ba nɛɛ ɛɛ, ba do kɛŋɔ nenabɔɔne bwaala yon nɛ a su, o baa ɡel nɛɛ yaa, a yon hweeh la ken.
Dombwea baa ta aa, nenabɔɔne dɛ suuɡi, kɛ wee baa lɔ aa, dɛ a mwɛɛlɔ, a bini yon hol dɛ chɔ pɛɛ.
Nɛra baa soɡe nyoɡmare ta, dɛ valɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe nee dɛ nyɔ nyoɡrɔ, ba ɡaaɡɔ dɛ ka serewe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Nɛra soɡe nyoɡmare ta le Seeba ne Tema dɛ valɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin ne.
Ba hwɛɡa kaa tonɛ, nenabɔɔne aa hweehra bini.
Hé do kɛ nenabɔɔne la n be, he ta chae bɛlbwa dɔe, he na waane aa ba n nɛ dɛ ɔmɛ dɛ le habɔɔ.
N bol he be kɛŋɔ he tɛ mɛ komɛl, kɛɛ he che n naa ta bɔ komɛl tɛ nomɛl, dɛ́ le he kondɔɔh ta naa?
Kɛɛ he lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma nɔn ta, kɛɛ dɛ cha mɛ le nɛn waa dɔɔ mɛ, o nyu bini do kpeɡri nɔn ta nɔ?
A wer, hé baɡ mɛ n wechɔɡa maa ɛa, mɛɛ tɔ nyoa dɛ́ no he be.
Kasinteŋ dii dɛ we, kɛ waa haa dɛ bol nɔ ta mun dɔe.
He dɛ lii ŋɔ n dɛ bol wepuu, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ chaŋe n waa, kɛŋɔ nɛn waa wola kerekere waa lii nɔɔ?
Hɛɛ won ta bie bilalbii waa kwara!
Dɛ yoɡ he daamanar dɛ́ dɔ suuɡa.
N dɛ soŋe heya, hé nyiŋ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ!
Mɛɛ teŋe nyosone he sie yaa?
Hé berɛ nyiŋi a bini, dɛ bɛ men bolchɔɡe pa, hé kwaa lii, dɛkalkɛ n waa la wer.
Nyosone ane le n nyoa kɛɛ?
Maa wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa jemɛ aa?”
Job berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini soɡa bini, tomkpeɡaa chɔ le dɛ tɛo, kɛŋɔ paate waa dɛ ɛ toma la.
A do kɛŋɔ yom aa nyin chunchule dɛɛ onɛ, kɛɛ paa te aa dɛ kpa o kembɔr la.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ so korobie bɛlbwa pɛɛpɛɛ, jwaana bɛlbwaa mɛɛ na wa.
N yon chɔ dɛɛ lii ŋɔ, ‘Bɛweeree bɔr ɛɛ ba chaahna ń irɔ?’ Dɛ chɔ kalaŋ ta, dɛ beɡre ɡɛ naa dɛɛ nyin bɔr chaah.
Dudule ne ŋwɛra su n bwadabii bwa, nee ɛɛ le n ŋwɛra ta.
N tɔpera teŋo baa kaa warane kɛŋɔ yasɔɔh aa dɛ ta kokorowa la, a dɛ tonɛ kɛ dɛ n ta hwɛɡa dɔe.
N Naa Korowii, bɛ soh kɛŋɔ me mkpa ka kerabeŋkpoŋ hweera, silɛɛ toole n soɡa bini kpa.
Taraken haa na mɛ nɔ, haa men na kpa, hɛɛ baa nyin n bɔree, dɛ n toole.
Gɛ bam aa wola le do saŋ bɛlbwa la, ɡɛɛ nɛn sewaa waa wola ba kpa.
Waa berɛ ba so o dem kpa, bela o fa aa soɡa la, baa on na kpa.
Anomanta, maa nyoa tɔ, mɛɛ che n weweele taa, dɛ́ bol waa sum ne.
N ɛ mpo, kɛɛ o bini oljen asɛ hɛɛ do mɛ dɛɛɡɔ aa?
N Naa Korowii, n baa chɔ kalaŋ ta dɛ́ ŋɔ n onaa, n chɔɔbɔr la ɡelɔ waa aa dɛ ha mɛ la nyoa ɛɛ sɔɔh, bela kwaraa la, he dɛ aah mɛ deera ta, he ɡelɔ mɛɛ na wepila dɛɛ ɔmɛ, dɛ́ ɡel n pɛla lawɛ kɛŋɔ baa hamɛ n lobi n sewɛ dɛ ɡwaa kɛ aa ka n hoɡa ɡbo nɔ.
N soɡa bini pe mɛ, maa nyin kɛ n so le dɛɛ la.
Gel mɛ, n soɡa ta mun dɔe.
Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyina ɡe ba waa hiaeh nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ dawɛ waa baa dɛ ɛɔ?
He dɛ nyiŋi ba we-ɛɛla, chɔɔ bɛlbwa dɛɛ daah ba saŋ bɛlbwa.
Haa sie laa kpɔ n nɛɛ tama, dɛ́ ɡel n lile nentane kwaraa naa?
Dɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa kwaraa naa, bɔkwa waa n ɛɛ nɔ?
He laa dɛɛ daah nɛra la aa?
Ɛrɛɛ he fome siwi pa n nɛɛ nɔɔ?
N ɛ bone tɛɛ kɛɛ?
Ɛrɛɛ haa wola n wechɔɡa kpɔe kɛ mɛ, dɛ ɡel waa maa koni a ta la taɔ?
Maa biɡri chɔ n banɔn ta, hɛɛ dɛɛ nyin n bɔree, kɛ dɛ n toole.”
Job dam Bildad wobol Bildad waa le Su la chaŋe Job ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo he wobobala nɔ ɛɛ ba tona ɔ?
He wobol do kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ, kɛ a ɛ wepuu.
Waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ la, Korowii dɛ ɡolaa?
Waa aa toɡraa Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la ɛɛ ɛ.
He bii ken ɛ Korowii wechɔɡa, a waa o tɛr ba deŋne ɡɛ aa chɛa.
Dɛ he dɛ nyin Korowii bɔr, dɛ́ ɡuŋi dɛɛ soŋe On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la, dɛ he waa wer dɛ toɡre aa, wɛɛ ba chae dɛ́ berɛ tɛɛ sobɔrdɛɛɡe a ɛɛ kembɔr.
Kwaa haa dɔa mumpar la ken aa kanɛ, anɔ la Korowii aa ba tɛɛ a habɔɔ la ɛɛ do kanee kohona.
Ta sie nyiŋi, saŋ la tena waa bini, dɛ na waa ya naawa aa hwela.
Ya te aa biɡri, yaa wobɛlbwa jemɛ, ya soɡa bini do kɛŋɔ lileo ken harɛ nɔ ta.
Hé ɡel ya naawa wejema baɡle heyaa wa, dɛ́ nyiŋi waa baa bola bil la ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Bela nee aa lole laanee pul won kpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ, aa won kpeɡ bela nee aa wola toole.
Nee la hweehraa, anee tɔ sie dɛɛ hol, kɛ dɛ a ta kpeɡe kɛŋɔ ba kua dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Gɛɛ nɛra baa soh Korowii waa la bwa do, baa vɛh Korowii nomanta, ba ta hwɛɡa dɔe.
Kon baa kpɔ ba hwɛɡa dawɛ o ta, do kɛ ŋwandare yal ken.
Ba yale ŋwandare yal ta naa, wɛɛ won laɡ ba kpoŋaa?
Ba lawɔ kpoŋe aa, baa won che naa?
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra do kɛ kpɔɡa aa kpeɡa dɛ che webaah, ba do kɛŋɔ anɔ la aa moɡa tɔ bodɛɛɡe baa du daa.
A dɛ ta lune bar bwea, ásɛ dɛ lawa kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ.
Kɛ dɛ nomɛl tua le bela aa, nomɛlbwa aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ a fa lɔ bela.
Gɛɛ a do, silɛɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɔa laanee, banfalaa yon ba so ba buɡ ta.
Kpelaa, Korowii aa nɛra ba waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la vɛh bwa, ɡɛɛ waa wola wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡe cha.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he sie lɛ he mamɛ, dɛ́ hɛɡre dɛɛ moo.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo sihiih kpo he dɔma, wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deremi ɡe chɔɡ.”
Job chaŋe Bildad Job chaŋe Bildad ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, n jemɔ kɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ.
Aah ɛrɛɛ nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba wona di bole Korowii nɛɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won tɔŋle Korowii ɔ?
Wɛɛ won pɛɛ webele kaɡboŋ, nɛn aa won chaŋe a bini beŋkpoŋ kwara.
Korowii dɔ wejema, dɛ do kpeɡri taeh!
Umee dɛ́ won ɛ deŋnekpeɡ o nɛ, á chiɡu kɛrɛdɛ nɔ?
O huɡri bwejena dɛɛ ta, o baah diu waa, o dɛ chɔɡa.
Korowii ɡelɔ harɛ ɛɛ jiɡri dɛ́ le o buɡ ta, ásɛ kwaa waa chɔŋɛ a ta, a do kɛ pilare la ɛɛ yiiɡi.
Wɛɛ won ŋɔ wee bɛ le, jwaana ɡe weweela bɛ won chaah.
O ɡboo paɡri nyundua bɔle kɛ yal, dɛ berɛ won valɛ mpo nehɛma ta.
Onee ta weweela bwa soo siwi, ne anɔ la aa lɔ nyundua weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
O dɛ ɛ wejena nomɛlbwa aa wola won jemɛ a mun, dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla aa wola nyoa dɔe.
Korowii kpɔ n jwɛɛh ba kaa laa, maa on na.
Dɛ o ŋɔ wɛɛ lɛ komɛlee yaa, umee dɛ́ won tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ ɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwaa hɛɛ ɛ nɔɔ?’ Korowii baah diu waa, o ɡbaɡba aa won o te larawe warane, o dɛ sɔɔh mpo bini oljen ne kwaa aa dɛ chao la nyoa, á do o lɔɡa.
A do ɡɛ naa, n dɔ waane dɛ chaŋe Korowii aa?
N ne waa won cheme.
Dɛ n waa fe toɡrɔ kwaraa naa, n fe aa won chaŋo, waa maa ɛ bwaa kɛ ń fe soŋe Korowii waa dɛ di n waa la ó sune n nɛ.
Dɛ n fe yerɔ o sɛh n be naa, maa lii kɛŋɔ o fe ɛɛ no n bee.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo peuchɔɡe ta dɛ́ lɔ mɛ bil, n bwara foɡri, aa wola mun dɔe.
Waa ɡel ń won hwee ɡba, dɛ́ kpɔ suna dii ta n nɛɛ kohona.
Dɛ kpeɡri waa yaa, onee kpeɡa dɛ ɡwaa mɛ!
Dɛ kɔɔto ɡee yaa, umee dɛ́ won la o ne nɔ?
N waa fe toɡrɔ kwaraa naa, n wobol fe ɛɛ pa mɛ bolchɔɡee.
Wobɛlbwa fe toole n nɛɛ aa, n waa fe ta maɡrɛ.
N waa toɡrɔ te, kɛ n waane laa wobɛlbwa aa ba n nɛ.
N soɡa bini pe mɛ.
A bwa beŋkpoŋ, a waa n ŋɔ, ‘Korowii dɛ chɔɡ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa la.’ Wekpeɡa piɡro ba seo ne naa, Korowii dɛ mamɛ nɛn wobɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ.
Harɛ bɛl baa do nɛnchɔɡa nɔn ta naa, Korowii dɛ damɛ nɛra baa dɛ di ba waa liire.
Dɛ o laa aa, umee dɛ́ won ɛ ɡɛ nɔ?
N soɡa bini tɔpera dɛ kaa warawara kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ chwa, silɛɛ bɛlbwa ɡe toole a ta.
A do kɛŋɔ ɡbera aa chɔŋɛ nee sie dɛɛ kaa warane, kɛɛ kee aa le nyundua, dɛɛ ba ba lawɛ kon di la ken.
Dɛ n ŋɔ mɛɛ soh n weweelee yaa, atane n tɔ nyoa, dɛ́ kwaa n sie do, dɛ mamɛ.
N weweele bwa ta, n dɛ ɔmɛ, n jemɔ kɛ Korowii ɛɛ pa mɛ bolchɔɡee.
Dɛ n di bolchɔɡe aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ń koh ta pɛɛ ja aa?
Hale n sɔ semina dɛ sarame nɔɔra o ne kwaraa naa, Korowii ɛɛ taɡ mɛɛ do bɔluŋ doŋa aa lɔ o bini, n bwara laala kwaraa aa men nyin, kɛŋɔ nɛn yon hah o dɔŋ la.
O ta nɛn ɛɛ ásɛ n ŋɔ mɛɛ chaŋoo, kɛɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ n ne wɛɛ ka che kɔɔtoo.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ba che n ne Korowii baah ta dɛ́ bol ya wa.
N Naa Korowii, ɡel n deŋne tɛra, laa ɔmee bɛlbwa kpɔ n nɛ.
N fe ɛɛ bol waa maa wola ɔmɛ, kɛ ɡɛ aa doa taraken nɔ, maa won bol.”
Job berɔ bol Korowii be ŋɔ, “N soɡa bini pe mɛ, mɛɛ bol waa maa wola ɔmɛ.
No n tebinichɔɡ waa nɔ.
N Naa Korowii, Bɛ men bolchɔɡe pa, ɡel ń jemɛ waa aa bala n ne he dɔ.
A wer he be kɛŋɔ he fiɡ mɛ, dɛ́ vɛh kon he ɡbabir aa tao wa aa?
Hɛɛ sɛh waa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ vɔrɔwe taa yaa?
Nɛn sibie he dɔ dɛɛ nyiŋi waa kɛ nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ nyiŋi naa?
He tɔpera do kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini waa won sewa kwa aa?
He bene haa di do kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini kwa aa?
Dɛ ɡɛɛ a do aa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin he na n wechɔɡa dɛɛ nyin he jemɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa maa ɛa nɔɔ?
He ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ n ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ, nomɛl aa won lɛɛ mɛ le he nɔn ta.
Men he ɡbabir aa kpɔ nɔɔra ma nɔ, hɛɛ berɔ chɔɡ mɛ naa?
Lii kɛŋɔ choh nee he ma mɛ, hɛɛ berɔ chɔɡ mɛ ń berɛ teera aa?
Hen tɛ n mɛɛ bokpeɡa o lol mɛ, he ɡelɔ n kpeɡ n nya tea bini.
Henee kpɔ dɛɛhne choŋri n hoɡa, dɛ kpɔ ol ne tɔn bɔla.
He nyin mɛ dɛ tɛ mɛ mkpa, dɛ nyiŋi n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ n ta do le.
Kɛ n nao kɛŋɔ anɔ bwa lɔ he bini, asɛ n jemɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ lɔ he nyu bini.
Dɛ he dɛ nyiŋi kɛ n fee ɛ wechɔɡa, ásɛ he fe bɛ kpɔ kɛ mɛ.
N ɛ wechɔɡa aa, n fe na wa!
N waa toɡrɔ ɡe aa, n fe aa won ir nyu ne, ásɛ sihiih fe kpo mɛ wenaale ɡwaala aa ɡwaa n nɛɛ nomanta.
N ɛ wedɛɛɡa n baŋa pa kwaraa naa, he dɛ bɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ nyujente, dɛɛ aah mɛ dɛ́ do mɛ bol he nyokpowe-ɛɛla ne.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa he kpɔ wefala dɛɛ dawɛ n nɛ, he bandia teŋɛ dɛɛ ɡwaa n nɛ, dɛ na vɔrɔwe wefala dɛ́ ba yoo mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, bɔkwa waa he ɡel ba lol mɛ nɔ?
N dɛ nyin kɛ n fe aa sewa, nomɛlbwa bɛ men na.
Dɛ ba ta men lolɛ, n fe den sewɛ tea bini bɔ kɛ baa lol mɛ nɔ.
N tɔpera aa kaa ta tama kae yaa?
Gel mɛ n so dɛ́ lɛ n sie tama, ásɛ n berɔ kaa laa, maa wola berɛ ba kpa.
N dɛ kaa bela bochaah naa wola toole, bela biro ne suna ɡbo aa lole, bela ɛ biro ɡbo dɛ do kɛŋɔ harambaŋa o ta mar dɔe, dɛ do saɡasaɡa.”
Job dam Sofar wobol Job bol waa tonɛ, asɛ o dam Sofar waa ɛ Naama te ɡe ŋɔ, “Amɔ nomɛlbwa aa ɡɛ waa nɔɔ chaŋe aa?
Wobol kohona ɡelɔ nɛn waa ɛɛ do wer aa?
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ yaa won chaŋe kɛɛ?
He wepuu waa nɔ ɛɛ won tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ, ya bɛ won bol wa aa?
He dɛ bol ŋɔ he waa ɛ kasinteŋ, he ŋɔ he waa toɡrɔ Korowii sie.
Gɛ n fe aa dɛ nyin kɛ Korowii fee chaŋe!
Dɛ ɡel he jemɛ kɛ wejema fuuh, waane lole dɛ ɡwaa nɛwɛnyina liire ta.
Korowii fe chɛ kɛ ó tɛr he deŋne ɡwaa ken.
Hɛɛ won jemɛ Korowii waa nyoa aa?
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la kpeɡri waa dɔa la, hɛɛ won no a mun aa?
Korowii wejema la ɡwaa nyundua ne harɛ jaŋne.
A bini luŋri ɡwaa lalabwɛ.
Hɛɛ won jemɛ ɡɛ naa?
O wejema la kan ɡwaa ɡɛ harɛ nɔ paɡri aa doa, dɛ ɡwaa mpo ɡba.
O lawɛ ŋɔ ba bol he waa dɛ́ doe dea aa, umee dɛ́ won tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ ɔ?
Korowii jemɛ nyosonteŋna wa, o dɛ na ba wechɔɡa we-ɛɛla bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
Gɛne ne wejema dɔe la, dɛ ba wono dɛɛ kpɔɡ bini ol o berɛ dem kon.
Job, kpɔ he bambile bwa tɛ Korowii, dɛɛ soŋo.
Gel wechɔɡa ɛɛ, hale wechɔɡa haa ɛa dɛɛ sɔh bwa.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel he ir nyu ne, dɛ́ dɔ hwɛɡa, he che kiŋkiŋ haa wola ɔmɛ.
Hɛɛ soh he wenaale la bwaa kwaraa, kɛŋɔ nee aa pala ba kaa, haa wola an na kpa la.
He soɡa bini ɛɛ chaahnoo dɛ ɡwaa webaŋa, ásɛ he wenaale aa do kɛŋɔ biro la do kɛŋɔ chɔmbibi wechɛn ken.
Hɛɛ soo kɛrɛdɛ dɛkalkɛ he dɔ hwɛɡa, Korowii ɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel he onɛ, ɔmee bɛlbwa aa wola toole.
Hɛɛ chɔɔ nomɛlbwa aa wola won aahre, nɛra ɡalɡa ba he be, hɛɛ cha ba.
Kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ nao baa a munii no, baa bɔree dɔ dɛ́ chwa kaa.
Ba hwɛɡa bwaa kɛŋɔ ba fee sewɛ.”
Job chaŋe Sofar Asɛ Job chaŋe Sofar ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, heyaa bol waa nɛra ɛɛ no, he toole n be naa, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ bol wejema waa n be kpa.
Kɛ n dɔ liire kɛ heya, he ta men ɡwaalɛ.
Umee lole waa wola ɡɛ waa nɔ jemɔɔ?
N berɛ akwekwe nɛn n daamanar be, ba dɛ mam mɛ, kɛ n waa toɡrɔ, wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole n nɛ, Korowii fa no n wesoŋa ka.
Nɛn waa lɔ bosɔɔhna ta dɛ mamɛ nɛn waa aa lɔ o nɛ.
He nyin waa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa dɛ na wa.
Kɛ ŋwɛɛra ne nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, kwaa baa dɛ tomɛ la taa ba kpeɡri do.
He dɛ nyin waa dɛ hweli aa, he bɔɔ ola ne jumbii á baɡle heyaa wa, kɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta kontaala, ne mpo bini pɛŋa á baɡle heyaa wa.
A ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwa jemɛ waa Korowii aa ɛa.
Korowii kontaala bwa nyu lɔ o nɔn ta, hale nɛwɛnyina bwa.
Gɛ kondikwa aa dɛ do nyondoŋe som, asɛ wobol ɡe ɛɛ do deŋne som la, ɡɛɛ ya dɔ wejema dɛɛ le nɛra baa biɡra be.
Korowii bee wejema ne kpeɡri, ne nɛra jae dɛ waa mun noe le.
Korowii taɡɛ kon ta aa, nomɛlbwa aa won berɛ kwaaro cheɡ.
O do nɛn dea aa, nomɛlbwa aa won leo.
O won ɡela bwaala ɡel nɛɛ ásɛ hwel che, o pili nyundua bwaala nɛ kohona naa, neerare dɛ suuɡi dɛ́ chɔɡ kwa.
Korowiirii dɔ kpeɡri ne wejema, nɛra baa dɛ neɡre nɛra ne banɔ la baa neɡ ba bwa lɔ o lɔɡa.
O lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ja nɛra wejema, dɛ ɡel nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole do kɛŋɔ ɡɛna ken.
O dɛ lɛ koranar kpeɡri, dɛ́ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ yoma.
O dɛ lɛ sɔfore wejema, dɛɛ ba banɔ la baa di kpeɡri biɡri ne harɛ.
O dɛ sɔɔh nɛra baa dɛ di kasinteŋ nyoa, dɛɛ lɛ nomonome wejema.
O ɡelɔ sihiih ɛɛ kpo nɛnjena, dɛɛ sɔɔh kpeɡnɛra nyoa.
O dɛ le kwaa aa sɔah nɛra aa wola a mun jemɛ ne baŋ, dɛɛ le biro ta kwaa ne bochaah.
O won ɡela harɛ bɛl do kpeɡri dɛ́ chɔɡ bɛl ɡe, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel ba warɛ ó lɔ ba peɡre.
Korowii dɛ lɛ harɛre la nomonome liire, dɛ́ ɡel ba wili do hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
Dɛ do biro ta dɛɛ laɡre, dɛɛ yɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛra ken.”
Job berɔ ŋɔ, “N na ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, n noɔ, dɛ jemɛ a mun.
Waa haa jema la, n ɡe jema, he ta men ɡwaalɛ.
N ne Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔree dɔa, n ne he laa.
N dɛ nyin kɛ n ne Korowii cheme, ásɛ n baɡle kɛ n ta bolchɔɡe dii.
Hé kpɔ nyosone tɔ kasinteŋ ta, hé do kɛŋɔ tɛɛɡa te waa wola won chah weela!
Hé tɔ nyoa kwaraa naa, dɛ a fe ɛ wejemwa.
Hé no n waa nɔ bini, hé no n wesoŋa maa kpɔa dɛɛ bil he sie nɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ teŋe nyosone nɔɔ?
Hé dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ dɛ́ won cha Korowii kɛɛ?
Hɛɛ won ɡel o baŋa pa aa?
Hɛɛ won bol o waa tɛo kɔɔto aa?
Korowii nyiŋi he bini naa, wɛɛ na wedɛɛɡa anee yaa?
Hɛɛ won neɡro ɡɛ haa dɛ neɡre nɛra la kɛɛ?
Dɛ he ɛ waa dɛ sɔh dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra sie ta naa, Korowii ɛɛ pa heyaa bolchɔɡee.
O kan waa doa la ɛɛ ɡeloo he jum jah.
Aa ɡel ɔmee lawɛ heya aa?
He sɛɡla ta mun dɔe, a do kɛŋɔ tɔɔ.
Waa haa bola dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lɛ he te do kɛŋɔ choh aa wola kpeɡe ken.
Hé tɔ nyoa, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń bol wa, ásɛ waa aa ba n nɛɛ la ba.
Dɛ wobɛlbwa kwaraa yaa, n sɛoh kɛŋɔ n kpɔ n nyu charɛ seo.
Hale dɛ Korowii kpo mɛ naa, n ta dɔ hwɛɡa o be dɛ́ chemo, dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ n ta bolchɔɡe dii.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel n dɔ lɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ bɛlbwa aa won ba o sie.
Hé cheɡ deŋne no waa maa dɛ ba bola, dɛ́ no ɡɛ maa dɛ baɡle nɔ.
Maa dɔa lii n waa cheɡ nɔ, n jemɔ kɛ Korowii ɛɛ pa mɛ bolee.
Nomɛl lole n ne o won cheme n waa nɔ ta naa?
Nɛn lole ɡɛ naa, n fe ɛɛ heloo dɛ́ sewɛ.
N Naa Korowii, ɛ webele anɛ nɔ ɡbo tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n won ba he sie.
Gel n deŋne tɛra dɛ laa ɔmee kohona kpɔ n nɛ.
Dɛ he yer mɛ naa mɛɛ chaŋee, kɛɛ n bol wa ásɛ he chaŋ mɛ.
Keraŋwɛnɛɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ koni waa ta nɔ?
Gel ń jemɛ waa maa koni a ta.
Ɛrɛɛ he laa sie kpɔ n nɛ, dɛ kpɔ mɛ berɛ he dɔm nɔɔ?
He dɛ nyin he aah mɛɛ kɛɛ?
He ɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ papohole peu aa taa kpɔ dɛɛ kaa kɛɛ?
Hɛɛ doŋ mɛɛ kɛŋɔ haahra peu aa dɛ kaa a nee yaa?
He chwerɛ n bwara waa aa wola were, hale anɔ la maa ɛa n bonɔɔne saŋ.
He do kpɛɛ n nakpale, dɛɛ nyiŋi n vala bini, dɛɛ dawɛ n nabuɡe.
Gɛɛ a do, nɛn do kɛ daa waa pɔah, kɛŋɔ yal chao aa dɛ diu ken.”
Job berɔ ŋɔ, “Ba lolɛ nɛn aa, o tɔpera aa kanɛ, a lɔ tamaa ken, wenaale ɡe ɡboo a bwa.
O dɛ kpeɡ warane kɛ kpɔɡa ken, dɛɛ hol warane, tamaa ken dɛ o nyoɡrɔ kɛŋɔ lileo ken.
N Naa Korowii, hɛɛ nyiŋ mɛɛ dɛ́ na kɛ n lɔ bonɔ, dɛ́ ba bol n waa kɛɛ?
Nɛn waa kah doŋa la ɛɛ won lolɛ nɛn waa wola doŋa kaeh yaa?
Nɛn toole!
He tɔ sie jemɛ ɡɛ nɛn aa so ka tel, dɛ jemɛ korobie aa lɔ o soɡa la ta.
He maɡa ɡɛ bil aa wola charɛ.
Laa sie kpɔ o nɛɛ dɛ́ ta o waa tɛo, dɛ́ ɡel o ɛ o toma ka tel kɛŋɔ waa tonɛ dɛ́ onɛ kɛŋɔ paate.
Hwɛɡa lole dɛ tɛ daa baa teŋo ta, wɛɛ berɔɔ pamɛ dɛ moɡɛ.
Hale dɛ o lune la ɛ ambena o muŋkpul sewɛ dɛ ka harɛ bini, dɛ berɛ dɔ nee tama aa, o berɔ dɛɛ ir dɛ ta kpala kɛŋɔ daa baa chɔɔro ken.
Kɛ dɛ nɛn te sewaa, dɛ a tonɔ, o sewaa, dɛ lee o dɔɔ jaɔ?
Gɛ neerare yon ɡel pala, ásɛ nenabɔɔne hweeh dɛ́ hol la, ɡɛɛ nɛn yon sewɛ, waa wola ir kpa.
Nyundua ne harɛ taa lole nɔ, waa won ir kpa.
N Naa Korowii, n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he laɡ mɛ sɔh lalabwɛ, dɛ́ ɡel n do bela ka tel saŋ he bandia nyoa aa sɔɔh, ásɛ he lii n waa tɔpetooro bɛl.
Nɛn sewaa, wɛɛ won ir dɛ́ dɔ mkpa ja aa?
N fe ɛɛ ɛ tomaa dɛ kpa ka tel kɛŋɔ n wenaale bwa aa ba a jaɡa.
He fe ɛɛ yer mɛɛ, ásɛ n ɡe chaŋe, ásɛ he sie lɛ men haa ta mɛ la nɛ.
Kasinteŋ, he fe ɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi n vala binii, haa wola n wechɔɡaa nyiŋi.
Hɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛ mɛ haa wola an lii kpa, dɛ́ fee wechɔɡa bɛlbwa maa ɛa.
Gɛɛ, bwejena yon kuuɡi dɛ́ choɡli, ásɛ bwea huɡri le bela aa lole, ásɛ nee palɛ dɛ́ kpɔ bwea ta dɛɛ kɛɡra, bwaalajen won teera taɡa dɛ́ kaa, ɡɛɛ he won ɡela nɛwɛnyini hwɛɡa ɛɛ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
He dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ o sewɛ dɛ́ kaa, dɛ́ ɡel o siebɔr beɡre ó kaa.
O bibaala dɔ jirima kwaraa naa waa jemɛ, ba di sihiih ɡe aa, waa no.
O ɡbosoroo bwadabii wee, ne suna waa dɛ dii wɛɛ na.”
Elifas wobol nɛɛtena Belaa Elifas, Teman te la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Job, wejereme bɛlbwa aa waa bol kɛ he kwaa nɔ, a ta mun dɔe kɛ peuchɔɡe aa dɛ ta.
Wejereme bɛlbwa aa waa kenii bol, kɛɛ dɛ́ bol waa lɛ o te wobol aa wola mun dɔe ne.
Haa Korowii ɔma kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ waane, anomanta, nomɛlbwa aa on soŋe.
He nyoa wobol dɛ baɡle he da, neɡra lɔ he nyoa wobol ta.
He ɡbabir nyoa wobol pae bolchɔɡe, waa aa le he nyoa dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ.
Henee nɛn baa tɔ sie lolɛ aa?
He lole mɔɔ Korowii ta deŋɡarere aa?
He no waa Korowii aa vɔrɔwa aa?
He ɡboo nɛn haa dɔ wejemaa?
Wobɛlbwa toole he jemɛ ya ɡe aa wola jemɛ.
Wejema besoo he dɔ ya ɡe aa wola dɔe yɔ?
Banjeni ne nyumpompoŋa tena lɔ ya bini, banɔ la baa ɡwaa he mɛɛ kwara.
Aa were kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡbabir dɛ larawe he bwara aa, he vɛh.
Ya sɔɔh bwara dɛ che o naa ta bol waa he be.
Ɛrɛɛ he bwaawee ir asɛ he sie beɡre ya nɛɛ, he baah di Korowii nɛɛ kohona dɛ ɡel ɡɛ wobochɔɡa nɔ ɛɛ le he nyoa nɔɔ?
Nɛnee bɔkwa ó ŋɔ doŋa toole o nɛɔ?
Nɛn bɛlbwa toole o waa toɡre Korowii be.
Kpelaa, Korowii ta hwɛɡa dɔe tɛ nyundua toroma, ba waa ta toɡrɛ o be, nɛn te pɔɔh, wechɔɡa suu kɛŋɔ waa dɛ nyɔ ne.
Job, cheɡ deŋne, ń bol waa he be, waa maa naa la, mɛɛ baɡle a binii.
Waa wejerema aa bola, anɔ la aa le ba naawa be saŋ la bwa, ba ta kpɔe sɔh.
Ba naawa ɡboo fa dɔ harɛ la, dɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra toole dɛ ɡel ba laa ba te kpɔ Korowii nɛ.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena baa dɛ fiiɡi ba bala, bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ baa ba soɡa bini bwaa.
Ɔmewa ɛɛ chole ba deŋna taa, ɡɛ saŋ baa ŋɔ ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, ŋwɛɛra den lɔ ba tɔ ba nɛ.
Ba ta hwɛɡa dɔe kɛŋɔ baa le waa nyoaa, nomɛl lee ba cheɡ dɛ́ kpoo ba, ásɛ kɔkɔsakire di ba ola.
Ba jemɔ kɛ ba seo tɔpere dɛ́ tel.
Wekpeɡa ne wenaale ɡelɔ baa ɔmɛ kohona a dawɛ ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ kooro waa dɛ la ka yoo ba laa, dɛkalkɛ banee nɛra baa ume nɔn dɛ pa Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ nɛ, dɛ yo Korowii dɛ vɛoh la.
Ba deŋne kpeɡri dɛ kpɔ kwaa tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe dɛ ka yo Korowii.
Sodɛɛɡa ɡelɔ ba je faɡra, ba teene do bare.
Baa ka so bwɛɛre aa paɡra, ne deremi a nɛra aa chwaa kaa la taa, a ka tama deene la choɡli.
Baa nyao, ba kondɔɔh bwa le ba nɔɔra ta, nɛra aa ba kondɔɔh bɛlbwaa na kpa.
Sewaa chɛ kɛ bá sewɛ.
Baa ɛo kɛŋɔ daa nii aa fuh o kpala, peu ta kpɔ o fee kaa ken.
Ba bɛ ba te neɡre dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ dawɛ konsale ta, baa komɛlbwaa dɔ le a ta.
Ba tɔpere aa tel dɛ ba holɔ, kɛŋɔ daa kpale, baa wola won moɡɛ kpa.
Baa ɛo kɛŋɔ ɡrepo daa o nɔna aa wola beɛ dɛ lee, kɛɛ ɔleve daa o fee bwa aa leera.
Nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la aa biirii dɔ, ásɛ nii fuh nɛra baa dɛ nyin kɛ baa yaɡ ba sen la deremi.
Gɛ nɛra nɔɔ dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa, neɡra ɡe ɡboo ba bwa saŋ bɛlbwa.”
Job chaŋe Elifas Anee Job chaŋe Elifas ŋɔ, “N no waa nɔ dɔŋa bwa ka, he berɔ dɛɛ chwee n ŋwɛr kwara.
He wobojaŋa nɔ aa tonɛ bwa, bɔkwa waa dɛɛ ha heyaa hɛɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ n be nɔɔ?
Dɛ he fe do ɡɛ maa doa nɔ, n ɡe do ɡɛ haa doa nɔ naa, n fe ɛɛ bol waa ɡwaa heya he kwaa la berɛ dɔ wesoma.
Kɛ n nyoa wobol ɛɛ won tɛ heyaa bokpeɡa, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Wobɛlbwa toole ń bol a cha mɛ, n tɔ nyoa ɡe aa, n weweele nyoa aa sɔɔh.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ n bokpeɡa tonɛ, dɛ kpoo n dem tena bwa.
He laɡ mɛ dɛ ɛɛ mɛ dɔm, n ɡwaŋɔ dɛ ka hoɡa ɡbo nɛra cheɡɛ ɡɛ ta, dɛ pa mɛ bolchɔɡe.
He toɡri n bini bandia ne kɛ kpɔɡ bini ol ken.
He hah mɛ dɛ fome siwi pa n nɛ.
Nɛra dɛ muɡli n baah ba dɛ warɛ dɛ bar mɛ cheme, dɛɛ kpaa n lwɛrɛme.
Korowii kpɔ mɛ do wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔn ta, o taɡ mɛ ta ba bini.
N fa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, Korowii den ba hamɛ n baŋa dɛ taɡ mɛ ta harɛ.
O kpɔ mɛ dɛɛ hweli hɛm tae.
O ta hɛma le bobɛlbwa dɛɛ yaɡ mɛ, hɛma la yaɡ mɛ dɛɛ vah.
O ɡel n teabini kwaa bwa chɔ baŋ, hale o ta n nɛɛ sune tamaa bɛlbwa.
O teŋɔ dɛɛ do mɛ bola, kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ yo laa siswɛm ne la.
N tɔ lweyal dɛɛ wi, Korowii pɔ n nɛɛ n so bomboɡ ta.
N wio n sibie swɛɛ dɛ bwa ɔɡre.
N ta naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla ane bɛlbwa ɛɛ, n Korowii soŋa ta ɡe n kpɔ duure tɛo.
Dɛ n sewaa, bɛ nɛra baa ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ kɛ ba!
Bɛ ɡel wii maa dɛ wi n kasinteŋ waa la ta tɔ.
Taraken, n dɔ nomɛl nyundua waa dɛ ba n naa ta cheɡa, dɛ́ bol n waa tɛ mɛ.
N daamanar dɛ mam mɛ, n dɛ wi siniire ŋɔ Korowii cha mɛ.
N dɛ nyin nomɛl ó che n naa ta soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ, ɡɛ dam yon soŋe dɛɛ tɛ o dɔŋ la.
A ka n bene tamaa ken, n kaa bela baa wola laŋɛ dɛɛ ba kpa.”
Job berɔ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Maa won hwee kɛrɛdɛ kpa, n seo tɔpere telo tonɛ, lalbɔɔ ɡbosoo kaa dɛ chɔ kpaa mɛ.
Nɛra bwa dɛ mam mɛ, n dɛ na ɡɛ ba sie aa beɡra baa muɡli n baah.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡbabir ba che tɛ mɛ nɔ.
Umee lole dɛ́ ba che n habɔɔ?
He kpɔ waa mun noe sɔɔh ba, haa ɡel ba di bole n nɛ.
Gɛ baa dɛ sɛɡle ŋɔ, Dɛ nomɛl le o daamanar tɛ dɛ lɛ komɛl aa, naate la biirii dɛ́ na a waa la.
Gɛɛ nɛra kpɔ sɛɡla nɔ dɛɛ bol n wa, nɛra lawɛ n sie dɛɛ teɡɛ harɛ.
Suna dii ɡelɔ maa na kɛrɛdɛ n nɔɔra ne nakpale ɡwaŋre, dɛ do kɛŋɔ dawii ken.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwara yɔrɔ a wa, dɛɛ pwaah mɛ ŋɔ maa Korowii tomɛ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la ɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛ́ do ɡɛ dɛɛ la, dɛ́ teŋɛ dɔ bokpeɡa saŋ bɛlbwa.
Dɛ ba bwa berɔ ba dɛ ba che n sie naa, maa ba bini bɛlbwaa na kɛ o ɛ wejereme.
N soɡa bini tɔpera tonɔ, n waa maa maɡla bil ɡe chɔɡ, n hwɛɡa ɡe tonɛ.
N daamanar kpɔ jwaana berɛ webaŋa bɔr joɔ ɡe aa ba ŋɔ, ‘A ka tama bɔr chaah.’ N hwɛɡa bwa lɔ lalabwɛ, belaa mɛɛ ba n kalaŋ pae dɛ́ chɔ biro ta.
Ásɛ n ŋɔ lalbɔɔ be ŋɔ, ‘N mɛɛ hen,’ dɛ́ ŋɔ dudule ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Heyaa n nya ne n nimambii.’ Dɛ lee n hwɛɡa dɔɔ jaɔ?
Waa n sie aa dawɛ a ta la, umee dɛ́ na nɔ?
Waa maa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta la, n ne aa lalabwɛɛ kaa.”
Bildad wobol nɛɛtena Anee Bildad, Su te la chaŋe Job ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo he wobobala nɔ ɛɛ ba tona ɔ?
Tɔ nyoa ya ɡe bol ane.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii yaa kɛ ola nɔɔ?
He dɛ lii kɛ ya ɡɛnɔ kɛɛ?
He kpɔ bandia dɛɛ chɔɡ he wa.
He bandia nomanta, Korowii chɔɡ harɛ kɛɛ dɛ huɡri bwejena le a chebɔra aa?
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra kandea ɛɛ dimoo, wɛɛ ɡel hɔe.
Kandere aa lɔ ba deenee ɛɛ dimoo, bɔr bir ta ba nɛ.
Ba vala bini fa kpeɡri, kɛ a sɔɔhnɔ, jae baa dɛ ja nɛra bane la ɡelɔ ba ɡbabir chole.
Ba ɡbaɡba soɡa bini we-ɛɛla dɛ laɡ ba kɛŋɔ bel ken, ba valɛ kaa jo o ta.
Bel la dɛ lawɛ ba nalurumi, dɛ kpoŋe ba bini kiŋkiŋ.
Ba harɛ bel ba ŋwɛnɛ ta, o chɔ dɛɛ kpaa ba.
Kwaa aa dɛ aah ba ɛɛ bar baa cheme, dɛ ti ba dɛɛ di ba nafeena.
Ba fa dɔ kwa, taraken lɔr dɛ kpo ba.
Wekpeɡa chɔ le dɛɛ kpaa ba.
Weechɔɡa ɡboo ba bwadabi, a ɡelɔ ba nɔɔra ne nakpale bwa pɔh.
Seo kpɔ ba le bela baa soɡa ba bwara sɔɔh ba, dɛ kaa ba ne lalabwɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o ka so ba deene la ta ɛɛ won ka so, kɛ bá kpɔ jebɔrɔwe merɛ a bwa bini mɔɔ.
Ba do kɛ daa waa sewa le o lune ta ka ta o kpala ta.
Nomɛlbwa aa ba waa lii harɛ nɔ ta ba sɔna he kwaraa.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔma doŋ baa le harɛ nɔ ta, dɛ́ le bochaah ta kaa biro ta.
Baa bii kɛɛ naanaree dɔ, ba dwee bɛlbwa aa ka.
Nɛra baa le wee leebɔr, dɛ ka tel wee cholibɔr tena nɛ ɛɛ no ba waa, ásɛ ɔmee chole ba nɛɛ kohona baa chel.
Gɛ aa dɛ ba wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛɛ chiɡa laanee la, nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la.”
Job chaŋe Bildad Ate, Job chaŋe Bildad ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba ɡela n bambile sɔɔh mɛ nɔ?
Saŋ bɛlbwaa hɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ, sihiih aa heyaa kpo ɡɛ haa dɛ sopa mɛ nɔ naa?
Dɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa kwaraa naa, he waane laa, n nɛɛ a dawɛ.
He dɛ lii kɛ he ɡwaa mɛ, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ n wechɔɡaa ɡela mɛɛ na wa.
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii ɡela wenaale nɔ ba n nɛ, o harɛ bel dɛ laɡ mɛ.
N wio dɛɛ nyin nomɛl ó ba lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale nɔ ta, n do lɔŋɔ, kɛ kasinteŋ te bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ.
Korowii tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, n ta bɔr dɔe dɛ́ kpɔ, o ɡelɔ n ka biro ta dɛɛ nyin bɔr dɛ kaa.
O laa n wer doe bwa kpɔ n nɛ, dɛ ɡel n paŋɛ n jirima waa lɔ n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ kooɡbɛrɛ la.
O chɔɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ baa kuuɡi dea ta ken, dɛ ɡel n hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ, kɛ baa huɡri daa ta la ken.
O baah dɛ di n nɛɛ kohona, wɛɛ yoo mɛ kɛ o dɔm ken.
O ɡelɔ o laa tena lɔ ba tɔ n nɛɛ dɛɛ yoo mɛ, ba ma kwaa dɛ che a ta bar mɛ cheme, ba vɔrɔwe ba sobɔra bar n dea.
Korowii ɡelɔ n ne n lolanar baah do jaŋne, n berɛ hɔɔh nɛra baa jem mɛ be.
N lolanar bwa chwa mɛ, n daamanar soh n wa.
Nɛra baa soɡe n dem ne n toli dɛ lii mɛ hɔɔh, n berɛ nɛŋhɔɔh ba siwi ta.
N yerɛ n bonɔɔ o ta men chaŋɛ, hale n soŋo ŋɔ ó cha mɛ.
N haah naa n hweera sɔɔh nyin dɛ́ no, n dɔɔranar ne n nimanar aa n jwɛɛh bala nyin.
Bechale ɡba dɛ nyiŋi n nyubaah, ba na mɛ naa, ba dɛ mam mɛ.
N daamanar tenten kii mɛ, nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ.
N bwadabii tonɔ a ka n hoɡa ɡbo, a ka tama n fee sewɛ.
N daamanar, hé dɔ tedoma tɛ mɛ, Korowiirii lɔ mɛ bil.
Ɛrɛɛ he che n nɛɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa ɡela aa noo mɛ nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ha mɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
N dɛ nyin kɛ nomɛl fee lii n waa nɔ, dɛ́ chwera do tɔn bini, kɛɛ ba fee kpɔ buni ɛa dawɛ bwe ta, á do le saŋ bɛlbwa.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ n Lɛɛ lole, waa bwa jaɡa saŋ la, wɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ taa, dɛ́ ba bol n waa tɛ mɛ.
Weela nɔ aa chɔɡ n bwadabii nɔ habɔɔ n ta do le nɔ, mɛɛ na Korowiirii.
N ɡbabir ɛɛ nao siwi nee, nomɛl laa dɛɛ ba o nae, n sie cheɡɛ chiŋ o wa.
Dɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa yaa ba wona ɡel o bwara nyɛɡo wɔ?’ Hé dɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta dɛ́ ha mɛ.
A chɛ kɛ he ɡbabir ɔmɛ Korowii tokobi dɛ o baah diu waa, ó kpɔ dɛɛ tɛr nɛra deŋne, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛl lole dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole.”
Sofar wobol nɛɛtena Ate, Sofar Naama te la chaŋe Job ŋɔ, “Waa la ha mɛ asɛ n piɡri chaŋe, n liire ɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ ń chaŋe.
N no waa haa bola la a ɛ chɛɡa, kɛ n jemɛ ɡɛ maa chaŋe.
He ɡbabir jemɛ ɡɛ aa doa dɛ le mumpar, dɛ le ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa ta nɛwɛnyini o ba so harɛ nɔ ta, nyubinikpeɡ tena silɛɛ aa biɡri, nɛra baa wola Korowii jemɛ dɔ silɛɛ, kɛ aa ɡɛɛ ka.
Ba dɛ ɛ mbarafo dɛɛ ɡɔɔ ba te, ba nyu kaa leɡe baama ta, baa nyoɡro kwaraa kɛŋɔ peu aa kpɔ tutuɡ kaa la, ásɛ nɛra baa na ba ka la ɛɛ pɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa ba dɔɔ?’ Hɛɛ na baa fini, kere dɛ ba toole kpa kɛŋɔ deera ken, kɛŋɔ wepila haa naa jwaana, haa wola an na kpa la.
Nɛra ba fa aa na ba la aa ban na kpa, bela ba fa aa soɡa la.
Ba ɡbabir biirii chɛ kɛ bá bɔ kwaa baa lɛa le nyaara be la, ba ɡbabirii dɛ́ berɛ kwaa baa lɛa la tɛ a tena.
Ba bonɔɔne saŋ bokpeɡa la, ba ne anee dɛ́ ka chɔ teera bini.
A do kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa aa ɛ kontora ba nyoa bini ken, asɛ ba kpɔ do ba kaŋa bini dɛɛ moɡra, ba ɡelɔ a do bela biɡri, a som la nomanta, a yon ka do ba kaŋa bini.
Kondikwa aa jo ba tea bini la, ɛɛ do kpelii kɛŋɔ tɛɡchɔɡa ken.
Nɛra kondɔɔh nyubinikpeɡ tena aa lɛa la, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba uɡe a bwa.
Kwaa nyubinikpeɡ tena aa lɛa la do kɛŋɔ tɛɡchɔɡa ken, aa kpoo baa kɛ harɛ aa kpɔ ba ken.
Baa kondikwaa ne sen Korowii aa sweera tɛɛ ba laanee dɔ kohona, a warɛ kɛŋɔ nee aa sua la.
Komɛlbwa baa ɛ toma dɔ la, baa bera tɛ, kwaa baa koah dɔ la, baa dɔ di, dɛkalkɛ ba fiiɡi nyaara dɛ vɛɛh ba, dɛ lɛ deene ba laa maa.
Ba siwi aa komɛlbwa su, kwaa baa lɛa cheɡ la, bɛlbwa aa won lɛɛ ba.
Ba lɛ nɛra kondɔɔh ba be a tonaa, anɔ la baa lea cheɡ ba be la ɡe ɛɛ le ba nɔn taa.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena la aa ba dɔ kwaa kohona la, a taa wenaale ɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala, nɛra baa di suna la waa ɛɛ ka dawɛ ba nɛɛ taeh.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ o bandia kohonaa ba ba nɛ, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne, saŋ ba ta aa lɔ kwaa la ta dɛɛ di la.
Ba chwao le dɔmkon baa kpɔ buni ɛo nyoa aa, hɛm o nyoa aa ɛ ayaawaa dɛɛ ba ba yaɡa dɛ́ kpoo ba.
Hɛma la ɛɛ yaɡ baa dɛ vah le, a nyoo aa dɛ nyɛɡle la yaɡɛ dɛ che ba pwɛ ta le.
Ɔmee kohona ɛɛ chole ba nɛɛ, komɛlbwa baa dɔa nyoɡre biro ta, nii nɛn aa wola an marɛ, ba fuh ba ne ba haahna ne bii bwa.
Nyundua ne harɛ, ɛɛ lee baa tɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa.
Ba kondɔɔh bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, awola Korowii baah aa di kohona, kɛŋɔ nee aa sua dɛ yon kpɔ komɛlbwa kaa la.
Waa Korowii aa lea cheɡ nyubinikpeɡ tena laanee la, ɡɛɛ baa ba nae.”
Job wobol Ate, Job chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe heya, hé cheɡ deŋne no waa maa dɛ ba bola nɔ, dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa, aa larawe n bwaraa.
Hé tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, ásɛ n bol n wa, ásɛ n tonɔ mɔɔ naa, hé mam mɛ.
Nɛn siee n kpɔ waa dɛɛ bil aa?
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ ń lawɛ bambile ɔ?
Hé nyiŋ mɛ asɛ he bwara yɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔɔra sawɛ nyoo.
N lii waa aa puu mɛ nɔ naa, dɛ ɔmee laɡ mɛ taeh, n bwara bwa ɛɛ sa.
Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɡel nyubinikpeɡ tena so biɡri, dɛ hwɛɛh dɛɛ dɔ ba te nɔɔ?
Ba dɛ dɔ bii ne naanar, dɛ́ so ba kpeɡ ba siwi ta.
Ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta ba deremi, baa wola ɔmɛ, Korowii aa ba deŋne tɛr.
Ba nabala dɛ jwee, ba naneene loɡle, aa harɛ dɛɛ ta.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena la ɡelɔ ba bii ɛɛ le, dɛ́ do bobɛlbwa dɛɛ hɛlɛ dɛɛ jah kɛŋɔ pebiiri ken.
Ba yiiɡi kwaa dɛɛ lɔ janjela ba bii ɛɛ sa, ba bii no kalipe sii ba sie lɛ kohona.
Gɛ nɛra la dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh ba soɡa bini bwa, dɛ yon sewɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ta, bá huɡ ba.
Ane a bwa, ba dɛ bol Korowii be ŋɔ, ‘Gel ya so ya soɡa jeiih ken!
Yaa he waa la nyin dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Umee Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ya tomɔ wɔ?
Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ yaa ba dɔe le Korowii soŋa ta nɔ?’ Ba wer doe toole ba ɡbaɡba be, anomanta, n ne ba toole wobɛlbwa bini.
Korowii ɡelɔ nyubinikpeɡ tena piɡri dɛɛ sewaa?
Wekpeɡa toolo dɛɛ ba ba nɛ aa?
Korowii baah diu o tɛr nɛnchɔɡe deŋne bwa naa?
Ba do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡhole peu kpɔa ba kaa la aa?
Kɛɛ haahra dompeu kpɔ ba kaa.
Akai!
He bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii kwaa mɛɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ cheɡ o bie.’ Korowii tɛr mɛɛ la ɡbaɡba deŋne o wechɔɡa la waa o na.
Gel wechɔɡ-ɛɛ la ɡbabir na o deŋnetɛra waa dɛ ba dɔe, dɛ́ nyɔ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la danana ne.
O waane laa bii waa ta ba habɔɔ wa, ɡɛ saŋ o tɔpera aa ba su dɛ ba a jaɡa la.
Nomɛl ɛɛ won baɡle Korowii wa aa?
Onee dɛɛ bol hale nomonjena wa.
Nomɛl dɛ́ sewɛ dɛ o bwara ta kpeɡri kohona, ɡɛ saŋ o bwara aa sɔɔhno o dɔ bosɔɔhna, o bwadabii dɛ́ do wer kɛrɛdɛ, o hoɡa bini ɡe do kpeɡri.
Nomɛl ɡe dɛ́ sewɛ sum ne, o ta som bɛlbwa nae bwa.
Ba bwa dɛ́ sewɛ baa huɡ ba, ásɛ kwaa di ba ola.
N jemɛ waa bwa aa lɔ hé liire bini, ne liichɔɡa haa liira dɛɛ tɛ mɛ bwa wa.
He dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa nɛnjena la nɛra, ba fa aa ɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena deremi, ba fa aa soɡe a bini la dɔɔ?’ He ta vavala la bɔɔrɛ kɛɛ?
He ta waa baa baa bol noɛ kɛɛ?
Korowii laa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra daa le, awola waa ba tɛr nɛra deŋne, wɛɛ ɡel ba tenee awola waa ba kembɔr ne la.
Umee dɛ́ won bol wechɔɡ-ɛɛra waa baa ɛa ba be nɔ?
Waa baa dɛ ɛ la, umee dɛ́ won bɔ ba ba we-ɛɛla kem ɔ?
Ba te la, ba dɛ la ka huɡ ba, nɛra dɛ daah ba ŋwama, nɛnlaa tenten dɛ teŋɛ ba nɛɛ kaa ba huɡribɔr, ásɛ teera tɔ ba nɛ, ba chɔ jeiih ken.
He te, waa aa wola mun dɔe he bol dɛɛ larawe n bwara, he wobol bwa ɛ nyosone.”
Elifas wobol toorotena Belaa Elifas, Teman te la ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ, “Nɛn waa ɛɛ won dɔ tɔnɔ dɛ tɛ Korowii aa?
Nɛn waa jemɛ waa kwaraa la, wɛɛ won ɛ waa á do wer o be naa?
Dɛ he waa toɡrɔ aa, Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ dɛ dɔ komɛl, kɛɛ he waa wer aa, a dɔ tɔnɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii ɔ?
Haa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii waa wɛɛ ba he pwaeh, dɛ́ bol he waa kɛɛ?
He wechɔɡa laa kana aa?
He wechɔɡa ta nyoa dɔe.
He lɛ he dɔŋ kon cheɡ awɔba pɛɛpɛɛ, he laa o yal wur, o che dakpaŋ.
He vɔmɛ nɛra nyoɡre aa dɛ kpo ba ne, dɛ vɔmɛ nɛra lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba kondikwa, a lole kɛŋɔ he dɔ kpeɡri dɛ dɔ harɛ, dɛ dɔ jirima dɛ so o ta.
He doŋi luhaahna ba kaa nɔŋɡbala ne, dɛ fiiɡi bilalbii ɡe.
A waa nafuɡere bare cheme, asɛ ɔmee den su he bwa la.
A waa a do kɛŋɔ bɔr biro ta he nɛɛ haa wola na, a do kɛ nee suu tɔ he nɛɛ la.
Nyundujaɡla laa Korowii do aa?
Dɛ ba sie ne harɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi weweela a ɡe aa lɔ nyundua aa?
Kɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwaa Korowii jemɔɔ?
Wɛɛ do biro nɔ taa dɛ́ bol nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole aa?
Baama aa kana tɔ o nɛ, dɛ ɡel waa yaa na.
O lɔ nyundujaɡla ne harɛ baah ta dɛɛ valɛ.’ Hɛɛ soo kɛŋɔ saŋ la tena aa?
Gɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra fa aa soɡa la aa?
Ba serewɔ mɔɔ ba saŋ tel, kɛŋɔ nee yon su ba bɔle deene ta la.
Ba ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, ‘Gel yaa!
Bɔkwaa hen Haa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ɛɛ ba wona ɛ yaa ɔ?’ Kɛ Onee tɛɛ ba kondɛɛɡa a su ba deene, anomanta, n laa n te kpɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra liire la ta.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra na ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ ba chɔɡa ba sie lɛ, nɛra wobɛlbwa aa wola toole ba nɛɛ dɛ mam ba ŋɔ, ‘Kpelaa, Korowii chɔɡ ya dɔma, asɛ nii fuh ba kondɔɔh bwa.’ Job, kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii, ásɛ he bwara sɔɔhne, he ɛ ɡɛ naa, wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ.
No waa waa dɛ doe a ta, dɛ́ kpɔa do he nyu bini.
Dɛ he berɔ ba Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la be naa, wɛɛ lɛɛ.
Dɛ he laa wechɔɡa kpɔ bela haa soɡa, dɛ pa he suuɡaswɛm ta bomboɡ ta, ne he suuɡaswɛm tenten ta bwea aa lɔ nenabɔɔne aa hweehra baah ta, ásɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la do kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm, ne suuɡapoŋ kohona tɛɛ.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel he sie lɛ o nɛɛ kohona, ásɛ he won dɛɛ tomɔ bambidɛɛɡe ne.
Hɛɛ wiu noo ásɛ o no he be, hɛɛ baɡɔɔ nyoa dɛ́ won teŋɛ a ta.
Waa haa dɛ lii ŋɔ hɛɛ ɛo ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ, he ŋwɛnɛre bwa chaah.
Dɛ nɛn lɔ harɛ naa, hé soŋe Korowii tɛo ŋɔ ó lawɔ ir, o dɛ lɛ banɔ la baa dɛ pwɛr ba te.
Nɛn wobɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛɛ kwaraa la, Korowii ɛɛ lɛo, wɛɛ che he tepoŋ haa dɔa la taa dɛ lɛo.”
Job chaŋe Elifas Belaa Job chaŋe Elifas ŋɔ, “Hale fini n waa ta kpeɡri dɛ ɡwaa n nɛɛ ja, n pɛma habɔɔ, Korowii ta dɛ tɛr n deŋne.
N dɛ nyin kɛ n fe aa na Korowii, dɛ́ na ɡɛ maa ɛ dɛ́ la bela waa soɡa!
N fe ɛɛ kpɔ n waa bil o sie, dɛ́ bol n waa aa cha mɛ bwa baɡlo.
N fe ɛɛ nao ɡɛ waa chaŋ mɛ, dɛ́ no waa waa bol baɡ mɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ che o kpeɡri waa dɔa kohona la taa n ne o tɔŋle waa naa?
Akai, waa waa kpɔ dawɛ n nɛ.
N waa toɡra nomanta, awola mɛɛ kpɔ n waa bil o sie, ó pa mɛ bole dɛ́ lee mɛ ta kwaraa.
Kɛ n la wee leebɔr aa, o toole bela, n berɔ la wee cholibɔr ɡe aa, maa on na.
O dɛ ɛ toma weekaŋle nyunduabɔr aa, maa on na.
O berɔ do weekaŋle harɛbɔr ɡe aa, n sie aa o nɛɛ dawɛ.
Kɛ o jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa dɛ kpɔ o ta, o daah mɛɛ na naa, mɛɛ do werii, kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm baa doo nii ta.
N dɛ teŋɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa dɛ kpɔ o ta kasinteŋ ta, n dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta, maa bɛlbwa ɡel.
N dɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare waa do mɛ ta, n kpoŋe o nyoa wobol bini, dɛ ɡwaa n wenyina.
Korowii te, ɡɛ waa doa o den do, nomɛlbwa aa won beɡre waa do o nyoa, anɔ la waa dɛ nyinii wɛɛ ɛ. Waa waa do mɛ a ta la, anee wɛɛ ba ɡela a ɛ, o ta dɔ a dɔŋa warɛ o be cheɡ mɛ.
A waa ɔmee chole n nɛɛ o sie nɔ, n lii a ɡɛ waa nɔ naa, n dɛ ɔmɔ.
Korowii ɡelɔ n bambile chɔɡ, Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la ɡelɔ n ɔmɛ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, biro la ta ɡelɛ n ɡel wii, a lole kɛŋɔ biro kohona la ta ɡelɛ mɛɛ na.”
Job berɔ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ aa wola tɔpere bɛl leɛ cheɡ, dɛ́ bol nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole ɔ?
Nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ la bɛ on na kɛ o dɛ bol wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la wa.
Nɛra dɛ huɡri bwea baa kpɔa bil harɛ jwɛhre ta, ásɛ ba kwaa do kan, ba ŋwɛ peera ba ja ba kwaa ta, dɛ́ kpɔa dɛɛ la dibɔra.
Ba dɛ ŋwɛ bilalbie keeɡo, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡa kemɛ luhaah, dɛ́ lɛ o nabal cheɡ awɔba.
Ba dɛ tɔ nyaara ŋwɛnɛ ba wenyina ta, dɛ́ doŋ ba bwa bá chwa ka sɔh.
Gɛ keeɡore yon do pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe kondikwaa la, ɡɛɛ nyaara la ɡe do, ɡɛ tentenee ba ɡaaɡe nyin kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛ ba bii.
Kooni aa wola ba kwaa ɛɛ taa baa kuuh kondikwa, dɛ́ ka kuuh daa nɔna nyubinikpeɡ tena kooni ta.
Ba ta yale dɔe, dɛɛ chɔ dakpaŋ, waa dɛ kpo ba jwaana, komɛlbwa toole ba kpɔ tɔ.
Bwaalajena nɛo dɛɛ kpo ba bwejena dor, baa wola bobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ jo la, ba yon ka pɛɡle bwea ba bwara wɔrɔbe.
Ba lɛ bilalbie o taa dɛ ɔr le o nya be, dɛ lɛ nyaa bie ka cheɡ awɔba.
Baa wola yale dɔe nomanta, pɛɛpɛɛ ɡɛɛ baa valɛ, dɛ́ che mea le kooni ta dɛ́ chɔ lɔr.
Nyaara la harame nyubinikpeɡ tena noo dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛ harame ba ɡrepo nɔna nee baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen, kɛ baa ɡel ba nyɔ ane.
Nɛra baa dɛ ba serewa dɛ pɛmɛ bwɛjen la ta, banɔ la baa do ba bola ɡe ɛɛ wi, dɛɛ nyin Korowii ó cha ba, kɛ Korowii laa sie kpɔ ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la nɛ.
Nɛra bane lole dɛ hah bochaah, baa jemɛ webaŋa valɛ.
Bɔr joɔ waa, dɛ nɛn waa dɛ kpoo nɛra iro, dɛ́ kaa kpoo nɛŋɡwɛɡra ne nyaara, jwaana dɛɛ bɛɛ kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ.
Nɛn waa lawɛ nɛra bane haahna dɛɛ chɔ la, dɛ́ kpa kɛŋɔ bɔr bir.
O dɛ lii kɛŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa aa men na,’ dɛ́ kpɔ sie sɔh.
Ŋwɛɛra ku deene ɡbeni dɛɛ jo a bini jwaana, kɛ webaŋa dɛ ba tɔ ba te do dea, baa bɔr chaahna nyin dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Bɔr biraa, o ber ba webaŋa, ɔmewaa aa lɔ biro ta la man ba.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena la do kɛŋɔ, doŋa aa jaah nee sie, Korowii taah harɛ baa dɔɔ, nomɛlbwa aa ba daa kooni taa la kaa ɛ toma.
Gɛ dombwea yon nyoɡre bɔwɔb kɛɛ hwel saŋ la, ɡɛɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡe nyoɡre dɛɛ kaa lalabwɛ.
Ba nyare baa lol ba ɡba soh ba wa, dudule di ba ola.
Ba dɛ soh nyubinikpeɡ tena la waa kwaraa, ba dɛ do kɛŋɔ daa waa kuuɡa ken.
Ba fiiɡi hambara ne haahna baa wola bii dɔe, ba ta luhaahna nɛɛ sune.
Kɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛ chɔɡ kpeɡnɛra, a lole kɛŋɔ ba soɡe le, kɛ ba jemɔ kɛ baa mkpaa dɔ.
Korowii ken ɛɛ ɡeloo ba bwara sɔɔh ba ba soɡa bini, kɛ dɛ o sie lɔ ba we-ɛɛla ta.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena la soɡa bini dɛ do wer tamaa bɛl, tamaa ken ɡe dɛ ba kaa harɛ, ba nyanyini tonɛ kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa baa kua dɛ boa a nyoa, dɛ berɛ do kɛŋɔ mea paa aa koma a ka a daa ɡbo la.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, umee dɛ won ŋɔ n teŋe nyosone, dɛ́ baɡle kɛ ɡɛ laa waa la doɔ?”
Bildad wobol toorotena Belaa Bildad, Su te la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowiirii dɔ kpeɡri komɛlbwa ta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa ɔmɔ, o ɡelɔ deŋnesɔɔhna do o be nyundua bela.
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ o laa tena nyoa ɔ?
Bobɛlbwa toole o bochaah la aa wola toole.
Ɛrɛɛ nɛn ɛɛ ba wona ŋɔ o waa toɡrɔ Korowii be nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba wona ŋɔ doŋa toole o nɛɔ?
Hale dɛ korobie aa chaah Korowii be, weweela aa were o be naa, bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini waa do kɛŋɔ dudul kɛɛ sɔɡlɔ do o be nɔ?”
Job wobol Belaa Job chaŋe Bildad ŋɔ, “Na ɡɛ haa cha nɛn waa wola bokpeɡa dɔe!
Berɛ na ɡɛ haa lɛ men maa ɡwɛɡraa nɔ!
Na jae haa ja nɛn waa wola wejema dɔe!
Na ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ waa mun noe kohona!
Umee chae he bol ɡɛ waa nɔɔ?
Umee tɛɛ liire he bol ɡɛ waa nɔɔ?
Lala bwara dɛ sa kɛrɛdɛ, banla baa lɔ neerare bini, ne kwaa aa soɡe a bini bwa.
Lalabwɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ Korowii siwi ta, komɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔ o ta waa wola on na.
Korowii paɡri weekaŋle nyunduabɔr bɔle, bela komɛlbwa aa wola toole, o ta ɡelɛ harɛ saɡɛ komɛlbwa ta o lawɔ kpoŋe.
Korowiirii vɔrɔwe bwaala nee do o baama bini, kɛ bwaala nee la tɔɡre ɡe aa won baama la pere.
O kpɔ kon tɔ korobie bwa, dɛ paɡri o baama tɔ o ta.
O pere bochaah le biro ta, o do kɛŋɔ jwɛh dɛ teŋɛ mpo ne nyundua baah.
Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ pilare aa lawɛ nyundua kpoŋe laanee yaa, aa yiiɡuu ɔmee lawa.
O cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛ ɡel mpo ɛɛ vuuɡi, dɛ che o wejema ta chɔɡ mpo bini oljen Rahab.
O nyoa peuwee ɡela nyundua chaah, o nɔn nee o kpo kontuuɡi damanta waa ɛ harɛkon, dɛ tuuɡa dɛɛ kaa la.
Waa waa ɛa la bini tamaa la, a bini wetama anee ya no.
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ kpela, ɡɛ Korowii kan ne o kpeɡri aa doa ɔ?”
Job ta teŋɔ dɛɛ bol o waa la dɛ ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii, waa lole saŋ bɛl bwa, Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ waa wola men kɛrɛdɛ ɛɛ, dɛ ɡel mɛɛ na wahala, n ta aa lɔ mkpa bini, Korowii ta ɡel mɛɛ hwee nɔ, maa nyoa pili bol wechɔɡe bɛlbwa, maa nyosonee teŋe.
Maa won ŋɔ he waa wer, maa sɛh ŋɔ n di bolchɔɡe ka tel kɛŋɔ maa sewa.
Mɛɛ che toɡra n wa aa toɡra taa kiŋkiŋ maa wola ɡel.
N liire aa men bolchɔɡee pa, saŋ bɛlbwa n ta aa soɡe le nɔ.
Korowii, ɡel n dɔma na ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ na, bá na ɡɛ nɛra ba wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe aa dɛ na.
Dɛ Korowii teŋe nɛra baa wola on tomɛ hweera ta naa, bɔkwa hwɛɡaa baa ba dɔe yɔ, dɛ o teŋe ba mkpa ta naa?
Korowii ɛɛ no ba wii ɡɛ saŋ wenaale aa ba ba nɛɛ yaa?
Ba sie ɛɛ dɛɛ lɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ nɛɛ yaa?
Baa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwaa yaa?
Mɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii kpeɡri aa doa, maa On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la ŋwɛnɛree kpɔ sɔh heya.
He bwa siwi na ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ he ta ɛɛ bol waa aa wola mun dɔe nɔɔ?
Waa Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ, aa dɛ ba ɡela a pu nyubinikpeɡ ne sikpeɡ tena laanee nɔ.
Ba bii ɛɛ warɔɔ, kɛ baa kpoo ba laa taa, ba naanar aa kondikwaa dɔ di vaɡɛ.
Weechɔɡaa dɛ́ kpoo ba bii ne ba naanar baa ba ka la, ba luhaahna aa ban wi.
A lole kɛ ba dɔ suuɡapoŋ kɛ nee ken, dɛ dɔ yale kohona, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra laanee dɛ́ tɔ yale la, ásɛ banɔ la wobɛlbwa aa wola toole ba nɛɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa la bɔne dɔŋa.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena deene baa maa do kɛŋɔ kon dudul yon sɔh tɔ o nɛɛ la, kɛɛ pata nɛn waa dɛ kpa koo aa doa.
Ba dɛ chɔ kɛ kondɔɔhna, kɛ baa ɡɛɛ ka, ba ne jara dɛ a bwa le ba nɔn ta.
Ɔmee dɛ́ piɡ ba kɛŋɔ nee aa sua, peukpeɡ ta dɛ́ ba kpɔ ba kaa jwaana.
Peu waa le wee leebɔr ta dɛ́ ba kpɔ ba kaa, dɛ́ le ba ne ba deremi ta kaa.
Wɛɛ ba taɡ baa ta, waa wola ba nɛɛ sune, ba chwa dɛɛ le o be.
Peu lɔ kpaŋa ta ba nɛɛ kɛ nɛn, ba wechɔɡa wa, o nyoa ɛɛ si dɛ taɡ ba le ba deremi.”
Job berɔ ŋɔ, “Bela baa dɛ kwi suuɡapoŋa lole, bela baa laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ta ɡe do le.
Harɛ binii ba kwi buni dɛɛ le, dɛ dɔ ayaawa dɛɛ le bwea ane ɡe ta.
Nɛra kpɔ kandere jo dɛɛ kaa harɛ bini biro ta, ba kwiu dɛɛ la bojaŋ, dɛɛ nyin bwea ɡɛ kwaa nɔ aa lɔ a ta biro ta bela.
Ba kwiu dɛɛ la bela nɛn aa wola soɡe bwa, bela nɛn aa wola valɛ dɛɛ la, bela nɛra aa wola toole bwaa baa ɛ toma, ŋwɛɛra taa ba saɡre ɡɛ saŋ dɛ jo kaa kwia.
Harɛ nɔ taa kondikwa le dɛɛ ba, kɛ o bini ɡe, ba kpɔ nii dɛɛ peɡri bwea la ɡɛ saŋ.
Bwedɛɛɡa ane a yoɡ aa kpeɡa lɔ bwea la ta, suuɡaswɛm do bwea la men ta.
Jumbii aa dɛ di ola bɛlbwa aa bela ŋwɛnɛ jemɛ, kɔla siwi ta bela nae bwa.
Kpɔɡ bini ola ta bela kpɔe bwa, nyujente ta bela laŋɛ bwa.
Nɛra kwiu dɛ paɡre bwekpeɡa, dɛ kwi bwejena a lɔɡre chɔ.
Ba forɛ bɔɔ bwea la bini, ba siwi ɛɛ na kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa la bwa.
Ba nyiŋi neerare nyuune ta, dɛ kpɔ kwaa aa sɔah la ɛɛ le baŋ.
Kɛ leperaa yaa ba wejema nae yɔ?
Leperaa waa mun noe ɡe doɔ?
Nɛwɛnyini aa ɡɛ wejema waa aa hiah jemɛ, haa won nao harɛ nɔ ta.
Haa won na wejema neerare vile ta.
Mpo ta ɡe, haa won dɔɔ bela.
Baa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten yawɔ, kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ ɡɛ suuɡapoŋ tɔɡre aa doa maɡɛ o yoɡ.
Haa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaa dɔɔ, haa won kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɔɔ.
Haa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kɛɛ diɡi maɡɔ, haa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaare charɔ.
Bwedɛɛɡa ane a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ta wejema tele, bwedɛɛɡa ane aa ɛ ampoŋa ne answɛɛma dɛɛ nyɛɡle ta on tele.
Ane ɡe a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, ne suuɡaswɛm baa yawa dɛɛ le bojaŋ harɛ ɡba, ta on tele.
Amɔ dɛ leperaa wejema leɔ?
Lee waa mun noe doɔ?
O sɔh nɛra ne ola bwa Korowii aa taa, hale jumbii aa dɛ ɡah ɡba.
Banɔ la baa lɔ lalabwɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Tamaa kenii ya no o wa.’ Korowii dɔ o ŋwɛnɛ wejema, o ɡboo jemɛ bela waa lole, dɛkalkɛ o dɛ na harɛ jaɡa bwa, dɛɛ na komɛlbwa waa lɔ o ta.
Korowiirii ɡela peu nyoa do kpeɡri, dɛ maɡɛ mpo bini ne, dɛ baɡle ɡɛ saŋ bwaala aa dɛɛ nɛ, dɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛ bwaala aa kɔr dɛɛ kpɔ o ta.
O na wejema kɛŋɔ o waa hiaoh, dɛ na kɛŋɔ o wer, dɛ daahno na.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ nɛwɛnyini be ŋɔ, ‘N ɔmaa dɛɛ ba ɡela hé dɔ wejema, he ki wechɔɡa ɡe aa, anee waa mun noe.’ ”
Job teŋɔ dɛ bol o waa la ŋɔ, “Gɛ n fe aa dɛ nyin kɛ n berɛ do kɛ ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa nyiŋi n nɛɛ, ɡɛ saŋ waa ɡela n ŋwɛnɛre chaah dɛ ɡel n won valɛ biro ta!
Gɛ saŋ n fa aa cheɡɛ n naa ta, dɛ kpɔ Korowii ɛ n dam tenten, o kpɔ nɔn tɔ n ne n dem tena nɛ.
Dɛ ɡɛ saŋ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la ja n nɛ, asɛ n bii bar mɛ cheme, ɡɛ saŋ n fa aa ɛ kondɔɔh dɛ n dɔ ɔleve noo taeh!
Dɛ n dɛ la bwɛjen la doonyojen la ta, dɛ́ ka so bela nomonome bwa aa dɛ so la, ásɛ bonɔɔna na mɛ dɛ́ kɛrɛ che, banjeni ir che dɛ́ kpɔ duure tɛ mɛ, nomonome ɡel wobol, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔɔra tɔ nyoo.
Hale nomonjena dɛ hel, baa wola waa bol.
Nomɛlbwa waa no n wobol dɛ́ bol n bwara wedɛɛɡe, banɔ la baa na mɛ kpɛɛ mɛ, lɛɛ maa dɛ lɛ nyaara baa wia dɛɛ nyin nɛra bá cha ba la wa, ne bilalbii baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó lɛɛ ba.
Nɛra baa cheɡɛ seo nyoa soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ, n ɡel luhaahna baah sɔɔh ba.
Toɡra n wa aa toɡra do kɛŋɔ maa tɔ yal, kasinteŋ bola ɡe do kɛŋɔ maa do batakaare dɛ kpɔ yal vɔwɛ nyu.
Menee fa dɛ tɔ nyoŋa sie, dɛɛ cha boobie.
N do kɛŋɔ mɛɛ dɛ tɛ nyaara, dɛɛ cha hɔɔhra ba wa aa lɔ kɔɔto.
N dɛ sɔɔh nyubinikpeɡ tena nyoa, dɛ́ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ di kpeɡri ba nɛɛ la ta.
N liiro kɛŋɔ ń dɔ mkpajaŋ, dɛ́ chɔ n dem sewɛ sɔnɔnɔɔ.
N do kɛŋɔ daa o lune aa kaa nee ta, asɛ mɛn ɛɛ ta o kpala ta jwaana.
N nyanyini aa tonɛ bwa, n bwara ɛɛ do kpeɡri saŋ bɛlbwa.
Nɛra dɛ kpa dɛ́ no n wa, ba dɛ hel jeiih ken, dɛ́ no n wejaala.
N bol waa tonaa, baa waa bol kpa, n waa dɛ jo ba nyuune bini.
Ba dɛ kpaa mɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra yon dɛɛ kpa bwaala la, kɛŋɔ paara aa dɛ kpa yoo saŋ bwaala ken.
N mamɛ ba be naa, a dɛ ɛɛ ba wepiɡra, dɛkalkɛ baa ɡɛ lii, n pur sie ba be naa, ba dɛ dɔ bokpeɡa.
N ɛ ba nyu te dɛɛ tɔ ba sie, n soɡe ba bini kɛŋɔ kooro ne o laa tena, dɛ do kɛ nɛn waa dɛ larawe nɛra ba loo aa kua bwara.”
Job teŋɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra maa ɡwaa ba nomonome kwaraa dɛ mam mɛ taraken!
Ba mɛɛnanar kwaraa n fe aa wola ban kpɔ, ba ne n nyootena daah n peera.
Wedɛɛɡa besoo mɛɛ ba dɔe le, a ɡɛ nɛra baa do ken dɛ ɡwɛɡre nɔ be nɔ?
Nyaa ne lɔr nomanta, ba lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin kondikwa jwaana.
Kpɔɡ la binii ba toɡri papooni a bini aa do nyɛɡre, ne dalune a ɛ ba kondikwa.
Ba doŋi a ɡɛ nɛra la le ba bala bini, dɛɛ moo ba kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛra ken.
Nenabɔɔne aa hweehra binii ba ka so, bwea baah ne bɔɔne bini bwa.
Ba lɔ kpɔɡ bini dɛɛ wi kɛŋɔ ola, dɛ pɛɡle dɔŋa kpɔɡa lɔɡre, ɡɛ aa ɛ ba bwara wɔrɔbe.
Ba ɛ nɛra ba wa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe, ba ta sɔna dɔe, ba doŋ ba le harɛ la ta.
Name, menee ba bibaala kpɔ ɡo yela dɛɛ mamɛ, menee ba kpɔ maɡɛ waa dɛ bol dɛɛ mamɛ.
Ba hah mɛ, baa men bɛne, baa waa haŋre, dɛ ta nentane dɛɛ ta n siebɔr.
Korowii aa ɡela n ɡwɛɡre, maa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa nomanta, ba na mɛ naa, ba dɛ ɛɛ mɛ wobɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.
Ba yon pɛ nyoa lɔ ba tɔ n nɛɛ dɛɛ yoo mɛ, dɛ doŋ mɛ n chwa dɛɛ kaa, dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo.
Ba tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ́ dɔ bɔr chɔɡ mɛ, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ kah ba.
Ba yoo mɛ kɛŋɔ laa tena aa ku danjwɛɛ dɛ jo ken, dɛ che bela aa peɡra la dɛ wur ba n be.
Ɔmee kohona chole n nɛ, n nyanyini kaa kɛŋɔ peu ken, n kondɔɔh ɡe bwa le n nɔn ta kaa kɛŋɔ bam ken.
N dɛ ba sewa, tɔpere bɛlbwaa mɛɛ na wahala.
N hoɡa bini dɛ chwee mɛ jwaana, n bwara bini wee aa men ɡel bwa.
Korowii hamɛ n baŋa, n batakaare jwereme marɛ n nɛ.
O taɡ mɛ ta kpechɛɡre ta, n do kɛŋɔ teera ne tɔɔ aa wola toole wobɛlbwa bini la.
N Naa Korowii, n wio dɛɛ yerɛ kɛ haa men chaŋe, n iro che, kɛ he sie pa n nɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
He nyu bini kpeɡri n nɛ, dɛɛ yoo mɛ he kpeɡri bwa ne.
He laɡ mɛ ir che, dɛ ɡel peu ta dɛ kpɔ mɛ dɛɛ kaa, he vuɡ mɛ dɛɛ ta peukpeɡ bini bobɛlbwa.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ seo binii hɛɛ kaa n ne, bela haa lea cheɡ nomɛlbwa la.
Kpelaa, nɛn waa lɔ wahala ta, dɛ wi dɛɛ nyin nɛn ó chao la, baa on lɔ.
N fa ta wie tɛ banɔ la baa lɔ wahala ta naa?
N loo fa ta kui tɛ nyaara aa?
Kɛ maa dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ wedɛɛɡa ta la, wechɔɡaa mɛɛ dɔ, maa dɛɛ nyin bochaah la, biroo mɛɛ na.
N bambile bini dɛ wure, waa ɡel bwa, tɔpere bɛlbwaa wenaale ɛɛ puu mɛ.
N lɔ tebinichɔɡ ta saŋ bɛlbwa, maa wɛre bwa, n iro dɛɛ che nɛra baah ta, dɛɛ soŋe kɛ ba cha mɛ.
N dɛ wi suna wii kɛŋɔ kalampoŋa kɛɛ taataa aa dɛ si la ken.
N bwadabii sie biro dɛɛ sɔle, n bwara bwa wɔrɔbɔ kɛŋɔ kabul aa laɡ mɛ ken.
N harame n janjela dɛɛ lɔ wii yela, dɛ hoh n kalipe dɛɛ taa wiile.”
Job berɔ ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ maa bitoloo nyiŋi n pɛla dɔɔ.
Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, bɔkwaa Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la kpɔ tɛ nɛn dɛ le nyundua ɔ?
Bɔkwaa Korowii le cheɡ tɛ nɛn ɔ?
O ta kon waa chɔɡ nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ yaa?
O ta wenaale ɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa?
Waa n we-ɛɛla jemaa?
Waa n naɡale bɛlbwa na naa?
Dɛ n teŋɛ wepuu ta, kɛɛ dɛ teŋɛ nyosone waa ta naa, amɔ Korowii nyiŋi n waa bini, wɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole n nɛ, dɛ n bɛɡɔ le o ŋwɛnɛ la ta, dɛ n siwi ɡelɔ n bambile lawɛ wechɔɡa kɛɛ dɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ kah doŋa aa, amɔ Korowii ɡel nɛra bane di kwaa maa para, dɛ́ ɡel ba fuɡri n koo kondikwa.
Dɛ n pɛla dɔ haah, kɛɛ dɛ n kaa pɛl n dɔŋ bɛl doonyoa aa, amɔ Korowii ɡel n haah ka ɛ kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛ baa bɛl, ásɛ dɛ kaa chɔ baala bane habɔɔ.
A fe ɛ sihihwa, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá bol a waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Aa doo kɛŋɔ nii dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa, dɛ́ kaa n ne seo ta, dɛ́ chɔɡ komɛlbwa maa dɔa.
Dɛ n ta kasinteŋ bolɛ n bonɔɔna ne toli be, ɡɛ saŋ waa aa lɔ n ne ba baah ta naa, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona ka che Korowii sie nɔ?
Bɔkwa waa mɛɛ ba dɔe dɛ́ bol o be n we-ɛɛla waɔ?
Korowii waa ta mɛ do n nya tea bini laa ta ba ɡe aa?
O tenten laa ta ya bwa do teene bini naa?
