Dɛ n vɛh nyaara pɛla kwaa kpɔe dɛ tɛɛ ba, kɛɛ dɛ ɡel luhaana hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ, n ɡbosoo kpɔ n kondikwa, n ta bilalbii ane tɛɛ, kɛ n bonɔɔne saŋ n nyiŋi nyaara nɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba mɛɛ, dɛ nyiŋi luhaahna nɛɛ le n bechale saŋ, dɛ n na nomɛl waa dɛ ba sewa yal bɛ dɔe wa, kɛɛ nyaa waa wola komɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ tɔ, o ta andɛɛɡa sweerɛ tɛ mɛ, kɛ maa wola n peera pona kpɔe sɔh yal tɛo, kɛɛ dɛ n aah bilalbie dɛ fiiɡu, jema maa jema kɛŋɔ mɛɛ di bole kɔɔto la waa yaa, Kórowii ɡel n nɔɔra kuuɡi, dɛ́ tor le n vam ta.
N ɔmɛ waa Korowii aa ɡel a ba n nɛ, n ɔmɛ o kan waa doa, n ta wone ɛ ɡɛ waa la.
Dɛ n fe kpɔ n hwɛɡa dawɛ suuɡaswɛm ta kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten be kɛŋɔ nɛn ŋɔ, ‘Henee n lɛɛ,’ dɛ n fe dɛ hɛɡre n kondɔɔh kohona wa, kɛɛ kwaa maa dɔa, n na ɡɛ wee aa dɛ lɔ dɛɛ chaah bɔr, kɛɛ korobie kaala ne o wer waa doa, a ta wone ɡel n liire berɛ kɛ n sɔh dɛ́ toma, n ta ɡuŋe dɛ kpɔ duure tɛa aa, a ɡe fe ɛ wechɔɡa Korowii be ó bol dɛ́ pa bole, n fe ɛ nɛn n wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe, Korowii waa lɔ nyundua be.
Dɛ n sie fe lɛ n dɔm wahala waa dɛ na, kɛɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ o waa waa dɛ na ta, n ta waa bolɛ dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ taahno o sewɛ, dɛ n dem nɛra fe ta bolɛ ŋɔ, ‘Umee wola Job nɔn ta ola dɔe chwe kohona kaɔ?’ Kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa ta fɔɡbaah chɔe jwaana, dɛkalkɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa mɛɛ lɛ hɔɔhra n dem, dɛ n tɔ n wechɔɡa ta ɡɛ bane aa dɛ ɛ, a do n bambile bini, kɛŋɔ maa bol waa nɛra aa bol la wa, asɛ n ɔmɛ mama n lolanar aa mam mɛ waa kohona, n tɔ nyoa n ta buse leɛ.
Dɛ n fe dɔ nɛn waa no n wa, n kpɔ n waa bil o sie, Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔree dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ, nɛn n ne waa dɔa la, ó chwerɛ waa la.
Mɛɛ kpɔa dawɛ n vam ta, dɛ́ kpɔ pi kɛ kooɡbɛrɛ.
Mɛɛ baɡle Korowii wobɛlbwa maa ɛa n baŋa pa ásɛ n ba o sie maa wola ɔmɛ.
Dɛ n harɛ la dɛ wi n tɛl kɛŋɔ nɛn, o pweeri ɛɛ wi siniire, dɛ n di harɛ la ta kondikwa n ta a kem bɔe, dɛ ɡel harɛ la tena bambile chɔɡ aa, ate Korowii ɡel mea a fe aa le la, jabalnadaŋɛre le chiɡ a naa ta, ane ɡe soo siwi aa le la, kpɔɡa le chiɡ a naa ta.” Job nyoa wobol la chiɡo.
Elihu wobol Gɛɛ a do Job daamanar batoro la ɡel o chaŋa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɛ lii kɛ o waa toɡrɔ o ɡbaɡba be.
Belaa Barakɛl bibaa Elihu, o nabaa sɔne Ram, ba bwa le Bus dea.
Elihu baah di Job nɛɛ kɛ waa ŋɔa ŋɔ o waa toɡrɔ ɡwaa Korowii la.
O baah di Job daamanar batoro la ɡe nɛ, kɛ baa wola wone ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ o waa ta maɡrɛ la.
Elihu lawɛ bambile tama mɔɔ dɛ bol waa Job be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ɡwaalo nomonome.
Waa naa kɛŋɔ nɛra batoro la ta waane dɔe dɛ́ bol Job be la, o baah diu.
Ate, Barakɛl bibaa Elihu ŋɔ, “Bechalaa men, heyaa nomonome, a waa mɛɛ ɔmɛ kɛ n pili nyoa dɛ́ baɡle waa maa jema he be.
N liiro kɛŋɔ, ‘Nomonomee chɛ kɛ ba bol wa, ásɛ nɛra baa biɡra ɡe ɛɛ baɡle nɛra wejema.’ Kɛ Korowii kpɔ o Doma dɛɛ do nɛn bini, On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔree hweera dɛɛ tɛo wejema.
Nɛra baa hwɛɛhra ɡbo laa dɔ wejema, nɛra baa biɡra ɡe ɡbo laa dɛɛ no waa mun.
Anomanta, n ŋɔ, he cheɡ deŋne no n be!
N ɡe ɛɛ baɡle heyaa anɔ la maa jema.
N tɔ nyoa he bol wa, dɛ no waa haa baɡla, dɛ he dɛ nyin waa dɛ bol, n cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ dɛ no he be.
Kɛ he bini bɛlbwa ta wone ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ o waa ta maɡrɛ, bɛlbwa ta wone chaŋe waa waa bola.
He bɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ya na wejema, Korowiirii dɛ ŋɔ o wa aa were, nɛn te laa.’ N laa Job bol waa yaɡɛ, maa he nyoa wobol taa che dɛ́ chaŋo.
Job daamanar batoro la bwara yɔrɔ, ba ta waane dɔe dɛ́ bol, baa jemɛ waa baa bol.
Baa hela nɔ, n kpa tama aa?
Baa cheɡa baa wola wobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ bol nɔ.
N ɡee bol waa, mɛɛ bol anɔ la maa jemaa.
Wobol su n nyoa, maa won ɡel a ka n tea bini.
Waa su n bini kɛŋɔ loŋ baa do sen o bini dɛ tɔ o nyoa, mɛɛ peroo kɛŋɔ loŋfale, baa do senfala o bini wɛɛ ba pera.
A chɛ kɛ n bol wa ásɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ, a chɛ kɛ n pili nyoa dɛ́ chaŋe.
Maa bɛlbwa siebɔree nyiŋi ɡwaa bɛl, maa waa bol dɛɛ fɛrɛ, dɛ n bol waa dɛɛ fɛrɛ aa, Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ mɛɛ.”
Elihu berɔ ŋɔ, “Job, taraken dɛɛ no n be, cheɡ deŋne no wobɛlbwa maa dɛ ba bola.
N dɛ nyin n bol wa, wobol lɔ n nyoa.
Tepoŋ nee mɛɛ ba waa bola, kasinteŋii mɛɛ ba bola.
Korowii Doma taa o che ta mɛ, On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔree hweera do n bini n dɔ mkpa.
Hɛɛ wonoo waa, chaŋ mɛ, kpɔ he te dɛ́ ba n sie.
N deno do kɛ hen Korowii sie, teeraa ba kpɔ ma n ɡe.
A ta chɛ kɛ he ɔm mɛ, kɛɛ mɛɛ fiiɡii.
N no waa haa bola la n deŋna bini, n no waa hen Job aa bola ŋɔ, ‘N waa toɡrɔ, wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole n nɛ, n do kaih, wobɛlbwa toole n nɛ.
Kɛ Korowii na wechɔɡa n nɛ, o kpɔ mɛ ɛ o dɔm.
O do kpɛɛ n nakpale, dɛɛ nyiŋi n vala bini bwa.’ Job, he waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe anɔ ta, Korowii ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini.
Ɛrɛɛ he bol he waa dɛɛ baɡle Korowii waa wola hen chaŋe nɔɔ?
Korowii dɛ bol waa fini, kere dɛ bol anfala, kɛ nɛn aa liire a ta do.
Deera ne wepila ta jwaana, ɡɛ saŋ nɛn aa chɔ dom kwaraa o kalaŋ ta la, a taa Korowii bol waa dɛɛ do ba deŋna ta, dɛɛ kah ba ɔmee kohona ɛɛ laɡ ba, dɛ́ berɛ ba liire le wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, dɛ́ le ba ne mbarafo ta, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le seo nyoa, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba ba bɛ ban kpoo.
Korowii dɛ́ tɛr nɛra deŋne weela ne, ba hoɡa bini bwa ɛɛ wee ba kohona, ásɛ kondikwa aa ba som do, ba pɛla yon le kondikondɛɛɡa ta.
Ba ɡwaŋɛ, haa won jem ba kpa, dɛ́ ka hoɡa ɡbo.
A ka tama ba sewɛ ba huɡ ba, dɛ́ sewɛ kaa lalabwɛ.
Kɛ dɛ nyundua torome balɔ dɛ́ ba cha ba aa, bɛl le kaɡboŋa bini ba dɛ́ ba che tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ baɡle waa aa wera tɛ nɛwɛnyini, dɛ ba na ba sum, dɛ́ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, ‘Lɛɛ ba le seo nyoa n dɔ kon dɛ́ kpɔ charɛ ba nyu,’ ásɛ nɛra ba fa aa ka hoɡa la, bwadabii berɛ do wer kɛŋɔ bechale ken, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ ba bonɔɔne saŋ.
Gɛ nɛra la soŋe Korowii aa, o dɛ na ba sum, ba dɛ tomɛ Korowii silɛɛ ne, Korowii dɛ lɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ ba waa toɡrɔ o be.
Asɛ bɛlbwa ba che nɛra baah ta dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ le waa aa toɡra ta, Korowii ta ɡelɛ n dɔ deŋnetɛra aa chɛ mɛ.
O lɛɛ mɛ le seo nyoa, n ta so le dɛɛ na som nɔ.’ Korowii ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn kera anɛ, hale kera atoro, dɛ́ lawɔ le seo ta, ó bɛ sewɛ, dɛ́ so mkpa ta silɛɛ ne.
Job, cheɡ deŋne, ásɛ dɛ no n be, hel, ásɛ n bol wa.
Dɛ he dɔ waane dɛ́ bol aa, he chaŋ mɛ, bol wa n jemɛ kɛŋɔ he waa toɡrɔ.
Kɛ dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, no n be, hel, mɛɛ chaɡle wejemaa.”
Elihu wobol nɛɛtena Elihu berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra haa ɛ wejerema, hé no n waa nɔ, hé no, nɛra haa jemɛ wa.
Deŋnee dɛɛ no wa, asɛ nyondoŋe ɛɛ daɡɛ kondikwa.
Hé ɡel ya kpɔ waa aa toɡra dawɛ ya nɛ, hé ɡel ya pɛ hweli waa aa wera.
Job te ŋɔ, ‘N ta bolchɔɡe dii, kɛ Korowiirii vɔm mɛ bole pae.
A lole kɛ n waa toɡrɔ, kɛ ba dɛ lii mɛ nyosonteŋni, a lole kɛ n ta bolchɔɡe dii, Korowii do mɛ bol, asɛ mɛɛ ba sewa.’ Nɛn besoo Job, waa wola duure kpɔe tɛ Korowii nɔɔ?
O ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa pɛa, o ne nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ valɛ.
Kɛ Job te bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Tɔnɔ bɛlbwa toole dɛ tɛ nɛn kɛŋɔ o ne Korowii pɛ.’ Anomanta, hé no men Elihu be, he nɛra haa dɛ no waa mun.
Nomɛlbwa jemɔ kɛ Korowii aa wechɔɡa ɛ, On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la aa won ɛ wechɔɡa.
O dɛ bɔ nɛwɛnyini waa waa ɛa kem, dɛɛ ba waa ne o nɛɛ ɡɛ o we-ɛɛla aa doa.
Kpelaa, haa lii kɛ Korowii ɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡaa, On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la aa bole pa aa ɡole.
Umee kpɔ harɛ nɔ do o nɔn ta nɔ?
Umee ŋɔa wɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ nɔ bwa ta nɔ?
Dɛ Korowii fe saahnɔ ŋɔ, wɛɛ laa o hweeraa kpɔ nɛn bini naa, nɛwɛnyina bwa fe ɛɛ pɛo serewe, dɛ́ bwa berɛ kaa teera bini.
Job, he dɛ no waa mun aa, no waa nɔ, cheɡ deŋne no waa maa dɛ bol.
Nɛn waa hah kasinteŋ la ɛɛ won nyiŋi nɛra nɛ aa?
Hɛɛ won pwah Korowii waa kana o waa toɡre la aa?
O laa dɛɛ bol koranar be ŋɔ, ‘He waa ɛ wesale,’ dɛɛ bol nomonjena ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘He nyu bini kpeɡri’ la aa?
Waa koranar siebɔr nyiŋi, waa suuɡa tena kpɔe dɛɛ ɡwaa nyaara, dɛkalkɛ, onee ta ba bwa.
Gɛ nɛmbele banɛ la bwa piɡro dɛɛ sewɛ harambaŋa, Korowii lɔ ba dɛɛ bil baa serewe, o dɛ le nomonjena la ne sɛmɛlɛŋ ken.
O sie lɔ nɛra we-ɛɛla ta, dɛɛ na ba naɡale bɛlbwa.
Bɔr bira toole, biro toole bobɛlbwa, dɛ́ tɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛ ba kpɔ ba te sɔh Korowii.
A ta hiaih kɛ Korowii nyiŋi nɛra waa bini la sie, mɔɔ ba ba o be o bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Waa nomonjena waa bini nyiŋi mɔɔ dɛɛ ir ba, dɛ kpɔ bane dɛɛ chiɡ ba naa ta.
Waa dɛ nyiŋi ba we-ɛɛla bini nomanta, o dɛ le ba ne jwaana dɛɛ lɛ ba nomonome ba be.
O dɛ tɛr ba deŋne ba wechɔɡa wa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa na ba, dɛkalkɛ ba laa ba te kpɔ, dɛ vɛh o nɛɛ teŋa, baa sie aa o Mmarare la ta do.
Ba ɡelɔ nyaara wi dɛɛ no Korowii, asɛ wɛɛ no yera baa dɛ yerɔ ŋɔ ó cha ba.
Kɛ dɛ Korowii helɔ aa, umee dɛ won pwaoh wɔ?
O kpɔ sie sɔh aa, umee dɛ nao wɔ?
Kɛ o dɛ nyiŋi nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa kɛrɛdɛ, Korowii ta ɡelɛ nɛn waa wola on tomɛ ɛɛ di kora, dɛ́ haɡre nɛra la bela.
Dɛ nɛn ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, ‘N ɛ wechɔɡa, maa ɡɛɛ ɛ kpa.
Chaɡ mɛ waa maa wola an nae, dɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa aa, maa an ɛ kpa.’ Job, a chɛ kɛ Korowii tɛɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin kembɔr, haa vɛh he liire chara nɔ naa?
Henee chɛ kɛŋɔ he lii, n laa, bol anɔ la haa jema baɡ mɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ no waa mun dɛ sɛh ɡɛ, wejerema baa dɛ no n be la dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Job dɛ bol waa aa, wejema toole a ta, o wobol ta mun dɔe.’ Dɛ he nyiŋi Job waa bini ka tonaa, hɛɛ nao kɛ o dɛ bol waa kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ.
O kpɔ deŋnekpeɡ dɛɛ ja wechɔɡa ta, ya bini kwaraa la, o mamɔ dɛɛ lɔ kpaŋa, dɛ teŋɛ bol waa kohona dɛɛ yaɡɛ Korowii.”
Elihu wobol toorotena Elihu berɔ ŋɔ, “Job, he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ waa nɔ toɡraa?
He ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ n bolchɔɡe dii ɛɛ ba wona ɛɛ nɔ?’ Kɛ he berɔ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, ‘Tɔnɔ besoo aa ba dɔe tɛ mɛ, bɔkwaa mɛɛ ba dɔe wechɔɡa maa wola ɛ ta nɔ?’ N dɛ nyin kɛ n chaŋe, he ne he daamanar baa ja he nɛ.
Hé nyiŋi nyundua na, hé ha sie nyiŋi jeiih ɡɛ baama aa kaa nyundua.
Dɛ he ɛ wechɔɡa aa, a dɛ ɛ Korowii waane aa?
He wechɔɡa wara aa, bɔkwaa aa ɛo wɔ?
Dɛ he waa toɡrɔ aa, bɔkwaa aa tɛo wɔ?
Korowii aa komɛlbwa lɛ he be.
He wechɔɡa ɡelɔ nɛra bane ɛɛ na wa, he waa toɡraa, nɛra banee a dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ.
Ba dɛ fiiɡi nɛra kohona a ɡwaa ba nɛɛ aa, ba dɛ pɛmɛ, ba dɛ wi dɛɛ soŋe nɛn ó lɛɛ ba le kpeɡnɛn la nɔn ta.
Kɛ bɛlbwa aa bol ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa Korowii waa ta mɛ la dɔɔ?
Onee dɛɛ larawe nɛn bwara o wenaale ta jwaana.
Onee dɛɛ baɡle yaa waa dɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ waa dɛ baɡle kpɔɡ bini ola, dɛ ɡel ya dɔ wejema ɡwaa jumbii.’ Ba dɛ wi aa, Korowii aa ban chaŋe, mbarafo wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ ɛ nomanta.
Kasinteŋ, Korowii aa soŋa baa dɛ soŋo ba wesale ta no, On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la aa deŋne cheɡɛɛ dɛɛ no ba be.
Job, dɛ ɡɛɛ yaa, ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba he be noe, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ haa ŋɔa ŋɔ haa on na nɔɔ?
He waa chɔ o sie, a chɛ kɛ he lawɛ bambile dɛɛ kpao.
Anɔ la aa jaa, he ŋɔ waa nɛra deŋne tɛr o bandia ne, waa sie do kohona wechɔɡ-ɛɛra be.
Job, he dɛ bol waa pɛɛpɛɛ, haa wola wejema dɔe nomanta, he wobol warɔ.”
Elihu wobol naarɛtena Elihu berɔ ŋɔ, “Job, lawɛ bambile tɛ mɛ tama, n ta dɔ waa dɛ́ che Korowii naa ta dɛ́ bol.
Mɛɛ baɡle kɛ n dɔ wejema kohona, dɛ́ baɡle kɛ Korowii waa ta mɛ la waa wer.
Nɛn waa dɔ wejema kohonaa cheɡɛ he sie la, jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ maa nyosone teŋe.
Na ɡɛ Korowii aa kana kohona, waa nomɛlbwa vɛh, o kan dɛ jemɛ wobɛlbwa bini.
O ta ɡelɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena so dɛɛ biɡri, o bol nyaara waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Waa sie laa dɛɛ kpɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛ, o ɡelɔ baa do kɛ koranar, dɛɛ dɔ duure saŋ bɛlbwa.
Dɛ ba lawɛ nɛra do dea, dɛ do ba jɔɡrɔre baa na waa baa ɛa aa, Korowii dɛ́ baɡle ba bá wechɔɡa ne ba mbarafo we-ɛɛla.
Korowii dɛ kah ba bá sɛh ba chɔɡre, dɛ́ do ba bá charɛ liire le ba wechɔɡa ta.
Dɛ ba no Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ wa aa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛ tɔpera aa ka ba sie taa, ásɛ dɛ so bosɔɔhna ta.
Kɛ dɛ baa no aa, baa kpoo ba keri nee, dɛ ba ta wejema dɔe.
Nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la dɔ bandia ba bini, dɛ Korowii tɛr ba deŋne kwaraa naa, baa on soŋe ŋɔ ó cha ba.
Ba dɛ serewe ba bonɔɔne saŋ, ba we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ baa dɔ sihihseo seo.
Kɛ banɔ la baa lɔ wenaale ta la, Korowii lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le, o cheɡɛ ba wenaale ta, dɛ bol waa dɛɛ baɡ ba.
Korowii siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ó lawɛ dɛɛ le he wenaale ta, dɛ́ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna, dɛ́ ɡel he dɔ kondikondɛɛɡa kohona dɛɛ di.
Kɛ taraken he dɔ deŋnetɛra ɡɛ aa chɛa kɛ ba kpɔ tɛɛ.
Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ kondɔɔh kpɔ neɡre, bɛ ɡel sen yawa ɡole he wa.
He kondɔɔh kɛɛ he kpeɡri haa dɔa bwa, aa won chae.
Bɛ too ŋɔ seo ba kpɔe warane, ɡɛ saŋ harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa aa serewe.
Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ he te kpɔ jo wechɔɡa ta, a waa Korowii kpɔ wahala ba ta he nɛ.
Korowii kpeɡri kan dɛ ɡwaa wobɛlbwa.
Umee dɛ won baɡle waa kɛ Korowii ɔ?
Umee dɛ won baɡle Korowii wa, kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ o ɛ wechɔɡa ɔ?
Lii dɛ kpɛɛro kohona o we-ɛɛla wa, ɡɛ nɛra aa ɡo yela kpɛɛro a waa la.
Nɛwɛnyina bwa na waa waa ɛa, nɛra che bojaŋ dɛ nyiŋa jeiih ken.
Na ɡɛ Korowii aa kana!
O kan waa doa ɡwaa nɛn liire ta, nomɛlbwa aa saŋ waa lea do le, ba le fini jemɛ.
Onee tɛr nee le harɛ kaa nyundua, dɛ ɡel a berɛ bwaala, dɛ palɛ dɛɛ jo nenabɔɔne ta.
Bwaala le baama ta, dɛɛ nɛ kohona nɛwɛnyina bwa nɛ.
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa kpɔ baama bɔle nyundua, o wobol le bwaala kɔra bini bela waa lole nɔ?
Na ɡɛ waa ɡela bwaala ɛɛ nyɛɡle nyundua bwa, asɛ dɛ ɡel mpo vile bwa te bir.
Ken taa o che dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kondikwaa kohona.
Bwaala kɔra kpeɡri lɔ o nɔn ta, dɛ́ won ɡel o ka chiɡ bela bwa waa dɛ nyin.
Bwaala kɔra dɛ tɔ sie ásɛ dompeu teŋɛ, ásɛ nae bwa jemɛ o bala wa.”
Elihu wobol nuetena Elihu berɔ ŋɔ, “N bambile dɛ lɔ bwaala kɔra la wa, o dɛ lɔ warawara ken.
Hé bwa no Korowii taa waa do kɛ bwaala aa dɛ kɔr, kɔɡra aa dɛ le o nyoa.
O ɡelɔ bwaala ɛɛ nyɛɡle nyundua bobɛlbwa, o nyɛɡla dɛ tel harɛ jaɡa bwa.
A habɔɔ, ba no o nyɛɡa waa do kɛ bwaala aa nyɛɡla la, o nyɛɡa la kan kɛ bwaala aa kɔra.
O baa nyɛɡ kohona naa, dɛ komɛlbwa chɔ baŋ.
Korowii bol wa aa, ba dɛ na o nyokpowa, a ɛ wejena nɛn aa wola a mun no.
O ŋɔ dombwea lee harɛ ta, dɛ ŋɔ bwaalajena nɛ harɛ ta.
O ɡelɔ nomɛlbwa toma ba a jaɡa, asɛ nɛwɛnyina waa ta ba bwa jemɛ o toma wa.
Kpɔɡ bini ola kaalɔ, ka chɔ a bɔɔne bini.
Peujen tao le weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ waa kohona le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Korowii hweero asɛ neerare sɔɔh, a sɔɔhnɔ kohona dɛ hel.
Korowii kpɔ nee do baama bini, dɛ ɡel bwaala nyɛɡle do a bini bwa.
Bela waa dɛ nyinii o ɡel baama baa kaa harɛ nɔ ta bwa, dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ bwa waa dɛ nyin.
O won baama kpɔe ba tɛr nɛra deŋne, kɛɛ dɛ́ ba sɔɔh harɛ, dɛ́ baɡle o nyina.
Job, dɛɛ no waa nɔ, tɔ nyoa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii nyokpowaa waa ɛ.
He jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa Korowii ɡel bwaala nyɛɡle dɛɛ le baama bini naa?
He jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa baama saɡɛ nyundua, ne ɡɛ Korowii nyokpowe-ɛɛla aa doa aa?
Bɔwɔb dɛ kpoe he yal bini, ɡɛ saŋ peuchɔɡe waa le weekaŋle harɛbɔr, aa ba ta harɛ la ta dɛ́ chɔɡo la.
Hɛɛ won ja Korowii nɛɛ dɛ́ paɡri nyundua, waa do kpeɡri kɛ ayaawa aa dɛ nyɛɡle kɛ diɡi aa?
Baɡle yaa waa yaa bol Korowii be dɛ́ chaŋo, ya liire damɔ nomanta, ya ta wobɛlbwa dɔe.
Nomɛl ɛɛ won ka bol o be ŋɔ n dɛ nyin ń bol wa aa?
A chɛ kɛ n tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó chɔɡ mɛ naa?
Peu tao dɛ laa baama kpɔ nyundua aa, wee dɛ chaah kohona, nomɛlbwa aa won nyiŋi nyundua.
Korowii jirima le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba kɛ suuɡaswɛm, ya na o jirima waa kana la dɛɛ ɔmɛ.
Korowii Waa ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ kan, yaa won bɛno, o waa toɡrɔ dɛ do wer, waa nɛn fiiɡi.
Nɛra dɛ duuru a wa, nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛ ba jemɛ wa, kɛ dɛ ɡɛn la, waa ban nyin.”
Korowii chaŋe Job Korowii chaŋe Job le peujen la bini ŋɔ, “Umee hen hɛɛ tɔŋle n waa wobol aa wola mun dɔe ne nɔɔ?
Ir dɛ́ ba che n sie, ń bɔɔre wa, ásɛ he chaŋ mɛ.
Maa ta harɛ dɛ ɡel o ba che o chebɔr, dɛ leperaa he doɔ?
He jemaa, he baɡ mɛ.
Umee maɡɛ o paɡri ne o jaŋne ɔ?
Umee tɛr ŋwɛn dɛ maɡɔ wɔ?
He jemaa?
Bɔkwa kwaa taa harɛ chɔŋɛ a lawɔ kpoŋe, kɛɛ umee pa o mun ɔ?
Awola chɔmbibii la weweela ɡo yela kɛŋɔ nɛra ken, nyundua toroma ɡe sie lɛ dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre.
Men Korowiirii ɡela mpo nyoa boa chɔ bobeŋkpoŋ, ɡɛ saŋ maa ɡela nee le o vile ta, kɛ baa lolɛ bie, dɛ kpɔ baama tɔ o ta, dɛ kpɔ biro tenten fɔrɔwo, dɛ pe bela waa baa jaɡɛ, dɛ kpɔ kwaa tɔ o nyoa kɛŋɔ ɡbera, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Bonɔɔ hɛɛ ba wona ba jaɡɛ, haa ɡarɛ!
He nehɛma aa kpeɡa la nyoa ɡe jaɡɛ bonɔ.’ Job, le saŋ baa lolɛ, he wono ɡel jwaana berɛ webaŋa aa?
He wono ɡel bɔr chaah harɛ bwa ta, asɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra na dɛ chwa le ba sɔɔhbɔra kaa la aa?
Bɔr chaahnaa, a ɡelɔ baa na deŋɡarere ne nenabɔjena, a do kɛŋɔ baa kpɛrɛwe yal, kɛɛ baa di ɡwine vii ta ken.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa bɔchaah ta nyin, aa ɡelɛ ba dɔ bɔr dɛɛ di ba dichɔɡa.
Job, he wono valɛ mpo vile bini ka aa?
He wono valɛ mpo bɔluŋ tenten bini naa?
Nomɛl baɡle bela baa kpɔa dɛɛ jo lalabwɛɛ waa ɛ biro la ta kaa?
He jemɛ ɡɛ harɛ nɔ aa kana aa?
He jemɛ anɔ bwa naa, he chaŋ mɛ.
He jemɛ bela bɔr chaahna aa lea ba naa?
Leperaa biro doɔ?
Hɛɛ won kpɔa kaa bela aa lea aa?
He wono jemɛ bela a fa aa lole naa?
He jemɔ, dɛkalkɛ baa lolɛ biɡro!
Gɛ saŋ maa ta harɛ nɔ la dɛ he lole.
He jemɛ bela maa ɡela mɛn ne dombwea do aa?
N lea cheɡ tɛ wenaale ne laa yoi tɔpera.
Hɛɛ won jemɛ bela bɔr chaahna aa lea dɛɛ ba, kɛɛ bela wee leebɔr peu aa taa le dɛɛ kaa la aa?
Umee baɡle bwaala luɡri o che a ta dɛɛ ba, ne bwaala kɔra ŋwɛnɛre ɔ?
Umee ɡela bwaala ɛɛ nɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, harɛ nomɛlbwa aa wola o ta soɡe, dɛ ɡel o do wer, kpɔɡa won le o ta nɔ?
Bwaala do kɛ nɛn dɛ dɔ mɛɛ aa?
Nomɛlee lolɛ mɛn aa dɛ le ɡe aa?
Umee lolɛ dombwea ɔ?
Umee lolɛ mɛn aa le nyundua ɡeɔ?
Gɛ kwaa nɔ yon sɔɔh dɛ hel, dɛ tɔ neerare ne mpo sie.
Hɛɛ won ta weweela aa wera bwa soo siwi pɛ, kɛɛ dɛ pere ane bini, bɛlbwa ka che a che bɔr aa?
Hɛɛ won baɡle saŋ weweela bɛlbwa aa le, kɛɛ dɛ ɡel Baŋɡaahna le dɛ tɔ o bii nɛ aa?
He jemɛ Mmarare aa dɛ baɡle weweela aa lɔ nyundua dɛɛ chaah wa aa?
Hɛɛ won jemɛ ɡɛ tenten tɛ kwaa aa lɔ harɛ ta ɡe aa?
Hɛɛ won do baama ŋɔ á kpɔ nee ba bɔle he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nee yon su la aa?
Hɛɛ won do bwaala ó nyɛɡle dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔɔree hen naa?’ Umee kpɔ wejema do nɛn liire bini, kɛɛ nɛn ɛɛ no waa mun ɔ?
Umee dɔ wejema kohona dɛ́ won kure baama ɔ?
Umee ɡela aa nɛ bwaala ɔ?
Umee ɡela bwaala yon nɛ kohona, ásɛ harɛ bwa lamɛ nɔɔ?
Hɛɛ won tɛ nyujentena kondikwa, ásɛ a bii lɔr aa dɛ kpoa won vaɡɛ, ɡɛ saŋ aa sɔh a bɔɔne bini, kɛɛ dɛ chɔ dɛɛ kpa, dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ́ lawɛ di la aa?
Umee tɛ ɡaahɡaah bii kondikwa aa di dɛ a wio dɛɛ no Korowii, dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin kondikwa dɛ diɔ?”
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “He jemɛ saŋ bwea dor boohna aa dɛ lolɛ a bii aa?
He siwi nao kweɡla lolɛ o bie ka aa?
Hɛɛ won kure korobie aa kpoŋe a teene aa?
Hɛɛ won jemɛ saŋ aa dɛ loɡle aa?
He jemɛ saŋ loltea aa lɔa aa loɡle a bii aa?
Kpɔɡ binii a bii yon do dɛ́ kpeɡ, a bwara do kpeɡri dɛ kaa, aa berɛ ba a be kpa.
Keeɡo waa kpaŋa la, umee ɡela o dɔ o te nɔ?
Umee pur ŋwɛɛra baa kpɔa vɔrɔwo wɔ?
Pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa n kpɔ tɛo o so, bela kpɔɡa aa wola won kpeɡ.
Waa ɡbɔɡa aa dɛ le bwɛjena ta nyin, nomɛlbwa aa won dɛɛro dɛ́ kpɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma.
Bwea doree o do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, dɛɛ nyin kpɔɡlwɛɛ bɛlbwa waa lea dɛ́ chwe.
Kpɔɡ bini nao ɛɛ sɛoh ɛ toma tɛɛ naa?
Wɛɛ sɛoh chɔ he kondɛɛra kondikondibɔr jwaana aa?
Hɛɛ won lawɛ o par ŋwɛn kpoŋe ó ɛ toma aa?
Wɛɛ won parɛ he harɛ tɛɛ naa?
O bokpeɡa kohona nomanta, hɛɛ kpɔ he tenee dawɛ o nɛ aa?
Hɛɛ ɡel he tomkpeɡaa ta o nɛ aa?
He dɛ yarada kɛ o kpɔ he mea ba, dɛ ba boa a nyoa a lɔ bɔr aa?
Taataa dɛ lɔ a kena silɛɛ ne, kɛ a ta do kɛŋɔ chaŋɡal kwa, harɛɛ taataa yon hwe hala bil, dɛ́ ɡela a chɔ bomboɡ ta wɔrɔbe.
Waa jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ken ɛɛ won paɡre, kɛɛ kpɔɡ bini ol bɛl ɛɛ won ba tiɡri a ta.
O nyu bini kpeɡri o bii nɛ, á do kɛ o bii laa ken, o waane laa kɛŋɔ o koeh waa koah la ɛ pɛɛ.
Men Korowii ta ɡelɛ o jemɛ wa, kɛɛ dɛ tɛo waa mun noe bɛlbwa.
Kɛ dɛ o paɡri kena dɛɛ ba chwae yaa, o dɛ mamɛ jaaɡɔ waa won chwae kohona ne nɛn waa soɡe o ta.
Job, henee ɡela jaaɡɔ bwara do kpeɡri dɛ tɛo pona a bɔle o baŋa ta naa?
He ɡelɔ o won jaeh kɛŋɔ hɔɔhre dɛɛ aah nɛra hweera kohona ne naa?
O nafikoko kwii harɛ dɛɛ ta, bokpeɡa nee wɛɛ chwa silɛɛ ne kaa jo laa ta.
Waa ɔmee kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa, waa tokobii na dɛ́ le habɔɔ.
Dɔmkwaa nɛn waa soɡe o ta aa kpoŋa la dɛ si, dɛɛ nyɛɡle pelɔpelɔ ken.
Jaaɡɔ la kpɔ sibeɡra chwa dɛɛ kaa, o no bɛla sii yaa, waa won bobeŋkpoŋ che.
Ba hoh bɛla aa, dɛ o sio.
O won laa ɡbɔɡa noe dɛ le bojaŋ, laa nomonome nyɛɡa baa dɛ nyɛɡ ne lɔŋɔre baa dɛ do laa ta.
Henee baɡle kɔla wɛɛ ir, dɛ́ paɡri kena kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr aa?
He bee kee ɛɛ hweli o kɔr sɔeh nyundua aa?
Bwejaŋa baahnee wɛɛ so jwaana, belaa o so o bwara ɛɛ sɔɔhno.
Nyundua belaa o do, dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ lawɛ, o siwi dɛ naa dɛ le bojaŋ.
Ol lwɛɛ chalee ɛ o bii kondikwa, bela nɛra aa serewa chɔ laanee baa nao.”
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ, “Umee hen hɛɛ tɔŋle Men Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ rɔ?
Dɛ ɡɛɛ yaa, amɔ te chaŋ mɛ.” Anee Job chaŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, menee ume, ń ŋɔ mɛɛ chaŋee yɔ?
Maa wobɛlbwaa bol.
N bol waa kpee he ta men chaŋɛ, dɛ bol nɛɛ, kɛ taraken maa waa bol kpa.” Belaa Korowii bol waa Job be dɛ le peujen la bini ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ́ ba che n sie, ásɛ n bɔɔree wa, he chaŋ mɛ.
Hɛɛ ŋɔɔ he waa wer, dɛ́ chɔɡ mɛ ŋɔ n te waa aa were kɛɛ?
He kpeɡri tel men Korowii aa?
He nyɛɡa ɡe ɛɛ won do kan kɛŋɔ n nyɛɡa, kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra aa?
Job, dɛ ɡɛɛ yaa, baɡle he nyanyini ne he kan haa doa, baɡle kɛŋɔ he kan nɛra ɛɛ duuri.
Nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo, ɡel he baah di ba nɛ, ásɛ ba nyoa sɔɔh, nyiŋi, dɛ́ ba mbarafo te bɛlbwa ne harɛ, chɔɡ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bobɛlbwa baa lole.
Huɡe ba bwa pɛ, kwaa ba sie sɔh lalbɔɔ bini.
Ate, n fe ɛɛ tɔ sie kpɔ jaamee tɛɛ, dɛ́ sɛh kɛ he kpeɡri ɛɛ won lɛɛ.
Nyiŋi kaka maa ta he ne on la na, wɛɛ chwe kpɔɡaa kɛŋɔ nao aa dɛ chwe la aa?
O bwara kpeɡri taeh, o dɛɛhne ɡel o dɔ bokpeɡa!
O din pao kɛŋɔ peleme daa ken, o nakpadɛɛhne do kpeɡri.
O hoɡa kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ayaawa, o nakpale do kɛŋɔ bune ken.
Korowii kontaala bwa bini, onee tɔ sie.
Korowii waa tao la ɡboo dɛ́ won bɛno.
Kpɔɡa le deŋɡarere ta o dɔa dɛɛ chwe, asɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa bwa ɛɛ hɛlɛ o jwɛh.
O chɔ sɔɔhne bini, o sɔh kataŋa bini kpɔɡa tɔ o nɛ.
Sɔɔhne la tɔ o nɛ, asɛ daa aa cheɡɛ nee nyoa baro cheme.
Hale Jɔɔdan Moo suu ba tɔ o nɛɛ kwaraa naa, waa ɔmɛ.
Umee dɛ́ won bɛɛlo dɛ́ dɔɔ lawɔ ɔ?
Umee dɛ won lawɔ bel ne dɛ́ do ŋwɛn o mee ta nɔ?”
Korowii berɔ bɔɔ Job ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ won ta ɡoŋa lawɛ lɛŋɔ, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ŋwɛn vɔwɛ o nyoa aa?
Hɛɛ won kpɔ ŋwɛn do o mebɔɔ bini, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ɡoŋa lawɛ o nyoa aa?
Wɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ soŋe wobopwɛra ne ŋɔ hé na o sum aa?
Wɛɛ sɛoh he ne o fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ dɛɛ tomɛ saŋ bɛlbwa naa?
Hɛɛ won dɛɛro kɛŋɔ jumbie, kɛɛ dɛ́ do ŋwɛn o nakpala, he toli ɛɛ hɛlɛ o ne naa?
Bonadiire ɛɛ ba chemoo, dɛɛ nyin ba yawɔ, kɛɛ dɛ́ bɔne o bini naa?
Hɛɛ won yaɡɛ o bɔtɔn, kɛɛ o nyu tim ne naa?
He te kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o nɛɛ dɛ́ na, hɛɛ nao ɡɛ waa vuuɡi, haa won leɡo nɛɛtena kpa.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won sɔɔh o nyoa, he siwi ne o nɛɛ dawa, dɛ he bwara yɔrɔ.
O ɡɔɔ o te naa, dɛ́ o ɔma.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ba che o sie.
Nomɛlbwa aa won ŋɔ men Korowii di o kem, komɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɛ n kwa.
Gel n baɡle ɡɛ lɛŋɔ nakpale, ne o kan ne o bokpeɡa aa doa.
Umee dɛ́ won wur o bɔtɔn, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ kabaɡrare ba che o sie nɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won hah o nyoa, nyena aa do ɔma dɛ bar cheme nɔɔ?
O nyaŋ pɛɡa kpeɡri dɛ tɔ o nɛ, dɛ marɛ dɔŋa kiŋkiŋ ken.
Bɛlbwa marɛ dɔŋa, peu ɡba aa won jo a baah.
A deno marɛ dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ ken, komɛlbwa aa wola won pere a baah.
O sio waa, a do kɛ nii aa dɛ le o mee ne o nyoa, o sibie swɛɛ kɛŋɔ chɔɔlen wee aa dɛ le ken.
Ninlao dɛ le o nyoa, nihɛma ɡe ɛɛ chuɡri kohona.
Chuu dɛ le o mebɔɔne bini, kɛŋɔ vii aa chɔŋɛ kpɔɡa nii ta ken.
O hweeraa, hɔla dɛ lawɛ nii, ninlao chuɡri dɛɛ le o nyoa.
O kpeɡri lɔ o baŋa ta, a ɡelɔ nomɛlbwa waa chemo la, dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ.
O bwara bobɛlbwa kpeɡri kɛŋɔ buni, dɛ che kiŋkiŋ nomɛlbwa aa wola won taɡɔ.
O bambile kpeɡri kɛ bwe ken, o kpeɡri ɡwaa nambwe kwara.
O ɡɔɔ o te naa, ɔmee dɛ́ chole kpeɡnɛra nɛ, bá chwa le o sie dɛɛ kaa.
Tokobii aa won ɛo waane, hale lampea kɛɛ hɛm wa bini bɛlbwa.
Buni do kɛŋɔ haahra o siwi ta, ayaawa ɡe do kɛŋɔ daa waa pɔah ken.
Waa hɛma nae dɛɛ chwa, vamtor bwea do kɛŋɔ haahra o be, aa on wobɛlbwa ɛ. Guli kpɔe dɛ lɔɔ do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ o be, lampeare tae dɛ yaɡɔ ɛ wesoma tɛo.
O tea pɛɡa do kɛŋɔ kaŋle, o dɛ tuuɡi kpechɛɡre ta kɛŋɔ baa tuuɡi daa ken.
O jo mpo vile ta naa, a dɛ wure kɛŋɔ newɔb, dɛ ɡel mpo ɛɛ wure kɛŋɔ, baa kpɔ sooma noo chɔŋɛ nii ta la.
O pere nee dɛɛ kaa laa, nehɛma dɛ to teŋɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nyumpompoŋa ken.
Haa won kpɔ komɛlbwa maɡɔ harɛ nɔ ta, o ɛ hweera kon waa wola ɔmɛ.
O na oljen bɛlbwa naa, o jeɡa tɛo o siwi ta, o dɛ di kora kpɔɡ bini oljena bwa nɛ.”
Job chaŋe Korowii Anee Job chaŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ henee dɔ kpeɡri kohona.
Nomɛlbwa aa won tɔe ŋwɛnɛ wobɛlbwa ta.
He bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, ‘Umee hen hɛɛ tɔŋle n waa wobol aa wola mun dɔe ne nɔɔ?’ Kasinteŋ, n bol waa maa wola a mun no, waa aa ɛ nyokpoa kohona, maa wola a mun jemɛ.
He ŋɔ, ‘Cheɡ deŋne ń bol waa he be, mɛɛ bɔɔre waa ásɛ he chaŋ mɛ.’ Noe n no nɛra ɛɛ bol he wa, kɛ taraken, n ɡbabir kpɔ siwi nae.
Anomanta, sihiih kpo mɛ n charɛ n liire dɛ so bomboɡ ne tɔɔ ta, á baɡle kɛŋɔ n bambile chɔɡɔ.” Waa la jaɡa Korowii aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡle Job tonɛ la, o ŋɔ Elifas, Teman te la be ŋɔ, “N baah di he ne he daamanar banɛ la nɛ, dɛkalkɛ he ta n bwara wedɛɛɡe bolɛ kɛ n bonɔɔ Job.
Anomanta, lawɛ nabala anuanɛ ne pebala anuanɛ ka tɛ n bonɔɔ Job ó kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah tɛ heya.
Wɛɛ soŋoo tɛ heya, ásɛ n no dɛ bɛ he deŋne tɛr he ɡɛna waa kpa.
He ta n waa kasinteŋ bolɛ kɛ n bonɔɔ Job.” Asɛ Elifas ne Bildad, dɛ Sofar ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ ba be la, asɛ Korowii no Job wesoŋa la.
Ate, Job aa soŋa tɛ o daamanar batoro la tonɛ la, Korowii ɡelɔ o ɛ kondɔɔh ja.
O dɔ anɔ la o fa aa dɔa la bele anɛ ja.
O dɔɔranar ne nimanar ne nimambii, dɛ nɛra ba fa aa jemɔ bwa ba o dem, ba ne o di kwaa dɛ lɛ ba sie.
Ba bwɛɛlo dɛ larawe o bwara wenaale Korowii aa ɡela o na la wa, asɛ bɛlbwa tɛo suuɡa ne suuɡaswɛm noniseɡ.
Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛo dɛ ɡwaa loɡla la.
O berɔ dɔ peera kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anaarɛ, nyoɡmare kaɡboŋa anumɛl, nae baa kpɔa dɛɛ parɛ kaɡboŋ, dɛ keeɡore kaɡboŋ.
O bibaala lɔ banuanɛ dɛ bihaahna batoro.
Bihaah waa tɔ sie sɔne Jemima, nɛɛte sɔne Kesia, asɛ toorote ɡe Keren Hapuk.
Dɛ haah bɛlbwa toole dɛ do wer harɛ la ta kɛŋɔ Job bihaahna la, asɛ ba mɛɛ tɛ bane ba nimanar ne dɔɔranar o kondɔɔh la pera.
Anɔ habɔɔ, Job berɔ dɔ bene lafa fifraanaarɛ.
O soɡo dɛ na o bii ne ba ɡe bii ka tel naanar bele banaarɛ.
Anomanta, waa sewa dɛ o biɡro kɛrɛdɛ.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Sɛɡla Tɔn nɔ, Kooro Solomɔnee boa waa ɡalɡa nyoa dɛ chwerɔ.
Le nyuune — la, a ɛ waane mɛɛ bɛl aa bola dɛɛ ja o bie, ásɛ o hweli wejemwaa dɛ́ kpɔ so.
Waa aa kaa nɛn ne wechɔɡa ta, kɛŋɔ haah waa ɡela baala ɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Ba chwera do nyuune :-, :-, :-.
Wejema do kɛŋɔ handɛɛɡe waa ɡela baa ɛɛ dɔ liidɛɛɡa.
Ba chwera do nyuune :-, :-.
Waa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ kabora ta dɛ baɡle sɛɡla ane aa cha yaa, ásɛ ya dɔ wejema dɛ bɛ ɡɛn.
Gɛ sɛɡla aa cheɡa tɛ Kooro Devid bibaa Kooro Solomɔn o fa aa di kora Israel harɛ ta la sɛɡla.
Waa aa lɔ sɛɡla la taa kɛ, nɛra che a ta dɛ́ dɔ wejema, ne ɡɛ baa lawɛ ba te, á cha ba bá won dɛɛ no waa a mun noe aa kpeɡa mun.
Aa che sɛɡla nɔ taa nɛra won jemɛ wa, dɛ́ won ba te lawa dɛ́ dɔ dadɛɛɡe, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera ne kasinteŋ, dɛ waa aa toɡra.
Aa ɡeloo nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ sie pili, ásɛ toli ne bonɔɔna dɔ wejema.
Wejerema, hé cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no sɛɡla nɔ, dɛ́ dɔ wejema kɛrɛdɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ no waa mun la won ba te lawa, anɔ la aa wera ne anɔ la aa wola were ta, dɛ́ won dɛɛ no sɛɡla a mun noe aa kpeɡa, ne wejerema wobol ne wobobeela mun.
Wejema mumparee Korowii ɔma.
Gɛna ɡboo dɛɛ vɛh wejema, ne waa baa dɛ do ba a ta.
Bonɔɔna ne toli jae wa N bie, no waa he mɛɛ aa dɛ doe a ta, bɛ waa he nya aa dɛ baɡle vɛh.
Ba webaɡla la ɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ dadɛɛɡe, ásɛ he waa do wer kɛŋɔ, haa di bonɔɔne kɛɛ toli, dɛ kpɔ yal vɔwɛ nyu, kɛɛ dɛ do baŋa kwaa la.
N bie, dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra dɛ doe hé ɛ wechɔɡa aa, bɛ sɛh.
Dɛ ba ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, “Ba ya ka nyin nɛn kpo, kɛɛ ya ka teŋe ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ́ kpo nɛn ne o tepoŋ pɛɛ, ya ka kwaa ba ne ba bokpeɡa sɔh, kɛɛ ya ka do ba ŋwɛnɛ ba kaa lalabwɛ.
Yaa dɔ kondɔɔh bwa soo siwii, ba su ya deremi kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.
Anomanta, ba ja ya nɛɛ ásɛ ya bwa ka bɔne kwaa yaa ŋwɛ la.” N bie, he ne nɛra baa do ɡɛ la bɛ valɛ, laa he te kpɔ ba nɛ, ba ɡbaŋre wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, baa won ba te lawɛ nɛŋkpoa ta.
He dɛ nyin jumbie dɛ́ lawaa, baa on bel harɛ o siwi ta, baa mea lwee nyubaah ta du.
Nɛn waa do ɡɛ la dɛ harɛ o te bel, o dɛ nyin o ɡbaɡba seo!
Gɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin kafo waa do, o dɛ sewɛ ɡɛ yoi we-ɛɛla la ta.
Wejema dɛ yerɛ Wejema do kɛ haah dɛ do fɔɡbaahna dɛɛ yerɛ, o taa cheɡɛ chiŋ yawa baahna.
O cheɡɛ bwɛɛ doonyoo ne bela nɛra aa wara, dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa o taa che chiŋ ŋɔ, “Nɛra he sie aa wola pile, saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin kɛ he ɡɛn ka tel ɔ?
Haa waa hweli aa?
Dɛ he no kaeh maa dɛ kah heya aa, n fe ɛɛ kpɔ n bambile bwaa tɛ heya, dɛ́ baɡle heyaa wa.
N teŋɔ dɛɛ yerɛ heya, kɛ he vɛoh, n ta nɔn ŋɔ he ba, kɛ he mwaa n ne.
Haa waa maa dɛ ja heyaa a waa la nyin, he vɛh waa maa bola dɛɛ baɡle heyaa la ɡe.
Sibeɡra pu heya aa, n ɡe ɛɛ mamɛ heyaa, wekpeɡa ane aa do ɔma kohona ba he nɛ aa, n ɡe ɛɛ di he loroo.
Awola siswɛm aa pu heyaa kɛŋɔ dompeu, dɛɛ ba he nɛɛ kohona kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ, ásɛ hɛɛ na weweele ne wahala la, belaa hɛɛ ba men maa dɔ wejema nɔ yera, ásɛ n mwaa he bwa ne.
Hɛ́ɛ ɡaaɡoo dɛɛ nyin n bɔr bobɛlbwa yalayala ken, kɛ haa men na.
Hé kii wejema, haa nyin kɛ he ɔmɛ Korowii.
Hé ta waa maa dɛ ja heyaa la ta teŋɛ, he vɛh kaeh maa kah heyaa la nɛra bwa siwi ta.
Anomanta, hɛɛ dɔ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyinii, ásɛ he ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla ɡure he nyu ta.
Gɛna dɛ sewɛ wejema baa vɛah wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba kpɔ wejema dɛɛ ta habɔɔ, baa sie waa ta do.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no n waa la te ɛɛ so lee jeiih ken, o bwara sɔɔhno, ɔmee liire bɛlbwa aa wola on pu.”
Tɔnɔ aa lɔ wejema ta N bie, dɛ he no waa maa bola dɛɛ baɡle, dɛɛ do liire n waa ta, dɛ cheɡ deŋne wejemwaa ta, dɛ sɔɔh bwara dɛɛ no n waa mun, dɛ he soŋe Korowii wejema, dɛɛ no waa a mun noe aa kpeɡa mun, dɛ he siwi beɡrɔ, hɛɛ nyina kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ, kɛɛ kondɔɔh ane aa sɔh bobɛl aa, a taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ Korowii ɔma mun, dɛ́ berɛ jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Korowii bee wejema le, onee dɛɛ tɛ wejema ne waa mun noe.
Onee dɛɛ cha nɛn o wa aa toɡra, dɛɛ tɔ nɛn o ŋwɛnɛre aa wera ɡbemɡbe.
Korowii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ba bala kɛrɛdɛ nɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi banɔ la baa ta ba te tɛo nɛ.
Dɛ he no n be naa, hɛɛ jemɛ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ dɛ do wer, ne anɔ la aa toɡra.
Dɛ́ berɛ jemɛ waa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ.
He sie ɛɛ piluu, ásɛ he wejema ɡel he sie lɛ.
He waa mun noe ne he wejema ɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ lee waa aa wola were ta.
Aa kee le nɛra baa wola kasinteŋ bol dɛɛ ba waa ne nɛ, nɛra baa vɛh wedɛɛɡa ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ kaa kpɔ wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ aa ɛ biro ta wa, nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, ne banɔ la ba sie aa dɛ lɛ waa aa wola mun dɔe ta.
Ba ɛ nɛra ba wa aa wola sie chɔ, dɛ ɛ nɛra baa wola ba nɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.
Ba waa bwaa kɛ baa neɡre nɛra.
Wejemaa dɛ won lɛɛ le hanjwamane nɔn ta, haah waa kpɔ wobosoma kaa he ne wechɔɡa ta.
Haah waa le o sɛnojaa habɔɔ, dɛ chɔɡ fɔo o ne o jaa fa aa fɔwa Korowii sie la, ɡɛ haah la dem ŋwɛnɛ kaa seo ta, o chɔɔ kaa lalabwɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ la o be aa berɛ dɛɛ ba kpa.
Naate aa mkpa ŋwɛnɛ ta chiɡ kpa.
Anomanta, teŋɛ nɛndɛɛɡe luɡe ta, ásɛ dɛ so kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta soɡa.
Banɔ la wechɔɡa aa wola toole ba nɛɛ dɛɛ ba o ta kae.
Korowii ɛɛ teŋe nɛnchɔɡaa le harɛ nɔ ta, wɛɛ chuɡri wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa le o ta kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa kɛɛ daa ken.
Bonɔɔna ne toli jae waa ja N bie, bɛ waa maa baɡle nɔ soh, ɡel he liire do waa maa ŋɔa hɛɛ ɛ ta, aa ɡeloo he dɔ mkpajaŋ, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he soɡa bini do wer.
Bɛ ɡel Korowii nyina ne nɛnnyin dɛ kasinteŋ paŋɛ.
Kpɔa ɛ kɛŋɔ baŋa kon, ɡel a ɛ he bambile wa.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, hɛɛ dɔ sɔndɛɛɡee Korowii ne nɛra bwa be.
Bɛ he te kpɔ dawɛ anɔ la haa jema ta, kpɔ he hwɛɡa bwa do Korowii nɛ.
Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ la, lii Korowii wa, ásɛ o baɡle ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe hé kpɔ o ta.
Bɛ he te wejereme kohona dɛɛ lii, ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛ ke he te wechɔɡa ta.
Dɛ he teŋɛ a ta naa, aa ɛo kɛŋɔ tɛɛɡa, dɛ́ do he bwara bini dɛɛ chaeh.
Kpɔ he kondɔɔh, ne he koo kondikonloɡla tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ duuru.
Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he dɔ mea kohona he dɔndɔŋ su, ásɛ dɛ berɛ dɔ senfala kohona, haa wola won dɔ kwaa dɛ́ do a bwa.
N bie, dɛ Korowii dɛ tɛr he deŋne aa, bɛ an wesale lii.
Dɛ o dɛ toɡre naa, bɛ ɡel a hwah he bwara.
Nɛn Korowii aa dɛ nyin la, onee wɛɛ kah, kɛŋɔ mɛɛ yon dɛɛ toɡre o binyini la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ wejema la, o na som.
Nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun la, a dɔ tɔnɔ dɛ ɡwaa suuɡapoŋ, a ɛ kondɔɔh ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm.
Wejema yoɡ kpeɡri, dɛ ɡwaa kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, he konnyini bɛlbwa toole he won kpɔ maɡɔ.
O dɛ tɛ mkpajaŋ, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ tɛ kondɔɔh ne jirima.
O ɡelɔ he soɡa bini ɛɛ do wer, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel hɛɛ dɔ bosɔɔhna.
Nɛra baa dɔ wejema la, ba na som, o dɛ tɛ mkpa kohona.
Wejema nee Korowii ta harɛ, waa mun noe taa o che, dɛ ta nyundua ɡe.
O wejema taa o che, dɛ ta neerare aa palɛ, dɛ berɛ ta baama aa ɛ bwaala dɛɛ nɛ.
N bie, lawɛ he wejema ne waa mun noe bini, bɛ ɡel a paŋɛ.
Aa tɛɛ mkpaa, dɛ́ ɡel he soɡa bini do wer.
Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he valɛ wobɛlbwa ta sɔnɔnɔɔ, haa wola nachɔɡee lɔ.
He chɔɔ waa haa ɔmɛ, dɛ́ chɔ domsoma.
Haa wekpeɡa aa dɛ piɡri nɛn waa lii, kɛɛ wenaale aa dɛ ba wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛɛ laanee ɔmɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛ, waa ɡel he jo waa ta.
Gɛ haa dɛ ba wona ɛ tɛ nɛra aa hiah ba la ɛ, dɛ he dɔ a kpeɡri aa.
Dɛ he dɔ komɛl dɛ́ tɛ he dɔŋ aa tɛo, bɛ ŋɔ ó kaa kere dɛ́ ba.
Bɛ wechɔɡa lii tɛ he dɔŋ waa dɔ hwɛɡa he nɛɛ dɛ so bɛne.
Bɛ waa kpɔ dawɛ he dɔŋ nɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, dɛ o ta hen waane ɛɛ.
Bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre nɛn waa dɛ nyin yoi kwaa ta, bɛ waa waa dɛ ɛ la ane ɛ. Korowii kii nɛn o ŋwɛnɛre aa ɡola, o dɔ hwɛɡa tɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra, dɛɛ bol o waa o be.
Korowii nyotaahna lɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ dem, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra dem te, o swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo.
Korowii dɛ mamɛ mbarafo tena baa dɛ mamɛ ba bala, dɛɛ sune nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te la nɛ.
Wejeremaa dɛɛ dɔ jirima, ɡɛna ɡee dɛɛ so sihiih ta.
Wejema kan taeh N bii, hɛɛ no waa he mɛɛ aa dɛ baɡle, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no, ásɛ dɛɛ no waa mun.
Wedɛɛɡaa mɛɛ baɡle heyaa la, hé ɡel a do he liire bini.
N fa aa lɔ n nya ne n mɛɛ sie, dɛ ɡbo ɛ bibaa dɛ ta ɛ bechala la, n mɛɛ fa yon bol waa dɛɛ baɡ mɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Gel waa nɔ ɛɛ liire dɛ bɛ soh.
Dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta ásɛ dɛ biɡri.
Kpɔ wejema dɛɛ no waa mun, do liire a ta, dɛ bɛ waa maa bola la ta le.
Bɛ wejema vɛh, ásɛ o nyiŋi he nɛ.
Nyinu he bambile bwa, ásɛ o kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛ.
Wejema kan taeh, anomanta, hwelu.
Waa mun noe ɡwaa komɛlbwa haa dɔa.
Duu wejema, ásɛ o ɛɛ nɛnjen, kpɔ he te pɛlo, ásɛ o tɛɛ jirima.
Wɛɛ kpɔ jirimaa sime kɛŋɔ botidɛɛɡe, dɛ́ kpɔ pii kɛŋɔ kooɡbɛrɛ he dɔ jirima.” N bie, no n be, dɛ́ do sie a ta kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ dɔ mkpajaŋ.
N baɡle wejema, n kpɔe cheɡ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe haa kpɔ o ta dɛ́ so.
Dɛ he dɛ valɛ wejema ne naa, wobɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔe ŋwɛnɛ, he dɛ chwa kwaraa naa, haa nakpalaa lɔ.
Lawɛ waa haa hwela la bini saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ bɛ ɡel a le he nɔn ta, nyiŋi a ta kɛrɛdɛ, anee he mkpa.
Bɛ bela nɛnchɔɡa aa dɛ la la, bɛ ba waa dɔŋa ɛ. Dɛɛ ke he te, bɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta kpɔ, ke o ta, dɛ́ kpɔ he ŋwɛnɛ.
Gɛ nɛra la aa won chɔ, dɛ ba ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ, baa won haŋre, dɛ ba ta wechɔɡa dii.
Nyubinikpeɡ ne yoi we-ɛɛlaa ɛ ba kondikwaa ne sen. Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra waa do kɛŋɔ, bɔr aa chaahna chɔmbibii ka tel kɛŋɔ wee aa baŋa.
Kɛ nɛnchɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ te do kɛŋɔ, bɔr aa bira kpirkpir ken, baa kon baa lɔ naa o ta na.
N bie, cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no waa maa bol baɡle, dɛɛ no n be kɛrɛdɛ.
Bɛ ɡel a le he liire ta, ɡel a do he nyu bini.
A ɛ mkpa dɛ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ no a mun, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba bokpeɡa.
He dɛ lii wa aa, dɛɛ nyiŋa kɛrɛdɛ, waa haa dɛ lii la, anee hɛɛ ɛ. Bɛ waa aa wola kpela ɛɛ bol bwa, laa he te kpɔ neɡra wobol ta.
Do sie dɛɛ ɛ waa haa dɛ ɛ, do sie a ta, dɛ bɛ bobɛlbwa nyiŋi.
Nyiŋi he vala bini kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ che kiŋkiŋ bela haa dɛ kaa.
Laa he te kpɔ wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ ɡel he ŋwɛnɛ toɡre.
Bɛ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la ta le.
Jwamane jae wa N bie, cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no n wejema nɔ, no waa aa dɛ tɛ waa mun noe.
Ásɛ dɛ che a ta dɔ dadɛɛɡe, ásɛ he wobol baɡle kɛŋɔ he dɔ wejema.
Hanjwamane nyoa wobol som kɛŋɔ tooh ken, o taa pwɛre ɡwaa no, kɛ a habɔɔ la, waa waa doe a ta la kpeli kɛŋɔ ol kpela.
O nyoa wobol dɛ do nɛn bol kɛŋɔ naŋɡɔse ken.
Wɛɛ kaa he ne seo taa, lalabwɛɛ ŋwɛnɛɛ wɛɛ kpɔ.
Waa ŋwɛnɛ waa dɛ tɛ mkpa la ta kpɔ, valaa o valɛ dɛɛ valɛ, waa jemɛ anɔ la waa dɛ ɛ. N bii, hé berɛ no, hɛɛ berɛ waa maa dɛ bol he be nɔ soeh.
Haah waa do ɡɛ la, hé laa he te kpɔ o nɛ, he bɛ o doonyoa kwaraa fɛrɛ.
Gɛ laa aa, hɛɛ paŋɛ he bonɔɔne saŋ jirima he fa aa dɔa la nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn taa.
Ásɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra ba kpɔ he kondɔɔh di, ásɛ kwaa haa ɛ toma dɛ dɔ la, bɛ nomɛl kwaa ba berɛ.
Haa ba hwɛɛh la, he ba chɔ dɛɛ hime, ɡɛ saŋ he bwadabii bwa aa ɡwɛɡra la, ásɛ he ba ŋɔ, “N deŋnekpeɡ ne n waa bɛ noe, ne n bambikpeɡii tɛ mɛ.
N ta nɛra baa baɡ mɛ waa la be noɛ, n ta nɛra baa do mɛ la waa ta teŋɛ.
Asɛ buɡ nɔ ta mɛɛ ba ncho dii, nɛra bwa siwi ta nɔ.” He ne he haah ɡbo ɛɛ chɔ, kɛŋɔ haa dɛ nyɔ he dem nee ɡbo la.
Bɛ fɔɡbaahna haahna ka nyin.
Ba do kɛŋɔ nee aa wola were ne nyɔe.
Kpoŋe he haah ɡbo, he ne nomɛlbwa kon laa.
Gel he sie ɛɛ lɛ he bonɔɔne saŋ haah nɛ.
Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ he ne o chɔe bini.
O wer kɛŋɔ diɡi ken, o we-ɛɛla ɡe do wer, ɡel he sie ɛɛ lɛ o nɛ, hɛɛ nyinu kohona saŋ bɛlbwa.
N bie, bɔkwaa ɡela he berɛ kpɔ he te tɛ hanfale bɛl jaɔ?
Bɔkwaa ɡela hɛɛ sewɛ he dɔŋ bɛl haah nɛɛ jaɔ?
Korowii dɛ na wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ, o jemɛ he vala bini bwa.
Nɛnchɔɡe wechɔɡa do kɛŋɔ bel dɛ tɛo, o dichɔɡaa dɛɛ lawɔ.
Lawa waa wola won o te lawɛ laanee dɛ́ kpoo, o ɡɛnaa ɡela wɛɛ sewɛ.
Gɛna wejaala ane N bie, a balɔ kɛŋɔ he di ajinamuu tɛ he dɔŋ, dɛ he baɡɛ nyoa waane ta tɛ nomɛl aa, amɔ dɛ he nyobaɡa la ɛ bel dɛ tɛɛ, waa haa bola la harɛ bel.
N bie, a ba ɡɛ naa, dɛ he nɔn lɔ he dɔŋ la nyoa, ɛ warane la o be dɛ́ ka soŋo, dɛ́ dɔ he te.
Bɛ kpoŋe so, bɛ kpɔ chɔ.
Ɛ warane kɛŋɔ welo aa na kpaah, dɛ laa o te kpɔ, kɛɛ jumbie aa na nɛn waa dɛ harɔ bel la.
Bɔhwaah bɛlbwa nyiŋi vaɡla we-ɛɛla, dɛ́ che a ta hweli wa.
A ta nomoa kɛɛ nyu te dɔe, a ta kooro dɔe, kɛ a nyin a kondikwaa dɛɛ cheɡ hwel saŋ, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ kpa bwaala nee saŋ.
Bɔhwaah, saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin he chɔ ka tel, dɛ́ ir saŋ besoo?
He yon ŋɔ, “Chɔe tama, dom chuɡla tama, nɔɔra fɔɔla dɛ́ so onɛ tama.” He ne ŋɔe he ba jemɛ la, dɛ nyaa piɡri kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ aa kpoŋe dɔmkon dɛ́ ba che he nɛ.
Nɛnsale baa ɛ ba te nɛnchɔɡaa vala dɛɛ teŋe nyosone.
Ba kpɔ sie ne nakpale dɛɛ bol wa, dɛ kpɔ nonie dɛɛ baɡle wa, ba dɔ liichɔɡa ba nyu bini, dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa ba bambile ta.
Wobochɔɡa lɔ ba nyoo baa ir nɛra bandia.
Anomanta, kerabeŋkpoŋii wekpeɡa ɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala, buɡ taa aa ba ba nɛɛ chiɡa, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, ba chah kahonɛ.
Webele anumɛl kɛɛ anuanɛ ane lole Korowii haah kɔkɔkɔkɔ, anee, nɛn waa nyiŋi nɛn dɛɛ vah, ne nyosonteŋni, ne nɛŋkpoa, ne nɛn waa dɔ wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa o nyu bini, ne nɛn waa ɡbaŋa wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, ne dansewea dɛ nɛn wobochɔɡa aa lɔ o nyoa, dɛɛ ba peɡra ne o dem tena baah ta.
Jwamane jae wa N bie, dɛɛ no waa he mɛɛ aa dɛ doe a ta.
Bɛ waa he nya aa dɛ baɡle vɛh.
Kpɔa ɛ kɛŋɔ baŋa kon, ɡel a ɛ he bambile wa.
Aa tɔ he siee bobɛlbwa haa dɛɛ la, he chɔe bini, aa nyiŋi he nɛ, ásɛ he iro ɡe aa, a tɛɛ liire.
Webaɡla nɔ do kɛŋɔ kandea dɛɛ chaahne, wejaala nɔ ɛɛ won baɡle ɡɛ haa dɛ ba wona so.
Aa won kee le hanchɔɡe nɛ, dɛ́ won ɡel he laa he te kpɔ haah o nyoa wobol aa soma, dɛ ɛ nomɛl haah nɛ.
Bɛ o wer waa koh dɛ́ ɡel he sie do o nɛ, bɛ ɡel o kpɔ o tolsie neɡre.
Hɛɛ won kpɔ kondikwaa tamaa ken dɔ hanjwamane.
Kɛ dɛ he dɛ nyin nomɛl haah tenaa, komɛlbwa dɛ le he nɔn ta.
Hɛɛ won pa ninhɔla kore, he laala aa wola fuah?
Hɛɛ won valɛ ninhɔla ta, he napaala aa wola bwɛ aa?
Gɛɛ a do, nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ o dɔŋ haah chɔ la, baa tɛr o deŋne.
Dɛ nɛn dɛ chɔ lɔr, dɛ ka ŋwɛ kwaa di aa, he bɛ on hah, dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah.
Kɛ dɛ ba lawɔ tenaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ kwaa waa ŋwɛa la bele anuanɛ.
Kwaa waa dɔa bwa ɛɛ le o nɔn taa.
Baa waa le o haah habɔɔ, dɛ kaa nyin hanfala la ta liire dɔe, o dɛ chɔɡ o ɡbaɡba.
Waa duure dɔ, lɔɔraa chɔ le tɛo, sihiih aa o nɛɛ le bwa.
Baa baah aa di kohona, nemenɛ o meera tɔpere o yon bɔ a kem ɡɛ bwa waa dɛ nyin.
O sie aa larawa bɛlbwa ta lɛ, komɛlbwa toole he kpɔ tɛo o baah sɔɔh.
Hanjwamane jae wa N bie, dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ta, dɛ́ɛ do liire waa maa dɛ doe a ta la ta.
Dɛɛ no n waa dɛ́ dɔ mkpa, dɛ́ɛ nyiŋi waa maa dɛ baɡle la ta kɛrɛdɛ, kɛŋɔ he siwinyiŋi ken.
Kpɔa do kɛŋɔ noniseɡ, dɛ́ ɡel a do he bambile bini.
Kpɔ wejema kɛŋɔ he nimambie, dɛ́ kpɔ waa mun noe kɛŋɔ he dansom.
Aa lawɛɛ le hanjwamane, ne nomɛl haah o nyoa wobol aa soma nɛ.
Awola bɛl, n lɔ dea dɛ ha sie nyiŋi tokoro ta, dɛ na bonɔɔna bane baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ, ba bini la, dɛ bɛl te ɛ ɡɛne tenten.
Baa dɛ kaa la, dɛ ɡɛne la te valɔ dɛɛ kpɔ bela hanjwamane la aa soɡa.
Dɛɛ fɛrɛ haah la dem, dɛ bɔr dɛ jo, bobɛlbwa ɛɛ bir.
Ate, haah la kpɔ o te dɛ ba cheme bonɔɔ la, dɛ haah la do jwamanlaala dɛɛ taaɡe sie.
O ɛ haah o deŋne aa kpeɡa, waa sihiih jemɛ, dɛ do ɡaaɡa ɡbo ta, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ o cheɡɛ loŋkoni ta, kɛɛ fɔɡbaahna ane ta yawa ta, dɛ́ dɔ baa lawɛ.
Belaa haah la ba ɡbaa bonɔɔ la pɛl o te, dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o vaama ta, dɛ nyiŋi o siebɔr, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Fini n kpo kon dɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, asɛ a ka ola la ane.
Asɛ n le dɛ baa ɡaaɡe he bɔr, n nyin he bɔr asɛ dɛ nae la!
N kpɔ yadɛɛɡe Ijipt harɛ tena aa ɛo, o do wer kɛrɛdɛ pa n chɔɔbɔr.
Dɛ kpɔ korobo ne konsɔɔhsoma bwa soo siwi merɛ o ta.
Ba ya ka lɛ ya sie jwaana nɔ ne bwa, ya ka di ya bwara!
N jaa toole, o kaa bobɛl, bela jaŋne.
O kpoŋe suuɡa kohona dɛ kaa, wɛɛ dɔ yawanyoa anɛɛ.” Haah la kpɔ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ ne wobosoma dɛ dɔɔ kaa.
Buɡ la ta, bonɔɔ la den teŋɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nao baa tɛɡro dɛɛ la ka kpo la, kɛɛ kweɡla aa jo bel ta bela hɛm aa yaɡɔ dɛ́ kpoo la.
O berɔ do kɛŋɔ jumbie aa toola dɛɛ kaa bel ta, waa wola jemɛ kɛŋɔ o dɛ ba sewa la.
N bii, name hé no n be, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n wa.
Hé bɛ ɡel he pɛla do haah waa do ɡɛ nɔ nɛɛ ó ba neɡre heya, he bɛ bɛl nɛɛ teŋɛ bwa.
Gɛ haah nɔ chɔɡ baala taeh, dɛ berɛ ɡel bane ɡe serewe baa wola won kur ba.
He nakpala tire o dem aa, amɔ dɛ lalabwɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ taa he che la.
Bela ne seo bori.
Wejema yera waa dɛ yerɛ Hɛɛ no, wejema do kɛŋɔ haah dɛɛ yerɛ, o do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɔ liire, dɛɛ no waa mun, o taa che chiŋ.
O cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ nyoa deŋɡarere ta, o lɔ ŋwɛnɛ chɛchɛre ta.
O cheɡɛ bwɛjen doonyoo, bela baa kpɔa dɛɛ jo o bini, o lɔ bela dɛɛ yerɛ.
O ŋɔ, “N dɛ yerɛ nomɛlbwa, nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwaa mɛɛ yerɛ.
He sie ta pilaa, hé hweli sipila wa.
He ɡɛnaa, hé hweli wejemwa.
Hɛ́ɛ no, n waa nɔ wer taeh, anɔ la bwa maa dɛ bol he be la toɡrɔ.
Kpelaa mɛɛ bol, maa nyosone teŋe bwa.
Wobɛlbwa maa bol la bwa ɛ kasinteŋ, a bɛlbwa toole dɛ ɛ nyosone kɛɛ neɡra.
Nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun la, a bwa bini chɔɔ tɛo, dɛ berɛ toɡre tɛ banɔ la baa dɔ wejema.
Hé kpɔ waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ ja heya dɛ́ ɡel suuɡapoŋ, hé kpɔ wejema ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm tenten.
Menee Wejema, n ɡwaa kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, haa won kpɔ he bambile ta komɛlbwa maɡ mɛ.
Menee Wejema, n sie pilo, n jemɛ waa dɛɛ no waa mun.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii kii wechɔɡa, anomanta, n kii mbarafo ne maŋkurae we-ɛɛla, ne wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre, dɛ nyosone.
N dɛ baɡle nɛra waa bá kpɔ ɛ toma aa cha ba, n ɡelɔ baa no waa mun, dɛ́ dɔ kpeɡri.
N cha koranar baa di kora, ásɛ nomonome won mmarare aa wera doe.
Nomonjena ba wa aa toɡra cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛɛ di kora, dɛ́ won bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.
N dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin n bɔr dɛ́ na mɛ.
Menee dɔ kondɔɔh ne jirima dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ, dɛ soɡa bini wer doe dɛ ka tonɛ.
Kon haa dɔ le n be la ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm baa laa doŋa kpɔ o ta, dɛ ɡwaa suuɡapoŋ tenten.
Waa aa toɡraa mɛɛ ɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ ta, dɛɛ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ nyin mɛ kondɔɔh, ba deremi ɛɛ su kohona.
Men Wejema, menee Korowii tɔ sie ta, mɔɔ dɛ pa mun ta komɛlbwa.
Menee Korowii tɔ sie ta mumpar la, mɔɔ dɛ ta harɛ nɔ.
O ta mɛ mɔɔ dɛ ta mpore, ne nee nyuune.
Waa wola bwejena tae mɔɔ la, dɛ n lole, mɔɔ o kpɔ deŋɡarere ba cheɡ la, dɛ ba lol mɛ.
Waa wola harɛ ne kpɔɡ bini kɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta teera kwaraa tae mɔɔ la, dɛ n lole.
N siwi taa Korowii ta nyundua, dɛ pe mpo ne nyundua chenchema, ɡɛ saŋ waa kpɔ baama do nyundua, dɛ ta neerare a palɛ kaa jo mpo ta la.
N lole o maɡɛ bela mpo aa dɛɛ jaɡɛ, dɛ ŋɔ o bɛ bela ba ɡarɛ, ne ɡɛ saŋ waa pe harɛ mun.
Dɛ n lɔ Korowii jwɛɛh ya bwa pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma, dɛ n dɛ ɛ waa o bambile aa dɛ nyin tɔpere bɛlbwa, n sie ɛɛ lɛ o be saŋ bɛlbwa.
Asɛ n sie lɛ toma yaa pɛa ɛ la ta, n tea too nɛwɛnyina bwa nɛ.
N bii, name hé no n be, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ n waa ta la, o na som.
Hé no anɔ la maa dɛ do heyaa a ta, he bɛ an vɛh, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ wa.
Nɛn waa dɛ no n waa la, o na som, nɛn waa dɛ so n dem doonyoa kɛɛ dɛɛ kpa bela la, o na som.
Nomɛlbwa waa na mɛ la dɔ mkpa, Korowii tea ɛɛ too o nɛɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola men nae la, o ɛ o te, nomɛlbwa waa hah mɛ la pɛla lawɛ seo.”
Wejema ne ɡɛnewa Wejema do kɛ haah waa ma o dem, asɛ dɛ ɛ pilare anuanɛ do o ta.
O kpo ol dɛ kpɔ ɛ kondikonjena, dɛ kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma ane koo sen ta, dɛ pa chɔŋre teebur ta.
O tomɛ o toli ŋɔ bá la bwɛɛ la bela aa dawɛ deŋɡare ta ka yerɛ nɛra.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé banɔ la he sie aa wola pile la ba,” dɛ berɛ ŋɔ ɡɛna ɡe be ŋɔ, “Hé ba di kwaa dɛ́ nyɔ sen maa koo kwaa a ta nɔ ane.
Hé le he sie bɛ pila la ta, dɛ́ dɔ he nyu.
Hé teŋɛ wejema ŋwɛnɛ ta.
He dɛ ja nɛn waa dɛ ɛ sisawa aa, chɛɡaa hɛɛ dɔ.
He dɛ di wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɡe kasinteŋ aa, waa hɛɛ dɔ.
Bɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ nɛra sisawaa kasinteŋ di o ba haeh, di wejereme kasinteŋ, ásɛ o nyini.
Hé dɛ ja wejereme aa, a ɡelɔ wɛɛ jemɛ waa kohona.
Anɔ la bɛlbwa haa bol nɛn o wa aa toɡra be la, a dɛ ja o wejema ta.
Wejema mumparee Korowii ɔma, waa mun noe ɡe cheɡɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ jema ta.
Menee Wejema, he teŋɛ n nɛ aa, hɛɛ dɔ mkpajaŋee.
He jemɛ wa aa, aa do werii tɛɛ, he vɛah ɡe aa, hɛɛ na waa.” Gɛna do kɛŋɔ haah waa ɛ wobobala te, waa wola sihiih jemɛ.
O dem doonyoa kɛɛ bwɛɛ la deŋɡare taa o kara che wɛɛ so o ta, dɛɛ yerɛ nɛra baa ba dɛ kaa, banɔ la baa teŋa baa kaa ba liire do ba waa ta.
Dɛ ŋɔ ɡɛna be ŋɔ, “Nɛra he sie aa wola pile, hé ba n be bonɔ.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Nee haa ŋwɛ nyɔ la som taeh, kondikwaa haa sɔh di la som.” Nɛra waa dɛ lɛɛ ba la aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba la o dem aa, ba dɛ sewɛ.
Banɔ la baa tɔ sie jo bela la, ba bwa serewɔ kaa lalabwɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn sɛɡla Kooro Solomɔn sɛɡlaa teŋa nɔ.
Bechawejereme ɡelɔ o mɛɛ baŋa ɛɛ pa, kɛ bechaɡɛne te ɡelɔ o nya loo ɛɛ ku.
Wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ kpɔe dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe, kɛ dɛ he waa toɡraa, a dɛ lee seo ta.
Korowii aa ɡel lɔr kpo nɛn o wa aa toɡra.
O lɔ nɛnchɔɡe konnyini dɛɛ ta.
He dɛ ɛ bɔhwaah aa, nyae hɛɛ nya, kɛ dɛ he dɛ ɛ toma tenaa, kwaa hɛɛ dɔ.
Wejereme dɛ́ komɛ o koo kwaa a koma saŋ, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ́ chɔ kwaa koma saŋ te dɛ́ di sihiih.
Nomɛlbwa swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te mur, waa yoi waa bol á le baŋ.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra na som, baa o waa soh, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te waa won soeh warane.
Wejereme dɛ́ no jae, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ bol ɡɛnewaa te waa dɛ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Nɛn o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la, o wobɛlbwa dɛ́ do wer, nɛn o wa aa wola sie chɔ te, ba dɛ nao.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tɔ kasinteŋ ta la dɛ́ ba waa ne, kɛ nɛn waa dɔ bambile dɛɛ bol waa la, o dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol dɛ́ ba mkpa ne, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te mur, waa yoi waa bol á le baŋ.
Che kaɡraree dɛɛ ba tim kaɡrare tae ne, kɛ nɛnnyin te dɛ́ tɔ wechɔɡa ta.
Wejereme wobol binii wejema do, kɛ ɡɛne te, lɔɔraa baa lɔɔro.
Wejereme dɛ hweli wa, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ do o nyu bini, kɛ nɛn waa ɡɛna wobol te, dɛ ba waa ne.
Dɔɔh suuɡaa dɛɛ tɔɔ ɡbemɡbe, kɛ nyaa te, o nyae dɛ́ kaa o ne chɔɡa ta.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra kembɔree mkpa, asɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ba wechɔɡa ɡbo ne.
Nɛn waa cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no jae la dɛ́ biɡri, kɛ onɔ la waa wola o wechɔɡa sɛh la dɛ́ dɔ wa.
Nɛn waa hah o dɔŋ dɛɛ tɔh la ɛ nyosonteŋni, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ taa nyokpɛl la ɡɛnɔ.
Wobobala te bɛlbwa dɛ koni, asɛ nɛn waa won o nyoa lawa la jemɛ wa.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol do kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ tenten, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te liire ɛ wepuu.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol dɔ tɔnɔ dɛɛ tɛ nɛndamanta, kɛ ɡɛne te, liire waa wola dɔe la, dɛ́ kaa o ne seo ta.
Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ naa, a dɛ ba kondɔɔh ne, wenaale bɛlbwa aa a ta ja.
Gɛne siee dɛɛ lɛ wechɔɡa ta, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun te, o sie dɛ lɛ wejemwaa ta.
Waa nɛnchɔɡe aa dɛ ɔmɛ la, a dɛ ba o nɛ, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te, dɛ́ dɔ kon waa dɛ nyin.
Wekpeɡa pu wechɔɡ-ɛɛ aa, o dɛ sewɛ, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te, o dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa.
Gɛ konnyɛɡa aa dɛ nyɛɡ nyena, asɛ ninchuu ɡe ɛɛ we sie la, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ bonyɛɡa do tɛ nɛn waa tomɔ.
Waa on bansɔɔhna tɛ.
He dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii aa, he dɛ biɡri, kɛ he dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, haa he saŋ tel.
Kon nɛn o wa aa toɡra aa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o ta la, ɛ silɛɛ kon, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te hwɛɡa dɛ́ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Korowii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nɛ, dɛɛ chɔɡ banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ́ so deŋnesɔɔhna ta, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te, baa doŋu le o harɛ ta.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ bol nɛmbiwa, kɛ nɛn o nyondoŋe aa bar o nyu te waa dɔ jaɡa.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol dɛ́ sɔɔh baah, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te, o wobol dɛ muɡli baah.
Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ faah nɛra kwaa yoɡa ta.
O sie dɛ lɛ nɛn waa kpɔ kon waa maɡra ne kwaa maɡa nɛ.
Mbarafo dɛ ba sihiih ne, asɛ pwɛre doe ɡe ɛɛ ba wejema ne.
He waa toɡrɔ aa, a ɡelɔ hɛɛ jemɛ anɔ la haa ɛ, kɛ nɛra baa wola kasinteŋ dɔe la we-ɛɛlaa dɛɛ chɔɡ ba.
Kondɔɔh ta tɔnɔ dɔe seo tɔpere, kɛ he waa toɡrɔ aa, a dɛ lee seo ta.
He waa toɡrɔ aa, dɛ he waa wer, kɛ he ɛ nɛnchɔɡe aa, he ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla dɛ chɔɡe.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra daa dɛɛ lɛo, asɛ nɛn waa wola kasinteŋ dɔe la ɡbaɡba pɛla waa dɛɛ lawɔ.
Nɛnchɔɡe sewaa, o hwɛɡa bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, anɔ la o sie aa dawɛ a ta bwa tonɔ.
Korowii dɛ lɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛɛ le wahala ta, a yon berɛ ba nɛnchɔɡe nɛ.
Nyoa nee nɛn waa nyiŋi nɛn sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ waa ɛɛ chɔɡ o dɔŋ, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te, o wejemaa dɛɛ lɛo.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, bwɛɛ la tena bwa sie dɛ lɛ, kɛ dɛ nɛnchɔɡe baa sewaa, bɛlbwa dɛ mamɛ.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra we-ɛɛla taa a che bwɛɛ ɛɛ pili, dɛ berɛ che nɛnchɔɡe wobol ta bwɛɛ ɛɛ paɡre.
A ɛ ɡɛnewaa kɛŋɔ he muɡli he dɔŋ baah, kɛ he jemɛ waa tenaa, he dɛ lawɛ he nyoa.
Nɛn waa dɛ ŋwalɛ nɛra aa won waa ta tɔ, kɛ nɛn nɛra aa dɔ hwɛɡa o nɛɛ te dɛ tɔ wobɛlbwa ta.
Dɛ wejerema toole dɛ nyiŋi harɛ bɛl ta naa, o dɛ paɡre.
Bela nomondɛɛɡa aa lole la, deŋnesɔɔhna lɔ bela.
Haa nɛn jemɛ aa, haa o habɔɔ che kem ta.
Haa on ajinamuu di.
He vɛoh bɔ kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ he te do a ta.
Haah waa dɔ dadɛɛɡe la dɛ dɔ nyanyini, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ lɛ ɡaeh dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh ɡbo.
Nɛn o wa aa wera dɛ́ dɔ kɛrɛdɛ, nyubinikpeɡ te dɛ ha o ɡbaɡba.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ koeh aa tɔnɔ bɛlbwaa dɔ tɛo, nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ́ dɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Nɛn o siwi aa swɛɛra kɛŋɔ o waa toɡre kɛrɛdɛ la, dɛ́ dɔ o nyu, kɛ nɛn waa teŋa dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la te dɛ́ sewɛ.
Korowii kii nɛn o liire aa wola were, o sie dɛ lɛ nɛn o we-ɛɛla aa wera nɛ.
A ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛraa, kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa te ɛɛ dɔ ba nyuu.
Handɛɛɡe waa wola da dɔe la, do kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm noniseɡ do parakoo mee ta!
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra konnyini ɛ wedɛɛɡa, kɛ kon wechɔɡ-ɛɛ aa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o waa la, o dɛ ba bandia ne.
Nomɛl nɔn dɛ pili kɛ dɛ ta ɛɛ dɔ, asɛ bɛl ɡe nɔn aa pili kɛ dɛ ɡe nya.
Dɛɛ pili nɔn ásɛ wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ, dɛɛ cha banfala ásɛ ba cha he ɡe.
Nɛn waa tɔ mea cheɡ, dɛɛ kpa suuɡajena la, nɛra dɛ taahno, kɛ onɔ la waa le o kwaa ne dɛɛ yoɡa la, ba swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo.
He dɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa aa, nɛra dɛ nyin he wa, kɛ he dɛ nyin wechɔɡa aa, he dɛ dɔ.
Nɛn waa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o kondɔɔh ta la, wɛɛ cholo kɛŋɔ hwel saŋ papoo yon le la, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te ɛɛ do werii, kɛŋɔ bwaala nee saŋ papoo ken.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ waa dɛɛ dawɛ o dem tena nɛɛ la dɛ chɔ pɛɛ.
Gɛɛ a do ɡɛne ɛɛ berɛ wejereme bonɔɔ.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ nɛra ɛɛ dɔ mkpa, kɛ naɡrenyin te dɛ chɔɡ o bala.
Nɛndɛɛɡa dɛ dɔ ba wedɛɛɡa kembɔr harɛ nɔ ta naa, ɡɛɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ la, ɛɛ ba ba wechɔɡa kembɔr dɔe.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o jemɛ waa la dɛ sɛh chɔɡre.
Gɛnee wola sɛh kɛ ba baɡlo wa.
Korowii tea dɛ to nɛndɛɛɡa nɛ, dɛɛ pa nɛra baa dɛ lii wechɔɡa bolchɔɡe.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ aa won che o we-ɛɛla ta dɛ́ lɛ o te, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te dɛ́ so le kiŋkiŋ ken.
Handɛɛɡe ɡelɔ o jaa ɛɛ dɔ jirima, kɛ haah waa kpɔ sihiih dɛɛ kpo o jaa la, do kɛŋɔ weela aa lɔ nɛn nɛ.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, kɛ nɛn o nyondoŋe aa bar o nyu te liire ɛ nyosone ɡbosoo.
Nɛnchɔɡe wobol do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa sɔah dɛɛ nyin o dɔŋ dɛ́ kpo, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol dɛ́ lɛ nɛra.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra mun ɛɛ heo kwaraa, ásɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra te dwee do le.
Wejeremee baa kpɛɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi ɡɛna nyubaahna.
Dansaa waa dɔ bonɔɔ la, bɔ nɛn waa dɛ lii o te nɛnjen dɛ berɛ dɛɛ chɔ lɔr.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ nyiŋi o kondɛɛra nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Nɛnchɔɡaa dɛɛ ɛ nyubinikpeɡ ba kwaa nɛ.
Paa waa swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ toma laanee, dɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa kohona.
Gɛnee dɛɛ chɔɡ o te toma aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe ta.
Nɛnchɔɡa pɛla waa bwaa kɛŋɔ bichɔɡwa, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te, dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ ken.
Nɛnchɔɡe nyoa wobolee dɛɛ lawɔ, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te dɛ́ le wahala ta.
Nɛn kembɔr lɔ anɔ la waa bol ne o we-ɛɛle ta.
Anee ɡela wɛɛ dɔ kwaa aa chɛo.
Gɛnee yon dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ o wobɛlbwa wer, kɛ nɛn waa lɛ o dɔŋ waa dɛɛ ja o kwaa ta laanee wejereme.
Gɛne bandiaa baa na warane, kɛ nɛn waa dɔ nfɛrɛ laa liire dɛɛ kpɔ chɛɡa ta.
Nɛn waa dɛ di kasinteŋ laanee dɛɛ di danseɛ aa toɡra, nyosonteŋnii dɛɛ di dansewea.
Nɛra baa dɛ bol waa baa wola liire a ta do la, ba wobol dɛ we kɛŋɔ nii ken, wejereme wobol dɛ larawe bwara.
Kasinteŋ lole saŋ bɛlbwa, nyosonee dɔ jaɡa.
Nyosone ɡboo nɛn waa dɛ lii wechɔɡa nyu bini.
Nɛra baa dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne la dɔ silɛɛ.
Wechɔɡa aa nɛn o wa aa toɡra pu, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te ne wejoree.
Korowii kii nyosonteŋni, o sie dɛ lɛ nɛn waa dɛ di kasinteŋ nɛ.
Wejereme dɛ tɔ o wejemwaa ta, ɡɛnee dɛɛ pili o ɡɛnewaa ta dɛɛ tɛ nɛra.
Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ toma kohonaa dɛɛ dɔ nomonome, bɔhwaahree dɛɛ do nɛn lɔɡa, baa doo tomkpeɡa ta.
Waa liira kohona do kɛŋɔ bone ken, asɛ wobodɛɛɡa ɡe ɛɛ sɔɔh baah.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ tɛ o dɔŋ liidɛɛɡa, nɛnchɔɡee dɛɛ neɡre o dɔŋ.
Nɛn waa ɛ bɔhwaah la, waa o tetoo kwaa dɔ, kɛ nɛn o sie aa wola on hwah la o dɛ dɔ kwa.
Waa aa toɡra ŋwɛnɛ chɔɔ kaa mkpa ta, wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ te, seo taa o kaa.
Bechawejeremee dɛɛ no waa o mɛɛ aa dɛ doo a ta, kɛ deŋnekpeɡ te te, waa o wechɔɡa sɛh.
He dɔ wobodɛɛɡa aa, he na som, kɛ nɛn waa wola kasinteŋ bol te, dɛ na wa.
He jemɛ he wobol nyiŋaa, he laa he te dɛɛ kpɔ waa ta, kɛ nɛra baa bol waa baa wola liire a ta do la, dɛ chɔɡ ba te.
Bɔhwaah bɛlbwa aa o konnyini dɔ, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin toma te, o dɛ dɔ kon waa dɛ nyin.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra aa nyosone nyin, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe wobol te, sihihwaa ne ncho ɡboo a bwa.
Nɛn wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛ chao o soɡa bini, asɛ nyubinikpeɡ ɡe ɛɛ chɔɡ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.
Nɛra bane dɛ ɛ ba te kɛ dɔɔhna, kɛ dɛ komɛlbwa toole ba be, bane ɡe ɛ ba te nyaara, kɛ dɛ dɔɔhnaa ban.
Dɔɔhnee ba lawɛ dɛɛ lɛ suuɡa, kɛ nyaa te, ba waane laa o wa.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra soɡa bini chaahnɔ kɛŋɔ bochaah ken, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te do kɛŋɔ kandea waa dɛ dime.
Waa nee jenu ɛɛ ba, wejeremee dɛɛ bɔɔ waa bini.
Ŋwɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ dɔ kwaa la, ɡelɔ aa kaa kɛŋɔ peu ken.
Bɔwɔb kweena dɛ́ dɔ kwaa ɡe ɡelɔ a che dɛɛ warɛ.
He hwɛɡɛ kon ta, dɛ he ta dɔe yaa, he bambilee dɛɛ chɔɡ, kɛ he hwɛɡɛ komɛl ta dɛ dɔ aa, he sie dɛ lɛ.
He ɡelɔ wedɛɛɡa kpɔ he deŋna habɔɔ kaa laa, waa he nyin dɛɛ dawɛ he nɛ, kɛ he teŋɛ a ta naa, he bwara dɛ sɔɔhne.
Wejereme webaɡla do kɛ bule dɛɛ tɛ mkpa, a dɛ le nɛn seo ta.
Nɛn waa dɔ wejema la, dɛ́ dɔ duure, kɛ nɛn o wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe te, a dɛ kaa o ne wechɔɡa ta.
Wejereme bɛlbwa dɛ lii waa mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛa, kɛ ɡɛne te ɡelɔ baa na o ɡɛna.
Torome o wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe laanee dɛɛ ba waa ne.
Kɛ onɔ la o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ te, o dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
Nɛn waa wola jae no la dɛ nya dɛɛ di sihiih, kɛ naate waa dɛ no jae la, o dɛ dɔ nyanyini.
Na ɡɛ aa dɛ do som kɛ haa dɔ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin!
Nɛn waa ɡɛnaa ki o wechɔɡa ta lee.
Kpɔ he te pɛl wejereme ásɛ dɛ jemɛ wa, kɛ nɛn o ne ɡɛne aa pɛa la, o dɛ na wahala.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ne waa bobɛlbwa, kɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra te, wedɛɛɡaa ɛ ba kembɔr.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra naanaree dɛɛ di ba kapɛrɛre, kɛ nɛnchɔɡa te kapɛrɛre dɛ kaa nɛra ba wa aa toɡra be.
Dɛ nyaa koo kondikwaa ɛo kohona naa, nɛnchɔɡa ɡelɔ aa le o nɔn ta.
He dɛ fah he bie nyu aa, dɛ haa on nyin, kɛ dɛ he dɛ nyinu waa, he do sie dɛɛ kaoh buɡ ta.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra di kwaa o baah ɛɛ sɔɔhno, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te dɛ chɔ lɔr saŋ bɛlbwa.
Hanwejeremee dɛɛ vɔwɛ dea, kɛ hanɡɛnee yon dɛɛ paɡre dea.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra laanee dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ neɡre nɛraa wola Korowii kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Gɛne mbarafo wobol taa a che wɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra, asɛ wejereme wobol ɡe ɛɛ leo waa ta.
Bela baa kpɔ nae dɛɛ parɛ la, dɛ nae toole naa, kondikwa aa le do.
Kɛ nae lɔ bela tenaa, kondikwaa dɛ bu.
Nɛn waa dɔ kasinteŋ la aa nyosone teŋe, nɛn waa dɛ di dansewea la, nyosone ɡboo o bwa.
Nɛn waa dɛ mamɛ wejemwaa la aa waa jemɛ, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun te, dɛ́ jemɛ waa warane.
Laa he te kpɔ ɡɛne nɛ, waa won baɡle wobɛlbwa.
Wejereme jemɛ waa aa wera kɛ o ɛ. Gɛnee yon dɛɛ neɡre o nyu kɛ o jemɔ.
Gɛna waane laa wechɔɡa baa ɛ wa, nɛra ba wa aa toɡraa yon dɛɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ jemɛ waa aa dɛ ha o dɔŋ, kɛɛ ɡɛ o silɛɛ aa doa.
Nɛnchɔɡe dem dɛ chole, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra dem te dɛ che le.
Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o soɡa waa soɡa la ken wer, kɛ dɛ aa were, o ka tona la ɛ seo.
Mama bɛl ɡelɔ tebinichɔɡ ɛɛ le nɛn nɛ, asɛ silɛɛ bɛl habɔɔ ɡe ɛɛ berɛ wii.
Nɛn waa ɡel wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra, nɛndɛɛɡa ɡe ɛɛ dɔ ba we-ɛɛla kembɔr.
Gɛnee yon dɛɛ yarada wobɛlbwa waa dɛ no, kɛ wejereme te dɛ́ nyiŋi o vala bini.
Wejereme dɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ o soɡa bini kɛ o bɛ waa dɔ.
Gɛnee dɛɛ ɛ waa saɡasaɡa, o baah ɛɛ di warawara.
Nɛn o baah aa wola biɡri dii dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛnewa, wejeremee dɛɛ lawɛ bambile.
Nɛn ta wejema dɔe yaa, a ɡelɔ wɛɛ ɡɛn kohona, kɛ nɛn waa jemɛ waa te ne wejemaa.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi nɛndɛɛɡa baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii siee.
Nyaa dɔŋ kwaraa laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ o nɛ, suuɡatee dɔ chamene tena warɛ.
Nɛn waa dɛ na nyaara sum la, o na som, kɛ a ɛ wechɔɡa kɛŋɔ he hah he dɔŋ, dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah.
He dɛ lii liichɔɡa aa, dɛ he kono, kɛ he dɔ liidɛɛɡa aa, nɛra dɛ yaradae, dɛɛ tɛɛ duure ɡe.
Koeh habɔɔ tɔnɔ do, kɛ nyoa wobol te, pɛɛpɛɛ dea aa la.
Wejereme kondɔɔh o wejema, asɛ ɡɛne ɡe we-ɛɛla ɡel baa jemɔ.
Kasinteŋ danseɛ dii dɛ́ lɛ nɛn nyu, dansewea tee dɛɛ le nɛn habɔɔ.
Baa waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii bwara dɛ sɔɔhno.
Wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ o haah ne bii nɛ.
Korowii ɔma do kɛ bule waa dɛ tɛ mkpa, anee dɛɛ le nɛn seo ŋwɛnɛre ta.
Nɛn nee baa di kora, nɛra toole naa, kora ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Nɛn o baah aa wola di warawara la, o dɛ no waa mun taeh, kɛ nɛn waa wola bambile dɔe la, o dɛ maŋkura o te ɡɛna ta.
Deŋnesɔɔhna dɛ tɛ bokpeɡa, kɛ bɔweela te, ɛ weela.
He dɛ do nyaara weweele aa, he dɛ chɛɡɛ Korowii waa ta ba, kɛ he dɛ ɛɛ ba kɛrɛdɛ naa, he dɛ tɛ Korowii jirima.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ we-ɛɛlaa dɛɛ ba o chɔɡa ne, nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɔ hwɛɡa, hale seo ta.
Nɛn waa dɔ liiree dɔ wejema, ɡɛnee wola wejema liire dɔe.
Harɛ bɛl ɛɛ dɔ sɔnee yaa, dɛ a cheɡɛ toɡra o nɛra aa toɡra ta, wechɔɡaa ɛ sihiih tɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra.
Kooro bɛlbwa siwi dɛ su o bonɔɔ waa jemɛ wa.
O dɛ tɛr onɔ la waa dɛ ɛ sihihwaa deŋne.
Tahaah dɛ sɔɔh bandia, takpeɡ ɡe ɛɛ ir bwaawee.
Wejereme wobol ɡelɔ wejema ɛɛ dɔ pɛla, ɡɛne ɡee dɛɛ bol waa warawara, wejema aa wola toole a ta.
Korowii dɛ na bobɛlbwa, o dɛ nyiŋi wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ne wedɛɡ-ɛɛra bwa.
Wobodɛɛɡa do kɛŋɔ tɛɛɡa ken, neɡra wobolee dɛɛ ku loo.
Gɛnee dɛɛ vɛh o mɛɛ wa, kɛ nɛn baa dɛ jao wɛɛ no la, dɛ jemɛ wa.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ dɔ kondɔɔh o dem, kɛ nɛnchɔɡa kwaa dɔe dɛ tɛɛ ba wa.
Wejerema wobol dɛ tɛ wejema, Gɛne wobolee wola won wobɛlbwa tɛ.
Korowii kii nɛnchɔɡa saraha, o dɛ no nɛra ba wa aa toɡra wesoŋa.
Korowii hah nɛnchɔɡa we-ɛɛla, O dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ waa aa toɡra ta.
He laa sie kpɔ wedɛɛɡa ta naa, he dɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra kohona, he kii kɛ ba bol waa baɡle naa, sewee hɛɛ dɔ.
Korowii dɛ na lalbɔɔ ne lalabwɛɛ waa bwa, a ta do kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini bambile bini.
Nɛn waa dɛ muɡli nɛra baah la, aa nɛn waa jao la waa nyin, waa nɛn waa jemɛ waa la be la.
Nɛn sie lɛo waa, o dɛ mamɛ, o loo kuu tenaa, o bambile dɛ chɔɡ.
Nɛra baa dɔ liire la pɛlaa dɛɛ lawɛ kɛŋɔ ba hweli waa dɛɛ ja, ɡɛnee dɛɛ do sie ɡɛnewaa ta.
Nɛra baa lɔ wahala ta la soɡa bini aa were, kɛ nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ la, do kɛŋɔ baa dɛ di kondikonjena saŋ bɛlbwa ken.
He dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ dɔ kwaa tama, bɔ kɛŋɔ haa dɔ kwaa kohona dɛɛ dɔ wa.
He di dɔkpɔɡa dɔr komɛlbwa aa wola toole a ta bela baa dɛ nyini, bɔ kɛŋɔ haa di nao waa do noo dɔr bela baa haeh.
Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di warane la dɛ ba naɡra ne, kɛ nɛn waa dɔ bambile te dɛ sɔɔh waa nyoa.
Bɔhwaah soɡa bini do kɛŋɔ, waa dɛ valɛ sɔɔhne ta, kɛ he waa toɡraa, he ŋwɛnɛ wer.
Bechawejereme ɡelɔ o mɛɛ baŋa ɛɛ pa, kɛ biɡɛne te hah o nya, dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah.
Nɛn waa wola liire dɔe la, ɡɛnewaa dɛ lɛ o sie, kɛ nɛn waa dɔ liire la waa toɡrɔ.
He maɡle waa dɛ he ta jajaa dɔe yaa, a dɛ chɔɡ, kɛ dɛ he dɔ jajaala waraa, a dɛ do wer.
He chaŋe waa aŋwɛnɛ ta naa, a dɛ ba silɛɛ ne dɛɛ tɛɛ.
Waa bola a saŋ ta wer ɡa.
Wejereme bɛlbwa dɛ kpɔ mkpa ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ laa o te dɛɛ kpɔ waa aa ba seo ne.
Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ mbarafo la, Korowii dɛ chɔɡ o dem, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ luhaahna kwaa ta.
Korowii kii nɛnchɔɡa liire, nɛndɛɛɡa liiree dɛɛ lɛ o sie.
Nɛn waa dɛ nyin kafo la kpɔ waa dɛɛ ba o ne dem tena nɛ, kɛ nɛn waa kia kɛ ba yawɔ sen la ɛɛ so lee.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa yon dɔ haŋra waa ta mɔɔ dɛɛ chaŋe, kɛ nɛnchɔɡee yon too wobochɔɡa ɛɛ le o nyoa.
Korowii ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛ baah jaŋne, o dɛ no nɛn o wa aa toɡra wesoŋa.
Dɔŋa be mama dɛ́ ba silɛɛ ne, asɛ amanesoma ɡe ɛɛ ba bokpeɡa ne.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no jae aa dɛ ba mkpa ne la, o ne wejeremaa dɛɛ pɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola jae no la ta o nyu, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ no jae la, o dɛ no waa mun.
Nɛn waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la dɛ jemɛ wa, he ta he te pwɛraa, haa jirima dɔ.
Nɛwɛnyinii dɛɛ maɡle wa, asɛ Korowii ɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ haa bola a do wer.
Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o we-ɛɛla wer o be, kɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi a bini.
Kpɔ he wobɛlbwa haa ɛ la do Korowii nɔn ta, ásɛ wobɛlbwa haa maɡla la do wer tɛɛ.
Wobɛlbwa Korowii aa ɛ la, dɛ waane waa dɛ nyin waa o ɛa.
O ɡelɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ so le, ka tel saŋ baa dɔ deŋnetɛra.
Korowii hah nɛn waa dɛ ɛ mbarafo, kpelaa, naate ɛɛ di bolchɔɡee dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra.
Nyina ne kasinteŋ taa wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ do.
Korowii ɔma ɡe taa nɛn che dɛɛ ke wechɔɡa.
Dɛ nɛn waa dɛ su Korowii siwi aa, o ɡelɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ɛɛ ba o ne o dɔma kwaraa baah ta.
Ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta cheɡa dɔ kontama wer, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta, dɛ dɔa kohona.
Nɛn nyubini liire nee wɛɛ maɡle wa, kɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ baɡle waa waa ɛ. Kooro nyoa wobol do kɛŋɔ Korowii waa ken, waa bole pae ta koni.
Korowii dɛ nyin kasinteŋ bona dii waa ta, a waa o ɡel kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ kari kwaa do le.
Kooro bɛlbwa kii wechɔɡa, waa aa toɡraa ɡela kora ɛɛ che.
Koranar siwi dɛ́ su nɛn waa dɛ bol kasinteŋ, ba dɛ nyin nɛn waa dɛ bol kpela.
Kooro baah diu waa, wɛɛ won ɡel ba kpoe, wejeremee jemɛ o larawa.
Kooro sie lɛo waa, a dɛ ba mkpa ne, a do kɛŋɔ sitɔ bwaala baama ken, a nɛo waa, kwaa dɛ do wer.
A wer kɛŋɔ haa dɔ wejema ne waa mun noe, dɛ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa dɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa!
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra la dɛ ke wechɔɡa o vala bini, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyiŋi o vala bini la, dɛ dɔ o nyu.
Mbarafo dɛ ba chɔɡa ne, asɛ maŋkurae ɡe ɛɛ ba harɛ lɔe ne.
He pwɛre he te dɛ nya bɔ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ he ne mbarafo tena aa bɔne laa ta kwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no waa la, dɛ́ dɔ kɛrɛdɛ, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ la, o na som.
Nɛn o liire aa wera dɛ dɔ wejema laanee ba ŋɔ o dɛ no waa mun.
O wobosoma taa a che nɛra sɛh dɛɛ ba o be.
Wejema do kɛ bule dɛɛ tɛ wejereme mkpa, asɛ ɡɛne ɡe deŋnetɛra ɛɛ leo o ɡɛnewaa ta.
Wejeremee lii waa mɔɔ dɛɛ bol, o wobol ɡelɔ nɛra sɛh dɛɛ ba o be.
Wobodɛɛɡa do kɛŋɔ tohnoo ken, a som nyoa ta dɛɛ tɛ bokpeɡa ɡe.
Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o soɡa waa soɡa la ken wer, kɛ dɛ aa were, o ka tona la ɛ seo.
Teabɔɔ ɡela nɛn ɛɛ ɛ toma, onee dɛɛ doo a ta.
Nɛnchɔɡee dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa, o wobol do kɛŋɔ ninlao ken.
Nɛnchɔɡee kpɔ waa dɛɛ perɛ, onee dɛɛ ba waa ne, dɛɛ peɡri daamanar baah.
Nɛn waa dɛ nyin yoi la dɛ faah o dɔŋ, o kpɔ o dɔŋ la dɛɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta.
Nɛn waa laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ waa ta la dɛ lii wechɔɡa, o dɛ tɔ nyoa nyiŋi wechɔɡa chiɡ.
Nyumpompoŋa ɛ jirima botire, nɛn o wa aa toɡra laanee dɛɛ dɔa.
Bambile dɔe wer ɡwaa banyoo tenten, he jemɛ he te lawa aa, a ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa yoa lɛ bwɛbir.
Nɛra dɛ ta bie dɛɛ nyin liire a ta, kɛ Korowiirii jemɛ ɡɛ aa chiɡ.
Kondikonchwee bosɔɔhna aa lɔ a ta, ɡwaa kondikondɛɛɡa naɡra aa lɔ a ta.
Yom waa jemɛ waa la, dɛ nyiŋi o dɔɔ bie o wa aa wola kɛrɛdɛ doe nɛ, o dɛ dɔ kapɛrɛ kwaa aa ɛ bii la kwaa la ane.
Niinii ba kpɔ dɛɛ jemɛ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ a wer, ɡɛɛ Korowii ɡe ɛɛ nyiŋi bambile bini.
Nɛnchɔɡee dɛɛ do deŋna wobochɔɡa ta, ɡɛɛ nyosonteŋni ɡe cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no musuwa.
He dɛ mamɛ nyaaraa, Korowii waa ta baa hɛɛ chɛɡɛ, ɡɛɛ a do dɛ he sie dɛ lɛ he dɔŋ wahala ta naa, hɛɛ ba deŋnetɛra kohona dɔe.
Banjeni ne hanjeni jirimaa ba naanar, ɡɛɛ nya ne mɛɛ ɡe jirima ɛ ba bii.
Mbarafo wobol aa were tɛ ɡɛne, ɡɛɛ a ta chɛ kɛ kooro teŋe nyosone.
Nɛn waa dɛ yawɛ nomɛl sen la, dɛ lii kɛŋɔ a ɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa kpɔ o ta dɛ vɔrɔwo.
O dɛ lii kɛ ɡɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel o wobɛlbwa do wer tɛo.
Nɛn waa laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ waa o dɔŋ aa ɛo ta la dɔ nyina.
A kpoŋa dɛɛ bol te dɛ peɡri darame.
Nɛn waa jemɛ wa dɛ́ hweli waa dɛɛ le webeŋkpoŋ haa bol baɡlo ta la, ɡwaa ɡɛne baa chao chweema kera lafa.
Nɛnchɔɡe waa dɛ nyin deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla ɡbo la nɛn waa wola nɛn sum naa baa tomɛ o be.
He cheme sisire baa pa o bii kaa bɔ ɡɛne waa lɔ o ɡɛne we-ɛɛla ta.
He kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ bɔ wedɛɛɡa kem aa, wechɔɡa aa he demii paŋɛ bwa.
Naɡra mumpar do kɛŋɔ haa teɡɛ nee bio, waa la aa wola dɔe do kan la, teŋe a ta mɔɔ a kaa sie.
Korowii hah nɛn waa dɛ pa nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ bolchɔɡe, dɛ hah nɛn waa pa nɛn waa ɛ wechɔɡa boldɛɛɡe ɡe.
Tɔnɔ besoo a dɔ kɛŋɔ ɡɛne kpoŋe suuɡa dɛɛ nyin wejema dɛ o ta a liire dɔe yɔ?
Darame dɛ baɡle nyina saŋ bɛlbwa, asɛ lolanar ɡe do le tɛ dɔŋa chae waa ta.
Gɛnee di ajinamuu dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin naɡra sie dɛ lɛ wechɔɡa ta, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ ta nyoa ɛɛ kaa chɔɡa ta.
Nɛnchɔɡe waa kpɔ waa dɛɛ perɛ, aa andɛɛɡa dɔ, ɡɛɛ nɛn o nyondoŋe aa bar o nyu la ɛɛ na wa.
Biɡɛne lola dɛ we, silɛɛ toole tɛ o mɛɛ.
Silɛɛ dɛɛ tɛ bokpeɡa, asɛ lokua ɡee sɔɔh nɛn.
Nɛnchɔɡee ba sɔh dɛɛ yawɛ sen, asɛ wɛɛ berɛ waa sie.
Wejereme sie lɔ wejema ta saŋ bɛlbwa, ɡɛnee wola wobɛlbwa dɔe dawɛ o sie ta.
Biɡɛnee wola ɡelɛ o mɛɛ sie ɛɛ lɛ, onee ɡela o nya tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡ.
A ta maɡrɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn ɛ kɛrɛdɛ ba tɛr o deŋne, kɛɛ dɛ lɔɔ nomonome baa dɛ di kasinteŋ.
Wejereme wobol lɔ tamaa ken, nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun la jemɛ o te lawa.
Hale ɡɛne tɔ o nyoa so naa, ba dɛ liiru wejereme.
Nɛn waa wola nɛra baah jo la waane laa nomɛlbwa wa, o dɛ lɛ ɡaeh, waa nɛn waa lɛɛ dɛɛ do.
Gɛne waane laa waa mun noe, o waa bwaa kɛŋɔ o ɡe baɡle o wejema.
Nyubinikpeɡii dɛɛ ba nɛn bɛ bua ne, sihiih ɡe ɛɛ ba ncho dii ne.
Nɛn nyoa wobol do kɛŋɔ nee waa luŋa ken, wejema leebɔr do kɛŋɔ nee waa dɛ palɛ.
Aa were kɛŋɔ bá nyiŋi nɛnchɔɡe siebɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ bolchɔɡe tɛ nɛn waa wola bolchɔɡe dii.
Gɛne wobol dɛ ba naɡra ne, o nyoa wobolee ɡela baa lɔɔro.
Gɛne wobolee dɛɛ chɔɡo, o nyoa dɛɛ doo waa ta.
Nɛn ŋwala som, a do kɛŋɔ kondikonsoma aa dɛ jo tea.
Bɔhwaah aa toma ɛɛ nyin, o dɔŋee nɛn waa dɛ chɔɡ kwa.
Korowii do kɛŋɔ dejaŋ waa kpeɡa, belaa nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa chwa dɛɛ kaa wɛɛ lɛɛ ba.
Kondɔɔhna dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba kondɔɔh do kɛ bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro, ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o ɛ kon waa dɛ ba wona lɛɛ ba.
Maŋkurae nɛn aa dɛ maŋkura o te laanee dɛɛ ba o harɛ lɔe ne, pwɛra waa dɛ pwɛr o te ɡe ɛɛ tɛo jirima.
A ɛ ɡɛnewaa dɛ dɔ sihiih kɛŋɔ haa wola waa mun noɛ dɛɛ chaŋe.
Liire haa dɔ he weela ta kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɡbaŋroo la, dɛ ɛ ɡɛ, dɛ he ta ɡɛ liire dɔe yaa, dɛ hwɛɡa toole.
Wejerema dɔ liire kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ hweli waa, baa cheɡ deŋnee dɛɛ no wa.
Koŋkɛɛla pili ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ tɛ nɛn, a ɡelɔ wɛɛ jo nomonome bini.
Suune anɛ ta sie yaa, haa nyosom te jemɛ.
Nɛn tɔ sie bɔ on koro aa, nɛra dɛ lii kɛ o waa toɡrɔ.
Nemenɛ o dɔŋ baa baɡle o waa bini mɔɔ.
Waa lɔ nɛra banɛ ba waa aa kpeɡa baah ta naa, Korowii siee ba kpɔ dɛɛ bil wɛɛ baɡle a kasinteŋ.
A kpeɡri kɛŋɔ he won kwaa he ne he dam haa ɛo wechɔɡa baah, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa paɡre danjwɛkpeɡ baa maa bar bwɛjen.
Naɡra do kɛŋɔ bune baa kpɔa kaɡre bwɛjen doonyoa la.
He bol wedɛɛɡaa, he dɛ vaɡɛ kɛŋɔ haa di kondikondɛɛɡa ken, wobol aa wera ɡelɔ he baah ɛɛ sɔɔhne.
Nyoa wobol dɛ ba seo ne mkpa ne.
Anomanta, nyiŋi he nyoa wobol bini kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ bɛ waa dɔ.
He dɔ haah naa, dɛ he dɔ kondɛɛɡe, a dɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii chae.
Nyaa dɛ bol wa aa, o kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ soŋe, kondɔɔhnee dɛɛ chaŋe waa kpeɡri nɛ.
Chamene tena kpɔe kohona dɛ chɔɡe, kɛ damsom bɛl ɡwaa lole.
Nyaa o bwara aa wola wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɔe la, ɡwaa nyosonteŋni waa ɡɛna.
Aa were kɛŋɔ nɛn nya wejema, ɡɛɛ dɛ haa waa bini nyiŋi dɛɛ ɛa warawara ɡe aa, hɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Nɛŋɡɛnee dɛɛ chɔɡ o te, kɛ o yon berɛ kpɔ nya Korowii nɛ.
Dɔɔh daamanaree dɛɛ warɛ, nyaa daamanaree yon chwao.
He di dansewea aa, he dɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra, ɡɛɛ nyosonteŋni ɡe aa wola o bwara kpɔe kaa di.
Nɛra ɡalɡa takapɔ kɛŋɔ ba waa ɛɛ lɛ nɛnjen sie, ɡɛɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe ɛ nɛn waa dɛ kɛ kwaa dam.
He nyao waa, he lolanar dɛ́ vɛɛh, n baa bol he daamanar wa.
He dɔ waa dɛɛ nyin ba bɔr aa, haa ban na.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ wejema la, dɔ nyina tɛ o ɡbaɡba, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun la, o wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do wer.
Dansewea te dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra, ɡɛɛ nyosonteŋni ɡe ɛɛ sewɛ.
Yɛɛra ta ɡɛne chɛɛ, ɡɛɛ yom ɡe aa wola chɛɛ kɛ nomonjena do o lɔɡa.
Wejeremee won bambile lawa, o dɛ dɔ jirima waa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ ta.
Kooro bandia do kɛŋɔ nyujente aa sia ken, asɛ o silɛɛ ɡe do kɛŋɔ mɛn aa ta kpɔɡa ta ken.
Bibaa waa ɡɛna dɛ́ tɛ o mɛɛ wa, asɛ hannaɡrenyini we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ nee aa dɛ kor la ken.
Dem ne suuɡaa baa ne o haah sewɛ dɛɛ ɡel o bii, kɛ handɛɛɡe te, Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ.
Bɔhwaahree dɛɛ chɔ dom kohona, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa wola waane ɛɛ nyin la ɡe ɛɛ chɔ lɔr.
Nɛn waa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii Mmara ta la, o dɛ dɔ o nyu, nɛn waa wola a ta teŋɛ la, ó dɛ sewɛ.
Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ nyaa kɛrɛdɛ la, Korowiirii o kpɔ dɛɛ kemɛ, waa waa ɛa la, o dɛ tɛo a nachiɡe.
Kah he bii, ba nɛɛ he dɔ hwɛɡa kerekere, dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, hɛɛ ɡeloo ba chɔɡ.
Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di kohona dɔ wa aa, bɛ on lɛ, ɡel a noo, ɡɛ laa aa hɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ lɛo.
Ba dɛ jae naa dɛɛ no, dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta, ásɛ tɔpebɛl he ba dɔ wejema.
Nɛn won waa maɡla kohona, kɛ anɔ la Korowii aa dɛ nyin laanee dɛɛ ɛ. Kɛrɛdɛ nɛn aa dɛ ɛ waa ba teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin o wa, nɛn nyao bɔ kɛŋɔ waa dɛ teŋe nyosone.
Korowii ɔmaa dɛɛ ba mkpa ne, anee ɡela nɛn liire ɛɛ chɔ bobeŋkpoŋ o bwara ɛɛ sɔɔhno.
Nɛra bane bɔhwaah ɡwaa ba nɛɛ kɛ, bá won kpɔ kondikwaa kwaraa la nyoa.
Bammuɡli nɛn dɔ deŋnetɛra aa, nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ hweli waa dɛɛ le a ta, ɡɛɛ ba baɡle wejereme waa, wɛɛ jemɛ wa.
Bechala waa dɛ fiiɡi o mɛɛ, dɛ doŋi o nya dɛɛ le dem la, o ɛ sihihbie.
N bie, he dɛ vɛh waa baa dɛ doe a ta hwela aa, hɛɛ le wejema ŋwɛnɛ taa.
Dansewea tee kpɔ o dɔŋ kasinteŋ waa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, ɡɛɛ wechɔɡa ɛɛ do wechɔɡ-ɛɛ som kɛ kondikwa.
Deŋnetɛra chɔ le kpa bammuɡli nɛn, ɡɛɛ lɔɔra ɡe do le tɛ ɡɛne.
Sen nyɔe kohona ɡelɔ nɛn ɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa dɛɛ ɡɛn.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ a nyɔe berɛ o toma la ta liire dɔe.
Kooro bandia do kɛŋɔ nyujente aa dɛ si ken.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ doo bwaawee la dɛ ta o nyu.
Baa bɛlbwa jirimaa kɛŋɔ o laa o te kpɔ naɡra we-ɛɛla ta, ɡɛnee dɛɛ nyin yoi.
Paa waa dɛ ɛ bɔhwaah kwaa para saŋ la, ɡɛɛ waa wola kondikwaa dɔ a koma saŋ ɡe.
Waa aa lɔ nɛn liire bini do kɛŋɔ bule waa luŋa bini nee ken, naate waa dɔ wejema laanee won nee la dɔe.
Nɛra ɡalɡa dɛ bol ŋɔ ba dɔ nyina saŋ bɛlbwa, kɛ umee dɛ́ won jemɛ nɛn o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ ɔ?
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra o bwara aa wola wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɔe la, o seo habɔɔ, o bii dɛ na som.
Kooro soɡe o kookara ta dɛ́ bol waa dɛ́ pa bole aa, o dɛ na anɔ la aa wola were.
Umee dɛ́ won ŋɔ, “N te tea bini too, wechɔɡa toole n nɛ kwaraa nɔ?” Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ faah nɛra kwaa yoɡa ta, ne kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwaa o faah la.
Bechala we-ɛɛla taa ba che dɛɛ jemɛ kɛ o ɛ bechadɛɛɡe.
Deŋna nɛn aa kpɔa dɛɛ no waa nɔ, ne sibie waa dɛ na a ne nɔ, Korowiirii ta a bwa.
Dom dɛ do he som kohona naa, nyae hɛɛ nya, he iro dɛɛ ɛ toma aa, kondikwaa dɛɛ bu he nɛ.
He yon ŋɔ kon yoɡ aa were, dɛ berɛ kaa maŋkura he te o yawa ta.
Dɛ he jemɛ waa haa dɛ bol aa, he dɔ kon ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋ.
Nomɛl di hɔɔh ajinamuu he be naa, lɛ o yal cheɡ, dɛ naate ta he bini bɛl ɛɛ yaa, lɛ o komɛl cheɡ awɔba.
He kpɔ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ lɛ kwaa di aa, a som, kɛ a habɔɔ la, a dɛ do kpeli he nyoa bini.
Wobɛlbwa haa maɡla la, ɡel ba jae mɔɔ he ɛ. Nyin ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe mɔɔ dɛ vɔrɔwe laa.
Nɛn waa dɛ ɡaaɡe la dɛ taa nyokpɛl, anomanta, laa he te kpɔ nɛn waa dɛ bol waa kohona nɛ.
He taah he nya kɛɛ he mɛɛ aa, he piɡro dɛɛ sewɛ kɛŋɔ kandea aa dima biro ta la.
Dɛ he ta koɛh dɛ dɔ he te mumpar aa, a habɔɔ la, aa hen kɛrɛdɛ chiɡ.
Bɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ bɔ wechɔɡa kem, dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ o ɛ wobɛlbwa tɛɛ.
Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ faah nɛra kwaa yoɡa ta, ne onɔ la baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwaa dɛɛ faah nɛn.
Korowiirii kpɔ ya nakpale ɛɛ cheɡ bela waa wera, ɛrɛɛ nɛn ɛɛ ba wona jemɛ o vala bini nɔ?
He toolo baɡɛ Korowii nyoa aa, a ɛ bel dɛ chɔ kpae, a habɔɔ a ba ɛ waa dawɛ he nɛ.
Kooro waa jemɛ waa laanee yon na nɛnchɔɡe, dɛ yon tɛr o deŋne waa wola o sum na.
Korowii hweera waa hweera do nɛn bini la, do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah waa aa lɔ ya liire bini.
Nyina ne kasinteŋ ɡelɔ Kooro ɛɛ biɡri, nyina taa a che o kora ɛɛ che.
Bonɔɔ bokpeɡaa ɡela o dɔ jirima, ɡɛɛ nyumpompoŋa ɡel banjeni ɛɛ dɔ duure.
Deŋnetɛra kohona won wechɔɡa laa dɛ́ kpɔ nɛn bambile ta.
Kooro bɛlbwa liire lɔ Korowii nɔn ta, kɛŋɔ nɛn yon pere bɔr tɛ nee wɛɛ kpɔ o ta la.
Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o wobɛlbwa toɡrɔ o be, kɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi a bini.
We-ɛɛla aa wera dɛ toɡre, dɛ su Korowii siwi ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa ɛ saraha tɛo.
Sisa we-ɛɛla ne mbarafo, ne wedoŋa bwa ɛ wechɔɡa.
Nɛn waa dɛ maɡle waa kɛrɛdɛ la dɛ́ dɔ kwaa taeh, kɛ he too waa ta naa, nyae hɛɛ nya.
He kpɔ nyosone ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ dɔ kwa aa, a dɛ le he nɔn ta kɛŋɔ peu ken, dɛ́ berɛ ba seo ne.
Nyubinikpeɡ te naɡrenyinii dɛɛ chɔɡo, o dɛ vɛh waa aa wera ɛɛ.
Nɛn waa di waa ane bolchɔɡe la, o wobɛlbwa aa toɡre, kɛ nɛn waa di bole la soɡa bini toɡrɔ.
He ɡbo soɡe saldoa bɔ kɛ he ne hannaɡrenyini aa pɛ dem.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ te bɛlbwa dɛ nyin wechɔɡa taeh, waa o dɔŋ nɛɛ sune.
Bammuɡli nɛn dɔ deŋnetɛra aa, ɡɛne hweli waa dɛɛ le a ta, ɡɛɛ ba baɡle wejereme wa aa, wɛɛ jemɛ wa.
Korowii O Wa Aa Toɡra jemɛ waa aa lɔ nɛnchɔɡe dem.
Wɛɛ tɛr o deŋnee.
He laa deŋna kpɔ nyaa wii waa dɛ wi ta naa, he ɡe ɛɛ baa wiu, haa nɛnee dɔ ó lɛɛ.
Dɛ nomɛl baah di he nɛ, he sɔh kpɔ kon kɛo waa, a ɡelɔ o baah ɛɛ sɔɔh.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra la, ba bol kasinteŋ aa, o sie dɛ lɛ, dɛ ɛ ɔmee kohona tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.
Nɛn waa kona le wejema ŋwɛnɛ ta la, sewaa wɛɛ sewɛ.
He dɛ nyin silɛɛbɔra kohona naa, nyae hɛɛ nya.
Gɛɛ dɛ he dɛ nyin sen ne kondikondɛɛɡa aa, a do dɛɛ tɛɛ.
Nyubinikpeɡ te dɛ nyin nɛn o wa aa toɡra ne wechɔɡa aa, a dɛ ɡure o nɛ.
Baa ɡbo soɡo bɔ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ waa mo hannaɡrenyini o baah aa dɛ di kohona.
Nɛn waa jemɛ waa la dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh ne kondɛɛɡa, kɛ ɡɛnee dɛɛ chɔɡ o kwa.
Nɛn waa teŋɛ waa aa toɡra ta, dɛ dɔ nyina ɡe la, o dɛ biɡri, o wobɛlbwa ɡe ɛɛ do wer wɛɛ dɔ jirima.
Nɛn waa jemɛ waa la won bwɛjen bokpeɡa tena aa lɔ o ta yoi, dɛ́ paɡre ba dekpeɡa baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta.
He jemɛ he nyoa lawa aa, haa waa dɔ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ maŋkura o te la dɛ́ ɛ mbarafo.
O ɛ bammuɡli nɛn o we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ɡwaa kohona.
Bɔhwaah pɛla konee dɛɛ kpoo, dɛkalkɛ waa toma ɛɛ nyin.
O sie dɛ beɡre kohona o dɔ kwaa dɛɛ ja tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra la te ta tea dɛɛ tɛ kon, waa nɔn nyore.
Korowii kii nɛnchɔɡe saraha, n baa bol kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ liichɔɡa ɛa.
Dansewea te dɛ sewɛ, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no o be la ɡe sewɛ.
Nɛnchɔɡe dɛ ɛ o siebɔr kɛŋɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe, nɛn o wa aa toɡra te dɛ́ nyiŋi o waa bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Nɛwɛnyini wejema ne waa mun noe, dɛ wejaala ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, dɛ Korowii ta o nɛɛ jae yaa.
He dɔ jaɡre ɡɛ bɛlbwa dɛ won kpɔa yo aa, Korowiirii dɛ won ɡel he yo le.
Sɔndɛɛɡee chɛ nyina ɡwaa kondɔɔh tenten, ɡɛɛ duure do wer ɡwaa suuɡapoŋ kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm.
Suuɡate ne nyaa bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ Korowii be.
Onee ta ba bwa.
Wejereme dɛ na waa aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba dɛ fel dɛɛ kea, nɛn waa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛɛ yon ka jo a ta dɛɛ na wa.
Ɔmɛ Korowii, pwɛr he te, hɛɛ dɔ kwaa ne jirima ne mkpajaŋee.
Nafuɡere ne sɔɔhne lɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ŋwɛnɛ ta, he dɛ nyin he nyu aa, laa he te kpɔ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta.
Do he bie kɛrɛdɛ waa aa wera ta, ásɛ dɛ o baa kpeɡ aa, o bɛ an ɡel.
Gɛ suuɡate aa dɛ di kpeɡri nyaa nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa di kem la ɛ nɛn waa kemɔ suuɡa la bonɔɔ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la dɛ na a wa, nɛra waa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la dɛ ba a jaɡa.
Nɛn waa dɔ tesom dɛɛ tɛ nyaara kondikwa la, Korowii ɡelɔ wɛɛ na som.
Doŋi bammuɡli nɛn le he jwɛh, ásɛ wobobala ne naɡra ne chɛɡa bwa tonɛ.
Dɛ he dɔ bambidɛɛɡe dɛ jemɛ wobol aa, kooro dɛ kpɔe dam.
Korowii dɛ nyiŋi nomɛlbwa waa dɔ wejema, dɛ taɡɛ nyosonteŋni waa dɛɛ ta.
Bɔhwaahree yon ŋɔ, “Nyujente lɔ dahare!” Kɛɛ, “O ken ɛɛ kpo mɛ fɔɡbaahnaa!” dɛɛ so dem.
Hanjwamane wobol do kɛŋɔ bɔluŋ ken.
Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ Korowii bandiwaa la dɛ le o bini.
Gɛnewa lɔ bechala bɛlbwa bambile ta, kɛ dɛ he kpɔ chweema toɡro waa, o dɛ jemɛ wa.
Nɛn waa ɛɡre nyaara dɛ dɔ kwaa dɛɛ ja la, ne onɔ la waa kpɔ kwaa dɛɛ kɛ dɔɔhna la, ba bwa dɛ nya.
Wejerema waa baa bola Cheɡ deŋne dɛ no nɛn waa jemɛ waa wobol, dɛ́ hweli waa maa dɛ baɡle nɔ.
A wer kɛ he kpɔ do he nyu bini, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ bol wa.
N ɡelɔ hɛɛ jemɛ fini, ɡɛ aa ɛ he kpɔ he hwɛɡa bwa do Korowii nɛ.
N chwerɛ webele fifraatoro dɛ tɛɛ, wejaala ne wejema lɔ a ta.
A taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ kasinteŋ, dɛ́ kpɔ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa tomɛ.
Bɛ he dɔŋ nyae waa koh dɛ́ ɛɡro lɛ komɛl.
Bɛ o nɛɛ nya, ásɛ dɛ bol waa bɔɔ kɔɔto.
Korowii ɛɛ bol a ɡɛ nɛra la waa tɛɛ ba, ásɛ ɡɛ haa lɛɛ ba kwaa la, ó lɛ le he be.
He ne nɛn o baah aa dɛ di kohona bɛ darame di.
He ne nɛn o baah aa wola biɡri dii bɛ pɛ, ásɛ he ba hwelu dɛ́ le a ta kahonɛ.
Bɛ nɔn kpɔ ɛɡɛ tɔn ta tɛ nomɛl, kɛɛ dɛ di ajinamuu tɛo.
Dɛ he ta komɛl bwa dɔe dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ aa, baa won lɛ he kalaŋ haa dɛ chɔ o ta ɡba.
Bɛ harɛ jwɛh he naawa aa bilu la laa kpɔ.
Nɛn waa jemɛ nɔn toma kɛrɛdɛ la, koranar tomaa wɛɛ ɛ, waa nɛnsale toma ɛ.
Dɛ he ne nomonjen dɛ ba kwaa dii yaa, nyiŋi he waa bini kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ he ɛ kafonyini aa, jemɛ he te lawa.
Bɛ ɡel he pɛla do o kondikondɛɛɡa la ta, a ken ɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa kpɔ neɡre.
Bɛ kondɔɔh waa koh dɛ́ chɔɡ he te, ɡel a ɡɛ liire la, dɛ́ jemɛ he te lawa.
Kondɔɔh won hee kelo kɛŋɔ komɛl yon ɡale he sie ta la, a won ɛɛ kɛŋɔ kee kena yon moɡɛ ó ir kaa la.
Bɛ nɛn o tea bini aa kpela kondikwaa ba di bwa, bɛ ɡel he pɛla do o kondikondɛɛɡa ta.
Gɛ naate la liire aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o ɡbaɡba do.
Wɛɛ ŋɔ he bee ŋɔ, “Di he tea bwa.” Kɛ dɛ o bambile bwa ne laa.
Vaɡa haa vaɡa la, hɛɛ chwɛɛroo, ásɛ he wobosoma haa bola la yon ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Bɛ waa bol ɡɛne be koh, o dɛ lii waa aa lɔ a ta la wesale.
Bɛ saŋ la jwɛh waa chɔ le la laa kpɔ, bɛ bilalbii harɛ lɛ.
Ba dɔ nomɛl waa cheɡɛ ba habɔɔ, onee Korowii, wɛɛ boloo bɔe.
Cheɡ deŋne no wa, ásɛ dɛ hweli wa.
Bɛ sie laa kpɔ bechala doe ta, he kpɔ chweema dɛɛ tɛr o deŋne aa, waa sewɛ.
Dɛ he kpɔ chweema tɛr o deŋne aa, o nyuu hɛɛ lɛ.
N bie, dɛ he jemɛ wa aa, n baah ɛɛ sɔɔh mɛɛ.
Aa do n somee kɛ maa noa kɛ he dɛ bol waa aa toɡra.
Bɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bɔweela ɛ, ɡel Korowii duura swɛɛ he siwi saŋ bɛlbwa.
Wedɛɛɡa ane chɔ le kerekere dɛ tɛɛ, he hwɛɡa aa pɛɛ ta bwa.
N bie, no dɛ́ che a ta jemɛ wa, ásɛ he sie chɔ harɛ he soɡa bini.
Bɛ sennyɔɔra nɛɛ ja, he ne banɔ la baa dɛ di kondikombala la bɛ pɛ.
Sen nyɔe ne kondibala te, nyae nee aa ba, ɡɛɛ dom chɔe kohona ɡe ɛɛ ba yakwane tɔe ne.
Dɛɛ no he mɛɛ deŋna wa, onee lolɛ, he nya ɡe baa hwɛɛhraa, bɛ on nyiŋi vah.
Lawɛ kasinteŋ bini kpoŋe dɛ bɛ kpɔ ta, nyin wejema ne waa hwela dɛ waa mun noe.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra mɛɛ sie dɛ lɛ, nomɛlbwa waa lolɛ biwejereme la, sie dɛ lɛ o nɛ.
Gel he nya ne he mɛɛ sie ɛɛ lɛ, he nya te fanfa.
N bie, cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ n da.
Hanjwamane do kɛŋɔ bel, haah waa le o jaa habɔɔ do kɛŋɔ bɔluŋ.
O kpɔ o te dɛɛ sɔh kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ ken, dɛ ɡel baala le ba haahna habɔɔ dɛɛ ba o be.
O lawɛ ba nyuune dɛɛ lɔ dɔŋa.
Umee dɛɛ na waa kɛɛ dɛɛ wi suna ɔ?
Umee lɔ wobobala ne naɡra ta nɔ?
Umee ba do bol pɛɛpɛɛ ɔ?
Ume sibie swɛɛra ɔ?
Nɛra baa soɡe sen mun dɛɛ biɡri, kɛɛ dɛɛ daɡɛ sen baa koora a do kpeɡri la.
Bɛ ɡel sen a nyɔe aa soma, a sie swɛɛ dɛɛ wure numol bini neɡre.
A habɔɔ la, a do kɛŋɔ domkpule aa choɡe ken.
Hɛɛ na musuwaa, ásɛ he liire ɛ sakaa.
He sie ɛɛ birii kɛŋɔ haa soɡe ɡbera ta vil sie ken, kɛɛ haa chɔ ɡbera bini nehɛma ɛɛ lɔ la ken.
Hɛɛ boloo ŋɔ, “Ba lɔ mɛ, kɛ ba ta men bol doe.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Ba lɔɔ mɛ, kɛ maa jemɛ.
Saŋ besoo mɛɛ ba ira dɛ́ ka nyin sen nyɔ jaɔ?”
Bɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bɔweela ɛ, bɛ ɡel he pɛla lawɛ kɛ he ne baa pɛo.
Waa ba liire yon do a ta laanee naɡre wa, ba wobol ɡe ɛ bichɔɡwa.
Wejema nee baa do dem, asɛ waa mun noe ɡel wɛɛ che.
Wejema taa a che deene aa lɔ dem bela la su kondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.
Nɛn o kwa aa chaahna dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa kohona, asɛ nɛn waa jemɛ wa ɛɛ di kpeɡri.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé maɡle he waa kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ yo laa.
Gɛɛ a do dɛ he dɔ jajaala kɛrɛdɛ waraa, hɛɛ ba wona yo le.
Wejemwobol mun noe kpeɡri tɛ ɡɛne kɛŋɔ ó won no a mun.
Bwɛɛla chemo dɛɛ bol wa aa, waa won ane bol.
Nɛn waa dɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa la, nɛnchɔɡee baa yerɔ.
Gɛne wemaɡla bɛlbwa ɛ wechɔɡa, asɛ nɛn bɛlbwa ɡe hah bammuɡli nɛn.
Waa ba he nɛɛ dɛ he ta wone che kiŋkiŋ naa, dɛ he bokpeɡa aa kanɛ kpa.
Lɛ nɛra baa dɛ́ ba bá kpoora ba tepoŋ ne, bɛ che nyiŋ ba ba serewe.
Bɛ sie laa kpɔ waane ta, dɛ́ ŋɔ he waane laa.
Korowiirii jemɛ bambile bɛlbwa wa.
Wɛɛ bɔ bɛlbwa kemee ɡɛ waa ɛa.
N bie, tohnoo dɔ pɛla dɛ do som, anomanta, bɛ an vɛh.
Jemɛ kɛŋɔ wejema wer tɛ he wee, he dɔ wejema aa, he dɔ hwɛɡa he soɡa bini kerekere.
Bɛ he te ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛnchɔɡa yon vɔrɔwe vɔrɔwa, dɛ́ ka bar nɛndɛɛɡa deremi cheme, dɛ́ ŋwɛɛ ba la.
Waa pu nɛn o wa aa toɡra, o chole kera anuanɛ naa, o berɔ dɛɛ ir.
Kɛ dɛ wechɔɡa pu nɛnchɔɡe te naa, o dɛ lɔ harɛ.
