Waa pu he dɔm aa, bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ, o lɔ harɛ naa, bɛ ɡel a do he som.
A ba ɡɛ naa, Korowii ɛɛ nae, ásɛ dɛ laa o bandia kpɔ ɡɛ nɛn la nɛ.
Bɛ ɡel he baah di wechɔɡ-ɛɛra we-ɛɛla wa, bɛ ban bɔweela ɛ. Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe kerekere, wobɛlbwa toole o sie dawɛ a ta.
N bie, dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii ne he kooro, he ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba deŋnekpeɡ bɛ pɛ dɛ́ ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Wekpeɡa ane ɛɛ won piɡri le Korowii kɛɛ kooro la be dɛ ba.
Umee dɛ won jemɛ wahala aa le ba bɛlbwa be dɛ́ ba nɔ?
Wejerema waa ane ɡe ja Wejemwobol ane ɡee nɔ.
Nɛn siebɔr nyiŋa dɛ́ bol waa dɛ́ pa bole ta aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ.
He pa boldɛɛɡe te bolchɔɡe aa, harɛre nɛra bwa dɛ́ taahnee dɛ́ haeh.
He tɛr bolchɔɡe te deŋne aa, wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ, he dɔ sɔndɛɛɡe.
He chaŋe nɛn waa aŋwɛnɛ ta naa, a dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he ne o darame pɛo.
Nyin koo haa dɛ di o ta mɔɔ dɛɛ nyin bela haa kpɔ he nyu bil.
Bɛ waa haa wola he dɔŋ nɛɛ nae la danseɛ di, bɛ nyosone teŋe.
Bɛ ba lii ŋɔ, “Gɛ waa ɛɛ mɛ la, n ɡee ɛo anee, kɛɛ mɛɛ tɔɔ a welee.” N fɛrɛ bɔhwaah bɛl koo nyoa, n kpɔ ɡɛne bɛl daa koo ta.
Jabalnadaŋɛ ne kpɔɡa lɛ koo la bwa, bwea waa kpɔa ma danjwɛɛ baro la ɡe kuuɡi.
N nyiŋi koo la jeiih ken, dɛ lii waa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ kpɔ hweli wa.
Chɔe tama, dom chuɡla tama, nɔɔra fɔɔla dɛ́ so onɛ tama, he ne ŋɔe he ba jemɛ la, dɛ nyaa piɡri kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ aa kpoŋe dɔmkon dɛ́ ba che he nɛ.
Solomɔn sɛɡla ane ja Solomɔn sɛɡla ane Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea karakere aa nyiŋi a ta dɛ chwerɛɛ nɔ.
Ya kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ Korowii sɔeh waa kpɔ waane sɔh yaa, ɡɛɛ koranar ɡe dɔ duure pila baa pili waa dɛɛ nyiŋi a bini.
Gɛ haa wola won jemɛ nyundua jaŋne, ne harɛ bini luŋri la, ɡɛɛ haa wola won jemɛ kooro liire.
Laa doŋa kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ta, ásɛ nɛn waa jemɛ a toma kpɔ kwaa kondɛɛɡe.
Nɛnchɔɡa le kooro jwɛh aa, o kora ɛɛ cheo, toɡra o wa aa toɡra la wa.
Bɛ he te ɡɔɔ kooro sie, bɛ sobɔr nyin nɛnjena baah.
A wer kɛŋɔ kooro la ŋɔ, “Ba so n jwɛh,” ɡwaa kɛŋɔ waa iri, dɛ kpɔ he sobɔr tɛ nɛn waa ɡwaale.
Waa he ɡbaɡba aa naa la, bɛ too dɛ́ kpɔ kaa kɔɔto, ɡɛ laa dɛ he dɔŋ kaa di danseɛ bɔe naa, hɛɛ di sihiih.
Dɛ he ne he dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, he ne o ɡbo bola, dɛ bɛ ɡel a le baŋ.
A ba ɡɛ naa, baa bol he bwara wechɔɡaa, ásɛ nyanyini haa dɔa la tonɛ.
Wobol aa wera dɛ maɡre la, do kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm baa kpɔa di suuɡapoŋ ɡwini ken.
Nɛn waa dɛ no nɛn waa jemɛ waa wejaala la, a ɡwaa kwaa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛa.
Torome baa tomɔ o la dɛ baa bol kasinteŋ nɛn waa tomɔ be la, do kɛŋɔ nee aa dɛ sɔɔh baah, kwaa koma saŋ bɔr aa wɔba la ken.
Nɛn waa baɡɛ nyoa kɛ wɛɛ tɛ komɛlee waa wola tɛ la, o do kɛŋɔ baama ne peu aa wola bwaala ne ba ken.
Bambile dɔe ne tahaah won nomonjen liire bera, ɡɛɛ a won wekpeɡa ɡe sɔɔhna.
He dɔ tooh naa, di anɔ la aa maɡre he ne, a kohona dii ɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ weela.
Dɔŋ dem laŋa kohona dɛ peo, a che a ta o berɛ haeh kwara.
Nɛn waa di dansewea dɛɛ dawɛ o dɔŋ nɛɛ la, o do kɛŋɔ ɡuli kɛɛ kere kɛɛ hɛm waa nyɛɡa ken.
Dɛ he dɔ waa dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ he dam haa wola hwɛɡa o nɛɛ dɔe yaa, a do kɛŋɔ he nyen haa wola won kpɔ chaŋe kwa, kɛɛ he nakpala haa wola won valɛ o ta.
Nɛn waa aa puu o loo ku, ba ɡo yela dɛ larawe o bwara la, o dɛ naa kɛŋɔ haa laa o yal wur waa saŋ, kɛɛ haa kpɔ tɛɛɡa aa dɛ we do o ŋwɛr ta la.
He dɔm chɔ lɔr aa, tɛo kondikwaa ó di.
O ta nee dɔe dɛ́ nyɔ aa tɛo ane.
He ɛ ken aa, sihiih dɛ ba o kpoe o baŋa ɡole, Korowii tɛɛ a kembɔr.
Gɛ dɔŋ bwara waa bola aa dɛ ba bandia ne la, ɡɛɛ peu waa taa le bobɛl dɛɛ ba bwaala nee ne la do.
He ɡbo soɡe saldoa bɔ kɛ he ne hannaɡrenyini aa pɛ dem.
Gɛ he yon no amanesoma le bojaŋ a do he som la, ɡɛɛ nesɔn aa dɛ kpo nyɔɡre la ɡe do.
Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra kpɔ o te tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa, a do kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ doŋa do nee waa pala baa kaa ta ken.
Tooh kohona dii aa were, ɡɛɛ aa wola were kɛ he nyin sɔn kohona.
Nɛn waa wola won bambile lawɛ la, o do kɛŋɔ bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛɛ baro o kuuɡi la ken.
Gɛ ɡɛne aa wola kpɛɛra chɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ dombwea kɛɛ bwaala aa wola kwaa koma saŋ hiaeh.
Nyotaahna aa wola hen chɛɛ la, do kɛŋɔ jumbii aa dɛ ɡah aa wola daa ta joŋi la ken.
Chweema chɛ jaaɡɔ ne keeɡo, ɡɛɛ ɡɛne chɛ lɔɔra.
Bɛ he nyoa kpɔ do ɡɛne waa ta, ásɛ dɛ bɛ ba do kɛ on.
Chaŋe ɡɛne o ɡɛnewaa ta, ásɛ o jemɛ kɛŋɔ o ta wejereme ɛɛ.
He tomɛ ɡɛne aa, he nakpalee dɛɛ sɔɔhne, he bambile te aa hen sɔɔh.
Gɛ boobi aa wola won valɛ la, ɡɛɛ ɡɛne aa wola jemɛ sɛɡle.
He kpɛɛ ɡɛne aa, waa jemɛ.
A do kɛŋɔ haa vɔwɛ bwe ne taya tɔn pɛ, he ta bwe laa, waa kaa.
Gɛ sennyɔɔ aa wola won laa sɔɔh kpɔ o nɔn ta la, ɡɛɛ a do kpeɡri tɛ ɡɛne kɛ ó won sɛɡle.
Dɛ he bɔ ɡɛne waa ba dɛ kaa o bobɛl paa aa, dɛ a do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa ta hɛma ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ do nɛra bola ken.
Gɛ nyoate yon uɡe dɛ berɛ kaa dia la, ɡɛɛ ɡɛne teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛnewa.
Nɛn waa ɡɛna kohona la, hwɛɡa lɔ o nɛɛ ɡwaa nɛn waa dɛ lii kɛ o jemɛ wa, kɛ o ɡe aa jemɛ.
Bɔhwaahree yon ŋɔ, “Nyujente lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta, o lɔ fɔɡbaahna.” Anomanta, waa le.
Gɛ ɡbera aa cheɡɛ njinasoɔre ta dɛ ya dɛɛ tɔ la, ɡɛɛ bɔhwaah chɔ kalaŋ ta dɛɛ beɡre o te.
Nɛra bane bɔhwaah ɡwaa ba nɛɛ kɛ bá won kpɔ kondikwaa kwaraa la nyoa.
Bɔhwaah dɛ lii o te wejereme, kɛŋɔ o ɡwaa nɛra banuanɛ baa dɛ ba wona tɛ liidɛɛɡa.
Nɛn waa kpɔ o nyoa ɛɛ do nɛra waa aa wola o waa ɛɛ ta la, o do kɛŋɔ waa la fɔɡbaah, dɛ ka lawɛ nyoate deŋne.
Choɡla te waa dɛ ta hɛma nii naa lɔ a nyoa dɛɛ kpoo nɛra la, do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ neɡre o dɔŋ dɛ́ yon berɛ ŋɔ, hɛlaa wɛɛ hɛlɛ.
Gɛ nindaa hɔɔ tonaa, nii yon dime la, ɡɛɛ nɛn ŋwala ɡe toole naa, naɡra toole.
Gɛ hɔla aa dɔ nii, damara ɡe ɡel nii ɛɛ hɔ la, ɡɛɛ naɡrenyini ɡe ɛɛ ba naɡra ne.
Nɛn ŋwala som, a do kɛŋɔ kondikonsoma aa dɛ jo tea.
Nɛn dɛ bol o dɔŋ bwara wedɛɛɡe kɛ dɛ dɔ o liichɔɡaa, a do kɛŋɔ baa ɛ suuɡapoŋ bɔle vii habɔɔ la.
Nɛn o nyoa wobol aa soma, kɛ dɛ dɔ liichɔɡa la dɛ́ neɡre nɛra.
O wobol la dɛ do som, kɛ bɛ on yarada, liichɔɡa bwa soo siwii lɔ o nyu bini.
O ɛ o te kɛŋɔ ba bɛ on hah aa, o wechɔɡa ɛɛ le baŋee nɛra bwa na.
He kwi nafuɡe aa, he ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ le o bini.
He ɡbili bwe ŋɔ he ta he dɔŋ nɛ aa, wɛɛ berɔ ba he nɛ.
Nyosonteŋni hah nɛra waa teŋe nyosone dɛɛ dawɛ ba nɛ, ɡɛɛ neɡra wobol ɛɛ ba wechɔɡa ɡbo ne.
Bɛ waa haa ɛ kere kpɔ dɛɛ bol wa, haa jemɛ ɡɛ tɔɔ aa dɛ ba he pera.
Bɛ he te kpɛɛ, ɡel nɛra kpɛɛre.
Bwe ne hɛŋle bwa tɔɡre te, kɛ waa ɡɛne aa dɛ ba a ne la ɡwaa a bwa.
Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di wɛɛ tɔ waa wel la, o nyu bini kpeɡri dɛɛ chɔɡ wa, kɛ bɔweela te ɡwaalo.
A wer kɛŋɔ he di nɛn kasinteŋ nɛra baah.
A bɔ kɛŋɔ haa dɛ nyin o wa, he ta ɡelɛ o jemɛ.
He damdɛɛɡe dii kasinteŋ bɔ, kɛŋɔ he dɔm aa kpɔ nɔn dawɛ he vam ta.
Nɛn di kwaa vaɡɛ o tea aa, o waane laa tooh wa, ɡɛɛ nɛn lɔr aa dɛ kpoo la, koŋkpela ɛɛ do o som.
Gɛ jumbie yon ir le o kɔr ta dɛ kaa la, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa jo pua kaa dɛ ɡel o dem la do.
Konsɔɔhsoma sɔɔh ɡelɔ nɛn sie ɛɛ lɛ, ɡɛɛ dansom tenten ɡe liire waa tɛɛ la do.
Bɛ he chamenate kɛɛ he mɛɛ chamenate chwa.
He dam waa bɛne la ɡwaa lole waa lɔ bojaŋ, anomanta, dɛ waane pui naa, haa won la he lole be ŋɔ ó chae.
N bie, hweli waa dɛ jemɛ wa, ásɛ n baŋa pa, ń dɔ waa dɛ bol nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ mɛ nɛnsala la be.
Nɛn waa dɔ nfɛrɛ la, dɛ na waa aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba, dɛ yon ke o te.
Nɛn waa wola liire dɔe yon so nyiŋi a ba diu.
Lɛ nɛn waa cheɡɛ hɔɔh kem nyoa la yal bil, dɛ o di haah waa wola he bini bɛl ɛɛ ajinamuu aa, lɛ o yal bil.
Dɛ he felo chɔmbibi dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ chɔɔ he dɔŋ aa, a dɛ berɛ chɛɡa tɛ nɛn haa chɔɔro la.
Hannaɡrenyini do kɛŋɔ, bwaala aa dɛ wiri waa wola ɡel bwa.
Gɛ haa wola won kpoŋe peu, kɛɛ noo a mwɛɛ nɔn ta la, ɡɛɛ haa wola won larawe a ɡɛ haah la ó ɡel naɡra.
Gɛ buni aa dɛ sar buni la, ɡɛɛ chamene tena hweli waa dɛɛ le dɔŋa be.
Dɛ he nyiŋi fiɡ daa ta kɛrɛdɛ naa, he dɔ o nɔna dɛɛ di, ɡɛɛ dɛ bonɔɔ tomɛ o dɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, wɛɛ dɔ sɔn.
Gɛ nɛn nyiŋi nee ta o yon na ɡɛ o siebɔr aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o liire ɡe ɛɛ baɡle o nɛnsoo.
Gɛ nɛwɛnyini pɛla kwa aa wola tonɛ bwa la, ɡɛɛ lalabwɛɛ ɡe aa wola su bwa.
Nii taa ba kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm do dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ a wer, ɡɛɛ a che nɛn kpɛɛra ta, baa jemɛ o nɛnsoo.
Nɛn waa ɡɛna te, he lɔɔro ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwara noo, o ɡɛna ta lɔ o nɛ.
Nyiŋi he kondɛɛra ta kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ do sie a nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ suuɡa dɔe aa ɡɛ ka, ɡɛɛ kooɡbɛrɛ aa wola le chɔe dɛɛ tɛ naanar saŋ bɛlbwa.
Dɛ he kɛ kondɛɛra kondikwaa cheɡ, dɛ berɛ kɛ kpɔɡa aa lɔ deŋɡarere ta, mɔɔ anfala ɛɛ moɡaa, anee dɛ́ ɡel he dɔ yal tɔ le he peera ta, dɛ́ berɛ dɔ suuɡa le he boohna ta yawɛ harɛ.
Dɛ dɔ na-elnee kohona dɛɛ he haah ne bii, dɛ he toli, ba bwara do wer.
Nɛnchɔɡe dɛ chwa dɛ nomɛl aa on doŋi, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra baah suu kɛŋɔ nyujente ken.
Harɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa lɔ o ta la, o koranaree dɛɛ warɛ.
Kɛ harɛ waa dɔ nomonome baa dɔ wejema la, dɛ do kpeɡri dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ.
Kooro waa dɛ ɛ nyaara hɔhɔrɔwa la, do kɛŋɔ bwaala waa wola komɛlbwa kwaa ken.
Nɛra baa wola Mmara ta teŋɛ la, dɛ kpɛɛ nɛnchɔɡa.
Kɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Mmara ta la, hah nɛnchɔɡa.
Nɛnchɔɡaa wola waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ mun no, kɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii te dɛ́ no a mun kɛrɛdɛ.
Nyaa o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la, o bɔ suuɡa te o wa aa doŋa.
Biwejeremee dɛɛ teŋɛ Mmara ta, kɛ onɔ la o ne nɛnsale aa dɛ valɛ la te, kpɔ sihiih dɛɛ kpo o mɛɛ.
Nɛn waa dɛ kemɛ nɛra suuɡa, dɛ lɛ a nee kohona dɛ dɔ kondɔɔh la, o lɛa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa dɛ na nyaara sum.
Dɛ he vɛh Mmara ta teŋa aa, Korowii kii he wesoŋa.
He neɡre nɛndɛɛɡe dɛɛ kaa wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ ta naa, a dɛ di he ɡbaɡba.
Nɛn wobɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛɛ la, na som kerekere.
Suuɡa te dɛ lii o te wejereme, kɛ nyaa waa jemɛ waa la jemɛ ɡɛ naate aa doa.
Nɛndɛɛɡa baa di nomonome aa, nomɛlbwa sie dɛ lɛ, kɛ nomonchɔɡa balaa, ɡɛɛ nomɛlbwa hɔrɔme.
Nɛn waa dɛ tɔ o wechɔɡa ta la aa wer do, kɛ nɛn waa wona bol o kwaa dɛ ɡel a ɛɛ la, Korowii dɛ́ na o sum.
Nɛn waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la, o na som, kɛ deŋnekpeɡ te ɛɛ ba na waa taeh.
Nomonchɔɡe waa dɛ nyiŋi nɛŋɡwɛɡra la, o do kɛŋɔ nyujente kɛɛ sisire yon dɛɛ kɔɡre, dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ́ lawɛ la.
Kooro waa wola liire dɔe, o nyu bini do kpeɡri laanee dɛɛ fiiɡi o nɛra, kɛ onɔ la waa wola kafo nyin la dɛ́ dɔ mkpajaŋ.
Nɛn waa dɛ kpoo nɛra la, o ɡbaɡba bɔɔ wɛɛ kwi, bɛ on kah.
He waa bini wer aa, he dɛ dɔ he nyu, kɛ dɛ he waa bini ta toɡraa, he dɛ chole warane.
Paa waa swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ toma laanee, dɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa kohona, kɛ onɔ la waa teŋɛ wesale ta la te dɛ nya.
Nɛn waa dɛ bol kasinteŋ la, o dɛ na som taeh, kɛ nɛn o siwi aa swɛɛra kɛ o dɔ kwaa warane la ne wahalaa.
Siebɔr nyiŋa dɛ́ pa bole aa were, kɛ bane dɛ che komɛl tama waa dɔ di la ta, dɛ yon ɛ wechɔɡa.
Nɛn o siwi aa dɛ beɡre kwaa dɔe ta la, waa saŋ nyae aa ba o nɛɛ la te lii.
Nɛn waa bol waa baɡle o dɔŋ o charɛ la, o dɛ dɔ sɔndɛɛɡe ɡwaa nɛn waa kpɔ wobosoma dɛɛ neɡre o dɔŋ.
Haa ŋwɛ he nya kɛɛ he mɛɛ komɛl, dɛ ŋɔ he ta ŋwɛɛ ɛɛ la, dɛ henee ŋwɛɛ tenten.
Nɛn waa dɛ nyin kɛ o ɡbo ɛɛ dɔ la, dɛ́ ba wahala ne, kɛ nɛn waa kpɔ o te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ la soɡa bini dɛ do wer.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te ɛɛ dawɛ o ɡbaɡba liire ta la ɡɛnɔ, kɛ nɛn waa dɛ teŋɛ wejerema waa ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
Nɛn waa dɛ cha nyaara la, komɛlbwa aa on nya, kɛ nɛn waa laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ ba nɛɛ la, dɛ́ dɔ nyotaahna taeh!
Nomonchɔɡa baa di kora aa, ɡɛɛ nɛra hɔrɔme, ba le bela tenaa, dɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɔ bɔr dɛ di kora.
Dɛ he dɛ ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ saŋ bɛlbwa ba kaeh kahonaa, he ne ba jara la, dɛ he dɔ wa, haa a nyoa tɛɛɡaa dɔ.
Nɛndɛɛɡa baa di kora aa, nomɛlbwa sie dɛ lɛ, dɛ nɛnchɔɡa ɡe baa di aa, nomɛlbwa dɛ hime.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin wejema la, o mɛɛ sie dɛ lɛ, kɛ nɛn o ne haahna baa dɛ bɔ jwamane nyoa aa pɛa la, dɛ he o kondɔɔh.
Kooro waa dɛ di kasinteŋ la, o ɡelɔ harɛ la wobɛlbwa ɛɛ maɡre, kɛ onɔ la o sie aa dɛ lɛ kɛ baa yawɔ sen te dɛ paɡre harɛ.
Nɛn waa dɛ pa o dɔŋ la, dɛ́ harɔ bel.
Nɛnchɔɡe bɛlbwa wechɔɡaa dɛɛ lawɔ, kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te, silɛɛ ne hɛɡraa o bwa.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra la jemɛ waa aa wera tɛ nyaa, kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te waane laa o wa.
Wejeremee won waa larawa, kɛ bammuɡli nɛn te won waa ne bwɛjen ta bala.
Dɛ wejereme kpɔ ɡɛne la kɔɔto aa, ɡɛne la dɛ mamɛ dɛ́ do ɡbɔɡa, dɛ́ ba chɛɡa ne.
Nɛra baa dɛ kpo nɛra hah nɛn o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ, dɛɛ nyin nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ́ kpo.
Gɛnee dɛɛ baɡle o bandia nɛra baah ta, wejeremee dɔ bambile dɛ won o te lawa.
Kooro waa dɛ do deŋna nyosone waa ta la, o nomonome bwa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Nɛn waa nyaa ne nɛn waa dɛ fiiɡi nyaa la te bwa beŋkpoŋ, Korowiirii tɛ bɛlbwa sie o kpɔ dɛɛ na wa.
Kooro waa bol nyaara waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta la, o kora dɛ́ che dɛɛ biɡri.
Bechala deŋnetɛra wer dɛɛ tɛo wejema, kɛ he ta o nyu tɛo waa, o kpɔ sihiih dɛɛ kpo o nya.
Nɛnchɔɡa baa di kora aa, wechɔɡaa dɛɛ warɛ, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ so lee, dɛ́ na ba harɛ lɔe.
He do he bii kɛrɛdɛ naa, ba ɡelɔ hɛɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ne bambisɔɔhna.
Harɛ o nɛra aa wola Korowii waa kpɔe dawɛ ba nɛɛ la, bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin, kɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o Mmara ta la, ba na som.
Baa wobol ɡbo kpɔe dɛɛ do bonɔɔ, wɛɛ no a munii, kɛ o ken aa sie do.
Hwɛɡa lɔ ɡɛne nɛ, dɛ ɡwaa nɛn waa dɛ bol waa waa wola lii mɔɔ.
He ɡbɛɡbɛ he bonɔɔ le o bechale saŋ aa, a habɔɔ o dɛ ba bambichɔɡ ne.
Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di warawara la, dɛ ba naɡra ne.
Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di kohona dɛ ba wechɔɡa ne taeh.
He dɛ maŋkura he te naa, harɛɛ hɛɛ lɔ, kɛ he pwɛr he te naa, he dɛ dɔ duure.
He ne ŋwɛɛ dɛ bɔ aa, he ta he nyu, he bol kasinteŋ kɔɔto aa, ba dɛ tɛr he deŋne, he ta kasinteŋ bolɛ aa, Korowii dɛ taahne.
Nɛwɛnyini ɔma do kɛŋɔ bel ken, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada Korowii la, dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
Korowiirii dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ nɛra ɡalɡa aa dɛ nyin kɛ koranar nyin ba waa la.
Gɛ nɛndɛɛɡe aa hah nɛn o wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe la, ɡɛɛ nɛnchɔɡe ɡe hah nɛn o wa aa toɡra.
Waa aa le Aɡur be Waa aa le Jake bibaa Aɡur be laanee nɔ.
“Korowii kpɔ mɛ ta, n ta lɛɛ dɔe.
Dɛ n fa do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini ol, n ta nɛn liire dɔe.
Dɛ n ta wejema hwele, kɛɛ dɛ jemɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ la wa.
Nomɛl la Korowii doa dɛ berɛ ba kaa?
Umee lawɛ peu kpoŋe o nɔmpaa bini kaɔ?
Umee ɡbaa nee aa lɔ harɛ ta bwa do yal ta, kɛɛ umee kpɔ jwɛhre bil harɛ nɔ ta nyoa ɔ?
Umee jemɛ naate ɔ?
O sɔne ɛrɔɔ?
O bie sɔne ɛrɔɔ?
He jemɔ waa, baɡ mɛ!
Korowii dɛ teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta.
O dɛ tɔ nomɛlbwa waa ba o be ɡbemɡbe.
Bɛ waa Korowii aa wola bolɛ la kpɔ ja o waa ta, ásɛ o ba kaeh dɛ́ yerɛ nyosonteŋni.” Aɡur ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, webele anɛɛ mɛɛ nyin he be mɔɔ dɛ́ sewɛ, bɛ men vɔmɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛ le wesale ne nyosone ta kwaraa, bɛ ɡel ń nya kɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh kohona.
Tɛ mɛ anɔ la maa dɛɛ di tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Dɛ n dɔ kohona naa, mɛɛ soh he waa, dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Korowiirii ume o?’ N berɔ nya kwaraa ɡe aa, ŋwɛɛ mɛɛ ba ŋwɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel he sɔn chɔɡ.
Bɛ bonɔɔ sɔn ba chɔɡ tɛ o dɔɔ, ásɛ o ba taahne á dɔe.
Nɛra bane dɛ taah ba mɛɛnanar, baa andɛɛɡa sweerɛ dɛɛ tɛ ba nyare.
Ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa toole ba nɛ, kɛ dɛ ba senɛ wechɔɡa ta.
Nɛra bane dɛ ɛ mbarafo, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra nyubaahna.
Nɛra bane dɔ kpeɡri dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ fiiɡi nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra, dɛɛ lɛ kwa, a ɛ ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔa so, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba le nɛra bini.
A do kɛŋɔ kpanjeɡ aa dɔ bihaahna banɛ, a sɔne ‘Tɛ mɛ!’ Kombele atoro ane lole aa vaɡɛ bwa, naarɛte lole waa wola ŋɔ, ‘A maɡrɔ!’ Anee nɔ, lalabwɛ ne hambara, ne harɛ waa wola vaɡɛ dɛɛ nyin ne, dɛ nii aa dɛ lawɛ baa wola won dima.
Nɛn o siwi aa wola o mɛɛ tɔɡɛ wɛɛ mamɔ, dɛ berɛ nyiŋi o nya dɛɛ vah la, ɛɡreree dɛ́ foromi o sibie, ásɛ kokosakire di o ola.
Kombele atoro ane waa dɔ nyokpoa kɛrɛdɛ n be, naarɛte ɡe maa o mun no.
Anee kɛŋɔ, ɡɛ kee aa dɛ ɡah nyundua, harɛkon won bwetal ta kpɔe, ɡbera won nee sie kpɔe, asɛ baa ne haah yon dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa la.
Ŋwɛnɛ haah waa wola kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ o jaa, aa dɛ kpɔ o taa nɔ.
O yon le o jaa habɔɔ ka kpɔ banfale dɛ berɛ sɔ ne, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.’ Webele atoro ane lole yaa wola won kpoŋe, naarɛte ɡe ɡɛ.
Anee kɛŋɔ, yom waa bera di kora, ne ɡɛne waa dɔ kondikwa kohona dɛ di.
Ne haah nomɛlbwa aa wola on nyin o berɛ ba dɔ jaa, ne yomhaah waa lɛ haah waa lɔ o sie tolo jaa.
Kombele anaarɛ ane lɔ harɛ nɔ ta, dɛ do jeɡrejeɡre ken, kɛ dɛ ɡe jemɛ waa taeh.
Anee vaɡla, aa kpeɡe kɛ a dɛ nyin a kondikwaa hwel saŋ cheɡ, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ kpa bwaala nee saŋ.
Kukubanere aa wola kpeɡe nomanta, a jemɛ waa dɛɛ chɔ bwebɔɔne bini.
Tontombɛ ta sitɔɔ dɔe, kɛ a bwa pɛo dɛ ir dɛɛ kaa.
Hɛɛ won lawɛ ɡer he nɔn ta, kɛ koodemii hɛɛ nao.
Kombele atoro ane lole a vala do wer, ɡɛɛ naarɛte ɡe do.
Bɛlee puadɔɔ, o bwara kpeɡri ɡwaa ola bwa, waa komɛlbwa ɔmɛ kpɔɡ baah, ne bombala, ne jabala aa laa nyuune pa, ne koranar ba nɛra aa bar ba cheme.
Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛne haa dɛɛ maŋkura he te, dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa aa, ɡel dɛɛ lii wa.
He lɔ sooma aa, noo dɛ le a ta, he lɔ he dɔŋ mee ta naa, chal dɛ le, ɡɛɛ he muɡli he dɔŋ baah aa, hɛɛ ba naɡra ne.”
Waa aa le Kooro Lɛmoɛl be Waa aa hiah Kooro Lɛmoɛl, o nya bol baɡloo nɔ, “N bidɛɛɡe, n tea bini bie hen.
N baɡɛ Korowii nyoa, dɛ lolɛ.
Bɛ he bokpeɡa chɔɡ haahna nɛ, ba ɡelɔ koranar ɛɛ chɔɡ.
Lɛmoɛl, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ koranar nyɔ seŋkpeɡa, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ba pɛla do a ta.
A ɡelɔ baa soh mmarare aa lɔ ba harɛre ta, baa nyaara waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Nɛn waa soɡe seo nyoa, kɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ di suna laanee chɛ kɛ o nyɔ seŋkpeɡa.
Banee chɛ kɛŋɔ ba nyɔa, dɛ́ soh ba nyae ne suna baa dɛ di.
Kɛ he te chɛ kɛŋɔ he bol waa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa wola wobol jemɛ, ne banɔ la baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe bá bol ba waa tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta la.
Bol waa dɛɛ tɛ a ɡɛ nɛra ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta, ásɛ dɛ ɛ nɛn waa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.” Handɛɛɡe kpɛɛra Umee dɛ dɔ handɛɛɡe ɔ?
O dɔe kpeɡri ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa ne baŋa kwa.
O jaa yarada bwa lɔ o nɛ, waa ɡelɛ wobɛlbwa ɛɛ hiah o jaa.
O dɛ ɛ o jaa kɛrɛdɛ, waa on wechɔɡa ɛ o soɡa bini bwa.
O swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ta yabii ba kpɔ sɔh yal o do wer kɛrɛdɛ.
O dɛ la bojaŋ dɛ ka kpɔ kondikwa dɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ, stiimae yon la bojaŋ ka kpɔ bonadiire dɛɛ ba la.
O felo dɛɛ ir chɔmbibii, dɛɛ tɛ o dem tena kondikwa, dɛ́ berɛ baɡle o toli dem toma bá ɛ. O dɛ nyin harɛ waa wera dɛ́ yawɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ o suuɡa yawɛ daa dɛɛ du.
O bwara kpeɡri o swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ.
O dɛ na kɛŋɔ o bonadii dɔ tɔnɔ, dɛ ɛ toma wee kaa jo, o yon choŋi kandea, waa chɔ warane.
O dɛ lawɛ jeremi dɛ́ ta yabi, dɛ́ sɔh o ɡbaɡba yal.
Waa o ɡbo kon nyin, o dɛ ta tea dɛɛ tɛ nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra kwa.
Waa ɡelɛ waa ɛɛ kpo o dem tena waa saŋ.
O dɛ tɔ ba yale.
O ɡbaɡbaa dɛ́ nyarɛ bombore dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ pa o chɔɔbɔr.
O dɛ li yadɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.
O jaa ɡe soɡe bwɛɛ nomonome bini naa, nomɛlbwa dɛ duuru.
O dɛ sɔh yapondɛɛɡa ne kirisore dɛ yoɡ dɛɛ tɛ bonadiire.
O bwara kpeɡri o waa dɔ nyɛl, o bwara aa on hwah, o dɔ hwɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa.
O dɛ bol wejemwa, dɛɛ baɡle waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ.
O dɛ do sie o dem tena nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, o siwi ɛɛ swɛɛ wɛɛ nyin kwaa aa hiah ba.
O bii swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo, o jaa ɡe ɛɛ kpɛɛro.
O jaa yon ŋɔ, “Handɛɛɡa lole te, kɛ he dɔŋ toole.” Tolwaa te dɛ neɡre nɛn, wer ɡe ɛɛ tu, kɛ haah waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la chɛ kpɛɛra.
O chɛ kpɛɛra wobɛlbwa waa ɛ ta, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó dɔ duure nomɛlbwa be.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Wejereme Tɔn nɔ, wejereme la dɛ baɡle o liire ɡɛ waa aa dɛ chiɡ harɛ nɔ ta wa.
O nao kɛŋɔ a kpeɡri kɛ ya won no waane mun, a ta chɛ kɛ ya ŋɔ ya jemɛ wobɛlbwa.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɡboo jemɛ wobɛlbwa ka tonɛ, a chɛ kɛ yaa yaradao a bwa ta.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
A ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ ɡbosoo taa nɛn ɛɛ ba wona dɔ silɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Nyiŋi nyuune :, —.
Komɛlbwa ɛ wepuu Waa Wejereme bɛl, waa ɛ Kooro Devid bie dɛ di kora Jerusalam, aa bola laanee nɔ.
“Komɛlbwa ɛ wepuu.
Wobɛlbwa ta mun dɔe.” Wejereme laanee dɛɛ bol!
“Wobɛlbwa sese ta mun dɔe.” Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ nɛn ɛɛ ba dɔe dɛ́ le koeh bwa waa dɛ koh harɛ nɔ ta nɔ?
Nɛra dɛ sewɛ, baa lolɛ banfala, kɛ harɛ nɔ ta do ɡɛ waa doa.
Wee dɛ le dɛɛ chole, dɛ́ berɛ ɛ warane ba kaa bela waa dɛ le.
Peu dɛ ta baa kaa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ́ berɛ ta baa kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr, o dɛ ta bar ɡɛ naa dɛ ba cheme, dɛ́ berɛ ba kaa o buɡ ta.
Neerare bwa palɔ kaa jo mpo ta, kɛ waa su bwa.
A bwa berɔ dɛɛ kaa bela aa lea, dɛ́ palɛ ba kaa ja.
Wobɛlbwa ɛ koeh tenten, nɛn aa wola won bola ka tonɛ.
Siwi aa won ɡel nyiŋa, deŋne ɡe aa a noe ɡel.
Waane a fa aa chiɡa ka la ɛɛ berɔ chiɡ ja, waa Korowii aa ɛa ɡe, ɛɛ berɔ ɛ, wobɛlbwa ta wefala ɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta.
Waane lole ásɛ nomɛl na dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Anɔ te ɛ wefala aa?” Akai, a bwa fa lole, a lole saŋ la bwa mɔɔ ba lolɛ yaa.
Nomɛlbwa aa saŋ la baala waa lii kpa, hale banɔ la ba taa dɛ ba ba lola, nɛra baa lol ba, ba ɡe habɔɔ la, aa ba waa lii.
Wejema ɛ wepuu Men maa ɛ wejereme la, dɛ n fa ɛ Israel kooro dɛ so Jerusalam.
N siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ń jemɛ, dɛ le n te cheɡ dɛ hweli waa bwa nɛra aa dɛ ɛa harɛ nɔ ta.
Na wekpeɡa Korowii aa kpɔa ba dawɛ ya nɛ!
N na komɛlbwa nɛra aa dɛ ɛa harɛ nɔ ta, a bwa ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken.
Kon waa ɡola la, baa won toɡro.
Kwaa toole naa, nɛn aa an na dɛ́ kura.
N lii n nyu bini ŋɔ, “N kpeɡo dɛ dɔ wejema ɡwaa kooro bɛlbwa waa tɔ n sie dɛ ba di kora Jerusalam.
N hweli ɡɛ wejema ne liire dɔe aa doa, dɛ jema kɛrɛdɛ.” N siwi beɡrɔ n berɛ dɛɛ nyin ń jemɛ ɡɛ wejema ne ɡɛnewaa aa doa, dɛ na kɛ a bwa ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken.
Dɛkalkɛ, wejema kohona dɔe, ne suna dii kohonaa dɛɛ valɛ, waa mun noe kohona ɡe ne bambichɔɡaa.
Pɛlchɔɡa waa bɛlbwa ɛ wepuu N ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ mɛɛ teŋɛ pɛlchɔɡa waa taa, dɛ́ kpɔ daah n te na, dɛ́ na ɡɛ silɛɛ aa doa.
Kɛ a bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu.
N nao kɛŋɔ mama ɛ ɡɛnewa, pɛlchɔɡa ɡe aa wedɛɛɡa ne ba.
N cheɡɛ n wejema ta dɛ ŋɔ mɛɛ nyɔ senee dɛ́ di n nyu.
N liiro kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba wona di ba nyuune, tɔpera tama baa dɛ ba dii harɛ nɔ ta.
N ɛ wejena taeh.
N do deene dɛ parɛ daa kooni tɛ n te.
Mɛɛ ɛ bodɛɛɡee dɛ́ du daa bwa soo siwi aa dɛ nɔnɛ.
N kwi taama nee le bela palɛ kaa jo daa la mune, ásɛ a won kpeɡ kɛrɛdɛ.
N yawɛ yoma baala ne haahna bwa, asɛ ba lolɛ ba bini bane ɡe n dem.
N berɔ dɔ nae ne peera, dɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa tɔ n sie dɛ so Jerusalam bwa.
N lɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm kohona, ne kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ le harɛre koranar baa lɔ n lɔɡa be.
N dɔ haahna ne baala ɡe, ba ɡo yela dɛɛ lɛ n sie, asɛ n nyin haahna ɡe kohona.
N baa ɛ nɛnjen kohona, dɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa tɔ n sie Jerusalam.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, dɛ n ta dɔ wejema kohona.
N ta n te laa kpɔ kwaa n sie a dɛ lɛ a ta nɛ, n vɛh wobɛlbwa n bambile aa dɛ nyin.
N bambile lawɛ tomare bwa maa ɛa, anee ɛ kembɔr tɛ mɛ a bwa ta.
Kɛ maa kari waa bwa maa ɛa, ne kwaa maa koah dɛ dɔ la, dɛ komɛlbwa ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken, komɛlbwa ta tɔnɔ dɔe harɛ nɔ ta.
Wejema ne ɡɛna bwa ɛ wepuu Belaa n berɛ kpɔ liire, dɛ nyiŋi ɡɛ wejema aa doa, ne ɡɛ choɡla ne ɡɛnewaa ɡe aa doa.
Bɔkwaa kooro waa baa chiɡ o dɔŋ naa ta, ɛɛ ba wona ɛ á ɡwaa anɔ la sitɔte la aa ɛa ta nɔ?
N nao kɛŋɔ wejema wer ɡwaa ɡɛna, ɡɛ bɔr chaahna aa do wer ɡwaa biro la.
Wejereme bɛlbwa dɛ na bela waa dɛ kaa, kɛ ɡɛne te, biro binii o do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, waa jemɛ bela waa dɛ kaa.
Kɛ ane a bwa, n nao kɛŋɔ, sewee chɔ le tɛ ba bwa.
Belaa n lii kɛŋɔ, “Waa aa pu ɡɛne la ɛɛ won ba n ɡe nɛ.
Amɔ dɛ ɛrɛɛ n wejema maa dɔa la dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ mɛ nɔ?” Asɛ n ŋɔ, “Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu, a ta mun dɔe.” Baa wejerema ne ɡɛna bwa waa liira ba, baa soh ba bwa waa, tɔpera a taa dɛ ba bala ta.
Gɛ ɡɛne aa sewɛ la, ɡɛɛ wejereme ɡe ɛɛ ba sewa.
Koeh ɛ wepuu A ɡelɔ n ta silɛɛ bɛlbwa n soɡa bini dɔe kpa, dɛkalkɛ wenaale ɡboo a kpɔ ba ta n nɛ.
A bwa ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken.
N sie ta kwaa maa ɛ toma dɛ nyina harɛ nɔ ta lɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ba a ɡela tɛ nomɛl waa ba di n kwa.
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ kɛ naate ɛ wejereme kɛɛ ɡɛne ɔ?
Kɛ onee dɛ́ di kpeɡri kondɔɔh maa koah, dɛ nyina cheɡ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ta.
Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu.
Anomanta, n bambile pa mun chɔɡ, koeh bwa maa koah harɛ nɔ ta la wa.
Nɛn ɛɛ che o wejema ne o liire waa dɔa taa ɛ toma dɛ́ nyin kwa, dɛ́ ɡel a bwa habɔɔ tɛ nomɛl waa wola a toma ɛɛ.
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu.
Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba dɔe, dɛ́ le o koeh bwa waa swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ koh harɛ nɔ ta nɔ?
Toma waa dɛ ɛ o soɡa bini bwa ɛ weweele ne suna dii ɡbo.
Hale jwaana bwa, dɛ o ta dɛ lii wa, waa wola won chɔ.
A nɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu.
Waa aa wera tɛ nɛwɛnyini bwaa kɛŋɔ, o di kondikwa dɛ́ nyɔ sen lɛ o sie, ásɛ o bwara sɔɔhno o toma waa ɛa ta.
Anɔ ɡe kwaraa la, Korowii bee aa le, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o laa aa, umee dɛ́ won dɔ kondikwa di, dɛ́ lɛ o sie ɔ?
Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ nɛn o wa aa dɛ lɛ o sie wejema ne liire dɛ silɛɛ, kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ te, o ɡelɔ wɛɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ boa o kondɔɔh nyoa cheɡ tɛ nɛn o wa aa dɛ lɛ Korowii sie.
Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.
Komɛlbwa dɔ o saŋ Komɛlbwa dɔ o saŋ Korowii aa lea cheɡ, asɛ wobɛlbwa ɡe dɔ o tɔpere harɛ nɔ ta.
Bie lola dɔ o tɔpere, seo ɡe dɔ o tɔpere, kwaa dui saŋ lole, a fuɡra ɡe dɔ a saŋ, kpoe dɔ o tɔpere, chaeh ɡe tɔpere do le, danjwɛɛ taɡa dɛ́ ɡo saŋ lole, o kwaara dɛ́ ma ɡe saŋ do le.
Wii tɔpere lole, mama ɡe dɔ o tɔpere, suna dii tɔpere lole, silɛɛ ne hɛɡra ɡe dɔ a tɔpera, dɔŋa nyina dɔ a tɔpere, dɔŋa bɛ nyina ɡe dɔ a tɔpere, dɔŋa ɡbaara dɛ́ pɛl dɔ a tɔpere, dɔŋa baah peɡra ɡe tɔpere do le.
Kwaa bɔr ɡaaɡa dɛ́ naa dɔ a tɔpere, a bɔr bɛ ɡaaɡa tɔpere ɡe do le, kwaa nyoa boara tɔpere lole, a pae dɛ́ viɡri ɡe tɔpere do le, yal kɛɛra saŋ lole, o tae dɛ́ pɛ saŋ ɡe do le, nɛn hela dɛ́ so tɔpere lole, tɔpere waa bol waa la ɡe do le.
Dɔŋa nyina dɔ a tɔpere, dɔŋa haeh tɔpere ɡe do le, laa yoi tɔpere lole, deŋnesɔɔhna dɔe tɔpere ɡe do le.
Bɔkwaa nɛn waa dɛ ɛ toma, ɛɛ ba dɔe le o koeh waa dɛ koh ta nɔ?
N na wekpeɡa Korowii aa kpɔa ba dawɛ nɛwɛnyina nɛ.
O ɡelɔ komɛlbwa do wer o saŋ ta.
O ɡelɔ ya jemɛ ya liire bini waa aa lole saŋ la, ne anɔ la aa chiɡ kerekere saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, kɛ yaa won no waa bwa Korowii aa ɛa le mumpar kaa a jaɡa mun.
Anomanta, n nao kɛŋɔ waa nɛwɛnyina aa won ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, yá ɡel ya sie lɛ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa ya soɡa bini harɛ nɔ ta.
Nomɛlbwa di kondikwaa dɛ́ nyɔ sen, ásɛ o sie lɛ kwaa waa koah dɛ dɔ la ta, a ɛ Korowii koŋkɛɛla waa kpɔa kɛ yaa.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ komɛlbwa Korowii aa ɛ la, ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Nɛn aa won kpɔ ane ja kɛɛ dɛ́ laa ane kpɔ a ta.
Korowiirii ɛa ɡɛ, ásɛ nɛwɛnyina kpɔ duure tɛo.
Wobɛlbwa aa chiɡa ka la, ne anɔ la aa chiɡ ɡe fa chiɡo ka.
Korowiirii ɡela ɡɛ waa la bwa berɛ dɛɛ chiɡ.
N berɔ na waane harɛ nɔ ta ja, nyubinikpeɡ chiɡ kasinteŋ bole pae naa ta, wechɔɡa ɡe chiɡ waa aa toɡra naa ta.
N lii n nyu bini ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ ba bol nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, ne nyubinikpeɡ tena bwa waa dɛ́ pa ba bole, dɛkalkɛ wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dɔ o saŋee, we-ɛɛla bɛlbwa ɡe dɔ o tɔpere.” N berɔ lii ŋɔ, “Kɛ nɛwɛnyina te, Korowii daah ba dɛɛ na, dɛ́ ɡel bá jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba do kɛŋɔ ola ken.
Webeŋkpoŋii chɔ le dɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyina ne ola bwa, ɡɛ bɛl aa sewɛ la, ɡɛɛ o dɔŋ ɡe ɛɛ ba sewa.
Hweera beŋkpoŋii lɔ a bwa bini.
Nɛwɛnyina ta ola ɡwaalɛ.
Wobɛlbwa ɛ wepuu.
Bobeŋkpoŋii Korowii kontaala bwa ɛɛ kaa.
Teeraa Korowii kpɔ taa, anomanta, teera binii a bwa berɛ ɛɛ ba kaala.
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyina doma dɛ kaa nyundua, asɛ ola doma ɡe dɛɛ ka harɛ bini nɔ?” Anomanta, n nao kɛŋɔ waa nɛwɛnyini aa ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, ó ɡel o sie lɛ toma waa ɛa dɛ dɔ kwaa la ta, dɛkalkɛ anee ɛ kembɔr aa chɛ kɛ ó dɔ.
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ o seo habɔɔ wa ɔ?
Fiiɡa ne koeh ne chamene nyae wa N berɔ nyiŋi dɛ na fiiɡa nɛra aa dɛ fiiɡi ba dɔŋa harɛ nɔ ta.
N na nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba siniire, kɛ nɛn toole dɛ́ larawe ba bwara, dɛkalkɛ, nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la nɔn taa kpeɡri ka di.
Asɛ n bol ŋɔ, nɛra baa serewa la, ba na som dɛ ɡwaa banɔ la ba taa soɡe le.
Kɛ nɛra baa wola ban lolɛ, baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta nae mɔɔ la, ba na som.
Ate, n na kɛŋɔ toma nɛra aa dɛ ɛ dɛ́ dɔ kwaa bwa, le o dɔŋ bɛl komɛl waa dɔa, o na o siwi beɡre la ta.
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, a do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.
Gɛnee yon fɔɔ o nɔɔra so ŋɔ, waa tomaa ɛ, lɔr ɛɛ kpoo ó sewɛ.
He dɔ kondikwaa nɔndel di deŋnesɔɔhna ta, ɡwaa haa koah kohona, dɛ dɔa nɔndela anɛ di.
A bwa ɛ wepuu, kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.
N berɔ na waane ɡe aa wola mun dɔe harɛ nɔ ta.
Dɛ baa bɛl ɡboo soɡa, o ta bibaa kɛɛ nime dɔe.
Dɛ tɔpere bɛlbwaa wɛɛ koh, kɛ o siwi aa o kondɔɔh su.
Ate, o bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Ume waa mɛɛ koh maa wola won lɛ n sie nɔɔ?” Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, bosɔɔhna aa wola toole a ta.
Banɛ wer ɡwaa beŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛ ba nyoa ɛɛ won pɛ, ásɛ ba ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ dɔ ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin.
Beŋkpoŋ baa chole aa, o dɔŋ ɛɛ won chao ó ir.
Kɛ nɛn waa chole o ta nɛn dɔe o lawɔ ir la na wa!
Nɛra banɛ pɛo chɔ aa, ba dɛ wɔrɔbe dɔŋa bwara.
Kɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ɡbo aa won chɔ o bwara wɔrɔbe.
A lole kɛŋɔ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ bɛl ɛɛ won yo, dɛ́ pɔ o dɔŋ nɛ, kɛ ba pɛ nɛra banɛ naa, baa won lɛ ba te.
Ŋwɛn baa pɛra atoro chae kpeɡri.
Bonɔɔ waa nyaa dɛ jemɛ waa la, ɡwaa kooro waa hwɛɛhra, dɛ ɡɛn waa wola jae no.
A ɡɛ bonɔɔ la, ba ken lawɔ do dea mɔɔ o ba di kora, kɛɛ ba lolɔ nyaa bini o do o harɛ ta.
N nao kɛŋɔ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta bwa, teŋɛ bonɔɔ baa lawɔ o ba chiɡ kooro naa ta la nɛ.
Nɛra kooro aa dɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ ta nyoa dɔe, kɛ dɛ o baa sewaa, nomɛlbwa sie aa o waa waa ɛa taa lɛ.
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, a do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.
Kpɔ ɔmee tomɛ Korowii dɛɛ duuru He dɛ la Korowii Dea aa, nyiŋi he vala bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Do sie no o waa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡwaa ɡɛna saraha ba yon dɛɛ ɛ, baa wola jemɛ kɛ ba dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la.
Dɛɛ lawɛ he nyoa, he dɔ waane dɛ́ bol aa, nyiŋi a bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ too, dɛ́ bol baɡle Korowii.
Korowii te, nyundua o do, asɛ he do harɛ, anomanta, bɛ ɡel he wobol do kan. Liire waraa ɡela nɛn ɛɛ dee deera, ɡɛɛ dɛ nɛn dɛ́ bol waa kohona, dɛ o ta nyiŋe kɛrɛdɛ naa, wɛɛ bol ɡɛnewa.
Saŋ bɛlbwa he dɛ baɡɛ Korowii nyoa aa, bɛ ɡel a biɡri he ɛ ɡɛ haa ŋɔa hɛɛ ɛo la, dɛkalkɛ Korowii sie aa nɛn waa ɡɛna waa wola o nyobaɡa ta teŋɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
A wer kɛ nɛn ɡel nyoa baɡa, ɡwaa kɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa, dɛ vɛh a ta teŋa.
Bɛ ɡel he nyoa wobol kaa he ne wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ sɔfo be ŋɔ, sibeɡra ta laa he baɡɛ nyoa.
Bɛ ɡel Korowii baah di he nɛ he nyoa wobol wa, dɛ́ chɔɡ kwaa haa koah dɛ dɔ.
Deera kohona ne wobol kohona ta mun dɔe.
Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii.
Kondɔɔh ɛ wepuu He na nomɛl waa nyaa, baa wola o waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛo aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ fiiɡu harɛ la ta naa, bɛ ɡel á kpo he nyoa.
Nomoa bɛlbwa lɔ o dɔŋ waa ɡwaalo lɔɡa, asɛ ba bwa habɔɔ, nomonome bane ɡe ɡwaa ba.
Komɛlbwa aa le harɛ la ta la, nɛra baa lɔ o ta la bwaa dɛɛ dia, waa aa chɛ kooro laanee kɛŋɔ, wɛɛ nyiŋi harɛpare la ta, dɛkalkɛ o ɡe ɛɛ dɔ anee di kohona.
Nomɛlbwa o sie aa beɡre suuɡa laa an dɔ kohona, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kondɔɔh kohona la sie aa a ta lɛ.
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, a do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.
Nɛn dɔ kondɔɔh kohona naa, nɛra baa dɛ dia ɡe dɛ warɛ.
Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ naate la ɛɛ ba dɔe?
O sie ɡbo laa dɛɛ ba a ta lɛɛ yaa?
Tom-ɛɛ chɔe dɛ do o som, hale o di kondikwaa tama kɛɛ kohona noo.
Kɛ kondɔɔh kwaa waa dɔa kohona nomanta, waa won dom chɔ.
N na wedoŋa ane ɡe harɛ nɔ ta, nɛra yon pa ba kondɔɔh sɔh kɛ aa ban cha, kɛ a yon che waane ta bá paŋɛ ba kondɔɔh la, ásɛ dɛ ba dɔ bibaala bane kwaraa naa, baa komɛlbwaa dɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ ja ba.
Ba lolɛ bie ba harɛ nɔ ta naa, waa komɛlbwa ne ba, ɡɛ tentenee o sewaa wɛɛ ba kaala.
Waa won kpɔ komɛlbwa waa koah dɔ harɛ nɔ ta kaa.
Waa aa teŋa nɔ ɡe ɛ wedoŋa kohona.
Gɛ baa lolɛ nɛn o ba harɛ nɔ ta la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ kaalo.
Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ wɛɛ ba dɔe, o koeh waa dɛ koh pɛɛpɛɛ ta nɔ?
O soɡa bini bwa do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa soɡe biro ta ken, o liire chɔɡ, dɛɛ na wenaale kohona o baah di.
Ate, n na kɛŋɔ a wer kɛ nɛn di kondikwa, dɛ́ nyɔ sen, ásɛ o sie lɛ koeh waa dɛ koh tɔpera tama, Korowii aa kpɔa tɛo harɛ nɔ ta.
Waa aa chɔ le tɛo laanee la.
Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ Korowii tɛ nomɛl kondɔɔh dɛ ɡel o sie ɛɛ lɛ a ta, asɛ o jemɛ kɛŋɔ anee chɔ le tɛo waa, anee Korowii kpɔ kɛo.
Korowii aa ɡela o dɔ silɛɛ nomanta, waa o tɔpera tama waa di harɛ nɔ ta waa liira ba.
N berɔ na wechɔɡa ane harɛ nɔ ta, aa do tɔɡre kohona kɛŋɔ bone, dɛ dawɛ nɛra nɛ.
Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ nɛn kondɔɔh ne jirima, ɡɛ aa ɛ o bɛ komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin nya o soɡa bini.
Kɛ Korowii aa ɡel ó dɔa di, nɛmpɛɛ bɛlee yon berɛ ba kpɔ.
Anɔ ta mun dɔe, a ɛ wedoŋa.
Dɛ nomɛl soɡo biɡri dɛ dɔ bii lafa, kɛ o soɡa dɛ biɡri bwa habɔɔ, dɛ o ta wone dɔ silɛɛ o kondɔɔh waa dɔa ta, dɛ sewɛ ba huɡo kɛrɛdɛ naa, amɔ dɛ bie baa haro ta kwaraa ɡwaalo.
A ta mun dɔe kɛŋɔ bá lolɛ a ɡɛ bie la, o waa dɛ le nɛra liire bini kwaraa, ásɛ ba soh o wa.
A lole kɛŋɔ bie la ta wee nae kɛɛ dɛ jemɛ komɛlbwa te, kɛ o bwara sɔɔhno dɛ ɡwaa a ɡɛ nɛn la, hale ɡɛ nɛn waa dɔ kondɔɔh la soɡo bene kaɡboŋa anɛ kwaraa naa, silɛɛ bɛlbwa aa a taa do.
Ane a bwa, bobeŋkpoŋii bie la ne nɛn la bwa ɛɛ kaa.
Kondikwaa nɛn aa di waa wɛɛ koh, kɛ waa vaɡɛ bwa.
Gwaala besoo wejereme ɡwaa ɡɛne ɔ?
Dɛ nɛn nyao waa, o jo nɛra bini naa, o jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ lawɛ o te.
A wer kɛ he sie lɛ anɔ la haa dɔa ta, ɡwaa anɔ la haa kpɔ sie dawɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɔɔ ta.
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛ nɛn waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken.
Wobɛlbwa aa chiɡa saŋ la dɔ sɔn, asɛ ya jemɛ ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini ɡe aa doa.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ne nɛn, waa do kpeɡri ɡwaalo aa won cheme.
Nɛn wobol warɔ kohona naa, aa mun kohona dɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ aa ba wona dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ bɛlbwa nɔ?
Dɛkalkɛ umee dɛ́ won jemɛ waa aa wera tɛ nɛn, ya tɔpera tama aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe dɛ teŋe baa kaa kɛ lileo nɔ ta nɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won baɡle waa aa chiɡ harɛ nɔ ta o seo habɔɔ?
Wejema wa Sɔndɛɛɡe wer ɡwaa nosɔɔhsoma, ɡɛɛ seo tɔpere ɡe do wer ɡwaa lola tɔpere.
A wer kɛŋɔ nɛn la lwe mun, dɛ ɡwaa kɛ waa la bela baa dɛ di kondikonjena, dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛkalkɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ sewɔɔ.
A chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ do waa nɔ dɛɛɡɔ.
Suna dii ɡwaa mama, dɛkalkɛ suna dii ɡelɔ yaa hweli waa aa wera.
Wejereme soɡo waa, o dɛ́ lii seo wa, kɛ ɡɛne te, o sie dɛ́ lɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Wejereme dɛ́ kaeh naa, no o be, ɡwaa kɛ ɡɛne aa dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛre.
Gɛne mama do kɛŋɔ, baa kpɔ sɔɔhne do nii ta aa parame.
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu.
He ɛ wejereme dɛɛ faah nɛra aa, he do kɛŋɔ ɡɛne.
He sɛoh baa yawɛ sen ɡe aa, nɛnchɔɡee hɛɛ ɛ. Komɛlbwa tona wer ɡwaa o mumpar, asɛ bambile lawa ɡe ɡwaa kɛ haa dɛ ɛ mbarafo.
Bɛ ɡel he baah ɛɛ di warawara, ɡɛnee lɛ o dɔŋ waa dɛɛ do o bini.
Bɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ saŋ la wobɛlbwa do wer ɡwaa fini nɔɔ?” A ɛ ɡɛnewaa kɛ he bɔɔ ɡɛ.
Wejema wer kɛŋɔ haa dɔ kapɛrɛ kon bɛl dɛɛ cha nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta.
Wejema dɛ tɔ nɛn nɛ, kɛŋɔ suuɡa aa won nɛn lɛɛ la ken.
Wejema dɔe kohona ɛɛ won ɡel naate la so sodɛɛɡa, dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.
Nyiŋi waa Korowii aa ɛa.
Umee dɛ́ won toɡre kon waa ɡela o ɡoloo?
Waane kaalɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ naa, ɡel he sie lɛ, kɛ dɛ wenaale bɛlee tenaa, lii kɛŋɔ, Korowiirii ba silɛɛ ne, dɛ berɛ ba wenaale ɡe ne.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa aa won jemɛ ɡɛ aa chiɡu kerekere.
N soɡa maa soɡa aa wola mun dɔe nɔ, webele anɛ aa teŋa nɔɔ n na, nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ́ sewɛ o wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ wa, ásɛ nyubinikpeɡ te so dɛ́ biɡri o wechɔɡa ta.
Bɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ he waa toɡrɔ kohona, kɛɛ he jemɛ waa kohona, dɛ́ chɔɡ he te.
Dɛɛ berɛ nyubinikpeɡ ɛɛ kohona, dɛɛ berɛ ɡɛna ɡe kohona.
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ he sewɛ, dɛ he saŋ ta tele mɔɔ nɔ?
Lawɛ a bwa bini kpoŋe, dɛ bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa le he nɔn ta.
Naate waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii ɛɛ won le ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa nyoa.
Wejema ɛɛ won ɡel nɛmbeŋkpoŋ di kpeɡri, dɛ́ ɡwaa koranar fi baa lɔ bwɛjen ta.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra beŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole harɛ nɔ ta, dɛɛ ɛ wa aa toɡra waa wola wechɔɡa ɛ. Bɛ deŋne cheɡ dɛɛ no waa bwa nɛra aa dɛ bol, ɡɛ laa aa, hɛɛ ba noo kɛŋɔ he bonɔɔ kwaraa taahne, dɛkalkɛ he ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ he taah nɛra bane.
N cheɡɛ n wejema ta dɛ nyiŋi, dɛ daah a bwa na dɛ ŋɔ, “N siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ń dɔ wejema,” kɛ dɛ a berɔ ɡwaa n liire ta.
Gɛ bɛlbwa wejema aa doa bwa, o bini luŋri kɛrɛdɛ, o ta jaɡa dɔe, dɛ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ yá won jemɛ a mun.
Anomanta, n kpɔ n liire bwa do a ta, dɛ́ won jemɛ a mun, dɛ́ nyiŋi wejema ne ŋwɛnɛ aa cheɡɛ a ta waanee yon dɛɛ ɛ, dɛ́ na ɡɛnewaa aa lɔ nyubinikpeɡ ne ɡɛna ta.
N na waane aa dɛ we dɛ ɡwaa seo, haah bɛl do kɛŋɔ bel baa dɛ harɔ.
O bambile do kɛ nafuɡe, asɛ o nɔɔra do kɛŋɔ jɔɡrɔre, o kpɔ dɛɛ harɛ nɛra.
Wejereme bɛlbwa o wa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi la, ɛɛ won chwa le o nafuɡere la ta, kɛ ɡɛne te, wɛɛ lawɔɔ.
Wejereme la ŋɔ, “Hé na, waa maa naa laanee nɔ, n nyiŋi waane bini beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ aa cheɡɛ a ta waane yon dɛɛ ɛ. N taa dɛ nyiŋi a bini n ta wobɛlbwa nae mɔɔ la, babeŋkpoŋ o wa aa toɡra ɡboo n na nɛra kaɡboŋ bini, kɛ haah o wa aa toɡra beŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole ba bini.
Waa aa teŋa nɔɔ n hweli le a ta, Korowii fe ta nɛwɛnyina bwa ba waa toɡre, kɛ ba berɔ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛfale ta dɛ chɔɡ ba te.”
Umee ɛ wejereme ɔ?
Umee dɛ won baɡle waa mun ɔ?
Wejema dɛ kwaa nɛn siebɔr, dɛ ɡel wɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ.
Kooro duura wa Dɛ kooro bol wa aa, nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ waa ŋɔa, dɛkalkɛ he ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡle Korowii a wa.
Bɛ too ŋɔ hɛɛ le kooro sie kaa.
Bɛ on deŋnekpeɡ ɛ, dɛkalkɛ wɛɛ won ɛɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin.
Kooro aa dɛ di kpeɡri nomanta, dɛ o bol waa, umee dɛ́ won tɔŋlo wɔ?
Nomɛlbwa waa no o waa waa dɛ bol la, aa wahalaa na, kɛ wejereme te ɛɛ won jemɛ saŋ waa wera ne ɡɛ waa ɛ.
A lole kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini wenaale ɡwaa o nɛɛ te, kɛ wobɛlbwa dɔ saŋ waa wera ne ŋwɛnɛ baa ɛa.
Nomɛlbwa aa wola kere waa jemɛ nɔ, umee dɛ́ won baɡlo waa aa dɛ ba bala ɔ?
Nomɛlbwa ta kpeɡri dɔe o doma nɛ, nomɛlbwa aa jemɛ tɔpere waa dɛ ba sewa.
Gɛ baa wola won lawɛ nɛn le laa ta la, ɡɛɛ wechɔɡa aa wola nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa bini le.
N na a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, asɛ n lii waa baa dɛ ɛa harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
Nɛra bane dɛ di kpeɡri, asɛ bane ɡe do ba lɔɡa ba bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ.
N berɔ na nyubinikpeɡ tena baa huɡ ba, kɛ nɛra le huɡribɔr bela ba naa, ba yon berɛ dɛɛ kpɛɛ ba bwɛjen la bini baa soɡa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la.
Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu.
Nɛn ɛ wechɔɡa ba ta o deŋnetɛra kpɔe tɛo warane naa, nɛra dɛ dɔ liifala dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
A lole kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɛɛ won ɛ wechɔɡa kera lafa dɛ́ ta so biɡri.
Kɛ n jemɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ duuru la, wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ ba.
Kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa wola Korowii ɔmɛ nomanta, aa wer doe ba dɛ́ tɛɛ ba.
Ba tɔpera aa jaŋnee do kɛŋɔ, lileo yon teŋe ba kaa la ken.
Waane ɡe lole aa wola mun dɔe harɛ nɔ ta ja.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ dɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋnetɛra, asɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡe ɛɛ dɔ kembɔr aa chɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra.
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu ja.
Anomanta, n liiree kɛŋɔ a wer kɛ nɛwɛnyini di kondikwaa dɛ́ nyɔ sen lɛ o sie harɛ nɔ ta.
Gɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel o dɔ silɛɛ o toma ne o tɔpera Korowii aa kpɔa tɛo o so harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
N siwi beɡrɔ n nyiŋi ɡɛ wejema aa doa, dɛ na nɛwɛnyini koeh waa dɛ koh harɛ nɔ ta.
N nao kɛŋɔ nɛn aa wone dɛɛ chɔ dom chɔɔ ne jwaana, asɛ n na waa Korowii aa ɛa bwa.
Nomɛlbwa aa won jemɛ waa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ka tonɛ bwa.
Hale anɔ bwa habɔɔ, nɛwɛnyini ta wone jemɛ a mun.
Wejereme waa ŋɔa o jemɔ kwaraa la, waa won jemɛ bwa.
Nyokala beŋkpoŋii chɔ le tɛ nomɛlbwa N lii anɔ bwa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ na kɛŋɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, ne wejerema waa baa dɛ ɛ bwa, lɔ Korowii nɔn ta.
Kɛ bɛlbwa aa jemɛ kɛ wedɛɛɡa, kɛɛ wechɔɡa chɔ le dɛɛ kpaa ba.
Nyokala beŋkpoŋii chɔ le dɛ tɛ ba bwa, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, nɛndɛɛɡa ne nɛnchɔɡa, banɔ la baa kah doŋa, ne banɔ la baa wola doŋa kaeh, dɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛ banɔ la baa wola sarahare ɛ bwa.
Waa aa chɔ le tɛ nɛndɛɛɡe la, ɡɛɛ a chɔ tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɡe, ɡɛ aa doa dɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam la, ɡɛɛ a do tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ɔmɛ ŋwɛɛra.
Waa aa ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ do wobɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta laanee nɔ.
Webeŋkpoŋ laanee chɔ le tɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa.
Wechɔɡa su nɛra bambili ɡɛ saŋ ba taa soɡe le dɛɛ ɡɛn, ásɛ mɔɔ bá piɡri sewɛ.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola sewɛ mɔɔ, dɛ ta so harɛ nɔ ta dɔ hwɛɡa.
Nyoate waa wola sewɛ ɡwaa nyujente waa sewa.
Weera jemɔ kɛ baa sewɔɔ, kɛ nɛra baa serewa aa wobɛlbwa jemɛ, ba ta kembɔr bɛlbwa dɔe, nɛra aa ba waa kwaraa lii kpa.
Ba dɔŋa nyina ne dɔŋa haeh, dɛ ba meera waa bwa nyoɡrɔ, baa komɛlbwaa dɔ le wobɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta kpa.
Kaa ka di kondikwaa dɛ́ nyɔ sen silɛɛ ne, kɛ taraken Korowii sie dɛ lɛ waa haa dɛ ɛ ta.
Gel he sie ɛɛ lɛ hɛɛ hɛɡre saŋ bɛlbwa.
He ne he haah haa dɛ nyinu so sodɛɛɡa dɛɛ lɛ he sie, tɔpera aa teŋa baa kaa Korowii kpɔ tɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɔ.
Dɛkalkɛ anee chɔ le tɛɛ, he le koeh haa dɛ koh harɛ nɔ ta nyoa.
Do sie dɛɛ ɛ toma bokpeɡa bwa ne, dɛkalkɛ lalabwɛɛ haa dɛ ba kaala la, toma ɛɛ kɛɛ waane vɔrɔwa, kɛɛ waa mun noe, dɛ wejema toole bela.
N berɔ na waane ɡe harɛ nɔ ta.
Nɛra baa won chwae kohona laa chwaa dɛɛ tɔ sie, banyoola bwa laa wona yo laa dɛɛ pɔ nɛra nɛ.
Wejema laa dɛɛ tɛ kondikwa, kɛɛ nɛn o liire bini aa chaahna laa dɛɛ dɔ kondɔɔh.
Nɛn waa hweli tɔn kaa sie bwa laa dɛ́ won ɛ nomonjen.
Kɛ wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa dɛ ba ba bwa nɛ.
Ane a bwa, nomɛlbwa aa o tɔpere jemɛ, ɡɛ ba yon kpɔ asau lawɛ pɛŋe, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ bel lawɛ jumbie la, ɡɛɛ ba yon harɛ nɛra bela dɛ́ piɡri laɡ ba tɔpechɔɡe wee.
Wejema dɔe ɡwaa ɡɛna N berɔ na waane aa ɛ wejemwaa aa lɛ n sie harɛ nɔ ta.
Dɛ bwɛjen bɛl waa wola kanɛ kohonaa fa lole, nɛra baa lɔ o ta ɡe aa kanɛ.
Kɛ kooro bɛl waa kpeɡa kohona kpɔ o laa tena ba chɔ baro, dɛ ma kwaa baa che a ta jo bwɛjen la ta.
Dɛ baa bɛl soɡe a ɡɛ bwɛjen la ta dɛ nya, kɛ dɛ o dɔ wejema.
O cheɡɛ o wejema ta, dɛ lɛ bwɛɛ la.
Kɛ a habɔɔ la, nomɛlbwa ta o waa liire kpa.
Anomanta, n ŋɔ, “Wejema ɡwaa kpeɡri.” Kɛ baa la waa nyaa dɛ dɔ wejema la, nɛra ta on bui, nomɛlbwa ta o waa kwaraa liire kpa.
A wer kɛ ya no wobopwɛra wejereme aa dɛ bol, ɡwaa kooro waa kpɔ nyɛɡa bol waa dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛna.
Wejema wer ɡwaa dɔmkwaa baa dɛ yo ane, kɛ ɡɛne beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ won chɔɡ waa aa wera kohona.
Koŋɡaahle sewɔ aa, o sɔɔh won nosɔɔhsoma sɔɔh chɔɡa, ɡɛɛ ɡɛnewa tamaa bini do tɔɡre ɡwaa wejema ne jirima.
Wejereme bɛlbwa bambile cheɡɛ waa aa toɡra ta, kɛ ɡɛne te, wedoŋa ɡboo lɔ o bambile ta.
Hale o kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa kwaraa naa, o ta liire bɛlbwa dɔe, a ɡel nɛra bwa na o ɡɛna waa ɡɛna.
Dɛ kooro baah di he nɛɛ aa, bɛ ŋɔ he dɛ vɛh toma waa kpɔa do he nɔn ta.
Bambile lawa ɛɛ won sɔɔh he wechɔɡa haa ɛa nyoa.
N na wedoŋa ane ɡe harɛ nɔ ta, waane kooro bɛl aa koni a ta.
Gɛnaa ba yon kpɔ chɔ wejena nyoo, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡa tena chɔ anjeɡre nyoo.
N na yoma ba so jaɡre ta, asɛ nomonjena ɛɛ valɛ naa ta kɛŋɔ yoma ken.
Nomɛlbwa waa kwi bɔɔ la, wɛɛ won le o bini, nomɛlbwa waa ku danjwɛɛ dɛ jo la, harɛkon ɛɛ won choɡo.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ paɡre bwea la, bweaa dɛ́ doo bol, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ peɡri daa ɡe la, anee dɛ́ doo bol.
Dɛ kpanfɛ nyoa taŋɔ, ba ta on sarɛ aa, bokpeɡa nee hɛɛ ba o ne toma ɛɛ, kɛ he wejema taa aa ba cheɡa he won tonɛ.
Dɛ harɛkon choɡe tɛɛɡa te mɔɔ wɛɛ vɔwɔ kabere aa, dɛ a ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe tɛo.
Jirima lɔ wejereme nyoa, kɛ ɡɛne te, o ɡbabir nyoa wobolee dɛɛ chɔɡo.
Gɛne bol wa aa, a ɛ ɡɛne wobol, a tona bini do kɛ choɡla te wobol.
Gɛne wobol warɔ, aa tonɛ bwa.
Nomɛlbwa aa jemɛ waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere.
Umee dɛ́ won baɡle waa aa chiɡ ya seo habɔɔ?
Gɛne dɛ koh o toma ta, waa jemɛ ɡɛ waa ɛ dɛ́ kaa bobɛlbwa.
Harɛ o nɛra kooro aa ɛ bonɔmbi, ba nomonome ɛɛ di kondikonjena, dɛɛ lɛ ba sie jwaana la, ba bwɛɛlɛ!
Kɛ harɛ o nɛra kooro aa ɛ koobie, ba nomonome ɛɛ di kwaa saŋ waa wera ta, dɛ dɔ bokpeɡa ɡwaa kɛ baa nyɔ sen dɛɛ la, ba na som.
Dɛ nomɛl ɛ bɔhwaah dɛ vɛh o dea kwaara aa, wɛɛ luloo, ásɛ o nyundua la ku le o bini.
Kondikonjena dii dɛ ba silɛɛ ne, asɛ sen nyɔe ɡee ba hɛɡra ne, kɛ he ta suuɡa dɔe yaa, haa won ɛ a bini bɛlbwa.
Bɛ he liire ɛ kɛŋɔ, hɛɛ bol kooro bwara wechɔɡe bɛlee, kɛɛ dɛ́ taah suuɡate he dea haa chɔ o bini, dɛkalkɛ jumbie bɛl ken ɛɛ kpɔ waa haa bola laanee ka taa baɡ ba.
Gel he tea do som hɛɛ kɛ kwa Kpɔ he paanoo ta nee sie, tɔpera ane habɔɔ la, wɛɛ berɔ ba he be.
Bɔne he kwaa haa dɔa bini ane tɛ nɛra banuanɛ kɛɛ banuatoro, dɛkalkɛ haa jemɛ saŋ chɔɡa aa ba harɛ la ta.
Baama biro kohona naa, anee ɡela bwaala ɛɛ nɛ harɛ ta.
Daa cholo chɔ weekaŋle nyundua, kɛɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr aa, buɡ ta bela waa chola laanee wɛɛ chɔ.
Paa bɛlbwa waa so nyiŋi dɛ́ na ɡɛ peu aa dɛ ta la, jemɛ saŋ aa wola chɛ kɛ ó du kwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyiŋi baama ɡe, aa won dɔ komɛlbwa komɛ.
Haa wola luɡe peu aa dɛ kpɔ o ta jemɛ, kɛɛ ɡɛ nɛn aa dɛ kpeɡ o nya tea bini nɔ, ɡɛɛ haa wola won no Korowii we-ɛɛla waa mun.
Hɛɛ du kwaa yaa, he dua chɔɔ dɛ bɛ so pɛɛpɛɛ jɔmɔra ɡe.
Haa won jemɛ anɔ la aa do wer, chɔɔ kɛɛ jɔmɔra kwaa laanee yoo.
A laa ɡe aa, a bwa ken ɛɛ won do wer.
Lii Korowii waa tae he bonɔɔne saŋ Bɔr chaahnɔ nɛn na naa, dɛ silɛɛ balɔ.
Dɛ nomɛl wono so dɛ biɡri aa, a chɛ kɛ o sie lɛ o tɔpera la bwa ta.
Kɛ ó lii kɛŋɔ tɔpechɔɡa ane lole, dɛ warɛ ɡwaa anɔ la waa kpɔa so.
Wedɛɛɡa ane bɛlbwa toole dɛ do a habɔɔ kpa.
He ta ɛ bonɔɔ naa, ɡel he sie lɛ, dɛɛ di he bwara he bonɔɔne saŋ.
Dɛɛ teŋɛ waa he bambile aa dɛ nyin, ne komɛlbwa haa na ta.
Kɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ ba bol a bwa waa, dɛ́ pa bole.
Anomanta, bɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa hae, kɛɛ he na weweele bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ bonɔɔne saŋ waa teŋo baa kaa, dɛ bwa ɛ wepuu.
He taa lɔ he bonɔɔne saŋ ta la, dɛɛ lii Korowii waa tae wa, mɔɔ tɔpechɔɡa haa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa la ba.
Ásɛ tɔpere bɛl habɔɔ mɔɔ he lii ŋɔ, “N sie aa n soɡa ta lɛ kpa,” mɔɔ wee ne bɔrchaahna, ne korobie dɛ weweela kaa biro ta, ásɛ baama aa dɛ nɛ bwaala la ba tɔ nyundua, mɔɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah he dem ɛɛ chel, ásɛ nɛra ba fa aa kpeɡa la ɡwɛɡre, mɔɔ haahna baa dɛ namɛ kwaa la ɡel nama, dɛkalkɛ baa kanɛ.
Ásɛ nɛra baa kpɔ sibie pi tokorore ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi la bɛ won dɛɛ na kpa.
Berɛ lii mɔɔ saŋ tel ba tɔɔɡe doonyoo aa lɔ fɔɡbaahna ɡbeni, ásɛ manikare aa dɛ namɛ kwaa ɡel sii, ásɛ mɔɔ jumbii sii ɡel nɛra ir dom ta, kɛɛ yela ɡoe ɡbɔɡa bwa ba a jaɡa, ɡɛ saŋ nɛra aa dɛɛ ɔmɛ bwejaŋa dor laŋa, ne ɔmee aa lɔ fɔɡbaahna, ne ɡɛ saŋ daa bɛl waa dɛ fe fepoŋa.
Ásɛ hɔɔhre jah dɛɛ kaa tama tama, pɛlchɔɡa bwa ba a jaɡa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra boa ba nyoa, dɛɛ ba ba kaa lalabwɛ.
Lii Korowii waa tae waa mɔɔ suuɡapoŋ jɔɡrɔre cha, kɛɛ loɡ baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛo, ne vii baa dɔ nee dɛɛ do o bini paɡre, kɛɛ buni kɔlɔŋ ŋwɛn aa dawɛ o ta, ba tɛr nee dɛɛ kpɔ o ta la ku.
Ya bwadabii ɛɛ berɔɔ kaa teera ta, ásɛ ya doma kaa Korowii waa kpɔa tɛ yaa la be.
Wejereme la ŋɔ, “A bwa ɛ wepuu, Wobɛlbwa ta mun dɔe.” Waa la tona Wejereme la aa dɔ wejema nomanta, o baɡle bane ɡe ba dɔ wejema.
O hweli wobosɛɡla, dɛ na a bini kasinteŋ kɛrɛdɛ ken.
O takapɔ ŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ bolarawa wobolee, kɛ o waa waa chwera la a ɛ kasinteŋ dɛ do wer.
Wejereme wobol do kɛŋɔ, daa peteɡre aa kpɔa dɛɛ teɡɛ peera ken.
O wobosɛɡla ɡe do kɛŋɔ, baa lɔ dadowɛre do kon ta, a lawɔ kpoŋe.
Korowiirii ɛ Peteɡre beŋkpoŋ waa lole dɛ tɛ ya bwa.
N bie, nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ wobɛlbwa kpɔ ja a ta.
Tɔne chwera ta jaɡa dɔe, kwaa hwela kohona ɡelɔ nɛn ɛɛ ɡwɛɡre.
No waa la bwa name, a jaɡa bwaa kɛŋɔ, ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta, waa aa chɛ kɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa ɛ laanee.
Wobɛlbwa yaa dɛ ɛ la, Korowii ɛɛ bol a waa, dɛ́ pa bole, andɛɛɡa ne anchɔɡa bwa, hale anɔ la aa sɔah bwa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Yela Bini Yelsom Tɔn nɔ ɛ yel waa cheɡa tɛ bonɔɔ bɛl ne bitolo waa dɛ nyinu wa.
Ba bol waa dɔŋa be, dɛ baɡle ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin dɔŋa, ne ɡɛ baa pɛ so.
Anee dɛɛ baɡle kɛ nyina aa chɔ baa ne haah baah ta la waa hiaoh.
Korowiirii ta ɡɛ waa la, ásɛ a che a ta yá dɔ silɛɛ.
A chɛ kɛ yá won jemɛ nɛn waa dɛ bol waa tɔn nɔ baŋ bɛlbwa ta, ɡɛɛ ba kpɔ ja tɔn nɔ ta.
Kooro Solomɔn yela bini yelsomee nɔ.
Yel loɡle Hanfale waa dɛ pɛlɛ o jaa nɛɛ ne o daamanar wa Baɡle nyina kohona haa dɔa tɛ mɛ, he nyina dɔ pɛla kohona dɛ ɡwaa sen.
He nosɔɔhsoma sɔɔh som, he sɔn do kɛŋɔ baa fuɡe nosɔɔhsoma ta.
A waa ɡela bitoli bwa ɛɛ nyin he wa.
Laɡ mɛ kaa warane, n dɛ nyin kɛ n kooro laɡ mɛ kaa o dem warane!
Daamanar la Yá hɛɡre, dɛ́ ɡel ya sie lɛ kohona, yaa kpɛɛ he nyina haa dɔa laanee ɡwaa kɛ ya nyɔ sen. Hanfale la A waa ɡela bitoli bwa ɛɛ nyin he waa kɛrɛdɛ la!
Jerusalam bitoli, n biro dɛ do wer, n biro kɛŋɔ tɛnte deene aa lɔ Keda pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, kɛ dɛ berɛ do wer kɛŋɔ, Kooro Solomɔn koodem pateesanre.
Bɛ men ɡɛɛh, n bira maa bira wa, weeree ɡela n bir.
N nimanar baah di n nɛ dɛ ɡel n kaa ɛ daa koo bini toma, n ta bɔr dɔe dɛ nyiŋi n daa koo ta.
N sɛno maa dɛ nyini kohona, baɡ mɛ bela he peera aa dɛ di, ne bela aa ba dɛ onɛ webaŋa.
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ ń kpɔ sie sɔh yal bini, kɛŋɔ haah waa dɛ teŋɛ peteɡra bane ne ba peera nɛɔ?
Daamanar la Haah haa wera haahna bwa bini, haa jemɛ kɛ he teŋɛ peera luɡri ta, dɛ kpɔ he bombiire a kaa di peteɡra la kukujeɡre jwɛh.
Sɛno baa la N sɛnodɛɛɡe, n kpɔe dɛɛ maɡɛ Ijipt kooro jaaɡɔnee baa vɔwɔ pɛl torɔɡo ta ken.
Na ɡɛ he siebɔr ne deŋna kwa aa wera, he baŋa ne suuɡaswɛm baŋa kwaa ɡe do wer.
Yaa ɛ suuɡaswɛm deŋna kwaa tɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡapoŋ kwaa o bwara.
Hanfale la N kooro taa chɔ o kara ta la, n nosɔɔhsoma sɔɔh lɛ bɔr bwa.
N sɛno maa dɛ nyinu sɔɔh som kɛŋɔ korobo, dɛ do n ela baah.
N sɛno do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa fea, dɛ do daa kooni aa lɔ Ɛn Gedi harɛ ta ken.
Sɛno baa la N sɛnodɛɛɡe, na ɡɛ haa do wer, he wer tolo ɡa!
He sibie wer kɛŋɔ borɔnoma sibie.
Hanfale la Na ɡɛ haa do pwɛre, n sɛnodɛɛɡe, he waa dɛ lɛ n sie kohona.
Kpɔɡlwɛɛ ɛ ya chɔɔbɔr.
Sɛno baa la Peleme dolii ba kpɔ chiɡri ya dea, asɛ dadɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi ɡee ba kpɔ ɡoo.
Hanfale la N do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa fee aa lɔ Sarɔn harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta, dɛ do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa fee aa lɔ nenabɔɔ bini.
Sɛno baa la Gɛ kpɔɡ fee aa wera dɛ do sɔɔhne baah la, ɡɛɛ haah maa dɛ nyinu do toli bini.
Hanfale la Gɛ apol daa aa lɔ kɔr bini, dɛɛ nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡa la, ɡɛɛ baa maa dɛ nyinu do wer bonɔɔna bini.
N sie lɛo kɛ ń so o chunchule lɔɡa, o nɔna som n nyoa bini.
O laɡ mɛ ba bela waa di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ o sie, dɛ baɡle o nyina waa dɔa tɛ mɛ.
Tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa ne bosɔɔhna, he daa nɔna aa hola ne apolre dɛ do som, dɛkalkɛ he nyina waa ɡboo lɔ n liire bini.
N kpɔ nyu dawɛ o nɔŋɡal ta, o nɔndiɡ ɡbaa mɛ pɛl o te.
Jerusalam haahna, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, hé ŋwɛɛ komɛlbwa sɔn ta baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ, haa n ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe baahnee chɔɡ.
He bɛ ya nyina chɔɡ, ka tel kɛŋɔ ya nyina aa tona.
Yel nɛɛte Hanfale la N dɛ no n sɛno taa.
O tuo le bwejena dor warane, dɛ chwa kpɔ deŋɡarere dor dɛɛ ba n be.
N sɛnodɛɛɡe ɡbaŋre kɛŋɔ chwae kɛɛ kweɡlibale, onee ka cheɡa pɛl danjwɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi tokorore ta la.
Baa maa dɛ nyinu ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ir che, n sɛno, n sɛnodɛɛɡe, ásɛ n ne he kaa.
Nyiŋi na, waa saŋ baa kaa, bwaala ɡe toole.
Kpɔɡa dɛ fe harɛ ta bobɛlbwa, yela ɡoe saŋ telo name, asɛ bilore ɛɛ si harɛ ta bobɛlbwa.
Fiɡ daa nɔna pa mun dɛɛ ɛ bie, daa fee sɔɔh tɔ bobɛlbwa.
Ir che n sɛno, ir ba n sɛnodɛɛɡe, ásɛ n ne he kaa.” Sɛno baa la He do kɛ bilo waa kaa sɔh bwebɔɔ bini.
N dɛ nyin he wer haa doa la dɛ na, ɡel ń no he taa waa soma la.
Lawɛ kalampoŋare aa do jeɡre la mɔɔ á chɔɡ ya daa kooni aa dɛ ba fee la.
Hanfale la Menee dɔ n sɛnodɛɛɡe, asɛ o ɡee dɔɔ mɛ.
O ɡbo peeraa dɛɛ di kpɔɡa aa dɛ fe la bini.
Laa berɛ ba, n sɛnodɛɛɡe, ka tel kɛ bɔr aa chaahna biro bɛlbwa aa wola toole kpa, dɛɛ chwa kɛŋɔ chwae kɛɛ kweɡlibale, waa lɔ Bɛtɛr Bwejena dor.
Maa chɔ n kalaŋ ta jwaana bwa la, n lii n sɛnodɛɛɡe wa.
N nyin o bɔr, kɛ n ta on nae.
Mɛɛ iruu dɛ́ ɡaaɡe bwɛjen la bini, o fɔɡbaahna ne bela nɛra aa dɛ so.
Mɛɛ ka ɡaaɡoo nyin nɛn n bambile aa lawa.
N ɡaaɡɔ n ta on nae.
Nɛra baa dɛ daah bwɛɛ la ɡaaɡɔ dɛ ba puu mɛ, asɛ n bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He na nɛn n bambile aa lawɔ mɛɛ nyinu kohona la aa?” Maa dena ɡar ba n den na n sɛnodɛɛɡe la.
N bamu ŋɔ maa ɡel ó kaa, ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba o ne n nya dem, bela baa lol mɛ.
Jerusalam haahna, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, hé ŋwɛɛ komɛlbwa sɔn ta baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ, haa n ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe baahnee chɔɡ.
Yel toorote Hanfale la Bɔkwaa le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ le chuu dɛɛ kaa nyundua a sɔɔh do som, kɛŋɔ daawiile ne korobo bonadiire aa dɛ yoɡa nɔɔ?
Hé na, Kooro Solomɔn kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheo laanee.
Banyoola fifraanumɛl teŋɛ o nɛ, ba ɛ Israel harɛ nomonjena ɡbaɡba.
Ba bwa kpoŋe tokobie, dɛ bwa dɔ yoi wejema kɛrɛdɛ.
Bɛlbwa tokobii sɛɡle o baŋ bɛl, dɛɛ kpa wobɛlbwa aa ba jwaana.
Kooro Solomɔnee ɡela ba kwaa ɡɛ kon la ba kpɔ dɛɛ cheo.
Dadɛɛɡa aa le Lɛbanɔn nee o kwaaro.
O daa aa paaɡa la, suuɡapoŋee ba kpɔ ɛ a bwara, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ o mun la ɡe.
Ba kpɔ yakɔl bɔle o kara ta, Jerusalam haahna kpɔ kondɛɛɡa ɛ o bini ne o habɔɔ bwa.
Jerusalam haahna, hé le ba, dɛ́ ba na Kooro Solomɔn kooɡbɛrɛ o nya aa kpɔa piu, awola o sie aa lɛa kohona wɛɛ ɛ o hanfalwaa la.
Sɛno baa la N sɛnodɛɛɡe, na ɡɛ haa wera!
He wer kohona to!
He kpɔ yal bɔle he nyu, asɛ he siwinyiŋi do kɛŋɔ borɔnoma sibie.
He nyumpona biro kɛŋɔ bombiŋere aa tua le Gelead Bwejen doa dɛɛ ba.
He nyena too kɛŋɔ peera baa fonɛ a pona a le dɛɛ ba.
Bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ pɛo valɛ dɛɛ ba, beŋkpoŋ ɡba ta o te pere.
He nyotɔne swɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ ŋwɛnswɛm, a ne wobol do wer kohona.
He faɡra dɛ nyɛɡle yal bini.
He baŋa jaŋne dɛ siɡri, dɛ do wer, kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid dejaŋ ken.
He baŋa kwaa saɡre teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta anjeɡre kaɡboŋ.
He ela wer kohona, a do kɛ kweɡli bii anɛ, aa dɛ di kpɔɡa fee bini ken.
Mɛɛ ka so deŋɡare daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, ne korobo aa lɔ o taa, ka tel chɔɔbɔr ɡɛ saŋ biro aa wola toole kpa.
N sɛnodɛɛɡe, he wer kohona to, kirihiah bɛlbwa toole he nɛ.
N hanfale, le Lɛbanɔn bwea dor dɛ́ ba n be, le Lɛbanɔn bela ba n be.
Le Amana Bwejen doa tu ba, Senir ne Hɛmɔn Bwejena dor, bela nyujentena ne nonietena aa lole.
N hanfale ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe, he ɡelɔ n bambile lawɛ kohona, he nyiŋ mɛ kerabeŋkpoŋ he waa lɛ n liire, he baŋa kon beŋkpoŋ haa doa la wa.
N hanfale ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe, na ɡɛ n sie aa lɛ he nyina haa dɛ nyin mɛ ta!
He nyina dɔ pɛla kohona dɛ ɡwaa sen, asɛ he konsɔɔhsoma sɔɔh ɡwaa daawiile baa dɛ fuah sɔɔh.
N sɛnodɛɛɡe, he nyoa nee som kɛ tohnoo ken, wobosoma lɔ he nyoa, he yale sɔɔh som kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn yale.
N hanfale ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe, he do kɛ bodɛɛɡe baa du daa, ne nee nomɛlbwa aa wola won nyɔ ba tɔ a nyoo.
Kwaa aa lɔ bela kpeɡo dɛ do wer.
A do kɛŋɔ daa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ pɔmeɡranet dɛɛ nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡa.
Kwaa aa sɔɔh aa soma ne alele ta bela nyae, ne safrɔn, ne kalamus ne sinamɔn, ne korobo, dɛ konsɔɔhsoma aa wera bwa soo siwi.
He do kɛŋɔ nenapale nyu bodɛɛɡe baa du daa, kɛŋɔ bule waa dɛ palɛ wɔrɔbe nɛ, dɛ le Lɛbanɔn bwejena dor dɛɛ ba.
Hanfale la Weekaŋle nyundua peu ir, ásɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr peu ɡe ta.
Ta kpɔ bodɛɛɡe maa du daa la, ásɛ daa la sɔɔh yɛɛ kaa bojaŋ.
Gel n sɛnodɛɛɡe ba jo daa la baah, dɛ́ di a nɔna aa soma la.
Sɛno baa la N sɛnodɛɛɡe ne n hanfale, n ba bodɛɛɡe maa du daa.
N boa n konsɔɔhsoma ne korobo bwa nyoa.
N di n tohvaahna ne n tohno, dɛ nyɔ n sen ne na-elne.
Daamanar la N daamanar, hé di kondikwa dɛ nyɔ sen. Hé nyɔ ɡɛ bɛlbwa ɡɛ haa won.
Yel naarɛte Hanfale la Maa chɔa kwaraa la, dɛ n ta dɛ kpɔ liire.
N noɔ kɛŋɔ n sɛno aa lɔ ɡbera dɛ ŋɔ, “N hanfale ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe, he wer kɛŋɔ borɔnoma, he ta kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, yaa mɛ ɡbera.
Mɛn pwe n nyu bwa, kɔɔla ta jwaana, n nyumpona pwe.” N laa n batakaare foo, a chɛ kɛ ń berɛ kpɔ do ja aa?
N sarame n nakpale, ń berɛ kpɔ valɛ harɛpɛɛ aa?
N sɛno ha nɔn lawɛ ɡbera, asɛ n bambile ɛɛ lɔ o wa.
N iro ŋɔ n yao ɡbera, n nonie ne n nɔɔra bwa maa korobo, ɡɛ saŋ maa lawɛ ɡbera la koŋkare kon la.
N ya ɡbera ŋɔ n sɛno fee ba jo kɛ o kaalɔ, n ta on nae.
N bambile chɔɡ kaala waa kaala wa, asɛ n nyin o bɔr n ta on nae, n yerɔ ɡe o ta chaŋɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ daah bwɛjen la ɡaaɡɔ dɛ ba chem mɛ o bini.
Ba lɔɔ mɛ, dɛ do mɛ bol, dɛ lɛ n yal kaa.
Jerusalam haahna, hé baɡ mɛ nyoa, dɛ he na n sɛnodɛɛɡe la aa, hé ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o nyina kohona ɡelɔ n bambile chɔɡ, mɛɛ nyin o bɔr.
Daamanar la Haah waa wera haahna bwa bini, he sɛnodɛɛɡe la korɛ sɛnanar bwa bini kɛɛ?
Bɔkwaa ɡela o te ɡbosoroo waa korɛ, asɛ he ŋɔ ya baɡɛ nyoa ɔ?
Hanfale la N sɛnodɛɛɡe la wer bonɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ, o bwara ɡe do kpeɡri, o dɔŋ toole baala kaɡboŋa fi bini.
O siebɔr wer dɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten, o nyumpona ɡuɡro dɛ do wer, dɛ bir kɛŋɔ ɡaahɡaah ken.
O sibie wer kɛŋɔ borɔnomare aa toa kohona kɛŋɔ na-elne, dɛ do nenabɔɔne nyoo.
O faɡra wer kɛŋɔ bodɛɛɡe baa du daa konsɔɔhsoma su o bwa.
O nyotɔn do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa fee aa wera, korobo noo pweoh.
O nɔɔra wer kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm bune, baa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa cheɡ a ta.
O bwadabii wer kɛŋɔ bala nyen baa loɡao la, dɛ kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane a yoɡ aa kpeɡa cheɡ a ta.
O nakpale wer dɛ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ pilare baa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa aa toa ɛa, asɛ a chɔŋɛ suuɡaswɛm loɡa ta.
O mar wer dɛ dɔ jirima kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn peleme dajaŋa.
O nyoa som ne moe, o wobɛlbwa wer tɛ mɛ.
Jerusalam haahna, ɡɛ n sɛnodɛɛɡe aa doa mɛɛ nyinu kohona laanee la.
Daamanar la Haah waa wera kohona haahna bwa bini, leperaa he sɛnodɛɛɡe kaalɔ?
Baɡle yaa bela waa kaala, ásɛ ya chae hé nyin o bɔr.
Hanfale la N sɛnodɛɛɡe kaa bodɛɛɡe waa du daa konsɔɔhsoma aa su o bwa.
O sie dɛ lɛ a ta dɛ kaa nyin ane, dɛ kaa nyin kpɔɡa fee aa wera.
Menee dɔ n sɛnodɛɛɡe, asɛ o ɡee dɔɔ mɛ, o ɡbo peeraa dɛɛ di kpɔɡa fee aa wera baah ta.
Yel nuete Sɛno baa la N sɛnodɛɛɡe, he wer tolo, kɛŋɔ koobwɛjena Tirsa ne Jerusalam.
He waa dɔ jirima kɛŋɔ laa tena baa kpoŋe fraŋkaare.
Laa sie kpɔ n nɛ, ásɛ ba bɛ men lawɛ.
He nyumpona biro kɛŋɔ bombiŋere aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ tu le Gelead deŋɡarere ta dɛɛ ba.
He nyena too kɛŋɔ peera baa sɔa ne a le dɛɛ ba.
Bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ pɛo valɛ dɛɛ ba, beŋkpoŋ ɡba ta o te pere.
He faɡra dɛ nyɛɡle yal bini.
A do ɡuleɡule kɛŋɔ daa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ pɔmeɡranet nɔna.
Dɛ haŋkoranar fifraanumɛl, ne sɛnanar fifraanuatoro, dɛ toli baa wola baala jemɛ mɔɔ, baa wola nyoa dɔe kwara baa che naa, n sɛnodɛɛɡee wera tolo kohona kɛŋɔ borɔnoma.
O ɡboo mɛɛ nyin, onee o nya bihambeŋkpoŋ ɡbo waa dɛ nyinu kohona.
Bitoli nao waa, ba dɛ yerɔ nɛn waa na som, haŋkoranar ne sɛnanar dɛ kpɛɛro.
Daamanar la Umee wera tolo kɛŋɔ bɔr aa dɛ chaah nɔɔ?
O wer kɛŋɔ korobie, dɛɛ chaah kɛŋɔ wee.
Sɛno baa la N la almɔn daa koo ta, dɛ́ ka na kɛŋɔ mɛɛ na a fee, kɛɛ dɛ́ na ɡrepo ne pɔmeɡranet daa fee.
N bwara yɔrɔ mɛɛ chel kɛŋɔ nɛn waa kpɔ kooro torɔɡo dɛɛ la ka yo laa ken.
Daamanar la Sulam tolo, berɛ ba, berɛ ba.
Berɛ ba, ásɛ ya nyiŋi!
Sɛno baa la Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin he nyiŋi Sulam tolo, waa dɛ sa Mahanaim sae nɛra baah ta nɔɔ?
Sɛno baa la Koobie, toldɛɛɡe, na ɡɛ he nakpale ne naŋɡawa aa wera.
He nakpale dɔ pɛla kɛŋɔ, bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.
A do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema aa ɛa.
He ul do ɡuleɡule kɛŋɔ numol, sen ne konsɔɔhsoma suu dɛɛ ta saŋ bɛlbwa.
He tea do ɡuleɡule kɛŋɔ mea baa vɔwa, asɛ kpɔɡa fee aa wera baro cheme.
He ela wer kohona, a do kɛ kweɡla bii anɛ.
He baŋa jaŋne dɛ siɡri kɛŋɔ dejaŋ baa kpɔ bala nyen ɛo ken.
He sibie dɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn taama aa lɔ Bat Rabbim doonyoa.
He mee toɡrɔ kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn dejaŋ o sie aa chaɡɛ bwɛjen Damaskɔs.
He sɔn ɡɔɔrɔ kɛŋɔ Kaamɛl Bwejen.
He nyumpona jaŋne dɛ bir dɛɛ nyɛɡle, hale kooro kwaraa pɛla dɛ lawɛ.
Na ɡɛ haa wera tolo he waa ɛɛ lɛ sie, he nyina waa dɛ lawɛ n bambile kohona.
He jaŋne kɛŋɔ kpor da, he ela do kɛŋɔ daa nɔna sao.
Asɛ n ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ teeh daa laanee dɛ́ ka lawɛ o bie.” N dɛ nyin kɛ he ela do kɛŋɔ ɡrepo daa nɔna n be, he hweera sɔɔh som kɛŋɔ apolre a sɔɔh aa soma, asɛ he nyoa som kɛŋɔ sensoma tenten.
Hanfale la Gel sensoma la palɛ bɔeeh, ka kpɔ n sɛnodɛɛɡe nyotɔn ne o nyena ta bwa.
N sɛnodɛɛɡee dɔɔ mɛ, n ɡbo nɛɛ o pɛla do.
N sɛnodɛɛɡe, ba yá kaa bwɛɛ dahare, ya kaa ka chɔ bwɛjeɡre la ta jwaana.
Gel ya fel ir kaa daa kooni ta, dɛ́ ka na kɛ a pa mun dɛɛ fe, kɛɛ a fee pili sie, kɛɛ a nɔna aa do ɡuleɡule dɛ be, ásɛ n baɡle n nyina maa dɔa tɛɛ bela.
Kwaa fee sɔɔh lɛ bɔr bwa, asɛ silɛɛ kwaa bwa soo siwi, ambena ne anfala bar yaa cheme, asɛ he waa do n bambile bini, mɛɛ nyin he ɡbo wa.
Hanfale la N dɛ nyin kɛ he fe aa ɛ n nimambie, n ne he bwa aa ɔr n nya el.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel n ne he chemo aa, n fe ɡbaare pɛl n te nɛra baah, nomɛlbwa aa wola won pwaah mɛ.
N fe ɛɛ tɔ he sie dɛ́ ba he ne n nya dem, onee baɡ mɛ wa.
N fe ɛɛ tɛɛ sen a sɔɔh aa somaa he nyɔ, n daa fee nee ba harama ɛ sen. N kpɔ n nyu dawɛ o nɔŋɡal ta, o nɔndiɡ ɡbaa mɛ pɛl o te.
Jerusalam haahna, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, hé ŋwɛɛ baɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ, haa n ne n sɛnodɛɛɡe baahnee chɔɡ.
Yel numɛlte Daamanar la Umee le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛɛ ba dɛ kpɔ o te dawɛ o sɛno nɛɛ nɔɔ?
Hanfale la N iro che daa waa dɛ nɔnɛ lɔɡa, dɛ lawɛ ir bela baa lolɛ la.
Gel n ɡbo waa do he bambile ta saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ baŋe do he nɔn ta, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ seo aa wola jaɡa dɔe la, ɡɛɛ n ne he dɔŋa nyina do.
Baa ne haah meera kpeɡri kɛŋɔ seo, a won nii lawa kɛŋɔ nijena ken.
Mpo neerare aa won dime nyina nii, mojena bwa ɡe aa won su dɛ́ pala kaa.
Hale dɛ nomɛl ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔ o dea suuɡa bwaa yawɛ nyina aa, mamaa baa ba o mama.
Daamanar la Ya dɔ nimambie waa ɛ bitolo, waa wola ela leɛ mɔɔ.
Dɛ baa balɔ ŋɔ o dɛ nyinu waa, bɔkwa waa yaa ba wona ɛ tɛo wɔ?
O fe do kɛ danjwɛɛ aa, ya fe ɛɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋee ma dejaŋ chɔŋɛ o nɛ.
Dɛ o do kɛŋɔ doonyoa ɡbera daa ɡe aa, ya fe ɛɛ sɛh peleme daa dɛ́ tɔ o nɛ.
Hanfale la Dɛ n fa do kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ ken, kɛ n ela kpeɡo kɛŋɔ dejaŋa.
Anomanta, n sɛnodɛɛɡe jemɔ kɛŋɔ n dɔ bansɔɔhna ne deŋnesɔɔhna dɛɛ le o be.
Dɛ Kooro Solomɔn dɔ daa koo Baal Hamɔn, dɛ kpɔ tɛ paara ba lɛ dɛɛ parɛ o ta.
Dɛ bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ o kpɔ suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋ baa tɛo.
N daa koo ɛ n ɡbo kon n won kpɔ tɛ.
Kooro Solomɔn, he ken dɔ suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋ, asɛ paara baa dɛ nyiŋi koo la ta ɡe dɔ suuɡapoŋa lafraanɛ.
Sɛno baa La N sɛnodɛɛɡe, n bala bwa chemo dɛɛ kpa, ɡel ń no he taa le bodɛɛɡe haa du daa la.
Hanfale La N sɛnodɛɛɡe, ɛ warane ba n be, chwa ba warane kɛŋɔ kweɡla kɛɛ kweɡlibale waa le bwejena konsɔɔhsoma aa lɔ o ta doa.
Korowii Keamere Tɔne Le Aesaya Tɔn ta ka jaɡɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔobene Tɔn nɔ jaɡa la, tɔne la dɛ bol waa Korowii keamere ɡalɡa aa bola wa.
A ɡɛ keamere nɔɔ teŋa nɔ, Aesaya ne Jeremia, ne Ɛsekeɛl ne Daneɛl, ne Hosia ne Joel, ne Emɔs ne Obadia, ne Jona ne Maeka, ne Neehum ne Habakuk, ne Sefania ne Haɡae, ne Sekaria dɛ Malakae.
Korowii bol waa keamere la be ŋɔ bá bol o waa la baɡle nɛra.
Ba bini bane kaa bol o waa la Israel tena be, asɛ bane ɡe ka bola Juda tena be.
Ane ta, dɛ waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa kerekeree baa bol, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ɡɛɛ Korowii kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Kɛ waa aa hiah laanee kɛŋɔ ba dɛ bol o waa la, a ɛ amanesoma kɛɛ dɛ amanechɔɡaa yoo.
Aesaya Tɔn Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Aesaya baa bol Korowii waa Juda tena be.
O kah ba ŋɔ bá charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ Korowii bɛ ba deŋne tɛr.
Nyiŋi nyuune —.
O berɔ bol ɡɛ saŋ baa lawɛ nɛra la laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta wa, dɛ berɛ baɡ ba nyoa kɛŋɔ hwɛɡa ta lole kerekere.
Nyiŋi nyuune —.
Korowii aa ba waa soh, wɛɛ tɛɛ ba koofalee ó di kora saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Nɛn Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ bao ba lɛ yaa la.
Onee Mɛsaya.
Waa ɡalɡa taa baa ba cheɡa, dɛ́ baɡle ɡɛ Mɛsaya la aa dɛ ba ba ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ dɛ́ na wahala, ásɛ dɛ koh o nɛra wechɔɡa waa sewɛ lɛɛ ba.
Nyiŋi nyuune :—:.
Waa aa lɔ nyu :- ɛ Yeesu Kristo wobol ɡɛ saŋ waa dɛ pa o toma mun.
Nyobaɡa ane ɡe lole kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ berɔ ɡel wobɛlbwa ɛ anfala.
Nyiŋi nyu :-.
Baa bɛlee fa lole baa yerɔ Emɔɔs, o bibaa sɔne Aesaya.
Korowii pili waane bini kɛŋɔ deera ken baɡle Aesaya, aa ba Juda harɛ ta ne Jerusalam chiɡa.
O naa ɡɛ saŋ koranar bane aa di kora teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ Juda harɛ ta, banee Ussia ne Jotam ne Ahas, dɛ Hɛsɛkea.
Korowii bol o nɛra wechɔɡa wa Aesaya ŋɔ, Nɛra haa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ, hɛ́ɛ no waa Korowii aa bola!
“N dɛɛ n bii dɛ nyiŋ ba ba kpeɡ, kɛ ba kpaŋe n nɛ.
Nao jemɛ o dɔɔ, asɛ keeɡo jemɛ kon o dɔɔ aa kpɔ kondikwaa do o bini dɛɛ tɛo.
Kɛ n nɛra Israel tena te aa men jemɛ, baa waa mun no.” Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡbo harɛ, nɛra ba wechɔɡa aa ɡwaa ba nɛ, wechɔɡ-ɛɛra naanar ɡboɡbo, he vɛh Korowii, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoo.
He dɛ nyiŋi Israel tena Nɛŋɡoroŋ la nyubaah.
Bɔkwa waa he ta do he kpaŋa nɔ ta nɔɔ?
Deŋnetɛra besoo he ta ɛɛ nyin jaɔ?
He bwadabii bwa dɛ we heya, he sie ta harɛ chole.
Le he nyu ta ba ta harɛ, he bobɛlbwa toole dɛ do kpeɡri.
Ŋwɛra ne bela aa darawa ne chale ɡboo he bwa.
Ba ta an jaɡrɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa do tɛɛɡa a taa dɛ́ vɔwa.
He harɛ berɛ dimɡbia, nomɛlbwa toole o ta.
Ba kpɔ nii do he bwɛjena ta a fuh, hɔɔhra dɛ di he kooni kwa, he siwi taa baa chɔɡ a bwa.
Jerusalam chɔ pɛɛ kɛŋɔ kuku waa cheɡɛ daa koo ta ken, kɛŋɔ kuku waa cheɡa pɛɛ mea koo ta ken, kɛɛ bwɛɛ baa baro cheme dɛɛ ba o yoi ken.
Dɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro fe ta ya nɛn tamaa bane ɡelaa, ya bwa fe serewɔ kwaraa kɛŋɔ Sodom ne Gomoora tena ken.
Jerusalam tena, he ne he nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta, he do kɛŋɔ Sodom ne Gomoora tena ken.
Hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔ aa dɛ baɡle heya.
O ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa kwaa haa dɛ kpoo kohona dɛ kpɔ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la ɛɛ baɡleɔ?
Kwaa haa kpoora dɛ fuah dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ jam mɛ, pebala, ne ola noorare pe mɛ, nae ne pebiiri ne boohna chale aa men pɛla dɔ.
He dɛ ba dɛ́ ba tom mɛ naa, umee ŋɔa he ba nɔ?
Bɔkwaa dɔ n soŋnibɔr ba tiɡra ɔ?
He saraha kwaa bɛlbwa ta tɔnɔ dɔe n be kpa.
Hé ɡel a ne bala.
N kii konsɔɔhsoma haa dɛ fuah.
He wechɔɡa bɔle he korobifala, ne Ona Tɔpera, ne he chema haa chema dɛɛ tom mɛ bwa ta.
N bambile aa he Korobifala Tɔpejena dii ne tɔpejena haa lea cheɡ dɛɛ di kwa dɛɛ lɛ sie a ta la lawɛ.
Name te n koɔh, a le n mee.
He ir nɔɔra dɛɛ soŋ mɛ naa, mɛɛ laa sie kpɔ he nɛ.
Hale he soŋ mɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa noo, maa no.
Nɛra haa kpoora chal maa he nɔɔra bwa.
Hé sɔ he wechɔɡa ta dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ he nɛ.
Hé laa he wechɔɡwe-ɛɛla la kpɔ le n sie!
Hé ɡel a ɛɛ, dɛ́ do sie wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta!
Hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ cha nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa.
Hɛ́ɛ bol bilalbii ne luhaahna waa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Men Korowii ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, Hé ba ya pɛ kpɔ liire.
Dɛ he wechɔɡa kan dɛ chɔɡ heyaa kɛŋɔ kombiŋere yon chɔɡ kompoŋ la aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo he to kpelkpel kɛŋɔ yabi ken.
Hale dɛ a biro kpirkpir kɛŋɔ sibire kwaraa naa, mɛɛ ɡeloo he to kɛŋɔ pepoŋ pona ken.
Dɛ he ɛ deŋnepwɛr dɛ no n be te naa, hɛɛ dɔ harɛ la ta kondɛɛɡaa di.
Kɛ dɛ he vɛoh dɛ ta do he kpaŋa la ta te naa, laa nyoa hɛɛ ba kae.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Bwɛɛ kasinteŋ diile fa aa lɔ o ta, taraken ba do kɛŋɔ haah waa le o jaa habɔɔ dɛɛ nyin baala ken.
Nɛndɛɛɡa ɡboo fa o bwa, kɛ taraken nɛŋkpoa su o bwa.
Bwɛɛ he fa aa do kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ la, taraken haa were kpa.
He fa do kɛŋɔ sendɛɛɡa, kɛ taraken he do kɛŋɔ baa pule nee a ta ken.
He nomonome kpaŋe n nɛ, dɛ berɛ ka kpɔ ŋwɛɛra ɛ ba chamene tena.
Ba dɛ nyin kɛ nɛra ɛɛ yaɡ ba sen, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ koŋkɛɛla ɡbo ta.
Baa bilalbii waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kɛrɛdɛ, ɡɛɛ baa wola sie do luhaahna waa ta.
Anomanta, Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel Kpeɡnɛn la ŋɔ, “Namete he berɛ n dɔma n bwaawee ir he nɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee bɔ kem ásɛ n baah sɔɔh mɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee kohona, dɛ ɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ suuɡaswɛm do nii ta dɛ laa o doŋa kpɔ o ta la ken.
Mɛɛ berɔ ɡel he dɔ nɛra baa bol he waa dɛɛ pa bole, ne nɛra baa dɛɛ ja heyaa kɛŋɔ he fa aa dɔɔ ba wubwa la.
Ásɛ mɔɔ bá berɛ yerɛ heyaa Kasinteŋ Diile bwɛ, Nɛndɛɛɡa bwɛ.” Waa bola dɛ́ pa bole kasinteŋ ne taa Korowii ɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ lɛ Saayɔn tena.
Nɛra baa charɛ ba liire dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra la, wɛɛ lɛɛ baa.
Nɛra baa kpaŋe o nɛ, ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la, wɛɛ pɛo chɔɡ ba bwa.
Asɛ nɛra ba ɡe aa vɛoh la, ó kpoo ba ɡe.
“Sihiih ɛɛ kpo heyaa daa haa dua dɛɛ toma la waa.
Hɛɛ di nchoo bela haa du kwaa dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa a baah ta la waa.
Hɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ dajen o papooni aa jwala dɛɛ chure ken, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ daa baa dua baa wola nee a mune do ken.
Bokpeɡa tena ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ daa aa hola ken, asɛ ba toma baa toma ɡe do kɛŋɔ nii ken.
Kombele anɛ nɔ bwa ɛɛ pɛo dɛɛ fuh nomɛlbwa aa wola won dima.”
Korowii Bwejen waa lɔ Saayɔn Waa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡle Emɔɔs bibaa Aesaya, a ɛ Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam harɛ ta waa nɔ.
Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ bwe Korowii Dea aa chɔŋɛ o ta Jerusalam la waa ba hiah ɡwaa bwea bwa, ásɛ o sɔn le bwea bwa bini, ásɛ harɛre nɛra warɛ dɛ́ ba o ta.
Nɛra ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ ka ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya kaa Korowii Saayɔn Bwejen la doa Jerusalam, Korowii Jekɔb aa tomɔ la Dea.
Wɛɛ baɡle yaa o ŋwɛnɛree, ásɛ yaa valɛ o webaɡla ta.” Saayɔn Bwejen taa o Mmarare ɛɛ ba lee, bá bol baɡle o nɛra Jerusalam bela.
Wɛɛ bol harɛre nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ kwaa ba baah.
Baa beɡre ba kerii a ɛ para, dɛ́ beɡre ba lampeare ɡe ɡoori.
Harɛre nɛra aa dɔŋaa yo, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa hweli laa waa kpa.
Jekɔb naanar, hé ɡel yaa valɛ Korowii waa aa chaahna o kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ yaa la ta.
Korowii Tɔpere waa lea cheɡ N Naa Korowii, he vɛh he nɛra Jekɔb naanar.
Ba lɔ wee leebɔr tena wepuu ta, dɛ berɛ voɡra kɛŋɔ Filisti tena, dɛ jo nɛra baa wola hen tomɛ we-ɛɛla ta.
Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ɡboo a ɡɛ nɛra la harɛ bwa, ba kondɔɔh a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ta nyoa dɔe.
Jaɡre ɡboo ba harɛ bwa, asɛ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore ba kpɔ dɛɛ la laa ɡe ta nyoa dɔe.
Voɡa ɡboo ba harɛ la ta bwa.
Kwaa ba ɡbabir aa ɛa laanee baa tomɛ.
Ba dɛ ɡuŋi kwaa ba ɡbaɡba aa kpɔ nɔɔra ɛa.
Anomanta, hen Korowii ɛɛ ba ba bɛlbwa ne harɛɛ, ásɛ ba di sihiih.
N Naa Korowii, bɛ ba wechɔɡa kpɔ kɛ ba.
Hé bwa chwa ka jo bwebɔɔne bini, hé takapɔ dɛ́ kwi bɔɔne dɛ́ jo a bini, dɛ́ le Korowii bandia ne o kpeɡri dɛ o jirima kohona la ta.
Nɛn nyanyini ɛɛ tonɔɔ ɡɛ saŋ, ásɛ maŋkurae nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ maŋkura o te la ba harɛ, Korowii ɡbo sɔnee dɛɛ ba lee ɡɛ saŋ.
Nemenɛ Korowii le tɔpere bɛl cheɡ, dɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo ne sɔnnyin, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɡɔɔ ba te, dɛ́ ba ba ne harɛ.
Wɛɛ chɔɡ Lɛbanɔn peleme dajaŋa ne Basan dajena ɡe bwaa, ne bwejaŋa ne deŋɡarejena bwa, ne dejaŋa dɛ danjwɛɛre baa maa bar bwɛɛre a do kpeɡri bwa.
Hale stiimaere bonadiire aa dɛ so a bini, ne stiimajena andɛɛɡa bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo.
Nɛn nyanyini ɛɛ ba harɛɛ ɡɛ saŋ, ásɛ maŋkurae nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ maŋkura o te la tonɛ.
Korowii ɡbo sɔnee dɛɛ ba lee awola tɔpere, ásɛ voɡa ɡe bwa nyoɡre kwaraa.
Nɛra ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ kohona, dɛ́ chwa ka jo bwebɔɔne, dɛ́ kwi bɔɔne dɛ́ jo a bini, dɛ́ le Korowii bandia ne o kpeɡri, ne o jirima kohona la nyoa, ɡɛ saŋ waa ba jiɡri harɛ la.
Nɛra ɛɛ pa ba voɡa baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ɛa, dɛɛ toma laanee ta a wola tɔpere, ásɛ a berɛ daŋɡboŋre ne jereme kwa.
Baa kpɔ ɔmee chwa ka jo bwebɔɔne, ne bwejena aa peɡra la baah, dɛ́ le Korowii bandia ne o kpeɡri, ne o jirima kohona la nyoa, ɡɛ saŋ waa ba jiɡri harɛ la.
He bɛ hwɛɡa kpɔ do nɛwɛnyini nɛɛ kpa.
Waa sewaa?
Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini ɡeɔ?
Juda ne Jerusalam waa bola dɛ́ pa bole Hé no, Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛ ba nɛra ne kwaa Jerusalam ne Juda tena aa kpɔ ba te dawɛ a nɛɛ la laa dɛ kpɔ.
Wɛɛ tɔ ba kondikwaa ne nee ŋwɛnɛɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba banyoola ne laa tena, ne nɛra baa bol ba waa dɛɛ pa bole ne ba keamere ne ba voɡra, dɛ nomonome, ne nomonome baa chɔ laa tena nyoa ne bwɛɛ nomonome, ne nɛra baa dɛ ja ba, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ dobodobo we-ɛɛla bwa soo siwi.
Bonɔmbiee mɛɛ ba ɡela bá chɔ ba nyoa, nɛra baa wola kpeɡee dɛɛ ba ba harɛre la ta nyiŋa.
Nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ fiiɡi dɔŋaa, nɛn pu o dɔŋ dɛɛ yo, chamenate ne o chamenate ɛɛ yo.
Bechale aa ba nomonomee duu, nɛnsale ɡe aa nɛra baa dɔ nyanyinii kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Nɛn ɛɛ lawɛ o lole bɛlee dɛ́ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Henee dɔ bwara laala.
Ba di ya nomonome, saŋ waa chɔɡa dɛ do kpeɡri nɔ ta!” Wɛɛ iruu che ɡɛ saŋ dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Akai!
Maa won ɛ he nomoa dɛ́ cha heya.
N ta kondikwaa ne bwara laala bɛlbwa dɔe n dem.
He bɛ men kpɔ ɛ he nomoa.” Jerusalam paɡrɔ, Juda harɛ ɡe chɔɡ.
Nɛra baa lɔ bela nyoa wobol ne ba we-ɛɛla dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
Ba pili nyoa dɛɛ chɛɡɛ Korowii waa ɛ jirima te la.
Ba siebɔra ɡba dɛ baɡle ba nɛnsoo.
Ba dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa kpelelee kɛŋɔ Sodom tena, baa an sɔh.
Bá bwɛɛlɛ!
Ba ɡbaɡbaa nyin ba wahala dɛ dɔ.
Gel nɛra ba wa aa toɡra no kɛŋɔ aa do werii tɛɛ ba.
Baa di ba we-ɛɛla tɔnɔɔ.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwɛɛlɛ!
Aa do kpeɡrii tɛɛ ba taeh.
Waa ba ɡbaɡba aa ɛa la kembɔree baa ba dɔe.
Toli ne bonɔɔna dɛ fiiɡi n nɛra.
Haahnaa dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ dɛɛ do ba.
N nɛra, he sitɔɔla ɡelɔ he nyoɡre.
Ba ɡelɔ he nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ.
Korowii soɡo dɛ́ bol nɛra wa.
O kpɔ o te dɛɛ ba o nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole.
Korowii dɛ ba o nɛra nomonome ne ba sitɔɔla waa bola dɛ́ pa bole.
O ŋɔ, “Heyaa he n daa koo.
Heyaa pa nyaara kwaa le ba be kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa, dɛ kpɔ su he be deene.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Haa kɛrɛdɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ fɔɡɛ n nɛra, dɛ pa nyaara kwa, dɛ lawɛ ba sie dɛɛ teɡɛ harɛ nɔ.
Men Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooroo ŋɔa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Saayɔn haahna dɛ ɡɔɔ ba te, dɛ valɛ dɛ laa ba baŋa pa, dɛ kpɔ sie dɛɛ nyin baala.
Ba dɛ valɛ tolvala naɡale bori ne, asɛ naloɡa baa kpɔa do ba nakpale la ɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa.” Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo Saayɔn haahna nyubaahna chuɡri ŋwɛra, ásɛ ba nyuune ɡba.
Gɛ tɔpere la telaa, Korowii ɛɛ laa ba tolkwaa laanee kpɔ.
Wɛɛ laa ba naloɡa ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ saɡre ba nyumpona ta, dɛ ba baŋa kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ korobie dɛ le loɡla la, ne deŋna kwa, ne nɔnloɡa, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ bɔle nyuune ta laanee kpɔ.
Wɛɛ laa ba botidɛɛɡa ne ba naloɡa ne ba kirisore ne konsɔɔhsoma loŋa dɛ sɛbɛre aa lɔ ba chararee kpɔ, ne noniseɡa, ne noniseɡa baa kpɔa dɛɛ do ba mee ta, ne ba laaladɛɛɡa, anɔ la baa doa a baa chiɡ harɛ, ne anɔ la baa doa dɛɛ dawɛ ba laala baa dɛ doa ta, dɛ ba purjeɡre, ne diɡe, ne ba laalapoŋa andɛɛɡa, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba nyuune, dɛ anɔ la baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba sie, a bwaa wɛɛ ba laa kpɔ.
Konsɔɔhsoma a fe aa ɡel ba bwaraa sɔɔh do som la, sɔɔhraa ba bwara ɛɛ ba sɔɔhra, ásɛ ɡboɡbie ber ba kirisore, ásɛ ba nyumpona ba yon ɛa a do wer la bwa chure, ba nyuune ɡba, ba laaladɛɛɡa bwa berɛ yakwane, ásɛ ba wer tu, ba berɛ di sihiih.
Kere nee baa ba he bini baala kpoora a wola tɔpere, he kpeɡnɛra baa won yoi bwa ɡe ka laa ta.
Bwɛjen Saayɔn doonyoo ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ bwɛjen la do kɛŋɔ haah tea bini aa chɔɡa, o so harɛ dɛɛ wi la.
Gɛ tɔpere la, haahna banuanɛɛ ka lɔɔ tɔ babeŋkpoŋ nɛɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ, “He te kpɔ he sɔn dawɛ ya nɛɛ dɛ mo yaa, dɛ laa sihihsɔn haŋkwii la kpɔ ya nɛ.
Yaa hen kondikwaa waa pɛɛ, yaa hen yal waa pɛɛ.” Baa berɔɔ kwaa vɔrɔwe Jerusalam Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo nomɛl ba a ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ́ dɔ jirima dɛ́ do wer kɛŋɔ baa teŋe daa ta o berɛ forɛ le o buɡ ta dɛ do wer la.
Ásɛ nɛra baa ba ka Israel harɛ ta, dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu la bwa sie lɛ o nɛ, dɛ́ dɔ jirima le o nɛ.
Nɛra báa ba ka Jerusalam Korowii aa ɡela ba dɔ ba nyu la, báa yer baa nɛra baa do ɡoroŋee.
Gɛ saŋ la, Korowii ɛɛ fee haahna la doŋaa ta, dɛ́ fee nɛra baa kpoo nɛra Jerusalam la doŋa ta.
Wɛɛ che o kpeɡri taa dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne, dɛ́ fee doŋa aa lɔ harɛ la bwa ta.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ninchuu ɛ kɛŋɔ baama, dɛ́ ba tɔ Saayɔn Bwejen ne nɛra baa lɔ o ta nɛ webaŋa, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel nii ɡe tɔ ba nɛɛ dɛɛ chaah ba jwaana á ɛ kɛŋɔ chunchule, dɛ́ tɔ bwɛɛ la jirima bwa ta, bɔwɔb aa ban kpo webaŋa, hale bá dɔ bɔr dɛ́ chwa sɔh bwaala ne o peu ta.
Daa koo bɛl yel Mɛɛ ɡo nɛn maa dɛ nyinu yelee.
Gɛ yel nɔ ɛ n chamenate, ne o daa koo yel.
O para deŋɡare harɛdɛɛɡe bɛl ta.
O buɡli harɛ la, dɛ laa bwea aa lɔ o ta bwa pa mɔɔ dɛ nyin dadɛɛɡa chɔɔ o ta, dɛ chiɡri jɛŋla baa so o ta dɛɛ kpa koo la.
O komɛ bwe bɔɔ, bela baa ba tiɡri a nɔna ta a nee le.
Name o soɡo dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ aa nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡaa, kɛ a berɛ nɔnɛ nɔnchɔɡa.
Nɛra haa lɔ Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ ta, hé nyiŋi n ne n daa nɔ wa bini dɛ́ na.
A fe ta ka waane n fee ɛ daa la ta, asɛ n ta wone ɛ kɛɛ?
N fe dɛ nyin kɛ a nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡa, aah bɔkwaa bera ɡel a nɔnɛ nɔnchɔɡa nɔɔ?
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he jemɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ ba daa la ɛɛ.
Mɛɛ laa kwaa baa kpɔa keo laanee pa, ásɛ kwaa dia dɛ́ chɔɡa.
Mɛɛ kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa baro la ɡee, ásɛ kwaa tiɡra do harɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ maa wola belaa parɛ kpa, maa daa la kpalaa kɛ, ásɛ sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛ le bela.
Maa ɡel bwaala nɛ harɛ la ta kpa.
Koranar Bwa Kooroo dɔ daa koo la, asɛ koo la che tɛ Israel tena.
Daa la cheɡɔɔ tɛ Juda tena, banee daa waa chɔɔra o sie lɛ a ta la.
O fe dɛ nyin kɛ baa ɛ waa aa wera, asɛ ba berɛ dɛɛ kpoo nɛra.
Dɛ o dɛ nyin kɛ baa ɛ wedɛɛɡa ɡe, kɛ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba wii wɛɛ no.
Wechɔɡa nɛra aa dɛ ɛ Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la haa yawɛ deremi dɛɛ ja deremi ta, dɛ berɛ yawɛ kooni dɛɛ ja kooni ta, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ bɔr aa wola lee do tɛ he bala, asɛ he ɡbo lɛ harɛ dɔɔh dɛ so.
Nemenɛ Korowii bol waa a chole n deŋna ta.
O ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, demjena ɛɛ che dimɡbeenii, deremi aa kana dɛ do wer ɛɛ cheo nɛn aa lee do dɛ́ so a bini.
Daa katori fi nɔna, ɡalɔŋre anue ɡbo senee dɛɛ ba koo la ta lee, ásɛ kuruware lafa kondwee haa dua la, hale kuruwa fi kwara, haa dɔ.” Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la haa ira chɔmbibi dɛɛ ti sen, he banɔ la haa dɛ were sen mun ka tel kɛŋɔ haa dɛɛra.
Hé dɛ di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ he sie aa, he dɛ lɔ janjela dɛɛ yiiɡi kwaa dɛɛ hoh kalipere.
Kɛ Korowii we-ɛɛla te, haa sie a ta do, anɔ la waa dɛ ɛ, haa on duu.
He waa mun bɛ noe nomanta, baa lawɛ heyaa kaa harɛfale bɛl taa, dɛ kaa do heya.
Lɔr ɛɛ kpo he bini banɔ la baa chɔ he nyoa bá serewe, ásɛ dansaara haa ka la, nyɔɡre kpo heyaa he serewe.
Lalabwɛɛ chɔɔ dɛɛ kpaa ba, o doonyoa pilo che.
Jerusalam nomonjena ne dansaara ba sie aa lɛa baa do ɡbɔɡa la bwa ɛɛ jo belaa.
Anomanta, sihiih ɛɛ kpo mbarafo tenaa, dɛ́ ba nomɛlbwa ne harɛ.
Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ bol waa dɛ́ pa bole kasinteŋ ne, dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ baɡle o kan waa doa.
Wɛɛ che waa aa toɡra taa, dɛ́ baɡle ɡɛ waa do ɡoroŋ.
Peera ɛɛ chwe kpɔɡa bwɛɛ la dimɡbia taa.
Bela ɛɛ berɛ pebiiri dibɔree.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la haa cheɡɛ nyosone ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ tɛɡre wechɔɡa dɛɛ teŋɛ he nɛ, he banɔ la haa kpɔ he bokpeɡa dɛɛ ɛ nyubinikpeɡ kɛŋɔ baa do nao ɡboɡbii dɛɛ tɛr la.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ he banɔ la haa dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Korowii, ɛ warane dɛ́ ɛ he toma ya na.
Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ, baɡle he ŋwɛnɛre ya jemɛ.” Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la haa dɛ yerɛ wechɔɡa wedɛɛɡa, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ yerɛ wedɛɛɡa wechɔɡa, haa kpɔ biro berɛ bochaah, dɛ kpɔ bochaah berɛ biro.
Hé kpɔ koŋkpela berɛ kontora, dɛ kpɔ kontora berɛ koŋkpela.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la haa dɛ lii he te wejerema, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ he jemɛ wobɛlbwa ɡa la.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la haa dɛ yerɛ he te baala sen nyɔe ta, he baah su haa wola sen baa kpɔa koo dɔŋa nyɔe ɔmɛ la.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he banɔ la wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ yawɛ heyaa sen hɛɛ ta ba, dɛ́ yon pa bolsom te bolchɔɡe la.
Anomanta, ɡɛ ninlao yon piɡri lawɛ jaaɡesɛɛh dɛ́ fuah, kɛɛ dɛ yon fuh kpɔɡhola la, ɡɛɛ he ɡe ɛɛ ba tona kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa lune yon pɔh a fee ɡe hol, peu kpɔa kaa kɛŋɔ tutuɡ ken, dɛkalkɛ he vɛh Nemenɛ Korowii Mmara la, dɛ lii Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ waa waa kpɔa baɡle heyaa la wepuu.
Anɔ bwa ɡelɔ Korowii baah di o nɛra nɛ, o ir nɔn dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne.
Bwejena ɛɛ jiɡruu, ásɛ nɛra baa serewe la lala chɔ fɔɡbaahna kɛŋɔ haahra ken.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ o baah aa sɔɔh, o nɔn waa ira dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne la ɡe ta cheɡɛ ɡɛ.
Korowii ɡɔɔ o fraŋkaa dɛ yerɛ nɛra le bojaŋ harɛre ta.
O foolɔ yerɛ o nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa.
Hé na!
Ba chwao dɛɛ ba wɔrɔbe nɛ.
Ba bini bɛlbwa aa koh, kɛɛ baa lɔ nakpalaa.
Dom aa bɛlbwa chuɡli, baa dom ɡe chɔ.
Kirisore baa vɔrɔwa áa foo, ásɛ naŋɡaware baa doa ɡe áa kɛɛ.
Ba hɛma nyɛɡre, ba harɛ ba tori dɛɛ ba tae.
Jaɡre baa soɡe a ta la nafikokore kpeɡri kɛŋɔ kwɛrboɔ ken.
Kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore nakpale dɛ kile kohona kɛŋɔ kawulewule ken.
Ba ɡbɔɡa do kɛŋɔ nyujentena aa dɛ si.
Gɛ nyujente lawɛ ol dɛ́ yon tuuɡu dɛɛ kaa dɛɛ kɔɡre la, ɡɛɛ ba lawɛ n nɛra dɛɛ kaa, dɛɛ ɛ, nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛɛ ba.
Gɛ tɔpere la telaa, baa do ɡbɔɡaa, dɛ́ ba jo Israel harɛ bwa kɛŋɔ mpo yon dɛɛ si la ken.
Dɛ he nyiŋi harɛ la aa, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ bɔr biro ásɛ sibeɡra chole nomɛlbwa nɛ, ásɛ biro tɔ bochaah ta.
Korowii yerɛ Aesaya ŋɔ ó ɛ o keame A bena Kooro Ussia aa sewa, men Aesaya na Korowii chaahna ta, dɛ o soɡe kookara waa daŋa dɛ ɡwaa komɛlbwa ta, asɛ o laala tɔ Korowii Dea bela harɛ bwa.
N berɔ na hweera kwaa ane aa dɛ lawɛ nii dɛ baro cheme baa yera Serafim.
A bɛlbwa dɔ kena anumɛl.
A kpɔ a kena la bini anɛ dɛɛ tɔ a siebɔr, dɛ kpɔ anɛ dɛɛ tɔ a nakpale ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ anɛ aa kaa la ɡe dɛɛ ir.
Asɛ a bini bɛlbwa ɛɛ ŋɔ o dɔŋ be ŋɔ, “Koranar Bwa Kooro do ɡoroŋ, o do ɡoroŋ kɛrɛdɛ.
O jirima su harɛ nɔ bwa ta.” Asɛ a taa ɡel Korowii Dea la doonyoo ɡbeni daa la ne a doonyojoo bwa ɛɛ jiɡri, chuu tɔ Dea bela bwa.
Anee n ŋɔ, “Akwe!
N na wa.
Wechɔɡa ɡboo n nyoa wobol bwa, asɛ n so nɛra wechɔɡa aa lɔ ba nyoo baah ta, dɛ berɛ na Koojen, Nemenɛ Korowii nɔ.” Belaa Serafim la bɛl kpɔ nyɛwa, dɛ kpɔ ka nyɛwɛ nihɔl le kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta, dɛ kpɔ ir ba n be, dɛ ba kpɔ tɔrɛ n nyoa dɛ ŋɔ, “Na, nihɔl nɔ aa tɔre he nyotɔn nɔ, he bolchɔɡ bwa le he nɛ.
Korowii kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛɛ.” Asɛ men Aesaya berɛ no kɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa ŋɔ, “Umee ń tomɔɔ?
Umee dɛ́ la tɛ yaɔ?” Anee n sɛh ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ lao, tom mɛ.” O ŋɔ, “La dɛ́ ka ŋɔ Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, ‘Hɛ́ɛ no n waa kohonaa, kɛ haa a mun noe ba, hɛɛ nyiŋi a bini kohonaa, kɛ haa waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa jema ba.’ ” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ka ɡel nɛra nɔ bambile do kpeɡri, tɔɔɡe ba deŋna, dɛ tɔɔɡe ba sibie ɡe.
A waa laa aa, ba sie fe ɛɛ nao, ásɛ ba deŋna no, ba bambile lawa, bá berɛ ba n be ń lɛɛ ba.” Anee n ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, dɛ ka tel saŋ besoo?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ bwɛjena la aa berɛ dimɡbia, nomɛlbwa aa wola a taa so, ásɛ deremi aa lɔ a ta la chɔ pɛɛ, kooni bwa berɛ pua.
Mɛɛ doŋi nɛra laanee kaa bojaŋ, dɛ́ ɡel harɛ la bwa chɔ pɛɛ.
Dɛ nɛn beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ka harɛ la ta kwaraa naa, mɛɛ chɔɡ o ɡbaa.
Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ ba yon teŋe daa a ka o muŋkpul che dɛɛ moɡɛ la.” Daa la muŋkpul la cheɡɔ tɛ n nɛra baa ba ka harɛ la ta la.
Kala aa kaala dɛɛ tɛ Kooro Ahas A ɡɛ saŋ, laa chole Juda Kooro Ahas ne koranar banɛ bane baah ta.
Koranar la bɛlee Siiria Kooro Resin, bɛl ɡee Israel Kooro Pɛka, o mɛɛ sɔne Remalia.
Kooro Ahas ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Jotam, o nabaa ɡee Ussia.
Kooro Resin ne Pɛka kpɔ ba laa tena ba Jerusalam dɛ ba yoo ba, kɛ ba ta wone pɔ ba nɛ.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ tel Juda Kooro Ahas ne o nɛra be kɛŋɔ Siiria tena ne Israel tena pɛo ba harɛ la ta dɛ́ ba yoo ba, asɛ ba bwara yɔr dɛɛ sa kɛŋɔ peu aa taa jo daa bini la.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Aesaya be ŋɔ, “Yerɛ he bie Sea Jasub, ásɛ he ne o ka cheme Kooro Ahas bɔɔ baa kwiu feelɔɔ ken le nyundua tam la ta nee palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ o bini la harɛbɔr, ŋwɛnɛ baah ta bela baa dɛ ɛ yale toma la.
Ŋɔ Kooro Ahas be ŋɔ ó sɔɔh bwara, wɛ́ɛ berɛ ɔma.
Wɛ́ɛ berɛ ɡela o bambile chɔɡ.
Ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, nindaa anɛ chuu ɔma ɡwaa Kooro Resin, ne o harɛ Siiria tena dɛ Kooro Pɛka ne o nɛra bandia.
Siiria tena ne Israel tena ne ba kooro nyoa pɛo ba dɔ liichɔɡa dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛŋɔ, bá ka jo Juda tena harɛ ta dɛ́ yoo ba, dɛ́ bɔne o bini, ásɛ bɛ́lbwa dɔ o pera, dɛ́ kpɔ Tabeel bibaa so kora ta wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi o bwa ta.” Anee Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Aa ɡɛɛ ba.
Aa chiɡa ba.
Damaskɔs laa Siiria harɛ bwɛjen aa?
Kooro Resin ɡee Damaskɔs nyu te.
Onee umeo?
Bonɔ bene fifraanumɛl dɛ anue dɛ Israel harɛ paɡrɔ, waa bwɛbirii tel kpa.
Israel harɛ ta bwɛjen laa Samaria aa?
Kooro Pɛka ɡee bwɛɛ la nyu te.
Onee umeo?
Dɛ he ta yarada dɔe dɛ che kiŋkiŋ naa, haa won che kɛrɛdɛ kpa.” Korowii tomɔ ba ka ŋɔ Kooro Ahas be ja ŋɔ, “Soŋe Korowii háa dɛ tomɔ dɛ́ na waane, hale dɛ le lalabwɛɛ kɛɛ nyundujaɡla, á baɡle waa nɔ kasinteŋ.” Anee Kooro Ahas ŋɔ, “Maa soŋe dɛ́ na wobɛlbwa, maa Korowii daah dɛ́ na.” Ate, Aesaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Kooro Devid naanar, hɛ́ɛ no.
