Hae haa dɛ ha nɛra ba mee le ta maɡrɛ, asɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin he ha Korowii ɡe naa?
Korowii ɡbabir ɛɛ ɡeloo he na waane, á baɡle waa nɔ kasinteŋ.
Hé no!
Bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ bwa ɛɛ kpoŋe teaa dɛ́ lolɛ bibaa, ásɛ ba yerɔ Imanoɛl.
O baa kpeɡ dɛ jemɛ wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa aa, waɡasi ne tohnoo ɡboo dɛɛ ba o kondikwaa ɛɛ.
A ne ɡɛ saŋ tela la, koranar banɛ nɔ baa dɛ aah heyaa nɔ, ba dɔma ɛɛ ba yoo baa dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, ba harɛre chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ.” Aesaya ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ Korowii ɡel wekpeɡa ba he ne he nɛra, ne he koodem nɛra nɛ, dɛ́ ɡwaa ɡɛ saŋ Israel tena ne Juda tena aa peɡri dɔŋa baah la.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ Asiiria koojen ne o laa tenaa bá yo heya.
Gɛ saŋ Korowii ɛɛ fooloo yerɛ Ijipt harɛ ta nɛra baa lɔ nee nyoa bojaŋ bá wur ba kɛ chwɛɛhne ken, ne Asiiria tena ba ɡe warɛ ba kɛŋɔ toohna ken.
Baa bao dɛ́ ba su fɛlembɔɔne ne bwebɔɔne bini, dɛ́ tɔ sɔɔhne ne kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa ta.
Gɛ saŋ Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ Asiiria koojenii kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ fonɛ dɛ le Yufretis Moo baŋ, ó ba fonɛ he nyumpona ne he tampona dɛ he bwara pona bwa.
A ɡɛ saŋ la baa tel dɛ nɛn dɔ nalor ne boohna anɛ kwaraa naa, aa wonoo tɛo elnee ɡɛ del waa dɛ nyin.
Nɛra baa ba dɔ ba nyu dɛ́ ka harɛ la ta la, waɡasi ne tohnoo ɛɛ bu ba nɛɛ.
Gɛ saŋ la, bobɛlbwa baa parɛ daa kooni la, daa kaɡboŋ a yoɡ aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋ la bwa ɛɛ heo, bela berɛ le sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛre ɡbo.
Nɛra ɛɛ kpɔ belaa berɛ kpaah bɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ hɛma jo bela.
Harɛ la bwa dɛ ba sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛre ɡbo lee.
Deŋɡarere ba fa aa dɛ para la, jabalnadaŋɛre ne sɔɔhnee dɛɛ ba a ta lee, nomɛlbwa aa wola won jo bela.
Nae ne peeraa dɛɛ ba bela kpɔe dɛ́ berɛ dibɔr.”
Korowii cheɡɛ Asiiria koojen nɛɛ ɛ o wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ja ŋɔ, “Nyin tɔnjen ásɛ dɛ chwerɛ waa maa dɛ́ ba bola nɔ do o ta.
Chwera a do bare.
Anee kɛŋɔ Mahɛr Salal Has Bas.
O munii kɛŋɔ, ‘Bá ɛ warane dɛ́ ka kam anɔ la baa won, bá kpɔ chwae dɛ́ ka pa laala aa kaa.’ Mɛɛ ɡeloo n dea sɔfo Uria ne Sekaria baa dɛ yerɛ o mɛɛ Jɛbɛrkea ɛ n danseɛ tena.
Ba waa dɔ kasinteŋ.” Aa la sie la, n haah kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Pao Mahɛr Salal Has Bas.
Bie la ne kpeɡa dɛ́ jemɛ ‘nya’ ne ‘mɛɛ’ yera la, dɛ Asiiria koojen baa pa Damaskɔs tena kondɔɔh ne Samaria tena laala laa ta kaa.” Korowii berɔ bol waa n be ja dɛ ŋɔ, “Jerusalam tena aa vɛh nyiŋa maa dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ bɔeeh kɛŋɔ Siloa nenabɔɔ aa dɛ palɛ bɔeeh, dɛ dɔ silɛɛ Kooro Resin ne Kooro Pɛka nɛɛ kɛŋɔ bá ba cha ba nomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo Asiiria koojen ne o laa tena yoo ba.
Báa ba ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ Yufretis Moo aa sua bɔle o diŋɡoŋni bwa ta, dɛ́ su kpɔ Juda harɛ bwa, dɛ́ tel ba baŋa ta dɛ́ bɔle komɛlbwa ta.
Imanoɛl, wɛɛ paɡri o kenaa tɔ he harɛ la bwa.” Anomanta, harɛre nɛra, hé lawɛ he te pɛ dɛ́ so ɔmee ta!
Harɛre haa lɔ bojaŋa bwa nɛra, hé no.
Hé kpɔ he te dɛ́ ka yo, kɛ hɛɛ ɔmɛ!
Hé kpɔ he te dɛ́ ka yo, kɛ hé ɔmɛ!
He vɔrɔwe vɔrɔwa bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, aa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
He bol wobɛlbwa ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin kwaraa noo, aa ɛ wepuu, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ne ya lole.
Korowii ɔma Belaa Korowii kpɔ o kpeɡri kah mɛ ŋɔ n bɛ ŋwɛnɛ Juda tena aa dɛ kpɔ ta teŋɛ.
O ŋɔ, “Bɛ vɔrɔwa bwa nɛra aa bol a waa he be la ta no, dɛ bɛ waa baa dɛ ɔma la dɛɛ ɔmɛ.
Jemɛ kɛŋɔ Men Nemenɛ Korowii do ɡoroŋ.
Menee chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɔmɛ.
Menee boɡoroŋ haa jo dɛ́ dɔ he nyu.
N berɔ do kɛŋɔ bwe Israel tena ne Juda tena aa lɔ naa dɛ choɡli, dɛ berɛ do kɛŋɔ bel dɛ chɔ kpa Jerusalam tena dɛ́ laɡ ba.
Ba ɡalɡa ɛɛ lɔ naa, dɛ́ choɡli dɛ kuuɡi.
Belii dɛɛ ba ba lawa.” Pa waa Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la bwa pɛ.
Marɛ o nyoa dɛ́ kpɔ cheɡ n habɔteŋra be.
Mɛɛ kpa Korowii waa waa bola la waa.
O laa sie kpɔ Jekɔb naanar nɛɛ taraken, kɛ mɛɛ kpɔ n hwɛɡaa do Korowii nɛ.
N ne bechale Korowii aa tɛ mɛ laanee la.
Nemenɛ Korowii waa soɡe Saayɔn Bwejen ta la ɡelɔ ya che tɛ waa aa dɛ ba ɛɛ Israel tena bini.
Nɛra ŋɔ he be ŋɔ hé la voɡra baa dɛ bol waa woroworo ne ajɔsaara be dɛ́ ka jemɛ waane bini naa, dɛ a dɔ mun aa?
Bɔkwa waa chɛ kɛŋɔ yá ka bɔɔ lala dɛ́ jemɛ weera waa bini nɔ?
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laa chɛ kɛŋɔ yá kpɔ ya waa dɛɛ bil o sie naa?
Báa teŋɛ me Mmara ne n webaɡla la ta!
Dɛ ba ta ɡɛ waa la aa dɛ baɡle la bolaa, amɔ te a do kɛŋɔ baa soɡe biro ta ken.
Ba bwara ɛɛ hwaoh baa valɛ harɛ la ta, lɔr ɡe kpo ba, ba kpɔ bandia ha sie nyundua dɛ́ taah ba kooro ne Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ.
Ásɛ dɛ berɛ nyiŋi harɛ, baa komɛlbwaa na ka ja wahala ne ɡɛ bɔr aa bira kpirkpir dɛ do ɔma, ásɛ ba ɡbɔɡ ba ta biro tenten la ta.
Ba lolɛ bie tɛ yaa Kɛ ane abwa, wenaale bɛlbwa toole dɛ ba nɛra ba bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ nɛ.
Saŋ la, Korowii ɡelɔ Sebulon ne Naftale deene tena harɛre sɔn ba harɛ.
Kɛ kerekere wɛɛ ɡeloo Galilia harɛ ta bela hɔɔhra aa wara dɛ koo Juu tena bini la bwa dɔ jirima.
Harɛ waa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ kaa moo la nyoa bela bwa.
Nɛra ba fa aa do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa soɡe biro ta, berɔ na nii bɛl o chaah tɛ ba bwa.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ ba wechɔɡa aa ɡela ba do seo lɔɡa, kɛ nɛra baa soɡe biro ta la, ba na nii bɛl o chaah kohona tɛ ba bwa.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ ba harɛ la nɛra ya, he tɛɛ ba silɛɛ kohona.
Ba dɛ hɛɡre he sie kɛŋɔ nɛra koo kondikwaa yon ɛ kohona baa koma dɛɛ hɛɡre la.
Ba berɔ dɛɛ hɛɡre kɛŋɔ nɛra aa kaa yo laa, dɛ pa ba dɔma laala dɛɛ bɔne la.
He pɔ ba dɔma ba fa aa dɛ ha ba, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ daa dawɛ nae anɛ nɛ aa parɛ, dɛ kpɔ daŋɡbale dɛɛ lɔɔra la nɛ.
Gɛ tentenee he kuuɡi daa aa dawɛ Midian tena nɛ dɛ lɛɛ ba.
Laala baa doa dɛɛ yo laa, ne kon te bɛlbwa chal aa ɛo la, baa kpɔa do nii ta a fuh, baa kpɔa mar nii.
Ba lolɛ bie tɛ yaa, bibaalee.
Onee dɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ bwa kooro ɛɛ, baa yerɔ Nyokponɛn, ne Nomondɛɛɡe Waa Won Nɛra Jae, ne Nemenɛ Korowii, ne Saŋ Te Bɛlbwa Mɛɛ, dɛ Deŋnesɔɔhna Kooro.
O kora ɛɛ do kanee dɛɛ ja saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ deŋnesɔɔhna aa wola jaɡa dɔe do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Wɛɛ chiɡ Kooro Devid naa taa, dɛ́ di kora.
O kora ɛɛ che kasinteŋ ne waa aa toɡra taa dɛ́ do kpeɡri, dɛ́ le saŋ nɔ ka tel waa bwa jaɡa saŋ.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ do siee dɛ́ ɛ anɔ bwa.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr Israel tena deŋnee Korowii bol waane Jekɔb naanar baa ɛ Israel tena be, aa ba ba pui, ásɛ nɛra la bwa jemɛ a wa.
Israel ne Samaria tena la dɛ ɡɔɔ ba te dɛɛ maŋkura ba te dɛ ŋɔ, “Berekese dea la cholo, kɛ yaa sɛh bweaa dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ ma.
Ba teŋni fiɡ daa aa pwɛra la ta, kɛ yaa kpɔ peleme daa aa kpeɡaa chiɡ a buɡe ta.” Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena dɔma baah di bá ba yoo ba.
Siiria tena le wee leebɔr, ásɛ Filisti tena ɡe le wee cholibɔr, dɛ́ ba haah Israel tena pɛ dɛ́ laɡ ba lile.
Anɔ nɔ bwa habɔɔ Korowii baah aa sɔɔh, o nɔn waa ira dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne la ɡe ta cheɡɛ ɡɛ.
Israel tena la ta ba liire charɛ ba deŋnetɛra la habɔɔ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa nyin Nemenɛ Korowii bɔree.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr Israel tena nomonome ne ba nɛra deŋnee.
Wɛɛ teŋ baa ta kɛŋɔ baa teŋe daa nyundua ne o harɛbɔr bwa ta ken.
Nomonome ne nɛra baa dɔ jirima laanee daa la nyu, asɛ Korowii keamere baa dɛ teŋe nyosone o waa la ta la, ɡee daa la harɛbɔr.
Nɛra baa tɔ nɛra la sie la, ɡelɔ baa koni, dɛ ɡel banɔ la baa teŋɛ ba nɛɛ la ɡe nyoɡre kwaraa.
Anomanta, Korowii sie aa ba bini bonɔɔna nɛɛ lɛɛ ba, hale waa bilalbii ne luhaahna kwaraa sum nae ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba bini bɛlbwa aa o waa ta teŋɛ, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, ba wobol aa were.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, o baah aa sɔɔh, o nɔn waa ira dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne la ɡe ta cheɡɛ ɡɛ.
Ba wechɔɡa do kɛŋɔ nii naa dɛ lawɛ, dɛɛ fuh jabalnadaŋɛ ne sɔɔhne ken.
A dɛ lawɛ kɛŋɔ kɔr aa dɛ fuh, a chuu ɛɛ kaa nyundua la ken.
Koranar Bwa Kooro bandia nomanta, o deŋnetɛra do kɛŋɔ nii aa dɛ fuh harɛ la ta bwa, dɛɛ fuh nɛra.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa o dɔŋ sumii na kpa.
Baa kah kondikwaa nɔndiɡ ne ɡal bwa nee dɛɛ di, kɛ baa vaɡɛ, hale dɛ́ larawe ba biirere chwe.
Manasɛ dea nɛra ɛɛ yo Efrem dea nɛraa, ásɛ Efrem dea nɛra ɡe yoo ba, a ɡɛ deene anɛ nɔ ɛɛ pɛo dɛ́ yo Juda dea nɛra.
Anɔ nɔ bwa habɔɔ, Korowii baah aa sɔɔh, o nɔn waa ira dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne la ɡe ta cheɡɛ ɡɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ do mmarare aa wola aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ, ne mmarakpeɡa dɛ́ fiiɡi nɛra la, ba bwɛɛlɛ.
Ba laa nyaara waa sie dɛɛ berɛ, dɛ laa nɛra baa lɔ wahala ta waa dɛɛ ɡole, dɛ lɛ luhaahna kwaa dɛɛ le ba be, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ kah bilalbii ɡe kwa.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ awola Korowii aa dɛ ba he deŋne tɛra, ne wenaale aa le bojaŋ ba he nɛɛ laɔ?
Umee hɛɛ ba chwae ka marɔɔ?
Leperaa hɛɛ ba he kondɔɔh la ɡela ɔ?
Wobɛlbwa toole hé ɛ kpa, nemenɛ hé ja nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta, kɛɛ banɔ la baa ka kpoo la nɛ.
Anɔ nɔ bwa habɔɔ, o baah aa sɔɔh, o nɔn waa ira dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne la ɡe ta cheɡɛ ɡɛ.
Asiiria tena bole pae Korowii ŋɔ, “Asiiria tena bwɛɛlɛ!
Mɛɛ kpɔ baa ɛ kɛŋɔ n ɡuli maa kpɔ dɛɛ tɛr nɛra n baah aa di ba nɛɛ deŋne.
Nɛra baa wola men tomɛ la bee mɛɛ ba Asiiria tena toma, nɛra baa dɛ ɛ n bandiwaa la bee mɛɛ ba ba doe bá ka yoo ba, dɛ́ pa ba laala dɛ́ kah ba kondɔɔh, ásɛ dɛ tiɡri ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ kpechɛɡre aa lɔ fɔɡbaahna ken.
Kɛ Asiiria koojen te fe aa an ɡɛ nyin, dɛ o liire laa.
O waa bwaa kɛŋɔ o fee den chɔɡ harɛre ɡalɡa bwa kwara.
O dɛ maŋkura o te ŋɔ, ‘N laa sitɔɔla bwa ɛ koranar!
Gɛ maa chɔɡ bwɛjena Kaakɛmes ne Kalno ne Aapad ne Hamat dɛ Damaskɔs la, ɡɛɛ n chɔɡ Samaria ɡe.
Gɛ maa wona tɛr harɛre a voɡare aa wara dɛ ɡwaa bwɛjena Jerusalam ne Samaria voɡare deŋne la, maa won ɛ Jerusalam harɛ ne o voɡare ɡe ɡɛ maa ɛ Samaria harɛ ne o voɡare la kɛɛ?’ ” Dɛ Korowii baa tonɛ ɡɛ waa ɛ nɛra baa lɔ Saayɔn Bwejen doa ne Jerusalam bwa naa, wɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Mɛɛ ba tɛr Asiiria koojen deŋnee o mbarafo ne nyiŋa waa nyiŋi nɛn dɛɛ vah la wa.
Dɛkalkɛ o dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘N ɡbabir bokpeɡa ne n wejemaa n kpɔ ɛ waa nɔ bwa.
N chɔɡ harɛre jwɛhre dɛ yoo ba dɛ pa ba kondɔɔh.
Banyoo tentenee men.
N ir koranar ba kora ta.
N pa ba kondɔɔh kɛŋɔ jumbie kɔr ne hala ken.
Gɛ nɛn yon ka pu kwaa hala kɛŋɔ a chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ o yon pa la, ɡɛɛ n kpɔ harɛre la bwa.
Bɛlbwa ta parawe kɛɛ dɛ si.’ ” Kpanfɛ ɛɛ won ŋɔ o ɡwaa nɛn waa kpɔɔ dɛɛ teŋe daa aa, kɛɛ saradaa ɛɛ won ŋɔ o ɡwaa naate waa dɛ ɛ o ne toma aa?
Guli ɛɛ won ɡɔɔ o te dɛ nɛn laa kpɔɔ waa?
Kɛɛ da ɛɛ won ɡɔɔ nɛn aa?
Anomanta, Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ kpɔ ɡwaŋa weelaa ta Asiiria koojen laa tena baa kpeɡa kohona nɛ, ásɛ dɛ chɔɡ o jirima kɛŋɔ nii yon fuh kon tonɛ la.
Korowii waa do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah Israel tena, wɛɛ berɛ niinii dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa.
Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ Israel tena ɛɛ tomɔ la, ɛɛ berɛ ninlawee, dɛ́ fuh komɛlbwa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ, hale sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛ bwa.
Wɛɛ fuh kɔne aa wera, ne harɛdɛɛɡa bwaa kwara, komɛlbwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo.
Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ serewe weela aa lɔ nɛn nɛɛ la.
Daa aa ka o kɔr la bini la, tamaa kenii dɛɛ ba kae, ásɛ bechajeɡa kwaraa won kura.
Israel tena baa kaa wa Gɛ saŋ la, Israel tena baa kaa la aa hwɛɡaa dɔ Asiiria koojen waa lɔ ba harɛ la nɛɛ kpa.
Korowii Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la nɛɛ baa ba ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ kasinteŋ ne.
Ba bini tama ɛɛ berɔɔ ba Nemenɛ Korowii be.
Israel tena, dɛ he warɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle kwaraa naa, he tamaa dɛɛ ba kae dɛ́ berɛ ba.
Chɔɡa chɔ le dɛɛ kpa heya.
Gɛ Korowii aa cheɡ heyaa la, he chɛ ɡɛ.
Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛɛ ba chɔɡa waa vɔrɔwa cheɡ la ne bala ba ta harɛ la bwa ta.
A ɡɛ nomanta, Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛ bol ŋɔ, “N nɛra haa lɔ Saayɔn, hale dɛ Asiiria tena kpɔ daa dɛɛ lɔɔ heyaa ɡɛ Ijipt tena fa aa ɛ heyaa la aa, hé bɛ ban ɔmɛ.
A ka tamaa ken dɛ n baah sɔɔhnɔ, maa hé deŋnee tɛr kpa, ásɛ dɛ berɛ n bandia ta Asiiria tena ɡe nɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.” Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ lɔɔ baa chweema nee, ɡɛ waa ɛ Midian tena dɛ kpoo ba Oreb bwe ta la.
Wɛɛ ir o daŋɡbalaa pa nee ta, ɡɛ waa ɛ Ijipt tena ba ka nee ta la.
Mɛɛ laa wahala baa dɛ ɛ heyaa a berɛ heyaa bone laanee kpɔ he nɛ, ásɛ wobɛlbwa le he baŋa a ɡɛ saŋ.
Hé na!
Laa tena jo bwɛjen Aiyat, dɛ kpɔ Meɡrɔn dɛɛ ba, dɛ ka kpɔ bone ka cheɡ Mikmas.
Ba le ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔa kaa Geba baŋ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Yaa ka chɔ Gebaa jwaana la bwaa.” Ɔmee lawɛ Rama tena ba bwara ɛɛ sa, Kooro Sɔɔl bwɛɛ Gebea tena ir chwa.
Galim tena, hé do lɔŋɔre!
Nɛra haa lɔ Laisa ɡe, hé no.
Anatɔt tena, hé waa sum.
Madmena tena dɛ chwaaɡe, ásɛ Gebim tena ɡee ir ba buɡ ta dɛ́ kaa nyin ba nyu.
Fini tɔpere nɔ, baa bao dɛ́ ba che Nɔb.
Baa nyiŋi Jerusalam Saayɔn Bwejen la taa, dɛ́ ume nɔɔra pa ba nɛɛ dɛɛ aah ba.
Hé no!
Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ ba ba ne harɛɛ, kɛŋɔ baa choo daa dɛɛ ta la ken.
Dajaŋa la, wɛɛ teŋaa ɡo, dajena ɡe bwa choɡli.
Wɛɛ teŋ baa ta, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ kpanfɛ teŋni kɔr baah daa dɛɛ ta la ken.
Ba kpeɡri kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn daa kwara naa, wɛɛ teŋ baa ta.
Kora deŋnesɔɔhna aa lɔ o ta Kooro bɛl ɛɛ le Jese bie Devid luɡe taa dɛ́ ba, kɛŋɔ daa yon pamɛ le o muŋkpul ta, dɛ dɔ kpala dɛ nɔnɛ la.
Korowii Doma ɛɛ so o nɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel o dɔ wejema ne waa mun noe, dɛ́ jemɛ nɛra jae dɛ́ dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel ó jemɛ Korowii waa bini dɛɛ duuru.
Korowii duuraa dɛ́ lɛ o sie.
Waa nɛra siebɔree nyiŋi dɛ́ pa bole, waa nɛra wobol taa teŋɛ dɛ́ pa bole.
Ŋwɛnɛ waa toɡra taa wɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛɛ bol nɛra aa hiah ba wa, dɛ́ pa bole, kasinteŋii wɛɛ ba kpɔe dɛ́ bol harɛ nɔ ta nyaara waa tɛɛ ba.
O nyoa wobolee wɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛr nɛn deŋne, waa waa bol la ɛɛ kpoo wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa.
Waa aa toɡra ne kasinteŋii wɛɛ ba kpɔe ɛ kiriso, dɛ́ kpɔ vɔwɛ o chara.
Gɛ saŋ, ɡbolo ne pebie ɛɛ pɛ bobeŋkpoŋii, noniete ne booh pɛ chɔ.
Nao bie ne puadɔɔ ɡe pɛ bobeŋkpoŋ dɛɛ di, bechala ɛɛ teɡa.
Nao ne sisire ɛɛ pɛo dɛɛ di bobeŋkpoŋ, a bii ɡe pɛ dɛɛ chɔ, puadɔɔ chwe kpɔɡa kɛŋɔ nao ken.
Bechala ɛɛ huuhnuu ka hɛlɛ bɔɔ biro aa lɔ o bini nyoa, bechala ka kpɔ nɔn do domkpule bɔɔ bini waa on wobɛlbwaa ɛ. Nɛra aa ba dɔŋaa kpo kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡ komɛlbwa kpa, Korowii Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.
Nɛra ɛɛ jemɛ Korowii harɛ la bwa taa, kɛŋɔ mpo aa yɛɛra la ken.
Awola tɔpere la, Jese naa waa dɛ ba bala la ɛɛ cheo tɛ harɛre nɛra bwa kɛŋɔ fraŋkaa, ba bwa ɛɛ ba cheme o siee bela waa lole la, dɛ́ kpɔ jirima tɛo.
Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ berɔ che o kpeɡri ta lɛ o nɛra baa kaa dɛ le Asiiria ne Ijipt ne Patrus, ne Itiopia ne Elam ne Babelɔn, dɛ Hamat harɛre bwa, dɛ banɔ la bwa baa lɔ bojaŋa harɛre ta.
Wɛɛ ir fraŋkaa harɛre nɛra nɔ bwa na, dɛ́ boa Israel tena baa laɡ ba ka so harɛre ta la nyoa, dɛ́ ɡel Juda tena baa peɡra kaa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa la bwa ba cheme.
Israel tena sie aa Juda tenaa beɡre kpa, Gɛɛ Juda tena ɡe aa wola Israel tenaa dɔm kpa.
Baa pɛo dɛ́ lɔ ka tɔ Filisti tena baa lɔ wee cholibɔr nɛɛ dɛ́ yoo ba, dɛ́ ka kah banɔ la baa lɔ wee leebɔr la ɡe laala kɛ laa ta kwa, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ Edom ne Moab tena nɛ, Amɔn tena berɛ ba bechale dɛɛ tom ba.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo Ijipt mpo kpale la hweeh kwaraa, ásɛ dɛ berɛ ir nɔn pa Yufretis Moo la ta, peuwɔb bɛl ta kpɔ o ta, ásɛ o peɡri nenabɔɔne anuanɛ, nɛra won do naŋɡawa dɛ́ jo dɛɛ le o baŋ.
Ŋwɛnɛjen ɛɛ chɔɔ tɛ o nɛra baa kaa, dɛ́ le Asiiria harɛ la ta, ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ fa aa chɔa tɛ Israel tena ɡɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la.
Kpɛɛra yela Awola tɔpere la, hɛɛ ɡo yelaa ŋɔ, “Korowii jam kɛ o baah fa aa di n nɛɛ dɛ berɛ sɔɔh dɛɛ larawe n bwara taraken nɔ.
Kasinteŋ, Korowiirii n Lɛɛ.
Mɛɛ dɛɛ yaradao dɛ bɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ.
Korowii bee n bokpeɡa do, n yel maa ɡo bwa ɡee kɛŋɔ Korowii.
Onee n Lɛɛ.” Gɛ nyɔɡre dɛ kpo nɛn o dɔ kɔlɔŋ nee nyɔ, o sie lɛ la, ɡɛɛ dɛ Korowii lɛ nɛra aa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛ.
Awola tɔpere la, hɛɛ ɡo yelee ŋɔ, “Hé yerɛ Korowii sɔn, hé jaamo.
Hé ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa jemɛ ɡɛ waa ɛa, ásɛ dɛ berɛ baɡ ba ɡɛ o sɔn aa kana.
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, o ɛ wejena ɡa, Hé bol a waa harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa no.
Saayɔn tena, hé hɛɡre dɛ́ ɡo yela kohona.
Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la kan kohona!
O ne o nɛra so.”
Korowii bol Babelɔn tena chɔɡa wa Babelɔn waa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡle Emɔɔs bie Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ.
Hé kpɔ laa fraŋkaa ka pa deŋɡare daa aa wola toole o ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ laa tena ba, dɛ́ ir nɔɔra baɡ ba bá ka jo nɛnjena bwɛɛ la ta dɛ́ yoo ba.
Korowii nɛra waa lee ba cheɡ tɛ o te, dɛ yerɛ o banyoola ŋɔ bá tɛr nɛra baa dɛ ɛo bandiwaa la deŋne.
Ba sie dɛ lɛ kan waa doa la ta, dɛ́ ɡel ba won pɔ nɛra la nɛ.
Hé no!
Gbɔɡa dɛ le bwejena dor dɛɛ ba birbir kɛ nɛnlaa aa dɛ valɛ ken, kɛ harɛre nɛra ne ba koranar aa baa pɛ ken.
Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ yer ba bá kaa laa la.
Ba le harɛre jaɡa bojaŋ dɛɛ ba.
Bandia nee Korowii ɛɛ ba ba ne, bá ba chɔɡ harɛ la bwa.
Hé kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ nyu dɛ́ wi.
Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la telo.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la tɔpere waa dɛ ba nɛra chɔɡa la telo.
Gɛ saŋ telaa, nomɛlbwa bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, ásɛ ba hwɛɡa ɡe tonɛ.
Ɔmee ɛɛ chole ba nɛɛ, ba bwara wee ba chweeh, baa beɡre ba te kɛŋɔ loltea aa lɔ haah.
Ba nyoa ɛɛ kpoo kohonaa, ásɛ sihiih kpo ba, baa nyiŋi dɔŋa.
Hé na!
Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la dɛ ba.
Awola tɔpere la aa werii do kwara, o baah ɛɛ diu taeh.
Wɛɛ ɛ harɛ nɔɔ kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ken, dɛ́ chɔɡ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra le o ta.
Weweela aa chaah ɡɛ saŋ, wee aa bɔr chaahna ba kpa, korobie ɡe aa won chaah.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ba chɔɡ harɛ nɔɔ.
Mɛɛ tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋnee ba wedoŋa wa, dɛ́ ɡel ɡɔɔra nɛra aa dɛ ɡɔɔ ba te la teŋe.
Dɛ́ ba banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo la ɡe ne harɛ.
Nɛra baa le a nyoa ɛɛ ka tama kenii, ba waa do tɔɡre ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm tenten.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nyundua yiiɡi, ásɛ harɛ jiɡri dɛ́ le o chebɔr, ɡɛ tɔpere men Koranar Bwa Kooro aa baɡle n bandia harɛ nɔ ta la.
Hɔɔhra baa soɡe Babelɔn ɛɛ lɔɔ peɡre, dɛ́ kaa ba harɛre ta kɛŋɔ kpaahna aa jo kweɡli baah a lɔ peɡre la.
Baa chwao peɡre kɛŋɔ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe ken.
Nomɛlbwa baa lawɔ la, baa yaɡɔɔ kere nee kpo.
Baa cheo dɛɛ nyiŋi ba lɔɔ ba bii kpoo, dɛ́ jo ba deremi dɛ́ bal ba laala dɛ paɡɛ ba haahna ɡe.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé no!
Mɛɛ ɡeloo Midia tena ba yo Babelɔn tena.
Ba waane laa suuɡapoŋa wa, haa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm yaɡ ba sen. Baa kpɔ ba tori ne hɛmaa le bonɔɔna nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba.
Ba te waane laa bechasɔɔhne wa, ba ta tedoma dɔe tɛ bechajeɡre ɡe.
Babelɔn kora wer ɡwaa bwɛɛre bwa kora, bela tena kpɔɔ dɛɛ ta nyoa.
Kɛ men Korowii, mɛɛ chɔɡ kora laanee kɛŋɔ maa ɛ Sodom ne Gomoora la.
Nomɛlbwa aa belaa so kpa bwa, nɛra ba taa dɛ lol ba ne banɔ la ba ta aa dɛ ba ba lola bwa.
Arab tena baa vala dɛɛ valɛ aa ba tɛnte deene baŋre bela, peteɡra kwara aa ba peeraa teɡɛ la bela á ka di kpa.
Pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ola dɛ ba bela doe dɛɛ si deremi la bini, kwiure sɔh a kɔne bela, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini ola aa do kɛŋɔ boohna do bela dɛɛ jah.
Kalampoŋare ɛɛ dɛɛ si dekpeɡa binii, ásɛ ɡboli si koranar dedɛɛɡa bini.
Babelɔn chɔɡa saŋ telo, waa jaŋɛ kpa.”
Israel tena bojaŋ harɛfale ta lee ba wa Korowii ɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ Israel tena, wɛɛ berɔ lee ba tɛ o te ja, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ba so ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta.
Hɔɔhra ɛɛ ba ja ba nɛɛ ba ne ba pɛ so.
Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ cha baa dɛ kpɔ ba ba, ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta.
Ásɛ Israel tena berɛ kpɔ harɛre la nɛra berɛ ba yoma Korowii harɛ waa kpɔa tɛ Israel tena la ta.
Nɛra Israel tena fa aa lɔ ba lɔɡa la berɛ ba do ba lɔɡa, ásɛ dɛ baa tom ba.
Awola tɔpere Korowii aa tɛ heyaa ona le weweele ne hɔhɔrɔwa dɛ dochɔɡa he fa aa lɔ a ta la, hɛɛ kpɔ yelee sɛɡle Babelɔn kooro dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ nyubinikpeɡ te la aa bera sɔɔh!
Hé na ɡɛ o bandia aa ba a jaɡa!
Korowii kuuɡi wechɔɡ-ɛɛra daŋɡbale, o ɡelɔ koranar kpeɡri sɔɔh.
Banee kpɔ bwaawee dɛ do nɛra ba ta ba lɔɔra ɡelɛ bwa, harɛre nɛra baa pɔ ba nɛɛ la, ba ta ba fiiɡa ɡelɛ bwa.
Harɛ bwa dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna, nomɛlbwa ɛɛ ɡo yela silɛɛ ne.
Lɛbanɔn harɛ peleme daa, ne anɔ la aa jaa kwaraa sie lɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ la kora la ɡui wa, dɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Taraken baa ba he ne harɛ nɔ, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ teŋe yaa kpa.’ Lala kpɔ ba te ba sie beɡre baa kpa Babelɔn kooro bala.
A ɡelɔ nɛra ba fa aa dɛ di kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta dɛ sewɛ la ir dɛɛ jaamo.
Nomonome ba fa aa dɛ di kpeɡri harɛre ta ir ba kookane ta dɛɛ kpao.
Ba bwa ɛɛ ŋɔ o bee ŋɔ, ‘He ɡe sɔɔhnɔ ɡɛ yaa doa nɔ, ya bwa kɛrɛdɛ!
He jenu bwa tonɛ lalabwɛ, janjela baa lɔa dɛɛ duuri bwa chiɡo.
Dudulee he kalaŋ, dɛ tɔe yal.’ Babelɔn kooro, na ɡɛ haa le nyundua ba le harɛ.
Chɔmbibi wewee, chɔmbibi bonɔɔ!
Ba taɡɛ ta harɛ, nɛn he fa aa pɔ harɛre nɛ!
He fa liiro ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ teehnoo kaa nyundua.
Korowii weweela baŋ lee mɛɛ ba n kookara kpɔe ka cheɡ, dɛ́ so kɛŋɔ kooro weekaŋle nyunduabɔr bwejen la ta, bela kwaa aa bea baa wola an na aa dɛ cheme la.
Mɛɛ teehnoo ka so baama baŋ, dɛ́ ɛ n te kɛŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowii ken.’ Kɛ ane a bwa, Korowii ba he ne harɛ, dɛ kpɔe kaa lala huɡribɔr bɔɔ bini.
Banɔ la baa nae la ɛɛ nyiŋii jeiih ken, dɛɛ lii ŋɔ, ‘Baa la waa ɡela harɛ jiɡri dɛ ɡel koranar chel laanee nɔ kɛɛ?
Onee chɔɡ bwɛjena dɛ ɡel bela bwa berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, waa wola nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta kpɔe ta la aa?’ Koranar baa serewa la bɛlbwa chɔ o ɡbaɡba lalbɔɔ bini, ba ɛ ba ŋwama la a do wer.
Kɛ he te, ba kpɔe viɡri kɛŋɔ baa teŋe daa ta ken, ba ta hen huɡe.
Nɛra baa ka laa ta la lalaa tɔ he nɛ, ba kpɔ he ne ba bwa ta bwebɔɔ bini dɛ tiɡri he nɛ.
Ba ta hen huɡe kɛŋɔ baa huɡe he bala koranar la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, he chɔɡ he harɛ, he kpoo he nɛra.
Baa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra naanar sɔnee yerɛ kpa bwa.
Kwaa bɔr dɛ́ kpoo o naanar ba naawa chɔɡre baa ɛa la wa, ásɛ ba bɛ ir dɛ́ ba lɛ harɛ nɔ dɔɔh, dɛ́ ma bwɛjena o ta bwa.” Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ka che bwɛjen Babelɔn ne o nɛra nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba maa komɛlbwaa ɡel, bechale ɡba aa ka, o sɔn he.
Men Korowiirii ŋɔa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo bela berɛ kataŋa ne kwiure dobɔr, dɛ́ ɡbaa bela bwa ó chɔɡ.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.” Korowii bol Asiiria tena chɔɡa wa Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, “Waa maa vɔrɔwa la, anee dɛɛ ba ɛɛ, anɔ la aa dawɛ n sie la ɡee mɛɛ ba ɛɛ.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ Asiiria tenaa le n harɛ ta, mɛɛ tiɡri ba nɛɛ Israel harɛ bwejena ta, dɛ́ lawɛ n nɛra le Asiiria tena kpeɡri baa dɛ di ba nɛ, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ daa dawɛ nae anɛ baŋa ta a pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma la.
Waa nɔɔ n vɔrɔwe bil dɛɛ ba ɛɛ harɛ ta bobɛlbwa.
N ir nɔn dɛ́ tɛr harɛre nɛra deŋne.” Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa vɔrɔwa nɔ, umee dɛ́ won bera ɔ?
O ir nɔn dɛ́ tɛr nɛra deŋne, umee dɛ won ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o bɛ ɛɔ?
Korowii bol Filisti tena chɔɡa wa A bena Kooro Ahas aa chɔ o banɔn ta, waa aa le Korowii be ba laanee.
Filisti tena, daŋɡbala baa kpɔa lɔɔ heyaa ka la kuu, kɛ he bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ he hɛɡre.
Harɛkon sewaa, onchɔɡe kɛ domkpule dɛ́ chiɡ o naa ta, ásɛ o bii ɡe do kɛŋɔ doh dɛ́ ir.
Nɛra baa nyaa kohona ɛɛ dɔ kwaa dɛɛ di, ásɛ banɔ la ba soɡa bini aa kpeɡa tɛɛ ba ɡe dɔ bɔr chɔ bosɔɔhna ta, komɛlbwa aa ban ɛ. Kɛ he Filisti tena te, lɔree mɛɛ ba kpɔe kpoo heyaa he mun he harɛ la ta.
He bini bɛlbwa aa kae ba.
Hé do lɔŋɔre dɛɛ wii, he banɔ la haa lɔ bwɛjena bini la!
Filisti tena, hé ɡel he bambile teŋe!
Yoyoora tenten le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, kɛŋɔ ninchuu ken, dɛ bwa pɛ dɛɛ ba ba yo heya.
Webesoo yaa ba toroma baa le harɛ la ta ba la chaŋa ɔ?
“Korowii kpɔ Saayɔn cheɡ, ásɛ o nɛra baa dɛ na wahala dɔ bɔr so dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu.”
Korowii bol Moab tena chɔɡa wa Waa aa chiɡ Moab harɛ ta Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ, Moab harɛ ta bwɛjena Ar ne Kir chɔɡɔ.
Jwaana beŋkpoŋii ba chɔɡa.
Debɔn tena teehnɔ kaa deŋɡare ta, bela ba voɡ aa lole dɛ́ ka wi.
Moab harɛ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ wi bwɛjena Nɛbo ne Medeba waa, dɛ́ fonɛ ba nyuune ne tampona bwa ta, aa baɡle suna dii.
Ba tɔ lweyale fɔɡbaahna bwa, saldor ne bela baa dɛ cheme bwa, ba ne siniiree, ba wio dɛ ba tal.
Hɛsbɔn tena ne Eleale tena dɛ wi, ba lɔŋɔre tel Jahas.
A ɡelɔ ɔmee lawɛ Moab laa tena bwa ba lɔŋɔre bɔle, ba bwara yɔr.
N bambile dɛ wee mɛ Moab tena wa.
Nɛra baa soɡe harɛ la ta chwao kaa Soar, hale dɛ ka tel Eɡlat Sɛleseya.
Bane teehnɔ kaa Luhit, baa dɛ kaa la bwa, dɛ ba ne wii.
Bane chwao kpɔ Horonaim ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ wi ba chɔɡa wa.
Nimrim nenabɔɔ nee bwa hweehrɔ kwaraa, kpɔɡa aa lɔ o nyoa bwa holɔ, papo-lwɛɛ bɛlbwa toole dɛ ta che bela kpa.
Ba cheɡɛ ba kondɔɔh baa dɔa bwa ɡale Dajaŋa Nenabɔɔ, dɛɛ ba kpɔe ka sɔh.
Moab harɛ jwɛhre bobɛlbwaa baa wi, ba wii tel bela bwɛɛre Eɡlaim ne Beɛ Elim.
Chal ɡboo Demɔn neerare bwa, kɛ Korowii ta dɔ waane aa ɡwaa ken, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ nɛra baa soɡe bela.
Seo chɔ le dɛɛ kpa Moab tena baa dɛ chwa, ne banɔ la baa ka harɛ la ta.
Bwɛjen Sela tena, hé lawɛ pebiiri dɛ́ kpɔ ka tomɛ Israel tena kooro.
Hé tomɛ nɛra bá kpɔ le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ dɛ́ kaa Saayɔn Bwejen ta.
Moab haahna lɔ Aanɔn Moo nyoa milimili, dɛ la dɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ jumbii baa doŋa le a kɔne ta ken.
Ba ŋɔ Juda harɛ nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hé ja yaa, hé baɡle yaa ɡɛ yaa ɛ. Hé ɡel ya so he lɔɡa, hé chunchuli tɔ ya nɛ.
Hé kpɔ yaa sɔh, he bɛ yaa le tɛ nɛra baa dɛ yo yaa nɔ.
Hé ɡel ya Moab tena baa doŋi yaa ya ba marɛ nɔ dɔ sobɔr he harɛ ta.
Hé tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe, he bɛ ɡel ya dɔma dɔ yaa.” Wahala ɛɛ tonɔɔ, nɛŋkpoa ba a jaɡa, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ vuuɡi harɛ la bwa ɡe le o ta.
Baa cheɡ kora bɛlee, Kooro Devid naa dɛɛ ba o ta soɡa.
Kasinteŋ ne nɛnnyin nee wɛɛ ba o kara dii, dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Waa waa aa toɡra habɔɔ ta.
Ya no ɡɛ Moab tena aa dɛ ɛ mbarafo, ɡɛ baa dɛ ɡɔɔ ba te dɛɛ baɡle ba te.
Ba dɛ ɛ sikpeɡ dɛɛ maŋkura ba te, kɛ a ɛ wepuu.
Moab tena ɛɛ wi ba harɛ waa, ba bwa ɛɛ wiu.
Ba bwa ɛɛ lii konsoma ba fa aa dɛ di bwɛjen Kir Haresɛt la waa, dɛ́ pɛ dɛɛ wi.
Kooni aa bɛne Hɛsbɔn bwa chɔɡɔ, ɡɛɛ daa kooni aa lɔ Sibma la ɡe chɔɡ.
A ɡɛ daa kooni la nɔna senee harɛre nomonjena fa nyɔ dɛɛ dɛɛ.
Daa kooni la fa yɛɛrɔ tel bwɛjen Jasa, ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Yar Mpo ta.
N dɛ wi dɛɛ tɛ daa kooni aa lɔ Sibma, ɡɛ baa dɛ wi a waa Jasa la.
Hɛsbɔn tena ne Eleale tena, sinii dɛ yɔɔ mɛ he wa.
Moola fe dɛ le daa nɔna chaara saŋ nɔ, kɛ nɔna toole a ta, bɔr helɔ.
Silɛɛ ne hɛɡra toole daa kooni ta kpa.
Nomɛlbwa aa yela kɛɛ lɔŋɔree do daa kooni ta kpa.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe aa a nɔna ta tiɡri a nee le a ta kpa.
Silɛɛ ɡbɔɡa teŋo.
N dɛ hime Moab wa, n tea bini chɔɡ kohona Kir Haresɛt wa.
Moab tena teehno kaa bwe doa ba voɡa la ta naa, ba dɛ koh pɛɛpɛɛ.
Ba la ba voɡa deene bini dɛ ka soŋa oo, aa ban komɛlbwa lee ba.
Moab harɛ waa Korowii aa bola wubwa laanee la.
Taraken Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Gɛ paa te yon dɛɛ do o tɔpere la, ɡɛɛ Moab tena ɡe tɔpere do.
Bonɔ bene atoro Moab kondɔɔh bwa dɛ́ ba chɔɡa ó di ncho.
Nɛn damanta baa lɔ o ta bwa, tamaa kenii dɛɛ ba kae, baa ɡwɛɡroo.”
Korowii bol Damaskɔs tena chɔɡa wa Waa aa chiɡ bwɛjen Damaskɔs Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ.
“Damaskɔs aa bwɛjen ɛɛ ba kpa, wɛɛ ba chɔɡoo dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia chɔ.
Bwɛjena aa lɔ Siiria harɛ dɛ́ ba dimɡbia bera dɛ chɔ.
Aa berɛ peera ne nae dibɔraa, nomɛlbwa aa lee do dɛ́ doŋa.
Bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro toole Israel harɛ ta kpa.
Bwɛjen Damaskɔs ɡe aa koobwɛɛ ɛ kpa.
Siiria tena ɛɛ ba ka tamaa ba jirima tonɛ, ɡɛ Israel tena jirima aa tona la.” Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, Israel jirima waa dɔa la ɛɛ tonɔɔ, ásɛ nyaa chiɡ o kondɔɔh naa ta.
Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ koo baa komɛ o mea dɛ paa kaa la ken.
Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ koo baa kuuh mea Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini, o chɔ pɛɛ.
Kɛ mea tamaa dɛɛ ba kae, kɛŋɔ ba yon chaa ɔleve daa nɔna, ásɛ a yon ba ka nɔna anɛ kɛɛ atoro daa la nyundujaɡla kɛɛ tama aa ka o kpala ta la.” Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee bola.
Awola tɔpere la, nɛwɛnyina bwa ɛɛ kpɔ sie dawɛ Korowii nɛ.
Onee Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ waa ta ba baa tomɔ.
Baa kwaa ba ɡbaɡba aa maa dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa dɛɛ tɛ voɡa a ta laanee nyiŋi kpa.
Baa voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa ba ɡbaɡba aa paaɡa, ne bela baa maa dɛɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma la ta hwɛɡɛ kpa.
Awola tɔpere la, ba bwɛjena aa do kpeɡri ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbeenii, dɛ le kpɔɡa ne daa, ɡɛ Israel tena fa aa pɔ a ɡɛ bwɛɛre la nɛɛ a nɛra chwa a berɛ dimɡbeeni dɛ che la.
Israel tena, he liire le he Lɛɛ Korowii nɛ.
Onee Bwetal haa kpɔ he te marɔ wɛɛ tɔ heyaa ɡbemɡbe la, kɛ he soh o wa.
He du dadɛɛɡa bodɛɛɡa, dɛ kwaa bela dɛɛ tomɛ harɛre voɡare.
He fe wono ɡel a le awola tenten haa dua la, dɛ moɡɛ dɛ fe aa, haa komɛlbwa a ta chaa.
Wahala ne weweele aa wola tonɛ ɡboo hɛɛ ba dɔe.
Sibeɡra chole harɛre aa wara nɛ, a nɛra ɛɛ si kɛŋɔ mpo ken, dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma ken.
Hale nɛra warɔ dɛɛ moo kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma sii aa, Korowii ɛɛ kah baa ásɛ ba chwa kaa bojaŋ.
Baa chwao dɛ́ peɡre kɛŋɔ peu aa kpɔ haahra, kɛɛ kawulewule aa kpɔ doŋa kaa la ken.
A tel jɔmɔra aa, ba dɛ ɛ ɔmewa, kɛ tɔɔ ne pera chɔɔ dɛ ba kaalɔ.
A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛ́ chiɡ nɛra baa bal ya laala kɛ laa ta kwa kaa la nɛ.
Korowii bol Itiopia tena chɔɡa wa Nɛra baa lɔ Itiopia harɛ neerare baŋ le tontombɛ aa su o ta la, bá bwɛɛlɛ.
Ba dɛ tomɛ toroma bá so dafɛɡa ɡbeni bini, dɛ́ kpɔ Nael Moo sie.
Toroma haa ɡbaŋa, hé la harɛ o nɛra aa kpeɡa kohona ba bwara loɡa la be, nɛra baa do ɔma harɛ nɔ bwa ta, dɛɛ tiɡri ba dɔma nɛ neerare peɡri ba harɛ bini.
Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ba pa fraŋkaa bwe doa aa, hé nao, dɛ́ cheɡ deŋne, dɛ ba hoh bɛla aa, ásɛ he no.
Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ so nyundua dɛ́ nyiŋi jeiih ken, kɛŋɔ wee aa lea bɔr wɔrɔbe, kɛɛ mɛne aa dɛ ta wee lɔ a ta aa nyɛɡle kwaa koma saŋ la.” Kwaa koma aa wola tele mɔɔ kwaa fee chure asɛ daa nɔna la ɛɛ swɛɛ la, Korowii ɛɛ teŋni kpala nɔna aa saɡre a ta laanee bil, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ kere kuu a kpala la le a ta.
Gɛ kpala la aa chɔa la, ɡɛɛ Itiopia lala ɛɛ ba chɔe, ásɛ jumbii aa dɛ di ola dia bɔwɔb saŋ, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ɡe ba dia waa saŋ.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, nɛra baa kpeɡa kohona ba bwara do wer, ba do ɔma harɛ nɔ bwa ta, dɛɛ tiɡri ba dɔma nɛ, neerare peɡri ba harɛ bini la, baa kpɔ koŋkɛɛlaa ba tɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro Saayɔn Bwejen ta, bela baa dɛ tomɔ.
Korowii bol Ijipt tena chɔɡa wa Waa aa chiɡ Ijipt harɛ ta, Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ.
Hé na!
Korowii cheɡɛ bam ta, dɛɛ ba Ijipt harɛ ta wɔrɔbe nɛ.
Voɡare aa lɔ bela bwa jum jah o sie, asɛ bela tena bwa bwara yɔr.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ naɡraa ta Ijipt tena nɛ ba ɡbo yo dɔŋa, dɔɔ ne nime yo, chamena ne o chamenate yo, bwɛjen ne o bwɛjen dɔŋ yo, ásɛ koranar ɡe yo dɔŋa.
Ijipt tena hwɛɡa bwa ɛɛ tonɔɔ, ásɛ ba maɡla baa maɡla bil bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, bá kaa bɔɔ voɡa ne lala ne ba voɡra ne ba bebeela.
Mɛɛ kpɔ Ijipt tenaa do kooro nyubinikpeɡ te bɛl nɔn ta, o wa do ɔma, wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Men Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.” Nael Moo waa chɔ bela ɛɛ hweehroo, ásɛ o nenabɔɔ bini hol chɔ.
Bɔra baa kwia nee palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ a ta bwa ɛɛ sɔɔhnoo, ásɛ nenabɔɔne hweeh.
Kpɔɡa aa cheɡɛ nee ta bwa sewɛ.
Kwaa aa lɔ Nael Moo nyoa, ne kwaa baa dua o nyoa la bwa ɛɛ holoo, peu kpɔa kaa kwara.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ nee toma ɛɛ kpɔ nɔɔraa dawɛ nyu dɛ́ wi, nɛra baa dɛɛ ta ɡoŋa Nael Moo ta, ne banɔ la baa dɛ ta asauri o ta bwa hwɛɡa ɛɛ tonɔɔ.
Nɛra baa kpɔ jisere dɛɛ ɛ yapondɛɛɡa bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ sɔah bwara hwah.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ yale toma bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ di a paane waa do sum.
Nomonome baa chɔ Ijipt bwɛjen Soan nyoa la ɛ ɡɛna, nomonome baa jemɛ waa dɛɛ ja Ijipt kooro la aa on liidɛɛɡa tɛ.
Aah, hɛɛ won ŋɔ Ijipt kooro be ŋɔ, “N ɛ wejereme kɛŋɔ saŋ la tena wejerema ne koranar la bini bɛl aa?” Ijipt kooro, namete leperaa he wejerema la dɔɔ?
Gel ba baɡle he jemɛ ɡɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro aa kpaŋre Ijipt tena waa bil dɛɛ ba kpɔe ɛɛ ba.
Nomonome baa chɔ Soan nyoa berɛ ɡɛna, Mɛmfes nomonome ɡe wili.
Banee fe chɛ kɛŋɔ ba tɔ Ijipt tena sie, dɛ berɛ ɡel ba nyoɡre.
Korowii perewi sibir ta ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel Ijipt tena ɛ sakaa ba we-ɛɛla ta, kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛ yon chwɛɛ dɛɛ ɡbaɡre a ta la.
Wobɛlbwa toole Ijipt tena won ɛ kpa, nomonome kɛɛ dansaara aa won cha ba, nɛnjena kɛɛ nɛmpɛɛne aa won cha ba.
Awola tɔpere, Ijipt tena ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ haahna ken.
Baa ɔmɔɔ ba bwara chel Koranar Bwa Kooro nɔn waa ɡɔɔra dɛ́ kpɔ tɛr ba deŋne la wa.
Juda harɛ sɔn ɛɛ ɡeloo ɔmee kohona lawɛ Ijipt tena.
Nomɛlbwa yerɛ Juda harɛ sɔn aa, Ijipt tena bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, kpaŋra Koranar Bwa Kooro aa kpaŋre ba waa bil nomanta.
Awola tɔpere la, Ijipt harɛ bwɛjena anue tena ɛɛ bol Juda tena wobolee, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te tɛ kɛŋɔ baa tomɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro.
Baa pa bwɛjena la bɛl sɔnee ‘Bwɛjen waa dɛ ba Chɔɡa’.
Baa ɛ saraha kon Ijipt harɛ baah taa tɛ Korowii, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bwe ka pa o jwɛh ta tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ lii, awola tɔpere.
Aa cheo dɛɛ baɡle waa dɛ tɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro Ijipt harɛ ta.
Dɛ nɛra dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa asɛ ba do lɔŋɔ tɛ Korowii aa, wɛɛ tɛɛ baa lɛɛree ó lɛɛ ba.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ o tenee baɡle Ijipt tena bá jemɔ awola, dɛ́ tomɔ dɛ́ kpoo kwaa tɛo, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ mea sarahare ɡe tɛo.
Baa baɡɔ nyoa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr Ijipt tena deŋnee mɔɔ dɛ lɛɛ ba.
Baa ba o bee ásɛ o no ba wesoŋa dɛ́ chaah ba.
Awola tɔpere la, ŋwɛnɛ ɛɛ chɔɔ le Ijipt harɛ ka ta Asiiria harɛ ta, ásɛ Asiiria tena won Ijipt laŋa, Ijipt tena ɡe won Asiiria bala.
Gɛ nɛmbele banɛ nɔ ɛɛ pɛo dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.
Awola tɔpere la, Israel tena dɛ ba Ijipt ne Asiiria tena nɛɛ jae, dɛ́ ɡel harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa na som.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛɛ ba dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Ijipt tena baa ɛ n nɛra, ne Asiiria tena maa ta ba, dɛ Israel tena maa lee ba tɛ n te la, ba na som.”
Korowii bol Ijipt ne Itiopia tena chɔɡa wa A bena Asiiria koojen Saaɡɔn aa tomɛ o laa nomoa o la bwɛjen Asdɔd dɛ ka yoo ba dɛ lɛ bwɛjen la la, a ɡɛ saŋee Korowii che Emɔɔs bie Aesaya nɛɛ dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Ka laa lweyal wur bil, dɛ́ laa naŋɡawa parame he nakpale.” Asɛ Aesaya ka ɛ ɡɛ, dɛ valɛ dakpaŋ ne o nakpapɛɛ ne.
Ate, Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ n bonɔɔ Aesaya aa dɛ valɛ dakpaŋ ne nakpapɛɛ bene atoro nɔ, a ɛ we-ɛɛla dɛ baɡle waa aa dɛ ba Ijipt harɛ ne Itiopia harɛ chiɡa.
Gɛ tentenee Asiiria koojen ɛɛ ba Ijipt ne Itiopia tena waa kaa yoo ba, dɛ laɡ ba la ɛɛ ba bá valɛ dakpaŋ ne nakpapɛɛ ne.
Nomonome ne bechale bwa ɛɛ valɛ mumɡbal sihiih nee.
Nɛra baa dɔ Itiopia hwɛɡa, dɛɛ tamane Ijipt nɛɛ la ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ sihiih kpo ba.
Nɛra baa soɡe mpo nyoa bela la ɛɛ na waa aa puu baa dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Na ɡɛ aa chiɡ nɛra yaa kpɔ ya te dɛɛ dawɛ ba nɛɛ la, nɛra yaa chwaa kaa mar ba bá lɛ yaa le Asiiria koojen nɔn ta la!
Na waa aa puu ba!
Leperaa yaa ba sie doe jaɔ?’ ”
Korowii bol Babelɔn harɛ chɔɡa wa Waa aa chiɡ Babelɔn harɛ ta Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ.
Gɛ kawulewule aa taa dɛɛ kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la, ɡɛɛ wekpeɡa ɛɛ ba a le harɛ waa do ɔma ta ba.
N na waane kɛŋɔ chaahna ken a ɛ lokua kohona.
Bane le dɔŋa dɛɛ tɛ, bane ɡee chɔɡ kwaa kohona.
Elam tena, hé ka lɔ tɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ yoo ba!
Midia tena, hé bar ba bwɛjena cheme, dɛ́ tɔ ba do!
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo wahala Babelɔn aa ba a ne la teŋe.
A ɡɛ waa maa naa la ɡelɔ n bwadabii wee mɛ chweeh ken, kɛŋɔ loltea aa lɔ haah ken.
Waa maa noa la ɡelɔ maa won ɛ wobɛlbwa, n ɛo chinchaŋ waa maa naa la wa.
A ɡelɔ n bambile lɔ paupau ken, ɔmee kohona ɡelɔ n bwadabii bwa serewe.
Kpae maa dɛ kpa kɛŋɔ jɔmɔra ɛɛ ba silɛɛ nee la berɛ ɔmee kohona tɛ mɛ.
Chaahna la bini la, n nao kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ kondikwaa cheɡ tiɡ ta, dɛ pa yale pa harɛ dɛ so a ta, dɛɛ di kwaa dɛɛ nyɔ sen!
Buɡ la ta, taa den le ŋɔ, “Laa sitɔɔla, hé ir!
Hé ka kpɔ dɔmkwaa haa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ he te ɡbemɡbe laa ta la!” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ nɛn ó kaa daah, ásɛ wobɛlbwa waa na la ó ba bol.
Dɛ o baa na kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ne jaɡre ne keeɡore dɛ nyoɡmare laa tena so a ta naa, ó nyiŋ ba kɛrɛdɛ.” Belaa nɛn waa dɛ daah la kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa n che dejaŋ doa dɛɛ daah.” Na, baa bɛl waa cheɡɛ kon waa do kɛ torɔɡo bini ne jaɡre dɛ ba.
Asɛ nɛn waa dɛ daah la ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Babelɔn paɡrɔ!
O paɡrɔ!
Voɡare aa lɔ o ta bwa, ba paɡre a bwa burbur ken bil harɛ.” Aesaya ŋɔ, “N nɛra, ba ɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ baa lɔ mea ken, waa maa noa le Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ be laanee n bol la.” Korowii bol Edom harɛ chɔɡa wa Waa aa chiɡ Edom harɛ ta Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ.
Nomɛl lɔ Edom dɛ pɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛn haa dɛ daah, aa biɡruu mɔɔ bɔr chaah naa?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Tɔɔ dɛ ba pera, kɛ bɔr ɛɛ berɔɔ jo ja.
Dɛ he dɛ nyin dɛ́ jemaa, ba dɛ́ berɛ ba bɔɔ ja.” Korowii bol Arab harɛ chɔɡa wa Waa aa chiɡ Arab harɛ ta, Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ.
Dedan tena haa lɔ Arab harɛ ta dɛ valɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa hɛɛ ba he tɛnte deene baŋra dɛɛ chɔ jwaana.
Tema tena, hé kpɔ kondikwaa ne nee ba cheme banɔ la baa chwaa le laa ta la.
Ba chwao dɛɛ le keri, ne hɛma baa hara dɛɛ ba ba tae, dɛ wekpeɡa aa lɔ laa ta la nyoa.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Gɛ paadii yon jemɛ kɛŋɔ benanyoa wɛɛ ba o toma tona la, ɡɛɛ Keda tena jirima bwa ɛɛ ba tona benanyoa.
Keda laa tena baa jemɛ hɛma tae kɛrɛdɛ la aa kanee do kpa.
Men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ laanee bola.”
Korowii bol bwɛjen Jerusalam chɔɡa wa Waa aa chiɡ Chaahna Fɛlembɔjen ta, Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ.
Bɔkwaa waa bala ɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ bwɛjen nɔ nɛra bwa ɛɛ lɛ ba sie saldor nɔɔ?
Akwe!
Lɔŋɔre ɡbo bwɛ, bwɛjen ɡbɔɡa ne silɛɛ aa sui.
Kere laa ba kpɔ kpoo heya, laa ta ɡe laa he ka.
He bwɛjen la nomonome bwa pɛo chwa, kɛ ba laɡ ba, dɛ ba ta ban hɛma tae.
Hale ba dɔma aa lɔ bojaŋ ba chwa kaa kwaraa la, ba lawɛ ba bwa.
A waa n ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel mɛ n wi n nɛra.
He bɛ n bwara larawe n nɛra baa serewa nɔ wa.” Awola tɔpere la, Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ ɡeloo o ɛ ɡbɔɡa ne ɡaeh ne ɔmee tɔpere Chaahna Fɛlembɔjen la ta.
Ba kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen la ta awola, ba wii kaa le bwejena dor.
Elam laa tena kpoŋe hɛma ne a tori dɛ che kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore bini, bane ɡe so jaɡre ta.
Kir laa tena ɡe kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta le.
Gɛɛ a do kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, su he fɛlembɔjena harɛdɛɛɡa la bwa, asɛ nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta ɡe che Jerusalam doonyoone.
Kwaa aa tɔ Juda tena nɛɛ la, ba laa kpɔ.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, he kpɔ sie dawɛ dɔmkwaa aa lɔ Kɔr Bini Koodem la ta.
He nao kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ waa bar Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la pera aa choɡla, asɛ he ɡel nee do harɛbɔr tam la ta warɛ.
He kure Jerusalam deene, asɛ dɛ kuuɡi ane dɛ kpɔ a bwea ma danjwɛɛ la o do kpeɡri.
He ma konjen asɛ nee le tambene la ta dɛ ba jo o bini, bwɛɛ la ne danjwɛɛ waa baro la baah ta.
He ɛ anɔ nɔ bwa, kɛ he ta sie kpɔe dawɛ Korowii waa waa maɡla bil wubwa, dɛ ɛa la ta.
Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, hé dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛ́ wi, dɛ́ fonɛ he nyuune dɛ́ kpɔ lweyale tɔ awola tɔpere, á baɡle kɛŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡa.
Kɛ he kpoo nae ne peera dɛɛ di kwa, dɛ nyɔ sene dɛɛ hɛlɛ dɛɛ lɛ he sie.
Hé ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya di kwaa dɛ nyɔ sen. Kere ɡbo dɛ ya serewɔ.” Koranar Bwa Kooro ɡbaɡba bol n be ŋɔ, “Maa ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔɔ kpɔ kɛ ba bwa ka tel ba seo tɔpere.
Men Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.” Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro tomɛ men Aesaya ŋɔ, “La Sɛbna waa chɔ koodem bela tomare nyoa be ka ŋɔ, ‘Henee umeo?
Umee tɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ hé pɛɡre bwe, dɛ́ kpɔ bela ɛ he lalbɔɔ, asɛ hɛɛ ɛo bodɛɛɡe dɛ́ kpɔ bela ɛ he chɔɔbɔr nɔɔ?
Na, he ne he nɛnjen ɛɛ bwa, men Korowii dɛ́ ba he ɡɔɔra viɡri bonɔ.
Wɛɛ keerii kɛŋɔ bɔɔl ken, dɛ́ kpɔe ta harɛ waa paɡa ta.
Belaa hɛɛ ba sewa, belaa he laa torɔɡore haa dɛ che a bini, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ nyin sɔn la ɛɛ ba kae.
Sihiih ɛɛ kpo he nomoa he waa.
Men Korowii ɛɛ le he ne nomombɔr bela he fa aa lole wubwa laanee, dɛ́ ba he ne harɛ.’ Mɛɛ yerɛ Hilkia bie Eliakim waa ɛ n bonɔɔnee.
Mɛɛ doo he nomombatakaarejaŋ laanee, dɛ́ vɔwɔ he kiriso la dɛ́ kpɔ he nomonome la do o nɔn ta.
Wɛɛ ɛ nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam ne Juda dea tena bwa mɛɛ.
O nɔn taa mɛɛ ba Kooro Devid dem safoa kpɔe do ó di kpeɡri, dɛ o pili komɛl aa, nomɛlbwa aa won tɔɔ, dɛ o tɔ komɛl ɡe aa, nomɛlbwa aa won pilu.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o che kiŋkiŋ, kɛŋɔ baa kpaa tɛnte baŋra daa do harɛ o che kiŋkiŋ la, ásɛ o nomonome dii dɔ jirima o dem.
O dem nɛra wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dawɛ o nɛɛ, o naanar ne ba ɡe bii bwa saɡre o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ numoli ne loŋa aa saɡre daa ta la.
Awola tɔpere la, tɛnte baŋra daa maa kpaara do harɛ o pa kiŋkiŋ la ɛɛ pamɔɔ le dɛ́ chole, ásɛ laala aa saɡɛ o ta la bwa chɔɡ.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Korowii bol bwɛjen Taaya chɔɡa wa Waa aa chiɡ Taaya Korowii bol baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta laanee nɔ.
Nɛra haa dɛ ɛ toma stiimaere aa le Taases la, hé wi!
Taaya paɡrɔ.
Deene kɛɛ stiimae chebɔr toole kpa.
Saepros harɛ taa ɡɛ waa nɔ le ba he be.
Nɛra haa soɡe mpo nyoa la, hé wi!
He ne bonadiire baa le Sidon dɛɛ ɛ toma stiimae bini dɛ dɛɡ la, hé wi.
He tomɛ baala ba la mpo baŋ, dɛ ka yawɛ mea le Ijipt harɛ, dɛ ba yoɡ dɛɛ tɛ harɛre nɛra.
Bela baa ɛ bona dibɔr harɛre ɡalɡa ta.
Bwɛjen Sidon tena, a chɛ kɛ sihiih kpo heya.
Mpo haa kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛɛ la taɡɛ heyaa ta dɛ ŋɔ, “N do kɛ hambara, n ta bibaala dɛɛrɛ bwa, n baa bol bihaahna wa.” Dɛ Ijipt tena noɔ kɛŋɔ bwɛjen Taaya paɡraa, ba bwara ɛɛ yɔroo ba wi tɛɛ ba.
He nɛra haa soɡe mpo nyoa la, hé wi dɛ́ ir kaa Taases.
He bwɛsom Taaya laanee nɔ naa?
Bwɛbenebene o nɛra aa joa ka so bojaŋ harɛre ta laanee nɔ naa?
Umee ɡela ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡ Taaya ɔ?
Kondɛɛɡa bwɛɛ o bonadiire aa beɡre koobii dɛ dɔ nyanyini harɛ nɔ ta bwa laanee nɔ naa?
Koranar Bwa Kooroo ɡela a chiɡ.
O ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ ba jirima baa dɔa dɛɛ ɡɔɔ ba te la tonɛ, dɛ́ ba banɔ la baa dɔ nyanyini harɛ nɔ ta la ne harɛ.
Taases tena, he ta stiimae chuɡribɔr dɔe kpa.
Anomanta, hé ka parɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ parɛ Nael Moo nyoa harɛ ta la.
Korowii tɛr o nɔn pa mpo ta, o ir mpo nyoa koranar ɡalɡa.
O bol Keenan harɛ nɛra baa soɡe mpo nyoa la wa, dɛ chɔɡ ba dekpeɡa.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Sidon haa wera kɛŋɔ bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ, taraken he chɔɡɔ!
Silɛɛ aa lɔ he ta la bwa toole kpa.
Ir dɛ́ kaa Saepros harɛ ta, hale bela ɡba haa ona dɔe ba.” Nyiŋi Babelɔn tena harɛ na, ɡɛ nɛra nɔ fa toole wobɛlbwa bini.
Asiiria tena ɡelɔ o berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ola sobɔr.
Ba ma konjaŋa dɛ pɛl danjwɛɛre aa bar bwɛɛre la ta, dɛ che a ta jo, dɛ kuuɡi dekpeɡa bela bwa berɛ dimɡbia.
Nɛra haa dɛ ɛ toma Taases stiimaere bini la, hé wi!
Bwɛjen haa kpɔ sie dawɛ o ta la paɡrɔ!
Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba, ba soh Taaya waa bene fifraanuanɛ, aa doo kɛŋɔ kooro bene waa di harɛ nɔ ta.
A ɡɛ bene nɔ habɔɔ la, aa chiɡ Taayaa ɡɛ baa bola hanjwamane yel nɔ ta la.
“Hanjwamane te, ba soh he wa.
Kpɔ he janjela dɛ́ lɔ kohona valɛ bwɛɛ bini.
Go yela kohona ásɛ baala lii he wa.” Bene fifraanuanɛ habɔɔ la, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo Taaya tena berɛ kpɔ ba toma ja.
Gɛ hanjwamane yon dɛɛ nyin suuɡa baala be la, ɡɛɛ baa ba harɛ nɔ ta harɛre ta laŋa ka di bona.
Ba tɔnɔ baa dɔ ne ba suuɡa baa dɔa la, baa a taa tɔ.
Baa kwaaraa cheɡ á ɛ Korowii kwa, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ la kpɔ yawɛ kondikwaa kohona dɛ́ di dɛ́ yawɛ ba bwara laaladɛɛɡa baa dɛ nyin bwa.
Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ harɛ nɔ ne nɛra baa lɔ o taa Hé no!
Korowii dɛ ba harɛ nɔ chɔɡa o chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Wɛɛ lɔ nɛra baa lɔ o taa peɡre, dɛ́ chɔɡ komɛlbwa o ta.
Gɛ webeŋkpoŋ nɔ ɛɛ pu nɛra ne ba sɔfore, bonɔɔna ne ba dɔɔranar, bonadiire ne yarawa ne banɔ la baa dɔa dɛɛ kemɛ nɛra, ne banɔ la baa laŋa kaa kemɛ, dɛ dɔɔhna ne nyaara.
Harɛ nɔ ɛɛ chɔɡoo dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ, o komɛlbwa tonɛ kwaraa.
Korowiirii bola.
Hwel cheɡɛ harɛ ta, o ta kwaa bwa jwalɛ, nyundua tɔɔ, harɛ som tonɔ, harɛ ta nɛnjena ɡwɛɡre.
Harɛ ta nɛra siwi ta Korowii waa la sui, ba vɛh o Mmarare dɛ chɔɡ fɔo o ne baa fɔwa ó chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ.
Anomanta, Korowii taah harɛ bwa, nɛra baa lɔ o ta la ɛɛ dɔ ba wechɔɡa kembɔree.
Anomanta, wɛɛ kpɔ niinii tɛr ba deŋne dɛ́ fuuh ba, ba bini tamaa ken ka.
Daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen serewɔ, dɛ ɡel sen waa do tɔɡre.
Nomɛlbwa o sie fa aa dɛ lɛ sen ta la berɔ dɛɛ di suna.
Kwaa baa dɛ yiiɡa kɛŋɔ loŋa a sii do som helɔ, janjela baa dɛ hɛlɛ a ne dɛɛ lɛ sie la ɡe hel.
Haa nɛra baa dɛ hɛlɛ la ɡbɔɡa no bobɛlbwa.
Baa senee nyɔ dɛ́ ɡo yela kpa, seŋkpeɡa aa somɛ a nyɔɔra nyoo kpa.
Bwɛjen la chɔɡɔ dɛ chɔ pɛɛ, ba karɛ dem bɛlbwa doonyoa ɡbera tɔ ba ɡbaɡba nɛ.
Ba dɛ wi sen waa fɔɡbaahna, silɛɛ bwa tonɔ, sum ɡboo kaa.
Hɛɡra toole harɛ ta kpa.
Bwɛjen la chɔɡɔ, o doonyoo ɡbeni bwa kuuɡo kwaraa.
Gɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.
Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ baa chaa ɔleve ne ɡrepore nɔna, a ka beŋkpoŋa saɡre baa kuuhna la.
Nɛra baa dɔ ba nyu la ɛɛ ɡo yela silɛɛ nee.
Banɔ la baa lɔ wee cholibɔr ɛɛ baɡle jirima Korowii aa dɔa.
He banɔ la haa lɔ wee leebɔr pera ɡe, hé tɛ Korowii sɔn.
Ekwie harɛre aa lɔ mpo ta bwa nɛra, hé kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la.
Yaa no yelaa le harɛ jaɡa bwa bá ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel Korowii O Wa Aa Toɡra la dɔ sɔn!” Anee n ŋɔ, “A tonɔ, a tonɔ!
N dɛ ɡwaŋɛ!
Banɔ la baa dɛ neɡre nɛra ta nao dɛɛ neɡre.” Nomɛlbwa no n be!
Ɔmewaa ne bɔɔ ne bela chɔɔ kpa heya.
Nomɛlbwa waa no ɔmewaa ɡbɔɡa dɛ́ chwa la, wɛɛ ka le bɔɔ binii.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa le bɔɔ bini dɛ́ takapɔ ir la, wɛɛ le bel taa.
Nyundua ɛɛ piluu nee fuɡe, kwaa harɛ aa cheɡɛ a ta ɡe yiiɡi kohona.
Harɛ ɛɛ peroo, wɛɛ jiɡruu dɛ́ peɡri.
Harɛ ɛɛ yɛɛɡoo kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛ ken, kɛɛ pata peu aa dɛ kpɔɔ ken.
Harɛ nɛra wechɔɡa sii ba nɛ, dɛ́ ba ba ne harɛ, baa choloo baa wola ir kpa.
Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ tɛr kwaa aa dɔ kpeɡri dɛ do nyundua, ne koranar baa dɔ kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta deŋnee.
Korowii ɛɛ lawɛ koranaree pɛ do dea, kɛŋɔ ba yon lawɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra dɛɛ do dea la, ásɛ a ba dɛ la sie ó tɛr ba deŋne.
Dɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro baa di o kora Saayɔn Bwejen ta Jerusalam aa, o kora dii jirima ɛɛ ɡwaa korobie chaahna ne wee lɔe, ásɛ bwɛjen la nomonome na dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ waa kana.
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii N Naa Korowii, henee mɛɛ tomɛ, mɛɛ tɛɛ sɔnee dɛ́ kpɛɛre.
He ɛ nyokpowa, waa haa maɡla bil saŋ la, he ɛa kasinteŋ ne.
He ɡelɔ bwɛjena berɛ dimɡbia, he kuuɡi danjwɛkpeɡa aa bara la.
Dekpeɡa hɔɔhra aa maa la, he kuuɡa ta, baa an ma kpa.
Anomanta, harɛre nɛra baa kpeɡa ɛɛ kpɛɛree, ásɛ bwɛjena a nɛra nyu bini aa kpeɡa duuri.
He lɛ nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra ba suna dii tɔpere ta.
He dɛ tɔ ba nɛɛ dɛɛ le peukpeɡ ta, wee nyɛɡre aa, he laɡ ba dɛɛ tɛɛ ba chunchule.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena do kɛŋɔ, peukpeɡ aa taa dɛ kpɔ nee dɛɛ lɔ danjwɛɛ dɛɛ kuu la, dɛ berɛ do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta wee waa do nyɛɡre ken.
He sɔɔh ɡbɔɡa ya dɔma nyubinikpeɡ tena baa le harɛre ta aa dɛ do la nyoa, ɡɛ bam yon tɔ wee ta dɛ sɔɔh o nyoa la.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ yerɛ harɛre nɛra bwaa ŋɔ, bá ba di kondikonjena, dɛ́ nyɔ sendɛɛɡa dɛ́ lɛ ba sie, Saayɔn Bwejen ta Jerusalam.
Gɛ bwejen nɔ taa Korowii ɛɛ ba tebinichɔɡ aa lɔ harɛre nɛra bwa nɛɛ la chɔɡa, dɛ́ laa a bwa kpɔ.
Wɛɛ le seo nee waa wola lee do kpa bwa.
Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ fee nomɛlbwa siniiree, dɛ́ laa sihiih o nɛra aa dia kpɔ harɛ nɔ bwa ta.
Korowiirii bola.
A ba ɡɛ naa, baa boloo ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laanee la.
Korowii yaa hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ laanee la, o lɛ yaa.
Hé ɡel ya hɛɡre ya sie lɛ, lɛɛ waa lɛ yaa la wa.” Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ Saayɔn Bwejen la taa, kɛ Moab tena te, baa tiɡri ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa tiɡri kpɔɡa dɛɛ koo nabena ta la.
Baa dɛɛ ta nɔɔra a binii, kɛŋɔ nɛn yon dɛɛ wa nee la.
Korowii ɛɛ ba ba jenu baa dɛ ɛ la ne harɛɛ, hale ba takapɔ ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, aa won lɛɛ ba.
Wɛɛ chɔɡ Moab harɛ bwɛɛre danjwɛkpeɡa ne anjaŋa bwaa, dɛ́ kuuɡa a bwa a chɔ harɛ.
Kpɛɛra yel Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ Juda harɛ nɛra ɡo yel nɔ harɛ la ta.
Ya dɔ bwɛjen danjwɛkpeɡ aa baro name, Korowii ɡbabirii cheɡɛ ya habɔɔ, dɛɛ nyiŋi danjwɛɛ waa baro ta.
Hé ya bwɛjen la doonyoone, ásɛ harɛ o nɛra wa aa toɡra, ba waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ Korowii bá jo.
N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ tɛ banɔ la ba liire aa cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ bosɔɔhna tenten, dawa baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ he nɛɛ la wa.
Hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Onee Bwetal waa dɛ tɔ ya nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.
O dɛ ba banɔ la baa dɛ ɡɔɔ ba te ne harɛ.
O dɛ kuuɡi bwɛjen waa kpeɡa baa soɡe o ta, ásɛ o kuuɡi chɔ harɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba, ne nyaara ɛɛ valɛ o taa, dɛ́ tiɡru do harɛ.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ŋwɛnɛ ɛɛ do wer, he kwaaro baa valɛ o ta.
Ya sie dawɛ he nɛɛ yaa teŋɛ he Mmarare ta, he ɡbosoo ya bambile lawɛ.
N sie dɛ che chiŋ jwaana he wa, chɔɔbɔr ɡe, n pɛla dɛ lawɛ.
He baa bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa dɛ pa bole aa, aa ɡeloo ba hweli waa aa toɡra.
A lole kɛŋɔ he ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, kɛ baa waa aa toɡra hweli.
Hale harɛ o nɛra wa aa toɡra ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, ba sie aa he kan haa doa tɔɡɛ.
N Naa Korowii, he dɔma aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ ba ba deŋne tɛra.
Gel ba na ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin he nɛra, ásɛ sihiih kpo ba.
Kpɔ deŋnetɛra haa maɡla bil ba la chɔɡ ba.
N Naa Korowii, he dɛ tɛ yaa deŋnesɔɔhna, komɛlbwa yaa dɔa la, henee ɛa tɛ yaa.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, nɛra banee fa dɛ nyiŋi ya nɛ, kɛ he ɡboo ya kpɔ jirima dɛɛ tɛ.
Taraken, ɡɛ nɛra la serewɔ, ba toole kpa, ba lala aa ir kpa.
He tɛr ba deŋne dɛ chɔɡ ba, nomɛlbwa aa ba waa lii kpa bwa.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡelɔ ya harɛ do kan.
He tuuh o jwɛhre kaa sie o do kan.
He ɛ ɡɛ dɛ dɔ jirima nɛra be.
N Naa Korowii, he tɛr he nɛra deŋne baa na wahala, asɛ ba ba he be ba soŋe.
He ɡelɔ ya bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ yaa wi, kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ ken.
Weweele yaa nao la ta wobɛlbwa ne balɛ, ya ta wone pɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra nɛ, ya ta wone yo lɛ harɛ la.
Kɛ he nɛra baa serewa la ɛɛ iruu, dɛ́ berɛ dɔ bwadabii ja.
He banɔ la haa lɔ lalbɔɔne bini, hé ir, dɛ́ ɡo silɛɛ yela!
Gɛ mɛn yon ta kwaa ta aa do wer chɔɔbɔr la, ɡɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba banɔ la baa serewa la mkpa tɛɛ.
Anomanta, n nɛra, hé ka jo he deene, dɛ́ laa ɡbeni tɔ he nɛ.
Hé kpɔ he te sɔh tama ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii baah aa sɔɔhna.
Hé no!
Korowii le o dobɔr nyundua dɛɛ ba, dɛ́ ba tɛr nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta deŋne ba wechɔɡa wa.
Harɛ ɛɛ le nɛra baa sɔah kpoo nɛra laanee tɛ, waa ban kpɔ sɔh kpa.
Korowii ɛɛ lɛ Israel tenaa Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ o kerejen waa nyɛɡa laanee tɛr oljen waa dɛ tuuɡi harɛ, dɛ ɛ harɛkon, dɛ ɡoɡli dɛɛ kaa sɔrr la deŋne.
Onee mpo bini oljen Lɛvayatan la.
Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ bol o daa koo bɛl waa wera waa ŋɔ, “Men Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi o ta, menee dɛɛ do nee o ta tɔpere bɛlbwa, chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa mɛɛ daahno, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ on ba chɔɡ.
N baah ta daa koo nɔ waa cheɡa tɛ n nɛra la nɛɛ dii, kɛ dɛ jabalnadaŋɛre ne sɔɔhne aa cheɡa tɛ ba dɔma, leɔ dɛ tɔ ba nɛɛ tenaa, mɛɛ jo ba binii dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.
Kɛ dɛ n nɛra dɔma dɛ nyin kɛ n kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛ aa, n ne ba baah ɛɛ do werii.” Tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao Jekɔb naanar baa ɛ Israel tena la dɔ lune dɛ́ le kɛŋɔ daa ken, dɛ́ moɡɛ dɛ́ fe, ásɛ dɛ nɔnɛ perɛ harɛ ta bobɛlbwa.
Korowii ta Israel tena deŋne tɛrɛ kohona, dɛ kpoo ba kɛŋɔ waa kpoo ba dɔma la.
Laalee o kpɔ tɛr Israel tena deŋne, dɛ doŋ ba le ba harɛ ta kpeɡri ne kaa harɛfale ta, kɛŋɔ peuchɔɡe aa taa le wee leebɔr, dɛ kpɔ kwaa dɛɛ kaa la.
Dɛ Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ Israel tena wechɔɡaa kɛ ba aa, atane baa kuuɡi kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare la buruburu kɛŋɔ fula ken, dɛ́ teŋni ba voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa, ne bwea baa paaɡa dɛ fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛo a ta la bwa ta.
Bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro la paɡrɔ, Nomɛlbwa toole o ta, o chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛ berɛ nae dibɔr.
Belaa a chɔ dɛɛ onɛ, dɛ́ pɛɡre daa kpala bwa ta.
Dɛ a holaa, a kuuɡo dɛɛ lee, ásɛ haahna yon ba paa kaa mar.
Israel tena aa waa mun no.
Anomanta, Korowii tea aa ba nɛɛ domɛ.
Onee ta ba, kɛ waa ba sum na.
Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ boa o nɛra nyoa le Yufretis Moo, dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta, dɛ lɔɔ ba kɛŋɔ mea ken, dɛ́ tɔɔ Israel tena beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa pɛ.
Awola bɛla ɛɛ siu kohona, dɛ́ yerɛ Israel tena baa laɡ ba laa ta, ba kaa Asiiria ne Ijipt harɛ ta ka so biɡri la, ásɛ ba bwa berɛ ba tomɛ Korowii Jerusalam, Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.
Efrem Dea tena wenaale wa Israel harɛ bwɛɛlɛ!
O jirima dɛ dime kɛŋɔ kwaa fee aa lɔ sitɔɔla baa ɛ sennyɔɔra kooɡbɛrɛre ta dɛɛ lee la.
Ba nyuune baa ɡɔɔra dɛɛ valɛ sɔɔh konsɔɔhsoma, kɛ ba dɛɛrɔ chɔ.
Hé na, Korowii dɔ nomɛl waa dɔ jirima o bwara ɡe do kpeɡri.
O bala bini do kɛŋɔ dombwea aa dɛ lee la, kɛɛ dompeu chɔɡe waa taa dɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa la.
Wɛɛ taɡɛ bwɛɛ laanee ɡo harɛ, kɛŋɔ bwaala yon nɛ kohona, dɛ́ chɔɡ kwaa dɛ́ pala kaa la.
Israel sitɔɔla, baa ɛ sennyɔɔra kooɡbɛrɛre baa kpɔa dɛɛ maŋkura ba te la, baa tiɡraa do harɛ.
Ba sitɔɔla la jirima dɛ ba dima, kɛŋɔ fiɡ daa nɔnloɡle bɛl aa tɔ sie swɛɛ, asɛ nɛn kpɔ di warane la.
Awola tɔpere la, Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛ́ ɛ kooɡbɛrɛ waa wera dɛ dɔ jirima kohona tɛ o nɛra baa kaa la.
Dɛ́ berɛ tɛ nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la liire, baa bola kasinteŋ ne, a berɛ che o nɛɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen la doonyoo, dɛ lɛɛ ba dɛɛ ta laa ta la dɔ bokpeɡa.
Hale Korowii keamere ne sɔfore la dɛ nyɔ sen dɛɛ yɛɛɡe.
Ba nyɔ seŋkpeɡa dɛɛ kɛŋle dɛ wili.
Keamere la seŋkpeɡa nyɔe kohona ɡelɔ waa Korowii aa ɡela baa naa chaahna ta la, baa a bini nae dɛɛ baɡle.
Sɔfore la ɡe wili waa bola dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Chwɛɛra ɡboo ba teeburre bwa, a bobɛlbwa sese ta kae dɛ do wer.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ ɛɛ bol men Aesaya waa ŋɔ, “Umee o bol Korowii waa dɛɛ baɡle ɔ?
Umee o pili waa mun dɛɛ tɛ nɔɔ?
Bechale baa ta elee a do wer tɛ.
O webaɡla ta mun dɔe.
O bol waa la sie, dɛ o bolɔ ba habɔɔ.” A wer ɡa, haa a mun no tenaa, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he no o waa wobofala ta.
Nɛŋhɔɔhraa wɛɛ ba ɡela ba bol baɡle heya.
Korowii ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ona bɔree la, nomɛlbwa waa koah la, ó ba onɛ,” dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Deŋnesɔɔhna bɔree” kɛ baa no.
Baa wobɛlbwa Korowii aa dɛ bol ba be mun no.
Ba bol waa la sie, dɛ ba bolɔ ba habɔɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa, asɛ ba le habɔɔ dɛ ka choɡli, dɛ foɡri, dɛ jo bel ta ba laɡ ba.
Anomanta, he sitɔɔla haa dɛ nyiŋi Jerusalam tena nɛɛ he siwi aa wola nɛn tɔɡɛ, hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol.
He dɛ ta nyoa ŋɔ, “Ya ne seo fɔwɛ fɔo, ya ne lalabwɛɛ nyoa pɛ.
Dɛ harɛchɔɡ peu dɛ ba naa, waa yaa dɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya kpɔ ya te do nyosone ne neɡra ta, kɛŋɔ aa tɔ ya nɛ dɛ́ lɛ yaa.” Waa Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bolee nɔ.
“Na, n pɛne Bwedɛɛɡe o wa aa hiah, dɛ kpɔ pa n Dea mun Saayɔn, o lawɔ kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ.
Kasinteŋii mɛɛ ba kpɔe berɛ ŋwɛn ba kpɔ dɛɛ maɡɛ kon, dɛ́ kpɔ waa aa toɡra berɛ kon demamaala aa kpɔa dɛɛ toɡre dea.
Dompeu ne nee dɛɛ ba a palɛ nyosone haa kpɔa tɔ he te la kaa.
Fɔo he ne seo aa fɔwa la ɛɛ chɔɡoo, nyopɛo he ne lalabwɛ aa dɔa la ɡe aa lee do kpa.
Dɛ harɛchɔɡ peu baa ta aa, wɛɛ dɔ heyaa, dɛ́ lɔ heyaa bil harɛ.
Chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa wɛɛ ba tae, saŋ te bɛlbwa waa ta la, wɛɛ kaa he nee.” Dɛ he no waa nɔ mun aa, ɔmee ɛɛ lawɛ heyaa kohonaa taeh.
Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ sɛɡla baa ŋɔa, mpa waa wola jaŋɛ nɛn chɔ o ta dɛ́ tɛɡre o te, bombo waa wola kanɛ dɛ́ telu ken.
Korowii ɛɛ iruu, dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ o fa aa ɛa Pɛrasem Bwejen ta la, dɛ ɛ ɡɛ tenten Gebeɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta, ásɛ dɛ ɛ o toma aa ɛ wefala yaa wola a dɔŋa nae bwa, dɛ́ ɛ nyokpowa.
He bɛ jae maa dɛ ja heyaa nɔ mamɛ, ásɛ he wahala haa dɛ́ ba nae la bɛ he nɛɛ ba ɡwaa kohona.
Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro bol n be, maɡla waa maɡla bil kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ harɛ bwaa la.
Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n be!
Hé no waa maa dɛ bol nɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Saŋ bɛlbwa laa paa teŋɛ dɛɛ parɛ, kɛɛ dɛɛ buɡli koo.
Waa kwaa harɛ la tonɛ la, wɛɛ merɛ anɔ la waa merɛɛ, dɛ́ du anɔ la ɡe waa du a bwa ne a bɔra.
O jemɛ o toma.
Korowiirii baɡlo anɔ la aa wera.
Waa kontɔɡ kpɔe dɛɛ lɔ konjeɡre kɛŋɔ jule.
Daa waa maɡraa o kpɔ dɛɛ lɔa, ásɛ a bɛ peɡri.
Namaa wɛɛ namɛ mea, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ paanoo.
Lɔe laa wɛɛ lɔa.
Saŋ bɛlbwa laa o teŋɛ dɛɛ lɔ mea.
Lɔe wɛɛ lɔa, ásɛ a bie le.
Nama laa wɛɛ nama.
Gɛ liire nɔ bwa, Koranar Bwa Kooro bee a le.
Baɡla waa baɡle nɛra waa dɔ nyokpoa, o wejema ta jaɡa dɔe.
Kooro Devid Bwɛjen wenaale wa Jerusalam tena hé bwɛɛlɛ!
He bwɛjen Kooro Devid aa soɡe o ta la ɛɛ chɔɡoo.
Bena bɛlbwaa he teŋɛ dɛɛ di he tɔpejena, kɛ Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo he Jerusalam tena bwara nyɛɡ heya, ásɛ hɛɛ wi dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre.
He bwɛjen la bwa ɛɛ ɛ chalee, kɛŋɔ kon baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma bar heyaa cheme dɛ́ tɔ heyaa do.
Baa ma konjaŋaa pɛl danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛɛ la, dɛ́ che a ta jo.
Wɛɛ lɔ heyaa bil harɛ, he chɔ dɛɛ bol wa, he taa ɛɛ le tama tama ken.
He wobol ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ lale wobol dɛɛ le harɛ bini, aa baŋee le kohona.
Kɛ he dɔma baa wara ɛɛ berɔɔ ɛ kɛŋɔ bomboɡ mohooh ken, ásɛ peu kpɔ kaa, nɛnlaa ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa he nɛɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ mea pɛɡa peu yon kpɔa ir kaa la.
Aa ɛo warane wɔrɔbe nɛ, Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ ba lɛ heyaa bwaala kɔɡra nee, harɛ jiɡri, ɡbɔɡa tɔ kohona, peukpeɡ ta, bwaalachɔɡe nɛ, nii chɔɡ kwa.
Harɛre nɛra baa wara, dɛ pu Jerusalam dɛɛ yo, dɛ ka kuuɡi o dekpeɡa, dɛ baro dɛ tɔ o nɛra do la, ba bwa waa ɛɛ kaaloo kɛŋɔ, haa na waane dɛ deera jwaana ken.
Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ lɔr aa dɛ kpoe, asɛ he chɔ dee dɛɛ di kwa, kɛ haa ba jar ir la, dɛ lɔr ta dɛ kpoe la ken.
Kɛɛ nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpoe he dee, dɛ na kɛ he dɛ nyɔ ne, dɛ jar ir dɛ nyɔɡre la ta dɛ kpoe la ken.
Gɛɛ aa ba doe dɛ tɛ harɛre nɛra baa wara dɛ yo Saayɔn Bwejen la.
Jerusalam tena nyoa ta kpoe yaa?
He bwara ta yɔraa?
He mwaalo ne, a ɡel he nyoŋe, he ta sen nyɔe kɛ dɛ ɡe dɛɛ, he dɛ yɛɛɡe, kɛ he ta seŋkpeɡa nyɔe.
Korowii kpɔ dom ta he nɛ, hɛɛ ba dom chɔe ka ɡarɛ, dɛ tɔɔɡe keamere la sibie, dɛ wili nɛra baa dɛ na waa bini la.
Waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa kerekere ba naa kɛŋɔ chaahna ta nɔ, he bee a do kɛŋɔ waa chwera do tɔn ta, dɛ marɛ o nyoa.
Asɛ dɛ he kpɔɔ tɛ nɛn waa jemɛ kura dɛ ŋɔ, “N poori, kure ń no aa,” o ŋɔ, “Maa won kure, ba marɛ o nyoa.” Kɛɛ dɛ he kpɔ tɔn la la nɛn waa wola jemɛ kure be ŋɔ, “N poori, kure tɛ mɛ” naa, o ŋɔ, “Maa jemɛ kure.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛra nɔ te, nyoa ɡbo nee baa baɡle kɛŋɔ n ne ba pɛo, nyoa ɡbo nee baa duu mɛ, kɛ ba tea bini te ta toe.
Toma baa dɛ tom mɛ la, nɛwɛnyini mmarare taa baa baɡle ŋɔ nɛ́ra teŋɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ba nyokpowaa nee ba ta ba nɛɛ ja, ba bwara yɔr.
Aa ɡeloo wejerema ɡɛn, ásɛ nɛra baa jemɛ waa bini waa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.” Nɛra baa swɛɛ siwi kpɔ ba waa dɛɛ sɔh Korowii la, ba bwɛɛlɛ!
Ba dɛ ɛ ba waa biro ta dɛɛ lii ŋɔ, “Umee na mɛ nɔ?
Umee dɛɛ ba jema ɔ?” He berɛ waa sie pi, kɛŋɔ mamaa aa berɛ choh.
Kon baa mao la ɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ nɛn waa mao la be ŋɔ, “He laa ma mɛ,” kɛɛ vii ɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ mamaa be ŋɔ, “Haa wobɛlbwa jemɛ” aa?
A ka tamaa Lɛbanɔn kɔr berɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe, ásɛ o ta kwaa do kɛŋɔ kɔr bini kwaa ken.
Gɛ saŋ la, amumure ɛɛ noo kɛŋɔ baa dɛ kure tɔn, ásɛ nyoŋa baa soɡe biro ta la won dɛɛ na.
Nɛŋɡwɛɡra sie ɛɛ berɔɔ lɛ Korowii waa ta ja, nyaara hɛɡre Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la wa.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena aa lee do kpa, bammuɡli tena aa lee do kpa, nɛra ba sie aa swɛɛ wechɔɡa ta bwa, Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ baa.
Wɛɛ chɔɡ banɔ la nɛra aa che ba wobol ta dɛ́ ɛ wechɔɡa, ne banɔ la baa ɡela nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole wili, ne banɔ la baa cheɡɛ nyosone ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ pa nɛra baa di bolsom bolchɔɡe.
Anomanta, Korowii waa lɛ Abraham bol waa nɔ dɛɛ baɡle Israel tena ŋɔ, “Sihiih aa heyaa kpo kpa bwa, haa he dɔma ɔma waa koh ɡwaŋɛ kpa.
Ba baa na ba bii ba bini, ɡɛ maa ɡela ba warɛ la aa, baa duu mɛɛ, dɛ́ sɛh kɛŋɔ menee Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la, dɛ́ ɔmɛ men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la kohona.
Nɛra baa ɡɛna ɛɛ hweli waa dɛ́ no a mun, banɔ la baa dɛ naɡre waa la ɡe sɛh baa baɡ ba wa.”
Nyopɛo fɔo waa wola tɔnɔ dɔe Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Deŋnekpeɡ tena baa dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta la, ba bwɛɛlɛ!
Ba dɛ teŋɛ ba ɡbaɡba liire aa wola n be leɛ ta, dɛɛ fɔwɛ nyopɛo fɔo n Doma aa wola ba nɛɛ jae, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ ja wechɔɡa ta.
Ba ta men bɔɔrɛ no dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ la Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ka marɛ Ijipt kooro ó tɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ lee ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta.
Mara baa ŋɔa ba kaa marɛ kooro la ɛɛ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Ijipt harɛ ta baa ŋɔa ba dɔ sɔɔhbɔr la, ba di ncho.
A lole kɛŋɔ Juda tena toroma lɔ Ijipt bwɛjena Soan ne Hanes, kɛ sihiih ne nchoo Juda tena ɛɛ ba dii, kpɔe baa kpɔ ba te ka dawɛ nɛra baa wola won cha ba nɛ, baa wola ba tɔnɔɔ dɔ la.” Waa Korowii aa bera kpɔ baɡle Aesaya chaahna ta, a ɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa waa Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa nɔ.
“Juda tena toroma la vɔrɔwe ba laala dawɛ keeɡore ta, dɛ vɔrɔwe ba kondɔɔh dawɛ nyoɡmare ta, dɛ kpɔ wekpeɡa ne siswɛm harɛ, nyujentena ne domkpule ne harɛkwaare aa dɛ jah aa lole, dɛɛ kaa harɛ la tɔnɔ bɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta la ta.
Chae bɛlbwa toole Ijipt harɛ ta, a ɛ wepuu.
A waa mɛɛ yerɔ Harɛkpeɡ Waa Wola Kpeɡri Dɔe.” Korowii ŋɔ men Aesaya be ŋɔ, “Namete kaa, dɛ́ ka chwerɛ n nɛra waa maa bol he be nɔ dawɛ bwepɛla ta tɛɛ ba, chwera do tɔn ta, ásɛ a chɔ le kerekere dɛ́ ɛ danseɛ saŋ te bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ba ɛ nɛra baa dɛ lɛ ɡaeh ne nyosonteŋna.
Ba ɛ nɛra baa vɛh Korowii waa noe.
Ba ŋɔ Korowii keamere baa dɛ na waa chaahna ta be ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ chaahna waa bol ya be kpa.
He bɛ kasinteŋ waa aa chɛ kɛ ya ɛ dɛɛ bol kpa.
Hɛ́ɛ bol waa aa dɛ lɛ sie, dɛ ɛ wesoma ya be.
Hé ɡel ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛ la.
He bɛ Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la waa bol ya be kpa.’ ” Anomanta, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la ŋɔ, “Haa vɛh waa nɔ, dɛ kpɔ he ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ di kpeɡri nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ neɡ ba nomanta, he wechɔɡa ɛɛ ɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ waa pera dɛɛ ba chola, asɛ dɛ piɡri chole buɡ ta la.
Wɛɛ paɡroo kɛŋɔ vimamaa vii yon paɡre, dɛ́ peɡri burbur la ken, o kaŋli aa wola kanee do kɛ ba kpɔ buh nii, kɛɛ ba kpɔ ɛ nee la.” Waa Nemenɛ Korowii, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ aa bol nɛra la bee nɔ.
“Hé berɛ ba n be, dɛ́ kpɔ he hwɛɡa dawɛ n nɛ, ásɛ n lɛ heya, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛ.
Kɛ he vɛoh, he ta balɛ.
He dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Akai, yaa so jaɡre taa dɛ chwa kaa.’ A wer ɡa.
Hé so jaɡre ta chwa.
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he jaɡre ɡbaŋre, kɛ nɛra baa ti heyaa la kwaa ɡbaŋre ɡwaa he kwa.
He nɛra kaɡboŋ ɛɛ na he dɔm beŋkpoŋii dɛ ɔmɔ dɛ́ chwa, he dɔma banue ɛɛ ɡeloo he bwa chwa, a ka he laa fraŋkaa ɡbo pa deŋɡare ta.” Ane a bwa, Korowii tea dɛ domɔ he waa wɛɛ kpa kɛ he ba o be.
O na he sum, dɛkalkɛ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
Banɔ la bwa baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛɛ la, ba na som.
Saayɔn tena, nɛra haa soɡe Jerusalam, haa wi kpa.
Korowii dɛ na he sum.
He wio noo waa, buɡ la ta, wɛɛ no he bee.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo wekpeɡa ne hɔhɔrɔwa ba he nɛ, kɛ waa o webaɡlaa kpɔ sɔh heya.
Wɛɛ kpɔ o tenee baɡle heyaa hé nao.
He kono kpɔ diɡ oo, ɡal oo, hɛɛ no taa bɛl he habɔɔ, o ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛ laanee la, hé kpɔ o ta.” Haa he voɡa haa kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm ɛ a bwara, laanee kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa kpa, dɛ́ kpɔa ka ta kɛŋɔ yakwara aa wola were ken, dɛ́ ŋɔ a be ŋɔ, “Hé le ya sie.” Korowii ɛɛ nɛ bwaalaa do kwaa haa dua ta, ásɛ a do wer dɛ́ ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
He kondɛɛra ɛɛ dɔ bɔr waa kanaa dɛɛ di.
Nae ne keeɡore haa kpɔa dɛɛ parɛ he kooni la, ɛɛ di mea baa pala kɛrɛdɛ pɛɡaa.
Awola Korowii aa ba kpoo he dɔma kohona dɛ́ kuuɡi ba dejaŋa ta la, nee ɛɛ palɔɔ le bwejaŋa ne deŋɡarere aa kaa nyundua bwa ta.
Korobie ɛɛ lɔɔ dɛ chaah bɔr kɛŋɔ wee ken, ásɛ wee chaah bɔr kohona kɛŋɔ baa lɔ tɔpera anuanɛ wee bɔr chaahna pɛ ken.
A ɡɛ saŋ Korowii ɛɛ vɔrɔwe bola waa do o nɛra laanee, dɛ́ chaah ba.
Hé no!
Korowii sɔn ɔma, o le bojaŋ dɛɛ ba.
O baah diu kɛŋɔ nii aa dɛ hɔ ken, chuu ɛɛ le kohona.
Bandia ɡboo o wobol bwa, aa fuh o dɔmaa kɛŋɔ nii aa dɛ fuh kwaa ken.
O hweera do kɛŋɔ nee waa dɛ palɛ dɛ su tel baŋa ta la.
O dɛ ɡboo harɛre nɛra kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɡboo kwaa la ken, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.
Gɛ baa kpɔ kabaɡrare do jaaɡɔ nyoa dɛɛ beɡro la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba harɛre nɛra beɡra le waa baa maɡla bil la ta.
Korowii nɛra sie ɛɛ lɛo baa ɡo yela kɛŋɔ, baa dɛ di tɔpejena dɛɛ ɡo yela jwaana la.
He baah ɛɛ sɔɔh heyaa kɛŋɔ nɛra aa hoh kalipere dɛɛ kaa Korowii Dea.
Korowiirii do kɛ Israel tena Bwetal waa dɛ lɛɛ ba.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra no o taa, dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ waa do kan, dɛ́ ɡel ba na o bandia waa dɛ́ ba o ne, dɛ́ ba tɛr ba deŋne.
Bandichɔɡe ne nii aa dɛ chɔɡ kwa, ne bwaalachɔɡe ne peu, ne bwaala kɔɡra dɛ dombwea nee wɛɛ ba bala.
Korowii taa la ɛɛ ɡeloo Asiiria tena bwara hɛlɛ, wɛɛ kpɔ o koodaŋɡbalaa lɔ ba bil.
Korowii aa ir o daŋɡbala dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ tɛr ba deŋne la, lɔe bɛlbwa waa lɔ ba la, dɛ Israel tena ɡe dɛ yiiɡi kwaa kɛŋɔ loŋa ken, dɛɛ lɔ janjela dɛɛ ɡo yela.
Korowii ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ ba ba yoi.
Korowii kwaa bobɛl cheɡ tɛ Asiiria koojen saŋ bɛl biɡri, dɛ́ fuuh.
O ɛ nimar bɔr o do luŋri dɛ do paɡri, ba pa damara bil a daŋɛ chɔ.
Korowii hweera ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ nii ne jebɔrɔwe ken, dɛ́ ba jo daa la ta a fuh.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ Jerusalam tena nɛ Banɔ la baa la Ijipt harɛ ta dɛ́ kaa nyin kɛŋɔ ba cha ba la, bá bwɛɛlɛ!
Ba kpɔ hwɛɡa do torɔɡore aa wara, baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre dɛɛ che a bini, ne bokpeɡa tena baa so jaɡre ta nɛ, dɛ laa sie kpɔ Korowii Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la nɛ.
Baa o bɔr nyin ó cha ba.
Kɛ onee wejereme, onee dɛ́ won ba bɔr chɔɡa ne.
Waa nentane tae dɛɛ ta harɛ, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ kpɛla.
Wɛɛ iruu che wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, ne banɔ la baa dɛ cha wechɔɡa la nɛ.
Nɛraa Ijipt tena, Korowii laa ban, asɛ ba jaɡre ɡe ɛ ola, a ta kwaa aa bea yaa wola an na ɛɛ.
Dɛ Korowii baa ir o nɔn dɛ́ tɛr nɛra deŋne aa, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ cha nɛra ɛɛ keeruu, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ cha ba la ɡe choɡli, ásɛ ba nɛmbele banɛ la bwa pɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ.
Waa Korowii aa bol men Aesaya be laanee nɔ.
“Gɛ nyujente onjen yon lawɛ ol dɛ́ kpoo dɛɛ ŋoo, ásɛ ba yerɛ peteɡra warɛ ŋɔ, bá doŋu, waa wola aahra baa dɛ aahro la ɔmɛ, waa wola ba ɡbɔɡa chaŋe la, ɡɛ tentenee men Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ ba bala bá ɛ Saayɔn Bwejen ta, dɛ́ ba yo Jerusalam dɔma nomɛlbwa aa wola won kah mɛ.
Gɛ jumbii yon ɡah dɛɛ bar a bii nɛɛ a kɔne ta dɛɛ tɔa ɡbemɡbe la, ɡɛɛ men Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ ba Jerusalam tena daahna.
Mɛɛ daah baa, mɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ dɛ́ yo lɛɛ ba.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Israel tena, he berɛ ba men he siwi aa sa mɛ, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ la be.
Awola tɔpere la, he bɛlbwa ɛɛ vɛh voɡa haa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ɛa, dɛ che a ta ɛ wechɔɡa laanee.
Asiiria tena ɛɛ serewoo dɛ ba ne nɛra laa yoa, kere waa wola nɛn kon ɛɛ dɛɛ ba ba kpoora.
Baa chwa laa taa, ásɛ ba lawɛ ba bini bonɔɔna yoma.
Ba koojen ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ dɛ́ chwa, ásɛ ba nomonome baa chɔ laa nyoa la kpɔ ɔmee dɛ́ chwa ɡel ba laa fraŋkaa.” Korowiirii bola.
O nii waa kpɔa dɛ fuh saraha kwaa la lɔ Jerusalam Saayɔn Bwejen ta.
Kora o wa aa toɡra kohona Hé no!
Kooro bɛl ɛɛ bao, dɛ́ ba di kora waa aa toɡra ne, o nomonome ɛɛ kpɔ kasinteŋii dɛɛ nyiŋi waa ta.
Ba bɛlbwa ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ bɔr dɛ peu dɛ ta aa, he chwa ka jo, dɛ́ berɛ do kɛ bɔr dɛ bwaala peu dɛ ba naa, he chwa ka sɔh.
Ásɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ɡe neerare aa chɔ o ta, do kɛŋɔ bwetal waa dɔ chunchule, dɛ che bela daa a wola toole.
Banla baa dɛ na aa ba sie laa kpɔ kpa, baa cheɡ deŋne ɡee dɛɛ no.
Banla ba liire aa wola bobeŋkpoŋ cheɡɛ la ɛɛ no waa munii, ásɛ banɔ la baa dɛ mɛnɛme won waa bola kɛrɛdɛ a bini chɔ.
Gɛ saŋ nɛn waa ɛ ɡɛne la baa on jirima tee yerɛ, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ neɡre nɛra la, bá yerɔ kasinteŋ te.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛne te dɛ bol ɡɛnewa, dɛɛ lii wechɔɡa dɛ́ ɛ. Waa waa dɛ ɛ ne anɔ la waa dɛ bol bwa ɛ Korowii bwara wechɔɡe.
O dɛ vɔmɛ nɛn lɔr aa dɛ kpoo kondikwa, dɛɛ vɔmɛ nɛn nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpoo ne.
Nɛn waa dɛ neɡre nɛra ɛ nɛnchɔɡe, wechɔɡa liiree wɛɛ lii, dɛ che neɡra ta dɛɛ chɔɡ nyaara ba wa aa suma, dɛɛ tɔ ba kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ.
Nɛn waa dɔ jirima te, o dɛ maɡle waa aa dɔ jirima dɛ́ ɛ, ásɛ a che a ta wɛɛ do kɛrɛdɛ.
Jerusalam haahna wa Haahna haa lɔ bosɔɔhna ta, hé no n be!
Bitoli haa soɡa kɛrɛdɛ, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n wa!
Benanyoa ne tɔpere tamaa bɛl habɔɔ la, he banɔ la haa soɡe bosɔɔhna ta la bwara ɛɛ sao, dɛkalkɛ daa nɔna toole hé chaa kpa.
Haahna haa lɔ bosɔɔhna ta la bwara ɛɛ sao he ɔmɛ.
Hé wur he laala ta, dɛ́ kpɔ lweyale mile chara.
Hé kpɔ nɔɔra lɔ bambili á baɡle kɛ he tea bini chɔɡɔ, he harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la wa, ne daa nɔna aa chɔɡa la wa.
Sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛre ɡboo n nɛra harɛre.
He wi deremi silɛɛ fa aa lɔ a ta la, ne bwɛjen o fa aa soma la wa.
Koodem ne bwɛjen nɛra fa aa su a ta la ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ.
Deremi ne dekpeɡa aa tɔ ba nɛɛ la bwa ɛɛ choɡluu, dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini keeɡore ne peera, kpɔ bela ɛ a dibɔr.
Gɛɛ aa ba doe dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ, Korowii Doma aa ba so ya nɛɛ mɔɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la berɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe, o ta kwaa do wer, ásɛ o berɛ do kɛŋɔ kɔr ken.
Kasinteŋ ne waa aa toɡraa dɛɛ ba harɛ la ta bwa doe.
Deŋnesɔɔhnaa dɛɛ ba waa aa toɡra la ta lee, dɛ́ ɡel bɔr sɔɔh, ásɛ ɔmee aa lee do kpa bwa.
Korowii nɛra ɛɛ so deŋnesɔɔhna taa, wobɛlbwa aa wola ba nɛɛ ba ba deremi, ásɛ ba so kɛrɛdɛ ken.
Hale dombwea lee kɔr la ta, bwɛjen la chɔɡ kwaraa naa, hɛɛ na somee, hɛɛ parɛ neerare nyoo, he kondɛɛra dɔ kpɔɡdɛɛɡa dɛɛ di.
Chae wesoŋa Hé bwɛɛlɛ, nɛra haa dɛ chɔɡ nɛra, nɛra aa wola he te chɔɡ.
Hé le nɛra dɛɛ tɛ, nɛra aa wola he te leɛ dɛɛ tɛ.
Hé ɡel nɛra chɔɡaa, nɛra ɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa, he ɡel nɛra lee dɛ tɛ aa, nɛra ɛɛ le heyaa tɛ.
N Naa Korowii, na ya sum, he bee ya hwɛɡa bwa do.
Nyiŋi ya nɛɛ he kpeɡri ne tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Lɛ yaa dɛɛ le wenaale ta.
He kɔr harɛre nɛra laa ta naa, ba dɛ chwa, he iro che ɡe aa, nɛra dɛ peɡre.
Gɛ tontombɛ aa dɛ di koo kwaa bwa la, ɡɛɛ baa ba ba laala pae laa ta a tonɛ.
Korowii kan taeh, o soɡe nyundua tenten.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo kasinteŋ ne waa aa toɡra su Jerusalam.
Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ dea mumpar waa kpeɡa dɛ tɛ heyaa he saŋ, dɛ́ lɛ heya dɛ́ tɛ heya wejema ne waa mun noe kohona saŋ bɛlbwa.
O ɔma taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ dɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa.
Na, ba kpeɡnɛra dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre kohona fɔɡbaahna dɛɛ nyin lɛɛra.
Nɛra baa tom ba ŋɔ bá ba larawe la ɡe dɛ wi kohona.
Ba ŋwɛnɛjena bwa chɔ pɛɛ, nɛra aa a ta kpɔ kpa.
Ba chɔɡ fɔo la, dɛ to ntama.
Nomɛlbwa toole baa duuru.
Harɛ la chɔɡɔ, o chɔɔ pɛɛ.
Sihiih kpo Lɛbanɔn kɔne, a daa serewe.
Sarɔn fɛlembɔdɛɛɡe berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, Basan harɛ ne Kaamɛl Bwejen ta, daa papooni dɛ chure.
Korowii ŋɔ harɛre nɛra be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ iruu name.
Mɛɛ baɡle n kpeɡri aa ɡwaa komɛlbwaa.
Hé kpoŋe n nɛra tea, kɛ aa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, he ɡbaɡba hweera ɛɛ berɛ niinii dɛ́ kpoo heya.
Hɛɛ fuuh kɛŋɔ baa fuh kwaa dɛɛ ɛ tɛɡ, kɛɛ baa pa sɔɔhne do nii ta a fuh la.
He banɔ la haa lɔ bojaŋa, hé no waa maa ɛa!
He banɔ haa bɛna ɡe, hé sɛh kɛŋɔ n dɔ kpeɡri.” Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam dɛ ɔmɛ, nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la bwara dɛ sa.
Ba ŋɔ, “Ya bini umee dɛ won so nii aa dɛ hɔ aa wola dime, dɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa nɔ jwɛh ɔ?” Nɛra ba wa aa toɡraa dɛɛ bol kasinteŋ, baa wola ba kpeɡri ta cheɡɛ hamɛ nɛra dɛɛ dɔ kwa.
Nɛra ba sie aa wola lɛ kɛ ba yaɡ ba sen, dɛ laa ba te dɛɛ kpɔ nɛŋkpoa waa ta, dɛɛ lawɛ ba te kɛŋɔ baa wechɔɡaa ɛ la.
Banee dɛɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne soɡa, kɛŋɔ baa soɡe dekpeɡ bini.
Baa dɔ kondikwaa dɛɛ di, nee ɡe aa ban paŋɛ bwa.
Hɛɛ na kooro ne o wer ne kan waa doa, ne o harɛpaɡ waa chɔa dɛ kaa bojaŋ.
He liire aa webena haa dɛ ɔma kohona la taa do kpa.
Hɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Leperaa nɛn waa dɛ kure nɛra la dɔɔ?
Naate waa dɛ lɛ toɔ la ɡe sɛ?
Leperaa naate waa dɛ nyiŋi dejaŋa ta la ɡe dɔɔ?” Haa jenu tena laanee na kpa bwa, nɛra ba wobol aa kora haa wola a mun no la.
Hé nyiŋi Saayɔn, bwɛjen yaa dɛ di tɔpejena o ta la.
Hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ Jerusalam dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ne soɡa, kɛŋɔ tɛnte dea waa cheɡɛ o buɡ ta, saŋ bɛlbwa, o daa baa kpaara do harɛ dɛ kpɔ baŋro la aa fome kpa bwa, ɡɛɛ o ɡboɡbie ɡe aa wola chaa.
Korowii ɛɛ do belaa dɛ́ ɛ ya Kpeɡnɛn.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo yá so harɛdɛɛɡe nejena ne nenabɔɔne aa lɔ o ta.
Ya dɔma aa ɡbeni a taa tawɛ, ba stiimaere aa a taa kpɔ.
Korowiirii dɛ́ bol ya wa, onee do Mmarare dɛɛ tɛ yaa, dɛ́ ɛ ya kooro.
Onee dɛ́ lɛ yaa.
Gboɡbie dɔma aa kpɔa baŋre ba ɡbeni yal la yɔɡɔ.
A ta wone lawɛ dajaŋ yal la aa lɔ o ta la kɛrɛdɛ, Nɛra ɛɛ bɔne dɔma laaladamanta baa paa laa ta laanee, hale boobie kwaraa pa ane.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam wechɔɡaa kɛ ba.
Hale bɛlbwa aa berɛ ŋɔ, “N bwara dɛ wee mɛ.”
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr o dɔma deŋnee Harɛre nɛra, hé suuh tel dɛ́ no!
Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no!
Hé ɡel harɛ ne kwaa bwa aa lɔ o ta no n wa!
Korowii baah di harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.
O bwaawee iro kohona ba laa tena nɛ.
O lee ba cheɡ dɛ́ kpoo ba kwaraa.
Baa ban huɡe, baa paa baa ta, ásɛ ba sɔɔh tɔ bɔr bwa koŋkoŋkoŋ ken, ba chale ɛɛ palɛ bwejena dor bobɛlbwa.
Wee ne korobie dɛ weweela bwa ɛɛ nyoɡroo, ásɛ Korowii doa ɡuɡri kɛŋɔ baa ɡuɡri kalaŋ la.
Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa ɛɛ lee harɛɛ kɛŋɔ papohola aa le daa ta dɛɛ lee la.
Korowii kere baa tonɛ o toma nyundua aa, wɛɛ berɔɔ ba Edom tena nɛ.
O pa ba bolchɔɡe cheɡ, dɛ́ kpoo ba.
Chal ne noo ɡboo tɔ Korowii kere la bwa, kɛŋɔ baa kpo pebiiri ne boohna dɛ ler a kporombie ɛ saraha ken.
Korowii dɔ saraha ɛɛ bwɛjen Bosra.
Nɛra ɛɛ serewoo kɛrɛdɛ kere la nyoa, Edom harɛ ta.
Wɛɛ kpoo nɛra baa dɔ kpeɡri kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini nae, ne banɔ la baa do kɛŋɔ nabali bwaa, ásɛ harɛ la bwa sɔ chal ne no.
Korowii le tɔpere bɛl cheɡ, dɛ́ ba lɛ Jerusalam tena, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba dɔma bɔ kem.
Edom harɛ neerare ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ kootal ken, bela teera ɛ kɛŋɔ jebɔrɔwe, ásɛ harɛ la bwa fuh.
Wɛɛ dɛɛ fuuh webaŋa ne jwaana waa wola dime bwa, ásɛ o ninchuu ɡe teŋɛ tɛr dɛɛ kaa nyundua saŋ bɛlbwa.
Harɛ la ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, nomɛlbwa aa wola belaa kpɔ kpa bwa.
Kwiu bwa soo siwi, ne ɡaahɡaahre lɛ bela dɔɔh.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la berɛ dimɡbia waa wola maree dɔ.
Kooro aa lee do dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta, sitɔɔla ɡe aa lee do, ásɛ sɔɔhne le kooderemi, apeah ɡe le bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, ne ba dekpeɡa ta.
Wɛɛ berɛ kalampoŋare ne kwiure sobɔree.
Belaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ola ne ɡboli ɛɛ ba doe dɛɛ ɡɔle, dɛ́ do ɡbɔɡa dɛɛ yerɛ dɔŋa.
Kpɔɡ bini ola aa dɛ valɛ jwaana ɡe ɛɛ ba belaa, dɛ́ baa onɛ.
Kwiure ɛɛ sɔh a kɔne belaa dɛɛ hwe, dɛ tee a bii do a kena lɔɡre dɛɛ nyiŋa.
Kokosakire ɡe ɛɛ ba cheme belaa, bɛlbwa ne o chee.
Hé nyiŋi Korowii tɔn bini dɛ́ kure na.
Kwaa nɔ bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ nyoɡre, bɛlbwa aa belaa do waa wola o cheerii dɔ.
Korowiirii bola ŋɔ á ɛ ɡɛ, o Doma la ɛɛ ba a ne Edom harɛ taa.
Onee dɛ bɔne harɛ la tɛa, bɛlbwa dɔ o kon, dɛ́ do bela saŋ te bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ŋwɛnɛ waa do ɡoroŋ Silɛɛ ɛɛ ba pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa, hɛɡra ba harɛ komɛlbwa aa wola o ta ɛ ta, ásɛ kwaa le o ta dɛ́ fe.
Aa feo kohona, silɛɛ ne moola ba bela kɛrɛdɛ.
Aa do werii kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn bwejena, ásɛ harɛ la do wer ne para, kɛŋɔ Kaamɛl ne Sarɔn harɛre ken.
Anɔɔ dɛ́ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ we-ɛɛla aa wera, dɛ dɔ jirima kohona, o kpeɡri ɡe do kan. Hé do banɔ la ba bwara aa yɔra la ɡbemba, bá won che kiŋkiŋ.
Hé ŋɔ banɔ la ba bambile aa chɔɡa la be ŋɔ, “Hé che kiŋkiŋ, he bɛ ɔmɛ.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɛ ba, dɛ́ ba cha heya.
Wɛɛ ba lɛ heyaa le he dɔma nɔn taa, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne kohona bɔ kem.” O balaa, nyoŋa sie ɛɛ piluu bá na bɔr, ásɛ amumure ɡe no wa.
Ásɛ boobie ir che, dɛɛ jah kɛŋɔ kweɡli ken, amumure ɡe ɡo yela silɛɛ ne.
Nee ɛɛ pili pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa, ásɛ nenabɔɔne chɔ harɛ waa hola ta dɛɛ palɛ.
Bela wee aa lɔa o hol la ɛɛ berɛ tamee, ásɛ bela nee fa aa wola toole pili ne.
Bela kalampoŋare fa aa lole la ɛɛ berɛ kataŋaa, o berɛ moɡɛ kpɔɡa ne pul.
Ŋwɛnɛjen ɛɛ chɔ belaa baa yerɔ “Ŋwɛnɛɡoroŋ Waa Dɛ Kaa Korowii be.” Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa o taa kpɔ, ó chɔ tɛ nɛra baa teŋɛ Korowii waa la ta, hale ɡɛna kwara aa o taa kpɔ.
Nyujentena aa belaa do, kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡe bɛlbwa aa ŋwɛnɛ la taa kpɔ.
Nɛra Korowii aa lɛɛ ba la ɡbosoo dɛɛ ba o ta kpɔe.
Baa valɔɔ ɡo silɛɛ yela ka jo Jerusalam, hɛɡra aa wola nyoa dɔe ne.
Ba sie ɛɛ lɛo ba bwara sɔɔh ba, suna dii ne tebinichɔɡ le ba bini kwaraa.
Asiiria Koojen Senakerib aah Jerusalam tena Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora bene fi dɛ anaarɛ ta la, Asiiria koojen Senakerib baa yo Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, dɛ lɛa dɔɔh.
Asɛ Asiiria koojen tomɛ o laa nomoa ne laa tena baa wara, ba le Lakes dɛ ba Kooro Hɛsɛkea be Jerusalam.
Laa nomoa la aa laŋa la, o kaa che bɔɔ baa kwiu feelɔɔ ken le nyundua tam la ta, nee palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ o bini la harɛbɔr.
O lɔ ŋwɛnɛjen waa kaa bela baa dɛ ɛ yale toma.
Baala batoro le Kooro Hɛsɛkea be Jerusalam, dɛ la Asiiria koojen torome la be.
Banee, Hilkia bibaa Eliakim waa chɔ koodem nyoa, ne Sɛbna waa ɛ kooro karake, dɛ Asaf bibaa Joa waa dɛ nyiŋi kooro tɔne ta.
Laa sitɔɔ la ŋɔ ba be, bá la ka ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea be kɛŋɔ Asiiria koojen la dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa taa he kpɔ he te dawɛ dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ ɔɔ?
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ nyoa wobol do kɛ wejema, ne kpeɡri ba kpɔ dɛɛ yo laa kɛɛ?
Ume nɛɛ he kpɔ he te dawɛ, dɛ ɛɛ mɛ dɔm nɔɔ?
Na, dɛ Ijipt kooro nɛɛ he kpɔ he te dawɛ aa, a do kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ pul ɛ daŋɡbala, asɛ o ku dɛ tɔɡɛ he nɔn.
Gɛɛ Ijipt kooro do tɛ nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛɛ bwa.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea ta ɡelɛ he chɔɡ kwaa haa dɛ toma bwea dor dɛ ŋɔ Juda harɛ ta ne Jerusalam tena bwa be ŋɔ báa tomɛ kombeŋkpoŋ ta Jerusalam aa?
N ne hɛɛ ŋwɛɛroo n naa Asiiria koojen sɔn ta.
Mɛɛ tɛɛ jaɡre kaɡboŋa anɛɛ, dɛ hɛɛ won dɔ laa tena bá so a bwa ta naa.
Haa won kpɔ he te maɡɛ Asiiria koojen nomonome la bini bechala kwara, kɛ he dɛ hwɛɡɛ Ijipt kooro nɛɛ kɛ o ba tɛɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore, ne laa tena baa dɛ so jaɡre ta.
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii habɔɔ n le dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yo he harɛ nɛra nɔ kɛɛ?
Korowii ɡbabirii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń ba dɛ́ ba chɔɡ harɛ nɔ.” Asɛ Eliakim ne Sɛbna dɛ Joa ŋɔ Asiiria koojen laa sitɔɔ la be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya dɛ soŋe, bol Aram tena wobol baɡle he bonɔɔna.
He bolaa, ya dɛ no.
Bɛ Hibru tena wobol kpɔ bol ya be.
Nɛra baa cheɡɛ bwɛjen nɔ danjwɛɛ nɔ ta dɛ no he be.” Anee laa sitɔɔ la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ne he kooro ɡbo bee n nomoa tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol waa nɔ kɛɛ?
He ɡbo laa, nɛra baa sosoɡe bwɛjen nɔ danjwɛɛ nɔ ta ɡe jao, baa di ba ɡbaɡba benaa, dɛ́ nyɔ ba feene kɛ heya.” Ate, laa sitɔɔ la ir che dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ bol waa Hibru tena wobol ne ŋɔ, “Hé no Asiiria koojen waa maa ba a ne!
Dɛ́ he bɛ ɡel Kooro Hɛsɛkea neɡre heya.
Waa won lɛ heya!
He bɛ o nɛɛ teŋɛ, dɛ́ ɡel hé kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ ŋɔ, wɛɛ lɛ heyaa, waa bwɛjen nɔɔ kpɔ do Asiiria koojen nɔn ta.
He bɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea waa no.
Asiiria koojen dɛ bol ŋɔ, hé le bwɛjen la bini ba o be, dɛ́ kpɔ he te ba do o lɔɡa.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he bini bɛlbwa dɔ o fiɡ ne o ɡrepo daa kooni nɔna di, dɛ́ nyɔ o kɔlɔŋ bini ne, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ maa kpɔ heyaa kaa bojaŋ harɛ waa do kɛŋɔ he kon nɔ ta.
Harɛ daa kooni aa lole he dɔ sen le a ta, ne mea baa kpɔ ɛ paanoo, ne ɡrepo daa kooni.
He bɛ ɡel Kooro Hɛsɛkea neɡre heyaa ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ lɛ heyaa.
Harɛ bɛl voɡ wono lɛ harɛ la nɛra le Asiiria koojen nɔn ta ka aa?
Leperaa bwɛjena Hamat ne Aapad voɡa dɔɔ?
Sefavaim tena voɡare sɛ?
A wono lɛ Samaria tena aa?
Harɛre nɔ voɡ besoo wona lɛ o harɛ le n be nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba wona lɛ Jerusalam ɔ?” Asɛ nɛra la hel jeiih ken, ba ta nentane tae ta harɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea tɔ sie ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ ba bɛ on chaŋe.
Ate, Eliakim ne Sɛbna dɛ Joa kɛɛ ba laala, a baɡle kɛ ba loo kuu, dɛ la Kooro Hɛsɛkea be, dɛ ka bol waa Asiiria koojen laa sitɔɔ la aa bola la o be.
Aesaya jae waa ja Kooro Hɛsɛkea Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa no waa la, o ɡe laa o yal waa tɔɔ la kɛɛ, dɛ ka kpɔ lweyal tɔ dɛ ka jo Korowii Dea.
O tomɛ Eliakim waa dɛ nyiŋi koodem waa ta, ne Sɛbna waa ɛ karake, dɛ bela sɔfore nomonome ba ɡe aa tɔ lweyale ŋɔ, bá la Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya be.
Waa waa kpɔa tɛ ŋɔ ba ka ŋɔ Aesaya be laanee kɛŋɔ, “Wahala ne deŋnetɛra ne sihiih tɔperee fini.
Ya do kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ o ɡwɛɡre waa wola won lolɛ la ken.
Asiiria koojen tomɛ o laa sitɔɔla nomoa, ó ba chɛɡre Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la.
N dɛ soŋe Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ kɛ, ó tɛr a ɡɛ nɛra la deŋne a wa.
Anomanta, soŋe Korowii tɛ ya nɛra ya taa kaa nɔ.” Kooro Hɛsɛkea toroma la aa ba Aesaya be la, anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ka ɡel he dɔɔ no kɛŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Bɛ Asiiria koojen waa la ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ maa won lɛ heya.
No, mɛɛ ɡeloo koojen la no waane aa ɛ ɔmewa, ásɛ a ɡel o berɛ kaa o harɛ ta, ásɛ Korowii ɡel bá ka kpoo kere ne.’ ” Asiiria laa nomoa la noɔ kɛŋɔ, Asiiria koojen ne o laa tena le Lakes, dɛ kaa yo bwɛjen Lebna tena baa bɛn ba, asɛ o ir la koojen la be bela.
Belaa Asiiria koojen no kɛŋɔ, Ijipt Kooro Tirhaka waa le Itiopia ne o laa tena dɛ ba ba yoo.
Anomanta, o chwerɛ tɔn, dɛ kpɔ tomɛ toroma Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ, “Bɛ he Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛɛ la neɡre kɛŋɔ, Asiiria koojen la aa won yo lɛ Jerusalam.
A lole kɛŋɔ he no ɡɛ Asiiria koojen bɛlbwa aa ɛ harɛre nɔ bwa, dɛ chɔɡa kwaraa.
He te ɛɛ won le a nyoa aa?
N naawa yo harɛre nɛra bane baa le Gosan ne Haran ne Rɛsɛf, dɛ chɔɡ ba harɛre, dɛ kpoo Bɛt Eden tena baa soɡe Tɛl Asa, ba voɡare wono lɛɛ ba aa?
Leperaa bwɛjena Hamat ne Aapad ne Sefavaim dɛ Hena kɛɛ Iva koranar dɔɔ?” Kooro Hɛsɛkea wesoŋa Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea lɛ tɔn la dɛ kure, dɛ kpɔ la Korowii Dea, dɛ ka laa paɡri bil Korowii sie.
Asɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, he so kena kwaa Kerobim doa.
Korowii bɛlbwa toole ka ja he nɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛre bwa ta.
Henee ta nyundua ne harɛ.
Ir nyu ne, dɛ́ no n wesoŋa nɔ, no waa Koojen Senakerib aa ba a ne, dɛ baa chɛɡre hen Korowii haa lole saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ.
A ɛ kpela, Korowii, kɛŋɔ Asiiria koojena yo harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra, dɛ chɔɡ ba harɛre a chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Ba pa ba voɡare do nii ta a fuh, dɛkalkɛ a ɛ daa ne bwea nɛn aa sɛah.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, lɛ yaa le Asiiria koojen Senakerib nɔn ta, ásɛ harɛre bwa nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ he ɡboo Korowii.” Kooro Senakerib chola waa chola wa Ate, Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya kpɔ kala tɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, o no Asiiria koojen Senakerib wesoŋa haa soŋo la, Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Jerusalam waa do kɛ bechatolo, waa wola baa jemɛ la hah hen Koojen Senakerib, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyubaah.
Koojen Senakerib, umee hɛɛ lii he nyu bini kɛ onee hɛɛ chɛɡre dɛɛ ɛo nɛnhɛla nɔɔ?
Men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ laanee hɛɛ ɛ sisawaa la.
He tomɛ he toroma ba ɛ mbarafo baɡ mɛ ŋɔ, he wono kpɔ torɔɡore teeh kaa bwejena aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn dor.
He ŋɔ belaa he teŋni peleme daa aa jaŋa kohona, ne dadɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi, dɛ jo kaa kɔr la baah tenten.
He ɛ mbarafo ŋɔ, he kwi buli harɛfala ta, dɛ nyɔ a bini nee bela.
Dɛ ŋɔ he laa tena nakpale ɡbo ɡelɔ Ijipt Nael Moo hweeh.
He ta noɛ kɛ saŋ la bwaa n le vɔrɔwa bil kɛɛ?
N tɛɛ kpeɡri he ɡel bwɛɛre danjwɛkpeɡa aa bara kuuɡi, dɛ berɛ dimɡbeeni.
N ɡelɔ a nɛra bwa ɡwɛɡre, ba bwara yɔr ba di sihiih.
Ba ɛo kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa lɔ koo ta, kɛɛ kpɔɡa aa lɔ lɔɡ doa, asɛ wee leebɔr peu chɔɡe yon ta a sewɛ la ken.
N jemɛ he wobɛlbwa bini, he laŋa ne he bala bwa, ne he deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla haa dɛ ɛɛ mɛ.
N no he deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla, ne he mbarafo haa dɛ ɛ, a chole n deŋna ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔ ɡoŋaa do he mee ta, dɛ́ kpɔ kabaɡrare do he nyoa, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔe kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta ba la ta kaa.’ ” Ate, Aesaya ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ, “Waa aa che a ta, n naa Kooro Hɛsɛkea, he jemɛ laanee nɔ.
Koo kwaa baa koma bena nɔ la, ane ɛɛ le a buɡ taa, ásɛ he dia, ásɛ benanyoa chemaa, hé di a tenten.
A bentooro te la, hé du mea dɛ́ koma, dɛ́ parɛ daa kooni, dɛ́ di a nɔna.
Nɛra baa ka, dɛ́ le Juda dea la ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ, daa waa ta lune kaa bini, dɛ won nɔna la ken.
Bane ɛɛ kao dɛ́ do Jerusalam Saayɔn Bwejen ta.
Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ do siee, dɛ́ ɛ anɔ bwa.” Asiiria koojen waa Korowii aa bola laanee nɔ.
“Waa bwɛjen nɔ taa dɔ jo, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ta hɛm bonɔɔ.
Waa konee kpɔ tɔ o te ɡbemɡbe dɛ́ ba o doonyoa, kɛɛ dɛ́ ma kon waa che o ta teeh jo o bini dɛ́ yo.
Ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta ba la, wɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ o ta kaa waa wola won jo bwɛjen nɔ ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ tɔ bwɛɛ nɔ ɡbemɡbee dɛ́ lɛo, n jirima ne nyoa maa baɡɛ n bonɔɔ Devid nomanta!” Ate, awola jwaana, Korowii nyundua torome la bela Asiiria laa tena aa lole la, dɛ ka kpoo ba bini kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanuatoro dɛ banue.
Nɛra iro chɔɔ, dɛ ba na ɡɛ nɛra la aa serewa chɔ bobɛlbwa.
Aa ba ɡɛ la, Asiiria koojen Senakerib ɡel laa la yoi, dɛ ir ka so Asiiria bwɛjen Niniwe.
Dɛ belaa ɛ koojen soŋnibɔr.
Awola bɛl, o ka dɛ tu voɡa o voɡ Nesrɔk dea, asɛ o bibaala banɛ, Adramɛlɛk ne Saresa ka kpoo kere ne, dɛ chwa kaa Ararat harɛ ta.
Asɛ o bibaa Esaahadon chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea weela wa Aa ba dɛ la sie la, weela lɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea wɛɛ ba sewa.
