Asɛ Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya la o be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ɛ he dem ne he wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haa he weela nɔ taa ir, hɛɛ chɔ he banɔn taa!” Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea berɛ o sie chaɡɛ danjwɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n poori, lii ɡɛ maa ta tea bwa tɛɛ, dɛ tomɛ kasinteŋ ne, dɛ ɛ waa haa dɛ nyin.” Dɛ wi lokua ne kohona.
Anee Korowii berɛ ŋɔ Aesaya be ŋɔ, ó berɛ, dɛ́ ka ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea be kɛŋɔ, “Men Korowii he nabaa Devid fa aa tomɔ la, n no he wesoŋa, dɛ na siniire aa dɛ yɔɔre.
Mɛɛ kpɔ bene fi dɛ anuee ja he mkpa ta.
Mɛɛ lɛ he ne bwɛjen Jerusalam tenaa, ásɛ Asiiria koojen bɛ won pɔ he nɛ.
Mɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ bwɛɛ nɔ ta.” Aesaya ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ ɛ waanee á baɡle kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɛ waa waa baɡɛ nyoa laanee.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo wee chunchule kaa mun ta, ásɛ chunchule ka dawɛ kon Kooro Ahas aa mao dɛ che o ta teeh dɛɛ jo dea la naɡale fi kon la ta.” Waa bol ɡɛ la, wee berɔ kaa mun ta, chunchule la ka dawɛ naɡale fi kon la ta.
Juda harɛ ta Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɡbaŋra habɔɔ la, o chwerɛ jam yel.
“N liiro kɛŋɔ n ta n saŋ tele, dɛɛ ba sewa.
N cheɡɛ lalabwɛɛ doonyoa, dɛ n fe aa lii kɛŋɔ mɛɛ dɔ mkpaa.” N ŋɔ, “Maa Korowii na harɛ nɔ ta kpa, kɛɛ dɛ́ na nɛra ba soɡe harɛ nɔ ta.
Ba lɛ me mkpa le harɛ nɔ ta, kɛŋɔ baa boŋi tɛnte dea baa baŋro.
Gɛ yasɔɔh yon sɔh yal tonɛ dɛ́ laa teŋe la, ɡɛɛ n ɡe ɛɛ ba teŋa sewɛ.
N liiro ŋɔ Korowii fe lɛ me mkpa tonɛ.
Jwaana bwaa n kpɔ weweele bini dɛ wi, a do kɛ nyujente aa dɛ paɡre n hoɡa ken.
N liiro ŋɔ Korowii fe lɛ me mkpa tonɛ.
N wio n taa do jeɡaa kɛŋɔ kweah aa dɛ si ken.
N ha sie nyiŋi nyundua dɛ ba koh.
N Naa Korowii, ba lɛɛ mɛ le n wenaale bwa maa dɛ na nɔ ta.
Ń bol ameo?
Korowiirii bol a waa n be, dɛ ɡbaɡba berɛ ɛa.
Suna aa lɔ n bambile bini nomanta, maa won dom chɔ.
N Naa Korowii, anɔ bwa taa nɛwɛnyina mkpa do, a taa n ɡe mkpa do.
Gel n ɡbaŋre, ásɛ dɛ dɔ n nyu.
N weweele ɛɛ ber mɛ deŋnesɔɔhnaa.
He cheɡɛ he nyina ta, dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le wekpeɡa a fe aa dɛ ba n nɛɛ bala ta, dɛ kpɔ n wechɔɡa bwa kɛ mɛ.
Nɛra baa lɔ lalabwɛɛ aa won kpɛɛre, serewe aa won ɡo yel kpɛɛre.
Nɛra baa lɔ lalabwɛɛ aa won hwɛɡɛ he waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la ta.
Weeraa dɛɛ kpɛɛre ɡɛ maa dɛ kpɛɛre fini nɔ.
Eehnanar dɛ bol he kasinteŋ waa ba bii be.
Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ, ásɛ ya lɔ janjela dɛɛ ɡo yela o Dea, ya soɡa bini bwa.” Aesaya bol Kooro Hɛsɛkea be wubwa ŋɔ, bá ka toɡri fiɡ nɔna dɛ́ nama dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ marɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɔr la ta, ásɛ o ɡbaŋre.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa dɛ́ baɡle kɛ mɛɛ la Korowii Dea nyundua belaa yɔ?”
Toroma baa le Babelɔn harɛ ta wa A ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Babelɔn harɛ ta kooro bɛl sɔne Mɛrɔdak Baladan, o mɛɛ sɔne Kooro Baladan.
Kooro Mɛrɔdak Baladan aa no Kooro Hɛsɛkea weela waa la, o chwerɛ tɔne dɛ kpɔ koŋkɛɛla ja tomɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ka tɛo.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea lɛ toroma la silɛɛ ne, asɛ dɛ kpɔ o kara mun kwaa aa lɔ dem, suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, ne konsɔɔhsoma ne nodɛɛɡa, dɛ o dɔmkwaa ne bela waa dɛ cheɡa bwa baɡ ba.
Komɛlbwa toole dɛ do o dem kɛɛ harɛ la ta waa wola ban baɡlɛ.
Ate, Korowii keame Aesaya la ka bɔɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Leperaa ɡɛ nɛra nɔ leɔ?
Dɛ́ ba amaneɛ ɔ?” Anee Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Ba le bojaŋ harɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Babelɔn ta.” Aesaya pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa ba na he koodem ɔ?” Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, “Ba na komɛlbwa aa lɔ n koodem.
Komɛlbwa toole n kara mun maa wola kpɔe baɡ ba.” Aesaya ŋɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ, “Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ komɛlbwa waa lɔ he koodem bonɔ ne anɔ la bwa he naanar aa nyina cheɡ ba le fini la bwa Babelɔn tena ba kpɔa kaa ba harɛ ta, komɛlbwa aa ka.
Korowiirii ŋɔa.
Baa larawe he ɡbaɡba naanar la banee kaa, dɛ́ ka fɔɡɛ ba lure, bá do Babelɔn koodem dɛɛ tomɛ.” Kooro Hɛsɛkea chaŋe ŋɔ, “Waa haa ɡela n no le Korowii be nɔ wer.” Dɛkalkɛŋɔ, o liiro kɛ wɛɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhnaa o kora che kɛrɛdɛ o saŋ.
Korowii nɛra bolarawa wa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Hé larawe n nɛra bwara.
Hé bol bansɔɔh waa baɡle Jerusalam tena dɛ́ ŋɔ, ba weweele baa naa kohona teŋo, ba bɔ ba wechɔɡa kem tonɛ.
Ba dɔ ba wechɔɡa bwa deŋnetɛra kohona, dɛ le men Korowii be.” Nomɛl dɛ bol waa takpeɡ ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ŋɔ, “Nɛ́ra ɡel ba we-ɛɛla toɡre, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ kpa ba Dɔɔ bala.
Fɛlembɔɔ te bɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé tɔɔ, dɛ́ bur deŋɡare ne bwe te bɛlbwa.
Bobɛlbwa waa wola were la chɛ kɛ hé ɡel ó chɔ harɛ, dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta ó chɔ kpalantaŋ.
Ásɛ Korowii ba baɡle o jirima nɛwɛnyina bwa na.
Korowiirii bola.” N no taa bɛl o ŋɔ, “Bol waa takpeɡ ne!” Asɛ n ŋɔ, “Ń ŋɔ ɛrɔɔ?” “Ŋɔ nɛwɛnyina bwa do kɛ kpɔɡa fee, ba jirima ɡe do kɛ kpɔɡa fee aa wola biɡri la ken.
Dɛkalkɛ Korowii ta peu dɛɛ ta a ta, kpɔɡa dɛ sewɛ, a fee ɡe ɛɛ lee.
Nɛwɛnyini do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa, kpela.
Kpɔɡa dɛ sewɛ, a fee ɡe ɛɛ chure, kɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la te waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Jerusalam tena, he teeh kaa bwejena dor, dɛ́ ka bol amanesoma la!
Hé bola takpeɡ ne, he bɛ ɔmɛ, hé ŋɔ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre nɛra be ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɛ ba.” Nemenɛ Korowii dɛ ba kpeɡri ne, dɛ́ ba di kora.
Hé na, o dɛ ba o kembɔr ne dɛ́ ba tɛ nɛra.
Wɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre yon dɛɛ nyiŋi o peera nɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ a bii pɛl o bambile, ásɛ dɛ teɡɛ a nyare aa loɡla la kaa bɔeeh ken.
Umee dɛ́ won kpɔ o nɔŋkola maɡɛ moo, kɛɛ dɛ won kpɔ nɔn maɡɛ ɡɛ nyundua aa do kan nɔɔ?
Umee wona kari harɛ nɔ ta teera, kɛɛ bwejena ne deŋɡarere tɔɡre kɛrɛdɛ nɔ?
Nɛn besoo jemɛ Korowii liire ɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won baɡlo waa dɛ́ jao wɔ?
Ume bee Korowii la, naate baɡlo waa ó jemɔɔ?
Umee baɡlo kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ ɔ?
Ume tenee baɡlo wejema, kɛɛ waa mun noe yɔ?
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra do tamaa kɛŋɔ bokiti bini nee aa kora le kerabeŋkpoŋ ken Korowii be.
Ba do kɛŋɔ tutuɡ aa dawɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ kari kwaa tɔɡre ta ken.
O dɛ kari ekwie harɛre a do fɛɡre o siwi ta kɛŋɔ tutuɡ ken.
Daa aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn kɔr bini aa kanɛ dɛ won fuh jam kwaa Korowii saraha kon ta, n baa bol ola aa lɔ o ta ba kpoora dɛ fuh dɛɛ tɛo wa.
Harɛre nɛra ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ Korowii be.
Ba do kɛ kwaane aa wola siwi su o be ken.
Umee yaa ba wona kpɔ Korowii maɡɔɔ?
Bɔkwaa yaa ba kpɔe baɡle o waɔ?
Voɡ te, loɡree dɛɛ loɡɔ, asɛ nɛn waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema ɡe yon kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ o bwara, dɛ ɛ suuɡapoŋa jɔɡrɔre doo.
Nyaa waa wola won dɔ ɡɛ kwaa nɔ la, o dɛ nyin daa waa wola pɔh, dɛ́ nyin nɛn waa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema, ó sɛh dɛ ɛ voɡ ó won che kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ bɛ chole.
Haa jemaa?
He ta noɛ yaa?
Haa a mun jemaa?
Ba ta he be bolɛ saŋ Korowii aa ta harɛ mumpar la kɛɛ?
Onee di harɛ bwa kora dɛ so kookara ta nyundua, asɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta do jeɡre kɛŋɔ vaɡla ken.
Onee paɡri nyundua bɔle kɛŋɔ yal ken, dɛ baŋro kɛŋɔ baa baŋre tɛnte dea dɛ so o bini la.
Onee won koranar ɛɛ kɛŋɔ dansaara ken, ba waa ɛ wepuu.
Ba do kɛŋɔ kwaa baa dua, kɛɛ kwaa baa mera, a pa mun dɛɛ dɔ lune, asɛ Korowii ɡel peu ta a ta a hol, asɛ kawulewule kpɔa kaa kɛŋɔ haahra ken.
Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ la ŋɔ, “Umee hɛɛ ba men kpɔe maɡɔɔ?
Umee n ne o ɛ kɛrɛdɛ ɔ?” Hé ha sie dɛ nyiŋi nyundua ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta.
Korowiirii ta weweela dɛ ɡel a le beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa dɛ warɛ, asɛ o pa bɛlbwa sɔn.
O kpeɡri waa dɔa kohona nomanta, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta nyoɡrɛ.
Israel tena, bɔkwa waa hɛɛ naɡre waa saŋ bɛlbwa ŋɔ, Korowii aa he wehiah jemɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, o laa sie kpɔ he wahala ta nɔɔ?
Haa jemaa?
He ta noɛ yaa?
Korowii lole saŋ bɛlbwa.
Onee ta harɛ nɔ bwa.
Waa koh bwa, waa ɡwɛɡre ɡe.
Nomɛlbwa aa won jemɛ o wejema waa dɔa mun bwa.
O won banɔ la baa ɡwɛɡra bokpeɡa tɛɛ, dɛ won banɔ la baa wola kpeɡri dɔe ɡe kpeɡri jae.
Bonɔɔna ne toli kwaraa won koeh dɛ ɡwɛɡre, dɛ́ lɔ naa chole.
Kɛ nɛra baa dɔ hwɛɡa Korowii nɛɛ la te ɛɛ dɔ bokpeɡfalaa.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo bá dɔ kena, dɛ́ ir kɛŋɔ kee ken.
Baa chwao, kɛ baa koh bwa, dɛ́ valɛ baa ɡwɛɡre bwa ɡe.
Korowii waa dɛ cha Israel tena Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra, hé hel dɛ́ no n be!
Harɛre nɛra, hé nyin bokpeɡfala, dɛ́ ba bol he wa!
Ya bwa cheme kɔɔto ásɛ bɛlbwa bol o wa.
Umee le nɛn le wee leebɔr ɔ?
Umee tɛo kpeɡri o won yo lɛ harɛre dɛ pɔ a koranar nɛɔ?
O kpɔ o tokobi dɛ kpoo ba, dɛ kpɔ o to ne hɛma ba peɡre, kɛŋɔ peu aa taa dɛ kpɔ tutuɡ ne haahra kaa la.
O dɛ ti ba, dɛ́ doŋ ba dɛɛ kaa, wobɛlbwa aa wola on ha.
O ɡbaŋre, a do kɛŋɔ o nakpale aa harɛ leɡe ken.
Umee ɛ waa nɔ dɛ ɡel a maɡre, kɛŋɔ waa yerɛ nɛra ne ba naanar ne ba ɡe naanar le mumpar bá ɛ o toma ɔ?
Men Korowii maa lole le mumpar la, menee ɛa, menee dɛɛ ba nɛra baa ka mun ɡe nɛɛ jae.
Nɛra baa lɔ ekwie harɛre ta naa dɛ ɔmɛ, hale banɔ la baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwara ɛɛ sa ba suuh tel dɛ ba, bɛlbwa ɛɛ cha o dɔŋ, ásɛ dɛ yon ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Che kiŋkiŋ!’ Nɛn waa dɛ sɛh kwa dɛ́ do nɛn waa jemɛ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ o bwara ɡbemba.
Nɛn waa lɔ suuɡaswɛm dɛɛ pɛ dɛ ɛo voɡ la, dɛ́ do onɔ la waa dɛ loɡa o bwara ɡe ɡbemba.
O ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o ɛ wa, dɛ kpaa dadowɛre do voɡ la ta, o bɛ chole.
Kɛ he te, Israel tena haa ɛ n bonɔɔna, Jekɔb naanar maa le heya, n dam Abraham dwee, harɛ jaɡa lee n kpɔ heyaa le, o jaɡaa n yerɛ heyaa le, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N bonɔɔnaa heya.’ N le heyaa tɛ n te, n ta heyaa tae.
Anomanta, he bɛ ɔmɛ, n ja he nɛ.
He bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ, menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛ heyaa bokpeɡaa, dɛ́ cha heya.
Mɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛ, dɛ́ lɛ heya.
Nɛra ba baah aa di he nɛɛ kohona la bwa, sihiih ɛɛ kpo baa ba baŋa ɡole.
Nɛra baa ŋɔ bá yo heyaa la, ɛɛ serewoo dɛ́ tonɛ.
Hɛɛ ɡaaɡe he dɔma bɔree, kɛ haa ban na.
Nɛra baa kpɔ yoi pu heyaa ɛɛ serewoo.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, mɛɛ tɛ heyaa bokpeɡa.
N dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ ɔmɛ, mɛɛ cha heyaa.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, haa kanɛ, haa kpeɡe.
He bɛ ɔmɛ, mɛɛ cha heyaa.
Men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ maa ɛ he Lɛɛ laanee ŋɔa.
Hé na, mɛɛ ɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ erɛ boyu onfale o do nyɛɡre, ásɛ he kuuɡi bwejaŋa dɛ́ paɡra, dɛ́ bur deŋɡarere kɛŋɔ tutuɡ ken.
Hɛɛ palaa ásɛ peu kpɔa kaa, peujen lɔa merɛ.
Kɛ he te sie ɛɛ lɛ Korowii nɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpɛɛ men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la.
Nyaara ne banɔ la ba waa aa suma ɛɛ ba nyin nee dɛ́ nyɔ kahonɛ ba lobi hol, men Korowii ɛɛ no ba wesoŋaa tɛɛ ba.
Menee Israel tena ɛɛ tomɛ, maa ban ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nee palɛ le bwejena aa hola dor, dɛ́ ɡel fɛlembɔɔne bule ne.
Mɛɛ beɡre pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛɛ ó ɛ kataŋa, dɛ́ ɡel harɛ waa do kpakee bule ne.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo peleme ne akaasia ne mɛtel ne ɔleve daa le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo kɔr bini daa le harɛ waa wola were tɛ komɛlbwa ta, ásɛ nomɛlbwa na dɛ́ lii dɛ́ no a mun kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii ɛa, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ laanee taa.” Korowii, Israel tena kooro la ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ he waa ba, dɛ́ ba baɡle ɡɛ aa ɛa he kon do som.
Hé ba he voɡa ne á baɡle waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa kerekere, ásɛ dɛ a baa chiɡ aa ya jemɛ, dɛ́ baɡle waa aa chiɡa saŋ la, ásɛ ya nyiŋi a bini dɛ́ no a mun.
Hé ɡel a baɡle yaa waa aa lɔ le kerekere, ásɛ ya jemɛ kɛ a ɛ voɡa kpela.
Hé ɡel á ɛ waa aa ɛ wedɛɛɡa kɛɛ wechɔɡa ásɛ ya bwara yɔr ya ɔmɛ.
Voɡa la ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ, asɛ a we-ɛɛla ɡe ɛ wepuu.
N kii nɛra baa dɛ toma la ne ba voɡa.
N le nomɛl o le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Wee leebɔree o so dɛɛ tom mɛ.
Wɛɛ tiɡri koranar nɛɛ kɛŋɔ demamaa yon dɛɛ ɡbɛr teera, kɛɛ vimamaa yon dɛɛ charame choh la.
He bini ume voɡee bola bil wubwa kɛŋɔ waa nɔ ɛɛ chiɡuu ásɛ ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ o dɛ bol kasinteŋ ɔ?
Voɡ bɛlbwa toole dɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Nomɛlbwa ta an noɛ le he be bwa.
Men Korowiirii tɔ sie bol amanesoma la Jerusalam tena be.
Men tomɛ torome ŋɔ ó ka bol ba be.
N nyiŋi voɡa la bini, dɛ a bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won baɡle waa la, a bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won chaŋe waa la.
Na, a bwa ɛ neɡra!
A we-ɛɛla bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
A do kɛŋɔ peu ken, komɛlbwa toole a be.”
Korowii bonɔɔ bɛl wa Korowii ŋɔ, “N bonɔɔ maa leo dɛ tɛo kpeɡrii nɔ, n sie lɛ o nɛɛ taeh.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n Doma ba so o nɛ, ásɛ o baɡle nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta bwa ɡe ɡɛ n kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛre aa doa.
Waa waa bol dɛɛ nyɛɡ, waa takpeɡ ɡee kpɔ bol waa fɔɡbaahna.
Nɛn do kɛŋɔ daa waa ɡwɛɛna dɛɛ ba kui yaa, waa ɡel o ku.
Dɛ o do kɛŋɔ kandea waa dɛ lawɛ kɛlll la ɡe aa, waa ɡel ó dime.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra bwa jemɛ kasinteŋ la.
Waa koh, waa ɡwɛɡre ɡe, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa aa ba jemɛ kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛre la.
Nɛra baa lɔ bojaŋ harɛre ta ɛɛ dɔ hwɛɡa o webaɡla taa.” Korowii waa ta nyundua dɛ paɡru, dɛ ta harɛ ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta, dɛ tɛ nɛra baa lɔ o ta hweera ba dɔ mkpa la, onee bola ŋɔ, “Men Korowiirii yerɛ, dɛ tɛɛ kpeɡri ŋɔ hɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra harɛ nɔ ta.
He nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa ásɛ n ne nɛwɛnyina bwa fɔwɛ fɔo, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ kandea dɛ́ tɛ harɛre nɛra.
Hɛɛ ɡeloo nyoŋa sibie pili, ba won dɛɛ na, ne banɔ la baa do ba dea, ba do biro tenten ta.
Menee Korowii, n sɔnee ɡɛ.
Maa ɡel nɛra kpɔ jirima aa chɛ kɛ ba tɛ mɛ la tɛ nomɛl, maa ɡel bá kpɔ kpɛɛra aa chɛ mɛ la tɛ voɡa.
Na, webena maa bol a waa la chiɡo, asɛ mɛɛ bol anfala wa.
N ɡelɔ hɛɛ no a waa mɔɔ a chiɡ.” Korowii kpɛɛra yel Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa, hé ɡo yelfale kpɛɛ Korowii.
Nɛra haa dɛ ɛ toma mpo ta, ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa, ne harɛ jaɡa nɛra bwa, hé ɡo kpɛɛra yel tɛo!
Nɛra haa soɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ bwɛɛre ta, hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii!
Keda naanar, bela bwa haa soɡa la, hé ɡe ɡo kpɛɛra yela!
Sela tena, hé le bwejena dor dɛ́ kpɔ silɛɛ ɡo yela tɛo!
Bojaŋ harɛre nɛra, hé kpɔ jirima tɛo, dɛ́ kpɛɛro.
Korowii ɛɛ leo kɛŋɔ banyoo o siwi aa swɛɛra, o kpɔ takpeɡ kɔɡre dɛɛ yerɛ laa tena, dɛɛ yo o dɔma kpeɡri nɛ.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Maa mwaala ne biɡro, n dɛ nyin waane dɛ́ ɛ, kɛ n helɔ jeiih ken.
Taraken te, mɛɛ do lɔŋɔree kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ ken.
N eehnɔ, n hweera bwa pi.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ bwejena ne deŋɡarere bwaa, dɛ́ ɡel a papooni ne kpɔɡa hol, dɛ́ ɡel moo ne taama bwa hweeh dɛ́ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ.
Mɛɛ tɔ nyoŋa siee, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kpɔ ŋwɛnɛre baa wola a ta jemɛ ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo biro baa lɔ o ta la berɛ bochaah dɛ́ tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛre aa wola were a chɔ harɛ.
Waa nɔɔ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ tɛɛ ba, maa ban ta.
Kɛ nɛra baa dɛ yarada voɡa, dɛɛ yerɛ kwaa baa sɛah, kɛɛ voɡa ba ‘naa’ la te, mɛɛ vɛɛh baa bá di sihiih kohona.” Israel tena do kɛŋɔ nyoŋa ba deŋna taŋ Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé nɛra haa taŋ deŋna, hé no!
Nyoŋa ɡe, hé nyiŋi dɛ́ na!
Umee nyoŋa kohona kɛŋɔ n bonɔɔ nɔ, kɛɛ dɛ taŋ deŋne kɛŋɔ n torome maa tomɔ wɔ?
Umee nyoŋa kɛŋɔ onɔ la men Korowii aa leo tɛ n te laɔ?
Israel tena, waa haa kpɔ siwi na warɔ taeh, he ta sie a ta doe.
He dɔ deŋne dɛ́ no waa kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ haa deŋne cheɡ.” Korowii waa aa toɡra nomanta, a su o siwi kɛŋɔ ó ɡel o Mmarare do kan dɛ́ dɔ jirima.
Kɛ nɛra nɔ, ba dɔma kah ba kwaa dɛ paa kaa, dɛ laɡ ba do bɔɔne bini dɛ tɔ ba do, dɛ do ba deene ɡe.
Ba ɛ nɛra baa lɛ ba kwaa bwa ba be, nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ lɛɛ ba.
He bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ no waa nɔ kɛɛ dɛ́ cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ ba ɛɛ saŋ bɛl aa?
Umee kpɔ Israel tena do nɛnchɔɡa nɔn ta ba kah ba kwaa kaa lɔ?
Korowii baa ɛo wechɔɡa la laa aa?
Ba vɛh o ŋwɛnɛre ta teŋa, ba ta o Mmarare waa la noɛ.
A waa o ɡel o bandia waa kana kohona ba ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba na waa laa ta.
A do kɛ o mar nii bar Israel harɛ ken, kɛ ba ta kpɔe do ba nyu bini.
Nii la nyaa ba, kɛ ba ta wobɛlbwa ɡe hwele dɛ le a ta.
Lɛɛ beŋkpoŋ waa lole dɛ tɛ Israel tena Israel tena, Korowii waa ta heya la ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɔmɛ.
Menee lɛ heyaa ta, n yerɛ he sɔn dɛ le heyaa tɛ n te.
Men dɔ heya.
He dɛ ɡale vile aa, ń ja he nɛ, haa morɛ, wobɛlbwa aa heyaa ɛ.
He jo nii ta naa, haa fuh.
Aa heyaa nyaa, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ fuuh.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, he Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ maa dɛ lɛ heyaa la.
N kpɔ Ijipt tena charɛ he nyu, dɛ kpɔ Itiopia ne Seba tena cheɡ he buɡ ta dɛ lɛ heya.
He waa hiah mɛ kohona, he waa aa dɔ jirima n be mɛɛ nyin heyaa nomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ harɛre ne a nɛraa charɛ he nyu.
He bɛ ɔmɛ, n ja he nɛ.
Mɛɛ kpɔ he nɛra baa lɔ wee leebɔree ba, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ banɔ la baa lɔ wee cholibɔr la ɡe ba ja he nɛ.
Mɛɛ ŋɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne weekaŋle harɛbɔr tena bee ŋɔ bá tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ bá kaa!
Hé kpɔ n bibaala le bojaŋ ba, dɛ́ kpɔ n bitoli baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa ɡe ba, ba ɛ n nɛra, menee ta ba, ba kpɔ jirima dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ nɛra baa dɔ sibie kɛ baa wola na, ne nɛra baa dɔ deŋna kɛ baa wola waa no la ba.
Gel harɛre bwa ta nɛra ba cheme bobeŋkpoŋ.
Ba voɡ besoo wona baɡle waa aa ɛa saŋ la mɔɔ a ɛɔ?
Voɡ besoo wona baɡle anɔ aa dɛ ba chiɡa taraken nɔɔ?
A ba a danseɛre ne dɛ́ ba baɡle kɛŋɔ waa aa dɛ ba bola la ɛ kpela, ásɛ ane ɡe no dɛ́ sɛh kɛŋɔ kpelaa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, heyaa n danseɛre, n le heyaa kɛŋɔ n bonɔɔna ásɛ he jem mɛ dɛ́ yarada mɛ dɛ́ no a mun kɛŋɔ n ɡboo lole.
N sie, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ n habɔɔ bɛl ta dɛ ba bala.
Menee Korowii, n ɡbosoroo, n habɔɔ, Lɛɛ bɛlbwa toole.
Menee baɡle waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa, dɛ lɛ heya, dɛ ɡel nɛra no a wa.
Harɛ bɛl voɡ bɛlbwa aa lɔ he be laa ɛ ɡɛ.
N danseɛree heya.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Kpelaa, n ɡboo Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.
Nomɛlbwa aa won lɛ o te n nɔn ta.
Anɔ la maa ɛ la, nomɛlbwa aa won bera.” Israel tena Babelɔn harɛ ta lee wa Korowii, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ waa ɛ he Lɛɛ la ŋɔ, “He lɛɛ nomanta, mɛɛ do laa tena bá ka yo Babelɔn.
Mɛɛ kuuɡi bwɛjen la doonyoonee, ásɛ o nɛra silɛɛ berɛ wii.
Menee Korowii, he Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la.
Menee ta heya, menee he Kooro.” Kenii Korowii bol.
Onee ɡela mpo faa pere, ŋwɛnɛ chɔ o baah ta la.
Onee ɡela nee lɔ laa tena ne jaɡre ne torɔɡore a choɡli chɔ, nee bɔle ba nɛɛ ba ta wone ir kpa dɛ serewe kɛŋɔ nii aa dima ken.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé laa he liire kpɔ waa a fa aa chiɡa la ta, he bɛ an lii kpa.
Hɛ́ɛ no!
N dɛ ba wefale bɛl ɛɛ.
Taraken o dɛ le, he ta on nae yaa?
Mɛɛ bil ŋwɛnɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa, dɛ́ ɡel nenabɔɔne chɔ harɛ la ta.
Kpɔɡ bini ola ɛɛ duu mɛɛ, kalampoŋare ne kwiure ɛɛ duu mɛɛ, nee maa tɛa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la wa.
Anee mɛɛ ba n nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te la tɛɛ bá nyɔ, N ta ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bá ɛ n nɛra, dɛ́ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ mɛ.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Kɛ ane a bwa, he ta men tomɛ, Israel tena, n waa pe heya.
Hé ta peera kpoe dɛ fuah ɛ sarahare tɛ mɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔ saraha bɛlbwaa ba duu mɛ.
N ta mea sarahare waa kpɔe dawɛ he nɛɛ a ɛ heyaa bontɔɡa, n ta daawiile ɡe waa pɛɛrɛ le he be he mee le.
He ta daawiile kalamus a sɔɔh aa soma yawɛ bá fuh tɛ mɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ he tɛ mɛ he saraha kwaa bodɛɛɡa á su n siwi.
Kɛ he wechɔɡa kan dɛ ɛɛ mɛ bone, he wedoŋa ɡe ɛɛ le n mee.
Menee fee he wechɔɡa dɛɛ ta.
N ɡbaɡba waa mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ, maa an lii kpa bwa.
Hé lii mɛ waa a fa aa chiɡa, ásɛ ya cheme dɛ́ bola, ásɛ he baɡle anɔ la haa di bole a ta.
He nabaa waa tɔ sie la ɛ wechɔɡa, asɛ he nomonome bwa kpaŋe n nɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ le he sɔforee le ba toma ta Korowii Dea sihiih kpo ba.
Mɛɛ kpɔ Israel tenaa do ba dɔma nɔn ta bá chɔɡ ba, ba tama baa ka ɡe, bá ɛɛ ba nɛnhɛla.”
Korowii le Israel tena tɛ o te Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena haa ɛ Jekɔb naanar, hé no!
He ɛ n bonɔɔna n le heyaa tɛ n te.
Menee Korowii maa ta heya, dɛ jemɛ heyaa mɔɔ ba lolɛ heya, dɛ cha heyaa la.
He bɛ ɔmɛ, he ɛ n bonɔɔna maa le heyaa tɛ n te, n bambile lawɛ heya.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nee chɔ harɛ waa hola ta, ásɛ nenabɔɔne chɔ dɛɛ palɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n Doma ba so he bii nɛ, dɛ́ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ he naanar.
Baa kpeɡuu kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa aa lɔ harɛsɔn ta, ne dajaŋa aa cheɡɛ nee nyoa ken.
Bɛl ɛɛ bao dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Korowiirii mɛɛ tomɛ,’ ásɛ bɛl ɡe kpɔ Jekɔb sɔn dawɛ o nɛ, bɛl ɡe chwerɛ o nɔn ta kɛŋɔ ‘Korowii nɛnee men,’ ásɛ dɛ kpɔ Israel sɔn pa o te.” Nemenɛ Korowii waa ɛ Israel tena Kooro ne ba Lɛɛ la ŋɔ, “Menee komɛlbwa Sitɔɔ, ne a Muŋkaa bwa, n habɔɔ Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole.
Umee do kɛŋɔ men ɔ?
Ó bol.
Naate ɡel n jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa n ne o ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Ó baɡle waa aa chiɡa le ɡɛ saŋ maa ta saŋ la tena, ne waa a taa dɛ ba bala kerekere.
He bɛ ɡel he bwara ɛɛ sa!
He bɛ ɔmɛ!
Saŋ la bwa laa n le baɡle waa nɔ, dɛ bola aa?
N danseɛree heya.
Dɔɔ bɛl ɡe lole dɛ ja n nɛ aa?
Akai, Bwetal bɛlbwa toole he chwa ka marɔ ó won lɛ heya, beŋkpoŋ ɡba toole.” Nɛra baa dɛ ma voɡa kɛɛ dɛɛ sɛah la dɛ ɛ wepuu, kwaa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta la ɛ konsale.
Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa nɔ, ba do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa nyoŋa ken, baa wobɛlbwa jemɛ, baa di sihiih.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ma voɡ kɛɛ dɛɛ loɡɔ la, o ta tɔnɔ dɔe tɛo.
O ne nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡ la bwa ɛɛ di sihiih.
Nɛra laa dɛɛ sɛh kwa aa?
Ame binii ba doɔ?
Ba bwa ɛɛ ba chemoo ba bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole, ásɛ ba bwara yɔr kohona, ba di sihiih.
Nii taa loɡre do buni dɛ́ yon kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma.
Hamba nee wɛɛ lɔɔro bokpeɡa ne, dɛ́ ɛo ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin kɛ kon la mar do.
Lɔr ne nyɔɡre nee wɛɛ ɛo dɛ́ ba koh.
Nɛn waa jemɛ kwaa sɛɛh dɛ maɡɛ daa waa kpɔ sɛh kon, dɛ́ kpɔ kon peo, mɔɔ dɛ́ sɛoh, ó do wer, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ nɛn, dɛ́ kpɔ ka cheɡ voɡ dea.
Peleme daa aa weraa wɛɛ teŋe dɛ́ kpɔ sɛh kwaa la.
O dɛ chale daa aa do ɡɛ la, ásɛ a ne daa aa cheɡɛ kɔr baah bwa che dɛ́ kpeɡ.
Gɛ laa ɡe aa, o dɛ chɔɔ daa waa do kɛŋɔ a ɡɛ daa nɔ bɛl, ásɛ bwaala yon nɛ do o ta o kpeɡ.
O dɛ mar daa nɔ ane, dɛɛ ŋwee, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ daa kondikwa, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɡe sɛh voɡ dɛɛ tomɔ.
O kpɔ daa la ane dɛɛ mar nii, dɛɛ wɔɔ ola kɛɛ dɛ daala dɛɛ chwe.
O yon ŋwee nii la dɛ ŋɔ, “N bwara wɔrɔbɔ.” Daa la pera ɡe, o kpɔɔ dɛɛ sɛh voɡ, dɛɛ yerɔ o dɔɔ, dɛ ɡuŋi dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “N dɔɔree hen, kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ.” Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la ɡɛnɔ kohona, baa wobɛlbwa ɡe mun no.
Ba sibie tɔɔɡɔ, baa na, ba ta liire ɡe dɔe dɛ́ no waa mun.
Ba bini bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ lii wa, bɛlbwa ta wejema dɔe dɛ́ no a mun dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Daa nɔ tentenee n mar, dɛ kpɔ o hɔla dɛɛ daa kondikwa, dɛ wɔɔ ol a ta dɛ chwe.
O pera chɛ kɛŋɔ ń kpɔ ɛ kii kon aa?
A chɛ kɛŋɔ ń ɡuŋi dakpul aa?” A ɛ wesale kɛŋɔ waa dɛ di tɔɔ ken.
O neɡre o nyu dɛ nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ.
Waa won lɛ o te, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ won jemɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Kon maa kpoŋa ɛ nyosone kon.” Korowii ŋɔ, Israel tena, hé lii ɡɛ waa nɔ.
N bonɔɔnaa heya.
Menee ta heya.
Maa he waa soh bwa.
N laa he wechɔɡa fee a tonɛ, kɛŋɔ bam ne chɔɔlen kɔɔla ken.
Hé laa berɛ ba n be, dɛkalkɛ menee lɛ heya.
Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua, hé ɡo silɛɛ yela.
Komɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ ta ɡe, hé ɡo hɛɡra yela, hale bwejena ne kɔr bini daa bwa.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii lɛ Israel tena, dɛ baɡle o jirima waa dɔa.
Nɛra ɛɛ berɔ ba so Jerusalam Israel tena, Korowii waa ɛ he Lɛɛ, dɛ ta heyaa la ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii maa ta komɛlbwa.
N ɡboo paɡri nyundua kɛŋɔ yal, nomɛlbwa ta n nɛɛ jae n ta harɛ.
Menee ɡela keame nyosonteŋna waa ɛ nyosone, dɛ ɡel voɡra waa ɛ ɡɛnewa, dɛ won beɡre harɛ nɔ ta wejerema wejema, a ɛ wesale.
Menee ɡela waa n toroma aa bol la ɛɛ ɛ kpela.
Menee ŋɔa nɛra ɛɛ berɔɔ bá so Jerusalam, Juda bwɛɛre a fa aa paɡra la, bá berɛ kwaa vɔrɔwa.
N dɛ ŋɔ mpo hweeh, ó hweeh, ásɛ nenabɔɔne ɡe hweeh.
Men Korowii berɔ bol Saeros ɡe waa ŋɔ, ‘Henee dɛɛ ba n nɛra nɛɛ nyiŋa, dɛ́ ɛ waa maa dɛ nyin la bwa ka tonɛ,’ dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé kwaa pa Jerusalam ne men Korowii Dea la mun.’ ”
Korowii le Saeros ŋɔ ó ɛ kooro, dɛ leo ŋɔ ó pɔ harɛre nɛra nɛ.
O leo ŋɔ ó yo harɛre, dɛ́ pɔ ba koranar nɛɛ dɛ lɛ́ ba kpeɡri ba be.
Korowiirii dɛ́ ya bwɛjena doonyoone ɡbeni tɛo.
O ŋɔ Saeros be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tɔ he siee, dɛ́ bur bwejena ne deŋɡarere.
Mɛɛ paɡre ayaawa ɡberjenaa, dɛ́ kuuɡi bune baa kpɔa kaɡra la ɡe.
Mɛɛ tɛɛ kondɔɔh aa sɔah nɛra aa wola an na, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ, n yerɛ he sɔn.
N bonɔɔnaa Israel tena n lee ba tɛ n te nomanta, n le he Saeros cheɡ dɛ tɛɛ jirima kohona, a lole kɛ dɛ haa men jemɛ.
Menee Korowii, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa, nemenɛ n ɡbo.
Haa men jemɛ, kɛ mɛɛ tɛɛ kpeɡrii.
N ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ le wee leebɔr kaa o cholibɔr, nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
N habɔɔ, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa, nemenɛ n ɡbo.
Menee ta bochaah ne biro bwa, menee dɛɛ tɛ bosɔɔhna, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ba sibeɡra ɡe ne.
Men Korowii, menee ɛ anɔ bwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo wa aa toɡra le nyundua ba harɛ ta kɛ bwaala ken, ásɛ waa aa wera ne kasinteŋ do le, Men Korowiirii ta a bwa.” Nɛn o ne Korowii waa tao la aa dɛ yo la, ó bwɛɛlɛ!
Naate do kɛŋɔ vii ken.
Choh ɛɛ won ŋɔ mamaa be ŋɔ waa o toma jemaa?
Vii ɛɛ won bɔɔ mamaa waa aa bala o mao wa aa?
Gɛɛ a do, nɛn waa ŋɔ o nya ne o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he lol mɛ dɛ ɡel n do ken?” Korowii, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ waa ta ba, dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa chiɡ kerekere la ŋɔ, “He ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ, hé bɔɔ mɛ n bii wa, kɛɛ dɛ́ baɡ mɛ ɡɛ maa ɛ. Menee ta harɛ, dɛ ta nɛwɛnyina do o ta.
N kpeɡrii n kpɔ baŋre nyundua kɛŋɔ yal, dɛ kpɔ wee ne korobie dɛ weweela cheɡ a chebɔra.
Mɛɛ che toɡra n wa aa toɡra taa, dɛ́ ɡel Saeros ir dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra ne anɔ la maa dɛ nyin.
Mɛɛ kwaa o ŋwɛnɛree a do wer.
Onee dɛ́ ba kwaa ma n bwɛjen Jerusalam, dɛ́ lɛ n nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa harɛfala ta la.
Waa ɛ dɛ́ lɛ komɛl le nɛn be.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii ŋɔa.” Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Ijipt ne Itiopia harɛre kondɔɔh kwaa ɛɛ ɛ he kwaa, ásɛ Seba baala baa kpeɡa kohona berɛ he yoma.
Baa do ba jɔɡrɔree, ba teŋɛ he nɛ.
Baa ɡuŋi heyaa harɛɛ, dɛ́ sɛh ŋɔ, ‘Korowii teŋɛ he nɛɛ kpela.
Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole.’ ” Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ wɛɛ lɛɛ ba la, o ɛ Korowii waa kpɔ o te dɛɛ sɔh.
Sihiih ɛɛ kpo nɛra baa cheɡ voɡaa.
Ba bwa ɛɛ pɛo di ncho.
Kɛ Israel tena te, Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ baa saŋ bɛlbwa.
Baa sihiih di, saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.
Korowiirii ta nyundua onee Korowii, dɛ berɛ ta harɛ ɡe o che kiŋkiŋ.
O ta harɛ tae o chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ, kɛ o tao ŋɔ nɛra so o ta.
O ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa.
N ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ sɔh, kɛɛ dɛ che biro ta bol waa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
N ta Israel tena be ŋɔe ŋɔ, ‘Hé nyin n bɔr pɛɛpɛɛ.’ Menee Korowii, Kasinteŋ ɡboo n bwa, waa aa wera dɛ toɡre ɡboo mɛɛ bol.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra haa chwaa le laa ta kaa la, hé berɛ ba.
Nɛra baa kpɔ daa berɛ voɡa dɛ kpoŋa dɛɛ valɛ la aa waane jemɛ.
Ba kpɔ wesoŋa dɛɛ bil voɡa aa wola won lɛɛ ba sie.
Hé cheme, dɛ́ bol he waa kɔɔto, ásɛ nɛra baa kpɔ waa daɡ ba la le jina dɛ́ kpɔ liire.
Umee bol waa aa chiɡa taraken nɔ bil wubwa nɔ?
Umee le saŋ la bwa dɛ bola ɔ?
Men Korowii maa ɛ he Lɛɛ la laa aa?
Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole.
Harɛre nɛra bwa, hé ba n be, dɛ́ ba dɔ he nyu.
N ɡboo Korowii, Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa.
N ŋwɛɛ n ɡbaɡba, maa nentanee ta dɛ́ berɛ kpɛla.
N nyoa wobol bɛlbwa toɡrɔ.
Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ ɡuŋ mɛ harɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ che n sɔn ta ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba Dɔɔree men.
Baa bol n waa ŋɔ, ‘O ɡbo bee waa aa toɡra ne kpeɡri do.’ Banɔ la ba baah aa di n nɛɛ la bwa, ɛɛ berɔɔ ba n be sihiih ne.
Men Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo Jekɔb naanar bwa waa toɡre, ásɛ ba kpɛɛ mɛ.”
Babelɔn voɡa wa Korowii ŋɔ, “Babelɔn tena voɡa Bel ne Nɛbo baa dɛ toma la di sihiih, ba paa dawɛ keeɡore ta a ɛ bontɔɡa a chea dɛɛ koh.
Voɡa la ta wone lɛ a te, ba dɔma cheɡɛ a bwa kaa.
Israel tena haa kaa la bwa, hé no n be.
Menee nyiŋi he nɛɛ le ɡɛ saŋ baa lolɛ bwa.
Menee dɛɛ ba he nɛɛ nyiŋa, dɛ́ ka tel he hwɛɛhra saŋ he nyumpona aa to.
Menee ta heya, mɛɛ chwaa heyaa, dɛ́ kpoŋe heya, dɛ́ lɛ heya.
Umee hɛɛ ba men kpɔe maɡɔɔ?
Umee do kɛ men ɔ?
Bane fuɡe suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa le pure bini, dɛ kpɔa dawɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ kari kwaa ta.
Ba kpɔa tɛ nɛn waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema o kpɔ kwaa voɡ, asɛ ba ɡuŋi dɛɛ tomɔ.
Ba ɡɔɔro dɛ chwaa, dɛ choɡo cheɡ o chebɔr aa, dɛ o cheɡɔ, waa won tu nakpala.
Ba yerɔ waa won sɛh.
Waa won lɛɛ ba le ba wahala ɡe ta.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, hé lii waa nɔ, dɛ́ ɡel a ka he nyu bini.
Hé ɡel he siwi swɛɛ a ta.
Hé lii waa aa chiɡa saŋ la.
N ɡboo Korowii, n dɔŋ toole.
N bol waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa mɔɔ a ba, saŋ la bwaa n le baɡle anɔ la a taa dɛ ba bala.
N ŋɔ waa maa maɡla bil bwa ɛɛ ɛo, mɛɛ ɛ anɔ la bwa n tea aa tooraa.
Mɛɛ yerɛ nomɛlee le bojaŋ harɛ wee leebɔr, ásɛ o ba tawɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra baah ta kɛŋɔ kela ken, dɛ́ ba tonɛ anɔ la maa maɡla bil bwa.
Waa maa bola la, anee dɛɛ ba ɛɛ.
Hé no n be, deŋnekpeɡ tena, he ne waa aa toɡra baah jaŋne.
N dɛ ba n waa aa toɡra ne.
A toole bojaŋ, aa biɡri kwaraa.
Mɛɛ lɛ Jerusalam tenaa, dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔ n jirima.”
Babelɔn paɡra wa Korowii ŋɔ, “Babelɔn, bwɛjen baa wola yoi dɛ pɔ he nɛ, he do kɛŋɔ bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ.
Tu he kookara ta, dɛ́ ba so harɛ.
Taraken baa hen ɡbɛɡbɛ kpa, he berɛ yom.
Ka namɛ men nam ta, laa kon haa kpɔa bɔle sie la kpɔ, dɛ́ laa yal ɡbaa he hwie ta, dɛ́ jo neerare le a baŋ.
Nɛra ɛɛ nae kɛŋɔ he cheɡɛ mumɡbal, baa na sihiih haa dia.
Mɛɛ bɔe he wechɔɡa kemee, maa nomɛlbwa nɛɛ sune.” Ya Lɛɛ, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ, Koranar Bwa Kooro yaa dɛ tomɔ la.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Babelɔn haa do kɛŋɔ bitolo, so harɛ biro ta jeiih ken.
Baa hen harɛ nɔ ta bwa bwɛɛre haŋkooroo yerɛ kpa!
N baah fa di n nɛra Israel tena nɛ, n tɛr ba deŋne kɛŋɔ n nɛra laa ban ken, dɛ kpɔ ba do hen Babelɔn nɔn ta.
He ta ba nɛɛ sune, hale banɔ la baa hwɛɛhra kwaraa la, he do ba hɔhɔrɔwa.
He fa ŋɔ hɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛ ɛ haŋkooro saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, anomanta, he ta ɡɛ we-ɛɛla nɔ kpɔe do he liire bini, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ lii ɡɛ aa dɛ ba he chiɡa.
No, he dɛ di he bwara, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ɛɛ.
He ŋɔ he ne Korowii kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, nomɛlbwa toole he habɔɔ.
He ta liire kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɛ luhaahnee bwa, haa biseo ɡee di.
Gɛ webele anɛ nɔ ɛɛ piɡri tɔpebeŋkpoŋii.
Ane he kaberere bwa, hɛɛ di bisewee, he jaa sewɛ.
He kpɔ he te dawɛ he wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa aa men na.’ He wejema ne he liire wili dɛ ɡel he ŋɔ, ‘Menee men.
Nomɛlbwa toole n habɔɔ kpa.’ Wekpeɡa ɛɛ pui, he bebee waa bwa aa won sɔɔh a nyoa.
Siswɛm waa ɛɛ pui, waa haa wola a waa deere bwa piɡri.
Anomanta, ir nyu ne, dɛ́ do sie he kaberere ne he dobodobo we-ɛɛla aa wara he le a ne bechale saŋ, dɛɛ ɛa la.
A ken ɛɛ won ɛ waane, he ken ɛɛ won kpɔ aah he dɔma.
Jae bwa haa dɔa habɔɔ, he ta kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe.
Gel wejerema baa jemɛ weweela wa, dɛɛ baɡle waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa korobie bɛlbwa ta, ir ba lɛɛ le waa aa dɛ ba he pui la ta.
Na, ba do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡhole, nii ɛɛ fuuh baa.
Hale baa won lɛ ba te le ninlao la ta kwara.
Gɛ nii la ta doe kɛŋɔ nii haa won la a jwɛɛh ka ŋwee.
Waa nɛra haa le he bechale saŋ dɛɛ la ba be baa jae la aa dɛ ba ɡela he na laanee.
Bɛlbwa ɛɛ nyin bɔree dɛ́ chwa kaa, bɛlbwa aa lee do, dɛ́ lɛɛ.”
Israel tena deŋnekpeɡ wa Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé no, Jekɔb naanar baa bera dɛɛ yerɛ heyaa Israel tena he le Juda dea, he dɛ ŋwɛɛ men Korowii sɔn, dɛɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ tomɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la, kɛ haa waa haa dɛ bol la ɛ.
He dɛ́ maŋkura he te ŋɔ he le bwɛjen Jerusalam, dɛ ŋɔ he kpɔ he te dawɛ men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la nɛ.
Fini laa n le dɛ bol waa aa ɛa.
N bola biɡri asɛ he jemɛ, buɡ la taa n den ɡel a ɛ. Dɛ n jemɔ kɛŋɔ he deŋne kpeɡri kɛŋɔ buni, he lwɛɛma do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwe.
A waa ɡela n bol waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere la, dɛ bol waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa mɔɔ á chiɡ, ásɛ he bɛ ba ŋɔ he voɡaa ɡela a chiɡ.
He no waa n fa aa bola baɡle heyaa asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé sɛh kɛŋɔ a ɛ kpela.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa mɛɛ bol wefala aa sɔah maa wola he be bolɛ la he bee.
Tarakenii mɛɛ ba ɡela a chiɡ.
Waa aa do ɡɛ ta chiɡe bwa.
Ane chiɡo ka aa, he fe ŋɔ he jemɛ a wa.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, he ɛ nɛra bane baa jema kɛ ɡaeh tenaa heya.
A waa haa wola waa nɔ bwa no la.
N sɔn ne kpɛɛra waa mɛɛ lawɛ bambile he nɛ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ heyaa ba chɔɡ.
N do heyaa weweele ta, dɛ daah heyaa na, kɛŋɔ ba yon do suuɡapoŋ nii ta dɛ mwɛɛlo la.
Kɛ n nao kɛŋɔ haa siwi su.
N ɡbaɡba waa n ɛa ɡɛ.
Maa ɡel n sɔn chɔɡ, maa ɡel he kpɔ jirima aa chɛ mɛ la tɛ nomɛl.” Israel tena dɔ ba te le Babelɔn lɔɡa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé no n be, Israel tena maa yerɛ heya.
Menee Korowii, menee komɛlbwa sitɔɔ, ne muŋkaa.
N ɡbaɡbaa kpɔ nɔn pa harɛ mun, dɛ kpɔ n nɔndiɡ baŋre nyundua.
N yera aa, a dɛ ba n be.
Hé bwa ba cheme dɛ́ no.
Voɡa la bini umee wona baɡle anɔ nɔɔ?
Nɛn maa leo la ɛɛ yo Babelɔn tenaa.
Wɛɛ ɛ waa maa dɛ nyin kɛ o ɛ bwaa.
Menee pili nyoa dɛ yerɔ, menee leo dɛ ɡel o won ɛ o toma bwa ka tonɛ.
Hé suuh tel n be, dɛ́ ba no waa nɔ.
Le waa nɔ mumpar bwa n ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ a sɔh heya, n wobɛlbwa maa bol la, a dɛ ɛ kpela.” Nemenɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o Doma ta, dɛ tom mɛ.
Waa Korowii, waa ɛ he Lɛɛ, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la aa dɛ bolee nɔ, “Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, menee dɛɛ chaɡle heyaa anɔ la aa wera tɛ heya, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ chaɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ o ta.
Dɛ he fe cheɡ deŋne n waa ta naa, he fe dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna kɛrɛdɛ, kɛŋɔ nenabɔɔ waa wola hweeh bwa, dɛ́ dɔ kpeɡri kohona kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma ken, dɛ́ won wobɛlbwa ɛɛ á toɡre.
He naanar fe ɛɛ warɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.
N fe nyiŋ ba kɛrɛdɛ ba dɔma bɛ won chɔɡ ba, ásɛ ba sɔn bɛ he.” Hé le Babelɔn harɛ ta, hé chwa le o nɛra bini!
Hé kpɔ silɛɛ taa bol bobɛlbwa ŋɔ, “Korowii lɛ o bonɔɔna Israel tena.” Waa kpɔ ba kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la, nyɔɡre ta ban kpoe.
O ɡelɔ nee bule le bwe ta tɛɛ ba.
O pere bwe nee palɛ le o ta.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Bosɔɔhna toole dɛ tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.”
Israel tena do kɛŋɔ kandea tɛ harɛre nɛra Bojaŋa harɛre nɛra, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n be.
Korowii lee mɛ n ɛ o bonɔɔ, o yerɛ n sɔn mɔɔ ba lol mɛ.
O ɡelɔ n nyoa wobol do nyɛɡre kɛŋɔ naŋɡɔse ken, dɛ kpɔ o nɔn tɔ n nɛ, dɛ ɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ hɛm waa nyɛɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ ɛ toma ken.
O berɔ ŋɔ, “Israel harɛ, he do kɛŋɔ n bonɔɔ, he nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa nɛra kpɛɛ mɛ.” Anee n ŋɔ, “N koɔh ta pɛɛ, n chɔɡ n bokpeɡa wepuu ta pɛɛpɛɛ.
Kɛ n kpɔ n waa bwa do Korowii nɔn ta, n kembɔr ɡe lɔ o be.” Korowii lee mɛ dɛ ɛɛ mɛ o bonɔɔ mɔɔ ba lol mɛ, dɛ ŋɔ ń berɛ ba o nɛra Israel tena baa peɡra dɛ do bobɛlbwa la ne o be.
Korowii ɡelɔ n dɔ duure, o bee n kpeɡri do.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “N bonɔɔ, n dɔ wejena ane tɛɛ he ɛ. Israel tena baa kaa la ɡbo sie laa hɛɛ ba tɔe.
Mɛɛ ɛɛ kɛŋɔ kandea hɛ́ɛ chaah harɛre nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ la bwa nɛ, ásɛ n won lɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa.” Israel tena Lɛɛ, ba Nɛŋɡoroŋ la ŋɔ nɛn harɛre nɛra aa haoh baa wola on kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa, ba nomonome ɛo yom la be ŋɔ, “Koranar ɛɛ nae dɛ́ ir che, koobii nae dɛ́ ɡuŋi harɛ.
A nɔ bwa ɛɛ ɛo dɛkalkɛŋɔ, men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ n wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la, menee lee.” Korowii ɛɛ berɔɔ lɛ Israel tena Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ saŋ telo kɛŋɔ ń lɛ heya aa, mɛɛ na he sumii dɛ́ cha heya.
Mɛɛ nyiŋi heyaa, dɛ́ ɡel he ne nɛra bwa fɔwɛ fɔo.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he ka so he harɛ waa chɔɡa dɛ chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ la ta ja.
Mɛɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa do ba deene bee ŋɔ, ‘Hé le kaa!’ dɛ́ ŋɔ banɔ la baa lɔ biro ta ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Hé le ba bɔchaah ta.’ Baa ɛo kɛŋɔ peera aa dɛ di deŋɡarere ta ken, lɔr ne nyɔɡre aa ba kpoe ba.
Wee nyɛɡre ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta peuwɔb aa ban ha, dɛkalkɛ naate waa dɛ nyin ba waa la ɛɛ tɔ ba siee, dɛ́ la ba ne bela nesɔn aa bula dɛɛ le.
Mɛ́ɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛɛ bil bwejena dor, dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ n nɛra bá kpɔ o ta.
Baa le bojaŋaa ba, bane ɛɛ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔree, bane ɡe le wee cholibɔr dɛ́ ba, ásɛ bane ɡe le Aswan dɛ́ ba.” Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua, hé do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ ne, kwaa aa lɔ harɛ ta ɡe, hé hɛɡre!
Bwejena ɡe ɡo silɛɛ yela.
Korowii ɛɛ larawe o nɛra bwaraa, wɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ wahala tena ɡe.
Kɛ Jerusalam tena te ŋɔ, “Korowii ɡel yaa, o soh ya wa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Haah ɛɛ won soh o bilole waa ɔro wa aa?
Dɛ nya ɛɛ soh o bie waa yaa, n te aa he waa soeh ba bwa.
Jerusalam, n chwerɛ he sɔn do n nɔmpaala bini, he waa dawɛ n bambile ta saŋ bɛlbwa.
Nɛra baa ba kwaa vɔrɔwe ɛɛ bao taraken, ásɛ banɔ la baa chɔɡe la le kaa.
Ha sie nyiŋi bar dɛ́ na waa aa dɛ chiɡ!
He nɛra dɛ́ cheme dɛ́ berɛ ba he be dem!
N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛ, maa ɛ Korowii maa lole saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ, he sie ɛɛ lɛ he nɛra nɛɛ, kɛŋɔ hanfale sie yon lɛ o baŋa kwaa ne nɔnloɡa aa wera ta la.
A lole kɛŋɔ harɛ la fa paɡrɔ, dɛ berɛ dimɡbia, kɛ taraken harɛ la ɛɛ do jeɡaa tɛ nɛra baa dɛ ba ba so o ta.
Ásɛ nɛra ba fa aa chwa he yaa la, bá kpɔ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta.
He bii baa kaa lol ba harɛfale ta la ɛɛ ba ŋɔ he be tɔpebɛlee ŋɔ, ‘Ya farɛ harɛ nɔ ta to, waa kanɛ tɛ yaa.
Tɛ yaa bɔr yá so!’ Ásɛ he ba lii he nyu bini ŋɔ, ‘Ume tenee lolɛ ɡɛ bii nɔ tɛ mɛ nɔ?
Dɛ n paŋɛ bii maa wola lii kɛ mɛɛ dɔ banee kpa.
Ba doŋ mɛ n kaa harɛfale ta, aah umee dɛɛ bechale nɔɔ?
Dɛ n ɡboo kaa, leperaa ba le ba te nɔ?’ ” Kenii Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ o nɛra be, “Mɛɛ kwɛr harɛre nɛraa, ásɛ ba kpɔ he bii berɛ ba dem.
Koranar ɛɛ kpɔ heyaa berɛ ba bii, ásɛ ba haŋkoranar ɡe berɛ he nyare.
Baa dɛɛ ɡuŋi heyaa harɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ duure tɛ he ya.
Belaa hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Nɛra baa kpɔ hwɛɡa dawɛ n nɛɛ la, sihiih aa ban kpo bwa.” Hɛɛ won lɛ banyoo kwaa waa paa laa ta naa?
Hɛɛ won lɛ nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta le nyubinikpeɡ te nɔn ta naa?
Ate, ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ bolee kɛŋɔ, “Kpelaa, mɛɛ lɛ nɛra banyoola aa laɡ ba laa ta laanee le ba be, mɛɛ lɛ laala baa paa laa ta laanee le nyubinikpeɡ tena la be tɛɛ ba.
Mɛɛ yo nɛra baa dɛ yo he yaa, ásɛ dɛ lɛ he bii.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra baa dɛ yoo heyaa la kpoo ba ɡbaɡba, dɛ́ nyɔ ba ɡbaɡba chale, dɛ́ dɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa nyɔ sen ken, ásɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ, Men Korowii, menee he Lɛɛ, menee yawɛ he nyu, dɛ berɛ ɛ Jekɔb Kpeɡnɛn waa tomɔ la.”
Israel wechɔɡa ne Korowii Bonɔɔ deŋnepwɛr wa Korowii ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ doŋaa n doŋi n nɛra ta, kɛŋɔ baa aa vɛh o haah la kɛɛ?
Dɛ ɡɛɛ yaa, leperaa tɔn maa chwera a baɡle kɛŋɔ n vɛoh la dɔɔ?
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ, baa lawɛ heyaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛre ta la, yoɡaa n yoɡ heyaa kɛ yoma kɛɛ?
Hé no, he wechɔɡa waa a ba ɡɛ, a do kɛŋɔ n vɛh heyaa la.
N ba he be, n ta heyaa nae, n yerɛ heyaa he ta sɛɛh.
Kpeɡri maa kpɔ lɛ heyaa laanee n ta dɔe kɛɛ?
Mɛɛ won ŋɔ mpo hweeh, ó hweeh, dɛ́ berɛ won ɡel neerare hweeh, bela do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, ásɛ a pɛŋa bwa serewe dɛ́ pɔh.
Mɛɛ won ɡel biro tɔ nyundua bwa, ásɛ dɛ bir kɛŋɔ lweyal ken.” Nemenɛ Korowii baɡ mɛ n jemɛ wobol, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ do nɛra baa koah ɡbemba.
O laɡ mɛ dɛɛ ir chɔɔ bɛlbwa dɛ ɡel mɛɛ no waa waa dɛ ba n baɡla.
Nemenɛ Korowii ɡelɔ mɛɛ no waa mun.
N ta deŋnekpeɡ ɛɛ dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoo.
N berɛ n nyaŋ tɛ nɛra ba lɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ n taŋɡbaɡre ɡe tɛ nɛra ba chuɡri n tampona.
N ta n sie laa fɛr sihihwaa ne nentane baa taa ta n sie ta.
Sihiih aa men kpo, dɛkalkɛ Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ cha mɛ.
Anomanta, n lawɛ n te, dɛ n jemɔ kɛŋɔ maa nchoo di bwa.
Korowii bɛn mɛ.
Wɛɛ pa mɛ bolee.
Umee dɛ́ won kpɔ waa dawɛ n nɛɔ?
Naate ɡel ya cheme.
Ume tenee n ne o dɔɔ?
Naate ba n ne o cheme, dɛ́ bol.
Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ cha mɛ, umee dɛ́ won pa mɛ bolchɔɡe ɔ?
Ba bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo kɛŋɔ yal sɛɛle aa diu la ken.
He banɔ la bwa haa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛɛ no o bonɔɔ waa la, a balɔ kɛ he dɛ valɛ biro ta kwaraa naa, hé yarada Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ he te dawɛ o nɛ.
He banɔ la ɡe haa dɛ nyin hé chɔɡ he bala la, aa di he ɡbaɡbaa.
Korowii ɡbabirii dɛɛ ba ɡela á chiɡ ɡɛ.
Hɛɛ na waa kohonaa taeh.
Jerusalam tena bɔlarawa wa Korowii ŋɔ, “He banɔ la he siwi aa swɛɛ waa aa toɡra ta, hɛɛ nyin he jem mɛ la, hé no n be.
Hé lii he nabaa Abraham waa do kɛŋɔ bwe baa pɛɡre heyaa le o ta, ne bɔɔ baa kwi heyaa le o bini la.
Hé lii he nabaa Abraham, ne Saara haa le ba bini la wa.
Maa yerɛ Abraham dɛ o ta bie dɔe, asɛ n swee andɛɛɡa tɛo dɛ́ ɡel o naanar warɛ.
Jerusalam berɛ dimɡbia, mɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ o nɛra baa soɡe o ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ le daa warɛ dɛ́ do wer, kɛŋɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe la.
Silɛɛ ne hɛɡra ɛɛ do belaa, ásɛ ba ɡo kpɛɛra ne jam yela dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
N nɛra, hé no n be!
N harɛ ta nɛra, hé cheɡ deŋne no waa maa dɛ bol nɔ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he jemɛ me Mmarare, ásɛ n kasinteŋ ɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah harɛre nɛra.
Mɛɛ bao warane, dɛ́ ba lɛɛ ba, ba lɛɛ tɔpere aa jaŋɛ kwara.
N ɡbabirii dɛ nyiŋi harɛre nɛra nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ n kasinteŋ la.
Bojaŋa harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ dɔ hwɛɡaa, dɛɛ nyiŋi lɛɛ maa dɛ ba ba lɛɛ la ŋwɛnɛ.
Hé ha sie nyiŋi nyundua, dɛ́ berɛ ba sie ne harɛ dɛ́ nyiŋi.
Nyundua ɛɛ nyoɡroo kɛŋɔ ninchuu ken, ásɛ harɛ ɡe chɔɡ kɛŋɔ yakwara aa kɔɔhna ken, nɛra baa lɔ o ta serewe kɛŋɔ chwɛɛhne.
Kɛ lɛɛ maa dɛ ba nɛra lɛɛ la ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
N waa aa toɡra ɡe aa tonɛ bwa.
He banɔ la haa jemɛ waa aa toɡra, dɛɛ teŋɛ me mmarare ta la, hé no n be.
He bɛ bammuɡla nɛra aa dɛ ɛ heyaa la ɔmɛ, kɛɛ he bwara hwah chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡɛ heyaa la wa.
Ba bwa ɛɛ heo kɛŋɔ, sɛɛle aa di laala kɛɛ dudule aa dɛ chɔɡ yabii ken.
Kɛ toɡra n wa aa toɡra ɛɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwaa, ásɛ lɛɛ maa lɛ nɛra la chɔ ka le naanar baa ka ba bwa.” N Naa Korowii, ir nyu ne dɛ́ cha yaa!
Kpɔ he kpeɡri la ba lɛ yaa ɡɛ haa ɛa saŋ la!
He laa chɛwɛ mpo bini oljen Rahab la aa?
He laa ɡela mpo hweeh, ŋwɛnɛ chɔ bela waa luŋa, asɛ nɛra haa lɛɛ ba won le o baŋ la aa?
Nɛra haa lɛɛ ba la ɛɛ berɔɔ ba jo Jerusalam, dɛ́ ɡo yela dɛɛ hɛɡre silɛɛ ne.
Ba sie ɛɛ lɛo saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ sum ne hima le kwaraa.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Menee dɛɛ larawe he bwara.
Nɛwɛnyina ɡee bɔkwa, hɛɛ ɔm baɔ?
Ba dɛ serewe, ba do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa.
Kɛ he soh men Korowii maa ta heyaa dɛ paɡri nyundua kɛŋɔ yal, dɛ pa harɛ mun la wa.
Ɛrɛwaa tɔpere bɛlbwa hɛɛ ɔmɛ nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi heya, dɛɛ nyin bá chɔɡ heyaa kohona nɔɔ?
Leperaa ba bandia ɛɛ tel ɔ?
Banɔ la baa do ba dea la, aa biɡri bá lee ba.
Baa dea baa kwiu bɔɔ biro tenten do bela la binii serewe, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ kondikwaa waa ɛɛ noo baa.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.
Menee wona ɡel mpo ɛɛ ir dɛɛ lɔ nehɛma.
N sɔnee Nemenɛ Korowii.
Menee kpɔ n waa tɛ heya, dɛ kpɔ n nɔn tɔ he nɛ.
Menee paɡri nyundua kɛŋɔ yal, dɛ pa harɛ mun.
Menee ŋɔ Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, ‘N nɛraa heya.’ ” Jerusalam tena wenaale jaɡa Jerusalam tena, hé ir nyu ne, hé ir!
He nyɔ Korowii danana nee a nyoa aa kpeɡa kɛŋɔ sen la, he nyɔ a bwa kwaraa dɛ dɛɛ, dɛɛ yɛɛɡe.
He bii haa lol ba bwa, bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔ he sie.
Bɛlbwa toole he dɛɛ ó lawɛ he nɔɔra.
Wekpeɡa anɛ nɔɔ pu heya, umee dɛ́ won larawe heyaa bwara ɔ?
Laa yoi ɡelɔ he harɛ chɔɡ, lɔr chole he nɛra nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ bwɛɛ heya.
He bii ɡwɛɡrɔ chɔ fɔɡbaahna, ba do kɛŋɔ kweɡla aa lɔ bel ta ken.
Korowii baah di ba nɛ, aa noo ba kohona.
Hé no, Jerusalam tena, he waa sum.
Hé dɛɛrɔ, kɛ he ta sen nyɔe.
Nemenɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ wɛɛ che he habɔɔ la ŋɔ, “Hé na, n lɛ n danana nee numol haa nyɔ o bini sen dɛɛ la le he nɔn ta.
Haa anee nyɔ kpa bwa.
Mɛɛ kpɔɔ do nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi heyaa la nɔn ta.
Banee yon ŋɔ, ‘Hé chɔ harɛ, ásɛ ya valɛ he nyaŋ ta.’ He chɔ harɛ ba kpɔ he nyaŋ berɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ tiɡri he nɛ.”
Korowii ɛɛ lɛ Jerusalam tenaa Bwɛjen Jerusalam, ir!
Ir nyu ne!
Kpɔ bokpeɡa tɔ he te kɛŋɔ yal ken.
Jerusalam, Korowii bwɛɛ waa do ɡoroŋ, kpɔ he yadɛɛɡe tɔ dɛ dɔ jirima.
Nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ, dɛ kah doŋa te bɛlbwa, aa won jo he bwɛɛ nɔ ta kpa.
Jerusalam haa do kɛ bitolo, ir dɛ́ pee he bwara ta, dɛ́ so he kookara ta.
Ásɛ dɛ laa jɔɡrɔre baa lawɛ dɛ doe laa ta la foo.
Kenii Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ he nɛra be.
“Ba ta heyaa yoɡe lɛ komɛlbwa, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ ba lɛɛ dɔe haa wola komɛlbwaa bɔ.” Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “N nɛra fa kaa so Ijipt harɛ ta ka.
Ban dɛɛ nyin dɛ kaa.
Asɛ aa la sie Asiiria tena laɡ ba kaa kpeɡri ne.
Bɔkwa waa nɔ jaɔ?
Babelɔn tena lawɛ n nɛra bwa kaa pɛɛpɛɛ, ba ka do ba lɔɡa, ba siwi sa ba.
Ba dɛ bol mɛ nɛnhɛlwobol saŋ bɛlbwa.
Anomanta, saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao n nɛra jemɛ ɡɛ maa doa, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Menee bola.” Hé na ɡɛ toroma baa kpoŋe Amanesoma dɛ valɛ bwea dor dɛɛ ba wa aa dɔ nyokpoa ne, dɛɛ bol deŋnesɔɔhna ne Korowii lɛɛ wa!
Hé no ba bala wa aa, he bambile ɛɛ sɔɔh heyaa taeh.
O bol Saayɔn tena be ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ di kora!” Nɛra baa dɛ daah bwɛjen la pɛo dɛɛ do lɔŋɔre silɛɛ ne!
Ba na Korowii ba siwi ne kɛ waa bera dɛɛ ba Saayɔn!
Jerusalam tena, he bwɛjen berɛ dimɡbia, hé pɛ ɡo silɛɛ yela.
Korowii larawe o nɛra bwara, dɛ lɛ Jerusalam ɡe.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre nɛra bwa na ɡɛ o kpeɡri aa do ɡoroŋ.
Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa ɛɛ na ɡɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa wona lɛ yaa.
Hé le Babelɔn harɛ!
Hé pere he te le ba nɛɛ kwara!
He bɛ komɛlbwa waa kah doŋa leɡe!
He nɛra haa cheɡɛ Korowii Dea laala la, hé le ba bini, dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ.
Toola ne laa hɛɛ ba lee, kɛɛ chwae laa hɛɛ ba chwae le, dɛ́ dɔ he nyu.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ tɔ he siee, wɛɛ berɔ teŋɛ he nɛɛ dɛ́ daah heya.
Korowii Bonɔɔ bonyɛɡa ne o jirima dɔe wa Korowii ŋɔ, “N bonɔɔ ɛɛ won ɛ toma maa kpɔa do o nɔn ta la tonɛ, baa duuruu taeh, dɛ́ ɡel o sɔn le.
Nɛra warɔ dɛ nao ba bwara yɔr, ɡɛ baa ɛo, o siebɔr ne o bwadabii beɡre dɛ doŋ kohona la, o ta nɛn leɛ kwaraa kpa.
Kɛ taraken, harɛre nɛra nyoa ɛɛ kpo o waa, koranar hel, ba bwara yɔr.
Baa na waa baa wola ba be bolɛ bwaa, ásɛ anɔ la baa wola noɛ bwa la, bá no a mun.”
Anee nɛra la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Umee dɛ́ fe yarada waa yaa dɛ bol nɔɔ?
Umee dɛ́ fe jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii ɛaɔ?
Korowiirii ɡela o bonɔɔ kpeɡ o sie, dɛ do kɛŋɔ daa waa le harɛ hole ta.
O ta nyanyini ne wer dɔe yá pɛla lawɔ, o wobɛlbwa ta silɛɛ dɔe yá nyinu.
Nɛra haoh dɛ vɛoh, o na wahala ne weweele.
Nɛra nao, dɛ laa sie kpɔ o nɛ.
Ya ta on kpɔe ɛ wobɛlbwa, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoo.
Kpela, onee laa ya ɡwɛɡra, ne weweele kpɔ ya nɛ.
Kɛ ya te liiro kɛŋɔ Korowiirii lɔɔro dɛ doo weweele dɛ kpɔ tɛr o deŋne.
Ya wechɔɡa waa ba doo bol, ya wechɔɡa waa ba lɔɔro.
Gɛ aa ɛ yá dɔ bosɔɔhna waa o dɔ deŋnetɛra, á che a ta ya dɔ bokpeɡa.
Ya bwa do kɛ peera aa kpaŋa ken, bɛlbwa ɛɛ kaa bela waa dɛ nyin, asɛ Korowii ɡel deŋnetɛra a fe aa chɛ yaa la bwa ba o nɛ.
Ba ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa, kɛ o helɔ, o ta nyoa pile.
O tɔ nyoa kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ pebie dɛɛ kaa kpobɔr la.
O ɛo jeiih kɛŋɔ penee baa dɛ fonɛ o pona ken.
O ta nyoa pile dɛ bol wobɛlbwa sese.
Ba lawɔ dɛ vɛh o waa dii dɛ tɛo aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ kpoo.
Waa dɔa sewɛ la, umee dɛ́ won baɡle o naanar waa kpaɔ?
N nɛra wechɔɡa waa ba kpoo.
O ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa ba pɛ huɡe, dɔɔhna lalbɔɔ binii o chɔ.
A lole kɛ o ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ, kɛɛ dɛ teŋe nyosone bwa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Men Korowii tetooraa ba doo bol, o na wahala.
O seo la ɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha, dɛ kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛɛ kɛ ba.
Waa wona ɛ ɡɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ mkpajaŋee dɛ́ na o naanar, ásɛ a che o nɛɛ waa men Korowii aa maɡla bil la ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
O soɡa bini wahala waa baa na habɔɔ la, wɛɛ berɔɔ dɔ mkpa, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ o ta wahala nae pɛɛpɛɛ.
N bonɔɔ o waa aa toɡra, o lɛ nɛndamanta wechɔɡa che nomanta, mɛɛ che o seo la taa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba.
Anɔ waa mɛɛ ba on nomombɔr tɛɛ, dɛ́ tɛo kpeɡri, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o kpɔ o te tɛ ba kpoo, ba kuro ja wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛ.
O kpɔ o te ɛ saraha, dɛ lɛ nɛndamanta bwa wechɔɡa che, dɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa men Korowii be tɛɛ ba.”
Korowii nyina waa dɔa tɛ Israel tena Korowii ŋɔ, “Jerusalam haa do kɛŋɔ hambara, ɡel he sie lɛ hɛɛ moo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haah o jaa aa chwao la ɛɛ ba dɔ biirii ɡwaa onɔ la o jaa aa wola on chwae.
Paɡri he tɛnte dea kɛrɛdɛ ó do kan. Gel o ŋwɛɛra do jaŋne, dɛ́ kpaa daa haa kpɔa baŋro la, á kaa bini.
Hɛɛ paɡri he harɛ jwɛhree a kaa sie diɡ ne ɡal, ásɛ he naanar berɛ lɛ harɛre nɛra bane aa soɡe a ta taraken nɔ, dɛ́ so a ta.
Bwɛjena aa chɔ pɛɛ taraken la, he nɛra ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ berɛ ba so a ta.
Bɛ ɔmɛ, sihiih aa he kpoe ba kpa, nɛra aa ɡel he fɛɡre.
Hɛɛ soh he toli saŋ sihiih waa bwaa, haa ɡɛ saŋ haa do kɛŋɔ luhaah laanee lii kpa.
Naate waa tae laanee dɛ́ do kɛ he jaa, o sɔne Nemenɛ Korowii.
Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ laanee he Lɛɛ, onee harɛ nɔ bwa Dɔɔ.
He do kɛŋɔ bitolo o jaa aa vɛoh aa we o nɛɛ kohona.” Kɛ Korowii yerɛ ŋɔ he ba o be, dɛ ŋɔ, “Tamaa kenii n ɡele, kɛ n tea ɛɛ domɛ he nɛɛ kohona, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne.
Bandia kohonaa ɡela n laa sie kpɔ he nɛɛ tama, kɛ n nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe nomanta, mɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛɛ.
Men Korowii maa ɛ he Lɛɛ bola.
A do kɛŋɔ Nowa ber saŋ ken n be, ɡɛ maa ŋwɛɛra kɛ maa ɡel nee su bɔle harɛ bwa kpa la.
Gɛɛ taraken mɛɛ ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ n baah aa he nɛɛ di ń tɛr he deŋne kpa.
Hale bwejena jiɡro le a buɡ ta, asɛ deŋɡarere chuɡri aa, n nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la te ɛɛ do lee, n ne he deŋnesɔɔhna fɔo la ɡe aa jaɡa dɔe ba bwa.
Men Korowii maa dɔ tedoma tɛɛ laanee bola.
Jerusalam, wahala bwɛjen peuchɔɡa aa taa dɛ chɔɡe, nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ larawe he bwara, mɛɛ kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ́ berɛ kwaa mae.
Mɛɛ kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa soo siwi baa yera rubii ma he dejaŋa.
He doonyoo ɡberjena ne danjwɛɛre ɡe, anɔ la aa dɛ nyɛɡle ne anɔ la aa jaa bwa nee mɛɛ ba a ɛɛ.
Men Korowiirii dɛ́ baɡle he bii wa, dɛ́ ɡel a chiɡ ba kɛrɛdɛ, bá dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna.
Waa aa toɡra taa aa ba cheɡa he won che kɛrɛdɛ, he ne nyubinikpeɡ tena baah ɛɛ do jaŋnee, komɛlbwa toole he ɔmɛ.
Nomɛlbwa nyini naɡra aa, n be laa a le.
Bɛlbwa waa kpɔ yoi ba pui la aa hen wo.
Menee ta loɡre, o yon kpɔ nii do hɔla ta dɛ́ lɔa a hɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ buni do dɛ́ loɡɛ dɔmkwa.
Menee ta laa tena ɡe, ba kpɔ dɔmkwaa yo dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa.
Dɔmkon bɛlbwa toole bá won kpɔ che he nɛɛ á maɡre.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ waa dawɛ he nɛɛ la, wɛɛ di bolchɔɡee.
Mɛɛ che n bonɔɔna habɔɔ, bá di bole ba dɔma nɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Korowii dɛ yerɛ nɛra nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo ba Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé banɔ la nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo heyaa la, nee lole, hé ba nyɔ!
He ta suuɡa dɔe yaa, hé ba, hɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa di pɛɛpɛɛ!
Sen ne na-elnee lole, suuɡa ne laa baa yawa, yoɡ ɡe toole a ta!
Bɔkwa waa hɛɛ chɔɡ suuɡa kwaa aa wola kondikwaa ɛɛ ta, dɛɛ koh kwaa aa wola vaɡɛ ta nɔɔ?
Hé cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ no waa maa dɛ baɡle heya, ásɛ dɛ dɔ kondikondɛɛɡa di.
Hé cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ ba n be, hé no n be, ásɛ dɛ dɔ mkpa.
N ne hɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee o do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, ɡɛ maa baɡɛ Devid nyoa ŋɔ, mɛɛ dɛɛ nyin o waa kasinteŋ nee la.
Menee ɛo harɛre nɛra sitɔɔ ne nomoa, ásɛ a che o nɛɛ ń baɡle n kpeɡri.
Kpelaa, hɛɛ yerɛ harɛre nɛra baa wola hen jemɛɛ, bá ba he be, harɛre nɛra haa wola ban jemɛ ɡe ɛɛ chwao ba he be.
Men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ haa dɛ tom mɛ nomanta, baa ba he bee, jirima maa ɡela he dɔ la wa.” Hé nyin Korowii bɔr saŋ haa nao nɔ ta, hé yerɔ, taraken waa bɛne heyaa nɔ.
Nɛnchɔɡe ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ, dɛ́ charɛ o liire, dɛ́ berɛ ba Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ be.
O dɛ sune nɛn nɛ, dɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ o bambile bwa ne.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Waa haa dɛ lii laa mɛɛ lii, he we-ɛɛla dɔŋa laa mɛɛ ɛ. Gɛ harɛ ne nyundua baah aa jaŋa la, ɡɛɛ n we-ɛɛla ne n liire ɡwaa he kwa.
N waa la do kɛ bwaala ne mɛn yon le nyundua dɛ pweh harɛ la ken.
A ɡelɔ kwaa baa dua won ɛɛ, nɛra dɔ kondikwaa di, dɛ́ dɔ a dwee ɡe du.
Gɛɛ waa aa le n nyoa ɛɛ ba ɛɛ.
Maa bol á berɛ ba n be pɛɛpɛɛ, nemenɛ waa maa dɛ nyin la bwa aa ɛa ka tonɛ.
Silɛɛ nee hɛɛ ba Babelɔn lee, bosɔɔhna nee baa ba he sie tɔe le he ne bwɛjen la ta.
Bwejena ne deŋɡarere bwa ɛɛ nao dɛɛ ɡo yela, daa bwa ɡe lɔ kpaŋa.
Bela sɔɔhne aa lole la, dajaŋa ɛɛ le a buɡ taa, ásɛ jabalnadaŋɛre le dadɛɛɡa buɡ ta.
Gɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ɡeloo Korowii dɔ sɔn kohona, dɛ́ chɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ lii waa men Korowii aa ɛa.”
Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ jao ɛ Korowii nɛra Korowii ŋɔ o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ bol waa aŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra.
Lɛɛ maa dɛ ba ba lɛ heyaa la telo.
Nɛra ɛɛ nao ɡɛ n waa aa toɡra.
Naate waa dɛ ɛ waa nɔ dɛ lawa kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ di Ona Tɔpere waa wola on chɔɡ, dɛ lawɛ o te waa wola wechɔɡa ɛ la, o na som.” Dɛ nɛŋhɔɔh kpɔ o te ja Korowii nɛra nɛɛ aa, o bɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii aa men lɛ ja o nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ nɛ.” Nomɛlbwa baa fɔɡɛ o lur ɡe bɛ ŋɔ, “N te heo.” Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol ɡɛ nɛra la be laanee kɛŋɔ, “Dɛ nɛra baa fɔɡɛ ba lure dɛ di n Ona Tɔpere la, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ su n siwi, dɛɛ di kasinteŋ n fɔo la ta naa, baa dɔ komɛl waa ɡwaa bibaala ne bihaahnaa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba sɔn ka n Dea, dɛ́ do le saŋ bɛlbwa, bá kpɔ dɛɛ liiru.” Korowii ŋɔ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa kpɔ ba te ba pɛlo, asɛ dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ nyinu dɛɛ yerɛ o sɔn, dɛɛ di Ona Tɔpere baa wola on chɔɡ, dɛ lawɛ o fɔo la bini kiŋkiŋ la be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ la he ne Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ taa, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa silɛɛ n soŋebɔr bela.
N siwi ɛɛ su kwaa baa fuah ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ n saraha kon ta laanee dɛ́ lɛa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa yerɛ n Dea Korowii soŋebɔree tɛ harɛre nɛra bwa.” Nemenɛ Korowii waa tɔ Israel tena sie dɛ le ba ne bojaŋ harɛfale ta la ŋɔ, “N ta ɛɛ ba bane ɡe nee, ba ba ja ba nɛ.” Korowii pwah Israel nomonome Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra haa ɛ he te kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini ola, hé ba dɛ́ ba chɔɡ n nɛra Israel tena.
Nomonome baa ɛ sitɔɔla dɛɛ daah n nɛra Israel tena la, ba do kɛŋɔ nyoŋa ken, baa waa mun no.
Ba do kɛŋɔ nyootena aa wola won wor dɛ chɔ dɛɛ dee ɡbo, dɛɛ nyin chɔe.
Ba do kɛŋɔ nyootena aa dɛ di kwaa kohona aa wola vaɡɛ bwa.
Ba do kɛ peteɡra baa wola waa mun no.
Bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ anɔ la aa dɛ su o siwi, ne waa aa le tɔnɔ tɛo.
Ba yon ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel ya nyin sen nyɔ!
Hé ɡel ya nyɔ seŋkpeɡa dɛ́ dɛɛ.
Ásɛ kere ɡe yá ɛ ɡɛ ja, á ɡwaa fini kwara.’ ”
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ́ serewe, dɛ nomɛlbwa waane laa, hale nomɛlbwa aa a mun jemɛ.
Ba serewaa, wenaale bɛlbwa aa ba nɛɛ ba kpa.
Nɛra baa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa la, ba serewaa, ba dɛ chɔ sɔnɔnɔɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Kɛ heya, sɔmmɔra bii, nɛra baa dɛ chɔɡ yal ne jwamane tena bii, hé ba bonɔ!
Ume loroo hɛɛ di nɔɔ?
Ume baahnee hɛɛ muɡli dɛɛ mile he nyoo o nɛɛ nɔɔ?
Deŋnekpeɡ tena naanar ne nyosonteŋna dwee laa heyaa?
Hé liire bwaa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ di sɛm he voɡa dajena mune.
Hé dɛ kpoo he bii dɛɛ ɛ sarahare voɡa aa lɔ bwebɔɔne aa bɛne nenabɔɔne ta.
Bwea aa bwara aa loɡaa, he kpɔ le nenabɔɔne ta ɛ voɡa dɛɛ toma.
Anee he wee sen saraha dɛɛ tɛa, dɛɛ tɛa mea saraha ɡe.
Anɔ nɔ bwa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ, n sie lɛ a ta naa?
Bwejena doree he la dɛ ka kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha, dɛɛ di sɛm.
Hale he kpɔ he voɡa cheɡ he deremi dɛ tɔ ɡbeni a ta.
He chwa mɛ, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa, a do kɛŋɔ he ne aa dɛ chɔ mpa ta dɛɛ di sɛm ken.
He bambile lawa taeh, he yoɡ he te tɛa he ne a pɛ dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa.
He dɛ fɔɡle ɔleve noo ne nosɔɔhsoma kohona dɛ kaa tomɛ he voɡ Molɛk.
He tomɛ nɛra bojaŋ, hale lalabwɛ dɛɛ nyin voɡfala.
He chwao ti voɡa dɛ koh, kɛ dɛ vɛh ɡela.
He berɔ kwaa dɔ bokpeɡfala dɛɛ nyin voɡfala, haa ɡwɛɡre.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa tenee voɡa hɛɛ ɔma kohona dɛ le n habɔɔ, dɛ soh n waa kwaraa ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Maa mwaa he bwa ne saŋ la bwa, waa ɡela haa wola men ɔmɛ nɔ kɛɛ?
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ anɔ la haa dɛ ɛ la toɡrɔ, kɛ mɛɛ le he mun nee waa haa dɛ ɛ ta.
He voɡa aa tɔnɔ bɛlbwaa dɔ tɛ heya.
Dɛ waane pu heya aa, hé do lɔŋɔ tɛ he voɡdamanta la, á ba lɛ heya.
Peu bɛlbwa ɛɛ won che a bwa kaa.
Nyoa peu kwaraa ɛɛ won kpɔa kaa.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te dawɛ n nɛɛ la te ɛɛ so harɛ la taa, dɛ́ tom mɛ N Dea Jerusalam.” Nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te bolarawa Korowii ŋɔ, “Kwaa ŋwɛnɛ, kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ n nɛra bá ba!
Laa komɛlbwa waa tɔ bɔr la kpɔ ta.
Menee dɔ sɔn dɛ ɡwaa komɛlbwa dɛ do ɡoroŋ, dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa.
N soɡe n kookara waa daŋa ta boɡoroŋ nyundua, dɛ berɛ so nɛra ba tea bini aa chɔɡa ba wechɔɡa wa.
Ba pwɛr ba te baah ta, dɛ́ ɡel ba sie sɔɔh, bá dɔ hwɛɡa ja.
Maa teŋɛ dɛ kpɔ waa dawɛ n nɛra nɛ, kɛɛ n baah di ba nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, ba bwara ɛɛ hwaoh n sie.
Menee ta ba, dɛ tɛɛ ba mkpa.
Ba wechɔɡa ne ba sibeɡra waa nomanta, n baah fa di ba nɛɛ taeh, asɛ n tɛr ba deŋne dɛ laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ.
Kɛ ane a bwa ba deŋne kpeɡri, dɛɛ ɛ waa ba bambile aa lawa.
N jemɛ ɡɛ ba wechɔɡa ɛɛ aa chɔɡ ba kɛŋɔ weela, kɛ mɛɛ chaah baa, dɛ́ tɔ ba sie, dɛ́ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ́ larawe banɔ la baa dɛ wi bwara, ásɛ Israel tena wii berɛ kpɛɛra.
Banɔ la baa lɔ bojaŋa ne sie bonɔ la, mɛɛ tɛɛ baa deŋnesɔɔhna tentenee, mɛɛ chaah baa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra te do kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma aa wola won bobeŋkpoŋ che, dɛ yon che doŋa bwa soo siwi baa ta la ken.
Deŋnesɔɔhna toole tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.” Korowiirii bola.
Nyoa vɔwa tenten Korowii ŋɔ, “Kpɔ takpeɡ bol wa, bɛ hel!
Gel he taa le kohona kɛŋɔ bɛla!
Ŋɔ n nɛra Israel tena be ba deŋnekpeɡ ne ba wechɔɡa baa ɛɛ mɛ la wa.
Ba dɛ tom mɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ nyin n ŋwɛnɛre dɛ jemɛ, dɛɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ ba waa toɡrɔ, á do kɛŋɔ ba ta Korowii Mmarare vɛɛh.
Ba dɛ soŋe waa aa toɡra n be, dɛɛ nyin kɛ n bɛn ba.” Ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ ya vɔwɛ nyoa Korowii aa wola na, dɛɛ pwɛr ya te waa wola jemɛ nɔɔ?” Korowii ŋɔ, “Haa vɔwɛ nyoa la, he ɡbo nɛɛ he sie lɛ dɛ yon dɛɛ ɛ he tom-ɛɛra hɔhɔrɔwa.
He nyoa vɔwa habɔɔ he ɡarɔ dɛɛ yo.
He dɛ lɔɔ dɔŋa nɔŋɡuŋe ne.
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ɡɛ nɔɔ dɛ́ ɡel n no he wesoŋa kɛɛ?
Kenii hɛɛ yerɛ nyoa vɔwa nɔ naa?
He kpɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ dɛ pwɛr he te, kɛɛ he ɡure nyu su kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ, dɛ kpɔ lweyale tɔ dɛ so tɔɔ ta naa, dɛ anee nyoa vɔwa aa?
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ men Korowii sie dɛ lɛ ɡɛ ta kɛɛ?
Nyoa vɔwa maa dɛ nyin laanee kɛŋɔ, hé foo nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba do ba dea la ta.
Hé lɛ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba ásɛ ba dɔ ba te.
Ane ɡee kɛŋɔ, dɛ lɔr dɛ kpo nomɛl aa, tɛo kwaa ó di.
Nomɛl nyao, o ta bɔr dɔe dɛ́ chɔ aa, kpɔɔ kaa he dem.
Dɛ nomɛl ɡe ta yal dɔe dɛ́ tɔ aa, tɛo bɛl, ásɛ dɛ bɛ sie laa kpɔ he lolanar ɡe nɛ.
Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela n sie lɛ he nɛ, ásɛ he chaah kɛŋɔ wechɛn ken, ásɛ he weela bwa kaa warane, he wedɛɛɡa tɔ he sie, ásɛ n jirima tɔ he nɛ.
Asɛ name dɛ he soŋ mɛ naa ń no, he do lɔŋɔ yer mɛ naa, ń sɛh ŋɔ, ‘Men nɔ.’ Dɛ he ɡel nɛra hɔhɔrɔwa ɛɛ, dɛ ɡel waa kpɔe dɛ daɡ ba, dɛ ɡel wobochɔɡa bola, dɛ tɛ nɛn waa chɔ lɔr kondikwa, dɛ tɛ nɛn waa dɛ na wahala o konnyini aa, ate, biro ɛɛ berɛ bochaahnee tɛ heya.
Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa, anee dɛ́ ɡel men Korowii baɡle heya ŋwɛnɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛ́ berɛ tɛ heya kondɛɛɡa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta he di, dɛ́ do kpeɡri.
Dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he do kɛŋɔ bodɛɛɡe haa du daa sɔn do o ta saŋ bɛlbwa ken, kɛɛ bule waa wola hweeh bwa la.
Ásɛ he nɛra won berɛ kwaa vɔrɔwe saŋ la bwɛɛre aa paɡra, dɛ berɛ dimɡbeeni la cheɡ a buɡ ta.
Baa yerɛ heyaa nɛra haa won danjwɛɛre aa kuuɡa kwaaraa, ne nɛra haa won deene aa choɡla mae.” Ona Tɔpere dii kembɔr Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he nyiŋi Ona Tɔpere la ta o do ɡoroŋ tɛ heya, he ta he ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla ɛɛ, dɛ liiru kɛŋɔ o ɛ men Korowii tɔpere baa dɛ onɛ o ta, haa wola kpɔe valɛ he ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛ, kɛɛ dɛ ɛ he toma dɛ bol wobochɔɡa aa, ate, mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ silɛɛ toma haa dɛ tom mɛ la wa.
Mɛɛ berɔ ɡel he dɔ duure harɛ ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ́ berɛ na som harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ he nabaa Jekɔb la ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Korowii keame bol nɛra wechɔɡa wa He bɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii aa kpeɡe dɛ́ lɛ heya, kɛɛ o deŋna tɔɔɡɔ waa wola yera haa dɛ yerɔ la no.
He wechɔɡaa tɔ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ, a do kɛ waa he be no la, anee pere he ne o baah he dɛ soŋo waa, waa wola chaŋe, dɛ kpɔ o te dɛɛ sɔh heyaa la.
Nɛŋkpoa ne wedoŋa ɡboo su he bwa.
Waa aa dɛ le he nyoo ɛ nyosone, hɛɛ lii nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla.
Nomɛlbwa ta kasinteŋ ta cheɡɛɛ dɛ kpɔ o dɔŋ la kɔɔto bwa.
Nyosone ɡbo taa he che dɛɛ di bole.
He dɛ vɔrɔwe vɔrɔwa dɛ́ chɔɡ bane.
He liire ne he we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ domkpule hala ne ŋwandare yal ken.
Nomɛlbwa waa di a hala la, wɛɛ sewɔɔ.
Haa won kpɔ ŋwandare yal tɔ kɛŋɔ yal.
He we-ɛɛla ɛ dichɔɡa ɡbo, dɛ ɛ naɡrenyine ɡe.
He ɡbaŋre wechɔɡa ɛɛ ne nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ kpoe ta.
Wechɔɡa lɛ he liire bwa, dɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa bobɛlbwa haa dɛ la.
Deŋnesɔɔhna ŋwɛnɛ te, haa an jemɛ.
Kasinteŋ ɡe toole he waa bini.
He we-ɛɛla bwa ɡolo, a ɡel nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ a ta aa deŋnesɔɔhna waa jemɛ.
Nɛra la bol ba wechɔɡa Ate, nɛra la ŋɔ, “Ya ne kasinteŋ baah jaŋne, ya waa ɡe ta toɡrɛ.
Ya dɛ nyin bochaah ta dɛ́ valɛ, kɛ biro tenten ɡboo ya na, dɛɛ laɡre bɔr bobɛlbwa, kɛŋɔ nyoŋa aa dɛ ɡaaɡe.
Ya won naa lɔe webaŋa kɛŋɔ jwaana, weera bini la, ya do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa.
Ɔmee chole ya nɛɛ ya wi dɛɛ di suna.
Ya dɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ, Korowii ba lɛ yaa le nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi yaa nɔn ta, kɛ yaa wobɛlbwa na.
N Naa Korowii, ya wechɔɡa kan kohona he sie, ya wechɔɡa ɡba di danseɛ.
Ya jemɛ ya wechɔɡa bwa.
Ya ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoe, dɛ vɛh he nɛɛ teŋa.
Ya fiiɡi ya dɔŋa dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoe.
Ya liire ne ya wobol bwa ɛ nyosone.
Waa aa ɛ kpela ne waa aa toɡra kaa bojaŋ, a do kɛŋɔ kasinteŋ toole kpa ken.
Anomanta, kasinteŋ tonɔ, dɛ ɡel nɛra baa laa ba te dɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ta la, nɛra berɛ hah ba.” Korowii na ɡɛ, asɛ o sie ta lɛɛ kɛŋɔ kasinteŋ aa wola toole la.
O nyoa kpoo kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ cha nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba, anomanta, wɛɛ che o ɡbaɡba kpeɡrii taa dɛ́ lɛɛ ba.
O kpɔ waa aa toɡra ɛ laa batakaare, dɛ kpɔ lɛɛ waa lɛ heyaa la ɛ buni ɡbɛrɛ pi.
Dɛ ta tea kohona kpɔ deŋnetɛra waa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba bɔ nɛra kem la berɛ yal, dɛ kpɔ tɔ.
Korowii baah ɛɛ di o dɔma nɛɛ ɡɛ baa ɛa la wa, hale banɔ la baa lɔ bojaŋ harɛre ta bwa.
Le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr, nɛra ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔ jirima tɛo.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ wɛɛ bao kɛŋɔ nepale ne peu a nyoa aa kpeɡa.
Korowii ŋɔ o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ba Saayɔnee dɛ́ ba lɛ he banɔ la haa charɛ liire le he wechɔɡa ta bwa.
Fɔo n ne haa fɔwɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, ń tɛ he ne he bii ne he naanar n Doma ne n webaɡla, á chɔ le tɛ heyaa saŋ bɛlbwa.”
Jerusalam jirima dɔe kerekere Jerusalam, ir dɛ́ chaah kɛŋɔ wee!
Korowii jirima dɛ chaah he nɛ!
Na, biro tenten dɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta nɛra nɛɛ tɔe, kɛ he te, Korowii jirima ɛɛ chaah he nɛɛ.
Harɛre nɛra ne koranar bwa ɛɛ ba he bochaah la taa.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Ha sie dɛ́ nyiŋi bar, he nɛra bwa chemo dɛɛ ba he be.
He bibaala le bojaŋa harɛre ta dɛɛ ba, ba kpɔ he bihaahna chwaa dɛɛ ba.
Hɛɛ na ɡɛɛ he hɛɡra ir, he tea ɡe too.
Ba dɛ ba harɛre kondɔɔh ne dɛ́ ba tɛɛ.
Mpo baŋ le kwaa bwa ɛɛ bao.
Baa ba nyoɡmare nee kohona, dɛ́ ba perɛ harɛ nɔ bwa.
Midian ne Efa harɛre taa aa ba lee.
Seeba tena ɛɛ ba suuɡaswɛm ne daawiile nee, dɛɛ kpɛɛ men Korowii.
Baa kpɔ Keda peera bwaa ba tɛ heya, Nɛbayɔt pebala ɡe ɛɛ he kwaa, ásɛ he kpoora saraha kon ta tɛ men Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ jirima ba n Dea.
Stiimaere besoo pɛa dɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ baama, kɛɛ kulukukure aa dɛ ba a kɔne ta nɔɔ?
A ɛ stiimaere aa le bojaŋa dɛ kpɔ n nɛra dɛɛ ba dem.
Ba cheɡɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm dɛɛ ba, dɛ kpɔ jirima dɛɛ ba ba tɛ men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ waa ɡela harɛre nɛra kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ o nɛra la.” Korowii ŋɔ Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, “Nɛŋhɔɔhraa dɛ́ berɛ ba kwaa ma he bwɛjen nɔ danjwɛɛre, ásɛ ba koranar ɛɛ tomɛ heya.
N baahnee fa dia n tɛr he deŋne.
Taraken te, mɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ heya, dɛ́ sune he nɛ.
He doonyoone ɛɛ yao che saŋ bɛlbwa chɔɔ ne jwaana, aa wola tɔ kpa bwa, ásɛ harɛre koranar tɔ ba nɛra sie, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kondɔɔh jo he be.
Harɛre nɛra baa ŋɔa baa heyaa tomɛ la, ba harɛre ɛɛ paɡroo dɛ́ chɔɡ kwara.
Baa che Lɛbanɔn kɔr dadɛɛɡa ne ba dajaŋa bwa soo siwii dɛ́ ba kwaa n Dea maa lɔ o bini nɔ ne n bwɛjen la á do wer.
Nɛra ba fa aa ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa naanar ne banɔ la ba fa aa hah he ya, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyubaah ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi he siee.
Baa yerɛ he bwɛɛ Korowii Bwɛjen, Saayɔn, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la Bwɛ.
Jerusalam, ba fa haeh dɛ vɛɛh, nomɛlbwa aa he ta kpɔ.
Kɛ mɛɛ ɛɛ he do wer kɛŋɔ, bwɛjen waa soma tɛ nɛra saŋ te bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Harɛre nɛra ne koranar ɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, haah aa dɛ ɔr o bie, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii he Lɛɛ, menee Korowii, Jekɔb Kpeɡnɛn waa tomɔ la.
Mɛɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛmee chiɡ ayaawa naa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡapoŋ chiɡ buni naa ta, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ ayaawa chiɡ daa naa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ buni chiɡ bwea naa ta tɛɛ.
He koranar aa he nɛraa fiiɡi kpa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo baa nyiŋi he nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
Haa yoi ɡbɔɡaa no he harɛ ta kpa, wobɛlbwa aa chɔɡ he harɛ ta kpa bwa.
Mɛɛ tɔe ɡbemɡbee kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ ken dɛ́ lɛɛ, ásɛ he kpɛɛ mɛ, lɛɛ maa lɛɛ ta la wa.
Haa wee nyin kɛ tɔɔ peraa, o chaah tɛɛ kpa.
Haa korobie ɡee nyin kɛ o chaah tɛɛ jwaana ɡe.
Men Korowiirii dɛɛ ba he nɛɛ chaahna saŋ bɛlbwa, n jirima do he nɛ.
Wahala haa dɛ na bwa ɛɛ ba a jaɡaa.
Men Korowiirii dɛɛ ba he nɛɛ chaahna kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie saŋ bɛlbwa.
He nɛra bwa wa ɛɛ toɡroo, harɛ la ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa.
Baa doo kɛŋɔ daa maa duu o pamɛ le o lur ta ken.
Men ta ba, ásɛ baa baɡle n jirima.
Banɔ la baa wola kanɛ la, baa warɔ dɛ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ harɛjen nɛra.
Mɛɛ ɛa waranee saŋ waa wera ta.
Menee Korowii.”
Amanesoma aa dɛ ba ba lɛ nɛra Nemenɛ Korowii Doma la ir n nɛ, dɛ lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol Amanesoma baɡle nyaara, dɛ́ larawe nɛra ba bambile aa chɔɡa bwara, dɛ́ ŋɔ nɛra baa laɡ ba yoma, ne nɛra baa do ba dea be ŋɔ ba lɛɛ balɔ.
O tom mɛ ń ɡel nɛra bwa jemɛ kɛ tɔpere Korowii aa dɛ ba o nɛra lɛɛ dɛ́ tɛr ba dɔma deŋne telo, dɛ́ larawe nɛra bwa baa dɛ wi bwara.
O tom mɛ ń larawe Jerusalam tena ba bambile aa chɔɡa baa wi la bwara, ásɛ ba dɔ silɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel wii, dɛ́ ɡo kpɛɛra yela, dɛ́ ɡel suna dii.
Baa ɛo kɛŋɔ daa Korowii ɡbaɡba aa dua.
Baa dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡraa, ásɛ ba kpɛɛro o waa waa ɛa wa.
Baa berɔ kwaa vɔrɔwe saŋ la bwɛjena aa paɡra la.
Bwɛɛre aa berɛ dimɡbia dɛ chɔ le saŋ la ba tel fini bwa.
Nɛŋhɔɔhra ɛɛ tomɛ heyaa, dɛɛ teɡɛ he peera, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ parɛ he kooni dɛɛ nyiŋi he daa kooni ta.
Baa yerɛ heyaa Korowii sɔforee, ne Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la bonɔɔna.
Harɛre nɛra kondɔɔh ɛɛ ɛ he kwaa, ásɛ he koh a waa dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo.
He sihiih ne ncho haa dia bwa tonɔ.
Hɛɛ so he ɡbaɡba harɛ taa ásɛ he kondɔɔh warɛ kohona, he silɛɛ aa jaɡaa dɔ.
Korowii ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin waa bola dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, n kii ŋwɛɛ ne wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛ n nɛra kembɔree kasinteŋ ta, n ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo, o do le saŋ bɛlbwa.
Ba sɔn ɛɛ leo harɛre nɛra bwa bini, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa na ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ banee n swee andɛɛɡa tɛ.” N dɛ hɛɡre kohona waa Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa ɛa nɔ wa.
O kpɔ laala ne waa aa toɡra ɛ batakaare do mɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.
N wer kɛŋɔ hanfale ne o jaa aa kpɔ ba te kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ kaa ba cheremibɔr ken.
Gɛ konduuli yon pere harɛ dɛ le, dɛ kpeɡ la, ɡɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba o nɛra lɛɛ, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa kpɛɛro.
Jerusalam sɔnfale dɔe Mɛɛ bol waa dɛ do Saayɔn tena ɡbemba.
Jerusalam nomanta, maa nyoa tɔ, ka tel kɛŋɔ maa pɔ he nɛra dɔma nɛ.
Toɡra baa toɡra la ɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔ silɛɛ kɛŋɔ, kapɛla aa dɛ hɔ jwaana ken.
Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ na Jerusalam ne o nɛra toɡra baa toɡra, ba koranar bwa ɡe na he jirima.
Korowii ɡbabir ɛɛ tɛɛ sɔnfalee.
Hɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ kooɡbɛrɛ waa wera kɛrɛdɛ tɛ Korowii.
Baa hen ‘Bwɛɛ baa ɡelo’, kɛɛ he harɛ ‘Dimɡbia’ yerɛ kpa.
Sɔnfale baa dɛ ba he yera laanee ‘Hɛpseba’ dɛɛ yerɛ he harɛ ɡe ‘Biula’ dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii sie lɛ he nɛ, ásɛ o do kɛŋɔ jaa tɛ he harɛ.
Gɛ bonɔmbii yon nyin bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ dɛ lawɔ hanfale la, ɡɛɛ Korowii waa tae ɛɛ ba he jaa ɛɛ.
Gɛɛ Korowii sie ɛɛ ba he nɛɛ lɛɛ, kɛŋɔ baa sie yon lɛ o hanfale nɛɛ la.
Jerusalam, n kpɔ nɛra ba so he danjwɛɛre ta baa daahne.
Baa nyoa tɔ webaŋa ne jwaana bwa.
Baa lii Korowii o nyobaɡa la waa, ásɛ o bɛ he waa soh.
Baa ɡel Korowii onɛ bwa ka tel kɛŋɔ, waa bera kwaa vɔrɔwe hen Jerusalam.
Wɛɛ ɛɛ bwɛjen nɛra bwa kpɛɛre harɛ nɔ ta.
Korowii baɡɛ nyoa, dɛɛ ba ɡela a che o kpeɡri ta ɛ ɡɛ.
O ŋɔ, “Maa ɡel he dɔma dɔ he mea di kpa, nɛŋhɔɔhra ɡe aa he senee dɔ nyɔ kpa.
He banɔ la haa du mea dɛ koma laanee dɛɛ ba a dii, dɛ́ kpɛɛ men Korowii.
He banɔ la haa pa ɡrepo nɔna laanee dɛɛ ba a sen nyɔe n Dea dembaahna.” Jerusalam tena, hé le kaa, dɛ́ ka kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ he nɛra baa bera dɛɛ ba la!
Hé laa bwea aa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ la ta la pa, ó do wer!
Hé kpɔ fraŋkaa pa ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra jemɛ.
Korowii bol waa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa be ŋɔ, “Saayɔn tena, he na ɡɛ he Lɛɛ aa dɛ ba!
O kpoŋe o kembɔr, o ne nɛra waa lɛɛ ba dɛɛ ba.” Baa yer baa ‘Korowii Nɛra Baa Do Goroŋ’, ne ‘Nɛra Korowii Aa Lɛɛ Ba’.
Baa yerɛ Jerusalam ɡee, ‘Bwɛjen Korowii Aa Dɛ Nyin’, ne ‘Bwɛjen Korowii Aa Wola On Vɛɛh’.
Korowii yo harɛre nɛra dɛ pɔ ba nɛ “Umee le bwɛjen Bosra waa lɔ Edom harɛ ta dɛɛ ba nɔɔ?
Umee ka dɛ ba dɛ tɔ yaswɛɛma dɛɛ ba kpeɡri ne bokpeɡa ta ken?” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Menee, n dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won lɛ heya n dɛ ba dɛ́ ba bol yoi maa yoa dɛ pɔ wechɔɡa nɛɛ wa.” “Bɔkwaa ɡela he yal nɔ swɛɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna ta nɔɔ?” Korowii ŋɔ, “N tiɡri harɛre nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, baa tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna ta ken, nomɛlbwa ta men ba chae.
Bandia nee n tiɡri ba nɛ, asɛ ba chal ɛ n yal bwa la.
N liiro kɛŋɔ saŋ maa lɛ n nɛra la telo, kɛŋɔ n tɛr ba dɔma deŋne bɔ kem.
A ɛɛ mɛ nyokpoa kɛŋɔ, maa nyiŋa n ta nomɛlbwa nae ó ba cha mɛ.
N bandia ɡelɔ n dɔ bokpeɡa dɛ won yo dɛ pɔ n dɔma nɛ.
Bandia nee n tiɡri harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, dɛ fuɡe ba chal ta harɛ.” Kpɛɛra ne wesoŋa Mɛɛ bol Korowii nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe la waa.
Mɛɛ kpɛɛro waa bwa waa ɛa tɛ yaa la wa.
O nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe ne tedoma waa dɔa nomanta, o swee andɛɛɡa tɛ ya Israel tena.
Korowii ŋɔ, “N nɛraa ban, baa men neɡre.” A waa o lɛɛ ba le ba wenaale ta la.
Nyundua torome laa lɛɛ ba le ba wahala ta, Korowii ɡbabirii lɛɛ ba.
Nyina ne tedoma waa dɔa tɛɛ ba waa o lɛɛ ba.
O nyiŋi ba nɛɛ le saŋ la bwa.
Ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ o nɛɛ dɛ ɡel Korowii Domadɛɛɡe tea bini chɔɡ.
Anomanta, Korowii berɛ ba dɔm dɛ yoo ba.
Anee ba berɛ lii waa aa chiɡa, Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis saŋ la, asɛ dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii waa lɛ o nɛra ne ba sitɔɔla le mpo ta la dɔɔ taraken nɔ?
Korowii waa kpɔ o Doma tɛ Mosis la sɛ?
Korowii aa cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛ ɡel Mosis ɛ wejena mpo teŋe la, o lɛ sɔn waa wola jaɡa dɔe.
O nɛra kpɔ bela o fea luŋa dɛ ɡale.
Mosis cheɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ ba ɡale kɛŋɔ jaɡre a siwi aa beɡra aa chwa aa wola naa lɔ la.” Gɛ ba yon teɡɛ nae kaa deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta a yon ka onɛ la, ɡɛɛ Korowii tɛ o nɛra ona.
O tɔ o nɛra sie o sɔn dɔ jirima.
N Naa Korowii, ba sie ne harɛ le nyundua boɡoroŋ bela haa soɡa ne jirima haa dɔa dɛ́ nyiŋi yaa.
Leperaa nyina he fa aa dɛ nyin ya waa la dɔɔ?
Leperaa he kpeɡri la dɔɔ?
He nyina ne he tedoma la sɛ?
Bɛ yaa ta.
Dɛ ya nabaa Abraham ne Jekɔb ŋɔ baa yaa jemɛ kwaraa naa, he te aa yaa ta, henee ya mɛɛ.
N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ he ɡel ya kpaŋe ya laa sie kpɔ he ŋwɛnɛre ta nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he ɡel ya ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoe nɔɔ?
Koh banɔ la baa dɛ tomɛ ne banɔ la baa ɛ he nɛra la waa dɛ́ ba ya be.
He Dea waa do ɡoroŋ fa ɛ he nɛra kon saŋ bɛl, kɛ taraken ya dɔma kuuɡu, dɛ tiɡru do harɛ.
Ya do kɛŋɔ nɛra he fa aa wola ya nɛɛ nyiŋe ka, kɛɛ ya ta he nɛra ɛɛ ken.
N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ haa wola nyundua pere dɛ́ ba harɛ nɔ?
Bwejena fe ɛɛ nae dɛ́ ɔmɛ, dɛ́ yiiɡi.
Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ nee yon chɔŋɛ nii ta dɛɛ wure chachacha la.
Ba dɛ́ ba baɡle he dɔma he kpeɡri, dɛ́ ɡel harɛre nɛra bwara chel he siwi ta!
He fa ɛ ɔmewaa kohona ya fa aa wola a waa liire, bwejena jiɡri he siwi ta.
Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole ba nao o do kɛ hen Korowii, kɛɛ dɛ no wejena haa ɛa tɛ nɛra baa dɔ hwɛɡa he nɛ.
He dɛ lɛ banɔ la baa kpɔ silɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra, ne ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ baa ɛ.
He bandia kohona habɔɔ, ya ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa le saŋ la bwa.
Ya bwa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ kah doŋa, ya wedɛɛɡa kwaraa do kɛŋɔ yakwara waa chɔ puldoa ken.
A ɡelɔ ya do kɛŋɔ papooni aa hola, peu ta dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ kaa la ken.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛɛ soŋe, nomɛlbwa aa nyin kɛŋɔ he chao.
He kpɔ he te sɔh yaa, dɛ koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ ta yaa.
N Naa Korowii, ya mɛɛ hen, ya do kɛŋɔ choh, asɛ henee mamaa.
Henee ta ya bwa.
Bɛ ɡel he baah di ya nɛɛ kohona, bɛ ya wechɔɡa waa kpɔ do he nyu bini saŋ bɛlbwa.
He nɛraa yaa, na ya sum.
He bwɛjena la berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, Jerusalam berɛ dimɡbia.
He Dea waa do ɡoroŋ dɛ do wer tɛ yaa ya naawa fa aa kpɛɛre o bini la, nii fuuh.
Bɔra ya sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta bwa kuuɡo dɛ berɛ dimɡbeeni.
N Naa Korowii, dɛ he na anɔ bwa ken aa, hɛɛ soo nyiŋi dɛ́ ɡel ya na waa a ɡwaa yaa nɛɛ kohona naa?
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr deŋnekpeɡ tena deŋnee Korowii ŋɔ, “N kpɔ n te baɡle nɛra baa wola n waa bɔɔrɛ, kɛ nɛra baa wola n bɔr ɡaaɡɛ laanee na mɛ.
N yerɛ harɛ o nɛra aa wola men tomɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Menee nɔ.
Menee nɔ.’ Saŋ bɛlbwaa n paɡri n nɔɔra kɛŋɔ ń lɛ n nɛra ba deŋne aa kpeɡa, dɛɛ ɛ waa baa dɛ nyin.
Ba teŋɔ dɛɛ muɡli n baah, dɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ saraha voɡare ta, bodɛɛɡe baa du daa bini, dɛ fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛa.
Ba dɛ la bwebɔɔne bini ne lala huɡribɔr, dɛ ka yerɛ lala jwaana, dɛ́ ka so ŋwama ta dɛɛ were.
Ba dɛ chwe parakoo ola, dɛɛ di dɛɛ nyɔ ola baa kpoora tɛ voɡa dɔr, ne kwaa maa kia.
Ba yon ŋɔ ba bala be ŋɔ, ‘He laa he te kpɔ ya nɛ, ya do ɡoroŋ, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé leɡe yaa!’ N mee le ba nɛ, n bandia ɡe do ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, nii aa wola dime bwa ken.
N lii ɡɛ maa tɛr ba deŋne cheɡ, ba chwera bil n sie.
Maa sie laa kpɔ waa baa ɛa nɔ ta.
Mɛɛ bɔ ba a kemee, ba ne ba naawa bwa wechɔɡa baa ɛa wa.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba fuh daawiile voɡa ta deŋɡarere dor, dɛ chɛɡre mɛ bela.
Anomanta, mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee ɡɛ aa chɛa, ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛ le saŋ la bwa wa.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Gɛ nee aa lɔ ɡrepo nɔna sao ta ba yon ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ an chɔɡ, ba ta ɛɛ daa a ne senee’ la, ɡɛɛ maa wola n nɛra bwaa chɔɡ, mɛɛ lɛ banɔ la baa dɛ tom mɛɛ.
Mɛɛ swee Israel tena baa ɛ Juda dea tena andɛɛɡaa, ásɛ ba naanar so bwejena dor.
Nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te, baa tom mɛ laanee dɛɛ ba bela soɡa.
Sarɔn ɛɛ ɛ peera dibɔree, ásɛ Akɔ Fɛlembɔjen ɛ bela nae aa dɛ onɛ, dɛ́ tɛ n nɛra baa dɛ nyin mɛ bambile bwa ne.
He banɔ la haa berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ dɛ vɛh Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡ Gad ne voɡ Meni.
Aa ɛ nyokalaa tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ sewɛ laa taa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, n yerɛ heyaa he ta sɛɛh, dɛ bol waa he be he ta men chaŋɛ.
He kpɔ he ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ ɛ waa aa wola n siwi sui dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.” Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N bonɔɔna ɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa di dɛɛ nyɔ sen kohona, kɛ he te, lɔr ne nyɔɡre ɛɛ kpo heyaa taeh.
N bonɔɔna sie ɛɛ lɛo, kɛ he te ɛɛ di sihiih.
N bonɔɔna ɛɛ ɡo silɛɛ yelaa, kɛ he te ɛɛ wi lokua wii.
He sɔn ɛɛ berɛ tooh tɛ nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te laanee.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ kpoo heyaa, dɛ́ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ duu mɛ kɛrɛdɛ la sɔnfale.
Nomɛlbwa dɛ nyin kɛ o swee andɛɛɡa harɛ la ta naa, ó soŋe le men Kasinteŋ Korowii be.
Wahala aa lɔ he nɛɛ wubwa ɛɛ tonɔɔ, he soh a wa.” Nyundufale ne harɛfale wa Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ta nyundufale ne harɛfalee.
Haa webena a fa aa lole la waa lii kpa bwa.
Hé ɡel he sie lɛ hɛɛ hɛɡre saŋ bɛlbwa.
N dɛ ba Jerusalamfale ɛɛ o do som, ásɛ o nɛra sie ɛɛ lɛ.
N ɡbabir sie ɛɛ lɛ Jerusalam ne o nɛra nɛɛ kohona.
Wii ne lɔŋɔre aa o taa do kpa.
Bechasɔɔhne aa serewe kpa, nɛra bwa ɛɛ soo biɡri.
Baa yerɛ nɛra baa di bene lafa bonɔɔnaa, nomɛlbwa sewɔ dɛ o ta ɡɛ dɔe yaa, amɔ te dɛ n taahno.
Baa do deenee dɛ́ so a bini, dɛ́ parɛ daa kooni, dɛ́ di a nɔna.
Baa deenee ma nɛra bane ba so a ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ du kwaa nɛmpɛɛne dia kpa.
Nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te la ɛɛ biɡruu kɛŋɔ daa aa dɛ biɡri la, dɛ́ ɡbaɡba di ba toma baa ɛa ta.
Baa koh ta pɛɛ bwa, ba tomare bwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ ba.
Wekpeɡa ɡe aa ba bii nɛɛ ba bwa.
Mɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ ba ne ba naanaree saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ba ne ŋɔ ba soŋ mɛ tonɛ la, dɛ n noɔ dɛ́ chaŋe.
Ba taa dɛ bol kwaraa la, dɛ n te jemɔ.
Gboli ne pebiiri ɛɛ pɛ bobeŋkpoŋii dɛɛ di, nyujentena chwe kpɔɡa kɛŋɔ nae ken, harɛkon ɡe, teeraa wɛɛ ba dii.
A bɛlbwa aa kwaa chɔɡ, aa nɛra ɡee kpo n bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ Saayɔn ta kpa.” Korowiirii bola.
Korowii ɛɛ bol harɛre nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole Korowii ŋɔ, “Nyunduaa n kara, asɛ harɛ ɡee n natiɡribɔr.
Debesoo siwii hɛɛ ba wona ma ń jo o ta nɔ?
Debesoo taa ń won jo dɛ́ chɔ onɔɔ?
N ɡbaɡba laa ta ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwa kɛɛ?” Korowiirii bola.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa pwɛr ba te, dɛ sɛh ba liire chara laanee mɛɛ nyin kohona.
Banee dɛɛ ɔm mɛ dɛɛ no n wa.
Gɛ nɛra la dɛ ɛ waa aa too ba tea.
Ba kpo nao ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, a do kɛŋɔ baa kpo nɛn ken, a do kɛŋɔ baa kpo nyoate.
Gɛɛ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ mea saraha la, a do kɛŋɔ parakoo chal, bɛlbwa fuh daawiile ɡe aa, a do kɛŋɔ waa dɛ tu voɡa.
Kwaa maa kia la taa ba sie ɛɛ lɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ wekpeɡaa ba ta ba nɛ, waa baa dɛ ɔma kohona la.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ n yer ba, bɛlbwa ta chaŋɛ, dɛ bol wa, bɛlbwa ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no.
Ba berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa maa wola nyin.” Hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol, he nɛra haa dɛ ɔmɔ dɛɛ no o deŋna waa la.
O ŋɔ, “He wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ mɛ nomanta, he bala bane hah heya, dɛ vɛh heya.
Ba dɛ muɡli he baah ŋɔ, ‘He ɡel Korowii baɡle o kpeɡri dɛ́ lɛ heya ásɛ ya na he silɛɛ.’ Kɛ ba ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ ba sihiih dii kohona.
Hɛɛ no moola kohona aa dɛ le bwɛjen la bini, dɛ́ no ɡbɔɡa aa le Korowii Dea bela.
Korowii deŋnetɛra waa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ o dɔma moolaa.
N bwɛjen waa do ɡoroŋ la do kɛŋɔ haah waa lolɛ bie waa wola weweele bɛlbwa nae.
Nomɛl noɔ kɛɛ dɛ na waa nɔ dɔŋa ka aa?
Baa won vɔrɔwe harɛbir tɔpebeŋkpoŋ aa?
Gɛɛ loltea aa wola Saayɔnee lɔ biɡri ó na weweele mɔɔ dɛ́ lolɛ o bii.
Mɛɛ pili haah lolee dɛ́ berɛ vɔmɔ bie aa?
He bɛ lii kɛŋɔ saŋ telo kɛŋɔ ba lolɛ n bii aa, mɛɛ tɔ a ŋwɛnɛɛ.” Korowiirii bola.
He banɔ la haa dɛ nyin Jerusalam waa la, he ne ó pɛ lɛ sie.
Nɛra haa wia tɛo bwa ɡe hɛɡre.
Jerusalam ɛɛ dɛɛ heyaa hé dɔ o kondɔɔh la ane hé sie lɛ, kɛŋɔ haah elne yon bu o bie nɛɛ ó ɔr vaɡɛ la.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Jerusalam, mɛɛ ɡeloo deŋnesɔɔhna ne harɛre kondɔɔh bu he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, nee waa wola hweeh bwa ken.
Hɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ haah yon kpoŋe o bie nɔn ta, dɛɛ nyinu, dɛɛ dɛɛro la.
Mɛɛ larawe Jerusalam tena bwaraa, ɡɛ haah yon dɛɛ ɛ o bie la.
Dɛ he na ɡɛ waa nɔ a chiɡ aa, he sie ɛɛ lɛo, a tɛɛ kpeɡri, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ n dɛ cha nɛra baa dɛ no n deŋna wa, dɛɛ baɡle n bandia nɛra baa ɛɛ mɛ dɔm nɛ.” He na, Korowii kpɔ o torɔɡore dɛɛ ba nii ne kɛŋɔ kawulewule.
O baah dɛ fuh kohona, wɛɛ ba ó ba tɛr nɛra deŋne.
Nii ne laalee wɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛr harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa deŋne.
Nɛra waa kpoo ba ɛɛ warɔɔ taeh.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Saŋ telo kɛŋɔ n kpoo banɔ la baa laa doŋa kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛɛ la voɡa ta daa mune, ne banɔ la baa dɛ chwe parakoo ne mari, dɛ kondikwaa bwa soo siwi maa kia la.
Maa jemɛ ba liire ne ba we-ɛɛla nomanta, n dɛ ba ń yerɛ harɛre nɛra, ne wobol bɛlbwa tena bwa cheme, ásɛ ba na n jirima.
Mɛɛ ɛ waane ba binii, dɛ́ tomɛ banɔ la baa le a nyoa la, ásɛ ba la bojaŋa harɛre nɛra baa wola n waa noɛ dɛ na n jirima ne n kpeɡri la be.
Harɛre nɛra kɛŋɔ, Taases ne Lebya dɛ Lidia tena.
Lidia tena nɔ jemɛ to tae taeh, ne Tubal ne Grik tena harɛ.
Gɛ harɛre nɔ nɛra bee baa ba laŋa dɛ́ ka bol n kpeɡri maa dɔa la waa baɡ ba.
Baa kpɔ he bala baa lɔ bela harɛre la ta laanee ba tɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ koŋkɛɛla ken.
Jaɡre ne keeɡore ne nyoɡmare ne kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore, ne anɔ la aa dɔ tɔre baa taɡa nee baa ba koŋkɛɛla ne bala ba tɛ mɛ, n bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ ta Jerusalam.
Baa ba a nee kɛŋɔ Israel tena yon kpɔ mea sarahare do kondɛɛɡa bini baa tɛ mɛ n Dea la ken.
Mɛɛ le ba bini banee ɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ harɛfale la ne nyundufale maa dɛ́ ba tae a che n kpeɡri ta dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ la, ɡɛɛ he ne he naanar sɔna ɛɛ ba cheɡa.
Korobifale Tɔpejena dii ne Ona Tɔpere bɛlbwa ta la, nɛwɛnyina bwa ɛɛ ba tom mɛɛ Jerusalam bonɔ.
Nɛra ɛɛ leo dɛ́ kaa nyiŋi banɔ la baa ɛɛ mɛ deŋnekpeɡ la lala kɛ baa serewa chɔ.
Dudule aa dɛ di ba ola la aa sewɛ bwa, nii aa dɛ fuuh ba ɡe aa dime bwa, ásɛ ba waa pe nɛwɛnyina bwa.”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Jeremia baa bol Korowii waa la Juda tena bwɛjen Jerusalam tena be.
A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ waa nyin kɛ ó ɛ Korowii keame, kɛ Korowii leo.
Nɛra sie ta Korowii waa waa bola la ta lɛɛ, asɛ wɛɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ ba ken ɛɛ kpoo.
Nyiŋi nyu :-.
O kpɔ o wenaale bil Korowii sie.
Nyiŋi nyu :-.
O di ba kasinteŋ ŋɔ ba dɔma ɛɛ ba yoo baa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ laɡ ba le ba harɛ ta kaa.
Tɔn nɔ tona bini la, a ɡɛ waanɔ chiɡo kpela.
Nyiŋi nyu .
Jeremia berɔ ŋɔ bene fifraanuanɛ habɔɔ la, baa berɔɔ le bojaŋ harɛfale ta ba, ásɛ Korowii berɛ kpɔ ba harɛ la tɛɛ ba.
A habɔɔ, o berɔ na kɛŋɔ o nɛra ɛɛ charɛ ba liiree, dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ baa dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta kasinteŋ ne.
Nyiŋi nyu :-.
Baa bɛl sɔne Hilkia, dɛ o ɛ sɔfore baa lɔ Anatɔt la bɛl, dɛ do Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta.
O bibaa sɔne Jeremia, Jeremia waa waa bola laanee teŋa nɔ.
Korowii bol waa Jeremia be ɡɛ saŋ Amɔn bibaa Kooro Josia aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene fi dɛ atoro ta, ne ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa di kora Juda harɛ.
A habɔɔ, Korowii berɔ bol waa Jeremia be ka tel Kooro Josia bibaa Sedekia aa di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta.
A ɡɛ bena la korobie anue ta la, ba lawɛ Jerusalam tena laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Korowii yera waa yerɛ Jeremia Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “N tɔ sie lee cheɡ dɛ tɛɛ mkpa, mɔɔ ba lolɛ la, dɛ n lee cheɡ, menee lee ŋɔ hé ɛ n keame harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.” Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, n ta ɛ bechala, maa wobol jemɛ.” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ŋɔ he ɛ bechala, a chɛ kɛ he la nomɛlbwa maa tomɛ o be la be, dɛ́ ka bol wobɛlbwa maa doe ŋɔ hé bol.
Dɛɛ berɛ ba ɔma.
Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Belaa Korowii tɛr nɔn leɡe n nyoa dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Taraken n kpɔ n waa dɛɛ do he nyoa, hé ka bol.
Na, n lee fini dɛ tɛɛ kpeɡri harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, hé fuɡri dɛ́ kuuɡi dɛ́ chɔɡ, dɛ́ berɛ laɡ ba ir dɛ́ du, bá kpeɡ kɛŋɔ konduula ken.” Korowii berɔ bɔɔ mɛ ja ŋɔ, “Jeremia, bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ?” N chaŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, n na almɔn daa kpale.” O ŋɔ, “He bol kasinteŋ, kɛ n dɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ n waa maa bola la bwa ɛ ɡɛ.” Korowii berɔ bɔɔ mɛ ja ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ?” Asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N na vii bɛl nee do o bini, dɛɛ wure kɛŋɔ waa chɔŋɛ nii ta ken, dɛ wɛle le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Wenaale ɛɛ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔree dɛ́ ba nɛra baa lɔ Juda harɛ ta nɛ.
N dɛ ba nɛra baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr harɛre ta bwa yera cheme.
Ba koranar ɛɛ bao ba cheɡ ba kookane Jerusalam doonyojena ta, dɛ́ ba yoo ba, dɛ́ kuuɡi o danjwɛjena aa baro, dɛ Juda bwɛɛre bwa ɡe.
Mɛɛ ba bol n nɛra waa dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne, ba nyubinikpeɡ ne habɔɔ baa bera kpo mɛ la wa, ba fuh daawiile ɛ sarahare voɡare ane ta, dɛɛ tomɛ kwaa ba ɡbaɡba aa kpɔ nɔn ɛ. Ir, dɛ́ kpɔ he te, Jeremia, dɛ́ ka bol wobɛlbwa maa doe ŋɔ hé bol ba be.
Dɛɛ berɛ ba ɔma taraken, he ɛ ɡɛ naa, henee mɛɛ ba ɡela he berɛ ɔm ba kohona ba sie.
Fini, n ɡelɔ he do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro, ne buni pila ne ayaawa danjwɛɛ harɛ la ta, ásɛ he won yo Juda koranar ne ba nomonome, sɔfore ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta.
Baa yoi, kɛ baa won pɔ he nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n ja he nɛɛ ásɛ dɛ lɛɛ, men Korowiirii bola.”
Israel tena vɛɛh baa vɛh Korowii Korowii berɔ bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ir la ka bol n waa nɔ Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, ‘N dɛ lii ɡɛ he waa fa aa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ mɛ he toli saŋ, ɡɛ maa mo heyaa loɡla hɛɛ nyin mɛ, dɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, harɛ baa wola komɛlbwa o ta due.
Israel tena, he fa do ɡoroŋ tɛ men Korowii ɡbo, dɛ do kɛŋɔ koo kondikonloɡla baa koma ken, asɛ nɛra baa fiiɡi heyaa la, n kpɔ wenaale kohona ba ta ba nɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ” Jekɔb naanar, hé no Korowii wa, Israel deene bwa, hé no.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Bɔkwa waa n ne he naawa dɔ, asɛ ba vɛɛh mɛ dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ nɔɔ?
Ba teŋɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe nɛɛ dɛ berɛ nɛnsale.
Ba ta n waa bɔɔrɛ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa Korowii dɔɔ?
Onee lawɛ yaa le Ijipt harɛ, dɛ kpɔ yaa valɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, harɛ komɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta, o dɔ bɔluŋe, biro ne hwel do bela, nomɛlbwa aa o ta kpɔ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra ɛɛ so belaa.’ Harɛpare ondɛɛɡe taa n kpɔ ba ba so, bá ba dɔ daa nɔna ne kondikwaa aa wera di.
Kɛ ba kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la dɛ chɔɡo.
Sɔfore ɡba ta bɔɔrɛ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa Korowii dɔɔ?’ Nɛra baa dɛ baɡle me Mmarare ɡba ta men jemɛ.
Nomonome la bwa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛɛh mɛ.
N keamere bol waa voɡ Baal sɔn ta, dɛ kaa teŋɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe nɛ.
Anomanta, men Korowii, n ne he dɔɔ ja.
Mɛɛ tɛr he bii ne he naanar deŋnee.
Hé ɡale kaa wee cholibɔr Saepros mpo nyoa harɛ ta ka na.
Hé tomɛ nomɛl ó la Keda harɛ wee leebɔr ɡe ka nyiŋi.
Hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ waa aa do ken nɔ dɔŋa ta chiɡe ka.
Harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra toole dɛ charɛ ba voɡa, a lole kɛŋɔ a waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, kɛ n nɛra kpɔ n jirima tɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe dɛɛ toma.
Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua, hé ɡel he nyoa kpo hɛɛ chel ɔmee ne kohona.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Wechɔɡa anɛɛ n nɛra ɛɛ mɛ, ba vɛh men maa do kɛ bule, o nee aa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ ka kwi bɔɔne aa won nee lɛɛ, bɔɔne aa peɡra aa wola won lɛ ne.
Israel tena, ba ta heyaa yoma lawɛ, ba ta heyaa lolɛ he ɛ nɛndɔɔla.
Ɛrɛɛ a ɛ he dɔma lawɛ he bwa laa ta kaalɔ?
He dɔma do kɛŋɔ nyujentena dɛɛ si, dɛ ɡel he harɛ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ.
He bwɛɛre fuoh, nɛra chwa le a ta kaa.
Laa tena baa le Ijipt bwɛjena, Mɛmfes ne Tapanes ta dɛ fonɛ he nyuune la kpalkpal kɛ yoma.
