Haa vɛh men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, ɡɛ saŋ maa tɔ he sie kpɔ heyaa dɛɛ kaa la, a waa laa ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ba he nɛɛ nɔ naa?
Tɔnɔ besoo Ijipt harɛ ta laŋa dɛ́ ka nyɔ Nael Moo nee ɛɛ ba lee tɛ heya ɔ?
Bɔkwaa dɔ Asiiria harɛ ɡe ta laŋa dɛ́ ka nyɔ Yufretis Moo neɔ?
Hé ɡbabir nyubinikpeɡii dɛ́ ɡel he dɔ deŋnetɛra.
Vɛɛh haa vɛɛh mɛ la ɡe ɡel he di bolchɔɡe.
He ɡbabir nyiŋi dɛ́ na ɡɛ haa ɛ wechɔɡa he tea bini chɔɡ, ɡɛ saŋ haa vɛh men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, haa wola men ɔmɛ la wa.
Men Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.
Israel tena, saŋ la bwaa he vɛh kɛ hɛɛ yer mɛ he dɔɔree, he vɛh n waa ta teŋa dɛ́ tom mɛ.
Kasinteŋ, he ka dɛ tomɛ voɡa deŋɡarere dor ne dajena mune.
He fa do kɛŋɔ ɡrepo da o dwee aa wera n kpɔ du.
Ɛrɛɛ he berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛ berɛ dachɔɡa aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe dɛ tɛ mɛ nɔɔ?
He sɔ semina waa nyɛɡa ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwaraa naa, he wechɔɡa ta lɔ he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ doŋa dɛ chɔ n sie.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona ŋɔ, ‘Ya ta doŋa kpɔe kah ya te, ya ta voɡa Baalre tomɛ ɔ?’ Hé nyiŋi he we-ɛɛla haa ɛa fɛlembɔjen la bini, dɛ́ lii waa haa ɛa la bwa.
He do kɛŋɔ nyoɡma nee waa dɛ chwa bobɛlbwa dɛɛ nyin jweera.
He berɔ do kɛŋɔ keeɡo waa kpaŋa, dɛ man pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
O ba dɛ chwa dɛɛ nyin jweeraa, umee dɛ́ won sɔɔh o sie ɔ?
Ambala bɛ a te koh dɛ́ chwa dɛɛ tiu, o jweera saŋ telaa, aa nao.
Israel tena, he bɛ chwa dɛ́ foɡri he napaala pɛɛpɛɛ, ásɛ he lobi mune hol teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ voɡare ane nɛɛ la wa.
Kɛ he ŋɔ, ‘A ta tɔnɔ dɔe.
Ya dɛ nyin harɛre ane voɡa wa, a chɛ kɛ yaa teŋɛ a nɛ.’ Gɛ ba lawɛ ŋwɛɛ sihiih yon kpoo la, ɡɛɛ sihiih kpo he Israel tena bwa, he ne he koranar, ne he nomonome ne sɔfore, dɛ n keamere bwa.
He dɛ yerɛ daa, ‘N dɔɔ,’ dɛ ŋɔ bwe ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Henee lol mɛ.’ He berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, kɛ dɛ waane baa puu heyaa tenaa he yon ŋɔ, ‘Korowii, ba dɛ́ ba lɛ yaa!’ Leperaa voɡare he ɡbabir aa ɛa la dɔɔ?
Dɛ waane pu heyaa aa, hé yera, dɛ aa won ba lɛ heya aa!
Juda tena, he voɡare warɔ kɛŋɔ he bwɛjena.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ naɡre n waɔ?
He bwa ɛɛ mɛ deŋnekpeɡ.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Pɛɛpɛɛ n tɛr he deŋne, haa nyin kɛ he charɛ he liire le waa haa dɛ ɛ ta.
He kpoo keamere maa tom ba he be kɛŋɔ nyujente lɔr aa dɛ kpoo ken.
He fini bii, hé no waa men Korowii aa dɛ bol nɔ.
N ta doe kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, kɛɛ harɛ biro tenten aa lɔ o ta tɛ heya.
Ɛrɛɛ n nɛra ɛɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ ɡaaɡe kaa bobɛlbwa, yaa berɛ ba he be kpa.’ Bitolo ɛɛ won soh o suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa ne baŋa kwaa ne noniseɡa aa, kɛɛ hanfale soh o hanfale laala doe yaa?
Kɛ n nɛra soh n waa biɡri maa wola won jemɛ a saŋ.
He dɔ sɛnanar nyina wejema taeh!
Hale hanjwamanere ɛɛ won hweli le he be.
Nyaara baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ he kpoo ba la chal ka he laala ta nɛra ɛɛ naa, a lole kɛŋɔ he ta ban lawɛ kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛra ba jo he be.
Kɛ ane a bwa, he dɛ bol ŋɔ, he ta bolchɔɡe bɛlbwa dii, Korowii baah ta he nɛɛ dii, Kɛ men Korowii ɛɛ bol he waa dɛ́ pa bole, dɛkalkɛ he ŋɔ he ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɡaaɡe kohona dɛɛ charɛ he we-ɛɛla ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Ijipt tena ɛɛ neɡre heyaa kɛŋɔ Asiiria tena ɡe fa aa neɡre heyaa la.
Hɛɛ ɡure nyuu su, dɛ́ kpɔ sihiih kaa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii vɛh nɛra haa kpɔ he te dawɛ ba nɛ, baa heyaa cha kpa.”
Israel tena kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ baa vɛh o haah asɛ haah la ka yalɛ banfale aa, baa la aa won ka kpɔɔ ba o dea kpa.
Gɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ won kpɔ harɛchɔɡ tenten ba.
Gɛ tentenee he teŋɛ voɡare nɛɛ kohona kɛŋɔ hanjwamane aa dɛ teŋɛ baala nɛ.
He dɛ nyin he berɛ ba n be naa?
Hé ha sie dɛ́ nyiŋi deŋɡarere dor!
Bobɛl lole haa wola jwamane ka bɔe yaa?
He yon so ŋwɛnɛ nyoa dɛɛ kpa baala kɛŋɔ nɛra baa soɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛɛ ɡaaɡe ken.
He cheɡɛ nyubinikpeɡ ne jwamane ta, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ la.
A waa bwaala teŋe, dɛ ɡel nɛɛ.
Kɛ he nya sihiih jwamane ta, haa sɛh ŋɔ sihiih kpo heya.
He yer mɛ, ‘N mɛɛ ne n dam le n bechale saŋ, he baah ɛɛ teŋɔ di ya nɛɛ ɡɛ naa?’ Gɛɛ he yon dɛɛ bol, kɛ dɛ ɡarɛ kaa ɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.” Israel ne Juda tena liire chara wa Kooro Josia kora dii saŋee Korowii bol men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “He na waa Israel tena ba waa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe kɛŋɔ hanjwamane aa ɛa kenɛ?
Ba la deŋɡarere dor ne dajena mune kaa tomɛ voɡa.
Israel tena do kɛŋɔ hanjwamane ken.
N liiro ŋɔ anɔ baa ɛa nɔ bwa habɔɔ baa berɔɔ ba n be, ba dɔŋa Juda tena ɡe ɡba nao.
Israel jwamane la nomanta, n vɛoh dɛ tao ŋwɛnɛ o kaa.
Kɛ Juda ta ɔmɛ, dɛ ɡe kaa bɔ jwamane.
Aa wola Juda hae kɛ Israel waa waa ɛa ɛ wechɔɡa la, o bɔ jwamane dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ la, dɛ berɛ kaa tomɛ voɡare baa kpɔ daa ne bwea ɛa.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, Juda waa ɛ Israel dɔŋ, o wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe la, ta berɛ ba n be o bambile bwa ne, dɛ ta ɛɛ kpɔ a liire.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “A lole kɛŋɔ Israel bɔ jwamane te, kɛ o waa toɡrɔ dɛ ɡwaa Juda.
La ka bol waa nɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ‘Hé berɛ ba, Israel tena he wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe.
N baah aa he nɛɛ di kpa, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ sune nɛn nɛ, n baah aa won di he nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Men Korowiirii bola.
He ɡbabir lɛ he wechɔɡa do, he ɛ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la deŋnekpeɡ, he kpɔ he te tɛ voɡare dajena lɔɡre bwa, he ta n waa ta teŋɛ.’ Men Korowiirii bola.
Hé berɛ ba, nɛra he waa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe, dɛkalkɛ he dɔɔree men.
Mɛɛ le nɛmbeŋkpoŋii le bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ le nɛra banɛ le dea bɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne Saayɔn Bwejen ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔ heyaa do sitɔɔla baa dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ nɔn taa, ásɛ ba kpɔ wejema ne waa mun noe nyiŋi he nɛ.
A ɡɛ saŋ haa ba warɛ kohona harɛ la ta la, nɛra aa n ne He Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la waa bol kpa.
Baa o waa liira ba, o waa aa ban hiah kpa, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa kwaa onfalee.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, baa yerɛ Jerusalam ‘Korowii Kookara’ bɔree, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa ba bela dɛ́ baa tom mɛ.
Baa ba wechɔɡa ne deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla la taa teŋɛ kpa.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, Juda tena ɛɛ ba ja Israel tena nɛɛ, bá bwa le bojaŋ harɛ baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ta, bá kaa harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ he naawa la ta, ó ɛ he kon.” Korowii nɛra voɡa toma Belaa Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, n dɛ nyin kɛ ń kpɔ heyaa berɛ n bii dɛ́ tɛ heyaa harɛ waa wera, harɛ waa wera kohona harɛre bwa ta.
N liiro ŋɔ hɛɛ yer mɛ he mɛɛ dɛ bɛ habɔɔ berɛ kpo mɛ.
Kɛ ɡɛ haah o wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ o jaa la, ɡɛɛ he Israel tena wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ mɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Lɔŋɔre dɛ le bwejena aa chɔ pɛɛ dor, Israel tena wii baa dɛ wi dɛɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa baa lɔ a ta wa, dɛkalkɛ ba soh Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ wa.
Hé berɛ ba, he nɛra he wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo Korowii.
Wɛɛ chah heyaa dɛ́ ɡel he waa berɛ dɔ kasinteŋ.
He ŋɔ, “Ya sɛoh ŋɔ yaa berɔ ba Korowii be, dɛkalkɛ onee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ.
Voɡare yaa toma bwejena dor la ta yaa chae.
Korowii ya Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ ɡboo ɛ ya lɛɛ.
Le ya bechale saŋee voɡare aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe chɔɡ ya naawa toma baa ɛa, ba peera ne nae, ba bibaala ne bihaahna bwa.
Ya di ncho dɛ chole harɛ, asɛ sihiih tɔ ya nɛ.
Ya ne ya naawa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɛ.
Le ya bonɔɔne ne toli saŋ ba le fini, ya ta Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la waa noɛ.”
Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena charɛ ba liire Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, dɛ hɛɛ berɔɔ waa, hé berɛ ba n be.
Dɛ hɛɛ laa voɡare maa kia laanee kpɔ n sie dɛ bɛ n habɔɔ le, dɛ́ kpɔ kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ ne waa aa toɡra ta ŋwɛɛ n sɔn ta naa, amɔ mɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ harɛre nɛra bwa ásɛ ba kpɛɛ mɛ.” Kenii Korowii bol Juda ne Jerusalam tena be, “Hé pwɛr he bambili kɛŋɔ paa yon buɡli harɛfale mɔɔ dɛ́ du kwaa la, dɛ bɛ kondwee kpɔ du sɔɔhne baah.
Hɛɛ teŋɛ fɔo he ne men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ aa fɔwa la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ he te bwa tɛ mɛ, he Juda ne Jerusalam tena bwa.
Gɛ laa aa, n baah ɛɛ diu kohona, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa la wa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa won sɔɔh o nyoa.
Wenaale aa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr Hé bola Juda ne Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, ‘Hé hoh bɛla harɛ la bwa ta.’ Hé do lɔŋɔ kohona ŋɔ, ‘Hé boa nyoa.
Hé ɡel ya chwa kaa bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara la ta.’ Hé ir fraŋkaa chaɡɛ Saayɔn.
He bɛ hɛlɛ, hé chwa dɛ́ lɛ he nyu.
N kpɔ wenaale le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, chɔɡa tenten nee mɛɛ ba he nɛ.” Gɛ nyujente yon le o sɔɔhbɔr dɛɛ ba la, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ chɔɡ harɛre kpɔ o te dɛ le dɛɛ ba.
O le bela waa lole, dɛ́ ba chɔɡ he harɛ.
He bwɛjena ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbiaa, nɛra aa wola a taa so.
Hé kpɔ lweyale tɔ, dɛ́ wi dɛ́ɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre, dɛkalkɛ Korowii bandia kohona la ta ya nɛɛ leɛ.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, kooro ne nomonome bwa bambile ɛɛ teŋoo, sɔfore nyoa kpo kohona, ásɛ bɔyɔra kohona chole n keamere nɛ.” Anee men Jeremia ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, he neɡre Jerusalam tena kohona.
He ŋɔ baa dɔ deŋnesɔɔhnaa.
Na ɡɛ kere aa jaɡɛ ba baŋa baa ba ba kpoora.” Gɛ saŋ baa ŋɔ Jerusalam tena bee ŋɔ, peuwɔb bɛl tao le bwejena dor pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ ba ta Jerusalam tena nɛ, kɛ peu waa do kɛ bá kpɔ palɛ kwaa laa.
Peu waa kpeɡa kohona dɛ́ le Korowii be ba laanee.
O dɛ́ ba ba waa bola dɛ́ pa bole name.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé na, dɔm la dɛ ba kɛŋɔ baama ken, kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ɡee ba kɛŋɔ kawulewule, o jaɡre ɡbaŋre ɡwaa kɔle.” Nɛra la ŋɔ, “Ya bwɛɛlɛ, ya bwa serewɔ!” Jerusalam tena, hé ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ ásɛ Korowii lɛ heya.
Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba he nyubinikpeɡ vɔrɔwa nɔ ɡela ɔ?
Taa bɛl le Dan dea harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua, dɛɛ baɡle wenaale aa le Efrem harɛ deŋɡarere dor wa.
Taa la ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ harɛre nɛra be, dɛ́ bola Jerusalam ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Laa tena baa wara le bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛɛ ba, dɛɛ dooɡe laa lɔŋɔre dɛ́ ba yo Juda harɛ bwɛjena.
Ba cheɡɔ bar Jerusalam kɛŋɔ baala aa dɛ daah koo, dɛkalkɛ o nɛra ɛɛ mɛ deŋnekpeɡ.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ Juda tena, he we-ɛɛla ne he liiree ɡela anɔ bwa ba he nɛ.
Deŋnetɛra aa chɛ heyaa laanee.
A dɛ we kɛrɛdɛ.
Na ɡɛ aa jo he bini.” Anee Jeremia ŋɔ, “N weweele kan, a kan kohona to!
N bwara bwaa dɛɛ wee mɛ mɛɛ beɡre n te.
N loo kuu, n bambile ɛɛ lɔ kohona!
Maa won tɔ nyoa, dɛkalkɛ n no bɛla sii, dɛ no laa lɔŋɔre.
Wekpeɡa ane balaa, dɛ ane teŋɔ, harɛ la bwa berɛ dimɡbia.
Kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ n tɛnte deene maa soɡe a ta bwa chɔɡɔ.
Saŋ besoo laa fraŋkaare, ne bɛle hoeh nɔ ɛɛ ba ɡela ɔ?” Korowii ŋɔ, “N nɛra ɡɛnɔ, baa men jemɛ.
Ba ɛ bechale baa wola liire dɔe, baa waa mun no.
Ba dɔ wejema bá kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ baa wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ te jemɛ.” N nyiŋi harɛ nɔ dɛ o ta mar dɔe, komɛlbwa toole o ta, asɛ nyundua ɡe, kwaa aa dɛ chaah bɔr toole.
N berɔ nyiŋi bwejena dɛ a dɛ jiɡri, asɛ deŋɡarere bwa ɡe ɛɛ yiiɡi.
N berɔ nyiŋi n ta nomɛlbwa nae, jumbii bwa ɡe ir kaa.
N nyiŋo, dɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, o bwɛjena bwa berɛ dimɡbia, Korowii bandia kohona la wa.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Harɛ la bwa dɛ́ ba dimɡbia bera, kɛ maa den chɔɡ o bwa kwaraa.
Gɛ nomanta, harɛ la ta nɛra ɛɛ wiu ásɛ nyundua bwa bir, dɛkalkɛ menee bola maa nsana le.
N dɔɔ kpɔ a liire, maa habɔɔ le.” Nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta, ne banɔ la baa kpoŋe tori ɡbɔɡa ɡelɔ nɛra bwa chwa kaa.
Bane chwao ka sɔh kɔne bini, bane chwa ka teeh bwea.
Bwɛɛre la bwa chɔ pɛɛ, nɛra toole a bini.
Jerusalam, he harɛ bwa chɔɡɔ, he do kɛ hanjwamane dɛ do tol-laala, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm baŋa kwaa ne deŋna kwaa do.
Bɔkwaa dɔ kwaa kpɔe ɛ he siebɔr dɛ́ di toli ɔ?
He kpɔ kondɛɛɡa dɛɛ kwaa he te pɛɛpɛɛ, he sɛnanar bwa vɛɛh hale dɛɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo.
N dɛ no lɔŋɔ kɛ haah loltea aa lɔɔ, wɛɛ eeh dɛɛ lolɛ o biloɡle.
A kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ Jerusalamee do kɛŋɔ haah waa dɛ wi o hweera pi, dɛɛ tɛɡre nɔɔra ŋɔ, “Akwe, n na wa, ba dɛ ba dɛ́ ba kpo mɛ.”
Nomɛlbwa waa ta toɡrɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Jeremia, ir la ka nyiŋi Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna.
Nyiŋi o bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ bar, ásɛ dɛ ɡaaɡe bela nɛra aa dɛ cheme bwa.
Dɛ hɛɛ won dɔ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwaraa o wa aa wera dɛɛ di kasinteŋ aa, mɛɛ kpɔ Jerusalam tena wechɔɡaa kɛ ba.
A lole kɛ ba ŋɔ ba dɛ tomɛ men Korowii, kɛ ba teŋe nyosone dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ n sɔn ta.” Belaa n lii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, kasinteŋ ɡbo laa hɛɛ nyin aa?
He tɛr ba deŋne, kɛ ba ta weweele bɛlbwa nae, he do ba sibeɡra, kɛ ba ta wobɛlbwa hwele le a ta.
Ba ɡelɔ ba bambile do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwe ken, dɛ vɛh kɛ baa charɛ ba liiree.” Ate, n berɛ lii ŋɔ, “Ba ɛ nyaara ɡbo baa wola jemɛ, ba ɛ ɡɛna, dɛkalkɛ baa waa Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ nyin jemɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ la nomonjena bee n ne bá ka bol.
Ba te jemɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la waa bwa kɛrɛdɛ.” Kɛ ba bwa pɛ nyoa dɛ vɛh Korowii waa la ta teŋa.
Anomanta, nyujente ɛɛ le kpɔɡ binii dɛ́ ba kpoo ba, ɡboli le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ́ ba toɡri ba ola.
Ásɛ noniete ba chɔ ba bwɛɛ dahare, dɛ́ toɡri nomɛlbwa waa le ola, dɛkalkɛ ba wechɔɡa kan, ba habɔɔ bera dɛ́ kpo Korowii ɡe ɡwaa.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Juda tena, ɛrɛ waa a chɛ kɛ ń kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛ heya ɔ?
He vɛɛh mɛ dɛɛ tomɛ voɡare a wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe.
N tɛ heyaa komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin, kɛ he ɡarɛ kaa bɔ jwamane, he ne hanjwamanere ɛɛ valɛ.
Ba do kɛŋɔ jaɡ-bala aa dɔ kwaa di vaɡɛ kohona, dɛɛ nyin jweera ken.
Bɛlbwa pɛla lawɛ o dɔŋ haah.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ń tɛr ba deŋne waa nɔ wa aa?
A ta chɛ kɛ n bɔ harɛ waa do ken nɔ nɛra kem aa?
Men Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo dɔma ba teŋni n nɛra daa kooni nɔna ta, kɛ baa den chɔɡ a bwa kwaraa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba teŋni a kpala bwa ta, dɛkalkɛ ba cheɡɔ tɛ nɛra baa wola men jemɛ la.
Israel ne Juda tena bwa waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ mɛ kwaraa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii nɛra teŋe nyosone ŋɔ, “Waa yaa wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba.
Yaa wekpeɡa bɛlbwa nae ba.
Laa bɛlbwa aa ya nɛɛ ba, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ lɔr kpo yaa yá serewe.
Korowii keamere la waa do kɛŋɔ peu aa taa baa kaa ken, Korowii waa la toole ba bini, anomanta, waa baa dɛ bol la ɛɛ ɡure ba nyu taa.” Anomanta, waa Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Nɛra nɔ aa bol ɡɛ nomanta, n wobol maa kpɔ do he nyoa la ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nii ken.
Ba ɡe ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ daa nii aa dɛ fuah.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, n kpɔ nɛra le bojaŋ harɛ ta ásɛ ba ba yo heya.
Harɛ o nɛra aa lole le saŋ la bwa dɛ do kpeɡri haa wola ba wobol no, haa a mun ɡe no.
Ba laa tena jemɛ hɛma tae kohona, baa wola nomɛlbwa nɛɛ sune.
Baa di he kondikwaa bwaa, dɛ́ kpoo he bibaala ne bihaahna.
Baa kpoo he peera ne naee, dɛ́ chɔɡ he ɡrepo ne fiɡ daa bwa.
Baa chɔɡ he bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, hɛɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta bwaa.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Ane a bwa, tɔpere la telaa, maa he bwaa chɔɡ kwaraa.
Ba bɔɔ ɡɛ aa bala n ɛ anɔ bwa naa, Jeremia, ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Gɛ haa dena berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ harɛfala voɡare la, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ ba nɛŋhɔɔhra toma ba harɛ ta.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ waa nɔ Jekɔb naanar be dɛ́ bola baɡle Juda tena ŋɔ, ‘Hé cheɡ deŋne, ɡɛna haa wola liire bɛlbwa dɔe.
He dɔ sibie kɛ haa na, he dɔ deŋna kɛ haa waa no.
Menee Korowii, amɔ haa men ɔmaa?
A ta chɛ kɛ hɛɛ chel n sie naa?
Menee ɡela hɛŋle ɛ mpo jwɛh, o do le saŋ bɛlbwa mpo aa wola won su ɡale.
Nehɛma ɛɛ won ta ɡɛ bɛlbwa, kɛɛ dɛɛ si kohona, kɛ aa won ɡale kaa hɛŋle baŋ.
Kɛ he nɛra nɔ te, he ɡɛnɔ dɛ ɛ bambikpeɡ nɛra.
He berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ dɛ ɡel n toma ɛɛ.
He ta liire dɔe ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta kɛŋɔ he kpɔ duure tɛ mɛ.
Menee ɡela bwaala loɡla ne yoo bwaala ɛɛ nɛ, he kondikwaare ɛɛ do wer, hɛɛ koma bena bɛlbwa.
Anomanta, ɡɛ waa aa wera nɔ paŋɛ heya, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa la wa.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra soɡe n nɛra bini, dɛ chɔ dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ nɛra yon harɛ bela dɛɛ lawɛ jumbii, ne bela baa hara dɛɛ lawɛ nɛra ken.
Gɛ kpaah yon pa jumbii su ɡbɛr bini la, ɡɛɛ ba pa laala baa cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡa ta su ba deene.
Anee ɡela ba dɔ suuɡa dɛɛ di kpeɡri.
Baa di kondɛɛɡa vaɡɛ dɛ je nomanta, ba wechɔɡa ta jaɡa dɔe.
Baa bilalbii waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, baa kasinteŋ bol dɛɛ cha nyaara ɡe.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowii tɛr ba deŋne waa nɔ wa aa?
A ta chɛ kɛ ń bɔ harɛ waa do ken nɔ nɛra kem aa?
Waa aa dɔ nyokpoa aa wola were chiɡ harɛ la ta.
N keamere dɛ bol wa aa ɛ nyosone ɡbosoroo, sɔfore cheɡɛ ba kpeɡri ta dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta, kɛ n nɛra sie dɛ lɛ a ta.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ baa ba ɛɛ yɔ?’ ”
Dɔma chɔɔ bar Jerusalam Bɛnjamen dea tena, hé chwa le Jerusalam dɛ́ dɔ he nyu.
Hé hoh bɛla la Tekoa, ásɛ dɛ choŋi nii Bɛt Hakerem ɡe, á baɡle kɛ siswɛm balɔ.
Wekpeɡa ne harɛchɔɡ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba.
Bwɛjen Saayɔn wer kohona, kɛ mɛɛ chɔɡoo, peteɡra ɛɛ kpɔ ba peera la dibɔr bela, dɛ́ baŋre ba tɛnte deene bar o bwa, ásɛ bɛlbwa ka so bela waa dɛ nyin.
Baa bol dɔŋa bee ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya kpɔ ya te dɛ́ ka yo Jerusalam!
Hé ir, webaŋaa yaa ba laŋa ka yo.
Akwe, wee joɔ tonɛ, saŋ kaalɔ bɔr kwaraa dɛ ba bira.
Jwaanaa yaa ba laŋa ka yo, dɛ́ chɔɡ danjwɛkpeɡa baa maa bar bwɛjen la.” Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Hé teŋni daa dɛ́ kpɔ ma kwaa haa che a ta jo ka chɔɡ bwɛjen Jerusalam.
Jerusalam chɛ deŋnetɛra, dɛkalkɛ nɛra fiiɡa su o ta.
Gɛ nee yon bule dɛɛ le bule ta la, ɡɛɛ wechɔɡa le Jerusalam dɛɛ ba.
Kwaa chɔɡa ne yoi ɡbɔɡa su o ta.
Weela ne dɔŋa bola doe ɡboo mɛɛ na bobɛlbwa.
Jerusalam tena, hɛ́ɛ no jae maa dɛ ja heya, ɡɛ laa aa, mɛɛ vɛh heyaa, dɛ́ ɡel he harɛ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa wola won so o ta.” Koranar Bwa Kooro bol n be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo Israel dɔma ba pa ba harɛ komɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, baa chaa ɡrepo koo daa nɔna bwa le o ta ken.
Gɛɛ a chɛ kɛ saŋ bɛl taa lole nɔ, hé cha nomɛlbwa.” Anee men Jeremia chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ŋɔ n bol wa dɛ́ kah ba aa, umee dɛ́ no n be nɔ?
Ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena dɛ vɛh he waa noe.
Ba dɛ mamɛ waa haa ŋɔa n bol la.
He bandia waa lɔ ba nɛɛ la dɛ we n bambile maa wola won kpoŋa kpa.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ n bandia ba bechale nɛɛ fɔɡbaahna, ne bela bonɔɔnaa aa dɛ cheme, ne baala ne ba haahna bwa nɛ, hale banɔ la baa hwɛɛhra bwa.
Baa kpɔ ba deremii tɛ nɛra bane, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kooni ne ba haahna ja, ɡɛ saŋ maa tɛr nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta deŋne.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Bechale ne nomonome bwa cheɡɛ sibeɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ nyin kwa, hale n keamere ne sɔfore dɛ teŋe nyosone.
Ba na n nɛra ŋwɛra dɛ ŋɔ kuree.
Dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Deŋnesɔɔhna lole,’ kɛ dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna bɛlbwa toole.
Amɔ sihiih kpo ba wedoŋa baa ɛa nɔ ta kenɛ?
Akai, sihiih ta ban kpoe kwara, ba siebɔra ɡba dɛ baɡle kɛ sihiih ta ban kpoe.
Anomanta, baa chɔɡoo kɛŋɔ bane aa chɔɡa la.
Awola maa ba tɛr ba deŋne la, ba wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba a jaɡaa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Israel tena vɛh Korowii ŋwɛnɛ Korowii ŋɔ o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hé ka che ŋwɛnɛ chɛchɛre ta dɛɛ nyiŋi.
Hé bɔɔ ŋwɛnɛbena wa, dɛ́ jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa wera dɛɛ kpɔ o ta, dɛ́ so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Anee he ŋɔ, ‘Akai, yaa o taa kpɔ.’ Belaa men Korowii le nɛra baa dɛɛ daah heya dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no bɛla sii!’ Ate he ŋɔ, ‘Yaa ɡɛɛ sɛh.’ Anomanta, harɛre nɛra, hé no, ásɛ dɛ hweli waa aa dɛ ba n nɛra nɛɛ chiɡa.
Hé no, harɛre nɛra bwa, n kpɔ wenaale dɛɛ ba n nɛra nɛ, ásɛ a ɛ ba wechɔɡa kembɔr, dɛkalkɛ ba ta n waa noɛ dɛ vɛh men Mmarare ta teŋa.
N waane laa daawiile baa le ane Seeba harɛ dɛɛ ba, kɛɛ kalamus a sɔɔh aa soma baa le a ne bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la.
Maa saraha kwaa haa dɛ fuah la nyin, n sie aa kwaa haa kpoora dɛɛ tɛ mɛ ta lɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo ɡɛ nɛra nɔ lɔ naa dɛ́ choɡli.
Lolanar ne ba bii ɛɛ serewoo, nɛra ne ba daamanar ɡe serewe.
Hé nyiŋi na!
Laa tena le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, harɛ o nɛra aa kana kpɔ ba te le harɛ jaɡa dɛɛ ba ba yo laa.
Ba kpɔ ba tori ne lampeare kpoŋe, ba nyu bini kpeɡri, baa nɛn nɛɛ sune.
Ba soɡe jaɡre ta a nakpale ɛɛ si kɛŋɔ mpo aa dɛ si la ken.
Ba kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ba yo Jerusalam.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Jerusalam tena ŋɔ, “Ya no ba wa, asɛ ya bwara yɔr, weweele ne bambiteŋa ɡel ya do kɛŋɔ loltea aa lɔ haah ken.
Yaa won ŋɔ yaa leo kaa dahare, kɛɛ dɛ ka valɛ ŋwɛnɛre ta, dɛkalkɛ ya dɔma kpɔ ba te dɛ kpoŋe ba dɔmkwa, asɛ ɔmee kohona bar yaa cheme.” Korowii berɔ bol waa o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ lweyale tɔ dɛɛ ɡbili tɔɔ ta, dɛɛ wi lokua ne kɛŋɔ haa wi he bibambeŋkpoŋ waa sewa ken.
Dɛkalkɛ nɛn waa dɛ́ ba ba chɔɡ heyaa la ɛɛ piɡri heyaa.
Jeremia, n kpɔe ka do n nɛra bini ásɛ he nyiŋ ba, ɡɛ nɛn yon nyiŋi bune dɛ jemɛ a bini andɛɛɡa la.
Ba bwa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ ne bambikpeɡ tena, dɛ valɛ dɛɛ ɛ nyokpɛl ɡbo.
Ba kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ayaawa ne buni ken, ba bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla aa were.
N nɛra do kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋa doŋa aa lɔ a ta, hale he do nii a ta dɛ lɔ fuɡme ɡɛ bɛlbwa nii la wɔrɔbe aa, aa won mwɛɛ a doŋa le.
Gɛɛ n nɛra nyu bini do kpeɡri, banchɔɡa aa won pere ba te le bandɛɛɡa bini.
A kpeɡri kɛ ń won kwaa ba.
Baa dɛɛ yerɛ n nɛra sɔnee ŋɔ suuɡapoŋa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n vɛɛh ba.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Jeremia Korowii waa bola Korowii ŋɔ Jeremia be ŋɔ ó che Korowii Dea doonyoa dɛ́ bol waa nɔ, “Juda tena bwa, hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol, heyaa yon kpɔ doonyoa nɔ ta jo dɛ baa tomɛ Korowii.
Hé charɛ he we-ɛɛla, ásɛ n ɡel he so bonɔ.
He bɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋe nyosone nɛɛ teŋɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ bol ŋɔ he dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna la.
Ba yon ŋɔ, Korowii Dea laanee la!
Korowii Dea laanee la!
Korowii Dea laanee la!
Hé charɛ he liire dɛ́ ɡel ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛ la.
Hé ɡel he waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛ dɔŋa.
Hé ɡel hɔɔhra ne bilalbii dɛ luhaahna fiiɡa.
Hé ɡel nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ so he bini la kpoora, dɛ́ ɡel voɡare ɡe toma, a ɡɛ ɛɛ won chɔɡ heya.
Hé charɛ he liire aa, hɛɛ teŋɔɔ so harɛ nɔ maa kpɔa tɛ he naawa o ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la la ta.
Hé no, waa aa ɛ nyosone taa he yarada do.
He dɛ ŋwɛ, dɛɛ kpoo nɛra, dɛɛ bɔ jwamane dɛɛ di dansewea, dɛɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare voɡ Baal ta, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡare haa wola an jemɛ wubwa.
Waa maa kia laanee he yon ka ɛ, dɛ́ berɛ ba che n sie n Dea bonɔ dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna.’ He dɛ lii kɛ n Dea maa ŋɔa baa tom mɛ o bini nɔ ɛ ŋwɛɛra sɔɔhbɔr kɛɛ?
N na waa haa dɛ ɛ bwa.
Hé la Silo bela n fa aa tɔ sie le cheɡ ŋɔ hɛɛ tom mɛ la, dɛ́ ka na waa maa ɛa bela, n nɛra Israel tena wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa.
Hé taa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa nɔ la, men Korowii bol he be keraŋwɛnɛ bwa, kɛ he vɛh n be noe.
N yerɛ heya, kɛ he ta men chaŋɛ.
Anomanta, ɡɛ maa ɛ Silo laanee mɛɛ ba n Dea maa lea cheɡ ŋɔ hɛɛ tom mɛ o bini, dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ o ta la ɛɛ.
Dea nɔ maa kpɔa tɛ he ne he naawa nɔ ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ maa ɛ Silo la.
Mɛɛ doŋi heyaa le n sie ɡɛ maa doŋi Israel tena baa ɛ he lolanar bini bane la.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Israel tena Korowii deŋnekpeɡ ɛɛ wa Belaa Korowii ŋɔ, “Jeremia, bɛ wobɛlbwa soŋe tɛ nɛra nɔ, dɛɛ berɛ ba naa ta cheɡa soŋe ba wechɔɡa n be tɛɛ ba.
Dɛkalkɛ maa he bee no.
Haa ba we-ɛɛla na Juda bwɛjena ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna aa?
Ba bechale cheɡɛ damara ba bil, ba mɛɛnanar ɛɛ mar nii, asɛ haahna kpɔ noo koo men ta, dɛ charama dɛ wɔɔra kɛŋɔ paanoo, dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Nyundua Haŋkooro la.
Ba berɔ fuɡe sen dɛ kpɔ ɛ sarahare tɛ voɡare ane ɡe, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ muɡli n baah.
Amɔ men Korowii baahnee baa muɡli ɡɛ nɔ naa?
Akai, ba ɡbabirii dɛɛ do ba te sihiih.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ n bandia waa do kɛ nii ba ta n Dea nɔ ne nɛra dɛ kondɛɛra bwa nɛ.
Hale daa ne koo kondikwaa bwa soo siwi.
N bandia la aa sɔɔh bwa.
N nɛra, he dɛ ba sarahare kwaa fuih yaa, he dɛ fuh ane bwa kon baa dɛ ɛ sarahare o ta, dɛɛ di ane ɡe, kɛ men Korowii dɛ bol he be ŋɔ, hɛɛ won dɛɛ di a bwa.
Maa lawɛ he naawa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba la, n ta ban saraha kwaa baa fuah kɛɛ saraha bɛlbwa waa ta doe.
N do ba ŋɔ baa no n wa, ásɛ n ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra.
N berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ baa ɛ ɡɛ maa do ba la, ásɛ wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba.
Kɛ ba ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no n be, dɛ teŋɛ ba deŋnekpeɡ ne wechɔɡa we-ɛɛla aa lɔ ba bini la ta, dɛ chɔɡ ba te kwaraa.
Le awola he naawa aa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba le fini, keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa n teŋɛ dɛɛ tomɛ toroma baa ɛ n keamere la he be.
Kɛ he ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no n be.
Hale he bambile berɔ do kpeɡri dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena kohona ɡwaa he naawa.
Jeremia, he bol ɡɛ waa nɔ ba be kwaraa naa, baa he bee no, he yer ba ɡe aa, baa hen chaŋe.
Anomanta, ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ba harɛ nɛra aa men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ waa ta teŋɛ kɛɛ dɛ hweli waa ane le ba deŋnetɛra ta.
Kasinteŋ toole kpa.
Baa a waa bol kpa kwara.
Jerusalam tena, hé wi, hé fonɛ he nyuune dɛ́ pa ta.
Hé kaa deŋɡarere dor dɛ́ kaa taa wiile, dɛkalkɛ men Korowii, n baah di he nɛɛ n vɛh heya.
Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen bini wechɔɡa Juda tena ɛ wechɔɡa ane.
Ba kpɔ ba voɡare maa kia la cheɡ n Dea maa lea cheɡ ŋɔ baa tom mɛ o bini la, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaoh.
Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen binii ba ma kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ yerɔ Tɔfɛt.
Belaa ba kpoo ba bibaala ne bihaahna dawɛ nii ta ɛ saraha.
Gɛ laa n bol ba be, ɡɛ toole n liire ta.
Anomanta, saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao baa wola on yerɛ Tɔfɛt kɛɛ Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen kpa, baa dɛɛ yerɔ Nɛŋkpoa Fɛlembɔjenii.
Baa huɡe nɛra belaa ka tel kɛ bɔr aa wola lee do bá huɡ ba.
Ba dɛ ba serewa chɔ dɛ́ ɛ kondikwaa tɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola, nomɛlbwa aa wola lee do dɛ́ doŋa.
Harɛ la ɛɛ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛɛ.
Mɛɛ laa silɛɛ ɡbɔɡa te bɛlbwaa kpɔ Juda ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahnaa, hale ba hanfalwaa silɛɛ bwa.
Dɛkalkɛ harɛ la ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbiaa.”
Korowii ŋɔ, “A ɡɛ saŋ la, baa pa Juda koranar ne nomonome, ne sɔfore ne Korowii keamere, dɛ banɔ la baa jaa dɛ fa so Jerusalam la hoɡaa le ba lalbɔɔne bini.
A fe aa chɛ kɛ bá boa a nyoa dɛ́ ka huɡa la, aa chɔɔ kɛŋɔ haahra aa ɡela harɛ ɛɛ do wer ken harɛ la bobɛlbwa.
Baa pa hoɡa laanee nyenɛ, ásɛ wee ne korobie ne weweela aa do kɛ voɡare a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ aa nyina kohona dɛɛ toma, dɛ kaa bɔɔ ba nyu waa a be la ɛɛ lɔ a ta.
Ásɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena baa ka dɛ́ so harɛ la ta la, banɔ la men Korowii aa lɔ ba peɡre ba so bobɛla ɛɛ dɛɛ nyinu kɛŋɔ, ba fe serewe ɡwaa kɛ ba taa soɡe le.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Wechɔɡa ne deŋnetɛra wa Korowii ŋɔ men Jeremia bol o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Nɛn cholaa, waa berɛ dɛɛ ir kpa aa?
Nɛn nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ aa, waa habɔɔ berɛ aa?
Bɔkwa waa bala nɛra nɔ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa Jerusalam tena ɛɛ le habɔɔ nɔɔ?
Ba sie ta dɛ lɛ waa aa ɛ nyosone ta, baa nyin kɛ bá berɛ ba n be.
N cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no ba be, kɛ baa kasinteŋ bol.
Nomɛlbwa aa lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ charɛ o liiree dɛ́ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa n ɛɔ?’ Bɛlbwa ne o ŋwɛnɛ waa dɛ kpɔ o taa kɛŋɔ jaaɡɔ o sie aa beɡra baa kaa o ne laa ta ken.
Hale chaŋɡale aa dɛ ɡah nyundua ɡba jemɛ komɛlbwa saŋ, ɡɛɛ kwehre ne konkolombiiri bwa ɡe jemɛ saŋ aa kpɔa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe sobɔrfala.
Kɛ n nɛra te aa jemɛ waa maa dɛ nyin dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona ŋɔ he jemɛ wa dɛ jemɛ me Mmarare la ɡeɔ?
Nɛra baa dɛ chwerɛ Mmarare la bera, dɛ́ neɡre heya.
Sihiih ɛɛ kpo wejerema la bwaa, baa wiluu á do kɛŋɔ bel aa laɡ ba.
Baa vɛh n waa la nomanta, ba ta wejema bɛlbwa dɔe kpa.
Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ ba haahnaa tɛ jafala, dɛ kpɔ ba kooni do nɛnfala nɔɔra ta baa nyiŋi a ta.
Nomɛlbwa, le bechale nɛɛ kaa nomonome nɛ, bɛlbwa dɛ nyin kwaa sibeɡra ne.
Hale n keamere ne n sɔfore bwa, ba sie dɛ lɛ nɛra faahra ta.
Ba dɛ jaɡre n nɛra ŋwɛra dɛɛ liira kɛŋɔ a ɛ kure, anomanta, baa lii kɛ a ɛ sibeɡra.
Dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Deŋnesɔɔhna, deŋnesɔɔhna,’ dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna bɛlbwa ɡe toole.
Amɔ sihiih kpo ba ba wedoŋa baa ɛa nɔ ta kenɛ?
Akai, sihiih ta ban kpoe, ba siebɔra ɡba dɛ baɡle kɛ sihiih ta ban kpoe.
Anomanta, baa chɔɡoo kɛŋɔ bane aa chɔɡa la.
Awola maa ba tɛr ba deŋne la, ba wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba a jaɡaa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Dɛ n dɛ nyin n boa nɛra nyoa, kɛŋɔ paa yon komɛ koo kondikwa dɛ boa a nyoa la ken.
Kɛ ba do kɛŋɔ daa waa wola nɔna dɔe, kɛŋɔ fiɡ daa nɔna aa wola toole o ta ken, hale a papooni bwa hol.
Anomanta, n ɡelɔ nɛŋhɔɔhra ba lɛ ba harɛ dɛ so o ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii nɛra la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ ya bwa ta so nɔɔ?
Yá boa ya nyoa.
Hé ɡel ya chwa kaa bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara bini, dɛ́ den ka serewe bela.
Korowii ŋɔ yá na waa dɛ́ serewe, dɛ do tɛɡchɔɡa nee ta tɛ yaa ŋɔ yá nyɔ, wechɔɡa yaa ɛa dɛ jo o nɛɛ la wa.
Deŋnesɔɔhna dɔe taa yaa hwɛɡɛ, kɛ yaa wedɛɛɡa bɛlbwa na.
Ya dɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛ ya dɔ chaeh, ɔmeeree bera ba chole ya nɛ.
Ya dɛ no ya dɔma jaɡre hweera aa nyoa aa kpeɡa, dɛ le bwɛjen Dan ta.
Jaɡ-bala sii kpɔ ɔmee kohona ba ta harɛ la nɛra bwa nɛ baa chel.
Ba balɔ dɛ́ ba chɔɡ ya harɛ ne komɛlbwa waa lɔ o ta, ne bwɛjen la dɛ nɛra baa lɔ o ta bwa.” Korowii bolɔ ja ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no!
Mɛɛ tomɛ he dɔmaa kɛŋɔ harɛkonchɔɡa á ba yo heya.
Domkpuli aa dorome heya, haa wola won vɔwa kabere.” Jeremia bambile chɔɡɔ o nɛra wa N bambile chɔɡɔ kohona, asɛ n loo ku.
Hé no n nɛra wii baa dɛ wi bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii toole Saayɔn kpa kɛɛ?
Saayɔn Kooro ɡe toole bela kɛɛ?” Asɛ Korowii waa ɛ ba kooro la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he kpɔ kwaa he ɡbabir aa ɛa dɛɛ muɡli n baah, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe, dɛ le harɛfala ta nɔɔ?” Nɛra la do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ, “Lɔmɔɡa saŋ kaalɔ, kwaa koma ba a jaɡa, kɛ ya ta lɛɛ dɔe mɔɔ.” Asɛ Jeremia ŋɔ, “Lokua su n bwa, dɛkalkɛ ba chɔɡ n nɛra.
N dɛ wi, n bwara yɔr kohona.
Tɛɛɡa toole Gelead harɛ kɛɛ?
Nɛra baa dɛ chah weela toole bela aa?
Ɛrɛɛ n nɛra ta chaeh dɔe nɔɔ?
Ba ŋwɛra aa won tonɛ.”
Jeremia berɔ ŋɔ, “N nyu bini fe do kɛŋɔ bule bini ne, asɛ n siniire do kɛŋɔ nenapale aa, n fe ɛɛ wiu chɔɔ ne jwaana, kpoora baa kpoo n nɛra la wa.
N dɛ nyin kɛ n fe aa dɔ bobɛl ka so pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ le bela n nɛra aa lole.
Ba bwa waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, dɛ ɛ nɛnchɔɡa ɡbosoroo.
Ba dɛ kpa saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ bá teŋe nyosone kɛŋɔ ba yon harɛ hɛm dɛ́ tao la ken.
Ba ta sɛɛh dɛɛ bol kasinteŋ.” Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “N nɛra ɛ wechɔɡa aa, ba yon berɛ ka ɛ ane ja, baa jemɛ kɛ menee Korowii aa chɛ kɛ bá tom mɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he daamanar kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ berɛ he hwɛɡa kpɔe do he lolanar nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba bɛlbwa ɛ nyosonteŋni, asɛ daamanar ɡe ɛɛ chɔɡ dɔŋa.
Dam dɛ neɡre o dɔŋ, bɛlbwa aa kasinteŋ bol.
Nyosone ɡboo su ba nyoo, baa koh wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta.
Jeremia, nyosonteŋna binii he so, ba nyosone teŋa nomanta, ba vɛɛh mɛ kɛ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Anomanta, Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ do n nɛra nii taa, dɛ́ daah ba na kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ buni do nii ta la ken.
Bɔkwaa mɛɛ ba ɛɛ n nɛra wechɔɡa waa jaɔ?
Ba nyoa wobol do kɛŋɔ hɛm waa dɛ kpo ken, wechɔɡa ɡboo baa bol.
Nyoa wobol ɡbo nee baa lea dɔŋa, kɛ ba bambile bini te ta chaahnɛ, ba dɛ haɡre dɔŋa bela.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ń tɛr ba deŋne waa nɔ wa aa?
A ta chɛ kɛ ń bɔ harɛ waa do ken nɔ nɛra kem aa?
Men Korowiirii bola.” Belaa n ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ wiu dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre bwejena wa, dɛ taa wiile pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, kondɛɛra dibɔra la wa.
A bwa berɛ dimɡbia, nomɛlbwa aa a ta kpɔ, bɛlbwa aa nae ɡbɔɡa ɡe no.
Jumbii bwa iro kaa, kpɔɡ bini ola ɡe bwa chwa kaa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ paɡre Jerusalamee o berɛ dimɡbia, ásɛ kalampoŋare kpɔ bela berɛ a sobɔr, dɛ́ chɔɡ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre, nomɛlbwa aa wola won so a ta.” Asɛ n bɔɔ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, umee dɔ wejema kohona dɛ́ won no waa nɔ mun ɔ?
Umee he le ŋɔ ó won baɡle a bini nɔ?
Bɔkwa waa harɛ nɔ chɔ pɛɛ kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɛra aa wola o ta kpɔ kpa nɔɔ?” Anee Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, “Baa vɛh n webaɡla maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la waa, ba ta duure kpɔe tɛ mɛ, kɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ta.
Kɛ ba ɡarɔ teŋɛ ba bambikpeɡ we-ɛɛla ta.
Voɡa Baalre nɛɛ ba teŋɛ dɛɛ toma, ɡɛ ba naawa aa baɡ ba la.
Anomanta, kenii men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la ɛɛ bol, ‘Mɛɛ do tɛɡchɔɡa kondikwaa ne nee taa tɛ nɛra nɔ ba di.
Mɛɛ lɔ baa peɡre harɛre ba ɡbabir kɛɛ ba naawa aa wola an jemɛ ta.
Dɛ ɡel laa tena ti ba ka tel kɛŋɔ baa kpoo ba bwa kwaraa.’ ” Jerusalam tena wio dɛɛ nyin chae Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
“Hé nyiŋi waa aa chiɡa nɔ!
Hé yerɛ haahna baa dɛ wi, haahna baa jemɛ wiile taara kɛrɛdɛ la, hé yer ba, bá ba.” Anee nɛra la ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ba ba warane, dɛ́ ba taa wiile tɛ yaa, ka tel kɛŋɔ siniire aa su ya sibie dɛɛ yɔɔ yaa.
Hɛ́ɛ no wii ɡbɔɡa aa dɛ le Saayɔn.
Ba ŋɔ, ‘Akwe, ya chɔɡɔ!
Sihiih kpo yaa kɛrɛdɛ.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ yá le ya harɛ nɔ ta, ya soŋnibɔra bwa paɡrɔ.’ ” Belaa Jeremia ŋɔ, “Haahna, hé cheɡ deŋne Korowii be, dɛ́ɛ no waa waa dɛ bol.
Hé chaɡle he bihaahna ɡɛ baa dɛ wi, ne he daamanar ɡɛ baa dɛ taa wiile.
Seo do kɛŋɔ nɛnchɔɡe dɛ che ya tokorore ta jo ya deremi.
Bechale serewɔ chɔ fɔɡbaahna, asɛ bonɔɔna ɡe serewe chɔ cheremibɔra.
Waa Korowii aa ŋɔa n bol laanee nɔ.
‘Nɛra serewɔ chɔ bobɛlbwa kɛŋɔ haahra aa chɔ kpɔɡ bini ken.
A do kɛ nɛra aa kuuɡi boyu a daŋɛ chɔ ba habɔɔ nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ boa a nyoa.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “Wejerema bɛ mbarafo ɛ ba wejema baa dɔa wa, bokpeɡa tena bɛ ba te dɛɛ maŋkura ba bokpeɡa baa dɔa wa, kɛɛ dɔɔh kpɔ o te dawɛ o kondɔɔh ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o te maŋkurae la, wɛɛ maŋkura o te kɛŋɔ o jemɛ men Korowii dɛɛ no n waa mun, dɛkalkɛ n nyina lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
N waa wer dɛ toɡre ɡe, dɛkalkɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛɛ lɛ n sie.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba ń tɛr nɛra baa teŋe ba pena ɡbo, men Korowii wa aa wola toole ba bambile bini la deŋne.
Banee Ijipt ne Juda ne Edom ne Amɔn ne Moab tena, dɛ nɛra baa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ do bojaŋ harɛre ta la.
Dɛkalkɛ a ɡɛ harɛre nɔ nɛra ne Israel tena ta n waa kpɔe do ba bambile bini.”
Korowii ne voɡare wa Jeremia berɔ ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, bá cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ harɛre nɛra bane we-ɛɛla ta dɛɛ teŋɛ.
He bɛ waa aa dɛ chiɡ nyundua, dɛɛ baɡle waane aa ha heya, a lole kɛŋɔ harɛre nɛra bane te dɛ ɔma.
Ba nawee waa bwa ɛ wepuu, ba yon teŋe daa le kɔr bini, ásɛ nɛn waa jemɛ kwaa sɛɛh kpɔ o buni sɛoh.
Ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ɛ o bwara, ó do wer, dɛ kpɔ hamba lɔ dadowɛre do o ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ ó che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ bɛ chole.
Ba ɛa a do kɛŋɔ yakwane baa saɡa koo, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ doŋi jumbii la ken, ba voɡare la aa won waa bol.
Cheɡaa baa chea, dɛkalkɛ aa won valɛ.
He bɛ an dɛɛ ɔmɛ, wobɛlbwa toole á won ɛ, kɛɛ dɛ́ won ɛ wedɛɛɡa ane tɛ heya.” N Naa Korowii, nomɛlbwa ta kpeɡri dɔe kɛ hen, he kan kohona, nɛra bwa jemɛ kpeɡri kohona haa dɔa wa.
Harɛre nɛra bwa Kooro, umee dɛ ŋɔ waa duuree kpɔ tɛɛ nɔ?
A chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa duuri.
Harɛre bwa nɛra ne wejerema dɛ ba koranar, bɛlbwa ta do kɛ hen.
Ba bwa ta liire dɔe dɛ ɛ ɡɛna ɡbo.
Bɔkwaa baa ba wona hweli le daa voɡare baa ɛa, aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe ta nɔ?
Ba yon kpɔ suuɡapoŋa le bwɛjen Taases ne suuɡaswɛm le bwɛjen Ufas ta, dɛ baa ɛ ba voɡare bwara.
Nɛra baa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh, ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ yale sɔeh wejema ɡe, yon kpɔ yaburum ne yakɔl ɛ a bwara.
Kɛ hen N Naa Korowii, he waa dɔ kasinteŋ, henee kooro haa lole saŋ bɛlbwa.
He baah diu waa, harɛ bwa dɛ chel, harɛre nɛra aa won che he bandia nyoa.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ voɡare aa wola wone ta nyundua ne harɛ nɔ la, a dɛ ba chɔɡa le harɛ nɔ ta kwaraa.” Korowii kpɛɛra yel Korowii cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛ ta harɛ, o wejema nee o ta harɛ nɔ bwa, dɛ che o liire ta dɛ paɡri nyundua ɡe.
O bol wa aa, bwaala dɛ nɛ dɛɛ kɔɡre nyundujaɡla, o ɡelɔ baama aa dɛ nɛ bwaala ir dɛɛ le harɛ jaɡa.
O ɡelɔ bwaala ɛɛ nɛ dɛɛ nyɛɡle, asɛ dɛ ɡel peu ta le bela waa lole.
Nomɛlbwa ta liire dɔe, ba ɡɛnɔ, sihiih kpo nɛn waa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa o voɡare la.
Kwaa waa ɛa la bwa ɛ nyosone, a ta hweera dɔe.
A waa ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe, dɛ ɛ kwaa a wa aa dɔ wesoma.
A chɔɡa saŋ telo Korowii ba naa, wɛɛ chɔɡ a bwaa.
Kɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ta do kɛ ban, dɛkalkɛ onee ta komɛlbwa, dɛ le Israel tena tɛ o te, dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ o kapɛrɛ nɛra.
Koranar Bwa Kooroo o sɔn.
Harɛchɔɡ waa dɛ ba Jerusalam tena, hé boa he laala nyoa, dɛ́ le harɛ la ta, he dɔma chɔɔ bar heyaa dɛ́ ba yo heya.
Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ doŋi nɛra baa soɡe harɛ nɔ taa, dɛ́ kpɔ wenaale kohona ba ta ba nɛ, ásɛ ba laɡ ba kaa.” Jerusalam tena dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Ya na wa, bola baa do yaa wa!
Yaa won chah ya ŋwɛra!
Ya liiro kɛ yaa koh ya weela taa, kɛ yaa le a nyoa.
Ya tɛnte deene chɔɡɔ, a ŋwɛɛra bwa chaa.
Ya bii bwa kaalɔ ɡel yaa, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole, dɛ́ baŋre ya tɛnte deene, kɛɛ dɛ́ nyin sobɔra tɛ yaa.” N chaŋɔ ŋɔ, “Ya sitɔɔla bwa nya liire, baa waa bɔɔrɛ dɛɛ le Korowii be.
Anomanta, aa ban kɛrɛdɛ chiɡ, asɛ ba nɛra bwa lɔ peɡre.
Hɛ́ɛ no!
Waane dɛ ba, laa tena ɡbɔɡa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, dɛ́ ba chɔɡ Juda bwɛjena á berɛ dimɡbia, ásɛ kalampoŋare kpɔ bela berɛ a soŋnibɔra.” Jeremia wesoŋa wa N Naa Korowii, nomɛlbwa ta o nyokala kpeɡri dɔe, bɛlbwa ɡe aa won jemɛ o soɡa waa bini.
Kpɔ kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ ta toɡ mɛ, he bandia ne laa, ɡɛ laa aa, hɛɛ chɔɡ mɛɛ.
Gel harɛre nɛra na he bandia, banɔ la baa wola hen tomɛ, dɛ vɛɛh la.
Ba kpoo he nɛra Israel tena dɛ chɔɡ ba harɛ kwaraa.
Korowii ne Jeremia fɔo fɔwa wa Korowii ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no waa aa lɔ n ne he fɔo yaa fɔwa la ta, ásɛ dɛ bol baɡle Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam tena bwa.
Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ ŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa wola waa aa lɔ fɔo nɔ ta teŋɛ la, nyotaahna lawɔ.
A ɛ waa maa do ba naawa ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ waa do wɔrɔbe ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nii aa won buni mwɛɛla la.
N ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, baa duu mɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa maa do ba a ta la ta, ásɛ ba ɛ n nɛra, n ɡe ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ.
Belaa n fe ɛɛ ba harɛ maa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa ŋɔ o ɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe la kpɔe tɛɛ ba ó ɛ ba kon.
Harɛ baa soɡe o ta fini nɔ.” Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, á ɛ ɡɛ.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ka bol ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa Juda bwɛjena ta, ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna.
Bol nɛra la ɡe be ŋɔ bá cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa aa lɔ fɔo nɔ ta kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Le saŋ maa lawɛ ba naawa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba le fini, keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa n kah ba ŋɔ baa duu mɛ.
Kɛ ba ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no n be.
Dɛɛ teŋɛ ba deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla ne wechɔɡa ta.
Anomanta, n kpɔ taahna bwa aa lɔ fɔo la maa do ba ŋɔ ba fe ɛɛ teŋɛ a ta la ba ta ba nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba ta n waa la noɛ.” Anee Korowii berɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Juda ne Jerusalam tena dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa.
Ba charɛ ba liire dɛɛ ɛ ba naawa wechɔɡa baa ɛa la, dɛ vɛh n waa ta teŋa.
Ba kaa teŋɛ voɡare ane nɛɛ dɛɛ toma.
Israel ne Juda tena bwa chɔɡ fɔo n ne ba naawa aa fɔwa la.
Anomanta, men Korowii ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ wekpeɡa baa wola won le a nyoa ba ta ba nɛ.
Ba wio dɛɛ yer mɛ kwaraa naa, maa ba bee no.
Juda bwɛɛre ne nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam ɛɛ wiu yerɛ voɡa baa dɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma a ta laanee, kɛ wekpeɡa la balaa, aa won cha ba.
Juda tena voɡare warɔ kɛŋɔ ba bwɛjena ken, asɛ kwaa baa dɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma a ta dɛɛ tɛ ba sihihvoɡ Baal ɡe warɛ, kɛŋɔ Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna aa wara la.
Jeremia, bɛ nɛra nɔ naa ta che soŋe le n be tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛ ba wio yer mɛ ba sibeɡre wee ta naa, maa ba bee no.
N nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe dɛ́ so n Dea kpa.
Ba ɡalɡa nyu bini kpeɡri, hale dɛ yon kpɔ n saraha kwaa ba fe aa fuh tɛ mɛ la le kaa.
Kɛ dɛ n kpɔ wenaale ba ta ba nɛ aa, ba sie aa lɛ kpa.
N fa ŋɔ ba do kɛŋɔ ɔleve daa waa kpeɡa kohona dɛ dɔ papooni, asɛ nɔndɛɛɡa su o bwa, dɛ do wer.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo peukpeɡ ta kerabeŋkpoŋ, ásɛ nii le o papooni ta, dɛ́ kuuɡi o kpala.
Israel ne Juda tena fa do kɛŋɔ daa men Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dua, kɛ taraken n liiro kɛ ń kpɔ wahala ba ta ba nɛ.
Ba wechɔɡa waa a ɡɛ waa nɔ ɡure ba nyu ta.
Dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo n nɛ, dɛ kaa fuh daawiile voɡ Baal ta dɛɛ muɡli n baah.” Jeremia kpoe vɔrɔwa wa Korowii ɡelɔ men Jeremia jemɛ vɔrɔwa n dɔma aa dɛ vɔrɔwe n wa.
Dɛ n do kɛŋɔ pebie waa pwɛra ba lawɔ dɛɛ kaa kpobɔr ken.
N ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba dɛ vɔrɔwe n bwara wechɔɡa ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya kpo Jeremia ɡɛ ba yon chɔɡ daa ne o nɔna bwa la, dɛ́ kpoo le harɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ o sɔn den he kwaraa.” Ate, Jeremia soŋe ŋɔ, “Koranar Bwa Kooro haa dɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ nyiŋi ɡɛ nɛn liire ne o bambile aa doa, tɛr ba deŋne, dɛ́ bɔ ba kem, dɛkalkɛ he nɔn taa n kpɔ n waa do.
Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ Anatɔt baala bane ŋɔ n bɛ Korowii waa bol o sɔn ta, ɡɛ laa aa baa kpo mɛɛ.” Anomanta, Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee.
Baa kpoo ba bonɔɔna laa taa, lɔr kpo ba bibaala ne bihaahna ɡe ba serewe.
Ba bini bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ba kae, dɛkalkɛ chɔɡa tentenee mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta Anatɔt baala nɛ, ba deŋnetɛra bena la ta.”
Jeremia waa naɡra Jeremia ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, saŋ bɛlbwa maa kpɔ n waa bil he sie la, he konee dɛɛ do som.
Mɛɛ bol he waa bola dɛ́ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta waa.
Ɛrɛɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena wobɛlbwa yon dɛɛ chiɡ ba kɛrɛdɛ nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ nɛnchɔɡa ɛɛ dɔ bosɔɔhna nɔɔ?
Ba do kɛŋɔ daa he kpɔ ba du, he nyiŋi ba nɛɛ ba kpeɡ dɛ dɔ lune dɛɛ nɔnɛ.
Ba nyoo ɡbo nee baa kpɛɛre, kɛ he waa toole ba bambile bini.
N Naa Korowii, kɛ ane a bwa, he jem mɛ, he dɛ na mɛ dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ he waa aa lɔ n bini.
Tɛɡre nɛnchɔɡa la kɛŋɔ peera baa dɛ la ka kpoora!
Lee ba cheɡ ka tel saŋ baa kpoo ba!
Saŋ besoo harɛ nɔ ɛɛ ba hola ka tel mɔɔ kpɔɡa bwa hol ɔ?
Dɛkalkɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena soɡe o ta, a ɡel kpɔɡ bini ola ne jumbii bwa serewe.
A bwa habɔɔ la, nɛra la dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Korowii aa waa aa pu yaa nae ba.’ ” Gɛ Korowii aa chaŋe Jeremia Korowii ŋɔ, “Jeremia, he ne nɛra chwao, he ta ban wone dɛ koh aa, ɛrɛɛ he ne jaɡre ɛɛ ba wona chwa ɔ?
He lɔ naa bɔchaah ta naa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona chwa Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa kɔr bini nɔ?
He dɔɔranar ne nimanar, dɛ he ɡbabir lolanar lee tɛ, ba taa cheɡɛ chiŋ baa mooli.
A lole kɛŋɔ he ne ba bol waa dɛɛ mamɛ, kɛ dɛɛ berɛ ba yaradae.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ vɛh n nɛra Israel tenaa, nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te la.
Mɛɛ lawɛ nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba waa do ba dɔma nɔn ta.
N ɡbabir nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te chwa mɛ, ba do kɛŋɔ nyujente waa lɔ kpɔɡ bini dɛɛ kɔr mɛ, anomanta, n hah ba.
N nɛra maa lee ba tɛ n te do kɛŋɔ jumbie kɔle aa baro cheme dɛ́ yoo.
Hé yerɛ kpɔɡ bini ola á bwa ba cheme dɛ́ di o ola.
Peteɡra kpɔ ba peera ba tiɡri n daa koo do harɛ, kɛŋɔ harɛre ane koranar aa chɔɡ n nɛra la.
A ɡelɔ koo n sie aa dɛ lɛ o ta chɔɡ, dɛ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ.
O berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛ chɔ pɛɛ n siwi ta.
Harɛ la bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, dɛkalkɛ nomɛlbwa waane laa o wa.
Laa tena baa wara lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ deŋɡarere dor, dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba chɔɡ nɛra ne kwa.
Men Korowiirii kpɔ ba dɛɛ ba, bá ba yoo ba, dɛ́ chɔɡ harɛ la bwa ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ deŋnesɔɔhna dɔ.
N nɛra ɛɛ du meaa, kɛ sɔɔhnee baa ba koma, dɛ́ koh pɛɛpɛɛ baa wola komɛlbwaa dɔ.
N bandia kohona nomanta, ba koo kondikwaa bwa chɔɡɔ sihiih kpo ba.” Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa, ba so bar harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ n nɛra Israel tena ba ba chɔɡo la, mɛɛ le ba ne ba harɛre taa, kɛŋɔ ba yon fuɡri dua la ken, dɛ́ lɛ Juda tena le ba bini.
A habɔɔ, mɛɛ berɔ dɔ tedoma tɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa, dɛ́ berɛ ba ba ne ba buɡ ta.
Ásɛ bɛlbwa kaa o nɛra bini, ne harɛ waa le o ta.
Kɛ dɛ ba wono charɛ ba liire dɛ hweli n nɛra we-ɛɛla, dɛ won dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ n sɔn ta ŋɔ, ‘N ta aa lole saŋ bɛlbwa’ nɔ ɡɛ ba fa aa baɡle n nɛra ba yon ŋwɛɛ voɡ Baal la aa, amɔ ba ɡee ja n nɛra nɛɛ, ásɛ ba wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no aa, mɛɛ le ba nee kɛŋɔ baa fuɡri dua ken, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Yapondɛɛɡe kiriso wa Korowii berɔ bol men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ka yawɛ yapondɛɛɡe dɛ́ ɛo kiriso vɔwɛ he chara.
Bɛ ɡel nee leɡo.” Anomanta, n kaa yawɛ yapondɛɛɡe kiriso la, dɛ kpɔ vɔwɛ n chara, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ n be la.
Belaa o berɛ bol waa n be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ kiriso haa yawa dɛɛ vɔwɛ chara la, dɛ́ kpɔ kaa Yufretis Moo ta ka sɔh o bwebɔɔne bini taraken.” Anomanta, n laŋɔ dɛ ka kpɔ do Yufretis Moo bwebɔɔ bini, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ n be la.
A habɔɔ la, Korowii berɔ bol waa n be ja ŋɔ, “La Yufretis Moo ta ka kpɔ kiriso maa ɡela he kpɔ ka sɔh la ba.” Anomanta, n laŋɔ dɛ ka kwi bela maa kpɔa huɡe la.
Kɛ dɛ o bwa chɔɡɔ kwaraa, o ta wobɛlbwa ɛɛ doe.
Belaa Korowii bol waa n be ja ŋɔ, “Gɛ kiriso la aa chɔɡa la, ɡɛ tentenee mɛɛ ba Juda ne Jerusalam tena baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo la chɔɡa.
Gɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔ vɛh n waa ta teŋa.
Ba deŋne kpeɡri, ba nyu bini do kpeɡri kohona, asɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ harɛre ane voɡare.
Anomanta, baa doo kɛŋɔ kiriso waa chɔɡa, waa wola ɛɛ doe kpa la ken.
Gɛ ba yon kpɔ kiriso vɔwɛ chara la, ɡɛɛ n lawɛ Israel ne Juda tena vɔwɛ n te.
Ásɛ ba fe ɛ n nɛra, dɛ́ kpɔ kpɛɛra ne duure tɛ mɛ.
Kɛ ba vɛh n waa noe.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Sen loŋa ane wa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Jeremia, ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ sen loŋ bɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé do sen o bini ó su.
Baa chaŋo ŋɔ ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ sen loŋ bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ ó su sen. Ásɛ he berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Korowii dɛ ba ɡela nɛra baa soɡe harɛ la ta dɛɛ, kɛŋɔ baa nyɔ sen ken.
Hale koranar baa ɛ Kooro Devid naanar, ne sɔfore ne n keamere, dɛ banɔ la baa soɡe Jerusalam bwa jao.
Mɛɛ laɡ baa lɔ dɔŋa, kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ loŋa lɔ dɔŋa a paɡre la ken.
Hale mɛɛnanar ne ba bii bwa.
Maa bɛlbwa sumii na, kɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ tedoma tɛ nomɛlbwa ŋɔ maa ban chɔɡ.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Jeremia ja nɛra mbarafo ɛɛ wa Israel tena, Korowiirii bol waa la.
Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no o be, he bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ. Hé tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ jirima mɔɔ o ɡel bɔr bir, ásɛ he bɛ naa lɔ deŋɡarere dor.
Hé dɛ nyin kɛ bɔr chaah he nɛ, kɛ wɛɛ berɔ ɡel bɔr chaahna la berɛ biro ta he nɛ, dɛ́ bir kpirkpir ken.
Kɛ dɛ he vɛh o waa la noe yaa, sɔeh mɛɛ ba sɔeh dɛ́ wi, he mbarafo wa.
Mɛɛ wiu kohona siniire yɔɔ mɛ, lawa baa lawɛ Korowii nɛra laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta la wa.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ ń ŋɔ kooro ne o nya be ŋɔ, “Hé le he kookane ta tu ba, dɛkalkɛ he kooɡbɛrɛre aa wera dɛ́ ba he nyuune ta lee.” Baa tɔɔɡe Juda weekaŋle harɛbɔr bwɛjena ɡbenii baa wola won yaa, dɛkalkɛ ba dɔma baa chɔ bar bwɛɛ la.
Baa lawɛ Juda tena bwaa kaa bojaŋ harɛfala ta.
Hé ha sie nyiŋi, he dɔma le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba.
Leperaa nɛra baa lɔ he nɔn ta, he koh ba waa dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo la dɔɔ?
Dɛ nɛra haa dɛ lii ba he daamanar baa yo heya, dɛ pɔ he nɛɛ he do ba lɔɡa aa, bɔkwa waa hɛɛ ba bola ɔ?
Hɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ wɛɛ ba lola ken.
Kɛ he berɔ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ pu yaa nɔɔ?” He wechɔɡa kohona waa he bwara laala kɛɛ, a ɡel he bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ kohona la.
Itiopia te ɛɛ won charɛ bwadabi aa?
Kɛɛ noniete ŋɔ waa nyin kɛ o bwara lɛɡre aa?
Gɛɛ he nɛra wechɔɡa aa jooɡe heyaa nɔ aa wola won ɡel hɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
“Mɛɛ lɔ heyaa peɡre kɛŋɔ, peu yon ta haahra ɛɛ kaa la ken.
Anɔ la aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé dɔ laanee la, anee n maɡɛ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ he vɛɛh mɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡare a wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡbaa he bwara laalaa kaa nyundua, ásɛ nɛra na he ncho dii, sihiih kpo heya.
N jemɛ he jwamane ne pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla wa.
Dɛ na ɡɛ haa tomɛ voɡa deŋɡarere dor ne kpɔɡ bini ba fe aa kia la.
Jerusalam tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ.
Saŋ besoo he kah doŋa ka tel ɔ?”
Hwel ne lɔr dɛ laa wa Waa Korowii aa bol men Jeremia be, hwel bɛl waa dɛ́ ba cheɡa waa nɔ.
O ŋɔ, “Juda harɛ nɛra dɛ wi, o bwɛjena nɛra bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ, ba chɔ harɛ di suna dɛɛ ɡbaɡre, harɛ la chɔɡa wa, asɛ Jerusalam tena wi dɛɛ nyin chae.
Nomonjena tomɛ ba bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá ka nyin ne.
Ba la kwaa aa won nee lɛɛ ta ba ta nee nae.
Ba kpɔ ba polviine berɛ ba pɛɛ, ba bambile chɔɡɔ ba hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ kwaa bɔle nyuune, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba loo kuu.
Harɛ la holɔ dɛɛ peɡri dɛkalkɛ bwaala aa nɛ, asɛ paara bambile chɔɡ, dɛ kpɔ kwaa bɔle nyuune, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba loo kuu.
Hale kweɡlinee chwao ɡel o bifola, dɛkalkɛ kpɔɡa toole ó chwe.
Kpɔɡ bini keeɡore cheɡɛ deŋɡarere dor, dɛɛ hɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ kalampoŋare ken, aa won na kɛrɛdɛ dɛkalkɛ kpɔɡa toole á chwe.
N nɛra wio dɛɛ noo mɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, a lole kɛŋɔ ya wechɔɡa ɡelɔ ya di bolchɔɡe, koh he sɔndɛɛɡe la wa dɛ́ cha yaa.
Dɛkalkɛ ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoe kohona.
He ɡbo nɛɛ ya Israel tena sie dawɛ, he ɡboo lɛ yaa dɛɛ le wenaale ta.
Ɛrɛɛ he do kɛŋɔ hɔɔh harɛ nɔ ta kɛɛ nɛŋkaa waa baa so ya bini tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he do kɛ nɛn waane aa piɡru, kɛɛ banyoo waa wola kpeɡe dɛ́ won lɛ o nɛra nɔɔ?
N Naa Korowii, kasinteŋ he ja ya nɛ, he sɔn dawɛ ya nɛ, anomanta, bɛ yaa vɛh.’ ” Korowii bol nɛra nɔ waa ŋɔ, “Ba dɛ nyin bá chwa le n be, dɛ́ kaa valɛ bobɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.
Anomanta, men Korowii sie aa ba nɛɛ lɛ, mɛɛ lii ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa waa dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ wedɛɛɡa soŋa dɛ́ tɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ.
A lole kɛŋɔ ba dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, kɛ maa wii baa wia dɛɛ noo mɛ laanee no.
Ba fuh sarahare dɛ ɛ mea sarahare dɛɛ tɛ mɛ, kɛ n sie aa a ta lɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpoo ba laa ta, ásɛ lɔr ne weechɔɡa ɡe kpoo ba.” Anee n ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, keamere la bane teŋɔ dɛɛ bol nɛra la be ŋɔ, baa laa kɛɛ lɔr bɛlbwa nae ba, dɛkalkɛ ba ŋɔ he baɡ ba nyoa ŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ɡboo dɛ́ do ya harɛ nɔ ta.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Keamere la teŋe nyosone dɛɛ bol wa n sɔn ta.
N ta ban tomɛ kɛɛ dɛ lee ba, n ta wobɛlbwa ɡe bolɛ ba be.
Waa baa dɛ na chaahna ta, ne anɔ la aa chiɡ kerekere, dɛ voɡa toma waa baa dɛ bol la bwa ɛ waa ba ɡbaɡba aa liira.
Anomanta, waa men Korowii aa dɛ bol keamere baa dɛ bol waa n sɔn ta dɛɛ teŋe nyosone laanee nɔ.
N ta ban tomɛ, kɛ ba dɛ bol ŋɔ laa kɛɛ lɔr aa harɛ nɔ taa ba.
Kɛ a ɡɛ keamere la, baa kpoo ba laa taa, lɔr ɡe kpo ba, ba serewe.
Laa ne lɔr la nomanta, nɛra baa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡ ba la ɡe ɛɛ serewoo, ásɛ ba paa ba ta Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna.
Nomɛlbwa aa lee do dɛ́ huɡe ba ne ba haahna ne bibaala dɛ bihaahna bwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔ ba nyubinikpeɡ baa ɛa la kembɔr kɛrɛdɛ.” Korowii do mɛ ŋɔ, ń bol n suna maa dɛ di waa ba be ŋɔ, “Siniire dɛ yɔɔ mɛ chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa aa wola tonɛ, n nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba, kɛŋɔ bitolo waa wola baa bɛlbwa jemɛ, ba doo bol kohona la wa.
N leɔ kaa kpɔɡ bini naa, n dɛ na nɛra baa kpoo ba laa ta, n berɔ ba bwɛjen la bini ɡe aa, n dɛ na nɛra lɔr aa kpo ba ba serewe.
Korowii keamere ne sɔfore bwa lɔ harɛ la ta, baa jemɛ waa Korowii aa ŋɔa bá ɛ.” Nɛra la bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he deno vɛh Juda tena kwaraa kɛɛ?
He hah Saayɔn tena ɡe aa?
Ɛrɛɛ he do yaa bola yaa wola won dɔ chaeh nɔɔ?
Ya fe dɔ hwɛɡa kɛŋɔ yaa dɔ deŋnesɔɔhnaa, kɛ yaa wedɛɛɡa bɛlbwa na, dɛɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ ya dɔ chaeh saŋ bɛl, kɛ waa aa do ɔma kohona ɡboo yaa na.
Ya na ya wechɔɡa ne ya naawa bolchɔɡe baa dia, ya bwa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛɛ kohona.
Lii nyoa haa baɡɛ yaa la, dɛ bɛ yaa nyiŋi vah, bɛ ɡel Jerusalam tena di sihiih, belaa he kookara che dɛ dɔ jirima la.
Bɛ fɔo ya ne haa fɔwa la chɔɡ.
Harɛre voɡare aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe ɛɛ won ɡel bwaala nɛ aa?
Nyundua ɡe ɡbo ɛɛ won ɡel bwaala wir aa?
Akai, hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ ɡbosoroo dɛ won ɛ.
Ya hwɛɡa bwa lɔ he nɛ, dɛkalkɛ he ɡboo wona dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa.”
Wekpeɡa aa dɛ ba Juda tena nɛɛ wa Belaa Korowii bol n be ŋɔ, “Hale Mosis ne Samoɛl ba fa aa ɛ n bonɔɔna baa che n sie dɛɛ soŋe kwaraa naa, maa nɛra nɔ nɛɛ sune.
Gel ba kaa, bá le n sie bonɔ kaa.
Asɛ dɛ ba bɔɔre ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa yaa ba kaala aa,’ hé ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘Weechɔɡaa dɛ́ kpoo bane, baa kpoo bane ɡe laa taa, ásɛ lɔr kpoo bane ɡe, mɔɔ ba lawɛ bane laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛre ta.’ Men Korowii ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ wekpeɡa bele anaarɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɡela ba na.
Baa kpoo ba laa taa, ásɛ nyootena tuɡ ba ka ta.
Jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini olaa dɛ́ di ba ola kabora.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre nɛra bwa bambile teŋe ba wa, waa Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea bibaa Manasɛ aa ɛa Jerusalam la wa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Jerusalam tena, umee dɛ́ sune he nɛɛ jaɔ?
Nomɛl lole dɛ́ wi tɛ heya aa?
Umee dɛ́ bɔɔ heyaa he bokpeɡa dɔe waa jaɔ?
He berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, he deno na teŋɛ dɛɛ vɛɛh mɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee dawɛ he nɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ heya, maa won dɔ tedoma tɛ heyaa kpa.
Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ lɔ heyaa peɡre, ɡɛ ba yon palɛ mea la ken, bwɛjen doonyojena la ta.
Mɛɛ kpoo he ne he biirii, dɛkalkɛ he ta liire charɛ le he wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo luhaahna warɛ harɛ la ta, dɛ́ ɡwaa mpo nyoa hɛŋle.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔm ba chɔɡ bonɔɔna ne ba nyare webaŋkpelaa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bambiteŋa ne ɔmee kohona ba ta he nɛ.
Bii banuanɛ nya bwara ɛɛ yɔroo ó hwaahɡe.
Webaŋkpela ɛɛ berɔ jwaanaa, ásɛ sihiih kpoo o bambile ɛɛ weo.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma ba kpoo he bini banɔ la baa kaa la.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Asɛ men Jeremia ŋɔ, “Akwe, n nya, n na waa kɛ haa lol mɛ, harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa hah mɛ dɛɛ yoo mɛ.
N ta bɛl kon kemɛ kɛɛ dɛ kemɛ le bɛl be, kɛ nɛra bwa ɡarɔ dɛɛ taah mɛ.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, mɛɛ lɛ heyaa, ásɛ wobɛlbwa maɡre tɛ heya, dɛ́ ɡel he dɔma ba ɡuŋi heyaa harɛ, he wenaale ne suna dii tɔpera ta.
Umee dɛ́ won ku buni ɔ?
Gɛɛ haa wola won yo he dɔma baa do kɛŋɔ buni ayaawa aa koo o ta o do kpeɡri, ba le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
He wechɔɡa aa kana harɛ la ta bwa nomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo dɔma pa he kondɔɔh, ne laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa, ásɛ a ɛ deŋnetɛra tɛ heya.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he do he dɔma lɔɡa dɛɛ tom ba harɛfale haa wola o ta jemɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ n bandia iro dɛɛ fuh kɛŋɔ nii dɛɛ ba he nɛ.” Belaa men Jeremia ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he ɡbabir jemɛ waa nɔ mun, lii n wa, dɛ́ nyiŋi n nɛ.
Bɔ n dɔma baa dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo kem.
Bɛ so nyiŋi bá dɔ bɔr dɛ́ ba kpo mɛ, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ he waa mɛɛ na anɔ bwa.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ, haa bol waa n be la, n cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ noa.
A ɛɛ mɛ silɛɛ n bambile lawa, dɛkalkɛ henee dɔɔ mɛ.
N laa n te kpɔ nɛra baa soɡa dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa, dɛɛ hɛɡre kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛra bini.
N ɡbo soɡo, dɛkalkɛ he ja n nɛ, asɛ bwaawee far mɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ n bonyɛɡa aa wola tonɛ, asɛ ba do mɛ bol kohona, maa wola chaah dɔ nɔɔ?
He do kɛŋɔ nenabɔɔ kɛɛ bule hwel saŋ, nee aa wola toole a ta tɛ mɛ kɛɛ?” Anomanta, waa Korowii aa dɛ bol men Jeremia be laanee nɔ, “He berɔ ba n be naa, mɛɛ lɛɛ, ásɛ he berɛ ɛ n keame.
He dɛ bol wobodɛɛɡa, dɛ anchɔɡa laa aa, hɛɛ bol n waa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
Gel nɛra nɔ no, dɛ́ ba he be, he te laa dɛ́ la ba be.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ danjwɛkpeɡ tɛ nɛra nɔ, danjwɛkpeɡ tenten baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo.
Baa yoi kɛ baa won pɔ he nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ le nɛnchɔɡa nɔn ta, dɛ́ ɡel ba nyubinikpeɡ waa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe bwa ɛ pɛɛ.”
Wenaale tɔpere Belaa Korowii berɛ bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé mo haah dɛ́ lolɛ bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna Juda harɛ ta bonɔ.” Dɛkalkɛ waa Korowii aa bol bibaala ne bihaahna baa lol ba harɛ nɔ ta, ne ba nyare dɛ ba mɛɛnanar be laanee teŋa nɔ.
“Weechɔɡaa dɛɛ ba ba kpoora, nomɛlbwa aa ban wi kɛɛ dɛ huɡ ba, ásɛ a chɔ kɛŋɔ puldoa haahra aa ɡela harɛ ɛɛ do wer.
Laa kɛɛ lɔree dɛ́ kpo ba bá serewe, ásɛ ba ola berɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola kondikwa.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Lwe ba dem bɛl ta naa, bɛ bela jo.
Bɛ lokua dɔ tɛ nomɛlbwa, maa andɛɛɡaa swee tɛ n nɛra ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna, kɛɛ dɛ baɡle n nyina kɛɛ dɛ sune ba nɛɛ kpa.
Suuɡa tena ne nyaara bwaa dɛɛ ba serewa he harɛ nɔ ta.
Nomɛlbwa aa ban huɡe kɛɛ dɛ́ wii ba.
Bɛlbwa aa konee kpɔ mɔn o te kɛɛ dɛ́ fonɛ o nyu, á baɡle kɛ o dɛ di suna.
Nomɛlbwa aa kondikwaa kɛɛ senee yawɛ tɛ o dɔŋ bɛl o lole aa sewa wa, dɛ́ kpɔ larawo bwara.
Bɛlbwa aa o dɔŋ bwaraa larawe, hale nɛn o nya kɛɛ o mɛɛ aa sewa wa.
Bɛ dem nɛra aa cheme bela dɛɛ di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ ba sie jo.
He ne ba bɛ pɛ so dɛ́ di kwa kɛɛ dɛ́ nyɔ sen. Anomanta, no waa men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la aa dɛ bol.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo hɛɡra ne silɛɛ ɡbɔɡa, dɛ hanfalwaa mun chema dɛɛ lɛ sie bwa ba a jaɡa.
Nɛra baa lɔ bonɔ ɛɛ na ɡɛ waa nɔɔ, á ɛ ba siwi ta.
He bol waa nɔ baɡ ba aa, baa bɔɔre waa aa bala men Korowii ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ ń tɛr ba deŋne kohona.
Dɛ berɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ wechɔɡa besoo bolchɔɡee ba di, webesoo ba ɛ dɛ jo men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ nɛɔ?
Asɛ he ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘He naawa aa berɛ habɔɔ kpo men Korowii dɛ ka teŋɛ voɡare nɛɛ dɛɛ toma la waa.
Ba vɛɛh mɛ dɛ ɡel me Mmarare ta teŋa, kɛ he wedoŋa berɔ ɡwaa anɔ la he naawa aa ɛa.
He bwa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, haa men duu.
Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ heyaa ka ta harɛfale he naawa aa wola o ta jemɛ bwa ta, ásɛ he kaa tomɛ voɡare bela chɔɔ ne jwaana.
Maa he nɛɛ suna ba!’ ” Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ nɛra aa n sɔn taa dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ men Korowii maa lole saŋ bɛlbwa laanee fa lawɛ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta kpa.
Kɛ baa berɔ ŋwɛɛ n sɔn taa ŋɔ men Korowii maa lole saŋ bɛlbwa laanee lawɛ Israel tena le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr harɛ ta, ne harɛre waa lɔ ba peɡre a ta la ta.
Mɛɛ berɔ kpɔ ba ba harɛ ba ɡbaɡba aa le o ta, n kpɔ tɛ ba naawa la.” Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo dɔma baa wara ba lawɛ nɛra nɔ, kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ nee toma yon dɛɛ lawɛ pɛŋa la ken.
Dɛ́ ɡel dɔma ɡaaɡe ba bɔr bwea ne deŋɡarere dɛ bwebɔɔne bwa ta, kɛŋɔ kpaahna yon dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ́ kpo la ken.
Korowii dɛ na waa bwa baa dɛ ɛ, a bwa chɔ o sie.
Gɛɛ baa wola won kpɔ ba wechɔɡa ɡe sɔɔh.
Dɛ wɛɛ bɔ ba kem bele anɛɛ, ba nyubinikpeɡ ne wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa, dɛkalkɛ ba teŋɛ voɡare waa kia aa wola mkpa dɔe nɛ, a su harɛ la bwa dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaoh.
Jeremia hwɛɡa waa dɔ Korowii nɛɛ wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, henee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa, dɛ do kɛ danjwɛkpeɡ n chwa baa marɛ n sibeɡra wee.
Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ le harɛ jaɡaa dɛ́ ba he be ba ŋɔ, “Ya naawa ta komɛlbwa dɔe, ka ja voɡare aa ɛ konsale aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe ta.
Nɛwɛnyina ɛɛ won kwaa voɡa tɛ ba te naa?
Ɔɔh, kɛ a bwa ɛ konsale.” Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ a do tenaa, mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre la nɛra na n kpeɡri ne n kan maa doa kohona, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii aa chɛ kɛ bá tom mɛ.”
Juda tena wechɔɡa ne ba deŋnetɛra wa Korowii ŋɔ, “Juda tena, ba kpɔ buni chwerɛ he wechɔɡa dawɛ he bambili ta, dɛ kpɔ kwɛrboɔ dia ɡwine dawɛ nyeɡlare aa paaɡe saraha kwaa loŋkoni la ta.
He nɛra laŋɔ kaa tomɛ kwaa haa dɛ ɛ sarahare a ta, ne voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa baa paaɡa dajena mune ne deŋɡarere, dɛ bwejena bwa dor.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma ba kpɔ he kondɔɔh, ne laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa, dɛ bwejena dor haa dɛ tomɛ voɡare la do ba nɔn ta, he wechɔɡa bwa haa ɛa harɛ la ta wa.
Hɛɛ paŋɛ harɛ maa kwaara cheɡ heya o ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon laanee.
Mɛɛ kpɔ heyaa do he dɔma lɔɡa hɛɛ tom ba, harɛ haa wola o ta jemɛ bwa ta, dɛkalkɛ he ɡelɔ n baah di, waa wola sɔɔh bwa.” Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee.
“Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te dawɛ nɛwɛnyini nɛ, dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ o bokpeɡa ta dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo men Korowii la, o bwɛɛlɛ.
Naate ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ dajeɡa waa cheɡɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Wobɛlbwa aa werii do tɛo.
Harɛ waa hola dɛ peɡri, nomɛlbwa aa wola won so o ta, komɛlbwa ɡe aa wola won kpeɡ o ta la, o taa wɛɛ ba cheɡa.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te dawɛ n nɛɛ la, o na som.
Naate ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ daa baa duu nee nyoa, o dɛ ta lune kaa nee la ta.
Hwel cheɡɔ waa, aa on wobɛlbwa ɛ, dɛ o te ta dɔ papooni.
Bwaala ta nɛɛ benanyobir kwaraa naa, dɛ o ta won nɔna.
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ nɛwɛnyini bambile bini waɔ?
Wobɛlbwa toole o bini ka ja neɡra ɡbo, nomɛlbwa aa wola won kwaaro.
Men Korowii te, n dɛ nyiŋi nɛn liire bini, dɛ́ jemɛ anɔ la bwa aa lɔ o bambile ta.
Dɛ́ che bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla ta tɛo, o kembɔr ɡɛ aa chɛo.” Nɛn waa dɛ nyin suuɡa sibeɡra ne la, o do kɛŋɔ jal waa tee hala aa wola o kwaa ɛɛ.
Naate soɡa bini tama la, wɛɛ paŋɛ o kondɔɔh laanee, ásɛ a habɔɔ ó na kɛ o ɛ ɡɛnewa.
Jeremia ŋɔ, “Saŋ la bwaa Korowii Dea yaa dɛ tomɔ o bini do kɛŋɔ kookara Korowii jirima aa lɔ o ta, asɛ o che bwejen doa.
N Naa Korowii, he nɛɛ Israel tena sie dawɛ, sihiih ɛɛ kpo nɛra baa berɛ habɔɔ kpoe bwaa.
Nɛra baa chwaa le he be bwa sɔna ɛɛ nyoɡroo kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa ken.
Dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh hen haa do kɛ nee waa dɛ bule saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ tɛ Israel tena.
N Naa Korowii, chaah mɛ ásɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Lɛɛ mɛ ásɛ n dɔ bosɔɔhna kohona, dɛkalkɛ henee mɛɛ kpɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Juda tena teŋɔ dɛɛ bol n be ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa waa Korowii aa ŋɔa aa chiɡu la dɔɔ?
Gel á ba ya na.’ N ta vɛɛh kɛŋɔ mɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre, maa nyin kɛ he kpɔ sibeɡra tɔpere bɛlbwa ba ba nɛ.
Wobɛlbwa aa le n nyoa la chɔ he sie.
Bɛ men ɔmee kohona dɛɛ do, henee n chwa baa marɛ sibeɡra tɔpere.
Gel sihiih kpo nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛ, kɛ bɛ ɡel sihiih kpo mɛ.
Gel ɔmee laɡ ba kohona, dɛ laa ɔmee kohona kpɔ n nɛ.
Gel ba na he sibeɡra tɔpere la, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, dɛ́ berɛ chɔɡ ba ja.” Ona Tɔpere dii wa Waa Korowii aa bol men Jeremia be laanee nɔ.
“Ir la ka che doonyojen baa dɛ yerɔ Nɛra Doonyoa, bela Juda koranar aa kpɔa jo dɛɛ le, ásɛ dɛ ka che Jerusalam doonyojena bwa ɡe ta, dɛ́ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no Korowii wa, hé Juda koranar ne nomɛlbwa waa soɡe Jerusalam dɛ che doonyoa nɔ ta dɛɛ jo bwa.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ bone che Ona Tɔpere, kɛɛ dɛɛ che bone dɛɛ kpɔ Jerusalam doonyojena ta.
He bɛ bone bɛlbwa kpɔ le he deremi ta, kɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma Ona Tɔpere la ta.
Hé ɡel ó do ɡoroŋ ɡɛ maa do he naawa la.
Kɛ ba ta deŋne cheɡɛ, ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, ba ta n be noɛ á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa hweli waanee le n be.
Kɛ dɛ he cheɡ deŋne dɛ no n be, he ta bone bɛlbwa kpɔe kpɔ bwɛjen nɔ doonyojena ta Ona Tɔpere ta, dɛ ɡel tɔpere la do ɡoroŋ, he ta toma bɛlbwa o ta ɛɛ yaa, amɔ bwɛjen nɔ doonyojena taa koranar baa soɡe Kooro Devid kookara ta, ne ba nomonome ɛɛ ba kpɔe dɛɛ jo.
Ba ne ba nomonome ɛɛ so jaɡre ne kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore taa ba, ásɛ Juda baala ne nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam bwa ɡe ja, ásɛ nɛra so bwɛjen nɔ ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Nɛra ɛɛ le Juda bwɛɛre ne bwɛjeɡre aa bar Jerusalam, ne Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ne wee cholibɔr bwea lɔɡre bwɛɛre, ne deŋɡarere harɛ, dɛ Nɛɡɛv waa ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ne anɔ la baa kpoora, ne mea sarahare, ne daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, dɛ jam saraharee ba Korowii Dea.
Kɛ dɛ he taŋ deŋne he ta Ona Tɔpere la dii o do ɡoroŋ, dɛ che bone dɛɛ jo Jerusalam doonyojena la ta naa, amɔ mɛɛ choŋi nii aa wola dime bwaa Jerusalam doonyojena bwa ta, ásɛ dekpeɡa bwa fuh.’ ”
Jeremia la vimamaa bɛl dem Korowii berɔ bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ́ la vimamaa dem, belaa mɛɛ ba n bol waa he be.” Anomanta, n iro dɛ tu la vimamaa la dem, dɛ ka na kɛ o soɡo dɛɛ ma.
Kɛ dɛ o baa na kɛŋɔ vii la bɛlbwa ta kɛrɛdɛ doe o be naa, o yon chɔɡo dɛ́ berɛ kwaa kpɔ ma konfale bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin.
Belaa Korowii bol waa n be ŋɔ, “Israel tena, maa won ɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ mamaa nɔ aa ɛa nɔ naa?
Gɛ choh yon do mamaa nɔn ta la, ɡɛɛ he Israel tena ɡe do n nɔn ta.
Dɛ saŋ bɛlbwa n ŋɔ mɛɛ chɔɡ harɛ bɛl nɛraa, dɛ́ paɡro dɛ́ kuuɡi o bwa, dɛ ɡɛ harɛ nɛra la berɔ charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta naa, amɔ te mɛɛ ɡeloo, dɛ́ nyiŋi wenaale n fe aa ŋɔa mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta ba nɛɛ la ta.
Gɛɛ dɛ n ŋɔ mɛɛ che harɛ bɛl nɛra habɔɔ dɛ́ ɡel ba won vɔrɔwe ba bwɛɛ la ó che kiŋkiŋ, kɛ dɛ harɛ la nɛra berɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa baa men duu aa, mɛɛ ɡel wedɛɛɡa n fe aa ŋɔa mɛɛ ɛo tɛɛ ba laanee.
Anomanta, ŋɔ Juda tena ne nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam be ŋɔ kenii men Korowii ɛɛ bol, ‘Hé na, n dɛ ba ń kpɔ wenaale ane ba ta he nɛ, dɛ́ɛ vɔrɔwe he vɔrɔwa ɡe.
Anomanta, bɛlbwa charɛ o liire dɛ́ ɡel o ŋwɛnɛre ne o we-ɛɛla do wer.’ Kɛ baa chaŋo ŋɔ, ‘A bɛlbwa ta tɔnɔ dɔe.
Ya ɡbabir ɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi ya we-ɛɛla taa, ásɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ teŋɛ o bambikpeɡ ne o wechɔɡa waa ta.’ ” Anomanta, waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
“Bɔɔ harɛre nɛra ŋɔ, ‘Umee no waa nɔ dɔŋa kaɔ?
Israel tena fe ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, kɛ ba ɛ wedoŋa ne waa aa wola were kohona.
Lɛbanɔn dombwea bwa won mwɛɛla le o bwejena dor kwaraa naa?
Lɛbanɔn bwejena neerare aa sɔna dɛ palɛ dɛɛ le a ta la ɛɛ won ɡel pala aa?
Kɛ n nɛra te soh n wa.
Ba fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ voɡa a wa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe.
Ba lɔ na, dɛ ɡel ŋwɛnɛbena la ta kpɔe, dɛ kaa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛfala baa wola a ta jemɛ ta.
Ba harɛ ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbiaa, dɛ́ berɛ waa nɛra aa na dɛɛ mamɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, ásɛ nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa bwa nyoa kpo dɛɛ viiɡi nyuune.
Gɛ peu yon ta le wee leebɔr la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba ba lɔe peɡre ba dɔma sie.
Ba wenaale tɔpere ta la, mɛɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo ba, maa n sie berɛ dɛ́ cha ba.’ ” Asɛ nɛra la bane ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya vɔrɔwe Jeremia vɔrɔwa, dɛkalkɛ sɔfore waa baa dɛ bol la ɛɛ do lee, wejerema ɡe webaɡla aa tonɛ, ɡɛɛ Korowii keamere ɡe waa la ɛɛ ba cheɡa.
Anomanta, hé ɡel ya nyin waane dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel waa waa dɛ bol la noe.” Anomanta, men Jeremia soŋɔ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no waa nɛra baa hah mɛ aa dɛ bol.
A chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ wechɔɡa bɔ wedɛɛɡa kem aa?
Kɛ ba kwi nafuɡe dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ lawɛ.
Lii kɛŋɔ n fa cheɡɛ he sie, dɛ bol ba waa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ, hé laa he bandia kpɔ ba nɛ.
Anomanta, ɡel lɔr kpoo ba bii, kɛɛ ba serewe laa ta.
Gel ba haahna ɛ luhaahna dɛ bɛ bii dɔ, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ba kpoo ba jaranar, ásɛ ba bonɔɔna ɡe serewe laa ta.
Gel ba dɔma piɡri lɔ ba tɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ pa ba laala, ásɛ ɔmee laɡ ba baa dooɡe lɔŋɔre, dɛkalkɛ ba kwi nafuɡe dɛ sɔh har mɛ bela, dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ lawɛ.
Kɛ hen Korowii, he te jemɛ vɔrɔwa bwa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe dɛ́ kpo mɛ.
Bɛ ba dichɔɡa kpɔ kɛ ba, kɛɛ dɛ́ fee ba wechɔɡa he sie.
Gel ba choɡli chɔ he sie, ásɛ dɛ che he bandia ta tɛr ba deŋne kohona.”
Jeremia ne leo bɛl waa paɡra wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ir la ka yawɛ leo le o mamaa be.
Kpɔ bwɛjen la nomonome ne sɔfore la bane ja he nɛ, ásɛ he la Jerusalam Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen waa bɛne Kaŋli Doonyoa la ta.
He tel bela aa, hé bol waa maa bol he be la.
Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Juda koranar ne Jerusalam tena, hé bwa cheɡ deŋne no men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ aa dɛ bol.
N dɛ ba wenaale kpɔe ba ta harɛ nɔ ta, á ɡel nomɛlbwa waa no la, o bwara yɔr kohona.
Waa maa dɛ ba ba ɛɛ laanee la, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛɛh mɛ dɛ kpɔ harɛre ane voɡare ba su bonɔ bwa.
Ba fuh saraha kwaa tɛ voɡare ba ɡbabir kɛɛ ba naawa, kɛɛ Juda koranar ɡba aa wola an jemɛ bwa.
Dɛ kpoo nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, ba chale su bonɔ.
Ba ma kwaa baa ɛ sarahare a ta tɛ voɡ Baal, dɛ fuh ba bibaala ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛo.
N ta ban doe ŋɔ ba ɛ ɡɛ, a toole n liire ta kwaraa.
Anomanta, tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba bala, ásɛ nɛra aa bonɔ Tɔfɛt kɛɛ Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjenii yerɛ kpa.
Baa dɛɛ yerɔ Nɛŋkpoa Fɛlembɔjenii.
Bonɔɔ mɛɛ ba Juda ne Jerusalam tena vɔrɔwa baa vɔrɔwa bil bwa chɔɡa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔma pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba laa ta, ásɛ ba ola berɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola kondikwa.
Chɔɡa kohona waa do kenii mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta bwɛjen nɔ ta, ásɛ o berɛ kon nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa na, dɛ́ ɔmɛ ba nyoa kpo, o nɛra bola baa do ba wa.
Ba dɔma ɛɛ ba bar bwɛjen laanee dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ kpo o bini nɛra.
Kwaa baa ma dɛ́ che a ta jo ba be ɛɛ do ɔmaa kohona, a ɡel lɔr chole o nɛra nɛ, ásɛ ba kpoo dɔŋa dɛɛ chwe, hale ba bibaala ne bihaahna bwa.’ ” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ ń paɡre leo la nɛra n ne baa la bela la siwi ta, asɛ n ŋɔ Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ ne o nɛra chɔɡa, ó do kɛŋɔ leo waa paɡra baa wola won kwaa mao kpa.
Baa huɡe nɛra Tɔfɛt belaa, ka tel kɛŋɔ bɔr aa wola lee do baa huɡ ba kpa.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba kpɔe ɛ bwɛjen nɔ ne o nɛra.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ó do kɛŋɔ Tɔfɛt la ken.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Jerusalam deene bini ne Juda koranar deene, ne saldor baa fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ weweela, dɛ bela baa fuɡe sen ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ voɡare bwa ɛɛ kah doŋaa kɛŋɔ Tɔfɛt ken.” Belaa men Jeremia le Tɔfɛt bela Korowii aa tom mɛ n ka bol o waa la.
Asɛ n ka che Korowii Dea dembaah bela dɛ ŋɔ nɛra la bwa be ŋɔ, “Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Hé no!
N dɛ ba wenaale bwa maa ŋɔa ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta bwɛjen nɔ ne bwɛjeɡre bwa aa baro bwa nɛra nɛɛ la ne, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ tena dɛ vɛh n waa la noe.’ ”
Jeremia ne sɔfo Pasur Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Ima, o bibaa sɔne Pasur.
Dɛ sɔfo Pasur ɛ nomonjen waa chɔ nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea nyoa.
Waa noa kɛŋɔ men Jeremia dɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o ɡelɔ ba lɔɔ mɛ, dɛ do mɛ jɔɡrɔre.
Bela bɛne Bɛnjamen Doonyoa nyunduabɔr, Korowii Dea bela.
Tɔ aa pera la, Pasur baa foo n jɔɡrɔre la, asɛ n ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii ta ŋɔe ŋɔ he sɔne Pasur, sɔn waa pae laanee Maɡor Misabib.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
‘N dɛ ba ɡela a che he nɛɛ ɔmee chole he ne he daamanar bwa nɛ, ásɛ ba dɔma kpoo ba laa ta he siwi ta.
N dɛ ba Juda tena bwa kpɔe do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa.
Wɛɛ lawɛ banee kaa o harɛ ta dɛ́ kpoo bane ɡe.
Mɛɛ berɔ ɡel ba dɔma pa ba kondɔɔh aa lɔ bwɛjen nɔ ta bwa, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ ba komɛlbwa ta, hale Juda koranar kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa, dɛ́ che a bwa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.
Kɛ hen Pasur te, baa lawɛ he ne he dem tena bwaa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Belaa hɛɛ ba sewa bá huɡe, he ne he bala haa teŋe nyosone kohona tɛɛ ba la bwa.’ ” Jeremia Korowii waa naɡra N Naa Korowii, he neɡ mɛ, asɛ n teŋɛ he nɛ.
He pɔ n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ he kpeɡri ɡwaa mɛ.
Nɛra dɛ muɡli n baah, tɔpebir bwaa baa mam mɛ.
N dɛ ba waa bola aa, lɔŋɔree mɛɛ do, dɛɛ bol yoi ne kwaa chɔɡa wa.
Waa Korowii waa la aa kpɔa tɛ mɛ laanee, chɛɡa ne bammuɡla tɔpebir bwa.
Kɛ dɛ n ŋɔ maa Korowii sɔnee yerɛ, kɛɛ dɛ́ bol waa o sɔn ta kpa aa, o waa la yon do n bambile bini, dɛɛ fuh n hoɡa bini kɛŋɔ nii ken.
N yon takapɔ ŋɔ n lawɛ n te, kɛ dɛ n horɔ.
N dɛ no nɛra bwa aa dɛ ŋwalɛ ŋɔ, “Ɔmee kohona bar yaa cheme!
Hé ɡel ya kpɔ o waa ka bil nomonome sie.” N daamanar ɡba dɛ nyin n harɛ lɔe, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛl ken ɛɛ won neɡro, ásɛ ya won lawɔ, dɛ́ bɔ ya kem.” Kɛ hen Korowii, he ja n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ banyoo ken, anomanta, nɛra baa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ bwa ɛɛ horɔɔ.
Sihiih ɛɛ kpo ba saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la, dɛkalkɛ ba wobɛlbwa aa maɡra ba.
Nɛra aa sihiih baa di la soeh ba bwa.
Koranar Bwa Kooro, henee dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛn o wa aa toɡra bini, dɛ jemɛ waa aa lɔ o bambile ne o liire bini.
Anomanta, ɡel n na kembɔr haa kpɔ tɛ n dɔma, dɛkalkɛ he nɔn taa n kpɔ n waa do.
Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii.
Hé jam Korowii.
Onee lɛ nyaara dɛɛ le nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn ta.
N taah nyoa tɔpere baa lol mɛ o ta.
Soh tɔpere n nya aa lol mɛ wa.
Nyotaahna lawɛ naate waa ɡela n mɛɛ no a wa, dɛ ɡel o sie lɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Ba lolɛ bibaa tɛɛ” la.
Kórowii ɛ naate ó do kɛ bwɛjena waa chɔɡa, o ta ba nɛɛ sune la ken.
Ó ɡel naate ɛɛ no wii ɡbɔɡa chɔɔ, dɛɛ no laa lɔŋɔre ɡe webaŋa, dɛkalkɛ naate ta men kpoe n nya tea bini, ásɛ bela fee ber mɛ lalbɔɔ.
Bɔkwa waa ɡela ba lol mɛ te nɔ?
Ń ba na wenaale dɛɛ di suna, ásɛ sihiih kpo mɛ n soɡa bini bwa waa kɛɛ?
Korowii vɛh Kooro Sedekia wesoŋa Korowii bol waa Jeremia be ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Sedekia aa tomɛ Malkija bibaa Pasur, ne Maaseya bibaa sɔfo Sefania o be.
Ba ŋɔ, “Bɔɔ le Korowii be tɛ yaa, dɛkalkɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa dɛ ba ba yo yaa.
Korowii ken ɛɛ ɛ nyokpo waanee tɛ yaa kɛ saŋ la, ásɛ o berɛ habɔɔ kaa.” Ate, Jeremia chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Hé ŋɔ Kooro Sedekia be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, o ɡbabirii dɛ́ yo he laa tena haa kpɔ ba dɛɛ la ka yo Babelɔn kooro ne o laa tena la, dɛ́ pɔ he nɛ.
Wɛɛ boa he laa tena dɔmkwaa nyoa, a daŋɛ chɔ bwɛjen la baah ta.
O ɡbabirii dɛ́ yo heya o bokpeɡa ne o bandia kohona bwa ne.
Wɛɛ kpo nomɛlbwa waa soɡe bwɛjen la binii, nɛra ne ola bwa, ásɛ weechɔɡa kpoo ba bwa.
A habɔɔ la, wɛɛ lawɛ Juda Kooro Sedekia ne o nomonome, ne nɛra baa kaa dɛ do bwɛjen nɔ bini dɛ dɔ ba nyu le weechɔɡa, ne laa kɛɛ lɔr la ta do Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ne ba dɔma baa dɛ nyin ba dɛ kpo la nɔn ta.
Kooro Nebukadnesa aa bɛlbwa ɡela ba, waa bɛlbwa nɛɛ sune kɛɛ dɛ dɔ tedoma tɛo.
Korowiirii bola.’ ” Ate, Korowii berɛ ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ ń bol nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé no.
Webele anɛ nɔɔ n kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, ŋwɛnɛ haa che o ta dɔ mkpa, ne ŋwɛnɛ haa che o ta dɔ seo.
Nomɛlbwa soɡe bwɛjen nɔ ta naa, baa kpoo laa taa, kɛɛ weechɔɡa ne lɔr ɡel o sewɛ.
Kɛ bɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te ka do Babelɔn tena baa chɔa bar heyaa nɔ lɔɡa te ɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
N siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ń chɔɡ bwɛjen nɔ, o kɛrɛdɛ doe te laa.
Babelɔn kooro nɔn taa wɛɛ ba doe, ásɛ o fuh o bwa dɛɛboo ken.” Korowiirii bola.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, ń bol Juda koodem tena be ŋɔ, “Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no waa men Korowii aa dɛ bol.
Kooro Devid naanar, waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
‘Hé na kɛŋɔ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre lole tɔpere bɛlbwa, hé lɛ nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba le ba dɔɔranar nɔn ta, nɛra baa lɛ ba laala bwa la.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, n bandia ɛɛ fuuh kohona kɛŋɔ nii ken, bɛlbwa aa wola won sɔɔh o nyoa, wechɔɡa haa ɛa la wa.
N ne Jerusalam tena dɔɔ, heyaa soɡe deŋɡarere dor, a do kɛŋɔ he soɡe bwetal harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta ken.
He yon ŋɔ, “Umee dɛ́ won ba yo yaa ɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won ba ku ya danjwɛkpeɡa dɛ́ jo ya be nɔ?” Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee ɡɛ he we-ɛɛla aa doa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nii le he kɔne bini dɛ́ fuh komɛlbwa aa lɔ a ta, Men Korowiirii bola.’ ”
Jeremia Korowii waa bola Juda koodem Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Jeremia be kɛŋɔ ń ir la Juda kooro be o koodem, dɛ́ ka bol waa nɔ bela.
“Juda kooro haa ɛ Kooro Devid naa, he ne he nomonome ne nɛra baa cheɡɛ doonyojena nɔ ta dɛɛ jo bwa, hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre.
Hé lɛ nɛn baa dɛ fiiɡu, dɛ́ lɛ o laala le o nomoa nɔn ta.
He bɛ naɡra kɛɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ ba nɛŋhɔɔhra ne bilalbii, kɛɛ luhaahna nɛ, he bɛ nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ kpo harɛ nɔ ta.
Dɛ he nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ waa maa do heyaa a ta nɔ ta naa, amɔ Kooro Devid naanar ɛɛ teŋɔ di kora.
Asɛ ba ne ba nomonome, ne ba nɛra so jaɡre ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore bini bwa kpɔ koodem doonyojena nɔ ta dɛɛ jo.
Kɛ dɛ haa waa maa do heyaa a ta teŋaa, amɔ te men Korowii, n dɛ ŋwɛɛ n ɡbaɡba kɛŋɔ koodem nɔ bwa ɛɛ kuuɡuu dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia.” Gɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
“A lole kɛŋɔ Juda koodem wer kɛŋɔ Gelead harɛ ne Lɛbanɔn bwejena n be, kɛ kasinteŋ, mɛɛ ɛɔ kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, kɛŋɔ bwɛɛre nɛra aa wola toole a ta ken.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo laa tena ba yoo, bɛlbwa kpoŋe o dɔmkwa.
Baa teŋni o peleme daa aa wera laanee ta, dɛ́ paa do nii ta.
A habɔɔ, harɛre nɛra ɛɛ teŋo baa kaa dɛ́ na bwɛjen nɔ, dɛɛ bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa Korowii ɛ bwɛjen nɔ ken?’ Ásɛ nɛra bane ɡe chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Baa vɛh fɔo ba ne Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ aa fɔwa, dɛ berɛ kaa tomɛ voɡare ane, dɛɛ duura la waa.’ Kooro Joahas waa Jeremia aa bola Juda tena, he bɛ Kooro Josia wi, he bɛ o lwe kwaraa ɛ. Kɛ hé wi tɛ o bibaa Joahas kohona, dɛkalkɛ baa lawɔɔ kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta waa wola berɛ ba kpa, waa harɛ baa lolɔ o taa na kpa.
Waa Korowii aa bol Kooro Josia bibaa Salum waa baa chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta dɛ di kora Juda harɛ, dɛ berɛ le koodem bonɔ kaa laanee nɔ.
‘O le bonɔ kaa, waa berɛ ba kpa.
Bojaŋ harɛfale baa lawɔ laa ta kaa la taa wɛɛ ba sewa, waa won berɛ ba o harɛ ta kpa.’ Kooro Jehoiakim waa Jeremia aa bola Nomɛlbwa waa wola ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta kpɔe dɛ ma o koodem la, o bwɛɛlɛ.
O cheɡɛ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ paɡri o nyundua deene, dɛ ɡel o harɛ nɛra ɛ toma pɛɛpɛɛ, o ta ban kem bɔe.
O ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ma n koodemii ó do kan, o nyundua deene bini do paɡri.’ Anomanta, o do tokorojena o ta, dɛ kpɔ peleme daa kwaa o bini, dɛ kpɔ konswɛɛma maala.
He do dem dɛ kpɔ peleme daa kwaaro waa, anee dɛ́ ɡel nɛra ŋɔ he ɛ kooro kɛɛ?
Kondikwaa ne sen fa ta he mɛɛ nyae, kɛ o ɛ anɔ la aa wera dɛ toɡre, anomanta, o wobɛlbwa wer dɛ tɛo.
O bol nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra waa tɛɛ ba, anomanta, o wobɛlbwa wer tɛo.
Gɛ laa dɛɛ baɡle kɛ nɛn jemɛ men Korowii aa?
Kɛ he sie beɡre anɔ la he ɡbo aa dɔ ta, dɛɛ kpoo nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, dɛɛ fiɡ ba, dɛ ɛɡ ba dɛɛ lɛ ba kwa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Anomanta, ɡɛ Korowii aa bol Juda Kooro Josia, o bibaa Jehoiakim waa nɔ.
“Nomɛlbwa aa Kooro Jehoiakim seo waa wi, kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Aku, n dam, he seo dɛ we, bwɛɛlɛ ne seo.’ Nomɛlbwa aa on wi ŋɔ, ‘Aku, n dɔɔ, kɛɛ n naa kooro, bwɛɛlɛ ne seo!’ Gɛ keeɡo sewɔ, ba yon tuuɡu le ka ta bwɛɛ dahare la, ɡɛɛ baa ba Kooro Jehoiakim tuuɡa le, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka ta Jerusalam doonyojena baŋ.
Jerusalam tena, hé ir la ka do lɔŋɔre Lɛbanɔn, dɛ́ la Basan harɛ ne Abarim ɡe ka wi, dɛkalkɛ ba kpoo nɛra baa ja he nɛɛ la bwa.
Gɛ saŋ he wobɛlbwa aa wera tɛɛ laanee n kaeh, kɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Maa deŋnee cheɡ dɛ́ no.’ Gɛɛ he do dɛ le he bechale saŋ bwa, haa sɛɛh dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ta.
Peu ɛɛ tao kpɔ he sitɔɔla baa do kɛ peteɡra la kaa, baa lawɛ nɛra baa ja he nɛɛ laa taa kaa bojaŋ harɛfala ta.
Ásɛ he di ncho, sihiih kpoe, he nyubinikpeɡ haa ɛa la wa.
He soɡe Lɛbanɔn deene baa kpɔ peleme daa ɛa bini, he bwara sɔɔhne, kɛ he waa dɛ ba sum doe hɛɛ pɛmɛ, kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ ken!” Korowii ŋɔ Kooro Jehoiakim bibaa Kooro Jehoiachin be ŋɔ, “Men Korowii taa lole nɔ, hale dɛ he do kɛŋɔ noniseɡ waa dɛ baɡle kpeɡri nɛn aa dɔa, dɛ do n nɔndiɡ ta kwaraa naa, mɛɛ foori ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔe do nɛra baa dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo, hɛɛ ɔm ba la nɔn ta.
Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ne o laa tena nɔn taa mɛɛ ba he kpɔe do.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo bá lawɛ he ne he nya laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Harɛ baa wola he bini bɛlbwa o ta lolɛ, ásɛ he bwa so bela serewe.
Hɛɛ dɛɛ nyinu kɛ he berɛ ba he harɛ la ta, kɛ haa won ba o ta kpa.” Ate, men Jeremia ŋɔ, “Amɔ Kooro Jehoiachin nɔ do kɛŋɔ loŋ waa paɡra, ba kpɔ ta nomɛlbwa aa wola nyin kpa kɛɛ?
A waa ba lawɛ o ne o bii laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale, baa wola o ta jemɛ nɔ naa?
Harɛ nɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ danseɛ dɛ́ cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no Korowii waa waa bola.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
‘Chwerɛ baa nɔ waa do tɔne bini, dɛ́ kpɔɔ kɛŋɔ o ta bii dɔe, nɛn o wobɛlbwa aa wola werii do tɛo o soɡa bini bwa, waa naanaree dɔ, ba ba so Juda harɛ kara ta, Kooro Devid luɡe ta.’ ”
Kerekere hwɛɡa wa Korowii ŋɔ, “Sitɔɔla baa do kɛŋɔ peteɡra, dɛɛ chɔɡ n nɛra, dɛ lɔ ba dɛɛ peɡre la, bá bwɛɛlɛ.” Anomanta, waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ bol sitɔɔla aa chɛ kɛ bá nyiŋi o nɛra nɛɛ laanee nɔ, “He ta n nɛra la nɛɛ nyiŋe dɛ doŋ ba, dɛ ɡel ba lɔ peɡre.
Taraken, n dɛ ba he deŋne tɛra, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa la wa.
N ɡbabir ɛɛ boa ba bwa nyoa, dɛ́ le harɛre maa lɔ ba peɡre a ta la ta, dɛ́ berɛ teɡ ba ba harɛ baa dɔ kpɔɡa dɛɛ chwe ta.
Baa loɡle biirii warɛ, ásɛ dɛ ya kohona.
Mɛɛ berɔɔ le sitɔɔla baa nyiŋi ba nɛ, ásɛ bɛlbwa aa ɔmɛ kɛɛ dɛ́ nyoɡre kpa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpera ane dɛ ba ásɛ n ɡel Kooro Devid naa o wa aa toɡra, dɛ do kɛŋɔ Daa Kpale ba, dɛ́ ba di kora.
O balaa, wɛɛ che wejema taa nyiŋi ba nɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera harɛ la bwa ta.
O baa di kora aa, Juda tena ɛɛ dɔ bosɔɔhnaa, ásɛ Israel tena ɡe so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Sɔn baa dɛɛ yerɔ laanee, ‘Korowii Waa Dɛ Lɛ Yaa.’ Tɔpera ane dɛ ba ásɛ nɛra aa n sɔn taa ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ lawɛ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta kpa.’ Kɛ baa ŋɔɔ, ‘Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ lawɛ Israel tena le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr harɛ ta, ne harɛre waa lɔ ba peɡre a ta.’ Ásɛ ba dɔ ba ɡbabir harɛ dɛ́ so o ta.” Keame nyosonteŋna wa A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ Korowii keamere wa.
N loo kuu a kpɔ bochela ta n nɛ, n hoɡa bini bwa ɛɛ wee mɛ.
N do kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛ ken, kɛ nɛn waa nyɔ sen kohona, Korowii waa aa do ɡoroŋ o bol n be la wa.
Jwamane su harɛ la ta, Korowii taahna nomanta, harɛ la chɔɡɔ, a ɡel kondɛɛra dibɔra aa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ hol.
Keamere la kpɔ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡa ta dɛɛ di kpeɡri.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Keamere la ne sɔfore bwa aa men duu, hale n Dea bela, ba dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo ŋwɛnɛre baa dɛ kpɔ a ta do vɔle, biro do o ta, ásɛ ba lɔ naa dɛ́ choɡli.
Mɛɛ kpɔ wenaalee ba ta ba nɛ, ba deŋnetɛra tɔpere.
Men Korowiirii bola.
N na waane maa kia keamere baa lɔ Samaria nɛ.
Ba dɛ bol waa voɡ Baal sɔn ta, a ɡel n nɛra Israel tena nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ.
N berɔ na waane aa wola were kwaraa keamere baa lɔ Jerusalam ɡe nɛ.
Ba dɛ bɔ jwamane dɛɛ teŋe nyosone.
Ba dɛ do wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡbemba wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, a ɡel nomɛlbwa aa charɛ dɛɛ le a ta.
Ba wechɔɡa do kɛŋɔ Sodom ne Gomoora tena n be.” Anomanta, Koranar Bwa Kooro bol keamere baa lɔ Jerusalam waa ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ do tɛɡchɔɡa kondikwaa taa bá di, dɛ́ do ane ɡe nee ta bá nyɔ, dɛkalkɛ ba ɡelɔ nɛra aa men tomɛ harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa.” Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
“He bɛ waa keamere la aa dɛ bol he be la no, ba dɛ chɔɡ he liire, hwɛɡa bɛlbwa toole a ta.
Anɔ la baa liira ɡboo ba na chaahna ta dɛɛ baɡle, waa men Korowii aa bola laa.
Ba teŋɔ dɛɛ bol nɛra baa vɛh n waa ta teŋa be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ŋɔ, hɛɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhnaa.’ Dɛɛ bol deŋnekpeɡ tena ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Wenaale bɛlbwa aa he nɛɛ ba.’ Kɛ keamere nɔ bɛlbwa aa Korowii liire ne o wesɔɔhla jemɛ.
Bɛlbwa toole dɛ no, kɛɛ dɛ jemɛ o waa la mun.
Hé na, Korowii bandia do kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ waa dɛ ta, kɛŋɔ kawulewule dɛ ta dɛɛ kpɔ nyubinikpeɡ tena nyubaahna.
Korowii bandia la nyoa aa sɔɔh, ka tel kɛŋɔ waa ɛ o tetoowa tonɛ.
Tɔpera ane dɛ ba bala, ásɛ mɔɔ he no waa nɔ mun kɛrɛdɛ.
N laa tomɛ ɡɛ keamere nɔ, kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ ba iro dɛ kaa.
N ta ŋɔe ba ka bol wobɛlbwa, kɛ ba cheɡɛ n sɔn ta kaa bol wa.
Dɛ n ne ba fe chemo, ba jemɛ n liire ne n wesɔɔhla la aa, n nɛraa ba fee ka bol n waa la baɡle, ásɛ ba charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ne nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla bwa ta.
N ɛ Korowii maa lɔ bobɛlbwa, bobeŋkpoŋ ɡbo laa n do.
Nomɛlbwa aa won ka sɔh bobɛl maa wola on na.
N toole nyundua ne harɛ ta bwa naa?
Men Korowiirii bola.
N no keamere nyosonteŋna maa wola ban tomɛ, asɛ ba che n sɔn ta dɛɛ bol n waa la wa.
Ba yon ŋɔ, ba deero dɛ na men Korowii waa chaahna ta.
Saŋ besoo a ɡɛ keamere nyosonteŋna baa cheɡɛ ba ɡbabir liire ta dɛɛ baɡle waa nɔ ɛɛ ba ɡela ɔ?
Ba dɛ lii ŋɔ chaahna baa dɛ na, dɛɛ bola dɔŋa be la ɛɛ won ɡel n nɛra soh n wa, ɡɛ ba naawa fa aa cheɡɛ voɡ Baal toma ta, dɛ soh n waa la.
Keame bɛlbwa na waane chaahna ta naa, o yon ŋɔ deeraa o dee, kɛ n keame bɛlbwa waa dɛ bol waa aa le n be la te, wɛ́ɛ bola kasinteŋ ta.
Haahra ta korɛ, asɛ mea ɡe koraa?
N waa la do kɛŋɔ nii, dɛ berɛ do kɛ hamba waa won bwea paɡra burbur ken.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Anomanta, n ne a ɡɛ keamere baa ŋwɛ waa dɛɛ le dɔŋa be, dɛ ŋɔ n waa baa bol la dɔɔ.
Kasinteŋ, n hah keamere ba ɡbabir aa dɛ bol ba wa, dɛ yon ŋɔ a ɛ men Korowii waa la.
Anomanta, n ne nɛra baa cheɡɛ chaahna ta, dɛ teŋe nyosone dɛɛ maŋkura ba te la dɔɔ.
Ba bola dɛ ɡel n nɛra ɛɛ nyoɡre, dɛ n ɡe laa tom ba.
Ba waa la aa nɛra nɔ cha tama bɛlbwa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Keame nyosonteŋna baa wola Korowii waa bol Korowii ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Dɛ n nɛra nɔ bini bɛlbwa kɛɛ n keame, kɛɛ n sɔfo bɔɔre ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa men Korowii ɛɛ bol ɔ?’ Asɛ he chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘He waa do kɛ bone dɛ dawɛ Korowii nɛ, anomanta, wɛɛ vɛh heyaa.’ Kɛ dɛ nomɛlbwa kɛɛ n keame, kɛɛ sɔfo bɛlbwa bol waa ŋɔ, ‘Bone aa ɡwaala Korowii kpɔ dawɛ ya nɛ’ aa, mɛɛ tɛr ba ne ba lolanar deŋnee.
A chɛ kɛ bá ɡarɛ bɔɔ ba daamanar ne lolanar ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa Korowii chaŋe ɔ?
Bɔkwa waa o bol ɔ?’ Anomanta, ba bɛ waa aa ɡwaala Korowii kpɔ dawɛ ba nɛɛ la waa bol kpa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ bɛlbwa ɛ ɡɛ naa, mɛɛ ɡeloo n waa la do kɛŋɔ bontɔɡa ɡbaɡba dawɛ o nɛ.
Ba berɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ waa la sie, Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro la.
Jeremia, bɔɔ n keamere la ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ Korowii chaŋe heya ɔ?
Bɔkwa waa o bol ɔ?’ Dɛ ba vɛh waa maa do ba a ta, dɛ ŋɔ waa aa ɡwaalaa n kpɔ ba dawɛ ba nɛ aa, ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɛɛ soh he waa, dɛ́ kpɔ he ne bwɛɛ waa kpɔa tɛ he ne he naawa la ka ta bojaŋ, ásɛ he le o sie kwaraa.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he di sihiih taeh, sihiih nomɛlbwa aa wola o waa soh bwa.’ ”
Fiɡ daa nɔna wɛɡrɛ dela anɛ ane wa Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiakim bibaa Jehoiachin ne o nomonome, ne nɛra baa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema, dɛ nɛra baa dɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi ɛɛ wejema le Jerusalam kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn.
A habɔɔ, Korowii ɡel men Jeremia na waane chaahna ta, dɛ fiɡ daa nɔna wɛɡrɛre anɛ cheɡɛ o Dea doonyoa bela.
Nɔndɛɛɡa su wɛɡrɛ beŋkpoŋ, anee tɔ sie swɛɛ, asɛ wɛɡrɛ nɛɛte la te kwaa ɛ nɔnchɔɡa, baa wola won dia.
Belaa Korowii bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Jeremia, bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ?” Asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Fiɡ daa nɔnaa mɛɛ na.
Anɔ la aa ɛ nɔndɛɛɡa la wer, kɛ anɔ la aa ɛ nɔnchɔɡa la te bwa chɔɡɔ, baa wola won dia.” Belaa Korowii berɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Kenii men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la ŋɔ, ‘Fiɡ nɔndɛɛɡa la do kɛŋɔ, Juda tena maa ɡela ba laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn.
Mɛɛ do sie ba bee ba wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ berɛ ba bane bonɔ, dɛ́ laɡ ba ir bá kpeɡ, maa ɡel ba chole, dɛ́ kwaa ba du, maa ban fuɡri ta kɛŋɔ dua.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔ nyina bambile, á ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ.
Mɛɛ ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra, dɛkalkɛ baa kpɔ ba bambile bwaa tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ berɛ ba n be.
Kɛ fiɡ nɔnchɔɡa baa wola won dia la te, men Korowii ŋɔ ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba Juda Kooro Sedekia ne o nomonome, ne nɛra baa kaa dɛ do Jerusalam ɛɛ.
Hale ba lɔ bonɔ harɛ nɔ ta, kɛɛ dɛ ka so Ijipt harɛ ta kwaraa noo.
Mɛɛ kpɔ wenaale kohonaa ba ta ba nɛ, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa ɔmɛ kohona.
