Nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ mam baa dɛɛ muɡli ba baah, dɛɛ taah ba bobɛlbwa maa lɔ ba peɡre bwa.
Laa ne lɔr, dɛ weechɔɡaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta ba nɛ, ka tel kɛŋɔ beŋkpoŋ kwaraa aa wola ka, harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ ba ne ba naawa la ta.’ ”
Dɔma baa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr wa Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa di kora bene anaarɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be nɛra bwa baa lɔ Juda harɛ ta wa.
Dɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ɡe di benanyoa beŋkpoŋ o kora ta.
Anomanta, men Korowii keame Jeremia bol Juda tena la bwa ne nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam be ŋɔ, “Le bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro, ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Amɔn bibaa Josia aa di kora bene fi dɛ atoro la, dɛ Korowii dɛ bol waa n be, asɛ n bol he be keraŋwɛnɛ bwa, kɛ he ta n be noɛ.
Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa Korowii tomɛ o bonɔɔna baa ɛ o keamere he Juda ne Jerusalam tena be, kɛ he ta deŋne cheɡɛ, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ noo.
Ba yon ŋɔ, ‘Hé charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa ne he we-ɛɛla aa wola were ta, ásɛ he won so harɛ Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ he ne he naawa la ta, saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
He bɛ voɡare nɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ toma.
He bɛ kwaa he ɡbabir aa kpɔ nɔɔra kwaara kpɔ ir Korowii bwaawee.
He ɛ ɡɛ tenaa, waa heyaa chɔɡ.’ Kɛ Korowii ŋɔ he ta o be noɛ, dɛ kpɔ kwaa he ɡbabir aa kpɔ nɔɔra kwaara ir o bwaawee, a ba wenaale ne ba ta he nɛ.
Anomanta, Koranar Bwa Kooro bolɔ kɛŋɔ, haa wola o be noɛ nomanta, wɛɛ yerɛ nɛra baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne o bonɔɔ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesaa, ásɛ ba ba yo nɛra baa soɡe Juda ne harɛre aa bara cheme bwa.
Wɛɛ chɔɡ ba bwaa kwaraa ken, ásɛ ba do kɛ komɛl waa doŋa nɛra na dɛɛ mamɛ, harɛ la bwa chɔ pɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo ba silɛɛ ne ba hanfalwaa ɡbɔɡa bwa ba a jaɡa.
Nɛra aa mea baa dɛ nama nambwe ta ɡbɔɡaa no, kɛɛ dɛ na kandere chaahna.
He harɛ nɔ bwa ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbiaa, nɛra na ba nyoa kpo, ásɛ harɛre aa baro cheme la nɛra do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa, dɛɛ tomɔ bene fifraanuanɛ.
Kɛ bene fifraanuanɛ la baa kaa laa, wɛɛ tɛr Babelɔn kooro ne o harɛ nɛra deŋnee ba wechɔɡa la wa, ásɛ dɛ chɔɡ harɛ la o berɛ dimɡbia saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Wɛɛ kpɔ wenaale bwa baa chwera do tɔn nɔ bini, o che men Jeremia nɛɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta harɛ la ta laanee ba ta ba nɛ.
Wɛɛ bɔ Babelɔn tena kemee waa baa ɛa la wa, ásɛ harɛre nɛra ɡalɡa ne koojena ba laɡ ba yoma.” Korowii bandia danana nee nyɔe wa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Jeremia, lɛ numol nɔ, sen aa lɔ o bini do kɛŋɔ n bandia danana ne, mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ nɛra bá nyɔ dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne.
Kpɔ kaa harɛre nɛra maa tomɛ ba be la be, dɛ́ ɡel bá nyɔ.
Ba nyɔɔ tonaa, baa dɛɛroo dɛɛ yɛɛɡe, asɛ choɡla chole ba nɛ, laa maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ la wa.” Anomanta, n lɛ numol la, dɛ ɡel harɛre nɛra waa tom mɛ ba be la nyɔ o bini sen la.
Banee, Jerusalam ne Juda bwɛɛre nɛra, ba ne ba koranar ne nomonome bwa, ásɛ a ɡel ba harɛ berɛ dimɡbia, nɛra bambile teŋe baa mamɛ dɛɛ taah ba dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini.
Ijipt kooro ne o bonɔɔna ne o nomonome dɛ o nɛra bwa, ne nɛŋhɔɔhra bwa baa lɔ bela, ne Us harɛ koranar ne Filisti koranar bwa, banɔ la baa le Askɛlɔn ne Gasa ne Ekron dɛ nɛra baa kaa dɛ do Asdɔd, ne Edom ne Moab dɛ Amɔn harɛre ta, ne koranar baa lɔ bwɛjena Taaya ne Sidon bwa, ne harɛre aa lɔ ba lɔɡa dɛ do mpo la baŋ bwa, ne Dedan ne Tema ne Bus, dɛ banɔ la baa lɔ bojaŋ harɛre ta bwa, ne Arab koranar bwa ne harɛfala koranar baa soɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛre ta, ne Simri ne Elam dɛ Midia koranar bwa, dɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr koranar baa lɔ bojaŋa ne ambori bwa ta, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ nyɔ.
Ba bwa habɔɔ la, mɔɔ Babelɔn kooro ɡe ba nyɔ danana nee la.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la dɛ do ba ŋɔ, bá nyɔ n bandia danana sen la ka tel kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ dɛ chwɛɛ, ka tel kɛŋɔ baa choɡli baa wola won ir kpa, laa maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ la wa.
Kɛ dɛ ba vɛh numol la lɛɛ dɛ nyɔ aa, hé ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooroo ŋɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá nyɔ.
Mɛɛ kpɔ wenaalee ba ta bwɛjen n ɡbabir sɔn aa dawɛ o ta.
Ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba tenee wola deŋnetɛraa dɔ aa?
Akai, baa won le a nyoa, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ba laa ne ba ta harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.
Hen Jeremia, bol n waa la ba be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii dɛ kɔɡre kɛŋɔ nyujente dɛ le nyundua dɛɛ ba.
O taa do kɛŋɔ bwaala kɔra, dɛ le o soŋnibɔr waa do ɡoroŋ bela, dɛɛ nyɛɡ o nɛra baa lɔ o harɛ nɔ ta nɛ.
Wɛɛ tiɡri ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba yon dɛɛ tiɡri ɡrepo daa nɔna la ken.
Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ jaɡa bwa ɛɛ no o nyɛɡa laanee.
Korowii ne harɛre nɛra dɔɔ, wɛɛ bol nɛwɛnyina bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole, ásɛ dɛ kpoo nyubinikpeɡ tena.’ ” Korowiirii bola.
Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
“Hé na, wenaale dɛ ba, o le harɛ bɛl nɛra be dɛ kaa bane ɡe be.
O do kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ aa taa le harɛ jaɡa ken.” Gɛ saŋ la, nɛra baa kpoo ba laa ta la ɛɛ warɔɔ chɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, le harɛ baŋ bɛl ba kaa o jaɡa.
Nomɛlbwa aa ba lwee ɛ, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ ba huɡ ba.
Ásɛ ba chɔɡ, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ nabena aa ɡela harɛ ɛɛ do wer ken.
He nomonome haa do kɛŋɔ peteɡra dɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛra nɛɛ la, hé do lɔŋɔre dɛɛ wi kohona!
Hé chɔ harɛ dɛɛ ɡbili, dɛkalkɛ saŋ telo kɛ bá kpoo heya.
Hɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ vii yon le harɛ dɛ paɡre la ken.
Nomonome haa do kɛŋɔ peteɡra la aa bɔree dɔ chwa kaa bobɛlbwa.
Hɛ́ɛ no nomonome baa do kɛ peteɡra la lɔŋɔre ne wii baa dɛ wi, dɛkalkɛ Korowii chɔɡ ba peera dibɔra.
Haa deŋnesɔɔhnaa dɔ harɛ la ta, Korowii bandia kohona la wa.
Korowii vɛh o nɛra kɛŋɔ nyujente yon chwa le o sɔɔhbɔr la ken.
Harɛ la berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o bandia kohona ta ɡel ba dɔma ba chɔɡ ba harɛ.
Jeremia aahra dɛ́ kpo wa Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa dena ba di kora Juda harɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa aa teŋa nɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ir ka che n Dea dembaah, dɛ́ bol waa bwa maa doe ŋɔ he bol baɡle nɛra baa le Juda bwɛɛre ta dɛ baa tom mɛ bela la.
Bɛ webeŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta, bol a bwa.
Ba ken ɛɛ noo dɛ́ charɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta.
Ba ɛ ɡɛ tenaa, mɛɛ charɛ n liiree chɔɡa n fe aa ŋɔa mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta ba nɛɛ laanee.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ ń bol nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ teŋɛ n waa maa dɛ baɡle heyaa la ta, ásɛ dɛɛ no waa n bonɔɔna baa ɛ n keamere maa tom ba he be keraŋwɛnɛ bwa la be.
Kɛ ane a bwa, he ta waa maa cheɡɛ ba nɛ dɛ bol he be la ta teŋɛ.
Dɛ he ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ aa, ate waa maa ɛ Silo laanee mɛɛ ba n Dea bonɔ ɛɛ, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa kpɔ bwɛjen Jerusalam sɔn ɛ kon baa taahno.” Sɔfore, ne Korowii keamere dɛ nɛra la bwa no waa men Jeremia aa bola Korowii Dea bela la.
Maa dena tonɛ waa Korowii aa do mɛ ŋɔ ń bol baɡ ba la, sɔfore la ne Korowii keamere dɛ nɛra la bwa baa laɡ mɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “He chɛ kpoe!
Ɛrɛɛ he che Korowii sɔn ta dɛɛ bol ŋɔ Dea nɔ ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ Silo, ásɛ bwɛjen nɔ ɡe chɔɡ, nɛra aa wola o taa so kpa nɔɔ?” Ate, nɛra la bwa den ba bar men Jeremia Korowii Dea bela.
Juda nomonome aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba le koodem bela dɛ la Korowii Dea, dɛ ka che ba chebɔra doonyoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Doonyofale la ta.
Belaa sɔfore, ne Korowii keamere la ŋɔ nomonome la ne nɛra la bwa be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ chɛ kɛ ba kpoo, dɛkalkɛ o bol Korowii waa yaɡɛ bwɛjen nɔ nɛra.
He ɡbabir noɔ!” Ate, n ŋɔ nomonome la bwa ne nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Korowiirii tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol waa aa dɛ ba Dea nɔ ne bwɛjen nɔ ta baɡle heya.
Anomanta, hé charɛ he soɡa ne we-ɛɛla bwa, dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɛ, ásɛ o charɛ o liire dɛ bɛ wenaale waa bol a waa la kpɔ ba ta he nɛɛ kpa.
N te, n dɔɔ do he nɔn ta, wobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la, hé kpɔ ɛɛ mɛ.
Kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ he kpo mɛ naa, he ne nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen nɔ ta ɛɛ di bolchɔɡee, kɛŋɔ haa kpo nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ.
Kasinteŋ, Korowiirii tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba kah heya.” Belaa nomonome ne nɛra la bwa ŋɔ sɔfore ne Korowii keamere la be ŋɔ, “Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ sɔn taa baa nɔ che dɛ bol waa baɡle yaa, a ta chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.” A habɔɔ la, nomonome la bane iro che dɛ bol nɛra baa chema la be ŋɔ, “Gɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora la, Korowii keame Maeka waa le Mɔresɛt bol Koranar Bwa Kooro waa baɡle Juda tena bwa ŋɔ, ‘Saayɔn ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ koo baa parɔ dɛ du kwaa o ta ken, Jerusalam bwa ɛɛ kuuɡuu dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ Korowii Bwejen Dea aa chɔŋɛ o ta la berɛ kɔr.’ Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Juda tena ta Maeka kpoe.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ soŋe ŋɔ o na o sum.
Asɛ Korowii charɛ o liire wenaale waa ŋɔa o fe ɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta ba nɛɛ la ta.
Kɛ taraken ya berɔ dɛɛ nyin wenaale kohona dɛ́ ba ta ya nɛ.” Dɛ baa bɛl ɡe lole baa yerɔ Uria, o mɛɛ sɔne Sɛmaya dɛ le bwɛɛ Kiriat Jearim.
O ɡe bol waa Korowii sɔn ta, waa aa dɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ ne harɛ nɔ ta bala, ɡɛ Jeremia fa aa bola la.
Kooro Jehoiakim ne o laa tena dɛ o nomonome bwa aa no waa Uria aa bola la, dɛ o dɛ nyinu dɛ́ kpo.
Kɛ Uria noɔ kɛ kooro dɛ nyinu dɛ́ kpo, asɛ dɛ kpɔ ɔmee chwa kaa Ijipt harɛ ta.
Kooro Jehoiakim tomɛ Akbɔ bibaa Ɛl Netan ne baala bane Ijipt ŋɔ, bá ka lawɛ Uria ba.
Ba lawɛ Uria le Ijipt harɛ dɛ kpɔɔ ka tɛ Kooro Jehoiakim, asɛ o kpoo dɛ kpɔ o chɔɔ la ka ta bela baa dɛ huɡe nɛmpɛɛne la.
Kɛ ane a bwa, men Jeremia te dɔ n nyu di, dɛkalkɛ Safan bibaa Ahikam cha mɛ o ta ɡelɛ ba laɡ mɛ tɛ nɛra la ba kpo mɛ.
Juda tena Kooro Nebukadnesa ka toma wa Kooro Josia bibaa Sedekia aa baa di kora Juda harɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ ń kpɔ oltɔn ŋwɛɛra vɔwɛ da, dɛ́ kpɔ dawɛ n baŋa ta kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ daa dawɛ nae nɛ aa parɛ la.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ń kpɔ kala tɛ nomonome baa cheɡɛ koranar baa lɔ Edom ne Moab harɛre ta, ne bwɛjena Amɔn ne Taaya dɛ Sidon naa ta, dɛ ba Kooro Sedekia be Jerusalam la.
Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ń do ba bá ka ŋɔ ba koranar be waa Korowii fa aa bola ŋɔ, “N kpeɡri waa kana kohona nee n ta harɛ nɔ bwa ne nɛwɛnyini dɛ ola aa lɔ o ta bwa, dɛ kpɔa do nomɛlbwa maa leo nɔn ta.
Menee kpɔ harɛre nɔ bwa do n bonɔɔ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa nɔn ta, hale dɛ ɡel kpɔɡ bini ola bwa ɛɛ tomɔ.
Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ tomɔɔ, dɛ tomɛ o bibaa ne o naa ka tel kɛŋɔ o harɛ la aa chɔɡ.
Ásɛ o harɛ nɛra ɛɛ tomɛ harɛre nɛra baa kpeɡa kohona ne koojena.
Kɛ dɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra ta sɛɛh dɛ kpɔ ba te do o lɔɡa aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpoo ba laa ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ lɔr ne weechɔɡa ba ta ba nɛ, á ɛ ba deŋnetɛra ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ɡela Kooro Nebukadnesa aa chɔɡ ba kwaraa.
Anomanta, he bɛ he keamere kɛɛ nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ baa won baɡle waa aa dɛ ba wona chiɡ kerekere, dɛ che deera kɛɛ lala yera kɛɛ dobodobo we-ɛɛla ta be dɛɛ no.
Ba bwa dɛ bol he be ŋɔ he bɛ he te kpɔ do Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa lɔɡa.
Ba dɛ neɡre heya dɛ́ ɡel ba lawɛ heya kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Mɛɛ doŋi heyaa ásɛ he ka serewe.
Kɛ dɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra kpɔ ba te ka do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa dɛɛ tomɔ waa, ate mɛɛ ɡeloo ba so ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta, dɛɛ parɛ o ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Men Jeremia fa tɔ sie bol ɡɛ waa nɔ tenten baɡle Juda Kooro Sedekia ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he te do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa.
He ne he nɛra tomɔ ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu.
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ he ne he nɛra sewɛ laa ta, kɛɛ lɔr kɛɛ weechɔɡa kpoo heya ɔ?
Gɛ waa nɔɔ Korowii ŋɔ aa pu harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra baa vɛah dɛ kpɔ ba te do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa la.
He bɛ keamere baa ŋɔa he bɛ he te kpɔ do o lɔɡa la be no.
Neɡraa baa neɡre heya.
Korowii ɡbabir bolɔ ŋɔ o ta bɛlbwa tomɛ, asɛ ba che o sɔn ta dɛɛ teŋe nyosone la.
Anomanta, o ŋɔ wɛɛ doŋi he bwaa, ásɛ ba kpoo heya, he ne keamere baa dɛ teŋɛ nyosone la bwa.” Belaa n ŋɔ sɔfore la ne nɛra la be waa Korowii fa aa bola ŋɔ, “He bɛ keamere baa dɛ bol ŋɔ aa biɡri bá berɛ kpɔ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ faa do Korowii Dea bonɔ la le Babelɔn ba la be no.
Neɡraa baa neɡre heyaa la.
He bɛ ba be dɛɛ no!
Hé kpɔ he te ka do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa, ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu!
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ bwɛjen nɔ paɡre dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia ɔ?
Dɛ ba ɛ Korowii keamere kpela aa, bá bɔɔ le men Koranar Bwa Kooro be, ásɛ n bɛ ɡel laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ do n Dea, ne anɔ la aa lɔ koodem bela la, ba paa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.” Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol pilare ne loɡjen baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo, ne kwaane aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡo ba won a taɡa, dɛ laala ane baa kpɔa ɛ Dea la bini a do wer dɛ ka bwɛjen nɔ bini, Kooro Nebukadnesa aa wola kpɔe kaa Babelɔn, ɡɛ saŋ waa lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiakim bibaa Jehoiachin laa ta le Jerusalam kaa Babelɔn, o ne Juda ne Jerusalam nomonome bwa la.
Hé no, waa men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, aa dɛ bol laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, dɛ do n Dea ne koodem waa lɔ Jerusalam la wa.
“Baa paa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta, a do bela ka tel kɛŋɔ n liire aa berɛ ba a ta.
Ásɛ n berɛ ɡel bá berɛ ba a ne, ásɛ n berɛ lɛa cheɡ bonɔ.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Keame nyosonteŋni Hanania A ɡɛ waa aa teŋa nɔ chiɡo ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene anaarɛ korobinue te la ta.
Belaa Korowii keame bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Hanania, o mɛɛ sɔne Asuur o le Gebeɔn, o bol waa men Jeremia be Korowii Dea, nɛra la ne sɔfore bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘Mɛɛ kuuɡi Babelɔn kooro kpeɡri, waa do kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ daa dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ laanee.
Bene anɛ ne tela dɛ n ɡelɔ ba kpɔ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ fa do Korowii Dea, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa paa le bonɔ la, dɛ́ berɛ ba a ne.
Mɛɛ berɔɔ kpɔ Jehoiakim bibaa Kooro Jehoiachin, ne Juda tena bwa baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta Babelɔn la bwa ba.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ba n kuuɡi Babelɔn kooro kpeɡri waa do kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ daa dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ la ken.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ” Belaa men Jeremia che sɔfore ne nɛra baa lɔ Korowii Dea la sie dɛ bol Hanania be ŋɔ, “Aamen!
Kórowii ɛa ɡɛ!
N dɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel o waa haa bola la ɛ kasinteŋ, dɛ́ ɡel laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ do Korowii Dea la ne nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfale ta la bwa, bá berɛ le a bwa ne Babelɔn ba bonɔ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, berɛ dɛɛ no waa maa dɛ ba he be ne nɛra nɔ be bola.
Keamere baa tɔ n ne he sie saŋ la bolɔ ŋɔ, harɛre nɛra ne koojena ɛɛ serewe laa taa, ásɛ lɔr ne weechɔɡa ɡe kpoo bane.
Kɛ keame bɛlbwa waa dɛɛ bol Korowii waa ŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna lole, ásɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ laanee nɛra ɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ keame kasinteŋ Korowii aa tomɔ.” Belaa Hanania laa daa waa dawɛ men Jeremia baŋa kɛŋɔ bontɔɡa la ku, asɛ dɛ che nɛra la bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba o kuuɡi Babelɔn kooro kpeɡri waa do kɛŋɔ daa ba yon kpɔ dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ, Babelɔn kooro kpɔ dawɛ harɛre nɛra baŋa ta la.
Bene anɛ ne tela dɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛo.” Ate, Jeremia le bela dɛ kaa.
Keame Hanania aa ku daa waa dawɛ Jeremia baŋa ta habɔɔ la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ir la ka ŋɔ Hanania be ŋɔ, ‘Haa wona ku daa la nomanta, buni konee dɛɛ ba ba chiɡ o naa ta.
Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, dɛ́ wɛɛ kpɔ buni waa do kɛŋɔ daa ba yon kpɔ dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ laanee dawɛ harɛre nɛra baŋa ta, ásɛ baa tomɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa.
Hale dɛ́ ɡel kpɔɡ bini ola ɡba ɛɛ tomɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa.’ ” Belaa men Jeremia ŋɔ Hanania be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ no, Hanania!
Korowii laa tomɛ, asɛ he teŋe nyosone dɛɛ baɡle nɛra nɔ ba ɡe ɛɛ yarada la.
Anomanta, Korowii dɛ ba he kpoe le harɛ nɔ ta.
Benanyoa ne chema dɛ he sewɔ, dɛkalkɛ he ɡelɔ nɛra nɔ berɛ habɔɔ kpoo.
Gɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ.” Asɛ Hanania sewɛ a ɡɛ bena la korobinuanɛ ta.
Jeremia tɔn waa chwera ka tɛ Juu tena Babelɔn Kenii tɔn men Korowii keame Jeremia aa chwera le Jerusalam, ka tɛ nomonome baa kaa dɛ ja nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa la, ne sɔfore ne Korowii keamere, dɛ nɛra baa jaa Kooro Nebukadnesa aa laɡ ba le Jerusalam dɛ kaa ba ne Babelɔn la bini waa do.
N chwerɛ tɔn nɔ ɡɛ saŋ baa lawɛ Kooro Jehoiachin ne o nya ne koodem nomonome, ne Juda ne Jerusalam nomonome, ne nɛra baa dɔ kwaa sɛɛh wejema, dɛ banɔ la baa dɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi ɛɛ wejema laa ta kaa harɛfale ta la.
Men Jeremia kpɔ tɔn maa chwera la do Safan bibaa Elasa ne Hilkia bibaa Gemaria, Juda Kooro Sedekia aa laɡ ba tɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa la nɔn ta.
O bini waa nɔ, “Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ bol nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta le Jerusalam kaa Babelɔn laanee nɔ.
‘Hé ma deene dɛ́ so a bini, ásɛ dɛ parɛ bodɛɛɡa dɛ́ du daa dɛɛ di a ta.
Hé mo haahna dɛ́ loɡle bibaala ne bihaahna, dɛ́ nyin haahna tɛ he bibaala ɡe, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ he bihaahna ɡe tɛ yal, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba ɡe dɔ bibaala ne bihaahna.
Hé ɡel he mun ya kohona bela, dɛ bɛ mule.
Hɛ́ɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa ne waa aa ɡel he soɡa bini do wer, bwɛjena maa ɡela ba lawɛ heyaa ka so a ta la ta.
Hé che ba naa ta soŋe le n be dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba wobɛlbwa wer dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, ba nɔn bini do wer aa, anee dɛ́ ɡel he ɡe nɔn bini do wer.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ dɛ́ kah heyaa ásɛ he bɛ ɡel keame nyosonteŋna ne voɡra baa soɡe he bini la ɛɛ neɡre heya.
He bɛ wepila baa ŋɔa ba dɛ na la yarada.
Nyosonee ba che n sɔn ta teŋe dɛɛ baɡle heya.
N ta ban tomɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ” Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Bene fifraanuanɛ la ba a jaɡa Babelɔn aa, mɛɛ berɔ ba he be, dɛ́ che suna maa sune he nɛɛ dɛ baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, mɛɛ berɔ ba he ne Jerusalam bonɔ la ta.
Dɛkalkɛ n jemɛ anɔ la maa vɔrɔwa dɛɛ cheɡ heya.
Vɔrɔwa aa ɡel he wobɛlbwa do wer, haa wola chɔɡ, ásɛ he dɔ kerekere hwɛɡa.
Belaa hɛɛ ba n sɔn yera dɛɛ soŋ mɛ, ásɛ n no he wesoŋa.
Hɛɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe n bɔree dɛ́ na mɛ, dɛ he dɛ́ nyin n bɔr he bambile bwa ne naa, hɛɛ na mɛɛ.
Kasinteŋ, hɛɛ na mɛɛ, ásɛ n lawɛ heyaa le Babelɔn harɛ haa kaa so o ta la ta, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne he buɡ ta Jerusalam.
Mɛɛ boa he nyoa le harɛre maa lɔ heyaa peɡre a ta la ta, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne harɛ maa le he ne o ta kaa harɛfala ta la ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.” He ken ɛɛ dɛɛ boloo ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛ yaa o keamere Babelɔn harɛ ta, kɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ bol kooro waa soɡe Kooro Devid kara ta, ne nɛra bwa baa ka bwɛjen la ta, ne bwɛɛla baa wola nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfale ta nɛɛ jae la, kasinteŋ waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpoo ba laa ta, ásɛ lɔr ne weechɔɡa ɡel ba serewe, dɛ́ ɡel bá ɛ kɛŋɔ fiɡ daa nɔna aa pɔah baa wola won dia la ken.
Mɛɛ kpɔ laa ne lɔr dɛ weechɔɡaa ba ta ba nɛ, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa hah ba.
Bobɛlbwa maa lɔ ba peɡre kaa la, nɛra ɛɛ na baa ba bambile teŋe ba nyoa kpo waa aa puu ba la wa.
Nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ mam baa, ba berɛ kon nɛra aa na dɛɛ taahno.
Gɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba ta n waa maa cheɡɛ n bonɔɔna baa ɛ n keamere nɛɛ dɛ bol ba be keraŋwɛnɛ bwa la noɛ.
Ba deno vɛh n waa la noe.’ ” Korowiirii bola.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Anomanta, hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ɛ no men Korowii wa, he nɛra maa ɡela ba lawɛ heyaa le Jerusalam kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn la.
Waa men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ aa dɛ bol Kolaya bibaa Ahab, ne Maaseya bibaa Sedekia waa nɔ.
N ŋɔ, ‘Ba cheɡɛ n sɔn ta dɛɛ teŋe nyosone anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ baa do Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa nɔn ta, ásɛ o kpoo ba he siwi ta.
Ba nomanta, nɛra baa laɡ ba le Juda harɛ kaa Babelɔn la bwa dɛ́ nyin ba taah nɛn aa baa ŋɔ, “Kórowii ɛo kɛŋɔ Sedekia ne Ahab Babelɔn kooro aa fuuh ba la.” Dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ wedoŋa tenten Israel harɛ ta, ba dɛ nyin ba bala haahna, dɛ che n sɔn ta teŋe nyosone, a ɛ waa maa wola ban a ta doe.
N jemɛ a bwa dɛɛ di a danseɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ” Tɔn baa chwera ka tɛ Sɛmaya Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la kpɔ kala tɛ men Jeremia n kpɔ tɛ Nehelam te Sɛmaya waa chwerɛ tɔn o sɔn ta ka tɛ nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam bwa, ne sɔfo Maaseya bibaa Sefania dɛ sɔfore baa kaa bwa be.
Tɔn la bini la, o bol Sefania be ŋɔ, “Korowii lee sɔfo he ba chiɡ Jehoiada naa ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi o Dea la ta.
Henee chɛ kɛ he nyiŋi dɛ́ lawɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ we choɡla, dɛɛ ɛ o te kɛ Korowii keamee on la, dɛ́ doo bune jɔɡrɔre ne bune kwaa o baŋa ta.
Ɛrɛɛ he ta Jeremia waa le Anatɔt dɛɛ bol waa kɛŋɔ Korowii keame la kaeh yɔ?
O kpɔ kala tɛ yaa Babelɔn kɛŋɔ yaa so belaa biɡri.
Anomanta, hé ma deene dɛ́ so a bini, ásɛ dɛ parɛ bodɛɛɡa dɛ́ du daa dɛɛ di a ta.” Anee sɔfo Sefania kure tɔn la bini waa baɡle men Jeremia.
Ate, Korowii bol waa n be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ kala nɔ ka tɛ nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa harɛfale ta bojaŋ la.
Ŋɔ Sɛmaya waa ɛ Nehelam te dɛ ba bol Korowii waa la baɡle la, n laa tomɔ, asɛ o neɡre dɛ ɡel he yarada waa aa ɛ nyosone.
Anomanta, mɛɛ tɛr Sɛmaya ne o naanar deŋnee.
O nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwara aa ka dɛ́ do nɛra nɔ bini.
Waa kondɛɛɡa maa dɛ ba kpɔe tɛ n nɛra la nae ba, dɛkalkɛ o ɛ deŋnekpeɡ o ta n waa ta teŋɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Korowii berɔ lɛ o nɛra Israel tena Waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Chwerɛ waa maa bol he be la bwa do tɔn bini.
Tɔpera ane dɛ ba, ásɛ n lawɛ n nɛra Israel ne Juda tena le harɛfala ta, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ ba ba harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ ba naawa ŋɔ ba konee la ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Waa Korowii aa bol n be, Israel ne Juda tena wa laanee nɔ.
“N no lɔŋɔ waa do ɔma kohona, hundam chole bobɛlbwa, deŋnesɔɔhna aa wola toole bela.
Hé pɛɛ no!
Baa lɛɛ won kpoŋe tea dɛ́ lolɛ bie aa?
Aah ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ na baala ba bwara aa kpeɡa, ba nɔɔra dawɛ ba teene ta kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ nɔɔ?
Nomɛlbwa siebɔr ɡwaŋɔ kohona.
Tɔpechɔɡe bɛl dɛ ba, baa won kpɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa maɡɔ.
Wɛɛ ɛ suna dii tɔperee tɛ Jekɔb naanar, kɛ ane a bwa, baa le a nyoaa.” Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ kuuɡi kon waa do kɛŋɔ da, ba yon kpɔ dawɛ nae nɛɛ aa parɛ, ba kpɔ dawɛ Jekɔb naanar baŋa ta laanee, dɛ́ kuuɡi jɔɡrɔre la ɡe bwa.
Ásɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra aa won dɛɛ fiɡ ba kpa.
Baa tomɛ men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ laanee, ne Kooro Devid naa maa leo tɛɛ ba, wɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ la.
Anomanta, n nɛra, he bɛ ɔmɛ, Israel tena, he bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ.
Mɛɛ lɛ heyaa le bojaŋ harɛre taa ba, he naanar baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta la.
Ásɛ he berɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ne bosɔɔhna, nomɛlbwa aa heyaa aah kpa.
Mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ lɛ heya.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ harɛre nɛra maa lɔ heyaa peɡre ba bini bwaa, kɛ he te, maa den chɔɡ heyaa kwaraa.
Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee, kɛ mɛɛ sune he nɛɛ dɛ́ nyiŋi heya kɛrɛdɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii berɔ bol waa o nɛra be ŋɔ, “He ŋwɛra aa won tonɛ, he bola haa dɔa bwa ɡe haa chaeh dɔ.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ nyiŋi he nɛ, tɛɛɡa toole dɛ́ chah he ŋwɛra, hwɛɡa bɛlbwa toole kɛ baa chah heyaa.
He daamanar bwa soh he wa, bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ nyiŋi heyaa kɛrɛdɛ kpa.
N baa yo heya kɛ he dɔm, dɛ tɛr he deŋne kohona, dɛkalkɛ he wechɔɡa ne he nyubinikpeɡ kan kɛrɛdɛ.
He bɛ bola baa do he yaa la waa dɛɛ wi, baa won chah heya.
He wechɔɡa ne he nyubinikpeɡ kan kohona, a waa n tɛr he deŋne.
Kɛ taraken, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin he chɔɡa la mɛɛ chɔɡoo, ásɛ ba lawɛ he dɔma bwa kaa harɛfala ta.
Nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi heya la, baa fiiɡi ba ɡee, ba pa he laala kaa laa, baa pa ba ɡe laalaa.
Kɛ mɛɛ berɔ ɡel he dɔ bokpeɡa ásɛ dɛ chah he ŋwɛra, a lole kɛŋɔ he dɔma dɛ bol kɛŋɔ, ‘Ba vɛh Saayɔn, nomɛlbwa aa o waa dawɛ kpa.’ Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ berɔ lawɛ n nɛra ba ba harɛ ta, dɛ́ dɔ tedoma tɛ bɛlbwa ne o lolanar.
Baa berɔ kwaa ma Jerusalam, dɛ́ kwaa o koodem la cheɡ o buɡ ta.
Nɛra baa soɡe bela ɛɛ ɡo kpɛɛra yelaa, dɛ́ do lɔŋɔre dɛɛ hɛɡre.
Mɛɛ swee ba andɛɛɡaa, dɛ́ ɡel ba mun ya, ásɛ dɛ dɔ duure.
Ba bii ɛɛ berɔ do kɛ saŋ la ken, ásɛ n lawɛ harɛ la nɛra ba che kiŋkiŋ n sie, dɛ́ tɛr nomɛlbwa waa fiɡ ba la deŋne.
Ba ɡbaɡba binii ba sitɔɔ waa ɛ ba kooro ɛɛ ba lee.
Mɛɛ lawɛ ɡɛ nɛn laanee ba n be ó bɛn mɛ.
Umee dɛ́ won ba n be dɛ n laa ta nɔn yerɔ wɔ?
Men Korowiirii bola.
Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba n nɛra ɛɛ, ásɛ n ɡe ɛ Korowii haa dɛɛ tom mɛ.” Hé na, Korowii bandia do kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ, dɛ́ ta kpɔ nyubinikpeɡ tena nyuune ta.
Korowii bandia waa do ɔma la nyoa aa won sɔɔh, atane o tonɛ o bambile bini wa.
Tɔpera ane ta dɛ ba mɔɔ, ásɛ n nɛra won no waa nɔ mun.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao ásɛ Israel deene bwa kpɔ mɛ ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ n ɡe kpɔ ba ɛ n nɛra.
Israel tena baa ka baa wola sewɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo ta la, mɛɛ sune ba nɛɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba bwara sɔɔh ba.” Korowii kpɔ o te baɡle Israel tena saŋ la dɛ ŋɔ, “Nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe n nyin heya.
Nyina kohonaa n ta teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin heya.
Israel tena, mɛɛ berɔ lawɛ heyaa ir, ásɛ he berɛ kwaa che kɛrɛdɛ.
Hɛɛ berɔ kpɔ he janjelaree le, he ne nɛra ba sie aa lɛa kaa sa.
Hɛɛ berɔɔ kwaa du daa kooni Samaria deŋɡarere ta.
Paa bɛlbwa waa dua la, wɛɛ di a nɔnaa ó sie lɛ.
Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah Efrem harɛ lɔŋɔre ɛɛ le deŋɡarere dor dɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘He ba ya kaa Saayɔn Bwejen waa lɔ Jerusalam la doa, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la be.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé ɡo silɛɛ yela tɛ Israel tena, ba harɛɛ kana harɛre bwa bini.
Hé ɡo kpɛɛra yel ŋɔ, ‘Korowii lɛ o nɛra banɔ la baa kaa la bwa.’ Mɛɛ laɡ baa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ́ boa ba nyoa le harɛ jaɡa.
Nyoŋa ne banɔ la ba peri aa serewa, hale tekpoŋra, dɛ banɔ la lol tea aa lɔ ba bwa, nɛnlaa tentenee dɛɛ ba bera ba.
Baa ba wii nee, dɛɛ soŋe men Korowii, ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba dɛɛ ba.
Mɛɛ laɡ baa kpɔ nenabɔɔne nyoo, harɛ waa chɔa kaa, baa wola naa lɔ o ta, dɛkalkɛ n ɛ Israel tena mɛɛ, Efrem ɡe ɛ n bibanloɡle.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra, hé no, hɛ́ɛ bol n waa la mpo nyoa bojaŋ harɛre ta.
N lɔ n nɛra Israel tena peɡre, kɛ mɛɛ berɔ boa ba nyoa, ásɛ dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre aa dɛ nyiŋi peera la ken.
N ɡelɔ Israel tena di ba nyu, dɛ lɛɛ ba le harɛre nɛra baa kpeɡa kohona nɔn ta.
Baa bao dɛ ba ɡo silɛɛ yela Saayɔn Bwejen la ta, ásɛ ba sie lɛ n koŋkɛɛla, aa ɛ mea ne sen ne ɔleve no, dɛ peera ne nae bwa ta.
Baa doo kɛŋɔ bodɛɛɡe ba du daa, bwaala nɛ o ta ken, dɛ́ dɔ kondɛɛɡa men Korowii aa kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Ásɛ ba sunaa di kpa.
Belaa toli ɛɛ ba sae ba sie lɛ, ásɛ bonɔɔna ne banjeni bwa ɛɛ hɛɡre.
Mɛɛ larawe ba bwaraa, dɛ́ ɡel ba wii ber ba silɛɛ, ásɛ ba dɔ hɛɡra kohona le ba suna dii ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo sɔfore di kondikondɛɛɡaa, ásɛ n nɛra bwa ɡe dɔ ba kwaa baa dɛ nyin.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Ba no taa bɛl le Rama.
Lokua wii naate ɛɛ wi.
Rakɛl dɛ wi o bii wa, ba larawo kahonɛ, dɛkalkɛ o bii bwa serewɔ.” Kenii Korowii ɛɛ bol, “Hé ɡel wii haa dɛ wi la, dɛ́ fee he siniire.
Anɔ la haa ɛa tɛ he bii aa pɛɛ ɛɛ ba, hɛɛ dɔ a kembɔree, ba bwa ɛɛ berɔɔ le ba dɔma harɛ taa ba.
Hwɛɡa lole tɛ heya kerekere, ásɛ he bii bwa berɛ ba ba harɛ la ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.
N no n nɛra Israel tena suna wii baa dɛ wi, ‘N Naa Korowii, ya do kɛŋɔ kondɛɛre waa kpaŋa ken, kɛ he baɡle yaa ŋɔ yaa teŋɛ he waa ta.
Berɛ lawɛ yaa ba he be, ya dɛ kpa kɛ he berɛ lawɛ yaa ba he be, dɛkalkɛ henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ.
Ya berɛ habɔɔ kpoe, kɛ a ta biɡre ya dɔ liire, dɛ berɛ ba he be.
Kɛ a habɔɔ haa tɛr ya deŋne la, ya baŋa ɡolo sihiih kpo yaa.
Sihiih kpo yaa kohona, dɛkalkɛ ya bechale saŋ bwaa ya le ɛ wechɔɡa.’ ” Anee Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, he do kɛŋɔ bibaa maa dɛ nyinu kohona.
Saŋ bɛlbwa maa yerɛ he sɔn la, he nyina waa dɛ do n bini kohona.
N bambile dɛ lawɛ, n dɔ tedoma tɛ heya.
Hé kpɔ kwaa paaɡe á ɛ nso ŋwɛnɛ la ta, á baɡle heya ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ o ta kaa.
Israel tena, hé berɛ ba, hé berɛ ba bwɛɛre haa le a ta kaa la ta.
Nɛra he wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba he ɡaaɡe bala nɔ ɡela ɔ?
He fa do kɛ bitolo o wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe.
Mɛɛ beɡre wobɛlbwa anfalaa harɛ nɔ bwa taa, kɛŋɔ haah aa kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o jaa nɛɛ la ken.” Korowii nɛra wer doe kerekere Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “N berɔ lawɛ Juda tena ɡe ba ba harɛ ta naa, baa dɛɛ bol Juda harɛ ne o bwɛɛre taa ŋɔ, ‘Korowii swee Saayɔn Bwejen waa lɔ Jerusalam boɡoroŋ bela o Dea aa lole la andɛɛɡa.’ Nɛra ɛɛ berɔɔ ba so Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta, paara ne peteɡra baa dɛ teɡɛ ba kondɛɛra bwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra ba bambile aa chɔɡa la dɔ bokpeɡfala, ásɛ dɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa lɔr aa kpoo o ɡwɛɡre kondikwaa o di.” Belaa men Jeremia n chɔ dɛ ir, asɛ n na kɛ n dom la som n be.
“Men Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, tɔpera ane dɛ ba ásɛ n ɡel nɛra ne kondɛɛra ba su Israel ne Juda harɛ bwa ta.
Gɛ maa nyiŋi ba nɛɛ dɛ fuɡri dɛ kuuɡi dɛ chɔɡ dɛ berɛ laɡ ba ir dɛ du la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ nyiŋa dɛ́ laɡ ba ir, ásɛ ba kpeɡ kɛŋɔ konduula ken.
Tɔpera la telaa, nɛra aa berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nya ne mɛɛ di ɡrepo nɔnnyɛɡa, ásɛ ba bii nyena nyɛɡ.’ Banɔ la baa di ɡrepo nɔnnyɛɡa la nyenaa dɛɛ ba nyɛɡa, ásɛ dɛ bwa serewe ba ɡbaɡba wechɔɡa baa ɛa wa.” Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao, ásɛ n ne Israel ne Juda tena bwa fɔwɛ fɔofale bɛl.
O ne fɔo la n ne ba naawa aa fɔwa a ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la, aa beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba naawa fa ta fɔo la ta teŋɛ.
Fɔo n ne Israel tena aa fɔwɛ tɔpera aa lɔ sie la ta laanee nɔ.
Mɛɛ kpɔ me Mmaraa do ba bambili bini, dɛ́ chwerɔ do ba nyuune bini, ásɛ n ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra.
Aa berɛ hiah kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa baɡle o dɔŋ kɛɛ o nime ŋɔ, ‘Jemɛ Korowii kɛ onee he Dɔɔ’ kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba bechale ne nomonome bwa ɛɛ jem mɛ kɛ ba Dɔɔree men.
Mɛɛ sune ba nɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ ba waa aa wola toɡrɛ kɛ ba, maa ba wechɔɡa waa lii kpa bwa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Menee ta wee asɛ wɛɛ chaah webaŋa, dɛ ɡel korobie ne weweela ɡe ɛɛ chaah jwaana.
Menee ɡela mpo ir dɛɛ lɔ nehɛma, Koranar Bwa Kooroo n sɔn.
A ɡɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua nɔ ɛɛ ɡel toma ɛɛ yaa, amɔ dɛ ɡɛɛ Israel harɛ nɛra ɡe aa wola lee do.
Dɛ tɔpebɛl ba fe ɛɛ won maɡɛ ɡɛ nyundua aa doa, dɛ́ jemɛ kwaa harɛ nɔ aa chɔŋɛ a ta naa, anee n fe vɛh n nɛra Israel tena waa bwa baa ɛa la wa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Tɔpera ane dɛ́ ba ásɛ ba berɛ kwaa ma bwɛjen Jerusalam n sɔn ta, dɛ́ le Hananɛl Dejaŋ wee cholibɔr, dɛ́ kaa Loŋkora Doonyoa la ta.
Ásɛ ba jwɛh le bela kaa wee cholibɔr dɛ́ kaa Gareb deŋɡare ta, dɛ́ bar kaa Goa.
Fɛlembɔjen la bwa, bela baa dɛ huɡe nɛra, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ta chaa o bini, dɛ harɛre aa chɔ Kedrɔn nenabɔɔ ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le Jaɡre Doonyoa wee leebɔr bwa, ɛɛ do ɡoroŋee tɛ mɛ.
Nomɛlbwa aa bwɛjen laanee kuuɡi kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡo kpa.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Jeremia harɛ bɛl yawa wa Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene fi ta, dɛ ɡɛ saŋ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ɡe di kora bene fi dɛ anuatoro.
Dɛ Babelɔn kooro laa tena baa bar Jerusalam cheme ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ laɡ mɛ do dea, n do Juda tena koodem dembaah, bela nɛra baa dɛ daah kooro aa lole.
Juda Kooro Sedekia laɡ mɛ do dea kɛŋɔ maa ŋɔa ŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba ɡela Babelɔn kooro ba yo bwɛjen nɔ tena, dɛ́ laɡ ba.
Kooro Sedekia aa won chwa.
Baa lawɔɔ ka tɛ Babelɔn kooro, ásɛ o ne o sie ɡba dɔŋa ba bol wa.
Baa lawɔɔ kaa Babelɔn, o do bela ka tel kɛŋɔ maa nyiŋi o waa bini tonɛ.
Hale o yo Babelɔn tena kwaraa naa, aa on kɛrɛdɛɛ chiɡ.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “He mɛɛ nime Hanamɛl waa ɛ Salum bibaa la ɛɛ ba he bee dɛ́ ba soŋe, hé yawɛ o koo waa lɔ Anatɔt Bɛnjamen harɛ ta.
Dɛkalkɛ henee ɛ o lole tenten dɛ dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ he yawɛ harɛ la.” Belaa Hanamɛl ba n be dembaah bela, dɛ ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń yawɛ harɛ la ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.
Anee ɡela n jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii bol waa n be kpela.
N yawɛ harɛ la le Hanamɛl be dɛ bɔ suuɡa aa chɛa la tɛo, a tɔɡre ɛɛ ɛ suuɡapoŋa fi dɛ anuanɛɛ.
N sɛoh dɛ chwerɛ tɔn la, dɛ kpɔ nɔn ɛɡɛ o ta, o che tɛ n ne o fɔo la, asɛ nomɛl di danseɛ asɛ n maɡɛ suuɡapoŋa aa chɛa kɛŋɔ n kpɔ bɔ kem la.
Belaa n kpɔ tɔne anɛ aa dɛ baɡle kɛ n yawɛ harɛ la, ne a wobɛlbwa aa jaa dɛ do tɔn la bini, onɔ la baa marɛ a nyoa ne onɔ la baa wola o nyoa marɛ, dɛ kpɔa tɛ Nɛrea bibaa Baruk, o nabaa sɔne Maseeya.
Hanamɛl ne danseɛ tena baa jaa dɛ ɛɡre ba nɔɔra la, dɛ Juda tena baa soɡe dembaah bela la bwa la siwi ta.
Ba bwa siwi ta bela la, n ŋɔ Baruk be ŋɔ, “Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ laanee doe ŋɔ he lɛ tɔn baa marɛ o nyoa, ne onɔ la baa wola o nyoa marɛ la bwa, dɛ́ kpɔa do leo bini ásɛ a won biɡri.
Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Baa berɔ yawɛ deene ne kooni dɛ daa kooni he harɛ nɔ ta ja.’ ” Jeremia wesoŋa Maa kpɔ danseɛ tɔn la tɛ Baruk habɔɔ la, n soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, henee cheɡɛ he kpeɡri kohona ta dɛ ta nyundua ne harɛ.
Wobɛlbwa aa kpeɡe tɛɛ.
He baɡle he nyina nɛra kaɡboŋa nɛ, kɛ he berɔ dɛɛ tɛr nɛra deŋne ba mɛɛnanar wechɔɡa baa ɛa wa.
He kan dɛ do kpeɡri, henee Koranar Bwa Kooro.
He dɛ vɔrɔwe vɔrɔwa aa wera dɛɛ ɛ wejena.
He sie lɔ wobɛlbwa nɛn aa dɛ ɛ ta, dɛɛ bɔ ba kem ɡɛ bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla aa doa.
A saŋ la, he ɛ nyokpowaa Ijipt harɛ ta, he ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛa dɛ ba le fini.
Israel ne harɛre nɛra bwa bini, a ɡel nomɛlbwa jemɛ he waa bobɛlbwa.
He cheɡɛ wejena ne nyokpowe-ɛɛla ta, dɛ kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta ya dɔma nɛ, dɛ che he kpeɡri ta lawɛ he nɛra Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta.
He kpɔ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe waa do ken nɔ tɛɛ ba, ɡɛ he fa aa baɡɛ ba naawa nyoa la.
Kɛ baa bala dɛ ba so o ta la, ba vɛh he Mmarare la, ba ta waa haa do ba a ta kɛɛ waa haa baɡ ba la ta teŋɛ.
A waa he kpɔ wenaale nɔ bwa ba ta ba nɛɛ la.
Babelɔn tena ma kwaa baa che a ta dɛ́ jo bwɛjen la bini bar o bwa, dɛ́ yoo ba dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Hale ba pa mun kwara.
Laa ne lɔr dɛ weela ɛɛ ɡeloo bá pɔ ba nɛɛ warane.
He ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ waa haa bola la ɛ ɡɛ.
A lole kɛŋɔ a ka tama Babelɔn tena ba yo dɛ lawɛ yaa kaa.
Kɛ ane a bwa, Nemenɛ Korowii, henee do mɛ ŋɔ ń yawɛ harɛ la nɛra baa di danseɛ la siwi ta.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii maa dɛ di kora harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ, wobɛlbwa toole dɛ do kpeɡri tɛ mɛ.
N dɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ kpɔe do Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ne o laa tena nɔn ta, ásɛ ba yoo dɛ́ pɔ o nɛra nɛ, ásɛ dɛ fuh o bwa.
Baa fuh bwɛjen la bwaa, ne nɛra baa fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ voɡ Baal ba sal deene dor, ne sen sarahare baa fuɡa dɛɛ tɛ voɡare ane dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ muɡli n baah la.
Israel ne Juda tena ta wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ka ja wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛ le ba bechale saŋ n sie.
Kasinteŋ, kwaa ba ɡbaɡba aa ɛa nɔɔra nee ba kpɔ muɡli n baah.
Nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen nɔ ta ir n bwaawee dɛ ɡel n baah di kohona le awola baa vɔrɔwo.
N ɛ n liire kɛ n chɔɡo, Juda ne Israel tena wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa, ba ne ba koranar ne nomonome dɛ n sɔfore dɛ n keamere la bwa.
Ba berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ n teŋɔ dɛɛ baɡ ba n waa la, kɛ baa deŋne cheɡ dɛ́ no n be, ásɛ dɛ hweli.
Hale ba kpɔ voɡa maa kia la ba cheɡ n Dea maa ŋɔa baa tom mɛ o bini la ta, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaoh.
Ba ma kwaa baa ɛ sarahare a ta tɛ voɡ Baal deŋɡarere dor.
Ba kpoo ba bibaala ne bihaahna ɡe dɛɛ tɛ voɡ Molɛk Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen ta.
N ta ban doe ŋɔ ba ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ, a toole n liire ta kwaraa ŋɔ baa ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔɔ, a che a ta Juda tena ɛ wechɔɡa.” Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Jeremia, nɛra nɔ dɛ bol ŋɔ laa ne lɔr dɛ weechɔɡa ɛɛ ɡeloo Babelɔn kooro ba yo yaa, dɛ́ pɔ ya nɛ, ásɛ ya do o lɔɡa.
Berɛ no waa maa dɔa dɛ́ bol ja, ‘N dɛ ba nɛra maa cheɡɛ n bandia kohona ta dɛ lɔ ba peɡre harɛre bwa ta la nyoa boara, mɛɛ berɔ ba ba bwa ne bonɔ, dɛ́ ɡel ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Baa ɛ n nɛraa, ásɛ n ɡe ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ.
Webeŋkpoŋ ɡboo mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛɛ ba ba soɡa bini, a chɛ kɛ baa tɛ mɛ duure saŋ bɛlbwa, ba naanar ne ba ɡbaɡba wer doe wa.
N ne baa fɔwɛ fɔwee ó chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Maa wedɛɛɡa maa ɛɛ ba ɡel bwa, mɛɛ kpɔ n ɔmaa do ba bini, ásɛ ba bɛ habɔɔ berɛ kpo mɛ kpa.
N sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ mɛɛ ɛɛ ba wedɛɛɡaa, dɛ́ ɡel ba so harɛ nɔ ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gɛ maa kpɔ wenaale ba ta nɛra nɔ nɛɛ nɔ, ɡɛ tentenee mɛɛ ba wedɛɛɡa ɡe ne bala ba tɛɛ ba, ɡɛ maa baɡ ba nyoa la.
Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ harɛ nɔ ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, ásɛ nɛra kɛɛ kpɔɡ bini ola aa wola won so o ta, ásɛ ba kpɔ do Babelɔn tena nɔn ta.
Kɛ baa berɔ yawɛ kooni bonɔ ja.
Nɛra ɛɛ yawaa, ásɛ ba ɛ a tɔne dɛ́ ɛɡre nɔɔra dɛ́ lɛa do, ásɛ nɛra di a danseɛ.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ, Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ne bwɛɛre aa bar Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ ta dɛ deŋɡarere harɛ bwɛɛre, ne Juda bwejena lɔɡre bwɛɛre bwa, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Nɛɡɛv waa ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa aa ba chiɡa.
Mɛɛ laɡ baa ba ba harɛ ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ”
Nyobaɡa hwɛɡa ane dɔe waa ja Baa lawɛ men Jeremia do dea n ta do dembaah bela baa dɛ daah la, Korowii berɔ bol waa n be nɛɛtena ja ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii maa ta harɛ nɔ dɛ kwaaro cheɡ o chɔŋɛ kwaa ta dɛ do le.
N sɔnee Korowii, Yer mɛ, ásɛ n chaŋe, ásɛ dɛ baɡle wejena ne waa aa sɔah haa wola an jemɛ.
Jerusalam deene ne Juda koodem bwa ɛɛ kuuɡuu, dɛ́ le nɛra baa baa chɔ baro dɛ yoo la wa.
Ba ne Babelɔn tena ɛɛ yo laalee, ásɛ ba deene su nɛra n baah aa dia n kpoo ba la.
Nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen nɔ ta wechɔɡa nomanta, n berɛ n habɔɔ kpo ba.
Kɛ bwɛjen nɔ nɛra te, mɛɛ berɔ ɡel bá dɔ bokpeɡa, dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ne bosɔɔhna ɡe kohona.
N dɛ ba ɡela Juda ne Israel tena wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel bá do kpeɡri ɡɛ ba fa aa doa wubwa la.
Mɛɛ fee ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛ jo n nɛɛ la bwaa, dɛ́ laa bolchɔɡe baa dia la kpɔ ba nɛ.
Ásɛ a che bwɛjen Jerusalam nɛra nɛ n dɔ silɛɛ ne jirima dɛ duure, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa ɔmɛ dɛɛ chel, wedɛɛɡa maa ɛa tɛ Jerusalam tena, ne ɡɛ maa ɡela ba wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba la wa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛra dɛ bol ŋɔ bonɔ do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, nɛra kɛɛ kondɛɛra toole o ta.
Kpelaa ba ŋɔ.
Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna bwa chɔ pɛɛ, nɛra kɛɛ kondɛɛra toole bela.
Kɛ hɛɛ berɔɔ baa no, silɛɛ ne hɛɡra lɔŋɔre dɛ hanfalwaa mune ɡbɔɡa.
Hɛɛ noo nɛra ɡo yela dɛ́ kpɔ jam sarahare dɛɛ ba n Dea, dɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé kpɔ jam tɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro!
O waa wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’ Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ nɔ berɛ do wer ɡɛ o fa aa doa wubwa la.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Harɛ nɔ waa do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ nɛra kɛɛ kondɛɛra aa wola toole o ta nɔ, saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao ásɛ peteɡra dɔ dibɔra tɛ ba peera a kaa di.
Deŋɡarere bwɛɛre ne bwejena lɔɡre bwɛɛre, ne Nɛɡɛv bwɛɛre aa lɔ Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta, ne bwɛɛre aa bar Jerusalam, dɛ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta la, peteɡra ɛɛ won dɔ bɔr dɛɛ kure ba peera.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Tɔpera ane dɛ ba ásɛ waa maa baɡɛ Israel ne Juda tena nyoa la ɛ ɡɛ.
A ɡɛ tɔpera la, mɛɛ ɡeloo Kooro Devid naanar bini nɛn o wa aa toɡra ir, dɛ́ kpɔ waa aa toɡra ne kasinteŋ ba harɛ la ta.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, mɛɛ lɛ Juda ne Jerusalam nɛra bwaa, ásɛ ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Ásɛ baa yerɛ bwɛjen Jerusalam ‘Korowii Waa ɛ Ya Lɛɛ.’ ” Anomanta, kenii Korowii ɛɛ bol, “Kooro Devid naa ɛɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ di kora Israel harɛ, ásɛ sɔfore le Lewi dea dɛɛ tom mɛ n Dea saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛɛ fuh sarahare ne mea sarahare, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa baa kpoora ɡe baa tɛ mɛ.” Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa wola won chɔɡ fɔo waa chɔ n ne webaŋa ne jwaana baah, ásɛ webaŋa ne jwaana aa won ɛ toma a saŋ ta la, ɡɛɛ haa wola won chɔɡ fɔo n ne n bonɔɔ Devid aa fɔwa o do le la.
O naa ɛɛ di koraa saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.
Gɛ tentenee n ne n sɔfore baa le Lewi dea ɡe fɔwɛ fɔo kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ tom mɛ saŋ bɛlbwa, a ɡɛ fɔo la aa wola won chɔɡ bwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n bonɔɔ Devid naanar, ne Lewi dea tena baa ɛ n Dea sɔfore mun ya kohona, ásɛ ba bɛ won kur ba, kɛŋɔ baa wola won kure weweela kɛɛ mpo nyoa hɛŋle la.” Korowii berɔ bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “He ta noɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra nɔ aa dɛ bol ŋɔ, men Korowii vɛh Israel ne Juda tena maa lee ba tɛ n te la aa?
Ba hah n nɛra, dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nyubaahna, baa wola ban komɛl yerɛ, dɛɛ lii ba harɛfale bɛl nɛra.
Kɛ men Korowii fɔo chɔ n ne webaŋa ne jwaana baah, dɛ do mmarare tɛ nyundua ne harɛ bwa.
Gɛ maa ɛa nɔ nomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo n ne Jekɔb naanar ne n bonɔɔ Devid fɔo yaa fɔwa la do le.
Mɛɛ le Devid naanar la bini bɛlee ó ba nyiŋi Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb naanar nɛ.
Mɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ n nɛra, dɛ́ ɡel ba wobɛlbwa berɛ do wer tɛɛ ba ja.”
Kooro Sedekia jae wa Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be, ɡɛ saŋ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ne o laa tena, ne harɛre nɛra, dɛ wobol bwa soo siwi nɛra baa lɔ o lɔɡa, aa pɛa dɛɛ yo Jerusalam ne bwɛɛre aa baro cheme.
Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ waa waa bol n be laanee kɛŋɔ, ń ir la ka ŋɔ Juda Kooro Sedekia be ŋɔ, o dɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ kpɔe do Babelɔn kooro nɔn ta, ásɛ o fuh o bwa.
Kooro Sedekia aa bɔree dɔ chwa, baa lawɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka do Kooro Nebukadnesa nɔn ta.
O ne o sie ɛɛ ɡba dɔŋaa ba bol wa, ásɛ ba lawɔ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Jeremia ŋɔ, “Juda Kooro Sedekia, cheɡ deŋne no waa Korowii aa ŋɔa ń bol he be.
‘Baa hen laa ta kpoe ba.
Deŋnesɔɔhna taa hɛɛ ba sewa.
Gɛ nɛra yon dɛɛ fuh daawiile ɡɛ saŋ ba yon dɛɛ huɡe koranar baa ɛ he naawa dɛ tɔ he sie la, ɡɛɛ baa ba daawiile fuih tɛ he ɡe.
Baa wiu dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Akwe, ya kooro sewɔ.” ’ ” Belaa men Korowii keame Jeremia bol waa nɔ bwa Juda Kooro Sedekia be Jerusalam, ɡɛ saŋ Babelɔn kooro laa tena aa dɛ yo bwɛjen Jerusalam la.
Dɛ laa tena la dɛ yo bwɛjena Lakes ne Aseka ɡe, dɛ a ɡboo ka bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara Juda harɛ ta.
Yoma nyu dii Korowii berɔ bol waa men Jeremia be, ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Sedekia ne Jerusalam tena bwa aa fɔwɛ fɔo, dɛ tɛ yoma bwa ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ bá di ba nyu, yoma baa ɛ Hibru tena, haahna ne baala bwa, ɡɛ aa ɛ Juu te bɛlbwa bɛ o dɔŋ yom lawɛ.
Anomanta, nɛra la ne ba nomonome bwa baa fɔwɛ fɔo la sɛoh ŋɔ, baa ɡel nɛra baa laɡ ba yoma laanee, ásɛ ba bɛlbwa di o nyu.
Asɛ ba bwa sɛh dɛ ɡel bɛlbwa dɔ o te.
Kɛ a habɔɔ, nɛra baa dɔ yoma dɛ ɡel ba di ba nyu la charɛ ba liire, ba ɛɡ ba dɛ ɛɛ ba yoma ja.
Belaa Korowii bol men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘N ne he naawa fɔwɛ fɔo ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta, bela baa do ba kɛŋɔ yoma la, kɛŋɔ bene anuanɛ bɛlbwa ta la, Hibru te bɛlbwa waa tomɛ o dɔɔ bene anumɛl la, a chɛ kɛ bá ɡelo ó di o nyu.
Kɛ ane a bwa, he naawa ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no n be.
Dɛ ɛ tɔpera tamaa ane aa baa kaa, he charɛ he liire dɛ ɛ wa aa toɡra n sie, he bini bɛlbwa tɛ o dɔŋ waa ɛ yom ŋwɛnɛ o di o nyu.
Hale dɛ fɔwɛ fɔo n sie, n Dea bonɔ haa dɛ tom mɛ.
Kɛ he berɔ charɛ he liire dɛɛ chɔɡ n sɔn, bɛlbwa berɔ ka lawɛ baa kɛɛ haah o fa aa ɛ yom he lawɔ la.
He berɔ ɛɡ ba dɛ ɛɛ ba yoma ja.
Anomanta, men Korowii ŋɔ, he ta n waa la noɛ, he ta ɡelɛ he bala dɔ ba nyu di.
Gɛ aa wera laanee kɛŋɔ, mɛɛ ɡeloo hé di he nyu, ásɛ laa ne weechɔɡa dɛ lɔr ɡe kpoo heya.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre nɛra bwa bambile teŋe he wa.
Baala baa wola n ne ba fɔo yaa fɔwa ta teŋɛ la, mɛɛ ɛɛ baa kɛŋɔ ba yon fɔwɛ fɔo dɛ́ pere nabale bini anɛ, ásɛ dɛ valɛ kpɔ o baah ta kaa la ken.
Juda ne Jerusalam dɛ koodem nomonome, ne sɔfore dɛ harɛ la ta nɛra bwa n ne baa fɔwɛ fɔo ba valɛ kpɔ nabale baa pere o bini anɛ baah la, mɛɛ laɡ baa tɛ ba dɔma baa dɛ nyin ba dɛ kpoo laanee.
Ásɛ ba ola berɛ kondikwa tɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini ola.
Mɛɛ lawɛ Juda Kooro Sedekia ne o nomonomee tɛ ba dɔma baa dɛ nyin ba dɛ́ kpoo laanee, dɛ Babelɔn kooro laa tena baa ŋɔa ŋɔ baa heya ba yo kpa la.
Mɛɛ do baa ásɛ ba berɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ ta.
Baa ba yo nɛra baa lɔ o taa dɛ́ laɡ ba, ásɛ dɛ fuh o bwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo Juda harɛ bwɛɛre do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken, nomɛlbwa aa won so a ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ”
Jeremia ne Rekab tena wa Gɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa di kora Juda harɛ la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ir la Rekab dea luɡe nɛra be ka bol waa ba be.
Ásɛ dɛ laɡ ba ba deene aa lɔ Korowii Dea keŋkeŋ la bɛl bini, ásɛ dɛ tɛɛ ba sen bá nyɔ.” Anomanta, n laŋɔ dɛ ka lawɛ Jeremia nɛɛte ɡe bibaa Jaasania.
A ɡɛ Jeremia nɔ mɛɛ Habasiinia.
Jaasania nimanar ne o dɔɔranar dɛ o bibaala bwa n lawɛ, dɛ ba ba ne Korowii Dea bela.
N laɡ ba jo Iɡdalia bibaa Hanan waa ɛ Korowii keame, ne o habɔteŋra dea.
Gɛ dea nɔ lɔ Salum bibaa Maaseya dea nyunduabɔr, dɛ Salum dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa, asɛ nomonome la bini bane ɡe baa jaa kwaa teŋɛ.
Ate, n kpɔ sen aa su loŋa dɛ numoli cheɡ Rekab tena la sie, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé lɛ sen nyɔ.” Belaa ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Yaa sen nyɔ, ya nabaa Jonadab waa ɛ Rekab bibaa do yaa ŋɔ, ya ne ya naanar bɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛ ya nyɔ sen bwa.
O berɔ ŋɔ a ta chɛ kɛ yá do deene, kɛɛ dɛ́ parɛ kɛɛ dɛ́ yawɛ daa kooni.
O do yaa ŋɔ yáa so tɛnte deene ɡbo bini, ásɛ dɛ won so harɛ yaa soɡe o ta kɛŋɔ nɛŋhɔɔhra nɔ ta.
Ya teŋɛ wobɛlbwa ya nabaa Jonadab aa do yaa la ta.
Ya ne ya haahna kɛɛ bibaala ne bihaahna bɛlbwa ta sen nyɔe bwa, kɛɛ dɛ do deene so a bini kɛɛ dɛ dɔ daa kooni, kɛɛ koo kondikwa.
Ya soɡe tɛnte deene bini dɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa ya nabaa Jonadab aa do yaa a ta bwa.
Kɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ne o laa tena aa baa lɔ tɔ ya nɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta la, ya liiro kɛŋɔ ya chwa ba Jerusalam dɛ le Babelɔn ne Siiria laa tena nyoa.
A waa ya so Jerusalam la.” Belaa Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ja ŋɔ, “Ir la ka ŋɔ baala baa lɔ Juda ne Jerusalam be ŋɔ, ‘Amɔ haa waa hweli ásɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ waa ta naa?
Rekab bibaa Jonadab do o bibaala ŋɔ ba bɛ sen nyɔ, asɛ ba teŋɛ a ta.
Hale ba le fini baa sen nyɔ, dɛkalkɛ ba no ba nabaa deŋna wa.
Kɛ ane a bwa, n teŋɔ bol waa he be keraŋwɛnɛ bwa, kɛ bɛlbwa ta n waa ta teŋɛ.
N teŋɔ tomɛ n bonɔɔna baa ɛ n keamere bwa he be.
Ba bol he be ŋɔ bɛlbwa charɛ o liire le wechɔɡa ta dɛ́ ɡel he we-ɛɛla do wer.
Dɛ he bɛ voɡare ane nɛɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ toma.
Ásɛ he won so harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ he ne he naawa la ta.
Kɛ ane a bwa, he ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no n be.
Jonadab naanar teŋɛ waa ba nabaa aa bol ba be la ta, kɛ he ta n waa ta teŋɛ.’ Anomanta, men Korowii Maa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ ɛɛ kpɔ wekpeɡa maa ŋɔa mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta Juda ne nomɛlbwa waa lɔ Jerusalam nɛɛ laanee ba.
Dɛkalkɛ n bol waa he be, he ta noɛ, dɛ yerɛ heya he ta men chaŋɛ.” Ate, men Jeremia ŋɔ Rekab dea luɡe nɛra la be ŋɔ, Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la bolɔ ŋɔ, “He no waa he nabaa Jonadab aa bol he be la, dɛ teŋɛ waa waa baɡle heya, ne anɔ la bwa waa do heyaa ta.
Anomanta, men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ ŋɔ, ‘Rekab bibaa Jonadab luɡe taa nɛra ɛɛ ba lee dɛɛ tom mɛ.’ ”
Baruk kure Korowii tɔn o Dea Juda Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa di kora bene anaarɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ kpɔ tɔn chwerɛ Israel ne Juda tena, dɛ harɛre aa jaa waa maa bol he be, dɛ́ le Kooro Josia bere saŋ ba le fini.
Dɛ Juda tena no wekpeɡa maa dɛ nyin n kpɔ ba ta ba nɛɛ nɔ naa, ba ken ɛɛ charɛ ba liiree le ba wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ n kpɔ ba nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla ne ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba.” Anomanta, men Jeremia yerɛ Nɛrea bibaa Baruk, dɛ kpɔ waa bwa Korowii aa bol n be la tɛo ó chwerɛ.
Asɛ Baruk chwerɛ a bwa do tɔn bini.
Asɛ n ŋɔ Baruk be ŋɔ, “Ba ta men ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ n won jo Korowii Dea, anomanta, ir la bela awola tɔpere baa dɛɛ vɔwɛ nyoa la, ásɛ dɛ kure tɔn la bini waa maa ɡela he chwerɛ do tɔn bini la bwa baɡle ba.
Kura baɡle Juda tena baa le ba bwɛɛre ta ba la bwa.
Ba ken ɛɛ soŋe Korowii, ásɛ dɛ charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii kpɔ o bandia waa do ɔma kohona la dɛɛ ba ba ta ba nɛ.” Gɛɛ a do Baruk kure Korowii waa waa chwera do tɔn bini la Korowii Dea bela, ɡɛ maa bol o be la.
Juda Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa di kora Juda harɛ bene anue, korobie anuanaarɛ ta la, nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam ne Juda bwɛɛre ta nɛra bwa vɔwɛ nyoa ba waa dɔ nyɛl Korowii be.
Gemaria mɛɛ Safan waa ɛ koodem karake dea belaa Baruk che dɛ kure waa bwa maa bol o be o chwerɛ do tɔn bini la.
O dea la lɔ nyunduabɔr dɛ bɛne Korowii Dea doonyoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Doonyofale la bɔr.
Baruk kure Korowii tɔn bini waa baɡle nomonome Mikaya waa ɛ Gemaria bibaa dɛ ɛ Safan naa, no Korowii waa bwa aa lɔ tɔn la bini, ate o ir la koodem karake la dea bela, dɛ nomonome la bwa soɡo.
Banee koodem karake Elisama, ne Sɛmaya bibaa Delaya, ne Akbɔ bibaa Ɛl Netan, ne Safan bibaa Gemaria, ne Hanania bibaa Sedekia, dɛ nomonome baa kaa bwa.
Mikaya aa bol waa bwa waa noa Baruk kure le tɔn la bini baɡle nɛra la tonɛ la, nomonome la bwa tomɛ Nɛtanea bibaa Jehudi, o nabaa sɔne Sɛlɛmia, asɛ Sɛlɛmia ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Kusi.
Jehudi laŋɔ ka ŋɔ Baruk be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ tɔn haa kure o bini waa baɡle nɛra la ba.” Anomanta, Baruk iro kpɔ tɔn la kpoŋe kaa ba be.
Anee nomonome la ŋɔ Baruk be ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ soŋe, so harɛ ásɛ dɛ kure baɡle ya ɡe.” Ate, Baruk kuro baɡ ba.
Baa no tɔn la bini waa la, ba nyiŋi dɔŋa sie bochela ne dɛ ŋɔ Baruk be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ yá bol waa nɔ bwa baɡle kooro.” Ate, ba berɛ bɔɔ Baruk ŋɔ, “Baɡle yaa ɡɛ haa ɛa dɛ won chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa.
Jeremiaa bola baɡle he chwerɛ kɛɛ?” Ate, Baruk chaŋe ŋɔ, “Jeremiaa bol wobɛlbwa n be, asɛ n ɡe chwera do tɔn nɔ bini.” Belaa ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He ne Jeremia bwa ka nyin bɔr sɔh.
He bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa jemɛ bela haa lole.” Kooro fuh tɔn la Nomonome la kpɔ tɔn la ka bil koodem karake Elisama dea, asɛ dɛ la kooro be o dembaah dɛ ka bol wobɛlbwa baɡlo.
Belaa kooro tomɛ Jehudi ŋɔ ó ka kpɔ tɔn la ba.
Asɛ o la Elisama dea ka kpɔ ba, dɛ ba kure baɡle kooro ne nomonome baa cheɡa baro la bwa.
Dɛ waa saŋee, asɛ kooro so o koodem baŋ bɛl, dɛɛ ŋwee nii koropɔɔto ta.
Jehudi aa kure tɔn la baŋne atoro kɛɛ anaarɛ tonɛ la, kooro la kpɔ kerejeɡa teŋe tɔn la bini, dɛ paa ta koropɔɔto la bini, ka tel kɛŋɔ tɔn la bwa aa fuah.
Kɛ ane a bwa, kooro ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ dɛ no waa nɔ la, ta ɔmɛ, a ba ɛ kɛ baa tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡoo.
A lole kɛŋɔ Ɛl Netan ne Delaya dɛ Gemaria soŋe kooro la ŋɔ o bɛ tɔn la fuh, kɛ o ta ba be noɛ.
Ate, Kooro la do o bibaa Jeramiil, ne Asriel bibaa Seraya dɛ Abdeel bibaa Sɛlɛmia ŋɔ bá ba lawɛ Baruk ne men Korowii keame Jeremia ba tɛo.
Kɛ Korowii lawɛ yaa sɔh.
Kooro Jehoiakim aa fuh tɔn maa bol o bini waa baɡle Baruk tonɛ la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, ń kpɔ tɔnfale dɛ́ chwerɛ waa aa lɔ loɡle tɔn Kooro Jehoiakim aa fuuh la do o ta.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ ń bol Juda Kooro Jehoiakim be ŋɔ, “He fuh tɔn la, dɛɛ bɔɔ Jeremia ɡɛ aa ɛa o chwerɛ ŋɔ Babelɔn kooro ɛɛ bao ba chɔɡ he harɛ nɔ, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa aa lɔ o ta.
Anomanta, waa men Korowii aa dɛ bol hen Kooro Jehoiakim be laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘He naa bɛlbwa aa kara Kooro Devid aa soɡe o ta la dii ba bwa.
He dɛ ba sewa ba kpɔ he chɔɔ ka ta, ásɛ wee lɔ he nɛɛ webaŋa, jwaana ɡe la mɛn lee he nɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛr he ne he naanar dɛ he nomonome deŋnee, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa dɛ jo n nɛɛ la wa.
He ne Jerusalam kɛɛ Juda tena bɛlbwa ta deŋne cheɡɛ dɛ no waa maa dɛ kah heyaa la, anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ wekpeɡa maa ŋɔa mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta he nɛɛ laanee ba.’ ” Anomanta, men Jeremia kpɔ tɔnfale tɛ Nɛrea bibaa Baruk waa ɛ n karake la.
Asɛ o chwerɛ wobɛlbwa a fa aa lɔ loɡle tɔn la bini dɛ anɔ la bwa aa jaa n kpɔ tɛo la.
Jeremia lawa dɛ́ do dea Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa lawɛ Josia bibaa Sedekia so kora ta Juda harɛ ta chiɡ Jehoiakim bibaa Jehoiachin naa ta.
Kɛ o ne o nomonome ne harɛ la ta nɛra bini bɛlbwa ta deŋne cheɡɛ, dɛ no waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ men Jeremia nɛɛ dɛ bol ba be la.
Belaa Kooro Sedekia tomɛ Sɛlɛmia bibaa Jehukal, ne Maaseya bibaa sɔfo Sefania ŋɔ ń che ba naa ta soŋe Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la tɛ ya harɛ nɛra.
Dɛ ba ta men Jeremia lawɛ do dea mɔɔ, asɛ n do nɛra la baah dɛɛ valɛ.
Babelɔn laa tena yon ba bar Jerusalam cheme dɛɛ yoo ba, kɛ baa noa kɛŋɔ Ijipt kooro laa tena le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, ba laa berɛ kaa.
Belaa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la bol waa n be ŋɔ, ń bol Juda Kooro Sedekia be ŋɔ, “Ijipt laa tena lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ ba bá cha heya, kɛ baa berɔɔ kaa ba harɛ ta.
Ásɛ Babelɔn laa tena la berɛ ba ja dɛ́ ba yo bwɛjen nɔ nɛra dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ dɛ fuh o bwa ja.
Men Korowii ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ berɛ he te neɡra dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ Babelɔn tena ɛɛ ɡel heyaa.
Baa ɡɛɛ ɛ!
Hale dɛ he wono pɔ Babelɔn laa tena bwa nɛ, asɛ a ka banɔ la baa do ba bola ɡbo ba chɔ ba tɛnte deene bini kwaraa naa, baa iruu le dɛ́ ba fuh bwɛjen nɔ bwa.” Babelɔn laa tena berɔ le Jerusalam kaa, dɛkalkɛ Ijipt kooro laa tena dɛ ba.
Ate, men Jeremia pa mun le bwɛjen Jerusalam ta dɛ́ kaa Bɛnjamen dea harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka lɛ n bɔr maa dɔ le n lolanar harɛ ta.
Kɛ maa tel Bɛnjamen Doonyoa ta la, nomoa waa chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah bela nyoa baa yerɔ Irija, o mɛɛ Sɛlɛmia, o nabaa ɡe sɔne Hanania, laɡ mɛ dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “He chwao dɛɛ kaa Babelɔn tena be.” Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Gɛ laa a do!
Chwae laa n chwa dɛɛ kaa Babelɔn tena be.” Ane a bwa, Irija ta n be noɛ, o laɡ mɛ dɛ kpɔ mɛ kaa nomonome la be.
Ba baah di n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ŋɔ bá lɔɔ mɛ, dɛ kpɔ mɛ ka do koodem karake Jonatan dea.
Dɛ ba beɡre o dea la dɛ lawɛ nɛra dɛɛ do o bini.
Anomanta, ba laɡ mɛ do dea bɛl baa kwiu bɔɔ, biro tenten do o bini, asɛ n do bela biɡri.
A habɔɔ la, Kooro Sedekia tomɔ ba ba yer mɛ ba o be koodem.
Asɛ o bɔɔ mɛ bokɛre ŋɔ, “Waane lole dɛ le Korowii be tɛ yaa kɛɛ?” Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Waane lole, baa lawɛɛ tɛ Babelɔn kooro.” Belaa n bɔɔ Kooro Sedekia ŋɔ, “Wechɔɡa besoo n ɛ he ne he nomonome ne nɛra nɔ, asɛ he laɡ mɛ do dea nɔɔ?
He keamere baa ŋɔa ŋɔ Babelɔn kooro aa he harɛ nɔɔ ba yo la bɔkwa waa puu baɔ?
Taraken n naa kooro, cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa maa dɛ ba he bɔɔra nɔ dɛ́ ɛ tɛ mɛ.
N dɛ soŋe kɛ he bɛ men kpɔ ka do dea Jonatan dem bela kpa.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, sewaa chɛ kɛ n den sewɛ.” Anomanta, Kooro Sedekia ɡelɔ ba do mɛ dea o dembaah bela.
N lɔ bela, asɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa nɛra baa dɛ wɔɔ paanoo ɛɛ tɛ mɛ paanoo beŋkpoŋ, ka tel kɛŋɔ paanoo aa baa tonɛ bwɛjen la bwa ta.
Ba lawɛ Jeremia ta kɔlɔŋ bini Dɛ Matan bibaa Sɛfatea ne Pasur bibaa Gedalia ne Sɛlɛmia bibaa Jehukal dɛ Malkija bibaa Pasur dɛ no waa men Jeremia yon bol dɛɛ baɡle nɛra dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
Nomɛlbwa waa so bwɛjen Jerusalam ta la, laa kɛɛ lɔr kɛɛ weechɔɡaa dɛɛ ba o kpoe.
Kɛ banɔ la baa kpɔ ba te ka do Babelɔn tena lɔɡa la ɛɛ dɔ ba nyuu, baa wola sewɛ.” Korowii berɔ bol ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba bwɛjen nɔ nɛra kpɔe do Babelɔn Kooro ne o laa tena nɔn ta, ásɛ ba yoo ba, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.” Belaa nomonome la ŋɔ Kooro Sedekia be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ chɛ kpoe.
O dɛ chɔɡ laa tena baa ka bwɛjen nɔ ta, ne nɛra la bwa liire o wobol ne.
Ba kɛrɛdɛ laa wɛɛ nyin, ka ja ba chɔɡa ta.” Anee Kooro Sedekia chaŋe ŋɔ, “N kpɔɔ do he nɔn ta.
Maa won tɔe ŋwɛnɛ.” Anomanta, ba lawɛ men Jeremia dɛ kpɔ mɛ ta kooro bibaa Malkija kɔlɔŋ bini.
Dɛ o lɔ kooro dembaah bela nɛra la aa dɛ daah la.
Ŋwɛɛraa ba kpɔ vɔɡ mɛ dɛ kpɔ mɛ tu kɔlɔŋ la bini.
Dɛ nee toole o bini, kpechɛɡre ɡboo, asɛ n ka jo a ta.
Kɛ Itiopia te Ɛbɛd Mɛlɛk, o ɡe aa ɛ nomoa dɛ do koodem bela noɔ kɛ ba laɡ mɛ ta kɔlɔŋ bini.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ kooro soɡe Bɛnjamen Doonyoa la ta, anomanta, Ɛbɛd Mɛlɛk iro la o be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, nyubinikpeɡ waa baala nɔ ɛ Korowii keame Jeremia la.
Ba lawɔ ka ta kɔlɔŋ bini bela lɔr aa dɛ ba o kpoe ó sewɛ, dɛkalkɛ bwɛjen nɔ kwaraa ta la, kondikwaa toole kpa.” Belaa kooro do Ɛbɛd Mɛlɛk ŋɔ ó kpɔ baala fifraatoro ja o nɛ, ásɛ dɛ tɛr mɛ le kɔlɔŋ la bini ásɛ n bɛ sewɛ.
Anomanta, Ɛbɛd Mɛlɛk lawɛ baala la ja o nɛ, asɛ ba la dea bɛl baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa o bini koodem bela la lɔɡa.
O pa yakwane ne laala ane aa kɛɛra le bela asɛ dɛ vɔrɔwa, dɛ ta ŋwɛɛra la do n be kɔlɔŋ la bini.
Belaa Ɛbɛd Mɛlɛk ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ yakwane la ne laala aa kɛɛra la do he luɡbɔɔne ásɛ ŋwɛɛra haa kpɔ vɔwɛ a ta la bɛ hen bola ba do.” N ɛ ɡɛ, asɛ ba tɛr mɛ le kɔlɔŋ la bini ŋwɛɛra la ne.
Asɛ n den ka do dembaah bela nɛra la aa dɛ daah la.
Kooro Sedekia bɔɔ Jeremia waa ja Ate, Kooro Sedekia tomɛ ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ men Jeremia ba doonyotooro te waa lɔ Korowii Dea bela la ta, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba hen waane bɔɔra, kɛ na kɛŋɔ haa wobɛlbwaa kpɔ sɔɔh mɛ.” Asɛ men Jeremia chaŋe Kooro Sedekia ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ n bol kasinteŋ la he be naa, hɛɛ kpo mɛɛ.
Hale dɛ n ŋɔ mɛɛ jae kwaraa ɡe aa, haa n bee no.” Anomanta, Kooro Sedekia sɔɔh dɛ ŋwɛɛ baɡ mɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ tɛ yaa mkpa nɔ, maa hen kpo kɛɛ dɛ́ lawɛ do nɛra baa dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo nɔn ta.” Belaa n ŋɔ Kooro Sedekia be ŋɔ, “Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ he kpɔ he te do Babelɔn kooro nomonome lɔɡa aa, baa hen kpo, ásɛ dɛ ɡel bwɛjen nɔ ɡe fuih, he ne he lolanar bwa ɡe dɔ he nyu.
Kɛ dɛ he ta he te kpɔe ka do Babelɔn kooro nomonome lɔɡa aa, bwɛjen nɔ ɛɛ ka do Babelɔn tena nɔn taa ásɛ ba fuuh, he ɡbabir kwara aa he nyuu dɔ.’ ” Asɛ Kooro Sedekia ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ɔmɛ Juu tena baa kpɔ ba te ka ja Babelɔn tena bini la, dɛkalkɛ Babelɔn tena la ken ɛɛ lee mɛɛ tɛɛ ba, ásɛ ba fiɡ mɛ.” Anee men Jeremia chaŋe ŋɔ, “Baa he lee ba dɛ tɛɛ ba.
He te ɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa bola la ta, ásɛ wobɛlbwa kaa kɛrɛdɛ tɛɛ, he dɔ he nyu.
Kɛ dɛ he ta sɛɛh dɛ kpɔ he te do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa aa, waa Korowii aa pili a bini baɡ mɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, haahna la bwa baa kaa dɛ do Juda kooro dem bela la, baa laɡ baa le bela ka tɛ Babelɔn kooro nomonome.
A ɡɛ haahna la ɛɛ bol he bee ŋɔ, ‘Kooro daamanar tenten neɡro, ba waa tɔɔɡe o waa ta.
Taraken o nakpale aa morɛ kpechɛɡre ta nɔ, o daamanar chwao ɡelo.’ ” Asɛ men Jeremia berɛ ŋɔ, “Baa lawɛ haahna ne ba bii bwaa ka tɛ Babelɔn tena.
He ɡbabir ɡe aa a nyoa lee ba.
Babelɔn kooro ɛɛ lawɛ hen kooro laa taa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta, ásɛ ba fuh bwɛjen nɔ bwa dɛɛboo ken.” Belaa Kooro Sedekia chaŋ mɛ ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa no waa yaa bola nɔ, ɡɛ la aa, hɛɛ sewɔɔ.
Nomonome la noɔ kɛŋɔ n ne he bol waane aa, baa bao dɛ ba bɔɔre waa haa bol kooro be, ne waa waa bol he be.
Baa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ dɛ hɛɛ bol kasinteŋii yaa, baa hen kpo.
Den ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ dɛ he dɛ soŋ mɛ ŋɔ n bɛ hen lawɛ ka do dea Jonatan dem ásɛ he sewɛ bela.” Ate, nomonome la bwa ba n be dɛ ba bɔɔ mɛ wa, asɛ n bol wobɛlbwa kooro aa do mɛ ŋɔ ń bol ba be la.
Anomanta, ba ta wone ɛ wobɛlbwa kpa, dɛkalkɛ ba bini bɛlbwa ta waa n ne kooro aa bola la noɛ.
Anomanta, ba laɡ mɛ do dea n do koodem dembaah bela ka tel tɔpere Babelɔn laa tena aa baa yo Jerusalam tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
Jerusalam paɡra wa Waa aa cheɡɛ a ta Jerusalam paɡre laanee nɔ, Kooro Sedekia aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bene anuanaarɛ, korobie fi ta la, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena bwa kaa Jerusalam dɛ ka chɔ bar ba, dɛ yoo ba.
Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta, korobinaarɛ tɔpenuanaarɛ ta la, ba kuuɡi Jerusalam danjwɛjen la, dɛ jo ba be.
Belaa Babelɔn kooro nomonome bwa kpɔ ba kane ba so Baah ta Doonyoa la ta.
Banee Nɛrɡal Saresa waa le Samɡa, ne Nɛbo Sarsekim waa chɔ nomonome la nyoa, ne Nɛrɡal Saresa bɛl ɡe, dɛ nomonome baa kaa bwa.
Juda Kooro Sedekia ne o laa tena bwa aa na ɡɛ la, ba chwao le bwɛjen la bini dɛ kpɔ doonyoa bɛl waa lɔ danjwɛɛre anɛ ane baah ta le, dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta jwaana.
Babelɔn laa tena la ti ba dɛ ka lawɛ Kooro Sedekia Jeriko harɛ bɛl waa chɔa kaa ta.
Ba lawɔ ka tɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa, ɡɛ saŋ dɛ o lɔ bwɛjen Ribla waa lɔ Hamat harɛ ta.
Belaa Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ka bol o waa dɛ pao bolchɔɡe.
Babelɔn kooro kpoo Kooro Sedekia bibaala o siwi ta Ribla bela, dɛ kpoo Juda nomonjena ɡe bwa, dɛ foromi Kooro Sedekia sibie dɛ doo ayaawa jɔɡrɔre, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Babelɔn tena la fuh koodem la ne nɛra la deene, dɛ kuuɡi Jerusalam danjwɛɛre bwa ɡe.
Nebusaradan waa chɔ kooro laa tena baa dɛ daahno nyoa, lawɛ nɛra baa kaa dɛ do Jerusalam, dɛ banɔ la baa baa ja o nɛɛ la bwa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Kɛ o ɡel nɛra baa nyaa dɛ do Juda harɛ ta bini bane baa wola komɛlbwa dɔe kwaraa la, asɛ dɛ kpɔ daa kooni ne kooni tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa fa cheɡɛ men Jeremia nɛɛ dɛ do Nebusaradan waa chɔ laa tena baa dɛ daah kooro nyoa la ŋɔ, “Kpɔɔ kaa dɛ́ kaa nyiŋi o nɛ, dɛɛ berɛ on hɔhɔrɔwa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, kɛ wobɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin la, ɛ tɛo.” Anomanta, Nebusaradan waa chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah kooro ne Nebusasban ne Nɛrɡal Saresa baa ɛ nomonjena, dɛ Babelɔn kooro nomonome la kabora tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ mɛ le koodem dembaah bela ba.
Ba kpɔ mɛ do Ahikam bibaa Gedalia, o ɡe mɛɛ aa ɛ Safan la nɔn ta, ŋɔ ó nyiŋi n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ tel n ne n bwɛ.
Gɛɛ a do n berɛ ka so n nɛra bini.
Gɛ saŋ baa laɡ mɛ do dea dembaah bela baa dɛ daah la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ir la ka ŋɔ Itiopia te Ɛbɛd Mɛlɛk be ŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘N dɛ ba ɡela wekpeɡa maa ŋɔa mɛɛ kpɔɔ ba ta bwɛjen nɔ nɛra nɛɛ la ba, wedɛɛɡa te laa.
A ɡɛ saŋ telo aa, hɛɛ naa siwi nee.
Kɛ men Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ awola tɔpere, baa wola hen lawɛ tɛ nɛra haa dɛ ɔm ba la.
Mɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛ, baa wola won kpoe.
Hɛɛ chwao dɛ lɛ he nyu, dɛkalkɛ he kpɔ he te dawɛ n nɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ”
Ba le Jeremia dea Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be, ɡɛ saŋ Nebusaradan waa chɔ kooro laa tena baa dɛ daahno nyoa, aa lee mɛ dea baa do mɛ Rama la.
Dɛ ba laɡ mɛ dɛ do mɛ jɔɡrɔre, dɛ kpɔ n ne Jerusalam dɛ Juda tena baa lawɛ yaa laa ta la kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Nebusaradan laɡ mɛ le bokɛre dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la bolɔ ŋɔ wekpeɡa ɛɛ ba he harɛ nɔ taa, asɛ taraken dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa bola la.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa balɔ, dɛkalkɛ he ɛ nɛra wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛ vɛh o waa ta teŋa.
Kɛ fini, n laa jɔɡrɔre la dɛɛ foo he nɔɔra.
Hɛɛ won teŋɛ n nɛɛ kaa Babelɔn ásɛ n nyiŋi he nɛ, dɛ haa nyin ɡe aa, he ɡel.
Harɛɛ chɔa kaa la, hɛɛ won kaa bobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin ka so.” Mɔɔ men Jeremia aa berɛ n te ŋɔ ń kaa la, Nebusaradan berɛ ŋɔ, “Berɛ kaa Ahikam bibaa Gedalia o nabaa aa ɛ Safan be.
Babelɔn kooro leo dɛ kpɔ Juda bwɛɛre do o nɔn ta wɛɛ nyiŋi a ta, ásɛ he ne ó ka so nɛra la bini, kɛɛ dɛ bobɛlbwa ɡee hɛɛ nyin aa, hɛɛ won ka so.” Asɛ Nebusaradan kpɔ kondikwaa ne koŋkɛɛla ane tɛ mɛ n kpɔ kaa.
Anomanta, n la Ahikam bibaa Gedalia be Mispa n ne nɛra baa ka harɛ la ta la ka so.
Gedalia kpoe wa Juda laa nomonome la bwa ne ba laa tena baa peɡra dɛ do kpɔɡ bini la noɔ kɛŋɔ Babelɔn kooro le Ahikam bibaa Gedalia ɛ ba harɛ nomoa, wɛɛ nyiŋi bela harɛ la ta.
O kpɔ baala ne haahna dɛ bechale baa nyaa, baa wola ba te lawɛ kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta Babelɔn la, ba bwa iro la Gedalia be Mispa.
Banee Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael, ne Karea bibaala Johanan ne Jonatan, ne Tanhumet bibaa Seraya, ne Efai bibaala baa le Nɛtɔfa, ne Jaasania waa ɛ Maaka te, dɛ baala baa ja ba nɛɛ bwa.
Belaa Gedalia ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡ ba ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ berɛ Babelɔn tena nɔ ɔma, hé so bonɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Babelɔn kooro, aa chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛɛ.
N ɡbabir dɛ ba Mispa soɡa dɛ́ che he naa ta, Babelɔn tena baa dɛɛ ba ya be la sie.
Kɛ a chɛ kɛ he boa sen ne daa nɔna ne ɔleve noo nyoa cheɡ, dɛ́ ka so bwɛɛre haa dɛ ba ba so a ta la ta.” Juu tena bwa baa lɔ Moab ne Amɔn ne Edom, dɛ harɛre aa jaa nɛra aa noa kɛ Babelɔn kooro ɡel nɛra bane Juda harɛ, dɛ le Ahikam bibaa Gedalia, o nabaa aa ɛ Safan wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la, ba bwa berɔ le bwɛɛre baa peɡra ka so a ta, dɛ ba Juda harɛ ta.
Ba ba Gedalia be Mispa, asɛ ba boa sen ne daa nɔna nyoa a warɛ kohona.
Karea bibaa Johanan ne laa nomonome baa peɡra ka do kpɔɡ bini la bwa ba Gedalia be Mispa, dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Amɔn Kooro Baalis tomɛ Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael ŋɔ ó ba kpoe naa?” Kɛ Gedalia ta waa la yaradae.
Belaa Karea bibaa Johanan sɔh ka ŋɔ Gedalia be Mispa ŋɔ, “Tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ n sɔh ka kpo Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael, nomɛlbwa aa wola na.
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ o kpoe asɛ Juu tena baa ja he nɛɛ bonɔ nɔ lɔ peɡre dɛ kpɔ sibeɡra ba ta nɛra baa kaa dɛ ta so bela nɛɛ nɔɔ?” Anee Gedalia chaŋe Johanan ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ!
Ismael waa haa bola nɔ ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ!”
Korobie anuanɛ ta la, Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael, waa ɛ koobie, dɛ berɛ ɛ kooro nomonome la bini bɛl la, o iro dɛ lawɛ baala fi ja o nɛɛ ba la Ahikam bibaa Gedalia be Mispa.
Ismael nabaa sɔne Elisama.
Kondikwaa dii saŋ aa tela, ba bwa pɛ so dɛɛ di kwaa la, belaa Ismael ne baala fi baa jaa la ir kpɔ keri dɛ kpo Gedalia, dɛ onee Babelɔn kooro le ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta.
Ismael berɔ kpoo Juu tena baa ja Gedalia nɛɛ Mispa, dɛ Babelɔn laa tena baa lɔ bela bwa.
Tɔ aa pera, mɔɔ bɛlbwa jemɛ Gedalia kpoe waa la, dɛ baala fifraanuatoro fonɛ ba tampona dɛ kɛɛ ba laala, dɛ kpɔ keri mɔne ba bwara, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba lɔ lwe ta, dɛ le bwɛɛre Sɛkem ne Silo dɛ Samaria ba.
Dɛ ba kpoŋe mea ne daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ sarahare Korowii Dea.
Anomanta, Ismael leɔ dɛ kpɔ wii ka chem ba, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N poo heya, hé ba dɛ́ ba na Gedalia.” Baa dena jo bwɛjen la bini la, Ismael ne baala baa ja o nɛɛ la kpoo ba bini fifraanuanɛ, dɛ paa ba ta kɔlɔŋ bɛl bini.
Ba bini fi soŋe Ismael ŋɔ, “Bɛ yaa kpoo!
Ya dɔ mea ne ɔleve no dɛ tooh a sɔh kpɔɡ bini.” Anomanta, o ɡel ba.
Kɔlɔŋ la Ismael aa pa Gedalia ne nɛra waa kpoo ba ka ta o bini la, o ɛ Kooro Asa kɔlɔŋ waa kwiu ɡɛ saŋ Israel Kooro Baasa aa baa yoo laa.
Nɛra waa kpoo ba la su kɔlɔŋ la.
Ismael lawɛ nɛra baa ka Mispa la bwa, kooro bihaahna ne banɔ la baa jaa dɛ ka bela.
Dɛ Nebusaradan waa chɔ kooro laa tena baa dɛ daahno nyoa, le Ahikam bibaa Gedalia o chɔ ba nyoa.
Waa laɡ ba la, o ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Amɔn tena harɛ pera dɛɛ kaa bane.
Karea bibaa Johanan ne laa nomonome la bwa baa ja o nɛɛ la no hiribiwaa Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael aa ɛa la.
Anomanta, ba kpɔ ba laa tena bwa dɛ́ ka yo Ismael.
Ba tiu dɛ ka lawɔ tamjen bɛl waa chɔ Gebeɔn jwɛh.
Nɛra Ismael aa laɡ ba dɛɛ kaa aa na Johanan ne o laa tena baa ba la, ba sie lɛo.
Ate, ba bwa berɛ chwa le o be, dɛ kaa Karea bibaa Johanan be.
Kɛ Ismael ne o baala la bini banuatoro chwao le Johanan be, dɛ kaa Amɔn tena be.
Ismael aa kpo Gedalia habɔɔ la, Johanan ne laa nomonome la bwa baa ja o nɛɛ la tɔ nɛra baa ka Mispa Ismael fe laɡ ba dɛɛ kaa la sie.
Haahna ne laa tena, bechale dɛ koodem nomonome baa le Gebeɔn bwa.
Ismael ne o bala baa ja o nɛ valɔ dɛ ka onɛ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Gerut Kimham, o bɛne Bɛtlɛham dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba won le Babelɔn tena nɔn ta.
Dɛ ba dɛ ɔm ba, dɛkalkɛ Ismael kpo Gedalia la Babelɔn kooro aa leo wɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta.
Nɛra la ŋɔ Jeremia soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba Belaa laa nomonome la bwa, ne Karea bibaa Johanan ne Hosaya bibaa Jesania, dɛ nɛra baa kaa bwa, dɛ́ le bechale nɛɛ ba nomonjena bwa nɛ ba men Korowii keame Jeremia be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ soŋe, no ya wesoŋa nɔ, dɛ́ soŋe Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔ tɛ ya nɛra yaa ka harɛ nɔ bwa ta nɔ.
He ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ dɛ ya fa warɔ, kɛ taraken te, ya nɛra tamaa kenii kaa.
Soŋe Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la, ó baɡle yaa bela yaa kaa ne ɡɛ yaa ɛ.” Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N noɔ, mɛɛ soŋe Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ɡɛ haa dɛ soŋe laanee, ásɛ wobɛlbwa waa bol n be la, ń bol he be.
Maa wobɛlbwaa kpɔ sɔh heya.” Belaa ba ŋɔ n be ja ŋɔ, “Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɛ́ ɛ yaa danseɛ dɛ́ di yaa kasinteŋ, dɛ ya ta waa waa kpɔa tɛɛ ŋɔ he ba bol ya be la ta teŋaa.
Dɛ a wer kɛɛ aa were kwaraa naa, yaa teŋɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ waa taa, o bee ya tomɛ la.
Ya dɛ teŋɛ o waa bwa ta naa, ya wobɛlbwa ken ɛɛ won do wer tɛ yaa.” Korowii no Jeremia wesoŋa Tɔpera fi habɔɔ la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ja.
Anomanta, n yerɛ Karea bibaa Johanan, ne laa nomonome bwa baa ja o nɛɛ la, dɛ nɛra baa jaa bwa, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, asɛ he tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ka soŋe he waa o be tɛ heya la ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ hɛɛ so harɛ nɔ taa yaa, mɛɛ lawɛ heyaa ir maa wola ɡel he chole, dɛ́ kwaa du heya kɛŋɔ da, ásɛ he che kiŋkiŋ maa wola heyaa fuɡri kɛŋɔ dua, dɛkalkɛ wenaale maa kpɔa ba ta he nɛɛ la, ɡelɔ mɛɛ di suna kohona.
He bɛ Babelɔn kooro haa dɛ ɔmɔ taraken nɔ ɔmɛ.
Men Korowii ŋɔ he bɛ on ɔmɛ, dɛkalkɛ n ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ won lɛ heyaa le o nɔn ta.
Mɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛ heya, ásɛ dɛ ɡel Babelɔn kooro ɡe dɔ tedoma he nɛ, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne he harɛ ta ja.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ Kɛ dɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Yaa harɛ nɔ taa so,’ dɛ vɛh waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nɛɛ teŋa, kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Akai, yaa kaalo ka so Ijipt harɛ ta, bela yaa wola laa ne bɛle sii kɛɛ lɔree na naa,’ amɔ hé no waa Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ bol he Juda tena haa kaa la be.
‘Dɛ he siwi beɡre Ijipt harɛ ta kaala dɛ́ ka so bela aa, amɔ laa haa dɛ ɔmɛ laanee dɛ́ ba he nɛ, lɔr haa dɛ ɔmɛ kohona la ɡe ɛɛ teŋɛ he nɛɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, ásɛ he serewe bela.
Kasinteŋ, banɔ la bwa ba siwi aa beɡra kɛ bá kaa Ijipt harɛ ta la, laa ne lɔr dɛ weechɔɡaa dɛ́ kpoo ba.
Beŋkpoŋ ɡba aa won chwa le wekpeɡa maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ la ta.’ Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Gɛ maa kpɔ n bandia kohona ba ta nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ dɛ he kaa Ijipt harɛ ta naa, mɛɛ ba n bandia kpɔe ba ta he nɛ.
Nɛra ɛɛ nao dɛɛ taah heya ba bambile teŋe, dɛɛ mamɛ heya.
He siwi aa harɛ nɔ nae ba kpa.’ ” N berɔ bol ba be ja ŋɔ, “Korowii ŋɔ he Juda tena haa kaa la be ŋɔ he bɛ Ijipt harɛ ta kaa.
Anomanta, n dɛ kah heyaa fini ŋɔ, he kono kohona, a chɛ kɛ hé sewɛ.
He ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń soŋe Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ó nyiŋi he nɛ, dɛ baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ hɛɛ teŋɛ waa waa do heyaa bwa taa.
Taraken, n bol he be, kɛ he vɛh waa Korowii aa tom mɛ n ba bol he be la bwa.
Anomanta, hé lii waa nɔ.
Laa ne lɔr, dɛ weechɔɡaa dɛ́ kpoo heya, harɛ haa dɛ nyin he ka so o ta la ta.”
Jeremia lawa dɛ́ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta Men Jeremia bol wobɛlbwa Korowii Juda tena aa dɛ tomɔ la aa tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol ba be la bwa.
Belaa Hosaya bibaa Asaria ne Karea bibaa Johanan, dɛ deŋnekpeɡ baala bane ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “He dɛ teŋe nyosone!
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ ta hen tomɛ ŋɔ yá ɡel Ijipt laŋa.
Nɛrea bibaa Baruk doe ŋɔ hé kpɔ yaa do Babelɔn tena nɔn ta, ásɛ ba kpoo yaa kɛɛ dɛ́ lawɛ yaa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta Babelɔn.” Anomanta, Johanan kɛɛ laa nomonome la bɛlbwa, dɛ nɛra la bɛlbwa ta waa Korowii aa do ba ta teŋɛ, dɛ ta so Juda harɛ ta bela.
Belaa Johanan ne laa nomonome la kpɔ nomɛlbwa waa kaa dɛ do Juda harɛ ta la kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, ba ne nɛra baa peɡra dɛ ka so harɛfala ta dɛ berɛ ba so Juda harɛ ta la bwa.
Ba berɔ tɔ baala ne haahna ne bechale, dɛ kooro bihaahna Nebusaradan waa chɔ laa tena baa dɛ daah kooro nyoa sie kaa.
Nebusaradanee kpɔ ba do Ahikam bibaa Gedalia, ne men Jeremia maa ɛ Korowii keame, dɛ Nɛrea bibaa Baruk nɔn ta dɛ tɔ ba sie ba kaa.
Anomanta, ba kpɔ deŋnekpeɡ vɛh Korowii waa la, dɛ ka jo Ijipt harɛ, dɛ kpoŋe kaa bwɛjen Tapanes ta.
Baa lɔ Tapanes bela la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ bwekuŋe ane Juu tena la siwi ta, dɛ́ huɡa choh ta bela baa kpɔ berekese ma ŋwɛnɛ ó kaa nyundua, dɛ́ kaa Ijipt kooro koodem waa lɔ Tapanes la doonyoa.
Ásɛ dɛ berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ kpɔ n bonɔɔ Kooro Nebukadnesa waa ɛ Babelɔn kooroo ba bonɔ, dɛ́ ɡel ó kpɔ o kookara ba cheɡ bwekuŋe haa huɡa nɔ ta.
Wɛɛ baŋre o tɛnte deaa ó do kɛŋɔ koodem.
Wɛɛ ba yo Ijipt tenaa dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ banɔ la weechɔɡa aa kpoo ba la serewe, banɔ la baa laɡ ba la, bá laɡ ba kaa, ásɛ banɔ la ɡe baa kpoo ba laa ta la, bá kpoo ba.
Mɛɛ kpaa nii do Ijipt harɛ voɡare deene ta, ásɛ dɛ ɡel Babelɔn kooro fuh ba voɡare kɛɛ dɛ́ paa kaa.
Gɛ peteɡre yon laa kpanjeɡa dɛɛ kpɔ o batakaare ta la, ɡɛɛ Babelɔn kooro ɛɛ ba doŋa laa kpɔ Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ le bela kaa.
Wɛɛ kuuɡi bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura Hɛleopɔles Ijipt harɛ ta laanee, dɛ́ fuh Ijipt voɡa deene ɡe bwa.’ ”
Voɡa toma wenaale Korowii bol Israel tena baa lɔ Ijipt bwɛjena Miɡdol ne Tapanes ne Mɛmfes, dɛ banɔ la baa lɔ harɛ la weekaŋle harɛbɔr waa men Jeremia be.
Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “He ɡbabir na chɔɡa maa chɔɡ Jerusalam ne Juda bwɛjena la bwa.
Hale a bwa berɛ dimɡbia, nomɛlbwa aa wola a ta soɡe, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa lɔ a ta ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa dɛ ɡel n baah di.
Ba ɛ sarahare tɛ voɡare ane dɛɛ toma, voɡare ba ɡbabir kɛɛ hen kɛɛ he naawa aa wola an tomɛ.
Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa n tomɛ n bonɔɔna baa ɛ n keamere he be, ba bol he be ŋɔ he bɛ wedoŋa aa do ken maa kia nɔ ɛ. Kɛ he ta deŋne cheɡɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ no ba bee.
Haa nyin kɛ he ɡel wechɔɡa haa ɛa dɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ voɡare la.
Anomanta, n kpɔ n bandia ba ta Juda bwɛɛre nɛ, ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna, dɛ kpaa nii do a ta.
A bwa kuuɡo dɛ berɛ dimɡbeeni dɛ do ɔma, nomɛlbwa aa wola nyin kɛ o nyiŋi, dɛ ba le fini.
Anomanta, men Korowii Maa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la dɛ bɔɔ heyaa ɡɛ aa ɛa hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ aa ɡure he nɛɛ nɔ.
He dɛ nyin he ba chɔɡ baala ne haahna, bechale ne bechasɔɔhne ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa ka kpa kɛɛ?
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ do mɛ bandia, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡare dɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ voɡare aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta bonɔ haa baa so nɔɔ?
He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ he te, ásɛ harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ nyiŋi he nyubaah, dɛ́ɛ taah heya kɛɛ?
He deno soh nyubinikpeɡ wa he naawa aa ɛa Juda bwɛɛre ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna, ne Juda koranar ne ba haahna, dɛ he ne he haahna ɡe la kɛɛ?
Hale ba le fini he ta he te pwɛrɛ mɔɔ.
Haa men duu kɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare maa kpɔa tɛ he ne he naawa la ta.
Anomanta, men Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la sie ɛɛ beɡre he nɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ wenaale ba he nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ Juda harɛ bwa.
Kɛ Juda tena baa kaa dɛɛ nyin kɛ ba ka so Ijipt harɛ ta la te, mɛɛ chɔɡ ba bwaa.
Nomonome ne bechale bwaa dɛɛ ba laa kɛɛ lɔr ta sewa Ijipt harɛ ta.
Nɛra ɛɛ nao ba bambile teŋe, dɛ yerɛ ba sɔn dɛɛ taah ba, dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nyubaah.
Mɛɛ tɛr banɔ la baa lɔ Ijipt harɛ la deŋnee, ɡɛ maa kpɔ laa ne lɔr dɛ weechɔɡa chɔɡ Jerusalam tena la.
Juda tena baa kaa dɛ ba so Ijipt harɛ ta la aa won le a nyoa baa wola serewe.
Ba bini bɛlbwa aa won berɛ la Juda harɛ ta, bela baa dɛ nyin kɛ ba berɛ ka so ja la.
Ba bwa aa won kaa, atane ba bini tamaa bane.” Belaa baala baa jema kɛ ba haahna dɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma voɡare ane ta, ne haahna baa cheɡɛ bela bwa, dɛ Israel tena baa wara dɛ so Ijipt weekaŋle harɛbɔr ŋɔ men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Ya vɛh waa haa cheɡɛ Korowii sɔn ta dɛ bol ya be la.
Yaa ɛ waa yaa ŋɔa yaa ɛo laanee.
Yaa ɛ saraharee tɛ ya voɡ waa ɛ Nyundua Haŋkooro la, dɛ́ fuɡe sen ɛ saraha tɛo ɡɛ ya naawa ne koranar dɛ nomonome fa aa dɛ ɛ Juda bwɛɛre ta ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna la.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, ya dɔ kondikwa kohona asɛ ya wobɛlbwa do wer, wenaale bɛlbwa ta ya nɛɛ balɛ.
Kɛ le saŋ yaa ɡel daawiile fuih dɛ tɛ Nyundua Haŋkooro, dɛ ɡel sen sarahare ɛɛ dɛ tɛo la, yaa komɛlbwa dɔ kpa, asɛ laa ne lɔr ɛɛ kpoo bane ɡe.” Ate, haahna la berɛ ŋɔ, “Ya fuh daawiile dɛ fuɡe sen ɛ saraha tɛ Nyundua Haŋkooro la aa, ya jaranar aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya wɔɔ paanoo a mar do kɛŋɔ Nyundua Haŋkooro dɛ fuɡe sen ɛ sarahare ɡe tɛo wa aa?” Belaa men Jeremia bol baala ne haahna baa chaŋ mɛ la ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ sarahare he ne he naawa ne koranar, nomonome ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta aa ɛa Juda bwɛɛre ta ne Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna la, Korowii aa a waa jemɛ, kɛɛ o soh a waa kɛɛ?
Korowii aa wola won so nyiŋi he nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla ne waa waa kia hɛɛ ɛ la, anee ɡela he harɛ la berɛ kon baa taahno, dɛ berɛ dimɡbia nomɛlbwa aa wola o ta soɡe hale ba le fini la.
Haa ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ voɡare, haa wola waa Korowii aa do heyaa a ta teŋɛ, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo o nɛɛ la waa wekpeɡa nɔ ba he nɛɛ la.” Belaa men Jeremia ŋɔ nɛra la ne haahna la bwa be ŋɔ, “He nɛra haa le Juda harɛ dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol.
Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, ‘He ne he haahna we-ɛɛla dɛ baɡle waa haa ŋwɛɛra dɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ sɛoh fuh daawiile dɛ́ fuɡe sen ɛ sarahare tɛ Nyundua Haŋkooro la.’ Hé teŋɛ he nyobaɡa la ta!
Hé ka ɛ ɡɛ haa ŋwɛɛra la!
He Juu tena haa soɡe Ijipt bwa, hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol ŋɔ o ŋwɛɛ o ɡbaɡba sɔn waa kana kɛŋɔ Juu te bɛlbwa waa soɡe Ijipt harɛ ta bobɛlbwa aa won yerɛ o sɔn ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘N ŋwɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii waa lole.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “N sie lɔ ba be mɛɛ nyin ba dɛ chɔɡ, dɛ ɛɛ ba wedɛɛɡa te laa.
Juu tena baa soɡe Ijipt harɛ ta la, laa ne lɔree dɛ́ kpoo ba ka tel kɛŋɔ ba bwa aa serewa.
Ba bini banɔ la baa dɔ bɔr le Ijipt harɛ ta kaa Juda la ɛɛ do tamaa kenii.
Ásɛ Juda tena bwa baa kaa dɛ ba so Ijipt harɛ ta la jemɛ bɛl la o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ, n waa la kɛɛ ba waa baa dɛ teŋɛ a ta la.
Anɔɔ ɛ waa dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ bonɔɔ mɛɛ ba he deŋne tɛra, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ kaeh maa dɛ kah heya ŋɔ mɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa la ɛ kasinteŋ.” Waa Korowii aa bera dɛɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, “N dɛ ba Ijipt Kooro Hofra lawa tɛ o dɔma baa dɛ nyinu dɛ kpo la, ɡɛ maa kpɔ Juda Kooro Sedekia do Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa waa ɛ o dɔm dɛɛ nyinu dɛ́ kpo nɔn ta la.”
Korowii nyoa waa baɡɛ Baruk Waa Korowii keame Jeremia aa bol Nɛrea bibaa Baruk be, ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa di kora bene anaarɛ ta la, dɛ Baruk dɛ chwerɛ waa Jeremia aa dɛ bol.
A habɔɔ la, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ ŋɔ ń bol Baruk be ŋɔ, “He ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘N bwɛɛlɛ.
Korowii kpɔ suna dii ba ja n wenaale ta, n koɔh n hima maa dɛ hime ta, maa onɛ bwa.’ ” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ men Jeremia bol Baruk be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ taɡɛ komɛlbwa maa mao ta harɛ, dɛ́ fuɡri komɛlbwa maa duu ta, harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ nɛra nyiŋi he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ nɔɔ?
Bɛ an dɛɛ nyin, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ba wenaale kpɔe ba ta harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa nɛ.
Bobɛlbwa haa chwa kaa la, mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ he nyu.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Ijipt harɛ wa Waa Korowii aa bol men Korowii keame Jeremia be dɛɛ baɡle harɛre nɛra bwa waa laanee nɔ.
Ijipt harɛ waa tɔ sie.
Waa nɔ kaalɔ dɛɛ tɛ Ijipt Kooro Neko ne o laa tena.
Onee Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa yo dɛ pɔ o nɛ bwɛjen Kaakɛmes, o bɛne Yufretis Moo nyoa, ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoiakim aa di kora bene anaarɛ ta.
Ijipt laa nomonome nyɛɡɔ ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ kwaa haa kpɔ tɔ he te ɡbemɡbe laa ta, anjeɡre ne anjena dɛ́ le ka yo laa.
Hé kpɔ kwaa darawe jaɡre nɛ, dɛ́ teeh so a ta.
Bɛlbwa ka che o chebɔr, dɛ́ kpɔ o ɡbɛrɛ pi.
Hé sar he lampeare nyoo dɛ́ kpɔ he laa laala do.
Bɔkwaa mɛɛ na nɔɔ?
Ɔmee kohona chole Ijipt laa tena nɛɛ ba le habɔɔ chwa dɛɛ kaa.
Babelɔn laa tena yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba banyoola nɛ.
Ba kpɔ bochela chwa dɛɛ le, bɛlbwa aa kee dɛɛ nyiŋi, ɔmee kohona su ba bwa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Laa tena baa ɡbaŋa kwara ta wone chwa le kaa.
Ba lɔ naa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr Yufretis Moo ta dɛ choɡli.
Harɛ besoo nɛraa ɡɔɔ ba te kɛŋɔ Nael Moo waa sua dɛ bu atɛlɛ nɔɔ?
Ijipt harɛ nɛraa dɛɛ ɡɔɔ ba te kɛŋɔ Nael Moo, kɛŋɔ nee aa sua dɛ bu atɛlɛ ken.
O ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ suu dɛ́ tɔ harɛ bwa dɛ́ chɔɡ bwɛjena ne a nɛra.’ Jaɡre ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛla, hé le dɛ́ ka yo.
Nɛra haa soɡe jaɡre ta, hé kpɔ sibeɡra le.
Banyoola, hé le dɛɛ kaa, Itiopia ne Lebya harɛre baala, hé kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe dɛɛ yo laa kpoŋe, ásɛ Lidia baala harɛ ba tori.
Awola tɔpere la ɛ Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro Tɔpere, tɔpere waa dɛ ba o dɔma kem bɔe.
O tokobii nee wɛɛ ba ba kpoora, dɛ́ nyɔ ba chal sɔɔh nyɔɡre waa dɛ kpoo nyoa.
Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ kpoo o dɔmaa awola tɔpere, Yufretis Moo nyoa, weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Ijipt haa do kɛŋɔ bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ, he nɛra iro la Gelead harɛ ka nyin tɛɛɡa kwaraa naa, aa won chaah ba.
Komɛlbwa aa won ɡel bá dɔ bokpeɡa.
Harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ no he sihiih haa dia waa, bɛlbwa no he wii haa dɛ wi bobɛlbwa.
Laa tena ɛɛ lɔ naa dɛ́ laa dɔŋa, dɛ́ bwa choɡli.” Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa aa baa yo Ijipt harɛ tena la, Korowii bol waa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Bol waa nɔ Ijipt bwɛjen Miɡdol ne Mɛmfes, dɛ Tapanes nɛra be ŋɔ, ‘Hé nyin bɔra che dɛɛ kpa, dɛkalkɛ Babelɔn laa tena dɛ ba ba chɔɡ harɛre nɛra baa bar heyaa cheme.’ Bɔkwa waa bala he voɡjen Apis chole ɔ?
Korowiirii taɡɔ o chole.
He laa tena ɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ lɔ na, dɛ́ choɡli dawɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Baa bol dɔŋa bee ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel ya ir, dɛ́ berɛ kaa bela yaa lea ne ya nɛra bini, ásɛ ya dɔma bɛ yaa kpoo.’ Belaa baa ba bala dɛ́ ba ŋɔ, ‘Gbɔɡaa Ijipt kooro ɛɛ do pɛɛpɛɛ, o paŋɛ waa aa chɛ kɛ ó dɔ bwa.’ N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooro aa lole saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ, menee kooro.
Gɛ Tabɔ Bwejen aa jaŋa ɡwaa bwejena bwa asɛ Kaamɛl Bwejen ɡe do jaŋne che mpo nyoa la, ɡɛɛ nɛn waa ba yo heyaa la kpeɡri ɛɛ ba doe.
Ijipt tena, hé boa he laala nyoa bá lawɛ heyaa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Mɛmfes ɛɛ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛɛ, dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia nomɛlbwa aa wola won so o ta.
Ijipt harɛ do kɛŋɔ nanee waa wera ken, kɛ o dɔm ɛɛ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔree, dɛ́ ba yoo kɛŋɔ batatom aa dɛ domɛ nao ken.
Laa tena baa kaa yaɡ ba ŋɔ bá ba yo tɛɛ ba aa kpeɡe dɛ́ won yo, ba do kɛŋɔ nabiiri aa jea ken.
Ba ɡe ɛɛ berɔɔ chwa kaa baa wola won che ba naa ta, dɛkalkɛ ba wenaale tɔpere la telo, saŋ telo kɛ bá dɔ deŋnetɛra.
Ijipt tena ɛɛ chwao dɛɛ si kɛ harɛkon ken ɡɛ saŋ baa na ba dɔma bala.
Kpanfɛre nee ba dɔma ɛɛ ba bala bá yoo ba kɛŋɔ baala baa dɛ teŋe daa, dɛɛ chɔɡ kɔrjen la ken.
Ba warɔ ɡwaa tontombɛ, baa wola won kur ba.
Sihiih kpo Ijipt tena, ba dɔma le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ba yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.” Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba deŋnetɛra ne bala ba ta Tebes tena voɡ Amɔn, ne Ijipt harɛ ne o voɡa dɛ koranar bwa nɛ.
N dɛ ba n lawɛ Ijipt kooro ne nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ o nɛɛ bwa.
Mɛɛ laɡ baa do nɛra baa dɛ nyin ba dɛ́ kpo nɔn ta.
Banee, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ne o laa tena.
Kɛ a habɔɔ nɛra ɛɛ berɔ ba so Ijipt harɛ ta kɛ saŋ la ja.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii ɛɛ lɛ o nɛraa “N nɛra Israel tena, he bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ.
Mɛɛ lɛ heyaa le bojaŋ harɛre taa ba, he naanar baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfala ta bwa.
Ásɛ he berɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ne bosɔɔhna, nomɛlbwa aa wola won aah heyaa kpa.
N nɛra Israel tena, mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛ heya, mɛɛ chɔɡ harɛre nɛra maa lɔ heyaa peɡre ba bini bwaa, kɛ he te, maa den chɔɡ heyaa kwaraa.
Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee, kɛ aŋwɛnɛ taa mɛɛ ba he deŋne tɛra.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Gɛ Korowii aa bol Filisti tena wa Mɔɔ Ijipt kooro aa ka yo Gasa tena la, Korowii bol Filisti tena wa men Korowii keame Jeremia be.
O ŋɔ, “Na ɡɛ he dɔma aa wara dɛ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, ba do kɛŋɔ nee waa sua dɛ do ɔma.
Dɔma la dɛ ba ba lɔ tɔ Filisti tena harɛ ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta nɛ.
Baa lɔɔ tɔ nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjena ta la nɛɛ, ásɛ nɛra ɔmɛ dɛɛ do lɔŋɔre kohona dɛɛ nyin chae, nomɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ la ta ɛɛ wiu kohona.
Baa dɛɛ no jaɡre aa dɛ chwa nakpale sii, ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore kɔbare sii.
Mɛɛnanar aa ke nyiŋi ba bii dɛ́ cha ba, dɛkalkɛ ɔmee chole ba nɛɛ kohona, baa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Filisti tena bwa chɔɡa tɔpere la telo, ba dɔma dɛ ba ba kpoo banɔ la bwa baa kaa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa won cha Taaya ne Sidon kpa.
Men Korowiirii dɛ́ chɔɡ Filisti tena, ne nɛra ba fa aa soɡe Kret ekwi harɛ ta bwa.
Gasa tena dɛ di suna kohona, baa fonɛ ba nyuune á baɡle kɛŋɔ ba dɛ ɛ lwe, ásɛ Askɛlɔn tena hel jeiih ken a wa.
Saŋ besoo Filisti tena kabora ɛɛ ba wii ka tel ɔ?
He yon dɛɛ wi ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, he kpoŋe he kere, saŋ besoo hé kpɔ kere la kpoo nɛra ka tel ɔ?
Kpɔɔ do o tɔɔ bini ó chɔ bela jeih ken.’ Korowii aa ŋɔa kere la ka yo Askɛlɔn ne mpo nyoa tena bwa nɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba wona chɔɔ?”
Gɛ Korowii aa bol Moab harɛ wa Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ bol Moab harɛ wa men Jeremia be ŋɔ, “Nɛbo tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ, dɛkalkɛ he bwɛɛ la dɛ ba chɔɡa.
Dɔma yo Kiriataim tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, o danjwɛkpeɡ baa maa baro kuuɡo, asɛ sihiih kpo ba.
Moab harɛ nyanyini tonɔ.
Dɔma baa yo Hɛsbɔn tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛɛ vɔrɔwe kɛ bá ba chɔɡ Moab harɛ.
Nɛra haa lɔ bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Madmen ɡe bwa hel, dɛkalkɛ laa tena ɛɛ ba yoo baa.
Lɔŋɔre dɛ le Horonaim, sibeɡra ne bwɛɛ chɔɡa wii.
Ba chɔɡ Moab harɛ bwa, hɛ́ɛ no bechale wii.
Hɛ́ɛ no ba wii ɡbɔɡa Luhit ŋwɛnɛ ta, suna wii baa dɛ wi Horonaim ŋwɛnɛ ta.
Ba ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɛ warane, dɛ́ chwa lɛ he nyuune.
Hé chwa kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini keeɡo waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken.’ Moab harɛ tena, hé kpɔ he te dawɛ he bokpeɡa ne kondɔɔh ta, kɛ ba dɛ ba heyaa yoi dɛ́ pɔ he nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ voɡ Kemɔs kaa harɛfale ta, o ne o nomonome ne o kerekpoŋra.
Bwɛɛ bɛlbwa aa kae ba dɛ́ le chɔɡa la nyoa, fɛlembɔjena ne deŋɡarere a dor aa chɔa kaa bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hé paaɡe bwea a che tɛ Moab harɛ, dɛkalkɛ aa biɡri ba chɔɡo.
Moab bwɛɛre dɛ ba dimɡbia bera, nomɛlbwa aa belaa so kpa.” Kórowii taah nomɛlbwa waa wola o toma ɛ bambile bwa ne la!
Nomɛlbwa waa kwaa o tokobi cheɡ ŋɔ waa kpɔ kpo nɛn la, Kórowii taahno!
