Korowii ŋɔ, “Moab tena fa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, ba ta ban lawɛ kaa harɛfale ta bwa.
Ba fa do kɛŋɔ sen mun a taa lɔ loŋ bini, baa wola an fuɡe do loŋfale bini ken.
A kpeɡri, a sɔɔh ɡe ta charɛ bwa, dɛ ta do ɡɛ aa doa wubwa la.
Anomanta, tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ men Korowii tomɛ nɛra bá ba fuɡe Moab tena ta, kɛŋɔ baa dɛ fuɡe sen loŋa bini la ken.
Komɛlbwa aa a bini kae ba, ásɛ ba paɡre a bwa.
Sihiih ɛɛ kpo Moab tena ba voɡ Kemɔs waa, kɛŋɔ sihiih aa kpo Israel tena voɡ Bɛtel baa kpɔ ba hwɛɡa dawɛ o nɛɛ la.
Moab tena, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona ŋɔ, ‘Ya ɛ banyoola, baala yaa kpeɡa dɛ won laa yoi kohona ɔ?’ Moab harɛ dɛ ba chɔɡa, ásɛ o dɔma lɔ ba tɔ o bwɛɛre ta.
Baa kpoo o bonɔndɛɛɡa bwaa, men Koranar Bwa Kooro maa ɛ kooro laanee bola.
Moab wenaale telo tonɛ, o chɔɡa dɛ ba bala warane.
Bwɛɛre haa soɡa baro bwa nɛra hé wi tɛo, hé nɛra haa na o jirima bwa ŋɔ, ‘Hé na ɡɛ kooro faahna waa kpeɡa dɛ dɔ jirima la aa kua.’ Debɔn tena, hé le he soŋnibɔr waa dɔ jirima ba, dɛ́ ba so harɛ bomboɡ ta.
Nɛn waa ba chɔɡ Moab la balɔ dɛ́ ba kuuɡi danjwɛjen waa baro la.
Arowa tena, hé che ŋwɛnɛ nyoa dɛɛ kpa.
Hé nyiŋi haahna ne baala baa chwaa dɛɛ kaa, dɛ́ bɔɔ ba waa aa chiɡa.
Sihiih kpo Moab tena, dɛkalkɛ ba harɛ la bwa chɔɡɔ.
Hé wi dɛɛ do lɔŋɔre.
Hé ɡel Aanɔn Moo nyoa tena no kɛŋɔ ba chɔɡ Moab.
Bwɛjena aa chɔ deŋɡare doa harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta waa bola dɛ́ pa bole telo, anee Holon ne Jaasa dɛ Mɛfaat, dɛ kaa Debɔn ne Nɛbo dɛ Bɛt Diblataim, dɛ kaa Kiriataim ne Bɛt Gamul dɛ Bɛt Meɔn, ne Kereɔt ne Bosra, dɛ Moab bwɛɛre aa lɔ bojaŋ ne anɔ la aa bɛna bwa ta.
Moab tena kpeɡri bwa tonɔ, baa won yo kpa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé tɛ Moab tena sen bá nyɔ dɛɛ kohona, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ men Korowii deŋnekpeɡ.
Hé ɡel ba chɔ dɛɛ ɡbaɡre ba chwɛɛra ta, dɛ́ berɛ akwekwe nɛra.
Moab tena, Israel tena laa fa berɛ he akwekwe nɛra la aa?
Saŋ bɛlbwa he dɛ bol ba wa, a do kɛŋɔ he na ba ne ŋwɛɛra aa dɛ bɔ ken.
Moab tena, hé chwa le he bwɛɛre ta dɛ́ ka so bwea dor.
Hé ka sɔh he kɔne bwebɔɔne nyoo, kɛŋɔ borɔnomare ken.
Ya no Moab tena mbarafo wa, ba dɛ na ba nyu, dɛɛ ɡɔɔ ba te kohona.
Mbarafo ne deŋnekpeɡ ɡboo su ba bambili.
N jemɛ deŋnekpeɡ baa dɛ ɛ wa, mbarafo baa dɛ ɛ la ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe, a bwa ɛɛ ba a jaɡaa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Anomanta, n wio dɛɛ tɛ Moab tena, ba ɡbosoro waa mɛɛ wi.
N wio dɛɛ tɛ Kir Haresɛt baala.
N wio dɛ tɛ Sibma tena dɛ ɡwaa kɛ maa wi tɛ Jasa tena, Bwɛjen Sibma, he do kɛ ɡrepo da, he ta kpala dɛ ɡale Yar Mpo hale dɛ kpoŋe kaa Jasa Mpo nyoa bwa.
Kɛ taraken, nɛnchɔɡe baa chɔɡ he bɔwɔb saŋ nɔna ne he ɡrepo nɔna.
Silɛɛ ne hɛɡra bɛlbwa toole Moab harɛpare ondɛɛɡe ne kooni ta kpa.
N ɡelɔ sen toole bɔra baa dɛ harama, nɛra toole dɛ́ tiɡri a ta.
Baa mooluu, kɛ silɛɛ moola laa.
Hɛsbɔn ne Eleale tena lɔŋɔre dɛ le, hale aa tel Jahas tena be.
A tel Soar tena be, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Horonaim ne Eɡlat Sɛleseya.
Hale neerare aa lɔ Nimrim nenabɔɔ bwa hweehrɔ.
Moab harɛ taa mɛɛ ba nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sarahare deŋɡarere dor, dɛɛ fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare la kpoora.
Men Korowiirii bola.
N wio dɛɛ tɛ Moab ne Kir Haresɛt tena, kɛŋɔ baa dɛ hoh kalipe dɛɛ ɡo lweyela ken.
Ba kondɔɔh baa dɔa bwa le ba nɔn ta.
Ba bwa fonɛ ba nyuune, dɛ fonɛ ba tampona ɡe, asɛ dɛ mɔne ba nɔɔra keri ne, bɛlbwa kpɔ lweyal tɔ, a bwa baɡle kɛŋɔ ba lɔ lwe ta.
Moab saldor ne bɔra baa dɛ cheme bwa, wobɛlbwa toole ka ja wii ta, dɛkalkɛ n chɔɡ o bwa, kɛŋɔ loŋ baa wola nyin kpa la ken.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hé na ɡɛ Moab harɛ bwa aa chɔɡa!
Hé na ɡɛ o nɛra aa dɛ wi!
Hé na ɡɛ sihiih aa kpo Moab nɛra ba baŋa ɡole!
Moab bwa chɔɡɔ, asɛ harɛre nɛra baa soɡa baro bambile teŋe baa mam ba.” Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
“Hé na, mɛɛ ɡeloo dɔma lɔ ba tɔ Moab harɛ ta, kɛŋɔ kee yon le nyundua dɛ́ paɡri kena dɛ́ ba ta jal la ken.
Baa pɔ bwɛjen Kereɔt nɛɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba dekpeɡa bwa.
Awola tɔpere la, Moab banyoola ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ ken.
Baa chɔɡ Moab harɛ nɛra bwaa, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh men Korowii.
He nɛra haa lɔ Moab harɛ, ɔmee kohona ne bɔɔne, dɛ bela baa haraa dɛ́ chɔ kpa heya.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Nomɛlbwa koh ɔmee kohona la waa chwa dɛɛ kaa laa, wɛɛ le bɔɔ binii.
Bɛlbwa ɡe waa ŋɔ wɛɛ leo la, belii dɛɛ ba o lawa, dɛkalkɛ Moab tena deŋnetɛra saŋ telo ń kpɔ ba ta ba nɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Nɛra baa koh laa waa chwa ba bwɛjen Hɛsbɔn wilo, dɛɛ nyin ba nyu, dɛkalkɛ nii le Kooro Sihon koodem dɛ fuh le Hɛsbɔn o fa aa di kora o ta.
Nii la fuoh jo ba harɛ jwɛhre bwa ta, hale dɛ ka tel Moab tena baa dɛ nyin yoi kohona la harɛ bwejena dor.
Moab tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
Nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ voɡ Kemɔs la, he chɔɡɔ.
Ba lawɛ he bibaala ne bihaahna bwa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Kɛ tɔpera ane dɛ ba ásɛ n berɛ ɡel Moab harɛ do ɡɛ o fa aa doa ja.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Bonɔɔ men Jeremia Korowii waa maa bola ŋɔ wɛɛ pa Moab tena bolchɔɡe la jaɡɛ.
Gɛ Korowii aa bol Amɔn tena wa Gɛ Korowii aa bol Amɔn tena waa laanee nɔ.
“Baala toole Israel harɛ ta kpa, dɛ́ kpɔ harɛ la ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon kɛɛ?
Ɛrɛɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡ Molɛk berɛ ba lɛ Gad dea harɛ dɛ so o ta nɔɔ?
Kɛ tɔpera ane dɛ ba, ásɛ n ɡel nɛra baa lɔ Amɔn harɛ bwɛjen Raba no laa lɔŋɔre.
Bwɛjen la ɛɛ paɡroo dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia, ásɛ o bwɛjeɡre aa baro bwa ɡe fuh.
Belaa Israel tena ɛɛ ba banɔ la ba fa aa doŋ ba le ba harɛ ta la doŋa le.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hɛsbɔn tena, hé do lɔŋɔre bwɛjen Ai chɔɡa wa.
Nɛra haa lɔ bwɛjen Raba, hé ɡe wi!
Hé kpɔ lweyale tɔ dɛɛ wi, dɛɛ chwa bobɛlbwa yalayala ken, dɛkalkɛ baa kpɔ he voɡ Molɛk ne o kerekpoŋra, dɛ nomonome bwaa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
He nɛra he wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɛ mbarafo he fɛlembɔjena aa do wer kohona waɔ?
He kpɔ he hwɛɡa do he kondɔɔh ta dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa aa won ba yo yaa.’ ” Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra baa bar heyaa cheme kpɔ ɔmee kohona ba ta he nɛ.
Baa doŋi he bwaa le, bɛlbwa aa kae ba dɛ́ boa nɛra baa koh laa waa chwa la nyoa.
Kɛ a habɔɔ la, mɛɛ berɔ ɡel Amɔn tena wobɛlbwa berɛ do wer tɛɛ ba.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Gɛ Korowii aa bol Edom tena wa Gɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol Edom tena wa laanee nɔ.
“Wejerema toole Teman waa lɔ Edom harɛ ta kpa aa?
Nɛra toole dɛ́ won ja nɛra kpa kɛɛ?
Ba wejema bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ aa?
Bwɛjen Dedan tena, hé laa berɛ dɛ́ chwa!
Hé ka sɔh bwebɔɔne aa luŋa bini, n dɛ ba Esɔ naanar chɔɡa, dɛkalkɛ tɔpere telo kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne.
Nɛra dɛ chaa ɡrepo nɔna aa, ba dɛ ɡel tama a daa ta.
Dɛ ŋwɛɛra balɔ jwaana aa, anɔ la baa dɛ nyin ɡbo laa ba yon kpɔ kaa laa?
Mɛɛ laa komɛlbwa Esɔ naanar aa dɔa lɛ ba be, dɛ́ ɡel bela baa sɔah chɔ baŋ, nɛra bwa ɛɛ na baa, baa wola sɔɔhbɔraa dɔ kpa.
Ba bii ne lolanar, dɛ ba bala bwa ɛɛ serewoo, ba bini beŋkpoŋ kwara aa wola ka.
Hé ɡel he bilalbii waa do n nɔn ta, mɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ ba nɛ.
He luhaahna ɡe bwa ɛɛ won kpɔ ba hwɛɡa bwa do n nɛ.” Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
“Dɛ nɛra baa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ ń tɛr ba deŋne nyɔ n danana nee aa, ɛrɛɛ maa wola won tɛr he deŋne ɔ?
Haa won le deŋnetɛra la nyoa, a chɛ kɛ hé nyɔ n danana ne.
N ŋwɛɛ n ɡbaɡba kɛŋɔ bwɛjen Bosra ɛɛ paɡroo dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia, ásɛ dɛ berɛ kon nɛra aa na dɛɛ mamɛ, dɛɛ taahno ba bambile teŋe kohona.
Bwɛɛre aa baro bwa ɡe ɛɛ chɔɡoo kwaraa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Men Jeremia no Edom waa le Korowii be o ŋɔ, “N tomɛ torome bɛl harɛre nɛra be ŋɔ, ‘Hé boa he nyoa dɛ́ ir ka yo Edom tena!
Hé ir ka yoo ba laa!
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he nɛra ɡwɛɡre harɛre nɛra bwa bini, ásɛ ba haeh, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyubaah.
He mbarafo neɡre heya kohona, he dɛ lii kɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ́ ɔmɛ heya, he dɛ neɡre he te.
He soɡe bɔɔne bini bwejena dor.
A lole kɛ he soŋnibɔr lɔ nyundua, kɛŋɔ kee yon ka sɔh o kɔr nyundujaɡla la, kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo he le bela le harɛ.’ Edom harɛ dɛ ba kon waa do ɔma bera, ásɛ nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa na, dɛ́ ɔmɛ ba nyoa kpo, o nɛra bola baa do ba wa.
Gɛ maa chɔɡ Sodom ne Gomoora ne bwɛɛre aa bara cheme la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba Edom harɛ chɔɡa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa won so bela kpa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Gɛ nyujente yon le Jɔɔdan Moo kɔr bini ba kaa harɛdɛɛɡe ta ka di la, ɡɛɛ men Korowii ɛɛ ba Edom tena doŋa le ba harɛ ta.
Ásɛ nomoa maa leo la tɔ ba sie dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Umee bá won kpɔ maɡ mɛ nɔ?
Nomɛlbwa aa won tɔŋle mɛ.
Kooro besoo dɛ́ won che n sie nɔ?
Anomanta, hé no Edom tena vɔrɔwa men Korowii aa dɛ vɔrɔwe wa, ne ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin n ɛ bwɛjen Teman tena.
Hale ba bii bwa, baa laɡ ba laa taa kaa, ásɛ ɔmee ne bambiteŋa chole ba nɛ.
Edom harɛ baa paɡre tonaa, harɛ ɛɛ jiɡruu ásɛ harɛre nɛra ɛɛ no Edom tena lɔŋɔre, hale dɛ ka le Mposwɛm ta.
Hé na, dɔma dɛ́ ba ba yo Bosra tena, kɛŋɔ kee yon le nyundua dɛ́ paɡri kena dɛ́ ba ta jal la ken.
Awola tɔpere la, Edom banyoola ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ kohona, kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ la ken.” Gɛ Korowii aa bol Damaskɔs tena wa Korowii bol bwɛjen Damaskɔs tena waa dɛ ŋɔ, “Bwɛjena Hamat ne Aapad tena liire chɔɡɔ, dɛkalkɛ ba ta amanesoma noɛ.
Ba bambile dɛ wure kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma aa taa dɛɛ kaa bobɛlbwa ken.
Damaskɔs tena ɡwɛɡrɔ, ba kpɔ ɔmee chwa kaa, asɛ bochela ne weweele su ba bwa, kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ la ken.
Ba chwao ɡel bwɛjen o sɔn fa aa lea, bwɛɛ men Korowii sie aa dɛ lɛ o ta kohona.
Awola tɔpere la, Damaskɔs bonɔɔna ɛɛ serewoo chɔ fɔɡbaahna, ásɛ ba kpoo o laa tena bwa.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.
Mɛɛ do nii Damaskɔs danjwɛɛre taa, ásɛ a fuh Kooro Bɛn Hadad koodem dekpeɡa.” Gɛ Korowii aa bol Keda ne Hasɔ tena wa Korowii bol Keda dea tena ne Hasɔ harɛre Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa aa yoa dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ la waa ŋɔ, “Hé ir, dɛ́ ka yo Keda tena, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra baa soɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta wee leebɔr.
Hé kpɔ ba tɛnte deene ne a pateesanre, dɛ ba peera bwa kaa, hale ba laala ne nyoɡmare bwa.
Ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Ɔmee kohona bar heyaa cheme!’ Hasɔ tena, hé chwa le warane kaa.
Hé chwa ka sɔh bwebɔɔne aa luŋa bini.
Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa dɛ́ vɔrɔwe he vɔrɔwa.
Hé ir ka yo harɛ o nɛra aa dɛ lii kɛ ba soɡe bosɔɔhna ta la.
Ba bwɛjen ta doonyojena kɛɛ bune baa kpɔa dɛɛ kara dɔe, komɛlbwa toole dɛɛ tɔ ba ɡbemɡbe.
Baa lawɛ ba nyoɡmare ne kondɛɛra aa wara kɛŋɔ laa ta kwaa kaa.
Mɛɛ lɔ nɛra baa lɔ bojaŋa laanee peɡre, dɛ́ kpɔ wenaale ba ta ba nɛɛ le harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
Bwɛjen Hasɔ ɛɛ berɛ kalampoŋare soŋnibɔree, dɛ́ ɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Nomɛlbwa aa wola won so bela kpa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Gɛ Korowii aa bol Elam harɛ wa Korowii bol Elam harɛ waa men maa ɛ o keame Jeremia be, a ta biɡre Juda Kooro Sedekia di kora.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpoo nɛra baa jemɛ hɛma tae, dɛ ɡel Elam harɛ do kpeɡri la bwaa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo dɔma le harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa dɛ́ ba yo Elam tena laa, dɛ́ lɔ ba peɡre bobɛlbwa, harɛ bɛlbwa aa ka baa wola belaa do.
Mɛɛ kpoo Elam tenaa ba dɔma baa dɛ nyin ba dɛ́ kpoo sie.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia kohonaa ba ta ba nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel laa tena ti ba ka tel kɛŋɔ ba bwa aa serewa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ kpoo ba koranar ne nomonomee, dɛ́ ba cheɡ n kora bela dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Kɛ a habɔɔ la, mɛɛ berɔ ɡel Elam tena wobɛlbwa do wer tɛɛ ba.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Gɛ Korowii aa bol Babelɔn harɛ wa Korowii cheɡɛ men o keame Jeremia nɛɛ dɛ bol Babelɔn harɛ ne nɛra baa lɔ o ta waa ŋɔ, “Bol Babelɔn harɛ waa baɡle harɛre nɛra bwa.
Ir fraŋkaa, á baɡle waa aa dɛ ba!
Bɛ wobɛlbwa kpɔ sɔh, ŋɔ, ‘Babelɔn dɛ́ ba paɡra.
Baa paɡre ba voɡ Maadukuu, ásɛ sihiih kpo Babelɔn harɛ voɡa aa ɛ kii kwaa la bwa.’ Harɛ bɛl nɛra ɛɛ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔree, dɛ́ ba yo Babelɔn harɛ tena, ásɛ harɛ la bwa chɔ pɛɛ.
Nomɛlbwa aa kae ba dɛ́ so o ta, nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa dɛ́ ba chwae.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la telo aa, Israel ne Juda tena bwa ɛɛ pɛo dɛɛ wi, dɛɛ ɡaaɡe men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ bɔr.
Baa bɔɔ Saayɔn ŋwɛnɛ waa, dɛ́ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ bela kaa.
Baa kpɔ ba tenee ba pɛl men Korowii, ásɛ n ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo waa do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, baa wola o waa soh bwa.
N nɛra do kɛŋɔ peera a teɡra aa ɡela a nyoɡre ken, dɛ ɡel a do bwejena dor dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
A lɔ bwejena ne deŋɡarere ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, dɛ soh bela aa dɛ chɔ wa.
Nomɛlbwa waa ka puu ba la dɛ́ yoo ba.
Ba dɔma yon ŋɔ, ‘Ya ta bolchɔɡe dii, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii waa tɛɛ ba kondikwaa la nɛ, Korowii ba naawa fa aa kpɔ ba hwɛɡa bwa do o nɛɛ kohona la.’ N nɛra Israel tena, hé chwa le Babelɔn harɛ ta, he bɛ ɡel nomɛl ba tɔ he sie, hé tɔ sie le kaa.
Mɛɛ do harɛre nɛra baa pɛ nyoa dɛ do kpeɡrii le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, bá bar Babelɔn tena cheme, dɛ́ yoo ba, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Ba do kɛŋɔ kpaahna baa jemɛ hɛma tae kɛrɛdɛ, baa wola tae dɛɛ kur.
Gɛɛ baa ba Babelɔn harɛ tena yoi dɛ́ pa ba laala, ásɛ bɛlbwa dɔ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Babelɔn harɛ tena, he baa pa n nɛra laala laa ta kaa, asɛ he sie lɛ hɛɛ hɛɡre kɛŋɔ nao waa dɛ tiɡri mea, kɛɛ jaɡ-bala aa dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ken.
Kɛ sihiih ɛɛ kpo he bwɛjen Babelɔn tenaa, harɛ baa lolɛ heya o ta la ɛɛ di nchoo.
Babelɔn harɛ ɛɛ do jeɡaa harɛre bwa binii, dɛ́ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛ́ hol chɔ, nee kwara aa wola o taa do.
N bandia nomanta, nomɛlbwa aa Babelɔn harɛ ta soɡa ba, wɛɛ berɛ dimɡbiaa, ásɛ nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa na, ba bambile teŋe ba nyoa kpo.
Nɛra haa jemɛ hɛma tae bwa, hé kpɔ he te dɛ́ ka bar bwɛjen Babelɔn cheme.
Hé ta nɛra baa lɔ o bini hɛma, he bɛ ɡel ane ka, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo men Korowii nɛ.
Hé pa mun ka yo bwɛjen Babelɔn tena dɛɛ do laa lɔŋɔre, Babelɔn tena sɛoh dɛ ba ba te ne harɛ, ba dekpeɡa ne danjwɛɛre bwa kuuɡo.
A ɛ kembɔr men Korowii aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛr ba deŋne, bɛlbwa ɡe tɛr ba deŋne bɔ kem.
Hé ɛɛ ba ɡɛ tenten baa ɛ ba bala la.
He bɛ ɡel ba du kwaa harɛ la ta, kɛɛ dɛ komɛ kwa.
Hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe bela ɛɛ ɔmɛ laa tena baa ba yo harɛ la nɛra laanee, ásɛ dɛ bwa berɛ kaa ba harɛre ta.
Israel tena do kɛŋɔ kondɛɛra nyujentena aa chwaa teŋɛ a nɛɛ a peɡre ken.
Asiiria koojen do kɛ nyujente dɛ lawɛ Israel tena, asɛ naate waa ka mun paɡre Israel tena hoɡa laanee Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa.” Anomanta, Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tɛr Babelɔn kooro deŋnee, dɛ́ chɔɡ o harɛ ɡe, ɡɛ maa tɛr Asiiria koojen deŋne la.
Kɛ mɛɛ berɔɔ lawɛ Israel tena ba ba harɛ ta, ásɛ ba baa di kondikwaa aa lɔ Kaamɛl Bwejen ne Basan harɛ ta.
Baa di kondikwaa ɡɛ bwa baa dɛ nyin Efrem ne Gelead deŋɡarere ta.
A ɡɛ saŋ ne awola tɔpere la, baa nyiŋi waa aa ɡela Israel tena di bolchɔɡee, kɛ baa bolchɔɡe baa dia bɛlbwaa na, dɛ́ nyiŋi Juda tena ɡe wechɔɡa baa wobɛlbwaa na, dɛkalkɛ mɛɛ kpɔ n nɛra baa kaa la wechɔɡaa kɛ ba.
Hé ir dɛ́ yo Merataim ne Pɛkɔd tena.
Hé ti ba, ásɛ dɛ kpoo ba, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba kwaraa.
Hé ɛ ɡɛ maa do heyaa bwa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Laa ɡbɔɡa ɡboo su harɛ la ta bwa, chɔɡa tenten ɡbɔɡaa yaa no!
Na Babelɔn o fa aa do kɛŋɔ hamba, dɛɛ paɡre harɛ nɔ bwa la aa kuuɡa ɡɛ!
Na ɡɛ harɛ la bwa aa chɔ pɛɛ, asɛ harɛre nɛra bwa na ba nyoa kpo.
Babelɔn tena, n harɛ heya bel, he ne ŋɔ he jemɛ dɛ o lawɛ heya, ba nyin he bɔr dɛ lawɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ he vɛh men Korowii waa la noe.
Men Korowii pili dea n dɔmkwa aa lɔ o bini, dɛ pa n bandia dɔmkwaa le, dɛkalkɛ men Koranar Bwa Kooro dɔ toma dɛɛ la ka ɛ Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Hé le bojaŋa dɛ́ ba yo Babelɔn tena, dɛ́ paɡre deene baa dɛ cheɡ mea a bini, dɛ́ boa a nyoa a daŋɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡa kwaraa he bɛ komɛlbwa ɡel.
Hé kpoo ba laa tena bwa.
Babelɔn tena bwɛɛlɛ!
Ba deŋnetɛra tɔpere telo.” Nɛra baa chwaa le Babelɔn harɛ dɛ ba Jerusalam la dɛ bol ŋɔ, Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la dɛ́ ba ba bɔ Babelɔn tena kem, chɔɡa baa chɔɡ Korowii Dea la wa.
“Hé yerɛ nɛra baa jemɛ hɛma tae bwa bá ba yo Babelɔn tena.
Hé bar bwɛjen la cheme, he bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa dɔ bɔr chwa le.
Hé bɔ ba kem ɡɛ ba we-ɛɛla aa doa, ɡɛ baa kpɔa ɛ ba bala la, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh men Korowii, Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la.
Gɛ nomanta, baa kpoo Babelɔn bonɔɔna fɔɡbaahnaa, ásɛ o laa tena bwa ɡe serewe awola tɔpere.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Babelɔn harɛ tena, he ɛ mbarafo, men Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ne he dɔɔ.
Dɛkalkɛ he tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ ń tɛr he deŋne.
He harɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo la ɛɛ lɔ naa dɛ́ chole, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ cha heya he ir.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba fuh he bwɛjena, ásɛ komɛlbwa aa bar heyaa cheme ɡe fuh.” Waa Koranar Bwa Kooro aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Ba dɛ fiiɡi Israel ne Juda tena.
Nɛra baa laɡ ba dɛ tɔ ba ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ ŋɔ baa ɡel ba kaa.
Kɛ ba Lɛɛ la kpeɡri, o sɔne Koranar Bwa Kooro.
Wɛɛ yoo kohona dɛ́ lɛɛ ba, ásɛ ba dɔ bosɔɔhna ba harɛ ta, kɛ Babelɔn tena te, ba bwaraa dɛɛ ba nyɛɡa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Hé ka yo Babelɔn tena!
Hé ka kpoo nɛra baa soɡe Babelɔn, ne ba nomonome, dɛ wejerema bwa!
Hé ka kpoo keame nyosonteŋna la.
Ba ɡɛnɔ kohona!
Hé ka kpoo ba banyoola.
Ɔmee kohona chole ba nɛ.
Hé chɔɡ ba jaɡre ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore la!
Hé ka kpoo laa tena baa ba dɛ cha ba la bwa!
Hé na ɡɛ baa ɡwɛɡra!
Hé chɔɡ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini.
Baa paa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwaa kaa.
Hwél che ba harɛ ta, ásɛ o neerare bwa hweeh.
Voɡa aa lɔ harɛ la ta warɔ, a kpɔ ɔmee kohona ba ta harɛ la nɛra nɛɛ ba ɡɛn.
Pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ olaa dɛ́ ba so Babelɔn harɛ ta, ásɛ kwiure ɡe so bela.
Naanar baa ka ba bwa aa belaa ba so kpa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gɛ maa chɔɡ Sodom ne Gomoora ne bwɛɛre aa bara cheme la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba Babelɔn harɛ chɔɡa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa won so bela kpa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Hé nyiŋi na!
Laa tena le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, harɛ o nɛra aa kana o koranar warɛ kpɔ ba te le harɛ jaɡa dɛɛ ba ba yo laa.
Ba kpoŋe tori ne lampeare, ba nyu bini kpeɡri baa wola nɛn nɛɛ sune.
Ba soɡe jaɡre ta a nakpale ɛɛ si kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma aa dɛ ta ken.
Ba kpɔ ba te dɛɛ ba ba yo Babelɔn tena.
Babelɔn kooro no ba wa, ɔmee ɡel o bwara yɔr.
Weweele ne bambiteŋa ɡel o ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ ken.
Gɛ nyujente yon le Jɔɔdan Moo kɔr bini ba kaa harɛdɛɛɡe ta ka di la, ɡɛɛ men Korowii ɛɛ ba Babelɔn tena doŋa le ba harɛ ta.
Ásɛ nomoa maa leo la tɔ ba sie dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Umee bá won kpɔ maɡ mɛ nɔ?
Nomɛlbwa aa won tɔŋle mɛ.
Kooro besoo dɛ́ won che n sie nɔ?
Anomanta, hé no bwɛjen Babelɔn vɔrɔwa men Korowii aa dɛ vɔrɔwe wa.
Hale ba bii bwa, baa laɡ ba laa taa kaa, ásɛ ɔmee ne bambiteŋa chole ba nɛ.
Babelɔn harɛ baa paɡre tonaa, harɛ ɛɛ jiɡruu, ásɛ harɛre nɛra ɛɛ no Babelɔn tena lɔŋɔre.”
Babelɔn tena deŋnetɛra ja Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo peuchɔɡe waa dɛ chɔɡ kwaa ba chɔɡ Babelɔn harɛ ne o nɛra.
Mɛɛ tomɛ nɛŋhɔɔhraa ba ba chɔɡ Babelɔn harɛ ne o nɛra kɛŋɔ peu aa ta haahra dɛɛ kaa la ken.
Awola tɔpere la, baa le baŋ bɛlbwaa ba yo o nɛra, ásɛ harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ.
He bɛ Babelɔn laa tena ŋwɛnɛ tɛ ba ta hɛma, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ba laa laala do.
He bɛ ba bonɔɔna ɡel, hé kpoo laa tena la bwa kwaraa!
Baa do laa tena la bolaa, ásɛ ba serewe chɔ bwɛjena la fɔɡbaahna.
Men Korowii, Koranar Bwa Kooro ta n nɛra Israel ne Juda tena vɛɛh.
A lole kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo men Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la nɛ.
Hé chwa le Babelɔn harɛ!
Hé chwa lɛ he nyuune!
He bɛ Babelɔn tena wechɔɡa waa koh serewe.
Saŋ telo kɛ men Korowii bɔ ba kem, mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee ɡɛ aa chɛa.
Babelɔn fa do kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm numol, dɛ do men Korowii nɔn ta, dɛ ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa nyɔ o bini sen, dɛ dɛɛ dɛ bwa ɛɛ we choɡla.
Babelɔn ɛɛ piɡru paɡre dɛ́ chɔɡ.
Hé wi dɛɛ tɛ o nɛra!
Hé nyin noo aa ɛ tɛɛɡa do ba ŋwɛra ta, a ken ɛɛ ɡeloo bá dɔ bokpeɡa.
Asɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe bela ŋɔ, ‘Ya takapɔ ŋɔ ya cha ba, kɛ a kaa mun ta.
Hé ɡel ya ɡel ba waa tɛɛ ba, ásɛ bɛlbwa berɛ kaa o harɛ ta.
Korowii kpɔ o kpeɡri dɛ tɛr ba deŋne dɛ chɔɡ ba kwaraa.’ ” Korowii bol o nɛra be ŋɔ bá do lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Korowii ta yaa tɔɔ, Hé ba, ya la Jerusalam ka bol waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa ɛa.” Laa sitɔɔla ŋɔ, “Hé sar hɛma nyoo, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa haa kpɔ tɔ he te ɡbemɡbe laa ta!
Korowii di Midia koranar liire, dɛkalkɛ o dɛ nyin ó chɔɡ Babelɔn harɛ.
Korowii koh o Dea la wa dɛɛ nyin ó bɔ ba ba wechɔɡa kem.
Hé ir fraŋkaa ásɛ laa tena jemɛ dɛ́ ba kuuɡi Babelɔn danjwɛɛre.
Hé le laa tena la bane ba ba ja dɛɛ daah bwɛɛ la dahare, bane ɡe chɔ baro.” Korowii dɔɔ kpɔ liire ŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ Babelɔn tenaa.
Babelɔn tena, he nɛra haa soɡe neerare aa wara nyoo dɛ dɔ kondɔɔh kohona, he serewa telo.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋwɛɛ o ɡbaɡba ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ laa tena baa wara kɛŋɔ tontombɛɛ bá yo heya, ásɛ dɛ pɔ he nɛɛ dɛɛ moo silɛɛ ne.” Korowii kpɛɛra yel Korowii cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛ ta harɛ, o wejema nee o ta harɛ nɔ bwa, dɛ che o liire ta dɛ paɡri nyundua ɡe.
O bol wa aa, bwaala dɛ nɛ dɛɛ kɔɡre nyundujaɡla, o ɡelɔ baama aa dɛ nɛ bwaala ir dɛɛ le harɛ jaɡa.
O ɡelɔ bwaala ɛɛ nɛ dɛɛ nyɛɡle, asɛ dɛ ɡel peu ta le bela waa lole.
Nomɛlbwa ta liire dɔe, ba ɡɛnɔ, sihiih kpo nɛn waa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa o voɡare la.
Kwaa waa ɛa la bwa ɛ nyosone, a ta hweera dɔe.
A waa ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe, dɛ ɛ kwaa a wa aa dɔ wesoma.
A chɔɡa saŋ telo Korowii ba naa, wɛɛ chɔɡ a bwaa.
Kɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ta do kɛ ban, dɛkalkɛ onee ta komɛlbwa, dɛ le Israel tena tɛ o te, dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ o kapɛrɛ nɛra.
Koranar Bwa Kooroo o sɔn.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Babelɔn, he do kɛŋɔ n hamba waa ɛ n dɔmkon mɛɛ la o ne laa.
Henee n kpɔ yo harɛre nɛra, dɛ paɡre ba harɛre ne ba koranar.
Henee n kpɔ kpoo jaɡre ne nɛra baa soɡe a ta, dɛ paɡre kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre, ne nɛra baa soɡe a ta bwa.
Henee n kpɔ kpoo haahna ne baala, ne banjeni dɛ bonɔɔna, hale bonɔmbie ne toli bwa.
Henee n kpɔ kpoo peteɡra ne ba peera, dɛ kpoo paara ne nae aa dɛ parɛ, ne nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi harɛre ta, ne ba nomonome.
He siwi taa mɛɛ ba bwɛjen Babelɔn ne nɛra baa soɡe Babelɔn harɛ ta kem bɔe, wechɔɡa baa ɛa Jerusalam la wa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Babelɔn, he do kɛŋɔ bwejen haa dɛ chɔɡ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra.
Kɛ men Korowii ɛɛ dɔm, mɛɛ ɡeloo hé fuh dɛ́ berɛ tɔɔ ásɛ n taɡɛ ta harɛ.
He bwe bɛlbwa aa werii do bá kpɔ ma dea, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ pa dea mun kpa, dɛkalkɛ he dɛ ba doe kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hé ir fraŋkaa harɛ la ta!
Hé hoh bɛla ásɛ harɛre nɛra jemɛ!
Hé boa harɛre nɛra nyoa ásɛ ba ka yo Babelɔn tena.
Bol Ararat ne Mini dɛ Askenas harɛre nɛra be.
Le laa sitɔɔ waa tɔ ba sie, dɛ́ kpɔ jaɡre aa wara kɛŋɔ tontombɛ dɛ́ ka yo.
Boa harɛre nɛra nyoa bá ba yo Babelɔn tena laa.
Koranar baa le Midia, harɛ la sitɔɔla dɛ ba nomonome, dɛ harɛre baa dɛ nyiŋi a ta laa tena bwa ba.
Harɛ la jiɡro, dɛkalkɛ waa Korowii aa maɡla bil la telo kɛŋɔ Babelɔn harɛ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa won so bela kpa.
Babelɔn laa tena ɡel yoi dɛ ka so ba dekpeɡa bini.
Ba bokpeɡa tonɔ ba do kɛŋɔ haahna ken.
Ba kuuɡi bune baa kpɔa dɛɛ kaɡre ba doonyojena bwa, dɛ kpaa nii do ba deene ta.
Nae toroma na teŋɛ dɛ kaa bol Babelɔn kooro be ŋɔ, ba kuuɡi o bwɛjen la danjwɛjen dɛ jo o bini.
Dɔma tɔ leebɔɔne dɛ kpaa nii do ba dekpeɡa ta, asɛ ɔmee chole Babelɔn laa tena nɛɛ kohona.” Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Babelɔn harɛ nɛra do kɛŋɔ baa kuu mea dɛ kpɔ kaa a lɔ bɔr, asɛ nɛra ba tiɡra do harɛ, aa biɡri bá chɔɡ harɛ la.” Jerusalam tena ŋɔ, “Babelɔn kooro chɔɡ ya Jerusalam tena dɛ kpoo yaa, o ɡelɔ ya do kɛŋɔ loŋ komɛlbwa aa wola toole o bini ken.
O do kɛ harɛkon dɛ lawɛ yaa lile ya ola do o som o tea su, dɛ berɛ uɡe yaa ta.
Hɔhɔrɔwa bɛlbwa yaa naa bwa dawɛ Babelɔn harɛ nɛra nɛ.
Ya seo kembɔr bwa ɡure nɛra baa lɔ Babelɔn nyu ta.” Anomanta, Korowii bol Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, “Hé no, mɛɛ che he habɔɔ dɛ́ yo, dɛ́ bɔ he dɔma Babelɔn tena kem waa baa ɛ heyaa la wa.
Mɛɛ tɔ Babelɔn neerare nyuunee, a ɡel ba buli bwa ɡe hweeh.
Babelɔn dɛ ba paɡra dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia ne kalampoŋare sobɔr, dɛ́ berɛ kon nɛra aa na ba bambile teŋe baa mamɔ, nomɛlbwa aa won so bela.
Babelɔn tena dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ ŋoo kɛŋɔ nyujentena ken.
Ba dɛ nyin kondikwa kohona kɛɛ?
Mɛɛ ɛ kondikondɛɛɡaa cheɡ ba, ásɛ ba di dɛ́ nyɔ sen dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛ́ mamɛ dɛɛ moo.
Baa iruu ka chɔ baa wola won ir kpa bwa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba laɡ ba, kɛŋɔ ba yon lawɛ peloni kɛɛ boohna kɛɛ pebala, dɛ́ ka kpoora la ken.” Korowii bol Babelɔn waa ŋɔ, “Na ɡɛ baa yo Babelɔn, bwɛjen harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa fa aa dɛ kpɛɛro dɛɛ tɛo jirima la.
Na ɡɛ waa chɔɡa dɛ kpɔ bambiteŋa kohona ba ta harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.
Mpo suu tɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta, o nehɛma tao ba bɔle o ta.
O bwɛɛre bwa chɔ pɛɛ dɛ hol, kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ken.
Nomɛlbwa aa harɛ la taa so, á ba ɛ kɛ nɛn ɛɛ kpɔ o taa.
Mɛɛ tɛr voɡ Baal waa lɔ Babelɔn deŋnee, dɛ́ ɡel o uɡe komɛlbwa waa dia.
Harɛre nɛra aa berɛ dɛɛ tomɔ dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa baa tɛo kpa.
Babelɔn danjwɛɛ bwa dɛ́ ba kuuɡa.
N nɛra Israel tena, hé chwa le ba.
Hé chwa dɛ́ dɔ he nyu.
Hé chwa le men Korowii bandia waa do ɔma la ta.
He bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ kɛɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ, waa haa dɛ no harɛ la ta wa.
Bena bɛlbwa hɛɛ dɛɛ no wefalaa, hɛɛ no yoi waa harɛ taa, kooro ne o dɔŋ kooro ɛɛ dɛɛ yoo.
Anomanta, saŋ bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ n chɔɡ voɡa aa lɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Sihiih ɛɛ kpo harɛ la nɛra bwaa, ásɛ ba kpoo ba ba serewe chɔ o ta.
Belaa koŋkwaa aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ ɛɛ ba silɛɛ lɔŋɔre doe Babelɔn wa, dɛkalkɛ nɛra dɛ ba weekaŋle nyunduabɔr lee dɛ́ ba yoo dɛ́ chɔɡo.
A chɛ kɛ bwɛjen Babelɔn paɡre, kpoora baa kpoo Israel tena dɛ kpoo harɛ nɔ ta nɛra la ɡe wa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii berɔ bol waa o nɛra baa lɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta be ŋɔ, “He nɛra haa chwaa dɛ dɔ he nyu la, hé le warane, he bɛ hɛlɛ.
Hé lɔ bojaŋ harɛ ta te, kɛ he lii n wa, dɛɛ lii Jerusalam ɡe wa.” He ŋɔ, “Sihiih kpo yaa ya di ncho, dɛkalkɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra dɔ bɔr jo Korowii Dea bɔra aa do ɡoroŋ bela.” Kɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpera ane dɛ ba bala ásɛ n chɔɡ Babelɔn harɛ voɡa, ásɛ nɛra baa do ba bola bwa ɛɛ pɛmɛ harɛ la ta.
Hale Babelɔn wono kaa nyundua, o dekpeɡa kaa nyundua kwaraa naa, mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra ba chɔɡo.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé no lɔŋɔre aa dɛ le Babelɔn harɛ, o nɛra dɛ wi harɛ la chɔɡa wa.
Men Korowii dɛ ba Babelɔn harɛ chɔɡa, dɛ́ ɡel ɡbɔɡa aa dɛ le o ta nyoa sɔɔh.
Dɔma ɛɛ ba lɔɔ tɔ ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nehɛma a nyoa aa kpeɡa ken, dɛ́ yoo ba dɛɛ do lɔŋɔre.
Baa bao dɛ́ ba chɔɡ Babelɔn harɛ, dɛ́ lawɛ o laa tena bwa, ásɛ dɛ kuuɡi ba tori.
Menee Korowii maa dɛ tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋne.
Mɛɛ bɔ Babelɔn tena kemee ɡɛ aa chɛa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o koranar ne nomonome, ne wejerema dɛ laa tena, nyɔ sen dɛɛ.
Baa chɔ domii baa wola won ir kpa.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooro maa ɛ Kooro laanee bola.” Koranar Bwa Kooro bolɔ ŋɔ, “Babelɔn danjwɛkpeɡ la dɛ́ ba kuuɡa chɔ harɛ, ásɛ nii le o doonyojena ta.
O nɛra koeh baa koah ɛ pɛɛ, ásɛ nii le a bwa ta á fuh.” Waa men Jeremia aa kpɔa tɛ Nɛrea bibaa Seraya, baa dɛ yerɛ o nabaa Maaseya laanee teŋa nɔ.
Dɛ onee dɛɛ cha Juda Kooro Sedekia ɡɛ saŋ waa di kora bene anaarɛ, asɛ o ne o la Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Dɛ men Jeremia chwerɛ wenaale bwa aa dɛ ba Babelɔn harɛ ta bala do tɔn bini.
N ŋɔ Seraya be ŋɔ, “He tel Babelɔn harɛ ta naa, na kɛŋɔ hɛɛ kure tɔn nɔ bini waa bwaa takpeɡ ne kohonaa ba no.
Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, he fa bolɔ ŋɔ hɛɛ chɔɡ bonɔɔ, ásɛ nɛra kɛɛ kondɛɛra aa wola won so o ta, ó berɛ dimɡbia saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’ Seraya, he kure tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡle nɛra la tonaa, kpɔ ŋwɛn lawɛ bwe vɔwɛ marɛ o ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ka ta Yufretis Moo ta.
Asɛ dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Gɛ maa ɡela bwe la morɛ la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɡela Babelɔn chɔɡ baa wola won kwaa vɔrɔwo kpa, wenaale Korowii aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba ta ba nɛɛ la wa.’ ” Men Korowii keame Jeremia, n wobol jaɡɛ bonɔ.
Jerusalam paɡra wa Kooro Sedekia di bene fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛ di kora.
O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
O nya sɔne Hamutal, Jeremia bihaahnee o le Lebna.
Kooro Sedekia ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, ɡɛ Kooro Jehoiakim aa ɛa la.
Korowii baah di Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ nɛra nɛɛ kohona, anomanta, o doŋ ba le o sie.
Kooro Sedekia baa ɛ Babelɔn kooro deŋnekpeɡ.
Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene anuanaarɛ, korobie fi tɔpera fi ta la, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena bwa kaa Jerusalam dɛ ka yoo ba.
Ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene bwɛɛ la dahare, dɛ ma kwaa sawɛ bwɛjen la danjwɛɛ baa che a ta teeh jo o bini.
Ba teŋɔ tɔ bwɛɛ la tena do ka tel Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta.
A ɡɛ benanyoa la korobinaarɛ tɔpenuanaarɛ ta, dɛ lɔr o nyoa aa do kpeɡri kohona chole bwɛjen Jerusalam, kondikwaa toole nɛra di.
Babelɔn laa tena la kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la.
Kooro Sedekia ne Jerusalam laa tena kpɔ doonyoa bɛl waa lɔ danjwɛɛre anɛ ane baah ta, ba kpɔ bela dɛɛ kaa kooro bodɛɛɡe waa du daa ta, dɛ le kpɔ sie chaɡɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta jwaana, kɛ Babelɔn laa tena la ti Kooro Sedekia, dɛ ka lawɔ Jeriko harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta, asɛ o laa tena bwa chwa ɡelo.
Ba lawɔ kaa bwɛjen Ribla waa lɔ Hamat harɛ ta, ka tɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa o ka bol o waa dɛ pao bolchɔɡe.
Babelɔn kooro kpoo Kooro Sedekia bibaala o siwi ta Ribla bela, dɛ kpoo Juda nomonjena ɡe bwa, dɛ foromi Kooro Sedekia sibie dɛ doo ayaawa jɔɡrɔre dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta ka doo dea ka tel o serewe wee.
Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuanaarɛ, korobie anue tɔpera fi ta la, o laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan la Jerusalam.
O kaa fuh Korowii Dea ne koodem, dɛ Jerusalam deremi bwa.
O fuh nomonjena dedɛɛɡe te bɛlbwa.
Babelɔn laa tena Nebusaradan aa chɔ ba nyoa la kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la bwa.
Laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan lawɛ nɛra baa ka bwɛjen la ta, ne tom-ɛɛra, dɛ banɔ la baa le Kooro Sedekia habɔɔ, dɛ ka teŋɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa nɛɛ la bwa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Kɛ o ɡel nyaara baa lɔ Juda harɛ la bane ŋɔ baa ɛ toma daa kooni ne kooni aa lɔ bela la ta.
Babelɔn laa tena la kuuɡi ayaawa pilare ne kwaa aa dɔ nakpale baa taɡa a do Korowii Dea, dɛ ayaawa loɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo la, dɛ kpɔ a bwa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Dɛ berɛ pa viine ne soofire ne kwaa baa pa tɔɔ dɛɛ do a bini, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ menɛ kandea ŋwɛɛra, ne loɡa baa kpɔa dɛɛ chaɡɛ kwaa baa dɛ kpoo chale, ne loɡa baa dɛ fuh daawiile a bini, dɛ ayaawa kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea bwa kaa.
Laa sitɔɔ la kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ buh nii, ne loɡa baa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ la, kandea daa ne loɡa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen sarahare, komɛlbwa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ne suuɡapoŋ ɛa te, ba kaa a bwa ne.
Ayaawa aa lɔ pilare anɛ la ta, ne kwaa aa dɔ nakpale baa taɡa ne loɡbajen baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo, asɛ nabali fi dɛ anɛ do o lɔɡa, Kooro Solomɔn ɛa cheɡ Korowii Dea la, a kan kohona kɛŋɔ ba won maɡɛ a tɔɡre.
Pilare anɛ la le dɔŋa, bɛlbwa jaŋne dɛ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ, asɛ ayaawa baa kpɔa ɛa la ɡe jaŋne dɛ bara ɡe ɛ naɡale fi dɛ anuatoro.
Asɛ ba kpɔ ayaawa ɛ kafola a do ɡuleɡule kɛŋɔ, daa nɔna ane baa dɛ yera pɔmeɡranet ken dawɛ pila la bɛlbwa doa, a jaŋne dɛ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama.
Pila nɛɛte la ɡe kwaa la bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Pɔmeɡranet nɔna aa do ɡuleɡule la bwa lɔ fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anumɛl dɛ do baŋ bɛlbwa ta, asɛ pɔmeɡranet nɔna aa lɔ anɔ la aa lɔ kafola la ta nyundua bwa ɡe lɔ lafa.
Laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan lawɛ Sɔfonomoa Seraya ne o dɔŋ Sefania o ɡe aa dɛ chao, dɛ nomonome batoro bane baa dɛ daah doonyoa la laa ta kaa.
Ba bini banɔ la baa ka bwɛjen la bini la, o lawɛ nomoa waa chɔ laa tena nyoa ne nɛra banuanɛ baa dɛ ja kooro la.
Dɛ lawɛ laa nomoa la nɛn waa dɛ chao dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, dɛ laa tena fifraanumɛl baa jaa dɛ do bwɛɛ la bini.
Babelɔn laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan kpɔ ba bwa kaa bwɛjen Ribla ka tɛ Babelɔn koojen.
Ribla waa lɔ Hamat harɛ taa Babelɔn koojen ɡel ba kpoo ba bela.
Gɛɛ a do ba lawɛ Juda tena le ba harɛ ta, dɛ kaa ba ne bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Nɛra Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa aa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta laanee teŋa nɔ.
O kora dii bene anuanɛ ta la, Juu tena lɔ kaɡboŋa batoro fifraanɛ dɛ batoro, bene fi dɛ anuatoro ta la, nɛra lafraanuatoro fifraatoro dɛ banɛɛ o lawɛ le Jerusalam, asɛ bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro ta ɡe, Juu tena lafraanuanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue.
Nebusaradan waa chɔ laa tena nyoa laanee laɡ ba kaa.
Ba bwa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa banaarɛ lafraanumɛl.
Ba le Kooro Jehoiachin dea baa doo Baa lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiachin laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ la, ɡɛ saŋee Babelɔn Kooro Evil Mɛrɔdak di kora.
O tɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ ɡel ba le Kooro Jehoiachin dea korobie fi dɛ anɛ, tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anue ta.
Kooro Evil Mɛrɔdak bol wobodɛɛɡa tɛ Kooro Jehoiachin, dɛ tɛo jirima ɡwaa koranar baa ja o nɛɛ ba laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta Babelɔn bela la bwa.
Anomanta, Kooro Jehoiachin dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ laa laala waa doa ba doo dea la foo bil, dɛ kpɔ anfala do, asɛ o ne Babelɔn kooro pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwa o soɡa bini bwa.
Dɛ Kooro Jehoiachin soɡa bini bwa la, dɛ Babelɔn Kooro Evil Mɛrɔdak dɛ tɛo suuɡa waa kpɔ yawɛ kwaa aa hiaoh.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Wiile Taara Tɔn nɔ ɛ wiile baa taara dɛ baɡle wenaale aa ba bwɛjen Jerusalam tena nɛ, ɡɛ saŋ Babelɔn laa tena aa baa yo ba dɛ chɔɡ bwɛjen la.
Nɛn waa na wenaale nɔ, dɛ di a suna kohona laanee chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
A ken ɛɛ ɛ Korowii keame Jeremiaa.
Kɛ ane a bwa, o yaradao kɛŋɔ Korowii nɔn dawɛ wobɛlbwa ta.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
A tona bini la, o chwerɛ wesoŋa dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ ó berɛ lawɛ o nɛra ba o be.
Nyiŋi nyu .
Jerusalam suna dii Na ɡɛ bwɛjen Jerusalam aa chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ nɛra fa su o ta ɡa!
Na ɡɛ waa bera do kɛ luhaah, o waa do sum, dɛ o fa lɛ sɔn harɛre nɛra bini taeh!
Bwɛjen o fa aa do kɛ haŋkooro la, o berɛ yom taraken.
Jwaana bwaa wɛɛ wi kohona, siniire ɛɛ yɔɔro.
Harɛre nɛra baa dɛ nyinu bwa chwao, bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ larawe o bwara kpa.
O daamanar leo tɛ, dɛ bwa berɛ o dɔma taraken.
Ba fiiɡi Juda tena baa lɔ Jerusalam kohona, dɛ laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta.
Ba lɔ harɛfala ta, ba ta bosɔɔhna bɛlbwa dɔe.
Ba dɔma bar ba cheme, ba ta bɔr dɔe dɛ́ le chwa kaa.
Ŋwɛnɛre nɛra aa kpɔ a ta kaa tomɛ Korowii Dea ɛo surumm kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ wi ba nɛn bɛl waa sewa ken, dɛkalkɛ nomɛlbwa aa a ta kpɔ dɛ́ ba di tɔpejena baa lea cheɡ la kpa.
Bitoli baa dɛ ɡo yela bwara dɛ nyɛɡ bela, asɛ ba sɔfore ɡe ɛɛ wi.
Bwɛjen Saayɔn doonyoo chɔ pɛɛ, wenaale kohona do o ta.
O dɔma pɔ o nɛ, dɛɛ di kpeɡri.
Korowiirii ŋɔa o bwara nyɛɡ o wechɔɡa aa kana kohona la wa.
Ba lawɛ o bii bwa laa ta kaa harɛfala ta o dɔma siwi ta.
Jerusalam nyanyini bwa tonɔ.
O koranar ɡwɛɡrɔ kɛŋɔ lɔr aa kpo ola a ɡaaɡe nyin kondikwaa dɛ́ di kahonɛ la ken, a chwao le nɛra baa dɛ kpaahna dɛɛ nyina dɛ́ kpo la sie.
Jerusalam tena lii ɡɛ saŋ baa lɔ wenaale ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, ne kondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ba faa dɔa la.
Ba dɔma aa baa yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ la, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ba lɛɛ ba.
Ba dɔma nyiŋi ba chɔɡa la dɛɛ mam ba.
Jerusalam do kɛ nɛn waa ɛ wechɔɡa kohona dɛ kah doŋa ken.
Nomɛlbwa aa jirima kpɔe dɛɛ tɛo kpa, dɛkalkɛ ba na o sihiih waa dia, ne hima waa dɛ hime dɛ laa sie berɛ.
Bɛlbwa na wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah o te, o ta waa aa dɛ ba o nɛɛ chiɡa kerekere waa liire.
O chola waa chola la ɔma kohona, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ larawe o bwara.
O ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, sune n nɛ, dɛkalkɛ n dɔma pɔ n nɛ, dɛ kpɔ wenaale ba ta n nɛ.” Dɔma pa o laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa kaa.
O ɡbabir na harɛre nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ aa dɛ jo Korowii Dea la bini, bela Korowii fe aa wola ban ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ kɛ ba jo.
Jerusalam tena bwa himo dɛɛ nyin kondikwaa dɛ́ di.
Ba kpɔ ba laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛɛ charɛ kondikwa, dɛ́ won so.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, nyiŋi dɛ́ na wenaale yaa lɔ a ta taraken.” Jerusalam wio kɛ nɛn ken, dɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋ mɛ, amɔ nomɛl ɡe lole dɛɛ na n wenaale nɔ dɔŋa aa?
Wenaale Korowii baah aa dia kohona o kpɔ ba ta n nɛɛ saŋ nɔ ta nɔ.
Korowii ɡelɔ nii le nyundua dɛ ba jo n bini fuh n hoɡa.
O har mɛ bel dɛ ɡel n chole harɛ, asɛ dɛ ɡel mɛ bela, n do weweele ta tɔpere bɛlbwa.
O na n wechɔɡa bwa, dɛ boa a nyoa, dɛ vɔwa.
O kpɔa vɔwɛ n baŋa a tɔɡre ɡel n ɡwɛɡre.
O kpɔ mɛ do n dɔma ba kpeɡri aa ɡwaa mɛ nɔn ta.
Korowii vɛh n banyoola bwa, dɛ ɡel laa tena ba yo n bonɔɔna, dɛ chɔɡ ba kɛŋɔ ba yon tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna dɛɛ kpɔ a nee la ken.
A waa siniire ɛɛ yɔɔ mɛ kohona la.
Nomɛlbwa aa won larawe n bwara, bɛlbwa ɡe aa won do mɛ ɡbemba.
N dɔma pɔ n nɛ, n bii ta sidawa bɛlbwa dɔe kpa.
Jerusalam do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa ta nɔn dɛɛ nyin nomɛl ó ba chao, kɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ba larawe o bwara.
Korowii do nɛra baa soɡa bar Israel, asɛ ba ba yoo laa, dɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ kondoŋ bɛl ken.
Korowii te waa toɡrɔ tɛ mɛ, kɛ menee vɛh waa waa do mɛ a ta.
Hé no n be, he nɛra haa lɔ bobɛlbwa, dɛ́ na wenaale maa lɔ o ta.
Ba lawɛ n bonɔɔna ne toli bwa laa ta kaa harɛfala ta.
N yerɛ harɛre nɛra n ne ba nyoa aa pɛa, kɛ ba vɛh n chae.
Nomonome ne sɔfore serewɔ chɔ bwɛjen la fɔɡbaahna, kondikwaa baa ka soŋe di dɛ́ won so la wa.
N Naa Korowii, na n suna maa dɛ di, n loo kuu, n bambile chɔɡ n wechɔɡa wa.
Nɛŋkpoa lɔ fɔɡbaahna, hale nɛra ɛɛ serewe deremi ta.
Ba no n wii maa dɛ wii, kɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ba larawe n bwara.
N dɔma bwa no n wenaale wa, asɛ ba sie lɛ kɛ haa kpɔa ba ta n nɛ.
Gel tɔpere bɛl haa baɡɛ nyoa o waa la ba, ásɛ ba ɡe bwara nyɛɡ kɛ n kwaa nɔ.
Pa ba bolchɔɡe ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa wa, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne ɡɛ haa tɛr n deŋne n wechɔɡa waa nɔ.
N hima kan kohona n jum jah.”
Korowii tɛr Jerusalam tena deŋne Na ɡɛ Korowii aa kpɔ o bandia ba bɔle bwɛjen Saayɔn ta kɛŋɔ bam, dɛ tɛr o nɛra deŋne.
O le nyundua taɡɛ Israel wer ta harɛ.
O ta o natiɡribɔr waa ɛ o Dea la ɡba waa dawɛ o bandia tɔpere la ta.
O chɔɡ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bwa o ta bɛlbwa nɛɛ sune, dɛ chɔɡ dekpeɡa aa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa bandia ne.
O ɡelɔ sihiih kpo koranar ne ba harɛre.
O cheɡɛ o bandia kohona ta, dɛ sɔɔh Israel nɛŋkpeɡa nyoa.
Gɛ saŋ ba dɔma aa ba ba nɛɛ la, o berɛ habɔɔ kpo ba, o ta ban chae.
O baah di Israel tena nɛɛ kohona, o chɔɡ ba kɛŋɔ nii yon fuh dɛ chɔɡ komɛlbwa la.
O do kɛŋɔ dɔm waa harɛ o to pa ba nɛ, dɛ kpoo nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ ba nɛ dɛɛ nyin ba kohona.
O bandia kohona la ba Jerusalam tena nɛ.
Korowii do kɛŋɔ dɔm dɛ ba chɔɡ Israel harɛ.
O ɡelɔ o dekpeɡa ne kooderemi bwa berɛ dimɡbeeni, dɛ kpɔ wii ne suna dii aa wola jaɡa dɔe ba ta Juda tena nɛ.
O kuuɡi o Dea baa dɛ tomɔ o bini burbur ken, dɛ ɡel tɔpejena baa lea cheɡ a do ɡoroŋ, ne Ona Tɔpera bwa ba a jaɡa.
Kooroo yoo, sɔfoo yoo ba bwa nyɔ o danana ne.
Korowii vɛh kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo ta, dɛ ɡel o Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la.
O ɡelɔ dɔma ba kuuɡi kooderemi danjwɛɛre.
Dɔma la do silɛɛ lɔŋɔre bela ba fa aa dɛ tomɛ, kɛŋɔ tɔpejen baa lea cheɡ tɔpere bɛl ta ken.
Korowii siwi beɡrɔ kɛŋɔ Saayɔn danjwɛɛ kuuɡi.
O maɡɔ cheɡ kɛŋɔ ó chɔɡo kwaraa.
Danjwɛɛre la do kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ wi ken, a ta bokpeɡa bɛlbwa dɔe kpa.
Bwɛjen la doonyojena choɡlo dɛ huɡe harɛ, bune baa kpɔa dɛɛ kaɡra ɡe kuuɡi dɛ chɔɡ.
Ba lawɛ o koranar ne nomonjena bwa laa ta kaa harɛfala ta.
Sɔfore aa nɛra Korowii waa baɡle, asɛ Korowii keamere ɡe aa won wepila na dɛɛ le Korowii be kpa.
Jerusalam banjeni helɔ dɛ so harɛ jeiih ken, ba ɛ teera do ba nyuune ta dɛ kpɔ lweyale tɔ, a baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna.
Bitoli ɡe ɡure nyuune su harɛ.
N wio kohona n sie bwa ɛɛ wee mɛ, n loo ɡe ku.
N di suna dɛ ba koh, n nɛra chɔɡa baa chɔɡa wa, dɛkalkɛ bechale ne bechasɔɔhne bwa ɡwɛɡrɔ chɔ bwɛjen la fɔɡbaahna.
Lɔr ne nyɔɡre ɡelɔ ba wi dɛɛ yerɛ ba nyare, dɛɛ choɡli bwɛɛ la fɔɡbaahna kɛŋɔ baa do ba bola ken, dɛ serewe dawɛ ba nyare nɔɔra ta.
Akwe!
Ee, Jerusalam maa dɛ nyini kohona, ɛrɛɛ ń bol he waɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona larawe he bwara ɔ?
Nomɛlbwa ta he wenaale nɔ dɔŋa nae bwa.
He wenaale nɔ bini luŋri kɛŋɔ mpo vil ken, he ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe.
Wepila he keamere aa naa dɛɛ baɡle la ɛ nyosone, ba webaɡla la neɡre, ba ta ɡelɛ he jemɛ he wechɔɡa, ásɛ he charɛ he we-ɛɛla, ba bɛ hen lawɛ kaa harɛfala ta.
Bwɛjen Jerusalam, nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa nyiŋi dɛɛ mamɛ.
Ba viiɡi nyuune dɛɛ mamɛ, chɔɡa haa chɔɡa waa dɛ ŋɔ, “Akwe, bwɛjen Jerusalam waa wera kohona, asɛ harɛre nɛra bwa sie fa ɛɛ lɛ o nɛɛ laanee nɔ naa?” He dɔma bwa dɛ mamɛ dɛɛ muɡli he baah.
Ba mile nyoo dɛɛ pwee ŋɔ, “Ya wono chɔɡo!
Tɔpere yaa dɛ kpa laanee fini!” Korowii teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta, dɛ ɛ waa o fa aa vɔrɔwa bil ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo la.
O chɔɡe, o ta he nɛɛ sune, dɛ ɡel he dɔma pɔ he nɛ, dɛɛ di he loro, he chɔɡa la wa.
Bwɛjen Jerusalam, wi yerɛ Korowii.
He danjwɛɛre do kɛŋɔ nɛn o lole bɛl aa sewa wɛɛ wiu ken.
Gel siniire ɛɛ yɔɔre chɔɔ ne jwaana kɛŋɔ nenapale, bɛ suna dii ne wii ɡel.
Ir jwaana bɛlbwa dɛ́ɛ wi, dɛ́ɛ yerɛ Korowii ó chae.
Pili he bambile dɛ́ɛ soŋo ó sune he bii nɛ, bechale lɔr aa kpo ba ba serewe chɔ fɔɡbaahna la wa.
N Naa Korowii, nyiŋi na.
Umee he ɛ ken bwa nɔ?
A chɛ kɛ haahna chwe ba bii baa dɛ nyin ba ola aa?
A chɛ kɛ bá kpoo sɔfore ne Korowii keamere he Dea la bini naa?
Bechale ne nomonome bwa serewɔ chɔ fɔɡbaahna, ya dɔma kpoo bonɔɔna ne toli laa ta.
He ta ba nɛɛ sune dɛ kpoo ba awola he baah aa dia la.
N Naa Korowii, he ta nɔn yerɛ nɛra cheme kɛŋɔ kondikonjena dii tɔpere, asɛ ɔmee kohona bar mɛ cheme.
Awola he baah aa dia la, nomɛlbwa ta wone chwa kɛɛ dɛ le a nyoa.
Dɔma kpoo n bii maa dɛɛ ba, dɛɛ nyin ba kohona.
Deŋnetɛra ne liire chara dɛ hwɛɡa dɔe wa Menee nɛn maa na wenaale kohona dɛ le Korowii bandia ta.
O doŋ mɛ le o sie mɛɛ valɛ biro bini, ɡwaa kɛ n fe aa lɔ bɔchaah ta, kasinteŋ, o teŋɔ dɛɛ lɔɔ mɛ waa wola ɡel tɔpebir bwa, o ta n nɛɛ sune.
O ɡelɔ n ɡwaŋɛ, n ta bwadabii dɔe kpa, dɛ kuuɡi n hoɡa.
O ɡelɔ suna dii ne wahala nae bar mɛ cheme, kɛŋɔ baa laɡ mɛ do dea ken.
O ɡelɔ n do biro ta kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa biɡri la ken.
O vɔɡ mɛ jɔɡrɔre ne, n do kɛŋɔ nɛn baa lawɔ do dea, n ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ won lɛ n te.
Hale n kpɔ takpeɡ yerɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ ó cha mɛ kwaraa naa, waa n be no.
O kpɔ bwea tɔ mɛ bɔr, a ɡel n ŋwɛnɛre ɡole.
O sɔh kpɔɡ bini kɛŋɔ sisire, kɛɛ nyujente dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ lawɛ.
O tuɡ mɛ le ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ peeɡe n ola, dɛ ɡel mɛ n ɡbo chɔ.
O laa o to kpɔ, dɛ kpɔ o hɛma pa n nɛ, dɛɛ ta.
O ta o hɛma la a jooɡe n bwadabii bini.
A cheɡɛ a ta n nɛra kpɔ mɛ berɛ akwekwe nɛn, tɔpebir bwaa n mama ber ba yela baa ɡo.
Waa aa do kpeli ɡboo o kpɔ tɛ mɛ.
A ɛɛ mɛ kondikwaa ne nee mɛɛ nyɔ.
O ɡelɔ n chole bwea kuuɡi n nyena, n chɔ bomboɡ ta.
N ta deŋnesɔɔhna bɛlbwa dɔe, dɛ soh ɡɛ silɛɛ kwara aa doa.
N hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ Korowii nɛ, n jemɔ kɛ aa biɡri n sewɛ.
N lii n wenaale ne ɡaaɡa maa dɛ ɡaaɡe aa, a do kɛŋɔ maa di tɛɡkpela ken.
N dɛ lii a waa kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ n wee chwa le n bini.
Kɛ webeŋkpoŋ bɛlee n yon lii, ásɛ dɛ berɛ dɔ hwɛɡa.
Korowii nyina kohona aa wola tonɛ bwa, ne o tedoma nomanta, ya ta soɡe le, waa yaa ɡel bwa.
Chɔɔ bɛlbwaa aa beɡre anfala.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡbo waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
Korowiirii n komɛlbwa, n hwɛɡa bwa lɔ o nɛ.
Korowii wer tɛ nɛra baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛ, dɛɛ nyinu bambile bwa ne, anomanta, a wer kɛŋɔ nɛn lawɛ bambile dɛɛ kpa lɛɛ waa ba lɛ nɛra la.
A chɛ kɛ nɛn hweli ɡɛ bambile nɔ lawa le o bonɔɔne kɛɛ toli saŋ.
Gɛ nɛn la ɡbo so jeih dɛ́ kpɔ liire, dɛkalkɛ Korowiirii ɡela a ba o nɛ.
Naate kpɔ nyoa teɡɛ harɛ, á baɡle kɛ o sɛh chɔɡre, hwɛɡa ane ken ta lole.
Ó sɛh chɛɡa ne sihiih, dɛ lɔɔra bɛlbwa.
Korowii dɛ sune nɛra nɛ, waa won den vɛɛh ba ka tonɛ.
A lole kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ba suna dii nee, kɛ wɛɛ berɔ dɔ tedoma, o nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe kan kohona.
O sie aa lɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ wenaale kɛɛ suna dii ba ta nɛn nɛ.
Nɛra tiɡri nɛra baa laɡ ba do dea do harɛ, dɛ tɔ ba waa baa dɔa kɛ ba ɛ ŋwɛnɛ Nemenɛ Korowii sie, dɛ ba berɛ nɛn waa sie kɔɔto aa, amɔ Korowii aa a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwaa na naa?
Umee dɛ́ bol waa aa won chiɡ, dɛ Korowii laa sɛah kɛ a chiɡo?
Nemenɛ Korowii nyoa laa wechɔɡa ne wedɛɛɡa bwa do aa?
Ɛrɛɛ nɛn ta soɡe le dɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra o wechɔɡa wa aa, wɛɛ naɡre waɔ?
Hé ɡel ya nyiŋi ya we-ɛɛla bini na, dɛ́ charɛ ya liire, dɛ́ berɛ ba Korowii be.
Hé ɡel ya pili ya bambili dɛ́ ir nɔɔra soŋe Korowii waa dɛ di kora nyundua ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ ɛɛ deŋnekpeɡ, he ta ya wechɔɡa kpɔe kɛ yaa.
He bandia kohona ɡelɔ he ti yaa, dɛ kpoo yaa haa wola ya nɛɛ sune.
He kpɔ bandia bɔle he te kɛŋɔ bam, ásɛ ya wesoŋa bɛ won tel he be.
He ɡelɔ ya do kɛŋɔ puldoa haahra harɛre nɛra be.
Asɛ ya dɔma bwa pili nyoo bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ yaa.
Ya na ɔmewaa kohona, ba harɛ yaa nafuɡere, ba lawɛ yaa dɛ kpoo yaa.
Siniire dɛ yɔɔ mɛ kɛŋɔ nenapale, kpoora baa kpoo n nɛra la wa.
N siniire ɛɛ yɔɔ mɛɛ aa wola tonɛ bwa, ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡbaɡba aa le nyundua dɛ na.
N nyiŋi waa aa pu haahna bwa baa lɔ bwɛjen Jerusalam la aa, dɛ n bambile chɔɡɔ.
N dɔma hah mɛ pɛɛpɛɛ dɛɛ kpaah mɛ kɛŋɔ jumbie ken.
Ba lawɛ n ne n siwi ta kɔlɔŋ bini, dɛ foɡ mɛ bwea, dɛ́ fee kpo mɛ.
Ate, nee ba bɔle n nɛ, asɛ n lii ŋɔ n sewɔ tonɛ.
N Naa Korowii, n wio noe le kɔlɔŋ la bini ŋɔ hé cha mɛ.
He no n waa maa kpɔa bil he sie.
Bɛ deŋna tɔɔɡe, no n wii, dɛ́ ba cha mɛ.
He no n wesoŋa la, dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ n bɛ ɔmɛ.
N Naa Korowii, he baa che n habɔɔ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ.
N Naa Korowii, he ɡbabir na wechɔɡa baa kpɔa ɛɛ mɛ.
Ba bol n waa tɛ mɛ.
He ɡbabir na ɡɛ n dɔma aa hah mɛ, ne ɡɛ baa dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa.
N Naa Korowii, he no chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, dɛ jemɛ n vɔrɔwa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe bwa ɡe.
Tɔpebir bwaa baa bol n wa, dɛɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa.
Ba kpɔ n waa berɛ yela dɛɛ ɡo chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa.
N Naa Korowii, tɛr ba deŋne ɡɛ aa chɛa, ba waa baa ɛa la wa.
Bɛ ɡel ba dɔ hwɛɡa bɛlbwa, ásɛ he nyotaahna do ba nɛ.
Kpɔ bandia ti ba, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba le harɛ nɔ ta kwaraa!”
Jerusalam aa paɡra habɔɔ Na ɡɛ ya suuɡaswɛm sie aa chɔɡa, suuɡaswɛm tenten o fa aa dɛ nyɛɡle kohona la, o ta berɛ do ɡɛ kpa.
Korowii Dea bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, peɡrɔ dɛ chɔ fɔɡbaahna.
Na ɡɛ bwɛjen Saayɔn bonɔɔna ba fa aa do kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm a yoɡ aa kpeɡa aa doa, kɛ taraken, ba berɔ do kɛŋɔ vii baa kpɔ choh mao ken.
Kalampoŋa ɡba jemɛ ɡɛ waa ɔr o bie dɛ́ nyiŋi o nɛɛ ó kpeɡ.
Kɛ n nɛra Jerusalam tena nyu bini kpeɡri ba bii nɛɛ, kɛŋɔ taataa ken.
Ba ɡelɔ nyɔɡre ne lɔr kpo bechasɔɔhne baa serewe.
Bechale ɡaaɡɔ dɛɛ soŋe kondikwa, kɛ nomɛlbwa aa ban tɛ.
Nɛra ba fa aa dɔ kondikondɛɛɡa dɛɛ di la, lɔr kpo ba ba serewe chɔ fɔɡbaahna.
Banɔ la baa dɛ di yɛɛ ɡe kam kompuɡreri puldoa dɛɛ di.
N nɛra deŋnetɛra ɡwaa Sodom tena Korowii aa ɡela ba chɔɡa piɡ ba, nomɛlbwa aa wola wone lɛɛ ba la.
Jerusalam sitɔɔla waa fa do chasee kɛŋɔ yabi aa toa ken.
Ba fa dɔ bwadabii dɛ dɔ bokpeɡa, dɛ je ɡe kohona.
Kɛ taraken ba serewɔ chɔ fɔɡbaahna baa wola ban jemɛ.
Ba bwadabii holɔ kɛŋɔ da, dɛ marɛ ba hoɡa.
Banɔ la baa sewɛ laa ta la, bɔ banɔ la lɔr aa kpoo ba.
Kondikwa bɛ toole waa lɔr kpoo ba.
Wenaale aa chiɡ n nɛra nɛɛ nɔ, a ba wedoŋa kohona ne taeh, hale haahna baa dɔ tedoma tɛ ba bii daa ba ola chwe.
Korowii baah diu kohona, asɛ o choŋi nii dɛ fuh Saayɔn bwa dɛɛboo ken.
Harɛre koranar, kɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛn bɛlbwa, ta liire kɛŋɔ dɔma ɛɛ won kpɔ Jerusalam doonyojena ta jo o bini.
Kɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ wono chiɡ, dɛkalkɛ a cheɡɛ Korowii keamere ne o sɔfore wechɔɡa ta, nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ serewe.
A ɡɛ keamere ne sɔfore la dɛ ɡaaɡe fɔɡbaahna kɛŋɔ nyoŋa ken.
Nɛra aa cheɡɛ ba nɛɛ ba serewe, ba chale do ba nɛɛ la ɡelɔ ba kah doŋa, anomanta, nomɛlbwa aa won leɡ ba.
Asɛ nɛra la nyɛɡ ba nɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé le ya be kaa!
Hé kah doŋa!
He bɛ yaa leɡe!” Gɛɛ baa ba harɛre ta doe dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛɛ ba.
Korowii ɡbabirii lɔ ba peɡre, o laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ.
Nɛra aa sɔfore duu, baa nomonome ɡe kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Ya ta sie nyiŋi ŋɔ ya ken ɛɛ dɔ chae, dɛ ba kahonɛ.
Ya cheɡɛ ya dejaŋa ta nyiŋi kɛŋɔ, yaa dɔ harɛ bɛl nɛraa bá ba lɛ yaa le ya dɔma nɔn ta kahonɛ.
Ya dɔma dɛ nyiŋi ya vala bwa bini, a ɡel yaa won fɔɡbaahna kwaaraa valɛ.
Ya tɔpere telo tonɛ, a ka tamaa ken ya serewe.
Ba ɡbaŋre ɡwaa kɛŋɔ kee yon le nyundua la ken, dɛ ba tɔ ya nɛ.
Ba ti yaa bwejena dor, dɛ ka sɔh dɛɛ kpaah yaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Ba lawɛ kooro Korowii aa leo tɛ yaa.
Ya liiro kɛŋɔ o nɛɛ yá che dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.
Onee ya yarada kɛŋɔ wɛɛ lɛ yaa le nomɛlbwa waa ba lɔ tɔ ya nɛɛ la be.
Edom ne Us tena, hé hɛɡre dɛ́ ɡel he sie lɛ.
He ɡe chɔɡa dɛ ba, hɛɛ yɛɛɡoo mumɡbal ne, ásɛ sihiih kpo heya.
Saayɔn tena dɔ deŋnetɛra ba wechɔɡa wa, Korowii aa ɡel ba lawɛ heyaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta kpa.
Kɛ he Edom tena te, wɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee, dɛ́ le he nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla ne baŋ.
Suna dii wesoŋa N Naa Korowii, lii ya wa dɛ́ na waa aa pu yaa.
Nyiŋi dɛ́ na ɡɛ sihiih aa kpo yaa.
Harɛ waa ɛ ya kapɛrɛ kon kaa di nɛŋhɔɔhra nɔn ta, harɛfala nɛra lɛ ya deremi dɛ so a ta.
Ya mɛɛnanar serewɔ asɛ ya ɛ bilalbii, ya nyare ɛ luhaahna.
Ya dɛ bɔ nee kem mɔɔ dɛ́ dɔ nyɔ, ɡɛ tentenee yaa yawɛ damara ɡe.
Ya dɔma ti yaa dɛɛ di ya nafeena, ya koɔh kɛ baa yaa ɡel ya onɛ.
Ya koh kondikwaa yaa dɔ di wa, dɛ kpɔ ya te ka do Ijipt ne Asiiria tena lɔɡa.
Ya naawa fa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ bwa serewe kaa, kɛ taraken yanee bera dɔ a deŋnetɛra.
Yomaa bera dɛɛ nyiŋi ya nɛ, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won lɛ yaa le kpeɡri baa dɛ di ya nɛɛ ta.
Nɛŋkpoa aa lɔ kpɔɡ bini nomanta, ya dɛ sɛh seo kwara dɛ le kaa nyin kondikwa.
Lɔr ɡelɔ yaa we kabul, a ɡel ya bwadabii wɔrɔbe kɛŋɔ baa mar nii fononoo bini ken.
Ba ɡuɡri haahna dɛ laɡ ba chɔ Saayɔn Bwejen ta, ɡɛɛ ba ɛ toli baa wola baala jemɛ ɡe Juda harɛ bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ɡe ta.
Ba vɔrɔwe ya sitɔɔla nɔɔra ŋwɛɛra ne dɛ ka saɡ ba, baa duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ banjeni.
Ba ɛɡre bonɔɔna baa namɛ boyu kɛŋɔ yoma ken, bibaala ɡe che datɔɡa dɛɛ kɛŋle.
Nomonome aa bwɛjen la doonyojen ta bela so kpa, bonɔɔna ɡe ɡel yela ɡoe.
Silɛɛ toole ya bini kpa.
Ya dɔ silɛɛ aa, anee ya yon dɛɛ sa, taraken te ya dɛ wi, dɛkalkɛ ya lɔ suna dii ta.
Komɛlbwa toole ya won dɛɛ tamane o waa kpa.
Ya ɛ wechɔɡa nomanta, wenaale kohona ba ya nɛ.
Gɛ ɡelɔ ya bambili bwa chɔɡ, siniire nomanta, ya sibie swɛɛrɔ, yaa wone dɛɛ na kɛrɛdɛ kpa, dɛkalkɛ Saayɔn Bwejen chɔ pɛɛ, asɛ kalampoŋare do o ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
N Naa Korowii, he dɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa, hɛɛ teŋɔɔ di kora saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ɛrɛɛ he soh ya waa biɡri ɡɛ nɔɔ?
He ta ɛɛ ba lii ya waa ja tenaa?
N Naa Korowii, berɛ lawɛ yaa ba he be.
Berɛ ɡel ya dɔ silɛɛ o fa aa lole wubwa la.
Kɛɛ he deno vɛh yaa kwara kɛɛ?
He bandia ta jaɡa dɔe ya nɛ aa?
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Babelɔn laa tena lawɛ Ɛsekeɛl le Jerusalam kaa Babelɔn mɔɔ ba paɡre bwɛjen Jerusalam kwaraa.
Korowii kpɔ o waa la do o nyoa keraŋwɛnɛ bwa, ó bol baɡle o bala o ne baa lɔ Babelɔn harɛ, dɛ nɛra baa kaa dɛ do Jerusalam ɡe.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Jeremia ɡe bol Korowii waa dɛɛ baɡle Jerusalam tena.
Waa Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ Ɛsekeɛl wɛɛ bol la, o yon ɛ waane dɛ́ che a ta kpɔ baɡ ba waa la, ásɛ ba no a mun kɛrɛdɛ.
Korowii ɡelɔ o na wepila aa ɛ nyokpowaa ɡe kɛrɛdɛ.
Anɔ bwa sekwaraa ta la, Korowii dɛ nyin kɛ nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ o ɡboo ɛ kooro harɛ nɔ ta bwa, dɛ do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ di kpeɡri ɡe.
Korowii jirima ne hweera kwaa ane wa Waa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔ, Korowiirii pila baɡle men Busi bie sɔfo Ɛsekeɛl.
Baa lawɛ n ne Juu tena laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta ka so Keba Moo nyoa, bene fifraatoro korobie anaarɛ tɔpenue taa a ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡ.
Korobie la tɔpenue weeree ɛ bene anue baa lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiachin laa ta kaa Babelɔn.
Keba Moo nyoa Babelɔn harɛ ta belaa Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl maa ɛ sɔfo be, n dɔ o kpeɡri dɛ na wepila.
N nao kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ bɛl aa taa dɛ kpɔ bam waa kana le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, nii baro cheme, o bini ɛɛ nyɛɡle pelɔpelɔ ken.
Waa dɛ nyɛɡle la, komɛl do kɛŋɔ ayaawa ken dɛ do o bini.
Maa nyiŋi nii la bini la, n na hweera kwaa anaarɛ a mar aa do kɛŋɔ nɛn bela, bɛlbwa dɔ siebɔra anaarɛ ne kena anaarɛ.
A nakpale toɡrɔ, a napaala ɡe do kɛŋɔ nabale kwa, dɛɛ nyɛɡle kohona kɛŋɔ ayaawa baa looru ken.
A siebɔra anaarɛ ne kena anaarɛ la habɔɔ, bɛlbwa dɔ nɛn nɔn beŋkpoŋ keni bɛlbwa lɔɡa, a ɛ nɔɔra anaarɛ.
A bɛlbwa kena nyoo dɛ leɡe o dɔŋ kwa, a pɛ dɛɛ ir, aa a te berɛ.
Siebɔra hweera kwaa anaarɛ la aa dɔa la kokoɡrɔ.
Gɛ aa doa teŋa nɔ.
Nɛn siebɔr lɔ o sie, nyujente siebɔr do diɡ, nabal siebɔr do ɡal, asɛ kee siebɔr do habɔɔ.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ a siebɔra do.
A bɛlbwa dɔ kena anaarɛ, a paɡri anɛ kaa nyundua aa leɡe dɔŋa kwa, anɛ ɡe ɛɛ bɔle a bwara.
Bobɛlbwa Korowii Doma la aa dɛ kaa ane la, kaalaa aa kaa, aa sie berɛ.
Hweera kwaa la dɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ ninhɔla kɛɛ kapɛle ken.
Asɛ nii do a baahna ta, dɛ la sie dɛɛ ba, dɛɛ chaah dɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwaala.
Hweera kwaa la laŋɔ dɛɛ ba wɔrɔbe nɛɛ kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ nyɛɡle la.
Maa dɛ nyiŋi hweera kwaa la, n na kwaane a do kɛŋɔ saaker nakpale anaarɛ a che harɛ a bɛlbwa jwɛh.
Saaker nakpale anaarɛ la dɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane baa dɛ yera kresolet, a bwa ɛ siwi beŋkpoŋ.
A do kɛŋɔ beŋkpoŋ su o dɔŋ ta ken.
Bobɛlbwa hweera kwaa la aa dɛ kaa la, kaalaa aa kaa, saaker nakpale la aa menɛ dɛɛ kaa bobɛlbwa.
Kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ saaker nakpale la kan, dɛ do ɔma kohona sibie su a bwa bar.
Hweera kwaa la dɛ kaa laa, saaker nakpale la ne anee dɛɛ kaa.
A iro ɡe aa, a dɛ marɛ anɛ ane aa kaa.
Bobɛlbwa a doma aa dɛ kaa a ne la, o ne saaker nakpale laanee dɛɛ kaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a doma la lɔ saaker nakpale la ta.
Hweera kwaa la dɛ kaa laa, a ne saaker nakpale laanee dɛɛ kaa, a cheɡɔ aa, dɛ a ɡe cheɡɔ.
A iro aa, saaker nakpale la yon marɛ a nɛ, dɛkalkɛ hweera kwaa la doma lɔ saaker nakpale la ta.
N na komɛl aa bɔle hweera kwa la nyundua dɛ do ɔma kohona, dɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ dombwea ken.
Kon la aa bɔle a nyundua la lɔɡa la, a paɡri a kena anɛ a leɡe dɔŋa, dɛ kpɔ anɛ ɡe tɔ a bwara.
Hweera kwaa la dɛ kaa laa, n dɛ no a kena sii kɛŋɔ chuubu aa dɛ si la ken, a berɛ do kɛŋɔ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la taa, kɛɛ laa tena aa wara ɡbɔɡa ken.
A cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ aa, dɛ a fɔɔ a kena la.
N berɔ no taa bɛl le kon waa bɔle hweera kwaa la nyundua ɡɛ saŋ aa baa che dɛ fɔɔ a kena la.
Kon waa bɔle hweera kwaa la nyundua la, n na komɛl waa do kɛŋɔ kookara, ba kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane aa ɛ burum baa yera safaaya ɛ o doa, asɛ a do kɛŋɔ nɛn soɡe kookara la ta ken.
N nao kɛŋɔ nɛn waa soɡe kookara la ta la, le o chara ta dɛ kaa nyundua do kɛŋɔ buni baa doo nii ta wɛɛ nyɛɡle, dɛ́ berɛ le o chara ta dɛ́ ba harɛ la ɡe do kɛŋɔ nii, asɛ nii waa chaahna kohona baro cheme.
Gɛ bwaala deŋɡare yon le baama ta bɔr chaah la, ɡɛɛ bɔr waa chaahna bar kookara la do.
A dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii jirima aa doa.
Maa nao la, n cholo dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ, asɛ dɛ no taa bɛl.
Korowii yera waa yerɛ Ɛsekeɛl Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ir che ásɛ n bol waa he be.” Waa dɛ bol waa la, o Doma baa so n nɛ dɛ ɡɔɔ mɛ ir che, asɛ mɛɛ no o wobol la.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, n dɛ tomɛ n nɛra Israel tena be.
Nɛra ba deŋne aa kpeɡa, ba ne ba naawa vɛɛh mɛ le saŋ la ba le fini.
Nɛra men Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ tomɛ ba be la lwɛɛma kpeɡri, baa men bu.
N dɛ tomɛ he ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ kenii mɛɛ bol.
Ba no he be kɛɛ ba ta he be noɛ yoo, ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena wubwa, kɛ baa jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii keame ba ba be.
Kɛ hen nɛwɛnyini bie, dɛɛ berɛ ba ɔma, dɛɛ berɛ ba waa baa dɛ bol ɡe ɔma, a do kɛŋɔ haa dɛ la ka do jabalnadaŋɛre ne sɔɔhne baah ta.
Nɔrɔme baah taa hɛɛ la ka jo, kɛ bɛ ban ɔmɛ.
Bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ ba sie, ba deŋne kpeɡri.
Dɛ ba no he be kɛɛ ba ta he be noɛ yoo, he te ka bol waa maa ŋɔa he bol ba be la.
Ba ɛ nɛra ba deŋne aa kpeɡa.
Kɛ hen nɛwɛnyini bie, dɛɛ no waa maa dɛ bol he be nɔ.
Bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ kɛ ban.
Hah nyoa dɛ́ lɛ kwaa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛɛ nɔ di.” Belaa n nyiŋi dɛ na nɔn bɛl aa tɛra ba n be asɛ dɛ kpoŋe tɔn, dɛ paɡru n sie.
Dɛ ba chwerɛ wiile, wii ne wenaale waa do o sie ne o habɔɔ.
Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, di kon waa lɔ he sie nɔ, di tɔn nɔ, ásɛ dɛ ka bol waa baɡle Israel tena.” Ate, n hah nyoa, asɛ o kpɔ tɔn la tɛ mɛ ŋɔ n di.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, lɛ tɔn nɔ di dɛ vaɡɛ.” Asɛ n lɛ dɛ kpɔ di, o do som kɛŋɔ tooh ken.
Ate, o berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, name la Israel tena be ka bol n waa maa kpɔa tɛɛ la baɡ ba.
Nɛra ba wobol aa kpeɡa, a mun noe ɡe do kpeɡri be laa mɛɛ tomɛ, Israel tena bee mɛɛ tomɛ.
Ba ta harɛ o nɛra wobol aa kpeɡa, ba waa mun noe do kpeɡri ɡe ɛɛ.
Dɛ n fe tomɛ ɡɛ nɛra la be naa, ba fe noɔ.
Kɛ n nɛra Israel tena ɛɛ vɛh he be noe, dɛkalkɛ baa n waa nyin dɛ no, ba vɛh n wa, ba bambile kpeɡri, ba deŋne ɡe do kpeɡri.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo hen Ɛsekeɛl bambile do kpeɡri, ásɛ he bɛ he te kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he do kpeɡri kɛ bwe ken, dɛ́ do kpeɡri ɡwaa bwe waa kpeɡa te bɛlbwa, bɛ ban ɔmɛ.
A lole kɛŋɔ ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa maa dɛ bol he be nɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
La he bwɛɛ tena baa lawɛ he ne ban ba Babelɔn bonɔ la be ka ŋɔ, ba vɛoh woo ba ta vɛɛh yoo, ŋɔ ba be.
Kenii men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ bol.” Belaa Korowii Doma la ɡɔɔ mɛ ir che, asɛ n no takpeɡ bɛl n habɔɔ kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra ken ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ jirima Korowii aa dɔa o soŋnibɔr.” N no hweera kwaa la kena aa dɛ seeɡe dɔŋa ne saaker nakpale la aa dɛ si kohona kɛŋɔ harɛ aa dɛ jiɡri ken.
Korowii Doma la baa so n nɛɛ kpeɡri nɛ, dɛ kpɔ mɛ kaa, asɛ n sie beɡre n baah di n bambile bini.
N ba n bala baa laɡ ba ba Babelɔn harɛ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Tɛl Abib la be, o bɛne Keba Moo la.
N soɡe ba be tɔpera anuanɛ, asɛ n bwara yɔr waa maa naa la wa.
Korowii kaeh waa kah Israel tena Tɔpera anuanɛ la jaɡa, Korowii bol waa n be ja ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, n kpɔe kɛ hɛɛ daah n nɛra Israel tena.
Anomanta, cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ no n waa nɔ dɛ́ kah ba tɛ mɛ.
Dɛ n ŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ be ŋɔ wɛɛ sewɛ o wechɔɡa taa, dɛ he ta on kaeh, o ɡel o wechɔɡa la dɛ dɔ o nyu aa, wɛɛ sewɛ o wechɔɡa taa.
Ate, mɛɛ pɛɛre a waa.
Kɛ dɛ he kah wechɔɡ-ɛɛ la o ta o wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre la ta leɛ yaa, wɛɛ sewɛ o wechɔɡa taa.
Ate, hɛɛ dɔ he nyuu.
Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra la le o wetoɡra ta dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, mɛɛ kpɔ kon waa dɛ ba ɡela o lɔ naa bil o sie.
Haa wola on kaeh nomanta, wɛɛ sewɛ o wechɔɡa taa.
Maa waa waa ɛa a toɡre laanee lii, mɛɛ pɛɛre o seo waa.
Kɛ dɛ he kah nɛn o wa aa toɡra o no, o ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ yaa, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu, ásɛ he ɡe dɔ he nyu.” Korowii kpeɡri ba n nɛɛ bela dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ir kaa deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta, ásɛ n bol waa he be.” Ate, n ir dɛ kaa bela.
N na Korowii jirima bela ɡɛ n fa aa nao Keba Moo nyoa la, asɛ n kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Korowii Doma la baa so n nɛɛ dɛ laɡ mɛ ir che, dɛ bol waa n be ŋɔ, “Kaa he dem dɛ́ ka laa ɡbera tɔ he nɛ.
Nɛwɛnyini bie, baa vɔrɔwe ŋwɛɛra nee he chɔ haa wola won la nɛra baah ta.
Mɛɛ berɛ he nyondoŋee he bol waa kahonɛ, haa won bol waa dɛ́ kah deŋnekpeɡ tena nɔ kpa.
Dɛ n berɔ dɛɛ ba ba bol waa he be ja aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo he won bol wa, dɛ́ bol ba be ŋɔ kenii men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ bol, ‘Bɛlbwa waa no la ɛɛ noo, bɛlbwa waa wola no la ɡe aa no, dɛkalkɛ deŋnekpeɡ tenaa wubwa.’ ”
Dɔma teera mae dɛ́ sawɛ Jerusalam danjwɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, nyin berekese dɛ́ kpɔ bil he sie, ásɛ dɛ ɛ bwɛjen Jerusalam dawɛ o ta.
Ásɛ he ma teera sawɛ danjwɛɛ la, dɛ́ kpɔ bwejeɡre baro, á che tɛ kwaa dɔma aa won che a ta teeh jo bwɛɛ la ta.
Ɛ bwejeɡre á che tɛ dɔma la tɛnte deene, dɛ́ kpɔ dakpeɡa baa dɛ ba wona kpɔ kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛɛ la baro.
Kpɔ buni loɡ cheɡ he ne berekese la haa ɛ bwɛjen la dawɛ o ta la baah ta, dɛ́ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ bwɛjen la, á do kɛŋɔ he tɔ bwɛjen la do, á baɡle waane tɛ Israel tena dɛ́ kah ba.
Chɔ he ɡal ta, ásɛ n kpɔ Israel tena wechɔɡa dawɛ he nɛ.
Tɔpera haa chɔ he ɡal ta la bwa, ba wechɔɡa ɛɛ dawɛ he nɛɛ he na wahala.
N kpɔ ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la bwa dawɛ he nɛ.
Tɔpera lafraatoro fifraanuanaarɛɛ hɛɛ ba Israel tena wechɔɡa cheɡa.
Haa ba tonɛ anɔ la, berɛ chɔ he diɡ ta, dɛ́ lɛ Juda tena ɡe wechɔɡa dawɛ he nɛ.
Tɔpera fifraanaarɛɛ n kpɔ tɛɛ, tɔpebeŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa cheɡɔ tɛ benanyoa beŋkpoŋ.
Berɛ sie chaɡɛ Jerusalam haa ɛo dɛ tɔɔ do la, dɛ́ tɛr nɔn dɛ́ bol waa bandia ne, á baɡle waa aa dɛ ba bala.
Mɛɛ vɔrɔwee ŋwɛɛra nee, ásɛ haa won berɛ he te, dɛ́ chɔ baŋ bɛl ka tel kɛŋɔ tɔpera haa tɔ bwɛjen la do la aa baa kaa.
Kpɔ mea bwa soo siwi ne chebe koo dɛ wɔɔ paanoo.
Anee hɛɛ ba dii tɔpera lafraatoro fifraanuanaarɛ haa chɔ he ɡal ta la.
Maɡɛ he tɔpere bɛlbwa kondikwa a tɔɡre tel suuɡapoŋa fifraanɛ.
Nee ɡe haa nyɔ la, dɛɛ nyɔ pɛrɛntoa del tɔpere bɛlbwa.
He kondikwaa la, kpɔ nɛra benɡewa wɔɔ paanoo la, dɛ́ dia nɛra la bwa siwi ta.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ Israel tena ɡe ɛɛ ba kondikwaa aa ɛ kii kwaa dii, awola maa ba lɔ ba peɡre bá ka so harɛfala ta la.” Asɛ men Ɛsekeɛl ŋɔ, “Akai Nemenɛ Korowii, le n bechale saŋ ba le fini, n ta konlale kɛɛ kon olchɔɡa aa kpoo kpɔe leɡe n nyoa bwa.
Kondikwaa aa ɛ kii kwaa ta n nyoa joɛ bwa.” Ate, Korowii berɛ ŋɔ, “N kpɔ nabena chiɡ nɛn kwaa la naa ta, he kpɔ wɔɔ paanoo la.” O berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, mɛɛ tɔ kondikwaa ŋwɛnɛɛ a waa do tɔɡre Jerusalam.
Maɡaa baa ba kondikwaa maɡa dɛɛ di, ásɛ nee waa ɡe do tɔɡre a ha ba, baa dia tebinichɔɡ ne.
Kondikwaa ne nee waa ɛɛ do tɔɡree ba ɡwaŋre.
Ba bɔra ɛɛ yɔr dɔŋa nɛɛ, bá serewe ba wechɔɡa wa.”
Ɛsekeɛl fonɛ o nyu ne o tampona Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kpɔ tokobi waa nyɛɡa kɛŋɔ fon dɛ́ fonɛ he nyu ne he tampona.
Kpɔ kon maɡɛ pona la ɡɛ a tɔɡre aa doa, dɛ́ bɔne a bini bɔre atoro.
Fuh bɔre atoro la bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋ bwɛjen haa ɛo la bini saŋ haa tɔɔ do a ba a jaɡa la.
Kpɔ tokobi teŋni bɔrbeŋkpoŋ bini bar bwɛjen la bini, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ la aa kaa la ɡe ta, ásɛ peu kpɔa kaa, dɛkalkɛ tokobi nee mɛɛ ba ba kpoora.
Gel pona la tama ka he kpɔ vɔwɛ he batakaare nyoa.
Berɛ kpɔ anɔ la aa lɔ he batakaare nyoa la tama do nii ta á fuh, a taa nii ɛɛ ba lee dɛ́ ba fuh Israel tena bwa.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Na Jerusalam, n kpɔɔ cheɡ harɛre bwa baah ta a baro cheme.
Jerusalam tena ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh me Mmarare ne n waa maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la ta teŋa.
Ba deŋnekpeɡ berɔ ɡwaa harɛre aa bar ba cheme nɛra la kwara.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ he Jerusalam tena wechɔɡa ɡwaa nɛra baa bar heyaa cheme la.
He ta me Mmarare ta teŋɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ ń pa heyaa bolchɔɡe.
He teŋɛ nɛra baa bar heyaa cheme la we-ɛɛla ta.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ne he Jerusalam tena dɔɔ.
Mɛɛ pa heyaa bolchɔɡee harɛre nɛra bwa siwi ta.
Voɡa maa kia hɛɛ toma nomanta, mɛɛ tɛr he Jerusalam tena deŋnee taeh.
N ta ane ɛɛ bwa, maa a dɔŋa ɡee ɛ kpa bwa.
A ɡɛ nomanta, mɛɛnanar ne nyare ɛɛ chwe ba bii olaa, ásɛ bii ɡe chwe ba mɛɛnanar ne nyare ola.
Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee, ásɛ dɛ lɔ banɔ la baa ba ka la peɡre bobɛlbwa.” Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ, haa kpɔ voɡare ne we-ɛɛla maa kia dɛ kpɔ doŋa ba kah n Dea nɔ, n laa sie kpɔ he nɛ, maa he nɛɛ sune, maa he bwaraa kpɔ kɛ heyaa kpa.
He bɔne he bini bɔre batoro naa, weechɔɡa kɛɛ lɔree dɛ́ kpoo bɔrbeŋkpoŋ nɛra bwɛjen la bini.
Baa kpɔ tokobii kpoo bɔrbeŋkpoŋ nɛra ɡe bwɛɛ la dahare, ásɛ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ nɛra baa kaa la ɡe, n lɔ ba peɡre, dɛ́ ti ba n tokobi ne.
N sie aa beɡre ń ba tɛr he deŋne n bandia kohona ne tonɛ n baah sɔɔh mɛ la, hɛɛ jemɔ kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii bola a ɛ ɡɛ.
Mɛɛ paɡre he bwɛjen laanee, ásɛ harɛre aa bar heyaa cheme nɔ nɛra teŋo baa kaa laa, bá che bojaŋ nyiŋi dɛɛ mamɛ.
Gɛ saŋ maa tɛr he deŋne bandia kohona ne la, harɛre aa bar heyaa cheme la nɛra ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ taeh, baa he waa nyin, dɛɛ mamɛ heya.
Mɛɛ tɔɔɡe kondikwaa ŋwɛnɛɛ, ásɛ lɔr kpo heya.
Hɛɛ na lɔr weweelee kɛŋɔ baa ta hɛma yaɡɛ heyaa dɛ kpoo heyaa la.
Mɛɛ kpɔ lɔr ne kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡaa ba ta he nɛ, ásɛ a kpoo he bii.
Weechɔɡa ne nɛŋkpoa ɛɛ ba he nɛɛ, ásɛ ba kpoo heyaa laa ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Korowii bol Israel harɛ bwejena chɔɡa wa Korowii berɔ bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kpɔ sie pa Israel bwejena la ta, dɛ́ ka bol chɔɡa men Korowii aa dɛ ba a chɔɡa dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘He bwejena ne deŋɡarere, hé no Nemenɛ Korowii wa.
O ŋɔ o dɛ ba laa ne dɛ́ ba chɔɡ bwejena ne deŋɡarere, ne bwea ŋwɛnɛre aa chɔ a baahna, ne fɛlembɔjena voɡare aa lɔ a ta nɛra ɛɛ toma la bwa.
Wɛɛ paɡre kwaa haa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta ne kwaa haa dɛ fuh daawiile a ta bwaa, ásɛ dɛ kpoo nɛra la ba voɡare la sie.
Wɛɛ pa Israel tena baa serewa la lalaa bil ba voɡare sie, dɛ́ berɛ pa ba hoɡa bar kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta la.
Israel tena bwɛjena ne bela baa soɡa bwa dɛ́ ba chɔɡa.
Kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta, ne ba voɡare bwa ɛɛ paɡro burbur ken ja bɔra baa dɛ fuh daawiile ta, ásɛ kwaa baa ɛa bwa aa lee do kpa.
Nɛra ɛɛ serewoo chɔ bobɛlbwa, ásɛ banɔ la baa ka la jemɛ kɛŋɔ onee Korowii.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he bini bane dɔ he nyu, bá lawɛ heyaa peɡre kaa harɛre ta.
Banɔ la baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfala ta la, belaa baa ba liira kɛŋɔ ba fa ɛo wechɔɡa, dɛ vɛh o waa ta teŋa, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa.
Ásɛ a we ba nɛ, wechɔɡa ne waa Korowii aa kia ba ɛ la wa.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ onee Korowii, kaeh waa kah ba la, aahra laa o aah ba pɛɛpɛɛ.’ ” Kenii Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Ɛsekeɛl, lɔ kpaŋa dɛ́ ɡɔɔ nakpale lɔ harɛ, dɛ́ wi lokua ne, Israel tena kii waa baa ɛa la wa.
Baa serewe laa ne lɔr dɛ weechɔɡa taa.
Banɔ la baa lɔ bojaŋa la, weechɔɡaa dɛ́ kpoo ba, ásɛ banɔ la baa bɛna la serewe laa ta.
Banɔ la baa kaa la, lɔr ɛɛ kpo ba ɡee ba serewe.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɡela ba na n bandia kohona.
Nɛra ɛɛ serewoo chɔ bobɛlbwa, ba voɡare ne kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta bwa, ne deŋɡarere ta ne bwejena dor ne dajena mune, dɛ bela baa fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡare bwa.
Kpelaa, mɛɛ tɛr n nɔnee pa ba nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba harɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ó chɔ pɛɛ le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Dibla, ne bobɛlbwa baa soɡa.
Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛ menee Korowii.”
Israel tena chɔɡa telo Nemenɛ Korowii bol men Ɛsekeɛl be ja ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Israel tena harɛ la dɛ ba chɔɡa.
O bwa ɛɛ chɔɡo kwaraa.
‘Israel tena he chɔɡa telo, n dɛ ba n bandia ne he nɛ, dɛ́ ba bol he waa dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne he wechɔɡa ne waa maa kia he ɛa la wa.
Maa he nɛɛ sune, maa kpɔ kɛ heya, mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee he wechɔɡa ne waa maa kia he ɛa la wa.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ” Waa Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, “Harɛchɔɡ bɛl dɛ ba, haa wola o dɔŋ waa noɛ bwa.
Waa bwa jaɡa saŋ la telo, o pu heyaa tonɛ.
O joɔ.
Nɛra haa soɡe harɛ la ta, he chɔɡa telo.
Saŋ la telo, tɔpere la joɔ tonɛ.
Silɛɛ bɛlbwa toole voɡa aa lɔ bwea dor ta kpa, sibeɡra ɡboo.
Maa biɡri dɛ́ kpɔ n bandia ba he nɛ, mɛɛ bol he waa haa ɛa la waa dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne waa maa kia he ɛa la wa.
Maa he nɛɛ sune, maa kpɔ kɛ heya.
Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee waa haa ɛa la ne waa maa kia he ɛ la waa, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii ba a ne.
Tɔpere la telo, o pu heyaa tonɛ.
He dachɔɡe do kɛŋɔ kwaa haa dua, a dɛ le, daŋɡbala la dɛ moɡɛ.
He lwɛmkpeɡ la feɔ.
He naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla la ɛɛ berɛ daŋɡbalaa, dɛ́ tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋne, ba komɛlbwa aa kae ba, ba kondɔɔh ne kwaa aa dɛ tɛɛ ba jirima la bɛlbwa aa kae ba.
Tɔpere la telo, o pu heyaa tonɛ.
Kon-yoɡra ne yarawa sie aa lɛ, n bandia la dɛ ba nɛnlaa la bwa nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa yoɡ harɛ tɛ o dɔŋ la, dɛ ba bwa ta soɡe le naa, waa berɛ dɔɔ kpa.
Wepila aa dɛ baɡle nɛnlaa la bwa waa la aa beɡre.
Ba wechɔɡa nomanta, beŋkpoŋ kwara aa o nyuu dɔ.
Ba hoh laa bɛla nomɛlbwa kpɔ o te, kɛ nɛn waa la laa toole, dɛkalkɛ n baah di nɛnlaa la bwa nɛ.
He leɔ kɛrɛ aa, he lɔ laa ta, he berɔ so dem ɡe aa, he ne weechɔɡa ne lɔree.
Laa taa banɔ la baa lɔ kpɔɡ bini ɛɛ ba serewa.
Banɔ la ɡe baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta la, weechɔɡa ne lɔree dɛɛ ba ba kpoora.
Banɔ la baa dɔ ba nyu dɛ chwa la ɛɛ ka so bwejena doree, dɛɛ wi kɛŋɔ fɛlembɔjena bini kwehre ken, bɛlbwa wechɔɡa waa ɛa wa.
Nomɛlbwa bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, ásɛ ba bwara ɛɛ sa.
Baa kpɔ lweyalee tɔ ɔmee laɡ ba kohona.
Sihiih ɛɛ kpo baa ba fonɛ ba nyuune bwa ta, á baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna.
Baa kpɔ ba suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛmee ta fɔɡbaahna kɛŋɔ chaa.
Ba suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm la aa won lɛɛ ba le men Korowii bandia tɔpere la ta.
Baa won kpɔa yawɛ kwaa di, baa won dia ɡe dɛ́ vaɡɛ, dɛkalkɛ a taa ba lɔ naa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Ba maŋkura ba te ba suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa ne baŋa kwaa ne noniseɡa aa wera la, dɛ kpɔ ɛ voɡa maa kia ne kondoŋa.
A waa mɛɛ ba ɡela ba kondɔɔh ɛ kondoŋa tɛɛ ba.
Mɛɛ kpɔ a bwaa tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra, ásɛ ba kaah kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa, kɛɛ nɛnchɔɡa aa dɛ kah kwaa la, bá kpɔ doŋa kaah.
Mɛɛ laa sie kpɔ ba be, ásɛ ŋwɛɛra ba jo n Dea bela laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa aa lole la, dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kaoh.
Hé nyin jɔɡrɔre cheɡ, nɛŋkpoa ɡboo harɛ la bwa, yoi ɡboo bwɛjen la bwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛnchɔɡa tenten le harɛre ta ba, dɛ́ ba lɛ he deene dɛ́ kpɔ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he kpeɡnɛra haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ ba nɛɛ la nyoa sɔɔh, dɛ́ ɡel bela haa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Chɔɡa la dɛ ba, hɛɛ dɛɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhnaa, kɛ haa dɔ.
Harɛchɔɡ ɛɛ teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛɛ ba, waa aa wola kasinteŋ ɛɛ la ɡe ɛɛ warɔɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Hɛɛ dɛɛ nyinuu kɛ he no wepila waa le n keamere be.
N waa la nyoɡre sɔfore liire ta, baa won bola kpa.
Nomonome ɡe aa won jemɛ ja nɛra kpa.
Kooro ɛɛ wiu, sitɔɔ bwara yɔr, ásɛ harɛ la ta nɛra bwara ɛɛ sa.
He we-ɛɛla taa mɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa mɛɛ ba kpɔe pa heyaa bolchɔɡe, ɡɛ haa ɛ he bala la.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”
Voɡa toma Korowii Dea Baa lawɛ yaa kaa harɛfale ta bene anumɛl korobinumɛl tɔpenue ta la, dɛ men Ɛsekeɛl soɡe n dem, asɛ Juda tena nomonome la cheme n sie, asɛ Nemenɛ Korowii Doma den ba so n nɛ.
N nyiŋo dɛ na komɛl wepila ta kɛŋɔ nɛn ken.
Le o chara ta kaa o nakpale ta do kɛŋɔ ninlao ken, dɛ berɛ le o chara ta kaa o nyundua ɡe do kɛŋɔ ayaawa baa looru wɛɛ nyɛɡle.
O tɛr komɛl kɛŋɔ nɛn nɔn dɛ lawɛ n nyumpona, asɛ Korowii Doma ɡɔɔ mɛ n do harɛ ne nyundua baah ta.
A ɡɛ wepila nɔ ta la, Korowii kpɔ mɛ kaa Jerusalam o Dea la dembaah doonyoa waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua pera, dɛ voɡ Korowii aa kiu kɔkɔkɔkɔ lɔ bela.
Belaa n na Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ jirima, ɡɛ n fa aa nao Keba Moo la bɔr la.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, nyiŋi weekaŋle nyundua pera.” Asɛ n nyiŋi doonyoa waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ voɡ Korowii aa kiu kɔkɔkɔkɔ la cheɡɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta jwɛh.
Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, he na waa maa kia Israel tena ɛa bonɔ kenɛ?
Waa aa doŋ mɛ le n Dea kaa bojaŋee ba ɛ la.
Hɛɛ na anɔ la maa kia kohonaa á ɡwaa anɔ kwara.” Asɛ o laɡ mɛ ba dembaah la doonyoa bela.
N nyiŋo dɛ na bɔɔ bɛl danjwɛɛ la ta.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, paɡri bɔɔ nɔ.” Maa paɡru la, n nao kɛŋɔ doonyoa bɛlee.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Jo dɛ́ ka na wedoŋa ne kwaa maa kia baa ɛa bela.” Ate, n jo dɛ ka na kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, ne ola maa kia bwa, Israel tena voɡa baa ɛa dɛɛ toma bwa dawɛ danjwɛɛre la bwa ta.
Dɛ Israel nomonome fifraanuanɛ lɔ bela, asɛ Safan bibaa Jaasania ja ba nɛ.
Ba bɛlbwa kpoŋe kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile a ta, chuu la sɔɔh do som dɛɛ kaa nyundua.
Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, he na waa Israel nomonome aa baa sɔh dɛɛ ɛ kenɛ?
Ba lɔ dea ba voɡa aa suu bini dɛɛ toma.
Waa baa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Korowii aa yaa na, o vɛh harɛ nɔ.’ ” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ na anɔ la maa kia kohona á ɡwaa anɔ.” Korowii berɔ laɡ mɛ ba o Dea la weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa la ta, asɛ n na haahna bane baa soɡa dɛɛ wi ba voɡ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Taamus la seo.
O berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, he na anɔ ɡe kenɛ?
Hɛɛ na anɔ la maa kia kohona á ɡwaa anɔ kwara.” O berɔ kpɔ mɛ ba o Dea la dembaah bela, doonyoa bela pato la ne kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la baah ta, dɛ baala fifraanɛ dɛ banue lɔ bela.
Ba habɔɔ chaɡɛ Korowii Dea la, asɛ ba sie chaɡɛ wee leebɔr pera baa tomɛ wee.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, he na anɔ kenɛ?
Juda tena dɛ ɛ waa maa kia la, a ɡbo ta ba ne maɡrɛ, ba berɔ kpɔ naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla perɛ bwɛɛre la bwa, dɛɛ muɡli n baah, dɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ kohona.
Mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee bandia ne, maa ba nɛɛ sune, maa ba bwaraa kpɔ kɛ ba.
Ba wio noo mɛ kohona noo, maa ba bee no.”
Voɡtoroma kpoora wa A habɔɔ la, Korowii kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah bwɛjen nɔ ba bonɔ, bɛlbwa kpɔ o dɔmkon kpoŋe.” Belaa n na baala banumɛl ba le Korowii Dea doonyoa o sie aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba, bɛlbwa kpoŋe dɔmkon.
Dɛ baa bɛl jao dɛ tɔ yapoŋ, asɛ kwaa waa kpɔa dɛɛ chwerɛ do o be.
Ba bwa baa jo Dea la bini dɛ ba che saraha kon baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛo jwɛh.
Belaa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la jirima le Kerobim la ta, bela o fa aa lole la, dɛ kaa Dea la doonyoa.
Korowii ŋɔ baa la waa tɔ yapoŋ asɛ kwaa waa kpɔ chwerɛ do o be la be ŋɔ, “Gaaɡe Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna, dɛ́ do nɛra baa na waa maa kia, asɛ baa wi dɛɛ di suna a waa la nso ba tili ta.” N taa dɛ no Korowii be la, o berɔ ŋɔ baala la ɡe be ŋɔ, “Hé teŋɛ o nɛɛ jo bwɛjen la bini, dɛ́ ka kpoo nɛra la.
He bɛ bɛlbwa ɡel, he bɛ tedoma dɔ tɛ bɛlbwa.
Hé kpoo banjeni, bonɔɔna ne toli, haahna ne bechale.
Kɛ he bɛ banɔ la baa do ba nso la te kpoo.
Hé pa mun le n Dea bonɔ.” Anomanta, ba pa mun le nomonome baa lɔ Korowii Dea la sie nɛ.
Korowii ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé pa nɛra haa kpoo ba la ba su n dembaah bela, dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kah n Dea la.
Hé kaa.” Anomanta, ba jo bwɛjen la bini, dɛ pa mun dɛɛ kpoo nɛra la.
Ba lɔ nɛŋkpoa la ta, asɛ a ka n ɡbo che.
Belaa n kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ do lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Oo!
Nemenɛ Korowii, amɔ he dɛ ba Israel tena baa kaa nɔ bwa kpoora, dii he baah aa dia Jerusalam tena nɛɛ kohona nɔ wa aa?” Korowii chaŋ mɛ ŋɔ, “Israel ne Juda tena wechɔɡa ɡwaalɔ kohona, nɛŋkpoa ɡboo harɛ la bwa, kasinteŋ toole Jerusalam kpa.
Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Korowii vɛh ya harɛ nɔ, waa yaa na.’ Anomanta, maa ba nɛɛ sune, maa ba bwaraa kpɔ kɛ ba, mɛɛ ɛɛ ba ɡɛ baa ɛ bane la.” Belaa baa la waa tɔ yapoŋ asɛ kwaa baa dɛ chwerɛ ane do o be la berɛ la ka ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “N kaa ɛ waa haa do mɛ a ta la tonɛ.”
Korowii jirima le o Dea la ta Men Ɛsekeɛl nyiŋi kon waa bɔle Kerobim la doa, dɛ na komɛl kɛŋɔ kookara baa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane aa ɛ burum baa yera safaaya ɛo.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ baa la waa tɔ yapoŋ la be ŋɔ, “La saaker nakpale aa lɔ Kerobim la lɔɡa la baah ta.
Pa ninhɔla he nɔɔra su, dɛ́ kpɔ merɛ bwɛjen la ta.” N taa cheɡa dɛɛ nyiŋu la, o kaa jo.
Dɛ Kerobim la cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ baa la ka jo bela.
Belaa bam ba tɔ Korowii Dea dembaah bela bwa.
Korowii jirima le Kerobim la ta, dɛ ba kaa Korowii Dea la doonyoa bela.
Bam baa tɔ dembaah bela, asɛ Korowii jirima chaah bela bwa.
Kerobim la kena dɛ si, dɛ nɛn lɔ dembaah la baŋ kwaraa naa, o dɛ no sii la.
A sii la do kɛŋɔ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la taa ken.
Korowii aa do baa la aa tɔ yapoŋ la ŋɔ, ó ka pa ninhɔla le saaker nakpale aa lɔ Kerobim la lɔɡa baah ta la, o kaa jo dɛ che saaker nakpale la bɛl jwɛh.
Belaa Kerobim la bɛl tɛr nɔn, dɛ kpɔ nii aa lɔ a baah ta la ane do baa la aa tɔ yapoŋ la nɔn ta, asɛ o lɛ dɛ kpɔ le kaa.
Kerobim la bɛlbwa kena lɔɡre la, kwaane do kɛŋɔ nɛn nɔɔra ken.
Men Ɛsekeɛl berɔ nyiŋi dɛ na saaker nakpale anaarɛ.
Beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa cheɡɛ Kerobim la jwɛh, dɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane baa dɛ yera kresolet ken.
He nyiŋi saaker nakpale la aa, anaarɛ la bwa le dɔŋa.
A do kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa berɔ su o dɔŋ ta ken.
Kerobim la dɛ kaa laa, a won baŋne anaarɛ a siebɔra la aa chaɡa la bɛlbwa kaala.
Saaker nakpale la aa sie berɛ.
Kerobim la bwara bwa, a habɔɔ ne nɔɔra dɛ a kena ta bwa dɔ sibie, ɡɛɛ a saaker nakpale anaarɛ la ɡe dɔ sibie.
N no taa bɛl wɛɛ yerɛ ŋɔ, “Saaker nakpale aa dɛ kile kɛŋɔ kawulewule.” Kerobim la bɛlbwa dɔ siebɔra anaarɛ.
Onla waa tɔ sie do kɛŋɔ nabal siebɔr, nɛɛte do kɛŋɔ nɛn siebɔr, toorote do kɛŋɔ nyujente siebɔr, naarɛte la ɡe do kɛŋɔ kee siebɔr.
Belaa Kerobim la ir kaa nyundua.
Anee hweera kwaa n fa aa naa Keba Moo la bɔr la.
Kerobim la dɛ kaa laa, a ne saaker nakpale laanee dɛɛ kaa.
A paɡri kena dɛɛ ba ira aa, a dɛ marɛ a nɛɛ a ne aa kaa.
Kerobim la cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ aa, dɛ saaker nakpale la ɡe cheɡɔ, Kerobim la iro dɛɛ kaa nyundua aa, a ne anee dɛɛ ir, dɛkalkɛ hweera kwaa la doma lɔ a nakpale la ta.
Ate, Korowii jirima le o Dea doonyoa bela dɛ ba che Kerobim la nyundua.
Maa nyiŋa la, n nao kɛ Kerobim la paɡri kena dɛ ir kaa nyundua, a ne saaker nakpale la.
A kaa che Korowii Dea wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, asɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la jirima tɔ a nɛ.
A ɡɛ hweera kwaa nɔɔ n fa na Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ jirima tɔ a nɛɛ Keba Moo la bɔr la.
Anee ɡela n jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ɛ Kerobim.
Bɛlbwa dɔ siebɔra anaarɛ ne kena anaarɛ.
A kena la bɛlbwa do kɛŋɔ nɛn nɔn aa lɔ o lɔɡa ken.
A siebɔra do kɛŋɔ anɔ la n fa aa naa Keba Moo la bɔr la.
Bɛlbwa pa sie dɛɛ kaa, aa a te berɛ.
Korowii pa Israel sitɔɔla bolchɔɡe Korowii Doma la ɡɔɔ men Ɛsekeɛl kaa nyundua, dɛ kpɔ mɛ ba Jerusalam Korowii Dea wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta.
Belaa n na baala fifraanɛ dɛ banue, dɛ Asuur bibaa Jaasania, ne Bɛnaya bibaa Pɛlatea baa ɛ Israel harɛ nomonome ja ba nɛ.
Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, baala nɔɔ dɔ liichɔɡa dɛɛ do nɛra baa ɛ wechɔɡa bwɛjen nɔ ta la.
Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Saŋ aa chɛ kɛ ya do deene ta telaa?
Bwɛjen nɔ do kɛŋɔ vii baa kpɔa dɛɛ daa kwa, asɛ ya ɡee ola aa lɔ o bini.’ Anomanta, Nɛwɛnyini bie, ból ba be, waa aa dɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala dɛ́ ba chɔɡ ba.” Korowii Doma la baa so n nɛ, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ ń bol Israel tena be ŋɔ, “N jemɛ waa haa dɛ bol, ne anɔ la haa dɛ vɔrɔwe bwa ɡe.
He kpoo nɛra bwɛjen nɔ ta warɛ ɡa, ba lala perɛ fɔɡbaahna bobɛlbwa.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Nɛra haa kpoo ba perɛ bobɛlbwa laanee ola la, asɛ bwɛjen nɔ ɡee vii la.
Kɛ mɛɛ doŋi heyaa le o ta.
He dɛ ɔmɛ laa, kɛ laalee mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta he nɛɛ bá kpoo heya.
Mɛɛ doŋi heyaa le bwɛjen nɔ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ heyaa do nɛŋhɔɔhra nɔn ta, dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne.
He ɡbaɡba harɛ taa baa ba heyaa kpoora laa ta, ásɛ nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Bwɛjen nɔ aa won lɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ ola lɔ vii bini aa, o yon tɔ a nɛɛ la.
Israel harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa haa ka do bwa, mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii, dɛkalkɛ he ta me Mmarare ne n waa ta teŋɛ, dɛ kaa teŋɛ harɛre aa bar heyaa cheme nɔ tena mmarare ta.’ ” N nyoa taa lɔ waa aa dɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala ta mɛɛ bol la, Bɛnaya bibaa Pɛlatea den chole sewɛ.
Belaa n kpɔ sie pi harɛ, dɛ do lɔŋɔ lokua ne kohona ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, amɔ he dɛ ba nɛra baa ka Israel harɛ bwa chɔɡa kwaraa kɛɛ?” Korowii berɔ bol waa n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, nɛra baa soɡe Jerusalam dɛ bol he ne he bala Israel tena baa lawɛ heyaa laa ta kaa harɛfale ta la waa ŋɔ, ‘Nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa Babelɔn la ne men Korowii baah jaŋne kɛŋɔ ba won tom mɛ, dɛ ŋɔ banee Israel harɛ la ɛ ba kon.’ ” Korowii baɡɛ Israel tena nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ba ba nee Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bol he bala baa lawɛ he ne ban kaa harɛfala ta la be ŋɔ, ‘Menee ɡela ba laɡ ba kaa bojaŋa, ba lɔ peɡre harɛre ane ta la.
Kɛ taraken nɔ, mɛɛ ja ba nɛɛ harɛre baa lɔ a ta la ta.’ Berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ boa ba nyoa le harɛre maa lɔ ba peɡre a ta la taa, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ Israel harɛ la tɛɛ ba ja.’ Baa berɔ ba, dɛ́ ba laa voɡdoŋa maa kia bwa kpɔ le harɛ la ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba bambile che bobeŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba liifala.
Mɛɛ laa ba bambikpeɡ waa do kɛŋɔ bwe laanee kpɔ, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba bambile waa pwɛra.
Ásɛ baa teŋɛ me Mmarare ne n waa ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Mɛɛ kpɔ baa ɛ n nɛra, ásɛ n ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ.
Kɛ banɔ la ba bambili taa lɔ kondoŋa ne voɡa maa kia ta la te, mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋne a waa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Kerobim la paɡri a kena dɛ ir, asɛ saaker nakpale la ja a nɛ, asɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la jirima chaah kohona dɛ tɔ a nɛ.
Korowii jirima le bwɛjen la ta, dɛ kaa bwejen bɛl waa lɔ o wee leebɔr doa.
Wepila la ta la, Korowii Doma la kpɔ mɛ ir ba n bala baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfale ta Babelɔn la be.
Belaa wepila la ba a jaɡa, asɛ n bol wobɛlbwa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡ mɛ la chaɡle n bala la.
Ɛsekeɛl kaa ɛ o te kɛŋɔ hɔɔh harɛfale ta Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, deŋnekpeɡ tena binii he so la.
Ba dɔ sibie kɛ baa na, dɛ dɔ deŋna ɡe kɛ baa waa no, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena.
Nɛwɛnyini bie, ɛ dɛ́ pa he laala bwa webaŋa nomɛlbwa siwi ta.
Le bela kaa kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ dɛɛ kaa harɛfale ta he ka ɛ hɔɔh ken.
Ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ nɛra te, kɛ ba ken ɛɛ no a munii.
Pa he laala webaŋa ba siwi ta, ásɛ jɔmɔra ɡe he le dɛ́ɛ kaa ba bwa siwi ta, kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ dɛɛ kaa harɛfale ta la.
Forɛ bɔɔ he danjwɛɛ ta ba siwi ta, dɛ́ che bela pa he laala le.
Bɔr aa dɛɛ jo la, dawɛ he laala la vam ta ba siwi ta, ásɛ dɛ le kaa.
Kpɔ kon tɔ sie, dɛ bɛ harɛ haa dɛ kaa o ta la na.
Gɛ haa ɛ laanee dɛ́ baɡle Israel tena wa.” Anomanta, n ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do mɛ la.
Bɔr aa chaahna la, n do n bone dɛ kpɔ le kɛ nɛn baa lawɔ dɛɛ kaa harɛfale ta la.
Bɔr aa dɛ jo la, n kpɔ nɔɔra forɛ bɔɔ danjwɛɛ la ɡe ta, dɛ kpɔ n bone dawɛ n vam ta nɛra la bwa siwi ta dɛ le kaa.
Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, Korowii bol waa n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, taraken Israel tena deŋnekpeɡ nɛra aa dɛ bɔɔre waa haa dɛ ɛ nɔ, ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘N waa nɔ ɛ Jerusalam kooro ne Israel tena bwa baa lɔ bela wa.’ Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Gɛ maa ɛa nɔ dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba ba ɛɛ.’ Baa laɡ ba laa taa kaa harɛfale ta.
Kooro waa lɔ bela la ɛɛ kpɔ o bonee dawɛ vam ta jɔmɔra.
Baa forɛ bɔɔ danjwɛɛ taa ó kpɔ o ta le kaa.
Wɛɛ kpɔ konee tɔ sie dɛ bɛ harɛ na.
Mɛɛ ta asawii dɛ́ lawɔ, dɛ́ kpɔɔ kaa bwɛjen Babelɔn ta waa wola belaa na dɛ́ sewɛ bela.
Mɛɛ lɔ o nomonome ne o laa tena bwaa peɡre bobɛlbwa, ásɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra teŋɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba.
Dɛ n laɡ ba kaa harɛfala ta dɛ lɔ ba peɡre harɛre ta naa, a taa baa ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Mɛɛ ɡel ba bini tama banee ba bɛ laa ne lɔr dɛ weechɔɡa nyoa ka, ásɛ dɛ ka lii waa maa kia ba ɛa la harɛre baa chwaa kaa a ta la ta.
Ásɛ dɛ che a ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kpɔ bochela di kondikwa, dɛ́ nyɔ nee ɔmee ne sibeɡra ne.
Ŋɔ harɛ la ta nɛra be ŋɔ, ‘Men Nemenɛ Korowii dɛ bol nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam ne Israel harɛ la ta nɛra be kɛŋɔ, báa di kwaa bochela nee, dɛ́ nyɔ nee ɔmee ne sibeɡra ne.
Harɛ la bwa dɛ ba chɔɡa dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ, deŋnekpeɡ ne naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla aa lɔ bela la wa.
Bwɛjena nɛra aa su a ta bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, sɛɡla Israel tena aa dɛ sɛɡle ŋɔ, ‘A dɛ biɡri, yaa wepila Korowii keamere aa dɛ baɡle ŋɔ aa bao la ɡe na.’ Ŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowii bol a waa ŋɔ o dɛ ba ɡela sɛɡla la ba a jaɡa, baa ɡɛ waa laanee bol Israel harɛ ta kpa.
Gel ba no kɛŋɔ waa baa naa wepila ta la bɛlbwa telo tonɛ.
Wepila aa ɛ nyosone aa lee do kpa, kɛɛ nyosonwaa baa dɛ bola ŋɔ, aa bao kerekere aa Israel harɛ taa do kpa.
Men Korowii te, n bol wa aa, aa biɡri dɛ́ ba.
Saŋ he deŋnekpeɡ tena nɔ aa lole nɔ taa mɛɛ bola dɛ́ ɛa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Israel tena ta dɛ bol kɛŋɔ wepila haa naa ne waa haa bola ŋɔ aa bao la, fini laa, kerekere waa.
Anomanta, ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Wobɛlbwa aa le n nyoa la aa biɡri kpa, a bwa ɛɛ bao.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ”
Keame nyosonteŋna pwaeh Korowii berɔ bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kah Israel keamere baa kpɔ ba ɡbabir liire dɛɛ bol waa aa dɛ ba bala la.
Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá cheɡ deŋne, dɛ́ no waa maa dɛ bol.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Keame ɡɛna la bwɛɛlɛ.
Ba cheɡɛ ba ɡbaɡba wejema ta, dɛ ŋɔ ba dɛ na chaahna, dɛ ba ta wobɛlbwa nae.
Israel tena, he keamere la do kɛŋɔ dimɡbia kalampoŋare ken.
Baa sie do danjwɛɛre aa peɡra la ta, dɛ́ kwaara, ásɛ dɛ laa dɛ ba naa, ba won lɛ Israel ta, dɛ́ won che Korowii Tɔpere La nyoa.
Ba wepila ne ba nyosonwaa baa ŋɔa aa bao kerekere la bwa ɛ nyosone, ba ŋɔ men Korowiirii bola, dɛ n laa tom ba, dɛ ta ɛɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ anɔ la baa bola la ɛɛ ɛo.
N ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘He wepila haa naa la bwa ɛ nyosone, asɛ waa haa ŋɔa aa bao la ɡe ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ.
