He ŋɔ, men Korowiirii pila dɛɛ baɡle heya, dɛ n ɡe laa bola.’ ” Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “He dɛ neɡre nɛra, he waa ha ŋɔa aa bao ne he wepila la ɛ nyosone, n ne he dɔɔ.
Mɛɛ tɛr he keamere haa ŋɔa he dɛ na wepila ne waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere a ɛ nyosone la deŋnee.
Haa n nɛra Israel tena nɛɛ ja, kɛɛ bá chwerɛ he sɔna ja ba nɛ.
He bɛlbwa nakpala aa Israel harɛ taa tire kpa.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Nemenɛ Korowii.
Keamere la tɔ n nɛra sie dɛ ɡel baa nyoɡre.
Ba ŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna lole, dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ɡe toole bobɛlbwa.
N nɛra ma danjwɛɛ waa wola kpeɡe, asɛ keamere la kpɔ fula lɔɔ.
Ŋɔ keamechɔɡa la be ŋɔ, ba danjwɛɛ la dɛ ba chola.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo bwaala nɛ kohona, dombwea lee o ta, ásɛ peukpeɡ ta kohona lɔɔ.
Danjwɛɛ la baa chole aa, nɛra ɛɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ, fula baa kpɔa lɔ danjwɛɛ la munii ɛrɔɔ?” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ o baah diu wɛɛ ba ɡela peukpeɡ ta, ásɛ bwaala nɛ kohona dombwea lee, dɛ́ chɔɡ danjwɛɛ la.
O ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ taɡɛ danjwɛɛ baa lɔɔ fula laanee ta ó bwa chɔ harɛ, ásɛ bwea baa kpɔa pa o mun la chɔ baŋ.
Waa ba chole la, he bwa ɡe dɛ ba serewa.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Danjwɛɛ la ne nɛra baa kpɔ fula lɔɔ la nɛɛ mɛɛ ba n bandia ne bala, dɛ́ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Danjwɛɛ la kuuɡo, ɡɛɛ nɛra baa lɔɔ fula la ɡe aa wola lee do kpa.
Israel harɛ keamere la ŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna lɔ Jerusalam, kɛ dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ɡe toole.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, eɡle sie ta haahna baa cheɡɛ ba ɡbaɡba liire ta dɛɛ bol waa aa dɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala kerekere la nɛ, kah ba, dɛ ŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Haahna haa nyarɛ sɛmbɛ kwaa dɛɛ do nɔɔra, ne sɛmbɛ botini haa nyara dɛɛ bɔle nyuune la, hé bwɛɛlɛ.
He dɛ nyin kɛ he dɔ seo ne mkpa kpeɡri n nɛra Israel tena nɛ, dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ dɔ he te.
He chɔɡ mɛ dɛɛ tɛ n nɛra, dɛ lɛ mea nɔndela tama ne paanoo tama dɛɛ le ba be.
Dɛ teŋe nyosone dɛɛ kpoo nɛra baa wola chɛ kɛ he kpoo, dɛɛ ɡel banɔ la baa chɛ kpoora.
Gɛɛ he teŋe nyosone dɛɛ tɛ n nɛra asɛ baa yarada he wa.’ Men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘N hah he sɛmbɛre haa doa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lawɛ nɛra kɛŋɔ jumbii la.
Mɛɛ chaara le he nɔɔra ta, ásɛ dɛ ɡel n nɛra haa laɡ ba kɛ jumbii la dɔ ba te.
Mɛɛ wur he sɛmbɛ botini laanee ta, dɛ́ lɛ n nɛra le he nɔn ta, ásɛ ba le he bela la ta kwaraa.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
He nyosone la chɔɡ nɛndɛɛɡa liire, ɡɛ n fe aa wola nyin kɛ ba do.
He dɛ do nɛnchɔɡa ɡbemba ba bɛ ba liire charɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu.
Haa wepila ne nyosonwaa aa dɛ ba bala laanee na kpa.
Mɛɛ lɛ n nɛraa le he nɔn ta, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ”
Korowii voɡtoroma chɔɡa Israel nomonome la bane ba men Ɛsekeɛl be, dɛ ba bɔɔ mɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin.
Belaa Korowii bol waa n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, baala nɔ bambile cheɡɛ voɡa ta aa kaa ba ne wechɔɡa ta.
Ba dɛ lii kɛ mɛɛ chaŋ baa kɛɛ?
Anomanta, ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, kenii men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Israel te bɛlbwa o bambile aa cheɡɛ voɡa ta, aa kaa o ne wechɔɡa ta la, o ba n keame be dɛɛ nyin waane dɛ́ no aa, men Korowiirii dɛɛ ba baɡla ɡɛ maa dɛ ba o voɡa la ɛɛ.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ Israel tena bwa baa vɛɛh mɛ dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa la, ásɛ ba berɛ ba n be.’ Anomanta, ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ‘Men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ bá charɛ ba liire le voɡa ne kwaa maa kia baa toma la ta, dɛ́ berɛ ba n be.
Dɛ Israel te bɛlbwa kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa waa soɡe Israel tena bini berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ dɛ kpɔ voɡa toma che o bambile ta, dɛ ir la n keame be, dɛ́ ka bɔɔ dɛ́ jemɛ waa maa dɛ ba ɛɛ yaa, n ɡbaɡbaa dɛ́ chaŋe naate waa tɛo.
N siwi ɛɛ beɡre naate nɛɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa che a ta dɛ́ hweli wa.
Mɛɛ pere naatee le n nɛra Israel tena bini.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
N keame bɛlbwa baa neɡro o bol waane la, dɛ men Korowiirii neɡro o bol.
N nɔn dawɛ naate nɛ, mɛɛ chɔɡo le Israel tena bini.
Naate waa la ɡɛ keame la be la ne keame la bwa di bolchɔɡe, mɛɛ tɛr ba bwa deŋnee.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel Israel tena berɛ ba n be, dɛ́ ɡel wechɔɡa ta teŋa, dɛ bɛ doŋa kpɔ kah ba te.
Baa ɛɛ n nɛraa, ásɛ n ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ” Nomɛlbwa aa Korowii bole pae nyoa le Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, dɛ harɛ bɛl tena waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ mɛ dɛɛ ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa aa, mɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee dawɛ ba nɛ, dɛ́ tɔ ba kondikwaa ŋwɛnɛ.
Lɔr chole ba nɛ, ásɛ nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa serewe.
Hale dɛ Nowa ne Danɛl dɛ Job ba wa aa toɡra la kwaraa lɔ bela aa, ba wedɛɛɡa la aa won lɛ nomɛlbwa, atane ba ɡbo.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Kɛɛ dɛ n kpɔ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ba harɛ la ta, a ba kpoo nɛra baa lɔ o ta o chɔ pɛɛ, a ɡel nɛra ɛɛ ɔmɛ o ta kpɔe yaa, hale dɛ ɡɛ baala batoro nɔ lɔ harɛ la ta naa, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, baa won lɛ ba bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna nyu.
Ba ɡbosoroo dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu, kɛ harɛ la te bwa ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ.
Kɛɛ dɛ n kpɔ laa tena ba harɛ la ta tena nɛ, ba kpɔ dɔmkwaa ba kpoo nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa le o ta, hale dɛ baala batoro la lɔ o ta kwaraa naa, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, baa won lɛ ba bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna nyu.
Ba ɡbosoroo dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu.
Kɛɛ dɛ n kpɔ weechɔɡa ta ba harɛ la ta, dɛ kpɔ bandia kohona kpoo nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa, hale dɛ Nowa ne Daneɛl dɛ Job lɔ bela kwaraa naa, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, baa wona ba dɛ́ lɛ ba bibaala kɛɛ bihaahna.
Ba ɡboo dɛ́ won dɔ ba nyu ba wedɛɛɡa wa.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Webele anaarɛ aa wola weree mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba tɛr Jerusalam tena deŋne.
Laa ne lɔr ne kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa dɛ weechɔɡaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba kpoo nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa.
Ane a bwa, ba bini bane ɛɛ kao, bibaala ne bihaahna ɛɛ le o taa ba hen Ɛsekeɛl be.
Hɛɛ na ba daa, ne ba we-ɛɛla, dɛ́ dɔ bolarawa le wenaale maa kpɔa ba ta Jerusalam tena nɛɛ la ta.
Hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ aŋwɛnɛ taa n ɛɛ ba ɡɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Grepo da bɛl sɛɡla wa Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bɔkwaa ɡrepo da kpale kpɔ ɡwaa daa aa lɔ kɔr bini bɛlbwa kpale ɔ?
Baa wono kpɔ ɛ komɛl a maɡre aa?
Hɛɛ wono kpɔ pa, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa saɡɛ o ta naa?
Dɛ ba kpɔɔ do nii ta o nyoo la fuh, o kabora la ta fueh chiɡ aa, o wer tɛ waane ja aa?
O fa aa ɛ bir la, dɛ waa were tɛ komɛlbwa naa, bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ baa doo nii ta o nyoo la fuh, o kabora la ta fueh chiɡ la, ó berɛ dɔ jaɔ?” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ maa kpɔ ɡrepo da le kɔr bini daa bwa bini do nii ta o fuh la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam ɛɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee.
Ba le nii ane nyoa te, nii la ɛɛ berɔ fuuh ba.
Maa ba tɛr ba deŋne la, anee he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ mɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Jerusalam tena le Korowii habɔɔ Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ɡel Jerusalam tena jemɛ kii waa baa ɛa.
Ŋɔ waa men Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol Jerusalam tena be laanee nɔ, ‘Keenan harɛ taa ba lolɛ he naawa.
Amɔre tee he nabaa, asɛ Hiti tee he nya.
Awola baa lolɛ la, bɛlbwa ta he ul teŋe, kɛɛ dɛ sɔe nee he bwara doŋa le he nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ yal fɔrɔwe.
Nomɛlbwa ta tedoma dɔe tɛɛ, dɛ́ ɛɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bini bɛlbwa.
Kpɔɡ binii ba kpɔe ka ta, dɛkalkɛ awola baa lolɛ la bwaa ba haeh.
Belaa n teŋe baa kaa dɛ nae kɛ haa chɔ chal ta dɛɛ ta nakpale.
He taa chɔ chal ta bela la, n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, dɔ́ he nyu dɛ́ so.
N nyiŋi he nɛɛ dɛ ɡel he kpeɡ kɛŋɔ kon baa duu koo ta ken.
He kpeɡo dɛ do jaŋne dɛ do kpeɡri dɛ su haah.
He ela cheɡɛ chiŋ kɛrɛdɛ, he dɔ nyumpona kohona, kɛ dɛ komɛlbwa ta he nɛɛ tɔe hɛɛ valɛ mumɡbal.
A habɔɔ n berɔ fɛrɛ ba kaa, dɛ na kɛŋɔ namete he kpeɡo kohona kɛŋɔ he yalɛ, asɛ n paɡri n yal nyoa tɔ he nɛ, he ta mumɡbal cheɡɛ kpa.
N ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡle asɛ n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo he berɛ n haah.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
N sɔe ne he chal la bwa le, dɛ fɔɡle noorare.
Batakaare baa sɔh kwaa dawɛ o ta ne oltɔn naŋɡawadɛɛɡaa n kpɔ doe, dɛ kpɔ yapondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa tɔe.
N kpɔ suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa ne baŋa kwaa bwa doe.
N kpɔ noniseɡ do he mee ta, dɛ doe deŋna kwa, dɛ kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ waa wera pii.
Gɛɛ a do n kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa kwaa ɛɛ.
Yapondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ba sɔh kwaa dawɛ a ta ɛ he yale.
Mendɛɛɡa baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ ne tooh, dɛ ɔleve noo ɛ he kondikwa.
He kpeɡo dɛ do wer kohona, dɛ ba ɛ haŋkooro.
He wer kohona la nomanta, he lɛ sɔn harɛre bwa ta, dɛkalkɛ menee ɡela he do wer ka tonɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Kɛ he teŋɛ he wer kohona ne he nyanyini ta dɛɛ bɔ jwamane.
Nomɛlbwa teŋo baa kaa dɛ he ne o kaa chɔ.
He kpɔ he laala la ane ka kwaa bela nɛra aa chema dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa.
Belaa he bɔ jwamane la.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ, kɛɛ a chiɡ kwara.
He berɔ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa kwaa maa kpɔa tɛɛ la loɡɛ voɡbaala dɛɛ toma dɛɛ bɔ jwamane.
He kpɔ he yale baa sɔh kwaa dawɛ a ta la bɔla, dɛ kpɔ noo ne daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma n kpɔ tɛɛ la tɛa.
He berɔ kpɔ men baa nama a kper kɛrɛdɛ ne ɔleve no, dɛ tohnoo maa kpɔa tɛɛ ŋɔ hé di la ɛ saraha tɛa a sie lɛ he nɛ.
Gɛɛ a ɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
He lawɛ he bibaala ne bihaahna haa lol ba tɛ mɛ la, dɛ kpoo ba ɛ saraha tɛ voɡa.
He jwamane la ɡbo ta maɡraa?
He kpoo n bii dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ saraha tɛ voɡa.
Haa lɔ waa maa kia ne jwamane ta la, he ta ɡɛ haa doa he bechale saŋ liire.
Gɛ saŋ haa chɔ mumɡbal chal ta dɛɛ ta nakpale la.
Bwɛɛlɛ!
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Anɔ la haa bera ɛ ja he wechɔɡa ta laanee kɛŋɔ, he ta pwe, dɛ ma voɡ o do jaŋne chɔŋɛ o ta, o che fɔɡbaah nɛra bwa siwi ta.
Fɔɡbaahna bwa taa he ma voɡa chɔŋɛ pwee ta, dɛ kpɔ chɔɡ he wer haa doa.
He kpɔ he te dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa waa teŋa baa kaa, dɛ na teŋɛ dɛɛ bɔ jwamane kohona.
He ne Ijipt tena haa do jwɛh bwaa dɛɛ bɔ jwamane he ne baa chɔ.
Ba ɛ nɛra jwamanwa aa dɛ lɛ ba sie kohona.
He kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ muɡli n baah.
Anomanta, n nɔn dawɛ he nɛ, n lɛ he harɛ maa sweera dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ la pera, asɛ dɛ kpɔe do he dɔma Filisti tena baa hah waa haa dɛ ɛ nɔ nɔn ta.
He ɡarɔ bɔ jwamane Asiiria tena bini ɡe, a bwa habɔɔ kwaraa la, a ta he ne maɡrɛ.
He teŋɔ kpɔ he jwamanwe-ɛɛla la kaa Babelɔn tena harɛ ta ɡe.
Ba bwa ɛ bonadiire, hale anɔ bwa habɔɔ a ta he ne maɡrɛ.’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Na ɡɛ haa wola liidɛɛɡa dɔe.
He we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ hanjwamane waa wola sihiih bɛlbwa jemɛ ken.
Haa ta pweeri fɔɡbaahna dɛ kpɔ he voɡa chɔŋɛ a ta nɛra bwa siwi ta dɛɛ bɔ jwamane nomanta, he waane laa suuɡa wa kwara.
He do kɛ haah waa le o jaa habɔɔ.
He dɛ nyin hɔɔhra ɡwaa he jaa.
Hanjwamane bɛlbwa dɛ lɛ suuɡa, kɛ he te kpɔ kwaa dɛɛ kɛ baala baa dɛ nyini dɛɛ yaɡ ba sen, asɛ ba le bobɛlbwa ba he be, he ne baa chɔ.
Anomanta, he cheɡɛ he jwamanwe-ɛɛla ta he waa korɛ he bala bini.
Nomɛlbwa aa he nɛɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin komɛl.
He ɛ nomɛl haa dena korɛ kwaraa, he dɛ tɛ nɛra suuɡa, kɛ baa he te tɛ.
Anomanta, Jerusalam, he do kɛ hanjwamane.
Dɛ́ɛ no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be.
Kenii men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ bol, ‘Haa pa he kondɔɔh ta, dɛ che mumɡbal kɛŋɔ hanjwamane, dɛ kpɔ he te tɛ baala dɛ tomɛ voɡa maa kia, dɛ kpoo he bii ɛ saraha tɛa la nomanta, n dɛ yerɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyini he kpɔ he te tɛɛ ba la bwa cheme.
Nɛra haa dɛ nyin ne banɔ la haa hah ba bwa, ásɛ n foo he yale ba siwi ta he che mumɡbal ba baah ta.
Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee kɛ haahna baa dɛ le ba jaranar habɔɔ, dɛɛ kpoo nɛra la ken.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia kohonaa ba ta he nɛ, dɛ́ kpoe bɔ kem.
Ásɛ dɛ lawɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyini la, ásɛ ba chɔɡ pweeri ne he voɡjaŋa la bwa.
Baa laa he laala bwaa wur he bwara ta, dɛ laa he suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa ne baŋa kwaa aa wera la kpɔ, he che mumɡbal.
A ɡɛ nɛra la ɛɛ kpɔ nɛnlaalee ba ta he nɛ, ásɛ ba foɡre bwea, dɛ́ kpɔ keri chɛwɛ.
Baa fuh he deenee, dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne haahna baa wara siwi ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he jwamane la bwa ba a jaɡa, haa won dɛɛ tɛ nɛra haa dɛ nyin ba la suuɡa kpa.
Mɔɔ n bandia kohona la nyoa sɔɔh, ásɛ meera maa dɛ mee n baah di la le he nɛ, n bambilee ɛɛ sɔɔhnoo n baah aa wola di kpa.
He ta ɡɛ maa ɛɛ he toli saŋ la liire, dɛ ka ɛ waa maa kia nɔ bwa, dɛ ir n bandia, a waa mɛɛ ba he deŋne tɛra la.
Ɛrɛɛ he berɛ kpɔ jwamane ja waa maa kia la bwa ta nɔɔ?
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛra ɛɛ kpɔ ɡɛ sɛɡlaa dɛɛ bol he waa ŋɔ, ‘Jerusalam, ɡɛ nya aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o bihaah ɡe do.’ He ɛ he nya bihaah kpela, o vɛh o jaa ne bii.
He ɛ he nahaahnanar nime kpela, ba ɡe vɛh ba jaranar ne bii.
He ne bwɛjena aa bare la do kɛŋɔ nyabii.
He nya ɛ Hiti te, he mɛɛ ɛ Amɔre te.
He nahaahnee Samaria, o ne o bihaahna so he weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
He nime bihaah ɡee Sodom, o ne o bihaahna so he weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Ba da ɡbo laa he kpɔ, asɛ dɛ hweli ba waa maa kia la ɡe dɛ ɛa.
Kɛ he we-ɛɛla bwa ta la, a ta biɡre he den ɡwaa ba kwaraa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, n ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, ‘He nime Sodom ne o bihaahna ta wechɔɡa he ne he bihaahna aa ɛa nɔ dɔŋa ɛɛ.
Wechɔɡa he nime Sodom aa dɛ ɛ laanee nɔ.
O ne o bihaahna dɔ mbarafo, ba dɔɔ kohona dɛɛ di ba waane laa nomɛlbwa wa.
Ba ta nyaara ne nɛra aa hiah ba chae.
Ba ɛ mbarafo dɛ ɛ waa maa kia n siwi ta, a waa n chɔɡ ba ɡɛ he na la.
He wechɔɡa haa ɛa la, Samaria ta a dɔŋa ɛɛ.
He ɛ waa maa kia kohona ɡwaa ba, he nime ne he nahaah waa toɡrɔ ɡwaale.
He ne he sihiih so, he ɡelɔ he nimanar waa do wer ɡwaale, dɛkalkɛ he wechɔɡa kan ɡwaa ba kwa.
A do kɛŋɔ ba waa toɡrɔ kɛrɛdɛ ɡwaale.
Sihiih kpoe, he di ncho, he nimanar waa berɔ toɡre ɡwaale.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “Jerusalam tena, mɛɛ ɡeloo he na som, mɛɛ berɔ ɡel Sodom ne Samaria tena ɡe na som, dɛ́ ja he nɛ.
Hɛɛ di sihiih waa haa ɛa la wa, ásɛ ba che a ta dɔ bolarawa.
He nime Sodom ne o bihaahna, ne he nahaah Samaria ɡe ne o bihaahna bwa ɛɛ berɔ kaa bela ba fa aa lole, ásɛ he ɡe ne he bihaahna berɛ kaa bela he fa aa lole.
He fa aa dɔa dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo la, dɛ haa he nime Sodom komɛlbwa yerɛ, mɔɔ he wechɔɡa la bwa le baŋ.
He berɔ do kɛ on, hale Edom ne Filisti bihaahna bwa, dɛ nɛra baa soɡa bare bwa, dɛ haeh.
He jwamanwe-ɛɛla ne waa maa kia he ɛ la bwa ɛɛ ɡure he nyu taa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Gɛ bwa aa chɛ kɛ n kpɔ ɛɛ laanee mɛɛ ba kpɔe ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ he vɛh nyoa haa baɡ mɛ, dɛ chɔɡ n ne he fɔo la.
Kɛ mɛɛ lii fɔo n ne haa fɔwa he toli saŋ laanee, ásɛ n ne he berɛ fɔwɛ fɔo waa do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
He baa lii waa he fa aa lɔ a ta la aa, sihiih ɛɛ kpoe.
Maa kpɔ he nimanar ne he nahaahnanar ba tɛɛ bá do kɛ bihaahna tɛɛ la, ate ta fɔo n ne haa fɔwa la ta jae.
Gɛ taa aa ba cheɡa n ɡel n ne he fɔo la che, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Mɛɛ kpɔ waa haa ɛa bwaa kɛɛ, kɛ hɛɛ ba liiraa, ásɛ sihiih kpoe kohona he pili nyoa kahonɛ.” Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Kee anɛ ne ɡrepo da sɛɡla wa Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ka sɛɡle Israel tena dɛ ɡel ba jemɛ kɛ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Keejen bɛl o kena aa kpeɡa, o pona do jaŋne dɛ do wer iro ba Lɛbanɔn, dɛ ba lawɛ peleme daa kpale waa pama kaa nyundua dɛ kuu, dɛ kpɔ kaa bonadiire harɛ ta dɛ ka chɔɔro o bwɛjen bɛl ta.
O kpɔ Israel harɛ ta konduuli bii ka du harɛdɛɛɡe bɛl ta.
O duu kɛŋɔ nee nyoa da, bela nee aa lole kohona.
O leɔ dɛ pi harɛ kɛŋɔ ɡrepo da.
O kpala la kaa nyundua dɛ chaɡɛ kee la nɛ, asɛ o lune te kaa harɛ bini.
O ta kpala dɛ moɡɛ papooni.
Dɛ keejen bɛl ɡe lole o kena do kpeɡri, o pona jaŋne dɛ do wer.
Grepo daa la lune tɛrɔ kpɔ harɛ bini kaa kee la be, dɛ berɛ tɛr o kpala ɡe kaa o be dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ nee le o be.
Harɛdɛɛɡe taa ba duu, o che bela nee aa lole kohona, ó won ta kpala dɛ nɔnɛ dɛ́ do wer kɛrɛdɛ.’ Bɔɔ ba ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Grepo daa la ɛɛ won kpeɡ kɛrɛdɛ aa?
Kee waa tɔ sie la aa on fuɡri ta, dɛ chaa o nɔna, dɛ kuuɡi o kpala o bwa hol aa?
A ta bokpeɡa kohona kɛɛ nɛra baa wara hiaih mɔɔ dɛ fuɡru ta.
Hale ba fuɡru ka chɔɔ bofale aa, wɛɛ won kpeɡ dɛ́ do wer ja aa?
Dɛ wee leebɔr peuwɔb tao waa, wɛɛ sewɔɔ dɛ den hol che harɛ la ta bela.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Bɔɔ deŋnekpeɡ tena la ba baɡle sɛɡla la mun.” Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Babelɔn kooro la Jerusalam, dɛ ka lawɛ bela kooro ne o nomonjena, dɛ kaa ba ne Babelɔn.
O lawɛ koodem nɛra la bɛl o ne o fɔwɛ fɔo, asɛ Babelɔn kooro ŋwɛɛ baɡlo, dɛ berɛ lawɛ nomonome baa chɔ harɛ la nyoa ɡe ja kaa, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ harɛ la mule, dɛ bɛ won kaa sie kpa, ásɛ a che o ne o fɔo la ɡbo ta mɔɔ ó berɛ won che.
Kɛ Juda kooro la ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ ŋɔ waa won do Babelɔn kooro lɔɡa, asɛ o tomɛ toroma Ijipt harɛ ba ka kpɔ jaɡre ne laa tena baa wara ba.
Aa won maɡre tɛo waa?
Wɛɛ won le a nyoa aa?
Wɛɛ won chɔɡ o ne o baah fɔo la waa wola deŋnetɛraa dɔ aa?
Men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ, Babelɔn belaa Jerusalam kooro Babelɔn kooro aa cheɡo kora ta la ɛɛ ba sewa.
O ta ŋwɛɛra waa ŋwɛɛra la ne fɔo baa fɔwa la ta teŋɛ.
Ijipt kooro ne o laa tena baa wara dɛ do kpeɡri, dɛ jemɛ yoi kohona la aa won chao laa ta, ɡɛ saŋ o laa tena aa ba ma teera sawɛ bwɛjen la danjwɛɛre, dɛ́ che a ta kpoo nɛra kohona la.
Kooro la ŋwɛɛra waa ŋwɛɛra ne fɔo o ne Babelɔn kooro aa fɔwa la, o ta a ta teŋɛ.
Anɔ waa ɛa nɔ bwa ɡelɔ waa won le a nyoa.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛ n taa lole nɔ, mɛɛ tɛr o deŋnee, chɔɡa waa chɔɡ n ne o fɔo ne ŋwɛɛra waa ŋwɛɛra baɡ mɛ la wa.
Mɛɛ harɔɔ belii dɛ́ lawɔ.
Mɛɛ lawɔ kaa Babelɔn, dɛ́ tɛr o deŋne bela, dɛkalkɛ o le n habɔɔ.
Baa kpoo o laa tena baa chwaa dɛɛ kaa bwa laa taa, ba bini banɔ la baa ka la peɡre kaa bobɛlbwa.
Asɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii bola.” Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “N ɡbabir ɛɛ ku peleme daa la kpale waa kaa nyunduaa ásɛ dɛ ka chɔɔro.
O kpale waa pama dɛ do o nyundujaɡlaa mɛɛ ba kui ka chɔɔ bwejen doa.
Israel bwejen doaa mɛɛ ba o chɔɔra.
Wɛɛ ta kpalaa, dɛ́ do wer dɛ́ nɔnɛ.
Jumbii bwa soo siwi ba sɔh a kɔne bela, dɛ́ so o chunchule ta.
Daa aa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ men Korowii, n ɡelɔ daa waa do jaŋne mule, dɛ ɡel daa waa mula do jaŋne.
N ɡelɔ da-lwɛɛ hol, asɛ daa waa hola moɡɛ papooni dɛ do wer.
Men Korowiirii bola, mɛɛ ɛo.”
Nɛn waa ɛ wechɔɡa laanee dɛ́ sewɛ Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii sɛɡla haa dɛ sɛɡle Israel harɛ ta ŋɔ, ‘Nya ne mɛɛ di ɡrepo nɔnnyɛɡa, asɛ ba bii nyena nyɛɡ nɔɔ?’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ n taa lole nɔ, haa ɡɛ sɛɡla nɔɔ sɛɡle Israel harɛ ta kpa.
Nɛwɛnyina bwa nyu lɔ n nɔn ta, mɛɛ kɛɛ bie bwa nyu lɔ n nɔn ta.
Naate waa ɛ wechɔɡa la, naatee dɛ́ sewɛ.
Dɛ nomɛl we-ɛɛla toɡrɔ wɛɛ ɛ waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ o waa do wer, waa kwaa Israel tena aa kpoora dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡa bwejena dor la di, waa ba voɡa ɡe tomɛ, kɛɛ waa o dɔŋ haah lawɛ dɛɛ chɔ, waa haah waa le dahara nyin, waa nomɛlbwa fiiɡi, o berɛ nomɛlbwa kon waa lɛa cheɡ mɔɔ dɛ kemɔ suuɡa la dɛɛ tɛo.
Waa ŋwɛ, lɔr dɛ kpo nɛn aa, o dɛ tɛo kwaa wɛɛ di, nomɛlbwa waa wola yal dɔe la, o dɛ tɛo.
Waa suuɡa kemɛ dɛɛ lɛ a nee dɛɛ ja.
Waa wechɔɡa ɛ, o dɛ bol kasinteŋ nɛn ne o dɔŋ baah waa ta.
Nɛn waa do ɡɛ nɔɔ dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare ta kɛrɛdɛ.
O waa toɡrɔ, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu kɛrɛdɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɔ bichɔɡe wɛɛ kpoo nɛra, kɛɛ wɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ bini bɛlbwa o mɛɛ aa wola ane ɛɛ ka, kɛ o te ɛɛ di kwaa baa kpoora voɡare ta bwejena dor, dɛ lawɛ o bala haahna dɛɛ chɔ, dɛɛ faah nyaara, dɛɛ ŋwɛ.
O kemɛ nɛn suuɡa dɛ lɛ kon cheɡ naate ta kem la ba bɔe yaa.
Waa naate kon kpɔe dɛɛ tɛo.
O dɛ tomɛ voɡa maa kia la.
O kemɛ o dɔŋ suuɡa aa, o dɛ lɛ a nee aa ɡwaa.
A chɛ kɛ a ɡɛ nɛn nɔ so harɛ nɔ ta naa?
Akai!
O dɛ ɛ waa baa kia nɔ bwa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ á ɡure o nyu ta, bá kpoo.
Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛnchɔɡe nɔ dɔ bie, o na wechɔɡa o mɛɛ aa dɛ ɛ bwa, dɛ ɔmɛ o ta ɡɛ ɛɛ.
Waa kwaa Israel tena aa dɛ kpoora dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡa bwejena dor la di, kɛɛ dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa.
Waa o dɔŋ haah lawɛ dɛɛ chɔ, kɛɛ waa nomɛlbwa fiiɡi, o kemɛ nɛn suuɡa aa waa kon lɛɛ dɛɛ cheɡ o buɡ ta.
Waa ŋwɛ, o dɛ tɛ nɛn lɔr aa dɛ kpoo kondikwa, dɛɛ tɔ nɛn waa wola yal dɔe yal.
Waa wechɔɡa ɛ, o kemɛ nɛn suuɡa aa, waa a nee lɛ.
O dɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare bwa ta.
O mɛɛ wechɔɡa la aa won ɡel o dɔ seo, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu kɛrɛdɛ.
O mɛɛ te, o ɛɡre o bala dɛ lɛ ba kwa, dɛ ɛ o nɛra wechɔɡa, wɛɛ sewɔɔ.
He dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ bie dɔ deŋnetɛra o mɛɛ wechɔɡa waɔ?’ Bie la waa toɡrɔ dɛ do wer, o teŋɛ me Mmarare la ta kɛrɛdɛ ken, anomanta, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu kɛrɛdɛ.
Naate waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa laanee dɛɛ sewɛ.
Bie ta chɛ kɛ ó na wa o mɛɛ wechɔɡa wa, mɛɛ ɡe ta chɛ kɛ ó na wa o bie wechɔɡa wa.
Nomɛlbwa o waa aa toɡra wɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛ́ dɔ andɛɛɡa, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa ɡe, wechɔɡaa dɛɛ teŋɛ o nɛ.
Kɛ dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɡel wechɔɡa waa ɛa, dɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare bwa ta, dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa toɡra dɛ do wer aa, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu kɛrɛdɛ, waa sewɛ.
Mɛɛ kpɔ naate wechɔɡa bwaa kɛo, maa an lii kpa, dɛkalkɛ o waa toɡrɔ.
Wɛɛ so lee, waa sewa ba.
He dɛ lii kɛ n sie dɛ lɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ seo ta kɛɛ?
Akai, n sie aa a ta lɛ.
Ó le o wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ dɔ o nyuu mɛɛ nyin.
Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra le o wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta, dɛ ka ɛ wechɔɡa ne waa maa kia wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ ɛa la aa, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu yaa?
Maa o wedɛɛɡa waa ɛa wubwa la bɛlbwaa lii.
O kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe ne wechɔɡa waa ɛa la taa wɛɛ ba sewa.
Kɛ he dɛ bol ŋɔ, men Korowii waa ta toɡrɛ.
Israel tena, hé no, he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ men Korowii n waa ta toɡrɛ kɛɛ?
He waa laa wola toɡraa?
Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra le wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta dɛ ka ɛ wechɔɡa aa, wɛɛ sewɔɔ.
O wechɔɡa waa ɛa la waa wɛɛ ba sewa.
Kɛ dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ charɛ o liire le wechɔɡa waa ɛa ta, dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wera dɛ toɡre aa, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
O na wechɔɡa waa ɛa dɛ le a ta, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu kɛrɛdɛ, waa wola sewɛ.
Kɛ he Israel tena dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Men Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta toɡrɛ.’ He ŋwɛnɛree wola toɡrɛ.
Anomanta, he Israel tena, mɛɛ bol he waa beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋaa ɡɛ haa ɛa.
Hé charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa bwa ta, dɛ bɛ naa a ta lɔ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Hé laa he te kpɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ dɔ bambidɛɛɡe ne liifala dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ta.
Israel tena, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin kɛ he serewe nɔɔ?
N sie aa lɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa sewɛ.
Hé charɛ he liire, ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu!
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Suna dii yel Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Go suna dii yel nɔ tɛ Israel koranar banɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Na ɡɛ he nya aa do kɛŋɔ nyujente nee!
O dɛɛ o bii nyujentena ambala aa do ɔma baah.
O dɛɛ bii la bɛl o kpeɡ, dɛ baɡlo kpaahna, o lawɛ nɛra dɛɛ chwe.
Harɛre ta nɛra no o wa, dɛ harɔ bel a bɔɔ bini dɛ lawɔ.
Ba doo kwaa kɛŋɔ ɡoŋa dɛ tɛɡro kaa Ijipt harɛ ta.
O nya la nyiŋu ŋwɛnɛ, o hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ.
Ate, o berɛ dɛɛ bii la bɛl ja o kpeɡ dɛ do ɔma.
Waa baa kpeɡ la, o pu o bala o ne aa valɛ dɛ hweli kpaahna, dɛ ɡe lawɛ nɛra dɛɛ chwe.
O kuuɡi ba dekpeɡa dɛ chɔɡ ba bwɛɛre.
O sio waa, dɛ ɔmee kohona chole harɛ la ta nɛra nɛ.
Belaa harɛre nɛra pɛ dɛ ba yoo.
Nɛra le bobɛlbwa dɛ ta ba asauri baro dɛ lawɔ.
Ba kpɔ ɡoŋa lawɔ, dɛ doo buo bini ka tɛ Babelɔn kooro.
Ba doo dea, baa o sii no Israel deŋɡarere ta kpa.
He nya fa do kɛŋɔ ɡrepo daa dɛ che nee nyoa.
Nee aa lɔ bela kohona nomanta, o dɔ papooni kɛrɛdɛ dɛ won nɔna ɡe.
O kpala kpeɡri dɛ do wer kɛ bá kpɔ ɛ kooro daŋɡbala.
O kpeɡo tɛr kaa nyundua baama bini, nɛra na ɡɛ waa kpeɡa dɛ dɔ papooni kohona.
Ba baah di o nɛɛ kohona, dɛ huɡru ɡo.
Wee leebɔr peuwɔb tao dɛ ɡel o kpala la ne o nɔna la hol, nii fuh a bwa.
Taraken, pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ taa ba ka chɔɔro, harɛ waa hola nee aa wola toole o ta.
Nii le o kpale la bɛl ta dɛ fuh o ne o nɔna la bwa.
Daa la kpale bɛlbwa toole dɛ do kpeɡri bá kpɔ ɛ koodaŋɡbala kpa.’ Wii aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá wi laanee la.”
Israel tena deŋnekpeɡ wa Gɛ saŋ baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa Babelɔn bene anuanɛ, korobie anue tɔpera fi ta la, Israel nomonome la bane balɔ, dɛ ba so men Ɛsekeɛl sie dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa le Korowii be.
Belaa Korowii bol waa n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ŋɔ Israel nomonome la be kɛŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘He balɔ dɛ́ ba bɔɔ dɛ́ na waa aa le n be kɛɛ?
N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ maa lole saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ, maa ɡel he pɛɛ mɛ wobɛlbwa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ Nɛwɛnyini bie, he dɛ nyin kɛ he pa ba bolchɔɡe kɛɛ?
Ate, lii ba ba naawa kii waa baa ɛa la wa dɛ́ ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Awola maa le Israel tena tɛ n te la, n ir nɔn dɛ ŋwɛɛ baɡle Jekɔb naanar, dɛ kpɔ n te baɡ ba Ijipt harɛ ta kɛ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.
N berɔ ŋwɛɛ baɡ ba kɛŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta ba harɛ maa nyina cheɡ ba ta, o ɛ harɛpare ondɛɛɡe ɡwaa harɛre bwa.
N ŋɔ bá pa ba voɡa maa kia la ta, ba bɛ Ijipt harɛ ta voɡa nɛɛ teŋɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kah ba te.
Menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ.’ Kɛ Israel tena ɛɛ mɛ deŋnekpeɡ, baa n waa no, ba ta voɡa la pae ta, ba ta Ijipt tena voɡare maa kia la ɡe ta leɛ.
Anomanta, n ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ n bandiaa ba ta ba nɛɛ Ijipt harɛ ta.
Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ harɛre baa soɡe a ta nɛra bɛ n sɔnchɔɡe yerɛ ŋɔ n bolɔ ŋɔ, mɛɛ lawɛ Israel tenaa le Ijipt harɛ ta nomanta, n ta ɡɛ ɛɛ.
Ate, n tɔ ba sie dɛ le ba ne Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ba bane pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
N kpɔ n waa tɛɛ ba dɛ baɡ ba me Mmarare, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa teŋɛ a ta la, ó dɔ mkpa.
N ŋɔ baa di Ona Tɔpera la a ɛ fɔo dɛ́ chɔ n ne ba baah, dɛ́ lii kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii ɛɛ ba ba do ɡoroŋ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, ba ɛɛ mɛ deŋnekpeɡ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela.
Ba ta n waa ta teŋɛ, dɛ vɛh me Mmarare nomɛlbwa fe aa teŋɛ a ta ásɛ dɛ fe dɔ mkpa la.
Ba chɔɡ Ona Tɔpera la.
Anomanta, n ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia ba ta ba nɛɛ kohona, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba bwa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela.
Kɛ maa dɛ nyin n sɔndɛɛɡe nomanta, n ɡelɔ ásɛ harɛre ta nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛ na kɛŋɔ, n laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la bɛ n sɔnchɔɡe yerɛ.
N berɔ ir nɔn pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela, dɛ ŋwɛɛ baɡ ba kɛŋɔ, maa ban kpɔ ba harɛ maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la ta, harɛpare ondɛɛɡe dɛ ɡwaa harɛ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, ba vɛh me Mmarare, ba ta n waa ta teŋɛ, dɛ chɔɡ Ona Tɔpera la.
Ba liire bwa lɔ ba voɡare ta.
N na ba sum, n ta ban chɔɡɛ kɛɛ dɛ kpoo ba pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela.
N bol ba bii be pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela ŋɔ, ‘Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ he naawa we-ɛɛla kɛɛ mmarare kɛɛ ba voɡa nɛɛ teŋɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kah he te.
Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, hɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ne me Mmarare maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ di n Ona Tɔpera la, dɛ́ ɡel a do ɡoroŋ, ásɛ a ɛ waa dɛ chɔ n ne he baah ta.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la.’ Ba bii la ɡe ɛɛ mɛ deŋnekpeɡ.
Bɛlbwa ta n waa ne me Mmarare la ta teŋɛ kɛrɛdɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ anee fe dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔ mkpa.
Ba chɔɡ n Ona Tɔpera la.
Asɛ n ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia kohonaa ba ta ba nɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne.
Ate, n berɛ lawɛ bambile, dɛkalkɛ aa chɔɡ n sɔnee harɛre nɛra baa naa n lawɛ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta, ba siwi ta la.
N berɔ ir nɔn, dɛ ŋwɛɛ baɡ ba pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela kɛŋɔ, mɛɛ lɔ baa peɡre harɛ nɔ ta bwa, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh n wa, ne me Mmarare maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la ta teŋa, dɛ chɔɡ n Ona Tɔpera la, dɛ tomɛ voɡa la tenten ba naawa aa toma la.
N ɡelɔ baa ɛ waa aa wola ban cha, dɛ tɛɛ ba mmarare aa wola ɡel ba dɔ mkpa.
N ɡelɔ ba kpɔ ba bibanloɡla ɛ sarahare dɛ kah doŋa, n ɛ ɡɛ dɛ kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta ba nɛɛ ba chel, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ “Nɛwɛnyini bie, berɛ ŋɔ Israel tena be kɛŋɔ, anɔ ɡe taa ba naawa ɛɛ mɛ nɛnhɛlwa dɛ le n habɔɔ.
N laɡ ba ba harɛ maa ŋwɛɛra ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba la ta.
Ba baa na deŋɡarejaŋa ne dajena aa dɔ papooni kohona dɛ ka ɛ sarahare bela.
N baah di daawiile baa fuah a sɔɔh do som, ne sen sarahare baa ɛa tɛ voɡa la ta.
Ate, n bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwaa he kaa ɛ deŋɡarejena nɔ ta bela ɔ?’ Ba dɛ yerɛ bela ‘Bama’ ba le fini.
Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol Israel tena la be ŋɔ Men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘He ɡee ɛ wechɔɡa he naawa aa ɛa, dɛ tomɛ voɡa maa kia, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah ba te la anee kɛɛ?
Ba le fini, he ta lawɛ he bii kaa ɛ sarahare voɡa la ta baa fuuh ba, dɛ kpɔ doŋa dɛɛ kah he te.
He ta teŋɔ dɛɛ nyin waa dɛ́ no le n be.
N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ Men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, maa ɡel he pɛɛ wobɛlbwa le n be.
He ɛ he liire kɛŋɔ he fee do ɡɛ harɛre nɛra bane aa doa, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa baa kpɔ daa ne bwea ɛa.
Aa ɡɛɛ maɡre.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ n taa lole nɔ, mɛɛ che n kpeɡri taa dɛ́ ir nɔn tɛr he deŋne n bandia ne, dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa le harɛre haa peɡra dɛ ka so a ta la ta, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne.
Mɛɛ ba he ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ harɛre aa baro la taa, n ne he sie ɡba dɔŋa, ń bol he waa dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne.
Gɛ maa bol he naawa wa dɛ pa ba bole Sinai pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba heyaa ɛɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ do sie he bee kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ fɔo waa chɔ n ne he baah ta la.
Mɛɛ lawɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena baa lɔ he bini nɔɔ le bela baa soɡa taraken nɔ.
Maa ɡel ba naa tire Israel harɛ.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, hé dɛ nyin kaala ka tomɛ he voɡare aa, hé kaa.
Kɛ n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ a habɔɔ la, hɛɛ baa teŋɛ n waa taa dɛ́ ɡel sarahare ka ɛɛ he voɡare ta, dɛɛ chɔɡ n sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛɛ duu mɛ.
Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ dɛ do Jerusalam la taa he Israel tena la bwa ɛɛ ba men toma.
Belaa mɛɛ ba he saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ, ne anɔ la aa le he bambile ta he kpɔ dɛɛ ba ba tɛ mɛ la lɛɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ lɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma he yon kpɔ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la, mɛɛ boa he nyoa le harɛre haa peɡra kaa a ta la, ásɛ harɛre nɛra na kɛŋɔ n do ɡoroŋ.
Maa ba he ne Israel harɛ ta la, anee hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ la, harɛ maa ir nɔn dɛ ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ he naawa la.
Belaa hɛɛ ba we-ɛɛla ne liire aa ɡela he kpɔ he te kah doŋa la nae, ásɛ he hah he ɡbaɡba kɛŋɔ haa ɛ a ɡɛ wedoŋa nɔ la.
N koh n sɔndɛɛɡe waa dɛ ɛ waane aa, hɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii, dɛkalkɛ maa heyaa ɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola dɛɛ baɡle he Israel tena bwa.” Korowii bol weekaŋle harɛbɔr tena chɔɡa wa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kpɔ sie pa weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ́ bol waa aa dɛ ba kɔr la ta bala.
Bol kɔr la be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Cheɡ deŋne dɛ no!
N dɛ ba ɡela nii ba fuih, ásɛ dɛ chɔɡ he daa bwa, anɔ la aa hola ne anlwɛɛne bwa.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won dime nii la.
Aa le weekaŋle harɛbɔree dɛ́ fuh ba kaa weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ásɛ a nyaa nomɛlbwa.
Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii do nii la, bɛlbwa aa wola won dima bwa.’ ” Belaa men Ɛsekeɛl ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, ba dɛ bol n waa ŋɔ baa waa maa dɛ bol nɔ mun no, a do kɛŋɔ molbie.”
Korowii kere pama wa Korowii bol men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, eɡle sie ta Jerusalam tena nɛ, dɛ́ bol ba be ŋɔ, bɔra baa dɛ tom mɛ a ta la aa were.
Kah Israel harɛ ta tena ŋɔ, n ne ba dɔɔ.
Mɛɛ pamɛ n keree le o tɔɔ ta, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa.
Mɛɛ pamɛ n keree dɛ́ kpoo nɛra baa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr ne weekaŋle nyunduabɔr bwa.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowii, n pamɛ n kere aa, maa berɛ kpɔ su o tɔɔ ta kpa.
Anomanta, Nɛwɛnyini bie, ɡel he bambile chɔɡ he loo ku kohona hɛɛ hime, ásɛ nɛra bwa nae.
Dɛ ba bɔɔre ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ he bambile chɔɡ hɛɛ hime kohona naa’, ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Waa a taa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba bala waa.
Ɔmee ɛɛ lawɛ nomɛlbwa kohonaa ba bwara ɛɛ sa, ba bambile chɔɡ, ba bwara yɔr.’ A dɛ ba bala.
Aa bao ɡe.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Korowii berɔ bol waa n be dɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol waa aa dɛ ba bala dɛ́ ŋɔ, kenii mɛɛ bol, ‘N sar n kere o do nyɛɡre, asɛ wɛɛ nyɛɡle.
N saro dɛ́ kpɔ kpo.
O dɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwaala nyɛɡla ken!
Silɛɛ bɛlbwa aa n nɛra nɛɛ doe ba, dɛkalkɛ ba ta kaeh maa kah ba la ne n deŋnetɛra la ɔmɛ.
N fee kere la wɛɛ nyɛɡle, ásɛ dɛ pa mun ɛ o ne toma.
N saro kɛrɛdɛ wɛɛ nyɛɡle dɛ́ kpɔ do nɛn waa kpɔ kpoo nɛra la nɔn ta.
Nɛwɛnyini bie, wi dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre, dɛkalkɛ n nɛra ne Israel koranar waa wɛɛ ba.
Wɛɛ kpoo ba ne n nɛra kar bwaa.
Kpɔ nɔɔra lɔ bambile á baɡle kɛŋɔ he hwɛɡa tonɔ.
N kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ daah ba, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ dɛ ba ta ba liire charaa, ásɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ba ba nɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol waa aa dɛ ba bala n sɔn ta, dɛ́ lɔ kpaŋa sibeɡra ne.
Gel kere la ŋwɛnɛ keraanɛ, ó ŋwɛnɛ keraatoro kwara.
O ɛ kere waa do ɔma dɛ́ won kpo.
O ɡelɔ ɔmee le n nɛra nɛɛ kohona ba choɡli.
N kpɔ kere waa dɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwaala la, dɛɛ aah ba ba bwɛjena doonyoo, dɛɛ ba ba kpoora.
Kere haa nyɛɡa, mɔn ɡal ne diɡ bwa.
Mɔn bobɛlbwa haa berɛ!
N ɡe ɛɛ lɔ kpaŋaa, ásɛ n bandia la nyoa sɔɔh.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ” Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bil ŋwɛnɛre anɛ ásɛ Babelɔn kooro kpɔ o kere kpɔ a ta ba.
A ɛ ŋwɛnɛre aa le harɛ beŋkpoŋ ta, dɛ́ pa daa o baɡle bela ŋwɛnɛre anɛ la aa pera kaa.
Ŋwɛnɛ la beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ chaɡle kooro la ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta dɛ kaa Amɔn tena bwɛjen Raba la ta, ásɛ bɛl ɡe kaa Juda harɛ, Jerusalam bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛɛ baro la ta.
Babelɔn kooro cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ chɛchɛre la ta, dɛ kpɔ o hɛma bil daa, dɛ́ jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ o ta.
O kpɔ o voɡa bil dɛ kpɔ kondɛɛre waa kpoa pwɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi o ta.
O kpoŋe hɛm o nɔndiɡ ta dɛɛ ba tae do Jerusalam.
A dɛ chaɡle kɛŋɔ o dɛ ba dajaŋa kpɔe ba teɡli doonyojena la ta, dɛ do laa lɔŋɔ, dɛ kwi sɔɔhbɔra bɔɔne, dɛ ma kon baa che o ta dɛ́ jo bwɛɛ la ta dɛ́ kpoo ba.
Jerusalam tena noɔ waa baa yarada, fɔo ba ne kooro la aa fɔwa la wa.
Kɛ aa ɡeloo ba lii ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa, ásɛ ba laɡ ba laa ta.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘He wechɔɡa haa ɛa bwa chɔ baŋ.
Nomɛlbwa naa dɛ na ɡɛ haa bera do ɡe bwa.
Ba pa heyaa bolchɔɡe wobɛlbwa ta.
Baa lawɛ heyaa laa taa dɛ́ kaa he ne.
Kooro haa dɛ nyiŋi Israel nɛɛ dɛ ɛ nyubinikpeɡ te kohona, he tɔpere baa tɛr he deŋne la telo tonɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ hé laa he kooɡbɛrɛ la pili dɛ́ laa yal haa kpɔa vɔwɛ nyu la kpɔ.
Wobɛlbwa aa ɡɛ aa doa laanee do kpa.
Dansaara ɛɛ di koraa, ásɛ koranar berɛ dansaara.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ bwɛjen laanee, dɛ́ chɔɡo chɔɡa ɡbaɡba!
Kɛ wɛɛ do lee ka tel kɛŋɔ nɛn maa leo ŋɔ ó ba tɛr o bini nɛra deŋne aa ba, mɔɔ ń kpɔɔ do o nɔn ta.’ ” Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol waa aa dɛ ba Amɔn tena baa dɛ chɛɡre Israel tena nɛɛ bala dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Ba pamɛ kere dɛ́ ba kpoo nɛra.
Ba saro, ásɛ o do nyɛɡre dɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwaala ken.
Amɔn tena, he wepila haa dɛ naa, ne waa haa ŋɔa aa bao la bwa ɛ nyosone.
He ɛ nɛnchɔɡa, he nyu bini kpeɡri.
He tɔpere telo, he deŋnetɛra tɔpere la telo tonɛ.
Hé berɛ kpɔ kere la su o tɔɔ ta.
Hé berɛ kaa harɛ baa lolɛ o ta he naawa bwɛ, belaa mɛɛ ba he deŋne tɛra.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n banfuih ba ta he nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ heyaa do nyubinikpeɡ tena baa won kwaa chɔɡa kohona nɔn ta.
Niinii mɛɛ ba kpɔe fuh heya.
He ɡbaɡba harɛ taa hɛɛ ba serewa, baa wola he waa lii kpa.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ”
Jerusalam tena wechɔɡa wa Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, hɛɛ bol Jerusalam nɛŋkpoa nɛra aa suu nɔ waa yaa?
Bol o nɛra we-ɛɛla maa kia la waa ba be.
Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, nɛra baa kpoora dɛ teŋɛ voɡa ta, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah ba te nomanta, ba deŋnetɛra tɔpere dɛ ba.
Jerusalam tena di bolchɔɡe ba nɛra baa kpoora la wa, dɛ kah doŋa voɡa baa ɛa la wa.
Anomanta, ba deŋnetɛra tɔpere telo.
A waa n ɡel harɛre ta nɛra ɛɛ mam ba dɛ bwa ɛɛ nyiŋ ba dɛɛ vah la.
Harɛre aa bɛna ne anɔ la aa lɔ bojaŋa bwa nɛra dɛ mam ba, ba wesaɡasaɡare la wa.
Na ɡɛ Israel koranar aa cheɡɛ ba ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ta dɛɛ kpoo nɛra!
Nomɛlbwa toole bwɛjen la ta dɛɛ duu o nya ne o mɛɛ.
Ba dɛ faah nɛŋhɔɔhra, baa luhaahna ne bilalbii ɡe waa lii.
Ba siwii aa n kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la su, dɛɛ chɔɡ n Ona Tɔpera.
Ba bini bane teŋe nyosone dɛ ɡel baa kpoo ba bala, bane ɡe ɛɛ di voɡa kwaa deŋɡarere ta, bane ɛɛ bɔ jwamane.
Ba bini bane ɡe lawɛ ba mɛɛnanar haahna dɛɛ chɔ.
Bane ɡe ɡuɡri haahna ba bwara aa chɔɡa ba ne baa chɔ.
Bane dɛ bɔ jwamane, bane ɡe lawɛ ba bii haahna, kɛɛ ba nimambii ba ne baa pɛ nya ɡbo, kɛɛ mɛɛ dɛɛ chɔ.
Ba dɛ yawɛ ba bini bane sen baa kpoo nɛra.
Bane ɡe dɛ́ kemɛ ba bala Israel tena suuɡa, dɛ́ chɔŋɛ a nee dɛ́ che a ta ɛ dɔɔhna.
Ba soh n waa la kwara.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ lɔ kpaŋa bandia nee dɛ kooɡa ta ba nɛ, ŋwɛɛ ne nɛŋkpoa la wa.
Baa wono che n deŋnetɛra nyoa dɛ ta dɔ bokpeɡa awola maa ba tɛr ba deŋne la kɛɛ?
N bol wa aa, n dɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ lɔ baa peɡre harɛre ne bwɛɛre ta, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ba wechɔɡa bwa ba a jaɡa.
Gɛɛ dɛ ɡel harɛre ne bwɛɛre baa kaa a ta nɛra ɛɛ nyiŋi ba nyubaahna, ba siwi aa ban tɔɡɛ, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Anee Korowii berɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Israel tena waa ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe dɛ tɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ suuɡapoŋ do nii ta, dɛ mwɛɛlo asɛ ayaawa ne buni, dɛ kpana yon le a ta kɛ doŋa aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe la.
Gɛɛ Israel tena ɛ doŋa tɛ mɛ.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Haa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe tɛ mɛ nomanta, Jerusalamee mɛɛ ba he nyoa boara.
Gɛ ba yon mwɛɛ suuɡapoŋa ne ayaawa, ne buni dɛ kpana la, ɡɛɛ n banfuih ɛɛ ba heyaa mwɛɛla bwɛjen la bini.
Kpela, Jerusalamee mɛɛ ba he nyoa boara, dɛ́ mar nii do he lɔɡa n bandia ne, dɛ́ mwɛɛ heya.
Gɛ baa dɛ mwɛɛ suuɡapoŋ nii ta la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba heyaa mwɛɛla Jerusalam, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowii, n kpɔ n bandia kohona ba he nɛ.’ ” Korowii berɔ bol waa n be ja.
O ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol Israel tena be ŋɔ ba wechɔɡa ɡelɔ harɛ la kah doŋa, anomanta, n baah diu mɛɛ ba ba deŋne tɛra.
Ba koranar do kɛŋɔ nyujentena yon lawɛ ola dɛɛ kaa dɛɛ kɔɡre la.
Ba dɛ kpoo nɛra, dɛ pa ba suuɡare ne ba kondɔɔh bwa, a che a ta luhaahna warɛ o ta.
Sɔfore ɡe vɛh me Mmarare ta teŋa.
Baa waa aa do ɡoroŋ, ne anɔ la aa wola ɡoroŋ bini peɡri.
Baa waa aa wera, ne anɔ la aa wola were ɡe baɡle, dɛ ɡel n Ona Tɔpera ɡe dii, a che a ta Israel tena vɛɛh mɛ.
Israel nomonome do kɛŋɔ ɡboli dɛɛ peeɡe ola aa kpoora la.
Nɛŋkpoa taa ba che dɛɛ nyin kondɔɔh.
Ba keamechɔɡa laa sie kpɔ ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ ta, kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ fula lɔ dekɔɔh danjwɛ ta, dɛ tɔ o peɡra ta ken.
Ba won nyosone teŋa ŋɔ ba na waane wepila ta, dɛɛ baɡle ŋɔ waane ɛɛ bao, dɛɛ neɡre nɛra ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii bee a le, dɛ n laa bol wobɛlbwa.
Harɛ la ta, nɛra ɛɡre nɛra dɛɛ lɛ ba kwa, dɛɛ faah nɛŋhɔɔhra ne nyaara, baa waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta.
N nyiŋo kɛŋɔ mɛɛ na nomɛl ba binii ó ba ma Jerusalam danjwɛɛ la bela waa kua la, dɛ́ che ba naa ta, dɛ́ lɛ bwɛɛ la ta, ásɛ n fee ɡel o chɔɡa, kɛ n ta nomɛlbwa nae.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n banfuih ba ta ba nɛɛ kohona, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, ba waa baa ɛa la wa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Bitoli banɛ bane jwamane wa Korowii bol men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bihaahna banɛ bane ba bwa aa le nya beŋkpoŋ waa nɔ.
Ijipt harɛ taa ba so, dɛ le ba toli saŋ kpɔ bannyin dawɛ ba sie ta, dɛɛ bɔ jwamane.
Nomoa la sɔne Ohola, asɛ bechala la ɡe sɔne Oholiba.
N haahnaa ban, ba loɡle bibaala ne bihaahna tɛ mɛ.
Ohola cheɡɔ tɛ Samaria asɛ Oholiba ɡe che tɛ Jerusalam.
Ohola le n habɔɔ, dɛ kaa teŋɛ Asiiria baala nɛ.
Ba ɛ laa tena dɛ do laala burum, dɛ ɛ harɛ la nomonjena ne laa nomonome baa wera bonɔɔna dɛɛ yo jaɡre ne.
Ohola kpɔ o te tɛ Asiiria nomonome la bwa dɛɛ bɔ jwamane.
A che a ta o kaa tomɛ ba voɡare dɛ kah doŋa.
O teŋɛ jwamane waa pa a mun Ijipt harɛ ta la ta, dɛ chɔɡ o te.
O toli saŋ bwaa o le baala lawɔ dɛɛ chɔ.
Anomanta, n vɛoh tɛ Asiiria baala waa dɛ pɛlɛ ba nɛɛ kohona la.
Ba wur Ohola laala o che mumɡbal, dɛ lawɛ o bibaala ne bihaahna bwa kaa, dɛ kpoo kere ne.
A ɛ waa dɛ chɔ le haahna bwa ɛɛ bol o wa.
O nime Oholiba na ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, kɛ dɛ ɡarɛ bɔ jwamane ɡwaa o nahaah la kwara.
Asiiria harɛ nomonjena ne laa nomonome, baa do laala aa wera dɛ do wer bonɔɔna, dɛɛ yo jaɡre ne nɛɛ o ɡe ka teŋɛ.
N nao kɛŋɔ dɛ ɡɛɛ o ɡe do, o da deno doŋ kɛŋɔ o nahaah la.
Oholiba ta ɡelɛ a maɡre bela.
O na Babelɔn tena fotore baa kpɔ konswɛɛma ɛa a dawɛ danjwɛɛ ta, ba ɛ banyoola baa vɔwɛ kirisore dɛɛ yo jaɡre ne, dɛ kpɔ yapondɛɛɡa vɔwɛ nyuune.
Waa na ba la, o jwamanwaa la den ir, asɛ o tomɛ toroma ba be Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Baala la le bela ba o be, dɛ ba lawɔ chɔ.
Ba chɔ o ne chɔ chɔɡa hale a ba peo.
Bɛlbwa na o we-ɛɛla kɛŋɔ o ɛ hanjwamane.
N baah diu n vɛoh ɡɛ maa vɛh o nahaah la.
Oholiba ta ɡelɛ a maɡre ɡɛ, o teŋɔ bɔ jwamane ɡɛ o toli saŋ o fa aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Dɛ baala baa won haahna chɔe, ba pena do kɛŋɔ keeɡore kɛɛ jaɡ-bala penaa wɛɛ nyin name.
Oholiba, ɡɛɛ a do he lii he toli saŋ haa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ pɛlɛ baala nɛ.
Baala jaɡre he ela a bwa sɔɔh.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii dɛ bol hen Oholiba be ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo baala ba wa aa pee la baah di he nɛ, dɛ́ le baŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ ba bare cheme.
Baala baa le Babelɔn ne Asiiria dɛ Kaldea tena baa lɔ Pɛkɔd ne Soa dɛ Koa bwa ɛɛ ba he bee.
Mɛɛ boa laa nomonome baa wera bonɔɔna, ne harɛ la ta nomonjena, ne laa nomonome baa soɡe jaɡre ta dɛɛ yo la bwa nyoaa, ba ba he be.
Baa kpɔ dɔmkwaa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔree, dɛ́ so torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre, ne anɔ la aa dɔ tɔre baa taɡa kɛ torɔɡo warɛ kohona dɛ́ ba yo.
Baa le bobɛlbwaa dɛ́ ba bare, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe dɛ́ pi laa ɡbɛrɛre.
Mɛɛ kpɔe do ba nɔn ta ásɛ ba tɛr he deŋne.
N baah aa di he nɛɛ kohona nomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo ba kpɔ bandia doe sibeɡra kohona.
Baa teŋe he mee ne deŋnaa ta, dɛ́ lawɛ he bibaala ne bihaahna kaa, dɛ́ fuh banɔ la baa kaa la.
Baa wur he laala bwaa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa haa dɛ doa baŋa ne nɔɔra la.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba he ɛɛ, dɛ́ ba he jwamanwaa haa pa a mun Ijipt harɛ la ne a jaɡa.
Haa voɡa la kɛɛ Ijipt harɛ ta wobɛlbwa waa liira ba kpa.’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba he kpɔe do nɛra ba wa aa pee he hah ba la nɔn ta.
Baa haeh nomanta, baa pa he komɛlbwa haa dɔa bwaa kaa, ásɛ he ka che mumɡbal, nɛra bwa nae kɛŋɔ hanjwamane.
He pɛlchɔɡa ne jwamanee ba anɔ bwa ne ba tɛɛ.
Harɛre nɛra bwa bee he bɔ jwamane ka tel, dɛ teŋɛ ba voɡare nɛɛ dɛ kah doŋa.
Ŋwɛnɛ he nahaah aa kpɔ o ta laanee he ɡe kpɔ, anomanta, hɛɛ nyɔ o deŋnetɛra nee la anee.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ maa tɛr he nahaah deŋne kohona laanee mɛɛ ba he ɛɛ.
Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ mamɛɛ dɛ́ muɡli he baah, dɛkalkɛ deŋnetɛra la kan kohona.
Hɛɛ dɛɛroo kohona dɛɛ di suna.
Deŋnetɛra waa do ɔma dɛ chɔɡ he nahaah waa cheɡa tɛ Samaria laanee hɛɛ ba dɔe.
Hɛɛ nyɔ deŋnetɛra nee la bwa kpɛlɛŋŋ, dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn lɔ ela dɛɛ di suna.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Kenii men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ bol hen Oholiba be.
Haa soh n waa dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ nomanta, hɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra he pɛlchɔɡa ne he jwamane la waa.” Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, hɛɛ bol Ohola ne Oholiba waa dɛ́ pa ba bolchɔɡe aa?
Di ba kasinteŋ waa maa kia ba ɛ la wa.
Ba bɔ jwamane dɛ kpoo nɛra ɡe ja.
Ba le n habɔɔ dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡare, dɛ kpoo bii baa lol ba tɛ mɛ.
Ba kpɔ ba ɛ saraha voɡare ta, dɛ fuuh ba.
A ɡbo laa.
Ba kpɔ doŋa kah n Dea la dɛ vɛh n Ona Tɔpera dii.
Awola tenten baa kpɔ ba bii tɛ ba kpoo ba voɡa ta tonɛ la, ba baa jo n Dea dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaoh.
Ba dɛ tomɛ toroma ba ka yerɛ baala le bojaŋa ba.
Ba balaa, ba yon sɔ ne, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa pe ba siebɔra, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa do ba baŋa ne ba nɔɔra.
Ba yon so kane aa wera ta, asɛ teebur che ba sie, ba kpɔ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, ne ɔleve noo aa ɛ n kwaa la chɔŋɛ o ta.
N dɛ no nɛra baa wara dɛ di kwaa dɛɛ lɛ ba sie ɡbɔɡa.
Ba ɛ baala baa le ba ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Gɛ baala la kpɔ nɔnloɡa do haahna la, dɛ kpɔ haŋkoo-ɡbɛrɛre aa wera pi ba.
Belaa n bol haah jwamane wa aa peo la waa ŋɔ, ‘Hé lawɔ ka chɔ, o ɛ jwamane te wubwa.’ Baala la teŋɔ la Ohola ne Oholiba baa ɛ jwamane tena la be, ba ne ba ka chɔ.
Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee ba jwamane ne nɛra baa kpoora la waa, dɛkalkɛ ba di bolchɔɡe a ta.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛ́nlaa wur ba, dɛ́ ba tɔ ba nɛ, dɛ́ do ba sibeɡra, dɛ́ pa ba laala kaa.
Nɛnlaa ɛɛ foɡ ba bweaa, dɛ́ kpoo ba keri ne.
Baa kpoo ba bihaahna ne bibaalaa, dɛ́ fuh ba deene ɡe.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ, dɛ́ ba jwamane ne a jaɡa harɛ la ta, ásɛ a ja haahna ba bɛ ban hweli.
Mɛɛ tɛr he bwa deŋnee he jwamane ne voɡa haa toma la waa, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Nemenɛ Korowii.”
Vii baa kpɔa dɛɛ daa kwaa wa Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa Babelɔn bene anuanaarɛ, korobie fi tɔpera fi ta habɔɔ la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bɔ fini tɔpere nɔ deeti bil, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Babelɔn kooro kpɔ o laa tena dɛɛ ba ba tɔ Jerusalam tena do fini.
Kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa chaɡle Israel deŋnekpeɡ tena la be ŋɔ, men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɛ nee do vii bini, dɛ́ kpɔ chɔŋɛ nii ta.
Lawɛ pee waa wera dɛ́ chɛwɛ o ola do o bini, hé pa andɛɛɡa la, a vaama ne a hwie.
Kpɔ hoɡa bɔra aa wera ɡe ja a ta.
Kpɔ pee ola la bela aa wera kɛrɛdɛ.
Mar nii dɛ́ pa ola la do vii la bini, dɛ́ kpɔa chɔŋɛ nii ta.’ Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Bwɛjen Jerusalam nɛŋkpoa aa lɔ o ta kohona la bwɛɛlɛ.
O do kɛŋɔ vii o bini aa deera ken, o doŋa la aa wola le.
Tɔɔ ola baa chɛwa do o bini la beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa le ó chɔ pɛɛ.
Ba kpoo nɛra bwɛjen la ta, ba chale chɔ bwea ta, harɛpɛɛ ta laa a chɔ, ásɛ teera tɔ a ta.
N ɡelɔ chale la chɔ ɡɛ ba ta a ta tɔe, ásɛ n naa n baah di kohona, dɛ́ yoo ba bɔ kem.’ Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Bwɛjen nɛŋkpoa aa lɔ o ta la bwɛɛlɛ.
N ɡe ɛɛ pa damaraa bil a daŋɛ.
Hé pa daa ba ja kohona ásɛ dɛ huuh nii do a ta.
Hé daa ola la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ do kwaa a ta a do som, hé fuh hoɡa la.
Hé kpɔ buni vii ɡbo chɔŋɛ ninhɔla ta, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa bea dɛ swɛɛ, ásɛ doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ o bini la fuh, ó berɛ do wer kohona.
N ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ ba kahonɛ, doŋa aa wara dɛ do o bini la ta wone le.
Hale nii la ta wone le a ne.
Jerusalam tena, he wedoŋa la ɡelɔ he kah doŋa.
N takapɔ kɛŋɔ ń laa he doŋa bwa kpɔ he nɛ, kɛ n ta wone.
Aa won le he nɛ, nemenɛ haa na n bandia kohona la bwa mɔɔ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii bola.
Saŋ telo kɛŋɔ ń ɛ waa maa ɛ name.
Maa sie laa kpɔ he wechɔɡa ta, maa he sum ɡee na.
Hɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛraa, waa haa ɛa la wa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ” Ɛsekeɛl haah seo Korowii berɔ bol waa n be.
O ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, n dɛ ba nɔn uma lɔ nɛn haa dɛ nyinu kohona la dɛ́ kpoo.
Bɛ waane bol kɛɛ dɛ́ wi.
Wi dɛɛ do he bini.
Bɛ wi tɛ lale la, bɛ nakpapɛɛ valɛ, bɛ yal waa vɔwɛ he nyu ta laa kpɔ á baɡle kɛ he dɛ ɛ lwe.
Bɛ kon kpɔ tɔ he nyoa, bɛ kondikwaa nɛra baa dɛ ɛ lwe aa dɛ di la ane di.” Men Ɛsekeɛl, n bol waa nɛra la be chɔɔbɔr, asɛ jɔmɔra la n haah sewɛ.
Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, n ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do mɛ la.
Belaa nɛra la bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Haa won baɡle yaa a ɡɛ waa nɔ mun aa?” Asɛ n ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ ń bol he Israel tena be kɛŋɔ, o dɛ ba o Dea haa dɛ ɛ mbarafo dɛɛ maŋkura he te o waa la chɔɡa.
O wer he sie ta hɛɛ nyinu.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo ba kpoo he bibaala ne bihaahna haa ɡel ba habɔɔ Jerusalam la laa ta.
Hé ɛ ɡɛ maa ɛa nɔ.
Haa kwaa kpɔ tɔ he nyoo, haa kondikwaa nɛra baa lɔ lwe ta aa dɛ di la ɡee di.
Hɛ́ ɡel yapondɛɛɡa la vɔwɛ he nyuune, hé do naŋɡaware, dɛ bɛ wi, hɛɛ ɡwaŋɔɔ he wechɔɡa nɔ wa, bɛlbwa sɔh dɛɛ wi.
Hé nyiŋi men Ɛsekeɛl dɛ́ kpɔ hweli wa, dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ maa ɛa la.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel he jemɛ kɛ onee Nemenɛ Korowii.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, mɛɛ chɔɡ n Dea baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo o waa o do wer ba siwi ta, ba sie ɛɛ lɛ o ta laanee.
Mɛɛ lawɛ ba bibaala ne ba bihaahna bwa ɡee ja.
Awola tɔpere maa ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ la, nɛn waa wona le a nyoa la ɛɛ bao, dɛ́ ba bol a waa baɡle.
Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo he berɛ won waa bola, ásɛ he ne naate bol wa.
Gɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ ba nyiŋi dɛ́ kpɔ hweli waa dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”
Korowii bol Amɔn tena chɔɡa wa Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, eɡle sie dɛ kah Amɔn tena, dɛ́ bol waa aa dɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala.
Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa men Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol, ‘He sie lɛo kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ doŋa kah n Dea dɛ chɔɡ Israel harɛ bwa, dɛ lawa baa lawɛ Juda tena laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta la.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra le wee leebɔr bá yo heya, dɛ́ pɔ he nɛ.
Baa baŋre ba tɛnte deene he harɛ taa dɛ́ so, dɛ́ di he daa nɔna, dɛ́ nyɔ he kondɛɛra elne.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo bwɛjen Raba berɛ nyoɡmare dibɔr, ásɛ Amɔn harɛ bwa ɡe berɛ peera chɔɔbɔr.
Hɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘He sie lɛo kohona he lɔ kpaŋa dɛ jah dɛɛ hɛɡre, liichɔɡa haa dɔa Israel harɛ chɔɡa wa.
Anomanta, n nɔn dawɛ he nɛ ń tɛr he deŋne.
Mɛɛ kpɔ heyaa do harɛre nɛra nɔɔra ta kɛŋɔ baa pa laala laa ta kaa ken.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ he bwaa kwara, haa wola warɛ dɛ́ tel harɛbir nɛra kpa.
Hɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ” Korowii bol Moab tena chɔɡa wa Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Moab harɛ tena aa ŋɔa ŋɔ Juda harɛ tena do kɛŋɔ harɛre nɛra aa kaa la nomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra ba yo bwɛjena aa lɔ Moab jwɛh ta dɛ lɛo dɛɛ ta la.
Bwɛdɛɛɡa ane kɛŋɔ Bɛt Jɛsemɔt ne Baal Meɔn dɛ Kiriataim bwa jao.
Mɛɛ kpɔ Moab harɛ ne Amɔn tenaa do nɛra baa le wee leebɔr nɔn ta, ásɛ Amɔn tena sɔn he kwaraa.
Mɛɛ tɛr Moab tena deŋnee, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Korowii bol Edom tena chɔɡa wa Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Edom tena yoi baa kaa yo Juda tena bandia ne, dɛ tɔ ba wel la nomanta, a ɡelɔ ba di bolchɔɡe kohona, anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee dawɛ Edom tena nɛɛ dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne, ásɛ dɛ kpoo nɛra bwa ne ba kondɛɛra.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ le bwɛjen Teman dɛ́ ka le bwɛjen Dedan, ásɛ ba kpoo nɛra laa ta.
N nɛra Israel tena ɛɛ yo Edom tenaa dɛ́ tɔ n wel.
Baa ɡeloo Edom tena na n bandia kohona, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee tɔ ba wel.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ” Korowii bol Filisti tena chɔɡa wa Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Filisti tena aa ɛ Juda tena dɔma biɡri nomanta, ba dɔ liichɔɡa dɛ kpɔ nyubinikpeɡ ka tɔ ba wel Juda tena nɛ, dɛ chɔɡ ba.
Anomanta, n ŋɔ mɛɛ ka yo Filisti tenaa dɛ́ kpoo ba bwa le harɛ la ta.
N dɛ ba nɛra baa kaa dɛ so mpo nyoa la bwa chɔɡa.
Mɛɛ kpɔ bandia kohonaa ka tɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne kohona bɔ kem.
Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”
Korowii bol bwɛjen Taaya tena chɔɡa wa Bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ, korobiloɡle tɔpere waa tɔ sie baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bwɛjen Taaya tena dɛ do silɛɛ lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, chwaasere, bwɛjen Jerusalam chɔɡɔ!
Belaa bonadiire bwa ɛɛ la, waa chɔɡa nɔ, yaa do werii name.
Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Taaya tena, n ne he dɔɔ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre nɛra wur bá tɔ he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma ken dɛ́ yo heya.’ Baa chɔɡ danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen Taaya la bwaa, dɛ́ kuuɡi dejaŋa ɡe bwa.
Mɛɛ ɡbaa teɡaŋa ne bwekuŋe bwaa le harɛ la ta, á ka bwetal ɡbo.
Bela ɛɛ berɛ bɔr nɛra aa dɛɛ ɛ nee toma mpo taa, baa nyenɛ ba dɔɔhne.
Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ ka pa Taaya tena laalaa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwaa ken.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Baa kpoo nɛra baa soɡe bwɛɛre aa lɔ harɛ la ta keri nee, ásɛ Taaya tena jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa waa ɛ koranar bwa koojen bá yo Taaya tena.
O ne o laa tena ɛɛ warɔɔ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, bane valɛ, bane so jaɡre ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre ta, dɛ́ ba yoo ba.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba kpoo nɛra baa soɡe bwɛɛre aa lɔ Taaya harɛ la ta bwa keri ne.
Baa ma teeraa sawɛ ba danjwɛɛ la, dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa tɔ ɡbemɡbe, dɛ́ yoo ba.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpɔ dakpeɡa chuɡe ba danjwɛɛre ta, dɛ́ kpɔ dɔmkwaa chɔɡ ba dejaŋa ɡe.
Ba dɔma Babelɔn tena la jaɡre ɛɛ warɔɔ, a ɡel tutuɡ bɔle ba nɛ.
Kwaa aa dɔ tɔre baa taɡa kɛ torɔɡo, ne anɔ la baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre kpɔ bwɛjen la doonyoa la ta jo he be naa, a ɡbɔɡa ɛɛ yiiɡi danjwɛɛ laanee.
Baala baa soɡe jaɡre ta la ɛɛ kpɔ jaɡre laanee kpɔ fɔɡbaahna dɛɛ kpoo nɛra keri ne, ásɛ ba pilajena bwa ɡe kuuɡi.
Dɔma la ɛɛ pa Taaya tena kondɔɔh ne kwaa baa dɛ di a bona bwaa.
Baa taɡɛ ba danjwɛɛre bwaa ta, dɛ́ kuuɡi ba dedɛɛɡa ɡe bwa, ásɛ dɛ pa a bwekuŋe ne daa, dɛ teɡuŋe bwa ka ta mpo ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he yela ne janjela sii bwa ba a jaɡa.
Bɛlbwa aa a waa no kpa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo bwɛjen la bwetal la ɡbo ka, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ nee toma la ɛɛ nyenɛ ba dɔɔhne o ta.
Baa won kwaa vɔrɔwe bwɛjen Taaya kpa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ bol bwɛjen Taaya tena waa ŋɔ, ‘Ba yo heyaa dɛ pɔ he nɛɛ tonɛ aa, nɛra baa soɡe mpo nyoa la ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ taeh, lɔŋɔre nɛra baa dɛ kpoo ba la aa dɛ dooɡe la wa.
Koranar baa lɔ mpo nyoa la bwa ɛɛ ir ba kookane taa, dɛ́ foo ba koolaala ne ba laala baa sɔh kwaa dawɛ a taa bil.
Baa dɛɛ ɔmɔɔ kohona he wa, dɛ́ so harɛ bochela ne.’ Baa taa wiilee ŋɔ, ‘Ba chɔɡ bwɛjen o sɔn aa lea la.
Ba pa o stiimaere bwa le mpo ta kaa.
A ɡɛ nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjen nɔ ta laanee dɛɛ di kpeɡri mpo ta, dɛɛ aah nɛra baa soɡe o nyoa la.
Awola bwɛɛ la aa paɡra la, nɛra baa soɡe mpo nyoa ne ekwie ta la ɔmɔ, ba bwara yɔr a wa.’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo bwɛjen Taaya chɔ pɛɛ kɛŋɔ bwɛjena aa paɡra nomɛlbwa aa wola toole a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ mpo ba tɔ o ta ó ka vil ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔ bwɛjen Taayaa ka ja lala bini, o ka pu saŋ la tena baa serewa la.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o ka so bela kɛŋɔ bwɛɛre a fa aa paɡra la, o ne nɛra baa serewa biɡri la so.
Waa won ba harɛ nɔ ta weera bini kpa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o chɔɡ kwaraa, o waa tonɛ.
Nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ nyin o bɔree, baa on na kpa bwa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Bwɛjen Taaya wiile Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, taa wiile tɛ bwɛjen Taaya, ŋɔ bwɛjen waa lɔ mpo nyoa dɛ ɛ bonadibɔr tɛ nɛra baa lɔ mpo nyoa bobɛlbwa be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Bwɛjen Taaya, he ŋɔ he wer ka tonɛ.’ Mpo nyoa he do.
Nɛra baa vɔrɔwe ɡelɔ he do wer kohona kɛŋɔ stiimae.
Hɛmɔn Bwejen taa ba le dakpeɡa ne dɛ ba kwaare.
Dɛ le peleme daa ne Lɛbanɔn dɛ ba kwaa dajaŋ yal waa baŋre he ta la ta.
Dajenaa ba kpɔ le Basan harɛ ba ɛ he ŋwandaa, dɛ kpɔ dakpeɡa ane ɡe le Saepros, ne bala nyena, dɛ ba kwaa he bini, he do wer.
Ijipt harɛ taa ba kpɔ ŋwɛndɛɛɡe sɔh yapondɛɛɡe waa baŋre he doa dɛɛ kaa he ne la, dɛ berɛ kpɔ ane ɛ he fraŋkaa.
Saepros ekwi harɛ taa ba le yaburum ne oŋkɔl waa wera ne, a tɔ he nɛɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ chunchule.
Bwɛjena Sidon ne Aavad baalaa dɛɛ tawɛ.
He ɡbabir nɛra baa dɔ he wejemaa jaa dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛ.
Nɛmbena baa jemɛ stiimaere kwaara kɛrɛdɛ le Beblɔs, dɛ ja ba nɛ.
Nɛra baa le bobɛlbwa dɛ kpɔ stiimae dɛɛ kpɔ mpo ta balɔ ba ne hɛɛ di bona.
Pɛɛsea ne Lidia dɛ Put harɛre baalaa ɛ he laa tena.
Ba kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe, ne buni ɡbɛrɛre saɡɛ he danjwɛɛre ta, dɛ ɡel he dɔ sɔn ne jirima.
Bwɛjen Aavad ne Helɛk harɛ baalaa dɛɛ nyiŋi he danjwɛɛre ta, asɛ Gamad baala ɛɛ daah he dejaŋa ta.
Ba kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe saɡre he danjwɛɛre ta, dɛ ɡel he do wer ka tonɛ.
He kondɔɔh kohona nomanta, bonadiire le Taases dɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne bune dɛ kpana, dɛ baa charɛ kwaa he be.
Bonadiire baa le Tubal ne Mɛsɛk dɛ Grik tena harɛre, kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa ne yoma ba charɛ he laala.
Bonadiire baa le Bɛt Toɡama kpɔ jaɡre baa dɛ ɛ a ne toma, ne anɔ la baa dɛ la a ne laa, dɛ keeɡo neenanar ba charɛ he laala.
He ne baala baa le Roods di bona.
He ne nɛra kɛrɛdɛ baa soɡe mpo nyoa ɡe di bona.
Ba kpɔ bala nyena ne dadɛɛɡa ba charɛ kwaa he be.
Siiria harɛ ta tena ne he di bona kwaa haa dɔa kohona nomanta.
Ba kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa aa ɛ burum baa yera tɛɛkoes, ne bweswɛɛma ane baa dɛ yera rubire, ne koral aa le mpo bini, ne yakɔle, ne kwaa baa sɔah, ne yapondɛɛɡa, dɛ ba charɛ he laala.
Juda tena ne Israel tena ne he di bona.
Ba kpɔ mea ne tohno ne ɔleve no, dɛ konsɔɔhsoma baa dɛ fɔɡla ba charɛ laala he be.
Damaskɔs tena ne he di bona kwaa haa dɔa kohona la wa.
Ba kpɔ sen le Hɛlbɔn, dɛ pee pona ɡe le Saha ba charɛ laala he be.
Dan dea tena ne Grik tena baa le Usal kpɔ bune baa ɡuɡra dɛ choŋra, ne kalamus a sɔɔh a soma dɛ ɡel kondikwa ɛɛ do som, ba charɛ laala he be.
Dedan tena ɡe kpɔ yale baa kpɔa dɛɛ dawɛ jaɡre nɛɛ dɛɛ so a ta, ba charɛ laala he be.
Arab tena ne Keda harɛ ta koranar ne he di bona.
Ba kpɔ pebiiri ne pebala dɛ boohna ba charɛ laala he be.
Seeba tena ne Raama tena ne he di bona.
Ba kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma bwa soo siwi aa wera kɛrɛdɛ ne bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, dɛ suuɡaswɛm ba charɛ laala he be.
Bwɛjena ane baa dɛ yera Haran, ne Kanɛ, ne Eden, ne Seeba, ne Assur dɛ Kelmad ne he di bona.
Ba kpɔ laala ba charɛ kwaa he be.
Ba yoɡ yadɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa tɛɛ, yakɔle ne kwaa baa sɔah, ne kondɛɛɡa baa kpɔa dɛɛ pa harɛ dea, ne jisedɛɛɡa dɛ ɡboɡbie.
Bwɛjen Taases stiimaeree dɛɛ kpɔ he laala.
He do kɛŋɔ stiimae waa lɔ mpo ta dɛɛ che bontɔɡa.
Dɛ baala baa dɛ tawɛ la, tawɛ kaa mpo baah ta naa, peu ɛɛ tao le wee leebɔr dɛ́ ba paɡre.
He kondɔɔh ne laala haa dɛ di a bona bwa, nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma stiimae la bini bwa, nɛra baa dɛ kwaaro ne bonadiire, dɛ laa tena te bwa baa lɔ o bini bwa sekwaraa ɛɛ morɔɔ, awola tɔpere stiimae la aa paɡre la.
Mpo nyoa harɛ ɛɛ jiɡruu, nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi stiimae la ta aa dɛɛ wi la.
Nɛra baa kpoŋe ŋwandaa la bwa ɛɛ le ba stiimaere binii, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi a ta bwa le ba che baŋ.
Baa dooɡe lɔŋɔree dɛ́ wi kohona tɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ teera do ba nyuune ta dɛɛ ɡbili tɔɔ ta.
Baa koh he waa fonɛ ba nyuune, dɛ́ kpɔ lweyale tɔ.
Baa wiu kohona tɛɛ lokua ne.
Baa wi dɛɛ tɛɛ la, baa taa wiilee tɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Umee ya kpɔ bwɛjen Taaya maɡɔɔ?
Mpo bɔle o ta o hel.’ Haa kpɔ he laala haa dɛ di a bona kpɔ mpo ta la, he ɡelɔ harɛre tena na som.
He ɡelɔ harɛ nɔ ta koranar che he kondɔɔh kohona, ne laala haa dɛ di a bona ta dɛ dɔ ba te.
Taraken, he paɡrɔ mpo ta, dɛ chɔ vil bini.
He laala haa dɛ di a bona ne he toma tena bwa ja he nɛɛ mpo bini.
Nomɛlbwa waa soɡe mpo nyoa bwara yɔr he wa.
Hale ɔmee chole ba koranar nɛɛ kohona.
Ba siebɔra nya bena.
Bonadiire baa lɔ harɛre ta dɛ chweere, he paɡrɔ aa wola were, he waa tonɛ kwaraa.”
Korowii bol Taaya kooro chɔɡa wa Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol Taaya kooro be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘He dɛ ɡɔɔ he te dɛ ŋɔ he ɛ voɡ, he dɛ so voɡ kara ta mpo bare cheme.
Kɛ nɛwɛnyinii hen, he ta voɡ ɛɛ, he dɛ lii kɛ he ne voɡ wejema kɛrɛdɛ.
He wejema ɡwaa Danɛl aa?
Wobɛlbwa toole he nɛɛ dɛ sɔh aa?
He cheɡɛ he wejema ta dɛ dɔ kondɔɔh, suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa bwa su he be.
He cheɡɛ he bona dii wejema kohona ta, dɛ dɔ kondɔɔh kohona.
He kondɔɔh nomanta, he nyu bini dɛ do he som.
Anomanta, he dɛ lii he te wejereme kɛŋɔ voɡ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛŋhɔɔhra baa ɛ harɛre nɛra ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa ɡwaa harɛre bwa nɛra ba yoi.
Baa pamɛ ba kerii, dɛ́ chɔɡ kwaa haa cheɡɛ he wejema ta dɔ dɛ do wer la.
Baa kpoe dɛ́ kpɔe ta mpo ta kɛŋɔ baa huɡe la ken.
Hɛɛ won ŋɔ he ɛ voɡ nɛra baa dɛ ba ba kpoe la be naa?
Nɛwɛnyinii hen, he ta voɡ ɛɛ nɛra baa kpoe la nɔn ta.
Hɛɛ sewɔɔ kɛŋɔ nyoate ken, nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola men tomɛ nɔɔra taa hɛɛ ba sewa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ” Korowii bol waa n be ja ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, taa Taaya kooro wiile, waa aa dɛ ba o nɛɛ bala la wa, dɛ́ ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Henee wera nɛra bwa bini ka tonɛ bá hweli, he dɔ wejema kohona dɛ do wer ka tonɛ.
Dɛ he fa lɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe men Korowii aa du daa la, dɛɛ do kwaa aa wera kɛŋɔ, bwedɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi baa dɛ yera rubi, ne topas, ne emirad, ne kresolet, ne onis, ne jasepa, ne safaaya, ne tɛɛkoes dɛ bɛrel.
Awola baa tae laanee ba ɛ ɡɛ kwaa nɔ ne suuɡaswɛm kwaa tɛɛ.
N le Kerob cheɡ wɛɛ daahne.
Dɛ he soɡe n bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, dɛɛ valɛ bwedɛɛɡa aa dɛ nyɛɡle baah ta.
He waa fa toole n waa bini le awola maa tae mɔɔ he baa ɛ wechɔɡa.
He sie fa beɡrɔ hɛɛ di bona, a che a ta he ɛ naɡrenyini, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Asɛ n doŋi le n bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, dɛ ɡel Kerob la waa dɛ daahne la le he ne bwea aa dɛ nyɛɡle la baah ta.
He wer haa doa la ɡelɔ he ɛ mbarafo, dɛ chɔɡ he wejema, he nyanyini la wa.
Anomanta, n taɡɛ ta harɛ a wa, ásɛ koranar na a ja ba.
He wechɔɡa ne kasinteŋ bɛ dii he bona dii ta ɡelɔ he kpɔ doŋa kah deene haa dɛ tomɛ a bini.
A waa n ɡel nii ba le bwɛjen la ta, dɛ fuh o bwa dɛɛboo.
Nomɛlbwa na ɡɛ bwɛjen la aa fuah dɛ berɛ tɔɔ.
Harɛre nɛra baa jemɛ bwa bwara yɔr he wa, he chɔɡɔ aa wola were kwara, baa hen na kpa.’ ” Korowii bol bwɛjen Sidon tena chɔɡa wa Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, eɡle sie ta bwɛjen Sidon dɛ́ bol waa aa dɛ ba o ta bala, ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Bwɛjen Sidon, n ne he dɔɔ.
He nɛɛ mɛɛ ba cheɡa dɔ jirima.
He nɛra ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii ɡɛ saŋ maa ba tɛr ba deŋne, dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ n do ɡoroŋ la.
Mɛɛ kpɔ weechɔɡaa ba ta he nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel chal ɛɛ palɛ he fɔɡbaahna.
Nɛra ɛɛ serewoo chɔ bobɛlbwa, keri nee baa ba ba kpoora, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Bwɛɛre aa bar Israel cheme, ba ne baa wola somɛ, baa lii ba ne wechɔɡa, dɛ do kɛ jabalnadaŋɛre ne sɔɔhne tɛɛ ba la aa lee do kpa.
Baa jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ menee Nemenɛ Korowii.’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N baa boa Israel tena maa lɔ ba peɡre harɛre ta bwa nyoa tonaa, harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ n do ɡoroŋ.
Israel tena ɛɛ so ba ɡbaɡba harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ n bonɔɔ Jekɔb la taa.
Baa so deŋnesɔɔhna taa, dɛ́ do deene, dɛ́ parɛ daa kooni.
Mɛɛ tɛr nɛra baa ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la deŋnee, ásɛ Israel tena dɔ ba te.
Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.”
Korowii bol Ijipt harɛ chɔɡa wa Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi, korobie fi tɔpera fi dɛ anɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, eɡle sie dɛ́ bol waa aa dɛ ba Ijipt kooro ne o harɛ ta bala.
Ŋɔ o be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Ijipt kooro, n ne he dɔɔ, he do kɛŋɔ lɛŋɔ damanta dɛ do he nenabɔɔne ta.
He ŋɔ Nael Moo ɛ he kon, he ɡbabirii ɛo.
Kɛ mɛɛ do ɡoŋa he nyoaa, ásɛ pɛŋa aa lɔ nee la ta bwa marɛ he pɛɡa ta, ń tɛɡre le baŋ.
Mɛɛ ɡelee ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, he ne pɛŋa la bwa.
Hɛɛ chɔ pɛɛpɛɛ harɛ la taa, nomɛlbwa aa wola hen kpɔ.
Mɛɛ kpɔe tɛ harɛ la ta olchɔɡa ne jumbii á di he ol.
Ásɛ nɛra baa lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena kpɔ ba te dawɛ he Ijipt tena nɛɛ dɛɛ nyin kɛ hé cha ba, kɛ he do kɛŋɔ pul daŋɡbala waa wola kpeɡe.
Baa lawɛ kpoŋe la, he pɛɡrɔ dɛ tɔɡɛ ba vaama.
Baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ he nɛɛ la, he kuu dɛ ɡel ba nyaŋ diɡe.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo laa tena kpɔ keri ba yoi, dɛ́ kpoo he nɛra ne kondɛɛra bwa.
Ijipt harɛ bwa dɛ ba chɔɡa, dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Haa ŋɔa ŋɔ hen dɔ Nael Moo, henee ɛo la wa.
N ne he dɔɔ, n ne he nenabɔɔne ɡe dɔ.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ Ijipt harɛ bwaa o chɔ pɛɛ, le bwɛjen Miɡdol waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ka le bwɛjen Aswan o ɡe aa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le Itiopia harɛ jwɛh ta.
Nɛn kɛɛ ol bɛlbwa aa o taa kpɔ.
Bene fifraanaarɛ habɔɔ laa aa, nomɛlbwa kɛɛ komɛlbwa aa won so bela.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo Ijipt harɛ chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ́ ja harɛre aa chɔɡa bwa ta.
O bwɛjena bwa dɛ ba pɛɛ chɔe bene fifraanaarɛ.
Ásɛ n lɔ Ijipt tena peɡre harɛre bwa ta.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Bene fifraanaarɛ la habɔɔ la, mɛɛ lawɛ Ijipt tena maa lɔ ba peɡre harɛre ane ta laanee pɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba ba so Ijipt harɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ba naawa harɛ ba fa aa soɡe o ta la ta.
Ba harɛ la kora aa kpeɡrii do kpa.
Wɛɛ ɛ kora waa wola kpeɡrii do kpa harɛre koranar bwa bini.
Waa ir dɛ́ do kpeɡri dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛfala ane ta kpa.
Israel tena aa ba tenee kpɔ dawɛ Ijipt tena nɛɛ ŋɔ bá cha ba kpa.
Baa na waa aa ba Ijipt harɛ laanee, dɛ na kɛ aa were kɛŋɔ ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ Ijipt tena nɛ.
Ásɛ Israel tena jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Nemenɛ Korowii.” Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ, korobiloɡle tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena ka yo bwɛjen Taaya tena.
O ɡelɔ o laa tena la che bontɔɡa ba nyuune ɡba, ba vaama swe.
Kɛ kooro la ne o laa tena la bɛlbwa ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe le a ta.
Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, wɛɛ kpɔ Ijipt harɛɛ do Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa nɔn ta, ásɛ o pa Ijipt harɛ ta kondɔɔh bwa laa ta kaa, á ɛ o laa tena kembɔr.
N kpɔ Ijipt harɛ bɔ Babelɔn kooro ne o laa tena kem, waa baa kaa ɛ tɛ mɛ la wa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡo aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena do kpeɡri, ásɛ dɛ ɡel hen Ɛsekeɛl bol waa nomɛlbwa no, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”
Ijipt harɛ wiile Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol waa men Nemenɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa a dɛ ba bala dɛ wi ŋɔ, ‘Tɔpere waa do ɔma kohona dɛ ba!
Tɔpere la telo tonɛ.
Tɔpere Korowii aa bol Ijipt harɛ tena waa la telo tonɛ.
Baama ɛɛ tɔɔ awola, ásɛ harɛre bwa chɔɡ.
Laa tena dɛ ba ba yo Ijipt tena, Itiopia tena loo ɛɛ kuu.
Baa ba kpoo Ijipt tena la, baa pa ba kondɔɔh kaa, dɛ́ chɔɡ harɛ la ó berɛ dimɡbia.
Baa kpoo Itiopia ne Lidia ne Arab, dɛ Lebya harɛre laa tena baa kaa kpɔ ba, ba ba cha ba la bwa laa taa, dɛ́ kpoo n nɛra la bini bane ɡe.’ ” Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Ijipt chamene tena baa dɛ chao la bwa ɛɛ serewoo.
O laa tena baa do kpeɡri wɛɛ ɛ mbarafo ba waa la bwa ɛɛ serewoo.
Baa kpoo ba bwa laa taa le Miɡdol dɛ ba Aswan.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Harɛ la ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ harɛre bwa bini, ásɛ o bwɛjena bwa ɡe chɔɡ kwaraa dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia.
N ɡelɔ nii ba chɔɡ Ijipt harɛ dɛ kpoo nɛra baa dɛ chao waa, anee baa ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Awola tɔpere, mɛɛ tomɛ toromaa bá kpɔ stiimaere ba, dɛ́ ba aah Itiopia tena, dɛ́ le ba ne ba bosɔɔhna ta.
Lokua ɛɛ chole ba nɛɛ awola Ijipt aa chɔɡ la.
Tɔpere la ɛɛ bao kpela.” Nemenɛ Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpoo Ijipt harɛ nɛndamanta bwa.
O ne o laa tena ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa kohona ɡwaa harɛre laa tena ɛɛ bao, dɛ́ ba chɔɡ harɛ la.
Baa pamɛ ba kerii dɛ́ yo Ijipt tena, ásɛ Ijipt tena serewe perɛ harɛ la bwa ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nenabɔɔne aa su Nael Moo ta hweeh, ásɛ dɛ yoɡ harɛ la tɛ nɛnchɔɡa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛŋhɔɔhra ba chɔɡ harɛ la, ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta o chɔ pɛɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ chɔɡ voɡaa, ne anɔ la baa ɛa a do bwɛjen Mɛmfes bwaa.
Kooro aa Ijipt harɛ taa do kpa, ásɛ n kpɔ ɔmee kohona ba ta nɛra nɛɛ harɛ la ta bwa.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ Ijipt harɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔree o chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ́ fuh bwɛjen Soan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ɡe, dɛ́ ba tɛr Tebes waa ɛ ba bwɛjen la tena ɡe deŋne.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia ba ta bwɛjen Pɛloseɔm waa ɛ Ijipt dekpeɡ la taa.
Mɛɛ kpoo nɛndamanta baa lɔ bwɛjen Tebes ɡe bwaa.
Mɛɛ fuh Ijipt harɛɛ, ásɛ lokua chole bwɛjen Pɛloseɔm tena nɛ.
Baa kuuɡi bwɛjen Tebes danjwɛɛre aa baroo la, ásɛ bwɛjen Mɛmfes tena ɛɛ na weweele saŋ bɛlbwa.
Baa kpoo bonɔɔna baa lɔ bwɛjena Hɛleopɔles ne Bubastis laa taa, ásɛ dɛ lawɛ bwɛjena la nɛra bane kaa.
N baa sɔɔh Ijipt harɛ kpeɡri nyoa aa, bɔr dɛ ba bira bwɛjen Tapanes, ásɛ Ijipt harɛ kpeɡri baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo la ba a jaɡa.
Baama ɛɛ tɔ o bwaa, ásɛ ba lawɛ nɛra baa lɔ o bwɛjeɡre ta kaa.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba Ijipt tena deŋne tɛra, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.” Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ, korobiloɡle la tɔpenuanɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, n pɔ Ijipt kooro nɛ.
A do kɛŋɔ maa ku o nɔn ba ta on vɔwɛ o choŋi dɛ do kpeɡri, dɛ́ won lawɛ kere kpoŋe la ken.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ne Ijipt kooro dɔɔ.
Mɛɛ ku o nɔɔraa, ásɛ kere la le o nɔn ta le harɛ.
N dɛ ba Ijipt tena bwa lɔe peɡre harɛre bwa ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo Babelɔn kooro do kpeɡri, dɛ́ kpɔ n kere do o nɔn ta.
Kɛ Ijipt kooro te, mɛɛ kuuɡi o nɔɔraa, ásɛ o bwara nyɛɡo wɛɛ pɛmɛ Babelɔn kooro sie, dɛ́ sewɛ.
Gɛɛ, mɛɛ ɡeloo Ijipt kooro sɔɔh, dɛ́ ɡel Babelɔn kooro do kpeɡri.
Maa ba kpɔ n kere do Babelɔn kooro nɔn ta, ásɛ o kpɔ pa Ijipt tena nɛɛ la, nomɛlbwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Mɛɛ lɔ Ijipt tena bwaa peɡre harɛre bwa ta, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”
Peleme daa bɛl waa lɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta wa Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ, korobitooro te, tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ŋɔ Ijipt kooro ne o nɛnlaa be ŋɔ, ‘Umee n kpɔ he kora kpeɡri maɡɔɔ?
He do kɛŋɔ peleme daa waa lɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta, o kpala ne papooni do wer dɛ tɔ kɔr.
O pamɔ kaa nyundua dɛ do jaŋne dɛ kaa baama ta.
Nee lɔ bela dɛ́ ɡel o kpeɡ, a bulo le harɛ bini dɛ ɡel o kpeɡ dɛ do jaŋne, dɛ sɔɔh o mun bela waa cheɡa la.
Dɛ palɛ kaa jo daa aa cheɡɛ kpɔɡ bini bela la baah ta.
Gɛɛ a do o kpeɡ kaa nyundua kohona ɡwaa daa aa cheɡɛ kpɔɡ bini bwa.
Nee aa lɔ bela kohona nomanta, o kpala la tɛrɔ dɛ do kan kaa nyundua.
Jumbii bwa baa sɔh a kɔne o ta, asɛ kpɔɡ bini ola bwa ɡe ba chɔ o lɔɡa dɛ loɡle.
Harɛre bwa nɛra baa so o chunchule ta.
Daa la kpeɡo, dɛ ɛ dajen, dɛ do wer kohona, dɛ ta kpala a do jaŋne, dɛkalkɛ o lune kaa bini bela nee aa lole kohona.
Haa won kpɔ peleme daa aa lɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe bela men Korowii aa du daa la maɡɔ.
Haa won kpɔ dakpeɡ bɛlbwa soo siwi kpala maɡɛ peleme daa la kpala.
Daa aa lɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe bela bɛlbwa toole dɛ do wer kɛ on.
Menee ɡela o do wer, dɛ ta kpala kohona.
Men Korowii daa maa dua Eden bodɛɛɡe bela fe dɛ nyin a do kɛ on.
Name kenii men Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ bol waa aa dɛ ba daa waa kpeɡa kaa baama ta la pui.
Waa do jaŋne kohona nomanta, o mbarafo.
Anomanta, n kpɔɔ do harɛre nɛra baa ɛ hɔɔhra la kooro nɔn ta, ásɛ o ɛo ɡɛ aa chɛa o nyubinikpeɡ la wa.
N vɛoh.
Nɛŋhɔɔhra ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa teŋo ta dɛ ɡelo.
O kpala ne a nyoo aa kuuɡa chɔ bwejena ne fɛlembɔjena bwa ta.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ba bwa fa aa soɡe o chunchule ta la, le o mun.
Jumbii dɛ so daa waa chola la ta, asɛ kpɔɡ bini ola ɡe do o kpala la baah ta.
Anomanta, le fini dɛɛ kaa, daa waa cheɡɛ bela nee aa lole kohona bɛlbwa aa kpeɡ dɛ́ ka tel baama ta kpa.
A chɔ le kɛŋɔ a bwa serewe kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyina, dɛ kaa lalabwɛ.’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere daa la aa sewa dɛ kaa lalabwɛɛ la, n ɡelɔ harɛ bini neerare aa dɛ bule bɔle o ta, á baɡle kɛŋɔ a wio.
N ɡelɔ neerare ɡel pala.
Daa la aa sewa la, n ɡelɔ biro ba tɔ Lɛbanɔn bwejena ta, asɛ daa aa lɔ kɔr bini bwa serewe.
Maa teŋo ta o sewɛ kaa lalabwɛɛ la, n ɡelɔ ɔmee chole harɛre nɛra nɛ, o sii waa sia la wa.
Daa aa lɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe, ne dadɛɛɡa aa wera, dɛ do bela nee aa lole kohona Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta, dɛ sewɛ kaa la, o seo la tɛa bolarawa.
Banɔ la baa soɡe o chunchule ta, dɛ ɛ o chamene tena baa lɔ harɛre ta ne o kaa lalabwɛ, dɛ ka ja nɛra baa kpoo ba keri ne la nɛ.
A ɡɛ daa laanee Ijipt kooro ne o nɛndamanta la.
Daa aa lɔ Eden bodɛɛɡe la bini ume kan ne o wer ne onee ɛ kɛrɛdɛ ɔ?
Baa teŋe o ne Eden daa la bwaa ta, o kaa harɛ bini.
Taraken, wɛɛ ka ja nɛra baa wola men tomɛ ne banɔ la baa kpoo ba laa ta la nɛɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Ijipt kooro wiile Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi dɛ anɛ, korobie fi dɛ anɛ, tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kpɔ wiile ŋɔ Ijipt kooro be ŋɔ, ‘He do kɛŋɔ nyujente harɛre ta nɛra baah ta, he do kɛŋɔ lɛŋɔ waa lɔ moo ta.
He dɛ jo nenabɔɔne ta dɛ́ pora a chɔɡ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ta asawii lawɛ, ásɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra warɛ, dɛ́ tɛɡre ba ta baŋ.
Mɛɛ kpɔe ta harɛ la ta, dɛ́ ɡel jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ba kah he ola.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he ola perɛ bwejena dor, dɛ́ berɛ su fɛlembɔjena bini.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he chal palɛ dɛ́ pweh harɛ kaa bwejena la dor, dɛ́ ka su fɛlembɔjena la ta.
Maa ba chɔɡe tonɛ la, mɛɛ tɔ nyundua, ásɛ weweela nyoɡre, dɛ́ kpɔ baama tɔ wee ta, ásɛ korobie ɡel chaahna.
Mɛɛ dime kwaa aa lɔ nyundua dɛɛ chaah bwaa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bɔr bir ta he nɛ, he harɛ ta.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo a ha harɛre ta nɛra, maa ba chɔɡe le ba baah ta la, harɛre haa wola an jemɛ la.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre ta nɛra bwara yɔr he wa maa ba tɛr n kere le ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ aah ba la, ɔmee ɛɛ chole ba koranar nɛɛ.
He chɔɡa tɔpere wee la, bɛlbwa ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ o bwara ɛɛ sa, a do kɛŋɔ o dɛ ba sewa.’ ” Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ Ijipt kooro be ŋɔ, “Babelɔn kooro ɛɛ kpɔ o keree dɛ́ ba yoi.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre a laa tena nyu bini aa kpeɡa ɡwaa harɛre bwa kpɔ ba keri ba kpoo he nɛra bwa.
Baa chɔɡ he nɛndamanta ne he kondɔɔh haa dɛ ɛ mbarafo a waa la bwaa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba kpoo nae aa lɔ nejena nyoo bwaa.
Nɛra kɛɛ nae aa lee do dɛ́ jo a ta dɛ́ pora kpa.
Mɛɛ berɔɔ ɡel Ijipt neerare la chole a sie do wer, dɛ́ ɡel aa palɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Maa ba ɡel Ijipt harɛ chɔ pɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta, dɛ́ kpoo o nɛra bwa la, anee baa ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ baa ba kpɔe dɛɛ wiu.
Harɛre ta haahna bwaa dɛ́ taa ɡɛ wiile la tɛ Ijipt harɛ ne o nɛra bwa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi dɛ anɛ, tɔpera fi dɛ anue ta la, Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, wi tɛ Ijipt harɛ ta nɛndamanta bwa, kpɔ ba ka ja harɛre nɛra baa kpeɡa dɛ serewe kaa lalabwɛɛ la nɛ.
Bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, ‘He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he wer kohona ɡwaa nɛra bwa kɛɛ?
Hɛɛ kaa lalabwɛɛ, dɛ́ ka ja nɛra baa wola men Korowii tomɛ dɛ serewe kaa la nɛ.’ Ijipt tena bwa ne banɔ la baa kpoo ba keri ne la dɛ́ ba pɛɛ serewe.
N pamɛ n kere dɛɛ ba ba bwa kpoora.
Banyoola tenten ne nɛra baa yoa tɛ Ijipt tena dɛ serewe la ɛɛ ŋɔ Ijipt tena baa serewa kaa lalabwɛɛ la bee, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, ‘Nɛra baa wola men Korowii tomɛ dɛ serewe la ba bonɔ ba chɔ.’ Asiiria ne o laa tena ŋwama lɔ bela.
Laa taa ba kpoo ba bwa.
Asiiria harɛ ta nɛra ŋwama lɔ lalabwɛɛ bela, asɛ o laa tena chɔ baro harɛ bini bela.
Banɔ la ba fa aa kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta harɛre ta nɛra nɛɛ la, ba kpoo ba keri ne.
Elam harɛ ta nɛra chɔ bela, o laa tena baa kpoo ba laa ta la ŋwama chɔ baro.
Banɔ la ba fa aa kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta harɛre nɛra nɛɛ ba ta men Korowii tomɛ dɛ sewɛ kaa lalabwɛɛ la.
Ba ne banɔ la baa chɔ harɛ bini la di sihiih.
Elam harɛ ta nɛra ja nɛra baa kpoo ba laa ta la nɛ, o laa tena ŋwama baro cheme.
Ba bwa ɛ nɛra baa wola men Korowii tomɛ, ba kpoo ba laa ta.
Ba fa aa soɡe le la, ba kpɔ ɔmee ta nɛra nɛ.
Ba serewɔ, ba ne banɔ la baa kpoo ba laa ta la di sihiih.
Mɛsɛk ne Tubal bwa lɔ bela, ba laa tena ŋwama bar ba cheme.
Ba bwa fa aa men Korowii tomɛ, asɛ ba kpoo ba laa ta.
Ba fa aa soɡe le la, ba kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta nɛra nɛ.
Ba ta ba te nomonhuɡa huɡe ɡɛ ba yon dɛɛ huɡe saŋ la banyoola dɛ kpɔ ba nyuune dɛɛ dawɛ ba keri ta lalabwɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba dɔmkwaa dɛɛ dawɛ ba nɛɛ la.
Banyoola nɔ fa aa soɡe le dɛ do kpeɡri la, ba kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta nɛra nɛ.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɡela ba kpo Ijipt kooro.
Mɛɛ chɔɡoo ásɛ o sewɛ chɔ nɛra baa wola men Korowii tomɛ ba kpoo ba laa ta la baah.
Edom tena ne ba koranar ne ba nomonjena bwa chɔ bela.
Dɛ ba laa tena fa kpeɡri taeh, kɛ ane a bwa, ba ɡarɔ kpoo ba laa ta.
Ba chɔ nɛra ba fa aa wola men Korowii tomɛ la baah ta lalabwɛ.
Koranar baa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne Sidon tena bwa chɔ bela.
Kɛ ba kpoo ba ba di sihiih, ba kpeɡri ba fa aa dɔa dɛ kpɔ ɔmee kohona ta nɛra nɛɛ la habɔɔ.
Ba chɔ nɛra ba fa aa wola men tomɛ la baah ta lalabwɛ.
Gɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ Ijipt kooro ne o laa tena na nɛndamanta baa kpoo ba laa ta la, dɛ́ kpɔ larawe bwara.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
N ɡelɔ Ijipt kooro kpɔ ɔmee ta nɛra nɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta te, kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo ba kpo o ne o laa tena damanta bwa ba ka chɔ nɛra baa wola men tomɛ ba kpoo ba laa ta la baah ta.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Korowii le Ɛsekeɛl wɛɛ daah o harɛ nɛra Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol he bwɛɛ tena la be ŋɔ dɛ n ba laa ne harɛ la ta, asɛ ba le ba bini bɛl ŋɔ wɛɛ daah harɛ la, asɛ naate na laa tena bala aa, ó hoh bɛla dɛ́ ir harɛ la nɛra deŋne.
Dɛ bɛlbwa no bɛla la sii o ta kpɔe ɛ wa, asɛ dɔma la ba kpoo waa, o seo ɡure o ɡbaɡba nyu ta.
Naate no bɛla la sii dɛ vɛh o ta kpɔe ɛ wa aa, o seo ɛɛ ɡure o nyu taa.
O pu sie ɛ waane aa, o fe dɔ o nyu.
Dɛ nɛn waa dɛ daah harɛ la na dɔma bala o ta bɛla la hoɛh nɛra la jemɛ, asɛ dɔma la ba kpo ba bini bɛlbwa naa, naate baa kpoo la sewɛ o wechɔɡa wa, kɛ mɛɛ pɛɛ naate waa sewa la chal waa le nɛn waa dɛ daah bɔr la be.
Nɛwɛnyini bie, henee n le ŋɔ hɛɛ daah Israel harɛ ta nɛra.
No waa maa bola nɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ ja ba.
N ŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ be ŋɔ wɛɛ sewɔɔ, asɛ he ta on kaeh o le o wechɔɡa ta, dɛ sewɛ a ta naa, mɛɛ pɛɛ o chal waa le he be.
Dɛ he kaoh o ta a ta leɛ yaa, wɛɛ sewɛ o wechɔɡa la taa, kɛ he te ɛɛ dɔ he nyuu.” Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ba dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Ya wechɔɡa ne waa yaa koni a ta ɡwaa ya nɛ, a dɛ kaa ya ne mun ta.
Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ ya nyu ɔ?’ Ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, n ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ń sie aa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra seo ta lɛ, n dɛ nyin kɛ ba le a ta, dɛ́ dɔ ba nyu.
Israel tena, hé charɛ!
He charɛ he liire, dɛ́ le liichɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
Hé ɡel wechɔɡa haa dɛ ɛ la.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin seo nɔɔ?’ Anomanta, nɛwɛnyini bie, ŋɔ he bwɛɛ tena be ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra ɛ wechɔɡa aa, waa o nyuu dɔ toɡra o waa fa aa toɡra wubwa la wa.
Dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ le o wechɔɡa ta naa, waa deŋnetɛraa dɔ.’ Dɛ n ŋɔ nɛn o wa aa toɡra be ŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu, asɛ o kpɔ o te dawɛ toɡra o waa fa aa toɡra la ta dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, maa o wedɛɛɡa waa ɛa wubwa la bɛlbwa liira ba.
Wɛɛ sewɛ o wechɔɡa waa ɛa la waa.
N ŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ be ŋɔ wɛɛ sewɔɔ, asɛ o le o wechɔɡa la ta dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wera dɛ toɡre, kɛŋɔ dɛ nomɛl kpɔ komɛl ka tɛo o kpɔ cheɡ awɔba, dɛ lɛ suuɡa, asɛ o berɛ naate kon tɛo, kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ komɛl waa ŋwɛa ka tɛ kon te, dɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare aa dɛ tɛ mkpa ta, dɛ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ yaa, waa sewa ba, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Mɛɛ kpɔ o wechɔɡa waa ɛa la bɛlbwaa kɛo, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu dɛkalkɛ o ɛ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre.
Kɛ he nɛra la dɛ bol men Korowii waa ŋɔ n waa ta toɡrɛ.
Gɛ laa a do, ba waa wola toɡrɛ.
Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra ɡel wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, wɛɛ sewɛ o wechɔɡa waa ɛa la waa.
Gɛɛ dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wera dɛ toɡre aa, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Kɛ he Israel tena ŋɔ, ‘Men Korowii waa ta toɡrɛ.’ Mɛɛ nyiŋi he bini bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla taa dɛ́ bol o wa.” Jerusalam paɡra waa baɡla Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fi dɛ anɛ, korobie fi, tɔpenue ta la, baa bɛl waa dɔ bɔr chwa le Jerusalam ba men Ɛsekeɛl be, dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Jerusalam paɡrɔ!” Dɛ Korowii tɛ mɛ kpeɡri jɔmɔra bɛl, mɔɔ tɔɔper chɔɔbɔr baa la ba n be, asɛ Korowii pili n nyoa, dɛ ɡel n berɛ won waa bola.
Belaa Korowii bol n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, nɛra baa soɡe Israel harɛ bwɛjena aa paɡra ta dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ Abraham ɡboo, asɛ Korowii kpɔ harɛ la bwa tɛo o ɛ o kon.
Kɛ ya berɔ warɛ, anomanta, o berɛ ya bwa kon pi.’ Anomanta, ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Haa dɛ di ola ne a chale, dɛ tomɛ voɡa dɛɛ kpoo dɔŋa nɔ, a chɛ kɛ he dɔ harɛ nɔ o ɛ he kon aa?
Hé ɛ nɛŋkpoa nɛra, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa maa kia, dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa haahna.
A chɛ kɛ harɛ nɔ ɛ he kon aa?’ Ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Ń ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ n taa lole nɔ, baa kpoo nɛra baa kaa dɛ ta so bwɛjena aa paɡra la ta bwaa.
Banɔ la baa chwaa ka so kpɔɡ bini la, kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡaa dɛ́ di ba ola, ásɛ weechɔɡa kpoo banɔ la ɡe baa chwaa ka so dekpeɡa ne bwebɔɔne bini.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ kpeɡri o fa aa dɔa dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo la ba a jaɡa.
Bwejena aa lɔ Israel harɛ ta bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa won kpɔ a ta.
N ɡelɔ harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ waa maa kia ba ɛ la wa aa, baa jemɔ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ Kɛ hen Nɛwɛnyini bie, he nɛra la lawɛ dɔŋa pɛl bwɛjen la danjwɛɛ ne ba doonyoo dɛɛ bol he waa ŋɔ, ‘Hé ba yá ka no waa aa le Korowii be.’ Gɛɛ ba yon dɛɛ ba he be saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ ba so dɛɛ no waa haa dɛ bol, kɛ baa an kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ aa dɛ baɡle.
Ba nyoo ɡboo ba kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ ba ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, kɛ anɔ la baa dɔ ɡbo taa ba liire do.
Ba te be la, he waa la do kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ janjela dɛɛ lɔ yelsoma tasom ne.
Ba no waa haa bola la bwa, kɛ ba ta a bɛlbwa kpɔe ɛ waane.
He waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ ɛo, aa bao kpela ɡe.
Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii keame bɛl fa lɔ ba bini.”
Peteɡra ne peera wa Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol waa aa dɛ ba Israel nomonome baa do kɛŋɔ peteɡra nɛɛ bala, dɛ́ ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Hé bwɛɛlɛ!
He ɛ peteɡra haa wola he peera nɛɛ nyiŋi, he ɡbo waa hiah heya.
Hé laa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi a nɛ aa?
He dɛ nyɔ a elne, dɛ kpɔ a pona ɛ yale dɛɛ tɔ, dɛ kpoo anɔ la aa wera dɛɛ di.
Kɛ haa a nɛɛ nyiŋi.
He ta anɔ la aa ɡwɛɡra nɛɛ nyiŋe, he ta a weela tena chaeh, kɛɛ dɛ jaɡre anɔ la baa doa bola ŋwɛra.
He ta anɔ la aa yeŋa ne anɔ la aa nyoɡra ɡe bɔr nyine, dɛ ba a ne.
Nyubinikpeɡ nee he nyiŋa.
Haa wola a nɛɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ nomanta, a bwa lɔɔ peɡre, asɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ba kpoora, dɛ di a ola.
Anomanta, n peera yeŋo ka do bwejena dor ne deŋɡarere ta.
A peɡrɔ kaa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, nomɛlbwa ta a waa liire dɛ ɡaaɡe a bɔr.
Anomanta, he nɛra haa do kɛŋɔ peteɡra, hɛ́ɛ no waa men Korowii aa dɛ bol he be.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii taa lole nɔ, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ, n peera nya teɡre, a che a ta kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa lawa dɛɛ di.
N peteɡra la ta a bɔr ɡaaɡɛ, ba ɡbaɡba waa hiah ba.
Anomanta, peteɡra, he no waa maa dɛ bol he be.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii, n ne he dɔɔ.
Mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee dɛ́ lɛa le he be, haa a teɡraa ɛ kpa.
Mɛɛ lɛa le he be, maa ɡel he di a ta kpa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ nyin n peera bɔree, ásɛ dɛ nyiŋi a nɛ.
Gɛ peteɡre la peera ne dibɔr, dɛ ane peɡrɔ o yon ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin a bɔr la, ɡɛɛ Israel tena fa peɡre kaa harɛre bwa ta awola tɔpechɔɡe bɛl wee.
Mɛɛ ɡaaɡe ba bɔree name, dɛ́ berɛ ba ba ne.
Mɛɛ lawaa le harɛre aa kaa a ta la taa, dɛ́ boa a nyoa.
Mɛɛ le a ne harɛfala taa dɛ́ kpɔa ba a ɡbaɡba harɛ ta.
Israel bwejena dor ne neerare nyoo aa sɔnaa dɛɛ ba a dibɔra ɛɛ.
Mɛɛ teɡaa kaa dibɔra aa wera taa á ka di.
Israel harɛ bwejena doree mɛɛ ba a dɛɛra, á dɔ kpɔɡdɛɛɡa di a bwara sɔɔhna.
N ɡbabirii dɛ́ teɡɛ n peera dɛ nyin bodɛɛɡe tɛa a chɔ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ ɡaaɡo nyin anɔ la aa nyoɡra bɔr, dɛ́ berɛ ba anɔ la aa yeŋa la ɡe ne.
Mɛɛ vɔrɔwe anɔ la a bobɛla aa kuuɡaa, dɛ́ chah anɔ la a bwara aa dɛ wea, ásɛ a dɔ bokpeɡa.
Kɛ anɔ la aa dɔ bokpeɡa a bwara do wer la te, mɛɛ kpooraa, dɛkalkɛ n ɛ peteɡre n wa aa toɡra.’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N peera, mɛɛ nyiŋi he binii dɛ́ pere pedɛɛɡa le anchɔɡa bini, dɛ́ pere pebala le boohna bini.
Kpɔɡdɛɛɡa haa dɛ chwea la aa heyaa tel aa?
A chɛ kɛ he tiɡri a kar do harɛ naa?
Nedɛɛɡa haa dɛ nyoa la aa he ne maɡre aa?
A chɛ kɛ he porɛ a kar aa?
N dɔ peera ane ɡe a do le.
A chɛ kɛ a chwe kpɔɡa haa tiɡra do harɛ, dɛ́ nyɔ nee haa porɔ o bwa chɔɡ nɔ naa?
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ bol n peera aa ɡwaŋra ne anɔ la a bwara aa wera la waa.
He taɡɛ n peera aa ɡwɛɡra la vaama ne, dɛ chuɡra nyeɡlare ne ka ta, anomanta, mɛɛ lɛ n peera nyuu, ásɛ ba bɛ won ɛa hɔhɔrɔwa kpa.
Mɛɛ bol n peera la bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ baah waa.
Kooro waa do kɛ n bonɔɔ Kooro Devidii mɛɛ ba lee kɛŋɔ peteɡre beŋkpoŋ wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Men Korowiirii dɛ́ ɛ Korowii baa tom mɛ, ásɛ kooro waa do kɛ n bonɔɔ Kooro Devid ɛ ba kooro.
Men Korowiirii bola.
N ne baa fɔwɛ deŋnesɔɔhna fɔwee, dɛ́ le kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ne harɛ la ta, ásɛ n peera la do pua kpɔɡbaah ta, dɛ́ chɔ kɔne bini deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Mɛɛ swee ba ne harɛre aa chɔa bar n bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ dɛ do Jerusalam la andɛɛɡaa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo bwaala nɛ o saŋ ta, á ɛ bwaala dɛɛɡa.
Harɛ la ta daa bɛlbwa ɛɛ nɔnɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ koo kondikwaa ɛ kohona, nomɛlbwa so deŋnesɔɔhna ta o harɛ ta.
N baa lawɛ n nɛra le nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba kɛ yoma nɔn ta naa, anee baa ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Harɛre ane nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ aa won ba yoo ba, dɛ́ pa ba laala kaa kpa.
Gɛɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa ɡe aa wola won ba laɡ ba chwe.
Nomɛlbwa aa won ba aah ba kpa, ásɛ ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Mɛɛ tɛɛ ba harɛpare ondɛɛɡee ba kondikwa won ɛ, dɛ́ ɡel lɔr ba a jaɡa harɛ la ta.
Harɛre ane nɛra aa ban mamɛ kpa.
Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ menee kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ Israel tena nɛɛ ba ɛ n nɛra.
Hé ɛ n peera, mɛɛ dɛɛ heya.
Hé ɛ n nɛra, n ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Korowii Bol Edom tena chɔɡa wa Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, eɡle sie ta Edom harɛ ta tena nɛ, dɛ́ bol waa aa dɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Edom bwejena, n ne he dɔɔ.
Mɛɛ tɛr nɔnee pa he nɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ harɛ la, o ta do ɔma dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ he bwɛjena bwaa a berɛ dimɡbia dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ.
