Belaa hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Edom tena, he fa ɛ Israel tena dɔm, dɛ ɡel ba dɔma kpoo ba ba wenaale tɔpere, ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa deŋnetɛraa.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ n taa lole nɔ, haa dɛ kpoo nɛra nɔ, he ɡe ɛɛ sewɔɔ, haa won le a nyoa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo Edom harɛ deŋɡare chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ́ kpoo nɛra baa dɛ kpɔ o ta bwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo lala su bwejena dor bwa, ásɛ banɔ la baa kpoo ba laa ta chɔɔɡe deŋɡarere ta, dɛ́ su nenabɔɔne bwa bini.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ harɛ laanee kwaraa, ásɛ nɛra aa won berɛ ba so o ta kpa.
Anee hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Menee Juda ne Israel harɛre nɛra ɛɛ tomɛ, kɛ he Edom tena ŋɔ hɛɛ ka kpɔ harɛ laanee ɛ he kon.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ n taa lole nɔ, mɛɛ bɔ heyaa kemee he bandia ne meera, dɛ haeh haa hah n nɛra la wa.
Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee dɛɛ tɛr he deŋne waa haa ɛɛ ba la wa.
Anee hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ men Korowii, n no nɛnhɛlwobol haa bola Israel bwejena waa ŋɔ a bwa chɔ pɛɛ ba kpɔ tɛ heyaa a ɛ he kwa.
N no mbarafo waa haa bola yaɡ mɛ aa wola nyoa dɔe.’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ chɔɡ he ne he harɛ Edomee ó chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa sie lɛ.
Edom tena, he sie aa lɛa ɡɛ saŋ Israel tena harɛ aa chɔ pɛɛ la, ɡɛ tentenee mɛɛ ba kpɔe ɛ heya, Sɛɛ Bwejen ne Edom harɛ bwa.
Asɛ nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”
Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Israel harɛ Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol Israel bwejena be waa aa dɛ ba a nɛɛ bala, ŋɔ á no waa Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol a be.
‘He dɔma bol he waa ŋɔ, bwejaŋa aa lole saŋ la bwa la berɛ ba kwaa name.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ harɛre aa bar heyaa cheme aa baa yo heyaa dɛ lɛ Israel harɛre la, ba bwa chɛɡre Israel tena.
Anomanta, Israel bwejena ne deŋɡarere, ne nenabɔɔne ne fɛlembɔjena, ne bwɛɛre aa chɔɡa dɛ chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ bwɛjena baa pa a laala laa ta kaa, harɛre nɛra baa bar heyaa cheme la mamɛ heya.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii cheɡɛ n bandia kohona ta, dɛ bol waa yaɡɛ harɛre kabora la ne Edom harɛ bwa, dɛkalkɛ ba sie lɛo, dɛ che wedoŋa ta kpɔ n harɛ ɛ ba kon, dɛ kpɔ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.
Anomanta, bol waa aa dɛ ba Israel harɛ ta bala, dɛ́ ŋɔ bwejena ne deŋɡarere ne nenabɔɔne dɛ fɛlembɔjena be ŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowii bol waa meera ne bandia kohona ne, dɛkalkɛ he na hɔhɔrɔwa asɛ harɛre nɛra mamɛ heya.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ a do tenaa, n ir nɔn dɛ ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ harɛre aa bar heyaa cheme nɔ nɛra ɡe ɛɛ di sihiih bá mam ba.
Kɛ daa aa lɔ Israel bwejena dor ɛɛ berɔ moɡɛ, dɛ́ nɔnɛ kohona á ɛ kondikwaa tɛ n nɛra Israel tena, dɛkalkɛ aa biɡri n berɛ ba ba ne dem.
He waa lɔ n bambile ta, mɛɛ sune he nɛɛ he berɛ parɛ he harɛ la, dɛ́ du kwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he Israel tena ya.
Nɛra ɛɛ berɔ ba so bwɛjena aa paɡra la ta, dɛ́ kwaa vɔrɔwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra ne kondɛɛra ya kohona, dɛ́ ɡel he berɛ ba so ɡɛ he fa aa soɡa wubwa la, ásɛ he wobɛlbwa do wer tɛ heyaa ɡwaa saŋ la kwara.
Belaa hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena haa ɛ n nɛra berɛ ba so harɛ la ta ja.
Wɛ́ɛ ɛ he kapɛrɛ konee, lɔr aa he biirii kpo o ta kpa.
Nɛra dɛ bol he be ŋɔ he dɛ kpoo he ɡbaɡba nɛra, a ɡel bechale toole he harɛ ta.
Kɛ le fini dɛɛ kaa, háa he ɡbaɡba nɛraa kpoo, ásɛ dɛ paŋɛ bechale kpa.
Maa ɡel he no harɛre ta nɛra loro baa dɛ di heya, ne mama baa dɛ mamɛ heyaa la, kɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel he harɛ la paɡre kpa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.’ ” Korowii berɔ bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Israel tena fa aa soɡe ba harɛ ta la, ba cheɡɛ ba da ne ba we-ɛɛla ta, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ la dɛ chɔɡo.
Ba we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ haah waa le dahara n be.
Anomanta, n kpɔ n bandia kohona ta ba nɛ, nɛra baa kpoora harɛ la ta, dɛ tomɛ voɡa, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah harɛ la wa.
N lɔ ba peɡre harɛre ane ta, ba do harɛre ta bobɛlbwa, asɛ n pa ba bolchɔɡe ba we-ɛɛla la wa.
Harɛre ta bobɛlbwa baa la la, ba chɔɡ n sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la, dɛkalkɛ nɛra dɛ bol ba waa ŋɔ, ‘Korowii nɛraa nɔ, kɛ o doŋ ba o harɛ ta.’ N sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la waa hiah mɛ, chɔɡa Israel tena aa chɔɡo tɛ harɛre ta nɛra, bela bwa baa laŋa.
Anomanta, ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, ‘He waa laa mɛɛ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ.
N sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ he chɔɡo tɛ harɛre nɛra, bela bwa haa laŋa la waa.
Mɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ n sɔnjen la aa do ɡoroŋ, n sɔn haa chɔɡo tɛ harɛre nɛra la.
Ásɛ harɛre nɛra la bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Nemenɛ Korowii.
He nɛɛ mɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ chaɡle kɛŋɔ n do ɡoroŋ ba siwi ta.
Mɛɛ lawɛ heyaa dɛ́ boa he nyoa le harɛre la ta, dɛ́ ba he ne he ɡbaɡba harɛ ta.
Mɛɛ ɛ nedɛɛɡaa merɛ he nɛ, dɛ́ laa doŋa haa kaah la kpɔ he nɛ.
Mɛɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwaa kpɔ he nɛ, dɛ́ le heyaa le voɡa toma ɡe ta.
Mɛɛ tɛ heyaa bambifale ne liifalaa, ásɛ he won dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ta.
Mɛɛ laa he bambile waa do kɛ bwe laanee kpɔ, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bambile waa pwɛra.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n domaa ba so he nɛ, ásɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ me Mmarare, ne waa maa baɡle heyaa la ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ he naawa laanee n berɛ dɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ heyaa hé so o ta, ásɛ he ɛ n nɛra, ń ɡe ɛ Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ.
Mɛɛ lɛ heyaa le waa aa ɡela hɛɛ kah doŋa la ta, dɛ́ ɡel mea bu, dɛ́ doŋi lɔr le harɛ la ta, ásɛ he bɛ lɔr na.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he daa nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ koo kondikwaa ɡe ɛ kohona, ásɛ sihiih bɛ heyaa kpo harɛre ta nɛra be kondikwaa wa.
Belaa hɛ́ɛ ba he wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre ne he nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla bwa liira, ásɛ he baah di he ɡbaɡba nɛɛ wechɔɡa ne kii waa haa ɛa la.
Israel tena, n dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ he waa laa mɛɛ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ.
N dɛ nyin kɛ sihiih kpo heyaa we-ɛɛla haa dɛ ɛ la wa!’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola maa ba laa he doŋa bwa kpɔ he nɛɛ la, mɛɛ berɔ ɡel he ba so he bwɛɛre la ta, dɛ́ berɛ kwaa vɔrɔwe anɔ la aa ɛ dimɡbeeni la bwa.
Harɛ waa chɔ pɛɛ la ɛɛ berɛ harɛparee, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ kpɔ o ta la na kɛŋɔ o ta pɛɛ chɔe kpa.
Baa ŋɔɔ, ‘Harɛ waa chɔ pɛɛ laanee bera do kɛŋɔ Korowii Eden bodɛɛɡe la, bwɛjena a fa aa paɡra, dɛ chɔ pɛɛ laanee ba berɛ kwaa ma danjwɛɛre bara nɛra so a ta la.’ Belaa harɛre aa kaa dɛ bar heyaa cheme la ɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ, menee bera ba vɔrɔwe bwɛjena a fa aa paɡra dɛ chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ berɛ ɡel harɛ la ɛ harɛpare la.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola, mɛɛ ɛo ɡe.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ berɔ no Israel tena wesoŋa ja, ásɛ dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa la tɛɛ ba.
N dɛ ba ɡela ba warɛ kɛŋɔ peera ken.
Baa warɔɔ kɛŋɔ peera baa teɡa dɛɛ kaa dɛ́ ka kpoo ɛ saraha Jerusalam tɔpejena dii ta ken.
Bwɛjena a fa aa paɡra la, nɛra ɛɛ ba su a binii, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.”
Fɛlembɔjen hoɡa aa suu wa Korowii kpeɡri ba men Ɛsekeɛl nɛ, asɛ o Doma kpɔ mɛ le ka che fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, dɛ hoɡa su o ta bwa.
Doma la tɔ n sie la sie, dɛ ba n ne habɔɔ hoɡa la bini, asɛ n na hoɡa a warɛ chɔ fɛlembɔjen la bini, dɛ a bwara loɡao kɛrɛdɛ.
O bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, hoɡa nɔ ɛɛ won berɛ ba ɛ nɛra dɛ́ dɔ mkpa ja aa?” Belaa n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, he ɡboo dɛ́ won jemɛ.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bol hoɡa la be, waa aa dɛ ba a nɛɛ bala.
Ŋɔ á cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no men Korowii wa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii, n dɛ bol hoɡa la be ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ tɛ heyaa hweeraa hé berɛ dɔ mkpa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo dɛɛhne ba he nɛ, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bo-ol, dɛ́ kpɔ tɔn bɔle, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa hweera hé dɔ mkpa.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ” Anomanta, n bol waa aa dɛ ba a nɛɛ bala ɡɛ Korowii aa do mɛ la.
N nyoa ta aa lɔ wobol la ta la, asɛ kerabeŋkpoŋ n no ɡbɔɡa ane kohona, asɛ hoɡa la pa mun baa choŋri dɔŋa nɛ.
Maa dɛ nyiŋi la, n nao kɛŋɔ dɛɛhne ne bo-ol aa ba a ta, asɛ bɔtɔn bɔla, kɛ dɛ hweera toole a ta.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, yerɛ peu dɛ́ bol waa aa dɛ ba bala, dɛ́ ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Peu, le bobɛlbwa dɛ́ ba jo nɛra baa kpoo ba bil nɔ bini, ásɛ ba dɔ hweera dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.’ ” Anomanta, n bol waa la ɡɛ Korowii aa do mɛ la, asɛ hweera ba ba bini ba won hweera, dɛ dɔ mkpa dɛ ir che.
Ba warɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ laa tena.
Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, Israel tena bwa do kɛ hoɡa nɔ.
Ba dɛ bol ŋɔ ya hoɡa bwa loɡao, ya ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe, ya toole wobɛlbwa bini.
Anomanta, bol waa aa dɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala dɛ́ ŋɔ, men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘N nɛra Israel tena, n dɛ ba he ŋwama pila, dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa le, dɛ́ berɛ ba he ne Israel harɛ ta.
N nɛra, maa ba pili he ŋwama dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa le a bini la, a taa hɛɛ ba jema kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n Domaa ba so he nɛɛ hé dɔ mkpa, ásɛ n kpɔ heyaa kaa he ɡbaɡba harɛ ta ka so.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowii, waa maa bola la, n ɛa.
Men Korowiirii bola.’ ” Juda ne Israel harɛre bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, kpɔ da ásɛ dɛ chwerɛ o ta ŋɔ, ‘Kon nɔ ɛ Juda ne Israel tena baa ja o nɛɛ la kon.’ Berɛ kpɔ danɛɛte dɛ́ chwerɛ o ta ŋɔ, ‘Kon nɔ ɛ Efrem kon, dɛ che tɛ Josef ne Israel tena baa ja o nɛɛ la kon.’ Kpɔa pɛ á do kɛ daa beŋkpoŋii lɔ he nɔn ta.
He bwɛɛ tena bɔɔre ŋɔ he baɡ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ mun aa, he ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ kpɔ daa waa ɛ Josef kon dɛ do Efrem nɔn ta dɛ ɛ Israel deene baa ja o nɛɛ laanee, dɛ́ kpɔ pɛ daa waa ɛ Juda kon la ta, á do n nɔn ta dɛ́ ɛ daa beŋkpoŋ.’ Kpɔ daa haa chwerɛ a ta la kpoŋe ba siwi ta, dɛ́ ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ lawɛ n nɛra Israel tenaa le harɛre baa chwaa ka so a ta laanee.
Mɛɛ boa ba nyoa le bela bwa baa lole, dɛ́ berɛ ba ba ne ba ɡbabir harɛ ta.
Mɛɛ lɔ baa pɛ bá ɛ harɛ beŋkpoŋ nɛra, dɛ́ so Israel bwejena dor.
Kooro beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ, ásɛ ba bini aa pere dɛ́ ɛ harɛ anɛ nɛra kpa.
Baa voɡaa tomɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa maa kia dɛ kah doŋa, kɛɛ dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa kpa, dɛkalkɛ mɛɛ lɛɛ baa le wechɔɡa bwa aa ɡela ba le habɔɔ la taa, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛ.
Mɛɛ kpɔ baa ɛ n nɛra, n ɡe ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ.
Kooro waa do kɛ n bonɔɔ Kooro Devid la, onee dɛ́ ɛ ba kooro, dɛ́ do kɛ peteɡre beŋkpoŋ dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Baa teŋɛ me Mmarare ne waa maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba taa kasinteŋ ne.
Harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ n bonɔɔ Jekɔb la taa baa ba soɡa, harɛ ba naawa fa aa soɡe o ta la.
Ba ne ba bii ne naanar, dɛ ba ɡe bii ɛɛ so o taa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, ásɛ kooro waa do kɛ n bonɔɔ Kooro Devid ɛ ba kooro saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
N ne baa fɔwɛ deŋnesɔɔhna fɔwee o do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ba do kpeɡri ba mun ya kohona, ásɛ n kpɔ n Dea la ba cheɡ ba harɛ ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Ba baahnee mɛɛ ba soɡa, dɛ́ ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra.
N kpɔ n Dea la ba cheɡ ba harɛ la ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la naa, anee dɛ́ ɡel harɛre nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee le Israel tena tɛ n te.’ ”
Korowii bol nomonjen Gɔɡ chɔɡa wa Korowii bol waa men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, eɡle sie ta koonomoa Gɔɡ waa lɔ Maɡɔɡ harɛ ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi Mɛsɛk ne Tubal harɛre ta.
Bol waa aa dɛ ba o nɛɛ bala dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii, n ne o dɔɔ.
Mɛɛ sɔɔh o nyoa, dɛ́ kpɔ ɡoŋre do o nyoa ta, dɛ́ tɛɡro, dɛ́ kpɔ o ne o laa tena bwa kaa.
O nɛra baa vɔwɛ ntoa dɛ so jaɡre ta, ne laa tena baa kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe, ba bwa ɛɛ beɡre ba keri bobɛlbwa.
Baala baa le Pɛɛsea, ne Itiopia, dɛ Libya harɛre ta bwa ɛɛ ba ja o nɛɛ, dɛ́ kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta, ne bune ɡbɛrɛre.
Laa tena bwa baa le Goma, ne Bɛt Toɡama waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr bwa baa ja o nɛ, ɡɛɛ harɛre kɛrɛdɛ bwa laa tena ɡe ba ja.
Ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o ne o laa tena damanta baa baa ja o nɛɛ bwa ir, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te, ásɛ o tɔ ba sie.
Bene ane habɔɔ la, mɛɛ ɡeloo o nyin dɔmkwa, dɛ́ ka bar Israel harɛ ba fa aa yoo o chɔ pɛɛ la.
O nɛraa ba boa ba nyoa le harɛre ta, ba ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta la.
O ne o laa tena ne harɛre ta nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la ɛɛ warɔɔ, dɛ́ ba harɛ la ta kɛ peukpeɡ, dɛ́ ba tɔ harɛ la ta bobɛlbwa kɛŋɔ bam ken.
Waa men Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol nomonjen Gɔɡ be laanee nɔ, ‘Awola tɔpere la, liichɔɡa ɛɛ pa munii ba he nyu bini, ásɛ hɛɛ nyin a ŋwɛnɛre.
Hɛɛ ŋɔɔ hɛɛ ka yo Israel harɛ ta bwɛɛre baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, baa wola danjwɛjena mae bara, a ba ɛ kɛ aa dɔ doonyoo ba kpɔ bune dɛɛ kaɡra laanee.
Hɛɛ pa nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjena a bwa fa aa paɡra dɛ ɛ dimɡbeeni la laalaa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ nyoa ba boa le harɛre ane ta la.
Taraken, ba dɔ kondɛɛra ne laala tenten dɛ so harɛ la baah ta.’ ” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Seeba ne Dedan, dɛ bonadiire baa le Taases ne o bwɛjeɡre ta ɛɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ, ‘Hɛɛ boa he laa tena nyoa, dɛ́ ba yo dɛ́ pa suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa, kondɛɛra ne laala kɛŋɔ laa ta kwaa dɛ́ kaa kɛɛ?’ ” Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, ka bol waa aa dɛ ba nomonjen Gɔɡ nɛɛ bala ŋɔ, ‘Awola n nɛra Israel tena aa so ba deŋna sɔɔh ba la, haa ban na naa?
Hɛɛ le bojaŋ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔree, dɛ́ tɔ harɛre laa tena baa wara dɛ so jaɡre ta sie dɛ́ ba.
Ba ɛ laa tena baa wara dɛ do kpeɡri kohona.
Hɛɛ ba tɔ n nɛra Israel tena nɛɛ kɛŋɔ bam yon tɔ harɛ ta la.
Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo hen nomonjen Gɔɡ ba yo n nɛra Israel tena, ásɛ harɛre ta nɛra jem mɛ, maa ba che he nɛɛ dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ n do ɡoroŋ ba siwi ta la.
He waa laa n faa che n bonɔɔna baa ɛ Israel keamere nɛɛ dɛ bol la aa?
A ɡɛ saŋ la, n bol waa aa dɛ ba bala biɡri kɛŋɔ mɛɛ ɡeloo nomonjen Gɔɡ ba yoo ba.
Waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa awola tɔpere laanee nɔ.
Nomonjen Gɔɡ kaa yo Israel tena ba harɛ ta naa, n baah ɛɛ diu kohona.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
N siwi aa beɡre n baah di kohona awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ jiɡri kohona Israel harɛ ta.
Pɛŋa aa lɔ mpo ta, ne jumbii aa dɛ ɡah, ne kpɔɡ bini ola, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta, ne anɔ la aa dɛ huuh, dɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta bwa bwara ɛɛ sa n siee.
Bwejena bwa ɛɛ huɡruu, diŋɡoŋni kuuɡi, ásɛ bwɛjena danjwɛɛre bwa ɡe choɡli.
Wenaale bɛlbwa soo siwii mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba ta nomonjen Gɔɡ nɛ.
Ba bini bɛlbwa ɛɛ berɛ o keree ba o dɔŋ nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Weechɔɡa ne nɛŋkpoaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba tɛr ba deŋne.
Bwaalajen ɛɛ nɛo kohona, ásɛ dombwea ne jebɔrɔwe nii lee nomonjen Gɔɡ ne o laa tena, dɛ harɛre laa tena baa ja o nɛɛ bwa nɛ.
Gɛ taa mɛɛ ba ɡela harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra na ɡɛ maa kana dɛ do ɡoroŋ.
Ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.’ ”
Nomonjen Gɔɡ nɛɛ pɔe Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, bol waa aa dɛ ba koonomoa Gɔɡ waa ɛ koonomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Mɛsɛk ne Tubal be ŋɔ, n ne o dɔɔ.
Kenii men Nemenɛ Korowii bol, ‘Mɛɛ sɔɔh he nyoa dɛ́ tuuɡi harɛ le he ne bojaŋ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr le, dɛ́ kpɔe ka ta Israel bwejena la dor.
Mɛɛ lɔ he to waa lɔ he nɔŋɡal taa ta, ásɛ dɛ ɡel he hɛma le he diɡ ta lee.
Israel bwejena taa hɛɛ ba sewa, he ne he laa tena bwa, ne harɛre ta laa tena baa ja he nɛɛ bwa.
Mɛɛ kpɔe tɛ jumbii ne kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa aa di konlala, he ɛ a kondikwa.
Kpɔɡ binii hɛɛ ba sewa chɔ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ kpɔ niinii ba fuh Maɡɔɡ harɛ ne nɛra baa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta mpo nyoo, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n nɛra Israel tena jemɛ kɛ n sɔn do ɡoroŋ, dɛ bɛ doŋa kpɔ kah n sɔn kpa.
Ásɛ harɛre ta nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Israel Nɛŋɡoroŋ la.
Tɔpere la ta dɛ ba, wɛɛ bao kpela.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Nɛra baa soɡe Israel bwɛɛre ta la ɛɛ leo ka pa dɔmkwaa la, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ damara.
Dɔmkwaa kɛŋɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta, anjena ne anjeɡre, tori ne hɛma, ne koŋkwaa baa dɛ yo a ne laa bwa soo siwi, dɛ lampeare.
Bene anuanɛ dɛ ba ta dɛ mara.
Aa hiah kɛŋɔ ba la kpɔɡ bini ka nyin daa kɛɛ dɛ́ ka teŋni daa kɔr bini ba mar kpa, dɛkalkɛ baa dɛɛ mar dɔmkwaa laanee.
Ba ɡe ɛɛ ka pa nɛra baa pa ba laala laa ta la laalaa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ tɛ nomonjen Gɔɡ lala huɡribɔree Israel harɛ ta, fɛlembɔjen waa lɔ wee leebɔr ŋwɛnɛ nɛra aa kpɔ o ta baa kaa mpo ta la.
Huɡribɔr la ɛɛ tɔ bela nɛra aa kpɔa baa kaa la ŋwɛnɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ belaa baa ba nomonjen Gɔɡ ne o laa tena bwa huɡa.
Anomanta, baa yerɛ belaa Hamɔn Gɔɡ Fɛlembɔjen.
Korobie anuanɛ dɛ Israel tena ta dɛ huɡ ba ɡɛ, dɛ́ won laa doŋa kpɔ harɛ la ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ la ta la ɛɛ jao dɛɛ huɡ ba.
Awola tɔpere la, baa tɛ mɛ jirimaa, ásɛ o ɛ tɔpere baa kpɔ dɛɛ lii a ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Korobie anuanɛ habɔɔ la, baa le baalaa ba ɡaaɡe harɛ la ta bwa dɛ huɡe banɔ la baa wola ban nae huɡe la bwa, ásɛ dɛ laa harɛ la ta doŋa kpɔ.
Ba dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛ ka le hoɡ la bɛl nɛ aa, baa kpɔ konee pa bela, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ kwi lalbɔɔne la ba kpɔ ka huɡe Hamɔn Gɔɡ Fɛlembɔjen la bini.
Bwɛɛ bɛl ɛɛ bɛne belaa ba kpɔ o sɔn pa laa tena la, dɛɛ yerɔ Hamona.
Gɛɛ baa ba doŋa laa kpɔ harɛ la ta.’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, yerɛ jumbii bwa soo siwi, dɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa bwa ŋɔ, ‘Hé bwa le ba boa nyoa, dɛ́ di saraha maa dɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ.
O ɛ sarahajen Israel bwejena dor.
Hɛɛ di olaa dɛ́ nyɔ chal.
Hɛɛ di laa tena olaa, dɛ́ nyɔ koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta chale kɛŋɔ pebala ne pebiiri, kɛɛ boohna ne nabala a bwa aa dɔ bo-ola kɛrɛdɛ dɛ le Basan harɛ ken.
Saraha maa dɛ ba ɛɛ tɛ heyaa la, hɛɛ di ola aa dɔ noo a ba pe heya, dɛ́ nyɔ chal kohona a dɛɛ heya.
N tiɡ ta, hɛɛ di jaɡre ne nɛra ba dɛ so a ta, ne banyoola, dɛ laa tena bwa soo siwii olaa, dɛ́ vaɡre ɡɛ bwa haa dɛ nyin.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛre ta nɛra na n jirima, dɛ́ na n deŋnetɛra maa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba nɛ, ne ɡɛ maa cheɡɛ n kpeɡri ta dɛɛ ɛ, ne ɡɛ n liire aa wera.
Le awola dɛɛ kaa la, mɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.
Harɛre ta nɛra ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ, Israel tena wechɔɡa baa ɛa laanee ɡela ba dɔma laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta, dɛkalkɛ ba le n habɔɔ.
N laa sie kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ ba do ba dɔma nɔn ta, ba kpoo ba keri ne.
Ba wedoŋa ne wechɔɡa kohona nomanta, n laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba dɔ deŋnetɛra ɡɛ aa chɛa.’ ” Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ berɔɔ lawɛ Jekɔb naanar baa ɛ Israel tena laanee le bojaŋ harɛfale la ta, dɛ́ sune ba nɛ, ásɛ n sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la bɛ chɔɡ.
Baa soh ba sihihwaa ne kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe dɛ tɛ mɛ ɡɛ saŋ baa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta ba harɛ ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola ban aah la.
Maa laɡ ba le harɛre ta, ba dɔma harɛre baa soɡe a ta dɛ́ ba boa ba nyoa la, mɛɛ che ba nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel harɛre ta nɛra jemɛ kɛ n do ɡoroŋ.
Belaa baa ba jema kɛŋɔ, menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.
A lole kɛŋɔ n doŋ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfala ta te, kɛ mɛɛ boa ba nyoaa, dɛ́ ba ba ne ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta, maa bɛlbwa habɔɔ ta.
Maa sie laa kpɔ ba nɛɛ kpa, mɛɛ kpɔ n Domaa ba so Israel tena nɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Korowii Defale la bɔr wa Baa lawɛ yaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue ta, benfale tɔpera fi ta la, dɛ Jerusalam aa paɡra bene fi dɛ anaarɛ habɔɔ.
Awola tɔpere laanee Korowii kpeɡri ba n nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ mɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Korowii kpɔ mɛ kaa Israel harɛ ta ka chɔŋɛ bwejen bɛl waa kaa nyundua kohona doa chaahna ta.
Bwejen la weekaŋle harɛbɔr, n na deene ane bela kɛŋɔ bwɛjen bɛl ken.
O la n ne bela, asɛ n na baa bɛl waa cheɡɛ deene la doonyoa dɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ ayaawa.
O kpoŋe ŋwɛmpoŋ ne daa baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwa.
Baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ cheɡ deŋne no waa maa dɛ ba he be bola nɔ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛ a waa n ba he ne bonɔ.
Ásɛ dɛ ka bol wobɛlbwa haa naa Israel tena be.” Doonyoa waa lɔ wee leebɔr N na danjwɛɛ waa bar Korowii Dea la cheme.
Baa la kpɔ o daa la o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale anuanaarɛ maɡɛ danjwɛɛ la.
O bare lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ, o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɡe lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ.
Belaa o kaa doonyoa waa chaɡɛ wee leebɔr la ta, dɛ ka che kon baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ teeh la, dɛ teeh kaa nyundua dɛ ka maɡɛ doonyoa waa lɔ bela ɡe, o ɡe lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ.
Dejeɡre atoro lɔ bela nɛra che a bini dɛɛ daah bɔr.
A bɛlbwa paɡri lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ, asɛ a jaŋne ɡe lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ.
Ba ma danjwɛɛ o bare aa ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama dɛ teŋni a baahna.
Baa la maɡɛ bɔr waa chɔa kaa dejeɡre la doonyoa, asɛ o ɛ naɡale anuanaarɛ.
O berɔ maɡɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ kaa doonyoa la ta, o lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anɛ, o doonyoa daa la ɡe bare lɔ naɡale atoro.
Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la sie chaɡɛ Korowii Dea la.
Wee leebɔr doonyoa la bini bela, dejeɡre atoro lɔ baŋ bɛlbwa ta, a bwa kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ danjwɛɛre aa lɔ a baŋ bɛlbwa ta la ɡe kɛrɛdɛ.
Ate, baa la berɛ maɡɛ bɔr baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ kaa doonyoa la ta paɡri.
O lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anue, asɛ o jaŋne ka tama o ɛ naɡale fifraanɛ.
Dejeɡre la bɛlbwa sie, ba ma danjwɛɛ o jaŋne aa kaa nyundua dɛ ɛ naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama, asɛ dejeɡre la bɛlbwa bini paɡri ne o jaŋne lɔ naɡale anuananaarɛ.
Asɛ dɛ berɛ maɡɛ le dea la habɔɔ danjwɛɛ la ta, dɛ ba ɡale bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, asɛ a ka tama a ɛ naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.
O maɡɔ le dea waa lɔ tia la dɛ ba Korowii Dea dembaah la ta, o lɔ naɡale fifraanuanaarɛ.
Le doonyoa waa lɔ Dea la habɔɔ, dɛ kaa doonyoa waa lɔ nyoa ta dea la ta ɡe lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.
Bɔjeɡre lɔ dejeɡre la habɔɔ danjwɛɛ ne bini danjwɛɛ la ta.
Ba ɛ bambie daa maɡre bini danjwɛɛre aa chaɡɛ bɔr waa chɔa kaa la ta.
Habɔɔ dembaah Baa la kpɔ mɛ jo habɔɔ dembaah la bini.
Bela la, n na deene fifraatoro baa maa pɛl danjwɛɛ la, ne ŋwɛnɛ bɛl baa mao bwea ne o ir nyundua, dɛ bar dembaah la cheme.
Gɛ ŋwɛnɛ la chɔɔ bar dembaah la.
Habɔɔ dembaah la lɔ harɛ dɛ ɡwaa bini dembaah la.
O maɡɔ le bini doonyoa la ta, dɛ ba harɛbɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ ba bini dembaah la baŋ.
O wee leebɔr la ne o weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanunue.
Weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa Baa la maɡɛ doonyoa o sie aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr paɡri ne o jaŋne.
Belaa ba che dɛɛ jo habɔɔ dembaah la ta.
Dejeɡre la, atoro lɔ baŋ bɛl, atoro ɡe do baŋ bɛl.
A danjwɛɛre ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la bwa jaŋne ne a paɡri kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ doonyoloɡle la ken.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, o paɡri ɡe ka tama o tel naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.
Dea la bɔjeɡre ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, dɛ bambie daa baa ɛa dawɛ danjwɛɛ la ta o do wer la bwa, ba maɡa a ɛ kɛrɛdɛ, kɛŋɔ doonyoa waa chaɡɛ wee leebɔr la.
Kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta anuanɛ lɔ bela, a sie chaɡɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la.
Dɛ doonyoa bɛl lɔ bini dembaah la ta, dɛ chaɡɛ doonyoa waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ɡɛ tenten wee leebɔr doonyoa la aa doa la.
O maɡɔ le doonyoa bɛl ta, dɛ kaa bɛl o ɡe sie aa chaɡɔ ta, asɛ a baah la ɛ naɡale lafa fifraanue.
Weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa Baa la kpɔ mɛ kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera, asɛ n na doonyoa bɛl o sie aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
O maɡɛ doonyoa daa la ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, a bwa ne anɔ la maɡa ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Doonyoa la ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, bɔjeɡre lɔ a ta kɛŋɔ bɔɔne aa lɔ anɔ la ta la.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, asɛ o paɡri ɡe ka tama a tel naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.
Kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta anuanɛ lɔ bela.
A sie chaɡɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, asɛ ba ɛ bambie daa dawɛ danjwɛɛre la baŋ bɛlbwa ta a do wer.
Bini dembaah la dɔ doonyoa o sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ o che doonyoa la ta maɡɛ kaa doonyoa waa lɔ habɔɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr la ta, o ɛ naɡale lafa fifraanue.
Doonyoo aa dɛ kaa dembaah bini bela Ate, baa la kpɔ mɛ kpɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ ba n ne bini dembaah la ta.
O maɡɛ doonyoa waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr la, asɛ o ne anɔ la bwa ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
O dejeɡre ne danjwɛɛre aa lɔ bini la, ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo o ta la bwa, ba maɡa a ɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ anɔ la ken.
Doonyoa la ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo o ta la dɔ bɔjeɡre a bwa ta.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, o paɡri ɡe ka tama o tel naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.
Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo doonyoo aa lɔ bini dembaah la ta bwa la paɡri ka tama o tel naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.
He joɔ dɛɛ kaa bini ɡe aa, a lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama.
Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo o ta la sie chaɡɛ habɔɔ dembaah la, asɛ ba ɛ bambie daa dawɛ danjwɛɛre aa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ la ta la ta.
Ba ma kwaa anuatoro bela baa che a ta teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta.
Wee leebɔr doonyoa waa lɔ bini dembaah Baa la berɔ laɡ mɛ ba bini dembaah la ta, wee leebɔr pera, dɛ ba maɡɛ bela doonyoa la, o maɡa a ne anɔ la bwa ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
O dejeɡre ne o bini danjwɛɛre, dɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo, ne anɔ la bwa maɡa kɛrɛdɛ.
Doonyoa la ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, bɔɔne lɔ a bwa ta.
A jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, a paɡri ɡe ka tama o ɛ naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.
Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo o ta la sie chaɡɛ habɔɔ dembaah la, asɛ ba ɛ bambie daa dawɛ danjwɛɛre aa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ la ta.
Ba do kwaa anuatoro bela baa che a ta teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta.
Ate, o berɛ laɡ mɛ ba weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ ba maɡɔ.
O ne anɔ la bwa, ba maɡa a ɛ kɛrɛdɛ, ɡɛɛ o dejeɡre ne bini danjwɛɛre, dɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la, bɔɔne do a bwa ta.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, o paɡri ɡe ka tama o ɛ naɡale fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro.
Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la sie chaɡɛ habɔɔ dembaah la, asɛ ba ɛ bambie daa dawɛ danjwɛɛre la bɛlbwa ta, a do wer.
Kwaa anuatoro do bela ba che a ta teeh dɛɛ kaa o ta.
Deene baa dɛ kwaa saraha kwaa a bini Dea bɛl pɛl bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo, doonyoo aa lɔ dem waa lɔ bini la bɛlbwa, belaa baa yaɡle saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah la.
Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo doonyoa ta la, teeburre anɛ cheɡɛ baŋ bɛlbwa ta.
A taa baa kpoo saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah, ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha kwa.
Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo danjwɛɛ la habɔɔ, weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa, teeburre anɛ cheɡɛ baŋ bɛl dɛ bɛne kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ teeh la, asɛ anɛ ɡe che a baŋ bɛl.
Gɛɛ a do asɛ teeburre anaarɛ che doonyoa la baŋ bɛlbwa ta, a bwa ɛ teeburre anuatoro, baa kpoo kwaa baa kpɔa baa ɛ saraha a ta.
Ba sɛh bwea ɛ teeburre anaarɛ ɡe tɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ ɛ sarahare.
Bɛlbwa jaŋne ka tama o ɡwaa naɡale anɛ, o paɡri ɡe ka tama o ɡwaa naɡale anɛ, asɛ o daŋa ɡe ɛ naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama.
A taa ba yon kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ kpoo, dɛɛ kwaa saraha kwaa baa fuah, dɛɛ dawɛ.
Ba ɡoŋe bune a nyoo ɛ anɛnɛ pɛ danjwɛɛ la ta dɛ bar, a jaŋne do kɛ nɔmpaa del.
Dɛ kpɔ saraha ola la dɛɛ dawɛ teeburre la ta.
Sɔfore deene Baa la berɔ kpɔ mɛ ba bini dembaah la ta.
Deene anɛ lɔ bela.
Bɛl lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa la jwɛh, o sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, onɔ la ɡe do weekaŋle harɛbɔr, o sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Dea o sie aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr la ɛ sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea toma la kon, asɛ onɔ la o ɡe sie aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la ɛ sɔfore baa dɛ nyiŋi kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la kon.
Banee Sadɔk naanar, ba ɡboo ɛ Lewi dea tena baa dɛ ba wona la Korowii sie dɛ́ kaa tomɔ.” Asɛ baa la maɡɛ dembaah la, o ɛ fɔɔskwɛɛ.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue, o paɡri ɡe naɡale lafa fifraanue.
Asɛ saraha kon la che Korowii Dea la sie.
Korowii Dea la Baa la kpɔ mɛ ba bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo Korowii Dea la, dɛ ba maɡɛ bela doonyoa daa la.
A baŋ bɛlbwa paɡri lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama.
O doonyoa la paɡri ɡe lɔ naɡale fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ, asɛ danjwɛɛ waa lɔ bini la baŋ bɛlbwa bare lɔ naɡale anaarɛ ne tama.
Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la paɡri lɔ naɡale fifraatoro, le o nyoa ta kaa o tia ɡe lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anuatoro.
Kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛ teeh dɛɛ kaa lɔ o ta, asɛ pilare do doonyoa daa la jwɛh.
A habɔɔ la, baa la laɡ mɛ ba Korowii Dea la bini waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛ ba maɡɛ o doonyoa daa la.
Baŋ bɛlbwa paɡri lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ.
Doonyoa la ɡbaɡba paɡri lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anue, asɛ o danjwɛɛre aa vaah le baŋ la paɡri ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama.
O berɔ maɡɛ Dea la bini ɡe.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanumɛl, asɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale fifraatoro.
Belaa o jo Korowii Dea la bini tenten, dɛ ka maɡɛ o doonyoa daa.
Bɛlbwa paɡri lɔ naɡale atoro.
Doonyoa la ɡbaɡba ɡe paɡri lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ.
O danjwɛɛre aa vaah le baŋ la bɛlbwa bare lɔ naɡale fi ne tama.
O maɡɛ Korowii Dea la bini tenten jaŋne, o ɛ naɡale fifraatoro, asɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale fifraatoro dɛ kaa dea waa lɔ bini la ta.
Asɛ o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bonɔ ɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten.” O maɡɛ Korowii Dea la danjwɛɛ la ɡe.
O bare lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ, dɛ dɔ deene a do o bini a do baŋ bɛlbwa ta bar.
Deene aa bar Korowii Dea la bɛlbwa paɡri lɔ naɡale anumɛl.
Dejeɡre aa baro la chɔŋre dɔŋa nɛɛ bele atoro.
Baŋ bɛlbwa lɔ deene fifraatoro.
Ba ma danjwɛjeɡre bar Korowii Dea la danjwɛɛ dɛ bar, a lawɛ dejeɡre la kpoŋe.
Korowii Dea la danjwɛɛ ɡbaɡba ta laa ba ma sawɛ.
Danjwɛɛre aa bar Korowii Dea la harɛbɔr bare kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, nyundua deene baa dɛ cheɡ kwaa a bini la, paɡri ɡwaa harɛbɔr deene la.
Ba ma kwaa baa cheɡɛ a ta teeh le harɛ dɛɛ kaa nyundua.
Ba maa le mun ta deene la ta, dɛ kpɔ baah deene la ta, dɛ kaa nyundua kwaa la ta.
N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii Dea la chɔŋɛ bela waa daŋa dɛ baro, ba ma dejeɡre aa lɔ Korowii Dea la keŋkeŋna chɔŋɛ bela.
Bela daŋa ne daa waa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ la bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
O ɡwaa naɡale anuanaarɛ.
Dejeɡre la danjwɛɛ waa lɔ habɔɔ la bare lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama.
Baah waa chɔ dejeɡre aa lɔ Korowii Dea la ne sɔfore deene la baah paɡri lɔ naɡale fifraatoro dɛ bar Korowii Dea la.
Doonyoo lɔ dejeɡre la ta dɛ le baah la ta.
Beŋkpoŋ lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, asɛ beŋkpoŋ ɡe do weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Bela waa daŋa ba ma dejeɡre chɔŋɛ o ta la teŋɛ baah la ta.
O bare lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama dɛ bar.
Dea o sie aa chaɡɛ Korowii Dea dembaah wee cholibɔr pera la paɡri lɔ naɡale lafa dɛ anue.
Danjwɛɛ la bare lɔ naɡale anuanɛ ne tama dɛ bar, o jaŋne ɡe lɔ naɡale lafa fifraatoro dɛ anue.
Baa la maɡɛ Korowii Dea la.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue, asɛ o dembaah ne deene dɛ a danjwɛɛre bwa ɡe jaŋne lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue.
Korowii Dea la dembaah wee leebɔr pera ne o sie bwa paɡri lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue.
O berɔ maɡɛ dea o sie aa chaɡɛ dembaah dɛ do Korowii Dea la bini, ne dejeɡre aa lɔ baŋ bɛlbwa ta baa cheɡ laala a bini jaŋne, a ɛ naɡale lafa fifraanue.
Korowii Dea la bini doonyoa, ne Boɡoroŋ la, dɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten, ne daa baa kpɔa tɔ a ta le harɛ kaa tokorore ta la, ba kpɔ daa la tɔ tokorore la ta.
Danjwɛɛre aa lɔ Korowii Dea la bini tenten la, ba ɛ kwaa dawɛ daa ta, dɛ kpɔ bɔle le nyundua ba ɡbeni la ta bwa, ba ɛ Kerobim ne bambie daa dawɛ a ta.
Bambie daa tɔ sie, asɛ Kerobim la teŋɛ, ɡɛɛ a do dɛ bar dea la bini.
Kerob la bɛlbwa dɔ siebɔra anɛnɛ.
Bɛl siebɔr do kɛŋɔ nɛn, dɛ chaɡɛ bambie daa la baŋ bɛl, bɛl ɡe siebɔr do kɛŋɔ nyujente, dɛ chaɡɛ bambie daa la baŋ bɛl.
Ba ɛa dawɛ danjwɛɛ la ta bar, dɛ le Dea la harɛ kaa ɡbeni la nyundua.
Dea la bini doonyoa daa la ɛ baŋne anaarɛ, baŋne anɛ jaŋne ɡwaa baŋne anɛ ɡe.
Gɛɛ onɔ la waa lɔ Boɡoroŋ Tenten doonyoa ta ɡe do.
Ba kpɔ daa kwaa kon baa dɛɛ ɛ saraha o ta.
O daŋa lɔ naɡale anaarɛ ne tama, dɛ dɔ baŋne anaarɛ.
Bɛlbwa lɔ naɡale atoro.
Asɛ baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Teebur waa cheɡɛ Korowii sie laanee la.” Korowii Dea la bini ne Boɡoroŋ Tenten la bwa dɔ ɡbeni anɛnɛ.
Ba dɛ ya bɛlbwa baŋne anɛ, ɡbeni la bɛlbwa dɔ njinasoɔ anɛnɛ.
Korowii Dea la bini la, ba ɛ Kerobim ne bambie daa dawɛ a ɡbeni ta kɛŋɔ anɔ la baa ɛa dawɛ danjwɛɛre la ta la ken, asɛ daa bɛl saɡɛ bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo la sie.
Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo danjwɛɛre la baŋ bɛlbwa ta la, ba do tokorojeɡre, dɛ ɛ bambie daa dawɛ danjwɛɛre la baŋ bɛlbwa ta.
Deene aa lɔ Korowii Dea la keŋkeŋni ɡe ta, ba saɡɛ daa a ta.
Sɔfore deene Baa la tɔ men Ɛsekeɛl sie, dɛ la n ne Korowii Dea weekaŋle nyunduabɔr o habɔɔ dembaah la ta, dɛ kpɔ mɛ jo deene a sie aa chaɡɛ Dea la dembaah, ne danjwɛɛ waa lɔ o baŋ bɛl weekaŋle nyunduabɔr pera.
Dea o doonyoa aa chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la jaŋne lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue, asɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.
Ŋwɛnɛ waa chɔ bini dembaah, ne onɔ la waa lɔ habɔɔ Korowii Dea la bɔr baah lɔ naɡale fifraatoro.
Ba ma deene atoro chɔŋre dɔŋa nɛɛ kaa nyundua ŋwɛnɛ la baŋ bɛlbwa ta, a sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa, asɛ bɔr do a sie nɛn won che bela.
Ŋwɛnɛ chɔ deene la sie bini bela.
O paɡri lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anue, o jaŋne ɡe lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue.
A doonyoo sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Deene aa lɔ nyundua la aa paɡe kɛŋɔ anɔ la aa lɔ baah ta ne harɛ bɔr kwaa la, dɛkalkɛ a chɔŋre dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛ le habɔɔ.
Deene aa lɔ nyundua la ta pilare dɔe kɛ dembaah kwaa la, anomanta, a bini aa kanɛ kɛŋɔ baah ta ne harɛ bɔr kwaa la.
Danjwɛɛ bɛl lɔ deene la habɔɔ o sie chaɡɛ habɔɔ dembaah la, dɛ teŋe kpɔ deene la sie.
O lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.
Deene aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛ do baŋ bɛl habɔɔ dembaah la jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue, asɛ anɔ la aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛ bɛne Korowii Dea la ɡe lɔ naɡale lafa fifraanue.
Nɛn le habɔɔ dembaah la ta dɛɛ ba naa, doonyoo aa lɔ harɛ deene ta la lɔ wee leebɔr.
Habɔɔ dembaah weekaŋle harɛbɔr la, danjwɛɛ le bela dɛ ba Korowii Dea dembaah la ta.
O lɔ danjwɛɛ waa lɔ o habɔɔ la baŋ bɛl, asɛ deene do bela, ŋwɛnɛ chɔ a sie.
A do kɛŋɔ deene aa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la ken.
A jaŋne ne a paɡri bwa beŋkpoŋ, dɛ dɔ bela baa kpɔa dɛɛ le, dɛ bwa le dɔŋa.
Doonyoo aa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ne doonyoo aa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr la le dɔŋa.
Ŋwɛnɛ bɛl pa mun le wee leebɔr pera dɛ fɛrɛ danjwɛɛ la doonyoa a sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa, nɛn won che o ta dɛ jo deene la bini.
Baa la ŋɔ men Ɛsekeɛl be ŋɔ, “Deene aa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ne anɔ la aa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr a sie chaɡɛ Korowii Dea dembaah bela la, ɛ sɔfore deene.
Belaa sɔfore baa dɛ ba men Korowii sie la ɛɛ ba saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona la dɛɛ dii.
Deene la aa do ɡoroŋ kohona nomanta, a binii baa ba saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kohona kɛŋɔ mea sarahare, ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare, dɛ bolchɔɡe dii saraha kwaa kpɔe dɛɛ cheɡ.
Sɔfore la baa jo Korowii Dea dɛ ɛ ba toma tonaa, ba bɛ le kaa habɔɔ dembaah bela.
Bá foo laala baa doa ɛ toma la bil deene la bini, dɛkalkɛ a do ɡoroŋ.
Bá do laala pɛɛne mɔɔ dɛ́ le kaa nɛra la bini.” Waa maɡɛ Korowii Dea la bini bɔr bela tonɛ la, o tɔ n sie kpɔ mɛ le wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ maɡɛ bela bwa bar.
O kpɔ daa la maɡɛ wee leebɔr pera, o ɛ naɡale lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
O maɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ɡe, o ɛ naɡale lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
O berɔ maɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, o ɡe ɛ naɡale lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
Belaa o berɛ sie chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr pera ɡe dɛ maɡɛ.
O ɡe ɛ naɡale lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
Gɛɛ o maɡɛ baŋne anaarɛ la bwa.
Danjwɛɛ baro, asɛ o jaŋne ɛ naɡale lafraanuanɛ fifraanue, o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale lafraanuanɛ fifraanue, dɛ pere bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ la le bɔr waa wola ɡoroŋ doe la ta.
Korowii jirima berɔ ba o Dea Baa la kpɔ men Ɛsekeɛl ba Korowii Dea wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, asɛ n na Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la jirima o le wee leebɔr dɛɛ ba.
O taa do kɛŋɔ chuubu sii ken, asɛ o jirima chaah kohona harɛ la ta bwa.
Wepila la do kɛŋɔ anɔ la Korowii aa baa chɔɡ bwɛjen Jerusalam, ne Keba Moo nyoa kwaa maa naa la, asɛ n ba harɛ dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Korowii jirima la cheɡɛ wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ ba su o Dea la bini.
Belaa Korowii Doma la kpɔ mɛ ir, dɛ ba n ne bini dembaah la ta, asɛ Korowii jirima su o Dea bela.
Dɛ baa la cheɡɛ n jwɛh, asɛ n no nomɛl taa Korowii Dea la bini wɛɛ bol waa n be.
O ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, n kookara chebɔree bonɔ.
Bonɔɔ mɛɛ ba soɡa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛɛ nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛ.
Israel tena aa ba koranar baa serewaa ɛ kɛŋɔ voɡa aa wola mkpa dɔe, dɛɛ toma dɛɛ ɛ jwamanwa bonɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ doŋa kah n sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la kpa.
Koranar la kpɔ ba doonyoo ne a daa ba kpaɡɛ n Dea doonyoo kwaa la, asɛ danjwɛɛ teŋe n ne ba baah ta.
Ba ɛ waa maa kia, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah n sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la, asɛ n baah di n kpoo ba.
Bá ɡel jwamane la, dɛ́ pa ba voɡare ne ba koranar voɡare mkpa aa wola toole a ta la ta, ásɛ n ba so ba baah ta saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, baɡle ɡɛ n Dea la wa aa doa Israel tena be, ásɛ sihiih kpo ba ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa.
Gel ba nyiŋi o mar, dɛ sihiih kpo ba ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa aa, baɡ ba ɡɛ n Dea la mar aa doa.
Gɛ o bini mar ne o doonyoo baa cheɡɛ a ta jo dɛɛ le, dɛ́ baɡ ba o waa bwa.
Chwerɛ waa nɔ bwa bil ba, ásɛ ba won na ɡɛ Dea la wobɛlbwa aa doa, ásɛ ba jemɛ dɛ́ won dɛɛ teŋɛ mmarare la bwa ta.
Mmara waa chɔ le dɛ tɛ Korowii Dea laanee teŋa nɔ.
Bwejen la doa ne bɔr waa baro bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do ɡoroŋ kohona.
Kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta Naɡale baa kpɔa maɡɛ Korowii Dea la, ɡɛ tentenee ba maɡɛ saraha kon la ɡe.
Saraha kon la lɔɡa dɛ bar la, bɔɔ bɛl lɔ bela.
O paɡri lɔ naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama, o luŋri ɡe tel natuune ta, asɛ o nyoo dɛ bar bare ɛ nɔmpaa del.
Saraha kon la daŋaa nɔ, le o lɔɡa bɔɔ la ta, dɛ́ ba o keŋkeŋ bela waa wola kanɛ la lɔ naɡale atoro, o paɡri ɡe lɔ naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama.
Le o lɔɡa bela aa wola kanɛ dɛ́ ba o doa waa kana ɡe lɔ naɡale anumɛl, asɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama.
Saraha kon la nyundua bela baa kpo kwaa dɛɛ fuah la lɔ naɡale anumɛl, asɛ kwaane aa do kɛŋɔ nyeɡlare anaarɛ paaɡe o loŋkoni ta.
Kon baa dɛ ɛ sarahare o ta la ɛ fɔɔskwɛɛ.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fi dɛ anuatoro, asɛ o paɡri ɡe do ɡɛ.
O nyundua bela waa kana ɛ fɔɔskwɛɛ.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ, o paɡri ɡe do ɡɛ, asɛ kon waa bar o nyoa la ka tama o tel naɡale beŋkpoŋ.
Saraha kon la bɔɔ luŋri lɔ naɡale beŋkpoŋ ne tama.
Kon baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ teeh ɡe do o wee leebɔr pera.” Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, dɛ ba ɛ saraha kon la tonaa, ŋwɛnɛre baa che a ta dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa dɛ́ kpɔ a chale dɛɛ merɛ o ta laanee teŋa nɔ.
A chɛ kɛ he lawɛ nabale ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ Lewi dea tena baa ɛ sɔfore dɛ ɛ Sadɔk naanar.
Banee dɛɛ ba n sie dɛ baa tom mɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Kpɔ o chal la ane ɛ kwaa anaarɛ aa do kɛŋɔ nyeɡlare dɛ paaɡe saraha kon la loŋkoni ta la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɛ o doa bela waa kana la, ne kon waa bar o nyoo ta bwa bar.
Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ saraha kon la ta, ó do ɡoroŋ.
Kpɔ nabale la ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, dɛ́ fuuh bela baa lea cheɡ Korowii Dea la dahara bela.
Tɔɔ perɔ aa, a chɛ kɛ he lawɛ bombal waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ o chal laa doŋa kpɔ saraha kon la ta, ɡɛ haa kpɔ nabale la ɛ la.
Haa laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ saraha kon la ta tonɛ la, kpɔ nabale ne pebal a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii le he kondɛɛra bini ba tɛ mɛ.
Kpɔa ba n sie, ásɛ sɔfore la ɛ yar merɛ a ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ saraha baa fuah tɛ mɛ.
Berɛ lawɛ bombal ne nabale dɛ pebal, a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii, le he kondɛɛra bini ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɔpere bɛlbwa tɔpera anuanɛ tɛ mɛ.
Tɔpera anuanɛɛ sɔfore la kpɔ soŋe men Korowii, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ saraha kon la ta kpɔ tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ do n nɔn ta dɛ́ pilu.
Tɔpera anuanɛ nɔ ba a jaɡa aa, tɔpenuatoro wee la, sɔfore la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ saraha kwaa haa fuah, ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare la ba saraha kon la ta, ásɛ n lɛ heyaa do.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Kooro ne Lewi dea tena dɛ sɔfore Belaa baa la lawɛ men Ɛsekeɛl ba Korowii Dea la wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ o tɔɔ.
Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Den ɡel doonyoa nɔ tɔ ɡɛ.
Bɛ on pili, nomɛlbwa ɡe bɛ o ta kpɔ, dɛkalkɛ men Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ la, n kpɔ o ta.
Kooro ɡboo dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ jo ka di kondikwaa aa do ɡoroŋ n sie bela.
Bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ jo laanee chɛ kɛ o che jo, dɛ́ berɛ che o ta le.” Baa la kpɔ mɛ kpɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa ta, dɛ ba n ne Korowii Dea la sie.
Asɛ n na kɛŋɔ Korowii jirima baa su o Dea la bini bwa, asɛ n ba harɛ dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ no n mmarare ne waa bwa aa chɔ le tɛ n Dea la.
Do sie dɛɛ nyiŋi doonyoo ne bɔra baa cheɡɛ a ta jo dɛɛ le a ta bwa.
Ŋɔ Israel lwɛmkpeɡ tena la be ŋɔ men Nemenɛ Korowii dɛ bol kɛŋɔ, ‘Israel tena, waa maa kia hɛɛ ɛ la maɡre ɡɛ.
A bwa habɔɔ, he ɡelɔ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola ba pena teŋe, baa wola men duu, ba jo n Dea la ta, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaoh, ɡɛ saŋ haa kpɔ kondikwaa ne ola noorare, dɛ a chale ba ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
A cheɡɛ a ta he chɔɡ n ne he fɔo la.
Heyaa chɛ kɛ he nyiŋi n waa aa do ɡoroŋ ta n Dea bela, kɛ he berɔ kpɔ do nɛŋhɔɔhra nɔn ta.
Anomanta, men Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola ba pena teŋe, baa wola men duu, ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá jo n Dea la bini, hale nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe he Israel tena bini.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tɛr Lewi dea tena ba ne Israel tena aa le n habɔɔ dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa la deŋnee.
Ba ken ɛɛ dɔ bɔree dɛɛ daah n Dea doonyoo la, dɛɛ ɛ toma bela.
Baa kpo saraha kwaa baa fuah, ne nɛra la kwaa baa kpoora, dɛɛ cha ba.
Baa tomɛ voɡa dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa nomanta, n ir nɔn dɛ ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ba dɔ deŋnetɛra ba wechɔɡa la wa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Ba bɛ n sie ba, dɛ́ ba tom mɛ kɛŋɔ sɔfore, kɛɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ baa tuuhnu tel kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ, ne saraha aa do ɡoroŋ kohona la bɛlbwa.
A chɛ kɛ sihiih kpo ba, baa dɔ deŋnetɛraa waa maa kia ba ɛ la wa.
Kɛ ane a bwa, mɛɛ kpɔ tomkpeɡa aa chɛ kɛ baa ɛ n Dea bela la bwaa do ba nɔn ta.
Kɛ Sadɔk naanar baa ɛ Lewi dea sɔfore dɛ kpɔ kasinteŋ ba tom mɛ n Dea bela, ɡɛ saŋ Israel tena aa le n habɔɔ la, banee ba n sie bela dɛ ba tom mɛ.
Kɛ taraken, bá ba che n sie dɛ́ kpɔ ola noorare ne a chale ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Ba ɡboo dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ jo n Dea la ta, banee dɛ́ suuh tel n saraha kon la, dɛ́ɛ ɛ n Dea bela toma bwa.
Ba cheɡɛ dembaah doonyoo la ta jo n Dea la bini naa, a chɛ kɛ bá do yapondɛɛɡa laala.
A ta chɛ kɛ bá do komɛlbwa baa kpɔ olpona ɛo ba jo bini dembaah kɛɛ n Dea bela, dɛ́ ɛ toma.
Bá kpɔ yapondɛɛɡa baa vɔwa nyuune ne a yapebori.
A ta chɛ kɛ bá do komɛlbwa aa ɡel bɔwɔb laɡ ba.
Mɔɔ ba le ka jo habɔɔ dembaah la ta bela nɛra aa lole la, bá foo laala baa doa ɛ toma la bil deene aa do ɡoroŋ la bini.
Bá kpɔ laala pɛɛne do, ásɛ a bɛ waa kpɔ ba ta nɛra la nɛ.
Sɔfore bɛ ba nyumpona paa ta, ba bɛ ɡel a moɡɛ kohona ɡe.
Bá fona a ba harɛ.
Sɔfo bɛlbwa dɛ ba Dea la bini dembaah la ta joe yaa, o bɛ sen nyɔ.
Sɔfo ta chɛ kɛ ó mo luhaah kɛɛ haah o jaa aa vɛoh.
Wɛɛ won mo Israel bihaah waa wola baa jemɛ, kɛɛ luhaah sɔfo aa sewa ɡelo.
A chɛ kɛ sɔfore la chaɡle n nɛra wa, dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ ne kwaa aa wola ɡoroŋ doe, dɛ́ pere kwaa doŋa aa lɔ a ta le kwaa doŋa aa wola toole a ta.
Nomɛl ne o dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, sɔfore laanee dɛ́ nyiŋi a ta, dɛ́ bola, ɡɛ aa lɔ me Mmarare ta la.
A chɛ kɛ baa teŋɛ me Mmarare ne n waa maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba bwa ta, n tɔpejena maa lea cheɡ bwa, ásɛ dɛɛ di n Ona Tɔpera la, dɛ́ ɡel a do ɡoroŋ.
Sɔfo bɛlbwa ta chɛ kɛ o leɡe nɛn waa sewa dɛ́ kah doŋa, nemenɛ o nya ne mɛɛ, bibaa kɛɛ bihaah, o nime kɛɛ dɔɔ kɛɛ nimambie waa wola yalɛ mɔɔ.
Dɛ o kah doŋa ba sɔɔ taa, ó so tɔpera anuanɛ.
Awola waa ba jo Korowii Dea, o bini dembaah la ta bela dɛ́ ba ɛ toma la, ó ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha tɛ o te.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Menee dɛ́ tɛ sɔfore la komɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.
He bɛ ban Israel harɛ la pera tɛ.
Menee ba kondɔɔh.
Banee dɛ́ di mea sarahare, ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ sarahare, ne bolchɔɡe dii sarahare, dɛ komɛlbwa Israel tena aa kpɔa baa tɛ mɛ la.
A bwa ɛ ba kwa.
He koo kondikonloɡla aa wera, ne komɛlbwa haa kpɔa baa tɛ mɛ la ɛɛ ɛ sɔfore la kwaa.
He kpɔ menloɡla ba tɛɛ ba, ásɛ n swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heyaa he deremi.
Sɔfore ta chɛ kɛ ba di jumbie kɛɛ ol bɛlbwa waa sewa ta baŋa, kɛɛ onɔ la kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa aa kpoo.”
Israel harɛ la bɔna Korowii ŋɔ, “He dɛ ba harɛ la bɔna tɛ Israel dea bɛlbwa ó ɛ o kapɛrɛ kon aa, a chɛ kɛ he le o pera cheɡ tɛ men Korowii, ó ɛ bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ.
O jaŋne ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, asɛ o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro.
Bela bɔr la bwa ɛɛ do ɡoroŋee.
A ɡɛ bɔr la jaŋne ne o paɡri ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa lafraanuanɛ lafraanue, ásɛ n Dea la che o baah ta, ásɛ harɛ chɔ dɛ́ ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue dɛ́ baro.
Bɔne harɛ la bini, dɛ maɡɛ bɔr o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, ásɛ o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue.
Belaa n Dea waa ɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ɛɛ ba cheɡa.
Belaa dɛ́ ɛ bɔr tɛ sɔfore baa ba n sie dɛ́ baa tom mɛ.
Belaa ba deene ne n Dea waa ɛ boɡoroŋ la ɛɛ ba cheɡa.
Harɛ la pera naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraanuanɛ dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue waa ɛ o jaŋne, ne naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue waa ɛ o paɡri la chɛ kɛ o ɛ Lewi dea tena baa dɛ ɛ toma n Dea la kon.
Ásɛ ba vɔrɔwe bwɛɛre o kar la ta.
Harɛ la pera bwɛjen la aa che o ta la paɡri ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa anuanɛ lafraanue, o jaŋne ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, dɛ́ teŋɛ bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.
Ó ɛ Israel tena bwa kon.
Kooro o taa soɡe le chɛ kɛ ó dɔ harɛ la pera ka jaɡɛ baŋ bɛlbwa jwɛh ta, dɛ́ le harɛ waa do ɡoroŋ ne bwɛjen kon la ta.
Wɛɛ le wee cholibɔree kaa, dɛ́ le wee leebɔr ɡe kaa.
Wɛɛ do jaŋnee le wee leebɔr teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr, dɛ́ do ɡɛ Israel dea bɛlbwa kon aa doa.
Gɛ harɛ nɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ kooro la kon Israel harɛ ta, ásɛ n koranar aa n nɛraa dɛɛ fiiɡi kpa, dɛ́ tɛ Israel dea bɛlbwa ŋwɛnɛ ó dɔ o harɛ ɡɛ aa chɛa.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel koranar, he wechɔɡa la ɡwaalɔ to.
Hé ɡel naɡrenyin, ne fiiɡa haa dɛ fiiɡi nɛra la, dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wera dɛ toɡre.
He bɛ n nɛra doŋi le ba harɛ ta dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ he kon.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hé kpɔ kwaa aa chɛa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwaa tɔɡre ne a wara.
Kuruware ne loŋa haa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwaa bwa chɛ kɛ a ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Suuɡapoŋ beŋkpoŋ tɔɡre lɔ suuɡa bwejeɡre fifraanɛ.
Suuɡapoŋa fifraanumɛl tɔɡre lɔ mina beŋkpoŋ.” Sarahare ne Tɔpejena Dii Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Koŋkɛɛla aa wera hé kpɔ ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ laanee, mea kuruware anumɛl dɛ le kuruware lafa bɛlbwa ta, ásɛ mea ane soo siwi ta ɡe, he ɛ ɡɛ tenten.
Hé bɔne noo ɡalɔŋre anue bini bɔre fi aa, n bɔr lɔ o ta bɔrbeŋkpoŋ.
Gɛɛ a do noo ɡalɔŋre fifraanue bɛlbwa ta.
Pee beŋkpoŋii chɛ kɛ hé lawɛ le kondɛɛre lafraanɛ bɛlbwa aa dɔ dibɔrdɛɛɡe Israel harɛ ta dɛɛ di ba tɛ mɛ.
A ɡɛ peera laanee baa ba kpɔe ja mea sarahare ne saraha kwaa baa fuah, dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare ta, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe nɛra la wechɔɡa n be n kpɔ kɛ ba.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Harɛ la ta nɛra bwa kpɔ koŋkɛɛla ba tɛ kooro waa lɔ Israel harɛ ta ó ɛ saraha.
A ɛ kooro la toma kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah, ne mea sarahare, dɛ sen sarahare tɛ tɔpejena ne Korobifala dɛ Ona Tɔpera dii ta.
Wɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare, ne mea sarahare, ne sarahare baa dɛ fuah, dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraharee ba soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa n be, ń kpɔ kɛ ba.
Waa Nemenɛ Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
Korobiloɡle la tɔpere waa tɔ sie ta, a chɛ kɛ he lawɛ nabale waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii dɛ́ kpo, dɛ́ ba laa doŋa kpɔ n Dea la ta.
Sɔfo la kpɔ nabale baa kpɔa ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha la chal la ane ba ɛ n Dea doonyoa daa la ta, ne saraha kon la loŋkoni anaarɛ ta, dɛ doonyoo daa aa lɔ bini dembaah la ta.
A chɛ kɛ he berɛ ɛ ɡɛ tenten korobie la tɔpenuanɛ wee ta tɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola saahnɛ, kɛɛ waa wola jemɛ dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba soŋa le n be dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ n Dea la ta ó do ɡoroŋ.
Korobiloɡle la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta, a chɛ kɛ he di Galekaa Tɔpejen tɔpera anuanɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ di paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta.
Tɔpeloɡle ta la, kooro la lawɛ nabale ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ o te, ne harɛ la ta nɛra bwa.
Tɔpejen la dii tɔpera anuanɛ ta la, tɔpere bɛlbwa a chɛ kɛ o lawɛ nabali anuanɛ, ne pebala anuanɛ bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii, dɛ́ ba ɛ saraha baa fuah tɛ mɛ.
Tɔpere bɛlbwa, ó berɛ lawɛ bombal ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha.
Nabali la bɛlbwa ta la, ó kpɔ men kuruware fi dɛ́ ba ɛ mea saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ men kuruware fi ja pebala la bɛlbwa ɡe ta, dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anumɛl ja men kuruware fi bɛlbwa ta.
Kukure Tɔpejen dii, tɔpenuanɛ wee waa dɛ pa mun korobie anuanɛ, tɔpera fi dɛ anue ta la, a chɛ kɛ kooro la ɛ ɡɛ tenten tɔpera anuanɛ ja wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare, ne saraha baa dɛ fuah, ne mea sarahare, dɛ noo waa kpɔ ba la ta.”
Kooro la ne Tɔpejena Dii Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Doonyoa waa lɔ bini dembaah o sie chaɡɛ wee leebɔr la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó tɔ tɔpera anumɛl baa dɛ ɛ toma la, kɛ Ona Tɔpere ne Korobifale Tɔpejena dii ta te, a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé pilu.
Kooro la chɛ kɛ ó che habɔɔ dembaah bela jo, dɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ jo, dɛ́ ba che doonyoa ɡbera la jwɛh.
Ásɛ sɔfore la kpɔ o saraha kwaa baa fuah, ne deŋnesɔɔhna saraha kwaa ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ.
Ó tomɛ men Korowii doonyoa bela, dɛ́ berɛ le kaa.
A ta chɛ kɛ ba tɔ ɡbera la nemenɛ jɔmɔra.
Ona Tɔpera ne Korobifala Tɔpejena dii ta, harɛ la ta nɛra bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá ba doonyoa la ta bela, dɛ́ ba tom mɛ.
Ona Tɔpere ta la, kooro la chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ pebali anumɛl ne pebal a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii ba fuah ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii.
Mea saraha waa kpɔ ja pebal la ta la chɛ kɛ á ɛ mea kuruware fi, mea saraha waa kpɔ ja pebali la ta la te, ó kpɔ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anumɛl koo men kuruwa bɛlbwa ta.
Korobifale Tɔpejen dii ta, kooro la lawɛ nabale ne pebiiri anumɛl, dɛ pebal a bɛlbwa aa wola kirihiah dii, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ saraha.
A chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ mea kuruware fi ja nabale la ta ɛ mea saraha, men kuruware fi ja pebal la ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ mea la ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin ja pebiiri la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anumɛl ja men kuruware fi bɛlbwa ta.
Kooro la kpɔ doonyoa la ta jo aa, ó berɛ che bela le.
Harɛ la ta nɛra dɛ ba n sie dɛ ba tomɛ tɔpejena baa lea cheɡ la ta naa, nomɛlbwa waa cheɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa la ta jo dɛ ba tom mɛ la, ó ka che o weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa la ta le.
Bɛlbwa ɡe waa che weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa ta dɛ́ jo la, ó che o weekaŋle nyundua doonyoa la ta le.
Bela bɛlbwa aa che dɛ́ jo la, ó che baŋ bɛl le.
Kooro la chɛ kɛ ó ja ba nɛɛ jo, ba dɛ le ɡe aa, bá bwa pɛ le.
Tɔpejena dii, ne tɔpera baa lea cheɡ dɛ́ di kwaa dɛɛ lɛ sie ta, mea saraha la chɛ kɛ a ɛ mea kuruware fi dɛ ja nabale ta, men kuruware fi ja pebal ta, ásɛ pebiiri la ɡe ó kpɔ ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anumɛl ja mea kuruware fi bɛlbwa ta.
Kooro la dɛ ba ba ɛ saraha aa le o bambile ta, dɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah kɛɛ dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare dɛ kpoa tɛ mɛ naa, bá pili doonyoa o sie aa chaɡɛ wee leebɔr la tɛo ó jo.
A chɛ kɛ ó ɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah kɛɛ deŋnesɔɔhna saraha kwaa la ɡɛ waa dɛ ɛ Ona Tɔpere ta la.
Ásɛ dɛ o baa le kaa laa, ba laa ɡbera la tɔ.
Tɔpere bɛlbwa saraha Tɔpere te bɛlbwa chɔɔbɔr, a chɛ kɛ he lawɛ pebie waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii dɛ di benanyoa ba ɛ saraha dɛ́ kpoo, dɛ́ fuuh tɛ men Korowii.
Hé kpɔ mea kuruwa beŋkpoŋ ne tama ja a ta chɔɔbɔr bɛlbwa, ásɛ a ɛ mea saraha dɛ́ kpɔ noo pɛrɛntoa dela anɛ koo a ta a pweh.
Mea saraha kpɔe ba tɛ mɛ chɛ kɛ á chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gɛɛ hɛɛ ba pebie la ne mea saraha, dɛ noo la kpɔe dɛ́ baa ɛ saraha baa fuah chɔɔbɔr bɛlbwa dɛɛ tɛ men Korowii.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛ kooro la pere o harɛ pera tɛ o bibaa bɛl aa, dɛ harɛ la berɛ o bie la ɡe ne o naanar kon.
Ó ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon dɛ́ do ba luɡe ta.
Kɛ dɛ o kpɔ o harɛ la pera tɛ o bonɔɔ bɛl aa, bonɔɔ la kpɔ ka tel benanyoa baa berɛ kwaa dɛɛ tɛ a tena, ásɛ o berɛ kon la tɛ kooro la ó berɛ ɛ o kon, o ne o bii ɡboo dɛ won dɔɔ pi.
Kooro la ta chɛ kɛ ó lɛ nɛra la kapɛrɛ kon bɛlbwa le ba be.
A chɛ kɛ ó tɛ o bii la ba ɡe harɛ ó ɛ ba ɡe kapɛrɛ kon, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ n nɛra nɔ bini bɛlbwa komɛlbwa bɛ o nɔn ta le.” Korowii Dea bela baa dɛ daa kwa Baa la berɔ kpɔ men Ɛsekeɛl jo deene aa sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛ bɛne weekaŋle harɛbɔr doonyoa, bini dembaah la bɔr.
A ɛ deene aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ sɔfore la.
O baɡ mɛ bobɛl waa lɔ deene aa lɔ wee cholibɔr pera.
Baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bonɔɔ sɔfore la ɛɛ ba bolchɔɡe dii sarahare ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha kwaa dɛɛ daala, dɛ wɔɔ mea saraha kwa, ɡɛ aa ɛ ba bɛ kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ kpɔ le kaa habɔɔ dembaah la bini, dɛ́ kpɔ waa ka ta nɛra la nɛ.” Belaa o kpɔ mɛ ba jo habɔɔ dembaah la ta, dɛ tɔ n sie ya ka kpɔ o loŋkoni anaarɛ la bwa ta.
Loŋkora bɛlbwa ta, n na dembaah bela.
Loŋkoni anaarɛ aa lɔ habɔɔ dembaah la bini la, dembaahna lɔ o bini bela bwa.
Bɛlbwa jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraanumɛl, asɛ a paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue, a bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
Dembaahna la bini bɛlbwa, ba kpɔ bwea ma danjwɛɛre bar.
Ba berɔ ma bɔra baa mar nii a ta bar a lɔɡa.
Baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bonɔɔ Korowii Dea tom-ɛɛra la ɛɛ ba saraha kwaa nɛra aa kpɔa dɛɛ ba la daala.”
Nee waa pala le Korowii Dea la bɔr Baa la berɔ kpɔ men Ɛsekeɛl ba Korowii Dea doonyoa la ta, asɛ n na nee aa pala le doonyoa bela dɛɛ kaa wee leebɔr pera, bela Korowii Dea la sie aa chaɡa la.
Dɛ nee la palɔ le Korowii Dea la lɔɡa weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera, dɛɛ kaa saraha kon la weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Baa la cheɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr doonyoa, dɛ kpɔ mɛ le ba dahara doonyoa o sie aa chaɡɛ wee leebɔr la ta, dɛ nee la palɔ le weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera baa kaa.
Baa la kpoŋe ŋwɛn bɛl waa dɛ maɡɛ o ne kwa, dɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ wee leebɔr pera.
O maɡɛ naɡale kaɡboŋ lafraanue dɛ kpɔ mɛ jo nee la ta o tel n nasoɡdor.
O maɡɛ naɡale kaɡboŋ lafraanue ja, dɛ kpɔ mɛ jo nee la ta o tel n natuune ta.
Dɛ maɡɛ naɡale kaɡboŋ lafraanue, dɛ kpɔ mɛ jo nee la ta o tel n chara ta.
O berɔ maɡɛ naɡale kaɡboŋ lafraanue, anɔ te la, o kpɔ mɛ jo nee waa do kɛŋɔ moo maa wola won leo, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o suu kohona dɛ do luŋri nomɛlbwa aa wola won wao le o baŋ.
O bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, he na waa nɔ kenɛ?” Asɛ dɛ berɛ tɔ n sie dɛ kpɔ mɛ le ba moo la nyoa.
Maa tel bela la, n na daa a warɛ kohona che moo la baŋ bɛlbwa ta.
Baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Gɛ moo nɔ palɔ kpɔ wee leebɔr harɛ ta dɛ wili jo Jɔɔdan Felembɔjen ta, dɛ ka jo Yar Mpo ta.
O palɔ ka jo mpo la ta naa, mpo nee la dɛ́ do wer.
Nee bini kwaa bwa soo siwi ɛɛ warɔɔ kohona, dɛ́ ba so nee la ta bela bwa waa pala dɛɛ kaa la.
Pɛŋa ɛɛ warɔɔ do o ta, dɛkalkɛ nee la aa dɛ palɛ la ɡelɔ mpo nee aa ɛ yar la do wer.
Bela waa pala dɛɛ kaa bwa, komɛlbwa won o bini soɡa.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ pɛŋa toma ɛɛ ba che o nyoaa, dɛ́ le Ɛn Gedi dɛ́ nyenɛ ba asauri ba Ɛn Eɡlaim.
Pɛŋa bwa soo siwii dɛɛ ba o ta doe kɛŋɔ Mɛdetereenea Mpo pɛŋa ken.
Kɛ o nyoo aa do kɛ chɛɡbɔra la nee la te aa won do wer, aa chɔɔ bá dɔ yar dɛɛ le a ta.
Daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ bwa soo siwi ɛɛ le nee la nyoa baŋ bɛlbwa taa.
A papooni aa hola ba, aa nɔnaa ɡel.
Korobie bɛlbwa taa aa ba nɔna, dɛkalkɛ nee le Korowii Dea bela palɛ dɛɛ ba bela.
A nɔna la ɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa, ásɛ ba kpɔ a papooni ɡe dɛɛ chah weela.” Harɛ la jwɛhre Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Anɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ harɛ la haa dɛ ba bɔna tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la, ne bɔre anɛ Josef dea bii aa dɛ ba dɔe la jwɛhre, ásɛ bɛlbwa dɔ o harɛ ó ɛ o kapɛrɛ kon.
Bɔno kɛrɛdɛ bɛlbwa dɔ o kon, dɛkalkɛ n ir nɔn dɛ ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ he naawaa n kpɔ harɛ nɔ tɛ.
Harɛ nɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon.
Kenii harɛ la jwɛh ɛɛ ba doe.
O weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jwɛh la, le Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta, dɛ́ kpɔ bwɛjen Hɛtlɔn ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ ɡale kaa bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ kaa bwɛjen Hamat, dɛ́ kaa Sedad, ne bwɛjena Bɛrɔta ne Sibraim aa lɔ bwɛjena Damaskɔs ne Hamat jwɛh ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa bwɛjen Hasa Hatikon, o ɡe aa lɔ Hauran jwɛh ta.
Jwɛh la ɛɛ le Mɛdetereenea Mpo taa dɛ́ kaa Hasar Enan, dɛ́ kpɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jwɛh waa lɔ bwɛjen Damaskɔs, ásɛ jwɛh waa lɔ bwɛjen Hamat la do o weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
Onɔɔ dɛ ɛ weekaŋle nyundua jwɛh la.
O wee leebɔr jwɛh la ɛɛ chɔɔ le Hauran ne bwɛjen Damaskɔs baah ta, dɛ́ kpɔ Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa, Gelead ne Israel harɛ baah ta, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa Yar Mpo ta, dɛ́ kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Taama.
Onɔ ɡee wee leebɔr jwɛh la.
Weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh la ɛɛ le Taamaa, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le neerare aa lɔ Mɛreba Kades, dɛ́ ka kpɔ fɛlembɔjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Wadi waa lɔ Ijipt harɛ jwɛh, dɛ́ kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta.
Weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh laanee la.
O wee cholibɔr jwɛh la, Mɛdetereenea Mpo laanee dɛ́ ɛ jwɛh, dɛ́ kaa bobɛl o ne bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ kaa bwɛjen Hamat sie aa chaɡɛ dɔŋa.
Wee cholibɔr jwɛh laanee la.
A chɛ kɛ he bɔne harɛ nɔ tɛ dɔŋa Israel denaa ta.
Hé bɔna á ɛ kapɛrɛ tɛ he ne nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡe he bini dɛ dɔ bii la.
Hé kpɔ ba kɛŋɔ bwɛɛlembii baa lol ba Israel harɛ ta, he ne ba bwaa dɛ́ pɛ dɔ kapɛrɛ Israel harɛ deene bini.
Dea bɛlbwa hɔɔhra aa ba so o ta la, belaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé tɛo o kapɛrɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
Israel harɛ bɔna denaa ta Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Kenii Israel deene sɔna ne harɛ la waa do.
Harɛ la weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jwɛh la, Dan dea tena ɛɛ dɔ ba konee.
Wɛɛ chɔɔ le bwɛjen Hɛtlɔn ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ kaa bela baa cheɡa dɛɛ kaa bwɛjen Hamat, dɛ́ le bwɛjen Enan ta kaa bwɛjen Damaskɔs weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ́ kaa Hamat la ɛɛ ɛ ba harɛ la jwɛh bɛlee, dɛ́ teŋe le wee leebɔr pera ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Aasa dea tena ɡe ɛɛ dɔ ba konee.
Ba ne Dan dea tena do jwɛh, wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Naftale dea tena ɡe ɛɛ dɔ ba konee.
Ba ne Aasa dea tena do jwɛh, wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Manasɛ dea tena ɡe ɛɛ dɔ ba konee.
Ba ne Naftale dea tena do jwɛh, wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Efrem dea tena ɡe ɛɛ dɔ ba konee.
Ba ne Manasɛ dea tena do jwɛh, wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Rubin dea tena ɡe ɛɛ dɔ ba konee.
Ba ne Efrem dea tena do jwɛh, wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Juda dea tena ɡe ɛɛ dɔ ba konee.
Ba ne Rubin dea tena do jwɛh, wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Harɛ o ne Juda dea tena kon aa do jwɛh, dɛ́ le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr la, bá le cheɡ mɛ o korɛ.
O paɡri ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, o jaŋne dɛ le o wee leebɔr teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr pera ɡe do kɛŋɔ deene la kwaa baa dɔa la dɔŋa, ásɛ n Dea la che o baah ta.
Harɛ la pera waa kora he le cheɡ mɛ la chɛ kɛ o jaŋne ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, o paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue.
Belaa dɛ́ ɛ bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ sɔfore.
O weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jaŋne ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, wee cholibɔr paɡri ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue.
O wee leebɔr paɡri ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue, ásɛ o weekaŋle harɛbɔr pera jaŋne ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue.
O baah taa chɛ kɛ n Dea la che.
Wɛɛ ɛ sɔfore la konee, Sadɔk naanar baa tom mɛ kasinteŋ ne, ba ta n ŋwɛnɛ ta leɛ, kɛŋɔ Lewi dea tena la bane aa ɛa ɡɛ saŋ Israel tena aa berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ la.
A ɡɛ harɛ laanee dɛ́ ɛ ba dibɔr maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba ó korɛ le harɛ la ta.
O ɛ harɛ waa do ɡoroŋ kohona dɛ do ba ne Lewi dea tena jwɛh ta.
Sɔfore harɛ jwɛh ta bela la, Lewi dea tena la ɛɛ dɔ harɛ o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanuee, o paɡri ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue.
A ta chɛ kɛ bá yoɡ harɛ la kɛɛ bá kpɔ charɛ komɛl.
Harɛ la pera waa dena do ɡoroŋ dɛ do wer ɡwaa a bwa laanee.
A ta chɛ kɛ ó kaa nɛnfala be, dɛkalkɛ o do ɡoroŋ dɛ tɛ men Korowii.
Harɛ la kabora o paɡri aa ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa anuanɛ lafraanue, o jaŋne ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue la ɛ nomɛlbwa bɔr harɛ la ta tena aa do deene, ne bela ba kondɛɛra aa dɛɛ di, ásɛ bwɛjen la do baah ta.
Gɛ bwɛjen la aa dɛ ba doe laanee nɔ.
O baŋne anaarɛ la bɛlbwa lɔ naɡale kaɡboŋa anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
Harɛ bwɛjen la kondɛɛra aa di o ta la baŋne anaarɛ la bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ ó ɛ naɡale lafraatoro fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue.
Harɛ waa ka o ne n Dea la jwɛh ta jaŋne chɛ kɛ ó ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue wee leebɔr pera, ásɛ wee cholibɔr ɡe ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anue.
O taa kondikwa ɛɛ ba lee dɛ́ tɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta bwa.
Israel dea bɛlbwa ta nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen la taa dɛɛ ba kooni harɛ la ta para.
Harɛ la bwa ɛ fɔɔskwɛɛ.
Naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue baŋ bɛlbwa ta.
A chɛ kɛ bá le n Dea la harɛ ó korɛ ja bwɛjen la kon ta.
Komɛlbwa waa ka baŋ bɛlbwa ta n Dea la ne bwɛjen la bɔr la ta bwa ɛ kooro la kwa.
Le bela dɛ́ kaa wee leebɔr ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue, dɛ́ teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr jwɛh ta, naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ lafraanue dɛ́ kaa wee cholibɔr jwɛh la ta.
Gɛ bɔra anɛ nɔ bwa ɛ́ kooro la kwa, ásɛ n Dea la che baah ta.
Gɛɛ Lewi dea tena harɛ ne bwɛjen la harɛ la ɛɛ ba baah ta chɔe, dɛ́ do kooro la kon la baah ta.
Bɔr waa ɛ kooro la kon la ɛɛ chɔ jwɛh waa lɔ Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene jwɛh la baah taa.
Deene aa kaa la te, bɔrbeŋkpoŋii Bɛnjamen dea tena ɛɛ ba dɔe.
Wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Simeon dea tena ɡe ɛɛ dɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋii.
Ba jwɛh le Bɛnjamen dea tena jwɛh ta, wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Isaaka dea tena ɛɛ dɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋii.
Ba jwɛh le Simeon dea tena jwɛh ta, wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Sebulon dea tena ɛɛ dɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋii.
Ba jwɛh le Isaaka dea tena jwɛh ta, wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Gad dea tena ɛɛ dɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋii.
Ba jwɛh le Sebulon dea tena jwɛh ta, wɛɛ le wee leebɔree teŋe ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Gad dea tena harɛ ɛɛ le weekaŋle harɛbɔr jwɛh taa dɛ́ le Taama, dɛ́ ba neerare aa lɔ Mɛreba Kades, dɛ́ kpoŋe kaa nenabɔɔ waa lɔ Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta, dɛ́ kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta.
Gɛɛ harɛ baa dɛ ba bɔna tɛ Israel deene á ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwaa la waa do, ásɛ bɛlbwa dɔ o kon.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Bwɛjen la doonyoo Men Korowii berɛ ŋɔ, “Kenii doonyoo baa che a ta dɛɛ le bwɛjen la ta waa do.
Le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr la, o jaŋne lɔ naɡale kaɡboŋa anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
Baa kpɔ Israel deene sɔnaa pa doonyoo aa lɔ bwɛjen la ta.
Doonyoo atoroo lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ba kpɔ Rubin ne Juda dɛ Lewi deene sɔna paa.
O wee leebɔr pera jaŋne lɔ naɡale kaɡboŋa anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
Doonyoo atoroo lɔ bela, ba kpɔ Josef ne Bɛnjamen dɛ Dan deene sɔna paa.
Weekaŋle harɛbɔr ɡe jaŋne lɔ naɡale kaɡboŋa anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
Doonyoo atoroo lɔ bela, ba kpɔ Simeon ne Isaaka dɛ Sebulon deene sɔna paa.
O wee cholibɔr pera la jaŋne lɔ naɡale kaɡboŋa anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanue.
Doonyoo atoroo lɔ bela, ba kpɔ Gad ne Aasa dɛ Naftale deene sɔna paa.
Harɛ la bwa jaŋne dɛ bar la ɛɛ ɛ naɡale kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛɛ.
Dɛ le awola dɛ kaa la, baa yerɛ bwɛjen la, ‘korowii lɔ bela.’ ”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Tɔn nɔ nyuune — dɛ baɡle waa aa pu Daneɛl.
Ba lawɔ le Jerusalam kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta, o ka ɛ yom dɛɛ tomɛ bela kooro.
Baa kaa ɛ hɔɔhra harɛfale ta kwaraa la, dɛ o ne o bala batoro ta dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa la ta kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ nɛra ɡalɡa ɛɛ chɔɡ ba.
Korowii cha ba ba dɔ wejema, dɛ lɛɛ ba le wenaale nyoa.
A habɔɔ la, Pɛɛsea Koojen Dareɔs nao kɛŋɔ Korowii Daneɛl aa dɛ tomɔ la kan. Nyiŋi nyu :-.
Nyuune — dɛ baɡle wepila Korowii aa ɡela Daneɛl na aa ba chiɡa kerekere dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ koranar ne ba harɛre bwa lɔ Korowii nɔn ta.
Daneɛl ne o daamanar batoro Kooro Jehoiakim aa di kora Juda harɛ ta bentooro te ta la, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena la ka chɔ bar bwɛjen Jerusalam dɛ yo bwɛɛ la tena.
Korowii ɡelɔ o pɔ Juda Kooro Jehoiakim nɛ, dɛ pa laala baa kpɔa cheɡ Korowii Dea la ane kaa Babelɔn harɛ ka cheɡ o voɡ dea bini, bela baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.
Ate, Kooro Nebukadnesa ŋɔ Aspenas waa chɔ o koodem nomonome nyoa be ŋɔ, ó kpɔ Israel koodem bonɔɔna bane baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa Babelɔn, ne banɔ la baa le nomonjena deremi ta ba.
Ba bini bonɔɔna baa wola kirihiah dii dɛ do wer, dɛ́ dɔ bambile hweli komɛlbwa waa hweli, dɛ dɔ lem dɛ́ won dɛɛ no waa mun warane, dɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ bá won ɛ toma koodem.
Ásɛ Aspenas baɡ ba Babelɔn tena wobol ne o chwera.
Babelɔn kooro ŋɔ báa tɛɛ ba o kondikwaa ne sen waa dɛ nyɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa la dɔŋa.
Dɛ ŋɔ bá baɡ ba waa la bene atoro, ásɛ mɔɔ ba baa ɛ toma koodem bela.
Nɛra baa kaa lee ba le Juda dea tena bini la banee, Daneɛl ne Hanania ne Mesael dɛ Asaria.
Babelɔn koodem nomoa la tɛɛ ba sɔnfala.
Daneɛl sɔne Bɛltesasa, Hanania sɔne Sadrak, Mesael sɔne Mesak, asɛ Asaria ɡe sɔne Abɛdnɛɡo.
Kooro kondikwaa ne sen waa ŋɔa ba kpɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba la, Daneɛl ɛ o liire kɛŋɔ waa ɡɛ kondikwaa la ne sen laanee nyɔ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ o te kah doŋa.
Asɛ dɛ soŋe Aspenas waa ɛ koodem nomoa la a wa, dɛ bɛ doŋa kah.
Korowii ɡelɔ koodem nomoa la na Daneɛl sum dɛ chao, kɛ Aspenas ŋɔ Daneɛl be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ɔmɛ n dɔɔ kooro waa ŋɔa ń tɛ heyaa kondikwaa ne sen la.
A ta chɛ kɛ o ba na he ɡwaŋa dɛ he bala la te bwadabii wer.
A ba ɡɛ naa, o ken ɛɛ koh he waa dɛ́ kpo mɛ.” Asɛ Daneɛl ŋɔ nɛn koodem nomoa la aa leo ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi o ne Hanania ne Mesael dɛ Asaria nɛɛ la be ŋɔ, “N poori, tɛ yaa dɔkpɔɡa komɛlbwa aa wola toole a ta, ne nee ɡbo tɔpera fi, dɛ́ kpɔ daah yaa na.
Ásɛ dɛ kpɔ yaa maɡɛ yabala baa dɛ di kooro dem kondikwaa la, dɛ́ che a ta na ɡɛ haa ɛ yaa.” Anomanta, o sɛoh, dɛ tɛɛ ba kondikwa baa bɔɔ a waa la tɔpera fi, dɛ́ kpɔ daah ba na.
Tɔpera fi la aa tela la, dɛ Daneɛl ne o bala batoro la dɔ bokpeɡa kohona, ba bwadabii ɡe do wer ɡwaa banɔ la baa dɛ di kooro dem kondikwaa la.
Le a ta dɛɛ kaa la, nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la ta ɡelɛ ba di kooro dem kondikwaa la kpa, dɛ ɡel baa di dɔkpɔɡa komɛlbwa aa wola toole a ta.
Korowii tɛ ɡɛ bonɔɔna banaarɛ la wejema ne waa mun noe, ba won kure tɔne dɛ jemɛ chwera ɡe kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Daneɛl berɔ won wepila ne deera bwa soo siwi mun baɡla.
Bene atoro kooro la aa doa ŋɔ bá kpɔ ba ba o be la, koodem nomoa Aspenas kpɔ bonɔɔna la bwa la Kooro Nebukadnesa be.
Kooro la ne ba bol wa, asɛ o na kɛŋɔ ba bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ do kɛ Daneɛl ne Hanania ne Mesael dɛ Asaria, anomanta, ba kpɔ ba do koodem toma ta.
Le ɡɛ saŋ dɛɛ kaa la, wobɛlbwa kooro la aa dɛ nyin a wejema ne waa mun noe waa la, o dɛ bɔɔ ba, asɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ Daneɛl ne o bala batoro la wejema ɡwaa voɡra ne dobodobo tena baa lɔ o harɛ ta bwa kerafi.
Daneɛl soɡe koodem bela dɛɛ tomɛ, ka tel Pɛɛsea Koojen Saeros aa baa yo Babelɔn harɛ tena dɛ di kora.
Kooro Nebukadnesa deera Kooro Nebukadnesa aa di kora bennɛɛte ta la, awola bɛl o deero, asɛ o liire chɔɡ o ta wone chɔ.
Anomanta, o ɡelɔ ba ka yerɛ dobodobo tena, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla, ne voɡra dɛ wejerema baa jemɛ weweela waa ŋɔ bá ba baɡlo deera la mun.
Baa ba o be la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N liire chɔɡ n deera ane maa deera wa, asɛ mɛɛ nyin a mun dɛ́ jemɛ.” Asɛ ba kpɔ Aram tena wobol chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Kórowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ saŋ bɛlbwa!
Bol he deera la baɡle he bonɔɔna, ásɛ ya baɡle a mun.” Anee Kooro Nebukadnesa ŋɔ wejerema baa jemɛ weweela waa la be ŋɔ, “Waa maa liira laanee kɛŋɔ, dɛ he ta wone na n deera nɔ dɛ baɡ mɛ a mun aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá chɛwɛ he ola, dɛ́ kuuɡi he deremi a berɛ dimɡbeeni.
Kɛ dɛ he wono baɡ mɛ deera la ne a mun aa, mɛɛ kɛ heyaa kwaa a su he siwi, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa sɔn ɡe taeh.
Anomanta, hé baɡ mɛ deera la ne a mun.” Ate, ba berɛ chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, baɡle yaa deera la, ásɛ ya ɡe baɡle a mun.” Anee kooro la ŋɔ, “N nao kɛŋɔ he dɛ́ nyin ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ lɔ n waa maa bola la ta, dɛkalkɛ he ɡbabir na ɡɛ maa cheɡa dɛ ɛ n liire, dɛ he ta deera la bolɛ baɡ mɛ naa, deŋnetɛraa dɛ́ chɔ le tɛ heya.
He vɔrɔwɔ kɛŋɔ he dɛ ba n be dɛ́ ba teŋe nyosone, dɛ́ neɡre mɛ, ásɛ n charɛ n liire.
Hé baɡ mɛ deera la, ásɛ n jemɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ won baɡ mɛ a mun.” Asɛ wejerema baa jemɛ weweela waa la chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, nomɛlbwa toole harɛ nɔ ta, dɛ́ won ɛ waa hen kooro aa bola nɔ.
Kooro bɛlbwa waa lɛ sɔn kɛɛ dɛ dɔ kpeɡri ta ɡɛ waa nɔ bɔɔrɛ le dobodobo te, kɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla, kɛɛ wejereme be bwa.
Waa kooro aa dɛ bɔɔ la kpeɡri kohona to.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won pili a bini tɛ kooro nemenɛ voɡa, a ɡɛ voɡa la ɡe toole harɛ nɔ ta.” A ɡelɔ kooro la baah di kohona, asɛ o ŋɔ ba kpoo wejerema baa lɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta bwa.
Anomanta, ba ɛ mmara kɛŋɔ bá kpoo wejerema la, asɛ ba tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá ka ɡaaɡe Daneɛl ne o bala la bɔr, dɛ́ ba kpoo ba.
Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Areɔk, onee chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daah kooro la nyoa.
Waa laŋa dɛɛ la ka kpoo Babelɔn harɛ ta wejerema la, Daneɛl kpɔ wejema ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ bol wobodɛɛɡa nomoa la be.
Daneɛl bɔɔ nomoa Areɔk la ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa kooro do mmara kpeɡ nɔ ken?” Asɛ o bol waa la Daneɛl be.
Ate, Daneɛl den la kooro be dɛ ka soŋo tɔpere, ásɛ o ɛ dɛ ba baɡlo deera la mun.
Daneɛl laa berɛ kaa o dem dɛ ka bol waa la baɡle o daamanar Hanania ne Mesael dɛ Asaria.
Daneɛl ŋɔ bá soŋe Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ó na ba sum waa aa do ɔma nɔ ta, ásɛ ba bɛ o ne o daamanar la bwa pɛ kpoo ja Babelɔn harɛ ta wejerema baa kaa la nɛ.
Awola jwaana la, Korowii pili waa la bini baɡle Daneɛl.
Asɛ o kpɛɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua.
O ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii sɔn saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, onee dɔ wejema ne kpeɡri.
Onee dɛɛ beɡre tɔpera ne saŋ, onee dɛɛ chiɡ nɛn kora ta, dɛ́ berɛ iru kora ta.
Onee dɛɛ tɛ wejerema wejema, dɛɛ tɛ lem ne waa mun noe.
O dɛ le kwaa aa sɔah baa wola an na ne baŋ, o jemɛ kon waa lɔ biro ta, asɛ nii baro cheme dɛɛ chaah.
N Naa Korowii ya naawa aa tomɛ, n dɛ jaame dɛɛ kpɛɛre.
He tɛ mɛ wejema ne kpeɡri, dɛ pili waa yaa soŋe bini baɡ mɛ, he ɡelɔ ya jemɛ kooro deera.” Daneɛl deera mun baɡla Ate, Daneɛl la Areɔk Kooro Nebukadnesa aa leo ŋɔ ó kpoo Babelɔn harɛ ta wejerema la be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “Bɛ Babelɔn harɛ wejerema la kpoo.
Kɛ kpɔ mɛ la kooro be, ásɛ n ka baɡlo o deera la mun.” Ate, Areɔk den ɛ warane kpɔ Daneɛl la kooro la be dɛ ŋɔ, “N na nɛra yaa kaa laɡ ba laa ta le Juda harɛ ta la bɛl ó won baɡle hen kooro deera la mun.” Belaa kooro bɔɔ Daneɛl baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Bɛltesasa ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ won jemɛ n deera la dɛ́ baɡ mɛ a mun aa?” Anee Daneɛl chaŋe ŋɔ, “Wejereme kɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla kɛɛ dobodobo te kɛɛ voɡre bɛlbwa aa won baɡle a mun.
Kɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua lole dɛ́ won pili waa aa sɔah bini.
Waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa kerekeree o kpɔ baɡle hen n naa Kooro Nebukadnesa la.
He deera ne wepila haa chɔa dɛ na laanee teŋa nɔ.
N naa kooro, haa chɔa la, dɛ he liire dawɛ waane aa dɛ ba bala kerekere ta, asɛ Korowii waa won waa aa sɔah bini pila la ɡel he na waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa.
Korowiirii ɡela n won baɡle waa aa do ken dɛ sɔh nɔ mun, n ɡbaɡba wejema aa ɡwaa nomɛlbwa ta laa a che, kɛ ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ hen n naa kooro, he jemɛ waa haa naa he deera bini la, ń baɡle a mun tɛɛ.
N naa kooro, kon haa nao he deera la ta laanee komɛl baa mao kɛŋɔ nɛn o do kan dɛ do ɔma kohona, dɛɛ nyɛɡle al-al ken.
Kon la nyu ɛ suuɡaswɛm tenten, o bambile ne o nɔɔra ɛ suuɡapoŋ, asɛ o tea ne o hwie ɛ ayaawa, o nakpale ɛ buni, asɛ o napaala pera ɛ buni, o pera ɛ choh.
Haa dɛ nyiŋu la, bwekuŋi bɛl waa wola nɛn nɔn ta leɛ kuu, dɛ ba lɔ kon baa mao kɛŋɔ nɛn la napaala aa ɛ buni ne choh la, dɛ kuuɡa burbur ken.
Belaa buni la, ne choh, ne ayaawa, ne suuɡapoŋ, dɛ suuɡaswɛm la bwa den kuuɡi buɡ la ta, dɛ do kɛŋɔ baa lɔ kwaa pɛla ta lɔmɔɡa saŋ a pɛɡa chɔ la ken.
Asɛ peu ta dɛ kpɔa kaa, bɛlbwa ta kae.
Kɛ bwekuŋi waa baa lɔ kon waa do kɛ nɛn la, baa ɛ bwejen tenten dɛ tɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa.” Daneɛl ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he deera haa deera laanee la.
Namee mɛɛ ba ń baɡle a mun.
N naa kooro, he ɛ koranar bwa kooro.
Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ɛɛ koojen dɛ ɡel he do kan, dɛ tɛɛ kpeɡri ne jirima.
He nɔn taa o kpɔ nɛra, ne kpɔɡ bini ola, dɛ jumbii aa dɛ ɡah do.
Henee dɛɛ nyiŋi a nɛ, bobɛlbwa aa lole.
Henee kon la nyu baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛo la.
He kora la habɔɔ, kora bɛl ɡe ɛɛ bao dɛ́ che tɛ suuɡapoŋ la, kɛ waa hen tel.
Ásɛ toorote ɡe ba, dɛ́ che tɛ ayaawa la.
Onee dɛ́ ba di kora harɛ nɔ bwa ta.
Ásɛ a habɔɔ kora bɛl ɡe ka mun ba, onee naarɛte.
Wɛɛ do kpeɡrii kɛŋɔ buni ken.
Gɛ buni aa won kwaa kuuɡa dɛɛ namɛ kwaa bwa la, ɡɛɛ kora la ɛɛ ba sitɔ kwaa la ɛɛ.
Gɛ haa na kon baa mao kɛŋɔ nɛn la napaala ne nanie pera ɛ choh, a pera ɛ buni la, ɡɛɛ kora la bini ɛɛ ba peɡra.
Kora la pera ɛɛ do kpeɡrii kɛŋɔ buni ken, ásɛ o pera ɡe aa kpeɡrii do kɛŋɔ choh ken.
Gɛ o nanie pera aa ɛ buni o pera ɛ choh la, ɡɛɛ kora la pera ɛɛ ba kpeɡri doe, ásɛ o pera ɡe do pwɛre.
Gɛ haa na buni ne choh a koo dɔŋa la, ɡɛɛ kora la nɛra ɛɛ ba dɔŋa koora ba nyoa aa wola pɛ bwa, ɡɛ buni ne choh aa wola won pɛ la.
A ɡɛ koranar la kora dii ta la, Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ɛɛ chiɡ kora waa wola chɔɡ, kɛɛ nomɛlbwa aa wola won pɔ o nɛ.
Wɛɛ ba chɔɡ kora bele anaarɛ la bwaa a ba a jaɡa.
Kɛ o te ɛɛ cheo dɛ́ do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Daneɛl berɔ ŋɔ, “Bwekuŋi la waa wola nɛn nɔn ta leɛ, dɛ le bwejen tenten bɛl ta, dɛ ba lɔ buni ne ayaawa ne choh ne suuɡapoŋ dɛ suuɡaswɛm la, dɛ kuuɡu burbur ken la munii.
Nemenɛ Korowiirii baɡle kooro waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa kerekere.
Deera haa deera la munii n baɡle dɛ berɛ baɡle a mun kɛrɛdɛ ken tɛɛ la.” Ate, Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ kpɔ duure tɛ Daneɛl.
Dɛ ŋɔ bá ɛ saraha dɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma tɛ Daneɛl.
Kooro la ŋɔ Daneɛl be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɛ Dɔɔranar bwa Dɔɔ, ne Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛ ɡela nɛra won dɛɛ na chaahna dɛ won a mun baɡla, dɛkalkɛ he wono baɡle waa aa sɔah nɔ mun.” Kooro la ɛ Daneɛl nɛnjen, dɛ kɛo konjena taeh, dɛ kpɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta kpeɡri bwa do o nɔn ta.
O ɛo Babelɔn harɛ ta wejerema bwa nomoa.
A bwa habɔɔ la, Daneɛl soŋe kooro la, asɛ o kpɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta bwa waa do Sadrak ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo nɔn ta.
Asɛ Daneɛl te ta do koodem bela dɛ ɛ nomoa.
Kooro Nebukadnesa suuɡaswɛm voɡ A habɔɔ la, Kooro Nebukadnesa ɡelɔ ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa voɡ, o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale fifraanuanaarɛ, asɛ o paɡri lɔ naɡale anuanaarɛ.
Asɛ dɛ ka cheɡo Babelɔn deŋɡarere dor harɛ ta bobɛl waa chɔa kaa baa yerɛ bela Dura.
Asɛ dɛ yerɛ harɛ la ta nomonome ŋɔ bá cheme, koranar ne nomonome baa chɔ harɛre nyoo, ne laa sitɔɔla ne nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi suuɡare ta, ne nomonome baa dɛ bol waa kɔɔto, dɛ nomonome baa kaa dɛ do harɛ la ta bwa ŋɔ bá ba cheme, ásɛ dɛ pili voɡ la.
Nomonome la bwa aa laŋa dɛ́ ka pili voɡ la, ba kaa che o sie.
Ate, kooro keame bɛl ir che dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Harɛre nɛra bwa ne wobol bɛlbwa nɛra haa le he harɛre ta ba, waa kooro aa dɛ do heyaa a ta laanee kɛŋɔ, dɛ he ba dɛ no bɛle, ne kalipere, ne janjelare, dɛ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ lɔ yela sii aa, a chɛ kɛ he ɡuŋi, dɛ́ duu voɡ Kooro Nebukadnesa aa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛo dɛ cheɡo la.
Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh ɡuŋa dɛ́ duu voɡ la la, baa kpɔɔ ka do nii aa lɔ fononoo binii.” Anomanta, harɛre nɛra bwa ne wobol bɛlbwa nɛra baa le harɛre ta ba aa no bɛle, ne kalipere, ne janjelare dɛ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ lɔ yela sii la, ba den ɡuŋi dɛ duu suuɡaswɛm voɡ Kooro Nebukadnesa aa cheɡo la.
A ɡɛ saŋee, Babelɔn harɛ wejerema bane baa jemɛ weweela waa la Kooro Nebukadnesa be, dɛ ka chɔɡ Juu tena tɛo.
Ba kaa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Korowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ!
N naa kooro, he do mmara ŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa no bɛle, ne kalipere, ne janjelare dɛ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ lɔ yela la, ó ɡuŋi dɛ́ duu suuɡaswɛm voɡ la.
Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa wola ɡuŋe dɛ duuru la, bá kpɔɔ do nii aa lɔ fononoo bini.
Sadrak ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo baa ɛ Juu tena he kpɔ ba chɔ Babelɔn harɛ nɔ waa nyoa la, ba vɛh he waa la.
Baa he voɡa tomɛ, dɛ vɛh suuɡaswɛm voɡ haa kpɔa cheɡ la ɡe ɡuŋa.” Ate, Kooro Nebukadnesa baah di kohona, asɛ o ɡel ba ka yerɛ Sadrak ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo, dɛ ba ba ne o sie.
Anee Kooro Nebukadnesa bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “A ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ he vɛh n voɡa la ne suuɡaswɛm voɡ maa cheɡo la toma aa?
Dɛ he baa no bɛle, ne kalipere, ne janjelare dɛ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ lɔ yela sii, dɛ ɡuŋi suuɡaswɛm voɡ la aa, dɛ a wer.
Kɛ dɛ he vɛh ɡuŋa aa, baa denoo kpɔ heyaa ka do fononoo nijena aa dɛ hɔ kohona la bini.
Dɛ voɡ besoo dɛ́ won lɛ heyaa le n nɔn ta jaɔ?” Asɛ Sadrak ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, a ta hiaih kɛŋɔ ya won lɛ ya te he sie waa nɔ ta.
Dɛ ba kpɔ yaa ka do fononoo nijena aa dɛ hɔ kohona bini naa, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ won lɛ yaa le o ta, dɛ́ won lɛ yaa he nɔn ta ɡe.
N naa kooro, hale dɛ Korowii ta yaa ba lɛɛ kwaraa naa, yaa he voɡa kɛɛ kon haa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaaro laanee tomɛ.” Ate kwaraa Kooro Nebukadnesa baah di Sadrak, ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo nɛɛ kohona, o ŋɔ ba kwaa fononoo nii la do a ɡwaa ɡɛ aa doa la keraanuanɛ, dɛ ŋɔ o laa tena ba bwara aa kpeɡa la bini bane be ŋɔ, bá vɔrɔwe Sadrak ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ka do fononoo nijena aa dɛ hɔ la bini.
Ate, ba vɔrɔwe nɛra batoro la, dɛ ba ta do batakaarejaŋa ne yapejaŋa, dɛ yapondɛɛɡa baa kpɔa vɔrɔwe nyuune bwa ne laala baa doa bwa, dɛ kpɔ ba ka ta fononoo nijena la bini.
Gɛ kooro waa la aa hiah, ne ɡɛ nii laa dɛ hɔ a nyoa do kpeɡri kohona nomanta, nii la nyaa laa tena la baa kpɔ Sadrak ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo ka ta nii la ta la, ba serewe, asɛ Sadrak ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo baa vɔɡ ba la ka le nijena la baah ta.
Buɡ la ta, Kooro Nebukadnesa den jah boyɔra ne, asɛ o bɔɔ o nomonome ŋɔ, “Nɛra batoro laa ba vɔrɔwe dɛ kpɔ ba ta nijena nɔ ta la aa?” Ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ɡɛɛ.” Asɛ kooro ŋɔ o nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi na.
N dɛ na nɛra banaarɛ baa valɛ nii la ta, ba ta ban vɔrɔwɛ, ba ta fueh ɡe.
Onɔ la waa jaa naarɛ la dɛ le nyundua torome.” Ate, Kooro Nebukadnesa ka che bɛne fononoo nijena la nyoa bɔr, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ yerɛ ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii bonɔɔna Sadrak ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo, hé le nii la ta ba!” Buɡ la ta, ba den le ba che.
Asɛ koobii ne nomonome baa chɔ harɛ nyoo, ne laa sitɔɔla dɛ nomonome baa kaa dɛ do harɛ la ta bwa ba bar nɛra batoro la cheme dɛɛ nyiŋ ba.
Ba nao kɛŋɔ nii la ta ba bwadabii fueh, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ ba nyumpona ɛɛ nyaaroo, ba laala baa doa ɡe ta fueh.
Nii sɔɔh ɡe ta ba nɛɛ tɔe.
Kooro Nebukadnesa ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii Sadrak, ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo aa dɛ tomɔ la.
O ɡelɔ o nyundua torome ba, dɛ ba lɛ o bonɔɔna.
Ba kpɔ ba te tɛo, dɛ vɛh waa maa do ba a ta, dɛ sɛh kɛŋɔ ba sewɔ bɔ ba be kɛŋɔ ba ɡuŋi kɛɛ dɛ tomɛ voɡ bɛlbwa, atane Nemenɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ ɡbo.
Taraken n dɛ do mmara kɛŋɔ, harɛ bɛlbwa nɛn kɛɛ nomɛlbwa kɛɛ wobol bɛlbwa nɛra bol waa yaɡɛ Korowii Sadrak, ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo aa dɛ tomɔ la aa, bá teŋni naate bini, ásɛ o dem berɛ dimɡbia.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ voɡ bɛlbwa toole, dɛ́ won lɛ nɛn waa aa do ken nɔ ta.” Ate, kooro la berɛ ɛ Sadrak, ne Mesak dɛ Abɛdnɛɡo nomonjena Babelɔn harɛ bwa ta.
Kooro Nebukadnesa nɛɛtena deera Kooro Nebukadnesa chwerɛ tɔn kaa harɛ bɛlbwa ta ka tɛ wobol bɛlbwa nɛra.
O ŋɔ, “N dɛ na heya!
N sie lɛo kohona kɛŋɔ ń bol nyokpowaa ne we-ɛɛla Nemenɛ Korowii aa ɛa tɛ mɛ.
Korowii nyokpowe-ɛɛla waa ɛa tɛ yaa ta nyoa dɔe.
O waa waa dɛ ɛ ɡe kan taeh.
O kora ta jaɡa dɔe, wɛɛ di koraa saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.
Dɛ men Kooro Nebukadnesa soɡe n dem deŋnesɔɔhna ta, dɛ dɔ kondɔɔh kohona, n bwara sɔɔh mɛ koodem.
N deero asɛ dɛ na waane ɔmee laɡ mɛ.
Maa chɔa la n na wepila, asɛ koŋkwaa ane soo siwi ɡale n sie ta a ɡel mɛɛ ɔmɛ kohona.
Anomanta, n ɡelɔ ba yerɛ Babelɔn harɛ ta wejerema bwa ŋɔ bá ba cheme n sie, dɛ́ baɡ mɛ deera la mun.
Ate, dobodobo tena, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla, ne wejerema baa jemɛ weweela wa, dɛ voɡra bwa ba, asɛ n bol deera la baɡ ba, kɛ ba ta wone baɡ mɛ a mun.
A habɔɔ la, Daneɛl baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Bɛltesasa maa kpɔ n voɡ sɔn pao la, ba n be.
Voɡa aa wola nɛwɛnyina ɛɛ tɛo kpeɡri ane, anomanta, n bol n deera la o be.
Asɛ n ŋɔ Bɛltesasa waa ɛ dobodobo tena bwa nomoa la be ŋɔ, ‘N jemɔ kɛ voɡa aa wola nɛwɛnyina ɛɛ ane tɛɛ kpeɡri, asɛ wesɔɔhla bɛlbwa toole dɛ do kpeɡri tɛɛ.
N deera maa deera laanee la.
Baɡ mɛ a mun.
Wepila ane maa chɔa dɛ na laanee nɔ.
N na daa bɛl, asɛ o che harɛ bɛl baah ta.
Dɛ o kpeɡo kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ daa la dɛ kpeɡ dɛɛ do kan kohona, dɛ kpeɡ kaa leɡe nyundua.
Nɛn cheɡɛ harɛ jaɡa bobɛlbwa naa, o dɛ nao.
O papooni wer, o nɔna warɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa dɔ dɛɛ di.
O chunchule taa kpɔɡ bini ola ɛɛ chɔ, jumbii ɛɛ sɔh a kɔne o kpala ta.
Belaa kontaale bɛlbwa dɔ kwaa dɛɛ di.
N ta aa chɔa dɛɛ lii deera nɔ waa la, n nyiŋo dɛ na nyundua torome bɛl waa do ɡoroŋ, o tu le Korowii be nyundua dɛɛ ba.
O kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Hé teŋe daa la ta dɛ́ choo o kpala, dɛ́ nɛɛ o papooni le o kpala la ta, dɛ́ nɔr o nɔna la merɛ.
Hé doŋi kpɔɡ bini ola la le o chunchule ta, ásɛ dɛ doŋi jumbii la ɡe le o kpala ta.
Hé ɡel o muŋkpul la che, dɛ kpɔ buni jɔɡrɔre ne ayaawa vɔwɔ ó che kpɔɡ bini bela.
Hé ɡel mɛn lee o nɛ, ásɛ o ne kpɔɡ bini ola so kpɔɡ bini, harɛ nɔ ta.
Hé ɡel o liire charɛ ó kpɔ ol liire, o bɛ nɛn liire dɔ ka tel kɛŋɔ bene anuanɛ aa baa kaa.
Nyundua torome la ne o bala baa ja o nɛɛ dɛ do ɡoroŋ la bee ɡɛ deŋnetɛra waa nɔ le.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel nomɛlbwa waa soɡe le jemɛ kɛŋɔ, Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ di harɛre kora bwa kpeɡri, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin, hale dɛ kpɔ tɛ nɛra baa do pwɛre dɛɛ so kora ta.” Deera men Kooro Nebukadnesa aa deera laanee nɔ.
Bɛltesasa, baɡ mɛ a mun, dɛkalkɛ wejereme bɛlbwa toole n harɛ nɔ ta, dɛ́ won baɡ mɛ a mun.
He te, voɡa aa wola nɛwɛnyina ɛɛ aa tɛɛ kpeɡri ane nɔ, hɛɛ wonoo baɡle.’ ” Daneɛl deera mun baɡla Ate, Daneɛl baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Bɛltesasa la bwara yɔr kohona, o wili waa waa dɛ lii ta.
Anomanta, kooro la ŋɔ, “Bɛltesasa, bɛ ɡel deera la kɛɛ a mun baɡla dɔe ɔmee.” Ate, Bɛltesasa chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, n dɛ nyin kɛ deera nɔ ne a mun fe bɛ he waa ɛ, dɛ fee ɛ he dɔma wa.
Daa haa deera nao o do kan dɛ do kpeɡri, dɛ kpeɡ kaa leɡe nyundua baa nao harɛ bɛlbwa ta, o papooni do wer, o nɔna warɛ nomɛlbwa dɔ ane dɛɛ di, kpɔɡ bini ola chɔ o chunchule ta, asɛ jumbii sɔh a kɔne o kpala ta la, n naa kooro, henee daa waa kpeɡa dɛ do kpeɡri la che tɛ.
He kpeɡo dɛ kaa leɡe nyundua, asɛ dɛɛ di kpeɡri harɛre bwa ta.
N naa kooro, he na nyundua torome waa do ɡoroŋ o le nyundua dɛɛ tu, dɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé teŋe daa la ta, dɛ́ chɔɡo, hé ɡel o muŋkpul la che, dɛ́ kpɔ buni jɔɡrɔre ne ayaawa vɔwɔ, o ne o lune che kpɔɡ bini.
Hé ɡel mɛn le nyundua lee o muŋkpul nɔ nɛ, ásɛ o ne kpɔɡ bini ola so kpɔɡ bini bene anuanɛ.’ N naa kooro, deera la munii la.
Gɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ aa chiɡ he nɛɛ.
Baa doŋii le nɛra bini he ne kpɔɡ bini ola ka so.
Hɛɛ chwe kpɔɡaa kɛŋɔ nao, ásɛ mɛn ta he nɛɛ bene anuanɛ, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ haa ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ di kpeɡri harɛre kora bwa ta.
Korowii ɡboo dɛɛ le nɛn waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ kpɔɔ so kora ta.
Daa la muŋkpul ne o lune la nyundua torome la aa ŋɔa ó che la munii kɛŋɔ, dɛ he baa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɔ kpeɡri harɛ nɔ bwa ta naa, he kora ɛɛ berɔɔ che.
Anomanta, n naa kooro, no waa maa dɛ jae a ta nɔ.
Gel wechɔɡa ɛɛ, dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa toɡra, dɛ́ ɡel he nyubinikpeɡ la, dɛɛ na nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba sum.
He wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii dɛɛ la.” Deera la baa ɛ ɡɛ A ɡɛ waa la bwa chiɡ Kooro Nebukadnesa nɛ.
Korobie fi dɛ anɛ habɔɔ, dɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa dɛ valɛ Babelɔn koodem saldoa.
O ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen Babelɔn waa do kan ken nɔ, menee doo o ɛ n koobwɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ baɡle n kpeɡri kohona ne n jirima maa dɔa.” O nyoa ta lee, dɛ taa bɛl le nyundua dɛ ŋɔ, “Kooro Nebukadnesa, dɛɛ no, kpeɡri haa dɔa he kora ta la le he nɔn ta.
Baa doŋii le nɛra bini he ne kpɔɡ bini ola ka so.
Hɛɛ chwe kpɔɡaa kɛŋɔ nao bene anuanɛ, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ haa ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ di kpeɡri harɛre kora bwa ta.
Korowii ɡboo dɛɛ le nɛn waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ kpɔɔ so kora ta.” Waa nyundua torome la aa ŋɔa aa chiɡ Kooro Nebukadnesa nɛɛ la ɛ kpela.
A chiɡ o nɛɛ buɡ la ta, asɛ ba doŋu le nɛra bini, asɛ o chwe kpɔɡa kɛŋɔ nao ken.
Mɛn ta o nɛ, o nyumpona do kɛŋɔ kee kena ken, o nonie ɡe kpeɡ kɛŋɔ jumbie nanie ken.
Kooro Nebukadnesa ŋɔ, “Bene anuanɛ la aa baa kaa la, n ha sie nyiŋi nyundua, ate dɛ n sie chole harɛ, asɛ n kpɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii, dɛ kpɛɛro dɛ tɛo jirima kɛŋɔ onee lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Wɛɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la, o kora ɛɛ cheo saŋ te bɛlbwa.
Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta waa ta komɛlbwa ɛɛ o be.
Gɛ waa dɛ nyin laanee wɛɛ ɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ nɛra nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa aa won tɔŋlo kɛɛ dɛ́ bɔɔro waa waa ɛa.
Gɛ saŋ n sie aa chole harɛ la.
Korowii berɔ tɛ mɛ duure ne jirima n kora kan waa doa la wa.
Nɛra baa dɛ ja mɛ ne n nomonome nyin n bɔr, dɛ berɛ kpɔ mɛ cheɡ kora ta, asɛ n berɛ dɔ kpeɡri waa ɡwaa wubwa kon la.
