Name, men Kooro Nebukadnesa, n dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii waa dɛ di kora nyundua, dɛɛ tɛo sɔn ne jirima dɛkalkɛŋɔ, o waa toɡrɔ o wobɛlbwa ɡe do wer.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɡɔɔ o te la, o won naate ne harɛ bala.”
Nɔn waa chwerɛ danjwɛɛ ta wa Awola jwaana bɛl, Kooro Bɛlsasa ɡelɔ ba ɛ kondikonjena, o ta nɔn yerɛ o nomonjena nɛra kaɡboŋ, asɛ o ne baa di kwaa la dɛɛ nyɔ sen. Ba ta aa dɛ nyɔ sen la, Kooro Bɛlsasa tomɛ o bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa numoli o mɛɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa fa aa paa le Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la ba, ásɛ o ne o nomonjena ne o haahna dɛ o sɛnanar kpɔ nyɔ sen.
Ate, ba ka pa a ɡɛ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa numoli la le Korowii Dea Jerusalam ba, asɛ Kooro Bɛlsasa ne o nomonjena ne o haahna dɛ o sɛnanar kpɔ dɛɛ nyɔ sen. Baa dɛ nyɔ sen la, dɛ ba dɛ kpɛɛ voɡa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm, ne suuɡapoŋa, ne bune, ne ayaawa, ne daa dɛ bwea ɛa la.
Buɡ la ta, dɛ nɛn nɔn ba dɛ chwerɛ koodem danjwɛɛ baa maalo ta, dɛ kandea cheɡɛ bela dɛɛ chaah.
Asɛ Kooro Bɛlsasa ɛɛ nyiŋi ɡɛ nɔn la aa doa dɛɛ chwerɛ la.
O siebɔr ɡwaŋɔ, o liire chɔɡ, asɛ ɔmee lawɔ kohona o natuune ɛɛ sa dɛɛ lɔ dɔŋa.
Ate, kooro kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla, ne wejerema baa jemɛ weweela wa dɛ voɡra, ŋɔ bá ba.
Baa bala la, Kooro la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ bɛlbwa wono kure kwaa baa chwera nɔ, dɛ baɡ mɛ a mun aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá tɔɔ yakɔl, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm jɔɡrɔre do o baŋa, ásɛ n habɔɔ ó ɛ nɛn waa teŋa tooro, dɛ dɔ kpeɡri kohona n kora harɛ nɔ ta.” Ate, kooro wejerema la bwa laŋɔ, kɛ ba ta wone kure kwaa baa chwera la, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa wonoo baɡle a mun.
Anomanta, ɔmee kohona lawɛ Kooro Bɛlsasa, o siebɔr ɡe foo kohona.
O nomonjena liire chɔɡɔ, ba ta ɡɛ baa ɛ nae.
Kooro nya aa no kooro ne o nomonjena ɡbɔɡa la, asɛ o ir la dea baa di kondikonjena o ta la, dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Korowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ saŋ bɛlbwa!
Bɛ ɡel a hae ásɛ he siebɔr foo ɡɛ!
Baa bɛl lɔ he harɛ nɔ ta voɡa aa wola nɛwɛnyina ɛɛ tɛo kpeɡri ane.
He mɛɛ kora dii saŋ la, o nao kɛŋɔ o ɛ wejereme, dɛ jemɛ waa kɛŋɔ voɡa ken.
He mɛɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa ɡbaɡba kpɔɔ ɛ dobodobo tena, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla, ne wejerema baa jemɛ weweela waa dɛ voɡra bwa nomoa.
Gɛ baa la sɔne Daneɛl, dɛ he mɛɛ dɛ yerɔ Bɛltesasa.
He mɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ o liire wer o dɔ wejema dɛɛ no waa mun, dɛ won deera mun baɡla.
O won waa aa kpeɡa ne sɛɡla ɡe bwa mun baɡla.
Gel ba la ka yerɛ Daneɛl, ásɛ o ba baɡle a mun.” Anomanta, ba laŋɔ ka kpɔ Daneɛl ba kooro sie, asɛ o pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Henee Daneɛl, haa ja nɛra n mɛɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa aa laɡ ba le Juda harɛ ta dɛ ba Babelɔn nɛɛ la aa?
N noɔ kɛŋɔ voɡa aa wola nɛwɛnyina ɛɛ tɛɛ kpeɡri ane, he dɔ wejema dɛ dɔ liire ɡa.
Ba ba nɛra baa dɔ wejema ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɔmwe-ɛɛla ne n be ŋɔ, bá kure kwaa baa chwera dawɛ bonɔ nɔ, dɛ́ baɡ mɛ a mun, kɛ ba ta wone baɡle a mun.
Taraken, n noɔ kɛŋɔ he won waa mun baɡla, waa a mun noe aa kpeɡa ɡe la, he won a mun baɡla.
Dɛ he wono kure kwaa baa chwera nɔ dɛ baɡ mɛ a mun aa, mɛɛ tɔe yakɔlee, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm jɔɡrɔre do he baŋa, ásɛ n habɔɔ henee dɛ́ teŋɛ tooro, dɛ́ dɔ kpeɡri n kora ta harɛ nɔ ta.” Anee Daneɛl chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ɡel koŋkɛɛla la do he be, kɛɛ kpɔ tɛ nomɛl.
Ane a bwa, mɛɛ kure kwaa baa chwera dawɛ nɔɔ tɛɛ, dɛ́ baɡle a mun.
N naa kooro, Nemenɛ Korowii ɛ he mɛɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa koojen, dɛ tɛo jirima ne nyanyini dɛ kpeɡri kohona.
Kpeɡri waa tɛo nomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa ne harɛre ta nɛra ne wobol bɛlbwa tena dɛ ɔmɔ dɛɛ chel.
Nɛra waa dɛ nyin ba kpoora la, o kpoo ba.
Banɔ la waa wola ba kpoora nyin la, o ɡel ba.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o ɡɔɔ o sɔn la, o dɛ ɛo ɡɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o ba o ne harɛ ɡe la, o dɛ ɛo ɡɛ.
Kɛ waa baa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ o nyu bini do kpeɡri wɛɛ ɛ mbarafo la, Korowii iru kora ta, jirima waa dɔa la paŋɔ.
Korowii doŋu le nɛra bini asɛ o liire do kɛŋɔ ol liire ken.
O ne kpɔɡ bini keeɡore kaa so, wɛɛ chwe kpɔɡa kɛŋɔ nao ken.
Mɛn ta o nɛɛ o bwara pweh, ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa na kɛŋɔ Nemenɛ Korowiirii dɔ kora nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ di la kpeɡri, dɛɛ kpɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyin.
Kɛ hen, n naa Kooro Bɛlsasa, haa ɛ n naa Kooro Nebukadnesa bibaa la, he jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, kɛ he ta he te pwɛrɛ.
He ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Korowii waa dɛ di kora nyundua nɛ, dɛ ka kpɔ numoli aa lɔ o Dea he ne he nomonjena, ne he haahna dɛ he sɛnanar kpɔ nyɔ sen.
He kpɛɛ voɡa baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa, ne suuɡaswɛm, ne ayaawa, ne bune, ne daa dɛ bwea ɛa aa wola na, aa wola waa no kɛɛ dɛɛ no waa mun la.
Kɛ Korowii he mkpa ne he wobɛlbwa aa lɔ o nɔn ta la te, he ta duure kpɔe tɛo.
A waa Korowii ɡel nɔn la ba chwerɛ danjwɛɛ la ta la.
Waa waa chwera laanee teŋa nɔ, mene, mene, tekel, parsen.
Mene munii kɛŋɔ, Korowii kure he tɔpera haa di he kora ta, dɛ ba a ne a jaɡa.
Tekel munii kɛŋɔ, ba kpɔe chɔŋɛ kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwaa ta, dɛ na kɛ haa tɔɡɛ.
Pɛrɛs ɡe munii kɛŋɔ, ba bɔne he kora bini tɛ Midia ne Pɛɛsea tena.” Ate, buɡ la ta, Kooro Bɛlsasa ɡel ba ka kpɔ yakɔl ba tɔ Daneɛl, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm jɔɡrɔre do o baŋa, asɛ dɛ ɛo nɛntoorote waa dɔ kpeɡri o kora ta harɛ la ta.
Awola jwaana la tentenee ba kpo Babelɔn Kooro Bɛlsasa, asɛ Midia te baa dɛ yerɔ Dareɔs lɛ kora la di, dɛ o di bene fifraanumɛl dɛ anɛ.
Ba lawɛ Daneɛl do nyujentena bɔɔ bini Kooro Dareɔs aa baa di kora la, o liiro ŋɔ ó le nomonome lafa fifraanɛ bá chɔ harɛ bamperi nyoo, dɛɛ nyiŋi a ta, o harɛ la bwa ta, o le nomonjena batoro ɡe ba chɔ ba nyoa, dɛ́ nyiŋi na kɛŋɔ nomonome la dɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa aŋwɛnɛ ta, ásɛ wobɛlbwa won kaa ɡɛ kooro aa dɛ nyin.
Daneɛl ne nɛra banɛ banee o le.
Daneɛl baɡlɔ kɛ o won toma ɛɛ dɛɛ ɡwaa o bala la, ne nɛra baa lee ba baa nyiŋi harɛ la bamperi ta la, asɛ o toma su kooro la siwi.
A ɡɛ nomanta, kooro la liiro kɛŋɔ ó den kpɔ harɛ la waa bwa do o nɔn ta wɛɛ nyiŋi o ta.
Anee o bala nomonjena la ne nomonome baa lee ba baa nyiŋi harɛ la bamperi la, ɛɛ nyin Daneɛl bwara wechɔɡa dɛ́ le kora la be pera, kɛ ba ta wone.
Ba ta o bwara wechɔɡe bɛlbwa nae, dɛkalkɛ o waa wer dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ.
Anee nomonome ne nomonjena la ŋɔ, “Yaa Daneɛl nɔ wechɔɡe bɛlbwaa dɔ, atane Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la waa ta.” Ate, ba bwa la Kooro Dareɔs be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Kórowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la!
Ya nomonome bwa yaa dɛ nyiŋi Babelɔn harɛ nɔ ta, nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra nɛ, ne nomonome baa chɔ harɛre nyoo, ne laa sitɔɔla dɛ nomonome baa jaa, sɛoh kɛŋɔ hen n naa kooro do mmara, dɛ nyiŋi na kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɛ tomaa.
Gel bɛlbwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ, ó ɡuŋi voɡ kɛɛ nɛn tɔpera fifraatoro nɔ baah ta, atane he ɡbo.
Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh ɡɛ mmara nɔ la, bá lawɔ ka do nyujentena bɔɔ bini.
N naa kooro, do ɡɛ mmara la dɛ́ ɡel ba chwerɔ, ásɛ he kpɔ nɔn ɛɡɛ o ta, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won berɔ ɡɛ baa wola won Midia ne Pɛɛsea tena mmara berɛ la.” Anomanta, Kooro Dareɔs ɡelɔ ba chwerɛ mmara la.
Daneɛl aa noa kɛ ba chwerɛ mmara la la, o la dem dɛ teeh kaa o abrɔsane doa dea bini.
Dɛ dea la tokorore pilo dɛ chaɡɛ Jerusalam.
O dɛ ɡuŋi dɛɛ soŋe Korowii keraatoro tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ kpɛɛro.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ɛ wubwa.
Belaa nɛra baa la kooro be o do mmara la pɛ, dɛ la ka na kɛŋɔ Daneɛl ɡuŋo dɛɛ soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ ó chao.
Anomanta, ba la Kooro Dareɔs be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “He ta mmara doe ŋɔ tɔpera fifraatoro aa lɔ ya sie nɔ ta, nomɛlbwa waa ɡuŋi voɡ kɛɛ nɛn, dɛ he kooro laa o ba ɡuŋi dɛ́ soŋe la, bá lawɔ ka do nyujentena bɔɔ bini naa?” Ate, kooro chaŋe ŋɔ, “Mmara la ta chɔ le dɛ che kiŋkiŋ ɡɛ Midia ne Pɛɛsea tena mmara baa wola won berɔ la.” Asɛ ba ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “Daneɛl waa ja nɛra baa laɡ ba le Juda harɛ bojaŋ ba la aa hen duu, waa mmara haa doa la ɡe ta teŋɛ.
O ta dɛ soŋe Korowii tɔpere bɛlbwa keraatoro.” Kooro la aa no ɡɛ la, a we o nɛɛ kohona.
Dɛ o siwi beɡrɔ wɛɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ waa che o ta dɛ́ lɛ Daneɛl ta.
O lii a waa ka tel kɛŋɔ wee aa joa.
Asɛ nɛra la berɛ pɛ dɛ la kooro be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, lii kɛŋɔ Midia ne Pɛɛsea tena mmara bini la, dɛ kooro do mmara aa, baa won on berɛ.” Ate, Kooro Dareɔs ɡel ba lawɛ Daneɛl ba, dɛ kpɔɔ ka ta nyujentena be a bɔɔ bini.
Kooro la ŋɔ Daneɛl be ŋɔ, “Kórowii haa dɛ tomɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa la lɛɛ.” Ba kpɔ bwe bɛl ba tɔ bɔɔ la nyoa, asɛ kooro la kpɔ o noniseɡ ne o nomonjena la noniseɡa ka pɛl bwe la ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won ka lɛ Daneɛl ta.
Kooro la berɔ kaa o dem, o ta wone di kondikwaa jwaana la bwa, o sie ta lɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ silɛɛ waane bɛlbwa o dem ɡe.
O ta wone chɔ dom.
Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, kooro la iro dɛ ɛ warane la nyujentena bɔɔ la ta.
Waa dɛ bɛne bɔɔ la la, o bambile chɔɡɔ o kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ yerɛ Daneɛl ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la bonɔɔ, Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ kasinteŋ ne tɔpere bɛlbwa la wono ba lɛɛ le nyujentena la be naa?” Anee Daneɛl ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Kórowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la ɡelɔ o torome ba dɛ ba tɔ nyujentena la nyoo.
A ta wone do mɛ bol, dɛkalkɛ Korowii nao kɛŋɔ n di bole, asɛ hen n naa kooro ɡe, n ta hen wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ.” Kooro sie lɛo kohona, o ŋɔ bá ka lawɛ Daneɛl le bɔɔ la bini.
Asɛ ba la ka lawɔ le bɔɔ la bini, dɛ komɛlbwa ta o bobɛlbwa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ o yarada Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ.
Ate, Kooro Dareɔs ɡel ba ka kpɔ nɛra baa haŋɛ Daneɛl nyoa la ba tɛo, asɛ o ɡel ba kpɔ ba ne ba haahna, ne bii bwa ka do nyujentena bɔɔ la bini.
Baa wola bɔɔ la mun ta tele mɔɔ kwara la, dɛ nyujentena la toɡri ba bini, dɛ paɡre ba hoɡa bwa.
Asɛ Kooro Dareɔs chwerɛ tɔne ka tɛ wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛre ne o harɛ ta bwa.
O ŋɔ, “N dɛ na he bwa!
N do mmara harɛ maa dɛ di kora o ta la kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa ɛɛ ɔmɛ dɛɛ duu Korowii Daneɛl aa dɛ tomɔ la.
O ɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa, o lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
O kora aa ɡu bwa, o kpeɡri waa dɔa ta jaɡa dɔe.
Onee dɛɛ lɛ nɛn dɛ ɡel o dɔ o nyu dɛɛ di, dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowa, o we-ɛɛla ɡe do kan nyundua ne harɛ bwa.
Onee lɛ Daneɛl nyujentena nɔn ta aa wola on kpoe.” Daneɛl wobɛlbwa wer tɛo ɡɛ saŋ Koojen Dareɔs aa soɡe kora ta, ne ɡɛ saŋ Pɛɛsea Kooro Saeros aa di kora.
Daneɛl deera dɛ na kpɔɡ bini oljena anaarɛ ane wa Babelɔn Kooro Bɛlsasa aa di kora benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta la, men Daneɛl deero dɛ na wepila ane ɡɛ saŋ maa chɔ mpa ta jwaana.
Asɛ n chwerɛ waa maa naa deera la ta jwaana la bil.
N deera la ta la, n nao kɛŋɔ peu bele anaarɛ tao le baŋ bɛlbwa kpɔ nyundua dɛ baa ta mpo ta.
Asɛ mpo bini oljena anaarɛ ɛɡɛ le mpo la ta, bɛlbwa korɛ o dɔŋ ta.
“Oljen waa tɔ sie la do kɛŋɔ nyujente, dɛ dɔ kena kɛŋɔ kee ken.
Maa nyiŋa na la, ba tu o kena la le o nɛɛ dɛ lawɔ ir, o che o nakpale anɛ ta kɛŋɔ nɛn ken, asɛ o dɔ nɛn liire ɡe.
N berɔ na oljen nɛɛte o do kɛŋɔ sisire ken.
O iro joŋi o habɔɔ nakpale anɛ ta, dɛ kuɡlambii atoro lɔ o nyoa o kpɔ nyena nyɛwa.
Asɛ taa bɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Ir ka chwe ola ɡɛ bwa haa won.’ Onɔ habɔɔ, n berɔ na oljen bɛl ɡe o do kɛŋɔ noniete, kena anaarɛ lɔ o nyaŋ ta kɛŋɔ jumbie ken.
Gɛ oljen nɔ dɔ nyuune anaarɛ, ba tɛo kora dii kpeɡri.
A habɔɔ, n na oljen waa teŋa naarɛ.
O ɔma o waa dɔ nyokpoa o do kpeɡri ɡe kohona.
O nyena ɛ bune dɛ do kan, komɛlbwa waa lawɛ la, o dɛ di o ola, dɛ́ tiɡri o kabora do harɛ.
O korɛ oljena la bwa bini, dɛ dɔ nyeɡlare fi.
Maa dɛ nyiŋi nyeɡlare la la, nyeɡlejeɡaa bɛl berɔ ba le pa a baah ta, asɛ wubwa kwaa atoro la tu le onjeɡa la sie.
Nyeɡlejeɡa la dɔ sibie kɛŋɔ nɛn ken, o dɔ nyoa dɛɛ bol mbarafo wobol.
Men Daneɛl berɔ na kɛŋɔ kookane aa baa che, asɛ Nɛn Waa Lole Saŋ La Bwa ba so kane la bɛl ta.
O tɔ yal o to kɛŋɔ yabi, asɛ o nyumpona to kpelkpel kɛŋɔ pee pona.
Ninlao ɡboo o kookara la, asɛ kara la nakpale do kɛŋɔ saaker nakpale dɛɛ hɔ.
Asɛ nii do kɛŋɔ moo dɛɛ palɛ o sie.
Nɛra kaɡboŋa bele kaɡboŋa ɛɛ tomɔ, nɛra kaɡboŋa fi bele kaɡboŋa fi ɡe che o sie.
Saŋ telo kɛŋɔ nɛra so dɛ bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole, asɛ ba pili tɔne.
N ta aa dɛ nyiŋi la, dɛ nyeɡlejeɡa la dɛ bol mbarafo wobol.
N nyiŋo ka tel kɛŋɔ baa kpo oljen waa teŋa naarɛ la, dɛ chɔɡ o ol, dɛ ɡɔɔ ta nii aa dɛ hɔ la ta.
Oljena aa kaa la, ba lɛ a kpeɡri a be, dɛ tɛa ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ á do le ka tel saŋ bɛl tama.
Wepila la ta jwaana la ne la, n na nomɛl kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini bie ken, o le nyundua baama bini dɛɛ ba.
O baa tel Nɛn Waa Lole Saŋ La Bwa la jwɛh, asɛ dɛ ba che o sie.
Nɛn Waa Lole Saŋ La Bwa la tɛ nɛwɛnyini bie la kpeɡri, ne jirima dɛ kora dii, asɛ harɛre ne nɛra bwa soo siwi, dɛ wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra ɛɛ tomɔ.
Wɛɛ di kpeɡrii saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la, o kora aa ɡu bwa.
Deera la mun baɡla Wepila men Daneɛl aa naa la ha mɛ taeh, doma ne liire bini bwa.
N suuhno tel nɛra baa cheɡɛ bela la bini bɛl, dɛ ŋɔ ó baɡ mɛ wepila la mun kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ o baɡ mɛ ɡɛ oljena anaarɛ la aa cheɡa tɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Oljena anaarɛ la cheɡɔ tɛ koojena anaarɛ aa dɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta bala.
A bwa habɔɔ la, Nemenɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra laanee wɛɛ ba kora la kpɔe tɛ, ó ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’ Asɛ n berɛ dɛɛ nyin ń jemɛ oljen waa teŋa naarɛ, o waa korɛ o bala bini dɛ do ɔma kohona, o nyena ɛ bune o nanie ɛ ayaawa la.
O lawɛ komɛlbwa naa, o dɛ chweo dɛ diu, dɛ tiɡri o kabora do harɛ la mun.
N berɔ dɛɛ nyin ń jemɛ nyeɡlare fi aa paaɡe o nyu ta, ne nyeɡle bɛl o ɡe aa lea pa asɛ nyeɡlare atoro tu la mun.
O dɔ sibie ne nyoa dɛɛ bol mbarafo wobol.
A ɡɛ nyeɡle laanee do ɔma ɡwaa o bala bwa la.
N ta aa dɛ nyiŋi la, n nao kɛŋɔ ɡɛ nyeɡle la yo Korowii nɛra ba waa aa toɡra laa dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, mɔɔ Nɛn Waa Lole Saŋ La Bwa la ba, dɛ́ ba pa Nemenɛ Korowii nɛra ba waa aa toɡra la boldɛɛɡe, asɛ saŋ tel kɛŋɔ ba kpɔ ba kora di name.
O baɡ mɛ oljen waa teŋa naarɛ la waa mun.
‘Oljen waa teŋa naarɛ la cheɡɔ tɛ kora waa teŋa naarɛ, dɛ́ ba harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
O kora ɛɛ korɛ kora bɛlbwa taa, dɛ́ lɛ harɛ nɔ bwa dɔɔh, dɛ́ tiɡri o ta.
Nyeɡlare fi la cheɡɔ tɛ koranar fi baa dɛ ba oljen waa teŋa naarɛ la kora ta la lee.
Ba habɔɔ la, koofale bɛl ɛɛ bao dɛ́ korɛ banɔ la nɛ, dɛ́ ir koranar batoro.
Wɛɛ bol waa yaɡɛ Nemenɛ Korowiirii, ásɛ dɛ fiiɡi Korowii nɛra ba waa aa toɡra, dɛ́ takapɔ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ beɡre Korowii nɛra mmarare baa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ne tɔpejenaa.
Ásɛ Korowii nɛra ba waa aa toɡra la do o lɔɡa bene atoro korobie anumɛl.
Nomonome ɛɛ soo dɛ́ bol o wa, dɛ́ laa kpeɡri waa dɔa la lɛ o be, dɛ́ chɔɡo kwaraa a tonɛ.
Kpeɡri ne kan harɛ nɔ ta kora aa dɔa la ɛɛ berɔɔ ba ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii nɛra ba waa aa toɡra la kon.
Korowii Kora la kpeɡri aa ɡu bwa, ásɛ koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ɛɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ no o wa.’ Waa la jaɡaa la.
Men Daneɛl aa naa la, n ɔmɔ kohona n siebɔr ɡwaŋɛ, kɛ n kpɔ wobɛlbwa do n nyu bini.”
Daneɛl pebal ne booh waa naa wepila ta wa Kooro Bɛlsasa aa di kora bene atoro ta la, men Daneɛl na wepila ja anɔ la n fa aa naa la habɔɔ.
Wepila la ta la, n nao kɛŋɔ maa lɔ bwɛjen Susa baa ma danjwɛjen baro, o do Elam harɛ ta.
Dɛ n cheɡɛ Ulai Moo nyoa, asɛ n na pebal bɛl o dɔ nyeɡlejaŋa anɛ.
A habɔɔ la, nyeɡle la bɛl berɔ ba kpeɡ dɛ do jaŋne ɡwaa o dɔŋ la.
N na pebal la kɛŋɔ waa chuɡri ola le wee cholibɔr ne weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Ol bɛlbwa ta wone che o sie kɛɛ dɛ won sɔɔh o kpeɡri nyoa.
O ɛ ɡɛ a too o tea dɛ dɔ kpeɡri taeh.
N ta aa dɛ lii dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ mun la, dɛ booh bɛl le wee cholibɔr ba, dɛɛ chwa wɔrɔbe nɛɛ bobɛlbwa, kɛ dɛ o nakpale ɡe aa harɛ leɡe.
O dɔ nyeɡlejen beŋkpoŋ o pa o sibie baah ta.
O ba pebal n fa aa nao o dɔ nyeɡlare anɛ dɛ che moo nyoa la be, dɛ ba chuɡru o bokpeɡa bwa ne.
N nao kɛŋɔ o kpɔ bandia kohona ka pu pebal la, asɛ dɛ chuɡo dɛ laa o nyeɡlare anɛ la kuuɡi.
Pebal la sɔɔhnɔ o ta wone pu booh la yo, asɛ o chuɡo ɡo harɛ dɛ tiɡri o nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ won lɛ pebal la.
Booh la baa dɔ kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ o ta aa dɛ di kpeɡri la, o nyeɡlejen la kuu asɛ nyeɡlare anaarɛ aa kana le paaɡe o buɡ ta.
Bɛl chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyundua, bɛl chaɡɛ wee leebɔr, bɛl chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ bɛl chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr.
Nyeɡlejeɡa bɛl leɔ pa nyeɡlare la bɛl ta, dɛ di kpeɡri kohona chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr ne wee leebɔr, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Israel Harɛdɛɛɡe la ta.
Nyeɡlejeɡa la wono kpeɡ kohona, dɛ ka tel nyundua laa kwaa aa wara dɛ ɛ weweela la be, asɛ dɛ taɡɛ a bini ane ta harɛ, dɛ tiɡri a nɛ.
O ɛ o te nɛnjen kɛŋɔ Korowii dɔm baa wara kooro la ken, dɛ laa tɔpere bɛlbwa saraha baa ɛa dɛɛ tɛo la lɛ o be, dɛ ɡel doŋa kah Korowii Dea la.
Nɛra fe aa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare tɔpere bɛlbwa la, wechɔɡaa ba berɛ dɛɛ ɛ.
A che a ta Korowii waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la nyoɡre.
Wobɛlbwa nyeɡle la aa ɛa la chiɡu kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ n no kɛŋɔ nyundua torome bɛl aa dɛ bɔɔ o dɔŋ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo waa baa naa wepila la ta ɛɛ ba a jaɡa bala ɔ?
Bɛweeree wechɔɡa aa do ɔma dɛ ba chiɡ tɔpere bɛlbwa sarahare naa ta nɔ ɛɛ ba ɡela ɔ?
Saŋ besoo bá tiɡri Korowii dɔm baa wara ne Korowii Dea nɛɛ ka tel ɔ?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Aa ɛo ka tel chɔɔ ne jɔmɔre kaɡboŋa anɛ lafraatoro, baa wola won ɛ sarahare, a habɔɔ mɔɔ ba ɛ we-ɛɛla, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ Korowii Dea la ta, ó do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii.” Wepila la mun baɡla Men Daneɛl aa na wepila la dɛ ta ɛɛ nyin a mun dɛ jemɛ la, n den na komɛl o ba che n sie kɛŋɔ nɛn, asɛ n no nomɛl taa Ulai Moo la nyoa o ŋɔ, “Gebreɛl, baɡle baa nɔ o wepila waa naa la mun.” Ate, Gebreɛl ba che bɛne bela maa cheɡa la, asɛ n ɔmɛ kohona dɛ chole kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Anee o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bie, n dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ wepila nɔ mun dɛ baɡle waa bwa jaɡa saŋ wa.” O ta aa dɛ bol waa n be la, n sie bir mɛ n chole, asɛ o laɡ mɛ ir che chiŋ.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba waa aa dɛ ba Korowii bandia kohona la habɔɔ bala he be bola.
Wepila la dɛ baɡle waa bwa jaɡa saŋ wa.
Pebal haa nao o dɔ nyeɡlare anɛ la cheɡɔ tɛ Midia ne Pɛɛsea koranar.
Asɛ booh la che tɛ Grik tena harɛ kooro.
Nyeɡlejen waa pa o sie baah la cheɡɔ tɛ kooro waa tɔ sie.
O nyeɡle waa kua asɛ nyeɡlare anaarɛ le o buɡ ta la, dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ harɛ la bini dɛ́ ba peɡra, ásɛ koranar banaarɛ ba di a kora, kɛ ba kora la aa won do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ sitɔ kora la.
Koranar banaarɛ kora dii la aa dɛɛ ba a jaɡa la, baa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ kohonaa dɛ́ chɛ deŋnetɛra.
Ásɛ kooro o nyu bini aa kpeɡa dɛɛ neɡre nɛra ba.
Wɛɛ dɔ kpeɡrii taeh, kɛ o ɡbaɡba kpeɡri laa.
Wɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa á ɛ nyokpoa, o wobɛlbwa waa ɛ do wer tɛo, dɛ́ chɔɡ nɛnjena ne Korowii nɛra bwa.
Wɛɛ che kasinteŋ bɛ bola taa dɛ́ do wer.
Wɛɛ dɛɛ liiruu kɛŋɔ o ɡwaa nomɛlbwa, dɛ che a ta chɔɡ nɛra ɡalɡa ɡɛ saŋ baa so dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna lole.
Wɛɛ muɡli koranar bwa kooro baahnee, kɛ a bwa habɔɔ la, wɛɛ chɔɡoo dɛ nɛn kpeɡri ta laa.
Chɔɔ ne jɔmɔre sarahare wepila baa baɡle a mun tɛɛ la ɛɛ ɛ kpelaa.
Anomanta, marɛ wepila la nyoa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ aa la sie tama mɔɔ á chiɡ.” Men Daneɛl, dɛ n ɡwɛɡrɔ, n bwara wee mɛ la sie tama mɔɔ n ta won ba ir dɛ ɛ toma tɛ kooro.
N ta wepila la mun noɛ, dɛ a ɡwaa n liire ta.
Daneɛl wesoŋa Kooro Dareɔs waa ɛ Midia te, di kora Babelɔn harɛ ta.
Dɛ o mɛɛ sɔne Sɛksɛs.
A bena waa di kora la, men Daneɛl nyiŋi tɔne bini, dɛ na waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Jeremia nɛɛ bol ŋɔ, Jerusalam ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbia, dɛ́ ka tel bene fifraanuanɛ.
Asɛ n kpɔ lweyal tɔ dɛ so tɔɔ ta, a baɡle kɛ n dɛ di suna, dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii.
N soŋe Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ bol n nɛra wechɔɡa ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he kan dɛ do ɔma kohona.
He dɛ teŋɛ he fɔo ta, dɛɛ baɡle he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe nɛra baa dɛ nyini nɛ.
Ba dɛ teŋɛ waa haa dɛ do ba ta la ta.
Ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ koni, dɛ ɛ nyubinikpeɡ, dɛ le he habɔɔ.
Ya bɛɡɔ le waa haa do yaa a ta ne he Mmarare ta.
Ya ta waa he bonɔɔna baa ɛ he keamere la aa cheɡɛ he sɔn ta, dɛ bol ya koranar ne nomonome, ne ya naawa dɛ ya harɛ nɔ nɛra be la noɛ.
N Naa Korowii, he waa toɡrɔ, ya di sihiih fini.
Juda ne Jerusalam tena, ne Israel tena haa lɔ yaa peɡre harɛre aa lɔ bojaŋa ne anɔ la aa bɛna ta bwa, dɛkalkɛ ya waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛɛ.
N Naa Korowii, ya ne ya koranar ne nomonome ne ya naawa di sihiih kohona, dɛkalkɛ ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ ya ɛ deŋnekpeɡ he nɛ, he dɛ sune nɛn nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ, ya ta hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ la waa noɛ, kɛɛ he Mmarare haa cheɡɛ he bonɔɔna baa ɛ he keamere nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ yaa la ta teŋɛ.
Ya Israel tena bwa koni he Mmara la, dɛ vɛh kɛŋɔ yaa no he waa.
Asɛ he ɡel taahna waa baa ŋwɛɛ ntam dɛ chwera he bonɔɔ Mosis Mmara la ta la ba ya nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he nɛ.
He ɡelɔ waa he fa aa bola dawɛ ya nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, hɛɛ kpɔ deŋnetɛraa ba ya ne ya koranar nɛɛ la ɛ ɡɛ.
Harɛ nɔ ta bwa, he ta nɛra deŋne tɛrɛ ɡɛ haa tɛr bwɛjen Jerusalam tena deŋne nɔ bwa.
Gɛ tenten baa chwera Mosis Mmara la ta la, ɡɛ deŋnetɛra la bwaa ba ya nɛ.
Kɛ ya ta Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la bɔr nyine ó cha yaa ya le ya wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ dɛ no o kasinteŋ waa la.
Korowii kpɔ deŋnetɛra ba ta ya nɛɛ warane, dɛkalkɛ o waa toɡrɔ wobɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ ta.
Kɛ ane a bwa, ya ta o waa noɛ.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, henee cheɡɛ he kpeɡri ta lɛ he nɛra le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ lɛ sɔn tɛ he te a ta chɔ le ba le fini, kɛ ya ɡarɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kohona.
N Naa Korowii, ɡɛ aa cheɡɛ he we-ɛɛla aa toɡra ta he cha yaa wubwa la, laa he bwaawee ne bandia kohona la kpɔ he bwɛjen Jerusalam, he Saayɔn Bwejen la ta.
Ya ne ya naawa wechɔɡaa ɡela nɛra baa soɡa bar yaa la ɛɛ mamɛ Jerusalam ne he nɛra.
Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, no he bonɔɔ waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ bil he sie ne n wesoŋa nɔ name.
He sɔn nomanta, na ya sum chɔe he Dea nɔ aa chɔ pɛɛ nɔ wa.
N Naa Korowii, cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no, pili sie dɛ́ na chɔe he bwɛjen nɔ aa chɔ pɛɛ nɔ wa, dɛkalkɛ he sɔn dawɛ o ta.
Toɡra ya wa aa toɡra waa laa yaa soŋe, he nɛn sum nae kohona waa yaa soŋe.
N Naa Korowii no.
N Naa Korowii kpɔ kɛ yaa.
N Naa Korowii, cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ ɛ waane.
Bɛ ɡel a biɡri, ɡɛ aa ɛ nomɛlbwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he cheɡɛ he nɛra ne bwɛjen nɔ nɛɛ dɛ lɛ sɔn tɛ he te.” Nyundua torome Gebreɛl baɡle wepila la mun N ta teŋɔ dɛɛ soŋe, dɛɛ bol n ne n nɛra Israel tena wechɔɡa wa, dɛ kpɔ bil Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ sie ŋɔ, ó berɛ kwaa o Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la cheɡ.
N ta aa lɔ n wesoŋa ta la, nyundua torome Gebreɛl n fa aa nao wepila aa tɔ sie ta la iro kpɔ nyundua wɔrɔbe nɛɛ dɛ ba n be.
Dɛ jɔmɔr saraha saŋ telo.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, taraken n balɔ dɛ́ ba baɡle hé no wepila la mun.
Gɛ saŋ haa dena pa mun dɛɛ soŋe Korowii la, o no he wesoŋa la, asɛ n ŋɔ ń ba bol he be, dɛkalkɛ Korowii dɛ nyin he waa taeh.
Anomanta, cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ no wepila maa dɛ ba a mun baɡla tɛɛ nɔ.
Korowii do bene fifraanuanɛ bele anuanɛ cheɡ kɛŋɔ he nɛra ne bwɛjen Jerusalam ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Baa kpɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwaa kɛ, ásɛ waa aa toɡra do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ wepila ne Korowii waa aa dɛ ba bala ɛ kpela, ásɛ ba berɛ kpɔ Korowii Dea la do o nɔn ta.
Do waa nɔ dɛɛɡɔ dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ, le ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa bola ŋɔ bá berɛ kwaa ma Jerusalam la, aa ɛ bene anuanɛ bele anuanɛɛ, ásɛ ba kwaa vɔrɔwe Jerusalam ɡɛ o fa aa doa la, dɛ́ berɛ kwaa o fɔɡbaahna, dɛ́ ma danjwɛkpeɡa baro bene anuanɛ bele fifraanumɛl dɛ anɛ mɔɔ nomoa Korowii aa leo la ba.
Aa bao wahala saŋ.
A ɡɛ bene la bwa habɔɔ la, baa kpo nomoa Korowii aa leo cheɡ laanee chɔɡre ŋwɛnɛ taa, ásɛ baa o wobɛlbwa waa lii kpa.
Ásɛ kooro waa kpeɡa kpɔ o laa tena ba yo, dɛ́ chɔɡ bwɛjen la ne Korowii Dea la ɡe.
Waa bwa jaɡa saŋ la ɛɛ bao kɛŋɔ nee yon su wɔrɔbe nɛɛ dɛ chɔɡ kwaa la ken, dɛ́ kpɔ laa ba chɔɡ waa Korowii aa ŋɔa aa ɛo la.
Nomoa la ne nɛra baa wara ɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee bene anuanɛ.
Bene anuanɛ la baah ta la, wɛɛ ɡeloo ba ɡel kwaa baa kpoora dɛɛ ɛ saraha, ne koŋkɛɛla baa dɛ ba a ne Korowii Dea la ne bala.
Ásɛ o kpɔ konchɔɡechɔɡe waa dɛ paɡre bwɛɛ la ka pa Korowii Dea doa bobɛl waa do jaŋne kaa nyundua, ásɛ o do bela ka tel kɛŋɔ chɔɡa aa dɛ ba o nɛɛ bala aa bala, ɡɛ Korowii aa bola la.”
Daneɛl wepila waa naa Tiɡris Mojen nyoa Kooro Saeros aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ bentooro te ta la, Korowii pili waane bini baɡle Daneɛl, baa bera dɛ yerɔ Bɛltesasa.
Dɛ waa la ɛ kpela dɛ ɛ laajen wa.
Wepila la taa o che dɛ no waa la mun.
Gɛ saŋ la, men Daneɛl, n tea bini chɔɡɔ yawanyoa atoro.
N ta kondikonsoma dii, ol kɛɛ sen ta n nyoa joɛ.
N ta noo bɛlbwa ɡe fɔɡlɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ yawanyoa atoro la aa ba a jaɡa.
A ɡɛ bena la korobiloɡle tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ ta, dɛ men Daneɛl, n cheɡɛ Tiɡris Mojen nyoa.
N ha sie nyiŋi, dɛ na baa bɛl waa do laalapoŋa, asɛ kiriso baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛo vɔwɛ o chara.
O bwara do kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane aa dɛ nyɛɡle baa yera kresolɛt, o siebɔr do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ nyɛɡle ken, o sibie do kɛŋɔ kapɛle aa dɛ hɔ, o nɔɔra ne nakpale do kɛŋɔ ayaawa baa looru ken, asɛ o taa do kɛŋɔ nɛnlaa aa bol waa dɛɛ nyɛɡ ken.
Men Daneɛl ɡboo na wepila la, dɛ baala bane ja n nɛ, ba te ta kon la nae, kɛ ɔmee laɡ ba kohona asɛ ba chwa ka sɔh.
Anomanta, a ka n ɡbo mɛɛ nyiŋi ɡɛ nyokpowaa nɔ, dɛ n ta bokpeɡa dɔe kpa, n siebɔr beɡre kɛŋɔ lale sie maa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa.
N noɔ kɛŋɔ baa la dɛ bol wa, asɛ mɛɛ no, n sie den bir mɛ, n chole kpɔ sie pi harɛ.
Ate, nɔn bɛl laɡ mɛ ir, asɛ n pi n nɔɔra ne natuune ta, n bwara bwa ɛɛ sa.
Baa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, Korowii dɛ nyin he waa taeh.
Ir che dɛ́ no waa maa dɛ ba he be bola nɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
He bee ba tom mɛ.” Waa bol waa la n be la, n iro che dɛ n bwara ta dɛ sa.
Ate, o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, le awola haa ɛ he liire kɛ he pwɛr he te tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ no waa nɔ mun la taa o no he wa.
N balɔ dɛ́ ba chae he wesoŋa la wa.
Asɛ nyundua torome waa dɛ di Pɛɛsea harɛ kpeɡri la ba tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Ate, Maekel waa ɛ nyundua toroma nomonome la bini bɛl ba cha mɛ, lawa baa laɡ mɛ n so Pɛɛsea harɛ ta la wa.
Taraken, n balɔ dɛ́ ɡel he jemɛ waa aa dɛ ba he harɛ ta nɛra nɛɛ chiɡa kerekere, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ wepila nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ waane a ta aa dɛ ba saŋ bɛl.” O ta aa dɛ bol waa n be la, n kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ bol waa kahonɛ.
Asɛ nyundua torome waa do kɛŋɔ nɛn kpɔ nɔn ba leɡe n nyoa, mɔɔ n pa mun pili nyoa dɛ bol wa.
N ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n na weweele taeh wepila nɔ ta, asɛ a ɡel n bwara yɔr.
Nomoa, ɛrɛɛ men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɔ ne hɛɛ ba wona bol waɔ?
N bokpeɡa bwa tonɔ maa wola won hwee kɛrɛdɛ.” Ate, o berɛ kwaa leɡ mɛ, asɛ n dɔ bokpeɡa.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Korowii dɛ nyini, anomanta, dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, bɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa hae ɡe.” Waa bol waa nɔ n be la, n berɔ dɔ bokpeɡa, asɛ n ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, bol waa bwa haa dɛ nyin kɛ he bol, taraken te he ɡelɔ n dɔ bokpeɡa.” Anee o bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “He jemɛ waa aa ba n ne he be nɔ naa?
Aa biɡri ń berɛ ba kaa nyundua torome waa dɛ di kpeɡri Pɛɛsea harɛ dɛ́ ka yoo laa, a habɔɔ mɔɔ nyundua torome waa dɛ di kpeɡri Grik tena harɛ ɡe ba, kɛ anɔ la aa tɔ sie la, mɛɛ baɡle waa aa lɔ Kasinteŋ Tɔn la binii.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ che n habɔɔ n ne o yo, atane nyundua torome Maekel waa dɛ di kpeɡri Israel harɛ la ɡbo.”
Midia Kooro Dareɔs kora dii benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta la, n cheɡɛ o habɔɔ dɛ chao.
Ijipt ne Siiria harɛre kora wa Nyundua torome Maekel waa dɛ daah Israel harɛ la ŋɔ, “Namee mɛɛ ba kasinteŋ la he be bola.
Koranar batoro ɛɛ ir Pɛɛsea harɛ taa, ásɛ naarɛte ɡe ba dɛ́ ba dɔ suuɡa ɡwaa banɔ la bwa.
O baa dɔ kpeɡri dɛ le o kondɔɔh la ta naa, wɛɛ di nomɛlbwa liiree ba yo Grik tena harɛ kooro.
Ásɛ kooro bɛl ɡe waa do kpeɡri ba ir, dɛɛ di kora kpeɡri ne ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin.
Gɛ kooro la balaa, o harɛre waa dɛ di kora a ta la dɛ ba peɡra, dɛ bɔne bɔre anaarɛ.
O naanar aa koraa dɔ di.
Gɛ kooro la aa kpeɡrii dɔ kpa, dɛkalkɛ o kora la ɛɛ ɡuu, dɛ́ berɛ bane kon.
Ijipt kooro ɛɛ do kpeɡrii, kɛ o laa sitɔɔ bɛl ɛɛ do kpeɡrii ɡwaalo, dɛ́ di o kora kpeɡri kohona ne.
Aa ba la sie la, Ijipt kooro ne Siiria kooro ɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee, ásɛ Ijipt kooro kpɔ o bihaah tɛo ó mo.
Kɛ ba darame la aa biɡri, ásɛ haah la ne o jaa, ne o bie, dɛ toli baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ kaa la, bá kpoo ba bwa.
Aa biɡri bɛlbwa ásɛ Ijipt kooro bihaah la lole bɛl ba iru, dɛ́ ba so o buɡ ta.
Wɛɛ kpɔ laa tenaa ka yo Siiria kooro, dɛ́ jo o koodem dekpeɡ bini, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Wɛɛ pa ba voɡa baa loɡa, ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ suuɡapoŋa koŋkwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, dɛ́ kaa a bwa ne Ijipt harɛ.
A habɔɔ deŋnesɔɔhna aa ba tama la, Siiria kooro ɛɛ kpɔ o laa tenaa ka lɔ tɔ Ijipt kooro ne o nɛra nɛ, kɛ waa won, dɛ́ berɛ kaa o harɛ ta.
Siiria kooro la bii ɛɛ boa laa tena damanta nyoa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te, dɛ́ ka yoo ba.
Baa su harɛ la ta bobɛlbwaa kɛŋɔ nee yon su dɛ́ palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ bobɛlbwa la, dɛ́ yo ka tel dekpeɡ waa lɔ ba dɔma bwɛjen doonyoa.
Ijipt kooro ɛɛ kpɔ bandiaa kpɔ o laa tena, dɛ́ ka yo Siiria kooro, dɛ́ pɔ o ne o laa tena damanta la nɛ.
Ijipt kooro la ɛɛ maŋkura o te pɔe waa pɔ ba nɛɛ la waa, ne laa tena waa kpoo ba warɛ la, kɛ waa won teŋɛ dɛɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛɛ ɡɛ.
Siiria kooro la ɛɛ berɛ habɔɔ ka kpɔ laa tena baa ɡwaa wubwa tena la, ásɛ tɔpedɛɛɡe ta la, ó kpɔ laa tena baa dɔ dɔmkwaa warɛ ka yo Ijipt kooro.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, nɛra ɡalɡa ɛɛ ɛ Ijipt kooro deŋnekpeɡii, ásɛ hen Daneɛl, he harɛ ta nɛra bane baa ɛ naɡrenyine ɡe ɛ deŋnekpeɡ wepila baa naa la wa, kɛ baa horɔɔ.
Anomanta, Siiria kooro ɛɛ kpɔ o laa tenaa ba chɔ bar bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛjen baro la, dɛ́ pɔ o nɛra nɛ.
A ba ɡɛ naa, Ijipt laa tena aa won yo kpa, hale ba laa tena baa jemɛ yoi aa bokpeɡaa dɔ, dɛ́ won che a nyoa.
Siiria kooro waa ka lɔ tɔ ba nɛɛ la, wɛɛ ɛɛ baa ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin, nomɛlbwa aa wola won tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ.
Wɛɛ ka che Israel Harɛdɛɛɡe la taa, ásɛ dɛɛ di kpeɡri o ta.
Siiria kooro ɛɛ dɛɛ nyinuu kɛ o kpɔ o harɛ ta laa tena bwa ba.
Waa dɛ nyin o chɔɡ o dɔma harɛ nomanta, o ne Ijipt kooro la ɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee, ásɛ o kpɔ o bihaah tɛo ó mo, kɛ ane a bwa, aa on cha.
A habɔɔ la, wɛɛ berɔ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ mpo nyoa harɛre nɛra nɛ.
Wɛɛ yoo baa, dɛ́ pɔ ba ɡalɡa nɛ, kɛ laa nomoa bɛl ɛɛ le harɛfale bɛl taa, dɛ́ ba pɔ o nɛɛ dɛ́ sɔɔh o nyoa, ásɛ maŋkurae waa dɛ maŋkura o te la ɡure o nyu ta.
Anɔ ɡe habɔɔ, wɛɛ berɔ kaa o ɡbaɡba harɛ dekpeɡa taa, kɛ baa pɔ o nɛɛ, o waa bwa ba a jaɡa.
Kooro waa ba chiɡ o naa ta la ɛɛ tomɛ nɛnee ó ɛɡre nɛra lɛ toɔ, dɛ́ ɡel suuɡa ba o kara mun.
Kɛ a ba dɛ la sie naa, baa kpo kooro laanee, nɛra baah ta laa, laa ɡe ta laa.” Nyundua torome la berɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛmpɛɛ bɛl waa wola kora la ta jae ɛɛ ba chiɡ Siiria kooro naa taa, dɛ́ di kora.
Wɛɛ kpɔ laalee ba ta harɛ la ta nɛra nɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ deŋnesɔɔhna lole.
Ásɛ dɛ che neɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ di kpeɡri.
Nomɛlbwa waa tɔŋlo la, hale dɛ Sɔfonomoa Korowii aa leo yoo, wɛɛ chɔɡoo.
Kooro la ne harɛre ane nɛra ɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee, dɛ́ che a ta neɡre harɛre ane nɛra dɛɛ di kpeɡri kohona, a lole kɛŋɔ o harɛ aa kanɛ.
Wɛɛ kpɔ laalee lɔ ka tɔ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ waa wera dɛ won kondikwaa ɛɛ nɛ a piɡ ba, dɛ ɛ waa o naawa bɛlbwa aa wola ane ɛɛ bwa.
Ásɛ dɛ bɔne laala baa paa laa taa tɛ o nɛra baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la.
Wɛɛ dɛɛ vɔrɔwoo kɛŋɔ ó ka yo bwɛɛre aa dɔ dekpeɡa, kɛ aa biɡri bɛlbwa o waa la ba a jaɡa.
Siiria kooro ɛɛ lɔ bambilee, dɛ́ kpɔ laa tena baa wara bá ba yo Ijipt kooro, ásɛ o ɡe kpɔ laa tena baa wara dɛ do kpeɡri, dɛ́ ba yoo laa.
Kɛ baa neɡre Ijipt kooroo, dɛ́ le o habɔɔ o yo kahonɛ.
O ɡbabir nɛra baa dɛ jao laanee dɛɛ ba o chɔɡa.
Baa kpoo o laa tena ɡalɡaa, ásɛ ba bwa tonɛ.
Gɛ koranar banɛ baa dɔ liichɔɡa tɛ dɔŋa nɔ ɛɛ pɛo so tiɡ ta dɛɛ neɡre dɔŋa, kɛ aa tɔnɔ bɛlbwaa dɔ tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛ saŋ baa lea cheɡ la ta dɛ ba.
Siiria kooro ɛɛ kpɔ laala waa paa laa ta la bwaa kaa o harɛ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ sibeɡra dɛɛ nyin o chɔɡ Korowii ne o nɛra fɔo waa do ɡoroŋ la.
Wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyinii, ásɛ dɛ berɛ kaa o ɡbaɡba harɛ ta.
A habɔɔ la, wɛɛ ba yo Ijipt harɛ tenaa, kɛ ate ɛɛ korɛ wubwa yoi la taa waa won pɔ ba nɛ.
Rom tena ɛɛ kpɔ stiimaeree le mpo nyoa wee cholibɔr harɛre taa, dɛ́ ba yoo, ásɛ o bambile chɔɡ.
Wɛɛ berɔ kpɔ bandia dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ chɔɡ Korowii fɔo waa do ɡoroŋ la.
Wɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ nɛra baa wola fɔo la ta teŋɛ la nɛɛ.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo o laa tena kpɔ doŋa kah Korowii Dea dekpeɡ la, dɛ́ ɡel ba ɡel sarahare baa dɛ ɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ konchɔɡechɔɡe waa dɛ paɡre bwɛɛ la pa. Siiria kooro la ɛɛ neɡre nɛra baa koni fɔo baa fɔwa laanee, kɛ banɔ la baa jemɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ cheo kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ yoo.
Nomonome baa jemɛ waa la ɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra ɡalɡa jemɛ wa, kɛ aa biɡri ba kpoo bane keri ne, kɛɛ dɛ́ fuh bane, dɛ́ lawɛ bane laa ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ pa ba laala laa ta kaa.
Baa dɛɛ kpoo wejerema la ɡɛ la, Korowii nɛra ɛɛ dɔ nɛraa ba cha ba tama, ásɛ nɛra ba wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe la ɡe ba ja ba nɛɛ kwaane baa dɔ le a ta la wa.
Baa kpoo ba bini wejerema la banee, ásɛ a che a ta Korowii laa doŋa kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛɛ ba, ka tel waa bwa jaɡa saŋ waa lea cheɡ ŋɔ wɛɛ bao la.
Kooro waa dɛ ɡɔɔ o te wa Siiria kooro la ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyinii, dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo, dɛɛ ɡɔɔ o te ŋɔ o ɡwaa voɡ bɛlbwa, hale Nemenɛ Korowii waa kana la.
Wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwaa ka tel saŋ Korowii aa tɛr o deŋne.
Korowii ɛɛ ɛ waa waa bola ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo laanee.
Kooro la aa duuree kpɔ tɛ voɡa o naawa aa toma la, ne onɔ la haahna aa dɛ nyinu la.
Kasinteŋ, waa voɡ bɛlbwaa duu, dɛkalkɛ wɛɛ maŋkura o tenee ŋɔ o ɡwaa komɛlbwa.
Wɛɛ kpɔ duuree tɛ voɡ waa dɛ nyiŋi dekpeɡa ta, ne voɡ o naawa aa wola on jemɛ la.
Wɛɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm, ne suuɡapoŋa, ne bwedɛɛɡa dɛ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwaa tɛo.
Wɛɛ kpɔ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡhɔɔh baa nyiŋi o dekpeɡa ta.
Wɛɛ kpɔ duuree tɛ banɔ la baa sɛah kɛ o ɛ kooro la, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba sobɔrjena báa nyiŋi nɛndamanta nɛ, dɛ́ bɔne harɛ tɛɛ ba ó ɛ ba kembɔr.
Aa ba ka tama Siiria kooro waa ba a jaɡa la, Ijipt kooro ɛɛ ba yoo laalee, ásɛ Siiria kooro la kpɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore, ne laa tena baa soɡe jaɡre ta, ne stiimaere aa wara, o kpeɡri bwa ne dɛ́ ka puu yo.
Wɛɛ lɔɔ ka tɔ harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nee yon su dɛɛ kpɔ bobɛlbwa la ken, dɛ́ ba lɛ harɛre dɔɔh.
Wɛɛ ba Israel Harɛdɛɛɡe la taa, harɛre ta nɛra ɛɛ serewoo, kɛ Edom ne Moab harɛre ta nɛra dɛ Amɔn harɛ ta nomonome te ɛɛ le a nyoaa.
Wɛɛ che o kpeɡri taa dɛ́ lɛ harɛre la, hale baa Ijipt harɛ ɡba ɡela ba.
Wɛɛ pa Ijipt suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa koŋkwaare dɛ kondɔɔh bɛlbwaa, dɛ́ le bela ka yo Lebya ne Itiopia harɛre tena, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Kɛ wɛɛ ba no waa aa chiɡ wee leebɔr ne weekaŋle nyunduabɔr nɔɔ, ásɛ o jum jah, á ɡel o ir kpɔ sibeɡra kohona ka yo dɛ́ kpoo nɛra warɛ.
A habɔɔ la, wɛɛ baŋre tɛnte dedɛɛɡa aa kana á ɛ o koodem, Mɛdetereenea Mpo ne bwejen bela Korowii Dea aa cheɡa la baah ta.
Kɛ wɛɛ ba sewɔɔ, dɛ nomɛlbwa toole bela dɛ́ chao.”
Waa bwa jaɡa saŋ Nyundua torome waa do laalapoŋa la ŋɔ, “A ɡɛ saŋ la, nyundua toroma nomoa Maekel waa dɛ daah he nɛra la ɛɛ leo ba.
Gɛ saŋ ɛɛ ɛ wahala saŋee, le harɛ nɔ mumpar ba le fini a dɔŋa ta balɛ bwa.
Gɛ saŋ la, he harɛ ta nɛra baa chwerɛ ba sɔna do Korowii tɔn bini la, ɛɛ dɔ lɛɛlee.
Nɛra ɡalɡa baa serewa ɛɛ berɔ ir, ásɛ bane kaa mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa ta, bane ɡe kaa weweele aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa ne sihiih ta.
Nomonome baa ɛ wejerema la ɛɛ chaahnoo kɛŋɔ nyundua, ásɛ banɔ la baa baɡle nɛra bane waa a che a ta ba waa toɡre la, baa doo kɛŋɔ weweela dɛɛ chaah saŋ bɛlbwa.” Ate, nyundua torome la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, laa tɔn la tɔ dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa marɛ o nyoa ka tel waa bwa jaɡa saŋ.
Nɛra ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ la dɛɛ ba, dɛɛ nyin Korowii waa la dɛ́ jemɛ, ásɛ wejema warɛ taeh.” Asɛ men Daneɛl nyiŋi dɛ na baala banɛ ba che nee bɛl nyoa, bɛl lɔ o baŋ le, bɛl ɡe do o baŋ bonɔ.
Ate, bɛl pɛɛ nyundua torome waa do laalapoŋa la, dɛ o cheɡɛ nee la nyunduabɔr dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ́ ka tel saŋ besoo ɡɛ nyokpowaa nɔ ɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?” Nyundua torome la ir nɔɔra anɛ bwa nyundua, asɛ n no ɡɛ waa ŋwɛɛ Korowii Waa Lole Saŋ Bɛlbwa sɔn ta ŋɔ, “Aa ɛ bene atoro ne faah.
Gɛ saŋ nɛra baa teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ bonyɛɡa aa ba a jaɡa la, dɛ waa nɔ bwa ɡe chiɡo.” N no waa waa bola, kɛ n ta a mun noɛ.
Anomanta, n bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ba chiɡa ka tonɛ ɔ?” O ŋɔ, “Daneɛl, kaa taraken, dɛkalkɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ waa aa chɛ kɛ ba laa tɔ, dɛ marɛ o nyoa ka tel waa bwa jaɡa saŋ.
Baa laa doŋaa kpɔ nɛra ɡalɡa nɛɛ bá waa toɡre wechɔɡa aa ba nɛɛ do, kɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ nyubinikpeɡ.
Nyubinikpeɡ te bɛlbwa aa a munii no, kɛ wejerema te ɛɛ no a munii.
Le ɡɛ saŋ baa ɡel tɔpere bɛlbwa sarahare ɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ konchɔɡechɔɡe waa dɛ paɡre bwɛɛ la pa la ɛɛ ɛ tɔpera kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanuanaarɛɛ.
Nɛra baa so kasinteŋ ne, dɛ́ kpa ka tel tɔpera kaɡboŋ lafraatoro fifraatoro dɛ anue aa ba kaa la, ba na som.
Kɛ hen Daneɛl, he te kaa, di kasinteŋ ka tel waa bwa jaɡa saŋ.
Hɛɛ sewɔɔ kɛ hɛɛ iruu, dɛ́ dɔ he kembɔr waa bwa jaɡa saŋ.”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Hosia kaa bol Korowii waa la Israel harɛ weekaŋle nyundua tena be bwɛjen Samaria.
O di ba kasinteŋ ŋɔ wenaale ɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ baa Korowii waa ta teŋɛ, dɛ berɛ nya kasinteŋ ɡe.
Dɛ Hosia haah Goma le o jaa habɔɔ, asɛ Korowii che a ta dɛ baɡle Israel tena ŋɔ ɡɛɛ ba ɡe le on Korowii habɔɔ.
Hosia kah ba ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ tɛr ba deŋne a waa, kɛ a habɔɔ la, wɛɛ berɔ laɡ ba ba o be, dɛkalkɛ o ta dɔ nyina tɛɛ ba kohona.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
Korowii pili o waa bini baɡle Beeri bibaa Hosia.
A ɡɛ saŋee koranar bane kɛŋɔ Ussia, ne Jotam, ne Ahas dɛ Hɛsɛkea di kora Juda harɛ ta teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Dɛ Jehoas bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam di kora Israel harɛ ta.
Hosia haah ne o bii Korowii aa pa mun che Hosia nɛɛ dɛɛ bol waa Israel tena be la, o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ka mo haah, kɛ wɛɛ le he habɔɔ dɛ́ lolɛ sɛmbii, ásɛ ba ir dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ ba nya.
Gɛɛ n nɛra Israel tena waa aa wola kasinteŋii dɔ tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ le n habɔɔ.” Anomanta, Hosia kaa mo Diblaem bihaah Goma, o ne o lolɛ bibaa.
Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Hosia be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ bwɛjen Jesreel sɔn pa he bie la.
Aa biɡri ń ba tɛr Israel kooro deŋne, kpoe o naa Kooro Jehu aa kpoo nɛra Jesreel la wa, dɛ́ teŋe Jehu luɡe tena kora ta, Israel harɛ.
Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ sɔɔh Israel laa tena nyoa Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen binii.” A habɔɔ, Goma berɔ lolɛ bihaah, asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Hosia be ŋɔ, “Pa o sɔn Lo Ruhama, dɛkalkɛ maa nyin kɛ ń baɡle nyina Israel tena nɛ, maa ba wechɔɡa ɡee kpɔ kɛ ba kpa.
Kɛ Juda harɛ ta tena te, mɛɛ nyin baa, mɛɛ lɛɛ baa.
Dɔmkwaa aa do kɛ to ne hɛma, ne tokobie dɛ jaɡre nɛra aa kpɔa dɛɛ la laa ne laa mɛɛ ba kpɔe lɛɛ ba.
Men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la kpeɡri nee mɛɛ ba ba lɛɛ.” Goma aa teŋe Lo Ruhama el tonɛ la, o berɔ lolɛ bibaa bɛl, asɛ Korowii ŋɔ Hosia be ŋɔ, “Pa bie la sɔn Lo Ami, dɛkalkɛ Israel tena ta n nɛra ɛɛ, baa men Korowii tomɛ.” Israel tena ɛɛ warɔɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken, baa wola won kur ba.
Korowii ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘He ta n nɛra ɛɛ’, kɛ tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba ó yer ba ‘Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa bii’.
Juda ne Israel tena ɛɛ berɔ pɛ, ásɛ dɛ le nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ó ɛ ba sitɔɔ.
Ba harɛ la ɛɛ do werii ba dɔ ba te, awola ɛɛ ɛ tɔpejenii tɛ Jesreel tena.
Korowii ŋɔ Hosia yerɛ o bala Israel tena la ‘Korowii nɛra’ ne ‘Korowii nɛnnyina.’ Korowii tɛr Israel tena deŋne dɛ berɛ lɛɛ ba Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “N bii, hé soŋe he bala baa do kɛŋɔ haah o jwamane nomanta, n haah naa wola on ɛɛ, o ɡe jaa laa men la, ó ɡel o bannyin la, dɛ́ ɡel jwamanwaa la.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa, mɛɛ wuruu o che muŋɡbal kɛŋɔ awola baa lolɔ la ken.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo ó do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ harɛ waa hola, ásɛ nyɔɡre kpoo ó sewɛ.
Maa o bii waa nyin, dɛkalkɛ sɛmbiirii ban.
Ba nya le n habɔɔ, dɛ ka di sɛm lolɛ sihihbii.
O ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ teŋɛ banfala nɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ n te tɛɛ ba, ásɛ ba tɛ mɛ kondikwaa ne ne, ne pee pona yale ne yapondɛɛɡa, ne ɔleve noo dɛ sen.’ Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ sɔɔhnee tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ.
Mɛɛ tɔɔ do waa wola won dɔ bɔr le.
Wɛɛ ti baala laanee, kɛ waa ban pu, wɛɛ nyin ba bɔree, kɛ waa ban na.
Ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ berɔɔ kaa n jaloɡle be, belaa wera tɛ mɛ ɡwaa taraken.’ O ɡbabir ta liire kɛŋɔ menee tɛo kwaa kɛŋɔ mea, senfala ne ɔleve no, ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ suuɡaswɛm kohona, o kpɔ kaa tomɛ voɡ Baal la.
Anomanta, mea koma telaa, mɛɛ ba lɛa, dɛ́ ba lɛ n sen senfala saŋ.
Dɛ ba lɛ n pee pona yale, ne yapondɛɛɡa maa kpɔa tɛo o tɔ o mumɡbal ta la.
Mɛɛ wuruu ó che mumɡbal o sɛnanar la sie, nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛo le n nɔn ta.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o tɔpejena dii ba a jaɡa.
Benanyoa ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, ne Ona Tɔpera dii dɛ tɔpejena waa lea cheɡ bwa.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ o ɡrepo ne fiɡ daa waa ŋɔa o sɛnanar la kpɔɔ bɔɔ kem la.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo o daa kooni baah moɡɛ kohona, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini ola ba di a nɔna.
Mɛɛ tɛr o deŋnee, tɔpera waa fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma tɛ voɡa Baalre la, ne suuɡaswɛm nɔnloɡa, ne baŋa kwa dɛ noniseɡa waa doa dɛ teŋɛ o sɛnanar nɛɛ dɛ soh n waa la wa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Anomanta, mɛɛ lawɔɔ, dɛ́ kpɔɔ kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka kpɔ sɛmwobol ɡbɛɡbɛo.
Mɛɛ berɛ o daa kooni laanee tɛo, ásɛ dɛ berɛ Akɔ Fɛlembɔjen la bela hwɛɡa aa lole.
Belaa wɛɛ ba yela ɡoe silɛɛ ne kɛŋɔ o toli saŋ, ne ɡɛ awola tɔpere waa le Ijipt harɛ ta la ken.
Awola tɔpere la, wɛɛ yer mɛ ‘n jaa’, waa men ‘n dɔɔ’ yerɛ kpa.
Maa ɡel ó yerɛ voɡa Baalre sɔna, waa a waa bol kpa.
Awola tɔpere la, n ne kpɔɡ bini ola ne jumbii, ne kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta dɛ anɔ la aa dɛ huuh ɛɛ fɔwɛ fɔwee, ásɛ a bɛ n nɛra wobɛlbwa ɛ. Mɛɛ le laa ne dɔmkwaa kɛŋɔ, to ne hɛma dɛ tokobie bwa nee harɛ la taa, ásɛ bɛlbwa dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna harɛ la ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔ hen Israelee ɛ kɛŋɔ n haah saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, mɛɛ di kasinteŋii, maa he habɔɔ le.
N nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe he nɛɛ aa tona ba bwa, mɛɛ dɔ tedomaa tɛɛ, ásɛ he ɛ n haah saŋ bɛlbwa.
Mɛɛ teŋɛ n nyobaɡa taa, dɛ́ kpɔe ɛ n haah, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛ menee Korowii.
Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ no n nɛra Israel tena wesoŋaa, ásɛ dɛ ɡel bwaala nɛ harɛ la ta, ásɛ mea ne ɡrepo ne ɔleve do wer Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen bini.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n nɛra Israel tenaa, ásɛ ba ba so harɛ la ta, nɛra n fa aa ŋɔa ‘Maa ban nyin la,’ ń berɛ nyin ba wa.
Nɛra maa ŋɔa ‘Ba ta n nɛra ɛɛ la’, ń berɛ ŋɔ ‘Hé ɛ n nɛra’, ásɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ la.’ ”
Hosia ne o haah berɛ pɛɛ wa Korowii ŋɔ men Hosia be ŋɔ, “Berɛ la he haah be, á baɡle kɛ he dɛ nyinu.
A lole kɛŋɔ baa bɛl dɛ nyinu te, kɛ bɛ an dawɛ.
Nyinu ɡɛ men Korowii aa dɛ nyin Israel tena baa berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛ kpɔ daa nɔna aa hola kaa tɛ voɡa n ɡarɛ dɛɛ nyin ba la.” Anomanta, suuɡapoŋa fi dɛ anue, dɛ mea a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore lafa fifraanuee n kpɔ ka lɛo.
Asɛ n ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gel n ne he so la sie, bɛ jwamane bɔ kpa, bɛ baa bɛlbwa nyin kpa.” Gɛɛ Israel tena ɛɛ ba soɡa biɡri baa wola kooro kɛɛ nomoa bɛlbwaa dɔ.
Baa saraharee ɛ, dɛ paaɡe bwea dɛɛ duura, ba sɔfore aa batakaareborii do, baa voɡaa cheɡ dɛɛ toma kpa.
Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba bala, ásɛ Israel tena berɛ ba Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ, ne kooro waa ɛ Kooro Devid naa be.
Bochela nee baa ba Korowii be bala, ásɛ o swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ ba.
Korowii ne Israel tena dɔe wa Korowii ŋɔ o ne Israel tena dɔɔ, dɛ ŋɔ bá no waa waa dɛ bol.
O ŋɔ, “He waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, he ta nyina ɡe dɔe, haa men jemɛ harɛ nɔ ta.
Taahna wobol ɡboo lɔ he nyoo, he dɛ teŋe nyosone, dɛɛ kpoo dɔŋa, dɛɛ ŋwɛ, dɛɛ chɔɡ yal, dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa wola were bwa dɛɛ ja.
Nɛŋkpoa ɡboo harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
A ɡɛ nomanta, harɛ la holɔ dɛ chɔɡ, ásɛ kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa serewe.
Kpɔɡ bini ola ne jumbii dɛ mpo bini pɛŋa bwa dɛ serewe.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ bɛ dɔ, bɛlbwa bɛ o dɔŋ pwah.
He do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ pwah sɔfore.
Chɔɔ ne jwaana bwaa hɛɛ lɔ na, he ne Korowii keamere bwa.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ ba Israel waa ɛ he nya la chɔɡa.
N nɛra aa wola men Korowii jemɛ nomanta, ba dɛ serewe.
He sɔfore, haa wola n waa ta teŋɛ nomanta, n ɡe vɛh heya.
Haa vɛh men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ webaɡla ta teŋa nomanta, n ɡe ɛɛ vɛh he biirii.
He sɔfore, haa dɛ warɛ la, dɛ he dɛ ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa kohona.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo he jirima berɛ sihiih.
N nɛra wechɔɡa taa he sɔfore che dɛɛ dɔ he te, anomanta, he dɛ nyin ba na dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa kohona.
Gɛ maa dɛ ba nɛra la ɛɛ laanee mɛɛ ba he sɔfore ɡe ɛɛ.
Men Korowii ɛɛ tɛr he bwa deŋnee, dɛ bɔ heyaa kem a wa.
Hɛɛ di kondikwaa, kɛ haa vaɡɛ, dɛ́ bɔ jwamane, kɛ he mun aa ya bwa, dɛkalkɛ he vɛh men Korowii dɛ kpɔ he te tɛ voɡa ane.
Sembena ne anfala nyɔe chɔɡ n nɛra liire baa waa mun no.
Daa baa teŋa ɛ voɡa taa baa la dɛ kaa bɔɔ ba nyuune wa, ásɛ daa la ɛɛ bol waa ba be.
Ba laa ba te kpɔ men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ nɛ, kɛŋɔ hanjwamane dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa ane.
Bwejena doree baa ɛ sarahare, dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa deŋɡarere ta, ne dajena bwa soo siwi a chunchule aa soma lɔɡre.
A cheɡɛ a ta he bihaahna kpɔ ba te do jwamane ta, asɛ he bibaala haahna ɡe ɛɛ chɔɡ yal.
Maa he bihaahna baa dɛ bɔ jwamane la deŋnee tɛr, ɡɛɛ maa wola he bibaala haahna ɡe deŋnee tɛr ba yal chɔɡa wa.
He baala nɔ ɡbabir deŋnee mɛɛ ba tɛra, dɛkalkɛ he ne haahna la dɛ bɔ jwamane dɛ kaa ɛ saraha voɡa ta, nɛra baa wola waa mun no la ɛɛ heo!
A lole kɛŋɔ he Israel tena le n habɔɔ, he bɛ ɡel Juda tena ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ di a bolchɔɡe.
He bɛ Gelɡal la, he bɛ Bɛt Avɛn ɡe la.
He bɛ men dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ men Korowii ta aa lole!
Israel tena deŋne kpeɡri, kɛŋɔ naneenanar a deŋne aa kpeɡa ken.
Ɛrɛɛ men Korowii ɛɛ ba wona kpɔa la dibɔr kɛŋɔ baa teɡɛ pebiiri dɛɛ la dibɔr ɔ?
Israel tena kpɔ ba te jo voɡa toma ta, hé ɡel ba.
Ba nyɔ sen tonaa, ba ka dɛ bɔ ba jwamane la ja.
Ba sie dɛ lɛ sihihwaa ta ɡwaa anɔ la aa tɛɛ ba jirima.
Kawulewule ɛɛ tao kpɔ ba kaa, ásɛ sihiih kpo ba sarahare baa dɛ ɛ voɡa ta la wa.”
Korowii bol Israel tena chɔɡa wa Korowii ŋɔ, “Sɔfore, hé no!
Israel tena, hé cheɡ deŋne!
Koobii ɡe, hé no!
N dɛ ba he waa bola dɛ́ pa bole.
He do kɛŋɔ baa harɛ bel Mispa, dɛ do kɛŋɔ asau baa taa bɔle Tabɔ Bwejen ta.
Deŋnekpeɡ ne nɛŋkpoa tena kohona, mɛɛ tɛr he bwa deŋnee.
Israel, n jemɛ he waa bwa a chɔ n sie.
He nɛra waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, baa men Korowii tomɛ kpa.
Ba we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ baa won berɛ ba men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ be.
Jwaman we-ɛɛla ɡboo su ba liire ta.
Baa men Korowii jemɛ.
Israel tena mbarafo ɛ danseɛ kɛ ba di bolchɔɡe.
Ba wechɔɡa ɡelɔ ba lɔ naa dɛ chole, Juda tena ɡe ja ba nɛɛ lɔ naa dɛ chole.
Ba kpɔ ba peera ne nae ɛ saraha dɛɛ nyin men Korowii bɔr aa, baa men na.
N laa n te kpɔ ba nɛ.
Ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ mɛ, ba le n habɔɔ, sɛmbii ɡboo baa loɡle.
Ba Korobifala Tɔpejena dii, ɛɛ chɔɡ ba ne ba kooni bwaa.
Hé hoh laa bɛla Gebea, dɛ́ hooh Rama ɡe.
Hé do laa lɔŋɔ Bɛt Avɛn.
Bɛnjamen dea tena, hé ir dɛ́ tɔ sie.
Israel harɛ ɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ, awola maa ba tɛr o nɛra deŋne la.
Israel deene bwa bee mɛɛ bol waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ aa dɛ ba bala.
Juda sitɔɔla do kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛra baa dɛ huɡri harɛre jwɛh bwea.
N baah ɛɛ di ba nɛɛ kohonaa, kɛŋɔ nee aa sua dɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa la ken.
Ba dɛ fiiɡi Israel tena, ba pa ba bolchɔɡe dɛ tiɡ ba do harɛ, hwɛɡa baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ voɡsale ta la wa.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ Israel tenaa kɛ koŋɡaahla aa dɛ chɔɡ kwaa la, dɛ́ ɛ Juda tena ɡe kɛŋɔ kon waa pɔah.
Israel tena na ba weela, asɛ Juda tena ɡe na ba ŋwɛra, asɛ Israel la Asiiria koojen be ŋɔ ó ba cha ba.
Kɛ o ta wone chah ba weela, o ta wone chah ba ŋwɛra ɡe.
Mɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ nyujente ken Israel harɛ ne Juda tena bini.
Mɛɛ toɡri ba olaa, dɛ́ che ba kaa nomɛlbwa aa wola won lɛɛ ba.
Ásɛ n berɛ kaa n buɡ ta bela maa lole ka tel kɛŋɔ baa sɛh ba chɔɡre.
Baa dɛɛ nyin n sie dɛ na, ásɛ a noo ba aa, bá ɡaaɡe n bɔr sibeɡra ne.”
Israel tena liire bɛ chara wa Israel tena berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya berɛ kaa Korowii be.
Onee toɡri ya ola, wɛɛ berɔ chah yaa.
O do yaa bola, kɛ wɛɛ vɔrɔwe ya ŋwɛraa.
Tɔpera anɛ habɔɔ la wɛɛ lawɛ yaa ir, tɔpetooro wee la, wɛɛ berɔ ba ya ne ya buɡ ta, ásɛ ya do o sie.
Hé ɡel ya takapɔ dɛ́ jemɛ Korowii, ya do sie dɛɛ yaradao.
Wɛɛ ba ya bee kɛŋɔ chɔɔlen wee ken.
Wɛɛ bao kɛ bwaala, kɛŋɔ yoo saŋ bwaala aa wola vɛh la.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Ń ɛ heyaa ɛrɔɔ, Israel ne Juda tena?
He nyina haa dɛ nyin mɛ la do kɛŋɔ chɔɔbɔr kɔɔla, ne chɔɔlen mɛn aa wola biɡri la ken.
A waa n tomɛ n keamere he be, waa bola dɛ́ pa bole ne he kpoora wa.
N waa bola dɛ́ pa bole do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa nyɛɡla ken he nɛ.
He dɛ na dɔŋa sum aa, anee mɛɛ nyin dɛ ɡwaa kɛ haa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
Men Korowii jema hiah mɛ ɡwaa sarahare ɛɛ dɛ́ fuah.
Ba chɔɡ n ne ba fɔo la kɛŋɔ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ Adam ken.
Ba le n habɔɔ harɛ la ta.
Nɛnchɔɡa ne nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra ɡboo su bwɛjen Gelead bwa.
Sɔfore la do kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛra dɛ sɔh kpɔɡ bini.
Ba dɛ kpoo nɛra Sɛkem ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa ɛ sihihwaa bwa soo siwi.
N na wedoŋa ane Israel tena bini, ba dɛ tomɛ voɡa, ba kah doŋa.
He Juda tena ɡe, n do tɔpere dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne waa haa dɛ ɛ la wa.”
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛlbwa men Korowii aa ŋɔ ń chah n nɛra Israel tena dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔ kwaa ja la, ba nyubinikpeɡ ne ba wechɔɡa ɡboo mɛɛ na.
Ba dɛ faah dɔŋa, dɛ jo deene dɛɛ ŋwɛ, dɛɛ ŋwɛ nɛra kwaa fɔɡbaahna.
Baa lii kɛŋɔ n jemɛ ba wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ la bwa.
Ba wechɔɡa ɡwaa ba nɛ, a bwa chɔ n sie.
Ba nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla dɛ lɛ kooro sie, ba nomonome ɡe sie ɛɛ lɛ nyosone baa dɛ teŋe ta.
Ba bwa dɛ bɔ jwamane, ba we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ fononoo bini nii nɛn waa dɛ wɔɔ paanoo aa kwaara do kohona, dɛ charame paanoo ka tel kɛŋɔ aa uɡa, dɛ kpɔ ka do fononoo bini la.
Kooro tɔpejen bɛl dii ta la, nomonome la nyɔ sen dɛɛ, asɛ kooro ne sennyɔɔra la dɛɛ, dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛnewa.
Ba we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ fononoo bini nii ken, sɔeh ba sɔh dɛɛ vɔrɔwe kooro vɔrɔwa.
Ba bandia lɔ ba bini jwaana bwa, tɔɔ perɔ aa, dɛ a ɡwaalɔ, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ ninlao ken.
Ba bandia la do kɛŋɔ fononoo bini nii ken, ba kpɔ kpoo ba koranar.
Ba koranar bwa serewɔ, kɛ nomɛlbwa aa men soŋe ŋɔ ń chao.
Israel tena kpɔ ba te dɛɛ koo harɛre aa bar ba nɛra bini.
Ba do kɛŋɔ paanoo o baŋ pera ɡbo aa bea.
Nɛŋhɔɔhraa dɛɛ di kpeɡri ba nɛ, kɛ baa jemɛ.
Ba nyumpona pa mun dɛɛ to, kɛ baa jemɛ.
Israel tena mbarafo dɛ di danseɛ ba wechɔɡa wa, kɛ anɔ bwa habɔɔ, baa berɛ dɛɛ ba men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la be, kɛɛ dɛ́ nyin n bɔr.
Israel tena ta liire dɔe, ba do kɛŋɔ kweah waa ira, dɛ la dɛɛ ba waa wola sobɔr dɔe.
Ba tɔ sie yerɛ Ijipt tena ŋɔ bá cha ba, dɛ berɛ chwa la Asiiria tena be.
Mɛɛ ta asawii dɛ́ laɡ ba, kɛŋɔ baa dɛ lawɛ jumbii ken, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa.
Bá bwɛɛlɛ!
Ba vɛɛh mɛ dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ.
Waa dawɛ ba nɛ, ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ n nɛ.
N pɛla lole kɛŋɔ n fee lɛɛ ba, kɛ ba teŋe nyosone dawɛ n nɛ.
Baa men soŋe kasinteŋ ne, ba chɔ harɛ dɛɛ wi kɛŋɔ voɡtoroma.
Ba boa nyoa dɛɛ soŋ mɛ mea ne senfala, kɛ dɛ laa ba te kpɔ n nɛɛ kɛ voɡtoroma.
Deŋnekpeɡ tena bane le!
Menee dɛɛ ba, dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri, kɛ ba dɛ vɔrɔwe n wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa.
Ba teŋɔ berɛ habɔɔ dɛɛ kpo men Nemenɛ Korowii, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡ waa wola kpeɡri dɔe, ba do kɛŋɔ to waa sɔɔhna ken.
Laa taa baa ba ba nomonome kpoora, ba mbarafo wobol wa, ásɛ Ijipt tena mam ba.”
Israel tena du peu dɛ ɡel mea Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Hé hoh laa bɛla.
He dɔma dɛ ba he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ kee aa le nyundua dɛɛ tu la, chɔɡa haa chɔɡ n ne he fɔo, ne deŋnekpeɡ haa ɛa men Mmarare ta la wa.
Kɛ ane a bwa, Israel tena wio dɛɛ yer mɛ ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, ya jemɛ.’ Israel tena vɛh waa aa wera, anomanta, ba dɔma ɛɛ ti ba a waa.
Ba cheɡ koranar maa wola a waa jemɛ, dɛ le nomonome le n habɔɔ.
Ba kpɔ ba ɡbaɡba suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm ɛ voɡa dɛ kpɔ chɔɡ ba te.
Suuɡaswɛm Samaria tena aa kpɔa ɛ nabale la ɡelɔ n baah di ba nɛ, bá kpɔ viɡri.
Saŋ besoo baa ba voɡa toma ɡela ɔ?
Israel harɛ taa voɡ la le, Israel tee loɡɔ, men Korowii laa.
Samaria nabale la, baa kuuɡu buruburu ken.
Ba du peu dɛ ɡel mea, anomanta, kawulewulee baa ba koma.
Mea aa wola bie dɔe ta kondikwaa dɔe.
Dɛ a dɔ bie kwaraa naa, nɛŋhɔɔhraa dɛɛ ba a dii.
Israel tena waa tonɔ, ba do kɛŋɔ konsala harɛre nɛra bini.
Ba joɔ kaa Asiiria harɛ ta, kɛŋɔ keeɡo kpaŋi waa pere o te dɛɛ ɡaaɡe ken, dɛ yoɡ ba te tɛ Asiiria ne harɛre tena bane bá cha ba.
Ba yoɡ ba te tɛ ɡɛ te, kɛ taraken mɛɛ berɔ boa ba nyoa.
Baa na hɔhɔrɔwa kohonaa Asiiria koojen nɔn ta.
Israel tena aa ɛ kwaa baa ɛ saraha a ta aa warɛ la, dɛ ɡɛɛ ba wechɔɡa ɡe ɛɛ warɛ.
N chwerɛ waa taeh, dɛ le me Mmara la bini tɛɛ ba, kɛ ba liira harɛ bɛl ta wa.
Ba kpɔ kwaa ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ dɛɛ chwe a ola, men Korowii, n sie aa a ta lɛ.
Mɛɛ lii ba wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ laanee, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne a wa.
Baa berɔ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta.
Israel tena ma kooderemi, dɛ soh men Korowii maa ta ba wa.
Juda tena ma dekpeɡa bwɛjena ta taeh.
Kɛ mɛɛ kpɔ niinii ba ta ba bwɛjena ta, ásɛ a fuh ba dekpeɡa bwa.”
Israel tena deŋnetɛra wa Hosia ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ harɛre ane nɛra.
Dɛkalkɛ he le Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la habɔɔ.
Mea pɛla bɛlbwa haa cheme o ta la, he sie dɛ lɛ jwamansuuɡa ta.
Mea ne sen aa heyaa tela ba, ásɛ senfala ɡe aa lee do.
Korowii aa ɡel Israel tena so o harɛ la ta, baa berɔɔ ka so Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka di kwaa baa kia Asiiria harɛ ta.
Baa won kpɔ sen ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii kpa, kwaa baa kpoo dɛ́ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo la aa o sie lɛɛ ba.
Ba kondikwaa baa dɛ ba a dii la bwa ɛɛ ɡeloo bá kah doŋa kɛŋɔ lwe mun kondikwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa dia la kah doŋa.
Ba ɡboo dɛ́ dia, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá ba a ne Korowii Dea.
Tɔpejena dii Korowii aa lea cheɡ la telo aa, ɛrɛɛ baa ba ɛɛ yɔ?
Dɛ wekpeɡa chiɡo asɛ ba lɔ peɡre aa, Ijipt tena ɛɛ boa ba nyoaa, ásɛ dɛ ba sewɔ aa, bá huɡ ba bwɛjen Mɛmfes.
Jabalnadaŋɛre ɛɛ kpeɡuu tɔ ba kondɔɔh aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa la bwa ta, ásɛ sɔɔhne ne kpɔɡa moɡɛ tɔ bela ba deene fa aa cheɡa la.
Tɔpera Korowii aa tɛr ba deŋne la dɛ tel, tɔpere waa bɔ ba kem la telo.
Gel Israel tena jemɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Ba wechɔɡa warɔ, ba ɡaeh we-ɛɛla ɡe do kan nomanta, ba ŋɔ Korowii keame la ɡɛnɔ, nɛn Korowii Doma aa lɔ o nɛɛ la ɛ choɡla te.
Korowii kpɔ men Hosia keame dɛ tom mɛ ŋɔ ń bol waa baɡle o nɛra Israel tena.
Kɛ bobɛlbwa maa la la, ba dɛ har mɛ bela kɛŋɔ jumbie ken.
Korowii Dea kwara, banee n dɔma.
Ba nɛra sen yawa lɛ ba liire to, kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ ba fa aa lɔ bwɛjen Gebea la.
Korowii ɛɛ lii ba nyubinikpeɡ laanee, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne a wa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ saŋ maa na he Israel tena la, n sie lɛo kɛŋɔ maa na ɡrepo nɔna pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken.
Maa na he naawa la, a do kɛŋɔ maa na fiɡ nɔnloɡle waa swɛɛra ken.
Kɛ baa bera ka tomɛ voɡ Baal Bwejen Peɔ la, ba waa doŋo kɛ voɡ la ken.
Israel tena jirima ɛɛ le ba nɛɛ kaa kɛŋɔ jumbie aa ira kaa la ken, baa biirii loɡle tɛɛ ba kpa, haahna aa teenee kpoŋe, baa teene ɡee jo kpa.
Ba loɡlɔ kwaraa naa, mɛɛ ɡeloo ba di biseo, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa aa wola ka.
Dɛ n laa n te kpɔ ba nɛ aa, bá bwɛɛlɛ.
Gɛ saŋ maa na Israel tena la, dɛ ba do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa soɡe Taaya harɛ waa do wer la ta ken.
Kɛ taraken, ba le ba bii tɛ ŋɔ bá kpoo.” Ate, Hosia ŋɔ, “Korowii, bɔkwaa ń soŋe tɛɛ baɔ?
Bɛ ɡel ba haahna lolɛ, bɛ ɡel ba dɔ elnee ba bii ɔr.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Ba nyubinikpeɡ la pa mun Gelɡal, belaa n le hah ba.
Ba wechɔɡa nomanta, mɛɛ doŋ baa le n Dem.
Maa ba waa nyin kpa, ba nomonome bwa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena.
Israel tena do kɛŋɔ daa o lune bwa aa hola waa wola nɔnɛ.
Ba loɡle bii dɛɛ nyin ba kohona kwaraa naa, mɛɛ kpoo baa.” Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la vɛɛh ba, dɛkalkɛ ba ta o waa ta teŋɛ.
Baa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe harɛre taa, baa bɔree dɔ so.
Israel tena fa do kɛŋɔ ɡrepo da, asɛ nɔna su o bwa.
Ba kondɔɔh do kɛŋɔ ɡrepo nɔna ken, aa dɛ warɛ la, dɛ ba dɛ ɛ kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta aa warɛ.
Harɛ la dɛ ɛ kondikwaa kohona naa, ɡɛɛ ba ɡe ɛɛ paaɡe bwea aa wera kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ duura.
Nyosone ɡboo su ba bwa a chɛ kɛ bá di bolchɔɡe a wa.
Korowii ɛɛ paɡre ba saraha kwaa, dɛ́ chɔɡ bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura laanee.
Belaa baa ba ŋɔe ŋɔ, “Ya ta kooro dɔe, dɛkalkɛ ya ta Korowii duure.
Ya dɔ kooro kwaraa naa, bɔkwaa o fe ɛɛ ba ɛɛ tɛ yaa ɔ?” Ba baɡɛ nyoo taeh, dɛ teŋe nyosone dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ ba ne nɛra pɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa.
Anomanta, kasinteŋ berɛ nyosone, kɛŋɔ koo baa parɔ kpɔɡchɔɡa ta che o ta.
Nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjen Samaria ɛɛ ɔmɛ suuɡaswɛm baa kpɔa loɡɛ nabale o do bwɛjen Bɛt Avɛn la waa.
Ba ne sɔfore baa dɛ tomɔ la bwa ɛɛ wiu kɛrɛdɛ, ba sie aa o we-ɛɛla taa lɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba laa kpɔ le ba be kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Baa cheo kaa Asiiria harɛ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ka bɔ toɔ tɛ koojen waa lɔ bela la.
Sihiih ɛɛ kpo Israel tenaa, baa di sihiih voɡa baa sɛah la waa.
Baa lawɛ Samaria tena ne ba kooroo kaa, kɛŋɔ nee aa palɛ daa dɛɛ kaa la ken.
Voɡa aa lɔ bwea dor bwɛjen Bɛt Avɛn, bela Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la, dɛ ba chɔɡa.
Sɔɔhne ne jabalnadaŋɛre ɛɛ leo tɔ kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta dɛɛ tɛ ba voɡa bwa.
Ásɛ ba ŋɔ bwejena ne deŋɡarere be ŋɔ, “Hé choɡli tɔ ya nɛ.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena ta wechɔɡa baa ɛɛ mɛ la ɡelɛ.
Gɛ saŋ baa lea ɛ wechɔɡa bwɛjen Gebea la.
Anomanta, laa taa baa ba serewa Gebea.
Mɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, ásɛ harɛre ta nɛra pɛ dɛ́ ba tɛr ba deŋne ba wechɔɡa kohona la wa.
Israel tena do kɛŋɔ nalor baa baɡlo mea lɔe, o sie ɛɛ lɛ a ta.
Anomanta, mɛɛ kpɔ daa dawɛ o baŋa ta wɛɛ parɛ.
Mɛɛ teŋɛ Israel tena nɛɛ ásɛ Juda tena ɛɛ parɛ.
Israel tena bwa ɡe ɛɛ buɡli harɛ.
Hé ɡel he waa toɡre, ásɛ dɛ dɔ nyina waa wola jaɡa dɔe.
Hé pwɛr he bambile waa kpeɡa, kɛŋɔ harɛ waa hola.
Saŋ telo kɛ hé nyin men Korowii bɔr mɔɔ n bala tel, ásɛ n swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heyaa kohona.
Kɛ a ɛo kɛŋɔ haa du wechɔɡa dɛ komɛ wechɔɡa.
He di he nyosone la nɔna.
Haa kpɔ he te dawɛ he bokpeɡa ta, ne he laa tena baa wara dɛ jemɛ yoi nɛɛ nomanta, he nɛra ɛɛ no laa ɡbɔɡaa, ásɛ he dekpeɡa bwa chɔɡ.
Aa doo kɛŋɔ Kooro Salman aa kpɔ laa ba chɔɡ bwɛjen Bɛt Aabɛl, dɛ kpoo haahna ne ba bii bil la.
Gɛɛ dɛɛ ba he Bɛtel tena nɛɛ chiɡa, dɛkalkɛ he wechɔɡa kan kohona.
Awola tɔpere laa la aa pa mun la, baa ba kpo Israel kooroo.”
Korowii nyina waa nyin Israel tena Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel fa aa do kɛ bechala la n nyinu, dɛ yerɔ le Ijipt harɛ ta kɛŋɔ n bie.
Kɛ maa teŋa dɛɛ yerɔ la, dɛ ɡɛɛ o teŋɛ dɛ jo dɛɛ kaa.
N nɛra kpoo kwaa tɛ voɡa Baalre, dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma tɛ voɡa.
Menee chaɡle Israel tena ba jemɛ vala, dɛ laɡ ba n nɔɔra ne ba ir che, kɛ ba ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Nyinaa n kpɔ laɡ ba ba n be, dɛ kpɔ ba chwaa.
N laa koeh aa dawɛ ba nɛɛ la kpɔ, asɛ dɛ ba harɛ dɛ pa ba kondikwa.
Ba vɛh ba liire chara dɛ́ ba n be, anomanta, a chɛ kɛ bá berɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka do Asiiria tena lɔɡa.
Ba dɔma ɛɛ ba yoo ba laa ba bwɛjena taa, ásɛ dɛ kuuɡi bune baa kpɔa kaɡre ba doonyoo, á ɡel waa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe bwa ba a jaɡa.
N nɛra siwi beɡrɔ kɛ bá berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ.
Baa wiu, dɛkalkɛ wejena dawɛ ba nɛ, kɛ nomɛlbwa aa laa kpɔ ba nɛ.
Israel tena, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona ɡel heya ɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona le heyaa tɛɔ?
Mɛɛ won chɔɡ heyaa kɛŋɔ Adma tena aa?
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona chɔɡ heyaa kɛŋɔ Seboiim tena ɔ?
N liire aa men ɡɛ baɡle, nyina maa dɛ nyin heyaa la kan taeh.
Maa n bandia kohona laanee kpɔ ba tɛr he deŋne, kɛɛ dɛ́ berɛ ba chɔɡ heyaa kpa.
Korowiirii men, nɛwɛnyini laa men.
N ɡboo Korowii Maa Do Goroŋ dɛ do he baah ta, maa n bandia ne he bee ba.
Dɛ n kɔr n nɛra dɔma nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nyujente aa, baa teŋɛ n nɛɛ.
Baa le wee cholibɔree dɛ́ ba n be warane.
Baa kpɔ bochelaa dɛ́ ba kɛŋɔ Ijipt harɛ ta jumbii ken, kɛŋɔ Asiiria harɛ ta kwehre ken.
Mɛɛ kpɔ baa ba so ba deremi ta ja.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Israel tena wechɔɡa Korowii ŋɔ, “Nyosone ɡboo Israel tena teŋe dɛɛ tɛ mɛ, tɔpere bwaa baa neɡ mɛ.
Juda tena ta dɛ ɛɛ mɛ deŋnekpeɡ, men Korowii Maa Do Goroŋ dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ la.”
Israel tena wobɛlbwa ɛ wepɛɛ dɛɛ chɔɡ wa tɔpere te bɛlbwa.
Ba chwao dɛɛ ti nyosone, asɛ naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla ɡe su ba bwa.
Ba ne Asiiria tena fɔwɛ fɔo, ba ne Ijipt tena ɛɛ di bona.
Korowii ne Juda tena dɔɔ, wɛɛ tɛr Israel tena deŋnee ɡɛ ba wechɔɡa aa doa wa, dɛ́ bɔ ba kem ɡɛ ba we-ɛɛla aa doa.
Ba nabaa Jekɔb ta aa lɔ o nya tea bini la, dɛ o lawɛ o kpar dɔŋ Esɔ nalume baa vuuɡi dɔŋa.
Waa baa kpeɡ la, o ne Korowii su luɡe.
Jekɔb ne nyundua torome su luɡe asɛ Jekɔb pɔ o nɛ, o wio dɛ soŋe nyundua torome la ŋɔ ó sweero andɛɛɡa.
Korowii ba o be Bɛtel dɛ bol waa o be bela.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ, Jekɔb ne o su luɡe la, o sɔnee Korowii, onee chɛ kɛ yá tomɛ.
Kɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ Jekɔb naanar, hé berɛ ba Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la be, hé kpoŋe nyina ne kasinteŋ, dɛɛ no o be saŋ bɛlbwa.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Kon-yoɡra kpɔ kwaa aa wola chɛɛ maɡɛ kwaa dɛɛ faah nɛra, ba sie dɛ lɛ nɛn faahra ta.
Israel tena dɛ ɛ mbarafo dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔ suuɡa, dɛ ɛ dɔɔhna.
Ya kondɔɔh bwa habɔɔ baa wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ya nɛɛ na.’ Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la.
Mɛɛ berɔɔ ɡel he so tɛnte deene bini ja, kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ he fa aa soɡe a bini tɔpejena dii maa lea cheɡ ta la.
N bol waa keamere la be, dɛ ɡel ba na wepila taeh, dɛ che ba nɛɛ kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa he be dɛ ja heya.
Ane a bwa, Gelead tena dɛ tomɛ voɡa.
Banɔ la baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la ɛɛ serewoo.
Ba dɛ kpoo nabala dɛɛ ɛ saraha Gelɡal.
Kwaa baa dɛ ɛ sarahare a ta la, ɛɛ chɔɡoo kɛŋɔ bwea aa dawɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ harɛ baa parɔ ta.” Ya nabaa Jekɔb chwao kaa Mɛsopoteemea harɛ ta.
Waa dɛ nyin haah dɛ́ mo la, o kaa teɡɛ baa bɛl peera.
Korowii cheɡɛ o keame Mosis nɛɛ dɛ lawɛ Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ ɡel o nyiŋi ba nɛ.
Kɛ Israel tena ɡelɔ o baah di kohona, Korowii baa dɛ tomɛ ɛɛ ɡeloo ba wechɔɡa ɡure ba nɛ, dɛ́ bɔ ba kem waa baa ɛa wa.
Korowii baah di Israel tena nɛ Efrem dea tena fa bol wa aa, Israel deene aa kaa la dɛ ɔmɛ, banee Israel tena ɛɛ duu.
Kɛ Efrem dea tena tomɛ voɡ Baal, anomanta, baa serewoo.
Ba ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa kohona, ba kpɔ ba suuɡapoŋa dɛɛ ɛ voɡa, ba ɛa a do wer kɛrɛdɛ, a bwa ɛ kwaa nɛra baa dɔ a wejema aa ɛa.
Ba bol ɡɛ nɛra nɔ waa ŋɔ, “Ba kpoo nɛra dɛɛ ɛ saraha, dɛɛ mo voɡ baa ɛo kɛŋɔ nabale la lwɛɛma.” A ɡɛ nomanta, baa nyoɡroo warane kɛŋɔ kɔɔla aa tɔa chɔɔbɔr, kɛŋɔ mɛn aa wola biɡri dɛ a leo la, kɛŋɔ haahra peu aa taa dɛ kpɔa le pɛla ta kaa la, dɛ do kɛŋɔ chuu aa kpɔ tokoro ta dɛɛ le.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ n lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ la.
He bɛ voɡ bɛlbwa yarada ka ja n nɛ.
Lɛɛ bɛlbwa toole ka ja n nɛ.
N nyiŋi he nɛɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, harɛ o ta aa do wɔrɔbe kohona.
Maa tɛ heyaa kondikwaa he di la, he vaɡrɔ, haa vaɡra la, he ɛ mbarafo asɛ dɛ soh n wa.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ba he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nyujente ken, kɛŋɔ noniete waa pɛl ŋwɛnɛ nyoa dɛɛ nyin kon dɛ́ lawɛ.
Mɛɛ ba yo heyaa kɛŋɔ sisire bii aa nyoɡra wɛɛ ɛ la, dɛ́ ba peeɡe he bini.
Dɛ́ di he ola buɡ la ta kɛŋɔ nyujente ken, dɛ́ toɡri he bini kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa aa dɛ ɛ la.
Israel tena, he serewɔ, dɛkalkɛ he ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo n nɛ.
Hé ŋɔ ń tɛ heyaa kooro ne nomonome, asɛ n tɛ heya, kɛ ɛrɛɛ baa ba wona lɛ heya ɔ?
Bandia nee n tɛ heyaa kooro, dɛ berɛ che bandia ta dɛ le o ne.
Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ di bolchɔɡe, ba chwera do tɔn bini dɛ kwaara cheɡ.
Ba nyu som kɛ baa dɔ bɔr dɛ́ so, kɛ dɛ ɡɛn dɛ vɛh waa la.
Ba do kɛ bechala baa dɛ ba o lola waa wola bala nyin.
Mɛɛ lɛɛ ba le lalbɔɔ bini, dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le seo nyoa.
Seo, leperaa he weechɔɡa dɔɔ jaɔ?
Lalbɔɔ, leperaa chɔɡa haa dɛ ba yaa chɔɡa dɔɔ?
Maa tedomaa dɔ tɛ he Israel tena, a lole kɛŋɔ he wer he bala bini.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo peuchɔɡe ta le wee leebɔr, dɛ́ ta le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Nee aa won palɛ le neerare nyuune ta, ásɛ buli hweeh.
Mɛɛ pa he kondɛɛɡaa le bela haa dɛ cheɡa la kaa.
Samaria tena chɛ kɛŋɔ ba bolchɔɡe ɡure ba nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ men Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la deŋnekpeɡ.
Laa taa baa ba ba kpoora, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ba bechale cha harɛ dɛ́ ya ba tekpoŋra teene.”
Hosia soŋe Israel tena ŋɔ bá berɛ ba Korowii be Israel tena, hé berɛ ba Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ be.
He wechɔɡa ɡelɔ he choɡli!
Hé ɡel ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ he wesoŋa, dɛ́ berɛ ba Korowii be.
Hé soŋo ŋɔ, “Kpɔ ya wechɔɡa bwa kɛ yaa, dɛ́ sune ya nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛ yaa, ásɛ ya kpɛɛre, ɡɛ yaa baɡɛ nyoa la.
Asiiria tena aa won lɛ yaa, ya jaɡre yaa dɛ la ane laa la aa won lɛ yaa.
Yaa berɛ yerɛ kwaa ya ɡbabir aa kpɔ nɔɔra ɛ la, ya voɡa kpa, dɛkalkɛ hen Korowiirii dɔ tedoma tɛ bilalbii.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ berɔ lawɛ n nɛra ba n be, dɛ́ nyin ba waa n bambile bwa ne, dɛkalkɛ n bandia toole ba nɛɛ kpa.
Mɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ bwaala waa nɛ harɛ waa hola ta, dɛ́ tɛ Israel tena, ásɛ ba do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa fee ken.
Dɛ so kɛŋɔ daa lune aa kaa harɛ bini ken, kɛŋɔ peleme daa aa lɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta ken.
Baa kpeɡuu dɛ́ so le, ásɛ dɛ do wer kɛŋɔ ɔleve daa ken.
Ba sɔɔh ɛɛ do somee kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn peleme daa ken.
Baa berɔ so ásɛ n kpɔ nɔn tɔ ba nɛ.
Israel tena ɛɛ parɛ mea, ásɛ ba wobɛlbwa do wer kɛŋɔ ɡrepo daa aa dɛ nɔnɛ kohona la.
Ba sɔn ɛɛ leo kɛŋɔ Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta sen ken.
Israel tena aa voɡaa tomɛ kpa.
Mɛɛ no ba wesoŋaa ásɛ dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
N do kɛŋɔ daa waa wola chure ken, n chunchule ɛɛ tɔ ba nɛɛ, ba wer doe bwa le n be.” Umee wejereme ɔ?
Naate ɛɛ jemɛ waa nɔɔ.
Umee dɛɛ pese waɔ?
Naate ɛɛ no a munii.
Korowii ŋwɛnɛre toɡrɔ, nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ teŋɛ a ta, kɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena dɛ lɔ naa a ta.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Joel baɡle Korowii deŋnetɛra waa kɛŋɔ tontombɛ ane aa wara dɛ́ ba chɔɡ harɛ la, ne hwel waa dɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ ba wenaale kohona ne ba ta nɛra nɛɛ wa.
O yerɛ nɛra la ŋɔ bá charɛ ba liire, dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛ ŋɔ ba ɛ ɡɛ naa Korowii ɛɛ berɔ ɡel harɛ la do wer, ásɛ dɛ swee ba andɛɛɡa.
O ŋɔ Korowii baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo o Doma ba so nɛra bwa nɛ, bonɔɔna ne bitoli, ne baala dɛ haahna bwa.
Nyiŋi nyu :-.
Kasinteŋ, a ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡo Pɛntekɔs Tɔpejen la ta.
Nyiŋi We-ɛɛla nyu .
Waa aa le Korowii be dɛ ba Pɛtoɛl bibaa Joel be laanee nɔ.
Tontombɛ ane wa Nomonome, hé cheɡ deŋne no, hé no, he nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa.
Waa nɔ dɔŋa chiɡ he bere saŋ kɛɛ he naawa bere saŋ ta ka aa?
Hé bola he bii be, ásɛ ba bola ba ɡe bii be, ba bii la ɡe bola ba naanar baa ka ba be.
Dɛ tontombɛ ane balɔ, dɛ ba di kwaa kaa laa, anɔ la aa wara yon teŋɛ dɛ́ ba di.
Anɔ la aa wara baa di kaa laa, anjeɡre ane ɡe ba di dɛ́ kaa, ásɛ ane kapa ɡe yon ba di a kabora.
Sennyɔdɛɛra, hé ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ hɛɛ wi, hɛɛ wi senfala wa, dɛkalkɛ ɡrepo nɔna baa harama dɛɛ ɛ sen la bwa chɔɡɔ.
Tontombɛ la do kɛ laa tena dɛ ba yo n nɛra, a kpeɡri dɛ warɛ, aa wola nyoa dɔe, a nyena do kɛŋɔ nyujente nyena ken.
A chɔɡ n ɡrepo daa maa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen, dɛ chɔɡ n fiɡ daa kooni.
A nyee a pɛɡa bwa, asɛ a kpala bwa to.
Hɛ́ɛ wi kohona kɛŋɔ bitolo aa liɡe lweyal dɛɛ wi o bechajaa waa sewa la ken.
Mea ne sen sarahare toole Korowii Dea kpa.
Sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la bwa dɛ wi a wa.
Kooni bwa chɔ pɛɛ, asɛ harɛre bwa hol, mea ɡe bwa chɔɡ, ɡrepo nɔna bwa ɡe hol, ɔleve daa bwa chɔɡɔ.
Paara, hɛ́ɛ di suna, hé nɛra haa dɔ ɡrepo daa kooni ɡe ɛɛ wi, mea bwa soo siwi chɔɡɔ, kondikwaa bwa chɔɡɔ kwaraa.
Grepo ne fiɡ daa bwa holɔ, ɡɛɛ daa bɛlbwa waa dɛ nɔnɛ sewɛ.
Kasinteŋ, nomɛlbwa ta silɛɛ dɔe kpa.
Liire chara wa Sɔfore, hé kpɔ lweyale tɔ dɛɛ wi, heyaa dɛɛ ɛ toma saraha kon la ta.
Hé la Korowii Dea ka so jwaana bwa dɛɛ wi, dɛkalkɛ mea kɛɛ sen sarahare aa Korowii Dea ba kpa.
Hé yerɛ nɛra bwa ba cheme, bá vɔwɛ nyoa.
Hé yerɛ harɛ la nomonome bwa ba Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ Dea, dɛ́ ba wi noo bela.
Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la telo, saŋ On Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la aa ba chɔɡa ne la.
Wɛɛ ba ɔmee kohona nee ba ta nɛra nɛ.
Ya kondikwaare dɛ chɔɡ yaa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa, silɛɛ bɛlbwa toole Korowii Dea kpa.
Harɛ holɔ anomanta, kondwee bwa pɔɔh.
Deene baa dɛ cheɡ kondikwaa a bini bwa kuuɡo, dɛkalkɛ mea toole bá kpɔ do a bini.
Ya nae bwa dɛ wi dɛɛ di suna, a ta bɔr dɔe dɛ́ ɡaaɡe ka di, hale peera bwa bwara dɛ nyɛɡ.
N Naa Korowii, henee n wi dɛɛ no, nii fuh kondɛɛra dibɔra, dɛ fuh kpɔɡ bini daa bwa.
Hale kpɔɡ bini ola wio dɛɛ noe, dɛkalkɛ nenabɔɔne hweehrɔ, asɛ nii fuh kondɛɛra dibɔra.
Tontombɛ aa wara wa Hé hoh bɛla kohona Saayɔn, Korowii bwe waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.
Hé nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa hé ɡel he bwara ɛɛ chel, Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la dɛ ba, o telo tonɛ.
Bɔr dɛ ba bira a ɡɛ saŋ, ásɛ baama tɔ bobɛlbwa.
Tontombɛ ɛɛ wuruu ba tɔ bwejena ta, kɛŋɔ laa tena baa kpeɡa kohona ken.
A dɔŋa ta chiɡe bwa, aa chiɡ saŋ bɛlbwa ɡe bwa.
A dɛ chɔɡ kwaa kɛŋɔ nii yon fuh kwaa dɛ chɔɡa la.
Harɛ waa chɔ a sie do kɛ Korowii bodɛɛɡe Eden ken, asɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ chɔ a habɔɔ, komɛlbwa aa won chwa le a be.
A mar do kɛŋɔ jaɡre ken, dɛ chwa dɛɛ jah kɛŋɔ jaɡre baa dɛ la ane laa.
A ɡbɔɡa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore sii ken, dɛ ɡah dɛɛ ɡale bwejena, a kena ɛɛ si kɛŋɔ nii aa dɛ fuh kpɔɡ ɛɛ parame la.
A do kɛŋɔ laa tena baa kpeɡa kohona, dɛ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ la ka yo laa ken.
A dɛ ba naa, dɛ ɔmee chole harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, ásɛ bɛlbwa bambile ɛɛ teŋe.
A dɛ yo kɛŋɔ laa tena aa dɛ yo nɛra ken, dɛɛ teeh danjwɛɛre.
A bwa dɛ teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, aa berɛ dɛɛ le a ŋwɛnɛ ta.
Aa dɔŋa taɡɛ, bɛlbwa pa sie dɛɛ kaa.
A dɛ jo bela waa kpeɡa dɛ́ le, wobɛlbwa aa wola an ɛ.
A iro kpɔ bwɛjen la danjwɛɛre ta dɛ ka jo deene bini, kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛra yon kpɔ tokorore ta dɛɛ jo deene bini la.
A dɛ ba naa, dɛ harɛ dɛ jiɡri, nyundua ɡe ɛɛ yiiɡi.
Biro dɛ tɔ wee ne korobie ta, weweela ɡe aa won chaah kpa.
Korowii tɔ o laa tena sie dɛ nyɛɡ, a do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra ken, o laa tena la ta nyoa dɔe, ba ɛ banyoola dɛɛ no o deŋna wa.
Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la ɔma kohona.
Umee dɛ́ won che a nyoa ɔ?
Liire chara wa Korowii ŋɔ, “A ta mun kae, hé charɛ he liire, dɛ́ kpɔ he bambile bwa tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ vɔwɛ nyoa dɛɛ wi kohona.
He bɛ he laala kɛɛ á baɡle he suna dii, hé ɡel he suna dii baɡle kɛ he bambile chɔɡɔ.” Hé charɛ he liire dɛ́ berɛ ba Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ be, o bambile too dɛ dɔ tedoma tɛ nɛn.
O baah aa di warawara, o nyina ta jaɡa dɔe.
O kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ ba saŋ bɛlbwa, waa wola ba deŋne tɛr.
O ken ɛɛ na ya sumii dɛ́ charɛ o liire, dɛ́ swee yaa andɛɛɡa, ásɛ ya dɔ mea ne sen kohona dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ sarahare tɛo.
Hé hoh bɛla Saayɔn Bwejen ta, dɛ́ boa nɛra nyoa, bá vɔwɛ nyoa á baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna.
Hé boa nɛra la nyoa, dɛ́ laa ba doŋa kpɔ ba nɛ.
Hé boa nomonome nyoa, dɛ́ yerɛ bechale bá ba cheme, hale bechasɔɔhne baa dɛ ɔr.
Hanfale ne o jaa le ba dea baa soɡe o bini ba.
Hé sɔfore haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii o Dea doonyoa ne saraha kon baah ta la, hé wi dɛ́ soŋo ŋɔ, “Ya Naa Korowii, sune yan yaa ɛ he nɛra nɛ, bɛ ɡel harɛ nɛra bane mamɛ yaa dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔɔ?’ ” Korowii berɔ ɡel harɛ la do som Anee ɡela Korowii sie ba o nɛra nɛ, dɛ sune ba nɛ harɛ la ta.
Korowii chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tɛ heyaa mea ne senfala ne ɔleve noo kohonaa a maɡre he ne.
Maa ɡel harɛre ta nɛra mamɛ heyaa kpa.
Mɛɛ doŋi tontombɛ aa do kɛŋɔ laa tena, dɛ le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr laanee le he be, dɛ́ taɡɛ ane ka ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, ásɛ dɛ taɡɛ anla aa tɔ sie la ka ta Yar Mpo ta.
Anɔ la aa lɔ habɔɔ ɡe, n taɡa ka ta Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta.
Aa serewoo dɛ́ pɔh, ásɛ a sɔɔh kaa nyundua.” Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɛ wejena.
Harɛ, bɛ ɔmɛ, ɡel he sie lɛ he hɛɡre.
Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɛ wejena.
Kpɔɡ bini ola, he bɛ ɔmɛ, ola dibɔra kpɔɡa dɛ moɡɛ.
Daa ɡe ɛɛ nɔnɛ, fiɡ ne ɡrepo nɔna ɡe warɛ.
Saayɔn tena, hé ɡel he sie lɛ, hɛɛ hɛɡre Korowii haa dɛ tomɛ nɛ yoo bwaala ne bwaala loɡla waa tɛ heya kɛrɛdɛ wa.
O ɡelɔ bwaala nɛ heyaa kohona.
Mea lɔbɔra bwa ɛɛ su meaa, ásɛ ɔleve noo ne senfala su vɛɛhna dɛ́ɛ ta.
Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ bɔ heyaa kwaa tontombɛ la aa baa chɔɡ la kemee, anɔ la aa wara ne anjeɡre la, ne ane ɡe aa bera teŋɛ dɛ ba di, asɛ ane ɡe kapa ka mun ba dɛ ba di a kabora la.
Men Korowiirii kpɔ tontombɛ aa do kɛŋɔ laa tena nɔ ba ta he nɛ.
Hɛɛ dɔ kondikwa kohonaa di dɛ́ vaɡre, ásɛ dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la, o ɛ nyokpowaa tɛ heya, sihiih aa n nɛraa kpo kpa.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel he jemɛ kɛ n ja he nɛɛ Israel harɛ, menee Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, nomɛlbwa toole kpa.
Sihiih aa n nɛraa kpo bwa.” Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “A habɔɔ la, mɛɛ tɛ nɛra bwa soo siwii n Doma la kohonaa, ásɛ he bibaala ne bihaahna bwa bol n waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa kerekere la, ásɛ he bonɔɔna na chaahna, ásɛ he banjeni dee deera.
Gɛ saŋ la, mɛɛ ɡeloo n Doma ba so n bonɔɔna ne toli bwa nɛ.
Mɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa nyundua ne harɛ taa, ásɛ nɛra na chal ne nii ne ninchuu kohona.
Wee dɛ ba bira, ásɛ korobie swɛɛ kɛŋɔ chal ken, mɔɔ Korowii Tɔpejen waa do ɔma la ba.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa wi yerɛ men Korowii la, mɛɛ lɛo.
Saayɔn Bwejen ne Jerusalam taa nɛra ɛɛ ba ba nyu dɔe, ɡɛ men Korowii aa bola ŋɔ, ‘Ba bini bane ɛɛ chwao le Jerusalam, kɛ banɔ la maa lee ba tɛ n te la ɛɛ dɔ ba nyuu.’ ”
Korowii ɛɛ bol harɛre nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole Korowii ŋɔ, “Saŋ maa lea cheɡ la telo aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam tena wobɛlbwa berɛ do wer tɛɛ ba.
Mɛɛ boa harɛre nɛra nyoa dɛ́ ba bane Jehosafat Fɛlembɔjen bini.
Belaa mɛɛ ba ń ba bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole, waa bwa baa kpɔa ɛ n nɛra Israel tena la, dɛkalkɛ ba lɔ ba peɡre harɛre nɛra bini dɛ bɔne n harɛ.
Ba ta bie n nɛra nɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ nɛra baa dɔ bá ɛ ba yoma, ba yoɡ ba bibaala ne bihaahna, dɛ kpɔ ba suuɡa bɔ hanjwamanere ne sen kem.
Nɛra haa lɔ bwɛjena Taaya ne Sidon dɛ harɛre aa lɔ Filisti bwa, bɔkwa waa n ne he dɔɔ?
He dɛ bɔ mɛ waane maa ɛ heyaa kem kɛɛ?
Dɛ kemee hɛɛ bɔ mɛ tenaa, mɛɛ ɡeloo a berɛ ba ɡure he nyu ta warane.
Hé kpɔ n suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ n kondɛɛɡa kaa ka cheɡ he voɡa deene bini.
He lawɛ Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam tena le ba harɛ ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta, dɛ ka yoɡ ba tɛ Grik tena.
N dɛ ba n laɡ ba le harɛre haa yoɡ ba tɛ la ta, ásɛ waa haa ɛɛ ba la ɡure he nyu ta.
Mɛɛ yoɡ he bibaala ne bihaahnaa tɛ Juda harɛ ta tena, ásɛ ba ɡe yoɡ ba tɛ Seba tena baa soɡe bojaŋ harɛ ta la.” Korowiirii bola.
“Hé bol harɛre nɛra be ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ka yo laa!
Bá yerɛ banyoola la bwa, dɛ́ boa laa tena la bwa nyoa bá ba yo!
Hé kpɔ he para loɡɛ tokobie dɛ́ beɡre he ɡoori lampeare.
Asɛ nɛra baa ɡwɛɡra ɡe ŋɔ, ‘Ya bwara kpeɡri!’ Harɛre aa bara cheme bwa nɛra, hé le ba ka boa nyoa warane fɛlembɔjen la bini.” N Naa Korowii, ba he banyoola ne dɛ́ ba yoo ba.
Harɛre ta nɛra bwa ir nyu ne, dɛ́ ba kaa Jehosafat Fɛlembɔjen la bini.
Belaa men Korowii ɛɛ ba bala dɛ́ ba so, dɛ́ bol harɛre nɛra baa bara cheme bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Ba nyu bini kpeɡri kohona.
Teŋ ba ta kɛŋɔ mea koma saŋ ba yon teŋni a daa la.
Tiɡri ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba yon tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna ta, ka tel kɛŋɔ a nee yon su kwa, hale dɛɛ ta la.
Nɛra kaɡboŋa baa wola nyoa dɔe, lɔ Jehosafat Fɛlembɔjen bini.
Dɛkalkɛ, Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ la telo tonɛ, fɛlembɔjen la bini.
Korobie ne wee aa lɔ, ásɛ bɔr bir, weweela ɡe aa chaah kpa.
Korowii ɛɛ kɔroo le Saayɔn Bwejen ta, o taa do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ kɔɡre ken, o le Jerusalam dɛɛ ba, nyundua ne harɛ ɛɛ jiɡri.
Korowii ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ danjwɛkpeɡ ken, ásɛ o nɛra chwa kaa marɔ.
Korowii ɛɛ swee o nɛra andɛɛɡaa “Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, n soɡe n Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.
Jerusalam ɛ bwɛjen maa lea cheɡ o do ɡoroŋ, nɛŋhɔɔhra aa won ba yo dɛ́ pɔ n nɛra nɛɛ kpa.
Saŋ la telo aa, daa kooni ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ tɔ bwejena ta, nae warɛ do deŋɡarere bwa ta, ásɛ Juda harɛ nenabɔɔne bwa ɡe su ne.
Nenapale bɛl ɛɛ palɔɔ le Korowii Dea dɛ́ kaa Akaasia Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ́ sɔɔh bela harɛ la bwa.
Ijipt harɛ dɛ ba pɛɛ chɔe, ásɛ Edom harɛ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, yoi baa kaa yo Juda harɛ ta tena, dɛ kpoo nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ la wa.
Nɛra ɛɛ so Juda ne Jerusalam harɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa, ka tel naanar baa ka ba bwa saŋ.
Nɛra baa kpoora maa wola kpɔe kɛ ba la, mɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛ ba, ásɛ dɛ ka so Saayɔn Bwejen ta.”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Juda harɛ bwɛɛ bɛl taa Emɔs le, kɛ o kaa bol Korowii waa la Israel harɛ weekaŋle nyundua tena be.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ wobɛlbwa wer harɛ la ta ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta, asɛ dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii nɛra sie ta aa wola bambile ta leɛ.
Emɔs bolɔ ŋɔ Korowii sie aa ba nɛɛ lɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba dɛ nyiŋi nyaara nyubaah, baa kasinteŋ ɡe bolɛ dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.
O di ba kasinteŋ kpeɡri nɛɛ ŋɔ Israel harɛ nɛra ta harɛre nɛra baa bar ba cheme la ta korɛ.
Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɛ nyin kɛ ba bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Nyiŋi nyu :-.
Baa bɛl sɔne Emɔs, dɛ o ɛ peteɡre dɛ so Tekoa.
Korowii pili waane aa dɛ ba Israel harɛ ta bala baɡlo chaahna ta, bene anɛ mɔɔ harɛ jiɡra bɛl chiɡ Israel harɛ ta.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ Kooro Ussia di kora Juda harɛ ta, asɛ Jehoas bibaa Kooro Jɛroboam ɡe di kora Israel harɛ ta.
Emɔs ŋɔ, “Korowii baah diu o kɔr le Saayɔn Bwejen ta, o taa kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ kɔɡre ken, o le Jerusalam dɛɛ ba.
Kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa holɔ, Kaamɛl Bwejen doa kpɔɡa bwa serewe.” Korowii pa bwɛɛre aa bar Israel tena cheme bolchɔɡe Korowii ŋɔ, “Damaskɔs tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne.
Ba lɔɔ Gelead tena nyubinikpeɡ ne, kɛŋɔ baa lɔ mea pɛla ta ken.
Mɛɛ ba fuh koodem Kooro Hasael aa doo laanee, dɛ́ ba fuh Kooro Bɛn Hadad dekpeɡa la, dɛ́ chɔɡa.
Mɛɛ kuuɡi bwɛjen Damaskɔs doonyoa ɡbenii, dɛ́ ir nɛra baa soɡe Bɛn Avɛn Fɛlembɔjen, ne kooro waa dɛ di kora Bɛt Eden.
Baa lawɛ Siiria tena laa taa kaa Kir harɛ ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Gasa tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne.
Ba lawɛ harɛbir nɛra laa ta, dɛ ka yoɡ ba yoma tɛ Edom tena.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh danjwɛjena aa bar bwɛjen Gasa la, dɛ́ fuh o dekpeɡa bwa, dɛ́ chɔɡa.
Mɛɛ ir koranar baa lɔ bwɛjena Asdɔd ne Askɛlɔn kora taa.
Mɛɛ tɛr bwɛjen Ekron tena deŋnee, ásɛ Filisti tena baa kaa la bwa serewe.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Taaya tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne.
Ba lawɛ harɛbir nɛra laa ta kaa bojaŋ Edom harɛ ta, ba ta beŋkpoŋri fɔo ba ne baa fɔwa la ta teŋɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh danjwɛjena aa bar bwɛjen Taaya, dɛ́ fuh o dekpeɡa, dɛ́ chɔɡa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Edom tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne.
Ba kpɔ keri kpoo ba lolanar Israel tena, ba ta tedoma dɔe tɛɛ ba, ba bandia ta jaɡa dɔe, waa sɔɔh bwa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh bwɛjen Teman, dɛ́ fuh bwɛjen Bosra dekpeɡa, dɛ́ chɔɡa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Amɔn tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne.
Ba yo laa dɛɛ nyin ba harɛ do kan, anomanta, ba kpoo Gelead tekpoŋra, dɛ ya ba teene.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh danjwɛjena aa bar bwɛjen Raba dɛ́ chɔɡ ba dekpeɡa.
Dɔma ɛɛ do lɔŋɔree dɛ́ ba yoo ba awola, kɛŋɔ kawulewule aa dɛ ta ken.
Baa lawɛ Raba kooro ne o nomonome laa taa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Korowii ŋɔ, “Moab tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne.
Ba ta Edom kooro bui, ba huɡri o hoɡa, dɛ fuah a berɛ tɔɔ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh Moab harɛ, dɛ́ fuh dekpeɡa aa bar bwɛjen Kereɔt.
Moab tena ɛɛ serewoo, a ɡɛ saŋ laa tena aa dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa dɛɛ hoh laa bɛle la.
Mɛɛ kpo Moab kooro ne o nomonome baa ja o nɛɛ bwaa.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Juda tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne a wa.
Ba vɛh me Mmarare la, ba ta waa maa do ba a ta teŋɛ, dɛ le n waa ta, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa ba naawa fa aa toma la.
Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo nii ba fuh Juda harɛ, dɛ́ fuh Jerusalam dekpeɡa, dɛ́ chɔɡa.” Korowii pa Israel tena bolchɔɡe Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr ba deŋne a wa.
Ba yoɡ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, dɛ di kema baa wola won bɔ la.
Ba lɛ suuɡapoŋa ba ka ɛ yoma, dɛ yoɡ nyaara baa di kema, kema la suuɡa aa wola won yawɛ naŋɡawa ɡba.
Ba tiɡri nyaara dɛɛ do harɛ kɛŋɔ teera ken, dɛ vɛh nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba waa bola dɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Mɛɛ ne o bie bwa pɛ hahbeŋkpoŋ, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah men Korowii sɔn waa do ɡoroŋ la.
Bobɛlbwa baa dɛ tom mɛ la, ba pa yale baa lɛa cheɡ awɔba la dɛɛ chɔ a ta.
Ba cheme n Dea aa, suuɡa baa faah nɛra dɛ lɛ le ba be la, a nee baa nyɔ sene.
Israel tena siwi taa n chɔɡ Amɔre tena kwaraa, dɛ ba kpekpeɡo ba bwara do kpeɡri, kɛŋɔ peleme daa ne dajena ken, asɛ n chɔɡ a nɔna ne a lune.
Menee lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ kpɔ heyaa kpɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bene fifraanaarɛ, dɛ ba kpɔ Amɔre tena harɛ tɛ heya.
N berɔ le he bibaala la bini bane ba ɛ n keamere, ba bini bonɔɔna la bini bane ɡe ɛ Nasiri tena.
Israel tena, n teŋe nyosone naa?
Men Korowiirii bola.
Kɛ he ɡelɔ Nasiri tena nyɔ sen, dɛ do n keamere ŋɔ ba bɛ n waa aa dɛ ba bala la ka bol.
Taraken, mɛɛ tiɡrii do harɛ kɛŋɔ torɔɡo yon che bone kohona dɛ tire kon ta la.
Nɛra baa won chwae la aa won le a nyoa, bokpeɡa tena ɛɛ ɛo kahonɛ, banyoo bɛlbwa ɡe aa won lɛ o nyu.
Nɛn waa jemɛ hɛm tae ɡba aa won che a nyoa, laa te bɛlbwa waa won chwae aa won le a nyoa, nɛn waa soɡe jaaɡɔ ta ɡba aa won lɛ o nyu.
Hale banyoola ba bambile aa kpeɡa, ɛɛ chwao ɡel ba dɔmkwaa awola tɔpere, Men Korowiirii bola.”
Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, he no waa aa le n be dɛɛ ba he harɛbir nɛra maa lawɛ heyaa le Ijipt harɛ ta la nɛ.
He ɡboo ɛ nɛra maa le heya tɛ n te harɛre nɛra bwa bini, a waa a chɛ kɛ ń tɛr he deŋne he wechɔɡa bwa waa la.” Korowii keame toma Nɛra banɛ nyoa ta pɛɛ yaa baa wono pɛ dɛ́ valaa?
Nyujente dɛ si kɔr bini dɛ ol laa o dɔ lawaa?
Wɛɛ do o bɔɔ binii dɛɛ ŋoo dɛ komɛl laa o lawɛ dɛɛ di aa?
Ba ta bel harɛ aa jumbie ɛɛ ba le o taa o lawɔ waa?
Bel won tae pɛɛ dɛ waane laa ɛo waa?
Laa bɛla sio bwɛjen bɛl ta naa, o nɛra aa ɔmaa?
Wechɔɡa ane chiɡ bwɛjen bɛl nɛra nɛ aa, dɛ Korowii laa ɡela a ba ɡɛ naa?
Nemenɛ Korowii aa waanee ɛ, dɛ o ta a bini pile baɡle o bonɔɔna baa ɛ o keamere.
Nyujente kɔraa, umee wola ɔmɔɔ?
Nemenɛ Korowii bol wa aa, umee wola la ka bol o waa aa dɛ ba bala laɔ?
Emɔs ŋɔ Samaria nomonome be ŋɔ, “Hé la ka bol nɛra baa soɡe Asdɔd ne Ijipt dekpeɡa bini la be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ka cheme Samaria bwejena dor, dɛ́ na yoi we-ɛɛla ne fiiɡa baa dɛ fiiɡi nɛra bela.’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “Baa jemɛ waa aa wera la ɛ. Ba cheɡɛ laa ta, dɛ che laala su ba dekpeɡa bini.” Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɔma ɛɛ ba bar ba harɛɛ cheme, dɛ́ kuuɡi dekpeɡa, dɛ́ pa ba dejena bini laala kaa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Gɛ peteɡre yon yo lɛ pee le nyujente nyoa, dɛ o nakpale anɛ ɡbo kɛɛ o deŋnekera ɡboo kaa la, ɡɛ tentenee mɛɛ ba Israel tena lɛɛ, banɔ la baa lɔ Samaria ne Damaskɔs dɛ yale ba kanedɛɛɡa ta bwa.
No ɡɛ waa nɔ, ásɛ dɛ kah Jekɔb naanar.” Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ laanee bola.
“Awola maa ba tɛr Israel tena deŋne ba wechɔɡa waa la, mɛɛ paɡre kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta Bɛtel bwaa, dɛ́ kuuɡi kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ nyeɡlare dɛ paaɡe a ta bwaa bil harɛ.
Mɛɛ paɡre ba dejena ne ba dejeɡre bwaa.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ deene baa kpɔ bala nyena ɛ kwaa cheɡ a bini a do wer la bwaa.
Dejena bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo kwaraa, Men Korowiirii bola.”
Israel tena ta berɛ ba Korowii be Hé no, haahna haa lɔ Samaria dɛ do bwara kɛ nae aa lɔ Basan harɛ ta, he dɛ fiiɡi nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra, dɛɛ ŋɔ he jaranar be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ sen baa tɛ yaa.” Nemenɛ Korowii waa do ɡoroŋ ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, “Tɔpera ane ɛɛ bao ásɛ ba lawɛ heyaa ɡoŋri ne kaa.
Baa tɛɡre bɛlbwaa kaa kɛŋɔ pɛŋe ken.
Baa lawɛ heyaa kpɔ danjwɛɛ waa pera ta, dɛ́ tɛɡre heyaa kaa bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Haamɔn.” Korowiirii bola.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, he dɛ nyin aa, hé ir kaa Bɛtel, bela haa dɛ tom mɛ la, ka ɛ wechɔɡa.
Hé kaa Gelɡal ɡe ka ɛ wechɔɡa kohona.
Hé kpɔ saraha kwaa kaa tɛ chɔɔ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ bɔne kwaa haa dɔa bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ kaa tɛ tɔpera atoro bɛlbwa.
Israel tena, hé kpɔ paanoo iisi aa lɔ a ta ɛ saraha ba jam mɛ, dɛɛ baɡle he te saraha aa le he bambile la ta, dɛkalkɛ anee hɛɛ nyin ɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.
Menee ɡela lɔr chole he bwɛjena bwa ta, asɛ he paŋɛ kondikwa bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ta, kɛ he ta berɛ ba n be.
Menee ɡela bwaala ɡel nɛɛ, ɡɛ saŋ aa ka korobie atoro he komɛ koo koŋkwaare.
N ɡelɔ bwaala nɛ bwɛɛ beŋkpoŋ ta, dɛ ɡel o ta bɛl te ta nɛɛ.
O nɛ koo bɛl ta, bɛl ta bwaala dɔe, harɛ hol.
Nyɔɡre kpo bwɛjena nɛra ɡalɡa bane ba ɡwɛɡre, dɛ ɡaaɡe la bwɛjen bɛl ta dɛ́ ka nyin nee nyɔ, ba ta dɔe.
Ane a bwa, he ta berɛ ba n be.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Keraŋwɛnɛ bwaa n ɡel he koo koŋkwaare chɔɡ, weela anee n kpɔ chɔɡa.
Tontombɛ di he fiɡ ne ɔleve daa, kɛ he ta berɛ ba n be.
Men Korowiirii bola.
N kpɔ weechɔɡa ba ta he nɛ, ɡɛ n fa aa ɛ Ijipt harɛ ta la.
N kpoo he bonɔɔna laa ta, dɛ lawɛ he jaɡre kaa.
