Dɛ ɡel nɛra baa serewa chɔ sɔɔh kpo heya, bela haa soɡa, kɛ he ta berɛ ba n be.
N chɔɡ he bini bane, ɡɛ maa chɔɡ Sodom ne Gomoora tena la.
Dɛ he do kɛŋɔ nindaa waa lɔ nii ta n kee heyaa le, kɛ he ta berɛ ba n be.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Anomanta, Israel tena, mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee.
Maa dɛ ba heyaa ɡɛ ɛɛ nomanta, hé kpɔ he te dɛɛ kpa men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ n pa heyaa bolchɔɡe.” Korowiirii ta bwejena dɛ ta peu ɡe, dɛ ɡel nɛn jemɛ o liire.
Onee ɡela webaŋa won jwaana bera, bwejena dor ɛ o natiɡribɔr, o sɔne Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ.
Liire chara dɛ́ berɛ ba Korowii be Emɔs ŋɔ, “Israel tena, hé no wiile maa taara dɛɛ tɛ heyaa nɔ.
‘Israel harɛ waa do kɛŋɔ bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ la paɡrɔ waa wola werii do kpa, harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ kwaa vɔrɔwo.’ ” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Bwɛjen bɛl lɔ Israel harɛ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ laa tena kaɡboŋ la laa, kɛ nɛra lafa ɡboo dɛ́ berɛ ba.
Bwɛɛ bɛl ɡe kpɔ laa tena lafa la, kɛ ba nɛra fi ɡboo dɛ́ berɛ ba.” Korowii ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ ba n be, ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu.
He bɛ Bɛtel la ka tom mɛ, he bɛ Gelɡal la, he bɛ Beɛseeba ɡba la.
Kasinteŋ, baa lawɛ Gelɡal tena laa taa kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta, ásɛ Bɛtel paɡre kwaraa.” Emɔs ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ ba Korowii be dɛ́ dɔ he nyu, ɡɛ laa aa, wɛɛ ba he Israel tena nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nii, dɛ́ ba fuh heya, dɛ́ fuh Bɛtel tena ɡe, nomɛlbwa aa wola won dima.
He berɛ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ sie, dɛ tɔ waa aa toɡra ŋwɛnɛ.
Korowiirii ta Baŋɡaana ne weweela bwa so siwi, dɛ berɛ ɡel bɔr ɛɛ beɡre, dɛ ɡel bɔr bir dɛɛ chaah, bɔr chaah dɛɛ bir.
Dɛ ta mpo o ba bɔle harɛ ta.
O sɔne Korowii.
Onee dɛɛ chɔɡ ba dekpeɡa, dɛ ɡel bwɛjen baa ma danjwɛɛ baro ɛɛ berɛ dimɡbia.
Hé hah nomɛlbwa waa wola nyosone teŋe, dɛɛ bol kasinteŋ kɔɔto dea.
He fiiɡi nyaara dɛ ɛɡre ba dɛɛ lɛ mea.
Anomanta, haa deene haa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa maa la binii so, kɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ sen nyɔ le he daa kodɛɛɡa haa para la ta.
N jemɛ ɡɛ he wechɔɡa aa kana, dɛ jemɛ wedoŋa bwa haa ɛa.
He ɛɡre nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, dɛ ɡel baa yawɛ heyaa sen, haa nyaara waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta kɔɔto.
Anomanta, nɛn waa jemɛ waa la tɔ nyoa, a ɡɛ wechɔɡa saŋ nɔ waa aa do ɡɛ nɔ ta.
Hé nyin wedɛɛɡa, dɛ́ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ dɔ he nyu.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ja he nɛ, ɡɛ haa bol o waa la.
Hé hah wechɔɡa, dɛ́ nyin wedɛɛɡa, hé ɡel kasinteŋ ɛɛ ɛ toma kɔɔto deene.
Nemenɛ Korowii ken ɛɛ sune Josef dea nɛra baa kaa nɛɛ.” Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Nɛra ɛɛ wi fɔɡbaahnaa, ásɛ lokua wii do bela nɛra aa dɛ cheme bwa.
Baa yerɛ paara bwaa cheme ba wi tɛ nɛra baa serewa, dɛ́ ka kpɔ nɛra bá ba wi.
Nɛra ɛɛ wi daa kooni ta bwaa.
Gɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ bao, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ba ba tɛr he deŋne.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii Tɔpere waa lea cheɡ Emɔs ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o na tɔpere Korowii aa dɛ ba ba bol nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole la, ó bwɛɛlɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin he na Korowii Tɔpere waa lea cheɡ laɔ?
Biro ɡboo awola, bɔr aa o ta chaahna ba.
Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ chwa nyujente dɛ ka cheme sisire ken.
Aa doo kɛŋɔ nɛn aa jo o dea dɛ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ danjwɛɛ ta, asɛ harɛkon domɔ.
Korowii Tɔpere waa lea cheɡ la, biro kpirkpir ɡboo, wee aa lee do kwara, dɛ́ chaah bɔr.” Korowii ŋɔ, “N hah he tɔpejena haa dɛ di la, n sie aa a ta lɛ kwaraa.
A lole kɛŋɔ he kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah ne mea sarahare baa tɛ mɛ, maa an lɛ.
He kpɔ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare baa tɛ mɛ te, n sie aa a taa lɛ.
Hé kpɔ he ɡbɔɡa yela le n nɛ.
Maa he janjela yela nyin dɛ́ no.
Kɛ, hé ɡel kasinteŋ do le saŋ bɛlbwa, kɛŋɔ moo aa dɛ palɛ, waa aa toɡra ɡe do kɛŋɔ nenabɔɔ waa wola hweeh bwa.
Israel tena, n ta sarahare ne kwaa lɛɛ le he be bene fifraanaarɛ haa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta.
Hé dɛ tomɛ voɡ Sakut haa ɛo kooro, ne Kaiwan haa ɛo kɛŋɔ wewee.
Hɛɛ che ɡɛ voɡa nɔɔ, ɡɛ saŋ maa lawɛ heyaa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta, Damaskɔs baŋ le la.
Men Korowii Maa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.”
Israel harɛ chɔɡa wa Saayɔn tena haa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa aa heyaa ha, ne Samaria Bwejen dor tena haa dɛ lii kɛ he soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta la, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
Nomonjena haa dɛ tɔ Israel harɛ waa sie, Israel tena ɛɛ ba he be hɛɛ cha ba la bwa, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
Hé la bwɛjen Kalne ka na, dɛ́ le bela la bwɛjen Hamat, dɛ́ berɛ kaa Filisti tena bwɛjen Gat.
Ba ɡwaa he harɛre anɛ nɔ naa?
Ba harɛ la kan ɡwaa he kon aa?
Haa lii kɛŋɔ tɔpechɔɡe bɛl dɛ ba, kɛ he we-ɛɛla ɡbo ɛɛ ɡeloo ó ba warane.
Mpare baa ɛa dɛ kpɔ bala nyena mɛɛ a taa hɛɛ chɔ, dɛɛ yale he kanedɛɛɡa ta.
Hé kpoo pebiiri aa wera, ne nabali aa do bwara dɛɛ chwe.
Hé dɛ nyin yela kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid ken, dɛɛ lɔa he janjelare ne.
He dɛ nyɔ numojena ne sen, dɛ kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma aa wera dɛɛ ɛ he te, kɛ haa chɔɡa Israel aa dɛ ba chɔɡa te waa wi.
Anomanta, hɛɛ ja nɛra baa tɔ sie dɛ́ laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛre ta la nɛɛ, ásɛ kwaa haa dia dɛɛ lɛ sie, ne he waa bwa ba a jaɡa.
Korowii hah mbarafo Israel tena aa dɛ ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii, Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ŋwɛɛ o ɡbaɡba ŋɔ, “N hah mbarafo Israel tena aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ ki ba dekpeɡa baa soɡe a bini.
Mɛɛ kpɔ bwɛjen la ne komɛlbwa waa lɔ o taa do ba dɔma nɔn ta.” Baala fi ka dembeŋkpoŋ ta kwaraa naa, ba ɡe ɛɛ serewoo.
Nɛra baa serewa la lole bɛl ɛɛ bao, dɛ́ ba pa lala la le dem bela, dɛ́ bɔɔ nomɛlbwa waa ka dem bela ŋɔ, “Nomɛl ta lɔ he be bonɔ kɛɛ?” Ásɛ taa bɛl chaŋe ŋɔ “Ɔɔhɔh!” Ásɛ lole la ŋɔ, “Hel!
Ya nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ Korowii sɔn yerɛ.” Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ ba taɡɛ demjena ne demjeɡre bwa ɡooɡe aa, baa taɡɛ a bwaa ɡooɡe, á paɡre buruburu ken.
Jaɡre won bwea dor chwae yaa?
Nɛn ɛɛ kpɔ nae ka parɛ bela aa?
Kɛ he ɡelɔ kasinteŋ do kɛ tɛɡchɔɡa, asɛ waa aa toɡra berɛ do kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa ken.
He dɛ maŋkura he te kɛŋɔ haa kaa yo lɛ Lo Debar dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya cheɡɛ ya bokpeɡa ta dɛ ka yo lɛ Kanaim.” Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ ŋɔ, “Israel tena, mɛɛ ɡeloo harɛ bɛl nɛra ba yo heya, dɛ́ ba fiiɡi heyaa le Lebo Hamat ŋwɛnɛ weekaŋle nyundua, dɛ́ ba weekaŋle harɛbɔr Jɔɔdan Moo ta.”
Wepila aa ɛ tontombɛ wa Nemenɛ Korowii ɡelɔ men Emɔs na waane wepila ta.
N nao kɛŋɔ waa dɛ boa tontombɛ nyoa, ɡɛ saŋ dɛ ba teŋe kpɔɡa ba kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ kooro jaɡre tonɛ, kpɔɡa pa mun dɛɛ moɡɛ, asɛ nɛra pa mun dɛɛ du konfala.
Tontombɛ la balɔ, dɛ ba chɔɡ konlwɛɛ te bɛlbwa harɛ la ta, asɛ n ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, ɡel kɛ he nɛra!
Ɛrɛɛ he nɛra ɛɛ ba wona so nɔ?
Ba nɔn ta kao!” Anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “Maa ɡela ba a chiɡ kpa.” Nemenɛ Korowii ɡelɔ n na waane wepila ta ja.
N nao kɛŋɔ waa kpɔ nii dɛɛ ba ba fuh harɛ la, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛr o nɛra deŋne.
Nii la fuoh dɛ hweeh viljena bwa, dɛ fuh dɛɛ ba ba chɔɡ harɛ ɡe.
Belaa n ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii, n dɛ soŋe, ɡel!
Ɛrɛɛ he nɛra ɛɛ ba wona so nɔ?
Ba nɔn ta kao!” Anomanta, Nemenɛ Korowii ɡelɔ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Maa ɡela ba a chiɡ kpa.” Korowii ɡelɔ men Emɔs na waane wepila ta ja.
Dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ danjwɛɛ bɛl baa mao jwɛh, dɛ kpoŋe ŋwɛn baa kpɔa dɛɛ toɡre danjwɛ.
Korowii bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Emɔs, bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ?” Asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛn baa kpɔa dɛɛ toɡre danjwɛɛ.” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ, “N kpɔɔ dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ n nɛra do kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ waa ɡola.
Maa ba deŋnetɛraa kpɔ kɛ ba kpa.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ bɔra Aesek naanar aa ka dɛ tomɛ bwaa, ásɛ Israel harɛ bɔra aa do ɡoroŋ ɡe chɔɡ, dɛ́ ka yo Kooro Jɛroboam dem nɛra laa.” Emɔs ne sɔfo Amasea Belaa sɔfo Amasea waa lɔ Bɛtel la kpɔ kala tɛ Israel Kooro Jɛroboam ŋɔ, “Emɔs dɛ vɔrɔwe he vɔrɔwa Israel harɛ ta bonɔ.
O waa waa dɛ bol la ɡwaalɔ to.
Waa Emɔs aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Baa kpo Kooro Jɛroboam laa taa, ásɛ ba lawɛ Israel tena laa ta kaa, ba le ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.’ ” Belaa Amasea ŋɔ Emɔs be ŋɔ, “Korowii keame, ir kaa Juda harɛ ta kaa bol Korowii waa la, dɛ́ so bela baa bɔe a kem.
Bɛ Korowii waa la bol Bɛtel bonɔ kpa, dɛkalkɛ bonɔɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ne kooro bwa ba dɛ baa tomɛ.” Emɔs chaŋo ŋɔ, “N ta Korowii keame ɛɛ, kɛɛ dɛ ɛ Korowii keame bie.
Dɛ peteɡree men, asɛ n berɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi fiɡ daa ta.
Kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ n ɡel peera teɡa, dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń ba bol o waa la baɡle o nɛra Israel tena.
Hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be.
He ŋɔ, ‘Bɛ Korowii waa la bol, ɡel waa aa dɛ ba Israel tena nɛɛ bala la waa bola.
Ásɛ dɛ ɡel waa bola dɛ́ yaɡɛ Aesek dea tena.’ Anomanta, waa Korowii aa dɛ bol sɔfo Amasea be laanee nɔ.
‘He haah ɛɛ valɛ bwɛjen nɔ taa dɛɛ bɔ jwamane.
Baa kpoo he bibaala ne bihaahna laa taa.
Baa lɛ he harɛ peraa, dɛ́ bɔne tɛ nɛra, ásɛ he ka sewɛ voɡtoroma harɛ ta.
Kasinteŋ, baa lawɛ Israel tena laa taa le ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.’ ”
Wɛɡrɛ bɛl ne daa nɔna aa bea wa Nemenɛ Korowii berɔ ɡel men Emɔs na waane wepila ta ja.
N na wɛɡrɛ bɛl daa nɔna aa bea do o bini.
Asɛ o bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ na nɔ?” N chaŋe ŋɔ, “N na wɛɡrɛ daa nɔna aa bea do o bini.” Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “N nɛra Israel tena tɔpere telo kɛ n tɛr ba deŋne, maa ba bwaraa kpɔ kɛ ba kpa.
Awola tɔpere la, yela baa ɡo n Dea la ɛɛ berɛ wii.
Nɛra ɛɛ serewoo kohona chɔ bobɛlbwa, ásɛ bɔr hel.” Israel tena bwɛɛlɛ Hé no, he nɛra haa dɛ fiiɡi nyaara dɛɛ chɔɡ nɛŋɡwɛɡra harɛ la ta, dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo Korobifala Tɔpejena dii ɛɛ ba a jaɡa bala ásɛ ya yoɡ mea ɔ?
Saŋ besoo Ona Tɔpere ɡe ba kaa ásɛ ya ka yawɛ kwa ɔ?
Ásɛ ya kpɔ kwaa aa wola chɛ kɛ ya kpɔ maɡɛ kwa, dɛ́ dawɛ a yoɡ, dɛ́ faah nɛra a maɡa ta, dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa aa wola naŋɡawa ɡba yoɡ tele yawɛ nyaara yoma, dɛ́ kpɔ yoɡ dawɛ mea ta.” Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, “Maa ba waa baa ɛa bɛlbwaa soh bwa.
Harɛ la ɛɛ jiɡruu a waa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa soɡe harɛ la ta di suna.
Harɛ la dɛ́ ba dɛɛ beɡre kɛŋɔ Nael Moo yon su, ásɛ dɛ berɛ hweeh ka chɔ o buɡ ta la ken.” Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo bɔr jo webaŋa ásɛ bobɛlbwa bir.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he Tɔpejena dii berɛ lwe, ásɛ he yela ɡoe berɛ wii.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he bwa tɔ lweyale dɛ́ fonɛ he nyuune.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo awola do kɛŋɔ nomɛl aa dɛ wi o bibambeŋkpoŋ la, dɛ́ ɛ tɔpechɔɡe ka tonɛ.
Tɔpera ane dɛ ba, ásɛ men Nemenɛ Korowii ɡel lɔr chole harɛ nɔ ta.
Kondikwaa kɛɛ nyɔɡre laa, men Korowii waa la bɛ dɔe dɛ́ no la waa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Nɛra ɛɛ ɡaaɡoo le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ́ ba kaa weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ne wee leebɔr dɛ́ ba kaa wee cholibɔr, dɛɛ nyin Korowii waa la dɛ́ no, kɛ baa dɔ no.
Awola tɔpere la, toli ne bonɔɔna ba bwara aa kpeɡa sie ɛɛ bir baa bá choɡli, nyɔɡre wa.
Banɔ la baa dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ Samaria voɡa, kɛɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ Dan dea voɡ, kɛɛ voɡ waa lɔ Beɛseeba bwa dɛ́ ba choɡla, baa wola won ir kpa.”
Israel harɛ chɔɡa wa N na Korowii kɛŋɔ waa cheɡɛ kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la jwɛh, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kpɔ kon lɔ pilare la doa ásɛ Dea la doonyoa danjwɛɛre yiiɡi.
Ásɛ a peri kuuɡi le nyundua ba le nɛra la nɛɛ ba serewe.
Ba bini banɔ la baa ka la, mɛɛ kpoo ba laa taa.
Ba bɛlbwa aa won le, beŋkpoŋ ɡba aa bɔree dɔ chwa.
Hale ba kwi bɔɔ ka le lalabwɛɛ kwaraa naa, mɛɛ ta nɔnee laɡ ba.
Ba teehnɔ ir kaa nyundua ɡe kwaraa naa, mɛɛ le ba ne belaa ba harɛ.
Ba chwao ka sɔh Kaamɛl Bwejen doa aa, mɛɛ nyin ba bɔree, dɛ́ laɡ ba.
Ba chwao le n sie ka sɔh mpo bini naa, mɛɛ ɡeloo mpo bini oljen laɡ ba chwe.
A lole kɛŋɔ ba dɔma laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpoo ba laa ta.
N siwi swɛɛ ba nɛ, ba wedɛɛɡa te waa laa, ba kpoora waa.” Korowii, onee Koranar Bwa Kooro, onee kpɔ nɔn leɡe harɛ wɛɛ mwɛɛ, asɛ nɛra baa lɔ o ta bwa ɛɛ wi.
Harɛ la bwa ɛɛ beɡre kɛŋɔ Nael Moo yon su, dɛ́ berɛ hweeh ka chɔ o buɡ ta la.
Korowii ma o dobɔr o do nyundua, dɛ ta nyundua o bɔle harɛ bwa ta, dɛ ɡel mpo ba bɔle harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
O sɔne Korowii.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Israel tena, n dɛ nyin he waa kɛŋɔ maa dɛ nyin Itiopia tena waa la.
Gɛ maa lawɛ he Israel tena le Ijipt harɛ ta la, ɡɛɛ n lawɛ Filisti tena le ekwi harɛ Kret ta, dɛ lawɛ Siiria tena le Kir.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Men Nemenɛ Korowii, n dɛ nyiŋi Israel harɛ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ.
Mɛɛ chɔɡoo le harɛ nɔ ta, kɛ maa Jekɔb naanaree chɔɡ kwaraa.
Mɛɛ bol waa ásɛ dɛ yiiɡi Israel tena harɛre nɛra bwa bini, kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɡboo boyu beŋkpoŋ ɡba aa wola harɛ le la.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa lɔ n nɛra bini bwa, baa kpoo ba laa taa.
Banee dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Korowii aa ɡel wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ba ya nɛ.’ ” Israel kwaara dɛ́ vɔrɔwe wa Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ n berɛ kwaa cheɡ Kooro Devid kora waa ɡua la.
Mɛɛ kwaaroo vɔrɔwe bɔra aa paɡra ne dimɡbeeni bwa, dɛ́ kwaa maa a do ɡɛ a fa aa doa wubwa la, Israel tena ɛɛ ka yo nɛra baa ka Edom harɛ taa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ harɛre ta nɛra ba fa aa ɛ n nɛra la jemɛ kɛ menee ɡela a ba ɡɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpera la dɛ ba, ásɛ nɛn waa dɛ parɛ tɔ nɛn waa dɛ komɛ sie, onɔ la waa dɛ du ɡe tɔ nɛn waa dɛ tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna sie.
Senfala ɛɛ koruu le bwejena dor dɛ́ palɛ kpɔ deŋɡarere ta.
Mɛɛ berɔ ba n nɛra Israel tena baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta la nee, bá ba kwaa vɔrɔwe dimɡbeeni dɛ́ so a bini.
Baa parɛ daa koonii, dɛ́ nyɔ a sen, dɛ́ parɛ bodɛɛɡa, dɛ́ di kondikwa baa parɛ la.
Mɛɛ lawɛ Israel tenaa ba so ba ɡbaɡba harɛ ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola won ba doŋ ba le harɛ maa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la ta.
Men Korowii haa dɛ tom mɛ laanee bola.”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Obadia fa liiro ŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa won le Korowii nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole nyoa.
Tɔpebeŋkpoŋii wɛɛ ba ɡela bɛlbwa na kasinteŋ la.
Edom harɛ baa ɛ Esɔ naanar ɛ Juda harɛ baa ɛ Jekɔb naanar dɔm.
Babelɔn laa tena aa lɔa ka tɔ Jerusalam tena nɛɛ la, Edom tena sie lɛo dɛ cha ba.
Babelɔn tena jo bwɛjen la bini, dɛ pa kondɔɔh kohona kaa.
Obadia ŋɔ tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao, ásɛ Edom tena ne Korowii nɛra dɔma bane chɔɡ, ásɛ harɛ la ɛ Korowii kon.
Waa aa dɛ ba Edom harɛ ta chiɡa Nemenɛ Korowii kpɔ baɡle Obadia laanee nɔ.
Ya noɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa bol Edom harɛ wa.
O tomɛ o torome bɛl harɛre nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hé ir, ya kpɔ ya te ka pu Edom tena yo.” Korowii ŋɔ Edom tena be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo he ɡwɛɡre harɛre nɛra bwa bini, ásɛ ba hah heya, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyubaahna.
He mbarafo neɡre heya.
He soɡe bɔɔne bini bwejena dor, dɛ yon ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ won ba n ne harɛ nɔ?’ A lole kɛ he soŋnibɔr lɔ nyundua, kɛŋɔ kee yon ka sɔh o kɔr nyundujaɡla la, kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo he le bela ba harɛ.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Ŋwɛɛra dɛ ba jwaana aa, anɔ la baa dɛ nyin ɡboo baa kpɔ.
Nɛra dɛ pa daa nɔna aa, ba dɛ ɡel beŋkpoŋa ane.
Kɛ he Edom tena te, he dɔma kpoo he bwa.
He Esɔ naanar, he dɔma pa he kondɔɔh haa kpɔa sɔh bwa kaa.
Nɛra he ne baa fɔwɛ fɔo ɛɛ le he ne he harɛ taa.
Baa neɡre heyaa, dɛ́ pɔ he nɛ.
Daamanar he ne baa pɛ nɔn di kwaa ɛɛ harɛ heyaa belii haa wola jemɛ.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ tɛr Edom wejerema deŋnee, nɛra baa dɛ no waa mun dɛ so bwejaŋa dor bwaa mɛɛ ba chɔɡa.
Bwɛjen Teman laa tena bwa ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ kohona.
Baa kpoo ba bwaa Edom harɛ la taa.
Edom tena, haa cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta kpoo he lolanar baa ɛ Jekɔb naanar nomanta, chɔɡaa hɛɛ ba chɔɡa, dɛ́ di ncho saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Awola Jekɔb naanar dɔma aa lɔa ka tɔ Jerusalam tena nɛɛ la, he Edom tena cheɡɔ nyiŋi ba pa ba kondɔɔh bɔne dɔŋa.
He ɡe ɛ nɛnchɔɡa kɛ ban.
A fe ta chɛɛ kɛ he sie lɛ he lolanar baa lɔ Juda harɛ wenaale wa.
A ta chɛɛ kɛ he hɛɡre ba chɔɡa wa, kɛɛ dɛ mam ba ba sibeɡra tɔpere wee.
A ta chɛ kɛ he jo n nɛra be bwɛjen la ta he sie lɛ ba wenaale wa, dɛ́ kpɔ kpeɡri pa ba kondɔɔh kaa ba chɔɡa tɔpere wee.
A ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he ka che ŋwɛnɛ chɛchɛre ta lawɛ banɔ la baa dɔ bɔr chwa le dɛɛ kaa la.
A ta chɛ kɛ he kpɔ ba ka do ba dɔma nɔn ta ba sibeɡra tɔpere wee.
Tɔpere men Korowii aa kpɔ bol harɛre ta nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la telo tonɛ.
Gɛ haa ɛa nɔɔ mɛɛ ba kpɔa ɛ he Edom tena ɡe, he we-ɛɛla bwa ɛɛ ɡure he nyu taa.
N ɡelɔ n nɛra nyɔ n danana nee Saayɔn Bwejen waa do ɡoroŋ ta.
Kɛ harɛre aa bara cheme nɔ nɛra ɡe ɛɛ nyɔ danana nee á ɡwaa a nɔ ka tel saŋ baa serewe.
Kɛ Jekɔb dea bii bane ɛɛ dɔ ba nyuu Saayɔn Bwejen la ta, ásɛ o ɛ bɔr waa do ɡoroŋ, bá berɛ dɔ harɛ waa ɛ ba kapɛrɛ kon wubwa la.
Jekɔb ne Josef nɛra ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nii, dɛ́ chɔɡ Esɔ dea bii ɡɛ nii yon dɛɛ fuh haahra la.
Esɔ naanar bini bɛlbwa aa kae ba.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Nɛra baa soɡa bɛne Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ɛɛ ba so Edom harɛ bwejaŋa doree, ásɛ banɔ la baa le deŋɡarere lɔɡre ba lɛ Filisti tena harɛ so.
Israel tena ɛɛ ba so Efrem ne Samaria harɛre taa, ásɛ Bɛnjamen dea bii ɡe ba lɛ Gelead harɛ so.
Israel laa tena baa chwaa ka so Keenan harɛ ɛɛ berɔɔ ba lɛ Foniisia harɛ, dɛ́ kpoŋe ka le Sarefat, dɛ́ so o ta, ásɛ banɔ la ɡe baa le Jerusalam dɛ do Sɛfarad la ka lɛ bwɛɛre aa lɔ Nɛɡɛv, dɛ́ so a ta.
Jerusalam baala baa yoa dɛ le la ɛɛ ka yo Edom tenaa, dɛ́ kpɔ harɛ la dɛɛ nyiŋi o ta.
Asɛ Korowii ɡbabir ɛ ba kooro.”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Korowii keame Jona tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle waa aa puu ɡɛ saŋ waa vɛh Korowii nyoa wa.
Dɛ Jona aa nyin ó ka bol Korowii waa la Niniwe tena be, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ Israel tena dɔma, dɛɛ lii kɛ dɛ ba charɛ ba liire dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta naa, Korowii aa ba deŋnee tɛr.
A bwa habɔɔ, waa laŋa dɛ ka bol waa la ba be la, ba charɛ ba liire dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta kpela, asɛ Korowii laa deŋnetɛra la kpɔ ba nɛ.
Aa ba ɡɛ la, Jona soɡo dɛ naɡre Korowii wa.
Korowii baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ harɛre nɛra bwa waa hiaoh, dɛɛ nyin kɛ bɛlbwa charɛ liire dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ berɛ ba o be, dɛ́ ɡwaa kɛ waa tɛr ba deŋne.
O ɛ Korowii waa dɔ nyina dɛɛ sune nɛn nɛ, dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa too o tea.
Jona ɛ Korowii deŋnekpeɡ Baa bɛl fa lole baa yerɔ Jona, o mɛɛ sɔne Amitai.
Awola bɛl, Korowii ŋɔ Jona be ŋɔ, “Le he harɛ ta, dɛ́ la bwɛjen Niniwe ta, dɛ́ ka di ba kasinteŋ ŋɔ ba wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ la le n mee.” Anee Jona vɛh Korowii toma waa dɛ tomɔ Niniwe la, dɛ chwa dɛɛ kaa Taases.
Anomanta, o la Jopa, bela stiimaere aa dɛ chuɡe, asɛ dɛ ka dɔ bɛl waa dɛ kaa Taases.
O bɔ o suuɡa dɛ jo dɛ fe ɛɛ kaa Taases ásɛ Korowii bɛ on na.
Anee Korowii ɡel peujen bɛl ta mpo la ta.
Peu la nyoa kpeɡri kohona, dɛ ir nehɛma baa lɔ dɛɛ beɡre nee la, stiimae la fe ɛɛ ba pera.
Aa ba ɡɛ la, ɔmee lawɛ nɛra baa lɔ stiimae la bini bwa, asɛ bɛlbwa wi dɛɛ yerɛ o voɡ waa dɛ tomɛ.
Ba pa laala aa lɔ stiimae la bini la dɛɛ ta nee ta, ásɛ o do fɛɡre.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa aa dɛ chiɡ la, jaah dɛ Jona te lɔ stiimae la lɔɡa bobɛl, dɛ te chɔ dom kwaraa.
Nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi stiimae la ta la, la Jona be dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ o chɔ dom kwaraa.
Asɛ o chumu dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔree he te dɔ dɛ chɔ aa?
Ir, dɛ́ wi yerɛ he voɡ haa dɛ tomɔ, o ken ɛɛ na ya sumii, dɛ́ lɛ yaa le waa nɔ nyoa, ásɛ ya dɔ ya nyu.” Asɛ nɛra la bwa baa lɔ stiimae la bini la ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ ɡel ya bil daa, dɛ́ na naate aa cheɡɛ o nɛɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ba ya nɛɛ nɔ.” Ba bil daa la, asɛ a lawɛ Jona.
Anee ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Baɡle nɛn aa cheɡɛ o nɛɛ wekpeɡa nɔ ba ya nɛɛ nɔ.” Ba berɔ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Tombesoo hɛɛ ɛɔ?
Bwɛ besoo taa he leɔ?
Harɛ besoo ta nɛnee hen ɔ?
Wobobesoo tee hen ɔ?” Asɛ Jona ŋɔ, “Hibru tee men, Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua waa ta nyundua ne harɛ ne mpo laanee mɛɛ tomɛ.” Ate, dɛ ɔmee tenten lawɛ nɛra la bwa.
Asɛ ba berɛ bɔɔro ja ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?” dɛkalkɛŋɔ, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ Korowii tomɔ asɛ o vɛh dɛɛ chwa.
Dɛ nae peu la nyoa na dɛɛ do kpeɡri mpo la ta kwara.
Asɛ ba bɔɔ Jona ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yá ɛ peu nɔ ɡel tae ásɛ nee nɔ nyoa sɔɔh tɛ yaa ɔ?” Belaa o ŋɔ, “Hé ɡɔɔ mɛ ta nee ta, o nyoa ɛɛ sɔɔhnoo.
N ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ n nɛɛ a che ɡɛ peukpeɡ nɔ ɛɛ ta nɔ.” Ba ne o ɡɔɔra dɛ ta nee ta la, ba takapɔ kɛŋɔ ba kaa stiimae la ne ka chuɡe baŋ, kɛ ba ta wone, dɛkalkɛ dɛ nae peu la ne mpo nehɛma la na dɛɛ do kpeɡri kohona ɡwaa wubwa la kwara.
Belaa ba wi yerɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, anɔ bwa haa ɡela a chiɡ nɔ ɛ he tetoora.
Ya dɛ soŋe, yaa dɛ ba baa nɔ kpɔe dɛ́ viɡri mpo ta nɔ, bɛ yaa ba kpoo.” Ate, ba ɡɔɔ Jona viɡri nee ta ken tuuu.
Buɡ la ta, mpo la hel kerker ken.
Asɛ ɔmee lawɛ nɛra la bwa kohona Korowii wa, ba kpo kwaa ɛ saraha tɛo, dɛ baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ baa tomɔɔ.
Dɛ Korowii te le pɛŋejen bɛl ó ba kpɔ Jona lile, asɛ o do o tea bini tɔpebire atoro, chɔɔ ne jwaana.
Jona wesoŋa Jona aa lɔ pɛŋe la tea bini la, o soŋe Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la.
O ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, maa lɔ wekpeɡa ta dɛ do lɔŋɔ tɛɛ la, he no n wesoŋa.
Maa lɔ lalabwɛɛ dɛ do lɔŋɔ tɛɛ la, he no n wii.
He ɡɔɔ mɛ viɡri mpo vil ta, n chɔ nee bini, wɛɛ kile n ne, asɛ nehɛma bwa bɔle n nɛ.
N liiro kɛ he doŋ mɛ le he sie, dɛ ŋɔ maa he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ laanee na kpa.
Nee bɔle n nɛ, n hweera pi, n do vil bini, asɛ mpo bini kpɔɡa laa n nyu bwa.
N sirimo ka chɔ bwejena lɔɡre, a do kɛŋɔ baa huɡ mɛ maa wola bɔree dɔ le dɛ́ dɔ n nyu.
Kɛ n Naa Korowii le n ne seo ta.
N naa Korowii, maa naa kɛŋɔ n fe dɛ ba sewa la, n lii he wa, n siwi swɛɛ he soŋa ta, a tel he be, he Dea waa do ɡoroŋ la ta.
Nɛra baa daŋre voɡsale toma ne, ba siwi ɛɛ sua la, ba paŋɛ chae he fe aa cha ba la.
Kɛ n te, mɛɛ jaame yel nee, anee dɛɛ ba saraha ɛɛ.
Nyoo maa baɡa bwa, mɛɛ chuɡraa.
Korowiirii dɛɛ lɛ nɛwɛnyini.” Belaa Korowii bol waa pɛŋe la be, asɛ o ka uɡe Jona ta nee la nyoa.
Jona Niniwe laŋa Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Jona be ja ŋɔ, “Ir kaa bwɛjen Niniwe, dɛ́ ka bol waa n fa aa bol he be la bela tena be.” Ate, Jona ta vɛɛh kpa, dɛ ir kpɔ waa la kaa Niniwe.
Bwɛjen la kan taeh.
Tɔpera atoroo nɛn ɛɛ ba wona valɛ dɛ ɡaaɡe bwɛɛ la bini bwa.
Jona jo bwɛjen la bini dɛ valɛ tɔpebir.
Waa waa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, “Bonɔ tɔpera fifraanaarɛ Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ Niniwee.” Niniwe tena la aa no waa la la, ba yarada Korowii dɛ ŋɔ, nomoa oo, bechala oo, bɛlbwa vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ́ kpɔ lweyal tɔ á baɡle kɛ ba charɛ ba liire dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta.
Hale bwɛɛ la kooro aa no o bwɛɛ la chɔɡa waa la, o fuɡro ir o kookara ta, dɛ wur o yal waa tɔɔ la ta, dɛ kpɔ lweyal tɔ dɛ ka so tɔɔ ta.
Asɛ ba lɔ dawuro bwɛɛ la bwa ŋɔ, “Kooro ne o nomonome ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa bɛ kwaa di, o bɛ nee nyɔ, o bɛ o kondɛɛra kɛŋɔ nae ne peera dɛ boohna ya ta á ka di, kɛɛ á ka nyɔ ne.
Nomɛlbwa tɔ lweyal, ásɛ dɛ pee ane do o kondɛɛra ɡe.
Bɛlbwa ɡel o wechɔɡa ne dachɔɡe waa lɔ a ta, dɛ́ wi dɛɛ yerɛ Korowii.
O baah ken ɛɛ sɔɔhnoo, ásɛ o dɔ tedoma tɛ yaa, dɛ́ charɛ o liire le o bandia waa dɛ ba kpɔe ba chɔɡ yaa la ta, ásɛ ya bɛ serewe.’ ” Belaa Korowii aa naa kɛ ba charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre ta la, o tea domɛ ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel chɔɡa waa ŋɔa wɛɛ chɔɡ baa la.
Jona bandia ne Korowii tedoma A ɡɛ waa nɔ ta Jona som doe kwaraa.
O baah diu asɛ o soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, waa maa lɔ n bwɛɛ dɛ bol la laa nɔ naa?
A waa n fee chwa dɛɛ kaa Taases la.
N jemɔ kɛ he dɛ na nɛn sum, he tea dɛ domɛ nɛn nɛ, he baah aa di warawara.
Nɛnnyin ɡboo he bwa.
He won he liire chara dɛ́ le nɛwɛnyina deŋne tɛra ta.
N Naa Korowii, n poori den kpo mɛ.
N sewɔ bɔ n be kɛŋɔ maa soɡe le.” Belaa Korowii ŋɔ, “He ɡe dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ he baah di waa nɔ ta naa?” Ate, Jona le Niniwe bela dɛ kaa o wee leebɔr, dɛ ka do kuku, dɛ so o lɔɡa dɛɛ nyiŋi waa aa pu Niniwe tena.
Belaa Korowii ɡel juɡ bɛl o papooni aa paɡa le, dɛ tɔ Jona nɛɛ dɛ tɛo chunchule, asɛ o bwara sɔɔhno kohona.
Aa ba ɡɛ la, o sie lɛo.
Tɔɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Korowii ɡelɔ dudul bɛl ba chwe juɡ waa ɡela o le dɛɛ tɛ Jona chunchule la, o sewɛ.
Wee aa baa baŋɛ la, Korowii ɡelɔ peuwɔb bɛl ta le wee leebɔr, wee ɡe do nyɛɡre dɛɛ lɔ Jona nɛɛ kohona, o fe ɛɛ ba sewa dɛ ŋɔ, “N sewɔ bɔ kɛŋɔ maa soɡe le.” Anee Korowii ŋɔ Jona be ŋɔ, “He dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ he baah di juɡ nɔ wa aa?” Ate, Jona ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh.
N baah diu kohona kɛŋɔ n sewɛ kwara.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Juɡ nɔ, jwaana beŋkpoŋii o le, he ta o ta koɛh, he laa ɡela o kpeɡ, dɛ o sewɔ jwaana beŋkpoŋ aa, ɡɛɛ o waa ɛɛ we he nɛ aa?
Aah ɛrɛ waa Niniwe o nɛra aa ɡwaa kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanɛ, baa wola wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa baah jemɛ, ba kondɛɛra ɡe aa wola nyoa dɔe nɔ, ba waa aa wola n nɛɛ weɔ?”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Maeka ne Korowii keame Aesaya bwa soɡe Juda harɛ ta saŋ beŋkpoŋ ta.
Maeka baɡle Juda harɛ tena ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, ɡɛ tenten waa tɛr Samaria waa lɔ Israel weekaŋle nyundua harɛ tena deŋne la.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, dɛkalkɛ ba we-ɛɛla bwa doŋo, baa kasinteŋ ɡe kpɔe dɛɛ bol waa aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Maeka berɔ baɡle ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ Korowii nɛra dɔ kerekere hwɛɡa, ɡɛ saŋ harɛre nɛra bwa aa so deŋnesɔɔhna ne bosɔɔhna ta la.
Nyiŋi nyu :-.
O berɔ bol nomonjen bɛl waa le Kooro Devid luɡe ta dɛ́ ba nyiŋi o nɛra nɛɛ wa.
Nyiŋi nyu :-.
Baa bɛl sɔne Maeka dɛ le Mɔresɛt.
Korowii pili waane aa dɛ ba bwɛjena Samaria ne Jerusalam chiɡa baɡlo.
Dɛ ɡɛ saŋee Juda koranar bane baa dɛ yer ba Jotam ne Ahas dɛ Hɛsɛkea di kora teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ Juda harɛ ta.
Hé no, nɛra haa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa, ne komɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta.
Nemenɛ Korowii le o Dea waa do ɡoroŋ nyundua dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba bol waa bɔ heya.
Korowii bol Samaria ne Jerusalam chɔɡa wa Hé na!
Korowii le o dobɔr waa do ɡoroŋ, dɛ tu baa valɛ bwejena dor.
Asɛ bwejena bwa mwɛɛ o lɔɡa, kɛŋɔ tohkel aa chɔŋɛ nii ta, dɛ palɛ dɛɛ jo fɛlembɔjena bini kɛŋɔ bɔchuubu ken.
Israel tena baa ɛ Jekɔb naanar wechɔɡa baa ɛ Korowii waa a bwa ba ɡɛ.
Bamewaa ɡela Israel tena ɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɔ?
Samaria koobwɛɛ nɛra laa aa?
Bamewaa dɛ́ di bolchɔɡe voɡa baa dɛ tomɛ Juda harɛ ta waɔ?
Jerusalam tenaa.
Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo Samaria berɛ dimɡbia, baa parɛ ɡrepo daa koonii, dɛ́ kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen bela, dɛ́ taɡɛ o danjwɛɛ bwea bwa ka do fɛlembɔjen ta, ásɛ o mumpar bwea bwa chɔ baŋ.
Samaria tena voɡa bwa ɛɛ paɡroo burbur ken, ásɛ nii fuh saraha kwaa bwa aa lɔ bela.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ ba voɡa bwaa.
Baa lɛ kwaa haahna aa bɔ jwamane dɛ dɔ, dɛ boa a nyoa nomanta, ba dɔma ɛɛ paa ka tɛ jwamane tena bane ɡe bobɛl.” Wii ne suna dii Men Maeka ŋɔ, “Anɔ nomanta mɛɛ wiu dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre, á baɡle kɛ n dɛ di suna.
Mɛɛ valɛ nakpapɛɛ ne mumɡbalee, dɛ́ si kɛŋɔ kalampoŋa, dɛɛ si kɛŋɔ kwiu ken.
Baa do Samaria tena bolaa baa wola won chah, Juda tena ɡe dɛ ba a dɔŋa nae.
A tel bwɛjen Jerusalam doonyojen tenten bela n nɛra aa soɡa.” He bɛ a waa bol baɡle ya dɔma Gat tena, hé bɛ wi kwaraa ɡe.
Hé ɡbili bomboɡ ta Bɛt Ofra, á baɡle kɛ he bambile chɔɡɔ.
Safir tena, hé valɛ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta mumɡbal ne sihiih ne.
Bwɛjen Saanan tena ɡe, hé bɛ lii ŋɔ hɛɛ le o taa.
He baa no kɛŋɔ Bɛt Ɛsɛl tena dɛ wi aa, he jemɛ kɛŋɔ he ta sɔɔhbɔr ba be bela dɔe.
Marɔt tena, he lɔ bonyɛɡa ta, dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ he dɔ bosɔɔhna, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ chɔɡa ba ta he nɛ, hale a tel bwɛjen Jerusalam doonyojen tonɛ.
Lakes tena ɡe, hé vɔrɔwe kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore pɛl jaɡre.
He chaa Israel tena wechɔɡa baa ɛa, a che a ta Jerusalam tena ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa.
Juda harɛ tena, hé kal Mɔresɛt Gat tena dɛ́ le bwɛɛ la ta, Israel koranar aa chae bɛlbwaa dɔ le Aksib tena be.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo dɔm ba yo he nɛra haa lɔ Maresa, dɛ́ pɔ he nɛ.
Ásɛ Israel nomonome chwa ka sɔh Adulam bwebɔɔ bini.
Juda tena, hé fonɛ he nyuune, á baɡle kɛ he dɛ di suna, dɛ́ wi tɛ he bii haa dɛ nyin ba la.
Hé paa he nyuune, á do kɛŋɔ kɔkɔsaki nyu, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa laɡ baa le he be kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Gɛ nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi nyaara wa aa dɛ ba doe Nɛra baa dɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa, dɛ chɔ ba chɔɔbɔra dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wedoŋa la, bá bwɛɛlɛ.
Tɔɔ perɔ chɔɔ aa, dɛ ba ɛ ba wechɔɡa la, dɛkalkɛ kpeɡri baa dɔa nomanta, bɛlbwa aa won tɔ ba ŋwɛnɛ.
Ba dɛ nyin nɛra kooni kɛɛ deene aa, ba dɛ lɛa kpeɡri ne.
Ba won nɛra deremi, kɛɛ ba kapɛrɛ kwaa ɡe lɛɛ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta.
Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “N dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛ ń kpɔ wahala ba ta he nɛ, haa wola won chwa dɛ le a nyoa.
Wenaale la dɛ ba he nɛɛ ɡwaala kohona, haa wola won valɛ dɛɛ ɡu kpa.
Awola tɔpere la, ɡɛ wiile aa teŋa nɔɔ, baa ba kpɔe muɡli he baah ŋɔ, ‘Ya na waa kɛrɛdɛ.
Korowii ɡelɔ ba lɛ ya harɛ, dɛ kpɔ yaa tɛ nɛnchɔɡa.’ ” Anomanta, bɛlbwa toole Korowii nɛra bini dɛ́ dɔ harɛ la le bie tae bini.
Keame nyosonteŋna Ba keamere ŋɔ, “He bɛ Korowii waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere la bol.
Hɛ́ɛ berɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ bola, sihiih bɛlbwa aa won di yaa.” Israel tena, a chɛ kɛ ya ŋɔ, “Korowii Doma baah di ya nɛɛ kɛɛ?
Wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔɔ yaa?” Nomɛlbwa o wa aa toɡra la Korowii swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo.
Korowii ŋɔ, “A ta biɡre n nɛra ɛ deŋnekpeɡ n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ n dɔma.
Hé lɛ laaladɛɛɡa le nɛra baa teŋa baa kaa, wobɛlbwa aa wola ban hiaih be, ba do kɛ baala baa le laa ta dɛɛ ba ken.
He dɛ doŋi n nɛra haahna dɛɛ le ba deremi aa wera ta.
He laa wedɛɛɡa maa sweera tɛ ba bii saŋ bɛlbwa la dɛɛ kpɔ.
Hé ir dɛ kaa, bonɔ ta bɔr haa so onɛ ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɡelɔ harɛ la kah doŋa.
O chɔɡɔ baa wola won kwaaro kpa.
Nɛra nɔ dɛ nyin keame waa teŋe nyosone ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo sene bwa soo siwi bu he nyɔ dɛ́ dɛɛ.’ Lɛɛ nyobaɡa Israel tena, mɛɛ boa he bwa nyoa, kasinteŋ, mɛɛ boa he nɛra haa kaa la bwa nyoaa.
Mɛɛ boa he nyoa kɛŋɔ peera yon pɛ do leɡ ta, kɛɛ kondɛɛra yon warɛ do dibɔr la.
Gɛ tentenee mɛɛ ba ɡela nɛra su harɛ la ta kohona.” Korowiirii dɛ́ pili ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ba dɛ́ le bojaŋ harɛfale baa kaa bane la ta.
Baa kuuɡi bwɛjen la doonyojena laanee dɛ́ le kaa.
Korowii waa ɛ ba kooro laanee dɛ́ tɔ ba sie.
Maeka kaeh waa kah Israel nomonome Asɛ men Maeka berɛ ŋɔ, “Israel nomonome, ne sitɔɔla haa lɔ Israel, hé no.
Heyaa chɛ kɛ hé jemɛ waa aa toɡra dɛ do wer, he hah waa aa wera dɛɛ nyin wechɔɡa, he dɛ pee n nɛra ola ne ba bɔtɔne kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa.
He dɛ chwe ba ola dɛɛ swe ba bɔtɔne, dɛ chɛwɛ ba hoɡa jeɡrejeɡre, kɛŋɔ ba yon chɛwɛ ola do vii bini la ken.” Saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao nomonome nɔ wi yerɛ Korowii kɛ waa ban chaŋe, waa ba wesoŋaa no wechɔɡa baa ɛa la wa.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ.
“Keame nyosonteŋna ɡelɔ n nɛra nyoɡre, ba dɔ komɛl dɛ́ le nɛra be dɛ di aa, ba soŋe deŋnesɔɔhna dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Ba ta komɛlbwa dɔe le ba be tenaa, ba dɛ kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ka yoo ba laa.
Anomanta, keame nyosonteŋna, a dɛ ba doe kɛŋɔ bɔr aa joa ta he nɛ, haa won dɛɛ na chaahna kɛɛ dɛɛ voɡɛ ɡe kpa.
Nɛra baa dɛ na waa chaahna ta, ne voɡra bwa dɛ ba sihiih dii.
Ba bwa ɛɛ kpɔ nɔɔraa tɔ sie, dɛkalkɛ Korowii aa ban chaŋe.” Kɛ n te, Korowii ɡelɔ o Doma ba so n nɛ, asɛ n dɔ kasinteŋ ne kpeɡri dɛ́ bol Israel tena wechɔɡa wa.
Hé no, Israel sitɔɔla, he hah waa aa toɡra, dɛɛ berɛ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ sie.
Nɛŋkpoa ne kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe taa he che dɛɛ ma Korowii bwɛjen Jerusalam.
Jerusalam sitɔɔla sɛoh baa yaɡ ba sen, sɔfore bol Korowii waa dɛɛ lɛ suuɡa, keamere ɡe baɡle waa baa naa chaahna ta dɛɛ lɛ suuɡa.
Kɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii nɛɛ ya kpɔ ya te dawɛ, yaa wenaale bɛlbwaa na.” He nomanta, Saayɔn ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ koo baa parɔ dɛ du kwaa o ta ken, Jerusalam bwa ɛɛ kuuɡuu dɛ́ chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ Korowii Bwejen Dea aa chɔŋɛ o ta la berɛ kɔr.
Korowii Kora dii harɛ nɔ ta bwa deŋnesɔɔhna ne Tɔpera ane dɛ ba, ásɛ Korowii Bwejen Dea aa chɔŋɛ o ta la do jaŋne ɡwaa bwejena bwa.
Wɛɛ kpeɡuu ɡwaa deŋɡarere bwa, ásɛ nɛra warɛ le harɛre ta dɛɛ ba o ta.
Harɛre nɛra ɡalɡa ɛɛ bao dɛ́ ba ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya kaa Korowii Bwejen la ta, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la Dea.
Wɛɛ chaɡle yaa o ŋwɛnɛree, ásɛ ya won dɛɛ kpɔ a ta.” Korowii Mmara ɛɛ le Saayɔn Bwejen taa, ásɛ o kpɔ bol waa o nɛra be Jerusalam.
Wɛɛ bol harɛre nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ kwaa harɛre nɛra baa kpeɡa baah.
Baa beɡre ba kerii a ɛ para, dɛ́ beɡre ba lampeare ɡe ɡoori.
Harɛre nɛra aa dɔŋaa yo, a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ baa hweli laa waa kpa.
Bɛlbwa ɛɛ so deŋnesɔɔhna taa, asɛ daa kooni ne fiɡ daa kooni baro cheme, nomɛlbwa aa wola won ba aah ba kpa.
Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.
Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡaree, kɛ ya te, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ waa taa yaa ba teŋa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii liire waa dɔa Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ n boa nɛra maa tɛr ba deŋne nyoa, nɛra maa ɡela ba laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfala ta la.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo boobie ka, dɛ́ le nɛra baa doŋ ba le harɛfale ta ba la, berɛ warɛ kohona dɛ́ do kpeɡri.
Men Korowii ɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ le awola, ne saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la Saayɔn Bwejen waa lɔ Jerusalam.” Kɛ hen Saayɔn Bwejen haa lɔ Jerusalam, belaa Korowii do kɛ peteɡre dɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛra nɛ, hɛɛ berɔɔ ba ɛ bwɛjen nyu tenten, ɡɛ he fa aa doa wubwa la.
Bɔkwa waa bala hɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre nɔɔ?
He ta kooro dɔe kpa kɛɛ?
Nɛn waa bol waa dɛɛ ja heyaa sewɔ, a kpɔ weweele ta he nɛɛ hɛɛ pɛmɛ kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ waa?
Jerusalam tena, hé ɡbaɡre dɛ́ɛ pɛmɛ kohona, kɛŋɔ haah loltea aa lɔɔ.
A chɛ kɛ he le bwɛjen nɔ ta, dɛ́ ka so kpɔɡ bini.
A chɛ kɛ he dɔma lawɛ heya kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn, ásɛ mɔɔ Korowii ba lɛ heyaa le ba nɔn ta.
Taraken, harɛre nɛra pɛ nyoa dɛ́ ba yo heya.
Ba ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ Jerusalam paɡre dɛ́ berɛ dimɡbia, ásɛ ya sie lɛ a wa.” Kɛ baa Korowii liire jemɛ, baa jemɛ kɛŋɔ o boa ba nyoa dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne, kɛŋɔ ba yon boa mea nyoa dɛɛ ba a lɔe la.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Jerusalam tena, hé ir ka yo he dɔma, mɛɛ ɡeloo he do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nabal waa dɔ bune nyeɡlare, o nafikokore ɡe do kɛŋɔ ayaawa ken.
Hɛɛ yo harɛre ɡalɡa nɛraa, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ kondɔɔh baa yo nɛra dɛ lɛa la, ba tɛ men Korowii maa ɛ harɛ nɔ bwa dɔɔ la.”
Korowii baɡɛ kooro bɛl nyoa dɛ le Bɛtlɛham Jerusalam tena, hé boa he laa tena nyoa, laa tena chɔɔ bar bwɛjen la dɛ́ ba yo yaa.
Baa kpɔ daa lɔ Israel kooro kaŋe sihiih kpoo o jirima tonɛ.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Juda harɛ bwɛjeɡa Bɛtlɛham, Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bini bwɛsala laa hen, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he taa kooro ɛɛ ba lee, dɛ́ nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛ.” Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ vɛh o nɛra Israel tenaa tɛ ba dɔma, ka tel kɛŋɔ haah la loltea aa lɔɔ aa lolɛ o bie.
Israel tena baa lɔ bojaŋ harɛfale ta ɛɛ berɔ ba ja ba bala Israel tena nɛ.
O balaa, wɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛra nɛɛ kɛ peteɡre, Korowii kpeɡri ne o sɔn waa kana ne, ásɛ o nɛra bwara sɔɔh ba.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ na kan Korowii aa doa ɡɛ saŋ.
Onee dɛ́ ba tɛɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna.
Lɛɛ ne deŋnetɛra wa Dɛ Asiiria tena baa yo ya harɛ, dɛ won jo ya dekpeɡa yaa sɔh a bini ta naa, yaa le nomonome baa wara kohonaa bá ka yoo ba.
Nomonome la ɛɛ ka yo Asiiria tena baa ɛ Nimrod harɛ ta tena laalee, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Baa lɛ yaa le Asiiria laa tena nɔn taa awola baa ba che ya nɛɛ dɛ́ valɛ kaa ya harɛ jwɛhre ta la.
Israel tena baa ɛ Jekɔb naanar baa ka la ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ mɛn aa le Korowii be, dɛ koo harɛre nɛra bini, kɛŋɔ bwaala aa wir kpɔɡa ta, aa wola nɛn siwi ta nyiŋi mɔɔ la.
Banɔ la baa kaa dɛ peɡre ka do harɛre ta la, ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ nyujente aa lɔ kpɔɡ bini, dɛɛ kpaah ola kɛɛ peera dɛ́ pee a ola, baa wola lɛɛ dɔ.
Gɛɛ he Israel tena ɛɛ ba yoi, dɛ́ pɔ he dɔma nɛ, ásɛ dɛ chɔɡ ba kwaraa.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ chɔɡ jaɡre haa dɛ la ane laa, ne kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore ba vɔwɛ dɛɛ pɛla bwa.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ he harɛ bwɛjenaa, dɛ́ kuuɡi he dekpeɡa ɡe bwa.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ he voɡra ne sɔm we-ɛɛla bwaa, ásɛ haa won dɛɛ voɡɛ kpa.
Mɛɛ berɔɔ chɔɡ voɡa haa sɛah, ne bwea haa paaɡa dɛɛ duura bwaa, ásɛ haa kwaa he ɡbabir aa kwaara laanee tomɛ kpa.
Mɛɛ fuɡri voɡhaah Asera dajaŋaa le he bini, dɛ́ paɡre he bwɛjena.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n bandia kohonaa ba ta harɛre nɛra baa wola n waa ta teŋɛ la nɛɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.”
Korowii ne Israel tena dɔe wa Israel tena, hé no waa Korowii aa dɛ bol.
“Hé ir, dɛ́ kpɔ he waa ka bil bwejena ne deŋɡarere sie.
Bwejena ne kwaa bwa haa le saŋ la bwa do le dɛ lawɛ harɛ kpoŋe ɡe, hé no.
Korowii ne o nɛra Israel tena dɔɔ, wɛɛ ba ba waa bola dɛ́ pa bole.
N nɛra Israel tena, bɔkwa waa n ɛ heya ɔ?
N ɛ heyaa waane dɛ jo he nɛɛ kɛɛ?
Hé chaŋ mɛ.
He fa ɛ yoma Ijipt harɛ ta, asɛ n lawɛ heyaa le bela.
N tomɛ Mosis ne Arɔn dɛ Miriam, bá ba tɔ he sie.
N nɛra, hé lii wechɔɡa Moab Kooro Balak fa aa vɔrɔwa, asɛ Beɔ bibaa Balam chaŋo la wa.
Hé berɛ lii ŋwɛnɛ haa vala le Sitim dɛ ba Gelɡal, dɛ́ na ŋwɛnɛre maa cheɡɛ a ta lɛ heya.” Bɔkwaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe ba Korowii waa dɛ di kora nyundua sie ba tomɔ wɔ?
Ń kpɔ nabiiri aa di benanyoa ba fuah ɛ saraha o sie naa?
Ń kpɔ pebala kaɡboŋa ne ɔleve noo aa wara dɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ moo ba tɛ Korowii aa?
O sie ɛɛ lɛ n nɛɛ yaa?
Kɛɛ ń lawɛ n biloɡle, ba bɔ n wechɔɡa maa ɛa kem ɔ?
Akai, waa aa weraa Korowii chaɡle yaa, wáa waa dɛ nyin dɛ́ le ya be laanee kɛŋɔ, ya di kasinteŋ dɛɛ sune dɔŋa nɛ, dɛ́ pwɛr ya te tɛo.
Israel tena bolchɔɡe dii ne deŋnetɛra wa A ɛ wejemwa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii.
O dɛ yerɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen Jerusalam ŋɔ, “Hé no, he nɛra haa baa cheme bwɛjen la bini!
Mɛɛ won soh he nyubinikpeɡ tena kondɔɔh haa cheɡa ka su deene, ne kwaa haa kpɔa maɡɛ kwaa dɛɛ faah nɛra n haah la wa aa?
Mɛɛ won kpɔ nɛra baa maɡɛ kwaa dɛɛ faah nɛra bwara kɛ ba aa?
He nɛra haa dɔ suuɡa dɛɛ ɛɡre nyaara, nyosonteŋna ɡe ɡboo he bwa.
Anomanta, n pa mun dɛ́ chɔɡ heya, he wechɔɡa haa ɛa la wa.
Hɛɛ di kwaa kɛ haa vaɡɛ, a do kɛ he ta komɛlbwa dii.
Hɛɛ dɛɛ cheɡ kwaa, kɛ aa le he nɔn taa, dɛkalkɛ men Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba chea laa ta kaa.
Hɛɛ du koo kwaa kɛ haa komɛlbwaa na komɛ, hɛɛ harame ɔleveree dɛ dɔ a no, kɛ haa dɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa, dɛ harame ɡrepo nɔna ɛ sen, haa dɔ nyɔ.
He teŋɛ Kooro Omri mmarare, ne o bibaa Kooro Ahab dem tena wedoŋa baa ɛa ta, ba we-ɛɛla la taa hɛɛ teŋɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa, ásɛ harɛre nɛra mamɛ heya.”
Israel tena suna dii N waa sum kohona!
N do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa ɡaaɡa dɛɛ nyin daa nɔna lɔmɔɡa saŋ, waa wola daa bɛlbwa nɔn waa ka o ta kɛɛ ɡrepo nɔna o daa ta nae dɛ́ di.
Ba tɔɔ ɡrepo nɔna, ne fiɡ daa nɔna aa soma la bwa.
Ba doŋi nɛra baa dɛ duu Korowii bwa le harɛ la ta, nomɛlbwa ta kae o waa toɡre kpa.
Nɛra bwa chɔɔ dɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ bá kpoo nɛra, bɛlbwa dɛ harɛ o dɔŋ bel dɛ́ dɔɔ lawɛ.
Ba bwa hweli wechɔɡa dɛ jema kɛrɛdɛ.
Nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole, ne ba nomonome bwa dɛ nyin kɛ baa yaɡ ba sen. Ba ne nɛnjena kpɔ wejema ŋwɛnɛ lɛ kwaa dɛɛ le ba be.
Ba bini nɛndɛɛɡe kwaraa do kɛŋɔ jabalnadaŋɛ.
Onɔ la o wa aa toɡra ɡe do kɛŋɔ sɔɔh daa ken.
Tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ Korowii tɛr ba deŋne ɡɛ waa cheɡɛ keamere baa dɛ daah ba nɛɛ kah ba la, ba wilo taraken kwara.
Dɛɛ berɛ he dɔŋ yaradae ka tonɛ, bɛ he dam ɡba nɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.
Hale he haah he ne waa pɛa dɛɛ chɔ kalaŋ ta, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyoa wobol ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Bibaa ne o mɛɛ ɛɛ dɔmoo, bihaah ne o nya dɔm, ásɛ bihaah ne o helahaah ɡe dɔm, ásɛ nɛn lolanar berɛ o dɔma.
Kɛ n te, n dɛ hwɛɡɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii ŋwɛnɛ.
Korowii waa ɛ n Lɛɛ laanee mɛɛ kpa, wɛɛ no n bee.
Israel ɛɛ iruu Ya dɔma, he bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ.
A lole kɛ ya cholo te, yaa iruu.
Ya lɔ biro ta te, Korowiirii dɛ́ do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah yaa bɔr.
Ya ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, anomanta, a chɛ kɛ yá na o bandia tama mɔɔ.
Wɛɛ lɛ yaa dɛ́ le chɔɡre baa kpɔa ɛ yaa la ta.
Wɛɛ lawɛ yaa ba bɔchaah ta, ásɛ ya na toɡra o wa aa toɡra.
Belaa ya dɔma ɛɛ ba a nae ásɛ sihiih kpo ba.
Banee fa muɡli ya baah ŋɔ, “Leperaa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔɔ tenɔ?” Yaa soo dɛ́ na ba chola, baa tiɡri ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ tiɡri kpechɛɡre ta ken fɔɡbaahna.
Jerusalam tena, tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ he berɛ kwaa ma he bwɛjen danjwɛɛre la, dɛ́ paɡri he harɛ jwɛhre kaa sie.
Awola tɔpere la, nɛra ɛɛ le Asiiria ne Ijipt bwɛjena taa ba, hale dɛ́ kpoŋe le Ijipt kaa Yufretis Moo wee leebɔr, dɛ́ berɛ le Ijipt kaa weekaŋle harɛ bɔr, dɛ́ le mpore ta harɛjaɡa ba kaa bwejena dor.
Kɛ harɛ bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, o nɛra we-ɛɛla wa, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ken.
Korowii suna waa sune Israel tena nɛ Ya Naa Korowii, nyiŋi he nɛra nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre aa dɛ nyiŋi peera, nɛra haa lee ba tɛ he te la.
Ya do kɛ peera aa pere a te, dɛ ka do kpɔɡbaah dɛɛ di.
Gel he nɛra ka do harɛpare ondɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ Basan ne Gelead ta, dɛɛ di kɛ saŋ la.
Gel ya na he nyokpowe-ɛɛla, ɡɛ haa ɛa dɛ fa le ya ne Ijipt harɛ ta ba la.
Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ nao sihiih kpo ba, ba kpeɡri bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Ba bwara ɛɛ yɔroo, bá kpɔ nɔɔra tɔ nyoo, dɛ́ tɔɔɡe ba deŋna.
Baa di teeraa kɛŋɔ harɛkon, kɛŋɔ kwaa aa dɛ tuuɡi tea ta ken.
Baa le ba dekpeɡa taa bochela ne ɔmee ne, dɛ́ berɛ ba hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ sie.
N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, nomɛlbwa ta do kɛŋɔ hen, he kpɔ he nɛra baa kaa wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ ba, he nɛra baa ɛ he kapɛrɛ nɛra la.
He baah diu waa, aa biɡri, he sie dɛ lɛ kɛ hɛɛ na ya sum.
Hɛɛ berɔɔ dɔ tedoma ya nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ naa tire ya wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ kpɔa ka ta mpo vile ta.
Hɛɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ ne he nyina aa wola jaɡa dɔe taa, dɛ́ sune Jekɔb ne Abraham naanar nɛ, ɡɛ haa baɡɛ ya naawa nyoa saŋ la.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Neehum bol Korowii waa aa dɛ baɡle Asiiria bwɛjen Niniwe wa.
Dɛ Asiiria tena la kpeɡri taeh, ba nyubini ɡe do kpeɡri, asɛ Netan bol wepila ane waa naa Niniwe chɔɡa wa.
O nao kɛŋɔ a ɛ Korowii deŋnetɛra waa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba nɛ.
Harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra aa won le Korowii deŋnetɛra la nyoa, dɛ ba kpeɡri kwaraa noo.
Korowii lawɛ bambile o bandia la ta, kɛ dɛ ba ta liire charɛ dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta naa, o deŋnetɛra la ɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ kpela.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
Waa aa chiɡ bwɛjen Niniwe, Korowii bol baɡle Neehum waa le Ɛlkɔs chaahna ta, asɛ o chwerɛ bil laanee nɔ.
Korowii baah di Niniwe tena nɛ Korowii dɛ mee, dɛ ɡel o dɔma wechɔɡa ɛɛ ɡure ba nɛ.
O baah dɛ di ba nɛɛ wɛɛ bɔ ba kem bwaawee ne, dɛɛ tɛr banɔ la baa haoh deŋne.
O teŋɔ kpɔ o bandia dɛɛ ta o dɔma nɛ.
Korowii baah aa di warawara, o dɔ kpeɡri kohona.
Waa wechɔɡ-ɛɛ bɛlbwaa ɡel dɛ o ta o deŋne tɛrɛ.
Bobɛlbwa Korowii aa dɛ valɛ la, belaa kawulewule ne dompeu ɛɛ ta, asɛ baama ɛ o nakpale tutuɡ.
O dɛ bol wa mpo hweeh, dɛ́ ɡel neerare bwa hweeh.
Basan harɛdɛɛɡe ne Kaamɛl Bwejen bwa dɛ hol, asɛ Lɛbanɔn daa fee bwa ɡe ɛɛ serewe.
Bwejena dɛ jiɡri o sie, deŋɡarere ɛɛ mwɛɛ.
Korowii leɔ dɛɛ ba naa, harɛ bwa ne nɛra baa lɔ o ta bwa dɛ chel.
O baah diu waa, umee dɛ́ won che a nyoa ɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won ba o sie o bandichɔɡe ta nɔ?
O baah diu kohona naa, a do kɛŋɔ baa fuɡe nii ta ken, bwea bwa dɛ peɡri burbur ken o sie.
Korowii wer, o kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra nɛɛ ba wenaale tɔpere, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ yaradao nɛ.
Kɛ Niniwe te, wɛɛ chɔɡoo kɛŋɔ nee waa sua dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa, ásɛ dɛ doŋi o dɔma ta biro ta.
Korowii vɔrɔwa bɛlbwa dɔma aa vɔrɔwa la, wɛɛ chɔɡ a bwaa, wekpeɡa bɛlbwa aa berɛ ba nɛɛtena kpa.
He sennyɔɔra, nii ɛɛ fuh heyaa kɛŋɔ sɔɔhne aa kaɡre dawii baah ken.
Niniwe, he taa nɛnchɔɡe le dɛɛ vɔrɔwe Korowii vɔrɔwa, dɛɛ baɡle nɛra wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre.
Anomanta, kenii Korowii ɛɛ bol o nɛra Juda tena be, “A lole kɛŋɔ Asiiria tena kpeɡri, dɛ warɛ dɛ dɔ nɛra bá ba cha ba, kɛ mɛɛ chɔɡ baa le harɛ nɔ ta bá he kwaraa.
Juda tena, menee ɡela he fa na wahala, kɛ maa berɛ ɡel he na ɡɛ kpa.
Mɛɛ teŋe kpeɡri Asiiria tena aa dɛ di he nɛɛ la taa, dɛ́ chaa jɔɡrɔre aa vɔrɔwe heyaa la.” Kenii Korowii bol he Asiiria tena waa bil, “Haa naanaree dɔ dɛ́ kpɔ he sɔna pa ba.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ voɡa haa sɛah daa nee, dɛ anɔ la haa loɡa a do he voɡa deene bini la.
Mɛɛ kwi he lalbɔɔ bil, dɛkalkɛ he waa ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe.” Hé ha sie nyiŋi bwejena dor!
Nɛn waa kpoŋe amanesoma dɛ valɛ bela, dɛɛ bol deŋnesɔɔhna wa.
Juda tena, hé di he tɔpejena la, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa haa baɡɛ Korowii nyoa la ba tɛo.
Nyubinikpeɡ tena aa heyaa ba yo he harɛ ta kpa.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ ba bwaa kwaraa.
Bwɛjen Niniwe chɔɡa wa Niniwe tena, nomɛl dɛ ba ba yo heya.
Hé daah he dekpeɡ la!
Hé ta sie ŋwɛnɛ ta!
Hé che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ kpɔ he te ka yo!
Korowii berɔ dɛɛ ba Jekɔb jirima kpɔe tɛo, kɛŋɔ waa kpɔ Israel tena jirima tɛɛ ba la.
A lole kɛŋɔ nɛnchɔɡa chɔɡ ba bwa, harɛ la chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ chɔɡ ɡrepo daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen bwa.
Kwaa Niniwe dɔma aa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta la swɛɛrɔ, laala baa doa ɡe swɛɛ.
Torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre nɛɛ dɛɛ la laa bune dɛ nyɛɡle, awola baa kpɔ ba te dɛɛ kaa laa la.
Ba ir ba lampeare nyundua dɛɛ aah ba.
Laa tena kpɔ torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre dɛɛ che a bini la chwa jo fɔɡbaahna, dɛ la dɛɛ ba fɔɡbaah bɛlbwa ta.
Ba do kɛ baa choŋi kapɛle ken, dɛ teŋe wɔrɔbe nɛɛ baa kaa, kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ nyɛɡle ken.
Niniwe laa nomoa le o laa tena baa kpeɡa, kɛ ba lɔ nakpale ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ ba.
Ba chwao dɛ ka marɛ bwɛjen la danjwɛ, dɛ kpɔ kon tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe.
Gbeni baa kpɔa tɔ nee la nyoa la pilo, asɛ koodem la bwa kuuɡi.
A chɛ kɛ Niniwe chɔ pɛɛ, ásɛ ba lawɛ o nɛra laa ta kaa.
O toli ɛɛ wiu kɛŋɔ kwehre ken, dɛɛ lɔ ba bambile á baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna.
Nɛra le Niniwe dɛɛ kaa kɛŋɔ nee aa pala le tam ta ken.
Ba bala dɛ yer ba ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel!
Hé ɡel!” Kɛ nomɛlbwa aa habɔɔ berɛ.
Hé pa ba suuɡapoŋa ne ba suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa.
Kondɔɔh su bwɛɛ la bwa, a ta nyoa dɔe.
Niniwe bwa chɔɡɔ, ba pa o kwaa bwa kwaraa, o chɔ pɛɛ.
Ɔmee su o nɛra bwa, ba natuune sɔɔh, ba bwara ɛɛ sa, ba siebɔra ɡwaŋre.
Bɔkwa waa pu bwɛɛ o fa aa do kɛŋɔ nyujentena sobɔr laɔ?
Niniwe tena fa aa lɔ ba bwɛɛ kɛŋɔ nyujente ombal ne onnee, dɛ so bela dɛɛ dɛ́ɛ a bii, a ne a biirii ba dɛɛ ka, aa wola komɛlbwa ɔmɛ.
Ba do kɛŋɔ nyujente aa kpo ol, dɛ peeɡe o bini tɛ o haah ne bii, dɛ che ol la su o bɔɔ bini.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “N cheɡɛ he nɛ.
Mɛɛ fuh torɔɡore haa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre laanee.
Baa kpoo he laa tena laa taa, dɛ́ pa laala haa paa le bane be la.
Baa he toroma taa no kpa bwa.”
Niniwe tena bwɛɛlɛ Bwɛjen nɛŋkpoa ne nyosonteŋna aa su o ta la tena bwɛɛlɛ.
Kondɔɔh su he bwa, he dɔma ɛɛ ba a pae kaa.
Hɛɛ no chweremi baa dɛ cha jaɡre, ne a torɔɡore baa vɔrɔwa pɛla nakpale sii, ne chwae jaɡre aa dɛ chwa kohona, dɛ kwaa baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la jaeh aa dɛ jah sii.
Laa tena soɡe jaɡre ta dɛɛ chwa dɛ́ ka yo, dɛɛ beɡre kerele fal fal, lampeare ɛɛ nyɛɡle al-al ken.
Nɛra serewɔ pirim, lala daŋɛ chɔ ba ta nyoa dɔe, nɛra ɛɛ laala.
A bwa cheɡɛ Niniwe tena baa do kɛ hanjwamane la pɛlchɔɡa ta.
Ba cheɡɛ voɡra nɛɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra pɛla do ba nɛ.
Ba kpɔ jwamane ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ lawɛ harɛre nɛra kɛrɛdɛ yoma, ne sɔm ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ lawɛ nɛra bane ɡe.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Niniwe, n cheɡɛ he nɛ.
Mɛɛ laa he yalee kpɔ he mun ta, dɛ́ ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa nae, ásɛ sihiih kpoe ba siwi ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔ doŋaa ta he nɛ, n siwi aa hen su, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra bwa kpɔ sie pa he nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa nae la ɛɛ le habɔɔ dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Niniwe chɔɡɔ kwaraa.
Umee dɛ́ wi tɛo wɔ?
Leperaa ń dɔ nɛn ó larawe o bwara ɔ?’ ” He ɡwaa bwɛjen Tebes waa chɔ Nael Moo nyoa nee bar o bwa la kɛɛ?
Nee laanee tɔɔ ɡbemɡbe, dɛ do kɛŋɔ danjwɛ.
Onee dɛɛ nyiŋi Itiopia ne Ijipt harɛre ta, o kpeɡri ta nyoa dɔe, Put ne Lebya harɛre nɛra bwa ɡe jao dɛɛ chao.
Kɛ ba wono ba yo he nɛra, dɛ laɡ ba kaa harɛfale bɛl ta.
Ba lawɛ bechale dɛ kpɔ ba cha harɛ ba bini toɡri chɔ fɔɡbaahna.
Ba lawɛ nomonjena dɛ bil daa ba nyuune ta, dɛ kpɔ jɔɡrɔre do sitɔɔla.
Gɛɛ he Niniwe tena ɡe ɛɛ ba dɛɛra dɛ́ chwa ka sɔh, dɛ́ nyin bɔr ka marɛ he dɔma bɛ heyaa na.
Dekpeɡa aa tɔ heyaa ɡbemɡbe la bwa do kɛŋɔ fiɡ daa aa nɔnɛ a nɔnloɡla, dɛ ba yiiɡi daa la aa, o nɔna yon ba lee naate waa dia la nyoa bini.
He laa tena bwa berɛ haahna.
He bwɛjena doonyoo pilo paɡri nɛɛ tɛ he dɔma, a doonyoo ɡbeni bwa fuoh.
Hé dɔ nee cheɡ kohona, tɔe baa dɛ ba ba tɔ heyaa do la wa.
Hé nyiŋi he dekpeɡa ta a do kpeɡri.
Hé ɡbɛr teera dɛ́ saa a lawɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ he te dɛ́ teŋe berekese.
Belaa nii ɛɛ ba heyaa fuih, ba kpoo heyaa laa ta, dɛ́ he heyaa kɛŋɔ tontombɛ yon di kwaa la.
Hé ɡel he nɛra warɛ kɛ hɔɔhre, kɛɛ tontombɛ.
He ɡelɔ he bonadiire warɛ dɛ ɡwaa weweela.
Kɛ ba do kɛŋɔ tontombɛ ken, dɛ́ chɔɡ harɛ kwaa bwa kwaraa dɛ́ ir kaa.
Nɛra baa dɛ daah heya, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma koodem bela la, ba do kɛŋɔ tontombɛ aa wura ba maɡre danjwɛɛre ta waa saŋ, dɛ wee baa le aa, a yon ir kaa la, nomɛlbwa aa wola bela aa ira kaa jemɛ.
Asiiria koojen, nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi he harɛ ta kɛ peteɡra la bwa chɔɔɡɔ.
He nomonjena bwa serewɔ.
He nɛra la bwa peɡrɔ dɛ do bwea dor, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ boa ba nyoa.
Komɛlbwa aa won ɡel he ŋwɛra tonɛ, bola baa do heyaa la ɛɛ kpoo heyaa.
Nomɛlbwa waa no he waa sie ɛɛ lɛo dɛ́ lɔ kpaŋa ta he nɛɛ a wa.
Umee wola he nyubinikpeɡ haa ɛa aa wola nyoa dɔe la nyoŋwaara nae ba nɔ?
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Habakuk sie ta Israel tena dɔma Babelɔn tena kpeɡri ne ba nyubinikpeɡ we-ɛɛla ta lɛɛ, asɛ dɛ bɔɔ Korowii a wa.
Dɛ o dɛ nyin o jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa Korowii aa wola ɡelɛ ba ɡel o nɛra ka yoi.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
Korowii baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ o deŋnetɛra la ken ɛɛ biɡruu mɔɔ dɛ ba, kɛ a chɛ kɛ nɛra la teŋɛ dɔ kasinteŋ.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
Tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao ásɛ nomɛlbwa na Korowii jirima kɛrɛdɛ.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
A bwa habɔɔ la, Habakuk ɛ yel ŋɔ, wobɛlbwa aa chiɡ la, wɛɛ yarada Korowiirii, ásɛ dɛɛ kpa ane bɛlbwa waa dɛ ba ɛɛ.
Waa Korowii aa pila baɡle o keame Habakuk chaahna ta laanee nɔ.
Habakuk wenaɡra “N Naa Korowii, kera aŋwɛnɛɛ ń yerɛ ŋɔ hé cha mɛ mɔɔ he no, kɛɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le naɡrenyine we-ɛɛla ta nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he ɡel mɛɛ na we-ɛɛla aa wola toɡrɛ ɡbo nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he laa sie kpɔ nɛra nɛɛ baa ɛ wechɔɡa nɔɔ?
Kwaa chɔɡa ne naɡrenyin we-ɛɛlaa chɔ n sie.
Yoi ne nyopɛo bɛ dɔe bar mɛ cheme.
Mmara bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ di nɛn, anomanta, kasinteŋ toole kpa.
Nɛnchɔɡa dɛ tɔ nɛndɛɛɡa ŋwɛnɛ, dɛɛ berɛ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ sie.” Waa Korowii aa chaŋa Ate, Korowii bol o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi harɛre nɛra baa bar heya cheme dɛ́ɛ pese ba.
Hɛ́ɛ na waane ba binii a ɛ heyaa nyokpoa kohona.
N dɛ ba waane ɛɛ he saŋ nɔ ta, háa wola lii kɛŋɔ aa bao.
Dɛ ba bol he be ka kwaraa naa, haa yarada.
N dɛ ba Babelɔn tena baa do ɔma, ba sie ɡe do kpeɡri, kpeɡri tɛɛ, ásɛ ba laa tena wur kaa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ́ ka yo nɛra dɛ́ lɛ ba sobɔra aa wola ba kwaa ɛɛ bwa dɔɔh.
Ba waa dɔ ɔmee ne hundam, ba ɡbaɡba mmara taa baa teŋɛ, baa nomɛlbwa waa no.
Ba jaɡre ɡbaŋre ɡwaa nonietena, dɛ do ɔma ɡwaa ɡboli lɔr aa dɛ kpoa jɔmɔra.
Ba nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta ɡe le bojaŋa, dɛ chwa kohona dɛɛ ba, kɛŋɔ kokosakire yon ir le nyundua ba harɛ baa di ol la.
Ba dɛ ba naa, naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla ɡboo lɔ ba sie ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa no ba bala waa la, dɛ ɔmee lawɔ.
Nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta la warɔ, kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.
Ba siwi aa koranar tɔɡɛ, dɛɛ ɛ nomonome sisawa.
Bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛɛre bara ɛ wesoma waa ba be.
Ba cheɡɛ teera do danjwɛɛre baa maa bar bwɛjena mune, dɛ che a ta teeh ka yoo ba dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Asɛ dɛ wur kaa kɛŋɔ peu yon ta dɛ kpɔ haahra kaa la.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ, ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ ba bokpeɡa ta kɛŋɔ nɛn aa kpɔ sie dawɛ o voɡ ta la.” Habakuk wenaɡra nɛɛtena N Naa Korowii, saŋ la bwa laa he le ɛ Korowii aa?
Henee Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, Korowii haa do ɡoroŋ la.
N Naa Korowii, he le Babelɔn tena, dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri ŋɔ bá ba tɛr ya deŋne, kɛ he do kɛ Bwetal dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ ya nɛ.
He do ɡoroŋ kohona, haa soɡee dɛɛ nyiŋi waa aa ɛ wechɔɡa.
Haa wechɔɡa nyin.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba nyoa tɔe, dɛ́ nyiŋi nɛnchɔɡa bá chɔɡ nɛra ba wechɔɡa aa wola doe kɛ ban ɔ?
He ɡelɔ nɛwɛnyina do kɛŋɔ mpo bini pɛŋa, ne mpo bini koŋkwaa aa wola nomoa dɔe wɛɛ nyiŋi a nɛ.
Ba dɔma Babelɔn tena kpɔ ɡoŋri dɛɛ laɡ ba kɛŋɔ pɛŋa ken, dɛ kpɔ dɔɔne tɛɡ ba dɛɛ le baŋ, asɛ ba sie lɛ baa hɛɡre a ta.
Anomanta, ba kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ ba dɔɔne, dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tɛa dɛɛ toma, dɛkalkɛ a ɡɛ kwaa laanee dɛɛ tɛɛ ba ba kondɛɛɡa, ne kondikondɛɛɡa tenten bwa.
Baa ɡeloo ba teŋɛ dɛ́ kpoo harɛre nɛra kɛŋɔ pɛŋa baa wola ba sumii na naa?
Mɛɛ iruu che n jɛŋla doa, dɛ́ nyiŋi dɛ́ no waa Korowii aa dɛ ba n be bola.
Dɛ o chaŋ mɛ naa, ń na ɡɛ maa dɛ ba o be bola.
Waa Korowii aa chaŋa Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Chwerɛ waa maa pili a bini baɡle chaahna ta la dawɛ bwepɛle ta, ɡɛ baa dɛ ba wona naa dɛ́ kure.
Tɔpere bɛl ta dɛ ba ásɛ waa maa pili a bini baɡle la tel.
A dɛ baɡle ɡɛ waa bwa jaɡa saŋ aa dɛ ba doe.
A ɛ kasinteŋ.
Hale a biɡro kwaraa naa, hé so kpaa.
Kasinteŋ, aa bao.
Aa biɡri bɛlbwa.
Wepila laanee nɔ, Babelɔn tena baa ɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena aa ba nyuu dɔ, kɛ naate o waa aa toɡra dɛɛ su Korowii siwi la, wɛɛ yaradao dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
Kondɔɔh neɡre Babelɔn tena dɛ ɡel ba nyoɡre.
Ba ɛ kafonyine, ba siwi aa kwaa su bwa.
Ba jenu dɛɛ ɛ sikpeɡ kɛŋɔ seo waa wola vaɡɛ bwa la.
A waa ba teŋɛ dɛɛ pɔ harɛre nɛra nɛ, dɛɛ laɡ ba laa ta.
Nɛra Babelɔn tena aa pɔ ba nɛɛ la ɛɛ mam baa dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Hé bwɛɛlɛ, kɛ haa cheɡ kwaa aa wola he kwaa ɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ nɛnfaah kwaa ɛ kondɔɔh nɔ.
Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ka jaɡɔɔ?’ Nɛra baa di he kema la dɛ ba ira kerabeŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ do heyaa sibeɡra he bwara ɛɛ sa.
A ba ɡɛ naa, baa pa he laala kpeɡri nee.
He pa harɛre nɛra kondɔɔh bwa, ɡɛɛ nɛra baa kaa la ɡe ɛɛ ba hé kondɔɔh pae.
Nɛra haa kpoora dɛ fuɡe ba chale ta kohona, ne chɔɡa haa chɔɡ harɛre ne bwɛɛre ne nɛra baa soɡe a ta la nomanta, ɡɛɛ baa ba he ɡe ɛɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta dɛɛ nyin kondɔɔh dɛ́ tɛ o nɛra, dɛɛ nyin bodɛɛɡe dɛ́ so, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won tel o be dɛ́ chɔɡo la, ó bwɛɛlɛ.
He vɔrɔwɔ dɛ chɔɡ harɛre nɛra kohona, dɛ ɡel sihiih kpo he ɡbaɡba dem tena, dɛ berɛ ba waane ba dawɛ he nɛ.
Bwea haa kpɔa ma dea la ɛɛ do lɔŋɔree kɛŋɔ nɛra ken, ásɛ doli haa kpɔa tɔɔ la ɡe sɛh.
Nomɛlbwa waa cheɡɛ nɛŋkpoa kɛɛ wechɔɡa ta dɛ vɔrɔwe bwɛjen la, ó bwɛɛlɛ.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛa kɛŋɔ harɛre nɛra toma baa ɛa dɛ koh la bwa dɛ ba fuih.
A bwa ɛ koeh pɛɛpɛɛ.
Gɛ nee aa su mpo ta la, ɡɛɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɛɛ ba Korowii kpeɡri ne o jirima kohona jema.
Babelɔn tena, he bwɛɛlɛ!
He tɛ he bala sen ba nyɔ dɛɛ, dɛ chɔ mumɡbal dɛ di sihiih.
Jirima he fe aa dɔ la ɛɛ berɛ sihiih.
He saŋ telo name, hé nyɔ dɛ́ chɔ mumɡbal!
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he ɡbaɡba nyɔ o danana nee aa su numol, ásɛ ncho dii tɔ jirima he fe aa dɔ la ta.
Gɛ haa teŋe Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta daa la, ɡɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba he ɡe chɔɡa.
Gɛ haa kpo kpɔɡ bini ola la, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ ba a waa nae.
He kpoo nɛra dɛ fuɡe ba chal ta harɛ la ta, he chɔɡ harɛre ne bwɛjena ne a nɛra bwa.
Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ voɡ nɛwɛnyini aa kpɔ nɔn sɛoh la dɔɔ?
O waa bwa ɛ nyosone.
Nɛn waa kwaaro la dɔ yarada o ta.
O dɛ kwaa voɡa aa wola won waa bol.
Nɛn waa ŋɔ dakpul be ŋɔ ó dɔ mkpa, kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ bwe waa wola hweera dɔe be ŋɔ ó ir la, ó bwɛɛlɛ!
Wɛɛ won baɡle wa aa?
Suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋee ba kpɔ fɔɡle o bwa, o ta hweera bɛlbwa dɔe.
Korowii lɔ o Dea waa do ɡoroŋ bini.
Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta, hé bwa hel o sie.”
Habakuk wesoŋa Korowii keame Habakuk waa waa soŋe Korowii nɔ.
N Naa Korowii, n no he waa haa ɛa la.
He we-ɛɛla nomanta, n cheɡɔ n bwara ɛɛ chel.
Berɛ ɛ a ɡɛ wejena la ya saŋ nɔ ta, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ya jemɛ a wa, ásɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa yaa ɛ he baah di la, hé sune ya nɛ.
N Naa Korowii, he le Teman harɛ ta ba.
He ɛ Korowii Haa Do Goroŋ dɛ le Paran Bwejen ta.
He jirima tɔ nyundua, asɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ kpɛɛre harɛ nɔ ta.
He wer do kɛŋɔ wee aa dɛ le chɔɔbɔr la.
He nɔmpaa bini dɛ nyɛɡle al-al ken, belaa he kpeɡri sɔh.
Weechɔɡa tɔ he sie, asɛ he ŋɔ seo be ŋɔ ó teŋɛ he nɛ.
He iro che asɛ harɛ jiɡri, he ta sie nyiŋi harɛre nɛra aa, dɛ ba dɛ chel.
Bwejena aa lole le saŋ la bwa kuuɡo, asɛ deŋɡarere a ɡe aa lole le saŋ la bwa ɡe bur.
He te ŋwɛnɛre ta jaɡa dɔe.
N na Kusan tena tɛnte deene bini baa ɔmɛ taeh, ɡɛɛ Midian tena ɡe bwara ɛɛ sa ba tɛnte deene bini.
N Naa Korowii, he baah di neerare nɛɛ kɛɛ?
He bandia lɔ nenabɔɔne nɛɛ kɛɛ?
Mpo nɛɛ he baah di, ɡɛ saŋ haa soɡe he jaɡre, ne torɔɡore baa vɔrɔwa pɛl a nɛɛ dɛɛ la ka yo nɛra dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ kɛɛ?
He harɛ he to kpa, dɛɛ nyin he ta he hɛma.
He kpɔ bwaala nyɛɡla pere harɛ bini.
Bwejena nae dɛɛ chel, asɛ bwaala nɛ, nee su dɛ palɛ baa kaa dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa, dɛɛ ta nehɛma kohona.
Wee ne korobie cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ nyundua, dɛkalkɛ he dɛ ta he hɛma ne he lampea, aa nyɛɡle al-al ken dɛ baa kaa.
He kpɔ bandia valɛ kpɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa, dɛ kpɔ bwaawee tɛr harɛ nɔ ta nɛra deŋne kɛŋɔ baa dɛ lɔ mea.
He leɔ ba kɛŋɔ he ba lɛ he nɛra, ne nɛn haa leo o ɛ kooro.
He chɔɡ harɛ baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa o ta nomoa, dɛ lɛ o kpeɡri bwa.
He hɛma yaɡɛ o laa sitɔɔ, ɡɛ saŋ o laa tena aa wura ba tɔ ya nɛɛ dɛ lɔ yaa peɡre la.
Ba sie lɛɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa sɔah dɛɛ fiiɡi nɛŋɡwɛɡra.
He kpɔ he jaɡre ka do mpo ta aa valɛ, dɛɛ vuuɡi nehɛma aa dɛ ta kohona la.
N noɔ asɛ n bambile teŋe, n nyoa kpo a ɡɛ ɡbɔɡa la wa, n bwara yɔrɔ, n nakpale bwa ɛɛ sa.
Kɛ n sɔɔh bwara dɛɛ kpa tɔpechɔɡe wee Korowii aa ba tɛr nɛra baa dɛ yo yaa deŋne.
Hale dɛ fiɡ daa ta feɛ, ɡrepo daa ɡe ta nɔnɛ, ɔleve daa ɡe vɛh nɔna, kondikwaa ta ɛɛ, peera toole leɡ bini, asɛ nae ɡe toole a leɡ ta naa, Korowii nomanta, mɛɛ hɛɡroo, n sie lɛ Korowii waa ɛ n Lɛɛ la nɛ.
Nemenɛ Korowiirii n kpeɡri, o ɡelɔ n nakpale do kɛŋɔ chwae kwaa ken, n won bwejena dor vala.
N chwerɛ waa nɔ ka tɛ yela nomoa ó kpɔ o janjela ne kwaa aa do ɡɛ la lɔa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Sefania kpɔ Korowii waa la Juda tena be, dɛ baɡ ba ŋɔ Korowii baah di ba ne harɛre nɛra nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba tomɛ voɡa dɛ vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa.
Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba, ásɛ Korowii kpɔ wenaale ba ta ba nɛ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, Sefania ŋɔ Korowii ta dɛ nyin o nɛra.
Tɔpebeŋkpoŋ wɛɛ berɔ ba kwaa vɔrɔwe Jerusalam, ásɛ nɛra baa soɡe bela pwɛr ba te dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta.
Waa Korowii aa kpɔa baɡle Sefania, ɡɛ saŋ Amɔn bibaa Josia aa di kora Juda harɛ ta laanee nɔ.
Sefania mɛɛ sɔne Kusi, asɛ Kusi mɛɛ sɔne Gedalia, Gedalia mɛɛ sɔne Amaria, asɛ Amaria ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Hɛsɛkea.
Korowii Tɔpere waa bol waa dɛ́ pa bole Korowii ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba komɛlbwa chɔɡa le harɛ nɔ ta.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ nɛwɛnyina ne ola bwaa, ne jumbii aa dɛ ɡah nyundua, ne mpo bini pɛŋa bwa.
Nɛnchɔɡa ɛɛ daŋɔɔ chɔ kɛŋɔ dea aa chola chɔ ken, dɛ́ chɔɡ nɛwɛnyina bwa, nomɛlbwa aa wola ka.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Mɛɛ tɛr Juda harɛ, ne nɛra baa soɡe Jerusalam la bwa deŋnee.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ voɡ Baal ne o komɛlbwaa kwaraa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa aa o kerekpoŋra la waa lii kpa.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ nɛra baa teehna kaa deene dor kaa tomɛ wee, ne korobie dɛ weweela, ne banɔ la baa ŋwɛɛra ŋɔ ba dɛ tom mɛ kɛ dɛ berɛ kaa tomɛ voɡ Molɛk ɡe ja laanee.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ banɔ la baa berɛ habɔɔ dɛ vɛh n nɛɛ teŋa, ne banɔ la baa wola n be ba ń baɡ ba waa laanee.
Bɛ́lbwa hel men Nemenɛ Korowii sie.
Tɔpere maa lea cheɡ dɛ́ bol n nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole la telo tonɛ.
N dɛ ba n nɛra Juda tena kpoora ɛ saraha, dɛ́ le ba dɔma bá ba yoo ba dɛ́ pa ba laala.
A ɡɛ Korowii saraha Tɔpere la, mɛɛ tɛr nomonome ne koobii dɛ nɛra baa kpɔ harɛfale bɛl nawee waa do ba te la deŋnee.
A ɡɛ tɔpere la, mɛɛ tɛr nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa deŋnee, ne banɔ la baa kpoo nɛra, dɛ ŋwɛ ba laala dɛ pa ka su ba voɡ baa dɛ tomɔ dea la ɡe deŋnee.
A ɡɛ tɔpere la, hɛɛ no wii le bwɛjen Jerusalam Pɛŋa Doonyoa bela, dɛ́ no wii le bwɛɛ la bwɛfala pera, ásɛ ɡbɔɡa kohona ɛɛ le deŋɡarere aa bɛne bwɛɛ la dor.
He nɛra haa soɡe bwɛɛ la yawa ta bɔr pera, hɛ́ɛ wi kohona, he bonadiire ne banɔ la baa dɛ peɡri suuɡapoŋa la bwa dɛ́ ba serewa.
A ɡɛ saŋ mɛɛ kpɔ kandeaa ɡaaɡe Jerusalam bwa, dɛ́ tɛr nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa ta ban hiaeh, ba nyu bini do ba som la deŋne, dɛɛ lii ŋɔ, ‘Wobɛlbwa aa ɛ wedɛɛɡa kɛɛ anchɔɡa la, Korowii waane laa.’ Ba dɔma ɛɛ pa ba kondɔɔh bwaa kaa, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba deene.
Baa ma deenee, kɛ baa a binii so, dɛ́ parɛ ɡrepo daa kooni, baa a nɔnaa dɔ ɛ sen nyɔ.” Korowii Tɔpejen waa lea cheɡ Korowii Tɔpejen waa lea cheɡ o do ɔma la telo tonɛ, o dɛ ba warawara, o pu yaa tonɛ.
A ɡɛ tɔpere la ɛɛ ɛ sibeɡraa taeh, banyoola ɛɛ do lɔŋɔre kohonaa.
A ɡɛ tɔpere la, Korowii bwaawee ɛɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ taeh, suna ne wenaale tɔperee, wahala nae ne chɔɡa ɡbosoroo, ásɛ baama tɔ, bɔr ɛ jumaa ken.
Bɔr dɛ ba bira kohona a ɡɛ tɔpere, wɛɛ ɛ laa bɛle hoeh tɔperee, ásɛ laa tena lɔŋɔre tɔ.
Baa yo bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, a dɔ dejaŋaa.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ a ɡɛ wenaale nɔɔ ba ta nɛra baa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo n nɛ, ásɛ baa laɡre bɔr kɛŋɔ nyoŋa ken.
Baa ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa nomanta, mɛɛ fuɡe ba chalee ta kɛŋɔ nee ken, ásɛ ba lala chɔ dɛ́ pɔh.” Korowii bwaawee Tɔpere la, ba suuɡaswɛm kɛɛ suuɡapoŋa aa won lɛɛ ba.
O bwaawee dɛ ba harɛ nɔ bwa fuih kɛŋɔ nii ken.
Nomɛlbwa waa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta waa ɛɛ ba a jaɡaa buɡ ta.
Liire chara wa He nɛra, haa wola sihiih jemɛ, hé boa nyoa dɛ́ charɛ he liire mɔɔ Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ o do ɔma, dɛ́ kpɔ heya kɛŋɔ peu aa taa dɛ́ kpɔ haahra kaa la tel, mɔɔ Korowii bandia saŋ la ba, ásɛ o bwaawee bɛ he nɛɛ ir kohona.
He nɛra haa pwɛr he te dɛ do harɛ nɔ ta, hé charɛ he liire dɛɛ no Korowii wa.
Hé ɡel he waa toɡre, dɛ́ ba he te ne harɛ o sie, o ken ɛɛ lɛ heyaa, waa wola he deŋnee tɛr kpa, awola o bwaawee aa ir nɛra nɛɛ la.
Filisti tena bolchɔɡe pae Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ chwao le Gasa, ásɛ Askɛlɔn chɔ pɛɛ.
Wee ne ŋɔ o ba che nyufala, dɛ Asdɔd tena bwa chwao le kaa, ásɛ Ekron tena bwa le kwaraa.
Filisti tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ.
He nɛra haa soɡe mpo nyoa bwa, Korowii dɔɔ vɔrɔwe he deŋnetɛra waa bil tonɛ, dɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ heyaa, beŋkpoŋ kwaraa aa wola ka.
He harɛ waa lɔ mpo nyoa la ɛɛ berɛ peera dibɔree, dɛ́ berɛ peera leɡ, peteɡra ɡe do ba patare o ta.
Juda tena baa ka la ɛɛ ka so belaa, ó berɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔr, ásɛ jɔmɔra telo aa, bá ka chɔ bwɛjen Askɛlɔn deene bini.
Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɛ́ nyiŋi ba nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba do wer, ɡɛ ba fa aa doa wubwa la.
Moab ne Amɔn bolchɔɡe pae Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N no chɛɡra ne bammuɡli wa Amɔn ne Moab tena aa dɛ ɛ n nɛra, dɛɛ aah ba ŋɔ baa lɛ ba harɛɛ.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooro Israel tena aa dɛ tom mɛ taa lole nɔ, n ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ, Moab dɛ ba chɔɡa kɛŋɔ bwɛjen Sodom, ásɛ Amɔn ɡe chɔɡ kɛŋɔ bwɛjen Gomoora ken.
Aa berɛ yar kwibɔraa, kpɔɡa le a ta, á chɔ pɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
N nɛra baa ka laanee dɛ́ pa ba laala, dɛ́ ka kpɔ ba harɛ la so.” Anɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ kembɔr tɛ Moab ne Amɔn tena, mbarafo ne chɛɡra dɛ bammuɡli waa baa kpɔa ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro nɛra la wa.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ɔmee kohona chole ba nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba voɡare aa lɔ harɛ la ta bwa.
Ásɛ harɛ bɛlbwa ta nɛra ɛɛ tomɔ, bɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛɛ tomɔɔ o ɡbaɡba harɛ taa.
Itiopia bolchɔɡe pae Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ kpoo Itiopia tena ɡe bwaa.
Asiiria bolchɔɡe pae Korowii ɛɛ che o kpeɡri taa, dɛ́ chɔɡ Asiiria harɛ, ásɛ o bwɛjen Niniwe chɔ pɛɛ, dɛ́ berɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, nee aa wola o taa do.
Peera ne nae dɛ ola bwa soo siwi ɛɛ kpɔ belaa berɛ a chɔɔbɔra.
Kwiure kpɔ o dimɡbeeni berɛ a sobɔra, a sii ɛɛ le a tokorore taa, ásɛ ɡaahɡaahre ɡe ɛɛ si a doonyoo.
Peleme daa baa kpɔa ɛ doli dawɛ deene la ta la bwa chɔ baŋ.
Gɛɛ bwɛjen o nɛra aa dɛ lii kɛ ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, wobɛlbwa aa ban ha la ɛɛ ba nae.
Ba yon ŋɔ, “Ya bwɛjen ɛ bwɛjen tenten, bwɛɛ bɛlbwa toole o habɔɔ kpa.” Hé na chɔɡa waa chɔɡa, ásɛ kpɔɡ bini ola kpɔ bela berɛ a chɔɔbɔra.
Nɛra báa teŋe baa kaa bwa ɛɛ mamɔɔ dɛɛ for nɔɔra.
Jerusalam kerekere wa Bwɛjen baa dɛ do ba nɛra hɔhɔrɔwa, dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa la, ó bwɛɛlɛ!
O nɛra ta Korowii be noɛ, ba ta sɛɛh dɛ teŋɛ toɡra waa toɡ ba la ta.
Ba ta ba te kpɔe dawɛ Korowii nɛ, kɛɛ dɛ soŋe chae le o be.
Bwɛjen la nomonome do kɛŋɔ nyujentena aa dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ken, o koranar ɡe do kɛŋɔ ɡboli aa lawɛ ol jɔmɔra, aa wola won haŋre dɛ́ ɡel hoɡ ɡba ka tɔɔ per o ta.
O keamere waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, ba dɔ mbarafo.
O sɔfore kpɔ doŋa dɛɛ kah kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ, dɛɛ ɡole Korowii Mmara ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin.
Korowii ta lɔ bwɛjen la bini, o waa toɡrɔ, waa wola wedoŋa nyin.
Tɔpere bɛlbwaa wɛɛ di o nɛra kasinteŋ, waa wola habɔɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa, kɛ ane a bwa, sihiih aa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa lɔ o ta la kpo.
Korowii ŋɔ, “N chɔɡ harɛre bwa nɛra ne ba bwɛjena, dɛ kuuɡi danjwɛɛre baa maa bara, ne a dejaŋa bwa a berɛ dimɡbeeni.
Bwɛjena la chɔ pɛɛ, nɛra toole a fɔɡbaahna, nomɛlbwa ta kae kpa.
N ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ n nɛra fe ɛɛ che anɔ taa dɛ́ tɛ mɛ duure, dɛ́ sɛh teŋɛ toɡra maa dɛ toɡ ba la ta, dɛ bɛ deŋnetɛra maa kpɔa toɡ ba la soh.
Kɛ buɡ nɔ ta ba we-ɛɛla berɔ kaa ba webena la ta.” Anomanta, Korowii ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ kpaa mɛ ka tel tɔpere la maa ba bol harɛre nɛra wa.
N ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ mɛɛ boa harɛre nɛra, ne koranar ne ba harɛre nyoaa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ n bandia kohona ba ta ba nɛ.
N bwaawee ɛɛ ir ba nɛɛ kohonaa, ásɛ dɛ fuh harɛ nɔ bwa kɛŋɔ nii ken.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, mɛɛ beɡre harɛre nɛra bwa liiree, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ba ɡel voɡa toma dɛɛ yerɛ n sɔn ɡbo.
Ba bwa ɛɛ pɛ nyoa dɛɛ tom mɛ.
N nɛra baa lɔa peɡre ka do Itiopia harɛ bojaŋ la ɛɛ ba saraha kwaa nee ba tɛ mɛ, dɛ́ baa tom mɛ.
Gɛ tɔpere la, maa ɡel sihiih kpo heyaa he deŋnekpeɡ haa ɛɛ mɛ la waa kpa.
Mɛɛ le mbarafo tena bwa nee n bwɛjen nɔ ta, ásɛ bɛlbwa ɡe aa won ɛɛ mɛ sisawaa n bweɡoroŋ n Dea aa chɔŋɛ o ta la ta kpa.
Nɛra ba waa aa pwɛra ne nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ n nɛɛ laanee dɛ́ so bela, ásɛ ba ba n be, ń cha ba.
Israel tena baa ka harɛ la ta la aa wechɔɡaa ɛ, kɛɛ dɛ́ teŋe nyosone, kɛɛ dɛ́ neɡre ba dɔŋa.
Baa dɔ komɛlbwa baa dɛ nyinii ba deŋna sɔɔh ba, baa wola nomɛlbwaa ɔmɛ.” Israel tena, hé ɡo yela silɛɛ ne, dɛ́ kpɔ takpeɡ kpɛɛ Korowii.
Jerusalam tena, hɛ́ɛ hɛɡre bambile bwa ne!
Korowii ɡel he deŋne tɛra, dɛ le he dɔma bwa ne.
Korowii waa ɛ Israel kooro la ja he nɛ.
Komɛlbwa toole he ɔmɛ kpa.
Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ ba bol Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɔmɛ, Bwɛɡoroŋ Saayɔn tena.
He bɛ ɡel he bwara hwah.
Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ja he nɛ.
O dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won lɛ heya.
O sie ɛɛ lɛ he nɛɛ kohonaa, dɛ́ che o nyina ta tɛ heyaa mkpafale.
Wɛɛ ɡo yelaa dɛɛ hɛɡre he wa.
O sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ di tɔpejen bɛl dɛɛ lɛ ba sie la ken.” Korowii ŋɔ, “N ɡelɔ he wenaale la ba a jaɡa, dɛ laa waa aa dɛ do heyaa sihiih ɡe kpɔ.
Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba ń tɛr nɛra baa dɛ do heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa la deŋne.
Mɛɛ lɛ banɔ la ba peri aa serewaa, dɛ́ berɛ ba banɔ baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfala ta la ne dem.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo banɔ la ba fa aa di sihiih la berɛ dɔ duure, ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa kpɛɛ ba.
Saŋ bɛl dɛ ba ásɛ n boa he nɛra baa peɡra nyoa, dɛ́ ba ba ne dem.
Mɛɛ ɛ heyaa nɛnjenaa, ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa kpɛɛ heya, dɛ́ ɡel he berɛ dɔ kondɔɔh ja.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Haɡae kpɔ Korowii waa la Jerusalam tena be, ɡɛ saŋ baa le bojaŋ harɛfale Babelɔn ba la.
Gɛ saŋ dɛ ba kwaarɔ ma ba deene, asɛ wobɛlbwa do wer dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, kɛ dɛ Korowii Dea la te ta kuuɡo chɔ.
Korowii waa la Haɡae aa bola la do nɛra la ɡbemba ásɛ ba kwaa ma Korowii Dea la, dɛ́ɛ tomɔ o bini ɡɛ aa chɛa, ásɛ Korowii swee ba andɛɛɡa, o jirima ba su o Dea la bini.
Korowii do Juda tena ŋɔ bá kwaa ma o Dea la Pɛɛsea Koojen Dareɔs kora dii bennɛɛte korobinumɛl tɔpeloɡle habɔɔ la, Korowii cheɡɛ o keame Haɡae nɛ, dɛ bol waa Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl waa dɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta, ne Jehosadak bibaa Sɔfonomoa Josua be.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ Haɡae be ŋɔ, “Nɛra nɔ ŋɔ saŋ ta tele kɛŋɔ ba berɛ kwaa ma n Dea la.” Korowii cheɡɛ o keame Haɡae nɛɛ dɛ bol waa ɡɛ nɛra la be.
O ŋɔ, “N nɛra, ɛrɛɛ he te so dedɛɛɡa bini asɛ n Dea ɛ dimɡbee nɔɔ?” Kenii Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi he waa bini kɛrɛdɛ.
He dɛ du kwaa kohona, kɛ tamaa kenii hɛɛ komɛ, dɛɛ di kwa kɛ haa vaɡɛ.
He dɛ nyɔ sen kɛ aa kanɛ dɛ́ dɛɛ heya, dɛɛ tɔ yale kɛ waa ɡarɛ dɛɛ kpo heya.
He ɛ toma dɛɛ dɔ suuɡa, kɛ aa heyaa le.” Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi he waa bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Hé teeh bwejena, dɛ́ la ka teŋni dadɛɛɡa ba kwaa do n Dea, ásɛ a do n som baa tom mɛ o bini ń dɔ jirima.
He soɡo dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɔ koo kwaa taeh, kɛ a berɔ ba do tamaa ken.
Anɔ la haa ba a ne dem la, ń chɔɡa.
Bɔkwa waa a ba ɡɛ nɔ?
Gela haa ɡel n Dea o chɔ kɛŋɔ dimɡbee he sie beɡre he kwaa ta la waa.
He waa haa ɛa laanee ɡela men Korowii ɡel bwaala ɡel nɛɛ, kondikwaa aa wola won ɛ la.
N ɡelɔ hwel che harɛ ne deŋɡarere ta, ne mea kooni, ne ɡrepo ne ɔleve daa kooni, ne kondikwaa aa dɛ le harɛ la ta, ne nɛra, ne nae dɛ toma haa kpɔ he nɔɔra dɛɛ ɛ ta.” Ate, Sɛrobabɛl ne Sɔfonomoa Josua dɛ nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta ba berɛ ba la bwa, ɛ waa Korowii aa ŋɔa ba ɛ la.
Ba ɔmɔ dɛ no waa Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa tomɛ o keame Haɡae la.
Korowii keame Haɡae kpɔ waa Korowii aa kpɔa tomɔ la ka tɛ nɛra la ŋɔ, “Korowii ŋɔ, ‘N ja he nɛ.’ ” Ate, Korowii ɡel Juda harɛ nomoa Sɛrobabɛl, ne Sɔfonomoa Josua dɛ nɛra baa kaa la bwa bwara ir, ba pa mun ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro baa dɛ tomɔ Dea la toma mun.
Kooro Dareɔs aa di kora bennɛɛte korobinumɛl tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ taa ba pa Dea la mun.
Korowii Dea baa kwaara ma jirima wa A ɡɛ bena la korobie anuanɛ tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta la, Korowii berɔ che o keame Haɡae nɛɛ dɛ bol waa ŋɔ, ó bɔɔ Juda harɛ nomoa Sɛrobabɛl, ne Sɔfonomoa Josua dɛ harɛ la ta nɛra baa kaa la ŋɔ, “Umee ta kaa dɛ́ lii n Dea nɔ jirima o fa aa dɔa ɔ?
Taraken, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nao wɔ?
O berɛ kompɛɛ bɛl he siwi ta naa?
He bɛlbwa bɛ ɡel o bwara yɔr, hé ɛ toma la, n ja he nɛ.
Haa le Ijipt harɛ ta la, n baɡɛ heyaa nyoa ŋɔ mɛɛ ja he nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa.
N ta ja he nɛ, he bɛ ɔmɛ.” Koranar Bwa Kooro bol Haɡae be ŋɔ, “A ka tamaa ken mɛɛ yiiɡi nyundua ne harɛɛ dɛ mpo.
Mɛɛ chɔɡ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola Korowii tomɛ kpeɡri bwaa, ásɛ ba kpɔ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa kohona ba o bini, ásɛ n ɡel kondɔɔh ba su n Dea la bwa.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.
Harɛ nɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm bwa ɛ n kwa.
Jirima taraken n Dea nɔ aa dɛ ba dɔe la, ɛɛ ɡwaa wubwa kon laanee.
Ásɛ dɛ tɛ n nɛra deŋnesɔɔhna bela.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.” Andɛɛɡa soŋa dɛ́ tɛ nɛra baa kah doŋa Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora bennɛɛte ta korobie anuanaarɛ, o tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ taa Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro bol waa keame Haɡae be ja ŋɔ, “Bɔɔ sɔfore la ɡɛ Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle waa maa dɛ ba he bɔɔra nɔ.
Dɛ nomɛl kpoŋe ol baa kpɔa ɛ saraha tɛ men Korowii, o do wer ne dii do o batakaare bini, asɛ dɛ kpɔ batakaare la ka leɡe paanoo, ne kondikwaa baa daala kɛɛ sen, kɛɛ no, kɛɛ kondikwaa bɛlbwa naa, a ɡelɔ a ɡɛ kondikwaa la ɛɛ do ɡoroŋ aa?” Asɛ sɔfore la ŋɔ, “Akai.” Anee Haɡae ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛl lawɛ lale dɛ kah doŋa, dɛ ka leɡe ɡɛ kwaa la bɛlbwa naa, dɛ doŋa la ba a ta naa?” Sɔfore la ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, dɛ doŋa lɔ a ta.” Ate, Haɡae berɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii ŋɔ, ɡɛ tentenee nɛra baa lɔ ɡɛ harɛ nɔ ta ne wobɛlbwa baa dɛ ɛ bwa do, waa an lɛ.
Komɛlbwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ba kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la kah doŋa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “He ta waa aa pu heyaa nɔ nae yaa?
Mɔɔ he pa mun dɛ́ do n Dea la, nomɛl kpɔ kon dɛɛ la ka maɡɛ mea kuruwa dela fifraanɛ bela aa wara chɔ aa, kuruwa dela fii wɛɛ dɔ.
Nomɛl la bela baa dɛ harame ɡrepo, dɛ ŋɔ o dɛ la ka ɛ sen vii dela fifraanue naa, vii dela fifraanɛɛ wɛɛ dɔ.
N ɡelɔ peuwɔb ne dombwea ba chɔɡ he kwaa haa dua bwa, kɛ he ta he liire charɛ dɛ ba n be.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Hé nyiŋi le fini dɛɛ kaa, korobinuanaarɛ nɔ tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ nɔ haa pa Korowii Dea nɔ mun nɔ, dɛ́ na waa aa dɛ ba bala.
Mea tonɔ, asɛ ɡrepo ne fiɡ daa, ne pɔmeɡranet dɛ ɔleve daa ta nɔnɛ mɔɔ, kɛ le fini dɛɛ la mɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ heya.” Korowii nyoa waa baɡɛ Sɛrobabɛl Korowii berɔ bol waa o keame Haɡae be korobie la tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ ta nɛɛtena ja dɛ ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Juda harɛ ta nomoa Sɛrobabɛl be ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ yiiɡi nyundua ne harɛɛ.
Mɛɛ lɛ koranar kpeɡri ba bee, dɛ́ ɡel harɛre kora kpeɡri ba a jaɡa.
Dɛ beɡre torɔɡore baa vɔwa dɛɛ pɛl jaɡre piiɡi.
Jaɡre ɛɛ choɡluu, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ so a ta kpoo dɔŋa keri ne.
Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ le hen Sɛrobabɛl haa ɛ n bonɔɔnee, ásɛ hɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta n sɔn ta, henee ń le.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.’ ”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Sekaria ne Korowii keame Haɡae bwaa pɛa ɛ toma, ɡɛ saŋ Jerusalam tena aa pa mun dɛ berɛ kwaa dɛɛ ma Korowii Dea la.
Sekaria baɡle wepila bele anuatoro Korowii aa pili a bini baɡlo.
Nyiŋi nyuune —.
O do nɛra la ɡbemba ŋɔ bá tonɛ Korowii Dea la, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ba we-ɛɛla ɛɛ lɛ Korowii sie.
O berɔ nyiŋi Korowii sweera waa swee tɛ o nɛra, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba kooro waa ɛ Mɛsaya waa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ bao ba lɛ o nɛra.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
O dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowiirii Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo wobɛlbwa waa ŋɔa aa chiɡuu la chiɡ, ɡɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa la.
Korowii yerɛ o nɛra ŋɔ bá berɛ ba o be Pɛɛsea Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora bennɛɛte korobie anuatoro ta la, Korowii bol waa o keame Sekaria waa ɛ Bɛrekea bibaa be.
Sekaria nabaa sɔne Ido.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ Sekaria be ŋɔ ó bol nɛra la be ŋɔ on Korowii baah fa di o naawa nɛɛ taeh, dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he charɛ he liire dɛ berɛ ba n be naa, mɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ.
He bɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ he naawa.
Banee n keamere baa tɔ sie la bol n waa ba be ŋɔ bá charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ne wedoŋa ta, kɛ ba ta n be noɛ, kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ duure tɛ mɛ la.
He naawa sɛ taraken jaɔ?
N keamere la ɡe ta lole ja aa?
N cheɡɛ n bonɔɔna baa ɛ n keamere nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ me Mmarare ne n waa tɛ he naawa dɛ ja ba, kɛ ba vɛah dɛ dɔ a deŋnetɛra.
Belaa ba charɛ ba liire ŋɔ men Korowii Maa Ɛ Koronar Bwa Kooroo tɛr ba deŋne ɡɛ aa chɛa.
Deŋnetɛra aa chɛ ba laanee ba dɔ le Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro be ɡɛ waa ŋɔa wɛɛ ɛo la.” Korowii keame Sekaria jaɡre ane waa naa wepila ta wa Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora bennɛɛte, korobie fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ baa dɛ yerɔ Sebat, tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa o keame Sekaria be jwaana.
Kenii Sɛkaria bol Korowii waa la.
“Awola jwaana la, men Sekaria na baa bɛl wepila ta o so jaaɡɔswɛm ta.
Dɛ o cheɡɛ daa ane baa dɛ yera mɛtel baah ta fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, asɛ nɛra bane ɡe so jaaɡɔswɛɛma, ne jaaɡɔkɔla dɛ jaaɡɔpoŋa ta o habɔɔ.
Ate, n bɔɔro ŋɔ, ‘N dɔɔ, nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta nɔ munii ɛrɔɔ?’ Korowii nyundua torome la n ne waa dɛ bol waa la chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ chaɡle a munii.’ Belaa baa waa soɡe jaaɡɔswɛm ta dɛ che daa la baah ta la ŋɔ, ‘Banee banɔ la Korowii aa toma ŋɔ bá ka ɡaaɡe harɛ nɔ bwa ta dɛ́ na waa aa dɛ chiɡ.’ Ba balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ Korowii nyundua torome la waa cheɡɛ daa la baah ta la be ŋɔ, ‘Ya laŋɔ ka ɡaaɡe harɛ nɔ ta bwa, dɛ na kɛ harɛ la sɔɔhnɔ o nɛra bwa ɡwɛɡre.’ Ate, Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, ‘Koronar Bwa Kooro, bene fifraanuanɛɛ nɔ he baah aa di Jerusalam ne Juda bwɛjena tena nɛ.
Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba ba sum nae yɔ?’ Belaa Korowii bol wobodɛɛɡa ne bolarawa waa o nyundua torome n ne waa bol waa la be.
Ate, Korowii nyundua torome la waa bol waa n be la ŋɔ ń ka bol Koranar Bwa Kooro waa waa ŋɔa ŋɔ, ‘N dɛ nyin Jerusalam n bwɛjen waa do ɡoroŋ la waa taeh, kɛ n baah di harɛre a nɛra aa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta la nɛɛ kohona.
Dɛ n fe dɛ na n nɛra sum, kɛ ɡɛ harɛre la nɛra ɡelɔ n nɛra wahala ɡwaa kohona.
Mɛɛ sune Jerusalam tena nɛɛ, dɛ́ berɛ ba bela, ásɛ ba kwaa ma n Dea ne bwɛjen la bwa.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.’ Korowii nyundua torome berɔ ŋɔ kenii Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ bol, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo n bwɛɛre la berɛ dɔ a te, ásɛ dɛ larawe n nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam bwara, dɛ́ kpɔ bwɛjen la ɛ n kon.’ Nyeɡlare ane wa Wepila ane ɡe ta, n na nabal nyeɡlare anaarɛ ane.
N bɔɔ Korowii nyundua torome la waa dɛ bol waa n be la ŋɔ, ‘Nyeɡlare nɔ ɡe munii ɛrɔɔ?’ O chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Nyeɡlare nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ harɛre a nɛra aa kpeɡa, dɛ lɔ Juda ne Israel dɛ Jerusalam tena peɡre kaa harɛre ta la.’ Belaa Korowii baɡ mɛ loɡra banaarɛ bane ɡe.
N bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwaa baala nɔ ɛɛ ba ba ɛɔ?’ Asɛ Korowii nyundua torome la chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Ba balɔ dɛ́ ba aah, dɛ́ doŋi harɛre a nɛra aa kpeɡa, dɛ ba chɔɡ Juda harɛ dɛ lɔ o ta nɛra bwa peɡre kaa harɛre ta la.’ ”
Baa bɛl waa kpoŋe ŋwɛn baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ bɔr Wepila ane ɡe ta, men Sekaria na bonɔmbii bɛl waa kpoŋe ŋwɛn baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ bɔr.
N bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa hɛɛ kaalɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “N dɛ la ka maɡɛ Jerusalam dɛ́ na ɡɛ o paɡri ne o jaŋne aa doa.” Belaa Korowii nyundua torome la n ne waa bol waa la le dɛɛ kaa, asɛ o dɔŋ ba chemo, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Chwa la ka ŋɔ bonɔmbii la be ŋɔ bɔr toole bá ma danjwɛɛ bar Jerusalam kpa, dɛkalkɛ nɛra ne kondɛɛra warɛ o ta.
Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ nii, dɛ́ bar bwɛjen la kɛŋɔ danjwɛɛ ken, dɛɛ daah bwɛjen la, ásɛ dɛ so o baah ta o jirima ne.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ o nɛra be ŋɔ, “Hé ba warane.
Hé chwa le weekaŋle nyunduabɔr harɛ la ta ba, dɛkalkɛ menee lɔ heyaa peɡre harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
Men Korowiirii bola.
Saayɔn tena, hé chwa le ba Jerusalam, he banɔ la baa lawɛ heyaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ Babelɔn harɛ ta la.
He waa hiah mɛ kɛŋɔ n siwinyiŋi ken, anomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa leɡe heyaa kɛɛ dɛ ɛ heyaa waane aa, dɛ menee o ɛ la.
Men Korowii ɡbabirii dɛ́ yoo ba, ásɛ n nɛra ba fa aa ɛɛ ba yoma la pa ba laala kɛ laa ta kwaa kaa.” Anɔ bwa chiɡaa, hɛɛ jemɔ kɛŋɔ Koranar Bwa Kooroo tomɛ men Sekaria.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Jerusalam tena, hé ɡel he sie lɛ hɛɛ ɡo yela!
N dɛ ba dɛ́ ba so he baah ta.” Harɛre ɡalɡa nɛra ɛɛ ba Korowii bee a ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ́ ba ɛ o nɛra.
Wɛɛ so he baah taa, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Koranar Bwa Kooroo tom mɛ he be.
Korowii ɛɛ berɔ ba kpɔ Juda harɛ ɛ o kon waa dɛ nyinu kohona, harɛ waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, dɛ́ nyin bwɛjen Jerusalam ɡwaa bwɛɛ bɛlbwa.
Nɛwɛnyina bwa hel Korowii sie, dɛkalkɛ o iro le o boɡoroŋ bela waa lole.
Sɔfonomoa bɛl wepila wa Wepila ane ɡe ta, Korowii baɡle men Sekaria Sɔfonomoa Josua o che Korowii nyundua torome bɛl sie.
Asɛ Bɔnsam ɡe ba che Josua diɡ ta dɛɛ ba waa kpɔe dawɛ o nɛ.
Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ Bɔnsam be ŋɔ, “Bɔnsam, Korowiirii dɛ́ pae bolchɔɡe!
Korowii waa le Jerusalam tɛ o te la, onee dɛ́ pae bolchɔɡe!
Baa nɔ do kɛŋɔ nindaa baa keero le nii ta.” Dɛ Josua cheɡɛ Korowii nyundua torome la sie dɛ do laaladoŋa.
Belaa Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ o bala baa cheɡɛ o sie la be ŋɔ, “Hé laa baa nɔ laaladoŋa la foo.” Dɛ ŋɔ Josua be ŋɔ, “Na, n laa he wechɔɡa kpɔ he nɛ, mɛɛ kpɔ laaladɛɛɡaa doe.” Belaa o ŋɔ bá kpɔ yal baa kpɔa dɛɛ vɔwɛ nyu la ondɛɛɡe vɔwɔ, asɛ ba kpɔ vɔwɔ, dɛ doo laaladɛɛɡa, dɛ Korowii nyundua torome la cheɡɛ bela.
Ate, Korowii nyundua torome la bol Josua be ŋɔ Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa taa, dɛɛ ɛ waa maa dɛ nyin tenaa, mɛɛ kpɔ n Dea wobɛlbwaa do he nɔn ta, ásɛ hɛɛ nyiŋi o dembaahna bwa ta.
Mɛɛ no he wesoŋaa, ɡɛ maa dɛ no nyundua toroma baa cheɡɛ he sie nɔ wesoŋa.
Sɔfonomoa Josua, he ne he bala sɔfore baa ja he nɛɛ la, hé no.
He cheɡɔɔ tɛ wedɛɛɡa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere.
N dɛ ba n bonɔɔ baa dɛ yerɔ Daa Kpale ne.
Hé na bwe maa kpɔa bil Josua sie.
Baŋne anuanɛ lɔ bwe beŋkpoŋ la ta.
Mɛɛ di ɡwinee dawɛ o taa, dɛ́ laa wechɔɡa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta kpɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.
Awola tɔpere la, he bini bɛlbwa ɛɛ yerɛ o dɔŋee he so deŋnesɔɔhna ta, ásɛ he ɡrepo ne he fiɡ daa kooni bar heya.”
Kandea daa wepila wa Korowii nyundua torome la o ne men Sekaria fa aa bol waa la berɔ ba chum mɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn yon chɔ dom ba chumu la.
O bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa he na nɔ?” Asɛ n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N na kandea daa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛo, asɛ loɡ baa dɛ do noo o ta chɔŋɛ o doa.
Kandere anuanɛ lɔ o ta, asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ bɔɔne anuanɛ baa do ŋwɛɛra a ta.
Ɔleve daa anɛ cheɡɛ kandea daa la jwɛh, bɛl cheɡɛ loɡ la diɡ-bɔr, asɛ bɛl ɡe che ɡalbɔr.” N bɔɔ Korowii nyundua torome la waa bol waa n be la ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, bɔkwaa kwaa nɔ che tɛɔ?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Haa kwaa nɔ jemaa?” N ŋɔ “N dɔɔ, akai, maa jemɛ.” Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń bol Korowii waa Sɛrobabɛl be ŋɔ, “He wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii, he kpeɡri ne laa yoi ne laa, kɛ n Doma kpeɡri taa.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.
Wobɛlbwa aa kana dɛ do kɛŋɔ bwejen aa won tɔ hen Sɛrobabɛl ŋwɛnɛ.
Hɛɛ kpɔ bwe la mamaala aa kpɔa do n Dea o lawɔ kpoŋe laanee ba, ásɛ nɛra moo dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘O wer, o wer!’ ” Korowii bol waa men Sekaria be ja ŋɔ, “Sɛrobabɛl pa n Dea la mun, o tentenee dɛ́ mao tonɛ.
Anee dɛ ɡel n nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooroo tomɛ ba be.
Bame waa nyiŋi Korowii Dea la mumpar toma la dɛɛ vaɔh?
Ba sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ ŋwɛn baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ danjwɛɛ la aa lɔ Sɛrobabɛl nɔn ta, ba berɛ dɛɛ pa Dea la mun.” Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Kandere anuanɛ nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii sibie anuanɛ waa kpɔa dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ nɔ bwa.” Asɛ n bɔɔ Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Ɔleve daa anɛ aa cheɡɛ kandea daa nɔ diɡ ne ɡal nɔ munii ɛrɔɔ?” N berɔ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɔleve daa kpala anɛ aa lɔ suuɡaswɛm paapore anɛ jwɛɛh suuɡaswɛm noo palɛ dɛɛ le a bini nɔ munii ɛrɔɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Haa ɡɛ kwaa nɔ mun jemaa?” N ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ, akai, maa jemɛ.” Ate o ŋɔ, “Kpala anɛ nɔɔ cheɡa tɛ baala banɛ, Korowii waa ɛ harɛ nɔ bwa Dɔɔ aa lee ba, dɛ fuɡe noo do ba nyuune ta baa tomɔ la.”
Tɔn waa dɛ kile nyundua wepila Men Sekaria berɔ na tɔn waa dɛ kile nyundua wepila ta!
Ate, Korowii nyundua torome la bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa he na nɔ?” N chaŋe ŋɔ, “N na tɔn waa lɔ nyundua.
O jaŋne lɔ naɡale fifraatoro, asɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale fi dɛ anue.” Anee o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ba chwerɛ nyotaahna waa do o ta aa kaa harɛ nɔ bwa ta.
O baŋ bɛl dɛ baɡle kɛ nomɛlbwa waa ŋwɛ la, baa leo harɛ la taa, baŋ bɛl ɡe waa ɛɛ baɡle ŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa teŋe nyosone dɛ ŋwɛɛ la, baa le o ɡee le harɛ la ta.” Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tomɛ tɔn nyotaahna aa lɔ o ta laanee o kaa dem bɛlbwa baa dɛ ŋwɛ ta, ne dem bɛlbwa baa teŋe nyosone dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ n sɔn ta.
Wɛɛ ka do dem la taa dɛ́ taɡɔ ɡo, dɛ́ kuuɡi o daa bwa kwaraa.” Haah bɛl waa lɔ wɛɡrɛ bini wepila Ate, Korowii nyundua torome n ne waa dɛ bol waa la, balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ha sie nyiŋi nyundua, dɛ́ na kon waa dɛ ba nɔ.” Asɛ n bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa konee yɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “O ɛ wɛɡrɛ baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwa,” o berɛ ŋɔ, “o cheɡɔ tɛ harɛ nɔ ta bwa nɛra wechɔɡa.” Dɛ wɛɡrɛ la dɔ tɔ, kpana nee ba ɛo.
N nao kɛŋɔ waa pila, asɛ haah bɛl so o bini.
Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Haah nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ nyubinikpeɡ.” Asɛ o berɛ taɡɔ do wɛɡrɛ la bini dɛ kwaa o tɔ la tɔ.
Ate, n berɛ ha sie nyiŋi, dɛ na haahna banɛ baa dɔ kena kɛŋɔ nyeŋɡboŋ dɛ ir dɛɛ ba n be, dɛ ba kpɔ wɛɡrɛ la ir kaa nyundua.
Ate, n bɔɔ Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Leperaa haahna la kpɔ wɛɡrɛ la dɛɛ kaa lɔ?” O chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ba dɛ kaa o ne Babelɔn harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka ma dea dɛ́ kpɔ cheɡ o bini.
Ba ma dea la tonaa, baa kpɔɔ cheɡ o bini dɛɛ tomɔ.”
Laa torɔɡore anaarɛ ane wepila N berɔ na wepila ane ɡe aa ɛ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore anaarɛ a le ayaawa bwejena anɛ ane baah ta dɛɛ ba.
Ba kpɔ sitɔ torɔɡo la vɔwɛ jaaɡɔswɛɛma aa tɛɡro, dɛ kpɔ nɛɛte vɔwɛ jaaɡɔbiŋere aa tɛɡro, dɛ kpɔ toorote vɔwɛ jaaɡɔpoŋa aa tɛɡro, dɛ kpɔ naarɛte ɡe vɔwɛ jaɡre a bwara aa lɛɡra aa tɛɡro.
N bɔɔ Korowii nyundua torome n ne waa dɛ bol waa la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, kwaa jaɡre nɔ aa dɛ tɛɡra nɔ munii ɛrɔɔ?” O chaŋ mɛ ŋɔ, “A ɛ peu bele anaarɛ aa le nyundua Korowii waa ɛ harɛ nɔ bwa Dɔɔ be.
Kon baa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔbiŋere la sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, Babelɔn harɛɛ a tɛɡre dɛɛ kaa.
Onɔ la baa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔpoŋa la sie chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr, asɛ onɔ la baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre a bwara aa lɛɡra la ɡe sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr a bwa tɛɡre dɛɛ kaa.” Jaɡre a bwara aa lɛɡra la leo, dɛ a bwara kpeɡri, a siwi beɡre kɛ a fee den kaa harɛ nɔ bwa ta.
Anee Korowii nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Hé le ka ɡaaɡe harɛ nɔ bwa, dɛ́ na waa aa dɛ chiɡ.” Asɛ a le dɛ kaa ɡaaɡe harɛ nɔ bwa ta.
Ate, Korowii nyundua torome la yer mɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Jaɡre aa kpɔ sie chaɡɛ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr Babelɔn harɛ dɛ kaa la, kaa sɔɔh Korowii bandia nyoa.” Josua kooɡbɛrɛ wa Korowii bol waa n be ŋɔ, “Ka lɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm le Hɛldae, ne Tobija dɛ Jedaya baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta Babelɔn ba berɛ ba la be.
Berɛ la Sefania bibaa Josia dem awola tenten.
Kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm la kwaa kooɡbɛrɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ pi Jehosadak bibaa Sɔfonomoa Josua.
Bol o be ŋɔ men Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, ‘N bonɔɔ waa do kɛ Daa Kpale la ɛɛ ta kpalee le bela waa lole, dɛ́ berɛ ba kwaa ma men Korowii Dea la.
Onee dɛ́ do n Dea la, ásɛ dɛ dɔ jirima dɛ́ so kookara ta di kora.
Sɔfo bɛl ɡe ɛɛ che o kookara la jwɛɛh o ne wɛɛ ɛ toma.
Ba bwa dɔ nyopɛo deŋnesɔɔhna do ba nɛra banɛ bwa baah ta.’ A chɛ kɛ he kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ nɔ cheɡ n Dea bela, bá kpɔ dɛɛ lii Hɛldae, ne Tobija, ne Jedaya dɛ Sefania bibaa Josia.
Nɛra ɛɛ le bojaŋaa ba, dɛ́ ba cha bá kwaa ma Korowii Dea la.
Ásɛ he jemɛ kɛ Koranar Bwa Kooroo tom mɛ he be.
Dɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa do heyaa a ta kɛrɛdɛ tenaa, ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ɛo.”
Nyoa vɔwa wa Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora bene anaarɛ ta, korobie anuanaarɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Keslɛv ta, tɔpenaarɛ ta la, Korowii bol waa men Sekaria be.
