Bɛtel tena tomɛ Saresa ne Rɛɡɛm Mɛlɛk dɛ ba nɛra ŋɔ, bá la Nemenɛ Korowii Dea, dɛ́ ka soŋe Korowii, dɛ́ bɔɔ sɔfore baa lɔ bela ne Korowii keamere ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ yá wi chɔɡa baa chɔɡ Korowii Dea la, dɛ́ vɔwɛ nyoa korobinuete la ta ɡɛ yaa ɛa bene aa baa kaa bwa ta la aa?” Asɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro bol waa n be ŋɔ, “Bɔɔ harɛ la ta nɛra bwa ne sɔfore la ŋɔ, ‘Haa vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ wi korobinuete ne korobinuanɛte ta bene fifraanuanɛ aa baa kaa ta la, dɛ n waa he koh vɔwɛ nyoa aa?
Haa di kwaa dɛɛ nyɔ sene la, dɛ he ɡbaɡba silɛɛ waa laa hɛɛ ɛ aa?
Gɛ waa nɔɔ Korowii che o keamere baa tɔ sie nɛɛ dɛ bol a saŋ la.
Jerusalam ne bwɛɛre aa baro nɛra fa aa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta dɛ dɔ ba te, nɛra su o ta, ne bwɛɛre aa baro bwa ta dɛ do Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ dɛ harɛre aa lɔ wee cholibɔr deŋɡarere harɛ ta bwa la.’ ” Koranar Bwa Kooro bol waa men Sekaria be ja ŋɔ, ń bol o nɛra be ŋɔ “Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi dɔŋa nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne, dɛ́ dɔ tedoma dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
He bɛ luhaahna kɛɛ bilalbii kɛɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra kɛɛ nyaara dɛɛ fiiɡi.
He bɛ dɔŋa liichɔɡa dɔ.
Kɛ n nɛra ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh noe, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛ kuuɡi kwaa tɔ deŋne.
Ba ɡelɔ ba bambile do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwe ken, dɛ vɛh waa maa cheɡɛ n Doma ta dɛ bol baɡle n saŋ la keamere la ta teŋa.
Anomanta, men Koranar Bwa Kooro baah di ba nɛɛ taeh.
Gɛ maa bola ba ta noɛ la, ɡɛɛ ba ɡe soŋ mɛ naa, maa wola no.
N lɔ ba peɡre harɛfala ta kɛŋɔ kawulewule aa lɔ haahra dɛɛ peɡre la ken, bela ba fa aa kaa ɛ hɔɔhra la.
Harɛdɛɛɡe la chɔ pɛɛ, nomɛlbwa toole o ta.”
Korowii baɡɛ Jerusalam tena nyoa Koranar Bwa Kooro bol waa men Sekaria be ja ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin Jerusalam waa taeh, n sie beɡrɔ kohona mɛɛ mee o wa.
Mɛɛ berɔɔ ba Jerusalam, bela n Saayɔn Bwejen aa lole dɛ́ ba so.
Baa yerɛ Jerusalamee Kasinteŋ Bwɛjen, ásɛ dɛɛ yerɛ men Koranar Bwa Kooro Bwejen la Bwejen Waa Do Goroŋ.” Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Banjeni ne hanjeni ta ɛɛ kpoŋe daŋɡbalee, dɛ́ so Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna.
Bibaala ne bihaahna ɛɛ su bwɛjen la fɔɡbaahnaa, dɛɛ hɛlɛ.
Nɛra baa ba ka ɡɛ saŋ la ɛɛ ŋɔɔ aa won maɡre, n te be te, aa kpeɡe.
Mɛɛ lɛ n nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr harɛre ta laanee.
Mɛɛ berɔ ba bane ba so Jerusalam, ásɛ ba ɛ n nɛra, n ɡe ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ n nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne waa aa toɡra ne.
He banɔ haa lole taraken nɔ, waa haa dɛ no nɔ ɛ waa n keamere fa aa bola ɡɛ saŋ baa pa n Dea la mun la, he do ɡbemba, ásɛ dɛ ma n Dea la.
Mɔɔ ba ɛ men Korowii Dea la toma la, dɛ nɛn ɛ toma kɛɛ ba kpɔ kondɛɛre ɛ toma aa, kembɔr toole.
Dɛ dɔma nomanta, deŋnesɔɔhna toole, menee ba yoi ne nɛn ne o dɔŋ baah ta.
Kɛ taraken te, ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ba bini bane aa kaa nɔ, maa ban ɛ ɡɛ n fa aa ɛ banɔ la kpa.
Koo kondikwa ɛɛ do werii kɛrɛdɛ, ɡrepo daa ɛɛ nɔnɔɔ kohona, komɛlbwa do wer harɛ la ta, ásɛ bwaala nɛ kohona.
Gɛ kwaa nɔ bwaa mɛɛ ba kpɔe tɛ he nɛra haa kaa la kɛ kapɛrɛ kwa.
Gɛ baa taah he Juda ne Israel tena harɛre ta la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ba heyaa lɛɛ, ásɛ nɛra che he nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ wedɛɛɡa.
He bɛ ɔmɛ, hé dɔ ɡbemba.” Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Gɛ he naawa fa aa ɡela n baah di n lii kɛŋɔ mɛɛ ɛɛ baa wechɔɡaa maa wola ba nɛɛ sune la, ɡɛɛ taraken n lii kɛŋɔ ń swee Jerusalam ne Juda tena bwa andɛɛɡa.
He bɛ ɔmɛ.
Waa aa chɛ kɛ he ɛ laanee nɔ, hé bol kasinteŋ dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛ nomɛl ne o dɔŋ dɔ waa kɔɔto aa, hé bol a kasinteŋ a ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne, he bɛ wechɔɡa lii dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, he bɛ ɡel he sie ɛɛ lɛ ŋwɛɛra aa wola kasinteŋ ɛɛ ta.
N hah a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Koranar Bwa Kooro bol waa men Sekaria be ja ŋɔ, “Nyoa haa dɛ vɔwɛ korobinaarɛ, ne korobinue, ne korobinuanɛ dɛ korobifi ta la, hé kpɔ ɛ tɔpejena dii silɛɛ aa lɔ a ta, dɛ́ tɛ Juda tena.
Anomanta, hɛɛ nyin kasinteŋ ne deŋnesɔɔhna.” Koranar Bwa Kooro berɔ bol ja ŋɔ, “Nɛra ɡalɡa ne nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjena ta ɛɛ bao tɔpebɛl, ásɛ bwɛjen bɛl nɛra la bwɛjen bɛl tena be ka ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel ya kaa warane ka tomɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, dɛ́ soŋo ó swee yaa andɛɛɡa.
Hé ɡel ya pɛ kaa.’ Nɛra ɡalɡa ne harɛre a nɛra baa dɔ kpeɡri ɛɛ ba Jerusalamee, dɛ́ ba tomɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, dɛ́ soŋo ó swee ba andɛɛɡa.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, baala fi ɛɛ le harɛre wobol bɛlbwa binii, dɛ́ ba lawɛ Juu te beŋkpoŋ batakaare nyoa dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Gel ya ne he kaa, ya noɔ kɛ Korowii ja he nɛ.’ ”
Israel tena dɔma deŋnetɛra Waa aa le Korowii bee nɔ.
O dɛ ba ba chɔɡ Hadrak harɛ ne bwɛjen Damaskɔs.
Nɛra ne Israel deene bwa sie lɔ Korowii nɛ, ne Hamat o ne Damaskɔs aa do jwɛh, ne bwɛjena Taaya ne Sidon tena baa dɔ wejema la jao.
Taaya tena do dekpeɡa tɛ ba te, dɛ boa suuɡapoŋa nyoa kɛŋɔ teera, ne suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ doŋa aa chɔ fɔɡbaahna.
Kɛ Korowii ɛɛ laa Taaya kondɔɔh bwaa kpɔ, dɛ́ paa ka ta mpo ta, ásɛ nii fuh o bwa dɛɛboo ken.
Bwɛjen Askɛlɔn tena ɛɛ nao dɛ́ ɔmɛ, bwɛjen Gasa tena ɡe na ba bambile wee ba, ásɛ Ekron tena ɡe hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ.
Gasa tena kooro ɛɛ le ba nɔn taa, ásɛ Askɛlɔn chɔ pɛɛ.
Hɔɔhraa dɛ́ ba kpɔ Asdɔd so, ásɛ n sɔɔh Filisti tena mbarafo nyoa.
Baa ol chal aa lɔ o ta, kɛɛ kondikwaa maa kia di.
Banɔ la baa ka la, ɛ berɔ ɛ men Korowii nɛra, dɛ́ ɡe dɔ ba dea Juda harɛ ta, ásɛ Ekron tena ɡe berɛ ɛ n nɛra kɛ Jebus tena ken.
Kɛ mɛɛ daah n harɛɛ le laa tena nɔn ta, ba bɛ won ba bela.
Nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi nɛra aa won ba yo n nɛra kpa, dɛkalkɛ n ta dɛ daah ba.
Saayɔn kooro bala Saayɔn tena, hé hɛɡre kohona, Jerusalam tena, hé moo ɡa.
Hé nyiŋi na!
He kooro dɛ ba he be, o waa toɡrɔ dɛ won nɛra lɛɛ, o pwɛre, o soɡe keeɡo bie ta, keeɡo bale taa o so.
Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ le laa torɔɡore nee Israel harɛ ta, dɛ́ le laa jaɡre ne Jerusalam, ásɛ dɛ kuuɡi laa tori bwa.
He kooro ɛɛ bol deŋnesɔɔhna waa harɛre nɛra bee.
Wɛɛ di koraa le mpo bɛl taa ba kaa bɛl ta, dɛ́ le Yufretis Moo ta kaa harɛ jaɡa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Kɛ he te, kwaa haa kpoora dɛ ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ la, a chal nee n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo, anomanta, mɛɛ lawɛ he nɛraa le bɔɔ baa kaa do ba o bini nee aa wola toole bela la ta.
Hé berɛ ba kaa, he nɛra baa lawɛ heyaa kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta, taraken he dɔ hwɛɡa, hé berɛ ba kaa he harɛ bosɔɔhna aa lɔ o ta.
Taraken n dɛ ŋɔ he be, mɛɛ tɛ heyaa anɔ la haa paŋa la bele anɛɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡure Juda harɛɛ kɛŋɔ to ken, dɛ́ kpɔ Efrem ɛ hɛma.
Dɛ́ kpɔ Saayɔn baala ɛ keri, dɛ́ ka yo Grik tena harɛ baala.” Korowii ɛɛ bao Korowii ɛɛ le nyunduaa dɛ́ ba o nɛra be, ásɛ o hɛm nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwaala nyɛɡla ken.
Nemenɛ Korowii ɛɛ hoh laa bɛlaa, dɛ́ valɛ peujen bini kpeɡri ne le weekaŋle harɛbɔr ba.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ɛɛ tɔ o nɛra ɡbemɡbee.
Baa chɔɡ ba dɔma vamtor bwea nee, dɛɛ moo laa ta kɛŋɔ sennyɔdɛɛra ken.
Baa kpoo ba dɔmaa, ásɛ ba chal ɛɛ palɛ kɛŋɔ baa kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha, dɛ kpɔ a chale dɛɛ merɛ saraha kwaa loŋkoni ta la ken.
Tɔpere la telaa, Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ lɛɛ baa, kɛŋɔ peteɡre aa lɛ peera le wahala ta.
Baa dɛɛ nyɛɡle o harɛ taa, kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm kwaa aa pɛɡle kooɡbɛrɛ ta la.
Na ɡɛ harɛ la aa dɛ ba wer doe dɛ́ dɔ pɛla!
Kondikwaa ne sen aa lɔ harɛ la ta la ɛɛ ɡeloo bonɔɔna ne toli kpeɡ, dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa.
Korowii ɛɛ nyiŋi Juda tena nɛɛ Hé soŋe Korowii o fel nɛ bwaala.
Korowiirii dɛɛ ɛ baama aa nɛ bwaala.
Onee ɡela bwaala nɛ dɛɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyina, koo kwaa ɛɛ do wer dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa.
Voɡa dɛ teŋe nyosone, voɡra waa baa dɛ na ɛ nyosone, deera mun baa dɛ baɡle la ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ, bolarawa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra ɛ wesale.
Anomanta, ba ɡelɔ nɛra nyoɡre kɛŋɔ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe, asɛ nɛra ɛɛ fiɡ ba.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “N baah di nɛra baa do kɛ peteɡra la nɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛr sitɔɔla la deŋnee, dɛkalkɛ, mɛɛ nyiŋi Juda dea tena baa do kɛ n peera la nɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba do kɛ jaaɡɔ waa kpeɡa laa ta.
Juda dea tena binii nɛn waa do kɛ bwe baa kpɔ pa dea mun ɛɛ ba lee, o bee daa baa kpɔ baŋre tɛnte ɛɛ ba lee, to baa kpɔ yo laa le o be, ásɛ koranar ne nomonome bwa ɡe le o be.
Ba bwa ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ banyoola, dɛ́ɛ tiɡri ba dɔma nɛɛ fɔɡbaahna laa ta.
Men Korowii ja ba nɛɛ nomanta, baa yoo dɛ́ pɔ ba dɔma baa soɡe jaɡre ta, laa ta nɛ.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo Juda dea tena do kpeɡri dɛ́ lɛ Josef dea tena.
Mɛɛ berɔɔ ba ba ne bela ba fa aa lole, dɛkalkɛ n dɔ tedoma tɛɛ ba.
Baa doo kɛŋɔ nɛra n fa aa wola ban vɛɛh ken, dɛkalkɛ menee Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ la.
Mɛɛ dɛɛ chaŋ baa ba wesoŋa taa.
Israel tena ɛɛ doo kɛŋɔ banyoola, ásɛ ba sie lɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra aa nyɔ sen ba sie ɛɛ lɛ la.
Ba bii ɛɛ nao ba sie lɛ, ásɛ ba hɛɡre waa Korowii aa ɛa wa.
Mɛɛ yer baa, dɛ́ boa ba nyoa.
Kasinteŋ, mɛɛ lɛɛ baa dɛ́ ɡel ba warɛ ɡɛ ba fa aa doa wubwa la.
A lole kɛ n lɔ ba peɡre harɛre nɛra bini, kɛ báa ba lii n waa bojaŋ harɛre taa.
Ba ne ba bii ɛɛ dɔ ba nyuu, ásɛ dɛ bwa berɛ ba dem.
Mɛɛ berɔɔ le ba ne Ijipt harɛ taa ba, dɛ́ boa ba nyoa le Asiiria harɛ ta.
Mɛɛ kpɔ baa ba Gelead ne Lɛbanɔn harɛre ta, ásɛ ba warɛ harɛre la ta baa wola a taa jo.
Wekpeɡa kohona bɛlbwa aa do kɛŋɔ mpo nehɛma dɛ ba ba nɛɛ aa, men Korowii ɛɛ sɔɔh a nyoaa, ásɛ Nael Moo vile bwa hweeh.
Asiiria tena mbarafo nyoa ɛɛ sɔɔhnoo, ásɛ Ijipt harɛ kora kpeɡri nyoa ba harɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛ n nɛra kpeɡrii, ásɛ baa tom mɛ dɛɛ no n wa.
Men Korowiirii bola.”
Nomonome nyubinikpeɡ tena chola wa Lɛbanɔn harɛ, pili he ɡbeni ásɛ nii ba fuh he peleme daa bwa dɛ́ chɔɡa.
Dadɛɛɡa, hé wi, dɛkalkɛ peleme cholo, dajena kwaraa bwa chɔɡɔ.
Basan harɛ dajena, hé wi, ba teŋni kɔr la daa aa farɛ o bini bwa.
Hé no koranar baa do kɛ peteɡra la wii baa dɛ wi, ba jirima baa dɔa bwa tonɔ.
Hé no nyujentena sii aa dɛ si kohona, kɔr o daa aa fara a do o bini Jɔɔdan Moo nyoa bwa chɔɡɔ.
Peteɡra banɛ bane wa Kenii Korowii men Sekaria aa dɛ tomɔ la bol n be, “Ɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre waa dɛ nyiŋi peera baa lea cheɡ dɛ́ ka kpoora la.
Nɛra baa dɛ yawa dɛɛ kpoora la aa deŋnetɛraa dɔ.
Nɛra baa dɛ yoɡa dɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔ suuɡa, Kórowii jam!’ Hale nɛra baa dɛ teɡa la aa a nɛɛ sune.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Maa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ la ta bɛlbwa sumii na.
Mɛɛ le bɛlbwaa tɛ o dɔŋ ne o kooro.
Baa fiiɡi ba harɛ la ta nɛraa, kɛ maa ban lɛ.” Anomanta, men Sekaria nyiŋi peera baa lea cheɡ dɛ́ ka kpoora la nɛ, dɛ teɡa kaa dibɔr, anɔ la baa dɛ fiiɡa la fanfa.
Asɛ dɛ kpɔ daŋɡbale anɛ, dɛ pa bɛl sɔn ‘Sum Nae’, asɛ bɛl ɡe ‘Nyopɛo’, dɛ nyiŋi peera la nɛ.
Korobibeŋkpoŋ ɡbo ta, n doŋi peteɡra batoro bane baa hah mɛ.
Peera la chwao le n be, n mee le a wa.
Ate, n ŋɔ peera la be ŋɔ, “Maa won ɛ he teɡre kpa.
Anɔ la aa sewɛ la, a sewɛ, anɔ la baa kpo la, ba kpoora, ásɛ anɔ la aa ka la di a bala ola.” Ate, n kpɔ daŋɡbala maa pa o sɔn ‘Sum Nae’ la dɛ kuu, a baɡle kɛŋɔ n chɔɡ fɔo Korowii ne harɛre nɛra bwa aa fɔwa la.
Fɔo la chɔɡɔ awola tɔpere, asɛ peera baa dɛ fiiɡa la ɛɛ nyiŋ mɛ, dɛ na kɛŋɔ Korowiirii bol ɡɛ waa maa ɛa la.
Men Sekaria ŋɔ peyarawa la be ŋɔ, “A wer tɛ heya aa, hé bɔ mɛ a kem, a laa ɡe aa, hé ɡel.” Asɛ ba tɛ mɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraatoro.
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ do kon baa kpɔ suuɡa dɛɛ do o bini n Dea bela la bini.” Asɛ n kpɔ suuɡapoŋa fifraatoro baa kpɔa tɛ mɛ, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ a kan kohona la ta kon la bini.
Ate, n berɛ ku daŋɡbanɛɛte maa pa o sɔn ‘Nyopɛo’ la, a baɡle kɛ n chɔɡ beŋkpoŋri waa lɔ Juda harɛ ne Israel harɛ baah la.
Ate, Korowii ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Berɛ ɛ ɡɛ peteɡre ɡɛne aa dɛ ɛ o toma ja.
N dɛ ba peteɡre bɛl ne harɛ la ta.
Waa peera aa nyoɡra la bɔree ɡaaɡe, waa a bii nɛɛ nyiŋi, waa anɔ la baa doa bola laanee chah, waa anɔ la aa dɔ bokpeɡa la ɡe kondikwaa tɛ.
Anɔ la aa do bwara la, wɛɛ kpoora dɛɛ chwe, hale dɛ́ teŋni a nafikokore dɛɛ ta.
Peteɡre ɡɛne waa chwa ɡel peera la, ó bwɛɛlɛ!
Baa kpɔ keree ŋwɛnɛ o nɔn ne o diɡ siwi.
O nɔn ɡe sewɛ, o diɡ siwi ɡe tɔ kwaraa.”
Jerusalam tena kerekere lɛɛ wa Israel waa aa le Korowii bee nɔ.
Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ, dɛ ta nɛwɛnyini la ŋɔ, “N dɛ ba ɡela Jerusalam do kɛ numol sen aa lɔ o bini tɛ harɛre aa baro la nɛra, ásɛ ba kpɔ nyɔ dɛ́ dɛɛ, dɛɛ yɛɛɡe.
Dɛ ba tɔ Jerusalam do aa, bá tɔ Juda ɡe do ja.
Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo Jerusalam do kɛŋɔ bwe, waa yiiɡi.
Harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa aa pɛ nyoa dɛ́ ba yoo ba la, bɛlbwa waa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡɔɔ bwe laanee la, wɛɛ doo bolii.
Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔma jaɡre ɔmɛ, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra baa dɛ so a ta la we choɡla.
Mɛɛ nyiŋi Juda dea tena nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba dɔma jaɡre nyoŋe.
Ásɛ Juda nomonome bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, ‘Jerusalam tena kpeɡri, dɛkalkɛ Koranar Bwa Kooroo baa tomɛ.’ Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ ɡeloo Juda nomonome do kɛŋɔ koropɔɔto ninhɔla aa suu dɛ́ do dahola baah dɛɛ hɔ, kɛɛ kapɛle aa lɔ mea baah ta dɛɛ lawɛ nii.
Baa chɔɡ harɛre aa bar ba la nɛra bwaa, kɛ Jerusalam tena te ɛɛ so ba buɡ taa deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
Korowii ɛɛ tɔ sie lɛ Juda dea tena mɔɔ, ɡɛ aa ɛ Kooro Devid naanar ne nɛra baa soɡe Jerusalam la jirima bɛ Juda tena ɡwaa.
Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ tɔ nɛra baa soɡe Jerusalam ɡbemɡbee, hale ɡwɛɡre kwaraa waa lɔ ba bini kpeɡri do kɛŋɔ ɡɛ Kooro Devid fa aa doa la.
Ásɛ Kooro Devid naanar tɔ ba sie kɛŋɔ Korowii nyundua torome kɛɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba.
Awola tɔpere la, mɛɛ chɔɡ harɛre aa dɛ yo Jerusalam tena laanee.
Nɛn baa yaɡɔ kere ne wiile Mɛɛ ɡeloo sum nae ne Korowii soŋa Doma ba so Kooro Devid naanar, ne Jerusalam tena bane nɛ.
Baa dɛɛ nyiŋi naate baa yaɡɔ lampea ne o sewɛ laanee, dɛɛ wiu kɛŋɔ nɛra aa dɛ wi ba bibeŋkpoŋ waa sewa, kɛɛ baa dɛ wi ba bibanloɡle waa sewa la ken.
Awola tɔpere la, wii waa do Jerusalam la ɛɛ do kanee, kɛŋɔ Hadad Remɔn tena wii baa wi Meɡido deŋɡare doa harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta la.
Harɛ la tena bwa ɛɛ wiu, dea bɛlbwa nɛra ne ba haahna ɛɛ wiu.
Kooro Devid dea, ne Netan dea, ne Lewi dea, ne Simee dea dɛ deene la kar nɛra bwa ɛɛ wiu.
Dem te bɛlbwa, baaloo, haahnoo, ba bwaa dɛɛ ba wii.”
Wechɔɡa ne doŋa sɔe dɛ ta wa Nemenɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “Tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao, ásɛ nee bule dɛɛ le harɛ bini tɛ Kooro Devid ne o naanar, ne bwɛjen Jerusalam tena.
Belaa baa ba laŋa, dɛ́ ka sɔ ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa, ne doŋa baa kaah bwa ta.
Mɛɛ le voɡa aa lɔ harɛ la ta la nee awola, baa wola a sɔnaa lii kpa.
Mɛɛ le keame nyosonteŋna la nee, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ba pɛla le voɡa toma ta.
Dɛ nomɛl dɛ teŋe nyosone ŋɔ waane ɛɛ chiɡuu kerekere aa, naate nya ne o mɛɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé sewɛ, dɛkalkɛ he teŋe nyosone Korowii sɔn ta.’ O ta teŋɔ dɛɛ bol aa, o nya ne o mɛɛ ɡbaɡba tɔɡɔ kere kpo.
Awola tɔpere la, sihiih ɛɛ kpo keame bɛlbwa waa ŋɔa o dɛ na chaahnaa.
Waa keamere batakaaree do dɛ́ neɡre nɛra kpa.
Wɛɛ ŋɔɔ, ‘N ta keame ɛɛ, paaree men, n bonɔɔne saŋ bwaa n le dɛɛ parɛ.’ Dɛ nomɛl bɔɔ bɛlbwa kon la aa ɡela pɛl dawɛ o bwara ta naa, wɛɛ chaŋoo ŋɔ, bolii ba doo o damanar dem.” Ba kpo peteɡre la asɛ peera la lɔ peɡre Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ir n keree dɛ́ kpo n peteɡre waa dɛ tom mɛ la.
Kpo peteɡre la ásɛ peera la lɔ peɡre ń dɔ bɔr kpoo a bii la.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Harɛ la ta bwa ba bɔne ba bini bɔre atoro naa, baa kpɔ kerii kpoo bɔre anɛ nɛra á ba ka bɔrbeŋkpoŋ nɛra.
Bɔrbeŋkpoŋ nɛra nɔɔ mɛɛ ba kpɔe kpɔ nii ta kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm do nii ta dɛ laa a doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ a ta la.
Baa yerɛ n sɔnee, ásɛ n ɡe sɛh ba be.
Mɛɛ ŋɔɔ, ‘N nɛraa ban,’ ásɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔɔ laanee la.’ ”
Korowii Kora ba dii wa Tɔpere Korowii aa lea cheɡ dɛ́ bol nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole la dɛ ba.
He dɔma ɛɛ ba pa he Jerusalam tena laala kɛ laa ta kwa, dɛ́ bɔna he siwi ta.
Korowii ɛɛ boa harɛre nɛra nyoa bá ba yo bwɛjen Jerusalam tena, dɛ́ lɛ bwɛjen la dɔɔh.
Baa jo ba deene, dɛ́ pa ba laala, dɛ́ ɡuɡri ba haahna chɔ.
Baa lawɛ bwɛjen la pera nɛraa kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta, dɛ́ ɡel ba kar bwɛjen la ta.
Korowii ɛɛ leo, dɛ́ ka yo a ɡɛ harɛre la nɛra ɡɛ waa dɛ yo saŋ la.
Awola tɔpere la, wɛɛ ka che Ɔlevere Bwejen la taa, Jerusalam wee leebɔr.
Ásɛ Bwejen la bini bɔne anɛ le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr, dɛ́ ɡel fɛlembɔjen chɔ baah ta, ásɛ Bwejen la pera do weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, o pera ɡe do weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Hɛɛ chwao kpɔ fɛlembɔjen waa bɔne Bwejen la binii kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Asɛl ta.
Hɛɛ chwao ɡɛ he naawa fa aa chwaa ɡɛ saŋ harɛ aa jiɡra dɛ Juda Kooro Ussia di kora la.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ bao, o nyundua toroma bwa ja o nɛ.
Awola tɔpere la, wee aa lɔ, waa aa ba, kwaa aa sɔɔh dɛ hel kɛŋɔ dombwea.
Gɛ tɔpere la dɔŋ ta balɛ bwa, webaŋa toole, jwaana ɡe toole, Korowii ɡboo jemɛ a ɡɛ tɔpere la wa.
Hale jwaana kwara dɛ bɔr ta chaahnɔ.
Awola tɔpere la, nedɛɛɡe ɛɛ palɔɔ le Jerusalam, o pera kaa Yar Mpo ta, o pera berɛ kaa Mɛdetereenea Mpo ta bɔwɔb ne waa saŋ bwa.
Korowiirii dɛ́ ɛ kooro awola tɔpere la harɛ nɔ bwa ta.
Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛɛ tomɔɔ, dɛ́ jemɔ dɛɛ yerɛ o ɡbo sɔn.
Harɛ la bwa, dɛ le Geba kaa Remɔn waa lɔ Jerusalam weekaŋle harɛbɔr ɛɛ chɔɔ kaa Jɔɔdan Moo la ta.
Ásɛ bela Jerusalam aa lole la dawɛ nyundua o buɡ ta, dɛ́ le Bɛnjamen Doonyoa dɛ́ kaa bela Doonyoa Waa Tɔ Sie la aa lole la, ne Loŋkora Doonyoa, dɛ́ teŋe kaa Hananɛl Dejaŋ, dɛ́ kaa bela baa dɛ harame kooro daa nɔna nee dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ sen la ta.
Nɛra ɛɛ ba so Jerusalam deŋnesɔɔhna taa, nomɛlbwa aa wola won ba aah o nɛra dɛ́ chɔɡo kpa.
Weechɔɡa Korowii aa dɛ ba kpɔe ba ta harɛre a nɛra aa ba yo Jerusalam tena laanee nɔ.
Ba bwadabii ne ba sibie ne ba nyondoŋa ɛɛ pɔɔh, dɛ ba ta serewɛ.
Awola tɔpere la, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ ɔmee kohonaa ba ta ba nɛ, á ɡel ba lawɛ dɔŋa nɔɔra, dɛɛ yo dɔŋa.
Juda tena ɡe ɛɛ ka cha Jerusalam tenaa yo.
Baa pa harɛre aa baro la nɛra kondɔɔh, suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ yale kohonaa.
A ɡɛ weechɔɡa la siwi ɛɛ ba jaɡre ne keeɡore, ne nyoɡmare dɛ kondɛɛra aa lɔ bela ba dɔma aa soɡa la bwa nɛɛ.
Harɛre ta nɛra baa ba yo Jerusalam tena ásɛ ba bini bane ka la, baa di Kukure Tɔpejen la Jerusalam benanyoa bɛlbwaa, dɛɛ tomɛ Kooro waa ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro la.
Dɛ harɛ la bɛlbwa nɛra ta Jerusalam laŋɛ ka tomɛ Kooro Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro la aa, bwaala aa ban nɛ.
Ijipt harɛ ta tena ta laŋɛ dɛ ɡe ka tomɛ aa, bwaala aa ban nɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ weechɔɡa waa kpɔ ta harɛre nɛra báa wola la ka di Kukure Tɔpejen la nɛɛ.
Waa nɔɔ dɛɛ ba deŋnetɛra ɛɛ, dɛ́ tɛ Ijipt tena ne harɛre nɛra la bwa baa wola la ka di Kukure Tɔpejen la.
Awola tɔpere la, dorɔŋre baa kpɔ do jaɡre baŋa la, baa chwerɛ a taa ŋɔ, ‘A Do Goroŋ Tɛ Korowii’, ásɛ viine baa kpɔa dɛɛ daa saraha kwaa Korowii Dea la, á berɛ do kɛŋɔ loɡa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛ che kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la sie.
Vii bɛlbwa waa lɔ Jerusalam ne Juda ɛɛ do ɡoroŋee tɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, ásɛ nɛra baa ba ɛ saraha la kpɔ viine la daa ba saraha kwa.
Keenan tena bonadiire bɛlbwa aa Koranar Bwa Kooro Dea belaa do awola tɔpere.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Malakae kpɔ Korowii waa la ba Jerusalam tena be, ɡɛ saŋ baa le Babelɔn bojaŋ harɛfale ta ba, dɛ ba kwaa ma Korowii Dea la.
Gɛ saŋ la, dɛ bɛlbwa aa ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔa dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta la ta teŋɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Malakae do ba ɡbemba ŋɔ bá berɛ dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii kasinteŋ ne, dɛɛ teŋɛ o webaɡla la ta.
O berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ berɛ dɔ tedoma tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ tomɛ toromee, ó ba kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛo o bala ta.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
Korowii ɛɛ swee andɛɛɡaa tɛ banɔ la ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛo la.
Waa Korowii aa pila baɡle o keame Malakae chaahna ta ŋɔ ó bol baɡle Israel tena laanee nɔ.
Korowii nyina waa nyin Israel tena Korowii ŋɔ o nɛra Israel tena be ŋɔ, “Men Korowii, saŋ bɛlbwaa mɛɛ nyin heya.” Kɛ he dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa chaɡla kɛ he dɛ nyin yaa ɔ?” Asɛ Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, “Jekɔb dɔɔree Esɔ, kɛ n nyin Jekɔb ne o naanar, dɛ hah Esɔ ne o naanar baa ɛ Edom tena.
A habɔɔ Esɔ aa baa dɔ deŋɡarere harɛ ta so la, asɛ n chɔɡ bela bwa o berɛ kalampoŋare sobɔr.” Edom tena la ŋɔ, “A lole kɛ Korowii chɔɡ ya harɛ te, kɛ yaa berɔ kwaa vɔrɔwe bwɛɛre la.” Asɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Ba ken ɛɛ won berɛ vɔrɔwe bwɛɛre la te, kɛ mɛɛ chɔɡaa ja.
Baa yerɛ harɛ la ‘Nyubinikpeɡ Tena Harɛɛ’, n bandia aa o nɛra nɛɛ le bwa.” Israel tena siwi ɛɛ na ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Korowii kan, hale dɛɛ di kpeɡri harɛfala aa bar Israel harɛ bwa!” Saraha kwaa aa di kirihiah Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “Bie dɛɛ tɛ o mɛɛ jirima, asɛ bonɔɔ ɡe ɛɛ tɛ o nomoa duure.
Menee he mɛɛ, ɛrɛɛ haa wola jirima kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ mɛ nɔ?
N ɛ he dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ haa wola duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ mɛ nɔ?
He sɔfore, heyaa wola duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ n sɔn, kɛ he dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ yaa wola duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ he sɔn ɔ?’ ” Korowii ŋɔ, “He kpɔ kondikwaa aa kah doŋa dɛɛ ba n saraha kon ta.
He berɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa ya kpɔ doŋa kah he saraha kon laɔ?’ He ŋɔ Korowii saraha kon la ta jirima kon ɛɛ.” Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “He kpɔ kondɛɛra aa nyoŋa, ne anɔ la aa wola won valɛ, dɛ anɔ la bwara aa dɛ wea ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ naa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ yaa?
He kpɔ ɡɛ kwaa nɔ ka tɛ he harɛ nomoa aa, aa do o somee yaa?
O sie ɛɛ lɛ he nɛɛ dɛ ɛ he wesoŋa tɛ heya aa?
Taraken, dɛ he sɔfore dɛ soŋ mɛ ŋɔ ń kpɔ kɛ heya aa, mɛɛ no he wesoŋaa yaa?
Maa he wesoŋaa no.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.” O berɔ ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ he sɔfore la bini bɛl fee tɔɔɡe men Korowii Dea ɡbeni, bela haa joa dɛ kaa ɛ saraha la, ásɛ he bɛ won jo ka choŋi nii saraha kon la ta ɛ sarahasale.
N sie aa he nɛɛ lɛ, maa he nɔn ta saraha kon bɛlbwa ɡee lɛ.
Harɛre nɛra ɛɛ duu mɛ kohonaa, le wee leebɔr ba kaa wee cholibɔr.
Baa fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa somaa, dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa aa wera le harɛ bɛlbwa ta ba, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ duu mɛ.
Kɛ he sɔfore dɛ chɔɡ n sɔn dɛ ŋɔ n saraha kon la kah doŋa.
He ŋɔ kondikwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ba o ta la ɡe ta jirima dɔe, dɛ ɛ konsale.
He ŋɔ he mee leɔ, dɛ laa sie kpɔ saraha kwaa aa wera kɛŋɔ he kpɔ baa tɛ mɛ la ta.
Kɛ he kpɔ kondɛɛra bola aa lɔ a nɛ, ne anɔ la aa wola won valɛ kɛɛ weela tena ba ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
Mɛɛ lɛa yaa?
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ pedɛɛɡe do o peera bini, dɛ baɡ mɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ ba tɛ mɛ, dɛ berɛ kpɔ onɔ la waa di kirihiah ba ɛ saraha tɛ mɛ la, o neɡ mɛ.
Nyotaahna lɔ o nɛ.
N ɛ koojen, a chɛ kɛ harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɔm mɛ.”
Sɔfore kaeh wa Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ sɔfore la be ŋɔ, “Hé no, waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa laanee kɛŋɔ, dɛ he vɛh n waa nɔ noe, dɛ vɛh jirima kpɔe dɛ́ tɛ n sɔn he bambile bwa ne naa, taahnaa mɛɛ ba heyaa taahna, dɛ́ ɡel kɛ n fe aa swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heya.
N dɔɔ taah heya, dɛkalkɛ he ta he liire ɛɛ kɛŋɔ he kpɔ jirima tɛ mɛ.
He we-ɛɛla nomanta, mɛɛ tɛr he naanar deŋnee, dɛ́ kpɔ kondɛɛra haa kpoora ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ mɛ tɔpejena ta la bena fɔɡle he sie, ásɛ ba kpɔ he ne loŋɡboŋbena la ɡɛ kaa.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel he jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee kah heyaa dɛɛ le ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, ásɛ fɔo n ne Lewi dea tena aa fɔwa la won do le dɛɛ la.
N ne Lewi dea tena fɔo la ɛ mkpa ne deŋnesɔɔhna n kpɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Gɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel baa ɔm mɛ kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ duu mɛ.
Waa aa ɛ kasinteŋii ba baɡle, ba ta nyosone teŋe bwa.
N ne ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Waa aa toɡra ɡbo laa ba ɛ, kɛ a cheɡɛ ba nɛɛ nɛra ɡalɡa ɡe charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta.
A chɛ kɛ sɔfo bɛlbwa dɔ wejema kɛrɛdɛ le men Korowii be, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle nɛra wa, ásɛ nɛra la ba be kaa hweli n waa la.
Banee men Koranar Bwa Kooro tomɛ.
Kɛ he sɔfore le ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la ta, he webaɡla ɡelɔ nɛra ɡalɡa lɔ naa dɛ nyoɡre, dɛ chɔɡ fɔo n ne Lewi dea tena aa fɔwa la.
Anomanta, n ɡelɔ haa jirimaa dɔ, ásɛ sihiih kpo heyaa Israel tena siwi ta, dɛkalkɛ he ta n waa ta teŋɛ.
Nɛra siebɔraa he nyiŋi dɛɛ bol wa.” Juda tena Korowii habɔɔ lee Mɛɛ beŋkpoŋ laa ya dɔ aa?
Korowii beŋkpoŋ laa ta ya bwa naa?
Ɛrɛɛ ya waa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, yaa chɔɡ fɔo Korowii ne ya naawa aa fɔwa la nɔɔ?
Juda tena ta ba nyobaɡa ta teŋɛ, dɛ chɔɡ ba ne men Korowii fɔo la.
Ba ɛ waa maa kia Israel harɛ ta bwa, ne bwɛjen Jerusalam.
Baala mo nɛŋhɔɔhra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa bihaahna, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kah Korowii Dea la.
Kórowii le baa te bɛlbwa waa dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ le Israel tena bini, hale dɛ naate sɛoh ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa tɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro kwaraa noo.
Waane ɡe lole hɛɛ ɛa ja.
He wio dɛ kpɔ sinii su kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii ta bwa, dɛ wi dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre lɛɛ waa wola he saraha kwaa lɛ silɛɛ ne kpa la wa.
He dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛ waa Korowii vɛh yaa nɔɔ?’ A kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ he ne he bonɔɔne saŋ haah Korowii aa ɛ danseɛ a ta ken, dɛkalkɛ he chɔɡ fɔo haa ŋwɛɛra Korowii sie ŋɔ o ɛ he haah la.
Korowii ta ɡelɛ haah ne baa ɛ beŋkpoŋ bwadabii ne doma ta naa?
Bɔkwa waa o ɛa ɡɛ nɔɔ?
O dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he bii baa teŋɛ o waa la ta.
Anomanta, bɛlbwa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel nyobaɡa aa lɔ o ne o bonɔɔne saŋ haah baah la chɔɡ.
Koranar Bwa Kooro, Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “N kii kɛ baa ne o haah vɛh dɔŋa.
N kii baa bɛlbwa waa ɛ nyubinikpeɡ waa nɔ dɔŋa o haah nɛ.
Anomanta, bɛlbwa nyiŋi o te kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ nyobaɡa aa lɔ o ne o haah baah la chɔɡ dɛɛ di kasinteŋ.
Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.” Tɔpere Korowii aa bol o nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole He ɡelɔ Korowii mee le he wobol ta.
He dɛ pɛɛ ŋɔ “Ɛrɛɛ ya ɡel o mee leɔ?” He ŋɔ, “Korowii sie dɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa nɛ, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ leperaa Korowii o waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la dɔɔ?”
Koranar Bwa Kooro bolɔ ŋɔ, “Hé no, mɛɛ tomɛ n toromee ó tɔ n sie dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ mɛ ń ba.
Ásɛ Dɔɔ haa dɛ nyiŋu ŋwɛnɛ la ba piɡri heyaa o Dea, onee hɛɛ nyiŋi ŋwɛnɛ ó ba dɛ́ ba baɡle fɔo la wa.” Umee dɛ́ won che o sie o bala tɔpere la ta nɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won le a nyoa ɔ?
Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ nii baa kpɔa dɛɛ mwɛɛ bune dɛ laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ a ta, kɛɛ simina waa nyɛɡa ken.
Wɛɛ ba sɔ Lewi dea tena doŋaa ta kɛŋɔ ba yon mwɛɛ suuɡapoŋ ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ laa doŋa kpɔ a ta la ken.
Gɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɔe, ásɛ ba kpɔ saraha kwaa aa wera baa tɛo, mɔɔ Korowii sie lɛ dɛ́ lɛ Juda ne bwɛjen Jerusalam nɛra saraha kwaa baa kpɔ baa tɛo la, ɡɛ a fa aa doa saŋ la.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ bao warane dɛ́ ba bol he waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Mɛɛ ba bol voɡra ne nɛra baa dɛ chɔɡ yal, ne dansewea tena ne nɛra baa dɛ faah ba tom-ɛɛra ba kembɔr ta, ne nɛra baa dɛ fiiɡi luhaahna ne bilalbii, ne nɛra baa wola nɛŋhɔɔhra waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta, baa wola men ɔmɛ bwa waa.” Korowii ŋɔ, “Menee Korowii, maa charɛ bwa, a waa ɡela he Jekɔb naanar ta do le la.
He ne he naawa bwaa berɛ habɔɔ kpo mɛ, dɛ vɛh me Mmarare ta teŋa.
Hé berɛ ba n be, ásɛ n ɡe do sie he be.
Kɛ he dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ ya ɛ dɛ́ berɛ won ba he be nɔ?’ N dɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ a wer kɛŋɔ nɛn ŋwɛ men Korowii aa?
Kɛ he dɛ ŋwɛɛ mɛ.
He dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa taa yaa ŋwɛɛ nɔ?’ Kwaa haa bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ baa tɛ mɛ, ne saraha kwaa taa hɛɛ ŋwɛɛ mɛ.
Nyotaahna lawɛ he Israel tena bwa, dɛkalkɛ he dɛ ŋwɛɛ mɛ.
Kwaa haa bɔne a bini bɔre fi la, hé kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ba tɛ men Korowii n Dea, ásɛ kondikwaa warɛ n Dea bela.
Hé daah mɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ta dɛ́ na, ásɛ n ɡel bwaala nɛ kohona, dɛ́ swee heyaa andɛɛɡa, dɛ́ ɡel kondikwaa warɛ he deremi kohona.
Maa ɡel kwaa ba chɔɡ he koo kondikwaa kpa, dɛ́ ɡel he ɡrepo daa ɡe nɔnɛ kohona.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel harɛre ta nɛra bwa yerɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna tena, dɛkalkɛ he soɡe harɛdɛɛɡe ta.
Men Koranar Bwa Kooroo bola.” Kasinteŋ tena kembɔr Korowii ŋɔ, “He bol wedoŋa tɛ mɛ.
Kɛ he berɔ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Wedoŋa besoo ya bol tɛɛ nɔ?’ He bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii toma ɛ wepuu.
Tɔnɔ besoo ya dɔ dɛɛ le waa waa kpɔa tɛ yaa ŋɔ yaa teŋɛ a ta, asɛ a berɛ do kɛŋɔ ya tea bini chɔɡɔ Koranar Bwa Kooro sie nɔɔ?
Kɛ taraken nɔ, ya dɛ yerɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ jenu bosɔɔhna tena.
Kasinteŋ, waa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ ɛ la, a dɛ do wer dɛɛ chiɡ ba kɛrɛdɛ, hale banɔ la baa dɛ tɔŋle Korowii dɛ vɛh o waa la aa deŋnetɛra bɛlbwa dɔ.’ ” Kɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii bol waa dɔŋa be, asɛ Korowii do deŋne ba be, dɛ no waa bwa baa bola.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɔ dɛɛ tɛ o sɔn jirima la, ba chwerɛ ba sɔna do tɔn bini bil o sie, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii ba wa.
Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Awola maa ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, mɛɛ kpɔ baa ɛ n bii maa dɛ nyin ba kohona.
N tea ɛɛ domɛ ba nɛɛ ń lɛɛ ba, kɛŋɔ mɛɛ yon dɔ tedoma tɛ o bie waa dɛ tomɔ dɛɛ lɛo la ken.
Hɛɛ berɔ na ɡɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra waa aa korɛ banɔ la ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa waa ta, ne ɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ men Korowii waa aa korɛ banɔ la baa wola men tomɛ waa ta.”
Korowii Tɔpere waa lea cheɡ Koranar Bwa Kooro ŋɔ, “Hé no, tɔpere men Korowii aa dɛ ba ba bol nɛra baa dɛ baɡle ba te, ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra waa la dɛ ba kpela.
Baa fuuh kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken, ba komɛlbwa aa wola ka.
Kɛ he banɔ la haa dɛ duu mɛ la, kpeɡri maa kpɔ lɛ heyaa la ɛɛ ba he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ wechɛn yon le dɛɛ tɛ bokpeɡa la.
Ásɛ he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ ba yon ya nae bii leɡ ta a sie lɛ aa jah la ken.
Awola tɔpere maa ba ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ la, hɛ́ɛ tiɡri nyubinikpeɡ tenaa do harɛ kɛŋɔ tɔɔ.
Hé lii Mmarare ne webaɡla maa cheɡɛ n bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ he Israel tena bwa ŋɔ hɛɛ teŋɛ a ta Sinai Bwejen ta la.
Hé no, mɛɛ tomɛ n keame Elaeja he bee, mɔɔ men Korowii Tɔpejen waa do ɔma kohona la ba.
Wɛɛ berɔ ɡel nyopɛo ba mɛɛnanar ne ba bii baah ta, dɛ ɡɛ laa tenaa, mɛɛ ba taah harɛ laanee ó chɔɡ.”
Amanesoma tɔne anaarɛ la wa Yeesu harɛ nɔ ta soɡa ka tel saŋ waa sewa la, nɛra banaarɛɛ chwerɛ o wa.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ teŋa nɔ, Matiu ne Mak ne Luk dɛ Jɔn.
Bɛlbwa chwerɛ Yeesu wa, ɡɛ bɛlbwa aa na o wa.
Amanesoma Matiu Aa Chwera Tɔn Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Matiu dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ nɛra jemɛ kɛ Yeesuu Lɛɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ ó ba lɛ o nɛra la.
O dɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii waa baa bola ŋɔ aa bao Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔobene Tɔn la bini la, a baa ɛ kpela ɡɛ saŋ Yeesu aa ba harɛ nɔ ta la.
O dɛ bol Yeesu lola, ne o harɛ nɔ ta soɡa dɛ ɡɛ waa sewa dɛ berɛ ir seo ta la wa.
O dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ amanesoma la ta Juu tena ɡbo kon ɛɛ, harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ɡe jao.
Matiu dɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛre Yeesu aa kpɔ a ta dɛ chaɡle nɛra wa.
Anee teŋa nɔ.
.

Harɛ Nɔ Chɔɡa Webaɡla.
Nyiŋi nyuune —.
Gɛ Yeesu Kristo nabaala aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ wa Gɛ Kooro Devid naa Yeesu Kristo nabaala aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ laanee nɔ.
Abrahamee ɛ ba bwa nyu te.
Abraham lolɛ Aesek, Aesek lolɛ Jekɔb, Jekɔb lolɛ Juda ne o dɔɔranar ne nimanar, asɛ Juda lolɛ Pɛrɛs ne Sɛra.
Ba nya sɔne Taama.
Pɛrɛs lolɛ Hɛsrɔn, Hɛsrɔn lolɛ Ram, Ram lolɛ Aminadab, Aminadab lolɛ Naasɔn, Naasɔn lolɛ Salmon, Salmon lolɛ Boas, o nya sɔne Rahab, Boas lolɛ Ɔbɛd, o nya sɔne Rut, Ɔbɛd lolɛ Jese, asɛ Jese lolɛ Kooro Devid.
Kooro Devid lolɛ Solomɔn.
Solomɔn nyaa haah bɛl Uria fa aa moo ka la, Solomɔn lolɛ Rɛhoboam, Rɛhoboam lolɛ Abija, Abija lolɛ Asa, Asa lolɛ Jehosafat, Jehosafat lolɛ Jehoram, Jehoram lolɛ Ussia, asɛ Ussia lolɛ Jotam.
Jotam lolɛ Ahas, Ahas lolɛ Hɛsɛkea, Hɛsɛkea lolɛ Manasɛ, Manasɛ lolɛ Amɔn, Amɔn lolɛ Josia, asɛ Josia lolɛ Jekonia ne o nimanar.
A ɡɛ saŋee Babelɔn tena pɔ Israel tena nɛɛ dɛ laɡ ba kaa ba harɛ la.
Baa laɡ ba kaa Babelɔn harɛ la habɔɔ Jekonia lolɛ Sealteɛl, Sealteɛl lolɛ Sɛrobabɛl, Sɛrobabɛl lolɛ Abiud, Abiud lolɛ Eliakim, Eliakim lolɛ Asɔ, asɛ Asɔ lolɛ Sadɔk.
Sadɔk lolɛ Akim, Akim lolɛ Eliud, asɛ Eliud lolɛ Eliasa, Eliasa lolɛ Matan, Matan lolɛ Jekɔb, Jekɔb ɡee lolɛ Josef.
Gɛ Josef nɔɔ mo Mɛɛre waa lolɛ Yeesu baa dɛ yerɔ Kristo, Korowii aa ŋɔa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ o nɛra la.
Le Abraham bere saŋ ka tel Kooro Devid saŋ la, naanar la lɔ fi dɛ banaarɛ.
Asɛ le Kooro Devid saŋ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ baa laɡ ba kaa Babelɔn harɛ la ɡe, naanar la lɔ fi dɛ banaarɛ.
Asɛ dɛ berɛ le ɡɛ saŋ baa laɡ ba kaa Babelɔn harɛ la ba le Kristo saŋ la, a ɡe jaɡɛ fi dɛ banaarɛ.
Yeesu Kristo lola wa Kenii Yeesu Kristo lola bini waa do.
Josef ne Yeesu nya Mɛɛre nɛra sɛoh ŋɔ ó kpɔɔ mo.
Baa wola chɔe mɔɔ la, dɛ Mɛɛre cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛ kpoŋe tea.
Dɛ o jaa Josef la ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi.
Dɛ o fe aa nyin kɛŋɔ ó do Mɛɛre sihiih nɛnfuuh baah ta, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ó sɔh dɛ́ vɛoh.
Gɛ waa nɔ aa lɔ Josef liire bini la, belaa Korowii nyundua torome bɛl ba o be deera ta dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Devid naa Josef, dɛɛ berɛ ɔma kɛŋɔ hɛɛ mo Mɛɛree.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡee ɡela o kpoŋe tea la.
Wɛɛ lolɛ bibaalee, ásɛ he pa o sɔn Yeesu, o munii kɛŋɔ Lɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ on dɛɛ ba bala dɛ́ ba lɛ o nɛra ba wechɔɡa ta.” A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa chiɡo dɛ ɡel waa Korowii aa ɡela o keame bol la ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ waa ŋɔa ŋɔ, “Bitolo waa wola baa jemɛ bwa ɛɛ kpoŋe teaa dɛ́ lolɛ bibaa, ásɛ ba yerɔ Imanoɛl.” O munii kɛŋɔ, “Korowii ne ya lole.” Josef aa ir dom ta la, o ɛ ɡɛ Korowii nyundua torome la aa ŋɔ o be la, dɛ kpɔ Mɛɛre ba o dem.
Kɛ o ne o ta chɔe bwa dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa lolɛ o bibaa la.
Waa lolɔ la, Josef pa o sɔn Yeesu.
Wejerema bane baa baa duu Yeesu Gɛ saŋ baa lolɛ Yeesu Bɛtlɛham waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta la, dɛ kooro bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Hɛrɔd di kora.
Belaa wejerema bane baa jemɛ weweela waa le wee leebɔr harɛ bɛl ta dɛ ba Jerusalam, dɛ ba bɔɔ bela tena ŋɔ, “Leperaa Juu tena kooro baa lolɔ taraken la dɔɔ?
Ya na wewee bɛl wee leebɔr ya bwɛɛ o baɡle kɛŋɔ ba lolɔ.
Anee ya ba dɛ́ ba duuru.” Kooro Hɛrɔd ne Jerusalam tena bwa aa no ɡɛ kooro nɔ waa la, ɔmee laɡ ba.
Anomanta, kooro la yerɛ Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema la bwa ba cheme o sie dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Leperaa baa ba Kristo la Korowii aa ŋɔa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la lola ɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Baa lolɔɔ Bɛtlɛham waa lɔ Juda harɛ nɔ taa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii keame la baɡlɔ ŋɔ, ‘Juda harɛ bwɛjeɡa Bɛtlɛham, Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bini bwɛsala laa hen, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he taa kooro ɛɛ ba lee, dɛ́ nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛ.’ ” Belaa Kooro Hɛrɔd yerɛ wejerema la le bokɛre, dɛ bɔɔ ba ɡɛ saŋ ɡbaɡba wewee la aa lea.
Waa bɔɔ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé takapɔ dɛ́ la Bɛtlɛham, dɛ́ ka ɡaaɡe bie la bɔr kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ na bela waa lole, dɛ́ ba ŋɔ n be ásɛ n ɡe ka duuru.” Wejerema la aa no kooro la wobol tonɛ la, ba chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ kaa.
Baa dɛ kaa la, wewee la ba fa aa nao wee leebɔr la berɔ le ja, dɛ tɔ ba sie dɛ la Bɛtlɛham, dɛ ka jaɡɛ che dem bela bie la aa lole la.
Baa na wewee la la, ba sie lɛo kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba jo dem bela, dɛ ka na bie la ne o nya Mɛɛre.
Ba kaa ɡuŋi bie la, dɛ duuru dɛ pur ba bone, dɛ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne daawiile ane a sɔɔh aa soma baa yera fraŋkensɛns ne korobo tɛ bie la.
Baa dɛ ba kaala la, Korowii cheɡɛ deera ta dɛ ja ba ŋɔ ba bɛ Hɛrɔd be la kpa, asɛ ba berɛ che ŋwɛnɛfale ta kaa ba bwɛ.
Josef ne Mɛɛre chwae kaa Ijipt harɛ ta wa Baa le bela dɛ kaa la, Korowii nyundua torome bɛl ba Josef be deera ta dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kooro Hɛrɔd dɛ ba ɡela nɛra ɡaaɡe bie la bɔr dɛ́ kpoo.
Anomanta, ir dɛ́ kpɔ bie la ne o nya bwa chwa kaa Ijipt harɛ ka so bela, ka tel ɡɛ saŋ maa berɛ ba ŋɔ hé le bela mɔɔ he le.” Asɛ Josef ir harambaŋa, dɛ kpɔ bie la ne o nya bwa chwa dɛ kaa Ijipt harɛ, dɛ ka so bela ka tel ɡɛ saŋ kooro la aa sewa.
A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ chiɡa dɛ ɡel waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame la nɛɛ bol la ɛ kasinteŋ.
O ŋɔ, “N bie lɔ Ijipt harɛ, asɛ n yerɔ o ba.” Kooro la aa baa jemɛ kɛŋɔ wejerema la neɡro la, o bwaawee iro taeh.
Dɛ o fa ta sie dɛ na kɛ ɡɛ saŋ wejerema la aa ŋɔa ba na wewee bɛl la, aa dɔ bene anɛɛ.
Anomanta, o do nɛra ŋɔ bá ɡaaɡe dɛ́ kpoo bibaala ba taa ɛ bechasɔɔhne ka tel banɔ la baa di bene anɛ, dɛ do Bɛtlɛham ne o bwɛɛre aa baro cheme la bwa ta.
A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ ɡela Korowii keame Jeremia waa o fa aa bola la ɛ kasinteŋ.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛl lɔ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Rama dɛɛ wi.
Lokua wii naate ɛɛ wi.
Rakɛl dɛ wi o bii wa, ba larawo kahonɛ, dɛkalkɛ o bii bwa serewɔ.” Josef ne Mɛɛre habɔɔ bera kaa Nasarɛt Kooro Hɛrɔd aa sewa la, dɛ Josef ta lɔ Ijipt harɛ ta, asɛ dɛ dee dɛ na Korowii nyundua torome bɛl.
Nyundua torome la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir, dɛ́ kpɔ bie la ne o nya hé kaa Israel harɛ ta ja, dɛkalkɛ naate waa dɛ nyin bie la dɛ́ kpo la sewɔ.” Anee Josef ir, dɛ kpɔ bie la ne o nya bwa dɛ berɛ kaa Israel harɛ.
Waa noa kɛ Akelɔs chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta dɛ ɛ kooro Juda harɛ ta la, dɛ o fe dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ó kaa bela.
Korowii berɔ jao deera ta ŋɔ o bɛ Juda harɛ la, asɛ o kaa Galilia harɛ ta dɛ ka so bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Nasarɛt la ta.
Anee ɡela waa Korowii keame la fa aa bola ŋɔ, “Baa yerɔ Nasarɛt tee” la ɛ kasinteŋ.
Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee wa A ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ baa bɛl waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee baa yerɔ Jɔn ba Juda harɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, dɛ baa bol Korowii Waa ŋɔ, “Hé charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii Kora pu heyaa tonɛ.” Jɔn nɔ waa Korowii keame Aesaya faa bol la.
O ŋɔ, “Nomɛl dɛ bol waa takpeɡ ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ ŋɔ, nɛ́ra ɡel ba we-ɛɛla toɡre, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ kpa ba Dɔɔ bala.” Gɛ Jɔn nɔ, nyoɡma pona nee ba sɔh o yal, asɛ o kpɔ ol tɔn ɛ kiriso dɛɛ vɔwɛ o chara.
O kondikwaa ɡee tontombɛ ne tooh.
Dɛ nɛra le Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ ta bobɛlbwa, ne bwɛɛre aa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa bwa dɛɛ ba o be.
Ba bol ba wechɔɡa chaɡlo waa, dɛ o sɔ ba Korowii nee moo la ta.
Jɔn aa naa kɛ Farisii ne Saduki tena ɡe warɔ dɛɛ ba o be ó sɔ ba Korowii nee la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nɛnchɔɡa kɛŋɔ domkpuli bii baa do nii kpɔɡ ta asɛ a le dɛ chwa dɛɛ kaa la!
Umee ŋɔ he be ŋɔ hɛɛ wonoo chwa le Korowii bandia ta nɔ?
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ chaɡle kɛŋɔ he charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa ta.
He bɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ haa ɛ Abraham naanar la ɡbo ɛɛ wonoo ɡel he chwa Korowii bandia la.
Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɛɛ wonoo ɡel bwea nɔ beɡre Abraham naanar.
He do kɛŋɔ daa.
Daa bɛlbwa waa wola nɔndɛɛɡa nɔnɛ la, baa teŋoo ta dɛ́ fuuh.
Gɛɛ Korowii ɡe ɡɔɔ o kpanfɛ nɛra baa wola ba liire charɛ la nɛɛ dɛɛ ba ba teŋna ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ba do nii ta bá fuh.
N te, nee n kpɔ dɛɛ sɔ heyaa Korowii nee dɛ chaɡle kɛ he charɛ he liire le wechɔɡa ta.
Kɛ naate waa ba n habɔɔ la te, wɛɛ kpɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ne niinii sɔ heya.
O ɡwaa mɛ.
Maa o napaa tee kwaraa dɔ.
O do kɛŋɔ paa waa cheɡɛ o pɛla ta, dɛ kpɔ o te dɛɛ ba mea pala.
Wɛɛ palɛ a bwaa kɛrɛdɛ ken, ásɛ dɛ pa ka do dɔndɔŋ bini cheɡ.
Kɛ a pɛɡa la te, wɛɛ kpɔ nii aa wola dime bwaa fuah.” Yeesu Korowii nee sɔe wa Gɛ saŋee Yeesu le Galilia harɛ dɛ ba Jɔɔdan Moo la nyoa Jɔn be ŋɔ ó sɔɔ Korowii ne.
Dɛ Jɔn fe dɛ nyin vɛɛh, dɛ ŋɔ, “Menee chɛ kɛŋɔ ń ba he be hé sɔ mɛ Korowii ne, ɡɛɛ he ba n be naa?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Taraken nɔ te, sɔ mɛ.
He sɔ mɛ naa, ɡɛɛ yaa ba wona ɛ wedɛɛɡa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi la bwa.” Asɛ mɔɔ Jɔn sɛh dɛ sɔɔ nee la.
Waa sɔɔ Korowii nee la tonɛ la, Yeesu le nee la ta dɛ ba che baŋ.
Nyundua pilo, asɛ o na Korowii Domadɛɛɡe o do kɛŋɔ borɔnoma ken dɛ ba so o nɛ.
Asɛ taa bɛl le nyundua ŋɔ, “N bie maa dɛ nyinu o wa ɛɛ su n siwii nɔ.”
Gɛ Bɔnsam aa daah Yeesu na Belaa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpɔ Yeesu kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, ásɛ Bɔnsam daahno na.
Dɛ Yeesu vɔwɛ nyoa tɔpebire fifraanaarɛ.
Dɛ lɔr dɛ kpoo.
Anee Bɔnsam ba o be dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ henee Korowii Bie la kpela aa, ɡel bwea nɔ berɛ paanoo hé di.” Anee Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, ‘Kondikwaa ɡbo laa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn mkpa.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol la bwa ɡe dɛ tɛ nɛn mkpa.’ ” Anee Bɔnsam kpɔɔ kaa Korowii Bwɛjen Jerusalam la ta, dɛ kpɔɔ ka cheɡ Korowii Dea la nyundujaɡla, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ henee Korowii Bie la kpela aa, che bonɔ dɛ́ jah le harɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo o nyundua toroma ɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Baa lawɛɛ haa wola nakpala kwaraa lɔ.’ ” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Korowii Tɔn ɡe baɡlɔ ŋɔ, ‘Bɛ N Naa Korowii daah na.’ ” Asɛ Bɔnsam berɛ kpɔɔ ka chɔŋɛ bobɛl waa do kɛŋɔ bwejen bɛl doa, dɛ baɡlo harɛ nɔ ta bela bwa kora dii aa lole, ne kondɔɔh ne konjena aa lɔ o ta bwa ɡale o sie ta, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ɡuŋ mɛ harɛ dɛ duu mɛ naa, mɛɛ kpɔ kwaa haa naa nɔ bwaa tɛɛ.” Anee Yeesu kɔro ŋɔ, “Le n jwɛɛh kaa, Bɔnsam!
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, ‘Dɛɛ duu N Naa Korowii dɛɛ tomɛ o ɡbo.’ ” Anee Bɔnsam ɡelo dɛ kaa, asɛ nyundua toroma ba chao.
Yeesu toma mun pae Galilia harɛ ta Gɛ saŋ Yeesu aa noa kɛ ba lawɛ Jɔn do dea la, o berɔ kaa Galilia harɛ ta.
O la Nasarɛt, kɛ o ta bela soɡe, dɛ berɛ ka so bwɛɛ bɛl waa lɔ Galilia Moo la nyoa, dɛ do Sebulon ne Naftale harɛ ta baa yerɔ Kapeeneɔm la ta.
Gɛ waa nɔɔ ɡela Korowii keame Aesaya waa o fa aa bola la ɛ kasinteŋ.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa lɔ Sebulon ne Naftale harɛre aa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ, dɛ́ kpɔ kaa mpo nyoa bela la, Galilia harɛ ta bela nɛra baa wola Juu tena aa wara dɛ koo Juu tena bini la.
Nɛra ba fa aa do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa soɡe biro ta, berɔ na nii bɛl o chaah tɛ ba bwa.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ ba wechɔɡa aa ɡela ba do seo lɔɡa, kɛ nɛra baa soɡe biro ta la, ba na nii bɛl o chaah kohona tɛ ba bwa.” Gɛ saŋ laanee Yeesu pa mun bol waa dɛɛ chaɡle nɛra ŋɔ, “Hé charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii Kora la pu heyaa tonɛ.” Gɛ Yeesu aa kpɔ o loɡla habɔteŋra Yeesu aa dɛ valɛ Galilia Moo la nyoa la, o na baala banɛ baa dɛ ɛ nee toma dɛɛ ta asau.
Baala banɛ laanee Seemɔn baa dɛ yerɔ Pita la ne o nime Andriu.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel he pɛŋa la nyina dɛ́ ba teŋɛ n nɛ, ásɛ n baɡle heyaa ɡɛ baa nyin nɛra baa tɛ Korowii.” Buɡ la ta, ba den ɡel ba asauri la bela, dɛ kpɔ teŋɛ o nɛ.
Waa dɛ kaa sie la, o berɔ ka na Sebedii bii banɛ, Jems ne o nime Jɔn, dɛ ba ne ba mɛɛ lɔ ɡbera bini dɛɛ tɔɔɡe ba asauri, asɛ Yeesu yer ba.
Buɡ la ta, ba den ɡel ba mɛɛ ne ɡbera la bela, dɛ kpɔ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Gɛ Yeesu aa chah weela tena Yeesu ɡaaɡe Galilia harɛ ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ jo cheremi deene bini, dɛɛ chaɡle nɛra Korowii Kora la Amanesoma wa, dɛɛ chah nɛra baa dɛ we weela bwa soo siwi.
O waa perɛ Siiria harɛ bobɛlbwa, anomanta, bela tena kpɔ ba weela tena baa dɛ we weela bwa soo siwi dɛ ba o be.
Banɔ la kwaa aa dɛ ir ba nɛ, ne banɔ la baa dɛ we ɡbuŋɡbuŋri, ne banɔ la ba nɔɔra ne ba nakpale aa serewa bwaa ba kpɔ ba Yeesu be o chaah ba.
Dɛ nɛnlaa tenten le Galilia harɛ ne bwɛɛre fi baa dɛ yera Dekapɔles la, ne Jerusalam, ne Juda harɛ, ne Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ bwɛɛre bwa ta, dɛ kpɔ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Som nae ne tebinichɔɡ wa Yeesu aa na nɛnlaa la la, anee o teeh bwejen bɛl dɛ ka so, asɛ o habɔteŋra la baro cheme, asɛ wɛɛ baɡ ba waa dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ kɛ nyaara la, ba na som, dɛkalkɛ banee dɛɛ ba Korowii Kora la koobii ɛɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ wi taraken la, ba na som, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɛɛ larawe ba bwaraa.
Nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te la, ba na som, dɛkalkɛ Korowii nyobaɡa la, banee o baɡɛ tɛ.
Nɛra ba sie aa beɡre waa aa toɡra dɛɛ su Korowii siwi la, ba na som, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɛɛ cha baa a ta kɛrɛdɛɛ bá dɔa ba tetoora.
Nɛra baa dɛ na nɛra sum la, ba na som, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɡee na ba sumii.
Nɛra ba tea bini aa toa la, ba na som, dɛkalkɛ banee dɛɛ ba Korowii nae.
Nɛra baa dɛ larawe waa dɛɛ sɔɔh waa nyoa la, ba na som, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɛɛ yer ba o biirii.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi, nɛra koh a waa dɛɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la, ba na som, dɛkalkɛ banee dɛɛ ba Korowii Kora la koobii ɛɛ.
Dɛ nɛra koh teŋa haa teŋɛ n nɛɛ nɔ waa dɛɛ chɛɡre heya, dɛɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa, dɛɛ teŋe nyosone, dɛ bol musu waa bɛlbwa dɛɛ dawɛ he nɛ aa, he na som.
Hé ɡel he sie lɛ kohona, dɛkalkɛ he kembɔr kan taeh Korowii be.
Gɛɛ ba kpɔ ɛ Korowii keamere baa tɔ sie la.
Yar ne nii waa dɛ chaah wa He do kɛŋɔ yar aa dɛ kwaa dɔr nɛwɛnyina bwa bini.
Dɛ yar aa somɛ kpa aa, ɛrɛɛ baa ba a ɛɛ á do som jaɔ?
A ta wejema dɔe bá ɛ kpa.
Fuɡaa a den chɛ kɛŋɔ bá fuɡa ta dɛ́ tiɡri a ta.
He do kɛŋɔ nii waa dɛ chaah bɔr nɛwɛnyina bwa bini.
Bwɛjen waa dawɛ deŋɡare doa la aa won sɔh.
Nomɛlbwa aa kandea choŋi dɛ́ kpɔ kon dɛɛ pi o ta.
Kɛ ba dɛ choŋu dɛ́ kpɔ chɔŋɛ kon ta, ásɛ o chaah tɛ nɛra baa lɔ dem bela la bwa.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ hé chaah tɛ nɛra, ásɛ ba na he wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ, dɛ́ duu he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la.” Korowii Mmara la waa baɡla Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé bɛ dɛɛ lii kɛ n balɔ dɛ́ ba chɔɡ Mosis Mmara la ne waa Korowii keamere la aa chaɡla la.
A chɔɡa laa n ba.
N balɔ dɛ́ ba ɡel á dɔ mun kɛrɛdɛ.
Kasinteŋ, nyundua ne harɛ taa lole nɔ, Mmara nɔ bini wejeɡa bɛlbwa aa lee ba, hale dɛ́ ka tel wobɛlbwa jaɡa saŋ.
Anomanta, naate waa berɛ Mmara la bini onjeɡa bɛlbwa dɛ́ berɛ chaɡle bane ɡe bá ɛ ɡɛ la, waa bɔr dɔe ba Korowii Kora bini.
Naate ɡe waa dɛ teŋɛ Mmara la ta, dɛ́ chaɡle bane ɡe baa ɛ ɡɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ nomonsoŋnibɔree Korowii Kora bini.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, dɛ he wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ɡwaalaa, haa won ja Korowii Kora ta ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
Nɛŋkpoa wa He noɔ kɛ ba ŋɔ saŋ la tena be ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ nɛn kpo.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpo nɛn la, o ɛ wechɔɡa kɛŋɔ bá bol o waa dɛ́ pa bole.’ Kɛ taraken, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, nomɛlbwa o baah aa di o dɔŋ nɛɛ la, o ɛ wechɔɡa kɛŋɔ bá bol o waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa yerɛ o dɔŋ nɛnsala la chɛ kɛ ó che Juu tena nomonome bwa sie.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa o ɡe aa yerɛ o dɔŋ koŋɡɛne bɛl la, a chɛ kɛ bá tao Bɔnsam nii ta.
Anomanta, dɛ he kpɔ jam kwaa dɛɛ la ká tɛ Korowii bela baa dɛ fuh kwaa dɛɛ tɛo la, dɛ lii kɛ he ne he dɔŋ bɛl dɔ waane aa, ɡel he kwaa la bela, dɛ́ la ka nyin he dɔŋ la hé ne o nyoa ka pɛ mɔɔ he ba kpɔ he kwaa la tɛ Korowii.
Dɛ he ne he dɔŋ dɔɔ, asɛ o kpɔe dɛɛ kaa kɔɔto aa, larawo hé kwaa he baah.
Gɛ laa aa, o dɔɔ tel he ne bela aa, kɔɔto nomoa la ɛɛ kpɔe tɛ prosiri bá ka doe dea.
Kasinteŋ, dea belaa hɛɛ ba kae ka tel ɡɛ saŋ haa bɔ he kem la bwa, kapɛrɛ ɡba aa wola ka mɔɔ ba lee.” Jwamane wa Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “He noɔ kɛ ba fa aa ŋɔa ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ jwamane dɛɛ bɔ.’ Kɛ taraken n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, he naate haa na haah dɛ nyiŋu he pɛla do o nɛɛ la, he bɔ jwamane he bambile bini.
Anomanta, dɛ he diɡ siwi ɛɛ ɡeloo he ɛ wechɔɡa aa, fomo ta!
He fomo ta kwaraa bɔ kɛ haa kpɔ sibie anɛ kaa Bɔnsam nii ta.
Dɛ he nɔndiɡ ɛɛ ɡeloo he ɛ wechɔɡa aa, teŋo ta!
He teŋo ta kwaraa bɔ kɛ haa kpɔ nɔɔra anɛ kaa Bɔnsam nii ta.
Baa ne haah dɔŋa vɛɛh wa Ba fa ŋɔ nomɛlbwa dɛ ba o haah vɛɛh yaa, ó chwerɛ tɔn tɛo dɛ́ vɛoh.
Kɛ taraken te, n ŋɔ baa bɛlbwa o haah naa wola baala nyine, asɛ o vɛoh la, o di bolchɔɡe, dɛkalkɛ o ɡelɔ haah la bɔ jwamane.
Asɛ naate ɡe waa bera ka mo haah la baa vɛoh la, o ɡe bɔ jwamane.” Korowii nyoa baɡa ne ŋwɛɛra wa Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “He noɔ kɛ baa ŋɔ saŋ la tena be ŋɔ, ‘He bɛ waa haa baɡɛ nyoa dɛ ŋwɛɛ a ta la ta koni.
Hé ɛ waa la tɛ Korowii.’ Kɛ n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, he bɛ ŋwɛɛ kwaraa.
He bɛ nyundua ŋwɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii soŋnibɔree.
He bɛ harɛ ŋwɛɛ, o natiɡribɔree.
He bɛ bwɛjen Jerusalam ŋwɛɛ, Koojen bwɛɛ bela.
He bɛ he nyu ɡba ŋwɛɛ.
Haa won ɡel he nyumpon beŋkpoŋ ɡba to, ɡɛɛ haa wola won ɡel ó bir ɡe.
Ba dɛ bɔɔre waa dɛ a ɛ kpela aa, sɛh ŋɔ, ‘Ɔɔh,’ dɛ nyosone ɡee yaa, ŋɔ, ‘Ɔɔhɔh.’ He bol waane ja a ta naa, amɔ a te le Bɔnsam be.
Wechɔɡa kem bɔe wa He noɔ kɛ ba fa aa ŋɔa ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ nɛn fome he siwi aa, hé ɡe fome o siwi.
Dɛ nɛn fome he nyen aa, hé ɡe fome o nyen.’ Kɛ taraken te n ŋɔ, dɛ nomɛl ɛɛ wechɔɡa aa, bɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ bɔɔ kem.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa kpaa he diɡ lwɛɛma aa, berɛ ɡal lwɛɛma la ɡe tɛo ó kpaa ja.
Dɛ nomɛl dɛ nyin kɛ ó kpɔe la kɔɔto, dɛ ka lɛ he batakaare aa, kpɔ he yal ɡe jao.
Dɛ kpeɡnɛn ɡe dɛ doe ŋɔ hé che o bone ka doo kwansini beŋkpoŋ naa, che ka doo kwansini anɛ.
Dɛ nomɛl soŋe komɛl aa, kpɔ tɛo.
Dɛ nomɛl ɡe ŋɔ o dɛ nyin komɛl dɛ kemaa, kpɔ kemɔ.
Dɔma nyina wa He noɔ kɛ ba fa aa ŋɔa ŋɔ, ‘Hé nyin he daamanar dɛ́ hah he dɔma.’ Kɛ taraken n dɛ ŋɔ he be, hé nyin he dɔma dɛ́ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, ásɛ nɛra jemɛ kɛ he ɛ he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la bii, dɛkalkɛ o te ɡelɔ wee lɔ dɛɛ tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ne nɛndɛɛɡa bwa, dɛ nɛ bwaala ɡe dɛɛ tɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa.
Dɛ he dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ nyin heyaa ɡbo aa, kembɔr besoo hɛɛ ba dɔe le Korowii be nɔ?
Toɔ lɛɛra baa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡba dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ nyin ba wa.
Dɛ he ne he chamene tena ɡbo dɛ bol wa aa, dɛ amee he ɛ ɡwaa he bala ɔ?
Hale nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ ɡba won ɡɛ ɛɛ!
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé we-ɛɛla bwa do kaih, ɡɛ he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la waa aa do kaih la.”
Kwaa kɛɛ wa Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ berɛ he wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ nɛwɛnyini sie ta, ásɛ baa kpɛɛ heya.
Dɛ he dɛ ɛ he wedɛɛɡa nɛwɛnyini sie ta naa, hɛɛ paŋɛ he kembɔree he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la sie.
Anomanta, dɛ he dɛ ba nɛn kon kɛɛ yaa, he bɛ kpɔ lɔ dawuro dɛ́ ɡel nɛra jemɛ, ɡɛ nɛra baa na nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ waa yon dɛɛ ɛ cheremi deene ne fɔɡbaahna la.
Ba te dɛ́ nyin kɛ nɛra na ba wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛ́ kpɛɛ ba.
Kasinteŋ, ba te dɔ ba kembɔr tonɛ.
Dɛ he te dɛ́ ba nɛn kon kɛɛ yaa, he bɛ ɡel he dansom ɡba jemɛ.
Hé sɔh dɛ́ kɛo, ásɛ he Mɛɛ la waa dɛ na waa haa ɛa dɛɛ sɔh bwa la bɔ heyaa kem.” Korowii soŋa wa Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “He dɛ ba Korowii soŋa aa, he bɛ he te ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ na nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ waa la.
Banee yon dɛɛ nyin cheremi deene ne fɔɡbaahna cheɡa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii, ásɛ nɛra na ba.
Kasinteŋ, ba te dɔ ba kembɔr tonɛ.
Dɛ he te dɛ́ ba Korowii soŋa aa, hé kpɔ he te sɔh mɔɔ dɛ́ soŋe Korowii waa ɛ he Mɛɛ baa wola on na la.
Onee dɛɛ na waa haa ɛa dɛɛ sɔh bwa.
Onee dɛ́ bɔ heyaa kem.
He bɛ wobojaŋa aa wola mun dɔe dɛɛ bol he Korowii soŋa ta kɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, baa wola Korowii tomɛ la yon dɛɛ ɛ la.
Ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba wobojaŋa laanee dɛ́ ɡel ba voɡa no ba wa.
He bɛ ɛ kɛ ban.
He Mɛɛ la jemɛ he wenyina bwa mɔɔ hɛɛ soŋo.
Kenii chɛ kɛ hɛɛ soŋe Korowii, ‘Ya Mɛɛ haa lɔ nyundua, henee chɛ duura.
Baɡle he kora dii harɛ nɔ ta.
Gel ya ɛ he tetoowaa harɛ nɔ ta, ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛa nyundua la.
Tɛ yaa ya fini kondikwa, dɛ́ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa kɛ yaa, ɡɛ yaa kpɔ ya dɔŋa wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ ba la.
Dɛɛ ke yaa wechɔɡa luɡri ta.
Le yaa musu ta.
He kora dii, ne he kpeɡri, ne he jirima ta jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Aamen.’ Dɛ he kpɔ he dɔŋa wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ heyaa dɛɛ kɛ ba aa, he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la ɡee kpɔ he wechɔɡa haa dɛ ɛ laanee dɛɛ kɛ heya.
Kɛ dɛ haa he dɔŋa wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛɛ kɛ ba aa, he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la ɡe aa he kwaa kpɔ kɛ heya.” Nyoa vɔwa wa Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “He dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa aa, he bɛ dɛɛ ŋwe kɛ nɛra baa dɛ na nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa, aa dɛ ɛ la.
Dɛ ba te dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa aa, ɡɛɛ ba ŋwe dɛ́ laa ba siebɔr chɔɡ, ásɛ nɛra na kɛŋɔ ba dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa.
Kasinteŋ, ba te dɔ ba kembɔr tonɛ.
Kɛ he te, dɛ he dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa aa, hé samɛ he sie dɛ́ lee he nyuune, ásɛ nɛra bɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, nemenɛ he Mɛɛ baa wola on na la ɡbo.
Onee dɛɛ na waa haa ɛa dɛɛ sɔh la.
Onee dɛ́ bɔ heyaa kem.” Korowii doa kondɔɔh wa Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡel he siwi swɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta kondɔɔh ta.
Harɛ bonɔ te, kwaa won kwaa chwee, kwaa won deera dɛ́ chɔɡ, ŋwɛɛra ɡe won dea joe dɛ́ ŋwɛ.
Kɛ hé ɡel he siwi swɛɛ Korowii doa kondɔɔh ta.
Belaa kwaa aa wola toole dɛ́ chwea, aa wola dee, ŋwɛɛra ɡe aa wola won jo dea ka ŋwɛa.
Bela he kondɔɔh aa lole laanee he liire ɡe do.
Kandea waa dɛ chaah we-ɛɛla Sibie do kɛ kandea dɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyini.
Anomanta, dɛ he sibie wer aa, he dɛ na bɔr.
Dɛ a chɔɡɔ ɡe aa, amɔ dɛ he lɔ biro ta.
Gɛɛ a do, dɛ he sie beɡre Korowii waa ta naa, dɛ he wobɛlbwa chaahnɔ.
Kɛ dɛ he sie beɡre harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta naa, he lɔ biro tenten ta.” Korowii toma ne kondɔɔh wa Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa aa won tomɛ dɔɔranar banɛ.
Dɛ a ba ɡɛ naa, wɛɛ dɛɛ nyin bɛl waa dɛ́ ɡwaa bɛl.
A laa ɡe aa, o sie ɛɛ dɛɛ lɛ bɛl bee dɛ́ ɡwaa bɛl.
Haa won tomɛ Korowii dɛ́ berɛ won nyin harɛ nɔ ta kondɔɔh a maɡre.
Anomanta, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, he bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre he soɡa bini kwaa haa di ne nee haa nyɔ, ne yale haa tɔ ne laala haa do wa.
Haa jemɛ kɛ mkpa ɡwaa kondikwa, asɛ bwadabii ɡe ɡwaa yal aa?
Hé ta sie nyiŋi jumbii na.
Aa kwaa du, aa komɛ, a ta bela aa komɛ kwaa do dɔe, kɛ he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la dɛ́ tɛa kondikwaa aa di.
He ta jumbii nɔ ɡwaalaa?
He bini umee dɛ́ won kpɔ sibeɡra ŋwɛnɛ bɛl ta, dɛ́ kpɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ja o mkpa tɔpera ta nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he yale bɛ dɔe waa hiah heyaa nɔɔ?
Hé ta sie nyiŋi ɡɛ kpɔɡ bini koŋkwaa dɛ fe aa, a fee yon do wer la dɛ́ na.
Aa toma ɛ dɛɛ koh, aa yabi ta.
Kɛ n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, Kooro Solomɔn ɡba ne o kondɔɔh bwa, o laala ta wer doe kɛ a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwa.
Kpɔɡa haa naa a do wer fini, ásɛ kere ɡbo dɛ a serewɔ bá fuah nɔ, dɛ Korowii ɡelɔ a do wer ken naa, ɛrɛɛ waa wola won tɔ heyaa yal ɡwaala ɔ?
He yarada aa kanɛ kwara!
He bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre hɛɛ pɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwaa yaa ba dii yɔ, bɔkwaa yaa ba nyɔe yɔ, kɛɛ leperaa yaa ba yale dɔe dɛ́ tɔɔ?’ Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, baa wola Korowii tomɛ la liiree dɛɛ do a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ ta.
Kɛ he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la jemɔ kɛ he dɛ nyin anɔ bwa.
Anomanta, hé ɡel he sie beɡre Korowii Kora la ne wedɛɛɡa aa dɛ su o siwi la ta, dɛ bɛ an mun dɛɛ ta, ásɛ o kpɔ anɔ haa dɛ nyin nɔ bwa tɛ heya.
He bɛ ɡel kere waa swɛɛ he siwi.
Tɔpere te bɛlbwa dɔ o waa aa lɔ o ta.
Anomanta, hé ɡel fini waa ɡbo swɛɛ he siwi.”
Dɔŋa pwaeh wa Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “He bɛ he dɔŋa dɛɛ pwah, ásɛ Korowii ɡe bɛ heyaa pwah, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ pwah he dɔŋa la, ɡɛɛ Korowii ɡee ba heyaa pwaeh.
Kon haa kpɔa maɡɛ kwaa tɛ he dɔŋ la tentenee baa ba kpɔe maɡɛ tɛ he ɡe.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ bol he dɔŋ wechɔɡa tama wa, haa wola he te wechɔɡdamanta dawɛ nɔɔ?
A do kɛŋɔ dabor aa lɔ he siwi ta haa wola on kpɔe, dɛ ŋɔ he dɔŋ be ŋɔ ó ɡel he laa dapuɡri kpɔ o siwi ta.
Nɛn haa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
Tɔ sie laa dabor la kpɔ he siwi ta mɔɔ, dɛ́ won na kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ laa dapuɡri waa lɔ he dɔŋ siwi ta la kpɔ.
Dɛ hé dɛ bol Korowii Amanesoma dɛɛ baɡle nɛra, asɛ baa no dɛ ɛa kɛ wesalee yaa, hé ɡel ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he kpɔ kondɛɛɡa tɛ nyootena aa, aa wola a waa jemɛ la, aa ɡelaa dɛ́ ba dorome.
He kpɔ kondɛɛɡa ta parakooni ɡe aa, aa tiɡri a taa dɛ́ laa chɔɡ.” Konnyina soŋa Korowii be wa Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii, wɛɛ tɛ heyaa.
Hɛ́ɛ nyin he konnyina o be, hɛɛ dɔɔ.
Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ lɔ ɡbera, wɛɛ ya heyaa.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ soŋo la dɛ dɔ, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o konnyina dɛɛ le o be la, o dɛ tɛo.
Gɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba ɡbera yae dɛ́ tɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ lɔ la.
He bini umee o bie ɛɛ nyin paanoo, ásɛ o kpɔ bwe tɛo wɔ?
Kɛɛ dɛ o dɛ nyin pɛŋe aa, ó ka lawɛ harɛkon ba tɛo wɔ?
Dɛ he wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔ kwara jemɔ dɛ kpɔ kondɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ he bii aa, ɛrɛ waa he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la te aa wola kondɛɛɡaa kpɔ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ soŋo wɔ?
Gɛ haa dɛ nyin kɛ nɛra ɛ dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la, hé ɡe ɛ ɡɛ tenten dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
A ɡɛɛ dɛɛ baɡle Mosis Mmara la, ne Korowii keamere la webaɡla la bini kɛrɛdɛ.” Ŋwɛnɛ waa feela wa Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛre anɛɛ lole, bɛl do feelɔɔ ken, bɛl ɡe paɡri.
Hé kpɔ ŋwɛnɛfeelɔɔ la ta, dɛkalkɛ onɔ la waa paɡa la dɛ́ kaa he ne seo ta.
O ta kpɔe pwɛre.
Anomanta, nɛra baa dɛ kpɔ o ta warɔ.
Kɛ onɔ la waa do feelɔɔ la dɛ́ kaa he ne mkpa ta.
O ɡe ta kpɔe kpeɡri.
Anomanta, nɛra tama kenii jema dɛɛ kpɔ o ta.
Daa ne o nɔna wa Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi nyosonteŋna baa ŋɔa Korowii keameree ban la kɛrɛdɛ.
He na ba aa, ba pwɛre kɛŋɔ peera ken.
Kɛ ba bini te, ba sie beɡre kwaa kɛ ɡboli ken.
Ba we-ɛɛla taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ jem ba.
Kpeele aa won nɔnɛ kɛɛ, ɡɛɛ sɔɔh daa ɡe aa wola won nɔnɛ fiɡ nɔna.
Dadɛɛɡe nɔna wer, dachɔɡe te nɔna aa were.
Dadɛɛɡe aa won nɔnɛ nɔnchɔɡa, ɡɛɛ dachɔɡe ɡe aa wola won nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡa.
Daa bɛlbwa waa wola nɔndɛɛɡa nɔnɛ la, baa teŋo ta dɛ́ fuuh.
Anomanta, nyosonteŋna la we-ɛɛla taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ Korowii keamere laa ban.
Nɛra baa dɛ yer mɛ ‘N Dɔɔ, n Dɔɔ’ la bwa laa dɛɛ ba Korowii Kora la bini dɔe dɛ́ ja, nemenɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ n Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la tetoowa.
Tɔpejen maa ba la baa tel aa, nɛra ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ baa bol n be ŋɔ, ‘N Dɔɔ, he sɔn ne laa ya bol Korowii Waa la aa?
He sɔn ne laa ya doŋi kwaa nɛra nɛɛ la aa, kɛɛ he sɔn ne laa ya ɛ nyokpowa damanta la bwa la aa?’ A taa mɛɛ ba ba be ŋɔe ŋɔ, ‘Maa heyaa jemɛ bwa.
Hé le n sie bonɔ, wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bane!’ Demamaala banɛ bane wa Nomɛlbwa waa no n waa nɔ, dɛ ɛ ɡɛ aa dɛ baɡle la, do kɛ wejereme bɛl waa ma o dea chɔŋɛ bwe ta.
Bwaala nɛo, nenapala suuɡi, asɛ peujena ta.
Kɛ dea la ta chole, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o chɔŋɛ bwe ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa no n waa nɔ, asɛ o ta ɡɛ aa dɛ baɡle la ɛɛ la do kɛ ɡɛne bɛl waa ma o dea hɛŋle harɛ ta.
Bwaala nɛo, nenapala suuɡi, asɛ peujen ta, asɛ dea la chole biram!” Yeesu aa bol waa la tonɛ la, o webaɡla la ɛ nɛnlaa la nyokpoa, dɛkalkɛ a ta do kɛ ɡɛ Tɔnjerema la yon dɛɛ baɡle la.
O te dɛ bol waa kɛ nɛn waa dɔ waa bwa kpeɡri ken.
Yeesu aa chah baa bɛl weechɔɡa aa ɛ o bwara Yeesu aa le bwe la doa dɛ tu harɛ la, nɛnlaa teŋɛ o nɛ.
Asɛ baa bɛl weechɔɡa aa ɛ o bwara ba, dɛ ba ɡuŋi o sie dɛ ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, hɛɛ sɛoh waa, hɛɛ wonoo ɡel n bwara kwaa.” Yeesu tɛr o nɔn dɛ leɡo dɛ ŋɔ, “N sɛoh.
N ɡelɔ he bwara kwaa.” Buɡ la ta, weela la den le o nɛ.
Anee Yeesu kaoh ŋɔ, “Bɛ nomɛlbwa be ŋɔ.
Pa sie kaa Sɔfo be, dɛ́ kpɔ he te ka baɡlo ó pɛne, ásɛ he kpɔ kwaa ka tɛo ó kpo ɡɛ Mosis aa chaɡla la, á baɡle kɛ he weela la toole he nɛɛ kpa.” Rom sooja nomoa bɛl bonɔɔ chaeh wa Yeesu la Kapeeneɔm.
Waa dɛ jo bwɛɛ la ta la, Rom sooja nomoa bɛl ba dɛ ba soŋo ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, n bonɔɔ bwara dɛ weo.
O kuuɡo chɔ dea, o bwara dɛ nyɛɡo taeh.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ka chaoh.” Sooja nomoa la ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, n ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he ba n dem.
Kɛ he cheɡɛ bonɔ ŋɔ wéela la le o nɛ aa, wɛɛ ɡbaŋroo, dɛkalkɛ he dɔ wobɛlbwa kpeɡri.
N ɛ nɛn maa lɔ nomonome bane lɔɡa, dɛ dɔ soojare do n ɡe lɔɡa.
Mɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ bɛl be ŋɔ, ‘Kaa,’ ó kaa, dɛ́ berɛ ŋɔ onfale be ŋɔ, ‘Ba,’ ó ɡe ba.
Mɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ n bonɔɔ be ŋɔ, ‘Ɛ ken tɛ mɛ,’ ásɛ o ɛ.” Yeesu aa no ɡɛ la, o nyoa kpoo, o ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n ta nɛn waa dɔ yarada kɛ baa nɔ nae bwa.
N ta o yarada dɔŋ nae Israel tena kwaraa bini.
Kasinteŋ, nɛra ɛɛ le wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔree ba so Korowii Kora ta, ásɛ ba ne Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb pɛ di kondikwaa bela.
Ásɛ nɛra Korowii Kora la fe aa chɛ ba la, bá kpɔ ba ta biro ta, belaa wii ne weweele do.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ sooja nomoa la be ŋɔ, “Kaa dem.
Gɛ haa yaradaa nɔ, á ɛ ɡɛ tɛɛ.” Buɡ la taa, nomoa la bonɔɔ la dɔ bokpeɡa.
Yeesu chah nɛndamanta bane Yeesu la Pita dem dɛ ka na kɛ Pita helahaah bwara wɔrɔbɔ o chɔ kalaŋ ta.
Yeesu lawɛ o nɔn, weela la le o nɛ o bwara sɔɔhno, asɛ o ir dɛ daa kwaa tɛo.
Bɔr aa joa la, ba kpɔ nɛra kwaa aa dɛ ir ba nɛɛ ba Yeesu be, o kpɔ o nyoa wobol doŋi kwaa la le ba nɛ, asɛ dɛ chah weela tena ɡe.
Anɔ nɔɔ ɡela Korowii keame Aesaya waa waa bola bil la ɛ kasinteŋ.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Onee laa ya ɡwɛɡra ne ya weela kpɔ ya nɛ.” Gɛ Yeesu nɛɛ teŋa aa kpeɡa Yeesu aa na nɛnlaa la aa baro cheme la, o ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ bá le Galilia Moo baŋ.
Tɔnjereme bɛl balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, bobɛlbwa haa dɛ la la, mɛɛ teŋɛ he nɛɛ kaa.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Manyajeɡre kwaraa dɔ bɔɔne dɛɛ chɔ a bini, asɛ jumbii aa dɛ ɡah nyundua ɡe dɔ a kɔne.
Kɛ Men Nɛn Bie te ta bobɛlbwa dɔe ń chɔ dɛ́ onɛ.” Anee o habɔteŋra la bɛl ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, ɡel n la, ásɛ n mɛɛ baa sewaa ń huɡo mɔɔ dɛ́ ba teŋɛ he nɛ.” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Hé te teŋɛ n nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra baa wola Korowii mkpa dɔe, dɛ do kɛ nɛra baa sewa Korowii ta la ɛɛ huɡe ba dɔŋa.” Yeesu sɔɔh peujen bɛl nyoa Yeesu jo ɡbera bini, o ne o habɔteŋra la ɛɛ kaa.
Buɡ la ta, dɛ peujen bɛl dɛ ta moo la sie, asɛ nehɛma ɡel ba ɡbera la ɛɛ ba mora.
A ɡɛ saŋ nɔ dɛ Yeesu te chɔ dom ɡbera la bini.
O habɔteŋra la kaa chumu dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔ, lɛ yaa!
Ya dɛ ba serewa!” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Oo!
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɔmɛ kohona ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Haa men yarada kwaraa!” Asɛ o den ir, dɛ kɔr peujen la ne nehɛma la ŋɔ á ɡel ɡɛ.
Waa bol ɡɛ la, dɛ bɔr denɔ hel kerkerker ken.
A ɛ nɛra la bwa nyokpoa baa pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo siwii nɔ, peu ne nehɛma ɛɛ no o wobol nɔɔ?” Baala banɛ bane kwa aa dɛ ir ba nɛɛ weela chaeh Yeesu aa le moo la baŋ dɛ ba Gadara harɛ ta la, baala banɛ bane kwa aa dɛ ir ba nɛɛ le lala huɡribɔr dɛ ba chemo.
Wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ nomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa aa won bela baa lole kpɔ.
Baa chemo la, ba den kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ya be nɔ, Korowii Bie?
He dɛ ba ba do yaa weweele mɔɔ ya weweele nae saŋ la tel kɛɛ?” Dɛ parako damanta ane lɔ ba jwɛɛh bela dɛɛ di kwa.
Anee kwaa aa dɛ ir baala la nɛɛ la soŋe Yeesu ŋɔ, “Dɛ hɛɛ doŋi yaa te naa, ya dɛ soŋe, ɡel ya ka so parakooni nɔ nɛ.” Yeesu kɔra ŋɔ, “Hé kaa!” Asɛ a bwa den le ka so parakooni la nɛ, asɛ a ɡe bwa den ɡbomɛ biribiribiri, dɛ wili diŋɡoŋ ka le moo la ta dɛ serewe.
Nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi parakooni la chwao kaa bwɛɛ la ta, dɛ ka bol waa aa chiɡ bela la bwa, ne waa aa pu baala la kwaa aa dɛ ir ba nɛɛ la wa.
Anomanta, nɛra baa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta la bwa chwao dɛ ba cheme Yeesu, asɛ baa baa nao la, ba soŋo ŋɔ ó le ba harɛ ta.
Gɛ Yeesu aa chah baa bɛl waa kuuɡa so Yeesu jo ɡbera ta dɛ ɡale moo la kaa o ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ ta.
Belaa nɛra bane kpɔ weela te bɛl waa kuuɡa so fɔɔ kalaŋ ta dɛɛ chemo.
Yeesu aa na ɡɛ baa yaradao la, o ŋɔ naate waa kuuɡa la be ŋɔ, “Sɔɔh bwara.
Aa maɡroo, n bie.
N kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛɛ.” Anee Tɔnjerema bane lii ba nyu bini ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ dɛ ɛ Korowii nɛnhɛla!” Yeesu aa jemɛ waa aa lɔ ba nyu bini la, o ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii musu waa nɔɔ?
Maa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ n kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo nɔ, ne kɛŋɔ maa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ir dɛ́ valɛ, a bini umee kpeɡa ɔ?
Mɛɛ chaɡle heyaa kɛŋɔ Men Nɛn Bie dɔ kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta kɛ ń kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa kɛ ba.” Belaa o ŋɔ naate waa kuuɡa la be ŋɔ, “Ir dɛ́ kpɔ he kalaŋ kaa dem!” Baa la den ir che dɛ kaa o dem.
Nɛnlaa la aa na a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ɔmee laɡ ba, ba kpɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ waa tɛ nɛwɛnyini ɡe kpeɡri ŋɔ ó ba won ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ la.
Gɛ Yeesu aa yerɛ Matiu Yeesu aa le bela dɛ valɛ dɛɛ kaa la, o kaa na baa bɛl waa dɛ lɛ toɔ baa yerɔ Matiu, dɛ o soɡe o toma ta dɛɛ lɛ toɔ.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ba teŋɛ n nɛ.” Asɛ Matiu ir dɛ teŋɛ o nɛ.
Yeesu la Matiu dem dɛ ka so tiɡ ta.
Waa dɛ di kwaa la, toɔ lɛɛra baa dɛ bɔ apoo ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra pirim baa ja o ne o habɔteŋra la nɛɛ baa di.
Farisii tena bane aa na ɡɛ la, ba pɛɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa he dɔɔ nɔ ne a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ pɛ dɛɛ di kwaa nɔɔ?” Yeesu no waa baa pɛɛra la, dɛ chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Weela tenaa hiah tɛɛɡa te, bokpeɡa tena laa.
Hé ka kwaa hweli waa baa chwera bil heyaa ŋɔ, ‘He dɛ na he dɔŋa sum aa, anee mɛɛ nyin dɛ ɡwaa kɛ haa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ’ la.
Nɛra baa dɛ lii ba te nɛndɛɛɡa waa laa n ba.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra waa n ba, ásɛ ba charɛ ba liire.” Nyoa vɔwa wepɛɛre Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la habɔteŋra ɡe baa pɛɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa ya ne Farisii tena nɔ te yon dɛɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, asɛ he te habɔteŋra nɔ te aa wola nyoa vɔwɛ kwaraa nɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Baa aa lawɛ hanfale dɛ yerɛ o daamanar ŋɔ bá ba lɛ ba sie nɔ, baa berɔɔ so lɔr aa?
Baa lɔree so.
Kɛ tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ hanfale jaa laanee le ba bini.
Gɛ saŋ la te, baa vɔwɛ nyoaa.
Baa yafale yakwara kpɔe dɛɛ tɔ yabene bɔɔ.
A ba ɡɛ naa, yafale yakwara la ɛɛ kɛɛroo le yabene la ta, ásɛ bɔɔ la berɛ do kan kohona.
Gɛɛ baa wola senfala kpɔe dɛɛ do loŋbena aa kɔɔhna bini dɛɛ tɔ a nyoa.
Gɛ laa, dɛ sen la baa peraa, aa do kpeɡrii dɛ́ pere loŋa la á chɔɡ, ásɛ sen la fuɡe.
Loŋfale binii baa do senfala, ásɛ a bwa won do wer.” Bitolo bɛl waa sewa ne hanweela te bɛl wa Yeesu ta aa dɛ bol waa nɔ la, cheremi dea nomoa bɛl baa ɡuŋi o sie dɛ ŋɔ, “N bie sewɔ taraken.
Kɛ ba kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o nɛ, ásɛ o berɛ ir.” Anee Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la bwa ir teŋɛ o nɛ.
Belaa haah bɛl chal aa fuɡo bene fi dɛ anɛ ba kpɔ Yeesu habɔɔ, dɛ ka leɡe o batakaare nyoa.
Dɛ o tɔ sie lii o nyu bini kɛŋɔ dɛ o leɡe Yeesu batakaare nyoa ɡbo kwaraa naa, wɛɛ ɡbaŋroo.
Yeesu ke nyiŋi dɛ na haah la, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Tolo, sɔɔh bwara.
He yarada haa yarada mɛ la ɡelɔ he ɡbaŋre.” Gɛ waa nɔ taa haah la ɡbaŋre.
Belaa Yeesu jo cheremi dea nomoa la dem.
Waa na ɡɛ nɛra aa dɛ hoh kalipere ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ lwe la aa dɛ do ɡbɔɡa la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé bwa le dem bonɔ!
Bie la ta sewɛ, domii o chɔ.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, ba mamɔ.
Baa doŋi nɛra la bwa le dem bela tonɛ la, Yeesu jo dea bela tolo la aa chɔa la dɛ lawɛ o nɔn, asɛ tolo la ir dɛ dɔ bokpeɡa.
Gɛ waa nɔ perɛ baah bela bwɛɛre la kɛrɛdɛ bwa ta.
Gɛ Yeesu aa chah nyoŋa banɛ bane Yeesu aa le bela dɛɛ kaa la, nyoŋa banɛ bane no o ɡbɔɡa, dɛ ir teŋɛ o nɛɛ dɛɛ yerɔ dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Devid Naa, na ya sum!” Yeesu aa kaa jo dem la, nyoŋa la joɔ puu, anee o pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “He dɛ yarada mɛ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ wonoo chah heya aa?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, ya Dɔɔ.” Anee Yeesu kpɔ nɔn leɡe ba sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa dɛ yarada la, á ɛ ɡɛ tɛ heya.” Asɛ ba bwa berɛ dɛɛ na.
Anee Yeesu kah ba sibeɡra ne ŋɔ, “He bɛ waa nɔ taa baɡle nomɛlbwa.” Kɛ ba ɡarɔ le dɛ ka ɡel waa la perɛ baah bela bwɛɛre la bwa ta.
Gɛ Yeesu aa chah amumu bɛl Nɛra la aa le dem bela dɛɛ kaa la, nɛra bane ɡe berɔ kpɔ baa bɛl kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛɛ o bol waa kahonɛ ba Yeesu be.
Yeesu aa doŋi kwaa la le o nɛɛ la, baa la den dɛɛ bol wa, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa lɔ bela la nyoa kpo.
Ba ŋɔ, “Ya ta waa nɔ dɔŋa nae Israel harɛ nɔ ta bwa!” Anee Farisii tena la te ŋɔ, “Kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ bwa kooroo tɛo kpeɡri o won kwaa doŋa nɛra nɛɛ la.” Gɛ Yeesu aa na nɛra sum Yeesu ɡaaɡe bwɛjena ne anjeɡre bwa ta, dɛ bol Korowii Kora Amanesoma baɡ ba ba cheremi deene, dɛ chah nɛra baa we weela te bɛlbwa soo siwi.
Waa na nɛnlaa la ɡɛ la, o dɔ tedoma tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ nɛra ba bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ baa wola Lɛɛ dɔe kɛ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe ken.
Anee o kpɔ nɛra la maɡɛ konduula dɛ ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Koo kondikwaa la kan, kɛ tom-ɛɛra la lɔ tamaa ken dɛɛ ba a koma.
Anomanta, hé soŋe Koo Te ásɛ o kpɔ tom-ɛɛra bane ba ja, bá ka ɛ a toma.”
Yeesu aa tomɛ o toroma fi dɛ banɛ wa Yeesu yerɛ o toroma fi dɛ banɛ la cheme dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri báa kpɔ doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛ, ásɛ dɛ won chah weela bɛlbwa ɡe.
Yeesu toroma fi dɛ banɛ la waa kpɔ ba laanee nɔ.
Seemɔn waa pa o sɔn Pita la ne o nime Andriu, ne Jems ne o nime Jɔn baa ɛ Sebedii bii la, Felep ne Batolomeo, ne Tɔmas ne Matiu o fa aa dɛ lɛ toɔ la, ne Jems waa ɛ Alfeɔs bie la dɛ Tadeɔs, ne Seemɔn Sɛlɔt la dɛ Judas Eskareɔt waa le Yeesu tɛ ba kpoo la.
Yeesu aa dɛ tomɛ a ɡɛ nɛra fi dɛ banɛ nɔ la, o do ba ŋɔ, “He bɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la harɛ ta la, he bɛ Samaria bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ta la.
Hé kaa Israel tena baa do kɛŋɔ peera aa nyoɡra la be, dɛ́ ka bol ba be ŋɔ Korowii Kora puu ba tonɛ.
Hé chah weela tena, dɛ́ chum nɛra baa serewa.
Hé chah weela bwa aa dɛ chɔɡ nɛn bwadabi, dɛ́ doŋi kwaa a yon dɛɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ la le ba nɛ.
N kpɔ kpeɡri nɔ kɛ heyaa pɛɛpɛɛ.
Hé ɡe kpɔ chaah ba pɛɛpɛɛ.
He bɛ suuɡa te bɛlbwa kpɔ.
Ŋwɛnɛ haa dɛ ba kaala la, he bɛlbwa bɛ pur kpɔ, dɛ bɛ batakaani bele anɛ kpɔ, dɛ bɛ naŋɡawa bele anɛ ne daŋɡbala kpɔ, dɛkalkɛ tom-ɛɛ kembɔr chɛo.
Bwɛɛ bɛlbwa haa tel o ta la, hé nyiŋi nɛndɛɛɡe, ásɛ dɛ so o be dɛ́ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ haa le bela.
He kaa jo dem bɛlbwa ta naa, hé ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Kórowii tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.’ Dɛ dem bela tena lɛ heyaa silɛɛ ne naa, baa dɔ bosɔɔhna dem belaa.
Kɛ dɛ ba ta heyaa lɛɛ silɛɛ ne naa, baa bosɔɔhna dɔe ba.
Dɛ dem bɛl kɛɛ bwɛɛ bɛl tena ŋɔ baa heyaa lɛ, baa he waa la ɡee no aa, hé pee he nakpale teera ta bela, ásɛ a baɡle kɛŋɔ he kpɔ Korowii Waa ba ba be ba vɛah, ásɛ dɛ le bela.
Kasinteŋ, awola Korowii aa ba pa nomɛlbwa bole la, waa Sodom ne Gomoora tena aa naa la ɡba ɛɛ bɔ a ɡɛ bwɛɛ la tena waa.” Gɛ nɛra aa dɛ ba Yeesu toroma nɛɛ cheɡa Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no!
N dɛ tomɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ peera hé ka koo he dɔma baa do kɛ ɡboli baah ta.
Hé ɡel he sie pili hɛɛ do dɛɛɡɔ kɛ harɛkwa, ásɛ dɛ do pwɛre dɛ́ man kɛ borɔnomare.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛ baa lawɛ heyaa ka cheme nomonome sie, dɛ́ lɔɔ heyaa chweremi ne cheremi deene ta.
Baa koh n waa yerɛ heyaa cheme Abane nomonome ne koranar siee, dɛ́ ŋɔ hé ba bol Amanesoma la baɡle ba ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la.
Dɛ ba baa lawɛ heyaa dɛ la he ne ba sie naa, he bɛ ɡel waa haa dɛ ba bola, ne ɡɛ haa bol dɛ́ lɛ he te hiah heya.
A baa tel kɛŋɔ hé bol wa aa, hɛɛ jemɛ waa haa dɛ ba bolaa.
Waa haa dɛ ba bola la aa he bee le.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee dɛɛ ba he nɛɛ cheɡa dɛ́ bol wa.
Nɛra ɛɛ le ba ɡbaɡba lolanaree tɛ bá kpoo ba, baala le ba bii tɛ bá kpoo ba, ásɛ bechale ɡe ir che ba nyare ne mɛɛnanar nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel baa kpoo ba.
Nɛra bwa ɛɛ koh n waa hah heya.
Kɛ naate waa dɛ ba wona dɛ́ lawɛ bambile ka tonɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Dɛ he la bwɛɛ bɛl ta baa ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa aa, hé chwa kaa bwɛfale ta.
Kasinteŋ, haa won la Israel bwɛɛre nɔ bwa ta ka chiɡ mɔɔ Men Nɛn Bie ba.
Nɛn waa dɛ hweli toma ta o dɔɔ ɡwaalɛ, bonɔɔ ɡe ta o nomoa ɡwaalɛ.
Dɛ ba dɛ yerɛ dea nomoa Bɛlsebul waa ɛ sɔnchɔɡe aa, dea bii la te ta pɔeh yaa?
Anomanta, he bɛ nɛra dɛɛ ɔmɛ.
Wobɛlbwa baa tɔ a ta la ɛɛ le baŋee, ásɛ waa aa sɔah bwa ɡe le nɛra jemɛ.
Waa maa dɛ bol he be biro ta la, hé bola webaŋa, ásɛ waa maa sɔah bol he be la, hé bola nɛnlaa baah.
He bɛ nɛra baa dɛ ba wona kpo heya, baa wola won kpo he lileo la ɔmɛ, kɛ hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii waa dɛ ba wona chɔɡ bwadabii ne lileo la bwa Bɔnsam nii ta la.
He nao kɛ pɛtoprɛ ta yoɡ dɔe, kɛ beŋkpoŋ ɡba aa harɛɛ le dɛ he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua aa o waa jemɛ.
He nyumpona kwara, o jemɛ a nyoa.
Anomanta, he bɛ ɔmɛ.
He ta pɛtoprɛre ɡwaalɛ wobɛlbwa ta naa?
Nomɛlbwa waa won che nɛra baah ta, dɛ́ sɛh ŋɔ o ja n nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ n ɡee ba naate sɔn yera n Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la sie kɛ o ja n nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa vɛɛh mɛ nɛra baah ta, dɛ ŋɔ o ta n nɛɛ jae la, ɡɛɛ n ɡee ba o vɛɛh n Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la sie, dɛ́ ŋɔ n ne o laa.
He bɛ dɛɛ lii kɛ n ba nyopɛo ne harɛ nɔ ta.
Nyopɛo ne laa n ba, yoi nee n ba.
N balɔ ásɛ bibaa ne o mɛɛ koh n waa dɔm, bihaah ne o nya dɔm, ásɛ bihaah ne o helahaah ɡe dɔm, ásɛ nɛn lolanar berɛ o dɔma.
He naate haa dɛ nyin he nya ne he mɛɛ waa ɡwaa mɛ la ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he teŋɛ n nɛ, asɛ he naate ɡe haa dɛ nyin he bihaah ne he bibaa waa ɡwaa mɛ la ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he teŋɛ n nɛ.
He naate haa wola he te kpɔe tɛ dɛ sɛh wahala nae ne seo bwa, dɛ baa teŋɛ n nɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa kpɔ daɡaɡre che bá ka kpaaro pɛl o ta la ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he teŋɛ n nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa o sie aa swɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ kwaa ta la, wɛɛ paŋɛ o nyuu, ásɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe o sie aa wola harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ kwaa ta lɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Nomɛlbwa waa nyiŋi he nɛɛ la, menee o nyiŋi la.
Asɛ nomɛlbwa waa nyiŋi n nɛɛ la, naate waa tom mɛ laanee o nyiŋi la.
Nomɛlbwa waa nyiŋi Korowii keame nɛɛ o keamere ɛɛ nomanta la, wɛɛ dɔ Korowii keame kembɔree.
Asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa koh nɛndɛɛɡe dɛɡre waa dɛ nyiŋi o nɛɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ nɛndɛɛɡe kembɔree.
Kasinteŋ, dɛ nomɛlbwa koh n wa, dɛ tɛ n habɔteŋra bechale nɔ bini bɛlbwa nesɔna o nyɔ aa, waa o kembɔr paŋa ba bwa.”
Yeesu ne Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee wa Yeesu aa bol waa nɔ baɡle o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la tonɛ la, o le bela dɛ kaa bwɛɛre aa bɛne bela la ta, dɛ kaa bol Korowii Waa dɛɛ baɡ ba.
Dɛ ba do Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la dea, o chɔ bela dɛ no waa Yeesu Kristo aa dɛ ɛ la, asɛ o tomɛ o habɔteŋra bane o be ŋɔ bá ka pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Henee nɛn Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo o ba la aa, kɛɛ he laa, ásɛ yaa nyiŋi naate habɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hé berɛ kaa, dɛ́ ka ŋɔ Jɔn be waa haa baa na dɛ no la.
Hé ŋɔ o be ŋɔ nyoŋa dɛ na bɔr, boobie ɛɛ valɛ, asɛ nɛra weechɔɡa aa chɔɡ ba bwadabii la ɡe bwara kwaa.
Hé ŋɔ o be ŋɔ amumure dɛ no wa, lala ir seo ta, asɛ nyaara ɡe dɔ Amanesoma la dɛɛ no.
Nomɛlbwa haa wola men tɔŋle la, he na som.” Jɔn habɔteŋra la aa dɛ kaa la, Yeesu bol Jɔn waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛnlaa la ŋɔ, “Haa la Jɔn be pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta la, dɛ bɔkwaa he fe ɛɛ nyin kɛ he na nɔ?
Kpɔɡ bɛl peu aa dɛ ta wɛɛ yiiɡi la kɛɛ?
Dɛ ɡɛ laa ɡe aa, dɛ bɔkwa tenee he ka nyiŋi ɔ?
Nɛn waa do laaladɛɛɡaa he ka nyiŋi kɛɛ?
Nɛra baa dɛ do laaladɛɛɡa la, kooderemii ba do.
Hé baɡ mɛ, bɔkwa tenee he la bela ka nyiŋi ɔ?
Korowii keamee kɛɛ?
Kasinteŋ, Korowii keamee he na la, kɛ o ɡwaa Korowii keame kwara, dɛkalkɛ Jɔn nɔ waa ba chwerɛ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tomɛ n toromee ó tɔ he sie dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ” ’ la.
Kasinteŋ, ba lolɛ nɛnjena harɛ nɔ ta, kɛ Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee nɔ ɡwaa ba bwa.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ bechala Korowii Kora la ta te berɔ ɡwaa Jɔn.
Dɛ le saŋ la Jɔn aa lea dɛɛ bol Korowii Kora nɔ waa la, nɛra sie beɡrɔ ba kpɔ sibeɡra dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ ja o Kora la ta.
Korowii keamere la bwa ne Mosis tɔ sie bol Korowii Kora la waa dɛ ba tel ɡɛ saŋ Jɔn aa bala.
Kɛ dɛ hɛɛ yarada n waa maa dɛ bol nɔɔ te naa, Elaeja la baa bol o waa ŋɔ wɛɛ bao la, onee a ɡɛ Jɔn nɔ.
Nomɛlbwa waa no la, ó no.
Bɔkwa konee mɛɛ ba fini nɛra nɔ kpɔe dɛ maɡɔɔ?
Ba do kɛŋɔ bechale bane aa dɛ hɛlɛ fɔɡbaah, asɛ bane ŋɔ ba bala be ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ ya ɡo silɛɛ yela, he sie ta lɛɛ he sa, ya berɛ ta wiile ɡe, he loo ta kui he wi nɔɔ?’ Jɔn aa bala la, dɛ o dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, waa sen ɡe nyɔ, asɛ nomɛlbwa ŋɔ kwaa dɛ ir o nɛ.
Asɛ Men Nɛn Bie la te aa bala la, n di kwa, dɛ nyɔ sen ɡe, asɛ nomɛlbwa berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé na baa nɔ!
Kondikondidii ne sennyɔɔree on.
Toɔ lɛɛra baa dɛ bɔ nɛra apoo ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa ɛ o daamanar.’ ” Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, anee o ŋɔ, “Wejereme bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla taa a che baa jemɛ kɛ o ɛ wejereme.” Bwɛɛre a tena aa wola Yeesu yaradae wa Bwɛɛre Yeesu aa ɛ nyokpowaa a ta warɛ la, a nɛra ta ba wechɔɡa ta leɛ.
Anomanta, o ŋɔ, “Korasen tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ.
Hɛɛ na waa taeh!
Bɛtsaeda tena, hé ɡe bwɛɛlɛ.
He ɡee na waa taeh!
Nyokpowaa nɔ maa ɛa he bini nɔ, dɛ Taaya ne Sidonee n fee ɛa nɔ naa, ba fe charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta biɡri, dɛ tɔ lweyale dɛ kpɔ tɔɔ fɔɡɛ ba bwara bwa.
Kasinteŋ, awola Korowii aa ba dɛ́ ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la, wɛɛ na Taaya ne Sidon tena sumii ɡwaa heya.
Ásɛ he Kapeeneɔm tena ɡe, he fe dɛ nyin kɛ he ɡbaɡba ir kaa Korowii doa kɛɛ?
Baa viɡri heyaa Bɔnsam nii taa.
Nyokpowaa nɔ maa ɛa he bini nɔ, dɛ ba fe ɛa Sodom aa, Sodom fe ta lole ba le fini, Korowii fe ta on chɔɡɛ.
Kasinteŋ, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ awola Korowii aa ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la, wɛɛ na Sodom tena sumii ɡwaa heya.” Ona aa lole dɛ tɛ nɛra baa koah Belaa Yeesu kpɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, nyundua ne harɛ bwa Dɔɔ!
N dɛ jaame kɛ haa kpɔ he waa nɔ sɔh sipila tena ne wejerema, dɛ kpɔ baɡle nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ nɔ.
Jam, n Mɛɛ.
Gɛɛ wera he be.” Belaa Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ kpɔ wobɛlbwa do n nɔn ta.
Nomɛlbwa aa men Korowii Bie jemɛ, nemenɛ n Mɛɛ la ɡbo.
Gɛɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe aa wola n Mɛɛ la jemɛ, nemenɛ n ne nɛra maa dɛ nyin kɛ ń ɡel ba jemɔ la.
He banɔ la he soɡa bini waa aa kana ɡwaa he nɛɛ la bwa, hé kpɔa ba n be ásɛ n lɛ heyaa he onɛ.
Gɛ baa kpɔ daa dawɛ nae anɛ nɛ a pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma la, hé ɡel n ne he pɛ ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ he hweli le n be, dɛkalkɛ n pwɛre, maa mbarafo ɡe ɛ.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa koeh ba.
N waa do toŋɡboŋ ken, bone maa kpɔ dawɛ he nɛɛ la ɡe fɛɡre.”
Ona Tɔpere wepɛɛre Ona Tɔpere bɛl wee, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra kaa kpɔ mea koo bɛl ta, dɛ lɔr dɛ kpo o habɔteŋra la, asɛ ba ɛ mea la ane dɛɛ chwe.
Farisii tena la aa na ɡɛ la, ba ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na!
He habɔteŋra la dɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ koni ya Ona Tɔpere Mmara la.” Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He ta kure na ɡɛ ya naa Devid aa ɛa ɡɛ saŋ lɔr aa dɛ kpo o ne o nɛra la kɛɛ?
O jo Korowii Dea dɛ kpɔ paanoo aa ɛ Korowii kwa, o ne o nɛra di.
Mmara fe aa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ kɛ bá fee di ɡɛ paanoo la, sɔfore ɡboo fe dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ bá dia.
Kɛɛ he ta kure na ɡɛ Mosis Mmara la aa baɡla kɛ, sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea Ona Tɔpere la ta la, dɛ koni Ona Tɔpere Mmara la, kɛ ba ɡe aa bolchɔɡe di aa?
Korowii Dea toma ɛɛ waa baa wola bolchɔɡe di la, kɛ kasinteŋ, nomɛl lɔ bonɔ dɛ ɡwaa Korowii Dea.
Korowii Tɔn dɛ baɡle kɛ, ‘He dɛ na he dɔŋa sum aa, anee mɛɛ nyin dɛ ɡwaa kɛ haa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.’ Dɛ he fe jemɛ waa nɔ mun aa, he fe aa nɛra nɛɛ nya ŋɔ ba di bolchɔɡe, dɛkalkɛ Men Nɛn Bie laanee dɔ Ona Tɔpere kpeɡri.” Baa bɛl o nɔn aa sewa wa Yeesu le bela dɛ kaa cheremi dea bɛl ta, dɛ baa bɛl o nɔn aa sewa lɔ bela.
Dɛ nɛra bane lɔ bela dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ kpɔ waa dawɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Anomanta, ba pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ya Mmara la dɛ tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ya won chah weela Ona Tɔpere aa?” Anee Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Amɔ dɛ he bini bɛl pee le bɔluŋ bɛl bini Ona Tɔpere aa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?
Waa pee laanee ka lawɛ le bɔɔ la bini naa?
Nɛn ta pee ɡwaalaa?
Anomanta, ya Mmara dɛ tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ yá ɛ nɛn wedɛɛɡa Ona Tɔpere.” Anee o ŋɔ baa la o nɔn aa sewa la be ŋɔ, “Tɛr he nɔn.” Asɛ baa la tɛr o nɔnsewe la, dɛ o berɔ do kpeɡri ɡɛ o fa aa doa wubwa la, dɛ do kɛ o nɔn la waa wola sewɛ la.
Belaa Farisii tena la le bela dɛɛ vɔrɔwe kɛ bá kpo Yeesu.
Bonɔɔ Korowii aa leo tɛ o te wa Yeesu aa naa kɛ nɛra la dɛ nyinu dɛ́ kpo la, o le bela kaa bofale, dɛ nɛnlaa tenten teŋɛ o nɛ, asɛ o chah ba bini banɔ la ba bwara aa dɛ wee ba la bwa, dɛ ŋɔ ba bɛ o waa taa baɡle nomɛlbwa.
Gɛ Yeesu aa ɛa nɔɔ ɡela ba jemɛ kɛ waa Korowii keame Aesaya fa aa bola la ɛ kasinteŋ.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “N bonɔɔ maa leo laanee la.
O waa mɛɛ nyin, asɛ n sie ɡee lɛ o nɛɛ ɡa.
Mɛɛ ɡeloo n Doma ba so o nɛ, ásɛ o baɡle nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta bwa ɡe ɡɛ n kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛre aa doa.
Waa waa tɔŋle dɛɛ nyɛɡ, waa takpeɡ ɡee kpɔ bol waa fɔɡbaahna.
Nɛn do kɛŋɔ daa waa ɡwɛɛna dɛɛ ba kui yaa, waa ɡel o ku.
Dɛ o do kɛŋɔ kandea waa dɛ lawɛ kɛlll la ɡe aa, waa ɡel ó dime.
Wɛɛ lawɛ bambile nɛra nɛɛ dɛ́ yo ka tel ɡɛ saŋ nɛra bwa aa ba jemɛ Korowii kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛre la, ásɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta bwa kpɔ ba hwɛɡa dawɛ o nɛ.” Yeesu ne Bɛlsebul Asɛ nɛra bane kpɔ baa bɛl kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛɛ dɛ ɡel o nyoŋe, waa wola won waa ɡe bol ba Yeesu be, asɛ o chah baa la dɛ ɡel wɛɛ na dɛ won waa ɡe bola.
Waa Yeesu aa ɛa la ɡelɔ nɛnlaa la bwa nyoa kpo, baa pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Amɔ Devid Naa nɔɔ naa?” Farisii tena la aa no waa nɛra la aa dɛ bɔɔ dɔŋa la, ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ bwa kooro Bɛlsebulee tɛo kpeɡri o won kwaa doŋa nɛra nɛɛ la.” Yeesu aa jemɛ waa baa dɛ bol la, anee o ŋɔ, “Dɛ harɛ bɛl ta tena bini pere anɛ ba ɡbo ɛɛ yo aa, harɛ la dɛ paɡre.
Asɛ bwɛjen bɛlbwa ɡe o bini aa pere anɛ bampera ne bampera ɛɛ yo la, bwɛɛ la dɛ paɡre.
Gɛɛ dɛ waane ba lolanar bane bini asɛ ba pere anɛ ba ɡbo ɛɛ yo aa, lola la aa won ɛ lola.
Anomanta, dɛ Bɔnsam kora bini peɡro baa yo aa, amɔ te kora la aa won ɛ kora.
Dɛ he ŋɔ Bɛlsebulee tɛ mɛ kpeɡri n won kwaa doŋa nɛra nɛɛ aa, a wer.
Aah, dɛ he ɡe, umee tɛ he habɔteŋra nɔ kpeɡri ba won a doŋa ɔ?
He ɡbaɡba habɔteŋra la we-ɛɛlaa dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he kono kwara!
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri nee mɛɛ doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ la.
Anomanta, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Kora dii la telo tonɛ.
Nomɛlbwa aa won jo bokpeɡa te dea dɛ́ ŋwɛ o laala, nemenɛ o tɔ sie won vɔrɔwo mɔɔ, dɛ́ won jo o dea dɛ́ pa o laala.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola n nɛɛ jae la aa n waa nyin.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola men chae dɛɛ boa n nɛra nyoa dɛɛ pɛ la lɔ ba dɛɛ peɡre.
Anomanta, n dɛ ŋɔ he be kɛ Korowii ɛɛ wonoo kpɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ne wobochɔɡa bɛlbwa kɛ nɛn.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa bol Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la te nɛnhɛlwobol la, waa kpɔ kɛo bwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa bol waa yaɡɛ Men Nɛn Bie la, wɛɛ wonoo kpɔ kɛo.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa bol wobochɔɡa yaɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la te, fini ne kere, Korowii aa kpɔ kɛo bwa.” Daa ne o nɔna Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ daa nɔn wer aa, dɛ daa la ɡbabirii wera.
Kɛ dɛ he ŋɔ daa nɔn aa weraa, dɛ daa la ɡbabir ɡee wola were.
Daa nɔn taa ba che dɛɛ jemɛ o dasoo.
Nɛnchɔɡa kɛ harɛkwa bii!
Wechɔɡa ɡbo aa su he bini nɔ, wobodɛɛɡa ɛɛ wonoo le he nyoa ta naa?
Waa aa lɔ nɛn bambile ta laanee o nyoa ɛɛ bol.
Nɛndɛɛɡe wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ taa a che baa jemɛ wedɛɛɡa aa lɔ o bambile bini.
Gɛɛ ba che nɛnchɔɡe ɡe wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta dɛɛ jemɛ wechɔɡa aa lɔ o bambile bini.
N dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, wesale bɛlbwa nomɛlbwa aa bola la, wɛɛ baɡle a munii awola Korowii aa ba dɛ́ ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la.
He ɡbaɡba wobol taa Korowii ɛɛ ba cheɡa pa heyaa bole.
He wobol ɛ wobodɛɛɡa aa, wɛɛ pae boldɛɛɡee, dɛ he wobol ɛ wobochɔɡa aa, wɛɛ pae bolchɔɡee.” Ba soŋe Yeesu ŋɔ ó ɛ nyokpowa ba na Tɔnjerema la bane ne Farisii tena bane ba Yeesu be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya dɛ nyin kɛ he ɛ nyokpowaane yá na dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ kpelaa Korowii bee he le.” Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ fini nɛra ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡbo baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Maa wobɛlbwaa ɛ hé na, nemenɛ waa aa pu Korowii keame Jona la dɔŋ ɡboo dɛɛ ba n ɡe pui, ásɛ he che a ta jemɛ n nɛnsoo.
Gɛ Jona aa di tɔpebire atoro pɛŋejen la tea bini la, ɡɛɛ Men Nɛn Bie la ɡee ba tɔpebire atoro dii lalbɔɔ bini.
Awola nɛra bwa aa ir seo ta dɛ ba che Korowii sie, ásɛ o bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole la, Niniwe tena ɛɛ bol waa bɔ fini nɔ tena, dɛkalkɛ ba te no Korowii waa Jona aa bola la mun dɛ charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta.
Kɛ kasinteŋ, naate waa ɡwaa Jona lɔ bonɔ, asɛ he ŋɔ haa o bee no.
Seeba kooro waa ɛ haah la ɡba ɛɛ bol waa bɔ fini nɔ tena, dɛkalkɛ o valɔ le harɛ jaɡa, dɛ́ ba no Kooro Solomɔn wejemwa.
Kɛ kasinteŋ, naate waa ɡwaa Kooro Solomɔn lɔ bonɔ, asɛ he ŋɔ haa o bee no.” Bɔnsam torome bera dɛ́ ba nɛn be ja Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Fini nɔ nɛra do kɛŋɔ nɛn Bɔnsam aa ɡela o torome bɛl do o nɛɛ dɛ chɔɡ o da.
A habɔɔ la, naate charɛ o liire, asɛ Bɔnsam torome la le o nɛɛ dɛ kaa ka nyin bofale dɛ so.
O ɡaaɡaa, o ta wone dɔ bɔr dɛ́ so onɛ, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ kaa n buɡ ta bela maa lea ba laanee,’ dɛ berɛ ka na kɛ baa la liire chaahnɔ kɛŋɔ dea baa chaaro dɛ kwaaro kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ dɛ ɡel o chɔ pɛɛ.
Gɛɛ o yon la ka kpɔ o bala banuanɛ aa ɡwaalo kwara.
A bwa yon ba so naate la nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ o da ɡwaa ɡɛ o fa aa doa wubwa la.
Gɛɛ aa ba doe fini nɔ nɛra baa ɛ nɛnchɔɡa nɔ nɛ.” Yeesu nya ne Yeesu nimanar Yeesu nyoa ta aa lɔ waa ta o bol dɛɛ baɡle nɛra la la, o nya ne o nimanar ba bela dɛ ba che buse dɛɛ nyinu dɛ́ bol waa o be.
Anomanta, nɛra la bɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na, he nya ne he nimanar cheɡɛ buse dɛɛ nyin he bɔr dɛ́ bol waa he be.” Yeesu pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Umee n nyaɔ?
Umewaa n nimanar ɔ?” Asɛ o tɛr o nɔn pa o habɔteŋra la nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na n nya ne n nimanar.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ waa n Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua aa dɛ nyin kɛ ó ɛ laanee n nime ne n nimambie ne n nya.”
Mea dui sɛɡla Awola tenten Yeesu le dem bela dɛ ka so moo nyoa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra wa.
Nɛnlaa la aa wara nomanta, o jo ɡbera ta ka so, asɛ nɛnlaa la bwa che baŋ.
Asɛ o kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa chaɡ ba ŋɔ, “Baa bɛlee ira dɛ kaa merɛ mea o koo ta.
Waa dɛ merɛ mea la, ane lee ŋwɛnɛ nyoa, asɛ jumbii ba tɔɔ di.
Ane lee bwetala ta bela teera aa wola toole kohona.
Teera la aa dawɛ bwetala la ta la aa kanɛ, a ta biɡre bɛlbwa mea la le.
Kɛ a lune ta wone kaa bini.
Anomanta, wee aa lɔa la, a jwalɔ dɛ serewe.
Mea la ane ɡe lee sɔɔhne baah, asɛ sɔɔhne la kpeɡ dɛ lawa, a ta wone ɛ. Kɛ anɔ la aa lee harɛdɛɛɡe ta la te leɔ, asɛ dɛ ma kohona.
Ane ma lafare, ane ma fifraanunumɛla, asɛ ane ɡe ma fifraatotoro.” Yeesu aa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, anee o ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin dɛ́ no la, ó no.” Yeesu baɡle mea dui sɛɡla mun Asɛ o habɔteŋra la la o be ka pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa he yon kpɔ sɛɡla dɛɛ bol waa nɛra nɔ be nɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He te dɔ Korowii Kora ne a wejema a fa aa sɔah bwa dɛ jemɛ.
Kɛ ba te ta dɔe.
Anomanta, naate waa dɔa la, baa jao anee ó dɔ kohona.
Kɛ naate waa wola komɛlbwa dɔe la, tama kwaraa waa dɔa la ɛɛ le o nɔn taa.
Waa aa bala n kpɔ sɛɡla dɛɛ bol waa ba be laanee nɔ.
‘Ba dɔ sibie, kɛ baa na, dɛ dɔ deŋna, kɛ baa waa no, baa waa mun jemɛ.’ Ba waa Korowii keame Aesaya faa bol la.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Nɛra nɔ ɛɛ noo kohona, kɛ baa a mun jema ba, baa nyiŋuu kohona, kɛ baa a jema ba, dɛkalkɛ ba bambile kpeɡri, ba kpɔ nɔɔra tɔɔɡe deŋna, dɛ tɔɔɡe ba sibie ɡe.
A waa laa aa, ba sie fe ɛɛ nao, ásɛ ba deŋna no, ásɛ ba jemɛ a mun, dɛ́ charɛ ba liire, ásɛ n lɛɛ ba.’ Kɛ he te, he nyu som taeh.
He sibie dɛ na, he deŋna ɡee no wa.
Kasinteŋ, Korowii keamere kɛrɛdɛ ne nɛra ba wa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi kɛrɛdɛ fe dɛ nyin kɛ ba na anɔ haa dɛ na nɔ, ba ta dɔe na, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin dɛ no anɔ haa dɛ no nɔ, ba ta dɔe no.
Hé cheɡ deŋna dɛ́ no baa waa merɛ mea la waa la mun.
Nɛra baa dɛ no Korowii Kora nɔ waa baa wola a mun jemɛ laanee do kɛ mea la aa lee ŋwɛnɛ nyoa la.
Bɔnsam balaa, dɛ o baa laa waa baa noa la bwa kpɔ le ba nyu bini.
Mea aa lee bwetala ta la ɡe cheɡɔ tɛ nɛra baa no waa nɔ, dɛ ba sie lɛo la.
Kɛ waa la aa wola ban jooɡe la ɡelɔ aa won ba nyu bini ka.
A cheɡɛ Korowii waa ta waane puu ba, asɛ nɛra ɡe ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa aa, dɛ ba horɔ.
