Mea la aa lee sɔɔhne baah la cheɡɔ tɛ nɛra baa no waa nɔ, asɛ harɛ nɔ soɡa liire ne harɛ nɔ kondɔɔh waa beɡre ba sie, ba ta ɡelɛ waa la dɔ tɔnɔ.
Asɛ mea la aa lee harɛdɛɛɡe ta la ɡe cheɡɔ tɛ nɛra baa no Korowii Waa la dɛ lawɛ a bini, a dɔ tɔnɔ tɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ mea la aa ɛa kɛrɛdɛ, ane ma lafare, ane ma fifraanunumɛla, ane ma fifraatotoro la.” Kpɔɡchɔɡa aa dɛ lawɛ koo kwaa sɛɡla Yeesu kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa chaɡ ba ja dɛ ŋɔ, “Kenii Korowii Kora la do.
Baa bɛlee ira dɛ ka merɛ mea o koo ta.
Jwaana bɛl nɛra bwa aa chɔa la, o dɔm bɛl ɡe iro dɛ ka merɛ kpɔɡchɔɡa ane mea koo la ta, dɛ ir chwa.
Kwaa la bwa aa lea dɛ kpeɡ la, a bie ɛɛ taa ba che jemɛ kɛ kpɔɡchɔɡa koo mea la ta.
Baa la bonɔɔna baa bɔɔro ŋɔ, ‘Nomoa, kɛ mea ɡboo he merɛ koo nɔ ta laɔ?
Lee kpɔɡchɔɡa nɔ ɡe le dɛ ba koo a ta nɔɔ?’ Anee nomoa la chaŋ ba ŋɔ, ‘N dɔm bɛlee ɛ ɡɛ la.’ Asɛ o bonɔɔna la berɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, ‘He dɛ nyin kɛ yá ka parɛ kpɔɡchɔɡa la ta kɛɛ?’ Anee baa la ŋɔ, ‘Kai.
Dɛ he ŋɔ he para ta taraken aa, hɛɛ parɛ mea la anee ja a ta.
Hé ɡel a bwa pɛ che dɛ́ kpeɡ.
A koma ta la, mɛɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ba a koma la bee bá tɔ sie kɛ kpɔɡchɔɡa la, dɛ́ vɔrɔwa, dɛ́ che ka ta nii ta dɛ́ fuah, mɔɔ dɛ́ ba komɛ mea tenten la, dɛ́ pa ka do mɛ n dɔndɔŋ bini.’ ” Mastad bii sɛɡla Yeesu kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa chaɡ ba ja dɛ ŋɔ, “Kenii Korowii Kora la do.
Baa bɛlee ira dɛ kpɔ daa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ mastad bii dɛ ka du.
Kwaa bie baa dɛ du bwa bini onjeɡaa.
Kɛ dɛ o leɔ dɛ kpeɡ aa, o dɛ ɡwaa konduula bwa, dɛ́ yon kpeɡ dajen, ásɛ jumbii ɡba ba sɔh a kɔne o kpala ta.” Yeesu kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa chaɡ ba ja dɛ ŋɔ, “Kenii Korowii Kora la do.
O do kɛŋɔ haah bɛl aa ira dɛ kpɔ iisi tama ka koo men loɡbaa del ta, asɛ a won ɡel men la bwa uɡe.” Waa nɔ bwa Yeesu aa bola dɛɛ baɡle nɛnlaa la bwa la, dɛ sɛɡla nee wɛɛ bol.
Webeŋkpoŋ ɡba toole o wobol ta waa wola sɛɡla kpɔe bol.
Gɛ waa ɛa nɔ ɡelɔ waa Korowii keame la fa aa bola la ɛ kpela.
O fa ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ sɛɡlaa bol wa chaɡle heya.
Waa nomɛlbwa aa wola jemɛ bwa le harɛ nɔ mumpar la, mɛɛ bol ba bee.” Kpɔɡchɔɡa sɛɡla la mun Yeesu aa le nɛnlaa la baah la, o kaa jo dea, asɛ o habɔteŋra la ba o be dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Chaɡle yaa kpɔɡchɔɡa baa la dɔm la aa kaa merɛ koo mea la ta la mun.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Men Nɛn Bie laanee merɛ mea tenten la.
Harɛ ta bonɔɔ ɛ koo la.
Mea tenten laanee nɛra baa ja Korowii Kora la ta la, asɛ kpɔɡchɔɡa la ɡe che tɛ nɛra baa lɔ Bɔnsam be pera.
Baa la dɔm la waa kaa merɛ kpɔɡchɔɡa koo mea tenten la ta la cheɡɔ tɛ Bɔnsam.
Kwaa la koma la cheɡɔ tɛ waa bwa jaɡa saŋ, asɛ nɛra baa koma la cheɡɔ tɛ nyundua toroma la.
Gɛ baa vɔrɔwe kpɔɡchɔɡa la dɛ che ka do nii ta a fuh la, ɡɛɛ waa bwa jaɡa saŋ ɛɛ ba doe.
Men Nɛn Bie la ɛɛ tomɛ n nyundua toromaa ba n kora nɔ ta, bá ba kpɔ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ do nɛra wechɔɡa ta ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ka ta ninlao ta, belaa wii ne weweele do.
Ásɛ name nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa ba wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi la chaah kɛŋɔ wee ken ba Mɛɛ Kora la ta bela.
Nomɛlbwa waa no la, ó no.” Kondɔɔh kwaane aa sɔah sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii Kora la waa ane ɡee la ja.
A do kɛŋɔ baa bɛl aa kaa kpaah kondɔɔh kwaane baa kpɔa sɔh harɛ bɛl ta.
Asɛ o ɡe berɛ kwaa sɔh dɛ kpɔ kwaa la silɛɛ, dɛ ka yoɡ komɛlbwa waa dɔa, dɛ kpɔ suuɡa la ka yawɛ a ɡɛ harɛ la.
Korowii Kora la tenten berɔ do kɛŋɔ bonadii bɛl waa dɛ ɡaaɡe lwedɛɛɡa ane a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ́ yawɛ.
Asɛ awola bɛl, o ka na lwedɛɛɡe tenten bɛl o yoɡ aa kpeɡa taeh, dɛ ka yoɡ o kondɔɔh bwa, dɛ kpɔ ka yawɛ ɡɛ lwee la.
Dɔɔh kpɔe dɛ́ lawɛ pɛŋa sɛɡla Korowii Kora la dor bɛl ɡee nɔ.
Nɛra bane baa dɛ ɛ nee toma kaa ta dɔɔh moo ta, dɛ lawɛ pɛŋe te bɛlbwa siwi.
Dɔɔh la aa su pɛŋa la, ba tɛr ba hɛŋle ta, asɛ dɛ soŋni harɛ dɛ chale a bini, dɛ pa pɛŋedɛɛɡa la do loɡbaa bini, asɛ dɛ pa anɔ la aa wola were la ka ta.
Gɛɛ waa bwa jaɡa saŋ ɛɛ ba doe.
Nyundua toroma ɛɛ bao dɛ́ ba chale nɛnchɔɡa le nɛndɛɛɡa bini, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ nɛnchɔɡa la ka ta ninlao ta.
Belaa wii ne weweele do.” Yeesu pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “He dɛ no waa nɔ mun te naa?” Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh.” Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “Amɔ nomɛlbwa waa jemɛ Mosis Mmara la, dɛ berɛ ba hweli Korowii Kora nɔ waa la do kɛŋɔ nomɛl aa dɔ o dem, dɛ dɔ konfala ne kombena, dɛ won a bini bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kpɔe dɛ́ le bela waa dɛ cheɡ o kwa.” Korowii keame waa wola sɔn dɔe o bwɛɛ wa Yeesu aa kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa baɡle nɛra la tonɛ la, o le bela, dɛ berɛ kaa o ɡbaɡba bwɛ.
O baɡle nɛra waa ba cheremi dea ta, asɛ nɛra baa no o webaɡla la bwa nyoa kpo, baa pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Leperaa o le ɡɛ wejema nɔ ne nɔɔ?
Asɛ nyokpowaa waa dɛ ɛ nɔ ɡeɔ?
Kapenta te la bie la laa kɛɛ?
O nya laa Mɛɛre aa?
O nimanar laa Jems ne Josef ne Seemɔn dɛ Judas kɛɛ?
Bwɛɛ nɔ ta laa o nimambii bwa do aa?
Leperaa o le a ɡɛ wejema nɔ ne nyokpowaa ɛɛ nɔ bwa ne nɔ?” Anomanta, ba siwi ta on sui.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korowii keame dɔ sɔn bobɛlbwa.
Kɛ o ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ tena ne o lola ɡboo wola on duu.” Baa wola on yaradae nomanta, nyokpowaa waa ɛa bela ta warɛ.
Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee nyu teŋa Kooro Hɛrɔd waa dɛ nyiŋi Galilia harɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ la no Yeesu wa, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ o bonɔɔna be ŋɔ, “Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee laanee la.
O weero le seo ta.
A waa o won nyokpowaa nɔ ɛɛ la.” Kooro Hɛrɔd nɔ fa ɡelɔ ba lawɛ Jɔn, dɛ doo kpɛɛ dɛ kpɔɔ ka do dea.
Kooro nɔ nime Felep haah Hɛrɔdeas waa o koh ɛ Jɔn ɡɛ la, dɛkalkɛ kooro la moo, asɛ Jɔn ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o ta an aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ kɛ waa mo Hɛrɔdeas la.
Asɛ kooro la fe ɛɛ nyin Jɔn dɛ́ kpo.
Kɛ dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ Juu tena la, dɛkalkɛ ba te bwa ŋɔ Jɔn ɛ Korowii keame.
Awola bɛlee kooro la ɛɛ di o lola tɔpere, asɛ Hɛrɔdeas bihaah ba sa baɡle nɛra la bwa.
O sae la ɡelɔ kooro la sie lɛ.
O ŋɔ tolo la be ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛ komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la, mɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ.” O la ka ŋɔ o nya be.
O nya ɡel o la dɛ ka ŋɔ kooro la be ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ he kpɔ Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la nyu dawɛ korɔ ta ba tɛ mɛ taraken.” Waa nɔ we kooro la nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ o ntam waa ŋwɛɛra la ne nɛra baa soɡe bela dɛ no la nomanta, waa nyin kɛ ó to o ntam la, asɛ dɛ sɛh, dɛ ɡel ba la dea bela baa do Jɔn la, dɛ ka teŋe o nyu, dɛ kpɔ dawɛ korɔ ta ba tɛ tolo la, asɛ o ɡe kpɔ ka tɛ o nya.
Jɔn habɔteŋra la balɔ dɛ ba kpɔ lale la ka huɡe, asɛ dɛ ka taa baɡle Yeesu.
Yeesu tɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banue kondikwaa ba di Yeesu aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o le nɛra baah dɛ ka kpɔ ɡbera dɛ kaa bela nomɛlbwa aa wola toole.
Nɛra no ɡɛ waa la, dɛ le ba bwɛɛre ta dɛ kpɔ naa ta dɛ tiu.
Yeesu aa le ɡbera la bini, dɛ nɛnlaa tenten lɔ bela.
Ba waa domɛ o tea, asɛ o chah ba bini weela tena.
Bɔr aa dɛ jo la, o habɔteŋra la baa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, bonɔ ɛ kpɔɡ baah, bɔr ɡe dɛ jo.
Anomanta, ŋɔ ba be bá kaa bwɛɛre nɔ aa bar bonɔ nɔ ta, dɛ́ ka yawɛ kwaane di.” Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Ba ta chɛɛ kɛ ba kaa.
Hé ɡe nyin kwaa tɛɛ ba bá di.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Paanoo anue ne pɛŋa anɛ ɡboo ya dɔ bonɔ.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ.” O ɡel nɛra la bwa so harɛ kpɔɡlor la ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ paanoo anue la ne pɛŋa anɛ la, dɛ ha sie nyiŋi nyundua dɛ jam Korowii, dɛ mɔne paanoo la do o habɔteŋra la nɔɔra ta dɛ ŋɔ bá bɔne tɛɛ ba, asɛ nɛra la bwa di dɛ vaɡre.
O habɔteŋra la aa tɔɔ paanoo ne pɛŋa baa dia a ka la pɛ la, a su wɛɡrɛjena fi dɛ anɛ.
Nɛra baa di kwaa la, ba baala ɡbo ɛɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa banue.
Haahna ne bechale te ta jae.
Yeesu valɛ nee sie Belaa Yeesu ɡel o habɔteŋra la jo ɡbera bini dɛ tɔ sie kaa moo la baŋ, asɛ o ɡe ɡel nɛra la ɛɛ peɡre.
Nɛra la aa kaala la, o teehnɔ kaa bwejen bɛl doa, dɛ ka soŋe Korowii bela.
Bɔr aa baa ɡarɛ bwa, dɛ o ɡbo ta lɔ bela.
Gɛ saŋ nɔ bwa dɛ ɡbera la lɔ mobaah ta asɛ nehɛma ɛɛ beɡro, dɛkalkɛ dɛ peu bɛl tao dɛɛ chem ba.
Jabal loɡla sii saŋ la, Yeesu valɔ kpɔ nee la sie dɛɛ kaa ba be.
Baa nao o valɛ nee sie dɛɛ ba la, ba ɔmɔ dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre ŋɔ, “Lalee yoo!” Yeesu den ŋɔ, “Hé lawɛ bambile.
Menee!
He bɛ ɔmɛ!” Anee Pita ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, dɛ henee yaa, ɡel ń ɡe won valɛ nee sie ba he be.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Ba.” Belaa Pita den le ɡbera bini tu nee sie dɛ valɛ dɛɛ kaa o be.
Waa na ɡɛ peu la aa dɛ ta la, o berɔ ɔmɛ dɛ den dɛɛ morɛ, asɛ dɛ do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, lɛɛ mɛ!” Buɡ la ta, dɛ Yeesu tel bela dɛ lawɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “He yarada aa kanɛ kwara!
Ɛrɛɛ he berɛ di tɔŋla nɔɔ?” Baa jo ɡbera la bini la, peu la ɡel tae.
Yeesu habɔteŋra baa lɔ ɡbera la bini la ɡuŋu dɛ ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, henee Korowii Bie la kpela.” Ba tawɔ ka chuɡe moo la baŋ bɛl Gɛnɛsarɛt harɛ ta.
Bela tena la aa jemɔ la, ba kaa yerɛ baah bela tena ba bwara aa dɛ wee ba bwa ba Yeesu be.
Ba soŋo ŋɔ ó ɡel weela tena la leɡe o batakaare nyoa ɡbo ásɛ dɛ ɡbaŋre.
Asɛ banɔ baa leɡe o batakaare nyoa la bwa ɡbaŋre.
Naawa webaɡla Farisii tena ne Tɔnjerema bane le Jerusalam dɛ ba bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa he habɔteŋra nɔ ɛɛ jo ya kii nɛɛ nɔɔ?
Sama ya naawa aa baɡle yaa ŋɔ yá samɛ nɔɔra mɔɔ dɛɛ di kwaa la, baa ɡɛ ɛ!” Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa he ɡee jo Korowii kii nɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ he ɡbaɡba webaɡla ta nɔɔ?
Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Duu he nya ne he mɛɛ, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, Nomɛlbwa waa bol o nya ne o mɛɛ bwara wechɔɡe la, a chɛ kɛ bá kpoo.’ Kɛ he ɡe dɛ baɡle kɛ nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔ o mɛɛ ne o nya be ŋɔ ó kpɔ kwaa waa dɔ dɛ́ kpɔ cha ba la bwa tɛ Korowii, a ta chɛɛ kɛ ó duu o mɛɛ dɛ́ chao kpa.
Kenii hɛɛ chɔɡ Korowii Mmarare dɛɛ teŋɛ he ɡbaɡba webaɡla ta nɔ.
He nɛra haa nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
Korowii keame Aesaya na he waa bol kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ waa ŋɔa ŋɔ, ‘Nɛra nɔ te, nyoa ɡbo nee baa duu mɛ, kɛ ba tea bini te ta toe.
Nɛwɛnyini mmarare taa baa baɡle ŋɔ nɛ́ra teŋɛ, anomanta, pɛɛpɛɛ baa tom mɛ.’ ” Kwaa nɛn aa dɛ di laa ɡela o ɛ nɛnchɔɡe Yeesu yerɛ nɛnlaa la ba o be, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé no waa nɔ dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ kwaa nɛn aa dɛ di laa ɡela o ɛ nɛnchɔɡe, nemenɛ anɔ la aa dɛ le o nyoa wɛɛ bol la.” Anee o habɔteŋra la ba o be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “He jemɔ kɛŋɔ he waa nɔ haa bola nɔ jo Farisii tena nɔ bini kenɛ?” Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Daa te bɛlbwa n Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la aa wola on due la, baa huɡruu ta.
He bɛ ban dawɛ le!
Ba ɛ nyoŋa baa dɛ tɔ nyoŋa sie.
Nyoŋe lawɛ o dɔŋ nyoŋe daa aa, ba bwa dɛ le bɔɔ ta.” Asɛ Pita ŋɔ, “Chaɡle yaa waa nɔ mun.” Anee Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He ɡe aa a mun jemaa?
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ kwaa haa dɛ di la, tea binii aa kaa dɛɛ berɛ dahara aa?
Kɛ waa aa le nɛn nyoa la te, bambile binii a le.
Anee yon ɡel nɛn ɛ nɛnchɔɡe.
Liichɔɡa ne nɛŋkpoa, ne jwamane ne ŋwɛɛ wa, ne nyosone teŋa ne nɛra ŋwala, dɛ anɔ aa jaa bwa, bambile binii a le.
Anee ɡela nɛn ɛɛ ɛ nɛnchɔɡe.
Kɛ dɛ nɛn ta nɔn samɛ ɡɛ he naawa aa chaɡle heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ɛ di kwaa la aa, a te aa won ɡel ó ɛ nɛnchɔɡe.” Haah bɛl yarada dɔe wa Yeesu le bela dɛ kaa bwɛjena Taaya ne Sidon pera.
Haah bɛl waa ɛ Keenan te dɛ do bela ba Yeesu be dɛ ba kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Devid Naa Yeesu, na n sum!
Nomoa, kwaa dɛ ir n bihaah nɛɛ dɛɛ fiiɡu, a do kpeɡri.” Yeesu ta on chaŋɛ, asɛ o habɔteŋra la ba o be dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “Gel haah nɔ kaa kɛ waa teŋɛ ya nɛɛ dɛɛ do yaa ɡbɔɡa la!” Anee Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa do kɛŋɔ peera aa nyoɡra dɛ le Israel tena bini la ɡbo waa ba tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba ɡaaɡe ba bɔr.” Haah la den ba ɡuŋi Yeesu sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Cha mɛ, Nomoa.” Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ bechale di kwaa vaɡre mɔɔ nyootena ɡe di.
Aa were kɛ ba kpɔ bechale kondikwaa tɛ nyootena.” Belaa haah la ɡe sɛh ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋii, Nomoa, kɛ nyootena aa bechale kondikompuɡrere aa leera la ɡe di aa?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa dɛ yarada mɛ la kan kɛrɛdɛ!
Gɛ haa dɛ nyin la, aa ɛ ɡɛɛ tɛɛ.” Buɡ la ta, bie la ɡbaŋre.
Gɛ Yeesu aa chah nɛndamanta bane Yeesu le bela dɛ kaa fɛrɛ Galilia Moo la nyoa, dɛ ka teeh bwejen bɛl dɛ so bela, asɛ nɛnlaa tenten ba o be, dɛ kpɔ weela tena ba peri aa serewa, ne nyoŋa ne boobie ne amumure, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ we weela bwa soo siwi ba bil o sie, asɛ o chaah ba.
Nɛra la nyoa kpoo kɛ baa na ɡɛ amumure aa bera won waa bola, boobie ne nɛra ba peri aa serewa won ir che dɛɛ valɛ, asɛ nyoŋa ɡe berɛ won dɛɛ na la.
Anomanta, ba kpɛɛ Korowii ba Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la.
Yeesu yerɛ o habɔteŋra la dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nɛra nɔ waa dɛ domɛ n tea, dɛkalkɛ n ne baa soɡa tɔpera atoroo nɔ, taraken ba ta komɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ di.
Dɛ n ɡel ba ɡɛ ba kpɔ lɔr kaa laa, baa ɡwɛɡre ŋwɛnɛ taa.” O habɔteŋra la pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ paanoo tɛ nɛndamanta nɔ bwa dɔŋ kpɔɡ nɔ baah bonɔ bá di a won tel baɔ?” Anee Yeesu pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Paanoo aŋwɛnɛɛ he dɔɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Anuanɛ dɛ pɛŋejeɡre tamaa ane.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ nɛnlaa la be ŋɔ bá so harɛ.
Asɛ o kpɔ paanoo anuanɛ la ne pɛŋa la dɛ jam Korowii, dɛ mɔne do o habɔteŋra la nɔɔra ta, dɛ ŋɔ bá bɔne tɛ nɛnlaa la, ba ɡe bɔne tɛɛ ba.
Ba bwa di kwaa la dɛ vaɡre.
O habɔteŋra la tɔɔ anɔ la baa dia a ka la pɛ, asɛ a su wɛɡrɛjena anuanɛ.
Nɛra baa di kwaa la, ba bini baala ɛɛ ɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banaarɛɛ.
Haahna ne bechale te ta jae.
Asɛ Yeesu ta nɛra la ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ jo ɡbera bini kaa Maɡadan pera.
Ba soŋe Yeesu ŋɔ ó ɛ nyokpowa ba na Farisii tena bane ne Saduki tena bane ba Yeesu be dɛ ba daahno na dɛɛ nyin ó ɛ nyokpowaane bá na ásɛ dɛ won jemɛ kɛ Korowii bee o le kpela.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Weswɛm saŋ he nyiŋi nyundua dɛ nyundua swɛɛraa, he yon ŋɔ bwaala aa tena ba.
Chɔmbibi ne ɡe he iro dɛ na kɛ nyundua swɛɛrɔ dɛ bibir aa, he yon ŋɔ nyundua aa swɛɛra dɛ bibir nɔ, bwaala ɛɛ nɛo.
He won nyundua nyiŋa dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa, aah ɛrɛ waa haa wola won jemɛ waa aa chiɡ taraken nɔ te mun nɔɔ?
Fini nɛra haa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡbo haa wola Korowii ɔmɛ nɔ, heyaa ŋɔa ń ɛ nyokpowaa he na naa?
Maa wobɛlbwaa ɛ hé na.
Waa aa pu Korowii keame Jona la dɔŋa ɡboo dɛɛ ba n ɡe pui, ásɛ he che a ta dɛ́ jemɛ n nɛnsoo.” Anomanta, o ɡel ba bela dɛ kaa.
Farisii ne Saduki tena webaɡla aa do kɛŋɔ iisi wa Yeesu habɔteŋra la aa ɡale moo la la, ba soɔh, ba ta paanoo kpɔe ja.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ Farisii tena ne Saduki tena iisi wa.” Ba ta o sɛɡla la mun noɛ, dɛɛ pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Amɔ yaa wola paanoo kpɔe waa wɛɛ bol ɡɛ naa?” Yeesu aa no waa baa dɛ pɛɛ dɔŋa la, o pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa hɛɛ pɛɛ dɔŋa paanoo bɛ dɔe waa nɔɔ?
Haa men yarada kwara!
Saŋ la bwa haa waa mun no mɔɔ naa?
Maa mɔne paanoo anue tɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banue ba di ka la, a kabora haa paa la, wɛɡrɛ dela aŋwɛnɛɛ he dɔ laɔ?
Paanoo anuanɛ la maa tɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banaarɛ ba di la, wɛɡrɛ dela aŋwɛnɛɛ ɡee he dɔ laɔ?
Ɛrɛ taa a che he ta wone jemɛ kɛŋɔ paanoo waa laa mɛɛ bol he be nɔɔ?
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ Farisii tena ne Saduki tena iisi la wa.” Name o habɔteŋra la ta no waa la mun kɛ iisi baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ paanoo waa laa wɛɛ ja ba la, kɛ Farisii tena ne Saduki tena webaɡla la taa wɛɛ ja ba.
Gɛ Pita aa baɡle Yeesu nɛnsoo Yeesu la Sisaaria Felepae bwɛɛre ane ta.
Belaa o pɛɛ o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo nɛra ɛɛ lii Men Nɛn Bie nɔɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Bane ŋɔ Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee laanee hen, bane ŋɔ Elaejaa hen.
Bane ɡe ŋɔ Jeremia laa hen aa, amɔ te, Korowii keamebena la bɛlee hen.” Anee Yeesu berɛ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Asɛ he ɡe sɛ, nɛn besoo hɛɛ lii mɛ nɔ?” Seemɔn Pita chaŋo ŋɔ, “Henee Kristo la, Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la Bie la.” Yeesu ŋɔ, “Jɔn bie Seemɔn, he na som kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa wola hen waa nɔ baɡlɛ asɛ he jemɛ nɔ.
N Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua laanee baɡle.
Anomanta, n ŋɔ he sɔne Pita, o munii Bwe.
Gɛ bwe nɔ taa mɛɛ ba n dea doe chɔŋɛ.
N habɔteŋraa n dea la.
Hale seo kwara aa wola won pɔ ba nɛɛ bwa.
Mɛɛ kpɔ Korowii Kora la safoonee do he nɔn ta, ásɛ waa haa wola sɛɛh harɛ nɔ ta la, nyundua ɡe Korowii aa sɛh, kɛ anɔ haa sɛah harɛ nɔ ta la, nyundua ɡe Korowii ɛɛ sɛah.” Anee Yeesu kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ o waa bol baɡle nomɛlbwa kɛ onee Kristo la.
Gɛ Yeesu aa bol o wahala nae ne o seo wa Le ɡɛ saŋ la, Yeesu bol waa chasee ken dɛɛ baɡle o habɔteŋra la, dɛ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛŋɔ ń kaa Jerusalam, dɛ́ ka na wahala bela nomonome ne Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema nɔn ta, ásɛ ba kpo mɛ, ásɛ a tɔpetooro wee la, ń ir seo ta.” Anee Pita lawɔ le bokɛre dɛ kaoh ŋɔ, “Aa!
N Dɔɔ, Korowii ɛɛ la a ne bojaŋ.
Aa he nɛɛ ɡɛɛ ba bwa.” Belaa Yeesu laa o te berɛ dɛ kɔr Pita ŋɔ, “Le n jwɛh, Bɔnsam!
He dɛ neɡ mɛ ń ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛkalkɛ haa anɔ la Korowii aa dɛ nyin la lii, nemenɛ nɛra tetoowa.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ nyin kɛ ó teŋɛ n nɛ aa, ó ɡel o tetookwaa nyina dɛ́ kpɔ o te kɛ wɛɛ sɛh wahala nae ne seo bwaa, dɛ́ ba teŋɛ n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa kpɔ daɡaɡre che bá ka kpaaro pɛl o ta la, dɛkalkɛ nomɛlbwa o sie aa swɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ kwaa ta la, wɛɛ paŋɛ o nyuu.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe o sie aa wola harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ kwaa ta swɛɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Dɛ nɛn dɔ harɛ nɔ ta kwaa bwa dɛ nyoɡre o nyu aa, bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ wɛɛ ba dɔe yɔ?
Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba wona kpɔ dɛ́ charɛ o nyu ɔ?
Men Nɛn Bie nɔ ɛɛ kpɔ n Mɛɛ jirima laanee, n ne n nyundua toroma le nyundua ba, dɛ́ ba bɔ nomɛlbwa kem ɡɛ o toma aa doa.
Kasinteŋ, a ɡɛ saŋ Men Nɛn Bie aa ba di kora la, he bini bane ɛɛ so lee, dɛ́ na mɛ.”
Yeesu beɡra wa Aa di tɔpera anumɛl la, Yeesu tɔ Pita ne Jems ne o nime Jɔn sie ba ka teeh bwejen bɛl, dɛ ɡbo ka so o doa bobɛl.
Baa soɡa la, dɛ Yeesu beɡrɔ, o siebɔr do kɛŋɔ wee ken, asɛ o laala waa doa la ɡe to dɛɛ nyɛɡle al-al ken.
O habɔteŋra batoro la berɛ ŋɔ ba nyiŋi, dɛ Mosis ne Elaeja ja Yeesu nɛɛ baa bol wa.
Anee Pita ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, a wer taeh kɛ yaa lɔ bonɔ nɔ!
Dɛ he dɛ nyin aa, mɛɛ do kukure atoroo cheɡ bonɔ, ásɛ he kpɔ bɛl, Mosis kpɔ bɛl, ásɛ Elaeja ɡe kpɔ bɛl.” O nyoa taa lɔ waa ta wɛɛ bol la, dɛ bampoŋ bɛl denɔ ba tɔ ba nɛ, asɛ ba no taa bɛl bam la bini kɛ, “N Bie maa dɛ nyinu o wa ɛɛ su n siwii nɔ.
Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no o be.” Yeesu habɔteŋra la aa no taa la la, ɔmee laɡ ba kohona ba ɡuŋi dɛ kpɔ ba sie piiɡi harɛ.
Asɛ Yeesu ba, dɛ ba kpɔ nɔn lɔ ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ir che.
He bɛ ɔmɛ.” Ba laa ba nyuune ir dɛ nyiŋi, dɛ nomɛlbwa toole ka ja ba ne Yeesu nɛ.
Baa le bwejen la doa dɛɛ ba la, Yeesu ja ba ŋɔ, “He bɛ waa nɔ haa naa nɔ taa baɡle nomɛlbwa bwa, dɛ́ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa ɡel Men Nɛn Bie ir seo ta mɔɔ.” Anee o habɔteŋra la pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛ waa Tɔnjerema la ɛɛ chaɡle ŋɔ, a chɛ kɛŋɔ Elaeja tɔ sie ba mɔɔ Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la ɡe ba nɔɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Elaejaa dɛ́ tɔ sie ba kpela, dɛ́ ba kwaa ŋwɛnɛ mɔɔ.
Kɛ kasinteŋ, Elaeja balɔ dɛ kaa.
Waa bala la, ba ta on jemɛ dɛ ɛo ɡɛ bɛlbwa aa too ba tea.
Weweele la tenten baa kpɔa ɛo laanee baa ba kpɔe ɛ Men Nɛn Bie ɡe.” Asɛ mɔɔ o habɔteŋra la ta jemɛ kɛŋɔ Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la waa wɛɛ bol la.
Yeesu chah bibaa bɛl waa dɛ chole ɡbuŋɡbuŋri Gɛ saŋ baa le bwejen la doa dɛ tu la, ba kaa pu nɛnlaa bane.
Baa bɛl den ba ɡuŋi Yeesu sie dɛ ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, na n bibaa nɔ sum tɛ mɛ!
O dɛ chole ɡbuŋɡbuŋri.
A iraa, aa were kwaraa.
Tɔpebɛla a iraa, a ɡelɔ wɛɛ chole nii ta, asɛ tɔpebɛla ɡe a ɡel wɛɛ chole nee ta.
N kpɔɔ ba he habɔteŋra nɔ be, kɛ ba ta wone chaoh.” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Oo!
Fini nɔ nɛra wechɔɡa aa lɔ he nɛɛ nɔ, he ta yarada dɔe!
Tɔpera aŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń lawɛ bambile, dɛ́ so he be mɔɔ he yarada Korowii ɔ?
Maa tɔpere bɛl dii ba he be kpa oo!
Hé kpɔ bie la ba tɛ mɛ!” Yeesu kɔr kwaa aa ɡela ɡbuŋɡbuŋri la ɛɛ ir bie la nɛɛ la, asɛ a le o nɛɛ kaa.
Buɡ la ta, bie la den dɔ bokpeɡa.
Anee Yeesu habɔteŋra la la o be bokɛre, dɛ ka pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa ya te ta wone doŋi kwaa la le bie la nɛɛ nɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “He yarada aa wola kanɛ waa.
Kasinteŋ, dɛ he yarada fe kan kɛŋɔ sipon ɡba aa, hé fe ɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ bwejen nɔ be ŋɔ ó huɡri kaa bela haa dɛ nyin, ásɛ o kaa.
Hé fe ɛɛ wonoo ɛ komɛlbwa.
A ɡɛ kwaa nɔ konsoo la, nyoa vɔwa ne Korowii soŋa ɡboo dɛɛ ba wona doŋa.” Yeesu bol o seo waa ja Yeesu habɔteŋra la bwa aa baa cheme Galilia harɛ la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ba dɛ ba Men Nɛn Bie lee do nɛra nɔn ta.
Baa kpo mɛɛ, ásɛ tɔpera atoro ń berɛ ir seo ta.” Ate, dɛ o habɔteŋra la bwa loo kuu.
Korowii Dea toɔ bɔe wa Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la la Kapeeneɔm.
Asɛ Korowii Dea toɔ lɛɛra baa pɛɛ Pita ŋɔ, “He Dɔɔ nɔ dɛ bɔ Korowii Dea toɔ aa?” Anee Pita ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, o dɛ bɔ.” Pita aa jo dem bini la, Yeesu den tɔ sie pɛɛro, “Seemɔn, bamewaa bɔ toɔ dɛɛ tɛ harɛ nɔ ta koranar ɔ?
Ba ɡbaɡba bii kɛɛ hɔɔhra ɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he na nɔ?” Anee Pita ŋɔ, “Hɔɔhraa dɛɛ bɔ.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ te naa, amɔ te a ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ bá lɛ koobii toɔ.
Kɛ maa wola nyin kɛ yá jo ba nɛɛ nomanta, la moo ta, dɛ́ ka ta ɡoŋa.
Pɛŋe bɛlbwa waa tɔ sie ba tɛr ɡoŋa la, lɔɔ le baŋ dɛ́ nyiŋi o nyoa bini.
Hɛɛ na suuɡa bwe waa tel n ne he bwa toɔ laanee, ásɛ he kpɔ ka bɔ tɛ ya bwa.”
Nɛn waa ɛ nomoa Korowii kora ta A ɡɛ saŋ la Yeesu habɔteŋra la bwa ba o be dɛ ba pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ya bini umee ɡwaa ya bwa dɛ ɛ nomoa Korowii Kora la ta nɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu yerɛ bechajeɡa bɛl dɛ ɡel o ba che ba baah ta, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, he ta he liire charɛ dɛ do kɛŋɔ bechajeɡre aa, haa won ja Korowii Kora la ta bwa.
Naate waa won pwɛr o te, dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ bechajeɡa nɔ la, onee ɡwaa nomɛlbwa Korowii Kora la ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa koh n waa dɛ́ nyiŋi bie nɔ dɔŋ nɛɛ la, menee o nyiŋi la.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa neɡre bechajeɡre nɔ dɔŋ bɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada mɛ nɔ ásɛ o ɛ wechɔɡa la, dɛ ba fe vɔwɛ nambwe do o baŋa, dɛ kpɔɔ ka ta mpo vil ta kwaraa fe bɔ.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra, hé bwɛɛlɛ, he dɔŋa neɡra dɛɛ do wechɔɡa ta nomanta.
A ɡɛ waa la ɛɛ bao te, kɛ naate waa ba a ne la, ó bwɛɛlɛ.
Dɛ he nɔn kɛɛ he nakpala ɛɛ neɡree he ɛ wechɔɡa aa, teŋo ta.
Haa dɔ nɔmbeŋkpoŋ kɛɛ nakpabeŋkpoŋ, dɛ dɔ Korowii be kaa bɔ kɛŋɔ, haa dɔ nɔɔra anɛ kɛɛ nakpale anɛ, dɛ kaa Bɔnsam nii aa wola dime bwa la ta.
Dɛ he siwi ɡee neɡree he ɛ wechɔɡa aa, fomo ta.
Haa dɔ siwi beŋkpoŋ, dɛ ba dɔ Korowii mkpa bɔ kɛŋɔ, haa dɔ sibie anɛ dɛ kaa Bɔnsam nii aa wola dime bwa la ta.” Penyoɡre bɛl sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ n bechajeɡre nɔ bɛlbwa nyiŋi vah.
N dɛ ŋɔ he be kɛŋɔ, nyundua toroma baa dɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la won n Mɛɛ sie laŋa saŋ te bɛlbwa.
Nɛra baa nyoɡra la waa Men Nɛn Bie koh ba.
Dɛ nomɛl dɔ peera lafa asɛ beŋkpoŋ nyoɡre aa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?
Wɛɛ ɡel fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ la a dibɔr belaa tama, dɛ́ ka ɡaaɡe beŋkpoŋ waa nyoɡra la bɔr.
Dɛ o nao waa, kasinteŋ, o sie ɛɛ lɛ o nɛɛ ɡwaa fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ la aa wola nyoɡrɛ la.
Gɛɛ a do he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la aa wola nyin kɛŋɔ bechale nɔ bini bɛlbwa nyoɡre.” He dɔŋ waa ɛɛ wechɔɡa wa Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he dɔŋ ɛɛ wechɔɡa ane aa, la o be he ne o le bokɛre bela nomɛlbwa aa wola toole, dɛ́ ka ɡel o jemɛ wechɔɡa waa kpɔa ɛɛ.
Dɛ o na o wechɔɡa dɛ larawe naa, dɛ he berɔ dɔ he chamenate.
Kɛ dɛ o ŋɔ waa sɛh kɛ o ɛ wechɔɡa aa, ka nyin nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kɛɛ banɛ ja he nɛ, ásɛ he ne ba la o be, dɛkalkɛ nɛra banɛ kɛɛ batoro danseɛ ɛ kasinteŋ.
Dɛ he ne nɛra la laŋɔ o ŋɔ waa sɛh ja aa, kpɔ ka bil he bala bwa he ne ba aa dɛ cheme la sie.
Dɛ o ŋɔ waa ba ɡe bee no aa, ɡel o waa tɛo kɛ nɛn waa wola Korowii tomɛ kɛɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ.
Kasinteŋ, wobɛlbwa haa wola sɛɛh harɛ nɔ ta la, nyundua ɡe Korowii aa sɛh, asɛ wobɛlbwa haa sɛh harɛ nɔ ta la, nyundua ɡe Korowii ɛɛ sɛoh.
N berɔ dɛɛ ŋɔ he be ja kɛ dɛ he bini banɛ ɡba nyoa pɛo harɛ nɔ ta hɛɛ nyin komɛl aa, n Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la ɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ bela nɛra banɛ kɛɛ batoro aa kpɔ nyopɛo cheme n sɔn ta la, dɛ n ja ba nɛ.” Bonɔɔ waa wola waa kpɔe dɛɛ kɛ sɛɡla Anee Pita ba bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, kera aŋwɛnɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ n dɔŋ ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa aa, ń kpɔ kɛo wɔ?
Kera anuanɛ kɛɛ?” Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “N ta ŋɔe kera anuanɛ, kɛ kera fifraanuanɛ bele anuanɛ.
Anomanta, Korowii Kora waa la do kɛŋɔ kooro bɛl ne o bonɔɔna wa.
Kooro la iro dɛ ŋɔ o bonɔɔna ba baɡle ba toma ɛɛ bini ó na.
Waa pa mun dɛɛ nyiŋi ba toma ɛɛ bini la, a taa o na kɛ bonɔɔna la bɛl di o kem suuɡa aa wola nyoa dɔe.
Waa naa kɛŋɔ bonɔɔ la aa won ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ́ bɔ kem la la, o ŋɔ bá yoɡ o ne o haah ne bii ne o kondɔɔh bwa, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ kem la.
Anee bonɔɔ la ɡuŋi kooro la sie dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, ‘N poori, na n sum dɛ́ lawɛ bambile, kɛ mɛɛ bɔe he kem la bwaa.’ Asɛ kooro la na o sum kohona dɛ ɡelo, dɛ kpɔ kem la kɛo.
Bonɔɔ la aa dɔ bɔr le dɛɛ kaa la, o kaa pu o dɔŋ o ɡe aa di o kenjeɡaa bɛl.
Waa na o dɔŋ la la, o den hamɛ o lobi dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Kpɔ n suuɡa tɛ mɛ!’ Anee o bonɔndɔŋ la ɡuŋi o sie dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, ‘N poori, na n sum dɛ́ lawɛ bambile, kɛ mɛɛ bɔe he kemee.’ Bonɔɔ la ta o dɔŋ la sum nae, dɛ ɡel ba ka doo dea dɛ ka tel saŋ waa bɔ kem la mɔɔ.
O bonɔndɔŋa la aa na waa aa chiɡa la, a we ba nɛɛ taeh, asɛ ba ka taa waa la baɡle ba bwa dɔɔ kooro la.
Kooro la yerɛ o bonɔɔ la dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Nyubinikpeɡ te kohona!
N koh soŋa haa soŋ mɛ la waa dɛ kpɔ kendamanta la bwa kɛɛ.
Amɔ a fe ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he ɡe fee na he dɔŋ nɔ sum, dɛ́ kpɔ kem nɔ kɛo wa aa?’ Kooro la kpɔ bandia ŋɔ bá kpɔ bonɔɔ la ka do dea, dɛ́ ɛo weweele ká tel ɡɛ saŋ waa dɛ ba wona bɔ kem la bwa.” Yeesu aa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, anee o ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ɡe ta he bambile bini leɛ dɛ kpɔ he dɔŋa wechɔɡa kɛ ba aa, ɡɛɛ n Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la ɡee ba heyaa ɛɛ.”
Baa ne haah dɔŋa vɛɛh Yeesu aa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, o le Galilia harɛ dɛ kaa Juda harɛ, Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ.
Dɛ nɛnlaa tenten teŋɛ o nɛ, asɛ o chah weela tena bela.
Asɛ Farisii tena bane ba bela dɛ ba kpɔ webɔɔra dɛɛ haɡro bela dɛ́ fe dɔɔ lawɛ.
Ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Mmara dɛ tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ baa won che wobɛlbwa ta vɛh o haah naa?” Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He ta Korowii Tɔn la kure no kɛɛ?
Korowii waa ta kwaa bwa la, waa dɛ ba nɛwɛnyini tae la, baa ne haahnee o ta, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘A waa baa ɛɛ ba o nya ne o mɛɛ jwɛɛh lee, dɛ́ kpɔ o te ka pɛl o haah, ásɛ ba nɛra banɛ la pɛ ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ la.’ Anomanta, baa nɛra banɛ ɛɛ ba kpa, ba pɛo ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Dɛ Korowii lawɛ nɛra banɛ pɛ aa, ŋwɛnɛ toole kɛŋɔ nɛn berɛ pere ba baah kpa.” Anee ba pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛ waa Mosis Mmara la tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ dɛ baa dɛ ba o haah vɛɛh yaa, ó chwerɛ tɔn tɛo dɛ́ baɡle kɛ o vɛoh nɔɔ?” Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He bambikpeɡ waa Mosis tɛ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ hé chwerɛ tɔn tɛ he haah dɛ́ vɛoh la.
Gɛ laa a faa do wubwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh o haah la, dɛ baala laa haah la nyin mɔɔ o vɛoh, dɛ ka mo hanfale aa, dɛ o ɛ o haah la wechɔɡa dɛ bɔ jwamane.” Anee o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ kenii waa nɔ chɔ tɛ baa o haah moe ta te naa, amɔ te a wer kɛ baa bɛ haah mo, ásɛ haah ɡe bɛ yalɛ kwara.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nɛra bwa laa dɛ́ won so ŋɔ baa haahnaa mo, nemenɛ banɔ la Korowii aa kpɔ ɡɛ tɛɛ ba la ɡbosoroo.
Nɛra bane haahna bɛ moe la ne a ŋwɛnɛree.
Bane le a ne Korowii doa ba.
Asɛ bane ɡe, fɔɡaa ba fɔɡɛ ba lure, asɛ bane ɡe koh Korowii Kora la waa dɛ ɛ ba te ɡɛ.
Naate waa won teŋɛ n waa maa baɡla nɔ ta la, ó takapɔ dɛ́ teŋɛ a ta.” Yeesu swee bechale bane andɛɛɡa Dɛ nɛra bane kpɔ ba bii ba Yeesu be ŋɔ ó kpɔ o nɔn dawɛ ba nɛ, dɛ́ swee ba andɛɛɡa.
Asɛ o habɔteŋra la kɔɡre nɛra la ŋɔ bá kpɔ ba bii la le le.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “He bɛ bechale la ŋwɛnɛ tɔ.
Hé ɡel ba ba n be, dɛkalkɛ banɔ dɔŋa nɔɔ Korowii Kora koobii la.” Yeesu aa kpɔ o nɔn dawɛ ba nɛɛ tonɛ la, o le ba be dɛ kaa.
Baa bɛl waa ɛ dɔɔh wa Baa bɛl iro dɛ la Yeesu be dɛ ka pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Nomoa, wedɛɛɡa besoo chɛ kɛŋɔ ń ɛ dɛ́ dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa nɔ?” Anee Yeesu ɡe berɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa hɛɛ pɛɛ mɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa nɔɔ?
Korowii ɡbosoo ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe.
Kɛ dɛ he dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa te naa, dɛɛ ɛ waa Korowii Mmarare la aa dɛ chaɡle la.” Anee o pɛɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “A bini ameo?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Bɛ nɛn kpo, bɛ jwamane bɔ, bɛ ŋwɛ, bɛ nyosone teŋe dawɛ he dɔŋ nɛ.
Dɛɛ duu he nya ne mɛɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ nyin he dɔŋ kɛ he ɡbaɡba.” Baa la ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ te bwa, n dɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Amee ka mɛ jaɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he dɛ nyin kɛ he waa do kɛrɛdɛ ka tonaa, ka yoɡ he kwaa haa dɔa bwa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ a suuɡa kɛ nyaara.
Ka ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ ba teŋɛ n nɛ.
Hɛɛ dɔ kondɔɔh cheɡ Korowii doaa.” Baa la aa no ɡɛ Yeesu aa bola la, o tea bini chɔɡɔ, o laa berɛ kaa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɔ kondɔɔh taeh.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, aa do kpeɡrii tɛ dɔɔh kɛ ó dɔ bɔr ja Korowii Kora la ta.
N dɛ ŋɔ he be ja kɛŋɔ, aa do pwɛree tɛ nyoɡma kɛŋɔ ó won jo tɔɔɡe bɔɔ ta, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ dɔɔh naa wona ja Korowii Kora la ta.” Yeesu habɔteŋra la aa no ɡɛ la, ba nyoa kpoo, baa pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Amɔ te umee dɛɛ ba o nyu dɔe yɔ?” Yeesu ha sie nyiŋ ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bee a do kpeɡri, kɛ Korowii be te, wobɛlbwa aa kpeɡe.” Anee Pita chaŋe Yeesu ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na, ya te ɡel komɛlbwa yaa dɔa dɛ ba teŋɛ he nɛ.
Bɔkwaa yaa ba dɔe yɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa ba beɡre kwaa bwa anfala, ásɛ Men Nɛn Bie nɔ ba so n kookarajen la ta la, he nɛra fi dɛ banɛ nɔ haa teŋɛ n nɛɛ nɔ ɡee so kookane fi dɛ anɛ taa, dɛ́ bol nɛra baa le Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la bwa waa dɛ́ pa ba bole.
Asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe koh n waa dɛ ɡel o dem ne o nahaahnanar, ne o dɔɔranar ne nimanar, ne o nya ne o mɛɛ, ne o bii dɛ kooni aa, wɛɛ dɔ a dɔŋa bele lafaa, dɛ́ berɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la ɡe.
Nɛra baa tɔ sie ɡalɡa ɛɛ ba ka munii, ásɛ nɛra baa ka mun ɡe ɡalɡa ba tɔ sie.”
Tom-ɛɛra baa bɔ ba paa sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii Kora la do kɛŋɔ paa bɛl ne o tom-ɛɛra bane wa.
Paa la iro chɔmbibi dɛɛ nyin tom-ɛɛra bá ka ɛ toma o koo ta dɛ́ lɛ suuɡa.
O ne ba di yoɡ, asɛ ba sɛh kɛ baa ɛ toma tɔpebir la bwaa, dɛ́ lɛ denaare beŋkpoŋ aa ɛ tɔpebir toma kembɔr, asɛ o ɡel paa tena la kaa koo la ta.
Dɛ́ɛ kaa koola nenyɔɔ saŋ la, o berɔ ka na bonɔɔna bane baa cheɡɛ fɔɡbaah pɛɛpɛɛ.
Anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡe kaa n koo la ta ka ɛ toma, ásɛ n tɛ heyaa kembɔr aa chɛ heya.’ Asɛ ba no o be dɛ kaa.
Gɛ saŋ wee aa baa che nyufala, ne wekee saŋ la, o berɔ na tom-ɛɛra la bane ɡe ja, dɛ bol ba ɡe be ɡɛ waa bol banɔ la be la, asɛ ba ɡe kaa koo la ta.
Aa baa ka tamaa ken wee jo la, o berɔ ka na nɛra bane kɛ ba ɡe aa cheɡɛ fɔɡbaah pɛɛpɛɛ.
Anee o pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛ waa fini bwa he che bonɔ dɛɛ chɔɡ pɛɛpɛɛ nɔɔ?’ Belaa ba chaŋo ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛlbwa ta yaa o toma ta kpɔe.’ Anee baa la ŋɔ, ‘Gɛɛ te naa, hé ɡe kaa n koo ta bela ka ɛ toma.’ Wee aa baa swɛɛ bɔr jo name la, o yerɛ naate waa dɛ nyiŋi o koo la ta la dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Yerɛ tom-ɛɛra la, dɛ́ bɔ ba kem.
Kɛ tɔ sie le banɔ la baa ka mun ba la nɛ, dɛ́ bɔ ba kem.’ Banɔ la baa ba toma la ta dɛ wee dɛ ba joe la bɛlbwa dɔ denaare beŋkpoŋ.
Anomanta, dɛ banɔ la baa tɔ sie ba toma la ta chɔmbibi ne la dɛ lii kɛ baa dɔ suuɡaa ɡwaa ba bala la, kɛ denaare beŋkpoŋaa o bɔ ba ɡe bwa.
Baa lɛ ba kembɔr la dɛ ba berɔ dɛɛ naɡre paa la waa ŋɔ, ‘Banɔ te aa dena ba ta biɡre bɛlbwa wee den swɛɛ, asɛ ya te le chɔmbibi ne bwa wedamanta nɔ kpo yaa, ɡɛɛ he saah bɔ ya bwa kem kɛrɛdɛ aa?’ Anee paa la chaŋe ba bini nomoa la ŋɔ, ‘N dam, n ta heyaa faahrɛ.
N ne he ta toma nɔ yoɡ dii, he sɛh denaare beŋkpoŋa mɔɔ dɛ ba ɛa?
Hé kpɔ he suuɡa le n sie kaa.
Men dɛɛ nyin dɛ bɔ he bwa kem kɛrɛdɛ.
N ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ń kpɔ n ɡbaɡba suuɡa ɛ ɡɛ aa too n tea a?
Kɛɛ ɡɛ maa ta tea dɛ ɛ laanee dɛɛ we he nɛ?’ ” Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, o ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ a do, muŋkaala ɛɛ ba tɔ siee, ásɛ sitɔɔla berɛ ba ka mun.” Yeesu berɔ bol o seo waa toorotena Yeesu aa dɛ kaa Jerusalam la, o kaa ŋɔ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la ɡbo be ŋwɛnɛ la ta ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no n be.
Yaa dɛ kaa Jerusalam nɔ, baa ka le Men Nɛn Biee tɛ Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema la.
Baa pa mɛ bolchɔɡee dɛ́ ŋɔ bá kpo mɛ.
Baa kpɔ mɛɛ do nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la nɔn ta, bá di n loro, dɛ́ cha mɛ chweremi, dɛ́ kpaa mɛ pɛl daɡaɡre ta, dɛ́ kpo mɛ, ásɛ tɔpetooro wee la ń ir seo ta.” Haah bɛl waa soŋa tɛ o bii Asɛ Sebedii haah ne o bii ba, dɛ ba ɡuŋi Yeesu sie dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, ó ɛ waane tɛɛ ba.
Anee Yeesu pɛɛ haah la ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń ɛ tɛɛ nɔ?” Belaa haah la chaŋo ŋɔ, “Baɡ mɛ nyoa kɛ dɛ he baa di kora aa, hɛɛ ɡeloo n bii banɛ nɔ bɛl so he diɡ ta, bɛl ɡe so he ɡal ta.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ bii la be ŋɔ, “Haa waa haa dɛ soŋe nɔ mun jemɛ.
Hɛɛ wonoo nyɔ n tɛɡkpela nɔ maa dɛ ba nyɔe nɔ ane aa?” Anee ba sɛh ŋɔ, “Yaa wonoo.” Asɛ Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛ hɛɛ nyɔ n tɛɡkpela nɔ dɔŋaa te, kɛ n ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ kpɔ nɛn so n diɡ ne n ɡal ta.
Banɔ la baa su n Mɛɛ siwi laanee dɛɛ ba bela dɔe dɛ́ so.” Yeesu habɔteŋra fi la aa kaa la, ba no waa Sebedii bii la aa ɛa la, ba baah di ba nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, Yeesu yerɛ ba bwa cheme dɛ ŋɔ, “He jemɔ kɛ harɛ nɔ ta nomonome ne ba nomonjena dɛ di kpeɡri ba nɛra nɛ, dɛ ɡel baa tom ba, dɛ ɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Kɛ ɡɛ laa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé te do.
He bini bɛl dɛ nyin kɛ ó ɛ nomoa aa, a chɛ kɛ ó kpɔ o te ɛ kɛ bechala dɛɛ tomɛ heya.
Dɛ he bini bɛl dɛ nyin kɛ wɛɛ tɔ he sie naa, a chɛ kɛ ó berɛ o te kɛ he bwa bonɔɔ.” Dɛ ŋɔ, “Men Nɛn Bie ta balɛ kɛ nɛ́ra tom mɛ.
N te balɔ dɛ́ ba tomɛ nɛra, dɛ́ ɡarɛ kpɔ n nyu charɛ nɛndamanta mkpa.” Yeesu chah nyoŋa banɛ bane Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la aa le Jeriko dɛɛ kaa la, nɛnlaa tenten teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Dɛ nyoŋa banɛ bane soɡe ŋwɛnɛ nyoa dɛ no Yeesu ɡbɔɡa kɛ waa dɛ kaa, asɛ ba kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ yerɔ ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, Devid Naa, na ya sum!” Dɛ nɛnlaa la dɛ kah ba ŋɔ bá tɔ nyoa.
Kɛ dɛ namee ba taa dooɡe lɔŋɔre kohona dɛɛ yerɛ, “N Dɔɔ, Devid Naa, na ya sum!” Anee Yeesu jaɡɛ che, dɛ yer ba dɛ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń ɛ tɛ heya ɔ?” Asɛ ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya dɛ nyin he ɡel yá berɛ won dɛɛ na.” Yeesu dɔ tedoma tɛɛ ba, dɛ kpɔ o nɔn leɡe ba sibie.
Buɡ la ta, dɛ ba sie pilo ba won dɛɛ na, dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Gɛ Yeesu aa jo Jerusalam jirima ne Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la aa dɛ tel Jerusalam la, ba baa le Bɛtfej waa lɔ Ɔlevere Bwejen la bɔr.
Belaa Yeesu tomɛ o habɔteŋra la bini banɛ, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé la bwɛɛ nɔ waa lɔ he sie nɔ ta.
Haa den dɛɛ tel o ta la, hɛɛ nao kɛ baa vɔwɛ keeɡo bɛl ne o bie.
Hé pura dɛ́ kpɔa ba tɛ mɛ.
Dɛ nomɛl bɔɔ heyaa waane aa, hé ŋɔ naate be ŋɔ he Dɔɔ dɛ nyina.
Buɡ la ta, wɛɛ ɡeloo he pura, dɛ́ kpɔa ba.” Gɛ waa nɔ chiɡo, asɛ dɛ ɡel waa Korowii keame fa aa bola la ɛ kasinteŋ.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Ŋɔ Saayɔn tena be ŋɔ bá nyiŋi na!
Ba kooro dɛ ba ba be!
O pwɛre.
O soɡe keeɡo bie ta, keeɡo bale taa o so.” Asɛ o habɔteŋra la la, dɛ ka ɛ ɡɛ waa tom ba la.
Ba ba keeɡo la ne o bie la ne, asɛ dɛ pa ba laala pa a nɛ.
Yeesu soɡe o bie la nɛɛ baa kaa.
Nɛnlaa la ba ne Yeesu aa dɛ kaa la bane pa ba laala ne ba yale pa ŋwɛnɛ la ta, asɛ bane ɡe kɛ papooni ba pa ŋwɛnɛ la ta.
Nɛra baa tɔ o sie la ne banɔ la baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la bwa pɛ nyoa dɛɛ tɛo jirima ŋɔ, “Woowo!
Devid Naa nɔ!
Korowii swee naate waa valɛ o sɔn ta dɛɛ ba nɔ andɛɛɡa.
Ya dɛ jam Korowii waa lɔ nyundujaɡla la!” Yeesu aa jo Jerusalam la, bwɛjen la bwa lɔɔ kpu, asɛ ba bwa ɛɛ pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo nɔɔ?” Anee nɛnlaa la ŋɔ, “Korowii keamee.
Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta laanee.” Yeesu la Korowii Dea Yeesu kaa tel Korowii Dea bobɛl, asɛ dɛ doŋi kon-yoɡra ne nɛra baa dɛ yawɛ kwaa la bwa, dɛ beɡre nɛra baa dɛ peɡri suuɡare la ne banɔ la baa dɛ yoɡ borɔnomare la teeburre piiɡi, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn la bini ŋɔ, ‘Baa yerɛ n Dea Korowii soŋebɔree,’ ɡɛɛ he te kpɔ bela berɛ ŋwɛɛra sɔɔhbɔr aa?” Ba kpɔ nyoŋa ne boobie ba o be Korowii Dea bela, asɛ o chaah ba, nyoŋa la ɛɛ na, boobie la ɡe won vala.
Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema la aa na wejena waa dɛ ɛ la ne ɡɛ bechale la aa dɛ si ŋɔ, “Woowo!
Devid Naa hen” la, ba baah di o nɛ.
Anomanta, ba pɛɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “He dɛ no ɡɛ bechale nɔ aa dɛ si nɔ kenɛ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n dɛ no.
He ta Korowii Tɔn la bela baa chwera ŋɔ, ‘Bechale ne bechasɔɔhne nyoaa he kpɔ he kpɛɛra do’ la kure ka kɛɛ?” Yeesu ɡel ba bwɛjen la ta, dɛ kaa Bɛtani ka chɔ.
Yeesu taah fiɡ daa bɛl Tɔɔ aa pera chɔɔ, Yeesu le Bɛtani dɛ berɛ baa kaa bwɛjen Jerusalam la, dɛ lɔr dɛ kpoo.
O na fiɡ daa bɛl cheɡa ŋwɛnɛ la nyoa dɛ fee la kɛ ó ka nyin o nɔna di.
Waa laŋa la, dɛ papooni ɡboo o bwa.
Anee o taah daa la ŋɔ, “He te aa wola ba he ba nɔnɛ kpa bwa!” Buɡ la ta, dɛ daa la denɔ sewɛ dɛ chure.
O habɔteŋra la aa na ɡɛ la, ba nyoa kpoo, baa pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ fiɡ daa nɔ den chure warane ken?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, dɛ he dɔ yarada, haa tɔŋla di he bambile bini naa, hɛɛ wonoo ɛ ɡɛ maa ɛa dɛ ɡel daa nɔ sewɛ nɔ.
A ɡbo laa.
Hɛɛ wonoo kpɔ yarada ŋɔ bwé nɔ chuɡri ka le mpo ta, ásɛ o chuɡri ka le mpo ta.
Dɛ he kpɔ yarada dɛɛ soŋe Korowii aa, komɛlbwa haa soŋo la, hɛɛ dɔɔ.” Kpeɡri Yeesu aa dɔa dɛɛ ɛ wa Yeesu berɔ la Korowii Dea, dɛ kaa chaɡle nɛra Korowii Wa.
Asɛ Sɔfonomonome ne bwɛɛ la nomonome ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Umee tɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ hé ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ haa dɛ ɛ nɔɔ?
Umee tɛɛ kpeɡri kwaraa te nɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “N ɡba dɔ waane mɛɛ nyin n pɛɛ heya.
Dɛ he wono chaŋ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ naa, n ɡee chaɡle heyaa kpeɡri maa dɔa dɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔɔ.
Umee tɛ Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la kpeɡri o kpɔ dɛɛ sɔ nɛra nee laɔ?
Korowiirii tɛo waa, kɛ nɛnee tɛɔ?” Ate, dɛ ba ɡboɡbo berɔ kpoŋe dɔŋa dɛ ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛɛ yaa ba o chaŋa ɔ?
Ya ŋɔ Korowiirii tɛo waa, wɛɛ berɔɔ pɛɛ yaa ɡɛ aa ɛa yaa wola o waa yaradae.
Dɛ ya berɔ ŋɔ nɛnee tɛo waa, ya dɛ ɔmɛ waa bwɛɛla nɔ aa kpɔ ɛ yaa, dɛkalkɛ ba bwa dɛ yarada kɛŋɔ Jɔn ɛ Korowii keame.” Anomanta, ba ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Yaa jemɛ.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ haa jemɛ te naa, n ɡe aa heyaa kpeɡri maa dɔa dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ toma nɔɔ baɡle.” Bibaala banɛ bane sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé no waa nɔ, dɛ́ baɡle ɡɛ haa naa.
Baa bɛlee ira dɛ dɔ bibaala banɛ.
Awola bɛl, o la o binomoa la be dɛ ka ŋɔ, ‘N bie, fini la n koo la ta ka ɛ toma.’ Anee o bie la ŋɔ, ‘Maa la,’ asɛ a habɔɔ la, o berɛ charɛ o liire dɛ ka ɛ toma koo la ta.
Asɛ baa la berɛ la o bie bechala la ɡe be, dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ɡɛ waa bol o dɔɔ la be la.
O te den sɛh ŋɔ, ‘Yoo, mɛɛ lao,’ dɛ berɛ vɛh laŋa.
Nɛra banɛ nɔ, ba bini umee ɛ o mɛɛ tetoowaa tɛo wɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “O binomoa laanee.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, toɔ lɛɛra baa dɛ bɔ nɛra apoo ne jwamane tena bwa ɛɛ tɔ siee dɔ Korowii Kora la ta jo ɡel heya, dɛkalkɛ Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la ba he be dɛ ba chaɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la ŋɔ hé kpɔ o ta, asɛ he vɛh o waa la yaradae.
Kɛ toɔ lɛɛra ne jwamane tenaa bera yarada o waa la.
Hale haa bera na ɡɛ la, he ta he liire charɛ dɛ berɛ ba yaradao.” Nɛra baa dɛ daah koo sɛɡla A habɔɔ la, Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé no sɛɡla nɔ ɡe.
Baa bɛlee fa lole dɛɛ parɛ kwaane baa kpɔa dɛɛ daa sen. O ke a ɡɛ koo la, dɛ kwaa bɔr baa dɛɛ harame a nee dɛɛ do, dɛ chiɡri jɛŋla bela bá so o ta dɛɛ daah koo la, a koma telaa, ba dɔ ba bɔr.
A habɔɔ la, o kpɔ koo la tɛɛ ba bá nyiŋi o ta tɛo, dɛ kaa harɛ bɛl ta.
Nɔna la koma aa tela la, o tomɛ o bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá la nɛra la aa dɛ nyiŋi koo la ta la be, dɛ́ ka lɛ o dibɔr ba tɛo.
Anee nɛra la lawɛ bonɔɔna la, dɛ lɔɔ bɛl, dɛ kpo bɛl, asɛ dɛ foɡre bɛl ɡe bwea.
Baa la berɔ kwaa tomɛ bonɔɔna la banfala ba warɛ ɡwaa banɔ la baa tɔ sie la, asɛ nɛra la berɛ ɛ ba ɡe ɡɛ tenten baa ɛ banɔ la la.
Name te dɛ o ɡbaɡba biee kaa ó tomɛ.
Asɛ o tomɛ o bie la ɡe dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N ɡbaɡba bie nɔ te, baa heeh o siebɔree.’ Nɛra la aa dena na o bie la, ba den ŋɔ, ‘Yoowa, koo te la ɡbaɡba biee la.
Hé ɡel ya lawɔ dɛ́ kpoo, ásɛ o mɛɛ kapɛrɛ la bwa berɛ ya kwa.’ Anomanta, ba lawɔ dɛ le o ne koo la ta dɛ ka kpoo ta.” Asɛ Yeesu pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ koo te la kaa ba naa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba a ɡɛ nɛra la baa dɛ nyiŋi koo la ta la ɛɛ yɔ?” Anee ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “O balaa, wɛɛ ba kpoo nɛnchɔɡa la bwaa, dɛ́ kpɔ koo la tɛ nɛnfala, banɔ la dɛ ba komɛ daa nɔna la aa, baa dɛ ba on o dibɔr tɛɛ.” Yeesu pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Hé ta waa nɔ Korowii Tɔn la bini nae kaa?
Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, ‘Bwe la mamaala aa vɛoh dɛ liiru konsala laanee bera ba lawɛ dea la kpoŋe la.
Korowiirii ɡela a ɛ ɡɛ, asɛ a ɛ yaa nyokpowa.’ Anomanta, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, Korowii ɛɛ lɛ o kora laanee le he be, dɛ́ kpɔ ka tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ba wona nyiŋi o ta kɛrɛdɛ la.
Nomɛlbwa waa chole Bwe la waa lawɛ dea la kpoŋe la ta la, wɛɛ kuuɡuu.
O berɔ le ba le nomɛlbwa nɛɛ ɡe aa, wɛɛ pweremoo.” Sɔfonomonome la ne Farisii tena la aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba jemɔ kɛ ba waa Yeesu ɛɛ bol la.
Anomanta, dɛ ba fe dɛ nyin o lawa.
Kɛ ba berɔ ɔmɛ nɛnlaa la, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba te dɛ yerɛ Yeesu Korowii keame.
Hanfale kondikwaa sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ kpɔ sɛɡla dɛ bol waa baɡle nɛra la ja, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kenii Korowii Kora ɛɛ ba doe.
Kooro bɛlee lawɛ hanfale tɛ o bie, dɛ ɡel ba ɛ o hanfale kondikwa.
O tomɛ o bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ nɛra waa yer ba ŋɔ bá ba di hanfale kondikwaa la, asɛ ba sie ta on sui dɛ vɛh bala.
Anee o berɛ kwaa tomɛ banfala dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ka ŋɔ nɛra maa yer ba la be ŋɔ ba tonɛ kondikwaa la.
N kpoo nabala ne nae aa do noorare kohona, anomanta, n tonɛ komɛlbwa kɛ bá ba.’ A bwa pɛpɛrɛ nɛ, ba vɛoh dɛ kaa ba tomare ta.
Bɛl kaa o koo, bɛl ɡe kaa o bonadibɔr, asɛ ba kar la ɡe lawɛ o bonɔɔna waa tom ba la dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo ba.
A ɛ kooro la bandia kohona dɛ ɡel o tomɛ o soojare ba ka kpoo banɔ la baa kpoo o bonɔɔna la, asɛ dɛ fuh ba bwɛjen la ɡe.
Anee o kwaa yerɛ o bonɔɔna bane ɡe ja, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Ba tonɛ n hanfale kondikwaa la, kɛ nɛra la maa yer ba ŋɔ bá ba di la, a ta ban chɛɛ.
Name te hé le kaa fɔɡbaahna, dɛ́ ka yerɛ nɛra haa na ba la bwa ba hanfale kondikwaa la mun.’ Asɛ bonɔɔna la le kaa fɔɡbaahna, dɛ ka yerɛ nɛra baa na ba la bwa.
Nɛndɛɛɡa ne nɛnchɔɡa bwaa ba yerɛ, asɛ nɛra su bela baa lawɛ hanfale la maa ken.
Kooro la aa dɛ jam hɔɔhra la aa baa cheme bela la, o na baa bɛl ba bini kɛ o te ta laala aa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó do dɛ ba hanfale dem bela la ane doe.
Anee o bɔɔ baa la ŋɔ, ‘N dam, ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa a che he ba bonɔ, haa wola laala aa chɛ kɛ hé do dɛ́ ba hanfale dem bonɔ nɔ ane doe nɔɔ?’ Waa bɔɔro ɡɛ la, o ta waane dɔe dɛ bol.
Anee kooro la den ŋɔ o bonɔɔna la be ŋɔ, ‘Hé vɔrɔwe baa nɔ nɔɔra ne o nakpale, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka ta dahara biro ta.
Belaa wii ne weweele do.’ ” Yeesu aa kpɔ sɛɡla nɔ bol waa baɡ ba tonɛ la, asɛ o ŋɔ, “Nɛra maa yer ba warɔ taeh, kɛ ba bini tamaa kenii n chale.” Toɔ bɔe wepɛɛre Farisii tena la le bokɛre dɛ ka vɔrɔwe ɡɛ baa ɛ dɛ́ dɔ Yeesu lawɛ webɔɔra ne.
Anomanta, ba tomɛ ba habɔteŋra bane ne Hɛrɔd nɛra bane, ba ba o be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ kasinteŋ ɡboo hɛɛ bol, haa nyosone teŋe.
Korowii ŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ chaɡle nɛra kasinteŋ ne.
He ta bolɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ a habɔɔ kɛŋɔ a dɛ do bane som, kɛɛ a dɛ we bane bambile nɔ.
Haa nɛra siebɔr nyiŋi dɛɛ bol wa, kɛŋɔ bɛl ɛ kooro kɛɛ nomoa kɛɛ bechala nɔ.
Anomanta, chaɡle yaa ɡɛ haa na waa nɔ yá jemɛ.
Ya mmarare dɛ tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ya bɔ toɔ dɛɛ tɛ Rom Koojen Siisa la aa, kɛɛ waa yaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ?” Yeesu tɔ sie jemɛ ba liichɔɡa, anomanta, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He nɛra haa nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin dɛ́ har mɛ bel nɔɔ?
Hé kpɔ suuɡa haa kpɔa dɛɛ bɔ toɔ la tɛ mɛ ń na.” Baa kpɔ suuɡa la ba la, anee o pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ume nyu ne o sɔnee nɔɔ?” Anee ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Koojen Siisa nyu ne o sɔnee.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Gɛɛ a do te naa, hé kpɔ kwaa aa ɛ Koojen Siisa kwaa tɛo, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa aa ɛ Korowii kwaa la tɛ Korowii.” Baa no ɡɛ Yeesu aa bola la, ba nyoa kpoo, ba le o be dɛ kaa.
Seo ta ira wepɛɛre Awola tenten la, Saduki tena ba Yeesu be.
Dɛ baa yarada kɛŋɔ nɛn sewaa, wɛɛ berɔɔ ir ja.
Ba baa bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Nomoa, Mosis fa ŋɔ dɛ baa sewɔ ɡel o haah ba ta bii dɔe yaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ o nime kɛɛ o dɔɔ kpɔ haah la mo dɛ́ loɡle bii, ásɛ a ɡɛ bii la ɛ lale la bii.
Asɛ baa bɛl ne o nimanar banumɛlee fa lole.
Nomoa la mo haah dɛ ba sewɛ, dɛ o ne haah la ta bie lolɛ, anomanta, o nime waa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la kpɔ haah la mo.
O ɡe ne haah la ta lolɛ, o sewɛ.
Gɛɛ toorote la ne banɔ la baa kaa la mo haah la ka lɔ nyoa, dɛ ba serewe.
A habɔɔ la, luhaah la ɡe baa sewɛ.
Taraken nɔ, dɛ tɔpere nɛra baa sewa bwa aa dɛ ba ira nɔ telaa, baala banuanɛ la bini, umee dɛɛ ba haah la jaa ɛɛ yɔ?
Ba bwa ɡee moo ka.” Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He kono kwaraa!
Haa wola Korowii Waa baa chwera ne o kpeɡri waa jemɛ la waa.
Dɛ nɛra baa sewa la berɔ iraa, baala aa haahnaa mo, haahna ɡe aa yalɛ.
Baa soo kɛŋɔ nyundua toroma ken.
Nɛra seo ta ira ɡe la nɔ, he ta ɡɛ Korowii aa bol he be la kure dɛ no a mun kɛɛ?
O ŋɔ, ‘Menee Korowii Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tomɔ la.’ Lala laa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii, weeraa dɛɛ tomɔ.” Nɛnlaa la aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba nyoa kpo o webaɡla ta.
Korowii Mmarare la bini onjen Belaa Farisii tena la aa no ɡɛ Yeesu aa chaŋe Saduki tena la kɛrɛdɛ ba ta berɛ won dɔ waane dɛ́ bol kpa la, ba kaa cheme, asɛ ba bini Tɔnjereme bɛl pɛɛ Yeesu waane, dɛ́ kpɔ harɔ bel.
O pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Nomoa, mmarare nɔ te bwa bini umee dena ɡwaa a bwa nɔ?” Yeesu chaŋɔ ŋɔ, “ ‘Hé nyin N Naa Korowii he bambile bwa, he hweera ne he liire bwa ne.’ Onɔɔ ɡwaa a bwa dɛ tɔ a bwa sie.
Onɔ la waa jaa dɛ teŋɛ nɛɛ o waa hiah la ɡee kɛŋɔ, ‘Nyin he dɔŋ kɛ he ɡbaɡba.’ Gɛ mmarare anɛ nɔ binii Mosis Mmara la ne waa Korowii keamere la aa baɡla la bwa le.” Kristo la wepɛɛre Farisii tena la bane aa kaa pɛ so la, Yeesu pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa laɔ?
He dɛ lii kɛ ume naa yɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Devid naa.” Anee Yeesu berɛ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛ waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa ir Devid nɛɛ la o berɛ yerɔ o dɔɔ nɔɔ?
Devid fa ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii ŋɔ n Dɔɔ be ŋɔ ó so nomombɔr o diɡ ta ka tel kɛŋɔ waa ba o dɔma ne harɛ ásɛ o tiɡri ba nɛ.’ Dɛ Devid fa yerɔ o dɔɔ raa, ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa a che Kristo la berɛ ba ɛ Devid naa ɔ?” Nomɛlbwa ta wone chaŋe waa Yeesu aa pɛɛra la, anomanta, le awola tɔpere la dɛɛ kaa la, nomɛlbwa ta wone ba che o sie, dɛ pɛɛro waane kpa.
Gɛ Yeesu aa ja nɛra Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena wa Yeesu bol waa dɛ chaɡle nɛnlaa la ne o habɔteŋra la dɛ ŋɔ, “Tɔnjerema la ne Farisii tena nɔɔ dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ bá chaɡle Mosis Mmara la bini baɡle nɛra.
Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ hé no ba be, dɛ́ teŋɛ waa baa dɛ baɡle heyaa ŋɔ hé ɛ la bwa ta.
Kɛ he bɛ ba we-ɛɛla te hweli, dɛkalkɛ baa waa baa bola dɛɛ chaɡle heyaa la ɛ. Ba kpɔ ba mmarare ɛ bontɔɡa, dɛ ɡel nɛra che dɛɛ koh, kɛ ba te ɡbaɡba aa berɛ ɛɛ nyin kɛ bá kpɔ nonii ɡba leɡa, ásɛ a ba ɛ kɛ baa choɡ baa ɡba.
Ba we-ɛɛla bwa la, nɛraa baa nyin kɛ bá na ba dɛɛ tɛɛ ba duure.
Gɛ nɛra yon chwerɛ Korowii wobol dɛ kpɔ vɔwɛ ba tili ne ba vaama ta la, hé na ɡɛ ba te kwaa yon do paɡri.
Hé na ɡɛ ba batakaani nyoo jɔɔra aa dɛ do jaŋne.
Bela nɛra yon cheme tɔpejena dɛɛ lɛ ba sie la, ba te la bela aa, kane dɛɛɡa ɡbo taa baa nyin soɡa.
Asɛ ba la cheremi deene bini ɡe aa, nomonsobɔraa baa nyin.
Ba dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ nɛra ba harɛ, dɛɛ lea ba yawa ta ne fɔɡbaahna, dɛɛ yer ba ‘Nomoa, nomoa.’ He bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa yerɛ heyaa ba nomoa, dɛkalkɛ he bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
Nomoa beŋkpoŋ ɡbo ɡee he dɔ.
Ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta ɡe, he bɛ nomɛlbwa he Mɛɛ dɛɛ yerɛ, dɛkalkɛ he Mɛɛ lɔ beŋkpoŋ ɡbo dɛ do nyundua.
He bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa ɡe yerɛ he bini bɛlbwa o dɔɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɔɔ beŋkpoŋ ɡboo lole, onee Kristo la.
He bwa bini, naate waa ɡwaa heyaa la chɛ kɛ ó ɛ o te kɛŋɔ bechala dɛɛ tomɛ heya.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ maŋkura o te la, Korowii ɛɛ ba o ne harɛɛ, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ pwɛr o te la, Korowii ɛɛ ɛo nɛnjenii.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ, Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena, he nɛra haa nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
He tɔ Korowii Kora la ŋwɛnɛ.
Heyaa nɔɔ haa jo, he ɡe aa ŋwɛnɛɛ tɛ ásɛ banɔ la baa dɛ nyin bɔr dɛ́ jo la dɔ bɔr.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ, Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena, he nɛra haa nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
Heyaa yon ɡaaɡe aaa ɡɛ haa ɛ dɛ́ dɔ nɛn waa wola Juu te ɛɛ ó ba ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii.
Kɛ dɛ he baa dɔ bɛl aa, he yon berɛ ɛo o chɔɡ kwaraa, asɛ a yon berɛ do kɛŋɔ o tenee bera chɛ Bɔnsam nii ta laŋa ɡwaa heya.
Nyoŋa haa dɛ tɔ nɛra sie, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
He yon dɛɛ chaɡle nɛra ŋɔ, ‘He naate haa ŋwɛɛ Korowii Dea la, ate aa won hen waane ɛ. Kɛ suuɡaswɛm waa lɔ Korowii Dea bela la te, baa o te ŋwɛɛ.’ Nyoŋeɡɛna bane!
Suuɡaswɛm la ne Korowii Dea la waa ɡela suuɡaswɛm la do ɔma la, umee do ɔma ɡwaa o dɔŋ ɔ?
He berɔ dɛɛ chaɡle nɛra ŋɔ, ‘He naate haa ŋwɛɛ kon baa kpo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la, a ta waane ɛɛ.
Kɛ kwaa baa kpoa tɛ Korowii bela la te, baa an ŋwɛɛ.’ He nyoɡrɔ kwara!
Kwaa baa kpoa tɛ Korowii la, ne kon baa kpo kwaa la dɛ ɡel kwaa la do ɔma la, a bini umee do ɔma ɡwaa o dɔŋ ɔ?
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa ŋwɛɛ kon baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la, bela baa kpoo kwaa la ne kwaa aa dawɛ o ta la bwaa o ŋwɛɛ la.
Asɛ nomɛlbwa waa ŋwɛɛ Korowii Dea la, Korowii ne Dea la bwaa o ŋwɛɛ la.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe ŋwɛɛ Korowii doa aa, Korowii soŋnibɔr ne Korowii ɡbaɡbaa o ŋwɛɛ la.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ, he Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena, he nɛra haa nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
He kondiili do tamaa ɡɛ bɛlbwa naa, he won a bini pera bɔre fi dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ aa ɛ Korowii kwaa la ka tɛo, ɡɛ Mmara la aa baɡla la, kɛ dɛ ɡel Mmara la bini waa aa tɔ sie dɛɛ baɡle ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ di kasinteŋ, dɛ́ɛ na nɛra sum, ásɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ yarada heyaa la te.
Gɛ waa nɔɔ chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɛ, dɛ́ ja anɔ la haa dɛ ɛa la ta.
Nyoŋa haa dɛ tɔ nɛra sie dɛɛ maŋkura wejeɡre ɡwaa anjena!
He waa haa dɛ ɛ la do kɛŋɔ nɛn o yon nyiŋi o nenyɔɔle ta, dɛ́ won na pereware dɛ́ laa kpɔ ta, kɛ dɛ nyoɡma te lɔ a ta naa, waa o te na, dɛ yon kpɔ lile.
Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena, nɛra haa nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
He waa haa dɛ ɛ ɡelɔ he do kɛŋɔ baa loo numol kɛɛ loɡ habɔɔ o do wer, asɛ doŋa su o bini te la.
Dɛ́ ɛɡre nɛn lɛ o kondɔɔh o be, ne kafonyin ɡboo su he bwa.
Farisii tena nyoŋa bane!
Hé loo doŋa aa lɔ numol la bini la mɔɔ.
O bini la dɔɔ lea, dɛ o habɔɔ leɔ.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ, Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena, nɛra haa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
He do kɛŋɔ ŋwam baa teɡɔ wɛɛ nyɛɡle.
O nyundua la ɡboo wera, kɛ o bini te, hoɡa ne kompɔɔhla ɡboo.
Gɛɛ he den do.
Ba na heya aa, he wer siwi ta kɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡa, kɛ he bini te, neɡra ne wechɔɡa ɡboo su he bwa.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ, Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena, nɛra haa nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
Heyaa yon kwaa bela baa huɡe Korowii keamere a do wer.
Nɛndɛɛɡa baa serewa la ɡe, he yon kwaa ba ŋwama a do wer ken, dɛɛ chaɡle kɛŋɔ dɛ heyaa fe he naawa ɡɛ saŋ la aa, he te fe aa wola ja dɛ́ kpo Korowii keamere la.
Kɛ he ɡe aa berɛ ɛɛ tɔh kɛŋɔ banɔ la baa kpoo Korowii keamere la naanaree heya!
Hé takapɔ dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la he naawa aa pa mun ɛa la ka tonɛ.
Nɛnchɔɡa kɛŋɔ harɛkwa, domkpuli bii!
Ɛrɛɛ hé ɛ haa wola Bɔnsam nii taa joɔ?
N ɡelɔ hɛɛ no kɛŋɔ mɛɛ tomɛ Korowii keamere, wejerema ne Tɔnjerema he bee.
Hɛɛ kpoo banee, dɛ́ kpaa bane pɛl daɡaɡra ta, dɛ́ kpɔ chweremi lɔɔ bane cheremi deene ta, dɛ́ doŋ ba jo bwɛɛre ta dɛɛ nyin ba dɛ́ lawɛ.
Anomanta, nɛndɛɛɡa baa nya ba nɛɛ dɛ kpoo ba la, dɛ́ le kpoe baa kpo Ebel waa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ la, ka tel kpoe baa kpo Bɛrekea bie Sekaria Korowii Dea la, ne bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛo la baah ta bela la, ba bwa waa ɛɛ ɡure he nɛɛ.
Kasinteŋ, nɛndɛɛɡa baa kpoo ba la bwa waa ɛɛ ba ɡure fini nɛra nɔ nɛɛ!
Oo, Jerusalam tena!
Korowii tomɛ o keamere he be naa, ɡɛɛ he kpoo ba, o tomɛ toroma he be naa, ɡɛɛ he foɡ ba bwea.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa mɛɛ nyin kɛ ń kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛɛ kɛ jal aa lawɛ o bii dɛɛ do o kena lɔɡre la, kɛ haa nyin kɛ ń lawɛ heyaa pɛ.
Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ ta he waa tɛ heya.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, haa men na kpa ka tel ɡɛ saŋ maa ba ja, asɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Woowo!
Korowii Biee cheɡɛ o sɔn ta dɛɛ ba la!’ ”
Gɛ Yeesu aa bol Korowii Dea chɔɡa wa Yeesu aa le Korowii Dea bela dɛɛ kaa la, o habɔteŋra la baa ŋɔ ó nyiŋi na Korowii Dea la kan waa doa ne ɡɛ waa wera.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi deene nɔ bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
N dɛ ŋɔ he be kɛ baa ba kuuɡi a bwaa ta.
Bwe bɛlbwa aa lee do dɛ́ ta chɔŋɛ o dɔŋ nɛɛ kpa.” Yeesu baɡle o habɔteŋra wahala baa na kerekere Yeesu teehnɔ ka so Ɔlevere Bwejen la doa.
Belaa o habɔteŋra la ɡbo ka puu bela, dɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Chaɡle yaa ɡɛ saŋ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa aa dɛ́ ba chiɡa, ne waa aa dɛ ba bala dɛ chaɡle kɛŋɔ he bala saŋ la ne waa bwa jaɡa saŋ la telo.” Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa neɡre heya.
Nɛra ɛɛ warɔɔ taeh dɛ́ ba neɡre heya, dɛ́ kpɔ n sɔn dɛɛ bol wa, hale dɛ́ ŋɔ banee Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la, dɛ́ neɡre nɛra kɛrɛdɛ bwa.
Hɛ́ɛ no laa ɡbɔɡaa he jwɛh, ásɛ dɛɛ no ane ɡe ɡbɔɡa bojaŋa.
Kɛ dɛ he ba dɛ na ɡɛ naa, he bɛ ɔmɛ.
A chɛ kɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa chiɡ, kɛ dɛ a laa dɛɛ chaɡle kɛ waa bwa jaɡa saŋ la telo.
Harɛre ane ɛɛ yo dɔŋaa, koranar ɡe yo dɔŋa.
Lɔr ɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwaa, ásɛ harɛ ɡe ɛɛ jiɡri bobɛlbwa.
Kɛ anɔ bwa do kɛŋɔ haah loltea yon tɔ sie lɔɔ dɛ o lola ta tele mɔɔ la.
Ásɛ mɔɔ ba ta lawɛ heyaa tɛ nɛra, ba ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa dɛ́ kpoo heya.
Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ koh n waa hah heya.
A ba ɡɛ naa, nɛra baa teŋɛ n nɛɛ nɔ kɛrɛdɛ ɛɛ le n habɔɔ, dɛ́ le ba bala tɛ, ásɛ dɛ hah dɔŋa.
Ásɛ nɛra ir dɛ́ teŋe nyosone kɛŋɔ ba ɛ Korowii keamere, dɛ́ neɡre nɛra kɛrɛdɛ.
Wechɔɡa ɛɛ perɛ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwaa, ásɛ nɛra bane aa won nyin ba dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ kpa.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola n habɔɔ leɛ, dɛ won teŋɛ n nɛɛ ka tonɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Baa bol Korowii Kora Amanesoma nɔ waa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwaa, ásɛ nɛwɛnyini te bɛlbwa no mɔɔ waa bwa jaɡa saŋ la tel.” Konchɔɡechɔɡe waa dɛ paɡre bwɛ Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Hé naate haa kure tɔn nɔ bonɔ la no a mun kɛrɛdɛ.
Hɛɛ na konchɔɡechɔɡe Korowii keame Daneɛl fa aa bol o waa ŋɔ o dɛ paɡre bwɛɛ la cheɡa Korowii Dea boɡoroŋ bela.
Gɛ saŋ la telaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ Juda harɛ tena chwa le Juda ka sɔh bwejena la baah.
Nomɛlbwa waa soɡe saldoa ɡe, o bɛ berɛ koh o te ŋɔ o dɛ tu dɛ́ jo dea dɛ́ ka kpɔ komɛl kpa.
Nomɛlbwa waa lɔ koo ta bɛ berɛ ŋɔ o dɛ kaa dem dɛ́ ka kpɔ o yal kpa.
Ei!
Aa do kpeɡrii tɛ tekpoŋra ne haahna baa kpoŋe bechasɔɔhne a ɡɛ saŋ nɔ noo!
Hé soŋe Korowii ásɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ aa dɛ ba chiɡa he chwaaɡe nɔ bɛ waa saŋ chiɡ, dɛ bɛ Ona Tɔpere ta chiɡ, dɛkalkɛ, dɛ le harɛ nɔ mumpar bwa ba le fini, wahala aa dɛ we dɛ do ɔma ɡɛ dɔŋ ta chiɡe bwa.
Asɛ wahala aa do ɔma ɡɛ dɔŋ ɡe aa chiɡ kpa bwa.
Kɛ dɛ Korowii fe ta tɔpera la ane teŋe ta aa, nomɛlbwa fe aa o nyuu dɔ.
Anomanta, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ Korowii nɛra waa chal ba dɛ lɛɛ ba la dɔ ba nyu la, o teŋe tɔpechɔɡa la ane ta.
Gɛ saŋ la dɛ nomɛl ŋɔ he be ŋɔ Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la lɔ bonɔ kɛɛ le naa, he bɛ on yarada, dɛkalkɛ nɛra ɛɛ bao dɛ́ ba teŋe nyosone ŋɔ Kristo laanee ban, ásɛ bane ɡe teŋe nyosone ŋɔ Korowii keameree ban.
Baa ɛ wejena ne nyokpowaa, dɛɛ nyin bɔr dɛ́ neɡre nɛra Korowii aa chal ba dɛ lɛɛ ba la kwara.
N felo dɛɛ bol waa nɔ he be noo, ásɛ he pu sie jemɛ a wa.
Dɛ nomɛl ŋɔ he be ŋɔ Kristo la lɔ kpɔɡ bini naa, he bɛ bela la.
Dɛ nomɛl ɡe ŋɔ, ‘Nyiŋi na, o sɔh dea nɔ bini’ naa, he bɛ yarada, dɛkalkɛ Men Nɛn Bie bala ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ bwaala yon nyɛɡle le wee leebɔr kaa wee cholibɔr la.
Gɛɛ maa wola n balaa kpɔ sɔh nomɛlbwa.
‘Bela konlale aa lole la, belaa kokosakire ɛɛ cheme.’ Wahala ne sibeɡra la aa chiɡ dɛ den dɛɛ tonɛ la, buɡ la ta ‘wee aa bɔr chaahna ba kpa, korobie ɡe aa bɔr chaahna ba kpa, weweela dɛ ba nyundua lee dɛ́ lee harɛ, ásɛ Korowii doa bwa yiiɡi dɛ́ chɔɡ.’ Men Nɛn Bie bala wa A taa hɛɛ ba waane nyundua nae a chaɡle Men Nɛn Bie la kpeɡri, ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa na dɛ́ wi, ásɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ Men Nɛn Bie la aa le nyundua baama bini dɛɛ ba kpeɡri ne jirima tenten ne.
Nɛra ɛɛ no Korowii bɛla la sii, ásɛ Korowii tomɛ o nyundua toroma bá ba harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ́ ka boa o nɛra waa chal ba dɛ lɛɛ ba la bwa nyoa.
Fiɡ daa wehwela wa Hé kpɔ fiɡ daa hweli wa.
O baa foɡre dɛɛ le papo-lwɛɛne aa, dɛ nomɛlbwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ bɔwɔb saŋ telo tonɛ.
Gɛɛ dɛ waa nɔ maa bol he be nɔ bwa baa dɛɛ chiɡ aa, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛ tɔpere maa dɛ bol o waa la bala telo.
Kasinteŋ, a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa dɛ ba chiɡa mɔɔ fini nɛra nɔ bwa serewe.
Nyundua ne harɛ ɛɛ chɔɡoo.
Aa lee ba do kpa.
Kɛ n waa maa bola te bwa ɛɛ do lee saŋ te bɛlbwa.
Nomɛlbwa aa tɔpere ne saŋ la jemɛ Nomɛlbwa aa Korowii Tɔpere la ne saŋ ɡɛ waa la aa dɛ ba chiɡa jemɛ.
Nyundua toroma la ne Men Nɛn Bie la ɡba aa jemɛ.
N Mɛɛ la ɡboo jema.
Men Nɛn Bie bala ɛɛ piɡri nɛraa kɛ Nowa saŋ nesuuli la aa baa piɡri nɛra la.
Gɛ saŋ nee la aa wola sui dɛ chɔɡ harɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ nɛra dɛ di kwaa dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛɛ mo haahna, dɛɛ yalɛ jaranar.
Ba lɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ ta dɛɛ ɛ dɛ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ Nowa aa jo daka la bini ɡel ba.
Kɛ ba ta wone jemɛ waa aa dɛ ba bala ka tel ɡɛ saŋ nee la aa sua dɛ ba kpɔ ba bwa kaa.
Gɛɛ Men Nɛn Bie la bala la ɛɛ ba nɛra piɡra.
Gɛ saŋ la, nɛra banɛ ɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma koo taa, ásɛ ba ba kpɔ beŋkpoŋ kaa, dɛ́ ɡel bɛl.
Haahna banɛ ɛɛ pɛo dɛɛ namɛ kwaa nambwe ta, bá ba kpɔ beŋkpoŋ kaa, dɛ́ ɡel bɛl bela.
Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ do dɛɛɡɔ, dɛkalkɛ haa tɔpere la ne saŋ la he Dɔɔ la aa ba jemɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ no.
Dɛ dem te fe jemɛ ɡɛ saŋ ŋwɛɛ aa ba ŋwɛo waa, o fe aa domii chɔ dɛ́ ɡel o ba jo dem dɛ́ ŋwɛo.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɡe kpɔ he te, dɛ́ so kpa, dɛkalkɛ piɡraa Men Nɛn Bie la ɛɛ ba ba piɡri heya.
Bonɔndɛɛɡe ne bonɔnchɔɡe wa Bonɔɔ waa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛ dɔ liire la nɔn taa o dɔɔ kpɔ o dem tena dɛɛ do, dɛ ŋɔ bɔr dɛ maɡre aa, ó tɛɛ ba kondikwa.
Dɛ o dɔɔ la baa puu, dɛ o dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa kpɔa do o nɔn ta la aa, o sie ɛɛ lɛo.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, o dɔɔ la ɛɛ kpɔ o komɛlbwaa do o nɔn ta ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi a ta.
Kɛ dɛ o ɛ bonɔnchɔɡe, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N dɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ waa kaala nɔ, waa ba taraken,’ dɛ do o bonɔndɔŋa la nɛɛ dɛɛ lɔɔ, dɛɛ di kwaa waa dɛ nyin, o ne sennyɔɔra ɛɛ dɛɛ raa, amɔ wɛɛ na waa.
Tɔpebeŋkpoŋii o dɔɔ la ɛɛ ba bala ba piɡru, dɛ́ tɛr o deŋne taeh, dɛ́ doŋu ka pu nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra siebɔr mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ waa la.
Belaa wɛɛ ba doe dɛɛ wi dɛɛ na weweele.”
Bitoli fi bane sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Men Nɛn Bie bala la telaa, kenii Korowii Kora ɛɛ ba doe.
O dɛ ba doe kɛŋɔ toli fi bane baa ira dɛ kpɔ ba kandere dɛɛ la ká cheme hanfale jaa.
Ba bini banue ɛ ɡɛna, banue ɡe ɛ wejerema.
Gɛna la ta noo kpɔe ásɛ dɛ ba kandere la bini noo tonaa bá kpɔ do.
Kɛ wejerema la te kpɔ noo do loŋa ta dɛ ja ba kandere la ta.
Hanfale jaa la ta fele ba, anomanta, dom chuɡli bitoli la, ba bwa chɔɔɡe doromi.
Harambaŋa la, nɛra bane nao kɛŋɔ hanfale jaa la dɛ ba, asɛ dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, ‘Hanfale jaa laanee la oo!
Hé le ka chemo!’ Bitoli fi la bwa ir doromi ta, dɛ kwaa ba kandere.
Gɛna banue la ŋɔ wejerema la be ŋɔ, ‘Hé tɛ yaa he noo nɔ ane.
Gɛ laa aa, ya kandere dɛ dirimi.’ Anee wejerema la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Aa ya ne he bwaa tel, anomanta, hé chwa la bela baa dɛ yoɡa la ka yawɛ ane.’ Gɛ saŋ bitoli ɡɛna la aa chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa noo la yawa la taa hanfale jaa la ba.
Wejerema la aa kpɔ ba te la, ba dɔ bɔr teŋɛ hanfale jaa la nɛɛ dɛ ka di hanfale kondikwaa la.
Baa joa tonɛ la, dem te den laa ɡbera la tɔ.
A habɔɔ la banɔ la balɔ, dɛ baa yerɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔɔ, ya dɛ soŋe, ya yaa ásɛ ya jo.’ Anee hanfale jaa la ŋɔ, ‘Kasinteŋ, maa heyaa jemɛ.’ ” Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o berɛ ŋɔ, “Anomanta, hé ɡel he sie do le hɛɛ kpa, dɛkalkɛ haa tɔpere la ne ɡɛ saŋ maa dɛ ba bala la jemɛ.” Bonɔɔna batoro bane sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Awola Men Nɛn Bie la aa ba la, kenii Korowii Kora la ɛɛ ba doe.
Baa bɛlee ira dɛɛ ba o ŋwɛnɛ bɛl kaala, dɛ yerɛ o bonɔɔna dɛ kpɔ o suuɡa bwa do ba nɔn ta.
Gɛ del ba bɛlbwa aa dɛ ba wona kpoŋe la taa o nyiŋi dɛ bɔne tɛɛ ba.
O tɛ sitɔte la bɔre anue, dɛ tɛ nɛɛte la bɔre anɛ, asɛ dɛ tɛ toorote la ɡe bɔrbeŋkpoŋ, mɔɔ dɛ kaa o ŋwɛnɛ la.
A ta biɡre bɛlbwa onɔ la waa dɔ bɔre anue la den kpɔ o kwaa ka ɛ toma dɛ berɛ dɔ a dɔŋa ja a ta.
Gɛ tentenee onɔ la waa dɔ bɔre anɛ la ɡe berɛ dɔ a dɔŋa ja o kwaa ta.
Bonɔɔ la waa dɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ la te kpɔ o kwaa ka huɡe harɛ.
Aa baa biɡri la, bonɔɔna la dɔɔ la balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ bɛ́lbwa ba chaɡle ɡɛ waa kpɔ o suuɡa ɛ. Bonɔɔ la waa tɛo bɔre anue la kpɔ anɔ la waa dɔa ja la ja anɔ waa kpɔa tɛo la ta dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N Dɔɔ, bɔre anuee he tɛ mɛ, kɛ n ɡe berɔ dɔ a dɔŋa ja a ta.
Anee la.’ Anee o dɔɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Jam, bonɔndɛɛɡe, kasinteŋ te!
Tama nɔ haa kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛ ɛ a ne toma nɔ, mɛɛ kpɔe so andamanta nyoa.
Ba puu mɛ so silɛɛ ta.’ Bonɔɔ nɛɛte la ɡe ba dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘N Dɔɔ, bɔre anɛɛ he tɛ mɛ, kɛ n ɡe berɔ dɔ a dɔŋa ja a ta.
Anee la.’ Anee o dɔɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Jam, bonɔndɛɛɡe, kasinteŋ te!
Tama nɔ haa kpɔ kasinteŋ ɛ a ne toma nɔ, mɛɛ kpɔe so andamanta nyoa.
Ba puu mɛ so silɛɛ ta.’ Asɛ bonɔɔ waa dɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ la ɡe ba, dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘N Dɔɔ, n jemɔ kɛ he waa kpeɡri.
Bela haa wola mea due laanee hɛɛ koma, asɛ bela haa wola kwaa ane komɛ laanee hɛɛ nyin a cheɡbɔr.
Anomanta, n ɔmɔ dɛ kpɔ suuɡa haa tɛ mɛ la ka huɡe harɛ.
Anee la.’ Anee o dɔɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Bonɔnchɔɡe bɔhwaah kohona!
He jemɔ kɛ bela maa wola mea duee mɛɛ koma, asɛ bela maa wola kwaa komɛ laanee mɛɛ nyin a cheɡbɔr aa?
A fe chɛ kɛŋɔ he kpɔ n suuɡa la ka cheɡ nɛra baa kpɔ suuɡa dɛɛ cheɡ ba be ba kpɔ dɛɛ kemɛ nɛra la, ásɛ n balaa, ń ka lɛ n kwaa ne a nee bwa.
Anomanta, hé lɛ o kwaa la o be dɛ́ kpɔ tɛ onɔ maa tɛo anue o dɔ a dɔŋa ja a ta la.
Anomanta, naate waa dɔa la, baa jao anee ó dɔ kohona.
Kɛ naate waa wola komɛlbwa dɔe la, tama kwaraa waa dɔa la ɛɛ le o nɔn taa.
Bonɔnsala nɔ te, hé kpɔɔ le dahara ka ta biro ta, belaa wii ne weweele do.’ ” Nɛn Bie la bala dɛ́ ba bol nɛra waa pa bole Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ Men Nɛn Bie la balɔ jirima ne, nyundua toroma la ja n nɛ aa, mɛɛ ba so n kookara taa, ásɛ nɛwɛnyina baa lɔ harɛ bɛlbwa ta ba cheme n sie.
Mɛɛ peɡri ba bini bɔre anɛɛ, ɡɛ peteɡre aa dɛ peɡri o peera ne o boohna bini la.
Mɛɛ kpɔ wedɛɛɡa tena laanee che n nɔndiɡ ta, ásɛ ba kar la ɡe che n nɔŋɡal ta.
Belaa mɛɛ ba n ŋɔ banɔ la baa lɔ diɡ ta la be ŋɔ, ‘He banɔ n Mɛɛ aa swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heyaa la, hé ba di kora waa le harɛ mumpar dɛ kwaa cheɡ heyaa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ lɔr aa dɛ kpo mɛ la, he tɛ mɛ kondikwaa n di, nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo mɛ la, he tɛ mɛ nee n nyɔ.
Maa ɛ hɔɔh la, he kpɔ mɛ kaa he deremi, maa valɛ mumɡbal la, he tɛ mɛ yal n tɔ.
N bwara wee mɛ, he nyiŋi n nɛ, asɛ baa do mɛ dea ɡe la, he kaa na mɛ.’ A taa wedɛɡ-ɛɛra la ɛɛ ba ŋɔe ŋɔ, ‘Ya Dɔɔ, bɛweeree ya na kɛŋɔ lɔr aa dɛ kpoe ya tɛɛ kondikwaa he di, asɛ nyɔɡre ɡe kpoe ya tɛɛ nee he nyɔɔ?
Bɛweeree ya na kɛŋɔ he ɛ hɔɔh ya kpɔe kaa ya deremi, dɛ berɛ na kɛŋɔ haa valɛ mumɡbal ya tɛɛ yal he tɔɔ?
Bɛweeree ya na kɛ he bwara wee kɛɛ ba doe dea asɛ ya ka nae nɔ?’ Ásɛ n ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Kasinteŋ, ɡɛ haa cha n nimanar baa ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra waa nɔ dɔŋa puu ba la, menee he cha la.’ Ásɛ n berɛ ŋɔ banɔ la baa lɔ n ɡal ta la be ŋɔ, ‘He banɔ Korowii nyotaahna aa lawɛ heyaa la, hé le n sie bonɔ, dɛ́ ka jo nii aa wola dime bwa ba mara tɛ Bɔnsam ne o toroma la ta, dɛkalkɛ lɔr kpo mɛ, he ta men kondikwaa tɛɛ ń di, nyɔɡre kpo mɛ, he ta men nee tɛɛ ń nyɔ.
Maa ɛ hɔɔh la, he ta men lawɛ kaa dem, maa valɛ mumɡbal ɡe la, he ta men yal tɛɛ ń tɔ.
N bwara wee mɛ, ba do mɛ dea ɡe, kɛ he ta balɛ dɛ ba na mɛ.’ Ásɛ ba ɡe chaŋo ŋɔ, ‘Ya Dɔɔ, bɛweeree ya na kɛ lɔr ne nyɔɡre dɛ kpoe, kɛɛ he ɛ hɔɔh, kɛɛ dɛɛ valɛ mumɡbal, kɛɛ he bwara wee, kɛɛ ba doe dea, asɛ ya ta balɛ dɛ ba chae nɔ?’ Ásɛ n ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Kasinteŋ, ɡɛ haa wola n nimanar baa ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra waa nɔ dɔŋa puu ba he ta bɛlbwa chae la, menee haa wola chae la.’ Banɔ te ɛɛ kaa weweele aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la taa, ásɛ wedɛɡ-ɛɛra la te dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la.”
Yeesu kpoe vɔrɔwa wa Yeesu aa chaɡ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, o ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa jema la, kerele ɡbosoroo baa di Galekaa Tɔpejen kondikwaa la.
A taa baa ba Men Nɛn Bie lee tɛ nɛra bá kpaa mɛ pɛl daɡaɡre ta, dɛ́ kpo mɛ.” Anee Sɔfonomonome ne bwɛɛ nomonome ka cheme Sɔfonomoa Kaefas dem, dɛ ka so dɛɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ baa che o ta dɛ́ lawɛ Yeesu dɛ́ kpoo nomɛlbwa aa wola jemɛ.
Baa chema la dɛ ba berɔ ŋɔ, “Yaa won lawɛ baa nɔ ɡɛ tɔpejen nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛ nɛra noɔ waa, aa werii do.
Bwɛɛ nɔ ɛɛ vuuɡuu.” Ba fuɡe noo do Yeesu nyu ta Dɛ Yeesu lɔ Bɛtani dɛ do Seemɔn weechɔɡa fa aa chɔɡ o bwadabii la dem.
Yeesu aa lɔ dem bela dɛɛ di kwaa la, haah bɛl kpoŋe nosɔɔhsoma ane a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a su loŋ bɛl dɛ ba o be, asɛ dɛ ba fuɡe do Yeesu nyu ta.
Yeesu habɔteŋra la aa na ɡɛ haah la aa ɛa la, a di ba baah, ba kpɔ bandia pɛɛ ŋɔ, “Kwaa nɔ ɡe chɔɡa nɔ mun ɔ?
O fe yoɡ nosɔɔhsoma nɔ naa, o fe aa suuɡaa dɔ a warɛ ó kpɔ tɛ nyaaraa?” Yeesu aa no ɡɛ baa dɛ bol la, o pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa hɛɛ pwah haah nɔ nɔɔ?
Wedɛɛɡa tentenee o ɛ tɛ mɛ la.
Nyaara te, he ne banee lole tɔperee bwa, kɛ n te aa he bee do ka tonɛ.
Haah nɔ nosɔɔhsoma nɔ waa fuɡa do n nyu ta nɔ, n seo waa o ɛ ɡɛ la.
Kasinteŋ, harɛ nɔ ta bela bwa baa bol Amanesoma nɔ la, baa bol waa haah nɔ aa ɛa nɔ belaa, a ɛ sɔn tɛo dɛɛ la.” Judas sɛoh kɛ wɛɛ le Yeesuu tɛ Ate, Yeesu habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la bini beŋkpoŋ baa dɛ yerɔ Judas Eskareɔt la Sɔfonomonome la be dɛ ka pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ n ba Yeesu ne ba tɛ heyaa aa, aŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ ba n tɛɛ yɔ?” Anee Sɔfonomonome la kure suuɡapoŋa fifraatoro do o nɔn ta.
Dɛ le ɡɛ saŋ la, Judas pa mun dɛɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe waa won che o ta, dɛ́ le Yeesu do ba nɔn ta.
Kondikwaa baa dia dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii Yeesu Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta tɔpeloɡle la taa, Yeesu habɔteŋra la ba o be dɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa hɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ya ka ɛ Galekaa kondikwaa la tɛɛ he dio?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hé la bwɛjen bini, hɛɛ na baa bɛl maa jemɔ ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Nomoa la ŋɔ o tɔpere telo ŋɔ o ne o habɔteŋra dɛ ba bá di Galekaa kondikwaa la he dem.’ ” Yeesu habɔteŋra la kaa ŋɔ ɡɛ waa ŋɔa la, asɛ dɛ daa Galekaa kondikwaa la cheɡ bela.
Bɔr aa joa la, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la laŋɔ dɛ ka so dɛɛ di kwaa la.
Baa dɛ di kwaa la, Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, he bini bɛlee dɛɛ ba n lee tɛ bá kpo mɛ.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o habɔteŋra la teene bini chɔɡɔ kohona, asɛ baa pɛɛro beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, menee kɛɛ?
N Dɔɔ, menee kɛɛ?” Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Naate n ne waa pɛ nɔn hɛna beŋkpoŋ bini laanee.
Men Nɛn Bie nɔ ɛɛ sewɔɔ ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa dɛ baɡle la, kɛ naate waa lee mɛ tɛ bá kpo la, bwɛɛlɛ.
Dɛ ba fe ta naate lolɛ ɡba fe bɔ!” Anee Judas waa dɛ ba o lee tɛ la ɡe pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, menee kɛɛ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Anee he bol la.” Baa dɛ di kwaa la la, Yeesu kpɔ paanoo dɛ jam Korowii o wa, asɛ dɛ mɔne tɛ o habɔteŋra la dɛ ŋɔ, “N bo-olii la.
Hé lɛ dɛ́ di.” Asɛ dɛ berɛ kpɔ numol ne sen dɛ jam Korowii dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé bwa nyɔ sen nɔ ane.
Sen nɔɔ cheɡa tɛ n chal maa dɛ ba nɛra kɛrɛdɛ waa koeh dɛ́ fuɡe ta ásɛ Korowii che a ta dɛ́ kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba.
Á ɛ fɔo dɛ́ chɔ Korowii ne nɛwɛnyini baah ta.
Kasinteŋ, maa sen nɔ anee nyɔ kpa bwa ka tel ɡɛ saŋ n ne haa berɛ ba nyɔ anfala n Mɛɛ Kora la ta.” Asɛ ba ɡo yel kpɛɛ Korowii dɛ ir le kaa Ɔlevere Bwejen la ta.
Pita tɔɔh ŋɔ waa Yeesu jemɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Jwaana nɔ ne he bwa ɛɛ chwao kaa ɡel mɛ, ɡɛ baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɛɛ kpo peteɡre laanee, ásɛ peera la bwa lɔ peɡre’ la.
Kɛ dɛ n iro le seo ta naa, mɛɛ tɔ siee kaa Galilia harɛ ta he nɛ.” Anee Pita ŋɔ, “Dɛ n bala nɔ bwa chwao ɡele naa, n te aa chwa ɡele bwa.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ Pita be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, jabal loɡle ne sii fini, dɛ he tɔɔh kera atoro ŋɔ haa men jemɛ.” Anee Pita ŋɔ, “Dɛ seo kwaraa yaa, n ne hɛɛ sewɔɔ, kɛ maa tɔh ŋɔ maa hen jemɛ bwa.” Asɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra baa jaa la bwa ɡe bol ɡɛ.
Yeesu soŋe Korowii Gɛtsɛmane Asɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la kaa bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Gɛtsɛmane, asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé so bonɔ ń la le ka soŋe Korowii dɛ́ ba.” O kpɔ Pita ne Sebedii bii banɛ la dɛ kaa bela.
Dɛ o loo kuu, o ta nae ɡɛ bwa waa ɛ o te.
Asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N tea bini chɔɡɔ kohona to.
A ɡbo ɛɛ kpo mɛɛ kwara.
Hé so bonɔ dɛɛ were ń la ba.” Yeesu la sie tama dɛ ka kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, dɛ a fe ɛɛ maɡroo waa, he bɛ ɡel a ɡɛ wahala nɔ ba n nɛ.
Kɛ anla aa too n tea laa mɛɛ nyin, kɛ ɛ he tetoowa.” Yeesu berɔ ba o habɔteŋra batoro la be, dɛ ba na kɛ ba chɔɔɡe doromi, asɛ o ŋɔ Pita be ŋɔ, “He ta wone cha mɛ dɛ so were dɔŋ beŋkpoŋ ɡba naa?
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ soŋe Korowii, ásɛ Bɔnsam bɛ won neɡre heya.
He bambile fe dɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ, kɛ he bwadabii pwɛre.” Yeesu berɔ ka soŋe Korowii ja dɛ ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, dɛ nae chɛ kɛŋɔ ń na ɡɛ wahala nɔ, ásɛ he laa kpɔ n nɛɛ aa wola maɡre aa, ɛa ɡɛ aa too he tea.” Yeesu aa bera ba o habɔteŋra la be ja la, dɛ ba fe ŋɔ bá hamɛ sie dɛ bɛ dom chɔ, kɛ ba ta wone, dɛ chɔɔɡe doromi.
Yeesu berɔ ɡel ba ja dɛ ka soŋe Korowii toorotena ɡɛ o fa aa soŋo la tenten.
O berɔ ba o habɔteŋra la be dɛ ba pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Domii he chɔ dɛɛ onaa?
Saŋ baa dɛ ba Men Nɛn Bie la kpɔe do wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔn ta la telo.
Hé ir yá kaa.
Hé na, naate waa dɛ ba n lee tɛ bá kpo mɛ laanee la.” Yeesu lawa wa Yeesu nyoa ta aa lɔ waa ta wɛɛ bol la, dɛ Judas waa ɛ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la bini bɛl la denɔ ba.
Dɛ nɛnlaa tenten Sɔfonomonome ne bela nomonome aa tom ba kpoŋe keri ne ɡule ja Judas nɛɛ ba ba.
Dɛ Judas tɔ sie ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Baa la maa ɡbaaro pɛl n bambile dɛ́ mo o lwɛɛma la, amɔ dɛ onee.
Hé den lawɔ dɛɛ la o ne.” Judas den pa sie Yeesu be dɛ ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, he leaa?” O ɡbaaro pɛl o bambile dɛ mo o lwɛɛma.
Anee Yeesu pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N dam, ɛrɛ balaa he ba bonɔ nɔɔ?” Belaa nɛra la den ba ɡuɡri Yeesu dɛ lawɔ.
Nɛra baa ja Yeesu nɛɛ la bɛl pamɛ o kere le o tɔɔ ta, dɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ Sɔfonomoa la bonɔɔ deŋne laa cha.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he kere la do o tɔɔ ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ kere dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, kere nee baa ba o ɡe kpoe.
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ n fe ɛɛ wonoo yerɛ n Mɛɛ ŋɔ ó ba cha mɛ, ásɛ o ɡel nyundua toroma baa wola nyoa dɔe ba dɛ́ ba yo lɛɛ mɛ kɛɛ?
Kɛ n ɡelɔ a ba ɡɛ naa, dɛ waa baa chwera bil ŋɔ ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ á ba la ta berɛ ɛ ɡɛ kpa.” Anee Yeesu pɛɛ nɛra la ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛɛree men he kpɔ keri ne ɡule dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba laɡ mɛ naa?
Tɔpere bɛlbwaa n ne heyaa yon so Korowii Dea bela, ásɛ mɛɛ baɡle nɛra wa, kɛ he ta men bela lawɛ.
Anɔ bwa ɛo ásɛ waa Korowii keamere la aa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini la ɛ kpela.” Belaa Yeesu habɔteŋra la bwa chwa peɡre a kao.
Yeesu kaa che Juu tena nomonome sie Nɛra la baa lawɛ Yeesu la kpɔɔ kaa Sɔfonomoa Kaefas dem, dɛ Tɔnjerema ne bwɛɛ la nomonome la cheme bela.
Baa dɛ kaa la, Pita ɡe teŋɛ ba nɛɛ bojaŋ dɛ ka jo Sɔfonomoa la dem, dɛ ka pu nɛra baa dɛ daah dem bela la so, dɛɛ nyin ó na ɡɛ bwa baa dɛ ba kpɔe ɛ Yeesu.
Sɔfonomonome ne Juu tena nomonome baa dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la bwa nyoa pɛo baa nyin waa dɛ́ kpɔ dawɛ Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ́ won che a ta kpoo.
Anomanta, nɛra kɛrɛdɛ bwa teŋe nyosone dawɛ o nɛ, kɛ ba ta wone dɔ waane dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ dɔɔ kpo.
Anee nɛra banɛ bane den le che baah ta dɛ ŋɔ, “Baa nɔɔ fa ŋɔa wɛɛ wonoo paɡre Korowii Dea nɔ dɛ kpɔ tɔpera atoro mao ja la.” Anee Sɔfonomoa la ir che dɛ ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he na waa nɔ baa kpɔa dawɛ he nɛɛ nɔɔ?
He ta waane dɔe hé chaŋe aa?” Yeesu mwaa o ne, o ta wobɛlbwa chaŋɛ.
Anee Sɔfonomoa la berɛ ŋɔ o be ja ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ kɛŋɔ, dɛ henee o Bie Kristo la waa baɡɛ yaa nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la aa, ɡel ya jemɛ fini.” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Anee he bol la.
Kɛ n berɔ dɛɛ ŋɔ he bwa be ŋɔ, tɔpebɛl hɛɛ ba na Men Nɛn Bie laanee kɛŋɔ maa soɡe Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡnɛn la diɡ ta, ásɛ dɛ na ɡɛ n ne baama aa le nyundua dɛɛ ba!” Belaa Sɔfonomoa la laa o ɡbaɡba laala waa doa la laa kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé no musu wa!
Bɔkwa danseɛ yá berɛ dɛɛ nyin jaɔ?
Kɛ he bwa no musu waa nɔ waa dena bol nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he na waa nɔɔ, bwɛɛla?” Ba bwa den pɛ nyoa ŋɔ, “O chɛ kpoe.” Ba ta nentane ta o siebɔr dɛ lɔɔro, dɛ tɔɔ kande.
Banɔ la baa dɛ kpaa o lwɛrɛme dɛɛ chuɡru kwɛɛrɛre la yon berɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Dɛ henee Kristo la aa, na chaahna dɛ́ won jemɛ naate waa lɔe nɔ!” Pita tɔɔh ŋɔ waa Yeesu jemɛ Dɛ Pita soɡe buse dem baah bela, asɛ Sɔfonomoa la tolo bɛl ba o be dɛ ŋɔ, “Kɛ he ɡe fa teŋɛ Yeesu waa le Galilia harɛ la nɛɛ laɔ?” Asɛ Pita tɔh pelepele ken ba bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ haa dɛ bol nɔ, maa a bini jemɛ kwara!” Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o le bela dɛ ka che dem la doonyoa.
Tolo bɛl berɛ nao bela dɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa cheɡɛ bela la be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ ɛ Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt la habɔteŋra la bɛl.” Asɛ Pita berɛ tɔh dɛ ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ waa on jemɛ.
A ta biɡre bɛlbwa asɛ nɛra baa cheɡɛ bela la ba o be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Kpela, haa won tɔh ŋɔ Yeesu nɛra la bɛl laa hen, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he dɛ bol Galilia tena wobol.” Asɛ Pita ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii kɛ dɛ n jemɛ baa nɔ bobɛlbwa naa, ó bɛ men ɡel!” Buɡ la ta, dɛ jabal sio, asɛ Pita lii ɡɛ Yeesu fa aa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Jabal ne sii dɛ he tɔɔh ŋɔ haa men jemɛ kera atoro bwa” la.
Waa lii a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o le dahara dɛ ka wi lokua ne.
Ba lawɛ Yeesu ka che Paelet sie Tɔɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Korowii Dea Sɔfonomonome bwa ne ba harɛ la nomonome chemo dɛ vɔrɔwe Yeesu kpoe vɔrɔwa, dɛ vɔrɔwe o nɔɔra, dɛ kpɔɔ ka tɛ Rom nomoa Paelet waa dɛ nyiŋi bela harɛ ta.
Judas seo wa Judas la waa le Yeesu tɛ ba dɔɔ lawɛ la aa bera na kɛ ba dɛ nyin ba kpo Yeesu la, a we o nɛ, asɛ o berɛ charɛ o liire kɛŋɔ o fe jemaa, o fe ta suuɡa la lɛɛ dɛ le Yeesu tɛ, asɛ dɛ berɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa fifraatoro la ka tɛ Sɔfonomonome la ne bwɛɛ nomonome la, dɛ ŋɔ, “N ɛ wechɔɡa kɛ maa le nɛn waa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé ka kpoo nɔ.” Anee nɛra la ŋɔ, “Ya te waane laa, a bwa do kɛ hen.” Anee Judas kpɔ suuɡapoŋa la viɡri Korowii Dea bela, asɛ dɛ ka saɡɛ o te.
Sɔfonomonome la pa suuɡa la dɛ ŋɔ, “Suuɡa nɔ ɛ chal suuɡa, asɛ ya mmarare ɡe aa yaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ kɛŋɔ ya won kpɔ suuɡa nɔ ja Korowii Dea suuɡa ta.” Anomanta, ba bwa nyoa pɛo kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ suuɡa la ka yawɛ harɛ bɛl waa ɛ vimamaa harɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ huɡe hɔɔhra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bela.
A waa ɡela baa yerɛ bela harɛ la Chal Harɛ dɛ ba le fini la.
Waa Korowii keame Jeremia fa aa bola la ɛ kpela.
O fa ŋɔ, “Ba lɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraatoro, ɡɛ Israel tena nyoa aa pɛa ba di o yoɡ la, asɛ dɛ kpɔ ɡɛ suuɡa la ka yawɛ vimamaa harɛ la ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ n be la.” Yeesu aa cheɡɛ Paelet sie wɛɛ pɛɛro wa Dɛ Yeesu ɡe cheɡɛ nomoa Paelet sie.
Asɛ Paelet bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Henee Juu tena kooro ɛ?” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Anee he bol la.” Sɔfonomonome ne harɛ nomonome la teŋe nyosone dawɛ Yeesu nɛ, kɛ Yeesu ta ban chaŋɛ.
Asɛ Paelet bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Wedamanta nɔ bwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ dawɛ nɔ, haa no kɛɛ?” Yeesu ta wobɛlbwa chaŋɛ, o ta a bɛlbwa tɔeh, asɛ nomoa Paelet nyoa kpo kohona.
Ba ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ bá kpo Yeesu Dɛ o dɔ we-ɛɛle bɛl waa dɛ ɛ bena bɛlbwa.
A ɡɛ tɔpejen la baa tel aa, wechɔɡ-ɛɛ te bɛlbwa baa doo dea asɛ bwɛɛla la ŋɔ ó fooru ta la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó fooru ta.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ ba do baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Barabas nomɛlbwa aa dɛ no o sɔnchɔɡe dea.
Asɛ baa ba Paelet be o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Barabas ne Yeesu baa dɛ yerɔ Kristo la, ba bini umee hɛɛ nyin ń fooru ta tɛ heya ɔ?” Dɛ o ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ bɔweela waa ba che Yeesu nɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ dɛ kpɔɔ ba o be la.
Nomoa Paelet aa soɡe o kara ta dɛɛ bol waa la, o haah tomɛ nɛn o be ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ baa la wobɛlbwa ɛ. Nɛndɛɛɡe tentenee.
Gɛ maa dee o waa fini nɔ la, a we n nɛɛ taeh.” Jaah dɛ Sɔfonomonome ne bwɛɛ nomonome la do nɛnlaa la bwa ŋɔ bá ŋɔ Barabasee baa nyin kɛ Paelet foo ta ásɛ dɛ kpo Yeesu.
Anee Paelet bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Nɛra banɛ nɔ bini umee hɛɛ nyin ń foo ta tɛ heya ɔ?” Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Barabas.” Belaa o berɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛɛ he ŋɔ ń ɛ Yeesu nɔ baa dɛ yerɔ Kristo nɔɔ?” Asɛ ba bwa pɛ ŋɔ, “Kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta!” Anee Paelet bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yɔ?
Bɔkwa wechɔɡaa o ɛɔ?” Ate, dɛ ba berɔ kwaa ŋɔ kohona ŋɔ, “Kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta!” Nomoa Paelet aa naa kɛ dɛ o ŋɔ o saɡɛ waa la ta naa, waa aa ba la aa wer doe ba la, o ɛ nee dɛ samɛ o nɔɔra nɛnlaa la bwa sie dɛ ŋɔ, “N laa dɛɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé kpo nɛndɛɛɡe nɔ.
He ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ ɛ he wa!” Anee nɛra la ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, hé te ɡel o seo wobɛlbwa dawɛ ya ne ya naanar nɛ!” Belaa Paelet le Barabas ta, ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin la, dɛ ɡel ba lɔɔ Yeesu bampɔrɔ ŋwɛɛra ne mɔɔ dɛ kpɔɔ tɛ ŋɔ bá ka kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta.
Gɛ soojare aa muɡli Yeesu baah Asɛ soojare la kpɔ Yeesu le kaa nomoa Paelet dem, dɛ yerɛ ba bala soojare la bwa ba ba baro cheme, dɛ laa o laala foo, dɛ kpɔ yaswɛm bɛl kɛŋɔ ba bela kooro yal ba tɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ sɔɔhne sɔh kooɡbɛrɛ piu, dɛ kpɔ daa bɛl do o nɔndiɡ ta, dɛɛ ɡuŋu harɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɛ kooro la dɛɛ taramo dɛɛ si, “Woowo, Juu tena kooro!” Asɛ dɛ ta nentane dɛɛ ta o nɛ, dɛ kpɔ daa la dɛɛ cha o nyu.
Baa muɡli o baah tonɛ la, ba laa yal la foo o bwara ta, dɛ kpɔ o ɡbaɡba laala o fa aa doa wubwa la doo, dɛ kpɔɔ le dɛɛ kaa dɛ́ ka kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta.
Ba kpaa Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta Baa dɛ kaa la, ba kaa na Sairini baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Seemɔn.
Ba ɛɡro o lɛ Yeesu daɡaɡre la che.
Asɛ ba ba bela baa dɛ yerɔ Gɔlɡɔta la.
Gɔlɡɔta munii Nyuhoɡ Bɔr.
Asɛ ba kpɔ koŋkpelakpela ane koo sen ta dɛ kpɔ tɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ó nyɔ.
Waa daɡa na la, o vɛh nyɔe.
Ba foo o laala, dɛ kpaa o nɔɔra ne o nakpale pɛl daɡaɡre ta.
Dɛ soojare la dɛ nyin Yeesu laala bɔna, dɛ ta chacha mɔɔ dɛ́ won jemɛ laala ba bɛlbwa aa di.
Gɛɛ ba ɛ mɔɔ dɛ ba so dɛɛ nyiŋu.
Ba chwerɛ o wechɔɡa waa ɛa ba koh a waa kpoo la pɛl o daɡaɡre la ta o nyundua.
A ɡɛ waa laanee, yeesu, juu tena kooroo nɔ.
Belaa ba kpaa ŋwɛɛra banɛ pɛl daɡaɡra ta ja Yeesu nɛ, bɛl saɡɛ o diɡ ta, bɛl ɡe saɡɛ o ɡal ta.
Nɛra baa kpɔ bela bɔr baa kaa la chɛɡre Yeesu dɛɛ muɡli o baah ŋɔ, “Chwa!
Nɛn waa dɛ ba Korowii Dea paɡra dɛ́ won kpɔ tɔpera atoro mao la laa nɔ ɡbao?
Lɛ he te!
Dɛ henee Korowii Bie la aa, le daɡaɡre la doa tu harɛ yá na!” Gɛɛ Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema ne bwɛɛ nomonome muɡli o baah ɡɛ banɔ la aa ɛa la, dɛ ŋɔ, “Ao!
O won bane te lɛɛ, kɛ waa won lɛ o te ɡbaɡba.
Kɛ Israel tena kooroo yɔ.
Hé ɡel ó tu le daɡaɡre la doa ba harɛ yá na ásɛ dɛ yaradao.
O ŋɔ Korowii nɛɛ o sie dawɛ, dɛ ŋɔ Korowii Biee on.
Dɛ o waa dɛ lɛ Korowii sie te naa, amɔ Kórowii ba lɛo taraken.” Dɛ ɡɛɛ ŋwɛɛra baa kpaa ba pɛl daɡaɡra ta ja o nɛɛ la ɡee chɛɡro.
Yeesu seo Wee aa baa che nyufala la, bɔr biro jumaa ken dɛ ka tel wekee saŋ mɔɔ dɛ berɛ chaah ja.
Wekee saŋ aa baa tel la, Yeesu do lɔŋɔ kpeɡri nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” O munii kɛŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ Korowii, n Mɛɛ Korowii, ɛrɛɛ he chwa mɛ nɔɔ?” Nɛra baa cheɡɛ bela la aa no ɡɛ la, ba ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no!
Elaejaa wɛɛ yerɛ la.” Asɛ bɛl chwa buɡ la ta, dɛ ka kpɔ konjɔɡɔjɔɡɔ bɛl waa dɛ lɛ nee ka li sennyɛɡa ta dɛ kpɔ toh daa ta, dɛ kpɔ pao ó nyɔ.
Nɛra baa kaa la ɡe ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya na, dɛ Elaeja ɛɛ ba lɛo wa aa?” Belaa Yeesu berɛ do lɔŋɔ kohona, asɛ dɛ ɡel o doma kaa, o den sewɛ.
Waa sewa la, ate dɛ yal waa teŋe Korowii Dea la baah ta la pere anɛ le nyundua ba ta harɛ.
Harɛ jiɡro, asɛ bwetala bini peɡri, lalbɔɔne pili, asɛ Korowii nɛra baa serewa kɛrɛdɛ ir seo ta.
Yeesu aa ir seo ta la, ba ɡe le ba lalbɔɔne bini dɛ ka jo bwɛjen Jerusalam, asɛ nɛra kɛrɛdɛ na ba.
Sooja nomoa ne o soojare baa dɛ daah Yeesu la aa na ɡɛ harɛ aa jiɡra ne waa aa chiɡa la, ba ɔmɔ, asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Korowii Biee baa nɔ kpela!” Dɛ haahna warɔ dɛ che bojaŋ dɛɛ nyiŋi.
A ɡɛ haahna nɔɔ teŋɛ o nɛɛ le Galilia harɛ dɛ daa kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛo.
Ba bini banee Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la, ne Jems ne Josef nya Mɛɛre, dɛ Sebedii bii la nya.
Yeesu huɡa Awola jɔmɔra la baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Josef, o le Arimatea dɛ ɛ suuɡate balɔ.
Dɛ o ɡba ɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la bɛl, dɛ ɡe la Paelet be dɛ ka soŋo ŋɔ ó tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó ka kpɔ Yeesu lale la.
Paelet sɛh dɛ kpɔ tɛo.
Anee Josef kpɔɔ, dɛ kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe bɛl dɛ fɔrɔwo, dɛ kpɔɔ ka huɡe lalbɔɔ o ɡbaɡba aa forɛ bwe bɛl ta o do kɛŋɔ dea ken baa wola nomɛlbwa o bini huɡe mɔɔ la, dɛ ɡbili bwejen bɛl tɔ o nyoa, asɛ dɛ le bela kaa.
Dɛ Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la ne o dɔŋ Mɛɛre la soɡe bela, asɛ ba sie pa lalbɔɔ la ta baa nyiŋi.
Yeesu lalbɔɔ daahna Awola tɔpere la, dɛ Juu tena dɛ kpɔ ba te ásɛ tɔɔ peraa, bá di ba Ona Tɔpere.
Tɔ aa pera la, Sɔfonomonome ne Farisii tena la kaa cheme nomoa Paelet dem, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ɡɛ saŋ a ɡɛ nyosonteŋni nɔ aa wola sewɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ o dɛ bol ŋɔ dɛ o sewaa, tɔpera atoro wɛɛ iruu ja.
Anomanta, do nɛra bá kaa daah lalbɔɔ la mɔɔ tɔpetooro wee la tel.
A waa laa aa, o habɔteŋra la ɛɛ ka ŋwɛ lale laanee le bɔɔ la bini, dɛ́ ka teŋe nyosone baɡle nɛra bwa ŋɔ iraa ba Dɔɔ la ir.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, neɡra baa dɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ dɔe ka neɡre nɛra nɔ ɛɛ dɔ bɔree che ɡwaa ɡɛ baa tɔ sie neɡre nɛra la bwa.” Anee nomoa Paelet ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Soojaree la.
Hé ɡel bá ka daah bɔɔ la.
Ŋwɛnɛ te bɛlbwa haa kpɔ o ta ásɛ ba bɛ won ka ŋwɛ lale la la, hé kpɔ o ta.” Anee ba ka ɛ ɡɛ baa ɛ bwa nɛn bɛ won ka ŋwɛ lale la.
Ba kaa maa lalbɔɔ la ne bwe la baa kpɔa tɔ o nyoa la bobɛl pɛ ɡɛ aa ɛ dɛ nomɛl ŋwɛo jo bɔɔ la bini naa, ba won jemɛ, asɛ dɛ berɛ kpɔ soojare so bela ŋɔ báa daah bela.
Yeesu seo ta ira wa Ona Tɔpere la aa ɡara, asɛ tɔɔ ɛɛ ba pera Kwasiara waa ɛ tɔpeloɡle la, Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la ne o dɔŋ Mɛɛre la iro ŋɔ ba dɛ la ka nyiŋi bela baa huɡe Yeesu la.
Kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ Korowii nyundua torome bɛl le nyundua tu harɛ, asɛ harɛ jiɡri kohona.
O la bɔɔ la ta dɛ ka ɡbili bwejen la le o nyoa, dɛ so o ta.
Dɛ he nao waa, o dɛ jajare sie kɛŋɔ bwaala aa nyɛɡla ken, asɛ o laala waa doa la ɡe to kpelkpel kɛŋɔ yabii ken.
Soojare baa dɛ daah bela la aa nao la, ba ɔmɔ taeh, ba bwara ɛɛ sa, ba bwa chɔɔɡe kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa ken.
Anee nyundua torome la ŋɔ haahna la be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɔmɛ.
N jemɔ kɛ Yeesu baa kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta o sewɛ la bɔree hɛɛ nyin.
O toole bonɔ kpa.
O iro ɡɛ o fa aa ŋɔ he be la.
Hé ba na bela baa huɡo la, ásɛ dɛ ɛ warane dɛ́ la ka baɡle o habɔteŋra be kɛŋɔ o ir seo ta, dɛ́ berɛ ŋɔ o tɔ ba sie dɛɛ kaa Galilia harɛ ta.
Belaa baa ba o nae.
Waa maa dɔa dɛ bol he be laanee la.” Asɛ haahna la chwa le bɔɔ la bɔr bela.
Ɔmee laɡ ba, ba sie ɡe ɡarɛ lɛ taeh.
Ba lawɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ chwa la ka taa waa la baɡle Yeesu habɔteŋra la.
Buɡ la ta, Yeesu chem ba ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ chɔɔ ba, asɛ ba tel o be dɛ ɡuŋi lawɛ o napaala dɛɛ duuru.
Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɔmɛ.
Hé la ka ŋɔ n nimanar la be kɛ bá kaa Galilia harɛ.
Belaa baa ba n nae.” Nɛra baa dɛ daah Yeesu lalbɔɔ nyoa wobol Haahna la ta aa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la, soojare la baa dɛ daah lalbɔɔ la bane chwao kaa bwɛjen Jerusalam dɛ taa waa aa chiɡa la bwa baɡle Sɔfonomonome.
Sɔfonomonome la ne bwɛɛ nomonome chemo dɛ vɔrɔwe, dɛ nyin suuɡa damanta tɛ soojare la, dɛ lɔ ba nyoa ŋɔ, “He ɛo waa, hé ŋɔ dɛ he chɔɔɡe doromi harambaŋa, asɛ o habɔteŋra la ba ŋwɛo kaa, asɛ dɛ Paelet noɔ kɛ dɛ doromii he chɔ dɛ ɡel ba won ba ŋwɛ Yeesu chɔɔ la, dɛ ɡel ba la he ne kɔɔto aa, yá bol tɛ heyaa ásɛ he kon do som.” Soojare la aa lɛ suuɡa la, ɡɛ Sɔfonomonome la aa do ba ŋɔ bá bol laanee ba taa baɡle nɛra bwa.
Hale kpoŋe ba le fini, ɡɛ waa laanee Juu tena ta kpoŋe dɛɛ bol.
Yeesu kpɔ o te chaɡle o habɔteŋra Yeesu habɔteŋra fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ la Galilia harɛ ta ka chemo bwe bɛl o fa aa ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ o baa ir seo ta naa bá chemo bela la.
Baa nao la, ba duuru, kɛ dɛ bane dɛ tɔŋle ŋɔ Yeesu laa ba na la.
Yeesu tel ba jwɛh dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii kpɔ nyundua ne harɛ nɔ ta bwa kpeɡri do n nɔn ta.
Anomanta, hé valɛ kaa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ́ ka nyin nɛra bwa bini nɛra bá ba teŋɛ n nɛ, dɛ́ sɔ ba Korowii ne, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ba do n Mɛɛ ne men o Bie ne o Domadɛɛɡe la nɔn ta, ásɛ dɛ chaɡ ba ŋɔ báa teŋɛ n waa maa chaɡle heyaa la bwa ta.
Kasinteŋ, mɛɛ che he habɔɔ, dɛ́ ja he nɛɛ tɔpere te bɛlbwa, dɛ́ ka tel wobɛlbwa jaɡa saŋ.”
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Mak chwerɛ Yeesu wa dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, o dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won chaɡle nɛra wa, dɛ́ chah nɛra weela, ásɛ dɛ berɛ won kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa kɛ ba.
O kpɔ Yeesu Korowii nee sɔe la pa o waa la mun.
O dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la aa baa jemɛ ɡɛ waa doa, kɛ nɛra kɛrɛdɛ tɔŋlo o webaɡla la wa.
Yeesu seo ne o seo ta ira waa laanee o kpɔ ba a jaɡa.
Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee wa N dɛ nyin n baɡle heyaa amanesoma aa le Korowii Bie Yeesu Kristo waa la ta.
A mumparee nɔ.
