Korowii keame Aesaya chwerɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa bol nɛn waa dɛ ba Yeesu sie tɔe la waa o Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tomɛ n toromee ó tɔ he sie dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ.” Dɛ berɛ chwerɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛl dɛ bol waa takpeɡ ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ ŋɔ nɛ́ra ɡel ba we-ɛɛla toɡre, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ kpa ba Dɔɔ bala.” Gɛɛ a do Jɔn ir dɛ ba pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, dɛ ba bol Korowii Waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra, dɛɛ ŋɔ bá charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ Korowii kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, ásɛ o ɡe sɔ ba Korowii ne.
Belaa nɛra baa le Juda harɛ, ne Jerusalam tena bwa le kaa Jɔn be ka no o waa la, dɛ bol ba wechɔɡa dɛɛ baɡlo, asɛ o sɔ ba Korowii nee Jɔɔdan Moo ta.
Jɔn nɔ yal waa tɔɔ la, nyoɡma pona nee ba sɔɔh, ol tɔn ɡee ɛ o kiriso.
Dɛ tontombɛ ne toohnee ɛ o kondikwa.
O ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Nomɛl dɛ ba n habɔɔ dɛ́ ɡwaa mɛ.
Maa o napaa tee kwaraa dɔ.
Maa sɔ heyaa Korowii nee la, nee ɡbaɡbaa n kpɔ sɔ heya.
Kɛ o te ɛɛ kpɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee sɔ heya.” Jɔn sɔ Yeesu Korowii ne, asɛ Bɔnsam ɡe daahno na Belaa Yeesu le Nasarɛt waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta dɛ ba Jɔn be, asɛ o sɔɔ Korowii nee Jɔɔdan Moo ta.
Buɡ la ta, Yeesu aa le nee la ta la, o nao kɛŋɔ nyundua pilo, asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe do kɛŋɔ borɔnoma ken dɛ ba so o nɛ.
Asɛ o no taa bɛl le nyundua ŋɔ, “Henee n bie maa dɛ nyin he wa, he wa ɛɛ su n siwi.” Anee Korowii Doma la den ɡel o kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, bela kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa aa lole, asɛ o do bela tɔpera fifraanaarɛ.
Dɛ Bɔnsam dɛ ba o be bela dɛ baa daahno dɛɛ na kɛŋɔ o fe charɛ nyoa.
Dɛ nyundua toroma ɡe dɛ ba o be dɛ baa chao.
Gɛ Yeesu aa kpɔ o loɡla habɔteŋra Belaa ba lawɛ Jɔn do dea.
A habɔɔ la, Yeesu la Galilia harɛ dɛ ka bol Korowii Amanesoma baɡ ba.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Tɔpere la telo!
Korowii Kora pu heyaa tonɛ!
Hé charɛ he liire dɛ́ le he wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ dɛ yarada Amanesoma nɔ!” Belaa Yeesu aa dɛ valɛ Galilia Moo la nyoa la, o na nɛra banɛ bane baa dɛ ɛ nee toma dɛɛ ta asau, Seemɔn ne o nime Andriu.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel he pɛŋa la nyina dɛ́ ba teŋɛ n nɛ, ásɛ n baɡle heyaa ɡɛ baa nyin nɛra baa tɛ Korowii.” Buɡ la ta la, ba ɡel ba asauri la dɛ teŋɛ o nɛ.
Baa le bela dɛ la sie tama ken la, o na baala banɛ bane, Sebedii bii Jems ne o nime Jɔn, baa lɔ ba ɡbera bini dɛɛ tɔɔɡe ba asauri.
Belaa Yeesu yer ba, asɛ ba ɡel ba mɛɛ Sebedii ne paa tena baa kpɔ ba ja ba nɛɛ la ɡbera la bini dɛ ka teŋɛ o nɛ.
Baa bɛl kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛɛ wa Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la Kapeeneɔm, asɛ Ona Tɔpere la, o la cheremi dea dɛ ka baɡle wa.
O webaɡla la ɛɛ ba nyokpoa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ta do kɛ ɡɛ Tɔnjerema la yon dɛɛ baɡle la.
O te dɛ bol waa kɛ nɛn waa dɔ waa bwa kpeɡri ken.
Belaa baa bɛl kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛɛ ba cheremi dea bela dɛ ba nyɛɡ ŋɔ, “Yeesu Nasarɛt te, bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ya be nɔ?
Ya chɔɡaa he ba kɛɛ?
N jemɛ he nɛnsoo.
Henee Korowii Biɡoroŋ la waa ŋɔa ŋɔ o dɛ ba bala la.” Anee Yeesu kɔr kwaa la aa lɔ baa la nɛɛ la ŋɔ, “Hé tɔ nyoa dɛ́ le o nɛ.” Asɛ a ir o nɛɛ dɛ ɡel o beŋri, a dooɡe lɔŋɔre mɔɔ dɛ le o nɛ.
Gɛ waa nɔ ɛ nɛra la bwa nyokpoa, asɛ ba bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa nɔɔ?
A ɡe ɛ webaɡlefala kɛɛ?
He ta nae kɛŋɔ o dɔ kpeɡri dɛ bol waa kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ be a no dɛɛ kaa la aa?” Buɡ la ta, Yeesu waa perɛ Galilia harɛ bobɛlbwa.
Gɛ Yeesu aa chah nɛndamanta bane Baa le cheremi dea bela la, ba ne Jems ne Jɔn pa sie kaa Seemɔn ne Andriu dem.
Dɛ Seemɔn helahaah bwara wɔrɔbɔ o chɔ kalaŋ ta.
Yeesu aa bala la, ba bol haah la waa baɡlo.
Asɛ o la o be dɛ ka lawɔ ir.
Belaa a le o nɛ o bwara sɔɔhno, asɛ o ir dɛ daa kwaa tɛɛ ba.
Wee aa joa la, ba kpɔ weela tena ne nɛra kwaa aa dɛ ir ba nɛɛ bwa ba Yeesu be.
Asɛ bwɛɛ la tena la bwa ba che dem la doonyoa.
O chah nɛndamanta weela bwa soo siwi aa lɔ ba nɛ, dɛ doŋi kwaa ɡe le nɛndamanta nɛ.
O ta kwaa la ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ a won bol wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a jemɛ o nɛnsoo.
Yeesu Korowii waa bola Galilia harɛ ta Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Yeesu iro le dem bela dɛ kaa bela aa hela, dɛ ka soŋe Korowii.
Belaa Seemɔn ne o bala la ir dɛ kaa ɡaaɡe o bɔr.
Baa nao la, ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nɛra bwa dɛ nyin he bɔr.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya kaa bwɛɛre aa bɛne bonɔ nɔ ta ásɛ n ka bol waa a ɡe ta, dɛkalkɛ a waa n koh ba.” Anomanta, o valɛ Galilia harɛ bwa dɛɛ bol waa ba cheremi deene bini dɛɛ doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛ.
Yeesu chah baa bɛl weechɔɡa aa ɛ o bwara Asɛ baa bɛl weechɔɡa aa ɛ o bwara ba Yeesu be, dɛ ba ɡuŋi harɛ dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ sɛoh waa, hɛɛ wonoo ɡel n bwara kwaa.” O waa do Yeesu sum, o tɛr o nɔn leɡo dɛ ŋɔ, “N sɛoh.
N ɡelɔ he bwara kwaa.” Buɡ la ta la, weela la den le o nɛ, asɛ o bwara kwaa.
Anee Yeesu kaoh ŋɔ, “Bɛ nomɛlbwa be ŋɔ.
Pa sie kaa Sɔfo be dɛ́ kpɔ he te ka baɡlo ó pɛne, asɛ hé kpɔ kwaa ka tɛo ó kpo, ɡɛ Mosis aa baɡla la, á baɡle kɛ he weela la toole he nɛɛ kpa.” Waa kaoh tonɛ la, o ɡelɔ o le kaa.
Baa la aa lea la, o kpɔ waa la perɛ bobɛlbwa.
A ɡelɔ Yeesu ta wone valɛ kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin kpa.
Anomanta, bwɛɛ bɛlbwa waa la o ta la, ɡɛɛ o ka so bwɛɛ la dahara, asɛ nɛra le bobɛlbwa dɛ ba o be.
Yeesu chah baa bɛl waa kuuɡa Tɔpere bɛl habɔɔ la, Yeesu berɔ la Kapeeneɔm.
Belaa o waa perɛ bwɛɛ la ta kɛ o lɔ dem.
Anomanta, nɛra cheme dem bela kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ bɔr toole doonyoa kwaraa, asɛ Yeesu bol waa baɡ ba.
Belaa nɛra banaarɛ bane kpɔ baa bɛl waa kuuɡa dɛɛ ba Yeesu be.
Bɔr aa fara la, ba ta wone kpɔ baa la ba o be.
Anee ba teeh dea la dɛ forɛ sal la bela Yeesu aa cheɡa la, dɛ kpɔ baa la ne o kalaŋ waa chɔ o ta la dɛ che bela dɛ kpɔɔ bil Yeesu sie.
Belaa Yeesu aa naa kɛ ba yaradao kɛrɛdɛ la, o ŋɔ baa la waa kuuɡa la be ŋɔ, “N bie, n kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛɛ.” Tɔnjerema baa soɡe bela la lii ba nyu bini dɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ o do dɛɛ bol waa ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Korowii ɡboo won wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ.
Aa!
O dɛ ɛ Korowii nɛnhɛla.” Belaa Yeesu aa jemɛ waa baa liira la, asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Maa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ n kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo nɔ, ne kɛŋɔ maa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ir dɛ́ kpɔ o kalaŋ valɛ, a bini umee kpeɡa ɔ?
Mɛɛ chaɡle heyaa kɛŋɔ Men Nɛn Bie dɔ kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta kɛ ń kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa kɛ ba.” Belaa o ŋɔ naate waa kuuɡa la be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ŋɔ he be!
Ir dɛ́ kpɔ he kalaŋ kaa dem!” Asɛ baa la ir buɡ la ta, dɛ kpɔ o kalaŋ nɛra la bwa siwi ta bela dɛ kaa.
A ɡelɔ nɛra la bwa nyoa kpo, asɛ ba kpɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ ba ta a dɔŋa nae bwa.
Gɛ Yeesu aa yerɛ Lewi Yeesu berɔ la Galilia Moo la nyoa.
Belaa nɛra warɛ dɛ ba o be, asɛ wɛɛ baɡ ba wa.
Waa vala baa kaa la, o na baa bɛl waa soɡe o toma ta dɛɛ lɛ toɔ, baa yerɔ Lewi, o mɛɛ ɡe sɔne Alfeɔs.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ba teŋɛ n nɛ.” Asɛ o ir dɛ teŋɛ o nɛ.
A habɔɔ la, Yeesu la Lewi dem dɛ ka so dɛɛ di kwa.
Toɔ lɛɛra baa dɛ bɔ nɛra apoo ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra yon warɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Ba ne Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la so tiɡ ta.
Anee Farisii tena Tɔnjerema la aa na Yeesu ne toɔ lɛɛra ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la aa pɛa dɛɛ di kwaa la, ba bɔɔ o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ o ne ɡɛ nɛra nɔ pɛ dɛɛ di kwaa nɔɔ?” Yeesu aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Weela tenaa hiah tɛɛɡa te, bokpeɡa tena laa.” Dɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa dɛ lii ba te nɛndɛɛɡa waa laa n ba.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra waa n ba, ásɛ ba charɛ ba liire.” Nyoa vɔwa wepɛɛre Awola bɛl, Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la habɔteŋra ne Farisii tena vɔwɛ ba nyoa, asɛ nɛra bane ba Yeesu be dɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa Jɔn habɔteŋra ne Farisii tena habɔteŋra te ɛɛ vɔwɛ ba nyoa, asɛ he habɔteŋra nɔ te aa wola nyoa vɔwɛ nɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu sɛɡ ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Baa aa lawɛ hanfale dɛ yerɛ o daamanar ŋɔ bá ba lɛ ba sie nɔ, baa berɔɔ so lɔr aa?
Baa lɔree so.
Kɛ tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ hanfale jaa laanee le ba bini.
Gɛ saŋ la te, baa vɔwɛ nyoaa.
Baa yafale yakwara kpɔe dɛɛ tɔ yabene bɔɔ.
A ba ɡɛ naa, onfale la ɛɛ kɛɛroo le yabene la ta, ásɛ bɔɔ la berɛ do kan kohona.
Baa senfala kpɔe dɛɛ do loŋbena aa kɔɔhna bini dɛɛ tɔ a nyoa.
Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa, senfala la baa peraa, aa do kpeɡrii dɛ́ pere loŋa la á chɔɡ, ásɛ sen la fuɡe.
Senfala chɛ loŋfala.” Ona Tɔpere wepɛɛre Awola Ona Tɔpere bɛl, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra kpɔ mea koo bɛl ta, asɛ o habɔteŋra la kuuɡi mea la ane.
Anee Farisii tena bane aa naa la, ba ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na!
He habɔteŋra la dɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ koni ya Ona Tɔpere Mmara la.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “He ta ɡɛ ya naa Devid aa ɛa saŋ la Abiata aa ɛ Sɔfonomoa la kure kɛɛ?
Gɛ saŋ la Devid nyao, asɛ lɔr ɛɛ kpo o ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la.
O la Korowii Dea dɛ ka di paanoo aa ɛ Korowii kwa, nomɛlbwa fe aa wola ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ó di la atane kɛ sɔfore la ɡbo, asɛ o di dɛ tɛ o nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la ɡe ba di.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ja ŋɔ, “Nɛn waa Korowii cheɡ Ona Tɔpere.
Ona Tɔpere te waa laa o ta nɛn.
Anomanta, Men Nɛn Bie dɔ Ona Tɔpere ɡba kpeɡri.”
Baa bɛl o nɔn aa sewa Yeesu la cheremi dea bela ja, dɛ baa bɛl o nɔn aa sewa lɔ bela.
Dɛ nɛra bane lɔ bela dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ kpɔ waa dawɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Asɛ baa nyiŋi kɛ wɛɛ chah baa laanee Ona Tɔpere la ta ásɛ ba dɔ o waa dɛ́ bol.
Asɛ Yeesu yerɛ baa la o nɔn aa sewa la ŋɔ ó ir ba che ba sie.
Belaa Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ Korowii Mmara la ɛɛ baɡle yaa ŋɔ yá ɛ Ona Tɔpere ta laɔ?
A ɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta kɛ yaa ɛ nɛra wedɛɛɡa kɛɛ yaa ɛ nɛra wechɔɡa ɔ?
A ɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta kɛ ya lɛ nɛra mkpa kɛɛ yá chɔɡ baɔ?” Waa bɔɔ ba ɡɛ la, ba ta wone bol wobɛlbwa.
Asɛ Yeesu nyiŋi ba bwa, o baah di.
Gɛ ba liire aa do toŋɡboŋ kohona la ta o sie lɛɛ.
Anee o ŋɔ baa la be ŋɔ ó tɛr nɔn.
Waa tɛr o nɔn la, dɛ o nɔn la berɔ do kpeɡri.
Anomanta, Farisii tena la le cheremi dea la bini, asɛ ba ne Hɛrɔd nɛra la ka cheme dɛ vɔrɔwe Yeesu vɔrɔwa dɛ́ fee kpoo.
Gɛ nɛnlaa aa baa teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ Asɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra le kaa Galilia Moo la ta.
Belaa nɛnlaa bane baa le Galilia harɛ teŋɛ o nɛ.
Nɛra baa le Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam ne Idumia harɛ ne Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr, dɛ nɛra baa le bwɛjena Taaya ne Sidon pera bwa no o wa, dɛ ba o be.
Nɛra la warɔ kohona, anomanta, Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ bá nyin ɡbera bɛl tɛo ó jo o bini ásɛ nɛra la che baŋ dɛ bɛ o nɛɛ tɔ.
Waa chah nɛra kohona nomanta, weela tena la kar ta dɛ nyinu dɛ leɡe.
Banɔ la kwaa aa dɛ ir ba nɛɛ la nao waa, ɡɛɛ ba choɡli o sie dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ bol waa o be, ŋɔ, “Henee Korowii Bie la!” Anee Yeesu kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ o nɛnsoo baɡle.
Gɛ Yeesu aa le o toroma fi dɛ banɛ Asɛ Yeesu ka che bwe bɛl ta, dɛ yerɛ nɛra waa dɛ nyin, anee ba ba o be.
Belaa o le ba bini fi dɛ banɛ dɛ ŋɔ bá teŋɛ o nɛɛ dɛɛ bol Korowii Wa.
O ŋɔ baa dɔ kpeɡrii dɛɛ doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛ.
Yeesu nɛra fi dɛ banɛ waa kpɔ ba laanee nɔ.
Seemɔn waa pa o sɔn Pita la, ne Sebedii bii Jems ne o nime Jɔn waa pa ba ɡe sɔn Bɔanɛjes la, o munii kɛ Sikpeɡ Tena, ne Andriu ne Felep ne Batolomeo, ne Matiu ne Tɔmas ne Alfeɔs bie Jems, ne Tadeɔs, ne Seemɔn Sɛlɔt, dɛ Judas Eskareɔt wáa le Yeesu tɛ ba kpoo la.
Yeesu ne Bɛlsebul Yeesu aa kaa dem la, nɛnlaa baa cheme o nɛɛ ja, o ne o habɔteŋra la ta bɔr dɔe dɛ́ di kwaa kwara.
Belaa Yeesu nɛra aa noa la, ba ba kpɔɔ le ba baah, dɛkalkɛ nɛra dɛ bol ŋɔ o dɛ we choɡla.
Asɛ Tɔnjerema bane le Jerusalam ba dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Bɛlsebul waa ɛ kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ bwa kooro laanee tɛo kpeɡri o kpɔ dɛɛ doŋi kwaa la.” Anee Yeesu yer ba dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ Bɔnsam ɛɛ ba wona doŋi o tenten nɔ?” Dɛ sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ harɛ bɛl ta tena bini pere anɛ asɛ baa yo aa, o dɛ paɡre.
Dɛ waane ba dem bɛl ta asɛ ba baah pere anɛ ba ɡbo ɛɛ yo aa, dem la aa won che.
Dɛ Bɔnsam ɡe kora bini peraa, waa won che.
O dɛ ba chɔɡa.” O berɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa aa won jo bokpeɡa te dea dɛ́ ŋwɛ o laala, nemenɛ o tɔ sie won vɔrɔwo mɔɔ, dɛ́ won jo o dea dɛ́ pa o laala.” Belaa o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, Korowii won nɛra wechɔɡa ne nɛnhɛla baa dɛ ɛo la kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ ba.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la nɛnhɛla la te, waa kpɔ kɛo.
Naate wechɔɡa ɛɛ dawɛ o nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa.” Waa nɛra aa dɛ bol kɛ kwaa ir Yeesu nɛɛ la waa o bol ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Yeesu nya ne o nimanar Yeesu aa lɔ dem bela la, o nya ne o nimanar baa che buse dɛ tomɛ nɛn ŋɔ ó yerɔ.
Dɛ nɛra warɔ dɛ so baro cheme, anee ba ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he nya ne he nimanar cheɡɛ buse dɛɛ yerɛ.” Asɛ Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Umee n nya ne n nimanar ɔ?” Anee o laa nyu ir dɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa soɡa baro la, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na n nya ne n nimanar.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin laanee n nime ne n nimambie ne n nya.”
Mea dui sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ la Galilia Moo la nyoa dɛ kaa baɡle nɛra wa.
Nɛra baa cheɡa baro la warɔ, anomanta, o jo ɡbera bini dɛ ka so nebaah tama, asɛ nɛra la ɡe che baŋ.
Belaa o kpɔ sɛɡla dɛ bol waa chaɡ ba ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no.
Baa bɛlee ira dɛ kaa merɛ mea.
Waa ka dɛ merɛ mea la, ane lee ŋwɛnɛ nyoa, asɛ jumbii ba tɔɔ di.
Ane lee bwetala ta bela teera aa wola toole kohona.
Teera la aa dawɛ bwetala la ta la aa kanɛ, a ta biɡre bɛlbwa mea la le.
Kɛ a lune ta wone kaa bini.
Anomanta, wee aa lɔa la, a jwalɔ dɛ serewe.
Ane lee sɔɔhne baah dɛ le, asɛ sɔɔhne la kpeɡ dɛ lawa, a ta wone ɛ. Asɛ anɔ la aa lee harɛdɛɛɡe ta la le, dɛ do wer dɛ ɛ. Ane ma fifraatotoro, ane ma fifraanunumɛla, asɛ ane ɡe ma lafare.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin dɛ́ no la, ó no.” Mea dui sɛɡla mun baɡla Aa ka Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la ne nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ la, ba bɔɔro sɛɡla la mun.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korowii ta o Kora bini wobɛlbwa kpɔe sɔh he te.
Kɛ nɛra baa kaa la te, sɛɡla nee mɛɛ ba waa ba be bola, ásɛ a ɛ ɡɛ baa chwera ŋɔ, ‘Baa nyiŋuu kohona, kɛ baa a mun jema ba baa noo kohona, kɛ baa a jema ba, dɛkalkɛ baa ba liire chara ba bwa, ásɛ Korowii kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba.’ ” Belaa Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He ta sɛɡla la mun noɛ yaa?
Dɛ he ta onɔ mun noɛ yaa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ no sɛɡla bwa mun nɔ?
Nɛn la waa dɛ merɛ kwaa la, o cheɡɔ tɛ naate waa dɛ bol Korowii Wa.
Asɛ nɛra baa dɛ no Waa la bane do kɛ mea la aa lee ŋwɛnɛ nyoa jumbii tɔɔ di la, dɛkalkɛ ba baa no Korowii Waa la aa, buɡ la ta, dɛ Bɔnsam baa laa kpɔ ba nyu bini.
Nɛra baa dɛ no Waa la bane ɡe do kɛ mea la aa lee bwetala ta bela teera aa wola toole kohona kɛŋɔ a lune won kaa bini la, dɛkalkɛ ba baa no Korowii Waa la, dɛ ba sie lɛo.
Kɛ Waa la aa wola ban jooɡɛ la ɡelɔ aa won ba nyu bini ka.
A cheɡɛ Korowii Waa ta waane puu ba aa, dɛ ba horɔ.
Asɛ nɛra baa dɛ no Waa la bane ɡe do kɛ mea la aa lee sɔɔhne baah la, dɛkalkɛ ba no Korowii Waa la, kɛ dɛ ba soɡa bini ne kondɔɔh waa ne wepuu aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta beɡre ba sie, baa ɡelɛ Waa la ɛɛ dɔ tɔnɔ.
Nɛra baa dɛ no Korowii Waa la bane ɡe do kɛ mea la aa lee harɛdɛɛɡe ta dɛ le, asɛ dɛ ma fifraatotoro ne fifraanunumɛla ne lafare la, dɛkalkɛ ba no Korowii Waa la aa, ba dɛ kpoŋe a bini, dɛ́ ɡel a dɔ tɔnɔ.” Kandea waa chɔŋɛ kon ta sɛɡla Yeesu bɔɔ ba ja ŋɔ, “Ba choŋi kandea dɛ kpɔ kon dɛɛ pi o ta kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ do mpa lɔɡa ɔ?
Kon ta laa ba kpɔ dɛɛ chɔŋaa?
Komɛlbwa waa sɔah ɛɛ le bochaahnee nɛra nao.
Waa bwa baa tɔ a ta ɛɛ ba leo nɛra jemɛ.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin dɛ́ no la, ó no.” Yeesu bolɔ ŋɔ, “Hé pese waa nɔ haa noa nɔ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ kpelaa ba ŋɔ, ‘Kon haa kpɔa maɡɛ kwaa tɛ he dɔŋ la tentenee baa ba kpɔe maɡɛ tɛ he ɡe la, dɛ́ berɛ jae ane.’ Anomanta, naate waa dɔa la, baa jao anee ó dɔ kohona.
Kɛ naate waa wola komɛlbwa dɔe la, tama kwaraa waa dɔa la ɛɛ le o nɔn taa.” Konduuli kpeɡa sɛɡla Yeesu ŋɔ, “Korowii Kora do kɛ baa bɛl waa du kwa, asɛ dɛ chɔ, dɛɛ ir tɔpere bɛlbwa, asɛ kwaa la le.
O ta jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa a le.
Harɛ laanee ɡela a le dɛ kpeɡ dɛ nɔnɛ.
Belaa kwaa la aa ɛa dɛ be la, o kpɔ kere ka koma, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ a koma telo.” Mastad bii sɛɡla Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa konee yaa ba kpɔe dɛ maɡɛ Korowii Kora laɔ?
Sɛɡla besoo yaa ba kpɔe baɡle o mun ɔ?
O waa tamaa won yɛɛra kɛŋɔ baa bɛl aa ira, dɛ kpɔ mastad bii dɛ ka du.
O do jeɡaa ken ɡwaa harɛ nɔ ta kwaa bwa bie.
Kɛ o baa le dɛ kpeɡ aa, o kan ɡwaa konduula bwa, dɛ peɡri kpaljena, asɛ jumbii sɔh kɔne do o papooni lɔɡre.” Gɛɛ Yeesu kpɔ sɛɡla nɔ bwa dɔŋa dɛ bol waa ka tel kɛ nɛra la aa wona no a mun.
Sɛɡla ɡbo nee wɛɛ bol waa ba be.
Kɛ o ne o habɔteŋra la ɡbo te, o dɛ baɡ ba a bini.
Yeesu sɔɔh peujen bɛl nyoa Awola tenten jɔmɔra ne la, Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ bá ɡel ba kaa Galilia Moo la baŋ.
Belaa ba ɡel nɛra la bela, dɛ jo ɡbera Yeesu aa lɔ o bini la bini, asɛ dɛ kpɔ ɡbeni la aa lɔ bela la ane ja.
Baa dɛ kaa la, buɡ la ta, peujen bɛl tao, dɛ kpɔ nehɛma dɛɛ jo ba ɡbera la bini wɛɛ ba sui.
Dɛ Yeesu te serɛ o kapuri dɛɛ chɔ dom ɡbera la mun ta.
Anee o habɔteŋra la chumu dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, yaa dɛ ba mora nɔ, he waane laa kɛɛ?” Asɛ Yeesu ir dɛ kɔr peu la ŋɔ, “Gel!” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ nehɛma la be ŋɔ, “Hel!” Belaa peu la ɡel, asɛ bɔr hel kerker ken.
Yeesu bɔɔ o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Oo!
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɔmɛ kohona ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Ba le saŋ nɔ haa men yarada aa?” Ba bwara hwah o waa taeh, ba bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo siwii nɔ, peu ne nehɛma ɛɛ no o wobol nɔɔ?”
Yeesu chah baa bɛl kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la tawɔ kaa Galilia Moo la baŋ Gerasa harɛ ta.
Belaa Yeesu aa le ɡbera la bini la, baa bɛl kwa aa dɛ ir o nɛɛ wɛɛ chɔ lala huɡribɔr den ba chemo.
A ɡɛ baa nɔ, ba fa yon lawɔ dɛ doo kpɛɛ, asɛ o yon laa kpɛɛ la kuuɡi.
Hale ba dɛ doo jɔɡrɔre, asɛ o yon laa chaa.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa aa won on lawɛ dɛɛ doo kpɛɛ ne jɔɡrɔre kpa.
Asɛ o chwa ka do lala huɡribɔr ne bela bwea ane aa lole.
Belaa o do chɔɔ ne jwaana bɛlbwa dɛɛ valɛ bwea la dor dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre, dɛ kpɔ bwea dɛɛ mɔne o bwara.
Gɛɛ a do baa nɔ aa na Yeesu bojaŋ kɛ o dɛ ba la, o chwa dɛ ka ɡuŋi Yeesu sie, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Yeesu, Nemenɛ Korowii Bie, bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin n be nɔ?
N kpɔ Korowii dɛɛ soŋe, bɛ men weweele do.” Baa la bol ɡɛ waa nɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Yeesu tɔ sie ŋɔ, “Konchɔɡe, le baa nɔ nɛ!” Belaa Yeesu bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He sɔne ɛrɔɔ?” O ŋɔ, “N sɔne Dɔm, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya warɔ pirim.” Anee o soŋe Yeesu kohona ŋɔ o bɛ an doŋi le harɛ la ta.
Bela la, dɛ parakooni damanta ane lɔ diŋɡoŋ bɛl ta dɛɛ di.
Anee kwaa la aa dɛ ir baa la nɛɛ la soŋe Yeesu ŋɔ ó ɡel a kaa parakooni la nɛ.
Asɛ Yeesu tɛa ŋwɛnɛ, a le baa la nɛɛ dɛ ka jo parakooni la nɛ.
Belaa parakooni damanta dɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa anɛ la bwa chwa biribiribiri dɛ wili diŋɡoŋ bɛl dɛ ka lee moo la ta dɛ serewe kwaraa.
Belaa nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi parakooni la chwa, dɛ la bwɛɛ la ta ne daamune aa bɛne bela la ta, dɛ ka bol waa aa chiɡa la.
Asɛ nɛra la le ba bwɛɛre ta dɛ ka na waa aa chiɡa, dɛ la bela Yeesu aa lole la, dɛ ka na kɛ baa la konchɔɡa damanta fa aa ir o nɛɛ la, a bwa kaalɔ, o liire ba harɛ, o do laala dɛ so.
Baa nao la, ba ɔmɔ.
Nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛ na la bol nɛra be waa aa chiɡ baa la ne parakooni la nɛ.
Belaa ba soŋe Yeesu ŋɔ ó le ba harɛ ta dɛ kaa.
Waa dɛ jo ɡbera bini la, anee baa la soŋo ŋɔ ó ɡel o ne o kaa.
Asɛ Yeesu vɛh dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kaa dem he nɛra be, dɛ́ ka bol wejena Korowii aa ɛa tɛɛ, ne he sum waa naa la chaɡ ba.” Baa la chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa, dɛ ka bol bela bwɛɛre fi ane aa pɛa baa yera Dekapɔles la tena be wejena Yeesu aa ɛa tɛo, asɛ a ɛ ba bwa nyokpoa.
Bitolo bɛl waa sewa ne hanweelate bɛl wa Yeesu aa jo ɡbera bini dɛ berɛ kaa moo la baŋ le la, nɛnlaa bane baro cheme, o do nee nyoa.
Belaa cheremi dea nomonome la bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jaerɔs ba bela dɛ ba na Yeesu, dɛ ɡuŋi o sie dɛ lawɛ o nakpala, dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “N poori, nomoa, n bihaah bwara dɛ weo wɛɛ ba sewa.
Ba dɛ́ ba kpɔ he nɔɔra dawɛ o nɛɛ ásɛ o bwara do kpeɡri o ir.” Baa la ne Yeesu aa dɛ kaa la, dɛ nɛnlaa bane teŋɛ o nɛ dɛ fiilo do baah ta dɛɛ taɡɔ.
Dɛ haah bɛl ɡe lole chal ɛɛ fuɡo bene fi dɛ anɛ, o chah, o komɛlbwa tonɛ, kɛ weela la ɡe ta ɡwaa o nɛ.
Waa no Yeesu ɡbɔɡa la, o lii o nyu bini kɛŋɔ dɛ o la bela dɛ ka dɔ bɔr jo nɛnlaa la bini dɛ ka leɡe Yeesu batakaare kwaraa naa, wɛɛ ɡbaŋroo.
Dɛ ir dɛ la bela dɛ ka jo ba baah ta, dɛ ka che Yeesu habɔɔ dɛ leɡe o batakaare.
Buɡ la ta, chal la aa dɛ fuɡo la teŋe.
O na o bwadabii bini kɛ o weela la kaalɔ.
Belaa Yeesu na kɛŋɔ kpeɡri ane le o bini.
O berɛ habɔɔ nɛnlaa la baah ta dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Umee leɡe n batakaare nɔɔ?” Anee o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “He ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ nɛnlaa nɔ aa bare cheme dɛɛ taɡɛ dɔŋa nɔ warɔ, ɡɛɛ he berɛ ŋɔ nomɛl leɡe naa?” Anee Yeesu nyiŋi nɛra la bini kɛŋɔ o ken fe ɛɛ na naatee yaa?
Haah la aa naa ɡɛ Yeesu aa ɛa tɛo la, o kpɔ ɔmee ne bochela dɛ ba ɡuŋi o sie, dɛ bol o weela la bwa waa baɡlo.
Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Tolo, he yarada lɛɛ.
Kaa bosɔɔhna ne, ásɛ he bwara do kpeɡri.” Yeesu nyoa ta aa lɔ waa waa dɛ bol la ta la, nɛra bane le cheremi dea nomoa la dem dɛ ba ŋɔ nomoa la be ŋɔ, “He bihaah la sewɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ha nomoa nɔ jaɔ?” Yeesu ta waa baa dɛ bol la ta teŋɛ, dɛ ŋɔ nomoa la be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ yarada mɛ.” Yeesu ta ɡelɛ nomɛlbwa teŋɛ o nɛ, nemenɛ Pita ne Jems dɛ Jɔn waa ɛ Jems nime la.
Baa tel nomoa la dem la, Yeesu na nɛra baa dɛ do ɡbɔɡa dɛɛ wi kohona.
Waa jo bela la, o ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa dɛɛ wi nɔɔ?
Bie la ta sewɛ, domii wɛɛ chɔ.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, ba mamɔ.
Anee o doŋi ba bwa le buse, dɛ kpɔ bie la mɛɛ ne o nya, ne o habɔteŋra batoro la baa ja o nɛɛ la jo bela bie la aa chɔa la, dɛ ka lawɛ bie la nɔn, dɛ kpɔ ba wobol ŋɔ, “Talita kum!” O munii kɛ, “Tolo, n ŋɔ hé ir che.” Buɡ la ta, bitolo la ir che dɛ valɛ.
Ba bwa bwara yɔr.
Yeesu kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa no, kɛ bá nyin kwaa tɛ bie la ó di.
Gɛ saŋ la dɛ bie la dɔ bene fi dɛ anɛ.
Ba vɛh Yeesu Nasarɛt Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la le bela dɛ ba o ɡbaɡba bwɛ.
Ona Tɔpere la aa tela la, o la cheremi dea dɛ ka chaɡle wa.
Nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛ no la, a ɛɛ ba anebɛlbwa.
Ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ baa nɔ ɡe ɛ dɛ jemɛ waa nɔ nɔɔ?
Bɔkwa wejemaa o dɔ ken dɛ won nyokpowaa nɔ bwa dɔŋa ɛɛ nɔɔ?
Kapenta te la laa aa?
Mɛɛre bie la laa aa?
Jems ne Josef ne Judas dɛ Seemɔn wa dɔɔ la laa aa?
O nimambii laa lɔ ya be bonɔ naa?” Anomanta, ba siwi ta on sui.
Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korowii keame dɔ sɔn bobɛlbwa, kɛ o bwɛɛ ne o nɛra ne o dem tena be te, o ta sɔn dɔe.” O ta wone ɛ nyokpowaane bela, nemenɛ weela tena tamaa banee o kpɔ o nɔɔra dawɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ chaah ba.
Yeesu bwara yɔr ba yarada baa wola on yaradae la wa.
Yeesu tomɛ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ Asɛ o la bwɛɛre la aa bɛne bela la ta ka bol Amanesoma la chaɡ ba.
Yeesu yerɛ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la ba cheme o sie, dɛ pɛ ba banɛnɛ dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ la nɛ, dɛ tom ba ŋɔ bá ka ɛ o toma.
O kah ba ŋɔ, “He bɛ komɛlbwa sese kpɔ, nemenɛ daŋɡbale ɡbosoroo.
He bɛ kondikwaa kwaraa kpɔ.
He bɛ pure kpɔ.
He bɛ suuɡa ɡe kpɔ.
He won naŋɡawa doe, kɛ he bɛ batakaani bele anɛnɛ kpɔ.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Bwɛɛ bɛlbwa haa la o ta la, dem haa ka jo o ta la, hé so bela ka tel kɛŋɔ haa le bwɛɛ la ta.
Dɛ ba ta heyaa lɛɛ silɛɛ ne bwɛɛ la ta naa, hé pee he napaala teera ta bela, ásɛ a baɡle kɛŋɔ he kpɔ Korowii Waa ba ba be ba vɛah.” Belaa ba ɡe le dɛ ka bol waa la ŋɔ nɛ́ra charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le wechɔɡa ta.
Ba doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ pirim, dɛ́ kpɔ noo fɔɡle weela tena baa wara, dɛ́ chaah ba weela.
Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee nyu teŋa Yeesu waa perɛ bobɛlbwa, nomɛlbwa no o wa.
Kooro Hɛrɔd ɡe noɔ.
Bane ŋɔ, “Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la, onee.
O weero le seo ta, a waa o won nyokpowaa nɔ ɛɛ la.” Nɛra bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Korowii keame Elaejaa.” Asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ o ɛ keame kɛŋɔ keamebena la ken.
Belaa Kooro Hɛrɔd aa no waa nɔ la, o ŋɔ, “Jɔn maa ɡela ba teŋe o nyu la weero.” Dɛ kooro la mo o ɡbaɡba nime Felep haah baa yerɔ Hɛrɔdeas, asɛ Jɔn ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o ta an aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ.
Jɔn aa ŋɔ ɡɛ la nomanta, kooro la ɡelɔ ba lawɔ dɛ doo kpɛɛ dɛ kpɔɔ ka do dea.
Hɛrɔdeas lɛ Jɔn kɔrɔ dɛɛ nyinu dɛ́ kpo, kɛ o ta wone.
Kooro la ɔmɛ Jɔn, dɛkalkɛ Jɔn ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa toɡre, anomanta, o nyiŋu kɛrɛdɛ.
Jɔn aa dɛ bol waa la, kooro la bwara yɔrɔ, kɛ ane a bwa, o no waa la silɛɛ ne.
Tɔpere aa tela kɛ kooro la di o lola tɔpere la, o ɛ kondikwaa dɛ yawɛ sene dɛ hɛlɛ, dɛ lɛ o koranar baa sawɔ ne Galilia nomonome bwa sie.
Asɛ Hɛrɔdeas bihaah ba dɛ ba sa, o waa lɛ kooro la ne nɛra o ne baa cheme bela la sie.
Anee kooro la ŋɔ tolo la be ŋɔ, “Baɡle kon haa dɛ nyin ásɛ n kpɔ tɛɛ.” Kooro la ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡle tolo la kɛ, “Komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la, mɛɛ tɛɛ, hale n kora pera.” Anee bihaah la le kaa o nya be dɛ ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa konee ń lɛɔ?” Namee Hɛrɔdeas dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ o kpo Jɔn.
O ŋɔ o bie la be ŋɔ ó ka ŋɔ ó tɛo Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la nyu.
Tolo la berɛ ba warane dɛ ba ŋɔ kooro la be ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ he kpɔ Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la nyu dawɛ korɔ ta ba tɛ mɛ taraken.” Waa nɔ we kooro la nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ o ntam waa ŋwɛɛra la ne nɛra baa soɡe bela la nomanta, waa nyin kɛŋɔ o koni o ntam la.
Buɡ la ta, o tomɛ o sooja bɛl ŋɔ ó ka teŋe Jɔn nyu ba.
O kpɔ o kere dɛ ka teŋe Jɔn nyu dea bela baa doo la, dɛ kpɔ dawɛ korɔ ta, dɛ kpɔ ba tɛ tolo la.
Tolo la ɡe kpɔ ka tɛ o nya.
Jɔn habɔteŋra la aa no waa nɔ la, ba balɔ dɛ ba kpɔɔ ka huɡe.
Yeesu tɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banue kondikwaa ba di Nɛra Yeesu aa tom ba la berɔ ba o be, dɛ ba bol anla baa ɛa ne anla baa baɡla dɛ chaɡlo.
Anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ba ya kaa bobɛl nomɛlbwa aa wola toole, ásɛ he ka onɛ tama,” dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa bala dɛɛ kaa la warɔ, ba ta bɔr dɔe dɛ́ di kwaa kwara.
Anomanta, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la ɡbo jo ɡbera bini dɛɛ kaa bela nomɛlbwa aa wola toole.
Jaah nɛra pirim na ba kɛ baa dɛ kaa, dɛ jemɛ kɛ banee, dɛ le bwɛɛre ta chwa dɛ ti ba.
Yeesu aa le ɡbera la bini la, dɛ nɛnlaa tenten lɔ bela.
Ba waa domɛ o tea, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba do kɛ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe ken.
Anomanta, o chaɡ ba waa taeh.
Bɔr aa dɛ ɛ jɔmɔra la, o habɔteŋra la ba o be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Nomoa, bonɔ ɛ kpɔɡ bini, bɔr ɡe dɛ jo.
Anomanta, ŋɔ ba be bá kaa bwɛɛre aa bar bonɔ nɔ dɛ́ ka yawɛ kwaane di.” Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Hé nyin kwaa tɛɛ ba bá di.” Anee ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Yaa wonoo dɔ suuɡa damanta kɛŋɔ denaarere lafraanɛ dɛ́ yawɛ paanoo tɛ nɛra nɔ bwa dɔŋ bá di aa?” Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Paanoo aŋwɛnɛɛ he dɔɔ?
Hé ka nyiŋi na.” Baa kaa nyiŋi na la, ba balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya dɔ paanoo anue ne pɛŋa anɛ.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá ɡel nɛra la pɛ dɛ́ so kpɔɡlor la ta.
Asɛ ba pɛ dɛ so, bane lafare, bane ɡe fifraanunue.
Yeesu kpɔ paanoo anue la ne pɛŋa anɛ la dɛ ha sie dɛ nyiŋi nyundua dɛ jam Korowii, dɛ mɔne paanoo la do o habɔteŋra la nɔɔra ta dɛ ŋɔ bá bɔne tɛɛ ba, dɛ mɔne pɛŋa la ɡe tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá bɔne tɛɛ ba, ba bwa di dɛ vaɡre.
Baa dia tonɛ la, Yeesu habɔteŋra la tɔɔ paanoo la ne pɛŋa baa dia a ka la pɛ do wɛɡrɛjena fi dɛ anɛ bini, a bwa su.
Nɛra baa di paanoo la, ba baala ɡbo ɛɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa banuee.
Yeesu valɛ nee sie Belaa o ɡel o habɔteŋra la jo ɡbera bini dɛ tɔ sie kaa baŋ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Bɛtsaeda, asɛ o ɡe ɡel nɛra la peɡre.
Nɛra la aa kaala la, o teehnɔ kaa bwe bɛl doa dɛ ka soŋe Korowii bela.
Bɔr aa baa ɡarɛ bwa, dɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la lɔ mobaah, asɛ a ka o ɡbo che baŋ.
O nao kɛŋɔ baa won tawɛ kɛrɛdɛ kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ peu tao dɛɛ chem ba.
Jabal loɡla sii saŋ la, o valɔ kpɔ nee la sie dɛɛ kaa ba be, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin o tel ba kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba nao kɛŋɔ waa dɛ valɛ nee sie, dɛ lii kɛŋɔ lalee, dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre.
Ba bwa sekwara aa nao la, ba jum jaoh.
Asɛ Yeesu bol waa ba be warane ŋɔ, “Hé lawɛ bambile.
Menee!
He bɛ ɔmɛ.” O jo ba be ɡbera la bini.
Waa joa la, peu la helɔ.
O habɔteŋra la bwa bwara hwaoh taeh.
Ba liire aa do toŋɡboŋ baa wola paanoo la waa la mun noɛ la, a ɡelɔ ba bwara hwah.
Ba tawɔ ka chuɡe moo la baŋ le Gɛnɛsarɛt harɛ ta, dɛ lawɛ ɡbera la vɔwɛ.
Buɡ la ta, baa le ɡbera la bini la, nɛra jemɛ Yeesu.
Anomanta, ba chwao jo bwɛɛre aa lɔ bela la ta, dɛ che weela tena le ba kalaŋre ta, dɛ kpɔ ba ba bela baa noa kɛ Yeesu lole la.
Bobɛlbwa Yeesu aa laŋa, bwɛjeɡre ta, bwɛjena ne daamune ta la, ba kaa che weela tena ba bil yaware ta, dɛ soŋo ŋɔ ó ɡel weela tena la leɡe o batakaare nyoa.
Banɔ la baa leɡo la bwa ɡbaŋrɔ.
Nabaala webaɡla Farisii tena la ne Tɔnjerema la bini bane baa le Jerusalam la pɛ nyoa dɛ ba cheme Yeesu sie.
Farisii tena la ne ba dɔŋa Juu tena la bwa ta ba nɔɔra samɛ ŋwɛnɛ saŋ la tena la aa baɡla la ta naa, baa kwaa di, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba kii.
Dɛ ba le yawa ta ba naa, ba dɔ yaɡla bɛl baa dɛ yaɡle kondikwaa baa kpɔa le yawa ta ba la, dɛɛ loo ba numoli ne polviine ne loɡa ɡɛ saŋ la tena aa baɡla la mɔɔ dɛɛ di kwa.
Farisii tena la ne Tɔnjerema la aa cheme Yeesu sie la, ba nao kɛ o habɔteŋra la bane chɔɡ ba kii la.
Ba ta nɔɔra samɛ ɡɛ, dɛ kpɔ nɔndoŋa dɛɛ di kwa.
Ba bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa he habɔteŋra nɔ ɛɛ jo ya kii nɛɛ baa wola sarama ya naawa aa baɡle yaa ŋɔ yá sarame ya nɔɔra mɔɔ dɛɛ di kwaa nɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He nɛra haa nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
Korowii keame Aesaya na he waa bol kɛrɛdɛ kɛ waa ŋɔa ŋɔ, ‘Nɛra nɔ te, nyoa ɡbo nee baa duu mɛ, kɛ ba tea bini te ta toe.
Nɛwɛnyini mmarare taa baa baɡle ŋɔ nɛ́ra teŋɛ, anomanta, pɛɛpɛɛ baa tom mɛ.’ Korowii waa he ɡel, dɛ berɛ lawɛ he saŋ la waa bini.” Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ ba be ja ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ haa vɛh Korowii waa la bil dɛ lawɛ he saŋ la waa bini!
Mosis Mmara la bini o ŋɔ, ‘Duu he nya ne he mɛɛ,’ dɛ, ‘Nomɛlbwa waa bol o nya ne o mɛɛ bwara wechɔɡe la, a chɛ kɛ ba kpoo.’ Kɛ he te dɛ baɡle he saŋ la waane kɛŋɔ dɛ nɛn dɔ komɛl dɛ́ won kpɔ cha o nya ne o mɛɛ, dɛ ŋɔ ‘n ɛo Kɔɔban’ aa, Kɔɔban munii kɛŋɔ Korowii konee, amɔ haa sɛh ó kpɔ kon la cha o nya ne o mɛɛ kpa.
Hé kpɔ he saŋ la waa la haa dɛ baɡle la dɛɛ tɔ Korowii waa la ŋwɛnɛ.
Waa haa dɛ ɛa ken warɔ.” Yeesu yerɛ nɛra la ba o be ja dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé bwa no n be dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ kwaa nɛn aa dɛ di la laa ɡela o ɛ nɛnchɔɡe, anɔ la aa dɛ le o nyoa wɛɛ bol la, anee ɡela o ɛ nɛnchɔɡe.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna dɛ no la, ó no.” Yeesu ɡel nɛnlaa la bela dɛ ba dem, anee o habɔteŋra la bɔɔro sɛɡla la mun.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He ɡe aa a mun jemaa?
Haa jemɛ kɛ kwaa haa dɛ di aa won ɡel he ɛ nɛnchɔɡe aa?
Aa he bambile bini kaa.
He teene binii aa kaa, ásɛ dɛɛ berɛ dahara.” Yeesu aa bol waa nɔ la, o baɡlɔ kɛ kondikwaa bɛlbwa wer.
Aa won ɡel nɛn ɛ nɛnchɔɡe.
Dɛ ŋɔ, “Waa aa le nɛn bambile bini la, anee ɡela o ɛ nɛnchɔɡe.
Liichɔɡa ne jwamane, ne ŋwɛɛ ne nɛŋkpoa, ne dɔŋa haahna nyina ne kwaa ta sibeɡra, ne musu wa ne nɛra faahra, ne pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla ne kayɛɡlɛ, ne dɔŋa ŋwala ne karamani wa dɛ liire bɛ dɔe, bambile binii a le.
Anee ɡela nɛn ɛ nɛnchɔɡe.” Haah bɛl yarada dɔe wa Yeesu berɔ ir le bela kaa bwɛjen Taaya pera, dɛ ka jo dem bɛl ta, dɛ́ fee so bela tama ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ jemɛ, kɛ o ta wone sɔh.
Belaa haah bɛl kwaa aa dɛ ir o bihaah nɛɛ no Yeesu waa dɛ ba ɡuŋi o sie, dɛ soŋo ŋɔ ó doŋi kwaa la le o bihaah la nɛɛ tɛo.
Haah la ta Juu te ɛɛ, kɛ lola bini te, Siiria harɛ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Finiisia tee.
Waa wola Juu te ɛɛ la, Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ bechale di kwaa vaɡre mɔɔ nyootena ɡe di.
Aa were kɛ ba kpɔ bechale kondikwaa tɛ nyootena.” Haah la wono no a mun dɛ ŋɔ, “Kpelaa he ŋɔ, Nomoa, kɛ nyootena aa bechale kondikompuɡrere aa leera la ɡe di aa?” Yeesu ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ haa bola nɔ nomanta, kaa dem.
Kwaa la le he bihaah la nɛ.” O la dem dɛ kwaa la le o bihaah la nɛ, asɛ o chɔ mpa ta.
Yeesu chah amumu bɛl Yeesu berɔ le Taaya harɛ dɛ kpɔ Sidon ne Dekapɔles harɛ dɛ kaa Galilia Moo la ta.
Nɛra bane kpɔ baa bɛl waa wola waa no, wobol waa do kpeɡri tɛo ba Yeesu be, dɛ soŋo ŋɔ ó kpɔ o nɔn dawɛ o nɛ, ásɛ wɛɛ no wa, dɛ́ won waa bola.
Yeesu kpɔ baa la le nɛra la baah ta, o ne o ɡbo ka che bokɛre, asɛ o kpɔ o nonie do baa la deŋna bini, dɛ berɛ ta nentane dɛ kpɔ leɡe o nyondoŋe, dɛ ha sie nyiŋi nyundua dɛ hwee fuuu, dɛ ŋɔ baa la be ŋɔ, “Efata!” O munii kɛŋɔ, “Pili.” Buɡ la ta la, baa la deŋna pilo, asɛ o nyoa chaa, o won waa bola kɛrɛdɛ.
Yeesu aa chah baa la tonɛ la, o kah nɛra la ŋɔ ba bɛ nomɛlbwa be ŋɔ.
Waa dɛ kah ba la, ate taa ba ta ɛɛ bol waa la kwara.
Belaa nɛra baa noa la nyoa kpo taeh, ba ŋɔ, “O ɛ wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ, hale o ɡelɔ amumure ɛɛ no wa, dɛ won waa bola.”
Yeesu tɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banaarɛ kondikwaa ba di A ta biɡre bɛlbwa nɛnlaa bane ba cheme Yeesu sie ja, kɛ dɛ ba ta komɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ di.
Anee Yeesu yerɛ o habɔteŋra la ba o sie dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nɛra nɔ waa dɛ domɛ n tea, dɛkalkɛ n ne baa soɡa tɔpera atoroo nɔ, taraken ba ta komɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ di.
Dɛ n ɡel ba ɡɛ ba kpɔ lɔr kaa laa, baa ɡwɛɡre ŋwɛnɛ taa.
Bane ɡe le bojaŋa.” Belaa o habɔteŋra la chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ paanoo tɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ dɔŋ bá di kpɔɡ nɔ baah nɔ?” Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Paanoo aŋwɛnɛɛ he dɔɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Anuanɛ.” Belaa o ŋɔ nɛnlaa la be ŋɔ bá so harɛ, asɛ o kpɔ paanoo anuanɛ la dɛ jam Korowii dɛ mɔne do o habɔteŋra la nɔɔra ta dɛ ŋɔ bá bɔne tɛ nɛnlaa la, ba ɡe bɔne tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ ba dɔ pɛŋa tama ɡe, asɛ o kpɔa jam Korowii dɛ ŋɔ bá bɔne a ɡe tɛɛ ba.
Ba bɔnɔ tɛɛ ba, asɛ ba di dɛ vaɡre.
Anɔ la aa kaa la, ba paa a su wɛɡrɛjena anuanɛ.
Nɛra baa di kwaa la ɛɛ ɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banaarɛɛ.
Yeesu ɡelɔ ba peɡre.
O ne o habɔteŋra la jo ɡbera la bini dɛ chaɡɛ Dalmanuta pera dɛ kaa.
Belaa Farisii tena bane ba Yeesu be dɛ ba tɔŋlo dɛ daahno na dɛɛ nyin o ɛ nyokpowaane bá na dɛ́ jemɛ o waa kɛŋɔ o le Korowii be kpela.
Yeesu hweero fuuu dɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ fini nɔ nɛra ɛɛ nyin nyokpowaa dɛ́ na nɔɔ?
Kasinteŋ, maa wobɛlbwaa ɛ fini nɔ nɛra na.” Asɛ dɛ ɡel Farisii tena la bela dɛ berɛ jo ɡbera bini kaa baŋ bɛl.
Farisii ne Hɛrɔd tena webaɡla aa do kɛ iisi Yeesu habɔteŋra la soɔh, ba ta kondikwaa kpɔe, dɛ ba ɡe ta komɛlbwa dɔe ba be ɡbera la bini nemenɛ paanoo beŋkpoŋ.
Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ Farisii tena ne Hɛrɔd iisi wa.” Ba ta o sɛɡla la mun noɛ, dɛ bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ paanoo baa wola dɔe waa o ken ɛɛ bol.
Belaa Yeesu aa no waa baa dɛ bol la, o pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa hɛɛ pɛɛ dɔŋa paanoo bɛ dɔe waa nɔɔ?
Saŋ la bwa haa waa mun no mɔɔ naa?
Ɛrɛɛ he liire do toŋɡboŋ ken?
He dɔ sibie kɛ haa na naa?
He dɔ deŋna ɡe kɛ haa waa no aa?
Haa waa lii kɛɛ?
Maa mɔne paanoo anue tɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banue ba di ka la, a kabora haa paa la, wɛɡrɛre aŋwɛnɛɛ he dɔɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Fi dɛ anɛ.” O berɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Asɛ maa mɔne paanoo anuanɛ tɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banaarɛ la, wɛɡrɛ dela aŋwɛnɛ ɡee he dɔɔ?” Ba ŋɔ, “Anuanɛ.” O ŋɔ, “He ta a mun noɛ ja aa?” Yeesu chah nyoŋe bɛl Bɛtsaeda Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la Bɛtsaeda.
Asɛ nɛra bane kpɔ baa bɛl waa nyoŋa ba o be, dɛ ba soŋo ŋɔ ó kpɔ nɔn leɡe nyoŋe la ó sie pili.
Belaa Yeesu lawɛ nyoŋe la nɔn dɛ kpɔɔ le bwɛɛ la dahara dɛ ka ta nentane do o sie ta, dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He dɛ na bɔr aa?” Nyoŋe la laa sie ir dɛ ŋɔ, “N na nɛra baa valɛ, kɛ n dɛ na ba kɛ daa ken.” Yeesu berɔ kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o sie ta ja, o nyiŋi bɔr jeiih ken, dɛ a maɡrɔ, name te wɛɛ na bɔr ɡereŋ.
Asɛ Yeesu kaoh ŋɔ ó kaa o dem dɛ bɛ a waa bol tɛ nomɛlbwa bwɛɛ bini.
Pita baɡle Yeesu nɛnsoo Belaa Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la la bwɛɛre aa lɔ Sisaaria Felepae lɔɡa.
Baa dɛ kaa la, o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo nɛra ɛɛ lii mɛ nɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nɛra bane ŋɔ Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee laanee hen.
Bane ŋɔ Korowii keame Elaejaa hen.
Asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ Korowii keamere la bɛlee hen.” O berɔ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo he ɡe ɛɛ lii mɛ nɔ?” Anee Pita ŋɔ, “Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ásɛ o ba lɛ yaa laanee hen.” Yeesu kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ o waa bol baɡle nomɛlbwa.
Gɛ Yeesu aa bol o wahala nae ne o seo wa Belaa Yeesu pa mun dɛɛ baɡle o habɔteŋra la kɛ a chɛ kɛ o Nɛn Bie la na wahala kohona waa bwa ta, ásɛ nomonome ne Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema vɛoh, ásɛ ba kpoo, ásɛ a tɔpetooro wee la, ó ir seo ta.
O bol ɡɛ waa nɔ ba be kaih ken.
Anee Pita lawɔ le bokɛre dɛ kaoh ŋɔ o bɛ ɡɛ bol.
Belaa Yeesu ha sie dɛ nyiŋi o habɔteŋra la dɛ kah Pita dɛ ŋɔ, “Le n jwɛh, Bɔnsam!
Haa anla Korowii aa dɛ nyin la lii nemenɛ nɛra tetoowa.” Belaa o yerɛ nɛnlaa ne o habɔteŋra la dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ nyin kɛ ó teŋɛ n nɛ aa, ó ɡel o tetookwaa nyina, dɛ́ kpɔ o te kɛ wɛɛ sɛh wahala nae ne seo bwaa, dɛ́ ba teŋɛ n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa kpɔ daɡaɡre che bá ka kpaaro pɛl o ta la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa o sie aa swɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ kwaa ta la, wɛɛ paŋɛ o nyuu.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa koh n ne Korowii Amanesoma nɔ waa dɛ kpɔ o nyu ta la, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Dɛ nɛn dɔ harɛ nɔ ta kwaa bwa dɛ nyoɡre o nyu aa, bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ wɛɛ ba dɔe yɔ?
Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba wona kpɔ dɛ́ charɛ o nyu ɔ?
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡbo baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ nɔ, baa ba nyuu dɔ n bala tɔpere.
Naate sihiih aa dɛ kpoe n ne waa nɔ taraken nɔ la, awola Men Nɛn Bie ne nyundua toromedɛɛɡa la aa ba n Mɛɛ jirima ne la, maa he heehra ba awola tɔpere.”
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɛɛ ba di o Koraa kpeɡri nɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta, dɛ he bini bane ta soɡe le dɛ nao.” Yeesu beɡra wa Aa di tɔpera anumɛl la, Yeesu tɔ Pita ne Jems ne Jɔn sie ba ka teeh bwejen bɛl, dɛ ɡbo ka pɛ so o doa bobɛl.
Baa soɡa la, dɛ Yeesu beɡrɔ, asɛ o laala bwa to dɛɛ nyɛɡle al-al ken, dɛ to kohona ɡwaa ɡɛ baa chɛɡɛ laala a yon to la.
Ba ne ŋɔe ŋɔ ba nyiŋi dɛ Elaeja ne Mosis ja o nɛɛ ba ne wɛɛ bol wa.
Asɛ Pita ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, a wer taeh kɛŋɔ yaa lɔ bonɔ nɔ.
Gel ya do kukure atoro ásɛ he kpɔ bɛl, Mosis kpɔ bɛl, Elaeja ɡe kpɔ bɛl.” Ɔmee laɡ ba kohona dɛ ɡel Pita aa dɛ bol waa kwaraa la, dɛ waa jemɛ waa waa dɛ bol.
Belaa bam bɛl ba tɔ ba nɛ, asɛ ba no taa bɛl bam la bini kɛ, “N Bie maa dɛ nyinuu nɔ.
Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no o be.” Ba te ne taa la noe tonɛ dɛ ke nyiŋi dɛ nomɛlbwa toole bela.
Yeesu ɡboo ba na kɛŋɔ o ja ba nɛɛ bela.
Baa le bwejen la doa dɛɛ ba la, Yeesu ja ba ŋɔ, “He bɛ waa nɔ haa naa nɔ taa baɡle nomɛlbwa bwa, dɛ́ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ Men Nɛn Bie la aa sewa dɛ ir mɔɔ.” Anomanta, ba ta nomɛlbwa be ŋɔe, kɛ dɛ ba te ɡbaɡba dɛ bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Seo bini ira nɔ te munii ɛrɛ te nɔ?” Anee ba bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛ waa Tɔnjerema la ɛɛ baɡle ŋɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ Elaeja tɔ sie ba mɔɔ Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la ɡe ba nɔɔ?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Elaejaa dɛ tɔ sie ba kpela, dɛ́ ba kwaa ŋwɛnɛ mɔɔ.
Kɛ ɛrɛ waa Korowii Tɔn la ŋɔ Nɛn Bie la dɛ ba wahala nae kohona, kɛ nɛwɛnyini sie aa o tɔɡa ba laɔ?
Kasinteŋ, Elaeja balɔ dɛ kaa.
Waa bala la, ba tetooraa ba ɛo.
Gɛɛ ba chwerɛ o waa Korowii Tɔn bini la.” Yeesu chah bie bɛl kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛ Baa baa tel o habɔteŋra la kabora la be la, dɛ nɛnlaa bar ba cheme, asɛ ba ne Tɔnjerema bane ɛɛ tɔŋle wa.
Nɛra la aa na Yeesu la, ba bwara yɔrɔ, asɛ ba chwa dɛ ba jaamo.
Asɛ o bɔɔ o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he ne baa tɔŋle laɔ?” Baa bɛl le nɛra la bini dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, kwaa dɛ ir n bie nɛɛ dɛ ɡel waa won waa bol, asɛ n kpɔɔ ba he be.
A iraa, ɡɛɛ a ɡoo harɛ, ásɛ fufuɡ ɛɛ le o nyoa, dɛ o dɛ chwe o nyena, dɛ ɡbeŋri chɔ.
N soŋe he habɔteŋra la ŋɔ bá doŋi kwaa la ta, asɛ ba doŋa kahonɛ.” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Oo!
Fini nɔ nɛra wechɔɡa aa lɔ he nɛɛ nɔ, he ta yarada dɔe!
Tɔpera aŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń lawɛ bambile dɛ́ so he be mɔɔ he yarada Korowii ɔ?
Maa tɔpere bɛl dii ba he be kpa oo!
Hé kpɔ bie la ba tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ ba kpɔ bie la ba tɛo.
O kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛɛ la aa na Yeesu la, a taɡɔ ta, asɛ o chɔ dɛɛ yo ɡɛ ɡbuŋɡbuŋri te aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛɛ ɡbili bɔr bwa, dɛ fufuɡ dɛ le o nyoa.
Asɛ Yeesu bɔɔ bie la mɛɛ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo weela nɔ lawɔ wɔ?” Asɛ o mɛɛ la ŋɔ, “O bechale saŋ bwaa a lawɔ.
Kwaa la ir o nɛɛ aa, dɛ a dɛ nyin o kpoe.
Tɔpebɛla a taɡɔ dɛɛ ta nii ta, tɔpebɛla ɡe a taɡɔ dɛɛ ta nee ta.
Dɛ hɛɛ wonoo chaoh waa, na ya sum dɛ́ chaoh tɛ yaa.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ wonoo chaoh waa, a lɔ he be.
Nɛn waa yarada Korowii la, Korowii won wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ́ tɛo.” Buɡ la ta, dɛ baa la sɛoh takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “N yaradao, kɛ n yarada aa kanɛ.
Cha mɛ ń yaradao kohona.” Asɛ Yeesu aa baa na kɛŋɔ nɛra wuro dɛɛ ba ba tɔ ba nɛɛ la, o den kɔr kwaa aa dɛ ir bie la nɛɛ la ŋɔ, “He konchɔɡa haa dɛ ir bie nɔ nɛɛ waa wola waa no, waa berɛ won dɛɛ bol waa ɡe nɔ, n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ hé le o nɛ!
He bɛ o nɛɛ ba so kpa bwa!” Ate, dɛ kwaa la sio kpeɡri ne dɛ taɡɛ bie la ta harɛ, asɛ o chɔ dɛɛ yo kɛŋɔ ɡbuŋɡbuŋri te ken mɔɔ a le o nɛ.
Anee o chɔ kɛŋɔ waa sewa ken.
Asɛ nɛra kɛrɛdɛ ŋɔ o sewɔ.
Belaa Yeesu lawɛ o nɔn o ir.
Yeesu aa ba dem a ka o ne o habɔteŋra la ɡbo la, ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa ya te aa wola wone kɔr kwaa la a le nɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Korowii soŋa ɡboo won a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ doŋa.” O ne o habɔteŋra la le bela dɛ kpɔ Galilia harɛ ta kaa.
Dɛ waa nyin kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa jemɛ bela waa lole, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o dɛ baɡle o habɔteŋra la wa, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ba dɛ ba Men Nɛn Bie lee do nɛra nɔn ta, ásɛ ba kpo mɛ, ásɛ a tɔpetooro wee la, ń ir seo ta.” Dɛ ba ta Yeesu waa waa bola la mun noɛ, kɛ dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ bá bɔɔro a mun.
Nɛn wáa ɛ nomoa wepɛɛra Asɛ ba ba Kapeeneɔm.
Baa baa jo dea la, Yeesu bɔɔ o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he tɔŋle ŋwɛnɛ ta laɔ?” Ba ta wone chaŋo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba dɛ nyin bá jemɛ ba bini onɔ la wáa ɛ ba bwa nomoa, dɛɛ di a ɡɛ tɔŋla.
Asɛ Yeesu so harɛ dɛ yer ba dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Naate waa dɛ nyin kɛ o ɛ he bwa nomoa la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ o te bechala dɛɛ tomɛ heya.” Anee o lawɛ bechajeɡa bɛl ba che ba baah ta, dɛ kpɔɔ, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa koh n waa dɛ nyiŋi bie nɔ dɔŋ nɛɛ la, dɛ menee o nyiŋi la.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa nyiŋi n nɛɛ la, dɛ n ɡbo laa o nyiŋi.
Dɛ naate waa tom mɛ la nɛɛ o nyiŋi la.” Nomɛlbwa waa wola ya nɛɛ cheɡɛ ɛ ya som Jɔn ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya na baa bɛl waa kpɔ he sɔn dɛɛ doŋi kwaa nɛra nɛ, asɛ ya kaoh ŋɔ ó ɡel, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta ya bini bɛl ɛɛ.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “He bɛ on kah ŋɔ ó ɡel, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won che n sɔn ta ɛ a ɡɛ nyokpowaa nɔ dɔŋa dɛ́ berɛ yerɛ n sɔnchɔɡe kpa.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola ya nɛɛ cheɡɛɛ la, dɛ ya somee.
Kasinteŋ, nomɛlbwa waa koh kɛ he ɛ men Kristo nɛra dɛ́ tɛ heyaa nee hé nyɔ la, waa o kembɔr paŋa ba bwa.
Nɛra neɡra bá ɛ wechɔɡa Nomɛlbwa waa neɡre bechajeɡre nɔ dɔŋ bɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada mɛ nɔ ásɛ o ɛ wechɔɡa la, dɛ ba fe vɔwɛ nambwe do o baŋa dɛ kpɔɔ ka ta mpo vil ta kwaraa fe bɔ.
-Dɛ he nɔn ɛɛ neɡree he ɛ wechɔɡa aa, teŋo ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he kpoŋe nɔmbeŋkpoŋ dɛ dɔ Korowii be kaa bɔ haa kpoŋe nɔɔra anɛ dɛ kaa Bɔnsam nii aa wola dime bwa la ta.
-Dɛ he nakpala ɡe ɛɛ neɡree he ɛ wechɔɡa aa, teŋo ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ he nakpale teŋno he dɔ Korowii be kaa laa, a bɔ kɛŋɔ haa dɔ nakpale anɛ dɛ kaa Bɔnsam nii ta.
Dɛ he siwi ɡe ɛɛ ɡeloo he ɛ wechɔɡa aa, fomo ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he kpoŋe siwi beŋkpoŋ dɛ ja Korowii Kora ta bɔ kɛŋɔ, haa kpoŋe sibie anɛ dɛ kaa Bɔnsam nii ta, belaa ‘dudule aa dɛ di ba ola la aa wola sewɛ bwa, nii aa dɛ fuuh ba la ɡe aa dime bwa.’ Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ niinii ɛ nɛra bwa kɛŋɔ ba yon kpɔ yar merɛ kwaa ta la.
Yeesu kpɔ o habɔteŋra maɡɛ yar Yar wer.
Kɛ dɛ aa somɛ kpa aa, ɛrɛɛ baa ba a ɛɛ á do som jaɔ?
Anomanta, hé ne he dɔŋa so kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ do som ɡɛ yar aa soma la.
Hé ɡel he nyoa pɛ.”
Baa ne haah dɔŋa vɛɛh wa Asɛ Yeesu le bela dɛ la Juda harɛ ta, dɛ ka le Jɔɔdan Moo la baŋ.
Nɛndamanta wur dɛ ba tɔ o nɛɛ ja, asɛ o baɡ ba waa ɡɛ o yon dɛɛ ɛ la.
Farisii tena bane ba bela dɛ baa haɡro bela dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin dɛ́ lawɔ.
Ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Mmara dɛ tɛ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ baa vɛh o haah naa?” Anee o ɡe berɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ Mosis Mmara baɡle heyaa laɔ?” Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Mosis tɛ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ baa chwerɛ tɔn dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ o vɛh o haah, dɛ́ vɛoh.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bambikpeɡ waa Mosis chwerɛ a ɡɛ Mmara nɔ tɛ heyaa la.
Gɛ laa a fa do wubwa.
Korowii aa ta kwaa bwa mumpar la, ‘Baa ne haahnee o ta.
A waa baa ɛɛ ba o nya ne o mɛɛ jwɛɛh lee, dɛ́ kpɔ o te ka pɛl o haah, ásɛ ba nɛra banɛ la pɛ ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ la.
Anomanta, baa nɛra banɛ ɛɛ ba kpa, ba pɛo ɛ beŋkpoŋ.’ Dɛ Korowii lawɛ nɛra banɛ pɛ aa, ŋwɛnɛ toole kɛŋɔ nɛn berɛ pere ba baah kpa.” Baa la dem la, o habɔteŋra la berɔ bɔɔro a ɡɛ waa nɔ ja.
Asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh o haah dɛ ka mo onfale la, dɛ o ɛ o haah la wechɔɡa dɛ bɔ jwamane.
Dɛ haah ɡe vɛh o jaa dɛ ka yalɛ banfale aa, dɛ o ɡe ɛ o jaa la wechɔɡa dɛ bɔ jwamane.” Yeesu swee bechale bane andɛɛɡa Dɛ nɛra bane kpɔ ba bii dɛɛ ba Yeesu be ŋɔ ó kpɔ o nɔn dawɛ ba nɛ.
Asɛ o habɔteŋra la kɔɡre nɛra la ŋɔ bá kpɔ ba bii la le le!
Yeesu aa na ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛ la, o baah di ba nɛ, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ bii la ŋwɛnɛ tɔ.
Hé ɡel ba ba n be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ banɔ dɔŋa nɔɔ Korowii koobii la.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, naate waa wola o te kpɔe tɛ Korowii dɛ yaradao ɡɛ bechala aa dɛ ɛ la, waa bɔree dɔ dɛ ba ja o Kora la ta.” Asɛ o kpɔ bii la, dɛ kpɔ o nɔɔra dawɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ swee ba andɛɛɡa.
Baa bɛl waa ɛ dɔɔh wa Yeesu aa bera dɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ ta lee dɛ kaa la, baa bɛl chwao dɛ ba ɡuŋi o sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomondɛɛɡe, ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ ń ɛ dɛ́ dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa nɔ?” Anee Yeesu bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he yer mɛ nɛndɛɛɡe nɔɔ?
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe.
Korowii ɡbosoo ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe.
Kɛ he jemɛ Korowii Mmarare laɔ?
Anee, ‘Bɛ nɛn kpo, bɛ jwamane bɔ, bɛ ŋwɛ, bɛ nyosone teŋe dawɛ he dɔŋ nɛ, bɛ he dɔŋ faah, dɛɛ duu he nya ne he mɛɛ.’ ” Anee o ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n bechale saŋ bwaa n le dɛ teŋɛ anɔ bwa ta.” Yeesu nyiŋu, o sie lɛ o nɛ, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “A ka he webeŋkpoŋ.
La ka yoɡ kwaa haa dɔa bwa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ a suuɡa kɛ nyaara.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, hɛɛ dɔ kondɔɔh cheɡ Korowii doa.
Ka ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ dɛ ba teŋɛ n nɛ.” Yeesu aa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, ate dɛ o tea bini chɔɡɔ, asɛ o berɛ ɡure nyu su, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o dɔ kwaa kɛrɛdɛ.
Asɛ Yeesu ke nyiŋi o habɔteŋra la dɛ ŋɔ, “Aa do kpeɡrii tɛ dɔɔhna kɛŋɔ bá dɔ bɔr ja Korowii Kora la ta.” A ɡɛ waa la Yeesu aa bola la ɡelɔ o habɔteŋra la bwara yɔr.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Biiwa, a kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nɛn dɔ bɔr ja Korowii Kora la ta.
Aa do pwɛree tɛ nyoɡma kɛŋɔ ó won jo tɔɔɡe bɔɔ ta, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ dɔɔh naa wona ja Korowii Kora la ta.” Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ la, dɛ o habɔteŋra la bwa bwara yɔrɔ, asɛ baa bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Amɔ te, umee dɛɛ ba o nyu dɔe yɔ?” Belaa Yeesu pa sie nyiŋ ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bee a do kpeɡri, kɛ Korowii be te, wobɛlbwa aa kpeɡe.
Wobɛlbwa pwɛre Korowii be.” Belaa Pita ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na, ya te ɡel komɛlbwa yaa dɔa dɛ ba teŋɛ he nɛ.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, nomɛlbwa waa koh n ne Amanesoma nɔ waa dɛ ɡel o bwɛɛ tena ne o nimanar ne o dɔɔranar ne o nahaahnanar, ne o nya ne o mɛɛ, ne o bii dɛ o kooni la, wɛɛ dɔ a ɡɛ bwɛɛre ne nimanar ne dɔɔranar ne nyawa ne bii, dɛ kooni nɔ bɛlbwa kembɔree kera lafa harɛ nɔ ta, dɛ́ ja hɔhɔrɔwa nɛra aa dɛ ba o haeh dɛ́ ɛo la ta.
A bwa habɔɔ la, wɛɛ dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe ɡee nyundua ja.
Nɛra baa tɔ sie ɡalɡa ɛɛ ba ka munii, ásɛ nɛra baa ka mun ɡe ɡalɡa ba tɔ sie.” Yeesu berɔ bol o seo waa toorotena Dɛ ba lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa Jerusalam, asɛ Yeesu tɔ ba sie.
Dɛ o habɔteŋra la bwara yɔrɔ, asɛ nɛra baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la bwa ɡee ɔmɛ.
Asɛ Yeesu berɛ lawɛ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la kaa bokɛre, dɛ ka taa waa aa dɛ ba o ɛɛ la bwa baɡ ba, dɛ ŋɔ, “Yaa dɛ kaa Jerusalam nɔ, baa ka le Men Nɛn Biee tɛ Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema la.
Baa pa mɛ bolchɔɡee dɛ́ ŋɔ bá kpo mɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ do nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la nɔn ta.
Baa di n loroo, dɛ́ tata nentane ta n nɛ, dɛ chacha mɛ chweremi, dɛ́ kpaa mɛ pɛl daɡaɡre ta, dɛ́ kpo mɛ.
Kɛ a tɔpetooro wee mɛɛ berɔɔ ir seo ta.” Jems ne Jɔn Yeesu soŋa Asɛ Sebedii bii Jems ne Jɔn ba o be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya dɛ nyin he ɛ waane tɛ yaa.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa yɔ?” Belaa ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “He baa di he kora waa dɔ jirima dɛ so he kookara ta naa, ya dɛ nyin kɛ he ɡel ya so pɛle, bɛl so he diɡ ta, bɛl ɡe so he ɡal ta.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Haa waa haa dɛ bol nɔ mun jemɛ.
Hɛɛ wonoo nyɔ n tɛɡkpela maa dɛ ba nyɔe nɔ ane aa?
Hɛɛ wonoo na hɔhɔrɔwa maa dɛ ba nae nɔ dɔŋa aa?” Anee ba sɛh ŋɔ, “Yaa wonoo.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kpelaa!
Hɛɛ nyɔ n tɛɡkpela nɔ anee dɛ́ na n hɔhɔrɔwa nɔ dɔŋa.
Kɛ n ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ kpɔ nɛn so n diɡ ne n ɡal ta.
Korowii ɡboo jemɛ nɛra waa kwaa a ɡɛ bɔra la cheɡ dɛ́ kpɔ ba ka so bela.” Yeesu habɔteŋra kabora la aa baa no a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba baah di Jems ne Jɔn nɛ.
Anomanta, Yeesu yerɛ ba bwa ba o be dɛ ŋɔ, “He jemɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la te, ba nomonome dɛ di kpeɡri ba nɛ, dɛ yon ɡel baa tom ba.
Kɛ ɡɛ laa chɛ kɛŋɔ á do he te be.
Dɛ he bini bɛl dɛ nyin ó ɛ he bwa nomoa aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ o te ɛ bechala dɛɛ tomɛ heya.
Dɛ he bini bɛl dɛ nyin ó ɛ o te sitɔɔ raa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó sɛh dɛ́ berɛ o te kɛ he bwa bonɔɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Men Nɛn Bie kwaraa ta balɛ kɛ nɛ́ra baa tom mɛ.
N te balɔ dɛ́ ba tomɛ nɛwɛnyini, dɛ́ kpɔ n nyu charɛ nɛndamanta mkpa.” Yeesu chah Baatemeos o won dɛɛ na Ba ba bwɛjen Jeriko, asɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la ne nɛnlaa bane aa le bela dɛɛ kaa la, dɛ Temeos binyoŋe Baatemeos o yon dɛɛ soŋe kwaa saŋ bɛlbwa la soɡe ŋwɛnɛ la keŋkeŋ.
Waa noa kɛŋɔ Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt laanee la, dɛ o dɛ yerɛ Yeesu takpeɡ ne dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Devid Naa Yeesu, na n sum!” Asɛ nɛra kɛrɛdɛ kaoh ŋɔ ó tɔ nyoa.
Kɛ o ta ban chaŋɛ.
Namee o ta do lɔŋɔ kohona dɛɛ yerɛ, “Devid Naa Yeesu, na n sum!” Anee Yeesu jaɡɛ che, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé yerɔ.” Asɛ ba yerɛ nyoŋe la dɛ ŋɔ, “Sɔɔh bwara dɛ ir!
O dɛ yerɛ.” Asɛ o wur o yal viɡri, dɛ jah ir che dɛ ba Yeesu be.
Belaa Yeesu bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa he ŋɔ ń ɛ tɛɛ nɔ?” Asɛ nyoŋe la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n dɛ nyin ń won dɛɛ na.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kaa.
He yarada haa yarada mɛ la ɡelɔ he dɔ bokpeɡa.” Buɡ la ta, dɛ o wono dɛɛ na, dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta.
Yeesu jo Jerusalam jirima ne Baa dɛ tel Jerusalam dɛɛ bɛne Bɛtfej ne Bɛtani la, Ɔlevere Bwejen la bɔr bela la, o tomɛ o habɔteŋra la banɛ ŋɔ bá tɔ sie, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé la bwɛɛ nɔ waa lɔ he sie nɔ ta.
Haa dɛɛ tel bela la, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ baa vɔwɛ keeɡo bie bɛl baa wola o ta soɡe bwa.
Hé laa pur dɛ́ kpɔɔ ba.
Ásɛ dɛ nomɛl bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ bɔkwaa hɛɛ ba o ne ɛɛ yaa, hé ŋɔ he Dɔɔ dɛ nyinu dɛ́ ɛ waane, ásɛ dɛ berɛ kpɔ ba taraken.” Asɛ ba la dɛ ka na keeɡo bie bɛl baa lawɔ vɔwɛ ŋwɛnɛ nyoa doonyoa bɛl jwɛh.
Baa dɛ puru la, nɛra baa cheɡɛ bela la bane bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa he pur keeɡo bie la dɛ́ɛ ɛɔ?” Asɛ ba bol ɡɛ Yeesu aa ŋɔa bá bol la, asɛ nɛra la tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ.
Ba kpɔ keeɡo bie la ba tɛ Yeesu dɛ pa ba yale darawe o habɔɔ, asɛ Yeesu so o ta.
Nɛndamanta tɛo jirima dɛ pa ba yale pa ŋwɛnɛ ta, asɛ bane ɡe kɛ papooni bela kooni la ta, dɛ pa ŋwɛnɛ la bwa ta.
Dɛ nɛra baa tɔ Yeesu sie ne banɔ la baa ka mun la bwa dɛ si, “Woowo!
Korowii swee naate waa valɛ o sɔn ta dɛɛ ba nɔ andɛɛɡa!
Korowii swee ya Naa Devid kora nɔ waa dɛ ba ira ja nɔ andɛɛɡa!
Korowii jam!” Yeesu la Jerusalam dɛ ka jo Korowii Dea bini dɛ nyinyiŋi waa aa dɛ ɛ bela la bwa.
Bɔr aa dɛ jo la nomanta, o ne o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la kaa Bɛtani.
Yeesu taah fiɡ daa bɛl Tɔɔ aa pera, ba le Bɛtani dɛɛ ba la, dɛ lɔr lawɛ Yeesu.
O na fiɡ bɛl bojaŋ dɛ o moɡɛ papooni sukuu ken, dɛ fe la o mun ŋɔ o ken fe ɛɛ dɔ o nɔna anee di kɛɛ?
Waa tel bela la dɛ papooni ɡboo tɔ daa la bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ pure nɔna ta tele mɔɔ.
Belaa Yeesu taah fiɡ daa la ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa aa he nɔna dii ba kpa bwa.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o habɔteŋra la noɔ.
Baa tel Jerusalam la, Yeesu jo Korowii Dea bobɛl dɛɛ doŋi kon-yoɡra ne kon-yarawa baa lɔ bela la.
O berɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛɛ peɡri suuɡa la teeburre bwa piiɡi, dɛ taɡɛ banɔ la baa dɛ yoɡ borɔnomare la bwa kane ta.
O ta sɛɛh nomɛlbwa kpɔ bone bɛlbwa kpɔ Korowii Dea dembaahna la bini.
Asɛ o bol waa dɛɛ baɡ ba ŋɔ, “Ba ta chwerɛ ŋɔ, ‘Baa yerɛ n Dea harɛre nɛra bwa Korowii soŋebɔr’ yaa?
Gɛɛ he te berɛ kpɔɔ berɛ ŋwɛɛra sɔɔhbɔr aa?” Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema la aa no a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, belaa ba pa mun dɛɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ kpo Yeesu.
Dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o webaɡla dɛ kpo nɛra bwa nyoa.
Bɔr aa ba dɛ jo la, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la le bwɛjen la ta.
Fiɡ dahole wehwela wa A tɔɔ aa pera chɔmbibi ne ba valɛ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la, ba kaa le fiɡ daa la ta, dɛ o sewɔ kwaraa le o nyundua ka le o lune bwa ta.
Belaa Pita lii ɡɛ aa ɛa mɔɔ daa la sewɛ la, dɛ ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, na.
Fiɡ daa la haa taahno la sewɔ!” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé yarada Korowii.
Kasinteŋ, nomɛlbwa waa won kpɔ yarada ŋɔ bwe nɔ be ŋɔ ó ir ka le mpo ta, waa wola tɔŋlɛ o bambile ta tamaa bɛlbwa, dɛ yarada kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ wonoo ɛ ɡɛ la, aa ɛo tɛo kpela ɡe.
Anomanta, kasinteŋ, dɛ he dɛ soŋe Korowii komɛl aa, hé yarada kɛŋɔ he dɔɔ dɔ kon la.
Dɛ he wono yarada ɡɛ naa, komɛlbwa haa soŋe la, Korowii ɛɛ tɛ heyaa.
-Dɛ he iro che dɛɛ soŋe Korowii ɡe aa, wobɛlbwa he bala bane aa ɛ heyaa la, hé kpɔ kɛ ba ásɛ he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la ɡe kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛ heya.” Kpeɡri Yeesu aa dɔa dɛɛ ɛ wa wepɛɛre Asɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra berɛ ba jo Jerusalam ja.
Yeesu aa ba dɛ valɛ Korowii Dea la bini la, Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema ne bela nomonome la ba o be dɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Umee tɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ hé ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ haa dɛ ɛ nɔɔ?
Umee tɛɛ kpeɡri kwaraa te nɔ?” Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Ń bɔɔ heyaa webeŋkpoŋ, dɛ he wono jemaa, mɛɛ baɡle heyaa naate waa tɛ mɛ kpeɡrii mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Umee tɛ Jɔn kpeɡri wɛɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee laɔ?
Korowiirii tɛo waa, kɛ nɛwɛnyinii tɛo wɔ?
Hé baɡ mɛ naate.” Ate, dɛ ba ɡboɡbo dɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ŋɔe yɔ?
Dɛ ya ŋɔ Korowiirii tɛo waa, wɛɛ ŋɔɔ, ‘Aah ɛrɛɛ haa wola Jɔn yaradae yɔ?’ Kɛ dɛ ya ŋɔ nɛwɛnyinii tɛo ɡe aa, aa werii do.” Dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ ba ɡbaɡba nɛra la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ nomɛlbwa yaradao kɛŋɔ Korowii keamee Jɔn.
Anomanta, ba waa baa bola laanee kɛŋɔ, “Yaa jemɛ.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa wola jemɛ la, ɡɛɛ n ɡe aa wola heyaa naate waa tɛ mɛ kpeɡri mɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ maa dɛ ɛ nɔɔ baɡle.”
Nɛra baa dɛ daah koo sɛɡla Yeesu kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa baɡle nɛra la dɛ ŋɔ, “Baa bɛlee fa lole dɛɛ parɛ daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen. O ke a ɡɛ koo la, dɛ kwaa bɔr baa dɛɛ harame a nee dɛɛ do, dɛ chiɡri jɛŋla bela, bá so o ta dɛɛ daah koo la, dɛ kpɔ nɛra báa ɛ koo la toma, a koma telaa, bá dɔ ba bɔr.
A habɔɔ la, o kpɔ koo la tɛɛ ba bá nyiŋi o ta tɛo, dɛ kaa harɛ bɛl ta.
A koma saŋ aa baa tel la, o tomɛ o bonɔɔ bɛl ŋɔ ó ka lɛ o dibɔr ba tɛo.
Bonɔɔ la aa laŋa la, nɛra la lawɔ dɛ lɔɔro dɛ doŋu o kaa.
Ba ta on komɛlbwa tɛɛ o kaa.
Koote la berɔ tomɛ o bonɔn-nɛɛte, asɛ ba lɔɔ o ɡe dɛ doo bol o nyu ta dɛ ɛo wilewile ken.
Asɛ koo te la berɛ tomɛ o bonɔɔna la bɛl ja, asɛ nɛra la lawɔ dɛ kpoo.
Gɛɛ o tomɛ toroma bane ja, asɛ ba lɔɔ bane dɛ kpo bane ɡe.
Dɛ nɛn waa kaa ó tomɛ bwaa o ɡbaɡba bie waa dɛ nyinu ɡwaa komɛlbwa.
O bonɔɔna la bwa aa baa tonɛ la, o bie laanee o ka mun tomɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ba na n bie nɔ te naa, baa heehroo.’ Nɛra la aa na o bie la la, ba den ŋɔ, ‘Yoowa, baa la ɡbaɡba biee la.
O mɛɛ toole naa, on dɛɛ ba o kapɛrɛ dii.
Hé ɡel ya kpoo, ásɛ dɛ o mɛɛ baa sewaa, dɛ kwaa la ɛ ya kwa.’ Ba lawɛ bie la dɛ kpoo dɛ kpɔɔ viɡri koo la baŋ.” Asɛ Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ a ɡɛ koo te nɔ ɛɛ ɛɔ wɔ?
Wɛɛ ba kpoo a ɡɛ nɛra laanee, dɛ́ kpɔ koo la do nɛnfala nɔn ta.
Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn la bini ŋɔ, ‘Bwe la mamaala aa vɛoh dɛ liiru konsala laanee bera ba lawɛ dea la kpoŋe la.
Korowiirii ɡela a ɛ ɡɛ, asɛ a ɛ yaa nyokpowa.’ He ta a ɡɛ waa nɔ kure ka aa?” Yeesu aa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ kpɔ sɛɡle la, dɛ Juu tena nomonome la dɛ́ nyin bɔr dɛ́ lawɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ banee o sɛɡle.
Kɛ dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ nɛnlaa baa lɔ bela la, dɛ ɡelo dɛ kaa.
Toɔ bɔe wepɛɛre Baa kaala la, ba kaa tomɛ Farisii tena ne Hɛrɔd habɔɔ tena bane ŋɔ bá ba haɡre Yeesu bela wepɛɛre ne dɛ́ lawɔ.
Asɛ ba ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ he dɛ bol kasinteŋ.
He ta waa bolɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ a habɔɔ kɛŋɔ a dɛ do bane som, kɛɛ a dɛ we bane bambile nɔ.
Haa nɛra siebɔr nyiŋi dɛɛ bol waa kɛŋɔ bɛl ɛ kooro kɛɛ nomoa kɛɛ bechala nɔ.
Korowii ŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ baɡle nɛra kasinteŋ ne.
Webeŋkpoŋii yaa nyin ya jemɛ.
Onee kɛŋɔ ya Mmara nɔ dɛ tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ yá bɔ toɔ dɛ́ɛ tɛ Rom Koojen Siisa la aa, kɛɛ waa yaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ?” Dɛ Yeesu jemɛ ba wepɛɛre la mun dɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ haɡre mɛ bela nɔɔ?
Hé kpɔ suuɡa bwe ba ń na.” Anee ba kpɔ bɛl tɛo, asɛ o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ume nyu ne o sɔnee dawɛ suuɡa nɔ ta nɔɔ?” Asɛ ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Koojen Siisa laanee.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Oo.
Amɔ hé kpɔ kwaa aa ɛ Koojen Siisa kwaa la tɛo, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa aa ɛ Korowii kwaa la tɛ Korowii.” Asɛ o waa ɛɛ ba anebɛlbwa.
Seo ta ira wepɛɛre Anee Saduki tena ba Yeesu be.
Dɛ baa yarada kɛŋɔ nɛn sewaa, wɛɛ berɔɔ ir ja.
Ba baa bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Nomoa, Mosis fa chwerɛ Mmara bɛl tɛ yaa ŋɔ, dɛ baa sewɔ ɡel o haah dɛ ba ta bii dɔe yaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ o nime kɛɛ o dɔɔ kpɔ haah la mo dɛ́ loɡle bii, ásɛ a ɡɛ bii la ɛ lale la bii.
Hahbeŋkpoŋ bibaala banuanɛɛ fa lole, asɛ o binomoa la ba mo haah dɛ ba sewɛ, dɛ o ta bie dɔe.
Asɛ onla waa teŋɛ binomoa la nɛɛ la ɡe kpɔ haah la mo dɛ ba sewɛ, dɛ o ɡe ne o ta bie lolɛ.
Gɛɛ bitoorote la ɡe mo haah la dɛ ba sewɛ, dɛ o ta bie dɔe.
Bii la bwa mo haah la ka lɔ nyoa dɛ ba serewe, dɛ ba ta bii dɔe.
A bwa habɔɔ la, haah la ɡe baa sewɛ.
Aah dɛ nɛra bwa seo bini ira tɔpere la baa tel asɛ bibaala la bwa ir aa, ba bini umee dɛɛ ba haah la jaa ɛɛ yɔ?
Ba nɛra banuanɛ la bwa ɡee fa moo.” Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He kono kwaraa!
Haa wola Korowii Waa baa chwera ne o kpeɡri waa jemɛ la waa.
Nɛra baa ir seo ta naa, baa soo kɛŋɔ nyundua toroma, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa haahna moe ba, baa jaranar ɡe yala ba.
Nɛra seo ta ira ɡe la nɔ, dɛ he dɛ lii Mosis Tɔn bini waa ane aa dɛ baɡle dawii fuih la wa aa, ba chwerɛ bela ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, ‘Menee Korowii he nabaala Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tomɔ la aa?’ Lala laa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii, weeraa dɛɛ tomɔ.
Anomanta, he kono kwaraa!” Korowii Mmarare la bini onjen Dɛ Tɔnjereme bɛl ɡe ba bela dɛɛ no waa baa dɛ pɛɛro wɛɛ baɡle a bini la, dɛ na kɛŋɔ waa la ŋwɛnɛ taa Yeesu bola la.
O ɡe bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Mosis Mmarare la bini umee ɛ onjen ɡwaa a bwa nɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “A bwa bini onjen laanee nɔ, ‘Israel tena, hé no.
N Naa Korowii nɔ habɔɔ Dɔɔ bɛlbwa toole kpa.
Hé nyin N Naa Korowii he bambile bwa, he hweera, he liire, ne he bokpeɡa bwa ne.’ Onjen waa teŋa nɛɛ laanee nɔ.
‘Nyin he dɔŋ kɛ he ɡbaɡba.’ Mmara bɛlbwa toole dɛ ɛ onjen dɛ ɡwaa anɛ nɔ.” Asɛ Tɔnjereme la ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Jam, he ɛ wa, Nomoa.
He waa nɔ bwa ɛ kasinteŋ.
Korowii beŋkpoŋ ɡboo lole.
Komɛlbwa toole dɛ dɔ yaa ka ja o nɛ.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ yá nyinu ya bambile ne ya liire ne ya bokpeɡa bwa ne, dɛ́ nyin ya dɔŋa kɛŋɔ yaa dɛ nyin ya ɡbaɡba la.
A ɡɛ mmarare anɛ nɔ ta teŋaa wera ɡwaa ɡɛ bwa yaa kpoo kwaa dɛ fuah dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, dɛ che kwaa kaa tɛo.” Yeesu aa naa kɛŋɔ baa la chaŋe waa la wejema ne la, o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He sie dɛ chaah Korowii Kora waa la ta.” A habɔɔ la, nomɛlbwa ta berɛ hɛlɛ waa dɛ bɔɔro waane kpa.
Kristo la wepɛɛre Yeesu aa ba dɛ baɡle waa Korowii Dea la, o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛ waa Tɔnjerema la ŋɔ Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ásɛ o ba lɛ yaa la ɛɛ ɛ Devid naa nɔɔ?
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe fa ir Devid nɛɛ dɛ ɡel o baɡle Kristo waa dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii ŋɔ n Dɔɔ be ŋɔ ó ba so nomombɔr o diɡ ta ka tel kɛŋɔ waa ba o dɔma ne harɛ ásɛ o tiɡri ba nɛ.’ Aah Devid kwaraa fa aa dɛ yerɔ o dɔɔ nɔ, ɛrɛɛ a berɛ ɛ o ɛ Devid naa ɔ?” Nɛnlaa la no o wobol la silɛɛ ne.
Waa dɛ baɡ ba la, o ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi Tɔnjerema la kɛrɛdɛ.
Ban yon do laalajena ásɛ nɛra bwa na ba dɛɛ ɡuŋ ba harɛ yaware ta la.
Ba dɛ nyin nomombɔra soɡa kohona cheremi deene, ne nomombɔra soɡa tɔpejena dii cheremibɔra la.
Ba sie beɡre kwa, dɛɛ kam kwaa luhaahna deremi, dɛ berɛ saah dɛɛ soŋe Korowii wobojaŋa ne nɛra sie ta.
Ba kembɔr ɛɛ do kanee taeh!” Luhaah bɛl suuɡa tae wa Yeesu kaa so Korowii Dea suuɡa tae daka bɔr dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa ta suuɡa dɛɛ do o bini la, dɛ dɔɔhna bane dɛ do suuɡajena tenten.
Belaa luhaah nyaa bɛl ɡe ba do suuɡa bwejeɡre anɛ.
Asɛ Yeesu yerɛ o habɔteŋra la dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, luhaah nyaa nɔ do suuɡajena dɛ ɡwaa nɛra nɔ bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o dea suuɡa bwaa o ɡbaa ba do daka nɔ bini la.
Kɛ dɔɔhna la te suuɡa bini tama baa naa kɛŋɔ ba laa kpɔ aa, aa ba nɛɛ we la, anee ba kpɔ baa do la.”
Gɛ Yeesu aa bol Korowii Dea chɔɡa wa Yeesu aa dɛ le Korowii Dea la, o habɔteŋra la bɛl ŋɔ, “Nomoa, na bwea baa kpɔa ma deene nɔ aa bara ɡɛ.
Deene la kakan bee!
A wer ɡe laa nɔ!” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kɛ he na dejena nɔ kenɛ?
Ba ta ɛɛ paɡre a bwaa kwara, ásɛ a bwe beŋkpoŋ kwara aa lee do dɛ́ ta chɔŋɛ o dɔŋ ta kpa.” Yeesu baɡle o habɔteŋra wahala baa na kerekere Asɛ Yeesu so Ɔlevere Bwejen la doa dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea la, asɛ Pita ne Jems ne Jɔn dɛ Andriu ɡbo ba o be, dɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Waa la haa bola la, saŋ besoo aa ba chiɡa ɔ?
Bɔkwaa dɛɛ ba baɡla kɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡa teloo?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ heyaa neɡre.
Nɛra ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ kpɔ n sɔn ba dɛ́ ba ŋɔ banee men.
Ba bɛlbwa ɛɛ ŋɔɔ onee Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ nɛra la, dɛ́ neɡre nɛra pirim.
Dɛ he baa no laa yoi waa ne laa ɡbɔɡa bobɛlbwa ɡe aa, he bɛ ɡel a ɛ heyaa wepiɡra, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ á ɛ ɡɛ.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa chɛ kɛŋɔ á chiɡ, dɛ wobɛlbwa jaɡa la ta tele mɔɔ.
Harɛre ane ɛɛ yo dɔŋaa, koranar ɡe yo dɔŋa.
Lɔr ɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwaa, ásɛ harɛ ɡe ɛɛ jiɡri bobɛlbwa.
Kɛ anɔ bwa do kɛŋɔ haah loltea yon tɔ sie lɔɔ dɛ o lola ta tele mɔɔ la.
Hé ɡbaɡba ɡe nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.
Baa larawe heyaa dɛ la he ne nomonome sie, dɛ́ lɔɔ heyaa cheremi deene bini.
Men nomanta hɛɛ che Abane nomonome ne koranar siinii dɛ́ bol Korowii Amanesoma la baɡ ba.
Baa bol Amanesoma laanee baɡle nɛwɛnyina bwa mɔɔ wobɛlbwa jaɡa la ba.
Dɛ ba baa lawɛ heya, dɛ la he ne nomonome sie naa, he bɛ ɡel waa haa dɛ ba bola la hiah heya.
A baa tel kɛŋɔ hé bol wa aa, hé bol wobɛlbwa aa le he nyoa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ waa haa dɛ ba bola la aa he bee le.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la bee aa ba lee.
Nɛra ɛɛ le ba ɡbaɡba lolanaree tɛ bá kpoo ba, baala le ba bii tɛ bá kpoo ba, ásɛ bechale ɡe ir che ba nyare ne mɛɛnanar nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel baa kpoo ba.
Nɛra bwa ɛɛ koh n waa hah heya.
Kɛ naate waa dɛ ba wona dɛ́ lawɛ bambile ka tonɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Hɛɛ na konchɔɡechɔɡe waa dɛ paɡre bwɛɛ laanee kɛŋɔ o cheɡɛ bela aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba nao.
Bonɔ kpeɡri.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa kuro la kwaa nyiŋu kɛrɛdɛ.
He baa na ɡɛ naa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ Juda harɛ tena chwa ka nyin sɔɔhbɔr ba bwea la ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa soɡe saldoa ɡe, o bɛ berɛ koh o te ŋɔ o dɛ tu dɛ́ jo dea dɛ́ ka kpɔ komɛl kpa.
Nomɛlbwa waa lɔ koo ta bɛ berɛ ŋɔ o dɛ kaa dem dɛ́ ka kpɔ o yal kpa.
Ei!
Aa do kpeɡrii tɛ tekpoŋra ne haahna baa kpoŋe bechasɔɔhne a ɡɛ saŋ nɔ noo!
Hé soŋe Korowii ásɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ bɛ waa saŋ chiɡ oo!
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɡɛ wekpeɡa nɔ dɔŋa ta balɛ bwa.
A ɔma!
Dɛ den le saŋ la Korowii aa ta harɛ la dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini nɔ, nɛwɛnyini ta a dɔŋa nae bwa.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛo waa, a dɔŋa aa ɛɛ ba kpa.
Dɛ Korowii fe ta tɔpera la ane teŋe ta aa, nomɛlbwa fe aa o nyuu dɔ.
Kɛ o koh o nɛra waa chal ba dɛ lɛɛ ba ba teŋɛ o nɛɛ la waa dɛ teŋe tɔpechɔɡa la ane ta.
A ɡɛ saŋ la bane ɛɛ dɛɛ ŋɔɔ, ‘Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ásɛ o ba lɛ yaa laanee nɔ!’ Ásɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ, ‘On ka lɔ le la!’ A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa baa ɛ aa, he bɛ a bɛlbwa yarada, dɛkalkɛ nɛra ɛɛ bao dɛ́ ba teŋe nyosone ŋɔ Kristo laanee ban, ásɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ Korowii keameree ban.
Baa ɛ bebeewaa ne nyokpowaa dɛɛ nyin bɔr dɛ́ neɡre nɛra Korowii aa chal ba dɛ lɛɛ ba la kwara.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ!
N dɔɔ baɡle waa aa dɛ ba ɛɛ mɔɔ tɔpere la ba.
Men Nɛn Bie bala wa A ɡɛ wekpeɡa nɔ baa ɛ dɛ kaa laa, wee aa bɔr chaahna ba kpa, korobie ɡe aa bɔr chaahna ba kpa.
Weweela dɛ ba nyundua lee dɛ́ lee harɛ, ásɛ Korowii doa bwa yiiɡi dɛ́ chɔɡ.
Belaa baa ba Men Nɛn Bie nae kɛŋɔ maa lɔ baama bini dɛɛ ba kpeɡri ne jirima a dɔŋa aa wola toole ne.
Mɛɛ tomɛ nyundua toromaa harɛ nɔ bobɛlbwaa bá valɛ lawɛ n nɛra maa chal ba dɛ lɛɛ ba la bwa nyoa.
Fiɡ daa wehwela Hé kpɔ fiɡ daa hweli wa.
O baa foɡre dɛɛ le papo-lwɛɛne aa, dɛ nomɛlbwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ bɔwɔb saŋ telo tonɛ.
Gɛɛ dɛ waa nɔ maa bol he be nɔ baa dɛɛ chiɡ aa, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛ tɔpere maa dɛ bol o waa la bala telo.
Kasinteŋ, a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa dɛ ba chiɡa mɔɔ fini nɛra nɔ bwa serewe.
Nyundua ne harɛ ɛɛ chɔɡoo.
Aa lee ba do kpa.
Kɛ n waa maa bola te bwa ɛɛ do lee saŋ te bɛlbwa.
Nomɛlbwa aa tɔpere ne saŋ la jemɛ Nomɛlbwa aa Korowii Tɔpere la ne saŋ ɡɛ waa la aa dɛ ba chiɡa jemɛ.
Nyundua toroma la ne Men Nɛn Bie la ɡba aa jemɛ.
N Mɛɛ la ɡboo jema.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, hɛ́ɛ do dɛɛɡɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haa tɔpere la jemɛ.
Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ nomoa bɛl aa dɛ ba bobɛl kaala dɛ baɡle o bonɔɔna tomare, dɛ ŋɔ baa waa dɛ nyiŋi o dem ta la be ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi o ta kɛrɛdɛ la.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ta wone jemɛ tɔɔ la wee dem te la aa dɛ ba bala.
Bɛl lole jwaanaa wɛɛ ba bala.
Gɛ laa ɡe aa, harambaŋa ne.
Bɛl lole o ta jabala siiɡa saŋ balaa, chɔɔbɔree wɛɛ ba bala.
He bɛ ɡel o ba piɡri heya, dɛ he dɛ chɔ doromi.
Waa nɔ maa dɛ bol he be nɔ, nɛra bwa bee mɛɛ ŋɔ la.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋu ŋwɛnɛ kɛrɛdɛ!”
Yeesu kpoe vɔrɔwa wa A baa ka tɔpera anɛ ásɛ ba di ba tɔpejen baa dɛ yerɔ Galekaa la.
A ɡɛ tɔpera nɔ taa baa di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta la.
Dɛ Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema la dɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ bɛl dɛ́ sɔh lawɛ Yeesu dɛ́ kpoo, dɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛndamanta nɔ aa dɛ ba chema ya bena nyoa nɔ dii ta nɔ, dɛ ya kpoo ɡɛ tɔpera nɔ ta naa, baa lɛ ɡaeeh.” Ba fuɡe noo do Yeesu nyu ta Yeesu la Bɛtani dɛ ka choɡ Seemɔn weechɔɡa fa aa chɔɡ o bwara ka la dea.
Baa dɛ di kwaa la, haah bɛl kpɔ nosɔɔhsoma a yoɡ aa kpeɡa loŋbir bɛl ba jo ba be.
O baa paɡre loŋ la dɛ wee nosɔɔhsoma la dɛɛ do Yeesu nyu ta.
Dɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela la bane baah diu, baa bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Aah nosɔɔhsoma nɔ ɡe ken chɔɡa nɔ munii ameo?
Ba fe yoɡa aa, o fe ɛɛ le suuɡajena tentenee ba fee kpɔ tɛ nyaara.
A ɡɛ fe ta bɔe kɛŋɔ ɡɛ nɔ waa ɛa nɔ naa?” Dɛ chwee haah la kohona.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hé ɡelo jeiih ken.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ hao ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Wedɛɛɡee o ɛɛ mɛ la.
Nyaara aa he be paŋa ba bwa.
Dɛ he dɛ nyin ban wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ yaa, hɛɛ wonoo dɛɛ ɛɛ ba saŋ bɛlbwa.
Kɛ n te, maa he bee do ka tonɛ.
Anla waa won ɛ laanee o ɛ la.
N huɡa laalee o pu sie dɛɛ kpɔ dɛ fuɡe nosɔɔhsoma dɛɛ ta n nɛɛ la.
Kasinteŋ, bobɛlbwa baa bol Amanesoma nɔ harɛ ta bobɛlbwa la, baa bol waa waa ɛa nɔ waa dɛ́ kpɔ liiru.” Asɛ Judas Eskareɔt waa ɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la bɛl la ir la Sɔfonomonome be dɛ ka ŋɔ wɛɛ wonoo cha ba ásɛ ba lawɛ Yeesu.
Baa no ɡɛ la, ba sie lɛo, dɛ ŋɔ baa tɛo suuɡaa.
Asɛ Judas pa mun dɛɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ bɛl dɛ́ won ɡel ba dɔɔ.
Kondikwaa baa dia dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii Yeesu wa Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta tɔpeloɡle la taa, baa kpoo Galekaa pebiiri dɛ ɛ nawee we-ɛɛla.
Awola tɔpere la, Yeesu habɔteŋra la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa hɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ya ka ɛ Galekaa kondikwaa la tɛɛ he dio?” Belaa o tomɛ ba nɛra banɛ dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé la bwɛjen bini.
He kaa na baa bɛl o che vii ne nee aa, hé teŋɛ o nɛ dɛ́ ka jo dem waa jo o ta la.
He laŋaa, hé ŋɔ dem te la be ŋɔ nomoa la ŋɔ lee dea o ne o habɔteŋra aa dɛ ba Galekaa kondikwaa o bini dii la dɔɔ?
Ásɛ o baɡle heyaa abrɔsane doa dea bɛl baa kwaaro dɛ nyin kane bwa cheɡ o bini kɛrɛdɛ la.
Belaa hɛɛ ba ya kondikwaa bwa ɛɛ dɛ cheɡ.” O habɔteŋra la aa la bwɛjen la ta la, ɡɛ waa baɡla la tentenee ba ka na, asɛ dɛ daa ba Galekaa kondikwaa la bela.
A jɔmɔra ne la, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la ba bela.
Baa soɡa dɛɛ di kwaa la, Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, he nɛra n ne haa pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwaa nɔ bini bɛlee dɛɛ ba n yoɡa tɛ nɛra la.” Ate, dɛ ba teene bini chɔɡɔ, ba berɛ dɛɛ bɔɔro beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa ŋɔ, “Menee kɛɛ?
Menee kɛɛ?” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “He nɛra fi dɛ banɛ nɔ n ne haa dɛ pɛ nɔn hɛna beŋkpoŋ bini nɔ bɛlee.
Men Nɛn Bie la ɛɛ sewɔɔ ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa baɡla kɛŋɔ mɛɛ ɛo la.
Kɛ naate waa yoɡ mɛ tɛ bá kpo mɛ la, ó bwɛɛlɛ!
Ba fe ta on lolɛ kwaraa fe bɔ!” Baa dɛ di kwaa la, Yeesu kpɔ paanoo dɛ jam Korowii o wa, asɛ dɛ mɔne tɛ o habɔteŋra la, dɛ ŋɔ, “N bo-olii la.
Hé lɛ dɛ́ di.” Asɛ o berɛ kpɔ numol ne sen ɡe dɛ jam Korowii dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba, asɛ ba nyɔ ka tɛ dɔŋa.
Asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Sen nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ n chal maa dɛ ba nɛra kɛrɛdɛ waa koeh dɛ́ fuɡe ta.
Á ɛ fɔo dɛ chɔ Korowii ne nɛwɛnyini baah ta.
Kasinteŋ, maa a ɡɛ sen nɔ anee nyɔ kpa bwa, nemenɛ kɛŋɔ awola maa ba nyɔ anfala Korowii Kora la ta.” Asɛ ba ɡo yel bɛl dɛ jam Korowii, dɛ le kaa Ɔlevere Bwejen la ta.
Pita aa tɔah ŋɔ waa Yeesu jemɛ Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bwa ɛɛ ba chwao ɡel mɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɛɛ kpo peteɡre laanee, ásɛ peera la bwa lɔ peɡre.’ Kɛ dɛ Korowii baa ir mɛ seo ta naa, mɛɛ tɔ he siee la Galilia harɛ ta.” Anee Pita ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ n bala nɔ bwa chwao ɡele kwara naa, n te aa chwa ɡele!” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ Pita be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, jabal loɡle ne sii kera anɛ kere chɔmbibi ne dɛ he tɔɔh kera atoro ŋɔ haa men jemɛ kwaraa!” Anee Pita ŋɔ, “Dɛ seo kwaraa yaa, n ne hɛɛ sewɔɔ, kɛ maa tɔh ŋɔ maa hen jemɛ bwa!” Gɛɛ o habɔteŋra la bwa ŋɔ baa o habɔɔ le bwa.
Yeesu soŋe Korowii Gɛtsɛmane Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra aa tel bela baa dɛ yerɛ Gɛtsɛmane la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé so bonɔ ásɛ n ka soŋe Korowii ba.” O kpɔ Pita ne Jems ne Jɔn ja o nɛ.
Waa dɛ kaa la, dɛ ɔmee ne bambiteŋa lawɔ kohona.
Asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N tea bini chɔɡɔ kohona to.
A ɡbo ɛɛ kpo mɛɛ kwara.
Hé so bonɔ dɛɛ were.” Asɛ o la sie tama dɛ ka pi harɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ a fe ɛɛ maɡroo waa, waa aa dɛ ba la fe bɛ o nɛɛ chiɡ.
Dɛ berɛ soŋo ja ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, wobɛlbwa toole haa wola won ɛ. N poori, bɛ ɡel n na a ɡɛ wahala nɔ, kɛ ɛ he tetoowaa dɛ ɡel n tetoowa.” Asɛ Yeesu berɛ ba ba be dɛ ba na o habɔteŋra batoro la kɛŋɔ ba chɔɔɡe doromi.
Anee o bɔɔ Seemɔn Pita ŋɔ, “Chɔe he chɔ aa?
He ta wone were tamaa bɛlbwa naa?” Asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ soŋe Korowii ásɛ Bɔnsam bɛ won neɡre heya.
He bambile fe dɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ, kɛ he bwadabii pwɛre.” Asɛ o berɛ la dɛ ka soŋe Korowii ɡɛ o fa aa kaa soŋe la, dɛ berɛ ba ba be, dɛ ba chɔɔɡe doromi, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ dom dɛ chuɡ ba taeh.
Baa jemɛ ɡɛ baa bol o be kpa.
Waa bera ka ba toorotena dɛ ba dɛ chɔɔɡe doromi ja, anee o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He ta chɔɔ dɛɛ onaa?
A tonɔ.
Saŋ la baa dɛ ba Men Nɛn Bie kpɔe dɛ́ do wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔn ta la telo.
Hé ir yá kaa.
Hé na, naate waa dɛ ba n lee tɛ bá kpo mɛ laanee la.” Yeesu lawa wa Yeesu ta aa dɛ bol waa, dɛ o habɔteŋra la bini bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Judas balɔ.
Nɛnlaa bane teŋɛ o nɛɛ dɛ kpoŋe tokobie ne keri ne ɡule.
Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema la ne bela nomonomee tomɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ.
Baa dɛ ba la, Judas ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Naate maa ɡbaaro pɛl n bambile dɛ mo o lwɛɛma la, hé lawɔ dɛ nyiŋu kɛrɛdɛ o bɛ won lɛ o te dɛ chwa.” Waa baa tel Yeesu be la, o ɡbaaro pɛl o bambile dɛ mo o lwɛɛma dɛ ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ!” Belaa ba lawɔ.
Asɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la bɛl pamɛ o kere le o tɔɔ ta, dɛ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ Sɔfonomoa la bonɔɔ deŋne dɛ laa cha.
Asɛ Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛɛree men he kpɔ keri ne ɡule dɛɛ ba hé ba laɡ mɛ naa?
Saŋ la bwa maa lɔ Korowii Dea dɛɛ baɡle waa la, ɛrɛɛ haa wola men lawɔɔ?
Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ waa baa chwera la bwa ɛ kpela la, waa anɔ bwa ɛɛ ɛ nɔ.” Belaa Yeesu habɔteŋra la bwa lɔ peɡre dɛ chwao.
Dɛ bonɔɔ bɛl kpɔ yapoŋ mile chara dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ, asɛ ba fe ɛɛ nyin o lawa, asɛ o ɡel yapoŋ la dɛ chwa kaa ɡɛ.
Yeesu kaa che Juu tena nomonome sie Belaa ba kpɔ Yeesu la Sɔfonomoa la dem.
Dɛ Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema ne ba bela nomonome bwa cheme bela.
Dɛ Pita teŋɛ ba nɛɛ bojaŋ dɛ ba jo nomoa la dem baah.
Dɛ o ne soojare baa dɛ daah doonyoa la soɡo dɛɛ ŋwee nii.
Sɔfonomonome ne Juu tena nomonome baa dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la bwa nyin ŋwɛnɛ la bwa ta baa che, dɛ́ di waa la bɔ Yeesu dɛ́ fee ɡel ba kpoo kahonɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra kɛrɛdɛ teŋe nyosone dawɛ Yeesu nɛ, kɛ dɛ ba webaɡla la aa beŋkpoŋ ɛ. Asɛ baala bane ir dɛ teŋe nyosone ŋɔ, “Ya noɔ waa dɛ bol ŋɔ wɛɛ paɡre Korowii Dea nɔ nɛwɛnyini aa mao nɔɔ, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ tɔpera atoro ma onla nɛwɛnyini aa wola mae.” Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɡba webaɡla la ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ.
Belaa Sɔfonomoa la ir che nɛra la bwa baah ta dɛ bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Amɔ he ta wobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ chaŋe waa nɔ baa dɛ bol nɔ bɛlbwa naa?” Asɛ Yeesu tɔ nyoa, o ta wobɛlbwa chaŋɛ.
Asɛ nomoa la berɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Henee Korowii Bie Kristo la waa ŋɔa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ásɛ o ba lɛ yaa la aa?” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Menee, hɛɛ ba na Men Nɛn Bie laanee kɛŋɔ maa soɡe Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡnɛn la diɡ ta, ásɛ dɛ na ɡɛ n ne baama aa le nyundua dɛɛ ba!” Asɛ Sɔfonomoa la laa o ɡbaɡba laala waa doa la kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa danseɛ yá berɛ so dɛ́ɛ nyin jaɔ?
He ta nɛnhɛlwobol waa dɛ bol Korowii noɛ yaa?
Ɛrɛɛ he na nɔ?” Ate, dɛ ba bwa ŋɔ, “O ɛ wechɔɡa.
Hé kpoo!” Dɛ bane ta nentane dɛɛ ta o nɛ, asɛ bane ɡe kpɔ nɔɔra tɔ o sie dɛɛ lɔɔro dɛɛ tɔɔ kande dɛ ŋɔ ó jemɛ naate waa lɔɔ.
Asɛ soojare baa dɛ daah bela la kpakpaa o lwɛrɛme.
Pita aa tɔɔh ŋɔ waa Yeesu jemɛ Pita ta lɔ dem baah bela, asɛ Sɔfonomoa la tolo bɛl ba dɛ ba nao dɛ o dɛ ŋwee nii, dɛ nyiŋu jeiih ken dɛ ŋɔ, “Kɛ he ɡe fa teŋɛ Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt la nɛɛ laɔ?” Asɛ Pita tɔh pelepelepele ken, dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa hɛɛ bol nɔɔ?
Maa a bini jemɛ kwara!” Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o kaa dem la doonyoa bɔr.
Sɔfonomoa tolo la berɔ nao ja dɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa cheɡɛ bela la be ŋɔ, “Nɛra la bini bɛlee baa nɔ!” Asɛ Pita berɛ tɔh ŋɔ waa Yeesu jemɛ ja.
A ta biɡre bɛlbwa asɛ nɛra baa cheɡɛ bela la ŋɔ, “Haa won tɔh ŋɔ Yeesu nɛra la bɛl laa hen, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Galilia tee hen.” Asɛ Pita ŋwɛɛ ŋɔ, “Maa baa nɔ haa dɛ bol o waa nɔ jemɛ kwara!” Buɡ la ta, dɛ jabal nɛɛtena sio, asɛ Pita lii ɡɛ Yeesu aa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Jabala ne sii kera anɛ dɛ he tɔɔh kera atoro bwa ŋɔ haa men jemɛ bwa” la.
Waa lii a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, dɛ o dɛ wi.
Ba lawɛ Yeesu ka che Paelet sie Tɔɔ aa pera chɔmbibi ne la, Sɔfonomonome ne bwɛɛ nomonome ne Tɔnjerema bwa, Juu tena nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi ba waa bini la te bwa, chemo dɛ vɔrɔwe Yeesu vɔrɔwa, dɛ vɔrɔwe o nɔɔra, dɛ kpɔɔ ka tɛ Rom nomoa Paelet waa dɛ nyiŋi bela harɛ ta.
Belaa Paelet bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Henee Juu tena kooro ɛ?” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Anee he bol la.” Sɔfonomonome la teŋe nyosone dawɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Asɛ Paelet bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “He ta wobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ bol aa?
Haa won chaŋe wedamanta nɔ bwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ dawɛ nɔ bini ane aa?” Yeesu ta wobɛlbwa chaŋɛ, asɛ Paelet nyoa kpo.
Ba ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ba kpo Yeesu A ɡɛ tɔpejen la baa tel aa, wechɔɡ-ɛɛ te bɛlbwa baa doo dea asɛ bwɛɛla la ŋɔ bá leo ta la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá leo ta.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, nɛra bane fa vuuɡi Rom nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi bela harɛ la dɛ kpoo nɛra a ɡɛ waa la ta.
Dɛ Barabas ja a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ nɛ, asɛ ba do ba bwa dea.
Asɛ nɛnlaa la ba Paelet be dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó le wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la bɛl ta, ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛ bena bɛlbwa la.
Belaa o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ń foo Juu tena kooro la ta kɛɛ?” Dɛ o ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ bɔweela waa Sɔfonomonome la che Yeesu nɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ dɛ kpɔɔ ba o be la.
Jaah dɛ Sɔfonomonome la do nɛnlaa la bwa ŋɔ bá ŋɔ Barabasee baa nyin, dɛ ŋɔ Páelet leo ta.
Belaa Paelet bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛɛ he ŋɔ ń ɛ baa la haa dɛ yerɔ Juu tena kooro laɔ?” Asɛ ba bwa kparɛ si ŋɔ, “Kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta!” Anee Paelet bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yɔ?
Bɔkwa wechɔɡaa o ɛɔ?” Ate, dɛ ba berɔ kwaa si kohona ŋɔ, “Kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta!” Paelet aa wola nyin kɛŋɔ nɛnlaa la bwaawee ir o nɛɛ la, o le Barabas ta tɛɛ ba dɛ ɡel ba lɔɔ Yeesu bampɔrɔ ŋwɛɛra ne mɔɔ dɛ kpɔɔ tɛ ŋɔ bá ka kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta.
Gɛ soojare aa muɡli Yeesu baah Asɛ soojare la kpɔ Yeesu le kaa Paelet dem baah dɛ yerɛ ba bala soojare bwa, dɛ kpɔ yaswɛm bɛl kɛŋɔ ba bela kooyal tɔ Yeesu, dɛ kpɔ sɔɔhne sɔh kooɡbɛrɛ piu, dɛ ba dɛ ɡuŋi o sie dɛɛ si, “Woowo, Juu tena kooro!” Asɛ ba kpɔ chweremi dɛɛ cha o nyu, dɛ ta nentane dɛɛ ta o nɛ, dɛɛ ɡuŋu harɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɛ kooro la.
Baa muɡli o baah tonɛ la, ba laa yaswɛm la foo o bwara ta, dɛ kpɔ o ɡbaɡba laala la doo, dɛ kpɔɔ le dɛɛ kaa dɛ́ ka kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta.
Ba kpaa Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta Baa dɛ kaa la, ba kaa na Seemɔn waa le Sairini, dɛ o le bobɛl dɛɛ ba.
Ba ɛɡro o lɛ Yeesu daɡaɡre la che.
Dɛ a ɡɛ Seemɔn la biirii Alɛksanda ne Rufus.
Asɛ ba kpɔ Yeesu kaa bela baa dɛ yerɛ Gɔlɡɔta la.
Gɔlɡɔta munii Nyuhoɡ Bɔr.
Asɛ ba kpɔ korobo aa wona dɛɛ sɔɔh bwadabii wee nyoa do sen ta dɛ kpɔ tɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ó nyɔ, asɛ o vɛh nyɔe.
Ba foo o laala, dɛ kpaa o nɔɔra ne o nakpale pɛl daɡaɡre ta.
Dɛ soojare la dɛ nyin Yeesu laala bɔna, dɛ ta chacha mɔɔ dɛ́ won jemɛ laala ba bɛlbwa aa di.
Koola nenyɔɔ saŋee ba kpaa Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta.
Ba chwerɛ o wechɔɡa waa ɛa ba koh a waa kpoo la pɛl o daɡaɡre la ta.
A ɡɛ waa laanee, juu tena kooro.
Ŋwɛɛra banɛɛ ba kpaa pɛl daɡaɡra ta ja Yeesu nɛ.
Bɛl saɡɛ o diɡ ta, bɛl ɡe saɡɛ o ɡal ta.
Asɛ waa baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ “Baa yerɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ” la ɛ kasinteŋ.
Nɛra baa kpɔ bela bɔr baa kaa la chɛɡre Yeesu dɛɛ muɡli o baah ŋɔ, “Chwa!
Nɛn haa dɛ ba Korowii Dea paɡra dɛ́ won kpɔ tɔpera atoro mao la laa nɔ ɡbao?
Lɛ he te dɛ́ tu harɛ yá na!” Gɛɛ Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema la muɡli o baah dɔŋa be dɛ ŋɔ, “Ao!
Nɛra ɡboo o won lɛɛ, kɛ waa won lɛ o te.
He nɛn haa ŋɔa henee Israel tena kooro Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ásɛ o ba lɛ yaa la, le daɡaɡre la doa tu harɛ yá na dɛ́ won yaradae.” Asɛ ŋwɛɛra baa kpaa ba pɛl daɡaɡra ta ja o nɛɛ la ɡee chɛɡro.
Yeesu seo wa Wee aa baa che nyubaah la, bɔr biro jumaa ken dɛ ka tel wekee saŋ mɔɔ bɔr berɛ chaah ja.
Wekee saŋ aa tela la, Yeesu do lɔŋɔ kpeɡri nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” O munii kɛŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ Korowii, n Mɛɛ Korowii, ɛrɛɛ he chwa mɛ nɔɔ?” Nɛra baa cheɡɛ bela la aa no ɡɛ la, ba ŋɔ, “Na, Elaejaa wɛɛ yerɛ la!” Asɛ bɛl chwa dɛ ka kpɔ konjɔɡɔjɔɡɔ waa won nee lɛɛ ka li sennyɛɡa ta, dɛ kpɔ toh daa ta tɛo o nyɔ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya na, dɛ Elaeja ɛɛ ba leo daɡaɡre nɔ taa yaa?” Belaa Yeesu do lɔŋɔ kohona, asɛ o doma le o sewɛ.
Asɛ yal waa teŋe Korowii Dea baah ta la pere anɛ le nyundua ba ta harɛ.
Soojare lafa nomoa waa dɛ daah Yeesu aa na ɡɛ Yeesu hweera aa teŋa la, o nyoa kpoo, asɛ o ŋɔ, “Korowii Biee baa nɔ kpela!” Dɛ haahna bane ɡe cheɡɛ bojaŋ dɛɛ nyiŋi.
Ba bini banee Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la, ne Jems Bechala ne Josis nya Mɛɛre, ne Salome.
A ɡɛ saŋ waa lɔ Galilia harɛ la, dɛ a ɡɛ haahna nɔɔ daa kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛo.
Dɛ haahna bane ba fa aa teŋɛ o nɛɛ pirim ba Jerusalam la bwa lɔ bela.
Yeesu huɡa wa Awola tɔpere la taa baa nyin ba kwaa bwa dɛɛ cheɡ ásɛ dɛ tɔɔ peraa, bá di Ona Tɔpere la.
Dɛ Josef waa le Arimatea la ɛ ba bela nomonome la bini nɛn nɛra bwa aa dɛ tɛo duure.
O ɡe dɛ kpa saŋ la Korowii aa di kora dɛ lɛɛ ba la.
Awola jɔmɔra la, o lɔ bambile dɛ la Paelet be dɛ ka soŋo ŋɔ ó tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó ka kpɔ Yeesu lale la.
Asɛ a piɡri Paelet kɛŋɔ Yeesu aa dena sewɛ la.
Anee o yerɛ soojare lafa nomoa la dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Yeesu sewɔ kpela aa?” Nomoa la aa sɛah ŋɔ Yeesu sewɔ la, Paelet tɛ Josef ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ ó ka kpɔ o lale la.
Asɛ Josef yawɛ yapoŋ dɛ ka laa Yeesu kpɔ daɡaɡre la doa dɛ kpɔ yapoŋ la fɔrɔwo dɛ huɡo.
Bwebɔɔ bɛl baa kwiu kɛŋɔ dea binii ba huɡo, dɛ ɡbili bwe tɔ bɔɔ la nyoa.
Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la ne Josis nya Mɛɛre na bela baa huɡo.
Yeesu seo ta ira wa Ona Tɔpere la aa ɡara la, Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la ne Jems nya Mɛɛre ne Salome, yawɛ tɛɛɡa ane a sɔɔh aa soma ŋɔ bá fee kpɔ ka fɔɡle Yeesu lale la.
Kwasiara waa ɛ tɔpeloɡle tɔ mun aa dɛ kpɔ la, dɛ ba tel bela baa huɡe Yeesu la.
Baa dɛ ba la, dɛ ba dɛ bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Umee dɛɛ ba bwe la ɡbila le bɔɔ la nyoa tɛ yaa ɔ?” Baa ta sie nyiŋi la, dɛ bwejen la ɡbilo le bɔɔ la nyoa.
Baa jo bɔɔ la bini dɛ bonɔɔ bɛl soɡe diɡ pera, dɛ do wurpoŋ, asɛ ba bwara yɔr.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr,” dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt baa kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta la lalee hɛɛ nyin nɔ naa?
O toole bonɔ kpa.
Waa sewa la, o iro.
Hé na bela baa huɡo la.
Hé la dɛ ka ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la ne ba dɔŋ Pita be ŋɔ o dɛ tɔ sie kaa Galilia harɛ.
Belaa hɛɛ ba o nae ɡɛ o fa aa bola la.” Asɛ ba nyoa kpo, ba kpɔ bochela chwa le bɔɔ la bini.
Baa dɛ kaa la, dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ, anomanta, ba ta wobɛlbwa bolɛ nomɛlbwa be.
Yeesu kpɔ o te chaɡle Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala Kwasiara waa ɛ tɔpeloɡle tomun aa dɛ kpɔ Yeesu aa ir seo ta la, o tɔ sie kpɔ o te baɡle Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la.
Yeesu fa doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ anuanɛ le ɡɛ haah nɔ nɛ.
Mɛɛre laŋɔ dɛ ka ŋɔ nɛra ba fa aa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ la be waa la waa naa la.
Waa la ba be dɛ ba koh Yeesu seo la waa dɛɛ ɛ lwe dɛɛ wi siniire mɛrmɛr ken.
Waa ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ Yeesu berɔ ir seo ta dɛ ŋɔ o te nao la, ba ta on yaradae.
A habɔɔ la, Yeesu berɔ beɡre o te dɛ ba ba nɛra banɛ be, dɛ ba le Jerusalam dɛɛ kaa.
Ba ɡe aa laŋa ka bol ba bala kabora la be la, ba ta yaradae.
Yeesu kpɔ o te chaɡle o habɔteŋra A habɔɔ la, o kpɔ o te chaɡle o habɔteŋra fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ la, dɛ ba dɛ di kwa.
O pwaah ba ba yarada nyae ne ba bambikpeɡ la waa kɛŋɔ baa wola ba bala baa tɔ sie nao la yaradae la.
Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kaa harɛ ta bobɛlbwa dɛ́ ka bol Amanesoma la baɡle nɛwɛnyina bwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa yarada ásɛ ba sɔɔ nee la, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ o wechɔɡaa kɛo.
Kɛ naate waa wola yaradae la, wɛɛ di bolchɔɡee.
Nɛra baa yarada n waa la ɛɛ ɛ wejenaa, ásɛ nɛra na dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ n nɛraa ban.
Baa dɔ kpeɡrii dɛ́ won che n sɔn ta dɛɛ doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛ.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɛɛ ir ba nɛɛ baa bol wobofala.
Dɛ harɛkwaa dom ba aa, wobɛlbwa aa ba ɛɛ ba.
Dɛ ba nyɔ tɛɡchɔɡa kwara naa, baa sewa ba.
Baa wonoo kpɔ ba nɔɔra dawɛ weela tena nɛɛ bá dɔ bokpeɡa.” Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu aa bol waa ba be tonɛ la, Korowii kpɔɔ kaa nyundua, o ka so nomombɔr o diɡ ta.
Asɛ o habɔteŋra la kaa bobɛlbwa dɛ kaa bol Korowii Waa la.
Dɛ Korowii teŋɛ ba nɛɛ asɛ ba we-ɛɛla baa dɛ ɛ la ɡel nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba waa baa bola dɛɛ ɡaaɡe la ɛ kpela.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Luk boa waa nyoa warɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ o won chwerɛ Yeesu bwara waa kɛrɛdɛ, ne o toma waa baa ɛ harɛ nɔ ta.
O dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, Yeesu ɛ Lɛɛ Korowii kpɔɔ baɡɛ Israel tena nyoa, dɛ berɛ ɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa Lɛɛ.
O dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la dɛ ɛ toma nɛra bini, asɛ Korowii ɛɛ cha nyaahra ne dɔɔhna, ne baala ne haahna, ne nɛndɛɛɡa dɛ nɛnchɔɡa bwa ba konnyina ta.
Nomoa Teɔfelɔs, nɛra warɔ dɛ takapɔ ŋɔ baa chwerɛ waa aa chiɡ ya binii.
Ba chwerɛ waa yaa noa dɛ le nɛra baa kpɔ siwi naa mumpar la, dɛ faa ɛ a toma dɛɛ bol Korowii Waa la.
Nomoa, n ɡbaɡba nyiŋi a ɡɛ waa nɔ bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛ le mumpar, anomanta, n liiro kɛ aa maɡroo kɛ n chwerɛ dɛ baɡle a bini ɡɛ aa teŋa beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa dɛ tɛɛ, ásɛ he won jemɛ waa baa bol he be la bini kasinteŋ bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee lola wa Gɛ saŋ Hɛrɔd aa ɛ kooro Juda harɛ la, dɛ Sɔfo bɛl lole baa yerɔ Sekaria, asɛ o ɛ Abija be pera sɔfore la bɛl.
Dɛ o haah sɔne Ɛlesabɛt.
Dɛ sɔfore deene la bɛl biee o ɡe.
Dɛ ɡɛ nɛra banɛ nɔ bwa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa aa su Korowii siwi, baa no Korowii wa, dɛɛ teŋɛ a bwa ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Sekaria moo, ba bwa ba hwɛɛh, kɛ dɛ ba ta bie dɔe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Ɛlesabɛt ɛ hambara.
Awola bɛl, Abia be pera sɔfore toma telo, asɛ Sekaria do Korowii Dea dɛɛ ɛ o Sɔfo toma.
Gɛ sɔfore yon dɛɛ ɛ la, ba ta chacha mɔɔ dɛ leo ŋɔ ó jo Korowii Dea dɛ́ ka fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma.
O jo bela, asɛ nɛnlaa la bwa che buse dɛɛ soŋe Korowii ásɛ o fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma la tonɛ.
Belaa Korowii nyundua torome forɛ le ba Sekaria be Korowii Dea bela, dɛ ka che bela waa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma la diɡ bɔr.
Sekaria aa na nyundua torome la la, a ɛo anebɛlbwa, asɛ ɔmee lawɔ.
Anee nyundua torome la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Sekaria, dɛɛ berɛ ɔma!
Korowii no he wesoŋa.
He haah Ɛlesabɛt ɛɛ lolɛ bibaalee tɛɛ, ásɛ he pa o sɔn Jɔn.
Dɛ o lolaa, he bambile ɛɛ sɔɔhnee he sie lɛ, nɛra sie lɛ pirim, bá hɛɡre.
Wɛɛ ɛ nɛnjen Korowii bee.
Waa sen kɛɛ kwaa aa dɛ dɛɛ te bɛlbwa nyɔe ba.
Waa lɔ o nya tea bini kwaraa la, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la dɛ ba o nɛɛ soɡa kpeɡri nɛ.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo Israel tena charɛ ba liire, dɛ́ ba N Naa Korowii be.
