Wɛɛ dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ne kpeɡrii kɛŋɔ Korowii keame Elaeja ken, dɛ́ tɔ ya Dɔɔ sie, dɛ́ ɡel eehnanar ne ba bii nyoa pɛ, dɛ́ berɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena liire ba nɛra ba wa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi ŋwɛnɛ ta.
Gɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ nyin nɛra cheɡ ya Dɔɔ, ásɛ o balaa, ba won lɛo dɛ́ tomɔ.” Belaa Sekaria bɔɔ nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ n jemɛ kɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ kpela ɔ?
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ n ne n haah bwa hwɛɛhrɔ.” Anee nyundua torome la chaŋo ŋɔ, “Menee Gebreɛl maa dɛ che Korowii sie la.
Onee tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol Amanesoma nɔ he be.
Kɛ haa wola n waa nɔ yaradae dɛɛ tɔŋ mɛ nomanta, hɛɛ berɛ amumuu dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa nɔ bwa aa ɛa dɛ ɛ kpela mɔɔ he won bol wa.
Jemɛ kɛŋɔ waa nɔ maa bola nɔ saŋ telaa, a bwa ɛɛ ɛo kɛrɛdɛ ken.” Gɛ saŋ Sekaria aa lɔ Korowii Dea bela la, dɛ nɛra cheɡɛ buse dɛɛ kpao.
A ɛɛ ba nyokpoa kɛ waa biɡri bela la.
Waa le Korowii Dea bela dɛ ba buse la, o ta wone bol waa nɛra la be.
Anomanta, ba nao kɛŋɔ o na komɛl deera ta bela.
Anee ɡela waa wola won waa bol dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra ne nyu dɛɛ baɡle waa la.
Sekaria toma aa tonɛ Korowii Dea bela ɡɛ saŋ la, o kaa o bwɛ.
Waa nɔ habɔɔ la, Sekaria haah Ɛlesabɛt jo tea, dɛ kpɔ o te sɔh dem korobie anue.
Ɛlesabɛt cheɡɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, dɛ ŋɔ, “Name te N Naa Korowii laa sihiih kpɔ n sie ta, ásɛ n won jo nɛra bini.” Nyundua torome baa bol Yeesu lola wa Ɛlesabɛt tea la korobie anumɛl ta la, Korowii nyundua torome baa dɛ yerɔ Gebreɛl la le Korowii be dɛ ba bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Nasarɛt waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta la ta.
Tolo bɛl waa wola baa jemɛ bwa baa yerɔ Mɛɛre bee o ba.
Dɛ Mɛɛre dɛ ba Josef yala ɡɛ saŋ.
Kooro Devid deaa Josef le.
Nyundua torome la ba Mɛɛre be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Korowii nɛnnyini, jam.
N Naa Korowii cheɡɛ he habɔɔ.” Waa nyundua torome la aa baa bol Mɛɛre be la ɛo anebɛlbwa, asɛ o lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa nɔɔ?” Belaa nyundua torome la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma, kɛ Korowii tɛɛ hɛɛra.
Hɛɛ kpoŋe tea dɛ́ lolɛ bibaa, ásɛ dɛ pa o sɔn Yeesu.
Wɛɛ ɛ nɛnjenii, ásɛ baa yerɔ Nemenɛ Korowii Bie.
N Naa Korowii dɛ ba on o naa Devid kora la dɔŋ cheɡa ó di.
Wɛɛ ɛ Jekɔb naanar bwa sekwaraa kooro o kora aa wola jaɡa dɔe ba.” Anee Mɛɛre ŋɔ nyundua torome la be ŋɔ, “Maa wola baa jemɛ mɔɔ nɔ, ɛrɛɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won maɡre ɔ?” Belaa nyundua torome la ŋɔ, “Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɛɛ ba he bee, ásɛ Nemenɛ Korowii kpeɡri tɔ he nɛ, ásɛ he kpoŋe tea.
Anɔ taa aa ba cheɡa bie haa dɛ ba lola la ɛ nɛn o wa aa do ɡoroŋ, ásɛ baa yerɔ Korowii Bie.
Dɛɛ no!
He lole Ɛlesabɛt baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o hwɛɛhrɔ ŋɔ waa lolɛ la, taraken o jo tea.
Korobie anumɛlee nɔ, kɛ o ɡe fe ɛ hambara.
Na, wobɛlbwa ta Korowii ɛɛ tele.” Anee Mɛɛre ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowiirii dɔɔ mɛ, anomanta, ó ɛɛ mɛ ɡɛ bwa haa ŋɔa nɔ.” Asɛ nyundua torome la le Mɛɛre be dɛ kaa.
Mɛɛre laŋɔ ka chɔɔ Ɛlesabɛt A ɡɛ waa nɔ ta la, Mɛɛre iro dɛ kpɔ yɔra chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta ka le Juda deŋɡarere harɛ bobɛl dɛ kaa Sekaria bwɛ, dɛ ka jo Sekaria dem dɛ ka chɔɔ Ɛlesabɛt.
Ɛlesabɛt aa no Mɛɛre taa la, anee bie la aa lɔ o tea bini la lɔ kpeɡri nɛ, asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ba so Ɛlesabɛt nɛ.
Belaa o kpɔ takpeɡ bol waa ŋɔ, “Korowii sweere andɛɛɡa ɡwaa haahna bwa, dɛ swee he bie waa lɔ he tea bini la ɡe andɛɛɡa.
N ɡee umeo n Dɔɔ nya ɛɛ ba ba chɔɔ mɛ nɔɔ?
Buɡ la ta, he wobol aa chole n deŋna ta la, bie waa lɔ n tea bini la den kpɔ silɛɛ ne hɛɡra dɛ lɔ.
He na som kɛ haa no n Naa Korowii wobol dɛ yarada kɛŋɔ ɡɛ waa la ɛɛ ɛo nɔ.” Mɛɛre yel waa ɡoa kpɛɛ Korowii Anee Mɛɛre ŋɔ, “N dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii n bambile bwa ne.
N sie lɛ Korowii waa ɛ n Lɛɛ la nɛ.
O nyiŋi n ɡe maɡa nɔ dɔŋ maa ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre nɔ nɛ, dɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa ɛɛ ba taraken lee dɛɛ bol n waa ŋɔ n na som, dɛkalkɛ Nemenɛ Korowii ɛ wejena tɛ mɛ.
O chɛ duura.
Nɛra te bwa baa dɛ ɔmɔ la, o dɛ na ba sum, dɛɛ na ba biirere sum, dɛɛ na ba ɡe biirere ne ba naanar bwa sum.
O chaɡle o kpeɡri dɛ doŋi nɛra baa dɛ lii ba te nɛnjena la ba peɡre.
O ir kpeɡnɛra ba kora ta, dɛ ɡɔɔ nɛŋɡwɛɡra baa di kpeɡri.
O tɛ nyaara kondɛɛɡa ba di, dɛ doŋi dɔɔhna ba kpɔ nɔŋɡbala kaa.
O lii nyobaɡa waa baɡɛ ya naawa la, dɛ lawɛ o bonɔɔna Israel tena bini kpoŋe wobɛlbwa ta, dɛɛ sune ba nɛ, ɡɛ tenten waa baɡɛ Abraham ne o naanar nyoa kɛ wɛɛ na ba sumii saŋ bɛlbwa la.” Belaa Mɛɛre so Ɛlesabɛt be dɛ ɛ korobie atoro mɔɔ dɛ kaa o bwɛ.
Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee lola wa Ɛlesabɛt lola aa tela la, o lolɛ bibaa.
O nɛra ne o bala aa no ɡɛ Korowii aa na o sum dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa tɛo la, o ne ba bwa sie lɛo.
Bie la aa dɔ yawanyoa la, ba balɔ ŋɔ ba ba teŋe o pen, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin bá kpɔ o mɛɛ Sekaria sɔn pao.
Anee o nya Ɛlesabɛt ŋɔ, “Akai!
A chɛ kɛ yá pao Jɔn!” Belaa ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Aah, he lole bɛlbwa ta ɡɛ sɔn nɔ dii yɔ!” Asɛ ba kpɔ nɔɔra dɛ baɡle waa Sekaria be, dɛ bɔɔro sɔn waa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ba kpɔ pa o bie la.
Belaa Sekaria ɡel ba nyin dapɛɡa tɛo, asɛ o chwerɛ o ta dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, “Bie la sɔne Jɔn.” Nɛra baa lɔ bela la ŋɔ ba ta nyokpowaa nɔ dɔŋa nae bwa.
Buɡ la ta la, Sekaria o fa aa wola won bol waa la nyoa chaarɔ, o won bol wa, dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ waa ɛ wejena tɛo la.
Belaa ɔmee lawɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela la bwa, asɛ ba kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ perɛ Juda deŋɡarere harɛ bwɛɛre la bwa ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa no waa nɔ la, o liira o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ ɡɛ bie nɔ ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?” Ba nao kɛŋɔ Korowii teŋɛ bie la nɛ.
Sekaria yel waa ɡoa kpɛɛ Korowii Jɔn mɛɛ Sekaria ɡe la, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe baa so o nɛ, asɛ o won bol waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o cha o nɛra dɛ lɛ yaa le wahala ta.
O tɛ yaa nɛnjen o le o bonɔɔ Devid dea, dɛ ŋɔ ó ba lɛ yaa.
O cheɡɛ o keamere la nɛɛ dɛ bol wubwa ŋɔ wɛɛ lɛ yaa le ya dɔma ne nɛra baa hah yaa bwa sekwaraa nɔn taa, dɛ́ na ya sum ɡɛ waa baɡɛ ya naawa nyoa la, dɛ́ lii o fɔo o ne baa fɔwa la.
O ne ya naa Abrahamee fɔwɛ fɔo la, asɛ o ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡlo kɛŋɔ wɛɛ lɛ yaa le ya dɔma nɔn taa ásɛ ya tomɔ yaa wola ɔmɛ, ásɛ ya ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa do ɡoroŋ o sie ya soɡa bini bwa.” Anee Sekaria bol waa o bie la be ŋɔ, “N bie, baa yerɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii keamee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ hɛɛ tɔ ya Dɔɔ siee, dɛ́ kwaa bɔr tɛo ásɛ o ba, ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ o nɛra be ŋɔ, dɛ ba charɛ ba liire dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta naa, wɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛ ba dɛ́ lɛɛ ba.
N Naa Korowii tea aa dɛ domɛ nɛn nɛɛ kohona nomanta, wɛɛ ɡeloo o wee ɛɛ chaah yaa, ásɛ dɛ chaah ya banɔ la yaa lɔ biro ta dɛɛ ɔmɛ seo la, dɛ́ chaɡle yaa deŋnesɔɔhna ŋwɛnɛ.” Kenii a do asɛ Jɔn kpeɡ, dɛ dɔ nomonliire.
O soɡe pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ tɔpere waa pa o toma mun Israel tena bini aa tela.
Yeesu Kristo lola wa A ɡɛ saŋ la Rom Koojen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Ɔɡɛstas la do mmara ŋɔ bá kure nɛra baa lɔ harɛ bobɛlbwa.
A ɡɛ nɛra kura nɔɔ tɔ sie.
Dɛ Kwiriniosii dɛɛ nyiŋi Siiria harɛ ta a ɡɛ saŋ.
Anomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ kaa o bwɛɛ dɛ́ ka chwerɛ o sɔn.
Anee Josef le Nasarɛt waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta la, dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta kaa Bɛtlɛham waa ɛ Devid bwɛɛ dɛ do Juda harɛ ta la, dɛ ka chwerɛ o sɔn, dɛkalkɛŋɔ belaa ɛ o naa Devid bwɛ.
Josef ne Mɛɛre ba bwa nɛra aa sɛah ŋɔ bá so la bwaa la Bɛtlɛham sɔna chwera la ta.
Dɛ Mɛɛre kpoŋe tea ɡɛ saŋ.
Baa lɔ bela la, lol lɔɔ, asɛ o lolɛ o binyoa, o ɛ bibaa.
O kpɔ yal fɔrɔwo dɛ kpɔɔ bil kon jaɡre aa dɛ di kwaa o bini la bini, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ bɔr toole bela hɔɔhra aa dɛ chɔ bwɛɛ la ta la kwara bá chɔ.
Peteɡra ne nyundua toroma wa A ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ peteɡra bane teɡɛ ba peera kaa dibɔr, asɛ bɔr jo, asɛ ba chɔ bela dɛɛ daah ba peera la.
Belaa Korowii nyundua torome bɛl forɛ le ba nɛ, asɛ Korowii jirima chaah bela.
Ɔmee laɡ ba taeh.
Anee nyundua torome la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ berɛ ɔma!
Amanesoma aa dɛ ba silɛɛ ne bala ba tɛ nɛra bwa la nee n ba.
Jwaana nɔ ne, ba lolɛ he Lɛɛ.
He Dɔɔ Kristo Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ heyaa laanee ba lole Devid bwɛɛ la.
Waa haa che a ta jemɔ laanee nɔ.
Hɛɛ na bie laanee kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ yal fɔrɔwo o chɔ kon jaɡre aa dɛ di kwaa o bini la bini.” Buɡ la ta, dɛ Korowii dɔm bane baa wara denɔ ba ja onɔ la nɛ, dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé tɛ Korowii waa lɔ nyundua la sɔn, ásɛ dɛ ɡel nɛwɛnyina baa lɔ harɛ ta Korowii siwi aa su ba la ɡe dɔ bosɔɔhna.” Nyundua toroma la aa le peteɡra la be dɛ kaa nyundua la, ba ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya la Bɛtlɛham dɛ́ ka na waa aa chiɡ bela, asɛ N Naa Korowii che nyundua toroma nɔ nɛɛ dɛ ba bol ya be nɔ.” Ba chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ la bela warane, dɛ ka na Mɛɛre ne Josef, dɛ na bie la ɡe kɛ waa chɔ kon jaɡre aa dɛ di kwaa o bini la bini.
Belaa peteɡra la aa na bie la la, ba bol nɛra baa cheme bela la be ɡɛ nyundua torome la aa baa bol bie la waa ba be la.
Nɛra baa cheme bela aa no waa nɔ la, ba bwa nyoa kpo waa peteɡra la aa bola la ta.
Asɛ Mɛɛre kpɔ waa la bwa do o nyu bini dɛɛ kari.
Peteɡra la berɔ dɛɛ kaa.
Gɛ nyundua torome la aa bol ba be la tentenee ba ka na.
Anomanta, ba ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii.
Yeesu lolanar kpɔɔ la Korowii Dea Bie la aa dɔ yawanyoa la, ba teŋe o pen, dɛ pa o sɔn Yeesu, ɡɛ tenten nyundua torome la aa ŋɔa mɔɔ o nya kpoŋe o tea la.
Tɔpere aa tela kɛŋɔ Mɛɛre sɔ o lola doŋa ta ɡɛ Mosis Mmara la aa baɡla la, o ne Josef kpɔ ba bie Yeesu ja ba nɛɛ dɛ la Korowii Dea Jerusalam dɛ kpɔɔ ka baɡle Korowii, ɡɛ Mmara la aa baɡla kɛ bibanloɡle bɛlbwa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔɔ tɛ Korowii la.
Ba laŋɔ asɛ dɛ ka ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii ɡɛ Mmara la aa baɡla ŋɔ bá kpɔ borɔnomare anɛ, kɛɛ kulukukure anɛ la Korowii Dea dɛ́ ka jaamo la.
A ɡɛ saŋ la dɛ baa bɛl lɔ Jerusalam baa yerɔ Simeon.
O ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe, dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛ o dɛ nyiŋi naate waa dɛ ba ó ba lɛ Israel tena ŋwɛnɛ.
Dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ir o nɛ, dɛ ɡel o jemɛ kɛŋɔ o siwi ɛɛ na Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ Israel tena la mɔɔ dɛ́ sewɛ.
Awola tɔpere la, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpɔ Simeon kaa Korowii Dea, asɛ Josef ne Mɛɛre ɡe kpɔ Yeesu la bela, ásɛ ba ɛo ba we-ɛɛla ɡɛ Mmara la aa baɡla la.
Baa joa la, Simeon kaa kpɔ Yeesu pɛl o bambile dɛ jam Korowii dɛ kpɛɛro, dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, he teŋɛ he nyobaɡa ta, name te hɛɛ wonoo ɡel men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ sewɛ sɔnɔnɔɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n siwi na ya Lɛɛ, haa leo tɛ yaa ŋɔ nɛra bwa nao la.
On dɛɛ ba he waa kpɔe dɛ́ baɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, ásɛ he nɛra Israel tena dɔ jirima la.” Gɛ Simeon aa bol Yeesu waa la kpo Yeesu nya ne o mɛɛ nyoa.
Simeon soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ Yeesu nya ne o mɛɛ, dɛ ŋɔ o nya be ŋɔ, “Hé no waa nɔ!
Bie nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ Israel tena bane kwaara ne bane chɔɡa.
Wɛɛ berɔɔ che tɛ Korowii, ásɛ nɛra bol waa yaɡɔ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bambile bini waa chɔ baŋ.
Gɛ baa dɛ ba o ɛɛ la, aa we he nɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ kere dɛɛ tɔɡɛ he bambile ken.” A ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ luhaah bɛl lole dɛ ɛ Korowii keame, baa yerɔ Hana.
Dɛ Fanoɛl bihaahnee on, asɛ o le Aasa dea.
Dɛ o hwɛɛhrɔ.
O yalɔ o toli saŋ, o ne o jaa so bene anuanɛ asɛ o jaa la ba sewɛ.
O ta yalɛ kpa, dɛ ba di bene fifraanuatoro dɛ anaarɛ.
O ta o Korowii toma kpɔe bil harɛ.
Chɔɔ ne jwaana dɛ o lɔ Korowii Dea, dɛ yon dɛɛ vɔwɛ nyoa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii.
Buɡ la ta, Yeesu nya ne o mɛɛ aa lɔ Korowii Dea la, Hana ɡe jo bela dɛ ka che ba jwɛh, dɛ kpɔ jam ne kpɛɛra tɛ Korowii, dɛ bol Yeesu waa baɡle nɛra baa soɡa dɛɛ kpa Korowii kɛ ó ba lɛ Jerusalam tena ta la.
Josef ne Mɛɛre aa tona ɡɛ Korowii Mmara la aa baɡla la, ba berɔ kaa ba bwɛɛ Nasarɛt waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta la.
Yeesu kpeɡo, dɛ do kpeɡri, dɛ dɔ liire, asɛ Korowii chao wɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Yeesu aa lɔ Korowii Dea wa Bena nyoa bɛlbwaa Yeesu nya ne o mɛɛ la Jerusalam dɛ kaa di ba tɔpejen baa dɛ yerɔ Galekaa la.
Gɛ saŋ Yeesu aa di bene fi dɛ anɛ la, o ne o nya ne o mɛɛ la Jerusalam dɛ ka di a ɡɛ tɔpere la, ɡɛ ba yon dɛɛ ɛ wubwa la.
Baa di tɔpere la tonɛ dɛ berɛ dɛɛ kaa ba bwɛɛ la, Yeesu pere o te le ba nɛ, dɛ ka mun so Jerusalam, dɛ o nya ne mɛɛ ta jemɛ.
Dɛ ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o lɔ nɛra baa pɛa dɛɛ kaa la bini.
Anomanta, ba valɔ tɔpebir mɔɔ dɛ ta kaa nyin o bɔr ba lolanar ne ba jerema be.
Baa nyin o bɔr kahonɛ la, ba berɔ la Jerusalam dɛ kaa ɡaaɡe o bɔr.
A tɔpetooro wee la, ba kaa nao Korowii Dea, dɛ o ne Juu tena baa dɛ baɡle Korowii waa soɡo, wɛɛ no ba wa, dɛɛ bɔɔ ba wa.
Nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛɛ no waa la bwa nyoa kpo ɡɛ waa jemɛ waa kohona, ne ɡɛ baa dɛ bɔɔro waa asɛ o won dɛɛ baɡle a bini kɛrɛdɛ la ta.
O nya ne o mɛɛ aa nao la, ba nyoa kpoo, anee o nya bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N bidɛɛɡe, bɔkwa waa he ɛ yaa ken?
N ne he mɛɛ bwa siwi swɛɛrɔ, ya kpɔ sibeɡra dɛɛ ɡaaɡe he bɔr.” Belaa o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin n bɔr nɔɔ?
He ta wone jemɛ kɛŋɔ n Mɛɛ Korowii deemii n do kɛɛ?” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, ba ta a mun noɛ.
Belaa Yeesu ir ba chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ kaa Nasarɛt.
Waa lɔ o nya ne o mɛɛ be la, dɛ o dɛ no ba deŋna wa.
O nya kpɔ waa la bwa do o nyu bini dɛɛ kara.
Dɛ Yeesu dɛ kpeɡ dɛɛ jemɛ wa, asɛ o we-ɛɛla ɛɛ lɛ Korowii ne nɛra sie.
Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee wa Gɛ saŋ Siisa Tibeereɔs aa di Rom kora bene fi dɛ anue la, dɛ Pɔnteɔs Paelet ɛ Juda harɛ nomoa, asɛ Hɛrɔd ɛ Galilia harɛ kooro, asɛ o dɔɔ Felep ɛ Ituria ne Trakonaetes harɛre kooro.
Dɛ Laiseenias ɛ Abilini harɛ kooro, asɛ Anas ne Kaefas ɛ Sɔfonomonome Jerusalam.
Gɛ saŋee Korowii kpɔ o waa do Jɔn waa ɛ Sekaria bie la nyoa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la, asɛ o ir dɛ bol Korowii Waa la bwɛɛre aa bar Jɔɔdan Moo la bwa ta, dɛɛ ŋɔ nómɛlbwa charɛ o liire dɛ́ le o wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ ba sɔɔ Korowii nee ásɛ Korowii kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo.
Gɛ waa nɔɔ Korowii keame Aesaya chwerɛ o tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Nomɛl dɛ bol waa takpeɡ ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ ŋɔ, nɛ́ra ɡel ba we-ɛɛla toɡre, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ kpa ba Dɔɔ bala.
Fɛlembɔɔ te bɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé tɔɔ, dɛ́ bur deŋɡare ne bwe te bɛlbwa.
Ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa waa ɡola la chɛ kɛŋɔ hé toɡro, dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa bɔɔne bɔɔnere aa lɔ o ta ó chɔ kpalantaŋ.
Nɛwɛnyina bwa ɛɛ nao ɡɛ lɛɛ Korowii aa dɛ ba yaa lɛɛ la aa doa.” Belaa Jɔn ŋɔ nɛnlaa baa lea ba o be ŋɔ ó sɔ ba nee la be ŋɔ, “Nɛnchɔɡa kɛŋɔ domkpuli bii baa do nii kpɔɡ ta asɛ a le dɛ chwa dɛɛ kaa!
Umee ŋɔ he be ŋɔ hɛɛ wonoo chwa le Korowii bandia ta nɔ?
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ chaɡle kɛŋɔ he charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa ta kpela.
He bɛ he hwɛɡa kpɔ do Abraham nɛɛ kɛ o ɛ he nabaa nomanta, hɛɛ wonoo chwa Korowii bandia.
Hé ɡel n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, Korowii ɛɛ wonoo ɡel bwea nɔ beɡre Abraham naanar.
He do kɛŋɔ daa.
Daa bɛlbwa waa wola nɔndɛɛɡa nɔnɛ la, baa teŋoo ta dɛ́ fuuh.
Gɛɛ Korowii ɡe ɡɔɔ o kpanfɛ nɛra baa wola ba liire charɛ la nɛɛ dɛɛ ba ba teŋna ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ba do nii ta bá fuh.” Anee nɛnlaa la aa baro cheme la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Aah, ɛrɛɛ yá ɛɔ?” Asɛ o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ batakaani bele anɛ la, ó kpɔ bɛl tɛ nɛn waa wola bɛl dɔe kwaraa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa o ɡe aa dɔ kondikwaa dɛ́ di la ɡe ɛ ɡɛ tenten.” Belaa toɔ lɛɛra baa dɛ bɔ apoo bane ba ŋɔ ó sɔ ba Korowii ne, dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ yá ɛɔ?” Anee o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He bɛ suuɡa lɛ dɛɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ lɛ.” Soojare bane ɡe ba o be dɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Asɛ ya ɡe sɛh?
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ yá ɡee ɛɔ?” Asɛ o ŋɔ ba ɡe be ŋɔ, “He bɛ nɛra ɛɡre dɛɛ lɛ suuɡa ba be, dɛ bɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe suuɡa lɛ dɛ tɔ o wechɔɡa ta.
Hé ɡel he kembɔr ɛɛ su he siwi.” Nɛnlaa la hɛɡra den ir waa aa dɛ ba bala la ta, baa lii ba nyu bini kɛŋɔ Jɔnee ken ɛ Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ásɛ o ba lɛ yaa la.
Anomanta, Jɔn ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nee tenten nee mɛɛ sɔ heya.
Kɛ nomɛl ta dɛ ba dɛ ɡwaa mɛ, maa wola o napaa teera kwaraa dɔ.
O te, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ne nii nee wɛɛ ba heyaa sɔe.
O do kɛŋɔ paa waa cheɡɛ o pɛla ta, dɛ kpɔ o te dɛɛ ba mea pala.
Wɛɛ palɛ a bwaa kɛrɛdɛ ken, ásɛ dɛ pa ka do dɔndɔŋ bini cheɡ.
Kɛ a pɛɡa la te, wɛɛ kpɔ nii aa wola dime bwaa fuah.” Amanesoma Jɔn aa bola dɛ kpɔ ja nɛra la te ta nyoa dɔe.
Jɔn ŋɔ Galilia Kooro Hɛrɔd be ŋɔ moe waa mo o nime haah Hɛrɔdeas la, ne wechɔɡa bwa waa ɛa ja la ta maɡrɛ.
Gɛ waa nɔ Jɔn aa bol o be la nomanta, o ɡelɔ ba lawɔ do dea dɛ den do anam kwara.
Yeesu Korowii nee sɔe wa Gɛ saŋ Jɔn fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra la bwa Korowii nee la, o sɔ Yeesu ɡe.
Yeesu nee sɔe ta, waa dɛ soŋe Korowii la, nyundua pilo, asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe do kɛŋɔ borɔnoma ken dɛ ba so o nɛ, asɛ ba no taa bɛl nyundua kɛŋɔ, “Henee n bie maa dɛ nyin he wa, he waa ɛɛ su n siwi.” Gɛ Yeesu Kristo nabaala aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ Gɛ saŋ Yeesu aa pa mun dɛɛ ɛ o toma la, dɛ o di bene dɛ ɛ fifraatoro, dɛ nɛra dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Josef biee.
Josef ɡe mɛɛɛ Heli, Heli ɡe mɛɛɛ Matat, Matat ɡe mɛɛɛ Lewi, Lewi ɡe mɛɛɛ Mɛlke, Mɛlke ɡe mɛɛɛ Janai, asɛ Janai la ɡe mɛɛɛ Josef.
Josef ɡe mɛɛɛ Matateas, Matateas ɡe mɛɛɛ Emɔs, Emɔs ɡe mɛɛɛ Neehum, Neehum ɡe mɛɛɛ Ɛsle, Ɛsle ɡe mɛɛɛ Naɡae, asɛ Naɡae la ɡe mɛɛɛ Mat Maat ɡe mɛɛɛ Matateas, Matateas ɡe mɛɛɛ Semein, Semein ɡe mɛɛɛ Josek, Josek ɡe mɛɛɛ Jɔda, Jɔda ɡe mɛɛɛ Jɔhanan, asɛ Jɔhanan la ɡe mɛɛɛ Resa.
Resa ɡe mɛɛɛ Sɛrobabɛl, Sɛrobabɛl ɡe mɛɛɛ Sealteɛl, Sealteɛl ɡe mɛɛɛ Nɛre, Nɛre ɡe mɛɛɛ Mɛlke, Mɛlke ɡe mɛɛɛ Adi, asɛ Adi la ɡe mɛɛɛ Kosam.
Kosam ɡe mɛɛɛ Ɛlmadam, Ɛlmadam ɡe mɛɛɛ Er, Er ɡe mɛɛɛ Josua, Josua ɡe mɛɛɛ Eliesa, Eliesa ɡe mɛɛɛ Jorim, asɛ Jorim la ɡe mɛɛɛ Matat.
Matat ɡe mɛɛɛ Lewi, Lewi ɡe mɛɛɛ Simeon, Simeon ɡe mɛɛɛ Juda, Juda ɡe mɛɛɛ Josef, Josef ɡe mɛɛɛ Jonam, asɛ Jonam la ɡe mɛɛɛ Eliakim.
Eliakim ɡe mɛɛɛ Mɛlea, Mɛlea ɡe mɛɛɛ Mɛna, Mɛna ɡe mɛɛɛ Matata, Matata ɡe mɛɛɛ Netan, Netan ɡe mɛɛɛ Devid, asɛ Devid la ɡe mɛɛɛ Jese.
Jese ɡe mɛɛɛ Ɔbɛd, Ɔbɛd ɡe mɛɛɛ Boas, Boas ɡe mɛɛɛ Salmon, Salmon ɡe mɛɛɛ Naasɔn, Naasɔn ɡe mɛɛɛ Aminadab, asɛ Aminadab la ɡe mɛɛɛ Admin.
Admin ɡe mɛɛɛ Aani, Aani ɡe mɛɛɛ Hɛsrɔn, Hɛsrɔn ɡe mɛɛɛ Pɛrɛs, Pɛrɛs ɡe mɛɛɛ Juda, Juda ɡe mɛɛɛ Jekɔb, asɛ Jekɔb la ɡe mɛɛɛ Aesek.
Aesek ɡe mɛɛɛ Abraham, Abraham ɡe mɛɛɛ Tɛɛra, Tɛɛra ɡe mɛɛɛ Neehɔ, Neehɔ ɡe mɛɛɛ Sɛrɔɡ, Sɛrɔɡ ɡe mɛɛɛ Reu, asɛ Reu la ɡe mɛɛɛ Pɛlɛɡ.
Pɛlɛɡ ɡe mɛɛɛ Iba, Iba ɡe mɛɛɛ Seela, Seela ɡe mɛɛɛ Keinan, Keinan ɡe mɛɛɛ Aafaksad, Aafaksad ɡe mɛɛɛ Sɛm, asɛ Sɛm la ɡe mɛɛɛ Nowa.
Nowa ɡe mɛɛɛ Lamɛk, Lamɛk ɡe mɛɛɛ Mɛtusala, Mɛtusala ɡe mɛɛɛ Enɔk, Enɔk ɡe mɛɛɛ Jarɛd, Jarɛd ɡe mɛɛɛ Mahalalel, asɛ Mahalalel la ɡe mɛɛɛ Keinan.
Keinan ɡe mɛɛɛ Enɔs, Enɔs ɡe mɛɛɛ Sɛt, Sɛt ɡe mɛɛɛ Adam, asɛ Korowiirii ta Adam.
Gɛ Bɔnsam aa daah Yeesu na wa Yeesu aa le o Korowii nee sɔe la bɔr Jɔɔdan Moo ta dɛɛ kaa dem la, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ir o nɛ, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, asɛ o ka do bela tɔpera fifraanaarɛ.
Asɛ Bɔnsam ka daahno na a ɡɛ tɔpera nɔ ta.
Dɛ waa komɛlbwa di, anomanta, a habɔɔ la, dɛ lɔr lawɔ.
Bela la, Bɔnsam ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ henee Korowii Bie la kpela aa, ɡel bwe nɔ berɛ paanoo hé di.” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, ‘Kondikwaa ɡbo laa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn mkpa.’ ” Asɛ Bɔnsam berɛ kpɔɔ ka chɔŋɛ bobɛl waa do kɛŋɔ bwejen bɛl doa, dɛ baɡlo harɛ nɔ ta bela bwa kora dii aa lole ɡale o sie ta, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he kpɔ duure tɛ mɛ naa, mɛɛ kpɔ a kpeɡri ne a kondɔɔh bwaa tɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a bwa sekwaraa lɔ n nɔn ta.
Nɛn maa dɛ nyin laanee n kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ.
Dɛ he kpɔ duure tɛ mɛ naa, a bwa dɛ ba he kwaa ɛɛ, he di a kpeɡri.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, ‘Dɛɛ duu N Naa Korowii dɛɛ tomɛ o ɡbo.’ ” Belaa Bɔnsam kpɔɔ kaa bwɛjen Jerusalam, dɛ kpɔɔ ka cheɡ Korowii Dea la nyundujaɡla, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ henee Korowii Bie la kpela aa, che bonɔ dɛ́ jah le harɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo o nyundua toroma ɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Baa lawɛɛ haa wola nakpala kwaraa lɔ.’ ” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, ‘Bɛ N Naa Korowii daah na.’ ” Bɔnsam aa daah Yeesu ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta kɛ ó fe ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ kahonɛ la, o ɡelo dɛ kaa tama mɔɔ.
Yeesu toma mun pae Galilia harɛ ta Dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri lɔ Yeesu nɛ, asɛ o berɛ la Galilia harɛ.
Belaa o waa perɛ baah bela bwɛɛre la bwa ta.
O la ba cheremi deene bini dɛ ka bol Korowii Waa nɛra be, ba bwa kpɛɛro.
O ba Nasarɛt bela baa dɛɛro la, asɛ ɡɛ o yon dɛɛ ɛ Ona Tɔpere bɛlbwa la, o la cheremi dea, dɛ ir che ŋɔ ó kure Korowii Tɔn la.
Asɛ ba kpɔ Korowii keame Aesaya tɔn la ba do o nɔn ta.
O pili tɔn la, dɛ na bela baa chwera ŋɔ, “Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ir n nɛ, dɛ lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol Amanesoma baɡle nyaara, dɛ́ ŋɔ nɛra baa laɡ ba yoma, ne nɛra baa do ba dea be ŋɔ ba Lɛɛ balɔ, dɛ́ ɡel nyoŋa sibie pili ba won dɛɛ na, dɛ́ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la le ba dɔma nɔn ta, asɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra bwa jemɛ kɛ tɔpere Korowii aa dɛ ba o nɛra Lɛɛ la telo.” Ate, Yeesu kure tɔn la tonɛ dɛ laa tɔ, dɛ kpɔ do nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi cheremi dea bela la nɔn ta, dɛ so harɛ.
Asɛ nɛra baa lɔ cheremi dea bela la bwa kpɔ sie pa o nɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋu fuuu ken.
O berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Fini, waa haa noa le Korowii Tɔn bini nɔ chiɡo ɡɛ Korowii aa bola ŋɔ aa ɛo la.” Belaa nɛra la bwa kpɛɛro.
Ba nyoa kpo ɡɛ o nyoa ne wobol aa soma la, asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Josef bie la laa nɔ naa?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N jemɔ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ sɛɡ mɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Tɛɛɡa te, chah he te.
Gɛ yaa noa kɛ he ɛ Kapeeneɔm la, ɛ ane he ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ bonɔ ɡe.’ ” Dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, Korowii keame ta sɔn dɔe o ɡbaɡba bwɛ.
N dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ɡɛ saŋ Korowii keame Elaeja fa aa lole hwel che bene atoro korobie anumɛl bwaala aa wola nɛ, asɛ lɔr chole harɛ la bwa ta la, dɛ luhaahna warɔ dɛ do Israel tena bini, kɛ Korowii ta Elaeja tomɛ ba bini bɛlbwa be.
Luhaah bɛl waa lɔ Sidon harɛ bwɛɛ bɛl baa yerɔ Sarefat la ɡbo bee o tomɔ.
Gɛ saŋ Korowii keame Elaesa fa aa lole la, dɛ Israel tena weechɔɡa ane aa chɔɡ ba bwadabii warɔ.
Kɛ o ta ba bɛlbwa chaeh.
Siiria harɛ baa Naaman ɡboo o chah.” Nɛra baa lɔ cheremi dea bela la aa no waa nɔ la, dɛ bwaawee laɡ ba.
Dɛ ba bwɛɛ la chɔŋɛ bwe ta.
Ba iro dɛ tɛɡre Yeesu le bwɛɛ la ta, dɛ kpɔɔ ka che bwe la doa bobɛl waa wila su, dɛ́ fee taɡɔ ta, ásɛ o nyu ba yaɡɛ harɛ.
Anee o valɛ jo nɛra la baah, dɛ valɛ o tetoora kaa.
Baa bɛl kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛ Yeesu la Galilia harɛ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kapeeneɔm la ta, dɛ kaa baɡ ba Korowii Waa Ona Tɔpere ta, asɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ baɡle Korowii Waa la ɛ ba bwa nyokpoa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o dɛ bol waa kpeɡri ne.
Cheremi dea bela la, dɛ baa bɛl lɔ bela, kwaa ɛɛ ir o nɛ, asɛ o do lɔŋɔ ŋɔ, “Aa!
Yeesu Nasarɛt te, bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ya be nɔ?
Ya chɔɡaa he ba kɛɛ?
N jemɛ he nɛnsoo.
Henee Korowii Biɡoroŋ waa ŋɔa ŋɔ o dɛ ba bala la.” Anee Yeesu kɔr kwaa la aa lɔ baa la nɛɛ la ŋɔ, “Hé tɔ nyoa dɛ́ le o nɛ!” Belaa a lɔ baa la bil nɛra la siwi ta.
A ta on wobɛlbwa ɛɛ, dɛ le o nɛɛ dɛ kaa.
Nɛra baa lɔ bela la bwa nyoa kpoo, ba ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa nɔɔ!
Hé na ɡɛ baa nɔ aa kpɔ kpeɡri bol waa baɡle kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ asɛ a kaa!” Anomanta, Yeesu waa perɛ baah bela bwɛɛre la bwa ta.
Yeesu chah nɛndamanta bane Yeesu le cheremi dea bela dɛ la Seemɔn dem, dɛ Seemɔn helahaah bwara wɔrɔbɔ tenten, asɛ ba bol o waa Yeesu be ŋɔ ó chaoh.
Belaa o la weela te la be o chɔɔbɔr, dɛ ka che o jwɛh, dɛ kɔr o weela la, asɛ a le o nɛ o bwara sɔɔhno, buɡ la ta, o ir dɛ daa kwaa tɛɛ ba.
Wee aa dɛ jo la, nɛra baa dɔ chamene tena baa we weela bwa soo siwi la kpɔ ba ba Yeesu be, asɛ o kpɔ o nɔɔra dawɛ ba nɛɛ dɛ chah ba bwa sekwaraa.
Kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ la le ba nɛɛ pirim.
Aa dɛ le dɛ a dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Henee Korowii Bie la!” Yeesu kah kwaa la, o ta ɡelɛ a bol wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a jemɔ kɛŋɔ onee Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ o nɛra la.
Yeesu Korowii waa bola cheremi deene bini Bɔr aa dɛ chaah la, Yeesu le bwɛɛ la ta, dɛ ka so bela nomɛlbwa aa wola toole.
Dɛ nɛra iro dɛɛ nyin o bɔr.
Baa nao la, ba ta on ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ kɛ o kaa bobɛlbwa, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ɡel ba ne o so.
Anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛŋɔ ń bol Korowii Kora Amanesoma la bwɛɛre ane ɡe ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ anee Korowii tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba ɛ.” Anomanta, o valɔ dɛɛ bol Amanesoma la dɛɛ baɡle nɛra cheremi deene bini Juda harɛ bwa.
Gɛ Yeesu aa yerɛ o loɡla habɔteŋra Awola bɛl, dɛ Yeesu cheɡɛ Gɛnɛsarɛt Moo la nyoa, asɛ nɛnlaa bane ba baro cheme, dɛ taɡɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ ba o be dɛ́ ba no Korowii Waa waa dɛ bol la.
Yeesu na ɡbeni anɛ ane nɛra bane baa dɛ ɛ nee toma aa lawa vɔwɛ, dɛ le kaa chɛɡɛ ba asauri.
Belaa o ka jo ɡbera la bɛl bini.
Dɛ baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Seemɔn konee.
O ŋɔ Seemɔn be ŋɔ ó taɡɛ ɡbera la do tama.
Anee o taɡɛ do tama, asɛ Yeesu so o bini dɛ bol waa baɡle nɛnlaa la.
Waa bol waa baɡle nɛra la tonɛ la, o ŋɔ Seemɔn be ŋɔ, “He ne he bala la pa he asauri la do ɡbera nɔ bini, dɛ́ ɛɡɛ do baah ta, dɛ́ ka ta.” Anee Seemɔn ŋɔ, “E!
N Dɔɔ, jwaana ne bwaa ya le ta asauri nɔ, ya ta komɛlbwa dɔe.
Kɛ haa dɔa ŋɔ ɡɛ nɔ te naa, mɛɛ ɡeloo ya ka ta.” Baa taɡɛ ɡbera la do nebaah ta la, ba kaa ta asau la bɔle pɛŋedamanta ane nɛ, asɛ wɛɛ ba kɛɛra.
Anomanta, ba laa nɔn ir ba bala bane ba ne baa dɛ ɛ tonsiwi beŋkpoŋ dɛ do ɡbera bɛl bini la ŋɔ bá ba, dɛ́ ba cha ba, ba tɛɡre pɛŋa la do ɡbeni anɛ la bwa bini a su dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin dɛ morɛ.
Seemɔn baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Pita aa na a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o kaa ɡuŋi Yeesu sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Oo, n Dɔɔ, wechɔɡ-ɛɛree men!
N poori, le n be.” Pɛŋedamanta Seemɔn ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la aa dɔa la ɛ ba bwa nyokpoa.
Gɛ tentenee a ɛ ba bala Sebedii bii Jɔn ne Jems la nyokpoa.
Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ Seemɔn be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ ɔma.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa, hɛɛ ɡel pɛŋa nyinaa dɛ́ baa teŋɛ n nɛ, ásɛ n baɡle heyaa ɡɛ baa nyin nɛra baa tɛ Korowii.” Baa tawɛ ba ɡbeni la ba chuɡe dɛ lawa vɔrɔwe la, ba ɡel wobɛlbwa dɛɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Yeesu chah baa bɛl weechɔɡa aa ɛ o bwara Awola bɛl, dɛ Yeesu lɔ bwɛɛ bɛl ta, dɛ baa bɛl lɔ bela asɛ weechɔɡa ɛ o bwara bwa.
Waa na Yeesu la, o baa ɡuŋi o sie dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, dɛ he sɛoh ŋɔ hɛɛ chaah mɛɛ yaa, hɛɛ wonoo ɡel n bwara kwaa.” Anee Yeesu tɛr nɔn leɡo, dɛ ŋɔ, “N sɛoh.
He bwara kwaarɔ.” Buɡ la ta, dɛ o weela la denɔ le o nɛ, o bwara kwaa.
Asɛ Yeesu kaoh ŋɔ, “Bɛ nomɛlbwa be ŋɔ, kɛ la Sɔfo be ó ka pɛne, ásɛ he kpɔ kwaa ka tɛo ó kpo, ɡɛ Mosis aa baɡla la, ásɛ nɛra bwa na dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ he weela la toole he nɛɛ kpa.” Waa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o bɛ nomɛlbwa be ŋɔ la, name tenee a ɛ anam.
Yeesu waa perɔ kohona, asɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba o be pirim dɛ baa no o waa la wɛɛ chaah ba weela.
Dɛ ba dɛ ba o be ɡɛ naa, ɡɛɛ o yon laa o te kpɔ ba bini, dɛ́ kaa bela nomɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ́ kaa soŋe Korowii.
Yeesu chah baa bɛl waa kuuɡa so Awola bɛl, dɛ Yeesu dɛ baɡle nɛra Korowii Wa, asɛ Farisii tena bane ne Tɔnjerema baa le Galilia harɛ, ne Juda harɛ bwɛɛre la bwa ta ne Jerusalam ba, dɛ ba so bela, dɛ Korowii tɛo kpeɡri asɛ wɛɛ chah weela tena.
Belaa baala bane che baa bɛl waa kuuɡa ne o kalaŋ ba, asɛ dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin bɔr dɛ́ kpɔɔ jo dem bela Yeesu aa lole la dɛ́ kpɔɔ ka bil o sie.
Bɔr aa fara la, ba ta wone kpɔ baa la ba o be, anee ba teeh dea la, dɛ ka forɛ sal la bela Yeesu aa cheɡa la, dɛ kpɔ baa la ne o kalaŋ waa chɔ o ta la, dɛ che bela kpɔɔ bil Yeesu sie nɛra la baah ta.
Yeesu aa na ɡɛ baa yaradao la, o ŋɔ baa la waa kuuɡa la be ŋɔ, “Baa, n kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛɛ.” Asɛ Tɔnjerema la ne Farisii tena baa soɡe bela la lii ba nyu bini ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ o do dɛɛ bol nɛnhɛlwaa ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Dɛ Korowii laa aa, umee dɛ́ won kpɔ nɛn wechɔɡa kɛo wɔ?” Yeesu aa na waa baa dɛ lii la, o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii ɡɛ waa nɔ nɔɔ?
Maa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ n kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo nɔ, ne kɛŋɔ maa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ir dɛ́ valɛ, a bini umee kpeɡa ɔ?
Mɛɛ chaɡle heyaa kɛŋɔ Men Nɛn Bie dɔ kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta kɛ ń kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa kɛ ba.” Belaa o ŋɔ naate waa kuuɡa la be ŋɔ, “N dɛ ŋɔ he be!
Ir dɛ́ kpɔ he kalaŋ kaa dem!” Asɛ baa la ir buɡ la ta, dɛ kpɔ o kalaŋ nɛra la bwa siwi ta bela, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii dɛɛ kaa.
Yeesu aa ɛ ɡɛ la, nɛra la bwa nyoa kpoo, ɔmee laɡ ba, asɛ baa kpɛɛ Korowii dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa nyokpowaa ya na fini ken?” Gɛ Yeesu aa yerɛ Lewi Anɔ habɔɔ la, Yeesu valɔ baa kaa dɛ na nomɛl waa soɡe o toma ta dɛɛ lɛ toɔ.
Dɛ o sɔne Lewi.
Yeesu aa nao la, o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir ba teŋɛ n nɛ.” Anee Lewi ɡel wobɛlbwa dɛ ir teŋɛ o nɛ.
Lewi ɡelɔ ba ɛ kondikonjena o dem dɛ hɔɔh Yeesu, asɛ o ne Yeesu ne toɔ lɛɛra pirim ne nɛra bane ka so dɛɛ di kwaa la.
Belaa Farisii tena ne ba bini Tɔnjerema la pwah o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ne toɔ lɛɛra baa dɛ bɔ nɛra apoo ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra pɛ dɛɛ di kwaa nɔɔ?” Yeesu aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Weela tenaa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe tɛɛɡa te bɔr, bokpeɡa tena laa.” Dɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa dɛ lii ba te nɛndɛɛɡa waa laa n ba.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra waa n ba, ásɛ ba charɛ ba liire.” Nyoa vɔwa wepɛɛre Asɛ ba pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa Jɔn habɔteŋra la ne Farisii tena la yon vɔwɛ nyoa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii, asɛ he habɔteŋra nɔ te aa wola ɡɛ ɛ nɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu sɛɡ ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Baa aa lawɛ hanfale dɛ yerɛ o daamanar ŋɔ bá ba lɛ ba sie nɔ, baa berɔɔ so lɔr aa?
Baa lɔree so.
Kɛ tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao kɛŋɔ baa lawɛ hanfale jaa laanee le ba bini.
Gɛ saŋ la te, baa vɔwɛ nyoaa.” Belaa o berɛ sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Baa yafale mɔnɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tɔ yabene bɔɔ.
Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ he chɔɡ onfale la, o ne ombene la ɡe aa dɔŋaa le.” Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Baa senfala kpɔe dɛɛ do loŋbena aa kɔɔhna bini dɛɛ tɔ a nyoo.
Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa, senfala la baa peraa, aa do kpeɡrii dɛ́ pere loŋa la á chɔɡ, ásɛ sen la fuɡe.
Senfala chɛ loŋfala.
Nomɛlbwa aa sen aa peraa nyɔ, dɛ́ berɛ kaa nyin anɔ la aa wola pere bɔr kpa, dɛkalkɛ ampera la wer tɛo.”
Ona Tɔpere wepɛɛre Awola Ona Tɔpere bɛl, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra kpɔ mea koo bɛl ta, asɛ o habɔteŋra la kuuɡi mea la ane dɛ fɔɡa dɛɛ chwe.
Baa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ la, Farisii tena bane nao dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ koni ya Ona Tɔpere Mmara nɔɔ?” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “He ta ɡɛ ya naa Devid aa ɛa saŋ la lɔr aa dɛ kpo o ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la kure kɛɛ?
O la Korowii Dea dɛ ka di paanoo aa ɛ Korowii kwa, nomɛlbwa fe aa wola ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ó di, atane kɛ sɔfore ɡbo la.
O diu, dɛ tɛ o nɛra ɡe ba di.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Men Nɛn Bie laanee dɔ Ona Tɔpere kpeɡri.” Baa bɛl o nɔn aa sewa wa Awola Ona Tɔpere bɛl, Yeesu la cheremi dea dɛ ka baɡle wa.
Dɛ baa bɛl lɔ bela, asɛ o nɔndiɡ sewɛ.
Dɛ Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena lole dɛɛ nyiŋi Yeesu kɛ wɛɛ chah baa laanee Ona Tɔpere la ta, ásɛ ba dɔ o waa dɛ́ bol.
Dɛ Yeesu te jemɛ waa baa dɛ lii, anee o yerɛ baa la o nɔndiɡ aa sewa la, dɛ ŋɔ ó ir ba che ba sie.
Asɛ o ir dɛ ba che ba sie.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N dɛ bɔɔ heya.
Ɛrɛɛ Korowii Mmara la ɛɛ baɡle yaa ŋɔ yá ɛ Ona Tɔpere ta laɔ?
A ɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta kɛ yaa ɛ nɛra wedɛɛɡa kɛɛ yaa ɛ nɛra wechɔɡa ɔ?
A ɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta kɛ ya lɛ nɛra mkpa kɛɛ yá chɔɡ baɔ?” Yeesu nyiŋi nɛra la bwa, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ baa la be ŋɔ ó tɛr o nɔn.
Waa tɛr o nɔn la, dɛ o nɔn la berɔ do kpeɡri.
Belaa Tɔnjerema la ne Farisii tena la baah di baa bol dɔŋa be ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ bá ɛ Yeesu.
Gɛ Yeesu aa le o toroma fi dɛ banɛ Yeesu aa le bela la, o la deŋɡare bɛl ta bela nomɛlbwa aa wola toole, dɛ ka do bela dɛɛ soŋe Korowii jwaana la bwa.
Tɔ aa pera la, o yerɛ o habɔteŋra la, asɛ dɛ kpɔ ba bini fi dɛ banɛ dɛ ŋɔ o toromaa ban.
O kpɔ Seemɔn waa pao Pita la, ne Pita nime Andriu, dɛ Jems ne Jɔn ne Felep ne Batolomeo, dɛ kpɔ Matiu ne Tɔmas ne Alfeɔs bie Jems, dɛ Seemɔn baa dɛ yerɔ Sɛlɔt la, dɛ kpɔ Jems bie Judas ne Judas Eskareɔt waa leo tɛ ba kpoo la.
Yeesu chaɡle nɛra waa dɛ chaah ba weela Waa le o toroma la tonɛ la, o ne ba le deŋɡare la doa dɛɛ tu harɛ, dɛ ba pu o habɔteŋra la bane, asɛ o ne ba che bobɛl waa chɔ harɛ.
Ba warɔ pirim dɛ le Juda harɛ, ne Jerusalam, ne mpo nyoa bwɛjena baa dɛ yera Taaya ne Sidon, dɛ ba o be dɛ ba no o wa, asɛ o chaah ba weela.
Nɛra kwaa aa dɛ ir ba nɛɛ a ɛɛ ba weela bwa ba bela, asɛ o doŋa ta ba.
Dɛ nɛra la bwa siwi swɛɛrɔ baa nyin dɛ́ leɡo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ kpeɡri bɛl le o bini dɛɛ chah ba bwa weela.
Som nae ne tebinichɔɡ wa Yeesu nyiŋi o habɔteŋra la, dɛ ŋɔ, “He banɔ la haa ɛ nyaara la, he na som, dɛkalkɛ heyaa dɛɛ ba Korowii Kora koobii ɛɛ.
He banɔ la lɔr aa dɛ kpo heyaa taraken la na som, dɛkalkɛ hɛɛ ba vaɡɔɔ.
He banɔ la haa dɛ wi taraken la na som, dɛkalkɛ hɛɛ ba mamɔɔ.
Dɛ nɛra koh Men Nɛn Bie nɔ waa dɛ hah heya, dɛ vɛh heya, dɛ chɛɡre heya, dɛ yerɛ he sɔnchɔɡe aa, he na som.
Dɛ a ba ɡɛ naa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ kohona ásɛ he hɛɡre, dɛkalkɛ he kembɔr warɔ taeh Korowii be.
Gɛ tentenee ba naanar ɛ Korowii keamere ba fa aa lole la.
He banɔ nɔ haa ɛ kondɔɔhna taraken la, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
He silɛɛ bwaa hɛɛ na la.
He banɔ nɔ haa vaɡra taraken nɔ, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
Lɔr ɛɛ ba kpo heyaa taeh.
He banɔ nɔ haa dɛ mamɛ taraken nɔ, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
Hɛɛ ba wiu.
He banɔ la nɛra aa dɛ bol he bwara wedɛɛɡe nɔ, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
Gɛ tentenee ba naawa kpɛɛ keame nyosonteŋna baa wola Korowii nyoa waa bolɛ la.” Dɔma nyina Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “He banɔ la haa dɛ no n waa nɔ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ nyin he dɔma wa, dɛɛ ɛɛ ba wedɛɛɡa.
Hé swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ taah heya, dɛ́ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ heyaa wechɔɡa la ɡe.
Dɛ nomɛl kpaa he lwɛɛma aa, berɛ baŋ bɛl ɡe tɛo ó kpaa ja.
Dɛ nomɛl lɛ he yal he be naa, kpɔ he batakaare ɡe jao.
Dɛ nomɛl soŋe komɛl aa, tɛo.
Dɛ nomɛl kpɔ he komɛl aa, bɛ o be lɛ kpa.
Gɛ haa dɛ nyin kɛ nɛra ɛ dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la, hé ɡe ɛ ɡɛ tenten dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ he dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ nyin he waa ɡbo aa, dɛ he wedɛɛɡa haa dɛ ɛ a ɡwaa la, anee ameo?
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡba dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ nyin ba wa.
Dɛ he ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ heyaa wedɛɛɡa ɡbo aa, dɛ he chɛ jam aa?
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡba aa ɡɛ ɛa?
Dɛ nɛra baa dɔ dɛ́ bɔ heyaa ɡboo hɛɛ kemɛ kwa aa, bɔkwa kembɔree hɛɛ ba dɔe yɔ?
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡba dɛ kemɛ ba bala wechɔɡ-ɛɛra kwa, ásɛ ba baa dɔ aa, ba bɔ ba.
Hɛ́ɛ nyin he dɔma wa, dɛ́ ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
He dɛ kemɛ nɛra kwa aa, he bɛ a lɛɛ waa dɛɛ lii.
Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, anee hɛɛ ba kembɔr dɔe kohona dɛ́ ɛ he Mɛɛ Nemenɛ Korowii la bii.
O te dɛ nyiŋi wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ne boniayɛ tena bwa.
Hɛ́ɛ sune nɛra nɛ, ɡɛ he Mɛɛ la aa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ la.
Dɔŋa pwaeh He bɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ pwah, ásɛ Korowii ɡe bɛ heyaa pwah.
He bɛ dɔŋa bolchɔɡe dɛɛ pa, ásɛ Korowii ɡe bɛ heyaa bolchɔɡe pa. Hé kpɔ he dɔŋa wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ ba, ásɛ Korowii ɡe kpɔ he wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ heya.
Hɛ́ɛ tɛ dɔŋa kwa, ásɛ Korowii ɡee tɛ heya a do kan kohona.
Korowii dɛ ba he tɛɛ yaa, wɛɛ maɡaa, dɛ́ jwiira, dɛ́ ɛɡra a jo kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ su porrr ken dɛɛ ta.
Kon haa kpɔa maɡɛ kwaa tɛ he dɔŋ la tentenee baa ba kpɔe maɡɛ tɛ he ɡe.” Yeesu berɔ sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Nyoŋe ɛɛ wonoo lawɛ o dɔŋ nyoŋe daa a maɡre aa?
Ba bwa aa bɔɔ taa ka le dɛ́ choɡli aa?
Nɛn waa dɛ hweli toma la ta o dɔɔ ɡwaalɛ, kɛ dɛ o dɔɔ hweli toma dɛ jemɛ tonɛ kwaraa naa, o ne o dɔɔ ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ bol he dɔŋ wechɔɡa tama waa haa wola he te wechɔɡdamanta waa dawɛ nɔɔ?
A do kɛŋɔ dabor aa lɔ he siwi ta haa wola on kpɔe, dɛ ŋɔ he dɔŋ be ŋɔ, ‘N dam, ɡel n laa dapuɡri kpɔ he siwi ta.’ Nɛn haa nyiŋi nɛra sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
Tɔ sie laa dabor la kpɔ he siwi ta mɔɔ, dɛ́ won na kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ laa dapuɡri waa lɔ he dɔŋ siwi ta la kpɔ.” Daa ne o nɔna Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Dadɛɛɡe aa won nɔnɛ nɔnchɔɡa, ɡɛɛ dachɔɡe ɡe aa wola won nɔnɛ nɔndɛɛɡa.
Daa bɛlbwa nɔna waa nɔna la taa ba che dɛɛ jemɔ.
Sɔɔh da aa ɡbal nɔna nɔnɛ, ɡɛɛ kontromoo ɡe aa wola lomporo nɔnɛ.
Nɛndɛɛɡe wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ taa a che baa jemɛ wedɛɛɡa aa lɔ o bambile bini.
Gɛɛ ba che nɛnchɔɡe ɡe wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta dɛɛ jemɛ wechɔɡa damanta aa lɔ o bambile bini, dɛkalkɛ waa aa lɔ nɛn bambile ta laanee o nyoa ɛɛ bol.
Demamaala banɛ bane wa Ɛrɛ waa hɛɛ yer mɛ he dɔɔ, haa wola waa maa dɛ bol he be ɛ nɔɔ?
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ba n be dɛ baa no n waa nɔ dɛɛ ɛa la, mɛɛ chaɡle heyaa ɡɛ waa doa.
Naate do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ ba o dea doe, dɛ kwi o mun pae bɔɔ ka jaɡɛ bwetal ta mɔɔ dɛ ma dea la.
Nee aa pala ba jo dea la mun la, o ta chole, dɛkalkɛ o doo kɛrɛdɛ.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa no n waa nɔ, waa wola ɡɛ aa baɡla la ɛ la, o do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa do o dea, o ta o mun pae bɔɔ kwii ka jaɡɛ bwetal ta mɔɔ dɛ den doo la.
Nee aa pala ba jo dea la mun ta la, o cholo dɛ chɔɡ kwaraa.”
Rom sooja nomoa bɛl bonɔɔ chaeh Yeesu aa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa baɡle nɛra la tonɛ la, o le bela dɛ kaa Kapeeneɔm.
Dɛ Rom sooja nomoa bɛl lɔ bela dɛ dɔ bonɔɔ bɛl dɛɛ nyin o waa kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ bonɔɔ la bwara dɛ weo, a ka jɛɛ ken o sewɛ.
Sooja nomoa la aa no Yeesu waa la, o tomɛ Juu tena nomonome bane ŋɔ bá ka soŋo ó ba chah o bonɔɔ la tɛo.
Baa la Yeesu be la, ba soŋo kohona ŋɔ ó ba chah nomoa la bonɔɔ la tɛo, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “A wer kɛŋɔ he cha nomoa nɔ, dɛkalkɛ o dɛ nyin ya Juu tena wa, hale o do cheremi dea tɛ yaa kwara.” Baa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, Yeesu iro, o ne baa kaa.
Aa ka tama o tel dem bela la, sooja nomoa la tomɛ o daamanar o be ŋɔ bá ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ o ta chɛɛ kɛ Yeesu ba o dem, anomanta, o bɛ o te koh, dɛ ŋɔ o ɡbaɡba ɡe ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ o ba Yeesu be.
Kɛ Yéesu bol waa waa ba o dem dɛ́ ba bol la ásɛ o bonɔɔ la ɡbaŋre.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “N ɛ nɛn maa lɔ nomonome bane lɔɡa, dɛ dɔ soojare ba do n ɡe lɔɡa.
Mɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ bɛl be ŋɔ, ‘Ba,’ ó ba, dɛ́ berɛ ŋɔ onfale be, ‘Kaa,’ ó ɡe kaa.
Mɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ n bonɔɔ be ŋɔ, ‘Ɛ ken tɛ mɛ,’ ásɛ o ɛ.” Yeesu aa no waa nɔ la, o nyoa kpoo, yarada waa yaradao la wa, asɛ o berɛ habɔɔ dɛ ŋɔ nɛnlaa baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n ta nɛn waa yarada mɛ ken nae bwa.
N ta o yarada dɔŋ nae Israel tena kwaraa bini.” Belaa nɛra sooja nomoa la aa tom ba la berɛ kaa o be.
Baa tel o dem la, ba nao kɛŋɔ o bonɔɔ la ɡbaŋrɔ.
Yeesu ir luhaah bɛl bie seo ta Aa ɛ tama la, Yeesu leɔ dɛɛ kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Neen.
Waa dɛ kaa la, dɛ o habɔteŋra ne nɛnlaa bane ja o nɛ.
Waa dena dɛɛ tel bwɛɛ la ta la, dɛ ba cheɡɛ baa bɛl waa sewa dɛɛ kaa ka huɡe.
Dɛ ɡɛ nɛn waa sewa la ɛ luhaah bɛl bibeŋkpoŋ waa dɔa.
Dɛ bwɛɛ la tena bane teŋɛ luhaah la nɛɛ pirim.
Yeesu aa na luhaah la, o waa do o sum, asɛ o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ berɛ wii.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o kaa leɡe lale la baa fɔrɔwo la, asɛ nɛra baa cheɡɔɔ la jaɡɛ che bobeŋkpoŋ, asɛ o ŋɔ, “Bonɔɔ, n ŋɔ hé ir!” Belaa bonɔɔ la fuɡri ir so, dɛ den dɛɛ bol wa.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “He biee la.” Ɔmee lawɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela la bwa, asɛ baa kpɛɛ Korowii dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii keamejen bɛl ba ya bini bonɔ!
Korowii balɔ dɛ́ ba lɛ o nɛra!” Yeesu waa waa ɛa la perɛ Juda harɛ ne harɛre aa baro cheme la bwa ta.
Yeesu ne Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee wa Anee Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la habɔteŋra ba Jɔn be dɛ ka bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa baɡlo.
Asɛ o yerɛ ba bini banɛ, dɛ tom ba Yeesu be ŋɔ bá ka bɔɔro ŋɔ onee nɛn Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo o ba la aa, kɛɛ o laa ɔ, ásɛ baa nyiŋi naate habɔɔ?
Jɔn habɔteŋra la aa ba Yeesu be la, ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee laanee tomɛ yaa he be dɛ ŋɔ yá ba bɔɔre ŋɔ, henee naate Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo o ba la aa, kɛɛ he laa ɔ, ásɛ yaa nyiŋi naate habɔɔ?” A ɡɛ saŋ la dɛ Yeesu chah weela tena taeh, dɛ doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛ a le ba nɛ, asɛ dɛ ɡel nyoŋa ɡee na bɔr.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ Jɔn toroma la be ŋɔ, “Hé ka bol Jɔn be waa haa baa na ne anɔ la haa baa no.
Hé ŋɔ o be ŋɔ nyoŋa dɛ na bɔr, boobie ɛɛ valɛ, asɛ nɛra weechɔɡa aa chɔɡ ba bwadabii la ɡe bwara kwaa.
Hé ŋɔ o be ŋɔ amumure dɛ no wa, lala ir seo ta, asɛ nyaara ɡe dɔ Amanesoma la dɛɛ no.
He naate haa wola men tɔŋle la, he na som.” Jɔn toroma la aa kaala la, Yeesu bol Jɔn waa nɛnlaa la be ŋɔ, “Haa la pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta bela la, bɔkwaa he fe ɛɛ nyin kɛ he na laɔ?
Kpɔɡ bɛl peu aa dɛ ta wɛɛ yiiɡi waa he la bela kɛɛ?
Dɛ ɡɛ laa ɡe aa, dɛ bɔkwa tenee he la ŋɔ he ka nyiŋi ɔ?
Nɛn waa do laaladɛɛɡaa he la ka nyiŋi kɛɛ?
Nɛra baa dɛ do laaladɛɛɡa dɛɛ di ba tetookondikwaa la, koodemii ba do.
Hé den baɡ mɛ, bɔkwa tenee he la bela ka nyiŋi ɔ?
Korowii keamee kɛɛ?
Kasinteŋ, Korowii keamee he na la, kɛ o ɡwaa Korowii keame kwara.
Jɔn nɔ waa ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ tomɛ n toromee ó tɔ he sie dɛ́ kwaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ” ’ la.
N dɛ ŋɔ he be, ba lolɛ nɛnjena harɛ nɔ ta, kɛ Jɔn ɡwaa ba bwa.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ bechala Korowii Kora la ta te berɔ ɡwaalo.” Nɛmpɛɛne la ne toɔ lɛɛra la kwaraa baa dɛ bɔ nɛra apoo aa no Yeesu waa la, ba sɛoh ŋɔ Korowii waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
Gɛ nɛra nɔɔ Jɔn fa aa sɔ Korowii nee la.
Kɛ ba nomonome ne Farisii tena la ne Tɔnjerema la te vɛh Korowii waa aa wera tɛɛ ba la.
Dɛ ba te fa ta ɡelɛ Jɔn sɔ ba Korowii ne.
Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa konee mɛɛ ba fini nɛra nɔ kpɔe dɛ maɡɔɔ?
Bɔkwa nɛraa ban ɔ?
Ba do kɛŋɔ bechale bane aa dɛ hɛlɛ fɔɡbaah, asɛ bane ŋɔ ba bala be ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ ya ɡo silɛɛ yela he sie ta lɛɛ he sa, ya berɛ ta wiile ɡe, he loo ta kui he wi nɔɔ?’ Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la aa bala la, dɛ waa sen nyɔ, dɛ yon vɔwɛ nyoa, asɛ he ŋɔ kwaa dɛ ir o nɛ!
Asɛ Men Nɛn Bie ɡe aa bala nɔ, n dɛ di kwaa dɛɛ nyɔ sen, asɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Hé na baa nɔ!
Kondikondidii ne sennyɔɔree on.
Toɔ lɛɛra baa dɛ bɔ nɛra apoo ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa o daamanar.’ ” Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o ŋɔ, “Wejereme bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla taa a che baa jemɛ kɛ o ɛ wejereme.” Yeesu la Seemɔn waa ɛ Farisii te dem Farisii te bɛl yerɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ó ba ó ne o di kwa, asɛ Yeesu la o dem ba ka so tiɡ ta, dɛɛ ba kwaa dii.
Bwɛɛ la ta la, dɛ haah bɛl dɛ bɔ jwamane dɛ do bela.
Waa noa kɛ Yeesu lɔ Farisii te la dem dɛɛ di kwaa la, anee o ka kpɔ nosɔɔhsoma loŋ bɛl del, dɛ ba ɡuŋi Yeesu jwɛh dɛ wi ta o napaala ta, dɛ kpɔ o nyumpona fee o sinii la waa wia ta Yeesu napaala ta la, dɛ mo o napaala, dɛ fuɡe nosɔɔhsoma la fɔɡla.
Belaa Farisii te la waa yerɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ó ba di kwaa la aa na a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ fe ɛ Korowii keame tenten naa, o fe jemɛ haah nɔ hahsoo waa dɛ leɡo nɔ.
O fe jemɛ o wechɔɡa waa lɔ a ta bwɛɛ nɔ ta.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Seemɔn, n dɔ waane dɛ́ bol he be.” Asɛ baa la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, bol.” Belaa Yeesu sɛɡlo ŋɔ, “Nɛra banɛ banee di baa bɛl kem.
Ba bwa di o kem te, kɛ bɛl kwaa ɡwaa o dɔŋ kwaa kera fi.
A ɡɛ kema la nɛra banɛ la aa dia la, ba bɛlbwa ta wone bɔ, asɛ o kpɔ kɛ ba.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ aa do ɡɛ nɔ, ba bini umee hɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ nyin baa la waa kohonaa yɔ?” Anee Seemɔn chaŋo ŋɔ, “N dɛ lii kɛ naate o kem aa kana la, onee dɛ́ nyin baa la waa kohona.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kpelaa he ŋɔ.” Yeesu aa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o berɛ sie ta haah la be, dɛ ŋɔ Seemɔn be ŋɔ, “Kɛ he na haah nɔ kenɛ?
Maa ba he dem bonɔ la, he ta men nee tɛɛ ń sarame n nakpale.
Kɛ haah nɔ te wio ta n nakpale ta, dɛ kpɔ o nyumpona feera kɛrɛdɛ ken.
He ta men lɛɛ silɛɛ ne dɛ mo n lwɛɛma.
Kɛ maa baa so nɔ bwa, o ta n napaala moe ɡelɛ bwa.
He ta men nee tɛɛ ń sarame n nakpale ɡɛɛ mɛɛ bol noo maa kpɔ fɔɡle n nyu wa aa?
Kɛ o te fuɡe nosɔɔhsoma fɔɡle n nakpale.
Anomanta, mɛɛ dii kasinteŋii.
Nyina haah nɔ aa nyin n waa kohona nɔ baɡlɔ kɛ Korowii kpɔ o wechɔɡa damanta waa ɛa la bwa kɛo.
Naate waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ kohona a ɛ kɛŋɔ he kpɔa kɛo la, nyina waa dɛ nyin he waa la aa kan do.
Waa Korowii jam kohona kɛ nɛn waa ɛ anjena la.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “Korowii kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛɛ.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, anee nɛra baa soɡe tiɡ ta bela dɛ ja o nɛɛ la ɛɛ lii ba nyu bini ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo baa nɔ o kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ nɛra nɔɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “He yarada haa yarada mɛ nɔ lɛɛ.
Ir dɛɛ la.
Kórowii tɛɛ bosɔɔhna.”
Mea dui sɛɡla Aa ɛ tama la, Yeesu jo bwɛjena ne bwɛjeɡre ta dɛɛ bol Amanesoma la kɛ Korowii Kora la dii telo.
Dɛ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la, ne haahna bane waa doŋi kwaa ba nɛɛ dɛ chaah ba weela la ja o nɛ.
Gɛ haahna nɔ bɛlee Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala Yeesu fa aa doŋi kwaa bele anuanɛ le o nɛɛ la.
Bɛl ɡee Joana waa ɛ Kusa waa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Kooro Hɛrɔd dem la haah, ne Susaana ne ba bala bane baa wara dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la nɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba ɡbaɡba suuɡa dɛ yawɛ kwaa tɛɛ ba baa di la.
Dɛ nɛra teŋɔ le bwɛɛre aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ la ta dɛɛ ba Yeesu be.
Nɛnlaa la aa wara dɛ bar Yeesu cheme la, o kpɔ sɛɡla dɛ bol waa baɡ ba ŋɔ, “Baa bɛlee ira dɛ kaa merɛ mea o koo ta.
Waa dɛ merɛ mea la la, ane lee ŋwɛnɛ ta, asɛ nɛra tiɡri a ta, jumbii ɡe ba tɔɔ di.
Mea la ane ɡe lee bwetala ta.
Aa lea la, a jwalɔ dɛ serewe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ sɔn toole bela.
Mea la ane lee sɔɔhne baah dɛ le, sɔɔhne la kpeɡ dɛ lawa a serewe.
Ane ɡe lee harɛdɛɛɡe ta dɛ le, dɛ do wer kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ mendaa bɛlbwa ɛ bie lafa.” Yeesu aa bol waa nɔ tonɛ la, o kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin dɛ́ no la, ó no!” Mea dui sɛɡla mun baɡla Yeesu aa tonɛ o wobol la, o habɔteŋra la bɔɔro sɛɡla la mun.
Anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korowii ta o Kora bini wobɛlbwa kpɔe sɔh he te.
Kɛ nɛra baa kaa la te, sɛɡla nee mɛɛ ba waa ba be bola, ásɛ a ɛ ɡɛ baa chwera ŋɔ, ‘Ba dɔ sibie kɛ baa na, dɛ dɔ deŋna kɛ baa no, baa waa mun jemɛ.’ Hé no sɛɡla la mun.
Mea la cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii Waa la.
Anɔ la aa lee ŋwɛnɛ nyoa jumbii ba tɔɔ di la cheɡɔ tɛ nɛra baa no Korowii Waa la, asɛ buɡ ta dɛ Bɔnsam baa laa kpɔ ba nyu bini ásɛ ba bɛ ba te kpɔ tɛ Korowii ó lɛɛ ba la.
Anɔ la ɡe aa lee bwetala ta bela teera aa wola toole kohona a lune aa wola wone kaa bini a jwalɛ dɛ sewɛ la, a do kɛ nɛra ba yon no waa la, dɛ ba sie lɛo, kɛ aa wola won ban jooɡe dɛɛ ka ba nyu bini la.
A cheɡɛ Korowii Waa ta waane puu ba aa, dɛ ba horɔ.
Asɛ anɔ la ɡe aa lee sɔɔhne baah, sɔɔhne la lawa a sewɛ la ɡee nɛra baa no Korowii Waa la, asɛ ba soɡa bini ne kondɔɔh waa ne wepuu aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta beɡre ba sie, baa ɡelɛ waa la ɛɛ dɔ tɔnɔ la.
Anɔ la ɡe aa lee harɛdɛɛɡe ta dɛ le dɛ do wer dɛ ma kohona la ɡee nɛra baa no Korowii Waa la dɛ kpoŋe a bini kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ dɔ bambile dɛ teŋɛ a ta, dɛ́ ɡel a dɔ tɔnɔ la.” Kandea waa chɔŋɛ kon ta sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa aa kandea choŋi dɛ kpɔ kon dɛɛ pi o ta, kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ do mpa lɔɡa.
Ba choŋi kandea aa, kon taa ba kpɔ dɛɛ chɔŋɛ ásɛ wɛɛ chaah nɛra bwa.
Komɛlbwa waa sɔah la ɛɛ le bochaahnee ba nao.
Waa bwa baa tɔ a ta la ɛɛ ba leo nɛra jemɛ.
Anomanta, hé no kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ jemɛ waa nɔ mun.
Dɛ he wono no a mun aa, mɛɛ ja heyaa anee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ naate waa dɔa la, baa jao anee ó dɔ kohona.
Kɛ naate waa wola komɛlbwa dɔe la, tama kwaraa waa dɔa la ɛɛ le o nɔn taa.” Yeesu nya ne o nimanar Yeesu nya ne o nimanar la bela waa lole la, kɛ nɛnlaa la nomanta, ba ta wone tel o be.
Anee nomɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He nya ne he nimanar cheɡɛ buse dɛɛ nyin ba nae.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N nya ne n nimanaree nɛra baa dɛ no Korowii Waa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta la.” Yeesu sɔɔh peujen bɛl nyoa Awola bɛl, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la kaa jo ɡbera bini, asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá kaa moo baŋ, asɛ ba taɡɛ ɡbera la do.
Baa tawa dɛɛ kaa la, Yeesu chɔ dom ɡbera la bini.
Buɡ la ta, dɛ peujen bɛl dɛ ta dɛ kpɔ nehɛma dɛɛ jo ba ɡbera la bini, asɛ ɡbera la ɛɛ ba mora.
Anee o habɔteŋra la chumu dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya serewɔ tonɛ!” Belaa o ir dɛ kɔr peu la ne nehɛma la, asɛ a hel, asɛ bɔr hel kerker ken.
Bɔr aa hela la, o bɔɔ o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ haa wola men yarada nɔɔ?” Ba ɔmɔ, ba bwa bwara hwah, asɛ baa bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo siwii nɔ, wɛɛ bol waa peu ne nehɛma ɛɛ no o wobol nɔɔ?” Yeesu chah baa bɛl kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la tawɛ ɡbera kaa Galilia Moo la baŋ, Gerasa harɛ ta.
Yeesu aa le ɡbera la bini la, baa bɛl waa ɛ bwɛɛ la te kwa aa dɛ ir o nɛɛ baa chemo.
Dɛ kwaa la aa lɔ o nɛɛ biɡro, asɛ o foo o laala ta, dɛ chwa le dem dɛ ka so lala huɡribɔr.
Gɛ baa nɔ aa na Yeesu la, o chwao dɛ ba ɡuŋi o sie, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Yeesu, Nemenɛ Korowii Bie, bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin n be nɔ?
N dɛ soŋe, bɛ men weweele do.” Pɛɛ laa baa la do lɔŋɔ la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Yeesu tɔ sie ŋɔ kwáa la le o nɛ.
Gɛɛ kwaa la yon dɛɛ ir o nɛ, asɛ baa lawɔ dɛɛ doo jɔɡrɔre.
Ba doo kpɛɛ ɡe aa, ɡɛɛ o yon kuuɡa, asɛ kwaa la yon kaa o ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
Belaa Yeesu bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He sɔne ɛrɔɔ?” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “N sɔne Dɔm.” Dɛ kwaa la warɔ pirim dɛ do o nɛ, a waa o ŋɔ o sɔne Dɔm la.
Anee kwaa la soŋe Yeesu ŋɔ o bɛ an doŋi ka ta bela baa dɛ ba wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa hɔhɔrɔwa doe la.
Bela la, dɛ parakooni damanta ane lɔ diŋɡoŋ bɛl ta dɛɛ di.
Anee kwaa la soŋe Yeesu ŋɔ ó ɡel a kaa parakooni la nɛ, asɛ o tɛa ŋwɛnɛ.
A le baa la nɛɛ dɛ ka jo parakooni la nɛ, asɛ parakooni damanta la bwa chwa biribiribiri, dɛ wili diŋɡoŋ la dɛ ka lee moo ta dɛ serewe kwaraa.
Belaa nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi parakooni la aa na waa aa chiɡa la, ba chwa dɛ la bwɛɛ la ta, ne daamune aa bɛne bela la ta, dɛ ka bol waa aa chiɡa la bela tena be.
Bela tena aa noa la, ba le ba bwɛɛre ta dɛ ba na waa aa chiɡa la.
Baa ba Yeesu be la, dɛ baa la kondamanta fa aa lɔ o nɛɛ la, dɛ o kwaa la bwa kaalɔ, o liire ba harɛ, o do laala dɛ so Yeesu sie.
Baa na ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba ɔmɔ.
Nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛ na ɡɛ Yeesu aa chah baa la kwaa fa aa lɔ o nɛɛ la bol a waa ba bwɛɛ tena la aa ba bela la be.
Yeesu aa ɛ ɡɛ la, nɛra baa le baah bela la soŋo ŋɔ ó le ba harɛ ta dɛ kaa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ɔmee tenten chole ba nɛ, asɛ o jo ɡbera la bini dɛ kaa.
Yeesu aa dɛ kaa la, anee baa la kwaa fa aa lɔ o nɛɛ la soŋo ŋɔ, “Gel n ne he kaalɔ.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kaa he nɛra be dem, dɛ́ ka bol wejena Korowii aa ɛa tɛɛ la.” Baa la laŋɔ dɛ ka bol waa Yeesu aa ɛa tɛo la bwɛɛ la bwa ta.
Bitolo bɛl waa sewa ne hanweelate bɛl wa Yeesu aa bera kaa moo la baŋ la, nɛra baa lɔ bela la jaamo silɛɛ ne, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba soɡo dɛɛ kpao.
Belaa cheremi dea nomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jaerɔs ba, dɛ ba ɡuŋi Yeesu sie, dɛ soŋo ŋɔ o dɛ nyinu o dem.
Dɛ ɡɛ baa nɔ bibeŋkpoŋ waa dɔɔ, o ɛ bihaah dɛ di bene fi dɛ anɛ bwara dɛ weo wɛɛ ba sewa.
Yeesu aa dɛ kaa la, dɛ nɛnlaa bane teŋɛ o nɛ, dɛ fiilo do baah ta dɛɛ taɡɔ.
Dɛ haah bɛl ɡe lole chal ɛɛ fuɡo bene fi dɛ anɛ, o chah, o komɛlbwa tonɛ tɛɛɡa tena be.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa ta wone chaoh.
O jo nɛra la baah ta dɛ ka che Yeesu habɔɔ dɛ leɡe o batakaare nyoa.
Buɡ la ta, dɛ chal la aa dɛ fuɡo la teŋo.
Asɛ Yeesu bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Umee leɡ mɛ nɔɔ?” Waa bɔɔra la, nomɛlbwa ta sɛɛh.
Anee Pita ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, nɛnlaa nɔ aa bare cheme dɛɛ taɡɛ dɔŋa nɔ, anee he berɛ dɛɛ bɔɔ naate waa leɡe naa?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “N nao kɛ nomɛl leɡ mɛ, dɛkalkɛ kpeɡri ane le n bini.” Belaa haah la aa naa kɛŋɔ waa won kpɔ o te sɔh la, o kpɔ bochela dɛ ka ɡuŋi Yeesu sie nɛra la bwa siwi ta, dɛ baɡle waa la aa bala o leɡo la, ne ɡɛ o weela la aa kaala buɡ la ta la.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Tolo, he yarada haa yarada mɛ la ɡelɔ he ɡbaŋre.
Dɛɛ la.
Korowii tɛɛ bosɔɔhna.” Yeesu nyoa taa lɔ waa waa dɛ bol la ta la, torome le cheremi dea nomoa la dem dɛ ba ŋɔ nomoa la be ŋɔ, “He bihaah la sewɔ.
Bɛ berɛ ha nomoa la kpa.” Ajaah Yeesu no waa la torome la aa baa bol la, anomanta, o ŋɔ Jaerɔs be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɔmɛ, kɛ yarada mɛ.
Wɛɛ berɔɔ dɔ bokpeɡa ja.” Yeesu aa tel dem bela la, o ta ɡelɛ nomɛlbwa ja o nɛɛ dɛ jo bela bie la aa chɔa la, nemenɛ Pita ne Jɔn ne Jems ne bie la nya ne o mɛɛ ɡbosoroo.
Dɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela la koh bie la waa dɛɛ wi.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ wi.
Bie la ta sewɛ, domii o chɔ!” Yeesu aa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, dɛ ba dɛ mamɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba jemɔ kɛ o sewɔ.
Waa ba bie la jwɛɛh la, o lawɛ o nɔn dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Bie, ir!” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, bie la hweera berɔ ba ja, asɛ o fuɡri ir buɡ la ta, asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ bá nyin kwaa tɛo o di.
Bie la nya ne o mɛɛ bwa bwara yɔrɔ, asɛ Yeesu kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ nomɛlbwa be waa aa chiɡa la bol.
Yeesu aa tomɛ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ wa Yeesu yerɛ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la ba cheme o sie, dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri ne ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ bá doŋi kwaa nɛra nɛ, dɛ́ chah weela ɡe, dɛ tom ba ŋɔ bá ka bol Korowii Kora la wa, dɛ́ chah weela tena.
Waa dɛ tom ba la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ komɛlbwa kpɔ kpoŋe he ŋwɛnɛ nɔ kaala ta.
He bɛ daŋɡbale kpɔ, he bɛ pure kpɔ, he bɛ kondikwaa kpɔ, dɛ bɛ suuɡa kɛɛ batakaare bele anɛnɛ kpɔ.
Bwɛɛ bɛlbwa haa la o ta la, dem haa ka jo o ta la, hé so bela ka tel kɛŋɔ haa le bwɛɛ la ta.
Dɛ bwɛɛ la tena ta heyaa lɛɛ silɛɛ ne naa, hé pee he napaala teera ta bela dɛ́ le bela, ásɛ a baɡle kɛŋɔ he kpɔ Korowii Waa ba ba be ba vɛah.” Asɛ ba le kaa, dɛ kaa bol Amanesoma la bela bwɛɛre la ta, dɛɛ chah weela tena bobɛlbwa.
Kooro Hɛrɔd waa dɛ nyiŋi Galilia harɛ ta aa no waa Yeesu aa dɛ ɛ la bwa la, o liire ɛo sakaa ken, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ nɛra bane dɛ bol ŋɔ Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la ir seo ta.
Bane ŋɔ Korowii keame Elaejaa ir seo ta, asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ Korowii keamebena la bɛlee weera.
Anee Kooro Hɛrɔd ŋɔ, “Jɔn te, n ɡelɔ ba teŋe o nyu, aah nɛn besoo ɡe waa mɛɛ no ken nɔɔ?” Asɛ dɛ swɛɛ siwi kɛŋɔ wɛɛ na Yeesuu.
Yeesu tɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banue kondikwaa ba di Yeesu toroma la balɔ dɛ ba bol waa baa kaa ɛ o be, asɛ o kpɔ ba le nɛnlaa la bini ba kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Bɛtsaeda la ta.
Nɛra aa no o waa la, ba tiu bela, asɛ o lɛɛ ba silɛɛ ne dɛ bol Korowii Kora la waa baɡ ba, dɛ chah ba bini banɔ la ba bwara aa dɛ wee ba la.
Wee aa dɛ jo la, o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la la o be dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Tɛ nɛnlaa nɔ ŋwɛnɛ bá kaa bwɛɛre aa bar bonɔ nɔ dɛ́ ka nyin kondikwaa ne chɔɔbɔra, dɛkalkɛ bonɔ ɛ kpɔɡ baah.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Hé tɛɛ ba kwaa bá di.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, ba chaŋo ŋɔ, “Paanoo anue ne pɛŋa anɛɛ ya dɔ.
Nemenɛ ya la dɛ́ ka yawɛ kondikwaa ba tɛ nɛra nɔ bwa.” Dɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela la, ba baala ɛɛ ɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banuee.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Hé ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá pɛɛɡe so fifraanunue.” Anee o habɔteŋra la ɡel nɛra la pɛɛɡe dɛ so ɡɛ.
Asɛ Yeesu kpɔ paanoo anue la ne pɛŋa anɛ la, dɛ ha sie dɛ nyiŋi nyundua dɛ jam Korowii, dɛ mɔne do o habɔteŋra la nɔɔra ta ŋɔ bá bɔne tɛ nɛra la.
Baa bɔne paanoo la tɛ nɛra la, ba bwa diu dɛ vaɡre, ane ka.
O habɔteŋra la tɔɔ a puɡrere la baa dia ka la pɛ, asɛ a su wɛɡrɛjena fi dɛ anɛ.
Pita baɡle Yeesu nɛnsoo Awola bɛl, dɛ Yeesu ɡbo lɔ bobɛl dɛɛ soŋe Korowii, asɛ o habɔteŋra la la o be.
Anee o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo nɛra ɛɛ lii mɛ nɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Bane ŋɔ Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee laanee hen.
Bane ŋɔ Elaejaa hen, asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ Korowii keamebena la bɛlee weera.” Asɛ o bɔɔ ba ɡe ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo he ɡee lii mɛ nɔ?” Anee Pita chaŋo ŋɔ, “Henee Kristo la Korowii aa ŋɔa wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la.” Yeesu bol o wahala nae ne o seo wa Belaa Yeesu kah ba kohona ŋɔ ba bɛ ɡɛ bol nomɛlbwa be.
Asɛ o berɛ ŋɔ, “Men Nɛn Bie la chɛ kɛŋɔ ń na waa nomonome ne Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema nɔn ta, ásɛ ba vɛɛh mɛ, dɛ́ kpo mɛ, ásɛ a tɔpetooro wee la, ń ir seo ta.” O berɔ ŋɔ ba bwa be ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ nyin kɛ ó teŋɛ n nɛ aa, ó ɡel o tetookwaa nyina, dɛ́ kpɔ o te tɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa kɛ wɛɛ sɛh wahala nae ne seo bwaa, dɛ́ ba teŋɛ n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa kpɔ daɡaɡre che bá ka kpaaro pɛl o ta la, dɛkalkɛ nomɛlbwa o sie aa swɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta la, wɛɛ paŋɛ o nyuu.
Ásɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe o sie aa wola harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ kwaa ta lɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Dɛ nɛn dɔ harɛ nɔ ta kwaa bwa dɛ nyoɡre o nyu aa, bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ wɛɛ ba dɔe yɔ?
Nomɛlbwa sihiih aa dɛ kpoo n ne n webaɡla nɔ ta la, awola Men Nɛn Bie ne nyundua toromedɛɛɡa aa ba n Mɛɛ jirima ne la, maa naatee heeh awola tɔpere.
Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɛɛ ba di o Kora harɛ nɔ taa, dɛ he bini bane ta soɡe le dɛ nao.” Yeesu beɡra wa Yeesu aa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ la, a yawanyoa la, o kpɔ Pita ne Jɔn ne Jems, o ne ba teeh bwe bɛl dɛ kaa o doa, dɛ ka soŋe Korowii.
A ɡɛ saŋ Yeesu aa dɛ soŋe Korowii la, o siebɔr beɡrɔ, asɛ o laala waa doa la to dɛɛ nyɛɡle al-al ken.
Ba ne ŋɔ ba nyiŋi, dɛ o ne nɛra banɛ dɛ bol wa.
Dɛ Korowii keamebena Mosis ne Elaejaa.
Baa bala dɛ Korowii jirima lɔ ba nɛ, baa bol ɡɛ Yeesu aa dɛ ba sewa Jerusalam ásɛ Korowii waa la ɛ kpela.
Dɛ Pita ne o bala la dɛ chɔ doromi.
Ba iro dɛ na Yeesu kɛŋɔ o laala aa toa dɛɛ nyɛɡle al-al ken.
Ba na nɛra banɛ la baa ja Yeesu nɛɛ la ɡe.
Nɛra banɛ la aa le Yeesu be dɛɛ kaa la, Pita ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, a wer kɛŋɔ yaa lɔ bonɔ nɔ.
Gel ya do kukure atoro, ásɛ he kpɔ bɛl, Mosis kpɔ bɛl, ásɛ Elaeja ɡe kpɔ bɛl.” Dɛ waa jemɛ waa waa dɛ bol.
Pita ta aa dɛ bol waa nɔ la, bam bɛl denɔ ba tɔ ba nɛ, asɛ ɔmee laɡ ba kɛŋɔ bam la chunchule aa baa tɔ ba nɛɛ la.
Belaa taa bɛl le bam la bini ŋɔ, “N Bie maa leo laanee la.
Hé no o be!” Wobol la aa chiɡa la, dɛ a ka Yeesu ɡbo, asɛ o habɔteŋra la hel jeiih ken ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, ba ta nomɛlbwa be waa baa naa la bolɛ ɡɛ saŋ.
Yeesu chah bie bɛl kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛ Tɔ aa pera la, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra batoro la le bwe la doa tu harɛ, asɛ nɛnlaa bane ba chemo.
Belaa baa bɛl kpɔ takpeɡ bol waa nɛra la bini ŋɔ, “Nomoa!
N dɛ soŋe, nyiŋi n bie nɔ nɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
O ɡboo n bie.
Kwaa dɛ ir o nɛ.
A ir o nɛ aa, ɡɛɛ o piɡri do lɔŋɔ, asɛ a yon kpɔɔ ɡo harɛ o beŋri chɔ, asɛ fufuɡ ɛɛ le o nyoa.
A dɛ ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa mɔɔ dɛ́ le o nɛ.
N soŋe he habɔteŋra la ŋɔ bá doŋa o nɛɛ tɛ mɛ, kɛ ba ta wone.” Anee Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Oo!
Fini nɔ nɛra wechɔɡa aa lɔ he nɛɛ nɔ, he ta yarada dɔe!
Tɔpera aŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń lawɛ bambile dɛ́ so he be mɔɔ he yarada Korowii ɔ?
Maa tɔpere bɛl dii ba he be kpa oo!
Kpɔ he bie la ba bonɔ.” Bie la aa dɛ ba la, kwaa la ɡoo harɛ dɛ ɡel o beŋri.
Yeesu kɔr kwaa la, dɛ chah bie la, dɛ kpɔɔ tɛ o mɛɛ.
Nɛra la bwa nyoa kpo Korowii kpeɡri la nɛ.
Yeesu bol o seo waa ja Ba nyoa aa kpoa ba taa kooɡa la, Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no waa nɔ maa dɛ ba he be bola nɔ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ soh!
Ba dɛ ba Men Nɛn Bie lee do nɛra nɔn ta.” O habɔteŋra la ta waa la mun noɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔɔ sɔɔh ba.
Dɛ ba ɡe dɛ ɔmɛ, anomanta, ba bɔɔro waa la mun kahonɛ.
Nɛn waa ɛ nomoa wepɛɛra Wetɔŋla chole o habɔteŋra la baah ta, asɛ baa nyin ba jemɛ ba bini onɔ la wáa ɛ ba bwa nomoa.
Baa wola a ne baŋ leɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ Yeesu jemɛ waa baa dɛ lii.
Belaa o lawɛ bechala bɛl ir che o jwɛh, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa koh n waa dɛ nyiŋi bie nɔ nɛɛ la, dɛ menee o nyiŋi la.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa nyiŋi n nɛɛ la, dɛ naate waa tom mɛ laanee o nyiŋi la.
Naate waa ɛ o te bechala he bini la, onee nomoa.” Belaa Jɔn ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, ya na baa bɛl waa kpɔ he sɔn dɛɛ doŋi kwaa nɛra nɛ, asɛ ya kaoh ŋɔ ó ɡel, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta ya bini bɛl ɛɛ.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ Jɔn ne o bala la be ŋɔ, “He bɛ on kah ŋɔ ó ɡel.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola he nɛɛ cheɡɛ la, he somee on.” Samaria harɛ bwɛɛ bɛl tena vɛh Yeesu Tɔpere aa dɛ tel kɛ Korowii kpɔ Yeesu kaa o be nyundua la, Yeesu kpɔ o te, dɛ den chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ pa sie dɛɛ kaa Jerusalam.
O tomɛ nɛra bane ŋɔ bá tɔ o sie dɛ́ la Samaria harɛ bwɛɛ bɛl ta dɛ́ ka nyin bɔr tɛo ó choɡ.
O sie aa chaɡɛ Jerusalam la nomanta, bela tena ta on lɛɛ.
Yeesu habɔteŋra Jems ne Jɔn aa na ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, he dɛ nyin kɛ ya ɡel nii le nyundua ba dɛ́ ba fuuh ba kɛɛ?” O habɔteŋra la aa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o ta ban ɡelɛ.
O laa o te berɛ dɛ do ba nee ba samɛ.
Asɛ o ne o habɔteŋra la kaa ba sie bwɛɛ bɛl ta.
Gɛ Yeesu nɛɛ teŋa aa kpeɡa Baa vala dɛɛ kaa la, baa bɛl ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Bobɛlbwa haa dɛ la la, mɛɛ teŋɛ he nɛɛ kaa.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Manyajeɡre kwaraa dɔ bɔɔne dɛɛ chɔ a bini, asɛ jumbii aa dɛ ɡah nyundua ɡe dɔ a kɔne, kɛ Men Nɛn Bie la te ta bobɛlbwa dɔe ń chɔ dɛ́ onɛ.” Asɛ o berɛ ŋɔ baa bɛl ɡe be ŋɔ, “Teŋɛ n nɛ.” Anee baa la ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, ɡel n la, ásɛ n mɛɛ baa sewaa, ń huɡo mɔɔ dɛ́ ba.” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Gel nɛra baa wola Korowii mkpa dɔe la huɡe ba dɔŋa, ásɛ he ka bol Korowii Kora la bini waa baɡle nɛra.” Asɛ baa bɛl ɡe ŋɔ o be ja ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, mɛɛ teŋɛ he nɛɛ, kɛ ɡel n ka kal n haah ne bii mɔɔ dɛ́ ba.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o ɡe be ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa pa mun dɛɛ ba para dɛ ka kpɔ par, o nyu bini berɛ dɛɛ ɛo anɛnɛ la aa won parɛ a maɡre.
Gɛɛ a do kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ja Korowii Kora la taa la bɛ berɛ dɔ liire anɛ kpa.”
Yeesu tomɛ o habɔteŋra fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ Anɔ habɔɔ la Yeesu yerɛ o habɔteŋra fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ bane, dɛ pɛ ba banɛnɛ, dɛ tom ba ŋɔ bá tɔ sie bwɛɛre ne bela waa dɛ ba a ta laŋa la ta.
O kpɔ nɛwɛnyini maɡɛ konduula, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Koo kondikwaa la kan, kɛ tom-ɛɛra la lɔ tamaa ken dɛɛ ba a koma.
Anomanta, hé soŋe Koo Te la ásɛ o kpɔ tom-ɛɛra la bane ba ja bá ka ɛ a toma.
Hé kaa.
N dɛ tomɛ heyaa hé ka koo he dɔma baah ta.
He bɛ suuɡa pure kpɔ, he bɛ pure haa kpɔ laala dɛɛ do a bini ɡba kpɔ, he bɛ naŋɡawa bele anɛnɛ kpɔ.
He bɛ ka jaɡɛ che ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ jam nɛra wobohweeh ne.
Dem haa ka choɡ o ta la, hé tɔ sie ŋɔ, ‘Kórowii tɛ dem nɔ tena bosɔɔhna!’ Dɛ nɛn Korowii aa ŋɔa o dɔ bosɔɔhna lɔ bela aa, Korowii ɛɛ tɛo wedɛɛɡa haa soŋa laanee.
Dɛ ɡɛ nɛn toole ɡe aa, he wedɛɛɡa haa soŋa la ɛɛ berɔɔ ba he ɡbaɡba be.
Hé so a ɡɛ dem la ta, dɛɛ di ba kondikwaa baa dɛ di dɛ tɛ heyaa la ane, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tom-ɛɛ kembɔr chɛo.
A ɡɛ dem la te habɔɔ, he bɛ le ka so dem bɛlbwa ta kpa.
Bwɛɛ bɛlbwa haa la o ta ásɛ bela tena lɛ heyaa la, kwaa baa tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé di la, hé lɛ dɛ́ di.
Hé chah bela tena ba bwara aa dɛ wee ba la weela, ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Korowii Kora la pu heya.’ Dɛ he la bwɛɛ bɛl ta, ba ta heyaa lɛɛ yaa, he bɛ o ta so.
Haa dɛɛ le la, hé ŋɔ, ‘Hale ya pee he bwɛɛ nɔ teera aa ɛ ya napaala la ta, dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ ya kpɔ Korowii Waa ba he be he vɛah.
Kɛ a chɛ kɛ hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Kora la pu heya.’ Kasinteŋ, Sodom tena baa ɛ wechɔɡa asɛ Korowii fuuh ba la, baa bɔ ɡɛ bwɛɛ la tenaa awola Korowii aa ba dɛ́ ba pa bole la.
Bwɛɛre a tena aa wola Korowii yaradae Korasen tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
Bɛtsaeda tena ɡe, hé bwɛɛlɛ!
Dɛ nomɛl fe ɛ ɡɛ nyokpowaa nɔ maa ɛa he siwi ta nɔ bwɛjena Taaya ne Sidon aa, ba fe charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta biɡri.
Ba fe ta lweyale tɔe dɛ so sibeɡra ta naa?
Awola Korowii aa ba pa bole la, wɛɛ na bwɛjena Taaya ne Sidon tena sumii ɡwaa heya.
Asɛ he Kapeeneɔm tena ɡe, ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ ń bol he waɔ?
He dɛ nyin kɛ he ir kaa Korowii be nyundua kɛɛ?
Hɛɛ ba harɛɛ Bɔnsam nii taa.” Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa ka no he be la, n bee o no, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa ka vɛh he waa la, n waa o vɛh.
Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh n waa la, naate waa tom mɛ la waa o vɛh.” Yeesu habɔteŋra fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ bala wa Yeesu habɔteŋra fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ la la o toma la dɛ ba silɛɛ ne, asɛ ba ne o cheme.
Ba ne waa chema la, ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔ, yaa kaa che he sɔn ta dɛ bol waa la, kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ kwaraa ɔmɛ yaa.” Belaa Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He pɔ Bɔnsam nɛ.
N nao kɛŋɔ waa le nyundua ba le harɛ kerabeŋkpoŋ kɛŋɔ bwaala aa nyɛɡla ken.
Hɛ́ɛ no!
N tɛ heyaa kpeɡri kɛŋɔ hé tiɡri harɛkwaare ne nɔrɔme nɛ, dɛ́ pɔ ya dɔm Bɔnsam ne o toroma bwa nɛ, wobɛlbwa aa wola won ɛ heya.
He bɛ ɡel a do he som kɛŋɔ kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ aa no he wobol nɔ.
Waa aa chɛ kɛ hé koh a waa dɛ́ ɡel he sie lɛ laanee kɛŋɔ bá chwerɛ he sɔna nyundua ja Korowii bii nɛ.” Gɛ saŋ dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ir Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ ɡel o sie lɛ, asɛ o ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, nyundua ne harɛ bwa Dɔɔ!
N dɛ jaame kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ waa nɔ sɔh sipila tena ne wejerema, dɛ kpɔ baɡle nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ nɔ.
Jam, n Mɛɛ.
Gɛɛ wera he be.” Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ kpɔ wobɛlbwa do n nɔn ta.
Nomɛlbwa aa men Korowii Bie jemɛ nemenɛ n Mɛɛ la ɡbo.
Gɛɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe aa wola n Mɛɛ la jemɛ nemenɛ n ne nɛra maa dɛ nyin kɛ ń ɡel ba jemɔ la.” Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la ɡbo aa baa so la, o berɛ sie ta ba be, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He nɛra he siwi aa na wejena maa dɛ ɛ nɔ la, he na som.
Kasinteŋ, Korowii keamere ne koranar kɛrɛdɛ fe dɛ nyin waa haa dɛ na dɛɛ no nɔ, dɛ́ no dɛ́ na, kɛ ba ta dɔe.” Samaria nɛndɛɛɡe sɛɡla Tɔnjereme bɛl balɔ dɛ ba kpɔ wobol kɛ wɛɛ daah Yeesuu dɛ́ jemɛ o liire, dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa nɔ?” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ Korowii Tɔn la baɡle ɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ no a mun ɔ?” Asɛ baa la ŋɔ, “Dɛ hé nyin N Naa Korowii he bambile bwa, he hweera, he bokpeɡa ne he liire bwa ne, dɛ́ nyin he dɔŋ kɛ he ɡbaɡba.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpelaa he ŋɔ.
Dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ, hɛɛ dɔ ɡɛ mkpa laanee.” Dɛ Tɔnjereme la dɛ nyin kɛ ó baɡle kɛ o te dɛ ɛ waa Yeesu aa bɔɔra la bwa, dɛ ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Umee n dɔŋ ɔ?” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Baa bɛlee le Jerusalam dɛɛ kaa Jeriko, dɛ ka pu ŋwɛɛra ŋwɛnɛ baah ta, ba den ɡuɡru, dɛ lɔɔro, dɛ doo bola, tamaa kaa o sewɛ, dɛ laa o laala bwa lɛ o be, dɛ ɡelo o chɔ ŋwɛnɛ baah ta bela dɛɛ ba sewa.
Dɛ Sɔfo bɛl ɡe kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ la ta dɛ baa kaa, dɛ na baa la, dɛ fɛrɔ ba kaa.
Dɛ Lewi dea te bɛl waa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ɡe kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ la tenten ta dɛ ba pu baa la, dɛ ɡe fɛrɔ kaa.
Dɛ Samaria tena ba ne Juu tena aa wola somɛ la bɛl kpɔ a ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la tenten ta dɛ baa kaa, dɛ ba pu baa la, dɛ o chɔ o buɡ ta bela.
Waa nao la, dɛ o waa sum o be.
O choɡ o bone cheɡ, dɛ nyiŋi a bini, dɛ laa noo ne sen ane soo kpɔ dɛ suuh tel o be, dɛ kpɔ noo la ne sen la do o ŋwɛra la ta.
O vɔrɔwa, dɛ ɡɔɔro so o konteehne waa soɡe o ta la ta, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa bela dem bɛl hɔɔhra yon dɛɛ choɡ o ta la ta, dɛ ka nyiŋu.
Tɔ aa pera la Samaria te la kpɔ suuɡapoŋa anɛ tɛ naate waa dɛ nyiŋi hɔɔhra dem la ta la, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó nyiŋi weela te la nɛ, dɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ berɔɔ ba ja, ásɛ dɛ ba bɔɔ komɛlbwa waa chɔɡ o nɛɛ la kem.” Yeesu aa bol waa nɔ tonɛ la, o bɔɔ Tɔnjereme la ŋɔ, “Nɛra batoro nɔ, ba bini umee nyiŋi baa la ŋwɛɛra aa lɔɔro dɛ doo bola la kɛŋɔ o dɔŋ ɔ?” Belaa Tɔnjereme la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Onɔ la waa na o sum dɛ nyiŋu laanee.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kaa dɛ kaa ɛ ɡɛ tenten.” Yeesu la Maata ne Mɛɛre dem Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la aa dɛ kaa la, ba kaa tel bwɛɛ bɛl ta, belaa haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Maata lɛo dɛ kaa o ne o dem.
Dɛ Maata dɔ o nime bihaah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Mɛɛre.
Dɛ ɡɛ Mɛɛre nɔ, dɛ o soɡe Yeesu be dɛɛ no o webaɡla la.
Dɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la kondikwaa toma ɡwaa Maata nɛ, anee o la Yeesu be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, he ta nae kɛŋɔ n nime aa kpɔ toma la bwa ta n ɡbo nɛ aa?
Anomanta, ŋɔ o be ó ba cha mɛ!” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ei, Maata!
Wedamanta beɡre he sie, a lɛ he liire bwa.
Kɛ webeŋkpoŋ ɡee hiaah.
Waa aa weraa Mɛɛre kpɔ la, anomanta, maa won ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ɡel.”
Gɛ Yeesu aa chaɡle Korowii soŋa wa Awola bɛl, dɛ Yeesu lɔ bobɛl dɛɛ soŋe Korowii.
Waa tona la, o habɔteŋra la bɛl ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, baɡle yaa ɡɛ yaa soŋe Korowii, ɡɛ Jɔn aa baɡle o habɔteŋra la.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he dɛ soŋe Korowii aa, hé ŋɔ, ‘Ya Mɛɛ haa lɔ nyundua, henee chɛ duura.
Baɡle he Kora dii harɛ nɔ ta.
Tɛ yaa ya fini kondikwa, dɛ́ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa kɛ yaa, ɡɛ yaa kpɔ ya dɔŋa wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ ba la.
Dɛɛ ke yaa wechɔɡa luɡri ta.’ ” Ate, Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ kɛŋɔ he bini bɛl dɔ o dam, dɛ la ka chumu harambaŋa, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘N dam, kem mɛ pea atoro.
N dam bɛl le bobɛl ba choɡ mɛ taraken, n ɡe ta komɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ tɛo ó di.’ Dɛ he soŋo ɡɛ naa, wɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ hé ɡelo ŋɔ he bɛ o dom chɔɡ ŋɔ o karɛ o ɡbera o ne o bii chɔ, anomanta, waa won ir dɛ́ tɛɛ komɛlbwa naa?
Akai!
Waa won ŋɔ ɡɛ.
Kasinteŋ, dɛ a ka darame la ɡbo wa aa, o fe aa ir dɛ́ tɛɛ komɛlbwa.
Kɛ haa wola kaalɛ, dɛ ta che dɛɛ soŋo la nomanta, wɛɛ tɛɛ komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin laanee.
Anomanta, ɡɛɛ a do, hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii, wɛɛ tɛ heyaa.
Hɛ́ɛ nyin he konnyina o be, hɛɛ dɔɔ.
Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ lɔ ɡbera, wɛɛ ya heyaa.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ soŋo la dɛ dɔ, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o konnyina dɛɛ le o be la, o dɛ tɛo.
Gɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba ɡbera yae dɛ́ tɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ lɔ la.
He bini umee o bie ɛɛ nyin pɛŋe, ó ka lawɛ harɛkon ba tɛo wɔ?
Kɛɛ dɛ o dɛ nyin jahal aa, ó ka lawɛ nɔm ba tɛo wɔ?
Dɛ he wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔ kwaraa jemɔ dɛ kpɔ kondɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ he bii aa, ɛrɛ waa he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la te aa wola nɛra baa dɛ soŋo o Domadɛɛɡe la tenee tɛo!” Yeesu ne Bɛlsebul Dɛ Yeesu dɛ doŋi kwaa aa lɔ baa bɛl nɛɛ o berɛ amumu.
Kwaa la aa le baa la nɛɛ la, o bol wa.
Nɛnlaa la aa lɔ bela la nyoa kpoo.
Bane te ŋɔ, “Kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ bwa kooro baa dɛ yerɔ Bɛlsebul la, onee tɛo kpeɡri wɛɛ doŋi kwaa la.” Dɛ bane ɡe dɛ nyin dɛ daahno na, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ɛ we-ɛɛla ane, ásɛ a baɡle kɛ o le Korowii be kpela.
Yeesu aa jemɛ waa baa dɛ lii la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ harɛ bɛl ta tena bini pere anɛ ba ɡbo ɛɛ yo aa, harɛ la dɛ paɡre.
Gɛɛ dɛ waane ba lolanar bane bini asɛ ba baah pere anɛ ba ɡbo ɛɛ yo aa, lola la aa won ɛ lola.
Anomanta, dɛ Bɔnsam kora bini pero baa yo aa, o kora la aa won ɛ kora.
Heyaa ŋɔa ŋɔ Bɛlsebulee tɛ mɛ kpeɡri n won kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ doŋa.
Dɛ Bɛlsebul nɛɛ n che dɛɛ doŋa aa, a wer.
Aah dɛ he ɡe, umee tɛ he habɔteŋra nɔ kpeɡri ba won a doŋa ɔ?
He ɡbaɡba habɔteŋra la we-ɛɛlaa dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he kono kwara!
Korowii kpeɡri nee mɛɛ doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ la.
Anomanta, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Kora dii la telo tonɛ.
Dɛ bokpeɡa te kpɔ o dɔmkwaa dɛɛ daah o dem kɛrɛdɛ naa, o komɛlbwa aa chɔɡ.
Kɛ dɛ bɛl ɡe berɔ do kpeɡri ɡwaalo dɛ ka puu dɛ pɔ o nɛ aa, o dɛ kpɔ o dɔmkwaa waa kpɔ o sie dawɛ a ta la, dɛ́ kpɔ o kondɔɔh ja.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola n nɛɛ jae la aa n waa nyin.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola men chae dɛɛ boa n nɛra nyoa dɛɛ pɛ la lɔ ba dɛɛ peɡre.
Bɔnsam torome bera dɛ́ ba nɛn be ja Fini nɔ nɛra do kɛŋɔ nɛn Bɔnsam aa ɡela o torome bɛl do o nɛɛ dɛ chɔɡ o da.
A habɔɔ la, naate charɛ o liire, asɛ Bɔnsam torome la le o nɛɛ dɛ kaa ka nyin bofale dɛ so.
O ɡaaɡaa, o ta wone dɔ bɔr dɛ́ so onɛ, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ kaa n buɡ ta bela maa lea ba laanee,’ dɛ berɛ ka na kɛ baa la liire bini chaahnɔ kɛŋɔ dea baa chaaro dɛ kwaaro kɛrɛdɛ ba ta nɛn kpɔe do o ta dɛ ɡel o chɔ pɛɛ la.
Gɛɛ o yon la ka kpɔ o bala anuanɛ aa ɡwaalo kwara.
A bwa yon ba so naate la nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ o da ɡwaa ɡɛ o fa aa doa wubwa la.
Gɛɛ aa ba doe fini nɔ nɛra baa ɛ nɛnchɔɡa nɔ nɛ.” Som nae tenten wa Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, haah bɛl bol waa o be takpeɡ ne nɛra la baah ta, dɛ ŋɔ, “Haah waa lolɛ dɛ dɛɛre la na som.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa dɛ no Korowii Waa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta laanee na som.” Ba soŋe Yeesu ŋɔ ó ɛ nyokpowa Nɛra la aa bar Yeesu cheme pirim la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ fini nɔ nɛra ɛ nɛnchɔɡa ken?” Ba dɛ nyin nyokpowaa dɛ́ na mɔɔ dɛ́ yarada kɛ Korowii bee n le, kɛ baa dɔ na.
Waa aa pu Korowii keame Jona la dɔŋa ɡboo dɛɛ ba n ɡe pui, ásɛ he che a ta jemɛ n nɛnsoo.
Gɛ Korowii aa ɛ Jona dɛ baɡle Niniwe tena kɛ on tomɔ la, ɡɛ tentenee wɛɛ ba Men Nɛn Bie la ɡe ɛɛ dɛ́ baɡle fini nɔ nɛra kɛ on tom mɛ.
Awola nɛra bwa aa ir seo ta dɛ ba che Korowii sie ásɛ o bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole la, Seeba kooro waa ɛ haah la ɛɛ bol waa bɔ fini nɔ tena, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o valɔ le harɛ jaɡa dɛ́ ba no Kooro Solomɔn wejemwa.
Kɛ kasinteŋ, naate waa ɡwaa Kooro Solomɔn lɔ bonɔ, asɛ he ŋɔ haa o bee no.
Niniwe tena ɡba ɛɛ bol waa bɔ fini nɔ tena, dɛkalkɛ ba te no Korowii Waa Jona aa bola la mun dɛ charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta.
Kɛ kasinteŋ, naate waa ɡwaa Jona lɔ bonɔ, asɛ he ŋɔ haa o bee no.
Kandea waa dɛ chaah we-ɛɛla “Nomɛlbwa aa kandea choŋi asɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ sɔh dea bini, bela nomɛlbwa aa wola on na, kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ kon pi o ta.
Ba choŋi kandea aa, ba kpɔɔ dɛɛ chɔŋɛ kon ta, ásɛ wɛɛ chaah nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ba bela.
Sibie do kɛ kandea dɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyini.
He sibie wer aa, he dɛ na bɔr.
Dɛ a chɔɡɔ ɡe aa, amɔ dɛ he lɔ biro ta.
Gɛɛ a do, dɛ he sie beɡre Korowii waa ta naa, dɛ he wobɛlbwa chaahnɔ.
Kɛ dɛ he sie beɡre harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta naa, he lɔ biro ta.
Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ he sie won chaah waa Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta, he bɛ biro ta so.
Dɛ he sie beɡre Korowii waa ta, asɛ he ɡel wetɔŋla ne dachɔɡe bɛlbwa dɛ lɛ Korowii wa aa, ɡɛɛ he sie ɛɛ ba chaahna kɛrɛdɛ Korowii waa la ta, kɛŋɔ baa choŋi kandea asɛ wɛɛ chaah bɔr kohona la.” Yeesu chɛɡre Farisii ne Tɔnjerema Yeesu aa bol waa tonɛ la, Farisii te bɛl yerɔ ŋɔ ó ba di kwaa o dem.
Anee o la baa la dem dɛ ka so dɛɛ ba kwaa dii.
A ɛ Farisii te la nyokpoa kɛ waa dɛ ba kwaa dii la, o ta nɔɔra samɛ ɡɛ ba nawee wa aa dɛ baɡle la.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He Farisii tena do kɛŋɔ baa loo numoli ne hɛne bwara dɛ ɡel a bini la.
Nɛra sie ta waa ɡboo hɛɛ ɛ, kɛ he bambile bini te, wechɔɡa ne kwaa ta sibeɡra ɡboo he bwa.
Gɛna!
Korowii waa ta yaa nɔ, o laa ɛ ya bini ne ya baŋ bwa kɛɛ?
Hé kpɔ kwaa haa nyina cheɡ la dɛɛ kɛ nyaara he bambile bwa ne ásɛ komɛlbwa do wer tɛ heya.
He Farisii tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ kɛ haa dɛ tɛ Korowii o bɔr he par nyoa kondikonjeɡre kwaraa ta, kɛ dɛ vɛh kasinteŋ ne Korowii nyina te la.
Anɔ nɔɔ chɛ kɛ hɛ́ɛ ɛ, kɛ he bɛ anɔ la aa jaa la ɡel.
Farisii tena, hé bwɛɛlɛ kɛ haa dɛ nyin sobɔrdɛɛɡa cheremi deene bini, dɛɛ nyin kɛ baa duu heyaa nɛra baah ta nɔ.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ!
He do kɛŋɔ ŋwama nɛra aa wola a waa jemɛ dɛɛ valɛ a ta ken.” Belaa Tɔnjerema la bɛl ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, dɛ he ŋɔ ɡɛ naa, dɛ he jo ya ɡba nɛ.” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “He Tɔnjerema haa dɛ baɡle Korowii Waa la ɡe, hé bwɛɛlɛ.
Hé kpɔ wekpeɡa aa do kɛŋɔ bone dɛ dawɛ nɛra nɛ, kɛ dɛ te berɛ laa nɔn kpɔ a ta.
Hé bwɛɛlɛ.
Heyaa ma kwaa chɔŋre Korowii keamere ŋwama ta la.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ laa he naawa kpoo la aa?
Kwaa haa maa chɔŋre Korowii keamere la ŋwama la ta la baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ he ɡbabir sɛh waa he naawa aa ɛa la ta.
Anɔ waa Korowii bol o Tɔn la baa dɛ yerɔ Wejema la bini ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ tomɛ n keamere ne toroma ba bee, baa kpoo banee dɛ́ fiiɡi bane’ la.
Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ pɛɛ fini nɔ nɛra o keamere nɛra aa kpoo ba le harɛ mumpar la bwa waa.
Dɛ le Ebel kpoe ta ka tel Sekaria baa kpoo bela baa dɛ fuh kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii ne Korowii Dea la tenten baah ta la.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, Korowii ɛɛ pɛɛ fini nɔ nɛra ba bwa waa.
Hé Tɔnjerema ɡe bwɛɛlɛ!
He do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa laa dea Korowii wejema aa lɔ o bini karɛ, dɛ laa koŋkare la kpɔ haa wola o binii jo, he ɡe aa nɛra ŋwɛnɛɛ tɛ bá jo dɛ́ ka hweli.” Yeesu aa le bela kaa la, Tɔnjerema la ne Farisii tena la muɡli o baah taeh, dɛ ɡel o bol waa kohona.
Ba haɡro bela dɛ́ lawɛ o nyoa.
Jae Yeesu aa ja nɛra Aa ɛ tama la, nɛra kaɡboŋa baa cheme Yeesu sie.
Baa wara nomanta, dɛ ba dɛ tiɡri dɔŋa nakpale ta.
Belaa Yeesu tɔ sie bol waa o habɔteŋra la be dɛ sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ Farisii tena iisi wa.
Nɛra sie baa nyiŋi dɛɛ ɛ wa.
Wobɛlbwa nɛra aa tɔ a ta la ɛɛ le baŋee, ásɛ waa aa sɔah bwa ɡe le nɛra jemɛ.
Taraken waa haa bola biro ta la, aa le bochaah taa ba no, ásɛ waa haa sɔah bol nɛn be dea he ne o ɡbo la, baa bola nɛnlaa baahnee.
Yabala, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, he bɛ nɛra baa dɛ ba wona kpo heyaa baa wola won ɛ waane kpa la ɔmɛ.
Kɛ mɛɛ baɡle heyaa naate aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won kpo heya, dɛ́ berɛ won kpɔ heyaa kaa Bɔnsam nii ta la.
Onee chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɔmɛ.
He nao kɛ pɛtoprɛ ta yoɡ dɔe, kɛ Korowii ta beŋkpoŋ kwaraa waa soɛh.
He nyumpona kwara, Korowii jemɛ a nyoa.
He bɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ.
He ta pɛtoprɛ ɡwaalɛ wobɛlbwa ta naa?
Hé ɡel ń ŋɔ he be, nomɛlbwa waa won che nɛra baah ta dɛ́ sɛh ŋɔ o ja n nɛɛ la, awola Korowii aa ba dɛ ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la, Men Nɛn Bie la ɡee yerɛ naate sɔn nyundua toroma siee kɛ o ja n nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa vɛɛh mɛ nɛra baah ta, dɛ ŋɔ o ta n nɛɛ jae la, awola Korowii aa ba dɛ́ ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la, n ɡee vɛh naatee nyundua toroma sie ŋɔ n ne o laa.
Nomɛlbwa waa bol waa yaɡɛ Men Nɛn Bie la, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛo, kɛ naate waa ɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la nɛnhɛla la te, Korowii aa o wechɔɡaa kpɔ kɛo.
Dɛ ba yerɛ heyaa ka che cheremi deene bini ne harɛ nɔ ta nomonome sie naa, he bɛ ɡel waa haa bol dɛ lɛ he te la hiah heya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ɛɛ baɡle heyaa buɡ la ta, ɡɛ haa dɛ ba bola.” Suuɡate ɡɛne bɛl sɛɡla Belaa baa bɛl waa ja nɛnlaa la nɛɛ ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ŋɔ n dɔɔ be ásɛ o ɡel ya bɔne kpanjoɡo ya mɛɛ aa sewa dɛ ɡel tɛ yaa a do o be la bini.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nɛmbaa, umee kpɔ mɛ cheɡ ŋɔ ń bol he waa dɛ́ bɔne he kapɛrɛ ɔ?” O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ he nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ kwaa dɛɛ kam, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini kondɔɔh kohona laa o mkpa.” Yeesu sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Suuɡa te bɛlee fa lole o koo kondikwaa ɛ taeh.
Belaa o so dɛ lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?
Bela maa chea do la aa kanɛ.’ Anee o ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ paɡre n dɔndɔŋre nɔɔ dɛ́ ɛa a do kan, ásɛ n mea ne n kwaa bwa dɔ bɔr jo a bini.’ O lii waa o nyu bini dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N dɔ kwaa dɛ́ di la sie, mɛɛ diu dɛ́ lɛ n sie dɛ́ so dɛɛ onɛ.’ Anee Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Gɛne!
Fini jwaana nɔ ne hɛɛ sewɔɔ, ásɛ kwaa haa kwaara cheɡ la, lee hɛɛ ba a bɔr nae jaɔ?’ ” Waa Yeesu aa bola dɛ kpɔ teŋe ɡɛ waa la ta laanee kɛ, “Gɛɛ aa ba nɛra baa kwaa kondɔɔh dɛɛ cheɡ ba te harɛ ta bonɔ baa wola kembɔr bɛlbwa dɔe Korowii be la nɛɛ doe.” Hé yarada Korowii Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Anomanta, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, he bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre he soɡa bini kwaa haa di ne yale haa tɔ wa.
He mkpa ɡwaa kondikwa, he bwadabii ɡe ɡwaa yal.
Hé ta sie nyiŋi jumbii na.
Aa kwaa du, aa komɛ, a ta bela aa komɛ kwaa dɛɛ do dɔe.
Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛa kondikwa.
He ɡwaa jumbii bam!
He bini umee dɛ́ won kpɔ sibeɡra ŋwɛnɛ bɛl dɛ́ kpɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ja o mkpa ta nɔ?
Dɛ haa won ɛ a ɡɛ wetamaa nɔ ɡba aa, ɛrɛɛ he ɡel he sie ɛɛ beɡre anɔ la aa kaa waɔ?
Hé ta sie nyiŋi ɡɛ kpɔɡ bini koŋkwaa dɛ fe aa, a fee yon do wer la dɛ́ na.
Aa toma ɛ dɛɛ koh, aa yabi ta.
Kɛ n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, Kooro Solomɔn ɡba ne o kondɔɔh bwa, o laala ta wer doe kɛ a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwa.
Kpɔɡa haa naa a do wer fini, ásɛ kere ɡbo dɛ a serewɔ ba fuah nɔ, dɛ Korowii ɡelɔ a do wer ken naa, ɛrɛɛ waa wola won tɔ heyaa yal ɡwaala ɔ?
He yarada aa kanɛ kwara!
Anomanta, he bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre hɛɛ nyin anɔ la haa di ne anɔ la haa nyɔ.
Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ baa wola Korowii tomɛ la liiree dɛɛ do a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ ta.
He Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la jemɔ kɛ he dɛ nyin anɔ bwa.
Hé ɡel he sie beɡre Korowii Kora la ta, ásɛ o kpɔ anɔ haa dɛ nyin nɔ bwa tɛ heya.” Korowii doa kondɔɔh Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “Anomanta, Korowii toroma, haa kanɛ, kɛ he bɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ, dɛkalkɛ a dɛ ɛ he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la silɛɛ kɛ he ja o Kora la ta.
Hé yoɡ kwaa haa dɔa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ a suuɡa la kɛ nyaara.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, hɛɛ dɔ pure aa wola chɔɡ ne kondɔɔh aa wola tonɛ bwa Korowii doa.
Belaa kondɔɔh aa wola mule, dɛkalkɛ ŋwɛɛra aa won la ka ŋwɛa, kwaa ɡe aa wola won chwea.
Bela he kondɔɔh aa lole laanee he liire ɡe do.
Bonɔɔna baa dɔ liire dɛɛ kpa Hé kpɔ he te dɛɛ kpa toma ɛɛ.
Hé kpɔ he te dɛ́ ɡel he kandere ɛɛ hɔ, kɛŋɔ bonɔɔna ba dɔɔ aa kaa hanfale chema asɛ ba so kpao, ásɛ dɛ o balɔ dɛ ba lɔ ɡbera aa, buɡ la ta, ba yao la.
Bonɔɔna baa soɡa kpa ba dɔɔ, ba ta dom chɔe o ba puu ba la, ba sie dɛ lɛ.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, wɛɛ kpɔ o tenee dɛ́ yer ba so tiɡ ta, ásɛ dɛ tɛɛ ba kwaa ba di.
Dɛ ba dɔɔ la balɔ jwaana kɛɛ harambaŋa dɛ ba puu ba kɛ ba soɡo kpao waa, ba sie ɛɛ lɛo.
Hɛ́ɛ no.
Dɛ dem te fe jemɛ ɡɛ saŋ ŋwɛɛ aa ba ŋwɛo waa, o fe aa ɡel ó won ba jo o dem dɛ́ ŋwɛo.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɡe kpɔ he te, dɛ́ so kpa, dɛkalkɛ piɡraa Men Nɛn Bie la ɛɛ ba ba piɡri heya.” Kasinteŋ te ne kasinteŋ te bɛ dɔe wa Anee Pita ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, yanee hɛɛ sɛɡle nɔ kɛɛ nomɛlbwa jao wɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Bonɔɔ waa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛ dɔ liire la nɔn taa o dɔɔ kpɔ o dem tena dɛɛ do, dɛ ŋɔ bɔr dɛ maɡre aa, ó tɛɛ ba kondikwa.
Dɛ bonɔɔ la dɔɔ la baa puu, dɛ o dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa kpɔa do o nɔn ta la aa, bonɔɔ la sie ɛɛ lɛo.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, o dɔɔ la ɛɛ kpɔ o komɛlbwaa do o nɔn ta ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi a ta.
Kɛ dɛ bonɔɔ la ta ɡɛ liire, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N dɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ waa kaala nɔ, waa ba taraken,’ dɛ do o dɔŋa bonɔɔna la ne toli baa kaa la nɛɛ dɛɛ lɔɔ, dɛ di kwaa dɛ nyɔ sen dɛɛ dɛɛ raa, amɔ wɛɛ na waa.
Tɔpebeŋkpoŋii o dɔɔ ɛɛ ba bala ba piɡru, ásɛ dɛ ba tɛr o deŋne taeh kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɛ nɛra baa wola Korowii yarada la ken.
Bonɔɔ waa jemɛ ɡɛ o dɔɔ aa dɛ nyin, kɛ dɛ vɛh o te kpɔe dɛ ɛ ɡɛ tɛo la, o dɔɔ ɛɛ ɡeloo ba lɔɔro taeh.
Kɛ bonɔɔ waa wola ɡɛ o dɔɔ aa dɛ nyin jemɛ, dɛ ɛ lɔɔra waa la, baa lɔɔroo tamaa ken dɛ́ kpɔ tɛr o deŋne.
Nɛn Korowii aa chao o jemɛ waa kohona la nɛɛ o kpɔ wedamanta ɛɛ dawɛ.
Nɛn baa kpɔ waa do o nɔn ta kohona la bee baa bɔɔ waa kohona.
Gɛ Yeesu aa bala ásɛ nɛra baah peɡri N balɔ dɛ́ ba kpɔ nii ta harɛ nɔ ta ó fuh.
Dɛ nii la fe dɔɔ dɛɛ hɔ aa, a fe ɛɛ do n somee taeh.
Wahala ane chɔ n sie a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá do mɛ a ta kɛŋɔ ba dɛ sɔ nɛn Korowii ne aa, ba yon doo nee ta la.
Dɛ n ta a ɡɛ wahala la nae tonaa, n bambile ta men sɔɔhnɛ.
He dɛ lii kɛ n ba nyopɛo ne harɛ nɔ ta kɛɛ?
Akai, n balɔ ásɛ nɛra ne ba lolanar dɔm.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa, dembeŋkpoŋ nɛra banue aa lɔ o ta la, ba baah dɛ ba pera ásɛ batoro hah banɛ, ásɛ banɛ la ɡe hah batoro la.
Mɛɛnanar dɛ ba ba bibaala haeh, ásɛ bibaala ɡe hah ba mɛɛnanar.
Nyare ɛɛ hah ba bihaahnaa, ásɛ bihaahna hah ba nyare.
Haahna ɛɛ hah ba bii haahnaa, ásɛ ba bii haahna hah ba.” Waa mun jema Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ nɛnlaa la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he na baama dɛ kaa mun ta naa, ɡɛɛ he ŋɔ bwaala dɛ ba nɛɛ, dɛ o nɛo.
He jemɛ bela peu aa le dɛɛ ta he ŋɔ bɔwɔb ɛɛ bao, dɛ o balɔ kpela.
Nɛra haa dɛ nyiŋi nɛn siebɔr mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa, he won nyundua ne harɛ nyiŋa dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa, aah ɛrɛ waa haa wola won jemɛ waa aa dɛ chiɡ taraken nɔ te mun nɔɔ?
He te aa won nyiŋi dɛ́ na waa aa wera dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta naa?
Dɛ he ne he dɔŋ dɔɔ, asɛ o kpɔe dɛɛ kaa kɔɔto aa, larawe naate he ne o pɛ.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa, o tel he ne bela aa, kɔɔto nomoa waa dɛ pa bole la dɛ ba he kpɔe dɛ́ tɛ prosiri, ásɛ ba ka doe dea.
Belaa hɛɛ ba doe ka tel kɛ haa bɔ suuɡa baa dɛ lɛɛ la bwa ka tonɛ, kapɛrɛ ɡba aa wola ka.”
Liire chara dɛ́ le wechɔɡa ta dɛ bɛ sewɛ Gɛ saŋ la dɛ nɛra bane lɔ bela dɛ ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ Galilia tena bane fa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, asɛ Paelet kpoo ba, asɛ ba chal koo kwaa baa kpoa tɛ Korowii la chal ta.
Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ waa aa pu a ɡɛ Galilia tena nɔ dɛ́ baɡle kɛ ba wechɔɡa ɡwaa Galilia tena baa kaa la kwaa kɛɛ?
N dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ɡɛ laa a do.
Dɛ he ta he liire charɛ le he wechɔɡa ta naa, he bwa ɡee serewoo.” Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Asɛ nɛra fi dɛ banuatoro bane dejaŋ bɛl aa kua chole ba nɛɛ Siloam ba bwa serewe la ɡeɔ?
He liire dɛ ɛ heyaa kɛ ba wechɔɡa ɡwaa nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam bwa kwaa kɛɛ?
N dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ɡɛ laa a do.
Dɛ he ta he liire charɛ dɛ le wechɔɡa ta naa, he bwa ɡee serewoo.” Fiɡ da waa wola nɔnɛ sɛɡla Yeesu sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Baa bɛlee fa lole dɛ ɛ bodɛɛɡe dɛ du daa bɛl o ta.
O laŋɔ ŋɔ ó ka nyin o nɔna toɡri, o ta nɔn beŋkpoŋ kwaraa dɔe o ta.
Anee o ŋɔ nɛn waa kpɔɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi bodɛɛɡe waa du daa la ta la be ŋɔ, ‘Na, bene atoroo nɔ maa dɛ ba bonɔ dɛ baa nyin daa nɔ nɔna, kɛ maa ane dɔ.
Anomanta, teŋo ta!
Ɛrɛɛ o che bonɔ dɛ lɛ bɔr dɛɛ ɛɔ?’ Asɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi bodɛɛɡe baa du daa o ta la ŋɔ, ‘N Dɔɔ, ɡel o che benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ja yá na.
Mɛɛ kwi o munii dɛ́ che nabena do o mun ta.
Dɛ benanyoa chemo o nɔnaa, amɔ te dɛ anee.
O ta wone nɔnɛ ɡe aa, ásɛ he teŋo ta.’ ” Yeesu chah haah bɛl waa ɡura Ona Tɔpere ta Awola Ona Tɔpere bɛl, dɛ Yeesu dɛ baɡle waa ba cheremi dea bɛl ta.
Dɛ haah bɛl kwa aa dɛ ir o nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ weela ta o nɛɛ bene fi dɛ anuatoro, dɛ ɡuro waa wola won pee o te kwaraa lɔ bela.
Yeesu aa nao la, o yerɔ dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Haah, le fini dɛɛ kaa, he weela kaalɔ, aa ba kpa.” Yeesu kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ haah la nɛ, asɛ buɡ la ta, o won pee o te, dɛ jam Korowii.
Cheremi dea bela nomoa la baah diu kɛ Yeesu aa chah nɛn Ona Tɔpere ta la, dɛ ŋɔ nɛra la aa lɔ bela la be ŋɔ, “Tɔpera anumɛlee chɛ kɛŋɔ yá kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma.
Anomanta, a ɡɛ tɔpera la taa chɛ kɛ hé baa chah he weela, kɛ Ona Tɔpere te ta laa!” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Nɛra haa dɛ nyiŋi nɛn siebɔr mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ wa!
Haa he nae ne keeɡore yae dɛɛ ta Ona Tɔpere dɛ teɡa la nee ta a kaa nyɔ ne aa?
Haah nɔ, Abraham naa on.
Bene fi dɛ anuatoroo la Bɔnsam aa soɡe o nɛɛ dɛ chɔɡo, aah aa were kɛ bá doŋi Bɔnsam la le o nɛɛ Ona Tɔpere dɛ́ lɛo ta aa?” Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ la, sihiih kpo o dɔma la.
Kɛ nɛnlaa baa kaa la te sie lɛ nyokpowaa waa ɛa la ta.
Mastad bi sɛɡla Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ tenee Korowii Kora waa la doɔ?
Bɔkwa konee mɛɛ ba o kpɔe dɛ maɡɔɔ?
O waa tamaa bɛlbwa won yɛɛra kɛŋɔ baa bɛl aa ira dɛ kpɔ mastad bii waa do jeɡaa ɡwaa daa bɛlbwa bi, dɛ kpɔ ka du, asɛ o le dɛ ɛ da, jumbii sɔh kɔne do o kpala ta.” Iisi sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa konee ń berɛ kpɔ Korowii Kora waa la maɡɛ jaɔ?
