A do kɛŋɔ haah bɛl aa ira dɛ kpɔ iisi tama ka koo men loɡbaa del ta, asɛ a won ɡel men la bwa uɡe.” Doonyoa waa do feelɔɔ Yeesu chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Waa dɛ kaa la, o kpɔ bwɛjena ne bwɛjeɡre ta dɛɛ baɡle nɛra wa.
Anee nomɛl bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, nɛra tama kenii Korowii ɛɛ ba lɛɛ yaa?” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé takapɔ dɛ́ kpɔ doonyoa waa do feelɔɔ o ta joe do kpeɡri la ta, dɛ́ jo ka ja Korowii Kora la ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra ɛɛ warɔɔ dɛ́ɛ nyin dɛ́ jo bela, kɛ baa won dɔ bɔr jo.
Dem te la ɛɛ iruu dɛ́ ba laa ɡbera la tɔ, a ka heyaa che baŋ, ásɛ hɛɛ lɔ ɡbera dɛɛ soŋo ŋɔ, ‘N poori, nomoa!
Laa ɡbera ya yaa ásɛ ya jo.’ Ásɛ o ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Maa heyaa jemɛ bobɛlbwa.’ Belaa hɛɛ ba ŋɔe ŋɔ, ‘Ya ne he fa pɛ nɔn di kwa, asɛ he bol waa baɡle yaa ya bwɛɛ ka.’ Ásɛ o berɛ ŋɔ he be ja ŋɔ, ‘N ŋɔ maa heyaa jemɛ bobɛlbwa.
Hé le n nɛɛ kaa, nɛnchɔɡa bane!’ Bela la, hɛɛ na Abraham ne Aesek ne Jekɔb dɛ Korowii keamere la bwa Korowii Kora la taa, ásɛ Korowii doŋi he te ta.
Belaa aa ba he nɛɛ wee, ásɛ hɛɛ wi.
Nɛra ɛɛ le wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr ne weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔree dɛ́ ba ja Korowii Kora la ta, ásɛ dɛ pɛ nɔn di kwaa dɛ́ lɛ sie.
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ muŋkaala ɛɛ ba tɔ siee, ásɛ sitɔɔla berɛ ba ka mun.” Gɛ Yeesu aa dɛ nyin Jerusalam Yeesu taa cheɡɛ buɡ la ta la, Farisii tena bane ba o be dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ he le bonɔ dɛ kaa bobɛl, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Kooro Hɛrɔd dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpoe.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ka ŋɔ baradeɛre te la be ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ so lee dɛɛ doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛ, dɛɛ chah weela tena tɔpera anɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ tonɛ n toma.’ Mɛɛ sewɔɔ te, kɛ a chɛ kɛ ń valɛ ŋwɛnɛ tɔpera anɛ dɛ́ kaa Jerusalam.
Bela laa baa kpoo Korowii keamere aa?
Oo, Jerusalam tena!
Korowii tomɛ o keamere he be naa, ɡɛɛ he kpoo ba, o tomɛ toroma he be naa, ɡɛɛ he foɡ ba bwea.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa mɛɛ nyin kɛ ń kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛɛ kɛ jal aa lawɛ o bii dɛɛ do o kena lɔɡre la, kɛ haa nyin kɛ ń lawɛ heyaa pɛ.
Taraken te, Korowii ta he waa tɛ heya.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, haa men na kpa ka tel ɡɛ saŋ maa ba ja, asɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Woowo!
Korowii swee naate waa valɛ o sɔn ta dɛɛ ba nɔ andɛɛɡa!’ ”
Yeesu aa chah baa bɛl waa ɛ weela te Awola Ona Tɔpere bɛl, Yeesu la Farisii tena nomonome la bɛl dem dɛɛ la ka di kwa, asɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela la ɛɛ nyiŋu dɛɛ kari waa waa dɛ ɛ bwa.
Dɛ baa bɛl waa suuɡa soɡe Yeesu sie bela, anee Yeesu bɔɔ Tɔnjerema la ne Farisii tena la ŋɔ, “Ya mmarare la dɛ tɛ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ba chah nɛn Ona Tɔpere aa?” Asɛ ba bwa hel.
Anee o lawɛ baa la dɛ chaoh dɛ ɡel o kaa.
Asɛ o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He bini umee o bie kɛɛ o nao le kɔlɔŋ bini Ona Tɔpere, waa wola on lawɛ le kɔlɔŋ la bini warane Ona Tɔpere la tenten ta nɔ?” Ba ta wone dɔ waane chaŋo a ɡɛ waa la ta.
Nɛra baa yer ba ŋɔ bá ba di kwaa la aa bala la, dɛ ba dɛ pɛne sobɔrdɛɛɡa dɛ́ so.
Anee Yeesu aa na ba ɡɛ la, o kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa baɡ ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛl baa yerɛ heyaa hanfale kondikwaa mun ŋɔ hé ba di kwaa aa, he bɛ nomonsobɔra ka pɛne dɛɛ so.
Aa bao kɛ o ken ka yerɛ nomɛl o nomonome aa ɡwaale.
Dɛ o balaa, naate waa yerɛ he bwa la ɛɛ ba ŋɔ he bee ŋɔ hé ir dɛ́ kpɔ nomombɔr la tɛ nomoa la.
Belaa hɛɛ ba sihiih kpɔe dɛ́ ir ka so bechasobɔr nɛra la bwa habɔɔ.
Dɛ ba yerɛ a ɡɛ yer nɔ dɔŋ bɔr aa, ka so bechasobɔr, ásɛ dɛ naate waa yerɛ la balaa, ó ba ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘N dam, ir kaa sie nomombɔr bela ka so.’ An dɛ tɛɛ jirima nɛra baa yerɛ he ne ba bwa la siwi ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ maŋkura o te la, Korowii ɛɛ ba o ne harɛɛ, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ pwɛr o te la, Korowii ɛɛ ɛo nɛnjenii.” Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, o ŋɔ baa la waa yer ba ŋɔ bá ba di kwaa la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ɛ kondikonjena webaŋa kɛɛ jwaana dɛɛ yerɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá ba di aa, bɛ he daamanar, he nimanar, he lola, kɛɛ he dɔŋa kondɔɔhna ɡbo yerɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ɡee ɛ anee dɛ́ yerɛ, amɔ dɛ he kwaa la kemee ba bɔe la.
Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ soo siwi aa, yerɛ nyaara ne boobie ne nɛra ba nakpale aa teŋna, ne nyoŋa bá ba di, ásɛ Korowii ɛɛ andɛɛɡa, dɛkalkɛ ba ta komɛlbwa dɔe dɛ kpɔ bɔe kem.
Awola nɛndɛɛɡa ba wa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi aa ir seo ta la, Korowii ɛɛ bɔe a kemee.” Kondikonjena ane sɛɡla Nɛra Yeesu ne baa soɡe kondibɔr la bɛl no ɡɛ waa la, dɛ ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa ba ja Korowii Kora la ta dɛ́ di kwaa la, ba sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛrɛdɛ!” Anee Yeesu sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Baa bɛlee fa lole dɛ ɛ kondikonjena, dɛ yerɛ nɛra pirim ŋɔ bá ba di.
Bɔr maɡrɔ kɛ bá ba kondikwaa la dibɔr, asɛ o tomɛ bonɔɔ ŋɔ ó ka yerɛ nɛra waa yer ba la ŋɔ bá ba, kɛ o tonɛ komɛlbwa.
Bonɔɔ la aa la ba be la, ba bwa ŋɔ ba ta bɔr dɔe, dɛ vɛh.
Sitɔte la ŋɔ bonɔɔ la be ŋɔ o yawɛ harɛ bɛl a chɛ kɛ ó la dɛ́ ka nao, anomanta, bonɔɔ la ka ŋɔ o dɔɔ be ŋɔ o bɛ ɡel a ɛ waane kɛ waa wola bɔr dɔe dɛ́ ba la.
Bɛl ɡe ŋɔ o yawɛ nae fi dɛ vɔrɔwe kwaa doa dɛɛ kaa a ne koo dɛ́ ka parɛ a ne dɛ́ na, kɛ tórome la ka ŋɔ o dɔɔ be ŋɔ o bɛ ɡel a ɛ waane kɛ waa wola bɔr dɔe dɛ́ ba la.
Bɛl ɡe ŋɔ waa mo haah ta biɡre, anomanta, waa won ba.
Asɛ bonɔɔ la la dɛ ka ŋɔ o dɔɔ la be ɡɛ baa bola la.
Anee o dɔɔ la baah di, o ŋɔ o bonɔɔ la be ŋɔ, ‘Ɛ warane kaa fɔɡbaah ne lomoola ta, dɛ́ ka yerɛ nyaara ne boobie ne nyoŋa ne nɛra ba nakpale aa teŋna ásɛ ba ba di kwaa la.’ A ta biɡre bɛlbwa bonɔɔ la ba dɛ ba ŋɔ o dɔɔ la be ŋɔ, ‘N la he tom la, kɛ sobɔra ane ta chɔ le pɛɛpɛɛ.’ Anee o berɛ ŋɔ bonɔɔ la be ŋɔ, ‘La ŋwɛnɛre ta ne dahare, nomɛlbwa haa nao la, lawɔ ba ásɛ n dem bonɔ su.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, nɛra n fa aa yer ba la bini bɛlbwa aa n kondikwaa nɔɔ di kpa!’ ” Gɛ Yeesu nɛɛ teŋa aa do kpeɡri Awola bɛl, nɛnlaa bane ja Yeesu nɛɛ o ne baa kaa, asɛ o ka berɛ o te dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa ba n be o ta men nyine ɡwaa o mɛɛ ne o nya, ne o haah ne bii, o dɔɔranar ne nimanar ne nimambii dɛ o ɡbaɡba aa, waa won ɛ n habɔteŋre.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola won kpɔ o te tɛ, dɛ sɛh wahala nae ne seo bwa, dɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa kpɔ daɡaɡre che bá ka kpaaro pɛl o ta la waa won ɛ n habɔteŋre.
Dɛ he bini bɛl dɛ nyin kɛ o do dejaŋ aa, waa nyiŋi na kɛŋɔ o dɔ suuɡa aa dɛ ba wona tel la aa?
O ta nyiŋe kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛ pa dea la mun, dɛ o ta ba wone tonɛ dea la doe yaa, nɛra ɛɛ mamɔɔ, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Baa nɔ laa fe dɛ do dem la aa?
O laa hora naa?’ Dɛ kooro ne o koodɔŋ bɛl dɔ yoi, o dɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fi o dɔŋ la ɡe dɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ naa, waa so dɛ́ lii kɛ wɛɛ wonoo kpɔ o nɛra la ka pu o dɔŋ la waa dɔ nɛra ɡwaalo la mɔɔ dɛ́ le ka puu wa aa?
O ne o dɔŋ la baah taa jaŋa o na kɛŋɔ waa won puu yo la, wɛɛ do toromaa bá ka larawo ásɛ ba pɛ.
Gɛ tentenee a chɛ kɛ he so lii mɔɔ.
Nomɛlbwa ta o komɛlbwa ɡelaa, waa won ɛ n habɔteŋre.
Yar wer, kɛ dɛ aa somɛ kpa aa, ɛrɛɛ baa ba a ɛɛ á do som jaɔ?
A ta wejema dɔe bá ɛ kpa.
Aa harɛ ɡba kwaa.
Fuɡaa a den chɛ kɛŋɔ bá fuɡa ta.
He naate haa no la, no.”
Penyoɡre bɛl sɛɡla Awola bɛl, toɔ lɛɛra baa dɛ bɔ apoo ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra teŋɔ dɛ ba bar Yeesu cheme dɛ́ no o wa.
Anee Farisii tena ne Tɔnjerema bane ŋwalɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ baa nɔ dɛ lɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra o ne ba yon pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwa.” Belaa Yeesu sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “He bini umee dɛ dɔ peera lafa, ásɛ beŋkpoŋ nyoɡraa, waa wola o bɔree ɡaaɡe ɔ?
Wɛɛ ɡel fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ laanee a dibɔr tama, dɛ́ ka ɡaaɡe beŋkpoŋ waa nyoɡra la bɔr ka tel kɛŋɔ waa nao.
Dɛ naate na a ɡɛ pee nɔ naa, silɛɛ kohona nomanta, wɛɛ kpɔɔ dawɛ vam ba dem.
O ba dem aa, wɛɛ ŋɔ o daamanar ne nɛra o ne baa soɡa bwa bee ŋɔ, ‘N sie lɛo kohona kɛŋɔ maa na n pee waa nyoɡra nɔ.
Anomanta, hé ba yá lɛ ya sie.’ Kasinteŋ, ɡɛɛ aa ba Korowii doa ɡe doe.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ beŋkpoŋ charɛ o liire dɛ le o wechɔɡa ta naa, Korowii ne o nyundua toroma sie ɛɛ lɛ o nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡwaa nɛra fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banuanaarɛ baa dɛ lii kɛ ba ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa baa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba charɛ ba liire dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta.
Suuɡa nyoɡre bɛl sɛɡla Gɛ laa ɡe aa, haah besoo lole dɛ dɔ suuɡapoŋa fi, asɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ nyoɡraa, waa wola niinii choŋi dɛ chaa o dea dɛ ɡaaɡe o bɔr sibeɡra ne ka tel kɛŋɔ waa nao wɔ?
O nao waa, wɛɛ yerɛ o daamanar ne nɛra o ne baa soɡa laanee dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N sie lɛo kohona kɛŋɔ maa na n suuɡapoŋ waa nyoɡra nɔ.
Anomanta, hé ba yá lɛ ya sie.’ Kasinteŋ, ɡɛɛ aa ba Korowii doa ɡe doe.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ beŋkpoŋ charɛ o liire dɛ le o wechɔɡa ta naa, Korowii ne o nyundua toroma sie ɛɛ lɛ o nɛɛ taeh.” Binyoɡre bɛl sɛɡla Yeesu berɔ sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Baa bɛl fa dɔ bibaala banɛ.
O bii la bini ombechala la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó bɔne o kpanjoɡo bini, ásɛ dɛ tɛo o bɔr.
Asɛ baa la bɔne o kpanjoɡo la bini tɛ o bii la, dɛ kpɔ o bie bechala la bɔr tɛo.
A ta tɔpere bɛl dii, o bie bechala la yoɡ o te kwaa la bwa, dɛ kpɔ o suuɡa jo pua bojaŋ kaa.
Waa laŋa la, o kaa ɛ suuɡa la saɡasaɡa ken.
Waa baa di suuɡa la bwa la, a ta tɔpere bɛl dii, asɛ lɔrjen bɛl chole harɛ la ta bela waa lole la, dɛ o ta suuɡa dɔe, o ta kondikwaa ɡe dɔe dɛ́ di.
Aa do ɡɛ la, o kpɔ o te ka pɛl bela te bɛl, asɛ o ɡel o kaa nyiŋi o parakooni nɛ.
Lɔr la nyoa baa do kpeɡri kohona, asɛ o baa pɛlɛ parakooni la kondikwaa kwaraa ta, kɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe ta on komɛlbwa tɛɛ.
Asɛ o sie aa baa ba harɛ la, o soɡo dɛ lii o mɛɛ waa dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N mɛɛ bonɔɔna kwaraa baa lɔ o sie la di kwaa dɛɛ ka, asɛ n do bonɔ lɔr ɛɛ kpo mɛ la.
Mɛɛ iruu, dɛ́ la n mɛɛ be dɛ́ ka ŋɔ, “N mɛɛ, n ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo he ne Korowii bwa nɛ.
N ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he yer mɛ he bie kpa.
Kɛ n poori, lɛɛ mɛ dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ ɛ he bonɔɔna la bɛl.” ’ Bie la aa lii ɡɛ la, o iro chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa o mɛɛ be.
Waa dɛ kaa o mɛɛ be la, o mɛɛ lɔ dem dɛ nao bojaŋ, asɛ o tea domɔ, o chwa chemo dɛ ka ɡbaaro pɛl o bambile.
Belaa bie la ŋɔ, ‘N mɛɛ, n jo he ne Korowii nɛ.
N ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he yer mɛ he bie kpa.’ Bie la nyoa ta lee mɔɔ dɛ o mɛɛ yerɛ o bonɔɔna ŋɔ, ‘Hé chwa ka nyiŋi n yale la bwa bini ondɛɛɡe ba tɛo ó tɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ noniseɡdɛɛɡe ba doo, dɛ́ nyin naŋɡawa ba tɛo ó do.
He tonaa, hé ka lawɛ nabie la bwa bini ondɛɛɡe dɛ́ ba kpo, ásɛ ya di kwa, dɛ́ lɛ ya sie, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n fa liiro kɛŋɔ n bie nɔ sewɔ, asɛ o berɛ ba nɔ.
O fa aa nyoɡra la, taraken te n nao.’ Ate, ba ɛ kondikwaare dɛɛ di dɛɛ lɛ ba sie tenten.
Waa nɔ bwa aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ binomoa la le koo dɛɛ ba.
Waa dɛ tel ba dem la, o no ɡboŋri ne yela ne sae ɡbɔɡa dem bela.
Anee o yerɛ o mɛɛ bonɔɔna la bɛl dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, ‘Bɔkwa waa chiɡ deemɔ?’ Anee o ŋɔ, ‘He nime la waa joa kaa la, onee bala, asɛ he mɛɛ ɡel ya kpo nabie la bwa bini ondɛɛɡe la dɛ ɛ kondikwaa dɛ di dɛɛ lɛ ya sie, dɛkalkɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa ta on ɛɛ.’ Asɛ binomoa la baah di, o kire ŋɔ waa deemii jo.
Asɛ o mɛɛ ba larawo ŋɔ ó ba dem.
Belaa bie la ŋɔ o mɛɛ be ŋɔ, ‘N mɛɛ, n ɡe aa dena dɛɛ tomɛ saŋ la bwa, n ta he toma vɛɛh bwa, bɔkwa konee he tɛ mɛ nɔ?
He ta bombie kwaraa lawɛ tɛ mɛ ŋɔ ń kpo n ɡe ne n daamanar kpɔ lɛ sie bwa.
Kɛ he bie nɔ waa kaa chɔɡ o suuɡa haahna nɛɛ dɛ ba nɔ, he berɔ ɡarɛ kpo nabidɛɛɡe tɛo.’ Anee baa la ŋɔ, ‘N bidɛɛɡe, n ne haa lole nɔ, n komɛlbwa maa dɔa la, hen dɔa.
He nime nɔ aa nyoɡra dɛ berɛ ba nɔ, a chɛ kɛŋɔ yá ɡel ya sie lɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya ŋɔ o sewɔ, o berɛ ba nɔ, ya ŋɔ o nyoɡrɔ, kɛ taraken ya nao.’ ”
Bonɔɔ wejereme bɛl Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Baa bɛlee fa lole dɛ ɛ kondɔɔh, dɛ kpɔ o kwaa bwa do o bonɔɔ bɛl nɔn ta ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi a ta.
Belaa nɛra ka ŋɔ suuɡate la be ŋɔ o bonɔɔ la dɛ di o suuɡa saɡasaɡa.
Anee suuɡate la tomɛ nɛn o ka yerɛ o bonɔɔ la, asɛ o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘N dɛ no waane kɛ he dɛ di n suuɡa.
Ka kpɔ he tɔn ba, dɛ́ ba baɡ mɛ suuɡa aa jo he nɔn ta, ne ɡɛ haa ɛ a ne, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ n kwaa do n nɔn ta, dɛkalkɛ maa ɡel he nyiŋi n kwaa ta kpa.’ Asɛ bonɔɔ la kaa dɛ ka lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, ‘N dɔɔ dɛ ba men toma ta lee.
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?
N ɡe aa kpeɡe dɛ parɛ di, asɛ n sie ɡe ɡarɔ ne kwaa soŋa.
N jemɛ ɡɛ maa ɛ, ásɛ dɛ ba lee mɛ toma ta naa, ń dɔ daamanar baa nyiŋ mɛ.’ O yerɛ nɛra baa di o dɔɔ kema la beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ bɔɔ sitɔte la ŋɔ, ‘Aŋwɛnɛɛ he di n dɔɔ kem ɔ?’ Anee o ŋɔ, ‘N di kem noo ɡarare lafa.’ Anee bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Lɛ tɔn warane, dɛ́ so harɛ dɛ́ chwerɛ fifraanue.’ Asɛ o berɛ bɔɔ nɛɛte ɡe ŋɔ, ‘Kem aŋwɛnɛɛ he ɡe dio?’ Asɛ o ŋɔ, ‘N di kem mea baaɡere kaɡboŋ.’ Anee bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, ‘Lɛ tɔn dɛ́ so harɛ dɛ́ chwerɛ lafraanuatoro.’ Anee bonɔɔ naŋɡarawa te nɔ dɔɔ la aa noa la, o kpɛɛro ŋɔ o ɛa wejema ta.” Yeesu aa sɛɡ ba tonɛ la, o ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire la, ba dɔ wejema ba ne ba bala kpoŋa dɛ ɡwaa nɛra ba sie aa chaah Korowii waa ta la.” Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ ja ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ he laala ne suuɡa aa ɛ harɛ nɔ ta kondɔɔh la dɛɛ nyin daamanar, ásɛ dɛ a baa hiah heya aa, bá won lɛ heyaa silɛɛ ne bwɛɛ waa wola chɔɡ bwa la ta.
Naate waa wona dɔ kasinteŋ kontamaa ta la, wɛɛ wonoo dɔ kasinteŋ anjena ɡe ta.
Naate waa wola wone dɔ kasinteŋ kontamaa ta la, waa won dɔ kasinteŋ anjena ɡe ta.
Dɛ he ta wone nyiŋi harɛ nɔ ta kondɔɔh a kwara aa ɛ konsale nɔ ta naa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona nyiŋi kondɔɔh tenten ta nɔ?
Dɛ he ta wone nyiŋi nomɛl kon ta naa, umee dɛɛ ba he ɡbaɡba kwaa kpɔe dɛ́ do he nɔn ta nɔ?
Nomɛlbwa aa won tomɛ dɔɔranar banɛ.
Dɛ a ba ɡɛ naa, wɛɛ dɛɛ nyin bɛl waa dɛ́ ɡwaa bɛl.
A laa ɡe aa, o sie ɛɛ dɛɛ lɛ bɛl bee dɛ́ ɡwaa bɛl.
Haa won tomɛ Korowii dɛ́ berɛ won nyin harɛ nɔ ta kondɔɔh a maɡre.” Farisii tena la aa no ɡɛ la, ba chwee Yeesu, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba dɛ nyin suuɡa taeh.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He dɛ ɛ he te kɛ he ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa he waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi, kɛ Korowii jemɛ ɡɛ he liire aa doa.
Kon waa ɛ konjen nɛwɛnyini sie ta la, Korowii te aa on komɛlbwa bu.
Mosis Mmara la ne Korowii keamere la waa la baa chwera laanee lole baa baɡle mɔɔ, dɛ́ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la aa bala.
Le ɡɛ saŋ waa bala dɛ baa bol Korowii Kora la Amanesoma la, nomɛlbwa siwi swɛɛrɔ wɛɛ nyin bɔr dɛ́ ja Korowii Kora la ta.
Kɛ, nyundua ne harɛ ɛɛ chɔɡoo, dɛ ba ta Mmara la bini wejeɡaa bɛlbwa berɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh o haah dɛ berɛ ka mo hanfale la, o ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ bɔ jwamane, asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa mo haah o jaa aa vɛoh la, o ɡe bɔ jwamane.” Dɔɔh bɛl ne Lasorɔs Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Baa bɛlee fa lole dɛ dɔ suuɡa, dɛɛ do laaladɛɛɡa dɛ dɔ kwaa nɔ bwa, asɛ dɛɛ di kondɛɛɡa tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ lɛ o sie tenten.
Dɛ baa bɛl ɡe lole dɛ nya, asɛ ŋwɛra ɛ o bwa baa yerɔ Lasorɔs.
Ba yon kpɔɔ ka bil suuɡate la dem doonyoa, asɛ wɛɛ do hwɛɡa kondikwaa suuɡate la aa di ka asɛ o bonɔɔna kpɔ ba ta la ta.
Hale dɛ nyootena ba dɛ kpɛle o ŋwɛra la.
Nyaa la baa sewɛ, asɛ nyundua toroma ba kpɔɔ kaa nyundua o ka so Abraham be.
Suuɡate la ɡe baa sewɛ, asɛ ba huɡo, asɛ o ka jo Bɔnsam nii ta.
Dɛ o dɛ na nii taeh.
On ŋɔa o nyiŋi, dɛ na Abraham bojaŋ le, asɛ Lasorɔs so o be.
Anee o ha nyoa yerɛ Abraham dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Abraham!
Na n sum, ásɛ dɛ tomɛ Lasorɔs ásɛ o kpɔ o nonii ka leɡe nesɔn dɛ́ kpɔ ba leɡe n nyondoŋe.
N lɔ nii ta n bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ mɛ.’ Anee Abraham ŋɔ, ‘N bie, lii kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ he fa aa lɔ harɛ ta la, he di yɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ Lasorɔs na wahala.
Taraken nɔ o dɛ di yɛɛ, asɛ he ɡee na wahala.
Hale n ŋɔ o ba bela kwaraa noo, waa won ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ bɔjen bɛl lɔ ya ne he baah ta, nomɛlbwa waa lɔ bonɔ dɛɛ nyin o ba bela haa lole la aa wola won ba, asɛ nɛra baa lɔ he be bela dɛɛ nyin dɛ ba bonɔ la ɡe aa won ba.’ Anee suuɡate la ŋɔ, ‘Amɔ te n dɛ soŋe, n Naa, tomɔ ó la n mɛɛ dem, dɛ́ ka kah n nimanar banue bane baa lɔ bela la ŋɔ, ɡɛ maa ɛa la, ba bɛ ɡɛ ɛ ásɛ dɛ ba bonɔ maa lole dɛɛ na wahala nɔ.’ Asɛ Abraham ŋɔ, ‘He nimanar la dɔ tɔne Mosis ne Korowii keamere la aa chwera la, á ja ba.
A chɛ kɛ ba kura dɛ́ no waa baa dɛ bol.’ Anee suuɡate la ŋɔ, ‘Akai, baa no, n Naa.
Kɛ dɛ nomɛl iro le seo ta dɛ ka ŋɔ ba be te naa, anee ba no dɛ́ charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta.’ Anee Abraham ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ baa tɔne Mosis ne Korowii keamere la aa chwera la waa no aa, nomɛl iro le seo ta dɛ la ba be kwara noo, baa no.’ ”
Wechɔɡa wa Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “A ɛ wobɛlbwa, waa aa dɛ ba ɡela nɛn ɛ wechɔɡa la ɛɛ bao.
Kɛ naate aa che o nɛɛ dɛ́ ba la, bwɛɛlɛ.
Dɛ ba vɔwɛ nambwe do naate baŋa dɛ kpɔɔ ka ta mpo vil ta kwara naa, a fe bɔ kɛŋɔ waa ɡela bechajeɡre nɔ dɔŋ bɛlbwa ɛ wechɔɡa.
Anomanta, hé nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ!
Dɛ he dɔŋ ɛɛ wechɔɡa aa, ŋɔ o be.
Dɛ o no a mun dɛ charɛ o liire aa, kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo.
Dɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa o ɛɛ wechɔɡa kera anuanɛ, asɛ dɛ ba he be dɛ ba ŋɔ waa waa ɛɛ la, o kon chɔɡaa, kpɔ kɛo.” Yeesu toroma la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔ, cha yaa dɛ́ ɡel ya dɔ yarada kohona.” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ he yarada fe kan kɛŋɔ sipon ɡba aa, he fe ɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ dajen nɔ aa cheɡa nɔ be ŋɔ ó chuɡri ka che mpo ta, ásɛ o no dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ.” Bonɔɔ toma ɛɛ wa Yeesu berɔ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He bini umee dɛ́ dɔ bonɔɔ wɛɛ parɛ he koo kɛɛ wɛɛ nyiŋi he peera ta, ásɛ waa le toma ta ba dem la, he den ŋɔ o be ó ba di kwa ɔ?
Akai!
Haa o be ɡɛɛ ŋɔ.
Hɛɛ ŋɔ o bee ŋɔ, ‘Ɛ n kondikwaa ka cheɡ mɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ he te ba che n be tiɡ ta, dɛ́ ɛ n wobɛlbwa tɛ mɛ ń di kwaa tonɛ mɔɔ he ɡe ka di he kwa.’ Bonɔɔ la ɛɛ dɔ jaamee waa o dɔɔ la aa doo a ta laanee yaa?
Akai.
Gɛ tentenee he waa do.
Dɛ he ɛ waa Korowii aa do heyaa a ta ŋɔ hé ɛ aa, he bɛ he te kpɛɛ.
Hé ŋɔ, ‘Ya ɛ bonɔɔna yaa wola tɔnɔ dɔe.
Toma aa chɛ kɛŋɔ yá ɛ la ɡboo ya ɛ la.’ ” Weetena fi bane Yeesu aa chaah ba weela Yeesu aa dɛ kaa Jerusalam la, o kpɔ Samaria harɛ ne Galilia harɛ jwɛh ta.
Asɛ waa dɛ jo bwɛjeɡa bɛl ta la, baala fi bane bwadabii weechɔɡa ane aa lɔ ba nɛɛ pa sie o be dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba chemo.
Ba cheɡɛ bojaŋ, dɛ ha nyoa ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu, na ya sum!” Belaa Yeesu aa na ba la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ he te ka baɡle sɔfore la ásɛ ba nyiŋi heyaa na.” Baa chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la, ba weela la kaalɔ, ba bwara kwaa.
Ba bini beŋkpoŋ aa naa kɛŋɔ o weela la kaalɔ o bwara kwaa la, o laa berɛ dɛ baa jam Korowii takpeɡ ne, dɛ ba ɡuŋi Yeesu sie dɛ jaamo.
Dɛ ɡɛ baa la ɛ Samaria te.
Anee Yeesu bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He lɔ nɛra fi n chah heya, leperaa banuanaarɛ la te dɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ baa nɔ waa wola Juu te ɛɛ nɔ ɡbo won kpɔ jam ba tɛ Korowii nɔɔ?” Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir kaa, yarada haa yarada mɛ nɔɔ ɡela he dɔ he te.” Korowii Kora bala wa Awola bɛl, Farisii tena bane bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Bɛweeree Korowii Kora la ɛɛ ba bala ɔ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Korowii Kora la ta komɛl haa dɛ ba o nae ɛɛ.
O ta komɛl yaa dɛ ba ŋɔe ŋɔ, ‘Onee nɔ, kɛɛ onee ka lɔ le nɔ’ ɛɛ.
Bambile binii o do.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Aa ba tel saŋ bɛlee ásɛ hɛɛ nyin dɛ fe dɔ Men Nɛn Bie la kɛŋɔ n ne haa soɡa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo ɡba, kɛ haa ɡɛɛ dɔ.
Nɛra bane ɛɛ ba ŋɔ he bee ŋɔ n lɔ bonɔ kɛɛ le nɔ.
He bɛ ka nyiŋi.
Gɛ bwaala yon nyɛɡle nyundua bwa chaah la, ɡɛɛ Men Nɛn Bie la bala ɛɛ ba doe, nomɛlbwa na mɛ.
Kɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ ń na wahala kohona ásɛ fini nɔ nɛra vɛɛh mɛ, mɔɔ anɔ bɛlbwa ba ɛ. Gɛ aa ɛa Nowa bere saŋ la, ɡɛɛ Men Nɛn Bie la ɡe bala saŋ ɛɛ ba ɛɛ.
Nowa bere saŋ la, dɛ ba dɛ di kwa, dɛɛ nyɔ sene, dɛɛ mo haahna, dɛ lawɛ haahna tɛ baala baa mo, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ awola Nowa aa jo o daka la bini, asɛ bwaala nɛ aaa, mpo ne neerare bwa su tɔ harɛ bwa, asɛ ba bwa serewe kwaraa.
Gɛ tenten aa ɛ Lɔt bere saŋ ɡe asɛ Sodom tena ɛɛ di kwa, dɛɛ nyɔ sene, dɛɛ di bona, dɛɛ parɛ, dɛɛ ma deene la, ɡɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ.
Awola Lɔt aa le Sodom dɛɛ kaa la, Korowii ɡelɔ nii ne jebɔrɔwe aa dɛ fuh le nyundua dɛ ba fuh Sodom tena bwa kwaraa.
Gɛ tentenee aa ba ɛɛ awola Men Nɛn Bie la aa ba ja la.
Awola tɔpere la, nomɛlbwa waa soɡe saldoa o laala do dea la, o bɛ tu ba kpɔ kpa.
Gɛ tentenee nomɛlbwa ɡe waa do koo ta la, o ɡe bɛ dem ba dɛ́ ba kpɔ komɛlbwa kpa.
Hé lii waa aa pu Lɔt haah la.
Nomɛlbwa o siwi aa swɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ kwaa ta la, wɛɛ paŋɛ o nyuu.
Asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe o siwi aa wola harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ kwaa ta lɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu.
Kasinteŋ, awola jwaana la, nɛra banɛ ɛɛ pɛo dɛ́ chɔ kalaŋ beŋkpoŋ ta, ásɛ Korowii ba kpɔ beŋkpoŋ kaa dɛ́ ɡel bɛl.
Haahna banɛ ɛɛ pɛo dɛɛ tuɡe kwa, ásɛ Korowii ba kpɔ bɛl kaa, dɛ́ ɡel bɛl.
Baala banɛ ɛɛ do koo taa, ásɛ o ba kpɔ bɛl kaa dɛ́ ɡel bɛl.” Anee o habɔteŋra la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔ, leperaa aa ba chiɡa ɔ?” Asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Bela konlale aa lole la, belaa kokosakire ɛɛ cheme.”
Luhaah bɛl ne nomoa waa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole sɛɡla Yeesu kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa baɡle o habɔteŋra la, dɛ ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ baa soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ bɛ bɔhwaah dɛɛ ɛ. O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nomoa bɛlee fa lole dɛɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole kɔɔto, dɛ do bwɛɛ bɛl ta.
Dɛ waa Korowii ɔmɛ, waa nɛn ɡe heeh.
Dɛ bwɛɛ la tenten ta la, dɛ luhaah bɛl ɡe lɔ bela, o yon dɛɛ la nomoa la be dɛ kaa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Cha mɛ ásɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔm nɔn ta.’ Dɛ kɔɔto nomoa la aa sie do o be, dɛ ɡel a biɡri.
A habɔɔ la, o lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, ‘Maa Korowii ɔmɛ, maa nɛn ɡe heeh, kɛ luhaah nɔ mare nɔ waa dɛ ɛɛ mɛ nɔ nomanta, mɛɛ nyiŋuu, dɛ́ ɡel ó di bole, ásɛ o laa o melee waane kpɔ n nɛ.’ ” Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “He no ɡɛ kɔɔto nomonchɔɡe la aa bola aa?
Dɛ nɛn waa do ken wono lɛ nɛn aa, ɛrɛɛ Korowii aa wola won cha o nɛra baa wia dɛɛ noo chɔɔ ne jwaana la dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le ba dɔma nɔn ta nɔ?
Aa biɡruu mɔɔ o cha ba aa?
N dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, Korowii ɛɛ wonoo cha ba.
Wɛɛ ɛa warane ɡee.
Dɛ Men Nɛn Bie la balaa, mɛɛ ba pu nɛra baa dɔ yarada harɛ nɔ taa te naa?” Farisii te bɛl ne toɔ lɛɛ bɛl sɛɡla Yeesu sɛɡle nɛra baa dɛ lii ba te kɛŋɔ ba ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ɡwaa nɛra bwa la ŋɔ, “Awola bɛl, nɛra banɛ bane la Korowii Dea dɛ kaa soŋe Korowii.
Dɛ bɛl ɛ Farisii te asɛ bɛl ɡe ɛ nɛnchɔɡa baa dɛ lɛ toɔ la bɛl.
Belaa Farisii te la ir che dɛ soŋe Korowii o nyu bini ŋɔ, ‘Korowii, n dɛ jaame kɛŋɔ maa wola doe kɛ n bala baa dɛ bɔ apoo, baa wola kasinteŋ bol, dɛɛ bɔ jwamane nɔ.
N dɛ jaame kɛŋɔ maa wola doe kɛŋɔ banchɔɡe nɔ waa dɛ lɛ toɔ nɔ.
N dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa tɔpera anɛ yawanyoa bɛlbwa ta, dɛɛ bɔne kwaa maa dɛ dɔ bwa bini bɔre fi dɛ kpɔ beŋkpoŋ dɛ baa tɛ hen Korowii.’ Toɔ lɛɛ la te cheɡɛ bojaŋ, o ta sie hae dɛ nyiŋi nyundua kwara, kɛ dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ nyu dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Oo, N Naa Korowii, wechɔɡ-ɛɛree men.
Na n sum dɛ́ kpɔ n wechɔɡa kɛ mɛ.’ ” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “N dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, toɔ lɛɛ la bee Korowii no dɛ kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo dɛ doo nɛndɛɛɡa bini, asɛ o kaa o dem.
Farisii te la te, o ta o be noɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ maŋkura o te la, Korowii ɛɛ ba o ne harɛɛ, asɛ nomɛlbwa waa pwɛr o te la, Korowii ɛɛ ɛo nɛnjenii.” Yeesu swee bechale bane andɛɛɡa Dɛ nɛra bane kpɔ ba bii dɛɛ ba Yeesu be ŋɔ ó kpɔ o nɔn dawɛ ba nɛ.
O habɔteŋra la aa na ba la, ba kɔɡre nɛra la ŋɔ bá kpɔ ba bii la le le.
Belaa Yeesu yerɛ bechale la ba o be, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “He bɛ bechale la ŋwɛnɛ tɔ.
Hé ɡel ba ba n be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ banɔ dɔŋa nɔɔ Korowii koobii la.
Kasinteŋ, naate waa wola o te kpɔe tɛ Korowii dɛ yaradao kɛŋɔ bechale nɔ la, waa Korowii Kora la ta dɔe ba dɛ́ ja bwa.” Baa bɛl waa ɛ dɔɔh wa Asɛ Juu tena nomoa bɛl bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Nomondɛɛɡe, ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ ń ɛ dɛ́ dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa nɔ?” Anee Yeesu bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he yer mɛ nɛndɛɛɡe nɔɔ?
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe.
Korowii ɡbosoo ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe.
Kɛ he jemɛ Korowii Mmarare la aa dɛ baɡle kɛ, ‘Bɛ jwamane bɔ, bɛ nɛn kpo, bɛ ŋwɛ, bɛ nyosone teŋe dawɛ he dɔŋ nɛ, dɛɛ duu he nya ne he mɛɛ’ laɔ?” Anee baa la ŋɔ, “Gɛ saŋ maa ɛ bechala la bwaa n le dɛ teŋɛ anɔ bwa ta.” Yeesu aa no ɡɛ la, o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “A ta kae webeŋkpoŋ.
Ka yoɡ kwaa haa dɔa, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ a suuɡa kɛ nyaara.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, hɛɛ dɔ kwaa cheɡ Korowii doa.
Ka ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ dɛ ba teŋɛ n nɛ.” Baa la aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, o tea bini chɔɡɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o dɔ suuɡa taeh.
Yeesu nyiŋu dɛ na kɛŋɔ o tea bini chɔɡɔ, asɛ o ŋɔ, “A kpeɡri kɛŋɔ dɔɔh dɔ bɔr ja Korowii Kora la ta.
Aa do pwɛree tɛ nyoɡma kɛŋɔ ó won jo tɔɔɡe bɔɔ ta, ɡwaa kɛŋɔ dɔɔh naa wona ja Korowii Kora la ta.” Nɛra baa no waa nɔ la ŋɔ, “Amɔ te umee dɛɛ ba o nyu dɔe yɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Waa aa kpeɡa tɛ nɛn, waa wola won ɛ la, aa kpeɡe Korowii te be.
Wɛɛ wonoo ɛ.” Asɛ Pita ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi na, ya te, ya ɡel komɛlbwa yaa dɔa dɛ baa teŋɛ he nɛɛ la.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, nomɛlbwa waa koh Korowii Kora nɔ waa dɛ ɡel o dem, kɛɛ o haah ne bii, kɛɛ o nya ne mɛɛ, kɛɛ o dɔɔranar ne o nimanar la, wɛɛ dɔ banee dɛ́ ɡwaa ɡɛ harɛ ta bonɔ.
A bwa habɔɔ la, wɛɛ dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe nyundua laanee ja.” Yeesu bol o seo waa toorotena Yeesu kpɔ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la le bokɛre asɛ dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé no!
Ya dɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Belaa Men Nɛn Bie wobɛlbwa Korowii keamere la aa chwera la ɛɛ ba kpela ɛɛ.
Baa kpɔ mɛɛ do nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la nɔn ta, ásɛ ba di n loro, dɛ́ chɛɡ mɛ, ásɛ dɛ ta nentane ta n nɛ.
Baa lɔɔ mɛɛ, dɛ́ kpo mɛ, ásɛ a tɔpetooro wee la, ń ir seo ta.” Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ waa la ba be la, ba ta a bɛlbwa mun noɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Korowii kpɔ a mun noe sɔɔh ba.
Ba ta ɡɛ waa dɛ bol la mun noɛ.
Yeesu chah nyoŋe bɛl waa dɛ soŋe kwa Baa dɛ tel Jeriko la, dɛ baa bɛl waa nyoŋa soɡe ŋwɛnɛ nyoa dɛɛ soŋe kwa.
Waa no nɛnlaa la ɡbɔɡa ba baa kaa la, o bɔɔ waa aa bala.
Anee ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt laanee ba dɛ kaa.” Belaa o kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Devid Naa Yeesu, na n sum dɛ́ cha mɛ!” Asɛ nɛra baa tɔ sie la kaoh ŋɔ ó tɔ nyoa.
Dɛ name tenee o taa bola kohona kwara, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Devid Naa, na n sum dɛ́ cha mɛ!” Anee Yeesu jaɡɛ che, dɛ ŋɔ bá lawɛ baa la waa nyoŋa la ba tɛo.
Baa ba o ne o be la, Yeesu bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń ɛ tɛɛ nɔ?” Asɛ baa la ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, n poori, ɡel ń berɛ dɛɛ na ja.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He yarada lɛɛ.
N chaeh.
Na bɔr.” Ate, buɡ la ta, dɛ o dɛ na bɔr, dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ, dɛɛ jam Korowii.
Asɛ nɛra la bwa aa naa la, ba kpɛɛ Korowii.
Yeesu ne Sakeos Yeesu la Jeriko dɛ kaa valɛ bwɛɛ la bini.
Dɛ toɔ lɛɛra nomoa bɛl lɔ bwɛɛ la ta dɛ ɛ suuɡate baa yerɔ Sakeos.
Dɛ o dɛ nyin dɛ na ɡɛ Yeesu aa doa, kɛ nɛnlaa la nomanta o ta on nae, dɛkalkɛ o ɛ nɛmbora.
Anee o chwa tɔ nɛnlaa la sie, dɛ ka teeh daa bɛl waa cheɡɛ bela Yeesu aa dɛ ba kpɔe ba kaa la, ásɛ dɛ dɔɔ na.
Yeesu aa baa tel daa la mun la, o ha sie dɛ nyiŋi o doa dɛ ŋɔ Sakeos be ŋɔ, “Ɛ warane dɛ́ tu harɛ ba.
He deaa mɛɛ ba choɡa fini.” Asɛ Sakeos tu harɛ warane dɛ ba kpɔ Yeesu kaa o dem silɛɛ ne.
Nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛ na la ŋwalɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o kaa choɡ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ dea.
Sakeos iro che dɛ ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nomoa!
N dɛ soŋe, no.
Mɛɛ bɔne n laala bini bɔre anɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ beŋkpoŋ kɛ nyaara.
Dɛ n kpɔ apoo ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ lɛ nomɛl kwaane aa, mɛɛ bɔ kwaa la bele anaarɛɛ tɛ naate.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Fini tɔpere nɔ, Korowii lɛ dem nɔ tena, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Abraham naa Sakeos ɡba.
Nɛra baa nyoɡra waa Men Nɛn Bie ba dɛ́ ba nyin ba bɔr dɛ́ lɛɛ ba.” Suuɡaswɛm bwea sɛɡla Dɛ ba dɛ tel Jerusalam, asɛ nɛra la ɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii Kora dii tɔpere la denɔ dɛɛ ba bala.
Baa dɛ no o be la, Yeesu berɔ bol waa sɛɡla ne ba be.
O ŋɔ, “Koobie bɛlee fa lole dɛɛ ba bojaŋ bwɛɛ bɛl ta kaala bá ka cheɡo kora, ásɛ o ba dɛ́ ba ɛ kooro.
Waa dɛ ba kaala la, o yerɛ o bonɔɔna fi, dɛ tɛ bɛlbwa suuɡaswɛm bwe, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá kpɔ dɛɛ di bona ka tel ɡɛ saŋ waa ba.
Waa kaala la, o waa ta o bwɛɛ tena tea toorɛ, asɛ ba tomɛ toroma bá tiu dɛ ka ŋɔ, ‘Yaa baa nɔ nyin kɛ o ɛ ya kooro.’ Kɛ ane a bwa, o dɔ o kora la, dɛ laa berɛ ba.
Waa bala la, o ɡelɔ ba yerɛ o bonɔɔna waa tɛɛ ba suuɡa la tɛo, ásɛ o na suuɡa baa dɔa.
Sitɔte la aa bala la, o ŋɔ nomoa la be ŋɔ, ‘Nomoa, suuɡaswɛm bwe haa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la, n kpɔɔ di bona dɛ dɔ suuɡaswɛm bwea fi dɛ ja onɔ la haa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la ta.’ Anee nomoa la ŋɔ, ‘Jam, bonɔndɛɛɡe, he ɛ wa!
Gɛ haa di kasinteŋ tamaa nɔ ta nɔ, mɛɛ ɡeloo he nyiŋi bwɛɛre fi ta.’ Belaa bonɔn-nɛɛte ba, dɛ ba ŋɔ o dɔɔ la be ŋɔ, ‘Nomoa, n dɔ suuɡaswɛm bwea anue dɛ ja onɔ la haa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la ta.’ Anee nomoa la ŋɔ o ɡe be ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo he nyiŋi bwɛɛre anue ta.’ Asɛ bɛl ɡe ba dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Nomoa, suuɡaswɛm bwe haa tɛ mɛ laanee la.
N kpɔɔ vɔwɛ duku ta dɛ kpɔ sɔh.
N ɔmɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he bambile kpeɡri, he ɛ nɛn haa dɛ kpɔ kwaa aa wola he kwaa ɛɛ, dɛɛ komɛ kwaa haa wola due.’ Anee nomoa la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, ‘Bonɔnchɔɡe kohona!
He ɡbaɡba nyoa wobol taa mɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ pae bolchɔɡe.
He jemɔ kɛ n ɛ bambikpeɡ te, dɛɛ kpɔ kwaa aa wola n kwaa ɛɛ, dɛɛ komɛ kwaa maa wola due kenɛ?
Aah ɛrɛɛ haa wola n suuɡa kpɔe ka cheɡ mɛ baŋɡe ásɛ n fee ba lɛ a ne a nee bwa nɔ?’ Belaa nomoa la ŋɔ bonɔɔna la kar baa cheɡɛ o be la be ŋɔ, ‘Hé laa suuɡa la lɛ o be, dɛ́ kpɔ ka tɛ bonɔɔ la waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm bwea fi dɛ ja o kon ta la.’ Anee ba ŋɔ ba dɔɔ la be ŋɔ, ‘Nomoa, kɛ o dɔ suuɡaswɛm bwea fi ɔɔ?’ Asɛ nomoa la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, naate waa dɔa la, baa jao anee ó dɔ kohona.
Kɛ naate waa wola komɛlbwa dɔe la, tama kwaraa waa dɔa la, ɛɛ le o nɔn taa.
N dɔma la baa ŋɔa baa men nyin kɛ n ɛ ba kooro la ɡe, hé laɡ ba ba n siwi ta bonɔ dɛ́ ba kpoo ba!’ ” Yeesu jo Jerusalam jirima ne Yeesu aa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, o tɔ sie ba nɛɛ dɛɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Baa dɛ tel Bɛtfej ne Bɛtani bwɛɛre ta, Ɔlevere Bwejen bɔr la, o tomɛ o habɔteŋra la bini banɛ ŋɔ bá tɔ sie, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé la bwɛɛ nɔ waa lɔ he sie nɔ ta.
Haa dɛɛ tel bela la, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ baa vɔwɛ keeɡo bie bɛl baa wola o ta soɡe bwa.
Hé laa pur dɛ́ kpɔɔ ba.
Dɛ nomɛl bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ bɔkwaa hɛɛ puru dɛ́ ɛ aa, hé ŋɔ naate be ŋɔ he Dɔɔ dɛ nyinu.” Asɛ ba la, dɛ ka na ɡɛ waa la tenten Yeesu aa ŋɔ ba be la.
Baa dɛ pur keeɡo bie la la, kontena bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ pur keeɡo bie nɔ dɛ́ ka ɛɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔ dɛ nyinu.” Asɛ ba kpɔ keeɡo bie la ba tɛ Yeesu, dɛ kpɔ ba yale darawe o nyaŋ ta dɛ ɡɔɔ Yeesu so o ta.
Waa soɡe keeɡo la ta baa kaa la, nɛra pa ba yale pa ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ tɛo jirima, asɛ o kpɔ keeɡo la valɛ a ta.
Baa wili Ɔlevere Bwejen la dɛɛ tel Jerusalam la, Yeesu habɔɔ nɛra la bwa sie lɛo, baa kpɛɛ Korowii kohona kɛŋɔ waa ɛ nyokpowaa ba na la.
Dɛ ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Kooro waa cheɡɛ o sɔn ta dɛɛ ba nɔ, dɛ́ ɡel nyundua tena bwa bwara sɔɔh ba!” Bela la, dɛ Farisii tena lɔ nɛnlaa la bini.
Ba ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, kah he habɔɔ nɛra nɔ ásɛ ba hel!” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ ba helaa, bwea kwara ɛɛ mooluu.” Yeesu wi Jerusalam wa Baa dɛ ba bwɛjen Jerusalam tela la, Yeesu nyiŋi bwɛɛ la dɛ wi tɛ o tena.
O wio ŋɔ, “Alako he fe jemɛ ɡɛ haa ɛ dɛ́ dɔ bosɔɔhna fini!
Korowii kpɔɔ sɔh heya, anomanta, haa won jemɛ.
Tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao ásɛ he dɔma ba ma danjwɛɛ bar he bwɛɛ nɔ, dɛ́ tɔ heyaa do haa wola won le.
Baa wuruu jo he bwɛɛ nɔ ta, dɛ́ paɡre he deene dɛ́ kpoo heya.
Baa kuuɡi he deene bwaa buruburu ken, bwe beŋkpoŋ kwara aa wola ka dɛ́ dawɛ o dɔŋ ta kpa.
Anɔ bwa ɛɛ ɛo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he lɛɛ tɔpere aa tela la, he ta sie doe.” Yeesu la Korowii Dea Asɛ Yeesu la Korowii Dea dɛ den kaa doŋi nɛra baa kpɔ bela berɛ bona dibɔr la.
O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn la bini ŋɔ, ‘N dea ɛ Korowii soŋebɔr,’ ɡɛɛ he te berɛ kpɔ bela berɛ ŋwɛɛra sɔɔhbɔr aa?” Dɛ o dɛ la Korowii Dea tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛ kaa baɡle wa.
Dɛ Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema ne nɛra la bini nomonome la dɛ nyinu dɛ́ kpo, kɛ ba ta ɡɛ baa ɛ dɛ́ dɔɔ nae, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o wobol dɛ do nɛra bwa som, baa wola won kaa dɛ́ ɡel o wobol, dɛ che dɛɛ no.
Ba pɛɛ Yeesu kpeɡri waa dɔa Awola bɛl, dɛ Yeesu lɔ Korowii Dea dɛɛ baɡle nɛra wa, dɛɛ bol Amanesoma la, asɛ Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema ne bela nomonome la ba o be, dɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Umee tɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ hé ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ haa dɛ ɛ nɔɔ?
Umee tɛɛ kpeɡri kwaraa te nɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel n bɔɔ heyaa webeŋkpoŋ.
Hé baɡ mɛ, Jɔn kpeɡri waa dɔa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ sɔ nɛra nee la, Korowiirii tɛo waa, kɛ nɛnee?” Waa bɔɔ ba ɡɛ la, dɛ ba ɡbo dɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ŋɔe yɔ?
Dɛ ya ŋɔ a le Korowii be naa, wɛɛ bɔɔ yaa waa aa bala ya ta Jɔn yaradae.
Dɛ ya berɔ ŋɔ nɛn bee a le ɡe aa, nɛra nɔ baa lɔ bonɔ nɔ bwa ɛɛ foɡre yaa bwea dɛ́ kpoo yaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba te bwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ Jɔn fa ɛ Korowii keame.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Yaa jemɛ bela kpeɡri la aa lea.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “N ɡe aa kpeɡri maa dɔa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ waa nɔ leebɔree baɡle he be.” Nɛra baa dɛ daah koo sɛɡla Yeesu kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa baɡle nɛra la, dɛ ŋɔ, “Baa bɛlee fa lole dɛɛ parɛ daa ane baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ daa sen. O kpɔ nɛra baa ɛ koo la toma, a koma telaa, ba dɔ ba bɔr.
A habɔɔ la, o kpɔ koo la tɛɛ ba bá nyiŋi o ta dɛɛ tɛo, dɛ kaa harɛ bɛl ta, dɛ ka biɡri.
Kwaa la koma saŋ aa baa tel la, o tomɛ o bonɔɔ bɛl ŋɔ ó ka lɛ o dibɔr ba tɛo.
Belaa nɛra la lɔɔ bonɔɔ la dɛ doŋu, ba ta on komɛlbwa tɛɛ o kaa.
Belaa koo te la berɛ tomɛ bonɔn-nɛɛte, asɛ ba lɔɔ o ɡe dɛ ɛo wilewile ken, dɛ doŋu o kaa, ba ta on komɛlbwa tɛɛ.
Anee koo te la berɛ tomɛ o bonɔn-tooro te ja, asɛ nɛra la do o ɡe bol, dɛ kpɔɔ ta koo la baŋ.
Belaa koo te la ŋɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ ń ɛ jaɔ?
Mɛɛ tomɛ n bibeŋkpoŋ maa dɛ nyin o waa nɔɔ.
O te ba nao baa heehroo!’ Nɛra la aa na o bie la, ba den ŋɔ, ‘Yoowa, baa la ɡbaɡba bie la.
O mɛɛ toole naa, on dɛɛ ba o kpanjoɡo dii.
Hé ɡel ya kpoo, ásɛ dɛ o mɛɛ baa sewaa, dɛ kwaa la ɛ ya kwa.’ Anee ba lawɛ bie la dɛ kpoo dɛ kpɔɔ viɡri koo la baŋ.” Asɛ Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ a ɡɛ koote nɔ ɛɛ ɛɔ wɔ?
Wɛɛ ba kpoo a ɡɛ nɛra laanee, dɛ́ kpɔ koo la do nɛnfala nɔn ta.” Nɛra la aa no ɡɛ la, ba ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ la a ne bojaŋ!” Yeesu nyiŋ ba dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Amɔ ɛrɛ tenee hɛɛ no Korowii Tɔn bini waa mun ɔ?
‘Bwe la mamaala aa vɛoh dɛ liiru konsala laanee bera ba lawɛ dea la kpoŋe la.’ Nomɛlbwa waa chole Bwe la waa lawɛ dea la kpoŋe la ta la, wɛɛ kuuɡuu.
O berɔ le ba le nomɛlbwa nɛɛ ɡe aa, wɛɛ pweremoo.” Toɔ bɔe wepɛɛre Dɛ Tɔnjerema la ne Sɔfonomonome la siwi swɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ baa lawɔɔ buɡ la ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba jemɔ ŋɔ banee o sɛɡle.
Kɛ dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ nɛnlaa la.
Anomanta, ba sie lɔ o nɛɛ baa kpaahno dɛ dɔɔ.
Ba tɛ nɛra bane suuɡa, dɛ tom ba ŋɔ bá ka haɡre Yeesu bela webɔɔre ne, a do kɛŋɔ siswɛm waa baa bɔɔ, ásɛ dɛ dɔɔ lawɛ, dɛ́ kpɔɔ do Rom nomoa waa dɛ di ba harɛ la kpeɡri nɔn ta.
A ɡɛ nɛra la ba Yeesu be dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ he dɛ bol kasinteŋ.
Haa nɛra sie nyiŋe mɔɔ dɛɛ bol wa.
Korowii ŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ baɡle nɛra kasinteŋ ne, ásɛ ya won jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ya ɛ. Webeŋkpoŋii yaa nyin kɛŋɔ ya jemɛ.
Onee kɛŋɔ ya mmarare dɛ tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ya bɔ toɔ dɛɛ tɛ Rom Koojen Siisa kɛɛ ya bɛ dɛɛ bɔɔ?” Dɛ Yeesu jemɛ ba webɔɔre la mun, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ suuɡa bwe ba n na.” Anee ba kpɔ bɛl ba, asɛ o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ume nyu ne o sɔnee dawɛ o ta nɔ?” Asɛ ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Koojen Siisaa.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Oo.
Amɔ hé kpɔ kwaa aa ɛ Koojen Siisa kwaa tɛo, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa aa ɛ Korowii kwaa la tɛ Korowii.” Ba ta wone dɔ wobɛlbwa dɛ che a ta lawɔ nɛra siwi ta, asɛ ba nyoa kpo ba che surumm ken.
Seo ta ira wepɛɛre Belaa Saduki tena bane ba Yeesu be.
Dɛ baa yarada kɛŋɔ nɛn sewaa, wɛɛ berɔɔ ir ja.
Ba baa bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Nomoa, Mosis fa chwerɛ Mmara bɛl tɛ yaa ŋɔ, dɛ baa sewɔ ɡel o haah dɛ ba ta bii dɔe yaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ o nime kɛɛ o dɔɔ kpɔ haah la mo dɛ́ loɡle bii, ásɛ a ɡɛ bii la ɛ lale la bii.
Hahbeŋkpoŋ bibaala banuanɛɛ fa lole, asɛ binomoa la mo haah dɛ sewɛ, dɛ o ta bie dɔe.
Asɛ onɔ la waa teŋɛ binomoa la nɛɛ la kpɔ haah la mo dɛ ba sewɛ, dɛ o ɡe ne o ta bie lolɛ.
Asɛ bitoorote la ɡe mo haah la dɛ sewɛ, dɛ o ta bie dɔe.
Gɛ tentenee ba bwa mo haah la ka lɔ nyoa ta dɛ ba serewe, dɛ ba ta bii dɔe.
A habɔɔ la, haah la ɡe baa sewɛ.
Aah taraken dɛ nɛra bwa seo ta ira tɔpere la baa tel asɛ bibaala la bwa ir aa, ba bini umee dɛɛ ba haah la jaa ɛɛ yɔ?” Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Fini nɔɔ baala ne haahna ɛɛ mo dɔŋa nɔ, kɛ nɛra baa dɛ ba seo ta ira dɛ won dɔ bɔr ja Korowii Kora la ta la te aa haahna moe ba, baa jaranar ɡe yala ba.
Baa sewɛ kpa bwa.
Baa doo kɛŋɔ nyundua toroma, dɛ ɛ Korowii bii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba iro le seo ta.
Mosis ɡba fa bol seo ta ira nɔ waa kaih ken.
Hé nyiŋi bela waa chwerɛ dawii fuih wa, dɛ bol Korowii waa ŋɔ onee Korowii Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tomɔ la.
Lala laa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii, weeraa dɛɛ tomɔ.
Korowii te be, nomɛlbwa ɛ wee.” Asɛ Tɔnjerema la bane ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he bola aŋwɛnɛ ta!” Ba ta wone bɔɔro wobɛlbwa kpa.
Kristo la wepɛɛre Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛ waa ba ŋɔ Devid naa dɛ ɛ Kristo la nɔɔ?
Aah Devid ɡbabir bol waa Korowii Yela Tɔn la bobɛl ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii ŋɔ n Dɔɔ be ŋɔ so nomombɔr n diɡ ta ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba he dɔma ne harɛ ásɛ he tiɡri ba nɛ.’ Devid fa aa dɛ yerɔ o Dɔɔ nɔ, aah dɛ ɛrɛɛ Kristo la berɛ ɛ dɛ ɛ Devid naa ɔ?” Gɛ Yeesu aa ja nɛra Tɔnjerema we-ɛɛla ta Yeesu cheɡɛ nɛra la bwa siwi ta dɛ ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi Tɔnjerema la kɛrɛdɛ.
Ban yon do laalajena ásɛ nɛra bwa na ba dɛɛ ɡuŋ ba harɛ yawa ta la.
Ba dɛ nyin nomombɔra soɡa cheremi deene ne bela nɛra aa chema dɛɛ di tɔpejena.
Ba sie beɡre kwa, dɛ yon kpɔ Korowii soŋa wobojaŋa ne tɔ sie dɛɛ kam kwaa luhaahna deremi.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee taeh.”
Luhaah bɛl suuɡa bɔe wa Yeesu aa lɔ Korowii Dea la, o nao kɛŋɔ dɔɔhna ta ba suuɡare dɛɛ do daka baa ta suuɡa dɛɛ do o bini.
Belaa luhaah nyaa bɛl ɡe ba do suuɡa bwejeɡre anɛ.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, luhaah nyaa nɔ do suuɡajena dɛ ɡwaa nɛra nɔ bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o dea suuɡa bwaa o kpɔ ba do daka nɔ bini la.
Kɛ dɔɔhna nɔ te suuɡa bini tama baa naa kɛŋɔ a waa aa ba nɛɛ we la, anee ba kpɔ ba do la.” Gɛ Yeesu aa bol Korowii Dea chɔɡa wa Belaa Yeesu habɔteŋra la bane ɛɛ bol Korowii Dea la waa o be, ɡɛ bwea baa kpɔa mao, ne kondɛɛɡa nɛra aa ɛa tɛ Korowii ba kpɔ kwaa o danjwɛɛ la wer aa doa.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao ásɛ anɔ haa naa nɔ, ba ta ɛɛ paɡre a bwaa ásɛ bwe beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa aa wola lee do dɛ́ chɔŋɛ o dɔŋ nɛɛ kpa.” Yeesu baɡle o habɔteŋra wahala baa na kerekere Anee ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Nomoa, saŋ besoo aa ba chiɡa ɔ?
Bɔkwaa dɛɛ ba baɡla kɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ́ ba chiɡa ɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ heyaa neɡre.
Nɛra pirim ɛɛ kpɔ n sɔnee ba dɛ́ ba ŋɔ banee men, dɛ́ ŋɔ tɔpere la telo.
He bɛ ba nɛɛ teŋɛ.
Dɛ he baa no laa yoi waa ne harɛ vuuɡa waa bobɛlbwa naa, he bɛ ɔmɛ.
A chɛ kɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa chiɡ.
Kɛ dɛ wobɛlbwa jaɡa la ta tele mɔɔ.” Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Harɛre ane ɛɛ yo dɔŋaa, koranar ɡe yo dɔŋa.
Harɛ ɛɛ jiɡri bobɛlbwaa taeh, ásɛ lɔr ne weela bwa soo siwi ba.
Hɛɛ na ɔmewaa aa wola balɛ bwa nyunduaa.
Mɔɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa chiɡ la, baa tɔ sie larawe heya, dɛ́ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa, dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa la cheremi deene bini, dɛ́ ka bol he waa dɛ́ do heyaa dea.
Baa koh n waa dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa ka che nomonome ne koranar siini.
Belaa hɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ dɔe dɛ́ bol Amanesoma la baɡ ba.
Ba baa lawɛ heya aa, he bɛ ɡel waa haa ka bol la hiah heya.
Menee dɛɛ ba n tɛ heyaa waa haa ka bol la, dɛ tɛ heyaa wejema ásɛ he dɔma bɛ won di bɔ heyaa kɛɛ dɛ́ tɔŋle heya.
He mɛɛnanar ne nyare, ne he dɔɔranar ne nimanar, ne he lolanar dɛ daamanar ɛɛ le heyaa tɛ ásɛ ba kpoo he bane.
Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ koh n waa hah heya.
Mɛɛ cha heyaa ásɛ he nyumpon beŋkpoŋ kwara aa harɛɛ le.
He lawɛ bambile aa, hɛɛ dɔ he nyuu.” Yeesu bol Jerusalam chɔɡa wa Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “He baa na kɛŋɔ soojare bar Jerusalam cheme aa, amɔ te hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ o paɡra telo.
Amɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa lɔ Juda harɛ ɡɛ saŋ la chwa kaa bwea dor dɛ́ ka sɔh.
Nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen Jerusalam la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá le warane, ásɛ bɛlbwa waa wola toole bwɛɛ la bini a ɡɛ saŋ la bɛ o bini jo.
A ɡɛ saŋee Korowii ɛɛ ba o nɛra deŋne tɛra, ásɛ waa Korowii Tɔn la aa baɡla la bwa ɛ kpela.
Ei!
Aa do kpeɡrii tɛ tekpoŋra ne haahna baa kpoŋe bechasɔɔhne a ɡɛ saŋ nɔ noo!
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra ɛɛ na wahala harɛ nɔ ta kohonaa, asɛ Korowii baah di ba nɛɛ o tɛr ba deŋne.
Baa kpɔ kerii kpoo bane, ásɛ dɛ larawe bane dɛ́ kpɔ ba kaa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, ásɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ɛ Jerusalam bwa posaposa ken ka tel kɛŋɔ ba ɡe saŋ aa ba kaa.
Men Nɛn Bie bala wa Hɛɛ na nyokpowaa wee ne korobie ne weweela taa.
Harɛ ta ɡe, mpo ɛɛ jiɡruu dɛɛ lɔ nehɛma kohona, ásɛ nɛra bwa ɔmɛ, ba bwara yɔr.
Nɛra bambile ɛɛ teŋoo kohona, ba lii waa aa dɛ ba bala la wa, ba hwaahɡe, dɛkalkɛ kwaa aa lɔ Korowii doa bwa yiiɡi dɛ́ chɔɡ.
Belaa baa ba Men Nɛn Bie nae kɛŋɔ maa lɔ bam bini dɛɛ ba kpeɡri ne jirima a dɔŋa aa wola toole ne.
Dɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ baa pa mun dɛɛ ɛ aa, hé kpɔ he te dɛɛ kpa, dɛkalkɛ he Lɛɛ tɔpere la telo.” Fiɡ daa wehwela Yeesu berɔ kpɔ sɛɡla bol waa ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ta sie nyiŋi fiɡ daa ne daa aa kaa nɔ dɛ́ na.
O ba dɛ foɡre aa, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ bɔwɔb saŋ telo tonɛ.
Gɛɛ dɛ waa nɔ maa bol he be nɔ baa chiɡ aa, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Kora la dii telo.
Kasinteŋ, a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa dɛ ba chiɡa mɔɔ fini nɛra nɔ bwa serewe.
Nyundua ne harɛ ɛɛ chɔɡoo.
Kɛ n waa maa bola te bwa ɛɛ do lee saŋ te bɛlbwa.
Gɛ aa hiah kɛ nɛn nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ Hé nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ!
He bɛ ɡel bodia kondikwaa dii ne sen nyɔe ne he weliira ɡwaa he nɛ, ásɛ tɔpere la bɛ heyaa ba piɡri kɛŋɔ nɛn yon ɡbarɛ bel la, dɛkalkɛ o bala tɔpere la ɛɛ piɡri nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwaa.
Hé ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ hɛɛ kpa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛ dɔ bokpeɡa dɛ le a ɡɛ waa aa chiɡ la nyoa, asɛ dɛ won che Men Nɛn Bie sie.” Dɛ tɔpere bɛlbwaa Yeesu bol waa dɛɛ baɡ ba Korowii Dea, asɛ bɔr baa jo aa, o yon kaa bwe bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Ɔlevere Bwejen la doa dɛ́ ka chɔ.
Asɛ tɔɔ perɔ chɔmbibi aa, o yon fel ba Korowii Dea bela, asɛ nɛra yon la o be dɛ ka no o waa la.
Yeesu kpoe vɔrɔwa wa Aa ka tama ba tɔpejen baa dɛ yerɔ Galekaa baa kpɔ Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta dɛɛ diu la tel la, dɛ Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema la dɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ bɛl dɛ́ che o ta kpo Yeesu, kɛ dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ bela tena la.
Judas sɛoh kɛ wɛɛ le Yeesuu tɛ Belaa Bɔnsam ba so Judas baa dɛ yerɔ Eskareɔt la nɛ.
Dɛ o ɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la bɛl.
O la Sɔfonomonome ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea bela la nomonome be, o ne ba ka vɔrɔwe ɡɛ waa dɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ le Yeesu tɛɛ ba.
Ba sie lɛo taeh, ba baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ dɛ o wono ɡel ba dɔɔ waa, baa tɛo suuɡaa.
O sɛh dɛɛ nyin saŋ waa wera nɛnlaa la aa wola Yeesu be do ásɛ o leo tɛɛ ba.
Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra Galekaa dii Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta tɔpere la ba yon dɛɛ kpoo Galekaa pebiiri aa tela la, Yeesu tomɛ Pita ne Jɔn dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kaa dɛ́ ka ɛ Galekaa kondikwaa ásɛ ya ba di.” Anee ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Leperaa hɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ya ɛa cheɡ ɔ?” O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Haa dɛɛ jo bwɛjen la ta la, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ baa bɛl cheɡɛ vii ne ne.
Hé teŋɛ o nɛɛ kaa dem waa dɛ kaa o ta la ta, ásɛ dɛ ka ŋɔ dem te la be ŋɔ, ‘Ya nomoa ŋɔ dea haa dɛ ba kpɔe tɛ o ne o habɔteŋra ásɛ ba ba so o bini dɛ́ di Galekaa kondikwaa la sɛ?’ Wɛɛ baɡle heyaa abrɔsane doa dea bɛl waa kwaa o bini dɛ kpɔ kane ne teeburre cheɡ bela.
Belaa hɛɛ ba kwaa la ɛɛ cheɡ.” Pita ne Jɔn laŋɔ dɛ ka na wobɛlbwa ɡɛ tenten Yeesu aa ŋɔ ba be la, asɛ ba ɛ kondikwaa la cheɡ bela.
Kondikwaa baa dia dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii Yeesu Bɔr aa maɡra kɛŋɔ bá di Galekaa kondikwaa la, Yeesu ne o toroma la kaa so dɛɛ ba kwaa dii.
Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “A ɡɛ Galekaa kondikwaa nɔ waa fa lɔ n bambile bini wubwa, asɛ mɛɛ nyin kɛ n ne he dia mɔɔ ba ɛɛ mɛ hɔhɔrɔwa.
N ɡelɔ hɛɛ no kɛŋɔ maa a ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ anee di kpa, nemenɛ waa Galekaa nɔ aa cheɡa tɛ la aa ɛa Korowii Kora la ta.” Belaa Yeesu kpɔ numol ne sen dɛ jam Korowii dɛ kpɔ tɛ o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Hé nyɔ ka tɛ dɔŋa.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Fini habɔɔ, maa sen nɔ anee nyɔ kpa ka tel ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa ba di kora.” Asɛ o berɛ kpɔ paanoo dɛ jam Korowii o wa, asɛ dɛ mɔne tɛɛ ba, dɛ ŋɔ, “Anɔ cheɡɔ tɛ n bo-ol maa kpɔa dɛ tɛ heya.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ lii mɛ.” Gɛ tentenee baa di kwaa la tonɛ la, o kpɔ numol ne sen la tɛɛ ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Sen nɔɔ cheɡa tɛ n chal maa dɛ ba he waa koeh dɛ fuɡe ta.
Aa ɛ fɔofalee dɛ́ chɔ Korowii ne nɛwɛnyini baah ta.” O berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé no!
Naate waa lee mɛ tɛ la lɔ bonɔ n ne o pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwa.
Gɛ Korowii aa baɡla la taa aa ba cheɡa Men Nɛn Bie la sewɛ, kɛ naate waa lee mɛ tɛ ba kpo mɛ la, ó bwɛɛlɛ.” Ate, dɛ ba dɛ bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Ya bini umee su baah dɛɛ ba ó ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ nɔɔ?” Nɛnjen ɛɛ webeɡra Webeɡra berɔ ba chole o habɔteŋra la baah ta kɛ ba bini umee ɛ ba bwa nomoa ɔ?
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ba koranaree yon dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ baa di kpeɡri ba nɛra nɛ, ba nomonjena ɡee nyin baa yer ba nomonjena.
He te ne ɡɛ waa la jaŋne.
He bini nomoa la, ó ɛ o te kɛ bechala, ásɛ onɔ la waa dɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ la ɡe ɛ o te kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ di somanjiri.
Nɛn waa soɡa o dɔŋ ɛɛ bɔne kwaa ne naate waa dɛ bɔne kwa, ba bini umee ɛ nomoa ɔ?
Naate waa soɡa la laa aa?
Kɛ n te aa lɔ he bini nɔ, n ɛ n te kɛ maa dɛ di somanjiri.
Heyaa ja n nɛɛ n wahala bwa bini.
Anomanta, n dɛ tɛ heyaa kora hé di, ɡɛ n Mɛɛ aa tɛ mɛ la.
N ne hɛɛ pɛ nɔnee di kwaa n kora ta, ásɛ he so kookane ta dɛ bol Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la bwa waa dɛ́ pa ba bole.” Pita tɔɔh ŋɔ waa Yeesu jemɛ Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Seemɔn, no!
Bɔnsam soŋe Korowii ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ daah heyaa na, kɛŋɔ haah yon palɛ mea dɛ laa a haahra kpɔ a ta la ken.
Kɛ n soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ásɛ he yarada nyoa bɛ sɔɔh.
Dɛ he berɔ berɛ he liire ba n be naa, hé lawɛ he bala la bá do wɔrɔbe.” Anee Pita chaŋo ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, n cheɡɔ kɛ bá do n ne hen dea.
Seo kwaraa yaa, n ne hɛɛ sewɔɔ.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “Ai, Pita!
Jabal loɡle ne sii fini dɛ he tɔɔh kera atoro ŋɔ haa men jemɛ.” Asɛ Yeesu bɔɔ o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “N fa aa tomɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé ka bol Amanesoma la, dɛ ŋɔ he bɛ suuɡa kpɔ, he bɛ pure ne naŋɡawa kpɔ la, komɛl nya heya aa?” Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Komɛlbwa sese ta yaa nyae.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Name te nomɛlbwa waa dɔ suuɡa kɛɛ bone la, ó kpɔ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola dɔmkon dɔe la ɡe yoɡ o yal dɛ́ kpɔ yawɛ bɛl.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, ‘Ba kuro ja wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛ.’ N waa baa chwera la bwa dɛ ba chiɡa taraken.” Belaa o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔ, tokobie anɛɛ la.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “A maɡrɔ.” Yeesu la Ɔlevere Bwejen ta ka soŋe Korowii Yeesu le bwɛɛ la ta dɛ kaa Ɔlevere Bwejen la ta, ɡɛ o yon dɛɛ ɛ la, asɛ o habɔteŋra la teŋɛ o nɛɛ kaa.
Baa tel bela la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii ásɛ Bɔnsam bɛ won neɡre heya.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o le ba jwɛɛh dɛ kaa sie tama, dɛ ka ɡuŋi dɛɛ soŋe Korowii, dɛ ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, hɛɛ sɛoh waa, bɛ ɡel n na a ɡɛ wahala haa ŋɔa ń na nɔ.
Kɛ ɛ he tetoora dɛ́ ɡel n tetoora.” Asɛ nyundua torome den ba o be dɛ ba doo ɡbemba.
O tea bini aa chɔɡa kohona la, o soŋe Korowii siswɛm ne, asɛ bɔwɔb le o nɛɛ dɛ kor dɛɛ lee kɛŋɔ chal ken.
Waa soŋe Korowii tonɛ dɛ berɛ la o habɔteŋra la be la, lokua kohona nomanta, dɛ ba chɔɔɡe doromi.
Anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he chɔɔɡe nɔɔ?
Hé ir dɛ́ soŋe Korowii ásɛ Bɔnsam bɛ won neɡre heya.” Yeesu lawa wa Yeesu nyoa ta aa lɔ waa ta wɛɛ bol la, dɛ Judas waa ɛ o habɔteŋra la bini bɛl kaa tɔ nɛnlaa bane sie, dɛ ba ba ne Yeesu be dɛ́ fe ɡbaaro pɛl o bambile dɛ́ mo o lwɛɛma.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Lwɛɛma moe nee hɛɛ ba Men Nɛn Bie la lee dɛ́ tɛ aa?” O habɔteŋra o ne baa lɔ bela la aa na waa aa dɛ ba bala la, ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, yá kpɔ ya tokobie nɔ ya ne ba yo aa?” Asɛ ba bini bɛl kpɔ o kere dɛ ŋwɛnɛ Sɔfonomoa la bonɔɔ diɡ deŋne dɛ laa cha.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel,” dɛ kpɔ nɔn ka leɡe bonɔɔ la deŋne la, buɡ la ta, dɛ chaoh.
Belaa Yeesu bɔɔ Sɔfonomonome, ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea nomoa, ne ba bwɛɛ nomonome baa bala dɛ́ ba lawɔ la ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛɛree men he kpoŋe tokobie ne ɡule dɛ ba laɡ mɛ naa?
N ne haa lɔ Korowii Dea tɔpere bɛlbwa la, ɛrɛɛ haa wola men lawɛ bela ɔ?
Taraken nɔ bɔr aa bira nɔ he dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ he ba laɡ mɛ.” Pita tɔɔh ŋɔ waa Yeesu jemɛ Ba lawɛ Yeesu dɛ kpɔɔ dɛɛ kaa Sɔfonomoa dem, dɛ Pita ne ba baah tɛrɔ, asɛ o teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Dɛ ba mar nii dem baah bela, asɛ Pita ka pu ɡɛ nɛra la so a jwɛh.
Pita aa soɡe nii la jwɛɛh la, Sɔfonomoa la tolo bɛl nao, dɛ nyiŋu jeiih ken, dɛ ŋɔ, “Yeesu habɔteŋree baa nɔ.” Anee Pita tɔh pelepele ken dɛ ŋɔ tolo la be ŋɔ, “Maa on jemɛ kwara!” Aa bera la sie tama ken la, baa bɛl na Pita dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ba bini bɛlee he ɡba!” Anee o ŋɔ, “Akai, n ta ba nɛɛ jae!” A habɔɔ dɛ ɛ dɔŋhwere beŋkpoŋ la, baa bɛl ɡe berɔ dalwe Pita jae waa ja Yeesu nɛɛ la ta ja, dɛ ŋɔ, “Galilia tee baa nɔ, anomanta, tɔŋla bɛlbwa toole kɛŋɔ o ta Yeesu nɛɛ jae!” Belaa Pita ŋɔ baa la be ŋɔ, “Maa waa haa dɛ bol nɔ bini jemɛ!” O nyoa ta aa lɔ waa la ta wɛɛ bol la jabal den si.
Asɛ Yeesu ke nyiŋi Pita siwi ta, asɛ o lii waa Yeesu fa aa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ jabal loɡle ne sii dɛ o tɔɔh kera atoro ŋɔ waa on jemɛ la.
Ate, Pita le buse dɛ ka wi kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba muɡli Yeesu baah dɛ lɔɔro Nɛra baa lawɛ Yeesu la muɡli o baah dɛ lɔɔro.
Ba kpɔ kon vɔwɛ o sie dɛɛ tɔɔ kande dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ jemɛ, umee lɔe nɔɔ?” Dɛ boloo nɛnhɛlwaa kohona.
Ba la Yeesu ne Juu tena nomonome sie Tɔ aa pera la, ba kpɔ Yeesu ka cheme Juu tena nomonome baa dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole ne Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema sie, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ henee Kristo Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la aa, bol ya no!” Anee o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ n ŋɔ he be ɡɛ noo, haa men yarada, n berɔ bɔɔ heyaa waane ɡe oo, haa men chaŋe.
Le taraken dɛɛ kaa la, Men Nɛn Bie la ɛɛ so Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡnɛn diɡ taa.” Asɛ ba bwa ŋɔ, “Amɔ he ɛ Korowii Bie kɛɛ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Anee he bol la.” Belaa ba ŋɔ, “Amɔ o ɡbaɡba aa bola nɔ, danseɛ besoo yá berɛ dɛɛ nyin jaɔ?”
Ba lawɛ Yeesu ba che Paelet sie Nɛra la taɡɛ ba kane ta dɛ ir, dɛ kpɔɔ la harɛ nomoa Paelet be, dɛ ka haŋɛ o nyoa ŋɔ, “Ya lawɛ baa nɔ kɛ waa dɛ chɔɡ ya harɛ.
O dɛ do nɛra dochɔɡa ŋɔ ba bɛ toɔ bɔ dɛɛ tɛ Rom Koojen Siisa kpa, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ɛ o te ya Juu tena kooro Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ yaa nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo o ba ba lɛ yaa la.” Anee Paelet bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Henee Juu tena kooro ɛ?” O ŋɔ, “Anee he bol la.” Asɛ Paelet ŋɔ Sɔfonomonome ne nɛnlaa baa cheme o sie la be ŋɔ, “N ta wechɔɡa baa nɔ aa ɛa nae.” Dɛ nɛra la nyoa ta kpeɡri, ba bol ane dɛɛ dawɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “O kpɔ o webaɡla dɛɛ chɔɡ nɛra liire Juu tena harɛ bwa ta taraken.
Galilia harɛ taa o pa mun, dɛ kpɔ ba le bonɔ!” Ba la Yeesu ne Hɛrɔd sie Paelet aa no ɡɛ la, o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Galilia tee yaa?” Baa bola ŋɔ Galilia tee la, dɛ Hɛrɔd waa ɛ Galilia kooro ɡɛ saŋ la ba Jerusalam, asɛ o ɡel ba kpɔɔ la o be.
Waa na Yeesu la, dɛ o sie lɛo taeh.
Waa no o waa dɛ fe ɛɛ nyinu o ɛ nyokpowaa ó na biɡro, anomanta, dɛ o dɛ nyinu dɛ́ na.
Kooro Hɛrɔd bɔɔro waa taeh, asɛ o mwaa o ne.
Belaa Sɔfonomonome ne Tɔnjerema la bol waa takpeɡ ne dɛɛ dawɛ o nɛ.
Asɛ Kooro Hɛrɔd ne o soojare ɛɛ muɡli o baah dɛɛ mamɔ, dɛ ka kpɔ koowur ba doo dɛ berɛ kpɔɔ ka tɛ Paelet.
Dɛ Kooro Hɛrɔd ne Paelet fa aa somɛ, kɛ le awola tɔpere la, ba kpɔ darame.
Ba ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ bá kpo Yeesu Paelet yerɛ bela tena ne Sɔfonomonome ne bwɛɛ nomonome ba cheme, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Heyaa lawɛ baa nɔ ba n be dɛ ŋɔ o dɛ do nɛra dochɔɡa ŋɔ bá lɛ ɡaeh harɛ nɔ ta.
N bɔɔro a bini he bwa siwi ta bonɔ dɛ na kɛŋɔ o ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Kpɔe he kpɔ waa la dɛɛ dawɔ.
Gɛɛ Kooro Hɛrɔd ɡe aa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa o nɛɛ nae dɛ berɛ kpɔɔ ba tɛ yaa.
Wobɛlbwa ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ yá kpoo.
Kɛ mɛɛ ɡeloo bá lɔɔro bampɔrɔ ŋwɛɛra ne dɛ́ kpɔɔ ta.” Dɛ ɡɛ ba tɔpejen baa dɛ yerɔ Galekaa la we-ɛɛla aa doa la, o telaa, ba yon le wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa do ba dea la beŋkpoŋ ta ó kaa.
Belaa nɛnlaa la bwa kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Kpoo!
Le Barabas ta ó kaa!” Gɛ Barabas nɔ ɛ nomɛl waa ja waane ba fa aa ir a ne bwɛjen la ta, dɛ vuuɡi Rom Koojen nomonome ba fa aa dɛ nyiŋi ba harɛ la ta, asɛ dɛ kpoo nɛra ɡe ja, asɛ ba lawɔ ka do dea.
Paelet bambile bini la, dɛ o dɛ nyin kɛ o ɡel Yeesu o kaa, asɛ o berɛ bol waa baɡle nɛnlaa la ja.
Ane a bwa, ba ta noɛ, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta!
Kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta!” O bɔɔ ba toorotena ŋɔ, “Wechɔɡa besoo o ɛɔ?
N ta wechɔɡa waa ɛa a chɛ kɛ ba kpoo nae!
Mɛɛ ɡeloo bá lɔɔro chweema ne dɛ́ kpɔɔ ta.” Dɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ bol la taa ba ta do, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ŋɔ o chɛ kpaara pɛl daɡaɡre ta.
Ba nyoa baa ɡwaa Paelet nɛ, asɛ o sɛh ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin tɛɛ ba, dɛ kpɔ waa la dawɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Paelet le baa la waa ja waane ba fa aa ir a ne dɛ vuuɡi Rom Koojen nomonome, dɛ kpoo nɛra ba doo dea la ta o kaa, asɛ dɛ kpɔ Yeesu tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ka ɛo ɡɛ bwa baa dɛ nyin.
Ba kpaa Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta Soojare la aa kpɔɔ dɛɛ kaa dɛ́ ka kpoo la, ba kaa cheme Seemɔn.
Sairini tee.
Dɛ o le koo dɛɛ ba, asɛ soojare la lawɔ dɛ lɛ daɡaɡre Yeesu aa cheɡɔɔ la, dɛ ɡel Seemɔn cheo teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Dɛ nɛnlaa tenten teŋɛ o nɛ, ba bini bane ɛ haahna dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ nyu dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛ wi dɛɛ tɛo.
Asɛ Yeesu berɛ o te dɛ ŋɔ, “Jerusalam haahna, he bɛ wi tɛ mɛ.
He wi tɛ he te ne he bii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba bala ásɛ he ŋɔ, nɛra baa wola lolɛ bwa ne banɔ la baa wola bii ɔrɛ bwa la na som.
A ɡɛ saŋ nɛra ɛɛ ŋɔ bwejena ne deŋɡarere bee ŋɔ, ‘Hé choɡli tɔ ya nɛ.’ Da-lwɛɛ dɛ fuh aa, dahole te ta pɔeh yaa?” Soojare la kpɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra banɛ bane ja Yeesu nɛɛ dɛɛ la ka kpoo ba.
Ba kaa tel bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Nyuhoɡ Bɔr.
Belaa ba kpaa Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta, dɛ kpaa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la ɡe pɛl daɡaɡra ta, dɛ kpɔ bɛl pa Yeesu diɡ ta, bɛl ɡe pa o ɡal.
Yeesu ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba.
Baa waa baa dɛ ɛ nɔ jemɛ.” Soojare la kpɔ o laala bil dɛɛ ta chacha ŋɔ naate waa di la, ó kpɔ onɔ la waa dɛ nyin.
Nɛnlaa cheɡɛ bela dɛɛ nyiŋu.
Juu tena nomonome muɡli o baah ŋɔ, “Kɛ he wono lɛ bane oo?
Dɛ he ŋɔ henee Kristo la Korowii aa leo la aa, lɛ he te yá na!” Gɛɛ soojare la ɡe mamɔ dɛ muɡli o baah, dɛ tuuh tel o jwɛh, dɛ kpɔ sennyɛɡa tɛo ŋɔ ó nyɔ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ŋɔ henee Juu tena kooro la aa, lɛ he te!” O nyunduabɔr daɡaɡre la ta la, ba chwerɔ ka pɛl bela ŋɔ, juu tena kooro laanee la.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la bɛl bol waa yaɡɔ ŋɔ, “He laa Kristo la kɛɛ?
Lɛ he te dɛ́ lɛ ya ɡeo.” Asɛ nɛɛte la aa jaa la kaoh ŋɔ, “Jamɔ haa Korowii ɔmɛ kɛɛ?
Gɛ baa ɛ yaa nɔ, ɡɛɛ ba ɛ o ɡe.
O te kwara wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ.
Kɛ ya te, waa yaa ɛa la, kenii a chɛ kɛ ya na.” Dɛ ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Yeesu, he baa di he kora aa, ásɛ he lii n wa.” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, hale fini, hɛɛ ja n nɛɛ nɛndɛɛɡa silɛɛ bwɛɛ nyundua belaa.” Yeesu seo wa Wee aa baa che nyubaah la, bɔr biro jumaa ken dɛ ka tel wekee saŋ, asɛ yal baa kpɔa teŋe Korowii Dea bini la baah pere anɛ.
Yeesu kpɔ takpeɡ do lɔŋɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, he nɔn taa n lileo do!” Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o doma le, o sewɛ.
Sooja nomoa waa lɔ bela dɛ na waa aa chiɡa la, o ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, wechɔɡa toole baa nɔ nɛ,” dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii.
Nɛra baa bala dɛ ba nyiŋi la loo kuu, ba kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ nyu dɛ kaa dem.
Kɛ nɛra baa jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ la ne haahna baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ dɛ le Galilia harɛ la te ta cheɡɛ bojaŋ dɛɛ nyiŋu.
Yeesu huɡa wa Dɛ baa bɛl sɔne Josef, o ɛ Juu te dɛ le Arimatea.
Dɛ o ja nomonome baa bol Yeesu waa la nɛ, dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe, dɛɛ kpa saŋ la Korowii aa di Kora dɛ́ lɛɛ ba la.
O te fe ta sɛɛh teŋɛ ba nɛɛ kɛ bá kpo Yeesu.
Gɛ baa la la Paelet be dɛ ka soŋe Yeesu lale, dɛ lao kpɔ le daɡaɡre la ta, dɛ kpɔ yapoŋ baaɡo dɛ kpɔɔ ka bil bwebɔɔ baa komɔ kɛŋɔ dea bini.
Dɛ ba ta lale kpɔe do o bini bwa.
Dɛ awola ɛ Fiara, asɛ baa kpɔ ba te dɛ́ di Ona Tɔpere la.
Haahna baa teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ le Galilia harɛ la, la bwebɔɔ la ta, dɛ ka na bela ne ɡɛ baa kpɔ lale la bil bɔɔ la bini.
Asɛ ba berɛ kaa dem, dɛ ka ɛ kwaane a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ ba kpɔe ka ɛ lale la.
Ona Tɔpere la, ba onɔ ɡɛ Mmara la aa baɡla la.
Yeesu seo ta ira wa Tɔɔ aa pera Kwasiara waa ɛ tɔpeloɡle la, tomun aa dɛ kpɔ la, haahna la kpɔ kwaa a sɔɔh aa soma la la bwebɔɔ la ta, dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ nomɛl ɡbili bwe baa kpɔa tɔ bɔɔ la le o nyoa, asɛ ba jo dɛ na kɛŋɔ ba Dɔɔ Yeesu lale la toole.
Ba nyoa aa kpoa ba che bela la, dɛ baala banɛ bane baa do laalapoŋa aa nyɛɡle al-al ken denɔ ba che ba jwɛh.
Ɔmee laɡ ba taeh, asɛ ba ɡure nyuune suuɡi harɛ.
Anee baala la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he baa nyin nɛnwee lala bɔr ɔ?
Waa o fa aa bol he be Galilia harɛ la, he soɔh kɛɛ?
O toole bonɔ, o iro.
O fa ta ŋɔe ŋɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ bá le o Nɛn Bie tɛ nɛnchɔɡa, ba kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta ásɛ a tɔpetooro wee la ó ir seo ta naa?” Belaa haahna la ta lii ɡɛ waa la.
Ba laa berɛ kaa dem, dɛ ka taa baɡle Yeesu habɔteŋra fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ la ne nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ la.
Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la ne Joana ne Jems nya Mɛɛre dɛ haahna bane baa jaa laanee bol waa la baɡle o toroma la.
Yeesu toroma la kpɔ waa la ɛ mola, ba ta kpɔe ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Belaa Pita te kpɔ chwae dɛ la bwebɔɔ la ta, dɛ ka boŋɛ dɛ haah o bini dɛ na yapoŋ baa kpɔa baaɡe lale la ɡbo chɔe.
Dɛ kpɔ nyokpoa kaa dem.
Emɛyas ŋwɛnɛ ta wa Awola tenten la, Yeesu habɔɔ nɛra la bini banɛ bane chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ le Jerusalam dɛɛ kaa Emɛyas.
Bela ne Jerusalam ɛɛ ɛ kwansini anuanɛɛ.
Dɛ ba dɛ bol waa dɔŋa be, dɛɛ baɡle dɔŋa waa aa chiɡa.
Baa dɛ bol waa sibeɡra ne dɛ bɔɔ dɔŋa dɛɛ kaa la, Yeesu ɡbaɡba kaa puu ba, ba ne wɛɛ kaa.
Ba nao, kɛ ba ta wone jemɔ.
Belaa Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he valɛ dɛɛ ba dɛɛ bol dɔŋa be nɔɔ?” Asɛ ba jaɡɛ che sum ne surumm ken.
Asɛ ba nɛra banɛ la bini bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kliopas la chaŋo ŋɔ, “He te ta waa aa chiɡ bonɔ tɔpera anɛ nɔ noɛ kɛɛ?
Jerusalam nɛŋhɔɔhree hen kɛɛ?” Anee Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa yɔ?” Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Waa aa pu Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt la waa yaa bol.
O ɛ Korowii keame dɛ dɔ kpeɡri wobol ne we-ɛɛla ta, Korowii ne nɛra bwa jemɛ o wa.
Ya Sɔfonomonome ne ya bela nomonome kpɔɔ tɛ ŋɔ bá di o wa, dɛ kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta dɛ kpoo.
Kɛ ya te, ya fa dɔ hwɛɡa kɛ onee naate o fe aa dɛ ba dɛ ba lɛ Israel tena la.
Waa nɔ aa chiɡa tɔpera atoroo la.
Anɔ la ɡe aa jaa, haahna bane baa ɛ ya bini bane la ɡelɔ ya nyoa kpo.
Ba felo dɛ la bela baa huɡo, kɛ ba ta o lale nae.
Asɛ ba ba dɛ ba ŋɔ ba na nɛra bane kɛŋɔ nyundua toroma ken bela, ba chaɡle kɛŋɔ Yeesu ir seo ta.
Belaa yabala la bane baa ɛ o habɔteŋra la bane la bela baa huɡo la, dɛ ka na a ɡɛ waa la tenten, dɛ a ɛ kpela ɡɛ haahna la aa bola la.
Kɛ Yeesu ɡbaɡba te, ba ta on nae.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nfɛrɛ nyaara!
Ɛrɛɛ haa wola Korowii keamere waa baa bola la yarada nɔɔ?
A ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ Kristo la Korowii aa ŋɔa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la na ɡɛ wahala nɔ bwa mɔɔ ásɛ dɛ dɔ Korowii Kora la di kɛɛ?” Asɛ Yeesu baɡ ba o bwara waa aa lɔ Korowii Tɔn la bwa bini.
O pa mun le anɔ la aa lɔ Mosis Tɔne la bini dɛ baɡle kaa anɔ la aa lɔ Korowii keamere kwaa la ta.
Baa tel bwɛɛ la baa dɛ kaa o ta la, Yeesu ɛo kɛŋɔ waa dɛ kaa sie, kɛ ba ta on ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ, dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, “Wee joɔ, bɔr dɛ bir, anomanta, ba yá chɔ.” Asɛ o sɛh o ne ba ka so.
Kondiiɡa saŋ aa tela ba ka cheme tiɡ ta la, o kpɔ paanoo dɛ jam Korowii dɛ kuuɡi do ba nɔɔra ta.
Belaa ba sie ta chole o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ Yeesuu.
Buɡ la ta, o den nyoɡre ba siwi ta.
Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “A waa laa wɛɛ baɡle Korowii Tɔn la waa ŋwɛnɛ ta asɛ a jo ya bini ɡɛ la aa?” Buɡ la taa, ba ir dɛ berɛ kaa Jerusalam a wola jɔmɔra la ne, dɛ ka na Yeesu habɔteŋra fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ la.
Dɛ ba ne nɛra baa jaa la pɛo so dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔ la iro kpela!
O kpɔ o te baɡle Seemɔn!” Gɛ nɛra banɛ la baɡle waa aa chiɡ Emɛyas ŋwɛnɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ baa dɛ kaa asɛ Yeesu ka puu ba la bini chaɡ ba, dɛ baɡle ɡɛ aa ɛa o kuuɡi paanoo tɛɛ ba mɔɔ ba ta jemɔ.
Yeesu kpɔ o te chaɡle o habɔteŋra A ɡɛ saŋ nɛra banɛ la aa bol ɡɛ waa la dɛɛ baɡ ba la, buɡ la ta, dɛ Yeesu denɔ ba che ba baah ta dɛ ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.” Ba jarɔ, ɔmee laɡ ba, ba lii kɛŋɔ lalee ba ken na.
Asɛ o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa ɡela he bambile chɔɡ nɔɔ?
Bɔkwa waa hɛɛ ɛ aahna aahna nɔɔ?
Hé nyiŋi n nɔɔra ne n napaala, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee.
Hé laɡ mɛ dɛ na, dɛkalkɛŋɔ lale ta bwadabii ne hoɡa dɔe ɡɛ haa na mɛ n che nɔ.” Yeesu bol ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ kpɔ o nɔɔra ne o napaala baɡ ba.
Ba sie lɛo, kɛ dɛ ba bwara hwaoh, asɛ ba taa tɔŋle.
O bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He dɔ kondikwaa ane bonɔ naa?” Asɛ ba tɛo pɛŋe baa ŋwiiro pera, asɛ o lɛ dɛ chwe ba siwi ta.
Ate, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Anɔ waa ɡɛ saŋ n ne haa lole la, n yon dɛɛ bol he be ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ n bwara wobɛlbwa baa chwera Mosis Mmara la bini ne Korowii keamere tɔne la bini ne Korowii Kpɛɛra Tɔn bini la ɛ kpela la.” Anee o kpɔ lii ba, ba no Korowii Tɔn la mun.
Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ Kristo la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó na wahala nɛra nɔn ta bá kpoo, ásɛ o seo habɔɔ tɔpera atoro la, ó ir seo ta, ásɛ ba che o sɔn ta dɛ́ bol Amanesoma la dɛ́ ŋɔ nɛ́ra charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ Korowii kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, dɛ pa mun le Jerusalam dɛ baɡle ɡɛ waa nɔ harɛ bobɛlbwa.
Heyaa waa nɔ danseɛ tena.
Kɛ hé no, n ɡbabir ɛɛ tomɛ kon n Mɛɛ aa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa laanee he be.
Anomanta, hé so bwɛjen nɔ ta ka tel kɛŋɔ kpeɡri la aa le nyundua ba he be.” Yeesu nyundua kaala Belaa o kpɔ ba le Jerusalam kaa Bɛtani dahare dɛ ka laa o nɔɔra ir dɛ soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba.
O Korowii soŋa dɛ tɛɛ ba ta la, o le ba jwɛh, asɛ Korowii kpɔɔ kaa nyundua.
Ba duuru dɛ berɛ kpɔ silɛɛ kaa Jerusalam, dɛ yon ka jo Korowii Dea dɛɛ jam Korowii tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Jɔn ɛ nomɛl waa bɛne Yeesu o habɔteŋra la bini.
Dɛ o dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa jemɛ nɛn la soo Yeesu aa ɛa, dɛ́ jemɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla waa ɛa, dɛ waa bwa waa dɛ baɡle.
O dɛ baɡle kɛ Yeesu ɛ Korowii bie, dɛ o ne Korowiirii lole le mumpar, asɛ o ba ɛ nɛwɛnyini, o ne nɛwɛnyina ba so harɛ nɔ ta.
Jɔn dɛ baɡle kɛ Yeesu cheɡɛ webaɡla ta dɛ baɡle ɡɛ o nɛn soo siwi aa doa.
Gɛ waa baɡle a bini laanee teŋa nɔ, Paanoo waa ɛ mkpa, ne kandea waa cheɡa tɛ harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa, ne peteɡredɛɛɡe la dɛ kasinteŋ ɡrepo daa la.
Jɔn dɛ nyin kɛ nɛra yarada Yeesu waa la, ásɛ dɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.
Nyiŋi nyu :.
Yeesu waa ɛ Korowii Nyoa Wobol la wa Wobɛlbwa mumpar Korowii aa wola nyundua ne harɛ tae mɔɔ la, dɛ Korowii Nyoa Wobol la lole.
Dɛ o ne Korowiirii lole, asɛ o ne o bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Dɛ onee ja Korowii nɛɛ mumpar la.
O nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ ta komɛlbwa.
Kontaale bɛlbwa toole waa wola o nɛɛ cheɡɛ dɛ tao.
Korowii Nyoa Wobol la bee Korowii mkpa do, asɛ ɡɛ mkpa nɔ ɡe ɛ kɛŋɔ nii dɛɛ chaah nɛwɛnyini sie.
Nii nɔ lole dɛɛ chaah biro ta, kɛ biro ta wone tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ ó chaah bɔr kahonɛ bwa.
Dɛ baa bɛl lole baa yerɔ Jɔn.
Korowiirii tomɔ ŋɔ ó ba bol nii la waa dɛ chaah nɛwɛnyini sie la waa nɛra be, ásɛ ba no dɛ yarada.
Dɛ Jɔn ɡbaɡba laa ɡɛ nii la.
Balaa o ba dɛ ba bol nɛn waa ɛ nii tenten la waa ásɛ nɛra jemɛ o wa.
Korowii Nyoa Wobol laanee nii kasinteŋ waa dɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta dɛ́ ba pili nɛwɛnyini sie la.
O nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ ta nɛwɛnyini, kɛ waa ba harɛ ta bonɔ la, nɛwɛnyini ta on jemɛ.
O ba o ɡbaɡba harɛ ta, asɛ o ɡbaɡba nɛra vɛoh.
Kɛ nɛra la te bwa baa lɛo dɛ yaradao la, o tɛɛ ba kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bá ɛ Korowii bii.
Ŋwɛnɛ nɛwɛnyini aa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ lolɛ bii la, kɛɛ nɛwɛnyini pɛla, kɛɛ nɛwɛnyini tetoora ta laa ba lol ba ba ɛ Korowii bii.
Korowii kpeɡri taa a che ba berɛ o bii.
Korowii Nyoa Wobol la baa berɛ nɛwɛnyini, dɛ ba so ya be.
Ya na o jirima waa dɔa, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Bibeŋkpoŋ laanee on.
Dɛ o wobɛlbwa wer, asɛ o dɔ kasinteŋ ɡe kohona.
O waa Jɔn faa bol kohona dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛn n fa aa dɛ bol o waa dɛ ŋɔ men tɔ sie o nɛɛ kɛ o ɡwaa mɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o lole mɔɔ ba lol mɛ la, on la.” Korowii chao kohona asɛ o ɡe na ya sum dɛɛ tɛ yaa andɛɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa, waa wola ɡel bwa.
Mosis nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ ba Mmara la ne.
Yeesu Kristo ɡe nɛɛ nɛn nɛɛ suna ne kasinteŋ bwa che dɛ ba harɛ ta.
Nomɛlbwa ta Korowii nae bwa.
O Bibeŋkpoŋ waa pɛlo la, on ɡela nɛwɛnyini jemɔ.
Jɔn waa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee webaɡla A wola bɛl, Juu tena nomonome baa lɔ Jerusalam la tomɛ ba sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ŋɔ bá ka bɔɔ Jɔn o nɛnsoo.
Waa waa bola dɛ kpɔ di Yeesu danseɛ laanee nɔ.
Baa bɔɔro ɡɛ la, o ta nyoa tɔe.
O bol kasinteŋ ŋɔ, “Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la laa men.” Anee ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Aah dɛ umee hen ɔ?
Elaejaa hen kɛɛ?” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “O laa men.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Korowii keame laanee hen kɛɛ?” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Akai.” Belaa ba ŋɔ, “Baɡle he nɛnsoo yá jemɛ, dɛ́ won dɔ wobɛl ka bol nɛra baa tomɛ yaa la be.
Nɛn besoo hɛɛ lii he te nɔ?” Belaa Jɔn kpɔ Korowii keame Aesaya waa o fa aa bola la chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Menee naate waa dɛ bol waa takpeɡ ne pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Hé ɡel he we-ɛɛla toɡre, dɛ́ kpɔ he te dɛɛ kpa he Dɔɔ bala’ la.” Anee nɛra Farisii tena la aa tom ba la bɔɔ Jɔn ŋɔ, “He ŋɔ Kristo la laa hen, Elaeja ɡe laa hen, Korowii keame la ɡe laa hen, aah dɛ ɛrɛɛ he ɛ dɛ won dɛɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii neɔ?” Belaa Jɔn ŋɔ, “Nee n te kpɔ dɛɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii ne.
Nomɛl lɔ he bini taraken haa wola on jemɛ.
Men bala mɔɔ o ba, kɛ o ɡwaa mɛ.
Maa o napaa tee kwaraa dɔ.” Bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Bɛtani o do Jɔɔdan Moo la wee leebɔr pera la, belaa a ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡ.
Dɛ belaa Jɔn ɛɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii ne.
Yeesu Korowii pebie la wa Tɔ aa pera la, Jɔn na Yeesu kɛŋɔ waa dɛ ba o be.
Belaa Jɔn ŋɔ nɛra o ne baa cheɡa la be ŋɔ, “Hé na Korowii Pebie waa dɛ ba nɛra bwa wechɔɡa laa dɛ́ kpɔ ba nɛɛ la!
O waa n faa bol ŋɔ, ‘Nomɛl lɔ n habɔɔ dɛɛ ba, dɛ ɡwaa mɛ, dɛkalkɛ o lole mɔɔ ba lol mɛ’ la.
Dɛ n ɡbabir fa aa on jemɛ, kɛ o waa n ba dɛ baa sɔ nɛra Korowii nee ásɛ Israel tena jemɔ.” Jɔn bol Yeesu waa ja ŋɔ, “N na Korowii Doma la aa le nyundua kɛŋɔ borɔnoma, dɛ ba so o nɛ.
N te fe aa jemɛ kɛ onee, kɛ Korowii waa lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ba kpɔ nee dɛɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee laanee ɡela n jemɔ.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Hɛɛ na n Doma laanee o ba so naate nɛ.
On dɛɛ ba n Domadɛɛɡe kpɔe dɛ sɔ nɛra la.’ A ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡo n na, anomanta, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ Korowii Biee on.” Yeesu aa kpɔ o loɡla habɔteŋra wa Tɔ aa pera la, dɛ Jɔn ne o habɔteŋra banɛ cheɡɛ bela ja.
O na Yeesu o baa kaa, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na Korowii Pebie la!” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o habɔteŋra banɛ la noɔ, dɛ ka teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Belaa Yeesu ke nyiŋi dɛ na kɛ baa teŋɛ o nɛ, asɛ o bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ɔ?” Asɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Rabae, lee he dem doɔ?” Rabae munii nɛn waa dɛ chaɡle wa.
Belaa o ŋɔ, “Hé ba na.” Asɛ ba la dɛ ka na o dem.
Dɛ a bɔ jɔmɔra dɔŋ anaarɛ, asɛ ba so o be bela wee ba jo.
Dɛ Andriu ɛ nɛra banɛ la Jɔn aa bol waa ba no dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ la bini bɛl.
Seemɔn Pita nimee on.
Waa waa tɔ sie ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ o kaa nyin o dɔɔ Seemɔn bɔr, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya na Mɛsaya la.” Mɛsaya munii Kristo.
O la Seemɔn ne Yeesu be.
Belaa Yeesu nyiŋu dɛ ŋɔ, “He sɔne Seemɔn.
Jɔn biee hen.
Taraken baa dɛɛ yerɛɛ Sefas.” Yeesu yerɛ Felep ne Nataaneɛl Tɔ aa pera la, Yeesu ɛo kɛŋɔ wɛɛ la Galilia harɛ taa.
O kaa na Felep dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Baa teŋɛ n nɛ!” Dɛ Felep bwɛɛ Bɛtsaeda, belaa Andriu ne Pita ɡe le.
Felep ɡe kaa na Nataaneɛl, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya na naate Mosis aa chwerɛ o waa Korowii Tɔn bini la.
O waa Korowii keamere la ɡe chwerɛ la.
O sɔne Yeesu.
Josef waa le Nasarɛt la biee.” Belaa Nataaneɛl ŋɔ, “Nasarɛt ɡe, kondɛɛɡe besoo dɛ́ won le bela ɔ?” Anee Felep ŋɔ, “Ba ba na nɔ!” Yeesu aa na Nataaneɛl wɛɛ ba o be la, o ŋɔ, “Israel te tentenee nɔ.
O waa dɔ kasinteŋ kɛrɛdɛ!” Belaa Nataaneɛl bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ jem mɛ nɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Haa lɔ fiɡ la mun la, n nae mɔɔ Felep ka yerɛ la.” Anee Nataaneɛl ŋɔ, “Nomoa, Korowii Biee hen.
Henee Israel tena Kooro la.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Maa ŋɔ he be ŋɔ n nae fiɡ la mun la waa he den yarada mɛ nɔ naa?
Hɛɛ na wejenaa a ɡwaa anɔ!” Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, hɛɛ nao nyundua aa pila, ásɛ nyundua toroma che bela tu dɛɛ ba Men Nɛn Bie be, dɛ berɛ teeh dɛɛ kaa.”
Keenan hanfalwa A habɔɔ tɔpetooro wee la, dɛ ba dɛ ɛ hanfalwaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Keena o do Galilia harɛ ta la.
Dɛ Yeesu nya Mɛɛre lɔ bela.
Ba yerɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la bane ɡe hanfale waa la bɔr bela.
Dɛ ba dɛ tɛ nɛra la aa cheme bela la sen, asɛ a bo.
Belaa Yeesu nya ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ba sen bwa tonɔ.” Anee Yeesu bɔɔ o nya ŋɔ, “N nya, aah ɛrɛ waa he berɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi n te siwi ta nɔɔ?
Gɛ saŋ maa dɛ ba n toma ɛɛ la ta tele mɔɔ.” O nya berɔ ŋɔ bonɔɔna baa dɛ do sene la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ o baa ŋɔ hé ɛ wobɛlbwa naa, hé ɛ.” Dɛ vɛɛhna anumɛl cheɡɛ bela asɛ ba kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ ba nawee bɛl.
Ba yon ɛ nee do a bini ásɛ nɛra yon dɛɛ sarame ba sarama bɛl soo mɔɔ dɛɛ di kwa.
Dɛ vɛɛhna la bɛlbwa won nee haŋkorɔ fah lɛɛ.
Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá do nee vɛɛhna la bini á su, asɛ ba do nee a su laɡlaɡ ken.
Baa do nee vɛɛhna la bini la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɛ ane la ka tɛ hanfale dea nomoa la.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, ba la nee la ne ka tɛo.
Baa tɛo la, dɛ senee.
Nomoa la aa daɡɛ nee aa berɛ sen la na la, o ta wone jemɛ bela aa lea ba, kɛ dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ do sen la te jemɔ.
Anomanta, o yerɛ hanfale jaa la dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa dɛ ba nɛra sen tɛɛ yaa, andɛɛɡa nee o yon tɔ sie le, ásɛ nɛra bwa aa dɔ kohona nyɔ la, mɔɔ o yon le anɔ la aa wola somɛ la ne ásɛ baa nyɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ he te tɔ sendɛɛɡa cheɡ dɛ ka mun dɛɛ ba a ne nɔɔ?” Yeesu nyokpowaa waa tɔ sie ɛa laanee la.
Keena waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta laanee o ɛa, dɛ chaɡle o nɛnsoo ne kpeɡri waa dɔa, asɛ o habɔteŋra la na dɛ yaradao.
A habɔɔ la, Yeesu ne o nya ne o nimanar dɛ o habɔteŋra la la Kapeeneɔm dɛ ka so bela tɔpera anɛ.
Yeesu la Korowii Dea Dɛ Juu tena tɔpejen baa dɛ yerɔ Galekaa la joɔ tonɛ, anomanta, Yeesu la Jerusalam.
Bela la, o nao kɛŋɔ nɛra bane aa dɛ yoɡ nae ne peera ne borɔnomare Korowii Dea bobɛl.
Dɛ nɛra baa dɛ peɡri suuɡare ɡe soɡe ba teeburre ta dɛɛ ɛ ba toma.
Belaa Yeesu pɛrɛ bampɔrɔ ŋwɛɛra, dɛ kpɔ doŋi peera ne nae ne kondɛɛra la bwa bela.
O taɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ peɡri suuɡare la teeburre piiɡi, dɛ lɔ ba suuɡare merɛ, dɛ kɔr banɔ la baa dɛ yoɡ borɔnomare la ŋɔ bá le a ne bela, dɛ ŋɔ ba bɛ o Mɛɛ dem kpɔ berɛ bonadibɔr.
Bela la, o habɔteŋra la liiro kɛŋɔ ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini bobɛl kɛŋɔ, “Korowii Dea waa swɛɛ n siwi taeh” la.
Belaa Juu tena nomonome la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa nyokpowaa hɛɛ ba wona ɛ dɛ́ chaɡle kɛŋɔ he dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ won ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “He kuuɡi Korowii Dea nɔ naa, n ɡe ɛɛ kpɔ tɔpera atoroo doo.” Belaa ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Dea baa kpɔ bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ anumɛl mao la, hen dɛ won kpɔ tɔpera atoro ɡbo doo wa aa?” Dɛ Yeesu ɡbaɡba bwadabii waa wɛɛ bol dɛ kpɔ maɡɛ Korowii Dea la.
Anomanta, Korowii aa ir Yeesu seo ta la, belaa o habɔteŋra la lii kɛŋɔ Yeesu fa bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ.
A ɡelɔ ba yarada waa baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini la, ne waa Yeesu aa bola la.
Yeesu ta aa lɔ Jerusalam dɛɛ di Galekaa Tɔpejen la, nɛra warɔ dɛ che o nyokpowaa waa ɛa ta, dɛ yaradao kɛŋɔ onee Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ nɛwɛnyina la.
Kɛ Yeesu ta ban yaradae kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ o te tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o jemɛ nɛwɛnyini da kɛrɛdɛ.
A ta hiaih kɛ nɛn baɡlo ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini aa doa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba jemɛ waa aa lɔ nɛn bambile bini.
Yeesu ne Nikodeemɔs Dɛ Juu tena nomoa bɛl lole baa yerɔ Nikodeemɔs.
Dɛ o ɛ Farisii te.
Awola bɛl jwaana, o ba Yeesu be dɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, nomɛlbwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii tomɛ ŋɔ hé ba baɡle nɛra wa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Korowii ta nɛn habɔɔ cheɡaa, waa won ɛ nyokpowaa nɔ haa dɛ ɛ nɔ.” Belaa Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin Korowii Kora la ta dɛ́ ja la, nemenɛ bá berɛ lolɔ ja.” Anee Nikodeemɔs pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Nɛn waa kpeɡa la, ɛrɛɛ bá ɛ dɛ́ berɛ won lolɔ jaɔ?
Wɛɛ wonoo berɛ jo o nya tea bini ja ásɛ o lolɔ wa aa?” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, dɛ ba ta nomɛlbwa lolɛ nee ne Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ne naa, waa Korowii Kora ta jae ba.
Nɛwɛnyini lola lole, asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡe lola do le.
Nɛwɛnyini lola ɛ bwadabii wa, asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe lola ɡe ɛ lileo wa.
He bɛ ɡel waa maa bola ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ba berɛ lolɛ heyaa la kpo he nyoa.
Bela peu aa dɛ nyin laanee o ta dɛɛ kaa.
O dɛ ta aa, he dɛ no o ɡbɔɡa kɛ haa on na, haa won jemɛ bela waa lea ne bela waa dɛ kaa.
Gɛɛ nomɛlbwa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa lolɔ la do.
Dɛ o we-ɛɛla laa aa, komɛlbwa toole dɛɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe lolɔ.” Belaa Nikodeemɔs pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ won maɡre ɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ɛ Juu tena nomonjen dɛɛ baɡle Korowii Wa, haa wola ɡɛ waa nɔ jemɛ nɔɔ?
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, waa yaa jema la, ne waa ya sie aa naa la, anee yaa bol, kɛ haa ya be no.
Aah dɛ maa dɛ bol waa aa lɔ harɛ ta bonɔɔ haa wola men yarada nɔ, dɛ n bol waa aa lɔ Korowii doa aa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ won yarada a te nɔ?
Dɛ Men Nɛn Bie laa aa, nomɛlbwa ta Korowii be nyundua laŋɛ mɔɔ.
N ɡboo le o be nyundua dɛ tu ba harɛ.
Gɛ saŋ ya naawa aa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la, Korowii keame Mosis la fa kpɔ buni dɛ loɡɛ harɛkon dɛ kpɔ do daa ta dɛ ɡɔɔro ásɛ nɛra nyiŋu dɛ bɛ dɛɛ sewɛ.
Gɛɛ a chɛ kɛ ba ɡɔɔ Men Nɛn Bie la.
Dɛ ba baa ɡɔɔ mɛ ɡɛ naa, nomɛlbwa waa yarada n waa la, wɛɛ dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa laanee.
Korowii dɛ nyin nɛwɛnyini taeh.
A waa o ɡel men maa ɛ o Bibeŋkpoŋ ɡbo waa dɔɔ la ba harɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa yarada n waa la bɛ sewɛ, kɛ ó dɔ o mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la.
Korowii aa tom mɛ harɛ la, o ta ŋɔe ŋɔ ń ba bol he waa dɛ́ pa heyaa bolchɔɡe.
Kɛ o tom mɛ ŋɔ ń ba nyin ŋwɛnɛ tɛ heya, ásɛ o won lɛ heya.
Nomɛlbwa waa yarada n waa la, Korowii aa o waa bol á ba ɛ kɛ wɛɛ di bolchɔɡee.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola n waa yaradae la, Korowii pao bolchɔɡe tonɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ta o Bibeŋkpoŋ la waa yaradae.
Ba bolchɔɡe pae munii kɛŋɔ nii waa dɛ chaah bɔr la ba harɛ nɔ ta, kɛ nɛwɛnyini berɔ dɛɛ nyin biro ɡwaa nii la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba wobɛlbwa ɛ wechɔɡa.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, waa bochaah nyin, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o le bochaah ta naa, nɛra ɛɛ na o wechɔɡa laanee.
Naate waa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa la te, waa bochaah lee ɔmɛ.
Wedɛɡ-ɛɛ bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ o waa bochaah ta ásɛ nɛra bwa na dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ o jemɛ Korowii.” Yeesu ne Jɔn A habɔɔ la, Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la la Juda harɛ ta, asɛ o ka di tɔpera anɛ ba be dɛɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee bela.
Dɛ Jɔn ɡe dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Aenɔn o ne Salim aa wola jaŋɛ la ta.
Dɛ nee lɔ Aenɔn taeh, asɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba Jɔn be wɛɛ sɔ ba Korowii ne.
A ɡɛ saŋ la dɛ ba ta Jɔn lawɛ do dea mɔɔ.
Dɛ nɛra baa teŋɛ Jɔn nɛɛ la ne Juu te bɛl dɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa ba bela Korowii toma waa aa ɛ nɔɔra ne naa sarama ne nee sɔe wa.
Ba la Jɔn be dɛ ka pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he dɛ lii kɛ he ne baa bɛl fa aa cheɡɛ Jɔɔdan Moo la wee leebɔr pera la aa?
O waa he faa bol la.
O dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii ne, asɛ nɛra bwa chwa dɛɛ kaa o be.” Belaa Jɔn ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won dɔ komɛl dɛ Korowii laa tɛo.
Maa ŋɔa ŋɔ n laa Kristo la, dɛ ŋɔ tomaa ba tom mɛ ŋɔ ń tɔ o sie la, he ta noɛ yaa?
Hanfale jaaree dɔ o haah.
Kɛ, dɛ hanfale jaa la dam lɔ hanfale la waa bɔr dɛ no o nyoa bela aa, dɛ o sie lɛo.
Gɛɛ n ɡe bwara sɔɔh mɛ kohona.
A chɛ kɛ o sɔn ɛɛ le kohona asɛ n te sɔn ɛɛ ba harɛ.
Nɛn waa le nyundua la ɡwaa nomɛlbwa.
Nɛn waa le harɛ bonɔ la, harɛ waa o jemɛ, a waa ɡee o won bola.
Kɛ nɛn waa le Korowii be nyundua la te ɡwaa nomɛlbwa.
Waa o siwi aa naa ne waa waa noa Korowii be laanee wɛɛ bol, kɛ nɛwɛnyini aa o be no.
Nomɛlbwa sɛh Korowii wa aa, o ɡbaɡba wono dɛɛ jemɛ kɛ Korowii waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
Nɛn Korowii aa tomɔ la, Korowii wobolee wɛɛ bol, dɛkalkɛ Korowii tɛo o Domadɛɛɡe la tɛɛ tenten.
Korowii nyin o Bie la taeh, dɛ kpɔ wobɛlbwa kpeɡri do o nɔn ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa yarada Korowii Bie la waa la, wɛɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwaa.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola Korowii Bie la waa yaradae la, waa mkpa dɔe ba.
Korowii bandia ɛɛ do o nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa.”
Yeesu ne Samaria haah bɛl Farisii tena la noɔ kɛŋɔ Yeesu berɔ dɛɛ dɔ nɛra kohona dɛɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee kohona dɛɛ ɡwaa Jɔn.
Kasinteŋ, dɛ Yeesu ɡbaɡba aa nɛra Korowii nee sɔ.
Dɛ o habɔteŋra laanee dɛɛ sɔ ba Korowii ne.
Yeesu aa no ɡɛ baa dɛ bol o waa la, o le Juda harɛ dɛ kaa Galilia harɛ ta.
Dɛ Samaria harɛ taa chɛ kɛ o kpɔ dɛ́ won kaa Galilia harɛ ta.
O baa le Samaria bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Seka la ta.
Dɛ a ɡɛ bwɛɛ la ne harɛ la Jekɔb aa kpɔa tɛ o bie Josef la aa jaŋɛ.
Dɛ Jekɔb kɔlɔŋ bɛl lɔ bela.
Yeesu aa vala dɛ koh la, o kaa so kɔlɔŋ la nyoa.
Dɛ wee cheɡɛ nyufala.
Samaria haah bɛl balɔ ŋɔ ó ba dɔ ne, asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Tɛ mɛ nee ń nyɔ.” Dɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la kaa bwɛɛ la ta dɛ́ ka nyin kondikwaa ba.
Belaa haah la nyoa kpo, o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Fini te Juu te dɛ soŋe Samaria haah ne aa?” Dɛ Juu tena dɛ kɔɡɛ Samaria tena taeh, dɛ baa sɛh ba ne baa pɛ numoli ne loɡa kwara.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he fe jemɛ kon Korowii aa dɛ nyin he tɛɛ nɔ, dɛ jemɛ naate waa dɛ soŋe nee nɔ naa, he fe ɛɛ soŋoo ásɛ o fee tɛɛ nee aa won tɛɛ mkpa.” Belaa haah la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, bule nɔ aa luŋa, asɛ haa wola kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ ta kɔlɔŋ dɔe nɔ, lee hɛɛ ba a ɡɛ nee aa dɛ tɛ mkpa nɔ dɔe yɔ?
He dɛ lii kɛ he ɡwaa ya naa Jekɔb waa tɛ yaa a ɡɛ bule nɔ la kɛɛ?
O ne o bii ne o kondɛɛra bwaa fa dɛ nyɔ nee bule nɔ ta.” Belaa Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa nyɔ nee nɔ la, nyɔɡre ɛɛ kpoo ja.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa nyɔ nee maa dɛ tɛo la te, nyɔɡre aa on kpo bwa.
Nee maa tɛo la ɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ bule aa lɔ naate bini dɛɛ bule nee aa dɛ tɛ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.” Belaa haah la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, amɔ te, tɛ mɛ a ɡɛ nee la ane ásɛ nyɔɡre bɛ men kpo kpa, ásɛ n bɛ bonɔ ba ba dɔ nee kpa.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ka yerɛ o jaa ba.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, “N ta jaa dɔe.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ŋɔ he ta jaa dɔe yaa, kpelaa he ŋɔ.
He yalɛ baala banue bwa, kɛ onɔ la he ne waa lole taraken la, he jaa laa on, anomanta, kpelaa he ŋɔ.” Asɛ haah la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, maa naa nɔ, Korowii keamee hen.
Bwe nɔ taa ya Samaria tena naawa faa tomɛ Korowii saŋ la.
Aah ɛrɛ waa he Juu tena ŋɔ Jerusalamee chɛ Korowii toma nɔɔ?” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, aa ba tel saŋ bɛlee nɛra aa wola Korowii tomɛ bwe nɔ ta, baa on tomɛ Jerusalam ɡe.
He Samaria tena te, ɛɛ he ɡee ɛ te, kɛ haa kon haa dɛ tomɛ jemɛ.
Kɛ ya Juu tena te jemɛ kon yaa dɛ tomɛ, dɛkalkɛ ya nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa ásɛ Korowii lɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa.
Korowii toma te lɔ bambile bini.
Aa ba tel saŋ bɛlee, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii kpela kpela la che o Domadɛɛɡe la ta dɛɛ tomɔ bambile bini, dɛɛ tomɔ kasinteŋ ne, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛɛ wɛɛ nyin kɛ baa tomɔ.
A ɡɛ tɔpere la telo tonɛ.
Korowii ɛ lileo.
Anomanta, dɛ ya dɛ tomɔ waa, yá che o Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛ́ kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ tomɔ bambile bini.” Anee haah la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya Lɛɛ la baa dɛ yerɔ Kristo la ɛɛ bao.
O balaa, wɛɛ baɡle yaa wobɛlbwaa.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Onee he ne wɛɛ bol waa la.
Kristo laanee men.” Belaa Yeesu habɔteŋra la ba.
Baa baa na o ne haah naa cheɡa dɛɛ bol waa la, a ɛɛ ba anebɛlbwa.
Kɛ ba bɛlbwa ɡe ta berɛ won bɔɔ haah la kon la waa dɛ nyin Yeesu be.
Bɛlbwa ta wone bɔɔ Yeesu waa aa bala o ne haah la ɛɛ bol waa la.
Haah la ɡel o vii waa dɛ ba o ne nee dɔe la bela dɛ chwa la bwɛɛ la ta ka ŋɔ bela tena be ŋɔ, “Hé ba ba na noo!
Baa bɛl wono baɡle n waa maa dɛ ɛ bwa!
Jamɔ Kristo laanee kɛɛ?” Haah la aa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, bela tena chwao le ba bwɛɛ la ta dɛɛ ba Yeesu be.
Haah la aa kaa bwɛɛ la ta la, Yeesu habɔteŋra la soŋo jande jande ŋɔ, “Nomoa, lɛ kondikwaa di!” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “N dɔ kondikwaa ane haa wola a waa jemɛ.” Anee o habɔteŋra la ɛɛ pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Nomɛl baa tɛo kondikwaa o di ɡbaɔ?” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “N kondikwaa kɛ maa dɛ ɛ n Mɛɛ waa tom mɛ la tetoora, ne kɛ maa ɛ o toma waa tɛ mɛ la bwa tonɛ.
He laa yon ŋɔ ba du kwa aa, korobie anaarɛɛ aa di mɔɔ baa koma la aa?
Kasinteŋ, he bɛ chɔ.
Hé ta sie na koo kwaa bwa aa bea ne koma ɡɛ!
Nɛn waa komɛ kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la dɛ dɔ o kembɔr.
Nɛwɛnyinaa naate ɛɛ komɛ, dɛɛ lɛɛ ba ásɛ ba dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la, ásɛ naate ne nɛn waa dua la bwa sie lɛ.
Baa ŋɔa, ‘Bɛlee dɛɛ du, bɛl ɡe ɛɛ komɛ’ la, kpelaa.
N waa nɔ maa ɡela hɛɛ baɡle nɔ, a do kɛŋɔ maa ɡela hɛɛ komɛ kwaa bela haa wola parɛ la.
Bane tɔ sie koh mɔɔ he baa na som la.” Samaria tena baa lɔ bwɛɛ la ta kɛrɛdɛ yarada Yeesu, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haah la ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “O bol waa maa dɛ ɛ bwa n be.” Anomanta, Samaria tena la aa ba Yeesu be la, ba soŋo ŋɔ ó so ba be.
O soɡe ba be tɔpera anɛ dɛɛ baɡ ba Korowii Wa.
Yeesu waa waa dɛ bol la ɡelɔ nɛra pirim berɛ yarada o waa la ja, dɛ ŋɔ haah la be ŋɔ, “A ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ he waa haa bola la ɡboo ɡela ya yaradao.
Ya ɡbaɡba ɡe aa kpɔ deŋne no o waa la name la, anee ɡela ya yarada dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra bwa Lɛɛree nɔ kpela.” Yeesu chah nomoa bɛl bibaa Yeesu aa di tɔpera anɛ bela la, o le bela dɛɛ kaa Galilia harɛ.
O ɡbabir fa bolɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii keame bɛlbwa ta sɔn dɔe o ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ bwa.” Waa jo Galilia harɛ la, bela tena lɛo silɛɛ ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa la Galekaa Tɔpejen dii Jerusalam la, ba na waa waa ɛa Galekaa dii la ta bwa.
Yeesu la Galilia bwɛɛ Keena.
Belaa o faa kpɔ nee berɛ sen la.
Waa la bela la, dɛ Abane nomoa bɛl bibaa bwara dɛ weo Kapeeneɔm.
Nomoa la aa noa kɛŋɔ Yeesu le Juda harɛ ba Galilia harɛ la, o ba o be dɛ ba soŋo ŋɔ ó la Kapeeneɔm dɛ ka chah o bie waa dɛ ba sewa la.
Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He bɛlbwa ta nyokpowaa ne wekpeɡa ane nae yaa, haa men yarada bwa.” Asɛ nomoa la soŋo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, yá kaa.
A waa laa aa, n bie la ɛɛ sewɔɔ.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ la he bwɛ, he bie la ɛɛ ɡbaŋroo!” Baa la yarada Yeesu waa waa bola la, dɛ berɛ kaa o bwɛ.
Waa dɛ kaa la, o bonɔɔna chemo ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He bie la ɡbaŋrɔ!” Belaa o bɔɔ ba saŋ la yiso o bie la weela la nyoa aa ba harɛ, asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ ɛ webaŋa dɔŋ beŋkpoŋ saŋee o bɔwɔrɔba la le o nɛ.” Belaa nomoa la lii kɛŋɔ a ɡɛ saŋ la tentenee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He bie la ɛɛ ɡbaŋroo” la.
A taa a che o ne o dem tena bwa yarada Yeesu waa la, dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo.
Yeesu aa le Juda harɛ ba Galilia harɛ la, nyokpowaa nɔɔ jaa nɛɛ waa ɛa.
Yeesu chah baa bɛl Bɛtsata A habɔɔ la, dɛ Juu tena tɔpejen bɛl telo, asɛ Yeesu la Jerusalam.
Dɛ tam bɛl chɔ Jerusalam asɛ Juu tena ɛɛ yerɔ Bɛtsata Hibru wobol ta.
O chɔɔ bɛne Peera Doonyojen la.
Tam la nyoa la, ba ɛ soŋnibɔra bele anue dɛ tɔa.
-Soŋnibɔra bela la, weela tena kɛŋɔ nyoŋa, boobie ne banɔ la ba peri aa serewa warɔ dɛ chɔ bela.
Dɛ baa bɛl ja weela tena la nɛɛ o weela do o nɛɛ bene fifraatoro dɛ anuatoro dɛ o ta chaeh dɔe.
Yeesu aa baa na o chɔe la, o wono jemɛ kɛŋɔ weela la aa lɔ o nɛɛ biɡro, anomanta, o bɔɔro ŋɔ, “He dɛ nyin kɛ he dɔ bokpeɡa aa?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh.
Kɛ tam la poraa, maa nɛn dɔ ó kpɔ mɛ kaa do o ta.
Maa takapɔ ŋɔ ń ka jo o ta, dɛ n dɔŋ tɔ n sie.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir che, dɛ́ kpɔ he kalaŋ kaa!” Yeesu aa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, baa la ɡbaŋrɔ dɛ ir che dɛ kpɔ o kalaŋ dɛ valɛ dɛɛ kaa.
Ona Tɔpere taa a ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡ.
Asɛ Juu tena nomonome ŋɔ weela te la Yeesu aa chaoh la be ŋɔ, “Fini ɛ Ona Tɔpere, anomanta, he koni Mmara kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ he kalaŋ che la!” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Naate waa chaah mɛ laanee ŋɔa ŋɔ ń ir kpɔ n kalaŋ dɛ́ kaa.” Anee ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Umee su baah ŋɔ hé ir dɛ́ kpɔ he kalaŋ che nɔɔ?” Baa la ta wone jemɛ naate la nɛnsoo waa chaoh la, dɛkalkɛ dɛ nɛnlaa tentenee lɔ bela asɛ Yeesu koo ba bini kaa.
A habɔɔ la, Yeesu na baa la Korowii Dea asɛ dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He nao kenɛ, taraken haa dɔ bokpeɡa nɔ, ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ, ásɛ anɔ la aa ɡwaa loɡla kwaa la bɛ he nɛɛ ba chiɡ kpa.” Belaa baa la aa le bela la, o la Juu tena nomonome la be dɛ ka chaɡle kɛŋɔ Yeesuu chaoh la.
Baa noa kɛŋɔ Yeesuu ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ Ona Tɔpere ta la, belaa ba pa mun haoh, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o chɔɡ ba Ona Tɔpere Mmara.
Anee Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ te dɛ ɛ o toma saŋ te bɛlbwa, anomanta, ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ n ɡe ɛɛ ɛ.” Gɛ waa nɔ Yeesu aa bola la ɛɛ ba bwaawee kohona dɛ ɡel baa nyinu dɛ́ kpo kwara, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Ona Tɔpere la ɡbo laa wɛɛ chɔɡ.
O berɔ ŋɔ o Mɛɛ waa lolɔɔ Korowii, asɛ dɛ kpɔ o te dɛɛ maɡɔ kɛŋɔ o ne o ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Kpeɡri Korowii bie la aa dɔa Belaa Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, toma Korowii aa dɛ ɛ laanee o Bie ɡe ɛɛ ɛ, dɛkalkɛ waa won kpɔ o ɡbo liire dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin.
Anɔ la Korowii aa dɛ ɛ laanee o Bie ɡe nyiŋi dɛɛ ɛ. Dɛkalkɛ Korowii dɛ nyin o bie asɛ dɛɛ baɡlo o we-ɛɛla dɔŋa wɛɛ ɛ. Anomanta, wɛɛ baɡloo wɛɛ ɛ wejena aa ɡwaa anɔ kwara ásɛ a ɛ heyaa nyokpoa.
Gɛ Korowii aa dɛ chum nɛra baa serewa asɛ dɛ ɡel baa dɔ mkpa la, ɡɛ tentenee o Bie la ɡe ɛɛ ba wona chum bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin dɛ́ tɛo mkpa.
