Korowii ɡbaɡba aa nomɛlbwa waa bol dɛ́ pa bole.
O tɛ o Bie la ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ ó bol nomɛlbwa waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Dɛ ŋɔ nómɛlbwa tɛ o Bie la jirima ɡɛ tenten baa dɛ tɛo jirima la.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa wola o Bie la jirima tɛ la, dɛ ɡɛɛ waa wola o Mɛɛ la waa tomɔ la jirima tɛ.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, nomɛlbwa waa no n waa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta asɛ dɛ yarada n Mɛɛ waa tom mɛ la, onee dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.
Maa naate waa bol dɛ́ pa bole kpa, dɛkalkɛ o le seo nɔn ta dɛ berɛ dɔ Korowii mkpa.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ja kɛŋɔ saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao ásɛ nɛra baa serewa no men Korowii Bie la taa, ásɛ banɔ la baa dɛ no la dɔ Korowii mkpa.
Tɔpere la dɔɔ tel kwara.
Gɛ Korowii aa dɔ mkpa dɛɛ tɛ la, ɡɛɛ o ɡel o Bie la ɡe dɔ mkpa dɛɛ tɛ, asɛ dɛ tɛo kpeɡri kɛ ó won dɛɛ bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole, dɛkalkɛ o Bie laanee Nɛn Bie la.
He bɛ ɡel anɔ ɛ heyaa nyokpoa, dɛkalkɛ tɔpere bɛl dɛ́ ba ásɛ nɛra baa serewa la no n taa, ásɛ bɛlbwa le o bɔɔ bini.
Banɔ la baa ɛ wedɛɛɡa la te ɛɛ berɔɔ dɔ Korowii mkpa, ásɛ banɔ la ɡe baa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la, ó berɛ chɔɡ ba.” Waa aa dɛ di Yeesu danseɛ Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “N ɡbo aa won ɛ wobɛlbwa n bambile ta, nemenɛ anɔ la Korowii aa chaɡ mɛ la.
A taa n che dɛ bol nɛra waa dɛɛ pa bole.
An ɡela n bole pae toɡre nɔ, dɛkalkɛ waa n Mɛɛ waa tom mɛ la aa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la ɡboo mɛɛ ɛ dɛ ɡel n bambile wa.
Dɛ n ŋɔ mɛɛ di danseɛ tɛ n ɡbaɡba aa, nɛra ɛɛ ŋɔɔ nyosonee mɛɛ teŋe.
Kɛ nomɛl lole dɛ di danseɛ dɛɛ tɛ mɛ, asɛ n jemɛ kɛŋɔ o danseɛ dii ɛ kpela.
Jɔn bee he tomɛ he toroma asɛ o bol kasinteŋ la baɡle heya.
Maa n te kpɔe dɛɛ dawɛ nɛwɛnyini nɛɛ ó di mɛ danseɛ.
N dɛ bol anɔ ásɛ he yarada Korowii ó won lɛ heya.
A ɡɛ Jɔn nɔ fa do kɛ kandea baa choŋu wɛɛ chaah bɔr kohona, asɛ hɛɛ nyin o bɔr chaahna la som dɛ na tama mɔɔ.
Kɛ n dɔ danseɛ bɛl waa kpeɡa dɛ ɡwaa Jɔn danseɛ waa baa di tɛ mɛ la kwara.
Anee kɛ toma n Mɛɛ Korowii aa kpɔa do n nɔn ta ŋɔ ń ɛ la.
Anee dɛɛ baɡle kɛ onee tom mɛ.
Asɛ n Mɛɛ la waa tom mɛ laanee dɛɛ di mɛ danseɛ.
He ta o taa noɛ bwa á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ he na o siebɔr ka, he ta o waa la ɡe kpɔe do he bambile bini, dɛkalkɛ he ta nɛn waa tomɔ he be la yaradae.
He swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ kure Korowii Tɔn la, ásɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe le a ta.
Asɛ ɡɛ tɔn nɔ bini waa ɡe ɛɛ di danseɛ dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
Kɛ haa nyin kɛ he ba n be dɛ́ ba dɔ mkpa la.
Maa sɔn nyin nɛwɛnyini be.
He te, n jemɛ heyaa dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ he bambile ta Korowii waa lawɛ.
N Mɛɛ Korowii sɔn nee n ba he vɛɛh mɛ, kɛ dɛ nomɛlee fe bala o ɡbaɡba sɔn ta naa, he fe ɛɛ no o bee.
He dɛ nyin sɔn dɔŋa be, kɛ a ta wehiah ɛɛ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ hé nyin sɔn Korowii te be.
He do ken aa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona dɛ yarada mɛ nɔ?
He bɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ menee dɛ che Korowii sie dɛɛ baɡle he wechɔɡa haa ɛa.
Me laa.
Mosis haa kpɔ he hwɛɡa bwa do o nɛɛ la, on dɛɛ baɡla.
He fe yaradao waa, he fe yarada n ɡe, dɛkalkɛ onee chwerɛ n waa o tɔn bini.
Haa wola waa waa chwera yaradae nɔ, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona yarada n waɔ?”
Yeesu tɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa banue kondikwaa ba di A habɔɔ la, Yeesu le Galilia Moo baa dɛ yerɔ Tibeerias Moo la.
Belaa nɛnlaa tenten teŋɛ o nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba nao kɛ waa ɛ nyokpowaa weela tena chaeh ta ka.
Belaa Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la bwa teeh kaa bwe bɛl doa dɛ ka so bela.
Dɛ a ka tama Juu tena tɔpejen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Galekaa la tel.
Yeesu baa ha sie dɛ nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ nɛnlaa bane dɛ ba o be, asɛ dɛ bɔɔ o habɔteŋra la bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Felep la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ kondikwaa tɛ nɛndamanta nɔ bwa dɔŋa bá dio?” Yeesuu saahna bɔɔ Felep ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ daahno dɛ́ na.
Kɛ o te la, dɛ o jemɛ anɔ la waa dɛ ba ɛɛ.
Asɛ Felep ɡe ŋɔ, “Dɛ yaa dɔ suuɡa damanta kɛŋɔ denaarere lafraanɛɛ dɛ́ yawɛ paanoo kwaraa naa, bɛlbwa aa won dɔ tama tama kwaraa di.” Anee Yeesu habɔteŋra la bini bɛl waa ɛ Seemɔn Pita nime baa yerɔ Andriu la ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Bibaa bɛl lɔ ya bini bonɔ dɛ dɔ paanoo anue ne pɛŋa anɛ.
Aah ɛrɛɛ a ɡe ɛɛ ba wona ɛ nɛndamanta nɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ba bwa so harɛ.” Dɛ kpɔɡlor warɛ bela, asɛ ba so a ta.
Dɛ ba bini baala ɡbo ɛɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa banue.
Belaa Yeesu kpɔ paanoo la dɛ jam Korowii dɛ bɔne tɛ nɛnlaa la.
Gɛ tentenee o kpɔ pɛŋa la dɛ jam Korowii dɛ bɔne tɛɛ ba ja.
Asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ ɡɛ aa maɡre o ne.
Baa dia tonɛ dɛ bwa vaɡre la, o ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Hé tɔɔ anla baa dia ka la pɛ ásɛ a bɛ chɔɡ ta.” Asɛ ba tɔɔ paanoo anue la nɛnlaa la aa dia a ka la pɛ, asɛ a su wɛɡrɛre fi dɛ anɛ.
Nɛnlaa la aa na a ɡɛ nyokpowaa nɔ Yeesu aa ɛa la, ba ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Kpelaa!
Onɔɔ Korowii keame baa ŋɔa ŋɔ wɛɛ bao la.” Belaa Yeesu na kɛŋɔ nɛra la dɛ nyin kɛ ba lawɔ dɛ́ cheɡo kora kpeɡri ne ó di, asɛ o sɔh le ba bini dɛ ɡbo ka so bwe la doa ja.
Yeesu valɛ nee sie A jɔmɔra ne la, Yeesu habɔteŋra la bwa berɔ tu ba moo la nyoa, asɛ dɛ ba jo ɡbera bini, dɛ berɛ ɡale moo la dɛ fe ɛɛ kaa Kapeeneɔm.
Bɔr baa jo dɛ Yeesu ta ba be balɛ mɔɔ.
Gɛ saŋ la ɡe, dɛ peujen bɛl dɛ ta dɛɛ beɡre nee la, asɛ nehɛma tɔ o bwa.
O habɔteŋra la aa tawa dɛ kaa dɛ ɛ kwansini atoro kɛɛ anaarɛ la, ba nao kɛŋɔ Yeesu aa valɛ nee la sie dɛɛ ba ba be, asɛ ɔmee laɡ ba taeh.
Belaa waa na ɡɛ la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Menee!
He bɛ ɔmɛ!” Baa naa kɛ Yeesuu la, ba sie lɛo, asɛ ba ɡel o ba jo ɡbera la bini.
A ta biɡre bɛlbwa ba tel bela baa dɛ kaa.
Tɔ aa pera la, nɛnlaa la aa soɡe moo la nyoa la nao kɛŋɔ dɛ ɡbera beŋkpoŋ ɡboo fa cheɡɛ leebɔɔ bela.
Yeesu habɔteŋra la ɡboo jo ɡbera la bini dɛ kaa, o te ta ba nɛɛ jae.
Asɛ ɡbeni ane le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Tibeerias ta, dɛ ba leebɔɔ la ta bela nɛra la aa soɡa Yeesu kpɔ paanoo dɛ jam Korowii a waa dɛ bɔne tɛɛ ba ba di la.
Anomanta, nɛnlaa la aa naa kɛŋɔ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la bini bɛlbwa toole bela la, ba jo ɡɛ ɡbeni la bini dɛ kaa o bɔr ɡaaɡa Kapeeneɔm.
Yeesu baɡlɔ kɛ onee kondikwaa aa dɛ tɛ mkpa Nɛra la aa tel bela la, ba kaa na Yeesu kɛ waa lɔ moo la baŋ bela, asɛ dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Nomoa, saŋ besoo he ba bonɔ nɔ?” Belaa o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, paanoo la he dɛ aa dia vaɡɛ la waa hɛɛ ɡaaɡe n bɔr la.
Menɛkɛsɛ he no nyokpowaa la bɛlbwa mun.
He bɛ kondikwaa aa won chɔɡa nɔ ta dɛɛ koh.
Hɛ́ɛ koh kondikwaa aa wola chɔɡ dɛɛ tɛ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta.
Gɛ kondikwaa nɔɔ Men Nɛn Bie la ɛɛ ba heyaa tɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ menee Korowii tɛ kpeɡri kɛŋɔ kooro aa tomɛ o bie faahna ne la.” Anee ba pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ ásɛ dɛ won ɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin ɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Gɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin laanee kɛ nómɛlbwa yarada o Bibeŋkpoŋ waa tomɔ la, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo.” Asɛ ba berɛ bɔɔro ja ŋɔ, “Aah bɔkwa nyokpowaa hɛɛ ba ɛɛ ásɛ ya na dɛ yaradae nɔ?
Ɛ waane yá na.
Ya naawa fa di kondikwaa ane soo aa le nyundua baa yera maana ɡɛ saŋ baa dɛ valɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la.
Anee ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini kɛŋɔ, ‘O tɛɛ ba kondikwaa aa le nyundua ba asɛ ba di la.’ ” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, Mosis laa tɛ heyaa kondikwaa aa le nyundua la.
N Mɛɛ ɡboo won kondikwaa tenten aa le nyundua la kpɔe dɛ tɛ.
Kondikwaa la Korowii aa tɛ yaa laanee nɛn waa le o ɡbaɡba be nyundua dɛ ba mkpa ne ba tɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa la.” Anee nɛnlaa la ŋɔ, “Nomoa, tɛ yaa ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ tɔpere bɛlbwa yaa di.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Menee kondikwaa aa dɛ tɛ Korowii mkpa la.
Nomɛlbwa waa ba n be la, lɔr aa on kpo.
Asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa yarada mɛ dɛ́ kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ la, nyɔɡre ɡba aa o kpoe ba bwa.
N ŋɔ he be ŋɔ he na mɛ, kɛ he ta men yaradae dɛ kpɔ he te tɛ mɛ mɔɔ.
Nomɛlbwa n Mɛɛ Korowii aa kpɔ tɛ mɛ la ɛɛ ba n bee dɛ́ ba teŋɛ n nɛ.
Maa nomɛlbwa ɡe waa ba n be laanee doŋi ta bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba tetoowa waa laa n le nyundua ba.
Naate waa tom mɛ la tetoowa waa n ba.
N Mɛɛ Korowii waa tom mɛ la tetoowaa kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la bɛ n nɔn ta le, asɛ tɔpera bwa jaɡa wee la, ń iru seo ta.
Dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ n Mɛɛ la aa dɛ nyin laanee kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa na men maa ɛ o Bie la dɛ yarada mɛ dɛ kpɔ o te tɛ mɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ásɛ n iru seo ta, tɔpera bwa jaɡa wee.” Belaa Juu tena la ɛɛ naɡre o waa kɛŋɔ o ŋɔ onee kondikwaa tenten aa le nyundua ba la.
Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Amɔ Josef bie Yeesu la laa kɛɛ?
Ya jemɛ o nya ne o mɛɛ bwa.
Aah ɛrɛɛ o berɛ ŋɔ nyunduaa o te le ba nɔɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel n waa naɡra dɔŋa be ɡɛ.
Nomɛlbwa aa won ba n be nemenɛ n Mɛɛ la ɡbaɡba waa tom mɛ la tɛro ba n be, ásɛ tɔpera bwa jaɡa wee la, ń iru seo ta.
Ba chwerɔ do Korowii keamere tɔne bini ŋɔ, ‘Korowiirii dɛɛ ba nomɛlbwa waa baɡla.’ Anomanta, nomɛlbwa Korowii aa dɛ baɡlo o waa la asɛ wɛɛ hweli la, wɛɛ ba n bee.
A ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛl na Korowii siwi ne ka, nemenɛ men maa le o be nyundua dɛ ba la ɡbo.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, nomɛlbwa waa yarada mɛ la dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.
Menee kondikwaa waa dɛ tɛ Korowii mkpa la.
He naawa fa di kondikwaa ane soo baa yera maana aa le nyundua, kɛ ba serewɔ.
Kondikwaa nɔ maa dɛ bol o waa nɔ, nyunduaa o ɡe le, kɛ nomɛlbwa waa di a ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ soo la waa sewɛ.
Menee kondikwaa aa le nyundua ba dɛ dɔ mkpa la.
Nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ la ɛɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.
Asɛ kondikwaa maa kpɔ tɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa bá di dɛ́ dɔ mkpa laanee n bo-ol.” Belaa Juu tena la berɛ dɛɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba wona tɛ yaa o bo-ol yaa dio?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, dɛ nomɛlbwa ta Men Nɛn Bie la bo-ol dii asɛ dɛ nyɔ n chal aa, amɔ dɛ o ta mkpa la dɔe.
Nomɛlbwa waa di n bo-ol ásɛ dɛ nyɔ n chal ɡe la dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ásɛ tɔpera bwa jaɡa wee la, ń iru seo ta.
N bo-olii kondikwaa tenten, asɛ n chal ɡee nee tenten.
Nomɛlbwa waa di n bo-ol asɛ dɛ nyɔ n chal la, n ne wɛɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋii, waa wola won daɡre o te n nɛɛ kpa.
N Mɛɛ waa tom mɛ laanee mkpa dɔɔ la, anomanta, o ɡelɔ n ɡe dɔ mkpa.
Gɛɛ nomɛlbwa waa di n bo-ol la, mɛɛ ba ɡela o dɔ mkpa.
Kondikwaa aa le nyundua ba dɛɛ tɛ mkpa laanee nɔ, o ta do kɛŋɔ he naawa kondikwaa baa dɛ yera maana baa dia mkpa aa wola toole a ta ba serewe la.
Nomɛlbwa waa di kondikwaa nɔ la ɛɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.” Kapeeneɔm cheremi deaa Yeesu do dɛɛ baɡle nɛra waa dɛ bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe O habɔteŋra la aa no ɡɛ la, ba kɛrɛdɛ ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ te kpeɡri kohona to, yaa won ɛ ɡɛ.” Yeesu aa naa kɛ o habɔteŋra la dɛ naɡre a ɡɛ waa la, o pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Gɛ waa nɔ kpeɡri tɛ heyaa kɛɛ?
Dɛ he fe na Men Nɛn Bie la n berɛ dɛɛ kaa nyundua bela maa lea ba la ɡe sɛ?
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡbosoroo dɛɛ tɛ mkpa.
Nɛwɛnyini bokpeɡa te ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Waa maa dɛ bol he be nɔ dɛ ba Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ne, asɛ dɛɛ tɛ heyaa mkpa.
Kɛ he bini bane ta yaradae.” Mumpar la bwa dɛ Yeesu te jemɛ ba bini banɔ la baa wola yaradae dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo, ne naate waa leo tɛ bá kpoo la.
Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Anɔ waa n ŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa won ba n be nemenɛ n Mɛɛ Korowii leo tɛ mɛ la.” A ɡɛ waa nɔ taa a che nɛra ba fa aa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la kɛrɛdɛ le mumur dɛ ɡel o nɛɛ teŋa.
Anee o bɔɔ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la ŋɔ, “He ɡe dɛ nyin kaala kɛɛ?” Asɛ Seemɔn Pita ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, dɛ ya le he be naa, ume bee yaa ba kaala ɔ?
He wobol taa mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe do.
Ya dɛ yaradae, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee Korowii Biɡoroŋ la.” Belaa Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Menee le he nɛra fi dɛ banɛ nɔ, kɛ he bini bɛl ɛ Bɔnsam nɛn.” Dɛ Seemɔn Eskareɔt bie Judas waa wɛɛ bol la.
O habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la bɛlee, kɛ onee dɛ́ ba leo tɛ.
Yeesu ne o nimanar Anɔ habɔɔ la, dɛ Galilia harɛ ta ɡboo Yeesu do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
Dɛ waa nyin kɛ o la Juda harɛ te ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ bela nomonome la dɛ nyin o bɔr dɛ́ kpoo.
Gɛ saŋ la dɛ a ka tama Juu tena Kukure Tɔpejen ba yon dɛɛ do kukure dɛɛ so a bini tɔpera anuatoro la telo bá di.
Anee Yeesu nimanar ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Le bonɔ dɛ́ kaa Juda harɛ ta, ásɛ he habɔteŋra baa lɔ bela la ka na he nyokpowaa haa dɛ ɛ nɔ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛ nɛra jemɛ o waa la, waa o waa ɛɛ dɛɛ sɔh.
Anomanta, ɡel nɛra bwa na he we-ɛɛla nɔ.” O nimanar la ɡbabir ta on yaradae.
Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He te, tɔpere bɛlbwa wer tɛ heyaa kɛ he la bela, kɛ n te tɔpere ta tele mɔɔ.
Heyaa harɛ nɔ ta nɛra aa wola haeh, kɛ ba hah n te, dɛkalkɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa mɛɛ bol ŋɔ ba we-ɛɛla aa were.
Hé kaa ka di tɔpejen la.
Tɔpere n te aa ba bela la ta tele mɔɔ.” Waa bol ɡɛ la, o kwaarɔ so Galilia harɛ ta.
Yeesu la Kukure Tɔpejen dii bɔr Yeesu nimanar la aa kaa ɡɛ tɔpejen la dii la, a habɔɔ o ɡe ir dɛ la bela.
O kpɔ o te sɔh, o ta nɛra baah valɛ.
Dɛ Juu tena nomonome la dɛ ɡaaɡe o bɔr tɔpejen la dii ta asɛ dɛɛ pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Leperaa baa la doɔ?” Dɛ nɛnlaa la kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ŋwalɛ o wa.
Bane ŋɔ, “O ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe.” Bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Akai, nɛra ɡboo wɛɛ neɡre.” Bɛlbwa ta bolɛ asɛ a le baŋ nɛra no, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ Juu tena nomonome la.
Baa di Kukure tɔpera la tel baah ta la, Yeesu kaa jo Korowii Dea dɛ pa mun dɛɛ baɡle nɛra Korowii Wa.
O webaɡla la ɛ Juu tena la nyokpoa kohona, asɛ baa bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ ɡɛ baa nɔ won jemɛ anɔ bwa, dɛ o ta tɔnjereme ɛɛ nɔɔ?” Belaa o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Waa maa dɛ baɡle nɔ ta n ɡbaɡba be leɛ, a bwa le Korowii waa tom mɛ la be.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa sɛoh kɛ wɛɛ ɛ Korowii tetoowaa te naa, wɛɛ won jemɛ kɛŋɔ kasinteŋ waa aa le Korowii bee mɛɛ bol la.
N ɡbaɡba webaɡla laa.
Dɛ nɛn kpɔ o kpeɡri dɛɛ baɡle wa aa, o nyin sɔn dɛɛ tɛ o ɡbaɡba.
Nɛn waa nyin sɔn dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa tomɔ la te la, o waa dɔ kasinteŋ, waa nɛra neɡre.
Mosis ta heyaa Korowii Mmara la tɛɛ yaa?
Asɛ he bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Aah dɛ ɛrɛɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo nɔɔ?” Belaa nɛnlaa la bane ŋɔ, “Dɛ kpoe nɛ?
Jamɔ komɛl ɡale he sie.
Umee dɛɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo ɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Webeŋkpoŋ ɡboo n ɛ asɛ he nyoa kpo ɡɛ la.
Mosis bee he dɔ penteŋa Mmara la.
O be laa penteŋa le te, he naawaa pa a mun.
Anomanta, he won bie pen teŋa Ona Tɔpere kwaraa ta.
Dɛ he lolɛ bie o yawanyoa chiɡ Ona Tɔpere ta naa, he dɛ teŋe o pen, dɛkalkɛ haa nyin he chɔɡ Mosis Mmara la.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ te naa, ɛrɛɛ he baah berɛ di n nɛɛ kɛ maa chah nɛn Ona Tɔpere ta nɔ?
Hɛ́ɛ pese wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛɛ bola.
He bɛ ŋɔ waane aa were dɛ he ta a bini nyiŋe.” Yeesuu Kristo la kɛɛ?
Bela la, dɛ Jerusalam tena bane dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ laa baa nyin o bɔr dɛ́ kpo la kɛɛ?
Na, onee cheɡɛ nɛra baah ta dɛɛ bol waa asɛ ba bwa tɔ nyoa che la.
Nomonome ken nao kɛŋɔ onee Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la.
Akai!
Baa nɔ te, ya jemɔ dɛ jemɛ o leebɔr, kɛ Kristo la te, dɛ o balaa, nomɛlbwa aa o leebɔree jemɛ.” Dɛ Yeesu cheɡɛ Korowii Dea bela dɛɛ bol wa.
Aa ba ɡɛ la o kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “He jem mɛ dɛ jemɛ bela maa lea.
N ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ne laa n ba.
Korowii waa ɛ kasinteŋ te laanee tom mɛ.
Haa on jemɛ.
N te jemɔ, dɛkalkɛ o bee n le, on tom mɛ n ba nɔ.” Anɔ nomanta, ba fe dɛ lawɔ, asɛ ba ta wone, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o tɔpere ta tele mɔɔ.
Nɛnlaa la kɛrɛdɛ bwa yaradao, asɛ dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, “Amɔ dɛ Kristo la baa ba naa, wɛɛ won dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa kohona dɛ́ ɡwaa anɔ baa nɔ aa dɛ ɛ nɔ kenɛ?” Ba tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá ka lawɛ Yeesu Farisii tena la aa noa kɛŋɔ nɛnlaa la dɛ ŋwalɛ Yeesu waa dɔŋa be la, ba ne Sɔfonomonome la tomɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea la ŋɔ bá ka lawɔ.
Dɛ Yeesu dɛ bol ŋɔ, “Tɔpera anɛ bɛlee mɛɛ ba he be bonɔ soɡa.
Maa biɡri ásɛ dɛ berɛ kaa naate waa tom mɛ la be.
Hɛɛ baa nyin n bɔree, kɛ haa men na, dɛkalkɛ bela maa do la, haa won ba bela.” Anee Juu tena nomonome la bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Amɔ leperaa baa nɔ ɛɛ nyin kaala ásɛ yaa wola on ba na kpa nɔɔ?
O ken ɛɛ kaa Juu tena baa jo pua ka so Grik tena harɛ ta la bee, dɛ́ kaa chaɡle Grik tena o waa la kɛɛ?
O ŋɔ, yaa ba nyin o bɔree kɛ yaa on na, bela waa dɛ kaa ɡe la, bɛlbwa aa won ba o be.
Aah dɛ ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ chaɡle nɔɔ?” Ba Kukure tɔpera la dii ta tɔpere waa baa ka mun dɛ ɛ tɔpejen tenten la, Yeesu iro che dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpoo la, ó ba n be ń tɛo nee ó nyɔ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada mɛ la, mɛɛ ɛo ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa baɡla laanee.
Dɛ, ‘Nee waa dɔ mkpa la ɛɛ dɛɛ le o nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa kɛŋɔ moo aa dɛ palɛ la.’ ” Nee nɔ waa bol o waa nɔ, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa ba kpɔ do nɛra baa yaradao la nɛɛ la waa o bol la.
Gɛ saŋ la dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ta balɛ mɔɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Yeesu ta o jirima dɔe mɔɔ.
Nɛnlaa la bini bane no o waa waa bola la, dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii keame laanee baa nɔ kpela.” Bane ŋɔ, “Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa laanee.” Asɛ bane ɡe tɔŋle ŋɔ, “Galilia harɛ taa Kristo la ɛɛ ba lee ba naa?
Korowii Tɔn ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ Kristo la ɛɛ ɛ Devid naanar la bɛlee dɛ le o bwɛɛ Bɛtlɛham aa?” Anomanta, nyopɛo ta ba bini balɛ kpa, Yeesu ɡbosoroo wa.
Asɛ bane ɛɛ nyin dɛ́ lawɔ, kɛ nomɛlbwa ta wone kpɔ nɔn leɡo.
Juda nomonome yarada bɛ dɔe Belaa nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea la berɛ kaa Sɔfonomonome ne Farisii tena la be dɛ ka bol, asɛ ba ɡe bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ta on lawɛ ba nɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Baa la waa waa dɛ bol la, nomɛlbwa ta o wobol dɔŋa bolɛ bwa.” Asɛ Farisii tena la berɛ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Jamɔ o wono neɡre he ɡe kɛɛ?
He na ya nomonome nɔ bini bɛl kɛŋɔ waa dɛ yaradao wa aa?
Kɛɛ he na Farisii tena la bɛl kɛ waa dɛ yaradao?
A ɡɛ nɛnlaa nɔ te la, baa Mosis Mmara la jemɛ.
Dɛ Korowii nyotaahna laɡ ba.” Belaa Nikodeemɔs waa ɛ Farisii te dɛ faa la Yeesu be ka la bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Mosis Mmara ta, yaa wonoo pa nɛn bolchɔɡe dɛ ya ta on yerɛ dɛ bɔɔro dɛ jemɛ waa waa ɛa mɔɔ naa?” Anee ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Jamɔ he ɡe le Galilia harɛ kɛɛ?
Dɛ he pese Korowii Tɔn la bini dɛ na naa, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ Korowii keame aa Galilia harɛ taa le ba bwa.” Belaa ba bwa ir kaa ba deremi.
Haah baa lawɔ jwamane bɔe ta wa Asɛ Yeesu kaa Ɔlevere Bwejen la ta.
Bɔr aa dɛ chaah chɔmbibi la, o berɛ kaa Korowii Dea.
Belaa nɛnlaa ba o be dɛ ba baro cheme, asɛ o so harɛ dɛɛ chaɡ ba Korowii Wa.
Asɛ Tɔnjerema ne Farisii tena lawɛ haah bɛl waa dɛ bɔ jwamane dɛ ba o ne Yeesu be, dɛ ɡel o ba che ba bwa baah ta.
Asɛ ba ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya lawɛ haah nɔ dɛ o ne baa bɛl waa wola o jaa ɛɛ chɔɔ.
Mosis Mmara dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ haah waa do ken la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá foɡro bwea kpo.
Amɔ taraken ɛrɛɛ he ɡe ŋɔɔ?” Ba pɛɛro ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ́ kpɔ daahno na kɛŋɔ wɛɛ bol waanee ásɛ ba fee dɔ o nyoa lawɛ.
Belaa Yeesu joŋi asɛ dɛ kpɔ o nonii dɛɛ chwerɛ harɛ.
Ba taa cheɡa dɛɛ pɛɛro waa ɡɛ la, o iro che asɛ dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé bini bɛlbwa waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ bwa la, ó tɔ sie ta bwe forɔ.” Asɛ dɛ berɛ kwaa joŋi dɛɛ chwerɛ harɛ ja.
Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, bɛlbwa lii o wechɔɡa waa ɛa.
Bɛlbwa ta wone kpɔ kon forɔ kpa, dɛ bwa peɡre.
Ba nomonomee tɔ sie dɛ kaa beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa a ba tel bechale nɛɛ dɛ ba tonɛ, a ba ka Yeesu ne haah la o ta che bela ɡɛ.
Asɛ Yeesu ir che, dɛ pɛɛ haah la ŋɔ, “Leperaa ba kaalɔ?
Ba bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ pae bolchɔɡe kpa aa?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n Dɔɔ, bɛlbwa toole.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Ate, n ɡe aa hen bolchɔɡee pa kpa.
Kaa, kɛ bɛ wechɔɡa ka ɛ kpa.” Yeesu ɛ harɛ nɔ ta kandea Yeesu bol waa baɡle Farisii tena la ja, dɛ ŋɔ, “N ɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah harɛ nɔ ta nɛra.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ la aa biro taa valɛ bwa, wɛɛ valɛ bochaah taa dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.” Belaa Farisii tena la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Henee bol he waa dɛ ɡbaɡba berɛ di he te danseɛ, anomanta, nyosonee hɛɛ teŋe.” Anee o ŋɔ, “Akai.
A lole kɛ n dɛ di n ɡbaɡba danseɛ te, kɛ kasinteŋii mɛɛ bol, dɛkalkɛ n jemɛ bela maa lea ne bela maa dɛ kaa.
Haa n leebɔr ne n kaabɔr jemɛ.
Harɛ nɔ ta liiree he kpɔ nyiŋi nɛn dɛɛ bol wa, kɛ n te aa bole pa. Dɛ mɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ kwaraa yaa, mɛɛ ɛa á toɡre, dɛkalkɛ n ɡbo laa, n Mɛɛ waa tom mɛ la ja n nɛ.
He mmarare la dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ webeŋkpoŋ nɛra banɛ bwa aa bol la ɛ kpela.
N ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ di n te danseɛ, asɛ n Mɛɛ la waa tom mɛ la ɡe ɛ danseɛ dɛ ja n nɛɛ wobɛlbwa maa dɛ ɛ ta.” Asɛ ba pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Leperaa he mɛɛ nɔ doɔ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa wola men jemɛ nɔ, ɡɛɛ haa wola n Mɛɛ la ɡe jemɛ,” dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he fe jem mɛ naa, he fe jemɛ n Mɛɛ la ɡe.” Korowii Dea suuɡa tae dakare bɔr belaa Yeesu do dɛɛ baɡle waa dɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Bɛlbwa ta wone lawɔ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o tɔpere ta tele mɔɔ.
Yeesu ŋɔ, haa won la bela maa dɛ kaa Asɛ Yeesu berɛ bol waa baɡle nɛra la ja ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ba kaaloo he ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin n bɔr, kɛ haa men na.
He wechɔɡa taa hɛɛ ba sewa.
Bela maa kaa la, haa won ba bela.” Anee Juu tena nomonome la bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “O ŋɔ yaa won la bela waa dɛ kaa!
Jamɔ wɛɛ kpo o tenee kɛɛ?” Belaa Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Harɛ nɔ ta nɛraa heya, asɛ n ɡe le nyundua.
He le harɛ nɔ ta, kɛ n te, harɛ nɔ ta laa n le.
A waa n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, hɛɛ sewɛ he wechɔɡa taa la.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa ta men yaradae kɛŋɔ Menee Men te naa, hɛɛ sewɛ he wechɔɡa taa.” Belaa ba bɔɔro ja ŋɔ, “Henee ume o?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Anee n ŋɔ he be chɔɔ bwa la.
N fe dɔ he waa dɛ bol kohona he di bolchɔɡe a ta, kɛ maa bol.
Naate waa tom mɛ la waa dɔ kasinteŋ nomanta, n wobɛlbwa maa bol nɛra be la ɛ waa aa le o be.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, ba ta o waa la mun noɛ kɛŋɔ o Mɛɛ Korowii waa wɛɛ bol.
Anomanta, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Awola haa ɡɔɔ Men Nɛn Bie nyundua la, belaa hɛɛ ba n nae kɛŋɔ Menee Men kpela, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ne laa mɛɛ ɛ wa, kɛ anɔ la n Mɛɛ la aa ŋɔ n be laanee mɛɛ bol.
Naate waa tom mɛ la ja n nɛ, o ta men tae, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ɛ anɔ la aa dɛ too o tea.” Nɛra baa no Yeesu waa la kɛrɛdɛ yaradao.
Kasinteŋ jema ɛɛ ɡeloo ya dɔ ya te Asɛ o ŋɔ Juu tena baa yaradao la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ɡelɔ n waa maa baɡle heyaa la do he bambile bini hɛɛ teŋɛ a ta te naa, dɛ he ɛ n habɔteŋra kpela, dɛ won jemɛ kasinteŋ la, asɛ kasinteŋ la ɡel he dɔ he te.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Abraham naanaree ya te, nomɛlbwa nɛndɔɔla laa yan.
Aah, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ yaa dɔ ya tenee yaa wola nɛndɔɔlaa ɛ kpa nɔɔ?” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la ɛ yom.
Wechɔɡa yawɔ yom.
Yom aa o dɔɔ deemii do ka tonɛ, kɛ dem te bie te ɛɛ do dem belaa saŋ bɛlbwa.
Anomanta, dɛ men Korowii Bie la lɛ heyaa dɛ ɡel he dɔ he te naa, amɔ te dɛ he dɔ he te kɛrɛdɛ.
N ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ he ɛ Abraham naanar, kɛ he berɔ dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo, dɛkalkɛ haa n webaɡla yarada.
Waa n Mɛɛ aa baɡ mɛɛ mɛɛ bol he be la, asɛ he ɡe ɛɛ ɛ anɔ la he mɛɛ aa bola he no.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Ya mɛɛɛ Abraham.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “Dɛ Abraham bii tentenee heya aa, he fe dɛ ɛ o we-ɛɛla siwi.
N waa maa dɛ bol saŋ bɛlbwa la ɛ kasinteŋ waa maa noa le Korowii be, kɛ he dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo.
Gɛɛ Abraham ɛ aa?
He ɡe mɛɛ toma siwii hɛɛ ɛ la.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Nyoasɛm bii laa yan oo, Korowii ɡboo ya Mɛɛ.” Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he Mɛɛ Korowii kpela aa, he fe dɛ nyin n wa, dɛkalkɛ o bee n le ba, dɛ do bonɔ taraken nɔ.
N ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ne laa n ba, onee tom mɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ haa wola n waa mun no nɔɔ?
Haa wola nyin kɛ he teŋɛ a ta la waa.
Bɔnsam biirii heya.
Waa waa dɛ nyin ɛɛ laanee he ɡee nyin ɛɛ.
Chɔɔ bwaa o le nɛŋkpoa we-ɛɛla ne, waa kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ kpɔ nemenɛ nyosone ɡbo.
O ŋɔ o bol wa aa, nyosone ɡboo wɛɛ teŋe, dɛkalkɛ o daa.
O ɛ nyosonteŋni, asɛ nyosone bwa kooroo on.
Kɛ n te maa dɛ bol kasinteŋ la waa haa wola men yarada la.
He bini umee dɛ́ won chaɡle kɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa kaɔ?
Aah dɛ n dɛ bol kasinteŋ aa, ɛrɛɛ haa wola men yarada ɔ?
Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ Korowii bie la dɛ no o wa.
Haa wola o bii ɛɛ la waa haa wola o waa nyin dɛ́ no la.” Gɛ Yeesu aa baɡle o nɛnsoo Belaa Juu tena la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Nyosonee yaa teŋe kɛ yaa ŋɔa ŋɔ, he ɛ Samaria te kwa ɛɛ ir he nɛɛ la aa?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Kwa aa n nɛɛ ir, n Mɛɛ sɔnee mɛɛ kwaa, asɛ he te ɛɛ chɔɡ mɛ.
Sɔn laa mɛɛ nyin.
Nɛn waa nyin sɔn dɛɛ tɛ mɛ la lole.
Onee dɛ́ ba pa nomɛlbwa bole.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, nomɛlbwa waa no n waa nɔ dɛ teŋɛ a ta la aa sewɛ bwa.” Anee Juu tena la ŋɔ, “Ya ta ŋɔe yaa?
Kwaa dɛ ir o nɛ.
Ya nabaa Abraham ne Korowii keamere la ɡba serewɔ, ɡɛɛ he te ŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa no he waa nɔ dɛ́ teŋɛ a ta la aa sewɛ bwa naa?
He ɡwaa ya nabaa Abraham waa sewa la kɛɛ?
Korowii keamere la ɡe serewɔ.
Aah dɛ ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii he te nɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “N ɡbaɡba dɛ nyin sɔn aa, a ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ, kɛ n Mɛɛ la haa dɛ bol o waa ŋɔ onee Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɛɛ tɛ mɛ sɔn.
Haa on jemɛ, kɛ n te jemɔ.
Dɛ n ŋɔ maa on jemaa, dɛ n ɛ nyosonteŋni kɛ heya.
N jemɔ asɛ dɛɛ no o deŋna wa.
He nabaa Abraham sie lɛo wɛɛ tamane n bala wa.
O nao o baah sɔɔhno.” Asɛ ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He ta bene fifraanue ɡba dii mɔɔ, ɡɛɛ he na Abraham aa?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, baa wola Abraham lolɛ mɔɔ la dɛ n lole.” Belaa ba pa bwea ŋɔ ba dɛ foɡro, asɛ o sɔh dɛ le Korowii Dea bela kaa.
Yeesu chah baa bɛl baa lolɔ nyoŋe Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra aa dɛ valɛ la, o na baa bɛl baa lolɔ nyoŋe.
Belaa o habɔteŋra la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Nomoa, baa nɔ ne o nya ne o mɛɛ, ba bini ume wechɔɡaa ba nyoŋa nɔ ne nɔɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ ne o lolanar bini bɛlbwa wechɔɡa be laa a le.
Gɛ aa ɛ Korowii chaɡle o kpeɡri o nɛɛ waa a ba ɡɛ la.
A wer kɛŋɔ bɔr aa chaahna nɔ, ya swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ Naate waa tom mɛ la toma, dɛkalkɛ bɔr dɛ ba bira nomɛlbwa aa wola won ɛ toma bɛlbwa kpa.
N taa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bonɔ nɔ, menee kandea dɛɛ chaah nɛra bwa.” Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o ta nentane ta harɛ dɛ teɡɛ a ne teera, dɛ kpɔ fɔɡɛ baa la sie.
Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “La tam la baa dɛ yerɔ Siloam la ta dɛ́ ka samɛ he sie.” Gɛ sɔn Siloam la munii kɛŋɔ “Ba tomɔ.” Waa laŋa dɛ ka samɛ o sie la tonɛ la, dɛ o dɛ na, dɛ berɛ ba buse.
Belaa o bala ne nɛra ba fa aa nao ka kɛ o fa nyoŋɔ dɛɛ soŋe kwaa la ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ laa fa yon so dɛɛ soŋe kwaa la aa?” Bane ŋɔ, “Onee,” asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Akai, o laa, lee wɛɛ leo.” Asɛ baa la ɡe ɡbaɡba ŋɔ, “Menee!” Anee ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ a ɛ he berɛ won dɛɛ na nɔɔ?” Belaa o ŋɔ, “Baa la baa dɛ yerɔ Yeesu laanee ta nentane dɛ teɡɛ a ne teera pɛ dɛ kpɔ fɔɡɛ n sie, dɛ ŋɔ ń la Siloam ta dɛ ka samɛ ta.
Asɛ maa laŋa dɛ ka samɛ la, buɡ la ta, mɛɛ na la.” Anee ba pɛɛro ja ŋɔ, “Leperaa o dɔɔ?” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Maa jemɛ bela waa lole.” Farisii tena wepɛɛre Belaa ba lawɛ baa la o fa aa nyoŋa la dɛ kaa o ne Farisii tena sie.
Dɛ tɔpere Yeesu aa teɡɛ nentane pɛ teera ta dɛ kpɔ chaoh la ɛ Ona Tɔpere.
Belaa Farisii tena la berɛ pɛɛro ɡɛ aa ɛa asɛ o won dɛɛ na.
Anee o ŋɔ, “Kpechɛɡree o kpɔ maa n sie asɛ n samɛ ta taraken dɛ won dɛɛ na la.” Asɛ Farisii tena la bane ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ ta Korowii be leɛ, dɛkalkɛ o chɔɡ Ona Tɔpere.” Bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɛɛ ba wona ɛ nyokpowaa nɔ dɔŋa baa nɔ aa ɛa nɔɔ?” A cheɡɛ a ta ba nyoa ta pɛɛ kpa.
Asɛ Farisii tena la berɛ pɛɛ baa la ja ŋɔ, “He ŋɔ o chaeh dɛ ɡel hɛɛ na bɔr, taraken nɔ, ɛrɛɛ he na o waɔ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Korowii keamee on.” Dɛ Juu tena nomonome la te dɛ tɔŋle ŋɔ, ba fe aa yarada kɛŋɔ o fa nyoŋɔ ka asɛ dɛ berɛ dɛɛ na, nemenɛ baa na o nya ne o mɛɛ mɔɔ.
Ba yer ba dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He bie nɔ naa?
He ŋɔ haa lolɔ dɛ o nyoŋɔ ɛ?
Aah ɛrɛɛ a ɛ asɛ o berɛ won dɛɛ na nɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Ya jemɔ kɛ ya biee.
Yaa lolɔ dɛ o nyoŋɔ.
Kɛ yaa ɡɛ aa ɛa asɛ wɛɛ na ne naate waa ɡela wɛɛ na te waa jemɛ.
Amɔ hé pɛɛ o ɡbaɡba na nɔ, dɛkalkɛ o kpeɡo dɛ́ won bol wa.” Dɛ Juu tena nomonome laanee baa ɔmɛ waa ba ŋɔ ɡɛ.
Nomonome la ɛ nyoa beŋkpoŋ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔ Yeesu ɛ Kristo la, baa doŋi naatee o bɛ ba cheremi dea jo kpa.
A waa o nya ne o mɛɛ ŋɔ o kpeɡo ŋɔ bá pɛɛro la.
Ba berɔ yerɛ baa la o fa aa nyoŋa la nɛɛtena, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi Korowii dɛ bol kasinteŋ.
Ya te jemɔ kɛ baa nɔ waa chaeh nɔ ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ.” Belaa o ŋɔ, “Dɛ o ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ne o ta ɛɛ yoo, n te aa jemɛ.
Webeŋkpoŋ maa jema laanee kɛ, n fa nyoŋɔ asɛ taraken dɛ berɛ dɛɛ na.” Anee ba berɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Aah ɛrɛɛ o ɛɛ nɔ?
Bɔkwa waa o ɛ dɛ won pili he sie nɔɔ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “N fa aa bol he be wubwa la, he vɛh noe.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń bol jaɔ?
He ɡe dɛ nyin he ɛ o habɔteŋra kɛɛ?” Belaa ba chɛɡro kohona, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Henee o habɔteŋre!
Ya te, Mosis habɔteŋraa yan.
Gɛ yaa jema laanee kɛ Korowii bol waa dɛ baɡle Mosis, kɛ baa nɔ te, yaa o leebɔr jemɛ.” Asɛ baa la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa nɔɔ?
Heyaa ŋɔa haa o leebɔr jemɛ, kɛ o ɡelɔ n te won dɛɛ na.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii deŋna toole wechɔɡ-ɛɛra be.
O deŋna lɔ banɔ la baa dɛ duuru dɛɛ ɛ waa waa dɛ nyin la be.
Le harɛ mumpar bwa, umee noa kɛŋɔ nomɛl wono pili nɛn baa lolɔ dɛ o nyoŋɔ sie bwa nɔ?
Dɛ Korowii be laa baa nɔ le ba naa, o fe aa won ɛ waa nɔ dɔŋa.” Anee ba ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He ne he wechɔɡaa ba lolɛ.
Gɛɛ he ŋɔ hé chaɡle yaa wa aa?” Asɛ ba doŋu cheremi dea bela bala kwara.
Korowii Doma bini nyoŋa wa Yeesu aa noa kɛŋɔ ba doŋu cheremi dea bala la, o nyin o bɔr asɛ dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “He dɛ yarada Men Nɛn Bie la aa?” Asɛ o pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Nomoa, umee naate ásɛ he chaɡ mɛ n jemɔ dɛ́ yaradao wɔ?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Naatee he den na la, o ne henee dɛɛ bol waa la.” Belaa baa la ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, n dɛ yaradae!” Asɛ dɛ ɡuŋi o sie dɛ tɛo duure.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole waa n ba harɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ nyoŋa berɛ dɛɛ na, ásɛ banɔ la ɡe baa dɛ na la berɛ nyoŋa.” Dɛ Farisii tena bane lɔ bela.
Baa no ɡɛ la, ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Amɔ ya ɡe ɛ nyoŋa kɛɛ?” Anee Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ he fe sɛoh kɛŋɔ he ɛ nyoŋa kwaraa naa, wechɔɡa fe toole he nɛ, kɛ haa ŋɔa he dɛ na nomanta, he ta lɔ wechɔɡa ta.”
Peteɡre bɛl sɛɡla Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, dɛ nomɛlbwa jo peera leɡ bini, dɛ o ta doonyoa cheɡɛ jo dɛ ka che baŋ bɛl dɛ teeh jo a be naa, dɛ ŋwɛɛree on.
Kɛ peteɡre waa dɛ teɡɛ peera la te, doonyoaa o che dɛɛ jo a be.
Dɛ o balaa, onee naate waa dɛ daah doonyoa la ɛɛ ba pila tɛ o dɔ bɔr jo a be.
Peera la ɛɛ no o taa, ásɛ o yerɛ anla aa ɛ o kwaa la sɔna á teŋɛ o nɛɛ ó le a ne kaa.
O le o ɡbaɡba kwaa la ne naa, o dɛ tɔ a sie ásɛ a teŋɛ o nɛ, dɛkalkɛ a jemɛ o taa.
Aa nɛŋhɔɔh nɛɛ teŋɛ bwa.
Aa chwao, dɛkalkɛ aa nɛŋhɔɔhra taa jemɛ.” Sɛɡlaa o kpɔ dɛ baɡ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ, kɛ ba ta a mun noɛ.
Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ ba be ja ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, n do kɛŋɔ peera leɡ doonyoa la.
Nɛra baa tɔ n sie dɛ ba la bwa, peera la ta deŋne ba be doe, dɛkalkɛ ba ɛ ŋwɛɛra.
Menee doonyoa la, ɡɛ peera aa cheɡɛ doonyoa dɛ jo dɛɛ le, dɛ dɔ kwaa dɛɛ di la, ɡɛɛ nomɛlbwa waa yarada mɛ la ɛɛ ba mkpa dɔe.
Ŋwɛɛ balaa, o balɔ dɛ́ ba ŋwɛ dɛ́ kpo dɛ́ chɔɡ kwa.
Wedɛɛɡa waa laa wɛɛ ba.
Kɛ n te balɔ dɛ ba tɛ heyaa mkpa ásɛ he dɔɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Menee Peteɡredɛɛɡe la.
Dɛ seo kwaraa yaa, mɛɛ kpɔ n nyuu charɛ n peera.
Nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi peera ta dɛɛ lɛ suuɡa la, o ta do kɛ peteɡre peera la aa ɛ o kwa.
Paa te la na ɡbolo bala aa, wɛɛ chwao ɡela, ásɛ o jo a bini dɛ́ lawɛ ane, dɛ́ lɔ a kar peɡre.
Wɛɛ chwao ɡela, dɛkalkɛ o ɡbabir kwaa laa, o waane laa a wa.
O kembɔr ɡbo waa wɛɛ ɛ. Menee Peteɡredɛɛɡe la.
Gɛ maa jemɛ n peera la, ɡɛɛ a ɡe jem mɛ, kɛŋɔ n Mɛɛ aa jem mɛ asɛ n ɡe jemɔ la.
Dɛ seo kwaraa yaa, mɛɛ kpɔ n nyuu charɛ dɛ lɛa.
N peera ane ta lɔ leɡa ane bini.
Mɛɛ nyin a ɡe bɔree dɛ́ tɔ a sie dɛ́ kpɔa ba ja anɔ ta, ásɛ aa no n taa dɛ́ bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ pɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛ.
Maa sɛah kɛŋɔ mɛɛ koh n peera waa dɛ́ sewɛ dɛ́ berɛ ir seo ta la nomanta, n Mɛɛ la dɛ nyin mɛ taeh.
Lao seo laa mɛɛ ba sewa nɔ.
N tetoosewee mɛɛ ba sewa.
N dɔ kpeɡri kɛ ń kpɔ n te tɛ dɛ́ sewɛ, dɛ́ berɛ dɔ kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ń ir seo ta.
Gɛɛ n Mɛɛ ŋɔ ń ba ɛ.” Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ la, Juu tena la nyoa ta pɛɛ baa tɔŋle dɔŋa ja.
Asɛ ba bini kɛrɛdɛ bwa ŋɔ, “Komɛlee ɡale o sie ta le!
O nyu toole!
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ do deŋne onɔ ɡe be dɛɛ no o waa nɔɔ?” Ba bini bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Dɛ komɛl ɡale nɛn sie aa, wɛɛ won dɛɛ bol waa ken aa?
Choɡla te ɛɛ won chah nyoŋe wɛɛ na naa?” Juu tena vɛh Yeesu Dɛ alalawo saŋee, asɛ baa di tɔpejen bɛl ba kpɔ Korowii Dea dɛɛ do o nɔn ta Jerusalam.
Dɛ Yeesu dɛ valɛ Korowii Dea doonyoa bela baa dɛ yerɔ Solomɔn Doonyoa la, asɛ Juu tena ba baro cheme dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ta ɡel yaa ɛ he waa aahna aahna ken nɔɔ?
Dɛ henee Kristo la aa, den ɡel ya jemɛ.” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ŋɔ he be wubwa, kɛ haa men yarada.
N we-ɛɛla bwa maa ɛa la, n Mɛɛ la kpeɡri nee mɛɛ ɛa asɛ aa di mɛ danseɛ.
Haa wola n peera ɛɛ waa haa wola men yarada la.
N peera dɛ no n taa, asɛ n jema aa teŋɛ n nɛ, asɛ mɛɛ tɛa mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Aa sewɛ bwa ɡe.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe aa won toa le n nɔn ta.
N Mɛɛ la waa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la kpeɡri ɡwaa komɛlbwa kpeɡri, anomanta, nomɛlbwa aa won toa le o nɔn ta.
N ne n Mɛɛ la bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.” Belaa Juu tena la pa bwea ja ŋɔ baa foɡroo kpo.
Asɛ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N baa ɛ wedɛɛɡa kohona n Mɛɛ la kpeɡri ne he bwa siwi ta asɛ he na.
Aah dɛ wedɛɛɡa nɔ bini ame waa hɛɛ ba men bwea foɡra nɔɔ?” Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “He wedɛɛɡa te ɛɛ waa laa yaa ba he kpoe nɔ, kɛ he musu waa haa dɛ bol la waa.
Nɛwɛnyinii hen, kɛ he berɔ dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he ɛ Korowii.” Yeesu chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘He bɛlbwa do kɛ Korowii.’ He ta kure no kɛɛ?
Dɛ o yerɛ nɛra waa kpɔ o waa la baɡle la Korowii aa, dɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ waa yaa wola won vɛh, dɛ men n Mɛɛ Korowii aa lee mɛ dɛ tom mɛ harɛ nɔ ta la ŋɔ Korowii Biee men aa, ɛrɛɛ he ŋɔ n dɛ bol musu waa nɔɔ?
Dɛ maa n Mɛɛ la we-ɛɛla ɛ te naa, he bɛ men yarada.
Kɛ dɛ n dɛ ɛ o we-ɛɛla aa ɛ nyokpowaa te, dɛ haa men yarada kwaraa naa, hé yarada o nyokpowaa la te, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ kɛ n ne o ɛ beŋkpoŋ bɛlbwa aa wola won daɡre o te o dɔŋ nɛ.” Bela la, dɛ ba fe dɛ nyin Yeesu dɛ́ lawɔ ja, asɛ o laa o te kpɔ fɛmm dɛ kaa.
Yeesu le Jɔɔdan Moo la ja dɛ kaa o baŋ bela Jɔn faa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la, dɛ ka so bela.
Nɛra ba o be pirim asɛ dɛ baa bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Jɔn ta nyokpowaa bɛlbwa ɛɛ, kɛ baa nɔ bwara waa Jɔn aa baɡla la bwa ɛ kpela.” Bela la, nɛra yarada Yeesu pirim.
Lasorɔs seo wa Baa bɛlee fa lole baa yerɔ Lasorɔs.
Dɛ o bwara dɛ weo.
Bwɛɛ waa lɔ o ta sɔne Bɛtani.
Dɛ ɡɛ bwɛɛ nɔ taa Mɛɛre ne o nahaah Maata ɡe do.
A ɡɛ Mɛɛre nɔɔ fa fuɡe nosɔɔhsoma ɛ Yeesu nakpale dɛ kpɔ o nyumpona feera la.
O nimambiee Lasorɔs o bwara aa dɛ weo nɔ.
Asɛ o nimambii la tomɛ nɛra ba ka ŋɔ Yeesu be ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, he dandɛɛɡe la bwara dɛ weo.” Yeesu aa no ɡɛ la, belaa o ŋɔ, “Serewe weela laa wɛɛ we nɔ.
Gɛ aa ɛ Korowii dɔ jirima ásɛ a che a ta Korowii Bie la ɡe dɔ jirima waa a ba ɡɛ.” Dɛ Yeesu dɛ nyin Maata ne Mɛɛre ne Lasorɔs bwa taeh.
Kɛ waa no Lasorɔs weela waa la, o soɡe bela tɔpera anɛ mɔɔ.
A habɔɔ la, o ŋɔ o habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya berɛ kaa Juda harɛ ta.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, he laa baah bɛl ta bela tena fe ɛɛ nyini dɛ́ foɡre bwea kpo la kɛɛ, ɡɛɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin bela laŋa taraken ja aa?” Anee o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Le chɔɔ wee aa le ka tel jɔmɔra wee aa jo la, dɔŋhwere fi dɛ anɛ laa aa?
Dɛ bɔr chaahnɔ nɛn ɛɛ valaa, waa naa lɔ bwa, dɛkalkɛ wee leɔ bɔr chaah.
Kɛ dɛ nɛn dɛ valɛ biro ta naa, anee wɛɛ lɔ na, dɛkalkɛ o ta kon dɔe wɛɛ chaahno bɔr.
Korowiirii wola o sie chaahnɛ la.” Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o berɔ ŋɔ, “Domii ya dam Lasorɔs chɔ, anomanta, mɛɛ lao dɛ́ ka chumu.” Belaa o habɔteŋra la chaŋo ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, dɛ domii o chɔ te naa, wɛɛ iruu dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa.” Dɛ Lasorɔs seo waa wɛɛ bol ba be, asɛ ba ɡe ta a mun noɛ dɛɛ lii o dom chɔe waa la.
Belaa Yeesu pili a bini chasee ŋɔ, “Lasorɔs sewɔ.
Kɛ he nomanta, a do n som kɛ maa wola toole bela o sewɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ an dɛ́ ɡel he yarada mɛ.
Hé ir yá kaa o be bela!” Belaa Tɔmas baa dɛ yerɔ Didimas la ŋɔ o bala Yeesu habɔteŋra la be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya pu nomoa ásɛ ya ne o bwa kaa, dɛ seo kwaraa yaa, yá ne ó sewɛ.” Yeesuu dɛɛ chum nɛra seo ta dɛɛ tɛ mkpa Baa tel bela la, Yeesu noɔ kɛŋɔ Lasorɔs sewɔ ba huɡo o dɔ tɔpera anaarɛ.
Bɛtani ne Jerusalam baah ɛɛ ɛ kwansini anɛɛ.
Asɛ Juu tena warɛ dɛ ba Maata ne Mɛɛre be dɛ baa bwɛɛ ba ba nimambie la seo wa.
Maata aa noa kɛŋɔ Yeesu dɛ ba la, o leɔ dɛ ka chemo, asɛ Mɛɛre te ta so dem.
Maata aa chemo la, o ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, he fe lɔ bonɔ naa, n nimambie nɔ fe ta sewɛ nɔ.
Kɛ n jemɔ kɛŋɔ taraken kwara, komɛlbwa haa soŋe Korowii la, wɛɛ ɛo tɛɛ.” Belaa o chaŋo ŋɔ, “He nimambie la ɛɛ ir seo taa dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.” Anee Maata ŋɔ, “N jemɔ kɛ tɔpera bwa jaɡa wee la lala bwa aa ir seo ta la, o ɡee iruu.” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Menee dɛɛ chum nɛra seo ta, menee dɛɛ tɛɛ ba mkpa.
Nomɛlbwa waa yarada mɛ la, dɛ o sewɔ kwaraa naa, wɛɛ dɔ mkpaa.
Asɛ nomɛlbwa waa soɡe le dɛɛ yarada mɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ mkpaa, waa sewɛ bwa.
He dɛ yarada ɡɛ waa nɔ naa?” Anee o sɛh ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n Dɔɔ, n yaradao kɛŋɔ henee Korowii Bie Kristo baa bola ŋɔ wɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ taa la.” Yeesu aa wia wa Maata aa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o berɔ la dem dɛ ka sɔh bol Mɛɛre be ŋɔ, “Nomoa la balɔ dɛɛ pɛɛ he wa.” Mɛɛre aa no ɡɛ la, o iro warane asɛ dɛɛ kaa o be.
Dɛ Yeesu ta bwɛɛ bini joɛ mɔɔ.
Dɛ o ta lɔ bela Maata aa baa chemo la.
Juu tena bane baa lɔ Mɛɛre be dem bela dɛɛ larawe o bwara la aa naa kɛŋɔ o iro dɛ ɛ warane le buse la, ba ɡe iro teŋɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ o ken dɛ kaa bela baa bil o nimambie la ka wi.
Mɛɛre aa tel bela Yeesu aa lole asɛ dɛ nao la, o kaa ɡuŋi o sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he fe lɔ bonɔ naa, n nimambie nɔ fe ta sewɛ nɔ.” Yeesu aa na ɡɛ waa dɛ wi asɛ Juu tena baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ la ɡe ɛɛ wi la, o loo kuu asɛ chal valɛ o bwara bini.
Belaa o pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Leperaa he bilu wɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, ba dɛ́ ba na.” Yeesu wio.
Asɛ Juu tena la ɛɛ bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Hé na nyina waa dɛ nyinu dɛɛ wi ɡɛ!” Bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ laa wona ɡel nyoŋe na la aa?
Dɛ o lɔ bonɔ naa, o fe ta wone chah onɔ o fe bɛ sewaa?” Yeesu ir Lasorɔs seo ta Belaa Yeesu loo ku, chal valɛ o bwara bini ja, asɛ ba la bela Lasorɔs aa chɔa la.
O bɔɔ la, bwee ba komɛ dɛ ɡbili bwe tɔ o nyoa.
Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé laa bwe la ɡbili le bɔɔ la nyoa.” Belaa Maata waa ɛ Lasorɔs nimambie la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ.
“N Dɔɔ, taraken o ken ka chɔɡɔ dɛ do sɔɔh, dɛkalkɛ o tɔpera anaarɛɛ la.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ dɛ he yarada mɛ naa, hɛɛ na ɡɛ Korowii aa dɔ jirimaa yaa?” Ba laa bwe la ɡbili le bɔɔ la nyoa, asɛ Yeesu ha sie nyundua dɛ ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, n dɛ jaame kɛ haa dɛ no n wa.
N te jemɔ kɛ tɔpere bwaa hɛɛ no n wa.
Nɛra baa ja n nɛɛ bonɔ nɔ waa mɛɛ bol ɡɛ, ásɛ ba won jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee tom mɛ la.” Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ yerɛ lale la ŋɔ, “Lasorɔs, le ba!” Asɛ o ir dɛ le bɔɔ la bini.
Dɛ yal baa kpɔa vɔrɔwe o nakpale ne o nɔɔra la ta vɔwɔ ɡɛ, asɛ botire ɡe vɔwɛ o nyu.
Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé pur laala la bwa ásɛ o kaa.” Yeesu kpoe vɔrɔwa Juu tena la baa ba Mɛɛre be la aa na ɡɛ waa nɔ Yeesu aa ɛa la, ba kɛrɛdɛ yaradao.
Kɛ ba bini bane te berɔ la Farisii tena la be, asɛ dɛ ka bol waa Yeesu aa ɛa la bwa.
Anomanta, Sɔfonomonome ne Farisii tena kaa cheme ba Juu tena nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi ba waa bini la, dɛ ŋɔ, “Aah, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ taraken ɔ?
Na nyokpowe-ɛɛla nɔ bwa dɔŋa baa nɔ aa dɛ ɛ. Dɛ ya ɡelo waa, nɛra kɛrɛdɛ bwa ɛɛ yaradao, ásɛ a che a ta ya dɔɔranar Rom tena dɔ bɔr dɛ́ ba lɛ ya Korowii Dea nɔ ne harɛ nɔ bwa kpeɡri dɛɛ di.” Belaa ba bini bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kaefas o ɛ Sɔfonomoa a ɡɛ benanyoa la ta la ŋɔ, “He ta liire dɔe ken aa?
Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ lɛ nɛra bwa seo dɛ sewaa, a ta bɔ kɛ harɛbir bwa aa paɡra aa?” Kaefas ɡbaɡba liire laa o kpɔ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Waa ɛ Sɔfonomoa laanee Korowii tɛo ɡɛ liire la o bola ŋɔ Yeesu ɛɛ lɛ Juu tena bwa sewee sewɛ la.
Juu tena ɡbo laa.
Ba ne Korowii nɛra baa lɔ bobɛlbwa la bwa sewee wɛɛ ba lɛɛ sewɛ dɛ́ lawɛ ba bwa pɛ, ásɛ ba ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Awolaa ba le pɛ nyoa dɛɛ nyin Yeesu dɛ́ kpo.
Anomanta, dɛ waa o te kpɔe dɛɛ jo Juu tena la bini kpa.
O joɔ kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Efrem ta, asɛ o ne o habɔteŋra la ka so bela.
Juu tena Galekaa Tɔpejen la aa dɛ tel la, nɛra kɛrɛdɛ le ba bwɛɛre ta dɛ kaa Jerusalam dɛ kaa ɛ we-ɛɛla ane dɛ́ laa doŋa kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ won di tɔpere la.
Belaa nɛra baa ba Jerusalam la ɛɛ ɡaaɡe Yeesu bɔr dɛ che Korowii Dea dɛɛ pɛɛ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “Wɛɛ ba ya tɔpejen nɔ taa kɛɛ waa ba nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii rɔ?” Dɛ Sɔfonomonome la ne Farisii tena la te dɔɔ bol ŋɔ, dɛ nomɛlbwa jemɛ bela waa lole naa, ó baɡ ba ásɛ ba ka lawɔ.
Ba fuɡe noo ta Yeesu napaala ta Aa baa ka tɔpera anumɛl bá di Galekaa Tɔpejen la, Yeesu berɔ ba Bɛtani dɛ la Lasorɔs la waa chumu seo ta la dem.
Ba hɔɔhro, o ne nɛra bane ne Lasorɔs so dɛɛ di kwaa la, asɛ Maata tɔɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Anee Mɛɛre kpɔ nosɔɔhsoma loŋbir a yoɡ aa kpeɡa kohona ba fuɡe ta Yeesu napaala ta, dɛ kpɔ o nyumpona dɛɛ feera.
Asɛ dea la bini bwa sɔɔh do som ken.
Belaa Yeesu habɔteŋra la bini bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Judas Eskareɔt o taa dɛ ba Yeesu lee tɛ la ŋɔ, “Ba fe yoɡ nosɔɔhsoma nɔ dɛ lɛ suuɡajena dɛ bɔne tɛ nyaara ta bɔ naa?” Menɛkɛsɛ ŋɔ nyaara waa hiaoh waa o ŋɔ ɡɛ la.
Waa ɛ ŋwɛɛ waa o ŋɔ ɡɛ.
Dɛ onee dɛɛ kpoŋe ba suuɡa, asɛ dɛ yon ŋwɛ ane dɛɛ di.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hé ɡelo jeiih ken.
Noo o kpɔ dɛɛ huɡ mɛ.
He ne nyaara ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa.
Kɛ n te, maa he bee so ka tonɛ.” Lasorɔs kpoe vɔrɔwa Belaa Juu tena pirim aa noa kɛŋɔ Yeesu lɔ Bɛtani la, ba ba bela dɛɛ nyinu dɛ́ na.
O ɡbo waa laa, Lasorɔs waa chumu seo ta la ɡe jao.
Anomanta, Sɔfonomonome la vɔrɔwɔ kɛŋɔ bá kpo Lasorɔs ɡba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o waa Juu tena kɛrɛdɛ vɛh ba nɛɛ teŋa dɛɛ yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo.
Yeesu jo Jerusalam jirima ne Tɔ aa pera la, nɛnlaa baa ba Jerusalam dɛɛ ba ba di Galekaa la noɔ kɛŋɔ Yeesu dɛ ba bela.
Belaa ba nyin bambie papooni dɛ kpɔ le bwɛɛ bini ka chemo ŋwɛnɛ ta silɛɛ ne dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Woowo!
Korowii swee Israel tena Kooro waa valɛ o sɔn ta dɛɛ ba nɔ andɛɛɡa.” Dɛ Yeesu nyin keeɡo bie bɛl, dɛ so o ta ɡɛ baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Saayɔn tena, he bɛ ɔmɛ!
Hé nyiŋi na!
He Kooroo soɡe keeɡo bie ta dɛɛ ba la.” Dɛ o habɔteŋra la ta o waa nɔ mun noɛ loɡla la, dɛ ka tel kɛ Korowii aa tɛo jirima mɔɔ ba ta lii kɛŋɔ ba chwerɛ o bwara waa Korowii Tɔn bini ɡɛ, asɛ ba ɛo ɡɛ kpela.
Dɛ nɛnlaa Yeesu aa yerɛ Lasorɔs lalbɔɔ bini, o ir seo ta ba siwi ta la bol ɡɛ waa ɛa la bwa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra.
Nɛnlaa baa noa kɛŋɔ o ɛ wejena nɔ la koh a waa dɛ ka chemo.
Belaa Farisii tena la bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Hɛlaa yaa hɛlɛ la!
Yaa won ɛo wobɛlbwa noo!
Na nɛra bwa aa wura teŋɛ o nɛɛ ɡɛ!” Grik tena bane baa dɛ nyin Yeesu dɛ́ na Dɛ Grik tena bane ja nɛra baa kaa Jerusalam dɛɛ la ká tomɛ Korowii Galekaa tɔpere la ta la nɛ.
Ba la Felep waa le Galilia harɛ bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Bɛtsaeda la be, dɛ ka soŋo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, ya dɛ nyin Yeesu dɛ́ nao.” Belaa Felep ka ŋɔ Andriu be, asɛ ba bwa la ka bol Yeesu be.
Anee o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Men Nɛn Bie la tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ Korowii tɛ mɛ jirima.
Kasinteŋ, dɛ ba ta boyubii kpɔe du o pɔh aa, waa won ya.
O ɡboo dɛ do le.
Dɛ he duu te naa, o dɛ le dɛ ya kɛrɛdɛ.
Nomɛlbwa o siwi aa swɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ kwaa ta la, wɛɛ paŋɛ o nyuu.
Asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe o siwi aa wola harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ kwaa ta lɛ la, wɛɛ dɔ o nyuu dɛ dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.
Nomɛlbwa waa sɛh dɛɛ tom mɛ la, wɛ́ɛ teŋɛ n nɛ.
Bobɛlbwa maa do la, belaa n toroma ɡe ɛɛ ba doe.
N Mɛɛ la ɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tom mɛ la sɔnee.” Yeesu bol o seo wa Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “Taraken n liire ta bobeŋkpoŋ cheɡɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ ń soŋe n Mɛɛ ŋɔɔ?
Ń soŋo ŋɔ, ‘N Mɛɛ, lɛɛ mɛ le waa nɔ nyoa’ aa?
Akai!
A ta ɡɛ maɡrɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ waa n ba.” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, ɡel he sɔn dɔ jirima!” Belaa ba no taa bɛl le nyundua kɛŋɔ, “N ɡelɔ n sɔn dɔ jirima, kɛ mɛɛ berɔɔ ɡel o dɔ ja.” Nɛnlaa baa ja o nɛɛ bela la aa no taa la, bane ŋɔ bwaalaa kɔra, asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ nyundua torome bɛlee bol waa o be.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “N waa laa ya no ɡɛ taa nɔ.
He waa.
Tɔpere Korowii aa bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la telo, asɛ name ɡee mɛɛ ba ń doŋi Bɔnsam waa ɛ harɛ nɔ ta kooro la ta.
Men, baa ɡɔɔ mɛ nyundua le harɛ nɔ ta.
Ba baa ɡɔɔ mɛ naa, mɛɛ tɛr nɛra bwaa ba n be.” Anɔ waa bola nɔ dɛ baɡle seo la soo siwi waa dɛ ba sewa.
Belaa nɛnlaa la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Ya noɔ Korowii Tɔn la ɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ dɛ Kristo la balaa, waa sewɛ bwa.
Aah, ɛrɛɛ he te berɛ ŋɔ Nɛn Bie la chɛ kɛŋɔ bá saɡɔ nyundua ɔ?
Umee Nɛn Bie nɔ kwaraa te nɔ?” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Bɔr taa dɛ chaah he nɛɛ tɔpera anɛ nɔ, hɛ́ɛ valɛ o ta.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, bɔr ɛɛ biruu he nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ valɛ biro ta la aa bela waa dɛ kaa jemɛ.
Bɔr taa dɛ chaah he nɛɛ nɔ, hé yarada bochaah la dɛ berɛ bochaah nɛra.” Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, o le ba baah asɛ dɛ ka sɔh.
Yeesu waa la bɛ yaradae O ɛ nyokpowaa kohona ba siwi ta, kɛ ane abwa, ba ta on yaradae.
Anɔ dɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii keame Aesaya waa waa bola la ɛ kpela.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, umee dɛ́ fe yarada waa yaa dɛ bol nɔɔ?
Umee dɛ́ fe jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii ɛaɔ?” Gɛɛ a do ba ta waa la yaradae, asɛ Aesaya berɛ bol ja ŋɔ, “Korowii tɔɔɡe ba sie, dɛ ɡel ba bambile do kpeɡri, ɡɛ aa ɛ ba sibie bɛ na, ásɛ ba liiree bini bɛ chaah ba no a mun, á ba ɛ kɛ baa charɛ ba liire dɛ́ ba o be ó chaah ba.” Yeesu jirimaa Aesaya na asɛ dɛ bol o waa ɡɛ la.
Juu tena nomonome kɛrɛdɛ ɡba yarada Yeesu, kɛ baa dɛ ɔmɛ Farisii tena nomanta, ba ta bolɛ nomɛlbwa no, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba bolaa, aa ɡeloo ba doŋ ba cheremi dea joe.
Nɛra bee baa nyin sɔn dɛ ɡwaa kɛ Korowii aa tɛɛ ba sɔn.
Belaa Yeesu kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa yarada mɛ la, n laa wɛɛ yarada.
Naate waa tom mɛ laanee wɛɛ yarada la.
Nomɛlbwa waa na mɛ la, dɛ naate waa tom mɛ laanee o na ɡɛ la.
N ba harɛ nɔ ta kɛŋɔ kandea dɛ baa chaah nɛra bwa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa yarada mɛ la bɛ biro ta do kpa.
Dɛ nɛn no n waa la dɛ waa a ta teŋaa, n laa dɛ bol o waa dɛ́ pa bole, dɛkalkɛ nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole waa laa n ba harɛ nɔ ta.
Nɛra bwa lɛɛ waa n ba.
Kɛ nɛn waa vɛh n ne n waa maa dɛ bol la ɛɛ di bolchɔɡee.
N waa maa dɛ bol nɔɔ dɛ́ pao bolchɔɡe tɔpere bwa jaɡa wee.
Dɛkalkɛ n ɡbabir kpeɡri ne laa mɛɛ bol waa nɔ.
N Mɛɛ waa tom mɛ laanee do mɛ dɛ chaɡ mɛ ɡɛ maa bol o wa.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ o waa la dɛ́ tɛ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe, anomanta, anɔ la waa bol n be laanee n ɡee bol.”
Yeesu sarame o habɔteŋra nakpale Aa ka tama ba di Galekaa Tɔpejen la, dɛ Yeesu jemɔ kɛŋɔ tɔpere telo kɛ ó le harɛ nɔ ta dɛ́ berɛ kaa o Mɛɛ be.
Dɛ o dɛ nyin o nɛra baa teŋɛ o nɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta la kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ka tonɛ.
O ne o habɔteŋra aa lɔ tiɡ ta jɔmɔra la, Bɔnsam tɔ sie kpɔ liichɔɡa ba do Seemɔn Eskareɔt bie Judas bini kɛŋɔ ó le Yeesu tɛ.
Dɛ Yeesu te jemɔ kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa kpeɡrii o Mɛɛ Korowii kpɔ tɛo, asɛ dɛ berɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ waa le o be ba la, ɡɛɛ o berɛ dɛɛ ba o be kaala.
Belaa o ir kondikwaa la ta, dɛ foo o batakaare, dɛ kpɔ bwarabwaa mile chara, asɛ dɛ fuɡe nee do kon bini, dɛ pa mun kpɔ dɛɛ sarame o habɔteŋra la nakpale, asɛ dɛ kpɔ bwarabwaa waa kpɔa mile chara la dɛɛ feera.
Waa baa tel Seemɔn Pita be la, anee Seemɔn Pita pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, n nakpalee hɛɛ ba sarama aa?” Anee Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Haa n waa maa dɛ ɛ nɔ mun jemɛ taraken mɔɔ.
A habɔɔ hɛɛ ba jema.” Asɛ o berɛ ŋɔ, “Akai!
Maa sɛh he sarame n nakpale bwa.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ta ɡelɛ n sarame he nakpale aa, amɔ n ne he toole wobɛlbwa bini kpa.” Anee o berɛ ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, amɔ dɛ ɡɛɛ te naa, bɛ n nakpale ɡbo sarame ɔ. Den sarame n nɔɔra ne n nyu bwa ja.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Nɛn waa sɔ nee la, dɛ nakpale laa o ba sarame aa, waa berɛ sɔ nee kpa, dɛkalkɛ doŋa toole o nɛ.
Anomanta, doŋa toole he bɛlbwa nɛ, nemenɛ he bini beŋkpoŋ.” Dɛ Yeesu te jemɛ naate waa dɛ nyin ó leo tɛ.
A waa o tɔ sie ŋɔ doŋa toole ba bɛlbwa nɛ, nemenɛ ba bini beŋkpoŋ la.
Waa sarame ba bwa nakpale tonɛ la, o berɔ kpɔ o batakaare la do dɛ berɛ ka so o soŋnibɔr, asɛ dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He jemɛ waa aa bala asɛ n ɛ heyaa ɡɛ nɔ naa?
He dɛ yer mɛ he dɔɔ kɛɛ he nomoa aa, aŋwɛnɛ taa, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛɛ a do.
Too, taraken he dɔɔ kɛɛ he nomoa aa sarame he nakpale nɔ, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɡe ɛɛ sarame dɔŋa kwa.
Anɔ maa ɛa nɔ chɔ le dɛ tɛ heya, hé nyiŋa dɛ́ ɡee ɛ a dɔŋa.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, yom ta o dɔɔ ɡwaalɛ, torome ɡe ta nɛn waa tomɔ ɡwaalɛ.
Dɛ he jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ ɛa ɡe te naa, hɛɛ na somee.
He bwa waa laa mɛɛ bol, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n jemɛ banɔ la maa lee ba.
Anɔ ɡelɔ waa baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini la ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ, ‘N dansom n ne waa pɛ nɔn di kondikwaa la, onee ɛɛ mɛ dɔm.’ N pu sie dɛɛ baɡle heyaa mɔɔ ásɛ dɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ baa ba naa, he jemɛ dɛ́ yarada kɛ menee Kristo la.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, nomɛlbwa maa tomɔ ásɛ he lɛo la, dɛ menee he lɛ.
Gɛɛ nomɛlbwa waa lɛɛ mɛ la ɡe, dɛ naate waa tom mɛ laanee o lɛ.” Yeesu bol o lee dɛ́ tɛ wa Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ tonɛ la, o bambile chɔɡɔ kohona, o ta wobɛlbwa kpɔe sɔɔh ba kpa, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, he bini bɛlee dɛ́ lee mɛ tɛ.” O habɔteŋra la ta wone jemɛ naate waa dɛ bol o wa, dɛ nyiŋi dɔŋa sie.
Dɛ ba bini bɛl Yeesu aa dɛ nyinu kohona la soɡo kpaɡɔ.
Belaa Seemɔn Pita lɔ sie o be ŋɔ ó bɔɔro ó baɡle ba bini bɛl la waa ŋɔa.
Anee o kpɔ o te pɛl Yeesu dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, ya bini umee yɔ?” Asɛ o chaŋe ŋɔ, “Nɛn maa dɛ ba paanoo kpɔe li dɔr tɛo la, onee dɛ́ lee mɛ tɛ.” Belaa o kpɔ paanoo li dɔr dɛ kpɔ do Seemɔn Eskareɔt bie Judas nɔn ta.
Waa tɛr nɔn dɛ lɛ paanoo la, Bɔnsam den ba so o nɛ.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ir ka ɛ waa haa dɛ ba ɛɛ la warane.” Nɛra baa soɡa ja o nɛɛ tiɡ ta bela la ta waa waa bola la mun noɛ.
Dɛ Judasee chɔ ba suuɡa bwa nyoa.
Anomanta, dɛ ba bini bane dɛ lii kɛ Yeesu ken dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó ka nyin tɔpejen la kondikwa.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa ɡe aa, amɔ o ken ŋɔ ó ka tɛ nyaara suuɡa.
Judas aa lɛ paanoo la dɛ di tonɛ la, o den le ba be bela kaa.
Dɛ jwaanaa.
Yeesu bol ɡɛ Pita aa le o habɔɔ Waa kaala la, Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korowii tɛ Men Nɛn Bie la jirima name, ásɛ a che n nɛɛ o ɡe dɔ jirima.
Dɛ a cheɡɛ n nɛɛ Korowii dɔ jirima aa, aa che o nɛɛ ń ɡe dɔ jirima, dɛ́ dɔa taraken.
N bii, maa he be bonɔɔ biɡri bɛlbwa.
Hɛɛ baa nyin n bɔree.
Gɛ maa bol Juu tena nomonome be laanee mɛɛ bol he be la.
Anee kɛŋɔ haa won ba bela maa dɛ kaa la.
N dɛ do heyaa wefala ta.
Anee kɛŋɔ, hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa.
Gɛ maa nyin heyaa la, ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɡe ɛɛ nyin dɔŋa.
Dɛ he dɛ nyin dɔŋa aa, aa ɡeloo nɛra bwa jemɛ kpela kɛŋɔ he ɛ n habɔteŋra.” Pita tɔɔh ŋɔ waa Yeesu jemɛ Anee Seemɔn Pita pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, leperaa hɛɛ kaalɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “Taraken nɔ, haa won teŋɛ n nɛɛ la bela maa dɛ kaa nɔ, kɛ he ta ɛɛ ba ti mɛɛ.” Belaa o pɛɛro ja ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, ɛrɛ waa maa wola won teŋɛ he nɛɛ taraken ɔ?
Dɛ seo kwaraa yaa, mɛɛ koh he waa sewɛ.” Anee Yeesu berɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Kpelaa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ won koh n waa sewaa?
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, jabal loɡle ne sii dɛ he tɔɔh kera atoro ŋɔ haa men jemɛ kwaraa.”
Yeesu larawe o habɔteŋra bwara Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ!
Hɛ́ɛ yarada Korowii ásɛ dɛɛ yarada n ɡe.
Deene lɔ n Mɛɛ Korowii dem taeh.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa a do aa, n fe aa he bee ŋɔ n dɛ la ka kwaa sobɔr cheɡ heyaa bela.
Dɛ n kaa kwaa bɔr cheɡ heyaa bela aa, mɛɛ berɔɔ ba ásɛ dɛ ba kpɔ heyaa kaa bela maa lole, ásɛ bela maa so la, hé ɡe do bela.
He jemɛ bela maa dɛ ba kaala la ŋwɛnɛ.” Yeesuu ɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ kaa o Mɛɛ be Anee Tɔmas pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, aah yaa wola bela haa dɛ kaa jemɛ nɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ́ ba he be bela ɔ?” Belaa o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Menee ŋwɛnɛ, menee kasinteŋ, menee mkpa.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ la n Mɛɛ la bee yaa, nemenɛ ó che n nɛ.
He fe jem mɛ kɛrɛdɛ naa, he fe jemɛ n Mɛɛ la ɡe.
Taraken he jemɔ.
Onee he na la.” Anee Felep ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, baɡle yaa he Mɛɛ la, ásɛ ya baah sɔɔh yaa.” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ne haa lole le saŋ la bwa nɔ, amɔ he ta wone jem mɛ mɔɔ naa, Felep?
Nomɛlbwa waa na mɛ la, dɛ n Mɛɛɛ o na la.
Ɛrɛɛ he berɛ ŋɔ ń baɡle heyaa n Mɛɛ la nɔɔ?
Haa yarada kɛŋɔ n ne n Mɛɛ la pɛo dɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ, o joo mɛ n ɡe joo kɛɛ?
N waa maa bol la bwa ta n ɡbabir be leɛ.
N Mɛɛ laanee joo mɛ asɛ mɛɛ ɛ o toma.
Hɛ́ɛ yarada mɛ kɛ maa ŋɔa ŋɔ, n jo n Mɛɛ asɛ o ɡe joo mɛ la.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa ɡe aa, hé yarada mɛ n nyokpowe-ɛɛla la wa.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa yarada mɛ la, wɛɛ ɛ n we-ɛɛla dɔŋa bwa soo siwii.
Wɛɛ won dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa ɡwaa n kwaa nɔ kwaraa, dɛkalkɛ mɛɛ berɔɔ kaa n Mɛɛ be.
Ásɛ komɛlbwa haa che n sɔn ta dɛ́ soŋe la, mɛɛ ɛo.
Anɔ taa aa ba cheɡa ń lɛ jirima tɛ n Mɛɛ Korowii.
Dɛ he cheɡɛ n sɔn ta soŋe komɛlbwa naa, mɛɛ ɛo.” Yeesu baɡɛ nyoa o Domadɛɛɡe la wa Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “He dɛ nyin n wa aa, hɛ́ɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la taa.
Mɛɛ soŋe n Mɛɛ Korowiirii ó berɛ tɛ heyaa Habɔchekpaa ja wɛ́ɛ cha heya, dɛ́ soŋe dɛɛ tɛ heya, ásɛ he ne o so saŋ bɛlbwa.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he jemɛ Korowii kasinteŋ waa la.
Nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire aa won yarada o Domadɛɛɡe wa, dɛkalkɛ baa won nao ásɛ dɛ jemɔ.
Kɛ he te jemɔ, dɛkalkɛ o ne heyaa lole, asɛ o so he nɛ.
N baa kaa laa, maa heyaa ta kɛ bilalbii, mɛɛ berɔɔ ba he be.
A ka tama, nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire aa men na kpa, kɛ he te ɛɛ na mɛɛ.
Maa dɔ mkpa nomanta, he ɡee dɔ mkpaa.
Tɔpere la telaa, hɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ n ne n Mɛɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ, bɛl aa wola won daɡre o te o dɔŋ nɛ, ásɛ n ne he ɡe ɛ beŋkpoŋ ɡɛ tenten.
Nomɛlbwa waa lɛ n waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta la, onee dɛɛ nyin mɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin mɛ la, n Mɛɛ la ɛɛ nyinuu, ásɛ n ɡe nyin naate, dɛ́ kpɔ n te baɡlo.” Belaa Judas pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba he te kpɔe baɡle ya ɡbosoo, asɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire nɔɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin mɛ la, wɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ n webaɡla la taa.
N Mɛɛ ɛɛ nyinuu, n ne o bwa ba o be ya ne o so.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola men nyin la, waa n webaɡla ta teŋɛ.
Waa haa dɛ no nɔ ta n be leɛ, a bwa le n Mɛɛ waa tom mɛ la be.
N ta aa lɔ he be nɔɔ mɛɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ he be.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa ɛ Habɔchekpaa la, onee n Mɛɛ ɛɛ ba toma ó che n sɔn ta ba dɛ ba baɡle heyaa wobɛlbwa, dɛɛ lii heyaa anɔ la bwa n fa aa bol he be la.
Deŋnesɔɔhnaa n kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, n ɡbabir deŋnesɔɔhnaa.
Harɛ nɔ ta deŋnesɔɔhna laa, anomanta, he bɛ ɡel he bambile teŋe ásɛ hɛɛ ɔmɛ.
N bol he be he no kɛŋɔ ‘Mɛɛ kaaloo ásɛ dɛ berɛ ba he be.’ Dɛ he fe dɛ nyin mɛ naa, he sie fe ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ maa kaa n Mɛɛ be, dɛkalkɛ o ɡwaa mɛ.
N pu sie dɛɛ bol he be mɔɔ a ba ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ a ɛ ɡɛ naa, hé yarada mɛ.
N ne haa won bol waa kohona kpa, dɛkalkɛ harɛ nɔ ta kooro dɛ ba.
O ta kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe n nɛ, kɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa jemɛ kɛ n dɛ nyin n Mɛɛ la, a waa mɛɛ ɛ anɔ la bwa waa do mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ la.
Hé ir, yá le bonɔ.”
Yeesu kpɔ o te maɡɛ ɡrepo da Yeesu berɔ sɛɡ ba ŋɔ, “Menee ɡrepo daa tenten waa dɛ nɔnɛ, asɛ n Mɛɛ ɡee paa la.
N kpale bɛlbwa waa wola nɔnɛ la, o teŋo dɛɛ ta, kɛ n kpale waa won nɔna la te, o dɛ kuu o nyoo ó won nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
A cheɡɛ waa maa baɡle heyaa la ta he do kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ kpala baa kuu a nyoo a won nɔna kɛrɛdɛ la.
Hé kpɔ he te pɛl mɛ ásɛ n ɡe lawɛ heyaa pɛl n te.
Grepo da kpale aa won nɔnɛ dɛ o ta o tenten ta choŋe.
Gɛ tentenee dɛ he ta he te kpɔe pɛl mɛ naa, haa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Menee ɡrepo daa la, asɛ he ɡee o kpala.
Dɛ he bɛlbwa choŋi n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ asɛ n ɡe lawɔ pɛl n te naa, anee ó won nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ he ta n nɛɛ cheɡɛ te naa, haa won ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Dɛ he bɛlbwa ta o te kpɔe pɛl mɛ naa, wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ daa kpale baa teŋo ta asɛ o hol la.
Kpala aa do ken la, pae ba paa dɛɛ do nii ta, aa fuh.
Hé kpɔ he te pɛl mɛ asɛ n webaɡla ɡe do he liire bini naa, he dɛ soŋe komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin aa, hɛɛ dɔɔ.
Dɛ he wono dɛɛ ɛ n Mɛɛ tetoowaa kɛŋɔ kpale waa dɛ nɔnɛ kɛrɛdɛ naa, wɛɛ dɔ jirimaa.
Anee dɛ baɡle kɛ n habɔteŋraa heyaa kpela.
Gɛ n Mɛɛ la aa dɛ nyin mɛ laanee n ɡee nyin heya.
Anomanta, he bɛ he te laa kpɔ n nyina maa dɛ nyin heyaa la ta bwa.
He dɛ teŋɛ waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta naa, haa he tenee laa kpɔ n nyina maa dɛ nyin heyaa la ta, kɛŋɔ maa teŋɛ waa n Mɛɛ aa kpɔa tɛ mɛ la ta maa wola n te laa kpɔ o nyina ta la.
N baɡle heyaa waa nɔ ásɛ he dɔ n silɛɛ dɔŋ, ásɛ he sie lɛ ka tonɛ.
Waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa laanee la.
Hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin heyaa la.
Nyina bɛlbwa toole dɛ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ nɛn aa wona koh o daamanar waa dɛ sewɛ.
He dɛ teŋɛ n waa maa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la ta te naa, amɔ dɛ n daamanaree heya.
Maa heyaa n bonɔɔna yerɛ kpa, dɛkalkɛ bonɔɔ naa won jemɛ o nomoa waa bini.
N daamanaree mɛɛ yerɛ heyaa name te, dɛkalkɛ n ɡelɔ he jemɛ wobɛlbwa maa noa dɛ le n Mɛɛ be.
He laa lee mɛ, menee le heya.
Gɛ kpaldɛɛɡe aa dɛ nɔnɛ la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ nyin kɛ he do, dɛɛ ɛ n Mɛɛ tetoowa, dɛ bɛ an ɡel bwa.
Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, komɛlbwa haa soŋe n sɔn ta la, wɛɛ tɛ heyaa.
Waa maa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa laanee kɛŋɔ, hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa.” Haeh nɛra aa hah Yeesu habɔteŋra Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire ɡbo hah heya aa, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee ba tɔ sie hah.
Dɛ he fe ɛ ba bini bane aa, ba fe ɛɛ nyin heyaa.
Kɛ maa le heyaa le ba bini he ɛ n nɛra la waa ba hah heyaa la.
Hɛ́ɛ lii ɡɛ n fa aa bol he be ŋɔ, yom ta o dɔɔ ɡwaalɛ la.
Dɛ ba ɛɛ mɛ hɔhɔrɔwa aa, ɡɛɛ baa ba he ɡe ɛɛ.
Dɛ ba teŋɛ n webaɡla ta naa, baa teŋɛ he ɡe kwaa ta ɡɛɛ.
Anɔ bwaa baa ba n waa koeh dɛɛ ɛ heya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa naate waa tom mɛ la jemɛ.
N fe ta balɛ dɛ ba bol waa chaɡ ba aa, ba fe aa bolchɔɡee di.
Kɛ taraken baa noa dɛ laa ba liire kpɔ a ta nomanta, ba ta nyoa dɔe dɛ́ bol le kpa.
Bɛlbwa waa hah mɛ la, dɛ o hah n Mɛɛ la ɡe.
Dɛ n fe ta waa nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa aa wola ɛɛ ka ɛ ba siwi ta te naa, ba fe aa bolchɔɡee di.
Kɛ ba na n nyokpowe-ɛɛla bwa, dɛ ɡarɛ hah n ne n Mɛɛ bwa.
Anɔ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ waa baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini la ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ, ‘Ba hah mɛ pɛɛ.’ Mɛɛ tomɛ Habɔchekpaa laanee o le n Mɛɛ be dɛ́ ba he be.
Onee Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa dɛ baɡle Korowii kasinteŋ waa la.
Dɛ o balaa, onee dɛ́ ɛ n danseɛ.
He ɡe ɛɛ bol n waa baɡle nɛra, dɛkalkɛ chɔɔ bwaa n ne he do le.”
“N baɡle heyaa waa nɔ bwa, ásɛ wobɛlbwa bɛ won ɡel he le habɔɔ.
Nɛra ɛɛ doŋi heyaa cheremi deene binii, ásɛ a ba saŋ bɛl kɛŋɔ bá kpoo heya, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii tetoowaa baa ɛ ɡɛ la.
Anɔ bwaa baa ba heyaa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa n ne n Mɛɛ jemɛ.
N bol waa nɔ he be, ásɛ dɛ a baa ba ɡɛ naa, he won lii dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ n fa bol he be.
N ta aa lɔ he be la waa maa wola he be bolɛ chɔɔ bwa la.” Toma Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa dɛ ɛ Yeesu berɔ ŋɔ, “Taraken mɛɛ berɔ kaa Naate waa tom mɛ la be, kɛ he bini bɛlbwa ta men bɔɔrɛ bela maa dɛ ba kaala.
Maa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ he be nomanta, he tea bini chɔɡɔ.
Kasinteŋii mɛɛ bol he be la, a wer tɛ heyaa kɛ ń kaa.
Dɛ n ta kaalaa, Habɔchekpaa la aa he bee ba.
Kɛ dɛ n baa kaalaa, mɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba he be.
Dɛ o balaa, wɛɛ di nɛra kasinteŋii dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ waa aa ɛ wechɔɡa, ne waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi, ne ɡɛ Korowii bole pae waa aa doa.
Wɛɛ di ba kasinteŋii ba wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ baa men yarada, dɛ di ba kasinteŋ waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi la ta, kaala maa dɛ kaa n Mɛɛ be haa wola men na kpa la nomanta.
Wɛɛ di ba kasinteŋii Korowii bole pae la ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii bol harɛ nɔ ta kpeɡnɛn la waa dɛ pao bolchɔɡe.
N fe dɔ waa kohona dɛ́ bol baɡle heya, kɛ aa ɡwaa he nɛɛ kɛ he won no a mun buɡ nɔ ta.
Kɛ dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa dɛ chaɡle Korowii kasinteŋ waa la balaa, wɛɛ pili wobɛlbwa binii tɛ heyaa hé no a mun.
O ɡbabir nyu bini waa laa wɛɛ ba bola baɡle heya.
Anɔ la waa noa le Korowii be laanee wɛɛ ba bola, dɛ́ chaɡle heyaa waa a taa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba bala.
Onee dɛ́ tɛ mɛ jirima, dɛkalkɛ onee dɛ́ kpɔ n wobɛlbwa ba bol he be.
Komɛlbwa n Mɛɛ la aa dɔa la ɛ n kon.
A waa n ŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee dɛ́ kpɔ n wobɛlbwa bol he be la.
Tebinichɔɡ ne silɛɛ wa A ka tamaa ken haa men na kpa, ásɛ a berɔ ɛ tama ɡe aa, he na mɛ ja.” O habɔteŋra la bane bɔɔ dɔŋa ŋɔ, “O waa nɔ waa dɛ bol nɔ munii ɛrɔɔ?
O ŋɔ, a ka tama yaa on na, ásɛ a berɔ ɛ tama ɡe aa, ya nao ja, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, o Mɛɛ la bee wɛɛ kaa waa yaa wola on na kpa la.” Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ ‘a ka tama’ nɔ waa bola nɔ ɛɛ baɡle ɔ?
Yaa a mun jemɛ!” Belaa Yeesu aa jema kɛŋɔ ba dɛ nyin ba bɔɔro ɡɛ wobol la mun la, o ŋɔ, “Amɔ maa ŋɔa ŋɔ a ka tama haa men na, ásɛ a berɔ ɛ tama ɡe aa, he na mɛ ja nɔ, a waa hɛɛ bɔɔ dɔŋa a mun nɔ naa?
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, he loo ɛɛ kuu he wi, ásɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire sie lɛ.
He tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡoo, kɛ he tebinichɔɡ la ɛɛ berɛ heyaa silɛɛ.
Dɛ lol tea lɔ haah naa, o tea bini dɛ chɔɡ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o bonyɛɡa saŋ telo.
O baa lolɛ tonaa, o dɛ soh o bonyɛɡa la, ásɛ o sie berɛ lɛ kɛŋɔ waa lolɛ bie ba harɛ nɔ ta.
Gɛɛ a do he ɡe be.
Taraken te, he tea bini chɔɡɔ, kɛ maa berɛ ba na heyaa la taa he sie ɛɛ ba lɛɛ kohona.
Gɛ silɛɛ la, nomɛlbwa aa won lɛ he be.
Tɔpere la telaa, haa men wobɛlbwaa bɔɔ kpa.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, dɛ he soŋe komɛlbwa n Mɛɛ be naa, wɛɛ koh n waa dɛ́ tɛ heya.
He ta n sɔn kpɔe dɛ soŋe komɛlbwa bwa.
Kɛ taraken te, hé kpɔ n sɔn soŋe, hɛɛ dɔɔ ásɛ he sie lɛ kohona.
Anɔ maa bola baɡle heyaa nɔ ɛ sɛɡla, kɛ tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba bala maa wola heyaa sɛɡle kpa.
Mɛɛ bol n Mɛɛ la waa he bee dɛ́ pili a bini chasee ken.
Tɔpere la telaa, hɛɛ kpɔ n sɔnee soŋe Korowii.
N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ n dɛ che he naa ta dɛ́ soŋe tɛ heya.
N Mɛɛ ɡbabir dɛ nyin heya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he dɛ nyin mɛ, dɛ yarada kɛŋɔ o bee n le ba.
O bee n le dɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta, taraken n berɔ dɛɛ le bonɔ dɛ kaa o be.” Anee o habɔteŋra la ŋɔ, “Taraken te haa yaa sɛɡle kpa.
He dɛ pili waa bini chasee.
Ya nao name kɛŋɔ he jemɛ wobɛlbwa aa lɔ nɛn nyu bini mɔɔ wɛɛ pɛɛre.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa pɛɛre waane kpa.
A ɡelɔ ya yarada kɛŋɔ Korowii bee he le.” Anee Yeesu bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He berɔ dɛɛ yarada mɛ taraken te naa?
Tɔpere bɛl dɛ ba, o joɔ tonɛ, he bwa dɛ ba chwae peɡre kaa he deremi ásɛ a ka n ɡbo.
N ne n Mɛɛ aa lole saŋ bɛlbwa nomanta, aa n ɡbo kae ba.
A waa mɛɛ baɡle heyaa waa nɔ ásɛ he dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna dɛ́ le pɛɛ n ne haa pɛa la ta la.
Hɛɛ na hɔhɔrɔwaa harɛ nɔ ta, kɛ hé lawɛ bambile, dɛkalkɛ n faɡɛ harɛ nɔ ta komɛlbwa nɛ.”
Yeesu soŋe Korowii tɛ o te Yeesu aa bol waa nɔ tonɛ la, o ha sie dɛ nyiŋi nyundua asɛ dɛ jam Korowii ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, tɔpere la telo.
Tɛ men maa ɛ he Bie jirima ásɛ n ɡe won kpɔ jirima tɛɛ.
He tɛ mɛ kpeɡri nɛra bwa nɛ, asɛ n won kpɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe tɛ nɛra haa kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ la.
Banɔ la baa jemɛ dɛ jemɛ kɛ he ɡboo Korowii kasinteŋ la, dɛ berɛ jem mɛ kɛ menee Yeesu Kristo haa tom mɛ la, banee dɛ́ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.
N tɛɛ jirima harɛ nɔ ta kɛŋɔ maa tonɛ toma haa kpɔa do n nɔn ta ŋɔ ń ɛ la bwa.
Anomanta, n Mɛɛ, maa cheɡɛ he sie taraken nɔ, tɛ mɛ jirima n ne haa dɔa wubwa mɔɔ dɛ ta harɛ nɔ la.
Yeesu soŋe Korowii tɛ o habɔteŋra Nɛra haa lee ba le harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bini dɛ kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ la, n ɡelɔ ba jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Henee dɔɔ ba dɛ kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ, asɛ ba sɛh dɛɛ teŋɛ he waa la ta.
Taraken ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ komɛlbwa haa tɛ mɛ la, he bee a le.
N bol waa haa baɡ mɛ la baɡ ba, asɛ ba sɛh a ta.
Ba jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ he bee n le ba, dɛ yarada kɛ henee tom mɛ.
N dɛ soŋe dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa laa n soŋe dɛɛ tɛ.
Banɔ la haa kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ laanee n soŋe dɛɛ tɛ, dɛkalkɛ henee dɔɔ ba.
N komɛlbwa ɛ he kon, asɛ he ɡe komɛlbwa ɛ n kon.
Ba waa n dɔ jirima.
N dɛ ba he be bela.
Maa harɛ nɔ taa biɡri, kɛ ba te ɛɛ ka harɛ nɔ taa.
Anomanta, n Mɛdɛɛɡe, kpɔ sɔn haa tɛ mɛ la kpeɡri tɔ ba nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ ba ɛ beŋkpoŋ ɡɛ n ne haa ɛ beŋkpoŋ la.
N fa aa lɔ ba be la, n kpɔ sɔn haa tɛ mɛ la kpeɡri tɔ ba nɛ, ba bɛlbwa ta n nɔn ta nyoɡrɛ, nemenɛ onɔ la baa chwerɛ o waa he Tɔn bini ŋɔ wɛɛ nyoɡroo la, o ɡbosoroo nyoɡra, ásɛ he Tɔn bini waa la ɛ kpela.
Taraken n berɔ dɛɛ ba he be bela, kɛ n taa lɔ harɛ ta nɔ, n dɛ bol waa nɔ ásɛ ba won dɔ silɛɛ maa dɔa la kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ.
Maa bol he Amanesoma la baɡ ba la, a ɡelɔ ba ta nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire nɛɛ jae kpa, ɡɛ maa wola ba nɛɛ jae la.
Anomanta, ba hah ba.
Maa soŋe ŋɔ hé laa ba kpɔ le harɛ nɔ ta, kɛ n dɛ soŋe ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ kee ba Bɔnsam nɛ.
Gɛ maa wola nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire nɛɛ jae la, ɡɛɛ ba ɡe aa wola ba nɛɛ jae.
Che he kasinteŋ waa la ta, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ bá won ɛ he ɡbo nɛra.
He waa ɛ kasinteŋ.
Gɛ haa tom mɛ harɛ nɔ ta la, ɡɛ tentenee n ɡee tom ba.
Ba nomanta, n kpɔ n te tɛɛ dɛ ɛ he ɡbosoroo nɛn ásɛ ba ɡe ɡba won berɛ he ɡbosoroo nɛra, teŋa baa dɛ teŋɛ he kasinteŋ la ta nomanta.
Yeesu soŋe Korowii tɛ nɛra baa ba yaradao Ba ɡbo laa n soŋe dɛɛ tɛ.
Nɛra baa ba che banɔ nɔ waa baa dɛ bol ta dɛ́ yarada mɛ la bwaa n soŋe dɛɛ tɛ.
N dɛ soŋe kɛ hé ɛ ba bwa beŋkpoŋ.
N Mɛɛ, ɡɛ n ne haa ɛ beŋkpoŋ bɛl aa wola won daɡre o te o dɔŋ nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ soŋe kɛ ya ne ba won ɛ beŋkpoŋ, ásɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire bwa won yarada kɛŋɔ henee tom mɛ.
Gɛ haa tɛ mɛ jirima laanee n ɡe tɛɛ ba ásɛ ba won ɛ beŋkpoŋ ɡɛ n ne haa ɛ beŋkpoŋ la.
N ne ba ɛ beŋkpoŋ, n ne he ɡe ɛ beŋkpoŋ, bɛl aa wola won daɡre o te o dɔŋ nɛ aa, anee dɛ́ ɡel ba beŋkpoŋri la won che kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire la jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee tom mɛ dɛɛ nyin ba ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin mɛ la.
N Mɛɛ, henee kpɔ ba tɛ mɛ.
N dɛ nyin kɛ ba ja n nɛɛ bela maa lole, ásɛ dɛ won na n jirima haa kpɔa tɛ mɛ.
He tɔ sie nyin mɛ mɔɔ dɛ ta harɛ, a waa he tɛ mɛ jirima la.
N Mɛdɛɛɡe, nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire aa hen jemɛ, kɛ n te jemɛ, asɛ banɔ nɔ ɡe jemɛ kɛŋɔ henee tom mɛ.
N ɡelɔ ba jemɛ, mɛɛ ɡeloo baa jemɛ, ásɛ ba won dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin mɛ la, ásɛ n ne ba won pɛ.”
Yeesu lawa Yeesu aa soŋe Korowii tonɛ la, o ne o habɔteŋra la leɔ, dɛ ka le nenabɔɔ Kedrɔn.
Dɛ ba ɛ bodɛɛɡe bɛl dɛ du daa ane bela, asɛ ba ka jo a baah.
Dɛ Judas waa leo tɛ la jemɛ bela, dɛkalkɛ Yeesu ne o habɔteŋra la dɛ cheme bela warawara.
Anomanta, Judas na Sɔfonomonome ne Farisii tena, asɛ ba tɛo soojare ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea la bane.
Asɛ ba kpɔ kandere ne kapɛle ne dɔmkwa, asɛ Judas kpɔ ba la bodɛɛɡe baa du daa la baah bela.
Dɛ Yeesu jemɛ waa aa dɛ ba o nɛɛ chiɡa bwa, anomanta, o leɔ ka chem ba, asɛ dɛ bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Ume bɔree hɛɛ nyin ɔ?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt la bɔree yaa nyin.” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “Menee nɔ!” Dɛ Judas waa le Yeesu tɛ la ja soojare la ne nɛra la nɛɛ ba che bela.
Yeesu aa ŋɔa men nɔ la, ba le habɔɔ dɛ choɡli.
Belaa o berɛ kwaa pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ume bɔree hɛɛ nyin ɔ?” Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt la.” Anee o ŋɔ, “N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ menee nɔ naa?
Dɛ n bɔree hɛɛ nyin aa, amɔ hé ɡel nɛra baa ja n nɛɛ nɔ te kaa.” Gɛ aa ɛ asɛ waa o fa aa bol o Mɛɛ be la ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ o fa aa ŋɔa ŋɔ, “N Mɛɛ, nɛra haa tɛ mɛ la bɛlbwa ta n nɔn ta nyoɡrɛ” la, a waa o bol ɡɛ.
Dɛ Seemɔn Pita dɔ kere o be bela.
O pamɛ kere le o tɔɔ ta, dɛ ŋwɛnɛ Sɔfonomoa la bonɔɔ diɡ deŋne dɛ laa cha.
Gɛ bonɔɔ la sɔne Malkus.
Pita aa ɛ ɡɛ la, Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ kere la su o tɔɔ ta!
N bɛ wahala n Mɛɛ aa cheɡa ŋɔ ń na la na kɛɛ?” Ba lawɛ Yeesu la Anas sie Rom soojare ne ba nomoa ne Juu tena baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea lawɛ Yeesu dɛ vɔrɔwo, dɛ tɔ sie la o ne Anas be.
Dɛ Kaefasee Sɔfonomoa a ɡɛ bena la ta.
Dɛ o mo Anas bie.
A ɡɛ Kaefas nɔɔ fa ŋɔ Juu tena nomonome be ŋɔ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ lɛ nɛra bwa seo sewaa, a bɔ harɛbir bwa aa paɡra.
Pita aa tɔɔh loɡla ŋɔ waa Yeesu jemɛ Baa dɛ kaa Yeesu ne la, Seemɔn Pita ne o dɔŋa habɔteŋra la bɛl teŋɛ o nɛ.
Dɛ Sɔfonomoa la jeremee a ɡɛ habɔteŋre nɔ, anomanta, o teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ jo Sɔfonomoa la dem bela.
Baa jo dem bela la, Pita te kaa jaɡɛ che dem la doonyoa.
Dɛ tolo bɛlee dɛɛ daah doonyoa la.
Asɛ Yeesu habɔteŋre la Sɔfonomoa la aa jemɔ la berɛ le buse, dɛ ba bol waa tolo la be, dɛ kpɔ Pita jo dem bela.
Belaa tolo la bɔɔ Pita ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ habɔteŋre laa hen aa?” Anee o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, o habɔteŋre laa men.” Dɛ waa lole, anomanta, dɛ Sɔfonomoa bonɔɔna ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea la do nii hɔla ta dɛ cheɡ dɛɛ ŋwee, asɛ Pita ka ja ba nɛɛ dɛ ɡee ŋwee.
Gɛ sɔfonomoa aa pɛɛ Yeesu wa Sɔfonomoa la bɔɔ Yeesu o habɔteŋra ne o webaɡla la wa.
Anee o ŋɔ, “Tɔpere bɛlbwaa mɛɛ baɡla nɛra baah ta ba bwa ɛɛ no.
Korowii Dea ne cheremi deene ya Juu tena bwa aa dɛ cheme a bini la, belaa mɛɛ baɡla.
N ta sɔeh dɛ baɡle wobɛlbwa ɡe bwa.
Amɔ ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ bɔɔ mɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Bɔɔ nɛra baa noa la, banee dɛ́ jemɛ waa maa baɡ ba dɛ́ baɡle.” Yeesu aa chaŋe waa la ɡɛ la, dɛ Sɔfonomoa la bonɔɔ bɛl cheɡɛ o jwɛɛh asɛ dɛ kpaa o lwɛɛma, dɛ kɔro ŋɔ, “Kenii chɛ kɛ he chaŋe Sɔfonomoa aa?” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “Waa maa bola a ta maɡrɛ la, baɡle nɛ́ra bwa no.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa ɡe aa, n lɔe nɔ munii ɛrɔɔ?” Asɛ Anas ɡel ba la Yeesu ne Sɔfonomoa Kaefas be, dɛ o nɔɔra ta vɔrɔwɔ ɡɛ.
Pita berɔ tɔh ja ŋɔ waa Yeesu jemɛ Dɛ Seemɔn Pita ta cheɡɔ dɛɛ ŋwee nii la, asɛ ba bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Baa la habɔteŋra la bɛl laa hen aa?” Asɛ o tɔh pelepele ŋɔ, “Bɛl laa men!” Dɛ Sɔfonomoa la bonɔɔ Pita aa ŋwɛnɛ o deŋne dɛ laa cha la lole bɛl lɔ dem bela.
O bɔɔrɔ ŋɔ, “Kɛ dɛ he ja baa la nɛra la nɛɛ bodɛɛɡe bela baa du daa laɔ?” Anee o tɔh ja ŋɔ, “Akai!” Buɡ la taa, jabal si.
Ba lawɛ Yeesu ba che Paelet sie Tomun aa dɛ kpɔ la, Juu tena nomonome la kpɔ Yeesu la Kaefas be, dɛ ba o ne Rom nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi ba harɛ ta la be koodem.
Dɛ Galekaa Tɔpejen dii telo, anomanta, Juu tena nomonome la te ta dem bela joɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba jo bela aa, baa kah doŋaa baa wola won di Galekaa kondikwaa la.
Baa vɛh bela joe la, ba harɛ nomoa Paelet leɔ ba ba be, dɛ ba bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa o ɛ aa wola maɡrɛ hɛɛ bɔɔro wɔ?” Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ laa aa, ya fe ta o ne he be balɛ.” Asɛ Paelet ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡbabir kpɔɔ kaa ka bol o waa ɡɛ he Mmara aa dɛ chaɡle.” Anee ba ɡe chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ya ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ yá bol nɛn waa dɛ pao bolchɔɡe bá kpoo.” Gɛ waa nɔ chiɡo ásɛ nɛra jemɛ kɛ Yeesu waa waa bola dɛ baɡle seo la soo waa dɛ ba sewa la ɛ kpela.
Asɛ Paelet berɛ jo o koodem bela, dɛ yerɛ Yeesu ba o be, dɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Henee Juu tena kooro ɛ?” Belaa o chaŋo ŋɔ, “He ɡbaɡbaa na waa nɔ dɛɛ bɔɔ mɛ kɛɛ nɛra banee bol n waa he be nɔ?” Anee Paelet ŋɔ, “Haa na mɛ nɔ, Juu tee men aa?
He ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ tena ne he Sɔfonomonomee ba he ne n be.
Bɔkwa wechɔɡaa he ɛɔ?” Asɛ Yeesu chaŋo ŋɔ, “Harɛ ta bonɔ laa mɛɛ di kora.
Dɛ harɛ ta bonɔɔ mɛɛ di kora aa, n nɛra fe aa sɛh bá kpɔ mɛ tɛ Juu tena, ba fe ɛɛ yoo lɛɛ mɛ.
Kɛ harɛ ta bonɔ kora laa mɛɛ di.” Yeesu aa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, anee Paelet bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Amɔ kooroo hen kpela kenɛ?” Asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Henee ŋɔa kooroo men.
Kasinteŋ bola waa ba lol mɛ.
A waa n ba harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ba bol kasinteŋ la nɛra bwa be.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kasinteŋ la, on dɛɛ no n be.” Anee Paelet ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa ɡee kasinteŋ nɔɔ?” Ba ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ bá kpo Yeesu Waa bol ɡɛ la, o berɔ le dɛ ka ŋɔ Juu tena la be ŋɔ, “N ta waa maa che a ta pao bolchɔɡe nae, kɛ ɡɛ he Juu tena yon ɡel n foo wechɔɡ-ɛɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛɛ ta he Galekaa Tɔpejen dii ta la, ń foo Juu tena kooro nɔ ta ɡɛ kɛɛ?” Belaa ba bwa nyɛɡ kohona ŋɔ, “Bɛ on foo!
Foo Barabas!” Dɛ ɡɛ Barabas nɔ, ŋwɛɛree.
Ba ŋɔ ba kpaa Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta Belaa Paelet ɡel o soojare ka lawɛ Yeesu, dɛ lɔɔro bampɔrɔ ŋwɛɛra ne.
Ba koh o baah muɡla waa dɛ kpɔ sɔɔhne sɔh kooɡbɛrɛ piu, dɛ kpɔ yaswɛm bɛl o do kɛŋɔ ba bela koranar wur ken dɛ doo.
Dɛ ba dɛ ba o be dɛɛ si, “Woowo, Juu tena kooro!” dɛɛ kpaa o lwɛrɛme.
Baa ɛo ɡɛ la, Paelet le buse ja dɛ ba ŋɔ Juu tena la be ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no bonɔ, mɛɛ le o ne busee tɛ heya, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛ n ta wobɛlbwa o nɛɛ nae dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ pao bolchɔɡe.” Anomanta, o ɡelɔ Yeesu le buse, dɛ sɔɔhne kooɡbɛrɛ piu, asɛ o do wurswɛm la.
Asɛ Paelet ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Onee la.” Sɔfonomonome ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea la aa nao la, ba kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Gel ba kpoo!
Gel ba kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta!” Anee Paelet chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Hé ɡbaɡba ba kpɔɔ ka kpaa pɛl daɡaɡre ta.
N te ta wobɛlbwa o nɛɛ nae dɛ́ che a ta dɛ́ ɡel ba kpoo.” Belaa Juu tena la berɛ chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ya dɔ Mmara bɛl waa dɛ baɡle kɛ o chɛ kpoe, dɛkalkɛ o dɛ yerɛ o te Korowii Bie.” Paelet aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, a taa o berɛ ɔmɛ kohona kwara.
Anomanta, o berɔ jo koodem bela, asɛ dɛ ka bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Lepetenee he leɔ?” Kɛ o ta on chaŋɛ.
Anee o berɛ bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Haa men chaŋe kɛɛ?
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ n dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won ɡel ba foori ta, dɛ́ berɛ won ɡel ba kpaare pɛl daɡaɡre ta kɛɛ?” Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Korowiirii sɛah dɛ ɡel he dɔ kpeɡri n nɛ.
O fe ta sɛɛh yaa, he fe ta kpeɡri dɔe n nɛ.
Nɛn waa lee mɛ tɛ dɛ ɡel he dɔɔ mɛ la wechɔɡa ɡwaa he kwa.” Paelet aa no ɡɛ la, dɛ o dɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ bɛl dɛ́ fee kpɔ Yeesu ta ó kaa.
Ate, nɛnlaa la kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yerɛ o te kooro la ɛ Rom Koojen Siisa dɔm!
Anomanta, dɛ he kpɔ baa nɔ ta aa, amɔ dɛ Rom Koojen la dɔmee hen!” Paelet aa no ɡɛ la, o kpɔ Yeesu le buse dɛ ba so bela waa soɡa dɛɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la.
Bwea nee ba mao o ir nyundua.
Juu tena wobol ta, baa dɛ yerɛ bela ‘Gabata’.
Awola tɔpere la ɛ tɔpere Juu tena bwa aa dɛ kpɔ ba te, dɛ́ daa kondikwaa cheɡ, dɛ́ won di Ona Tɔpere waa lɔ ba Galekaa la ta la.
Dɛ wee tel nyufala tonɛ, asɛ Paelet ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He kooro laanee la!” Anee ba nyɛɡ kohona ŋɔ, “Gel ba kpoo!
Gel ba kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta!” Asɛ Paelet bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “He kooro ɡbabirii he ŋɔ ń ɡel ba kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta naa?” Anee Sɔfonomonome la chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ya ta kooro bɛlbwa dɔe ka ja Koojen Siisa nɛ!” Ate, Paelet kpɔ Yeesu tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ka kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta.
Asɛ soojare la kpɔɔ kaa.
Ba kpaa Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta Ba kpɔ Yeesu le koodem bela dɛ ɡel o che daɡaɡre baa dɛ ba o kpaara pɛl o ta la, dɛ ba tel bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Nyuhoɡ Bɔr, asɛ Juu tena wobol ta, ba ɡe ɛɛ yerɛ bela Gɔlɡɔta.
Baa tel bela la, ba kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre la ta.
Ba kpaa nɛra banɛ ja o nɛ, bɛl do o diɡ ta, asɛ bɛl ɡe do o ɡal ta, asɛ o do ba bwa baah ta.
Belaa Paelet ɡel ba chwerɛ waane ka pɛl Yeesu daɡaɡre la nyundua.
Waa baa chwera laanee kɛ, juu tena kooro yeesu waa le nasarɛt laanee la.
Dɛ bela ne bwɛjen Jerusalam aa jaŋɛ, anomanta, Juu tena kɛrɛdɛ bwa na ɡɛ waa la dɛ kura.
Ba chwera Juu tena wobol ne Rom tena wobol ne Grik tena wobol ta.
Anomanta, Juu tena Sɔfonomonome la ŋɔ Paelet be ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa chwera ŋɔ, ‘Juu tena kooroo on’ nɔ aa were.
Chwerɛ ŋɔ ‘Onee ŋɔa Juu tena kooroo on.’ ” Anee Paelet chaŋe ŋɔ, “N te dɔɔ chwerɛ tonɛ.” Soojare la aa kpaa Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta tonɛ la, ba bɔne o laala bini bɔre anaarɛ, asɛ bɛlbwa kpɔ beŋkpoŋ.
Kɛ o batakaare waa doo lɔɡa la te, ba sɔɔh kombir, ba ta bobɛlbwa nyarɛ pɛ.
Anomanta, soojare la ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɡel ya kɛɛro.
Hé ɡel ya ta chacha, naate waa di la ó kpɔ.” Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Baa kpɔ n laalaa bɔne dɔŋa, dɛ́ ta chacha dɛ́ na naate waa di n batakaare.” Gɛ baa chwera laanee soojare la ɛ, dɛ ɡel a ɛ kpela.
Dɛ Yeesu nya ne Yeesu nyajen ne Klopas haah Mɛɛre ne Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la cheɡɛ Yeesu daɡaɡre la jwɛɛh bela.
Yeesu aa na o nya ne o habɔteŋre waa dɛ nyinu kohona la kɛŋɔ baa cheɡɛ dɔŋa jwɛh, asɛ o ŋɔ o nya be ŋɔ, “N nya, he biee la,” dɛ ŋɔ o habɔteŋre la ɡe be ŋɔ, “He nyaa la.” Le a ɡɛ saŋ la, o habɔteŋre la lawɛ Mɛɛre kaa o dem o ka so o be.
Yeesu seo wa A habɔɔ Yeesu aa naa kɛŋɔ o wobɛlbwa tonɔ la, o ŋɔ, “Nyɔɡre dɛ kpo mɛ,” ásɛ waa aa lɔ Korowii Tɔn bini la ɛ kpela.
Dɛ vii bɛl ne sennyɛɡa cheɡɛ bela, asɛ ba kpɔ konjɔɡɔjɔɡɔ bɛl waa won nee lɛɛ vɔwɛ daa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ hesɔp dajaŋ ta, dɛ kpɔ li sennyɛɡa la dɛ kpɔ su o nyoa ó nyɔ.
Yeesu aa nyɔa tonɛ la, o ŋɔ, “A tonɔ,” asɛ dɛ ɡure o nyu dɛ ɡel o doma le, o sewɛ.
Dɛ awola tɔpere la ɛ tɔpere Juu tena aa dɛ kpɔ ba te, dɛkalkɛ tɔɔ peraa dɛ ba jo Ona Tɔpere waa ɛ ba tɔpejen tenten la ta.
Dɛ baa nyin kɛŋɔ Yeesu ne nɛra la saɡɛ ka tel tɔpejen la ta.
Anomanta, ba kaa soŋe Paelet ŋɔ ó ɡel soojare kuuɡi ba nakpale bá sewɛ warane, ásɛ ba dɔ bɔr laa ba kpɔ daɡaɡre la ta.
Baa soŋe ŋwɛnɛ la, soojare la kaa kuuɡi nɛra la baa kpaa ba ne Yeesu pɛl daɡaɡre ta la nakpale.
Baa tel Yeesu be la, ba nao kɛŋɔ o te dɔɔ sewɛ, anomanta, ba ta o te nakpale kuuɡe.
Kɛ soojare la bɛl kpɔ lampea dɛ yaɡɛ Yeesu loŋi ta.
Buɡ la ta, chal ne nee le.
Naate waa di waa nɔ danseɛ la naa siwi ne, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ kasinteŋii, dɛɛ bola ásɛ he ɡe no dɛ́ yarada.
Anɔ ɡelɔ waa baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Baa o hoɡ beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ku” la ɛ kpela.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn la bobɛl ɡe ŋɔ, “Baa nyiŋi nɛn baa yaɡɔ lampea ne laanee.” Yeesu huɡa wa Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, baa bɛl waa le Arimatea baa yerɔ Josef la Paelet be dɛ ka soŋo Yeesu lale.
Dɛ a ɡɛ Josef nɔ dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ, kɛ o koh Juu tena ɔma waa dɛɛ sɔh o te a ɡɛ bɔr.
Paelet tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ ó ka kpɔ lale la kaa, asɛ o ka kpɔɔ kaa.
Nikodeemɔs waa la Yeesu be jwaana bɛl la, o ne Josefoo la Yeesu huɡribɔr bela.
Nikodeemɔs la konsɔɔhsoma bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ fɔɡle ba lala ne bela.
A kan dɛ do tɔɡre dɛ́ ɛ men baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ paanoo la baaɡe del.
Ba nɛra banɛ la kpɔ Yeesu lale la, dɛ kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma la fɔɡlo, dɛ kpɔ yapoŋ vɔrɔwo, ɡɛ Juu tena aa dɛ ɛ ba lala dɛɛ huɡ ba la.
Bela baa kpo Yeesu la, dɛ bodɛɛɡe bɛl baa du daa lɔ bela, asɛ ba forɛ lalbɔɔ bwe bɛl ta kɛŋɔ dea ken.
Dɛ ba ta nomɛlbwa o bini huɡe bwa.
Dɛ lalbɔɔ la bɛne bela, asɛ ba Ona Tɔpere ɡe telo tonɛ, anomanta, ba denɔ kpɔ Yeesu ka huɡe o bini.
Yeesu seo ta ira wa Tomun aa dɛ kpɔ Kwasiara waa ɛ tɔpeloɡle la, Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la la bela baa huɡe Yeesu la, dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ bwe baa kpɔa tɔ bɔɔ la nyoa la le o nyoa.
Waa na ɡɛ la, o chwao la Seemɔn Pita ne o dɔŋ Yeesu aa dɛ nyinu kohona la be dɛ ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ba laa ya Dɔɔ kpɔ lalbɔɔ la bini, yaa jemɛ bela baa kpɔɔ bil.” Pita ne o dɔŋ habɔteŋre la iro dɛ la bela baa huɡe Yeesu la.
Dɛ chwae baa chwa, asɛ Pita dɔŋ la chwa warane dɛ felu tel bɔɔ la ta.
O boŋɔ haah dɛ na yapoŋ la chɔe, kɛ o ta lalbɔɔ la bini tenten joɛ.
Belaa Pita waa ka mun la ba dɛ ba jo bɔɔ la bini, dɛ na yapoŋ la bela, dɛ na yapoŋ baa kpɔa vɔwɛ o nyu la kɛŋɔ waa ɡula chɔ pera.
Belaa Yeesu habɔteŋre waa tɔ sie tel bela la ɡe berɛ jo lalbɔɔ la bini, dɛ na a bwa.
Waa naa la, o den yarada.
Dɛ ba ta waa aa lɔ Korowii Tɔn bini bobɛl dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ Yeesu ir seo ta la mun noɛ mɔɔ.
Yeesu habɔteŋra la berɛ kaa ba deremi.
Yeesu kpɔ o te chaɡle Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala Kɛ dɛ Mɛɛre te ta cheɡɛ bɔɔ la nyoa dɛɛ wi.
Waa dɛ wi la, o boŋɔ dɛ haah lalbɔɔ la bini, asɛ dɛ na nyundua toroma banɛ.
Ba do kompoŋa so bela baa kpɔ Yeesu lale bil la.
Bɛl soɡe o nyu bɔr, asɛ bɛl so o nakpale bɔr.
Belaa nyundua toroma la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N nya, bɔkwa waa hɛɛ wi ken nɔ?” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Ba kpɔ n Dɔɔ kaa.
Maa jemɛ bela baa kpɔɔ ka bil.” Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ dɛ berɛ o te, dɛ Yeesuu cheɡa, kɛ o ta jemɛ kɛ onee.
Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “N nya, bɔkwa waa bala hɛɛ wi ken nɔ?
Ume bɔree hɛɛ nyin ɔ?” Dɛ Mɛɛre dɛ lii kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi bodɛɛɡe baa du daa bela laanee, anomanta, o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nomoa, dɛ henee baa kpɔ n Dɔɔ kaa laa, hé ɡel n jemɛ bela haa kpɔɔ ka bil, ásɛ dɛ la ka kpɔɔ.” Anee Yeesu yerɔ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛre.” Asɛ o berɛ sie o be dɛ kpɔ Aram tena wobol ŋɔ, “Raboni!” O munii Nomoa, dɛ ka lawɔ kpoŋe.
Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kpɔ mɛ ta, n ta n Mɛɛ be laŋɛ mɔɔ.
Kaa ka ŋɔ n nimanar be ŋɔ, ‘N berɔ dɛɛ kaa nyundua n ne he bwa Mɛɛ waa ɛ ya bwa Korowii la be.’ ” Asɛ Mɛɛre waa le Maɡdala la la Yeesu habɔteŋra la be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N na ya Dɔɔ la!” O bol waa Yeesu aa bola la ba be.
Yeesu kpɔ o te chaɡle o habɔteŋra Awola Kwasiara la jwaana la, Yeesu habɔteŋra la cheme dea bɛl bini.
Dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ Juu tena, anomanta, ba tɔɔɡe ɡbeni la dɛ laa karɛ ba nɛ.
Belaa ba ŋɔ ba nyiŋi, dɛ Yeesu baa che ba baah dɛ ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.” Waa bol ɡɛ la, o kpɔ o nɔɔra ne o loŋi baɡ ba, asɛ ba sie lɛ kohona kɛŋɔ baa na ba Dɔɔ la.
Yeesu berɔ bol ja ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ heyaa bambisɔɔhna.
Gɛ n Mɛɛ aa tom mɛ la, ɡɛɛ n ɡe ɛɛ tomɛ heya.” Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o hweero ta ba nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé lɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la.
Dɛ he ŋɔ Korowii kpɔ nɛra wechɔɡa kɛ ba aa, wɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛ ba, kɛ dɛ he ŋɔ Korowii bɛ nɛra wechɔɡa kpɔ kɛ ba aa, aa do ba nɛɛ.” Yeesu ne Tɔmas Dɛ Tɔmas baa dɛ yerɔ Kpar o ɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la bini bɛl la toole o bala la be ɡɛ saŋ Yeesu aa ba bela la.
Anomanta, dɛ ba dɛ bol o be ŋɔ, “Ya na ya Dɔɔ la.” Asɛ o chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ n te ta dadowɛre la buɡe aa lɔ o nɔɔra ta la nae, dɛ kpɔ n nonii do bela, dɛ berɛ kpɔ n nɔn do o loŋi bela baa kpɔ lampea yaɡɛ la aa, maa waa nɔɔ yarada.” A yawanyoa la, Yeesu habɔteŋra la berɔ ba cheme dea la bini ja, dɛ Tɔmas ja ba nɛ.
Ba kaɡre dea la ɡbeni, kɛ Yeesu baa jo che ba baah, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ heyaa bambisɔɔhna!” Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Tɔmas be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he nonii ba do n nɔɔra bɔɔne la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ he nɔn do n loŋi bɔɔ la ɡe ta, dɛɛ yarada mɛ, dɛ́ ɡel aahna aahna la haa dɛ ɛ la.” Asɛ Tɔmas ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, n Korowii!” Belaa Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Haa na mɛ nɔ waa he yarada mɛ nɔ kɛɛ?
Nɛra baa wola men nae dɛ yarada mɛ la, ba na som.” Nyokpowaa Yeesu aa ɛa o habɔteŋra la siwi ta warɔ taeh.
A bwa laa n chwerɛ do tɔn nɔ bini.
Kɛ n chwerɛ anɔ ásɛ he che a ta dɛ́ yarada kɛŋɔ Yeesuu Kristo Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ bao la, onee Korowii Bie la, ásɛ a che he yarada haa dɛ yaradao la ta he dɔ Korowii mkpa.
Yeesu kpɔ o te chaɡle o habɔteŋra banuanɛ A habɔɔ la, Yeesu kpɔ o te ba baɡle o habɔteŋra la Tibeerias Moo la ta ja.
Kenii a ɛ ba nao.
Dɛ o habɔteŋra Seemɔn Pita ne Tɔmas baa dɛ yerɔ Kpar la, ne Nataaneɛl waa le Keena waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta, ne Sebedii bii, dɛ ba bini banɛ pɛo so.
Asɛ Seemɔn Pita ŋɔ o bala la be ŋɔ, “N dɛ la ń ka ta asau.” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Amɔ te ya ne hɛɛ lao.” Asɛ ba bwa ka jo ɡbera bini dɛ ka ɛ toma tɔɔ ba per, dɛ ba ta komɛlbwa dɔe.
Tɔ aa pera la, dɛ Yeesu cheɡɛ nee nyoa bela, kɛ o habɔteŋra la aa nao la, ba ta jemɛ kɛ onee.
Belaa o yer ba ŋɔ, “Bwɛɛla, he ta pɛŋa dɔe yaa?” Anee ba ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, ya ta komɛlbwa dɔe.” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Hé ta asau la ta ɡbera la diɡ bɔr, hɛɛ dɔ anee.” Belaa ba ta do bela, asɛ asau la lawɛ pɛŋa kohona, ba ta wone tɛro do ɡbera la bini.
Anee Yeesu habɔteŋre waa dɛ nyinu kohona la ŋɔ Pita be ŋɔ, “Ya Dɔɔree.” Dɛ Seemɔn Pita foo o batakaare bil.
Waa noa kɛŋɔ ba Dɔɔree la, o berɛ kpɔ do, dɛ le nee la ta.
Asɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la kar la tawɛ ɡbera la, dɛ tɛr asau la ne pɛŋa la teŋɛ dɛ ba ta baŋ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba ne baŋ aa jaŋɛ kohona.
Wɛɛ ɛ naɡale lafaa.
Baa baa chuɡe la, ba na hɔla nii asɛ pɛŋe dawɛ a doa, asɛ paanoo chɔ bela.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ pɛŋa haa lawa la ane ba.” Belaa Seemɔn Pita ka jo ɡbera la bini dɛ tɛr asau la le baŋ, dɛ pɛŋejena su o bwa.
A lɔ lafa fifraanue dɛ atoro, kɛ a ne a wara bwa, asau la bobɛlbwa ta kɛɛrɛ.
Asɛ Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hé ba chɔɔ nyoa.” O habɔteŋra la bɛlbwa ta wone lɔ bambile dɛ pɛɛro o nɛnsoo, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ ba Dɔɔree.
Asɛ Yeesu ka kpɔ paanoo la tɛɛ ba, dɛ kpɔ pɛŋe la tɛɛ ba ɡɛ tenten.
Korowii aa iru seo ta la, anɔɔ jaa tooro waa kpɔ o te baɡle o habɔteŋra la.
Yeesu ne Pita Belaa baa di kwaa tonɛ la, o bɔɔ Seemɔn Pita ŋɔ, “Jɔn bie Seemɔn, he dɛ nyin mɛ dɛ ɡwaa banɔ nɔ naa?” Anee Pita ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n Dɔɔ, he jemɔ kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin he wa.” Anee Yeesu berɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ nyiŋi n pebiiri nɛ.” O berɔ pɛɛro nɛɛtena ŋɔ, “Jɔn bie Seemɔn, he dɛ nyin mɛ naa?” Anee o ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh, n Dɔɔ, he jemɔ kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin he wa.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ nyiŋi n peera nɛ.” Yeesu berɔ kwaa pɛɛro toorotena ŋɔ, “Jɔn bie Seemɔn, he dɛ nyin n waa aa?” Waa nɔ ɡelɔ Seemɔn Pita bambile chɔɡ kohona kɛ waa bera bɔɔro toorotena ŋɔ, “He dɛ nyin n waa” la.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, he jemɛ wobɛlbwa, he ɡbabir jemɔ kɛ n dɛ nyin he wa.” Anee Yeesu ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ dɛɛ n peera.
Kasinteŋ, n dɛ ŋɔ he be, he fa aa ɛ bonɔɔ la, he won kiriso vɔwa dɛ́ kaa bela bwa haa dɛ nyin.
Kɛ dɛ he baa hwɛɛhraa, hɛɛ tɛr nɔɔraa ásɛ nomɛl vɔrɔwe dɛ́ kaa he ne bela haa wola nyin laŋa.” O bol anɔ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle seo la soo Pita aa dɛ ba sewa, á che a ta Korowii dɔ jirima.
Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o ŋɔ Pita be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛ.” Yeesu ne o habɔteŋne waa dɛ nyinu kohona Baa dɛ kaa la, Pita keo nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ o dɔŋ habɔteŋre Yeesu aa dɛ nyinu kohona la teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Onee fa soɡa kpaɡɛ Yeesu ɡɛ saŋ o ne o habɔteŋra la aa chema tiɡ ta, asɛ dɛ bɔɔro naate waa dɛ ba o lee tɛ la.
Pita aa nao la, o bɔɔ Yeesu ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, aah baa nɔ ɡe sɛ?” Belaa o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Dɛ n dɛ nyin kɛ o so le dɛ ka tel saŋ maa ba kwaraa naa, he waanee yaa?
He te ɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛ!” Yeesu aa bol ɡɛ la, dɛ o habɔteŋra la dɛ bol bobɛlbwa ŋɔ, amɔ ba dɔŋ habɔteŋre la aa sewɛ bwa.
Kɛ ɡɛ laa Yeesu ŋɔ.
Waa waa bolaa kɛŋɔ, dɛ o dɛ nyin o habɔteŋre la so ka tel ɡɛ saŋ waa ba naa, Pita waane laa.
