Kórowii ka do heya.” Anee Pɔɔl ŋɔ toroma la be ŋɔ, “Rom tenaa ya bwa, kɛ ba lɔɔ yaa pɛɛpɛɛ bombaah ta dɛ tɔ yaa dea, dɛ ba ta ya waa bolɛ dɛ na wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ya nɛ.
Aah taraken nɔ sɔeh ba berɛ dɛɛ nyin dɛ sɔh ta yaa nɔ naa?
Aa maɡre!
Hé ɡel Rom nomonome la ɡbaɡba ba lawɛ yaa le!” Toroma la kaa bol Pɔɔl waa waa bola la Rom nomonome la be.
Nomonome la aa noa kɛŋɔ Pɔɔl ne Silas ɛ Rom tena la, ba ɔmɔ.
Anomanta, ba baa do ba jaŋɡbare, dɛ laɡ ba le bela baa do ba dea la, dɛ soŋ ba ŋɔ bá le bwɛɛ la ta.
Pɔɔl ne Silas aa le bela la, ba la Liidia dem.
Ba kaa na bwɛɛ la asɔre tena la bela, dɛ bol waa baɡ ba, dɛ do ba ɡbemba dɛ kaa.
Pɔɔl ne Silas Tesalonika laŋa Pɔɔl ne Silas aa ira dɛɛ kaa la, ba kaa kpɔ bwɛɛre ane baa dɛ yera Amfepɔles ne Apolonia ta dɛ ka le Tesalonika.
Dɛ Tesalonika Juu tena dɔ cheremi dea bela.
Pɔɔl la cheremi dea bela ɡɛ o yon dɛɛ ɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta la.
Waa lɔ bela la, o yawanyoa atoro bwa dɛ o ne Juu tena la dɛ bol waa dɛɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa Korowii waa baa chwera la ta.
Dɛ o dɛ baɡ ba Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ nɛwɛnyina la waa Korowii Tɔn bini, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛ Korowii keamere fa baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Kristo la ɛɛ na wahalaa dɛ́ sewɛ, dɛ́ ir seo ta.
Gɛ baa chwera la chɛ kɛ a ɛ. Waa bol ɡɛ tonɛ la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Yeesu nɔ n yon dɛɛ bol o waa nɔ, onee Kristo la.” Bane yarada Pɔɔl waa la, dɛ ba ja o ne Silas nɛ.
Bela haahna baa ɛ nɛnjena la ɡalɡa, ne bela Grik tena baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la ɡalɡa ɡe baa ja ba nɛ.
Nɛra baa yarada Pɔɔlwa waa la, dɛ baa ja asɔre tena la nɛɛ la aa dɛ warɛ la, dɛ aa somɛ Juu tena la be, asɛ ba ka nyin nɛŋkasale baa wola toma dɔe dɛ yon do dembaah dɛɛ ɡaaɡe ɡbo la, dɛ ir ba bwaawee, asɛ ba ne ba valɛ dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa bwɛɛ la bwa.
Ba la Jasen dem ŋɔ bá fe ka lawɛ Pɔɔl ne Silas ba tɛ bwɛɛla la.
Baa wola ban dɔe lawɛ la, ba tɛɡre Jasen ne asɔre tena la bane ka tɛ bwɛɛ la nomonome, dɛ nyɛɡ dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra nɔ, ban chɔɡ nɛra liire bobɛlbwa dɛɛ valɛ dɛ ɡel bobɛlbwa ɛɛ ɛ yeŋyeŋ la.
Taraken ba ba ya bwɛɛ nɔ ta, asɛ Jasen ɡe lɛɛ ba do o dem.
Waa ya Koojen Siisa aa wola nyin laanee baa ɛ. Ba ŋɔ Koojen bɛl ɡe berɔ do le ja ya Koojen nɔ nɛ.
Dɛ o sɔne Yeesu.” Bwɛɛ la tena ne ba nomonome aa no waa nɔ la, a ɡelɔ ba liire ɛ sakaa.
Nomonome la ɡelɔ Jasen ne asɔre tena la kpɔ suuɡa cheɡ ajinamuu kɛŋɔ baa wobɛlbwaa ɛ kpa.
Jasenwa waa baa ɛa laanee ba nyiŋi dɛ lɛɛ ba suuɡa dɛ ta ba.
Pɔɔl ne Silas Bɛrea laŋa Bɔr aa baa jo la, asɔre tena la kpɔ Pɔɔl ne Silas kaa Bɛrea.
Baa la bela la, ba kaa jo bela cheremi dea bini.
Dɛ bela Juu tena la waa do kɛrɛdɛ ɡwaa Tesalonika Juu tena, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba lɛ Yeesu waa la silɛɛ ne, dɛ won dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Tɔn bini tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛ́ɛ na, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ waa Pɔɔl aa dɛ bol la, kpelaa kɛɛ nyosonee yɔ.
Nɛra la kɛrɛdɛ yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo.
Grik haahna baa ɛ nɛnjena la kɛrɛdɛ ne ba baala bwa yarada Yeesu.
Juu tena baa lɔ Tesalonika aa noa kɛŋɔ Pɔɔl kaa bol Korowii Waa Bɛrea ɡe la, ba ba bela dɛ ba do ba, asɛ ba bwaawee ir Pɔɔlwa nɛ.
Belaa asɔre tena la ɡel Pɔɔl kaa mpo nyoa buɡ ta, asɛ Silas ne Timoti te so Bɛrea.
Nɛra la baa tɔ Pɔɔl sie dɛɛ kaa o ne la, ba la o ne ka tel Atens, dɛ berɛ kaa Bɛrea.
Baa dɛ kaa la, Pɔɔl ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá ka ŋɔ Silas ne Timoti be ásɛ ba ba o be warane.
Pɔɔl ne Silas bwɛjen Atens laŋa Pɔɔl aa soɡe bwɛjen Atens bela dɛɛ kpa Silas ne Timoti la, o nao kɛ voɡa su bwɛɛ la bwa.
Waa na ɡɛ la, o tea bini chɔɡɔ.
Anomanta, dɛ o dɛ la bela cheremi dea o ne Juu tena, ne Grik tena baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ Juu tena aa dɛ tomɔ la kaa nyiŋi Korowii waa la bini.
Dɛ tɔpere bɛlbwaa wɛɛ so bwɛɛ la fɔɡbaah, asɛ dɛɛ bol waa nɛra baa dɛ ba bela la be, asɛ o ne baa nyiŋi Korowii waa la bini.
Dɛ nɛra bane hweli bela wejema baa dɛ yera Epikuria ne Stoik la, dɛ ɡe ɛ ɡɛ wejema la chachaɡla bela.
Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɡe dɛ tɔŋlo dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ wobobala te nɔ ɡee bol nɔɔ?” Asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Jamɔ harɛ bɛl voɡa waa wɛɛ bol nɔ.” Pɔɔl aa dɛ bol Yeesu ne seo ta ira waa ba lii ɡɛ la.
Anomanta, ba kpɔ Pɔɔl kaa bela nomonome baa dɛ yer ba Areɔpaɡos tena la, dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Baɡle he wefala haa kpoŋa dɛɛ ɡaaɡe la bini yá no.
Ya ta he waa nɔ te dɔŋa noɛ bwa, anomanta, ya dɛ nyin kɛ he baɡle yaa a mun.” Dɛ Atens tena ne ba hɔɔhra tomaa wefala bola ne wefala pɛɛra dɛ́ no.
Pɔɔl aa cheɡɛ nomonome la sie la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N nao kɛŋɔ he Atens tena dɛ tomɛ voɡa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ maa dɛ ɡaaɡe he bwɛɛ nɔ ta dɛ na bɔra haa dɛ tomɛ la, n na kon haa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta, dɛ na kɛŋɔ baa chwerɛ bobɛl ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɛ tomɔ, kɛ yaa on jemɛ.’ Kon haa wola on jemɛ dɛ ɡee tomɔ la, o waa mɛɛ bol he be la.
O sɔne Korowii.
Korowiirii ta harɛ ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa.
On dɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa.
O waane laa chɔɔbɔra nɛwɛnyini aa maa tɛo la wa.
Nɛwɛnyini kondikwaa waa laa o do le, waa nɛwɛnyini komɛlbwa nyin, dɛkalkɛŋɔ on dɛɛ tɛ yaa mkpa ne hweera ne komɛlbwa.
Nɛmbeŋkpoŋii o ta, asɛ a ɡɛ nɛn la lolɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra, asɛ ba ya perɛ harɛ bwa.
Waa ta nɛwɛnyini la, o do bɛlbwa tɔpera ne ya dobɔra.
On saahna ɛa ɡɛ, ásɛ nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ laɡre dɛɛ nyin o bɔr kɛ nyoŋa ken, ásɛ o bɔr nyina bini la, bá nao.
Kɛ kasinteŋ, Korowii toole bojaŋ.
O ne ya bɛlbwa baah aa jaŋɛ.
Nomɛl te kompɛɛ, ‘Korowii alaworomɛɛ ya bwa do le, dɛɛ hwee, dɛɛ ɛ ya tomare.’ He nɛra baa dɛ chwerɛ wobobeela la ɡba di ɡɛ waa nɔ danseɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘O biirii ya ɡbabir.’ Korowii biirii yan, anomanta, ya bɛ on kpɔ maɡɛ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋ ne bwea koŋkwaare nɛwɛnyini ɡbaɡba aa kpɔ ba liire maa la.
Saŋ la nɛwɛnyini fa aa wola Korowii ŋwɛnɛ jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ la, o laa sie kpɔ ba wechɔɡa ta.
Kɛ taraken te, o ŋɔ hárɛ ta bobɛlbwa nɛra charɛ ba liire, dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o do tɔpere waa dɛ ba nɛwɛnyini bwa waa bola kasinteŋ ne la.
O le nɛn wɛɛ ba waa la bola.
O ir naate seo ta ásɛ nɛra jemɛ kɛŋɔ kpelaa o waa la.” Pɔɔl aa bol seo ta ira waa la, dɛ ba dɛ mamɔ, asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Ya dɛ nyin kɛ he bol he waa la yá no ja.” Belaa o le ba bini, dɛ kaa.
Nɛra la bane te yarada Yeesu waa la, dɛ ba ja o nɛ.
Nɛra baa yaradaa la bini bɛl sɔne Daneseɔs.
Dɛ Areɔpaɡos nomonome la bɛlee on.
Haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Damaris ne nɛra bane yarada Yeesu waa la.
Pɔɔl ne Silas Kɔrent laŋa A habɔɔ la, Pɔɔl le Atens dɛ kaa Kɔrent.
Belaa o ka na Juu te bɛl, dɛ o sɔne Akwela.
Dɛ Pɔntos tee on, asɛ o ka so Rom, dɛ berɛ le bela ba Kɔrent, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Rom Koojen Klɔdeɔs doŋi Juu tena bwa Rom.
Dɛ Akwela haah sɔne Presela.
Pɔɔl la ba be dɛ ka na ba, dɛ so ba be dɛ ɛ toma, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ɡbansaba toma o fa aa dɛ ɛ wubwa laanee baa ɛ. Dɛ o dɛ la ba cheremi dea Ona Tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛ kaa bol wa, asɛ o ne Grik tena ne Juu tena bwa yon dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii waa bini.
Dɛ o dɛ tɔŋ ba, ásɛ ba fe teŋɛ o kon ta.
Silas ne Timoti aa le Makidoonia harɛ ba la, a taa Pɔɔl do kpeɡri name dɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛɛ bol Yeesu waa la, dɛɛ di danseɛ dɛɛ baɡle Juu tena kɛŋɔ Yeesuu Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la.
Dɛ nɛra la dɛ nyin Pɔɔl toma chɔɡa, dɛɛ ɛo nɛnhɛla.
Anomanta, o jwii o laala doŋa ta dɛ baɡle kɛ o baɡ ba Korowii waa asɛ ba vɛah, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he nyoɡraa, nɛn laa ɛ heya, he ɡbaɡbaa ɛ he nyu.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa, nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ mɛɛ ba Korowii waa baɡla.
Maa he bee ba kpa.” Waa le ba be la, o kaa choɡ baa bɛl waa dɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ Juu tena aa dɛ tomɛ Korowii baa yerɔ Titeɔs Jastos.
Dɛ o dem lɔ bela cheremi dea jwɛɛh tenten.
Dɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi cheremi dea la ta la sɔne Krispus.
Dɛ o ne o dem tena bwa yarada Yeesu waa la.
Kɔrent tena kɛrɛdɛ no Yeesu waa la dɛ yaradaa, asɛ ba sɔ ba Korowii ne.
Awola bɛl, Pɔɔl na wepila ane jwaana.
O nao kɛŋɔ Korowii aa dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɛ dɛɛ ɔmɛ, dɛɛ bol n waa la nɛra be.
Bɛ nyoa tɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n cheɡɛ he habɔɔ.
N nɛra warɛ bwɛjen nɔ ta.
Anomanta, mɛɛ che he mun taa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won ɛɛ wobɛlbwa.” Anomanta, Pɔɔl soɡe bwɛɛ la ta dɛ baɡle nɛra Korowii waa benanyoa dɛ korobie anumɛl.
Gɛ saŋ baa tɛ baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Galio nomonome, asɛ o nyiŋi Akaya harɛ dɛɛ tɛ Rom Koojen laanee Juu tena pɛ nyoa, dɛ lawɛ Pɔɔl la o be.
Baa la o ne la, ba kaa ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ jo ya kii nɛ.
O dɛ baɡle nɛra ŋɔ báa tomɛ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ bɛl ta aa wola were.” Pɔɔl te ne ŋɔ o bol waa dɛ Galio ŋɔ Juu tena la be ŋɔ, “Juu tena, dɛ tonchɔɡa anee baa nɔ fe tomɛ nɔ naa, ŋwɛnɛ fe lole kɛ ń lawɛ bambile dɛ́ no he be.
Kɛ aa ɛ waa waa bola ne he bwɛɛ tena sɔna ne he bwɛɛ waa ɡbo waa nɔ te, hé ɡbaɡba ka nyiŋi a ta.
Maa a ɡɛ waa nɔɔ bol.” Galio doŋ ba o kɔɔto bela.
Belaa ba lawɛ cheremi dea nomoa baa dɛ yerɔ Sɔɔstenes la, dɛ lɔɔro Galio kɔɔto dea la sie tenten, kɛ Galio ta ban chaŋɛ kwara.
Pɔɔlwa berɔ ba kaa Anteɔk A habɔɔ la, Pɔɔl soɡe Kɔrent asɔre tena la be biɡri, asɛ dɛ kal ba dɛ le bela kaa Keŋkrea.
Dɛ o baɡɛ nyoa bɛl, anomanta, o fonɛ o nyu mɔɔ dɛ le Keŋkrea, asɛ o ne Akwela ne Presela kpɔ stiimae dɛɛ kaa Siiria harɛ.
Ba kaa tel Ɛfesos, asɛ Pɔɔl ɡel ba dɛ te kaa bela cheremi dea, asɛ o ne bela Juu tena kaa bol Korowii wa.
Nɛra la fe ŋɔ ó so ba be tama, kɛ o ta sɛɛh.
Kɛ waa dɛ ba ba be lee dɛ kaa la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii sɛoh te naa, mɛɛ berɔɔ ba he be,” dɛ́ che Ɛfesos kpɔ stiimae kaa.
Waa tel Sisaaria la, o la Jerusalam dɛ ka chɔɔ bela asɔre tena, dɛ le bela kaa Anteɔk.
Waa soɡe bela tama la, o le bela dɛ valɛ Galaasia harɛ ne Frejea harɛ bwɛɛre ta, dɛɛ ja nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ do bela la, dɛɛ do ba ɡbemba.
Dɛ Juu te bɛl ɛ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Alɛksandrea la bie, dɛ ba Ɛfesos, asɛ baa yerɔ Apolos.
Dɛ o jemɛ wobol taeh, dɛ jemɛ Korowii Tɔn bini waa ɡe kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba fa baɡle Apolos Yeesu bwara waa ne o ŋwɛnɛre bwa, asɛ o jema, dɛ ɡe ɛɛ baɡla o bokpeɡa bwa ne.
Kɛ, dɛ Jɔn o fa aa dɛ sɔ nɛra Korowii nee la waa waa baɡle nɛra Yeesu waa la ɡboo o no.
O lɔ bambile dɛ baa bol Korowii Waa cheremi dea.
Presela ne Akwela no waa waa dɛ bol la, dɛ kpɔɔ la ba dem dɛ ka baɡlo Korowii Waa la kɛrɛdɛ.
Belaa Apolos ŋɔ wɛɛ la Akaya harɛ taa.
Anomanta, Ɛfesos asɔre tena la doo ɡbemba dɛ chwerɛ Akaya harɛ asɔre tena tɔn ŋɔ ó ba ba be naa, bá nyiŋu kɛrɛdɛ.
Waa la bela la, o kaa cha nɛra Korowii aa sune ba nɛɛ dɛ ɡel ba yarada o waa la taeh.
O wono baɡle Korowii Waa bini bombaah kpeɡri nɛ, Juu te bɛlbwa aa wola wone tɔŋlo, dɛ won baɡle waa Korowii Tɔn bini kɛŋɔ Yeesuu Kristo la waa ɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa Lɛɛ la.
Pɔɔl la Ɛfesos Apolos aa lɔ Kɔrent la, Pɔɔl kpɔ harɛ la bwe doa bɔr dɛ ka le Ɛfesos.
Waa la bela la, o kaa pu nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ la bane bela, dɛ pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Haa kpɔ he te tɛ Yeesu la, Korowii tɛ heyaa o Domadɛɛɡe la aa?” Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ɔɔhɔh, ya te ta Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa noɛ kwaraa bwa.” Anee Pɔɔl berɛ kwaa pɛɛ ba ŋɔ, “Aah dɛ bɔkwa waa he sɛh ŋɔ hɛɛ ɛo mɔɔ ba sɔ heyaa Korowii nee laɔ?” Asɛ ba ŋɔ, “Jɔn waa o fa aa dɛ chaɡle laanee ya sɛh.” Belaa o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa charɛ ba liire dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta laanee Jɔn sɔ Korowii ne.
Jɔn fa aa dɛ baɡle nɛra waa la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ naate o taa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba bala la baa ba naa, bá yaradao dɛ́ kpɔ ba te tɛo.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, Yeesu waa wɛɛ bol la.” Baa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba ɡelɔ ba sɔ ba Korowii nee dɛ baɡle kɛ ba ɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nɛra.
Pɔɔl kpɔ o nɔɔra dawɛ ba nɛ, asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ba so ba nɛ, asɛ baa bol wobofala, dɛɛ bol Korowii Wa.
Dɛ baa tel baala fi dɛ banɛɛ.
Pɔɔl di korobie atoro bwa bela, dɛɛ bol Korowii Waa bela tena be bansua ne ba cheremi dea bini.
O laɡ ba dɛɛ so, o ne baa bol Korowii Kora la wa.
O takapɔ kɛ wɛɛ berɛ ba liiree, ásɛ ba fe teŋɛ o kon ta.
Ba bini bane deŋne kpeɡri baa waa la yarada kwara, dɛɛ bol Yeesu nɛɛ teŋa la waa aa wola were kwara nɛnlaa la bwa baah ta.
Anomanta, Pɔɔl ɡel ba, dɛ lawɛ nɛra baa yarada Yeesu waa la, asɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa o ne ba kaa cheme bobɛl baa dɛ yerɛ bela Teraanɔs Sukuu la ta.
Gɛ Sukuu la ta laŋa dɛ kaa hweli Korowii waa tɔpere bɛlbwa la, ba ɛ ɡɛ bene anɛ.
Anomanta, Juu tena ne Grik tena ɛɛ dɛ do Eesia harɛ ta bela bwaa no Yeesu waa la.
Dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ Pɔɔl nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa aa do kpeɡri dɛ berɛ ɡwaa loɡla kwaa la.
Dɛ nɛra kpɔ dukure ne yakwane waa leɡa dɛɛ la weela tena be, asɛ ba weelare ɛɛ le ba nɛ, asɛ ba bini banɔ la kwaa aa dɛ ir ba nɛɛ la ɡe kwaa la ɛɛ le ba nɛ.
Dɛ Juu tena bane lɔ bela dɛ yon ɡaaɡe dɛɛ doŋi kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛ.
Ba ɡe fe dɛ nyin dɛ kpɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu sɔn dɛɛ doŋi a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ dɛ yon dɛɛ kɔɡra ŋɔ, “Yeesu Pɔɔl aa dɛ bol o waa la sɔn ta, hé le kɛ yaa dɛ ŋɔ he be nɔ!” Dɛ Juu tena Sɔfonomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Skiiva la bibaala banuanɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ.
Awola bɛl, baa ŋɔa ba kpɔ Yeesu sɔn doŋi kwaa nomɛl nɛɛ la, a ɡelɔ o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N jemɛ Yeesu, dɛ jemɛ Pɔɔl ɡe.
Asɛ he ɡe, heyaa bamewaɔ?” Ate, dɛ baa la kwaa aa dɛ ir o nɛɛ la ɡuɡ ba dɛ lɔɔ ba, dɛ a ɔma.
O do ba bola, dɛ kɛɛ ba laala dɛ wur ba, asɛ ba chwa le o dem bela.
Juu tena ne Grik tena baa lɔ Ɛfesos la bwa no ɡɛ waa nɔ, asɛ ɔmee laɡ ba kɛrɛdɛ.
Gɛ waa nɔ aa chiɡa la, bela tena ta Yeesu waa la wesale liire kpa.
Ba ɔmɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Name nɛra baa yaradaa la kɛrɛdɛ le bombaah dɛɛ bol wechɔɡa baa ɛa, dɛɛ sɛh ba chɔɡre.
Asɛ ba bini bane baa ɛ dobodobo ka mɔɔ dɛ ɛ asɔre tena la le ba tɔne baa nyiŋi a bini dɛɛ ɛ dobodobo la ne, dɛ kpaa nii do a ta bombaah bela.
Baa kari tɔne la suuɡa la, aa do kanee.
Aa tel suuɡapoŋa kaɡboŋa fifraanuee.
Gɛ ŋwɛnɛkpeɡ nɔ taa a che Korowii waa la perɛ, dɛ won do kpeɡri kohona.
Gɛ waa nɔ habɔɔ la, Pɔɔl ɛ o liire kɛŋɔ wɛɛ la Makidoonia harɛ ne Akaya harɛ taa, dɛ ka kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ŋɔ dɛ o la a bwa ta naa, a chɛ kɛ o la Rom ɡba.
O tomɛ o bonɔɔna banɛ baa dɛ yer ba Timoti ne Erastos la, asɛ ba tɔ o sie kaa Makidoonia harɛ.
Kɛ o te soɡe Eesia harɛ ta tama.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ Ɛfesos tena baa wola asɔre tena ɛɛ la lɛ ɡaeh nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ ŋwɛnɛfale la ta la nɛ.
Gwine te bɛl lɔ bela baa yerɔ Demetreɔs.
O kpɔ suuɡapoŋa dɛɛ kwaa bela voɡ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Aatemes la dea chaa, asɛ ɡɛ toma la ɛɛ tɛ o ne o bala tom-ɛɛra tɔnɔ tenten.
O yerɛ o tom-ɛɛra la bwa ne nɛra o ne baa dɛ ɛ tonsiwi beŋkpoŋ la bwa, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Yabala, he jemɔ kɛ toma nɔ taa a che ya do wer la.
Kɛ taraken, he ɡbabir na waa Pɔɔl nɔ aa dɛ ɛ, dɛ no waa waa dɛ bol.
Ɛfesos bonɔ ɡbo laa wɛɛ ɛ o waa nɔ.
Eesia harɛ kɛrɛdɛ bwaa wɛɛ ɛa.
O wono berɛ nɛndamanta bwa liire baa teŋɛ waa waa dɛ baɡle la ta.
O waa waa dɛ bol laanee kɛ voɡa nɛwɛnyini ɡbaɡba aa kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ ɛa la ta kasinteŋ dɔe.
Waa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ nɔ, n dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ ya toma nɔ sɔn bɛ ba chɔɡ.
Ya toma nɔ ɡbo sɔn laa dɛɛ ba chɔɡa.
Ya voɡjen Aatemes dea nɔ nɛra aa dɛ maŋkurao nɔ, baa on komɛlbwa yera ba kpa, ásɛ o sɔn sewɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpo voɡ baa dɛ tomɔ Eesia harɛ ne bobɛlbwa la sɔn kwaraa!
Baa on ɔmɛ kpa.” Nɛra la aa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ba bwaawee iro, asɛ baa dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ya Ɛfesos tena voɡ Aatemes nɔ dɔŋ toole!” Ate, dɛ ɡbɔɡa tɔ bwɛjen la bwa, asɛ nɛnlaa la aa dɛ do ɡbɔɡa la lawɛ nɛra bane baa dɛ yer ba Gayos ne Aristakus la.
Makidoonia harɛ tenaa ban, asɛ ba ne Pɔɔl ɛɛ valɛ.
Nɛra la tɛɡ ba la bela ba bwɛɛ tena aa chema dɛɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la.
Pɔɔl fe dɛ nyin nɛra la be bela laŋa, kɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ la ta on ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ.
Dɛ o daamanaree Eesia harɛ nomonome la bane.
Ba tomɛ nɛra ŋɔ bá ka kaoh ŋɔ o bɛ lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ tire nɛra la baah belaa.
Nɛnlaa la kɛrɛdɛ aa jemɛ waa la waa baa cheme bela.
Dɛ ba bwa aa wesiwi beŋkpoŋ bol.
Bane nyɛɡa tɔɔ ba bol waa chaɡɛ bonɔ, dɛ bane ɡe bol ba kwaa chaɡɛ le.
Dɛ ba bwa dɛ bol waa saɡasaɡa ken, asɛ ɡbɔɡa tɔ bela bwa.
Bela Juu tena fe ɡelɔ ba bini bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Alɛksanda la ir che, dɛ fe tɔh ba nyoa ŋɔ ba laa ba waa la ne.
Anee o kpɔ nɔn ɛɡ ba ŋɔ bá tɔ nyoa, ásɛ o fe tɔh o bwɛɛ tena nyoa.
Nɛra la te ne o nae kɛ Juu tee on, dɛ ba pɛo dɛɛ bol kohona ŋɔ, “Ya Ɛfesos tena voɡ Aatemes nɔ dɔŋ toole!” Ba si ɡɛ naaa dɔŋhwere anɛ bwa.
Belaa ba bwɛjen karake nomoa waa chɔ ba nyoa la le dɛ ɡel ba tɔ nyoa.
Baa tɔ nyoa la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Yabala Ɛfesos tena, nomɛlbwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya bwɛɛ nɔɔ dɔ ya voɡjen Aatemes voɡ dea dɛɛ nyiŋi o ta.
Yanee dɔ Aatemes bwe la aa le Korowii doa ba le harɛ la ɡe.
Tɔŋla toole ɡɛ waa nɔ te ta.
Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, a chɛ kɛ he tɔ nyoa dɛɛ nyiŋi.
A ta chɛ kɛ he ɛ waane dɛ ba le waa nɛ.
Nɛra nɔ ta ya voɡ nɔ komɛlbwa ŋwɛɛ, ba ta on sisa wobol ɡe bolɛ.
Aah dɛ bala haa ba ba ne bonɔ nɔ mun ɔ?
Nomɛl ɛ Demetreɔs ne o bala waane aa, kɔɔto deene lole, nomonome baa dɛ bol waa a ta la ɡe lole.
Bá ka samane dɔŋa bela.
Gɛ ɡe laa aa, dɛ waane ta lole naa, tɔɔ la wee bwɛɛ nɔ nomonome aa cheme la, bá kpɔ bil ba sie.
Yaa dɛ do ɡbɔɡa ken nɔ, ya ta kɛrɛdɛ nyiŋaa, baa koh a waa lawɛ yaa.
Ba lawɛ yaa ɡe aa, yaa wobɛlbwaa dɔ bol, dɛ́ baɡle ɡbɔɡa nɔ mun.” Waa bol waa nɔ ɡɛ la, o ɡelɔ nɛra la peɡre.
Pɔɔl berɔ la Makidoonia ne Grik tena harɛ Gbɔɡa la nyoa aa sɔɔhna la, Pɔɔl yerɛ bela asɔre tena la cheme, dɛ do ba ɡbemba, dɛ kal ba, dɛ kaa Makidoonia harɛ.
O kpɔ baah bela bwɛɛre la ta, dɛ bol waa baɡ ba taeh dɛ ja ba, dɛ le bela ba Grik tena harɛ ta.
O di korobie atoro bela mɔɔ dɛ kpɔ o te, dɛ́ fe kpɔ stiimae kaa Siiria harɛ.
Waa dɛ kpɔ o te dɛ́ kaa la taa o na kɛŋɔ bela Juu tena dɛ vɔrɔwe dɛ́ lawɔ.
Belaa o berɛ laa berɛ kpɔ Makidoonia harɛ dɛ kaa.
Perɔs bie Sopata waa le Bɛrea la teŋɛ Pɔɔl nɛɛ kaa.
Aristakus ne Sɛkondos baa le Tesalonika la ɡe la bɛl.
Gɛɛ Gayos waa le Dɛɛbe la, ne Tichikos ne Trɔfemos baa le Eesia harɛ la ɡe la bɛl.
Timoti ɡe la bɛl.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ tɔ sie dɛ ka so kpa Pɔɔl ne men maa dɛ chwerɛ waa nɔ Troas.
Ya tɔpejena yaa dɛ di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta la ɡarɔ mɔɔ ya che Felepae jo stiimae bini.
Yaa le Felepae la, a tɔpera anuee ya ba puu ba Troas.
Ya di yawanyoa Troas bela.
Pɔɔl berɔ la Troas Memene wee jɔmɔra ne la, ya asɔre tena la chemo dɛ di kondikwaa ya Dɔɔ aa kpɔa ja yaa ŋɔ yá kpɔ dɛɛ lii o waa la, asɛ Pɔɔl bol Korowii Waa dɛɛ baɡle yaa.
Dɛ o fe dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ tɔɔ peraa ó kaa, anomanta, o bol waa ka tel harambaŋa.
Dɛ abrɔsane bɛl doaa ya cheme, asɛ kandere do bela pirim.
Dɛ bonɔɔ bɛl soɡe tokoro ta baa yerɔ Yutikus.
Pɔɔl aa bol waa biɡri la, dom lawɛ Yutikus kɛrɛdɛ.
Waa dɛ chɔ la, o le tokoro la ta abrɔsane la doa le harɛ.
Dɛ ɡɛ dea laanee chɔŋa tooro abrɔsane la deene aa chɔŋra la ta.
Baa ɡɔɔro, dɛ o sewɔ.
Anee Pɔɔl tu harɛ dɛ ka pi o nɛ, dɛ ɡbaaro pɛl o bambile, o berɛ wee.
Asɛ Pɔɔl ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ɔmɛ, o siwi lole.” Asɛ Pɔɔl berɛ deeh abrɔsane la dɛ ka di kwa, asɛ o ne ba bol waa la sie ka tel kɛ tɔ aa pera mɔɔ o kaa.
Ate, nɛra la sie lɛo kohona kɛŋɔ bie la aa ira la, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa dem.
Pɔɔl le Troas dɛ ba Miletus Ya kaa kpɔ ya stiimae la kaa bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Asos la ta.
Dɛ ya fe dɛ lii kɛ ya ka kpɔ Pɔɔl Asos bela, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ya ne o vɔrɔwɔ asɛ o ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔ harɛɛ dɛɛ cheme yaa bela.
Waa baa pu yaa Asos la, ya kpɔɔ ya stiimae la ta, asɛ ya ne o ba Mitiliini.
Tɔ aa pera la, ya berɔ kpɔ stiimae la le bela dɛ ba chɔ ekwi bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Keɔs la jwɛh.
Tɔ aa pera ja la, ya ba bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Samos la ta.
Asɛ tɔ aa bera per ja la, ya ba bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Maeletus ta.
Yaa dɛ ba la, ya ta Ɛfesos cheɡɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Pɔɔl aa nyin kɛ o ba biɡri Eesia harɛ ta.
O dɛ nyin kɛ o won tel Jerusalam warane mɔɔ ba Pɛntekɔs Tɔpejen la tel.
Pɔɔl cheɡɛ Maeletus kal Ɛfesos asɔre tena nomonome ŋɔ bá ba o be Maeletus.
Baa bala la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Le awola maa ba he be Eesia harɛ bonɔ la ba le fini, he na n da maa kpoŋa bwa.
N kpɔ n te kɛ n Dɔɔ Yeesu bonɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ o toma nɔ sipwɛra ne.
N koh he nyoɡra haa nyoɡre Korowii ŋwɛnɛ waa dɛ yon dɛɛ wi.
Juu tena aa dɛ vɔrɔwe n vɔrɔwa la, a noo mɛ taeh.
N ta wobɛlbwa kpɔe sɔh heya.
Wobɛlbwa aa le tɔnɔ tɛ heyaa la, n ta a ta tɔe.
N baɡle nɛra Korowii Waa cheremibɔra, dɛ baɡle o waa he deremi.
Juu tena ne Grik tena bwa bee n bol, dɛ ja ba ŋɔ bá charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta dɛ́ ba Korowii be, dɛ́ yarada Yeesu dɛ́ kpɔ ba te tɛo.
Taraken nɔ, Jerusalamee mɛɛ kaa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpɔ bela laŋa do n bambile ta maa wola won vɛh.
Dɛ waane ɛɛ puu mɛɛ belaa yaa, maa jemɛ.
Waa maa jema bwaa kɛŋɔ bwɛjen bɛlbwa ta maa la la, ɡɛɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe che nɛra nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ wahala ne dea chɔe chɔ n sie dɛɛ kpaa mɛ.
N waane laa n ɡbaɡba hweera wa.
Waa aa swɛɛ n siwi laanee kɛ, ɡɛ maa ɛ dɛ tonɛ toma n Dɔɔ Yeesu aa tɛ mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ la.
N tomaa kɛ ń bol Amanesoma la nɛra be bá jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ nyin ba chae.
Taraken nɔ, n jemɔ kɛ he nɛra maa valɛ he nɛɛ dɛ bol Korowii Kora nɔ waa he be nɔ, haa men na kpa bwa.
Mɛɛ di heyaa kasinteŋii fini.
He bɛlbwa baa nyoɡre Korowii ŋwɛnɛ aa, n laa ɛ waane, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n ta waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin la wobɛlbwa kpɔe sɔh heya.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa kpɔ ba do he nɔn ta ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la kɛrɛdɛ.
Korowii Bie ɡbaɡba chalee o kpɔ yawɛ o nɛra asɛ ba ɛ o kwa, anomanta, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ maa dɛ kaa nɔ, nɛnchɔɡa ɛɛ jo he binii kɛŋɔ peteɡre toole naa, ɡboli yon jo peera baah dɛɛ larawa la.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba bini bane ɛɛ dɛɛ bol waa aa wola weree, dɛ́ neɡre nɛra ásɛ ba ɡel Yeesu nɛɛ teŋa dɛɛ teŋɛ ba nɛ.
A waa n ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ŋɔ he bɛ ba soh kɛ n fa aa lɔ he be bene atoro bwa dɛ yon dɛɛ ja heyaa Korowii waa ta tɔpebii te bɛlbwa, dɛ koh he waa dɛɛ wi la.
N kpɔ heyaa do Korowii nɔn ta ásɛ o kpoŋe heya, ásɛ o nɛra nɛɛ suna waa la won do he bambile bini ásɛ he do kpeɡri, dɛ́ won di kapɛrɛsom la waa ɛa cheɡ nɛra waa laa ba doŋa bwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ asɛ ba ɛ o ɡbo nɛra la.
N sie ta nomɛlbwa suuɡa kɛɛ o yal ta beɡrɛ.
He ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ maa lɔ he be la, bɔwɔbee n kwee mɔɔ n ne nɛra baa teŋɛ n nɛɛ la ɛɛ dɔ ya komɛlbwa.
N cheɡɛ n we-ɛɛla ta dɛ baɡle heyaa kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ya swɛɛ siwi ɛ toma ken, ásɛ dɛ won dɛɛ cha nɛra baa wola kpeɡe la.
A chɛ kɛ yaa lii waa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɡbaɡba aa bola ŋɔ, ‘Nɛn waa dɛ kɛ nɛra kwaa la, o dɛ na som o bwara ɛɛ sɔɔhno, dɛ ɡwaa nɛn baa dɛ kɛo kwaa’ la.” Pɔɔl aa bol waa tonɛ la, o ɡuŋi harɛ, asɛ o ne ba soŋe Korowii.
Baa ira la, ba lawɔ ɡbaa ba bambile, dɛ kpɔ wii dɛ kalo.
Waa la aa ɡela ba loo ku kohona laanee kɛŋɔ waa ŋɔa baa on na kpa bwa la.
Baa ɡwao tonɛ la, ba doo ŋwɛnɛ la stiimae la bɔr.
Pɔɔl la Jerusalam Yaa le ba be la, ya jo stiimae bini dɛ pa sie kaa Kɔs, asɛ tɔ aa pera la, ya la Roods, dɛ ka che bela kaa Patara.
Belaa ya na kɛŋɔ stiimae bɛl aa ba dɛ kaa Finiisia harɛ ta, asɛ ya jo o bini dɛ kaa, dɛ ba le bobɛl dɛ na ekwi bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Saepros la, dɛ berɛ pa sie weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛ ka le Siiria harɛ ta, dɛ ka tu Taaya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ belaa stiimae la ɛɛ ba bone aa lɔ o bini la ne.
Ya nyin asɔre tena baa lɔ bela la bɔr, dɛ so ba be yawanyoa.
Bela la Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ɡelɔ ba ŋɔ Pɔɔl be ŋɔ o bɛ Jerusalam la.
Ya kaala aa tela la, ya le bela dɛ chiɡ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa.
Ba ne ba haahna ne bii bwaa baa do yaa ŋwɛnɛ dɛ le bwɛɛ la ta, dɛ ka tel nee nyoa, asɛ ya ɡuŋi harɛ nee nyoa bela dɛ soŋe Korowii dɛ kal dɔŋa.
Yaa kal dɔŋa tonɛ la, ya jo stiimae bini, asɛ ba kaa dem.
Ya le Taaya ba Tɔlemaes dɛ ba chɔɔ bela asɔre tena, dɛ so ba be tɔpebeŋkpoŋ.
Tɔ aa pera la, ya le bela dɛ ba Sisaaria, dɛ ba choɡ Felep.
Dɛ o ɛ nɛra banuanɛ ba fa aa lee ba Jerusalam ŋɔ báa nyiŋi suuɡa waa ta la bɛl.
Dɛ o dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ bol Korowii Wa.
Dɛ o dɔ bihaahna banaarɛ baa wola yalɛ bwa, asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la cha ba ba yon dɛɛ bol Korowii Wa.
Ya biɡri bela tama, asɛ Korowii keame bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Aɡabus la le Juda harɛ ba.
Waa ba ya be la, o baa kpɔ Pɔɔl kiriso, dɛ vɔrɔwe o ɡbaɡba nɔɔra ne nakpale dɛ ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ, “Kenii Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ŋɔ, Juu tena ɛɛ vɔrɔwe kiriso nɔ te kenii Jerusalam, dɛ kpɔɔ do nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ nɔn ta.” Yaa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ya ne asɔre tena baa lɔ bela la soŋe Pɔɔl ŋɔ o bɛ Jerusalam la.
Belaa o ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ wi ken dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he do mɛ bɔhwaah nɔɔ?
Baa vɔɡ mɛɛ Jerusalamee yaa, n sɛh ɡɛ.
Baa kpo mɛɛ ɡe kwaraa naa, n sɛh ɡɛ.
Baa koh n Dɔɔ Yeesu waa dɛ ɛɛ mɛ anɔ bɛlbwa naa, n waane laa.
N sɛh ɡɛ waa nɔ wubwa bambile bwa ne.” Ya bol harɛ bini waa nɔ bwa o be, o ta noɛ.
Anomanta, ya ɡelo dɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin a ɛ la, á ɛ ɡɛ.” A habɔɔ la, ya kpɔ ya bone dɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Yeesu habɔteŋra baa le Sisaaria la bane ɡe teŋɛ ya nɛɛ la, dɛ tɔ ya sie la ya ne baa la ya fe aa dɛ ba o dea choɡa la dem.
O le Saepros, dɛ ɛ nɛnloɡla baa lɛ Yeesu waa la bɛl, asɛ baa yerɔ Meesan.
Pɔɔl kaa tel Jerusalam Yaa ba Jerusalam la, asɔre tena la lɛ yaa silɛɛ ne.
Tɔ aa pera la, Pɔɔl kpɔ yaa la Jems be, dɛ asɔre tena nomonome la bwa lɔ bela.
Pɔɔl ne ba lea dɔŋa, asɛ o baɡle waa bwa Korowii aa chao o won ɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la harɛre ta.
Baa no Pɔɔl waa la, ba jam Korowii taeh.
Belaa ba ɡe ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nomoa, taraken nɔ, yaa won jemɛ Juu tena baa yarada ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nɔ nyoa baɡle.
Ba warɔ kohona.
Ba sie beɡre Mosis Mmara la ɡe ta taeh.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ bwa noɔ kɛŋɔ haa dɛ ɡaaɡe la, he ka dɛ baɡle Juu tena baa lɔ harɛre aa wola Juu tena harɛre ɛɛ ta la ŋɔ bá ɡel Mosis Mmara la ta teŋa.
Hale ba ŋɔ he ŋɔ bá ɡel ba bii pena teŋa, dɛ ŋɔ ba bɛ Juu tena kii te bɛlbwa ta dɛɛ teŋɛ.
Mosis Mmara ɡe ta ŋwɛnɛ ɡɛ tɛɛ.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ ɛɛ noo kɛŋɔ he balɔ.
Anomanta, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?
Yaa baɡlee ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ he ɛ. Baala banaarɛ bane baɡɛ Korowii nyoa bonɔ.
Kpɔ ba la Korowii Dea, ásɛ he ne ba ka pɛ ɛ we-ɛɛla haa dɛ ba ɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ laa doŋa kpɔ he nɛɛ la.
He laŋaa, hé bɔ ba kem aa chɛ kɛ ba bɔ waa la ta la tɛɛ ba, ásɛ ba won fonɛ ba nyuune.
He ɛ ken aa, nɛra bwa ɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ haŋaa ba haŋɛ he nyoa.
Baa nao kɛŋɔ he ɡbabir dɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara la ta.
Asɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛ yarada Yeesu waa la ɡe la, ya chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛɛ ba ŋɔ ba bɛ voɡ kwaa ne chal ne ol baa wola o baŋa teŋe o sewɛ la dɛɛ di, dɛ ŋɔ bá laa ba te dɛɛ kpɔ jwamane waa ta.” Baa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, Pɔɔl lɛ nɛra banaarɛ la, asɛ tɔ aa pera la, o ne ba ka ɛ we-ɛɛla la ásɛ ba doŋa le ba nɛ.
Baa tona la, Pɔɔl kaa jo Korowii Dea bini dɛɛ baɡle tɔpera aa di mɔɔ ba kpoo ba bɛlbwa koŋkwaare, ásɛ ba we-ɛɛla la tonɛ.
Dɛ a lɔ tɔpera anuanɛ.
Ba lawɛ Pɔɔl Korowii Dea Tɔpera anuanɛ la aa ba dɛ tel a jaɡa la, Juu tena bane baa le Eesia harɛ pera la na Pɔɔl Korowii Dea, dɛ bol waa dɛ ir nɛra bwaawee, dɛ lawɔ, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Israel tena, hé ba cha yaa oo!
Baa nɔɔ vala dɛɛ bol waa bobɛlbwa dɛɛ yaɡɛ ya Israel tena ne Mosis Mmara ne Korowii Dea nɔ la.
Name te kwara doŋaa o kpɔ baa jo ya Korowii Dea nɔ bini.
Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, Grik tena baa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba jo Korowii Dea la, banee o lawɛ baa jo o bini!” Dɛ ba na o ne baa bɛl waa le Ɛfesos baa yerɔ Trɔfemos la bwɛjen Jerusalam bela.
A waa ba ŋɔ ɡɛ la, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Pɔɔl jo o ne ba Korowii Dea la bini.
Ate, bwɛɛ la tena bwa lɛ ɡaeh, dɛ chwa le bobɛlbwa dɛ lawɛ Pɔɔl, dɛ tuuɡu le Korowii Dea la bini.
Buɡ la ta, dɛ ba tɔɔɡe Korowii Dea la ɡbeni bwa.
Nɛra la aa cheɡɛ Pɔɔl kpoe naa ta la, nɛra kaa ŋɔ Rom soojanomonjen waa dɛ nyiŋi bela soojare nɛɛ la be ŋɔ Jerusalam tena bwa lɛ ɡaeh.
Ate, nomoa la ɡel wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ kpɔ soojanomonome bane baa lɔ o lɔɡa ne soojare bane dɛ chwa la bela baa dɛ lɔɔ Pɔɔl la.
Nɛra la aa na nomoa la wɛɛ ba soojare ne la, ba ɡel Pɔɔl lɔɔra.
Nomoa la baa lawɛ Pɔɔl dɛ ɡel ba doo jɔɡrɔre, dɛ bɔɔ nɛra la ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo baa nɔɔ?
Webesoo o ɛɔ?” Ate, dɛ ba dɛ nyɛɡ bobɛlbwa, bane ɛɛ bol anɔ, bane ɡee bol ane soo siwi.
Baa dɛ do ɡbɔɡa ɡɛ la, o ta wone jemɛ waa la kasinteŋ, dɛ ŋɔ bá lawɛ Pɔɔl ka do soojare dejen bini.
Ba dɛ kaa dɛ ka tel dea la sanjol baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ jo o bini la ta, asɛ nɛra la ɛɛ nyin ba kpo Pɔɔl.
Anee soojare la lɛo le ba be, dɛ ɡɔɔro dawɛ ba vaama ta.
Dɛ nɛra teŋɔ dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé kpoo!
Hé kpoo!” Pɔɔl bol waa baɡle nɛra pirim Soojare la aa dɛ ba Pɔɔl ne dea la bini joe la, o bol waa ba nomonjen la be dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n dɛ nyin n bol waane he be tama.” Belaa nomoa la ŋɔ, “He dɛ no Grik wobol aa?
Jamɔ Ijipt te la waa bala baah bɛl ta, dɛ ba wetɔŋla ne, dɛ yo Abane nomonome asɛ dɛ jo nɛŋkpoora kaɡboŋa banaarɛ baa kpoŋe dɔmkwaa la ne kpɔɡ bini laanee hen kɛɛ?” Anee Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Juu te e men.
Silisia harɛ bwɛjen baa dɛ yerɔ Taasos la biee men.
N poori, tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń bol waa nɛra nɔ be.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, nomoa la tɛo ŋwɛnɛ, asɛ o che dea la sanjol ta dɛ kpɔ nɔn ɛɡɛ nɛra la ŋɔ bá tɔ nyoa.
Ba tɔ nyoa surumm ken, asɛ Pɔɔl kpɔ Aram tena wobol dɛɛ bol waa ba be, dɛ ŋɔ.
“N mɛɛwa ne n dɔɔranarwa, hé do deŋna n be ásɛ n bol n kon hé no.” Baa noa kɛŋɔ ba ɡbaɡba wobolee wɛɛ bol ba be la, ba tɔ nyoa jeiih ken, asɛ Pɔɔl ɛɛ bol o wa, dɛ ŋɔ, “Juu tee men.
Silisia harɛ bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Taasos la taa ba lol mɛ.
Kɛ bwɛjen Jerusalam bonɔɔ ba dɛɛ mɛ, asɛ Gamaleɛl chaɡ mɛ kwa, dɛ baɡ mɛ ya naawa kii bwa, asɛ mɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
N sie beɡrɔ mɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ he bɛlbwa aa dɛ tomɔ fini nɔ.
Dɛ n fa cheɡɛ nɛra baa teŋɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛfale nɔ ta nɔ nɛɛ dɛɛ nyin ba dɛ́ kpo, dɛ lawɛ ba baala ne haahna bwa do deene.
Sɔfonomoa ne ya Juu tena nomonome bwa ɛɛ wonoo di danseɛ kɛŋɔ kpelaa n ŋɔ.
Banee fa chwerɛ tɔne tɛ mɛ, ásɛ n won kpɔ la yabala Juu tena baa lɔ Damaskɔs la be, ásɛ ba tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń won lawɛ ŋwɛnɛfale la tena baa lɔ bela, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ba Jerusalam ásɛ ba ka ɛɛ ba wahala.
Maa dɛ la dɛ ka tel Damaskɔs la, kerabeŋkpoŋ dɛ nii le nyundua dɛ chaah n nɛɛ kohona dɛ bar mɛ cheme.
Dɛ wee cheɡɛ nyufala.
Belaa n chole harɛ.
Maa chola la, n no taa bɛl o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Oo, Sɔɔl!
Ɛrɛɛ he che n nɛɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?’ Belaa n ŋɔ, ‘Henee umeo, n Dɔɔ?’ Asɛ o ŋɔ, ‘Menee Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt la.
Menee hɛɛ yo la.’ Dɛ n ne nɛra banee dɛɛ kaa.
Ba na nii la te, kɛ ba ta naate waa dɛ bol waa n be la wobol te noɛ.
Belaa n pɛɛro ŋɔ, ‘N Dɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba ɛɛ yɔ?’ Asɛ o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Ir la Damaskɔs ásɛ Korowii ka baɡle waa waa dɛ nyin kɛ he ɛ.’ Nii la aa chaah n sie kohona la, a ɡelɔ n nyoŋe.
Anomanta, nɛra n ne baa dɛ kaa laanee bera laɡ mɛ da dɛ ba n ne Damaskɔs.
Damaskɔs bela la, dɛ baa bɛl lole baa yerɔ Ananias.
Dɛ o ɛ nɛn waa dɛ tomɛ Korowii kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara la ɡe ta kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ Juu tena baa lɔ bela la bwa ɛɛ tɛo duure kohona.
Ananias baa che n be dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N dɔɔ Sɔɔl, Korowii ɡel he sie pili.’ Buɡ la ta, dɛ n denɔ berɛ dɛɛ na, dɛ nao.
Asɛ o ŋɔ, ‘Korowii ya naawa fa aa dɛ tomɔ la, onee lee tɛ o te ŋɔ hé jemɛ waa waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ won no o Bidɛɛɡe la ɡbaɡba wobol, dɛ́ nao ɡe.
O ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ he won di danseɛ tɛo nɛra bwa be waa haa naa bwa ta, ne waa haa noa bwa ta.
Anomanta, bɛ berɛ so kpa.
Gel ba sɔe Korowii ne, ásɛ he yerɛ Yeesu sɔn dɛ́ soŋo ó kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛɛ.’ A habɔɔ la, n berɔ kaa Jerusalam.
Belaa n kaa soŋe Korowii o Dea bini dɛ na chaahna.
N na n Dɔɔ Yeesu, asɛ o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Le Jerusalam warane.
N waa nɔ haa dɛ di a danseɛ nɔ, Jerusalam tena aa a noe ba.’ Belaa n ŋɔ, ‘N Dɔɔ, ba ɡbabir na ɡɛ n fa aa la cheremi deene bini, dɛ kaa lɔɔ nɛra baa yarada he waa nɔ, dɛɛ do ba deene.
Gɛ saŋ baa kpo Steeven o fa aa dɛ di he waa nɔ danseɛ la, dɛ n lɔ bela dɛ sɛh ŋɔ o chɛ kpoe.
Hale baala la aa dɛ kaa bá ka kpoo dɛ wur ba yale la, men lɛa kpoŋe.’ Anee o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Kaa!
Mɛɛ ɡeloo he kaa bojaŋ, dɛ́ la nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ be.’ ” Pɔɔl aa dɛ bol o waa la bwa dɛ nɛra la bwa cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no o be.
Kɛ waa ba dɛ bol nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ be laŋa waa la, ba baah diu baa nyɛɡ kohona dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé le o ne!
Bɔkwaa he ɡel o che dɛɛ ɛɔ?” Ba baah diu, asɛ baa nyɛɡ, dɛɛ viwe ba yale, dɛ ɛ teera dɛɛ ta nyundua.
Anomanta, soojanomonjen la ɡelɔ ba kpɔ Pɔɔl jo dea.
Dɛ o ta wone jemɛ waa aa bala nɛra la ɛɛ nyɛɡ ɡɛ la.
Anomanta, o ŋɔ bá lɔɔ Pɔɔl bampɔrɔ ŋwɛɛra ne, dɛ́ ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa ásɛ o fe sɛh chɔɡre dɛ bol kasinteŋ.
Baa ŋɔa ba lɔɔro la, o pɛɛ ba bini nomoa la ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛ lole kɛŋɔ he lɔɔ Rom te dɛ ba ta o waa bolɛ dɛ́ na wechɔɡa waa ɛa aa?” Pɔɔl aa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, sooja la kaa ŋɔ ba nomonjen la be ŋɔ, “Dɛɛ do baa nɔ dɛɛɡɔ, dɛ bɛ on wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛ. Rom tee on.” Belaa nomoa la ba pɛɛ Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Rom tee hen aa?” Asɛ Pɔɔl sɛh ŋɔ Rom tee on.
Anee nomoa la ŋɔ, “Bɛlee n ɡba, kɛ n bɔ kem taeh mɔɔ dɛ won ɛ Rom te nɔ.” Belaa Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Rom tee lolɛ n te n ɛ Rom te.” Buɡ la ta, dɛ nɛra ba fe aa dɛ ba Pɔɔl lɔɔra la le habɔɔ.
Nomoa la ɡe aa naa kɛ Rom tee Pɔɔl asɛ o ɡel ba do jɔɡrɔre la, o ɔmɔ.
Pɔɔl kaa che Juu tena nomonome sie Nomoa la dɛ nyin o jemɛ waa la Pɔɔl aa ɛa asɛ Juu tena la baah di o nɛɛ la kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, tɔ aa pera la, o ɡelɔ ba le Pɔɔl dea, dɛ ɡel Sɔfonomonome ne Juu tena nomonome baa dɛ bol waa la bwa cheme.
Baa chema la, o ɡelɔ Pɔɔl ba che ba sie.
Waa baa che nomonome la bwa sie la, o nyiŋ ba, dɛ ŋɔ, “Yabala, n bambile bwa nee n tomɛ Korowii le saŋ la bwa ba le fini.
N liire ta men ɛɛ kɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa bwa.” Asɛ Ananias waa ɛ Sɔfonomoa la ŋɔ nɛ́ra baa cheɡɛ Pɔɔl jwɛɛh la kpaa o nyoa ta.
Belaa Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ lɔe bɔ kem, nɛra sie ta ɡboo he ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ dekɔɔh baa lɔɔ fula.
Haa chema nɔ, ɡɛ Mmara aa chaɡla laa hɛɛ ba nyiŋa dɛ́ bol n wa aa?
Aah dɛ haa ŋɔa bá lɔɔ mɛ nɔ, dɛ Mmara tɛ ŋwɛnɛ ɡɛ naa?” Anee nɛra baa cheɡɛ Pɔɔl jwɛɛh la ŋɔ, “Hei!
Sɔfonomoaa hɛɛ chɛɡre naa?” Asɛ Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Yabala, n ta jemɛ kɛ Sɔfonomoaa on.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ ŋwɛnɛ toole kɛ nomɛlbwa chɛɡɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi o bwɛɛ tena nɛ.” Pɔɔl nyiŋi nɛra baa cheme bela la dɛ na kɛŋɔ bane ɛ Saduki tena, asɛ bane ɡe ɛ Farisii tena.
Belaa o kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Yabala, Farisii tee men noo!
Farisii tena biee men.
N dɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛ nɛra ɛɛ ir seo taa.
Gɛ hwɛɡa nɔ maa dɔa nɔ waa ba ba n ne ŋɔ hé bol n waa dɛ́ pa bole la!” Waa dena ŋɔ ɡɛ la, wetɔŋla chole Saduki tena la ne Farisii tena la baah.
Ba nyoa ta berɛ pɛ kpa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Farisii tena la te ŋɔ nɛra bwa ɛɛ ba ir seo taa, dɛ ŋɔ lala ɡe lole, dɛ ŋɔ nyundua toroma ɡe lole.
Kɛ dɛ Saduki tena la te aa ɡɛ waa nɔ bɛlbwa yarada.
Ba nyɛɡa la nyoa baa do kpeɡri, asɛ Farisii tena Tɔnjerema la ir che dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa baa nɔ nɛɛ nae.
Bɛl lole komɛl kɛɛ nyundua torome bɛlee bol waa o be!” Ba wetɔŋla la nyoa baa do kpeɡri kohona, asɛ ɔmee berɛ lawɛ soojanomonjen la, asɛ wɛɛ lii kɛ baa tɛɡre Pɔɔlee kpo.
Anomanta, o ɡelɔ o bechale jo nɛra la baah ta, dɛ lɛ Pɔɔl ba nɔn ta, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa soojare dejen baa doo o bini la ta.
Awola jwaana ne la, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu baa che Pɔɔl jwɛh dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɔmɛ.
Hɛɛ di danseɛ tɛ mɛ Rom ɡɛ haa dia tɛ mɛ Jerusalam nɔ.” Pɔɔl kpoe vɔrɔwa Tɔ aa pera la, Juu tena la bane chemo dɛ vɔrɔwe waane.
Ba ŋwɛɛ ntam ŋɔ dɛ ba ta Pɔɔl kpoe yaa, ba bɛlbwa bɛ kwaa di, o bɛ nee nyɔ.
Ba ŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa to ntam la, Kórowii kpoo.
Ba nɛra ba nyoa aa pɛa ba vɔrɔwe ɡɛ waa nɔ la ɡwaa nɛra fifraanaarɛ.
Ba la Sɔfonomonome ne bwɛɛ nomonome be dɛ ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ya ŋwɛɛ ntam ŋɔ dɛ ya ta Pɔɔl kpoe yaa, yaa kwaa di.
Anomanta, hé ne Juu tena nomonome baa dɛ bol waa la tomɛ nɛn soojanomonjen la be ŋɔ ó le Pɔɔl tɛ heya, á do kɛŋɔ haa dɛ nyin he kwaa nyiŋi o waa bini kɛrɛdɛ la.
Ba dɛ ba o ne naa, waa bonɔɔ tel ya te kpoo.” Jaah Pɔɔl nimambie bɛl bibaa no ɡɛ waa la.
Anomanta, o la soojare dejen baa kpɔ Pɔɔl ka do o bini la ta, dɛ ka ŋɔ o be.
Belaa Pɔɔl yerɛ soojanomonome la bɛl dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “La bonɔɔ nɔ ne he nomonjen la be.
O dɔ waane dɛ bol o be.” Sooja la la o ne ba nomoa la be dɛ ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Pɔɔl la baa doo dea laanee yer mɛ dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ ń ba bonɔɔ nɔ ne he be.
O dɔ waane dɛ́ bol he be.” Belaa nomoa la lawɛ bonɔɔ la nɔn dɛ le o ne bokɛre dɛ pɛɛro ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa he dɔ dɛɛ nyin he bol n be nɔ?” Anee bonɔɔ la ŋɔ, “Juu tena vɔrɔwɔ ŋɔ baa ba soŋee ásɛ he kere kpɔ Pɔɔl tɛɛ ba bá la o ne ba nomonome baa dɛ bol waa la sie, á do kɛŋɔ baa dɛ nyin ba ka kwaa nyiŋi o waa bini kɛrɛdɛ la.
Kɛ bɛ Pɔɔl kpɔ tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛ ba nɛra dɛ ɡwaa fifraanaarɛ sɔh ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ́ kpoo.
Gɛ nɛra la ŋwɛɛ ntam ŋɔ ba ta Pɔɔl kpoe yaa, baa kwaa di, baa nee ɡee nyɔ.
Ba ɛ wobɛlbwa tonɛ.
He siwi taa baa nyiŋi.” Belaa nomoa la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa no kɛŋɔ he bol ɡɛ waa nɔ n be.” O ta bonɔɔ la ŋwɛnɛ o kaa.
Ba kpɔ Pɔɔl ka tɛ harɛ nomoa Fɛlekse Soojanomonjen la yerɛ o soojanomonome la banɛ, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé nyin soojare lafraanɛ, dɛ nyin soojare baa soɡe jaɡre ta dɛɛ yo la ɡe fifraanuanɛ, ne soojare baa dɛ yo lampea ne la lafraanɛ ásɛ ba la Sisaaria fini jwaana dɔŋ anuanaarɛ saŋ.
Nyin konteehna tɛ Pɔɔl ásɛ o so bɛl ta, dɛ́ la o ne sɔnɔnɔɔ ka tɛ harɛ nomoa Fɛlekse.” Nomoa la chwerɛ tɔn tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá kpɔ ka tɛ harɛ nomoa la.
Kenii o chwerɔ.
Men Klɔdeɔs Lisiasii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ n nomoa Fɛlekse.
He le aa?
Juu tena lawɛ baa nɔ dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin o kpoe, asɛ n ka le ba nɛ, dɛ no kɛ o ɛ Rom te, dɛ kpɔ soojare ka lɛo.
Maa lɛo dɛɛ nyin n jemɛ waa la waa baa dɛ nyin o kpoe la, n kpɔɔ la Juu tena nomonome baa dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la sie.
Belaa n na kɛŋɔ ba kii waa ba lawɔ.
Waa baa kpɔa dawɔ la ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpoo.
A ta chɛ kɛ bá doo dea ɡba.
A habɔɔ la, n berɔ ba no kɛŋɔ ba vɔrɔwe o vɔrɔwa dɛɛ nyin o kpoe, asɛ n ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ń ba o ne he be buɡ ta.
N ŋɔ nɛ́ra o ne baa dɔa la ɡe ba he be, dɛ́ ba baɡle waa la aa lɔ o ne ba baah ta.
N jaɡɛ bonɔ.
Gɛ nomoa la aa baɡle soojare la, ɡɛɛ ba ɛ. Ba kpɔ Pɔɔl le jwaana dɛ ka tel o ne bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Antipatris la.
Asɛ tɔ aa pera la, ba bini banɔ la baa kpɔ naa ta la berɛ ba Jerusalam, dɛ ɡel konteehna tena la, asɛ ba ne Pɔɔl kaa.
Baa kaa tel Sisaaria dɛ kpɔ tɔn la tɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta la, ba kpɔ Pɔɔl ɡe do o nɔn ta.
O kure tɔn la, dɛ pɛɛ Pɔɔl harɛ la ta waa lea.
Pɔɔl aa ŋɔa Silisiaa o le la, nomoa la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nɛra he ne baa dɔa la balaa, mɛɛ bol he waa laanee dɛ́ pa bole.” Dɛ o lɔ Hɛrɔd koodem bɛl ta.
O ŋɔ bá kpɔ Pɔɔl do bela, dɛ ŋɔ bá nyiŋu kɛrɛdɛ.
Pɔɔl waa bola harɛ nomoa Fɛlekse sie Tɔpera anue aa baa ɡale la, Sɔfonomoa Ananias ne nomonome bane ne mmara jereme bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Tɛtolɔs la la Sisaaria.
Ba la ba harɛ nomoa Fɛlekse be bela baa dɛ ba waa bola la, dɛ ka baɡle waa Pɔɔl aa ɛa ba ne o dɔ la.
Ba yerɛ Pɔɔl ba, asɛ Tɛtolɔs den pa mun dɛɛ bɔ nkoro dɛ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, he laworomɛ taraken ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna la sie.
He wono kpɔ ŋwɛnɛfale ta dɛɛ nyiŋi ya harɛ nɔ, asɛ o do som.
Ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta la, ya ne nɛra baa lɔ bojaŋ bobɛlbwa dɛ jaame kohona.
Maa nyin kɛ n kpɔ wobobala lawɛ so biɡri.
Kɛ n poori, lawɛ bambile dɛ no ya wetamaa nɔ.
Nɛnchɔɡe bɛlbwa ta baa nɔ tele!
O ne bɔpɛo aa somɛ!
O toma bwaa kɛ ó valɛ bol waa dɛɛ ir Juu tena bwaawee, ásɛ baa lɛ ɡaeh harɛ bɛlbwa waa la o ta la ta.
Nɛra bane baa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii toma ŋwɛnɛfale bɛl waa wola were la ta asɛ baa yer ba Nasarɛt tena la, ba nomoaa on.
-O fe dɛ nyin dɛ́ lawɛ nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ kwaraa ba jo ya Korowii Dea bini.
Ya ɡe kii ɡɛ kɔkɔkɔkɔ.
A waa ya lawɔ.
He ɡbabir pɛɛro waa, o ɡbaɡba ɛɛ baɡle waa aa bala ya lawɔ laanee.” Ate, dɛ Juu tena baa lɔ bela la bwa deno pɛ dɛ sɛh ŋɔ kasinteŋii ba nɛn la bola la.
Belaa ba harɛ nomoa la kpɔ nɔn ɛ Pɔɔl ŋɔ ó bol wa, asɛ Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Nomoa, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ haa lea di nomonome dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole harɛ nɔ ta biɡro.
Anomanta, a som n be kɛ haa dɛ ba n waa nɔ ta nyiŋa nɔ.
Maa la Korowii soŋebɔr Jerusalam la, a ta tɔpera fi dɛ anɛ kwaraa ɡwaalɛ.
He dɛ nyin hé pɛɛ no.
Maa la bela la, n ne nomɛlbwa ta wobɛlbwa tɔŋlɛ.
N ta nɛra ɡe doe ŋɔ bá ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Korowii Dea oo, cheremi dea oo, bwɛɛ bini noo, n ta nɛra doe a bɛlbwa bini ŋɔ bá ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Ba ta danseɛ bɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ chaɡle kɛ n ɛ waa nɔ bɛlbwa baa kpɔa dɛɛ daɡ mɛ nɔ.
Ba waa nɔ bini beŋkpoŋ waa ɛ kasinteŋ laanee kɛ baa ŋɔa ŋɔ ŋwɛnɛ la baa dɛ yerɔ ŋwɛnɛfale la, o taa mɛɛ teŋɛ, dɛ kpɔ o ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ya naawa fa aa dɛ tomɔ la.
N dɛ teŋɛ wobɛlbwa aa lɔ Mosis Mmara bini ne Korowii Keamere Tɔne bini la ta.
N dɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡa ne nɛnchɔɡa bwa ɛɛ berɔɔ ir seo ta.
Nɛra nɔ ɡba dɔ ɡɛ hwɛɡa nɔ.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ ba bol nɛwɛnyina bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Anomanta, n dɛ ɛ n wobɛlbwa naa, n dɛ ɛa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ bolchɔɡe di Korowii ne nɛwɛnyina bwa be.
Nomoa, maa le Jerusalam biɡro, asɛ n la bela ŋɔ ń kpɔ suuɡa ane ka tɛ n bala Juu tena ba soɡa bini aa kpeɡa tɛɛ ba, ásɛ dɛ ɛ n saraha ane.
Baa na mɛ Korowii Dea la, dɛ ɡɛ saraha nɔɔ mɛɛ ɛ. Dɛ n dɔɔ laa n doŋa kpɔ n nɛɛ tonɛ, dɛ fonɛ n nyu tonɛ.
Dɛ nɛnlaa bɛlbwa ta n nɛɛ jae a ba ɛ kɛ bá lɛ ɡaeh.
Dɛ Juu tena bane baa le Eesia harɛ lɔ bela.
Dɛ n ɛɛ ba waane aa, a chɛ kɛ ba ɡbaɡba fe aa lɔ bonɔ dɛ́ fe baɡle.
Gɛ laa ɡe aa, hé ɡel nɛra nɔ baa lɔ bonɔ nɔ baɡle, dɛ ɡɛ saŋ baa laɡ mɛ ka cheme Juu tena nomonome sie la, dɛ ba na n wechɔɡe bɛl aa?
Webeŋkpoŋ ɡbo waa n jemɛ.
Onee kɛ, awola baa chem mɛ la, n kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, ‘Maa dɛ yarada kɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ ir seo taa la, a waa he laɡ mɛ cheme bonɔ nɔ.’ ” Dɛ Fɛlekse jemɛ ŋwɛnɛfale la waa taeh.
Anomanta, o teŋe wobol la ta, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Dɛ soojanomonjen Lisias balaa, mɛɛ nyiŋi he waa nɔ taa.” Waa teŋe waa la ta la, o ŋɔ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi Pɔɔl nɛɛ la be ŋɔ ó berɛ kaa Pɔɔl ne dea, dɛ ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋu kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ o bɛ on tɔ do dea, asɛ dɛ Pɔɔl daamanar ba o be naa, ó tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ ba baa chao.
Aa baa di tɔpera anɛ la, Fɛlekse ne o haah Drusila ba Sisaaria.
Dɛ Juu tee o haah la.
Fɛlekse ɡelɔ ba ka yerɛ Pɔɔl, asɛ o baa baɡlo ɡɛ baa teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ yaradao.
Pɔɔl aa ba dɛ bol ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa ɡel o waa do kaih, dɛ ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ nyiŋi o te kɛrɛdɛ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, dɛ ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la, Fɛlekse berɔ ɔmɛ dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gel mɔɔ.
Dɛɛ la.
N baa dɔ bɔr ja aa, mɛɛ yerɛɛ.” Dɛ o dɛ lii kɛ Pɔɔl ɛɛ tɛo suuɡaa, anomanta, tama dɛ o yerɔ ŋɔ ó ba ásɛ baa bol wa.
Bene anɛ baa ɡale, asɛ Fɛlekse le kara ta, asɛ Pɔkeɔs Fɛstɔs ba di kara.
Dɛ Fɛlekse dɛ nyin kɛ Juu tena sie lɛ o nɛ, anomanta, o ɡelɔ Pɔɔl ta do dea.
Ba bol Pɔɔl wa Koojen Fɛstɔs sie Fɛstɔs ba Sisaaria dɛ ba di tɔpera atoro, dɛ le bela la Jerusalam.
Waa la bela la, Sɔfonomonome ne Juu tena nomonome kpɔ waa ba ne Pɔɔl aa dɔa bil o sie dɛ soŋo ŋɔ ó cha ba dɛ́ ba Pɔɔl ne Jerusalam ba tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ ba dɔɔ vɔrɔwe cheɡ kɛ dɛ ba dɛ ba Pɔɔl ne naa, nɛ́ra ba sɔh ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ́ kpoo.
Belaa Koojen Fɛstɔs ŋɔ Pɔɔl chɔ dea Sisaaria, dɛ ŋɔ aa biɡri o ɡba la Sisaaria bela.
Kɛ bá ɡel ba nomonome puu la bela, ásɛ dɛ Pɔɔl ɛ waane aa, bá baɡla bela.
Koojen Fɛstɔs berɔ di tɔpera anuatoro, kɛɛ tɔpera fi ba be Jerusalam mɔɔ dɛ ba Sisaaria.
Tɔ aa pera la, o kaa so bela baa dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la dɛ ŋɔ bá ba Pɔɔl ne.
Pɔɔl aa bala la, Juu tena baa le Jerusalam la baa che o jwɛɛh dɛ bol waa aa wola were dawɛ o nɛ.
Kɛ ane a bwa, ba ta wone dɔ wobɛlbwa dɛ chaɡle kɛ ba waa la ɛ kasinteŋ.
Pɔɔl wono bol waa dɛ baɡle kɛ o ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
O baɡlɔ kɛ o ta wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ jo Juu tena kii bɛlbwa nɛ, dɛ baɡle kɛ o ta wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ jo ba Korowii Dea kii bɛlbwa nɛ, dɛ ŋɔ o ta Rom Koojen la ɡe nɛɛ joɛ.
Dɛ Koojen Fɛstɔs dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ o kpɔ Juu tena la darame, anomanta, o bɔɔ Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ la Jerusalamee, ásɛ ba ka bol he waa baa kpɔa dawɛ he nɛɛ nɔ n siwi ta dɛ́ pa bole n ɡe na naa?” Belaa Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Akai!
Rom Koojen ɡbaɡba nɛra sie n che taraken nɔ.
Bonɔɔ chɛ kɛ ba bol n waa nɔ dɛ́ pa bole.
He ɡbabir jemɔ kɛ n ta Israel tena nɔ wechɔɡe bɛlbwa ɛɛ.
Dɛ n fe jo ya kii bɛl nɛɛ asɛ a ɛ kɛ a chɛ kɛ bá kpo mɛ naa, n fe aa won ŋɔ mɛɛ chwa sewee.
Kɛ dɛ ba waa baa kpɔa dɛ daɡ mɛ nɔ ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ te naa, nomɛlbwa aa won kpɔ mɛ do ba nɔn ta.
N dɛ nyin kɛ he la n ne Rom Koojen Siisa sie, ásɛ o ka bol n waa nɔ dɛ́ pa bole.” Belaa Fɛstɔs ne o nomonome le jina.
Baa bala la, Fɛstɔs ŋɔ Pɔɔl be ŋɔ, “Dɛ he ŋɔ hɛɛ la Rom Koojen bee ó ka bol waa nɔ dɛ́ pa bole te naa, hɛɛ la o bee.” Pɔɔl kaa che Kooro Aɡrepa ne Bɛnes sie Aa baa ɛ tɔpera anɛ la, kooro bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Aɡrepa ne haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Bɛnes ba Sisaaria, dɛ ba chɔɔ Fɛstɔs.
Baa di Sisaaria tɔpera anɛ la, Fɛstɔs taa Pɔɔl waa la baɡle Kooro Aɡrepa, dɛ ŋɔ, “Fɛlekse fa do a ɡɛ baa nɔ dea, kɛ o ta lole.
N la Jerusalam, asɛ Juu tena Sɔfonomonome ne ba bwɛɛ nomonome kaa bol o wa, dɛ kpɔ waa dɛɛ dawɔ, dɛ ŋɔ ń bol o waa dɛ́ pao bolchɔɡe.
Baa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, n ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ ya Rom tena te aa ɡɛ ɛ.
Ya te bwɛ, dɛ nɛn ne o dɔŋ dɔɔ, dɛ ya ta on ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ o ne nɛn waa kpɔ waa dawɔ la cheme o bol o kon, o ɡe bol, asɛ a bɔɔ waa, yaa on bolchɔɡe pa ɡɛ.
Anomanta, Juu tena la aa lawɛ dɔŋa ba bonɔ la, n ta hɛlɛ kwaraa.
Tɔ aa pera la, n baa so n kara ta bela maa soɡa dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la, dɛ ɡel ba ba Pɔɔl ne bela.
Dɛ n te dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o ken ɛ wechɔɡa ane kohona.
Kɛ nɛra la waa baa kpɔa dɛɛ dawɔ la ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ.
Dɛ ba Korowii toma wa, ne baa bɛl waa sewa baa yerɔ Yeesu la waa baa bol.
Ba ŋɔ Pɔɔl te ŋɔ ɡɛ Yeesu la waa sewa la ir seo ta.
Dɛ maa jemɛ ɡɛ maa ɛ dɛ́ bɔɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ bini, dɛ́ won bola kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, n bɔɔ Pɔɔl ŋɔ, ‘Yá la Jerusalam bá ka bol he waa nɔ dɛ́ pa bole bela kɛɛ?’ Maa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o soŋɔ ŋɔ wɛɛ chɔ dea ka tel kɛ Rom Koojen Siisa ɡbaɡba aa bol o waa la dɛ́ pa bole.
A waa n tɔɔ do dea la, ásɛ n baa dɔ ŋwɛnɛ aa, ń ɡel o la bela.” Belaa Kooro Aɡrepa ŋɔ Fɛstɔs be ŋɔ, “N ɡbaɡba dɛ nyin n na baa nɔ dɛ no o waa nɔ.” Asɛ Fɛstɔs ŋɔ, “Tɔ kere peraa, hɛɛ noo.” Tɔ aa pera la, Kooro Aɡrepa ne Bɛnes do ba koolaala, asɛ ba waa dɔ nyɛl kohona, asɛ ba ne bela bwɛjen soojanomonome ne bela nomonjena ba jo lamu ta.
Baa chema la, Fɛstɔs ɡelɔ ba ba Pɔɔl ne.
Belaa Fɛstɔs ŋɔ, “Kooro Aɡrepa, ne nɛra haa cheme bonɔ nɔ, n dɛ lii kɛ he bwa na baa nɔ.
Juu tena baa lɔ Jerusalam ne banɔ la baa lɔ Sisaaria bonɔ bwa kpɔ bandia dɛɛ nyɛɡ ŋɔ o waa aa were, ŋɔ o do kpoe.
Kɛ n ta wone na waa waa ɛa a ɛ kɛŋɔ o do kpoe.
Anomanta, o ɡbaɡba aa baa ŋɔ yá tɛ ŋwɛnɛ ásɛ Rom Koojen Siisa ɡbaɡba ka bol o waa la dɛ́ pa bole la, n ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ mɛɛ ɡeloo ó la o be.
Kɛ waa maa baɡla do tɔn bini kɛŋɔ ken ne kenii o ɛ waa n ŋɔ Rom Koojen ɡbaɡba nyiŋi o waa bini la, an kpeɡa tɛ mɛ nɔ.
Amɔ a waa n ba o ne he bwa sie, ne Kooro Aɡrepa ɡbaɡba sie, ásɛ he nyiŋi o waa nɔ bini la.
Bɛl lole he ken ɛɛ wonoo cha mɛ ń dɔ o waane dɛ́ chwerɛ ka tɛ Rom Koojen, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ n la o ne o be dɛ n ta wechɔɡa waa ɛa baɡlaa, a ta maɡrɛ.”
Pɔɔl bol o waa baɡle Kooro Aɡrepa Anee Kooro Aɡrepa ŋɔ Pɔɔl be ŋɔ, “N tɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ, ir dɛ́ bol he kon.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, Pɔɔl ir nɔn dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o dɛ ba o kon bola bá no, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kooro Aɡrepa, n sie lɛo kohona kɛ maa dɛ ba n kon bola he siwi ta, dɛ́ baɡle waa bwa Juu tena aa kpɔa dɛɛ daɡ mɛ nɔ.
N sie lɛo kohona, dɛkalkɛ he jemɛ ya Juu tena nawee waa bwa.
Anomanta, n poori, lawɛ bambile dɛ́ no n kon.
Juu tena bwa jemɛ ɡɛ maa doa n bechale saŋ bwa ba le fini.
Gɛ saŋ maa lɔ n bwɛɛ ne Jerusalam la, waa n fa aa dɛ ɛ bwa, ba jemɛ a bwa.
Dɛ ba sɛoh ŋɔ bá bol kasinteŋ aa, ba fe ɛɛ wonoo di danseɛ kɛŋɔ, ya Juu tena Korowii toma ŋwɛnɛ o ta teŋa aa kpeɡa kohona, baa yerɛ o nɛra Farisii tena la, o taa n ɡe ɛɛ teŋɛ.
Korowii baɡɛ ya naawa nyoa bɛl.
N dɛ hwɛɡɛ ɡɛ nyobaɡa la ta.
Gɛ hwɛɡa nɔ waa ba koh laɡ mɛ asɛ n che he sie hɛɛ ba n waa bola la.
Ya Juu tena deene fi dɛ anɛ tena la bwaa dɛɛ yarada Korowii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa baɡɛ yaa nyoa laanee, dɛ koh a waa dɛɛ tomɔ sibeɡra ne chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa.
N Naa kooro, webeŋkpoŋ nɔ ya bwa aa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o ta nɔ, onee ba kpɔ dawɛ n nɛɛ ŋɔ n ɛ wechɔɡa la.
Na nɔ!
Ya waa yaa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta laanee kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ ir yaa seo taa.
Bɔkwaa ɛa he nɛra haa lɔ bonɔ nɔ aa wola won yarada kɛŋɔ Korowii won nɛra seo ta ira ɔɔ?
N ɡba fa hah Yeesu waa le Nasarɛt la waa la.
N fa liiro kɛŋɔ ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa maa dɔa la, a chɛ kɛ n kpɔ o ta dɛ́ chɔɡ o waa la.
Maa lɔ Jerusalam la, dɛ ɡɛ toma nɔɔ mɛɛ ɛ. N soŋe Sɔfonomonome ba tɛ mɛ kpeɡri, asɛ n larawe Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra do deene pirim.
Gɛ saŋ la, dɛ ba bol ba waa dɛ pa ba bolchɔɡe ŋɔ bá kpoo ba aa, ɡɛɛ n ɡe sɛh teŋɛ ba kpoora la ta.
Dɛ n dɛ la cheremi deene bini saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ kaa ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa taeh, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ba bol Korowii nɛnhɛlwaa ásɛ n laɡ ba.
Ba waa aa dɛ di n baah kohona nomanta, n ti ba dɛɛ la bwɛɛre aa wola Juu tena bwɛɛre ɛɛ kwaraa ta, dɛ kaa ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa.
Gɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ bɛlee n soŋe Sɔfonomonome be, asɛ ba tɛ mɛ kpeɡri ŋɔ ń la Damaskɔs.
N Naa kooro, yaa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la, ɡɛ saŋ wee aa cheɡɛ nyufala la, n ne nyiŋa dɛ nii le nyundua dɛ chaah bɔr ɡwaa wee, dɛ chaah bɔr bar n ne nɛra yaa dɛ valɛ la.
Belaa ya bwa choɡli harɛ, asɛ n no kɛŋɔ nomɛl aa kpɔ ya bwɛɛ Juu tena wobol dɛɛ bol waa n be, dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Oo, Sɔɔl!
Ɛrɛɛ he che n nɛɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
He ɡbaɡbaa hɛɛ ɛ la.
He ne nao baa doo ŋwɛn dɛɛ teɡɔ o ta naa dɛɛ yaɡre o dɔɔ da bwa beŋkpoŋ.’ Anee n ŋɔ, ‘Henee umeo, n Dɔɔ?’ Asɛ o ŋɔ, ‘Menee Yeesu haa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ la.
Ir che!
N dɛ nyin n lee ásɛ he ɛ n bonɔɔ dɛ valɛ dɛɛ bol waa haa naa fini nɔ, ne anɔ la haa naa kerekere la nɛra be.
A waa n kpɔ n te chaɡle la.
Mɛɛ tomɛɛ Juu tena ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bwa bee, dɛɛ kisii wechɔɡe ba be.
Hen dɛ́ ka pili ba sie, ásɛ ba le biro ta dɛ́ ba bochaah ta bela nii aa lole, dɛ́ le Bɔnsam nɔn ta dɛ́ ba Korowii be, ásɛ o kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, ásɛ ba ba ja nɛra baa yarada mɛ n sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta ba ɛ n bii la nɛ.’ N Naa kooro, maa na ɡɛ waa nɔ la, n ta vɛɛh.
Gɛ bwa Yeesu aa le nyundua ba ŋɔ n be la, n ɛo.
N tɔ sie la Damaskɔs, dɛ la Jerusalam, dɛ ɡaaɡe Juda harɛ la te bwa, dɛ la harɛre a nɛra aa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ɡe ta.
Maa dɛ ɡaaɡe la bwa, dɛ n dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá charɛ ba liire, dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛ́ ba Korowii be, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ba we-ɛɛla chaɡle kɛ ba charɛ ba liire dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta.
Gɛ waa nɔ waa Juu tena laɡ mɛ ɡɛ saŋ maa lɔ Korowii Dea la, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin n kpoe.
Dɛ le ɡɛ saŋ nɔ bwa ba le fini nɔ, n dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii alaworomɛɛ n ta do le, dɛ won che he sie dɛɛ di waa nɔ danseɛ nomonjena ne bechale bwa be nɔ.
Waa Korowii keamere ne Mosis fa aa dɛ bol ŋɔ aa ɛo laanee n ɡe ɛɛ bol.
Anee kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la na wahala, dɛ́ tɔ sie ir seo ta lala bwa nɛ, dɛ́ won che o seo ta ira la ta, dɛ́ baɡle Juu tena ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la kɛŋɔ ya toole seo nɔn ta ne biro ta kpa, dɛkalkɛ nii chaah ya nɛ.” Pɔɔl aa dɛ bol waa ken la, Koojen Fɛstɔs kɔro ŋɔ, “Pɔɔl, choɡlaa dɛɛ wee kɛɛ?
He tɔn jema kohona laanee dɛɛ wee choɡla la!” Anee Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Nomoa, choɡla laa mɛɛ we!
Kasinteŋ torodoo mɛɛ bol la.
N Naa kooro Aɡrepa te jemɛ waa maa dɛ bol nɔ bwa.
A waa maa wola waa bola o sie ɔmɛ la.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ a bɛlbwa ta o habɔɔ leɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a bɛlbwa ta waa baa sɔah ɛ ɛɛ.
N Naa kooro, he yarada waa Korowii aa ɡela o keamere la bol la aa?
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he yaradaa.” Belaa Kooro Aɡrepa ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛ hɛɛ wonoo ɡel n berɛ asɔre te buɡ nɔ ta kɛɛ?” Anee Pɔɔl ŋɔ, “Dɛ buɡ nɔ taa yoo, dɛ kerekeree yoo, n te waa maa dɛ soŋe Korowii laanee kɛŋɔ, he ne nɛra baa dɛ no n waa fini nɔ fe do kɛŋɔ maa doa nɔ.
Kɛ maa soŋe kɛ ba doe jɔɡrɔre kɛ baa do mɛ nɔ te.” Belaa Kooro Aɡrepa ne Nomoa Fɛstɔs ne Bɛnes, ne nɛra baa lɔ bela la bwa ir, asɛ baa le bela la, baa ŋɔ dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ wobɛlbwa ta baɡlɛ kɛ o chɛ kpoe, kɛɛ ba doo dea.” Kooro Aɡrepa ŋɔ Nomoa Fɛstɔs be ŋɔ, “Dɛ ken laa o soŋe ŋɔ hé la o ne Rom Koojen Siisa be ó ka bol o waa dɛ́ pa bole nɔ naa, n fe ɛɛ ŋɔɔ hé kpɔɔ ta wɛɛ la.”
Pɔɔl jo stiimae bini kaa Rom Ba vɔrɔwɔ ŋɔ yá kpɔ nee ta kaa Itali harɛ bela Rom Koojen aa soɡa la.
Anomanta, ba kpɔ Pɔɔl ne nɛra bane baa do ba ɡe dea ja o nɛɛ la tɛ Rom Koojen soojanomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Juleɔs la.
Stiimae bɛl le Adramitium ba, asɛ ya jo o ta dɛɛ kaa.
Dɛ o dɛ kaa Eesia harɛ mpo nyoa bwɛɛre ta.
Dɛ baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Aristakus ja ya nɛ.
Makidoonia harɛ bwɛɛ Tesalonika la taa o le.
Tɔ aa pera laanee ya jo Sidon.
Juleɔs kpoŋe Pɔɔl kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó ka na o daamanar, ásɛ ba tɛo kwaa aa chɛ kɛ o dɔ o ŋwɛnɛ la ta.
Ya cheɡɛ bela dɛɛ kaa, asɛ peu ka ta dɛɛ cheme yaa.
Anomanta, ya berɔ kaa Saepros waa ɛ ekwi la baŋ bobɛl peu la aa wola bela te ta la dɛ kaa.
Ya kpɔ mpo ta ɡɛ dɛɛ la dɛ ka fɛrɛ Silisia ne Pamfilia jwɛh, dɛ ka chuɡe Maera waa lɔ Lisia harɛ ta la.
Belaa sooja nomoa la na Alɛksandrea tena stiimae bɛl waa dɛ kaa Itali harɛ, dɛ kpɔ yaa do o ta.
Ya kaalɔ tama tama ken tɔpera anɛ, mɔɔ dɛ ta ba tel Kenaedes, dɛkalkɛ dɛ peu aa yaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ.
Peu la aa wola ŋwɛnɛ tɛ la, ya pa sie Kret ne Salmone a bwa aa ɛ ekwie la baah ta, dɛ fɛrɛ Kret baŋ bela peu la aa wola bela te ta la dɛɛ kaa.
Yaa fɛrɛ Kret harɛ baŋ pera bela kaa la, a no yaa kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ ya ba le leebɔɔ bɛl o ne Lasea aa wola jaŋɛ, baa yerɛ bela Leebɔdɛɛɡe la.
Yaa biɡri ŋwɛnɛ ta kohona la nomanta, ya ne leebɔdɛɛɡe tela dɛ ya Juu tena tɔpejen yaa dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa o ta la ɡarɔ.
Gɛ tɔpere nɔ ɡe ɡaraa, dɛ ɡɛ mpo la ta vala aa were.
Anomanta, Pɔɔl ja ba ŋɔ, “Bwɛɛla, n nao kɛ le bonɔ dɛɛ kaa la, ya ŋwɛnɛ nɔ aa werii do tɛ yaa.
Ya dɛ la naa, yaa ka na siswɛmee, asɛ ya ne ya stiimae nɔ ne ya bone nɔ ka nee ta.” Pɔɔl aa bol ɡɛ la, sooja nomoa la ta o be noɛ.
O teŋɛ nɛn waa dɛ valɛ stiimae la ne, ne stiimae te la nyoa wobol ta.
Leebɔdɛɛɡe leebɔɔ bela aa were ne stiimae la cheɡa peujena la saŋ.
Ba ŋɔ stiimae leebɔdɛɛɡe lɔ Kret harɛ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Finiks la ta, anomanta, ba kɛrɛdɛ ŋɔ bá takapɔ so stiimae la bini tama tama dɛɛ la bela dɛ́ ka so bela, ásɛ peujena la saŋ kaa mɔɔ.
Dɛ Finiks leebɔɔ la chɔɔ kɛ korobifale ɡuri aa do ɡɛ la, asɛ o harɛ la nyoa bɛl sie chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr diɡ pera, asɛ bɛl ɡe chaɡɛ wee cholibɔr ɡal pera.
Peuchɔɡe aa ta mpo sie wa A ta biɡre dɛ peujeɡa bɛl tao le weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛɛ ba, asɛ ba lii kɛ baa wonoo kaa ɡɛ ba fe aa liira wubwa la.
Ba laa ba stiimae la buni baa kpɔa do nee bini dɛ ɡel stiimae la ɛɛ che la kpɔ dɛ fɛrɛ Kret harɛ dɛɛ kaa.
A ta biɡre bɛlbwa, asɛ bela peuchɔɡe bɛl o yon le wee leebɔr ɡal pera dɛɛ ba la ir kpeɡri nɛ, dɛ le Kret harɛ dɛ ta dɛɛ ba mpo ta.
Peu la aa taa dɛ ba lɔ yaa la, ya lawɛ ya stiimae la nyoa kahonɛ.
Dɛ stiimae la aa wone dɛɛ kaa sie kpa, dɛ den dɛɛ kaa bela peu la aa taa chaɡɛ la.
Ya baa tel ekwi bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kaoda la weekaŋle harɛbɔr, asɛ o tɔ yaa bɔr peu la be tama, kɛ dɛ o ta dɛ vuuɡi yaa te.
Ya bwara nyɛɡɔ mɔɔ ba ta won ɡɔɔ ɡberjeɡa waa pɛl ya stiimae la do ya stiimae la bini, dɛ kwaa stiimae la ŋwɛɛra vɔrɔwe kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba chweeh stiimae la ŋwɛɛra aa lɔ o keŋkeŋni la, asɛ a hamɛ kiŋkiŋ.
Dɛ kechɛ bɛl lɔ bela baa yerɔ Sirtis, asɛ baa ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ peu la ɛɛ taɡ baa kaa bela ásɛ ba ka bela.
Anomanta, ba ba stiimae la yajen la aa lɔ o doa la ne harɛ, asɛ peu la taɡ ba dɛɛ kaa.
Tɔ aa pera la, dɛ peu la ta dɛ ta kohona.
Anomanta, ba pa stiimae la bini bone ane viɡri, ásɛ o fɛɡre.
Tɔ aa pera ja la, ba ɡbaɡba pa stiimae la laala ane ta.
Tɔpera aŋwɛnɛ bwa dɛ yaa wee na, yaa weweela ɡe na, asɛ peu la ɡe na dɛɛ ta kpeɡri nɛɛ ɡɛ.
Ate, dɛ yaa ya nyuune te waa lii kɛŋɔ yaa ɛ nɛraa kpa.
Baa lɔ ɡbera la bini biɡri baa wola kondikwaa dii la, Pɔɔl iro che dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Yabala, maa ŋɔa ya bɛ Kret le la, a chɛ kɛ he fe no n kon ta.
Laala aa chɔɡa ne anɔ la haa paa ta nɔ, a fe ta ɡɛ balɛ.
Kɛ he bɛ ɔmɛ.
He bɛlbwa aa sewa ba.
Stiimae nɔ ɡboo dɛɛ ba chɔɡa.
Waa aa ɡela n ŋɔ ɡɛ laanee kɛ, dɛ jwaana ne la, Korowii waa dɔɔ mɛ dɛ ɡel mɛɛ ɛ o toma la, o torome ba n be, dɛ ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, ‘Pɔɔl, bɛ ɔmɛ!
Hɛɛ la Koojen Siisa bee.
Nɛra la bwa he ne baa dɛ valɛ nɔ, Korowii noɔ tɛɛ.
Wɛɛ lɛɛ baa.’ ” Pɔɔl aa bol ɡɛ la, o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Anomanta, he bɛ ɔmɛ, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ yarada Korowii.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ waa bola la, ɡɛɛ aa ba ɛɛ.
Kɛ peu nɔ ɛɛ taɡɛ yaa ka ta ekwi harɛ bɛl ta.” Tɔpere waa teŋa fi dɛ anaarɛ la harambaŋa ne la, dɛ peu la tao dɛɛ taɡɛ yaa ɡɛ.
Dɛ ya lɔ mpo la baa dɛ yerɔ Mɛdetereenea la ta.
Dɛ stiimae la tom-ɛɛra la liire ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ ya ken dɛ tel harɛ bɛl ta.
Anomanta, ba maɡɛ nee la dɛ na kɛŋɔ o luŋri tel naɡale fifraanaarɛ.
Aa ɛ tama la, ba berɔ maɡɛ na ja, dɛ na kɛŋɔ o luŋri tel naɡale fifraatoro.
Dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ ya stiimae la ɛɛ chuɡe bwea anee dɛ́ peɡri, dɛ koh a waa ɡɔɔ o bune anaarɛ bwa do nee ta stiimae la mun ta.
Dɛ ba dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ bɔ́r chaah warane.
Ate, dɛ stiimae tom-ɛɛra la fe dɛ nyin bɔr dɛ́ le o bini dɛ́ chwa.
Ba pur o ɡberjeɡa la do nee ta, dɛ teŋe nyosone ŋɔ ba fe dɛ la ka kpɔ stiimae la sie dɛ́ ka tɛr o bune ŋwɛɛra ane do nee ta.
Belaa Pɔɔl ŋɔ soojanomoa la ne soojare la be ŋɔ, “Dɛ stiimae tom-ɛɛra nɔ ta o bini soɡaa, he bɛlbwa aa he nyuu dɔ.” Asɛ soojare la chaa ŋwɛɛra aa vɔwɛ ɡberjeɡa la pɛl stiimae la, dɛ ɡel o kaa.
Tomun aa ba dɛ kpɔ la, Pɔɔl soŋ ba ŋɔ bá bwa di kwa, dɛ ŋɔ, “He tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛɛ nɔ he tea bini aa chɔɡa he so dɛɛ kpa waa aa dɛ ba chiɡa, haa wola kwaa dii.
N poo heya, hé di kwaa tama, dɛ́ won yo lɛ he nyuune.
Haa waa nɔ nyoa kae ba.
Wobɛlbwa aa he bɛlbwa ɛɛ ba.” Waa ŋɔ ɡɛ la, o kpɔ paanoo dɛ jam Korowii ba bwa siwi ta, dɛ mɔn dɛ di.
Waa ɛ ɡɛ la, ba bambile ba harɛ, asɛ ba dɔ ɡbemba dɛ won di kwa.
Dɛ ya bwa lɔ nɛra lafraanɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ nɛra banumɛl.
Yaa di kwaa vaɡre ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyin la, ba ɡɔɔ men baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ paanoo la ta mpo la ta, ásɛ stiimae la do fɛɡre.
Tɔ aa pera la, stiimae tom-ɛɛra ta wone jemɛ harɛ la yiso baa tel o ta.
Ba na leebɔjen bɛl, dɛ na o nyoa bwea ne hɛŋle, dɛ ɛ ba liire kɛŋɔ dɛ aa maɡroo waa, baa kpɔ stiimae laanee chaɡɛ leebɔɔ la ta.
Ba chaa stiimae la bune la do mpo la bini.
Dɛ ba fe vɔwɛ stiimae la ŋwandaa ɡe dɛɛ pɛlo, kɛ ba pur a ɡe, dɛ paɡri stiimae la sie yatɔɡ waa saɡɛ nyundua la, asɛ peu taɡɛ stiimae la dɛɛ kaa bela o sie aa chaɡa la, dɛ taɡɔ ka chuɡe.
Stiimae la kaa chuɡe hɛŋle ane ta asɛ o sie la karɛ che a ta dɛ kaa kahonɛ.
Waa cheɡɛ bobeŋkpoŋ ɡɛ la, dɛ nehɛma dɛ lɔ o habɔɔ la kohona.
Nehɛma la paɡre o habɔɔ la bwa.
Soojare la fe vɔrɔwɔ ŋɔ baa kpoo nɛra baa do ba dea dɛɛ kaa ba ne laanee, dɛ ŋɔ a waa laa aa, baa wa nee le dɛ chwa kaa.
Dɛ ba nomoa la aa Pɔɔl kpoe nyin dɛ koh o waa ŋɔ bá ɡel ba.
O ɡelɔ nɛra baa jemɛ nee la tɔ sie le nee dɛ wa kaa baŋ, asɛ ba kar la dawɛ dapɛɡre ne stiimae la puɡrere ta dɛ wa le.
Kenii ya bwa ɛ dɛ le.
Pɔɔlwa kaa chuɡe ekwi harɛ Mɔlta ta Ya le nee la baŋ, dɛ le ya siswɛm la nyoa mɔɔ dɛ ta no kɛŋɔ ɡɛ ekwi harɛ la sɔne Mɔlta.
Bela tena nyiŋi yaa kɛrɛdɛ.
Yaa dena jo bela dɛ bwaala dɛ nɛ asɛ waa do le kohona, asɛ ba mar nii tɛ yaa ya ŋwee.
Pɔɔl nyin daa ane ŋɔ ó kpɔ ba do nii la ta.
Jaah harɛkon lɔ daa la ta.
Waa doa nii ta bɔwɔb lawɛ harɛkon la, o leɔ dɛ choɡo, dɛ ka saɡɛ o nɔn ta.
Bela tena la aa na harɛkon la Pɔɔl nɔn ta saɡa la, dɛ ba dɛ bol dɔŋa be ŋɔ, “Baa nɔ maɡaa kpo nɛn!
Na waa le seo nyoa mpo ta asɛ o wechɔɡa taa ti o luɡe ɡɛ!” Pɔɔl mer harɛkon la ta nii la ta.
O choɡa la ta on wobɛlbwa ɛɛ.
Dɛ bela tena la te soɡo dɛɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ Pɔɔl nɔn la ɛɛ ɔrɔɔ, dɛ ŋɔ ɡɛ laa ɡe aa, wɛɛ choloo buɡ ta dɛ́ sewɛ.
Baa soɡa dɛɛ nyiŋu kɛŋɔ wɛɛ sewɔɔ waa wola sewɛ wobɛlbwa aa wola on ɛɛ la, ba berɔ ŋɔ voɡ bɛlee ken berɛ nɛn ba ba be la.
Dɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi bela harɛ la ta sɔne Publius.
Dɛ on dɔ harɛre aa lɔ ba jwɛɛh bela la te bwa.
O lɛ yaa dɛ nyiŋi yaa kɛrɛdɛ tɔpera atoro.
Dɛ Publius mɛɛ bwara wɔrɔbɔ asɛ o chɔ.
Dɛ o dɛ feeɡe ɡe.
Pɔɔl jo o be dea dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ soŋe Korowii tɛo, asɛ o ɡbaŋre.
Gɛ waa nɔ aa ɛa la, bela tena ba bwara aa dɛ wee ba la ba Pɔɔl be, asɛ o soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba ba ɡbaŋre.
Ba kɛ yaa kwaa pirim.
Yaa dɛ ba stiimae ta joe dɛ kaa la, ba tɛ yaa laala aa chɛ kɛ ya dɔ mɔɔ dɛ́ le la bwa.
Pɔɔlwa kaa tel Rom Ya di korobie atoro bela mɔɔ dɛ dɔ Alɛksandrea tena stiimae bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Voɡkpara la bini jo.
Peujen saŋ la aa tela la, stiimae la tena baa so Mɔlta, ásɛ peujena la tonɛ mɔɔ ba le.
Yaa lea la, ya kaa choɡ bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Serakius la, dɛ di tɔpera atoro.
Ya le bela dɛ la bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Rɛɡeɔm la.
Tɔ aa pera la, dɛ peu bɛl tao le weekaŋle harɛbɔr dɛɛ ba.
Tɔpera anɛɛ ya di ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ tel bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Puteoli.
Dɛ asɔre tena bane lɔ bela dɛ ŋɔ yá di yawanyoa ba be mɔɔ dɛ kaa.
Belaa ya le dɛ ba Rom.
Rom asɔre tena aa no ya waa la, ba baa cheme yaa Apius Yawa ta ne bela baa dɛ yerɛ Deene Atoro la bɔr.
Pɔɔl aa na ba la, o bambile ba harɛ, asɛ o jam Korowii.
Waa ba Rom la, ba tɛo o ɡbo dea, dɛ ɡel sooja beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ daahno.
Pɔɔl aa di tɔpera atoro Rom la, o yerɛ bela Juu tena nomonome bwa cheme dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Yabala, n ta ya bwɛɛ tena wobɛlbwa ɛɛ, n ta ya naawa waa baa dɛ ɛ la bɛlbwa nɛɛ joɛ, asɛ ba laɡ mɛ Jerusalam, dɛ kpɔ mɛ tɛ Rom tena ba tɔ mɛ dea la.
Ba ɡe aa nyiŋi n waa bini la, dɛ ba fe dɛ nyin n tae, dɛkalkɛ dɛ wobɛlbwa ta chaɡlɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpo mɛ ɡɛ ya bwɛɛ tena aa chaɡla la.
Baa ŋɔa bá ta mɛ la, ya bwɛɛ tena ta sɛɛh kwaraa, asɛ n koh a waa ŋɔ amɔ te bá tel n ne Rom Koojen Siisa sie ó ka nyiŋi a ta.
Kasinteŋ, dɛ anɔ laa aa, n ne ya bwɛɛ tena ta wobɛlbwa dɔe.
A waa n ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ n na heya, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ bil he sie, dɛkalkɛ nɛn Juu tena bwa aa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ba lɛ yaa la waa ba laɡ mɛ dɛ do mɛ jɔɡrɔre n nɔɔra nɔ.” Anee Juu tena la ŋɔ, “Ya bwɛɛ Juda harɛ tena ta yaa tɔn bɛlbwa chwerɛ dɛ baɡle he wobɛlbwa ya be.
Yabala baa le ya bwɛɛ dɛɛ ba bonɔ nɔ ɡe bɛlbwa ta he wechɔɡe bɛlbwa bolɛ ya no.
Yaa no he nyoa wobolee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ he ŋwɛnɛfale nɔ haa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii nɔ te, baa o waa nyin bobɛlbwa.” Ba tɛo tɔpere baa kpɔ ba no o nyoa wobol.
Tɔpere la aa tela la, ba ba o be pirim o dea bela.
Pɔɔl le chɔɔ dɛ baɡ ba Korowii Kora waa ka tel jwaana.
O bol Yeesu wa, dɛ lii ba waa Mosis ne Korowii keamere faa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini la bwa, dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin kɛ ba sɛh ŋɔ Yeesu waa ba faa chwerɛ la.
Nɛra la bane yarada o waa la, bane ɡe ta an yaradae.
Pɔɔl bol waa tonɛ asɛ baa ba peɡra.
Dɛ ba bwa liire ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ, baa tɔŋle dɔŋa.
O berɔ bol webeŋkpoŋ ja, mɔɔ ba bwa peɡre.
O waa waa bola laanee kɛŋɔ, “Korowii Domadɛɛɡe cheɡɛ o keame Aesaya nɛɛ bol waa ya naawa be, dɛ kpelaa o ŋɔ.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Ka ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ noo kohona, kɛ haa a mun noe ba, hɛɛ nyiŋuu kohona, kɛ haa a jema ba.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra nɔ bambile kpeɡri, ba kpɔ nɔɔra tɔɔɡe deŋna, dɛ tɔɔɡe ba sibie ɡe.
A waa laa aa, ba sie fe ɛɛ nao, ásɛ ba deŋna no, ásɛ ba jemɛ a mun, dɛ́ charɛ ba liire ásɛ n lɛɛ ba.” ’ ” Pɔɔl berɔ ŋɔ, “Anomanta, hé no.
Korowii waa aa dɛ ba nɛwɛnyini lɛɛ la, o berɔ kpɔa tɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, dɛkalkɛ ban dɛɛ ba o be noe.” Pɔɔl aa bol waa tonɛ la, ba leɔ dɛɛ kaa dɛɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa kohona.
Pɔɔl hane dea dɛ so o bini bene anɛ.
Dɛ nɛra dɛ ba o be.
O ta ba bɛlbwa berɛ.
Dɛ o dɛ baɡle nɛra Korowii Kora wa, dɛ kpɔ bansua dɛɛ baɡle ya Dɔɔ Yeesu wa.
Nomɛlbwa ta on ŋwɛnɛ tɔe.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn nɔ ka tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Rom, dɛɛ baɡle amanesoma aa dɛ ba wona lɛ nɛra, ne ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡle sodɛɛɡa o ne nɛra aa dɛ ba soɡa wa.
O dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa ɛ toma Kristo te soɡa bini, dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔobene Mmara la ta kpeɡri dɔe, dɛ́ won lɛ nɛra.
Wechɔɡa ne Mmara dɛ seo ta kpeɡri dɔe nɛwɛnyina nɛɛ kpa.
Dɛ Pɔɔl dɛ nyin kɛ o la Rom, anomanta, o tɔ sie kwaa ŋwɛnɛ, ásɛ dɛ won ka na asɔre tena baa lɔ bela la.
O teŋɔ dɛɛ baɡle asɔre tena baa lɔ bela ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ o ta, ásɛ ba soɡa bini baɡle kɛŋɔ ba dɛ yarada Korowii.
Dɛ ba so kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa.
Tɔn la jaɡa la, o kpɔ kala tɛ ŋɔ ó dɛ na nɛra waa jem ba Rom bwa.
Men Pɔɔl maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
Korowiirii lee mɛ dɛ ɡel n ɛ Yeesu torome, dɛ kpɔ o Amanesoma tɛ mɛ ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ bol nɛra be.
A ɡɛ Amanesoma nɔ waa o che o keamere waa lee ba nɛɛ dɛ baɡɛ nɛwɛnyina nyoa a saŋ la.
A waa ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini la.
Korowii Bie Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ ya Dɔɔ la, o waa Amanesoma la ɛɛ baɡle.
O nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ be pera la, Kooro Devid deaa o le, asɛ o Korowii ɛɛ ɡe be pera la, Korowii cheɡɛ o seo ta ira la ta, dɛ baɡle kpeɡri ne kɛŋɔ o Korowii Biee on.
O nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ sune n nɛ, dɛ cha mɛ, dɛ ɡel mɛɛ ɛ Yeesu toma dɛɛ baɡle nɛwɛnyina te bwa o waa ásɛ ba yaradaa dɛɛ ɛa, ásɛ o dɔ sɔn.
He Rom tena ɡe ja a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ Korowii aa lee ba ŋɔ bá ba ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛra nɔ nɛ.
He Rom tena Korowii aa dɛ nyin heyaa dɛ le heyaa ŋɔ hé ba ɛ o nɛra he wa aa toɡra la, he bwaa mɛɛ chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bwa na he sum, dɛ́ cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Korowii soŋa ne o jaama Mɛɛ tɔ sie che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ jam N Naa Korowii he waa kɛŋɔ haa yarada Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ kohona, asɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ bol he waa nɔ.
Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ n bambile bwa ne, dɛɛ bol o Bie la Amanesoma waa la, o jemɔ kɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa n soŋo dɛɛ tɛ heya.
Onee n danseɛ te.
N dɛ soŋo kɛŋɔ dɛ o sɛoh waa, ń fe won ba na heyaa taraken te.
N sie cheɡɛ chiŋ mɛɛ nyin kɛ n na heyaa dɛ́ cha heyaa waane Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa tɛ mɛ ne, ásɛ he do kpeɡri he teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ la ta.
Ya bwaa dɛɛ ba dɔŋa chae.
Gɛ maa yarada Yeesu Kristo la, aa do heyaa ɡbembaa, ásɛ ɡɛ he ɡe aa yaradao la do n ɡe ɡbemba.
Yabala, n dɛ nyin kɛ hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ saŋ bɛlbwaa n fe ɛɛ nyin kɛ ń ba he be, asɛ waa yon dɛɛ tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ.
N dɛ nyin ń dɔ he bane dɛ tɛ Yeesu Kristo kɛŋɔ maa dɔ bane le nɛra ba ɡe aa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bini la.
A chɛ kɛ ń bol Yeesu Amanesoma la nɛra bwa be, nɛra baa kaa sie ne banɔ la baa ka mun, nɛra ba sie aa pila ne banɔ la ba sie aa wola pile bwa be.
Anomanta, n siwi swɛɛrɔ mɛɛ nyin kɛ ń bol Yeesu Amanesoma la he Rom tena ɡe be.
Sihiih aa men kpo Yeesu Amanesoma nɔ bola ta.
A taa Korowii che dɛɛ baɡle o kpeɡri, dɛɛ lɛ nɛra bwa baa yarada o waa la.
Juu tenaa ó tɔ sie lɛ, nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ɡe jao.
Yeesu Amanesoma laanee dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini do ásɛ ya waa su o siwi.
Le waa la mumpar ka tel a jaɡa bwa, o waa yaradae waa ɡboo a bwa.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ, “Naate o wa aa toɡra dɛ su Korowii siwi la, wɛɛ yaradao dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.” Korowii baah diu kohona nɛwɛnyina wechɔɡa wa Korowii baah di nɛra ba wechɔɡa aa tɔ o kasinteŋ waa la ŋwɛnɛ asɛ a sɔɔh ba la nɛ.
O baah dɛ di ba wechɔɡa la ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Korowii wobɛlbwa nɛwɛnyini aa wona jemɛ la, o ɡelɔ ba naa chasee ken.
O ɡbaɡbaa pili a bini baɡ ba.
Dɛ́ le ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa ta harɛ la, o bwara waa nɛwɛnyini aa wola wone dɛɛ na siwi ne, kɛŋɔ o kpeɡri aa wola jaɡa dɔe ne o dor bwa, o ɡelɔ nɛwɛnyini na a bwa.
Nɛwɛnyini wono che Korowii kwaa waa taa ta, dɛ na o kpeɡri ne ɡɛ waa doa.
Anomanta, nɛwɛnyini aa won ŋɔ baa jemɛ kɛ Korowii lole.
Nɛwɛnyini jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii lole, kɛ baa on duu ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ baa duuru.
Baa jam kpɔe dɛɛ tɛo.
Nɛwɛnyini wechɔɡa ɡelɔ ba wili, ba ta liire dɔe kpa.
Ba dɛ yerɛ ba te wejerema, kɛ ɡɛna ɡee ban.
Korowii te aa sewɛ bwa.
Kɛ ba vɛh o toma, dɛɛ tomɛ kwaa ba ɡbaɡba aa kwaara a do kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini, kɛɛ jumbii, kɛɛ konaatena, kɛɛ kontuuɡa la.
Anomanta, Korowii ta ba waa tɛɛ ba, asɛ baa ɛ wedoŋa ba bambile aa lawa, dɛɛ chɔ baala ne haahna aa wola Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ.
Ba ɡel Korowii kasinteŋ la toma, dɛɛ tomɛ kwaa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe.
Kwaa Korowii aa taa la, anee baa tomɛ, dɛ ɡel Korowii ɡbaɡba.
On chɛ kɛ yaa kpɛɛro saŋ bɛlbwa.
Aamen.
Ba ken ɛɛ nomanta, Korowii ta ba waa tɛɛ ba, asɛ baa ɛ ba pɛla waa aa ɛ sihiih kohona.
Ba haahna kwaraa ne baala aa chɔ kpa, ba ne ba dɔŋa haahnaa dɛɛ chɔ baa ne haah.
Gɛɛ ba baala ɡe ne haahna aa wola chɔ kpa, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ pɛlɛ ba bandɔŋa nɛɛ kɛŋɔ haahna ken.
Ba ne ba dɔŋa baalaa dɛɛ chɔ baa ne haah.
Ba wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ la nomanta, ba dɛ dɔ a kembɔr aa chɔɡ ba nɛndaa.
Baa wola sɛɛh kɛŋɔ bá jemɛ Korowii waa nomanta, o ta ba waa tɛɛ ba, asɛ ba liire bwa ɛ anchɔɡa, asɛ baa ɛ waa aa wola chɛɛ kɛ baa ɛ. Harɛ bini wechɔɡa nɔ bwaa baa ɛ, mur ne sibeɡra ne meesɔɔh, ne bɔweela ne nɛŋkpoa, ne naɡra ne dɔŋa neɡra, ne dɔŋa haeh dɛ nɛra ŋwala.
Baa dɔŋa wedɛɛɡa bol, ba hah Korowii, ba siwi aa nɛn tɔɡɛ, ba jenu, ba mbarafo.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa baa nyin ŋwɛnɛfala dɛ́ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Ba siwi aa ba mɛɛnanar ne ba nyare su.
Ba nya nfɛrɛ, ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe, ba chal toole dɔŋa nɛ, ba tea aa nɛn nɛɛ domɛ.
Ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ken la, ba chɛ kpoe, kɛ dɛ ɡe ta na dɛɛ ɛa, dɛ ɡarɛ dɛɛ kpɛɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛa la.
Korowii bole pae aŋwɛnɛ ta wa He naate haa dɛ pwah he dɔŋ la, he ta wobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ bol dɛ́ lɛ he te kpa.
Henee ume noo, haa dɛ pwah he dɔŋ dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ɛ o wechɔɡa waa dɛ ɛ la dɔŋa la, dɛ he ɡbaɡbaa hɛɛ pa bolchɔɡe la.
Nɛn ɛ wechɔɡa nɔ dɔŋa aa, Korowii dɛ pao bolchɔɡe.
O te, aŋwɛnɛ taa wɛɛ pa nɛwɛnyini bolchɔɡe.
Kɛ he te, waa haa dɛ pwah nɛra a waa la, anee he ɡee ɛ.
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii aa he te waa bola ba dɛ́ pa bole kɛɛ?
Waa nɔ bwaa Korowii ta tea dɛɛ ɛ heya, dɛɛ tɛ heyaa sisɔna dɛɛ lawɛ bambile nɔ bwa, ásɛ he charɛ he liire dɛ́ le he wechɔɡa ta.
Kɛ haa o wedɛɛɡa nɔ bu, dɛɛ nyiŋa pɛɛ.
He deŋne kpeɡri.
Haa ɡelɛ he tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡ he wechɔɡa wa.
He ɡelɔ Korowii bwaawee ɛɛ do kan he nɛɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Awola waa ba pa bole kasinteŋ ne la, o baah ɛɛ di he nɛɛ taeh.
Gɛ nomɛlbwa we-ɛɛla aa doa la, anee wɛɛ ba nyiŋa dɛ́ bol o waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Nɛra baa dɛ nyin jirima Korowii be, dɛɛ nyin kɛ Korowii kpɛɛ ba, dɛɛ nyin mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe, dɛ koh a waa dɛ lawɛ bambile dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa la, Korowii ɛɛ tɛɛ baa mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ba tetoowa, baa wola Korowii waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ ta teŋɛ, dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, Korowii bwaawee ɛɛ ir ba nɛɛ taeh.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, ba bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡoo taeh, aa noo baa taeh.
Juu tenaa dɛ tɔ sie na bonyɛɡa a noo ba, nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ɡe jao.
Asɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa la, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔ jirima, dɛ́ kpɛɛ ba, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba bambisɔɔhna.
Juu tenaa dɛ́ tɔ sie na anɔ bwa, nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ɡe jao.
Korowii aa nomɛl waa nyin ɡwaa bɛl.
Nɛra baa wola Mmara Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ Mosis la jemɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, baa sewɔɔ.
Kɛ Mosis Mmara la ta laa Korowii ɛɛ ba nyiŋa, dɛ́ bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Banɔ la baa jemɛ Mmara la, Mmara la taa Korowii ɛɛ ba nyiŋa dɛ́ bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Maa dɛ bol nɔ, Mmara nɔ noe laa ɡela nɛn ɛɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi.
Mmara la ta teŋaa ɡela nɛn ɛɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi.
Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, baa Mosis Mmara la jemɛ.
Kɛ saŋ bɛlbwa ba ɡbaɡba aa kpɔ ba nyu bini nfɛrɛ dɛ ɛ ɡɛ Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle la, dɛ ba nyu bini nfɛrɛ la ɛ Mmara tɛɛ ba.
Kɛ a fe lole kɛŋɔ baa Mosis Mmara la jemɛ te.
Ba we-ɛɛla chaɡlɔ kɛŋɔ waa Mosis Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle la lɔ ba bambile bini.
Ba liire ɡba dɛ di danseɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a tel ane ta naa, ba ɡbaɡba liire yon ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa, ane ɡe ta ba ɡbaɡba liire yon ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Waa nɔ bwaa dɛɛ ba ɛɛ awola Korowii aa dɛ ba nɛra wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛɛ sɔh la ne bochaah lee, ásɛ Yeesu Kristo pa ba bole.
Gɛɛ me Amanesoma la ɛɛ baɡle.
Juu tena ne Korowii Mmara wa Asɛ he naate haa dɛ yerɛ he te Juu te, dɛ kpɔ he sie dawɛ Mosis Mmara la ta dɛ kpɔ Korowii dɛɛ ta nyoa la ɡe sɛ?
He jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin kɛ hɛɛ ɛ, dɛ jemɛ Mmara la, dɛ jemɛ waa aa wera bwa.
Kɛ he dɛ yerɛ he te nɛn waa jemɛ waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ.
Kɛ he ŋɔ henee ɛ nii dɛɛ chaah nɛra baa lɔ biro ta.
Wejema bwa ne Korowii wobɛlbwa lɔ Mmara la bini, anomanta, he kpɔ he te kɛ wejereme dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛna ne bamuɡe wa.
Haa dɛ baɡle he dɔŋa waa nɔ, ɛrɛɛ haa wola won baɡle he te ɡbaɡba ɔ?
Haa dɛ ŋɔ nɛra be ŋɔ ba bɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛ, asɛ dɛ te dɛɛ ŋwɛ nɔ sɛ?
Hé tenten nɔ, he ŋɔ nɛra bɛ ba bala haahna ne ba bala jaranar dɛɛ nyin.
Hé ɡbaɡba, haa ɡɛ ɛa?
Hé ŋɔ he kii voɡa, hen ɡee bera dɛɛ ŋwɛ kwaa a deene bini.
Hen kpɔ Mmara la dɛɛ ta nyoa, he ɡee wola a ta teŋɛ, asɛ nɛra koh he we-ɛɛla waa dɛɛ ɛ Korowii nɛnhɛla.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “He Juu tena aa ɡela nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la siwi sa Korowii la.” He dɛ teŋɛ Mmara la ta naa, dɛ he pena teŋa nɔ dɔ mun.
Kɛ dɛ haa Mmara la ta teŋaa, ate he fe ɡel he pena teŋa bɔ.
Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ baa wola ba pena teŋe la, ba dɛ teŋɛ Mmara la ta naa, haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ baa kɛŋɔ nɛra baa teŋe ba pena aa?
He Juu tena te jemɛ Mmara nɔ dɛɛ teŋe he pena, kɛ he bane aa Mmara la ta teŋɛ.
Asɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ɡe, baa ba pena teŋe, kɛ ba bini bane dɛ teŋɛ Mmara la ta.
Ba we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ɡeloo Korowii pa heyaa bolchɔɡe.
Nɛn waa ɛ Juu te, wobɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛɛ baɡle kɛ o ɛ Juu te, dɛ ja o pen teŋa ɡbo ta la, Juu te tenten laa on.
Penteŋa dɔ mun.
Waa aa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ nɛn ɛ Juu te tenten la, bambile binii a do.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee dɛɛ ba toma ɛɛ he bambile bini, ásɛ he won ɛ Juu te tenten.
Mmara bɛlbwa aa ɡɛ bambile nɔ tɛ.
Nɛn Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa chao asɛ o bambile bini waa ɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o ɛ Korowii nɛn la, nɛwɛnyini laa dɛɛ ba o kpɛɛra, Korowiirii dɛɛ ba o kpɛɛra.
Korowii ɛ kasinteŋ te Dɛ kenii a do aa, dɛ ɛrɛ ɡwaalaa ya Juu tena ɡwaa he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ yɔ?
Dɛ bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ lɔ ya penteŋa ta nɔ?
Ya Juu tena na som taeh dɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa kaa la ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
Anɔ la aa tɔ sie laanee kɛŋɔ yanee Korowii tɔ sie kpɔ o waa do ya nɔn ŋɔ ya baɡle nɛra.
Amɔ dɛ ya bini bane ta Korowii yaradae yaa, wɛɛ koh a waa ásɛ o waa aa yaradaa dɔ aa?
Akai!
Dɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa ɛ nyosonteŋna kwara naa, Korowii te wa ɛɛ dɔ kasinteŋii saŋ bɛlbwa.
Anee Korowii Tɔn la bol la.
O baɡle Korowii waa ŋɔ, “He wobol ɛɛ baɡloo kɛŋɔ he dɔ kasinteŋ, hɛɛ dɛɛ di bole he waa taa.” Nɛwɛnyini te ɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Dɛ a cheɡɛ ya wechɔɡa ta asɛ nɛra na kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe aa, amɔ ya ta wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ kɛɛ?
Dɛ Korowii tɛr ya deŋne aa, dɛ o waa toɡraa?” Nɛwɛnyini liiree nɔ!
Kɛ ɡɛ laa a do.
Dɛ Korowii waa ta toɡraa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ te won bol nɛwɛnyini waa dɛ́ pa bole ɔ?
Nomɛl ɡee pɛɛroo ŋɔ, “Aah dɛ a cheɡɛ n nyosone ta asɛ nɛra na kɛŋɔ Korowii dɔ kasinteŋ, o dɔ sɔn aa, dɛ n nyosone la ɛ wechɔɡa ja aa?” Amɔ yáa ɛ wechɔɡa ásɛ wedɛɛɡa le a ta kɛɛ?
Nɛra bane chɔɡ n sɔn, ba haŋɛ n nyoa ŋɔ n dɛ ŋɔ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr ba deŋnee, dɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta ɡee.
Nomɛlbwa toole o waa toɡre Taraken nɔ, ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa ya Juu tena ɡwaa he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ yɔ?
Ya ta heyaa ɡwaalɛ.
N fa baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ ya Juu tena ne he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ya bwa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.
Anee Korowii Tɔn la ŋɔ la.
O baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi.
Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ jemɛ wa, nomɛlbwa toole dɛɛ nyin o Korowii bɔr dɛ́ tomɔ.
Nomɛlbwa berɛ habɔɔ kpoo, nɛndɛɛɡe bɛlbwa toole ba bini, Bɛlbwa toole dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole.
Ba nyoa wobol doŋo, a sɔɔh nyosone ɡboo ba bwa.
A do kɛ domkpuli aa choɡe nɛn, dɛ berɛ do kɛ tɛɡchɔɡa aa dɛ kpo ken.
Wobochɔɡa ɡboo su ba nyoo.
Ba ɡbaŋre nɛŋkpoa waa ta.
Bobɛlbwa baa dɛ la la, waa ɡboo baa chɔɡ, dɛɛ ɛ nɛra hɔhɔrɔwa.
Waa aa ɡela nɛn bambile ɛɛ sɔɔhno la te, baa an jemɛ.
Baa Korowii ɡe ɔmɛ.” Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ waa Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle la, nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Mmara la ta laanee Mmara la ɛɛ baɡle, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won dɔ wobɛlbwa bol Korowii sie, ásɛ o won bol nomɛlbwa waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, Mmara ta teŋa aa won ɡel nomɛlbwa we-ɛɛla su Korowii siwi bwa.
Mmara la toma bwaa kɛŋɔ ó ɡel nɛwɛnyini jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya ɛ wechɔɡa.
Yarada taa a che nɛn waa won toɡre Korowii ɡelɔ ya jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta aa cheɡa ya wa ɛɛ su o siwi.
Mmara ta teŋa ta laa a che.
Mosis Mmara la ne Korowii keamere tɔne di danseɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ ta.
Yeesu Kristo yaradae taa a che nɛra wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada Yeesu waa la, o waa dɛ su Korowii siwi, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini bwa beŋkpoŋ Korowii be.
Nɛwɛnyini bwa ɛ wechɔɡa, ya bɛlbwa ta ɡɛ Korowii fe aa dɛ nyin o maŋkura yaa la chɛɛ.
Yeesu Kristo yawɛ yaa o chal ne.
A waa ya wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi.
O nɛn sum nae kohona waa o ɛ ɡɛ tɛ yaa pɛɛpɛɛ la.
Korowiirii le Yeesu Kristo ŋɔ ó ba fuɡe o chal ta, dɛ́ soŋe ya wechɔɡa, ásɛ o bandia le nɛra baa yarada Yeesu Kristo seo waa la nɛ.
Korowiirii fa saahna ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ baɡle kɛ o waa toɡrɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a saŋ la, nɛra aa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, o laa sie kpɔ ba be.
A fe chɛ kɛ ó tɛr nɛwɛnyini deŋne, kɛ o lawɛ bambile.
Taraken waa ɡela Yeesu Kristo koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ sewɛ nɔ, o baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ o waa toɡrɔ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo la, Korowii ɡelɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su o siwi.
Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, ya dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ya ta nyoa aa?
Ya ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe.
Ɛrɛ taa a che yaa wola won ta nyoa nɔɔ?
Mmara ta teŋa ta laa a che.
Yeesu Kristo yaradae laanee tɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ŋwɛnɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya sɛoh kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo yaradae taa a che Korowii ɡel nɛn ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su o siwi.
Mmara ta teŋa aa ɡelɛ nɛn ɛɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi bwa.
Juu tena ɡbo laa Korowii che tɛ.
Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ba bwa waa o do le.
Korowii beŋkpoŋ ɡboo lole.
Yeesu Kristo yaradae taa aa ba cheɡa ó ɡel Juu tena ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi.
O yaradae taa aa ba cheɡa ó ɡel nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ɡe ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi.
Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, dɛ ya dɛ yarada Yeesu aa, dɛ ya tɔ Mmara la ŋwɛnɛ kɛɛ?
Akai!
Yeesu yaradae nɔ te kwaraa dɛɛ ba ɡela ya won teŋɛ Mmara la ta.
Abraham yarada taa a che o waa su Korowii siwi He ta sie nyiŋi ya Juu tena nabaa Abraham na.
Gɛ saŋ la, bɔkwaa o na yarada waa nɔ bini nɔ?
O we-ɛɛla taa a che o waa su Korowii siwi aa, ate o fe dɔ waa dɛ kpɔ ta nyoa.
Kɛ dɛ he nyiŋi Korowii Tɔn bini na naa, waa won ta nyoa Korowii sie.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Abraham yarada taa a che Korowii lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi.
Nɛn ɛ toma ba bɔɔ kem aa, dɛ kemee ba bɔɔ.
Dɛ kɛɛ laa ba kɛo.
Kɛ nɛn waa wola wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ kpɔ o yarada do Korowii ɡbo nɛɛ kɛŋɔ o won wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛndɛɛɡa ɛɛ la, a cheɡɛ o yarada la ta asɛ Korowii lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su o siwi.
Gɛɛ ya Juu tena nabaa Devid faa baɡle nomɛlbwa Korowii aa wola o we-ɛɛla nyiŋe, asɛ dɛ lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi la waa kɛŋɔ o na som la.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra Korowii aa kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, waa wola a waa lii kpa la, ba na som.
Nyusom tee naate Korowii aa wola o wechɔɡa waa lii kpa bwa la.” A ɡɛ som nae nɔ Devid aa bol o waa nɔ, dɛ Juu tena aa dɛ teŋe pena nɔ, ba ɡboo dɛɛ ba som nae yaa, kɛ nɛra baa wola pena teŋe bwaa o ŋɔ?
Too, baa baɡla Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Abraham yarada taa a che asɛ o waa su Korowii siwi” nɔ, a ɡɛ waa nɔ chiɡo mɔɔ Korowii ɡel Abraham teŋe o pen kɛɛ o teŋo mɔɔ nɔ?
A chiɡo mɔɔ Abraham teŋe.
O pen teŋa la ɛ we-ɛɛle bɛl waa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o yarada waa o won ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su Korowii siwi, dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ waa wola teŋe mɔɔ la, dɛ o waa su Korowii siwi.
Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, baa wola pen teŋe dɛɛ yarada Korowii asɛ o lɛɛ ba kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi la, ba mɛɛɛ Abraham.
Nɛra baa teŋe ba pena la, Abraham biirii ba ɡe.
Ba pena waa laa ba ɛ o bii.
Dɛ ba dɔ yarada Abraham aa dɔa mɔɔ ba teŋe o pen la aa, anee bá ɛ o bii.
Korowii nyoa la o fa aa baɡɛ Abraham ne o naanar ŋɔ harɛ nɔ bwa ɛɛ ba ɛ ba konee la, Mmara ta teŋa waa laa o baɡɔ ɡɛ nyoa la.
Dɛ Abraham dɛ yarada Korowii, asɛ a che a ta o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su Korowii siwi, a waa Korowii baɡɔ nyoa.
Nyoa Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham ne o naanar la, dɛ nɛra baa teŋɛ Mmara ta laanee wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ tɛ aa, ate dɛ yarada nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ yarada Korowii nɔ ta mun dɔe.
Dɛ Korowii nyobaɡa la ɡe fe ɛ pɛɛ.
Mmara laanee dɛɛ ba Korowii bandia ne nɛra nɛ.
On lole nɛra ɡee konu waa Korowii baah ɛɛ di nɛra nɛ.
Dɛ Mmara fe toole naa, nɛra fe aa on koni.
Nyoa Korowii aa baɡa la, yarada taa a che.
A chɛ kɛ á ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ kon Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa la, o ɛ kon waa kpɔa tɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
O ɛ kon Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ Abraham naanar bwa pɛɛpɛɛ waa wola nsana lee ba.
Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara la ta la, ba ɡbo laa Korowii baɡɛ ɡɛ nyoa la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada Yeesu waa la kɛŋɔ Abraham aa yarada Korowii la, wɛɛ di nyobaɡa la tɔnɔɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya bwa mɛɛɛ Abraham.
Anee Korowii waa baa chwera ŋɔ, “N ɡelɔ he ɛ nɛnfuuh bwa mɛɛ” la baɡle la.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ kasinteŋ Korowii be.
Onee Abraham faa yarada la.
On won nɛra baa serewa kwaraa chuma, dɛ won dɛɛ bol waa aa wola chiɡe bwa kɛŋɔ aa chiɡa ka la.
Dɛ Abraham dɛ yarada Korowii dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ ɡe.
Dɛ waa nɛn aa wola Korowii yarada a ta la, dɛ o te dɛ yaradao.
A taa a che o ɛ nɛnfuuh bwa mɛɛ, ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He naanar ɛɛ warɔɔ” la.
Dɛ Abraham di bene lafa tonɛ, dɛ waa kpeɡe kpa.
Kɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa o naanar ɛɛ warɔɔ la, o ne o hwɛɛhra bwa, ne o haah Saara hambara ɛɛ bwa, o ta tɔŋlɛ.
O ta tɔŋlɛ tamaa bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ Korowii aa won ɛ waa waa baɡɔ nyoa laanee.
O ta Korowii yaradae ɡelɛ bwa.
Dɛ name kwaraa o ta dɔ yarada kohona, dɛɛ jam Korowii.
Dɛ Abraham jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ wonoo ɛ ɡɛ waa baɡɔ nyoa la.
A waa Korowii che Abraham yarada ta asɛ dɛ lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi la.
A ɡɛ waa la baa chwera do Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Korowii lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi” la, Abraham ɡbo laa ba chwerɛ tɛ.
Ya nɛra yaa dɛ yarada Korowii waa ir ya Dɔɔ Yeesu seo ta la, ya bwaa ba chwera tɛ.
Ya bwaa Korowii ɛɛ ba lɛɛ kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, ya waa su o siwi.
Ya wechɔɡa waa Korowii leo ŋɔ ó ba sewɛ, asɛ Korowii berɛ iru seo ta, ásɛ a che o nɛɛ Korowii lɛ yaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi.
Deŋnesɔɔhna ne silɛɛ dɔe wa Taraken nɔ, ya yarada aa ɡela Korowii lɛ yaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi nɔ, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ a che asɛ ya ne Korowii pɛ.
Yaa yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ ya te tɛo la, a taa a che o ɡel Korowii ɛɛ na ya sum dɛɛ cha yaa ɡɛ waa dɛ cha yaa nɔ.
Anomanta, ya sie lɛo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ bela Korowii aa lole o waa dɔ jirima kohona la, ya ɡee do belaa.
A ɡbo ta laa ya dɔ silɛɛ.
Ya sie dɛ lɛ ya wahala yaa dɛ na nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ anee dɛɛ ba ɡela ya dɔ bambile.
Bambile dɔe nɔ taa aa ba cheɡa, ásɛ dɛ Korowii daah yaa na naa, ya waa won dɔ kasinteŋ.
Ya waa dɔ kasinteŋ Korowii be naa, an dɛɛ ba ɡela ya dɔ hwɛɡa.
Hwɛɡa yaa dɔa nɔ, aa pɛɛ ɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii tɛ yaa o Domadɛɛɡe la ásɛ ya jemɛ o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa kohona.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, ya fa toole ane bɛlbwa bini Korowii ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la be pera.
Dɛ ya fa aa Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta teŋɛ.
Kɛ tɔpere Korowii aa doa la aa tela la, Yeesu lɛ ya wechɔɡ-ɛɛra seo dɛ sewɛ.
A kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nɛn lɛ nɛndɛɛɡe kwaraa seo dɛ́ sewɛ.
Nɛn waa dɛ nyin nɛn la te, bɛl lole nomɛl ken ɛɛ wonoo lɔ bambile lɛ o seo dɛ́ sewɛ.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, hé na ɡɛ Korowii tea aa dɛ domɛ nɛwɛnyini nɛ.
Gɛ saŋ ya taa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la, a taa Yeesu Kristo lɛ ya seo sewɛ.
Yeesu Kristo seo taa a che asɛ Korowii ɡel ya ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi.
Aah dɛ Korowii bwaawee baa ir nɛra nɛ aa, a te taa Yeesu Kristo aa wola won lɛ yaa aa?
Dɛ ya ne Korowii fa dɔmɔ, asɛ o che o Bie Yeesu seo la ta dɛ ɡel ya ne o pɛ aa, ya ne Korowii aa pɛa taraken nɔ, a te ta kwaraa laa wɛɛ ba o Bie Yeesu seo ta ira, ne o le doe nɔ waa koeh dɛ́ lɛ yaa aa?
A ɡbo laa.
Ya sie lɛ Korowii nɛɛ kohona ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nomanta.
O nɛɛ a che ya ne Korowii pɛ.
Adam ne Yeesu Kristo Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ nɛɛ a che wechɔɡa ba harɛ nɔ ta, asɛ a che o wechɔɡa ta seo ba harɛ ta.
A waa seo bu nɛwɛnyini bwa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini bwa ɛ wechɔɡa.
Korowii aa wola Mosis Mmara la ne balɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ wechɔɡa lole.
Kɛ bela Mmara aa wola toole la, baa wechɔɡa nkontaa bu.
Kɛ le Adam bere saŋ la ba le Mosis bere saŋ la, dɛ seo chɔ le tɛ nomɛlbwa.
