Hale nɛra ba fa aa wola Korowii nyoa vɛɛh kɛ Adam la bwaa fa dɛ serewe.
Adam chaaree naate ba fa aa ŋɔa o dɛ ba bala la.
Onee Yeesu Kristo.
Kɛ Adam ne Yeesu waa ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ chae Korowii aa na ya sum dɛ cha yaa la, a ne Adam wechɔɡa ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ.
A ɡwaala kohona.
Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ wechɔɡa taa a che seo ba nomɛlbwa nɛ.
Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ alaworomɛ ɡee nɛra bwa di.
Onee Yeesu Kristo.
O nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ sune nomɛlbwa nɛ, dɛ cha yaa kohona a ɡwaa Adam wechɔɡa la.
A berɔ do kɛŋɔ chae Korowii aa cha yaa la ne waa aa le nɛmbeŋkpoŋ la wechɔɡa ta la ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ.
Wechɔɡe beŋkpoŋ taa a che Korowii pa ya bwa bolchɔɡe.
Asɛ wechɔɡa aa wara la, Korowii na ya bwa sum, dɛ cha yaa dɛ lɛ yaa kɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi.
Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ wechɔɡa taa seo che dɛɛ di kora nɛwɛnyina bwa nɛ.
Gɛɛ a che nɛmbeŋkpoŋ nɛɛ asɛ Korowii na nɛwɛnyina sum kohona kwaraa dɛ cha yaa ya won ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi pɛɛpɛɛ dɛ di kora mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta.
Onee Yeesu Kristo.
Gɛ Adam wechɔɡe beŋkpoŋ aa lɛ chɔɡre tɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa la, ɡɛɛ Yeesu Kristo wedɛɛɡe beŋkpoŋ waa ɛa ɡel Korowii lɛ yaa kɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi, asɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa won dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ deŋnekpeɡ aa ɡela nɛra bwa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la, ɡɛɛ a che nɛmbeŋkpoŋ pwɛre waa doa ta, asɛ Korowii lɛ nɛra kɛrɛdɛ kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi.
Mmara balɔ dɛ ɡel wechɔɡa warɛ.
Kɛ, wechɔɡa aa dɛ dawɛ la, a taa Korowii na nɛwɛnyina sum, dɛ cha yaa kohona.
Gɛ wechɔɡa aa cheɡɛ seo nɛɛ dɛɛ di kpeɡri la, ɡɛɛ Korowii suna waa dɛ sune nɛwɛnyina nɛɛ la ɡe che ɡɛ Korowii aa ɛ yaa nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi la ta dɛɛ di kpeɡri, asɛ ya won dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ɡelɔ nɛra ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su Korowii siwi.
Wechɔɡa taa a che seo ba asɛ a che Yeesu nɛɛ mkpa ba Taraken nɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ŋɔe yɔ?
A chɛ kɛ ya na dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa tɔpere bɛlbwa, ásɛ Korowii ɛɛ na ya sum, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ kɛ yaa tɔpere bɛlbwa kɛɛ?
Akai!
Gɛ nɛn sewaa, waa wola toole wobɛlbwa bini kpa la, ɡɛɛ ya ne wechɔɡa baah do.
Aah dɛ ya ne wechɔɡa aa wola toole wobɛlbwa bini nɔ, ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa yaa ba wona dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jaɔ?
He soɔh kɛŋɔ baa sɔ yaa Korowii nee yáa teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la, ya ne onee pɛa sewɛ kɛɛ?
Baa sɔ yaa Korowii nee la nomanta, a kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ ya ne Yeesu Kristoo ba pɛ huɡe.
Ya ne waa pɛa sewɛ la nomanta, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o kpeɡri a dɔŋ aa wola toole la ta dɛ iru seo ta la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba ya ɡe chae ya kwaa so sofale waa wera, dɛ́ charɛ dofale waa wera.
Dɛ ya ne o pɛo dɛ sewaa, ya ne wɛɛ pɛo ir seo ta.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya dobene la ne Yeesuu ba pɛ saɡɛ o daɡaɡre ta.
Ya dobene la ne o wechɔɡa bwaa ba kpo, ásɛ o bɛ won di kpeɡri ya nɛɛ kpa, ásɛ wechɔɡa bɛ won yawɛ yaa yoma kpa.
Nomɛlbwa waa sewa la, o fooro le wechɔɡa kpeɡri aa dɛ di la be pera.
Ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa sewɛ la nomanta, ya dɔ yarada kɛŋɔ yaa dɔ mkpaa ya ne o pɛ so.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo ir seo ta waa wola sewɛ kpa bwa, seo ta kpeɡri dɔe o nɛɛ kpa.
O seo waa sewa la, kerabeŋkpoŋii o sewɛ dɛ pɔ kpeɡri wechɔɡa aa dɔa la nɛ.
Taraken soɡa waa soɡa nɔ, o soɡoo tɛ Korowii.
Gɛɛ a chɛ kɛ he kpɔ he te kɛŋɔ he ne wechɔɡa toole wobɛlbwa bini kpa kɛ nɛn aa sewa la.
He ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la nomanta, a chɛ kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii he do le tɛ.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ di kpeɡri he nɛ, ásɛ hɛɛ ɛ he bwadabii waa wola lee do saŋ bɛlbwa nɔ tetoowa.
He bɛ he bwadabii bobɛlbwa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ nɛra baa sewa dɛ ir, dɛ charɛ ba soɡa ne ba dor.
Hé kpɔ he bwadabii bobɛlbwa tɛ Korowii, dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra.
Wechɔɡa aa kpeɡri dɔe ba he nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii suna waa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ la lɔɡaa he do.
He toole Mmara lɔɡa kpa.
Yá kpɔ ya te do wedɛɛɡa ta dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ Yaa lɔ Korowii suna waa sune ya nɛɛ lɔɡa yaa wola toole Mmara lɔɡa nɔ, a chɛ kɛ yaa ɛ wechɔɡa kɛɛ?
Akai!
Kɛ he jemɔ kɛŋɔ dɛ he kpɔ he te do nomɛl nɔn ta ŋɔ on dɔ heya aa, dɛ on dɔ heyaa kenɛ?
He kpɔ he te tɛ wechɔɡa aa, hɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡaa ásɛ dɛ sewɛ.
He kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii dɛɛ no o be naa, wɛɛ lɛ heyaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa, ásɛ he waa su o siwi.
Korowii jam!
Wechɔɡa fa aa yawɛ heyaa yom, asɛ taraken nɔ he no o waa baa chaɡle heyaa dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo he bambile bwa ne nɔ, Korowii le heyaa wechɔɡa yawa a fa aa yawɛ heyaa yom la ta.
Taraken nɔ, he berɛ yoma dɛ tɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ.
He waa mun noe jaŋne, a waa n kpɔ waa haa dɛ noa tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛɛ baɡle heyaa waa la.
Gɛ he fa aa teŋa dɛ kpɔ he te do wedoŋa ta wubwa dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé berɛ kpɔ he te do wedɛɛɡa ta, ásɛ he waa do ɡoroŋ.
Wubwa la, dɛ wechɔɡa yawɛ heyaa yoma.
Dɛ he ne wedɛɛɡa toole wobɛlbwa bini.
Dɛ wechɔɡa ɡboo hɛɛ ɛ. Taraken nɔ, a waa dɛ ɛ heyaa sihiih.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ, dɛ tɔnɔ besoo a dɔ tɛ heya ɔ?
Waa aa lɔ ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ habɔɔ laanee seo.
Kɛ taraken nɔ, Korowii le heyaa wechɔɡa ta.
On dɔ heya.
He tɔnɔ haa dɔa laanee kɛŋɔ he soɡa bini aa toɡra Korowii be.
A taa aa ba cheɡa ásɛ he dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.
Wechɔɡa dɔ a kembɔr.
A kembɔree seo.
Asɛ kon Korowii ɡe aa dɛ tɛ laanee mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ o che dɛɛ tɛ a ɡɛ mkpa nɔ.
Hahmor ne yal mmara wa Yabala, he jemɛ mmara wa, anomanta, he jemɔ kɛ harɛ ta ɡboo mmara dɔ kpeɡri nɛra nɛ.
Haah waa yala la, dɛ o jaa ta sewaa, hahmor mmara vɔrɔwo, o ɛ o jaa la ɡbo haah.
O jaa sewɔ te naa, dɛ hahmor mmara ta on vɔrɔwɛ kpa.
Kɛ dɛ o jaa ta soɡe le, asɛ o ne banfale ɡe berɛ do le ja aa, baa yerɔ hanjwamanee.
Dɛ o jaa sewɔ te naa, dɛ hahmor mmara ta on vɔrɔwe kpa.
O yalɛ banfale aa, dɛ o ta jwamane bɔe.
Yabala, Yeesu Kristo seo waa sewa la, a ɛo kɛŋɔ he ne onee pɛa sewɛ.
Anomanta, he toole Mmara lɔɡa.
Mmara la aa kpeɡri di he nɛɛ kpa kɛŋɔ haah jaa sewaa, waa wola toole hahmor Mmara lɔɡa kpa la.
He berɔ ɛ Yeesu Kristo waa ir seo ta la nɛra, ásɛ dɛ won ɛ Korowii toma, he waa dɔ tɔnɔ o be.
Saŋ la yaa lɔ wechɔɡa ya nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ aa dɛ nyin la ta dɛɛ ɛ la, dɛ Mmara la dɛ ir ya bambile wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta, asɛ wobɛlbwa yaa dɛ ɛ la, aa kaa ya ne seo ta.
Taraken te ya fooro, Mmara la ta yaa dɔe kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya ne a ɡɛ Mmara nɔ o fa aa kpɔ yaa berɛ yoma la toole wobɛlbwa bini kpa.
Ya ɛo kɛ yaa serewa.
Yaa Mmara ŋwɛnɛ ta kpɔe dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii kpa.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee dɛɛ baɡle yaa ŋwɛnɛfale yaa tomɛ Korowii taraken.
Mmara ne wechɔɡa wa Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, dɛ Mmara la aa were kɛɛ?
O wer, kɛ on ɡela n jemɛ kɛŋɔ komɛl lole baa yerɔ wechɔɡa.
Dɛ Mmara la fe ta ŋɔe ŋɔ nɛwɛnyini bɛ ɡel o sie beɡre o dɔŋ kon aa, n fe aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ sibeɡra aa were.
Liichɔɡa nao kɛŋɔ aa wonoo che Mmara Korowii aa doa la ta, dɛ́ ɡel n ɛ wechɔɡa.
Liichɔɡa aa na ɡɛ la, a cheɡɛ Mmara la ta dɛ ɡel n sie ɛɛ beɡre komɛlbwa ta.
Dɛ mmara toole naa, wechɔɡa ta kpeɡri dɔe.
Mmara aa wola toole la, dɛ wobɛlbwa toole n baŋa n so.
Kɛ mmara aa bala la, belaa liichɔɡa ɡe ir, asɛ n na kɛŋɔ n sewɔ.
Mmara o fe aa chɛ kɛ ó ba mkpa ne la, seo nee o ba.
Liichɔɡa nao kɛŋɔ a dɔ bɔr name.
Mmara taa a che dɛ neɡ mɛ, dɛ taɡ mɛ do seo ta.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Mmara la ɛ kondɛɛɡe, asɛ o bini wobɛlbwa ɡe toɡre dɛ do wer.
Aah dɛ kon waa wera nɔ, o taa a berɛ che mɛɛ ba seo dɔe yaa?
O ta laa.
Liichɔɡaa cheɡɛ kon waa wera ta dɛ ɡel n dɔ seo, dɛ baɡle o dor ásɛ n jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Mmara la taa a che asɛ ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ liichɔɡa doŋo, aa wola were kwaraa.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe bee Mmara la le dɛ do wer.
Kɛ n te, nɛwɛnyinii men, anomanta, wechɔɡa yaɡ mɛ.
Waa maa dɛ ɛ kwaraa la nɔ, n ta wone jemɛ waa aa ɡela mɛɛ ɛa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ maa waa n fe aa dɛ nyin ɛɛ la ɛ. Waa maa wola nyin laanee mɛɛ ɛ. Maa wola waa maa dɛ ɛ nyin dɛ ɡee ɛa la nɔ, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ n sɛoh kɛŋɔ Mmara la wer.
Anomanta, n ɡbaɡba laa dɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ.
Liichɔɡa aa lɔ n bini la, an ɡela mɛɛ ɛa.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ liidɛɛɡa bɛlbwa toole n bini.
N nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔɔ n ŋɔ nɔ.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, n dɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ, kɛ maa won an ɛ. Wedɛɛɡa maa dɛ nyin ɛɛ la, a laa mɛɛ ɛ. Wechɔɡa maa wola a ɛɛ nyin la, anee mɛɛ ɛ. Dɛ waa maa wola ɛɛ nyin la, dɛ anee mɛɛ ɛ aa, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba laa dɛɛ ɛa kpa, dɛ liichɔɡa aa lɔ n bini laanee dɛɛ ɛa.
Waa maa naa laanee kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ yaa, dɛ komɛl ŋɔ n bɛ ɛ. N bambile fe lawɛ Korowii Mmara la ta teŋa, kɛ n bwadabii ɡe berɔ do dor bɛl.
O dɛ vuuɡi n bambile.
N bwadabii aa Korowii Mmara la aa lɔ n bambile bini la ta teŋa nyin.
Liichɔɡaa ɡela n bwadabii aa wola Korowii Mmara la ta teŋa nyin nɔ.
A ɡɛ liire nɔ yaɡ mɛ yom.
Akwe!
Bɔkwa waa na mɛ ken ɔ?
Umee dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ bwadabii nɔ waa dɛ kaa n ne seo ta nɔ nɔn ta nɔ?
Korowii jam.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo alaworomɛ, Korowiirii dɛ́ lɛɛ mɛ.
Anomanta, n bambile bini te, Korowii Mmara taa mɛɛ teŋɛ.
Kɛ n nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ be pera te, wechɔɡa taa mɛɛ teŋɛ.
Mkpa dɔe Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ta Taraken nɔ nɛra ba ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la te aa bolchɔɡe dii ba ba tɛr ba deŋne.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe lɔɡa maa lole dɛ dɔ mkpa nɔ taa Yeesu Kristo che dɛ lɛɛ mɛ le wechɔɡa ne seo lɔɡa n fa aa lole la ta.
Nɛwɛnyini mar aa do ɡɛ, waa wola kpeɡe dɛɛ tɔ Mmara ŋwɛnɛ, asɛ Mmara lɛ nɛwɛnyini kahonɛ la, Korowii te wono lɛ nɛwɛnyini.
O ɡelɔ o Bie tenten kpɔ nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ dɔŋ, dɛ ba chɔɡ liichɔɡa kpeɡri o fa aa dɔa nɛwɛnyini nɛɛ la dɛ laa wechɔɡa kpɔ, ásɛ ya waa do sweih kɛŋɔ Mmara la aa baɡla ŋɔ yá do la.
Yaa nɛwɛnyini mar liichɔɡa aa suu nɔ waa ta teŋɛ, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa taa yaa teŋɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ nɛwɛnyini mar liichɔɡa aa suu nɔ tetoowaa ta la, a taa ba ɡe liire do.
Nɛra ba ɡe aa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa ta la, a taa ba liire do.
He kpɔ liire do nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ liichɔɡa waa ta naa, he ne sewee.
Kɛ he kpɔ liire do Korowii Domadɛɛɡe tetoowaa ta naa, he dɔ mkpa dɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o liire do bwadabii waa ta dɛ ɡwaa wobɛlbwa la, o som laa Korowii, waa Korowii Mmara ta teŋɛ.
Waa won teŋɛ Korowii Mmara ta ɡe bwa.
Nɛra baa kpɔ ba liire do nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ dɛ ɡwaa wobɛlbwa la, ba waa aa won too Korowii tea bwa.
He te la, he ta he nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ som kpɔe ɡwaa wobɛlbwa.
Dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe lɔ he nɛ aa, ɡɛ waa dɛ baɡle heyaa laanee hɛɛ ba dɛɛ ɛɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola Domadɛɛɡe Yeesu Kristo aa dɛ tɛ la dɔe la, dɛ Yeesu nɛn laa on.
Dɛ Yeesu Kristo Domadɛɛɡe la lɔ he nɛ aa, wechɔɡa nomanta, he bwadabii ɛɛ sewɔɔ te.
Kɛ Korowii aa lɛ heyaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa he waa su o siwi nomanta, he lileore ɛɛ dɔ mkpaa.
Korowii waa ir Yeesu Kristo seo ta la, dɛ o Domadɛɛɡe lɔ he nɛ aa, ɡɛ Korowii aa iru seo ta la, wɛɛ che o Domadɛɛɡe la taa, dɛ́ tɛ he bwadabii aa dɛ ba pɔeh kerekere nɔ mkpa.
Anomanta, yabala, waa dawɛ ya nɛ, ya di kem, kɛ ya nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ kem laa ya di á ɛ kɛŋɔ yaa teŋɛ o nɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ nɛn teŋɛ nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ pɛla waa ta naa, waa mkpa dɔe ba.
Kɛ dɛ nɛn cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la nɛɛ dɛ vɛh o bwadabii pɛla wobɛlbwa naa, wɛɛ dɔ mkpaa.
Nɛra baa kpɔ ba te tɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe wɛɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ la, Korowii biirii ban.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa kpɔa tɛ heyaa la, o ta ɡelɛ he ne Korowii baah do kɛŋɔ nɛn ne o yom asɛ hɛ́ɛ ɔmɔ.
O ɡelɔ he ɛ Korowii bii.
O alaworomɛ ya won wii dɛ́ yerɛ Korowii ‘Mɛɛ, n Mɛɛ’, kɛŋɔ bie aa dɛ yerɛ o mɛɛ la.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡee yon ɡel ya jemɛ ya bambile bini kɛŋɔ Korowii biirii yaa.
Yaa ɛ Korowii bii nomanta, dɛ ya sɛoh dɛ na wahala Yeesu Kristo aa naa la aa, ya ɡee di o kapɛrɛɛ kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo aa dɛ di la, ásɛ Korowii kpɛɛ yaa ɡɛ waa kpɛɛ Yeesu Kristo la.
Kerekere jirima wa Wahala nɔ yaa dɛ na taraken nɔ, he nyiŋi som yaa dɛ ba nae kerekere la aa, a ta wahala ɛɛ kwaraa.
Korowii kontaala bwa siwi swɛɛrɔ aa kpa tɔɔ la wee Korowii aa baɡle nɛra baa ɛ o bii la.
A dɛ yo dɛ yo kaahonɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ta a te dɔe.
Korowiirii taa o tetoora ta kɛŋɔ a bɛ kpeɡri dɔ.
Kɛ a dɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ tɔpebɛl Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo a foo dɛ́ le kpeɡri bɛ dɔe nɔ ta, aa wola pɔh kpa, dɛ́ ja Korowii bii nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡe na som kɛŋɔ baa foora la.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ba le fini, Korowii kontaala bwa bwara dɛ nyɛɡ, aa pɛmɛ kɛŋɔ lol tea aa lɔ haah o yon dɛɛ pɛmɛ la.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, Korowii kontaala ɡbo bwara laa dɛɛ nyɛɡ.
Ya nɛra yaa dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ kwaa Korowii aa ba tɛ yaa la bini konloɡle la, ya ɡba bwara dɛ nyɛɡ.
Ya dɛ nyiŋi Korowii ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ba ɛ yaa o biirii, dɛ́ lɛ ya bwadabii le wechɔɡa ne seo nɔn ta.
Korowii aa lɛ yaa la, dɛ ɡɛ hwɛɡa nɔɔ ya dɔ.
Kon nɛn aa dɔa la, waa berɛ dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ o waa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ dɔɔ kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ kon waa wola nɛn nɔn ta joɛ la, o waa baa hwɛɡɛ.
Ya te la, kon waa wola ya nɔn ta joɛ mɔɔ la, o waa yaa hwɛɡɛ.
Yaa too.
Gɛ ya hwɛɡa yaa dɔa la aa lawɛ yaa ya wahala bwa bini la, ɡɛɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡee cha yaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya yarada aa kanɛ.
Yaa jemɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ yaa soŋe Korowii kwara.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe soŋɔ dɛɛ tɛ yaa sum ne, nɛn aa wola won baɡle kwara.
Korowii te jemɛ nɛn bambile bini waa bwa, dɛ jemɛ o Domadɛɛɡe la nyu bini, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin la, ɡɛɛ o Domadɛɛɡe la soŋo dɛɛ tɛ o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ nyin Korowii la, wobɛlbwa aa puu ba la, o ɡelɔ a ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
O tetooraa o lee ba ba ɛ o bii.
Nɛra Korowii aa jemɛ ba waa cheɡ wubwa la, waa wola ban tae mɔɔ la, dɛ o tɔ sie lee ba ŋɔ bá ba do kɛŋɔ o Bie la ken, ásɛ ba bwa ɛ o Bie la nimanar, ásɛ o ɡe ɛ ba Dɔɔ.
Anomanta, nɛra Korowii aa tɔ sie lee ba ɡɛ la, o lee ba ŋɔ bá ɛ o toma.
Waa lee ba ŋɔ bá ɛ o toma la, o lɛɛ ba kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi, asɛ o tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ba ba so o jwɛh dɛ́ dɔ jirima.
Ya ta sie nyiŋi anɔ bwa na naa, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ŋɔe yɔ?
Dɛ Korowii teŋɛ ya nɛ aa, umee dɛ́ won ɛ yaa waane ɔ?
Nɛn waa wola yaa o Bie kwaraa vɔmɛ, dɛ koh ya bwa waa kpɔɔ do nɛwɛnyina nɔn ta ba kpoo la, bɔkwaa bala waa wola tea ta dɛ́ tɛ yaa komɛlbwa dɛ ja o Bie la nɛɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won na Korowii bii waa lee ba nɔ bwara wechɔɡe bɛl dɛ bolɔ?
Korowii kwara waa dɛ pa bole la, o ŋɔ ba waa wer dɛɛ su o siwi.
Aah dɛ umee dɛ́ won pa ba bolchɔɡe ɔ?
Yeesu Kristo kɛɛ?
Sewaa o te koh ya waa sewɛ, kɛ a ɡbo laa.
O berɔ ir seo ta dɛ ka so nomombɔr Korowii diɡ ta, dɛ soŋo dɛɛ tɛ yaa.
Bɔkwaa dɛ won pere ya ne Yeesu Kristo baah waa wola ya waa nyina ba kpaɔ?
Noe aa dɛ no yaa kɛɛ wahala yaa dɛ na, kɛɛ cheɡa nɛra aa cheɡɛ ya nɛ, kɛɛ lɔr, kɛɛ nyaa, kɛɛ dɛ ya cheɡɛ seo nyoa o, kɛɛ sewɔ?
Gɛ Korowii Tɔn aa dɛ baɡle la, “He nomanta, ya cheɡɛ seo nyoa saŋ bɛlbwa.
Saŋ bɛlbwaa baa ɛ yaa kɛŋɔ peera baa dɛ la ka kpoa la ken.” Anɔ bwa sekwaraa ta la, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ yaa yoo le.
Yeesu Kristo waa nyin yaa la nɛɛ yaa ba cheɡa dɛ le.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa toole dɛ tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ waa wola ya waa nyina ba.
Seo kɛɛ mkpa aa won tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ.
Nyundua toroma kɛɛ Bɔnsam toroma aa bea yaa wola an na aa won tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ.
Waa aa dɛ ɛ fini nɔ kɛɛ anɔ la aa dɛ ba ɛɛ kerekere ɡe aa won tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ.
Kwaa aa dɔ kpeɡri bɛlbwa sese ɡe aa won tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ.
Komɛlbwa toole dɛ do nyundua kɛɛ harɛ bobɛlbwa dɛ́ won tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ.
Korowii kontaala bini komɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won pere yaa le Korowii nyina aa cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ wɛɛ nyin yaa la ta.
Korowii ne o nɛra Kasinteŋii mɛɛ ba bola la.
Maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛn la nomanta, maa nyosone teŋe.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ɡelɔ n jemɛ n bambile bini kɛŋɔ maa nyosone teŋe.
N tea bini chɔɡɔ, n bambile ɡe aa n wee ɡel bwa.
N ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ tena baa ɛ n nɛraa ɡela n bambile bwa wee mɛ ɡɛ nɔ.
Dɛ Korowii taah mɛ asɛ n ne Yeesu Kristo baah pere kwaraa ásɛ o lɛɛ ba aa, n dɛ nyin ɡɛ.
Israel tena maa dɛ bol ba waa nɔ, Korowii ɛɛ ba o bii dɛ baɡ ba o jirima.
O ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo, asɛ o tɛɛ ba o Mmara, dɛ baɡ ba ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ baa tomɔ, dɛ baɡ ba nyoa bele aŋwɛnɛ bwa.
Ba nabaala la nɛra bwa aa jemɛ ba waa la naanaree ban.
Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛɛ ba la, o nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ be pera la, ba dwee on.
Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛwɛnyini bwa nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Onee chɛ kpɛɛra.
Aamen.
N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ Korowii vɛh o nyobaɡa la ta teŋa, kɛ Israel tena bwa laa Korowii le kɛ o nɛra.
Abraham naanar bwa ɡe laa Korowii bii.
Korowii aa ŋɔ Abraham be ŋɔ, “Aesek luɡe taa hɛɛ ba he naanar maa baɡɛ nyoa dɔe” la, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Abraham dwee la te bwa waa lol ba ɡɛ nɛra bwa aa dɛ lolɛ la, Korowii nɛra laa ban.
Abraham bie la Korowii aa baɡɔ nyoa la, o dweee Korowii jemɛ kɛŋɔ Abraham naanaree ban, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham nyoa la, waa waa bola laanee kɛŋɔ, “Benanyoa saŋ nɔ mɛɛ berɔɔ ba.
N ne bala dɛ Saara lolɛ bibaa.” Anɔ ɡbo laa.
Rebɛka aa kpoŋe o kpara la tea la, ba bwa mɛɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Ya nabaa Aesekee ba mɛɛ.
Baa wola ban lolɛ mɔɔ, a ɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa kɛɛ wedɛɛɡa la, dɛ Korowii dɔɔ ŋɔ ba nya be ŋɔ, “Bii nɔ, bechala la ɛɛ lɛ nomonome o dɔɔ bee, ásɛ o dɔɔ la berɛ dɛɛ tomɔ.” A ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ lee Korowii aa le Jekɔb la, o tetooraa o leo.
Jekɔb we-ɛɛla laa o nyiŋi dɛ leo.
Anee Korowii Tɔn la baɡle ŋɔ, “N nyin Jekɔb dɛ hah Esɔ” la.
Amɔ yaa wonoo ŋɔ Korowii waa ta toɡrɛ kɛɛ?
O waa toɡrɔ.
O ŋɔ Mosis be ŋɔ, “Naate n tea aa toora kɛŋɔ ń sune o nɛɛ la, mɛɛ sune o nɛɛ.
Naate n tea aa toora kɛŋɔ ń tea domɛ o nɛɛ la, n tea ɛɛ domɛ o nɛɛ.” Waa nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ nyin ne anɔ la yaa dɛ ɛ la, Korowii te aa an nyiŋi.
O te suna waa sune nɛwɛnyina nɛɛ la, anee wɛɛ nyiŋi.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ɡɛ Korowii fa aa ŋɔ Ijipt kooro be la.
Anee kɛŋɔ, “N ɡelɔ he ɛ kooro ásɛ nɛwɛnyina bwa che he nɛɛ dɛ na ɡɛ maa dɔ kpeɡri, asɛ dɛ yerɛ n sɔn harɛ ta bobɛlbwa.” Naate Korowii tea aa toora kɛŋɔ ó sune o nɛɛ la, o nɛɛ wɛɛ sune.
Naate ɡe o tea aa toora kɛŋɔ ó ɡel o deŋne do kpeɡri la, onee o ɡel o deŋne ɛɛ do kpeɡri.
Nomɛl ɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Dɛ kenii a do aa, Korowii ɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ nomɛl deŋne kpeɡri nomanta, o ɛ wechɔɡa aa?
Umee dɛ́ won ŋɔ Korowii we-ɛɛla bɛ won ɛɔ?” Dɛ henee ume kɛŋɔ Korowii bol waa he chaŋe bɛl ɔ?
Vii ɡee wonoo bɔɔ mamaa waa aa bala o mao ɡɛ waa mao wa aa?
Naate waa dɛ ma la, o ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ o kpɔ choh waa dɛ ma a ne la ma kwaa aa too o tea aa?
A too o tea aa, wɛɛ kpɔ a ɡɛ choh laanee ma viine anɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ bɛl dɛɛ ɛ kwaa tɔpejena ɡbo, dɛ́ kpɔ bɛl ɡe dɛɛ ɛ kwaa tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Gɛɛ a do Korowii be.
Nɛwɛnyina ɛ o viine waa maa.
Bane chɛ chɔɡa.
O ma bane ɡe ásɛ ba ba na som o be.
Dɛ o fe dɛ nyin o baɡle o bandia nɛra baa chɛ chɔɡa la nɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel nɛra na o kpeɡri, kɛ o lawɛ bambile, ásɛ nɛra waa sune ba nɛɛ dɛ cheɡ ba kɛŋɔ bá ba na som la won jemɛ ɡɛ o som la aa doa dɛ dɔ jirima kohona.
Yanee o sune ya nɛɛ la.
Yanee o le ŋɔ ya ɛ o nɛra la.
Israel tena ɡbo bini laa o le nɛra ŋɔ ba ɛ o nɛra.
O le bane nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ɡe bini.
Kenii o ŋɔ o keame Hosia tɔn bini.
“Nɛra ba fa aa wola n nɛra ɛɛ n fa aa wola ban nyin la, mɛɛ yer baa n nɛra ne n nɛnnyinaa.” Ba chwerɛ tɔn la bobɛl ɡe ŋɔ, “Nɛra Korowii fa aa ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, ‘N nɛra laa heyaa’ la, baa berɔ yer ba Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa bii.” Aesaya bol Israel tena waa ŋɔ, “Dɛ Israel tena warɔ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle kwaraa naa, ba bini tamaa kenii Korowii ɛɛ ba lɛɛ.
Wɛɛ bol nɛwɛnyina bwa waa wɔrɔbe nɛɛ dɛ́ pa bole.” Anee Aesaya fa bol la, “Dɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro fe ta o nɛra dwee tama bane ɡelɛ aa, ya fe ɛɛ tonɔɔ kwaraa kɛŋɔ Sodom ne Gomoora tena.” Israel tena yarada bɛ dɔe Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ŋɔe yɔ?
Nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ la, ba siwi aa wola swɛɛrɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii lɛɛ ba kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi la, ba yarada nomanta, Korowii siwi su ba.
Kɛ Israel tena te aa swɛɛ siwi dɛ kpɔ ba sie do Mmara ta teŋa ta, dɛ ŋɔ anee dɛ́ ɡel Korowii lɛɛ ba kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi la, o siwi ta ba te kwaraa sui.
Aah dɛ bɔkwaa ɡela a ba ɡɛ nɔ?
Baa wola sie kpɔe dawɛ Korowii yaradae ta, dɛ kpɔ sie dawɛ ba we-ɛɛla ta kɛŋɔ anee dɛ́ ɡel Korowii siwi su ba la, a waa.
Anomanta, ba lɔ naa Bwe nɛra aa lɔ naa o ta dɛɛ chole la ta.
O waa ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini la.
Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ Bwee cheɡ Saayɔn, ásɛ nɛra ɛɛ lɔ naa o ta dɛɛ choɡli.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa yaradao la, sihiih aa o kpoe ba.”
Yabala, Korowii fe lɛ Israel tena aa, a fe som n be noo!
N soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛɛ ba ɡa.
Kasinteŋ, n wono bol ba waa kɛŋɔ ba Korowii toma swɛɛ ba siwi te, kɛ baa on tomɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Baa ɡɛ Korowii aa ɛa dɛɛ lɛ nɛra kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba wa ɛɛ su o siwi jemɛ, anomanta, ba ɡbaɡba ŋwɛnɛɛ baa kpɔ, dɛ vɛh Korowii ŋwɛnɛ waa cheɡɛ o ta dɛ ɡel nɛra wa ɛɛ su o siwi la ta teŋa.
Yeesu Kristo bala la teŋe Mosis Mmara ta teŋa ta kɛŋɔ a taa nɛn che Korowii lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi la.
Taraken nomɛlbwa waa yarada Yeesu Kristo waa la, Korowii ɛɛ lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡee ásɛ o waa su o siwi.
Kenii Mosis bol nɛra baa dɛ nyin ba che Mmara ta teŋa ta ásɛ ba waa su Korowii siwi la wa.
O ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ waa aa lɔ Mmara la bwa ta la, wɛɛ dɔ mkpaa le Mmara la ta teŋa ta.” Kenii Korowii Tɔn baɡle nɛra baa che yarada ta, ásɛ ba waa su o siwi ɡe wa, “Bɛ he nyu bini lii ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ la nyundua?’ dɛ́ kpɔ Yeesu Kristo tu harɛ, ‘kɛɛ dɛ tu bɔluŋ bini dɛ ka nyinu ba nɔ?’ dɛ ka nyinu le lala bini ba.” Waa Korowii Tɔn aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, “Korowii waa la pu heyaa tonɛ a lɔ he nyoo ne he bambili ta kwara.” Yeesu Kristo yaradae waa yaa dɛ bol he be laanee Korowii waa nɔ.
Dɛ he nɛn kpɔ nyoa ŋɔ komɛlbwa Dɔɔree Yeesu, dɛ yarada he bambile bini kɛŋɔ Korowii iru seo ta naa, Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo waa la yaradae bambile bwa ne taa a che Korowii ɛɛ lɛ nɛwɛnyina kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba wa ɛɛ su o siwi, asɛ a bola nyoa ne dɔŋa be taa a che Korowii ɛɛ lɛ yaa.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa yaradao la, sihiih aa o kpoe ba.” Juu tena ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ba bwa kɛrɛdɛ Korowii be.
Komɛlbwa Dɔɔree Korowii.
Nomɛlbwa waa wia dɛɛ yerɔ la, o dɛ chao kohona.
Anee Korowii Tɔn bol la, “Nomɛlbwa waa wi yerɛ ya Dɔɔ la, wɛɛ lɛo.” Aah dɛ nɛn ta on yaradae dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo waa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won yerɛ o sɔn ó lɛo wɔ?
Dɛ nɛn ta o waa noɛ yaa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won yaradao dɛ́ kpɔ o te tɛo wɔ?
Dɛ nɛn ta o waa la bolɛ nɛn be naa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ ó noɔ?
Dɛ Korowii ta nɛn tomaa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ bol o waa laɔ?
Anee kɛŋɔ Korowii Tɔn aa ŋɔa la.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ toroma baa kpoŋe Amanesoma dɛɛ valɛ la, hé no ba bala wa aa, he bambile ɛɛ sɔɔh heyaa taeh!” Amanesoma la balɔ, kɛ Israel tena bwa laa sɛh a ta teŋa.
Korowii keame Aesaya ɡbaɡba fa bolɔ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, umee yarada waa yaa bol ba be laɔ?” He nyiŋo na naa, Yeesu Kristo waa la noe taa a che nɛra ɛɛ yaradaa, asɛ a bola ɡe taa a che nɛra ɛɛ noa.
Mɛɛ bɔɔ heyaa webeŋkpoŋii.
Kpelaa kɛŋɔ ba ta noɛ yaa?
Ba noɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Ba waa baa dɛ bol la la harɛ ta bobɛlbwa nɛra aa lole, a tel harɛ jaɡa bwa.” N berɔ dɛɛ bɔɔ ja.
Israel tena fa ta noɛ yaa?
Mosis tɔ sie chwerɛ waa Korowii aa bola, dɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ bɔweela nɛra baa wola ban kure dɛɛ ja n nɛra nɛɛ la nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he bwaawee ir harɛ o nɛra aa ɡɛna nɛ.” Korowii keame Aesaya te kwaraa chwerɛ Korowii wobol ane a ɡwaa ɡɛ.
O chwerɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra ba fa aa wola n bɔr ɡaaɡe la, ban na mɛ, banɔ la ba fa aa wola n waa bɔɔ la, banee n kpɔ n te chaɡle.” Kenii o baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa bol Israel tena ɡe wa, “Saŋ bɛlbwaa n paɡri n nɔɔra kɛŋɔ ń lɛ n nɛra kɛ baa men yarada.
Ba deŋne kpeɡri, baa waa ɡe no.”
Korowii ta o nɛra Israel tena waa soɛh N dɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ, Korowii vɛh o nɛra Israel tena kɛɛ?
Akai!
N ɡbabir nɔ, Israel tee men.
N ɛ Abraham naa dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea.
Korowii ta nɛra o fa aa lee ba cheɡ wubwa ba ɛ o nɛra la vɛɛh.
Kɛ he jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa bol Korowii keame Elaeja waa ŋɔ o chɔɡ Israel tena tɛ Korowii laɔ?
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ba kpoo he keamere dɛ huɡri bela baa kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛɛ bwa.
N ɡboo kaa, dɛ ba dɛ nyin n ɡba kpoe.” Ɛrɛɛ Korowii chaŋe Elaeja ɔ?
O chaŋo ŋɔ, “N ta dɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa banuanɛ bane ba do le dɛ ɛ n nɛra baa wola voɡ Baal ɡuŋe bwa.” Gɛɛ a do taraken.
Nɛra tama bane ta lole Korowii aa na ba sum dɛ lee ba ba ɛ o nɛra.
Ba we-ɛɛla ta laa a che o lee ba.
Ba sumii o na dɛ lee ba ba ɛ o nɛra.
Dɛ ba we-ɛɛla taa a fe che o lee ba ba ɛ o nɛra aa, dɛ suna baa ŋɔa Korowii dɛ sune nɛwɛnyini nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba la ta mun dɔe.
Ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ŋɔe yɔ?
Gɛ Israel tena aa dɛ nyin kɛ ba waa su Korowii siwi la, ba ta ɡɛ dɔe.
Nɛra tama Korowii aa lee ba ba ɛ o nɛra la, ba waa su o siwi.
Ba kar taŋ deŋne Korowii be.
Anee ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Korowii saa ba liire, dɛ tɛɛ ba sie aa wola kasinteŋ laanee na, ne deŋna aa wola kasinteŋ laanee no, dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini tɔpere nɔ” la.
Ya nabaa Devid bolɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii, ɡɛ saŋ baa dɛɛ di kwaa dɛɛ lɛ ba sie la, ɡel siswɛm piɡ ba.
Gel waa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta la ɛ kon baa lɔ naa o ta dɛɛ choɡli, dɛ́ ɛ bel dɛɛ laɡ ba, ásɛ ba wa ɛɛ ɡure ba nɛ.
Gel ba nyoŋe, ásɛ dɛɛ na wahala saŋ bɛlbwa.” Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ lɛɛ wa Mɛɛ bɔɔ webeŋkpoŋii ja.
Israel tena aa lɔ naa dɛ chole la, ba denɔ chole baa wola won ir kpa aa?
Akai!
Baa iruu, kɛ ba wechɔɡa la taa a che Korowii lɛɛ waa lɛ nɛwɛnyina la maa nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ, ásɛ Israel tena na ba bwara wee ba.
Israel tena wechɔɡa baa ɛa la ba wedɛɛɡa ne ba tɛ nɛwɛnyina, asɛ ba chola baa chola dɛ paŋɛ kwaa Korowii be la ɡe ba wedɛɛɡa tenten ne dɛ ba tɛ nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ.
Israel tena chola la kwaraa aa ba wedɛɛɡa ne ba tɛ nɛwɛnyina nɔ, dɛ ba bwa lɛ Korowii wa aa, ɛrɛɛ aa ba doe yɔ?
He nɛra haa wola Israel tena ɛɛ la, he bee mɛɛ bol waa nɔ.
Korowii aa lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ Yeesu torome he be nɔ, mɛɛ maŋkura n toma nɔɔ.
Bɛl lole n bwɛɛ tena na ɡɛ naa, baa meeroo, asɛ a che a ta ba bane lɛ Yeesu waa nɔ.
Aa cheɡɛ Israel tena ne Korowii baah chɔɡa ta asɛ nɛwɛnyina kabora ne Korowii baah kwaa nɔ, dɛ Korowii berɔ lɛ Israel tena dɛ kpɔ ba ɛ o bii aa, bɔkwa nee aa ba bala ɔ?
Aa ba silɛɛ nee kohona, kɛŋɔ lala bwa aa ir seo ta.
Dɛ kon pera wer dɛ chɛ Korowii aa, dɛ o kar la bwa ɡe wer.
Dɛ daa lune wer dɛ chɛ Korowii aa, dɛ o ne o kpala bwaa.
Moo laa pala dɛɛ kaa nyundua la aa?
Israel tena do kɛ kobaah ɔleve da.
Ba teŋe o kpala ane ta, dɛ kpɔ hen haa wola Israel te ɛɛ dɛ do kɛ kpɔɡ baah ɔleve daa kpale, dɛ ba vɔrɔwe marɛ kobaah kon la bɛl buɡ ta, asɛ hɛɛ nyɔ o nedɛɛɡa dɛ di, dɛ dɛɡ.
Anomanta, bɛ kena dɛɛ kpaɡri daa kpala la baa kɛa ta la nɛ.
He mbarafo mun ɔ?
Daa kpale laa hen kɛɛ?
Hen ɡela daa la lune do le kɛɛ an ɡela he do le nɔ?
He te ɛɛ ŋɔɔ he waa ba kɛ daa la kpala la ta asɛ dɛ vɔrɔwe marɛ.
He ŋɔ ɡɛ naa, kpelaa he ŋɔ.
Baa wola Yeesu waa la yaradae waa ba teŋ ba ta.
He ɡe aa yarada Yeesu waa la, a waa he ta che la.
Anomanta, bɛ mbarafo dɛɛ ɛ. Pwɛr he te dɛɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.
Israel tena kwaraa baa ɛ daa la tenten pera la, Korowii kɛ ba ta.
He tenee dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ, waa wola heyaa kɛ ta aa?
He nyiŋo na naa, dɛ he jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii tea som, kɛ o waa ɡe kpeɡri taeh.
Nɛra ba deŋne aa kpeɡa baa wola o ŋwɛnɛ ta teŋɛ la, o dɛ nyiŋ ba sinyɛɡa ne.
Kɛ dɛ hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o ŋwɛnɛ taa te naa, wɛɛ ta tea tɛ he te.
Kɛ dɛ he ta o ŋwɛnɛ ta teŋaa, wɛɛ kɛ he ɡee ta.
Dɛ Israel tena berɔ yarada Yeesu waa la te naa, Korowii ɛɛ berɔɔ lɛɛ ba do ba buɡ ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ aa kpeɡe o be.
Korowii laa ɡela ba teŋe he nɛra haa do kɛ kpɔɡ baah ɔleve daa kpala, dɛ ba vɔrɔwe marɛ kobaah ɔleve daa muŋkpul ta nɔ naa, ba fe aa an ɡɛ ɛ wubwa.
Aah dɛ Korowii won he nɛra haa do kɛ kpɔɡ baah ɔleve daa kpala kwara kɛɛ, dɛ vɔrɔwe marɛ kobaah kwaa kwaraa ta a maɡre aa, Israel tena baa do kɛ kobaah ɔleve daa kpala waa kɛa ta la, ɛrɛ waa dɛ o berɔ kpɔ ba vɔrɔwe marɛ ba buɡ ta aa wola maɡre ɔ?
Korowii ɛɛ lɛ Israel tena bwaa Yabala, wesɔɔhla anee mɛɛ nyin kɛ he jemɛ, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa laa he den jemɛ.
Anee kɛŋɔ Israel tena nɔ bane deŋnekpeɡ baa dɛ ɛ nɔ, ken laa aa ba kae.
Nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ nyin kɛ o lɛɛ ba la, ba tel ɡɛ del waa dɛ nyin la aa, Israel tena ɛɛ ɡel ba deŋnekpeɡ nɔɔ.
Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ lɛ Israel tena bwaa ba ɛ o bii, kɛŋɔ Korowii Tɔn aa baɡla la.
O baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyina Lɛɛ la ɛɛ le Saayɔnee ba, dɛ́ ba le Israel tena waa aa ɡela baa wola Korowii waa ta teŋɛ bwa la ta.
Fɔo n ne báa fɔwɛ laanee kɛŋɔ mɛɛ lee baa ba wechɔɡa taa.” Israel tena aa vɛh Yeesu Amanesoma la nomanta, ba berɛ Korowii dɔma, asɛ a le wedɛɛɡa tɛ heya.
Kɛ baa ɛ nɛra Korowii aa chal ba la nomanta, o ta dɛ nyin ba taeh.
Nyoa waa baɡɛ ba naawa la, a waa o taa nyin ba la.
Korowii te dɔɔ ŋɔ o nɛnee nɛn, dɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo wedɛɛɡaa yaa, waa nsana le.
Gɛ he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ fa aa wola Korowii waa ta teŋɛ, asɛ o koh kɛ Israel tena vɛh o waa ta teŋa, asɛ dɛ sune he nɛɛ la, ɡɛ tenten Israel tena aa vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa la, wɛɛ koh suna waa sune he nɛɛ la waa dɛ́ sune ba ɡe nɛ.
Nɛwɛnyina bwa taŋ deŋne Korowii be, asɛ o koh a waa dɛ pa nɛra bwa bolchɔɡe.
Ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa toole yá che o ta dɛ́ le a ɡɛ bolchɔɡe nɔ ta.
A ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ Korowii na ya bwa sum.
Korowii kpɛɛra Ei!
Korowii liire ne o wejema kan te!
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ Korowii waa mun ɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ o waa bini bwa nɔ?
Anee Korowii Tɔn baɡle la.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Umee jemɛ Korowii nyu bini nɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won baɡlo waɔ?
Ume komɛlee Korowii kemɛ ka a ɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii di o kem dɛ ba bɔɔ wɔ?” O ta nomɛlbwa kem dii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ on ta kon te bɛlbwa.
O nɛɛ komɛlbwa che dɛ do le, o waa ɡee a do le.
O chɛ jirima saŋ bɛlbwa.
Aamen.
Ya kpɔ ya te ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii Anomanta, yabala, n dɛ soŋe heya.
Hé nyiŋi Korowii suna waa sune ya nɛɛ la dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛo.
Gɛ baa kpɔ kondɛɛɡa aa chɛ Korowii dɛɛ su o siwi dɛ kpo dɛ ɛ saraha tɛo dɛɛ tomɔ la, hé ɡe kpɔ he te kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saraha la, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ he nɛɛ dɛɛ tomɔ he bokpeɡa ne.
Gɛɛ a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.
He bɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire la da kpɔ.
Hé ɡel Korowii tɛ heyaa liifala, dɛ́ berɛ heyaa ásɛ he won jemɛ waa waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa wera o be dɛɛ too o tea, ne waa aa toɡra.
N cheɡɛ suna Korowii aa sune n nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ o toma do n nɔn ta nɔ ta, dɛɛ ja heyaa kɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa haa doa la, ɡel ba nae ɡɛ.
Bɛ́lbwa pwɛr o te, dɛ́ won jemɛ waa Korowii aa tɛo yarada ŋɔ ó kpɔ ɛ.
Ya bwadabii ɛ kombeŋkpoŋ, dɛ dɔ nyu, ne nɔɔra, ne nakpale, dɛ amesoore bwa.
A bwa ɡe ne a tomaree.
Gɛɛ ya ɡba do.
Ya warɔ te, kɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa nɔ, ya bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, ya bɛlbwa ɡe lole tɛ ya dɔŋa.
Kpeɡri Korowii aa cha ya bwa ya dɔ kokoɡrɔ.
A chɛ kɛ ya bɛlbwa kpɔ kpeɡri Korowii aa sune o nɛɛ dɛ tɛo la ɛ toma.
Dɛ Korowii Waa bola kpeɡrii o kpɔ tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ bola ɡɛ del he yarada aa doa.
Dɛ he dɔŋa toma kpeɡrii Korowii tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ.
Dɛ waa baɡla kpeɡri ɡee o tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ baɡle.
Dɛ nɛra ɡbemba doe kpeɡrii Korowii tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ.
Dɛ dɔŋa kwaa kɛɛ kpeɡrii o tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛa bambile bwa ne.
Dɛ waa sie tɔe kpeɡrii o tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛa tea bwa ne.
Dɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ kpeɡrii o tɛɛ naa, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛa tepoŋ ne.
Hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa bambile bwa ne.
Hé hah wechɔɡa te bɛlbwa, dɛ́ lawɛ wedɛɛɡa te bɛlbwa bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ.
Hé lawɛ dɔŋa kɛ nyabii, dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa duure ɡwaa ɡɛ haa dɛ lii he te ɡbaɡba.
Hé laa bɔhwaah kpɔ he waa bini, dɛ́ do ɡbemba dɛɛ tomɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo.
Haa dɔ hwɛɡa nomanta, hé ɡel he sie lɛ.
Wobɛlbwa pu heya aa, hé lawɛ bambile.
Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.
Hɛ́ɛ tɛ he dɔŋa asɔre tena ba soɡa bini aa kpeɡa tɛɛ ba he kwaa haa dɔa la ane.
He bɛ hɔɔhra dɛɛ doŋi he deremi.
Hé soŋe andɛɛɡa Korowii be dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa cheɡɛ he nɛ.
Hé soŋe andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, he bɛ wechɔɡa soŋe dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Nɛra lɔ silɛɛ bini naa, hé puu ba he ne ba lɛ sie.
Ba dɛ wi ɡe aa, hé ne ba wi.
Hé ne he dɔŋa so sodɛɛɡa.
He bɛ jenu dɛɛ ɛ, he bɛ he te pere dɛɛ le nyaara ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra bini.
He bɛ he te wejerema kohona dɛɛ lii.
He bɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ dɛɛ bɔ wechɔɡa kem.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ waa aa wera nomɛlbwa be.
Dɛ aa maɡroo waa, hɛɛ wonoo waa, hé takapɔ ásɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa bɛ he ne nomɛlbwa baah do.
Yabala, nɛra ɛ heyaa wechɔɡa aa, he bɛ ane ɛ dɛɛ bɔ kem.
Hé kpɔ tɛ Korowii.
O baah dɛ di ba nɛɛ taeh.
On dɛ bɔ ba kem, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ tɔ a peɡee, mɛɛ bɔ ba a kemee.’ ” He bɛ waa kem dɛɛ bɔ.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa ŋɔa hɛ́ɛ ɛ la.
“He dɔm chɔ lɔr aa, tɛo kondikwaa ó di.
Nyɔɡre dɛ kpoo waa, tɛo nee ó nyɔ.
He ɛ ken aa, sihiih dɛ ba o kpoe o baŋa ɡole.” He bɛ ɡel liichɔɡa lɛ he lem.
Hé kpɔ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɔ wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ.
Duure kpɔe tɛ harɛ nomonome A chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa siwi su o harɛ nomonome dɛɛ teŋɛ ba mmara ɡe ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ta ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ yaa, nomonome aa lee do.
Korowiirii cheɡ ba.
Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh o harɛ nomonome mmara ta teŋa la, dɛ waa Korowii aa cheɡaa o vɛh.
Wɛɛ di bolchɔɡee.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa la, baa nomonome ɔmɛ.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa dɛɛ ɔm ba.
Haa nyin kɛ hɛɛ ɔmɛ nomonome sie cheɡa aa, amɔ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
He dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa aa, baa kpɛɛree, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii bonɔɔnaa ban.
He kɛrɛdɛ waa baa ɛ ba toma la.
Dɛ he dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa te naa, dɛɛ ɔmɛ nomonome, dɛkalkɛŋɔ pɛɛpɛɛ laa ba dɔ kpeɡri baa kpoŋa la.
Korowiirii tɛɛ ba kpeɡri ásɛ ba tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋne dɛɛ tɛo.
Anomanta, hé ɡel he siwi ɛɛ su he nomonome.
Korowii bala waa dɛ ba bala dɛ́ ba tɛr he deŋne la ɡbo waa laa a chɛ kɛ he siwi ɛɛ su ba.
Dɛ he siwi aa ban su aa, dɛ he ɡbabir liire aa ɡel he bambile sɔɔhne.
A waa a do wer kɛŋɔ hɛɛ bɔ toɔ ɡe la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomonome baa do toɔ lɛɛ mmara nɔ la, Korowii tomaa baa ɛ ɡɛ la.
Anomanta, komɛlbwa aa chɛ kɛ he tɛ nɛn la, tɛo.
Dɛ he nyu toɔ yaa, bɔ.
Dɛ he kondɔɔh bɛlbwa ɡe toɔ yaa, bɔ.
Dɛ duuree a chɛ kɛ he tɛ nɛn aa, tɛo, dɛ jirimaa a chɛ kɛ he tɛ nɛn aa, tɛo.
A chɛ kɛ yaa nyin dɔŋa He bɛ kem di wobɛlbwa ta a chɔ le kpa heyaa ka ja dɔŋa nyina ta.
A ɡboo ɛ kem aa chɛ kɛ he di.
Nomɛlbwa waa wona dɛɛ nyin o dɔŋ la, o tonɛ Korowii Mmara la bwa.
Korowii Mmara aa chaɡla kɛŋɔ, “Bɛ jwamane bɔ, bɛ nɛn kpo, bɛ ŋwɛ, bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre he dɔŋ kon la,” a ne anɔ la aa kaa la bwa lɔ a ɡɛ Mmara beŋkpoŋ nɔ waa dɛ baɡle kɛ, “Nyin he dɔŋ kɛ he ɡbaɡba” nɔ ta.
Nɛn haa dɛ nyinu la, haa on wechɔɡaa ɛ bwa.
Naate waa dɛ nyin o dɔŋ la, dɛ o dɛ teŋɛ Korowii Mmara la bwa ta.
Hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he jemɔ kɛŋɔ tɔpere la telo.
He jemɔ kɛŋɔ a telo kɛŋɔ dɛ chɔe he chɔ a, he ir!
Ya lɛɛ tɔpere la joɔ tonɛ taraken dɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ saŋ yaa kpɔ ya te tɛ Yeesu dɛ pa mun dɛɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ la.
Tɔpere waa kaa bɔr chaah la aa kanɛ kpa.
Tɔɔ perɔ tonɛ.
Hé ɡel ya ɡel waa aa ɛ biro bini waa ɛɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ bochaah laala do dɛ́ won yo biro bini wa.
Hé ɡel ya lawɛ ya te kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ do kɛ nɛra bɔr aa chaah ba nɛ.
Dɛ warɛ dɛ valɛ dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa ne sennyɔdɛɛ waa toole kpa, hanyin ne banyin ne wedoŋa toole kpa, naɡrenyin ne bɔweela toole kpa.
Hé kpɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ dɔmkwa, dɛ́ laa sie kpɔ he nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ tetoowaa ta.
He bɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ pwah Dɛ Kristo te bɛl lole, o yarada aa wola kanɛ wɛɛ nyin o jo he bini naa, hé lɛo do he bini.
He bɛ o we-ɛɛla aa korɛ he kwaa ta la dɛɛ tɔŋle.
Bɛl yarada ɡelɔ o won komɛlbwa dii, asɛ naate o yarada aa wola kanɛ la, o ɡee di papooni ne taŋna ɡbo, waa ol di.
Naate waa dɛ di komɛlbwa la, a ta chɛɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ lii naate waa wola ol di la nɛndoŋ.
Naate waa wola ol di la, o bɛ naate waa dɛ di komɛlbwa wechɔɡ-ɛɛ dɛɛ lii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii lɛo dɛ ɛo o bie.
Henee umeo he won pwah nomɛl bonɔɔ nɔ?
O dɔɔ ɡbaɡbaa dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛŋɔ ó won baɡle kɛ o bonɔɔ dɛ ɛ waa kɛɛ waa waa ɛ. Waa ɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ la nomanta, wɛɛ ɛ waa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ wɛɛ wonoo chao o ɛ wa.
Nomɛl ɛɛ dɛɛ liiruu kɛŋɔ tɔpere bɛl ɛ onjen ɡwaa bɛl, ásɛ bɛl ɡee lii kɛŋɔ tɔpera bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
A chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa jemɛ anɔ la aa wera kɛŋɔ o ɛ ne anɔ la aa wola were o nyu bini.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ tɔpere bɛl ɛ onjen dɛ ɡwaa bɛl la, o dɛ tɛ Korowii duure, a waa wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ di komɛlbwa la, o dɛ tɛ Korowii duure, a waa wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o dɛ jam Korowii kondikwaa la wa.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ki kondikwaa ane soo dii la, o ɡe dɛ tɛ Korowii duure, a waa wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ.
O ɡba dɛ jam Korowii.
Ya bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ so le dɛ tɛ o ɡbo, bɛlbwa ɡe toole o seo ɛ o ɡbo wa.
Yaa lɔ mkpa ta nɔ, dɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu waa ya do le.
Dɛ ya baa sewɛ ɡe aa, dɛ onee ya sewɛ tɛ.
Anomanta, ya lɔ mkpa ta noo, sewaa ya sewoo, ya Dɔɔ Yeesuu dɔ yaa.
Yeesu Kristo seo waa sewa dɛ ir la, o ɛ ɡɛ dɛ ɛ weera ne lala bwa dɔɔ.
Aah dɛ bɔkwaa ɡela he nɛra haa wola ol di ɛɛ pwah he bala baa dɛ di komɛlbwa nɔɔ?
He banɔ la haa dɛ di komɛlbwa ɡe la, bɔkwaa ɡela hɛɛ lii he bala baa wola ol di nɛndoŋa nɔɔ?
Ya bwa ɛɛ che Korowii siee, ásɛ o bol ya waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɡuŋ mɛ harɛɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa di kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii men.’ ” Anomanta, ya bɛlbwa ɛɛ baɡle o toma waa ɛa Korowii siee.
Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, yá ɡel dɔŋa pwaeh.
Waa aa chɛ kɛ yaa ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ ya ɛ ya liire kɛŋɔ waa aa ɡel ya dɔŋa lɔ naa dɛ chole kɛɛ ba ɛ wechɔɡa la, yaa ɡel a ɛɛ.
Pɛɛ n ne n Dɔɔ Yeesu aa pɛa nɔ ɡelɔ n jemɛ kaih kɛŋɔ, kondikwaa bɛlbwa toole dɛ ɛ kondikondoŋa.
Kɛ dɛ nomɛl lii o nyu bini kɛŋɔ kondikwaa ane ɛ kondikondoŋa aa, dɛ a ɛ doŋa dɛ tɛo.
Dɛ he koh he kondikwaa waa dɛ ɡel he dɔŋ ɛ wechɔɡa o tea bini chɔɡ aa, dɛ he dɛ nyinu wa aa?
O waa Yeesu Kristo koh dɛ sewɛ, anomanta, bɛ ɡel he kondikwaa haa dɛ di la chɔɡo.
Bɛ ɡel nɛra dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ yerɛ waa haa dɛ liira wedɛɛɡa la wedoŋa.
Kondikwaa yaa dɛ di ne anɔ la yaa dɛ ki la ta wejena bɛlbwa ɛɛ Korowii Kora waa bini.
Waa aa ɛ wehiah laanee kɛŋɔ ɡɛ yaa ɛ ya waa su Korowii siwi, ne waa aa dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne ya ne ya dɔŋa baah ta, ne silɛɛ aa le Korowii Domadɛɛɡe be.
Nɛn a ɡɛ waa nɔ aa hiaoh Yeesu Kristo toma bini la, Korowii sie dɛ lɛ o nɛ, asɛ o wa ɛɛ su nɛwɛnyina ɡe siwi.
Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ ya ɡel ya siwi swɛɛ waa aa dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne, ne waa aa dɛ ba ɡela ya dɔŋa che kiŋkiŋ ta.
Bɛ kondikwaa waa koh dɛ́ chɔɡ waa Korowii aa ɛa.
Ya won kondikwaa bɛlbwa dii, kɛ aa were kɛŋɔ ya di kondikwaa aa dɛ ba nɛn ne wechɔɡa ta laŋa.
Waa aa toɡra kɛ hɛɛ ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ ol dii ne sen nyɔe, ne wobɛlbwa aa dɛ ba wona ɡel he dɔŋ lɔ naa chole la, a chɛ kɛ he laa he te kpɔ a ta.
Gɛ he liire aa dɛ ɛɛ kondikwaa dii be pera la, kpoŋe a bini ɡɛ, ásɛ a do he ne Korowii ɡbo baah ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ aŋwɛnɛ taa wɛɛ ɛa, aa wola o liire bini aahna aahna ɛ la, o na som!
Kɛ dɛ o dɛ di komɛl dɛɛ ɛ aahna-aahna kɛŋɔ o ɛ kondoŋ kɛɛ o ta kondoŋ ɛɛ yaa, Korowii ɛɛ pao bolchɔɡee kɛŋɔ waa dɛ diu, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o waa waa dɛ ɛ la, waa an ɛ yarada ne.
Wobɛlbwa ɡe nɛn aa dɛ ɛ waa wola an ɛ yarada ne, o liire aa wola on kɛrɛdɛ do a ta la, a ɛ wechɔɡa.
Ɛ he bala tetoowa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba Ya nɛra ya yarada aa kana la, a chɛ kɛ yaa lawɛ bambile banɔ la ba yarada aa wola kanɛ la nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba.
A ta chɛɛ kɛ yaa ɛ ya ɡbo tetoowa.
A chɛ kɛ ya bɛlbwa ɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera dɛɛ tɛ ya dɔŋa, ásɛ a cha ba, ásɛ ba won che kiŋkiŋ.
Yeesu Kristo aa lɔ harɛ ta la, dɛ o tetoowaa laa wɛɛ ɛ. Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii, chɛɡa baa chɛɡɛ la, anee ba kpɔ tɛ mɛ.” Wobɛlbwa ba fa aa chwera la, dɛ yanee ba chwera tɛ kɛŋɔ yá hweli waa le a ta.
A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛɛ ja yaa bambile dɔe ta, dɛɛ do yaa ɡbemba, ásɛ a che a ta ya dɔ hwɛɡa.
Korowii waa dɛ tɛ nɛn bambile dɛɛ do ɡbemba la, on dɛ tɛ heyaa nyopɛo teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la ta, ásɛ he pɛ dɛ́ kpɔ nyopɛo kpɛɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii.
Anomanta, hé lɛ nɛra dɛɛ ja he nɛɛ ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa lɛ heyaa la, ásɛ nɛra na dɛ tɛ Korowii jirima, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo wono ɛ toma Juu tena bini, asɛ dɛ chaɡle kɛ Korowii waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
Anee Korowii ɛ dɛ chuɡri o nyobaɡa waa baɡɛ Israel tena naawa la, ásɛ a che a ta nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ɡe kpɛɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ waa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ kohona.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bobɛl ŋɔ, “Anomanta, mɛɛ yerɛ he sɔn nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ baahnee, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛre.” Dɛ berɛ chaɡle bobɛl ɡe ŋɔ, “He nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, hé pu Israel tena hɛɡre.” Dɛ berɛ chwerɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, hé bwa jam N Naa Korowii, dɛ́ ɡo yela kpɛɛro.” Asɛ Aesaya ɡe bol ja, dɛ ŋɔ, “Jese naa bɛl ɛɛ bao.
On dɛ́ ir dɛ́ di kora nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ nɛ.
O nɛɛ baa ba hwɛɡa dɔe.” Korowii waa ɡela ya dɔ hwɛɡa Yeesu nɛɛ la, ó tɛ heyaa silɛɛ ne bansɔɔhna he yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii la ta, ásɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡe cha heyaa, ásɛ he won dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ Yeesu nɛɛ kohona.
Pɔɔl bol waa baɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ Yabala, n ɡbabir jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa taeh.
He jemɛ waa kohona, dɛ won dɔŋa waa baɡla ɡe.
He nyiŋo na naa, n tɔn nɔ maa chwerɔ nɔ, n di heyaa kasinteŋ waane ta dɛɛ lii heya.
Korowii aa sune n nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ o toma nɔ do n nɔn ta ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ baɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, a waa n won di heyaa kasinteŋ ɡɛ la.
Maa dɛ bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la dɛɛ baɡle he nɛra haa wola Israel tena ɛɛ la, n kpɔ n te ɛ kɛŋɔ Sɔfo waa lɛ nɛra kwaa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛɛ ba Korowii Dea bini la.
N dɛ nyin he no a waa dɛ yaradaa, ásɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe won laa he doŋa kpɔ he nɛ, ásɛ he ɛ Korowii nɛra.
Belaa ń won kpɔ heyaa tɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo la, ásɛ he waa su o siwi o lɛ heya.
N ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa nomanta, n won n te maŋkurae toma maa ɛa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɔ ta.
Waa Yeesu Kristo aa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛ ɛ he nɛra haa wola Israel tena ɛɛ bini la, maa lii kɛŋɔ mɛɛ won bol anfala ane ja a ta.
A ɡbo waa n jemɛ.
Anee kɛŋɔ taraken haa yarada Korowii waa nɔ.
Waa Yeesu aa cha mɛ mɛɛ bol dɛɛ baɡle heya, ne waa waa cha mɛ mɛɛ ɛ, ne wekpeɡa ne nyokpowaa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri aa ɡela mɛɛ ɛ la bwa ɡelɔ he yarada Korowii waa nɔ.
Taraken nɔ, le Jerusalam ka le Ilirikum le bwa, n bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma nɔ bela.
N ɛ n liire wubwa kɛŋɔ mɛɛ bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma nɔɔ.
Kɛ harɛre baa bol o waa a ta la, a ta laa mɛɛ bola.
A waa laa aa, dɛ nomɛl toma waa pa a mun cheɡ la taa n kpɔ dɛɛ choŋi la.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Nɛra nomɛlbwa aa wola o waa bolɛ ba be ka la, baa no o waa, dɛ́ jemɔ.” Anɔ waa maa wola bɔr dɔe dɛ ba he be kera aŋwɛnɛ bwa la.
Kɛ taraken nɔ maa tonɛ n toma bonɔ nɔ, asɛ n sie che chiŋ bene aŋwɛnɛ nɔ bwa kɛŋɔ ń ba na heyaa nɔ, n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ n ba dɛ kaa Speen harɛ ta naa, ń na heya.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ n baa so he be tɔpera anɛ, dɛ le bela dɛɛ kaa Speen harɛ ta naa, hɛɛ cha mɛɛ.
Taraken nɔ, kwaane nee mɛɛ ba ń ba kaa ka tɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ do Jerusalam.
Ba bala baa lɔ Makidoonia ne Akaya harɛre ta koŋkwaare ane ŋɔ ń kpɔ ka tɛ Jerusalam Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, ba soɡa bini do kpeɡri tɛɛ ba la.
Ba sie lɛo kɛŋɔ baa ta kwaa la.
Kasinteŋ, baa won jam Jerusalam Korowii nɛra la ka tonɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa cha Israel tena asɛ nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ di ba tɔnɔ la, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛ dɛ nɛra baa wola Israel tena ɛɛ la ɡe dɔ harɛ bonɔ kwaa aa, Israel tena ɡe di ba tɔnɔ.
Dɛ n kpɔ ba suuɡa bwa ka do ba nɔn ta tonaa, mɛɛ ba kaa Speen harɛ taa.
Kɛ mɛɛ che he bee.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ dɛ n ba he be naa, mɛɛ soŋe Yeesu Kristo ó swee andɛɛɡa tɛ heyaa kɛrɛdɛ.
Yabala, n kpɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ne nyina Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa ɡela yaa nyin dɔŋa la, dɛɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ he cha mɛ dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ.
Hé soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ ásɛ o kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛɛ Juda harɛ tena baa wola Yeesu yarada la bini, ásɛ waa maa dɛ la ka ɛ Jerusalam Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bini la, bá sie lɛ a ta, ásɛ dɛ Korowii sɛoh waa, ń ba he be silɛɛ ne, dɛ́ ba onɛ tama.
Korowii waa dɛ tɛ yaa deŋnesɔɔhna la, ó cha he bwa.
Aamen.
Pɔɔl kal asɔre tena ŋɔ o dɛ na ba Yɔɔ.
Ya nimambie nɔ sɔne Fiibi.
Asɔre tena baa lɔ Keŋkrea la binii o do dɛɛ ɛ toma.
Hé lɛo ja he nɛɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ Korowii nɛra lɛ ba dɔŋ la ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nomanta.
Komɛlbwa waa dɛɛ nyin dɛ le he be la, hé chao, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɡba cha Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra taeh.
N ɡbabir nɔ, o cha mɛ ka.
N dɛ na Presela ne Akwela n ne ba bwa aa dɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo toma nɔ la.
Ba fa koh n waa dɛ kpɔ ba nyuune charɛ seo.
N ne asɔre tena baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la bwaa dɛɛ jam ba.
N dɛ na asɔre tena baa cheme ba dem dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la bwa.
N dɛ na n chamenate Epaenitus waa tɔ sie yarada Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ Eesia harɛ ta bwa la.
N dɛ na Mɛɛre waa dɛ ɛ toma he bini ɡa la.
Hé ŋɔ n bwɛɛ tena Andronikus ne Junias ba fa aa do n ne ba dea ka la be ŋɔ n dɛ na ba.
Ba ɛ nɛra bane ba sɔn aa lea Yeesu toroma bini.
Ba tɔ sie ɛ asɔre tena n nɛ.
N dɛ na Ampelatos waa ɛ n chamenate ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nɛɛ teŋa ta la.
N dɛ na Ɔrbanus ya ne o bwa aa dɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo toma nɔ la, ne n chamenate Stakes.
N dɛ na Apeles wekpeɡa aa puu o ta che kiŋkiŋ Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ ta la.
N dɛ na Aristobulus dem tena bwa.
N dɛ na n bwɛɛ te Herodion.
N dɛ na Nasesos dem tena la baa ɛ asɔre tena la bwa.
N dɛ na n nimambii Trefiina ne Trefosa ba bwa aa dɛ ɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu toma nɔ la.
Hé ŋɔ n nimambie Pɛɛsis nomɛlbwa aa dɛ nyin o waa la be ŋɔ n dɛ nao.
O ɡe koh ya Dɔɔ Yeesu toma nɔ ta ɡa.
N dɛ na Rufus o sɔn aa lea ya Dɔɔ Yeesu toma nɔ ta la, ne o nya waa nyiŋ mɛ kɛ n ɡbaɡba nya la.
N dɛ na Asiŋkritus, ne Fleɡɔn, ne Hɛɛmes ne Patrobas, ne Hɛɛmas, dɛ yabala baa jaa la bwa.
N dɛ na Faelolɔɡɔs, ne Julia, ne Nɛreɔs ne o nimambihaah, ne Ɔlempas, dɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bane ba do bela la bwa.
Hɛ́ɛ lea dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nyabii.
Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la bwa dɛ na heya.
Yabala, n dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ, hɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa ɡela he baah ɛɛ peɡri, dɛɛ baɡle waa a ne Yeesu Kristo waa baa baɡle heyaa nɔ aa wola jo, asɛ dɛɛ vuuɡi heyaa la.
Hé jem ba dɛɛ ke he te ba nɛ.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo laa baa tomɛ.
Waa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta la, anee baa ɛ. Nyotor ne nyosone nee baa neɡre nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ la.
Nɛra bwa dɛ bol he teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu waa la ta waa bobɛlbwa, anomanta, n sie lɛ he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Kɛ n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he ɛ wejerema wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ bɔr, asɛ dɛ ɛ nɛra haa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ wechɔɡa ɛɛ be pera.
Korowii waa dɛ tɛ yaa deŋnesɔɔhna la aa biɡri chɔɡ Bɔnsam ne o toma, ásɛ he tiɡri o nɛ.
Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya.
Timoti n ne waa dɛ ɛ toma la dɛ na heya.
Lusias ne Jasen, dɛ Sosipata ba bwa aa ɛ n bwɛɛ tena la dɛ na heya.
Men Tɛɛseɔs Pɔɔl aa ɡela n chwerɛ tɔn nɔ tɛo la, n ɡe dɛ na heyaa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sɔn ta.
Men Pɔɔl dea te Gayos dɛ na heya.
O deemii bonɔ asɔre tena ɛɛ cheme.
Erastos waa dɛ cheɡ bwɛɛ nɔ suuɡa la, o ne ya dɔŋ Kwaatos bwa dɛ na heya.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sune he nɛ dɛ cha he bwa sekwaraa.
Aamen!
Hé ɡel ya jam Korowii.
Wɛɛ wonoo ɡel he che kiŋkiŋ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma maa dɛ bol he be la ta.
Korowii pili a ɡɛ waa nɔ bini.
Anee fa ɛ wesɔɔhla saŋ la bwa la, kɛ taraken te, o cheɡɛ o keamere waa baa chwera la ta, dɛ le a bwa ne baŋ.
Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la tɛ ŋwɛnɛ taraken ŋɔ nɛ́ra bol o waa la.
O ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ ba bola dɛɛ baɡle nɛra bwa ásɛ ba yaradaa dɛ́ teŋɛ a ta.
Hé ɡel ya che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ jam Korowii o ɡbo aa ɛ Korowii, dɛ ɡbo jemɛ wobɛlbwa la.
O jirima aa tonɛ bwa!
Aamen.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn loɡle nɔ ka tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Kɔrent dɛ́ nyiŋi webeɡra ane aa lɔ ba baah ta.
Kɔrent ɛ bwɛjen, asɛ nɛra le bobɛlbwa ba so bela dɛɛ di bona.
Nɛra dɛ tomɛ voɡa ne koŋkwaare bwa soo siwi bela baa wola Korowii tomɛ, anomanta, dɛ banyin ne hanyin ne wedoŋa bwa soo siwi lɔ bela kɛrɛdɛ.
Pɔɔl nyiŋi wekpeɡa la bini beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, dɛ baɡle ɡɛ asɔre tena la aa che a ta tomɛ Korowii.
O dɛ bol kpeɡri Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ cha nɛra ba won kpɔ ɛ toma dɛɛ tomɔ, ásɛ asɔre la won che kɛrɛdɛ.
O dɛ bol nɛra baa serewa, ne ira baa bera dɛɛ ba seo ta ira tɔpebɛl wa.
Menee Pɔɔl aa too Korowii tea asɛ o lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ba ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la.
N ne n dɔŋ Sɔɔstenes bwaa chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he asɔre tena haa lɔ Kɔrent dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la.
Korowiirii le heya, dɛ koh pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la waa dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ he nɛɛ dɛ ɡel he ɛ o nɛra.
Ya dɛ chwerɛ he ne nɛra baa lɔ bobɛlbwa dɛɛ tomɛ ya ne ba bwa Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la.
N Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristoo dɛ́ cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Korowii jaama N dɛ jam Korowii tɔpere bɛlbwa kɛ waa koh pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la waa dɛ sune he nɛɛ dɛɛ cha heyaa nɔ.
He ne waa pɛa la nomanta, o ja heyaa kpeɡri ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
O ɡelɔ he jemɛ wobol, dɛ tɛ heyaa wejema, asɛ a baɡle kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo waa la ya fa aa bol he be la jo he bambile bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, taraken haa kpɔ hwɛɡa dɛɛ kpa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bala nɔ, wobɛlbwa kpeɡri ta heyaa nyae le Korowii be.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɔɔ dɛɛ ba ɡela he che kiŋkiŋ ka tel he serewe bena, ásɛ awola tɔpere waa ba la, wechɔɡa bɛlbwa bɛ he nɛɛ do.
Korowii ɛ kasinteŋ te.
Onee le heyaa ŋɔ hé ne o Bie la do som.
O Bie laanee ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la.
Asɔre tena dɔŋa baah peɡra wa Yabala, n kpɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo dɛɛ soŋe heyaa kɛ hé bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
He bɛ dɔŋa baahna peɡri, hé ɡel he nyoa pɛ he we-ɛɛla ne he liire ta.
Yabala, nɛra bane le Kloi dem dɛ ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, webeɡra chole he bini bane baah ta, a waa n bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ la.
N noɔ kɛ bane ŋɔ ba teŋɛ men Pɔɔl nɛ, bane ɡe ŋɔ ba teŋɛ Apolos nɛ, asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ Pita nɛɛ ba te teŋɛ, bane ɡe ŋɔ ba teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛ.
Hé na!
Yeesu Kristo binii he bɔne la!
Men Pɔɔlee ba koh he waa kpaa pɛl daɡaɡre ta la aa?
Kɛɛ n sɔn nee ba sɔ heyaa Korowii nee ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ la?
Akai!
N dɛ jam Korowii kɛ ɡɛ saŋ n fa aa lɔ he be la, n ta nomɛlbwa Korowii nee sɔe ka ja Krispus ne Gayos nɛ.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ŋɔ n sɔ heyaa Korowii nee ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ n nɛ.
Dɛ Stɛfanas ne o dem tena ɡe laa n berɛ sɔ Korowii ne aa, maa lii kɛŋɔ n sɔ nomɛl nee kpa.
Yeesu Kristo fe ta men tomɛ ŋɔ ń baa sɔ nɛra Korowii ne.
O ŋɔ ń ba bol Amanesoma la nɛra be, kɛ n bɛ n ɡbaɡba wejema ne nyotor kpɔ dɛɛ bol waa la, ásɛ Yeesu sewa waa sewɛ daɡaɡre ta la bɛ pɛɛpɛɛ ɛ. Yeesu dɔ wejema ne kpeɡri le Korowii be O daɡaɡre la ta seo la yaa dɛ bol a waa la ɛ wesale tɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyoɡre.
Kɛ ya banɔ la Korowii aa dɛ lɛ yaa la te, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii kpeɡri lɔ a ta.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra wejema ne tɔn jema ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.” A ba ɡɛ naa, dɛ lee wejerema ne tɔnjerema wejema dɔɔ jaɔ?
Nɛra baa dɔ wobol wejema ɡe, dɛ lee ba dɔɔ?
Korowii ɡelɔ nɛwɛnyini wejema ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Ba ɡbaɡba wejema ɡelɔ baa Korowii jemɛ.
Korowii kpɔ o wejema ɛa ɡɛ, dɛ ŋɔ a ɛo silɛɛ kɛ wɛɛ lɛ nɛra baa yarada Amanesoma yaa bola dɛɛ baɡle nɛra asɛ baa liira wesale la.
Juu tena dɛ nyin ya ɛ nyokpowaa baɡ ba, Grik tena ɡe ɛɛ nyin kɛ ya baɡ ba wejema mɔɔ ba yarada.
Ya te, Yeesu Kristo sewa daɡaɡre ta la waa yaa bol.
A ɛ waa Juu tena aa dɛ lɔ naa a ta dɛɛ vɛah, asɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ɡe la, a ɛ wesale ba be.
Kɛ Juu tena ne Grik tena Korowii aa lee ba ŋɔ bá ba ɛ o nɛra la, Yeesu Kristo waa la ɛ Korowii kpeɡri ne o wejema ba te be.
Waa nɛra aa dɛ lii kɛ a ɛ Korowii wesale la, a ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini wejema, o ɡwɛɡra ɡe ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini kpeɡri.
Yabala, hé lii ɡɛ haa doa asɛ Korowii le heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ la.
He ɡalɡa ta wejerema ɛɛ nɛra be.
He ɡalɡa ɡe ta nɛnjena ɛɛ nɛra be.
He bwa ɡe laa ɛ koobii.
Korowiirii saahna le waa nɛra aa dɛ liira wesale dɛ́ ɡel sihiih kpo wejerema, asɛ dɛ saah le ɡwɛɡra ɡe dɛ ɡel sihiih kpo kpeɡnɛra, dɛ kpɔ waa nɛra aa haah, ne anɔ la baa dɛ liira wepuu, ne anɔ la baa wola a waa jemɛ ŋɔ á ba chɔɡ anɔ la nɛra aa dɛ maŋkuraa la, ásɛ nɛn bɛ won ɡɔɔ o te Korowii sie.
Korowiirii ɡela he ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ, ásɛ ya che o nɛɛ dɛ dɔ Korowii wejema.
O nɛɛ a che Korowii na yaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa dɛ berɛ kpɔ yaa ɛ o kwa.
Onee kpɔ seo dɛ yawɛ yaa le ya wenaale ta.
Anomanta, ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn la aa ŋɔa la.
“Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o te maŋkurae la, wɛɛ maŋkura o te waa Korowii aa ɛa ta.”
Yabala, a ɡɛ saŋ n fa aa ba he be dɛ ba di Korowii waa danseɛ he be la, nyotor ne nɛwɛnyini wejema laa n kpɔ bol waa baɡle heya.
Maa lɔ he be la, dɛ maa nyin kɛ n kpɔ wejema ane ja n wobol ta, nemenɛ Yeesu Kristo seo waa sewa daɡaɡre la ta la wa.
N fa aa lɔ he be la, n ta kpeɡri dii he nɛ.
Ɔmee ne bochela nee n ɛ toma he bini.
N webaɡla bini la, n ta wejema kpɔe bol waa baɡle heyaa ásɛ he sie lɛ.
Kɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee di n wobol la danseɛ dɛ ɡel a do kpeɡri.
Anomanta, nɛn wejema ta laa a che hɛɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo dɛɛ teŋɛ o nɛ.
Korowii kpeɡri la taa a che.
Wejema aa le Korowii Domadɛɛɡe be Ya dɛ bol wejema waa te dɛɛ baɡle nɛra ba sie aa chaah Korowii waa ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Wejema yaa dɛ baɡle a waa nɔ ta harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ne ba nɛnjena wejema ɛɛ.
Ba te, ɛɛ baa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Korowii wejema waa yaa baɡle.
A fa sɔɔh, nɛwɛnyini fa aa wola a waa jemɛ.
A ɛ waa Korowii aa ɛa cheɡ yaa mɔɔ dɛ ta harɛ nɔ, ásɛ a ba cha yaa ya dɔ jirima.
Harɛ nɔ ta nomonjena fa ta a ɡɛ wejema nɔ mun noɛ.
Dɛ ba fe no a mun aa, ba fe ta ɡelɛ ba kpo ya Dɔɔ la waa dɔ jirima la daɡaɡre ta.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ waa ba faa chwerɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “Waa nomɛlbwa aa wola a dɔŋa nae, nomɛlbwa aa wola a waa noɛ, nomɛlbwa ɡe aa wola an liire laanee Korowii ɛ cheɡ nɛra baa dɛ nyin o wa.” Kɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o Domadɛɛɡe la ta dɛɛ baɡle yaa a waa ásɛ ya won no a mun.
O Domadɛɛɡe la dɛ na wobɛlbwa bini kɛrɛdɛ, hale dɛ jemɛ Korowii wesɔɔhla ɡba.
Nomɛlbwa aa o dɔŋ nyu bini jemɛ, nemenɛ naate ɡbaɡba.
Gɛɛ a do nɛwɛnyini aa wola waa aa lɔ Korowii be jemɛ.
O Domadɛɛɡe ɡbosoroo jemɛ o nyu bini.
Ya te, liire yaa dɔa ta harɛ nɔ ta liire ɛɛ.
Korowiirii kpɔa tɛ yaa.
O kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe tɛ yaa o do ya nɛ.
Anee ɡela ya jemɛ kwaa waa tɛ yaa la.
Yaa dɛ bol waa nɔ, yaa nɛwɛnyini wejema ta cheɡɛ dɛɛ bola.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee dɛɛ baɡle yaa waa yaa bol.
Anɔ la waa bol la, anee ya ɡe kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle o wa.
Nomɛlbwa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa wola toole o nɛɛ la, o dɛ vɛh o Domadɛɛɡe la wa.
A ɛ wesale tɛ naate, waa a mun no, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡboo ɡela nɛn ɛɛ no Korowii waa mun.
Nɛn Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa lɔ o nɛɛ la jemɛ wobɛlbwa ŋwɛnɛre.
Kɛ nɛn waa wola toole o nɛɛ la aa won jemɛ naate waa lɔ o nɛɛ la ŋwɛnɛre.
Korowii Tɔn bini ba pɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛn besoo dɛ won jemɛ Korowii liire o?
Umee dɛ won baɡlo waɔ?” Kɛ ya te dɔ Yeesu Kristo liire.
Asɔre tena dɔŋa baah peɡra wa Yabala, n fa ta wone bol waa baɡle heyaa kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ baɡle nɛra Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa chaah ba sie la.
N bola tɛ heyaa kɛ nɛra ba taa dɛ teŋɛ ba nɛwɛnyini mar waa ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he do kɛŋɔ bechale ken Yeesu Kristo waa la ta.
Wobopwɛra nee n faa baɡle heyaa waa kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɔr bechala waa wola tele ne kondikwaa dii la.
Hale taraken kwara he ta tele mɔɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ta dɛ teŋɛ nɛwɛnyini mar waa ta.
Bɔweela ne naɡra aa lɔ he baah ta nɔ, nɛwɛnyini mar nɛɛ laa hɛɛ teŋɛ nɔ naa?
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ he dɔ ɡɛ da nɔ naa, he ja nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire nɛɛ kɛɛ?
Dɛ he bane ŋɔ he dɛ teŋɛ men Pɔɔl nɛ, asɛ he bane ɡe ŋɔ ba dɛ teŋɛ Apolos nɛ aa, amɔ dɛ he ne nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ ba nɛwɛnyini mar ta la da beŋkpoŋ.
Bamewaa Apolos ne Pɔɔl hɛɛ maŋkura ba ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Tom-ɛɛra ɡboo yaa.
Korowiirii tomɛ yaa he be, ásɛ he no Yeesu waa dɛ́ yaradaa dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛo.
Toma Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ ya bini bɛlbwa laanee yaa ɛ.
Ya fa do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ du kwaa dɛ do he bini.
Menee dua, asɛ Apolos ɡe ka ba, dɛ ba do nee a ta.
Korowiirii ɡela kwaa la le dɛ kpeɡ.
Anomanta, nɛn waa dɛ du kwaa ne onɔ la waa dɛ do nee a ta la te bɛlbwa aa won waane ɛ. Korowii ɡbosoroo won waa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee ɡela kwaa won lee, dɛɛ kpeɡ.
Nɛn waa dɛ du kwaa ne onɔ la waa dɛ do nee a ta la te bɛlbwa ta korɛ.
Korowii dɛ bɔ bɛlbwa kem ɡɛ aa chɛa.
Korowiirii dɔ yaa, ya ne o pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma.
Asɛ he ɡe do kɛŋɔ o koo waa dɛ parɛ, ne o dea waa dɛ do.
Korowiirii cha mɛ n won ɛ toma kɛŋɔ nɛn waa jemɛ dea mae kɛrɛdɛ la, dɛ pa dea la mun, asɛ nomɛl ɡe ba ma dɛɛ chɔŋɛ.
Kɛ bɛlbwa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ waa maa dɛɛ chɔŋɛ.
Yeesu Kristo ɡboo Korowii den kpɔ cheɡ kɛ dea mumpar.
Dɛ Yeesu laa aa, nomɛlbwa toole yá che o nɛɛ ó lɛ yaa.
A do kɛŋɔ bane aa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm, bane kpɔ suuɡapoŋa, bane kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa, dɛ ma chɔŋɛ dea la mumpar la ta, asɛ bane ɡe kpɔ daa ne kpɔɡa ne jaaɡe sɛɛh dɛ ma chɔŋɛ.
Dɛ Korowii Tɔpere waa dɛ ba nɛra bwa waa bola dɛ́ pa bole la telaa, belaa baa ba nae ɡɛ bɛlbwa toma aa doa.
Awola tɔpere la, niinii dɛɛ ba toma nomɛlbwa aa ɛa la wer bini baɡla.
Dɛ nii la jo toma haa ɛa chɔŋɛ dea la mumpar la ta dɛ a ta fueh yaa, Korowii ɛɛ bɔe a kemee.
Kɛ dɛ nomɛl toma fuoh waa, Korowii ɛɛ lɛ naatee, kɛ wɛɛ paŋɛ komɛlbwaa.
Wɛɛ ɛo kɛŋɔ kon baa keeru le nii ta ken.
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii Dea asɛ o Domadɛɛɡe la so he bini kɛɛ?
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa chɔɡ Korowii Dea la, Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ naatee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o Dea la waa doa la ɛ dea doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta.
Heyaa o Dea la.
He bɛ he te dɛɛ neɡre.
Dɛ he bini bɛl lole dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ o dɔ harɛ nɔ ta wejema aa, ó ɛ o te ɡɛne ásɛ dɛ dɔ Korowii wejema tenten.
Harɛ nɔ ta wejema ɛ wesale Korowii be.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini dɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra kpɔ wejema ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, kɛ Korowii dɛ laɡ ba.” Ba chwerɛ o bobɛl ɡe ŋɔ, “Korowii jemɛ harɛ nɔ ta wejerema liire kɛŋɔ a ɛ wepuu.” Anomanta, he bɛ bane kpɔ dɛɛ ta nyoa.
Komɛlbwa chɔ le dɛ tɛ heya.
Pɔɔl ne Apolos ne Pita, nyundua ne harɛ, mkpa ne seo, kwaa aa lole fini ne kerekere oo, heyaa dɔ a bwa.
Yeesu Kristo ɡee dɔ heya, asɛ Korowii ɡe dɔ Yeesu Kristo.
Yeesu Kristo toroma wa A wer kɛ hɛɛ yerɛ yaa Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔna.
Korowii baɡle yaa o wesɔɔhla dɛ kpɔ do ya nɔn ta ŋɔ yáa baɡle nɛra.
Waa aa chɛ nɛn baa kpɔ waa do o nɔn ta laanee kɛŋɔ o ɡel o waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
Dɛ he dɛ kpɛɛ mɛ kɛɛ he dɛ chɔɡ mɛ noo, n waane laa.
Nɛwɛnyini laa dɛ won bol n waa dɛ pa mɛ bole.
N ɡbabir aa won kpɛɛ n te dɛ́ chɔɡ n te.
N ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa nae n waa bini te, kɛ a ta baɡlɛ kɛ mɛɛ di bolee.
N Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristoo dɛɛ ba n waa bola dɛ́ pa bole.
Anomanta, he bɛ nomɛlbwa kpɛɛ kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡo ka tel kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo aa ba.
Dɛ o balaa, wobɛlbwa aa sɔah la ɛɛ le bochaahnee, wedɛɛɡa oo, wechɔɡa oo, a bwa ɛɛ leo, ásɛ wobɛlbwa aa sɔah dɛ do nɛwɛnyini bambile bini la chɔ baŋ, ásɛ Korowii kpɛɛ nomɛlbwa ɡɛ aa chɛo.
Yabala, n kpɔ toma n ne Apolos aa ɛa la dɛ che a ta dɛ baɡle waa nɔ, ásɛ he no a mun dɛ́ jemɛ waa aa wera kɛŋɔ he ɛ. Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, He bɛ ɛ ɡarɛ ɡɛ baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini la.
He bɛ bane kpɔ ɡwaa bane dɛ́ɛ maŋkura he te.
Umee ŋɔ he be ŋɔ he ɡwaa bane ɔ?
Wobɛlbwa haa jema la, Korowiirii tɛɛ.
Bɛ nyoa dɛɛ ta a do kɛŋɔ Korowii laa kpɔ waa haa jema la kɛɛ.
He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he dɔ komɛlbwa a maɡre he ne, he ɛ dɔɔhna.
He berɔ ɡarɛ yaa dɛɛ di kora.
Dɛ he fe dɛ di kora kpela te naa, a fe bɔ.
Ya ne he bwa fe ɛ koranar.
N te be, Korowii ɡelɔ ya banɔ nɔ yaa ɛ Yeesu toroma nɔ ka mun, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa laɡ ba dɛɛ la ka kpoo ba, asɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ nyiŋ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nyundua toroma ne nɛra bwa dɛ nyiŋi yaa.
Yeesu Kristo nomanta, ya ɛ ɡɛna nɛra be, kɛ he dɛ yerɛ he te wejerema o waa ta.
Ya ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra nɛra be, kɛ he ɛ he te o kpeɡnɛra.
Ba dɛ duu heya, dɛ lawɛ ya te sie dɛɛ teɡɛ harɛ.
Lɔr ne nyɔɡre dɛ kpo yaa, yakwanee yaa tɔ, nɛra ɛɛ lɔɔ yaa, ya ta sobɔr dɔe dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini.
Ya bokpeɡa taa yaa di.
Nɛra hah yaa dɛɛ chɛɡre yaa, kɛ ya te soŋe andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Ba dɛ ɛ yaa hɔhɔrɔwa, kɛ ya te sɔɔh bwara dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Nɛra dɛ chɔɡ ya sɔn, kɛ ya te dɛ kwaa ba sɔn.
Ya do kɛŋɔ puldoa haahra nɛra be, hale ba le fini.
N ta ɡɛ waa nɔ chwerɛ ba tɛ heyaa dɛ́ ɡel sihiih kpo heya, kɛ jae mɛɛ ja heya, haa ɛ n bidɛɛɡa maa dɛ nyin heyaa la nomanta.
Dɛ he dɔ nɛra ba warɛ pirim, dɛ won cha heyaa Yeesu Kristo ŋwɛnɛ ta naa, n ɡboo ta he mɛɛ.
Menee tɔ sie bol Amanesoma la he be.
A taa n che ɛ he mɛɛ Yeesu Kristo waa ta.
Anomanta, n dɛ soŋe heya, hé kpɔ n da.
A waa ɡela n tomɛ Timoti he be la.
O ɛ n bie maa dɛ nyinu, wɛɛ no n deŋna waa Yeesu Kristo toma nɔ ta.
Wɛɛ lii heyaa ɡɛ maa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo waa la ta.
Gɛ maa dɛ baɡle asɔrere ta bobɛlbwa laanee wɛɛ ba heyaa liira.
He bane dɛ baɡle he te dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ maa ba dɛ ba na heyaa kpa.
Dɛ Korowii sɛoh waa, aa biɡri mɛɛ ba he bee, dɛ ɡbaɡba ba na kpeɡri nɛra baa dɛ baɡle ba te la aa dɔa.
Ba wobol ɡbo ta laa n ŋɔ.
Korowii Kora bini doe ta nyoa wobol pɛɛpɛɛ ɛɛ.
O kpeɡri dɔe waa.
Ɛrɛ balaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ n ba he be nɔ?
Hɛɛ charɛ he daa, ásɛ n nyin he waa dɛ́ ba bambisɔn ne kɛɛ, ń kpɔ chweema ba, dɛ́ ba tɛr he deŋne ɔ?
Jwamane bɔe asɔre ta wa N dɛ no kɛ he bini bane dɛ bɔ jwamane aa wola were, hale nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ kwara aa wola ɡɛɛ ɛ. Ba ŋɔ he bini bɛl lawɛ o mɛɛ haah kwaraa dɛɛ chɔ.
A fe chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɡel he tea bini chɔɡ waa nɔ wa, asɛ hɛɛ maŋkura he te la.
Aa were kɛŋɔ ɡɛ nɛn la ta ja he bini kpa!
N ɡbabir toole he be bela, kɛ n liire te lɔ he be.
N dɔɔ pa naate waa ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bolchɔɡe kɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba aa lɔ bela ken.
Dɛ he baa cheme ya Dɔɔ Yeesu sɔn ta, o kpeɡri do he nɛ, n ɡe liire do he bini naa, hé kpɔ naate bwadabii do Bɔnsam nɔn ta ó chɔɡo, ásɛ awola tɔpere ya Dɔɔ aa ba la, ó ɡe ba lɛ o doma te.
Aa were kɛŋɔ hɛɛ maŋkura he te.
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ iisi tama wono ɡel men damanta ɛɛ uɡe aa?
Anomanta, hé laa ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ la kpɔ he bini, ásɛ o wechɔɡa aa do kɛŋɔ iisi la bɛ heyaa bu, ásɛ he do wer kɛŋɔ paanoo baa wola iisi a ta doe, dɛ di Galekaa Tɔpejen la.
He do ɡɛ kpela.
Yeesu Kristo koh ya waa dɛ sewɛ kɛŋɔ baa kpo peebie Galekaa tɔpere ta la.
Anomanta, hé ɡel ya kpɔ ya te kɛŋɔ yaa dɛ ba Galekaa kondikwaa dii ken, anee kɛŋɔ yá laa meesɔɔh ne wechɔɡa bɛlbwa soo siwi kpɔ ya bini, ɡɛ baa laa iisi kpɔ paanoo baa kpɔa dɛɛ di Galekaa ta la.
Hé ɡel ya kpɔ kasinteŋ ne tepoŋ dɛ́ teŋɛ Korowii nɛ.
N tɔn n fa aa chwerɛ heyaa la, n baɡlɔ kɛ he ne nɛra jwamane aa lɔ ba sie ta la bɛ pɛ.
Banɔ la baa wola Korowii tomɛ dɛɛ bɔ jwamane, ba sie ɛɛ beɡre kwa, baa tomɛ voɡa la, ba te laa n ŋɔ hé laa he te kpɔ ba nɛɛ nɔ, dɛkalkɛ ba te lɔ bobɛlbwa.
Haa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɔ, haa won laa he te kpɔ ba nɛ!
Nɛra maa dɛ bol ba waa laanee nɛra baa ŋɔa ba ja yabala asɔre tena nɛ, kɛ dɛɛ bɔ jwamane, dɛ kpɔ suuɡa ɡwaa komɛlbwa, dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa, dɛɛ bol nɛra bwara wechɔɡa, dɛ nyɔ sen dɛɛ dɛɛ, dɛɛ ŋwɛ la.
Ba ŋɔ ba ɛ asɔre tena dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa aa do ken nɔ la, he ne ɡɛ nɛra nɔ te bɛlbwa bɛ pɛ, a ba ɛ kɛ hɛɛ pɛ nɔnee di kwa.
Nɛra baa wola asɔre tena ɛɛ la te, n ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ n bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Korowiirii dɛ́ bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Nɛra baa ɛ asɔre tena la te, heyaa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ “Hé doŋi wechɔɡ-ɛɛ le he bini.”
Asɔre tena ɡbo ɛɛ bol ba ne ba bala baah wa Umee ŋɔ he be ŋɔ dɛ he bini bɛl ne o dɔŋ asɔre te dɔ waane aa, ó ɡel Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, dɛ́ kpɔɔ la nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ be bá ka bola ɔ?
Korowii nɛra laa dɛ bola aa?
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ kerekere Korowii nɛraa dɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole kɛɛ?
Dɛ heyaa dɛ́ ba bol ba waa te naa, ɛrɛɛ haa wola won bol wejeɡre aa do ken nɔɔ?
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ yan dɛ́ ba bol nyundua toroma waa dɛ́ pa bole kɛɛ?
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra waa yaa wola won bol aa?
Dɛ he ne he dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, ɛrɛɛ he kpɔ dɛɛ do nɛra asɔre tena aa wola ban kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa la nɔn ta ŋɔ bá bola ɔ?
A dɔ sihiih tɛ heya.
Amɔ wejereme beŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole he bini dɛ́ won bol he baah wa, asɛ hɛɛ samane dɔŋa dɛ ɡel nɛra baa wola asɔre tena ɛɛ kaa bol he waa nɔ naa?
A ta ɡɛ chɛɛ.
Haa dɛ samane dɔŋa nɔ ɡba kwara baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ he dɔɔ di bolchɔɡe.
Dɛ he ne he dɔŋ dɔ waane aa, lawɛ bambile.
Dɛ o ŋwɛɛ kwaraa naa, kpɔ kɛo.
A wer ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa samano.
Kɛ haa ɡɛ ɛ. Heyaa dɛɛ ɛ dɔŋa wechɔɡa, dɛɛ faah dɔŋa, hale he bala asɔre tena.
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa Korowii Kora la taa ja kɛɛ?
He bɛ he nyu neɡre.
Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɛnwa, ne voɡtoroma, ne nɛra baa dɛ bɔ jwamane, ne baala ba ne ba bandɔŋa aa dɛ chɔ haah ne baa, ne ŋwɛɛra, ne nɛra ba sie aa dɛ beɡre ba dɔŋa kwa, ne sennyɔdɛɛra, ne nɛra baa dɛ bol dɔŋa wobochɔɡa, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ faah nɛra, nɛn waa dɛ ɛ a ɡɛ waa nɔ te bɛlbwa la, waa Korowii Kora la taa ja.
He bini bane fa kpoŋe ɡɛ da nɔ.
Kɛ taraken Korowii koh ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ne Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la toma la waa dɛ sɔ he wechɔɡa bwa ta, dɛ ɡel he ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa he waa su o siwi.
Jwamane bɔe wa Nomɛl te kompɛɛ, “N dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ n ɛ wobɛlbwa.” Kpelaa, kɛ a bwa laa wera tɛ yaa.
N fe jemɔ kɛ maa komɛlbwa ki, kɛ maa ɡel komɛlbwa ɡwaa n nɛ.
Bɛl ɡee ŋɔɔ, “Tea waa kondikwaa do le, asɛ kondikwaa ɡe che dɛ tɛ tea.” Kpelaa, kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ a bwa dɔ jaɡa dɛ chɔɡ.
O ta nɛn bwadabii ɛɛ tɛo ŋɔ ó kpɔ ɛ jwamanwa, kɛ o ɛo tɛo kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ tomɔ.
Anomanta, nɛn bwadabii ɛ Korowii kon, wɛɛ tɛo komɛlbwa.
Gɛ Korowii aa kpɔ o kpeɡri ir ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo seo ta la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba o kpeɡri la kpɔe dɛ́ ir ya ɡe seo ta.
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he bwadabii ɛ Yeesu Kristo bwadabii pera kɛɛ?
Dɛ ɡɛɛ a do te naa, amɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ ń kpɔ n bwadabii waa ɛ Yeesu bwadabii pera la ka bɔ jwamane aa?
Akai!
He bɛ ɡel a ba ɡɛ.
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa bɔ jwamane la, o ne haah la pɛo dɛ ɛ bwadabii beŋkpoŋ aa?
Korowii Tɔnee baɡla ŋɔ, “Nɛra banɛ la ɛ beŋkpoŋ.” Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te pɛl ya Dɔɔ la ɡe, o ne o bwa dɔ Doma beŋkpoŋ.
Anomanta, hé laa he te dɛɛ kpɔ jwamane ta.
Wechɔɡa bɛlbwa nɛn aa dɛ ɛ la, aa o bwara bini so.
Kɛ nɛn waa dɛ bɔ jwamane la, o ɡbaɡba bwadabii wɛɛ do wechɔɡa ta.
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he bwadabii ɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la sobɔr kɛɛ?
Korowii kpɔɔ tɛ heya, o so he nɛ.
Anomanta, he laa dɔ he te.
Korowiirii dɔ heya, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o kpɔ Yeesu Kristo chal yawɛ heya.
Anomanta, hé nyiŋi he bwadabii ta kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ tomɛ Korowii dɛ́ tɛo sɔn.
Hahmor ne yal wepɛɛre He fa chwerɛ tɔn dɛ ba bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, dɛ baa ŋɔ waa haahnee mo aa, a wer aa?
Baa ŋɔ waa haahnee mo aa, a wer.
Kɛ jwamane aa wara la nomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ baa bɛlbwa dɔ o haah, ásɛ haah bɛlbwa ɡe dɔ o jaa.
Baa bɛlbwa bɛ ŋɔ o ne o haah naa chɔ, ɡɛɛ haah ɡe bɛ ŋɔ waa sɛh o ne o jaa chɔ.
Haah ta o bwadabii kpeɡri dɔe chɔe bɔr, o jaaree dɔ kpeɡri.
Gɛɛ baa ɡe aa wola o bwadabii kpeɡri dɔe, o haahnee dɔ kpeɡri.
Anomanta, bɛlbwa bɛ o te kpɔ sɔh o dɔŋ chɔe be pera, atane kɛŋɔ he bwa sɛoh kɛŋɔ he dɛ nyin kɛ hé kpɔ bambibeŋkpoŋ soŋe Korowii tɔpere bɛl tama mɔɔ.
Gɛ te wer.
Kɛ dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ tonaa, hé berɛ pɛ ja.
Dɛ he ta pɛɛ yaa, haa wola won lawɛ he te la, Bɔnsam ɛɛ ɡeloo hé ɛ wechɔɡa.
Waa nɔ maa baɡla nɔ ta denɛ dɛɛ do heyaa ŋɔ a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé mo haahna.
Kɛ n dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, dɛ he mo haah naa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
N te fe dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa fee bɛ haah mo, dɛ́ so ɡɛ maa soɡa nɔ.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa laa Korowii ta ŋɔ ó ɡbo so dɛ bɛ haah mo.
O dɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa o we-ɛɛla waa dɛ ɛ la kpeɡri, bɛl yon do kpeɡri anɔ ta, bɛl ɡe do kpeɡri anɔ ta.
Waa maa dɔa dɛ tɛ nɛra baa wola haahna dɔe, ne haahna baa wola jaranar dɔe, ne nɛra ba jaranar aa serewa laanee kɛ, bá fee so ɡɛ n ɡbo aa soɡa nɔ.
Dɛ bɛlbwa nao kɛŋɔ waa won haŋre dɛ́ ɡbo so te naa, amɔ ó mo haah kɛɛ ó yalɛ.
A bɔ kɛŋɔ haah kɛɛ baa pɛla aa dɔe aa we he nɛɛ kohona.
Anɔ la maa bera dɔ dɛɛ tɛ hahmoola ne jadɔɔhnaa nɔ.
N ɡbaɡba laa dɛɛ bol.
Ya Dɔɔree ŋɔa ŋɔ haah bɛ o jaa vɛh.
Kɛ dɛ o vɛh o jaa aa, o bɛ baa bɛlbwa yalɛ kpa, atane kɛŋɔ o berɛ la o jaa la be, ásɛ ba ka pɛ dɛ́ so ja.
Baa ɡe bɛ o haah vɛh.
N ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ bol anɔ te dɛɛ tɛ he kar la.
Ya Dɔɔ laa bola.
Dɛ he ɛ asɔre te dɛ mo haah waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ, a too o tea o ŋɔ wɛɛ soo waa, bɛ on vɛh.
Dɛ haah ɡe ɛ asɔre te dɛ yalɛ baa waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ, dɛ o tea toorɔ kɛŋɔ o ne wɛɛ soo waa, haah la bɛ on vɛh.
Baa waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ la, o mo haah waa ɛ asɔre te aa, pɛɛ o ne haah la aa pɛa la nomanta, Korowii kpɔ baa la dɛɛ ɛ o nɛn.
Gɛɛ a do, haah ɡe ta asɔre te ɛɛ dɛ yalɛ baa waa ɛ asɔre te aa, pɛɛ o ne waa pɛa la nomanta, Korowii kpɔ haah la ɡe dɛɛ ɛ o nɛn.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, ba bii fe ta Korowii bii ɛɛ, kɛ taraken ba ɛ o kwa.
Dɛ onɔ la waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ vɛh o dɔŋ waa ɛ asɔre tee yaa, tɛo ŋwɛnɛ wɛɛ la.
A ba ɡɛ naa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Korowii dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ya so deŋnesɔɔhna ta.
Dɛ Korowii ɛɛ che haah haa ɛ asɔre te nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛ he jaa aa, he jemaa?
Gɛɛ a do baa haa ɛ asɔre te la, dɛ Korowii ɛɛ che he nɛɛ dɛ́ lɛ he haah naa, he jemaa?
Korowiirii tɛ bɛlbwa o we-ɛɛla wɛɛ ɛ. Anomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa leo dɛ tɛo ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ ɛ la.
Gɛɛ mɛɛ bol asɔre tena baa lɔ bobɛlbwa la be.
Dɛ ba kpɔ kere chɔɡɛ nomɛl mɔɔ Korowii leo o ba ɛ asɔre te aa, o bɛ kpɔ sɔh.
Korowii le nomɛl ɡe, dɛ ba ta kere kpɔe chɔɡɔ waa, o bɛ ɡel ba kpɔ kere chɔɡɔ.
Ba kpɔ kere chɔɡɛ noo, a ta waane ɛɛ, ba ta kere kpɔe chɔɡɛ noo, a ta waane ɛɛ.
Kɛ Korowii Waa la ta teŋaa ɛ kasinteŋ.
Anomanta, do ɡɛ haa doa mɔɔ Korowii lee he ba ɛ asɔre te la.
Dɛ he ɛ yom dɛ ba ɛ asɔre te aa, bɛ ɡel a we he nɛ.
Kɛ dɛ ba tɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ hé le he yom ɛɛ la ta naa, bɛ vɛh.
Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ yom dɛ ɛ asɔre te la, o dɔ o te Korowii be.
Gɛɛ a do, nomɛlbwa waa dɔ o te dɛ ba ɛ asɔre te la, o ɛ Yeesu Kristo yom.
Korowiirii kpɔ Yeesu Kristo chal la yawɛ heya, anomanta, he bɛ lii kɛŋɔ nɛraa dɔ heya.
Yabala, ɡɛ he fa aa doa mɔɔ Korowii le heyaa he ba ɛ asɔre tena la, hé ta do ɡɛ, ásɛ he ne Korowii do le.
Korowii ta men nɛra baa wola yalɛ la waa baɡlɛ, kɛ o dɛ cha mɛ asɛ mɛɛ ɛ o toma kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, mɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ maa jemaa.
Waa lole dɛ dawɛ ya nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, n te be te, a wer kɛ ɡɛ haa soɡa la, hé ta so ɡɛ.
Dɛ he dɔ haah naa, bɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ vɛoh.
Dɛ he ta bɛl dɔe ɡe aa, bɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ nyin bɛlee.
He mo haah naa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Dɛ haah ɡe yalaa, a ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Kɛ waa lɔ a ta he soɡa bini, a waa mɛɛ nyin n lɛ heyaa le a ta la.
Maa ŋɔ ɡɛ nɔ, yabala, yaa harɛ nɔ taa biɡri bɛlbwa.
Anomanta, le fini dɛɛ kaa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ he banɔ la haa dɔ haahna la ɛ kɛŋɔ he ta haahna dɔe ken, he banɔ la haa dɛ wi ɛ kɛŋɔ he waa aa sume ken, he banɔ la ɡe haa dɛ mamɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ he sie ta lɛɛ ken, he banɔ la ɡe aa dɛ yawɛ la ɛ kɛŋɔ kwaa haa yawa la ta he kwaa ɛɛ ken.
Asɛ he banɔ la ɡe haa dɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta la bɛ ɛ a ɡwaa kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ne o waa dɔ jaɡa.
Waa biɡri bɛlbwa.
N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ harɛ nɔ ta waa bɛ heyaa ha kohona.
Baa waa wola haah dɔe la, o siwi dɛ swɛɛ Korowii toma ta, wɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ Korowii sie lɛ o nɛ.
Kɛ baa waa dɔ haah la te sie dɛ beɡre harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta, ásɛ o haah sie ɛɛ lɛ o nɛ.
Webele anɛɛ yon do o baŋa.
Haah waa wola yalɛ, kɛɛ tolo waa wola baa jemɛ mɔɔ la, o sie dɛ beɡre Korowii toma ta, o kpɔ o te ne o liire bwa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii toma.
Asɛ haah waa yala la ɡe sie ɛɛ beɡre harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta, ásɛ o jaa sie lɛ o nɛ.
N dɛ nyin kɛ n cha heya, a waa ɡela mɛɛ bol waa ɡɛ la.
Maa nyin kɛŋɔ he ŋwɛnɛ tɔ.
N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he ɛ anɔ la aa wera, ásɛ he liire bwa won do Korowii toma ta.
Dɛ baa bɛlbwa dɔ o bihaah waa kpeɡa ne yala, o ŋɔ waa ɡel o yalɛ, dɛ berɛ na kɛŋɔ a wer kɛŋɔ bie la yalaa, ó ɛ ɡɛ bwa waa dɛ nyin.
Ó ɡel o yalɛ.
A ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Dɛ baa bɛlbwa nyiŋi ɡɛ waa nɔ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ŋɔ waa o bihaahnee kpɔ tɛ baa bɛlbwa ó mo aa, dɛ nomɛl laa hɛo, dɛ o ɡbaɡba bambile binii a le, asɛ o ta on kpɔe tɛ baa laa, o ɛ wa.
Anomanta, dɛ nomɛl lawɛ o bihaah tɛ baa o mo aa, o ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Kɛ naate waa wola o bihaah lawɛ tɛ baa ó mo la ɛa kɛrɛdɛ ɡwaa o dɔŋ waa lawɛ o bihaah tɛ yal la.
Dɛ haah yalɔ, o jaa ta do le naa, baa laanee dɔ haah la kpeɡri.
Kɛ dɛ baa la sewaa, o ta haah la kpeɡri dɔe kpa.
Haah la won kaala, dɛ́ ka yalɛ baa waa dɛ nyinu ja.
Kɛ o bɛ baa waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ yalɛ.

A waa jema te, ya bwa jemɛ a wa.
Kɛ nɛwɛnyini wejema ɡelɔ wɛɛ nyin sɔn.
Asɛ nɛnnyin ɡe ɛ chae.

Naate waa dɛ nyin Korowii la te, Korowii ɡba jemɔ.
