Nomɛlbwa laa jemɛ ɡɛ.
Bane duu ɡɛ voɡa nɔ biɡri a man ba.
Hale ba le fini, dɛ ba di kwaa baa kpoora tɛ voɡa nɔ naa, dɛ ba liire dɛ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ voɡa laanee dɔ kwaa la.
Ba yarada aa wola kanɛ Yeesu waa la ta nomanta, dɛ ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa.
Ya kondikwaa yaa dɛ dia laa dɛ́ ɡel ya ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa Korowii be.
Dɛ ya dɛ dia oo, ya dɛ kia oo, aa wobɛlbwa baɡle.
Kɛ ane abwa, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ dɛ he ta an kie, he dɛ dia aa, he bɛ ɡel he we-ɛɛla neɡre nɛra ba yarada aa wola kanɛ Yeesu waa ta ba kia la.
Nɛn o yarada aa wola kanɛ Yeesu waa ta la, o na he nɛn haa jemɛ Yeesu waa la kɛrɛdɛ soɡe voɡ mun dɛɛ di kwa aa, aa ɡeloo o ɡe di.
He ɡelɔ he dɔŋ waa wola kiŋkiŋ cheɡɛ, Yeesu Kristo aa koh o waa sewɛ, ɛɛ ba he wejema ne daŋra dɛ́ nyoɡre aa?
Dɛ he dɛ ɛ he bala ba yarada aa wola kanɛ Yeesu waa ta la wechɔɡa ken asɛ ba tea bini chɔɡ aa, Yeesu Kristoo hɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la.
Dɛ n nao kɛ kondikwaa maa dɛ di la ɛɛ ɡeloo n dɔŋ ɡe di a kaa o ne wechɔɡa ta naa, amɔ te mɛɛ ɡel a dii, ásɛ n dɔŋ ɡe bɛ di dɛ́ ba kaa wechɔɡa ta.
Waa aa chɛ Yeesu torome kɛ wɛɛ ɛ N ta n te dɔe dɛɛ di n nyu aa?
N ta Yeesu torome ɛɛ yaa?
N ta ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nae yaa?
He teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ nɔ le toma maa ɛa he bini ya Dɔɔ kpeɡri ta la.
Dɛ bane ta sɛɛh kɛŋɔ Yeesu toromee men aa, he te jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ n ɛ o torome, dɛkalkɛŋɔ pɛɛ he ne waa pɛa la dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ n ɛ o torome kpela.
Dɛ nɛra dɛ pwaah mɛ naa, kenii mɛɛ ŋɔ.
Nɛra dɛ cha yaa kondikwaa ta naa, dɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta laa aa?
Yeesu Kristo nimanar ne Pita ne Yeesu toroma la bwa mo haahna ba ne baa valɛ.
Ya te ta ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ya mo haahna baa ɛ asɔre tena ya ne baa valaa?
Kɛɛ n ne Banabas ɡboo chɛ kɛ ya koh mɔɔ dɛɛ di?
Dɛ he ɛ sooja dɛɛ kaa laa laa, toma la ta laa hɛɛ di aa?
He parɛ koo aa, haa koo la kondikwaa di aa?
Nateɡre besoo wola o nae elnee nyɔɔ?
Nɛwɛnyini waa ɡbo laa dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ.
Mosis Mmara ɡba baɡle ɡɛ.
Mosis chwerɔ ŋɔ, “He bɛ nabal waa dɛ ɛ toma he koo ta la nyoa vɔwɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ o bɛ kwaa di.” Korowii ŋɔ ken aa, kondɛɛra ɡboo o ŋɔ aa?
Nɛwɛnyini waa o koh ŋɔ ɡɛ, ɡɛ aa cha yaa la waa o chwera, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ parɛ, ne nomɛlbwa waa dɛ komɛ kwaa la dɔ hwɛɡa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ kwaa la anee.
Dɛ ya bol Korowii Waa he be asɛ he dɔ Korowii mkpa aa, dɛ a ta maɡrɛ kɛ ya lɛ kondikwaa le he be, dɛ́ won dɔ harɛ nɔ ta bokpeɡa aa?
He dɛ tɛ bane ɡɛ.
Dɛ ɡɛ nɛra la dɔ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ aa, amɔ dɛ ya te ta pɔeh yaa?
Kɛ ya te aa ɡɛ kpeɡri la baɡle he nɛ, dɛ dɔ bambile wobɛlbwa ta dɛ bɛ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la ŋwɛnɛ tɔ.
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la, a taa ba dɔ kwaa dɛɛ di, asɛ banɔ la ɡe baa dɛ kpoo kwaa baa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii o Dea bini la, a taa ba ɡee di kɛɛ?
Gɛ tentenee ya Dɔɔ ɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ bol Amanesoma la dɛ ŋɔ báa di a ta.
N dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ n ɛ a bwa, kɛ n ta nomɛlbwa be ŋɔe ŋɔ ó tɛ mɛ komɛlbwa bwa.
Maa chwerɛ dɛɛ nyin kɛ he tɛ mɛ a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ.
N sewɔ bɔ n be kɛŋɔ waa maa koh a waa maŋkura n te la le n nɔn ta.
Maa won koh Amanesoma nɔ bola waa dɛɛ baɡle n te, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɛɛ do mɛ asɛ mɛɛ bol.
Dɛ n ta bolaa, mɛɛ dɔ waa.
Dɛ n tetoora nee mɛɛ ɛa aa, a fe maɡrɔ kɛ n fe ɛɛ lɛ a kembɔr.
Kɛ Korowiirii kpɔ o Amanesoma la do n nɔn ta ŋɔ ń bol nɛra be.
Anomanta, n ɡbaɡba tetoora laa mɛɛ ɛa.
Kembɔr besoo mɛɛ dɔɔ?
N kembɔree kɛŋɔ ń won bol Amanesoma la baɡle nɛra pɛɛpɛɛ dɛ bɛ kpeɡri maa dɔa la baɡle ba nɛ.
N fe dɛ di n nyu, nomɛlbwa laa dɔɔ mɛ, kɛ n ɛ n te yom dɛɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa, dɛ́ fee dɔ nɛra kɛrɛdɛ tɛ Korowii.
Maa dɛ ɛ toma Juu tena bini la, n ɛ n te kɛŋɔ Juu te ásɛ dɛ dɔɔ ba tɛ Korowii.
N ta Mosis Mmara la ta jae te, kɛ dɛ n koo nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ a ta la nɛ aa, n dɛ ɛ n te kɛ ba bini bɛl, ásɛ dɛ yon dɛɛ teŋɛ ba mmarare la ta ɡɛ ba yon dɛɛ ɛ la, ásɛ dɛ dɔɔ ba tɛ Korowii.
Gɛ tentenee dɛ n koo nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola Mosis Mmara la ta teŋɛ nɛ aa, n yon ɛ n te kɛ ban, ásɛ dɛ dɔɔ ba tɛ Korowii.
Kɛ aa baɡle kɛ n dɛ vɛh Korowii nyoa wobol.
N dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa ŋɔa yá teŋɛ la ta.
Dɛ n kaa koo nɛra bini, dɛ ba yarada aa kanɛ Yeesu Kristo waa ta naa, n ɡe dɛ ɛ n te kɛŋɔ ba bini bɛl, ásɛ dɛ won dɔɔ ba.
Gɛ nomɛlbwa aa doa la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ ɛ n te, ásɛ dɛ che ŋwɛnɛ bɛl ta, dɛ́ won dɔ bane, ásɛ Korowii lɛɛ ba.
Amanesoma nɔ waa mɛɛ teŋɛ anɔ bwa ta la, ásɛ dɛ won na som maa dɛ bol a waa la ane.
Dɛ nɛra dɛ ba chwae dɛ lɛ komɛl aa, ba bwa dɛ chwa te, kɛ ba bini beŋkpoŋii dɛɛ dɔ kon la.
Anomanta, hé chwa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ dɔ kon la.
Nomɛlbwa waa jemɛ chwae, dɛɛ tɛɡre o te dɛ́ chwa lɛ komɛl la, o dɛ dɔ haŋra kwaa bwa ta dɛ́ ka chwa dɛ́ tɔ sie ásɛ ba kpɔ ɡbɛrɛ piu.
Kpɔɡa nee ba sɔh ɡɛ ɡbɛrɛ la, waa biɡri dɛ o chɔɡɔ.
Kɛ ya te chwae yaa dɛ chwa la, ya dɛ nyin ɡbɛrɛ waa wola chɔɡ bwa.
Anomanta, n dɛ chwa n sie dawɛ komɛl ta.
Maa chwa pɛɛ.
N do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ yo, maa nɔɔra ta pɛɛpɛɛ.
N dɛ lawɛ n te, dɛɛ haŋre kɛrɛdɛ kɛ, n ɡbaɡba maa dɛ bol Amanesoma nɔ dɛɛ baɡle nɛra nɔ, n bɛ ba koni dɛ́ horɛ.
Voɡa toma jae wa Yabala, n dɛ nyin kɛ ń lii heya, ya naawa bwa nɛɛ Korowii bam la faa tɔ.
Moo la aa teŋa la, ba bwaa kpɔ o baah kaa.
A kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ ba fa aa sɔ ba bwa Korowii nee bam la ne mpo la ta, asɛ ba ne Mosis pɛ.
Ba bwa dɔ kondikwaa le Korowii kpeɡri ta dɛ di.
A berɔ che Korowii kpeɡri ta ba dɔ nee dɛ nyɔ.
Bwe taa ba dɔ nee la le.
Kristoo bwe la, dɛ faa teŋɛ ba nɛɛ ba kaa.
Kɛ Korowii sie ta ba ɡalɡa nɛɛ lɛɛ, asɛ ba serewe perɛ kpɔɡ la baah bobɛla.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛo dɛ ɡel ya jemɛ wa, ásɛ wechɔɡa pɛla bɛ yaa dɔ ɡɛ a pɛla fa aa dɔɔ ba la.
Ya bɛ voɡa dɛɛ tomɛ ɡɛ ba bini bane fa aa dɛ ɛ la.
Mosis chwerɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra la soɡo dɛ kwaa ba voɡa, dɛ di kwa, dɛ nyɔ sen, dɛ ir sa sachɔɡa.” Ya bɛ jwamane bɔ ɡɛ nɛra la bane fa aa ɛa asɛ Korowii kpoo ba bini kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ batoro tɔpebeŋkpoŋ la.
Ya bɛ Korowii daah dɛɛ na ɡɛ bane fa aa daahno na, asɛ o ɡel harɛ kpɔ ba ba serewe la.
Ya bɛ waa naɡre ɡɛ bane fa aa naɡre waa asɛ nyundua torome ba kpoo ba la.
Waa aa pu a ɡɛ nɛra la ɛo dɛ ɡel ba jemɛ wa.
Mosis chwerɛ a wa, dɛ ɡel ya nɛra yaa lɔ harɛ nɔ aa ka tɔpera tamaa o chɔɡ nɔ ta nɔ jemɛ wa.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ ta la, wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ naa ba lɔ.
Nomɛlbwa dɛ na wekpeɡa.
Anomanta, dɛ he dɛ na wekpeɡa aa, he laa bɔ bere.
Korowii waa dɔ yarada.
Waa ɡel wekpeɡa bɛlbwa ɡwaa he nɛɛ ásɛ he horɛ.
Wɛɛ baɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ haa kpɔ dɛ́ won lawɛ bambile ka tel kɛŋɔ haa le a nyoa.
Kondikwaa baa dia dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii Yeesu Anomanta, n daamanar, hé laa he te kpɔ voɡa waa ta.
He ɛ wejerema, anomanta, hé nyiŋi waa nɔ maa bola nɔ bini dɛ́ na.
Saŋ bɛlbwa yaa pɛ so dɛɛ di kwaa dɛɛ lii Yeesu Kristo seo la, sen la yaa dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii dɛɛ nyɔ la ɡelɔ ya ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ o chal la waa ta.
Paanoo yaa mɔna dɛɛ di la ɡelɔ ya ne o pɛ o bwadabii waa ta.
Ya warɔ, kɛ paanoo beŋkpoŋ la yaa pɛa di la nomanta, ya ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Hé ta sie dɛ́ na Juu tena wa.
Nɛra baa dɛ di kwaa baa kpoora dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la, ba ta ɡɛ we-ɛɛla la ta jae yaa?
N dɛ baɡle kɛ kwaa baa kpoora dɛɛ tɛ voɡa la, a ne voɡa ɡbaɡba ɛ kwaane kɛɛ?
Akai!
N dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛɛ kpoo kwaa la, ba kpoorɔ dɛɛ tɛ Bɔnsam toroma yaa wola an na la.
Korowii laa ba ɛ dɛɛ tɛ.
Maa nyin kɛŋɔ he ne Bɔnsam toroma pɛ komɛlbwa.
Haa won nyɔ sen la yaa dɛ nyɔ dɛɛ lii ya Dɔɔ waa la, dɛ́ berɛ ka nyɔ Bɔnsam toroma la kwa.
He ne ya Dɔɔ aa won pɛ nɔn di kwa, ásɛ he ne Bɔnsam toroma la ɡe berɛ pɛ nɔn di kwa.
Aa ɡɛɛ maɡre!
Hei!
He dɛ nyin he muɡli ya Dɔɔ baah o mee raa?
Ya kpeɡri ɡwaalo wa aa?
Nomɛl te kompɛɛ, “N dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ń ɛ wobɛlbwa,” kɛ a bwa laa wera tɛ mɛ, a bwa ɡe laa dɛɛ cha mɛ.
Aa were kɛŋɔ nɛn ɡel o ɡbo waa hiaoh.
A chɛ kɛ ó ɡel o dɔŋ ɡe kɛrɛdɛ doe waa hiaoh.
Dɛ ba dɛ yoɡ ola ol yoɡribɔr aa, yawɛ dɛ́ di.
Bɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ ane ken aa were.
Hé yawɛ di, dɛkalkɛŋɔ “Korowiirii dɔ harɛ ne komɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta.” Dɛ nɛn waa wola asɔre te ɛɛ yerɛ ŋɔ hé ba di kwaa he sɛh aa, kondikwaa bɛlbwa waa tɛɛ la, bɛ dɛɛ lii ŋɔ a ken aa were kɛŋɔ he di.
Lɛ dɛ di.
Kɛ dɛ nomɛl ŋɔ he be ŋɔ voɡee ba kwaa, a kondikwaa yaa, naate waa baɡle ɡɛ waa nɔ ŋɔ he bɛ di la nyu bini liire nomanta, bɛ di, ásɛ o bɛ ba lii kɛŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡa.
A ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ tɛɛ.
Naate la waa n ŋɔ he bɛ di la, ásɛ o liire bɛ on aahna-aahna ɛ. Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba nomɛl nyu bini liire waa koeh dɛ́ ɡel waa maa dɛ ɛɔ?
Dɛ n jam Korowii kondikwaa maa dɛ ba dii wa aa, nomɛlbwa bɛ men pwah kɛ maa di a ɡɛ kwaa la.
Anomanta, wobɛlbwaa hɛɛ ɛ oo, kwaa hɛɛ di oo, komɛlbwaa hɛɛ nyɔ oo, hé ɛ dɛ́ kpɔ jirima dɛɛ tɛ Korowii.
He bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa daŋre he ne dɛ́ ba nyoɡre.
Juu tee yoo, Grik tee yoo, asɔre tee yoo, he bɛ ba bini bɛlbwa ɡɛ ɛ. Gɛɛ mɛɛ ɛ, ásɛ n waa lɛ nomɛlbwa sie.
N ɡbo waa laa hiah mɛ.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa hiah mɛ, ɡɛ maa ɛ dɛ́ won dɔɔ ba tɛ Korowii ó lɛɛ ba.
Anomanta, hé kpɔ n da ɡɛ maa kpɔ Yeesu da la.
Haahna kwaa kpɔe dɛ́ bɔle nyu asɔre ɛɛ bɔra N dɛ kpɛɛ heyaa liira haa dɛ lii n waa bwa wobɛlbwa ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa baɡ mɛ asɛ n ɡe baɡle heyaa la ta.
N dɛ nyin kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristoo baa bɛlbwa nomoa, asɛ baa ɛ haah nomoa, Korowii ɡe ɛ Yeesu Kristo nomoa.
Baa bɛlbwa waa dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛɛ dɛ che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol Korowii Wa, kɛ dɛ kpɔ kon bɔle o nyu la, waa duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ Yeesu Kristo.
Dɛ haah ɡe dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛɛ dɛ che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol waa o ta kon kpɔe bɔle o nyu aa, waa duure kpɔe dɛɛ tɛ baa.
O do kɛŋɔ nɛn baa fonɛ o nyu ken.
Dɛ waa sɛh dɛ́ kpɔ kon bɔle o nyu ta naa, amɔ te bá fonɛ o nyu ta.
A ta maɡrɛ kɛ ba fonɛ o nyu ta ɡe aa, amɔ te ó kpɔ kon dɛɛ bɔle o nyu ta.
Aa were kɛŋɔ baa ɡe kpɔ kon bɔle o nyu, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o do ɡɛ Korowii aa doa, dɛɛ baɡle Korowii jirima.
Kɛ haah te dɛ baɡle baa jirima.
Haah bini laa baa le, haahnee le baa bini.
Haah waa laa Korowii ta baa, kɛ baa waa Korowii ta haah.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ ne nyundua toroma nyiŋa baa dɛ nyiŋi heyaa nomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ haah kpɔ kon dɛɛ bɔle o nyu á baɡle kɛŋɔ baa dɔ kpeɡri o nɛ.
Ya Korowii toma waa bini te, baa ne haah bwa sie dawɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Baa binii haah le mumpar la, kɛ taraken te haahnee dɛɛ lolɛ baa, asɛ Korowii ɡe ta komɛlbwa.
Hé bwa nyiŋi ɡɛ waa nɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
A wer kɛŋɔ haah ɛɛ soŋe Korowii dɛ o ta kon kpɔe bole o nyu ta naa?
Gɛ Korowii aa ta baa la, o nyu moɡɔ kohona naa, aa were.
A ɛ sihiih.
Kɛ dɛ haah nyu moɡɔ dɛ kpeɡ aa, a dɛ tɛo jirima wɛɛ do wer, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii tɛɛ ba nyumpona ŋɔ á tɔ ba nyuune ta.
Dɛ nomɛl dɛ tɔŋle ɡɛ waa nɔ naa, ó jemɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ ya ne asɔre tena bwa ɛɛ ɛ. Kondikwa baa dia dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii Yeesu Waane ɡe lole maa wola heyaa kpɛɛ dɛɛ ba he be bola.
He chemaa, he dɛ chɔɡ dɔŋa, haa dɔŋa cha.
Waa aa tɔ sie laanee kɛŋɔ, n noɔ kɛŋɔ dɛ he chemo dɛɛ soŋe Korowii aa, haa nyopɛo dɔ.
N dɛ lii kɛŋɔ kpelaa ba ŋɔ.
Aa ba ɡɛɛ.
Dɛ a ta ɡɛ balaa, nɛra aa won jemɛ banɔ la baa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa he bini.
Gɛ he yon cheme dɛɛ di kwaa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu sɔn ta dɛɛ lii o waa la, o waa laa hɛɛ lii ɡɛ la.
He bini bane dɛ di ɡɛ kondikwaare la warane, haa cheɡɛ dɛɛ kpa he bala.
Bane yon dɔ di dɛ́ nyɔ sen kohona dɛ́ berɛ dɛ́ɛ dɛɛ, dɛ bane ta komɛlbwa dɔe dɛ di.
Ɛrɛ waa yɔ?
He ta deremi dɔe dɛ́ so bela di kwaa kɛɛ?
He hah Korowii nɛra, dɛ ɡel sihiih ɛɛ kpo he bala baa nyaa.
Ɛrɛɛ ń ɛ heya ɔ?
Ń kpɛɛ heya aa?
Akai.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu baɡ mɛ waa nɔ n ɡe baɡle heyaa kɛŋɔ o fa ɛ waane jwaana baa leo tɛ la.
O kpɔ paanoo, asɛ dɛ soŋe Korowii do o ta, dɛ kuuɡu dɛ ŋɔ, “N bo-olii nɔ, maa kpɔa dɛ tɛ heya.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ lii mɛ.” Baa dia tonɛ la, o laa numol ne sen ane kpɔ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Sen nɔɔ cheɡa dɛ tɛ n chal.
Aa ɛ fɔofalee dɛ́ chɔ Korowii ne nɛwɛnyina baah ta.
Hɛ́ɛ nyɔ dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ lii mɛ.” Ya Dɔɔ wobol nɔ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, saŋ bɛlbwa háa di paanoo nɔ dɛ́ kpɔ numol nɔ nyɔ sen nɔ la, ya Dɔɔ seo waa hɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ la, ka tel saŋ waa berɛ ba ja.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa di ɡɛ paanoo nɔ, dɛ kpɔ numol nɔ nyɔ sen nɔ, waa wola an aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ la, dɛ Yeesu bo-ol ne o chalee o kpɔ doŋa dɛɛ leɡe la.
Nomɛlbwa chɛ kɛŋɔ ó nyiŋi o waa bini kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ di a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ di ɡɛ kwaa nɔ o ta liire kɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ bo-olii yaa, amɔ dɛ o dɛ muɡli Korowii baah dɛɛ do o te wahala ta.
A waa he ɡalɡa ɛɛ we weela dɛɛ ɡwɛɡre, asɛ bane ɡee serewe la.
Dɛ ya fe ɛɛ nyiŋi ya waa bini kɛrɛdɛ yaa, Korowii fe aa yaa bolchɔɡee pa, dɛ́ tɛr ya deŋne.
Ya Dɔɔ aa dɛ nyiŋi ya waa bini taraken nɔ, o dɛ tɛr ya deŋne ásɛ ya ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ, ásɛ ya bɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire wɛɛ ba ban bolchɔɡe pae la nɛɛ ja.
Anomanta, yabala, he pɛo dɛɛ di a ɡɛ kwaa nɔ naa, he bɛ a dii dɛɛ too.
Hé so dɛɛ kpa dɔŋa dɛ́ bwa cheme mɔɔ dɛɛ di.
Dɛ lɔr dɛ kpo bɛl aa, ó di kwaa dem mɔɔ dɛ ba.
He bɛ ya Dɔɔ kwaa la di ɡɛ aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ he dia.
Gɛ laa, Korowii baah ɛɛ di he nɛɛ.
Anɔ la aa kaa la, n balaa, mɛɛ baɡle heyaa.
Koŋkɛɛla Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa dɛ tɛ Yabala, n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ hé jemɛ kpeɡri Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa dɛ cha yaa ya dɔ la bini kɛrɛdɛ.
He na kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ he fa aa wola Korowii tomɛ la, dɛ he nyoɡrɔ dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa aa wola waa bol, kɛ dɛ a dɔ kpeɡri he nɛɛ hɛɛ toma.
Anomanta, n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ bol waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ne la, waa won taah Yeesu.
Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa dɛ bol ŋɔ Yeesuu ya Dɔɔ la, dɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡrii ɡela wɛɛ ŋɔ ɡɛ la.
Kpeɡri Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa cha nɛra ba dɔ la koɡrɔ, kɛ Doma beŋkpoŋ laanee tɛ a bwa.
Toma ya Dɔɔ aa bɔna tɛ yaa la koɡrɔ, kɛ Dɔɔ beŋkpoŋ tomaa yaa ɛ. Wejema Korowii aa bɔna tɛ yaa la koɡrɔ, kɛ Korowii beŋkpoŋii cheɡɛ ya bwa nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡee tɛ nomɛlbwa kpeɡri ŋɔ ó kpɔ dɛɛ cha o bala.
O tɛ nɛra bane wejema, dɛ tɛ bane ɡe sipila.
O Doma beŋkpoŋ laanee tɛ ba bwa a ɡɛ kpeɡri la, bá won bol waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra, dɛ ɡel bane che o kpeɡri la ta dɛ dɔ yarada kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ dɛ tɛ bane ɡe kpeɡri weela chaeh ta.
O tɛ bane kpeɡri ba won nyokpowaa ɛɛ, asɛ bane ɡe won che o kpeɡri la ta, dɛ́ won bol Korowii Wa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere.
O ɡelɔ bane won jemɛ kon la soo waa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ ba che o ta dɛɛ ɛ wa, dɛ ɡel bane ɡe won bol wobofala, asɛ dɛ ɡel bane ɡe won wobofala mun baɡla dɛɛ baɡle nɛra.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe beŋkpoŋ laanee tɛ nomɛlbwa kpeɡri o kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ la.
Gɛ aa too o teaa o tɛ nomɛlbwa.
Yeesu bwadabii aa ɛ kombir kɛ dɛ dɔ peɡra wa Hé ta sie nyiŋi he bwadabii na, o ɛ kombir, kɛ o dɔ peɡra, asɛ a bwa pɛ dɛ ɛ bwadabii beŋkpoŋ.
Gɛɛ Yeesu Kristo do.
Juu tena o, Grik tena o, yoma o, nɛra baa dɔ ba te noo, Korowii kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe la sɔ ya bwa ne, asɛ ya ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
O tentenee o ɡel ya bwa dɔ dɛ nyɔ do ya bini.
Nɛwɛnyini bwadabii ta konsiwi beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ.
O peɡra warɔ.
Dɛ he nakpala ŋɔ o ta nɔn ɛɛ nomanta, o ta bwara ta jae yaa, dɛ nyosonee.
O ta nɔn ɛɛ te, kɛ o ɡe ja bwadabii ta.
Dɛ deŋne ɡe ŋɔ o ta siwi ɛɛ nomanta, o ta bwadabii ta jae yaa, dɛ nyosonee.
O ta siwi ɛɛ, kɛ o ja bwadabii ta.
Dɛ bwadabii fe dɔ siwi ɡbo, deŋne ta jae yaa, ɛrɛɛ o fe ɛɛ ba waa noe yɔ?
Dɛ bwadabii fe ɛ deŋne ɡbo o ta mee dɔe yaa, ɛrɛɛ o fe ɛɛ ba sɔɔh noe yɔ?
Gɛ laa Korowii ta yaa.
O do bwadabii peɡra nɔ bwa, bɛlbwa ne o dobɔr.
Onee saahna ɛa ɡɛ.
Dɛ bwadabii fe ɛ konsiwi beŋkpoŋ ɡbo, peɡra bɛlbwa toole o ta naa, o fe ɛ bwadabii aa?
Akai.
Ya bwadabii peɡra la koɡrɔ, kɛ bwadabii la te ɛ kombeŋkpoŋ.
Siwi aa won ŋɔ nɔn be ŋɔ, “He ta n nɛɛ jae yaa, n ɡbo ɛɛ wonoo ɛ toma.” Gɛɛ nyu ɡe aa wola won ŋɔ nakpala be ŋɔ, “He ta n nɛɛ jae yaa, n ɡbo ɛɛ wonoo ɛ toma.” Bwadabii bobɛla yaa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ aa kpeɡe la dɔ tɔnɔ.
Bwadabii bobɛla yaa wola lii kɛŋɔ a wer laanee yaa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.
Anɔ la sihiih aa dɛ kpo yaa a waa yaa wola nyin kɛŋɔ nɛn na la, anee yaa tɔ a ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Anɔ la aa wera te, a ta hiaih kɛŋɔ ya nyiŋi a ta kpa.
Gɛɛ Korowii ɛ ya bwadabii ásɛ yaa heeh a ɡɛ bɔra yaa wola lii kɛŋɔ a waa hiaoh la.
Korowii ɛa ɡɛ ásɛ bwadabii la bini bɛ peɡri, ásɛ a bwa ɛɛ cha dɔŋa.
Dɛ bwadabii bobɛl dɔ weela aa, dɛ bwadabii bwaa weela lawɛ la.
Dɛ ba kpɛɛ bwadabii bobɛl aa, a dɛ do bwadabii la bwa som.
He bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ Yeesu Kristo bwadabii ta.
He bwa pɛo dɛ ɛ o bwadabi.
Korowii tɛ he bɛlbwa toma waa dɛɛ ɛ asɔre tena bini.
Anɔ la aa tɔ sie, o ŋɔ bane ɛ Yeesu toroma, dɛ ŋɔ báne che Korowii kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol waa waa kpɔa baɡ ba, tooro, dɛ kpɔ bane ŋɔ báa baɡle nɛra o wa, dɛ berɛ kpɔ bane ɡe ŋɔ báa ɛ nyokpowa, dɛ tɛ bane ɡe kpeɡri ŋɔ báa chah weela tena.
Dɛ ŋɔ báne ɛɛ cha nɛra, báne ɛ nomonome dɛɛ tɔ nɛra sie, dɛ ɡel bane ɡe won wobofala bola.
He bwaa ɛ Yeesu toroma aa?
He bwaa won Korowii kpeɡri la ta cheɡa dɛ́ bol wa aa?
He bwaa won Korowii waa la baɡla aa?
He bwaa won nyokpowaa ɛɛ yaa?
He bwaa won weela tena chaeh yaa?
He bwaa won wobofala bola aa?
He bwaa won wobofala mun baɡla aa?
Hé ɡel he sie beɡre, ásɛ hɛɛ nyin kpeɡri Korowii Domadɛɛɡe be, ásɛ dɛ won cha nɛra ŋwɛnɛre aa wera kohona la ta.
Mɛɛ baɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ waa wera ɡwaa a bwa.
Nɛnnyin wa Dɛ n wono dɛɛ bol nɛra bwa ne nyundua toroma wobol, kɛ dɛ maa nɛn nyin aa, dɛ ɡbɔɡaa mɛɛ do kɛŋɔ baa dɛ lɔ dawuro waa pera wɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa la.
Hale n wono che Korowii kpeɡri la ta, dɛɛ bol o waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ jemɛ o wesɔɔhla bwa, dɛ dɔ sipila kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ che o kpeɡri la ta, dɛ dɔ yarada dɛ won ŋɔ bwejen be ó chuɡri le o buɡ ta, dɛ kaa bofale asɛ o chuɡri, dɛ maa nɛn nyin aa, dɛ n ta nɛn ɛɛ.
Dɛ n wono kpɔ n komɛlbwa kɛ nyaara ba lɛ di, asɛ n berɛ koh Yeesu waa la waa dɛ sɛh ŋɔ mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpɔ nii fuuh mɛ, dɛ maa nɛn nyin aa, dɛ a ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Dɛ nɛn dɛ nyin nɛn aa, o dɔ bambile dɛɛ tɛ o bala, dɛɛ ɛɛ ba kɛrɛdɛ.
Waa bɔweela ɛ. Waa o te nɛnjen yerɛ.
Waa o te baɡle.
Waa waa saɡasaɡa ɛ o bala be.
Waa o ɡbo nyin, o dɛ nyin nomɛlbwa.
O baah aa nɛra nɛɛ di warawara.
Waa nɛn waa lɛɛ dɛɛ do o bini.
Kasinteŋii dɛɛ lɛ o sie.

Nɛnnyin ta jaɡa dɔe.
Korowii waa baa cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol bwa ɛɛ tonɔɔ tɔpebɛl wee.
Wobofala baa cheɡɛ Korowii kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol bwa ɛɛ teŋoo tɔpebɛl wee.
Wejema ɡee ba tonɔɔ.
Ya waa yaa jema la ta jema bɛl ɛɛ, waa yaa cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ta dɛɛ bol la ɡba ta bola bɛl ɛɛ.
Anɔ la aa wera ka tonɛ la saŋ telaa, tama yaa dɔa taraken nɔ bwa ɛɛ tonɔɔ.
Gɛ saŋ n fa aa ɛ bechala la, dɛ n dɛ bol bechawobol, dɛɛ ɛ bechawa, dɛɛ lii bechaliire.
Kɛ maa baa kpeɡ dɛ ɛ nomoa la, n ɡel n bechawaa la bwa.
Gɛ tentenee ya waa do taraken.
A do kɛŋɔ yaa dɛ nyiŋi diɡi waa wola na kɛrɛdɛ ta ken.
Dɛ tɔpere bɛl telaa, yaa naa kɛrɛdɛɛ kɛŋɔ a chɔ ya sie.
Anɔ la bwa yaa jema taraken nɔ, anjena ta lɔ mun ta.
Kɛ tɔpere la telaa, mɛɛ jemɛ wobɛlbwa ɡɛ Korowii aa jem mɛ la.
Anomanta, webele atoroo lole, yarada, hwɛɡa ne nɛnnyin.
Kɛ nɛnnyinii ɡwaa a bwa.
Koŋkɛɛla ane ɡe Korowii domadɛɛɡe aa dɛ tɛ Hé ɡel he sie beɡre nɛnnyin ta, ásɛ dɛɛ nyin kpeɡri waa lɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la be, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ cha nɛra.
Kɛ kpeɡri háa swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ nyin kohona laanee kɛŋɔ, he won che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛ́ɛ bol o wa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ naate waa dɛ bol wobofala la, nɛra laa o bol dɛɛ tɛ.
Korowiirii o bol dɛɛ tɛ.
O cheɡɛ Korowii kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol waa aa sɔah.
Nɛra aa a waa no.
Naate waa cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ta, dɛɛ bol waa la te bolɔ dɛɛ baɡle nɛra dɛɛ cha ba bá jemɛ Korowii Wa.
O dɛ do ba ɡbemba dɛɛ larawe ba bwara.
Nɛn waa dɛ bol wobofala la, o bolɔ dɛɛ tɛ o ɡbaɡba.
Naate waa cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol Korowii Waa la ɡe, asɔre tena la bwaa wɛɛ cha.
Dɛ he bwa won wobofala bola aa, n dɛ nyin ɡɛ.
Kɛ dɛ he won Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta cheɡa dɛ́ bol wa aa, ɡɛɛ dɛ́ do n som kohona.
Naate waa dɛ bol Korowii Waa la ɡwaa nɛn waa dɛ bol wobofala, atane kɛ nomɛl won a mun baɡla dɛɛ tɛ asɔre tena á cha ba.
Yabala, dɛ n ba he be dɛ baa bol wobofala dɛ haa a mun no aa, tɔnɔ besoo he dɔ le n be nɔ?
Dɛ n ta Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri la ta cheɡɛ, dɛ dɔ waa aa sɔah dɛ baɡle heya aa, kɛɛ dɛ n ta wejema ane dɔe, kɛɛ maa Korowii nyoa wobol kɛɛ o ŋwɛnɛre baɡla jemaa, tɔnɔ besoo hé dɔ le n be nɔ?
Hé ta sie na kwaa baa dɛ hɛlɛ a ne.
Dɛ a sii aa chɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, ɛrɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ no a bini nɔ?
Dɛ ba dɛ hoh laa bɛla ásɛ nɛra no dɛ́ ka yo, dɛ baa on hoh kɛrɛdɛ naa, umee dɛ́ won jemɛ dɛ́ kpɔ o te nɔ?
Gɛɛ a do, dɛ he wobol bini noe kpeɡri aa, ɛrɛɛ baa ba ɛɛ dɛ no a mun ɔ?
A do kɛŋɔ he ɡbo aa soɡa dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa.
Harɛ nɔ ta wobol warɔ, a bwa ɡe ɛ nɛra bane wobol dɛ dɔ mun.
Anomanta, nɛn dɛ bol waa maa a mun no aa, dɛ n berɛ deŋnebire te naate be.
Dɛ o ɡe aa n kon no aa, o ɡe berɛ deŋnebire te n be.
He siwi aa beɡra hɛɛ nyin kpeɡri Korowii Domadɛɛɡe be ó cha heyaa Korowii toma ta nɔ, hɛ́ɛ nyin anɔ la aa won cha asɔre tena kohona.
Naate waa cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛɛ bol wobofala la, ó soŋe Korowii ásɛ o chao ó won dɛɛ baɡle a mun.
Dɛ n dɛ soŋe Korowii wobofale ne naa, dɛ n lilewee dɛɛ soŋo la, kɛ n liire te aa wobɛlbwa ɛ. Amee jaɔ?
Mɛɛ soŋe Korowii n lileo nee, ásɛ dɛɛ soŋo n liire ɡe ne.
Mɛɛ kpɔ n lilewee ɡo yela, dɛ́ kpɔ n liire ɡe ɡo ja.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, he dɛ jam Korowii he lileo ne naa, ɛrɛɛ naate waa wola yarada dɛ ɛ nɛmpɛɛ la ɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ no a mun dɛ́ sɛh he nyoa ŋɔ “Aamen” dɛ́ teŋɛ waa haa jaamo a waa la ta nɔ?
Waa won no waa haa dɛ bol la mun.
He te jam Korowii kɛrɛdɛ kwaraa ɡba aa, a ta tɔnɔ dɔe tɛo.
N dɛ jam Korowii kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ waa ɡela n ɡe won wobofala bola, hale dɛ won a bola ɡwaa heyaa nɔ.
Kɛ dɛ n lɔ asɔre, dɛ bol n bwɛɛ wobol tama asɛ nɛra won no aa, a bɔ kɛŋɔ maa kpɔ wobofala bol waa kohona nɛra ta a mun noɛ.
Yabala, hé ɡel bechaliire.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé dɔ nomonliire.
Wechɔɡa ɛɛ te, hé ɛ he te bechasɔɔhne a bɔr.
He bɛ ɡel he liire kpeɡ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta.
Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra nɔ no n waa wobofala ta.
Hɔɔhraa mɛɛ ba ɡela ba bol baɡ ba, kɛ baa no.
Korowiirii ŋɔa.” Anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ nɛra ɛɛ bol wobofala, dɛɛ baɡle o kpeɡri dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa wola on yarada.
Nɛra baa dɛ yaradao la waa laa.
O waa baɡla Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ta la, banɔ la baa dɛ yaradao la waa.
Dɛ asɔre tena chemo, asɛ bɛlbwa ɛɛ bol wobofale, asɛ nɛra baa wola yarada dɛ ɛ nɛmpɛɛne ba ja he nɛ aa, baa ŋɔ he dɛ we choɡla aa?
Kɛ dɛ he bwa chemo dɛ che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri la ta dɛɛ bol o wa, asɛ nɛn waa wola yarada dɛ ɛ nɛmpɛɛ ba ja aa, wɛɛ noo dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ o dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Waa haa dɛ bol la bwa ɛɛ jo o nyu binii, ásɛ o nyoa kpo.
O tea bini waa bwa ɛɛ chɔ baŋee, ásɛ o ɡuŋi Korowii harɛ dɛ́ soŋo, ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ nɛra be ŋɔ Korowii ja he nɛɛ kpela.
Korowii toma aŋwɛnɛ ta Yabala, amee jaɔ?
Saŋ bɛlbwa haa cheme la, bɛl dɛ tɛ yel, bɛl dɔ sipila waa haa dɛ hwela, bɛl ɡe dɔ waane Korowii aa baɡlo, bɛl ɡee bol wobofala, bɛl ɡee baɡle a mune.
Hé ɡel waa haa dɛ ɛ la dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ nomɛlbwa.
Nɛra baa dɛ bol wobofala la, hé ɡel ba ɛ nɛra banɛ kɛɛ batoro ɡbo.
A chɛ kɛ bá bol kaa tɛ dɔŋa, ásɛ bɛl ɡee baɡle a mun ásɛ nɛra no ɡɛ waa bola.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won baɡle wobofale la mun aa, amɔ te náate waa ira dɛ fee bol waa la tɔ nyoa dɛ́ so.
Kɛ o ne Korowii ɛɛ bol waa o bambile bini.
Nɛra baa dɛ ba Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta cheɡa dɛ́ bol o waa la, hé ɡel ba ɛ banɛ ne batoro ɡbo, ásɛ ba kar la so dɛɛ no ba be, dɛɛ pese waa la kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ bɛl soɡo Korowii Domadɛɛɡe baɡlo waane aa, a chɛ kɛ naate waa dɛ bol waa la tɛo bɔr ó bol.
Hé bwa ɛɛ bol Korowii waa beŋkpoŋa beŋkpoŋa, ásɛ a dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ he bwa, dɛ́ do heyaa ɡbemba.
Nɛra Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa tɛɛ ba kpeɡri bá bol o waa la, bá won ba te lawa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii aa wesaɡasaɡare nyin.
Deŋnesɔɔhnaa wɛɛ nyin.
Gɛ baa dɛ ɛ asɔrere ta bobɛlbwa laanee.

A ta maɡrɛ kɛŋɔ haah bol waa asɔre dea bela.
He bee Korowii waa la che dɛ ba naa?
He ɡboo no waa la aa?
He banɔ la haa dɛ bol ŋɔ he won Korowii kpeɡri ta cheɡa dɛ́ bol o waa la, kɛɛ he dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la, hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ waa maa chwera ba tɛ heyaa la ɛ Korowii Mmara.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola nyin kɛŋɔ o no la, hé ɡelo.
Yabala, hé ɡel he sie beɡre hɛɛ nyin kpeɡri Korowii be, ásɛ dɛ won kpɔ bol o wa, dɛ bɛ banɔ la baa dɛ bol wobofala la ŋwɛnɛ tɔ.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa ŋwɛnɛ aa maɡra ta dɛ bɛ wesaɡasaɡare dɛɛ ɛ.
Yeesu seo ta ira Yabala, hé ɡel n lii heyaa Amanesoma la n fa aa bola baɡle heyaa asɛ he no dɛ taa teŋɛ a ta, asɛ a lɛ heyaa la wa.
Dɛ yarada haa dɔa Amanesoma la ta la ɛ kpela, he ta an vɛɛh dɛ kpoŋe a bini kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ maa baɡle heyaa la te naa, amɔ te a lɛ heya.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa te naa, amɔ dɛ he yarada la ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Gɛ Korowii aa baɡ mɛ laanee n baɡle heyaa la.
O baɡle waane aa ɛ wejena kɛŋɔ ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ sewɛ ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa baɡle o waa mɔɔ a ɛ la.
Ba huɡo, asɛ a tɔpetooro wee la Korowii iru seo ta.
Gɛɛ Korowii Tɔn baɡle mɔɔ a ɛ. Pitaa tɔ sie nao, mɔɔ o habɔteŋra fi dɛ banɛ la bwa nao, mɔɔ o habɔɔ nɛra lafraanue la ɡe nao kerabeŋkpoŋ.
Ba ɡalɡa ta lole ba le fini, bane ɡe serewe.
A habɔɔ la, Jems nao, asɛ Yeesu toroma bwa nao.
Menee ka mun nao.
N do kɛŋɔ bechala o nya aa kpoŋe o tea o ta beɛ kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ ba lolɔ la.
Menee Yeesu toroma la bwa bechala n waa aa wola hiaih.
N ta chɛɛ kwaraa kɛ ba yer mɛ o torome, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ n fa aa hah asɔre tena dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa la aa were.
Kɛ Korowii sune n nɛ, dɛ cha mɛ.
Chae waa cha mɛ laanee ɡela n do ɡɛ maa doa nɔ la.
O suna waa sune n nɛɛ la ta pɛɛ ɛɛ.
N iro, asɛ dɛɛ ɛ o toma la kohona hale dɛ ɡwaa n bala toroma la kwara.
N ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ne laa mɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ.
Korowiirii sune n nɛɛ dɛ cha mɛ, asɛ mɛɛ ɛa ɡɛ la.
Dɛ menee bol Amanesoma la baɡle heya o, nɛra banee yoo, webeŋkpoŋii ya bwa ɛɛ baɡle, anee he ɡee yarada.
Nɛra seo ta ira Dɛ ya baɡle Yeesu Kristo waa ŋɔ Korowiirii iru seo ta naa, ɛrɛɛ he bini bane berɛ dɛɛ ŋɔ Korowii aa nɛraa ir seo ta nɔɔ?
Dɛ Korowii aa nɛraa ir seo ta naa, amɔ te Yeesu Kristo ɡba ta seo ta ire.
Dɛ Korowii ta Yeesu Kristo ire seo ta te naa, amɔ te waa yaa dɛ baɡle heyaa la, ne yarada haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ te naa, amɔ te Korowii danseɛ yaa dɛ di la ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya dɛ baɡle heyaa ŋɔ Korowiirii ir Yeesu Kristo le seo ta.
Dɛ nɛra aa seo taa ir te naa, amɔ ya teŋe nyosone.
Dɛ nɛra aa seo taa ir aa, amɔ te Korowii ta on ire seo ta.
Dɛ Korowii ta Yeesu Kristo ire seo ta naa, amɔ te he dɛ yaradao pɛɛpɛɛ, dɛ he wechɔɡa ta lɔ he nɛ.
A berɔ dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ nɛra ba fa aa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo mɔɔ dɛ serewe la, Korowii aa ban lɛ.
Dɛ ya soɡa yaa soɡa nɔ ɡbo taa ya dɔ hwɛɡa Yeesu Kristo be naa, amɔ te ya waa sum ɡwaa nɛra bwa wa.
Kɛ ɡɛ laa a do.
Korowiirii ir Yeesu Kristo seo ta.
Onee tɔ sie ir seo ta nɛra baa serewa la nɛɛ mɔɔ ba ɡe baa ir.
Nɛmbeŋkpoŋii ba seo ne.
Nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ɡee ba seo ta ira ne.
Ya ne Adam bwa aa ɛ beŋkpoŋ la waa yaa serewe la.
Gɛɛ a do ya banɔ la ɡe ne Yeesu Kristo aa ɛ beŋkpoŋ la ɛɛ ir seo taa dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.
Kɛ ya bwa ne ya tɔperaa ya ir.
Yeesu Kristoo tɔ sie ir mɔɔ, ásɛ ya banɔ la ya ne waa ɛ beŋkpoŋ la ɡe ir ɡɛ saŋ waa ba ja la.
Belaa wobɛlbwa ɛɛ ba a jaɡa bala.
A taa Yeesu Kristo ɛɛ ba kpeɡri dɔe, dɛ́ pɔ konchɔɡa aa bea yaa wola an na bwa soo siwi nɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ kora la do o Mɛɛ Korowii nɔn ta ó di.
Yeesu Kristo chɛ kɛŋɔ ó di kpeɡri komɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa pɔ o dɔma bwa nɛ.
Dɛ o baa pɔ ba bwa nɛɛ tonaa, o dɔm muŋkaa waa pɔ o nɛɛ laanee seo.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Korowii ɡelɔ o dɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri.” Dɛ ba ŋɔ, “O ɡelɔ o dɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri” aa, a ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ o dɔ o Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri la dɛ kpɔ tɛo o di la ɡe kpeɡri.
Dɛ Korowii baa ɛ ɡɛ tonaa, o Bie ɡee kpɔ o tenee do o Mɛɛ Korowii waa kpɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri tɛo la lɔɡa, ásɛ Korowii ɡbo ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ.
Nɛra bane cheɡɛ lala naa ta dɛ ɡel baa sɔ ba Korowii ne.
Bɔkwa waa baa ɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Dɛ lala aa seo taa ir aa, bɔkwa waa ɡela ba ɡel ba ɛ ɡɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ baɔ?
Bɔkwa waa ya ɡee jo siswɛm waa ta saŋ bɛlbwa nɔɔ?
Yabala, kpelaa mɛɛ ŋɔ, dɛ maa siswɛm ta jo tɔpere bɛlbwa naa, amɔ te dɛ n laa yon dɛɛ kpɛɛ heyaa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ teŋa ta la.
Gɛ nɛra fa aa ɛɛ mɛ Ɛfesos la do kɛŋɔ n ne kpɔɡ bini ola aa yoa ken.
Dɛ harɛ nɔ ta waa ɡbo waa n ne ba yo aa, bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ n dɔ a ta nɔ?
Dɛ nɛra aa seo taa iraa, ya fe ɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Hé ɡel ya ir dɛ́ di kwaa dɛ́ lɛ sie, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tɔpebɛl yaa sewɔɔ.” He bɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ neɡre heya.
Danchɔɡe kpɔe dɛ chɔɡ dadɛɛɡe.
Anomanta, hé ir dɛ́ ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ hɛɛ ɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ bɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ ɛ.
He bini bane aa Korowii waa jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
A ta sihiih ɛɛ tɛ heya aa?
Gɛ ya bwadabi aa dɛ ba doe seo ta ira habɔɔ He bini bɛl ɛɛ bɔɔroo ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ lala ɛɛ ba wona ir seo ta nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ ba bwara ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?” Gɛne!
Komɛlbwa haa du la, o dɛ pɔh mɔɔ dɛ́ le.
Komɛlbwa haa du la, dɛ mea yoo, kon waa dɔ bii yoo, o papooni laa hɛɛ du.
O bii hɛɛ du, ásɛ o yon ɛ papooni dɛ́ le baŋ.
Korowiirii dɛɛ beɡra ɡɛ a bwa soo siwi aa doa ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin.
Bwadabii bwa ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ.
A bwa ne a soo siwii.
Nɛwɛnyini bwadabii korɛ ola kwaa ta.
Asɛ pɛŋa ɡe kwaa korɛ jumbii kwaa ta.
Korowii doa kwaa lole, asɛ harɛ ta ɡe kwaa do le, kɛ a wer korɛ dɔŋa ta.
Wee wer korɛ korobie wer ta.
Weweela ɡe wer korɔ.
Hale weweela bini kwara, ane dɛ chaah ɡwaa ane.
Gɛɛ nɛra seo ta ira ɛɛ ba doe.
Bwadabii yaa dɔa nɔ, dɛ ya baa serewe aa, o bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, kɛ bwadabii yaa dɔ dɛ ir seo ta la, o te aa chɔɡ bwa.
Bwadabii yaa dɔa mɔɔ dɛ serewe la ɛɛ chɔɡoo.
O ɛ kompɛɛ baa huɡo, kɛ Korowii ɛɛ leo seo taa, ásɛ o ɛ kondɛɛɡe.
Kon baa huɡo la aa kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔ, kɛ Korowii ɛɛ iruu ásɛ o do kpeɡri.
Bwadabii yaa dɔɔ harɛ nɔ ta laanee baa ba huɡa, kɛ onɔ la Korowii aa dɛ ba ira seo ta la te ɛɛ korɔɔ.
Gɛ harɛ nɔ ta bwadabii aa lole la, ɡɛɛ Korowii doa kon ɡe do le.
Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Korowii ta nɛnloɡle, dɛ yerɔ Adam, asɛ o dɔ mkpa dɛ do le.” Kɛ muŋkaa Adam la te ɛ Korowii doa nɛn dɛɛ tɛ mkpa.
Onee Yeesu Kristo.
Korowii doa bwadabii laa ya tɔ sie dɔ.
Harɛ nɔ ta konee ya tɔ sie dɔ mɔɔ dɛ dɔ Korowii doa kon la.
Nɛnloɡle la, ba mao tee ne o ɛ harɛ nɛn.
Asɛ nɛɛte la ɡe le nyundua.
Gɛ onɔ la baa mao tee ne fa aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o nɛra ɡe do.
Asɛ ɡɛ onɔ la waa le nyundua aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o ɡe nɛra do.
Gɛ yaa le onɔ la waa le harɛ nɔ ta la, ɡɛɛ yaa ba onɔ la waa le nyundua la ɡe lee.
Yabala, hé ɡel n ŋɔ he be, harɛ nɔ ta bwadabii aa won la Korowii be.
Kon waa dɛ pɔh la ne onɔ la waa wola pɔh aa won pɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ no, mɛɛ baɡle heyaa wesɔɔhle bɛlee.
Ya bwa laa dɛɛ ba serewa.
Hale dɛ ya serewɔ oo, ya ta serewɛ oo, Korowii ɛɛ beɡre ya bwa bwadabii kerabeŋkpoŋii.
Aa ɛo wɔrɔbe nɛɛ kilo, ɡɛ saŋ Korowii bɛla aa ba si, dɛ́ baɡle waa bwa jaɡa la.
Dɛ o sio waa, Korowii ɛɛ ir serewa laanee seo ta, ásɛ ba dɔ bwadabii waa wola pɔh, dɛ beɡre ya banɔ la yaa wola sewɛ dɛ ta so le la bwara, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ bwadabii waa wola pɔh la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó chiɡ onɔ la waa dɛ pɔh la naa ta.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ bwadabii waa wola sewɛ la chiɡ onɔ la waa dɛ sewɛ la naa ta.
Dɛ onɔ la waa wola sewɛ, waa wola pɔh la baa chiɡ onɔ la waa dɛ sewɛ, dɛɛ pɔh la naa ta naa, belaa waa baa chwera do Korowii Tɔn bini la ɛɛ ba kpela ɛɛ.
Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, “O kpɔ kpeɡri pɔ seo nɛ.” “Seo, lee he kpeɡri dɔɔ jaɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won do yaa weweele ta nɔ?” Wechɔɡaa ɡela seo ɛɛ do yaa weweele ta.
Mmara yaa wola o ta teŋɛ la ɡe ɡelɔ seo dɔ kpeɡri ya nɛ.
Korowii chɛ jam kohona.
O tɛ yaa kpeɡri dɛ le ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo be ásɛ ya pɔ seo nɛ.
Anomanta, yabala maa dɛ nyin he wa, hé lawɛ waa la bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛ bɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa ha heyaa ásɛ he berɛ habɔɔ.
Hé lawɛ ya Dɔɔ toma bini bambile bwa ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he koeh aa pɛɛ ɛɛ ba.
Suuɡa baa ta tɛ Korowii nɛra A ka suuɡa yaa dɛ nyin ya ta tɛ Korowii nɛra la.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ n fa aa ŋɔ asɔre tena baa lɔ Galaasia harɛ ta be ŋɔ báa ɛ la.
Kwasiara bɛlbwa, hé bini bɛlbwa ɛɛ kpɔ suuɡa, ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa wona dɛ le anɔ la Korowii aa chao o dɔ la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ cheɡ.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ n balaa, he bɛ suuɡa dɛɛ ta kpa.
Dɛ n balaa, mɛɛ chwerɛ tɔn aa dɛ baɡle n waa, he kpɔ ka tɛ nɛra haa dɛ yarada ba, dɛ́ tom ba bá kpɔ a ne kwaa haa tɛ Korowii nɛra la la Jerusalam.
Dɛ a chɛ kɛ n ne ba la naa, mɛɛ tɔ ba siee ya la.
Pɔɔl baɡle ɡɛ waa berɛ ba Makidoonia tena be N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ n la Makidoonia harɛ ta.
Dɛ n baa le bela aa, mɛɛ ba he bee, dɛ́ ba so he be dɛ́ biɡri tama.
N ken ɛɛ so he bee alalawo saŋ, ásɛ alalawo saŋ kaa mɔɔ he ta mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń kaa bela bwa maa dɛ nyin.
Dɛ n ŋɔ mɛɛ ba na heyaa tarakenii yaa, maa won biɡri he be.
Kɛ dɛ Korowii sɛoh n ba won ba naa, mɛɛ biɡri he bee.
Mɛɛ so Ɛfesos bonɔɔ ka tel kɛŋɔ Pɛntekɔs Tɔpejen la aa tel, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n dɔ bɔr bonɔ dɛ́ won ɛ Korowii toma kohona, ásɛ a le tɔnɔ dɛ tɛo.
Nɛra baa dɛ nyin ba tɔ n toma ŋwɛnɛ la warɔ te.
Timoti ba he be naa, hé lɛo kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ o sie lɛ.
Korowii toma maa dɛ ɛ la, anee o ɡee ɛ. Anomanta, he bɛ o sie lawɛ teɡɛ harɛ.
Hé doo ŋwɛnɛ ásɛ o kpɔ bambisɔɔhna dɛ berɛ ba n be.
N dɛ nyiŋi o ne yabala la ŋwɛnɛ.
N soŋe ya dɔŋ Apolos ŋɔ ó ja yabala la nɛɛ ba ba he be, kɛ a ta o som doe kɛ ó la bela taraken.
Dɛ o baa dɔ bɔr aa, wɛɛ bao.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ dɛ ta lawɛ waa la bini kiŋkiŋ.
Hé dɔ bambile ásɛ dɛ ɡel lawa haa lawɛ waa la bini la do kpeɡri.
Hé kpɔ nɛnnyin dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra.
Yabala, he jemɔ kɛŋɔ Stɛfanas ne o dem tenaa tɔ sie yarada Yeesu waa la Akaya harɛ nɛra la bwa bini, dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo dɛ swɛɛ siwi dɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra.
Anomanta, n dɛ soŋe heya, hɛ́ɛ no nomɛlbwa waa do ken ne nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ dɛɛ koh toma nɔ ta la deŋna wa.
Stɛfanas ne Fɔtonaatos ne Akaekus balɔ, asɛ a do n som taeh, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɡbabir ta wone ba ásɛ n na heya, kɛ ba chiɡ he naa ta dɛ ba, dɛ ba do mɛ ɡbemba taeh, dɛ do he ɡe ɡbemba.
Hɛ́ɛ duu nɛra baa do ken nɔ.
Asɔre tena baa lɔ Eesia harɛ la dɛ na heyaa taeh.
Akwela ne Presela ne asɔre tena baa dɛ cheme ba dem la ɡe dɛ na heyaa Yeesu sɔn ta.
Yabala bwa baa lɔ bonɔ dɛ na heya.
Hɛ́ɛ lea dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nyabii.
Men Pɔɔl ɡbaɡbaa bol waa nɔ ba chwerɛ, asɛ n ɡbabir ɡe chwerɛ anɔ aa kaa nɔ.
N dɛ na heya.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola ya Dɔɔ nyin la, Korowii nyotaahna lɔ o nɛ.
Ya Dɔɔ, ba!
Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ na nɛra sum la cha he bwa sekwaraa.
He nɛra he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la, n dɛ na heyaa n bambile bwa ne.
Aamen.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pɔɔl chwerɛ ɡɛ tɔn nɛɛte nɔ ka tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Kɔrent, ásɛ dɛ kwaa o ne ba baah kɛrɛdɛ.
Kristo tena la bane tɔŋle Pɔɔl waa waa dɛ bol la, kɛ dɛ ba bwa waa lɔ o bambile ta.
Dɛ o dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ, ba bwa berɛ pɛ dɛ́ ɛ beŋkpoŋ, ásɛ silɛɛ ba ba soɡa bini.
Dɛ o dɛ do asɔre tena la ɡbemba ŋɔ bá teŋɛ lɛ suuɡare baa dɛ lɛ la, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba won kpɔ cha asɔre tena baa lɔ Jerusalam la.
Pɔɔl baɡlɔ kɛ o ɛ Yeesu torome kpela.
O ja Kristo tena baa lɔ Kɔrent la ŋɔ bá nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ nɛra baa ŋɔa ba ɛ Yeesu toroma, kɛ dɛɛ teŋe nyosone la bɛ ban ba neɡre.
O dɛ nyin kɛ saŋ waa berɛ la ba be la, dɛ ba ɛ wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ.
Men Pɔɔl aa too Korowii tea asɛ o lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la, n ne ya dɔŋ Timotii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
Ya chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ asɔre tena baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii Kɔrent, ne Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa baa lɔ Akaya harɛ ta.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Pɔɔl Korowii jaama Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii.
Onee ya Mɛɛ o tea aa dɛ domɛ ya nɛɛ kohona, dɛ ɛ Korowii waa wona dɛɛ larawe nɛn bwara.
On dɛɛ larawe ya bwara ya wenaale bwa ta, ásɛ ya ɡe won che bambisɔɔhna waa tɛ yaa la ta dɛɛ larawe yabala baa lɔ wenaale bɛlbwa soo siwi ta la bwara.
Gɛ yaa ja Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ na wahala kohona la, ɡɛ tentenee a che o nɛɛ ya dɔ bɔlarawa ɡe kohona.
Dɛ ya dɛ na wahala aa, he chae waa yaa naa, ásɛ dɛ won larawe he bwara, ásɛ Korowii won lɛ heya.
Dɛ Korowii berɔ larawe ya bwara ɡe aa, dɛ he chae waa o ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ ya won cha heya, he won lawɛ bambile ɡɛ saŋ haa ba na ya wahala yaa naa la dɔŋ la.
Anomanta, ya hwɛɡa yaa dɔa he nɛɛ la aa pɛɛ ɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ haa dɛ na ya wahala la dɔŋ nɔ, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ ba ya bɔlarawa Korowii aa ba tɛ yaa la ane dɔe.
Yabala, ya dɛ nyin he jemɛ wahala yaa naa Eesia harɛ la wa.
Dɛ a kan dɛ ɡwaa ya nɛɛ kohona.
Dɛ yaa lii kɛŋɔ yaa le a nyoa bokpeɡa binii.
Ya te fe jemɔ kɛŋɔ yaa sewɔɔ, kɛ ya ta sewɛ.
Korowiirii ɛa ɡɛ ásɛ ya bɛ ya ɡbaɡba bokpeɡa ta dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ hwɛɡa do on waa dɛ ir nɛra seo ta la nɛ.
O lɛ yaa le siswɛm a fe aa chɛ kɛ ya sewɛ a ta la ta.
O ta dɛ lɛ yaa.
Ya kpɔ ya sie dawɛ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ lɛ yaa.
Hé cha yaa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii, ásɛ dɛ o baa no he wesoŋa dɛ cha yaa aa, nɛra won kpɔ jam tɛo pirim dɛ́ tɛ yaa kɛŋɔ waa no nɛndamanta wesoŋa baa soŋa tɛ yaa la.
Gɛ aa ɛa Pɔɔl charɛ o liire Webeŋkpoŋii ɡela ya baŋa pa. Anee kɛŋɔ yaa wonoo ŋɔ bambile bwa ne kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa yaa ɛa harɛ bonɔ la, tepoŋ ne bambile bwa nee ya ɛa Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta, a laa kɛ waa yaa ɛa he be la.
Korowiirii sune ya nɛɛ dɛ cha yaa ya ɛa.
Harɛ bonɔ wejema ne laa ya ɛa.
Waa yaa chwerɛ heyaa asɛ he kure dɛ no a mun la, anee ya chwerɛ.
Wobɛlbwa toole a bini he no a mun kahonɛ.
Taraken haa jemɛ ya waa tama nɔ, n dɛ lii kɛŋɔ hɛɛ jemɛ ya waa bwaa, ásɛ awola tɔpere ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa ba la, he baŋa pa ya waa kɛŋɔ ya baŋa aa pa he waa la.
Maa jemɛ he waa ken la, a waa n faa ɛ kɛ mɛɛ ba cha heyaa kera anɛ bwaa la.
N fa ɛo kɛ n Makidoonia harɛ kaala ta la, ń kpɔ he be, ásɛ n le bela dɛɛ ba ɡe aa, ń ba so he be tama, ásɛ he ta mɛ ŋwɛnɛ n kaa Juda harɛ.
Maa lii ken la, dɛ n le nɛn o liire aa dɛ ɛo aahna-aahna kɛɛ?
N dɛ maɡle maɡla aa, n ɡbo kɛrɛdɛɛ mɛɛ nyiŋi kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ ɛ, ásɛ a wer tɛ mɛ naa, n ŋɔ ɔɔh, dɛ buɡ ta n berɔ na kɛ aa were tɛ mɛ naa, n ŋɔ ɔɔhɔh kɛɛ?
N nyoa maa baɡɛ heyaa la, aahna-aahna toole a ta.
A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ Korowii wa aa ɛ kasinteŋ nyosone aa wola toole a ta la.
Korowii Bie Yeesu Kristo la n ne Silvanos ne Timoti aa baɡle o waa he be la dɔ kasinteŋ.
O ta dɔe kɛŋɔ o ŋɔ ɔɔh, dɛ berɛ le habɔɔ dɛ ŋɔ ɔɔhɔh.
O te bol wa aa, dɛ o bolɔ.
Nyoo bwa Korowii aa baɡa la, Yeesu nɛɛ ya che dɛ jemɛ kɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ.
O waa ya won Aamen la sii, ásɛ Korowii won dɔ sɔn.
Korowiirii ɡela ya ne he bwa won lawɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ teŋa la kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ le yaa tɛ o toma, dɛ do yaa nso aa baɡle kɛ onee dɔ yaa, dɛ tɛ yaa o Domadɛɛɡe la wɛɛ so ya nɛ, ásɛ ya che a ta dɛ́ jemɛ waa bwa waa ɛa cheɡ yaa.
Korowii waa jemɛ n nyu bini bwa la, onee n danseɛ te waa nɔ ta.
N fa aa wola Kɔrent balɛ la, maa nyin kɛ n ba chɛɡre heyaa he wechɔɡa waa ásɛ he bambile chɔɡ, a waa n ta balɛ.
Kpeɡri laa yaa baɡle heyaa he Korowii yaradae ta.
Yaa ɡɛ lii kwaraa.
Ya jemɔ kɛ he cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ he yarada ta.
Ya dɛ nyin kɛ ya cha heyaa ásɛ he sie lɛ.
Anomanta, n ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ maa he bee ba ásɛ dɛ ba ɡel he tea bini chɔɡ kpa.
N ɡelɔ he tea bini chɔɡ aa, umee dɛ́ lar mɛ bwara jaɔ?
Nɛn toole, nemenɛ he tenten maa chɔɡ he tea bini la.
A waa n chwerɛ heyaa tɔn la.
Dɛ maa nyin kɛ he nɛra haa chɛ kɛ he ɡel n sie lɛ la, n ba he be ásɛ he berɛ ba ɛɛ mɛ tebinichɔɡ wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n jemɛ he bwa waa kɛ n silɛɛ he silɛɛ.
Tɔn la n fa aa chwerɛ heyaa la, dɛ a dɛ we n nɛɛ taeh, asɛ n tea bini chɔɡ mɛɛ wi siniire dɛɛ chwerɔ.
N fa ta on chwerɛ dɛ́ ɡel he tea bini chɔɡ, kɛ n chwerɔ ásɛ he na ɡɛ del maa dɛ nyin he bwa.
Wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ Nɛn o fa aa ba tebinichɔɡ ne la, n ɡbo tea bini laa o chɔɡ.
He bwa tea binii o chɔɡ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl ta.
Maa nyin kɛ n do naate siswɛm, a waa n bola ken la.
Gɛ he kɛrɛdɛ nyoa aa pɛa he tɛr naate deŋne nɔ, a maɡrɔ.
He bɛ ane ɛ ja kpa.
A chɛ kɛ he kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo name, dɛɛ doo ɡbemba.
Gɛ laa, o tea bini chɔɡɔ kohona aa, wɛɛ horɔɔ.
Anomanta, n dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ he ɡel o jemɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ nyinu kohona.
Maa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ń ɛ heyaa dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ hɛɛ no n waa ta wobɛlbwa taa kɛɛ haa no la, a waa n chwerɛ heyaa tɔn la.
Nomɛlbwa haa kpɔ o wechɔɡa kɛo la, n ɡe kpɔɔ kɛo.
Nomɛl ɛɛ mɛ waane a chɛ kɛ ń kpɔ kɛo waa, n koh he waa dɛ kpɔ kɛo Yeesu Kristo siwi ta, ásɛ Bɔnsam bɛ ŋwɛnɛ ba dɔ dɛ́ chɔɡ ya wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya jemɛ o ŋwɛnɛre waa kpɔa dɛɛ neɡre nɛn.
Sibeɡra Pɔɔl aa kpɔa bol Korowii wa Troas Maa baa tel Troas ŋɔ ń bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la, n nao kɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ pili ŋwɛnɛ tɛ mɛ kɛ ń ɛ toma bela.
Kɛ maa wola ya dɔŋ Taetos ka pue bela la, n baah ta men sɔɔhnɛ.
Anomanta, n kal bela tena dɛ kaa Makidoonia harɛ.
Korowii jam kɛ waa cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ ɡel ya yo dɛɛ le nɔ.
Korowii cheɡɛ ya nɛɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ no Yeesu Kristo waa la bobɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, konsɔɔhsoma sɔɔh aa dɛ le nomɛlbwa ɛɛ no la.
Yeesu Kristo ɡelɔ ya ɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma Korowii be, ásɛ nɛra Korowii aa dɛ lɛɛ ba, ne banɔ la baa nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ ba chɔɡa ta bwa ɛɛ no ya sɔɔh.
Banɔ la baa dɛ nyoɡre la ɛɛ no sɔɔh laanee dɛ́ serewe, ásɛ banɔ la Korowii aa dɛ lɛɛ ba la ɡe no dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.
Umee dɛ won ɛ ɡɛ toma nɔɔ?
Nɛra kɛrɛdɛ kpɔ Korowii waa la berɛ bona dii dɛ yoɡ dɛɛ di.
Ba laa yan.
Korowiirii tɛ yaa waa nɔ ŋɔ yáa bola, ásɛ yaa bola o siwi ta bambile bwa ne, pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la nomanta.
Yaa dɛ ŋɔ ken nɔ, kpɛɛraa yaa kpɛɛ ya te ja kɛɛ?
A hiaoh kɛŋɔ ya kpoŋe tɔne aa baɡle ya nɛnsoo ne ɡɛ ya toma aa doa mɔɔ he lɛ yaa aa?
Kɛɛ a hiaoh kɛ ya dɔ ane le he be ásɛ nɛra won yarada yaa aa?
He ɡbaɡbaa ya tɔn waa dɛ baɡle tondɛɛɡa yaa ɛa.
Ya bambile taa Korowii chwerɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa na heya, dɛɛ pese heyaa kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ kure tɔn la.
He we-ɛɛla dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he ɛ Yeesu Kristo tɔn waa cheɡɛ ya nɛɛ dɛ chwerɛ.
Iŋki ne laa o chwerɔ, Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la Domadɛɛɡee o kpɔ chwerɛ.
Bwe ta laa o chwerɔ, bambile taa o chwerɔ.
Ya won ɡɛ bola, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛɛ yarada Korowii a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta.
A ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ ya dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ya won waane ɛɛ ya ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ta.
Korowii bee ya dɔ kpeɡri dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la bwa yaa dɛ ɛ. Korowii ɡelɔ ya won dɛɛ ɛ o fɔofale la toma.
A ɡɛ fɔofale nɔ ta mmara baa chwera waa ɛɛ, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa.
Mmara baa chwera la dɛ ba seo ne, kɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la te dɛ ba mkpa ne.
Bwe taa Korowii faa chwerɛ Mosis Mmara la dawɛ.
Bela Korowii aa kpɔ Mmara la tɛ Mosis la, Korowii jirima ba bela, bela bwa chaah, dɛ chaah Mosis nɛɛ o siebɔr ɛɛ nyɛɡle.
Mosis aa la Israel tena be la, dɛ nyɛɡla o siebɔr aa dɛ nyɛɡle la nyoa sɔɔhnɔ tonɛ.
Kɛ Israel tena aa nao la, ba ŋɔ o siebɔr dɛ nyɛɡle kohona to, ba ta wone nyiŋu.
Mosis Mmara kwara waa dɛ la nɛn ne seo ta la wono ba jirima nɔ dɔŋ ne naa, dɛ ɛrɛɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la wa ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?
Aa ɡɛɛ ɡwaa la aa?
Waa aa ɡela nɛra ɛɛ di bolchɔɡe Korowii sie la dɔ jirima ken aa, dɛ anɔ la aa ɡela nɛra ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba wa ɛɛ su o siwi la, ɛrɛɛ a jirima ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?
Waa a fa aa dɔ jirima kohona la, taraken a ta jirima dɔe kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ anfala jirima tɔɔɡe a nɛ.
Waa aa ɛa tɔpera anɛ dɛ tonɛ la, dɛ a dɔ jirima aa, dɛ anɔ la aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la, a jirima ta ɡwaalaa?
Ya dɔ hwɛɡa ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, anomanta, yaa ɔmɛ.
Ya ta do kɛ Mosis o fa aa wola nyin kɛ Israel tena na kɛŋɔ o siebɔr nyɛɡla nyoa dɛ sɔɔh, dɛ koh a waa kpɔ yachaahne tɔ sie la.
Israel tena fa aa waa la mun no.
Taraken ɡba, ɡɛɛ ba ta do.
Baa dɛ kure fɔobene la waa la, a ta do kɛ baa kpɔ yachaahne tɔ ba sie.
Ba ta Yeesu Kristo waa lɛɛ yaa, yachaahne la aa ba sie lee ba.
Hale fini ɡba, saŋ bɛlbwa ba dɛ kure Mosis Mmara Tɔn aa, a ta do kɛ yachaahne aa tɔ ba liire, dɛ ɡel baa a mun no.
Kɛ, saŋ bɛlbwa nɛwɛnyini aa charɛ o liire dɛ́ berɛ ba Yeesu be la, yachaahne la ɛɛ leo.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesuu Domadɛɛɡe la.
Bobɛlbwa ɡe o Domadɛɛɡe la aa lole la, nomɛlbwa dɔ o te, o toole Mmara lɔɡa.
Anomanta, komɛlbwa ta ya te sie tɔe.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu jirima chaah ya nɛ, dɛɛ beɡre yaa asɛ yaa do ɡɛ waa doa, jirima yaa dɔa la ɛɛ ja.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu waa ɛ Domadɛɛɡe la bee a bwa le.
Korowii toma do kɛŋɔ kondɛɛɡe aa lɔ viine bini Korowiirii sune ya nɛɛ dɛ tɛ yaa toma nɔ, anomanta, ya bwara aa yaa hwah.
Ya ɡel waa baa ɛa dɛɛ sɔh ne sihihwaa bɛlbwa.
Yaa nɛra neɡre, yaa Korowii waa yaa dɛ baɡle la sie berɛ.
Kasinteŋ ɡboo yaa di Korowii sie.
A taa ya che dɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ jemɛ ya da.
Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma nɔ yaa dɛ bol nɔ, dɛ a sɔɔh kwaraa naa, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyoɡre la bee a sɔh.
Bɔnsam baa dɛ maŋkurao harɛ nɔ ta kɛŋɔ Korowii la, o chɔɡ nɛra baa wola Yeesu yarada la liire.
Waa nyin kɛŋɔ Amanesoma nii aa le Yeesu Kristo o wa aa dɔ jirima kohona be la chaah ba.
Yeesu do ɡɛ Korowii aa doa.
Ya ɡbaɡba waa laa yaa baɡle nɛra nɔ.
Yeesu Kristo waa yaa baɡle kɛŋɔ onee komɛlbwa Dɔɔ, dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o nomanta, he bonɔɔnaa yan.
Korowii waa pere bochaah le biro ta, dɛ ɡel bɔr chaah la, onee ɡela o nii chaah ya bambile ne ya sie, asɛ ya won jemɛ ɡɛ o jirima yaa naa Yeesu Kristo be la aa doa.
Waa nɔ bwa yaa jema nɔ do kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ kondɛɛɡa do viine bini la.
Yanee viine la.
Yaa kpeɡe, kɛ Korowii kpɔ o toma tɛ yaa asɛ yaa ɛ. O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ won baɡle kɛŋɔ kpeɡri aa ɡwaa kpeɡri bwa la le o be.
Ya be laa a le.
Nɛra dɛ ha yaa kohona, kɛ baa ya nɛɛ pɔ.
Waa dɛ hiah yaa ya nyiŋi ɡɛ yaa ɛ kahonɛ, kɛ ya bwara aa yɔr, yaa ɡel.
Nɛra cheɡɛ ya nɛ, kɛ Korowii te ta ya habɔɔ leɛ.
Ba ɡo yaa bil te, kɛ ba ta wone kpo yaa.
Wenaale nɔ yaa dɛ na nɔ dɛ baɡle kɛ ya sɛoh kɛ yaa sewɛ Yeesu seo la dɔŋee, ásɛ nɛra na dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ ya dɔ o mkpa la.
Yaa soɡe le nɔ, Yeesu nomanta, saŋ bɛlbwaa ya so seo nyoa, ásɛ nɛra na o mkpa ya bwadabii waa won sewa nɔ aa dɔa.
Anomanta, a kaa ɛ kɛ ya te dɛ sewɛ, asɛ he te ɛɛ dɔ mkpa dɛ le ya seo la ta.
Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Maa yaradaa waa n bol.” Gɛɛ ya ɡee yarada.
Yaa yaradaa waa yaa bol.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii waa ir ya Dɔɔ Yeesu seo ta la, onee dɛɛ ba ya banɔ la ya ne Yeesu aa pɛa la seo ta ira, dɛ́ kpɔ ya ne heyaa kaa o be.
He waa Korowii ɛ anɔ bwa.
Waraa nɛra Korowii aa na ba sum den na dɛɛ warɛ.
Baa kpɔ jam kohonaa tɛ Korowii ásɛ o dɔ jirima.
Ken nɔ nomanta, bɔhwaah aa yaa lawɛ.
Tɔ aa dɛ per nɔ bwaa ya bwadabii ɡwɛɡre dɛɛ la.
Kɛ ya bini te la, kpeɡrii ya yarada do dɛɛ la.
Wahala tama nɔ yaa dɛ na tɔpera anɛ bɛl nɔ ɛɛ ɡeloo ya dɔ jirima aa wola jaɡa dɔe, ásɛ a ɡwaa wahala nɔ kwaraa ken.
Kwaa baa dɛ naa siwi ne la ta laa ya te sie dawɛ.
Anɔ la baa wola an na la taa ya sie dawɛ.
Kwaa baa dɛ naa la te, tɔpera anɛ bɛlee aa di.
Asɛ anɔ la baa wola an na ɡe la, a ta jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Ya Korowii doa bwadabii wa Ya harɛ nɔ ta bwadabii nɔ do kɛ pata ya do o ta.
Ya jemɔ kɛ dɛ o chɔɡaa, Korowii ɛɛ tɛ yaa defale o ɡbaɡba aa doa waa wola chɔɡ bwa nyunduaa.
Ya bwadabii nɔ te pe yaa.
Ya sie cheɡɛ chiŋ yaa hime, dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ ya Korowii doa bwadabii la do yaa, ásɛ ya bɛ bwadabii nya.
Ya taa lɔ ya bwadabii aa do kɛ patare ta nɔ, ya bwara dɛ nyɛɡ, yaa hime.
Ya bwadabii nɔ kpɔe dɛ le ya nɛɛ waa laa dena swɛɛ ya siwi.
Ya Korowii doa bwadabii la doe waa swɛɛ ya siwi kohona, ásɛ o chiɡ bwadabii waa won sewa nɔ naa ta ya dɔ mkpa.
Korowiirii cheɡ ɡɛ waa nɔ tɛ yaa, dɛ kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe tɛ yaa a baɡle kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ba tɛ yaa o mkpa laanee.
Anomanta, ya bwara aa yaa hwah bwa.
Ya jemɔ kɛ ya lɔ ya bwadabii nɔ bini naa, ya toole ya Dɔɔ be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ waa yaa dɛ na la ne laa ya so.
Waa yaa dɛ yarada a waa la nee ya so.
Ya bwara aa yaa hwah tamaa bɛlbwa.
Dɛ ya ɡel ya bwadabii nɔ waa do kɛ dea nɔ dɛ ka do ya Dɔɔ be naa, ɡɛɛ yaa nyin.
Anomanta, ya bwadabii nɔ binii ya do oo, ya Dɔɔ bee ya do oo, ya dɛ nyin ya waa bwa won su o siwi, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya bwa ɛɛ ba che Yeesu Kristo sie o bol ya waa dɛ́ pa bole, ásɛ bɛlbwa dɔ waa o fa aa soɡe le dɛɛ ɛ la kembɔr.
Dɛ bɛlbwa we-ɛɛla wer oo, aa were oo, wɛɛ dɔ a kembɔree.
Yeesu nɛɛ cheɡa ya ne Korowii kpɔ darame Yaa jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa do ɔma la waa ya bol waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra ásɛ ba jemɛ kasinteŋ la.
Korowii jemɛ ya bambile bini bwa.
N dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he ɡe jemɛ ya nɛnsoore he bambile bini.
Anɔ dɛ baɡle kɛ kpɛɛraa ya kpɛɛ ya te dɛɛ baɡle heyaa ja kɛɛ?
Akai!
Ya dɛ nyin ya baɡle heyaa wa, ásɛ he che a ta dɛ́ won dɛɛ maŋkura yaa nɛra baa dɛ chɔɡ yaa la be.
Waa nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ naa laanee baa maŋkura.
Baa nɛn bambile bini waa nyiŋi.
Dɛ ya nyu toole naa, Korowii waa a ba ɡɛ.
Ya sie chɔ harɛ ɡe aa, he wesomee a ba ɡɛ.
Yeesu Kristo nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa laanee dɛɛ do yaa ya we-ɛɛla bwa ta.
Gɛ yaa naa laanee kɛŋɔ dɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ lɛ nɛra bwa seo sewaa, a kaa chaa kɛ nɛra la bwa sewɔ.
O sewɔ tɛ nɛra bwa.
Anomanta, nɛra baa soɡe le la ta chɛ kɛ ba so ba ɡbaɡba soɡa kpa.
Bá so tɛ naate waa sewa tɛɛ ba asɛ Korowii iru seo ta la.
Anomanta, fini habɔɔ, yaa nɛra nyiŋi ɡɛ nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ nyiŋ ba la.
Ya fa dɛ nyiŋi Yeesu Kristo ɡba ɡɛ, kɛ yaa on ɡɛ nyiŋi kpa.
Nomɛlbwa o ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la, o berɛ nɛnfale.
O ɡel o webena o fa aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ charɛ dafale.
Korowiirii ɛ a bwa.
Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ o che, dɛ kwaa ya ne o baah ya ne o pɛ, dɛ tɛ yaa toma nɔ ŋɔ yá nyin nɛra dɛɛ tɛo, ásɛ ba ne o baah kwaa bá won pɛ.
Korowii cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ kwaa o ne nɛwɛnyina baah, dɛ laɡ ba dɛɛ pɛl o te, waa wola ba wechɔɡa nyiŋi.
Yanee o kpɔ o waa tɛ ŋɔ yá baɡle ɡɛ waa kwaa o ne ba baah, dɛ́ laɡ ba ásɛ o ne ba pɛ.
Taraken nɔ, Yeesu Kristoo tomɛ yaa ŋɔ yá bol waa dɛɛ tɛo la.
A kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii cheɡɛ ya nɛɛ dɛɛ bol waa nɛra be la.
Ya cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo naa ta dɛɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ, hé ɡel he ne Korowii baah kwaa he pɛ.
Dɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole Yeesu Kristo nɛ, kɛ ya kɛrɛdɛ nomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ o lɛ ya wechɔɡa che, ásɛ dɛ ya ne o pɛo waa, ya waa won su Korowii siwi ó lɛ yaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡaa yan.
Ya ne Korowii bwa aa pɛa dɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ, ya dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ Korowii aa na he sum dɛ cha heyaa nɔ, he bɛ ɡel a ɛ pɛɛ.
Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, “Saŋ aa tela kɛŋɔ ń na he sum la, n no he be.
N ta he chae vɛɛh a ɡɛ saŋ, n lɛ heya.” Hé no!
Tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ he no Korowii be ó na he sum.
Finii he lɛɛ tɔpere.
Wekpeɡa aa pu Pɔɔl Yaa nyin kɛ nomɛlbwa dɔ ya toma wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɛ bol, anomanta, waa aa ɡel nɛra lɔ naa la, yaa an kpɔe dɛɛ ɛɛ ba.
Ya dɛ ɛ ya wobɛlbwa ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ nɛra Korowii aa tom ba ɛɛ ɛ. Wekpeɡa dɛ pu yaa, ya lawɛ bambile dɛɛ so a ne.
Ya dɛ na bambiwɔrɔbe wa, a won yaa hiaih kohona.
Ya dɛ na sibeɡrewaa ɡe kɛrɛdɛ.
Ba dɛ lɔɔ yaa, dɛɛ do yaa deene, dɛ lɛ ɡaeh ya nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ yaa saɡasaɡa.
Ya dɛ ɛ tomkpeɡa dɛɛ koh.
Tɔpebɛl yaa dom dɔe dɛɛ chɔ.
Tɔpebɛl yaa kondikwaa dɔe dɛɛ di.
Ya cheɡɛ ya ɡoroŋ yaa doa la ta, ne Yeesu Kristo ŋwɛnɛ la waa yaa jema, ne bambile yaa dɔa, ne ya tesom ta dɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii bonɔɔnaa yan.
Ya cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la yaa dɔa, ne ɡɛ yaa nyin nɛra tea bwa ne, ne kasinteŋ bola ta, ne Korowii kpeɡri waa kpɔa cha yaa ta, dɛɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii bonɔɔnaa yan.
Waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi laanee ya dɔmkwa.
A nee yaa yo diɡ ne ɡal ne, a nee yaa tɔ ya te ɡbemɡbe.
Bane dɛ pena yaa, bane ɛɛ yoo yaa.
Bane dɛ chɛɡre yaa, bane ɛɛ kpɛɛ yaa.
Ba dɛ yerɛ yaa nyosonteŋna, kɛ kasinteŋ ɡee yaa bol.
Baa yaa komɛlbwa yerɛ, kɛ nɛra bwa ɡe jemɛ yaa.
A fe chɛ kɛ ya sewɛ, kɛ yan soɡe le la.
Ba ɛ yaa hɔhɔrɔwa, kɛ ba ta yaa kpoe.
Ba dɛ ɛ yaa tebinichɔɡ wa, kɛ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ ya lɔ silɛɛ ta.
Ya ɛ nyaara, kɛ ya won nɛra chae kohona.
Ya ta komɛlbwa dɔe, kɛ yan ɡee komɛlbwa.
Yabala Kɔrent tena, bambile bwa nee ya bol waa he be.
Ya dɛ nyin he waa taeh.
Ya laa wola heyaa nyin, heyaa wola yaa nyin.
Ya waa toole he bambile ta.
N dɛ bol waa nɔ dɛɛ baɡle heyaa kɛŋɔ n ne n bii ken.
Ya dɛ nyin heya, anomanta, hé ɡe ta tea dɛɛ nyin yaa!
Korowii nɛra ne voɡtoroma bɛ pɛɛ wa He bɛ ɡel he ne nɛra baa wola Korowii waa lɛɛ la pɛ dɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛ darame bɛlbwa toole wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa baah.
Ɛrɛɛ bochaah ne biro ɛɛ ba wona pɛ a maɡre ɔ?
Yeesu Kristo ne Bɔnsam ɛɛ wonoo pɛ a maɡre aa?
Nɛra baa yarada Yeesu Kristo ne banɔ la baa wola on yaradae aa won pɛ a maɡre!
Voɡa ɛɛ wonoo che Korowii Dea a maɡre aa?
Ya bwadabii nɔɔ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la dea.
Anee Korowii ɡbabir bol la.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ba so n nɛra bee, dɛ́ do ba baah, dɛ́ ɛ Korowii baa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra.
Anomanta, n bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Hé le ba bini!
Hé pere he te le ba nɛɛ kwara!
He bɛ komɛlbwa waa kah doŋa leɡe, ásɛ n lɛ heya, dɛ́ ɛ he Mɛɛ, ásɛ he ɛ n bii.’ Men Nemenɛ Korowiirii bola.”
N dandɛɛɡa, yanee Korowii baɡɛ a ɡɛ nyoa nɔ bwa.
Anomanta, hé ɡel ya do kaih.
Yá laa ya bwadabii ne ya bambile kpɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ta.
Hé ɡel ya swɛɛ siwi dɛ do ɡoroŋ, ɔma yaa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii nomanta.
Pɔɔl silɛɛ wa Hé kpɔ he bambile tɛ yaa dɛɛ no ya wa.
Ya ta he bɛlbwa wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Ya ta bɛlbwa chɔɡɛ, ya ta bɛlbwa neɡrɛ di ɡe bwa.
Waa maa bola nɔ, pwaeh laa mɛɛ pwah heya.
Anee n faa bol la, ya dɛ nyin heyaa taeh.
Seo taa yoo, bokpeɡa taa yoo, ya ne heyaa.
He waa dɔ kasinteŋ n be.
He ɡelɔ n baŋa ɛɛ pa taeh.
Ya wenaale yaa dɛ na bwa habɔɔ la, n bwara ta hwaeh.
N sie ta dɛ lɛ taeh.
Yaa ba Makidoonia harɛ ta habɔɔ kwaraa la, ya bwara ta yaa sɔɔhnɛ.
Bobɛlbwa yaa kpɔ la, ya ne wahalaa.
Dɛ yoi laa nɛra ɛɛ yo yaa kwara naa, dɛ ya ne bambiwɔrɔbaa.
Kɛ Korowii aa dɛ larawe tebinichɔɡ te bwara la nomanta, Taetos bala la ɡelɔ ya dɔ bɔlarawa.
O bala la ɡbo laa larawe ya bwara.
O baa baɡle ɡɛ waa baa na heyaa o ɡbabir bambile sɔɔhno he wa.
O bolɔ ŋɔ n waa dɛ ɛ heya, dɛ ŋɔ waa n fa aa bola la ɡelɔ he tea bini chɔɡ.
O baɡle ɡɛ haa cheɡɛ n habɔɔ dɛ yo dɛɛ tɛ mɛ.
Anomanta, name kwaraa n sie lɛ kohona.
N fa aa chwerɛ heyaa tɔn he tea bini chɔɡ la, a we n nɛ.
Kɛ aa berɛ dɛɛ we n nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he tea bini ta chɔɡɛ la sie.
Kɛ taraken te n sie lɛo.
He tea bini aa chɔɡa waa laa n sie lɛ.
He tebinichɔɡ la aa ɡela he charɛ da la, a waa n sie lɛ.
Gɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ nyin kɛ nɛwɛnyini tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡ.
Anomanta, ya ta heyaa wechɔɡe bɛlbwa ɛɛ.
Nɛwɛnyini tea bini chɔɡɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin kɛ wɛɛ ɛ aa, a ɡelɔ wɛɛ charɛ o liire.
A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛɛ ba Korowii mkpa ne.
Anomanta, a ta chɛ kɛ ya ɡel ya tea bini chɔɡ a ta.
Kɛ harɛ bonɔ tebinichɔɡ te, seo nee aa ba.
Tebinichɔɡ Korowii aa dɛ nyin he dɔ laanee he dɔ la.
Hé na waa aa lea tɛ heya.
Hé na ɡɛ haa dɛ takapɔ, asɛ he siwi swɛɛ hɛɛ nyin he baɡle kɛ he ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Hé na ɡɛ he bwaawee aa ir wechɔɡa ta, hé na ɡɛ haa dɛ ɔmɛ.
A ɡelɔ he pɛla lawɛ yaa, asɛ he siwi swɛɛ waa aa toɡra ta.
A ɡelɔ he siwi swɛɛ nɛra baa wola wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ nɛɛ he tɛr ba deŋne.
He wono baɡle kɛ he ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ waa la ta.
Maa chwerɛ heyaa tɔn la la, a ta ɛɛ kɛ naate waa ɛ o dɔŋ wechɔɡa, kɛɛ naate o dɔŋ aa ɛo wechɔɡa waa n chwerɔ.
Korowii ɡba nao kɛ n chwerɔ ásɛ he won jemɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin yaa.
Anee larawe ya bwara.
A ɡbo laa.
Yaa na ɡɛ haa cha Taetos o dɔ silɛɛ la, a ɡelɔ ya sie lɛ.
N fa bol he waa Taetos be, dɛ kpɛɛ heya.
He ta ɡelɛ sihiih kpo mɛ.
Waa yaa bol he be la bwa ɛ kasinteŋ.
Gɛɛ waa yaa bol Taetos be dɛ kpɛɛ heyaa la bwa ɛ kasinteŋ.
O lii ɡɛ he bwa fa aa dɛ no o waa ne ɡɛ he fa aa dɛ tɛo duure dɛɛ ɛ yalayala la aa, dɛ o nyina waa dɛ nyin heyaa la, dɛ jae a na dɛɛ ja.
N sie lɛo kohona kɛŋɔ maa dɔ heyaa dɛ won kpɔ hwɛɡa do he nɛɛ wobɛlbwa ta nɔ.
Gɛ aa chɛ kɛ asɔre tena ɛɛ kɛ kwa Yabala, ya dɛ nyin he jemɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa sune Makidoonia asɔre tena nɛɛ dɛ cha ba ba dɔ bonya kohona.
Ba na wahala kɛrɛdɛ.
A lole kɛ nyaaraa ban kohona, kɛ ba sie aa lɛ Yeesu lɛɛ waa lɛɛ ba la ta kohona nomanta, ba wono ta suuɡa kohona asɛ ba kpɔ cha nɛra.
Mɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ ba ta tea tɛ yaa kwaa ɡɛ ba bokpeɡa aa tela, hale ba tɛo ɡwaa ba bokpeɡa del kwara.
Ba ɡbaɡba tetooraa ba ɛ ɡɛ, nɛn laa do ba.
Ba ɡbaɡbaa soŋe yaa sibeɡra ne ŋɔ yá ɡel ba ja Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la nɛ.
Ba ɛ waa dɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ ya te fe aa dɛ lii.
Ba tɔ sie kpɔ ba te do N Naa Korowii nɔn ta, mɔɔ dɛ kpɔ ba te do ya ɡe nɔn ta ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin.
Anomanta, ya ŋɔ Taetos be ŋɔ tondɛɛɡa nɔ soo waa pa a mun la, ó den ba choŋi a ta, ásɛ dɛ cha heyaa he ɛ wedɛɛɡa haa dɛ ɛ kwaa kɛɛ bɔr la ka tonɛ.
He dɛ ɛ waa Yeesu waa bwa ta, yarada ta, waa bola ta, wejema ta, ne nyina haa dɛ nyin nɛra chae ta, ne nyina haa dɛ nyin yaa la ta.
Anomanta, ya dɛ nyin kɛ hɛɛ ɛ waa kwaa kɛɛ ɡe ta.
N ta bolɛ dɛɛ bil a ɛ lao kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ kɛ.
N dɛ nyin n jemɛ kɛŋɔ he nɛnnyin la ɛ nɛnnyin kasinteŋ.
A waa n baɡle ɡɛ bane siwi aa swɛɛ kwaa kɛɛ ta la.
Kɛ he na ɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa sune ya nɛɛ dɛ cha yaa kenɛ?
He nao kɛŋɔ o fa dɔ kwaa nɔ bwa, dɛ koh he waa dɛ berɛ nya, ásɛ a che o nyae ta he berɛ dɔɔhna.
Gɛ n te aa naa kɛŋɔ hé den tonɛ waa haa pa a mun bena ken la.
Heyaa tɔ sie dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he dɛ nyin nɛra chae.
Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛ tonɛ warane.
Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛ tonɛ ɡɛ haa vɔrɔwa la.
Hé tɛ anɔ la haa dɔa.
Dɛ he bambile lawɔ kɛ hɛɛ tɛ suuɡaa yaa, ɡɛ bwa haa dɔa dɛ tɛ la, aa su Korowii siwii.
Waa ŋɔ hé tɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ haa dɔa.
Koeh laa n laa dɛɛ kpɔ bane nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ baa dawɛ he nɛ.
Haa dɔa kohona taraken nɔ, a wer kɛŋɔ he cha banɔ la aa kpeɡa tɛɛ ba.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, a baa do kpeɡri tɛ heyaa asɛ ba ɡe dɔ aa, baa cha heyaa.
Dɛ he bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
Anee ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini la.
“Naate waa pa kondikwaa kohona la, kondikwaa ta o nɛɛ ɡwaalɛ.
Naate waa wola kondikwaa pae kohona la, o ta kondikwaa nyae.” Taetos toma bwɛjen Kɔrent Ya dɛ jam Korowii kohona kɛŋɔ waa ɡela Taetos siwi swɛɛ wɛɛ cha heyaa kɛŋɔ ya siwi aa swɛɛ he nɛɛ la.
Waa yaa ŋɔa Táetos ɛ la, o sɛoh ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo.
Dɛ o siwi swɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ o cha heya, anomanta, o tetooraa o ba he be la.
Ya dɔŋ la asɔre tena bwa aa dɛ kpɛɛro Amanesoma la bola ta la, o ne Taetosee yaa tomɛ he be la.
A ɡbo laa, asɔre tena la bwaa leo ŋɔ ó ja ya nɛɛ ya kpɔ koŋkɛɛla nɔ kaa Jerusalam, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu dɔ sɔn.
Ya dɛ ɛ toma nɔ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ ya dɛ nyin Korowii nɛra chae.
Ya dɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ waane ba dɔ bol dɛ́ le ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyiŋi koŋkɛɛla damanta nɔ ta.
Waa aa swɛɛ ya siwi kɛŋɔ yaa ɛ laanee waa aa toɡra.
Waa aa toɡra Korowii be ɡbo laa yaa ba ɛɛ.
Yaa ɛ waa aa toɡraa nɛwɛnyini ɡe be.
A waa ya tomɛ ya dɔŋ ŋɔ ó ne ba ba la.
Ya daahno na kera aŋwɛnɛ bwa, dɛ na kɛŋɔ saŋ bɛlbwa la, o siwi swɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ o cha toma nɔ.
Taraken te kwaraa la, o siwi beɡrɔ kɛŋɔ ó cha heyaa kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o dɛ yarada heyaa kohona.
Taetos te la, n ne onee dɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ dɛɛ cha heya.
Yabala baa ja o nɛɛ la ɡe la, asɔre tenaa lee ba.
Ba nɛɛ Yeesu Kristo che dɔ sɔn.
Anomanta, hé ɡel ba na ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin nɛn, ásɛ asɔre tena bwa no, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ yaa koh he waa dɛɛ maŋkura ya te la, pɛɛ laa.
Asɔre tena dɔŋa chae A ta hiaih kwaraa kɛŋɔ n chwerɛ heyaa chae asɔre tena aa dɛ cha Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ do Juda harɛ la wa.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he te dɛ nyin ba chae.
Anomanta, n kpɔ heyaa maŋkura n te Makidoonia tena be taeh.
N ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Bena ken bwaa yabala baa lɔ Akaya harɛ la swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ nyin nɛra chae.” He siwi aa swɛɛra hɛɛ nyin nɛra chae la, a ɡelɔ ba kɛrɛdɛ ɡee nyin nɛra chae.
N dɛ tomɛ yabala nɔ he be.
N dɛ nyin kɛ he kpɔ he te dɛ ta suuɡa ɡɛ maa ŋɔa he dɛ ɛ la, ásɛ nɛra maa kpɔ heyaa dɛɛ maŋkura n te ba be la jemɛ kɛŋɔ pɛɛ laa mɛɛ maŋkura n te.
Makidoonia harɛ tena teŋɛ n nɛɛ ba dɛ ba na kɛŋɔ he ta he te kpɔe mɔɔ naa, dɛ sihiih ta he te kpoe yaa, sihiih ɛɛ kpo ya tenee, dɛ le ɡɛ yaa dɛ maŋkura heyaa la nomanta.
A waa n na kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ n soŋe yabala nɔ ásɛ ba tɔ sie n nɛɛ dɛ́ ba he be, dɛ́ ba lɛ koŋkɛɛla la haa ŋɔa hɛɛ tɛo la bwa cheɡ, ásɛ ya ne bala la, dɛ a bwa chemo, ásɛ a baɡle kɛ nyinaa hɛɛ nyin dɛ tɛ, lao laa.
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ he du tama aa, tamaa hɛɛ ba koma, he du kohona ɡe aa, kohonaa hɛɛ ba koma.
Anomanta, bɛ́lbwa tɛ ɡɛ aa maɡra o bambile ta.
Bɛlbwa nao kɛŋɔ o tɛo aa we o nɛɛ yaa, ó ɡel tɛɛ.
Bɛl dɛ lii kɛ doe ba doo ŋɔ o tɛ aa, ó ɡel, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tɛ kwaa bambile bwa ne la, Korowii sie dɛ lɛ o nɛ.
Korowiirii dɛ won tɛ heyaa kwaa a ɡwaa ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin, ásɛ he dɔ kohona saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ won kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa kohona.
Anee ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini la.
“Waa nɔn nyore, o dɛ tɛ nyaara tɛɛ tenten.
O wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta jaɡa dɔe.” Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyina kondwee baa du, dɛɛ tɛ kondikwa.
On dɛ tɛ heyaa kondwee haa dɛ nyin bwa, dɛ́ ɡel a le dɛ́ nɔnɛ kohona, dɛ́ ɡel he wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ɡe won dɛɛ ja.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ́ won ta tea dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɛra saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ nɛra warɛ pirim dɛ́ jam Korowii he koŋkɛɛla la yaa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la wa.
Dɛ ya kpɔ he koŋkɛɛla nɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɛra aa hiah ba aa, dɛ chae ɡbo laa hɛɛ cha ba.
Dɛ a cheɡɛ a ta nɛra kpɔ silɛɛ ɡee jam Korowii kohona.
He we-ɛɛla nɔ ɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra na he yarada haa dɔa, dɛ́ jam Korowii a wa.
Baa jam Korowiirii kɛŋɔ haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la haa ŋɔa he yaradaa la ta.
Nɛra ɛɛ jam Korowiirii kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa wola heyaa doe, asɛ he ɡbaɡba ta tea dɛ tɛ ba ne nomɛlbwa kwaa haa dɔa nɔ.
He waa ɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ a ɡɛ nɛra laanee, ásɛ ba dɛ soŋe Korowii aa, ba soŋe dɛɛ tɛ heya, he bonya Korowii aa ɡela he dɔ la nomanta.
Ya dɛ jam Korowii kohona.
Yaa won jemɛ baɡle o koŋkɛɛle damanta waa kɛ yaa la wa.
Gɛ Pɔɔl aa baɡle o toma wa Men Pɔɔl, n dɛ soŋe heya.
Ba ŋɔ n lɔ he be naa, n pwɛre, kɛ n le he be te naa, n waa kpeɡri.
N dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ hé nyiŋi ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa pwɛra o tea do som la, ásɛ dɛ no n be.
Mɛɛ baɡle kpeɡri nɛra baa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ harɛ bonɔ waa ŋwɛnɛre taa ya teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ ya waa la nɛɛ.
Maa nyin kɛ n baɡle a ɡɛ kpeɡri la he nɛ.
A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ harɛ bonɔɔ ya so.
Kɛ harɛ bonɔ laa laa yaa yo.
Dɔmkwaa yaa dɛ yo a ne la, nɛwɛnyina kwaa laa.
A ɛ Korowii dɔmkwaa o kpeɡri aa lɔ a ta, asɛ ya kpɔ dɛɛ paɡre dekpeɡa.
Nɛwɛnyina wejema baa dɛ maŋkuraa dɛɛ tɔŋle waa la, a ne webaɡla baa dɛ maŋkuraa kohona dɛɛ tɔŋle waa asɛ nɛra jemɛ Korowii kahonɛ la do kɛ dekpeɡa yaa dɛ ba wona paɡre la.
Ya berɔ dɔ kpeɡri dɛ won berɛ nomɛlbwa liire, asɛ ba no Yeesu Kristo be.
N kpɔ n te dɛ so dɛɛ kpa, ásɛ he te dɔɔ ba no n be ka tonaa, n tɛr nɛra baa vɛah la deŋne.
Haa waa kari kɛɛ?
Nomɛlbwa dɛ lii kɛ o ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛn aa, ó jemɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ waa ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛn la, ɡɛɛ ya ɡe ɛ Yeesu nɛra.
Dɛ n dɛ maŋkura kpeɡri ya Dɔɔ aa tɛ yaa ŋɔ yá kpɔ dɛɛ cha heyaa la aa, sihiih aa men kpo.
O tɛ mɛ kpeɡri ń won cha heya.
O ta men kpeɡri tɛɛ ń kpɔ chɔɡ heya.
Maa nyin kɛ a ɛ kɛŋɔ aahraa n kpɔ tɔne dɛɛ aah heya.
Bane ɛɛ ŋɔɔ, “Pɔɔl tɔne nyoa kpeɡri to.
Kɛ he na o ɡbaɡba aa, waa kpeɡe.
O wobol ɡba ta wale dɔe.” A ɡɛ tena nɔ, a chɛ kɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya toole he be naa, waa yaa chwera dɛɛ ha heyaa ta korɛ, asɛ waa yaa lɔ he be dɛɛ ɛ ɡe korɛ.
Yanee bamewa ya kpɔ ya te maɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ lii ba te nɛnjena ɔ?
Yaa ya nyu kpɔe dɛɛ bɔ ba.
Ba yon nyiŋi ba bala we-ɛɛla dɛ kpɔ maɡɛ ba kwaa dɛ ŋɔ ba kwaa toɡrɔ.
Ba ɡɛnɔ te!
Waa aa wola toole anɔ la Korowii aa ɡela yaa ɛ ta la, ya te aa anee kpɔ maŋkura ya te.
Anɔ la bwa waa maɡa tɛ yaa la, a ɡbo taa yaa ba ya te maŋkurae.
Toma yaa dɛ ɛ he be la ɡba ja anɔ la waa tɛ yaa la ta.
He be bala ja ya toma ta.
Yaa ba he be la, dɛ ya ta ɛɛ ka ɡarɛ.
Yaa kpɔ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la ba he be la, dɛ ya ta ɛɛ ka ɡarɛ ya toma jaɡa.
Yaa nyin kɛ ya ɡarɛ bela Korowii aa maɡa tɛ yaa.
Toma yaa ɛa la, anee ya kpɔ dɛɛ maŋkura ya te.
Toma nɛra bane aa ɛa la, yaa an kpɔe dɛɛ maŋkura ya te.
Ya dɔ hwɛɡa kɛ he yarada ɛɛ kaa siee, ásɛ toma yaa dɛ ɛ he bini la ɛɛ ja dɛ kaa sie.
A taa yaa ba wona bol Amanesoma la harɛre aa lɔ sie la ta, ásɛ dɛ bɛ waa nɛra bane aa ɛa kpɔ maŋkura ya te.
Anee ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini la.
“Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o te maŋkurae la, wɛɛ maŋkura o te waa Korowii aa ɛa ta.” Naate waa dɛ kpɛɛ o te la, o laa nɛndɛɛɡe.
Naate Korowii aa dɛ kpɛɛro la, onee nɛndɛɛɡe.
Pɔɔl ne nɛra baa ɛ ba te kɛ Yeesu toromaa ban wa N dɛ nyin he lawɛ bambile dɛ́ no n ɡɛnewaa nɔ tama.
Soŋaa mɛɛ soŋe heya.
He waa dɛ we n bwara kɛŋɔ he wa aa dɛ we Korowii nɛɛ la.
He do kɛ haah waa wola baa jemɛ bwa, asɛ n kpɔɔ tɛ baa bɛl yal ken.
Yeesu Kristo ɡbaɡbaa a ɡɛ baa nɔ, o ɡboo chɛ kɛ ó ɛ he jaa.
Kɛ n dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ Bɔnsam bɛ bɔr ba dɔ che dɛ́ berɛ he liire, ásɛ he bɛ Yeesu Kristo dɛɛ nyin tepoŋ ne kpa, kɛŋɔ waa berɛ harɛkon dɛ kpɔ nyosone neɡre Hawa la.
Kɛ he dɛ lawɛ bambile dɛɛ no nɛra baa ba he be dɛ baa baɡle Yeesu waa a korɛ waa ya fa aa baɡle heyaa la ta nɔ?
Kɛ ba dɛ baɡle kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ waa a korɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa soɡe he nɛɛ la ta, kɛɛ ba dɛ baɡle heyaa amanesoma a korɛ anɔ la ya fa aa baɡle heyaa la ta naa, he dɛ lawɛ bambile dɛɛ no ba be nɔ?
Maa lii kɛ nɛra baa dɛ maŋkura ba te kɛ ba ɡwaa Yeesu Kristo toroma la ɡwaa mɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
Bɛl lole n nyoa ken ta chaahnɛ wobol ta, kɛ wejema te, n dɔɔ.
Wobɛlbwa yaa jema ɡe la, ya ɡelɔ a bini chaah he jemɛ a bwa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
N fa aa baɡle heyaa Korowii Amanesoma la, n ta heyaa komɛlbwa sese lɛɛ.
Maa pwɛr n te ɡɛ asɛ nɛra siwi ɛɛ su heyaa la, dɛ wechɔɡaa n ɛ aa?
Maa dɛ ɛ toma he be la, dɛ bobɛl asɔre tenaa dɛɛ bɔ mɛ kem.
He nyiŋo na naa, dɛ a kaa ɛ kɛ maa ŋwɛɛ ba, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ cha heya.
Gɛ saŋ maa lɔ he be la, suuɡa waa hiah mɛ naa, maa n te kpɔe dɛɛ dawɛ he nɛ.
Yabala baa le Makidoonia harɛ ba laanee baa tɛ mɛ kwaa maa dɛ nyin bwa.
Gɛ n fa aa wola n te kpɔe dawɛ he nɛɛ wubwa la, ɡɛɛ maa wola n tenee kpɔ dawɛ he nɛɛ saŋ bɛlbwa bwa.
N cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo kasinteŋ la waa ɡela n dɔ la ta dɛɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, nomɛlbwa toole Akaya harɛ bobɛlbwa dɛ́ tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa wola won maŋkura n te a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ ken nɔ, a ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ maa heyaa nyin.
Korowii ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin heya.
Waa maa dɛ ɛ nɔ, maa a ɛɛ ɡela ba.
Mɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛɛ, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ maŋkura ba te ŋɔ tombeŋkpoŋii ya ne baa ɛ la bɛ won dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ maŋkura ba te.
A ɡɛ nɛra la, Yeesu Kristo toroma ɡbaɡba laa ban.
Neɡraa baa neɡre nɛra, dɛ ɛ ba te kɛ Yeesu Kristo toromaa ban la.
A ta nyokpowaa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ Bɔnsam ɡbabir won o te beɡra dɛ do kɛ Korowii nyundua torome tenten ken.
Anomanta, dɛ Bɔnsam bonɔɔna ɡe beɡre ba te kɛŋɔ, banee dɛɛ chaɡle ŋwɛnɛ yaa kpɔ o ta dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi aa, dɛ a ta nyokpowaa ɛɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ bɔ ba kemee ɡɛ ba toma aa doa.
Pɔɔl dɛ maŋkura o te kɛ o ɛ Yeesu torome N dɛ ŋɔ he be ja.
Nomɛlbwa bɛ lii kɛŋɔ ɡɛnee men.
N ɡɛnɔ ɡba kwara naa, hɛ́ɛ no n be ásɛ n ɡe won maŋkura n te tama.
N jemɔ kɛ waa maa dɛ bol taraken nɔ, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu laa ŋɔa ń bola.
Maŋkurae nɔ maa dɛ maŋkura n te nɔ, ɡɛnewaa mɛɛ ɛ la.
Bane aa koh harɛ bonɔ kwara waa dɛɛ maŋkura ba te nomanta, n ɡee maŋkura n tenee.
Haa jemɛ waa kohona nomanta, he dɛ lawɛ bambile, dɛ kpɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ no ɡɛna be.
Nɛra kpɔ heyaa berɛ yoma, dɛ neɡre heyaa dɛɛ di, dɛɛ faah heya, dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyu baahna, dɛɛ kpaa he lwɛrɛme, kɛ he waane laa.
A dɛ ɛɛ mɛ sihiih kɛ n bol waa nɔ.
N ta jemɛ kɛ ya berɔ do pwɛre tɛ heyaa to.
Ya ta an kɛrɛdɛ ɛɛ.
Dɛ nomɛl dɔ wobɛl dɛ won koh a waa maŋkura o te naa, n ɡba ɛɛ wonoo maŋkura n te a ɡɛ waa la ta.
Gɛnewaa mɛɛ bol nɔ te.
Dɛ Hibru tenaa ban aa, bɛlee n ɡe.
Israel tena ɡee ban aa, bɛlee n ɡba.
Abraham naanaree ban aa, bɛlee n ɡe.
Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔnaa ban kɛɛ?
N dɛ bol choɡla wobol te, kɛ dɛ ba ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔna aa, n ɛ o bonɔɔ ɡwaa ba!
N ɛ toma ɡwaa ba.
Ba do mɛ dea ɡwaa ba, dɛ cha mɛ chweremi ɡwaa ba.
Waa maa naa a yon ka jɛɛ n sewɛ warɔ.
Kera anue bwaa Juu tena cha mɛ ba chweremi fifraatoro dɛ anuanaarɛ la.
Kera atoroo Rom tena lɔɔ mɛ chweremi ne, dɛ foɡ mɛ bwea kera beŋkpoŋ.
Kera atoroo stiimae morɛ n ne.
N lɔ nee siebɔr bir dɛ chaah, dɛ kwaa bir a ɡɛ stiimae mora nɔ bɛl ta.
N ɡaaɡebala nɔ ta la, neerare suuɡo dɛ tɔ mɛ do, n do siswɛm ta ka, asɛ ŋwɛɛra baa dɛ kpo nɛra dɛɛ kpɔ ba laala ɡe fe ɛɛ nyin n kpoe.
N bala Juu tena ne nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bwa ɡe cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛ fe ɛɛ nyin n kpoe.
Bwɛjena ta ne kpɔɡ baah ne mpo ta bwaa n na sibeɡrewa.
N na sibeɡrewaa nɛra baa wola asɔre tena kpelakpela ɛɛ be.
N ɛ toma dɛ koh kɛrɛdɛ.
A kɛrɛdɛ ta, dɛ maa dom chɔ.
Lɔr ne nyɔɡre ɡe kpo mɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
N vala kɛrɛdɛ ta, dɛ teloɡaa mɛɛ chɔ, dɛ busee mɛɛ chɔ, dɛɛ chɔ waa.
Anɔ te bwa chɔ keŋkeŋ.
Maa won baɡle a bwa.
Waa aa lɔ n bini dɛɛ swɛɛ n siwi laanee kɛŋɔ, asɔre tena baa lɔ bobɛlbwa la waa dɛɛ ha mɛ tɔpere te bwa.
Asɔre tena la bɛlbwa sɔɔhnaa, dɛ n ɡbabir bwara yɔrɔ.
Dɛ Bɔnsam neɡre bɛlbwa kaa wechɔɡa ta naa, dɛ a ɛɛ mɛ bandia.
Dɛ mɛɛ maŋkura n tenee yaa, waa aa dɛ chaɡle kɛ n ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre la taa mɛɛ ba n te maŋkurae.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Mɛɛ Korowii jemɔ kɛ nyosone laa mɛɛ teŋe.
O chɛ kpɛɛra saŋ bɛlbwa.
Maa lɔ bwɛjen Damaskɔs la, bwɛɛ la nomoa waa lɔ Kooro Aretas lɔɡa le nɛra ŋɔ báa daah doonyoone aa lɔ danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛɛ la bwa cheme ta la, ásɛ dɛ laɡ mɛ.
Aa ba ɡɛ la, n daamanar bane do mɛ wɛɡrɛjen bini dɛ do ŋwɛn o ta kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ta kɔlɔŋ ken, dɛ che danjwɛɛ la tokoro bɛl ta dɛ kpɔ mɛ tu dahara, asɛ n le o nɔn ta.
Pɔɔl wepila ne chaahna waa naa A chɛ kɛ n maŋkura n te.
N jemɔ kɛ aa wobɛlbwa kwaa te.
Mɛɛ baɡle chaahna Korowii aa ɡela n na, ne waa waa pila baɡ mɛ.
N jemɛ asɔre te baa bɛl.
Dɛ ɛ bene fi dɛ anaarɛɛ nɔ Korowii aa keeru kaa o be nyundujaɡla.
Dɛ o nɛndaa ɡbabirii kaa nyundua oo, dɛ o lileo ɡboo kaa bela oo, maa jemɛ.
Korowii ɡboo jema.
N jemɔ kɛ ba lawɔ kaa nyundua, kɛ anee n bol la, o nɛndaa ɡbabirii kaa bela oo, dɛ o lileo ɡboo kaa bela oo, Korowii ɡboo jema.
Korowii la o ne o be, o ka no waane nɛwɛnyini aa wola won bola.
Korowii ta ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ kɛ nɛwɛnyini bola.
N ŋɔ n maŋkura n te naa, ɡɛ nɛn nɔɔ mɛɛ ba kpɔe maŋkura n te.
Maa n ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛlaa kpɔ maŋkura n te, nemenɛ n nɛŋɡwɛɡre ɛɛ ɡbo ta.
Dɛ n ŋɔ ń kpɔ n ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla maŋkura n te kwaraa naa, ɡɛnewaa laa te, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɛ kasinteŋ.
Menee ɡɛ nɛn la, kɛ maa nyin n kpɔ ɡɛ waa la maŋkura n te.
Dɛ n waa maa dɛ ɛ nɛra ɛɛ na, ne anɔ la baa dɛ no ta laa aa, maa nyin kɛ nɛra kpɛɛ mɛ wobɛlbwa ta.
Korowii aa nyin kɛ n kpɔ wejena maa naa chaahna ta la dɛɛ maŋkura n te.
Anomanta, o ɡelɔ Bɔnsam kpɔ waane do n nɛɛ aa ha mɛ, dɛɛ tɔɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ sɔɔh, n bɛ won dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo.
Kera atoro bwaa n soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ o laa a ɡɛ waa nɔ kpɔ n nɛ, asɛ o ŋɔ, “Chae maa sune he nɛɛ dɛ chae nɔ ɡbo maɡre he ne.
Bela nɛn aa ɡwɛɡra la, belaa baa na n kpeɡri kohona.” Anomanta, a do n som kohona kɛ maa dɛ maŋkura n te n ɡwɛɡra ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a taa mɛɛ na Yeesu Kristo kpeɡri n nɛ.
N sie dɛ lɛ n ɡwɛɡra maa ɡwɛɡra, ne chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡ mɛ, ne kpeɡri bɔr yon do tɛ mɛ, ne cheɡa nɛra aa cheɡɛ n nɛ, ne ɡɛ maa koh Yeesu Kristo waa aa noo mɛ bwa ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ maa ɡwɛɡre la, a taa mɛɛ do kpeɡri.
Gɛ Pɔɔl siwi aa swɛɛ Kɔrent tena nɛ N bol waa kɛ ɡɛne, kɛ heyaa ɡela n ɛ ɡɛ.
Heyaa chɛ kɛ hé fe ɛɛ tɛ mɛ sɔn.
A lole kɛ n waa aa bobɛlbwa tel te, kɛ nɛra baa dɛ maŋkura ba te ɡwaa Yeesu Kristo toroma la, ba bɛlbwa ta men ɡwaalɛ wobɛlbwa ta.
N fa aa lɔ he be la, n lawɛ bambile kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa aa chaɡla kɛŋɔ Yeesu toroma la bɛlee men.
Wekpeɡa ne nyokpowaa bwaa n ɛ. Bɔkwaa n ɛ tɛ asɔre tena baa kaa la maa wola ɛɛ tɛ heya ɔ?
Anɔ la maa wola heyaa ɛɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, n ta heyaa hae suuɡa waa ta.
Hé kpɔ n wechɔɡa kɛ mɛ!
N tooro tenaa nɔ maa kpɔ n te dɛɛ ba he be bala dɛ́ ba chɔɔ heya.
Maa heyaa komɛlbwa bɔɔra ba.
He waa hiah mɛ, he suuɡa laa hiah mɛ.
Bechale ne ba mɛɛ, umee dɛɛ nyiŋi o dɔŋ ɔ?
N sie ɛɛ lɛo kɛŋɔ n chɔɡ n komɛlbwa he nɛ.
N chɔɡ n bokpeɡa he nɛɛ kwara dɛ won cha heya aa, a som n be.
Maa dɛ nyin heyaa kohona waa he te laa n waa kpɔ he bambile ta kɛɛ?
He nao kɛŋɔ n ta n te kpɔe dawɛ he nɛɛ kenɛ?
Kɛ nomɛl ɡee ŋɔɔ n sie pilo to mɛɛ neɡre heya.
Nɛra n fa aa tom ba he be la, n cheɡɛ ba bini bane nɛɛ dɛ neɡre heyaa di aa?
Men soŋe Taetos dɛ tomɛ o ne ya dɔŋ asɔre te la he be.
Hɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ Taetos baa neɡre heyaa di aa?
Dabeŋkpoŋ laa n ne o kpoŋaa?
Ya bwa we-ɛɛla ta beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ yaa?
Yaa dɛ ŋɔ ken nɔ, he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ya sɔnee yaa kwaa he be kɛɛ?
Akai!
Korowii siee yaa bola, pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la nomanta.
Yabala, wobɛlbwa yaa bol la, he wer waa yaa bola, ásɛ he won che kiŋkiŋ.
N dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ n balaa, ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin kɛ he do la, maa heyaa ɡɛɛ na, ɡɛ he ɡe aa dɛ nyin kɛ n do la, haa men ɡɛɛ na.
N dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ mɛɛ ba na naɡra, ne bɔweela, ne bandisale, ne n ɡbo dɔ, ne dɔŋa chɛɡra, ne dɔŋa ŋwala, ne mbarafo dɛ wesaɡasaɡare ɛɛ he baahnee.
Maa nyin kɛ ń ba ba he be ásɛ N Naa Korowii koh he wechɔɡa waa dɛ́ ɡel n fɛɡre.
N balɔ dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ta warɛ he bini, ba tea bini ta chɔɡɛ ba charɛ ba liire ba wedoŋa, ne ba jwamane, ne ba pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla baa dɛɛ ɛ ta naa, n tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡoo.
Jae ne kala aa ka mun N tooro tenaa nɔ maa dɛ ba ń ba chɔɔ heya.
N balaa, wobɛlbwa nɛra banɛ kɛɛ nɛra batoro aa di danseɛ a ta la, anee mɛɛ ba noe kɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ, ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn aa baɡla la.
N dɛ nyin n ŋɔ he banɔ la he fa aa ɛ wechɔɡa la, ne banɔ la baa kaa la be ŋɔ, n balɔ dɛ he ta ɡelaa, maa he ɡela ba, mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee.
N fa aa ba he be nɛɛtena la, n bolɔ, n kwaarɔ dɛɛ bol.
He fa dɛ nyin he na waane dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristoo soɡe n nɛɛ dɛɛ bol waa la.
Too, hɛɛ nao.
Kpeɡri ta on nyae.
Wɛɛ baɡle o kpeɡri he nɛɛ.
Ba fa aa kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta o sewɛ la, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ o ɡwɛɡrɔ, kɛ Korowii kpeɡri nomanta, o iro.
Ya ne o bwa fa pɛo ɡwɛɡre.
Kɛ taraken, ya cheɡɛ Korowii kpeɡri ta dɛ dɔ mkpa, asɛ ya won do he be o kpeɡri la ta.
Hé nyiŋi he te dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ he yaradao kɛrɛdɛ kɛɛ he ta on yaradae yɔ?
Hé pese he te dɛ́ na.
He jemɛ kɛŋɔ he ne Yeesu Kristo pɛo kɛɛ?
He nao kɛŋɔ he ne o ta pɛɛ te naa, ate dɛ he horɛ o waa yaradae ta.
N dɛ lii kɛŋɔ he nyiŋi yaa na naa, hɛɛ jemɔɔ kɛŋɔ yaa o waa yaradae ta horɛ.
Kɛ, ya dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ he bɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ ɛ. Nɛra nao kɛŋɔ ya ta horaa, a wer, kɛ a laa hiah.
Waa aa hiah kɛŋɔ hé ɛ waa aa wera.
Dɛ a ɡelɔ a do kɛŋɔ ya te horaa, a ta waane ɛɛ.
Yaa won ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ́ jo kasinteŋ la nɛ, chae a chɛ kɛ yaa chao.
Ya ɡwɛɡrɔ hé do kpeɡri aa, dɛ ya sie lɛo.
Ya dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ he waa toɡre ka tonɛ.
A waa n chwerɛ heyaa tɔn nɔ dɛ n ta he be balɛ mɔɔ la.
N dɛ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ dɛ bɛ sinyɛɡa ba kpɔ dɛɛ bol waa he be kpeɡri ya Dɔɔ la aa tɛ mɛ la ne.
Korowii ŋɔ ń kpɔ a ɡɛ kpeɡri nɔ cha heya, o ta ŋɔe ŋɔ ń kpɔ chɔɡ heya.
Too, yabala, n nyoa jaɡɛ bonɔ.
Hé so kɛrɛdɛ.
Hé swɛɛ siwi kɛ hɛɛ ɡeloo he wobɛlbwa toɡre ka tonɛ.
Hé no n waa maa bola dɛ kpɔ ja heyaa la.
Hé ɡel he nyoa pɛ, he bɛ dɛɛ yo.
Korowii waa dɛ nyin nɛwɛnyini kohona dɛɛ tɛ bosɔɔhna la, ó cha heya.
Hɛ́ɛ lea dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nyabii.
Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ do bonɔ bwa dɛ na heya.
Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo na he sum dɛɛ cha heya, Kórowii baɡle o nyina he nɛ, ásɛ Kórowii Domadɛɛɡe la ne he bwa pɛ.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn nɔ ka tɛ nɛra baa lɔ Galaasia asɔre ta, ásɛ ba won berɛ baa teŋɛ kasinteŋ Amanesoma la ta kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ ban ba neɡre.
Dɛ nɛra bane ba dɛ baɡle ŋɔ Kristo tena chɛ kɛŋɔ bá teŋɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔobene Mmara la ta, mɔɔ Korowii lɛɛ ba.
Pɔɔl baɡle a bini kɛŋɔ, ŋwɛnɛ beŋkpoŋ nɛn aa kpɔ o ta o ne Korowii do kɛrɛdɛ la, onee kɛ naate won yarada Yeesu baa kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta la.
Korowii Mmarare la ɡelɔ ya jemɛ ɡɛ wechɔɡa aa doa, ne kpeɡri aa dɛ di ya nɛ, kɛ aa won lɛ yaa.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la tomaa kɛ ó ɡel ya yarada Yeesu, ásɛ dɛ cha yaa ya won tomɔ ya soɡa bini.
Men Pɔɔl maa ɛ Yeesu torome la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
Nɛwɛnyini laa lee mɛ dɛ tɛ mɛ toma nɔ.
Yeesu Kristo ne o Mɛɛ Korowii waa iru seo ta laanee lee mɛ.
N ne yabala baa lɔ n be bonɔ nɔ bwaa chwera dɛɛ tɛ asɔre tena haa lɔ Galaasia harɛ ta bwa.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Ya Dɔɔ ɛ N Naa Korowii tetoowa kɛŋɔ, waa koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ sewɛ, dɛ lɛ yaa le taraken nɛra baa dɔ liichɔɡa bini nɔ.
Korowii chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ jirima tɛo saŋ te bɛlbwa.
Aamen.
Yeesu Kristo amanesoma bwa lɔ beŋkpoŋ He waa ɛɛ mɛ anebɛlbwa.
Korowiirii le heya.
Yeesu Kristo aa sune he nɛɛ dɛ lɛ heyaa la waa Korowii le heya.
Kɛ he deno dɛɛ vɛh Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la dɛɛ teŋɛ wefale ta.
Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma bɛlbwa toole, dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ, dɛ ja anɔ la yaa dɛ baɡle heyaa la ta.
Nɛra bane dɛ wili heya, dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ berɛ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la, a waa n ŋɔ ɡɛ la.
Dɛ ya bini bɛl kɛɛ Korowii nyundua torome le nyundua dɛ ba bol Yeesu Kristo bwara wobɛlbwa a berɛ korɛ anɔ la yaa dɛ baɡle heyaa la ta naa, Kórowii fuuh!
Gɛ ya fa aa bola la, ɡɛɛ mɛɛ bol he be ja la.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma bɛlbwa a korɛ anɔ la he fa aa noa dɛ yarada la ta naa, Kórowii fuuh!
Maa ŋɔ ken nɔ, dɛ nɛwɛnyini bee mɛɛ nyin sɔn kɛɛ Korowii be nɔ?
Maa sɔn nyin nɛwɛnyini be, Korowii bee mɛɛ nyin sɔn.
Dɛ nɛwɛnyini bee mɛɛ nyin sɔn te naa, n fe ta Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ ɛɛ.
Gɛ Pɔɔl aa baa ɛ Yeesu torome Yabala, hé ɡel n ŋɔ he be ŋɔ Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma nɔ maa dɛ bol he be nɔ, nɛwɛnyini be laa a le.
Nɛwɛnyini laa tɛ mɛ ɡɛ wejema nɔ.
Nɛwɛnyini laa baɡ mɛ.
Yeesu Kristo ɡbaɡbaa pili a bini baɡ mɛ dɛ ɡel n jemɛ a wa.
Gɛ saŋ n fa aa dɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ Juu tena aa dɛ tomɔ la, he noɔ ɡɛ n fa aa dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta dɛ che asɔre tena baa dɛ tomɔ nɛ, dɛɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa tenten, dɛɛ nyin dɛ́ chɔɡ ba toma bwa.
Dɛ n dɛ teŋɛ ya Juu tena Korowii toma ŋwɛnɛ la ta ɡwaa n nyudɔŋa baa ɛ Juu tena kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ ya Juu tena nawee waa ɡe ta ɡwaa nomɛlbwa.
Kɛ Korowii te lee mɛ kwaraa mɔɔ ba lol mɛ, asɛ dɛ sune n nɛɛ dɛ cha mɛ, dɛ kpɔ mɛ do toma nɔ ta.
A ɛo silɛɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel n jemɛ o Bie la, dɛ́ won baɡle o Amanesoma nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la be.
Waa lee mɛ ɡɛ la, n ta taarɛ baɡle nomɛlbwa ŋɔ ó baɡ mɛ ɡɛ maa ɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ jo o toma la ta.
N ta Jerusalam laŋɛ dɛ ka na nɛra baa tɔ sie ɛ Yeesu toroma n nɛɛ la mɔɔ.
Pae n den pa sie kaa Arab harɛ.
Maa le bela la, n baa kaa Damaskɔs.
A habɔɔ bene atoroo mɔɔ n la Pita be Jerusalam dɛ ka chɔɔro dɛ jemɔ.
Maa la Pita chɔɔra la, n kaa so o be tɔpera fi dɛ anue.
N ta Yeesu toroma la bɛlbwa nae bela ka ja Pita nɛ.
Jems waa ɛ ya Dɔɔ la nime la ɡee n berɛ na ja Pita nɛ.
Kasinteŋii mɛɛ chwerɛ la.
Korowii ɡba jemɔ kɛ nyosone laa.
A habɔɔ la, n la Siiria harɛ ne Silisia harɛ bwɛɛre ane ta.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ Juda harɛ asɔre tena la ta men nae siwi ne mɔɔ.
Dɛ n waa nɛra aa dɛ bol la ɡboo baa no.
N waa baa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, nɛn o fa aa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa laanee bera lɛ Yeesu Amanesoma ba fa aa yaradaa o koh a waa hah ba dɛɛ nyin ba kpoe la dɛɛ bol la.
Ba cheɡɛ a ta dɛ jam Korowii a wa.
Pɔɔl ne Yeesu toroma bane wa A habɔɔ bene fi dɛ anaarɛ la, n berɔ la Jerusalam ja.
N kpɔ Taetos ja n nɛ, asɛ ya ne Banabas la.
Korowiirii ɡela n jemɛ dɛ la ba be.
N tɔ sie la asɔre tena nomonome be n ne ba ɡbo so, n baɡle Yeesu Amanesoma maa dɛ bol nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ be la bwa ásɛ ba jemɛ n wa, ásɛ n toma maa ɛa ne anɔ la n ta aa dɛ ba ɛɛ la bɛ pɛɛ ɛ. Dɛ Grik tee Taetos, anomanta, o ta pen teŋe.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa ta on hɛɛ ŋɔ bá teŋe o pen.
Dɛ nɛra la bane tea bini laa ɡɛ baa ɡel Taetos la.
Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ dɛ ɛ ba te kɛŋɔ asɔre tenaa ban ken dɛ sɔh jo ya bini, dɛ baa nyiŋi dɛ́ jemɛ ya asɔre tena dɔe yaa dɔ ya te Mosis Mmara aa wola yaa vɔrɔwe la bini, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo toma nomanta, ya ne o ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Dɛ ba dɛ nyin ba hɛ yaa yá berɛ dɛɛ ɛ waa yaa vɛah la.
Yaa wola nyin kɛ bá won berɛ Amanesoma la sie ásɛ kasinteŋ la do le tɛ heyaa la, ya ta ban sie tɛɛ kwaraa.
Nɛra la bini banɔ la baa dɛ lii ba nɛnjena la ta wone dɔ wobɛlbwa bol dɛ ja Amanesoma maa dɛ bol la ta.
N te kwaraa waane laa ba nɛnjena ɛɛ wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii aa nɛnjena kɛɛ nɛnjeɡre nyiŋi.
Ba ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ Korowiirii kpɔ o waa la tɛ mɛ ŋɔ ń bol nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la be, ɡɛ waa kpɔ o waa tɛ Pita ŋɔ ó bol Juu tena be la.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡle o kpeɡri Yeesu torome Pita nɛɛ wɛɛ tomɛ Juu tena bini la, ɡɛɛ o baɡle o kpeɡri men maa ɛ Yeesu torome nɔ nɛɛ mɛɛ tomɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bini.
Jems ne Pita dɛ Jɔn nomɛlbwa aa dɛ yer ba asɔre tena nomonome la, ba ɡbabir sɛoh kɛŋɔ Korowiirii kpɔ ɡɛ toma nɔ do n nɔn ta, dɛ cha mɛ a ta.
Anomanta, ba do nɔɔra n nɔn ta, dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ nɛmbeŋkpoŋii ya bwa Korowii toma nɔ bini.
Ya nyoa pɛo, asɛ ba sɛh kɛŋɔ n ne Banabas ɛɛ bol Yeesu waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, ásɛ ba ɡee baɡle Juu tena.
Waa baa bola ja bwaa kɛŋɔ yáa lii nyaara waa dɛ́ɛ cha ba.
Dɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ waa n ɡe aa swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛa wubwa.
Pɔɔl di Pita kasinteŋ Pita aa ba Anteɔk la, n diu kasinteŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o dɛ ɛ waa aa wola aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ.
Jems fa tomɛ nɛra bane Anteɔk.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ aa wola Anteɔk balɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ Pita ne asɔre tena la bini bane baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la pɛo dɛɛ di kwa.
Kɛ Jems toroma la aa baa jo Anteɔk la, Pita chwa a ɡɛ nɛra la be kwaa dii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ, hɔɔhra la bɛ ba ŋɔ waa Juu tena nawee wa aa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ ba ne nɛra baa wola pena teŋni aa kwaa di la ta teŋɛ.
Pita koh nɛra siebɔr ɔma waa dɛ nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ.
Yabala Juu tena baa ɛ asɔre tena la kar la ɡe koh nɛra siebɔr ɔma waa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ Pita aa ɛa la.
Banabas ɡba nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ teŋɛ ba nɛ.
Maa naa kɛŋɔ ba nyoɡre Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la ŋwɛnɛ la, n di Pita kasinteŋ yabala la bwa siwi ta ŋɔ, “Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa a che he ɛ Juu te haa wola Juu tena nawee waa la ta teŋɛ, dɛ ŋɔ he hamɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ ŋɔ báa teŋɛ a ta nɔ?
Ya te nɔ, Juu tena ɛ ya nyare ne ya mɛɛnanar ba lolɛ yaa, asɛ ya ɡe ɛ Juu tena.
Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ asɛ Juu tena ɛɛ yer ba ‘wechɔɡ-ɛɛra’ la laa yaa.
Kɛ, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Mosis Mmara ta teŋa laa ɡela nɛn ɛɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi, nemenɛ kɛŋɔ haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo waa la, dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo.
Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ ya ɡe kpɔ ya yarada do, asɛ Korowii koh o waa dɛ lɛ yaa kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi.
Mmara ta teŋa laa dɛɛ ba yaa nɛndɛɛɡa ɛɛ Korowii be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Mmara ta teŋa aa won ɡel nomɛlbwa waa su Korowii siwi.
Yaa dɛ nyin ya che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su Korowii siwi la, an ɡela ya vɛh Mmara ta teŋa dɛ berɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la.
Dɛ a do ɡɛ naa, dɛ Yeesu Kristoo dɛɛ cha dɛ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ won dɛɛ kaa sie naa?
Akai!
Mosis Mmara n ɡbaɡba fa aa ŋɔa o ta teŋa ta tɔnɔ dɔe la, dɛ n berɔ berɛ habɔɔ dɛ baa teŋɛ o ta naa, n ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ yaa?
A ɡɛ Mmara laanee pili n sie dɛ ɡel n jemɛ waa dɛ chwa o ta teŋa.
Mosis Mmara la te be pera te naa, n do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa sewa.
N ne Mmara la toole wobɛlbwa bini kpa, ásɛ n won do le tɛ Korowii.
Baa kpaa Yeesu Kristo pɛl o daɡaɡre ta la, a kaa ɛ kɛ n ne onee sewa.
Anomanta, n soɡa nɔ maa soɡa nɔ, n ɡbaɡba laa dɛɛ hwee nɔ.
Korowii Bie Yeesu Kristoo soɡe n nɛɛ dɛɛ hwee la.
N hweera nɔ maa dɛ hwee nɔ, yarada maa yaradao la, anee ɡela n do le la.
Korowii Bie nɔ nyin mɛ kohona dɛ kpɔ o hweera charɛ n nyu.
Maa sɛh ɡel Korowii nɛra nɛɛ suna la ɛ pɛɛ.
Dɛ Mosis Mmara ta teŋa taa a che nɛn ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su Korowii siwi aa, amɔ te dɛ pɛɛpɛɛ Yeesu Kristo sewɛ la.”
Yarada kɛɛ Mmara ta teŋa Ee, Galaasia tena, he ɡɛnoo!
Ya ta heyaa baɡlɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa Yeesu Kristo sewɛ daɡaɡre ta bwa naa?
Aah bɔkwaa bera neɡre heyaa jaɔ?
Hé ɡel n bɔɔ heyaa webeŋkpoŋ.
Mosis Mmara ta teŋa taa a che he dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa, kɛɛ haa no Yeesu Kristo waa la dɛ yaradaa taa a che nɔ?
He ɡɛnɔ ɡa!
Korowii Domadɛɛɡee ɡela he won pa mun Yeesu nɛɛ teŋa ta.
Ɛrɛɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he kpɔ he ɡbaɡba kpeɡri ɛ ka tonɛ nɔɔ?
Amɔ waa he sie aa naa ne anɔ la haa noa la bwa ɛ pɛɛ aa?
Dɛ a ɛ pɛɛ te naa, dɛ aa were kwaraa!
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe nɔ waa tɛ heya, dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa he bini nɔ, dɛ Mosis Mmara ta teŋa waa o ɛ a bwa kɛɛ haa dɛ no o waa dɛ yaradaa la waa yɔ?
