Hé nyiŋi Abraham na.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “O yarada Korowii, asɛ Korowii che o yarada la ta dɛ lɛo kɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi.” A chɛ kɛ hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ yarada Korowii la, banee Abraham naanar.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ yarada taa aa ba cheɡa ásɛ Korowii lɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su o siwi.
Korowii fa bol Amanesoma la waa Abraham be dɛ ŋɔ, “He nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa Korowii swee nɛwɛnyina bwa andɛɛɡa.” Yaradaa Abraham yarada Korowii asɛ o swee andɛɛɡa tɛo.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa yarada Korowii la, Korowii ɛɛ sweero andɛɛɡaa.
Nɛra baa kpɔ sie dawɛ Mosis Mmara ɡbo ta kɛŋɔ a taa ba che Kórowii lɛɛ ba la, bá bwɛɛlɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a lɔ Korowii Tɔn bini kɛŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa koni Mosis Mmara la bɛlbwa saŋ bɛlbwa wee la, ó bwɛɛlɛ.” Taraken nɔ, ya nao kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa won che Mosis Mmara la ta dɛ́ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su Korowii siwi, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa won teŋɛ a bwa ta.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Naate o wa aa toɡra dɛ su Korowii siwi la, wɛɛ yaradao dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.” Nɛn waa dɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara ta la, yarada laa dɛɛ ba o lɛɛ.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa wona dɛɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara la bwa ta la, on dɛɛ ba o nyu dɔe.” Yeesu Kristo lɛ nyotaahna aa lɔ Mosis Mmara la ta bɛ won teŋa la dawɛ o nɛɛ dɛ lɛ yaa le a ta.
Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa baa saɡɔ daa ta la, Korowii nyotaahna lɔ o nɛ.” Korowii fa baɡɛ Abraham nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ sweero andɛɛɡaa.
Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ dɔ a ɡɛ wedɛɛɡe nɔ la, a waa o lɛ nyotaahna la dawɛ o nɛɛ dɛ lɛ yaa le a ta la, ásɛ a che yarada ta Korowii tɛ yaa o Domadɛɛɡe la waa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tɛ yaa la.
Mosis Mmara ne Korowii nyobaɡa Yabala, hé ɡel n kpɔ harɛ bonɔ waane maɡɛ waa nɔ maa dɛ bol nɔ.
Dɛ nɛra banɛ fɔwɛ fɔo o do kpeɡri aa, nɛmpɛɛ aa won puru ba habɔɔ, nomɛlbwa ɡe aa berɛ won berɔ ba habɔɔ.
Korowii Tɔn la baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii baɡɛ Abraham ne o naa nyoa.
Korowii Tɔn la ta ŋɔe ŋɔ Korowii baɡɛ Abraham ne o naanar nyoa.
Dɛ Abraham ne o naa.
O baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Abraham naa beŋkpoŋ, onee kɛ Kristo.
Waa maa dɛ nyin ń baɡle laanee kɛŋɔ Korowii ne Abraham fɔwɛ fɔo bɛl, asɛ Korowii baɡɛ Abraham nyoa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ teŋɛ fɔo la taa.
Mosis Mmara nɔ ɡe la, fɔo nɔ habɔɔ bene lafraanaarɛ dɛ fifraatoroo a ɡe ba.
Dɛ ɛrɛɛ Mosis Mmara nɔ won ɛ dɛɛ chɔɡ ɡɛ fɔo nɔ dɛ teŋe Korowii nyobaɡa la ta nɔ?
Dɛ Mosis Mmara la ta teŋa taa aa ba cheɡa Korowii ɛ yaa o wedɛɛɡe la te naa, ate dɛ o nyoa waa baɡɛ Abraham la ɛ pɛɛ.
Kɛ ɡɛ laa a do.
Nyoa Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham la waa o sune o nɛɛ dɛ chao, dɛ ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo wedɛɛɡee la.
Aah dɛ bɔkwa waa Korowii tɛ yaa Mosis Mmara laɔ?
Wechɔɡa jema waa o kpɔa ja yaa.
Korowii ɛo kɛŋɔ Mmara la do le dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ Abraham naa la aa bala.
Abraham naa nɔɔ Korowii baɡɛ nyoa la.
Nyundua toromaa Korowii ɡel ba ba Mosis Mmara la ne ba tɛ yaa.
Nɛn nɛɛ nyundua toroma la ba chiɡ dɛ kpɔ Mmara la tɛo, asɛ o ɡe kpɔ tɛ ya naanar.
Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa la ɡe la, o ɡbo waa, nɛmbeŋkpoŋ waa ta keame hiaih.
Amɔ dɛ Mosis Mmara nɔ ne nyoo Korowii aa baɡɛ yaa la aa jo kɛɛ?
A dɛ jo.
Dɛ nɛwɛnyini fe dɔ mmara bɛl waa dɛ ba wona toɡre nɛra ásɛ ba dɔ ba nyu aa, ate nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ mmara la ta la, o waa fe ɛɛ su Korowii siwii kɛŋɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe.
Korowii Tɔn la baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa vɔrɔwe nɛwɛnyina bwa, ásɛ Korowii nyobaɡa waa baɡɛ yaa la ɛ nɛra baa yarada Yeesu Kristo la ɡbo kwa.
Anomanta, nɛra baa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo laanee Korowii ɛɛ ba o nyobaɡa kwaa la kpɔe tɛ.
Yeesu Kristo yaradae waa nɔ aa wola balɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ Mosis Mmara la vɔrɔwe yaa kɛŋɔ nɛra baa do ba dea ken.
Yeesu Kristo yaradae waa nɔɔ bala mɔɔ ya ta dɔ ya te.
Dɛ Mosis Mmara nɔɔ dɛɛ nyiŋi yaa mɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ba.
Waa bala la, o yaradae taa aa ba cheɡa ásɛ ya waa su Korowii siwi, ásɛ o lɛ yaa kɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡa.
Yeesu Kristo yarada waa nɔ aa tel ya be nɔ, Mosis Mmara la laa dɔ yaa kpa.
Korowii bii ɛɛ He ɡbabir na, haa yarada Yeesu Kristo la nomanta, he bwa ɛ Korowii bii.
He banɔ la ba fa aa sɔ heyaa Korowii nee asɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo ɛ beŋkpoŋ la, Yeesu Kristo daa he kpɔ ɡɛ la.
Anomanta, peɡra bɛlbwa toole he baah kpa.
Juu tena oo, nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ yoo, yoma oo, deheɛre oo, haahna oo, baala oo, he bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ Yeesu Kristo be pera.
Dɛ he ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛra te naa, ate Abraham naanaree heya.
Kon Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham nyoa la, he ɡee dɔɔ.
N waa maa dɛ nyin ń bol laanee kɛŋɔ nɛnjen biee dɛɛ so o mɛɛ buɡ ta dɛɛ di o kwaa bwa te, kɛ o taa ɛ bechala la te, o ne ba dem nɛndɔɔla ɡba waa beŋkpoŋ.
Kɛ on ɡee dɔ o mɛɛ kwaa bwa.
O ta ɛ bechala aa, o lɔ nɛra lɔɡa.
Ban dɛɛ nyiŋi o komɛlbwa ta, dɛ ka tel tɔpere o mɛɛ aa doa la mɔɔ bá kpɔ komɛlbwa do o nɔn ta.
Gɛɛ a fa do ya ɡba nɛ.
Dɛ ya do kɛ bechale ken, asɛ koŋkwaa aa dɛ di kpeɡri harɛ bonɔ la ɛɛ di kpeɡri ya nɛ.
Korowii Tɔpere La aa tela la, o tomɛ o ɡbaɡba Bie, asɛ nɛŋhaah lolɔ harɛ nɔ ta, asɛ o ɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara ta la bɛl.
Gɛ Korowii aa ɛ dɛ won lɛ ya nɛra Mosis Mmara la fa aa vɔrɔwe yaa la waa o ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ won kpɔ yaa ɛ o bii.
Korowii aa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ o baɡle kɛŋɔ o biirii yaa la nomanta, o tɛ yaa o Bie la Domadɛɛɡe la o so ya nɛ, asɛ ya won dɛɛ yerɔ ‘n Mɛɛ, n Mɛɛ’, kɛŋɔ bie aa dɛ yerɛ o mɛɛ ɡɛ la.
Taraken nɔ, nɛndɔɔla laa heyaa kpa, Korowii biirii heya.
Haa ɛ Korowii bii la nomanta, wɛɛ tɛ heyaa kwaa waa dɛ tɛ o bii bwa laanee.
Pɔɔl siwi swɛɛ Galaasia tena nɛ Wubwa la, dɛ haa Korowii jemɛ, anomanta, dɛ koŋkwaa aa wola Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ la ɔma vɔrɔwe heya.
Taraken nɔ haa jemɛ Korowii nɔ, kɛɛ taraken nɔ Korowii aa jemɛ heyaa nɔ, ɛrɛɛ a ɛ asɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin he berɛ habɔɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛ kwaa aa wola kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe, ne waa aa dɔ wesoma nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ he berɛ dɛɛ nyin he kpɔ he te tɛa ásɛ a vɔrɔwe heyaa ja nɔɔ?
Kɛ he ta dɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara ta dɛɛ maŋkura tɔpejena ne korobie ane ne bene ane kenɛ?
He waa dɛ we n nɛ.
Amɔ toma maa ɛa he be la bwa ɛ pɛɛ aa?
N poo heya, yabala, n fa dɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara ta dɛ ɡel, dɛ berɛ do ɡɛ haa doa nɔ.
Anomanta, hé ta che kiŋkiŋ dɛ ɡel a ta teŋa dɛ do ɡɛ maa doa nɔ.
N fa aa lɔ he be la, he ta men wechɔɡe bɛlbwa ɛɛ.
Kɛ he dɛ lii waa aa ɡela n ba he be loɡla la dɛ ba bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la waa laɔ?
Dɛ n bwara dɛ wee mɛ.
Dɛ n weela la ɡelɔ n kpoŋa do kpeɡri, kɛ he ta men haih-haih ɛɛ dɛ vɛɛh mɛ.
Gɛ he fe aa lɛ nyundua torome Korowii aa tomɔ la, ɡɛɛ he lɛɛ mɛ.
Gɛ he fe aa lɛ Yeesu Kristo ɡbaɡba la, ɡɛɛ he lɛɛ mɛ.
He sie fa aa lɛ n nɛɛ kohona la, taraken te bɔkwa waa bera ba nɔ?
Mɛɛ wonoo ŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ la he fe wonaa, he fe foromi he sibie kwaraa tɛ mɛ.
Aah n kasinteŋ maa dɛ di heyaa nɔɔ ɡela n berɛ ɛ he dɔm taraken nɔ kɛɛ?
Nɛra maa bol ba waa ŋɔ ba dɛ wili heyaa la, ba swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ nyin he waa la, kɛ waa aa lɔ ba nyu bini la aa were.
Ba waa baa dɛ nyin ɛɛ laanee kɛŋɔ bá pere n ne he baah, ásɛ dɛ fe berɛ he sie kaa ba be.
Nɛn waa nyina wer te, kɛ waa aa che a ta ásɛ nɛn ɛɛ nyin o dɔŋ waa la, a taa kasinteŋ do.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ kasinteŋ saŋ bɛlbwa.
N lɔ he be noo, a ɛ kasinteŋ, n toole he be noo, a ɛ kasinteŋ.
N bii maa lolɛ heyaa Yeesu Kristo waa ta, he ta he da charɛ dɛ do kɛ Yeesu Kristo aa, he ɡelɔ n tea berɛ dɛɛ wee mɛ kɛ lol tea aa dɛ we haah la.
N fe dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ n fe aa lɔ he be taraken, dɛ fe berɛ n nyoa.
He waa ɛɛ mɛ anebɛlbwa!
Heeɡa ne Saara wa He banɔ la haa dɛ nyin kɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ Mosis Mmara la ta la, he ta noɛ ɡɛ Mosis Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle aa?
Korowii Tɔn ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ bibaala banɛɛ Abraham dɔ aa?
Dɛ bibaala banɛ nɔ bɛl nya ɛ yom, asɛ nɛɛte la te nya ta yom ɛɛ.
Gɛ baa ne haah naa dɛ lolɛ bie laanee Abraham ne o yomhaah la lolɛ o biloɡle la.
Kɛ o binɛɛte la o nya aa wola yom ɛɛ la te, Korowiirii baɡɔ nyoa dɛ tɛo bie la.
Yaa kpɔ haahna banɛ nɔɔ maɡɛ Korowii ne nɛwɛnyini nyopɛo dɔe fɔo bele anɛ la.
Ba bɛlbwa cheɡɔ tɛ fɔo la beŋkpoŋ.
Heeɡa waa ɛ Abraham yomhaah la cheɡɔ tɛ fɔo la nɛwɛnyini ne Korowii aa fɔwa Sinai Bwejen ta bela Korowii aa kpɔ o Mmara la tɛ Mosis la.
A ɡɛ fɔo la tenaa ɛ yoma la.
Heeɡaa cheɡa tɛ Sinai Bwejen waa lɔ Arab harɛ ta la.
O tenten, on cheɡa tɛ fini Jerusalam bwɛjen nɔ o nɛra bwa aa ɛ yoma nɔ.
Haah waa wola yom ɛɛ la ɡe cheɡɔ tɛ Jerusalam la waa lɔ nyundua la.
Onee ya nya nɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn la bini ŋɔ, “Hambara, ɡel he sie lɛ!
Haah haa wola loltea weweele nae ka, ɡel he sie lɛ hɛɛ moo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haah la o jaa aa chwao la ɛɛ ba dɔ biirii ɡwaa onɔ la o jaa aa wola on chwae la.” Yabala, ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ Abraham nyoa dɛ ɡel o lolɛ Aesek la, ɡɛɛ o baɡɛ nyoa ya ɡe ɛ o bii.
A ɡɛ saŋ la, dɛ Abraham bie la waa lolɔ ɡɛ baa ne haah naa dɛ lolɛ la, dɛ o cheɡɛ onɔ la Korowii aa cheɡɛ o Domadɛɛɡe nɛɛ dɛ tɛ Abraham la nɛɛ taeh.
Gɛ waa nɔ ta lole fini nɔ.
Kɛ a bwa habɔɔ la, ɛrɛɛ Korowii Tɔn la baɡle ɔ?
O baɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Doŋi yomhaah la ne o bie la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ yomhaah la bie la ne haah la waa wola yom ɛɛ la bie la aa won pɛ di ba mɛɛ kapɛrɛ a maɡre.” Anomanta, yabala, ya ta yomhaah bii ɛɛ.
Haah waa wola yom ɛɛ la biirii yaa.
Yeesu Kristo foo yaa dɛ ɡel ya di ya nyu Ya di ya nyu.
Yeesu Kristo foo yaa, anomanta, ya ta nɛndɔɔla ɛɛ kpa.
Waa foo heyaa nɔ, hé che kiŋkiŋ.
He bɛ ɡel ba kpɔ waa dɛɛ ha heyaa kpa.
Hé ɡel n ŋɔ he be, dɛ he teŋɛ Mosis Mmara nɔ ta dɛ ɡel ba teŋe he pena aa, dɛ waa Yeesu Kristo aa ɛa tɛ heyaa la ta tɔnɔ dɔe tɛ heyaa kwaraa.
Men Pɔɔl, men ŋɔa.
Hé ɡel n kwaa ŋɔ he be he no kɛrɛdɛ, nomɛlbwa waa ɡela ba teŋe o pen ásɛ o waa su Korowii siwi la, a chɛ kɛ ó teŋɛ Mosis Mmara la bwa ta.
He banɔ la haa dɛ nyin he che Mosis Mmara ta teŋa ta ásɛ dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa he waa su Korowii siwi la, he pere he te le Yeesu Kristo be.
He ta nɛra Korowii aa sune ba nɛɛ la nɛɛ jae.
Ya te ken nɔ, ya cheɡɛ yarada yaa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la ta dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɛɛ ɡeloo ya ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su Korowii siwi.
Yeesu Kristo ŋwɛnɛ ta teŋa nɔ ta te, ba teŋe nɛn pen oo, ba ta o pen teŋoo, a laa ɛ wehiah.
Waa aa hiah laanee kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo, asɛ ɡɛ yarada nɔ won ɡel wɛɛ nyin o dɔŋa.
He fa dɛ teŋɛ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Bɔkwaa bala haa wola berɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ la ta kpaɔ?
Bɔkwaa tɔ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ ɔ?
Korowii waa le heyaa he ba o be la, o be laa ɡɛ liire nɔ le.
Ba ŋɔ, “Iisi tama ken won paanoo damanta hoeh,” anomanta, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi liire aa do ken nɔ dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ.
N te ta dɛ yarada heya.
Ya Dɔɔ la ya bwa aa dɛ tomɛ la nomanta, n dɛ yarada heyaa kɛŋɔ haa liifalee dɔ.
Naate waa dɛ wili heyaa nɔ, ɡɛ bwa waa doa, Korowii ɛɛ bɔɔ kemee.
Yabala, dɛ n fe ta dɛ bol ŋɔ penteŋa hiaoh waa, nɛra fe cheɡɛ n nɛɛ ken aa?
Dɛ n fe kpɔ penteŋa waa dɛ ja Yeesu Kristo daɡaɡre ta sewa la waa ta dɛɛ bol aa, nɛra fe dɛ vɛh n wobol nɔ naa?
A ka n te wa aa, nɛra baa dɛ wili heyaa ŋɔ hé teŋe he pena la, ba dɛ nyin aa, bá fɔɡɛ ba lure ɡe.
Yabala, Korowiirii le heyaa tɛ o te, dɛ lɛ heyaa asɛ Mmara la bɛ heyaa vɔrɔwe kpa.
Kɛ haa dɔ he te nɔ, he bɛ ɡel a do he som kohona, asɛ hɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la bwa he bwadabii aa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɛ. Hé kpɔ dɔŋa nyina dɛɛ tomɛ dɔŋa.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, webeŋkpoŋ bɛl lole dɛ he dɛ ɛ aa, dɛ he tonɛ Mosis Mmara la bwa.
Onee kɛŋɔ, “Nyin he dɔŋ kɛ he ɡbaɡba.” Dɛ haa dɔŋa nyin, dɛɛ yo aa, amɔ te hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.
A waa laa aa, he dɛ ba dɔŋa baah chɔɡa kwaraa.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ne ya nɛwɛnyini mar nɔ wa Waa maa dɛ nyin n bol laanee kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la, ásɛ wɛɛ baɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ.
Dɛ o dɛ baɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ aa, haa wechɔɡa he nɛwɛnyini mar aa dɛ nyin la ɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ waa he nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu la aa dɛ nyin la, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa an nyin.
Nɛwɛnyini mar wenyina ne Korowii Domadɛɛɡe wenyina aa jo.
Anomanta, waa haa dɛ nyin ɛɛ la, haa wona ba dɛ ɛ. Dɛ he kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la wɛɛ baɡle heyaa ŋwɛnɛ te naa, Mosis Mmara la aa won di kpeɡri he nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa jemɛ nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ tetoowa.
Anee kɛŋɔ jwamane, ne wedoŋa, ne pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla te bwa soo siwi, ne voɡa toma, dɛ sɔm wa.
A bini anee kɛŋɔ nɛra ne ba dɔŋa aa dɛ di dɔm dɛɛ yo, ne bɔweela kohona, ne bandisale ne sibeɡra, ne nɛra ne ba bala baah peɡra, dɛ nyopɛo bɛ dɔe, ne bɔweela, ne dɛɛra dɛ́ dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa kohona, dɛ wesale aa do ken nɔ.
N fa ŋɔ he be wubwa ŋɔ hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ ŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ la, baa Korowii Kora la ta jae ba.
N berɔ kwaa dɛɛ lii heyaa ja.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la te, kwaa waa dɛ tɛ laanee dɔŋa nyina, ne silɛɛ, ne nyopɛo, ne bambile dɔe, ne tesom, ne wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ, dɛ kasinteŋ dɔe, ne pwɛre doe, dɛ ɡel nɛn won o te lawa.
Harɛ bɛlbwa toole dɛ ki a ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Nɛra baa ɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛra la, ba kpaa ba nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ wenyina ne ba liichɔɡa bwa pɛl Yeesu daɡaɡre la ta dɛ kpoa.
Taraken nɔ, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe laanee tɛ yaa mkpa, anomanta, a chɛ kɛ ya kpɔ ya te tɛo, dɛ́ ɡel wɛɛ baɡle yaa ŋwɛnɛ ya soɡa bini.
A ta chɛ kɛ yaa ɛ jenu.
A ta chɛ kɛ yaa ir dɔŋa bwaawee.
A ta chɛ kɛ ya dɔ bɔweela dɔŋa nɛ.
Nɛra bwa wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ wa Yabala, dɛ he lawɛ he bini bɛl wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ta naa, he banɔ la haa dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kɛrɛdɛ la, hé toɡro.
Kɛ he bɛ o nɛɛ nyɛɡ te, hé toɡro sipwɛra ne.
He ɡbaɡba ɡe la, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ Bɔnsam bɛ heyaa ba neɡre do wechɔɡa ta.
Waa pu he dɔŋ dɛ ɛ bone tɛo waa, hé chao.
He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ Yeesu Kristo mmara la taa hɛɛ teŋɛ la.
Dɛ nɛn ta nɛnjen ɛɛ dɛɛ lii o te nɛnjen aa, dɛ o dɛ neɡre o te.
Hé bɛlbwa nyiŋi o we-ɛɛla na.
Dɛ a wer aa, ó ɡel o sie lɛ.
Kɛ he bɛ he te kpɔ dɛɛ maɡɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ nyin sɔn, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ne o bonee wɛɛ ba cheɡa.
Nomɛlbwa baa dɛ baɡlo Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ la, kondɛɛɡe bɛlbwa haa dɔ la, tɛ naate waa dɛ baɡle la.
He bɛ he te dɛɛ neɡre.
Haa jemɛ kɛ baa Korowii neɡre kɛɛ?
Kwaa nɛn aa dua la, anee wɛɛ komɛ.
Dɛ nɛn teŋɛ o nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu pɛla kwaa nɛɛ dɛ du wechɔɡa aa, sewee wɛɛ ba koma.
Dɛ nɛn teŋɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la tetoowaa ta dɛ du wedɛɛɡa aa, wɛɛ komɛ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa laanee Domadɛɛɡe la be.
He bɛ ɡel ya bwara ɛɛ hwah ya wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta.
Dɛ ya swɛɛ siwi a ta naa, Korowii Tɔpere La telaa, yaa komaa.
Anomanta, saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ ŋwɛnɛ lole naa, yáa cha nomɛlbwa, a laa kɛŋɔ nɛra ya ne baa dɛ di lola Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ teŋa nɔ ta nɔ.
Jae ne kala aa ka mun N ɡbaɡbaa chwerɛ bonɔ la.
Hé na ɡɛ maa chwera a do bare ɡɛ!
Nɛra baa dɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé teŋni he pena la, nɛra sie ta waa baa ɛ ɡɛ.
Ba dɛ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ Juu tena na dɛ bɛ ba yaradae baa yarada Yeesu Kristo daɡaɡre ta sewa waa koh dɛ́ hah ba.
Nɛra baa sɛah ba teŋni ba pena la, ba ɡba aa Mosis Mmara la bwa ta teŋɛ.
Ba dɛ nyin ba teŋni he pena ásɛ dɛ won kpɔ a waa dɛɛ ta nyoa.
N te aa n te maŋkura wobɛlbwa ta, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo daɡaɡre ta sewa la waa taa n te ɛɛ jaaɡi.
O seo la ɡelɔ harɛ ta bonɔ waa berɛ wepɛɛ n be, a ta kpeɡri dɔe n nɛɛ kpa.
Penteŋa ne o bɛ teŋa te ta hiaih kwaraa.
Waa aa hiah laanee kɛ Korowii aa charɛ ya liire ya ɛ nɛnfala.
Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ waa maa dɛ baɡle nɔ ta ba soɡa bini la, Kórowii na ba sum dɛ́ tɛɛ ba bambisɔɔhna.
Banee o nɛra Israel tena la.
Nomɛlbwa bɛ men yɔna do kpa.
Yeesu Kristo toma maa dɛ ɛ la, a ŋwɛra pɛla lɔ n nɛ.
Yabala, yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ na nɛra sum la cha he bwa sekwaraa.
Aamen.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, Korowii dɔ liire tɛ nomɛlbwa, dɛ jemɛ waa waa dɛ nyin o ɛ tɛ bɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ asɔre tena la bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ Yeesu be pera, ásɛ ba we-ɛɛla baɡle kɛŋɔ Yeesu ne banee soɡa.
Pɔɔl baɡle a bini kɛ Korowii kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe la tɛ yaa, dɛɛ baɡle kɛ o wedɛɛɡa bwa waa dɔa tɛ yaa la ɛɛ ba ya bee kerekere.
Pɔɔl dɛ baɡle kɛ, asɔrere aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini bwadabi aa ɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛ dɔ peɡra nɔ, asɛ Yeesu ɛ a nyu te.
A berɔ do kɛ dea baa mao cheɡ, asɛ Yeesu Kristo ɛ bwe baa kpɔa pa o mun o lawɔ kpoŋe o che kiŋkiŋ.
Asɔre berɔ do kɛ haah waa kpɔ Yeesu ɛ o jaa la ken.
Pɔɔl aa chwerɛ tɔn nɔ la, dɛ o dɛ nyin kɛ ba kure baɡle Kristo tena baa lɔ bobɛlbwa, Ɛfesos ɡbo laa.
Men Pɔɔl aa too n tea asɛ o lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la, menee chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
N chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ do Ɛfesos, he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa ta kasinteŋ ne la.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Som nae aa le Yeesu Kristo domadɛɛɡe be pera Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o cha yaa wedɛɛɡa la bwa aa le o Domadɛɛɡe be la ta, asɛ yaa na som o be nyundua, pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la wa.
Korowii felo dɛ le yaa tɛ o te saŋ la o fa aa wola harɛ ɡba tae la, dɛ ŋɔ o dɛ ba ɡela ya ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ yá won do kaih dɛ bɛ doŋa bɛlbwa dɔ o be.
O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa waa o fel jemɛ ya waa cheɡ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ́ kpɔ yaa ɛ o bii.
O tetooraa o cheɡa ɡɛ.
O Binyini la waa o sune ya nɛɛ dɛ ta tea dɛ cha yaa ɡɛ, ásɛ nɛra won kpɛɛro ya sum waa dɛ na kohona la wa.
O Binyini laanee lɛ ya seo sewɛ.
O chalee yawɛ yaa tɛ Korowii, asɛ o kpɔ ya wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ yaa.
Anee dɛɛ baɡle suna waa sune ya nɛɛ kohona dɛɛ cha yaa la.
O ta dɛ cha yaa kɛrɛdɛ ya won dɔ wejema ne liire.
Gɛ bwa Korowii aa ɛ Yeesu Kristo waa cheɡ o tetoora ta a fa sɔh yaa la, o berɔ pili a bwa bini tɛ yaa ya won jemɛ ɡɛ aa su o siwi o cheɡa ɡɛ saŋ la, asɛ a ɛ ɡɛ saŋ la waa liira la.
O cheɡa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo nyundua ne harɛ ta komɛlbwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, ásɛ Yeesu Kristo ɛ ba Dɔɔ.
Ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa baa ɛ beŋkpoŋ la waa o le yaa tɛ o te.
Korowii o yon dɛɛ cheɡ ɡɛ wobɛlbwa aa dɛ ba ɛɛ asɛ a yon ɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin la, on fela le yaa tɛ o te ásɛ nɛra won nyiŋi ya banɔ la yaa fela dɔ hwɛɡa Yeesu Kristo waa ta la, dɛ́ kpɛɛro, dɛ́ tɛo jirima.
Baa baɡle heyaa kasinteŋ dɛ le Amanesoma la aa dɛ lɛ heyaa la ta la, he ɡba sɛoh dɛ ja beŋkpoŋri ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa ɛa la ta.
Haa yarada Korowii dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo la, o kpɔ o Domadɛɛɡe tɛ heyaa ɡɛ waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.
O Domadɛɛɡe la lɔ ya nɛɛ dɛ ɛ nso kɛŋɔ ya ɛ Korowii nɛra.
O Domadɛɛɡe la taa a che ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ yaa dɔ kwaa Korowii aa baɡɛ o nɛra nyoa laanee.
Anee baɡla kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ lɛ o nɛra bwaa ta, dɛ́ lɛ sɔn ne jirima tɛ o te.
Pɔɔl wesoŋa A waa ɡela maa no he yarada haa dɛ yarada ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo dɛɛ nyin Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa la, n ta ɛɛ jam Korowii he waa saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ soŋo dɛɛ tɛ heya.
Ásɛ n soŋe ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii waa dɔ jirima kɛrɛdɛ ɡa la, ó ja heyaa wejema, dɛ́ chaah he sie ásɛ he won dɛɛ jemɛ o waa saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ pili he sie, dɛ́ ɡel he won jemɛ hwɛɡa Korowii aa le heyaa he dɔ a do kan kohona la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ wedɛɛɡa waa baɡɛ o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra nyoa ŋɔ baa dɔɔ la kan taeh, dɛ́ berɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ kpeɡri Korowii aa dɔa dɛɛ cha ya banɔ la yaa yaradao la kan, a dɔŋa toole.
Hé lii ɡɛ o fa aa cha Yeesu Kristo o kpeɡri ne la, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ kpeɡri la tentenee ó kpɔ dɛɛ cha yaa.
O ir Yeesu Kristo seo ta, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa o be ka so nomombɔr o be nyundua bela, o dɔ kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ ɡa, dɛ ɡwaa kpeɡri konchɔɡa aa bea yaa wola an na bwa soo siwi aa dɔa, dɛ dɔ sɔn ɡwaa komɛlbwa kɛɛ nomɛlbwa waa lole taraken ne nɛra baa dɛ ba bala tɔpere aa dɛ ba bala la ta.
Korowii kpɔ komɛlbwa ne nomɛlbwa bil Yeesu Kristo sie o tire ba nɛ, dɛ berɛ ɡel o ɛ asɔre tena bwa nyu, asɛ ba ɡe ɛ o bwadabi.
Onee kana ɡa dɛ won su harɛ nɔ bwa, kɛ asɔre tena laanee ɡela o waa dɔ nyɛl ka tonɛ.
Ya dɔ mkpa Yeesu Kristo be He fa do kɛŋɔ he sewɔ Korowii be.
He wechɔɡaa ɡela he beɡre ɡɛ.
He fa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire dɛɛ teŋɛ wechɔɡa ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ konchɔɡa bwa yaa wola an na la dɔɔ la nɛ.
O tentenee dɛɛ ɛ toma deŋnekpeɡ tena bambili bini.
Gɛɛ ya bwa faa ɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa ya nɛwɛnyini mar wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ aa dɛ nyin, asɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ ya bwadabii pɛla ne ya liichɔɡa ta.
Ya ne nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire bwa nɛɛ Korowii baah faa di.
Kɛ Korowii nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa kohona, ne suna o yon dɛɛ sune ya nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ la nomanta, o ir yaa seo la ya wechɔɡa nomanta yaa sewa la ta, dɛ berɛ koh pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la waa dɛ tɛ yaa mkpafale.
Korowii suna waa sune he nɛɛ la taa a che dɛ lɛ heya.
Korowiirii ir ya ne Yeesu Kristo bwa seo ta, asɛ pɛɛ ya ne waa pɛa la nomanta, o berɛ tɛ ya bwa soŋnibɔra o be nyundua.
O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ kpɔ baɡle nɛra baa wola toole dɛ taa ba bala ásɛ ba na ɡɛ waa ɡara sune ya nɛɛ kohona dɛ cha yaa kɛrɛdɛ, ɡɛ waa cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ ta tea ɛ yaa waa nɔ bwa la.
O nɛn nɛɛ suna kan kɛrɛdɛ.
A ta dɔŋ dɔe.
Korowii aa lɛ heyaa ta la, o nɛn nɛɛ suna ne he yarada waa o ɛ ɡɛ.
He ɡbaɡba be laa a le, pɛɛpɛɛ o lɛ heyaa ta dɛ tɛ heyaa mkpa.
Ya wedɛɛɡa ta laa a che o lɛ yaa, nomɛlbwa bɛ kpɔ dɛɛ maŋkura o te.
Korowiirii ta ya bwa.
Waa ta yaa la, wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa o ta yaa ásɛ ya che Yeesu Kristo kpeɡri ta dɛɛ ɛa.
O tɔ sie cheɡ yaa kɛ ya baa ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Ya ne Yeesu Kristo beŋkpoŋri ɛɛ Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ lii ɡɛ he fa aa doa la.
He ta Juu tena ɛɛ, asɛ Juu tena baa dɛ maŋkura penteŋ la koh kɛ haa he pena teŋe dɛɛ nyiŋi he nyubaah.
A ɛ nɛwɛnyini bwadabii we-ɛɛla.
He fa aa Kristo Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la waa jemɛ.
He fa ta Juu tena Korowii aa lee ba dɛ ɡel ba ɛ o nɛra la nɛɛ jae.
He fa aa nyoo Korowii aa baɡa dɛ kwaa o ne o nɛra fɔo dɔe la waa jemɛ.
He fa ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe.
He fa aa Korowii jemɛ ó won cha heya.
Kɛ taraken he banɔ la he ne Korowii baah fa aa jaŋa la, Korowii koh Yeesu Kristo seo waa sewa, asɛ he ne o won pɛ la wa, dɛ kpɔ heyaa ba o be.
On ɡela nyopɛo ba, dɛ ɡel ya banɔ la ya fa aa hah dɔŋa la ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Haeh ya Juu tena ne he banɔ la haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ nɔ fa aa hah dɔŋa la do kɛ danjwɛɛ dɛ teŋe ya baah ta.
Onee paɡre a ɡɛ danjwɛɛ la.
O ɡbaɡba bwadabii o kpɔ ɛ ɡɛ dɛ sewɛ dɛ laa Mosis Mmara la laa kpɔ ya nɛ, ásɛ banɔ la baa dɛ teŋɛ a ta la bɛ ba te pere le banɔ la baa wola a ta teŋɛ la nɛ.
Onee wona kpɔ ya bwa pɛ, dɛ beɡre yaa ya ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya bwa ne onee pɛa.
Gɛɛ o ɛ dɛ ɡel ya dɔ nyopɛo.
Waa la bwa a fa aa vɔrɔwe yaa ya hah dɔŋa la, o chɔɡ a bwa ta daɡaɡre la ta dɛ ɡel ya bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ berɛ lawɛ ya ne Korowii pɛ.
O baa baɡle he nɛra haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, he ne Korowii baah fa aa jaŋa la, ne Juu tena ba ne Korowii baah fa aa wola jaŋɛ la bwa amanesoma kɛŋɔ nyopɛo balɔ.
Onee ɡela ya bwa dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la, dɛ che o nɛɛ dɛ won dɛɛ tel o Mɛɛ la be.
Anomanta, he ta hɔɔhra ɛɛ kpa.
He ɛ bwɛɛlembii dɛ ja Korowii nɛra la nɛ, dɛ ɛ o ɡbaɡba lola, dɛ ja Yeesu toroma ne o keamere la nɛ.
Jae haa ja ba nɛɛ do kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ma dea la.
O ɡelɔ he do kɛŋɔ dea danjwɛ.
O toroma ne o keamere laanee dea la sol-loɡle, asɛ o ɡbaɡba ɡee bwedɛɛɡe la baa kpɔa pa dea la mun la.
Onee lawɛ banɔ la bwa ba ne waa pɛa la kpoŋe, asɛ dea la ɛɛ kpeɡ dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea, o nomanta.
Pɛɛ he ne waa pɛa la nomanta, he ɡba ja dea la Korowii aa dɛ ma o ɛ o dobɔr la ta.
O Domadɛɛɡe la aa soɡe he nɛɛ la nomanta, he ɛ o dobɔr.
Pɔɔl ɛ toma nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ bini Gɛɛ a do men Pɔɔl baa koh kɛ n dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ bol o waa la dɛɛ baɡle he banɔ la haa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛ do mɛ dea la, n dɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ heya.
He ken no ɡɛ Korowii aa sune n nɛɛ dɛ cha mɛ kɛrɛdɛ n won dɛɛ cha heyaa la.
O ɡbaɡbaa pili o wesɔɔhla waa bini baɡ mɛ.
N fa chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ tama dɛ tɛ heya.
Dɛ he kure ɡɛ n fa aa chwera la aa, hɛɛ wonoo jemɛ kɛŋɔ n jemɛ Yeesu Kristo wesɔɔhla la bini.
Korowii fa ta o wesɔɔhla bini pile baɡle saŋ la tena.
Kɛ taraken o Domadɛɛɡe baɡle o nɛra baa ɛ o toromedɛɛɡa ne o keamedɛɛɡa la be, dɛ ɡel ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ pɛɛ banɔ la baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la ne Yeesu aa pɛa la ne Amanesoma la baa noa la nomanta, ba ja Juu tena nɛɛ dɛ ɛ Korowii kwa, dɛ bwa ja Yeesu Kristo nɛ, dɛ bwa pɛ dɛɛ di Korowii nyobaɡa la ɡe tɔnɔ.
Amanesoma toma nɔɔ Korowii kpɔ tɛ mɛ.
Sunaa o sune n nɛɛ kohona dɛ cha mɛ o kpeɡri ne, n won dɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ.
N ɛ bechala o nɛra bwa bini n fe aa wola chɛɛ, kɛ menee o le ŋɔ ń bol o Amanesoma la baɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe jemɛ wedɛɛɡa aa wola jaɡa dɔe dɛ le Yeesu Kristo waa bini.
Korowii aa ta komɛlbwa saŋ la ba le fini, o kpɔ waa nɔ ne ɡɛ a ŋwɛnɛre aa doa sɔh nɛwɛnyina.
Kɛ o pili a bini baɡ mɛ ń bol baɡle nɛra bwa ba jemɛ.
O ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ nyundua toroma, ne kwaa aa dɔ kpeɡri bwa dɛ do Korowii be nyundua bwa pese asɔre tena waa dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ bwa Korowii wejema aa kana ne ɡɛ waa dɛ ɛ o toma.
Gɛ waa cheɡa wubwa la, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa bala la, a wono ɛ ɡɛ.
Yaa dɛ yarada Yeesu ya ne o pɛ nɔ, yaa wonoo ba Korowii be yaa wola ɔmɛ.
Anomanta, waa maa dɛ soŋe heyaa laanee kɛ he bɛ ɡel he bwara hwah wahala maa koh he waa dɛɛ na nɔ ta.
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ he dɛ dɔ sɔn n wahala nɔ ta.
Pɔɔl Korowii soŋa dɛ́ tɛ Ɛfesos tena Anomanta, n dɛ ɡuŋi N Naa Korowii harɛ.
Onee komɛlbwa waa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa Mɛɛ.
O bee ba mɛɛnanar lɛ ba sɔn ne ba kpeɡri dɛɛ di.
N dɛ soŋo kɛ, chae waa dɛ cha yaa kohona a dɔ jirima nɔ nomanta, ó ɡel o Domadɛɛɡe tɛ heyaa kpeɡri, ásɛ he won lawɛ o waa bini kiŋkiŋ he bambile bwa ne, dɛ́ won dɔ yarada kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ he won lawɛ Yeesu Kristo he ne o pɛ.
N dɛ soŋo he bambile won do o nɛɛ dɛ́ lawɔ kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ he ne Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la bwa won jemɛ ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo nyina aa kana dɛ do luŋri, aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
O nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa la ɡwaa ya liire ta.
Kɛ n dɛ soŋe Korowii he won jema, dɛ́ won dɔ o ɡbaɡba da kɛrɛdɛ ɡa dɛ́ ka tonɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ tɛ Korowii sɔn!
Onee cheɡɛ o kpeɡri waa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma ya bini la ta dɛ won ɛ waa aa ɡwaa ɡɛ ya fe aa liira dɛɛ soŋo la.
Hé ɡel o dɔ jirima Yeesu Kristo ne asɔre tena waa bini saŋ bɛlbwa!
Aamen.
Yeesu ɡelɔ ya bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ Men Pɔɔl maa koh ya Dɔɔ waa la waa ba do mɛ dea la, n dɛ soŋe he bwa, hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ nɛra Korowii aa lee ba tɛ o te ɛɛ teŋɛ la.
Hɛ́ɛ sɔɔh bwara dɛɛ pwɛr he te, dɛ́ koh dɔŋa nyina waa dɛ́ dɔ bambile dɔŋa nɛ, dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi hé ne he bala baah do wer saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ bɛ nyopɛo la Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa tɛ heyaa la chɔɡ.
Yeesu bwadabii lɔ beŋkpoŋ, o Domadɛɛɡe ɡe lɔ beŋkpoŋ, asɛ hwɛɡa Korowii aa le yaa ya bwa dɔ la ɡe ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Ya bwa Dɔɔ lɔ beŋkpoŋ.
Waa ya bwa aa dɛ yarada, ne Korowii nee baa sɔ ya bwa la ɡe ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Ya bwa Mɛɛɛ Korowii, o lɔ beŋkpoŋ.
Onee dɔ ya bwa dɛɛ ɛ toma ya bwa bini, dɛ do ya bwa nɛ.
Kɛ ya bɛlbwa dɔ koŋkɛɛle aa le Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la be Yeesu Kristo kpɔ tɛ yaa.
Gɛ waa dɛ nyin laanee o bɔna tɛ ya bwa ɡɛ del aa chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa dɔ.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “O teehnɔ kaa nyundua, dɛ lawɛ nɛra waa laɡ ba laa ta kaa, asɛ o kɛ nɛra kwa.” Baa ŋɔa ŋɔ o kaa nyundua la, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ o tɔ sie tu ba harɛ.
Nɛn waa tua la, o tentenee kaa nyundua dɛ ka do nyundujaɡla ásɛ dɛ won do bobɛlbwa.
Onee kɛ nɛra kwaa la.
Kwaa waa kɛ nɛra laanee nɔ.
O cha bane ba won che o kpeɡri ta dɛ ɛ o toroma, dɛ cha bane ba won che o kpeɡri ta dɛ bol o wa, dɛ cha bane ɡe baa bol o Amanesoma la.
O cha bane ɡe baa nyiŋi o nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ baɡ ba o ŋwɛnɛ ta teŋa.
Gɛɛ o ɛ dɛ cha nɛra bá ɡe won ɛ o toma dɛ́ cha dɔŋa Yéesu Kristo bwadabii la won do kpeɡri, ásɛ ya bwa won dɔ nyopɛo yarada yaa yarada Korowii Bie ne jema yaa jemɔ la ta kɛrɛdɛ dɛ ka tonɛ, dɛ won kpeɡ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nomonome o nɛɛ teŋa ta, ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa doa la.
Onee ya kpɔ dɛɛ maɡɛ ya te dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ yaa kpeɡ.
A taa aa ba cheɡa nɛra aa wola won neɡre yaa kɛŋɔ bechale.
Dɛ ya ta kpeɡe kɛrɛdɛ o nɛɛ teŋa ta naa, bane ɛɛ ba baɡle yaa waa aa koraa, ya den sɛh warane dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ peu yon ɡɔɔ kon ir nyundua dɛ kpɔ ka ta bobɛlbwa la.
Nɛra bane won ba liire kpɔe dɛ́ teŋe nyosone á do kɛŋɔ kpelaa ken, dɛ́ won neɡre nɛra.
Korowii dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ya lawɛ kasinteŋ la bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ bola dɔŋa be nɛnnyin ne, ásɛ ya won kpeɡ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ do ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa doa.
Onee ya nyu.
Yan ɡee o bwadabi.
Onee choŋri bwadabii la bwa, aa lawɛ dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛɛ cha dɔŋa, ásɛ dɛ won kpeɡ tel ɡɛ o mar aa doa.
Dɔŋa nyinaa ɡela Yeesu Kristo bwadabii won kpeɡ ɡɛ dɛ do kpeɡri la.
Korowii mkpafale dɔe Yeesu be N siswɛm waa n che n Dɔɔ Yeesu sɔn ta dɛɛ bol he be la.
He bɛ banɔ la baa wola Korowii tomɛ la nɛɛ teŋɛ kpa.
Wepuu baa lii dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta la.
Ba sibie tɔɔɡɔ.
Ba nya liire, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena.
A waa ɡela baa wola Korowii mkpa dɔe la.
Wobɛlbwa aa ban sihiih ɛ. Anomanta, ba saahnɔ dɛɛ teŋɛ ba pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla ta, dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa ba siwi swɛɛ a ta.
Kɛ he te, ɡɛ laa ba baɡle Yeesu Kristo waa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ teŋɛ a ta.
He no o wa, ba baɡle heyaa kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ la, asɛ he jemɛ ɡɛ baa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛ.
Taraken hé ɡel he dabene la ne waa he fa aa dɛ teŋɛ a ta la.
He pɛlchɔɡaa neɡre he bwa dɛɛ chɔɡ he da la.
Hé ɡel webena la bwa, dɛ́ ɡel Korowii kwaa he bambile ne he liire bwa á berɛ anfala.
O tɛ heyaa dafale bɛl soo siwi waa kwaara, o do kɛ o tenten la ásɛ he won ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa tenten, he waa bwa do kɛrɛdɛ o be.
Anomanta, hé kpɔ dafale la.
Hé laa nyosone bɛlbwa laa kpɔ he waa ta, dɛɛ bol kasinteŋ dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he bwa pɛ bwadabii beŋkpoŋ ta dɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Dɛ he baah diu waa, he bɛ ɡel a ɛ bandichɔɡa he ɛ wechɔɡa.
Hé ɡel o sɔɔh warane.
Aa were kɛŋɔ he baah di wee ka jo dɛ o ta sɔɔhnɛ.
He bɛ ɡel Bɔnsam dɔ bɔr dɛ́ neɡre heya.
He fa dɛ ŋwɛ kɛɛ?
Hé ɡel ɡɛ ɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ he nɔɔra haa kpɔa dɛɛ ŋwɛ la dɛɛ ɛ tondɛɛɡa dɛ́ dɔ dɛɛ di, dɛ́ won dɔ ane dɛɛ tɛ nyaara ba ɡee di.
He bɛ ɡel wedoŋa bɛlbwa ɛɛ le he nyoo, kɛ hé ɡel he wobol ɛ waa aa wera dɛɛ do nɛra ɡbemba waa aa kpoŋ ba ta, dɛ won cha banɔ la baa dɛ noa la.
He bɛ ɡel Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la tea bini chɔɡ.
Korowiirii kpɔɔ do heyaa nso dɛ́ won jemɛ he banɔ la waa dɛ ba lɛɛ o lɛɛ tɔpere la.
Hé ɡel nyɛɡre doe, ne bandia, ne ɡaeh, ne wesaɡasaɡare, ne bahmuɡliwa, dɛ meesɔhwaa bwa, dɛɛ ɛ dɔŋa wedɛɛɡa, dɛ́ dɔ dɔŋa chal.
Dɛ he dɔŋ ɛɛ wechɔɡa aa, kpɔ kɛo kɛŋɔ Korowii aa koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛ heyaa la.
Bochaah ta soɡa wa He ɛ Korowii bii waa dɛ nyin heya, anomanta, hé chaaro dɛ́ kpɔ o da.
A wer kɛŋɔ he so dɔŋa nyina ne kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo aa nyin yaa dɛ sewɛ lɛ yaa a ɛ sarahadɛɛɡe dɛ tɛ Korowii la.
Kɛ jwamane ne wedoŋa ne sibeɡra dɔe dɔŋa kwaa ta te, he bɛ a waa dɛɛ bol á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɛa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ aa were tɛ Korowii nɛra.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ he wobol bini, dɛ bɛ wobochɔɡa ne ɡɛnewobol ne wobosale dɛɛ bol.
A ta chɛ kɛ hɛ́ɛ bola.
Hé ɡel he wobol ɛ Korowii kpɛɛra wa.
Hé jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ bɔ jwamane, dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa, ba sie ɛɛ beɡre kwaa ta la aa bɔr dɔe ba Yeesu Kristo ne Korowii Kora la bini.
Sie beɡra kwaa ta do kɛŋɔ voɡ toma ken.
He bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa kpɔ wepuu neɡre heya.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa waa Korowii baah di deŋnekpeɡ tena nɛɛ wɛɛ ba ba deŋne tɛra la.
Anomanta, he ne ɡɛ nɛra la bɛ wobɛlbwa ta pɛ.
He waa bwa fa ɛ biro bini wa, kɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nomanta, he ɛ bochaah ta nɛra.
Anomanta, hé ɡel he soɡa bini wobɛlbwa do kɛŋɔ bochaah ta nɛra.
Bochaah ta we-ɛɛlaa wedɛɛɡa ne wekaih dɛ kasinteŋ wa.
Anomanta, hé jemɛ waa haa ɛ aa lɛ Korowii sie, ásɛ dɛ ɡel biro bini waa ɛɛ.
A ta tɔnɔ dɔe.
Hé le a ne baŋ, ásɛ nɛra jemɛ ɡɛ aa doa.
Waa ba yon sɔh dɛ́ɛ ɛ la aa were.
A waa baɡla ɡba dɔ sihiih.
Ba le komɛlbwa ne bochaah ta naa, o kon soo siwi won nae kɛrɛdɛ.
Kon la bwa bɔr aa chaah o ta la, o ɡbaɡba dɛ baɡle o te.
A waa ba yon ŋɔ, “He banɔ la haa sewa chɔ la, hé ir, ásɛ Kristo chaah he nɛɛ” la.
Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi he soɡa bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɛ wejerema dɛ bɛ ɡɛn.
Wechɔɡa lole kɛrɛdɛ taraken.
Anomanta, hé takapɔ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa taraken nɔ haa dɔ bɔr dɛ́ ɛa nɔ.
Hé ɡel he nfɛrɛ nyae la, dɛ́ jemɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin la kɛrɛdɛ.
He bɛ sen nyɔ kohona dɛɛ dɛɛ.
Gɛ dɛ chɔɡ nɛn.
Kɛ hé ɡel Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la so he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ ɡel o wobol ne o yela do he bambile bini he bola dɛ́ɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛ́ɛ ɡo yela aa dɛ baɡle o waa la ne anɔ la aa dɛ kpɛɛro.
Hé kpɔ silɛɛ dɛ́ɛ kpɛɛ he Dɔɔ he bambile bwa ne, dɛ́ɛ yerɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sɔn, dɛ́ɛ jam N Naa Korowii waa bwa ta.
Hé bwa ɛɛ no dɔŋa be ɔma haa dɛ ɔmɛ Yeesu Kristo la nomanta.
Haahna ne ba jaranar Haahna, hɛ́ɛ no he jaranar waa kɛŋɔ he Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa hɛɛ no la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baalee ɛ o haah nyu te, kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo aa ɛ asɔre tena bwa nyu te la.
Banee ɛ o bwadabi wɛɛ lɛɛ ba.
Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ haahna ɛɛ no ba jaranar waa wobɛlbwa ta kɛŋɔ asɔre tena aa dɛ no Yeesu Kristo waa la.
Baala, hɛ́ɛ nyin he haahna kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa dɛ nyin asɔre tena dɛ koh ba waa sewɛ la.
O sewɔ tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ ɡel ba won ɛ o nɛra, ásɛ ba doŋa bwa won le ba nɛ, o waa baa noa ne Korowii nee baa sɔ ba nomanta.
O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ́ won kpɔ asɔre tena berɛ o handɛɛɡe, doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ, waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii, o bobɛlbwa aa wola jweremɛ, dɛ do wer ka tonɛ.
Gɛɛ chɛ kɛ baala ɡee nyin ba haahna kɛŋɔ ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin ba ɡbabir bwadabii la.
Baa bɛlbwa waa dɔ haah dɛɛ nyinu ɡɛ la, o ɡbabirii wɛɛ nyin la.
Umee dɛ hah o ɡbabir ɔ?
Nomɛlbwa dɛ nyiŋi o te kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyu ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa dɛ nyiŋi asɔre tena la.
Ya bwa ɛ o bwadabii la pera.
Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, “Gɛ nomanta, baa ɛɛ ɡel o nya ne o mɛɛ, ásɛ o ne o haah ka pɛ, ba nɛra banɛ la ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ.” A ɡɛ waa nɔ bini luŋri.
N te be te, Yeesu Kristo ne asɔre tena waa ba baɡle ɡɛ la.
Anomanta, he bɛlbwa takapɔ dɛ́ nyin o haah kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba, háah ɡe kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ o jaa.
Bechale ne ba nyare dɛ mɛɛnanar Bechale, hɛ́ɛ no he nyare ne he mɛɛnanar wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haa ɛ Kristo tena nɔ, anee chɛ kɛ hɛ́ɛ ɛ. Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, “Duu he nya ne he mɛɛ,” dɛ berɛ chwerɛ nyobaɡa bɛl waa ja o ta, o ɛ Korowii Mmara waa tɔ sie baɡɛ nyoa ja o ta.
Kenii o ŋɔ, “Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, Korowii ɛɛ nyiŋi heyaa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa mkpajaŋ harɛ nɔ ta.” Mɛɛnanar, he bɛ he bii sibeɡra dɛ́ɛ do, ásɛ ba baah ɛɛ di.
Hé kpoŋ ba kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛre ne waa la bwa aa wera ya Dɔɔ be.
Bonɔɔna ne toli dɛ ba dɔɔranar He banɔ la baa do heyaa bonɔɔna kɛɛ toli la, hɛ́ɛ no he dɔɔranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta wa, dɛ́ɛ duu ba, dɛ́ ta tea dɛ́ɛ tom ba kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristoo hɛɛ tomɛ.
He bɛ sɔn waa koh dɛ́ kpɔ bokpeɡa dɛ́ɛ ɛ toma nɛra sie ta, kɛ hɛ́ɛ ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔndɛɛɡa ne toldɛɛɡa aa dɛ ɛ, dɛ́ɛ ɛ toma he bambile bwa ne á su Korowii siwi.
Hé kpɔ silɛɛ dɛ́ɛ ɛ toma.
Nɛn laa hɛɛ tomɛ.
He Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristoo hɛɛ tomɛ.
Onee dɛɛ ba nomɛlbwa kem bɔe o tondɛɛɡa bwa waa ɛa ta.
Dɛ bonɔɔ kɛɛ toloo ba doe noo, dɛ he nyuu hɛɛ di oo, he bwa dɛ ba tondɛɛɡa haa ɛa kembɔr dɔe Yeesu Kristo be.
Dɔɔranar, hɛ́ɛ ɛ he bonɔɔna ne toli ɡe kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba fiiɡa.
He jemɔ kɛŋɔ he ne ba bwa Dɔɔ lɔ beŋkpoŋ nyundua.
Waa bane nyine dɛɛ ɡwaa bane.
Korowii laa laala bwa kpɔe dɛ́ do wa Anɔ la aa kaa laanee kɛŋɔ hé ɡel he ne ya Dɔɔ pɛ, ásɛ he won dɔ kpeɡri waa dɔa kohona la.
Bɔnsam dɔ baradeɛre kɛrɛdɛ ɡa.
Anomanta, hé kpɔ Korowii laa laala bwa do dɛ́ won yoo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛn laa ya ne wɛɛ yo.
Ya ne konchɔɡa aa bea yaa wola an na a dɔ kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ dɛ do biro ta la nɛ, ne konchɔɡa bwa soo siwi aa wara kohona laanee dɛɛ yo la.
Anomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ Korowii laa laala bwa do kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ konchɔɡa la baa ŋɔ a yo heya aa, he won che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ yo ka tonɛ dɛ́ ta won che.
Kenii hɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ won che.
Hé kpɔ kasinteŋ ɛ kiriso, dɛ́ kpɔ waa aa toɡra ɛ laa batakaare, dɛ́ kpɔ Amanesoma la aa dɛ baɡle nyopɛo dɔe la do he nakpale, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ yarada tɔ he te ɡbemɡbe, dɛ́ won lɛ hɛma la Bɔnsam aa kpɔa su nii ta dɛɛ ta heyaa la bwa dɛɛ ta, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ lɛɛ Korowii aa lɛ heyaa la ɛ buni ɡbɛrɛ dɛ́ kpɔ pi, dɛ́ kpɔ o waa la aa ɛ o Domadɛɛɡe tokobii la kpoŋe.
Hɛ́ɛ soŋo harɛ bini soŋa nɔ bwa.
Hé che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ta, dɛ́ɛ soŋo saŋ bɛlbwa.
He bɛ dom dɛɛ chɔ.
Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ́ɛ tɛ o nɛra la bwa.
Hɛ́ɛ soŋo dɛɛ tɛ n ɡe, ásɛ dɛ n dɛ ba waa bola aa, ń dɔ waa dɛɛ bol, dɛ́ dɔ bambile dɛ́ won pili o wesɔɔhla la le Amanesoma la bini.
Maa ɛ Yeesu nachiɡe dɛɛ bol Amanesoma nɔ ba koh a waa do mɛ dea nɔ.
Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii ásɛ n ta dɔ bambile dɛɛ baɡla ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ mɛɛ baɡla.
Kala aa ka mun Tichikos waa ɛ ya dɔŋ yaa nyinu kohona wɛɛ ɛ ya Dɔɔ toma kasinteŋ ne la, onee dɛ́ ba baɡle n toma waa bwa ne ɡɛ maa doa.
A waa ɡela n tomɔ he be ásɛ o ba bol ya waa baɡle heya, dɛ́ do heyaa ɡbemba la.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo tɛ he ne yabala la bwa deŋnesɔɔhna, ne nɛnnyin ne yarada, dɛ́ sune he nɛ, dɛ́ cha he banɔ la bwa haa dɛ nyin ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bambile bwa ne aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn nɔ ɡɛ saŋ baa lawɔ do dea.
Dɛ o dɛ nyin kɛ o jam Felepae tena koŋkɛɛla baa kpɔa ka tɛo la wa.
O do ba ɡbemba ŋɔ bá kpɔ silɛɛ dɛɛ tomɛ Yeesu, dɛ a baa do kpeɡri kwaraa naa, ba bɛ o toma la ɡel.
Dɛ ba nyiŋi na ɡɛ Yeesu aa pwɛr o te dɛ na wahala, dɛ ɡel ba ka kpaaro pɛl daɡaɡre ta kwara.
Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Pɔɔl sie aa lɛa, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ o dɛ na wahala asɛ bane ɡe ɛɛ tɔŋlo.
Suna Korowii aa sune Pɔɔl nɛɛ laanee ɡela o dɔ silɛɛ, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ chao.
Men Pɔɔl ne Timoti yaa ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔna la, yanee chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii nɛra he wa aa toɡra, he ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ he do Felepae la, ne he nɛra baa tɔ asɔre tena sie ne nɛra baa chɔ tomare nyoo la bwa.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Korowii jaama ne o kpɛɛra Saŋ bɛlbwa maa lii he waa la, n dɛ jam N Naa Korowii he wa, dɛ́ yon kpɔ silɛɛ dɛ́ soŋo dɛɛ tɛ he bwa, pɛɛ ya ne he bwa aa pɛa dɛɛ cha dɔŋa Amanesoma toma la ta le mumpar ba le fini la nomanta.
N dɔ hwɛɡa kɛŋɔ ɡɛ Korowii aa pa mun dɛɛ ɛ o tondɛɛɡa he bambile bini la, wɛɛ ja a taa ka tel awola Yeesu Kristo aa ba la.
Aŋwɛnɛ taa n dɔ he hwɛɡa ɡɛ la, dɛkalkɛ he bwa waa lɔ n bambile ta.
Baa do mɛ dea la, ne yoi maa yoa lɛ Amanesoma la cheɡ dɛ bol kasinteŋ aa lɔ a ta dɛɛ baɡle nɛra la, n ne he bwa nɛɛ Korowii sune dɛ cha yaa a ta.
Korowii jemɔ kɛŋɔ he pɛla laɡ mɛ taeh, nɛnnyin Yeesu Kristo aa kpɔa do n bambile ta la nomanta.
N dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛŋɔ ó ɡel he dɔ nɛnnyin kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ɛ ja, dɛ́ berɛ dɔ wejema ne nfɛrɛ dɛ́ ja a ta, ásɛ dɛ won jemɛ waa aa wera kohona.
Anee dɛ́ ɡel he won do kaih, nomɛlbwa aa wola he wechɔɡa dɔe ba dɛ bol ka tel awola Yeesu Kristo aa ba la.
N dɛ soŋo kɛ he che Yeesu Kristo kpeɡri la ta dɛ́ won dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ nɛra ɛɛ tɛ Korowii sɔn ne jirima.
Jɔɡrɔre baa do Pɔɔl Yabala, n dɛ nyin kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ wedɛɛɡa le waa aa chiɡ n nɛɛ la ta, dɛ́ ɡel Amanesoma la won kaa sie.
Bonɔ koojen soojare baa dɛ daah o dem, ne nɛra baa lɔ bonɔ bwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ waa ba do mɛ dea.
Asɛ n dea chɔe la berɛ ɡel yabala ɡalɡa ɡee yarada ya Dɔɔ Yeesu kohona, dɛ́ dɔ bambile dɛ́ɛ baɡle Korowii Waa la kɛrɛdɛ, baa wola ɔmɛ.
Kasinteŋ, bɔweela ne dɔŋa meera waa nɛra bane ɛɛ bol Kristo Amanesoma la, asɛ bane ɡee bola bambile bwa ne.
Ba te la, nɛnnyin waa baa ɛa, dɛkalkɛ ba jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii kpɔ toma nɔ tɛ mɛ ŋɔ ń yo lɛ Amanesoma la cheɡ.
Banɔ la ɡe, ba ɡbaɡba sɔn nyina waa baa bol Yeesu Kristo wa, ba tepoŋ ne laa.
Ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba ɛ ɡɛ naa, baa wonoo ɡel n tea bini chɔɡ dɛ́ ja n dea chɔe nɔ ta.
Kɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Dɛ liichɔɡa nee baa bola o, dɛ tepoŋ nee baa bola o, Yeesu Kristo waa baa bol la, n baah sɔɔh mɛ.
Aa sɔɔh mɛɛ dɛɛ la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n jemɔ kɛ Korowii ɛɛ lɛɛ mɛɛ le waa aa chiɡ n nɛɛ nɔ ta, he Korowii soŋa ne Yeesu Kristo Domadɛɛɡe la alaworomɛ.
Waa maa dɛ nyin n siwi swɛɛ a ta laanee kɛŋɔ, n bɛ n toma ba ɛ kahonɛ sihiih kpo mɛ, kɛɛ n won dɔ bambile kɛrɛdɛ taraken kɛŋɔ n fa aa dɔ bambile la, ásɛ Yeesu Kristo won dɔ jirima n we-ɛɛla bini.
Dɛ ba ɡelɔ n so le noo, ba kpo mɛ noo, Yéesu Kristo dɔ jirima a bwa bini.
N soɡa nɔ maa soɡa nɔ, Yeesu Kristo waa n so.
Dɛ n sewɔ ɡe aa, anee dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ mɛ kwara.
Kɛ dɛ n ta soɡe le naa, mɛɛ ba wonoo ɛ toma á won dɔ tɔnɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, maa jemɛ onɔ la bwa waa wera n be ń kpɔ.
N chinchaŋo.
N dɛ nyin kɛ n sewɛ dɛ́ ka so Yeesu Kristo be.
A bɔ kohona kɛ maa soɡe bonɔ.
Kɛ he nomanta, a hiaoh kohona kɛ n do bonɔ dɛ́ won cha heya.
Anomanta, n jemɔ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ so he bee dɛ́ won cha he bwa he kpeɡ Yeesu Kristo waa la ta, dɛ́ dɔ silɛɛ he yarada ta, ásɛ dɛ n baa so he be ja aa, he won dɔ bɔr kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ jaaɡi n wa, dɛ́ɛ kpɛɛ Yeesu Kristo.
Waa aa hiaah laanee kɛŋɔ hé ɡel he we-ɛɛla bwa do wer ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ nɛra baa no Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la waa aa doa, ásɛ dɛ n baa ba he be noo, n ta ba wone ba noo, ń no he waa kɛŋɔ he bwa liire ɛ beŋkpoŋ, hé che kiŋkiŋ, he nyoa pɛ, hé che tɛ Amanesoma la haa yaradaa la, á won la sie, dɛ́ berɛ dɔ bambile haa wola he dɔma ɔmɛ tamaa bɛlbwa bwa.
He bambile dɔe la taa bá che jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡbaɡba ɛɛ lɛ heyaa dɛ́ chɔɡ ba.
Korowii ɡelɔ he won yarada Yeesu Kristo, dɛ berɛ won koh o waa na hɔhɔrɔwa.
Wejenaa o ɛ tɛ heyaa he won koh o waa na hɔhɔrɔwa la.
He ɡba dɛ yo ɡɛ tenten he fa aa na mɛ mɛɛ yo la.
Gɛ yoi laanee hɛɛ no kɛ n ta dɛ yo la.
Yeesu pwɛre waa doa hwela Haa dɔ ɡbemba pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la ta, o nyina ɡee larawe heyaa bwara, he dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡe wɛɛ cha heya, dɛ dɔ nɛnnyin he chal do dɔŋa nɛɛ nɔ, amɔ hé ɛ waane dɛɛ ja, ásɛ n sie lɛ kohona ka tonɛ.
N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he bwa dɔ nyopɛo, ásɛ he liire ne he dɔŋa nyina ne wobɛlbwa haa lii la bwa won ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
He bɛlbwa bɛ o ɡbo sɔn nyina kɛɛ jenu waa koh dɛɛ ɛ wa, kɛ hé pwɛr he te dɛ́ɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɡwaa he ɡbaɡba.
He bɛ ɡel he ɡbo waa hiah heya.
Hé ɡel he dɔŋa ɡe waa hiah heya.
Gɛ Yeesu Kristo aa doa la, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛ he do.
O do ɡɛ Korowii aa doa, kɛ o ta ɡelɛ ɡɛ su o siwi kɛŋɔ o ne Korowii ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
O kpɔ o Korowii dor la bil, dɛ kpɔ o te kɛ somanji, dɛ do ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini aa doa.
Waa baa ɛ nɛwɛnyini la, o pwɛr o te dɛɛ no o Mɛɛ Korowii nyoa wobol, dɛ ɡel ba kpoo.
Hale daɡaɡre ta kwaraa ba kpoo.
A waa Korowii tɛo nomonome kɛrɛdɛ ɡa, dɛ berɛ tɛo sɔn ɡwaa sɔna tena bwa.
Yeesu Kristo sɔnjen la nomanta, nomɛlbwa ɛɛ ɡuŋi o siee dɛ́ kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛo.
Banɔ la baa lɔ nyundua, ne banɔ la baa lɔ harɛ ta, ne banɔ la baa serewa bwa, ɛɛ kpɔ duuree dɛɛ tɛo, ásɛ nomɛlbwa sɛh kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristoo nɛra bwa Dɔɔ, ásɛ o Mɛɛ Korowii dɔ jirima.
Nɛra ɡel ba we-ɛɛla chaah kɛŋɔ weweela Anomanta, n dandɛɛɡa, ɡɛ haa dɛ no n waa dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta ɡɛ saŋ n fa aa lɔ he be la, a hiaoh kohona kɛŋɔ maa wola toole he be nɔ, hé ta kpoŋe ɡɛ.
Korowii aa lɛ heyaa nɔ, hé kpɔ duure ne ɔmee dɛ́ɛ teŋɛ toma haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii soɡe he bɛlbwa nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma, dɛ ɡel he won sɛh dɛ won dɛɛ tomɔ kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ aa su o siwi.
Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ la, he bɛ waa dɛɛ naɡre, dɛ bɛ waa dɛɛ tɔŋle, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a wer kɛŋɔ he ɛ Korowii bii nomɛlbwa aa wola he wechɔɡa dɔe dɛ bol, he tea to, he do kaih.
Fini nɛra baa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra kɛrɛdɛ baa wola ŋwɛnɛ la ta kpɔ baahnee he do.
Gɛ weweela aa dɛ chaah jwaana biro ta la, ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛ he do ba baah dɛɛ chaah.
Hé ɡel Korowii wa aa dɔ mkpa la do he bambile bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ la, ń won hɛɡre he waa Yeesu Kristo bala tɔpere la ta kɛŋɔ n ta koɛh ta pɛɛ.
Kɛ dɛ yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii dɛɛ tomɔ la do kɛŋɔ saraha, asɛ a chɛ kɛ n chal fuɡe a ta naa, n dɛ nyin ɡɛ.
A ba ɡɛ naa, n sie ɛɛ lɛo, ásɛ he puu mɛ lɛ sie.
Gɛ tentenee a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɡe sie lɛ, ásɛ n pu heyaa lɛ sie.
Timoti ne Epafrodaetɔs Dɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu sɛoh waa, mɛɛ tomɛ Timoti he bee taraken ó ba na heya, dɛ́ ba bol he waa n be ásɛ n baah sɔɔh mɛ.
N ne o ɡboo dɔ liire beŋkpoŋ he wa.
Anomanta, n jemɔ kɛ onee he waa do o bambile bini wɛɛ nyin he ne andɛɛɡa.
Dɛ o laa aa, bɛlbwa sese dɛ dawɛ o ɡbaɡba wa, waa Yeesu Kristo waa dawɛ.
He ɡba jemɛ ɡɛ o waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛ do wer.
N ne o pɛo wɛɛ cha mɛ Amanesoma toma la ta kɛŋɔ bechala ne o mɛɛ.
Anomanta, dɛ n baa na ɡɛ baa dɛ ba n cheɡa aa, mɛɛ tomɔ he bee.
N dɔ hwɛɡa ya Dɔɔ nɛɛ kɛŋɔ aa biɡri bɛlbwa ásɛ n ɡbabir dɔ bɔr dɛ́ ba he be.
N liiro kɛŋɔ a hiaoh kɛ ń tomɛ ya dɔŋ Epafrodaetɔs he be.
N ne onee dɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ, dɛ yo dɛɛ tɛ Korowii.
Onee he faa tomɛ n be o ba cha mɛ la.
N ɡee berɔɔ tomɔ he be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, he pɛla lawɔ wɛɛ lii he bwa waa taeh.
A dɛ hao kohona kɛŋɔ haa no o weela wa.
O fa we weela dɛ chɔ fɔɡɛ taeh, dɛ fe ɛɛ ba sewa.
Kɛ Korowiirii na o sum dɛ sune n ne o bwa nɛ.
Dɛ o fe sewaa, n tea bini fe chɔɡɔ dɛ́ ja n wahala ta.
Ate waa n siwi swɛɛ mɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ń tomɔ he be ásɛ he nao he sie lɛ, ásɛ he waa bɛ men dɛɛ ha kohona.
Hé kpɔ silɛɛ dɛ́ lɛo, teŋa he ne o bwa aa dɛ teŋɛ ya Dɔɔ nɛɛ la nomanta.
Hɛ́ɛ duu nɛra baa do kɛŋɔ on.
Yeesu Kristo toma waa o koh dɛ kpɔ o nyu charɛ seo.
A ka jɛɛ ken o fee sewɛ.
Waa haa wola won cha mɛ a ta, dɛ koh a waa tomɔ n be la taa o fe ɛɛ ba sewa.
Nɛndɛɛɡe o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ Yabala, waa aa kaa laanee kɛŋɔ, hé ɡel he sie lɛ he ne ya Dɔɔ pɛɛ la ta.
Wesiwi beŋkpoŋii n berɛ chwerɛ dɛɛ tɛ heyaa la, kɛ aa men ha.
A dɛ ba ɡela he won che kiŋkiŋ.
Hɛ́ɛ do nɛnchɔɡa baa ɛ ba te manyare la dɛɛɡɔ.
Nɛra baa dɛ maŋkura penteŋ dɛ ŋɔ nómɛlbwa mɔn o bɔtɔn mɔɔ dɛ́ tomɛ Korowii la waa mɛɛ bol la.
Ya banɔ la yaa dɛ tomɛ Korowii o Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛɛ tɛ Yeesu Kristo sɔn, yaa wola bɔtɔn mɔna waa maŋkura la, yanee jemɛ penteŋ tenten la.
Dɛ bɔtɔn wa ɛɛ wonoo lɛ yaa aa, menee fe dɔ hwɛɡa kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa ŋɔ a cheɡɛ o waa waa ɛa ta o dɔ hwɛɡa aa, menee dɔ hwɛɡa dɛ ɡwaa naate.
Israel tee men.
Baa lol mɛ n dɔ yawanyoa la taa ba teŋe n pen.
Bɛnjamen deaa n le.
Israel te kaiih men, dɛkalkɛ n mɛɛ ne n nya bwa ɛ Hibru tena.
Dɛ ba dɛ bol Mmara ta teŋa wa aa, nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Mmara ta kohona baa yer ba Farisii tena la bɛlee men.
Ba dɛ nyin nɛn o siwi fa aa swɛɛ a ta naa, menee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n fa cheɡɛ Yeesu habɔteŋra la nɛɛ taeh.
Dɛ ba berɔ dɛɛ nyin nɛndɛɛɡe Mmara la be pera ɡe aa, n waa bwa toɡrɔ.
Kɛ waa la bwa n fa aa lɔ a ta a ɛ tɔnɔ tɛ mɛ la, Yeesu Kristo nomanta, n dɛ liira wepuu.
Kasinteŋ, komɛlbwa ne wobɛlbwaa n vɛh dɛɛ yera wepuu dɛ́ won jemɛ n Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo.
O jemaa hiaah ɡwaa komɛlbwa.
N koh o waa dɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa ta, dɛɛ liira puldoa haahra, dɛɛ nyin ń won dɔ Yeesu Kristo kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ ya bwa won pɛ, ásɛ n ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe, n waa su Korowii siwi.
N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ ń che Mmara ta teŋa ta dɛ́ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe n waa su o siwi.
Kɛ n dɛ nyin ń che yarada maa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la ta, dɛ́ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe n waa su o siwi.
Nɛndɛɛɡe ɛɛ le Korowii be o kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ nɛra la bwa baa yarada Yeesu.
N waa bwaa kɛ ń won jemɛ Yeesu Kristo, dɛ́ won jemɛ kpeɡri la soo waa ira seo ta dɛ dɔ, dɛ́ na wahala waa naa la dɔŋa, dɛ́ kpɔ n te ɛ kɛ n sewɔ ɡɛ waa sewa la, ɡɛ aa ɛ ń won ir seo ta ɡɛ waa ira la.
Siwi swɛɛra dɛ won tel waa jaɡa N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ n denɔ won do kaih dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe dɛ ka tonɛ.
Akai!
N ta swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ nyin ń won do ɡɛ bwa Yeesu Kristo aa lee mɛ ŋɔ ń do la.
Yabala, maa lii kɛŋɔ n tonɛ wobɛlbwa.
Webeŋkpoŋii hiah mɛ.
N ɡel waa aa lɔ habɔɔ, dɛ takapɔ dɛɛ la sie, dɛ́ won ka dɔ anɔ la aa lɔ sie la, dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ won tel a jaɡa dɛ́ won dɔ kembɔr.
Korowiirii yer mɛ ŋɔ ń ba dɛ́ ba do o be, Yeesu Kristo nomanta.
A waa n swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ nyin ń won dɔ kembɔr la.
A wer kɛŋɔ ya banɔ la bwa yaa kpeɡa Korowii waa la ta la dɔ ɡɛ liire.
Dɛ he bane ɡe liire korɔ waa nɔ ane ta naa, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo a bini chaah tɛ heya.
Kɛ ɡɛ bwa yaa wona dɛ jemɛ la, yá kpoŋe a bini dɛɛ la.
Yabala, hé kpɔ n da, dɛ́ɛ nyiŋi nɛra ɡe baa dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ yaa dɛ teŋɛ la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra warɔ baa wola ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta teŋɛ.
N fa baɡle ba waa he be kera aŋwɛnɛ bwa, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ baɡle heyaa taraken sinii ne ŋɔ ba ɛ Yeesu Kristo seo waa sewa daɡaɡre la ta la waa dɔm.
Ŋwɛnɛ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ aa kpɔ o ta la dɛ kaa ba ne seo ta.
Ba kpɔ tea ne bwadabii waa ɡwaa Korowii.
Waa aa ɛ sihihwaa la, a nee baa ta nyoa.
Ba liire bwa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta.
Kɛ harɛ nɔ ta ya bwɛɛ ɛɛ.
Ya bwɛɛ lɔ nyundua.
Yaa lɔ bonɔ nɔ, ya siwi swɛɛrɔ yaa kpa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ la ó le bela ba.
Dɛ o balaa, wɛɛ beɡre ya bwadabisale aa won pɔeh nɔɔ á do wer kɛŋɔ o ɡbaɡba bwadabii aa do wer kohona ɡɛ la.
O kpeɡri taa wɛɛ ba ɡɛ ɛɛ.
O dɔ kpeɡri kɛŋɔ o won ɡel komɛlbwa no o be.
Yabala haa ɛ n nɛnnyina, he pɛla laɡ mɛ.
He bee n silɛɛ do, he waa baa ba men tɔɔ dawa.
Anomanta, n dandɛɛɡa, hé che kiŋkiŋ pɛɛ ya ne ya Dɔɔ aa pɛa la ta.
Jae wa N dɛ soŋe Yoodia ne Sentiki kɛŋɔ bá kwaa ba baah dɛ́ ɛ beŋkpoŋ pɛɛ ya ne ya Dɔɔ aa pɛa la ta.
N dɔŋdɛɛɡe, n dɛ soŋe, cha haahna la dɛ́ kwaa ba baah, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba cha mɛ Amanesoma nɔ bola ta ɡa.
Klɛmɛnt ne n bala tom-ɛɛra la ɡe jao.
Ba sɔna lɔ Korowii Mkpa Tɔn bini.
Hé che pɛɛ he ne ya Dɔɔ aa pɛa la ta dɛ́ ɡel he sie lɛ.
Kasinteŋ, hé ɡel he sie lɛ.
Hé ɡel nomɛlbwa jemɛ he waa kɛ he pwɛre.
Ya Dɔɔ bala la pu yaa tonɛ.
He bɛ ɡel wobɛlbwa ha heya, kɛ hé kpɔ wobɛlbwa dɛɛ do Korowii nɔn ta dɛɛ soŋo waa aa hiah heya, dɛ́ɛ jaamo kɛ waa dɛ no he wesoŋa.
Belaa ó ɡe tɛ heyaa o bambisɔn waa ɡwaa bambisɔn te bwa nɛwɛnyini be á cha heya, dɛ́ ɡel he bambile ne liire chɔ bobeŋkpoŋ pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la wa.
Too, yabala, anɔ la aa kaa laanee nɔ.
Hé ɡel he liire do wedɛɛɡa ta.
Wobɛlbwa aa ɛ kasinteŋ, ne anɔ la aa dɔ jirima, ne anɔ la aa toɡra, ne anɔ la aa do kaih, ne waa aa wera, dɛ anɔ la aa dɔ pɛla, wobɛlbwa aa ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛ chɛ kpɛɛra la, hé ɡel he liire do a ta.
Wobɛlbwa haa hwela dɛ dɔ le n be, kɛɛ dɛ no dɛ na mɛɛ ɛ la, hé ɡee ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ Korowii waa dɛ tɛ nɛra bambisɔn la ja he nɛ.
Koŋkɛɛla ane jaama wa N sie lɛo kohona pɛɛ ya ne ya Dɔɔ aa pɛa nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he berɔ kwaa dɛɛ do n liire dɛ́ cha mɛ taraken.
He fa cha mɛ ka.
A ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ haa berɛ dɛɛ lii n waa kpa.
Kɛ bɔree he fa aa wola dɔe dɛ́ nyiŋ mɛ.
N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ n nyao.
Akai.
N wono hweli wobɛlbwa maa lɔ a ta n soɡa bini a man mɛ, n sie lɛ a ta.
Dɛ n nyao waa, n jemɛ ɡɛ maa so.
N berɔ dɔ ɡe aa, n jemɛ a ɡe ɡba soɡa.
N hweli wobɛlbwa a man mɛ.
Kondikwaa lole n di dɛ vaɡoo, kondikwaa toole n chɔ lɔr oo, n dɔɔ kohona kɛɛ nyae n nya oo, n won a bɛlbwa kpoŋa.
N won Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ cha mɛ la kpeɡri ta cheɡa dɛ́ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
Kɛ haa kpɔ n waa berɛ he bwa wa, dɛ cha mɛ n wahala ta la, he ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
He ɡba jemɔ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ saŋ maa ba he be Makidoonia harɛ loɡle la dɛ bol Amanesoma la dɛɛ tɛ heyaa asɛ dɛ kpɔ bela dɛɛ kaa la, asɔre tena baa lɔ bwɛɛre la ta la bɛlbwa ta men chae.
He Felepae tena ɡboo koh toma maa ɛa he bini la waa dɛ cha mɛ suuɡa ne.
Hale n fa aa lɔ Tesalonika la, he fa wono ha mɛ kwaa aa hiah mɛ.
Kerabeŋkpoŋ kwara laa.
Kasinteŋ, a ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ komɛlee mɛɛ nyin he be, kɛ he tɔnɔ haa dɔ dɛ́ le chae haa cha mɛ la binii mɛɛ nyiŋi.
N dɔ komɛlbwa maa dɛ nyin la bwa ka ɡarɛ.
N dɔ he haala haa ha mɛ la le Epafrodaetɔs be.
He haala la ɛ sarahadɛɛɡe o sɔɔh aa soma dɛ tɛ Korowii dɛɛ su o siwi.
N Naa Korowii ɛɛ cha heyaa komɛlbwa haa nyaa la taa dɛ le o kondɔɔh tenten la ta, pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la wa.
Hɛ́ɛ tɛ N Naa Korowii jirima saŋ bɛlbwa.
Aamen.
Kala aa ka mun Too, he banɔ la bwa he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa he ɛ Korowii nɛra he waa toɡre la, n dɛ na heya.
He bala baa lɔ n be bonɔ la dɛ na heya.
Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la bwa dɛ na heya.
Banɔ la baa lɔ Rom koodem laanee dena dɛɛ na heyaa kohona.
Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ na nɛra sum la cha he bwa sekwaraa.
Aamen.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle Yeesu Kristo kasinteŋ webaɡla la bini kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ nɛra bane dɛ neɡre Kristo tena baa lɔ Kolosi la dɛɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, a chɛ kɛ baa tomɛ kwaa aa bea yaa wola an na.
Nɛra la berɔ dɛɛ baɡle ŋɔ, Kristo tena chɛ kɛ baa teŋɛ mmarare ane baa doa, ne ba nawee we-ɛɛla ane ta mɔɔ Korowii lɛɛ ba.
Pɔɔl dɛ bol ŋɔ, Korowii cheɡɛ Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ ta komɛlbwa, anomanta, Yeesuu dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won lɛ yaa kwaraa.
Ya kaa kpɔ ŋwɛnɛfale bɛlbwa ta naa, aa ɡeloo ya ne Korowii baah do jaŋne, ásɛ ya paŋɛ chae bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o cha yaa.
Men Yeesu Kristo torome Pɔɔl ne ya dɔŋ Timotii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
Korowii tetooraa o tɛ yaa toma nɔ.
Ya chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ yabala haa lɔ Kolosi dɛ ɛ Korowii nɛra, asɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ, hɛɛ teŋɛ o nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne la.
Ń Naa Korowii cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Korowii jaama ne wesoŋa Ya dɛ jam ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii he waa ya wesoŋa bini saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya noɔ kɛŋɔ he dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo kɛrɛdɛ dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo, dɛɛ nyin Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa ɡe.
Amanesoma aa ɛ kasinteŋ la aa ba he be loɡla la, he no hwɛɡa aa dɛ tɛ la wa.
He yarada ne nɛnnyin la le kwaa haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta la ta.
Korowii ɡe kwaa a bwa cheɡ heyaa Korowii doa kɛrɛdɛ ken.
Amanesoma la perɔ, nɛra ɛɛ noa harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, aa ba hɛɛra ne.
Gɛ tentenee aa ba hɛɛra ne he be dɛ le awola haa noa Korowii pili he sie he jemɛ suna waa sune he nɛɛ dɛ cha heyaa la.
Epafras bee he no Amanesoma la le.
Ya ne o bwaa pɛa dɛɛ ɛ toma nɔ.
O ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ yaa nyinu kɛrɛdɛ.
Ya naa taa o che dɛɛ cha heya.
O bol ya be ɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa cha heyaa asɛ hɛɛ nyin dɔŋa.
Anomanta, ya le awola yaa no he waa dɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ ó Domadɛɛɡe baɡle heyaa o wobɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ berɛ dɛɛ pili he sie hé won jemɛ wobɛlbwa aa ɛ Korowii tetoora la, dɛ́ won do ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ ya Dɔɔ torome do, he wobɛlbwa won su o siwi, he won dɛ́ɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi, dɛ́ won jemɛ Korowii kohona, dɛ́ won dɔ kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ le o ɡbaɡba kpeɡri waa do kan dɛ dɔ jirima kɛrɛdɛ la ta.
N dɛ soŋe Korowii ó cha heyaa ɡɛ hé won lawɛ bambile wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ won kpɔ silɛɛ dɛ́ɛ jaamo waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ la wa.
Onee ɡela ya chɛ kɛ ya ne o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa won dɔ kondɛɛɡa waa dɔa tɛ o bii baa ja o Kora waa ɛ Bochaah Kora la ta.
O lɛ yaa le biro ta dɛ kpɔ yaa ka ja o Bie waa dɛ nyinu la Kora ta.
O Bie laanee lɛ yaa le Bɔnsam nɔn ta dɛ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa ɡe kɛ yaa la.
Yeesu Kristo ɛ nomoa komɛlbwa nɛ Yaa won Korowii na.
Gɛ Korowii aa doa la, ɡɛɛ o Bie ɡe do.
O Bie la lole mɔɔ o ta komɛlbwa.
O Bie la nɛɛ o che dɛ ta komɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ ta ne komɛlbwa waa lɔ nyundua, anɔ la yaa dɛ naa ne anɔ la yaa wola an na kɛŋɔ nyundua toroma ne konchɔɡa aa dɛ di kpeɡri bwa soo siwi.
O Bie la nɛɛ o che dɛ taa, asɛ a do le tɛo.
Gɛ saŋ a bɛlbwa fa aa wola toole la, dɛ o te lole.
Onee lawɛ komɛlbwa kpoŋe, a ta do le ba le fini nɔ la.
Onee asɔre tena bwa nyu, ba ɡee o bwadabi.
Onee tɔ sie komɛlbwa nɛ, dɛ tɔ sie ir seo ta nomɛlbwa nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ on chɛ kɛ ó ɛ nomoa komɛlbwa nɛ.
Korowii tetooraa o Bie Yeesu ɛ o ɡbaɡba.
O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ che o Bie la nɛɛ dɛ kwaa o ne kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ne harɛ bwa baah.
O ɡelɔ o Bie sewɛ daɡaɡre la ta o chal kwaa wobɛlbwa.
He fa aa Korowii jemɛ dɛ ɛ o dɔma, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he fa dɛ lii liichɔɡa, dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Kɛ name Yeesu Kristo aa baa ɛ nɛn dɛ sewɛ la, Korowii cheɡɛ o seo la ta dɛ kwaa he ne o baah, dɛ ɡel he won do kaih doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole he nɛ, nomɛlbwa aa wola he waa dɔe ba dɛ bol awola haa ba che Korowii sie la.
Dɛ he ta kpoŋe waa haa dɛ yaradaa la bini, he ta habɔɔ leɛ, dɛ dɔ hwɛɡa le Amanesoma la baa bola baɡle heyaa he no la ta kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa won chɔɡ he liire he bɛ dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ kpa aa, amɔ hɛɛ wonoo che o sie.
Ba dɛ bol Amanesoma nɔ bobɛlbwa.
N ɡbabir dɛ bola, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii lee mɛ.
Gɛ Pɔɔl aa ɛ toma tɛ asɔre tena Taraken a do n som kɛ maa lɛ he wahala dɛɛ na.
Wahala lole ń che Yeesu Kristo naa ta dɛ́ na tɛ asɔre tena baa ɛ o bwadabii la.
Anomanta, a do n som kɛ maa dɛ ba wona na wahala aa kaa la ane, ásɛ a won tonɛ.
N ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ o asɔre tena.
Korowiirii koh he chae waa dɛ tɛ mɛ a ɡɛ toma nɔ, dɛ ŋɔ mɛɛ baɡle o waa la bwa ásɛ nɛra bwa no.
Korowii waa la fa sɔɔh saŋ la bwa, nɛra ta a mun jemɛ.
Kɛ taraken te, o pili a bwa bini dɛ tɛ o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, bá na dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin kɛ ó ɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la baah.
O waa waa pili a bini la ɛ wedɛɛɡa aa ɛ wejena dɛɛ kpo nyoa.
Anee kɛ Yeesu Kristo Doma soɡe he nɛ, he dɔ hwɛɡa o be kɛ tɔpebɛl hɛɛ dɔ jirima o bee.
Ya waa yaa dɛ baɡle bwaa Yeesu Kristo la.
Ya dɛ ja nomɛlbwa, dɛɛ baɡle nɛra bwa wejema bwa ne, ásɛ dɛ ba won kpɔ bɛlbwa ba Korowii be kɛ ba kpeɡ Yeesu Kristo waa ta, pɛɛ ba ne waa pɛa la nomanta.
A waa ɡela n swɛɛ siwi dɛ takapɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma la.
Yeesu Kristoo tɛ mɛ kpeɡri ɡa n won dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ toma la.
N dɛ nyin he jemɛ ɡɛ n siwi aa swɛɛra mɛɛ koh n te he ne Laodisia tena ne nɛra baa wola men jemɛ la wa, dɛ́ do he bwa ɡbemba he won nyin dɔŋa dɛ́ ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ won jemɛ Korowii wesɔɔhla waa pili a bini tɛ heyaa la kɛrɛdɛ, he bɛ aahna-aahna tamaa bɛlbwa ɛ, dɛ́ dɔ tɔnɔ le o waa la bini kɛrɛdɛ.
O waa laanee Yeesu Kristo.
Korowii wejema aa wola jaɡa dɔe la bwa lɔ Yeesu Kristo be.
O nɛɛ ya che dɛ dɔ ɡɛ wejema nɔ.
N dɛ baɡle heyaa ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ won kpɔ nyotor neɡre heya.
N toole he be, kɛ n liire te lɔ he be.
Anomanta, a do n som kɛ he bwa aa pɛa, asɛ dɛ lawɛ yaradae haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ la.
Kpɔ he te pɛl Yeesu dɛ́ kpeɡ o waa la ta Haa dɔa kpɔ he te tɛ Yeesu Kristo kɛ he Dɔɔ nɔ, hé ne o pɛ wobɛlbwa ta.
A taa aa ba cheɡa he won che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ kpeɡ o waa la ta, dɛ́ won yarada o waa bwa kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ baa baɡle heyaa la, dɛ́ɛ jam Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.
Webaɡla ane lole bane ɛɛ baɡle dɛɛ yera wejema.
Hé nyiŋa kɛrɛdɛ.
A ɛ nyosone kɛɛ wepuu ba kpɔ dɛɛ neɡre nɛra.
Nɛwɛnyini nawee waa, ne koŋkwaa aa dɛ di kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta wejema waa baa baɡle la.
Yeesu Kristo be laa a le.
Yeesu Kristo ɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba.
O ba harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ba berɛ nɛwɛnyini.
He ne waa pɛa la, he dɔ komɛlbwa.
Onee dɔ sɔn waa ɡwaa kwaa yaa wola an na bwa soo siwi sɔn.
He ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la, o teŋe he dobene la ta.
O ɡe penteŋaa la.
He te teŋa nɔ ta ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ teŋe la ɛɛ.
Korowii nee ba fa aa sɔ heyaa la, anee baɡla kɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo bwaa ba pɛ huɡe.
Asɛ a berɛ che yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii ne kpeɡri waa kpɔa ir Yeesu seo ta la ta, he ne o bwa pɛ ir dɛ dɔ mkpa.
He wechɔɡa ne he dobene Korowii fa aa wola teŋe ta la ɡelɔ he fa do kɛŋɔ he serewɔ.
Kɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la, Korowii kpɔ he bwa wechɔɡa kɛ heya, dɛ tɛ he bwa mkpafale.
Teŋa haa ŋɔa ŋɔ hɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmara taa dɛ berɛ horɛ a bar heyaa la, a bwa taa o le heya.
Waa a waa pɛɛ kpa.
Korowii kpaa a bwa pɛl Yeesu daɡaɡre la ta a tonɛ.
Yeesu seo waa sewa la, o chɔɡ kwaa aa dɔ kpeɡri bwa kpeɡri, dɛ lɛ a kpeɡri dɔɔh.
O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ ɡel sihiih kpoa nɛra bwa siwi ta, bá jemɛ kɛŋɔ o ɡelɔ koŋkpeɡa la bwa kpeɡri ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Anomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ pwah heyaa kwaa ane haa dɛ di, ne kwaa haa dɛ nyɔ, ne he tɔpejena dii benanyoa ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, ne Ona Tɔpera ta naa, he bɛ on dawɛ.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ fa tɔ sie chiɡ dɛɛ baɡle waa aa dɛ ba ɛɛ kerekere la kɛŋɔ nɛn lileo aa tɔ o sie, waa wola o ɡbaɡba ɛɛ la.
Yeesu Kristo waa la aa bala la, anee waa la tenten.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ pwah heyaa ŋɔ haa ɡɛ waa teŋe nyosone ŋɔ pwɛraa wɛɛ pwɛr o te dɛɛ tomɛ nyundua toroma la ta teŋaa, he bɛ on dawɛ.
Gɛ nɛn nɔ dɛ maŋkura o te kɛŋɔ o dɛ na waa deera ta, dɛɛ yerɛ o te nɛnjen, kɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Nɛwɛnyini liire taa wɛɛ teŋɛ, dɛ vɛh o te kpɔe dɛ́ do Yeesu Kristo lɔɡa.
Onee ya nyu, asɛ ya ɛ o bwadabii dɛɛ dɔ bokpeɡa o be, bɛlbwa lawɛ o dɔŋ kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ ya ne o ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ che pɛɛ yaa pɛa la ta dɛ ɡel yaa kpeɡ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin.
He ne Yeesu Kristo pɛo dɛ sewɛ, anomanta, he ne koŋkwaa aa dɛ di kpeɡri harɛ nɔ ta toole wobɛlbwa bini kpa.
Aah bɔkwa waa he ta kpɔ he te dɛɛ do harɛ nɔ ta kii ta dɛ ɡel a vɔrɔwe heyaa ŋɔ, “He bɛ onɔ lawɛ, dɛ bɛ onɔ daɡɛ, dɛ bɛ onɔ leɡe” nɔɔ?
Gɛ kwaa nɔ ɛ kwaa dɛ he ɛa aa, dɛ a waa tonɔ.
Nɛwɛnyini kii ne ba nawee waa a te.
Kpela, nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ duu nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ta la kɛ ba ɛ wejerema, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba Korowii toma aa swɛɛ ba siwi kohona waa baa pwɛr ba te dɛɛ ha ba bwadabii la.
Kɛ a bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Aa won ɡel nomɛlbwa lawɛ o te dɛ́ ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Dɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo bwaa pɛa ir seo ta te naa, amɔ te hé swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ ɡel he bambile che kwaa aa lɔ nyundua la ta.
Belaa Yeesu do dɛ so nomombɔr Korowii diɡ ta.
Hé ɡel he liire bwa do kwaa aa lɔ nyundua la ta, dɛ́ ɡel kwaa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he do kɛŋɔ nɛra baa serewa a bɔr, he toole a ta kpa.
He mkpa lɔ Yeesu Kristo be, o ɡe do Korowii be.
Awola Yeesu Kristo he mkpa aa lɔ o be aa ba harɛ ta la, he ne o bwa ɛɛ pɛo dɛ ba ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ ba dɔ jirima o bala la ta.
Dabene ne dafale Anomanta, hé ɡel he harɛ nɔ ta dor bwa ta kwaraa.
He bɛ he bwadabii kpɔ do jwamane, ne wedoŋa, ne kayɛɡlɛ, ne pɛlchɔɡa, dɛ kwaa ta sibeɡra ta.
Kwaa ta sibeɡra do kɛŋɔ voɡa toma ken.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ, Korowii bwaawee dɛ ir a ta taeh.
Wɛɛ kpɔ wahalaa ta nɛra baa dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ la nɛ.
He ne ba bwaa fa lɔ a ta dɛɛ ɛ. Kɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɡel a bwa sekwaraa taraken te.
Hé laa bandia kpɔ he waa ta, he baah bɛ dɛɛ di saɡasaɡa, hé ɡel meesɔhwa, he bɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ chɛɡre, he bɛ ɡel wobochɔɡa ɛɛ le he nyoo.
He bɛ nyosone teŋe dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he laa he dabene la ne o we-ɛɛla la bwa kpɔ he nɛ, dɛ́ charɛ dafale.
Korowiirii ɡela he do ɡɛ la.
Onee dɛɛ kwaa he dafale la saŋ bɛlbwa ásɛ he do kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ waa doa la, dɛ́ won jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ.
Anomanta, nɛra Korowii aa ɡela ba do ɡɛ dofale nɔ la, ba ta dɔe kɛ ba peɡri dɔŋa bini kpa kɛŋɔ onɔ ɛ Juu te kɛɛ onɔ nɔ ta Juu te ɛɛ nɔ.
Nɛra bini peɡra toole kpa, kɛŋɔ onɔ teŋe o pen, kɛɛ onɔ nɔ ta o pen teŋe nɔ.
Hɔɔh kɛɛ daamun te kɛɛ yom kɛɛ nɛn waa dɔ o te toole kpa, ba bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Yeesu Kristo ɡbo waa hiah o nɛra.
Heyaa Korowii bidɛɛɡa waa le heyaa tɛ o te, dɛ laa he doŋa bwa kpɔ he nɛ, dɛɛ nyin heyaa kɛrɛdɛ.
Anomanta, hé kpoŋe dadɛɛɡe dɛ́ dɔ tedoma, dɛ́ ta tea dɛ́ɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛ́ɛ pwɛr he te, dɛ́ɛ tɛ nɛra sie, dɛ́ dɔ bambile tɛɛ ba.
Dɛ he bini bɛlbwa ne o dɔŋ dɔ waa aa, ó lawɛ bambile dɛ́ kpɔ kɛo.
Gɛ Korowii aa kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛ heyaa la, ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛ he ɡe kpɔ dɔŋa kwaa dɛ́ɛ kɛ ba.
Anɔ nɔ habɔɔ, hɛ́ɛ nyin nɛn.
Nɛnnyinii dɛ́ won ɡel he dɔ nyopɛo dɛ́ ɛ anɔ bwa kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ.
Hé ɡel nyopɛo waa aa le Yeesu Kristo be la do he bambile bini wobɛlbwa ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii yerɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛ́ dɔ nyopɛo.
Hé ɡel he sie ɛɛ su waa waa ɛa tɛ heya, hɛ́ɛ jaamo.
Hé ɡel Yeesu Kristo waa la do he bambile bini kɛrɛdɛ hɛ́ɛ baɡle dɔŋa, dɛ́ɛ ja ba wejema bwa ne, dɛ́ ɡo wesoŋa yela ne kpɛɛra yela dɛ́ɛ jam Korowii he bambile bwa.
Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ ne anɔ la bwa haa dɛ bol la, hɛ́ɛ ɛa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu sɔn ta, dɛ́ che o nɛɛ dɛ́ɛ jam o Mɛɛ Korowii.
Mmarare aa chɔ le tɛ Kristo tena deremi Haahna, hɛ́ɛ no he jaranar wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra ba ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu aa pɛa ɛɛ ɛ.
He baala ɡe, hɛ́ɛ nyin he haahna kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ban dɛ́ɛ panya.
Bechale, hɛ́ɛ no he nyare ne he mɛɛnanar waa saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ dɛɛ lɛ Korowii sie.
Mɛɛnanar, he bɛ he bii dɛ́ɛ do bandia ne, ásɛ ba bambile ba chɔɡ.
Bonɔɔna ne toli ɡe, hɛ́ɛ no nɛra haa dɛ tom ba harɛ nɔ ta la waa saŋ bɛlbwa.
He bɛ ba siebɔr na mɔɔ dɛ́ɛ tom ba dɛ́ɛ nyin baa kpɛɛ heya.
Hé ta tea dɛ́ɛ tom ba ɔma haa dɛ ɔmɛ he Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nomanta.
Wobɛlbwa haa dɛɛ ɛ la, hɛ́ɛ ɛa bambile bwa ne kɛŋɔ he Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristoo he ɛ dɛɛ tɛ.
Nɛn laa he ɛ dɛɛ tɛ.
He Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristoo he ɛ dɛɛ tɛ.
He jemɛ kɛŋɔ o bee hɛɛ ba kembɔr waa kpɔa cheɡ o nɛra la dɔe.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, wɛɛ dɔ o wechɔɡa kembɔree.
Korowii aa bane siwii nyiŋi ɡwaa bane.
He banɔ la haa dɔ bonɔɔna ne toli la, hɛ́ɛ ɛɛ ba waa aa toɡra dɛ do wer, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɡba lɔ nomɛl lɔɡa, o do Korowii doa.
Wejaala ane ɡe wa Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ́ ɡel he sie ɡe do a ta.
Hé ɡel he siwi su waa waa ɛa tɛ heyaa hɛ́ɛ jaamo.
Hé soŋe Korowii dɛ́ɛ tɛ ya ɡba, ásɛ o tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ ya won bol o Waa dɛ́ baɡle o wesɔɔhla aa ɛ Yeesu Kristo waa la.
A waa ba koh do mɛ dea nɔ.
Hɛ́ɛ soŋo ń won dɛɛ bola kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ ń bol a bwa a bini chaah la.
Hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ɛ nɛra baa wola asɔre tena ɛɛ la, ásɛ dɛ he dɔ ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa naa, hé che o ta dɛ́ won dɔɔ ba tɛ Korowii.
Hé ɡel he wobol do som dɛ́ɛ lɛ sie saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛ ba pɛɛ heyaa wobɛlbwa naa, hé won jemɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ he bol.
Kala aa ka mun Yɔɔ, ya dɔŋ Tichikos yaa dɛ nyinu o waa dɔ kasinteŋ, wɛɛ cha yaa, ya ne o bwa ɛɛ ɛ ya Dɔɔ toma nɔ la, wɛɛ ba baɡle n waa bwa he bee.
A waa mɛɛ tomɔ he be ó ba bol ya waa bwa, ásɛ he baah sɔɔh heyaa la.
O ne ya dɔŋ Onisemɔs o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ yaa nyinu la bwaa mɛɛ tomɛ, ásɛ ba ba bol waa aa dɛ chiɡ bonɔ bwa he be.
Onisemɔs te ɛ he bwɛɛ te.
Aristakus baa do n ne on dea la, ne Banabas nime Mak dɛ na heya.
A ɡɛ Mak nɔ waa n faa bol he be la.
O ba he be naa, hé lɛo silɛɛ ne.
Jeses baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Jastos la ɡe dɛ na heya.
Juu tena baa yarada Yeesu la bini, nɛra batoro nɔ ɡboo dɛɛ cha mɛ, n ne baa ɛ Korowii Kora la toma.
Ba dɛ cha mɛ taeh.
Epafras waa ɛ he bwɛɛ te la dɛ na heya.
O dɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo toma, dɛ soŋe Korowii kɛrɛdɛ ɡa dɛɛ tɛ heyaa saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ o ɡel he won che kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ jemɛ o waa kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ, ásɛ Yeesu Kristo waa bɛ heyaa aahna-aahna ɛ, he won ɛ Korowii tetoowaa bwa.
N ɡbabir na ɡɛ Epafras aa dɛ tomɛ he ne banɔ la baa lɔ Laodisia ne Heɛrapɔles la kohona.
Tɛɛɡa te Luk ya bwa aa dɛ nyinu la ne Demas ɡe dɛ na heya.
Hé ŋɔ yabala baa lɔ Laodisia la ne Nimfa ne asɔre tena baa dɛ cheme Nimfa dem la be ŋɔ n dɛ na ba.
Dɛ he baa kure tɔn nɔ tonaa, hé ɡel ba ka kuro baɡle asɔre tena baa lɔ Laodisia la.
Tɔn maa tɛ ba ɡe la, hé lɛ dɛ́ ka kure.
Hé ŋɔ Akipus be ŋɔ ó do sie dɛ́ ɛ toma ya Dɔɔ Yeesu aa kpɔa tɛo la bwa kɛrɛdɛ ken.
Men Pɔɔl ɡbaɡbaa chwerɛ bonɔ la, n dɛ na heya.
Hɛ́ɛ lii n waa kɛ ba ta aa do mɛ jɔɡrɔre n chɔ dea, dɛ́ soŋe Korowii dɛ́ɛ tɛ mɛ.
Kórowii sune he nɛ dɛ́ cha heya.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ do Kristo tena baa lɔ Tesalonika la ɡbemba.
O dɛ jam Korowii, Yeesu yaradae baa yaradao la wa.
O berɔ dɛɛ lii ba ɡɛ on Pɔɔl soɡa bini fa aa doa ɡɛ saŋ waa soɡe ba be la.
O dɛ nyin kɛ baa hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛ, ásɛ a do wer tɛɛ ba kerekere ba bɛ wahala ba na.
O dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ bá so sodɛɛɡa dɛɛ kpa Yeesu Kristo bala tɔpere la, ásɛ o bɛ ban ba piɡri.
Men Pɔɔl ne Silas ne Timotii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he nɛra haa ɛ asɔre tena dɛ do Tesalonika dɛɛ tomɛ N Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la.
Kórowii cha heya, dɛ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Tesalonika asɔre tena yarada ne ba we-ɛɛla Ya dɛ jam Korowii tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛ yon dɛɛ yerɛ he sɔna ya Korowii soŋa bini.
Gɛɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa ɡe yaa bol N Naa Korowii waa bera ɛ ya Mɛɛ la be he yarada haa yaradao dɛ won kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ o toma, ne he nyina haa dɛ nyinu dɛ ɡel he sie beɡre o toma ta, ne hwɛɡa haa dɔa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo be dɛ won dɛɛ lawɛ bambile wobɛlbwa ta la.
Yabala, ya jemɔ kɛ Korowii dɛ nyin heya, dɛ le heyaa ŋɔ hé ba ɛ o bii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Amanesoma la yaa baɡle heyaa la, wobol ɡbo ta laa a che dɛ ba he be.
Awola haa no waa la, Korowii kpeɡri la ne o Domadɛɛɡe la ɡelɔ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ɛ kpela.
He jemɛ ɡɛ yaa koh he waa dɛ kpoŋe ya te ɡɛ saŋ ya ne haa soɡa la.
Hé nyiŋi yaa dɛ́ kpɔ ya ne ya Dɔɔ da la.
Haa no Korowii Waa la dɛ yaradaa la, he na wahala ɡa, kɛ he wono lɛ Korowii Waa la silɛɛ aa le Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la be ne.
Gɛ haa ɛa laanee chɔa dɛ tɛ nɛra baa yaradaa Makidoonia harɛ ne Akaya harɛ bwa, baa nyiŋi dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii.
He bee ya Dɔɔ la waa che dɛ perɛ baah bela bwa.
Bela tena ɡbo laa noa, kɛ yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii la tel bobɛlbwa.
Anomanta, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ yá bol he waa nɛra be kpa.
Ba ɡbabir dɛ bol he wa, ɡɛ haa kpoŋe yaa dɛ no ya be, dɛ charɛ he liire le voɡa aa wola mkpa dɔe la ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ dɔ mkpa la, dɛ so kpa o Bie Yeesu waa dɛ ba nyundua lee dɛ ba la.
Onee o chum seo ta la.
Onee lɛ yaa le Korowii bandia waa dɛ ba bala la ta.
Pɔɔl toma ɛɛ Tesalonika Yabala, he ɡbabir jemɔ kɛ chɔɔra yaa chɔɔ heyaa la ta pɛɛ ɛɛ.
He jemɔ kɛ ba tɔ sie ɛ yaa hɔhɔrɔwa Felepae dɛ chɛɡre yaa taeh mɔɔ ya ba he be Amanesoma la ne la.
Kɛ Korowii tɛ yaa bansua ya won bol o waa la.
Jae yaa dɛ ja nɛra la, kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ taa, neɡra laa yaa neɡre nɛra, wedoŋa ɡe laa ya lii.
Anɔ la Korowii aa dɛ nyin laanee yaa bol.
Yanee o dɔ hwɛɡa tɛ kɛŋɔ ya bol o Amanesoma la.
Anomanta, yaa anɔ la nɛwɛnyini sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta bol, kɛ anɔ la Korowii waa jemɛ bambile bɛlbwa waa la aa dɛ nyin la, anee yaa bol.
Gɛ haa jema la, he kpɛɛra waa laa ya koh ba he be.
Ya ta balɛ dɛ ba bol waa dɛ neɡre heyaa dɛ lɛ kwaane ɡe.
Korowii ɡboo jema.
Ya ta sɔn nyine dɛ le he ne nomɛlbwa be.
Ya ɛ Yeesu Kristo toroma, dɛ fe dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ya lɛ komɛl le he be.
Kɛ ya tɛ heyaa sisɔna kɛŋɔ haah naa ta tea dɛɛ dɛɛ o bechasɔɔhna la.
Ya nyin he waa ya bambile bwa ne.
Korowii Amanesoma la ɡbo ne laa ya ba he be.
Yaa nyin he waa ɡɛ la, a ɛ yaa silɛɛ kɛŋɔ ya kpɔ ya te ja wobol la ta dɛ tɛ heya.
Yabala, haa ya toma ne ya koeh la waa lii kɛɛ?
Ya ɛ toma chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa, ásɛ ya bɛ he bɛlbwa koeh do ɡɛ saŋ yaa lɔ he be dɛ bol Korowii Amanesoma la dɛɛ baɡle heyaa la.
He nɛra haa yaradaa ne Korowii bwa ɛ ya danseɛ tena, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he nao kɛ ya we-ɛɛla wer, ya waa toɡre dɛ lɛ Korowii sie, doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole a ta.
He nao ɡɛ yaa do he bini bɛlbwa ɡbemba ɡɛ baa yon dɛɛ ɛ o bii la.
Ya do heyaa ɡbemba dɛ larawe he bwara dɛ do heyaa ŋɔ hé so sodɛɛɡa, ásɛ he waa lɛ Korowii sie.
Onee le heyaa he ba ɛ o bii, dɛ kpɔ o Kora la ne o nyanyini la pera tɛ heya.
Ya dɛ jam Korowii tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ yaa bol Korowii Waa la he be la, he noa kɛŋɔ Korowii Wa.
He ta an noɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn wa.
Gɛɛ a do kpela.
A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma he nɛra haa yaradaa nɔ bini la.
Yabala, he ne Korowii nɛra baa lɔ Juda harɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ wahala baa naa Juu tena be la, he ɡe na a dɔŋa he bwɛɛ tena be.
Juu tena nɔɔ kpo ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ne Korowii keamere la, dɛ hah yaa, dɛ doŋi yaa la.
Gɛ nɛnchɔɡa nɔ aa Korowii siwi su.
Ba ɛ nɛra bwa dɔm, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba dɛ tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ ya bɛ Korowii Waa la bol chaɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ásɛ Korowii bɛ ban lɛ.
Anomanta, ba wechɔɡa dɛ warɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, ásɛ Korowii bwaawee ir ba nɛ.
Pɔɔl aa dɛ nyin o berɛ ka na Tesalonika asɔre tena Ya te la, yabala, baa doŋi yaa le he be tɔpere tamaa nɔ la, ya ta he waa soɛh.
Kɛ nae yaa wola heyaa na.
Yaa le he be la, dɛ he be bala swɛɛ ya siwi, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ sikii lawɛ yaa taeh.
Yaa dɛ nyin he be bala la, ya takapɔ ɡɛ yaa ɛ dɛ na heyaa ja.
Men Pɔɔl yon takapɔ kɛ n fe ɛɛ ba he bee.
Kɛ Bɔnsam aa yaa ŋwɛnɛ tɛ.
Ya sie beɡra aa beɡra nɔ, he bee ya hwɛɡa ne silɛɛ do.
He waa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɛɛ ba yaa tɔɔ dawa, ya hɛɡre awola waa ba ya ba che o sie la.
He nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa ya dɔ sɔn ne silɛɛ.
Ya haŋrɔ kahonɛ, yaa wola he waa no la, ya liiro kɛŋɔ aa do werii kɛ ya tomɛ Timoti he be ásɛ a ka ya nɛra banɛ ɡbo Atens.
Timoti ɛ ya dɔŋ dɛ ɛ Korowii torome dɛɛ bol Yeesu Kristo Amanesoma la wa.
Ya tomɔ ó ba do heyaa ɡbemba dɛ́ ja heyaa he yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii la bɔr, he bini bɛlbwa bɛ wahala nɔ waa koh dɛ́ chwa.
He bwa jemɔ kɛ ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛ ya na.
Ya ne haa lole la, ya bol wahala nɔ waa dɛ ba bala nɔ waa he be he jemɛ wubwa.
Asɛ ɡɛ yaa ŋɔa laanee bala la.
A waa ɡela n haŋre kahonɛ dɛ tomɛ Timoti, ásɛ dɛ jemɛ he yarada bini kɛŋɔ Bɔnsam ken baa neɡre heyaa dɛ ɡel ya toma yaa baa ɛ la ken ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Gbemba wobol aa le Timoti be Kɛ taraken Timoti aa le he be ba la, o ba amanesoma ne kɛŋɔ he dɛ yarada Korowii dɛɛ nyin nɛra ɡe.
O ŋɔ ya be ŋɔ he dɛ lii ya waa kɛrɛdɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, dɛɛ nyin kɛ he na yaa ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyin heyaa dɛ na la.
Yabala, ya wahala ne ya wenaale yaa dɛ na nɔ, ya ɡel a bwa.
He yarada ɡelɔ ya baah sɔɔh yaa he wa.
Dɛ he lawɛ Korowii waa la kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ naa, dɛ ya dɔ bokpeɡa.
Bɔkwa jaamee yaa ba wona kpɔ tɛ Korowii he waɔ?
Silɛɛ yaa dɔa le Korowii be nɔ kan.
He waa ɡela ya sie lɛ la.
Ya dɛ soŋe Korowii chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa, ásɛ dɛ na he siebɔr ja, dɛ́ bol waa aa dɛ ba wona cha heyaa he yarada bini, ásɛ he do kpeɡri ja.
N Naa Korowii ɡbabir waa bera ɛ ya Mɛɛ la ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɛɛ chaɡle yaa ŋwɛnɛɛ ya ba he be.
Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu ja heyaa dɔŋa nyina kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ hɛɛ nyin nomɛlbwa ɡɛ yaa dɛ nyin heyaa la.
Wɛɛ ɡeloo he do kpeɡri, dɛ bɛ wechɔɡa dɔ, dɛ́ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa N Naa Korowii waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ la be, awola o ne o toromedɛɛɡa la bwa aa ba la.
Sodɛɛɡa aa dɛ lɛ Korowii sie Anɔ la aa jaa la, yabala, waa la haa hwela ya be ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ he so ásɛ Korowii sie lɛ he nɛɛ la, ɡɛɛ hɛɛ ɛ la.
Ya cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu naa ta dɛɛ ja heyaa ŋɔ a chɛ kɛ he ɛ dɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ.
He jemɛ waa yaa cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ bol baɡle heyaa la.
Korowii dɛ nyin kɛ he ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa dɛ laa he te kpɔ jwamane ta.
Báa bɛlbwa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ kɛ wɛɛ mo haahnee ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta.
He bɛ siyala ne sibeɡra ŋwɛnɛ ta kpɔ kɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ baa wola Korowii tomɛ la.
Nomɛlbwa bɛ o dɔŋ nɛɛ jo a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɛɛ tɛr nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ la deŋnee, ɡɛ yaa ja heyaa loɡla la ŋɔ hé nyiŋi a ta kɛrɛdɛ la.
Korowii aa le yaa ŋɔ ya ɛ o bii la, o ta ŋɔe ŋɔ yá ba ɛ wedoŋa.
O ŋɔ yá ba ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola a ɡɛ waa nɔ ta teŋɛ la, dɛ nɛwɛnyini waa laa o vɛh, dɛ Korowii waa tɛ heyaa o Domadɛɛɡe la waa o vɛh.
Too.
Ane ɡee la.
A ta hiaih kɛ ya berɛ baɡle heyaa dɔŋa nyina waa kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii baɡle heyaa ŋɔ hé nyin dɔŋa.
Kasinteŋ, he dɛ nyin he bala baa lɔ Makidoonia harɛ la bwa.
Yabala, ya dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛ he bɛ waa nɔ ɡel, kɛ hé ɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ.
Hé takapɔ dɛ́ ɛ he te nɛŋɡwɛɡra dɛ bɛ nɛra waa ta dɛɛ jo.
Hé kpɔ he bokpeɡa ɛ toma, dɛ bɛ he te kpɔ dɛɛ dawɛ nɛra nɛ, ɡɛ yaa ŋɔ he be wubwa la.
He dɛ ɛ ken aa, hɛɛ dɔ jirima nɛra baa wola asɔre tena ɛɛ la bee, haa he tenee kpɔ dawɛ nɛra nɛ.
Ya dɔɔ la bala Yabala, ya dɛ nyin kɛ ya bol yabala baa serewa la wa, ásɛ he tea bini bɛ chɔɡ kohona kɛŋɔ nɛra baa kaa, baa wola hwɛɡa dɔe kɛŋɔ yaa ir seo taa la.
Ya yaradao kɛ Yeesu sewɔ dɛ ir.
Gɛ tentenee yaa yarada kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ ba banɔ la baa yarada Yeesu mɔɔ dɛ serewe la kpɔe dɛ́ ja Yeesu nɛɛ ba ne o ba ɡɛ saŋ waa ba la.
Ya Dɔɔ la waa waa bolaa nɔ.
Ya banɔ la yaa so le dɛ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ ya Dɔɔ la aa ba la, yaa yabala baa serewa la siee tɔ kaa ya Dɔɔ be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ la ɡbabir ɛɛ le nyundua dɛ́ tu ba, dɛ́ ba yerɛ o nɛra takpeɡ ne, ásɛ o nyundua toroma nomoa ɡe yerɛ, Korowii bɛla si tɔ o sie, ásɛ banɔ la baa yarada Yeesu Kristo mɔɔ dɛ serewe la ir, ásɛ Korowii kpɔ ba ne ya banɔ la ɡe ya ta aa soɡe le ɡɛ saŋ la bwa kaa nyundua baama bini, dɛ́ ka cheme ya Dɔɔ bela, ásɛ ya ne o so saŋ bɛlbwa.
Anomanta, hé kpɔ waa nɔ dɛɛ larawe dɔŋa bwara.
Hé so kpa he dɔɔ bala Yabala, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ń chwerɛ dɛ́ baɡle heyaa tɔpere la waa nɔ aa dɛ ba chiɡa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he bwa jemɔ kpela kɛŋɔ tɔpere ya Dɔɔ la aa ba la ɛɛ piɡruu kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ aa dɛ piɡri nɛn jwaana la.
Gɛ saŋ nɛra aa ba ŋɔ, “Bobɛlbwa sɔɔhnɔ, ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna name te” la, belaa dɛ harɛchɔɡ la ɛɛ ba ba piɡra.
Wɛɛ piɡruu kɛŋɔ haah naa kpoŋe tea asɛ lol tea lɔɔ la ken.
Gɛ saŋ la, baa bɔree dɔ dɛ chwa ka sɔh.
Kɛ yabala, he te toole biro ta, he sie chaah waa nɔ ta.
Anomanta, Yeesu bala la aa heyaa piɡri kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ.
He bwa sekwara ɛ nɛra he sie aa chaah Korowii waa ta.
Biro bini nɛra laa yan, bochaah ta nɛraa yan.
Anomanta, ya bɛ bɔhwaah ɛ kɛŋɔ bane aa dɛ ɛ la, kɛ hé ɡel ya sie chɔ harɛ yaa nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ.
Bɔhwaahra ne nɛra baa dɛ dɛɛ te bwa ɛ biro bini nɛra.
Ya te yaa ɛ bochaah ta nɛra nɔ, hé ɡel ya sie chɔ harɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ yarada ne nɛnnyin ɛ ya laa batakaare kɛŋɔ baa do laa batakaare dɛɛ yo laa la, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ hwɛɡa yaa dɔa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu be kɛŋɔ wɛɛ lɛ yaa la ɛ buni ɡbɛrɛ dɛ́ kpɔ pi.
Korowii ta yaa tae ŋɔ yá ba di bolchɔɡe o sie.
O ta yaa ŋɔ yá che ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ ya nyu.
Onee sewa tɛ yaa, ásɛ awola o balaa, dɛ ya soɡe mkpa ta noo, sewaa ya sewɛ oo, yá ne Korowii won pɛ.
Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ do dɔŋa ɡbemba dɛɛ cha dɔŋa, ɡɛ haa dɛ ɛ nɔ.
Jae ne kala aa ka mun Yabala, ya dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ duu nɛra baa ɛ he nomonome dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma nɔ dɛɛ ja heyaa la.
Ba toma la nomanta, hɛ́ɛ duu ba kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ nyin ba wa.
Hé ɡel he bwa nyoa pɛ.
Yabala, ya dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛ hɛ́ɛ ja banɔ la baa ɛ bɔhwaahra la, dɛɛ do ɔmeera la ɡbemba, dɛ lawɛ banɔ la baa wola cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta la kpoŋe, dɛ́ dɔ bambile tɛ nomɛlbwa.
Hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ bɔ wechɔɡa kem, kɛ hé ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ he dɔŋa ne nomɛlbwa.
Hé ɡel he sie ɛɛ lɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa, wobɛlbwa ta, dɛɛ soŋe Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.
Hɛ́ɛ jam Korowii wobɛlbwa ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ Korowii che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛɛ baɡle o tetoowaa he be.
He bɛ ɡel Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa soɡe he nɛɛ la nyoa sɔɔh.
He bɛ he bala baa dɛ na chaahna la nyoa dɛɛ vɛh.
Kɛ hé nyiŋi ba webaɡla, ásɛ dɛ lawɛ anɔ la aa wera la bini.
Hé laa he te kpɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ta.
Korowii waa dɛ tɛ yaa bosɔɔhna la, ó ɡbabir laa doŋa bwa kpɔ he nɛ, dɛ ɛ heyaa nɛndɛɛɡa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta ka tel kɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa ba.
Korowii waa le heyaa he ba ɛ o bii la, o ɛ kasinteŋ te.
Onee dɛɛ ba heyaa nɛndɛɛɡa ɛɛ.
Yabala, hé soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ yaa.
Hɛ́ɛ lea dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ nyabii.
N kpɔ ya Dɔɔ dɛɛ do heyaa kɛ hé kure tɔn nɔ baɡle yabala la bwa sekwaraa.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ na nɛra sum la cha he bwa sekwaraa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn nɔ ka tɛ Kristo tena baa lɔ Tesalonika dɛɛ baɡle kasinteŋ aa lɔ Yeesu bala nɛɛtena harɛ nɔ ta la wa.
O dɛ baɡle ŋɔ ba wilo.
A chɛ kɛ ba che kiŋkiŋ yarada baa dɛ yarada Yeesu la ta, dɛ́ teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa saŋ baa soɡa dɛɛ kpa Yeesu Kristo bala la.
Men Pɔɔl ne Silvanos ne Timotii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he nɛra haa ɛ asɔre tena haa lɔ Tesalonika dɛ ɛ N Naa Korowii waa bera ɛ ya Mɛɛ la ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛra la.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Korowii jaama ne wesoŋa Yabala, ya koh he waa dɛ yon dɛɛ jam Korowii.
He chɛ ɡɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii la dɛ kaa sie saŋ bɛlbwa.
Nyina haa dɛ nyin dɔŋa la ɡe ɡba dɛ do kan ja.
Ya ɡbaɡba dɛ bol he waa dɛɛ baɡle asɔre tena baa cheme bobɛlbwa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la, dɛɛ kpɛɛ heya.
Ya dɛ ŋɔ ba be ɡɛ nɛra aa dɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa, aa no heyaa saŋ bɛlbwa, asɛ he dɔ bambile haa wola habɔɔ le dɛ ta teŋɛ dɛɛ yarada Yeesu la.
He we-ɛɛla baɡlɔ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii bole waa pa heyaa la toɡrɔ.
Haa koh o Kora waa dɛɛ na hɔhɔrɔwa nɔ, anee dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ he chɛ o Kora la ta jae.
Kɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa la te, Korowii ɛɛ bɔ ba a kemee.
O we-ɛɛla toɡrɔ.
Ó ɛɛ ba ɡɛ hɔhɔrɔwa la, dɛ ɡel he bwara sɔɔh heya.
Ya ne he bwaa dɛɛ ba bosɔɔhna la dɔe ɡɛ saŋ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa forɛ le nyundua o ne o nyundua toroma baa dɛ di kpeɡri ne nii nɛɛ ba la.
O balaa, wɛɛ bol nɛra baa wola Korowii jemɛ, baa wola Amanesoma aa dɛ baɡle ya Dɔɔ Yeesu waa noɛ la waa, dɛ́ bɔ ba a kem, dɛ́ per ba le o be.
Baa o kpeɡri aa ɡela o dɔ jirima laanee na kpa, ásɛ o kpɔ hɔhɔrɔwa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa ta ba nɛ.
Awola waa ba o tɔpejen la ta ásɛ o nɛra tɛo duure la, nɛra baa yaradao la bwa ɛɛ nao dɛ́ kpɛɛro.
He ɡba jao, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya fa aa baɡle heyaa o waa la, he noɔ dɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Yeesu bala la waa ya yon dɛɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ heya, ásɛ o cha heyaa he soɡa bini won maɡre dɛ́ chɛ lee waa le heyaa dɛ tɛ o te la, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa kpeɡri he won ɛ wedɛɛɡa la bwa aa lɔ he bambile bini ne wobɛlbwa haa ŋɔ hé ɛ, yarada haa yaradao la nomanta.
Ya dɛ soŋe Korowii ɡɛ, ásɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu sɔn won dɔ jirima dɛ́ le he we-ɛɛla ta, ásɛ he ɡe ɡba won dɔ jirima dɛ́ le o be.
N Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo suna waa dɛ sune ya nɛɛ dɛɛ cha yaa la nomanta, á bwa won ɛ ɡɛ.
Nɛn waa ɛ Yeesu Kristo dɔm tenten Yabala, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bala waa ne ɡɛ ya bwa aa dɛ ba o be chema la, n dɛ soŋe heya, hɛ́ɛ lii a waa kɛrɛdɛ.
Maa nyin nomɛlbwa bol wetamaa ane, ásɛ he den ɔmɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ ya Dɔɔ balɔ kaa.
Dɛ ba ŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe baɡ ba ɡɛ baa bol, kɛɛ dɛ he na tɔn bɛl o neɡre heyaa kɛŋɔ yanee chwerɔ waa, he bɛ no dɛ́ ɡel a ɛ heyaa waane.
He bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa neɡre heyaa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ waane ɛɛ ɛo mɔɔ ásɛ tɔpere la ba.
Gɛ saŋ nɛra aa ir dɛ́ warɛ pirim dɛ́ vɛh Korowii la ɛɛ bao, mɔɔ nɛn waa ɛ Kristo dɔm tenten Korowii bandia aa lɔ o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ ó chɔɡo la le.
Wɛɛ ɛ o tenee dɛ́ ɡwaa komɛlbwa nɛra aa dɛ toma dɛɛ yera ba dɔɔranar, hale wɛɛ kpɔ Korowii Dea berɛ sobɔr dɛ́ ŋɔ onee Korowii.
Haa lii kɛŋɔ n fa aa lɔ he be la dɛ n dɛ baɡle heyaa ɡɛ waa nɔ naa?
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ komɛlee tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ o le kahonɛ la, nemenɛ o saŋ tel.
Wechɔɡa dɔɔ ba taraken, kɛ aa won dɔ bɔr kohona, nemenɛ kon la waa tɔa ŋwɛnɛ la le mɔɔ.
Dɛ kon waa tɔa ŋwɛnɛ la baa le aa, belaa Wechɔɡa Te la ɛɛ ba bochaah lee nɛra jemɔ.
Kɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bala jirima ne o nyoa peu ɡbo kwara ɛɛ won kpoo buɡ ta.
Gɛ saŋ waa ba mɔɔ Yeesu ba kpoo la, Bɔnsam ɛɛ do o nɛɛ dɛɛ chao kɛrɛdɛ o won dɔ kpeɡri kohona, dɛ́ won dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowaa ne wejena, dɛɛ neɡre nɛra kɛŋɔ Korowiirii tɛo kpeɡri ken, dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa bwa soo siwi aa lole, dɛ́ won dɛɛ neɡre nɛra baa nyoɡra dɛɛ ba chɔɡa la.
Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ baa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba vɛh kasinteŋ waa aa dɛ ba wona lɛɛ ba la, ba ta o waa nyine.
Anomanta, o ɡelɔ nyosone o nyoa aa kpeɡa ɛɛ ba ba be dɛ ba tɔɔɡe ba sie, asɛ baa yarada waa aa ɛ nyosone, ásɛ o won pa nomɛlbwa waa wola sɛɛh dɛ teŋɛ o kasinteŋ waa la ta kɛ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa o sie lɛ a ta la bolchɔɡe.
Kiŋkiŋ cheɡa wa Anomanta, a chɛ kɛŋɔ yá jam Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa he wa, yabala.
O dɛ nyin heyaa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ le harɛ mumpar la bwa le heyaa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ lɛ heyaa.
O Domadɛɛɡe aa ɡela he doŋa bwa le he nɛɛ la, ne ɡɛ haa no o kasinteŋ waa dɛ yaradaa la, a waa o lɛ heyaa la.
Yanee fa bol Amanesoma la baɡle heyaa he no la, asɛ Korowii che a ta le heyaa ásɛ he ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo won pɛ dɔ jirima.
Anomanta, yabala, hé lawɛ kiŋkiŋ dɛ́ teŋɛ waa la bwa yaa kpɔ nyoa dɛ baɡle heya, ne anɔ la yaa chwera tɔn ta dɛ tɛ heyaa la ta.
Hé ɡel a bwa do he nyu bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ɡbaɡba ne N Naa Korowii waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ dɛɛ nyin yaa kɛrɛdɛ dɛ sune ya nɛɛ dɛ cha yaa, dɛ tɛ yaa hwɛɡa aa wera ne ɡbemba aa wola tonɛ bwa la, bá tɛ heyaa ɡbemba dɛ ɡel he che kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ dɛ won ɛ wedɛɛɡa te bɛlbwa, dɛ́ won dɛɛ bola ɡe.
He soŋe Korowii tɛ yaa Anɔ la aa kaa la, yabala, hé soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ ya ɡba, ásɛ ya Dɔɔ waa la won perɛ kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ won dɔ jirima, ásɛ nɛra no kɛŋɔ ɡɛ he ɡe fa aa noa la.
Hé soŋo o lɛ yaa dɛɛ le meesɔɔh tena ne nɛnchɔɡa be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa laa dɛ́ no waa yaa dɛ bol la dɛ yaradaa.
Kɛ Korowii waa dɔ kasinteŋ la, wɛɛ ɡeloo hɛɛ kpeɡ waa la ta teŋa ta, dɛ́ lɛ heyaa le Bɔnsam nɔn ta o bɛ heyaa dɔ.
Yaa dɛ yarada ya Dɔɔ la waa ya won dɛɛ yarada he ɡe kɛŋɔ he dɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ ya fa aa baɡle heyaa la ta la, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ yarada heyaa kɛ hɛɛ kpoŋe ɡɛ ya fa aa bol he be laanee dɛɛ la.
Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, ásɛ he won jemɛ nyina Korowii aa nyin heya, ne bambile Yeesu Kristo aa lawa o hɔhɔrɔwa la bini la.
Sie doe dɛɛ ɛ toma Yabala, ya cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sɔn ta dɛɛ ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, he bini bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ bɔhwaah o ta sɛɛh dɛɛ ɛ toma ɡɛ yaa baɡla la aa, hé ɡelo, he ne o bɛ pɛ.
Ya fa aa lɔ he be la, dɛ ya ta bɔhwaahra ɛɛ.
Anomanta, he jemɛ ɡɛ haa ɛ dɛ́ teŋɛ ya nɛ.
Ya ta nomɛlbwa kondikwaa dii pɛɛpɛɛ.
