Ya ɛ toma chɔɔ ne jwaana dɛɛ koh kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ bɛ heyaa ha ya kondikwaa wa.
Yaa ɛ ɡɛ nɔ, a ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ ya ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ya lɛ ɡɛ kwaa nɔ le he be.
Ya dɔ ŋwɛnɛ, kɛ ya ɛ ɡɛ dɛ kpɔ baɡle heyaa ásɛ hɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
Waa yaa kpɔa tɛ heyaa ɡɛ saŋ ya fa aa lɔ he be bela laanee kɛŋɔ, nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔa waa tomaa ɛ la ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó di kwa.
Ya dɛ no he waa kɛŋɔ he bane ta sɛɛh dɛɛ ɛ toma, dɛ valɛ pɛɛpɛɛ dɛ kpɔ nyoa dɛɛ do nɛra waa ta.
Ya cheɡɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sɔn ta dɛɛ ŋɔ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ be ŋɔ bá do sie dɛɛ ɛ ba ɡbaɡba toma dɛɛ di ba koeh ta.
Yabala, hé ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ la, dɛ bɛ ŋɔ he koɔh.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa ta sɛɛh kɛ wɛɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ yaa ŋɔa tɔn nɔ bini nɔ taa yaa, hé nyiŋu kɛrɛdɛ.
He ne o bɛ pɛ dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa, ásɛ sihiih kpoo.
N ta ŋɔe ŋɔ hé kpɔɔ berɛ he dɔm te, kɛ hé jao kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ haa dɛ ja he nimanar.
Kala aa ka mun Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la ɡbaɡba waa dɔ bambisɔn kɛrɛdɛ la, ó tɛ heyaa bambisɔn saŋ bɛlbwa, wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ ja he bwa nɛ.
Men Pɔɔl ɡbaɡbaa chwerɛ bonɔ nɔ.
N dɛ na heya.
Kenii n yon dɛɛ ɛ n tɔn bɛlbwa bini, ásɛ he won jemɛ kɛŋɔ n tɔnee.
Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ na nɛra sum la cha he bwa sekwaraa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Timoti ɛ nɛnfale waa yarada Yeesu dɛ ɛ Kristo te.
Pɔɔl leo ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi asɔre waa lɔ Ɛfesos la ta.
Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ doo ɡbemba o toma waa dɛ ɛ la ta, dɛɛ jao ŋɔ o bɛ ŋwɛnɛ tɛ baa baɡle nyosonwebaɡla.
Pɔɔl dɛ nyin kɛ Timoti ɛ o toma ɡɛ aa cha Kristo tena baa lɔ Ɛfesos, ásɛ dɛ lii kɛ o ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ.
Men Pɔɔl maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome laanee chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
Korowii waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ ne Yeesu Kristo yaa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ laanee do mɛ ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ bol o waa nɔ.
N bie Timotii n chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ.
Menee bol Korowii Waa he no dɛ yarada, dɛ berɛ n bie a ta la.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo chae dɛ́ na he sum, dɛ́ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna.
Korowii dɛ kah nyosonteŋna o waa baɡla ta Waa maa ba dɛ kaa Makidoonia harɛ ta dɛ ŋɔ he be la, a taa n ta do.
N ŋɔ hé so Ɛfesos dɛ kah nɛra baa teŋe nyosone dɛɛ tɛ nɛra ŋɔ Korowii Waa baa chaɡle la ŋɔ bá ɡel ɡɛ waa la, dɛ bɛ Korowii waa la sie berɛ.
Ŋɔ ba bɛ ɡel nyosone la ne ɡɛ baa dɛ baɡle ba naanar leebɔra baa wola a nyoa na bwa la lɛ ba liire.
Wetɔŋla ɡbo nee ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ ba.
Korowii toma ŋwɛnɛre laa baa baɡle la, dɛkalkɛ yarada ɡbo taa a che baa jemɛ Korowii toma ŋwɛnɛre.
Waa maa koh a waa doe waa nɔ ta laanee kɛŋɔ bá won dɔ nɛnnyin.
Nɛn waa dɔ nɛnnyin nɔ soo la ta wechɔɡa bɛlbwa dɔe, o tea too, o dɔ yarada kasinteŋ.
Nɛra bane ɡel ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ ka teŋɛ wesale aa wola mun dɔe bola ta.
Ba dɛ nyin kɛ ba ɛ ba te kɛ nɛra baa dɛ chaɡle nɛra Korowii Mmara la, kɛ waa ba siwi yon swɛɛ a ta baa bol la, ba ɡba aa a mun jemɛ.
Ya bwa jemɔ kɛ dɛ nɛn wono ɛ ɡɛ Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle la aa, Mmara la wer tɛo.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡa waa laa ba koh dɛɛ do mmara, kɛ nɛra baa wola mmara ta teŋɛ la, ne deŋnekpeɡ tena, ne nɛra baa vɛh Korowii la, ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, ne nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ, baa wola on duu la, ne nɛra baa dɛ kpoo ba mɛɛnanar ne ba nyare, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ kpo nɛra bwa, ne jwamane tena, ne baala ba ne ba bandɔŋa aa dɛ chɔ haah ne baa, ne nɛra baa lawɛ nɛra dɛɛ yoɡ ba kɛ yoma, ne nyosonteŋna, ne nɛra ba yon jemɛ kɛ nyosonee baa teŋe dɛ ɡarɛ dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ Korowii la, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ we-ɛɛla te bɛlbwa a ne webaɡla aa toɡra la aa wola kaa la, ba waa ba koh dɛɛ do mmara.
Gɛ waa aa toɡra la bwa lɔ Amanesoma Korowii aa kpɔa do n nɔn ta ŋɔ ń chaɡle nɛra la ta.
Anee dɛɛ baɡle Korowii waa dɔ jirima ne silɛɛ la wa.
Pɔɔl jam Korowii suna waa sune o nɛ N dɛ jam ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa tɛ mɛ o kpeɡri la kɛ waa yarada mɛ dɛ kpɔ o toma nɔ do n nɔn ta nɔ.
A lole kɛ n fa dɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo la nɛnhɛla, dɛɛ ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa, n siwi sao mɛɛ yoo.
Kɛ Korowii na n sum, dɛkalkɛ maa wola Korowii yarada dɔe n bini la, dɛ maa jemɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ ɛ. O sune n nɛɛ kohona dɛ cha mɛ taeh n dɔ yarada ne nɛnnyin yaa dɔa le pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la ta.
Waa nɔ ɛ kasinteŋ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé lɛa kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra waa Yeesu Kristo koh ba harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ba lɛɛ ba.
N wechɔɡaa kana ɡwaa nomɛlbwa kwa.
Kɛ Korowii sune n nɛ, asɛ Yeesu Kristo dɔ bambile tɛ mɛ n wechɔɡa damanta nɔ bwa ta, ásɛ nɛra baa ba no Korowii waa dɛ yaradao la jemɛ ɡɛ Yeesu aa dɔ bambile kohona, dɛ́ won yaradao dɛ́ dɔ o mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.
Yá kpɔ duure tɛ Koojen la o Kora dii aa wola jaɡa dɔe, waa wola sewɛ bwa, baa wola won on na, o ɡbo aa ɛ Korowii la, dɛɛ ɡuŋu harɛ fini ne tɔpere bɛlbwa.
Aamen.
N bie Timoti, n dɔ waane dɛ́ bol he be, ásɛ he lawɛ a bini he Korowii toma ta.
Gɛ ba fa aa cheɡɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛ bol o toma waa tɛɛ kpeɡri hɛ́ɛ ɛ nɔ waa la, ɡɛ waa la tenten taa mɛɛ doe la.
Anomanta, ɡel ɡɛ waa la doe ɡbemba ásɛ he won yo kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ kpoŋe Korowii yarada bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛɛ ɛ waa haa jema kɛ a toɡrɔ.
Gɛɛ bane aa wola ɛɛ, asɛ ba ta wone yarada Korowii ka tonɛ dɛ horɛ la.
Banɔ la baa hora la bini banee Haemenayɔs ne Alɛksanda.
N kpɔ ba do Bɔnsam nɔn ta, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛŋɔ baa Korowii nɛnhɛla ɛ.
Korowii toma Mmarare dɛ asɔre tena wa Anɔ la aa tɔ sie mɛɛ ja asɔre tena kɛŋɔ báa teŋɛ a ta laanee kɛ hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa.
Hɛ́ɛ soŋo dɛɛ jaamo wobɛlbwa ta.
Hé soŋo dɛɛ tɛ koranar ne nɛra baa dɛ di nomonome bwa, ásɛ ya bwa so bosɔɔhna ta jeih ken, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ɡɛ aa chɛa, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera o be.
Gɛɛ wera, dɛɛ lɛ ya Lɛɛ Korowii sie.
O te dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa dɔ o nyu, ásɛ dɛ ba jemɛ kasinteŋ waa la.
Anee kɛ Korowii beŋkpoŋii lole, dɛ dɔ nachiɡe beŋkpoŋ do o ne nɛwɛnyini baah ta, o ɡe ɛ nɛn.
Onee Yeesu Kristo waa kpɔ o te tɛ kɛŋɔ ba kpɔɔ charɛ nɛra bwa nyu la.
Gɛ saŋ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ waa nɔ maɡre la taa a den chiɡ la.
O ɛ ɡɛ a ɛ danseɛ dɛ chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa.
Anɔ waa Korowii lee mɛ ŋɔ ń lɔ a dawuro baɡle nɛra, dɛ́ berɛ ɛ Yeesu torome ɡe la.
Kasinteŋii mɛɛ bol la, maa nyosone teŋe.
Onee ɡela mɛɛ baɡle nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la, ásɛ ba yarada Yeesu dɛ́ jemɛ kasinteŋ la.
N dɛ nyin kɛ bobɛlbwa baala baa ɛ asɔre tena la laa ba te kpɔ bandisale ne wetɔŋla ta, ásɛ dɛ won ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa dɛ́ ir nɔɔra soŋe Korowii.
Gɛ tentenee mɛɛ nyin kɛ dɛ haahna dɛ ba laala doe yaa, ba bɛ jwamanlaala ne laala a waa aa do bola dɛɛ do.
Bá kpɔ laala aa maɡre ba ne, dɛ bɛ ba te kpɔ do nyuune ɛɛ aa dɛ ba kem ne, ne suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaare doe, ne yale a yoɡ aa kpeɡa liɡa ta.
Kɛ báa ɛ wedɛɛɡa kɛ haahna baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii.
Ba wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ laanee dɛ́ ɡel ba do wer toli.
A wer kɛŋɔ haahna ɛɛ pwɛr ba te, dɛ cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no Korowii Waa baa dɛ baɡ ba la.
N ta ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ kɛŋɔ haahna di nomonome baala nɛɛ dɛɛ baɡle wa.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ bá tɔ ba nyoa dɛɛ no, dɛkalkɛ Adamee Korowii tɔ sie ta mɔɔ dɛ ta o haah Hawa.
Adam ɡe kwaraa laa Bɔnsam neɡre la.
Hawaa o neɡre dɛ ɡel o ɛ wechɔɡa la.
Kɛ dɛ haahna kpoŋe Korowii yarada bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛɛ nyin nɛn, dɛ laa ba te dɛɛ kpɔ wedoŋa ta, baa wesale ɛ aa, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔ ba nyu ba lola ta.
Nomonome baa lɔ asɔre ta wa A ɛ kasinteŋ kɛŋɔ dɛ nɛn ŋɔ wɛɛ tɔ asɔre tena siee yaa, dɛ tondɛɛɡa tentenee naate ɛɛ nyin la.
A ɡɛ nɛn la, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra dɔ o wechɔɡe bol.
A chɛ kɛ o haah ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
A chɛ kɛ o won o te lawa, dɛ dɔ nfɛrɛ, o we-ɛɛla ɛɛ lɛ nɛra sie.
A chɛ kɛ o ɛ nɛn waa won hɔɔhra kpoŋa, dɛ won Korowii Waa baɡla.
A ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ó ɛ sennyɔdɛɛ, ó bɛ naɡrenyini ɛ. Kɛ ó ɛ nɛn waa pwɛra, waa wola o bwara ne waa nyin.
A ta chɛ kɛ o siwi beɡre suuɡa.
A chɛ kɛ ó won o haah ne bii nyiŋa, asɛ o bii ɛɛ no o deŋna waa dɛɛ tɛo duure.
Dɛ nɛn aa won o haah ne bii nyiŋi aa, ɛrɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛ́ won nyiŋi asɔre tena nɛɔ?
A chɛ kɛ ó ɛ nɛn waa kpɔ o te tɛ Korowii dɛ yaradao biɡri, ɡɛ aa ɛ nɛra waa tɔ ba sie la nomanta, o nyu bini bɛ on som ba do ó maŋkura o te kohona, ásɛ o ba jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡɛ Bɔnsam aa ɛa la.
A chɛ kɛ ó ɛ nɛn nɛra baa wola asɔre tena ɛɛ kwara aa dɛ yerɛ o sɔndɛɛɡe, asɛ o bɛ sihiih waane ba ɛ dɛ́ le Bɔnsam bel ta.
Nɛra baa chɔ tomare nyoo asɔre la ta la ɡe, ɡɛ.
A wer kɛŋɔ baa ɛ waa aa dɔ duure, dɛɛ di kasinteŋ.
Ba ta chɛɛ kɛ bá ɛ sennyɔdɛɛra, ba ta chɛɛ kɛ bá kpɔ suuɡa sibeɡra dɛɛ bɔ nɛra apoo.
A chɛ kɛ bá kpoŋe Korowii wesɔɔhla waa waa ɡela ya jemɛ la bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛɛ ɛ waa baa naa kɛ a toɡrɔ.
A wer kɛŋɔ hé nyiŋi ba waa bini, dɛ́ na dɛ ba waa wer mɔɔ he tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ bá ɛ ɡɛ toma la.
Ba haahna chɛ kɛ baa ɛ waa aa dɔ duure, dɛ bɛ nɛra dɛɛ ŋwalɛ.
A chɛ kɛ bá won ba te lawa, dɛ́ kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
A chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa waa chɔ asɔre tomare nyoa la haah ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ won o haah ne bii nyiŋa kɛrɛdɛ.
Banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ ba toma kɛrɛdɛ la dɛ dɔ sɔn, dɛɛ do kpeɡri yarada baa dɔa dɛɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la ta.
N dɛ nyin kɛ n wonaa, ń ba nae.
Kɛ n tɔ sie chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, ásɛ dɛ n baa biɡri aa, tɔ́n nɔ baɡle ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ yá banɔ la Korowii aa kpɔ yaa ɛ o dem tena nɔ so dɛɛ ɛ ya wa.
Yanee Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la toroma, o kpɔ o kasinteŋ waa la tɛ ŋɔ yá lawɛ a bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ, kɛ pila yon lawɛ dea kpoŋe la.
Ŋwɛnɛ yaa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii nɔ, tɔŋla toole kɛ wesɔɔhla aa lɔ o ta, asɛ Korowii ɡel ya jemɛ la ɛ wejena kohona.
Waa yaa lawɛ a bini kpoŋe laanee, Korowii baa berɛ o te nɛwɛnyini.
O Domadɛɛɡe la ɡelɔ nɛra bwa jemɛ kɛ o waa toɡrɔ.
Nyundua toroma nao.
Nɛra bol o waa baɡle harɛ nɔ ta nɛra baa lɔ bobɛlbwa.
Ba no o waa harɛ nɔ ta dɛ yaradao, asɛ Korowii kpɔɔ kaa nyundua o ka dɔ jirima.
Nyosonteŋna baa dɛ baɡle Korowii wa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la pili waa nɔ bini chasee ken baɡle heyaa ŋɔ, kerekere la nɛra bane ɛɛ vɛh Yeesu waa nɔɔ dɛ́ kaa yarada koŋkwaa aa dɛ neɡ ba, ásɛ dɛɛ no a be.
Nɛra baa kpɔ nyosone dɛɛ neɡre nɛra laanee kpɔ ɡɛ neɡra webaɡla la ɛɛ baɡle nɛra.
Ba liire chɔɡɔ.
Nɛra neɡra ne wechɔɡa man ba kɛŋɔ nɛn baa kpɔ buniwɔb chɔɡro a mano waa wola konwɔb ɔmɛ kpa la.
Gɛ nɛra nɔɔ vala dɛɛ chaɡle nɛra ŋɔ aa were kɛ baa mo haah kɛɛ haah yalɛ la, dɛ berɛ ŋɔ kondikwaa ane aa were kɛŋɔ nɛra di la.
Kɛ Korowiirii ta ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ ŋɔ bánɔ la baa jemɛ kasinteŋ waa la dɛɛ yaradao la kpɔ jam tɛo dɛ́ dia.
Korowii kontaala te bwa wer.
Dɛ ya kpɔ jam tɛo mɔɔ dɛ lɛa te naa, ate dɛ komɛlbwa ta vɛɛh doe, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ haa jam Korowii la ne Korowii ɡbaɡba wobol la won ɡela a do wer Korowii be ásɛ nɛn di.
Dɛ he kpɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡle he bala aa, anee dɛɛ ba chaɡla kɛŋɔ he ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome tenten haa teŋɛ Korowii waa haa yaradaa ne kasinteŋ la ta, dɛ́ kpɔ kpeɡ dɛ́ do kpeɡri.
Laa he te kpɔ wobosale aa wola Korowii waa ɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ nyin a bola la ta, dɛ swɛɛ siwi hweli ɡɛ haa dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa la ta.
Dɛ he swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ tɛɡre he pɔla bini naa, a dɔ tɔnɔ tama.
Kɛ dɛ he swɛɛ siwi kɛ hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa la taa yaa, anee dɔ tɔnɔ wobɛlbwa ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii nɛɛ teŋa dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ nɛra fini ne seo habɔɔ bwa.
Gɛ waa nɔ ɛ kpela tɔŋla aa wola toole a ta kwaraa.
Anomanta, no dɛ́ lawɛ a bini kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ.
Koeh yaa dɛ swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ o toma nɔ bwa, Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la nɛɛ ya sie dawɛ.
Onee dɛɛ lɛ nɛn te bɛlbwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa yaradao dɛ kpɔ o te tɛo la, o dɛ lɛo.
Dɛɛ chaɡ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa dɛɛ ja ba báa teŋɛ a ta.
Bɛ ɡel nɛra koh kɛ he ɛ bechala nomanta, dɛɛ ɛɛ sisawa, kɛ ɡel nɛra baa yarada Yeesu la na ɡɛ haa dɛ bol wa, ɡɛ he da aa doa, ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin nɛn, ɡɛ haa yarada Yeesu dɛ kpɔ he te tɛo, ne ɡɛ haa laa he te kpɔ wedoŋa ta, ásɛ dɛ hweli waa le a ta.
Do sie kure Korowii Tɔn dɛɛ baɡ ba cheremibɔra, dɛɛ bol Korowii Waa la dɛɛ chaɡ ba a bini ka tel ɡɛ saŋ maa ba.
Kpeɡri Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa chae he dɔ dɛ le awola nomonome la aa kpɔ nɔɔra darawe he nɛɛ dɛ che Korowii Domadɛɛɡe kpeɡri ta dɛ bol a waa la, bɛ ɡel a ɛ pɛɛ.
Swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ ɛa, ásɛ nɛra bwa na ɡɛ he toma aa dɛ kaa kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛɛ nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ he soɡa bini ne he webaɡla bini.
Kpoŋe a bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ baɡle nɛra la.
Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, hɛɛ lɛ he ɡbaɡba ne nɛra baa dɛ no he be la bwaa.
Waa aa chɛ kɛ asɔre tena ɛ Dɛ baa waa ɡwaale nomoa ɛ waane aa wola weraa, bɛ o nɛɛ nyɛɡ, kɛ bol waa baɡlo kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba mɛɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ ɛ bibaala haa ɛ nomoa ka tɛɛ ba la ɡe kɛŋɔ he ɡbaɡba nimanar, dɛ́ kpɔ haahna baa ɡwaale nomonome la ɛ he nyare.
Ásɛ bihaahna haa ɡwaa ba la ɡe, hɛ́ɛ ɛɛ ba kɛ he nimambii, wedoŋa bɛlbwa bɛ he ne ba baah ta do.
Haahna ba jaranar aa serewa baa wola nomɛlbwa dɔe ó nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la, dɛɛ duu ba dɛɛ cha ba.
Kɛ dɛ luhaah bɛl lole dɛ dɔ bii kɛɛ naanar aa, a chɛ kɛ ba jemɛ ɡɛ ba ne waa so, ba nyiŋu, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a wer kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta la ɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ nyiŋi ba lolanar ɡɛ ba ɡe fa aa koh ba nɛɛ la.
Gɛɛ dɛɛ su Korowii siwi.
Luhaah waa nyaa o ta nɛn dɔe ó nyiŋi o nɛɛ la te, Korowii nɛɛ o sie dawɛ wɛɛ soŋo chɔɔ ne jwaana bwa ó chao.
Kɛ luhaah bodia wa aa dɛ lɛ o sie la, o soɡe le te, kɛ o do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa sewa.
Ja ba ɡɛ waa nɔ ta, ásɛ nɛra bɛ ba bwara wechɔɡe dɔ bol.
Dɛ nomɛl lole, waa o nya ne o mɛɛ kɛɛ o dem tena nyiŋi aa, naate Korowii toma ɛ pɛɛ.
Naate waa wola Korowii yarada ɡba bɔɔ.
Bɛ luhaah waa wola bene fifraanumɛl dɔe mɔɔ la kure ja luhaahna maa bol ba waa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ cha ba dɛɛ nyiŋ ba la nɛ.
Luhaah waa dɔ bene fifraanumɛl, waa wola baa bɛlbwa jemɛ ka ja o jaa nɛ, nɛra bwa jemɛ o wedɛɛɡa waa ɛa wa, kɛŋɔ waa wona dɛɛ o bii ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta ba ɛ bechadɛɛɡa, dɛ won dɛɛ kpoŋe hɔɔhra kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ pwɛr o te ɛ toma tɛ asɔre tena, dɛ won cha nɛra wa aa puu ba, asɛ dɛ won kpɔ o te bwa tɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ɡbo la waa mɛɛ bol he be ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la.
Bɛ luhaahna ba taa ɛ toli kure ja luhaahna maa bol ba waa nɔ nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba pɛla ɛɛ ba lawɛ yalee, ba ɡel Yeesu Kristo toma la dɛ́ ka yalɛ, ásɛ a ɛ wechɔɡa tɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ ba fa aa bola ŋɔ Yeesu Kristo toma ɡboo baa ba ɛɛ, dɛ berɛ vɛh la.
Luhaahna nɔ dɔŋa, baa wedɛɛɡa bɛlbwa dɔe dɛɛ ɛ ka ja kɛŋɔ baa dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ valɛ deremi ta pɛɛpɛɛ.
A ɡbo laa.
Ba kpɔ nyoa dɛɛ do nɛra waa ta, dɛɛ ŋwalɛ nɛra, asɛ dɛɛ bol waa aa wola chɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba bol bwa.
Anomanta, dɛ luhaahna ba taa ɛ toli la yalɔ dɛ loɡle bii, dɛ won ba deremi ta nyiŋa, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ya dɔma bɛ wedoŋa bɛlbwa dɔ bol yaɡɛ yaa aa, ɡɛɛ n fe ɛɛ nyin.
Taraken ɡba, luhaahna bane dɔɔ le Yeesu Kristo habɔɔ dɛ ka teŋɛ Bɔnsam nɛɛ tonɛ.
Haah bɛlbwa waa ɛ asɔre te asɛ luhaahna do o dem la, ó takapɔ kɛ wɛɛ nyiŋi luhaahna laanee, ásɛ dɛ bɛ koeh la bwa kpɔ dawɛ asɔre tena nɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ asɔre ɡe won nyiŋi luhaahna la baa wola nɛra dɔe bá nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la.
Asɔre nomonome la baa dɛ tɔ asɔre tena sie kɛrɛdɛ la chɛ kembɔr bele anɛ.
Banee kɛŋɔ banɔ la ba sie aa dɛ beɡre Korowii Waa la bola ne a chaɡla ta la, dɛkalkɛ a lɔ Korowii Tɔn la bini kɛ, “He bɛ nao waa dɛ ɛ toma he koo ta la nyoa vɔwɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ o bɛ kwaa di.” Dɛ berɛ chwerɛ do o bini ja ŋɔ, “Tom-ɛɛ bɛlbwa kembɔr chɛo.” Dɛ nomɛl ba he be dɛ ba kpɔ waa dɛ dawɛ asɔre nomoa bɛl aa, bɛ no nemenɛ nɛn nɛɛte ne toorote baa di danseɛ kɛ waa la ɛ kasinteŋ mɔɔ he no dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wa.
Dɛ bɛl ɛ wechɔɡa aa, yerɔ cheme asɔre tena la bwa sie dɛ́ kaoh.
He ɛ ɡɛ naa, nɛra baa lɔ bela dɛ na la ɛɛ ɔmɔɔ dɛ laa ba te dɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.
N cheɡɛ Korowii ne Yeesu Kristo ne nyundua toroma la bwa sie dɛ kpɔ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, ásɛ he we-ɛɛla bwa ta la, he bɛ ɡel nɛra bane waa su he siwi dɛ ɡwaa bane, kɛ dɛɛ ɛ ba bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
Bɛ totoo kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ nomɛlbwa nɛɛ dɛ leo ŋɔ ó ɛ Korowii toma, ásɛ dɛ naate ta ba wone kpoŋe tom la bini dɛ ka ɛ wechɔɡa aa, a ba maali.
Nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel wedoŋa bɛlbwa maali.
He tea la ne ɡɛ he bwara yon dɛɛ wee warawara la nomanta, bɛ nee ɡbo dɛɛ nyɔ kpa.
He ɛo waa, hɛ́ɛ nyɔ sen ɡe tama.
Nɛra bane lole, ba te ne wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛ nɛra bwa nao, a yon che a ta ba la ba ne kɔɔto ka pa ba bolchɔɡe.
Kɛ nɛra bane ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa aa, waa la peu dɛ kaa kwaraa mɔɔ nɛra jemɛ.
Gɛ tentenee wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ɡe aa wola won sɔh.
Dɛ nɛn ɛ wedɛɛɡa sɔh ɡba aa, aa le baŋee.
Nɛra baa ɛ nɛndɔɔla la chɛ kɛŋɔ baa ɔmɛ ba dɔɔranar dɛɛ duu ba, ásɛ nɛra bɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɔ bol wechɔɡa yaɡɛ Korowii ne waa nɔ yaa dɛ chaɡle nɔ.
Nɛndɔɔla ba ne ba dɔɔranar bwa aa dɛ yarada Yeesu la bɛ koh kɛ ba ne ba bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ nomanta, ba siwi ɛɛ sa ba.
Ba tenee chɛ kɛ bá tomɛ ba dɔɔranar kɛrɛdɛ kwara, dɛkalkɛ ba dɔɔranar la bwa ɡe yarada Yeesu dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa.
Bol ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡ ba, dɛ́ chaɡ ba a bini.
Neɡra webaɡla ne kondɔɔh tenten wa Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ chaɡle Korowii Wa, asɛ a korɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo kasinteŋ waa la ta, ne ɡɛ yaa dɛ chaɡle nɛra ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔa dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii la ta la, naate dɛ maŋkura o te pɛɛpɛɛ.
Waa wobɛlbwa jemɛ.
Wetɔŋla dɛ weo choɡla, asɛ wetama bɛlbwa dɛ o dɛ vuuɡa.
Gɛ waa nɔɔ dɛɛ ba bɔweela ne naɡra ne dɔŋa chɛɡra ne liichɔɡa ne la.
Gɛ te la ne nɛra baa wola wedɛɛɡa lii, baa wola ya kasinteŋ waa la jemɛ la, ba dɛ saɡɛ wetɔŋla aa wola mun dɔe ta, dɛ yon dɛɛ lii kɛ Korowii toma ɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl baa kpɔ o ta dɛɛ nyin suuɡa.
Nɛn haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii, he siwi ɛɛ su komɛlbwa Korowii aa tɛɛ la, he ɛ kondɔɔh tenten.
Baa lolɛ yaa la, ya ta komɛlbwa ne harɛ nɔ ta balɛ.
Gɛɛ a do ya seo tɔpere ɡe, yaa wola won kpɔ komɛlbwa le bonɔ kaa.
Anomanta, dɛ ya dɔ kwaa yaa di, dɛ dɔ yale dɛɛ tɔ aa, hé ɡel a maɡre ya ne.
Nɛra ba siwi aa swɛɛ suuɡa ta la dɛ́ chole.
Suuɡa sibeɡra dɛ neɡ ba dɛɛ do pɛlchɔɡa ta, dɛ ɡel baa na wa, dɛɛ pɛlɛ konsale ne waa aa dɛ ba waa ne nɛ, dɛ yon ɡel ba chɔɡ kwaraa.
Suuɡa nyin kohona taa wechɔɡa bwa soo siwi ɛɛ le.
Bane teŋɛ suuɡa nɛɛ kohona dɛ nyoɡre Korowii ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ ɡel suna dii berɛ ka ba name.
Pɔɔl doe waa do Timoti Hei, Timoti!
Haa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ nɔ, a chɛ kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ ke he te ɡɛ waa la te bwa ta, dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi, dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ yaradao, dɛɛ nyin nɛn, dɛ́ won bambile lawa wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ́ do pwɛre.
Yarada haa dɛ yarada Korowii nɔ, yodɛɛɡee hɛɛ yo ɡɛ la.
Anomanta, yo kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.
A ɡɛ mkpa nɔɔ Korowii lee ŋɔ he ba dɔ ɡɛ saŋ haa cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ dɛ bol ɡɛ haa yarada Yeesu Kristo baɡle nɛnlaa la.
Korowii waa tɛ komɛlbwa mkpa la, ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la waa wona dɛ che Pɔnteɔs Paelet sie dɛ bol kasinteŋ la sɔn taa n che dɛɛ jae kɛ hé lawɛ waa nɔ bini kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɡel a toɡre, ásɛ nɛra bɛ a wobɛlbwa dɔ bol dɛ́ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa berɛ ba ja.
Dɛ o tɔpere baa telaa, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ó berɛ ba.
Korowiirii chɛ kpɛɛra.
O ɡboo ɛ komɛlbwa nyu.
Koranar Bwa Kooroo on, asɛ dɔɔranar bwa ɡe Dɔɔree on.
O ɡboo dɔ mkpa waa wola sewɛ bwa, dɛ so bela aa chaahna kohona nomɛlbwa aa wola won tel o jwɛh.
Nomɛlbwa ta on nae ka, asɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe aa won nao bwa.
Onee chɛ duure ne kpeɡri bwa dɔe saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Aamen.
Bol waa nɔ nɛra baa ɛ dɔɔhna harɛ nɔ ta la be ŋɔ, ba bɛ ɡel ba nyu bini do ba som kohona, dɛ bɛ hwɛɡa kpɔ do a ɡɛ kondɔɔh aa won tona dɛ won hee la ta.
Kɛ bá kpɔ ba hwɛɡa do Korowii waa ta tea dɛɛ tɛ yaa komɛlbwa asɛ ya won kpɔ dɛɛ lɛ ya sie la nɛ.
Ŋɔ ba be báa ɛ wedɛɛɡa, ásɛ wedɛɛɡa berɛ ba kondɔɔh, bá won ba tea tae dɛɛ kɛ nɛra bwa kwa.
Dɛ ba dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, an dɛɛ ba kerekere kondɔɔh aa wola chɔɡ bwa nyina cheɡ ba nyundua.
A taa baa ba wona dɔ mkpa tenten la.
Hei, Timoti!
Lawɛ waa la bwa Korowii aa kpɔa do he nɔn ta la bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Laa he te kpɔ wesale nɛra aa dɛ bol a ne Korowii Waa aa wola kaa, ne ɡɛnewaa bane aa wola jemɛ dɛɛ yera wejema dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tɔŋle kasinteŋ waa la ta, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ taa bane teŋɛ dɛ nyoɡre Korowii kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ la.
Ń Naa Korowii sune he nɛ, dɛ́ cha he bwa sekwaraa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn nɔ ka tɛ Timoti dɛɛ baɡlo ɡɛ waa tɔ asɔre tena baa lɔ Ɛfesos sie, a lole kɛ dɛ o ta ɛ bonɔmbi.
O dɛ do Timoti ɡbemba ŋɔ ó kpoŋe Yeesu kasinteŋ webaɡla la bini kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ o bwara bɛ ba yɔr ó le habɔɔ.
O dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ ó laa o te kpɔ wetɔŋla aa ɡela nɛra teŋɛ Korowii waa la ta kaahonɛ la ta, kɛ ó lii ɡɛ on Pɔɔl ɡbaɡba aa teŋɛ Korowii nɛ, waa wola habɔɔ leɛ la.
Men Pɔɔl maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
A too Korowii tea o lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ka bol mkpa waa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ yá che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɔ la wa.
N bidɛɛɡe Timoti, n dɛ nae.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo chae, dɛ́ na he sum, dɛ́ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna.
Jaama ne ɡbemba doe wa N dɛ jam Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ tepoŋ ne ɡɛ tenten n naawa fa aa dɛ tomɔ la he wa.
N Korowii soŋa ta bwaa mɛɛ jaamo he waa chɔɔ ne jwaana.
N lii wii awola haa wia la aa, ɡɛɛ n sie che chiŋ mɛɛ nyin n ba nae ásɛ n sie lɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
N dɛ lii ɡɛ haa kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ yarada Korowii ɡɛ he naa Lowis ne he nya Yunis fa aa dɛ yaradao la.
N jemɔ kɛ ɡɛ ba fa aa yarada Korowii dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo la, ba luɡe taa he den teŋɛ la.
A waa ɡela mɛɛ liiri kɛŋɔ hé ir nyu ne dɛ́ kpɔ Korowii kpeɡri awola maa kpɔ nɔn dawɛ he nɛɛ dɛ swee tɛɛ o kpɔ tɛɛ la ɛ toma, dɛkalkɛ Korowii Doma waa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ta ɡelɛ ya ɛ ɔmeera.
O ɡelɔ ya dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ dɔ dɔŋa nyina, dɛ won ya te lawa.
Bɛ ɡel a ɛɛ sihiih kɛ haa dɛ bol ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra.
Bɛ ɡel n ɡe waa dɔe sihiih kɛ baa koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ do mɛ dea la.
Kɛ hé ɡe che Korowii kpeɡri waa kpɔa tɛɛ la ta, dɛɛ na waa Amanesoma la wa.
Onee lɛ yaa, dɛ le yaa ŋɔ yá ba ɛ o nɛra dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ tɛo.
Ya tondɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa laa o le yaa, kɛ o liire waa dɔa tɛ yaa, ne ɡɛ waa na ya sum dɛ cha yaa waa o le yaa.
Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ o che dɛ na ya sum, dɛ cha yaa dɛ le yaa mɔɔ dɛ ta komɛlbwa.
Kɛ tarakenii ya ta che ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo bala waa ba harɛ bonɔ la ta, dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ.
O ɡelɔ seo ta kpeɡri dɔe kpa, dɛ berɛ che Amanesoma la ta baɡle yaa ɡɛ yaa dɛ ba o mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa dɔe.
Amanesoma nɔ waa Korowii lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ba bol, dɛ́ ɡel n ɛ o torome ɡe dɛɛ baɡle nɛra o wa.
A waa mɛɛ na waa maa dɛ na nɔ la.
Sihiih ɡe aa men kpo, dɛkalkɛ n jemɛ naate maa yaradao dɛ kpɔ n te tɛo, asɛ dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ wonoo kpoŋe n ne toma waa kpɔa do n nɔn ta la sɔnɔnɔɔ ken dɛ́ ka tel o bala tɔpere.
Lawɛ kasinteŋ waa maa chaɡle la bini kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ teŋɛ a ta, dɛ́ so Korowii yarada ne nɛnnyin yaa dɔa le pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa ta la ta.
Kpɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa lɔ ya nɛɛ la kpeɡri lawɛ wedɛɛɡa Korowii aa kpɔa tɛɛ la bini kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ.
He jemɔ kɛ nɛra baa lɔ Eesia harɛ ta bwa chwa mɛ, hale Fejelas ne Hɛmojenes ɡba jao.
N Naa Korowiirii dɛ na Oniseforɔs ne o dem tena sum, dɛkalkɛ dɛ on dɛɛ cha mɛ.
Dɛ sihiih aa on kpo kɛ baa do mɛ dea la.
Waa dena tel Rom laanee o ɡaaɡe n bɔr aaa dɛ ka tel kɛ waa na mɛ.
Ya Dɔɔ laanee dɛ na o sum o bala tɔpere la ta.
Henee jemɛ koeh damanta waa koh n nɛɛ Ɛfesos.
Yeesu Kristo sooja waa dɛ di kasinteŋ N bie Timoti, che kiŋkiŋ kpeɡri ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo aa chae he dɔ le pɛɛ he ne waa pɛa la ta.
Waa la nɛra aa chema warɛ asɛ n bol he be la, bola baɡle nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ dɛ jemɛ kɛ ba ɡe ɛɛ wonoo kpɔ bol baɡle nɛra bane ɡe la.
Dɛ wekpeɡa pui toma nɔ ta naa, ɡel he bwara nyɛɡ kɛ Yeesu Kristo sooja ɡbaɡba.
Sooja bɛlbwa dɛ nyin kɛ o toma su o nomoa siwi.
Anomanta, waa o te kpɔe dɛɛ koo nɛmpɛɛne waa ta.
Chwachwaa waa dɛ chwa dɛ́ lɛ komɛl la ɡe, dɛ o ta chwae mmara la ta teŋaa, waa won chwa dɔ komɛlbwa.
Paa waa dɛ swɛɛ siwi o koo toma ta laanee chɛ kɛ o di koo la kondikonloɡla.
Gel waa maa bola nɔ do he liire bini.
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he jemɛ a bwa mun kɛrɛdɛ.
Lii Yeesu Kristo waa kɛŋɔ o iro le seo ta.
Kooro Devid Naa on.
Gɛ waa nɔɔ mɛɛ bol Amanesoma maa dɛ baɡle nɛra la ta, dɛ koh a waa dɛɛ na wa, hale nɛra koh a waa dɛ kpɔ jɔɡrɔre vɔɡ mɛ, dɛ do mɛ dea kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ.
Kɛ Korowii waa te, nɛn aa won kpɔ jɔɡrɔre vɔwa.
Anomanta, n koh nɛra Korowii aa lee ba la waa dɛ lawɛ bambile wobɛlbwa ta, ásɛ Yeesu Kristo lɛ ba ɡe, dɛ berɛ tɛɛ ba jirima aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Kasinteŋ wobolee nɔ.
Ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ ya ne onee sewaa, ya ne wɛɛ berɔɔ ir dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.
Dɛ ya lawɛ bambile wobɛlbwa ta naa, ya ne wɛɛ di koraa.
Dɛ ya ŋɔ ya ne o laa aa, o ɡe ɛɛ ŋɔɔ o ne ya laa.
Dɛ ya ta kasinteŋ tena ɛɛ yaa, o te ta ɛ kasinteŋ te, waa won beɡre o te.” Tom-ɛɛ o siwi aa su Korowii siwi wa Dɛɛ lii nɛra ɡɛ waa nɔ, dɛ kah ba sibeɡra ne Korowii sie ŋɔ ba bɛ waa dɛɛ tɔŋle.
Wetɔŋla ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe.
Nɛra liiree aa chɔɡ.
Takapɔ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii, ásɛ he waa su o siwi kɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ o Korowii toma kɛrɛdɛ sihiih aa wola hen kpo, dɛ́ lawɛ kasinteŋ waa la bini kpoŋe kɛrɛdɛ.
Laa he te kpɔ nɛra baa dɛ bol wobosale a ne Korowii waa aa wola kaa la nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ɡelɔ nɛra ɛɛ le Korowii habɔɔ dɛ kaa ɛ anɔ la aa wola chɛɛ.
Ba webaɡla dɛ yɛɛ dɛɛ chɔɡ nɛra, ɡɛ ŋwɛrchɔɡe yon yɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ nɛn bwadabii la.
Haemenayɔs ne Faeletɔs ja ɡɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ nɛ.
Banee nyoɡre kasinteŋ waa la ŋwɛnɛ, dɛ kaa baɡle nɛra ŋɔ seo ta ira tɔpere la ɡarɔ, dɛɛ chɔɡ nɛra baa yarada Amanesoma la bane liire waa baa yaradaa la ta.
Kɛ a ɛ wobɛlbwa Korowii Dea waa pa o mun la cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ ken.
Ba chwerɛ o ta ŋɔ, “Korowii jemɛ nɛra baa ɛ o kwa,” dɛ berɛ chwerɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔa o ja Yeesu Kristo nɛra nɛɛ la chɛ kɛŋɔ ó laa o te kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.” Dem waa kana la, konsiwi beŋkpoŋ ɡbo laa lɔ o ta.
Suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa kwaa lɔ o ta.
Ane lole, daa nee ba sɛah, dɛ kpɔ choh ma ane ɡe.
Ane lole, wejena ta ɡboo baa le a ne, asɛ ane ɡe ba kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ wesale bɛlbwa.
Anomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa laa o te kpɔ wedoŋa ne wechɔɡa bwa ta naa, naate la do kɛŋɔ kwaa baa dɛ le a ne wejena ɡbo ta la.
O do kaih dɛ do le tɛ o Dɔɔ, dɛ dɔ tɔnɔ tɛo, dɛ che le kɛ ó kpɔɔ ɛ tondɛɛɡa te bwa.
Laa he te kpɔ wedoŋa bonɔɔna aa dɛ pɛlɛ a ta la ta, ásɛ he ne nɛra baa dɛ soŋe Korowii tepoŋ ne la siwi swɛɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ aa dɛ su Korowii siwi, ne Korowii yaradae, ne nɛnnyin, dɛ waa aa dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne la ta.
Bɛ he te kpɔ dɛɛ jo ɡɛnewaa ne wesale tɔŋla ta.
He ɡbabir jemɔ kɛ naɡra nee aa ba.
Nɛn waa ɛ ya Dɔɔ bonɔɔ ta chɛ kɛŋɔ o ne nɛn naɡre.
A chɛ kɛ ó pwɛr o te tɛ nomɛlbwa, dɛ́ won nɛra kwaa baɡla kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ nɛn jo o nɛ aa, ó won lawɛ bambile, dɛɛ baɡle nɛra o ne ba liire aa wola beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ la waa taa ne.
Bɛl lole naa, Korowii ɛɛ na ɡɛ nɛra la sumii, dɛ́ ɡel ba charɛ ba liire, ásɛ ba won jemɛ kasinteŋ waa la, ásɛ ba sie ba harɛ bá chwa le Bɔnsam bel waa laɡ ba dɛ ɡel baa ɛ o waa waa dɛ nyin la ta, ásɛ dɛ dɔ ba te.
Tɔpera aa ka mun wa Jemɛ kɛŋɔ tɔpera aa ba ka mun ba la, aa do kpeɡrii tɛ nɛra, dɛkalkɛ nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ nyin ba ɡbaɡbaa ɡwaa komɛlbwa, dɛɛ nyin suuɡa sibeɡra ne, dɛɛ ɛ mbarafo, dɛɛ ɛ jenu, dɛ bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ nɛra, dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena baa wola ba eehnanar waa no, dɛ ɛ boniayɛ tena, dɛ ɛ ba te nɛndoŋa.
Ba chal aa dɔŋa nɛɛ doe ba, baa wechɔɡaa kpɔ dɛɛ kɛ dɔŋa.
Baa dɛɛ haŋɛ dɔŋa nyooree, baa haŋraa dɔ ba pɛla kwaa ta, baa dɛɛ ɛ ɡaeeh, baa hah wedɛɛɡaa.
Baa ɛ bwɛpaɡre nɛraa, ba sie ɛɛ do wɔrɔbee, dɛɛ maŋkura ba te.
Baa kpɔ silɛɛ kwaa ɡwaa Korowii.
Baa dɛɛ ɛ ba we-ɛɛlaa kɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii ken, kɛ dɛɛ vɛh kpeɡri waa lɔ Korowii toma ta la te.
Laa he te kpɔ ɡɛ nɛra nɔ nɛ.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ bini banee yon kpɔ ŋwɛnɛre ane ta dɛ́ sɔh jo deremi ta, ásɛ dɛɛ dɔ haahna ba wechɔɡa aa ɡwaa ba nɛɛ ba sie ɛɛ yal ba ba pɛlchɔɡa ta la, ba yon dɛɛ teŋɛ ba nɛ.
A ɡɛ haahna la dɛ hweli waa tɔperee te bɛlbwa, kɛ kasinteŋ waa aa lɔ waa la bini la te, baa won an jemɛ bwa.
Gɛ Janes ne Jambɛs aa vuuɡi Mosis la, ɡɛɛ a ɡɛ baala nɔ ɡe ɛɛ vuuɡi kasinteŋ waa la.
Ba liire aa were.
Baa vɛh kasinteŋ waa la yaradae nomanta, Korowii vɛɛh ba.
Ba we-ɛɛla aa won tel sie bobɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ɡɛ a saŋ la tena aa na Janes ne Jambɛs ɡɛna la, ɡɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ na ba ɡe ɡɛna ɡɛ.
Pɔɔl ɡbemba waa do Timoti He Timoti te, he jemɛ waa maa dɛ baɡle la bwa, dɛ jemɛ n da, ne kon la waa maa dɛ koh, ne ɡɛ maa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo, ne ɡɛ maa won bambile lawa, ne ɡɛ maa dɛ nyin nɛn, ne ɡbemba maa dɔa.
Fiiɡa baa fiɡ mɛ ne n wenaale maa naa Anteɔk, Ikooniam ne Lestra, n lawɛ bambile a bwa ta la, he jemɛ a bwa.
Kɛ ya Dɔɔ la cha mɛ dɛ lɛɛ mɛ a ɡɛ waa la bwa ta.
Kasinteŋ, nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛ o ne Yeesu Kristo pɛ o soɡa bini o waa su Korowii siwi la, baa ɛo hɔhɔrɔwaa.
Nɛnchɔɡa ne nɛra baa neɡre nɛra dɛɛ do wechɔɡa ta la ɡe ɛɛ kao saɡɛ wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta dɛɛ la, dɛɛ neɡre nɛra, ásɛ nɛra ɛɛ neɡre ba ɡe.
Kɛ he te, dɛɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ webaɡla haa hwela dɛ jemɛ kɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ la ta.
Bɛ ɡel bwa.
He jemɛ nɛra baa baɡle ɡɛ waa la, dɛɛ yarada ba ɡe.
He bechale saŋ bwaa he le jemɛ Korowii Tɔn bini waa aa dɛ ba wona ɡel he dɔ wejema, dɛ che yarada haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la ta Korowii lɛɛ.
Korowii Tɔn bini waa bwa, Korowiirii kpɔa do nɛra liire ta ba chwera.
A wer kɛ ba kpɔa dɛɛ baɡle nɛra wa, dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ kah nɛra ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ toɡre nɛra, dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ chaɡle nɛra waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi.
Anee dɛ won cha Korowii nɛn ó won ɛ wedɛɛɡa bwa ka tonɛ.
N cheɡɛ N Naa Korowii ne Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ ba ba bol weera ne lala waa dɛ́ pa bole la sie, dɛ koh kora waa dɛ ba ba di la waa dɛɛ ŋɔ he be sibeɡra ne ŋɔ, hé bol Amanesoma la baɡle nɛra.
A som oo, aa somoo, kpɔ he te kɛ saŋ te bɛlbwa hɛɛ bolaa.
Eɡle sie ta ba nɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba jemɛ wechɔɡa baa dɛ ɛ, ásɛ dɛɛ ja ba.
Lawɛ bambile dɛɛ chaɡ ba.
Tɔpere bɛl ɛɛ bao ásɛ nɛra aa kasinteŋ waa la baɡlaa no, dɛkalkɛ baa an nyin.
Baa dɛɛ nyin waa aa dɛ do ba somee dɛ́ no, dɛ́ ka nyin nɛra pirim bá baa chaɡ ba waa ba pɛla aa lɔ a ta la, dɛ́ laa ba deŋne kpɔ kasinteŋ waa la ta, dɛ́ kaa no nyosonwa.
Kɛ he te, dɛɛ lawɛ he te wobɛlbwa ta.
Wekpeɡa pui naa, lawɛ bambile.
Dɛɛ lɔ Amanesoma la dawuro, ásɛ dɛɛ ɛ he toma bwa kɛ Korowii bonɔɔ.
N te, n seo tɔpere telo, n do kɛ sen baa dɔa dɛɛ ta dɛ ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii.
N yo yodɛɛɡe la dɛ tonɛ, dɛ chwa chwae la ɡe tonɛ.
Amanesoma maa dɛ yaradaa la ta ɡe, n ta habɔɔ leɛ.
Kon waa ka mɛ taraken laanee kompoŋ Korowii aa dɛ́ ba nɛndɛɛɡa baa yoa le, ba waa su o siwi la vɔwa.
N Dɔɔ waa kpɔ kasinteŋ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole laanee dɛɛ ba n tɛɛ, awola waa ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la.
N ɡbo laa dɛɛ ba ɡɛ kembɔr la dɔe.
Nɛra baa dɛ pɛlɛ o nɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋu ŋwɛnɛ la bwa ɛɛ dɔɔ.
Waane Pɔɔl ɡbabir aa bola Takapɔ ba n be warane, dɛkalkɛ Demas koh harɛ nɔ ta silɛɛ waa dɛ chwa mɛ.
O chwao kaa Tesalonika.
Krɛsɛns kaa Galaasia harɛ ta, asɛ Taetos ɡe kaa Dalmatia harɛ ta.
Luk ɡboo lɔ n be bonɔ.
He dɛ ba naa, kpɔ Mak ja he nɛɛ he ne o ba, dɛkalkɛ o ɛ nɛn bɛl waa won n chae n toma nɔ ta ɡa.
N tomɛ Tichikos Ɛfesos.
Dɛ he dɛ ba naa, kpɔ Kaapus be Troas dɛ lɛ n batakaare dɛɛ baa mɛ.
Lɛ n tɔne la ɡe ja dɛɛ baa mɛ.
Anɔ la baa kpɔ ol tɔn ɛa la waa dena hiah mɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Loɡre bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Alɛksanda la ɛɛ mɛ wechɔɡa taeh.
Korowii ɛɛ bɔɔ o waa waa ɛa la kemee.
Hé ɡe nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ ke he te o nɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ta yaa sie tɛɛ ya webaɡla ta kwaraa.
Baa yer mɛ cheme ŋɔ ń ba tɔh n nyoa loɡla la, n ta nomɛlbwa dɔe ó ba che n habɔɔ.
Nɛra bwa chwa mɛ.
Korowii bɛ ɡel a ɛ wechɔɡa ɡure ba nɛ.
Kɛ ya Dɔɔ la cheɡɛ n habɔɔ dɛ tɛ mɛ kpeɡri n won bol Amanesoma la bwa, asɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la bwa no.
Korowii lɛɛ mɛ le siswɛm ta kɛŋɔ nɛn baa lɛo le nyujente nyoa ta ken.
Ya Dɔɔ la ɛɛ lee mɛ wobɛlbwa taa, dɛ́ kpɔ mɛ sɔnɔnɔɔ ken kaa o nyundua koobwɛɛ la ta.
Onee chɛ kɛ ya tɛo jirima tɔpere bɛlbwa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.
Aamen.
Kala aa ka mun N dɛ na Presela ne Akwela ne nɛra baa lɔ Oniseforɔs dem bwa.
Erastos ta lɔ Kɔrent.
Trɔfemos bwara dɛ weo nomanta, n ɡelo Maeletus.
Takapɔ dɛ́ ba mɔɔ alalawo saŋ tel.
Yubilus ne Pudens ne Laenos ne Klɔdea dɛ he bala asɔre tena baa kaa la bwa dɛ nae.
Yá Dɔɔ ja he nɛ.
Ń Naa Korowii sune he nɛ dɛ́ cha he bwa sekwaraa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Taetos ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la bɛl, asɛ dɛ ba yarada Yeesu.
Pɔɔl leo ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi asɔre waa lɔ Kret la ta.
Pɔɔl chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ lii Taetos ŋɔ, sitɔɔla baa lɔ asɔre la ta chɛ kɛ ba soɡa bini wobɛlbwa do wer.
O dɛ ja Taetos ŋɔ ó kpɔ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta, dɛɛ baɡle nɛra Yeesu waa la kɛrɛdɛ.
Ó bol baɡle nomonome, ne bechale, ne baala dɛ haahna bwa.
Men Pɔɔl maa ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ dɛ berɛ ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
Korowiirii lee mɛ dɛ ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ cha nɛra waa lee ba tɛ o te la, ásɛ ba yarada kaa sie ba won jemɛ o kasinteŋ la, dɛ́ che a ta tomɛ Korowii.
Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la hwɛɡaa n dɔ.
Korowii waa wola nyosone teŋe laanee baɡɛ ɡɛ mkpa nɔ nyoa bil mɔɔ dɛ ta komɛlbwa.
Tɔpere o tea aa toora la, o ɡelɔ mɛɛ bol a waa nɛra jemɛ.
Ya Lɛɛ Korowiirii kpɔa do n nɔn ta dɛ ŋɔ mɛ́ɛ baɡle nɛra.
N bie Taetos, henee n chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ.
Waa ya bwa aa dɛ yarada la taa a che he ɛ n bie tenten.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo chae dɛ́ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna.
Toma aa chɛ kɛ Taetos ɛ Kret N ɡele Kret harɛ ásɛ he tonɛ waa aa hiah kɛ he ɛ la bwa, dɛ́ cheɡ nomonome asɔrere aa lɔ bwɛɛre la bɛlbwa ta ɡɛ maa baɡle la.
He dɛ nyin he le asɔre nomoa aa, kpɔ onɔ la nomɛlbwa aa wola o wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɔe dɛɛ bol, ó dɔ hahbeŋkpoŋ, o bii ɡe ɛɛ yarada Yeesu, nɛra aa wola ba waa bol ŋɔ ba chɔɡɔ dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, a chɛ kɛ nɛn waa dɛ tɔ asɔre tena sie la ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe nomɛlbwa aa wola o wechɔɡee dɔ bol bwa, waa ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ nomanta.
A chɛ kɛ o ɛ nɛn waa wola o te baɡle, dɛ lɛ nɛn kon dɛɛ ja o kon ta, o baah aa wola di warawara, waa wola sennyɔdɛɛ ɛɛ, waa wola naɡra nyin, o siwi aa wola suuɡa ta beɡre kohona.
A chɛ kɛ o ɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin hɔɔhra lɛɛ, dɛɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa, dɛ dɔ nfɛrɛ kɛrɛdɛ, o waa do kaih, wedoŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ, wɛɛ lawɛ o te kɛrɛdɛ.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii kasinteŋ waa la ta ɡɛ ba fa aa baɡlo la, dɛ́ won dɛɛ baɡle Korowii waa aŋwɛnɛ ta nɛra be, ásɛ dɛ won dɛɛ ja ba, dɛ́ bol waa dɛɛ baɡle banɔ la baa dɛ tɔŋle kasinteŋ waa la, ásɛ ba ɡe jemɛ.
Deŋnekpeɡ tena lole taraken taeh, dɛ kpɔ wepuu dɛɛ neɡre nɛra.
Juu tena baa lɔ he bini dɛɛ maŋkura penteŋ laanee dena dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ kohona.
A chɛ kɛ he kah ba ba tɔ nyoa.
Ba dɛ chɔɡ dembir nɛra liire ba yon vɛh kasinteŋ waa la ta teŋa.
Ba koh suuɡa waa dɛɛ chaɡle waa aa wola chɛɛ.
Kret tena la bɛl baa dɛ liiru kɛŋɔ o jemɛ wobol kɛrɛdɛ fa bolɔ ŋɔ, “Ya Kret tena bwa ɛ nyosonteŋna, ya we-ɛɛla do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini ola ken.
Ya ɛ bɔhwaahra dɛɛ di kwaa kohona.” Kpelaa o bol, anomanta, di ba kasinteŋkpeɡ ba jemɛ, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ɡɛ da la, dɛ́ baa teŋɛ Korowii waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ la ta.
Ŋɔ ba bɛ deŋne cheɡ dɛɛ no Juu tena waa aa ɛ nyosone la, ne waa nɛra baa vɛh kasinteŋ waa la aa ŋɔa báa ɛ la.
He tea too waa, komɛlbwa wer tɛɛ, haa an kondoŋa lii.
Kɛ nɛra wechɔɡa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ baa wola yarada la, komɛlbwa ɛ kondoŋ tɛɛ ba.
Ba liire ne ba bambile bwa doŋo.
Ba ŋɔ ba jemɛ Korowii, kɛ ba we-ɛɛla dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ baa Korowii jemɛ.
Ba we-ɛɛla doŋo Korowii be kohona, ba deŋne ɡe kpeɡri.
Baa won ɛ wedɛɛɡe bɛlbwa bwa.
Korowii waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ He te, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ baɡle Korowii waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ aŋwɛnɛ ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Ŋɔ banjeni be báa lawɛ ba te, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa dɔ duure, dɛ́ dɔ nfɛrɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ kɛrɛdɛ la ta, dɛɛ nyin nɛn kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ dɔ bambile ɡe.
Ŋɔ hanjeni ɡe be báa ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ́ ɡel ba we-ɛɛla do kaih, dɛ bɛ nɛra dɛɛ ŋwalɛ, dɛ bɛ ɡel sen lɛ ba liire.
Báa baɡle waa aa wera.
Dɛ ba dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, anee dɛ́ baɡle han-yala báa nyin ba jaranar ne ba bii, dɛ́ dɔ nfɛrɛ kɛrɛdɛ, wedoŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole ba nɛ, dɛ́ won ba dem tomare ɛɛ, dɛɛ ɛ nɛra wedɛɛɡa, dɛɛ no ba jaranar wa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ Korowii waa la wechɔɡe dɔ bol.
Ŋɔ bonɔɔna ɡe be ŋɔ bá dɔ nfɛrɛ wobɛlbwa ta.
Henee chɛ kɛ he ɡel he we-ɛɛla do wer wobɛlbwa ta, ásɛ ba nyiŋi dɛɛ hweli.
Dɛɛ baɡle waa kasinteŋ ne, dɛɛ swɛɛ siwi a ta.
Gel a toɡre kɛrɛdɛ, nɛra bɛ a wobɛlbwa dɔ dɛ́ bol, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ tɔŋle heyaa bɛ ya wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɔ dɛ́ bol, ásɛ sihiih kpo ba.
Gel nɛra baa lɔ bane nɔn ta kɛŋɔ bonɔɔna kɛɛ toli la no kɛŋɔ báa no ba dɔɔranar wa.
Bá ɡel ba wa ɛɛ lɛ ba sie wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ bɛ waa beɡre dɛɛ do ba nyoa, dɛ bɛ ba kwaa dɛɛ ŋwɛ.
Kɛ bá ɡel ba we-ɛɛla dɔ yarada kɛrɛdɛ ba dɔɔranar be.
Gɛɛ dɛɛ ba ɡela ya Lɛɛ Korowii waa nɔ yaa dɛ baɡle nɔ che ba nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ sɔn wobɛlbwa ta.
Korowii pili suna waa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ taraken asɛ nɛra bwa jemɛ, o lɛɛ ba.
Anomanta, ɡɛ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ a wer kɛ ya laa sie kpɔ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ne harɛ nɔ ta pɛlchɔɡa la bwa ta, dɛ́ dɔ nfɛrɛ, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra, dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii ya bere nɔ ta, dɛɛ kpa ɡɛ saŋ Yeesu Kristo aa ba o jirima ne ya nao la.
Onee Korowijen ne ya Lɛɛ la.
O bala taa ya dɔ hwɛɡa ne silɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
O koh ya waa dɛ sewɛ dɛ won lɛ yaa le wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ta, dɛ laa ya doŋa bwa kpɔ ya nɛ, dɛ kpɔ yaa ɛ o ɡbo nɛra yaa swɛɛ siwi wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta.
Baɡ ba ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, dɛ́ kpɔ he kpeɡri do ba ɡbemba, dɛ́ ja ba, dɛ́ bɛ ɡel ba bɛlbwa nyiŋi he nyubaah.
Waa aa wera a chɛ kɛ yaa ɛ Lii ba ŋɔ báa pwɛr ba te dɛɛ tɛ nomonome baa dɛ di kpeɡri te bɛlbwa, dɛɛ no ba deŋna wa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te kɛ baa dɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera bwaa.
Ŋɔ ba be ba bɛ nɛra bwara wechɔɡe dɛɛ bol, ba bɛ dɛɛ naɡre, báa pwɛr ba te, dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa duure kɛrɛdɛ.
Ya ɡbabir fa ɡɛnɔ.
Ya fa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena.
Ba fa neɡre yaa, pɛlchɔɡa bwa soo siwi ne bodia kpɔ yaa berɛ yoma.
Meesɔɔh ne bɔweela bwa nee ya faa so.
Nɛra fa hah yaa, ya ɡe hah dɔŋa.
Kɛ ya Lɛɛ Korowii aa le chae waa cha yaa la ne o nyina waa dɛ nyin nɛn asɛ ya jemɛ a waa la, o lɛ yaa ta.
Ya te wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa laa o lɛ yaa ta.
Sunaa o sune ya nɛɛ dɛ lɛ yaa ta, dɛ sɔ yaa nee ya won do kɛ baa bera kwaa lolɛ yaa.
O Domadɛɛɡe waa kpɔa tɛ yaa o kwaa yaa la nɛɛ ya che dɛ dɔ mkpafale la.
O Domadɛɛɡe waa kpɔa tɛ yaa la, ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo waa o koh tɛ yaa kohona, asɛ Korowii suna la ɡel ya ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ya waa su o siwi, ásɛ ya won dɔ hwɛɡa kɛ o mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la ɛɛ ɛ ya konee.
Waa nɔ bwa ɛ kpela.
Anomanta, dɛɛ berɛ a baɡla ɔma, ásɛ nɛra baa no Korowii waa dɛ yarada la swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Gɛɛ wera dɛ dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ nomɛlbwa.
Kɛ laa he te kpɔ ɡɛne wetɔŋla ne ɡɛ he naawa aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ waa bini baɡla ta, ne naɡrenyin, ne Mmara ŋwɛnɛre waa tɔŋla ta.
A ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe.
A ɛ wepuu.
Nɛn waa dɛ ba nɛra baah peɡra ne la, bol waa baɡlo ó ɡel.
Dɛ o ta teŋɔ dɛɛ ɛ aa, bol waa baɡlo ja.
Dɛ o ta he nɛɛtena waa la noɛ yaa, he ne o bɛ wobɛlbwa ta pɛ.
Jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa do ɡɛ la vɛh kasinteŋ waa la.
O ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ o dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa ɡba, kɛ dɛ ɡe taa ɛ. Webaɡla aa ka mun Dɛ n tomɛ Aatemas kɛɛ Tichikos he be naa, takapɔ dɛ́ ba n be Nikopolis warane.
N ɛ n liire kɛ ń ka so bela alalawo saŋ.
Takapɔ dɛ́ cha Sɛnos waa ɛ mmara jereme la ne Apolos bá won la ba ŋwɛnɛ la.
Bɛ ɡel komɛlbwa baa kpɔ la ŋwɛnɛ la waa hiah ba.
Gel yabala bwa hweli wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ, dɛɛ cha nɛra aa hiah ba, dɛ bɛ nɛra baa wola tɔnɔ dɔe ɛ. Nɛra n ne baa lɔ bonɔ la bwa dɛ nae.
N dɛ na nɛra baa dɛ nyin yaa ya ne baa yarada Yeesu la.
N Naa Kórowii sune he nɛ dɛ́ cha he bwa sekwaraa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Dɛ Faelemɔn ɛ Kristo te dɛ dɔ yombaa bɛl baa yerɔ Onisemɔs.
A wola bɛl, Onisemɔs chwao le o dɔɔ be.
O kaa cheme Pɔɔl dɛ no Korowii waa la, asɛ dɛ yarada Yeesu.
Pɔɔl tomɛ Onisemɔs ŋɔ ó berɛ kaa Faelemɔn be, dɛ́ kpɔ tɔn nɔ ka tɛo.
Pɔɔl ŋɔ Faelemɔn be ŋɔ o ne Onisemɔs berɛ pɛ so ja, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ɛ o nime ba bwa pɛ dɛɛ yarada Yeesu.
Men Pɔɔl baa koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ do mɛ dea la, ne ya dɔŋ Timotii chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ ya dandɛɛɡe Faelemɔn waa bera ɛ ya dɔŋ tom-ɛɛ ɡe la, ne ya nimambie Afia, ne ya dɔŋ Akipus ya ne waa cheɡa dɛ yo dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o toma nɔ ta la, ne asɔre tena baa dɛ cheme he dem la bwa.
Ń Naa Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo cha heya, dɛ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Jaama ne wesoŋa N Korowii soŋa bini te bɛlbwa, n dɛ yerɛ he Faelemɔn sɔn dɛ kpɔ jam dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n no he nyina haa dɛ nyin Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwa, ne ɡɛ haa dɛ yarada ya Dɔɔ Yeesu la wa.
Waa maa dɛ soŋe Korowii laanee kɛŋɔ nyopɛo la he ne o nɛra aa dɔa hɛɛ yaradao la chae kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ he won jemɛ wedɛɛɡa te bɛlbwa Korowii aa dɛ nyin o cha yaa ya won dɔ, pɛɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la nomanta.
N dam, he nyina haa dɛ nyin Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra la dɛ do mɛ ɡbemba dɛ ɡel n sie ɛɛ lɛ taeh, dɛkalkɛ he dɛ nyiŋ ba dɛɛ do ba ɡbemba.
Pɔɔl soŋɔ tɛ Onisemɔs He nɛnnyin nomanta, n dɛ nyin kɛ n soŋe waane.
N fe dɔ ŋwɛnɛ Yeesu Kristo be pera kɛŋɔ ń di kpeɡri he nɛɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ hé ɛ ɡɛ aa wera kɛŋɔ he ɛ, kɛ maa ɡɛɛ ɛ. Nyina haa dɛ nyin nɛra la taa n che dɛɛ soŋe, nyiŋi ɡɛ men Pɔɔl aa ɛ banjena, ne dea baa koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ do mɛ nɔ ta dɛ no n waa nɔ.
He nɛndɔɔle Onisemɔs waa ɛ n bie Yeesu Kristo be pera la naa taa n che dɛɛ soŋe waa nɔ.
Gɛ saŋ baa do mɛ dea la taa n bol Yeesu waa baɡlo o kpɔ o te tɛo.
Wubwa la dɛ o ta tɔnɔ dɔe tɛɛ, kɛ taraken te o dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ ya bwa.
N ɡelɔ wɛɛ ba he be kɛŋɔ n ɡbaɡba bie maa dɛ nyinu n bambile bwa ne la.
N fe dɛ nyin kɛ o do n be bonɔ, dɛ́ che he naa ta dɛɛ cha mɛ n dea doe nɔ baa koh Amanesoma la waa dɛ do mɛ nɔ ta.
Kɛ maa nyin n ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ́ le he habɔɔ dɛ n ta he be ŋɔe, ásɛ a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ n dɛ di kpeɡri he nɛ.
N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ wedɛɛɡe haa ɛ la le he ɡbabir bambile bini.
Bɛl lole naa, Korowiirii ŋɔa o ken le he nɔn ta tama mɔɔ dɛ berɛ ba he ne ó so ka tonɛ.
O ta he yom ɡbo ɛɛ kpa.
O ɛ he nimedɛɛɡe ya Dɔɔ Yeesu be pera.
Gɛ n kwara aa dɛ nyin o waa nɔ, n jemɔ kɛ he te ɛɛ nyin o waa ɡwaa ɡɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɛ he yom ne he nime tenten ya Dɔɔ Yeesu be pera.
Dɛ he jemɔ kɛŋɔ n ne he bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ aa, lɛo kɛŋɔ haa dɛ ba n lɛɛ ken.
Dɛ o fa ɛɛ wechɔɡa ane, kɛɛ dɛ he kem bɛlee o dio, kpɔ pɛɛ mɛ.
N Pɔɔl ɡbaɡbaa chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bonɔ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ bɔe kemee la.
Kɛ jemɛ kɛ he ɡba di n kem Korowii mkpa la haa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛ dɔ la ta.
Anomanta, n dam, ɡel n ɡe dɔ tɔnɔ dɛ́ le nyopɛo n ne haa cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ dɔ la ta, ásɛ n baah sɔɔh mɛ.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ no n waa nɔɔ dɛ ɛ ɡwaa ɡɛ kwara.
A waa n chwerɛ tɔn nɔ la.
Anɔ la ɡe aa jaa laanee kɛŋɔ nyin dea dɛɛ cheɡ mɛ.
N dɔ hwɛɡa kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ no he wesoŋa haa dɛ soŋo dɛɛ tɛ mɛ laanee ásɛ dɛ berɛ kpɔ mɛ ba tɛ heyaa ja.
Epafras baa koh Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ do n ne on dea la dɛ nae.
Gɛɛ Mak ne Aristakus ne Demas dɛ Luk baa ɛ n bala tom-ɛɛra la ɡe ɛɛ nae.
Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo sune he nɛ, dɛ́ cha he bwa sekwaraa.
Aamen.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Yaa jemɛ naate waa dena chwerɛ tɔn nɔ.
A ken ɛɛ ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Pɔɔlee.
Naate dɛ nyin ó cha Kristo tena, ásɛ ba won dɛɛ teŋɛ Yeesu waa la ta, dɛkalkɛ onee Korowii le tɛ yaa ŋɔ, ó ba lɛ yaa le ya wechɔɡa ne seo ta.
O baɡlɔ kɛ Yeesu ɛ nomɛl waa ɡwaa Korowii keamere baa bala kaa la, ne nyundua toroma dɛ Mosis.
Korowii baɡlɔ kɛ Yeesu baa chiɡ sɔfore ba fa aa lole Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔobene saŋ la naa ta, dɛkalkɛ o te ɛ saraha aa do wer ka tonɛ tɛ wechɔɡa, anomanta, ola kpoora dɛ ɛ saraha bɛlbwa ta hiaih kpa.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ nomanta, dɛ ya dɛ yarada Yeesu aa, yaa seo kɛɛ Bɔnsam kpeɡrii ɔmɛ kpa.
Naate waa chwerɛ tɔn nɔ baɡlɔ ŋɔ naweewa aa lɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔobene Tɔn la bini la, ne ola kpoora dɛ ɛ saraha fa lole kɛ komɛl chaa, asɛ Sɔfonomoa kasinteŋ Yeesu ba, dɛ ba kpɔ o te ɛ saraha tenten tɛ yaa.
O berɔ dɛɛ baɡle nɛra ba fa aa lɛ sɔn dɛ so Israel tena bini saŋ la we-ɛɛla, ɡɛ aa dɛ ba wona cha yaa, ásɛ ya won kpɔ ya hwɛɡa do Korowii nɛ, dɛ wekpeɡa bɛlbwa pu yaa aa, ya bɛ habɔɔ le.
Korowii bie la ɡwaa nyundua toroma A saŋ la dɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o keamere nɛɛ dɛɛ bol waa ya naawa be.
Kera aŋwɛnɛ bwaa o bol waa ba be.
Dɛ ŋwɛnɛre waa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ bol waa ba be fuuh.
Fini tɔpera nɔ aa ka mun nɔ te, o Bie nɛɛ o che dɛɛ bol waa ya be.
Korowii Bie nɔɔ o kpɔ cheɡ kɛŋɔ o toole naa, onee lole dɛ dɔ komɛlbwa.
O nɛɛ Korowii che dɛ ta komɛlbwa.
He na o jirima waa dɔa aa, dɛ he na jirima Korowii aa dɔa.
Gɛ Korowii aa doa o ɡe den do kati.
O wobol dɔ kpeɡri.
A kpeɡrii lawɛ komɛlbwa kpoŋe.
Korowii Bie la aa laa ya wechɔɡa kpɔ ya nɛɛ tonɛ la, o kaa so nomombɔr nyundua Nemenɛ Korowii diɡ ta, dɛ ɡwaa nyundua toroma bwa, ɡɛ sɔn Korowii aa tɛo la aa ɡwaa ba sɔn la.
Korowii ta o nyundua toroma la bɛlbwa be ŋɔe ŋɔ, “N Biee hen, fini n berɛ he Mɛɛ” bwa.
O ta ba bɛlbwa waa bolɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ɛ o Mɛɛ, ásɛ o ɛ n Bie” bwa.
Korowii aa dɛ ba o Bie waa lɔ o be loɡla la harɛ ta toma la, o bolɔ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ nyundua toroma bwa ɛɛ tomɔ.” O bol nyundua toroma la ɡe waa ŋɔ, “O ɡelɔ o nyundua toroma do kɛŋɔ peu ne ninlao.” O bol o Bie la waa ja, dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii, he kora ɛɛ cheo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Kasinteŋii hɛɛ ba kpoŋa dɛɛ di kora he nɛra nɛ.
He dɛ nyin waa aa toɡra dɛ ki wechɔɡa.
A waa Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ lee cheɡ he bala koranar bwa bini, dɛ fuɡe noo do he nyu ta dɛ tɛɛ silɛɛ.” Korowii berɔ ŋɔ, “Nomoa, wobɛlbwa mumpar la, henee ta harɛ.
Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua ɡe, he nɔn tomaa a bwa.
A bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo, aa wola lee do kpa, kɛ he te ɛɛ do lee dɛɛ la.
A bwa ɛɛ ba ɛ kombenaa kɛŋɔ yal yon hɛh la.
Hɛɛ kpɔa bil kɛŋɔ yal hɛoh waa, ba yon kpɛrɛwo bil la.
Aa beɡroo, aa wola won do wer kɛ konfala saŋ bɛlbwa wee kpa.
Kɛ he te ɛɛ do ɡɛ haa doa saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ he bene ɡe aa jaɡaa dɔ bwa.” Korowii ta nyundua toroma la bɛlbwa be ŋɔe ŋɔ, “So nomombɔr n diɡ ta ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba he dɔma ne harɛ he tiɡri ba nɛ.” Korowii bonɔɔna laa o nyundua toroma la te naa?
Nɛra Korowii aa ba lɛ la waa o yon dɛɛ tomɛ o nyundua toroma la ásɛ baa cha o nɛra o won lɛɛ ba.
Ya lɛɛ waa do kan Gɛɛ a do te naa, a chɛ kɛ ya do sie dɛ nyiŋi waa yaa noa la kɛrɛdɛ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ ba koni dɛ́ nyoɡre ŋwɛnɛ.
Waa Korowii fa aa kpɔa tɛ o nyundua toroma ba bol la ɛo kɛ mmarakpeɡ bɛl.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola a ta teŋɛ la, bá tɛr o deŋne ɡɛ aa chɛa.
A do ɡɛ naa, ya lɛɛ waa nɔ aa ɡwaa nyundua toroma waa la kohona nɔ, dɛ ya vɛah aa, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba ɛɛ dɛ́ leɔ?
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɡbaɡba fa tɔ sie bol ya lɛɛ waa nɔ, asɛ nɛra baa noa ɡe di danseɛ ya be kɛ a ɛ kasinteŋ.
Korowii ɡbaɡba cheɡɛ nyokpowaa ne wekpeɡa ɛɛ ta, ne o Domadɛɛɡe waa kpɔa bɔne nɛra ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin la ta dɛ di a danseɛ.
Yeesu baa kpɔ nɛwɛnyini bwadabi Nɛra baa dɛ ba le doe yaa dɛ bol ba waa nɔ, o ta ban kpɔe do nyundua toroma lɔɡa.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini bobɛl ŋɔ, “Korowii, nɛwɛnyini ɡee bɔkwa asɛ hɛɛ lii o waɔ?
Nɛwɛnyini ɡee bɔkwa hɛɛ dawɛ o waɔ?
Tamaa kenii he ɡel nyundua toroma ɡwaalo.
He ɡelɔ o dɔ jirima, asɛ komɛlbwa ɛɛ tɛo duure, dɛ kpɔ komɛlbwa do o lɔɡa.” Waa kpɔ komɛlbwa do nɛwɛnyini lɔɡa nɔ, a baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ komɛlbwa toole waa wola o kpeɡri dɔe.
Kɛ ya ta nae kɛŋɔ kwaa bwa lɔ nɛwɛnyini lɔɡa mɔɔ.
Kɛ ya dɛ na Yeesu te kɛŋɔ Korowii aa ba o ne harɛ, asɛ nyundua toroma ɡwaalo tama, asɛ waa na wahala dɛ sewɛ la, o tɛo jirima dɛ ɡel komɛlbwa ɛɛ tɛo duure.
Korowii alaworomɛɛ o sewɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyini bwa la.
Korowiirii ta komɛlbwa, asɛ a che o kpeɡri ta komɛlbwa ɡe do le.
Waa ɡela Yeesu na wahala la, maɡraa a maɡre kɛrɛdɛ.
Waa dɛ nyin o lɛ nɛndamanta dɛ ɡel ba ɛ o bii, dɛ do o be dɛ dɔ jirima la waa o ɡel Yeesu waa ɛ ba Sitɔɔ la ɡbaɡba kpɔ a ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la ta, dɛ na wahala dɛ won ɛ ba Sitɔdɛɛɡe kaih ka tonɛ dɛ lɛɛ ba la.
Yeesuu laa nɛwɛnyini doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ ɡel ba ɛ Korowii nɛra.
O ne nɛra waa laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ ba nɛɛ la bwa Mɛɛ beŋkpoŋ.
A waa aa wola on sihiih ɛ kɛŋɔ o yer ba o nimanar la.
O ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ bol he waa haa ɛa n nimanar bee.
Mɛɛ kpɛɛree ba chema binii.” O toolo berɛ ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kpɔ n hwɛɡaa do Korowii nɛ.” O berɔ ŋɔ, “N ne bechale Korowii aa tɛ mɛ laanee la.” Nɛra Yeesu aa dɛ yer ba bechale la, baa ɛ nɛwɛnyina dɛ dɔ bwadabii ne chal nomanta la, o ɡbabir baa berɛ nɛwɛnyini dɛ do kɛ ban, dɛ dɔ bwadabii ne chal.
O ɛ ɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ won che o seo waa dɛ ba sewa ta dɛ chɔɡ naate seo aa tɛo kpeɡri nɛra nɛɛ la.
Onee Bɔnsam.
Yeesu ɛ ken ásɛ dɛ won lɛ nɛra baa koh seo ɔma waa dɛ ɛ yoma ba soɡa bini bwa la.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ kasinteŋ, nyundua toroma laa o cha nɔ, Abraham naanaree o cha.
Dɛ a chɛ kɛ Yeesu do ɡɛ o nimanar la aa doa ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
Gɛɛ ó ɛ dɛ́ won tomɛ Korowii kɛŋɔ ba Sɔfonomoa kasinteŋ ne dɛɛ na ba sum, dɛ́ won dɛɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa, dɛ́ won dɛɛ kwaa ba ne Korowii baah.
Bɔnsam daahno na dɛ ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa ó fe ɛ wechɔɡa, kɛ o ta on wone.
Anomanta, wɛɛ wonoo cha nɛra Bɔnsam aa dɛ daah ba dɛɛ na la.
Yeesu ɡwaa Mosis Anomanta, n bala Korowii nɛra waa le ya ne he bwa tɛ o te, hé ta sie nyiŋi Yeesu na.
Korowiirii tomɔ ŋɔ ó ba ɛ ya waa yaa dɛ yarada nɔ Sɔfonomoa.
O waa dɔ kasinteŋ Korowii waa kpɔɔ ŋɔ ó ɛ o toma la be kɛŋɔ Mosis fa aa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii nɛra nɛɛ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ wobɛlbwa ta la.
Nɛn do dem aa, nɛra dɛ kpɛɛro dɛ ɡwaa dem la.
Gɛɛ Yeesu ɡe do.
A chɛ kɛ ba kpɛɛro ɡwaa Mosis, dɛkalkɛ dem bɛlbwa waa ɛ dem la, dɛ nɛnee doo.
Korowii ɡee ta komɛlbwa.
Mosis aa ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii nɛra waa bwa ta la, dɛ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ taeh, kɛŋɔ bonɔɔ kasinteŋ te wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ o dɔɔ be la.
Dɛ o dɛ bol waa Korowii aa ba bol kerekere la nɛra be.
Kɛ Yeesu Kristo te kasinteŋ waa dɔa la, Korowii Bie on, asɛ o ɛ Korowii nɛra bwa nomoa.
Ya yarada yaa dɔa Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ, ne hwɛɡa yaa dɔa ya sie lɛ a ta la, ya lawɛ a bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ naa, Yeesu Kristo nɛraa yan.
Nɛra baa vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa jae Anomanta, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe bolɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he no Korowii waa fini naa, he bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ kɛŋɔ he naawa fa aa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh o waa noe dɛ jo o nɛɛ la.
He naawa bene fifraanaarɛ baa dia kpɔɡ baah la, ba daah mɛ na dɛ na waa maa ɛa bwa.
Anomanta, n baah di ɡɛ nɛra la nɛ, asɛ n ŋɔ ba bambile ta n waa lawɛ bwa, asɛ ba vɛh n waa ta teŋa.
N baah aa dia la, n ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ, ‘Baa ona maa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ba onɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ onɛ la dɔe ba bwa.’ ” Anomanta, yabala, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ he bini bɛlbwa bɛ liichɔɡa ba dɔ kɛŋɔ waa Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa laanee yarada, dɛ́ ba vɛh o waa ta teŋa.
Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ ja dɔŋa tɔperee bwa mɔɔ tɔpere la o Domadɛɛɡe aa bol o waa dɛ ŋɔ “fini” la ɡarɛ, ásɛ wechɔɡa bɛ heyaa ba neɡre, he deŋne ba do kpeɡri.
Gɛ ya yarada aa doa le mumpar la, dɛ ya wono che ɡɛ kiŋkiŋ ka tel wobɛlbwa jaɡa aa, dɛ ya ne Yeesu Kristo pɛo wobɛlbwa ta.
Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ he no Korowii waa fini naa, he bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ kɛŋɔ he naawa fa aa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh o waa noe dɛ jo o nɛɛ la.” Dɛ lepetenaa no Korowii waa dɛ ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh o waa noe dɛ jo o nɛɛ nɔɔ?
Nɛra Mosis aa tɔ ba sie dɛ le Ijipt harɛ la bwaa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ la.
Lepetena nɛɛ Korowii baah di bene fifraanaarɛ nɔɔ?
Nɛra baa ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ serewe kpɔɡ baah la, ba nɛɛ o baah di.
Korowii aa ŋwɛɛra ŋɔ baa ona waa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ba onɛ la dɔe ba la, dɛ lepetena bee o ŋɔ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
Nɛra baa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ la bee o ŋɔ ɡɛ.
He ta nae kɛŋɔ ba yarada bɛ dɔe waa Korowii aa wola ban ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ba dɔ ona waa dɔa tɛɛ ba la aa?
Ona Tɔpere waa ɛ nɛra baa dɛ yarada Korowii kon Korowii nyoa waa baɡɛ nɛra ona waa ŋɔa bá ba onɛ la ta lole.
Anomanta, hé ɡel ya nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ he bɛlbwa bɛ a ɡɛ nyobaɡa la ba paŋɛ.
Gɛ yaa dɛ no Korowii Amanesoma nɔ, ɡɛɛ ba ɡe noa.
Kɛ ba te aa noa la, a ta tɔnɔ leɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ta an yaradae.
Ya te nɔ, ya dɛ yarada Korowii waa la, anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ya onɛ ona waa dɛ onɛ la bɛl.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “N baah aa dia la, n ŋwɛɛrɔ ŋɔ baa ona maa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ba onɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ onɛ la dɔe ba bwa.” A ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ ona toole kpa.
Gɛ saŋ Korowii aa ta harɛ la, dɛ o ɛ o wobɛlbwa tonɛ dɛ te onɛ.
Korowii Tɔn bobɛl bol tɔpenuanɛ wee la waa ŋɔ, “Korowii aa tonɛ o toma bwa la, o onɔ tɔpenuanɛ wee la ta,” asɛ bela yaa dɛ bol o waa nɔ baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ, “Baa ona maa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá ba onɛ ɡɛ maa dɛ onɛ la dɔe ba bwa.” A baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra bane ta lole dɛɛ ba a ɡɛ ona la dɔe.
Aa cheɡɛ a saŋ la tena baa no Korowii Amanesoma nɔ deŋnekpeɡ ta asɛ ba paŋɛ Korowii ona la, Korowii berɔ kwaa do tɔpefale, dɛ pa o sɔn “fini.” A habɔɔ aa biɡra la, Korowii cheɡɛ Devid nɛɛ dɛ bol ɡɛ tɔpere nɔ wa.
Anee n faa bol la.
“Dɛ he no Korowii waa fini naa, he bɛ deŋnekpeɡ ɛ.” Josua aa ba a saŋ la tena ne ba harɛ ta la, dɛ ba fe dɔ ona Korowii aa bol o waa la aa, Korowii fe ta berɛ bol tɔpefale waa kpa.
He nyiŋo na naa, ona Korowii aa kwaara cheɡ o nɛra la ta lole bá ba onɛ, kɛŋɔ Korowii aa Ona Tɔpenuanɛ wee la ta la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ onɛ ona Korowii aa dɛ onɛ la, dɛ o onɛ o toma bwa ta kɛŋɔ Korowii aa onɛ o toma ta tɔpenuanɛ wee la ta la.
Anomanta, hé ɡel ya swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ dɔ ɡɛ ona la.
A ta chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa ɛ a saŋ la tena deŋnekpeɡ la dɔŋ dɛ́ ba paŋɛ ɡɛ ona nɔ.
Korowii waa waa bola do kɛ kon o siwi aa lole, dɛɛ ɛ toma.
A nyɛɡre ɡe ɡwaa naŋɡɔse bɛlbwa, hale dɛ́ fe won pere hweera le lileo ta, dɛ́ won jo sema bini, hale dɛ́ fe won pere hoɡa ne fɔɔla baah.
A wono dɛɛ jemɛ nɛwɛnyini liire ne o wesɔɔhla bwa.
Korowii kontaale bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won kpɔ o te sɔɔh.
Wobɛlbwa chɔ baŋ o be wɛɛ nao.
Onee dɛ pɛɛ yaa waa bwa yaa baa ɛa harɛ nɔ ta.
Yeesu ɛ Sɔfonomonjen Ya dɔ Sɔfonomonjen waa wona la Korowii sie tenten.
Onee Korowii Bie Yeesu la.
Anomanta, hé ɡel ya lawɛ o waa la yaa dɛ yarada la bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ.
Ya Sɔfonomonjen yaa dɔa la ta nɛn waa wola ya nɛɛ sune ya ɡwɛɡra nɔ ta ɛɛ.
Daahna bɛlbwa soo siwi toole Bɔnsam aa wola on daahnɛ kɛŋɔ waa dɛ daah yaa nɔ.
Kɛ o cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ, o ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Anomanta, hé ɡel ya lɔ bambile dɛ́ tel Korowii waa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba la sie.
Wɛɛ na ya sumii dɛɛ cha yaa ɡɛ saŋ aa hiah yaa.
Sɔfonomoa bɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la, o dɔŋa nɛwɛnyini binii ba yon leo, dɛ kpɔɔ ŋɔ ó ɛ Korowii toma dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ kpɔ jam kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpo kondɛɛra dɛ́ fuah dɛɛ tɛo ba wechɔɡa wa.
A ɡɛ Sɔfonomoa nɔ ɛɛ wonoo dɛɛ sune nɛra baa wola waa jemɛ dɛɛ koni la nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɡba kwaraa ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ won dɛɛ vɛh wechɔɡa ɛɛ.
Gɛ o yon kpo kwaa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ nɛra ba wechɔɡa waa la, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba ɛɛ dɛɛ tɛ o tenten, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɡba ɡe dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Sɔfonomoa ɛɛ nɔ ɛ wejena.
Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ ɡbaɡba won le o te dɛ ɛ a ɡɛ toma nɔ, nemenɛ Korowii aa leo kɛŋɔ waa le Arɔn o ɛ bɛl la.
Gɛɛ a do Yeesu Kristo ɡe aa wola o te ɡbaɡba leɛ Sɔfonomoa toma aa ɛ wejena nɔ ta.
Korowiirii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N Biee hen, fini n berɛ he Mɛɛ.” Korowii bol bobɛl ɡe ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ ɛ Sɔfoo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk.” Yeesu aa lɔ harɛ ta la, dɛ wii ne siniire nee wɛɛ soŋe komɛlbwa dɛɛ le Korowii be.
Dɛ Korowii dɔ kpeɡri dɛ leo seo ta.
Waa pwɛra dɛɛ no Korowii deŋna waa la nomanta, dɛ Korowii dɛ no o wesoŋa.
Yeesu ɛ Korowii Bie, kɛ o na wahala, dɛ che a ta dɛ won pwɛr o te dɛ no o Mɛɛ deŋna wa.
Waa wona teŋɛ o Mɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ ta kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ la, o berɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o Yeesu ŋwɛnɛ ta bwa Lɛɛ, bá che o nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ lɛɛ aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Korowii bol o waa dɛ ɛo Sɔfonomoa kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk fa aa ɛ Sɔfo la.
Habɔɔ bera jae wa Waa yaa dɔa dɛ bol he be dɛ le ɡɛ waa nɔ ta la warɔ, kɛ a bini baɡla kpeɡri, dɛkalkɛŋɔ haa waa mun no.
Haa lea hweli waa nɔ biɡro, a chɛ kɛ saŋ nɔ he fe aa jema dɛɛ baɡle nɛra a wa.
Kɛ he ta do kɛ nɛra baa pa mun dɛɛ hweli Korowii wa, asɛ a chɛ kɛ ba le mun ta dɛ́ baɡ ba a wa.
A fe aa chɛ kɛ he won dɛɛ di kondikwaa tenten la, elee he ta ɛɛ ɔr.
Nomɛlbwa o ta aa dɛ ɔr Korowii waa ta la, bechalaa on.
Waa waa jemɛ, waa wedɛɛɡa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi jemɛ.
Nomonomee dɛɛ di kondikwaa tenten.
Banee ɛ waa biɡri, dɛ jemɛ wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa.
Yaa jemɛ Yeesu Kristo weloɡla la nomanta la, siee a chɛ kɛ yaa kaa, dɛɛ la nomonome bini.
Yaa berɛ pa mun bol ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ ya charɛ liire le ya wechɔɡa aa dɛ kaa ya ne seo ta la ta, ne ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ ya yarada Korowii dɛ kpɔ ya te tɛo waa kpa.
Yaa berɛ bol Korowii nee sɔe wa, ne nɔɔra kpɔe dɛ dawɛ nɛra nɛ, ne ɡɛ lala bwa aa ba ir seo ta, ne ɡɛ Korowii aa ba bol nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole dɛ́ bɔ ba ba wechɔɡa kem aa wola jaɡaa dɔ waa kpa.
Dɛ Korowii sɛoh waa, yaa ɡel anɔ bwa waa baɡlaa, dɛ́ kaa sie.
Nɛra baa yarada Korowii waa ka la, ɛrɛɛ bá ɛ dɛ charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta dɛ berɛ yaradao jaɔ?
Korowii chaah ba sie o waa nɔ ta ka, asɛ ba na Korowii doa koŋkɛɛle la som la bɛl, asɛ dɛ tɛɛ ba o Domadɛɛɡe la ka.
Ba no Korowii waa la dɛ jemɛ wera aa wera, dɛ dɔ kpeɡri baa dɛ ba dɔe tɔpere waa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba bala la ta ane.
Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, ba ɡel Korowii waa ba fa aa dɛ yarada la!
A kpeɡri kɛ ba charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta dɛ berɛ ba yaradao, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ baa kwaara kpaa Korowii Bie la dɛɛ pɛl o daɡaɡre ta, dɛ ɡel sihiih kpoo nɛra baah ta.
Ba ɛo dawɛ ba nyu ta.
Harɛ bɛlbwa bwaala aa dɛ nɛ o ta wɛɛ ɛ kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ parɔ la, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ó ɛ harɛdɛɛɡe.
Kɛ dɛ harɛ bɛlbwa le kpɔɡa ne sɔɔhne aa, o ta tɔnɔ dɔe.
O cheɡɛ Korowii taahna nyoa.
Baa fuuh.
N dandɛɛɡa, yaa dɛ bol anɔ bwa nɔ, he te la, he wa aa yaa ɡwaŋɛ.
Ya jemɔ kɛ he we-ɛɛla ɛɛ do werii a baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii lɛ heya.
Korowii ta nɛn waa wola waa ɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ soh he tondɛɛɡa haa dɛ ɛ, ne ɡɛ haa dɛ nyinu dɛ koh a waa cha o nɛra dɛ ta ɛɛ cha ba la waa.
Ya dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he bɛlbwa swɛɛ siwi ɡɛ dɛ́ ka tonɛ, ásɛ dɛ won dɔ kon haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o ta la.
Yaa nyin kɛ he bwara hwah heya.
Ya dɛ nyin he kpɔ nɛra baa lawɛ bambile dɛɛ yarada Korowii, ásɛ o tɛɛ ba kwaa waa baɡ ba nyoa la.
Korowii aa o nyobaɡaa charɛ bwa Korowii baɡɛ Abraham nyoa.
Waa baɡɔ nyoa la, komɛlbwa aa wola toole dɛ ɡwaalo la, o ɡbaɡbaa o ŋwɛɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ mɛɛ sweeree andɛɛɡaa, dɛ́ tɛɛ naanar kohona.” Abraham ɡe wono lawɛ bambile aaa, dɛ ba dɔ kon Korowii aa baɡɔ nyoa la.
Dɛ nɛn dɛ ba ŋwɛɛra aa, kon waa ɡwaaloo o yon ŋwɛɛ, ásɛ ba jemɛ kɛ kasinteŋii wɛɛ bol, dɛ tɔŋla bɛlbwa teŋo.
Dɛ Korowii dɛ nyin o baɡle nɛra baa dɛ ba kon waa baɡ ba nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo tɛɛ ba la kɛŋɔ waa o liire chara ba bwa, a waa o ŋwɛɛ la.
Korowii baɡɛ nyoa dɛ ŋwɛɛ o tenten ja.
Webele anɛ nɔ ɡelɔ nyobaɡa la do kpeɡri, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii aa won teŋe nyosone.
Anee dɛ do ya nɛra yaa ba Korowii be ŋɔ ó lɛ yaa la ɡbemba, ásɛ ya won do kpeɡri ya hwɛɡa yaa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ la ta.
A ɡɛ hwɛɡa nɔɔ dɛ ɡel ya bambile won che bobeŋkpoŋ, ásɛ ya che kɛrɛdɛ.
Hwɛɡa nɔ nomanta, a kaa ɛ kɛŋɔ yaa won jo Korowii Dea la bini tenten, bela pateesan fa aa tɔa nɛmpɛɛne aa wola bela jo la.
Yeesu aa ɛ Sɔfonomoa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk la, o koh ya waa dɛ tɔ sie ya nɛɛ jo bela mɔɔ ya ɡe ba.
Sɔfo Mɛlkesɛdɛk A ɡɛ Mɛlkesɛdɛk nɔ, dɛ Salɛm kooroo on, asɛ o ɛ Nemenɛ Korowii Sɔfo.
A saŋ la Abraham aa le laa waa kaa yo dɛ pɔ koranar banaarɛ bane nɛɛ dɛɛ ba la, Mɛlkesɛdɛk chemo dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛo.
Belaa Abraham bɔne kwaa waa dɔa laa la ta bwa bini bɔre fi dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛo.
Mɛlkesɛdɛk sɔn la munii “Waa aa Toɡra Kooro.” Salɛm ɡe munii “bambisɔɔhna.” Anomanta, dɛ “Bambisɔɔhna Kooroo” on.
Mɛlkesɛdɛk ta nya ne mɛɛ dɔe ya jemɛ.
O ta lolanar dɔe.
O ta lola tɔpere ne sewa tɔpere ɡba dɔe ya jemɛ.
O ɛ Sɔfo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la aa wola jaɡa dɔe kɛŋɔ Korowii Bie la ken.
He na ɡɛ waa ɛ nɛnjen kenɛ?
Ya nabaa Abraham o sɔn aa lea kohona la, o ɡbabir bɔne kwaa waa dɔa o laa ta bwa bini fi dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛo.
Lewi naanar baa ɛ sɔfore la, Mosis Mmara la ŋɔ ba bwɛɛ tena la bɛlbwa ɛɛ bɔne o kwaa bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba.
Kɛ Abraham naanaree ba bwa ɡe ɡba.
Lewi dea laa Mɛlkesɛdɛk le.
Kɛ Abraham ɡe bɔne o kwaa bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛo, asɛ Mɛlkesɛdɛk swee andɛɛɡa tɛ o kwaraa Korowii aa baɡɔ nyoa la.
Ya bwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ nomoaa sweera dɛɛ tɛ bechala.
Lewi luɡe ta sɔfore baa dɛ lɛ kwaa fi bɛlbwa bɔrbeŋkpoŋa la, ba dɛ sewɛ.
Mɛlkesɛdɛk te aa lɛa la, Korowii Tɔn baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ o lole saŋ bɛlbwa.
Lewi luɡe ta sɔforee dɛɛ lɛ kwaa fi bɛlbwa bɔrbeŋkpoŋa.
Kɛ yaa wonoo ŋɔ o nabaa Abraham aa bɔne o kwaa bini bɔre fi dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ tɛ Mɛlkesɛdɛk la, Lewi ɡba tɛo.
Dɛ ba ta Lewi lolɛ mɔɔ, kɛ yaa wonoo ŋɔ o ta ɛ o nabaa Abraham dwee dɛ ta ɛɛ ba bala a ɡɛ saŋ Mɛlkesɛdɛk aa cheme Abraham la.
Yeesu do kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk Gɛ saŋ Korowii aa tɛ o nɛra Mmara la, ɡɛ saŋee Lewi dea tena pa mun dɛɛ di sɔfore.
Dɛ nɛra fe ɛɛ wonoo che saraha Lewi dea sɔfore la fa aa ɛa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba la ta dɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ka tonaa, a fe ta hiaih kɛŋɔ Sɔfo waa do kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk berɛ ba, dɛ́ ɡel onɔ la waa le Lewi dea dɛ do kɛŋɔ Arɔn.
Dea o tena aa dɛ di sɔfore la, o beraa, a chɛ kɛ mmara la ɡe berɛ.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ yaa dɛ baɡle nɔ, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu waa yaa bol la.
O ɡe dea waa le o ta la korɛ sɔfore dea ta.
O dea waa le o ta la te bɛlbwa ta Sɔfo toma ɛɛ bwa.
Nomɛlbwa jemɔ kɛŋɔ Juda deaa o le.
Mosis ɡe fa ta bolɛ ŋɔ Juda dea tena dɛ di sɔfore bwa.
Tarakenii waa la bini ta chaah, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Sɔfo bɛl balɔ dɛ do kɛ Mɛlkesɛdɛk ken kati.
Nɛwɛnyini sɔfore dii mmara ta laa a che o ɛ Sɔfo.
O mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la kpeɡri taa a che o ɛ Sɔfo.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, Korowii Tɔn di danseɛ o waa ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ ɛ Sɔfoo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛŋɔ Mɛlkesɛdɛk.” Mmarabene la aa wola kpeɡri ne tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe la waa Korowii laa kpɔ.
A ɡɛ Mosis Mmara nɔ fa ta wone ɡel nɛwɛnyina ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ka tonɛ.
Kɛ taraken te, ya dɔ wefala dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta a ɡwaa ambena la, dɛ che a ta dɛ́ won tuuh dɛɛ tel Korowii.
Waa aa bera ja laanee kɛŋɔ Korowii ŋwɛɛra waa ŋwɛɛra la.
Ba fa aa dɛ cheɡ Lewi dea sɔfore la, Korowii fa ta ken ŋwɛɛrɛ bwa.
Yeesu te la, ŋwɛɛraa Korowii ŋwɛɛ dɛ cheɡo Sɔfo.
Ba baɡle a waa Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii ŋwɛɛrɔ, waa nyoa bera ba.
‘Hɛɛ ɛ Sɔfoo saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’ ” A ɡelɔ Yeesu ɛ ajinamuu te, ásɛ nɛwɛnyina nyiŋi dɛ́ na fɔofale Korowii aa fɔwa dɛ tɛ yaa la wera waa wera dɛ ɡwaa ombene la.
Anɔ la aa jaa laanee kɛŋɔ dɛ Lewi dea sɔfore la dɛ serewe.
Anomanta, a ɡelɔ nɛra baa di sɔfore la warɛ.
Kɛ Yeesu te, o lole saŋ bɛlbwa.
O sɔfore toma la aa berɛ dɛɛ kaa nɛnfale bɛlbwa be bwa.
Nomɛlbwa waa cheɡɛ Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ tuuh dɛɛ tel Korowii la, Yeesu ɛɛ lɛo waa wola nyoɡre kpa bwa.
O lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyina.
Maɡraa a den maɡre kɛŋɔ yaa dɔ Sɔfonomoa waa do kɛ Yeesu dɛɛ cha yaa.
Doŋa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ, o tea too, o ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ta pɛɛ.
Korowii tɛo nomonome dɛ keeru kaa o be nyundujaɡla.
O ta doe kɛŋɔ Lewi dea Sɔfonomonome la baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa saraha tɔpere bɛlbwa la.
Ba te chɛ kɛ ba tɔ sie ɛ ba ɡbaɡba wechɔɡa saraha mɔɔ dɛ ɛ nɛra la ɡe wechɔɡa saraha.
Saraha beŋkpoŋ ɡboo Yeesu ɛ, bɛl ta jae kpa.
O kpɔ o te ɡbaɡba ɛ saraha.
Baa nyiŋi Mosis Mmara ta dɛɛ kpɔ Sɔfonomonome la, nɛra baa wola wone dɛɛ vɛh wechɔɡa kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyina bwa aa doa laanee baa kpɔ.
Kɛ Mosis Mmara la habɔɔ la, waa Korowii aa bola dɛ ŋwɛɛ o ɡbaɡba la, an ɡela o Bie ɛ Sɔfonomoa.
O te vɛh wechɔɡa dɛ do kaih saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Sɔfonomoa waa cheɡa tɛ fɔofale Waa yaa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ ya dɔ Sɔfonomoa.
O soɡe nomombɔr Korowijen kookara la jwɛɛh nyundua.
Korowii Dea bini tenten la, belaa wɛɛ di sɔfore.
O ɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea ɡbaɡba, nɛwɛnyini laa doo.
Sɔfonomoa bɛlbwa tomaa kɛŋɔ wɛɛ fuh kwaa dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, dɛɛ ɛ saraha ɡe.
Anomanta, a hiaoh kɛŋɔ ya Sɔfonomoa nɔ ɡe dɔ kwaa waa kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii.
Dɛ o fe lɔ harɛ bonɔ naa, o fe aa Sɔfo ɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ sɔfore lɔ harɛ ta dɛɛ ɛ saraha ɡɛ Mosis Mmara aa baɡla la.
Ba sɔfore toma baa dɛ ɛ la, chaaraa baa chaa ɡɛ baa dɛ ɛa Korowii doa la.
A tenten laa.
A waa Mosis fa aa dɛ ba Korowii Tɛnte Dea baa dɛ tomɔ o bini la ɛɛ la, Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Nyiŋi dɛ ɛ komɛlbwa kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ maa baɡle bwe la doa la.” Taraken nɔ, ba tɛ Yeesu sɔfore toma o ɡwaa harɛ bonɔ sɔfore.
Fɔofale la waa cheɡɛ nɛwɛnyini ne Korowii baah ta dɛ fɔwɛ la ɡe ɡwaa ombene la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a cheɡɛ Korowii nyobaɡa aa do wer la ta.
Dɛ fɔobene la fe wer, waane toole o ta naa, onfale fe ta hiaih kpa.
Kɛ Korowii nao kɛŋɔ o nɛra chɔɡ fɔobene la, a waa o ŋɔ, “Saŋ bɛl ɛɛ bao, ásɛ n ne Israel ne Juu tena fɔwɛ fɔofale bɛl.
O ne fɔo la n ne ba naawa aa fɔwa a ɡɛ saŋ maa laɡ ba le Ijipt harɛ ta la aa beŋkpoŋ ɛɛ ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba naawa fa ta fɔo la ta teŋɛ.
Anomanta, n ɡe laa sie kpɔ ba nɛ.
Fɔo n ne Israel tena aa dɛ ba fɔwa kerekeree la.
Mɛɛ kpɔ me Mmaraa do ba nyu bini, dɛ́ chwerɔ do ba bambile bini, ásɛ dɛ ɛ Korowii baa dɛɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ ba ɡe ɛ n nɛra.
Aa berɛ hiah kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa baɡle o dɔŋ kɛɛ o nime ŋɔ, ‘A wer kɛŋɔ he jemɛ Korowii’ kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba bechale ne nomonome bwa ɛɛ jem mɛɛ.
Mɛɛ sune ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ba waa aa wola toɡrɛ kɛ ba, maa ba wechɔɡa waa lii kpa.” Korowii aa dɛ bol fɔofale waa nɔ, onloɡle la berɛ ombene.
Waa berɛ ombene nɔ, o kpeɡri tonɔ, wɛɛ ba nyoɡra.
Korowii Tɛnte Dea toma harɛ nɔ ta Taraken, loɡle fɔo Korowii ne o nɛra fa aa fɔwa la ɡba fa dɔ mmara baa cheɡɛ o ta dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii, dɛ dɔ bela baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii harɛ nɔ ta, asɛ o do Korowii Tɛnte Dea la bini.
Pateesan teŋe dea la doonyoa, asɛ bɛl ɡe bɔne dea la bini anɛ.
Dea la boloɡle la sɔne Boɡoroŋ.
A ɡɛ Boɡoroŋ la bɔr belaa kandea da ne teebur, dɛ paanoo baa kpɔa dɛɛ cheɡ Korowii sie la do.
Asɛ bela baa dɛ yerɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ɡe do pateesan nɛɛte la habɔɔ.
Korowii Boɡoroŋ Tenten la bɔr bela la, dɛ suuɡaswɛm kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma o bini la lɔ bela.
Dɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛ o bwara bwa, asɛ o che tɛ ba ne Korowii fɔo la lɔ bela.
Dɛ suuɡaswɛm vii la baa kpɔ kondikwaa aa le nyundua baa yera maana do o bini la, ne Arɔn daŋɡbala waa moɡɛ papooni la, ne bwepɛle anɛ la ba fa aa chwerɛ o ne ba fɔobene la mmara fi la do a ta la lɔ Daka la bini.
Ba kwaa kena kwaa anɛ ane baa dɛ yera Kerobim la chɔŋɛ Daka la ta a paɡri kena tɔ o ta a sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa.
Belaa ba laa Korowii bandia dɛɛ kpɔ o nɛra nɛɛ la, aa baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii jirima lɔ bela.
Yaa won dɔ bɔr taraken dɛ baɡle kwaa nɔ waa bwa ka tonɛ.
Yoo, kenii dea la bini kwaa cheche, asɛ sɔfore la ɛɛ jo o boloɡle la bini tɔperee bwa dɛ kaa ɛ ba toma.
Dea la bonɛɛte la te la, Sɔfonomoa ɡboo dɛɛ jo o bini.
O ɡba kwaraa la, kerabeŋkpoŋ ɡboo wɛɛ jo bela bena bɛlbwa.
O ta chal kpoŋaa, waa bela jo.
A nee o kaa soŋe o wechɔɡa ne nɛra la wechɔɡa baa ɛa baa wola jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa la.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe dɛ baɡle yaa waa dɛ le ɡɛ waa nɔ ta kɛŋɔ, dɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea la ta lole naa, Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ŋwɛnɛ ta pile mɔɔ.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ cheɡɔ dɛ tɛ fini nɔ.
A baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ saraha ɛɛ ne konaatena fuih dɛɛ tɛ Korowii aa won ɡel nɛn baa fuh kwaa la dɛɛ tɛo la tea to.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛ kondiile ne konnyɔɔla ne bwara sarama waa aa ɛ nawee wa.
Bwadabii waa a bwa, aa wone ɡel nɛn tea ɛɛ to.
Korowiirii kpɔa tɛ o nɛra ásɛ baa teŋɛ a ta dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ o ŋwɛnɛfale la aa bala.
Yeesu chal la wa Taraken te, Yeesu Kristo balɔ dɛ ba ɛ Sɔfonomoa, dɛɛ ɛ wefala aa bala dɛ do wer ya jemɛ a waa taraken nɔ la toma.
Korowii Tɛnte Dea waa dɛ ɛ toma o bini la dɔ jirima, dɛ do wer kɛrɛdɛ ɡwaa onɔ la.
Nɛwɛnyini laa doo, harɛ bonɔ kon laa.
Yeesu Kristo jo Korowii Boɡoroŋ Tenten la.
Waa jo bela la, boohna ne nabie chal laa o kpɔ jo bela.
O ɡbaɡba chalee o kpɔ jo bela, dɛ lɛ yaa ta aa wola jaɡaa dɔ bwa.
Kerabeŋkpoŋii o jo bela.
A ta hiaih kɛŋɔ o jo bela kpa.
Nɛn waa kah doŋa la, dɛ baa won kpɔ boohna ne nabala chal dɛ naloni tɔɔ kpɔe dɛ́ merɛ o nɛɛ ásɛ dɛ laa doŋa kpɔ o nɛ Korowii peraa, ɛrɛɛ a ɛ Yeesu Kristo chal aa wola won laa ya doŋa kpɔ ya nɛɛ kohona nɔ?
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la, on cha Yeesu Kristo o won kpɔ o te kɛŋɔ konaate waa wola kirihiah bɛlbwa dii dɛ ɛ saraha dɛ tɛ Korowii.
Yeesu chal ɛɛ laa ya wechɔɡa aa dɛ kaa ya ne seo ta la bwaa kpɔ ya nɛɛ ásɛ ya tea to, ásɛ a waa bɛ yaa hiah kpa, ásɛ ya won tomɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la.
Yeesu cheɡɔ tɛ nɛwɛnyini ne Korowii baah ta taraken dɛ fɔwɛ fɔo dɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyini ne Korowii, ásɛ nɛra Korowii aa lee ba ŋɔ ba ɛ o nɛra la won dɔ kwaa waa baɡ ba nyoa la saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Baa wonoo dɔa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, dɛkalkɛ wechɔɡa ba fa aa dɛ ɛ fɔobene la ta la, Yeesu Kristo aa baa sewɛ la, o bɔ a kem.
O sewɔ ásɛ ba wechɔɡa la bɛ won dɔ kpeɡri ba nɛɛ kpa.
Dɛ nɛn chwerɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ ba di o kapɛrɛ, dɛ o ta sewaa, nɛn aa won di.
Kɛ dɛ o sewɔ te naa, baa wonoo bɔne o kwaa name.
Dɛ naate waa chwerɛ tɔn la ta lole te naa, ŋwɛnɛ toole kɛŋɔ nɛn bɔne o laala.
A waa ɡela fɔobene la kwaraa ta la, chal ɛɛ fuɡe mɔɔ baa ɛ o we-ɛɛla la.
Mosis tɔ sie baɡle waa bwa Korowii aa ŋɔa ó nɛra la ɛ dɛ le Korowii Mmara Tɔn bini, mɔɔ dɛ kpɔ nabie ne boohna chale koo nee ta, dɛ kpɔ pee pona aa swɛɛra ne hesɔp ɛ chal ne nee la merɛ Korowii Mmara Tɔn la ne nɛra la bwa nɛ.
Waa kpɔa dɛɛ merɛ ba nɛɛ la, o ŋɔ, “Chal nɔɔ ɡela fɔo he ne Korowii aa fɔwa dɛ ŋɔ hɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ta la ta, á ɛ danseɛ kɛŋɔ he sɛoh.” Gɛ tentenee o yon ɛ chal la dɛ merɛ Korowii Tɛnte Dea la ne numoli ne koŋkwaare baa dɛ ɛ a ne toma bela la bwa ta.
Mmara la ta la, chal nee baa fee doŋa waa ne kwaa kɛrɛdɛ ta.
Dɛ chal ta fuɡaa, Korowii aa wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛɛ kɛ.
A ɡɛ kwaa la bwa, dɛ Korowii doa kwaa la chaaree a bwa.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ chɛ kɛ ba fee doŋa a ta.
Kɛ Korowii doa kwaa la te ɡbaɡba la, kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ fee a doŋa la ɡwaa anɔ.
Bela Yeesu Kristo aa joa la, Korowii Boɡoroŋ Tenten nɛwɛnyini aa mao o ɛ Korowii doa kon chaa la ɡbo bini laa o jo.
Korowii doa ɡbaɡbaa o la, dɛ ka che Korowii sie ásɛ dɛ won cha yaa taraken.
A ta hiaih kɛ o teŋɛ dɛɛ jo Boɡoroŋ Tenten la dɛ́ kpɔ o te ɛ saraha bena bɛlbwa ɡɛ Juu tena Sɔfonomoa aa dɛ jo ba kon ta chal aa wola o ɡbaɡba bwara chal ɛɛ ne la.
Dɛ bena bɛlbwaa wɛɛ jo bela dɛ kpɔ o te ɛ saraha aa, bena bɛlbwaa o fe ɛɛ ba wahala nae dɛ kpoŋe le harɛ mumpar ba le fini.
Kɛ kerabeŋkpoŋ ɡboo o ba harɛ nɔ ta tɔpere tama waa kaa nɔ ta, dɛ ba kpɔ o te ɛ saraha dɛɛ laa nɛra wechɔɡa kpɔ, waa wola ɡɛɛ ɛ kpa.
Kerabeŋkpoŋii nɛwɛnyini bɛlbwa ɛɛ ba sewa, ásɛ a habɔɔ la, Korowii bol o waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Gɛɛ ba kpɔ Yeesu Kristo ɡe ɛ saraha kerabeŋkpoŋ, ásɛ o che nɛndamanta wechɔɡa.
Wɛɛ berɔɔ ba nɛɛtena ja.
Wechɔɡa waa laa wɛɛ ba bala name te.
Nɛra baa dɛ kpao siswɛm ne laanee wɛɛ ba ba lɛ.
Yeesu kpɔ o te ɛ saraha kerabeŋkpoŋ tɛ yaa Tɔe Mosis Mmara la tɔ wedɛɛɡa a fa aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba bala la sie dɛ che tɛa.
A fa ta wedɛɛɡa la tenten ɛɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn lileo aa wola o ɡbaɡba ɛɛ la.
Anomanta, saraha Mmara la aa ɡela baa ɛ bena bɛlbwa la aa won ɡel nɛra baa dɛ ba a ne la ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ka tonɛ.
Dɛ saraha la fe wono ɡel ba le ba wechɔɡa ta kwaraa naa, ba fe ta a ɛɛ ɡelaa?
Dɛ a fe wono dɛɛ fee ba wechɔɡa ba nɛ aa, ba liire fe aa ban ha a waa we ba nɛɛ kpa.
Saraha laanee dɛɛ lii ba bena bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa ban, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nae ne boohna chale aa won fee wechɔɡa nɛra nɛɛ bwa.
A waa Yeesu aa dɛ ba harɛ ta bala la, o ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Konaatena ne koŋkwaa baa kpɔa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛɛ la, he sie aa a ta lɛ.
Kɛ he ɛ bwadabii bɛl tɛ mɛ.
He siwi aa konaatena baa dɛ fuah ambire dɛɛ tɛɛ ne saraha baa ɛa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ soŋe nɛra wechɔɡa la su.
Belaa n ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, menee la.
N balɔ dɛ́ ba ɛ he tetoowaa ɡɛ baa chwerɛ n waa Mmara tɔn la bini la.’ ” Anɔ la aa tɔ sie la, o baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ konaatena ne koŋkwaare baa kpɔa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta o sie lɛɛ.
O siwi ta konaatena baa fuah dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo, ne saraha baa ɛa dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ soŋe wechɔɡa la sui, kɛ dɛ Mosis Mmara ɡe fe baɡle a bwa.
Belaa o ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, menee la, n balɔ dɛ́ ba ɛ he tetoowa.” A baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii teŋe sarahabena la bwa ta, dɛ kpɔ Yeesu Kristo saraha la chiɡ a naa ta.
Yeesu Kristo aa ɛ Korowii tetoowaa dɛ kpɔ o bwadabii ɛ saraha kerabeŋkpoŋ a den tonɛ la nomanta, o laa ya bwa wechɔɡa kpɔ ya nɛ, dɛ ɡel ya ɛ Korowii nɛra.
Juu tena sɔfore te la, tɔpere bwaa ba che ba sɔfore toma ta dɛ teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ saraha siwibeŋkpoŋ.
Kɛ a ɡɛ saraha nɔ aa won laa nɛn wechɔɡa kpɔ o nɛɛ bwa.
Kerabeŋkpoŋ ɡboo Yeesu Kristo te ɛ nɛwɛnyini wechɔɡa saraha, a den maɡre, aa wola hiaih kɛŋɔ o ɛ bɛl kpa, dɛ ka so nomombɔr Korowii diɡ ta.
Belaa o do dɛɛ kpa ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii aa ba o dɔma ne harɛ ásɛ o tiɡri ba nɛ.
Saraha beŋkpoŋ waa ɛa dɛ fee wechɔɡa nɛra nɛɛ la ɡboo ɡela ba do kaih saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡba di danseɛ baɡle yaa.
O tɔ sie ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, ‘Fɔo n ne baa fɔwɛ tɔpera aa lɔ sie la ta laanee nɔ.
Mɛɛ kpɔ me Mmaraa do ba bambile bini, dɛ́ chwerɔ do ba nyuune bini.’ ” O berɔ ŋɔ, “Maa ba wechɔɡa waa lii kpa bwa.” Anomanta, dɛ Korowii dɔɔ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa kɛ yaa aa, a ta berɛ hiah kɛŋɔ ba ɛ saraha, dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe ya wechɔɡa kpa.
Yabala, Yeesu seo la nomanta yaa wonoo jo Boɡoroŋ Tenten la, yaa wola ɔmɛ.
Yeesu pili ŋwɛnɛfale mkpa aa lɔ o ta tɛ yaa, asɛ ya won jo Korowii Boɡoroŋ la ta.
O bwadabii ɛo kɛŋɔ pateesanjen o fa aa tɔ Korowii Boɡoroŋ Tenten la ŋwɛnɛ la.
Waa sewa la, ŋwɛnɛ pilo tɛ yaa.
Ya dɔ Sɔfonomonjen wɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii bii.
Anomanta, Korowii aa sɔ ya wechɔɡa ta waa wola ɡelɛ ya liire ɛɛ ɛ yaa kɛŋɔ ya ɛ wechɔɡa kpa, dɛ kpɔ o nedɛɛɡa sɔ ya bwadabii nɔ, hé ɡel ya kpɔ tepoŋ ne yarada ba o be, ya bɛ tɔŋle tama bɛlbwa, dɛ́ lawɛ hwɛɡa yaa dɔa la bini kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ bol baɡle nɛra yaa wola ɔmɛ tama bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ naate waa baɡɛ yaa nyoa la waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
Hé ɡel ya lii ɡɛ yaa ɛ, dɛ́ won dɛɛ do dɔŋa ɡbemba, ne dɔŋa nyina ne wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta, ásɛ dɛ bɛ chema yaa dɛ cheme saŋ bɛlbwa la ɡel, kɛŋɔ bane aa ɡela la.
Waa bwa jaɡa tɔpere la dɛ tel, anomanta, hɛ́ɛ do dɔŋa ɡbemba.
Korowii aa pili ya sie ya jemɛ o kasinteŋ nɔ, dɛ ya ta saahnɔ do wechɔɡa ta dɛɛ ɛ aa, saraha bɛlbwa toole bobɛlbwa dɛ fee ya wechɔɡa ya nɛɛ kpa.
Ɔmee taa yaa ba soɡa dɛɛ kpa Korowii Tɔpere waa dɛ ba nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ do banɔ la baa cheɡɛ o nɛɛ wechɔɡa nii aa dɛ lawɛ kohona la ta.
Nɛn koni Mosis Mmara, asɛ nɛra banɛ ne batoro di danseɛ tiao o waa waa ɛa la ta naa, baa o nɛɛ sune, kpoe baa kpoo.
Aah dɛ ɛrɛɛ a chɛ kɛ ba ɛ nɛn waa nyiŋi Korowii Bie la dɛɛ vaɔh?
Dɛ nɛn nyiŋi fɔo la Korowii aa cheɡɛ o Bie seo ta dɛ fɔwɛ la, dɛ fee o wechɔɡa o nɛɛ la pɛɛ aa, kembɔr besoo chɛ kɛ bá tɛo wɔ?
A ɡɛ nɛn la ɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa sune o nɛɛ la nɛnhɛla.
Korowii ŋɔ ó bɔɔ kem aa, o wenaale aa kanee do aa?
Naate waa ŋɔa ŋɔ, “Menee dɔ wechɔɡa kem bɔe, menee dɛ́ bɔ nɛra ba wechɔɡa kem” la, ya jemɛ o nɛnsoo.
Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii ɛɛ bol o nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole.” Wobɛlbwa toole dɛ do ɔma, kɛŋɔ haa ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ dɛ jo Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa la nɔn ta.
Hé lii ɡɛ he fa aa doa ɡɛ saŋ Korowii waa la aa chaah he sie la.
He na wahala ɡa, kɛ he ta habɔɔ leɛ.
Ba chɛɡre heyaa dɛ ɛ heyaa hɔhɔrɔwa nɛra baah ane ta.
Dɛ he dɛ cha nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa ane ta.
He na nɛra baa do ba dea la sum, dɛ cha ba ba wahala nae ta.
Ba lɛ he kwaa haa dɔa bwa, kɛ he sie ta kie.
He sie lɛo, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he jemɔ kɛ he dɔ komɛl waa wola jaɡa dɔe dɛ ɡwaa anɔ la haa paŋa la.
Anomanta, he bɛ ɡel he bambile chɔɡ he yaradae haa dɛ yarada Korowii Bie la.
A dɔ kembɔr kohona.
A hiaoh kɛŋɔ he lawɛ bambile dɛ́ won ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin, ásɛ dɛ won dɔ kwaa waa baɡɛ heyaa nyoa la.
Anee Korowii Tɔn baɡle la.
“A ka tamaa ken ásɛ naate waa dɛ ba bala la ba.
Waa biɡra ba.
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ su n siwi la te la, wɛɛ yarada mɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.
Kɛ dɛ o le habɔɔ te naa, n sie aa o nɛɛ lɛɛ ba.” Ya ta nɛra baa dɛ le habɔɔ dɛɛ nyoɡre la ɛɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ yarada dɛɛ dɔ mkpa laanee yan.
Yarada wa Bɔkwaa yarada ɔ?
Yaradaa kɛŋɔ yaa jema kaih kɛŋɔ yaa wonoo dɔ kwaa yaa dɛ tamane a wa, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ kwaa yaa wola an na siwi ne la bwa lole kpela.
Yarada taa a che Korowii pena a saŋ la tena.
Yarada taa a che ya no a mun kɛŋɔ nyoa wobol nee Korowii ta nyundua ne harɛ.
Anomanta, nyundua ne harɛ yaa dɛ na nɔ, kwaa baa wola an na nee ba taa.
Yaradaa Ebel dɔ, asɛ o kwaa waa kpɔa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii won su siwi, dɛ ɡwaa o dɔɔ Keen kwa, asɛ Korowii lɛa dɛ penao kɛŋɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi.
O fe sewɔ, kɛ o yaradae waa yarada Korowii nomanta, waa waa ɛa la chɔɔ ba le fini ba ta ɛɛ bola.
Yaradaa Enɔk yarada Korowii, asɛ Korowii kpɔɔ kaa o be nyundua, dɛ o ta sewɛ.
Ba nyin o bɔr kahonɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ Korowii kpɔɔ kaa nyundua.
Ba chwerɛ o waa kɛŋɔ Korowii aa wola on kpɔe kaa o be mɔɔ la, dɛ Korowii sie lɛ o nɛ.
Nɛn ta yarada dɔe yaa, o waa aa won lɛ Korowii sie.
Nomɛlbwa waa ba Korowii be la, a chɛ kɛ o dɔ yarada kɛŋɔ Korowii lole, dɛ́ yarada kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o jemɛ Korowii la, Korowii dɛ chao.
Yarada taa a che Korowii aa kah Nowa waa a ta aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba bala la, o no, dɛ o ta an nae mɔɔ.
O noɔ dɛ kwaa daka o ne o haah ne bii jo o bini, ba ta serewɛ.
Nowa te aa yaradaa, asɛ nɛwɛnyina baa kaa la aa wola yaradae la, a ɡelɔ nɛwɛnyina bwa di bolchɔɡe, asɛ dɛ ɡel o ɛ nɛra aa cheɡɛ ba yarada ta, asɛ ba waa su Korowii siwi la bɛl.
Yarada taa a che Korowii aa le Abraham ŋɔ ó kaa harɛ waa baɡɔ nyoa la ta la, o le dɛ kaa.
Waa dɛ kaa la, dɛ waa bela waa dɛ kaa jemɛ.
Yarada nee o ka so harɛfale Korowii aa baɡɔ nyoa la ta kɛŋɔ hɔɔh ken.
Tɛnte deene binii o so kɛŋɔ o bie Aesek ne o ɡe bie Jekɔb Korowii aa baɡɛ ba ɡe a ɡɛ nyoa nɔ tenten la.
Dɛ Abraham dɔ bwɛjen bɛl hwɛɡa.
A ɡɛ bwɛɛ la, Korowii ɡbaɡbaa vɔrɔwo, o che kiŋkiŋ.
Waa paɡre bwa.
Abraham yaradae waa dɛ yarada Korowii la taa a che o won lolɛ dɛ o hwɛɛhrɔ, asɛ o haah Saara ɡe ɛ hambara.
Dɛ o jemɔ kɛŋɔ nyoa Korowii aa baɡɔ la, wɛɛ ɛo.
Abraham aa hwɛɛhra waa wola kpeɡe kpa la, o wono lolɛ, asɛ o naanar ɡe ya, dɛ warɛ kɛŋɔ weweela kɛɛ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken.
Korowii yaradae taa a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa do dɛ ba serewe, dɛ ba ta waa Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa la nae siwi ne.
Kɛ ba yarada nomanta, ba naa bojaŋ ba sie lɛ kɛŋɔ haa na hɔɔhra bojaŋ baa ba he sie lɛ la.
Ba sɛoh kɛŋɔ ba ɛ hɔɔhra harɛ nɔ ta.
Nɛra dɛ bol ken aa, dɛ ba dɛ nyin ba chaɡle kɛŋɔ ba dɛ nyin ba ɡbaɡba harɛ dɛ so.
Dɛ harɛ baa le o ta ba la waa ba fee lii raa, ba fe ɛɛ wonoo berɛ kaa o ta.
Kɛ ɡɛ laa a do.
Harɛdɛɛɡe waa wera ɡwaa bela baa lea la waa baa lii.
Harɛ waa lɔ nyundua waa baa lii.
Anomanta, a ta Korowii sihiih ɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa dɛ yerɔ ba Korowii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o kwaa bwɛɛ bɛl cheɡ ba.
Yaradaa Abraham yarada Korowii waa o won lawɛ o bie Aesek ŋɔ o dɛ kpɔɔ ɛ saraha dɛ́ tɛ Korowii a ɡɛ saŋ Korowii aa daahno na la.
Kɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa ó kpɔ o bibeŋkpoŋ Aesek la ɛ saraha tɛo la, o ta vɛɛh.
Korowii baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ, “Aesek nɛɛ aa ba cheɡa ásɛ n tɛɛ he naanar la maa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ mɛɛ tɛɛ la.” Dɛ Abraham jemɔ kɛŋɔ hale dɛ Aesek sewɔ kwaraa naa, Korowii dɔ kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ó won iru seo ta.
Yaa wonoo ŋɔ sewaa Aesek sewɛ dɛ berɛ ba Abraham nɔn ta ja.
Yaradaa Aesek yarada Korowii waa o won swee Jekɔb ne Esɔ andɛɛɡa ba kerekere soɡa bini.
Jekɔb aa dɛ ba sewa la, o swee andɛɛɡa tɛ Josef bii banɛ la bwa.
Dɛ o kpoŋe daŋɡbala dɛ pi o ta dɛɛ duu Korowii.
Jekɔb aa dɛ yarada Korowii waa o won ɛ anɔ bwa.
Josef aa dɛ ba sewa la, o ŋɔ Israel tena be ŋɔ baa le Ijipt harɛ taa, dɛ baɡle ɡɛ baa kaa o hoɡa ne ka huɡe bwa.
Waa dɛ yarada Korowii la waa o won ɛ ɡɛ.
Mosis nya ne o mɛɛ aa lolɔ la, ba kpɔɔ sɔh korobie atoro, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba nao kɛŋɔ o wer bonɔɔ o bwara do kpeɡri.
Ba ta Ijipt kooro mmara waa doa la ɔmɛ.
Baa dɛ yarada Korowii waa ba won ɛ ɡɛ.
Mosis aa kpeɡa la, o ta sɛɛh ba yerɔ Ijipt kooro bihaah bie.
Waa dɛ yarada Korowii waa o won ɛ ɡɛ.
O ta sɛɛh ɛ Ijipt tena bodia waa baa lɔ a ta la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɛ wechɔɡa, harɛ bonɔ ɡbo ɡee aa jaɡɛ.
O sie lɛ Korowii nɛra la pui dɛ́ na wahala dɛ́ ɡwaa Ijipt tena bodia la.
O nyiŋi sihiih waa koh Kristo waa dɛ di la kɛŋɔ a wer o be dɛ ɡwaa kondɔɔhkwaa a fa aa lɔ Ijipt harɛ la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o dɛ nyiŋi tɔpere la Korowii aa ba bɔ nɛra bwa kem la ŋwɛnɛ.
Waa dɛ yarada Korowii la waa waa wola Ijipt kooro bandia ɔmɛ dɛ le bela, a do kɛŋɔ waa dɛ na Korowii baa wola on na la ken, o ta habɔɔ berɛ.
Mosis aa dɛ yarada Korowii waa o pa Galekaa Tɔpejen la dii mun, dɛ ɡel Israel tena ɛ chal lɔ ba ɡbeni, ásɛ Korowii nyundua torome waa dɛ kpoo Ijipt tena bibanloɡla la na dɛ bɛ ba te bibanloɡla kpoo.
Korowiirii Israel tena yarada waa Mposwɛm la teŋe anɛ, ásɛ o nenabɔɔ sie hol kɛŋɔ harɛpɛɛ, ba won jo le.
Ijipt tena aa ŋɔa ba ɡe le la, mpo la kaa ba ne.
Korowiirii Israel tena yarada waa ba bɔ nsara bar Jeriko tɔpera anuanɛ, asɛ danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛɛ la bwa cheme la kuuɡi.
Korowiirii hanjwamane Rahab yarada waa o lɛ Israel tena baa baa nyiŋi ba bwɛɛ la sɔh kɛrɛdɛ, Israel tena aa wola on kpoe ja nɛra baa wola Korowii waa noɛ la nɛ.
Too, ń baɡle ane ja aa?
Maa bɔree dɔ baɡle Gedeɔn, ne Barak, ne Samsen, ne Jɛfta, ne Devid, ne Samoɛl, dɛ Korowii keamere la bwa wa.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa yarada Korowii kohona, dɛ che ba yarada ta yo koranar dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ ɛ waa aa toɡra Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta, asɛ Korowii ɛ waa waa baɡɛ nyoa la ane ba bere saŋ.
Ba wono tɔ nyujentena nyoo, a ta wone laɡ ba.
Ba wono che nijena baah ta dɛ sɔɔh a nyoa, a ta wone fuuh ba, dɛ won lɛ ba te nɛra baa kpoŋe tokobie dɛɛ nyin ba kpoora nɔn ta.
Ba wono dɔ bokpeɡa ɡɛ saŋ baa ɡwɛɡra, dɛ won yo laa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ won pɔ harɛre ane tena nɛɛ laa ta ba chwaaɡe.
Korowii yaradae nomanta, ba wono chum haahna bane nɛra baa serewa.
Nɛra bane ɛ ba bini bane ɡe hɔhɔrɔwa kɛŋɔ bá fe vɛh Korowii nɛɛ teŋa, kɛ ba ta ba nyu dɔe waa koɛh dɛ vɛh, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba won ba ir seo ta dɛ́ dɔ bodɛɛɡe do.
Ba ɛ bane ɡe bahmuɡliwaa dɛ lɔɔ ba chweremi ne, dɛ do kpɛɛ bane ɡe nɔɔra, dɛ do ba dea.
Ba foɡre bane bwea dɛ kpoo ba, dɛ kpɔ seradaa teŋni bane bini anɛnɛ, dɛ kpoo bane ɡe tokobie ne.
Dɛ booh tɔne ne pee tɔnee bane kpɔ berɛ laala dɛɛ do.
Dɛ ba nyao kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ nɛra che ba nɛ, asɛ bane ɡe ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa aa wola were.
Dɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire ta chɛɛ kɛ ba ne a ɡɛ Korowii nɛra baa ɛ nɛnjena nɔ pɛ so.
Ba ta soŋnibɔr dɔe, dɛ do pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ne bwea dor dɛɛ ɡaaɡe, dɛɛ so bwebɔɔne ne bɔpɛɛne bini.
Nɛra dɛ pena a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa yaradae baa yarada Korowii wa, kɛ ba bɛlbwa ta kon Korowii aa baɡɛ Israel tena nyoa la dɔe.
Korowii lii waa aa wera cheɡ ya fini nɔ tena, dɛ ŋɔ a ɡɛ nɛra la ɡbo aa won do kaih ka tonɛ, nemenɛ kɛŋɔ ya ne ba bwa aa pɛa dɛ do kaih.
Korowii waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ Ya te aa dɔ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa waa baa yarada Korowii dɛ ɛ aa baɡle yaa waa nɔ, a chɛ kɛ ya ɡe lawɛ bambile dɛ chwa ya chwae waa chɔ ya sie nɔ siswɛm ne.
A chɛ kɛ ya laa komɛlbwa waa ɡel ya lɔ naa ya chwae ta la kpɔ, dɛ ɡel wechɔɡa aa dɛ tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ bwa.
Yáa nyiŋi Yeesu waa ɛ ya Korowii yaradae bwa nyu te, dɛ ɛ a mumpar ne a jaɡa la.
On koh bosɔɔhna waa ba dɔ waa asɛ ba ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa daɡaɡre ta la.
O ta sihiih waa koɛh dɛ vɛh.
Taraken o soɡe nomombɔr Korowii diɡ ta.
Hé nyiŋi ɡɛ nɛnchɔɡa fa aa haoh dɛɛ chɛɡro, asɛ o lawɛ bambile la, ásɛ bɔhwaah bɛ heyaa lawɛ, he le habɔɔ.
He ne wechɔɡa aa dɛ yo nɔ, he ta yoi chal le he nɛɛ mɔɔ.
He soh ɡɛ Korowii aa kpɔ heyaa ɛ o bii dɛ ja heyaa la aa?
Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, “N bie, dɛ Korowii dɛ tɛr he deŋne aa, bɛ an wesale lii.
Dɛ o dɛ toɡre naa, bɛ ɡel a hwah he bwara, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛn Korowii aa dɛ nyin la, o deŋnee wɛɛ tɛr, dɛɛ toɡre nɛn waa lɛo kɛ o bie.” Hé lawɛ bambile wahala haa dɛ na ta, dɛ nyiŋa kɛŋɔ he Mɛɛɛ dɛɛ tɛr he deŋne.
He deŋnetɛra la chaɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii kpɔ heyaa ɛ o bii, dɛkalkɛŋɔ bie bɛlbwa toole o mɛɛ aa wola o deŋnee tɛr bwa.
Dɛ o ta he deŋne tɛrɛ kɛŋɔ waa dɛ tɛr o bii bwa deŋne la aa, amɔ dɛ o bii ɡbaɡba laa heya, dɛ kataborerii heya.
Ya mɛɛnanar baa lolɛ yaa la kwara, ba tɛr ya deŋne aa, ya dɛ no ba be.
Aah dɛ ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua dɛ dɔ ya lileore la te sɛ, a ta chɛ kɛ ya no o be dɛ́ dɔ mkpa aa?
Ya mɛɛnanar baa lolɛ yaa la, tɔpera anɛ bɛlee ba tɛr ya deŋne ɡɛ ba ɡe aa naa kɛ aŋwɛnɛ taa la.
Kɛ Korowii te aa dɛ tɛr ya deŋne la, ya ɡbaɡba kɛrɛdɛ waa wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ ya do ɡoroŋ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ waa doa la.
Ba dɛ tɛr nɛn deŋne aa, buɡ la ta la, o tea bini dɛ chɔɡ, o sie aa lɛ.
