Kɛ dɛ o hweli waa name o deŋnetɛra la ta naa, o waa dɛ toɡre, asɛ o bwara ɛɛ sɔɔhno.
Anomanta, hé do banɔ la ba bwara aa yɔra ɡbemba, ba won che kiŋkiŋ.
Hé ɡel he we-ɛɛla toɡre ásɛ he bala baa ɡwɛɡra Korowii nɛɛ teŋa ta dɛ do kɛ nɛn waa dɛ duɡri la bɛ he ŋwɛnɛre aa wola toɡrɛ la ta kpɔ dɛ ba lɔ na.
A chɛ kɛ he toɡre he ŋwɛnɛre ásɛ ba kpɔ a ta dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa.
Korowii habɔɔ lee jae wa Hé swɛɛ siwi kɛŋɔ he ne nɛra bwa baah ɛɛ do werii, dɛ́ swɛɛ siwi kɛŋɔ hɛɛ do ɡoroŋee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ nomɛlbwa ta ɡoroŋ doe yaa, waa Korowii nae ba.
Korowii dɔ chae waa dɛ nyin o cha yaa kohona.
Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ a bɛ bɛlbwa ba paŋɛ.
A waa laa aa, wechɔɡa ane ɛɛ ba jo he binii dɛ́ chɔɡ nɛndamanta kɛŋɔ koŋkpela yon jo kondikwaa ta dɛ chɔɡa la.
He bini bɛlbwa bɛ jwamane ba bɔ, dɛ bɛ vɛh kɛ hɛɛ kpɔ duure tɛ Korowii, kɛŋɔ Esɔ aa koh kerabeŋkpoŋ kondikwaa dii waa charɛ o nomonome tɛ o nime la.
He nao kɛŋɔ waa bera baa nyin kɛŋɔ o mɛɛ swee tɛo ɡɛ baa sweera dɛɛ tɛ binomoa la, o ta ɡɛ dɔe kpa.
O siwi swɛɛrɔ wɛɛ nyin o dɔ ɡɛ a fe aa chɛa kɛ o dɔ, hale dɛ wi.
Kɛ waa o ɡbaɡba aa ɛa la, o ta wone bera a do ɡɛ a fa aa doa kpa.
Haa ba Korowii be nɔ, kon haa leɡe be laa he ba, kɛŋɔ Israel tena fa aa ba Sinai Bwejen ta la.
A ɡɛ bwejen nɔ fa dɛ lawɛ nii jiɡijiɡi ken.
Ba fa aa ba o mun la, bɔr bwa biro kpirikpiri ken, asɛ peu ɛɛ ta vuɡuvuɡu ken.
Dɛ bɛla bɛl dɛ si, asɛ nomɛl taa ɛɛ le.
Nɛra la aa no taa la, ba soŋɔ ŋɔ anɔ la baa noa la maɡre ɡɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ waa naate aa dɛ bol la kpeɡri tɛɛ ba.
O bolɔ ŋɔ, “Dɛ kondɛɛre kwaraa leɡe bwejen la aa, a chɛ kɛ bá foɡro bwea kpo.” Waa aa chiɡ bela la, dɛ a ɔma kohona to, asɛ Mosis ŋɔ, “Ɔmee laɡ mɛ, n bwara dɛ sa!” He te aa ba Korowii be nɔ, Saayɔn Bwejen ne Jerusalam waa lɔ nyundua dɛ ɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa bwɛjen la, o taa he ba.
Bela nyundua toroma kaɡboŋlafa aa chema silɛɛ ne laanee he ba.
O binomonome o kapɛrɛ aa ku ba nɔn asɛ ba sɔna do tɔn la aa lɔ o be la ta la ɡba cheme bela.
Ba ne Korowii waa dɛ ba nɛra bwa waa bola dɛ́ pa bole la, ne lala ba wa aa toɡra dɛ su o siwi, asɛ o ɡel ba ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ka tonɛ la bwa bee he ba.
Yeesu bee he ba.
On cheɡɛ nɛwɛnyini ne Korowii baah ta dɛ fɔwɛ fɔofale la.
Bela waa kpɔ o chal merɛ laanee he ba.
O chal soŋe wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛ yaa.
A ta do kɛŋɔ Ebel chal aa ba taahna ne la.
Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ dɛ bɛ deŋne taŋ Korowii waa waa dɛ bol la ta.
A saŋ la tena fa aa vɛh nɛn ba ne waa lɔ harɛ bonɔ waa waa bola dɛ kpɔ ja ba la, dɛ ba ta wone lɛ ba te naa, ya nɛra yaa vɛh naate waa lɔ nyundua waa waa kpɔa dɛɛ ja yaa la, ɛrɛɛ yá ɛ dɛ won lɛ ya te nɔ?
Waa bol waa ɡɛ saŋ la, harɛ jiɡro.
Kɛ taraken te, o baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ ba jiɡri harɛɛ kerabeŋkpoŋ ja.
Harɛ ɡbo laa mɛɛ ba jiɡra.
Mɛɛ jiɡri nyundua ɡee ja.” A ɡɛ waa waa bola dɛ ŋɔ “kerabeŋkpoŋ ja” nɔ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o baa jiɡri nyundua ne harɛ naa, Korowii kontaala aa lɔ a ta dɛ́ won jiɡri la ɛɛ chɔɡoo, ásɛ kwaa la aa wola won jiɡri la do le dɛɛ la.
Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ yaa jam Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ waa ɡela ya do o Kora waa wola yiiɡi ta nɔ.
A chɛ kɛ yaa tomɔ ɡɛ aa too o tea, dɛɛ tɛo duure dɛɛ ɔmɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya Korowii nɔ do kɛ nii aa wona dɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa kohona.
Waa aa dɛ su Korowii siwi He nya biirii dɔŋa Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ ta, anomanta, hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa saŋ bɛlbwa.
He bɛ soh kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ lɛ hɔɔhra dɛɛ nyiŋ ba kɛrɛdɛ.
Bane ɛ ɡɛ dɛ nyiŋi nyundua toroma, dɛ baa jemɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ lii nɛra baa do ba dea waa kɛŋɔ he ne banee ba do dea ken.
Hɛ́ɛ lii nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa ɡe waa kɛŋɔ he ɡe aa dɛ na weweele la bɛl ken.
A chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ hahmor, dɛ bɛ nɛmpɛɛne lawɛ dɛɛ chɔ dɛ ka ja ba haahna kɛɛ ba jaranar nɛ.
Korowii ɛɛ tɛr nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wedoŋa baa ne haah chɔe be pera dɛɛ nyin ba dɔŋa haahna kɛɛ ba dɔŋa jaranar la deŋnee.
He bɛ ɡel suuɡa waa swɛɛ he siwi kohona.
Hé ɡel anɔ la haa dɔa la maɡre he ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii bolɔ ŋɔ, “Maa heyaa ta bwa, maa sie laa kpɔ he nɛɛ bwa.” Anomanta, yaa wonoo lɔ bambile ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii dɛ cha mɛ, anomanta, maa ɔmɛ.
Ɛrɛɛ nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba wona ɛɛ mɛ nɔ?” Hé nyiŋi he nomonome ba fa aa bol Korowii waa dɛɛ baɡle heyaa la.
Hé nyiŋi ɡɛ ba fa aa teŋɛ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ ta dɛ ba serewe, dɛɛ yarada Korowii ɡɛ ba fa aa dɛ yaradao la.
Yeesu Kristo aa beɡre.
Gɛ waa doa a saŋ la, ɡɛɛ o ta do fini, ɡɛɛ wɛɛ ba doe saŋ bɛlbwa.
He bɛ ɡel wefala chɔɡ he liire ásɛ he le Korowii ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la ta.
He dɛ nyin he do kpeɡri Korowii nɛɛ teŋa ta naa, hé kpɔ sie dawɛ chae Korowii aa sune nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba la ta.
He bɛ sie kpɔ dawɛ kondikwaare ane kii ne ane dii ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ta wone cha nɛra baa kpɔ sie dawɛ a ta la.
Juu tena sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Tɛnte Dea bini la ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ ba di ya saraha kwaa yaa dɛ di la ane.
Juu tena Sɔfonomoa dɛ ba chal ne saraha ɛɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten la aa, o dɛ jo a ne bela dɛ́ kpɔ soŋe o nɛra wechɔɡa.
Kondɛɛra la baa ɛ a chal la te la, ba dɛ le a ne dahara dɛ́ ka fuah.
Gɛ tentenee Yeesu ɡe na wahala dɛ sewɛ bwɛjen Jerusalam dahara, asɛ dɛ kpɔ o chal dɛ laa doŋa kpɔ nɛwɛnyina nɛɛ ásɛ ba ɛ Korowii nɛra.
Anomanta, hé ɡel ya la o be dahara bela, dɛ́ ka puu di o sihiih waa dia la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ, ya ta bwɛjen dɔe dɛ so o ta saŋ bɛlbwa harɛ bonɔ.
Bwɛɛ o ta aa lɔ sie dɛɛ ba la, o taa ya sie dawɛ.
Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ ya che Yeesu nɛɛ dɛ ɛ ya saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa.
Saraha yaa dɛ ba ɛɛ laanee kɛŋɔ yáa dɛɛ kpɛɛroo dɛɛ yerɛ o sɔn.
He bɛ dɔŋa wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ne dɔŋa chae waa soh, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛ saraha a waa aa dɛ lɛ Korowii sie.
Hɛ́ɛ no nɛra baa dɛ tɔ he sie la nyoa wa, dɛɛ ɛ waa baa ŋɔa hɛ́ɛ ɛ la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ban dɛɛ nyiŋi heya.
Ba dɔ nkontaa dɛ bu Korowii sie dɛ baɡle ɡɛ bwa baa nyiŋi heya.
Hɛ́ɛ no ba nyoa wa, ásɛ ba won ɛ toma silɛɛ ne.
Dɛ haa ba nyoa waa no aa, baa ɛa tebinichɔɡ nee, aa wola tɔnɔ bɛlbwa lee ba dɛ́ tɛ heya.
Hé soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ yaa.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya tea bini too, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya dɛ nyin kɛ yaa ɛ waa aa toɡra saŋ bɛlbwa.
N dɛ soŋe heyaa kohona, ásɛ he soŋe Korowii, ásɛ o ba n ne he be warane.
N dɛ soŋe Korowii waa ir ya Dɔɔ Yeesu seo ta la.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɛ Peteɡrejen dɛɛ nyiŋi o peera ta.
Seo o ɡbaɡba aa sɛah dɛ sewɛ la, a taa a che asɛ Korowii fɔwɛ fɔo waa wola pura dɔe bwa la.
Kórowii waa dɛ tɛ bambisɔɔhna la tɛ heyaa dadɛɛɡe aa chɛ kɛ he dɔ, dɛ́ won dɛɛ ɛ o tetoora bwa.
Ó che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ ɛ waa waa dɛ nyin bwa ya bini.
Yeesu Kristo chɛ jam saŋ te bɛlbwa!
Aamen.
Yabala, n dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ he lawɛ bambile, dɛ́ no waa nɔ maa chwera dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ja heyaa nɔ.
He nyiŋo na naa, tɔn nɔ maa chwerɛ heyaa nɔ aa jaŋɛ bɛlbwa.
N dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba le ya dɔŋ Timoti dea.
O balɔ warane asɛ mɛɛ ba he be naa, n ne wɛɛ bao.
Ya dɛ na he nomonome la bwa, ne Korowii nɛra la bwa.
Yabala Itali harɛ tena la ɡe dɛ na heya.
N Naa Kórowii sune he nɛ, dɛ́ cha he bwa sekwaraa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Jems chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ cha Kristo tena, ásɛ ba ɡel ba soɡa bini ɛɛ baɡle kɛ ba dɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛ.
Nɛra baa ɛ Kristo tena ta dɛ ɛ waa aa wola were.
Ya da ne ya we-ɛɛla aa wola were la, Jems tɔn nɔ dɛ cha yaa, dɛɛ toɡre yaa.
Ya ŋɔ ya dɛ yarada Yeesu aa, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ya we-ɛɛla baɡle ɡɛ ya ne yabala aa soɡa.
Jems berɔ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii soŋa waa aa hiah, ásɛ ya na ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ ɛ toma nɛra soɡa bini.
Men Jems maa ɛ Korowii ne ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ laanee chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ tena haa lɔ bobɛlbwa la.
N dɛ na heya.
Yarada ne wejema Yabala, dɛ wobɛlbwa pu heyaa dɛ ɛ wekpeɡa aa, hé ɡel he sie lɛ.
A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ wobɛlbwa pu heyaa he ta habɔɔ berɛ kpo Yeesu aa, anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he dɔ bambile, dɛ́ won che kiŋkiŋ wobɛlbwa ta.
Hé dɔ bambile wobɛlbwa ta dɛ́ ka tonɛ, ásɛ dɛ won che a ta dɛ́ jemɛ wa, dɛ́ dɔ dadɛɛɡe, ásɛ wobɛlbwa bɛ heyaa nya harɛ nɔ ta.
Dɛ wobɛlbwa pu heyaa hɛɛ nyin a wejema aa, hé soŋe Korowii ásɛ o tɛ heya.
O tea chɔ pɛɛ, waa nɛn kon tɛ o waa berɛ dɛɛ we o nɛ.
Wɛɛ tɛ heyaa.
Kɛ hé kpɔ yarada dɛ́ɛ soŋo, dɛ bɛ dɛɛ tɔŋle.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɔŋle kɛ o ken aa o konnyinii dɔ la, o ta yarada dɔe.
O liire won bera warawara kɛŋɔ peu yon ta dɛɛ beɡre mpo nee dɛɛ kaa bobɛlbwa la.
Nɛn o liire aa ɛ anɛ la dɛ chole, o wobɛlbwa aa maɡre.
Dɛ naate dɛ soŋe Korowii aa, o bɛ dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ no o bee.
Dɛ he nyao dɛ ɛ Yeesu habɔteŋre aa, ɡel he sie lɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɛ nɛnjen Korowii be.
Dɛ he ɛ dɔɔh ɡe aa, ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ he ne nyaa la bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡre Korowii be.
Haa biɡri sewɛ kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa yon fe dɛ́ chure warane dɛ́ berɛ sewɛ la.
Gɛ wee yon le dɛ́ lɔ, ásɛ kpɔɡa sewɛ dɛ́ chure a fedɛɛɡa la ta, ásɛ a wer tonɛ la, ɡɛ tentenee dɔɔh ɡee ba sewa o kwaa nyina ta, ásɛ o kondɔɔh la bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
He bini bɛlbwa waa takapɔ lawɛ bambile dɛ́ɛ na wahala la, o na som.
Dɛ wenaale la kpoŋee la sie dɛ ba horɛ, kɛ he ta teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ he bambile bwa ne naa, wɛɛ tɛɛ mkpa waa ŋɔa ŋɔ wɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyinu laanee, á ɛ kompoŋ haa yoa dɛ le ba vɔwɛ.
Dɛ waane pu nomɛl o ɛ wechɔɡa aa, o bɛ ŋɔ Korowiirii ɡela o ɛ wechɔɡa.
Wobɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ɡel Korowii ɛ wechɔɡa.
Waa waane ɡee kpɔ ta ya nɛɛ ya ɛ wechɔɡa.
Dɛ waane pu nomɛl o ɛ wechɔɡa aa, o ɡbabir pɛla waa dɔa laanee ɡela o ɛ wechɔɡa.
Pɛla waa wola were la dɛ́ lolɛ wechɔɡa, ásɛ wechɔɡa ɡe baa waraa, a yon lolɛ seo.
Yabala, he bɛ ɡel ba neɡre heya.
Komɛlbwa waa wera la le Korowii be.
Komɛlbwa waa ɛ kondɛɛɡe la, Korowiirii kpɔa kɛ yaa.
Onee ya Mɛɛ waa ta kwaa bwa aa lɔ nyundua dɛɛ chaah harɛ.
Gɛ kwaa nɔ dɛ chaah, ane ta ɡe aa chaah, kɛ Korowii te aa beɡre bwa.
O ɡbaɡba tetooraa ya dɔ o waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ la dɛɛ no, dɛ che a ta ɛ o bii, ásɛ dɛ su o siwi kwaa waa taa la bwa bini.
Korowii waa noe ne a ɛɛ Yabala, hɛ́ɛ lii waa nɔ aa teŋa nɔ.
Hé ɡel he sie beɡre waa noe ta, dɛ́ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛɛ bol wa, ásɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel he baah ɛɛ di warawara.
Nɛwɛnyini bandia aa wobɛlbwa kwaa Korowii ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe teŋa ta.
Anomanta, hé le wedoŋa ne wechɔɡa aa lɔ he bini dɛ ɡwaa he nɛɛ la ta, dɛ́ pwɛr he te, dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii waa la waa kpɔa do he bambili bini á won lɛ heyaa la.
He bɛ waa la no dɛ́ ɡel a ɛɛ.
Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, he dɛ neɡre he te.
Hé ɛ ɡɛ waa la aa baɡla la.
Nomɛlbwa waa no waa nɔ, waa wola ɡɛ waa la aa baɡla la ɛ la, o do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyiŋi diɡi ta dɛɛ na o ɡbaɡba la.
Waa nyiŋi o te diɡi la ta dɛ na ɡɛ waa doa la, tamaa ken, dɛ o berɔ soh ɡɛ waa doa.
Korowii Mmara wer kɛrɛdɛ, o ɡelɔ yaa dɔ ya te, waa yaa vɔrɔwe.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no dɛɛ pese o bini, waa wola soh dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa baɡla la, Korowii ɛɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ naate o we-ɛɛla bwa ta.
Dɛ nomɛl dɛ lii kɛ o ɛ Korowii torome, dɛ o ta nyotɔɡbom dɔe yaa, o dɛ neɡre o nyu.
Naate Korowii toma la ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
Waa Korowii waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ aa dɛ nyin a do wer dɛ́ maɡre o toma bini laanee kɛŋɔ, yá cha bilalbii ne luhaahna ba wahala bini, ásɛ dɛ laa ya te kpɔ harɛ nɔ wechɔɡa ta.
Nɛra bini chala jae wa Yabala, haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ jirima Dɔɔ nɔ, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ he duu nɛra bane dɛ́ ɡwaa bane.
Dɛ he ne he bala chemo dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii, nɛra banɛ ba jo he bini, bɛl do suuɡaswɛm kwaa dɛ tɔ yadɛɛɡe, bɛl ɡe tɔ yadoŋ, asɛ he tɛ onɔ la waa do suuɡaswɛm kwaa dɛ tɔ yadɛɛɡe la sobɔrdɛɛɡe, dɛ ŋɔ onɔ la waa tɔ yadoŋ la be ŋɔ, ó te che bela kɛɛ ó ba so harɛ he sie naa, amɔ dɛ he dɛ duu bane dɛ ɡwaa bane.
Nɛra siebɔree hɛɛ nyiŋi dɛɛ duu bane dɛɛ nyiŋi bane nyubaahna.
Haa kɛrɛdɛ ɛ. Yabala, hé no!
Korowii we-ɛɛlaa kɛŋɔ ó le harɛ nɔ ta nyaara baa yaradao kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ ba yarada la ɛɛ ba kondɔɔh, ásɛ ba dɔ bɔr dɛ́ ja o Kora waa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ ɡeloo nɛra baa dɛ nyinu ja o ta la.
Kɛ he te lawɛ nyaara sie teɡɛ harɛ.
Dɔɔhna laa dɛɛ fiiɡi heya, dɛ lawɛ heyaa kaa che kɔɔto la aa?
Gɛ nɛra nɔ laa dɛɛ bol wechɔɡa dɛɛ yaɡɛ Yeesu sɔndɛɛɡe nɔ baa kpɔa dawɛ heyaa la aa?
Kɛ banee hɛɛ duu la!
Dɛ he dɛ teŋɛ Korowii Kora Mmara baa chwera ŋɔ, “Nyin he dɔŋ kɛ he te ɡbaɡba la” ta naa, dɛ he dɛ ɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Kɛ dɛ he dɛ duu nɛra bane dɛ ɡwaa bane aa, dɛ he dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Mmara baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ he di bolchɔɡe.
Nomɛlbwa waa teŋɛ Mmara la bwa ta kɛ dɛ koni o bini beŋkpoŋ la, dɛ o koni o bwa, dɛ di bolchɔɡe.
Korowiirii baɡla ŋɔ, “Bɛ jwamane bɔ.” O tentenee bera baɡle kɛ “Bɛ nɛn kpo.” Dɛ he ta jwamane bɔe dɛ kpo nɛn aa, dɛ he ɛ nɛn haa koni Mmara la.
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ ba ya waa bola o Kora Mmara waa kpɔa lɛ yaa asɛ ya dɔ ya te la ne.
Anomanta, hé nyiŋi he nyoo wobol ne he we-ɛɛla ta kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii aa naate waa wola o dɔŋ sum na la sumii na awola waa dɛɛ bol ya waa la.
Naate waa dɛ na o dɔŋ sum la aa o waa bola ɔmɛ.
Yarada ne wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ Yabala, dɛ nomɛl ŋɔ o dɛ yarada Korowii, dɛ o ta o yarada kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa aa, tɔnɔ besoo o yarada la dɔɔ?
A ɡɛ yarada nɔ ɛɛ wonoo lɛo wa aa?
He nao kɛŋɔ he dɔŋ baa kɛɛ haah dɛ chɔ waa, dɛɛ nyin yal dɛ́ tɔ, dɛɛ nyin kondikwaa ɡe dɛ́ di, asɛ he ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛɛ bokpeɡa dɛ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna,” dɛ vɔmɔ kwaa aa tɛo bokpeɡa la te naa, dɛ tɔnɔ besoo lɔ waa haa bola tɛo la ta nɔ?
Gɛɛ a do yarada ta kɛŋɔ dɛ nɛn ta wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛɛ ja o yarada ta naa, dɛ o yarada la ɛ wepuu.
Bɛl lole nomɛl ɛɛ ŋɔɔ yaradae ɡboo wɛɛ yarada Korowii, ásɛ bɛl ɡe ŋɔ wedɛɛɡaa o ɡee ɛ. Kɛ ɡɛ ɡe aa won maɡre.
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ba wona baɡ mɛ he yarada dɛ he ta wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛɛ ja a ta nɔ?
N te, mɛɛ che n wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ taa, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛ n dɛ yarada Korowii.
He dɛ yarada kɛŋɔ Korowii beŋkpoŋii lole naa?
A wer ɡa!
Kɛ he ne Bɔnsam toromaa soɡe dabeŋkpoŋ ta.
Ba ɡba dɛ yarada Korowii ɔmee ne bochela ne.
Gɛne!
He dɛ nyin n baɡle kɛŋɔ yarada wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ aa wola a ta jae la ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ aa?
Ya naa Abraham fe aa dɛ ba o bie Aesek kpoe dɛ tɛ Korowii la, a ta laa a che Korowii ŋɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi la aa?
He ta nae kɛŋɔ o yarada ne o wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ bwa aa pɛ aa?
O wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ taa a che o yarada ɛ yarada kasinteŋ.
Belaa Korowii Tɔn waa la ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ baa ŋɔa ŋɔ, “Abraham yarada Korowii, asɛ o yarada nomanta, Korowii ŋɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi” la.
Dɛ ba dɛ yerɔ Korowii dam.
Kɛ he nao kenɛ, nɛn wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ne o yarada bwa taa a che wɛɛ ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o wa ɛɛ su Korowii siwi, o yarada ɡbo ta laa.
Gɛ tentenee a do hanjwamane baa dɛ yerɔ Rahab la ɡba nɛ.
Israel tena toroma bane aa bala dɛ́ fe ba sɔh hweli o bwɛɛ harɛ waane dɛ́ ka taa ba bwɛɛ tena be la, o lɛɛ ba sɔh dɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛfale ba chwa kaa.
Gɛ wedɛɛɡa nɔ taa a che Korowii ŋɔ o ɡe ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su o siwi.
Anomanta, ɡɛ nɛn ta hweera dɔe yaa dɛ o sewɔ la, ɡɛɛ yarada wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ aa wola a ta jae la ɛ yaradapuu.
Waa nyondoŋe aa won ɛɛ Yabala, he bwa laa chɛ kɛ he ɡel he sie beɡre Korowii waa baɡla ta, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ haa jema la, ya nɛra yaa dɛ baɡle Korowii waa la waa binii wɛɛ ba nyiŋa kɛrɛdɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa kaa la.
Ya bwa dɛ koni saŋ bɛlbwa.
Dɛ nɛn aa wobɛlbwa waa dɛ bol la ta koni aa, dɛ o ɛ nɛn o wa a toɡra tenten.
Nɛn waa won o wobol nyiŋa la, o won o te lawa wobɛlbwa ta.
Ya kpɔ bune dɛɛ do jaɡre nyoo asɛ aa no ya wa, asɛ ya won a bera dɛɛ kaa bela bwa yaa dɛ nyin.
Yá ta sie na ɡɛ stiimae aa kana, asɛ peukpeɡ yon ta dɛ kpɔɔ dɛɛ kaa, kɛ dajeɡa bɛlee lɔ o ta ba kpɔ dɛɛ menɛ o sie asɛ wɛɛ kaa bela bwa baa dɛ nyin.
Gɛɛ nyondoŋe do jeɡaa nɛn bini, kɛ dɛ won wejena ɛɛ.
Hé na ɡɛ kɔr aa doa asɛ nihɔl won o fuih.
Nyondoŋe do kɛŋɔ nihɔl ken, dɛ won wechɔɡa ɛɛ taeh ya bini, dɛ won yaa chɔɡa ya soɡa bini bwa.
Bɔnsam niinii dɛɛ choŋu.
Kpɔɡ bini ola ne olchɔɡa ne jumbii ne kwaa aa dɛ huuh, dɛ mpo bini pɛŋa bwa, nɛn won a dɛɛra á do pwɛre.
Kɛ nyondoŋe te, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ won o nyiŋa.
O ɛ konchɔɡe haa wola won toɡro.
O dɛ kpo kɛŋɔ tɛɡchɔɡa ken.
O nee yaa jam Korowii waa ɛ ya Naa ne ya Mɛɛ la, dɛ berɛ kpɔ o tenten dɛɛ taah ya dɔŋa Korowii aa ta ba kɛŋɔ o tenten la.
Nyoa beŋkpoŋ la taa wobodɛɛɡa ne taahna bwa ɛɛ le.
Yabala, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ aa ba ɡɛ!
Nenabɔɔ ɛɛ wonoo palɛ, o nee ane do som ásɛ ane ɡe do nyɛɡre aa?
Yabala, fig da ɛɛ wonoo nɔnɛ sombie aa, kɛɛ bambi ɛɛ wonoo nɔnɛ fiɡ nɔna aa?
Gɛ tentenee nenabɔɔ o nee aa do nyɛɡre la aa wola won berɛ do som buɡ ta tenten.
Wejema anɛ ane wa He bini umee ɛ wejereme dɛɛ no waa mun ɔ?
Gel o pwɛr o te dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, ásɛ o da baɡle kɛ o ɛ wejereme.
Dɛ he dɛ nyin kɛ he ɡbo dɔ, dɛ dɔ bɔweela ne sibeɡra he bambile bini naa, amɔ he bɛ sɔn dɛ́ɛ nyin dɛ́ɛ ŋɔ he dɔ wejema.
Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, dɛ he ta kasinteŋ dɔe.
Gɛ wejema nɔ ta Korowii doa wejema ɛɛ, a ɛ harɛ ta kwa.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe toole a ta.
Bɔnsam liiree.
Anomanta, bela bɔweela ne n ɡbo dɔ aa lole la, belaa wesaɡasaɡare ne wedoŋa bwa do.
Nɛn waa dɔ Korowii doa wejema la, kenii o da do, o waa do kaih, o waa dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna, o pwɛre, o dɛ no o dɔŋ wa, o dɛ na o dɔŋ sum, o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe, o we-ɛɛla bwa wer, waa nɛra bane duure dɛɛ ɡwaa bane, o tea too.
Nɛra baa dɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhna la, nyopɛo nee baa ɛ ba wa, aa le wedɛɛɡa.
Hé kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii Bɔkwaa dɛɛ ba naɡra ne he baah ta nɔ?
Kwaa haa dɛ pɛlɛ a nɛɛ laa dɛɛ ba a ne naa?
Anee dɛɛ yo heya.
Kwaa haa dɛ nyin haa wola dɔ la waa hɛɛ kpoo dɔŋa la.
He dɛ nyin kwaa sibeɡra ne, kɛ haa dɔ, a waa ɡela hɛɛ naɡre dɛɛ yo la.
Haa wola Korowii soŋe la waa haa wola he konnyina dɔ la.
He dɛ soŋo, kɛ haa dɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ liire haa cheɡɛ a ta dɛɛ soŋo la aa were.
He ɡboɡbo konnyina ne kwaa haa dɛ pɛlɛ a nɛɛ waa hɛɛ soŋo.
He nɛnchɔɡa nɔ haa wola Korowii ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ hanchɔɡe waa dɛ nyin baala nɔ!
Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ nyin harɛ nɔ ta kwaa la vɛh Korowii dɛ ɛ o dɔm kɛɛ?
Nomɛlbwa waa daŋre harɛ nɔ ta kwaa nyina ne la vɛh Korowii.
Kɛ he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ pɛɛpɛɛ Korowii Tɔn la ŋɔ lileo Korowii aa kpɔa do ya bini la dɛ mee la?
Kɛ chae Korowii aa na ya sum dɛɛ cha yaa la, on kpeɡa, ɡɛ Korowii Tɔn la aa baɡla ŋɔ, “Korowii dɛ ba nɛra baa dɛ ɛ sɔnnyin la ne harɛ, dɛɛ sune nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te nɛ.” Anomanta, hé kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii ásɛ dɛ no o be.
Hé yo Bɔnsam.
Wɛɛ chwao le he be.
Hé suuh tel Korowii, ásɛ o suuh ba he be.
Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra, hé charɛ he liire dɛ́ le he wechɔɡa ta.
He banɔ la he liire aa ɛ anɛnɛ la, hé laa doŋa kpɔ he nɛ.
Hé ɡel he tea bini chɔɡ, hé wi.
Hé ɡel he mama berɛ wii ásɛ he silɛɛ ɡe berɛ sum.
Hé pwɛr he te tɛ Korowii.
Wɛɛ ɡɔɔ heyaa.
Yabala, he bɛ he bala dɛɛ ŋwalɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa ŋwalɛ o dɔŋ kɛɛ dɛ́ pwaoh la, dɛ Mmara laanee o ŋɔ aa were dɛɛ pwah la.
Dɛ he bol waa dɛɛ yaɡɛ Mmara la aa, amɔ te dɛ haa waa Mmara la aa baɡla la ɛ. Dɛ he dɛ ɡɔɔ he te dɛɛ pwah Mmara la.
Korowii ɡbosoroo dɛ́ won do Mmara dɛ́ won bol nɛn wechɔɡa wa, o ɡbosoroo dɛ́ won lɛ nɛra dɛ́ won chɔɡ bane ɡe.
He ɡee umeo he won bol he dɔŋ bwara wechɔɡe ɔ?
Mbarafo ɛɛ jae wa Hé berɛ dɛɛ no.
He banɔ la haa dɛ lii he nyuune bini dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Fini kɛɛ tɔpere nɔ tɔpesoo yaa la bwɛɛ nɔ bwɛsoo taa, dɛ́ ka di benanyoa dɛɛ di bona dɛ́ nyin kwa,” kɛ dɛ he ɡe aa jemɛ ɡɛ tɔɔ aa dɛ ba he pera la!
Gɛ kɔɔla yon ta, kɛ aa biɡri dɛ yon kaa la, ɡɛɛ he mkpa do.
Anomanta, a fe chɛ kɛŋɔ he ŋɔ, “Dɛ Korowii sɛoh dɛ tɛ yaa ŋwɛnɛ te naa, tɔɔ perɔ yaa ka ɛ kenii kɛɛ anɔɔ.” Kɛ taraken he dɛ ɛ mbarafo kɛ he ɡbo ɛɛ wonoo ɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin.
A ɡɛ waa la bwa ɛ wechɔɡa.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa jemɛ waa aa wera kɛŋɔ o ɛ, dɛ vɛh ɛɛ la, dɛ o ɛ wechɔɡa.
Kondɔɔhna jae wa Kondɔɔhna ɡe, hé no n be!
Waa aa dɛ ba heyaa pui la nomanta, hé dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛ́ɛ wi.
He kondɔɔh chɔɡɔ, kwaa di he bwara laala bwa.
He suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa bwa ɡe deero.
Awola Korowii aa dɛ ba he waa bola la, he suuɡare aa deera la ɛɛ ɛ danseɛ kɛŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ́ we heyaa kɛŋɔ nii ken.
Bɔkwaa hɛɛ cheɡ suuɡa tɔpera aa ka mun nɔ ta dɛ́ ɛɔ?
Hɛ́ɛ no!
Nɛra haa kpɔ ba, ba ɛ he kooni tomare he ta ban kem bɔe dɛ faah ba la, ba dɛ wi he tɛl.
A ɡɛ nɛra la wii chole Korowii waa ɛ komɛlbwa Dɔɔ la deŋna ta.
He dɔ sobɔrdɛɛɡe harɛ nɔ ta dɛ so, dɛɛ di he bwara.
Gɛ haa dɛ di he bwara la, he do kɛŋɔ kondɛɛre baa ku kpɔɡa dɛɛ tɛo ó di dɛ́ je bá kpoo la.
He pa nɛndɛɛɡa ba wa aa do kaih la bolchɔɡe dɛ kpoo ba, ba ta wone ɛ wobɛlbwa dɛ lɛ ba te.
Bambile lawa wenaale ta Kɛ yabala, hé lawɛ bambile, dɛ́ ka tel ɡɛ saŋ ya Dɔɔ la aa ba.
Hé na ɡɛ paa yon so kpa bwaala loɡla á nɛ ó du o kwa, dɛ́ lawɛ bambile, ásɛ yoo ɡe yo mɔɔ o koo kwaa la yon ɛ la.
Gɛ tentenee chɛ kɛŋɔ he ɡe lawɛ bambile dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he Dɔɔ la bala telo.
Yabala, he bɛ dɔŋa waa dɛɛ naɡre ásɛ dɛ ba di bolchɔɡe Korowii sie.
Ya bole pae dɛ tel.
Yabala, hé nyiŋi Korowii keamere la baa cheɡɛ o sɔn ta dɛ bol waa baɡle nɛra la na, dɛ na ɡɛ baa na wa, kɛ dɛ won lawɛ bambile ba wahala ta la.
Hé ɡe ɛ ɡɛ.
Ya dɛ yerɛ nɛra baa wona lawɛ bambile, dɛ che kiŋkiŋ la nɛra baa na som.
He fa no Job wa, ɡɛ waa wona lawɛ bambile dɛ che kiŋkiŋ o wahala bini ka tonɛ, asɛ a habɔɔ Korowii chao.
Nɛra waa dɛ domɛ Korowii tea wɛɛ sune ba nɛ.
Yabala, anɔ la aa jaa dɛ ɛ siswɛm waa laanee kɛ, he bɛ Korowii kɛɛ harɛ kɛɛ komɛlbwa dɛɛ ŋwɛɛ.
Ba dɛ bɔɔ heyaa waa dɛ a ɛ kpela aa, hé sɛh ŋɔ, “Ɔɔh,” dɛ nyosone ɡee yaa, hé ŋɔ, “Ɔɔhɔh.” He bɛ ŋwɛɛ ja, ásɛ a bɛ wechɔɡa ɛ dɛ́ tɛ heya.
Korowii soŋa yarada ne Dɛ sibeɡrewaane pu bɛlbwa naa, wɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii.
Dɛ silɛɛ waane ɡe pui naa, ɡo yela dɛ́ kpɛɛ Korowii.
Dɛ he bini bɛlbwa ɡe bwara dɛ weo waa, ó tomɛ nɛn o ka yerɛ asɔre la bini nomonome, ásɛ ba ba kpɔ noo leɡe o tile Yeesu sɔn ta, dɛ́ soŋe Korowii tɛo.
Dɛ ba kpɔ yarada dɛ soŋe Korowii aa, weela te la ɛɛ dɔ bokpeɡaa.
Ya Dɔɔ la ɛɛ ɡeloo o bwara do kpeɡri.
Dɛ wechɔɡa anee o ɛ kwaraa naa, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛo.
Anomanta, a wer kɛŋɔ he bol he wechɔɡa dɛɛ baɡle he bala he ne baa teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ la, ásɛ ba ɡe won soŋe Korowii dɛɛ tɛ heya, ásɛ o tɛ heyaa bokpeɡa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛndɛɛɡe dɛ soŋe Korowii aa, o dɛ no dɛ ɛ dɛɛ tɛo.
Korowii keame Elaeja fa ɛ nɛn kɛŋɔ yan.
O soŋe Korowii taeh dɛ ŋɔ ó ɡel bwaala nɛɛ, asɛ bwaala ta nɛɛ, hwel che bene atoro korobie anumɛl.
Asɛ o berɛ soŋe Korowii ja dɛ ŋɔ ó ɡel bwaala nɛ, asɛ nyundua pili, bwaala nɛ taeh, harɛ ta kwaa bwa le.
Yabala, dɛ he bini bɛl nyoɡrɔ le kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ la ta, asɛ he bini bɛl ɡe won berɛ chao dɛ baɡlo, asɛ o berɛ ba teŋɛ kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ la ta ja aa, dɛ naate waa chao la ɛ waa taeh.
Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa wona cha wechɔɡ-ɛɛ asɛ o ɡel wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛ berɛ baa ɛ wedɛɛɡa ja la, dɛ naate lɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ la mkpa, dɛ ɡel o wechɔɡa damanta bwa waa ɛa la, Korowii kpɔ kɛo.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Yeesu toroma la, dɛ Pitaa ɛ ba sitɔɔ, kɛ o hwelo dɛ jemɛ kɛ a chɛ kɛ sitɔɔ bɛlbwa ɛ toma tɛ nɛra.
O chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ do Kristo tena baa dɛ na hɔhɔrɔwa la ɡbemba, ba yarada baa dɔa la wa.
O dɛ lii yaa ŋɔ, ya dɔ hwɛɡa kerekere, dɛkalkɛ Yeesu baa sewɛ daɡaɡre ta, dɛ berɛ ir seo ta.
Tɔpebɛl Yeesu ɛɛ bao jirima ne, ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o nɛɛ la dɔ duure.
A chɛ kɛ ya we-ɛɛla baɡle kɛ ya ɛ Korowii nɛra, ásɛ ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa ane bɛlbwa aa ba ya nɛɛ la ɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Korowii kpɔɔ dɛɛ daah yaa, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ ya Korowii yaradae la ɛ kpela.
Men Pita maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo torome la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he Korowii nɛra haa peɡra dɛ ka ɛ hɔɔhra Pɔntos, ne Galaasia, ne Kapadoosia, ne Eesia dɛ Bitiinia harɛre ta la.
Korowii waa ɛ ya Mɛɛ cheɡɛ jema waa jemɛ heyaa wubwa la ta, dɛ le heyaa kɛŋɔ o nɛra dɛ tɛ o te.
O Domadɛɛɡe laanee ɡela he do ɡoroŋ, dɛ ɡel hɛɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo waa ta, asɛ o chal yaɡle he doŋa he nɛ.
Kórowii cha heyaa dɛ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna kohona.
Ya kpɛɛ Korowii hwɛɡa waa kpɔa tɛ yaa Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Korowii.
Waa dɛ sune ya nɛɛ kohona nomanta, o cheɡɛ ira waa ir Yeesu Kristo seo ta la ta dɛ ɡel ya ɛ nɛnfala.
Anɔ ɡelɔ ya dɔ hwɛɡa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Ya dɛ hwɛɡɛ kondɔɔh waa kwaara cheɡ yaa la ta kɛŋɔ aa ɛ ya kwaa.
O kwaa a bwa cheɡ heyaa Korowii doa, belaa aa wola pɔh, aa wola chɔɡ, aa wola tu bwa.
He cheɡaa a che.
He yarada nomanta, Korowii kpɔ o kpeɡri tɔ he nɛ, wobɛlbwa aa wola won ɛ heyaa ka tel kɛŋɔ waa ba lɛ heya.
O ɛ lɛɛ waa ba lɛ heyaa la wobɛlbwa tonɛ, dɛ lɛ heyaa waa bwa jaɡa saŋ.
Anomanta, he dɔ silɛɛ kohona, kɛ he tea bini ɛɛ chɔɡoo tama te, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Bɔnsam ɛɛ daah heyaa daahna bwa soo siwii na.
A bwa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he yarada la ɛ yarada kasinteŋ.
Suuɡaswɛm kwaraa nɔ, nii nee baa jemɛ a kasinteŋ, kɛ a dɛ chɔɡ.
He yarada la ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm, anomanta, a chɛ kɛ ba daah heyaa na ásɛ he won che kiŋkiŋ.
Belaa baa ba heyaa kpɛɛra, ásɛ he dɔ jirima, dɛ́ dɔ sɔn awola Yeesu Kristo aa ba ya nao la.
He ta on nae ka, kɛ he dɛ nyinu.
Taraken ɡba, haa on na, kɛ he dɛ yaradao.
Anomanta, he sie dɛ lɛ kohona nɛn aa wola won baɡle a wa.
He yarada dɔ mun.
A ɡelɔ Korowii ɛɛ lɛ heya, wɛɛ lɛ heyaa ka tonɛ.
He lɛɛ nɔ, Korowii keamere fa dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ ba he nɛɛ suna dɛ lɛ heyaa la wa, asɛ dɛ swɛɛ siwi dɛ pese Korowii waa waa bola la dɛ jemɛ a bini kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ Kristo Doma soɡe ba nɛɛ dɛɛ baɡle wahala Kristo aa dɛ ba nae, dɛ baɡle jirima aa dɛ ba bala wahala la habɔɔ.
Ba takapɔ kɛŋɔ bá fee won jemɛ tɔpere aa dɛ ba chiɡa, ne ɡɛ aa dɛ ba ɛɛ.
Korowii ɡelɔ a ɡɛ keamere la jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba koeh baa dɛ koh la, ba laa dɛ́ di a tɔnɔ, heyaa ba koh dɛɛ tɛ.
Waa haa noa taraken dɛ le Amanesoma baa bola he be la ta la, ban fa bola.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe waa tomɔ ya be laanee cha ba ba bola he be la.
Korowii nyundua toroma kwaraa dɛ nyin a ɡɛ waa nɔ dɛ́ jemɛ.
Goroŋ doe wa Anomanta, hé ir nyu ne dɛ́ ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ.
Hé kpɔ he hwɛɡa bwa do chae Yeesu Kristo aa cha heyaa awola waa ba nɛra bwa nao la ta.
Haa ɛ Korowii bii dɛɛ no o deŋna waa nomanta, he bɛ he pɛlchɔɡa waa he fa aa lɔ biro ta dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta la dɛɛ ɛ. Gɛ Korowii waa le heyaa tɛ o te aa do ɡoroŋ la, hé ɡe do ɡoroŋ ɡɛ he we-ɛɛla bwa ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Hé do ɡoroŋ, dɛkalkɛ n do ɡoroŋ.” Korowii waa wola nɛn siebɔr nyiŋi dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la, onee he wi dɛɛ yerɔ he Mɛɛ la.
Anomanta, hé kpɔ he te kɛ hɔɔhra he soɡa bini harɛ bonɔ, dɛɛ tɛo duure, dɛɛ ɔmɔ.
He jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii aa lɛ heyaa le he naawa wesale he fa aa lɔ a ta la ta la, harɛ bonɔ kwaa aa dɛ chɔɡ kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm ne laa o yawɛ heya.
Yeesu Kristo waa do kɛ saraha pebie doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o nɛ, waa wola kirihiah bobɛlbwa dii la, o ɡbaɡba chal nee Korowii yawɛ heya.
Korowii aa leo ŋɔ ó ɛ a ɡɛ toma nɔ, dɛ ba ta nyundua ne harɛ tae mɔɔ.
Kɛ he waa o koh dɛ ɡel o ba harɛ nɛra nao, tɔpera aa ka mun nɔ ta la.
O nɛɛ a che he yarada Korowii.
Korowii ɡee iru seo ta dɛ tɛo jirima.
Anomanta, he yarada ne he hwɛɡa haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ la, Korowii nɛɛ a bwa do.
Taraken nɔ haa sɛh kasinteŋ la ta teŋa, asɛ a che a ta he doŋa le he nɛɛ hɛɛ nyin dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ nɔ, hé den dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa kohona bambile bwa ne, dɛkalkɛ ba berɔ kwaa lolɛ heyaa nɛnfala.
Nɛn waa dɛ sewɛ la dwee laa heyaa kpa, Korowii waa wola sewɛ bwa la dweee heya.
Korowii Waa aa dɛ tɛ mkpa dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa la taa a che ba kwaa lolɛ heya.
Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛwɛnyini bwa do kɛ kpɔɡa fee, ba jirima ɡe do kɛ kpɔɡa fee.
Kpɔɡa dɛ sewɛ, a fee ɡe ɛɛ lee.
Kɛ Korowii Waa te lole saŋ bɛlbwa.” A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ Amanesoma baa bola baɡle heyaa la.
Anomanta, hé le wechɔɡa bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ dɔŋa neɡra bɛlbwa, ne nɛra sie nyiŋa dɛɛ ɛ wa, ne bɔweela dɛ nɛra waa bola bɛlbwa sese ta.
Hé ɡel he siwi swɛɛ Korowii Waa la noe ta kɛŋɔ bechasɔɔhne siwi yon swɛɛ elnee ta la, a che a ta he won kpeɡ he lɛɛ waa la ta.
He daɡɛ ya Dɔɔ la na taraken dɛ́ na kɛ o wer.
Bwe waa dɔ mkpa ne nɛra Korowii aa lee ba tɛ o te O te ɛ Bwe waa dɔ mkpa.
Nɛwɛnyini liiru konsala dɛ vɛoh, kɛ onee Korowii te nyiŋi kɛ o ɛ Bwedɛɛɡe o wa aa hiah dɛɛ nyinu.
Haa ba o be nɔ, he ɡe do kɛ bwea aa dɔ mkpa.
Hé ɡel o kpɔ heyaa ma Korowii Dea ásɛ he ɛ Korowii sɔfore haa do ɡoroŋ, ásɛ dɛ che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii bambile bwa ne a ɛ saraha dɛɛ su o siwi.
Ba chwerɛ Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Na, n pɛne Bwedɛɛɡe o wa aa hiah, dɛ kpɔ pa n Dea mun Saayɔn o lawɔ kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yaradao la, waa sihiih di bwa.” He nɛra haa dɛ yaradao ɡe be la, wɛɛ ɛ Bwedɛɛɡe o wa aa hiaah tɛ heya.
Asɛ nɛra baa wola on yaradae ɡe la, wɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ baa chwera Korowii Tɔn bini laanee ba be, kɛŋɔ, “Bwe la mamaala aa vɛoh dɛ liiru konsala laanee bera ba lawɛ dea kpoŋe la.” Ba berɔ chwerɛ o waa ŋɔ, “Bwe waa dɛ ba ɡela nɛra lɔ naa dɛ choɡli laanee la.” Ba vɛh Korowii waa la ta teŋa, an ɡela baa lɔ na.
Korowiirii cheɡa ɡɛ.
Kɛ he te la, Korowiirii le heya.
O Kora sɔforee heya.
He do ɡoroŋ.
He ɛ o nɛra waa le heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ bol o nyokpowaa waa ɛa.
On le he ne biro ta dɛ ba he ne o bochaah waa wera kohona la ta.
He fa ta Korowii nɛra ɛɛ, kɛ taraken te, o nɛraa heya.
O fa ta he sum nae, kɛ taraken te, o na he sum.
N dandɛɛɡa, n dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ haa ɛ hɔɔhra bonɔ, bonɔ aa wola he bwɛɛ ɛɛ nɔ, hé laa he te kpɔ he bwadabii pɛlchɔɡa ta.
Anee dɛɛ vuuɡi heyaa haa wola won ɛ waa Korowii aa kpɔa do he bambile bini la.
Haa lɔ nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ baah nɔ, hé ɡel he wobɛlbwa toɡre, ásɛ dɛ ba dɛ bol he waa ŋɔ he ɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa, a habɔɔ la, bá na he we-ɛɛla kɛŋɔ a wer, dɛ kpɔ jam tɛ Korowii awola waa ba ya ne o na dɔŋa la.
Pwɛr he te dɛɛ tɛ koranar ne nomonome Hé koh ya Dɔɔ la waa dɛ́ pwɛr he te dɛɛ tɛ nomonome baa cheɡ ba harɛ bonɔ bwa, he harɛ bwa nyu waa chɔ wobɛlbwa nyoa, ne o ɡe nɛra waa lee ba ŋɔ báa tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋne dɛɛ kpɛɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ waa aŋwɛnɛ ta la.
Korowii dɛ nyin kɛ hɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, dɛ́ won dɛɛ tɔ ɡɛna ŋwɛnɛ ba bɛ won bol ɡɛnewaa dɛɛ chɔɡ heya.
Hé so kɛŋɔ nɛra haa dɔ he te haa wola yoma ɛɛ.
Kɛ he bɛ dɔe haa dɔ he te la kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
Hé ɡel nɛra na kɛŋɔ Korowii bonɔɔna ne tolii heyaa he soɡa bini.
Hɛ́ɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa duure, dɛɛ nyin he bala baa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo la.
Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, dɛ́ kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ he harɛ bwa nyu te.
He banɔ la baa dɛ do heyaa bonɔɔna kɛɛ toli la, hé pwɛr he te, dɛɛ tɛ he dɔɔranar dɛɛ duu ba.
He dɔɔranar ba tea aa soma ba do pwɛre ɡbo laa n ŋɔ.
Hɛ́ɛ duu banɔ la ba nyu bini aa kpeɡa ɡba.
Maa dɛ ŋɔ nɔ, naate baa dɛ fiiɡu aa wola aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ, asɛ o koh Korowii waa dɛ won lawɛ bambile la, a wer dɛɛ lɛ Korowii sie.
Haa ɛ wechɔɡa, asɛ dɛ lawɛ bambile ba lɔɔre a waa la, bɔkwa sɔnee lɔ he bambile lawa la ta nɔ?
He ɛ wedɛɛɡa, ba ɡarɛ koh a waa dɛɛ ɛɛ hɔhɔrɔwa he lawɛ bambile aa, a ɛ sɔn dɛɛ tɛɛ Korowii be.
A ɡɛ waa nɔɔ Korowii le heyaa ŋɔ hɛɛ na, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo koh he waa dɛ na wahala, asɛ a chɔ tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ hɛɛ lawɛ bambile he wahala ta.
Ba chwerɔ ŋɔ, “O ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ bwa.
Nyosonwaa ta o nyoa leɛ bwa.” Ba fa aa dɛ chɛɡro chɛɡtɔrɔ la bwa la, o ta nyoa pile chɛɡɛ nomɛlbwa.
Ba fa aa dɛ ɛo hɔhɔrɔwa la bwa la, o ta nomɛlbwa aahrɛ.
O kpɔ a bwa tɛ Korowii waa dɛ bol nɛra bwa waa dɛɛ pa bole kasinteŋ ne la.
O ɡbaɡba lɛ ya wechɔɡa dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ na wahala daɡaɡre ta, ásɛ ya bɛ so tɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ́ so tɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ.
Bola baa doo la taa a che he dɔ bokpeɡa.
He fa do kɛ peera aa kpaŋa, kɛ taraken te, he ba he Dɔɔ waa dɛ nyin he nyu la be.
Haahna ne ba jaranar He haahna ɡe, hé pwɛr he te dɛɛ tɛ he jaranar.
Dɛ he dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, he banɔ la he jaranar aa wola Korowii waa yaradae la, he we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ɡeloo bá yarada.
Haa nyoa kwaraa pili bol wa, dɛkalkɛ baa na ɡɛ he we-ɛɛla aa wera doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole a ta, ne ɡɛ haa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii.
Gɛ haa dɛ ɛ he nyumpona, ne suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaare kɛŋɔ baŋa kwaa ne deŋna kwaa doe, ne laala haa dɛ do laa dɛ ɡel he do wer toli.
Hé ɡel nɛra na he wer waa aa lɔ bambile bini siwi aa wola an na la ta.
Hé do pwɛre, dɛɛ ɛ waa bɔeh.
Anee wera aa wola tu bwa, dɛ do wer kohona Korowii be.
A saŋ la haahna ba fa aa dɛ tomɛ Korowii kasinteŋ ne dɛɛ yaradao la, dɛ ba pwɛr ba te dɛɛ tɛ ba jaranar.
Anee ba ɡe wer.
Dɛ ɡɛɛ Abraham haah Saara ɡe do.
O pwɛr o te tɛ o jaa dɛ faa yerɔ o dɔɔ.
He waa toɡrɔ, haa ɔmɛ ɡe aa, ate Saara biirii heya.
Baala ɡe, ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛ he dɔ liire he ne he haahna soɡa bini, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ baa kpeɡe kɛŋɔ heya.
Hɛ́ɛ duu ba, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he ne ba bwaa dɛɛ ba Korowii mkpa waa cha heyaa hɛɛ ba dɔe la dɔe.
Hɛ́ɛ ɛ ken ásɛ wobɛlbwa bɛ he Korowii soŋa ŋwɛnɛ tɔ.
Wenaale nae wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta Waa maa dɛ nyin n bol laanee kɛŋɔ hé ɡel he nyoa pɛ, hé dɔ dɔŋa chal, hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa kɛŋɔ nyabii.
Hé dɔ tedoma dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛ pwɛr he te dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa.
He bɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ dɛɛ bɔ wechɔɡa kem.
He bɛ wobochɔɡa kpɔ dɛɛ bɔ wobochɔɡa kem.
Nɛn ɛɛ wechɔɡa aa, soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛo.
Korowii aa le heyaa la, dɛ hɛ́ɛ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ o tɛ heyaa hɛɛra.
Ba chwerɔ do Korowii Tɔn bini ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin mkpajaŋ, dɛɛ nyin kɛ o bwara sɔɔhno la, wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi o nyoa kɛrɛdɛ.
O bɛ wobochɔɡa dɛɛ bol, o bɛ nyosone dɛɛ teŋe.
Wɛ́ɛ ke o te wechɔɡa ta, dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Ó swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ɛ waa aa dɛ ba nyopɛo ne.
A do ɡɛ, dɛkalkɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛɛ su Korowii siwi la, Korowii dɛ nyiŋ ba, dɛɛ no ba wesoŋa.
Kɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa te, o ne baa jo.” He siwi swɛɛ wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta naa, umee dɛɛ ba he hae yɔ?
He dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa a che a ta hɛɛ na waa kwara naa, dɛ he ta som nae yaa?
A ba ɡɛ naa, bɛ nɛra baa dɛ hae la ɔmɛ.
Bɛ ɡel a hae.
Hɛ́ɛ duu Yeesu Kristo dɛɛ ɔmɔ he bambile bini kɛŋɔ he Dɔɔree on.
Hé kpɔ he te saŋ bɛlbwa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa bɔɔ heyaa he hwɛɡa haa dɔa nɔ wa aa, he won baɡlo a bini.
He dɛ baɡla aa, hé kpɔ sisɔna ne taa dɛɛ baɡla.
A chɛ kɛ he tea to he jemɛ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa aa he wobɛlbwaa dɔ dɛ bol.
He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, nɛra baa koh he teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛ, ne he wedɛɛɡa haa dɛ ɛ waa dɛ bol wobochɔɡa dɛɛ yaɡɛ heyaa la, sihiih ɛɛ kpo baa.
He dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ na wa aa, an wera kɛ haa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ na wa.
Dɛ Korowii tetooraa kɛ he koh he wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ waa dɛɛ na wa aa, a wer.
Yeesu Kristo ɡbaɡba sewɔ tɛ heyaa dɛ bɔ wechɔɡa kem.
Kerabeŋkpoŋii o sewɛ, waa wola berɛ sewɛ kpa.
O ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ bwa, kɛ o sewɔ tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.
Gɛ waa ɛ ya ne Korowii pɛ waa o ɛ ɡɛ.
Baa kpoo la, o bwadabii sewa, kɛ o lileo te dɔ mkpafale.
O lileo la lala baa vɔɡ ba Lalabwɛɛ la be, dɛ ka bol Korowii Waa ba be.
A saŋ la tena baa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ dɛ vɛh Korowii Waa noe ɡɛ saŋ Nowa fa aa dɛ kwaa o daka la, ba lalaa o bol Korowii Waa baɡle la.
Korowii fa lawɛ bambile ba nɛɛ biɡri, dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ Nowa aa kwaa o daka la tonɛ.
Nɛra tama baa lɔ o bini laanee Korowii lɛ nee la ta.
Dɛ ba lɔ nɛra banuatoro.
A ɡɛ nee nɔ cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii nee baa dɛ sɔ yaa aa lɛ yaa la.
Korowii nee sɔe ta bwara doŋa yaɡla ɛɛ.
Korowii nee sɔe munii kɛ ya soŋe Korowii ó tɛ yaa tepoŋ.
A cheɡɛ Yeesu Kristo seo ta ira ta, asɛ nee sɔe la won dɛɛ lɛ yaa.
O kaa Korowii be nyundua, dɛ ka so nomombɔr o diɡ ta, dɛɛ di kora nyundua toroma ne konchɔɡa aa bea yaa wola an na bwa soo siwi nɛ.
Wesaɡasaɡare ɛɛ ɡela dɛ so tɛ Korowii wa Yeesu Kristo aa baa ɛ nɛwɛnyini la, o na bonyɛɡa.
Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ he kpɔ he te, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ ɡɛɛ he ɡe bwara ɛɛ ba nyɛɡa.
Nomɛlbwa waa wona lawɛ bambile dɛ na bonyɛɡa ka la, waa wechɔɡa ɛ.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa, hé kpɔ Korowii tetoora dɛɛ tɔ sie he soɡa bini harɛ bonɔ.
He bɛ kwaa nɛwɛnyina aa dɛ pɛlɛ a ta la nɛɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ kpa.
Waa nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ aa dɛ ɛa asɛ he fa aa ɛa la, he ta a nyoa nae yaa?
Dɛ he sie dɛ lɛ jwamane ne pɛlchɔɡa we-ɛɛla ta.
Dɛ he dɛ sɔ sen, dɛɛ ɛ saɡasaɡa, dɛ lawɛ dɔŋa dɛɛ nyɔ sennyɔbala.
Dɛ he dɛ tomɛ voɡa dɛɛ jo Korowii kii nɛ.
Nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la, a dɛ ɛɛ ba anebɛlbwa kɛŋɔ he ne baa wola pɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa ne wesaɡasaɡare baa dɛ ɛ la.
A waa baa chɛɡre heyaa la.
Anɔ bwa baa dɛ ɛ nɔ, baa ba tɔh ba nyoa Korowii siee.
O kpɔ o te dɛɛ ba weera ne lala bwa waa bola dɛ́ pa bole.
Nɛra baa serewa la, ba bol Amanesoma nɔ baɡle ba ɡe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ bol ba ɡe waa dɛ́ pa bole ɡɛ waa dɛ ba weera ɛɛ la.
Waa ba fa aa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ saŋ baa wola sewɛ mɔɔ la, anee wɛɛ ba nyiŋa dɛ́ pa ba bole.
Korowii dɛ nyin kɛ ba dɔ mkpa ɡɛ waa dɔ mkpa la, a waa o ɡel Yeesu bol Amanesoma la chaɡ ba la.
Wobɛlbwa jaɡa tɔpere la telo.
Anomanta, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ, ásɛ dɛ won dɛɛ soŋe Korowii kɛrɛdɛ.
Waa aa ɛ wehiah kohonaa kɛ hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa bambile bwa ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɔŋa nyina dɛ tɔ wechɔɡa kɛrɛdɛ ta.
He dɔŋ baa choɡe naa, lɛo, bɛ waa dɛɛ naɡre.
Kpeɡri bɛlbwa nomɛlbwa aa dɔa la, Korowiirii kpɔa chao ŋɔ ó kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ o Korowii toma.
Anomanta, bɛ́lbwa nyiŋi o toma ta kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ cha o bala.
Nomɛlbwa Korowii aa chao o won dɛɛ bol o Waa la, wɛ́ɛ bola dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Waa wɛɛ bol la.
Nomɛlbwa Korowii aa chao o won dɛɛ tomɛ o dɔŋ la, wɛ́ɛ tomɔ bokpeɡa Korowii aa tɛo bwa ne, ásɛ wobɛlbwa ta la, Korowii che Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ sɔn.
On chɛ kpeɡri ne jirima aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Aamen.
Kristo te ɛɛ wenaale N dandɛɛɡa, he bɛ ɡel nii haa dɛ na taraken nɔ kpo he nyoa.
Daahnaa Korowii kpɔa dɛɛ daah he yarada.
He bɛ ɡel a ɛ heyaa wehɔɔhra.
Hé ɡel he sie lɛ kɛŋɔ haa dɛ na Yeesu Kristo wenaale dɔŋa nɔ, ásɛ awola haa ba na o jirima waa dɔa la, he sie lɛ, he bwara sɔɔh heyaa kohona.
Dɛ ba koh he teŋa haa teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ la waa dɛɛ chɛɡre heya aa, he na som.
A ba ɡɛ naa, a dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe o wa aa dɔ jirima la soɡe he nɛ.
Dɛ he bini bɛl dɛ na wahala aa, a bɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛnee o kpo, kɛɛ ŋwɛɛ o ŋwɛ, kɛɛ nɛnchɔɡee on, kɛɛ nyoaa o kpɔ do nɛra waa ta.
Dɛ a cheɡɛ he Kristo te ɛɛ ta, asɛ hɛɛ na wahala aa, bɛ ɡel a ɛɛ sihiih.
Jam Korowii kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo sɔn aa dawɛ he nɛ.
Tɔpere telo kɛŋɔ Korowii bol nɛwɛnyina waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Korowii nɛra nɛɛ wɛɛ ba mun pae.
Waa dɛ ba ya kwaraa kpɔe pa mun nɔ, dɛ ɛrɛɛ nɛra baa wola Amanesoma la yaradae waa ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?
Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Nɛra baa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡa ba waa su Korowii siwi kwaraa la, dɛ a kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ba dɔ ba nyu aa, dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ la, ɛrɛɛ ba waa ɛɛ ba doe yɔ?” Anomanta, he nɛra aa ɛ Korowii tetoora kɛ he na wahala la, hɛ́ɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa, dɛ kpɔ he te do Korowii waa ta heyaa la nɔn ta.
O waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
Waa aa kaala dɛɛ tɛ nomonome ne bonɔɔna N dɛ nyin n bol waane he asɔre nomonome baa dɛ tɔ he sie la be.
Asɔre nomoa la bɛlee n ɡe.
N ɡbaɡba kpɔ siwi na wahala la soo Yeesu Kristo aa naa.
Awola waa dɛ ba ɡela nɛra na o jirima la, n ɡe ɛɛ dɔ o jirima la bɛlee.
N dɛ soŋe heyaa kɛŋɔ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi Korowii nɛra baa ɛ o peera waa kpɔ ba tɛ heyaa ŋɔ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ la kɛrɛdɛ.
He bɛ ɡel ba do heyaa mɔɔ hɛɛ nyiŋ ba kɛrɛdɛ, hé ɡel a ɛ he ɡbaɡba tetoowa.
He bɛ suuɡa sibeɡra waa koh dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ toma nɔ, hé nyiŋi nyina haa dɛ nyin kɛ toma la kaa kɛrɛdɛ la dɛɛ ɛa.
He bɛ kpeɡri dɛɛ di nɛra baa kpɔ ba do he nɔn ta la nɛ.
Hé ɡel he we-ɛɛla do wer ásɛ ba nyiŋa dɛɛ chaara.
He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, Peteɡra Bwa Dɔɔ la balaa, wɛɛ tɛ heyaa jirima kon o wer aa wola tu bwa, o ɛ kompoŋ haa yoa dɛ le ba vɔwɛ heya.
He bonɔɔna ɡe la, hɛ́ɛ tɛ he nomonome duure.
Hé bwa pwɛr he te dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa, dɛɛ cha dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii Tɔn bolɔ ŋɔ, “Korowii ne mbarafo tena aa jo, kɛ o dɛ sune nɛra baa dɛ pwɛr ba te nɛɛ dɛɛ cha ba.” Anomanta, hé pwɛr he te dɛɛ no Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri bwa la wa, ásɛ o ɡɔɔ heyaa ir tɔpere waa wera o be ta.
Wobɛlbwa aa dɛ ha heyaa la, hé kpɔa bil Korowii sie, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he waa lɔ o bambile ta.
Hé ɡel he sie chɔ harɛ, hɛɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he dɔm Bɔnsam lole.
Gɛ nyujente yon dɛɛ kɔɡre, dɛ́ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ́ lawɛ la, ɡɛɛ o ɡe ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin nɛra dɛ́ lawɛ.
Anomanta, hé che kiŋkiŋ he yarada ta.
He bɛ Bɔnsam ŋwɛnɛ tɛ.
Hé jemɛ kɛ he bala baa dɛ yarada Yeesu bobɛlbwa la dɛ na a ɡɛ waa nɔ haa dɛ na nɔ dɔŋa.
Kɛ he baa na waa tama aa, Korowii waa dɛ na nɛra sum dɛɛ cha ba kohona la, o ɡbaɡba ɛɛ kwaa he wobɛlbwaa, dɛ́ ɡel he che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ́ do kpeɡri, dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa he bɛ chole.
Onee le heyaa hé won che pɛɛ he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la ta, dɛ dɔ o jirima aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa la.
On chɛ kpeɡri aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
Aamen.
Lea aa ka mun Silasee cha mɛ n chwerɛ heyaa tɔmbora nɔ la.
N jemɔ kɛ o waa dɔ kasinteŋ ya teŋa yaa dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ nɔ ta.
N dɛ nyin he jemɛ ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɛ, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ ɡɛ n fa aa baɡle heyaa chae Korowii aa sune ya nɛɛ dɛ cha yaa la, a ɛ kasinteŋ.
Hé den lawɛ a bini kiŋkiŋ.
Asɔre tena baa lɔ Babelɔn, Korowii aa lee ba ɡɛ waa le heyaa la, ba dɛ na heya.
N bie Mak ɡe dɛ na heya.
Hɛ́ɛ lea dɔŋa nɛnnyin ne.
He nɛra he ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la, Kórowii tɛ he bwa bosɔɔhna.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Pita chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛ́ cha Kristo tena, ásɛ ba won teŋɛ Korowii ne Yeesu Kristo kasinteŋ webaɡla la ta á lɛɛ ba, ɡɛ aa lɛ nɛra bane ɡɛ saŋ Yeesu fa aa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta aa no waa waa baɡla la.
Pita ne nɛra baa dɛ baɡle nyosonwa, dɛɛ ɛ hanyin ne banyin dɛ wedoŋa waa harɛ nɔ ta la aa liire kpɔ.
O ŋɔ a ɡɛ we-ɛɛla la aa were.
Pita dɛ do yaa ɡbemba ŋɔ Yeesu ɛɛ berɔ ba saŋ Korowii aa doa ŋɔ ó ba la.
Korowii dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa won charɛ o liire, dɛ́ le o wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ Yeesu berɔ ba naa, ó bɛ on chɔɡ.
Men Seemɔn Pita maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ dɛ ɛ o torome la, men chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he nɛra haa dɛ yarada Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ ya Korowii ne ya Lɛɛ la.
O wa aa toɡra nomanta, o tɛ heyaa ya yarada waa wera nɔ dɔŋ.
Kórowii che he jema haa jemɔ dɛ jemɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu la ta, dɛ́ cha heyaa kohona, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Korowii yerɛ o nɛra dɛ lee ba tɛ o te Yeesu dɔ Korowii kpeɡri la dɔŋ.
Anee o kpɔ cha yaa, asɛ ya dɔ komɛlbwa yaa hiah dɛ won do le dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa.
Yaa jemɛ Korowii waa le yaa ásɛ ya won dɔ o jirima ne o dadɛɛɡe la waa o ɛ ɡɛ.
Waa ɛ ɡɛ nɔ, o cha yaa ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡa kohona ta, aa wola dɔŋ dɔe.
O baɡɛ yaa nyoa a wa.
Hɛ́ɛ che a taa dɛ́ le pɛlchɔɡa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta dɛɛ chɔɡ nɛra la nyoa, ásɛ dɛ do ɡɛ Korowii aa doa la.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ wesoo nomanta la, hé takapɔ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa dɛɛ ja he Yeesu waa yaradae ta, dɛ́ kpɔ wejema dɛ́ ja he wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ta, dɛ́ won dɛɛ lawɛ he te dɛɛ ja he wejema ta.
Hɛ́ɛ lawɛ bambile dɛɛ ja he te lawa ta, dɛ kpɔ Korowii ɔma dɛɛ ja he bambile lawa ta.
Hɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa dɛɛ ja he Korowii ɔma ta, dɛɛ nyin nɛn dɛɛ ja he dɔŋa nyina ta.
Da waa wera tɛ heyaa la.
He wono dɔ a ɡɛ da nɔ kɛrɛdɛ naa, aa ɡeloo jema haa jemɛ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo la dɔ tɔnɔ dɛ́ su siwi.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola a ɡɛ da nɔ dɔe la, o liire do toŋɡboŋ ken.
Waa waa nyiŋe dɛɛ la sie.
A ɡɛ te la soɔh kɛŋɔ Korowii laa o wechɔɡa o fa aa dɛ ɛ la fee o nɛ.
Anomanta, yabala, Korowii aa le heyaa tɛ o te nɔ, hé takapɔ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ ɡeloo he we-ɛɛla baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii nɛra waa lee ba la banee heya.
He dɛ ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa naa lɔ Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ yaradae ta bwa.
He dɛ ɛ ken nɔ naa, Korowii ɛɛ tɛ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ kohonaa, ásɛ he ja ya Dɔɔ waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo Kora waa wola jaɡa dɔe la ta.
Korowii waa baa chwera do o keamere tɔne bini Kasinteŋ waa la haa noa la, he dɔɔ jema kɛrɛdɛ dɛ che a ta kiŋkiŋ.
Kɛ mɛɛ dɛɛ lii heyaa a waa saŋ bɛlbwaa.
N dɛ lii kɛŋɔ maa wola sewɛ mɔɔ nɔ, a chɛ kɛ mɛɛ lii heyaa hé do wɔrɔbe waa nɔ ta.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ aa biɡri n wur n harɛ nɔ ta bwadabii nɔ ta.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo ɡelɔ n jemɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Mɛɛ takapɔɔ dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ bwa maa won ɛ, ásɛ dɛ n ba toole kwaraa naa, he won dɛɛ lii waa nɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo kpeɡri waa dɔa ne o bala waa la yaa bol he be la, a ta waa yaa kpɔ liire dɛ teŋe nyosone ɛɛ.
Ya ɡbaɡba kpɔ sie na ɡɛ o wa aa dɔ nyɛl kohona.
O Mɛɛ Korowii ɡbaɡba aa tɛo duure ne jirima la, dɛ ya lɔ bela.
Taa bɛl le o Mɛɛ Korowii waa dɔ jirima kohona la be kɛŋɔ, “N ɡbaɡba Bie maa dɛ nyinu o wa ɛɛ su n siwii nɔ.” Taa la aa le Korowii doa ba la, ya noɔ.
Dɛ ya ne Yeesu lɔ bwe la Korowii aa ɡela o do ɡoroŋ la ta.
Anɔ ɡelɔ ya jemɛ kpelakpela kɛŋɔ waa Korowii keamere la aa bola la ɛ kasinteŋ.
A chɛ kɛ he cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ noa.
Ba waa baa bola la do kɛ kandea waa dɛ chaah biro ta ka tel kɛŋɔ tɔ aa pera.
Korowii Keamere Tɔne la ɛɛ chaah heyaa bɔree, ásɛ Korowii ɡel he liire chaah ɡɛ chɔmbibi wewee aa dɛ chaah bɔr la.
Hé jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ waa ba fa aa chwera Korowii Keamere Tɔne bini la, a bɛlbwa toole dɛ ɛ nɛwɛnyini nyu bini liire.
Akai!
Baa chwera la, ba ɡbaɡba liire ne laa ba chwera.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡee ir Korowii nɛra nɛ, asɛ baa bol waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere Korowii aa kpɔa do ba nyoa.
Nyosonteŋna baa dɛ chaɡle Korowii wa A saŋ la, nɛra bane teŋe nyosone ŋɔ Korowii keameree ban Israel tena bini.
Gɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba bala dɛ ba teŋe nyosone ŋɔ ban dɛɛ chaɡle nɛra waa he bini.
Baa dɛɛ chaɡle waa aa wola kasinteŋ ɛɛ, dɛ́ ɡel nɛra nyoɡre.
Gɛ ba wechaɡla aa doa la, haa won jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ.
Baa vɛh ba Dɔɔ waa bɔ ba wechɔɡa kem la waa, dɛ́ ɡel Korowii chɔɡ ba, ba sewɛ seopiɡri.
Nɛndamanta ɛɛ teŋɛ ba wedoŋa baa dɛ ɛ la taa, ásɛ a che a ta nɛra bol kasinteŋ ŋwɛnɛ wobochɔɡa kɛ waa were.
Ba sibeɡra baa dɔa kohona nomanta, baa dɛɛ teŋe nyosonee ŋɔ waa baa chaɡle heya, dɛ́ neɡre heyaa dɛɛ di.
Naate waa pa ba bolchɔɡe dɛɛ ba ba deŋne tɛra la, kpɔ o te dɛɛ kpaa ba saŋ bɛlbwa.
Waa dom chɔ.
Wɛɛ ɛɛ ba posaposa kenii.
Nyundua toroma ba fa aa ɛ wechɔɡa la, Korowii ta ban ɡelɛ.
O kpɔ ba ta deŋnetɛra bɔr waa ɛ bɔluŋluŋ dɛ bir kpirikpiri la dɛ ka tel awola waa ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la.
O ta a saŋ la tena ɡelɛ.
O ɡelɔ nee su tɔ nɛra baa wola on ɔmɛ la nɛ.
Nɛra waa ɡel ba bwaa Nowa o fa aa dɛ chaɡle nɛra ŋɔ bá ɡel ba waa toɡre Korowii be la, ne nɛra banuanɛ.
Sodom ne Gomoora tena fa aa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, Korowii ŋɔ waa ɡel ba dwee ka, dɛ fuh ba ne ba bwɛɛre bwa dɛɛboo.
Ba fuih chɔ le dɛɛ chaɡle waa aa ba chiɡ nɛra baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ nɛ.
Dɛ Lɔt te ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii bela, asɛ wedoŋa bwɛɛre la tena aa wola Korowii ɔmɛ dɛɛ ɛ la ɛɛ hao.
O te, Korowii lɛo.
Lɔt aa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe o waa su Korowii siwi dɛ do ba baah la, dɛ ba wedoŋa waa dɛ na ne anɔ la waa dɛ no tɔpebii bwa la ɡelɔ o bambile ɛɛ weo.
He nyiŋo na naa, dɛ Korowii te jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɔ dɛɛ le Bɔnsam daahna ta, dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋne, dɛ́ ka tel awola waa ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la.
Nɛra ba sie aa beɡre ba bwadabii nɔ wechɔɡa aa suu nɔ pɛlchɔɡa ta, baa wola waa bu la, ba deŋnee Korowii ɛɛ ba tɛra kohona.
A ɡɛ nɛra baa teŋe nyosone ŋɔ ba dɛ chaɡle waa nɔ, waa ba bambile aa lawaa baa ɛ. Ba bambile kpeɡri!
Baa nyundua toroma bu.
Wobochɔɡa kwaraa ba bol dɛɛ yaɡ ba!
Nyundua toroma kpeɡri dɛ dɔ jirima ɡwaa a ɡɛ nyosonteŋna nɔ, kɛ baa ban chɔɡɛ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii sisa wobol ne.
Nɛra nɔ te do kɛ kpɔɡ bini ola Korowii aa taa ŋɔ báa kpoa la ken.
Baa liire kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ wa.
Waa mun noe kpeɡri ba be naa, sisa wobolee ba bol dɛɛ yaɡa.
Baa serewoo kɛŋɔ ola ken.
Wahala baa ɡela nɛra ɛɛ na la, ba ɡe ɛɛ na a dɔŋaa.
Waa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a taa kɛŋɔ ba bodia waa baa dɛ ɛa bochaah la.
He ne baa pɛa dɛɛ di kwaa nɔ, ba do kɛ doŋa dɛɛ chɔɡ he wer.
Ba sɔɔh dɛɛ ɛ bodia waa he habɔɔ taeh.
Ba na haah bɛlbwa naa, ba dɛ nyinu.
Ba nyina baa dɛ nyin wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta dɔŋ dɔe.
Ba neɡre nɛra baa wola cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ Korowii waa ta dɛɛ kaa wechɔɡa ta.
Ba sie dɛ beɡre kwaa taeh.
Korowii taah ba!
Ba ɡel ŋwɛnɛtoɡre la, dɛ nyoɡre.
Ba kpɔ Beɔ bie Balam o fa aa ɛ Korowii keame la ŋwɛnɛ la.
O sie aa beɡre suuɡa kohona nomanta, o kpɔ ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta dɛ nyin suuɡa.
Korowii fa ɡelɔ keeɡo bol waa o be dɛ kaoh o wechɔɡa la ta.
Keeɡo ɡe fe aa waa bol.
Anomanta, Korowii keame nɔ ɡel o choɡla waa la.
He dɛ hwɛɡɛ ba nɛ aa, he hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ.
Ba do kɛ nenabɔɔ nee aa wola toole o ta, dɛ do kɛ baama peu aa ir a ne aa kaa ken.
Biro kpirikpirii Korowii kwaa cheɡ ba.
Ba nyoa wobol kan taeh, kɛ ɡɛnewaa a bwa.
Ba kpɔ bwadabii pɛlchɔɡa waa ne wedoŋa nɛra sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta, dɛ neɡre nɛra dɛɛ kaa wechɔɡa ta.
Nɛra baa pa mun dɛɛ le wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bini baa wola cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ mɔɔ laanee ba neɡre dɛɛ kaa wechɔɡa ta.
Ba yon ŋɔ baa ɡeloo nɛra dɔ ba te, dɛ ba ɡbabir ɛ yoma.
Ba wechɔɡa ɛɛ ba yoma, dɛkalkɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa aa wona lɛ nɛn liire la, a kpɔɔ berɛ yom.
Nɛra jemɛ ya Dɔɔ waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo waa la, dɛ won che a ta le waa aa dɛ la nɛn ne wechɔɡa ta harɛ bonɔ naa, a wer.
Kɛ dɛ ba berɔ ba ɡel a ɡɛ wechɔɡa la dɔ bɔr vɔɡ ba ja aa, a te dɛ ba waa berɔ ɡbɔr dɛ ɡwaa mumpar la.
Dɛ ba fe ta Korowii ŋwɛnɛtoɡre la waa noɛ ka aa, a fe bɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ baa jemɛ Korowii ŋwɛnɛ la dɛ vɛh waa o ɡbaɡba aa ŋɔa báa ɛ la ɛɛ.
Ba waa nɔ ɡelɔ sɛɡla baa sɛɡla Korowii Tɔn bini la ɛ kasinteŋ.
Ba sɛɡlɔ ŋɔ, “Nyoate uɡaa, ɡɛɛ o berɛ dia,” dɛ sɛɡle ŋɔ, “He sɔ parakoo ne aa, wɛɛ berɔɔ ka ɡbili o kpechɛɡre ta.”
Ya dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo bala tɔpere N dandɛɛɡa, tɔn nɔɔ n tɔn nɛɛte maa chwerɛ heya.
N tɔne anɛ nɔ bwa bini la, n dɛ lii heyaa ásɛ he do wɔrɔbe waa nɔ ta, dɛ́ dɔ tepoŋ.
N dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ he lii waa Korowii keamere la fa aa bola a saŋ la, ne waa Yeesu toroma la fa aa ŋɔa ya Dɔɔ waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ la ŋɔ hé ɛ la.
Anɔ la aa tɔ siee kɛŋɔ, a chɛ kɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ tɔpera aa ka mun nɔ ta nɔ, nɛra ɛɛ dɛɛ mamɛ heyaa.
Ba sie ɛɛ dɛɛ lɛ ba pɛlchɔɡa taa.
Baa dɛɛ bɔɔ heyaa ŋɔ, “Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ Yeesu ɛɛ berɔɔ ba ja la, lee o dɔɔ?” Dɛ ŋɔ, “Ya mɛɛnanar bwa serewɔ, dɛ o ta balɛ mɔɔ.
Gɛ harɛ nɔ aa doa o mumpar la, ɡɛɛ o ta do.” Ba saahnɔ laa ba liire kpɔ ɡɛ Korowii fa aa kpɔ nyoa bol waa a saŋ la asɛ nyundua ne harɛ pa mun la ta.
Nee nee Korowii ta harɛ, nee taa harɛ le.
Nee Korowii ɡel o su bɔle harɛ bwa a saŋ la dɛ chɔɡo.
Gɛɛ Korowii ŋɔ nyundua kwaa bwa ne harɛ kwaa bwa aa lole taraken nɔ, á do le ɡɛ, ásɛ nii ɛrɛ ba fuah awola waa dɛ ba nɛra baa wola on tomɛ waa bola dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba la.
N dandɛɛɡa, he jemɛ kɛŋɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ne bene kaɡboŋ bwa beŋkpoŋ Korowii be.
Beŋkpoŋii a bwa o te be.
Korowii aa o nyobaɡa ta too, ɡɛ bane aa dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Korowii biɡri o nyobaɡa waa baɡa ŋɔ ya Dɔɔ Yeesu ɛɛ bao la.
Bambilee o dɔ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ waa nyin kɛ nomɛlbwa chɔɡ ta.
O dɛ nyin kɛ nɛra bwa charɛ ba liire dɛ́ le ba wechɔɡa ta mɔɔ o ba.
Ya Dɔɔ Yeesu bala tɔpere la, wɛɛ piɡruu kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ bala aa dɛ piɡri la ken.
Awola tɔpere la, nyundua ɛɛ jiɡru kikikiki, dɛ́ nyoɡre nɛra siwi ta.
Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa ɛɛ fuuh dɛ́ mwɛɛ, ásɛ harɛ ne kwaa aa lɔ o ta bwa fuh.
Kwaa nɔ bwa aa dɛ ba fuih ken nɔ, dɛ ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ he doɔ?
A chɛ kɛ he do ɡoroŋ he soɡa bini, dɛ́ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii, dɛɛ kpa Korowii Tɔpere La nyundua aa fuh kwaraa ásɛ harɛ ɡe komɛlbwa fuh dɛ́ mwɛɛ kwaraa la.
Hé swɛɛ siwi ásɛ Korowii Tɔpere La ba warane.
Ya dɛ nyiŋi nyoa Korowii aa baɡa la ŋwɛnɛ.
Anee kɛŋɔ wɛɛ ta nyundua onfale ne harɛfalee.
Belaa wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ ba doe.
Anomanta, n dandɛɛɡa, haa dɛ kpa awola tɔpere la, hé swɛɛ siwi kɛŋɔ hɛɛ do ɡoroŋee dɛ bɛ wechɔɡa bɛlbwa dɔ Korowii sie, ásɛ he ne o baah do wer.
Hé nyiŋi Korowii bambile waa lawa nɔ kɛŋɔ ŋwɛnɛɛ o tɛ heyaa kɛŋɔ he charɛ he liire, ásɛ o lɛ heya.
Anee ya dɔŋ Pɔɔl yaa dɛ nyin o waa la fa kpɔ o wejema Korowii aa tɛo la dɛ chwerɛ heyaa la.
Pɔɔl dɛ bol a ɡɛ waa nɔ o tɔne bwa bini.
Ane ta Pɔɔl tɔne waane mun noe kpeɡri taeh.
Anomanta, nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ baa wola cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ la, ba dɛ berɛ waa la sie.
Gɛɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛɛ baɡle Korowii Tɔn bini waa la ane ɡe.
Kɛ ba ɡbaɡba nyu taa ba ɛ dɛɛ dawɛ.
Anomanta, n dandɛɛɡa, haa dɔa na ken nɔ, hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ dɛ bɛ ba ɡel nɛra baa wola Korowii ɔmɛ ba neɡre heyaa he lɔ naa he yarada la ta, dɛ́ ba choɡli.
Kɛ hé swɛɛ siwi ásɛ ya Dɔɔ waa ɛ ya Lɛɛ Yeesu Kristo suna waa sune he nɛɛ dɛɛ cha heyaa la ɛɛ ja kohona.
Hé swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ dɔ wejema o waa ta kohona.
Hé ɡel ya tɛo jirima taraken ne saŋ bɛlbwa.
Aamen.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Dɛ Jɔn ɛ Yeesu toroma la bini bɛl.
O na Yeesu, dɛ na ɡɛ waa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta.
O siwi taa Yeesu baɡle nɛra wa.
O chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ do Kristo tena ɡbemba, ásɛ ba so kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡel ba soɡa bini baɡle kɛ ba dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu webaɡla la ta.
O ŋɔ ya bɛ ɡel nɛra neɡre yaa nyosonwebaɡla ne.
Ba dɛ baɡle kɛ dɛ ya ɛ Korowii nɛra, ya we-ɛɛla wer kɛɛ aa were oo, a ta waane ɛɛ.
Yeesu ɡbaɡba baa ɛ nɛwɛnyini, a chɛ kɛ yá kpɔ o ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔa la ta, dɛ́ so bochaah Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ta, ásɛ dɛɛ nyin dɔŋa.

Ya no o waa dɛ nao.
Ya nyiŋu dɛ kpɔ ya nɔɔra leɡo.

Anomanta, ya dɛ bol o waa he be kɛŋɔ Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ saŋ bɛlbwa mkpa dɛ faa do o Mɛɛ be la, o ba ya be ya jemɔ.
Anɔ la yaa naa dɛ no laanee yaa bol he ɡe be, ásɛ he no dɛ́ ba ja ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua ne o bie Yeesu Kristo beŋkpoŋri ɛɛ la ta.
Ya dɛ nyin kɛ ya bwa bwara sɔɔh yaa kɛrɛdɛ.
A waa ya chwerɛ tɔn nɔ baa tɛ heyaa la.
Korowii chaahnɔ kɛ kandea ken Waa yaa noa le Yeesu be dɛɛ bol he be laanee kɛŋɔ, Korowii do kɛŋɔ kon waa chaahna ken.
Wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole o nɛ.
Anomanta, dɛ ya ŋɔ ya ne o ɛ beŋkpoŋ, kɛ dɛ berɛ dɛɛ ɛ biro bini wa aa, ya teŋe nyosone.
Ya we-ɛɛla dɛ baɡle kɛ ya waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe.
Korowii waa aa chaahna la, dɛ ya dɛ ɛ ya waa bwa a chaah kɛ on aa, dɛ ya ne yabala pɛo dɛ ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Dɛ Korowii Bie Yeesu chal la laa ya wechɔɡa bɛlbwa dɛɛ kpɔ ya nɛ.
Dɛ ya ŋɔ wechɔɡa toole ya nɛ aa, ya dɛ neɡre ya nyuune.
Dɛ yaa kasinteŋ bol.
Dɛ ya bol ya wechɔɡa baɡle Korowii aa, o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ te dɛɛ teŋɛ o nyobaɡa ta.
Wɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛ yaa, dɛ́ laa doŋa bwa kpɔ ya nɛ.
Dɛ ya ŋɔ ya ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ te naa, dɛ ya yerɛ Korowii nyosonteŋni.
O waa la ɡe toole ya bini.
Yeesu waa dɛ cha yaa N bidɛɛɡa, n chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, ásɛ he bɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ ɛ. Kɛ dɛ nomɛlbwa ɡarɔ ɛ wechɔɡa aa, ya dɔ nomɛl o do ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la be, dɛ́ soŋe ya wechɔɡa dɛɛ tɛ yaa.
Onee Yeesu Kristo la.
O Waa Toɡrɔ.
Onee koh ya wechɔɡa waa dɛ sewɛ tɛ yaa dɛ kwaa ya ne Korowii baah.
Ya ɡbo wechɔɡa waa laa o sewɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa jao.
Ya teŋɛ o waa ta naa, anee dɛɛ ba yaa baɡla kɛ ya jemɔ.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa ŋɔ o jemɛ Korowii, dɛ waa o waa ta teŋaa, ɡɛ nɛn la ɛ nyosonteŋni, dɛ kasinteŋ toole o be.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta la, onee dɛɛ nyin Korowii waa kɛrɛdɛ.
Anɔ taa yaa ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ kɛ ya ne Korowii pɛo.
Nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔa o ne Korowii pɛo la, a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ Yeesu Kristo da la.
Yabala, waa nɔ maa dɛ chwerɛ heyaa nɔ ta wefala ɛɛ.
Webena la yaa baɡle heyaa le mumpar la, anee ta.

Bochaah tenten balɔ, asɛ bɔr ɛɛ chaah kɛrɛdɛ.
Yeesu we-ɛɛla ne he ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla baɡle a ɡɛ waa nɔ mun.
Nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔa o lɔ bochaah ta, kɛ dɛ hah o dɔŋ la, naate ta lɔ biro tenten ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin o dɔŋ la do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa lɔ bochaah ta.
Bochaah la nomanta, komɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ɡel ó lɔ nakpala dɛ́ chole.
Nomɛlbwa waa hah o dɔŋ la do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa lɔ biro ta.
O dɛ valɛ, kɛ waa jemɛ bela waa dɛ kaa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ biro la ɡelɔ o nyoŋe.
N bidɛɛɡa, n chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ Korowii koh Yeesu waa dɛ kpɔ he wechɔɡa kɛ heya.
Nomonome, n chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ heyaa jemɛ naate waa lole le mumpar bwa la.
Bonɔɔna, n chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ he ɡe, dɛkalkɛ he pɔ Bɔnsam nɛ.

Bonɔɔna, n chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ heya, dɛkalkɛ he bwaraa kpeɡa, Korowii waa la do he bambile bini.
Heyaa wona pɔ Bɔnsam nɛ.
He bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta He bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ waa aa dɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire sie la, ne harɛ nɔ ta kwaa ta.
Dɛ he sie dɛ lɛ a ɡɛ kwaa la ta naa, dɛ haa he Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la waa nyin.
Bwadabii pɛlchɔɡa kwa, ne anɔ la aa ɛ siwi pɛla kwa, ne waa yaa nyina dɛ kpɔa dɛɛ maŋkura ya te la ɛ harɛ nɔ ta wa.
A ta ya Mɛɛ waa lɔ nyundua la be leɛ.
Harɛ nɔ ne o pɛla kwaa bwa sekwaraa dɔ jaɡa.

Hale taraken o dɔma dɔɔ warɛ dɛ ba.
Anomanta, ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa jaɡa saŋ telo.
Dɛ bane fa ja ya nɛ, kɛ dɛ ba ta denɛ ɛ ya bini bane, dɛkalkɛ ba chwao.
Dɛ ba fe ja ya nɛ aa, ya ne ba fe ta pɛo.
Kɛ ba chwao, asɛ a den baɡle kɛŋɔ ba bini bɛlbwa ta ya nɛɛ jae.

Kasinteŋ bɛ jema waa laa n chwerɛ tɔn nɔ baa tɛ heya.

Amɔ umee ɛ nyosonteŋni ɔ?
Nyosonteŋnii naate waa ŋɔa Yeesu laa Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la.
A ɡɛ nɛn la, onee Yeesu Kristo dɔm tenten.

Hé kpoŋe anɔ la haa noa dɛ le mumpar la bini.

Yabala, taraken ya ɛ Korowii bii.
Yaa jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ ɡɛ yaa dɛ ba doe.

O te, dɛ wechɔɡa toole o nɛ.

Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa aa su Korowii siwi la ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe ɡɛ Yeesu Kristo aa ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe la.
Nomɛlbwa waa teŋa dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la ɛ Bɔnsam nɛn, dɛkalkɛŋɔ harɛ mumpar la bwaa Bɔnsam le dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
A waa Korowii Bie la koh ba harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ba chɔɡ Bɔnsam toma bwa.

Bɔkwaa ɡela o kpoo wɔ?
O we-ɛɛla waa ɛa la aa wola were asɛ o nime kwaa do wer la, anee ɡela o kpoo.
Yabala, dɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire hah heya aa, he bɛ ɡel a ɛ heyaa nyokpoa.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya le seo nɔn ta dɛ ba dɔ mkpa, dɛkalkɛ ya dɛ nyin dɔŋa.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola o dɔŋ nyin la ta lɔ seo nɔn ta.
Nomɛlbwa waa hah o dɔŋ la do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ kpoo nɛra ken.
He jemɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa dɛ kpoo nɛra la ta Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la dɔe.
Gɛ Yeesu Kristo aa koh ya waa dɛ kpɔ o te tɛ dɛ sewɛ la, a taa ya che dɛ jemɛ ɡɛ nyina aa doa.

N bidɛɛɡa, he bɛ ɡel ya kpɔ wobol ne nyotor berɛ dɔŋa nyina.

Anɔ taa yaa ba wona jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya cheɡɔ tɛ kasinteŋ la.
Anɔ taa yaa ba bambisɔɔhna dɔe Korowii sie.
Dɛ ya liire pa yaa bolchɔɡe aa, Korowii ɡwaa ya liire dɛ jemɛ komɛlbwa.
Anomanta, yabala, dɛ ya liire aa yaa bolchɔɡe pa te naa, amɔ ya dɔ bambile dɛ che Korowii sie, yaa wola ɔmɛ.
Komɛlbwa yaa soŋo la, o dɛ tɛ yaa, dɛkalkɛ ya dɛ no o waa dɛɛ ɛ anɔ la aa dɛ su o siwi.
Waa Korowii aa dɛ ŋɔ ya be laanee kɛŋɔ, yá yarada o Bie Yeesu Kristo la, dɛ́ɛ nyin dɔŋa ɡɛ waa ŋɔ ya be la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no Korowii waa la, o kpɔ o te dɛɛ pɛl Korowii, asɛ o ɡe lawɔ dɛɛ pɛl o nɛ.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ɡelɔ ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
Nɛra domare pesea dɛ́ na Yabala, he bɛ nɛra baa ŋɔa ba dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la, dɛ che o ta dɛɛ baɡle waa la dɛɛ yarada warawara.
Hé pese ba, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ kpeɡri baa dɔa la le Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la be kɛɛ?
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ neɡre nɛra kɛŋɔ ba ɛ Korowii keamere ba harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa pirim.
Ŋwɛnɛ nɔ taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ́ jemɛ nɛra baa dɔ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ baɡle Yeesu waa ɛ Kristo Korowii aa tomɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la waa kɛŋɔ o baa ɛ nɛwɛnyini la, o dɔ Domadɛɛɡe waa le Korowii be la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tɔŋle Yeesu nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ la ta Domadɛɛɡe la dɔe le Korowii be.

Kenii o baɡle o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa.
O ɡelɔ o bibeŋkpoŋ la ba harɛ nɔ ta, ásɛ ya che o nɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.
Anɔɔ dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ nyina tenten aa doa.

Nomɛlbwa ta Korowii nae ka.
Kɛ dɛ ya dɛ nyin dɔŋa aa, anee Korowii ɛɛ ba yaa lawɛ pɛl o nɛ, ásɛ o nyina la do ya be kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la waa kpɔa tɛ yaa la ɡelɔ ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ kpela, yá kpɔ ya te pɛlo, ásɛ o ɡe lawɛ yaa pɛl o nɛ.
Ya na o Bie la dɛ di danseɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii ɡela o ba harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ba ɛ nɛwɛnyini Lɛɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa yarada Yeesu kɛŋɔ Korowii Biee on la, dɛ naate kpɔ o te pɛl Korowii, asɛ o ɡe lawɔ pɛl o te.
Anomanta, ya ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ nyin yaa, dɛ kpɔ siwi dawɛ o nyina la nɛ.
Korowiirii nyina bwa Dɔɔ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin nɛn la, o kpɔ o te dɛɛ pɛl Korowii, asɛ o lawɔ dɛɛ pɛl o nɛ.
Waa lawɛ yaa pɛl o nɛɛ la, a taa a che nyina la do ya nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ ka tonɛ, asɛ ya dɔ hwɛɡa awola Yeesu aa ba, dɛ́ ba bol nɛndɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole la.
Yaa Yeesu bala waa ɔmɛ, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ o da aa doa la, ɡɛ tentenee ya ɡe do nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire bini.

Ya dɛ nyin dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii tɔ sie nyin yaa.

Waa Yeesu Kristo aa kpɔa tɛ yaa laanee nɔ.

Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ Korowii bie la yaradae Nomɛlbwa waa yaradaa kɛŋɔ Yeesu ɛ Kristo la Korowii aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ wɛɛ tomɔɔ la, naate ɛ Korowii bie, dɛkalkɛ dɛ he dɛ nyin nomɛl waa aa, dɛ he dɛ nyin o bie ɡe wa.
Dɛ ya dɛ nyin Korowii dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa ta naa, a taa ya jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya dɛ nyin o bii.
Dɛ ya dɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa kpɔa tɛ yaa ta naa, anee dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ ya dɛ nyinu.
O waa la ta teŋa ɡe aa kpeɡe kohona tɛ yaa, dɛkalkɛ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ Korowii bie la won harɛ nɔ ta liire ne o komɛlbwa nɛɛ pɔe.
Ya cheɡɛ yarada yaa dɛ yarada Yeesu la ta dɛ pɔ a nɛ.
Umee dɛ́ won pɔ harɛ nɔ ta liire ne o komɛlbwa nɛɔ?
Nomɛlbwa toole, atane kɛŋɔ naate waa dɛ yarada kɛ Yeesu ɛ Korowii Bie la ɡbosoroo.
Yeesu Kristo aa bala dɛ ba ɛ o toma la, nee ne chal taa o che dɛ ba.
Korowii nee sɔe la ɡbo ta laa o toma la che.
Kɛ o chal waa fuɡa ta la ne Korowii nee sɔe la bwa taa a che.
Asɛ Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ɡee di danseɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ɛ kasinteŋ te.
Kombele atoroo di danseɛ dɛɛ tɛ Yeesu.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la, ne Korowii nee baa sɔɔ la, ne o chal waa fuɡa ta la bwaa di danseɛ dɛɛ tɛo dɛɛ baɡle wesiwi beŋkpoŋ.
Dɛ ya dɛ yarada nɛwɛnyini danseɛ aa, amɔ yaa Korowii kwaa yarada aa?
O kwaa laanee kpeɡa ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini kwa.
Korowii ɡbaɡbaa kpɔ waa nɔ di o Bie danseɛ.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa waa yarada Korowii Bie la, naate dɔ ɡɛ danseɛ nɔ o ɡbabir bambile bini, dɛ won jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ɛ kpela.
Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa wola Korowii yarada la ɡelɔ Korowii waa la ɛ nyosone, dɛkalkɛŋɔ naate aa ɡɛ Korowii aa bol o Bie la waa la yarada.
Waa Korowii aa bola a ɛ danseɛ laanee nɔ.

Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te pɛl Korowii Bie la dɔ a ɡɛ mkpa nɔ.
Nomɛlbwa waa wola o te kpɔe pɛl Korowii Bie la ta mkpa la dɔe.
Mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe N chwerɛ waa nɔ baa tɛ he banɔ la haa dɛ yarada Korowii Bie la, ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ he dɔ Korowii mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe la.
Ya dɔ hwɛɡa Korowii be kɛŋɔ wobɛlbwa yaa soŋo la, dɛ a ɛ o tetoowa aa, wɛɛ no ya bee.
Dɛ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ no ya be kwaa yaa dɛ soŋo la te naa, amɔ te dɛ ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya dɔɔ dɔ kwaa yaa dɛ soŋe o be la.

Wɛɛ tɛo mkpaa.

Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ ya bwa ɛ Korowii bii, asɛ nɛra baa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡbo liire, ne kwaa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ɡe do Bɔnsam lɔɡa.

O ɛ Korowii tenten, dɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa.
N bidɛɛɡa, hé nyiŋi he te kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ laa he te kpɔ komɛlbwa waa wola Korowii tenten ɛɛ la ta.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Jɔn chwerɛ a ɡɛ tɔn nɔ ka tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ bobɛl.

N ɡbo laa dɛɛ nyin ba ɡɛ.
