Ya dɛ na ya daamanar bwa.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Jud chwerɛ tɔn nɔ dɛɛ do Kristo tena ɡbemba ŋɔ, bá che kiŋkiŋ Korowii kasinteŋ webaɡla aa dɛ baɡle Korowii suna waa sune nɛwɛnyina nɛɛ la ta.
Dɛ ba bɛ banɔ la baa vɛh Yeesu Kristo waa ne o webaɡla dɛɛ baɡle wefala la be no, hale ba ŋɔ ba dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta kwaraa noo.
Tɔn nɔ le men Jud maa ɛ Yeesu Kristo bonɔɔ dɛ ɛ Jems nime la be.
N chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ he nɛra N Naa Korowii waa bera ɛ ya Mɛɛ la aa dɛ nyin heya, dɛ le heyaa tɛ o te, asɛ Yeesu Kristo ɡee nyin heyaa la.
Kórowii na he sum kohona, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna kohona, dɛ́ cha heyaa hɛɛ nyin dɔŋa kohona.
Nyosonteŋna baa dɛ chaɡle Korowii wa N dandɛɛɡa, n siwi fe swɛɛrɔ mɛɛ nyin kɛ ń chwerɛ heyaa tɔn dɛ baɡle lɛɛ Yeesu aa lɛ n ne he bwa la wa, asɛ n berɛ na kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ ń chwerɛ heyaa buɡ nɔ ta dɛ́ do heyaa ɡbemba, ásɛ hɛɛ yo waa yaa dɛ yarada la wa.
Korowiirii fa baɡle o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɡɛ baa dɛɛ tomɔ.
Gɛ waa baɡ ba la aa berɛ bwa.
Nɛra bane sɔɔh dɛ ba koo he baah haa wola jemɛ.
Baa Korowii tomɛ, dɛɛ bol ŋɔ nɛra ɛɛ wonoo dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii dɛ sune nɛra nɛ.
Ba dɛ ɛ ɡɛ ásɛ dɛ fe dɔ bɔr che dɛ́ɛ ɛ wedoŋa baa dɛ nyin.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ vɛh ya Nomoa beŋkpoŋ Yeesu Kristo waa dɔ yaa la kɛŋɔ ba Dɔɔree on.
Saŋ la bwaa Korowii Tɔn baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa pa ba bolchɔɡe dɛɛ ba ba deŋne tɛra.
N jemɔ kɛŋɔ he jemɔ, kɛ n dɛ nyin kɛ n lii heyaa ɡɛ Korowii fa aa lɛ Israel tena le Ijipt tena nɔn ta, asɛ a habɔɔ bane aa wola o waa yaradae, o kpoo ba la.
Nyundua toroma ɡe aa wola ɡelɛ bela Korowii aa tɛɛ ba ŋɔ bá di kpeɡri maɡre ba ne, dɛ́ le ba dobɔr la, ó tɔ ba do biro ta, dɛ́ do ba jɔɡrɔre waa wola ban foo ta bwa, dɛ́ ka tel kɛŋɔ o tɔpejen waa dɛ ba nɛra waa bola dɛ́ pa bole la.
Gɛɛ Sodom ne Gomoora tena ne bwɛɛre a fa aa lɔ ba jwɛɛh la tena, ɡe fa aa chɔ dɔŋa baa ne haah ŋwɛnɛdoŋ ta, aa wola were ne bola, dɛɛ chɔɡ ba te.
Baa ɛ ɡɛ la, Korowii ɡelɔ nii le ba nɛ, ásɛ nɛra bwa na dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ tɛr wechɔɡ-ɛɛ deŋne nii aa wola dime bwa ne.
Gɛ a saŋ la tena fa aa ɛa Korowii hah ba la, ɡɛɛ nɛnchɔɡa baa lɔ he baah nɔ che ba deera baa dɛ dee ta, dɛɛ ɛ wedoŋa ba bwadabii ne, dɛ vɛh Korowii ɔma, dɛɛ ɛ nyundua toroma nɛnhɛlwa.
Nyundua toroma bwa nomoa Maekel ɡba ta a dɔŋa ɛɛ bwa.
O ne Bɔnsam aa dɛ yo dɛɛ tɔŋle dɔŋa Mosis lale waa dɛ́ jemɛ ba bini onɔ la waa dɔɔ la, Maekel kwaraa ta liire kɛ ó bol Bɔnsam wobochɔɡe.
O waa waa bola bwaa kɛŋɔ, “Korowiirii dɛ́ dii kasinteŋ.” Waa nɛra nɔ aa wola a mun jemɛ la, wobochɔɡaa ba bol dɛɛ yaɡa.
Ba ne ola bwa beŋkpoŋ, dɛkalkɛ ola ta liire dɔe.
Waa aa ɛ á bwara sɔɔhna la, anee aa ɛ. Gɛɛ ba ɡe do.
An ɡee dɛɛ chɔɡ ba.
Bá bwɛɛlɛ!
Ba teŋɛ Keen ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe la ta.
Ba koh suuɡanyin waa dɛ kpɔ ba te jo wechɔɡa Balam fa aa ɛa la ta.
Ba dɛ vuuɡi Korowii kɛŋɔ Kora fa aa dɛ ɛ la.
Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ baa kɛŋɔ waa chɔɡ Kora la ken.
He yon cheme dɛ pɛ dɛɛ di kondikwaa aa dɛ baɡle beŋkpoŋri ɛɛ haa dɔa he Dɔɔ tom nɔ ta la, a ɡɛ nɛra la lɔ he baah kɛŋɔ doŋa dɛɛ chɔɡ he wer.
Ba ta sihiih dɔe.
Ba ɡbo waa baa dawɛ, baa nɛra waa dawɛ.
Ba waa ta hwɛɡa dɔe kɛŋɔ baama peu aa dɛ kaa a ne aa wola bwaala nee ne ba la.
Ba do kɛŋɔ daa aa wola won a nɔna saŋ nɔnɛ, asɛ ba chuɡra ta a den serewe kwaraa la.
Ba do kɛ mpo nehɛma a nyoa aa kpeɡa kohona ken.
Gɛ a yon dɛɛ vuuɡi, a fufuɡ doŋa ɛɛ le baŋ la, ɡɛɛ baa vuuɡi wa, ásɛ ba sihihwa ɛɛ le baŋ.
Ba do kɛ weweela aa wola chebɔr beŋkpoŋ dɔe, baa wola hwɛɡa kpɔe dɛɛ do a nɛɛ dɛɛ valɛ jwaana la.
Biro kpirikpirii Korowii kwaa ba cheɡ bá ka do bela saŋ bɛlbwa.
Adam natɛɛ ɡe naa Enɔk fa na ba waa dɛ bol ba waa ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ ɛɛ ba o nyundua toromedɛɛɡa kaɡboŋa nee, dɛ́ ba bol nɛra bwa waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Wɛɛ pa ba bolchɔɡe ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa dɛ vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa la waa, dɛ́ pa nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ bolchɔɡe ba nɛnhɛlwobochɔɡa baa bola dɛɛ yaɡɔ la wa.” Gɛ nɛra nɔ, saŋ bɛlbwaa baa naɡre wa, wa aa ba siwi su.
Wedoŋa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a ta laanee baa ɛ. Ba dɛ ta nyoa.
Kwaane dɔe dɛ le nɛra be waa baa bol nɛra wedɛɛɡe.
Wejaala ne webaɡla N dandɛɛɡa, hɛ́ɛ lii waa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo toroma la fa aa bol he be la.
Ba ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, “Tɔpera aa ka mun la ta la, nɛra ɛɛ leo dɛɛ mamɛ heya.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ aa Korowii ɔmɛ.
Wedoŋa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ a taa baa ɛ.” A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ ɡela he ne he asɔre tena dɔŋa baah ɛɛ peɡri la.
Harɛ bonɔ som lɛ ba liire bwa.
Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la toole ba nɛɛ kwaraa.
N dandɛɛɡa, hé te swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ɛ cha dɔŋa dɛ́ won che kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ he yarada haa dɔa Yeesu Kristo ŋwɛnɛɡoroŋ nɔ ta la do kan kohona.
Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii o Domadɛɛɡe la kpeɡri ne.
Korowii dɛ nyin heya, anomanta, hɛ́ɛ pɛlo, dɛ́ɛ kpa ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo waa dɛ sune nɛra nɛɛ la, ásɛ o tɛ heyaa mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.
Hɛ́ɛ sune nɛra baa dɛ ɛ aahna-aahna Yeesu Kristo waa nɔ ta baa wola an yarada kɛrɛdɛ la nɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ba wechɔɡa ta joe kɛŋɔ baa dɛ to kon dɛ́ le nii ta la.
Hɛ́ɛ sune bane ɡe nɛɛ dɛ́ɛ cha ba, kɛ hɛ́ɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ ásɛ ba wechɔɡa bɛ heyaa ba bu.
Korowii kpɛɛra Korowii waa wona dɔ kpeɡri dɛ lawɛ heyaa haa wola chole, dɛ laa he doŋa bwa kpɔ he nɛ, dɛ ɡel he dɔ silɛɛ dɛ che o sie dɛ na o jirima la, o ɡboo Korowii ne ya Lɛɛ, ya Dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo nomanta.
O chɛ jirima.
O dɔŋ toole.
Onee dɔ komɛlbwa kpeɡri, dɛ ɛ komɛlbwa Dɔɔ dɛ le saŋ la bwa ba le fini, dɛ dɔ a bwa saŋ bɛlbwa!
Aamen.
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla Jɔn chwerɛ waa Korowii aa pila baɡlo chaahna ta la bil, ɡɛ saŋ waa lɔ Patmɔs.
O baɡlɔ ŋɔ Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ Yeesu Kristo nɛɛ dɛ́ pɔ o dɔma bwa nɛ, hale Bɔnsam ɡe aa a ta lee ba.
Korowii nɛra ɛɛ dɔ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe bwa waa kwaara cheɡ ba laanee.
Nyundufale ne harɛfale bela Korowii aa lole saŋ te bɛlbwa la, bonyɛɡa bɛlbwa ɡe toole bela.
Harɛre nɛra bwa baa dɛ bol wobol te bɛlbwa harɛ nɔ ta bwa ɛɛ ba ja nɛndamanta nɛɛ, baa tomɛ Korowii bela.
A ɡɛ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ nɔ dɛ do yaa ɡbemba, dɛ ɡel yaa yarada Korowii, dɛ́ di kasinteŋ dɛɛ tɛo wekpeɡa bɛlbwa ta.
Waa nɔ aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔ, Korowiirii kpɔa baɡle Yeesu Kristo, ásɛ o kpɔ baɡle o bonɔɔna ne toli bá won jemɛ wa aa dɛ ba ɛɛ taraken.
Yeesu Kristo ɡelɔ nyundua torome bɛl ba o bonɔɔ Jɔn be dɛ ba baɡlo a wa.
Jɔn baɡle waa waa naa bwa.
Korowii waa ne Yeesu Kristo webaɡla ne waa waa naa dɛ no bwaa o chwerɛ.
Naate waa kure tɔn nɔ bini wa, dɛ baɡle wa aa dɛ ba chiɡa nɛra no la, o na som.
Banɔ la ɡe baa no waa baa kure la, dɛ́ ɛ waa waa baɡla la, ba ɡba na som.
Tɔpere waa kaa ásɛ waa nɔ bwa chiɡ la aa kanɛ kpa.
Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Eesia asɔrere anuanɛ Men Jɔnee chwerɛ waa nɔ dɛɛ tɛ asɔrere bele anuanɛ aa lɔ Eesia harɛ ta la.
Korowii waa lole saŋ la dɛ ba le fini, dɛɛ ba le doe saŋ bɛlbwa la, o ne o Domare anuanɛ aa lɔ o kookara mun la, ne Yeesu Kristo waa ɛ kasinteŋ te dɛ che tɛ Korowii, dɛ sewɛ, dɛ tɔ nɛra bwa sie ir seo ta, dɛ ɛ koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa nomoa la, ó cha heya, dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
Hɛ́ɛ tɛ naate waa dɛ nyin yaa, dɛ sewɛ, dɛ kpɔ o chal lɛ yaa, a le yaa wechɔɡa ta la sɔn.
O ɡelɔ ya bwa ɛ o Kora ta nɛra, dɛ ɛ sɔfore dɛɛ tomɛ o Mɛɛ Korowii.
Anomanta, hé tɛo sɔn.
Onee dɔ kpeɡri saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Aamen.
Hɛ́ɛ no!
Wɛɛ bao.
Baama taa o che dɛɛ ba bala.
Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ na o balaa.
Nɛra ba fa aa yaɡɔ dɛ kpoo la, ba ɡba ɛɛ nao.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa ɛɛ nao, dɛ́ koh o bala waa dɛ ba la waa dɛ́ wi.
Aa ba ɡɛɛ.
Aamen.
Nemenɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ dɛ do le saŋ la dɛ ba le fini, dɛɛ ba le doe saŋ bɛlbwa la, o ŋɔ, “Menee komɛlbwa Mumpar ne a Jaɡa.” Jɔn wepila ane waa naa Menee Jɔn maa ɛ he dɔŋ, dɛ koh pɛɛ ya bwa ne Yeesu Kristo aa pɛa la waa dɛɛ na wahala, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii o Kora ta, dɛɛ lawɛ bambile wobɛlbwa ta la.
N lɔ ekwi harɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Patmɔs la ta, bela baa koah kɛŋɔ n bol Korowii Waa dɛ ɛ Yeesu danseɛ dɛ laɡ mɛ ka ta la.
Awola bɛl, ya Dɔɔ Tɔpere ta, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ir n nɛ, n no takpeɡ bɛl n habɔɔ kɛŋɔ bɛla aa dɛ si ken.
O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ haa dɛ ba nae nɔ, chwera do tɔn bini, dɛ́ kpɔ ka tɛ asɔrere anuanɛ aa lɔ Ɛfesos ne Smɛɛna ne Pɛɛɡamɔm ne Tiatra ne Saades ne Feladɛlfea dɛ Laodisia la.” Belaa n ke nyiŋi kɛ mɛɛ na naate waa bol waa n be laanee, asɛ dɛ na suuɡaswɛm kandea daa anuanɛ, dɛ na komɛl kɛŋɔ nɛn ken, o do batakaarejaŋ o tel o napaala ta, dɛ vɔwɛ suuɡaswɛm kiriso o bambile ta, dɛ do suuɡaswɛm kandea daa la baah ta.
O nyumpona too kpelkpel kɛŋɔ yabi, o sibie ɡe ɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ ninlao ken.
O nakpale ɡe swɛɛrɔ kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ ayaawa do nii ta wɛɛ nyɛɡle la.
Asɛ o taa ɡe do kɛŋɔ chuubu aa dɛ si la.
O kpoŋe weweela anuanɛ o nɔndiɡ ta, asɛ tokobijen sie anɛ te waa nyɛɡa ɛɛ le o nyoa.
O siebɔr ɡe dɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ wee aa dɛ lɔ kpeɡri nɛɛ la.
Maa nao la, n cholo chɔ o sie kɛŋɔ serewe ken.
O kpɔ o nɔndiɡ dawɛ n nɛ, dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɔmɛ.
Menee komɛlbwa Sitɔɔ ne a Muŋkaa bwa.
Men lole saŋ bɛlbwa la.
N fa sewɔ, kɛ taraken n iro, maa wola sewɛ saŋ bɛlbwa kpa, dɛ dɔ seo ne Lalabwɛɛ safoone.
Chwerɛ waa haa naa nɔ, ne anɔ la aa lole taraken, ne anɔ la aa dɛ ba bala anɔ nɔ habɔɔ.
Weweela anuanɛ haa naa a do n nɔndiɡ ta la, ne suuɡaswɛm kandea daa anuanɛ la, n dɛ baɡle a mun dɛ tɛɛ.
Weweela anuanɛ la ɛ nyundua toroma baa cheɡa tɛ asɔrere bele anuanɛ aa lɔ bwɛɛre anuanɛ la ta la.
Kandea daa anuanɛ la ɡe cheɡɔ tɛ asɔrere anuanɛ la.”
Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Ɛfesos asɔre tena “Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Ɛfesos la be.
Kenii men maa kpoŋe weweela anuanɛ n nɔndiɡ ta, dɛɛ valɛ suuɡaswɛm kandea daa anuanɛ baah la ŋɔ, N jemɛ he toma haa ɛa, ne he koeh, ne he bambile haa lawa, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ haa nɛnchɔɡa waa nyin.
He fa kari nɛra ba fa aa dɛ yerɛ ba te n toroma la, dɛ na kɛŋɔ ba ta n toroma ɛɛ, dɛ na kɛŋɔ ba ɛ nyosonteŋna.
He lawɛ bambile dɛ koh n waa dɛ na wahala, kɛ dɛ ta lawɛ a bini.
Kɛ he webeŋkpoŋ maa dɔa laanee kɛŋɔ, nyina he fa aa dɛ nyin mɛ loɡla la ta ɡɛ doe kpa.
Anomanta, hɛ́ɛ lii ɡɛ he fa aa doa wubwa la, dɛ́ charɛ he liire, dɛ́ berɛ ka kpɔ he loɡla we-ɛɛla la ja.
Gɛ laa aa, mɛɛ ba he bee dɛ́ ba laa he kandea daa la kpɔ le o buɡ ta.
Kɛ Nikolai tena we-ɛɛla la haa haah la te, he ɛ wa.
Gɛɛ n ɡba hah ba we-ɛɛla.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.
Naate waa won yo le la, mɛɛ ɡeloo ó di mkpa daa la waa lɔ Korowii Eden bodɛɛɡe la ta nɔna.” Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Smɛɛna asɔre tena Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Smɛɛna la be.
“Kenii men maa ɛ komɛlbwa Sitɔɔ ne a Muŋkaa, dɛ sewɛ, dɛ ir la ŋɔ, N jemɛ he wahala ne he nyae wa, kɛ he ɛ dɔɔhna taeh.
N jemɛ wechɔɡa nɛra baa dɛ yerɛ ba te Juu tena kɛ dɛ ɛ Bɔnsam habɔteŋra la aa bola dawɛ he nɛ.
He bɛ wahala bɛlbwa haa ba na la ɔmɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ no!
Bɔnsam ɛɛ ɡeloo bá larawe he bane do dea, dɛ́ daah heyaa na.
Hɛɛ na wahalaa kohona tɔpera fi.
Dɛ seo bini kwara, he cheɡɛ kiŋkiŋ naa, mɛɛ tɛ heyaa mkpaa o ɛ kompoŋ haa yoa dɛ lɛ ba vɔwɛ heya.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.
Naate waa won yo le la, seo nɛɛte la aa won ɛo wobɛlbwa.” Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Pɛɛɡamɔm asɔre tena Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Pɛɛɡamɔm la be.
“Kenii men maa dɔ tokobijen o sie aa ɛ anɛ dɛ do nyɛɡre la ŋɔ, N jemɛ bela haa soɡa.
Bɔnsam soŋnibɔree he do la, kɛ dɛ ta che kiŋkiŋ.
Hale ɡɛ saŋ ba fa aa kpo Antipas waa ɛ kasinteŋ te dɛ che tɛ mɛ he bwɛjen Bɔnsam soŋnibɔr bela la, he ta tɔeh kɛŋɔ haa men yarada.
Kɛ n dɔ he waane tama.
Bane lɔ he bini dɛɛ teŋɛ Balam webaɡla ta.
Onee fa ɡela Balak neɡre Israel tena ba ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ di ola baa kpoa tɛ voɡa, dɛ kaa bɔ jwamane la.
Nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Nikolai tena webaɡla ta ɡba lɔ he bini.
Anomanta, hé charɛ he liire, dɛ́ le he wechɔɡa ta.
Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, mɛɛ ba he be waranee, dɛ́ ba kpɔ tokobii la waa lɔ n nyoa la, dɛ́ yo he banɔ la haa dɛ teŋɛ Nikolai tena webaɡla la ta la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.
Naate waa won yo le la, mɛɛ tɛo kondikwaa ane soo siwi baa dɛ yera maana nomɛlbwa aa wola an nae bwaa ó di, dɛ́ tɛo bwedɛɛɡe ompoŋ bɛl maa chwerɛ sɔnfale bɛl dawɛ o ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola sɔn la jemɛ, nemenɛ naate maa kpɔ tɛo la ɡbo.” Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Tiatra asɔre tena Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Tiatra la be.
“Kenii men maa ɛ Korowii Bie, dɛ dɔ sibie a do kɛŋɔ ninlao, dɛ dɔ nakpale kɛŋɔ ayaawa la ŋɔ, N jemɛ he we-ɛɛla ne he nɛnnyin wa, ne he Korowii yaradae, ne chae haa dɛ cha dɔŋa, ne he bambile haa dɛ lawɛ wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ he taraken we-ɛɛla wer ɡwaa he loɡla kwaa la.
Kɛ n dɔ he waane dɛ́ bol.
Hanchɔɡe Jɛsɛbɛl la waa dɛ yerɛ o te Korowii keame la, he ɡelɔ o do he be dɛɛ baɡle heya, dɛɛ neɡre n bonɔɔna ne n toli baa bɔ jwamane, dɛɛ di ola baa kpoora dɛɛ tɛ voɡa.
N tɛo tɔpere ŋɔ ó ɡel ɡɛ, ásɛ dɛ charɛ o liire le o wechɔɡa ta, kɛ waa no.
Hɛ́ɛ no!
Mɛɛ do o ne nɛra o ne baa dɛ bɔ jwamane la weelaa bá chɔ, a noo ba kɛrɛdɛ.
Dɛ ba ta ɡelɛ dɛ charɛ ba liire le ba wechɔɡa ta, dɛ ɡel ba tonchɔɡa la aa, ba bwa ɛɛ na wahalaa.
Mɛɛ kpoo o habɔteŋraa, ásɛ asɔre tena bwa jemɛ kɛŋɔ menee jemɛ nɛwɛnyini nyu bini ne ba weliira bwa.
Mɛɛ bɔ he bɛlbwa kemee ɡɛ o we-ɛɛla aa doa.
Kɛ he Tiatra tena haa kaa, haa wola wechɔɡa waa baɡla la ta teŋɛ, haa wola Bɔnsam we-ɛɛla baa dɛ yera wesɔɔhla la jemɛ la, maa wekpeɡa ane bɛlbwaa kpɔ dawɛ he nɛ.
Kɛ waa la haa lawɛ a bini kɛrɛdɛ la, hé den lawɛ a bini ɡɛ ń ba.
Naate waa won yo le, dɛ́ won ɛ n toma ɡwɛeeh dɛ́ ka tel a tona bini la, mɛɛ tɛo kpeɡrii ó di harɛ nɔ ta nɛra nɛ.
‘Wɛɛ kpɔ kpeɡrii dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ́ lɔɔ ba, dɛ́ chɔɡ ba kɛŋɔ baa paɡre vii la.’ N Mɛɛ tɛ mɛ ɡɛ kpeɡri nɔ.
N ɡe ɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛ naate la ɡɛ tenten, dɛ́ tɛo chɔmbibi wewee la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.”
Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Saades asɔre tena Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Saades la be.
“Men maa dɔ Korowii Domare anuanɛ ne weweela anuanɛ la ŋɔ, N jemɛ he we-ɛɛla.
Nɛra jemɔ kɛŋɔ he soɡe le bokpeɡa ta, kɛ he sewɔ.
He kpeɡri haa dɔa dɛɛ teŋɛ n nɛɛ la nyoa dɛ sɔɔh.
Anomanta, hé ir nyu ne dɛ́ kwaa a ɡɛ waa a nyoa aa dɛ sɔɔh la, á won che kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n ta he we-ɛɛla bɛlbwa nae a do wer dɛ toɡre n Mɛɛ Korowii be.
Hɛ́ɛ lii ɡɛ ba fa aa baɡle heyaa ne waa haa noa la, dɛ́ lawɛ a bini, dɛ́ charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa ta.
Dɛ he ta nyu ne iraa, mɛɛ piɡri heyaa kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ ken, haa wola jemɛ ɡɛ saŋ maa ba he be.
He ta dɔ nɛra tama baa wola ɡelɛ a do kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa doŋa do ba nɛ.
Mɛɛ tɛɛ ba yapoŋaa bá tɔ, n ne ba valɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba chɛ ɡɛ.
Naate waa won yo le la, mɛɛ tɔɔ yapoŋee kɛ ban.
Maa o sɔnee fee le Mkpa Tɔn la bini bwa.
Mɛɛ bol o waa n Mɛɛ ne o nyundua toroma la bee, kɛŋɔ n nɛnee on.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.” Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Feladɛlfea asɔre tena Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Feladɛlfea la be.
“Kenii men maa do kaih, dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ te, dɛ dɔ Devid safoa, dɛ o pili komɛl nomɛlbwa aa wola won tɔɔ, dɛ o tɔ komɛl ɡe aa, nomɛlbwa aa wola won pilu la ŋɔ, N jemɛ he we-ɛɛla.
Hɛ́ɛ no!
N pili ŋwɛnɛ tɛ heya, nomɛlbwa aa won tɔɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ he kpeɡri aa kanɛ.
Kɛ he wono dɛɛ teŋɛ n webaɡla ta.
He ta tɔeh kɛ n ne he laa.
He ta n nɛɛ teŋa ɡelɛ.
Hɛ́ɛ no!
Bɔnsam habɔteŋra baa dɛ teŋe nyosone, baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛɛ yerɛ ba te Juu tena la, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá ba ɡuŋi he sie, dɛ́ jemɛ kɛŋɔ n dɛ nyin heya.
Haa noa tɛ mɛ, dɛ lawɛ bambile dɛ na wahala nomanta, mɛɛ lɛ heyaa le wahala aa dɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛɛ dɛ́ ba daah ba la ta.
N dɛ ba taraken.
Hé lawɛ waa haa jema la bini kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ dɛ bɛ ɡel nomɛlbwa won neɡre heyaa he paŋɛ kompoŋ baa dɛ ba heyaa vɔwa he yoi dɛ le ta la.
Naate waa won yo le la, mɛɛ ɡeloo ó ɛ kɛŋɔ pila n Mɛɛ Korowii Dea bini, waa wola belaa le kpa bwa.
Mɛɛ chwerɛ n Mɛɛ Korowii sɔn ne o bwɛjen Jerusalam sɔnee dawɛ o nɛ.
Jerusalamfale waa dɛ ba n Mɛɛ Korowii be nyundua lee dɛ́ ba he be la sɔnee mɛɛ ba chwera dawɛ o nɛ, dɛ́ berɛ chwerɛ n sɔnfale dawɛ o nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.” Tɔn Jɔn aa chwera ka tɛ Laodisia asɔre tena Tɔn nɔ dɛ kaa nyundua torome waa cheɡa tɛ asɔre tena baa lɔ Laodisia la be.
“Kenii men maa ɛ Aamen, dɛ che tɛ Korowii, n waa dɔ kasinteŋ, Korowii che n nɛɛ ta komɛlbwa la ŋɔ, N jemɛ he we-ɛɛla.
Haa wɔbɛ, haa sɔnɛ ɡe.
Dɛ wɔrɔbe kɛɛ sɔnee he den do aa, a fe bɔ.
Kɛ haa do ywɛlɛywɛlɛ haa wola wɔbɛ, haa wola sɔnɛ ɡe la, mɛɛ poo heyaa ta.
He ŋɔ he dɔ kwa, dɛ ɛ dɔɔhna, komɛlbwa ta heyaa nyae.
Kɛ haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he waa dɔ sinyana, dɛ do sum.
He ɛ nyaara, dɛ nyoŋe, dɛ che mumɡbal.
Hé ɡel n ŋɔ he be.
A wer kɛ hé yawɛ suuɡaswɛm maa kpɔ nii laa o doŋa bwa kpɔ o ta la, ásɛ dɛ dɔ kwa, dɛ́ yawɛ yapoŋa n be dɛ́ tɔ, ásɛ dɛ laa sihiih kpɔ he nɛɛ he mumɡbal cheɡa ta.
Hé ba yawɛ tɛɛɡa ɡe n be, dɛ́ ka do he sibie ta dɛ́ won dɛɛ na.
Nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba la, n dɛ ja ba, dɛɛ tɛr ba deŋne.
Anomanta, hé swɛɛ siwi dɛ́ charɛ he liire le he wechɔɡa ta.
Hɛ́ɛ no!
N cheɡɛ doonyoa dɛɛ lɔ ɡbera.
Naate waa no n taa dɛ́ ba yaa mɛ la, mɛɛ jo o bee, n ne o pɛ nɔn di kwa.
Naate waa won yo le la, mɛɛ ɡeloo n ne o ka so n kookara ta, ɡɛ n fa aa yoa le dɛ ka so n Mɛɛ be o kookara ta la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋne la, ó no waa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la aa dɛ bol asɔre tena be la.”
Kookara waa lɔ Korowii be nyundua Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, n nao kɛŋɔ doonyoa bɛl pilo ta Korowii bwɛɛ la ta, dɛ no taa bɛl n fa aa noo kɛŋɔ bɛla la.
Taa la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Teeh ba bonɔ ń baɡle waa aa dɛ ba ɛɛ anɔ nɔ habɔɔ.” Buɡ la ta, Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la den ir n nɛ, asɛ n na kɛŋɔ kookara bɛl cheɡɛ nyundua, nomɛl so o ta.
Naate waa soɡe o ta la dɛ nyɛɡle al-al kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡa answɛɛma aa dɛ nyɛɡle.
Dɛ bwaala deŋɡare bɛl bar o kookara la, dɛ do kɛŋɔ bwelwɛɛne ane aa dɛ nyɛɡle.
N na kookane fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ a bar o kookara la cheme.
Nomonome fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ do laalapoŋa dɛ pi suuɡaswɛm kooɡbɛrɛre dɛ so a ta.
Dɛ kookara la waa lɔ baah ta la bɔr dɛ ɡbɔɡre kɛŋɔ, bwaala aa dɛ nyɛɡle dɛɛ jiɡri dɛɛ kɔɡre la.
Kandere anuanɛ ɡe cheɡɛ kookara la sie dɛɛ hɔ.
Korowii Domare anuanɛ laanee.
Kookara la sie la ɛo kɛ mpo aa chɔa dɛ do ɡereŋ kɛ diɡi ken.
Hweera kwaa anaarɛ ane aa dɔ kena cheɡɔ bar kookara la, bɛlbwa cheɡɛ o bampera beŋkpoŋ ta.
A dɔ sibie a siini bobɛlbwa ne a habɔɔne bobɛlbwa.
Hweera kwaa nɔ bɛl do kɛŋɔ nyujente, bɛl do kɛŋɔ nabal, bɛl siebɔr do kɛŋɔ nɛn, bɛl ɡe do kɛŋɔ kee aa paɡri o kena dɛɛ ir la ken.
Bɛlbwa dɔ kena anumɛl, dɛ dɔ sibie a bwara bobɛlbwa ne a kena lɔɡre ɡba.
A lɔ o be chɔɔ ne jwaana dɛɛ kpɛɛro aa wola ɡel bwa, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii Haa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ dɛ do le saŋ la dɛ ba le fini, dɛɛ ba le doe saŋ bɛlbwa la, he do ɡoroŋ noo, he do ɡoroŋ kɛrɛdɛ.” Saŋ bɛlbwa hweera kwaa anaarɛ la aa kpɔ jam dɛɛ tɛ naate waa soɡe kookara la ta dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa la, dɛɛ duuru, dɛɛ tɛo jirima la, dɛ nomonome fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ la laa ba kooɡbɛrɛre pili bil kookara la sie dɛ ɡuŋi naate waa soɡe kookara la ta dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa la, dɛɛ duuru ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii haa dɔ komɛlbwa la, he chɛ kɛŋɔ nɛra bwa tɛɛ jirima dɛ́ duuri, dɛ́ sɛh kɛŋɔ hen dɔ kpeɡri bwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ henee ta komɛlbwa, he tetoora taa a che a do le.”
Pebie bɛl ne tɔn baa marɛ o nyoa pila wa Asɛ n nyiŋi dɛ na kɛŋɔ naate waa soɡe kookara la ta la kpoŋe tɔn bɛl o nɔndiɡ ta.
Tɔn la sie ne habɔɔ bwa taa ba chwerɛ, dɛ ɡuɡru, dɛ marɔ kera anuanɛ.
N na nyundua torome bokpeɡa te bɛl wɛɛ bol waa takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “Umee ń dɔ ó laa kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la kera anuanɛ la swe, dɛ́ pilu wɔ?” Dɛ nomɛlbwa toole nyundua ne harɛ nɔ ta, ne nɛra baa serewa kwaraa bini dɛ́ won pili tɔn la, á ba ɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi o binii.
Anomanta, n wio kohona, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ta nomɛlbwa nae o chɛ kɛŋɔ ó pili tɔn la dɛ́ nyiŋi o bini.
Asɛ nomonome la bɛl ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Gel wii.
Na!
Naate waa le Juda dea baa yerɔ ba Nyujente, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ yerɔ Devid Naa la, o wono yo le.
Anomanta, wɛɛ wonoo swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la nyoa kera anuanɛ la dɛ́ pilu.” Belaa n nyiŋi dɛ na pebie bɛl waa cheɡɛ baah ta, kookara la bɔr, hweera kwaa la ne nomonome la baro.
O le pee baa kpoo.
O le nyeɡlare anuanɛ dɛ dɔ sibie ɡe anuanɛ.
Sibie la cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii Domare anuanɛ la waa toma a la harɛ nɔ bwa ta la.
Pebie la kaa laa tɔn la lɛ naate waa soɡe kookara la ta la nɔndiɡ ta.
Waa lɛ tɔn la, hweera kwaa anaarɛ la ne nomonome fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ la, ɡuŋi Pebie la sie dɛɛ duuru.
Bɛlbwa ne o janjela ne o suuɡaswɛm loɡ, asɛ daawiile baa dɛ fuah a sɔɔh do som la do ba loɡa la bini.
Konsɔɔhsoma la cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra wesoŋa.
Ba ɡo yelfale bɛl ŋɔ, “He chɛ tɔn la kpɔe dɛ́ swe o nyoa kwaa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba fa kpoe, asɛ he kpɔ he chal yawɛ nɛra tɛ Korowii dɛ le wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ ɡel ba ɛ N Naa Korowii Kora nɛra, ne o sɔfore dɛɛ tomɔ, dɛ́ ba di kora harɛ nɔ bwa ta.” N nyiŋo dɛ no kɛ bobɛlbwa dɛ ɡbɔɡre, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ nyundua toroma warɔ taeh, dɛ ba bar kookara la ne hweera kwaa ne nomonome la bwa dɛ cheme.
Ba lɔ kaɡboŋa kaɡboŋa maa wola ba nyoa jemɛ, dɛ bwa pɛ bol takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “Pebie la ba fa aa kpoo la, onee dɔ kpeɡri ne kondɔɔh ne wejema dɛ bokpeɡa, onee chɛ duure ne jirima ne kpɛɛra.” Asɛ n berɛ no komɛlbwa Korowii aa taa a do nyundua, ne komɛlbwa waa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ne mpo bini bwa, ne nɛra baa serewa kwaara bwa aa dɛ ŋɔ, “Naate waa soɡe kookara la ta la ne Pebie la chɛ kpɛɛra ne duure ne jirima, dɛ dɔ kpeɡri bwa saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.” Hweera kwaa anaarɛ la sio ŋɔ, “Aamen,” asɛ nomonome la ɡe ɡuŋi harɛ dɛ duuru.
Kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la nyoa wa Maa dɛ nyiŋi la, n na Pebie la aa swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la kera anuanɛ la bini sitɔ kon la.
Asɛ n no hweera kwaa anaarɛ la bɛl taa kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ kɔɡre la.
O ŋɔ, “Ba!” N nao kɛŋɔ jaaɡɔpoŋ bɛl aa lea, nɛn so o ta dɛ kpoŋe to.
Ba kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ tɛo, asɛ o dɔ kpeɡri dɛ le kaa, dɛ ka yo laa dɛ pɔ o dɔma nɛ.
Asɛ Pebie la swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn nɛɛte la.
Waa sweo la, n noɔ kɛ hweera kon la waa jaa nɛɛ la aa ŋɔa, “Ba!” Belaa jaaɡɔ bɛl ɡe le, o bwa swɛɛrɔ peihpeihpeih ken.
Dɛ ba tɛ naate waa soɡe o ta la kpeɡri ŋɔ ó chɔɡ beŋkpoŋri ɛɛ harɛ bwa ta, ásɛ nɛra kpoo dɔŋa.
Tokobijen bɛlee ba tɛo o kpɔ kaa.
Pebie la swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la toorote la, asɛ n no kɛ hweera kwaa toorote aa ŋɔa, “Ba!” N nyiŋo, dɛ jaaɡɔbiŋi bɛl ɡe leɔ.
Nɛn waa soɡe o ta la kpoŋe kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ kari kwaa tɔɡre la bɛl.
N no taa bɛl hweera kwaa anaarɛ la baah ta kɛŋɔ, “Tɔpebir kembɔree bá kpɔ yawɛ mea lakaja dela anɛ la, ásɛ anɔ la a yoɡ aa wola kpeɡe ɡe, tɔpebir kembɔree dɛɛ yawɛ lakaja dela anumɛl.
Kɛ noo ne sen te, ɡel a chɔɡa.” Belaa Pebie la swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn la naarɛte la.
Waa sweo la, n noɔ kɛŋɔ hweera kwaa naarɛte aa ŋɔa, “Ba!” Asɛ n nyiŋi dɛ jaaɡɔkɔl bɛl leɔ, asɛ nɛn so o ta baa yerɔ Seo.
Bɛl ɡe le teŋɛ o nɛ, o ɡe sɔne Lalabwɛ.
Ba tɛɛ ba kpeɡri bá kpɔ laa ne lɔr ne weechɔɡa ne kpɔɡ bini ola kpoo harɛ nɔ ta nɛra.
He bɔne harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa bini bɔre anaarɛ naa, banɔ la baa tɛɛ ba kpeɡri bá kpo la ɛɛ tel bɔre anaarɛ la bini beŋkpoŋ nɛraa.
Asɛ Pebie la swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn nuete la.
Waa sweo la, n nyiŋi Korowii Dea bela baa dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la harɛbɔr, dɛ na lala baa koh Korowii Waa la wa, ne cheɡa baa cheɡa tɛo waa dɛ kpoo ba la.
Ba kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Nemenɛ Korowii haa do ɡoroŋ dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ, saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta nɔ waa bola dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ bɔ ba ya kpoora nɔ kem ɔ?” Dɛ ba tɛ bɛlbwa yapoŋ ó tɔ, dɛ ŋɔ báa onɛ tama ka tel kɛŋɔ ba bala Korowii bonɔɔna ne toli baa dɛ ba ba ɡe kpoora kɛŋɔ ban la nyoa aa chiɡa.
N berɔ na Pebie la swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn numɛlte la.
Waa sweo la, harɛ jiɡro kohona, asɛ wee bir kɛŋɔ birisie ken, asɛ korobie swɛɛ kɛŋɔ chal.
Weweela chuɡro lee harɛ kɛŋɔ peujen yon ta, daa nɔŋhuuhne yon lee harɛ la.
Asɛ Korowii doa nyoɡre n siwi ta kɛŋɔ baa ɡuɡri kalaŋ la.
Bwejaŋa ne ekwie ɡe chuɡri le a buɡe ta kaa.
Harɛ koranar ne nɛnjena, ne soojare nomonome, ne dɔɔhna, ne bokpeɡa tena, ne nɛn te bɛlbwa, banɔ la baa ɛ yoma, dɛ banɔ la baa wola yoma ɛɛ bwa chwa ka sɔh bwebɔɔne ne bwetala aa lɔ bwejena ta lɔɡre, dɛɛ ŋɔ bwejena la ne bwetala la be ŋɔ, “Hé choɡli tɔ ya nɛ, ásɛ naate waa soɡe kookara la ta la bɛ yaa na, ásɛ he le yaa Pebie la bandia ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba tɔpejen la telo, nɛra ɛɛ ba ba danana nee nyɔe.
Anomanta, umee dɛ́ won le a nyoa ɔ?”
Nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanaarɛ dɛ ba naarɛ baa le Israel Anɔ habɔɔ la, n na nyundua toroma banaarɛ baa cheɡɛ harɛ nyoo peu leebɔra anaarɛ dɛ lawɛ peu, ásɛ a bɛ harɛ ne mpo ne daa bɛlbwa ta ta.
Asɛ n berɛ na nyundua torome bɛl o le wee leebɔr dɛɛ ba, dɛ kpoŋe kon Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa aa kpɔa dɛɛ do o kwaa nso la.
O kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ nyundua toroma banaarɛ la baa tɛɛ ba kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bá chɔɡ harɛ ne mpo la be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel harɛ ne mpo ne daa la chɔɡa ka tel kɛŋɔ, yaa do Korowii bonɔɔna ne toli nso ba tili ta tonɛ mɔɔ.” Ba baɡle nɛra baa do ba nso la nyoa n be.
Ba lɔ kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la taa ba le.
Banɔ la baa do ba nso Juda dea la lɔ kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ.
Asɛ banɔ la waa do ba le Rubin dea la ɡe lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ.
O do Gad dea nɛra ɡe kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ nso, dɛ do Aasa dea nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ.
Gɛɛ o do Naftale dea ɡe nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ, dɛ berɛ do Manasɛ dea nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ.
O do Simeon dea nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ, dɛ do Lewi dea nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ, dɛ do Isaaka dea nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ.
O do Sebulon dea nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ, dɛ do Josef dea nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ, asɛ Bɛnjamen dea ɡe, o do nɛra kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banɛ nso.
Nɛnlaa baa do batakaarepoŋa wa Anɔ la habɔɔ la, n nyiŋo dɛ na nɛnlaa nomɛlbwa aa wola won kur ba bela.
Ba le wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa ta.
Ba bwa do batakaarepoŋa, dɛ kpoŋe bambie daa a papooni do a ta, dɛ che kookara la ne Pebie la sie, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii waa soɡe kookara ta la ne Pebie laanee lɛ yaa oo!” Asɛ nyundua toroma la che dɛ bar nomonome la ne hweera kwaa anaarɛ la ne kookara la, dɛ ɡuŋi dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ duu Korowii, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Aamen!
Korowii chɛ kpɛɛra ne jirima ne jam ne duure.
Onee dɔ wejema ne kpeɡri, ne bokpeɡa saŋ bɛlbwa.
Aamen!” Asɛ nomonome la bɛl pɛɛ mɛ ŋɔ, “Nɛra nɔ baa do yapoŋa nɔ, umewaa yɔ?
Leperaa ba leɔ?” Anee n ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔ, maa jemɛ.
He ken jem ba.” Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Banee fa lɔ wahala tenten la bini dɛ won le a nyoa la.
Ba chɛɡɛ ba yale Pebie la chal la ta, a le dɛ to.
Anomanta, ba lɔ Korowii kookara la sie dɛɛ tomɔ chɔɔ ne jwaana kɛŋɔ o Dea sɔfore, asɛ o ɡbaɡba waa soɡe kookara la ta la ɛɛ tɔ ba nɛ.
Lɔr ne nyɔɡre aa ban kpo kpa bwa.
Wee aa ba nɛɛ lɔ cheihcheih, bɔr ɡe aa ba nɛɛ wɔrɔbe bambam.
Dɛkalkɛŋɔ Pebie la waa lɔ kookara la baah ta la dɛ ba Peteɡre ɛɛ, dɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ, wɛɛ teɡ baa kaa nee aa dɛ tɛ mkpa aa wola jaɡa dɔe ta.
Asɛ Korowii fee ba sinii bwa ta.”
Pebie swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn nuanɛte la nyoa Pebie la aa swe kwaa baa kpɔa marɛ tɔn nuanɛte la, Korowii doa bwa ɛo ken surumm dɛ biɡri tama.
Asɛ n na baa kpɔ bɛle anuanɛ tɛ nyundua toroma banuanɛ ba yon dɛɛ che Korowii sie la.
Nyundua torome bɛl balɔ dɛ kpoŋe suuɡaswɛm kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, dɛ ka che bela baa fuh kwaa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la.
Ba kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma la kohona tɛo o kpɔ ja Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra wesoŋa la ta, dɛ fuah konsɔɔhsoma la fuih bɔr baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛo o che kookara la sie la.
Daawiile la chuu le nyundua torome la nɔn ta, dɛ ka koo Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra wesoŋa ta, dɛ kaa nyundua Korowii be.
Asɛ nyundua torome la kpɔ kon la baa kpɔa dɛɛ fuh daawiile la, dɛ buh konsɔɔhsoma fuih bɔr nii la ane dɛ kpɔ ta harɛ.
Asɛ bwaala jiɡri dɛɛ kɔɡre, dɛɛ nyɛɡle bobɛlbwa pelɔpelɔ ken, asɛ harɛ ɡe ɛɛ jiɡri.
Bɛle anuanɛ ane wa Nyundua toroma banuanɛ la baa kpoŋe bɛle anuanɛ la kpɔ ba te dɛɛ ba a hoeh.
Nyundua torome waa tɔ sie la hoɔh.
Waa hoah la, dombwea ne nii koo chal ta, dɛ le nyundua kɛŋɔ baa kpɔa ta harɛ.
Ba bɔne harɛ bini bɔre atoro naa, anɔ la aa fuah la ɛɛ tel bɔr beŋkpoŋii, a ka bɔre anɛ.
Ba bɔne daa ne kpɔɡa bini bɔre atoro naa, anɔ la aa fuah la ɛɛ tel bɔr beŋkpoŋii, a ka anɛ.
Asɛ nyundua torome waa teŋa nɛɛ la hoh o bɛla.
Waa hoah la, komɛl do kɛŋɔ bwekpeɡi damanta baa viɡru ken, o le nyundua dɛɛ fuh, dɛ ba le mpo ta, asɛ o nee berɛ chal.
Ba bɔne mpo bini bɔre atoro naa, anɔ la aa berɛ chal la ɛɛ tel bɔr beŋkpoŋii, asɛ o bini kwaa serewe, stiimaere aa lɔ o ta la chɔɡ.
Nyundua torome waa teŋa tooro la ɡe hoɔh.
Waa hoah la, asɛ weweejen le nyundua dɛ ba le harɛ, o bwa ɛɛ hɔ kɛŋɔ kapɛla ken.
Waa baa le la, o le moo ne nenabɔɔne ta.
Dɛ he bɔne moo ne nenabɔɔne bwa bini bɔre atoro naa, anɔ la waa le a ta la ɛɛ tel bɔr beŋkpoŋii.
Wewee la sɔne Koŋkpel.
Nee waa le o ta la berɔ do kpeli, asɛ nɛra nyɔa dɛ serewe pirim, dɛkalkɛ nee la kpeli.
Nyundua torome waa teŋa naarɛ la ɡe hoɔh.
Waa hoah la, wee ne korobie ne weweela bwa ɛo kɛŋɔ baa lɔa, a pera biri.
Dɛ ba bɔne a bɛlbwa kpeɡri bini bɔre atoro naa, a bɛlbwa bɔr beŋkpoŋ aa won chaah kpa.
Webaŋa ne jwaana ɡba, ɡɛɛ a do.
Ba bɔne a bini atotoro naa, wee aa lɔ bɔr beŋkpoŋ ta webaŋa.
Korobie ne weweela ɡe ɡɛɛ jwaana.
N berɛ nyiŋi dɛ na kee bɛl waa dɛ ɡah nyundua dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ si, “Waa dɛ ba!
Waa dɛ ba!
Waa ɛɛ pu nɛra baa lɔ harɛ taa.
Dɛ nyundua toroma batoro la baa kaa dɛ hoh ba bɛle la hoɔh waa, waa ɛɛ pu harɛ ta tenaa.”
Nyundua torome waa teŋa nue la hoh o bɛla, asɛ n na wewee bɛl le harɛ.
Korowii tɛo Bɔnsam bɔluŋ la safoa.
Asɛ o laa bɔluŋ la pili.
Waa pilu la, chuu leɔ puul kɛŋɔ nijena chuu aa dɛ le la, asɛ wee bir, bɔr bwa ɛ jwumaa ken.
Asɛ tontombɛre le chuu la bini dɛ ba harɛ ta.
Korowii tɛa kpeɡri a doma ɛɛ we kɛŋɔ nɔm ken, dɛ ŋɔ a be ŋɔ a bɛ harɛ nɔ ta kpɔɡa kɛɛ papooni kɛɛ daa bɛlbwa chɔɡ, kɛ á dorome nɛra baa wola Korowii nso la dɔe ba tili ta la.
O ta an kpeɡri tɛɛ a dom ba dɛ́ kpoo ba, kɛ á dom ba dɛ́ wee ba ɡɛ nɔm aa dɛ we la, dɛ́ ka tel korobie anue.
Ásɛ ɡɛ saŋ baa nyin kɛ seo ba kpoo ba, kɛ baa dɔ, ásɛ seo chwa le ba be.
Tontombɛre la le jaɡre baa kpɔa dɛɛ la ka yo laa.
A dɔ kwaane a nyuune ta aa le suuɡaswɛm kooɡbɛrɛre, asɛ a siebɔr le nɛn.
A dɔ nyumpona kɛŋɔ haah, a nyena le nyujente nyena ken.
Kwaa tɔ a bambili kɛŋɔ laa batakaare bune aa dɛ bɔle bambile la, asɛ a kena ɛɛ ɡbɔɡre kɛŋɔ torɔɡore aa wara ba vɔwa pɛl jaɡre dɛ chwa dɛɛ kaa laa la.
A dɔ dini kɛŋɔ nɔrɔme ken dɛɛ domɛ.
A dini taa á dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ́ domɛ nɛn, dɛ́ weo korobie anue.
A dɔ a kooro.
O ɛ Bɔnsam torome waa dɛ nyiŋi Bɔnsam Bɔluŋ la ta.
Hibru tena dɛ yerɔ Abadɔn, Grik tena ɡe ɛɛ yerɔ Apoleɔn.
O sɔn la munii “Nɛn waa dɛ chɔɡ kwa.” Wekpeɡa aa tɔ sie la tonɔ, dɛ ta ka a bele anɛ habɔɔ a ta ɛɛ ba bala.
Nyundua torome waa jaa numɛl la hoh o bɛla, asɛ n no taa bɛl le kon baa dɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma o ta ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛo o che Korowii sie dɛ dɔ loŋkoni anaarɛ la ta.
Loŋkoni anaarɛ la bwa taa lɔŋɔ la le.
O ŋɔ nyundua torome waa jaa numɛl dɛ dɔ bɛla la be ŋɔ, “Pur Bɔnsam toroma banaarɛ la baa vɔɡ ba Yufretis Moo nyoa la ta.” Asɛ ba pur Bɔnsam toroma banaarɛ la Korowii fa aa vɔɡ ba dɛɛ kpa awola tɔpere la.
O do dɔŋhwere la ne tɔpere la ne korobie la ne bena la baa kpɔ pur ba bá kpoo nɛra.
Ba bɔne harɛ ta nɛra bini bɔre atoro naa, banɔ la baa dɛ ba kpoora la ɛɛ tel bɔr beŋkpoŋ nɛraa.
Ba baɡlɔ kɛŋɔ Bɔnsam toroma la dɔ soojare kaɡboŋa bele kaɡboŋ ɡe bele lafraanɛ dɛ so jaɡre ta.
N na jaɡre la kɛ chaahna ken, a dɔɔranar so a ta, dɛ do laa batakaare bune aa dɛ bɔle bambile la, asɛ a swɛɛ kɛŋɔ chal, ane do kɛŋɔ burum, asɛ ane ɡe kɔl kɛŋɔ solmen.
Asɛ jaɡre la nyuune do kɛŋɔ nyujentena nyuune.
Asɛ nii ne chuu ne jebɔrɔwe ninlao ɛɛ le a nyoo.
Ba bɔne harɛ bini nɛra bwa bini bɔre atoro naa, banɔ la nii ne chuu ne jebɔrɔwe ninlao aa dɛ le jaɡre la nyoo la aa kpoora la ɛɛ tel bɔr beŋkpoŋii.
Jaɡre la kpeɡri lɔ a nyoo ne a dini bwa ta.
A dini la do kɛŋɔ harɛkwa, dɛ dɔ nyuune dɛɛ choɡri.
A ɡɛ waa nɔ kwaraa ta la, nɛra baa kaa baa wola sewɛ a ɡɛ waa la ta la ta ba liire charɛ, dɛ le ba tonchɔɡa ta, dɛ ta ɛɛ tomɛ Bɔnsam toroma ne voɡa.
Suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne bwea ne daa baa kpɔa ɛ voɡa la aa na, aa waa no, aa won ir valɛ ɡe, kɛ ba dɛ toma.
Ba ta ba liire charɛ ba nɛŋkpoa ne sɔm we-ɛɛla ne jwamane ne ŋwɛɛ ta.
Nyundua torome ne tɔnjeɡa bɛl wa Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, n berɔ na nyundua torome bokpeɡa te bɛl, o le nyundua dɛɛ tu.
O kpɔ baama tɔ kɛŋɔ yal ken.
Bwaala deŋɡare bar o nyu, o siebɔr ɛɛ chaah kɛŋɔ wee, asɛ o nakpale ɡe do kɛŋɔ nii.
O dɔ tɔnjeɡa bɛl waa pila do o nɔn ta, dɛ kpɔ o nadiɡ do mpo ta, o naɡal ɡe che baŋ, dɛ si kpeɡri nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nyujente yon dɛɛ si la.
Waa sia la, bwaala kɔra anuanɛ la ɡe sɛoh.
Bwaala kɔra la aa dɛ bol waa la, n fe dɛ nyin n chwerɛ, dɛ berɛ no taa bɛl nyundua o ŋɔ, “Gel waa bwaala kɔra anuanɛ la aa bola la do he ɡbo nyu bini.
Gel a chwera!” Asɛ n berɛ na nyundua torome la n fa aa nao o naa bɛl do mpo ta, bɛl ɡe che baŋ la aa tɛr o nɔndiɡ pa nyundua, dɛ ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ ta nyundua ne harɛ ne kwa aa lɔ a ta bwa, dɛ ta mpo ne kwa aa lɔ o ɡe ta la, dɛ ŋɔ, “Aa biɡri kpa.
Nyundua torome nuanɛte la bɛla la hoeh saŋee Korowii wesɔɔhla waa baɡle o bonɔɔna baa ɛ o keamere la bwa ɛɛ ba ɛɛ tonɛ.” N berɛ no taa la waa le nyundua dɛ bol waa n be la.
O ŋɔ, “La ka lɛ tɔn la waa pila dɛ do nyundua torome la o naa bɛl aa lɔ mpo ta, bɛl che baŋ la nɔn ta.” N la o be dɛ ŋɔ ó kpɔ tɔnjeɡa la tɛ mɛ.
O ŋɔ, “Lɛ dɛ́ chwe.
Wɛɛ do somee kɛŋɔ tooh ken he nyoa bini, dɛ́ berɛ do kpeli he tea bini o ɛɛ haŋŋ ken.” Asɛ n lɛ tɔnjeɡa la le o nɔn ta, dɛ kpɔ chwe, o do som n nyoa bini kɛŋɔ tooh ken.
Maa lilo la, o berɔ do kpeli n tea bini o ɛɛ mɛ haŋŋ ken.
Anee ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé baɡle waa aa dɛ ba nɛndamanta baa lɔ harɛre bwa ta ne wobol bwa soo siwi dɛ koranar bwa ɛɛ kerekere la ja.”
Danseɛ tena banɛ bane wa Ba kpɔ daa bɛl baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ kwaa o do kɛŋɔ daŋɡbala tɛ mɛ, dɛ ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Korowii ŋɔ hé ir kpɔ daa nɔ ka maɡɛ Korowii Dea ne bela baa dɛ fuh kwaa dɛɛ tɛo la, dɛ́ kure nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ o bini la.
Bɛ bela waa ja Dea la ta ba tel bela mɔɔ dɛɛ jo Dea la tenten bini la te maɡɛ.
Teŋe bela ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii kpɔ bela tɛ nɛra baa wola on tomɛ, ásɛ ba tiɡri o bwɛjen Jerusalam la ta korobie fifraanaarɛ dɛ anɛ.
O danseɛ tena banɛ lole, dɛ tɔ lweyale.
Wɛɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡrii bá baɡle o waa la tɔpera kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanumɛl.” Gɛ nɛra banɛ nɔɔ ɔleve daa anɛ ne kandea daa anɛ a cheɡɛ harɛ bwa Dɔɔ la sie la che tɛ la.
Dɛ ba dɔm bɛlbwa ŋɔ o ɛɛ ba wechɔɡa aa, nii ɛɛ le Korowii danseɛ tena la nyooree, dɛ́ kpo naate.
A ɡɛ seo nɔɔ nomɛlbwa waa ŋɔ ó ɛɛ ba wechɔɡa la ɛɛ ba sewa.
Ba dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ lawɛ bwaala o ɡel nɛɛ ɡɛ saŋ baa dɛɛ bol Korowii Waa la bwa, dɛ́ berɛ won ɡel nee berɛ chal.
Ba dɔ kpeɡri kɛ bá kpɔ harɛchɔɡ waa bɛlbwa ta harɛ nɔ ta saŋ bɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.
Dɛ danseɛ tena la bol waa la tonaa, olchɔɡe bɛl ɛɛ le Bɔnsam Bɔluŋ la taa, dɛ́ ba yoo ba, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ kpoo ba, ásɛ ba lala chɔ bwɛjen la ba fa aa kpo ba Dɔɔ daɡaɡre ta la fɔɡbaah.
Baa wonoo dɛɛ yerɛ bela Sodom, dɛ́ berɛ won dɛɛ yerɛ bela Ijipt.
Wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa ɛɛ nyiŋi ba lala laanee tɔpera atoro ne fah, baa wola sɛh ba huɡ ba.
Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɛɛ koh ba seo la waa ba sie lɛ ba baah sɔɔh ba.
Baa chemoo dɛ́ lɛ sie, dɛ́ kɛ dɔŋa kwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ a ɡɛ Korowii toroma banɛ la fa kpɔ wahala ta ba nɛɛ taeh.
Asɛ tɔpera atoro ne fah habɔɔ la, hweera le Korowii be, dɛ jo ba nɛɛ ba dɔ mkpa dɛ ir, asɛ ɔmee lawɛ nɛra baa cheɡa dɛɛ nyiŋ ba la taeh.
Bela la, ɡɛ baala banɛ la no takpeɡ bɛl nyundua o ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ir ba bonɔ!” Asɛ ba ir, bam bɛl kpɔ ba kaa nyundua asɛ ba dɔma che dɛɛ nyiŋ ba baa kaa.
Buɡ la ta, harɛ jiɡri kohona, asɛ bwɛjen la deene choɡli.
Dɛ ba bɔne bwɛɛ la bini bɔre fi aa, deene aa choɡla la ɛɛ tel bɔr beŋkpoŋ deenee, nɛra kaɡboŋa banuanɛ serewɔ, asɛ ɔmee lawɛ banɔ la baa kaa la, asɛ ba kpɛɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua la.
Wekpeɡa aa teŋa nɛɛ la balɔ dɛ kaa.
A ka toorotena aa ba bala taraken.
Bɛla waa teŋa nuanɛ bɛl wa Nyundua torome waa teŋa nuanɛ la hoh o bɛla.
Waa hoah la, asɛ n no takpeɡa kohona nyundua o ŋɔ, “Harɛ nɔ ta kora bwa berɛ N Naa Korowii ne o Kristo waa tomɔ la kora.
Wɛɛ di koraa saŋ bɛlbwa.” Asɛ nomonome fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ baa soɡe ba kookane ta Korowii sie la ir, dɛ ɡuŋi dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛɛ duuru, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii Haa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro dɛ do le dɛ le saŋ la bwa ba le fini, ya dɛ jaame kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ he kpeɡri dɛɛ di kora komɛlbwa nɛɛ nɔ.
Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta baah diu, kɛ tɔpere baa nyɔ he danana nee la ɡe telo.
He bole pae tɔpere telo, hɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba bol nɛra baa serewa la waa dɛ́ pa bole, dɛ́ bɔ he bonɔɔna baa ɛ he keamere ne he nɛra ne banɔ la baa dɛ ɔmɛ la kem, ba bini nɛnjena ne nɛmpɛɛne bwa, dɛ́ chɔɡ banɔ la baa dɛ chɔɡ harɛ la.” Asɛ Korowii Dea waa lɔ nyundua la pili, ba na Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la.
Bwaala ɛɛ nyɛɡle pelɔpelɔ ken, dɛɛ kɔɡre, harɛ ɛɛ jiɡri, dombwea ɛɛ lee kohona.
Haah bɛl ne kontuuɡi damanta bɛl wa N na wejena ane aa ɛ nyokpo wa dɛɛ baɡle waane Korowii doa.
Haah bɛl kpɔ wee tɔ, dɛ kpɔ korobie ɡe do o nakpale lɔɡre, dɛ ɡuɡri weweela fi dɛ anɛ pi o nyu, kɛŋɔ kooɡbɛrɛ ken.
Haah la tea beɔ, loltea lɔɔ wɛɛ ba lola dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre.
Nyokpowaa ane ɡe aa dɛ baɡle waane berɔ ɛ nyundua bela ja.
Kontuuɡi damanta bɛl waa le lɛŋɔ leɔ.
O swɛɛrɔ dɛ dɔ nyuune anuanɛ dɛ nyeɡlare fi.
Asɛ kooɡbɛrɛ pi o nyuune la bɛlbwa ta.
Asɛ o kpɔ o din ɡbaa weweela ta harɛ.
Dɛ he bɔne a bini bɔre atoro naa, a bini beŋkpoŋii o ɡbaa.
O baa che haah la waa dɛ ba lola la sie dɛɛ nyin kɛŋɔ dɛ o lolaa, ó kpɔ o bie la lile.
Haah la lolɛ bibaa waa dɛ ba kpeɡri kpɔe dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛɛ aŋwɛnɛ ta.
Waa lolɔ la, ba lao kee kaa Korowii be o do o kookara la bɔr.
Asɛ haah la ɡe chwa jo pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, bela Korowii aa ɛ bɔr tɛo ŋɔ bá nyiŋu tɔpera kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanumɛl bwa la.
Asɛ laa chole Korowii doa.
Maekel waa ɛ nyundua toroma la bwa nomoa la ne o dɔm kaa pu kontuuɡi damanta la ne o ɡe bala ba yo, asɛ Maekel ne o dɔm pɔ ba nɛ.
Belaa ba ta bɔr dɔe dɛ so Korowii doa kpa, asɛ Korowii kpɔ kontuuɡi damanta waa ɛ harɛkon la yaa jemɛ o waa mumpar bwa, baa yerɔ Baradeɛre Te ne Bɔnsam, wɛɛ neɡre nɛra bwa baa nyoɡre la, ne o bala bwa ta harɛ.
N berɔ no takpeɡ bɛl Korowii doa o ŋɔ, “Taraken N Naa Korowii lɛɛ waa dɛ ba dɛ́ ba lɛ nɛra la telo.
O kpeɡri ne o kora dii saŋ telo.
Taraken o Kristo waa tomɔ ó ba lɛ yaa la lɛ kpeɡri dɛɛ di, dɛkalkɛŋɔ naate waa chɔɡ yabala dɛɛ tɛ Korowii saŋ bɛlbwa la, Korowii kpɔɔ ta.
Ba cheɡɛ Pebie la chal la ne Korowii Waa baa bola la ta dɛ pɔ o nɛ.
Ba ta ɡelɛ ba mkpa waa swɛɛ ba siwi, ba sɛh seo kwara.
Anomanta, Korowii doa tena, hé ɡel he sie lɛ.
He banɔ la haa lɔ harɛ ta ne mpo ta ɡe la, hé bwɛɛlɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Baradeɛre Te la tuo ba he be.
O baah diu kɛrɛdɛ, o jemɔ kɛ o tɔpere aa kanɛ kpa.” Korowii aa kpɔ kontuuɡi damanta la ta harɛ la, o iro dɛɛ ti haah la waa lolɛ bibaa la.
Anee ba tɛ haah la kee kena anɛ o kpɔ dɛ ir kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ, bela baa ɛa tɛo dɛ nyiŋu bene atoro ne fah la, ásɛ kontuuɡi damanta la bɛ won ɛo wobɛlbwa.
Kontuuɡi damanta la aa ti haah la, o pili o nyoa dɛ uɡe nee a ɛ kɛŋɔ nepale dɛ́ fee palɛ haah la kaa.
Kɛ harɛ cha haah la, dɛ pere, dɛ kpɔ nee la bwa nyɔ.
Asɛ kontuuɡi damanta la baah di haah la nɛɛ kohona, o kpɔ ka tɔ haah la naanar baa kaa dɛɛ no Korowii Waa dɛɛ teŋɛ Yeesu danseɛ waa ba dɛ di la ta la nɛ.
Asɛ dɛ ka che mpo nyoa dɛɛ kpa.
Olchɔɡe bɛl waa le mpo ta A habɔɔ la, n na olchɔɡe bɛl wɛɛ le mpo ta.
O dɔ nyuune anuanɛ dɛ nyeɡlare fi.
Kooɡbɛrɛ pi o nyeɡlare la bɛlbwa ta, ba chwerɛ sɔnchɔɡe ɡe dawɛ nyuune la bɛlbwa ta, a ɛ chɛɡa tɛ Korowii.
Olchɔɡe la maa nao la le noniete, o nakpale ɡe le sisire nakpale, asɛ o nyoa ɡe le nyujente nyoa.
Asɛ kontuuɡi damanta la kpɔ o kpeɡri ne o kora ne o nomonome kohona waa dɔa la bwa tɛ olchɔɡe la.
Olchɔɡe la nyuune la bɛl ɛo kɛŋɔ ba fa aa doo bol o sewɛ dɛ ir, asɛ bol la tonɛ.
O waa ɛ nɛra bwa nyokpoa ba teŋɛ o nɛ.
Nomɛlbwa tomɛ kontuuɡi damanta la, dɛkalkɛ o kpɔ o kpeɡri tɛ olchɔɡe la.
Ba duu o ne olchɔɡe la bwa kɛ Korowii ken, dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ume dɔŋee olchɔɡe nɔɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won puu yo laa lɔ?” Korowii ta on ŋwɛnɛ tɔe.
O ɡelɔ wɛɛ bol wejena ne nɛnhɛlwa, dɛ ɡel o dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won ɛa korobie fifraanaarɛ dɛ anɛ.
O pili nyoa dɛ bol Korowii nɛnhɛlwa, dɛ chɔɡ o ne bela waa lole ne nɛra baa lɔ o be bwa sɔn.
Korowii tɛo ŋwɛnɛ ó yo o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ ɡel o dɔ kpeɡri wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa nɛ.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra baa wola ba sɔna chwerɛ Pebie la baa kpoo la Mkpa Tɔn la bini harɛ mumpar bwa la, ba bwa ɛɛ duu olchɔɡe laanee kɛŋɔ Korowii ken.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ deŋna la, ó no.
Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ bá lawɛ nomɛlbwa laa ta naa, baa lawɔɔ.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa kweh kere dɛ kpɔ kpo nɛn aa, kere nee baa ba o ɡe kpoe.
Anɔ dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɔ bambile, dɛ́ lawɛ waa baa dɛ yaradaa la bini kiŋkiŋ.
Olchɔɡe bɛl waa le harɛ bini Belaa n berɛ na olchɔɡe bɛl kɛŋɔ onɔ la, o ɛɡɛ dɛɛ le harɛ bini.
O dɔ nyeɡlare anɛ kɛŋɔ pebale ken, o taa do kɛŋɔ kontuuɡi damanta taa ken.
Loɡle olchɔɡe la kpɔ o kpeɡri bwa tɛo, o che o naa ta dɛɛ ɛ wejena, dɛ ɡel nɛra bwa baa lɔ harɛ ta la ɛɛ duu loɡle olchɔɡe la ba fa aa doo bol o sewɛ dɛ berɛ ir o bol la tonɛ la.
O wono dɛɛ ɛ wejena ne nyokpowa, dɛ ɡel nii le nyundua lee harɛ, nɛra na.
Waa cheɡɛ loɡle olchɔɡe la naa ta dɛɛ ɛ wejena la nomanta, o wono neɡre nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ŋɔ bá ma komɛl kɛŋɔ olchɔɡe la ba fa aa kpɔ kere doo bol o sewɛ dɛ ir la.
Baa mao tonɛ la, Korowii tɛ olchɔɡe la waa teŋa nɛɛ la ŋwɛnɛ o tɛ kon la baa mao la hweera o won dɛɛ bol wa.
Olchɔɡe nɛɛte la ŋɔ bá kpoo nɛra baa wola sɛh dɛ́ tomɛ kon la baa mao la bwa.
O ɡelɔ ba do nomɛlbwa, ne nɛmpɛɛne ne nɛnjena, ne dɔɔhna ne nyaara, ne yoma dɛ nɛra baa wola yoma ɛɛ, nso ba nɔndiɡ ta kɛɛ ba tili ta.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa ta nso la dɔe yaa, o ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ ó yawɛ kon kɛɛ ó yoɡ komɛlbwa.
Nso la ɛ namba waa cheɡa tɛ olchɔɡe la sɔn.
Dɛ he dɔ wejema aa, no.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ liire dɛ́ won jemɛ olchɔɡe la namba la mun la, ó lii.
Onee , o ɛ nɛn sɔn.
Pebie ne nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banaarɛ la wa Belaa n nyiŋi dɛ na Pebie la cheɡa Saayɔn Bwejen doa.
Asɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banaarɛ baa chwerɛ o ne o Mɛɛ la sɔna ba tili ta la che o be.
Asɛ n no ɡbɔɡa nyundua kɛŋɔ chuubu aa dɛ si ken, a berɛ do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra kohona la.
Dɛ o dɛ si kɛŋɔ baa dɛ lɔ janjela la.
Nɛra la cheɡɛ Korowii kookara ne hweera kwaa anaarɛ la ne nomonome la be dɛɛ ɡo yelfale bɛl, nomɛlbwa aa wola won hweli yel la, nemenɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banaarɛ Korowii aa lɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa bini la ɡbo.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ do kɛŋɔ baala baa wola haah jemɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba lawɛ ba te dɛ do kaih.
Ba dɛ teŋɛ Pebie la nɛɛ bobɛlbwa waa dɛ la.
Banee nɛnloɡla Korowii aa lɛɛ ba nɛra waa dɛ ba ba lɛɛ la bwa bini, dɛ́ kpɔ ba tɛ o te ne Pebie la.
Ba ta nyosone teŋe bwa.
Wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɡe toole ba nɛ.
Nyundua toroma batoro bane wa Belaa n na nyundua torome bɛl waa ira kpɔ nyundua, dɛ kpoŋe Amanesoma aa wola tonɛ bwa, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ la ka bol wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa be.
O kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ́ɛ tɛo jirima, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tɔpere la telo kɛŋɔ ó bol nomɛlbwa waa dɛ́ pa bole.
Hɛ́ɛ duu Korowii waa ta nyundua ne harɛ, ne mpo ne neerare bwa aa lɔ harɛ ta la.” Nyundua torome nɛɛte ɡe iro teŋɛ onɔ la nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “O paɡrɔ!
O paɡrɔ!
Babelɔn bwɛjen la waa ɡela pɛlchɔɡa ne wedoŋa dɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta bwa nɛra kɛŋɔ sen asɛ ba waa fuh Korowii baah la paɡrɔ.” Toorote ɡe iro teŋɛ banɛ la nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ nomɛlbwa sɛoh dɛɛ tomɛ olchɔɡe la ne o chaa la baa mao la, dɛ ɡel ba doo nso o tile ta kɛɛ o nɔn ta naa, onee dɛɛ ba Korowii danana nee a nyoa aa kpeɡa kohona kɛŋɔ sen baa wola komɛlbwa a ta pule la nyɔe.
Wɛɛ na hɔhɔrɔwa kɛrɛdɛɛ jebɔrɔwe ninlao ta, nyundua toroma ne Pebie la sie, ásɛ chuu le bela baa dɛ na hɔhɔrɔwa la dɛɛ kaa nyundua saŋ bɛlbwa.
Nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ olchɔɡe la ne kon la baa mao la, ne nɛra baa kpɔ o sɔn do ba nso la, baa hɔhɔrɔwa la taa le bwa, dɛ́ɛ na waa chɔɔ ne jwaana.” Anɔ dɛ baɡle kɛ a chɛ kɛ Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta dɛɛ yarada Yeesu la lawɛ bambile dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ.
N berɔ no taa bɛl nyundua o ŋɔ, “Chwerɛ waa nɔ.
Le fini dɛɛ kaa, nɛra baa yarada ya Dɔɔ la dɛ kpɔ ba te tɛo la, dɛ ba sewaa, ba na som.” Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la bolɔ ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, ba onɔ.
Ba lee ba ba koeh ta.
Ba sɔndɛɛɡe ɛɛ teŋɛ ba nɛɛ kaa.” Kwaa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta koma wa Asɛ n nyiŋi dɛ na bampoŋ bɛl, nomɛl so o ta kɛŋɔ nɛn, dɛ pi suuɡaswɛm kooɡbɛrɛ, dɛ kpoŋe kerenyɛɡ.
Anee nyundua torome bɛl le Korowii Dea bini, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ onɔ la waa soɡe bam ta la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he kere la dɛ́ komɛ.
Kwaa koma saŋ telo.
Harɛ ta kondikwaa beɔ ne koma.” Asɛ onɔ la waa soɡe bam ta la ta o kere la, dɛ komɛ kwaa aa lɔ harɛ ta la.
Nyundua torome bɛl ɡe le Korowii Dea waa lɔ nyundua la bini, dɛ ɡe kpoŋe kerenyɛɡ.
Bɛl ɡe waa dɔ nii kpeɡri le konsɔɔhsoma fuih bɔr, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ kerenyɛɡ te la be ŋɔ, “Kpɔ he kerenyɛɡ la, dɛ́ chaa harɛ ta daa baa kpɔ a nɔna dɛɛ ɛ sen la nɔna.
A beɔ!” Asɛ o ta o kerenyɛɡ la harɛ ta dɛ chaa a nɔna, dɛ pa do kon ba yon pa nɔna la do dɛɛ sa a ta a nee le dɛɛ do o bini la.
A ɡɛ kon la cheɡɔ tɛ Korowii bandia.
Nɔna baa sa a ta la cheɡɔ tɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra.
Bwɛjen la daharaa ba sa ba nɛ, ba chal palɛ kaa kɛ kwansini lafraanɛ, a luŋri ɡe tel naɡale anɛ.
Nyundua toroma banuanɛ ne hɔhɔrɔwa bele anuanɛ N berɔ na wejena ane Korowii doa, a do kan dɛ baɡle waane.
A ɛ nyokpoa taeh.
N na nyundua toroma banuanɛ ba kpoŋe hɔhɔrɔwa bele anuanɛ.
Anee hɔhɔrɔwa aa ka mun ba ɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ anee dɛɛ ba ɛɛ mɔɔ Korowii baah sɔɔh.
N na bobɛl o do kɛŋɔ mpo aa chɔa dɛ do ɡereŋ asɛ nii do o ta.
Asɛ nɛra baa pɔ olchɔɡe la ne kon la baa mao la nɛɛ dɛ vɛh o namba waa cheɡa tɛ o sɔn la kpoŋe Korowii janjelare dɛ che nee la jwɛh, dɛɛ ɡo Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis ne Pebie la yel ŋɔ, “Oo, Korowii Haa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro, he we-ɛɛla kan ɡa.
Harɛ nɔ bwa Kooro, he ŋwɛnɛre toɡrɔ dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ.
Oo, n Naa Korowii, umee lole waa wola hen ɔmɔɔ?
Umee wola hen sɔnee tɛɔ?
He ɡboo do ɡoroŋ ka tonɛ.
Harɛ ta nɛn te bɛlbwa ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi he siee dɛ́ tomɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ waa haa ɛa la toɡrɔ nomɛlbwa jemɛ.” Anɔ habɔɔ la, n berɔ na Korowii Dea waa lɔ nyundua la baa pilu cheɡ.
Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr baa baŋro wɛɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ Korowii lɔ o nɛra bini laanee.
Asɛ nyundua toroma banuanɛ baa kpoŋe hɔhɔrɔwa bele anuanɛ la le Korowii Dea la bini.
Ba laala baa doa la wer dɛɛ nyɛɡle.
Ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm kirisore vɔrɔwe ba bambile.
Asɛ hweera kwaa anaarɛ la bɛl kpɔ suuɡaswɛm loɡa anuanɛ tɛɛ ba.
Korowii waa lole saŋ te bɛlbwa la bandia su a bwa.
Korowii jirima ne o kpeɡri ɡelɔ chuu su o Dea la bini, nomɛlbwa aa wola won jo bela, atane kɛŋɔ hɔhɔrɔwa bele anuanɛ nyundua toroma banuanɛ la aa kpoŋa la aa ɛa tonɛ mɔɔ.
Korowii bandia aa lɔ loɡa anuanɛ ane bini wa N berɔ no takpeɡ bɛl o le Korowii Dea la bini, dɛ ŋɔ nyundua toroma banuanɛ la be ŋɔ, “Hé kaa dɛ́ ka fuɡe Korowii bandia la aa lɔ loɡa anuanɛ bini la ta harɛ.” Nyundua torome waa tɔ sie la kaalɔ, dɛ ka fuɡe o kwaa ta harɛ.
Asɛ ŋwɛrchɔɡa aa dɛ we kohona lee nɛra baa dɔ olchɔɡe la nso dɛɛ tomɛ kon la baa mao la nɛ.
Asɛ nɛɛte ɡe ka fuɡe o kwaa do mpo ta.
Asɛ mpo nee chɔɡ, dɛ do kɛŋɔ lale chal, asɛ kwaa aa lɔ mpo ta bwa serewe.
Asɛ toorote ɡe le dɛ ka fuɡe o kwaa do moo bɛlbwa ne neerare bwa ta, a beɡre chal.
Asɛ n no nyundua torome la waa chɔ neerare nyoa la kɛ waa ŋɔa, “Hen haa lole saŋ la bwa dɛ ba le fini, henee ɛ Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ dɛ ka tonɛ la, he waa haa bola dɛ pa nɛra bolchɔɡe la toɡrɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba fa ɡelɔ he nɛra ne he keamere chal fuɡe.
Anomanta, he tɛɛ ba chal ba nyɔ.
Gɛɛ ba chɛ.” Asɛ n no taa bɛl konsɔɔhsoma fuih bɔr, o ŋɔ, “Korowii Haa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro la, he waa haa ɛa dɛ tɛr ba deŋne toɡrɔ dɛ ɛ kasinteŋ.” Nyundua torome naarɛte la ɡe leɔ, dɛ ka fuɡe o kwaa ta wee ta, asɛ a tɛo kpeɡri wɛɛ nyaa kɛŋɔ nii ken, dɛɛ nyaa nɛra, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o nyɛɡre taeh, asɛ baa bol Korowii waa dɔ kpeɡri hɔhɔrɔwa la nɛɛ nɛnhɛlwa.
Ba ta ba liire charɛ dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta.
Ba ta on jirima tɛɛ.
Onɔ la waa teŋa nue la ɡe leɔ, dɛ ka fuɡe o kwaa ta olchɔɡe la kookara ta, asɛ bɔr bir nɛra waa dɛ di kora ba nɛɛ la bwa nɛ, asɛ baa menɛ nyoa ba bonyɛɡa la wa, dɛɛ chɛɡre Korowii waa lɔ nyundua ba bonyɛɡa ne ŋwɛra aa lɔ ba nɛɛ la wa.
Ba ta liire charɛ dɛ le ba tonchɔɡa ta.
Nyundua torome waa teŋa numɛl ɡe leɔ, dɛ ka fuɡe o kwaa ta Yufretis Moo ta, asɛ o bwa hweeh dɛ chɔ ŋwɛnɛ tɛ koranar baa le wee leebɔr dɛɛ ba la.
N berɔ na kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ atoro a do kɛŋɔ sapone ken, bɛl le kontuuɡi damanta la nyoa, anɛ aa kaa la ɡe le olchɔɡe la ne keamechɔɡe la nyoa bini.
Bɔnsam kwaa, asɛ a won dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowa.
A leɔ dɛɛ kaa harɛ nɔ ta koranar bwa be, dɛ́ ka lawɛ ba bwa cheme bá yo Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ laa o tɔpejen la ta.
Hɛ́ɛ no.
Mɛɛ piɡri heyaa kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ ken.
Naate waa wola dom chɔ dɛ do o laala dɛ so dɛɛ kpa la na som.
N balaa, waa mumɡbalee valɛ nɛra nao ásɛ sihiih kpoo.
Kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ la lawɛ koranar bwa cheme bobɛl Hibru tena aa dɛ yerɛ bela Amaɡɛdɔn la.
Asɛ nyundua torome waa teŋa nuanɛ la ɡe fuɡe o kwaa do peu ta.
N no takpeɡ bɛl le kookara la te be Korowii Dea bela, o ŋɔ, “A tonɔ.” Asɛ bwaala ɛɛ nyɛɡle pelɔpelɔ bobɛlbwa, dɛɛ jiɡri, dɛɛ kɔɡre, asɛ harɛ jiɡri kohona.
Korowii aa ta nɛwɛnyini bwa, harɛ ta ɡɛ jiɡre bwa.
O jiɡra la ɔma.
Bwɛjen la peɡri atoro, asɛ harɛ nɔ ta bwɛɛre bwa paɡre.
Korowii lii Babelɔnjen tena wechɔɡa la wa, dɛ ɡel ba nyɔ o danana nee a nyoa aa kpeɡa kohona kɛŋɔ seŋkpeɡa la.
Ekwie aa lɔ neerare baahna, ne bwejena nyoɡrɔ, ba nyin a bɔr kahonɛ.
Tombwejena le nyundua dɛ do tɔɡre kɛŋɔ paanoo men bɔɡtɔ del dɛ ba lee nɛra nɛɛ dɛ a ɔma.
Asɛ nɛra koh a waa dɛ chɛɡre Korowii.
Haah bɛl ne olchɔɡe bɛl wa Belaa nyundua toroma banuanɛ baa kpoŋe loɡa anuanɛ la bɛl ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ba ń baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ ba jwamane te tenten la deŋne tɛra.
O soɡe neerare nyoo.
O ne harɛ nɔ ta koranar bwa di sɛm.
O wedoŋa la ɛo kɛŋɔ sen, asɛ o kpɔ tɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ba nyɔ dɛ dɛɛ.” Belaa Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ir n nɛ, asɛ nyundua torome la kpɔ mɛ kaa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, asɛ n na haah bɛl o so olchɔɡe bɛl nɛ.
Olchɔɡe la swɛɛrɔ dɛ dɔ sɔnchɔɡa o bwa, a bwa ɛ chɛɡa dɛɛ yaɡɛ Korowii.
O dɔ nyuune anuanɛ, o nyeɡlare ɡe ɛ fi.
Haah la di toli dɛ do laaladɛɛɡa, ane swɛɛ a sie do ɡimeɡime, ane ɡe swɛɛ peihpeih dɛ do wer.
O do baŋa kwaa ne deŋna kwaa ne nɔnloɡa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne bwedɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi ɛa, dɛ kpoŋe suuɡaswɛm luwee, wedoŋa ne jwamane we-ɛɛla suu.
Ba chwerɛ sɔn bɛl pɛl haah la tile ta.
O ɛ sɔn o mun aa sɔah.
Sɔn laanee babelɔnjen, jwamane tena ne harɛ nɔ ta wedoŋa bwa nya.
N na haah la kɛ waa dɛɛra.
Korowii nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ teŋɛ Yeesu nɛɛ ba koh a waa kpoo ba la chalee o nyɔ dɛ dɛɛ.
Maa nao la, n nyoa kpoo taeh.
Nyundua torome la pɛɛ mɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he nyoa kpo nɔɔ?
Mɛɛ pili haah nɔ ne olchɔɡe la waa soɡe o ta o dɔ nyuune anuanɛ ne nyeɡlare fi la waane aa sɔah binii baɡle.
Olchɔɡe la haa nao la, o siwi fa lole.
Kɛ taraken te o siwi toole kpa.
O dɛ ba teehna dɛ́ le Bɔnsam Bɔluŋ la bini, dɛ́ la Korowii ka chɔɡo.
Nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta Korowii aa wola ba sɔna chwerɛ do Mkpa Tɔn la bini nyundua ne harɛ mumpar bwa la, ba nyoa ɛɛ kpoo ɡɛ saŋ baa na olchɔɡe la kɛŋɔ o fa aa lole waa wola berɛ do le kpa dɛ berɛ le la.
Dɛ he ta wejema dɔe yaa, haa won no waa nɔ mun.
Olchɔɡe la nyuune anuanɛ la cheɡɔ tɛ bwejena anuanɛ.
A taa haah la so.
A berɔ che tɛ koranar banuanɛ ɡe.
Ba bini banue toole kpa.
Bɛl ta dɛ di o kora.
Bɛl ɡe ta lole, o ta dii mɔɔ.
Dɛ o baa di aa, waa kora taa biɡri.
Olchɔɡe la o fa aa lole waa wola berɛ do le kpa la, o ɡe ɛ kooro nuatorote dɛ ja banuanɛ la nɛ.
O dɛ ba kaala Korowii ka chɔɡo.
Nyeɡlare fi haa naa la cheɡɔ tɛ koranar fi baa wola kora dii mɔɔ.
Ba tɔpere telaa, baa di koraa dɔŋhwere beŋkpoŋ ɡbo.
Ba ne olchɔɡe la bwaa dɛɛ ba pɛɛ di kora.
Koranar la bwa ɛɛ ɛ liire beŋkpoŋii, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kpeɡri bwa tɛ olchɔɡe la.
Ba ne Pebie la ɛɛ yo laalee, ásɛ Pebie la ne nɛra waa lee ba, dɛ kpɔ ba teŋɛ o nɛɛ ba waa dɔ kasinteŋ la pɔ ba nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ onee Dɔɔranar Bwa Dɔɔ dɛ ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro.” Nyundua torome la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ “Neerare la haa naa kɛŋɔ jwamane te la soɡe a nyoo la cheɡɔ tɛ wobol te bɛlbwa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
Nyeɡlare fi la haa naa a che tɛ koranar fi la ne olchɔɡe la ɛɛ hah hanjwamane laanee, dɛ́ foo o bwara komɛlbwa, dɛ́ ɡelo dakpaŋ ɡɛ.
Baa chwe o olii, ásɛ dɛ fuh o kabora, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii kpɔ ɡɛ do ba bambile bini kɛŋɔ bá ɛ waa waa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ ɡel ba ɛ liire beŋkpoŋ, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kpeɡri tɛ olchɔɡe la ó di ka tel kɛŋɔ waa Korowii aa bola la aa ɛa.
Haah la haa nao la cheɡɔ tɛ bwɛjen la waa dɔ harɛ nɔ ta kora bwa la.”
Babelɔn paɡra wa A habɔɔ la, n na nyundua torome bɛl o le nyundua dɛɛ tu.
O dɔ kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ.
O jirima nomanta, harɛ bwa chaahnɔ.
O nyɛɡɔ kohona ŋɔ, “O paɡrɔ oo, o paɡrɔ!
Babelɔnjen la paɡrɔ, dɛ berɛ kwaa aa dɛ ir nɛra nɛɛ ne Bɔnsam kwaa te bɛlbwa ne jumbisale baa kia la dobɔr, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɡelɔ harɛ ta nɛra bwa wedoŋa ne ba pɛlchɔɡa dɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ sen, asɛ ba waa fuh Korowii baah.
Harɛ nɔ ta koranar ne o bɔ jwamane.
O kondɔɔh kwaa nyina kohona nomanta, harɛ nɔ ta bonadiire cheɡɛ o nɛɛ dɛ dɛɡ.” N berɔ no taa bɛl o le nyundua dɛ ŋɔ, “N nɛra, hé le o be.
Maa nyin kɛ he ne o pɛ dɛ́ɛ ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ́ pɛ na wahala maa dɛ ba ɡela o na la.
O wechɔɡa daŋɔ tel Korowii doa, Korowii kpaŋro bil.
O chɔɡra, hé ɛo ɡɛ o fa aa ɛa la.
Hé bɔɔ o tonchɔɡa la kem kera anɛ.
Sen la o yon ɛ tɛ nɛra bá nyɔ dɛ́ɛ dɛɛ la, hé ɡe ɛ ane tɛo á do kpeɡri ɡwaa ɡɛ kera anɛ ó ɡe nyɔ.
Gɛ o fa aa kpɔ o te ɛ nɛnjen dɛɛ di o nyu ɡa la, hé ɡel o na hɔhɔrɔwa dɛ́ di suna ɡe kɛrɛdɛ.
O dɛ lii o nyu bini ŋɔ onee haŋkooro, o jaa ta sewɛ, o tea bini aa chɔɡ bwa.
Anomanta, tɔpebeŋkpoŋii wahala ne weela ne tebinichɔɡ ne lɔr ɛɛ ba o kpoe, ásɛ nii fuuh, dɛkalkɛŋɔ N Naa Korowii waa dɛ ba o waa bola dɛ́ pa bole laanee dɔ kpeɡri bwa.” Harɛ nɔ ta koranar ba ne waa dɛ bɔ jwamane dɛɛ di ba bwara la, baa ba na o chuu kɛ o dɛ fuh la, baa wiu dɛ́ɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre.
Baa che bojaŋee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ baa ɔmɛ o hɔhɔrɔwa waa dɛ na laanee dɛ́ɛ ŋɔ, “Akwe!
Akwe!
Bwɛjen Babelɔn la o tena fa aa dɛ di kpeɡri ɡa la, waa puu kerabeŋkpoŋ o paɡre.” Ásɛ harɛ nɔ ta bonadiire ɛɛ wiu dɛ́ɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nɛn toole dɛ́ yawɛ ba kwaa kpa.
Nɛn toole dɛ́ yawɛ ba suuɡaswɛm, suuɡapoŋa, ne bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, ne yapondɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi, ne dasɔɔhsoma a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa soo siwi, ne kwaa baa kpɔ bala nyena ɛa, ne kwaa baa kpɔ dadɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa sɛah, ne anɔ la baa kpɔ ayaawa ne bune loɡa, ne anɔ la baa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane soo siwi ɛa la, ne konsɔɔhsoma bwa soo siwi, anɔ la baa dɛ fuh, ne anɔ la baa dɛ fɔɡle, ne sen, ne noo, ne mendɛɛɡa, ne mea, ne nae, ne peera, ne jaɡre, dɛ torɔɡore ba yon vɔwɛ pɛl la.
Ba yoɡ nɛra ɡe kɛŋɔ kondɛɛra ken.
Bonadiire la ɛɛ bol bwɛjen Babelɔn la waa ŋɔ, “Kwaa a pɛla aa dɔe la le he nɔn ta.
He kondikondɛɛɡa ne kondɛɛɡa fuoh.
Haa an na kpa bwa.” Banɔ la ba fa aa yoɡ a ɡɛ kwaa dɛ dɔ suuɡa a ta la ɛɛ che bojaŋee, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba dɛ ɔmɛ hɔhɔrɔwa aa puu la, dɛɛ wiu dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre, dɛɛ wi ŋɔ, “Akwe!
Akwe!
Waa pu bwɛjen la o nɛra fa aa dɛ do yapondɛɛɡa a sie aa swɛɛra, dɛ do ɡimeɡime ne answɛɛma peihpeih, dɛɛ do baŋa kwa, ne deŋna kwa, ne nɔnloɡa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm dɛ bwedɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi ɛa la, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o kwaa waa dɔa ɡa la bwa fuoh dɔŋhwere beŋkpoŋ.” Ásɛ nɛra baa dɛ kah stiimaere, ne nɛra baa jo a bini dɛɛ la bobɛla, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma a bini, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma bwa soo siwi mpo ta che bojaŋ.
Baa na ɡɛ waa dɛ fuh, ásɛ chuu ɛɛ le la, baa kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Jo bɛ le!
Bwɛjen nɔ dɔŋ toole wɛɛ fuh ɡɛ la.” Ba loo ɛɛ kuu, bá ɛ teera ta ba nyuune ta, dɛ́ɛ wiu dɛ́ɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre, dɛ́ ŋɔ, “Akwe!
Akwe!
Waa pu bwɛjen kondɔɔh aa su o bwa, dɛ ɡel nɛra baa dɔ stiimaere do mpo ta berɛ dɔɔhna la.
O paŋɛ komɛlbwa dɔŋhwere beŋkpoŋ.
Korowii doa tena ne Korowii nɛra he wa aa toɡra, ne Yeesu toroma, dɛ Korowii keamere, hé ɡel he sie lɛ a wa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii tɛr o deŋne wechɔɡa waa kpɔa ɛ heyaa la wa.” Belaa nyundua torome bokpeɡa te bɛl ɡɔɔ bwe bɛl waa do kan kɛŋɔ nambwejen, dɛ kpɔ ta mpo ta, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kenii baa ba bwɛjen Babelɔn la kpɔe dɛ́ ta kpeɡri nɛɛ baa wola on na kpa bwa.
Baa nɛra baa dɛ lɔ janjela, ne banɔ la baa dɛ hoh kalipere ne bɛle, ne komɛlbwaa na he bini kpa.
Gɛɛ baa wola nɛra baa dɛ sɛh kwa, ne nɛra baa dɛ sɔh kwa, ne banɔ la baa jemɛ toma bwa soo siwi he binii na kpa.
Baa nambwe ɡe sii no bela kpa.
Kandea bɛlbwa aa belaa chaah kpa.
Baa hanfala ne ba jaranar taa no bela bwa.
He bonadiire ɛ nɛnjena ba dɔŋa aa wola toole harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa.
He wono berɛ harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa liire, ba nyoɡre kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ tɛɡchɔɡa dɛɛ berɛ nɛn liire la.
Korowii keamere ne o nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, ne nɛra baa kpoo ba harɛ nɔ ta bwa la, ba chalee bá na bwɛɛ la ta la.”
Korowii kpɛɛra A habɔɔ la, n no waane Korowii doa kɛŋɔ nɛnlaa tenten ɡbɔɡa baa si, “Hé kpɛɛ N Naa Korowii!
Onee lɛ nɛwɛnyina, on chɛ jirima, on dɔ kpeɡri bwa, dɛkalkɛ ɡɛ waa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole la ɛ kasinteŋ dɛ toɡre.
O pa hanjwamane tenten la waa ɛ wedoŋa, dɛ chɔɡ harɛ nɔ la bolchɔɡe, dɛ tɛr o deŋne dɛ kpɔ bɔ o bonɔɔna ne toli waa kpoo ba la kem.” Ba berɔ si ja, “Hé kpɛɛ N Naa Korowii!
Babelɔn chuu ɛɛ dɛɛ kaa nyundua saŋ bɛlbwaa.” Nomonome fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ la ne hweera kwaa anaarɛ la ɡuŋo dɛɛ duu Korowii waa soɡe o kookara ta la, dɛɛ si, “Aamen.
Hé kpɛɛ N Naa Korowii!” Asɛ taa bɛl le kookara la ta dɛ ŋɔ, “He nɛra haa ɛ N Naa Korowii bonɔɔna ne o toli la, hɛ́ɛ tɛo sɔn.
He bini nɛŋɡwɛɡra ne nɛnjena haa dɛ ɔmɔ bwa, hɛ́ɛ tɛo sɔn.” N berɔ no nɛnlaa tenten baa dɛ bol waa kɛŋɔ chuubu aa dɛ si la, a berɛ do kɛŋɔ bwaala aa dɛ kɔɡre kohona la.
Ba ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ N Naa Korowii!
Korowii Waa Ɛ Koranar Bwa Kooro la dɛ di kora.
Hé ɡel ya sie lɛ ya hɛɡre kohona.
Yá tɛo sɔn, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Pebie la hanfale lawa telo.
O haah ɡe kpɔ o te cheɡ.
Ba kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe kpelkpel tɛo ó tɔ.” Anee nyundua torome la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Chwerɛ waa nɔ bil.
Nɛra baa yer ba ŋɔ bá ba di Pebie la hanfale kwaa la na som,” dɛ́ berɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii wobolee, a ɛ kasinteŋ.” Belaa n ɡuŋi o sie, dɛ fee ŋɔ n duuru, asɛ o ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡɛ ɛ. N ne hen ne he bala la baa lawɛ Yeesu waa bini la bwa ɛ o bonɔɔna.
Korowiirii chɛ kɛ he duu.
Yeesu waa waa baɡla laanee ɛ keamere la bwa wobol.” Nɛn waa soɡe jaaɡɔpoŋ ta wa Asɛ n na kɛŋɔ nyundua aa pila, jaaɡɔpoŋ bɛl le.
Nɛn waa soɡe o ta la, ba dɛ yerɔ Kasinteŋ Te, o waa do Goroŋ.
O dɛ bol nɛra waa kasinteŋ ne, dɛɛ yo laa aŋwɛnɛ ta.
O sibie do kɛŋɔ ninlao ken.
O pi kooɡbɛrɛre a warɛ pirim.
O sɔn bɛl dawɛ o nɛ, nomɛlbwa aa wola sɔn la jemɛ nemenɛ o ɡbo.
O sɔn bɛl ɡee Korowii Nyoa Wobol.
O tɔ yal bɛl baa kpɔa li chal.
Nyundua dɔm baa dɛ la laa do yapondɛɛɡa aa wera, dɛ so jaaɡɔpoŋa ta dɛ teŋɛ o nɛ.
Asɛ tokobii waa nyɛɡa ɛɛ le o nyoa, o kpɔ dɛɛ ba harɛ ta nɛra bwa yoi, dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.
Wɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛɛ kpeɡri ne aŋwɛnɛ taa, dɛ́ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ baa dɛ sa daa nɔna baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen ta a nee ɛɛ le la.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ bandiaa a nee la.
Sɔn bɛl dawɛ o yal ne o hwii ta.
Gɛ sɔn laanee koranar bwa kooro ne dɔɔranar bwa dɔɔ.
N berɔ na nyundua torome bɛl o che wee ta, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ jumbii aa dɛ ɡah nyundua bwa be ŋɔ, “Hé bwa ba cheme Korowii kondikonjena la mun.
Koranar ne soojanomonome, ne nɛnjena, ne jaɡre ne a dɔɔranar, ne nɛra bwa, ba bini banɔ la baa dɔ ba te ne yoma, ne nomonjena, dɛ bechale bwa serewɔ.
Anomanta, hé ba di ba ola.” Belaa n na olchɔɡe la, ne harɛ ta koranar, ne ba dɔm aa kpɔ ba te dɛɛ ba, dɛ́ ba yo naate waa soɡe jaaɡɔ ta la ne o dɔm.
Kɛ ba lawɛ olchɔɡe la, ne keamechɔɡe la o fa aa dɛ ɛ wejena dɛɛ tɛ olchɔɡe la, dɛɛ neɡre nɛra baa dɔ olchɔɡe la nso dɛɛ tomɛ kon baa mao o do kɛ olchɔɡe la.
Ba kpɔ ba bwa ne ba siweela ka ta bela nii ne jebɔrɔwe aa yɛɛra chɔ kɛŋɔ moo dɛɛ fuh.
Naate waa soɡe jaaɡɔ ta la kpɔ tokobinyɛɡ waa le o nyoa ta la kpoo olchɔɡe la nɛra baa kaa la, asɛ jumbii la bwa di ba ola ɡɛ aa wona.
Bene kaɡboŋ wa Belaa n berɛ na nyundua torome bɛl o le nyundua dɛɛ tu.
Waa dɛ tu la, dɛ o kpoŋe Bɔnsam Bɔluŋ la safoa ne jɔɡrɔjen bɛl.
O kaa lawɛ kontuuɡi damanta o fa aa ɛ harɛkon ya jemɛ o waa le mumpar la, baa yerɔ Baradeɛre Te kɛɛ Bɔnsam la.
O kpɔ jɔɡrɔre la vɔrɔwo bil bene kaɡboŋ, dɛ kpɔɔ ka ta Bɔnsam Bɔluŋ la bini, dɛ laa tɔ, dɛ karɔ kiŋkiŋ o bɛ nɛra baa lɔ harɛ ta neɡre ka tel kɛŋɔ bene kaɡboŋ la aa tela.
Dɛ tɔpere la telaa, baa puruu o le tama.
N na kookane, asɛ nɛra bane so a ta, asɛ Korowii tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ bá won dɛɛ bol nɛra waa dɛ́ɛ pa bole.
N na lala ba fa aa teŋɛ Yeesu kasinteŋ waa la ta, dɛ bol Korowii Wa, dɛ vɛh olchɔɡe la ne kon la baa mao la toma.
Ba ta ɡelɛ ba do ba o nso la ba tili ne ba nɔɔra ta.
Ba koh a waa teŋni ba nyuune.
Ba ir seo ta, asɛ ba ne Kristo pɛ dɛɛ di kora bene kaɡboŋ.
Lala seo ta ira loɡlee ɡɛ.
Banɔ la baa kaa baa wola ire la te, nemenɛ bene kaɡboŋ la tel mɔɔ bá ir.
Nɛra baa tɔ sie ir seo ta la na som.
Korowii nɛraa ban.
Seo nɛɛtena la ta kpeɡri dɔe ba nɛɛ kpa.
Baa ɛ Korowii ne Kristo sɔforee, ásɛ ba ne o pɛ di kora bene kaɡboŋ.
Bɔnsam bwɛɛlɛ Dɛ bene kaɡboŋ la telaa, baa pur Bɔnsamee dɛ́ yao ta.
O leɔ waa, wɛɛ ba neɡre nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwaa, Gɔɡ tena ne Maɡɔɡ tena, dɛ́ pona ba, bá warɛ kɛŋɔ mpo nyoa hɛŋle ken, dɛ́ kpɔ ba yo laa.
N na ba ba wur ba tɔ harɛ bwa, dɛ bar bwɛjen Korowii aa dɛ nyinu o nɛra do o ta la.
Asɛ nii le nyundua, dɛ ba le ba nɛɛ dɛ fuh ba bwa kwaraa.
Ba lawɛ Bɔnsam waa neɡ ba la ɡe, dɛ ta bela nii ne jebɔrɔwe aa yɛɛra chɔ kɛŋɔ moo la, bela olchɔɡe ne keame nyosonteŋna la aa lole la.
Baa na hɔhɔrɔwa chɔɔ ne jwaanaa aa wola jaɡa dɔe.
Nɛra baa serewa waa bola dɛ́ pa bole wa N berɔ na kookara damanta ompoŋ bɛl.
Nɛn waa soɡe o ta la, nyundua ne harɛ nao dɛ nyoɡre, ba ta on nae kpa.
Belaa n na nɛra baa serewa bwa, ba bini nomonjena ne bechale bwa, asɛ ba che kookara la sie.
Ba pili tɔne ane, asɛ dɛ berɛ pili onɔ la waa ɛ Mkpa Tɔn la.
Belaa Korowii che toma nɛra la aa ɛa mɔɔ dɛ serewe a do tɔne la bini la ta, dɛ bol ba waa dɛ pa bole.
Nɛra baa ka mpo ta la leɔ, asɛ nɛra baa sewɛ seo bwa soo siwi la ɡe le, asɛ Korowii che ɡɛ ba fa aa ɛa ta, dɛ bol ba waa dɛ pa bole.
Belaa ba kpɔ seo ne Lalabwɛɛ bwa ta nidamanta aa yɛɛra chɔ kɛŋɔ moo la ta.
Gɛ nii nɔɔ seo nɛɛte la.
Nomɛlbwa baa nyiŋi Mkpa Tɔn la bini dɛ nyin o sɔn kahonɛ la, dɛ ba kpɔɔ ka ta nii la ta.
Nyundufale ne harɛfale wa Belaa n na nyundufale ne harɛfale bɛl.
Dɛ nyundua ne harɛ la a fa aa lole la te nyoɡrɔ, asɛ mpo ɡe nyoɡre.
N berɔ na Korowii bwɛjen Jerusalamfale o le Korowii be dɛɛ ba harɛ.
Korowii kwaaro kɛrɛdɛ kɛŋɔ hanfale yon kpɔ o te dɛɛ ba o jaa be la.
Asɛ n no takpeɡ bɛl o le kookara la ta, dɛ ŋɔ “Hɛ́ɛ no!
Taraken Korowii dobɔree nɛwɛnyini bini.
O ne banee dɛ́ so, bá ɛ o nɛra ásɛ o ɡe ɛ ba Korowii, ba ne o so.
Wɛɛ fee ba sinii bwaa ta baa wola wi kpa.
Seo aa lee do kpa.
Lokua ne wii ne bwadabii wee aa lee do kpa, dɛkalkɛ webena la bwa toole kpa.” Anee naate waa soɡe kookara la ta la ŋɔ, “Taraken n ɡelɔ wobɛlbwa berɛ anfala.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Chwerɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ n wobol nɔ ɛ kpela, neɡra toole a ta.” Asɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “A tonɔ!
Menee komɛlbwa Sitɔɔ ne a Muŋkaa, menee wobɛlbwa Mumpar ne a Jaɡa.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa dɛ wi nyɔɡre aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo o la bela mkpa nee aa bula dɛɛ le, dɛ́ ka nyɔ ane pɛɛpɛɛ.
Naate waa wona yo le la ɛɛ dɔ kwaa nɔ bwaa.
Mɛɛ ɛ Korowii waa dɛ tom mɛ, ásɛ o ɡe ɛ n bie.
Kɛ ɔmeera ne nɛra baa wola men yarada, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ waa maa kia, ne nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra, ne nɛra baa dɛ bɔ jwamane, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ bebeewa, ne voɡtoroma dɛ nyosonteŋna.
Ba bwa bɔree nii ne jebɔrɔwe aa yɛɛra chɔ kɛŋɔ moo dɛɛ fuh la ta.
Anee seo nɛɛtena la.” Belaa nyundua toroma banuanɛ la ba fa aa kpoŋe loɡa hɔhɔrɔwa bele anuanɛ aa ka mun la aa su a bwa la bɛl ba, dɛ ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Ba ń baɡle Pebie la hanfale la.” Anee Korowii Domadɛɛɡe ir n nɛ, asɛ nyundua torome la kpɔ mɛ kaa bwejen bɛl doa.
O kpeɡo kɛrɛdɛ.
Belaa o baɡ mɛ Korowii bwɛjen Jerusalam la kɛ waa le Korowii be nyundua dɛɛ ba harɛ.
Dɛ Korowii jirima ɡelɔ o bwa ɛɛ nyɛɡle kɛŋɔ bwedɛɛɡe baa dɛ yerɔ jasepa o do wer kohona dɛ do ɡereŋ la.
Danjwɛjen bɛl waa kpeɡa kohona baro cheme.
O doonyoone lɔ fi dɛ anɛ, asɛ nyundua toroma fi dɛ banɛ ɡe cheche a ta.
Ba chwerɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la sɔna dawɛ doonyoone la ta.
O doonyoone la, atoro lɔ wee leebɔr, atoro do weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, atoro do wee cholibɔr, asɛ atoro ɡe do weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
Bwea baa ma danjwɛɛ la chɔŋɛ a ta la lɔ fi dɛ anɛ, asɛ Pebie la toroma fi dɛ banɛ la ɡe sɔna dawɛ bwea la ta.
Nyundua torome waa bol waa n be la kpoŋe suuɡaswɛm daa baa dɛ maɡɛ o ne kwa, dɛɛ ba bwɛɛ la ne o doonyoone dɛ danjwɛɛ la maɡa.
Bwɛjen la ɛ fɔɔskwɛɛ.
O paɡri ne o jaŋne bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
O kpɔ daa la dɛ maɡɛ bwɛɛ la, o jaŋne lɔ kwansini kaɡboŋ lafraanue.
O paɡri ne o jaŋne, ne o nyundua kpeɡa bwa beŋkpoŋ.
O maɡɛ danjwɛɛ la.
O kpeɡa del ɡe lɔ naɡale lafraanɛ dɛ fi dɛ anumɛl.
Gɛ nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ maɡɛ kwaa la, ɡɛɛ o maɡa.
Bwɛɛ la danjwɛɛ la, bwedɛɛɡa baa yera jasepa la ɡboo ba kpɔ mao.
Asɛ bwɛɛ la tenten ɡe, suuɡaswɛm tenten aa do ɡereŋ kɛŋɔ diɡii ba kpɔ mao.
Bwea fi dɛ anɛ baa ma danjwɛɛ la chɔŋɛ a ta la ɛ bwedɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.
A ɡelɔ o do wer.
Bweloɡle la sɔne jasepa, nɛɛte la ɡe sɔne safaya, asɛ toorote la ɡe sɔne aɡat.
Onɔ la waa teŋa naarɛ la ɡe sɔne ɛmeral.
Onɔ la waa teŋa nue la sɔne onis, numɛlte la sɔne kanɛɛleɔn, nuanɛte la ɡe sɔne kwats, nuatorote la ɡe bɛrel, nuanaarɛ topas, asɛ onɔ la waa teŋa fi la sɔne chalsedone, fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ te la ɡe sɔne tɛɛkoes, asɛ fi dɛ anɛ te la ɡe sɔne ametes.
Doonyoone fi dɛ anɛ la ɡe la, bwedɛɛɡa baa dɛ yera pɛɛlre laanee ba kpɔ kwaa a bwa ɡbeni, bɛlbwa di ombir.
Bwɛɛ la fɔɡbaah ɡe ɛ suuɡaswɛm tenten dɛ do ɡereŋ kɛŋɔ diɡi ken.
Korowii Dea baa cheme o bini dɛɛ tomɔ toole bela.
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la ne Pebie laanee cheɡa tɛ dea la.
A ta hiaih kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie chaah bela.
Korowii jirima dɛ chaah bela, asɛ Pebie la ɡe ɛ kandea bela.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ɛɛ ba valɛ o bochaah la taa, ásɛ koranar baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ɡe kpɔ ba jirima baa dɔa la ba jo o ta.
O doonyoone yao che, aa wola tɔ saŋ bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ bɔr aa bela jo.
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra ɛɛ kpɔ ba jirima baa dɔa, ne ba kondɛɛɡa bwaa jo bela.
Kɛ komɛlbwa doŋa te bɛlbwa aa lɔ o nɛɛ la aa won jo bela, ɡɛɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe waa dɛ ɛ sihihwaa dɛɛ teŋe nyosone la bɛlbwa ɡe aa wola won jo bela.
Nɛra baa chwerɛ ba sɔna do Pebie Mkpa Tɔn la bini la, banee dɛ́ won jo bela.
Nee bɛl waa dɔ mkpa dɛ do ɡereŋ wa Belaa nyundua torome la baɡ mɛ moo bɛl waa pala dɛɛ le Korowii ne Pebie la kookara la ta.
Nee la dɔ mkpa dɛ do ɡereŋ ken, dɛ palɛ dɛɛ kpɔ bwɛɛ la fɔɡbaah tenten.
Mkpa daa anɛ che o baŋne anɛ bwa ta, fɔɡbaah bela.
Mkpa daa la dɛ nɔnɛ kera fi dɛ anɛ benanyoa, korobie bɛlbwa kera beŋkpoŋ.
O papooni ɡe wono chah nɛra bwa weela.
Komɛlbwa Korowii aa taahno la aa bwɛɛ la taa do.
Korowii ne Pebie la kookara la chebɔree bela, ásɛ o bonɔɔna ne toli ɛɛ tomɔ, dɛ́ɛ nao, ásɛ o sɔn ɡe dawɛ ba tili ta.
Bɔr aa belaa dɛɛ jo, baa kandea ne weeree hiah, dɛkalkɛ N Naa Korowii ɛɛ dɛɛ chaah ba nɛɛ, ásɛ baa di koraa saŋ te bɛlbwa.
Yeesu bala wa Belaa nyundua torome la ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Waa nɔ ɛ kpela, nyosone bɛlbwa toole a ta.
N Naa Korowii o fa aa ir keamere nɛɛ la, onee tom mɛ ásɛ n ba baɡle waa aa dɛ ba ɛɛ taraken la, ásɛ o bonɔɔna ne toli jemɛ.” Yeesu ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no!
N dɛ ba taraken.
Nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ waa nɔ aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini, dɛɛ baɡle waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere la bini kpoŋe la na som.” Men Jɔn, menee no waa nɔ dɛ naa.
Maa noa dɛ naa la, n ɡuŋi nyundua torome waa baɡ mɛ waa nɔ la sie, dɛ fee ŋɔ ń duuru, asɛ o ŋɔ, “Bɛ ɡɛ ɛ. N ɡba ɛ Korowii bonɔɔ la bɛl kɛŋɔ he ne he bala keamere la ne nɛra la bwa baa dɛ no tɔn nɔ bini waa nɔ.
Korowiirii chɛ kɛŋɔ hé duu.” O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bɛ waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere dɛ do tɔn nɔ bini kpɔ sɔh.
Ka baɡla, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tɔpere la telo tonɛ kɛŋɔ waa nɔ bwa ba ɛ. Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la, ó te ɛ dɛɛ la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wedoŋa la, ó te ɛ dɛɛ la.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa la, wɛ́ɛ ɛ o wedɛɛɡa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe wa aa toɡra la teŋɛ dɛ́ do ɡɛ dɛɛ la.” Yeesu bolɔ ŋɔ, “Hɛ́ɛ no bonɔ!
N dɛ ba taraken.
N dɛ ba kembɔr maa dɛ ba nɛra tɛɛ la ne.
Gɛ nomɛlbwa toma aa doa laanee mɛɛ ba on kem bɔe.
Menee komɛlbwa Sitɔɔ, menee a Muŋkaa.
Menee wobɛlbwa Mumpar ne a Jaɡa.
Nɛra baa chɛɡɛ ba laala a do wer la na som, dɛkalkɛŋɔ banee dɛ́ won dɔ Mkpa Daa la nɔna di, dɛ́ won kpɔ doonyoone la ta ba tetoora dɛ́ɛ jo bwɛjen la ta.
Nɛndoŋa, ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ bebeewa, ne jwamane tena, ne nɛra baa dɛ kpoo nɛra, ne voɡtoroma, ne banɔ la bwa ba sie aa dɛ lɛ nyosone teŋa, ne nɛra neɡra la te, ba ka bwɛɛ la dahare.
Menee Yeesu, men tomɛ n torome ŋɔ ó ba baɡle waa nɔ, ásɛ he ka baɡle asɔre tena.
Devid Dwee men.
O Naa men.
Menee Chɔmbibi Wewee waa dɛ chaah kɛrɛdɛ la.” Korowii Domadɛɛɡe la ne hanfale la dɛ yerɛ ŋɔ, “Ba!” Nomɛlbwa waa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, ó ɡe ŋɔ, “Ba!” Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ wi nyɔɡre la, wɛ́ɛ ba.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin nee aa dɛ tɛ mkpa la dɛ́ nyɔ la, wɛɛ dɔɔ nyɔ pɛɛpɛɛ.
N dɛ kah nomɛlbwa waa no waa nɔ aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini dɛɛ baɡle waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere la kɛŋɔ, dɛ nomɛlbwa kpɔ waane ja a ta naa, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ wahala maa baɡle a waa tɔn nɔ bini laanee ta o nɛ.
Dɛ nomɛlbwa laa waa aa dɛ ba bala kerekere nɔ bini ane tamaa bɛlbwa kpɔ a ta naa, Korowii aa on mkpa daa maa baɡle o waa tɔn nɔ bini la nɔnaa tɛ ó di.
Waa on bɔree tɛ o bwɛjen waa do ɡoroŋ la maa baɡle o waa la ta.
Naate waa ɛ waa nɔ bwa danseɛ la ŋɔ, “Kpelaa, n dɛ ba taraken!” Aamen.
N Dɔɔ Yeesu, ba warane!
Yá Dɔɔ Yeesu cha he bwa sekwaraa haa ɛ Korowii nɛra la.
Aamen.
